default.zh: 信号处理目前已成为信息技术领域的基础学科。计算机和专用数字硬件的使用，使得各种复杂信号的处理技术得以实施，而这在以前是不可能的。本课程既简要描述信号处理最基本的内容也介绍最新应用。它是基于授课者在本领域的科研经验及学生最常遇到的概念，问题和技巧。其目标是使听众能将信号处理技术应用到他们自己感兴趣的领域，能理解信号处理领域里的专业文献，以及获得学习更先进技术和应用的背景。
default.en: Signal processing nowadays becomes a fundamental discipline in the field of information technology. Due to the use of computers and special purpose digital hardware, a variety of sophisticated signal processing techniques can be implemented, which was previously not possible. This lecture gives an introduction of both signal processing fundamentals and recent applications. It is designed based on the present lecturer's research experiences in the field in question and the concepts, problems and skills most commonly encountered by the students. Its goals are to enable the audience to apply signal processing techniques to their own field of interest, to make it possible for the audience to understand the technical literature on signal processing, and to provide the background for the study of more advanced topics and applications.

default.zh: 电子商务技术与研究前沿是一门与国外高水平专家共建的夏季学期课程。通过本课程学生将学习电子商务系统的基本概念，并通过分析和使用国际知名系统来了解其基本特点。进而掌握电子商务系统分析、设计和实施的基本要素和技能。此外，课程还将介绍电子商务研究领域的一些课题，如拍卖、协商、软件代理和信誉度计算，并展示相关领域的最新研究成果。课程以英语授课，注重实践与研究并重，旨在提高学生的动手能力，培养研究兴趣。不论学生将来选择进入工业界工作还是继续深造，都将受益匪浅。
default.en: E-Commerce Technology and Recent Research Progress is a summer semester course co-developed with high-level foreign experts. Through this course, students will learn the basic concepts of e-commerce systems and understand their basic characteristics by analyzing and using internationally renowned systems. Furthermore, they will master the basic elements and skills of e-commerce system analysis, design and implementation. In addition, the course will also introduce some topics in the research field of e-commerce, such as auctions, negotiations, software agents and reputation calculation, and present the latest research achievements in related fields. The course is taught in English, with equal emphasis on practice and research, aiming to improve students' practical ability and cultivate their interest in research. Whether students choose to enter the industry or continue their studies in the future, they will benefit a lot.

default.zh: 照明系统在工业国家中占据了近20%的能源消耗，因此，对于理工科本科学生而言，照明是一项很重要的课题。在本课程中，光、视觉、颜色以及照明系统的基本概念将作为第一部分介绍。第二部分将会讲解不同的光源，如白炽灯、气体放电灯以及LED灯，其中驱动白炽灯与气体放电灯的辅助设备及其电路将被展开讨论。由于LED灯源如今已得到了广泛地应用，驱动LED的直流与交流功率变换器将被作为重点讲解。最后将会讲解若干例设计范例，并利用计算机仿真来验证所设计的设备的工作状态，来帮助同学们更好地理解课程内容。
default.en: Lighting systems account for nearly 20% of all the electrical energy consumed in the industrialized countries. Therefore, it can be understood that Lighting is an important topic for undergraduate engineering students. In this course, the basic concepts related to light, vision, color and lighting design will be treated in a first part. In a second part of the course, the different light sources will be presented, including incandescent lamps, discharge lamps and very popular LED or solid-state lamps. The different auxiliary equipment used to drive incandescent and discharge lamps will also be expounded, including most common electronic circuits. Since, LED lamps are very relevant nowadays in lighting applications, power converters for DC and AC supplied applications will be presented in detail. Finally, some design examples will be carried out, performing computer simulations to verify the correct operation of the developed designs.

default.zh: 将光化学与电化学方法合并使用，以研究光能与电能和化学能的转换的学科，属于化学与电学的交叉学科。并介绍光电功能材料的相关知识。
default.en: The photochemical and electrochemical methods were combined to study the conversion of light energy and electrical and chemical energy of discipline, a chemical and electrical interdisciplinary. Learn the relevant knowledge of optoelectronic functional materials.

default.zh: 从过程质量控制及测量质量控制技术方面着手，来探索航空航天产品质量的控制方法和措施，力图提供一种航空航天产品质量控制的工程实现方法。使学生掌握过程控制的基本知识，培养学生对质量控制问题的认识和分析能力，并且提高学生在将来解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: From the aspects of process quality control and measurement quality control technology, we explore methods and measures for the aerospace product quality control, and try to provide an aerospace engineering realization method of the product quality control. It aims to let students master the basic knowledge of process control, cultivate students to realize and analyze the problems of quality control, and improve students' ability to solve practical problems in the future.

default.zh: 流体力学是研究各种流体现象以及相关力学行为的科学。现在微纳米尺度的流动已经出现在很多场合。尽管在科学和工程中已经得到了广泛应用，但微纳米尺度流动通常得不到很好的理解，主要原因是流体力学研究的出发点就是建立在宏观而非微观的基础上。本门课程在宏观尺度流体力学的基础上，还将着重讲解微观尺度的流体力学。课程不仅将分析目标放在这些流动现象，而且还会讲解一些计算机仿真模型。此外，鉴于粒子图像速度计（PIV）以及其相关技术如微米PIV已经快速的成为流体或类流体材料的运动的常用测量方法。本课程还将简要介绍PIV技术的基本科学原理和应用案例。通过本课程学习可以夯实学生的基础理论和应用的基础，开拓学生国际视野，培养学生将来从事交叉学科研究的能力。
default.en: Fluid mechanics studies fluids and the forces on them. Microscopic flows are appearing everywhere these days. Despite their prevalence in science and engineering fields, they are not well understood-in large part because the fluid mechanics intuition developed in the study of macroscale flows frequently does not apply to microscopic flows. The course will concentrate on behaviors not typically important at large length scales that become very important at small length scales. The course will take a largely analytical approach to studying these flow phenomena although some computational modeling will also performed. Particle image velocimetry (PIV) and related techniques such as micro-PIV are quickly becoming the standard tools for measuring fluids and fluid-like materials in motion. The course will also briefly introduce the basic scientific principles and applications underlying the PIV technique. The purpose for this course is consolidating students' basic theory and application foundation, developing students' international vision, cultivating students' ability to engage in interdisciplinary research in the future.

default.zh: 本课程介绍了金属的结构性能关系和其制造的相关内容，使其能在机械设计中有效的利用。在完成本课程时，同学们应当掌握： -熟悉常见的晶体结构,金属的力学性能;其变形,加强和腐蚀机制； -熟练描述金属成形过程的主要特征； -能进一步了解金属加工,特别是机械切割和激光烧蚀。
default.en: To provide a fundamental understanding of structure-property relations in metals and their manufacture to enable their effective utilization in mechanical design. On completion of the course a student should be able to: - Be familiar with common crystal structures, mechanical properties of metals; their deformation, strengthening and corrosion mechanisms; - Describe the main characteristics of metal shaping processes; - Have a further understanding of metal machining and in particular mechanical cutting and laser ablation.

default.zh: 随着现代机械装备朝着高精度、高效、大功率的方向发展，流体动力装备应用越来越广泛。流体力学是机械类专业的一门技术基础课，通过本课程使学生掌握流体平衡与运动的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，为学生学习后续课程和掌握专业知识以及为今后解决工程问题奠定初步的流体力学理论基础。
default.en: Nowadays, modern machinery is all about high precision, efficiency, and power, so fluid power systems are being used more and more. Fluid mechanics is a core technical subject for mechanical engineering students. This course gives them the basic theories, knowledge, and skills to understand how fluids behave—both when they're still and when they're moving. It sets the foundation for later studies, helps them get to grips with specialist knowledge, and gives them the basics they'll need to tackle real-world engineering problems.

default.zh: 在本课程中学生将会首先系统地学习不同类型材料的机械性能及其测试方法的基本原理。接下来他们将会学习材料变形和实效的微结构机理，以此理解材料内部微结构与其机械性能之间的联系。通过本课程的学习他们将能够应用这些知识来解决材料力学问题。
default.en: The students receive a repetition of the basic principles of mechanical properties of different classes of materials and testing methods. In the following they gain understanding of the correlation between microstructure and mechanical properties of materials by learning the micro-structural mechanisms of deformation and failure. They develop the skills to apply this knowledge to materials science problems.

default.zh: 本课程讲授景观研究的基本概念，方法，技能和过程。课程讲授结合研究实例，最终使学生得到景观研究的直观体验。
default.en: This course introduces students with design backgrounds to a range of research issues in the discipline of landscape architecture, including research concepts, methods, techniques, and process. Various types of research methods will be introduced and discussed in terms of their applications in landscape architecture. Other academic topics, such as documenting bibliography, academic journals, attending conferences, are also introduced.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍高级非线性有限元的网状设计、本构模型、边界条件以及静态分析、动态分析方法。着重讲解商用有限元软件Abaqus在汽车，能源和制造工程中的应用.
default.en: This course mainly introduces the advanced nonlinear finite element methods regarding the mesh design, the constitutive model, the boundary conditions and the static analysis, dynamic analysis. It focuses on the commercial finite element software Abaqus and its application in the automotive, energy and manufacturing engineering.

default.zh: 思想政治理论实践课程是思想政治理论课堂教学的延伸，通过“线上理论方法学习，线下投身社会实践”的实践教学环节，引导学生深入剖析近现代中国政治兴替背后的原因、引导学生深刻认识到中国人民怎样选择了马克思主义和中国共产党，实现树立正确历史观、学懂弄通做实习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想、牢固树立中国特色社会主义的道路自信、理论自信、制度自信和文化自信的教学目标，帮助大学生形成崇高的理想信念，弘扬伟大的爱国主义精神，确立正确的世界观、人生观和价值观，引导学生学以致用，提高他们分析问题和解决问题的能力，自觉投身于中国特色社会主义建设事业。
default.en: Practicum on Ideological and Political Theories is an extension of the classroom teaching of Ideological and political theory. Through the practical teaching link of "online theoretical method learning, offline social practice", students are guided to deeply analyze the reasons behind the rise and fall of modern China's politics, to deeply understand how the Chinese people chose Marxism and the Communist Party of China, and to realize the establishment of a correct historical view Xi Jinping, a student of the new socialist China, and firmly establishing the teaching goal of China's own socialist road, self-confidence, theoretical self-confidence, institutional self-confidence and cultural self-confidence.It further aims to establish a correct world view, outlook on life and value systems, to guide students to apply what they have learned to improve their abilities to analyze and solve problems, and consciously to devote themselves to the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics.

default.zh: 军事课是普通高等学校学生的必修课程。军事课以习近平强军思想和习近平总书记关于教育的重要论述为遵循，全面贯彻党的教育方针、新时代军事战略方针和总体国家安全观，围绕立德树人根本任务和强军目标根本要求，着眼培育和践行社会主义核心价值观,以提升学生国防意识和军事素养为重点，为实施军民融合发展战略和建设国防后备力量服务。普通高等学校通过军事课教学，让学生了解掌握军事基础知识和基本军事技能，增强国防观念、国家安全意识和忧患危机意识，弘扬爱国主义精神、传承红色基因、提高学生综合国防素质。军事课纳入普通高等学校人才培养体系，列入学校人才培养方案和教学计划，实行学分制管理，课程考核成绩记入学籍档案。军事课由《军事理论》《军事技能》两部分组成。《军事理论》教学时数36学时，记2学分。
default.en: Military course is a compulsory course for students in Colleges and universities. The military lesson should be guided by Xi Jinping's idea of strengthening the army and general secretary Xi Jinping's important exposition on education, fully implementing the party's educational policy, the new military strategy and the overall national security concept, focusing on the fundamental requirements of the basic mission and the goal of strengthening the army, focusing on cultivating and practicing the socialist core values and focusing on improving the national defense consciousness and military accomplishment of the students. We will implement the strategy of integrating military and civilian development and build a reserve force for national defense. Through the teaching of military courses, ordinary colleges and universities let students understand and master the basic military knowledge and skills, enhance the national defense concept, national security awareness and crisis awareness, carry forward the spirit of patriotism, inherit the red gene, and improve the comprehensive national defense quality of students. Military courses are included in the talent training system of ordinary colleges and universities, in the talent training program and teaching plan of colleges and universities, and credit system management is implemented. The course assessment results are recorded in the student status file. The military course consists of two parts: military theory and military skills. 36 teaching hours and 2 credits for military theory.

Through the teaching of military courses, ordinary colleges and universities let students understand and master the basic military knowledge and skills, enhance the national defense concept, national security awareness and crisis awareness, carry forward the spirit of patriotism, inherit the red gene, and improve the comprehensive national defense quality of students. Military courses are included in the talent training system of ordinary colleges and universities, in the talent training program and teaching plan of colleges and universities, and credit system management is implemented. The course assessment results are recorded in the student status file. The military course consists of two parts: military theory and military skills. 36 teaching hours and 2 credits for military theory.

default.zh: 根据《中华人民共和国国防法》、《中华人民共和国兵役法》、《中华人民共和国教育法》，为适应立德树人根本任务和强军目标根本要求，我校于 1987年正式开设军事课课程，含军事技能教学内容。根据教育部、中央军委国防动员部关于印发《普通高等学校军事课教学大纲》通知要求，为更好的增强学生国防观念、提高学生军事技能和综合国防素质。将原军事课中军事技能部分单列，于2020年开设“军事技能”课程。本课程包括共同条令教育与实施、射击与战术训练、防卫技能与战时防护训练、战备基础与应用训练四部分。课程教学以国防教育为主线，通过军事教学，使学生掌握基本的军事技能，弘扬爱国主义精神、传承红色基因，为实施军民融合发展战略和建设国防后备力量服务。 本课程考核施行四级制评定：优秀（90分）、良好（80分）、及格（60分）和不及格（低于60分）。
default.en: Military courses, including military skills, have been offered in Harbin Institute of Technology since 1987，according to the National Defense Law of the People's Republic of China, the Law of the People's Republic of China on Military Service and the Education Law of the People's Republic of China, aiming to adapt to the basic requirements of fostering virtue and increasing the power of its armed forces. Following the order of The Syllabus of Military Courses in Ordinary Institutions of Higher Learning from the Ministry of Education and the National Defense Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission, the part of the military skills is singled out as an independent course in 2020 in order to strengthen students’ awareness of the importance of national defense and improve their military skills and overall national defense quality. The course of Military Skills includes four parts: Education and Implementation of Common Regulations, Shooting and Tactical Training, Defense skill and Wartime Protection Training, Basic Combat Readiness and Application Training. This course focuses on national defense education, serving the goal of implementing the national military-civilian integration strategy and strengthening our national defense reserve forces through the education of basic military skills enabling students to acquire basic military abilities, deepen patriotism and carry on the great cause of communism. The assessment of this course will be in four levels: great (90), good (80), pass (60) or fail (below 60).

This course focuses on national defense education, serving the goal of implementing the national military-civilian integration strategy and strengthening our national defense reserve forces through the education of basic military skills enabling students to acquire basic military abilities, deepen patriotism and carry on the great cause of communism. The assessment of this course will be in four levels: great (90), good (80), pass (60) or fail (below 60).

default.zh: 《悦己人生》是一门将心理健康素质视为个体发展的基本素质和国民健康素质的重要成分，将大学生视为未来社会生活的重要建设者与参与者，旨在通过课程教学提升大学生的心理健康素质，促进其维护心理健康、预防和应对心理疾病整体水平，悦纳自己，理解他人，与环境和谐相处，创造自己的精彩人生。 本课程充分考虑大学生的心理发展特点和需求，注重理论联系实际，注重培养学生实际应用能力。课程内容丰富，形式多样，紧扣大学生的时代主题，以科学、专业的视角，帮助大学生丰富知识，完善认知，提升技能。 本课程充分发挥师生在教学中的主动性和创造性，充分调动学生的自主意识和参与的积极性。线上课程包括理论知识点的讲解、案例分析、课堂思考、习题练习，线下课程包括知识点回顾、小组讨论、互动分享、答疑解惑。线下课程是线上课程的有力补充。 通过本课程的学习，可以帮助大学生学习、掌握和理解心理健康的基本知识，树立心理 健康发展的自主意识，掌握自我调适、人际交往、恋爱生活、家庭互动、危机应对的基本方法。通过课程教学让每一个学生开启心灵大门、走进真实自我、驾驭学海方舟、撑起心灵晴空、乐享和睦关系、解锁爱情密码、创建和谐家庭、构建幸福生活，让每一个人都成为自己心理健康的第一责任人。
default.en: “ Enjoy your self，Happy your life ”is a course that regards mental health quality as the basic quality of individual development and an important component of national health quality, and regards college students as important builders and participants of future social life, aiming to improve the mental health quality of college students through course teaching, promote their overall level of maintaining mental health, preventing and responding to mental illness, accepting themselves, understanding others, living in harmony with the environment, and creating their own wonderful life. This course fully considers the characteristics and needs of college students' psychological development, pays attention to linking theory with practice, and focuses on cultivating students' practical application ability. The course is rich in content and diverse in form, closely following the theme of the times of college students, and helping college students enrich their knowledge, improve their cognition and improve their skills from a scientific and professional perspective. This course gives full play to the initiative and creativity of teachers and students in teaching, and fully mobilizes students' sense of autonomy and enthusiasm for participation. Online courses include explanations of theoretical knowledge points, case analysis, classroom thinking, and practice exercises, while offline courses include knowledge point review, group discussion, interactive sharing, and answering questions. In-person courses are a powerful complement to online courses. Through the study of this course, it can help college students learn, master and understand the basic knowledge of mental health and establish psychology Healthy development of autonomy, master the basic methods of self-adjustment, interpersonal communication, love life, family interaction, and crisis response. Through the course teaching, every student can open the door of the heart, enter the true self, control the ark of the sea of learning, support the clear sky of the heart, enjoy the harmonious relationship, unlock the love code, create a harmonious family, build a happy life, and let everyone become the first responsible person for their own mental health.

default.zh: 根据《中华人民共和国国防法》《中华人民共和国兵役法》《中华人民共和国教育法》，为适应立德树人根本任务和强军目标根本要求，我校于 1987年正式开设军事课课程，含军事技能教学内容。根据教育部、中央军委国防动员部关于印发《普通高等学校军事课教学大纲》通知要求，为更好的增强学生国防观念、提高学生军事技能和综合国防素质。将原军事课中军事技能部分单列，于2020年开设“军事技能”课程。本课程包括共同条令教育与实施、射击与战术训练、防卫技能与战时防护训练、战备基础与应用训练四部分。课程教学以国防教育为主线，通过军事教学，使学生掌握基本的军事技能，弘扬爱国主义精神、传承红色基因，为实施军民融合发展战略和建设国防后备力量服务。 本课程考核施行四级制评定：优秀（90分）、良好（80分）、及格（60分）和不及格（低于60分）。
default.en: Military courses, including military skills, have been offered in Harbin Institute of Technology since 1987，according to the National Defense Law of the People's Republic of China, the Law of the People's Republic of China on Military Service and the Education Law of the People's Republic of China, aiming to adapt to the basic requirements of fostering virtue and increasing the power of its armed forces. Following the order of The Syllabus of Military Courses in Ordinary Institutions of Higher Learning from the Ministry of Education and the National Defense Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission, the part of the military skills is singled out as an independent course in 2020 in order to strengthen students’ awareness of the importance of national defense and improve their military skills and overall national defense quality. The course of Military Skills includes four parts: Education and Implementation of Common Regulations, Shooting and Tactical Training, Defense skill and Wartime Protection Training, Basic Combat Readiness and Application Training. This course focuses on national defense education, serving the goal of implementing the national military-civilian integration strategy and strengthening our national defense reserve forces through the education of basic military skills enabling students to acquire basic military abilities, deepen patriotism and carry on the great cause of communism. The assessment of this course will be in four levels: great (90), good (80), pass (60) or fail (below 60).

default.zh: 绘画实习是一年级本科生的实践教学环节。课程通过集中的速写训练培养学生对造型和空间的整体观察、综合分析与表现能力，为后续专业课程的学习建立基础。通过实践还同时培养学生更加热爱专业、致力于祖国建设的事业心。
default.en: Drawing practice is a practical teaching component for first-year undergraduate students. The course aims to cultivate students' holistic observation, comprehensive analysis, and expressive abilities in modeling and space through intensive sketching training, laying the foundation for subsequent specialized courses. Through practice, it also fosters a deeper love for the profession and a sense of dedication to the cause of national construction.

default.zh: 本课程是面向建筑类一年级新生开设的专业介绍性课程。通过本课程的学习，学生将初步建立人居环境学科群的基本概念，了解建筑与设计学院相关专业与学科的定位及发展的基本脉络、本学科的科学体系等基本情况、学科分布基本特点，初步明确本专业的未来发展及毕业生去向等基本情况，培养同学们对于我国人居环境营建与可持续发展的历史责任感。
default.en: This is an introductory professional course designed for first-year architecture freshmen. Upon completing this course, students will initially establish fundamental concepts of the human settlement environment discipline cluster, gain an understanding of the positioning and development context of various majors and disciplines within the School of Architecture & Design, as well as the discipline’s scientific framework and general distribution characteristics. Students will also form a clear preliminary understanding of the career prospects and employment paths for graduates of relevant majors, and cultivate a sense of historical responsibility for the construction and sustainable development of human settlement environments across China.

default.zh: 本课程是建筑类专业与设计类专业的第一门实践类课程，学生在指定时间内赴指定的工程实践教育基地，在指导教师与实践教育基地的校外指导教师的共同指导与引领下，对所在城市的优秀设计作品进行参观、调查，对作品背后的创作过程得以认知与了解。通过这样的方式，使学生对所专业进行更进一步的启蒙认知。
default.en: This course is the first practical course for students majoring in architecture and design. Within a designated time frame, students will visit specified engineering practice education sites. They will engage in the exploration and investigation of outstanding design works with tutors from university and the off-campus instructor from the practice education site. Through this course, students will further deepen their understanding and enlightenment in their respective fields of study

default.zh: The Foundation Theory of Form Art（1） in Visual Arts is the first professional course for students enrolled in the School of Architecture and Design, and it is also an important category of foundational courses. The course objective is to cultivate students' modeling ability, improve their aesthetic taste, and activate their visual perception. The course is divided into two stages: The first stage is morphological research; Cultivate students' perception ability of form, understanding of abstract forms, abstract composition, and abstract art through abstract homework combinations; Understand the basic principles of visual order, composition, and formal beauty; The second stage is the foundation of sketching; Cultivate students' skills and abilities in composition, proportion, perspective, structure, black and white, shaping, space, texture, and other forms through a combination of sketching assignments; At the same time, the course also fully considers the connection with other subsequent courses. The main feature of this course is to achieve a transformation from a traditional teaching oriented approach to a research-based curriculum in teaching. In teaching practice, after teaching the basic principles, design some teaching activities to allow students to think and research on their own. Transforming students from passive learning to active research driven by interest, thus learning to consciously improve their modeling abilities in future
default.en: The Foundation Theory of Form Art（1） in Visual Arts is the first professional course for students enrolled in the School of Architecture and Design, and it is also an important category of foundational courses. The course objective is to cultivate students' modeling ability, improve their aesthetic taste, and activate their visual perception. The course is divided into two stages: The first stage is morphological research; Cultivate students' perception ability of form, understanding of abstract forms, abstract composition, and abstract art through abstract homework combinations; Understand the basic principles of visual order, composition, and formal beauty; The second stage is the foundation of sketching; Cultivate students' skills and abilities in composition, proportion, perspective, structure, black and white, shaping, space, texture, and other forms through a combination of sketching assignments; At the same time, the course also fully considers the connection with other subsequent courses. The main feature of this course is to achieve a transformation from a traditional teaching oriented approach to a research-based curriculum in teaching. In teaching practice, after teaching the basic principles, design some teaching activities to allow students to think and research on their own. Transforming students from passive learning to active research driven by interest, thus learning to consciously improve their modeling abilities in future

default.zh: 本课程是面向智慧建筑与建造专业一年级开设的专业介绍性课程。本课程从智慧建筑时代背景开篇，首先介绍了人工智能发展历程，剖析了建筑信息化与建筑工业化战略需求，进而对智慧建筑的发展历程、内涵解析、需求特点变革进行了系统介绍，以帮助学生构建智慧建筑概念框架。随后梳理了建筑全生命周期智慧化的三个重要阶段，即智慧设计、智慧建造和智慧运维，讲授各阶段涉及的主要理论、核心方法、前沿技术、工具平台与实践案例。最后通过对智慧建筑设计、建造、运维多阶段一体化实践案例的介绍，展示建筑全生命周期智慧化成果，强化学生对于智慧建筑与建造实践应用前景的理解。本课程阐述智慧建筑与建造专业知识结构体系，为智慧建筑与建造新工科专业、建筑学及相关专业学生系统掌握智慧建筑与建造相关知识提供支持。
default.en: This course is a foundational introductory program for first-year students in the Smart Buildings and Intelligent Construction major. Starting from the contextual background of smart architecture, it begins with an overview of artificial intelligence development, analysis the strategic needs of architectural informatization and industrialization, and systematically introduces the evolution, connotation, and transformative demands of smart buildings to help students establish a conceptual framework. The curriculum then elaborates on three critical phases of whole-lifecycle building intelligence: Smart Design, Intelligent Construction, and Smart Operation & Maintenance. Each phase covers core theories, methodologies, cutting-edge technologies, tool platforms, and practical cases (e.g., BIM, digital twins, IoT). Finally, integrated case studies across design-construction-operation stages demonstrate lifecycle intelligence outcomes, strengthening students’ understanding of applied prospects in smart architecture. By clarifying the disciplinary knowledge system of Smart Buildings and Intelligent Construction, this course supports new engineering discipline students, architects, and related majors in systematically mastering theories and practices of intelligent built environments.

default.zh: 设计基础课程面向建筑学院全院一年级本科生开课，是建筑学院专业基础课程的核心课程之一，对学生基本设计态度以及基本工作方法的养成具有重要的意义。课程包括MOOC系列、原理系列、设计系列三部分，并形成以设计课程为中心的核心课程体系。主要课程目标是通过结构有序的教学方法使学生树立正确的价值观念，明晰社会责任，掌握基本的设计研究能力：学生能够掌握正确的观察、记录、描述、总结的方法；学生能够具备基本的操作图纸、手工模型等多种设计工具进行设计研究的能力；学生能够建立初步的设计思维，获得基本的空间设计能力。掌握基本的设计表达能力：掌握基本的建筑图学知识，具备通过模型、图纸和语言等多种媒介表达设计过程和设计成果的能力。课程最后的成绩采用累加式，包括“空间练习”与“身体与空间”等部分，每一部分成绩也采用累加式，包括多个作业成果和平时练习等。
default.en: The first-year architecture design basic teaching is of great significance for a student to develop basic design attitude and fundamental work methods. "Design Basics" is one of the core courses of the professional foundation program of the School of Architecture, mainly including series courses of MOOC, principles, design, and forming the core curriculum system centered on designing courses. The main objective of the course is to enable students to establish correct values, make clear their social responsibilities, research capabilities through structured teaching methods, and acquire basic design expression skills. We hope that through learning, students can master proper methods of observation, recording, description, and summary; also, they can possess the basic capabilities of operating drawings, manual models and other design tools to do design study; and they can develop initial design thinking and acquire basic spatial design capabilities. We also hope that students acquire a basic knowledge of architectural graphics and gain the ability to express the design process and design outcomes through a variety of media including models, drawings and language.The final grade of the course adopts a cumulative calculation method, including "Spatial Exercise" and "Body and Space", and each part of the grade is also cumulatively calculated, including multiple homework results and daily practice.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向设计类专业一年级学生的专业设计基础课程，是帮助学生掌握智能创意设计的基本技能、建立专业素养的一门课程。作为设计基础公共教学平台的核心课程之一，本课程旨在通过结构有序的教学方法，使学生树立正确的价值观与义利观，掌握数字技术辅助下的基本设计研究与设计表达方法，建立初步设计思维，获得基本的设计能力。
default.en: This course is a foundational design course for first-year students in design-related majors, aimed at equipping them with essential skills for intelligent creative design and fostering their professional competence. As a core component of the public teaching platform for design fundamentals, it employs a structured and systematic instructional approach to help students develop sound values and a balanced perspective on ethics and interests. Through digital-aided design research and expression methods, students will establish preliminary design thinking and acquire fundamental design capabilities.

default.zh: 本课程是智慧建筑与建造专业是只能技术类课程的基础课程。通过本课程的学习，使本专业的学生理解本专业必备的数学观点和方法，掌握工程数学的基本概念、基本理论和基本计算，培养学生的抽象思维能力、逻辑推理能力、运算能力，为学生进一步学习专业后续课程打好基础。 本课程的主要内容是微积分、线性代数和数理统计。微积分部分包括微分方程、多元函数微积分学；线性代数部分包括n维向量、特质、线性空间的相关知识点；数理统计包括概率论的相关计算和统计学的基本概念，运算等。
default.en: This course is a foundational course for the Intelligent building and construction major. Through the study of this course, students in this major will understand the essential mathematical viewpoints and methods, master the basic concepts, theories, and calculations of engineering mathematics, cultivate their abstract thinking ability, logical reasoning ability, and computational ability, and lay a solid foundation for their further study of subsequent courses in the major. The main content of this course is calculus, linear algebra, and mathematical statistics. The calculus section includes differential equations and calculus of multivariate functions; The linear algebra section includes knowledge points related to n-dimensional vectors, traits, and linear spaces; Mathematical statistics includes calculations related to probability theory and basic concepts, operations, etc. of statistics.

default.zh: 一年级的设计基础学习，对于一个学生基本设计态度以及基本工作方法的养成具有重要的意义。《设计基础-2》课紧密承接《设计基础》课，是建筑设计基础公共教学平台的核心课程之一。主要课程目标是通过结构有序的教学方法使学生树立正确的价值观念，明晰社会责任，掌握基本的设计研究能力和设计表达能力，建立初步的设计思维，获得基本的建筑设计能力。 课程目标1 围绕“政治认同、家国情怀、文化素养、宪法法治意识、道德修养”等目标，将专业知识传授、能力培养和坚定学生理想信念有机融合，培养学生树立正确的世界观、人生观和价值观，今后能成为具有国际视野、家国情怀和使命担当的国家人居环境建设卓越人才。 课程目标2 通过本课程的学习，使学生初步认识建筑功能的概念，了解人体尺度等建筑功能的相关要素，能够对单一空间进行基本的功能分析和空间布局，初步认识空间组织与交通流线等基本问题；掌握建筑形式美的基本规律和构图美的基本法则；初步具备塑造具有美感的空间的能力，初步学会运用简单的界面与光影等要素塑造有艺术感的空间；学习多功能复合空间的组合方法，初步掌握通过总体布局、平面布置、空间和交通组织、材料和构造设计等满足建筑功能要求的建筑设计方法；掌握建筑美学原理，搭建设计审美结构，构筑综合空间、形态、建构等建筑艺术的认知与审美机制。 课程目标3 通过本课程的学习，使学生能够初步掌握科学的调查研究方法，能够对基于在地空间与社会的建筑学问题进行较为合理的研究设计；通过对经典建筑作品的解析，研究多功能复合空间组织的基本手法；初步具备建筑学专业自主学习与终身学习的意识，能主动应用建筑学专业视角去观察城市、街道、建筑、空间等，主动去了解建筑学领域内的最新理论及国际前沿动态。 课程目标4 通过本课程的学习，使学生初步了解建筑设计中的分工与协作，初步具有综合和协调的能力。 课程目标5 通过本课程的学习，使学生能够用书面及口头的方式表达自己的设计意图；具备操作图纸、手工模型等多种设计工具进行设计研究的能力，并掌握正确的建筑制图方法，具备通过模型、图纸和语言等多种媒介表达设计过程和设计成果的能力。
default.en: The study of design basics in the first year is significant for cultivating a student’s fundamental design attitude and basic working methods. Design Basis-2 closely follows the Design Basis course and serves as one of the core courses in the public teaching platform for architectural design basics. The primary objective is to use structured teaching methods to help students establish correct values, clarify social responsibilities, master basic design research and expression skills, establish preliminary design thinking, and acquire basic architectural design capabilities. The five specific objectives are as follows: Course Objective 1: Centering on goals such as “political identification, patriotism, cultural literacy, constitutional and legal awareness, and moral cultivation,” this objective integrates professional knowledge transfer with ability cultivation and the strengthening of ideals. It aims to foster students’ correct worldviews, outlooks on life, and values, enabling them to become excellent talents in national human settlement construction with an international vision, patriotism, and a sense of mission. Course Objective 2: Through this course, students will gain a preliminary understanding of the concept of architectural function and related elements such as human scale. They will be able to perform basic functional analysis and spatial layout for single spaces and gain a preliminary understanding of basic issues like spatial organization and traffic flow. Students will master the basic laws of architectural formal beauty and composition; acquire the preliminary ability to shape aesthetic spaces using simple interfaces, light, and shadow; learn combination methods for multi-functional composite spaces; and preliminarily master architectural design methods that meet functional requirements through overall layout, plan arrangement, spatial and traffic organization, and material/tectonic design. They will master architectural aesthetic principles, build a design aesthetic structure, and construct a cognitive and aesthetic mechanism for comprehensive space, form, and tectonics. Course Objective 3: Through this course, students will preliminarily master scientific investigation and research methods and be able to conduct reasonable research design for architectural problems based on local space and society. Through the analysis of classic architectural works, they will study the basic techniques of multi-functional composite spatial organization. Students will possess a preliminary awareness of autonomous and lifelong learning in architecture, be able to actively observe cities, streets, buildings, and spaces from a professional perspective, and actively understand the latest theories and international frontier dynamics in the field. Course Objective 4: Through this course, students will preliminarily understand the division of labor and collaboration in architectural design and possess preliminary skills in synthesis and coordination. Course Objective 5: Through this course, students will be able to express their design intentions orally and in writing. They will possess the ability to use various design tools, such as drawings and physical models, for design research. Furthermore, they will master correct architectural drafting methods and possess the ability to express the design process and results through multiple media, including models, drawings, and language.

default.zh: 一年级的设计思维学习与锻炼，对于一个学生基本设计态度以及基础学习、工作方法的养成具有重要的意义。《设计思维》课是建筑与设计学院公共教学平台的核心课程之一。主要课程目标是通过结构有序的教学与设计训练使学生树立正确的设计价值观，明晰社会责任，养成人文关怀，掌握基本的设计研究能力和设计表达能力，建立初步的设计思维，获得基本的空间设计能力。
default.en: Design Thinking A

default.zh: 造型艺术基础课是建筑与设计学院两大专业基础课之一。本课程在本科生教学计划的大框架指导下，对原有的课程进行有机的整合，形成目标更明确的新的课程。通过整合，新的课程比原有的相关课程的总学时数减少，从而提高效率，减轻学生的负担，但总体上要比原来达到更好的效果。由于本课程是新生入学后接触的第一门专业基础课，因此应充分考虑与其他后续课程的衔接。 本课程的主要特点是要在教学中实现从原来的教学型向研究型课程的转变。在教学实践中，在讲授基本原理之后，设计一些教学环节，让学生自己思考、研究。使学生从原来的被动学习，转变为在兴趣的驱使下主动地研究，从而学会在今后的学习中自觉提高造型能力。
default.en: This course is a foundational course for first-year undergraduate students in the School of Architecture and Design. Fundamentals of Plastic Arts is a fundamental course aimed at cultivating students' design literacy and creative thinking. This course mainly focuses on understanding design principles and training basic expression skills. Its main task is to cultivate students': 1）Understand the basic knowledge of color concepts, color essence, color attributes, etc; 2）Cultivate correct observation methods and guide students to feel the patterns of color changes; 3）Gradually master the techniques of color modeling expression and improve modeling ability; 4）Through a series of training, improve aesthetic taste and lay a foundation for subsequent design course learning.

default.zh: 绘画实习是一年级本科生的实践教学环节。课程通过集中的速写训练培养学生对造型和空间的整体观察、综合分析与表现能力，为后续专业课程的学习建立基础。通过实践还同时培养学生更加热爱专业、致力于祖国建设的事业心。
default.en: Drawing practice is a practical teaching component for first-year undergraduate students. The course aims to cultivate students' holistic observation, comprehensive analysis, and expressive abilities in modeling and space through intensive sketching training, laying the foundation for subsequent specialized courses. Through practice, it also fosters a deeper love for the profession and a sense of dedication to the cause of national construction.

default.zh: 本课程是建筑类专业与设计类专业的第一门实践类课程，学生在指定时间内赴指定的工程实践教育基地，在指导教师与实践教育基地的校外指导教师的共同指导与引领下，对所在城市的优秀设计作品进行参观、调查，对作品背后的创作过程得以认知与了解。通过这样的方式，使学生对所专业进行更进一步的启蒙认知。
default.en: This course is the first practical course for students majoring in architecture and design. Within a designated time frame, students will visit specified engineering practice education sites. They will engage in the exploration and investigation of outstanding design works with tutors from university and the off-campus instructor from the practice education site. Through this course, students will further deepen their understanding and enlightenment in their respective fields of study

default.zh: 本课程以人地关系为主线，系统论述人类活动影响下引起的主要环境要素（大气、物理等）污染的成因、特征及规律，同时结合学科前沿领域及其热点问题，探讨人与自然和谐相处的可 持续发展途径。主要内容有：第一章绪论；第二章大气环境；第三章物理环境；第四章环境管理；第五章环境科学技术与方法；第六章全球环境变化与可持续发展。 本课程是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业必修的学科基础课程，共计16学时。本课程实施的意义是增强学生的环境忧患意识；树立人与自然和谐共存的观点，同时承担起保护环境的历史重任。 本课程的教学主要是采用讲解法、讨论法和案例教学法实施教学。 课程的总体目标是：使学生系统掌握大气、物理等环境要素的特征、污染成因、迁移转化规律及其对生态系统和人类健康的影响；理解全球环境变化（如气候变化、臭氧层耗竭）的基本原理和可持续发展理论。使学生初步具备识别、分析和评价建筑环境与能源应用工程领域中典型环境问题的能力；能够运用环境科学的基本原理，思考工程实践可能带来的环境效应，并探索绿色、低碳的解决方案。使学生建立科学的自然观和系统思维，理解工程技术的环境责任，为后续学习专业课程奠定坚实的环境科学基础，培养成为具有强烈环境意识和社会责任感的卓越工程师。
default.en: This course, focusing on the human-environment relationship, systematically discusses the causes, characteristics, and patterns of pollution of major environmental elements (atmosphere, physical, etc.) caused by human activities. It also explores sustainable development pathways for harmonious coexistence between humans and nature, incorporating cutting-edge research and current issues in the field. The main contents include: Chapter 1 Introduction; Chapter 2 Atmospheric Environment; Chapter 3 Physical Environment; Chapter 4 Environmental Management; Chapter 5 Environmental Science, Technology and Methods; Chapter 6 Global Environmental Change and Sustainable Development. This course is a required foundational course for the Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering major, totaling 16 class hours. The significance of this course is to enhance students' environmental awareness; to cultivate a perspective of harmonious coexistence between humans and nature; and to instill in them the historical responsibility of environmental protection. The teaching methods for this course primarily employ lectures, discussions, and case studies. The overall goal of the course is to enable students to systematically master the characteristics, causes, migration and transformation patterns, and impacts on ecosystems and human health of atmospheric and physical environmental elements; and to understand the basic principles of global environmental change (such as climate change and ozone layer depletion) and the theory of sustainable development. This program aims to equip students with the initial ability to identify, analyze, and evaluate typical environmental problems in the field of building environment and energy application engineering; to enable them to apply the basic principles of environmental science to consider the potential environmental effects of engineering practices and explore green and low-carbon solutions. It also aims to cultivate students' scientific view of nature and systems thinking, understanding of the environmental responsibility of engineering technology, laying a solid environmental science foundation for subsequent professional courses, and nurturing them into outstanding engineers with a strong environmental awareness and social responsibility.

default.zh: 本课程是面向建筑学专业新生开设的专业介绍性课程，通过本课程的学习，学生将初步建立建筑学科集群的基本概念，了解本专业学科定位及发展的基本脉络、本学科的科学体系等基本情况，初步明确本专业的招生及毕业去向等基本情况。结合对前沿学术动态的讲授，了解专业课程及主要学术研究内容。通过本学科的讲授，引导学生在学科前沿动态的指导下自主地阅读相关书籍及文献，培养学生主动涉猎专业知识的能力，为培养科研学术型和专业技术型并重的人才打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The course is an introductory one, which is offered to be geared to the needs of new students of Architecture Department. New students will preliminarily understand basic concepts of architecture discipline cluster, basic characteristics, orientation of the specialty and relative subject, scientific system of the subject, etc. By the course, students will firstly be clear about recruitment and prospect on graduation about the specialty. Students will understand the courses of the specialty and major content of learning by combining leading-edge trends. Students will be guided to read relative books and documents on their respective specialties widely and independently by the course. We will foster students’ ability to dip into specialized acknowledge actively by the guidance of leading-edge trends of subjects and lay a solid foundation for fostering scientific research personnel and professional and technical personnel.

default.zh: 设计基础课程面向建筑与设计学院全院一年级本科生开课，是建筑与设计学院专业基础课程的核心课程之一，对学生基本设计态度以及基本工作方法的养成具有重要的意义。课程包括原理系列、设计系列、实践系列三部分，并形成以设计课程为中心的核心课程体系。主要课程目标是通过结构有序的教学方法使学生树立正确的价值观念，明晰社会责任，掌握基本的设计研究能力：学生能够掌握正确的观察、记录、描述、总结的方法；学生能够具备基本的操作图纸、手工模型等多种设计工具进行设计研究的能力；学生能够建立初步的设计思维，获得基本的设计能力。掌握基本的设计表达能力：掌握基本的设计图学知识，具备通过模型、图纸和语言等多种媒介表达设计过程和设计成果的能力。课程最后的成绩采用累加式，包括“设计练习”与“设计实践”等部分，每一部分成绩也采用累加式，包括多个作业成果和平时练习等。
default.en: The first-year architecture design basic teaching is of great significance for a student to develop basic design attitude and fundamental work methods. "Design Basics" is one of the core courses of the professional foundation program of the School of Architecture, mainly including series courses of MOOC, principles, design, and forming the core curriculum system centered on designing courses. The main objective of the course is to enable students to establish correct values, make clear their social responsibilities, research capabilities through structured teaching methods, and acquire basic design expression skills. We hope that through learning, students can master proper methods of observation, recording, description, and summary; also, they can possess the basic capabilities of operating drawings, manual models and other design tools to do design study; and they can develop initial design thinking and acquire basic spatial design capabilities. We also hope that students acquire a basic knowledge of architectural graphics and gain the ability to express the design process and design outcomes through a variety of media including models, drawings and language.The final grade of the course adopts a cumulative calculation method, including "Spatial Exercise" and "Body and Space", and each part of the grade is also cumulatively calculated, including multiple homework results and daily practice.

default.zh: 建筑设计基础课程面向建筑学院全院一年级本科生开课，是建筑学院专业基础课程的核心课程之一。课程紧密承接设计基础课程，对于一个学生基本设计态度以及基本工作方法的养成具有重要的意义。课程包括MOOC系列、原理系列、设计系列三部分，并形成以设计课程为中心的核心课程体系。主要课程目标是通过结构有序的教学方法使学生树立正确的价值观念，明晰社会责任，掌握基本的建筑设计研究能力和基本的建筑设计表达能力。课程最后的成绩采用累加式，包括“空间与身体”、“空间与场所”等部分，每一部分成绩也采用累加式，包括多个作业成果和平时练习等。另外，学生还需要合作完成1个建造实验。
default.en: The basic learning of architectural design in the first-year has important significance for the development of students' basic design attitude and basic working methods. "Architectural Design Basics" is one of the core courses of the professional foundation program which also closely following the course of "Design Basics". This course mainly includes series of MOOC courses, theory courses, and design courses. These courses form a core teaching system which are centered on the course of design. The aim of this course is to enable students to establish correct values, clear social responsibility and master the basic design and research capabilities through an orderly teaching method. The final grade of the course adopts a cumulative calculation method, including "Spaces and Body"and"Spaces and Places", and each part of the grade is also cumulatively calculated, including multiple homework results and daily practice. In addition, students will be required to collaborate on a construction experiment.

default.zh: 建筑环境学概论是建筑学院相关专业的一门专业集群基础课程。课程主要包括概论及应用介绍、建筑外环境、建筑热湿环境、人体对热湿环境的反应、室内空气质量与通风、建筑声环境、建筑光环境等基础知识。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课后作业和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Introduction of Built Environment is a basic course for related professional cluster majors in the School of Architecture. The course mainly includes the introduction, application introduction, outdoor environment of buildings, indoor thermal environment, human response to indoor thermal environment, indoor air quality and ventilation, building acoustic environment and building light environment etc. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework and final exam. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 设计美学基础面向建筑学院各专业本科生开课，是平台课中重要的基础理论课程。本课程以案例欣赏、美学分析为方法，理解设计的本质，了解设计学学科的发展；理解美的本质，了解审美的文化差异；了解设计与艺术、设计与技术、设计与经济、文化的关系。建立设计美学的基本理论知识框架。 课程主要讲授涉及到设计美学的美学基础理论，包括设计、设计学与设计的类型；美、美学与审美理论；设计与艺术思潮；设计技术与社会；设计的经济和价值等五讲。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期中课程作业、期中课程作业二个部分，通过设计艺术案例实验探索，理解设计美学的相关基础理论，能够将美学知识用于解决理解文化产品的创意设计问题。
default.en: The Basis of Design Aesthetics is an important basic theory course in the platform course. This course takes case appreciation and aesthetic analysis as the methods to understand the essence of design and the development of design discipline; Understand the essence of beauty and the cultural differences of aesthetics; Understand the relationship between design and art, design and technology, design and economy and culture. It is suggested that the basic theoretical knowledge framework of design aesthetics.The course mainly teaches the basic aesthetic theories related to design aesthetics, five lectures on the Design, design and types of design Beauty, Aesthetics and aesthetic theory; Design and art trends; Design technology and society; Economy and value of design. The examination results of this course are cumulative, including two parts: midterm course assignment and midterm course assignment. Through the experimental exploration of design art cases, we can understand the relevant basic theories of design aesthetics, and be able to use aesthetic knowledge to solve the creative design problems of cultural products.

default.zh: 造型艺术基础课是建筑学院专业基础课之一。本课程在建筑学院本科教学计划的大框架指导下，对原有的课程进行有机的整合，形成目标更明确的新的课程。通过整合，新的课程比原有的相关课程的总学时数减少，从而提高效率，减轻学生的负担，但总体上要比原来达到更好的效果。由于本课程是新生入学后接触的第一门专业基础课，因此应充分考虑与其他后续课程的衔接。 本课程的主要特点是要在教学中实现从原来的教学型向研究型课程的转变。在教学实践中，在讲授基本原理之后，设计一些教学环节，让学生自己思考、研究。使学生从原来的被动学习，转变为在兴趣的驱使下主动地研究，从而学会在今后的学习中自觉提高造型能力。
default.en: The basic course of plastic arts is one of the professional basic courses in the School of Architecture. Under the guidance of the undergraduate teaching plan of the School of Architecture, this course organically integrates the existing courses to form a new course with clearer objectives. Through integration, the new curriculum reduces the total number of class hours compared to the original related courses, thereby improving efficiency and reducing the burden on students, but overall, it achieves better results than the original. As this course is the first professional foundation course that new students will be exposed to after enrollment, full consideration should be given to the connection with other subsequent courses. The main feature of this course is to achieve a transformation from a teaching oriented to a research-oriented course in teaching. In teaching practice, after teaching the basic principles, design some teaching links to allow students to think and research on their own. Enable students to shift from passive learning to active research driven by interest, thereby learning to consciously improve their modeling skills in future learning.

default.zh: 建筑设计-1课程是一门面向智慧人居（建筑类）专业二年级本科生的专业设计基础课程，是帮助学生掌握建筑设计的基本技能，建立专业素养的一门课程。旨在通过理论学习与分阶段渐进的设计专题训练，使学生了解建筑空间与使用功能、行为体验、场所环境之间的关系，建立对建筑设计核心内容的系统认识；从建筑空间生成的认知入手，理解功能使用的规定性和弹性以及对建筑空间的制约与引发关系；理解场地环境与建筑空间的关系，学习基本的环境分析方法与场地设计方法，从而熟悉与掌握建筑设计的基本流程和方法。 课程环节包括理论知识、专题讲座、方案设计、模型制作等；教学方式包括专题讲授、一对一辅导、互动研讨及班际联合点评等；考核方法采用累加式考评，综合考虑设计图纸的表达、模型制作和过程汇报等。
default.en: The course "Architectural Design - 1" is a professional basic design course for second-year undergraduate students majoring in Smart Human Settlements (Architecture-related). It is a course that helps students master the basic skills of architectural design and establish professional literacy. The aim is to enable students to understand the relationship between architectural space and functional use, behavioral experience, and site environment, through theoretical learning and gradual design training, and establish a systematic understanding of the core content of architectural design; Starting from the cognition of the generation of architectural space, understand the regularity and elasticity of functional use, as well as the constraints and triggering relationships on architectural space; Understand the relationship between site environment and architectural space, learn basic environmental analysis methods and site design methods, and become familiar with and master the basic processes and methods of architectural design. The course includes theoretical knowledge, special lectures, scheme design, model production, etc; The teaching methods include thematic lectures, one-on-one tutoring, interactive discussions, and inter class joint evaluations; The assessment method adopts a cumulative evaluation method, which comprehensively considers the expression of design drawings, model production, and process reporting.

default.zh: 建筑设计-1课程是一门面向智慧人居（建筑类）专业二年级本科生的专业设计基础课程，是帮助学生掌握建筑设计的基本技能，建立专业素养的一门课程；旨在通过理论学习与分阶段渐进的设计专题训练，使学生了解建筑空间与使用功能、行为体验、场所环境之间的关系，建立对建筑设计核心内容的系统认识，掌握建筑空间设计的基本原则和建筑设计的基本流程与方法。
default.en: Architectural Design-1 is a professional design foundation course for second-year undergraduate students majoring in Smart Habitat (Architecture). It is designed to help students master basic architectural design skills and establish professional qualities. Through theoretical learning and phased, progressive design training, students will understand the relationship between architectural space and its functions, behavioral experiences, and the environment of the site. They will develop a systematic understanding of the core content of architectural design and master the basic principles, processes, and methods of architectural space design.

default.zh: 本课程是建筑学院二年级本科生专业基础课。造型艺术基础是一门用以培养学生设计素质、创造性思维的基础课，本课程主要研究对设计原理的理解和基本表现技能训练为基本着眼点，其主要任务是培养学生： 1．了解色彩概念、色彩本质、色彩属性等色彩的基本知识； 2．培养正确的观察方法，引导学生感受色彩变化规律； 3．逐步掌握色彩造型表现技法，提高造型能力； 4．通过系列训练，提高审美品味，为后续的设计课程学习打下基础
default.en: This course is a professional foundation course for second year undergraduate students in the School of Architecture. Fundamentals of Plastic Arts is a fundamental course aimed at cultivating students' design qualities and creative thinking. This course mainly focuses on understanding design principles and training basic expression skills. Its main task is to cultivate students: 1. Understand the basic knowledge of colors such as color concepts, color essence, and color attributes; 2. Gradually master various expressive techniques for color still life painting; 3. Cultivate correct observation methods and guide students to pay attention to the color changes of surrounding scenery anytime and anywhere; 4. Through a series of training, students will gradually master the method of color composition, laying the foundation for subsequent design course learning.Author:

default.zh: 建筑材料课程面向建筑学专业2年级本科学生，是本专业设计类课程和技术类课程的先修课程。本课程系统地介绍了建筑工程所用的水泥、混凝土、建筑砂浆、建筑钢材、防水材料、绝热吸声材料和装饰材料等各种建筑材料的品种、规格、技术性能、质量标准、适用条件、维护保养及质量检验要求等内容，并针对授课对象专业背景，讲解各种建筑材料在方案设计中的应用途径。通过本课程的学习，使学生熟悉不同建筑材料的核心性能，掌握建筑材料的应用方法，培养学生根据材料特性，进行技术设计及和方案设计的能力，并启发学生对新材料的兴趣，逐步培养多学科知识交叉的创新能力，为今后从事工程实践和科学研究打下基础。本课程最终成绩采用累加式，评价指标项包括期末报告、平时测试和课下作业。
default.en: The course of Building Materials is aimed at second-year college students, majoring in architecture. It is the prerequisite course for Architecture Design，Building Constructure and Building Structure. The main content includes building material`s performance, quality standards, applicable conditions, maintenance and quality inspection requirements, etc. According to the major characteristics, the application ways of various building materials in design will be explained. Through theoretical teaching and practical teaching, students will know about the basic knowledge of building materials, master the basic principles of building materials application, and have the ability to select suitable materials according to the design plan. For developing their technical design ability and plan creativity based on characteristics of materials, the students would be familiar with the core properties of different building materials, and master the application methods of main building materials. Simultaneously, by inspiring students' interest in new materials, they will have the innovative ability of cross-application of multidisciplinary knowledge gradually. The learning experience of Building Materials would be the foundation for future engineering practice and scientific research. The final grade for the course depends on several indexes, which are final report, regular tests and homework.

default.zh: 建筑材料课程是本专业设计类课程和技术类课程的先修课程。本课程系统地介绍了建筑工程所用的水泥、混凝土、建筑砂浆、建筑钢材、防水材料、绝热吸声材料和装饰材料等各种建筑材料的品种、规格、技术性能、质量标准、适用条件、维护保养及质量检验要求等内容，并针对授课对象专业背景，讲解各种建筑材料在方案设计中的应用途径。通过本课程的学习，使学生熟悉不同建筑材料的核心性能，掌握建筑材料的应用方法，培养学生根据材料特性，进行技术设计及和方案设计的能力，并启发学生对新材料的兴趣，逐步培养多学科知识交叉的创新能力，为今后从事工程实践和科学研究打下基础。本课程最终成绩采用累加式，评价指标项包括期末报告、平时测试和课下作业。
default.en: It is the prerequisite course for Architecture Design，Building Constructure and Building Structure. The main content includes building material`s performance, quality standards, applicable conditions, maintenance and quality inspection requirements, etc. According to the major characteristics, the application ways of various building materials in design will be explained. Through theoretical teaching and practical teaching, students will know about the basic knowledge of building materials, master the basic principles of building materials application, and have the ability to select suitable materials according to the design plan. For developing their technical design ability and plan creativity based on characteristics of materials, the students would be familiar with the core properties of different building materials, and master the application methods of main building materials. Simultaneously, by inspiring students' interest in new materials, they will have the innovative ability of cross-application of multidisciplinary knowledge gradually. The learning experience of Building Materials would be the foundation for future engineering practice and scientific research. The final grade for the course depends on several indexes, which are final report, regular tests and homework.

default.zh: 本课程介绍了建筑设计当代最新建模工具的基本方法、理论和实践。通过讲授、演示和课程作业引导，让学生了解学科研究和掌握专业相关设计软件。主要内容包括建筑组件类型与装配、参数建模、可视化和简单模拟。学生将通过使用建筑信息建模软件进行建筑项目设计的应用探索，并理解研发基础，便于未来将BIM应用于自己的研究项目和建筑设计实践中。
default.en: This course addresses fundamental methods, theories, and practices that engage contemporary modeling tools in the context of architectural design. It introduces selected academic and professional topics through lectures, demonstrations, and assignments. Topics include component types and assembly, parametric modeling, visualization, simulations. Students are expected to initiate intellectual explorations through the use of Building Information Modeling software for architectural design projects, and to develop foundations to apply it to their own research projects and design practices later.

default.zh: 本课程介绍了建筑设计当代最新建模工具的基本方法、理论和实践。通过讲授、演示和课程作业引导，让学生了解学科研究和掌握专业相关设计软件。主要内容包括建筑组件类型与装配、参数建模、可视化和简单模拟。学生将通过使用建筑信息建模软件进行建筑项目设计的应用探索，并理解研发基础，便于未来将BIM应用于自己的研究项目和建筑设计实践中。
default.en: This course addresses fundamental methods, theories, and practices that engage contemporary modeling tools in the context of architectural design. It introduces selected academic and professional topics through lectures, demonstrations, and assignments. Topics include component types and assembly, parametric modeling, visualization, simulations. Students are expected to initiate intellectual explorations through the use of Building Information Modeling software for architectural design projects, and to develop foundations to apply it to their own research projects and design practices later.

default.zh: 城市能源规划与管理A是建筑相关大类的一门大类专业基础课，在培养学生创新型思维、综合分析能力、工程实践能力方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授城市区域建筑能源规划方法及目标设定原则、区域建筑能源需求预测、绿色生态城区的能源资源分析、区域能源系统优化配置、区域建筑能源系统评价等内容，使学生较深入地了解区域建筑能源系统规划的基本方法。
default.en: Urban Energy Planning and Management A is a basic course of architecture-related major, which plays an important role in cultivating students' innovative thinking, comprehensive analysis ability and engineering practice ability. This course mainly teaches the method of regional building energy planning and the principle of target setting, the prediction of regional building energy demand, the analysis of energy resources of green ecological city, the optimization of regional energy system, the evaluation of regional building energy system, etc., to enable students to have a deeper understanding of the regional building energy system planning basic methods.

default.zh: 城市发展与规划史-1是人居环境学科群各专业的一门专业通识类理论课，通过对国内外城市发展历程与城市规划发展历程的讲解，帮助学生初步了解国内外城市是如何发展至今的？以及城市规划在这个过程中具有怎样的影响和作用？帮助学生初步理解城市发展的基本规律，建立起城市规划知识体系框架，形成初步的城市系统观、历史观和价值观，为进一步专业学习打好基础。http://jwts.hit.edu.cn/kcwh/querykcList#
default.en: Urban development and planning history 1 is a professional general theory course for all majors in the human settlements discipline group. Through the explanation of the development process of cities at home and abroad and the development process of urban planning, it helps students preliminarily understand how cities at home and abroad have developed so far? And what impact and role does urban planning have in this process? Help students preliminarily understand the basic laws of urban development, establish the framework of urban planning knowledge system, and form a preliminary view of urban system, history and values, so as to lay a good foundation for further professional learning.

default.zh: 本课程是面向智慧人居大类学生的专业启蒙课。通过本课程学习，使学生初步了解城市的缘起和发展历程，初步理解城市发展的基本规律，并初步理解城市规划在其中发挥的重要作用，帮助学生初步建立城市规划知识体系框架，形成初步的城市系统观、历史观和价值观，为进一步专业学习打好基础。
default.en: This course serves as an introductory and foundational course for students majoring in smart human settlement. Through this course, students gain a preliminary understanding of the origin and development of cities, the basic laws of urban development, and the important role of urban planning within this development. It helps students begin to build a framework of knowledge for urban planning, develop a preliminary understanding of urban systems, history, and values, and lay a solid foundation for further professional learning.

default.zh: 现代景观思想是一门面向景观学专业二年级学生的一门历史理论课程，是景观专业本科生本科阶段历史与理论教育的核心。现代景观思想是以现代时期的景观设计活动为主要研究对象，强调设计思想的阐释和价值的判断与思考，而不仅仅是史料和风格。本课程的教学目标是使学生从现代景观的内涵出发，以现代景观历史发展为线索，开阔国际视野，丰富设计语言，掌握现代景观设计的主要思想和设计手法，提高理论研究和批评能力。以期达到了解和掌握现代景观发展的基本史实，把握景观发展演变的基本脉络，认识景观发展的历史规律和发展趋势，整合景观设计理论，创造出基于中国文化的现代优秀景观作品。 目标1：开阔视野，丰富设计语言；了解与风景园林规划设计相关的社会科学知识，包括哲学、社会、艺术、环境行为与心理等，作为设计、研究、管理等工作的支撑。 目标2：掌握现代景观设计的主要思想和设计手法；应用课程知识，分析风景园林在空间组织、环境营造、形态审美、行为感知、材料技艺等层面的问题，以引导设计与表达。 目标3：整合景观设计理论；综合生态、经济、环境、社会、文化、技术、艺术等因素及其辩证关系，提出解决问题的方法和策略。 目标4：提高理论研究和批评能力，培养学生的专业社会责任感，增强文化自信。培养学生自主学习意识，不断研究和探索风景园林及相关领域的专业问题。
default.en: "Modern Landscape Thought" is a historical and theoretical course aimed at second-year landscape architecture students. It is the core of undergraduate education in the history and theory of landscape architecture. "Modern Landscape Thought" primarily focuses on the landscape design activities of the modern era, emphasizing the interpretation of design concepts and the assessment and reflection of their values, rather than just historical materials and styles. The course's teaching objectives are to lead students to explore the essence of modern landscapes, follow the historical development of modern landscapes, broaden their international perspective, enrich their design language, grasp the main ideas and design techniques of modern landscape design, and enhance their theoretical research and critical abilities. The aim is to enable students to understand and master the basic historical facts of modern landscape development, grasp the fundamental context of landscape development evolution, understand the historical laws and development trends of landscape development, integrate landscape design theories, and create outstanding modern landscape works based on Chinese culture. Objective 1: Broaden horizons and enrich design language; acquire knowledge of social sciences related to landscape architecture planning and design, including philosophy, society, art, environmental behavior, and psychology, as a foundation for work in design, research, and management. Objective 2: Master the main ideas and design techniques of modern landscape design; apply the knowledge from the course to analyze issues related to spatial organization, environmental creation, aesthetic form, behavioral perception, material techniques, and more, to guide design and expression. Objective 3: Integrate landscape design theory; combine ecological, economic, environmental, social, cultural, technological, and artistic factors and their dialectical relationships to propose problem-solving methods and strategies. Objective 4: Enhance theoretical research and critical abilities, cultivate students' sense of professional social responsibility, and boost cultural self-confidence. Encourage students to develop a sense of self-directed learning, continuously research and explore professional issues in landscape architecture and related fields.

default.zh: 人工智能技术深远地影响着建筑创作过程，推动了建筑设计思维演化，革新了建筑信息建模、性能模拟和优化设计方法与技术。本课程是面向智慧人居工科实验班二年级学生的课程，具有多学科交叉、理论实践结合特征，旨在培养学生立足人工智能技术展开建筑前沿设计理论、方法、策略与技术维度上的创新性思考能力。通过课程理论学习与循序渐进的专题训练，使学生了解数字建筑发展时代需求，熟悉数字建筑本质内涵特征，掌握数字建筑设计思维逻辑；培养同学们立足碳中和与可持续发展时代背景，开展数字建筑学习的历史使命感。同时，课程将使学生熟悉数字建筑信息建模方法、数字建筑性能模拟方法、数字建筑优化设计方法和数字建筑智慧建造方法，能够应用数字化建模工具展开建筑形态、空间、材料和构造信息建模实践，开展数字建筑性能模拟实践，进行数字建筑多目标优化设计和建造实践。
default.en: Artificial intelligence technology has profoundly affected the architectural creation process, promoted the evolution of architectural design thinking, and revolutionized building information modeling, performance simulation and optimization design methods and technologies. This course is a course for the second-year students of the intelligent human settlement engineering experimental class. It has the characteristics of multi-discipline and combination of theory and practice. It aims to cultivate students' innovativeness in the theories, methods, strategies and technical dimensions of cutting-edge architectural design based on artificial intelligence technology. Through course theoretical learning and gradual thematic training, students can understand the needs of the digital architecture development era, familiarize themselves with the essence and characteristics of digital architecture, and master the logic of digital architecture design thinking; Cultivate students' sense of historical mission in conducting digital architecture learning based on the background of carbon neutrality and sustainable development. At the same time, the course will familiarize students with digital building information modeling methods, digital building performance simulation methods, digital building optimization design methods, and digital building intelligent construction methods. They will be able to apply digital modeling tools to practice building form, space, material, and structural information modeling, carry out digital building performance simulation practice, and carry out multi-objective optimization design and construction practice of digital buildings.

default.zh: 自动控制原理是建筑环境与能源应用工程中分析和设计暖通空调自动控制系统的基础理论。通过本课程的学习，要求学生能够对一般控制系统建模、分析稳定性、准确性和动态性能，理解控制系统的综合与校正任务，具有从事建筑环境与能源应用工程工作所需的建筑设备自动化的控制理论及控制系统的基础知识，为深造自动控制方向的课程、分析和设计暖通空调自动控制系统奠定基础。 课程主要内容有：自动控制原理概论，包括系统基本概念和组成；控制系统的数学模型，包括拉普拉斯变换、传递函数和方块图；控制系统的时域分析法，包括一阶系统和二阶系统的过渡过程、稳定性和稳态误差；根轨迹法，包括根轨迹原理、基本规则和应用分析；频率特性法，包括频率特性曲线的绘制方法、奈奎斯特稳定判据和控制系统性能分析；控制系统的综合与校正。要求学生重点掌握拉普拉斯变换，以及时域分析法、根轨迹法和频率特性法三类分析方法，能够灵活运用上述方法分析控制系统的稳定性、准确性和动态性能，掌握测速反馈和PID控制对系统的校正特点。 课程采用讲授、课堂作业、互动讨论、线下答疑和上机实践等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、课堂考察和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Automatic Control Principle is the fundamental theory for analyzing and designing HVAC automatic control systems in building environment and energy application engineering. Through the study of this course, students are required to be able to model, analyze stability, accuracy, and dynamic performance of general control systems, understand the comprehensive and calibration tasks of control systems, and have the basic knowledge of control theory and control systems for building equipment automation required for work in building environment and energy application engineering. This lays the foundation for further courses in the field of automatic control, analysis, and design of HVAC automatic control systems. The main content of the course includes: Introduction to Automatic Control Principles, including basic concepts and components of systems; The mathematical model of the control system, including Laplace transform, transfer function, and block diagram; The time-domain analysis method of control systems, including the transition process, stability, and steady-state error of first-order and second-order systems; Root locus method, including root locus principle, basic rules, and application analysis; Frequency characteristic method, including the drawing method of frequency characteristic curve, Nyquist stability criterion, and control system performance analysis; Synthesis and calibration of control systems. Students are required to focus on mastering Laplace transform, as well as three types of analysis methods: time-domain analysis, root locus method, and frequency characteristic method. They are able to flexibly apply the above methods to analyze the stability, accuracy, and dynamic performance of control systems, and master the correction characteristics of speed measurement feedback and PID control on the system. The course is taught through methods such as lectures, classroom assignments, interactive discussions, offline Q&A, and online practice. The course assessment results are cumulative, and the assessment process includes homework, classroom assignments, and final exams. The total assessment score is calculated as a percentage, with a maximum score of 100 points.

default.zh: 房屋建筑学是一门实践性较强的综合技术科学，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握民用建筑设计原理、建筑构造的基本原理和一般构造方法，培养学生建筑构造设计、建筑方案设计与绘图的能力。
default.en: Building structure and architecture is kind of course which integrated teaching course and practice closely. By this class, the students are expected to learn the basic theory and method of building details design, and also the ability of construction drawings will be strengthened.

default.zh: 在教学过程中基于先修课程中所学到的审美素养与造型技能，结合四个实验教学环节，进行设计人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习相关专业课程和日后从事设计工作打下基础，在培养学生设计综合能力、提高团队合作能力等方面占有重要地位。 设计思维是数字媒体艺术和数字媒体技术专业教育课程，主要对创新思维和设计思维进行概述，并对设计思维的特点、类型和方法进行介绍，使学生能够通过设计思维的训练进行不同类型的设计创作；并使学生通过小组合作形式掌握设计的思维模式，增强创新意识。
default.en: In the process of teaching based on the prerequisite course learn the aesthetic literacy and other skills, combined with the four aspects of experimental teaching, basic training of design personnel required, for the students to learn the related courses and engaged in design work to lay the foundation, occupies an important position in the comprehensive capacity of students, improve the design team cooperative ability. Design thinking is the education course of digital media arts and digital media technology. It gives an introduction of innovative thinking and design thinking, design features, the type of thinking and methods are introduced, so that students can create different types of design through the design thinking training; and make students through group cooperation form to master the design mode of thinking and enhance the awareness of innovation.

default.zh: 设计与调研分析是面向数字媒体艺术专业本科生开课，是选修课基础课程之一。课程主要讲授设计调研的基本理论方法、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握设计调研与分析的具体过程和实施步骤；设计规划能力。 课程主要包括用户动机、生活方式、设计审美观念、可用性调查等方面的理论，掌握访谈、问卷和观察等用户调查的基本方法。课程考试采用累加，包括期末笔试和作业两个部分。另外，需要学生们独立完成一个实验。
default.en: Design and investigation analysis is one of the basic courses of the elective courses for digital media art majors. The course mainly teaches the basic theoretical approach to design and investigation, research hotspots, development trends and cutting-edge applications; familiarity and palm. The course mainly includes the theory of user motivation, lifestyle, design aesthetic concept, availability investigation, etc., master interviews, questionnaires and observation and other user surveys. The course exam is accumulated, including the final written test and operation two.

default.zh: 《摄影与镜头语言设计》是一门研究平面和影视摄影理论及技能，以及电影剧本、分镜头创作的专业限选课。本课程的主要目的是：掌握摄影与照明技术的基础知识和基本技能，结合摄影艺术理论和电影镜头语言，进行平面摄影艺术作品和影视艺术作品创作，并为学习后续相关课程打下基础。 作为培养学生摄影技术、摄影艺术造型和电影镜头语言设计能力的基础课，主要讲授：照相机的工作原理、组成及使用方法，摄影构图原理与方法，摄影照明布光方法，照明器材，室外和室内自然光条件下的摄影用光技巧，数码动态摄影技术，电影文学剧本及其创作，电影摄影镜头语言设计及电影分镜头设计等。
default.en: “Photography and Lens Language Design”is a professional limited course that studies the theory and skills of graphic and film photography, as well as film script and shot creation. The main purpose of this course is to master the basic knowledge and skills of photography and lighting technology, combine photography art theory with film lens language, create graphic photography art works and film and television art works, and lay the foundation for learning related courses in the future. As a basic course to cultivate students' abilities in photography technology, photography art modeling, and film lens language design, it mainly teaches: the working principle, composition, and usage methods of cameras, photography composition principles and methods, photography lighting layout methods, lighting equipment, photography lighting techniques under outdoor and indoor natural light conditions, digital dynamic photography technology, film literary scripts and their creation, Film photography shot language design and film sub shot design, etc.

default.zh: 《影像声音基础》课程是媒体技术与艺术学的专业基础课之一，也是从事视听作品配乐制作人员的必修课程。旨在提高学生对视听作品中声音三要素的理性认识，从而提高画面配置声音的编配工作。通过课程的教学与实践，使学生掌握基础乐理知识，声学知识，音乐欣赏、音质评价的基本常识，认识到声音的各种表现手法在视听作品中的特殊作用及配乐的基本原理和基本原则。本课程以提高理工科学生音乐鉴赏能力为手段，通过声音中的音乐实践，使他们学会如何欣赏作品、分析作品、选择声音作品，从而为画面（包括电视教学片、专题片、多媒体计算机课件）编配、创作声音素材。
default.en: The course "Fundamentals of image and sound" is one of the professional basic courses of media technology and art. It is also a compulsory course for music producers engaged in audio-visual works. It aims to improve students' rational understanding of the three elements of sound in audio-visual works, so as to improve the picture configuration and sound allocation. Through the teaching and practice of the course, students can master the basic music theory knowledge, acoustic knowledge, the basic knowledge of music appreciation and sound quality evaluation, and realize the special role of various expression methods of sound in audio-visual works and the basic principles and basic principles of soundtrack. By means of improving the music appreciation ability of science and engineering students, this course enables them to learn how to appreciate works, analyze works and select sound works through music practice in sound, so as to compile and create sound materials for pictures (including TV teaching films, feature films and multimedia computer courseware).

default.zh: 在数字媒体领域，程序设计是学生应掌握和运用的重要和必要技能。在诸多当下流行的程序设计语言中，Python具有先驱性的代表意义。本课程力求帮助初学者较容易地掌握程序设计，主要内容包括程序设计基础、操作符和表达式、数据输入和输出、选择结构、循环结构、模块化程序设计、复杂数据的表示和处理、函数、面向对象编程、文件读写等。本课程既关注基础语法也关注程序设计原则。期望通过本课程帮助学生掌握编写代码的技能，从而作为更高阶课程的技能基础。
default.en: Programming is one of the most important skills in digital media study. It is a necessary skill for students to master and skillfully use a programming language. Python is the pioneer of advanced programming languages and at present one of the most important and popular languages. The objective of our course is to try to make programming simple for beginners. This course involves programming basis, operator and expression, data input and output, selection structure, loop structure, implementation of modular programming, expression and processing of complex data, function, object-oriented programming, file reading and writing, etc. It focuses on both the fundamental grammar and the main principles of programming. This course is expected to help students master skills of writing codes and serve as a foundation for other advanced courses.

default.zh: 数字媒体设计基础是面向数字媒体艺术专业二年级学生的一门大类专业基础课程，也是其学习后续相关专业课程的基础课程，在树立学生专业意识，激发学习兴趣等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲授数字媒体艺术的美学溯源，数字媒体艺术的技术体系、主要类型和应用领域，对数字媒体艺术的创作思考、文化思考和教育思考等知识，着重培养学生理解数字科技与数字媒体艺术的互促关系，具备运用美学理论、技术手段进行数字媒体艺术作品设计的基本思维和能力。
default.en: Fundamentals of Digital Media Design is a general basic professional course for second-year students majoring in Digital Media Art, and also a prerequisite for their subsequent specialized courses. It plays a vital role in helping students establish professional awareness and stimulating their interest in learning. This course mainly covers the aesthetic origins of digital media art, its technical systems, major genres and application fields, as well as creative, cultural and educational reflections on digital media art. It focuses on cultivating students’ understanding of the mutually reinforcing relationship between digital technology and digital media art, and equips them with fundamental thinking and capabilities to design digital media art works by applying aesthetic theories and technical tools.

default.zh: 《流体力学B》为土木工程及理论与应用力学专业的主要技术基础课之一。本课程主要用于增强学生的专业理论水平，为学生的专业学习储备必要的基础知识。通过本课程的学习，可使学生掌握以牛顿三大定律为基础的经典力学基本理论在流体力学中的具体应用以及表现形式，培养学生面对与流体相关的风工程、渗流等具体工程应用时的理论联系实际能力，培养学生通过实验研究解决实际问题的能力。 本课程围绕流体力学三大基本方程，系统介绍流体静力学、流体运动学和动力学、流动阻力和水头损失、有压管流、明渠流动、量纲分析和相似原理等基本理论及其应用。同时安排了四选二形式的实验教学内容。 课程采用课堂讲授、课外自学和实验讲授的混合式教学方式。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课堂平时测验、作业、实验和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Fluid Mechanics B is a primary supporting technology course of civil engineering and theoretical and applied mechanics. This course aims at raising students' specialized theoretical level and providing necessary basic knowledge for their professional learning. After this course, students can master the specific application and manifestation of the basic classical mechanics theory, based on Newton's three laws, in fluid mechanics. This course will calculate students’ ability of not only combining theory with practice when dealing with specific engineering application related to fluid such as wind engineering and seepage but also solving practical problems by experiment. Focusing on the three basic equations of fluid mechanics system, this course systematically introduces the basic theory and application of hydrostatics, hydrokinematics and fluid dynamics, flow resistance and head loss, pressurized pipe flow, open-channel flow, dimensional analysis and similarity principle. Students can choose two from four experimental teaching classes. The course adopts the mixed teaching method of classroom teaching, self-study and experiment teaching. The assessment results of the course are cumulative. The assessment links include classroom tests, homework, experiments and final exams. The total score is measured in 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程是在以往快速设计的基础之上而设置的设计表现实习课程，旨在短时间内，在给定的设计范围内进行快速设计表现训练，达到锻炼学生短时间的设计意识水平，以及检验平时积累知识的能力。1. 树立正确的设计思想，理论联系实际，将设计做的合理、合乎基本要求；2.了解课程给出的具体设计范围和设计内容； 熟悉设计过程及应用原则，掌握正确的设计成果表达方法； 3.深化学生对快速设计表现的运用能力；提高学生快速分析与设计的综合的能力，锻炼整体性创作思维。
default.en: This course is a design performance practice course set up on the basis of previous rapid design. It aims to conduct rapid design performance training within a given design scope in a short period of time, so as to train students' design awareness in a short period of time and test their ability to accumulate knowledge in peacetime. 1. Establish a correct design idea, combine theory with practice, and make the design reasonable and meet the basic requirements; 2. Understand the specific design scope and design content given by the course; Familiar with the design process and application principles, master the correct expression method of design results; 3. Deepen students' ability to use rapid design performance; Improve students' comprehensive ability of rapid analysis and design, and exercise holistic creative thinking.

default.zh: 《庭院设计》课程教学通过带领学生进行庭院设计实际案例参观和相关竞赛教学成果的讲解基础上，带领学生进行庭院环境设计相关竞赛和实际题目与时俱进的设计研究。设计内容包括城市或文化遗产地外部视听环境设计。题目学生自己选择，也可以老师指定地方调研基础上设计。其教学目标如下：1、树立正确的视听环境综合性认识；2、理解室内外环境中内容设定的科学性和风格设定的协调性；3、初步掌握室内外环境的设计方法；4、深入了解室内外环境设计的制图规范和设计思想。
default.en: The teaching of "Courtyard Design" leads students to conduct design research on courtyard environment design related competitions and practical topics on the basis of the explanation of the teaching results of courtyard design and related competitions. The design includes the design of the external audiovisual environment of the city or cultural heritage site. Students can choose the topic by themselves, or they can design it on the basis of research in the place designated by the teacher. The teaching objectives are as follows: 1. Establish a correct comprehensive understanding of the audio-visual environment; 2. Understand the scientific nature of content setting and the coordination of style setting in indoor and outdoor environments; 3. Preliminary grasp of the design methods of indoor and outdoor environments; 4. In-depth understanding of drawing specifications and design ideas for indoor and outdoor environment design.

default.zh: 计史旨在帮助学生梳理设计史的发展脉络，构建系统化的知识框架，通过揭示当代设计现象与历史设计运动、设计风格之间的关联，探寻设计史对当下设计实践的映射与启示，从而培养学习者的理论素养与批判性思维，深化其对设计文化的理解，塑造富有洞察力的设计观。
default.en: History of Design aims to help students systematically understand the developmental trajectory of design history and construct a structured knowledge framework. By revealing the connections between contemporary design phenomena and historical design movements or styles, it explores how design history reflects and informs current design practices. This fosters learners' theoretical literacy and critical thinking, deepens their understanding of design culture, and cultivates an insightful design perspective

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授人因学的基本概念、基本原理和基本应用实例。研究人机工程学的目的就是提高作业的工作效率；提高设备、器具、作业环境的工作舒适性，安全性问题。融会贯通人机工程学的基本原理和准则对于设计师设计出符合人的生理特点、心理特点、科学规律的产品至关重要。 本课程主要有十章内容组成，分别介绍人因学的基本概念，起源与发展；人的构造尺寸与功能尺寸的测量与特点，人的心理特性与特点；典型常规作业环境的分析与设计原则；人的疲劳的分类，疲劳的测量与预防；安全的基本概念，安全分析的基本原理与方法，安全的预防与产品的安全设计；典型人机装置的设计包括显示控制装置设计，工作岗位与工作场所设计，工具的把手设计等；人机工程学的总体设计方法与设计应用实例；人机工程学的先进研究与技术介绍等。本课程通过课堂教学、实验和产品改良设计几个环节力求学生对人机工程学这门课程能有更深的理解。
default.en: The course mainly the teaches knowledge about the basic concept、principle and application of human factors engineering. The aim for studying human factors engineering is to improve the work efficiency, to enhance the comfort and safety of equipment, apparatus and working environment. The grasping of the principle and guide line of human-machine engineering is key for designer to design good products to meet the human’s psychological, physiological need and science rule.
