default.zh: 建筑环境与能源系统测试技术是面向建筑环境与能源应用工程专业本科生的一门核心专业课。本课程主要介绍测量的基本知识、测量误差分析和数据处理的方法、本专业常用的温度、压力、湿度、流速、流量、液位、气体成分、气体含尘浓度、环境噪声、环境中放射性等参量的基本测量方法和测试仪表，智能仪表与分布式自动测量系统的原理与应用，使学生较深入地了解和掌握建筑环境营造所涉及的暖通空调测试的基本原理和基本方法。通过本课程的学习着重培养学生的问题分析能力、综合方案设计能力、复杂工程问题研究能力，增强创新意识。 课程主要包括测试技术的基本知识、测量误差和数据处理、温度测量、湿度测量、压力测量、物位测量、流速及流量测量、热流测量、建筑环境测量、其它参数测量、电动显示仪表、自动化测量系统和建筑环境测试技术等内容。 本课程采用课堂讲授与讨论相结合的方式进行教学。考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括出勤、作业和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Building environment and energy system testing technology is a core discipline course for undergraduates who major in building environment and energy application engineering. In this course, the principles of measurement, error theory and data processing methods are introduced firstly; then the basic measurement methods and instruments for measuring temperature, pressure, humidity, velocity, flux, liquid level, gas components, concentration of dust in gas, ambient noise, radioactivity in the environment and other parameters are introduced. At last, the principles and applications of intelligence instruments and distributed automatic measuring systems are introduced. By this course, students are required to grasp the basic testing principles and methods in HVAC. The course includes the basic knowledge of testing technology, testing error and testing uncertainty, measurement of temperature, measurement, pressure, material level, velocity and flux, heat flux, building environment and other parameters, electric display instruments, automatic testing system, and testing technology for building environment. The course is taught by the combination of teacher’s lecture and interactive discussions. The result of the course evaluation is cumulative. The assessment includes attendance, homework and final exam. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程是高等学校建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业核心课程，在培养学生系统思维、建筑节能意识、系统运行优化意识等方面占有重要的地位，也是对学生进行社会主义核心价值观教育，帮助学生树立正确世界观人生观价值观的核心课程。可作为建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的专业课程《流体输配管网》、《暖通空调》、《供热工程》、《热质交换原理与设备》、《建筑给排水》以及《燃气输配》等主要专业课的内容补充与支撑。 为了适应智慧建筑的发展与节能减排目标实现的需要，建筑内的系统与设备需要不同程度的自动化控制与系统集成控制，而自动控制领域新产品与新技术的应用，对建筑设备与系统自动化提出了更高要求。因此本课程的主要内容包括暖通空调系统自动化系统的组成、常用控制器、常用执行器、计算机控制系统、常用设备控制方法、空调水输配系统控制、供暖与通风系统的调节与控制以及中央空调系统的自动控制。通过本课程的学习，重点培养学生对建筑设备与系统自动化、智能化的理解，及对建筑内自动控制系统的设计、施工和管理方面的能力。 本课程以《建筑设备系统自动化》为教学内容，主要任务是通过课堂教学构建学生经典控制理论的知识体系，培养学生分析和解决暖通空调控制系统控制问题的系统思维，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: This course is a professional core course of architectural environment and energy application engineering, which occupies an important position in cultivating students' systematic thinking, building energy conservation awareness, system operation optimization awareness, etc.. And it is also the core course for students to educate students on socialist core values and help students establish a correct world outlook and outlook on life values. It can be used as the content supplement and support of major professional courses of building environment and energy application engineering, such as "Fluid Transmission and Distribution Network", "HVAC", "Heating Engineering", "Principles and Equipment of Heat and Mass Exchange", "Building Water Supply and Drainage" and "Gas Transmission and Distribution". In order to adapt to the development of intelligent buildings and realize the goal of energy saving and emission reduction, systems and equipment in the building need different degrees of automation control and system integration control. In addition, the automation of building equipment and systems has been put forward with higher requirements because of the application of new products and technologies in the field of automation. Therefore, the main content of the course includes the composition of HVAC system automation system, common controllers, common actuators, computer control systems, common equipment control methods, air-conditioned water transmission and distribution system control, heating and ventilation system regulation and control, central air-conditioning system automatic control and so on. Through the course, the students' understanding of building equipment and system automation and intelligence and the ability to design, construct and manage of the automatic control system in the building are focused on cultivation. The course takes "Building Equipment System Automation" as the teaching content, and the main task is to build students' knowledge system of classical control theory through classroom teaching, cultivate students' systematic thinking to analyze and solve the control problems of HVAC control systems, and support the achievement of corresponding index points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 供热工程基础是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业课，在培养学生工程思维、综合分析能力方面占有重要的地位。本课程讲授以热水为热媒的供暖和供热系统的工作原理和设计知识，运用专业基础课知识解决供热工程中的实际应用问题。其中既包括通过理论推导和证明而得出的理论公式，也包括应用数学方法归纳整理的经验公式，以及大量实践经验总结的实用数据和参考指标。结合现代科学技术的发展，增加新材料、新技术和新设备等内容。通过本课程的学习，要求学生了解和掌握建筑环境与能源应用专业涉及到供暖系统与集中供热系统的工作原理、设计方法和运行管理的基本知识，具备供热系统相关设计、运行与管理的基本能力，同时掌握利用系统仿真等现代化工具分析解决实际工程问题的技能。 课程主要内容分为室内供暖系统和城镇集中供热系统两部分：室内供暖系统，包括热负荷计算、散热器热水供暖系统及其组成、散热器选型计算、热水供暖系统水力计算；城镇集中供热系统，包括热负荷概算、供热系统组成及其流量计算、供热管网水力计算、水压图绘制、水力工况分析、供热调节基本原理与方法、供热管线的敷设和构造。要求学生围绕供热系统的三个组成部分重点掌握热负荷计算、水力计算与运行调节的基本原理，理解室内供暖系统和集中供热系统设计过程中的重要环节。 课程采用讲授、作业练习、案例分析和讨论等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、课堂考察和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Basic of Heating Engineering is a professional course in the field of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering, which plays an important role in cultivating students' engineering thinking and comprehensive analysis abilities. This course teaches the working principles and design knowledge of heating and heating systems using hot water as the heating medium, and applies professional basic course knowledge to solve practical application problems in heating engineering. This includes both theoretical formulas derived and proven through theoretical derivation, empirical formulas summarized and organized using mathematical methods, as well as a large amount of practical data and reference indicators summarized from practical experience. Combining the development of modern science and technology, adding new materials, technologies, and equipment. Through the study of this course, students are required to understand and master the basic knowledge of the working principles, design methods, and operation management of heating systems and central heating systems in the field of Building Environment and Energy Applications. They are also required to have basic abilities in the design, operation, and management of heating systems, and to master the skills of using modern tools such as system simulation to analyze and solve practical engineering problems. The main content of the course is divided into two parts: space heating system and urban district heating system: space heating system, including heat load calculation, radiator hot water heating system and its composition, radiator selection calculation, and hydraulic calculation of hot water heating system; Urban district heating system, including heat load estimation, heating system composition and flow calculation, hydraulic calculation of heating pipeline network, drawing of water pressure diagram, hydraulic condition analysis, basic principles and methods of heating regulation, and laying and construction of heating pipelines. Students are required to focus on mastering the basic principles of heat load calculation, hydraulic calculation, and operation regulation around the three components of the heating system, and understand the important links in the design process of space heating systems and district heating systems. The course is taught through lectures, classroom assessments, case studies, and discussions. The course assessment results are cumulative, and the assessment process includes homework, project research, and final exams. The total assessment score is calculated as a percentage, with a maximum score of 100 points.

default.zh: 《燃气输配及储存》面向于建筑环境与能源应用专业的城市能源方向的本科生开课，是一门重要的专业课程，在培养学生工程思维、设计、开发解决方案、环境与可持续发展、综合分析能力等方面占有重要地位。课程主要讲授城市燃气管网系统组成、管网水力计算和水力工况、调压器的结构和基本原理，以及压缩天然气和液化天然气工艺流程等。帮助学生深入了解燃气输配系统设计的基本原理和方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、案例剖析和课程设计等环境着重培养学生的工程思维和实践能力。 课程主要包括燃气分类及用途、城市燃气需用量及供需平衡、燃气长距离输气系统、城市燃气管网系统、燃气管道及其附属设备、燃气管网水力计算、燃气管网水力工况、燃气的压力调节及计量、燃气的储存、压缩天然气供应、液化天然气供应、液化石油气供应等内容。 课程采用讲授、互动交流、实验、作业练习等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、课上互动和期末考试，总评成绩以百分记，满分100分。
default.en: The course of gas transportation, distribution and storage is one of the main professional courses for the students from major of building environment and energy application. Through studying this course, the capacity of engineering design method, methods for solving engineering problems, thought of environment and sustainable development, analysis based on complex conditions could be improved. In this course, the taught contents mainly include structure of gas pipeline, hydraulic calculation and condition of gas pipeline, structure of pressure regulator and its regulated method. By the manners of teaching in class, case study and engineering design, it could be enhanced that the capacity of project design method and practical application. The teaching content mainly includes introduction, type and application of gas, calculation of gas consumption and balance of supply and consumption, system of gas transportation in long pipeline, structure of gas pipeline in city, gas pipeline and its accessory equipment, hydraulic calculation of gas pipeline, hydraulic condition of gas pipeline, pressure regulator and flow measurement of gas, storage of gas, application of CNG, application of LNG and application of LPG. The course is taught by the way of teaching, interactive, experiments, homework, etc. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework, combined train, and final exams. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 《燃气燃烧与应用》是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业能源方向的一门专业必修课。 燃气是城镇建设的重要基础设施之一，也是城镇能源的重要组成部分，在我国现阶段，燃烧是能源利用的主要方式，燃气是非可再生能源，其清洁、高效的燃烧对于节约能源、改善大气环境、实现“双碳”目标具有重要意义。本课程结合我国目前燃气事业的发展及应用情况，以我国现行的规范、标准、规程为依据，向学生系统的介绍燃气燃烧的基本理论和燃烧方法、燃烧器的设计计算及民用、商用、工业用燃烧设备的基本知识。 课程主要内容包括燃气的燃烧计算、燃气燃烧反应动力学、燃气燃烧的气流混合过程、燃气燃烧的火焰传播、燃气燃烧方法、扩散式燃烧器、大气式燃烧器、完全预混式燃烧器、燃气互换性、民用燃气用具、燃气工业炉窑及燃气锅炉等。 通过本课程的课堂讲授、习题及作业等环节，使学生能够掌握燃气燃烧应用所需的理论知识，了解扩散式燃烧器、部分预混式燃烧器及完全预混式燃烧器的设计计算方法，培养学生分析问题、解决问题的综合能力，能够进行民用、工业燃烧设备的设计、改造和运行管理。
default.en: Gas combustion and application is a required course for undergraduates majoring in Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering. Gas is one of the important infrastructure of urban construction, but also an important part of urban energy, at the present stage in our country, combustion is the main way of energy utilization, gas is non-renewable energy, its clean and efficient combustion is of great significance for saving energy, improving atmospheric environment, and achieving the goal of " the carbon peak and carbon neutrality ". Combining with the current development and application of the gas industry in our country and based on the current norms, standards and regulations in our country, this course systematically introduces the basic theory and combustion methods of gas combustion, the design and calculation of burners and the basic knowledge of combustion equipment for civil, commercial and industrial use. The main contents of the course include gas combustion calculation, gas combustion reaction dynamics, gas flow mixing process of gas combustion, flame propagation of gas combustion, gas combustion methods, diffusion burners, atmospheric burners, fully premixed burners, gas interchangeability, civil gas appliances, gas industrial furnaces, gas-fired boilers, etc. Through classroom lectures, exercises, and assignments in this course, students can master the theoretical knowledge required for the application of gas combustion, understand the design and calculation methods of diffusion burners, partial premixed burners, and fully premixed burners, cultivate their comprehensive ability to analyze and solve problems, and be able to design, transform, and operate management of civil and industrial combustion equipment.

default.zh: 城市燃气气源是面向建筑环境与能源应用工程专业建筑能源方向本科生开课的一门专业课，在对学生进行系统专业训练、培养学生以专业理念从事燃气领域的设计与管理工作方面具有重要的地位。可作为建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的专业课程《流体输配管网》、《燃气输配与存储》、《建筑冷热源》、《热质交换原理与设备》、《燃气燃烧与应用》以及《燃气输配》等主要专业课的内容补充与支撑。 城市燃气必须通过一定的净化和质量调整措施，达到输配和应用的质量要求，并保证连续安全供应。通过本课程的学习，令学生了解城市燃气气源的物理化学性质、生产及净化原理、工艺流程等内容，为学生毕业设计时进行气源选择和未来工作中组织气源做好知识储备。本课程主要包括绪论、燃气的组成及性质、煤制气（包括干馏煤气、气化煤气）、干馏煤气净化、天然气生产（包括形成、开采集输、净化）和液化石油气生产工艺等内容。通过本课程的课堂教学、习题练习、课程论文等环节，着重培养学生遴选燃气气源、确定工艺流程、选择相关设备的能力。 本课程的主要任务是讲授城市燃气气源的种类、性质及其工艺，以城市中的燃气气源的特性及其选择方法为基础框架，将理论与工程紧密结合，构建将专业理论知识转化为实际工程应用的知识体系，使学生较深入地了解和掌握城市燃气气源的专业知识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: City Gas Source is a professional course for undergraduates majoring in building energy in building environment and energy engineering. This course is essential for creating students’ professional concepts for design and management in the gas industry through comprehensive professional training. It is also a content supplement and support for the primary courses in building environment and energy engineering, such as” Design of Fluid Body Transportation Network”, “Gas Transmission and Storage”,” Cold and Heat Sources in Buildings”, “Heat Mass Exchange Principle and Equipment”, “Gas Combustion and Application”, "Gas Transmission and Distribution". To meet the quality criteria for transmission, distribution, and application, as well as to assure continuous and safe supply, city gas should undergo various purification and quality adjustment methods. This course teaches students about the physicochemical characteristics of city gas, as well as production and purification concepts and fundamental technological procedures. Simultaneously, it builds knowledge reserves for students to pick air sources for their graduation projects and arrange air sources in future. The main contents include an introduction, the composition of city gas, coal gas (including dry distillation gas and coal gasification gas), purification of dry distillation gas, production of natural gas (including formation, development, transportation, and purification), and production of liquefied petroleum gas. Students could improve their ability to pick the appropriate city gas source, identify the technical procedure, and select the necessary equipment through lectures and assignments. The primary goal of this course is to teach students about the types, qualities, and processes of city gas sources. Based on the characteristics of gas sources in cities and selection methods as the main foundation, it combines theory and engineering and transforms theory into actual applications. Students can improve their understanding and mastery of city gas sources and receive appropriate indicator points in their learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《燃气信息化及智能化》是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业本科生的专业方向核心课程，是培养燃气行业人才智能化的重要课程。在培养学生以信息化、智能化思维设计和开发解决方案，使用先进计算方法综合分析问题，以及环境和可持续发展意识等方面具有重要地位。目的是使学生了解和掌握燃气信息采集、信息化系统、智慧燃气系统、智慧燃气基础设施以及燃气智慧平台的基本知识，掌握人工智能模型及算法的分类及原理。熟悉和掌握人工智能模型在智慧燃气系统中的应用，具备应用先进计算工具或计算软件应用或完善现有智慧燃气平台的能力，具备依靠人工智能技术开发解决特定燃气系统问题的能力。了解智慧燃气对于国家能源发展、社会发展的重要意义，明确燃气信息化及智能化在对于燃气行业提高效率、保护环境中的作用，培养能源与环境可持续发展的理念。主要内容包括：人工智能概述、智慧燃气与架构、燃气智能化基础设施、燃气信息采集、燃气系统信息化、人工智能模型及算法应用、燃气智慧平台与智能化评价等。 课程采用讲授、互动交流、作业练习等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、课上互动和期末考试，总评成绩以百分记，满分100分。
default.en: This course is a core course for undergraduates majoring in building environment and energy application engineering, and an important course for cultivating intelligent talents in the gas industry. It plays an important role in training students to design and develop solutions with information and intelligent thinking, to use advanced computing methods to comprehensively analyze problems, and to develop awareness of environment and sustainable development. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand and master the basic knowledge of gas information collection, information system, smart gas system, smart gas infrastructure and smart gas platform, and master the classification and principle of artificial intelligence models and algorithms. Be familiar with and master the application of artificial intelligence model in smart gas system, have the ability to apply or improve the existing smart gas platform with advanced computing tools or computing software, and have the ability to develop and solve specific gas system problems by relying on artificial intelligence technology. Understand the significance of smart gas for national energy development and social development, clarify the role of gas informatization and intelligence in improving efficiency and protecting environment of the gas industry, and cultivate the concept of sustainable energy and environment development. The main contents include: overview of artificial intelligence, intelligent gas and architecture, intelligent gas infrastructure, gas information collection, gas system informatization, artificial intelligence model and algorithm application, intelligent gas platform and intelligent evaluation. The course is taught by the way of teaching, interactive, homework, etc. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework, combined train, and final exams. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 专业软件应用与实践是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业课，在培养学生将现代工具应用于专业中的探索、综合分析能力方面占有重要的地位。课程主要讲授天正暖通、DeST等常用暖通设计与科研软件的结构和基本操作方法，使学生较深入地了解现代工具在建筑环境与能源应用工程设计与科研领域的应用方法。通过本课程的上机实践和项目研究环节着重培养学生应用现代工具分析、解决专业问题的思维和能力。 课程主要包括暖通计算机应用概论、天正暖通软件应用技术、DeST软件应用技术等内容，并结合专业背景设置研究项目的主题，培养学生应用所学知识解决专业问题的实践能力、软件操作和撰写专题报告的文字表达能力。 课程采用上机演示、上机实践和项目研究等启发式方式进行教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课堂表现、上机作业和项目研究，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Technical software application and practice is a professional course for students of building environment and energy engineering, and it plays a significant role in cultivating students’ capability of both the application and exploration of modern tools and comprehensive analysis. The course mainly deals with the structure and basic operation methods of Tianzheng HVAC, DeST and other software used in the design and research of HVAC, and it can make students to thoroughly understand the application of modern tools in design and research of building environment and energy engineering. Students are mainly trained in the ability and thinking of using modern tools to analyze and solve professional problems through computer practice and project research of this course. The course mainly includes the introduction of HVAC computer applications, Tianzheng HVAC software application technology, DeST software application technology, and it also sets project researches in the course. This course can cultivate students' practical ability to apply the knowledge they have learned to solve professional problems, software operation, and the ability to write technical reports. The course is taught by ways of computer demonstrations, computer practices and project researches. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes class performance, computer practice tasks and project researches. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程拟讲授人类城市的发展历程，探讨城市的定义及城市起源的不同观点，介绍人类最早的新石器城市及其群系特征，各古老文明代表性城市的形态特征及其发展演变，从横向上概述各大文明的城市地域特点及文明间的交流，纵向上强调从农业文明到工业文明催生的城市革命，在层次上涵盖物质文明、制度文明与精神文明对城市的影响；引导学生用宏阔的文明史观来思考城市这种大尺度的文明成果，从不同子系统及要素的相互作用机制来理解城市的复杂性，介绍人类重要的城市规划思想及其时空背景，通过对不同城市形态的解读使学生学会阅读城市，梳理人类城市史上“理想城市”理念的发展历程，使学生了解“乌托邦”思想倾向的意义与危险；开展讨论使学生反思、批判城市存在的问题，分析现代科技革命给现代城市发展带来的挑战与机遇；引导学生欣赏城市之美，激发对传统城市的热爱并唤醒城市历史文化保护的意识。
default.en: This course is to teach the development of human city, discusses the definition and the different opinions about the origin of the city of city, introduces the earliest Neolithic human cities and the characteristics of the formation of each representative urban morphological characteristics and evolution of ancient civilization, Outlines the major cities of civilization regional characteristics and exchanges among civilizations from the horizontal, stresses revolution of the city from agricultural civilization to industrial civilization on the longitudinal, and covers the influence of the material civilization, the institutional civilization and the spiritual civilization on the city; Guide students to think in summer of civilization history to urban civilization achievement of such a large scale, from the mechanism of the interaction of different subsystems and elements to understand the complexity of the city, introduces the important time for mankind city planning thoughts and its background of time and space, through the understanding of the different urban form to make the students learn to read, combing the history of human cities "ideal city" concept of development, make the students understand the meaning of "Utopia" mindset and its dangerous; The discussion enables students to reflect and criticize the problems existing in the city, and analyzes the challenges and opportunities brought by the modern scientific and technological revolution to the development of modern cities. Guide the students to appreciate the beauty of the city, arouse their love for the traditional city and arouse their awareness of the protection of the city's history and culture.

default.zh: 城乡规划原理1课程是城市规划专业的专业基础课程，课程的主要包括城市居住区规划的基本理论知识和城市居住区规划的编制方法，是居住小区修建性规划设计课程的理论基础。课程的主要任务是培养学生掌握城市居住区规划的原理，包括掌握居住区规划基本概念及其相关知识；居住区结构组织形式及其历史演变；城市居住区住宅群规划的原则、要求及布置形式；城市居住区道路系统规划的内容、原则与方法；城市居住区绿地系统规划的内容、原则与方法；城市居住区公共设施规划内容、原则与方法；城市旧居住区改造规划的原则与方式；城市居住区规划的技术经济指标体系的组成及量化
default.en: Urban and Rural Planning Principle 1 is a specialized basic course for graduate students in the specialty of Urban Planning. The course makes the theory foundation for the course of Residential Quarter Planning and Design, and it consists of basic theory knowledge and establishment methods of residential quarter planning. The aim of the course is to train students to master urban residential quarter planning principle including: basic meaning and relative knowledge of residential quarter planning; organization form and historical evolution of urban residential quarter planning; planning rules, requirements and distribution of residential building block; planning content, rules and methods of road system, green space system and public facility system; rules and methods of urban old residential quarter reconstruction planning; component and quantification of technique and economic factor system of urban residential quarter planning.

default.zh: 随着大数据技术及空间分析技术的发展，GIS与空间分析技术已在城乡规划及相关领域中扮演着重要的角色，也成为城乡规划学生及专业者必需了解的重要工具。通过本课程的学习，能够使学生了解GIS的基本原理、GIS的数据特征、GIS数据的获取与数据处理的基本流程。在GIS数据处理与可视化分析的基础上，使学生能够了解GIS进行基本的缓冲区分析、叠加分析、三维分析以及国土空间规划GIS大数据分析等等GIS空间分析的技术与方法。通过GIS空间分析，使学生能够结合GIS技术与相关的遥感、时空大数据等内容进行基本的空间数据分析，了解空间分析的基本理论、方法及发展趋势。通过案例分析与实践解析，使学生能够了解GIS与空间分析技术在城乡规划之应用，以及如何应用GIS的相关功能结合，应用于国土空间规划、社会人文综合等相关领域之中。能够使学生对GIS空间分析技术及常用软件做一个系统性了解。通过实例上机操作分析，让同学学习如何运用GIS专业软件，并培养同学应用这些空间分析工具在辅助规划决策分析之能力。
default.en: With the development of big data technology and spatial analysis technology, GIS and spatial analysis technology have been playing an important role in urban and rural planning and related fields, and become an important tool for urban and rural planning students and professionals to understand.Through the study of this course, students can understand the basic principles of GIS, GIS data characteristics, GIS data acquisition and data processing of the basic process.On the basis of GIS data processing and visualization analysis, students can understand GIS spatial analysis techniques and methods, such as basic buffer analysis, superposition analysis, three-dimensional analysis, and territorial space planning GIS big data analysis.Through GIS spatial analysis, students can combine GIS technology with relevant remote sensing, spatio-temporal big data and other contents to conduct basic spatial data analysis, and understand the basic theory, method and development trend of spatial analysis.Through case analysis and practical analysis, students can understand the application of GIS and spatial analysis technology in urban and rural planning, and how to apply the relevant functions of GIS in territorial space planning, social and humanistic integration and other related fields.It can make students have a systematic understanding of GIS spatial analysis technology and common software. Through THE EXAMPLE OF COMPUTER operation analysis, students learn how to use GIS professional software, and develop their ability to use these spatial analysis tools to assist in planning and decision analysis.

default.zh: 规划设计专题-1课程的讲授内容为住区修建性详细规划。本课程引导学生复习掌握学过的城市规划与建筑设计等相关知识，并灵活运用于住区修建性详细规划中；结合各阶段实践教学环节，对住区的道路、公共建筑、住宅群体和绿地等进行综合规划与设计，在巩固已有城市规划理论与方法的基础上，了解和掌握城市住区规划的先进思想、理论和实践实例，拓展规划视野，开阔规划思路，为实际住区规划工作和进一步探索城市住区规划新方法奠定基础，同时掌握城市不同用地间在空间上的联系对对应；熟练掌握详细规划工作的内容、方法、步骤，培养学生表达规划设计意图的能力，巩固和加深对城市规划原理和居住区规划原理的理解。
default.en: The teaching content of the Planning & Design Topic-1 course is Constructive Detailed Planning of Residential Area. This course mainly guides students to review the relevant knowledge of urban planning and architectural design they have learned, and to flexibly apply them to the Constructive Detailed Planning of Residential Area. Through practical teaching at various stages, students will carry out comprehensive planning and design of roads, public buildings, residential groups, and green spaces in residential areas. On the basis of consolidating existing urban planning theories and methods, students will understand and master advanced ideas, theories, and practical examples of urban residential planning, which can expand planning perspectives, broaden planning ideas and lay the foundation for the actual residential planning design and further exploration of new methods of urban residential planning. In this course, students will understand the spatial connections and correspondences between different urban land uses, acquire proficiency in the content, methods, and steps of detailed planning work. This course not only cultivates students' ability to express planning and design intentions, but also consolidates and deepens their understanding of urban planning principles and residential area planning principles.

default.zh: 城乡规划原理1课程是城市规划专业的专业基础课程，课程的主要包括城市居住区规划的基本理论知识和城市居住区规划的编制方法，是居住小区修建性规划设计课程的理论基础。课程的主要任务是培养学生掌握城市居住区规划的原理，包括掌握居住区规划基本概念及其相关知识；居住区结构组织形式及其历史演变；城市居住区住宅群规划的原则、要求及布置形式；城市居住区道路系统规划的内容、原则与方法；城市居住区绿地系统规划的内容、原则与方法；城市居住区公共设施规划内容、原则与方法；城市旧居住区改造规划的原则与方式；城市居住区规划的技术经济指标体系的组成及量化
default.en: Urban and Rural Planning Principle 1 is a specialized basic course for graduate students in the specialty of Urban Planning. The course makes the theory foundation for the course of Residential Quarter Planning and Design, and it consists of basic theory knowledge and establishment methods of residential quarter planning. The aim of the course is to train students to master urban residential quarter planning principle including: basic meaning and relative knowledge of residential quarter planning; organization form and historical evolution of urban residential quarter planning; planning rules, requirements and distribution of residential building block; planning content, rules and methods of road system, green space system and public facility system; rules and methods of urban old residential quarter reconstruction planning; component and quantification of technique and economic factor system of urban residential quarter planning.

default.zh: 本课程教学理论结合实践，在课程中结合实际案例展开教学，将城乡规划的知识、解决问题的能力以及城乡规划工作中的方法等内容融合在一起，来提高学生的学习兴趣和综合性能力。课程内容主要包括城市与城市发展；城市规划学科发展概述；城市规划基本概念与内容；城乡规划的编制与实施；城市总体布局等。在教学过程中采用多媒体教学手段，通过计算机大屏幕投影，结合课堂讲授、实例评析和交流互动讨论，使学生了解城市规划的基本理论，了解城市总体规划的编制内容与编制方法。
default.en: This course combines teaching theory with practice, and combines practical cases in the course of teaching, which integrates the knowledge of urban and rural planning, the ability to solve problems and the methods of urban and rural planning work together, so as to improve students' learning interest and comprehensive ability. The course content mainly includes cities and urban development; overview of urban planning discipline development; basic concepts and contents of urban planning; preparation and implementation of urban and rural planning; overall urban layout. In the teaching process, multimedia teaching methods are adopted, through computer large screen projection, combined with classroom teaching, case analysis and interactive discussion, so that students can understand the basic theory of urban planning, and understand the preparation content and method of overall urban planning.

default.zh: 城乡规划原理-2是城市规划专业的核心理论课程，也是城乡规划专业教育中最为重要的课程之一，是一门培养学生城市规划理论与实践能力的专业核心课。本课程通过多媒体教学手段使学生掌握有关城市及城乡规划的基本理论知识，并熟悉城乡规划的编制方法和编制内容，扩展学生的视野和认识城市、改造城市的能力，提高学生理性思维和形象思维的能力，为其它城乡规划专业课程打下扎实的理论基础。 本课程教学理论结合实践，在课程中结合实际案例展开教学，将城乡规划的知识、解决问题的能力以及城乡规划工作者必须具备的职业道德和关注公共利益等方面的内容综合融贯在一起，以期整体提高学生的综合性能力。本门课程的主要内容包括城市与城市发展；城市规划学科发展概述；城市规划基本概念与内容；城市规划的编制与实施；城市规划的调查分析；城市的性质与规模；城市建设用地的评价与选择；国土空间规划以及专项规划等。
default.en: Urban & Rural Planning Theory-2 is the core theoretical course of urban planning and one of the most important courses in urban and rural planning education. It is a professional core course that cultivates students' theoretical and practical abilities in urban planning. This course uses multimedia teaching methods to enable students to master basic theoretical knowledge about cities and urban-rural planning, familiarize themselves with the methods and contents of urban-rural planning, expand their horizons and abilities to understand and transform cities, improve their rational thinking and image thinking abilities, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for other urban-rural planning courses. This course combines teaching theory with practice, and combines practical cases to carry out teaching in the course. It integrates knowledge of urban and rural planning, problem-solving abilities, professional ethics and public interest concerns that urban and rural planning workers must possess, in order to comprehensively improve students' comprehensive abilities. The main content of this course includes cities and urban development; Overview of the Development of Urban Planning Discipline; Basic concepts and content of urban planning; The formulation and implementation of urban planning; Survey and analysis of urban planning; The nature and scale of the city; Evaluation and selection of urban construction land; National spatial planning and special planning, etc.

default.zh: 通过实际地段的预先设计，进一步掌握城市设计相关理论和设计方法，熟悉城市设计过程。从而在课程学习过程中培养学生从城市设计角度发现问题、分析问题、解决问题的能力。课程主要包含目标包含：（1）根据城市建设需求，每年由学生自行选定设计地段，要求学生对地段及周围地区环境进行深入细致的调查研究，分析其现状用地功能、周边环境条件等方面存在的问题及机会，在此基础上合理确定该地段的城市设计目标和设计概念。（2）按照城市设计的理论和方法，对地段进行城市设计方案设计，设计重点在于准确的功能定位、合理的交通组织及宜人的环境景观塑造。调动各种城市设计元素，创造一处环境舒适、景观优美的城市空间，使其成为城市中充满活力的区段，体现该城市区段应有的价值。（3）培养学生独立完成城市设计方案及各体统分析的能力。
default.en: By pre-designing the actual location, the course enables students to further master the theories and methods related to urban design, and become familiar with the urban design process. Furthermore, during the course learning process, students are trained to discover, analyze, and solve problems from the perspective of urban design. The main objectives of the course include: (1) Based on the needs of urban construction, students are required to independently identify the design site each year. Students are required to conduct in-depth and detailed investigation and research on the site and surrounding environment, analyze the existing problems and opportunities in terms of land use functions and surrounding environmental conditions, and reasonably determine the urban design goals and concepts of the site on this basis. (2) According to the theories and methods of urban design, students can design urban design schemes for the site. The design focus in the course is on accurate functional positioning, reasonable traffic organization, and pleasant environmental landscape shaping. Mobilize various urban design elements to create a comfortable and beautiful urban space, making it a vibrant segment of the city and reflecting the value that this segment. (3) Cultivate students' ability to independently complete urban design schemes and analyze various systems.

default.zh: 《场地设计原理》是城市规划、风景园林专业和环境设计专业的一门综合性工程技术基础课，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和场地设计实践能力方面起着重要的作用。课程通过多媒体教学、场地调研、案例分析等手段，对与场地设计相关的内容进行了分析，对场地设计的基本理论知识、场地分析、设计要素构成、设计步骤、设计要点进行了综述，使学生掌握有关室外环境设计涉及的建筑布局、道路、广场、场地、竖向、绿化、管线等要素的相关知识，熟悉场地及室外环境小品设施的设计方法，为学生后续的课程设计提供解决方法。同时，使学生初步了解和掌握国内外场地及室外环境工程设计的技术经验和先进理论，为今后进一步学习和研究奠定基础，因此本门课在城市规划专业、风景园林专业及环境设计专业教学计划中占有重要地位。
default.en: THEORY OF SITE DESIGN is a comprehensive engineering technology basic course for urban planning, landscape architecture and environmental design majors, which plays an important role in cultivating students' creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and site design practice ability. Through multimedia teaching, site investigation, case analysis and other means, the course analyzes the content related to site design, summarizes the basic theoretical knowledge of site design, site analysis, design element composition, design steps, and design points. Further, students can master the relevant knowledge about the elements of building layout, roads, squares, sites, vertical, greening, and pipelines involved in outdoor environment design, be familiar with the design methods of the site and outdoor environmental sketch facilities, which provide support for the subsequent curriculum design. At the same time, students will initially understand and master the technical experience and advanced theory of field and outdoor environmental engineering design at home and abroad, laying a foundation for further study and research in the future. Therefore, this course plays an important role in the teaching plan of Urban Planning, Landscape and Environmental Design.

default.zh: 城市道路与交通是高等工科院校中城市规划专业的主干课程之一，是一门培养学生城市交通规划与道路设计基本理论和实践能力的专业课程。本课程主要研究交通工程学基本理论、城市交通规划的理论与方法、城市道路及其附属设施设计理论与方法、城市交通管理与控制的基本知识。在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中的有关知识和技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行城市规划专业人员必不可少的基本训练，为日后从事城市规划工作打下基础，因此本课程在城市规划专业的教学计划中占有非常重要的地位。
default.en: Urban Road and Traffic is one of the main courses of urban planning in high engineering colleges and universities. It is a professional course that trains students’ basic theory and practical ability of urban traffic planning and road design. The main contents of this course are the basic theories of traffic engineering, the theories and methods of urban traffic planning, the theories and methods of urban road and ancillary facilities design, and the basic knowledge of urban traffic management and control. In the teaching procedures, this course comprehensively applies with relevant knowledge and skills that have been studied in pre-course, combines with a variety of practical teaching links, carries on essential basic training for urban planning professionals, and lays a foundation for engaging in urban planning in the future, so it occupies very important position in the teaching plan of urban planning.

default.zh: 场地设计课程是城市规划专业本科生一门重要的设计课程。该课程的设置力求使学生运用学过的“城乡规划原理1（住宅区规划原理）”、“测量学”以及“室外工程技术”中的相关知识，对城市场地及室外环境设施进行设计。 课程培养学生独立完成室外场地竖向设计的能力；掌握室外环境设计、小品及街道家具设计的基本方法；掌握室外工程设施的构造及节点设计方面的基本知识。课程的主要内容包括：住宅小区的竖向设计；场地室外工程设施设计；园林建筑小品设计。
default.en: Site Engineering Design is an important design course for graduate students in the specialty of Urban Planning. Through this course, students could know how to make urban site design and outdoor environment embellishment design by using relative knowledge in courses of “Theory of Residential Quarter Design”, “Surveying” and “Site Engineering Technology”. The aim of this course is to train students to own abilities to complete outdoor site design independently, to know basic methods about outdoor environmental design and street furniture design, and to master knowledge about site engineering facility construction and detailed design. The content of Site Engineering Design includes: site design of a residential quarter, site engineering facility design and landscape architecture design. The main goals of this course are three aspects: ability to complete the vertical design of outdoor space independently; master the basic methods of exterior design, sketches and street furniture design; master the basic knowledge of the construction and node design of outdoor engineering facilities. The content of teaching includes design concept and planning scheme. design concept is designated to understand the terrain characteristics of the site, and reasonably determine the total layout of the site, and carry out the design of the outdoor engineering facilities. And planning scheme is referred to students use the theoretical knowledge to follow the different design stages of the results required to complete the drawing of the drawings and a brief design description. In terms of teaching method, classroom teaching will use multimedia teaching equipment to combine teaching and practical case analysis. According to the contents of each part of the teachings, put forward the practical issues related to the detailed planning and construction of the teaching content, and let think, discuss, and explain on the one hand to improve students' interest in learning, and on the other hand can make students learn the theory and detailed planning and construction practice. In the process of building design, site design is critical. China has vast territory, with north-south terrain so obvious. But in the construction, site design principles are the same, to the greatest extent to maintain the original site terrain style, and reduce the capital investment of field engineering. The importance of site design in architectural design is manifested in three aspects: firstly, the site design ensures the balance of earthwork in the construction area. In the process of design, there is the need try best to maintain the original style and landscape environment in the construction site, and make appropriate amendments in the original terrain and geomorphology. In other words, it is necessary to design the site to maximize the construction area to ensure the balance of earthwork to ensure that the building can be carried out in a relatively flat environment for construction operations. Secondly, the vertical design of the site design directly affects the spatial composition of the building, needing fully take into account the terrain, geological and specific environmental characteristics, to weaken the difficulty of vertical design. Thirdly, Road design is also an important part of the design of the site, which directly affects the overall layout of the building and the construction function requirements. Environmental protection is the key and important concern of site design. The process of site design requires the use of the basic principles of architectural composition, showing a flexible and diverse sense of contrast, and natural integration, fully embodying the principle of harmony between man and nature, to play the site design in the maintenance of environmental principles in the positive role.

default.zh: 规划设计-1是城市规划专业重要的专业核心课程，本课程本学期主要讲授住区修建性详细规划内容。课程采用课堂讲授、案例分析、现场参观、设计研究、阶段性构思及方案的辅导和讨论等多种教学方式方法，立足于居住区规划原理课程的教学内容，将城市规划原理1、住宅建筑设计原理、公共建筑设计原理、绿化景观环境设计原理等理论知识灵活运用于居住小区的规划设计中，使学生了解当前城乡住区的发展建设现状和趋势，从住区调查和相关文献资料查阅解析入手，学习住区规划设计中指标的计算和应用，在完成住区的整体构思与定位、住区结构规划设计的基础上，进行住区道路交通设计、绿化景观设计、公共建筑设计和住宅群体布置等规划设计工作，并就住区规划方案中重要的公共空间及绿化核心景观进行深化设计，做到住区定位恰当、结构合理、交通安全、居住舒适和空间景观优美的同时，掌握住区规划设计及修建性详细规划设计的工作内容、方法和步骤，并进一步训练提高学生城乡居住环境综合分析研究能力和规划构思及成果的图纸表达能力，巩固和加深对相关专业知识的理解和实际应用，并为后续的修建性详细规划、城市设计、毕业设计等学习研究和专业相关能力培养打好坚实基础。
default.en: Urban Planning & Design Studio-1 is an important core course for urban planning majors. This semester, the main focus of this course is to teach detailed planning for residential construction. The course adopts various teaching methods such as classroom lectures, case analysis, on-site visits, design research, guidance and discussion of phased ideas and plans. Based on the teaching content of the course on residential planning principles, the course flexibly applies theoretical knowledge such as urban planning principles 1, residential building design principles, public building design principles, and green landscape environmental design principles to the planning and design of residential communities, To enable students to understand the current development and trend of urban and rural residential areas, starting from residential survey and relevant literature review and analysis, to learn the calculation and application of indicators in residential planning and design. On the basis of completing the overall concept and positioning of residential areas, residential structural planning and design, planning and design work such as residential road traffic design, green landscape design, public building design, and residential group layout are carried out, And deepen the design of important public spaces and green core landscapes in the residential planning plan, to achieve appropriate positioning, reasonable structure, traffic safety, comfortable living, and beautiful spatial landscape of the residential area. At the same time, master the work content, methods, and steps of residential planning and detailed construction planning and design, and further train and improve students' ability to comprehensively analyze and research urban and rural living environments, as well as their ability to express planning concepts and results on drawings, Consolidate and deepen the understanding and practical application of relevant professional knowledge, and lay a solid foundation for subsequent learning and research on construction detailed planning, urban design, graduation design, and the cultivation of professional related abilities.

default.zh: 本课程是城乡规划专业必修课，重点培养学生对现阶段习近平总书记提出的以生态文明为基础的新时期国土空间规划体制的理解，掌握具有中国特色社会主义和实现伟大中国梦思想指导下，国土空间发展新趋势和新需求。课程运用学过的城市规划和土地利用规划等相关理论知识，以规划设计为主要手段，在对国土空间现状调查的基础上，综合研究和探讨新体制下国土空间规划的方法。课程教学以设计辅导为主, 并配以基本概念及专题讲授，结合国内外实际案例辨析在国土空间规划基本原理之上拓展相关实践知识。通过课程教学，使学生明确国土空间规划改革的政策背景与重大意义，掌握国土空间规划的编制程序与基本内容，熟悉国土空间规划编制实践的具体操作与侧重点：初步了解国土空间规划体系，掌握规划编制内容和方法。通过实践教学培养现状分析能力，了解三区三线划定、国土空间布局、中心城镇规划、近期建设和设施规划等内容的规划设计方法。了解国家的有关政策与法规。鉴于国土空间规划层次较多，难度较大，本课程以乡镇级国土空间规划作为教学重点，选取国内具有代表性的乡镇级国土空间规划实际案例辅助教学。
default.en: The course utilizes the theoretical knowledge of urban planning and land use planning that has been learned, with planning and design as the main means. Based on the investigation of the current situation of national land space, it comprehensively studies and explores the methods of national land space planning under the new system. The course teaching mainly focuses on design guidance, accompanied by basic concepts and special lectures, and expands relevant practical knowledge based on the basic principles of national spatial planning by analyzing practical cases at home and abroad. Through course teaching, students will be able to understand the policy background and significant significance of land spatial planning reform, master the procedures and basic content of land spatial planning, familiarize themselves with the specific operations and focuses of land spatial planning practice, and have a preliminary understanding of the land spatial planning system, as well as grasp the content and methods of planning preparation. Through practical teaching, cultivate the ability to analyze the current situation, and understand the planning and design methods for the delineation of the three zones and three lines, land spatial layout, central town planning, recent construction and facility planning. Understand relevant national policies and regulations. Given the high level and difficulty of territorial spatial planning, this course focuses on township level territorial spatial planning as the teaching focus, and selects representative practical cases of township level territorial spatial planning in China as auxiliary teaching.

default.zh: 规划设计3是城市规划专业本科生一门重要的设计课程。该课程教学目的是使学生通过调研与实践，了解控制性详细的编制内容和编制方法。课程要求学生基本掌握土地使用控制，综合环境质量控制等方面的知识。 课程主要培养学生掌握土地使用控制的方法（土地使用性质细分及其兼容范围控制，土地使用强度控制）；基本掌握综合环境质量控制（城市主要公共设施、配套服务设施控制，内外道路交通关系控制，城市特色和景观控制，工程管线控制等）等方面的知识；具有独立完成控制性详细规划设计及规划管理的能力。
default.en: Urban Planning & Design Studio-3 is an important design course. The aim of this course is to make students learn about content and method of Urban Regulatory Detailed Plan establishment on the basis of surveying, researching and practicing. Students are required to master knowledge about land using control and integrated environment control.

default.zh: 规划快速设计培训课程设置力求使学生运用学过的知识，对指定设计地段进行快速规划设计，达到理解、消化学过理论知识的目的。该课程目的是考核和训练学生对所学基本知识的掌握以及综合运用各方面知识进行快速设计的能力。一方面，达到学生能够运用所学的理论知识完成相关图纸的绘制以及简要的设计分析问题。另一方面，学生能够掌握快速设计的方法，提高快速独立快速地完成规划设计的能力。
default.en: The training course for rapid planning and design aims to enable students to apply the knowledge they have learned to quickly plan and design designated design areas, in order to understand and digest the theoretical knowledge they have learned. The purpose of this course is to assess and train students' mastery of the basic knowledge they have learned and their ability to comprehensively apply various aspects of knowledge for rapid design. On the one hand, it aims to enable students to apply their theoretical knowledge to complete the drawing of relevant drawings and brief design analysis problems. On the other hand, students can master the methods of rapid design, improve their ability to quickly and independently complete planning and design, and achieve the ability to quickly and independently complete urban design.

default.zh: 作为本科阶段第二个快速设计，快速设计-2课程为学生提供了从规划思维向城市设计思维，从二维宏观的功能布局向三维中微观尺度的空间形态设计转变的平台。快速设计-2通常根据课程需要选定一定规模的城市地区，要求学生在6个小时内完成对设计对象的问题分析、概念生成、成果表达（文字及图形）等工作，并利用2个学时左右时间，由教师对设计方案进行讲解和点评。快速设计-2力图训练学生快速且独立地完成规划设计的能力。
default.en: As the second quick design course in the undergraduate stage, the Quick Design -2 course provides students with a platform to transition from planning thinking to urban design thinking, from two-dimensional macro functional layout to three-dimensional meso micro scale spatial form design. Quick Design -2 usually selects a certain scale of urban areas according to the course requirements, requiring students to complete problem analysis, concept generation, and result expression (text and graphics) of the design object within 6 hours, and to use about 2 class hours for teachers to explain and comment on the design plan. Quick Design -2 aims to train students' ability to quickly and independently complete planning and design.

default.zh: 城市综合调研是城乡规划专业重要的专业核心课程，也是一门社会实践性较强的基础课程。调查研究是对城乡社会环境从感性认识上升到理性认识的必要过程，是各阶段、各层次城市规划编制、研究和管理的主要依据。本课程在温习社会调查研究的相关概念、基本原理、方法体系和对应程序的基础上，结合城乡规划调查研究成果案例分析，从广泛阅读专业文献、深入观察城乡环境现象、敏锐发觉城乡问题入手，引导学生关注社会矛盾、关注民生，重点面向城乡规划或社会发展前沿问题、人文历史问题和弱势群体问题，帮助辅导学生理清调查研究意义、思路，设计调查研究方案、提炼调查研究类型和方法，讲授调查中不同论题的调查类型选择和方法组合，与同学共同讨论研究相关数据样本的获得途径和对应的分析方法及结果，辅导学生逐步深入调查程序，现场指导调查行动，在对比讲授调查报告逻辑框架特征、各部分内容要点及文字数据表达的同时，强调调查研究及成果报告的真实性、客观性和创新性，反复讨论修正调查报告的论证逻辑和量化及文体表述，培养学生透过现象发现问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，为后续的研究学习能力的培养打好坚实基础。
default.en: Urban survey research is an important professional core course of urban-rural planning, and it is also a basic course of social practice. Urban planning survey research is essential process of rising from the perceptual knowledge to the rational knowledge of urban and rural social environment, and main basis of various stages and various levels of establishment, research and management of urban planning. Based on the related concepts, basic principles, method system and corresponding procedures of the study, this course guides students to pay attention to social contradictions, people's livelihood, focus on urban and rural planning and social development frontier issues, human history and vulnerable groups problems combined with the case study of urban and rural planning investigation with a wide range of reading professional literature, in-depth observation of urban and rural environmental phenomena, keen find urban and rural problems. This course helps students to clarify the significance and concept of the research, design research programs, refine the types and methods of investigation and research, and teaches survey type selection and method combination of different topics, discusses the access and corresponding analysis methods and results of relevant data samples with students. This course also tutors students to learn in-depth investigation procedures gradually, guides the investigation action on-site, emphasizes authenticity, objectivity and innovation of results and the report by teaching the logic frame characteristics of the investigation report, key points of the contents and text data expression. Logic of the investigation, quantification and stylistic expression of the report are repeatedly discussed, in order to develop students’ ability to find problems, analyze problems, and solve problems from the phenomenon and lay a solid foundation for further study and research.

default.zh: 城乡规划原理-3课程是为城乡规划专业本科生开设的一门专业课程，建筑学、风景园林等专业本科生也可以选修。课程教学目的是使学生掌握有关村镇规划的基本理论知识，了解村镇规划不同于城市规划的特点，并熟悉村镇规划的主要内容，为业务实践和毕业设计打下理论基础。中国位于乡村地域的国土面积广阔，村镇数量众多。近年来，中央和地方各级政府对乡村建设问题都一直十分关注，村镇规划也成为国家乡村振兴战略和新型城镇化战略中的重要组成部分。但是，村镇规划与城市规划在理论和方法上存在较大的差异，深入了解和重视这些差异才能更好地完成村镇规划与建设工作。 本课程主要任务是培养学生了解村镇规划与建设在乡村振兴战略和新型城镇化战略背景下的重要意义；了解村镇发展的基本规律以及村镇规划的新理论和新方法，掌握村镇规划的编制内容及编制办法。 在课程教学过程中教师将采用多媒体教学手段，结合课堂讲授、村镇规划案例评析的方法加深学生对课堂知识的理解。在巩固已有城市规划相关知识的基础上，使学生了解和掌握村镇规划的基本内容和方法。
default.en: The Course of Urban & Rural Planning Theory-3 is a professional course designed for undergraduate students majoring in urban and rural planning. Undergraduate students majoring in architecture and landscape architecture can also choose to take it. The purpose of the course teaching is to enable students to master the basic theoretical knowledge of village and town planning, understand the characteristics of village and town planning that are different from urban planning, and become familiar with the main content of village and town planning, laying a theoretical foundation for business practice and graduation design. China is located in a vast rural area with a large number of villages and towns. In recent years, central and local governments at all levels have been paying close attention to rural construction issues, and village and town planning has become an important component of the national rural revitalization strategy and the new urbanization strategy. However, there are significant differences in theory and methods between village and town planning and urban planning. Only by deeply understanding and valuing these differences can we better complete the work of village and town planning and construction. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' understanding of the important significance of village and town planning and construction in the context of rural revitalization strategy and new urbanization strategy; Understand the basic laws of village and town development, as well as new theories and methods of village and town planning, and master the content and methods of compiling village and town planning. In the course teaching process, teachers will use multimedia teaching methods, combined with classroom teaching and case analysis of village and town planning, to deepen students' understanding of classroom knowledge. On the basis of consolidating existing knowledge related to urban planning, enable students to understand and master the basic content and methods of village and town planning.

default.zh: 本课程在教学计划中是建筑学和城市规划专业大四学生以及环艺专业大三学生的专业基础理论课，24学时，1.5学分。 通过本课程的教学，让学生掌握城市设计的基本知识，提高理论素养。对于建筑学专业的同学，有利于在今后的建筑设计学习和工作实践中建立起城市和城市环境的概念，增强城市责任感；对于城市规划的同学，这门课程是他们专业学习的拓展，是今后学习和工作实践中必须具备的理论素养。因此，该课程在城市规划、建筑类专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和作用。 本课程的教学内容包括：城市设计的基本概念，城市设计的历史和基本理论，城市设计基本要素和原则、城市设计的过程和成果，以及城市开发、管理和城市景观方面的知识。
default.en: This course is a professional basic theory course for senior students of architecture and urban planning and junior students of the professional environment art in the teaching program. It values 1.5 credits with 24 hours’ teaching time. Through the course we want to equip students with basic knowledge of urban design and enhance theoretical knowledges. It occupies an important position and role in teaching program of urban planning, architectural. For the students of architecture, it is conducive to establish the concept of cities and the urban environments and to improve the city's sense of responsibility during the study and work practices of architectural design in the future. For the students of urban planning, it is the expansion of their professional learning and the basic theoretical grounding during the study and work practices in the future. The curriculum of the course includes: the basic concepts, theories, elements, history, principles, processes outcomes of urban design and knowledges of urban development, management and urban landscapes.

default.zh: 本课程是为本科生开设的一门综合性专业选修课程，包括：城市工程系统和防灾规划。城市工程系统由电力电讯、给水排水、供热燃气、管线综合四个环节构成。 《电力电讯》课程目的是使学生通过学习，了解电力电讯设备的应用与发展概况，掌握城市电力电讯工程规划的基本理论和方法。 《给水排水》包括城市给水工程规划和城市排水工程规划，目的是通过教学使学生较为系统地掌握关于城市给排水工程规划的基本概念、基本理论和基本处理方法，培养学生对城市给排水工程设计、规划编制相关知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 《供热与燃气》使学生掌握城市燃气供应系统和城市供热系统的相关知识，培养学生具备编制城市工程规划的综合能力，并提升理论与实践结合的素质。 《管线综合》课程目的使学生了解城市管线综合规划的基本原则和规定，掌握管线综合规划编制方法和程序。 《防灾规划》课程教学目的是使学生掌握有关城市防灾学的基本理论知识，能够进行城市防灾工程规划以及基本的防灾工程设计。培养学生掌握国内外城市防灾学的发展状况与趋势；具备城市防灾规划设计的能力；了解新理论、新方法及发展趋势。
default.en: Urban Engineering System and Disaster Prevention Planning is an important comprehensive elective course for undergraduate students. The urban engineering system consists of four parts, which includes Electric Power and Telecommunication, Water Supply and Drainage, Heating and Gas, and Pipeline Synthesis. Electric Power and Telecommunication aims to make students to understand the general situation of the application and development of electric power telecommunication equipment, and to learn the basic theories and methods on engineering planning of urban electric power and telecommunication. Water Supply and Drainage aims to make students learn about the basic concept on engineering planning of city water supply and drainage, basic theory and basic processing method through systematically teaching, to cultivate the student to application ability related the urban water supply and drainage engineering design and planning, to realize the goal of teaching. Heating and Gas is a course to make the students learn the knowledge about urban heating and gas supply system, to foster students’ overall ability to work independently, and to improve the quality on combination of theory and practice. Pipeline Synthesis aims to make students understand the basic principles and regulations, and to cultivate students master the methods and procedures on urban planning of pipeline synthesis Disaster Prevention Planning aims to make students understand basic theories of urban disaster prevention, so as to content of courses on disaster prevention of planning and architectural design. At the same time, it seeks to develop students’ ability to study, organize, supervise, and make decisions on urban disaster mitigation. It is intended to guide students to master general situation on urban disaster prevention, to cultivate students’ the ability on urban disaster prevention, to know the latest theories, methods and trends.

default.zh: 本课程为城乡规划专业本科生选修课程。建筑学和风景园林专业本科生也可以选修。通过跟踪和解析国内外城乡规划领域的前沿理论和相关实践，使学生能够及时了解城乡规划的发展趋势，及时更新学科专业知识，拓展国际视野，提升创新能力。本课程以专题形式，在教学过程中教师采用多媒体教学手段，以课堂讲授、实例评析、政策解读等为主要内容，以最新的学科、行业发展动态信息突出教学内容的时效性与实战性，配合教学，引导学生学习专业文献检索和课外扩展阅读、专题研究和报告撰写等，提升学生自主学习、主动探索的能力，并及时了解城乡规划的最新理论、技术方法、前沿动态和国家的政策法规，为进一步强化城乡规划的专业意识和知识领域奠定基础。课程包括四个单元：（1）城乡规划问题与趋势，要求学生了解国内外城乡规划发展趋势、城镇化政策及研究课题；（2）城市社会可持续发展，要求学生了解城市社会发展研究的前沿理论、技术方法和实践案例；（3）城乡规划设计研究与实践，要求学生了解国内外规划设计新理论及实践案例。（4）城乡规划热点专题，针对我国城乡规划与建设的热点问题开展解析并研讨。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in urban and rural planning. Undergraduate students majoring in architecture and landscape architecture can also take elective courses. By tracking and analyzing cutting-edge theories and related practices in the field of urban and rural planning both domestically and internationally, students are able to timely understand the development trends of urban and rural planning, update their disciplinary knowledge, expand their international perspective, and enhance their innovation capabilities. This course takes the form of a special topic, and the teacher uses multimedia teaching methods in the teaching process, with classroom lectures, case analysis, policy interpretation, etc. as the main content. It highlights the timeliness and practicality of the teaching content with the latest subject and industry development information. In conjunction with teaching, it guides students to learn professional literature retrieval and extracurricular extended reading, special research and report writing, etc., enhancing students' ability to learn independently and explore actively, and timely understanding the latest theories, technical methods, cutting-edge dynamics, and national policies and regulations of urban and rural planning, laying the foundation for further strengthening the professional awareness and knowledge field of urban and rural planning. The course consists of four units: (1) Urban and Rural Planning Issues and Trends, requiring students to understand domestic and international urban and rural planning development trends, urbanization policies, and research topics; (2) The sustainable development of urban society requires students to understand the cutting-edge theories, technical methods, and practical cases of urban social development research; (3) The research and practice of urban and rural planning and design require students to understand new theories and practical cases of planning and design at home and abroad. (4) Special topic on urban and rural planning, analyzing and discussing hot issues in urban and rural planning and construction in China.

default.zh: 专业法规是指导行业行为的准则和规范，是维系理论与实践的原则性规定。新中国城市建设伊始，就十分重视建设法规的制定和完善，至今已基本形成了比较全面的建设法规体系，为我国的城乡建设的规范化、制度化提供了有力保障。目前，注册建筑师、注册城市规划师考试均把规划建设法规列为必考科目，这是相关执业工作必备的基本知识。 本课程从实际需要出发，讲授与城乡规划、风景园林专业密切相关的管理与法规知识，包括我国的工程建设基本程序、城乡规划法学、城乡规划编制管理、城乡规划实施管理，以及城乡规划编制单位资质管理和从业人员资格管理等相关知识。 期望通过本门课程，帮助学生熟悉我国城乡建设得以顺利实施所依赖的制度框架体系，掌握城乡规划编制或审批工作的主体、要点、程序，熟悉违法建设查处的原则依据，形成有明确公共利益取向的价值观，培养学生有意识地关注国家公共政策，初步掌握分析理解公共政策的能力，并为未来参加注册城市规划师考试奠定基础。
default.en: Professional laws and regulations are the norms and standards to guide the industry behaviors, and also the principled rules to relate theories with practice. Much attention has been put onto drafting and perfecting the city construction regulations since the foundation of the People’s Republic of China. Nowadays, a comprehensive construction laws and regulations system has been formed, which guarantees the normalization of the city and country’s construction in China. At present, the planning construction laws and regulations have been listed onto the required contents menu of Registered Architect and Registered Urban Planner qualification test, which are the necessary elementary knowledge in related work. This curriculum embarks from the actual needs, teaches knowledge about current city construction administration and regulations, which are closely related with Urban Planning and Landscape Architecture. It includes the basic program of engineering construction in China, science of urban planning law, urban & rural planning formulation and implementation administration and regulations, and qualification management in urban & rural planning industry. This course aims to help students to familiar with the institutional framework system which urban and rural construction follows, master the main bodies, key points and procedures in urban & rural planning formulation and implementation, familiar with the principles and legal basis in disposing illegal constructions, form the public interest- oriented values, cultivate students to pay close attention to national public policies, preliminarily possess the ability of analyzing and understanding public policies, lay a foundation for future’s registered urban planner exam.

default.zh: 本课程是风景园林专业本科生的专业设计课程，具有基础性、引导性的特征。通过基于小尺度建筑、庭园空间的设计训练，初步了解景观与建筑的基本概念；建立景观与建筑设计观念与思维；了解景观与建筑设计相关理论，掌握空间设计的基本方法，熟悉设计的过程；培养从景观设计角度发现问题、分析问题、解决问题的能力，尝试实验环节在设计过程中的介入途径。 通过课程学习使学生掌握以下知识与能力：了解景观与建筑的类型和基本构成要素；掌握从使用者主观需求、设计地段客观空间条件两个层面寻找并发现问题；通过案例讨论，分析设计条件及面临问题，能提出有效解决问题的方法；掌握设计的基本表达方法，并能准确、清楚的进行设计成果的表达。 本课程开题环节重点讲授课程的教学设计，明确设计目标和采用的相关设计方法；理论专题重点学习建筑与庭园的类型和相关设计要素及其影响机制；设计现场调研环节完成设计数据采集和使用者需求的收集；实验环节完成过程模型、土壤分析；设计方案环节重点完成案例分析、设计思维、空间表达、汇报展示的训练。
default.en: This course is a professional design course for undergraduate students majoring in landscape architecture, with basic and guiding characteristics. Through design training based on small-scale buildings and garden spaces, gain a preliminary understanding of the basic concepts of landscape and architecture; Establishing landscape and architectural design concepts and thinking; Understand the theories related to landscape and architectural design, master the basic methods of spatial design, and be familiar with the design process; Cultivate the ability to discover, analyze, and solve problems from the perspective of landscape design, and try to intervene in the experimental process during the design process. Through course learning, students will master the following knowledge and possess the following abilities: understanding the types and basic components of landscape and architecture; Mastering the search and discovery of problems from two aspects: user subjective needs and objective spatial conditions of the designed location; Through case discussions, analyze design conditions and problems faced, and be able to propose effective problem-solving methods; Master the basic expression methods of design and be able to accurately and clearly express the design results. The beginning session of this course focuses on teaching the teaching design of the course, clarifying the design objectives and relevant design methods used; The theoretical topic focuses on learning the types and related design elements of architecture and gardens, as well as their impact relationships; Complete the design data collection and user demand collection during the on-site research phase of the design; Complete experiments to process-model and soil analysis ; The design coaching session focuses on training in case analysis, design thinking, spatial expression, and presentation.

default.zh: 本课程是风景园林专业的一门重要的专业核心课程，以植物为主线，系统介绍植物学的基本理论与植物景观设计方法。对于风景园林专业学生而言，课程目标是培养其辨识常用景观植物、理解植物形态结构与功能的关系，培养其在具体项目实践中合理选用植物材料的分析和研究能力，以及运用所学知识分析、解决与植物学相关问题的能力。对于其他专业的学生而言，本门课程可作为一门通识课，引领同学了解多姿多彩的植物世界，了解植物景观设计的方法，培养其热爱自然、建立环境保护意识和自然界可持续发展的正确价值观。 课程教学内容以视频、文稿、动画、图片的方式呈现，要求学生仔细观看和阅读课程材料，按时完成单元测验和作业，积极参与讨论，分享学习体会，交流学习经验。
default.en: This course is an important professional core course for landscape architecture majors. With plants as the main line, it systematically introduces the basic theories of botany and plant landscape design methods. For students majoring in landscape architecture, the goal of the course is to cultivate their ability to identify common landscape plants, understand the relationship between plant morphological structure and function, develop their ability to analyze and research the rational selection of plant materials in specific project practice, and use the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve problems related to botany. For students of other majors, this course can be used as a general course to guide students to understand the colorful plant world, understand the methods of plant landscape design, and cultivate their right values of loving nature, establishing environmental protection awareness and sustainable development of nature. The course content is presented in the form of videos, manuscripts, animations and pictures. Students are required to carefully watch and read the course materials, complete unit tests and assignments on time, actively participate in discussions, share learning experiences and exchange learning experiences.

default.zh: 地理信息系统（GIS）作为一门新型的交叉性、边缘性学科，是空间信息科学与技术的一个重要组成部分，在城市规划与管理方面有着广泛的应用前景。通过地理信息系统课程的讲授，使学生能了解地理信息系统的基本概念、基本原理、应用方法、最新理论与发展趋势、以及在城市规划设计与管理等方面的发展现状与应用实例。学生能够了解和掌握GIS的技术特点，并能够结合城乡规划设计与管理中的遥感、交通、生态环境、城市管理以及社会基础设施与公共服务设施运行等方面的发展趋势与建设要求，将多类型、多来源的数据进行综合处理，能够运用GIS技术来进行城乡规划多元数据的采集、编辑与空间分析等工作，并将空间分析的结果进行综合的空间表达与可视化展示。将空间分析与大数据技术以及相关学科的发展趋势相结合，通过建构GIS的相关知识结构，拓展城市规划技术与理论思维。使学生能够了解GIS的设计方法、分析管理与应用等方面的最新理论技术方法，掌握运用相关知识进行城乡规划的设计、管理与决策分析的能力。
default.en: Geographic information systems ( GIS ) as a cross-cutting, a new borderline subjects, Is an important part of spatial information science and technology. Especially in urban planning and management has a wide application prospect. the basic task of geographic information system (GIS) course is let Student understanding “what is and how can do that” about GIS. In additional, Students can use GIS analysis some urban planning and urban design problem and aided design through out the course. Students are able to understand and grasp the characteristics of GIS technology, and the ability to combine remote sensing in urban and rural planning, design and management, and transport, operation of ecological environment, urban management, urban infrastructure and public service facilities, and so on. Students can learn how to use the integrated treatment of multiple types, multiple sources of data. In the lecture, Students can understand the basic concept of GIS, basic principle and application method of GIS, as well as the latest theory and the development tendency about GIS. We also discuss various GIS analysis and application examples for the urban planning, urban design and urban infrastructure management such as spatial buffer analysis, Overlay analysis, network analysis, digital elevation model (DEM) analysis in the lecture. The finally goal is promote knowledge structure of student and improving digital design capability of urban planning and urban design by using GIS.

default.zh: 1. 贯彻落实习总书记生态治国理念，有效引导学生深刻领会“绿水青山就是金山银山”蕴含的经济发展与自然生态系统及人文生态系统间的辩证关系。紧扣习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想铸魂育人这个核心任务，在课程内容中找到“触点”和“融点”，即尊重自然规律、生态过程及生物多样性的核心思想，当前世界面临着人口、资源、环境污染和生态破坏等问题，引导学生树立生态先行的景观规划设计哲学观，“顺应自然规律、重视生态价值”、实现“可持续发展、永续发展”；结合实践教学环节，以“润物无声”的方式教育和引导学生感受黑龙江得天独厚的大冰雪、大森林、大湿地、大界江等自然与人文资源所蕴藏的精神力量，贯彻“绿色”生态文明教育，树立学生为社会服务、为家国服务、为人类谋求生态系统服务和福祉的使命感和责任感。 2. 基于自然和人文科学相关知识，综合考虑自然生态环境和人文生态环境因素，研究风景园林规划设计的复杂问题；熟悉景观调查研究的基本原理、主要内容，掌握景观调查研究的基本操作程序、调查方法、数据采集方法、数据统计及分析方法、调研报告的撰写方法。 3. 通过调查、实验、统计、模拟等方法，（1）深入掌握调研全过程（设定研究问题——确定研究范围——制定调研计划——实施调研——数据整理分析——补充调研——数据再整理分析——调研结果汇总——完成调研报告）；（2）学会运用相关仪器及设备采集数据，科学地分析景观学复杂巨系统中的各类问题、得出科学结论并完成调研报告；（3）通过团队合作，培养学生的沟通能力和团队合作能力。
default.en: This course is a core course for Landscape Architecture majors with comprehensive, social and technical characteristics. It cultivates students' ability and quality to find and analyze problems on the basis of comprehensive consideration of natural ecological environment and humanistic ecological environment factors. Through the theoretical study and field research training of this course, students will master the following knowledge and have the following abilities: 1. Based on the relevant knowledge of natural and human sciences, comprehensively consider the natural ecological environment and human ecological environment factors, and study the complex issues of landscape architecture planning and design; Familiar with the basic principles and main contents of landscape investigation and research, master the basic operating procedures, investigation methods, data collection methods, data statistics and analysis methods, and research report writing methods of landscape investigation and research. 2. Through investigation, experiment, statistics, simulation and other methods, (1) in-depth understanding of the whole process of research (setting research questions -- determining the scope of research -- formulating research plans -- implementing research -- data collation and analysis -- supplementary research -- data re-collation and analysis -- summary of research results -- completion of research reports); (2) Learn to use relevant instruments and equipment to collect data, scientifically analyze various problems in the complex giant system of landscape science, draw scientific conclusions and complete research reports; (3) Cultivate students' communication skills and teamwork ability through teamwork.

default.zh: 本课程通过课堂讲授、实地调研和设计指导，训练学生综合运用所学的相关的场地设计理论知识进行设计实践，熟悉场地设计的设计过程，掌握场地设计的设计方法。了解园林植物的配置相关原理，了解植物群落与生态因子的相互关系。熟悉植物景观概念设计、方案设计、施工图设计程序与绘图标准⑤掌握园林植物与山石、地形、水体、建筑小品等景观要素的配置方法。 通过课程的训练与学习，达到让学生进一步掌握并熟练运用场地选择和资源分析、视觉设计、竖向设计、工程构造设计等场地设计的相关知识的目的，根据植物景观构图的科学性与艺术性原则，独立完成城市街道广场、城市住区、城市公园等城市绿地植物景观设计任务。培养学生实地调查研究的总结分析能力、针对不同情况采取适宜技术方案的解决问题能力和综合运用所学知识的工程实践能力。
default.en: This course trains students to comprehensively apply the relevant theoretical knowledge of site design through classroom teaching, on-site research, and design guidance, familiarize themselves with the design process of site design, and master the design methods of site design. Understand the principles related to the configuration of garden plants, and understand the interrelationships between plant communities and ecological factors. Familiar with plant landscape concept design, scheme design, construction drawing design procedures and drawing standards. ⑤ Master the configuration methods of landscape elements such as garden plants and mountains, terrain, water bodies, and architectural sketches. Through the training and learning of the course, the goal is to enable students to further master and proficiently apply relevant knowledge of site selection and resource analysis, visual design, vertical design, engineering structure design, and other site design. Based on the scientific and artistic principles of plant landscape composition, they independently complete urban green space plant landscape design tasks such as street squares, urban residential areas, and urban parks. Cultivate students' ability to summarize and analyze field investigations, adopt appropriate technical solutions for different situations, and comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned in engineering practice.

default.zh: 课程以生态为主线在规划和设计两个尺度进行公园设计。生态公园规划通过生态基础设施的视角，使学生把景观生态、环境生态的知识，转换为空间规划能力。了解自然生态系统的内在机制与规律，及其在城市化进程中的压力与问题。掌握生态系统分析方法、规划方法，为下一尺度生态公园设计提供上位规划，为最终的EOD整体规划设计建立坚实基础。基本内容包括对地段及周围地区生态环境进行调查研究，分析其生态过程、环境压力等方面的问题及机会，确定设计目标和概念，形成总体性整合方案，重点在于生态分析、生态系统规划。 生态公园设计基于上位规划的控制和指导，依托场地尺度完成可实践的生态设计。课程关注景观生态原理和生态工法的应用，培养学生从生态视角考虑景观空间设计，提升多维考虑问题的能力。基本内容包括对局部设计地块的再思考，分析场地生态资源的保护和利用方式，选择与场地空间匹配的生态工法，营建可感知的景观场所。旨在创造一个在生态效益、空间美学和景观体验之间平衡的景观空间。
default.en: The course takes ecology as the main line to design the park at the two scales of planning and design. Based on the planning of ecological park in the perspective of ecological infrastructure, students are enabled to convert the knowledge of landscape ecology and environmental ecology into a spatial planning ability. And the course cultivates students to understand internal mechanism and regularity of urban natural ecological system through the process of pressure and problems, to master ecosystem analysis, planning method for the next scale ecological park design and to establish solid foundation for the final overall EOD planning and design.Basic content includes: investigation and research of lots and the surrounding area environment analyzing the current situation, the surrounding conditions together with other problems and opportunities; identification of the target and design concepts to form the overall intergradational programme focusing on ecological analysis and ecological system planning. Based on the upper level planning, the ecological park design completes the practical ecological design on the site scale. Focuses on the application of landscape ecological principles and ecological engineering methods, the course cultivates students' ability to consider landscape space design from an ecological perspective and improve multi-dimensional consideration. The basic course content includes rethinking the local design of the plot, analyzing the protection and utilization of the site's ecological resources, selecting the ecological construction method that matches the site space, and building a perceptible landscape site. It aims to create a landscape space that balances ecological benefits, space aesthetics and landscape experience.

default.zh: 景观规划设计-3是风景园林学重要的高年级专业设计课程，具有综合性、社会性、技术性的特点，培养学生面对基于城市尺度的系统复杂性，通过设计讨论城市发展中的经济、生态、社会可持续议题。学生需要在形态维度、功能维度、时间维度、视觉维度、社会维度等层面，对特定城市区域进行深层次调研、讨论和设计，对场地的复杂性做出回应。在场地总规要求的基础上，以调研为依据，以问题为导向，从城市、建筑与景观的整体层面进行思维，提出发展策略和具体的城市设计方案，并对具有研究意义的典型城市开放空间进行详细设计。 （1）了解相关设计规范和原则，在城市尺度研究和讨论基于可持续发展的议题，了解城市系统的复杂性，通过城市设计回应现实问题，并通过场地尺度的详细设计提升实践能力。 （2）关注调研、分析、讨论；提升观察视角、批判思维、策略建构和设计创新能力；完善设计方法和设计过程；既强调对城市设计整体策略的系统建构，也强调对景观要素与空间细节的表现。 （3）提升绘图、文字、语言等层面的沟通表达能力。能够熟练运用图面、模型、文字及口头表达技能对设计问题进行分析、评价和沟通，提倡团队合作，并具备一定国际视野。 （4）引导学生感受黑龙江省内独特的自然与人文资源所蕴含的精神力量，挖掘城市文化基因，并学习运用规划设计方法传承地域情怀，增强文化自信。
default.en: landscape Planning and Design-3 is an important senior professional design course in landscape architecture. With comprehensive, social and technical characteristics, it trains students to discuss economic, ecological and social sustainable issues in urban development through design in the face of system complexity based on urban scale. Students need to conduct in-depth research, discussion and design of specific urban areas in the form dimension, functional dimension, time dimension, visual dimension and social dimension, and respond to the complexity of the site. On the basis of the requirements of the general regulations of the site, based on research and problem-oriented, the development strategy and specific urban design scheme are proposed from the overall level of city, architecture and landscape, and the typical urban open space with research significance is designed in detail. (1) Understand relevant design norms and principles, research and discuss issues based on sustainable development at the urban scale, understand the complexity of urban systems, respond to practical problems through urban design, and improve practical ability through detailed design at the site scale. (2) Focus on research, analysis and discussion; Enhance the ability of observation perspective, critical thinking, strategy construction and design innovation; Improve the design method and process; It emphasizes not only the systematic construction of the overall strategy of urban design, but also the performance of landscape elements and spatial details. (3) Improve communication and expression skills in drawing, writing and language. Be able to analyze, evaluate and communicate design problems skillfully with drawings, models, writing and oral expression skills, advocate teamwork, and have a certain international perspective. (4) Guide students to feel the spiritual power contained in the unique natural and human resources in Heilongjiang Province, tap the urban cultural gene, and learn to use planning and design methods to inherit regional feelings and enhance cultural self-confidence.

default.zh: 生态基础设施（Ecological Infrastructure，EI）本质上讲是城市的可持续发展所依赖的自然系统，是城市及其居民能持续地获得自然服务（natures services）的基础，这些生态服务包括提供新鲜空气、食物、体育、游憩、安全庇护以及审美和教育等等。它包括城市绿地系统的概念，更广泛地包含一切能提供上述自然服务的城市绿地系统、林业及农业系统、自然保护地系统，并进一步可以扩展到以自然为背景的文化遗产网络。 本课程目标：①学生对城市内一真实的设计地段进行仔细的调研，掌握分析地段生态构成及气候状况的能力；②运用景观生态学的理论与方法，对地段进行生态景观设计；③掌握城市绿地系统规划的相关要求；④旨在探索一个既景色优美，又遵循自然法则，对城市生态起到有益促进的城市发展模式。
default.en: The Ecological Infrastructure (EI) is essentially the natural system that cities rely on sustainable development. It is the basis for the sustainable acquisition of natures services by the city and its residents. These Ecosystem services include fresh air, food, sports, recreation, safe haven and aesthetic and education and so on. It includes the concept of urban green space system, more widely contains all can provide the natural services of urban green space system, forestry and agriculture, natural protected area system, and further, it can be extended to a network of cultural heritage based on nature. Objectives of this course: ①Students should conduct a careful investigation of a real design area in the city, and master the ability to analyze the ecological composition and climate situation of the area; ②Using the theory and method of landscape ecology, ecological landscape design is carried out; ③To master the related requirements of urban green space system planning; ④The aim is to explore a model of urban development that is both scenic and natural, which is conducive to urban ecology.

default.zh: 《景观工程与技术》是一门培养风景园林学专业学生景观工程意识、职业规范、工程理念与方法的十分重要的专业必修课程。 （1）专业知识: 让学生了解风景园林工程的范畴和基本理论，结合设计案例，通过对景观工程构造和施工手段的讲解，让学生掌握地形景观营造、道路景观营造、水体景观营造、生态景观营造、建筑景观营造、设施景观营造的工程技术，并学会绘制典型的景观工程构造节点； （2）能力要求:让学生了解风景园林工程的相关规范与法规，了解当今时代与工程技术创新的发展趋势和成就；并通过学习理解景观工程建造的问题和逻辑。 （3）综合素质:培养学生的社会责任感和适应发展的能力，使其能够在设计实践中理解职业责任和义务，遵守职业道德和规范并能有效履行责任。
default.en: Through the illustration about design methods and principles of garden’s buildings, including earthwork calculation, water landscape, roads in the park, water supply and drainage, rockwork design, with the analysis of excellent projects, the knowledge about Engineering Technicality of Landscape will be taught in the course. Students may be trained to grasp the different methods of resolving engineering problems. The course main content including: the developing history of landscape engineering and technicality, the definition and meanings of landscape engineering technicality, the engineering constitution nodes and their construction, the engineering and technicality of site landscape, road landscape, water landscape, plant landscape, buildings landscape, establishment landscape.

default.zh: 风景园林规划设计原理是一门培养学生景观意识、责任、理念与方法的专业基础课程。通过阐述景观规划设计的基本概念,论述景观规划设计中的哲学基础、总体目标、原则、元素特征、景观各系统构成与设计方法、景观各类型与设计方法等内容。课程教学包括对滨水景观、生态规划、海绵城市、文化景观、夜景观、纪念性景观等专项景观的原理与方法的介绍；以及规划设计中场地设计、园区规划、生态公园、城市绿地系统等四大类重要景观类型设计原理的阐述。教学目标如下：①了解掌握景观学科的基本理论和基本观点；②了解景观的设计内容设计制方法；③了解掌握景观调查内容和方法，能对特定问题进行分析；④了解掌握景观布局原则及方法；⑤了解景观和景观发展的基本规律、景观的新理论、新方法及发展趋势。
default.en: The principle of landscape planning and design is a professional basic course to train students' sense of sight, responsibility, ideas and methods. By expounding the basic concept of landscape design, this course elaborates the landscape planning and design philosophy, the overall objectives, principles, elements, characteristics of landscape, the composing and design methods of different system, different landscape types and design method etc. The course consists of the introduction of the principles and methods of waterfront landscape, ecological planning, sponge City, cultural landscape, night landscape, memorial landscape and other special landscape; as well as the elaboration of the four major types of landscape design principles —— the site design, park planning, ecological parks, urban green space system. The teaching objectives are as follows: ,① understand the basic theory of landscape ecology and the basic point of view; ②he understanding of design content design method of landscape;③ the understanding of the content and methods of landscape survey, to analyze the specific problems; ④understand the landscape layout principles and methods; ⑤the understanding of landscape and landscape development of the basic law, the new landscape the new theory, methods and development trend.

default.zh: 本课程通过课堂讲授和设计方案辅助指导的综合讲授手段，训练学生综合运用所学的场地设计理论知识进行设计实践，熟悉场地设计的设计过程，掌握场地设计的设计方法。通过理论知识的讲授为后续的场地规划设计课程的训练与学习打好基础，进而达到让学生进一步掌握并熟练运用场地选择和资源分析、视觉设计、竖向设计、工程构造设计等场地设计的相关知识的目的，培养学生实地调查研究的总结分析能力、针对不同情况采取适宜技术方案的解决问题能力和综合运用所学知识的工程实践能力。
default.en: Through the comprehensive teaching methods of classroom teaching and assisted guidance of design schemes, this course trains students to comprehensively apply the theoretical knowledge of site design to design practice, get familiar with the design process of site design and master the design method of site design.
