The objectives of the course are mainly to correspond to engineering knowledge, problem analysis, design and development solutions, research, engineering and society, communication, environment and sustainability from the perspective of architectural design innovation Continued development.

default.zh: 本课程是公共建筑设计原理的扩展性课程，针对图书馆建筑这一特殊建筑类型的设计问题做专题性介绍，以培养学生专业素养和提高设计能力为着眼点，使学生对于图书馆这类重要公共建筑的设计有全面、切实的认识，为日后从事建筑设计实践打下坚实基础。
default.en: The course is the expansible one of the Public Building Design, which introduces design problems of Library Building, in order to train students to have professional qualities, improve design abilities and develop a broad overall and solid view of this kind of Public Building design, furthermore, to lay a solid foundation for architecture design practices in future.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向建筑学本科高年级学生的专题理论课程，具有综合性、社会性、技术性的特点，是对学生专题建筑认知的扩展。本课程以“现代校园建筑”为核心，内容包含理论学习、专题学习；培养学生在建筑横向维度上进行更深层次理解的素质，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 本课程将深入探讨校园建筑的整体规划设计、功能设计要点及未来发展趋势，详细介绍现代校园建筑设计发展背景及现状，系统分析综合校园及各类校园建筑的规划设计要点，重点思考智慧校园、低碳校园、健康校园等技术和理念。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握校园建筑设计的基本理论、方法与技能，提高其在校园建筑设计和规划方面的专业素养和综合能力，为未来从事各类型校园建筑策划及设计相关工作打下坚实基础。 课程教学方式主要有课堂讲授、项目案例解析和自主研究学习；课程考核方法是根据学生的课堂出勤情况和结课论文的质量来综合评定，总成绩中课堂结课汇报占比100%。
default.en: This course is a thematic theory course for upper-year students in architecture, which is comprehensive, social and technical in nature, and is an extension of students' thematic architectural knowledge. With "contemporary campus architecture " as the core, this course includes theoretical and thematic studies; it cultivates students' quality of deeper understanding in the horizontal dimension of architecture and supports the achievement of the corresponding index points in the professional learning outcomes. This course will discuss the overall planning and design of campus architecture, functional design and future development trends, introduce the background and current situation of contemporary campus architecture architectural design, systematically analyze the planning and design of general campus architectures and various types of specialized campus architectures, and focus on thinking about the design concepts and methods of smart campus architecture, green campus architecture and healthy campus architectures. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theories, methods and skills of campus architecture design, improve their professional literacy and comprehensive abilities in campus architecture design and planning, and lay a solid foundation for their future work in the fields of types of campus architecture preliminary planning and design projects. The teaching methods of the course mainly include classroom lectures, project case analysis and independent study; the course assessment method is based on the students' classroom attendance and the quality of the final paper. In the total score, final papers account for 100%.

default.zh: 工业建筑设计专题是高等工科院校中建筑学专业的设计拓展类课程，专门针对工业建筑这一特殊类型的设计问题做专题性介绍。课程目标主要是了解工业建筑的类型特征和设计基础知识，掌握相应设计原理和方法。在教学过程中运用先修课程中掌握的知识和技能，结合实践教学环节，领悟工业建筑的独特性设计思维和设计要点。进一步拓展视野，了解当代工业建筑的变化趋势，探索未来工业建筑的发展方向。
default.en: The design of the industrial architecture is one of the professional courses in higher engineering college in architecture. The course is an extension to the lecture serials of special topic on industrial architecture. The course mainly includes the introduction of the basic theories and principle methods of the industrial architecture design. With the related knowledge and skills the students learned before and based on various practical projects, it makes the students to master the special professional thinking and requirements of industrial building design. To broaden the horizons, it also makes the students to understand the development of modern industrial architecture and its possible changing trends.

default.zh: 本课程是公共建筑设计原理的扩展性课程，专门对体育场馆这一特殊类型建筑的设计问题做专题性介绍，属于专业性实用性具强的专业课。主要目的是使学生：①了解、掌握体育建筑的分类及其共性特点，相关设计理论及方法；②熟悉其功能空间构成及相关规范要求，掌握视线设计、消防疏散设计原理与计算方法；③加深对体育建筑所需的大跨结构选型、结构形态和建筑造型等知识与设计的认知。通过本门课程的学习，达到以下课程目标： 目标1：使学生了解本课程的性质、任务，与其它课程的关系；掌握体育建筑的性质、类型及其共同特征；了解体育建筑的功能结构、分区及流线设计。 目标2：使学生通过学习体育建筑的视线设计原理和评价，掌握座席视线升起的计算方法。 目标3：了解和掌握体育建筑的防火疏散设计规范要求和设计手段。 目标4：了解体育建筑屋盖的主要结构形式及其应用特点，了解体育建筑的结构选型和建筑造型的密切关系，掌握正确处理二者关系的原则和手法。
default.en: This extended professional course of the design principles of public building provides a thematic introduction to the design issues of stadiums with strong specialty and practicability. The course aims are listed below: (1) To make students understand and comprehend the classification, commonalities, and characteristics of sports buildings, as well as relevant design theory and methodology. (2) To guide students to be familiar with the composition of functional spaces and relevant specification requirements of sports buildings, sightline design, design principles and calculations for fire evacuation. (3) To acquaint students with the specialized knowledge and design of the long-span structure selection, structural form, and shape of sports buildings.Through the study of this course, to achieve the following course objectives: (1) Students will be able to understand the nature, targe of the course, and the relationship with other courses. They will learn the nature, types, and common characteristics of sports buildings and comprehend the functional structure, partition, and circulation design. (2) To enable students to acquire the calculation method of raising the audience’s sightline via learning sightline design principles and assessment of sports buildings. (3) To understand and acquire code requirements for the fire evacuation plan and design methods of sports buildings. (4) To guide students to understand primary structural forms and application characteristics of the sports building roof. As well as to comprehend close relations between the structure selection and architectural modeling of sports buildings, and to grasp principles and methods of dealing with the relations.

default.zh: 在介绍人口老龄化、老年人环境需求、老年人建筑发展趋势的基础上，结合我国“以居家养老为基础、以社区服务为依托、以机构养老为补充”的养老方针，深入讲解与之相对应的住宿照料型养老设施、日间照料型养老设施、老年住宅/适老化住宅的设计要求，并介绍有代表性的国内外设计实例。
default.en: Phase with the introduction of an aging population, and environmental needs of the elderly, the elderly on the basis of the architectural trends, combined with our "home care, community service as the basis, institutional pension supplement" pension policy, in-depth explanation corresponding residential care facilities for the elderly, the type of day-care facilities for the elderly, elderly residential / suitable for the aging residential design requirements, and describes the representative domestic and foreign design examples.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向建筑学本科高年级学生的专题理论课程，具有综合性、社会性、技术性的特点，是对学生专题建筑认知的扩展。本课程以“当代医院建筑”为核心，内容包含理论学习、专题学习；培养学生在建筑横向维度上进行更深层次理解的素质，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 本课程将深入探讨医疗建筑的整体规划设计、功能设计要点及未来发展趋势，详细介绍当代医院建筑设计发展背景及现状，系统分析综合医院及各类专科医院的规划设计要点，重点思考智慧医院、绿色医院和健康医院等新兴医院的设计理念与方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握医院建筑设计的基本理论、方法与技能，提高其在医疗建筑设计和规划方面的专业素养和综合能力，为未来从事医疗建筑设计和健康科学领域的相关工作打下坚实基础。 课程教学方式主要有课堂讲授、项目案例解析和自主研究学习；课程考核方法是根据学生的平时成绩和结课案例分析成果的质量来综合评定，总成绩中平时成绩占比20%，结课案例分析成果占比80%。
default.en: This course is a thematic theory course for upper-year students in architecture, which is comprehensive, social and technical in nature, and is an extension of students' thematic architectural knowledge. With "contemporary hospital architecture" as the core, this course includes theoretical and thematic studies; it cultivates students' quality of deeper understanding in the horizontal dimension of architecture and supports the achievement of the corresponding index points in the professional learning outcomes. This course will discuss the overall planning and design of medical buildings, functional design and future development trends, introduce the background and current situation of contemporary hospital architectural design, systematically analyze the planning and design of general hospitals and various types of specialized hospitals, and focus on thinking about the design concepts and methods of smart hospitals, green hospitals and health hospitals and other emerging hospitals. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theories, methods and skills of hospital architectural design, improve their professional literacy and comprehensive abilities in medical architectural design and planning, and lay a solid foundation for their future work in the fields of medical architectural design and health science. The teaching methods of the course mainly include classroom lectures, project case analysis and independent study; the course assessment method is based on the students' usual performance and the quality of the final case study ppt. In the total score, usual performance accounts for 20% and final case study ppt account for 80%.

default.zh: 文化，是建筑之灵魂。对建筑中制度文化与精神文化的探究，是解决建筑之“为什么”方面的问题。 课程的目的在于从文化的视野去探究建筑表象背后更为深刻的故事，使学生能够分析与建筑空间的观念、形式相关联的种种文化因素，并能够解释建筑空间形式及其演变方式因文化而异的现象；能够以比较研究的方法理解不同文化背景下的建筑空间生成与发展动因，具备跨文化的建筑视野。 课程内容包括了东西方的文化特征、中国建筑与儒释道文化、建筑与哲学、建筑与人类学四个专题，通过专题讲授结合课堂汇报、讨论的教学形式，建立起中西方文明与建筑交互的整体架构，搭建中西方文明影响下的建筑思想或流派的比较研究平台。
default.en: Civilization is the soul of architecture. The research of institutional civilization and spiritual civilization is to solve the problem of “why” in architecture. The purpose of curriculum is to explore underlying stories behind images of architecture from the perspective of civilization, to enable students to analyze cultural elements associated with architecture form and notions of space. Furthermore, students are instructed to explain the phenomena that architecture space form and their evolvements vary with different civilizations, and they are required to using comparative study to grasp generation and development of architecture space in different culture background with the cross-cultural view. The curriculum includes four topics: Eastern and Western cultural characteristics, Chinese architecture and Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism culture, architecture and philosophy, and architecture and anthropology. The curriculum combines topic-based teaching with discussion in class to build an overall framework of interaction between Chinese and Western civilizations and architecture is established. And a comparative research platform of architectural thoughts or schools under the influence of Chinese and Western civilizations is built.

default.zh: 本课程拟探讨城市的定义及城市起源的不同观点，介绍人类最早的新石器城市及其群系特征，讲授中国城市的起源及中国城市的发展历程，从横向上概述中华文明不同的城市地域特点及地域间的交流，纵向上强调农业革命、周秦之变、唐宋之变及全球化引发的城市革命，在层次上涵盖物质文明、制度文明与精神文明对城市的影响；引导学生用宏阔的文明史观来思考城市这种大尺度的文明成果，从不同子系统及要素的相互作用机制来理解城市的复杂性；介绍先秦两种重要的城市规划思想及其时空背景，通过对不同城市形态的解读使学生学会阅读城市，梳理中国都城史上从“黄河时代”到“运河时代”的迁移历程，使学生了解都城选址反映出的政治、军事、经济的复杂考量；开展讨论使学生反思、批判城市存在的问题，分析现代科技革命给现代城市发展带来的挑战与机遇；引导学生欣赏城市之美，激发对传统城市的热爱并唤醒城市历史文化保护的意识。
default.en: This course aims to explore diverse perspectives on the definition and origin of cities, introduce the earliest Neolithic cities and their formation characteristics, teach the origin and development process of Chinese cities, summarize the regional characteristics and inter-regional exchanges of different cities in Chinese civilization horizontally, and emphasize the agricultural revolution, changes during the Zhou and Qin Dynasties, transformations in Tang Song Dynasties, as well as urban revolution caused by globalization vertically. It encompasses the influence of material civilization, system civilization, and spiritual civilization on urban areas. The objective is to guide students in contemplating large-scale civilizational achievements of cities within a broad framework of civilizational history while comprehending city complexity through interaction mechanisms among various subsystems and elements. This paper introduces two significant urban planning concepts along with their temporal and spatial backgrounds during pre-Qin period. By interpreting different urban forms, students can learn how to analyze cities while tracing migration processes from "Yellow River Era" to "Canal era" in Chinese capital's history; thus enabling them to understand complex political, military, and economic considerations reflected in capital city locations. The discussion prompts students to reflect upon existing issues within cities while analyzing challenges as well as opportunities brought about by modern scientific and technological revolutions for contemporary urban development. Students are guided towards appreciating city aesthetics which stimulates love for traditional cities while awakening awareness regarding historical-cultural preservation.

default.zh: 本课程讲授外国城市的发展历程，横向上概述各大文明的城市地域特点及文明间的交流，纵向上强调从农业文明到工业文明催生的城市革命，在层次上涵盖物质文明、制度文明与精神文明对城市的影响；引导学生用宏阔的文明史观来思考城市这种大尺度的文明成果，思考城市发展的动力因素，从不同子系统及要素的相互作用机制来理解城市的复杂性。介绍人类重要的城市规划思想及其时空背景，通过对不同城市形态的解读使学生学会阅读城市，理解城市布局对建筑的影响及建筑对城市空间的建构。梳理西方城市史上“理想城市”理念的源头与后续影响，使学生了解“乌托邦”思想倾向的意义与危险；开展讨论使学生反思、批判城市存在的问题，分析现代科技革命给现代城市发展带来的挑战与机遇；引导学生欣赏城市之美，激发对传统城市的热爱并唤醒城市历史文化保护的意识。树立正确的城市发展观，培养学生批判性思维的能力，学会分析外国城市发展的得与失。
default.en: This course aims to provide an in-depth understanding of the development process of foreign cities. It explores the urban regional characteristics of major civilizations and their horizontal exchanges, while emphasizing the vertical urban revolution from agricultural civilization to industrial civilization. Additionally, it examines the impact of material civilization, institutional civilization, and spiritual civilization on cities at various levels. By adopting a broad perspective on civilizational history, students are encouraged to contemplate the significant achievements made by cities and explore the driving factors behind urban development. Furthermore, they will gain insights into the complexity of cities through an examination of different subsystems and elements that interact within them. Through analyzing diverse urban forms, students will learn how to interpret cities and comprehend how urban layouts influence architecture as well as how architectural construction shapes urban spaces. The origin and subsequent influence of "ideal city" concepts in Western city history will be analyzed to help students understand both its significance and potential dangers associated with utopian ideologies. Discussions will enable students to reflect upon and critique existing issues within contemporary cities while also analyzing challenges and opportunities brought about by modern scientific and technological revolutions for their future development. Moreover, this course seeks to cultivate an appreciation for the beauty inherent in cities while stimulating a love for traditional ones thus awakening awareness regarding historical preservation efforts. Ultimately, this course aims to establish a correct concept regarding urban development while simultaneously training students' critical thinking abilities so that they can effectively analyze both gains achieved as well as losses incurred during foreign urban developments.

default.zh: 《历史遗产保护专题》是建筑学专业专题课程之一，对于学生树立良好的建筑历史观、加强遗产保护理论知识和建筑设计素养有重要作用。课程在教学中基于历史建筑的三重价值，历史价值、艺术价值、技术价值，帮助学生建立对历史建筑的全景式理解和多维度认知。从遗产保护的三个要素，根植的背景，感知的主体和遗产的实体，评析中国、西方大量遗产保护案例，从人文性引导、知识性讲解以及理论性提炼等多元教学方法、多重教学视角，理解遗产保护理论和保护方法等内容。 课程内容包括了解历史建筑的基本概念、评估标准和保护历程、保护法规等，学习挖掘多种信息进行合理的历史建筑考证与推断的方法；理解历史建筑的三种价值及遗产保护的当代意义，综合多元知识体系，培养鉴别、评析历史建筑的能力；评析中国、西方大量建筑遗产保护实际案例，引导学生建立遗产保护原则、更新策略、修缮方法等。
default.en: The Special Course on Historical Heritage Protection is one of the specialized courses in architecture, which plays an important role in cultivating a good view of architectural history, strengthening theoretical knowledge of heritage protection, and enhancing architectural design literacy for students. The course is based on the triple value of historical architecture in teaching, including historical value, artistic value, and technical value, to help students establish a panoramic understanding and multi-dimensional cognition of historical architecture. From the three elements of heritage protection, the rooted background, the perceived subject, and the entity of heritage, evaluate and analyze a large number of heritage protection cases in China and the West. From multiple teaching methods and perspectives such as humanistic guidance, knowledge-based explanations, and theoretical refinement, understand the theory and methods of heritage protection. The course content includes understanding the basic concepts, evaluation standards, protection history, protection regulations, etc. of historical buildings, and learning the methods of mining various information for reasonable historical building verification and inference; Understand the three values of historical architecture and the contemporary significance of heritage protection, integrate diverse knowledge systems, and cultivate the ability to identify and evaluate historical architecture; Analyze a large number of practical cases of architectural heritage protection in China and the West, and guide students to establish principles, update strategies, and repair methods for heritage protection.

default.zh: 本课程是面向建筑学、城乡规划、环境设计等专业的高年级本科生开设的专业选修课，也是一门带有软科学性质的专业理论课，旨在使学生较全面地了解中西方园林发展的基本史实，掌握不同园林形态的基本特征，初步认识园林发展的历史规律和发展趋势，基本掌握中西方园林设计的主要思潮和设计手法，进而提高专业素养，培养可持续发展的生态设计观。
default.en: This course is an elective specialized course for the senior students from the majors of architecture, city-planning and artistic design, and it’s also a professional theoretical course with the nature of soft science. It can give the students a more comprehensive understanding of the basic facts of the garden development in China and Europe, help them master the basic characteristics, theories and main thoughts of garden designs in China and European countries, so as to help the students to improve the professionalism and cultivate the eco-design conception of sustainable development.

default.zh: 《文化传承与建筑创新》从建筑文化传承与发展的角度探讨建筑创新问题，主要包括五方面内容：建筑与文化；文化传承与建筑文化生态学；建筑文化遗产的保护、传承与更新；建筑地域性；传统文化在当代建筑创作中的表达与应用。课程采用专题性讲授、案例教学、启发式教学、互动问答教学、实地调研等教学方法，以充分发挥学生的主观能动性，激发学生的创造性思维，培养学生的创新能力。 通过讲授本课程，使学生深刻认识东西方建筑文化的异同；掌握建筑文化生态学的理论与方法，树立建筑文化生态意识；认识与理解建筑文化遗产的价值、遗产保护的相关理念，掌握建筑文化遗产的传承与更新模式；深入了解建筑地域性与全球化的关系，认识建筑地域性的研究方法，掌握地域性建筑创作的表达方式与设计方法；深入认识传统文化与当代建筑创作的关系，深入掌握传统文化在当代建筑创作中的表达方式与设计方法。
default.en: The course "Special Topics on Culture Heritage and Architectural Innovation" explores architectural innovation from the perspective of architectural culture inheritance and development. It primarily encompasses five main aspects: 1.Fundamental Concepts and Theories of Architecture, Culture, and Cultural Ecology. 2.Introduction to Architectural Cultural Ecology. 3.Basic Concepts and Theories of Inheritance and Renewal of Architectural Culture Heritage. 4.Concepts and Theories of Architectural Regionalism. 5.Expression and Application of Traditional Culture in Modern Architecture. The course uses various teaching methods, including case studies, heuristic teaching, interactive Q&A sessions, and practical assignments, to fully engage students, stimulate their creative thinking, and develop their innovative capabilities. Through the instruction of this course, students will gain an understanding of the fundamental concepts and related theories of architectural culture and architectural cultural ecology. They will also acquire knowledge of the structure, operation, and mechanisms of the architectural cultural ecosystem, fostering an awareness of architectural cultural ecology. Furthermore, the course will enable students to appreciate the value of architectural culture heritage and the associated principles of heritage preservation. Students will be equipped with models for the inheritance and renewal of architectural culture heritage. Moreover, students will explore the topics of architectural regionalism in the context of globalization and the methodologies for regionalism research. They will also develop the skills to express regional characteristics in architectural design. Lastly, this course will intend to facilitate students' comprehension of the relationship between traditional culture and modern architecture, as well as the connection between Chinese architectural tradition and modernity, equipping them with the means and methods of expressing traditional culture in contemporary architecture.

default.zh: 本课程是一门主要面向本科三年级学生的综合性理论课程，其目的是在学生学完部分专业课程的基础上，进一步拓展绿色建筑设计专项内容的知识和能力。了解我国绿色建筑发展伟大成就，加强社会主义核心价值观培养，认识新时期我国城镇绿色建筑建设任务的重要性与艰巨性，培养科学素养、社会责任感及职业素养；掌握绿色建筑基本概念、设计要求、基本原理、设计原则、设计方法、相关法规标准等知识构成，能够将专业知识用于解决复杂工程问题，在设计环节中体现创新意识，充分考虑健康、环境及安全等因素；培养学生分析问题和进行绿色建筑技术综合集成设计的能力，能够理解和评价针对复杂工程问题的专业工程实践对环境、社会可持续发展影响的能力，具备建筑学学科国际视野，培养自主学习和终身学习的意识，有不断学习和适应发展的能力。课程内容主要包含绿色建筑概况（绿色建筑基本概念、发展背景、评价体系及设计要求等）、绿色建筑场地设计（场地安全、生活便利、资源节约及宜居环境等）、绿色建筑本体设计（方案设计及技术设计等）及国内外绿色建筑实践项目实例解析。
default.en: This course is a comprehensive theoretical course mainly for undergraduate students in the third year, whose purpose is to further expand the knowledge and ability of green building design on the basis of the completion of some professional courses. To understand the great achievements of Chinese green building development, strengthen the cultivation of socialist core values, understand the importance and arduousness of task of Chinese green building construction, and cultivate scientific literacy, social responsibility and professional literacy. Master the basic concept, design requirements, basic principles, design principles, design methods, regulations and standards of green buildings, and be able to apply professional knowledge to solve complex engineering problems, reflect innovative consciousness in the design process, and fully consider health, environment and safety factors. To cultivate students' ability to analyze problems and conduct comprehensive and integrated design of green building technology, understand and evaluate the impact of professional engineering practice on the environment and social sustainable development of complex engineering problems, international vision of architecture, awareness of independent learning and lifelong learning, and continuously learn and adapt to development. The course mainly includes the general situation of green buildings (basic concept, background, evaluation system and design requirements of green buildings, etc.), site design (site safety, convenience of life, resource saving and livable environment, etc.), design technology (scheme and technology design, etc.) and practice projects at home and abroad.

default.zh: 本课程针对目前普遍关注的绿色建筑可持续发展问题，结合建筑行业的专业背景，较为系统的介绍了绿色建筑的基本概念和内涵、绿色建筑在我国及世界范围内的发展历史和现状、绿色建筑的评价方法、绿色建筑设计模式和方法、绿色建筑案例分析、绿色建筑关键技术及我国绿色建筑使用后评估等内容，是一门关于绿色建筑概况的通识性课程。通过该课程的学习，使学生认识绿色建筑的基本概况，明晰绿色建筑与技术之间的关系，即绿色建筑是与所在地区气候及资源相适宜的技术的优化集成，而非所谓高新、昂贵技术堆砌的产物；建立绿色建筑可持续发展的观念，认识坚持适合我国国情的绿色建筑发展道路的科学性和必然性，逐步培养学生的学习动力和分析问题的能力，将学生的素质教育有机结合在一起。
default.en: This course is aimed at the sustainable development of green building with the background of the construction industry. It is a general curriculum of green building which systematically introduces the basic concept and connotation of green building, history and the present situation of green building both in China and throughout the world, evaluation methods of green building, design patterns and methods of green building, case analysis of green building, key technology of green building and post evaluation of green building in China, etc. Through the study of this course, the students will have a basic, clear understanding of green building and relationship between green building and corresponding technologies, which means green building is the optimal integration with the appropriate climate and resources in particular region, rather than the so-called high-tech, expensive technology packing products; establish the concept of sustainable development of green building, realize the scientific nature and necessity of adhering to the green building development path suitable for Chinese national conditions, combine students' quality education organically and gradually cultivate their learning motivation and ability of analyze problems.

default.zh: 《可持续住宅设计专题》是住居类建筑专精领域的拓展性专题课程，偏于研究型理论导入，聚焦住宅设计前沿理念与集成技术的专题介绍讲解，使学生在先修课程基础上，对于前沿住宅设计理论、研究及设计方法（包含理念、功能、技术等层面）有所接触，形成一定深度的相关知识概念体系架构，主要目的培养学生依托于住宅类型建筑的研究型设计综合与创新能力，更深入理解住宅建筑对于人生活品质提升的重要作用，培养建筑学科人才加强社会责任感与使命感。 该课程应作为人居环境导论、建筑设计基础、建筑设计、建筑计划学等课程的延续或补充，在前序和相关课程基础上，帮助学生进一步认识居住建筑发展的前沿趋势、被动式设计要点和节能减排的可持续设计理念，深刻了解地域性对居住建筑的影响，理解和掌握住宅建筑科学设计的理论和方法。课程主要内容为可持续居住建筑的设计理念、方法和设计参与因素等，简要梳理居住建筑的发展脉络、经典案例以及未来发展趋势等，帮助学生树立“以人为本”和“因地制宜”的设计观，了解被动式设计和设计理念的升级可以为建筑节能减排和可持续带来明显增益，增强学生设计创新精神，改进提效设计流程与思考方法。
default.en: "Special Topic on Sustainable Residential Design" is an advanced specialized course in the field of residential architecture. It focuses on the introduction of research-oriented theories, with a specific emphasis on presenting cutting-edge concepts and integrated technologies in residential design. Building on students' prior coursework, the course exposes them to frontier theories, research, and design methodologies in residential design (encompassing aspects such as concepts, functions, and technologies), enabling them to develop a structured and in-depth knowledge system in this domain. Its primary objective is to cultivate students' comprehensive and innovative capabilities in research-based design of residential buildings, deepen their understanding of the crucial role of residential architecture in enhancing people's quality of life, and foster a stronger sense of social responsibility and mission among talents in the architecture discipline. This course should serve as a continuation or supplement to courses such as Professional Introduction, Fundamentals of Architectural Design, and previous architectural design courses. Based on the foundation laid by these preceding and related courses, it helps students further recognize the cutting-edge development trends of residential architecture, the key points of open residential design, and the sustainable design concepts centered on energy conservation and emission reduction. It also enables students to gain a profound understanding of the impact of regional characteristics on residential buildings, as well as master the theories and methodologies of scientific residential design. The main content of the course includes the design concepts, methods, and influencing factors involved in sustainable residential architecture. Additionally, it briefly outlines the development context of residential buildings, classic cases, and future development trends. Through this, the course assists students in establishing a "people-oriented" and "adaptation to local conditions" design philosophy, helps them understand that passive design and the upgrading of design concepts can significantly contribute to building energy conservation, emission reduction, and sustainability, strengthens their spirit of design innovation, and improves the efficiency of their design processes and thinking methods.

default.zh: 本课程介绍声景在设计领域的应用。通过教学使学生掌握声景的基本概念、发展简史及发展现状和趋势，识记声景的元素构成、分类以及声景的设计原则。通过多个案例的列举和分析，介绍常见的声景规划设计手法，以及其他可供参考的声景设计方法，使学生了解在今后的实际工程中如何进行声景设计，培养学生身体力行参与声景设计的能力，树立声景与专业的和谐整体意识。为后续相关课程的开设奠定基础。
default.en: This course introduces the application of soundscape in the field of design. Through teaching, students can master the basic concepts, development history, current status and trends of soundscape, and recognize the composition, classification, and design principles of soundscape elements. Through the enumeration and analysis of multiple cases, common techniques for soundscape planning and design, as well as other reference soundscape design methods, are introduced to help students understand how to carry out soundscape design in future practical projects, cultivate their ability to participate in soundscape design personally, and establish a harmonious overall awareness between soundscape and the profession. To lay the foundation for the subsequent offering of relevant courses.

default.zh: 本课程介绍参数化设计的生产历史、理论和应用。侧重于创建基于性能的参数系统的基本概念和机制。主要平台是Rhino和参数化建模插件Grasshopper，并包括它们附加的插件。学生通过本课程学习，了解参数化建模系统的整体结构，并能熟悉可视觉编程环境；进一步可以将设计知识嵌入到参数模型中，并使用适当的参数化技术来表达设计过程的形式生成。
default.en: This course introduces the history, theory and application of Parametric Design for production. It focuses on the underlying concepts and mechanisms for creating performance-based parametric systems. The principle platform is the parametric modeling plug-in Grasshopper for Rhino 3-D with additional supporting plug-ins and add-ons as required. Students learn the overall structure of parametric modeling systems and acquire fluency in visual programming environments. They also gain experience in the embedding of design knowledge into a parametric model and in the use of appropriate parametric techniques for conveying formal elements of the design process..

default.zh: 算法与设计课程是建筑学专业数字化建筑设计系列课程中一门。通过学习，是目前建筑设计应用新的技术进行设计的方法之一。 使学生清晰的了解参数化设计的概念、方法和应用。结合参数化设计软件等工具，让学生具备了更高层次的使用计算机进行辅助设计的能力； 使学生能够通过编程化、参数化等手段，了解和实现造型形式和空间关系； 使学生能够有能力解决在设计中遇到的大量的、重复性调整工作，并能够在设计课程中得到应用。
default.en: Algorithm and Design course is one of the series courses of digital architectural design for architecture major. Learning is one of the methods of applying new technology to architectural design at present. To enable students to clearly understand the concept, method and application of parametric design. Combined with parametric design software and other tools, so that students have a higher level of computer-aided design ability; Enable students to understand and realize the shape form and spatial relationship by means of programming, parameterization, etc. To enable students to be able to solve the large number of repetitive adjustment tasks encountered in design and be able to be applied in design courses.

default.zh: 建筑创作技术观课程涵盖建筑材料、结构、构造等知识。通过本课程学习，使学生了解建筑技术发展概况、技术与艺术的辨证关系、以及建筑技术在建筑设计中的地位和作用，使学生能正确运用建筑技术知识从事建筑创作，提升建筑设计能力。系统的讲授建筑技术发展的历史脉络、阶段特征、材料选择、构造特点、作用表现等知识，熟悉建筑技术发展、驱动的规律，掌握建筑技术与建筑创作的作用原理与关联机制，培养学生举一反三、自主学习的能力。面对新材料、新技术、复杂的技术现象，可以做到科学、理性、系统的进行解读。培养多学科、交叉、综合运用多种手段的建筑设计思维。系统、整体的从建筑创作角度，看待材料、建筑结构、建筑物理、建筑设备、建筑施工等有关知识，通过综合技术手段，解决建筑设计中的方案深化问题。
default.en: The course on the concept of architectural creation technology covers knowledge from multiple disciplines such as building materials, building structures, and construction. Through this course, students will understand the development overview of architectural technology science, the dialectical relationship between architectural technology and art, as well as the position and role of architectural technology in architectural design. They will have a preliminary understanding of the relevant knowledge of architectural technology science, enabling them to correctly apply architectural technology knowledge to engage in architectural creation and improve their architectural design abilities. Through this course, students will acquire technical knowledge. Understand the historical context, stage characteristics, material selection, structural characteristics, and functional performance of the development of architectural technology, be familiar with the laws of development and driving of architectural technology, master the principles and correlation mechanisms of architectural technology and architectural creation, and cultivate students' ability to draw inferences from one example and learn independently. In the face of new materials, new technologies, and complex technological phenomena, scientific, rational, and systematic interpretation can be achieved. Cultivate a multi-disciplinary, interdisciplinary, and comprehensive approach to architectural design thinking. From a systematic and holistic perspective of architectural creation, we view knowledge related to materials, building structures, building physics, building equipment, and construction, and solve the problem of deepening solutions in architectural design through comprehensive technical means.

default.zh: 本课程为建筑学专业学生建筑师业务实践实习前的集中培训，是对学生在校所学习专业知识的综合回顾与总结，为学生独立参加社会与业务实践做好知识与心理准备；是建筑师业务实践实习顺利进行的前提与保障。本课程的教学目的和主要任务是使学生了解建筑师职业的发展历程、现状与发展趋势；熟悉建筑师的职能范围与工作内容，职业技能和能力要求；了解建筑师的工作程序、相关的法律、法规及技术标准；并进一步理解建筑师职业道德。
default.en: This course is a centralized training for architecture major students before their architectural business practice. It is a comprehensive review and summary of the professional knowledge learned at school, for preparing students participating social and business practice independently from both knowledge and psychological aspects. The course is the premise and guarantee for the smooth implementation of the architectural business practice. The purpose and the main task of the course is to enable students to understand the current situation and development trend of architect occupation; familiar with the functions of architects and the scope of work, requirements of occupation skill and ability; understanding of the architect's work procedures, the relevant laws, regulations and technical standards; and to further understand the architect occupation moral.

default.zh: 《专业思维训练A》是建筑与设计学院为建筑学专业、智慧建筑与建造专业本科生开设的一门思维导论课程，旨在通过系统的理论教学与实践训练，培养学生的专业思维能力和表达能力。课程内容涵盖建筑设计理论、建筑历史与理论、建筑技术理论和建筑快速表达四大模块，涉及中国建筑和外国古代建筑的基本理论与知识，以及建筑概论、建筑设计原理、建筑遗产保护、绿色建筑、数字建筑、城市设计、室内设计等相关基础理论与设计知识。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够综合运用所学知识，展示建筑设计和技术设计的解决方案，提高分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: 《Major Thinking Training A》 is an introductory course offered by the School of Architecture and Design for undergraduate students majoring in Architecture and Intelligent Building & Construction. It aims to cultivate students' professional thinking and expression abilities through systematic theoretical teaching and practical training. The course content covers four major modules: architectural design theory, architectural history and theory, architectural technology theory, and architectural rapid expression. It encompasses the basic theories and knowledge of Chinese and foreign ancient architecture, as well as related basic theories and design knowledge such as architectural overview, architectural design principles, architectural heritage conservation, green building, digital building, urban design, and interior design. Through the study of this course, students will be able to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have acquired to present solutions for architectural and technical design, and improve their abilities to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向建筑学、城市规划、景观学和设计学专业高年级学生的专业选修课程，针对现代木建筑快速发展，同时建筑教育缺失的问题，以木结构建筑材料在建筑中的基本特征、技术规律和设计原则为主要内容，旨在帮助学生扩展木结构建筑技术与设计方面的知识储备。在教学过程中运用先修课程中掌握的知识和技能，结合实践教学环节，领悟木建筑的独特性设计思维和设计要点。
default.en: This course is a professional elective course for senior students majoring in architecture, urban planning, landscape science and design. Aiming at the rapid development of modern wood architecture and the lack of its relative knowledge in education, it mainly focuses on the basic characteristics, technical rules and design principles of wood architecture. It is designed to help students expand their knowledge of wood construction technology and design.With the related knowledge and skills the students learned before and based on various practical projects, it makes the students to master the special professional thinking and requirements of wooden construction.

default.zh: 《城镇燃气应用（A）》是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业本科生的专业选修课程。 能源是人类社会赖以生存和发展的重要物质基础，燃气是城镇能源的重要组成部分，燃气供应是城镇现代化建设和节能环保的需要。我国现阶段燃气的应用领域及范围不断扩大，在“双碳”背景下，燃气将作为可再生能源的有力补充，助力实现能源供应的稳定性和可持续性。 本课程充分结合我国现阶段燃气供应系统的发展现状，系统而简要地讲授城镇燃气供应系统的基本理论和基本知识，适当介绍燃气供应及应用系统的新技术、新工艺、新设备和新材料。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解和掌握城镇燃气的基本分类与特性、燃气管网系统的构成、非管输燃气场站的工艺及主要设备、智慧燃气系统的作用与架构、民用及商用燃气应用设备等内容。 通过本课程的课堂教学、学生研讨和课堂设计等环节，使学生进一步了解城镇燃气系统的整体构成，着重培养学生的设计和管理城镇燃气供应系统的能力、问题分析能力、综合方案设计能力、团队协作能力、语言表达能力、复杂工程问题研究能力及增强创新意识。
default.en: Urban Gas Application (A) is a elective course for undergraduates majoring in Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering. Energy is an important material foundation for the survival and development of human society, and gas is an important component of urban energy. Gas supply is necessary for urban modernization construction and energy conservation and environmental protection. At present, the application field and scope of gas in China are constantly expanding. In the context of "dual carbon", gas will serve as a powerful supplement to renewable energy, helping to achieve stability and sustainability of energy supply. This course fully combines the current development status of gas supply systems in China, systematically and briefly teaches the basic theories and knowledge of urban gas supply systems, and appropriately introduces new technologies, processes, equipment, and materials of gas supply and application systems. Through the study of this course, students will understand and master the basic classification and characteristics of urban gas, the composition of gas pipeline network systems, the processes and main equipment of non pipeline gas transmission stations, the role and architecture of smart gas systems, and civil and commercial gas application equipment. Through the classroom teaching, discussions, and design of this course, students will further understand the overall composition of urban gas systems, with a focus on cultivating their ability to design and manage urban gas supply systems, analyze problems, design comprehensive solutions, team cooperation, language expression, research ability of complex engineering problems, and enhance innovation consciousness.

default.zh: 工程经济与管理向于建筑环境与建筑能源两个方向的本科生开课，是一门专业基础课，在培养学生工程思维、经济社会意识、综合分析能力方面占有重要的地位。课程主要讲授资金的时间价值、经济评价基本要素和方法、价值工程、工程项目可行性研究、工程管理等，使学生较深入地了解建筑环境与能源应用工程中的技术经济比较和工程管理的基本方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、案例剖析和项目研究等环节着重培养学生的工程思维与经济意识。 课程主要包括绪论，资金的时间价值与等值计算，经济性评价基本要素，投资回收期法、现值法、内部收益率法及投资收益率法等经济性评价基本方法、备选方案的经济性评价方法，不确定性分析，设备更新决策，价值工程、工程项目可行性研究、工程项目管理组织、工程项目过程管理和案例剖析等内容。 课程采用讲授、作业练习、案例分析和讨论等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括平时测验、课后作业和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Engineering Economics and Management is a fundamental course for undergraduate students who focus on building the environment and building energy. It plays an important role in cultivating students' engineering thinking, economic and social awareness, and comprehensive analysis abilities. The course mainly teaches the time value of funds, basic elements and methods of economic evaluation, value engineering, feasibility study of engineering projects, engineering management, etc., enabling students to have a deeper understanding of the technical and economic comparison and basic methods of engineering management in building environment and energy application engineering. Through classroom teaching, case analysis, and project research, this course focuses on cultivating students' engineering thinking and economic awareness. The course mainly includes introduction, time value and equivalence calculation of funds, basic elements of economic evaluation, basic methods of economic evaluation such as investment payback period method, present value method, internal rate of return method, and investment rate of return method, economic evaluation methods of alternative solutions, uncertainty analysis, equipment update decision-making, value engineering, feasibility study of engineering projects, engineering project management organization Engineering project process management and case analysis. The course employs teaching methods such as lectures, assignments, case analysis, and discussions. The assessment is cumulative, consisting of regular quizzes, homework assignments, and final exams. The final grade is scored out of 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授通风与空调技术基本理论、基本概念、各种系统的组成、特点和调节方法、系统中主要设备和构件的构造、工作原理、特性和选用方法、系统的自动控制方案，同时还涉及到通风空调领域的新进展和新技术。使学生较深入地了解和掌握建筑环境营造所涉及的通风和空调技术专业知识。通过本课程的课堂教学和案例剖析等环节着重培养学生的问题分析能力、综合方案设计能力、复杂工程问题研究能力，增强创新意识。 课程主要包括空调负荷计算、全空气系统和空气-水系统（包括湿空气焓湿图、定风量空调系统、变风量空调系统、空气处理机组、空气-水风机盘管系统、空调系统的运行调节及空调系统的选择）、冷剂式系统、工业与民用建筑通风、悬浮颗粒与有害气体的净化系统、民用建筑火灾烟气的控制、室内气流分布、特殊建筑空气环境的控制技术、暖通空调系统的自动控制和消声隔振等内容。 本课程采用课堂讲授与讨论相结合的方式进行教学。课程考核成绩为累加式，考核环节包括出勤、作业和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Principles of ventilation and air conditioning, basic concepts, composition, features and modulation of different systems, composition, working principles, characteristics, and selecting method, automatic control programs of main equipments and elements are introduced in this course. In the meantime, new progress and new techniques in HVAC are also involved. Students could learn and grasp ventilation and air conditioning techniques needed for making built environment. Ability of analyzing, schematic designing, complex engineering question researching will be trained through lecture and case study, and the innovation consciousness will be strengthened. The course includes cooling and heating load calculation, all air system and air-water system（including psychrometric chart of moist air, constant air volume system, variable air volume system, air handling units, air-water fan coil system, control of air conditioning systems, and selection of air conditioning systems）, refrigerant system, ventilation for industrial and civil buildings, purification of suspended particulate and harmful gases, fire control and smoke management of civil buildings, indoor air distribution, control technology for special built air environment, automatic control and noise control of air conditioning systems.。 The course is taught by the combination of teacher’s lecture and interactive discussions. Results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes attendance, homework, and final exam. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 新能源概论是可再生能源领域中占有重要地位的一门学科，它包括太阳能、风能、生物质能、可燃冰、地热能等利用技术。新能源已经成为当前的研究重点，也是产业发展的重点。这些能源的应用研究内容主要是计算各方面自然存在的能量，再通过研究不同机构用其吸收这些能量，使其成为可用能源。它的应用是一门多学科的综合技术，包括大气环境、海洋环境学、流体力学等学科。通过课程学习使学生掌握新能源能利用技术的基本理论与研究方法。
default.en: The introduction to new energy plays an important role in regenerative energy field. New energies include solar, wind, biomass energy, combustible ice and geothermal energy. It has become a central research issue of modern technology and pillar of industries. The study of new energies mainly concentrated on calculating the total energy that spread in the fields of nature and how to make these energies into application, which includes multi disciplines, including atmospheric environment, ocean engineering environments, fluid dynamics and so on. This course aims at letting students master the basic theories and methodologies in new energy field.

default.zh: 《低碳能源技术与应用》是针对低碳建筑供能系统的发展需求，而开设的一门专业必修课。它主要通过课堂授课，讲授新型的建筑能源系统、包括自然冷源、多能互补、燃气冷热电三联供、太阳能供热、发电、采光、空气净化、地热能、生物质能的高效利用技术以及在建筑中的工程应用。讲授内容将涉及各类新型低碳能源系统的运行原理、系统设计、适用性、以及优缺点等，来培养学生开阔的低碳技术视野以及工程运用能力。
default.en: Low carbon energy technology and Application is a professional compulsory course for the development needs of low-carbon building energy systems. It mainly teaches new energy systems, its efficient utilization technologies, and the engineering applications in low-carbon buildings, including natural cold sources, multi-energy complementary, gas-cooled/heat/power, solar heating, solar electricity generation, solar lighting, air purification, geothermal energy, biomass energy. The lecture content will involve the operation principle, system design, applicability, and advantages and disadvantages of various new low-carbon energy systems, so as to cultivate students' broad vision of low-carbon technology and engineering application ability.

default.zh: 化工原理面向建筑环境与能源应用工程专业建筑能源方向的本科生开课，是一门专业基础课，是学生学习专业课程的前期理论性较强的课程，在培养学生理论联系实际、以专业思维解决工程问题方面具有重要的作用。 课程的内容以化工原理的传热传质部分为主，以传输理论及单元操作原理为重点，使学生深入理解热量传输和质量传输过程的机理，初步了解传热传质过程的设备。通过本课程的课堂教学、习题分析等环节，着重培养学生进行燃气领域传热传质过程的设计计算以及选择传热传质设备的能力，支持学生学习燃气净化的相关技术。 课程主要包括绪论、热量传输过程、传质分离过程理论、蒸馏单元操作、 吸收单元操作、萃取单元操作、燃气领域涉及的传热设备和传质设备，以及各单元操作的工艺计算等内容。 课程采用讲授、课后习题以及习题课方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括平时参与讨论、课后作业和期末考试（闭卷），总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: 《Principles of Chemical Engineering》is an important professional basic course for the students from the building energy direction of the major of building environment and energy application. It has strong theoretical property, and is the basic for the studying of the related subsequent professional courses. By studying this course, the capacity of linking of theory and practice, and solving the engineering problems using theory knowledge could be enhanced. In this course, the heat and mass transfers during chemical engineering are the main contents, while the principle of transmission and unit operation are the key contents. Furthermore, it will be detailed taught that the mechanism of heat transfer and mass transfer, and the related equipment. By lecture and homework, the capacity of calculation for heat and mass transfer and choosing the related equipment could be trained. The main contents in this course include introduction, process of heat transfer, theory of mass transfer and separation, operation of distillation, operation of absorption, operation of extraction, equipment of heat and mass transfer used in field of natural gas, and the calculation of technological process referred in above operations. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises, and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes discussions, homework, and final exams. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程是高等学校建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业课程，在培养学生系统思维、建筑节能意识、系统运行优化意识等方面占有重要的地位，也是对学生进行社会主义核心价值观教育，帮助学生树立正确世界观人生观价值观的核心课程。可作为建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的专业课程《暖通空调》、《供热工程》、《建筑冷热源》、《建筑给排水》以及《燃气输配》等主要专业课的内容补充与支撑。 为了适应智慧建筑的发展与节能减排目标实现的需要，建筑内电能的分配与使用对建筑供配电系统提出了更高的要求。因此本课程的主要内容包括电力系统组成与特点、负荷计算及无功补偿、供配电一次回路的构成、短路电流的计算、电气设备的选择方法、供配电系统线缆的选择方法、.供配电系统的保护及配变电所二次回路与电路防雷保护。通过本课程的学习，重点培养学生对建筑中电能分配与使用的理解，及对建筑内供配电系统的设计、施工和管理方面的能力。 本课程以《建筑供配电技术》为教学内容，主要任务是通过学习建筑供配电技术基本概念，以建筑中的电能分配与使用为基础框架，将理论与工程紧密结合，构建将专业理论知识转化为实际工程应用的知识体系，使学生较深入地了解和掌握现代供配电技术的专业知识。通过课堂教学、案例剖析和项目研究等环节着重培养学生的问题分析能力、综合方案设计能力、复杂工程问题研究能力、增强创新意识。支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Power Supply and Distribution System in Building is a specialized course for the undergraduate program in Architectural Environment and Energy Application Engineering. It holds a significant position in cultivating students' systematic thinking, awareness of energy-efficient architecture, and optimization of system operations. Furthermore, it serves as a core course for instilling socialist core values in students, helping them establish the correct worldviews, outlook on life, and values. It can also serve as supplementary and supportive content for major courses in the field of Architectural Environment and Energy Application Engineering, such as "HVAC," "Heating Engineering," "Building Thermal Sources," "Building Water Supply and Drainage," and "Gas Transmission and Distribution." In response to the development of smart buildings and the need to achieve energy efficiency and emission reduction goals, there are higher requirements for the distribution and utilization of electrical energy within buildings. Therefore, the main content of this course includes the composition and characteristics of power systems, load calculation and reactive power compensation, the configuration of primary circuits for supply and distribution, short-circuit current calculation, methods for selecting electrical equipment, cable selection for supply and distribution systems, protection of supply and distribution systems, as well as secondary circuit and lightning protection in substations. Through the study of this course, the emphasis is on developing students' understanding of the distribution and utilization of electrical energy in buildings and their ability to design, construct, and manage supply and distribution systems within buildings. This course is based on the content of "Power Supply and Distribution Technology in Building." Its primary objective is to integrate fundamental concepts of supply and distribution technology with the distribution and utilization of electrical energy within buildings. It closely integrates theory with engineering, establishing a knowledge system that transforms theoretical knowledge into practical engineering applications. This enables students to gain a deeper understanding and mastery of modern supply and distribution technology. Through classroom teaching, case analysis, and project research, it emphasizes the development of students' problem analysis skills, comprehensive design capabilities, the ability to research complex engineering issues, and the enhancement of innovative thinking. This course supports the achievement of corresponding performance indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《热电厂供热》是工科高等学校建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业选修课，在能源发展中，节能减排是目前解决能源危机的重要手段，在未来缺少能源支柱，能源空心化的情况下，培养学生从现实境况尽量应对即将到来的能源挑战。使学生掌握热力发电厂的基本原理，具备热力系统分析能力和提高热电厂热经济性的方法，探讨热力系统最佳连接方式的途径及学习集中供冷、供热和分布式能源系统方面的知识，培养学生掌握先进的能源利用技术和学科交叉的能力。 课程采用启发式教学，激发学生主动学习的兴趣，培养学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力，引导学生主动自学获得自己想学到的知识。 本门课程结合国民经济发展现状和能源环境领域的民生问题，加强学生社会责任感和社会主义价值观的培养，充分认识保证人类社会可持续发展的必要性和可行性。课程使学生具有从事建筑环境与能源应用工程工作所需的能源供给工程实践，并具有综合运用所学知识解决能源供应系统的工程技术问题的能力，掌握先进的能源利用技术及方案。同时要求学生了解能源应用工程的发展现状和趋势，掌握节能减排的意义和手段，能针对复杂建筑环境与能源应用工程项目，基本具备撰写项目建议书、可行性研究报告的能力，理解本专业与建筑和能源相关学科的关系及相互影响。
default.en: Hermal Power Plant Heating is a professional elective course for the majors of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering in engineering colleges and universities. With energy development, energy conservation and emission reduction are currently important means to solve the energy crisis. In the absence of energy pillars and hollowing out of energy in the future, we aim to cultivate students to cope with the upcoming energy challenges as much as possible from the current situation.It enables students to master the basic principles of thermal power plants, possess the ability to analyze thermal systems, and improve the thermal economy of thermal power plants. It also explores the best connection methods of thermal systems and learns knowledge about centralized cooling, heating, and distributed energy systems, Cultivate students' ability to master advanced energy utilization technology and interdisciplinary knowledge. The course adopts heuristic teaching to stimulate students' interest in active learning, cultivate their ability to think independently, analyze problems, and solve problems, and guide students to actively self-learning to obtain the knowledge they want to learn. This course combines the current development status of the national economy and livelihood issues in the field of energy and environment, strengthens the cultivation of students' sense of social responsibility and socialist values, and fully recognizes the necessity and feasibility of ensuring sustainable development of human society. The course enables students to have the energy supply engineering practice required for working in building environment and energy application engineering, and to have the ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge learned to solve engineering and technical problems in energy supply systems, and master advanced energy utilization technologies and solutions. At the same time, students are required to understand the current development status and trends of energy application engineering, master the significance and means of energy conservation and emission reduction, be able to write project proposals and feasibility studies for complex building environments and energy application engineering projects, and understand the relationship and mutual influence between this major and architecture and energy related disciplines.

default.zh: 程序设计与数值计算是一门面向建筑环境与能源应用工程专业本科生开设的专业选修课。课程以MATLAB作为程序设计平台，讲授程序设计语言、图形用户界面设计和Simulink建模，结合专业知识进行程序设计演示。通过课堂讲授、作业和上机实践等环节的教学，要求学生掌握求解专业问题的程序设计、数据处理和数值计算方法，树立正确的编程思维，具备解决专业计算问题和撰写专题报告的能力。 课程主要内容如下：MATLAB环境，包括文件管理、工作空间和变量管理；基本运算，包括矩阵运算、多项式运算和符号运算；编程基本方法，包括脚本与函数、控制语句、效率与结构化编程、调试与维护；数据处理与数值计算，包括曲线拟合、插值运算、线性方程组求解、非线性方程的数值解法；图形与可视化，包括plot函数与二维图形的绘制、图形修饰与控制、特殊二维图形的绘制、三维图形的绘制、句柄图形；图形用户界面设计，包括设计画板、控件功能特点及其应用、图形用户界面设计案例；Simulink与系统仿真，包括仿真环境、模型库、微分方程建模和模块化封装。并设计一维无限大平壁非稳态导热过程和建筑热工过程的上机项目4项。 课程采用讲授、课堂作业、程序演示、互动讨论、线下答疑和上机实践等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课堂考察、程序演示和上机作业，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Programming and Numerical Calculation is a professional elective course for undergraduate students majoring in Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering. The course uses MATLAB as the programming platform, teaching programming languages, graphical user interface design, and Simulink modeling, and combining professional knowledge for programming demonstrations. Through classroom lectures, homework, and practical teaching, students are required to master programming, data processing, and numerical calculation methods for solving professional problems, establish correct programming thinking, and have the ability to solve professional calculation problems and write special reports. The main content of the course is as follows: MATLAB environment, including file management, workspace, and variable management; Basic operations, including matrix operations, polynomial operations, and symbol operations; Basic programming methods, including scripts and functions, control statements, efficiency and structured programming, debugging and maintenance; Data processing and numerical calculation, including curve fitting, interpolation operations, solving linear equations, and numerical solutions for nonlinear equations; Graphics and visualization, including plot function and 2D graphics drawing, graphics decoration and control, special 2D graphics drawing, 3D graphics drawing, handle graphics; Graphic user interface design, including design drawing board, control functional characteristics and applications, and graphic user interface design cases; Simulink and system simulation, including simulation environment, model library, differential equation modeling, and modular packaging. And design four practical projects for one-dimensional infinite flat wall unsteady thermal conduction process and building thermal process. The course is taught through methods such as lectures, classroom assignments, program demonstrations, interactive discussions, offline Q&A, and computer practice. The course assessment results are cumulative, and the assessment process includes classroom tests, programming reports and programming homeworks. The total assessment score is calculated as a percentage, with a maximum score of 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业本科生的专业方向选修课程。通过对本课程的学习，加深学生对安全生产的认识，培养学生预防并解决燃气事故的能力，为培养学生的安全意识、职业道德、突发事件应变能力等打下基础。目的是使学生了解和掌握燃气安全的基本知识与技术，掌握燃气泄漏、燃气火灾、燃气爆炸的基本原理，具备进行危险源识别、安全评价的知识基础，有从事燃气安全、燃气设施完整性管理工作的基础知识。熟悉和掌握燃气泄露、火灾、爆炸的计算方法，具有应用先进计算工具或计算软件解决燃气事故领域实际问题的能力。掌握燃气设施完整性管理方法，具备燃气管网设施完整性管理工作能力。掌握燃气安全和风险管理的基础知识，具备工业工程素养及安全生产意识。同时，注重情感、学习态度、价值观、学习方法以及表达能力的培养，加强科学精神、人文精神、社会责任感、职业道德和安全至上的修养。主要内容包括燃气安全基本概念、燃气泄漏与扩散、燃气火灾、燃气爆炸与防火防爆技术、燃气设施完整性管理等部分。 课程采用讲授、互动交流、作业练习等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、课上互动和期末报告，总评成绩以百分记，满分100分。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in building environment and energy application engineering. Through the study of this course, we can deepen students' understanding of safety production, train students' ability to prevent and solve gas accidents, and lay a foundation for cultivating students' safety consciousness, professional ethics and emergency response ability. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand and master the basic knowledge and technology of gas safety, master the basic principles of gas leakage, gas fire and gas explosion, have the knowledge foundation of hazard source identification and safety evaluation, and have the basic knowledge of gas safety and gas facility integrity management. Students should be familiar with and master the calculation methods of gas leakage, fire and explosion, and have the ability to use advanced calculation tools or software to solve practical problems in the field of gas accidents. Students should master the methods of integrity management of gas facilities and have the ability of integrity management of gas pipe network facilities. And master the basic knowledge of gas safety and risk management, have industrial engineering literacy and safety production awareness. At the same time, this course focuses on the cultivation of emotion, learning attitude, values, learning methods and expression ability, and strengthens the cultivation of scientific spirit, humanistic spirit, social responsibility, professional ethics and safety first. The main contents of this course include basic concepts of gas safety, gas leakage and diffusion, gas fire, gas explosion, fire and explosion prevention technology, and gas facility integrity management. The course is taught by the way of teaching, interactive, homework, etc. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework, combined train, and final report. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 绿色建筑面向于建筑环境与建筑能源两个方向的本科生开课，是一门专业选修课，也是一门综合性技术课，课程在培养学生工程思维、综合分析能力方面有重要的意义。 课程开设目的是使学生及时了解国内外最新的绿色建筑理论与技术发展动态，掌握绿色建筑国内外发展历史、绿色建筑内涵、绿色建筑实现的目标、绿色建筑评价标准、绿色建筑关键技术及绿色建筑实际工程案例。使学生认识绿色建筑的基本知识结构，为进一步学习和实践绿色建筑设计打下基础。课程围绕绿色建筑的定义、关键技术以及实际工程案例三方面展开，要求学生了解绿色建筑的基本概念与相关术语、绿色建筑规划的原则与方法；掌握绿色建筑室内环境控制技术、绿色建筑围护结构节能设计、绿色建筑材料与设备等关键技术；结合绿色建筑工程案例、学习绿色建筑相关的设计规范与评价体系、了解绿色建筑运营管理等内容。使学生能运用已学习过的专业知识解决绿色建筑中的实际应用问题，理解绿色建筑设计和运行过程中的重要环节，了解包括建筑节能技术在内的绿色建筑技术与理论研究的学术动向及发展脉络。 课程考核采用项目研究撰写科技报告的方式。以某些学术论文发以及最新的绿色建筑技术文献为载体，将绿色建筑设计、运行等内容有机融合串联。要求学生结合本门课程内容与专业知识，针对绿色建筑关键技术、前沿研究、实际问题进行分析并撰写课程报告，提高学生的理解能力、应用所学知识、方法解决建筑环境与能源应用相关工程问题的实践能力。
default.en: "Green Building" is offered to undergraduate students with two directions: Building Environment and Building Energy. It is a specialized elective course as well as a comprehensive technical course. This course holds significant importance in cultivating students' engineering mindset and enhancing their comprehensive analytical skills. The course's objective is to ensure that students stay informed about the latest developments in green building theory and technology, both domestically and internationally. It aims to Enable students to understand the basic knowledge structure of green building.The course revolves around the definition, key technologies, and practical engineering cases of green buildings, requiring students to understand the basic concepts and related terminology of green buildings, as well as the principles and methods of green building planning; Master key technologies such as indoor environmental control technology for green buildings, energy-saving design of green building envelope structures, and green building materials and equipment; Combining green building engineering cases, learning design specifications and evaluation systems related to green buildings, and understanding green building operation and management.The course is designed to empower students to apply their acquired professional knowledge to solve practical issues within the field of green building, understand the critical aspects within green building design and operational processes, understand the academic trends and developmental context of research in the areas of energy-efficient and green building technology and theory. The course assessment adopts the method of writing technology reports. Students are required to combine the course and professional knowledge, analyze and write course reports on key technologies, cutting-edge research, and practical issues related to green building, in order to improve their understanding ability, practical ability to solve HVAC engineering problems

default.zh: 《建筑传热》是一门双语课程，是工科高等学校建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的专业理论选修课之一，对于增强学生的专业理论水平、提高学生国际视野方面，在跨文化背景下进行沟通和交流有积极作用。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学培养学生理论知识的分析及应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。掌握建筑传热的基本理论与模型，具有从事建筑环境与能源应用工程工作所需的专业理论知识，能够将解决一定工程问题。该课程使学生较深入了解英国建筑传热计算模型与方法, 增强学生的专业素养。 课程主要内容主要包括绪论，各种建筑材料热力参数，建筑传热计算分析及地面传热计算Mercy公式，热路系统热力组成四部分。 课程采用讲授、讨论和项目研究等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括考勤、课后作业和项目研究，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Building heat transfer is one of the professional theory courses of building environment and energy application engineering. It is a bilingual course which plays an important role in enhancing students ' professional theoretical level and improving students' international vision. The course mainly deals with s the British traditional building heat transfer calculation model, the ground heat transfer formula and the thermal circuit theory. Students can get more understanding of the British building heat transfer calculation model and method. The course mainly includes the introduction, the traditional building heating model , thermal parameters for gase, heat loss from a solid floor, basic thermal elements. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework and presentation. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 《数据挖掘与能源智慧管理》是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业选修课程。课程主要目的是在当前智慧城市建设、物联网和大数据技术迅猛发展的背景下，培养学生利用数据挖掘这一前沿技术来进行建筑能源系统智慧管理的能力，拓展其知识面和技术视野。课程主要任务是通过课堂教学、案例剖析等环节，让学生大体上了解适用于建筑环境与能源智慧管理领域的数据挖掘基本算法知识，具备对建筑环境与能源智慧管理领域产生的海量数据进行初步的数据挖掘、知识发现以及结果显示的能力；初步具备利用数据挖掘技术和专业技能，对建筑能源系统管理方案进行简单的评估与优化的能力；以及利用数据挖掘技术，对现场测试的海量数据背后的知识进行分析和解释，并通过信息综合得到合理有效结论的能力。 课程总体上分为基础知识和专业应用两大部分。基础知识部分主要包括绪论、数据的基础知识、数据预处理、聚类分析、分类算法、关联性和相关性；专业应用部分又以城镇供热和燃气为主要能源智慧管理对象，具体包括智慧供热相关概念及标准解读、系统仿真、负荷预报与故障诊断等智能决策、智能调控，智慧燃气的基本概念、SCADA系统、管网GIS综合管理系统、智慧燃气系统构建等内容。 课程采用课堂讲授的教学方式。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课堂平时测验和撰写技术报告，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: "Data Mining and Smart Energy Management" is a professional elective course for the major of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering. The main purpose of the course is to cultivate students' ability to use the cutting-edge technology of data mining to carry out the intelligent management of building energy system and expand their knowledge and technical vision under the background of the rapid development of smart city construction, internet and big data technology. The main task of the course is to make students generally understand the basic data mining algorithm applicable to the field of built environment and energy smart management through classroom teaching and case analysis, and have the ability to conduct preliminary data mining, knowledge discovery and result display of massive data generated in the field of built environment and energy smart management. Additionally, make the students have the ability to use data mining technology and professional skills to carry out simple evaluation and optimization of building energy system management schemes. Lastly, make the students have the ability to use data mining technology to analyze and explain the knowledge behind the massive data in field tests, and to obtain reasonable and effective conclusions through information synthesis. The course is generally divided into two parts: basic knowledge and professional application. The basic knowledge part mainly includes introduction, basic knowledge of data, data preprocessing, cluster analysis, classification algorithm, correlation and correlation; The professional application part takes urban heating and gas as the main energy intelligent management objects, including intelligent decision-making and intelligent regulation such as smart heating related concepts and standard interpretation, system simulation, load forecasting and fault diagnosis, basic concept of smart gas, SCADA system, GIS integrated management system of pipe network, and construction of smart gas system. The course is given mainly by classroom teaching. The assessment result of the course is the summation of in-class exam and writing technical report. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 空气洁净技术面向建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的建筑环境方向本科生开课，是一门专业选修课，在培养学生工程实践能力方面占有一定的地位。课程主要讲授洁净室的工作原理及其洁净空调系统的设计、施工、检测认证等内容。通过本课程的课堂教学、案例剖析等环节培养学生相关工程科学知识的应用能力，着重培养学生的工程思维意识及工程应用能力。 课程主要包括空气洁净技术的分类及应用、洁净室的工作原理及其应用、洁净空调系统的设计方法、 洁净空调系统的方案设计、洁净空调系统的施工、洁净空调系统的检测与认证、工程项目案例分析等内容。 课程采用讲授、作业练习、案例分析和讨论等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括测试、作业、汇报和课程论文，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Air Purification Technology is a fundamental and elective course to students of building environment direction and students of other directions. The course plays an important role in training students' engineering practice. The course mainly includes the working principle of clean room，and the design, construction, testing and certification of the purification air-conditioning system. Through the teaching, case analysis and project research, this course focuses on training students' engineering thinking and engineering application. The course mainly includes the classification and application of air purification technology, working principle and application of class room, design method of purification air-conditioning system, scheme design, construction and testing and certification of purification air-conditioning system, case analysis of engineering projects etc. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises, case studies and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes test, homework, presentation and course paper. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 燃气空调技术是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业选修课程。主要讲授燃气空调技术的基本原理及设计计算、燃气空调型式结构与技术性能、燃气空调的燃料及燃烧计算、燃气空调选型与设备、燃气空调的设计应用，介绍燃气空调的推广对我国能源、经济带来的一系列影响，定量地研究其在终端用户方、电力和燃气供应方以及环境保护、人体健康方面的技术与经济效应，同时还介绍了燃气空调的新技术及燃气空调发展趋势。通过本课程的课堂教学、案例剖析和项目研究等环节，着重培养学生的工程思维和实践能力。 课程主要包括绪论，燃气空调的燃料及燃烧计算，燃气空调技术基本原理及设计计算，燃气空调形式结构与技术性能，燃气空调的燃烧系统，燃气空调系统设计实例等内容。 课程采用讲授、作业练习、案例分析和讨论等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、课程论文和项目研究等，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Gas Air Conditioning Technology is a major elective course to students major in building environment and building energy. The course mainly deals with basic principle and design calculation of gas air conditioning system, structure and technical characteristic, calculation of fuel, model selection and design, presenting its influence on recourse strategy and economics of our country, studying the technical and economical effects on users and producers as well as the environment. New trends of development and technologies are also introduced in this course. By the manners of teaching in class, case analysis and project research, it could be enhanced that the capacity of project designs method and practical application. The course mainly includes the introduction, fuel of gas air conditioning and its combustion calculation, basic principles and design calculation of gas air conditioning, the structure and technical performance of gas air conditioning, gas air conditioning combustion system, gas air conditioning practical design example etc. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises, case studies and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework, course paper, project studies etc. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程主要用于提高本科生建筑领域碳达峰碳中和的理论水平和实践能力，培养学生具备分析和处理零碳建筑及建筑降碳问题的相关知识和分析方法，为学生今后的专业学习和从事行业相关工作，储备必要的基础理论知识，同时训练学生在实际工程中的理论联系实际的能力。 本课程共6章，课程1-3章以零碳建筑的概念及认定为前提，结合中国建筑业建筑碳排放特征及影响因素，介绍建筑碳排放的计算方法，为建筑降碳策略的提出提供理论支持，同时明晰零碳、低碳和全生命周期碳排放的定义。课程4-6章在前3章的基础上，介绍建材生产及运输、施工、运营和废弃回收等生命周期的建筑降碳策略，并进一步概述零碳建筑的技术路径和设计策略，结合5个典型零碳建筑案例以及日本和英国的零碳建筑体系，全面展示零碳技术与设计的结合，并以此为依托因地制宜的提出我国未来零碳建筑的发展与展望。 课程主要内容有：零碳建筑与碳排放概述、中国建筑业碳排放特征及影响因素、零碳建筑认定与碳排放计算方法、建筑全生命周期低碳化策略、零碳建筑设计策略、典型案例及我国未来零碳建筑发展与展望。
default.en: This course is mainly used to improve the theoretical level and practical ability of carbon attainment and carbon neutrality in the field of construction for undergraduate students, to train students with the relevant knowledge and analytical methods to analyse and deal with zero-carbon buildings and building carbon reduction problems, to reserve the necessary basic theoretical knowledge for students' future professional studies and completion of their master's thesis, and to train students' ability to relate theory to practice in practical engineering. The course consists of 6 chapters. Chapters 1~3 take the concept and identification of zero carbon buildings as the premise, and introduce the calculation methods of building carbon emissions in the context of the characteristics and influencing factors of building carbon emissions in China's construction industry, providing theoretical support for the proposal of building carbon reduction strategies, as well as clarifying the definitions of zero carbon, low carbon and whole life cycle carbon emissions. Chapters 4 to 6 of the course build on the previous three chapters and introduce the life-cycle carbon reduction strategies of building materials production and transportation, construction, operation and waste recycling, and further outline the design strategies of zero-carbon buildings, combining five typical zero-carbon building cases and the zero-carbon building systems in Japan and the UK to demonstrate the combination of zero-carbon technology and design, and based on this, propose the future zero-carbon buildings in China according to local conditions. The course will also provide an overview of the future development and outlook of zero carbon buildings in China. The main contents of the course include: an overview of zero carbon buildings and carbon emissions, the characteristics and influencing factors of carbon emissions in China's construction industry, the identification of zero carbon buildings and carbon emission calculation methods, strategies for low carbon building lifecycle, zero carbon building design strategies, typical case studies and the future development and outlook of zero carbon buildings in China.

default.zh: 空调中的蓄冷技术是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业选修课程。在培养空调中的蓄冷系统的设计、管理和维护能力、问题分析能力、综合方案设计能力、复杂工程问题研究能力、以及环境和可持续发展的意识方面有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授冰蓄冷空调技术的基本理论、基本概念，各种蓄冷系统的组成、特征、调节方法和运行策略，主要蓄冰设备的工作特性、低温送风空调的特点，冰蓄冷空调系统设计方法以及冰蓄冷空调系统的经济评价等，同时还涉及到蓄冷空调技术领域的新进展和新技术。使学生较深入地了解和掌握建筑环境营造所涉及的蓄冷空调专业知识。 课程采用讲授、作业练习、案例分析和讨论等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、工程案例分析、项目研究，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Cold Storage Technology in Air conditioning is a selective major course for building environment and energy application engineering. The course plays an important role in training students' design, management and maintenance ability, problem analysis ability, integrated program design capability, complex engineering problem research ability, and consciousness of environment and sustainable development for cold storage system in air conditioning system. This course primarily focuses on basic theory, basic concept, composition, characteristic, adjustment methods and operating strategy for varieties of cold storage air condition system, and characteristics of main ice storage equipment and low-temperature air supply air conditioning system, design method and economic evaluation of ice storage air-conditioning system, etc. Furthermore, new advances and new technologies in the area of cold storage air-conditioning system are also involved. All this will make the student understand and master the technical expertise of cold storage air-conditioning system involved in the building environment construction. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises, case studies and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework, case analysis and project studies. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 热泵是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门主专业选修课程。在培养学生建筑环境与能源应用工程方面的问题分析能力、综合方案设计能力、复杂工程问题研究能力、以及环境和可持续发展的意识方面有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授热泵的基本理论、基本概念，各种系统的组成、特点和调节方法，系统中主要设备的构造、工作原理和运行特性、案例分析，以及不同系统的设计应用等。同时还涉及到热泵领域的新进展和新技术。使学生较深入地了解和掌握建筑环境与能源应用工程所涉及的热泵专业知识。 课程采用讲授、作业练习、案例分析和讨论等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、工程案例分析、项目研究、阶段考试和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Heat Pump is a selective major course for building environment and energy application engineering. The course plays an important role in training students' problem analysis ability, integrated program design capability, complex engineering problem research ability, and consciousness of environment and sustainable development. This course primarily focuses on basic theory, basic concept, composition, characteristic, adjustment strategy for varieties of heat pump system, and the constitution, working principle, operating characteristics of main equipment and components in heat pump system, case analysis, etc. are also included. Furthermore, new advances and new technologies in the area of heat pump are also involved。All this will make the student understand and master the technical expertise of heat pump involved in the construction environment. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises, case studies and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework, case analysis and project studies. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向本科生毕业后继续深造、就业等未来发展需求，巩固学生在建筑环境与能源应用工程领域的核心理论知识，训练学生综合运用多元知识分析和解决建筑环境与能源应用工程领域问题的思维和实践能力，使其成长成为能够快速适应和引领相关领域未来发展的优秀人才。课程采用讲授、作业练习、小组讨论以及论文等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分
default.en: This course is primarily designed to meet the future development needs of undergraduates for further education and employment after graduation. It aims to consolidate students' core theoretical knowledge in the field of Building Environment and Energy Applications Engineering, and to train students' thinking and practical abilities to analyze and solve problems in this field using a multi-disciplinary approach. The goal is to cultivate outstanding students who can quickly adapt to and lead future developments in related areas. The course will be taught through lectures, assignments, group discussions, and research pa-pers. The assessment will be cumulative, with the final score expressed as a percentage, with a maximum of 100 points.

default.zh: 城市社会学课程是城乡规划专业必修课程。城市社会学讨论的中心问题一直围绕着城市的发展与运行、以及在这过程中赋予的社会生活的意义展开。以此为核心，本课程将从主要概念、重要理论、城市结构等方面的内容对城市社会学的知识体系进行概括性的讲授。具体的教学内容包括：城市社会学导论、城市社会学的理论流派、城市社会结构、城市组织与社区、城市社会分层、城市空间结构、城市社会问题等。本课程面向于城乡规划专业学生，教学重点在于将城市社会学中与城乡规划研究内容相关的理论、方法、规律提炼为若干知识要点进行讲解，使学生能够系统地掌握相关知识并运用到专业实践当中。课程的教学目标为：掌握城市社会学相关的基础理论知识，如城市社会学基本概念、理论流派、城市结构、研究议题等；了解不同时期城市人口、经济、社会、文化对于城市发展的影响及城市社会发展规律，以及由此表现出的城市多样性特征；认识现实社会中的城市现象与问题，并能够运用城市社会学中所学知识，对现实社会中的城市问题展开较为深入分析与研究。
default.en: Urban Sociology is the major required course for urban and rural planning. According to central issue of urban sociology revolves around urban development and operation, the meaning of social life in this process, this course summarizes the knowledge system of urban sociology discipline through main concepts, important theories, and urban structures. Based on this, the main course contents include urban sociology introduction, urban sociology theories, urban social structure, urban organization and community, social stratification, the urban spatial structure, urban social problems. Due to its vast knowledge system, the course only extracts the theories, methods and rules closely associated with urban-rural planning discipline, which benefit students to use the relative knowledge into professional practice by the interdisciplinary view. The teaching course objectives can be divided into 4 aspects: To master the basic urban sociology theoretical knowledge, like basic concepts, core theories, urban structures, important issues, etc. To understand the influence of urban population, economy, society and culture to urban development, development rules of social development and the urban diversity characteristics of shown from that. To recognize and analyze the phenomenon and problems in the real society.

default.zh: 本课程为全英文课程，旨在为全校学生提供城市设计的相关知识。本课程通过对城市的概念年以及城市设计的历史、理论、要素等的介绍帮助学生构建对城市设计的基本认识。课程的讲授将结合city skylines在线游戏平台，帮助学生理解城市设计及实践的工作的复杂性。在完成city skylines项目的时候，学生应将课堂所学的对城市的理解、城市设计的基本技能应用在这一项目的完成过程中。学生还将在课程中在老师的带领下对选定城区进行调研，结合课程所学思考其问题和解决对策。调研环节将视课程进展和外界条件改为线上实验环节。
default.en: This course is an all English course aimed at providing students with knowledge related to urban design. This course helps students build a basic understanding of urban design by introducing the concept year of cities, as well as the history, theory, and elements of urban design. The course will be taught in conjunction with the city skylines online game platform to help students understand the complexity of urban design and practical work. When completing the city skylines project, students should apply the basic skills of understanding the city and urban design learned in the classroom to the completion process of this project. Students will also conduct research on selected urban areas under the guidance of the teacher during the course, and consider their problems and solutions based on what they have learned in the course. The research section will be changed to an online experimental section based on course progress and external conditions.

default.zh: 本课程在讲授社会调查研究的相关概念、基本原理、方法体系和对应程序的基础上，结合大量的城乡规划、城乡建筑和景观的调查研究成果案例，介绍城乡社会调查研究的基本类型、调查方法、统计分析方法、思维加工方法以及城乡社会调查研究的逻辑过程和一般程序，讲解社会调查研究方案制定的内容，包括调查方案设计内容及策略和相关指标设计要点，详细讲授城乡社会调查研究的选题及意义、调查计划总体安排和调查核心内容制定，讲授不同调查论题下方法选用技术和基础技巧，讨论调查初步成果与资料整理方法、分析研究和归纳技术与方法，结合不同类型的论题讲解调查成果的凝结及表达：即调查研究报告的框架编制及逻辑、调查核心内容的数据分析与表述、调查报告写作方式和展开模式特点，详细的分解讨论调查报告摘要、引言、主体文体、结论的写作要点，强调调查报告的真实性、客观性和独特视角，同时解析调查数据的分析与运用、量化分析的方法和表达；由案例和典型报告选择为触媒引导学生关注城乡规划社会问题、关注民生、重视实证方法、重视调查数据的意识，培养学生从现象中发现问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，为加深理解城市及规划社会规律和专业特点及知识，为后续的学习能力、研究能力的培养打好坚实基础。
default.en: Based on teaching related concepts, basic principles, method system and corresponding procedures of the social investigation and research, this course introduces basic types, statistical analysis methods, thinking processing methods, logical process and the general procedures of urban and rural social investigation and research, combined with a large number of investigation and research results of urban and rural planning, buildings and landscape. The content of how to make the social research program is discussed, including the strategies of investigation program design and points of related indicators design. Topics selection and significance of urban and rural social survey, overall arrangements for the investigation plan and developing the core content of the survey are introduced. This course also teaches methods of selection and basic skills according to different topics, discusses the initial results of the survey and data collation, analysis and induction methods, explains the condensation and expression of survey results combined with different types of topics: that is, framework and logic of the research report, data analysis and presentation of the core content, writing characteristics and development modes of the report. Furthermore, detailed decomposition of the investigation report’s summary, introduction, subject style, writing points of the conclusion is discussed, emphasizing the authenticity, objectivity and unique perspective of the survey report, and analyzing the analysis and application of the survey data, quantifying methods and expression of the analysis. This course leads students to focus on urban and rural planning social issues, concern about people's livelihood, pay attention to empirical methods and the awareness of survey data by selecting cases and the typical reports, and develops students’ ability to find problems, analyze problems, and solve problems from the phenomenon in order to deepen understanding urban and the related specialized knowledge and lay a solid foundation for further study and research.

default.zh: 城市建设经济概论课程从经济学角度介绍城市发展的机理和过程。通过阐述城市经济活动中出现的矛盾和问题，使学生了解制定正确的城市与区域发展战略的过程、合理利用城市空间资源的方法，以及科学评价城市发展状况和运营状态的方法。拓展学生横向思维，以全球经济的视角理解城市系统与城市规划、空间布局与经济增长、城市密度与经济规模、城市发展与产业结构等众多城市经济热点问题。
default.en: “Introductory urban development economies” is a course to clarify urban development mechanism and process in macro urban economic views. By explaining conflicts and problems occur in urban development and economy activities, it aims to teach urban planning major students to understand correctly urban and regional development procedures, methods of reasonable utilization of urban space recourses, and assessment of urban development status. This course is to expand and develop students’ ability of thinking and understanding urban development economic issues of urban system and urban planning, spatial layouts and economic prosperity, urban density and economic modes, urban development and industrial structures.
