Master the ability to plan and produce virtual reality images based on real-life photography, animation, and special effects, train key production techniques, and gain a deep understanding of various types of content creation processes, including the basic principles behind the hidden planning of virtual reality images, laying a solid foundation for future work in the field of virtual reality image creation.

default.zh: 本课程所涉及的内容展示了在社会网络的作用下正在浮现与发展起来的一些交叉学科领域，讨论了社会和技术领域相互联系的若干基本问题。主要包括社会网络的基本知识、基础数学知识，社会关系中的结构平衡，博弈论、进化博弈以及博弈论简单应用，信息网络，网络信息级联，小世界理论，流行网络等等。本课程将结合具体的社会媒体中的实例来解释相对应的理论。
default.en: This course presents cross-disciplinary knowledge in the context of social media and network, and discusses several basic problems about the society and technology. The content of this course mainly includes the basic knowledge of the social network, the foundations of mathematics, structure balance in the social relations, game theory and its application, web information, information cascade, small world theory and so on. We will introduce these theories with many useful application cases.

default.zh: 媒体数据分析课程是数字媒体艺术专业限修课程，为学生后续进行毕业设计毕业论文开阔视野，在培养学生综合运用专业编程能力、创意能力方面具有重要的作用。 本课程主要讲授媒体数据分析的基本原理和方法，包括回顾数学相关知识、数据采集的常见方法、数据可视化部分方法、朴素贝叶斯、聚类、协同过滤，以及常见的机器学习算法，线性回归、逻辑回归、神经网络。后续的实验环节，学生针对两个实际问题，提出相应的解决方案。 通过该课程的学习，使学生掌握概率论、统计学、机器学习的基本原理，从而指导数据分析实践；掌握数据分析在媒体运作中的作用，培养媒体操作过程中的数据思维，使学生能够使用数学工具分析实际问题；掌握Python数据分析的方法和工具，掌握可视化分析的方法和工具，能够编程实现数据分析的算法；通过数据分析的实践案例分析，使学生能够设计数据分析的实验解决实际问题。
default.en: Media Data Analysis is a course for digital media art undergraduate students, but also a practical course for students who want to find a job in data analysis area. And it enlarge the view of students who are preparing thesis. And it plays a significant role in developing programming skills and creative ability of students. This course introduces the basic principles and methods of media data analysis, including the review of mathematical knowledge, data acquisition methods, data visualization methods, naive Bayesian, clustering, collaborative filtering, and common machine learning algorithms, such as linear regression Logic regression, neural network. In the following experimental section, students should propose a solution for two corresponding problems. Through the study of the course, students can master the theory of probability, statistics, machine learning, further to practice data analysis, and can master the role of data analysis in the operation of the media. And students can use Mathematical tools to analyze practical problems, and master Python data analysis methods and tools and visual analysis methods and tools to be able to pro-grammatically implement the data analysis algorithm, through which students can design data analysis experiments to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 数字化与智能化是媒体融合发展显现态势，不同媒介形态的设计与传播趋向数智转向，展现新特质与新动向，促使信息传播满足多样、交互、参与的需求与体验。本课程系统介绍数智媒体融合的内涵、影响、不同媒介形态融合设计与传播的特征、要义及创新展现，旨在指导学生了解数智媒介发展呈现的全新特质，深入把握内在机理，理性分析与感性创意相融相人口目立，加强媒体化社会传播观念的确立，媒体技术赋能媒体创意产品的设计与传播。
default.en: Digitization and intelligentization are the trend of media convergence and development. The design and communication of different media forms tend to turn to digital and intelligence, show new characteristics and new trends, and promote information communication to meet the needs and experiences of diversity, interaction and participation. This course systematically introduces the connotation and influence of digital-intelligence media convergence, as well as the features, essence and innovative presentation of the design and communication of different media forms. It aims to guide students to understand the new characteristics presented by the development of digital-intelligence media, deeply grasp the internal mechanism, integrate rational analysis with perceptual creativity, and strengthen the establishment of the concept of media social communication. Media technology enables the design and communication of creative media products.

default.zh: 课程立足于交叉学科，将广告审美、广告创意、广告调研与设计实践相融合，是建立在美学理论、设计艺术学、传播学等不同学科基础之上的课程。结合理论与实践，既注重学生创新性思维的开发、创意表达能力的训练，又培养学生实地操作与调查分析能力。
default.en: Based on the cross-disciplinary, the course combines the aesthetic, creative, research and design practice of advertising, and is based on the aesthetic theory, design art, communication and other disciplines. Combining theory with practice, it not only pays attention to the development of students' creative thinking, the training of creative expression ability, but also trains students' ability of field operation and investigation and analysis.

default.zh: 网络交互动画是高等工科院校中数字媒体类专业的一门限选课程。在教学过程中要综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行数字媒体技术与设计人员所需的基本训练。为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事交互动画设计与制作工作打下基础。为学生进行交互动画的设计提供步进式指导，展开数字媒体产品的创新设计。以期培养其从事交互动画，尤其是交互动画研究和相关职业的知识基础与理论修养。
default.en: Network interactive animation is a limited course of digital media in higher engineering colleges. In the teaching process to the comprehensive application of the lessons learned in the relevant knowledge and skills, combined with a variety of practical teaching links, digital media technology and design staff needed basic training. For students to further study the relevant professional courses and engage in interactive animation design and production work to lay the foundation. For students to carry out interactive animation design to provide step-by-step guidance, to expand the digital media product design. In order to cultivate its interactive animation, especially interactive animation research and related occupation knowledge base and theoretical accomplishment.

default.zh: 物联网产品认知评估设计是一门涉及多个交叉学科领域的课程。本课程旨在让学生理解物联网产品交互设计中的认知学因素，发展学生从认知心理学角度分析用户体验的能力，结合多媒体界面的设计实例使学生深入理解人的多通道认知能力，以及如何借助认知学知识围绕物联网产品进行设计、修改人机界面与界面交互方式。在此基础之上，介绍包括启发式评估、可用性测试、观察法、访谈法等多种交互设计评估方法，培养学生针对不同物联网产品设计项目结合用户需要设计并实施适当的评估方法的能力。
default.en: The cognitive evaluation design of IoT products is a course that involves multiple interdisciplinary fields. This course aims to help students understand the cognitive factors in the interaction design of IoT products, develop their ability to analyze user experience from a cognitive psychology perspective, and combine multimedia interface design examples to deepen their understanding of human multi-channel cognitive abilities. It also aims to use cognitive knowledge to design and modify human-machine interfaces and interface interaction methods around IoT products. On this basis, various interactive design evaluation methods, including heuristic evaluation, usability testing, observation method, interview method, etc., are introduced to cultivate students' ability to design and implement appropriate evaluation methods for different IoT product design projects based on user needs.

default.zh: 网络交互产品设计是高等工科院校中数字媒体类专业一门主干课程，在教学过程中要综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行数字媒体技术与设计人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事交互产品设计工作打下基础，为学生进行数字媒体产品的设计提供步进式指导，展开数字媒体产品的创新设计，以期培养其从事交互产品设计，尤其是交互产品设计方面研究和相关职业的知识基础与理论修养。
default.en: Network interactive product design is a backbone course for digital media majors in higher engineering colleges. In the teaching process, it is necessary to comprehensively apply the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses, combine various practical teaching links, and provide basic training for digital media technology and designers, laying the foundation for students to further learn relevant professional courses and engage in interactive product design work in the future, Provide step-by-step guidance for students in the design of digital media products, carry out innovative design of digital media products, with the aim of cultivating their knowledge foundation and theoretical cultivation in interactive product design, especially in research and related professions.

default.zh: 互动装置艺术设计是一门跨学科的综合性较强的艺术形式，它包括了设计艺术、计算机图形技术、编程语言、传媒硬件材料等各类学科，是“场地+材料+情感”综合体现。《互动装置艺术设计》意在培养学生互动装置艺术设计和创作表现能力，使学生充分理解互动装置艺术设计的概念、特性、类型以及在环境设计、公共艺术、产品设计、展示设计中的应用，了解互动装置艺术设计在当前社会环境建设中的发展前景；通过动创意设计与动手制作模型相结合，开发学生立体的创造性思维，提高动手能力，掌握互动装置艺术设计与制作的知识和技能，具有互动装置艺术设计作品鉴赏能力和设计创新能力。互动装置艺术作为后现代艺术的一个主要艺术运动开始了自身的发展历程。在教学中以互动装置艺术的观念与形式为研究对象，进行了四个内容的研究：根据对互动装置艺术的历史渊源回顾，综述了互动装置艺术的本质与特征、理论渊源、观念源头等；基于对互动装置空间艺术所根植的艺术语言组合的讨论，论述了其观念语义与形式语言；通过对置艺术的设计与训练，提出了新的设计思路与技巧；通过对互动装置空间设计作品的个案研究，总结了互动装置艺术中的观念与形式建构的一个有别于传统审美的审美体系
default.en: Interactive Installation Art design is an interdisciplinary comprehensive art form, it includes all kinds of art design, computer graphics, programming language, hardware media materials, is "site + materials + comprehensive reflection of emotion". "Interactive Installation Art design" aims to cultivate students' ability of Interactive Installation Art design and creation, to enable students to fully understand the Interactive Installation Art design concept, characteristics, types and in the environmental design, public art, product design, exhibition design, Interactive Installation Art design development prospects in the understanding of the social environment in the construction of the current through the combination of dynamic and creative; design and make model, develop students' creative thinking three-dimensional, improve the ability to master the design and fabrication of device art knowledge and skills, equipment with works of art and design appreciation ability and design innovation ability. The installation art, as a major art movement of post-modern art, has begun its own development course. In the teaching of the concept and form of Interactive Installation Art as the research object, the research of four aspects: according to the review of history of installation art, summarizes the essence and characteristic, Interactive Installation Art theory origin, concept of source language combination; discuss art rooted on space art based on the device, and discusses the the concept of semantic and formal language; through the design and training of opposing art, puts forward the design ideas and new skills; through the case of unit space design research, summarizes the concept of construction and Interactive Installation Art in the form of a is different from the traditional aesthetic aesthetic system.

default.zh: 本课程讲授利用数据可视化来帮助人们理解和分析信息和数据的设计方法。在信息时代，大量信息的涌现使得人们需要跨越文本、数字以及静态图像才能够实现有效的媒介传播。在本课程中，学生将会了解数据可视化的设计原则和基本方法。课程尤为关注可以帮助用户感知和理解大规模的复杂数据的交互性的动态可视化的设计与实现，而这是依靠常规的静态视觉呈现无法实现的。最终，学生将能够应用恰当的设计方法和技术来创建互动信息图和构建具有美感的可视化图形表示。
default.en: This course will teach students to use data visualization to help people understand and analyze information and data. Communicating effectively in our information overloading era requires us to move beyond text, number, and even static images. In this course, the students will learn design principles and basic methods of data visualization and be focused on design and implement dynamic interactive visualizations that allow the users to perceive and understand much more complex information that are not possible by using regular static visual representations. At the end of the class, students will apply the design principles and use proper technologies to create interactive infographics and apply design aesthetics to visualization graphs.

default.zh: 数字仿真工程是数字媒体技术专业主干课程，是一门利用计算机软件模拟实际环境进行科学实验的技术性课程。它是以数学理论为基础，以计算机和各种物理设施为设备工具，利用物理的、数学的模型来对实际的或设想的系统及其演变过程进行类比、模仿研究。本课程的教学目的在于让学生建立模型化思维方法，了解多种仿真模型，掌握相关仿真软件，初步具备将理论分析、实验研究与工程实际应用相结合的能力。
default.en: “Digital Simulation Engineering” is a course that computer software is used to simulate the environment for science experiment. It is based on the theory of mathematics and takes computer and various physical facilities as equipment tools. Physical or mathematical model are built to simulate the actual or contemplated system and its evolution process. The purpose of this course is to make students establish the method of modeling thinking, understand a variety of simulation models, master the relevant simulation software and initially get the ability that can merge the theoretical analysis, experimental research and engineering practice together.

default.zh: 本课程为数字媒体艺术专业本科课程，旨在通过教师的示范和优秀作品的演示，激发学生通过动作捕捉技术创作人物动画的内在动力，通过实验培养学生的自学能力、协作能力、交流沟通能力和综合运用能力。通过实验教学，学生了解动作捕捉的操作流程，掌握动作捕捉软件和相关DCC软件以及结合游戏引擎的实时渲染实例。
default.en: This course is an undergraduate course for digital media art majors, aiming to stimulate students' intrinsic motivation to create character animation through motion capture technology through teacher's demonstration and demonstration of excellent works, and to cultivate students' self-study ability, collaborative ability, communication ability and comprehensive application ability through experiments. Through experimental teaching, students understand the operation process of motion capture, master motion capture software and related DCC software as well as real-time rendering examples combined with game engines.

default.zh: 《UI设计》是数字媒体专业的专业课程，是在图形图像处理、企业形象、logo标志设计课程上的延续与提高。课程几乎涉及到了平面设计专业基础课的各个方面，课程实践中注重对各设计基础课程如图形设计、编排设计、字体设计、构成设计等课程的综合运用，进行视觉界面部分的设计，为大多数互联网类公司培养研发部门和市场部门的视觉设计师。要求掌握精美UI图标的创意方法和技巧；掌握UI设计规范与应用；学会如何去把控一个整体设计项目及角色扮演；更进一步学习界面设计，掌握多媒体终端界面设计；视觉效果打造提升，可进行复杂的视觉效果表现；培养学生抽象思维及逻辑思维，拥有设计项目实战能力；掌握超写实UI图标设计技巧。可以将各类视觉技法应用到实际商业案例之中，让作品设计更加规范化，学会分析用户习惯，了解UI未来发展趋势与应用范围；使学生能够从战略角度分析一个互联网项目，盈利点、运营模式、产品原型、交互设计、用户体验、视觉表现等。
default.en: User interface design is a specialized course in digital media. It is the continuation and improvement of graphics, image processing, enterprise image and logo logo design course. The course involves almost all aspects of professional graphic design course, focusing on the design of curriculum practice in basic courses such as graphic design, layout design, font design, structure design course of integrated application, design visual interface part of the culture, R & D department and marketing department of visual designers for most Internet companies. Creative methods and skills required to master the exquisite UI icon; master UI design and application; learn how to control a whole design project and role play; to further study and master the multimedia interface design, interface design; visual effects to create visual effect can be improved, complex; cultivating students' abstract thinking and logical thinking that has design project combat ability; master the ultra realistic UI icon design skills. Can be all kinds of visual techniques applied to the actual business case, to make the work more standardized design, learn to analyze user habits, understand the development trend of UI and the application scope; to enable students to analyze an internet project from the angle of strategy, profit and operation mode, product prototype, interaction design, user experience, visual representation.

default.zh: 《算法艺术》意在培养学生了解算法艺术作品的创意流程及技术实现环节和人员分工的细节。掌握对基于创意表现、算法实现、交互设计等方面的创作能力，训练关键制作技巧，深入理解各种类型的内容创作方法，为将来进入技术与艺术融合的创作领域进行相关工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: The purpose of 'Algorithm Art' is to cultivate students' understanding of the creative process and technical implementation steps of algorithm art works, as well as the details of personnel division. Mastering creative abilities based on creative expression, algorithm implementation, interactive design, etc., training key production techniques, and deeply understanding various types of content creation methods, laying a solid foundation for future work in the field of technology and art integration.

default.zh: 本课程是数字媒体专业的个性化专业选修课程。人工智能技术在游戏开发中起着至关重要的作用，游戏角色的智能水平直接影响着游戏的惊险性、刺激性、趣味性。本课程以实例方式详细讲解如何在游戏引擎中实现不同的人工智能技术，如何应用游戏引擎内置的特性，涵盖有限状态机、路径寻找、行为操控以及行为树等技术，并且对于所有的算法，给出实现方法。实验环节验证课堂教学中的理论，掌握游戏智能算法的开发工具，实现群体智能、行为树、互动等流程关键技术，能够利用智能游戏设计各要素，增强用户体验， 营造具有智能驱动的游戏交互环境，满足一定设计任务。
default.en: Intelligent Game Design is a personalized professional elective course for digital media majors. Artificial Intelligence technology plays a crucial role in game development, and the intelligence level of the game character directly affects the thrill, excitement, and fun of the game. This course explains in detail how to implement different AI technologies in game engines by examples, how to apply the built-in features of game engines, covering technologies such as finite state machine, path finding, behavior manipulation and behavior tree, and gives implementation methods for all algorithms. The experimental session verifies the theories taught in the classroom, masters the development tools of game intelligence algorithms, realizes the key technologies of group intelligence, behavior tree, interaction, etc., and is able to utilize the elements of intelligent game design to enhance the user experience, create an intelligence-driven game interaction environment, and satisfy certain design tasks.

default.zh: 《信息艺术设计》是数字媒体艺术专业的一门重要课程，旨在培养学生掌握信息艺术设计的理念、方法和技能，具备将信息可视化、交互化、艺术化的能力。本课程结合理论教学和实践操作，注重学生创新思维和实际制作能力的培养，为学生的数字媒体艺术设计职业发展打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Information Art Design is an important course for digital media art majors, aiming to train students to master the concepts, methods and skills of information art design, and to have the ability to visualize, interact and art information. This course combines theoretical teaching and practical operation, focuses on the cultivation of students' innovative thinking and practical production ability, and lays a solid foundation for students' career development of digital media art design.

default.zh: 数字动漫创作是专业出口课程，主要讲在数字动漫艺术的基础理论，对动漫的基本原理、类型和应用进行介绍，使学生能够运用动漫创作的原理进行不同类型的动漫创作实践。
default.en: Digital anime creation is a professional export course that mainly focuses on the basic theories of digital anime art, introducing the basic principles, types, and applications of anime, enabling students to apply the principles of anime creation to different types of anime creation practices.

default.zh: 本课程旨在提供工业设计专业研究生符合可持续发展时代要求的设计方法与实践创新课程。目标通过将多学科交叉的方法融入传统产品设计方法以达到可持续设计与创新。课程涵盖讲述可持续设计相关概念和流程、相关国际标准、基本工具与技术的应用，并介绍整合可持续性的设计案例，引领学生开展案例研究与实践创新。
default.en: This course is designed to provide design methods and practical innovation courses for industrial design graduate students that meet the requirements of the sustainable development era. The goal is to achieve sustainable design and innovation by integrating multidisciplinary approaches into traditional product design methods. The course includes the introduction of concepts and processes related to sustainable design, relevant international standards, applications of commonly used tools and technologies, and the introduction of design cases that integrate sustainability and guide students to conduct case studies and practice innovation.

default.zh: 模型制作是产品设计专业的选修实验课程，通过实验教学使学生掌握产品设计所需要的基本知识和基本技能，体会蕴含在模型制作过程中的设计因素，不仅仅是在进行产品形态的塑造，也是对产品结构设计进行思考和产品模具的制造工艺进行探索。 模型制作使学生掌握实体模型建模方法，了解实物模型材料的性能、组成、用途以及选择，掌握工业产品表面装饰的一般方法和工艺；了解当代的新信息，能动地运用新材料、工艺和新技术；进行产品外观设计。
default.en: Model making is an elective experimental course for the product design major.Through experimental teaching, students can master the basic knowledge and skills required by product design and experience the design factors contained in the process of model making. It is not only shaping the product form, but also thinking about the product structure design and exploring the manufacturing process of product mould. Model making course make students to master the methods of entity modeling approach, and to understand the performance, composition, using and selection of materials, master the general methods and processes of surface decoration of industrial products; understand contemporary new information and use new materials, processes and technologies actively; and accomplish product appearance design.

default.zh: 本课程是产品设计专业本科教学的专业课程之一，价值分析是从技术和经济的角度研究价值，并通过研究产品功能与费用来探索提高价值的途径；设计管理是通过管理产品设计过程中的每一个步骤、协调参与产品设计的各个部门的关系来分析产品开发的方法。
default.en: his course is one of the core courses in the undergraduate program of Product Design. Value Analysis studies value from both technical and economic perspectives, exploring ways to enhance value by examining product functions and costs. Design Management analyzes product development methods by managing each step of the product design process and coordinating the relationships among all departments involved in product design.

default.zh: 本课程通过理论讲授、案例分析和实践项目，培养学生掌握数字产品设计的核心理论与方法，熟悉新媒体技术的应用场景，能够独立完成数字产品设计流程
default.en: This course, through theoretical lectures, case analysis, and practical projects, enables students to master the core theories and methods of digital product design, become familiar with the application scenarios of new media technologies, and independently complete the digital product design process.

default.zh: 本课程通过介绍包装设计的含义、发展和基本观点，掌握包装设计的内容和方法步骤，培养学生进行包装设计的依据、要求的能力为重点。旨在为后续的专业课程的学习提供理论基础。其教学目标如下： 目标1. 掌握以市场与用户为导向的战略性设计思维。使学生能够从市场策略、品牌定位和用户心理的角度出发，进行有针对性包装设计，并准确传达产品核心价值。 目标2. 深化材料、结构与视觉综合的造型语言。提高学生从材料特性、结构功能、制造工艺和视觉表现等多个维度进行一体化设计。 目标3. 树立以生命周期为导向的可持续设计价值观。培养学生从包装的整个生命周期（出发进行设计思考，力求在满足商业需求的同时，最大限度地减少对环境的影响。
default.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning, development, and fundamental perspectives of packaging design, enabling students to master the content, methods, and steps of packaging design, and cultivating their ability to execute packaging design based on relevant foundations and requirements. It aims to provide a theoretical foundation for subsequent specialized courses. The teaching objectives are as follows: Objective 1: Master market-and-user-oriented strategic design thinking. Enable students to conduct targeted packaging design from the perspectives of market strategy, brand positioning, and user psychology, accurately conveying the core value of the product. Objective 2: Deepen the integrated modeling language of materials, structure, and visuals. Enhance students' ability to perform integrated design across multiple dimensions, including material characteristics, structural functionality, manufacturing processes, and visual expression. Objective 3: Establish a lifecycle-oriented sustainable design价值观. Cultivate students' ability to consider the entire lifecycle of packaging from the outset of their design thinking, striving to minimize environmental impact while meeting commercial requirements.

default.zh: 本课程以实验性材料，如智能材料、生物基材料、纳米材料等为核心研究对象，围绕其设计、制备、性能优化及应用场景展开教学。课程目标旨在培养学生掌握材料科学基础理论、具备解决复杂工程问题的能力，并通过实践与协作强化创新思维。
default.en: This course focuses on experimental materials—such as smart materials, bio-based materials, and nanomaterials—as its core research subjects, covering their design, preparation, performance optimization, and application scenarios. The course aims to equip students with foundational theories of materials science, develop their ability to solve complex engineering problems, and strengthen innovative thinking through hands-on practice and collaboration.

default.zh: 帮助学生理解展览策划和展览空间设计的基本知识。 掌握展览空间设计的思维逻辑与工作方法。 能够进行展览空间的策划与创作。
default.en: Equip students with a foundational understanding of exhibition planning and design, enabling them to master its logical approach and methodology for conceiving and executing their own spatial creations.

default.zh: 建筑构造实习是课堂理论讲授的重要补充和实践性应用环节，其目的是使学生了解和掌握构造的基本方法，巩固和丰富自己学习的构造课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高在工地建造中观察、分析、解决问题的能力，为后续专业课程打下良好的基础。通过工地构造实习，还应使学生巩固所学理论，获的本专业实际知识，以培养实际工作能力和专业技能。教学内容及基本要求包括：了解工地的组织机构和生产组织管理情况；了解建筑结构的形式和施工方法；掌握建筑构造的特点和具体构造作法；掌握先进的施工技术和现代的管理方法；掌握新型的建筑材料性能和使用方法；了解行业内结构、构造、材料的发展方向。
default.en: Construction practice is an important supplement and application of classroom theory teaching, and an effective means to train architects and engineers. As a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan, its purpose is to make students understand and master the basic methods of construction, consolidate and enrich their own structural curriculum content, and train students to combine theory with practice. Teaching content and basic requirements include: to understand the organization of the practice units and production organization management; Understand the form and construction method of the building structure; Mastering the characteristics and concrete construction methods of building structure; Master advanced construction technology and modern management methods; To master the performance and use of new building materials; Understand the development direction of structure, structure and materials in the industry.

default.zh: 《建筑测绘实习》是建筑学专业的一门重要的专业核心课程，通过运用所学的建筑历史知识与建筑测绘的理论知识，采集测绘对象的三维数据信息，并用直观且便于保存和复制的形式表达出来。通过触摸历史建筑实例，体验前人的创作智慧，感受其真实尺度与数据尺度之间的关系，提高对建筑的观察力、尺度感和形式感，锻炼艰苦奋斗的工作态度和团队协作的能力以及图纸表达能力。具体课程目标如下：1：认识建筑测绘的课程性质、作用和在建筑历史研究中的地位，掌握建筑测绘的基本理论；能够运用所学的中外建筑史知识去观察、认知历史建筑。2： 能够通过观察建筑实物，相对准确地绘制出建筑的平面、立面、剖面及细部大样的草图，并用仪器采集其三维空间信息标注在草图上。3： 将草图的信息输入计算机，绘制出规范的建筑平立剖面图；撰写相关调查考察报告，学习传统建筑的研究方法及语言文字的表现能力，提高理论水平。
default.en: Practice in Architectural Surveying is a crucial core course for architecture majors. By applying knowledge of architectural history and theoretical understanding of architectural surveying and mapping, three-dimensional data information of surveyed objects is collected and presented in an intuitive format that is easy to save and replicate. Through studying examples of historical buildings, students can appreciate the creative wisdom of their predecessors, comprehend the relationship between real scale and data scale, enhance their observation skills, develop a sense of scale and form in architecture, as well as cultivate a diligent work ethic, teamwork ability, and proficiency in drawing expression. The specific objectives of this course are as follows: 1) To comprehend the nature, function, and significance of architectural surveying and mapping in the study of architectural history while mastering its fundamental theories; being able to utilize knowledge from Chinese and foreign architectural history to observe and identify historical buildings. 2) To accurately sketch building plans, elevations, sections, details by observing actual structures; employing instruments to collect three-dimensional spatial information which will be marked on these sketches. 3) To input sketch information into computers for generating standardized building profiles; writing relevant investigation reports; acquiring research methods traditional architecture along with language expression abilities thereby enhancing theoretical competence.

default.zh: 生产实习是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门重要的专业施工技能课，从基本的技能入手，培养学生对系统的运行调试和动手能力。通过对工程中的实际系统运行调试，掌握不同设备的运行步骤、各种工具的使用方法、施工组织与技术规范。根据课堂理论教学的内容，在实践中加以应用，从而巩固课堂中所学的知识。通过实习学生应具备对系统的施工运行中所出现的工程问题进行分析和解决的能力，并掌握本专业知识领域的基本技能。 课程主要包括两部分：首先学习施工组织规范和设备运行控制的基本常识，之后开展实际的生产实习。实习内容将设立以下五个方面，学生可以选择其中之一：小型建筑环境系统调试、小型冷冻站调试、建筑燃气系统调试、末端设备安装、海外游学。 课程采用讲授规范、现场实习等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括规范内容小测试、生产实习表现（对问题的思考和主动性）、组装系统的运行调试结果（实际动手能力）、实习报告的撰写，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Production Practice & Abroad Practice is an important course for students of both two professional directions in building environment and building energy. The course plays an important role in training students' ability of commissioning and operating system. Students will master a series of knowledge, such as the operation procedure of different system, How to use the common tools usually used in our major, the technic code of construction and operation of system. The practice is favorable for student to understand clearly and master deeply the knowledge learned in classroom. In the practice, students will have the ability of analyze and solve specific problems raised in practical operation of system, therefore master the basic skills used this major. The course includes two steps. First is learning the code in classroom, which will help students be prepared to conduct the operation of system; second is join into the practical project to operate the system. The course content of practice mainly includes five directions, each student could select one of them, which are indoor air quality control system, refrigeration system, gas system, the assessment of end-user equipment, and study abroad. The course is performed in both the way of teaching the code in classroom and practice with a real system in project. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes quiz of technic code, the performance of student in the practice (initiative motivation), the operation results of system commissioned by students (manipulative ability), and the writing of report. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程采用讲授与上机的教学方式，通过学习MATLAB基本运算、编程方法、数据处理和图形与可视化等基础知识，培养学生利用计算机解决基础数值问题的能力，训练学生计算思维能力，培养学生树立正确的程序设计思维，逐步适应大数据和人工智能时代的学习与工作。
default.en: This course employs an instructional model integrating lectures and in？lab computer exercises. By covering the essential elements of MATLAB—basic operations, programming techniques, data processing, and graphical visualization—students are expected to cultivate competence in solving elementary numerical problems with computational tools, sharpen their computational thinking, foster a correct approach to programming logic, and progressively acclimate themselves to the demands of learning and professional practice in the age of big data and artificial intelligence.

default.zh: 毕业设计是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的重要实践性教学环节，在培养学生工程设计能力方面占有重要的地位。通过设计全过程的训练，要求学生掌握应用专业知识分析和解决建筑环境和能源领域复杂工程问题的方法，具有专业相关的政策、法律法规和标准知识，具备通过文献研究，综合运用专业知识和现代工具设计（开发）复杂建筑环境与能源应用工程问题的创新解决方案的能力，具备专题报告文稿撰写、专业图纸绘制和专业知识交流的素养。 本课程分为空调、供热和燃气三个设计方向，学生选择其中一个设计方向完成相应要求。空调设计方向，要求完成负荷计算、空调/通风/供暖方案确定，全空气空调系统设计，空气－水风机盘管系统设计，排风系统设计，防排烟系统设计，冷热水系统设计；供热设计方向，要求完成负荷计算、供热方案、供热管网的水力计算、供热调节、散热损失计算、受力分析、站房设计、设备选型；燃气设计方向，要求完成城市燃气气源规划、燃气用气量计算、高峰小时流量计算、燃气调峰量计算、调峰方案的提出、燃气管网系统规划、管网水力计算、方案技术经济计算、天然气门站设计、液化天然气气化站设计、压缩天然气储配站设计。要求完成设计计算说明书和至少12张1号图纸绘制的工作量。 课程考核的环节包括开题、中期检查、指导教师评分、评阅人评分和毕业答辩，满分100分。
default.en: Graduation Thesis (Design) is an important practical teaching link in the field of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering, playing an important role in cultivating students' engineering design abilities. Through the training of the entire design process, students are required to master the methods of applying professional knowledge to analyze and solve complex engineering problems in the field of building environment and energy, possess professional knowledge of policies, laws, regulations, and standards, have the ability to design (develop) innovative solutions to complex building environment and energy application engineering problems through literature research, comprehensive application of professional knowledge and modern tools, and have the ability to write special report manuscripts Proficiency in professional drawing and knowledge exchange. This course is divided into three design directions: air conditioning, district heating, and gas supply. Students choose one of these design directions to complete the corresponding requirements. The direction of air conditioning design requires completing load calculations, determining air conditioning/ventilation/heating plans, designing all air conditioning systems, designing air water fan coil systems, designing exhaust systems, smoke control and exhaust systems, and designing cold and hot water systems; The direction of district heating design requires completing load calculation, heating scheme, hydraulic calculation of heating pipeline network, heating regulation, heat dissipation loss calculation, force analysis, heating plant/ substation design, and equipment selection; The direction of gas supply design requires the completion of urban gas source planning, gas consumption calculation, peak hour flow calculation, gas peak shaving calculation, proposal of peak shaving plan, gas pipeline network system planning, pipeline hydraulic calculation, scheme technical and economic calculation, natural valve station design, liquefied natural gas gasification station design, and compressed natural gas storage and distribution station design. The workload required to complete the design calculation manual and at least 12 No.1 drawings. The course assessment process includes question opening, mid-term inspection, instructor evaluation, reviewer evaluation, and graduation defense, with a maximum score of 100 points.

default.zh: 1. 供热工程方向 供热工程课程设计是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门主干设计实践课，是培养学生解决实际问题能力的重要教学实践环节。本课程以街区供热系统为设计对象，完成小规模的室内供暖系统和街区供热管网两部分设计，培养学生运用“供热工程”的理论和技术知识解决实际问题。要求学生了解供热工程相关的政策、法律法规、标准，掌握供热工程的方案设计、工程问题研究和计算机辅助设计方法，具有系统性与全局性解决问题的思维与意识，能够利用系统仿真等现代化工具分析解决实际工程问题，树立正确的设计观，为将来从事供热工程设计打下良好的基础。 课程以街区供热系统为设计对象，分为室内供暖系统和街区供热管网两部分设计：室内供暖系统设计，完成建筑物设计热负荷计算、室内供暖系统方案设计、散热器选型和供暖系统水力计算，绘制供暖系统首层平面图、供暖系统标准层（与顶层）平面图、供暖系统图、热力入口和管道井大样图；街区供热管网设计，完成供热区域设计热负荷计算、供热管网路由方案设计、供热管网水力计算、供热管网水压图设计，绘制供热管网管线平面图、管线纵断面图、主干线水压图。 2. 燃气输配方向 燃气输配课程设计是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的重要实践性教学环节，是培养学生工程设计能力、树立正确设计观的重要环节。本课程通过燃气输配课程设计培养学生综合运用所学的基础理论、基本知识和基本技能解决工程技术问题的初步能力，提高使用现代工具进行工程计算和制图的能力，通过查阅文献资料（包括有关标准、规范、手册、标准图及其他资料）增强自主学习的意识，锻炼专业内容的交流能力。从学生对城市燃气的认知与了解入手，使其了解建筑环境与能源应用工程专业与人民生活需求切实相关，进一步加强学生的社会主义价值观培养，使其充分认识到节能减排的艰巨性与特殊性。 课程主要包括民用建筑室内燃气管道设计、低压燃气输配管网设计等。学生需要具备应用水力计算软件、工程制图、计算机辅助设计以及计算数据分析处理等能力完成燃气管道布线方案、燃气管道水力计算、民用建筑室内燃气管道布置图、编制设计说明书。 课程考核综合阶段考察和结题答辩的累加评分，满分100分。
default.en: 1 Heating Engineering Course Design for Heating Engineering is a compulsory design practice course for the major of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering, and an important teaching practice link to cultivate students' ability to solve practical problems. This course takes the district heating system as the design object, completing the design of small-scale space heating systems and district heating networks, and cultivating students to apply the theoretical and technical knowledge of "heating engineering" to solve practical problems. Students are required to understand the policies, laws, regulations, and standards related to heating engineering, master the conceptual design, engineering problem research, and computer-aided design methods of heating engineering, have a systematic and global problem-solving mindset and awareness, be able to use modern tools such as system simulation to analyze and solve practical engineering problems, establish a correct design concept, and lay a solid foundation for future work in heating engineering design. The course takes the district heating system as the design object and is divided into two parts: space heating system design and district heating network design: space heating system design, completing building design heat load calculation, space heating system scheme design, radiator selection, and space heating system hydraulic calculation, drawing the first floor plan of the heating system, standard floor (and top floor) plan of the heating system, space heating system diagram, detailed drawing of the heating interface and pipeline well; Design the district heating network, complete the calculation of heating load in the heating area design, the design of heating network routing scheme, the hydraulic calculation of heating network, and the design of heating network water pressure diagram. Draw the heating network pipeline plan, pipeline longitudinal section, and main pipeline water pressure diagram. 2 Gas Transportation and Distribution Course design of gas transportation and distribution is an important practical teaching link of building environment and energy application engineering, and it is also an important link to train students' engineering design ability and establish correct design concept. This course through the curriculum design of gas transmission and cultivate students' comprehensive use of basic theory, basic knowledge and basic skills to solve engineering problems, the preliminary ability to improve the ability to use modern tools for engineering calculation and drawing, through consulting documents (including the related standards, specifications, manuals, standard drawing and other information) enhance the consciousness of autonomous learning, Practice professional communication skills. Starting with students' cognition and understanding of urban gas, make them understand that the major of building environment and energy application engineering is practically related to people's living needs, further strengthen the cultivation of students' socialist values, and make them fully realize the arduousness and particularity of energy conservation and emission reduction. The courses mainly include indoor gas pipeline design of civil buildings, low-pressure gas transmission and distribution network design, etc. Students are required to have the ability to use hydraulic calculation software, engineering drawing, computer-aided design and calculation data analysis and processing to complete gas pipeline wiring scheme, gas pipeline hydraulic calculation, civil building indoor gas pipeline layout, and design specifications. The cumulative score for the comprehensive stage of course assessment, assessment, and final defense is a maximum of 100 points.

default.zh: 建筑环境方向： 课程设计-2是建筑环境方向的一门主干设计实践课。在培养学生建筑环境营造方面的综合方案设计能力、复杂工程问题研究能力、工程制图、计算机辅助设计和应用计算机进行数据处理及分析的能力，以及了解建筑环境与能源应用工程专业相关的政策、法律法规、标准有重要的地位。 城市能源方向： 为使学生更好的理解和运用《燃气燃烧与应用》及《城市燃气气源》的理论知识，解决工程中的实际问题，设置课程设计-2。增强学生消化和巩固课程的理论知识，培养运用所学知识进行工程设计的初步能力。通过课程设计了解工程设计的内容、方法和步骤，初步培养确定设计方案、设计计算、绘制图纸、使用技术资料及编写设计说明书的能力。设计内容主要包括燃气具设计和燃气场站设计。 本课程选择某多层宾馆的空调系统及冷源设计作为设计题目，将学生所学的通风空调和空调冷源课程专业知识相结合用于实际工程设计。内容涵盖空调负荷计算、不同方案比较和确定、空气处理过程及处理设备选择、气流组织方案及计算、风管道布置及水力计算、制冷设备选择及水系统水力计算、空调系统控制方案确定等；同时绘制空调系统的原理图、平面图、剖面图等，以培养学生的合方案设计能力、复杂工程问题研究能力、工程制图、计算机辅助设计和应用计算机进行数据处理及分析的能力。 课程考核包括设计过程的表现及出勤情况、阶段考察和最终答辩，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Building Environment: Course Project-2 is a compulsory main major design course for major of building environment and energy application engineering. The course plays an important role in training students' problem analysis ability, integrated program design capability, complex engineering problem research ability, and engineering drawing, computer aided design and computer data processing and analysis capabilities, and in making students understand the related policies, laws and regulations in the field of the building environment and energy application engineering. In this course, the air conditioning system and cold source design of a multi-storey hotel will be selected as the design topic, training the students’capacity for practical engineering design by combining the knowledge of ventilation and air conditioning with the professional knowledge of cold source of air-conditioning . The design includes air conditioning load calculation, schemes comparison and determination, air handling process and corresponding equipment selection, air distribution calculation, the wind pipeline layout and hydraulic calculation, refrigeration equipment selection and hydraulic calculation of water system, air conditioning system control, etc..And Furthermore, such engineering drawing as the principle of air conditioning system, floor plan and section, etc., will be designed and drawed. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The course assessment includes the performance and attendance of the design process, the stage check and final oral defense. The total score is 100 points. Urban Energy: In order to enable students to better understand and apply the theoretical knowledge of 《Gas Combustion and Application》and 《Urban Gas Source》, and solve the practical problems in the project, Course Project-2 is set up. Strengthen the students' ability to digest and consolidate the theoretical knowledge of the course, and cultivate their preliminary ability to apply the knowledge learned to engineering design. Understand the contents, methods and steps of engineering design through course design, and preliminarily cultivate the ability to determine design schemes, design calculations, draw drawings, use technical materials and prepare design instructions. The design content mainly includes gas appliance design and gas station design.

default.zh: 毕业实习是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业学生在完成所有专业课程学习后，毕业设计（论文）前进行的重要实践性教学环节，在培养学生工程设计能力方面占有重要的地位。 本实习采用集中与分散相结合的方式进行，即：可由专业教师为学生集中安排实习单位，也鼓励学生自主联系实习单位。实习单位主要为与学生毕业设计方向（供热、供燃气、空调）相符的设计院。课程的主要任务是通过在工程设计单位的规范学习、辅助计算、辅助设计和工地调研等实践环节，培养学生综合运用所学知识分析工程技术问题的初步能力，了解建筑环境与能源应用工程专业相关的政策、法律法规、标准，掌握工程设计计算和制图的基本知识，具备与同行进行专业交流、积极融入团队合作、撰写专业文稿和自主学习的素养，以快速适应社会坏境。
default.en: The graduation internship is a crucial practical teaching segment for students majoring in Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering. It takes place after students have completed all professional courses and before they start their graduation project (thesis), and holds a significant position in fostering students' engineering design capabilities. This internship is conducted through a combination of centralized and decentralized arrangements. Specifically, professional teachers can centrally assign internship units to students, and students are also encouraged to independently secure their own internship placements. The internship units are mainly design institutes that align with the students' graduation project directions, which include heating, gas supply, and air conditioning. The primary tasks of this internship course are as follows: through practical activities such as learning standard practices in engineering design units, assisting in calculations, supporting design work, and conducting construction site investigations, students will develop initial abilities to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze engineering and technical issues. They will also gain an understanding of policies, laws, regulations, and standards related to the Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering major, master the basic knowledge of engineering design calculations and drawing, and acquire literacy in professional communication with peers, active integration into teamwork, writing professional documents, and independent learning—all to facilitate their rapid adaptation to the social environment.

default.zh: 遥感技术是城乡规划学科本科生必备的空间数据分析技术之一。本课程基于遥感成像原理和遥感数据分析技术与城市地表信息特征挖掘任务相结合，基于开源遥感数据处理平台进行课程实验，遥感数据分析的过程和结果能够有力支撑城乡规划学专业的设计和研究。本课程主要讲授遥感类型、成像原理、开放平台遥感大数据的获取与分析技术。通过课题讲授和上机操作结合的方式，使学生初步掌握遥感数据分析的技巧。
default.en: Remote sensing technology is one of the necessary spatial data analysis technologies for undergraduates in urban and rural planning disciplines. This course is based on the combination of remote sensing imaging principles and remote sensing data analysis technology with urban surface information feature mining tasks, and conducts course experiments based on open source remote sensing data processing platform. The process and results of remote sensing data analysis can effectively support the design and research of urban and rural planning majors. This course mainly teaches remote sensing types, imaging principles, and the acquisition and analysis technology of open platform remote sensing big data. Through the combination of topic teaching and computer operation, students can initially master the skills of remote sensing data analysis. Course Objective 1: Improve students' ability to collect, analyze, process and express remote sensing data. Course Objective 2: In the context of the era of big data, broaden students' thinking about the processing and application of remote sensing big data and master the methods of spatial data analysis. Course Objective 3: Develop students' ideas for urban and rural planning, design and research through the study of advanced remote sensing data processing methods.

default.zh: 本课程是培养学生在观念上从建筑向城市视角转换的重要实践教学环节，其主要任务是使学生熟悉各类城市公共建筑的功能布局以及与城市规划相关的要求，包括用地、交通、空间形态、环境景观等，培养学生分析环境、理解环境、尊重环境的思维观念，培养现场测绘、观察、分析的能力。本课程设计鼓励同学主动观察与分析城市现象，敏锐涉及城市发展动态和前沿课题，发掘城市文化背景，并以全面、系统的专业素质去处理城市问题。
default.en: This course is an important practical teaching link to train students to transform their concepts from the perspective of architecture to the city. Its main task is to familiarize students with the functional layout of various urban public buildings and the requirements related to urban planning, including land use, transportation, spatial form, environmental landscape, etc., and cultivate students' thinking concepts of analyzing, understanding and respecting the environment. Cultivate the ability of field mapping, observation and analysis. This course design encourages students to actively observe and analyze urban phenomena, sensitively relate to urban development trends and cutting-edge topics, explore urban cultural background, and deal with urban problems with comprehensive and systematic professional quality.

default.zh: 本课程为实践课程，主要针对乡村问题进行调查研究。每年会选取一个国内乡村为调研对象，以国家政策方针导向为背景，结合现实情况拟定调研主题。四周的调研课程全程在调研基地进行。工作过程中，学生将有机会与当地的居民、政府机构进行全方位沟通，就乡村发展建设面临的生态保护、贫困、经济模式、生活质量、幸福感以及乡村场所塑造、风貌特色、历史文脉等议题进行充分的研究、分析与讨论，寻找问题的原因，并提出解决方案与建议。实地访谈以及问卷是本次课程所应用的基本调研方法。调研工作过程中，教师会对调研过程中主要使用的方法、理论进行讲解，并定期举行工作讨论会，以对学生的调研工作进行实时指导。 通过本课程学生应能得到如下收获： （1）对课堂所学的城乡调研方法加以实践运用；锻炼沟通能力，培养观察、思考和解决现实问题的能力。 （2）通过实地考察和分析，了解中国乡村与城市发展差异，了解中国乡村社会结构、社会问题，提升学生的社会责任感和使命感。 （3）掌握规范化调研告写作方式。 （4）培养团队协作能力与领导能力。
default.en: This course is a practical course, which focuses on rural issues. Each year, a domestic village is selected as the research object, and the national policy and policy guidance are taken as the background, and the research topics are formulated according to the actual situation. The survey courses are conducted throughout the research object. In the process of work, students will have the opportunity to work with local residents and government agencies to carry out a full range of communication on rural development, including ecological protection, poverty, economic, quality of life, happiness and rural places shaping, character, history and other issues. Those issues will be fully investigated, analyzed and discussed to figure out reasons for them, and to put forward solutions and suggestions. Field interviews and questionnaires are the basic methods used in this course. In the course of the investigation, the teacher will explain the main methods and theories used in the investigation process, and hold a job discussion regularly, so as to guide the students' research work in real time. Through this course, students should be able to get the following results: (1) apply the methods of urban and rural investigation learned in classroom; exercise the ability of communication, and cultivate the ability to observe, think and solve practical problems. (2) through on-the-spot investigation and analysis, to understand the differences between China's rural and urban development, to understand the social structure and social problems of China's rural areas, and to enhance their sense of social responsibility and mission. (3) master the style of standardized research report writing. (4) train team cooperation ability and leadership ability.

default.zh: 《植物实习》课程以城市公园绿地、城市广场绿地、城市住区绿地等典型城市绿地为例，实地讲授景观植物的形态、生物学特征和观赏特性，从而提高景观学专业本科生识别园林植物的能力，为《植物景观设计》课程中科学地应用植物创造园林景观打好基础。教学目标具体提如下：①了解哈尔滨市常见的园林树木、花卉、草坪与地被植物种类，其形态特点、观赏特征、生态习性；②了解哈尔滨市常见植物在园林绿化当中的应用形式。
default.en: Taking typical urban green spaces such as urban park green space, urban square green space and urban residential green space as examples, the course will teach the morphology, biological characteristics and ornamental characteristics of landscape plants on the spot, so as to improve the ability of undergraduates majoring in landscape science to identify landscape plants, and lay a good foundation for scientific application of plants to create landscape in the course of Plant Landscape Design. The teaching objectives are as follows: ① Learn about the common garden trees, flowers, lawns and ground cover plants in Harbin, their morphological characteristics, ornamental characteristics and ecological habits; ② Understand the application forms of common plants in landscape greening in Harbin.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向景观学专业的专业基础课程，具有综合性、社会性和技术性的特点，培养学生在综合考虑场地空间特性、自然生态环境和人文生态环境的基础上发现问题、分析问题的能力和素质。通过认知学习与实践训练，使学生掌握以下知识，具备下列能力： 1. 贯彻落实习总书记生态治国理念，有效引导树立生态先行的景观设计哲学观，“顺应自然规律、重视生态价值”、实现“可持续发展、永续发展”；结合实践教学环节，贯彻“绿色”生态文明教育，树立学生为社会服务、为家国服务、为人类谋求生态福祉的使命感和责任感。 2. 通过对一定尺度的实体空间进行体验与感知，运用专业知识进行空间环境认知的同时，加深对人文生态环境和自然生态环境的认知。课程将理论联系实际，加深学生对专业知识更全面、更立体的理解和掌握。认知过程采取小组合作制，并全面记录所用调研方法、调研内容和调研结果，并对学习过程进行自我评价和相互评价，进而反思重新建构自己对景观设计的理解。 3.通过课程增加学生对专业的感性认识，增强学生的兴趣；培养学生见微知著，关注人文生态环境和自然生态环境问题的意识；锻炼学生观察、分析和总结判断的能力；培养学生重视合作的能力；为深入专业学习和研究奠定更坚实的基础。
default.en: This course is a professional basic course for landscape science, which is comprehensive, social and technical. It aims to cultivate students' ability and quality to find and analyze problems on the basis of comprehensive consideration of space characteristics, natural ecological environment and human ecological environment. Through cognitive learning and practical training, students can master the following knowledge and have the following abilities: In combination with the practical teaching link, implement the "green" ecological civilization education, and establish the sense of mission and responsibility of students to serve the society, the family and the country, and the ecological well-being of mankind. 2. By experiencing and perceiving the physical space of a certain scale and using professional knowledge to recognize the space environment, we can deepen our understanding of the human ecological environment and the natural ecological environment. The course integrates theory with practice to deepen students' more comprehensive and three-dimensional understanding and grasp of professional knowledge. The cognitive process adopts the team cooperation system, and comprehensively records the research methods, research contents and research results used, and conducts self-evaluation and mutual evaluation of the learning process, so as to reflect and reconstruct their understanding of landscape design. 3. Increase students' perceptual knowledge of the major and enhance their interest through the curriculum; Cultivate the students' awareness of being insightful and paying attention to human and natural ecological environment problems; Train students' ability to observe, analyze and summarize; Cultivate students' ability to attach importance to cooperation; It will lay a solid foundation for further professional study and research.

default.zh: 本课程是一门主要面向本科三年级学生专业方向实习实践课程，其目的是在学生学完部分专业理论课程基础上，通过课程学习，结合其他课程安排与城市特色，进一步探索景观规划设计所面临的复杂知识系统及设计语汇。城市中的建筑类型、建筑群体、公共空间与绿地系统丰富多样，各种类型都有大量值得学习借鉴的案例。课程能够了解我国景观规划设计发展伟大成就，加强社会主义核心价值观培养，培养科学素养、社会责任感及职业素养，培养精益求精的大国工匠精神，增强文化自信。课程内容带领学生运用城市空间的认识方法感受空间的尺度、界定、时间与运动，感受其中的实体元素以及建筑族群组群的纹理和质地，熟悉常见城市空间的构成，如广场空间、街道空间、建筑外部空间等，掌握城市空间设计的手法；观察了解历史文化街区中的传统结构关系及要素，使学生掌握历史文化名城保护规划的内容、原则、方法，熟悉保护历史文化街区重点内容，掌握历史文化街区保护规划的内容、原则、方法；培养学生分析问题和进行绿色建筑技术综合集成设计的能力，能够理解和评价针对复杂工程问题的专业工程实践对环境、社会可持续发展影响的能力等。
default.en: This course is a professional practice course for junior undergraduate students. Its purpose is to further explore the complex knowledge system and design vocabulary of landscape planning and design by combining other course arrangements and urban characteristics on the basis of students' completion of some professional theoretical courses. Urban building types, building groups, public spaces and green space systems are rich and diverse, and there are plenty of cases worth learning from. The course can understand the great achievements of China's landscape planning and design development, strengthen the cultivation of socialist core values, cultivate scientific literacy, social responsibility and professional literacy, cultivate the spirit of excellence of great country craftsmen, and enhance cultural self-confidence. The course content guides students to use the understanding method of urban space to feel the scale, definition, time and movement of space, feel the physical elements and the texture and texture of architectural groups, get familiar with the composition of common urban space, such as square space, street space, building external space, etc., and master the methods of urban space design. Observe and understand the traditional structural relations and elements of historical and cultural blocks, so that students can master the content, principles and methods of the protection planning of historical and cultural cities, get familiar with the key contents of the protection of historical and cultural blocks, and master the content, principles and methods of the protection planning of historical and cultural blocks; Students are trained to analyze problems and conduct comprehensive and integrated design of green building technologies, and to understand and evaluate the impact of professional engineering practices on the environment and social sustainable development of complex engineering problems.

default.zh: 设计师业务实践是一门环境设计专业的实习实践课，是培养学生成为执业环境设计师和室内设计师等必不可少的实践性教学环节。课程以学生在设计院实习、并以执业设计师为指导教师的学习方式进行。环境设计专业的学生在完成全部专业课学习的基础上，通过在设计单位的实际工作，学生将对环境设计和室内设计等设计工作进行全面的了解与实践，提高专业知识的综合运用能力。通过设计师业务实践，参与方案设计、扩初设计、施工图设计和现场设计等各类设计工作。
default.en: Designer's business practice is a practical course for environmental design majors, and it is an essential practical teaching link to train students to become professional environmental designers and interior designers. The course is conducted in the way that students practice in design institutes and professional designers guide teachers. On the basis of completing all professional courses, students majoring in environmental design can comprehensively understand and practice environmental design, interior design and other design work through their actual work in the design unit, so as to improve the comprehensive application ability of professional knowledge. Through the designer's business practice, participate in various design work such as scheme design, preliminary design, construction drawing design and site design.

default.zh: 毕业设计是环境设计辅修专业本科课程中重要的实践教学环节，也是学生毕业及学位资格认证的重要依据。 课程目标1：要求学生能够综合运用所学的理论、知识和技能独立完成城市空间环境设计的实践工程项目，全面检验学生基础理论掌握的情况、技能的熟练程度以及分析和解决问题的能力。 课程目标2：要求学生巩固和加深所学专业知识，扩展交叉学科的专业知识，提高独立进行分析和完成实际规划项目的能力。
default.en: Graduation design is the last teaching link before undergraduate students finish their studies and go to the actual jobs in society. It is a comprehensive assessment to comprehensively apply basic knowledge, professional knowledge and relevant knowledge to solve practical problems, and an important process to cultivate students' ability to independently conduct environmental design and scientific research, including: 1. Ability of research, literature search and related data collection and rational analysis; 2. Ability to come up with creative solutions and make comparative arguments; 3. Ability to adequately and correctly express design proposals, write technical papers and design specifications.

default.zh: 通过本课程设计对所学动画课程进行总结，并使学生能够运用动漫创作的原理进行不同类型的动漫创作实践。
default.en: This course design summarizes the animation courses learned and enables students to apply the principles of animation creation to different types of animation creation practices.

default.zh: 网站与网络程序设计是高等工科院校中数字媒体类专业一门主干课程。在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行网络媒体技术与设计人员所需的基本训练。为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事网络程序设计工作打下基础。在培养学生网站系统综合设计能力、提高解决复杂网络程序设计问题的能力等方面占有重要地位。
default.en: Web site and Web programming is a major course in the digital media industry of higher engineering colleges. In the teaching process of comprehensive use of the prerequisite learned in the knowledge and skills, combined with a variety of practical teaching links, the network media technology and design staff required basic training. For students to further study the relevant professional courses and in the future to engage in network programming to lay the foundation. In the training of student website system design capabilities, improve the ability to solve complex network programming problems and other aspects of an important position.

default.zh: 使学生了解和掌握数字媒体创作过程的前、后期创意思维、基本原理及技法。通过参观、学习、部分参与数字媒体制作部门的实际工作，培养学生的创意思维与动手能力。印证、巩固和丰富已学过的专业课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在创作实际中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题及解决问题的能力。为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。同时为毕业设计(论文)积累资料。
default.en: Enable students to understand and master the digital media creation process of the Pre-and post-creative thinking, Basic Principles and Techniques. by visiting, learning and partially participating in the actual work of the digital media production department, students ' creative thinking and practical ability are cultivated. To confirm, consolidate and enrich the content of the professional courses that have been studied, to cultivate students ' theory and practice, and to improve their ability to investigate, observe, analyze and solve problems in the practice of Creation. For the follow-up professional courses to lay the foundation for Learning. At the same time for graduation design ( thesis ) to accumulate Information.

default.zh: 数字媒体业务实践是数字媒体专业的实习实践课程，是学生在校期间的最后一个实习。学生在已修完绝大部分课程背景下，根据本专业特点，在认识实习、创意实习的基础上，在实习指导教师或实习单位指导教师的安排下，参与相关项目，尝试将近四年所学习的数字媒体技术和艺术理论应用于实践，进行数字媒体作品创作与制作，全面检验自己所学的知识和技能，为将要进行的毕业设计并即将走上工作岗位打好基础。
default.en: Digital Media Practice is a digital media technology professional, radio and television (Digital Media Arts) professional internship practical courses which is the last practice during in school. Students who have completed most of the courses, according to the characteristics of the profession, are based on the understanding internships, creative practice. Under the internship instructor or instructor internship arrangements, they will participate in related projects, trying to the digital media technology and art theory into practice for digital media creation and production work with their nearly four years’ knowledge which will have a comprehensive test their learned knowledge and skills that will be carried out and will soon embark on graduate design work to lay the foundation.

default.zh: 本课程是智慧建筑与建造专业四年级的实践课程，是基于项目的学习计划的重要部分。具体形式是学生去指定设计单位进行为期6周的实习，并在这段期间内由指导教师与建筑设计院共同对学生进行联合培养。其主要目的是让学生在实际操作中，在对工作环境与业务范围的亲自感知中，去理解建筑师的职能体系，熟悉建筑工程设计全过程。同时，也是对前面所学专业课程进行总结，完善学生的知识结构，提高动手能力，并在各专业的配合中感受团队精神。
default.en: This course is a practice course for the senior students of grade 4 in the major of Intelligent Building and Construction. It is an important part of the study plan. The course is to let students have a 6-week internship in designated design firms. During the period, the tutor and the agency will train the students together. The main purpose is to aid students to understand architects' function system and the whole process of architecture design in the actual operation and the perception of working environment and business confines. Meanwhile it is a summary for the former courses and will consummate students' knowledge structure and improve their practice ability and experience the team spirit in the coordination of different specialized areas.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）课程的教学过程是实现本科培养目标的重要阶段，是在建筑师业务实践与施工图培训环节后由学校教师和设计院教师共同指导完成一次综合性与实践性并重的设计训练，是整个本科教学过程的一次综合性的总结，是本科学生走向社会参与实践的最后一课，是教学与工程实践接轨的重要环节，同时，也是学生毕业及学位资格认证的重要依据。 通过真实项目，设计院实践导师联合指导和实地踏勘、调研以及实验等教学方式，强化毕业设计的实践性，通过实践教学增强学生的独立工作能力和对建筑师职业的理解。掌握计算机辅助建筑设计（CAAD）、数字化设计以及建筑性能模拟的相关知识，能够使用专业软件完成设计图绘制、设计文件编制、设计过程分析、建筑形态表达等。掌握一定的虚拟仿真VR技术，能够利用虚拟仿真技术对建筑物、群，以及建筑设计的过程进行模拟，并能够针对模拟结果进行分析。 毕业论文（设计）课程的教学目标是全面提高学生建筑设计的综合能力，是培养学生综合运用所学的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能用于分析、解决工程技术、经济、社会等实际问题，使学生得到工程设计方法和科研能力训练。
default.en: The teaching process of graduation thesis (design) course is an important stage to realize the goal of undergraduate education, it is a comprehensive and practical design training under the guidance of school teachers and Design Institute teachers after the practice of architecture and construction drawing training, is a comprehensive summary of the whole undergraduate teaching process, is the last lesson for undergraduate students to participate in social practice, is an important link between teaching and engineering practice, at the same time, also is the student graduation and the degree qualification attestation important basis. Through the real project, the design institute practice tutor joint guidance and on-the-spot survey, research and experiment and other teaching methods, strengthen the graduation design practice, through the practice of teaching to enhance the ability of students to work independently and the professional understanding of architects. Knowledge of computer-aided building design (CAAD) , digital design and building performance simulation, can use professional software to complete the design drawing, design document preparation, design process analysis, architectural form expression, etc. . Master certain virtual simulation VR technology, can use virtual simulation technology to simulate buildings, groups, and the process of architectural design, and can analyze the simulation results. The teaching goal of graduation thesis (design) course is to improve students' comprehensive ability of architectural design, it is to train students to use the basic theories, knowledge and skills they have learned to analyze and solve practical problems in engineering, economy and society, to train students in engineering design methods and scientific research ability.

default.zh: 航天与自动化集群专业导论课程紧密围绕杰出人才培养目标，以人才培养供给侧改革为抓手，结合航天与自动化集群相关专业的发展趋势、专业特点、培养目标、研究内容及应用领域，通过飞行器设计与工程类专业知识、航天发展背后的自动化力量、复合材料与智能工程类专业知识、电子科学与技术专业知识、光学工程专业知识、微电子科学与技术专业知识、光学遥感卫星的高精度姿态控制导论、运载火箭及导弹系统发展概述、复合材料在飞机上的应用现状及发展趋势、光电子产业当前发展概况、空间相机研究里程及科研心得、集成电路技术痛点及未来发展趋势、学术大师版块、工程巨匠版块、业界领袖版块、治国栋梁版块等方面的主题式授课，凝练校内专业知识内容，拓展校外前沿知识讲解。使学生对航天与自动化集群相关专业的发展趋势、专业特点、培养目标、研究内容及应用领域等形成宏观认识，为后续开展专业知识学习奠定相关基础。
default.en: Introduction to Disciplines of Astronautics and Automation closely focuses on the training objectives of outstanding talents, takes the supply-side reform of talent training as the starting point, and combines the development trend, professional characteristics, training objectives, research content and application fields of aerospace and automation cluster related majors. Through the professional knowledge of aircraft design and engineering, the automation power behind aerospace development, the professional knowledge of composite materials and intelligent engineering, the professional knowledge of electronic science and technology, the professional knowledge of optical engineering, the professional knowledge of microelectronics science and technology, the introduction of high-precision attitude control of optical remote sensing satellites, the development overview of launch vehicles and missile systems, the application status and development trend of composite materials on aircraft, the current development overview of the optoelectronic industry, the research mileage and scientific research experience of space cameras, the pain points and future development trends of integrated circuit technology, the academic master section, the engineering master section, the industry leader section, and the governance pillar section. Condense the content of on-campus professional knowledge and expand the interpretation of off-campus frontier knowledge. It enables students to form a macro understanding of the development trend, professional characteristics, training objectives, research content and application fields of aerospace and automation cluster related majors, and lays a relevant foundation for subsequent professional knowledge learning.

default.zh: 理论力学是各门力学课程的基础，同时是一门对工程对象进行静力学、运动学与动力学分析的技术基础课，在诸多工程技术领域有着广泛的应用。本课程的任务是使学生掌握质点、质点系、刚体和刚体系机械运动（包括平衡）的基本规律和研究方法，为学习相关的后继课程以及将来学习和掌握新的科学技术打好必要的基础；使学生初步学会应用理论力学的理论和方法分析、解决一些简单的工程实际问题；通过本课程的教学，着重培养学生在理论建模、结构工程、动力学分析等方面的分析、设计和应用能力，并支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。同时结合本课程的特点，培养学生科学的思维方式和正确的世界观，培养学生的相关能力。
default.en: The course mainly expounds classical mechanics theory. This course consists of two volumes. Part 1 covers the content of statics(Including the free-body diagram,planar force systems and couple systems, etc.), kinematics(Including the kinematics of a particle, the simple motion of a rigid body,resultant motion of a particle,etc.), dynamics(Including the particle dynamics,theorems of linear momentum,angular momentum and kinetic energy of particle systems ). Part 2 covers analytical mechanics (Including the fundamental equations of dynamics, Lagrange's equations of the first and the second kind, etc.)and mechanics vibration.

default.zh: 理论力学是研究物体机械运动一般规律的科学，是工科大学生重要的技术基础课。理论力学内容包括：静力学（研究物体平衡问题）、运动学（研究物体运动的几何性质）、动力学（研究物体机械运动状态的变化与作用力之间的关系），这些属于矢量力学范畴。还讲述虚位移原理、达朗贝尔原理、动力学普遍方程与拉格朗日方程、定点运动、非惯性系中的动力学、碰撞、机械振动基础等专题内容。 通过本课程的学习学生应掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: Theoretical Mechanics A is a course studying the general rules of object’s mechanical motions. It’s a technical and basal curriculum and it’s important for engineering students. The contents of Theoretical Mechanics A involve: Statics (to study the balance of object), Kinematics (to study the geometry characteristic of object motion), Dynamics (to study the relation of object’s mechanical motion and forces on object), which belong to the vector mechanics category. It also involves: principle of virtual displacement, d’Alembert’s principles, general equations of dynamics and Lagrange’s equation, motion with a fixed point, dynamics of not inertia frame, impact, and mechanical vibration elements, etc. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of classical mechanics and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 理论力学是研究物体机械运动一般规律的科学，是工科大学生重要的技术基础课。理论力学内容包括：静力学（研究物体平衡问题）、运动学（研究物体运动的几何性质）、动力学（研究物体机械运动状态的变化与作用力之间的关系），这些属于矢量力学范畴。还讲述虚位移原理、达朗贝尔原理等专题内容，并可选择分析力学基础、碰撞理论、机械振动基础和自由刚体运动理论等专题内容来学习。 通过本课程的学习学生应掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: Theoretical Mechanics B is a course studying the general rules of object’s mechanical motions. It’s a technical and basal curriculum and it’s important for engineering students. The contents of Theoretical Mechanics C involve: Statics (to study the balance of object), Kinematics (to study the geometry characteristic of object motion), Dynamics (to study the relation of object’s mechanical motion and forces on object), which belong to the vector mechanics category. It also involves some special contents such as principle of virtual displacement, d’Alembert’s principles, etc. And you can also choose to study topics such as fundamentals of analytical mechanics, collision theory, fundamentals of mechanical vibration and theory of free rigid body motion. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of classical mechanics and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 理论力学是研究物体机械运动的基本规律的学科。力学的一个分支。它是一般力学各分支学科的基础。理论力学C主要研究内容由静力学、动静法以及杆件变形内力分析三部分组成。其中，静力学研究作用于物体上的力系的简化理论及力系平衡条件，是本门课程的核心内容。理论力学的研究方法是从一些由经验或实验归纳出反映客观规律的基本公理或定律出发，经过数学演绎得出物体机械运动在一般情况下的规律及具体问题中的特征。理论力学的研究对象主要指质点、刚体及刚体系。理论力学建立科学抽象的力学模型（如质点、刚体等）。理论力学的另一特点是广泛采用数学工具，进行数学演绎，从而导出各种以数学形式表达的普遍定理和结论。 理论力学涉及众多的力学学科分支和广泛的工程技术领域，是一门理论性较强、与工程技术联系极为密切的技术基础课。通过本课程学习应使学生掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些经典力学理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。通过课程学习，达到如下课程目标：掌握静力学公理与各类典型约束条件，掌握物体受力分析及受力图的正确表达；掌握各种力系的简化和平衡理论，并能利用这些理论来计算和求解工程结构中的力学问题，获得约束反力的解，并能够解决一定的工程实际问题；正确理解构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念，掌握不同类型内力图的表达方式，掌握外力、剪力及弯矩间的关系并加以应用；掌握动静法，利用达朗贝尔原理求解动力学问题。
default.en: Theoretical mechanics is the study of the basic laws of the mechanical motion of the subject, a branch of mechanic, and the basis of various branches of General mechanics. The main research contents of Theoretical mechanics C are composed of Static mechanics, Dynamic and static method and the Internal force analysis of rod deformation. The Static mechanics studies the simplified theory of the force system acting on an object and the balance condition of the force system, which is the core content of this course. The research method of theoretical mechanics is based on some basic axioms or laws summarized by experience or experiment that reflect the objective facts. The patterns of the mechanical motion of the object under normal circumstances and its characteristics in specific problems are obtained through mathematical deduction. The research objects in Theoretical mechanics mainly refer to scientific and reasonable abstract mechanics models, including mass points, rigid bodies and rigid systems. Another feature of Theoretical mechanics is the various universal theorems and conclusions expressed in mathematical form deriving from the extensive use of mathematical tools and mathematical deductions. Theoretical mechanics involves many branches of mechanics and a wide range of engineering and technical fields. It is a basic theoretical course that is closely connected with engineering technology. The teaching of this course should enable students to master the basic theories and methods of Classical mechanics, and be good at applying these theories and methods to solve practical engineering problems, and lay the foundations for the follow-up courses. By learning this course, students should meet the following objectives: mastering the Static axioms, a variety of typical constraints, the force analysis of an object, and the correct expression of the force diagram; mastering the simplification and balance theories of various force systems, being able to apply these theories on engineering structures to calculate and solve mechanical problems and obtain the solutions of constrained reaction forces, and being able to solve certain practical engineering problems; correctly understanding the basic concepts of strength, stiffness and stability of the components, mastering the expression of different types of internal force diagrams, and understanding and being able to use the relationship between external forces, shear forces and bending moments; mastering the Dynamic and static method and being able to use the D'Alembert’s principle to solve the dynamic problems.

default.zh: 材料力学是工程力学专业重要的基础课，也是航天、交通、 土木、机械、能源等院系工科大学生重要的技术基础课程,是学习其他各类工科专业课程如结构力学、弹性力学、飞行器设计等课程的基础。这门课既是变形体力学的基础，也是工程结构应力变形分析和强度设计的基础。本课程讲授变形固体中应力应变的概念、构件在载荷作用下的变形和应力计算方法，以及构件的力学设计思想。要求学生牢固掌握构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念、基本理论和分析的基本方法；理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程在求解力学问题时的重要作用以及变形体力学的叠加原理、能量原理；熟练运用基本理论计算杆件的应力与变形，获得分析强度、刚度与稳定性的能力。
default.en: Material mechanics is an important basic course in the field of engineering mechanics, and also an important technical course for students majoring in aerospace, transportation, civil engineering, machinery, energy, and other engineering disciplines. It is a foundation course for studying other engineering courses such as structural mechanics, elasticity mechanics, aircraft design, etc. This course is not only the basis of deformation mechanics, but also the basis of stress and deformation analysis and strength design of engineering structures. This course teaches the concepts of stress and strain in deformed solids, as well as the methods for calculating deformation and stress in components under loading, and the mechanical design principles of components. Students are required to master the basic concepts, basic theories, and basic methods of analysis for components' strength, stiffness, stability, etc., and to be proficient in calculating the stress and deformation of bars using basic theories to develop the ability to analyze strength, stiffness and stability.

default.zh: 通过本课程学习，要求学生牢固掌握构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念、基本理论和分析的基本方法；深刻理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程在求解力学问题时的重要作用以及叠加原理、能量原理等这些变形体力学中的基本原理；熟练地运用基本理论计算杆件的应力与变形以及分析其强度、刚度与稳定性的能力。结合单独设课的实验课教学，使学生掌握材料力学性能、基本力学量的测试以及实验应力分析的原理、方法，培养学生的实践动手能力和创新能力。
default.en: This course aims to help engineering students to grasp the basics about structural members and their strength, stiffness and stability. At the end of this course, students should be able to apply the equilibrium conditions, geometric relations and material constitutive relations to solve practical engineering problems involving stress and strain analysis in elementary structural members, such as bars and beams. Issues on strength, stiffness and stability of structures should also be understood correctly to guide practical design. Some lab work will be arranged independently for a better understanding of the topics covered in the class, and to cultivate the creative and comprehensive experimental skills.

default.zh: 本课程是小学时（32学时）的材料力学课程，适用于非力学专业的本科生学习。通过本课程学习，使学生能够牢固掌握构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念，了解基本强度理论，掌握内力、应力、应变、变形等基本计算分析方法；深刻理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程在求解力学问题时的重要作用，以及叠加原理、切应力互等定理的应用；熟练地运用基本理论计算杆件的应力与变形，根据强度、刚度及稳定性条件能够对杆件进行强度、刚度和稳定性校核、截面设计及许可载荷确定。学生学习材料力学课程之后，需达到的基本要求如下：（1）对材料力学的基本概念和基本分析方法有明确的认识。（2）具有将一般杆类构件简化为力学模型和进行强度、刚度与稳定性分析计算的能力。（3）对应力状态分析与应变状态分析理论有深入的理解并会分析压杆的稳定性。（4）对于常用材料的力学性质及其测试方法有较明确的认识。
default.en: This curriculum is a short-period (32 credit hours) material mechanics course, which is suitable for the undergraduate student not majoring in mechanics. Through the study of this curriculum, students can firmly grasp several basic concepts, such as the strength, stiffness, stability, etc., understand the basic strength theory like Maximum Stress Theory, Maximum Strain Theory, etc., and master the scientific calculation and analysis methods of the internal force, stress, strain, deformation and so on. Simultaneously, students can profoundly understand the important role of the equilibrium, geometry and physics equations in solving the mechanical problems, as well as the application of Saint-Venant principle, Superposition Principle, Shear Stress Reciprocal Theorem, etc. Moreover, students can skillfully use the basic theory to calculate the stress and deformation of the rod, check the strength, stiffness and stability of the rod, design the geometry of the section and the allowable load according to the strength, stiffness and stability conditions. After learning material mechanics, students need to satisfy the following basic requirements: (1) Have a clear understanding of the basic concepts, basic analysis methods, mechanical property and its test method of common materials. (2) Have a deep understanding of the stress (strain) state analysis and the strength theory, and an appropriate theory can be selected to the analysis and calculation of the strength, stiffness and stabilization of the bar components. (3) As for an intricate engineering issue, the general bar components can be simplified into an appropriate mechanical model for the material mechanical analysis, and the structural optimization design scheme of the components can be given according to the actual engineering needs and the premise of meeting the mechanical properties requirements.

default.zh: 本课程是小学时（32学时）的材料力学课程，适用于非力学专业的本科生学习。通过本课程学习，使学生能够牢固掌握构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念，了解最大应力理论、最大应变理论等基本强度理论，掌握内力、应力、应变、变形等物理量的科学分析方法；深刻理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程在求解力学问题时的重要作用，以及圣维南原理、叠加原理、切应力互等定理等在材料力学分析中的应用；熟练地运用基本理论计算杆件的应力与变形，根据强度、刚度及稳定性条件对杆件进行强度、刚度和稳定性校核、截面设计及许可载荷确定。学生学习材料力学课程之后，需达到的基本要求如下：（1）对材料力学的基本概念及分析方法、常用材料的力学性质及其测试方法有明确的认识。（2）对应力（应变）状态分析与强度理论有深入的理解，针对构件的强度、刚度与稳定性问题能够选择合适的理论进行分析计算。（3）对于复杂工程问题，能够将一般杆类构件简化为对应的力学模型进行材料力学分析，并且能够根据工程实际需求，在满足力学性能要求的前提下，给出构件的结构优化设计方案。

default.zh: 工程力学涉及众多的力学学科分支和广泛的工程技术领域，是一门理论性较强、与工程技术联系极为密切的技术基础课。本课程涵盖了“理论力学”和“材料力学”的主要内容，其中理论力学主要以静力学部分为主，适用于工科非机类及相关专业。 本课程内容主要包括静力学基础、汇交力系、力矩与力偶、任意力系、摩擦、点及刚体的运动、动静法、内力及内力图、应力计算及强度条件、变形计算与刚度条件、组合变形和压杆稳定等内容。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，要求学生准确掌握静力学基本公理，能够完成物体（或物体系）的受力分析，掌握任意力学简化与平衡问题求解方法；正确理解构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念；能计算杆件的应力与变形以及分析其强度、刚度与稳定性；并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: Engineering mechanics A involves many branches of mechanics and a wide range of engineering and technical fields. It is a technical basic course which is highly theoretical and closely related to engineering technology. This course covers the main contents of "theoretical mechanics" and "material mechanics", in which the theoretical mechanics mainly focuses on statics, and applies to the non-mechanical and related majors of engineering. The course content mainly includes the basis of statics, concurrent system of force, torque and couple, arbitrary force system, friction, point and rigid body motion, dynamic-static method, internal force and internal force diagram, stress calculation and strength conditions, deformation calculation and stiffness condition, combined deformation and stability of column, etc. Through learning this course, make the students master the basic theories and methods of classical mechanics, accurately grasp the statics basic axioms, complete the object (or system) force analysis, master arbitrary force system simplification and balance problem solving method; The basic concepts of strength, rigidity and stability of the components are correctly understood. The stress and deformation of the rod are calculated and its strength, stiffness and stability are analyzed. And be good at applying these theories and methods to solve engineering practical problems, as well as laying the foundation for subsequent courses.
