The stress and deformation of the rod are calculated and its strength, stiffness and stability are analyzed. And be good at applying these theories and methods to solve engineering practical problems, as well as laying the foundation for subsequent courses.

default.zh: 自动控制原理C课程面向非控制类专业，如通信专业的本科生开课，是一门重要的选修课程，也是学生拓宽专业领域的基础课程之一。课程主要讲授自动控制系统的组成及其分析、设计中的基本理论，使学生熟悉各类控制系统数学模型以及时域、频域系统性能指标，掌握应用频域法分析和综合线性系统的基本原理和方法，并对现代控制理论的基本理论有一定了解。本课程重点培养学生掌握自动控制系统的构成原理和各元部件的作用，自动控制系统的基本分析方法和理论，对自动控制系统进行测试和评价的方法，使学生对本学科领域的自动控制系统能够进行维护、调整，并提出改进方案。 课程主要包括概述、控制系统的数学模型、时域分析方法、频率特性法及状态空间法。学生还需要独立完成三个实验并撰写实验报告。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时成绩、作业和实验四部分。
default.en: The course of Automatic Control Theory C is an important elective course for undergraduate students of non-controlling majors, such as communication major. It is also one of the basic courses for students to broaden their professional fields. The course is mainly about the composition and analysis of the automatic control system and the basic theory in the design. Through learning this course, students could understand the composition and basic theory of automatic control system, master all kinds of time-domain and frequency domain mathematical models of control system as well as the system performance indicators, grasp the basic principles and methods of using the frequency domain method for the analysis and synthesis of linear systems, and learn some of the basic theories of modern control. This course focuses on training students to master the constitute principle of automatic control system and the effect of each element, the basic analysis method and theory for automatic control system, the method of testing and evaluating automatic control system, as well as the abilities in maintenance, adjustment, and improvement for automatic control system on the field of related disciplines. The course includes the overview, the mathematical model of the control system, the time-domain analysis method, the frequency characteristic method and the state space method. Students also need to complete three experiments independently and write experimental reports. The examination results of this course are cumulative, including four parts: the final written examination, the daily performance, assignments and experiments.

default.zh: 自动控制原理D是面向非控制类专业本科生的专业基础课，课程将通过32学时的课堂授课，讲述自动控制的基本概念、线性控制系统的数学模型、多种（时域与频域，古典与现代）分析方法，以及经典的校正方法、现代的极点配置方法等主要内容。课程旨在为学生建立系统大局观和控制方法论，对培养学生形成正确的科研思想、锻炼理论与实践相结合能力具有重要作用。 本课程以理论教学为主，考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时成绩、作业三部分。
default.en: Automatic Control Theory D is a basic professional course for non-control undergraduates. The course will introduce the basic concepts of automatic control, mathematical models of linear control systems, various analysis methods (time domain and frequency domain, classical and modern), classical correction methods, modern pole assignment methods and other main contents through 32 class hours of classroom teaching. The course aims to establish a systematic overall view and control methodology for students, which plays an important role in training students to form correct scientific research thoughts and exercise their ability to combine theory and practice. This course is based on theoretical teaching, and the exam results are cumulative, including the final written test, the usual results, and the homework three parts.

default.zh: 《系统与控制》是面向电类专业本科生的一门核心基础课程，具有理论性强、应用发展快、教学难度大等特点，对培养学生形成科研系统观、锻炼理论与实践相结合能力具有重要作用。本课程涵盖古典控制理论和现代控制理论的核心内容，沿着系统建模、分析与综合的整体脉络，具体包括自动控制的基本概念、线性控制系统的数学模型、多种（时域与频域，古典与现代）分析方法，以及经典的PID控制、系统校正、极点配置等系统综合方法。 本课程理论教学与上机教学相结合，学生需要完成8学时的上机并撰写仿真报告。课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、翻转课堂、实验报告和作业四部分。
default.en: System and control，with the characteristics of deep theory, rapid application update and great teaching difficulty, etc, is the core curriculum for undergraduates in electric and automation majors, which also plays an important role in cultivating systematic scientific research views and the ability of combining theory and practice. This curriculum is mainly composed of classic control theory and modern control theory, from system modelling, analysis and synthesis, including elementary principles of automatic control, methods of automatic control system analysis (time/frequency-domain analysis, classical/modern analysis) and methods of system synthesis such as PID control, system compensation, pole assignment and so on. This course combines theory teaching with computer simulation together. Students also need to complete 8 credit hours of computer simulation independently and write simulation report. The course examination results are cumulative, including final examination, inverted classroom, experiment reports and homework.

default.zh: 航天器与智能自主系统认知将传统航天理论与新兴智能理论想结合，本课程是小卫星班航天器与智能自主系统系列课程之一，该 “贯通式”课程将从大一持续到大三，以“航天器与自主智能系统项目”驱动，学生完成认知、设计、加工制造、装配与调试、环境感知、自主智能控制、集群系统协同等全过程的学习实践。本课程以智能四足探测器为学习对象，通过对其设计、分析和控制方法进行学习，逐渐加深对航天器系统设计、动力学分析、运动规划及控制等内容的理解和掌握。本课程设计有智能四足探测器的虚拟样机联合仿真和组装调试实践等内容，对理论内容进行巩固，加强实践能力。课程主要讲解内容包括：航天器与智能自主系统认知概述；关节设计与运动原理；链式机构设计与运动原理；树型机构设计与运动原理；航天器与智能自主系统总体方案；航天器与智能自主系统运动学建模；航天器与智能自主系统运动学求解与验证；航天器与智能自主系统运动轨迹规划；航天器与智能自主系统虚拟样机仿真；航天器与智能自主系统实践验证等内容。
default.en: The cognition of spacecraft and intelligent autonomous systems combines traditional aerospace theory with emerging intelligence theory. This course is one of the series of courses on spacecraft and intelligent autonomous systems in the small satellite class. The "through type" course will continue from freshman to junior year, driven by the "spacecraft and autonomous intelligent system project". Students will complete cognition, design, manufacturing, assembly and debugging, environmental perception, autonomous intelligent control Learning and practice throughout the entire process of cluster system collaboration. This course takes intelligent quadruped detectors as the learning object, gradually deepening the understanding and mastery of spacecraft system design, dynamic analysis, motion planning and control through learning their design, analysis, and control methods. This course is designed with virtual prototype joint simulation and assembly debugging practice of intelligent quadruped detectors, which consolidates theoretical content and strengthens practical abilities. The main content of the course includes: an overview of spacecraft and intelligent autonomous system cognition; Joint design and motion principles; Chain mechanism design and motion principle; Tree type mechanism design and motion principle; Overall plan for spacecraft and intelligent autonomous systems; Kinematic modeling of spacecraft and intelligent autonomous systems; Kinematic solution and verification of spacecraft and intelligent autonomous systems; Motion trajectory planning for spacecraft and intelligent autonomous systems; Virtual prototype simulation of spacecraft and intelligent autonomous systems; Practical verification of spacecraft and intelligent autonomous systems.

default.zh: 《工程力学实验》是学生由基础课程转为技术基础课程学习的重要教学环节，既承载基础力学实验教学功能，以加深理解力学基本理论，又旨在加强工科学生基本力学科学实验素质和创新能力的培养。《工程力学实验》课程学习可使学生利用实验手段观察力学实验现象，探索力学实验规律，训练力学实验基本技能，培养力学科学实验素养，为解决工程实际力学问题奠定良好的力学实验基础。 《工程力学实验》围绕理论力学、材料力学两门理论教学的主要内容，并结合诸如结构动力学、实验力学等相关的课程，对传统的力学实验加以完善和补充而构成的一门独立课程。《工程力学实验》实验内容分三个层次（基本实验、综合性实验、研究性和设计性实验），综合性实验、研究性实验项目占总实验项目比例近60%。这些实验强调学生实验的自主性、启发性和研究性，注重学生实验素养和创新能力的培养。学生根据这些实验项目的性质，综合运用所学知识，自已设计实验方案，自主独立完成实验。
default.en: EXPERIMENTS IN ENGINEERING MECHANICS is an independent course which includes the mechanical experiments covering the theoretical courses such as Mechanics of Materials, Theoretical Mechanics, Experimental Mechanics, as well as Structural Dynamics. It is beneficial to the undergraduates from schools of Electrical and Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Materials Science, Astronautical Engineering, civil Engineering and Transportation Engineering. The experiments list provided for each school are customized according their own characteristics and training purpose. All experiments are opening experiments which can be pre-booked in advanced through internet. The experiments can be divided into three groups, basic experiments, comprehensive experiments and designing experiments. The total number of comprehensive experiments and designing experiments is nearly 60% of all items. These experiments are illuminating and focus on training the students’ independence and research abilities. By considering the experimental requirements and using the related theoretical knowledge, the students should design the experimental program and complete it independently EXPERIMENTS IN ENGINEERING MECHANICS can not only fulfill the teaching of basic mechanical experiments but also help the students to make a thorough understanding about the basic theories in mechanics. In addition, through this course, both the basic scientific qualities and the creative thinking abilities of the students will be initiated and enlarged. Through this course, the students will not only be capable of observing the mechanical phenomenon, but also will be trained with advanced experimental techniques. This will help them to be qualified in solving problems coming from the practical engineering.

default.en: It mainly introduces the frontier development direction and practical application of mechanics, materials and aircraft design

default.zh: 理论力学D是研究物体机械运动一般规律的科学，是自动化类工科大学生重要的技术基础课。本课程为32学时，主要讲授质点和刚体的运动学和动力学理论，包括点的运动学和刚体的简单运动和平面运动理论等运动学知识，此外还讲授动量定理、动量矩定理和刚体平面运动微分方程等动力学理论。通过本课程的学习应使学生掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: Theoretical Mechanics D is a course studying the general rules of object's mechanical motions. It’s a technical and basal curriculum and it’s important for engineering students. This course lasts for 32 hours. The contents of Theoretical Mechanics E involve: Kinematics (to study the geometry characteristic of moving objects), Dynamics (to study the relation of object’s mechanical motion and forces on object), which belong to the vector mechanics category. Through the study of this course, students should master the basic theories and basic methods of classical mechanics, and be good at applying these theories and methods to solve practical engineering problems, while laying the foundation for subsequent courses.

default.zh: 通过本课程学习，要求学生牢固掌握构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念、基本理论和分析的基本方法；深刻理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程在求解力学问题时的重要作用以及叠加原理、能量原理等这些变形体力学中的基本原理；熟练地运用基本理论计算杆件的应力与变形以及分析其强度、刚度与稳定性的能力。结合单独设课的实验课教学，使学生掌握材料力学性能、基本力学量的测试以及实验应力分析的原理、方法，培养学生的实践动手能力和创新能力。
default.en: This course aims to help engineering students to grasp the basics about structural members and their strength, stiffness and stability. At the end of this course, students should be able to apply the equilibrium conditions, geometric relations and material constitutive relations to solve practical engineering problems involving stress and strain analysis in elementary structural members, such as bars and beams. Issues on strength, stiffness and stability of structures should also be understood correctly to guide practical design. Some lab work will be arranged independently for a better understanding of the topics covered in the class, and to cultivate the creative and comprehensive experimental skills.

default.en: It mainly introduces the frontier development direction and practical application of mechanics, materials and aircraft design.

default.en: It mainly introduces the frontier development direction and practical application of mechanics, materials and aircraft design.

default.zh: 理论力学是研究物体机械运动一般规律的科学，是工科大学生重要的技术基础课。理论力学内容包括：静力学（研究物体平衡问题）、运动学（研究物体运动的几何性质）、动力学（研究物体机械运动状态的变化与作用力之间的关系），这些属于矢量力学范畴。还讲述虚位移原理、达朗贝尔原理等专题内容，并可选择分析力学基础、碰撞理论、机械振动基础和自由刚体运动理论等专题内容来学习。 通过本课程的学习学生应掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: Theoretical Mechanics F is a course studying the general rules of object’s mechanical motions. It’s a technical and basal curriculum and it’s important for engineering students. The contents of Theoretical Mechanics C involve: Statics (to study the balance of object), Kinematics (to study the geometry characteristic of object motion), Dynamics (to study the relation of object’s mechanical motion and forces on object), which belong to the vector mechanics category. It also involves some special contents such as principle of virtual displacement, d’Alembert’s principles, etc. And you can also choose to study topics such as fundamentals of analytical mechanics, collision theory, fundamentals of mechanical vibration and theory of free rigid body motion. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of classical mechanics and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 通过本课程学习，要求学生牢固掌握构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念、基本理论和分析的基本方法；深刻理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程在求解力学问题时的重要作用以及叠加原理、能量原理等这些变形体力学中的基本原理；熟练地运用基本理论计算杆件的应力与变形以及分析其强度、刚度与稳定性的能力。结合单独设课的实验课教学，使学生掌握材料力学性能、基本力学量的测试以及实验应力分析的原理、方法，培养学生的实践动手能力和创新能力。vvv
default.en: This course aims to help engineering students to grasp the basics about structural members and their strength, stiffness and stability. At the end of this course, students should be able to apply the equilibrium conditions, geometric relations and material constitutive relations to solve practical engineering problems involving stress and strain analysis in elementary structural members, such as bars and beams. Issues on strength, stiffness and stability of structures should also be understood correctly to guide practical design. Some lab work will be arranged independently for a better understanding of the topics covered in the class, and to cultivate the creative and comprehensive experimental skills.

default.zh: 现代控制多以数字控制器为主，而单片机（MicroController Unit; MCU）是数字控制器的核心单元，也是嵌入式系统应用的基础。掌握单片机原理、程序设计及应用，是实现自动控制系统的必要途径。 课程以现今流行的STM32单片机为讲解对象，从解决实际系统控制的问题出发，讲解系统控制中所涉及的单片机编程技术，包括各类初始化、各类中断处理、定时器、PWM（Pulse Width Modulation）输出/输入、DMA（Direct Memory Access）、I2C、USART等。同时，课程运用这些技术，帮助学生完成一个实际系统的控制，并结合课程实验引领学生自行编程完成控制律。 课程在自动控制原理和自动控制实践开课前，可作为学生前期能力培养的有效途径，为学生真正实现一个自动控制系统奠定基础。
default.en: Modern control mainly adopts digital controller, and MCU (MicroController Unit) is the key element of digital controllers, as well as the foundation of embedded systems. Mastering MCU theory, programming and application, is the necessary way for implementing automation control systems. The lecture uses the most popular MCU – STM32 as the target chip, aims to resolve practical system control problems, and explains the involved MCU programming techniques, which contain initializations, interrupt handling, timer, PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) output/input, DMA (Direct Memory Access), I2C, USART etc. Meanwhile, the lecture utilizes these techniques to help students realize a real system’s control, and leads the students to program the control law themselves by the lecture experiments. Before the lectures of automation control theory and automation control practice, this lecture is the efficient way to train the student’s earlier ability, and builds the foundation of allowing students to implement a real automation control system.

default.zh: 随着人工智能技术的发展和成熟，控制系统已经从全人工/半人工控制系统逐渐过渡到全自动智能化系统，其中，信号的智能检测与处理的知识体系是不可或缺的。智能检测与信号处理基础课程作为智能无人系统辅修专业的必修课，主要为对智能无人系统感兴趣的本科生开设。本课程为智能检测与信号处理基础课程的第一部分，主要讲授数字信号处理和智能信号处理的基本理论和方法，为信号的智能感知打下坚实的基础。本课程的主要内容分为离散信号及系统的时域分析方法、变换域分析方法以及时域离散系统的设计方法两大部分。时域分析方法主要包括典型序列及其表示和运算、系统的时域表示和时域特性分析，线性常系数差分方程的求解，信号的采样及重建等；变换域分析方法主要包括离散时间傅立叶变换（DTFT），周期序列的傅立叶级数（DFS），离散傅立叶变换（DFT）及快速傅立叶变换算法（FFT）；离散系统的设计部分包括数字滤波器的结构、无限冲激响应（IIR）和有限冲激响应（FIR）滤波器的设计方法。此外，本课程将结合实际系统，介绍数字信号处理理论的应用实例。由于数字信号处理的基本理论涉及到很多抽象的数学推导过程，为了使学生对理论知识有更具象的了解，本课程还将结合MWorks软件在课堂上做图形及动画演示，介绍使用MWorks软件进行简单数字信号处理的方法。
default.en: As the development and maturity of artificial intelligence technology, the control system has gradually transitioned from a full artificial/semi-artificial control system to a fully automatic intelligent system, in which the knowledge system of intelligent signal detection and processing is indispensable. As a required course for artificial intelligent systems, the course of intelligent signal detection and processing is mainly for undergraduates who are interested in these systems. This course is the basics of the course of intelligent signal detection and processing. It mainly contains the basic theories and methods of digital signal processing and intelligent signal processing, laying a solid foundation for the intelligent perception of signals. The main contents of this course can be divided into two parts: the method of time-domain analysis and transform-domain analysis of discrete signal and system; the designing method of discrete system. The time-domain analysis method mainly includes the analysis of typical sequences and their time-domain representation and operation; the time-domain representation and characteristics of systems; the solution of linear constant coefficient difference equation; the sampling and reconstruction theory of signal, etc. The transform domain analysis methods mainly include the discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT), the discrete Fourier series (DFS), the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) and the fast Fourier transform algorithm (FFT); the design of the discrete system including the structure of digital filter; the designing methods of infinite impulse response (IIR) and finite impulse response (FIR) filter. In addition, the application of digital signal processing theory in the actual system will be introduced. The basic theory of digital signal processing involves many abstract mathematical derivations, in order to enable the students to have a more concrete understanding of theoretical knowledge, this course also introduces MWorks software to demonstrate graphics and animation, and the methods of simple digital signal processing using MWorks software.

default.zh: 《智能信号检测与处理（2）》课程主要讲授信号检测的基本概念、智能检测系统的设计方法、信号数据的获取、转换与预处理方法、信号的智能检测与分析方法。以信号-信号数据获取-信号特征分析-信号智能检测处理为主线，始终围绕着“对实际中的信号进行检测”的核心理念开展教学，并结合信号与检测的工程应用问题进行讲解。 课程主要包括：智能信号检测技术的概述与研究内容、检测系统的基本设计方法、信号采集与误差处理、信号的转换与预处理、信号的基本特征分析方法、信号的智能检测与分析方法以及相关的实验部分。课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括作业、实验、研究设计和期末考试。
default.en: Intelligent Signal Detection and Processing (2) mainly teaches the basic concepts of signal detection, the design methods of intelligent detection systems, the acquisition, conversion, and preprocessing methods of signal data, and the intelligent detection and analysis methods of signals. The main line of the course is “signal - signal data acquisition - signal feature analysis - signal intelligent detection and processing”, the core idea of teaching is “detecting the actual signal in practice”, and the course is also explained with the engineering application of signal detection. The course mainly includes: the overview of intelligent signal detection technology, the basic design method of detection system, signal acquisition and error processing, signal conversion and processing, signal characteristic analysis method, the methods of signal intelligent detection and analysis, and the related experiments. The course examination results are cumulative, including assignments, experiment, research design and final exams.

default.zh: 这是一门培养科学兴趣和提升科学能力素养的课程。通过力学各方向科研教师介绍目前承担的航天领域相关科研工作，使学生们了解航天专业技术发展过程中遇到的问题以及解决方案；促进学生的科研思考能力和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This is a course that cultivates scientific interest and enhances scientific literacy. By introducing the current research work in the aerospace field undertaken by teachers in various fields of mechanics, students can understand the problems encountered in the development of aerospace technology and their solutions; Promote students' scientific research thinking and problem-solving abilities.

The contents of Theoretical Mechanics C involve: Statics (to study the balance of object), Kinematics (to study the geometry characteristic of object motion), Dynamics (to study the relation of object’s mechanical motion and forces on object), which belong to the vector mechanics category. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of classical mechanics and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 通过本课程学习，要求学生牢固掌握构件的变形的基本概念、基本理论和分析的基本方法；深刻理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程在求解力学问题时的重要作用以及叠加原理等这些变形体力学中的基本原理；熟练地运用基本理论计算杆件的应力与变形以及分析其强度能力。结合单独设课的实验课教学，使学生掌握材料力学性能、基本力学量的测试以及实验应力分析的原理、方法，培养学生的实践动手能力和创新能力。
default.en: This course aims to help engineering students to grasp the basics about structural members. At the end of this course, students should be able to apply the equilibrium conditions, geometric relations and material constitutive relations to solve practical engineering problems involving stress and strain analysis in elementary structural members, such as bars and beams. Issues on strength of structures should also be understood correctly to guide practical design. Some lab work will be arranged independently for a better understanding of the topics covered in the class, and to cultivate the creative and comprehensive experimental skills.This course aims to help engineering students to grasp the basics about structural members. default.zh: 本课程的目的是使学生对经典力学及其在当代的发展情况有一个系统的理解，这要求学生已经完成理论力学的基础课程。 第一部分：讨论刚体定点运动动力学问题，包括欧拉形式和拉格朗日形式的积分。并举例讨论刚体的一般运动。 第二部分：介绍拉格朗日力学的一些基本概念，包括动力学基本方程、拉格朗日方程及其初积分。 第三部分：作为分析力学的延续，学习哈密顿原理、高斯原理等。通过本课程的学习学生应掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: The object of this course is to impart a systematic undersdanding of the classical mechanics and its modern development for students, who finished the study of fundamental course of theoretical mechanics. Part 1 discusses the kinematics and dynamics of rigid body about a fixed point, including the integral cases of Euler and Lagrange. The general motion of a rigid body is discussed by example. Part 2 introduces the basic concepts of Lagrangain mechanics, including the general equations of dynamics, Lagrange equations and its first integrals. Part 3: As a continuation of analytical mechanics, learn Hamiltonian principles, Gaussian principles, etc.

default.zh: 弹性力学是研究弹性体由于受外力或温度改变等原因而发生的应力、形变和位移。是校核物体及结构是否具有所需的强度和刚度，并寻求改进它们的计算方法。它是对复杂、大型工程结构进行严密和精确的强度、刚度和稳定性分析必备的基础理论，是塑性力学、断裂力学、有限元、结构优化设计等力学专业课的先修课程，相较于材料力学能给出更加精确的解答。对于毕业设计阶段乃至后续学习和工作中解决航空航天、土木、机械、能源、交通等各领域中更复杂的相关力学问题（如弹性动力学、非线性弹性体、粘弹性体、各向异性和非均匀弹性体力学、热弹性、水弹性和气动弹性力学等）也是必不可少的前提。 本课程主要讲授弹性力学中的基本概念、基本方程及弹性力学分析问题的一些基本方法。通过本课程的教学，着重培养学生对平面和空间弹性体的应力、应变和位移进行数学建模，方程求解等方面的综合能力。进一步，应使学生掌握弹性力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Elasticity studies the stress, deformation and displacement of an elastic body due to external force or temperature change. It is to check whether the materials and structure have the required strength and stiffness, and seek to improve their computational method. It is the basic theory for the rigorous and accurate analysis of strength, stiffness and stability for complex engineering structures. It is also a prerequisite course for the mechanical professional courses such as plastic mechanics, fracture mechanics, finite element, structural optimization design and so on. Compared with the mechanics of materials, elasticity can give more accurate solutions. Elasticity is also an essential prerequisite for solving more complex mechanical problems in the fields of aerospace, civil engineering, machinery, energy, transportation and so on (such as elastodynamics, nonlinear elastomer, viscoelastic, anisotropic and non-uniform elastic mechanics, thermoelasticity, Hydroelasticity and aeroelasticity) in the graduation design stage and even in the follow-up study and work. This course mainly introduces the basic concepts, basic equations and some basic methods for elastic mechanics analysis. Through the teaching of this course, it focuses on cultivating students' comprehensive ability of mathematical modeling and computation for stress, strain and displacement of plane and space elastic problems. Furthermore, students should master the basic theories and methods of elasticity, and apply these theories and methods to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 计算力学课程主要是一种数值计算方法，如有限单元法。有限元法是求解各类工程问题的最有效的数值计算方法。这种数值计算方法是当今广泛应用的计算机求解技术。为此，要求学生深刻理解有限元法的基本算法和求解方法。教材中首先介绍了有限元刚度矩阵概念和通过插值函数表示的位移方程。然后，介绍了各种能量方法，如卡式定理、最小势能原理，以及加权余值法。最后，说明了如何应用于求解各类工程力学问题。设置该课程的目的就是向学生系统的介绍有限元数值计算方法，包括数学建模，求解方法和计算程序。使学生能够理解有限元法的基本理论和计算机应用技术。
default.en: The course of computational mechanics is mainly concerned with the numerical methods, e.g., the finite element method, which is the most effective numerical method that can be used to obtain the accurate solutions for various engineering problems. The numerical methods introduced in this textbook are nowadays very widely used computational techniques that it is essential for students to understand their basic solution algorism and applications of those techniques. The concept of finite element stiffness matrix and associated displacement equation in terms of interpolation functions are introduced first. The energy methods such as the first theorem of Castigliano, the principle of minimum potential energy and the method of weighted residual are described and illustrated with various examples. Finally, the applications to various engineering problems are illustrated. The material of this course of computational mechanics is expected to be useful for students who would like to learn the mathematical modeling, solution procedure and the computer programs used for solving practical problems. The objective of the course is to introduce various aspects of the numerical methods as applied to engineering problems in a systematic manner and to enable the students to understand the basic theory and computer implementation of the theory developed.

default.zh: 经典力学是各门力学课程的基础，包括牛顿力学、拉格朗日力学和欧拉力学等。作为一门体系严谨的力学核心基础课程，经典力学给出了力学分析的基本方法及由浅入深的逻辑认知规律，同时也是一门对工程对象进行静力学、运动学与动力学分析的技术基础课，在诸多工程技术领域有着广泛的应用。本课程的任务是使学生掌握质点、质点系、刚体和刚体系机械运动（包括平衡）的基本规律和研究方法，为学习相关的后继课程以及将来学习和掌握新的科学技术打好必要的基础；使学生初步学会应用经典力学的理论和方法分析、解决一些研究宏观机械运动的工程实际问题；通过本课程的教学，着重培养学生在理论建模、结构工程、动力学分析等方面的分析、设计和应用能力，并支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。同时结合本课程的特点，培养学生科学的思维方式和正确的世界观，培养学生的相关能力。
default.en: The object of this course is to impart a systematic undersdanding of the classical mechanics and its modern development for students. The course mainly expounds classical mechanics theory. This course consists of 3 volumes. Part 1 introduces the content of statics(Including the free-body diagram,planar force systems and couple systems, etc.), kinematics(Including the kinematics of a particle, the simple motion of a rigid body,resultant motion of a particle,etc.), dynamics(Including the particle dynamics,theorems of linear momentum,angular momentum and kinetic energy of particle systems ). Part 2 discusses the basic concepts of Lagrangain mechanics, including the general equations of dynamics, Lagrange equations and its first integrals: covers analytical mechanics (Including the fundamental equations of dynamics, Lagrange's equations of the first and the second kind, etc.)and mechanics vibration.Part 3 introduces the kinematics and dynamics of rigid body about a fixed point, including the integraled cases of Euler and Lagrange. The general motion of a rigid body is discussed by example.

default.zh: 固体力学基础涵盖传统课程材料力学和弹性力学的核心内容， 是工程力学专业承前启后的重要核心课程，是学习其他各类工科专业课程如结构力学、弹性动力学、飞行器设计等课程的基础。学习本课程后，学生能够掌握构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念、基本理论和分析的基本方法；深刻理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程在求解力学问题时的重要作用以及叠加原理、能量原理等这些变形体力学中的基本原理；熟练地运用基本理论计算杆件的应力与变形以及分析其强度、刚度与稳定性的能力；深刻理解三大基本方程、相容方程和圣维南原理等基本弹性理论以及半逆解法、变分法和有限差分等求解方法的基本原理，具备解决实际工程构件的弹性力学建模、应力、应变和位移的计算和分析、设计与评估等问题的知识基础，以及根据对有限元计算结果的深入分析改进工程设计的创新能力。
default.en: Fundamentals of Solid Mechanics includes the core content of the traditional courses, which are Mechanics of Materials and Elasticity. This course is a foundation course for studying other engineering courses such as structural mechanics, elasticity mechanics, aircraft design, etc. Therefore, Foundations of Solid Mechanics is a core course for students of Engineering Mechanics to build a bridge between earlier and later stages. After studying this course，students are able to master the basic concepts, basic theories, and basic methods of analysis for components' strength, stiffness, stability, etc., and to be proficient in calculating the stress and deformation of bars using basic theories to develop the ability to analyze strength, stiffness and stability. Students gain a deep understanding of the important role of balance equations, geometric equations and geometric equations in solving mechanical problems, mastering the basic principles of superposition principle, energy principle. In addition, students can gain a deep understanding for fundamental theories in elasticity: the three set of equations, compatibility equations, Saint-Venant principle, semi-infinite method, variational method, finite-difference method. Students have the basic knowledge to solve problems of actual engineering structures, including elasticity modelling, calculation and analysis of stresses, strains and displacements, design and evaluation etc. Thus, students possess the ability of creativity, which is the intensive analysis of the results of finite element calculations to improve engineering design.

default.zh: 工程仿真模拟是利用大型工程仿真模拟软件（如ANSYS、ADAMS等）对复杂机械系统进行定量描述建立系统的数学模型，用模型模拟来代替真实系统进行数值实验、求解分析和科学研究的过程。通过仿真模拟，有助于提高人们对工程领域各个物理过程的理解和认识，节省时间和实验成本，提高效率，为今后从事工程技术工作，提高产品设计开发和创新能力打下基础。
default.en: Engineering simulation is a process in which we use large-scale engineering simulation software (such as ANSYS, ADAMS, etc.) to quantitatively describe the complex mechanical system and establish a mathematical model of the system, and use model simulation to replace the real system for numerical experiments, solution analysis and scientific research. The simulation is helpful to improve people's understanding of various physical processes in the engineering field, save time and experimental costs, improve efficiency, and lay a foundation for engaging in engineering and technical work in the future, and improve product design, development and innovation capabilities. Engineering simulation is a practical technical core course in the field of intelligent manufacturing (2+X mode) in School of Future Technology. It mainly teaches the basic operation process of finite element analysis software (ANSYS) and multi-body system dynamics analysis software (ADAMS), static analysis and dynamic analysis of typical mechanical structures, and motion analysis of typical mechanical systems, so that students can deeply understand and master the basic operation process and use methods of large-scale engineering simulation software, It deepens students' understanding of the basic theory and knowledge of mechanical system, focus on cultivating students' ability to independently analyze and solve problems using computational mechanics analysis software, and have the ability to use large-scale engineering simulation software to solve problems in mechanical system structure analysis, motion analysis, dynamic analysis.

default.zh: 本课程在刚体力学基础上介绍固体力学的经典内容及其在工程结构中的典型应用。通过本课程学习，学生将掌握固体变形和强度分析的基本概念、基本理论和基本分析方法；深刻理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程以及叠加原理、能量原理等基本力学原理在求解力学问题时的重要作用。课程强化三类问题的分析和求解：一维杆件工程问题中应力与变形分析，及强度、刚度与稳定性的计算；弹性理论一般性理论和求解策略，及二维平面问题的表述、求解基本方法和经典问题。
default.en: Solid mechanics (1) introduces classical knowledge and its applications of engineering structures based on rigid body mechanics. Students will grasp basic concepts, theories and methods of deformations and strength analysis, understand the importance of balance, geometric and physical equations, as well as principles of superposition and energy in mechanics problem solving. It aims to strengthen abilities of analysis and problem solving in three fields: 1. stress, strain, strength, stiffness and stability analysis of one-dimensional engineering rods, 2. general theory of elasticity, and 3. two-dimensional elasticity and general strategies for solving classical problems.

default.zh: 本门课程作为经典力学课程的延伸，将学生学到的理论动力学向具体应用场景推广。动力学与控制方向是分析由刚体和变形体组成的动力学系统在外载荷作用下的移动、转动和变形，并根据所建的数学模型对系统进行轨道、姿态和振动控制的学科。本课程将以拉格朗日力学为基本工具，介绍数学建模中的刚体动力学、柔性体动力学、约束库、环境载荷等的数学建模方法；介绍数学模型的简化与线性化方法，并基于此设计运载器系统的轨道、姿态与振动控制；进而介绍多体系统动力学的建模方法，并基于此实现复杂机械系统的仿真与控制以及工程应用等。通过本门课程的学习，学生可以学习和掌握力学、机械和航天工程上常用刚性、柔性部件的建模和计算仿真方法，能够设计和实现相关仿真算法，并在简化数学模型上设计相应的控制器，并应用到自己的科研实践和工程问题的解决中去。
default.en: As a continuation of the course of Classical Mechanics, this course will extend the theoretical studies to practical engineering applications. The topics studied in dynamics and control include studies of the motions, rotations and vibrations of mechanical systems consists of rigid and deformable bodies, as well as the orbital, orientation and vibration control strategies to guarantee the system moves as expected. The main theoretical backgrounds of this course is the Lagrange mechanics, and the formulations of rigid bodies, flexible bodies, constraints as well as applied loads are provided in this course. The mathematical formulations will be simplified and linearized, and the control strategies are studied on those models. Frontier research topics, such as Lie group descriptions of rotations and real-time integrators will also be introduced. After study of this course, the students will be prepared for researches on vehicle dynamics of astronautics, aeronautics, ships, as well as railway engineering, and they will also be familiar with the applications of dynamics and controls on robotics and other machines.

default.zh: 复合材料导论课程是高等工科院校复合材料与工程专业的一门重要的基础课。其目的是使学生通过对本课程的学习，了解复合材料的定义、特点、分类和应用，了解复合材料的基本性能和发展概况，掌握近年来国内外复合材料研究的新理论、新进展，获得复合材料技术必要的基本理论、基本知识，为后续专业课程的学习和从事复合材料的研究打下坚实基础。本课程主要讲授复合材料领域中的基本理论和基础知识，以及近年来国内外复合材料研究的新理论、新进展。包括复合材料定义、分类、特性等基础知识、基体材料、增强材料、复合材料界面、聚合物基复合材料、金属基复合材料、陶瓷基复合材料等内容，是复合材料与工程专业学生非常重要的核心课，在培养学生具备一定的复合材料与工程的综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。通过本课程的课堂教学和课后实践等环节，为后续专业基础课和专业课学习打下良好的基础。
default.en: Introduction of Composite Materials course is an important basic course for composite materials and engineering major’s students. The aim of this course is enable students to understand the definition, characteristics, classification and application of composites, to understand the basic properties and development of composites, to study the new theory and progress of composite materials in recent years, and to obtain basic theories and basic knowledge of composite materials. This course mainly teaches the basic theory and basic knowledge in the field of composite materials, as well as the new theories and developments of composite materials research at home and abroad in recent years, including the definition, classification, characteristics and other basic knowledge of composite materials, matrix materials, reinforced materials, composites interface, polymer matrix composites, metal matrix composites, ceramic matrix composites and so on. It is an important basic course for composite materials and engineering major’s students. Through classroom teaching and after-school practice, it plays an important role in training students' comprehensive analysis ability and design ability of composite materials and engineering. It is very helpful for the follow-up professional basic courses and specialized courses study.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础I》本课程是复合材料与工程专业的一门主干专业技术基础课。材料科学理论是复合材料与结构学科的重要基础和支柱。本课程主要内容包括:晶体结构与缺陷, 包括空间点阵、指数标定、结合键、常见晶体结构的几何特征、晶体缺陷、界面以及塑性变形等基础知识和理论。 通过本课程的学习学生应掌握材料科学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: Course Description： 《Fundamentals of Materials Science and Engineering I》 as a main specialized basic course focuses on basic theories of composite materials science and engineering. Material science theory is an important foundation and pillar of composite materials and structures. The main content of this course involve: crystal structure and defects, including basic knowledge and theory of the space lattice, index calibration, bond, common crystal structure, crystal defects, interface and plastic deformation. From this curriculum, students should master basic theories and methods in the field of material science, and be skilled at solving practical engineering problems, lay a good foundation for the follow-up courses learning.

default.zh: 《航天技术概论》是飞行器设计与工程类专业的一门重要的专业介绍课程，在培养学生航天器总体设计、系统分析及航天器工程实践能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要通过介绍导弹、火箭、卫星等方面的知识，使学生了解和掌握导弹、火箭及卫星等基本概念和原理。通过本课程的课堂教学、项目研究、实验等环节，着重培养学生们了解导弹、火箭、卫星等航天器的历程、研究现状及发展趋势，了解和掌握航天器总体结构、设计、各分系统的功能及基本原理，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标的达成。
default.en: “Introduction to Aerospace Technology” is an important introductory course in the field of aircraft design and engineering. It holds a significant position in shaping students’ competencies pertaining to the comprehensive design of aerospace vehicles, systems analysis and practical engagement in aerospace engineering. This course primarily imparts knowledge concerning missiles, rockets, satellites and related topics, enabling students to gain an understanding and command over fundamental concepts and principles of these aerospace entities. Through classroom teaching, project research, experiments and other activities in this course, students are specifically trained to understand the history, current research and development trends of missiles, rockets and satellites. They also gain knowledge and proficiency in the overall structure, design, functions of various subsystems and basic principles of aerospace systems. The course aims to foster innovation and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in their professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 物理光学是电子科学与技术专业的一门重要的专业基础课，具有承前启后的作用，是学习后续专业课的基础，也是今后从事科研不可缺少的基础。通过该课程的学习将使学生掌握物理光学的基本知识，掌握分析问题的基本方法，培养学生运用光学知识解决后续课程以及以后工作中所遇有关问题的能力。 本门课程的教学内容前一部分讨论光的传播，以经典光学为主线，以光的电磁理论为基础，着重讲授光在各向同性介质、各向异性介质中的传播规律以及光的干涉、衍射、偏振特性。后一部分讨论光与物质的相互作用，包括晶体的感应双折射，光的吸收、色散和散射。 本门课程在注重物理思想的阐述的同时，适当引入现代光学的有关新概念和前沿课题，如激光原理，傅立叶光学基础等；注重启发式教学，形成师生间的互动；注重课程内容的系统性、综合性，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Physical Optics as an important fundamental and specialized course holds a significant position for students majoring in Electronic Science and Technology. It is a link between the previous and follow-up courses. Therefore, it becomes a necessary base for the students to learn later specialized courses and engage in future scientific researches. After the course, the students will be proficient in the basic ways of analyzing problems and gain the ability of solving the problems which may be encountered in later courses and research work. The main contents of this course are divided into two parts. The first part, based on the electromagnetism theory of optics, is to discuss the propagation of optics, it puts much emphasis on the optical propagation law through isotropy medium and anisotropic medium and the optical characteristics of interference, diffraction and polarization. The latter part discusses the interaction of light and substances, including induced birefringence of crystals, absorption, dispersion and scattering of the optics. It will pay much attention to the interpretation of physical ideas and the introduction of new concepts as well as advanced subjects of modern optics, such as the principle of laser, the basis of Fourier Optics and so on. In addition, the heuristic educational mode will be emphasized to foster the students’ ability of analyzing and solving problems.

default.zh: “量子力学B”是为电子科学与技术专业本科生开设的专业基础课，共40学时。 该课程采用从物理问题引入入手，由浅入深引入物理思想、物理方法及建立物理模型的讲授方法，依次向学生讲授：（1）波函数和薛定谔方程（2）一维定态问题（3）力学量用算符表达与表象变换（4）中心力场（5）粒子在电磁场中的运动（6）微扰理论（7）散射（8）自旋与全同粒子等内容。使学生掌握量子力学的基本理论与基本方法，为今后在近代光学、微电子、光电子等后续的专业课程及进一步的学习和今后的实际工作奠定一定的理论基础。 通过讲授课程，引导学生学会如何解决问题和处理问题，提高分析和解决实际物理问题的能力。同时，让学生从对一些自然现象的观察，了解怎样发现和建立新的理论。
default.en: “Quantum Mechanics B” is the profession foundation course that sets up for the professional undergraduate students in Science and Technology of Electronics, totally 40 learning-hours. This course, beginning with the basic physical problems, leads into the physics thoughts, physics methods and establishes the physics model step by step. The main contents are:(1) wave function and Schrodinger equation; (2)one-dimensional stationary state problems; (3)observables expressed as operators and the transformation of representation;(4)central field ;(5)particles in electromagnetic field;(6)perturbation theory ;(7)scattering; (8)spin and identical particles, etc. The basic theories can make the students master the basic methods of quantum mechanics, and set up a theoretic base for the following professional courses in modern-optics, micro-electronics, optoelectronics, etc. After the course, the students will be led how to solve problems, how to improve its ability to analysis the physics problems.

default.zh: 原子物理与半导体物理基础是一门专业基础课，原子物理部分介绍了原子光谱的规律和光谱特征，建立解释这些规律或现象的理论模型，并通过理论结果和实验的对比，验证理论模型的正确性。理论包括半经典和量子理论。讲述内容包括：原子的半经典模型、量子力学基本理论，氢原子能级与光谱的计算分析，以及碱金属原子光谱、多电子原子光谱、磁场中原子的精细光谱。通过原子物理学课程的学习，学生能够掌握角动量耦合的规律，能够分析多电子组态的原子能级，进而分析实际原子的能级系统及跃迁。半导体物理基础部分，为建立半导体能带概念，介绍了一维原子系统产生半导体能隙的机制，基本概念包括半导体电子有效质量、导电机构、回旋共振和能带结构，以及半导体杂质能级、缺陷和位错等。
default.en: Atomic Physics and Fundamentals of Semiconductor Physics is a professional basic course, Atomic Physics introduces the laws and spectral characteristics of atomic spectra, establishes a theoretical model to explain these laws or phenomena, and verifies the correctness of the theoretical model through the comparison of theoretical results and experiments. Theory includes both semi-classical and quantum theories. The contents include: the semi-classical model of atoms, the basic theory of quantum mechanics, the calculation and analysis of the energy level and spectrum of hydrogen atoms, as well as the spectrum of alkali metal atoms, multi-electron atoms, and the fine spectrum of atoms in the magnetic field. Through the study of atomic physics course, students can master the law of angular momentum coupling, analyze the atomic energy level of multi-electron configuration, and then analyze the energy level system and transition of actual atoms. In the part of Semiconductor Physical Foundations, in order to establish the concept of semiconductor energy band, it introduces the mechanism of semiconductor energy gap of one-dimensional atomic system. The basic concepts include the effective mass of semiconductor electron, conductive mechanism, cyclotron resonance and band structure, as well as semiconductor impurity energy level, defects and dislocation.

default.zh: 主要掌握和熟悉集成电路和电子科学与技术等专业方向的基础理论，涉及到固体物理和半导体物理等方面的物理概念和主要性质。本课程为学生介绍固态电子学的基本物理规律和性质，包括集成电路材料的基本物理性质、导电性以及半导体中的载流子及其运动状态，为从事集成电路、微电子器件、传感器及应用、光电子技术等方面的研究和工作打下必备的理论基础。
default.en: Master and be familiar with the basic theories of integrated circuits and electronic science and technology, involving the physical concepts and main properties of solid physics and semiconductor physics. This course introduces the basic physical laws and properties of solid-state electronics, including the basic physical properties and conductivity of integrated circuit materials, as well as the carrier and its motion state in semiconductors. This course lays a necessary theoretical foundation for the research and work in integrated circuits, microelectronics devices, sensor applications, and optoelectronic technology.

default.zh: 半导体是现代电子信息产业的核心基础材料，其独特的电学、光学特性是集成电路、半导体器件、光电子设备等各类电子系统实现功能的根本前提，已广泛渗透到通信、能源、医疗、人工智能等各个领域，成为推动科技进步与产业升级的关键支撑。当前，半导体技术正朝着纳米级、多功能化方向快速发展，对从业者的基础理论素养和实践应用能力提出了更高要求。《半导体物理学》课程紧扣半导体物理的基础理论与实际应用，全面介绍半导体中的电子状态、杂质和缺陷能级、载流子的统计分布与输运规律、非平衡载流子特性、p-n结及半导体光电、磁效应等核心知识，兼顾理论深度与实践导向，正确阐述核心物理概念，辅以必要的数学推导，帮助学生建立清晰的半导体物理图像。课程旨在使学生系统掌握半导体物理学的基本概念、理论和研究方法，深刻理解半导体器件的工作机理，建立理论与实际应用之间的关联，提升解决半导体相关实际问题的能力，为后续学习集成电路、半导体器件设计与制造等相关课程，以及将来从事半导体领域的科研、开发与应用工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Semiconductors are the core basic materials of the modern electronic information industry. Their unique electrical and optical properties are the fundamental premise for various electronic systems such as integrated circuits, semiconductor devices, and optoelectronic equipment to realize their functions. They have been widely penetrated into various fields such as communication, energy, medical care, and artificial intelligence, becoming a key support for promoting technological progress and industrial upgrading. At present, semiconductor technology is developing rapidly towards the nanometer level and multi-functionalization, putting forward higher requirements for the basic theoretical literacy and practical application ability of practitioners. Taking this classic textbook as the core, the course "Semiconductor Physics" closely focuses on the basic theories and practical applications of semiconductor physics, comprehensively introducing core knowledge such as electronic states in semiconductors, impurity and defect energy levels, statistical distribution and transport laws of carriers, characteristics of non-equilibrium carriers, p-n junctions, and semiconductor photoelectric and magnetic effects. It balances theoretical depth and practical orientation, correctly elaborates core physical concepts, and assists with necessary mathematical derivations to help students establish a clear semiconductor physical image. The course aims to enable students to systematically master the basic concepts, theories and research methods of semiconductor physics, deeply understand the working mechanism of semiconductor devices, establish the connection between theory and practical application, improve the ability to solve practical problems related to semiconductors, and lay a solid foundation for subsequent learning of related courses such as integrated circuits and semiconductor device design and manufacturing, as well as future engagement in scientific research, development and application work in the semiconductor field.

default.zh: 应用光学是光电信息科学与工程专业非常重要的专业核心课和基础课，是学习后续专业课的基础。本课程系统地讲授光学成像系统的基本理论和知识、理想光学系统的分析方法、典型光学系统的成像原理及分析方法等。主要内容包括：几何光学基本定律；球面与球面系统；平面与平面系统（平面反射镜、棱镜等）；理想光学系统；光学系统中的光束限制（孔径光阑、视场光阑、景深等）；光能及其计算；光线的光路计算等。本课程实践性比较强，需要做大量的习题来帮助学生加深对各种光学系统的理解，尤其是典型光学系统性能参数之间关系的理解，所以安排了一定学时的习题课。 课程成绩采用累加式，综合考虑平时成绩和期末笔试成绩。
default.en: Applied optics is an important core course and basic course of Photoelectric Information Science and Engineering, which is the basis of learning the following specialized courses. This course systematically lectures on basic theories and knowledge of optical imaging system, analytical methods of ideal optical systems, imaging principles and analytical methods of typical optical systems. The contents include: fundamental laws of geometrical optics; spherical surface and spherical surface systems; plane surface and plane surface systems (plane mirror, prism, etc.); ideal optical system; Restriction of light beam in optical systems (aperture stop, field aperture, field depth, etc.); light energy and its calculation; Ray tracing calculation, etc. This course practicality is strong, a lot of exercises to help students deepen the understanding of all kinds of optical system, especially, the understanding of the relationship between performance parameters of the typical optical system, some class of recitation is arranged. The courses score is cumulative, taking into account the regular grades and final exam score.

default.zh: 人工智能原理是国内外著名大学计算机专业设置的骨干课之一，也是国内外著名高校和研究机构的主要研究方向之一。本课程围绕智能体（Agent）的感知、决策与行为控制等基本问题，系统讲授人工智能的基本理论、核心模型与关键方法。课程内容涵盖搜索与优化、逻辑推理、自动规划、机器学习等理论基础，并结合计算机视觉、自然语言处理、智能控制、数据挖掘等典型应用场景，帮助学生构建全面的人工智能知识体系。课程将紧密结合本学科在人工智能方向的科研工作与发展前沿，通过理论讲授、案例分析与实践训练，培养学生面向复杂智能问题的建模与求解能力，理解“从原理到应用”的基本路径，具备自主学习、迭代研究与跨领域协作的科研素质。本课程也是后续“机器学习”、“计算机视觉”、“自然语言处理”等方向课程学习的理论基础。
default.en: Principles of Artificial Intelligence is one of the core courses offered by computer majors in renowned universities both domestically and internationally, and it is also one of the main research directions of famous universities and research institutions at home and abroad. This course focuses on the fundamental issues of perception, decision-making, and behavioral control of intelligent agents, and systematically teaches the basic theories, core models, and key methods of artificial intelligence. The course covers theoretical foundations such as search and optimization, logical reasoning, automatic planning, and machine learning, and combines typical application scenarios such as computer vision, natural language processing, intelligent control, and data mining to help students build a comprehensive knowledge system of artificial intelligence. The course will closely integrate the research work and development frontiers of this discipline in the field of artificial intelligence. Through theoretical lectures, case analysis, and practical training, it aims to cultivate students' modeling and solving abilities for complex intelligent problems, understand the basic path from principles to applications, and possess the scientific research qualities of self-directed learning, iterative research, and cross disciplinary collaboration. This course is also the theoretical foundation for subsequent courses in areas such as machine learning, computer vision, and natural language processing.

default.zh: 计算机视觉技术近年来的发展和突破，其在人脸识别、无人驾驶、事故检测等多个领域发挥着重要的作用。本课程旨在介绍计算机视觉的基础知识，阐明从传统图像分析技术基本概念、发展历程和相关理论，完善学生在计算机视觉领域的基础，并在实践中掌握视觉技术的基本应用。 本课程采用授课教学为主，上机教学为辅的方式， 24学时为课堂授课阶段，16学时为上机实践教学环节。基于前期的课堂讲授，通过上机实验训练，使学生熟悉景点计算机视觉技术的理论、技术和实际，为学生在智能视觉工程领域的深入学习研究奠定坚实的理论基础和实践上手能力。 本课程的理论教学主要内容有：成像链路、量化和混叠理论；图像的压缩和保真；图像区域分割；图像区域分割和边缘轮廓提取；图像特征识别和纹理特征；图像标定和三维重建。上机实验包括图像压缩、图像配准、相机标定与拼接、三维重建。 通过对基本理论的学习，和相应算法上机实验，使学生初步掌握计算机视觉基础理论、经典计算机视觉算法方法。通过学习开拓学生视野，使学生初步掌握解决计算机视觉问题的能力。
default.en: Computer vision technology has witnessed significant developments and breakthroughs in recent years, playing vital roles in diverse fields such as facial recognition, autonomous driving, and accident detection. This course aims to introduce fundamental knowledge of computer vision, elucidating core concepts, historical evolution, and theoretical frameworks of traditional image analysis techniques. It will strengthen students’ foundational expertise in the field while enabling them to master basic applications of visual technologies through practical implementation. The course employs a teaching methodology centered on lectures supplemented with lab sessions. It comprises 24 hours of lecture-based instruction and 16 hours of hands-on computer lab training. Building upon the theoretical knowledge from lectures, the lab sessions enable students to master classic computer vision theories, techniques, and real-world implementations. This foundation prepares students for advanced studies and research in intelligent vision engineering. Theoretical Curriculum Includes: Imaging pipelines, quantization and aliasing theory; Image compression and fidelity; Image region segmentation; Edge contour extraction; Feature recognition and texture analysis; Image calibration and 3D reconstruction. Lab Experiments Cover: Image compression techniques; Image registration; Camera calibration and panorama stitching; 3D reconstruction workflows. Through mastering core theories and implementing corresponding algorithms in labs, students will develop a foundational grasp of computer vision principles and classical methodologies. The course broadens students’ horizons while cultivating their initial capability to address computer vision challenges.

default.zh: 视觉传感原理是智能视觉工程的核心基础课程，光学起源于视觉，本课程要解决如何将模拟的视觉信息转化为数字信息，为后续的智能化信息处理提供基础。 课程目标如下： 课题目标1：掌握光电探测器的基本知识和基本特性，掌握CCD和CMOS图像采集器件的基本原理及其特性参数。 课题目标2：具有光电信号分析处理的能力，以及分析和解决图像处理电路设计的能力。 课题目标3：在学习和项目研究中培养和锻炼学生的研究能力、表达能力和团队合作精神，终身学习的意识。
default.en: The principle of visual sensing is a core fundamental course of intelligent vision engineering, optics originates from vision, this course aims to solve how to convert analog visual information into digital information, providing a foundation for subsequent intelligent information processing. Course objectives are as follows: Course objective 1: master the basic knowledge and basic characteristics of photoelectric detectors, and master the basic principles and characteristic parameters of CCD and CMOS image acquisition devices. Course objective 2: learn the ability of photoelectric signal analysis and processing, as well as the ability to analyze and solve the circuit design of image processing. Course objective 3: cultivate and exercise students' research ability, expression ability, and team cooperation spirit in learning and project research, and the awareness of lifelong learning.

default.zh: 这是一门培养科学兴趣和提升科学能力素养的课程。通过力学各方向科研教师介绍目前承担的航天领域相关科研工作，使学生们了解航天专业技术发展过程中遇到的问题以及解决方案；促进学生的科研思考能力和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This is a course that cultivates scientific interest and enhances scientific literacy. By introducing the current research work in the aerospace field undertaken by teachers in various fields of mechanics, students can understand the problems encountered in the development of aerospace technology and their solutions; Promote students' scientific research thinking and problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 本课程是哈工大未来技术学院小卫星班本科同学的一门必修课，一共8次课，每次课邀请一位国内航天领域知名专家为同学们做航天工程领域前沿技术的学术和科技报告，主要讲座内容有：航空航天工业发展历程、航空航天工程专业主要知识方向等；了解飞行器、动力系统、武器设备、电子设备和地面设备的组成、分类和工作原理；了解卫星、火箭、空间机械臂、导弹、无人机等航空器和航天器的先进技术方法等。
default.en: This course is a compulsory course for undergraduate students of the small satellite class in the School of Future Technology of Harbin Institute of Technology. The course is composed of eight lectures, each of which invites a well-known expert in the field of domestic aerospace to make an academic and scientific report on the frontier technologies in the field of aerospace engineering for the students. The main lectures include: the development history of the aerospace industry, the main knowledge direction of the aerospace engineering profession and so on. Students are enabled to understand the composition, classification and working principles of spacecraft, power systems, weapons equipment, electronic equipment and ground equipment, and to understand the advanced technological methods of satellites, rockets, space robotic arms, missiles, drones and other aerospace vehicles and spacecraft, and so on.

default.zh: 智能化与自主化是未来航天器的重要特征，本课程重点讲述智能航天器总体设计方法和新概念航天器设计与仿真技术，具体阐述总体设计流程、概念设计方法、动力学与控制、航天器半物理仿真系统等理论内容。以四旋翼无人机为实践对象，让学生对航天器控制系统的设计与仿真形成较为全面的了解与认知，并在课程设计中亲自动手，达到学有所成、学以致用的效果。通过本课程的学习，为将来从事航天领域科研和研究，特别是从事航天器总体设计、姿态控制系统设计与仿真的学生奠定理论基础与实践经验。
default.en: Intelligence and autonomy are important characteristics of future spacecraft. This course primarily focuses on intelligent spacecraft overall design methods and new concept spacecraft design and simulation techniques. It elaborates on theoretical content, including the overall design process, conceptual design methods, dynamics and control, and spacecraft semi-physical simulation systems. Using quadcopter drones as a practical example, students gain a comprehensive understanding of spacecraft control system design and simulation. They also have hands-on experience in course projects, achieving practical results. Through this course, students establish a theoretical foundation and practical experience for future research and work in the aerospace field, especially in spacecraft overall design, attitude control system design, and simulation.

default.zh: 无人机自主飞行是自主智能系统设计的一个重要分支，是当今的热点研究领域。多旋翼飞行器（以四旋翼飞行器为代表）以其稳定的留空性、路点控制的精确性和飞行的灵活性体现出传统飞行器无法比拟的优势。由于该类飞行器属于新概念飞行器，其控制与传统飞行器有较大不同，因此有必要研究其控制系统的设计，并在一定条件下实现该控制器，从而帮助无人机完成自主飞行。 本课程结合多旋翼飞行器的姿态控制问题，帮助学生以直观、实践的方式掌握自动控制系统设计的方法，鼓励学生亲自动手实现自己设计的控制器，并在实际四旋翼飞行器上加以验证。课程讲解飞行器控制、嵌入式系统开发、姿态/位置传感器、自动控制、多旋翼飞行器六自由度运动控制等核心技术，同时穿插进行实物控制实验，帮助学生真正掌握设计与实现无人机飞控的能力。课程充分培养学生的兴趣，使自动控制原理、自动控制元件等课程中学习的理论在实际系统中得到应用。希望本课程能带领学生真正应用自动控制原理等知识解决实际问题，实现无人飞行器的自主飞行。
default.en: Autonomous UAV flying is a key branch of autonomous intelligent system design, and also a hotspot study field nowadays. Muti-rotor flying vehicle (eg. Quad-rotor drone) possesses unbeatable advantages on stable hovering, precise waypoint control and flying flexibility. Because this kind of flying vehicle belongs to new concept drone, it is different from traditional flying vehicle on automation control. So it is necessary to study its control system’s design, and implement the controller to help the drone perform autonomous flying. This lecture focuses on the attitude control problem of multi-rotor flying vehicle, and help students master automation control design methods. The lecture encourages students to implement their own-designed controller, and run the system on real quad-rotor drone to verify the design. The lecture contains flying vehicle control, embedded system development, attitude/position sensor, automation control, multi-rotor drone’s 6 DOF (Degree of Freedom) kinetic control etc., and places physical system control experiments intermittently to help students train the ability of designing and implementing UAV’s flight control system. The lecture grows the student’s interest, and help to use the automation control theory, automation control elements etc. in the physical system. It is hopeful for this lecture to lead the students for using the automation control theory to solve practical problems, and to realize autonomous flying of UAV.

default.zh: 本课程详细介绍了基于线性矩阵不等式的不确定系统鲁棒控制的概念、理论及设计方法，包括目前应用广泛的线性矩阵不等式的概念、理论、算法及相关软件等，主要目的是针对本科阶段所学的航天器轨道、姿态动力学与控制等相关基础理论知识进行应用扩展与综合。学生可深入理解基于状态空间模型的控制系统分析和设计的基本概念、理论知识和数学方法，了解并掌握线性矩阵不等式这门数学工具的特点及在控制系统分析和设计中的应用，掌握现代航天器控制系统设计的工程思想与理论知识，深入理解空间环境、航天器轨道姿态动力学等基础知识以及在航天器通信、导航、遥感等方面的应用，掌握航天器系统仿真技术的工程思想与理论知识。 基于现代航天器控制设计中常用的状态反馈、观测器设计、滑模控制等方法，培养学生理论知识结合工程实践的科学研究能力，使学生熟练掌握LMI工具箱的使用，面向航天工程常见的卫星通信、导航、遥感，导弹攻防，火箭运载等任务，培养学生以工程任务为导向的科学研究能力，使学生熟练掌握SpaceSim等航天器系统仿真软件的使用；使学生具有总体设计眼光，在未来具备独立完成航天器总体或分系统相关科研课题的能力。
default.en: This course introduces the concept, theory and design method of robust control of uncertain systems based on linear matrix inequalities in detail, including the concept, theory, algorithm and related software of linear matrix inequalities widely used at present. The main purpose is to apply and integrate the basic theoretical knowledge of spacecraft orbit, attitude dynamics and control learned during the undergraduate period. Students can deeply understand the basic concepts, theoretical knowledge and mathematical methods of control system analysis and design based on state space model, understand and master the characteristics of the linear matrix inequality mathematical tool and its application in control system analysis and design, and master the engineering ideas and theoretical knowledge of modern spacecraft control system design. Deeply understand the basic knowledge of space environment, spacecraft orbit attitude dynamics, and its application in spacecraft communication, navigation, remote sensing, etc., master the engineering thought and theoretical knowledge of spacecraft system simulation technology. Based on the state feedback, observer design, sliding mode control and other methods commonly used in modern spacecraft control design, the scientific research ability of students combining theoretical knowledge with engineering practice is cultivated, so that students can master the use of LMI toolbox for common aerospace engineering tasks such as satellite communication, navigation, remote sensing, missile attack and defense, and rocket launch. Cultivate students' ability of scientific research oriented to engineering task, and make students proficient in the use of spacecraft system simulation software such as SpaceSim; To enable students to have an overall design vision, in the future with the ability to independently complete the spacecraft overall or subsystem related scientific research topics.

default.zh: 随着深空探测、在轨服务、星座自主运行等航天任务日益复杂化，传统依赖地面控制的航天器系统已难以满足实时性、可靠性与智能化需求。本课程聚焦航天器自主智能系统的创新设计，结合航天工程、人工智能、控制科学等多学科前沿，培养学生设计具备自主感知、决策、规划与执行能力的下一代智能航天器系统。本课程从理论基础、技术实践和创新思维三个层面开展课程设计，在理论基础上，掌握航天器自主系统的基本架构、核心算法（如状态估计、路径规划、故障诊断）及人工智能技术（机器学习、强化学习、多智能体协同）的应用原理；在技术实践上，通过仿真平台与项目案例，学习如何将AI算法嵌入航天器软硬件系统，解决星上资源受限、实时性要求高等工程挑战；在创新思维上，探索自主系统在新型任务场景（如太空制造、巨星座自主任务规划）中的设计范式，培养跨学科创新能力。 本课程核心内容模块包括航天器自主系统架构、智能感知与环境理解、自主决策与任务规划、在轨学习与自适应系统和前沿案例与创新设计，课程突出项目驱动、学科交叉与行业联动特色，项目驱动分组完成“从算法到星载代码”的全流程设计；学科交叉融入航天系统工程、边缘AI芯片、认知科学等交叉领域知识；行业联动邀请深度参与科研任务的学者分享工程痛点。学生将能够设计满足特定任务需求的航天器自主系统方案，编写轻量化AI算法并优化其在星载计算单元的部署，跟踪国际前沿趋势。授课采用理论授课+仿真实验（MATLAB/STK/Python）+行业案例研讨相结合形式。通过本课程，学生将站在航天与人工智能融合创新的最前沿，为参与未来智能航天器研发奠定基础。
default.en: As space missions such as deep-space exploration, on-orbit servicing, and autonomous mega-constellation operations grow increasingly complex, traditional ground-controlled spacecraft systems struggle to meet the demands for real-time responsiveness, reliability, and intelligence. This course focuses on the innovative design of autonomous intelligent systems for spacecraft, combined with the frontiers of aerospace engineering, artificial intelligence, control science and other disciplines, and trains students to design next-generation intelligent spacecraft systems with autonomous perception, decision-making, planning and execution capabilities. This course is designed from three levels: theoretical foundation, technical practice and innovative thinking, and on the basis of theory, students will master the basic architecture of spacecraft autonomous systems, core algorithms (such as state estimation, path planning, fault diagnosis) and the application principles of artificial intelligence technologies (machine learning, reinforcement learning, multi-agent collaboration). In terms of technical practice, through simulation platforms and project cases, students learn how to embed AI algorithms into spacecraft software and hardware systems to solve engineering challenges such as limited on-board resources and real-time requirements. In terms of innovative thinking, we will explore the design paradigm of autonomous systems in new mission scenarios (such as space manufacturing and autonomous mission planning of giant constellations), and cultivate interdisciplinary innovation capabilities. The core modules of this course include Spacecraft Autonomous System Architecture, Intelligent Perception and Environmental Understanding, Autonomous Decision-Making and Mission Planning, On-Orbit Learning and Adaptive Systems, as well as Cutting-Edge Case Studies and Innovative Design. The course emphasizes three distinctive features: project-driven learning, interdisciplinary integration, and industry-academia collaboration. The project-driven approach requires teams to complete full-process designs from algorithms to onboard code implementation. The interdisciplinary component incorporates knowledge from aerospace systems engineering, edge AI chips, cognitive science and other cross-cutting fields. The industry linkage involves inviting scholars deeply engaged in research missions to share practical engineering challenges. Upon completion, students will be able to design spacecraft autonomous system solutions tailored to specific mission requirements, develop lightweight AI algorithms and optimize their deployment on spacecraft computing units, and track international cutting-edge trends in the field. The teaching adopts a combination of theoretical teaching, simulation experiments (MATLAB/STK/Python), and industry case studies. Through this course, students will be at the forefront of the integration and innovation of aerospace and artificial intelligence, and lay the foundation for participating in the research and development of future intelligent spacecraft.

default.zh: 航天器与自主智能系统是目前航天领域的研究热点，本课程介绍无人机、无人车的基础知识；通过具体实例，讲解自主智能系统的设计；设计验证实验内容，帮助学生在实践中熟练应用所学的知识，提高学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，培养学生针对开放问题的创新精神和创新能力。 课程主要内容包括概述无人机介绍、无人车介绍等，如无人机分类、无人机组成、无人机视觉导航和无人车路径规划等。
default.en: Spacecraft and autonomous system are the hot topic of aerospace research community. This course aims at introducing the basic information about unmanned quadrotor and vehicle. The design of autonomous system will be taught through a real-world example. The experiment is deliberately designed to help the students to gain the knowledge and use it in practice. The ability to analyze and solve problem will be promoted for the students and the interest of innovation when facing the open problem will also be aroused. This course covers the topic of unmanned quadrotor and vehicle, such as the categories of UAV, the structure of UAV, SLAM and trajectory planning.

default.zh: 航天器轨道动力学与控制是小卫星班和飞行器设计学科的一门专业基础课。本课程主要研究航天器轨道动力学与控制的基本概念、原理和应用，是培养从事小卫星总体设计专业人才的重要组成部分。培养学生掌握航天器轨道动力学问题的基本理论方法，并解决一般的航天器轨道动力学应用问题的基本技能，为日后从事航天器的轨道动力学与控制及其他的航天器应用专业的研究工作奠定初步的理论基础。 本课程将在麻省理工学院轨道力学经典书籍《An Introduction to the Mathematics and Methods of Astrodynamics》 (Battin R.H.著，1999年)的基础上，讲解航天器轨道动力学中的基本问题和基本数学方法，并应用于轨道设计、轨道转移和轨道交会等任务。培养本科生在所学轨道动力学基础知识上，掌握轨道动力学领域所需的基本理论方法，并用于轨道工程任务的分析和设计；培养学生创新思维能力，为以后科学研究打下基础；了解目前轨道动力学中的热点问题和分析方法。
default.en: Spacecraft orbit dynamics and control is a professional basic course for the small satellite class and the discipline of space vehicle design. This course mainly studies the basic concepts, principles and applications of spacecraft orbit dynamics and control. It is an important part of cultivating professionals engaged in the overall design of small satellites. Train students to master the basic theories and methods of spacecraft orbital dynamics and solve the basic skills of general spacecraft orbital dynamics application problems, so as to lay a preliminary theoretical foundation for future research on spacecraft orbital dynamics and control and other spacecraft application majors. The course is based on the classic book in orbit dynamics in Massachusetts Institute of Technology, i.e., An Introduction to the Mathematics and Methods of Astrodynamics, Battin R.H., 1999. The main contents include the fundamental problem and the fundamental theory method in orbit dynamics and their applications in orbit transfer and rendezvous missions. The purpose of the course is to train the undergraduates to grasp the fundamental method in the field of orbit dynamics and to apply this technique into orbit mission analysis and design. Moreover, we will train the undergraduates’ innovative thinking, which may be used in their future scientific research. In addition, the research hot topics and the methods in orbit dynamics will be introduced in the course.

default.zh: 变形体力学与有限元课程内容涵盖传统课程中材料力学、结构力学、弹性力学、有限元四门课程中的基本内容。研究对象包括杆件的拉压、圆轴扭转、梁的弯曲以及组合变形，杆系结构、板类构件等弹性变形体，研究任务包括强度、刚度和稳定性等问题。本课程教学大纲从不同研究对象其材料均为变形体，而针对变形体的力学分析方法与变形体的几何形体无关的认知出发制定。课程的基本概念包括强度、刚度、稳定性、应力、应变、应变能等，基本原理和理论包括切应力互等、平衡、应变连续和变形协调、应力应变关系、能量原理、互等定理、强度理论、叠加原理等，基本方法是在综合平衡、几何、物理三个方面条件分析的基础上解决变形体力学问题。本课程强化应力应变分析主线，突出力学、几何、物理三大方程，解析求解与数值仿真并重，旨在培养学生掌握坚实的基础知识，并具有创造性思维、工程结构物理数学建模、复杂系统分析以及多学科综合设计与工程实践能力。
default.en: The content of the deformation mechanics and finite element analysis course covers the basic content of material mechanics, structural mechanics, elastic mechanics, and finite element analysis courses. The research objects include tension and compression of bars, torsion of circular shafts, bending of beams and combined deformations, as well as elastic deformations of bar structures and plate members. Research tasks involve studying strength, stiffness, and stability. The syllabus of this course is formulated from the understanding that the mechanical analysis methods of deformable objects have nothing to do with the geometry of deformable objects. The basic concepts of the course include strength, stiffness, stability, stress, strain, strain energy, etc. The basic principles and theories include mutual equivalence of shear stress, equilibrium, continuity of strain and coordination of deformation, stress-strain relationship, energy principle, mutual equivalence theorem, strength theory, superposition principle, etc. The primary approach involves solving mechanical problems of deformation on the basis of the analysis of equilibrium, geometry and physics. This course strengthens the main line of stress and strain analysis, highlights the three major equations of mechanics, geometry and physics, attaches equal importance to analytical solution and numerical simulation, and aims to cultivate students' solid basic knowledge and ability of creative thinking, mathematical modeling of engineering structure physics, complex system analysis, and multidisciplinary comprehensive design and engineering practice.

default.zh: 《航天器姿态动力学与控制》是飞行器设计与工程类专业的一门主干专业核心课。本课程是学生从基础课学习阶段过渡到专业课学习阶段的重要环节，利用基础课所学的知识和技能进行综合，进一步学习航天器姿态动力学、姿态控制方面的基本原理和方法，具有较强的理论性和实际应用性，使学生掌握基本的航天器姿态动力学建模的原理和方法以及姿态控制设计相关概念和原理。本课程将为学生进一步学习本专业其他专业课程打下基础。 教学内容包括：航天器姿态运动学和姿态动力学的基本概念，以及姿态动力学建模基本原理；自旋航天器、重力梯度稳定航天器、三轴姿态稳定航天器的姿态动力学建模方法及姿态运动分析；航天器姿态确定原理，自旋稳定航天器、三轴稳定航天器的姿态确定方法；自旋稳定航天器和三轴稳定航天器的姿态控制原理及设计方法；航天器姿态控制系统设计过程。 通过本门课程的学习，使学生初步掌握航天器姿态动力学与姿态控制的基本原理和方法，为将来从事航天器姿态动力学以及姿态控制系统设计等相关应用专业的研究工作或本专业进一步深造奠定初步的理论基础。
default.en: ‘Spacecraft Attitude Dynamics and Control’ is one of branch and basic courses for Specialty of Spacecraft Design and Engineering. This course transfers students from basic course learning step to specialized course learning step. This course concentrate on theory and application. It will enhances the ability of students for mastering knowledge and skill in basic course. Students will have a deeper understanding on principles of attitude dynamics and control. The purpose of this course is to make student possess the capacity on dynamic modeling and attitude control. This course will give a basic understanding for learning other specialized courses. The main contents of the course include: the basic concepts and knowledge of attitude kinematics and dynamics for spacecraft, and the modeling principles of attitude dynamics, and the attitude dynamical equations and modeling method for spin, dual-spin, gravity stabilization and three axis stabilization spacecraft; And also the basic principle and methods of attitude determination; the main methods of attitude determination for spin or three axis stabilization spacecraft; The principles and methods of attitude control for spin, dual-spin spacecraft and three axis stabilization spacecraft; and the design and implement process of attitude control system for spacecraft. Students will possess the capacity of attitude dynamic modeling and control when the course is finished. It is a foundation for students to engage in related work or have further learning on this major field.

default.zh: 《航天器总体设计》是一门本科专业课程，旨在帮助学生从工程设计的角度学习航天器的总体设计知识，了解航天器设计的特点与设计原则，深入理解与总体设计相关的知识和设计方法。课程分为7章，主要讲授航天器总体设计中的任务分析、总体方案设计、详细设计、空间环境影响及对策、航天器研制技术流程等相关知识，使学生能够站在系统的、全局的角度运用所学的知识去分析航天器工程设计中的各种实际问题，并将其应用于航天器的系统设计，形成初步的航天器总体设计与系统分析能力，为掌握航天器的工程设计方法打下基础。
default.en: “Spacecraft System Design” is an undergraduate major course aimed at helping students learn the system design knowledge of spacecraft from the perspective of engineering design, understand the characteristics and design principles of spacecraft design, and deeply understand the knowledge and design methods related to system design. The course content is divided into seven parts. The main content includes related knowledge such as task analysis, system scheme design, system detailed design, space environment impact and countermeasures, and spacecraft development technology process, enabling students to analyze various practical problems in spacecraft engineering design from a systematic and global perspective, and apply them to spacecraft system design, forming preliminary spacecraft system design and system analysis capabilities, establishing a foundation for mastering the engineering design methods of spacecraft.

default.zh: 多体系统动力学是研究多体系统（一般由若干个柔性和刚性物体相互连接所组成）运动规律的科学，在航空航天、机械工程、车辆工程、船舶工程、机器人等领域已经应用广泛，是进行工程设计与优化的关键依托。目前多体动力学已形成了比较系统的研究方法。其中主要有工程中常用的以拉格朗日方程为代表的分析力学的方法、以牛顿-欧拉方程为代表的矢量学方法、图论方法、凯恩方法和变分方法等。但是，现阶段大部分课程只是对理论进行讲解，依靠公式推导完成相关内容的学习，缺乏实践环节，学生难以在短时间内掌握抽象的学术内容。本课程面向本科大三年级学生，适用于航空航天类、机械类、力学类等专业。本课程讲解多体系统动力学与控制的理论内容和仿真实践技术，课程主要讲授绪论、双连杆机械臂、单刚体动力学与控制、计算多体系统动力学、漂浮基座机器人动力学与控制、固定基座机器人动力学与控制、MBdyn多体系统动力学仿真软件7个部分。相比于传统课程讲授和设置方案，本课程在以下方面进行了探索和创新： 1、 课程理论深度循序渐进。通过最简单的双连杆机构引入二体动力学理论，将约束、驱动、控制等基本概念结合简单机构进行讲解。随后基于固定基座机械臂和漂浮基座机械臂系统讲解并巩固多体系统动力学与控制理论。课程内容由浅入深、由简入繁，构建了合理清晰的理论体系。 2、 理论与实践相结合。每节课辅以随堂案例进行讲解，课程案例采用卫星、二连杆、机械臂等机构，具有典型代表性，能够融合每节课所讲解的理论架构。将理论内容与实际案例进行整合，基于实际系统对抽象繁琐的理论进行讲解，使学生能够快速掌握理论知识和方法。 3、 采用虚拟样机联合仿真技术。开发了多体系统动力学教学软件MBDyn，能够实现对本课程所有内容的验证。该软件具有完全自主知识产权，能够实现多体系统动力学建模与求解、控制联合仿真、后处理显示等功能。依托该软件能够使学生将课堂学习内容动手操作实现，强化对知识点的掌握和理解。 本课程以线下教学方式对理论知识、仿真案例及仿真方法进行讲解。同时设置了详细的随堂作业，帮助学生巩固所学内容。最后以期末考试检验教师教学及学生学习情况，考题内容、分值设置合理。
default.en: Dynamics and Control of Multibody System is the study of multi-body systems (generally composed of a number of flexible and rigid objects connected to each other) the laws of motion of science, in aerospace, mechanical engineering, vehicle engineering, marine engineering, robotics and other fields have been widely used, is the key to engineering design and optimization of the dependence. At present, multi-body dynamics has formed a relatively systematic research method. Among them, there are mainly the methods of analytical mechanics represented by Lagrange's equations commonly used in engineering, vectorial methods represented by Newton-Euler's equations, graph theory methods, Kane's methods and variational methods. However, at this stage, most of the courses only explain the theory and rely on formula derivation to complete the learning of relevant content, lacking practical aspects, students are difficult to grasp the abstract academic content in a short time. This course is for undergraduate third-year students, applicable to aerospace, mechanical, mechanics and other majors. This course explains the theoretical content and simulation practice technology of multi-body system dynamics and control, the course mainly teaches the introduction, double link robotic arm, single rigid body dynamics and control, computational multi-body system dynamics, floating base robot dynamics and control, fixed base robot dynamics and control, multi-body system dynamics simulation software (MBDyn) in seven parts. Compared with the traditional course lectures and setting programs, this course has explored and innovated in the following aspects: 1. The theoretical depth of the course is progressive. The theory of two-body dynamics is introduced through the simplest two-link mechanism, and the basic concepts of constraints, drive, and control are combined with a simple mechanism to explain. Subsequently, based on the fixed-base robotic arm and floating-base robotic arm system to explain and consolidate the multi-body system dynamics and control theory. The course content is from shallow to deep, from simple to complex, and builds a reasonable and clear theoretical system. 2. Combination of theory and practice. Each lesson is supplemented with accompanying cases, and the course cases adopt satellite, two-link, robotic arm and other institutions, which are typical and representative, and can integrate the theoretical structure explained in each lesson. Integration of theoretical content and actual cases, based on the actual system of abstract and complicated theory to explain, so that students can quickly master the theoretical knowledge and methods. 3. Adopt virtual prototype joint simulation technology. MBDyn, a multi-body system dynamics teaching software, has been developed to realize the verification of all the contents of this course. The software has completely independent intellectual property rights, and can realize the functions of multi-body system dynamics modeling and solving, control joint simulation, post-processing display and so on. Relying on this software, students can realize the classroom learning content by hands-on operation, and strengthen the mastery and understanding of knowledge points. This course is an offline teaching method to explain the theoretical knowledge, simulation cases and simulation methods. At the same time, detailed homework is set to help students consolidate what they have learned. Finally, the final examination is used to test the teachers' teaching and students' learning, and the content and score of the examination are set reasonably.

default.zh: 飞行器结构动力学结合飞行器结构设计和工程实际需求，主要讲述结构动力学的基本概念、基本理论、基本分析方法以及在工程中的应用，包括单自由度系统、多自由度系统和连续弹性体的振动，结构动力学中常用的数值方法；飞行器结构动力学建模，飞行器结构模态分析及动力学响应分析，飞行器动力学环境试验方法等。
default.en: Combining aircraft structural design with practical engineering requirements，the Dynamics of Aircraft Structure mainly introduces the fundamental concepts, theory and analytical methods of structural dynamics and its application in engineering . This course consists of Single-freedom system vibration, Multi-freedom system vibration, Continuous elastic system vibration，Numerical Methods commonly used in structural dynamics；Modeling of spacecraft structure dynamics, Modal analysis and dynamic response analysis of aircraft structural, Aircraft dynamics environmental test methods, etc.

default.zh: 系统建模与仿真基础是自动化类专业的一门核心先修课，主要讲授系统建模与仿真的概念、方法及工具，使学生了解和掌握系统建模方法与仿真方法，能够通过基于机理的建模、基于实验数据的建模、基于机理与实验数据相结合的建模等方法建立典型系统的模型，进一步了解并能运用仿真软件进行系统仿真实验。 本课程主要包括：（1）系统、模型与仿真的概念，系统建模与仿真的发展历程、现状、趋势与应用；（2）基于机理的建模、基于实验数据的建模、基于机理与实验数据相结合的建模等建模方法，电气网络系统、机械系统、机电系等基于机理的建模实例；基于插值、回归等方法的建模实例；基于机理与实验数据相结合建模实例；（3）几种基本仿真方法：欧拉法、梯形法、龙格库塔法、线性多步法；仿真算法的选择及步长确定方法；（4）仿真程序设计。 本课程的上机实验包括：模型建立与仿真实验。 通过课堂教学和上机实验等环节，培养学生的创新意识和分析能力以及建模仿真知识的应用能力，不仅是学习后续自动控制理论、自动控制实践等课程的基础，而且可为学生提供研究系统问题的强有力的工具，在培养学生系统性思维和建模仿真分析能力等方面具有重要作用。
default.en: Introduction to system modeling and simulation is a core course for students majoring in automation. It mainly talks about the concept, method and tools of system modeling and simulation. It also helps the students to learn and master the method for system modeling and simulation, based on which they can model typical systems through mechanism modeling, modeling based on experimental data or the previous two method combined. Simulation experiments is also a topic of this course. This course consists of the following parts. (1) The concept of system, model and simulation, and the history, current status, future direction and application of system modeling and simulation. (2) Mechanism modeling method and modeling examples such as electrical system, mechanical system, electro-mechanical system; modeling method and modeling examples based on experimental data or the previous two methods combined. (3) Typical simulation method, such as Euler method, Trapezoidal method， Runge-Kutta method and Linear Multiple-step method, and how to choose simulation method and simulation step. (4) Simulation program design. The experimental parts of this course are system modeling and simulation experiment. The desire to do innovative work, the ability of system analysis and the knowledge of modeling and simulation will be cultivated through classroom teaching and computer experiment. This will lay the foundation of learning automatic control theory and automatic control experiments, provide them with powerful tool for study system problem, and cultivate them to do systematic thinking and help them to gain the ability of modeling and simulation.

default.zh: 《智能系统控制理论（1）》是面向智能无人系统专业本科生的一门核心基础课程。课程将通过28学时的课堂授课以及4学时上机，讲述自动控制的基本概念、线性控制系统的数学模型、多种（时域与频域，古典与现代）分析方法，以及经典的校正方法、现代的极点配置方法等主要内容。课程旨在为学生建立系统大局观和控制方法论，对培养学生形成正确的科研思想、锻炼理论与实践相结合能力具有重要作用。 本课程理论教学与实验教学相结合，课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时成绩和上机。
default.en: Intelligent System Control Theory (1) is a core basic course for undergraduates majoring in intelligent unmanned system. The course will introduce the basic concepts of automatic control, mathematical models of linear control systems, various analysis methods (time and frequency domain, classical and modern), classical correction methods, modern pole assignment methods and other main contents through 28 hours classroom teaching and 4 hours computer simulation. The course aims to establish a systematic overall view and control methodology for students, which plays an important role in training students to form correct scientific research thoughts and exercise their ability to combine theory and practice. This course combines theoretical teaching with experimental teaching, and the course examination results are cumulative, including the final test, daily performance and computer simulation report.

default.zh: “自动控制理论（1）”是一门非常重要的技术基础课，主要介绍经典自动控制的基本理论、经典自动控制系统的分析和设计方法。课程内容主要包括： 1．自动控制系统的组成和要求； 2．控制系统教学模型的建立； 3．线性系统的时域分析方法； 4．用根轨迹分析线性控制系统的方法； 5．线性系统的频域分析方法； 6．线性控制系统的综合与校正； 7．非线性控制系统分析。
