default.en: Course Description： Brief Introduction to the Course of Theory of Automatic Control (1) Nature and Contents of the Course Theory of Automatic Control (1) is a very important basic course on technology. It mainly studies elementary theory of automatic control, methods of automatic control systems analysis and design. Contents of the course follows: 1. Components and requirements of automatic control systems. 2. Modeling of control systems. 3. Time domain analysis method of linear systems. 4. The method of control system analysis with root locus. 5. Frequency domain analysis method of linear systems. 6. Control systems synthesis and compensation. 7. Nonlinear control systems analysis.

default.zh: 人工智能技术是研究如何运用计算来模拟人脑所从事的感知、推理、学习、思考和规划等人类智能活动，解决需要人脑智能才能解决的问题。智能无人系统相关的专业辅修及双学位课程人工智能基础，与传统的计算机相关专业强调算法不同，更强调人工智能算法在专家系统、机器学习、深度学习及模糊推理结构在控制系统方面的应用。通过本课程学习掌握人工智能的基本概念、基本原理、知识的表示、机器学习技术、深度学习技术、神经网络技术，掌握人工智能的一个问题和三大技术。通过本课程的学习，为相关专业本科生了解人工智能技术的基本特点，掌握人工智能在工程实际中的应用奠定基础。
default.en: Artificial intelligence technology is the study of how to use computation to simulate human intelligence activities such as perception, reasoning, learning, thinking, and planning, in order to solve problems that require human brain intelligence. The auxiliary course of intelligent unmanned systems majors, Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence, differs from traditional computer related majors that emphasize algorithms. It emphasizes the application of artificial intelligence algorithms in expert systems, machine learning, deep learning, and fuzzy inference structures in control systems. Through this course, students will master the basic concepts, principles, knowledge representation, machine learning technology, deep learning technology, and neural network technology of artificial intelligence, and master one problem and three major technologies of artificial intelligence. Through the study of this course, it lays the foundation for undergraduate students in relevant majors to understand the basic characteristics of artificial intelligence technology and master the application of artificial intelligence in engineering practice.

default.zh: “自动控制理论（2）”是一门非常重要的技术基础课，主要介绍自动控制的基本理论、数字控制系统及现代控制理论的分析和设计方法。主要内容涉及数字控制系统的数学建模、数字控制系统的时域分析和频域分析、数字控制系统的模拟化设计和离散化设计、线性系统的状态空间描述、线性系统的状态空间法分析、线性系统的状态空间法综合。具体地，本课程内容主要包括： 1．信号的采样与保持； 2．线性离散系统数学模型的建立； 3．数字控制系统的时域及频域分析； 4．数字控制系统的模拟化设计； 5．数字控制系统的离散化设计； 6．线性控制系统的状态空间描述； 7．基于状态空间法的线性系统时域分析； 8. 基于状态空间法的线性系统综合； 9. 基于李雅谱诺夫方法的系统稳定性分析。
default.en: Course Description： Brief Introduction to the Course of Theory of Automatic Control (2) Nature and Contents of the Course Theory of Automatic Control (2) is a very important basic course on technology. It mainly studies elementary theory of automatic control, analysis and design methods of digital control systems and modern control theory. Contents of the course follows: 1. Sampling and holding of signals. 2. Modeling of linear discrete control systems. 3. Time domain and frequency domain analysis of digital control systems. 4. Analog design method of digital control systems. 5. Discrete design method of digital control systems. 6. State space description of linear systems. 7. Time domain analysis of linear systems based on state space methods. 8. Control systems synthesis based on state space methods. 9. Stability analysis based on Lyapunov theory.

default.zh: 随着计算智能领域的快速发展，模糊逻辑、神经网络、强化学习等技术越来越多地被应用到了自动控制领域，由此大大推动了智能控制理论的发展，有效提高了控制理论解决模型复杂性、不确定性的能力，同时大大提高了控制系统的“学习能力”。本课程将介绍模糊逻辑控制、神经网络控制以及强化学习控制的基本原理和核心算法，旨在让学生掌握智能控制领域的基本原理和思路，掌握一种能够处理复杂非线性被控对象、处理模型结构以及参数不确定性以及具有“自学习自适应能力”的控制理论。具体来讲本课程将包括以下几方面内容： 1. 模糊逻辑推理的基本原理和算法； 2. 模糊逻辑控制系统设计以及分析方法； 3. 神经网络的基本结构以及参数学习方法； 4. 神经网络控制系统原理以及分析方法； 5. 强化学习方法的基本原理和基本算法； 6. 强化学习控制系统设计。
default.en: With the rapid development of intelligent computation, the technologies such as fuzzy logic, neural network and reinforcement learning are increasingly applied to automatic control. It has greatly promoted the development of intelligent control theory and effectively improved the ability to solve the problems of model complexity and uncertainty. And it has also improved the "learning ability" of control system. This course will introduce the fundamental principles and core algorithms of fuzzy logic control, neural network control and reinforcement learning control to enable students to master the basic principles and ideas in the field of intelligent control. It will also help students to get a deep understanding of a control theory with “self-learning and adaptive ability” which can deal with complex nonlinear controlled objects, model structures and parameter uncertainty. This course will cover the following aspects: 1. The basic principles and algorithms of fuzzy logic inference; 2. Design of fuzzy logic control system and analytical method; 3. Basic structure of neural network and parameter learning approach; 4. The basic principles and analysis methods of neural network control system; 5. The basic principles and algorithms of reinforcement learning; 6. Design of reinforcement learning control system.

default.zh: 自动控制实践（1）课程面向控制科学与工程全系的本科生开课，是专业课中最重要的课程之一，也是学生学习后续专业课的基础。课程主要讲授控制系统中常见的几类元件的基本原理、结构和运行特性，重点使学生了解几类元件的理论基础、选择依据、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握常见自动控制元件和控制系统问题的基本计算方法和实验技能。 本课程主要包括四大部分：执行器及其控制，功率放大元件，测量元件，控制系统。本课程讲授的元件包括：直流电机、异步（感应）电机、永磁同步电机、永磁无刷电机、其他常见执行元件、线性功率放大器、PWM功率放大器、码盘与光栅等。除课堂讲授外，课程实践也是课程的重要组成部分，包括：直流电机驱动、直流电机特性、光电编码器信号处理、直流电机控制系统。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、课程实践和控制系统设计三部分。
default.en: Automatic Control Practice (1) is one of the most important courses to all the students in Control Science and Engineering Department, which is a knowledge foundation of the latter specialty lessons. In this course, several commonly used components of control systems are introduced about their working principle, basic structure and running characteristics. After finishing the lesson students should know the theoretical foundation, selection, advanced studies, tendency and applications of the above control components, be familiar to the basic calculation and test methods of control components and system problems. The course of Automatic Control Practice (1) contains four sections: actuator control, power amplifiers, sensor and control system. The components are comprised of DC motor, asynchronous (induction) motor, permanent magnet synchronous motor, permanent magnet brushless motor, other common actuator, linear power amplifier, PWM power amplifier, encoder, other new type sensor. The practice is important part of the course, and is comprised of DC motor driving system, DC motor characteristics, signal processing of optical encoder, DC motor control systems. The source score is composed of final examination, practice and control system design.

default.zh: 自动控制实践（2）是自动化类专业的一门非常重要专业核心课程，隶属于自动控制实践核心课，旨在自动控制原理与自动控制元件的学习基础上，将自动控制理论与控制系统设计实践之间架设一座桥梁，将理论与实际衔接起来。本课程是一门面向工程应用、实践性较强的课程，也是后续学习过程控制、飞行器控制与制导、无人机控制等课程的基础，在培养学生控制系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程重点讲授三个部分内容：一是通过分析控制系统的输入信号、设计指标等，讲授构建控制系统的方法；二是分析解决控制系统设计中的主要问题，如误差分析及减小误差方法、扰动影响及抑制方法等；三是结合实例讲授几种典型的控制系统设计方法，如伺服系统、调节系统等。 通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验及计算机仿真等教学环节，着重培养学生进行控制系统设计的综合应用能力，以及控制工程科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，为解决实际工程问题奠定基础。
default.en: Automatic control practice (2), the second phase of the core course automatic control practice, is itself one of the important core courses for automation students. Taking automatic control theory and automatic control components as prerequisites, the course serves as a bridge connecting automatic control theories and control systems design practices. The course is oriented to engineering applications and is, therefore, strongly characterized with practicing. The course will lay a sound foundation for the study of succeeding courses, such as process control, guidance and control of flight vehicles, control of unmanned aerial vehicles. The course holds an important position in cultivating students’ overall abilities of analysis and design. The course mainly consists three parts. The first part gives the methodology of constructing a control system through the analysis of various input signals and performance indices of the control system. The second part deals with main problems in control system design via, for example, error analysis and methods to reduce control errors, disturbance analysis and suppression methods. In the third part, design procedures for typical control systems, including servomechanisms and regulation systems, are given, together with various practical design examples. Through the course study, including lecturing in class and real experiments and computer simulations outside class, it is expected that the overall capabilities are cultivated for students in control system design. In addition, it is also hoped that the sense on innovation of students is improved to lay a sound foundation for solving practical engineering problems.

default.zh: “智能系统控制理论”是一门重要的专业基础课，主要讲授基于现代控制理论的控制系统分析与设计，以及基于强化学习的智能控制系统设计理论。课程主要内容如下： 1、智能系统控制概述 2、线性系统的状态空间分析 3、线性系统的状态空间综合 4、李雅普诺夫稳定性分析 5、强化学习在智能控制系统中的应用 6、多智能Agent系统分析
default.en: Control Theory of Intelligent System is a basic major course, which is mainly about the analysis and synthesis methods for modern control theory, as well as the design theory of intelligent control system based on reinforcement learning. The main contents of this course are as follows： 1. Overview of intelligent system control 2. Analysis of linear control systems based on state-space models 3. Synthesis of linear control systems based on state-space models 4. Stability analysis of control system based on Lyapunov methods 5. The application of reinforcement learning in intelligent control systems 6. Analysis of multi-agent system

default.zh: 智能系统控制实践是自动化类专业的一门非常重要专业核心课程，隶属于自动控制实践核心课，旨在自动控制原理的学习基础上，将自动控制理论与控制系统设计实践之间架设一座桥梁，将理论与实际衔接起来。本课程是一门面向工程应用、实践性较强的课程，也是后续学习运动控制系统、过程控制、飞行器动力学控制与制导、无人机控制等课程的基础，在培养学生控制系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程重点讲授四个部分内容：一是自动控制元件，重点学习电机及其驱动控制电路、各种类型的传感器等；二是通过分析控制系统的输入信号、设计指标等，讲授构建控制系统的方法，分析解决控制系统设计中的主要问题，如谐振及滤波、扰动抑制等；三是结合实例讲授几种典型系统设计方法; 四是针对智能系统控制方法，讲授专家控制和模糊控制的基本概念和应用。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验及计算机仿真等教学环节，着重培养学生进行控制系统设计的综合应用能力，以及控制工程科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Intelligent system control practice, the core course intelligent systems control practice, is itself one of the important core courses for automation students. Taking automatic control theory and automatic control components as prerequisites, the course serves as a bridge connecting automatic control theories and control systems design practices. The course is oriented to engineering applications and is, therefore, strongly characterized with practicing. The course will lay a sound foundation for the study of succeeding courses, such as process control, guidance and control of flight vehicles, control of unmanned aerial vehicles. The course holds an important position in cultivating students’ overall abilities of analysis and design. The course mainly consists four parts. The first part is to master automatic control components, with a focus on studying motors and their drive control circuits, various types of sensors, etc. The second part gives the methodology of constructing a control system through the analysis of various input signals and performance indices of the control system, and deals with main problems in control system design via, for example, error analysis and methods to reduce control errors, disturbance analysis and suppression methods. In the third part, design procedures for typical control systems, including servomechanisms and regulation systems, are given, together with various practical design examples. The fourth part discusses intelligent control systems, covering basic notions and applications of expert systems and fuzzy control systems. Through the course study, including lecturing in class and real experiments and computer simulations outside class, it is expected that the overall capabilities are cultivated for students in control system design. In addition, it is also hoped that the sense on innovation of students is improved to lay a sound foundation for solving practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 人工智能技术是一门涉及多学科、有广泛应用的综合性前沿学科。它的进步使得自动控制、计算机技术及机器视觉及语音处理结合为人类服务成为可能。本课程与计算机相关专业侧重人工智能算法不同，希望能够通过对人工智能课程的学习，使学生掌握人工智能技术的基本原理和方法；了解一般搜索方法及博弈论基础概念，学习不确定性推理方法、模糊推理、模糊控制系统及专家系统的基本概念及其在自动控制专业的应用，学习机器学习、专家系统、神经网络和知识发现等目前人工智能的主要研究领域的原理、方法和技术；增强学生的逻辑思维与实践应用能力，提高学生将理论和实际结合能力，为今后在各自领域开拓高水平的人工智能技术应用奠定基础.
default.en: Artificial Intelligence(AI) technology is a newly comprehensive forward subject that combining a multidisciplinary and widely used in engineering. Its progress makes it possible to combine automatic control, computer technology, machine vision and voice processing to better serve human beings. Different with the computer algorithm related AI course, through the study of AI course, students can known the basic principles and methods of AI technology; understand general search methods and basic concepts of game theory; to learn the basic concepts of uncertain reasoning methods, fuzzy reasoning, fuzzy control systems and expert systems, and their application to control community, to learn the principles, methods and techniques of machine learning, expert system, neural network and knowledge discovery in the main research fields of artificial intelligence at present. The course can enhance the ability of logical thinking and practical application of the students. Meanwhile, it can improve the ability of combining theory with practice, and make a better foundation for the developing high-level application of artificial intelligence technology in their respective fields in the future.

default.zh: 自动控制项目实践是一门融合理论分析与设计、数值仿真与虚拟仿真的实践课程。本课程主要以四旋翼无人机为研究对象，以Jupyter Notebook和三维虚拟仿真平台为实践平台，讲述被控对象的建模与仿真、控制系统设计的时域法实践、控制系统设计的现代控制方法实践等内容。
default.en: Automatic Control Project Practice is a practical course that integrates theoretical analysis and design, numerical simulation, and virtual simulation. This course mainly focuses on quadcopter unmanned aerial vehicles as the research object, using Jupyter Notebook and 3D virtual simulation platform as practical platforms. It covers the modeling and simulation of controlled objects, time-domain method practice of control system design, modern control method practice of control system design.

default.zh: 结合我校国防特色，“先进探测制导项目实践” 以飞行器为应用背景，研究飞行器探测目标的原理、导引飞行器与目标碰撞（或相遇）原理与方法的一门专业课程。课程较为全面系统地讲授了飞行器的运动方程、导引方法、弹道特性分析、复合制导的基本原理以及水下探测与制导的基本原理。通过本课程的学习，使学生全面和系统地掌握目标探测原理、飞行器与目标碰撞的导引规律和方法；建立理论与工程实际的紧密联系，通过理论教学和实验教学，为学生提供工程实践的机会，为今后从事飞行器探测与制导方向的科研工作奠定必要的基础。
default.en: In line with our school's defense characteristics, "Advanced Detection and Guidance Project Practice" is a specialized course that takes aircraft as the application background, focusing on the principles of aircraft target detection and the principles and methods of guiding aircraft to collide (or meet) with targets. The course comprehensively and systematically teaches the motion equations of aircraft, guidance methods, trajectory characteristic analysis, the basic principles of compound guidance, and the basic principles of underwater detection and guidance. Through the study of this course, students can comprehensively and systematically master the principles of target detection, the guidance laws and methods for aircraft to collide with targets, and establish a close connection between theory and engineering practice. Through theoretical teaching and experimental teaching, it provides students with opportunities for engineering practice and lays a necessary foundation for their future research work in the field of aircraft detection and guidance.

default.zh: 智能控制项目实践以工业及医疗领域的智能检测控制环节为课程对象，围绕其检测、控制、应用展开理论与实践高度融合的实验设计内容。理论方面覆盖了智能检测控制系统的建模组成、控制系统的性能分析、以及检测系统的理论方法及设计等内容，重点讲授视觉类智能检测控制系统的设计方法。工业类项目实践包含瑕疵检测、工序检测和尺寸检测，医学类项目实践包含组织形态学识别、病灶检测和病症诊断，且两类项目都涵盖了深度学习中视觉类智能算法，也都需要在检测过程中借助机械臂或者滑台对目标进行连续性动态搜寻。通过本课程的学习，使得学生掌握检测控制系统的基本理论知识；可以正确对系统的性能进行分析；具备综合运用理论知识，对系统整体进行规划、设计与开发；掌握智能检测算法、深度学习网络在智能化、无人化应用中的基本原理及方法。智能控制项目实践以工业及医疗领域的智能检测控制环节为课程对象，围绕其检测、控制、应用展开理论与实践高度融合的实验设计内容。理论方面覆盖了智能检测控制系统的建模组成、控制系统的性能分析、以及检测系统的理论方法及设计等内容，重点讲授视觉类智能检测控制系统的设计方法。工业类项目实践包含瑕疵检测、工序检测和尺寸检测，医学类项目实践包含组织形态学识别、病灶检测和病症诊断，且两类项目都涵盖了深度学习中视觉类智能算法，也都需要在检测过程中借助机械臂或者滑台对目标进行连续性动态搜寻。通过本课程的学习，使得学生掌握检测控制系统的基本理论知识；可以正确对系统的性能进行分析；具备综合运用理论知识，对系统整体进行规划、设计与开发；掌握智能检测算法、深度学习网络在智能化、无人化应用中的基本原理及方法。
default.en: The Project Practices of Intelligent Control takes the intelligent detection and control link in the industrial and medical fields as the course object, and develops the experimental design content of the high integration of theory and practice around its detection, control and application. In theory, it covers the modeling and composition of intelligent inspection and control system, the performance analysis of control system, the theoretical methods and design of inspection and control system, and focuses on the design methods of visual intelligent inspection and control system. The practice of industrial projects includes defect detection, process detection and size measurement, while the practice of medical projects includes histomorphology recognition, lesion detection and disease diagnosis. In addition, both projects cover visual intelligent algorithms in deep learning, and both require continuous dynamic search of targets with the help of mechanical arms or sliding platforms during the detection process. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theoretical knowledge of detection and control systems; can correctly analyze the performance of the system; have comprehensive theoretical knowledge to plan, design, and develop the overall system; master the basic principles and methods of intelligent detection algorithms and deep learning networks in intelligent and unmanned applications.

default.zh: “鲁棒与自适应控制”是控制科学与工程学科发展的重要前沿分支，是自动化类专业的一门非常重要专业必修课程，旨在自动控制原理学习基础上，面向实际控制系统中普遍存在的不确定性，课程结合本科生的知识结构特点，由浅入深，讲析SISO系统的鲁棒与自适应控制理论与应用，在培养学生控制系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程重点讲授三个部分内容：一是通过分析实际生活中的多种控制系统中的不确定性，讲授控制系统不确定性存在的原因及特点；二是针对系统中普遍存在的不确定性问题，采用鲁棒控制方法，对不确定性进行数学描述，并通过控制系统灵敏度分析解决带有被控对象不确定性的鲁棒控制系统分析及设计方法；三是针对系统中的不确定性，对系统中的参数进行在线辨识，并实时调整控制器参数，实现控制系统的自适应控制器设计。 通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验等教学环节，着重培养学生进行控制系统理论分析和设计的综合应用能力，以及控制工程科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，为解决实际工程问题奠定基础。
default.en: Robust and adaptive control is one of the frontiers in the control science and engineering discipline, also serves as an important mandatory course for automation students. Taking automatic control theory as a prerequisite, the course focuses on systematic methodology dealing with the uncertainties widespread in actual control systems. As a result of a deliberate consideration on the undergraduate knowledge scope, the course covers robust and adaptive control, both in theory and application, for single-input single-out-put systems, the exposition of which takes a gradual way, easy to involved, to help comprehension. The course mainly consists of three parts. The first part reveals the causation and properties of uncertainties in control systems through case studies on various control system examples taking from real life. The second part deals, via robust control theory, with uncertainties in systems, which are mathematically described. Control system sensitivity analysis is utilized to cope with uncertainties, and therefore leads to the robust control system analysis and design methos. The third part discusses adaptive controller design for systems with uncertainties through online identification of unknown parameters and accordingly adjusting in real time controller parameters. Through the course study, including lecturing in class and experiments outside class, it is expected that the overall capabilities are cultivated for students in theoretical analysis and design of control systems. In addition, it is also hoped that the sense on innovation of students is improved to lay a sound foundation for solving practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 最优控制基础是自动化类专业下设控制理论与控制工程模块中的一门重要基础课程，是现代控制理论中的一个非常重要的分支。本课程旨在介绍最优控制理论的基础知识和研究方法，主要内容包括：最优控制问题描述、古典变分法、Pontryagin极小值原理、动态规划、线性二次型最优控制、输出跟踪等。通过本课程的学习，学生可以掌握最优控制的内涵和本质、建立一个最优控制问题的数学描述、熟练使用欧拉方程求解泛函极值、应用古典变分法求解最优控制问题、深入体会极小值原理重要意义及其重要应用、掌握动态规划及线性二次型最优求解思想；此外，还可以使用数学仿真软件完成一个较复杂的工程最优控制问题的求解和结果分析。通过实验操作深刻体会最优控制思想，有效提高学生解决工程实际问题能力。
default.en: “Fundamentals of Optimal Control” is a very important course opened in the module of control theory and control engineering, which is suitable for the third-year undergraduate majored in automation. It is also a significant branch in modern control theory. The course aims to introduce fundamental theory and research methods for optimal control theory. The main contents include: description of optimal control problem, classical method of calculus of variations, Pontryagin’s minimum principle, dynamic programming, linear quadratic optimal control, and output tracking, etc. Through the course, students could grasp the meaning and essence of optimal control, construct mathematical description for an optimal control problem, apply Euler equation to solve the extremum for functionals, solve optimal control problem by classical calculus of variations, realize the important meaning of minimum principle and its significant applications, grasp the idea of dynamic programming and linear quadratic optimal control. Moreover, students could make use of mathematical simulation software to solve and analyze a relatively complicated engineering optimal control problem. Experimental operations could also help students grasp optimal control idea deeply and increase their ability effectively to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 本课程为机器学习的介绍性课程，主要讲述机器学习中的相关概念、原理和算法。从分类和线性回归开始讲起，直到近期新发展的方法如决策树、支持向量机、集成学习以及贝叶斯网络等方法。内容涵盖机器学习中的监督学习、非监督学习及集成学习等主要类别的算法。并针对相关的机器学习方法进行实验练习，培养用机器学习方法解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: This course is an introduction about machine learning, mainly focusing on the relevant concepts, principles, and algorithms in machine learning. We start from classification and linear regression, until recent developed methods, such as decision tree, support vector machine, ensemble learning, and Bayesian networks. The contents cover algorithms in the main categories of machine learning, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and ensemble learning. We also help students to conduct experimental exercises on relevant machine learning methods to cultivate the ability to solve practical problems using machine learning methods.

default.zh: 《计算机视觉》课程由航天学院控制科学与工程学科开设，主要面向自动化、探测制导与控制技术、智能装备与系统专业的本科生。课程旨在使学生掌握计算机视觉的基础理论和技术，并了解领域的最新发展。包含了数字图像描述、图像增强、特征检测、人脸识别、图像配准等课题。通过启发式、案例和互动式教学，结合实验教学和课程报告研究，课程旨在培养学生的独立思考、问题解决能力以及实际工程问题解决的技能。
default.en: The Computer Vision course is provided by the Control Science and Engineering discipline of the College of Aeronautics and Astronautics. Catering primarily to undergraduate students specializing in Automation, Detection, Guidance and Control Technology, and Intelligent Equipment and Systems. It aims to equip students with fundamental theories and techniques of computer vision and provide them with up-to-date knowledge in the field. The course covers key topics such as digital image processing, image enhancement, feature detection, face recognition, and image alignment. The teaching approach combines heuristic, case-based, and interactive methods, complemented by practical laboratory exercises and course report research. This multifaceted approach is designed to foster independent thinking, enhance problem-solving abilities, and cultivate practical engineering skills among students.

default.zh: 智能装备一体化设计课程主要讲授智能装备的基础知识、传感器检测系统、伺服驱动系统设计、运动控制系统设计、系统接口以及具体的设计案例等内容，目的使学生了解智能装备的基本原理和基本组成、掌握智能装备系统和各组成子系统的设计方法，培养学生在工程应用方面的能力。
default.en: The course of Intergrated Design of Intelligent Equipment mainly teaches the basic knowledge of intelligent equipment, sensor detection systems, servo drive system, motion control system, system interfaces, and their practical design cases. The purpose of course is to enable students to understand the basic principles and structure of intelligent equipment systems, master the design methods of intelligent equipment systems and its subsystems, and cultivate their abilities in engineering applications.

default.zh: 《计算智能》课程主要围绕该领域的三大模块，即神经网络、模糊逻辑以及进化算法，探讨控制、聚类、决策以及优化等问题的新思想和新方法。通过本门课的学习，学生能够比较系统地把握神经网络、模糊逻辑以及进化算法中的基本原理、关键问题和典型应用，提高学生对于人工智能、智能控制、机器学习等研究方向的兴趣。同时结合控制科学与工程学科背景，强调计算智能在系统控制中的应用。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学环节使得学生领悟计算智能三大模块的基本理论原理以及实际应用，体会不同模块合适的应用场景及优劣，培养学生在面对优化、控制等问题的创新能力和解决实际问题的能力。 本课程的目标包括：1.掌握单层神经网络、多层神经网络、径向基函数神经网络以及递归神经网络的基本思想、训练算法与性能分析方法，能够针对实际任务选择并实现适当的神经网络结构，使用相关软件完成模型训练与性能评估，培养严谨的数学建模意识和系统优化的科学素养。2. 理解模糊集合与模糊逻辑的基本概念与原理，掌握常用模糊算子和模糊推理方法，熟悉TS模糊模型的结构与应用场景，能够运用模糊逻辑处理不确定性问题并构建初步的模糊推理系统，培养辩证看待模糊性与精确性的哲学思维，提升在多因素决策中的逻辑表达能力。3. 掌握进化算法的基本思想与遗传算法的具体流程，理解其在全局数值优化和组合优化问题中的应用原理，能够针对具体问题设计遗传算法编码、适应度函数与操作算子，实现编程求解，培养在复杂优化问题中的创新思维与系统求解能力，增强对自然启示计算方法的跨学科理解。
default.en: The course "Computational Intelligence" primarily focuses on three major modules in the field—neural networks, fuzzy logic, and evolutionary algorithms—to explore new ideas and methods for addressing issues such as control, clustering, decision-making, and optimization. Through this course, students will be able to systematically grasp the fundamental principles, key issues, and typical applications of neural networks, fuzzy logic, and evolutionary algorithms, thereby enhancing their interest in research areas such as artificial intelligence, intelligent control, and machine learning. Additionally, against the background of control science and engineering, the course emphasizes the application of computational intelligence in system control. The main objective of this course is to enable students to comprehend the basic theoretical principles and practical applications of the three major modules of computational intelligence through classroom teaching, appreciate the suitable application scenarios and strengths and weaknesses of each module, and cultivate their innovative capabilities and problem-solving skills when confronting challenges such as optimization and control. This course is designed to provide a comprehensive exploration of three core modules: neural networks, fuzzy logic, and evolutionary algorithms. It delves into novel ideas and methods for tackling challenges in control, clustering, decision-making, and optimization. Through this course, students will systematically master the fundamental principles, key issues, and typical applications of each module. The curriculum is structured to not only enhance understanding of artificial intelligence, intelligent control, and machine learning but also to emphasize the application of computational intelligence within the context of control science and engineering. Furthermore, the course aims to cultivate students' practical abilities by enabling them to appraise the strengths, weaknesses, and suitable application scenarios of different methods, thereby fostering innovative thinking and problem-solving skills for addressing real-world optimization and control challenges. Specific learning outcomes include designing and implementing various neural network architectures, constructing fuzzy inference systems to handle uncertainty, and developing genetic algorithms to solve complex optimization problems, all while building a rigorous foundation in mathematical modeling and interdisciplinary understanding.

default.zh: 导航原理是航天与国防特色高校的自动化类专业的一门重要专业课，是学习后续专业课如飞行器控制与制导、航天器控制、最优导航与滤波等课程的基础，在培养学生导航系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授惯性导航、卫星导航以及组合导航的基本原理，使学生较深入地了解惯性导航要解决的基本问题和基本分析方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、平时作业、后续的实验教学、案例分析、和计算机仿真等环节，培养学生运用工程基础知识和专业知识的分析和设计导航系统的能力，支撑专业毕业要求中相应指标点的达成。 在学生能力培养方面，课程致力于达成以下目标： 课程目标1. 理解惯性导航系统和惯性器件、卫星导航系统和组合导航系统的基本原理、优缺点,具备导航问题分析的知识基础，了解导航的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿方向。 课程目标2. 了解和掌握惯性导航系统和惯性器件、卫星导航系统和组合导航系统的主要分析方法，具备分析和解决工程实践中导航系统问题的能力。 课程目标3. 熟悉和掌握导航系统及器件的基本实验设计能力和计算机仿真方法，获得实验技能，逐步具有应用先进工具解决工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: Principles of Navigation is a specialty course for the automation major students in universities with aerospace and defense backgrounds. It offers a basis for follow-up courses such as Flight-craft Control and Guidance, Spacecraft Control, and Optimal Navigation and Filtering. This course plays an important role in cultivating students' capability of comprehensive analysis and design for navigation system. It mainly covers the fundamental principles of inertial navigation, satellite navigation and integrated navigation, aiming to empower students to analyze the basic problems in inertial navigation. In this course, students will go through sessions of class lecturing, daily homework, experiments, case studies and computer simulations, honing their skills in navigation system design using basic knowledge in engineering and specialty. In terms of skill cultivation, this course tries to help students achieve the following objects: Course object 1: Understand the principles and features of inertial navigation systems (INS), satellite navigation systems (SNS) and integrated navigation systems (IGNS), have the preliminary knowledge for navigation analysis, and learn about the current hotspots, trends and directions in the fields. Course object 2: Understand and master the major analytic approaches for inertial navigation systems and devices, satellite navigation systems, and integrated navigation systems. Be able to tackle the issues in practical navigation systems. Course object 3: Be versed in and grasp the basic techniques in experimental designing and computer simulation for navigations systems and devices, acquire the operational skills, and cultivate the capacity to utilize up-to-date tools for problem solution in engineering practice.

default.zh: “探测与制导系统原理”是探测与制导专业本科生的专业核心课程，是在前期学习自动控制理论、导航原理等专业课的基础上，以制导武器为背景学习目标探测原理和导弹制导原理。该课程是一门工程技术类课程，在培养学生将理论知识与工程实践相结合方面具有重要的作用。 本课程主要包含三部分内容。首先介绍导弹制导系统方面的基础知识，包括导弹概述、导弹制导系统的分类、导引方法、导引头的功能和稳定方式等内容。然后讲授光学制导的原理和方法，内容包括光学基础知识、光电探测器原理、目标与背景的光学特性、红外点源制导系统的原理、红外成像制导系统的原理、红外对抗、电视成像制导原理、激光制导原理等。最后一部分是雷达制导原理，内容包括雷达技术基础、目标与背景的雷达辐射与反辐射特性、雷达导引头测角、测距、测速原理、雷达制导系统等。 课程的教学目的是使学生了解遥控制导、自寻的制导和自主制导系统的适用场景；理解经典导引律的思想；基本掌握光学制导系统和雷达制导系统的基本原理、系统组成、探测精度的影响因素等内容，为学生今后从事相关方向的研究和工作奠定必要的基础。
default.en: "The principles of detection and guidance system" is the core course of the detection and guidance major, which is based on the early studying of the automatic control theory and principles of navigation, learning the principles of target detection and missile guidance based on the background of guided weapon. This course is focused on the engineering technology, which plays an important role in cultivating students to combine theoretical knowledge with engineering practice. This course mainly contains three parts. Firstly, the basic knowledge of missile guidance system is introduced, including the missile overview, the classification of missile guidance system, the law of guidance, the function of the seeker and the stability of the guidance. Then the principle and method of optical guidance are teaching, including optical basic knowledge, photoelectric detector principle, optical characteristics of target and background, principle of infrared point source guidance system, principle of infrared imaging guidance system, infrared countermeasures, TV imaging guidance principle, laser guidance principle, etc. The final part is the radar guidance principle, which includes radar technology base, target and background radar radiation and anti-radiation characteristics, radar guidance head Angle, distance, speed measuring principle, radar guidance system, etc. The purpose of the course is to make students understand the application of remote guidance, self-homing guidance and autonomous guidance systems; to understand the idea of the classic guidance laws; The basic principle of optical guidance system and radar guidance system, to know well about the influence factors of the system and the influence factors of the detection precision and to lay the foundation for the research and work of the students in the future.

default.zh: 该课程是力学专业的一门技术基础课。着重介绍经典控制理论的基本概念、基本理论和基本分析方法。同时，紧密结合工程实际，以空间飞行器系统为研究对象，应用控制理论中的基本方法来分析、研究和解决实际问题。通过本课程的学习，使学生能建立数学和控制系统之间的关系，培养学生的系统概念和掌握系统动态性能的分析方法，为进一步专业课学习和参加控制工程实践奠定必要的基础。 1、树立正确的设计思想，理论联系实际，具有创新精神； 2、掌握控制系统的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，了解飞行器姿态控制的一般规律，具有分析飞行器控制系统的能力； 3、掌握飞行器控制的原理和方法，具有进行仿真研究的初步能力。 4、了解飞行器控制的新理论、新方法及发展趋向。
default.en: This course is a technical foundation course for mechanics majors. It focuses on introducing the basic concepts, basic theories and basic analysis methods of classical control theory. At the same time, it closely integrates with engineering practice, takes space vehicle system as the research object, and applies the basic methods in control theory to analyze, study and solve practical problems. Through the study of this course, students can establish the relationship between mathematics and control system, cultivate the system concept and master the analysis method of system dynamic performance, and lay the necessary foundation for further professional course study and participation in control engineering practice. 1、Establishing correct design ideas, linking theory to practice and having innovative spirit. 2、Master the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic skills of control system, understand the general law of aircraft attitude control, and have the ability to analyze aircraft control system. 3、Master the principles and methods of aircraft control, and have the preliminary ability to conduct simulation research. 4、Know the new theories, new methods and development trends of aircraft control.

default.zh: 计算力学课程主要是一种数值计算方法，如有限单元法有限差分方法。有限元等方法是求解各类工程问题的最有效的数值计算方法。这种数值计算方法是当今广泛应用的计算机求解技术。为此，要求学生深刻理解有限元法和有限差分方法的基本算法和求解方法。教材中首先介绍了有限元刚度矩阵概念和通过插值函数表示的位移方程。然后，介绍了各种能量方法，如卡氏定理、最小势能原理，以及加权余量法。最后，说明了如何应用于求解各类工程力学问题。有限差分方法主要内容包括：双曲方程、抛物方程和椭圆方程的差分格式等。设置该课程的目的就是向学生系统的介绍有限元等数值计算方法，包括数学建模，求解方法和计算程序。使学生能够理解有限元法等方法的基本理论和计算机应用技术。
default.en: The course of computational mechanics is mainly concerned with the numerical methods, e.g., the finite element method and finite difference method, which are the most effective numerical method that can be used to obtain the accurate solutions for various engineering problems. The numerical methods introduced in this textbook are nowadays very widely used computational techniques that it is essential for students to understand their basic solution algorism and applications of those techniques. The concept of finite element stiffness matrix and associated displacement equation in terms of interpolation functions are introduced first. The energy methods such as the first theorem of Castigliano, the principle of minimum potential energy and the method of weighted residual are described and illustrated with various examples. Finally, the applications to various engineering problems are illustrated. The main contents of finite difference method include: finite difference formats for hyperbolic, parabolic and elliptic equations. The material of this course of computational mechanics is expected to be useful for students who would like to learn the mathematical modeling, solution procedure and the computer programs used for solving practical problems. The objective of the course is to introduce various aspects of the numerical methods as applied to engineering problems in a systematic manner and to enable the students to understand the basic theory and computer implementation of the theory developed.

default.zh: 《空气动力学》是飞行器设计与工程、工程力学、飞行器环境与生命保障工程的工程基础类课程。本课程主要讲授空气与物体发生相对运动时，所出现的各种物理现象和遵循的基本规律以及空气与物体之间的相互作用力，以及飞行器气动部件空气动力学特性及其基本计算方法。本课程的教学注重培养学生的兴趣，着重培养学生对空气动力学基础理论知识的掌握，具备必要的空气动力学分析、计算和基本实验技能，为从事专业技术和科学研究打下基础。
default.en: The course Aerodynamics is an engineering basic course covering aircraft design and engineering, engineering mechanics, aircraft environment and life support engineering. This course mainly focuses on the various physical phenomena and basic laws that occur when air and objects move relatively to each other, as well as the aerodynamic characteristics of aircraft aerodynamic components and their basic calculation methods. The aim of this course is to cultivate students' interests on aerodynamics, and to make them master the necessary aerodynamic analysis, calculation and basic experimental skills, laying a foundation for engaging in professional technology and scientific research.

default.zh: 《实验力学》是通过实验的方法来解决力学问题的一门学科，是工程力学专业学生必修的专业基础课。在固体力学中，理论分析和实验分析是紧密相联的两部分，都是解决工程实际问题的重要手段。就固体实验力学而言，它以结构物的原型或模型为研究对象，通过对力学相关的物理量的量测来揭示其力学性态和变化规律。为验证和发展理论研究，保证优选工程设计方案的质量并进行失效分析，以及科学地进行运行管理提供了依据。《实验力学》是一门实践性很强的学科，因而实验教学是《实验力学》课程教学中的最重要的环节。通过实验教学，一方面使学生加深对实验力学基本原理和测试方法的理解，另一方面使学生掌握有关仪器设备的使用方法，培养动手能力及独立思考的能力。
default.en: Experimental Mechanics is a subject related to analyzing the mechanical properties of materials and structures by means of experimental methods. It is a required course for the students majoring in Engineering Mechanics. In Solid Mechanics, both theoretical analysis and experimental research play the key role to solve the problems in practical engineering. Generally speaking, the Experimental Mechanics for solids aims to reveal the mechanical properties and their evolution law of structures or model of real engineering parts. Meanwhile, it provides the fundamental reference for verifying and developing theories, ensuring optimal design, analyzing the failure performance of the engineering structures, as well as ensuring the scientific operation management. The practical part is the most important part for this course. Through experimental teaching, the students can not only have a thorough understanding of the basic measuring methods and principal, but also know the exactly using of apparatus used for mechanical related experiments. Through this course, both the practical ability and independent thinking ability of the students could be improved.

default.zh: 结构动力学是工程力学专业的一门重要的专业基础课。主要内容有：单自由度系统的振动，包括自由振动，固有频率，阻尼；受迫振动，简谐激振，阶跃激振，脉冲激振，任意激振等内容。多自由度系统的振动，包括建模，自由振动，模态频率，振型，正交性；受迫振动，结构响应等内容。连续弹性体的振动，包括杆、梁、板的振动。振动的近似计算方法等
default.en: The structural dynamics is an important basic technical course for the engineering mechanics subject. Its essential contents consist of: Vibration of SDOF system including free vibration, natural frequency, damping; Forced vibration, harmonic excitation, step excitation, impulse excitation, arbitrarily excitation. Vibration of MDOF system including Modeling, Free vibration, modal frequency, modal shape, orthogonal property; Forced vibration, structural response. Vibration of continuous elastic system including vibration of rod, beam，plank and so on. Numerical methods of structural dynamics.

default.zh: 本课程的教学目的旨在通过课堂教学、上机和实验，使学生能够了解断裂与疲劳领域的发展现状，掌握断裂与疲劳力学的基本概念、原理和方法，能正确地应用断裂与疲劳力学的基础理论和方法解决较复杂的工程实际问题，并具备开展相关领域深入科学研究的基本思维继而解决复杂问题的基本能力。通过这门课的学习，要求学生掌握： (1) 了解和掌握当今断裂力学(包括疲劳断裂)的基本概念，原理和方法 (2) 能正确地应用断裂与疲劳力学的基础理论和方法解决较复杂的工程实际问题 (3) 具备开展相关领域深入科学研究的基本思维继而解决复杂问题的基本能力 (4) 具备使用现代计算仿真和实验工具开展断裂力学工程和科学研究的基本能力
default.en: The teaching purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the current development situation in the field of fracture and fatigue, master the basic concepts, principles and methods of fracture and fatigue mechanics, and correctly apply the basic theories and methods of fracture and fatigue mechanics to solve complex practical engineering problems through classroom teaching, computer and experiment. The students should have the basic thoughts to carry out in-depth scientific research in related fields and then the basic ability to solve complex problems. The targets of this course are: (1) Understand and master the basic concepts, principles and methods of current fracture mechanics (including fatigue fracture); (2) Be able to apply the fundamental theories and methods of fracture and fatigue mechanics to solve some relatively complex engineering problems; (3) Have the basic thoughts to carry out in-depth scientific research in related fields and then the basic ability to solve complex problems; (4) Have the basic ability to use modern computational simulation and experimental tools to carry out engineering and scientific research in fracture mechanics.

default.zh: 这是一门培养科学兴趣和提升科学能力素养的课程。通过力学各方向科研教师介绍目前承担的航天领域相关科研工作，使学生们了解航天专业技术发展过程中遇到的问题以及解决方案；促进学生的科研思考能力和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This is a course that cultivates scientific interest and enhances scientific literacy. By introducing the current research work in the aerospace field undertaken by teachers in various fields of mechanics, students can understand the problems encountered in the development of aerospace technology and their solutions; Promote students' scientific research thinking and problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 这是一门培养科学兴趣和提升科学能力素养的课程。通过力学各方向科研教师介绍目前承担的航天领域相关科研工作，使学生们了解航天专业技术发展过程中遇到的问题以及解决方案；促进学生的科研思考能力和解决问题的能力。

By introducing the current research work in the aerospace field undertaken by teachers in various fields of mechanics, students can understand the problems encountered in the development of aerospace technology and their solutions; Promote students' scientific research thinking and problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 这是一门培养科学兴趣和提升科学能力素养的课程。通过力学各方向科研教师介绍目前承担的航天领域相关科研工作，使学生们了解航天专业技术发展过程中遇到的问题以及解决方案；促进学生的科研思考能力和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This is a course that cultivates scientific interest and enhances scientific literacy. By introducing the current research work in the aerospace field undertaken by teachers in various fields of mechanics, students can understand the problems encountered in the development of aerospace technology and their solutions; Promote students' scientific research thinking and problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 通过热力学学习，要求学生牢固掌握热力学中温度、功和热、能量、热力学第一定律和熵、第二定律等的基本概念和基本理论，深刻理解热力学自由能和热力学基本定律在求解热力学问题时的重要作用以及利用自由能值最小化或熵值最大化确定平衡条件，利用平衡条件确定相图的基本原理；熟练地运用这些基本概念和基本原理理解和分析热力学系统，将所学的热力学知识和具体的工程问题融合起来，培养学生的逻辑思维和分析能力，实现学生们能将热力学的基础和专业知识用于解决具体复杂热力学工程问题的目标。 学生学习热力学课程之后，需达到的基本要求如下： 1．对热力学的基本概念和基本分析方法有明确的认识。能确定热力学系统的熵和自由能等状态函数，获取平衡条件并能看懂和分析相图。 2．对自由能和化学势，以及相变和相图有较明确的认识，理解和掌握基本的原理和分析方法。 3．掌握从热力学的角度分析和思考具体工程问题的能力，提高对热力学基础理论的理解，培养底层思维能力，为将来能解决核心问题和在基础层面上进行创新打好基础。
default.en: This is an introductory course to thermodynamics. Topics of this course includes temperature, work and heat, energy, the first law of thermodynamics, entropy and the second law of thermodynamics, free energy, phase transformations of pure substances and mixtures. A portion of the above topics involves statistical mechanics. After finishing this course, students are expected to learn the above topics, fully understand them and are able to apply these fundamental principles to solve related engineering problems.

default.zh: 先进复合材料力学性能测试与仿真方法课程重点培养学生在解决实际工程问题中需要的复合材料制备、力学试验件设计、基本材料力学性能测量以及基本材料力学性能仿真分析方法。本课程是材料力学（固体力学基础）和工程力学实验课程的承接课程，希望通过本课程整合材料力学（固体力学）中的理论基础以及工程力学实验中培养的应变测量能力，以先进复合材料应用为背景，开展基于学生主动思考的实验方案设计、实验实施、理论与实验对比、方案修正与验证、仿真模型构建、网格划分以及有限元求解等教学工作，锻炼学生运用已有知识解决工程实际问题的能力，提升学生团队合作以及沟通技能。
default.en: Experiment and Simulation Methods for Mechanical Properties of Advanced Composite Materials focuses on cultivating students' skills in composite material preparation, mechanical test specimen design, basic material mechanical properties measurement, and basic material mechanical performance simulation analysis methods needed to solve practical engineering problems. This course is a continuation of the Materials Mechanics (Solid Mechanics Fundamentals) and Engineering Mechanics Experiment courses. We hope to integrate the theoretical foundation in Materials Mechanics (Solid Mechanics) and the strain measurement ability cultivated in engineering mechanics experiments through this course. With the application of advanced composite materials as the background, we will carry out experiment design and implementation, theoretical and experimental comparison, simulation based on FEM. The corresponding teaching work develops the students' practical capacity, communication and negotiation skills, and team cooperation ability.

default.zh: 《力学原理在结构设计中的应用与创新实践》创新实训实验课程围绕理论力学、材料力学两门理论课程的主要教学内容，并结合结构动力学、实验力学等相关课程，对传统力学实验加以完善和补充，构成一门独立的创新实验课程。创新实验课是学生由基础课程转为创新能力培养学习的重要教学环节，既承载基础力学实验教学功能，以加深理解力学基本理论，又旨在提升工科学生力学科学实验素质和创新能力。通过课程学习，可以增加学生对力学的学习兴趣，活跃教学与学习环节，发现优秀学生，吸引优秀人才尽快投身于力学学科基础研究和创新创业训练。 通过创新实训实验课程建设与探索，加快我校在力学基础学科拔尖学生培养引领示范作用，初步形成具有哈工大特色、世界水平的力学基础学科拔尖人才培养体系。
default.en: The course of “The Application of Mechanics Principles and Experiment of Innovative Designing in Structure” based on mechanical theory focuses on the main contents of two theoretical courses: Theoretical Mechanics and Material Mechanics, and combines Structural Dynamics, Experimental Mechanics and other related courses to improve and supplement the traditional mechanical experiment, forming an independent innovative experiment course. Innovative experiment course is an important link for students to change from basic theory learning to innovative ability training. It not only carries the teaching function of basic mechanics experiment to deepen the understanding of the basic theory of mechanics, but also aims to improve the mechanical experiment quality and innovation ability of engineering students. Through course learning, students can increase their interest in mechanics, activate teaching and learning links, and to find excellent students and attract excellent talents to participate in basic research and innovation and entrepreneurship training of mechanics as soon as possible. Through the construction and exploration of the innovative course, HIT has accelerated the leading and exemplary role in the cultivation of top-notch students in the basic of mechanics, and initially formed a top talent training system in the basic of mechanics with the characteristics of Harbin Institute of Technology and world leader.

default.zh: 本课程是复合材料与工程以及相关专业的一门重要的技术基础课，主要内容有应用弹性力学、应用塑性力学。在学生学习完基础课，对变形体材料与结构的力学性能有一定了解后，进入专业课学习之前，进一步对变形体的弹性和塑性力学分析方法进行系统的学习，为更好地学习专业课打下坚实基础。本课程主要介绍弹性力学平面问题的基本概念、基本方程、基本解法，空间问题的基本理论与基本解答，以及薄板小挠度弯曲问题的一般理论等。介绍弹性力学的基本概念和分析方法，研究弹性体在外界因素影响下的应力、应变和位移。结合具体的平面问题和空间问题进行学习和应用。研究变形体有弹性进入塑性的屈服条件，产生塑性的加载条件，以及分析塑性变形和应力特征的本构关系。通过本课程的学习，使学生对弹塑性力学的经典研究内容有全面的了解，为后续课程的学习以及今后实际工程应用中奠定重要基础。
default.en: The course is one important technology course of major of composite materials and engineering, as well as related professional basic courses. Its main content includes application elasticity and plasticity mechanics. Students completing the basic course, there is a certain understanding of the mechanical properties of materials and structures for deformable solids, before entering the specialty course, students learn systematically further analysis methods of elasticity and plasticity, in order to lay a solid foundation for better learning professional courses. This course introduces the basic concepts of plane problems, the basic equation, the basic solution, and the general theory of space issues and answers, as well as thin small deflection bending problem with the general theory etc. The basic concepts of elasticity and analytical methods are introduced, and elastomers under the influence of external factors, stress, strain, and displacement are researched. Students learn the combination of a specific plane, and space issues, and have application of them. In addition, we study the yield conditions of the deformable solid, the loading conditions of the plastic solid. The plastic deformation and stress distribution of the deformable solid are then studied by establishing the plastic stress-strain relationship of the deformable solid under external loading and displacement boundaries. Learning through the curriculum, students have a comprehensive understanding of the contents of the Elastic-plastic characteristics of deformable solid, laid an important foundation for the subsequent course of learning as well as practical engineering application in the future.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍复合材料的概念、分类、性能、特征和复合方法等。复合材料的力学行为是本课程的重要内容，主要讲述正交各向异性弹性基体、工程常数、坐标转换、单层板的强度和失效准则以及强度和刚度试验方法；预报单层板性能的宏观和微观力学方法；重点讲解经典层合板理论、应力-应变关系、力和力矩合成、几种典型层合板（对称、反对称和非对称层合板）的刚度矩阵、层合板的强度分析、强度准则、正交和角铺设层合板的强度特点以及层间应力分析等。
default.en: This course introduces the concept of composite materials, the classification, the performance, the features and complex methods of composites. The mechanical behaviors of composites are the major content in this course. It is mainly refer to the orthotropic elastic matrix, engineering constants, coordinate transformation, the strength and criteria of single ply laminates, strength and stiffness testing methods. It provides the macro and micro material mechanical methods to evaluate the effective properties of single lay laminate. Then, it introduces the traditional laminate theory, stress-strain relation, force and moment resultant, stiffness matrix of special laminates (symmetric, antisymmetric and non-symmetric laminates), strength analysis of laminate, strength criteria, strength characteristic of orthotropic and angle-ply laminates and interlaminar stress analysis.

default.zh: 航天器结构是航天飞行器最为关键的分系统之一，它不仅在提供承载、构型、支撑、接口和多种功能方面发挥关键作用，还体现了总体设计理念和整体结构概念，结构效率与可靠性决定了航天器系统的能力与水平。本课程包括环境条件、材料、设计、分析和试验，重点阐述航天器结构设计技术。通过本课程学习掌握航天器结构与机构的基本概念、功能、类型、研制流程以及相关的环境条件和应用的材料；掌握航天器结构的设计方法；掌握航天器机构的设计方法；掌握航天器结构与机构的试验方法。因此，《航天器结构》是工程力学、航天航空以及材料学等相关专业的一门非常重要且特色鲜明的专业核心课，是掌握高要求工程结构设计方法和从事航天器结构研究的基础。
default.en: Spacecraft structure is one of the most critical subsystems of spacecraft. It not only plays a key role in providing load bearing, configuration, support, interface, and multiple functions, but also embodies the concept of overall design and overall structure. Structural efficiency and reliability determine the ability and level of spacecraft system. This course covers environmental conditions, materials, design, analysis and test of spacecrafts, with special focus on the design methods. Through this course, students can master the basic concepts, functions, types, development processes, relevant environmental conditions and applied materials of spacecraft structures and mechanisms; master the design methods of spacecraft structures; master the design methods of spacecraft mechanisms; and master the test methods of spacecraft structures and mechanisms. Therefore, Spacecraft Structure is a very important and distinctive professional core course of engineering mechanics, aerospace, materials science and other related specialties, which is the basis for mastering the design methods of high-demand engineering structures and engaging in spacecraft structure research.

default.zh: 近年来，复合材料实验的方法受到了很大的重视。许多测定金属特性的实验方法，已用于测试纤维增强材料。但是，由于纤维增强复合材料的非均质性和各向异性，在把从金属材料实验技术中的实验方法直接用于测定复合材料特性之前，必须对它们进行认真仔细地审查。另外，复合材料的各种损伤不可避免，如何对典型损伤进行检测，特别是无损检测是当前复合材料领域的热点和难点。因此，本课程在理解与消化传统的实验方法基础上，重点讲解近代力学的研究过程中广泛采用一些新的实验手段和方法，使学生了解近代力学实验方法的发展前沿与分析评价手段。 本课程包括测试理论、制备工艺和测试操作三部分：理论部分主要内容包括一般原理和展望，试样准备，误差分析与实验数据处理，电测技术理论，复合材料力学性能实验方法（拉伸实验、压缩实验、剪切实验、弯曲实验、横向性能测试、层间断裂韧性、冲击实验和疲劳实验），无损检测方法和现代光学测试方法等；制备部分主要包括热压成型工艺和液体成型工艺；测试部分包括纤维增强复合材料拉伸实验、压缩实验和弯曲实验。
default.en: Experimental methods for mechanical properties of composite materials have received much more attention in recent years with the development of fiber reinforced composite materials. Many experimental methods used in determination of metal characteristics have been adopted to test the mechanical properties of fiber reinforced materials. Owing to the heterogeneity and anisotropy of fiber reinforced composite materials, the experimental methods used in metal materials should be carefully checked to determine the valid of the experimental methods. In addition, all kinds of composite damages are unavoidable. How to detect the typical damage, especially in nondestructive testing, is currently a hot topic in the field of composite materials. Therefore, based on understanding and digesting the traditional experimental methods, this course focuses on some new experimental means and methods used in advanced composite materials, and enables students to understand the development frontier and analysis evaluation method of modern mechanical test methods. The main contents of this course include three parts: experimental theory and method, preparation technology and experiment operation. The contents of theoretical parts involve: general principles and perspectives, specimen preparation, error analysis and experimental data processing, electrical measuring technology, experimental method of the mechanical properties (tension, compression, shear, flexure, through-thickness testing, interlaminar fracture toughness, impact and damage tolerance, fatigue), nondestructive testing method and modern optical testing method. The contents of manufacture processes involve: hot pressing process and resin molding process. The contents of experiment operation involve: bending test, tension test and compression test of fiber reinforced composite plates.

default.zh: 计算力学B是讲授力学问题数值计算方法的一门课程，其重点内容是有限元法，是结构分析及力学计算的主要工具和重要方法，也是工程分析中获得最广泛应用的计算分析方法。 计算力学B共32学时，授课内容主要包括：加权余量法、变分原理、最小位能原理等计算力学理论基础，弹性力学平面问题有限元控制方程的建立、特点、求解步骤，有限单元插值函数、等参元、数值积分、有限元方程组的求解方法，以及有限元的计算机程序实现、通用有限元软件演示等内容。 通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握计算力学理论基础、有限元法的基本原理和方法，培养学生在工程实际中分析问题、解决问题的能力，为学生将来工作、研究中，学习和利用有限元软件求解实际问题，奠定良好基础。
default.en: Computational mechanics B is a basic course for many specialties, which mainly instructs the basic theory and the calculate method of the Finite Element Method (FEM). The FEM can be used to analyze the deformation, the stress, the temperature, the heat transfer, and so on, of the different structures and component. To the student, the FEM is now the very important and basic tool for their work and research. The course totally teaches 32 periods. The main content includes: the basic theory and principle of the FEM, the interpolation method and functions, the isoparametric element method, and the numerical integrated method. The content of the computer experiment include: the usage demonstration for the FEM software, reading and modifying the source code of a simple FEM program, the General software(ABQUS) andthe analysis for some example by the General software. Through the study of this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of computational mechanics, and further, apply the methods to analysis engineering problems. So it will lay the foundation for students’ future work and scientific research.

default.zh: 材料物理性能是面向工科试验班复合材料工程方向的本科生开课，是专业课教学中最重要的课程之一，也是学生学习后续专业课的基础。课程内容涵盖材料各种物理性能的物理学概念、物理学原理与机制、物理参量的影响规律分析、物理性能分析在材料的科研和生产中的应用，以及各种物理性能测试和分析方法等方面。 本课程在介绍材料物理基础知识的基础上，主要讲授材料的导电、介电、热学、光学、磁学以及弹性和内耗等性能的物理本质和微观机制。重点掌握材料的成分、微观组织结构对物理性能的影响规律和机理，了解材料常规物理性能测试方法的基本原理。使学生对材料各种物理性能的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势和前沿应用等有明确的认识，并具备分析和解决工程材料宏观物理性能与微观结构特征之间关系的能力，逐步具有利用材料物理性能相关知识解决材料研究实际问题的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，综合期末考试、平时作业和实践能力考核三部分的成绩作为本课程学习的评价标准。
default.en: “Physical Properties of Materials” is one of the most important professional courses orienting to the undergraduates of Compound Materials and Engineering Specialty in engineering experimental class. As a theoretical basic of subsequent specialized courses, the course mainly contains the physical concepts, principles and mechanisms, the influence rules of physical parameters, the applications in the fields of scientific research and productions, measurement and analytical methods, and so on. On the basis of the knowledge of “Materials Physics”, the contents of “Physical Properties of Materials” are focused on the physical essences and micro-mechanisms of solid materials, which include electrical, dielectric, thermal, optical, magnetic, elastic properties and internal friction. It is necessary to mainly grasp the influence rules and mechanisms between the components and microstructure of materials and physical properties, and to understand the basic theories of the properties measuring methods. It is important for the undergraduates to know the theoretical basis, research hotspot, development tendency and cutting-edge applications of diversified physical properties of materials. Based on the study of the course, the relationships between macroscopical physical properties of materials and microstructure feature should be analyzed, and the ability of solving practical problems in material research should be possessed. The accumulative method, including final exam, usual homework and investigation of practical ability, is adopted to evaluate the learning outcome of the course.

default.zh: 材料分析测试方法是介绍材料微观结构表征技术的课程，是材料科学与工程及其相关领域工科大学生重要的技术基础课程,是联系专业基础知识与实际科研工作的纽带。课程主要从衍射技术、显微成像技术、能谱技术以及探针技术四个方面讲授材料微观结构表征方法，具体内容包括XRD、SEM、TEM、EDS等多种表征技术的基本原理、操作以及在相关领域内的最新研究动态。 通过本课程的学习学生应掌握主要材料分析方法的基本理论和操作方法，掌握不同技术的优缺点与应用范围，具备复杂材料表征问题综合分析的能力，能够根据实际需要综合多种表征方法建立快捷有效的实验方案。
default.en: Materials Characterization techniques is a curriculum focusing on the characterization technologies of material microstructures, and is an important technical core course for students in the major of material science and engineering and related fields. It works as a bridge to connect the fundamental knowledge and practical research work together. The content of the course can be categorized into four aspects based on the principles, including diffraction technologies, imaging technologies, spectroscope and scanning probe technologies. Specific attention will be placed on XRD, SEM, TEM, EDS, and the latest research trends in the related fields will be presented as well. By learning this course, students should grasp the basic theory and operation of the main material characterization techniques, understand their advantages and disadvantages, application scope, and gain the ability to analyze the microstructure of complex material.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础BII》课程是复合材料与工程专业的一门专业方向核心课程。材料科学理论是复合材料与结构学科的重要基础和支柱。本课程主要内容包括：材料热力学，相图的分析和使用方法，掌握以相变方法改变材料晶体结构、微观组织结构的原理和规律，包括材料热力学、相图、扩散、凝固和结晶、固态相变等基础理论。 通过本课程的学习，学生应掌握材料科学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: “Fundamentals of Materials Science and Engineering BII” as a main specialized basic course focuses on the basic theories of composite materials science and engineering. The contents of this course involve: material thermodynamics, phase diagram and phase transition, diffusion, solidification and crystallization, solid phase transition. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of material science and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍复合材料的概念、分类、性能、特征和复合方法等。复合材料的力学行为是本课程的重要内容，主要讲述正交各向异性弹性基体、工程常数、坐标转换、单层板的强度和失效准则以及强度和刚度试验方法；预报单层板性能的宏观和微观力学方法；重点讲解经典层合板理论、应力-应变关系、力和力矩合成、几种典型层合板（对称、反对称和非对称层合板）的刚度矩阵、层合板的强度分析、强度准则、正交和角铺设层合板的强度特点以及层间应力分析等。
default.en: This course introduces the concept of composite materials, the classification, the performance, the features and complex methods of composites. The mechanical behaviors of composites are the major content in this course. It is mainly refer to the orthotropic elastic matrix, engineering constants, coordinate transformation, the strength and criteria of single ply laminates, strength and stiffness testing methods. It provides the macro and micro material mechanical methods to evaluate the effective properties of single lay laminate. Then, it introduces the traditional laminate theory, stress-strain relation, force and moment resultant, stiffness matrix of special laminates (symmetric, antisymmetric and non-symmetric laminates), strength analysis of laminate, strength criteria, strength characteristic of orthotropic and angle-ply laminates and interlaminar stress analysis.

default.zh: 复合材料导论课程是高等工科院校复合材料与工程专业的一门重要的基础课。其目的是使学生通过对本课程的学习，了解复合材料的定义、特点、分类和应用，了解复合材料的基本性能和发展概况，掌握近年来国内外复合材料研究的新理论、新进展，获得复合材料技术必要的基本理论、基本知识，为后续专业课程的学习和从事复合材料的研究打下坚实基础。本课程主要讲授复合材料领域中的基本理论和基础知识，以及近年来国内外复合材料研究的新理论、新进展。包括复合材料定义、分类、特性等基础知识、基体材料、增强材料、复合材料界面、聚合物基复合材料、金属基复合材料、陶瓷基复合材料等内容，是复合材料与工程专业学生非常重要的核心课，在培养学生具备一定的复合材料与工程的综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。通过本课程的课堂教学和课后实践等环节，为后续专业基础课和专业课学习打下良好的基础。
default.en: Introduction of Composite Materials course is an important basic course for composite materials and engineering major’s students. The aim of this course is enable students to understand the definition, characteristics, classification and application of composites, to understand the basic properties and development of composites, to study the new theory and progress of composite materials in recent years, and to obtain basic theories and basic knowledge of composite materials. This course mainly teaches the basic theory and basic knowledge in the field of composite materials, as well as the new theories and developments of composite materials research at home and abroad in recent years, including the definition, classification, characteristics and other basic knowledge of composite materials, matrix materials, reinforced materials, composites interface, polymer matrix composites, metal matrix composites, ceramic matrix composites and so on. It is an important basic course for composite materials and engineering major’s students. Through classroom teaching and after-school practice, it plays an important role in training students' comprehensive analysis ability and design ability of composite materials and engineering. It is very helpful for the follow-up professional basic courses and specialized courses study.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础上》主要讲述材料结构和工艺的理论基础，主要研究材料的组成、结构与性能之间的相互关系和变化规律。本课程重点讲授晶体结构与缺陷（点缺陷、面缺陷）等材料科学基础理论等内容。为后续课程奠定基础，同时为将来从事复合材料研究与开发打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Fundamentals of Materials Science and Engineering mainly discusses the theoretical basis of material structure and technology. The course mainly explains the composition of materials, the interrelationship and variation patterns between structure and performance. The course focuses on the fundamental theories of materials science, such as crystal structure and defects (point defects, surface defects). To lay the foundation for subsequent courses and lay a solid theoretical foundation for future research and development in composite materials.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础》主要讲述材料结构和工艺的理论基础，主要研究材料的组成、结构与性能之间的相互关系和变化规律。本课程重点讲授晶体结构与缺陷（点缺陷、面缺陷）等材料科学基础理论等内容。为后续课程奠定基础，同时为将来从事复合材料研究与开发打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Fundamentals of Materials Science and Engineering mainly discusses the theoretical basis of material structure and technology, and mainly studies the interrelationships and variation patterns between the composition, structure, and properties of materials. This course focuses on the fundamental theories of materials science, such as crystal structure and defects (point defects, surface defects). To lay the foundation for subsequent courses and lay a solid theoretical foundation for future research and development in composite materials

default.zh: 《材料科学基础》是力学拔尖学生培养基地善义班的一门专业方向核心课程。材料科学是现代科学技术的重要物质基础和支柱。本课程主要内容包括:晶体结构与缺陷，包括空间点阵、指数标定、结合键、常见晶体结构的几何特征、晶体缺陷、界面以及塑性变形等基础知识；相图的分析和使用方法，掌握以相变方法改变材料晶体结构、微观组织结构的原理和规律，包括材料热力学、相图、扩散、凝固和结晶、固态相变等基础理论。 通过本课程的学习，学生应掌握材料科学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: “Fundamentals of Materials Science” as a main specialized basic course focuses on the basic theories of materials science and engineering. The contents of this course involve: crystal structure and defects, including space lattice, index calibration, bond, common crystal structure, crystal defects, interface and plastic deformation; phase diagram and phase transition, including material thermodynamics, phase diagram, diffusion, solidification and crystallization, solid phase transition. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of material science and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 《复合材料与结构》主要讲授复合材料基本概念、分类、特点及基本性能，复合材料层板基础理论和方法，复合材料破坏机理与破坏准则，典型复合材料结构的设计方法及准则，复合材料制备工艺，复合材料与结构力学性能测试方法等。要求学生掌握复合材料的概念、基本性能和材料设计基本概念；掌握经典层合板理论以及单层板微观和宏观力学性能的分析方法，应用刚度矩阵分析层合板的刚度特性，利用强度准则进行层板的破坏分析，根据刚度和重量设计要求进行层合板的铺层计算和设计；掌握复合材料结构设计方法和复合材料结构设计一般原则；掌握复合材料的成型工艺基本概念、特点和工艺基础理论以及复合材料实验方法和测试设备的操作要领，具备一定的解决复合材料结构制备与评价实际问题的能力。
default.en: The course "Composite Materials and Structures" mainly teaches the basic concepts, classifications, characteristics, and basic properties of composite materials, basic theories and methods of composite laminates, failure mechanisms and criteria of composite materials, design methods and criteria of typical composite material structures, preparation techniques of composite materials, and testing methods for mechanical properties of composite materials and structures. Require students to master the concepts, basic properties, and material design of composite materials; Master the classic theory of laminated plates and the analysis methods of micro and macro mechanical properties of single-layer plates, apply stiffness matrix analysis to analyze the stiffness characteristics of laminated plates, use strength criteria to analyze the failure of laminated plates, and calculate and design the layering of laminated plates according to the requirements of stiffness and weight design; Master the design methods and general principles of composite material structures; Master the basic concepts, characteristics, and basic theories of composite material forming technology, as well as the operation essentials of composite material experimental methods and testing equipment, and have the ability to solve practical problems in the preparation and evaluation of composite material structures.

default.zh: 科学与工程计算基础是利用计算机求解计算模型的数值分析方法的基础课程，是工科数学分析、代数与几何、固体力学基础的后续课程，用来衔接飞行器、力学或者复合材料相关专业课程。本课程包括插值、拟合、数值积分法、非线性方程求解、线性方程组求解、常微分方程数值解法、有限元方法、Monte-Carlo方法、神经网络及机器学习方法入门等内容。本课程特别注重学生的计算分析能力和程序编写能力的培养，增强利用数值模拟解决力学和航天国防领域相关挑战性科学和工程问题的能力。通过学习本课程，使学生能够掌握科学与工程计算分析方法，并且能够做相应的误差分析，并且具有实现算法的编程能力，提高学生综合运用数值分析方法解决实际工程问题的能力。
default.en: Calculating Fundamentals of Scientific and Engineering is a basic course of numerical analysis methods for solving computational models using computers. It is a follow-up course of Engineering Mathematical Analysis, Algebra and Geometry, and Solid Mechanics, which is used to link professional courses related to Aircraft Design, Mechanics, or Composite Materials. This course includes interpolation, fitting, Numerical integration, nonlinear Equation solving, System of linear equations solving, Ordinary differential equation numerical solution, Finite element method, Monte Carlo method, neural network and introduction to machine learning methods. This course pays special attention to the cultivation of students' numerical analysis and programming abilities, enhancing their ability to solve challenging scientific and engineering problems in the fields of mechanics and aerospace defense through numerical simulation. By studying this course, students will be able to master scientific and engineering calculation and analysis methods, perform corresponding error analysis, and have the programming ability to implement algorithms, improving their ability to comprehensively apply numerical analysis methods to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 飞行器设计基础是飞行器设计学科的一门主干技术基础课，包括导弹及运载火箭总体设计、远程火箭弹道学与制导方法和航天器轨道动力学三个部分。 通过导弹及运载火箭总体设计部分的学习，让学生掌握导弹及运载火箭各分系统在总体设计阶段需要遵循的设计思路及设计方法等基础知识，以及在设计初级阶段需要给出的主要设计参数及以后详细设计时可依据的经验公式等经验知识；通过远程火箭弹道学与制导方法的学习，使学生掌握远程火箭弹道及制导模型建立、分析求解和设计方案论证的理论及方法，具有基本的飞行器弹道及制导方案设计能力，以及分析和解决工程实践问题的创新意识和设计能力；建立航天器动力学的基本概念，理解飞行器的运动与受力之间的关系，掌握航天器轨道动力学问题的基本分析方法；通过航天器轨道动力学，掌握应用航天器轨道动力学的基本理论，解决一般的航天器轨道动力学应用问题的基本技能。 开设本课程的主要目的是为了满足新形势下的航天人材需求和新型人才培养模式的要求，拓宽飞行器设计学科的专业领域，突出专业特点，使学生熟练掌握飞行器设计方面的专业基础知识，提高他们的理论分析和解决工程问题的应用能力，培养符合我国航天事业未来发展要求的专业性人材。
default.en: Fundamentals of Aircraft Design is a main technical basic course of aircraft design discipline, including three parts : System Design of Missile and Launch Vehicle, Long-Range Rocket Ballistics and Guidance, and Orbital Dynamics of Spacecraft. Through the study of System Design of Missile and Launch Vehicle, students can master the basic knowledge of design ideas and design methods that need to be followed in the overall design stage of each subsystem of missile and launch vehicle, as well as the main design parameters that need to be given in the initial stage of design and the empirical formulas that can be used in the later detailed design. Through the study of Long-Range Rocket Ballistics and Guidance, students can master the theory and method of long-range rocket ballistics and guidance model establishment, analysis and solution, and design scheme demonstration. They have basic aircraft trajectory and guidance scheme design ability, as well as innovative consciousness and design ability to analyze and solve engineering practice problems. The basic concept of spacecraft dynamics is established, the relationship between the motion and the force of the spacecraft is understood, and the basic analysis method of the spacecraft orbit dynamics is mastered. Through the study of Orbital Dynamics of Spacecraft, students can master the basic theory of spacecraft orbital dynamics, and solve the basic skills of general spacecraft orbital dynamics application problems. The main purpose of this course is to meet the needs of aerospace talents and the requirements of new talent training mode under the new situation, to broaden the professional field of aircraft design discipline, to highlight the professional characteristics, to enable students to master the professional basic knowledge of aircraft design, to improve their theoretical analysis and application ability to solve engineering problems, and to cultivate professional talents in line with the future development requirements of China 's aerospace industry.

default.zh: 《飞行器动力学与控制》是飞行器设计与工程类专业的一门非常重要的基础核心课程，在培养学生飞行器动力学建模与分析、控制系统分析与设计和解决实际工程问题的能力等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要包含飞行器结构动力学、控制理论基础以及姿态动力学与控制三个部分。在飞行器结构动力学部分，通过讲授结构动力学的科学理论知识，使学生掌握关于典型结构固有频率、模态、频率响应函数等重要概念，以及模态分解与叠加的结构振动分析方法。在控制理论基础部分，通过讲授控制系统的构成、工作原理和各部件的作用; 使学生掌握建立控制系统数学模型的方法，以及分析与综合控制系统的几种方法：时域法、根轨迹法、频率法、状态空间法和相平面法。并使学生了解典型线性控制系统和非线性系统的分析和综合方法，建立起以系统的概念、数学模型的概念、动态过程的概念、闭环反馈的概念、综合设计的概念。在姿态动力学与控制部分，通过讲授航天器姿态动力学、姿态控制方面的相关概念，使学生了解和掌握航天器姿态动力学建模、航天器姿态确定和航天器姿态控制的基本原理，以及自旋航天器、三轴稳定航天器姿态动力学建模方法和姿态控制方法。教授专业知识的同时，培养学生飞行器动力学建模、分析与控制系统设计的能力，强化科学素养的同时，培养学生解决实际工程问题能力。
default.en: Aircraft Dynamics and Control is a very important basic core course for aircraft design and engineering majors. It plays an important role in cultivating students’ ability of aircraft dynamics modeling and analysis, control system analysis and design, and solving practical engineering problems. This course mainly includes three parts : flight vehicle structural dynamics, control theory basis and attitude dynamics and control. In the part of flight vehicle structural dynamics, by teaching the scientific theoretical knowledge of structural dynamics, students can master important concepts such as natural frequency, mode and frequency response function of typical structures, as well as structural vibration analysis methods based on modal decomposition and superposition. In the basic part of control theory, the composition, working principle and function of each component of the control system are taught. It enables students to master the method of establishing the mathematical model of the control system and several methods of analyzing and synthesizing the control system, such as time domain method, root locus method, frequency method, state space method and phase plane method. In addition, it leads the students to understand the analysis and synthesis method of the typical linear control system and nonlinear system. What’s more, it leads the students to establish the concept of system, the concept of mathematical model, the concept of dynamic process, the concept of closed-loop feedback and the concept of comprehensive design. In the part of attitude dynamics and control, the attitude dynamics and attitude control of spacecraft are taught. In the part of attitude dynamics and control, by teaching the related concepts of spacecraft attitude dynamics and attitude control, students can understand and master the basic principles of spacecraft attitude dynamics modeling, spacecraft attitude determination and spacecraft attitude control, as well as the attitude dynamics modeling method and attitude control method of spin spacecraft and three-axis stabilized spacecraft. While teaching professional knowledge, this course cultivates students' ability of aircraft dynamics modeling, analysis and control system design. While strengthening scientific literacy, this course also cultivates students' ability to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 智能结构与系统设计，是一门培养学生掌握智能结构与系统的一般设计方法的专业核心课。在前期材料力学、弹塑性力学、材料科学与工程基础、智能材料与结构力学基础等课程基础上，本课程主要从动力学及其设计、智能控制基础、智能结构与系统的一般设计方法等方面出发，系统培养学生综合运用材料学、力学、智能控制等方面的能力，让学生掌握一般智能结构的系统性设计的综合能力。本课程讲授静态结构设计方法、动态结构力学基本理论和及其设计方法、信号测试与分析的基本理论及方法、智能控制的基本理论及其工具；在此基础上，讲授智能结构的传感和驱动方法，并基于典型智能材料，进行融合传感、控制与作动的智能系统的综合设计及应用。
default.en: Intelligent Structure and System Design is a professional core course that trains students to master the general design methods of smart structures and systems. On the basis of the previous courses of mechanics of materials, elastoplastic mechanics, fundamentals of materials science and engineering, and fundamentals of smart materials and structural mechanics, this course mainly covers the aspects of dynamics and its design, smart control foundation. This course includes general design methods of smart structures and systems, and systematically cultivates students' ability to comprehensively use materials science, mechanics, smart control, etc., so that students can master the comprehensive ability of systematic design of general smart structures. Students will learn: static structure design methods, basic theories and design methods of dynamic structural mechanics, basic theories and methods of signal testing and analysis, basic theories and tools of smart control. On this basis, students will further learn: the sensing and driving methods of smart structures, and based on typical smart materials, the comprehensive design and application of smart systems that integrate sensing, control and operation are carried out.

default.zh: 软物质（soft matter）泛指处于固体和理想流体之间的复杂物质，主要共同点是其基本单元之间的相互作用比较弱，熵效应显著，且易形成有序结构，广泛存在于自然界，而且由于其丰富、奇特的性质，在人类的生活和生产活动中也得到广泛应用。智能软物质材料与器件课程主要讲授软物质基本概念，发展现状和趋势，并详细介绍电致活性聚合物、形状记忆高分子、凝胶、液晶弹性体、电磁流变体等典型软物质，以及器件和应用方面的知识。
default.en: Soft matters generally refer to the complex matters between solid and ideal fluid. The main common characteristics of soft matters are the weak interaction between their basic units, the significant entropy effect, and the easy-to-form ordered structures, which makes them widely exist in nature. Due to their rich and peculiar nature, soft matters have also been widely used in production and life of human beings. The course of Smart Soft Matter Materials and Devices mainly teaches the basic concepts, development status and trends of soft matters, and introduces in detail typical soft matters such as electroactive polymers, shape memory polymers, gels, liquid crystal elastomers, electromagnetic rheological material, and their applications in the devices.

default.zh: 智能材料与结构实验课程是通过智能材料与结构的集成化设计实验，使学生进一步深入了解作为传感器、智能驱动器的各类主流智能材料的原理、制备、表征方法，掌握面向实际工程应用的智能结构的设计、集成制造与性能测试方法。通过该课程的学习，掌握与智能材料与结构相关的材料学、力学、结构设计、实验测试等方面的专业知识，并能够根据研究与应用场景的不同需求，具有进行智能材料与结构的设计、分析与研制能力，解决实际工程问题。
default.en: The course of Smart Materials and Structures Experiment aims to deepen students' comprehension of the principles, preparation, and characterization methods of various smart materials as sensors and smart actuators. It also teaches them how to design, manufacture, and test the performance of smart structures oriented to practical engineering applications. Through the study of this course, students will master the professional knowledge of materials science, mechanics, structural design, experimental test and other aspects related to smart materials and structures. Furthermore, students will also acquire the skills to design, analyze and develop smart materials and structures and solve practical engineering problems according to different requirements of research and application scenarios.

default.zh: 智能材料分析测试方法实验课程是通过智能材料与机构系统的集成化设计实验，进一步深入了解作为传感器、智能驱动器的各类主流智能材料的工作原理、性能测试与表征方法，实现面向实际工程应用的智能结构的设计与集成制造方法。通过该课程的学习，掌握与智能材料与结构相关的材料学、力学、结构设计、实验测试等方面的专业知识，并能够根据研究与应用场景的不同需求，具有进行智能材料与结构的设计、分析与研制能力，解决实际工程问题。
default.en: The experiment course of the Intelligent Materials Analysis and Test Methods is to further understand the working principle, performance testing and characterization methods of intelligent materials as sensors and intelligent drivers, and realize the design and integrated manufacturing method oriented to practical engineering applications. Through this course, it should master the professional knowledge of materials science, mechanics, structural design, experimental tests and other aspects related to smart materials and structures. Furthermore, according to different requirements of research and application scenarios, it should acquire the skills to design, analyze and develop smart materials and structures and solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 在前期材料力学、弹塑性力学、材料科学与工程基础、智能结构与系统设计等课程基础上，本课程主要选取典型专业问题，从设计及其仿真分析角度，进程课程设计。让学生综合掌握并运用智能控制基础、智能结构与系统的一般设计方法，训练学生综合运用力学、材料学、智能控制等方面的专业能力。针对典型结构，开展融合传感、控制与作动的智能系统的综合设计，让学生掌握一般智能结构的系统性设计的综合能力。
default.en: Based on the courses such as material mechanics, elastic plastic mechanics, material science and engineering foundation, intelligent structure and system design, this course mainly selects typical professional issues, from the perspective of design and its simulation analysis, procedure curriculum design. Let students comprehensively master and use the general design methods of intelligent control foundation, intelligent structure and system, and train students to comprehensively use professional ability such as mechanics, material science, and intelligent control. For typical structures, the comprehensive design of the intelligent system that integrates sensing, control and movement, allows students to master the comprehensive ability of the systemic design of general intelligent structures.

default.zh: 智能高分子材料设计与合成是智能材料与结构专业的专业基础课,为后续专业课和毕业论文打下理论基础。本课程综合运用高分子的有关知识和内容，对学生进行智能高分子材料的化学知识的讲解。 使学生掌握智能高分子材料合成和智能高分子材料反应的基本理论和基础知识。通过本课程的学习，使学生对高分子材料的合成、制备和改性有基本认识，并能将其应用于智能高分子材料合成反应的条件控制中，具有设计新型智能高分子材料的能力和解决其合成过程中实际问题的能力。能够基于相关背景知识进行合理分析，在多学科环境中应用。
default.en: Design and Synthesis of Smart Polymer Materials is one of the foundation courses for the major of Smart Materials and Structures, which builds a solid foundation for the following specialty courses and graduation project. This course systematically integrates polymer science knowledge to deliver comprehensive instruction on chemical principles governing smart polymer materials. Students will acquire fundamental theories and methodologies for synthesizing and reacting smart polymers. Through this curriculum, learners develop essential understanding of polymer synthesis, preparation, and modification processes. They will master the application of controlled reaction conditions in smart polymer material synthesis, cultivating both the ability to design novel materials and practical problem-solving skills during production. The program equips students with interdisciplinary analytical capabilities to conduct informed analyses and apply knowledge across multiple scientific domains.

default.zh: 《弹箭空气动力学》是飞行器设计与工程、飞行器环境与生命保障工程、空间科学与技术专业本科生的一门专业课程，通过本课程的学习，使学生初步了解弹、箭部件气动力设计原理和分析方法，在内容上兼顾弹、箭结构的特殊性与一般绕流物体的一般性，重点掌握空气动力学的基本概念、基本原理及分析导弹和火箭的主要部件及组合体在不同状态下的空气动力特性的基本方法，使学生树立正确的飞行器结构工程设计思想，培养学生对所学理论的综合运用能力，为学生进一步从事飞行器设计工作打下基础。
default.en: Aerodynamics of Missile and Rocket is a specialized course for undergraduate students majoring in Aircraft Design and Engineering, Aircraft Environment and Life Support Engineering, Space Science and Technology. This course has a simple object to provide an insight into related knowledge regarding aerodynamic design theory and analysis method of missile and rocket, including particularity of missile and rocket structure and universality of flow around the object. This course focuses on elucidating basic concepts of aerodynamics, basic principles and the basic methods of analyzing the aerodynamic characteristics of the main components and components of missiles and rockets in different states.
