It is an important course to form the engineering design idea of aircraft structure. This course emphasizes the combination of physics theory with practical applications. It can be used for some practical purpose including spacecraft design.

default.zh: 《航天器姿态动力学与控制》是飞行器设计与工程类专业的一门主干专业核心课。本课程是学生从基础课学习阶段过渡到专业课学习阶段的重要环节，利用基础课所学的知识和技能进行综合，进一步学习航天器姿态动力学、姿态控制方面的基本原理和方法，具有较强的理论性和实际应用性，使学生掌握基本的航天器姿态动力学建模的原理和方法以及姿态控制设计相关概念和原理。本课程将为学生进一步学习本专业其他专业课程打下基础。 教学内容包括：航天器姿态运动学和姿态动力学的基本概念，以及姿态动力学建模基本原理；自旋航天器、重力梯度稳定航天器、三轴姿态稳定航天器的姿态动力学建模方法及姿态运动分析；航天器姿态确定原理，自旋稳定航天器、三轴稳定航天器的姿态确定方法；自旋稳定航天器和三轴稳定航天器的姿态控制原理及设计方法；航天器姿态控制系统设计过程。 通过本门课程的学习，使学生初步掌握航天器姿态动力学与姿态控制的基本原理和方法，为将来从事航天器姿态动力学以及姿态控制系统设计等相关应用专业的研究工作或本专业进一步深造奠定初步的理论基础。
default.en: ‘Attitude Dynamics and Control of Spacecraft’ is one of branch and basic courses for Specialty of Spacecraft Design and Engineering. This course transfers students from basic course learning step to specialized course learning step. This course concentrate on theory and application. It will enhances the ability of students for mastering knowledge and skill in basic course. Students will have a deeper understanding on principles of attitude dynamics and control. The purpose of this course is to make student possess the capacity on dynamic modeling and attitude control. This course will give a basic understanding for learning other specialized courses. The main contents of the course include: the basic concepts and knowledge of attitude kinematics and dynamics for spacecraft, and the modeling principles of attitude dynamics, and the attitude dynamical equations and modeling method for spin, dual-spin, gravity stabilization and three axis stabilization spacecraft; And also the basic principle and methods of attitude determination; the main methods of attitude determination for spin or three axis stabilization spacecraft; The principles and methods of attitude control for spin, dual-spin spacecraft and three axis stabilization spacecraft; and the design and implement process of attitude control system for spacecraft. Students will possess the capacity of attitude dynamic modeling and control when the course is finished. It is a foundation for students to engage in related work or have further learning on this major field.

default.zh: 远程火箭弹道学与制导方法是飞行器设计学科的一门专业选修课，是根据专业培养方案改革需求而开设的新增课程，主要为了开拓学生在运载火箭、弹道导弹弹道学及制导方面的相关知识。 课程内容包括两部分：第一部分为运载火箭及弹道导弹弹道学，包括相关背景知识，常用坐标系，运载火箭及弹道导弹受力分析，运载火箭及弹道导弹主动段、被动段、自由段和再入段运动分析，弹道计算，参数估算等；第二部分为运载火箭及弹道导弹制导方法，包括运载火箭及弹道导弹摄动制导方法，运载火箭及弹道导弹显式制导方法，运载火箭及弹道导弹组合制导方法等。 开设本课程的主要目的是为了满足新形势下的航天人材需求和新型人才培养模式的要求，拓宽飞行器设计学科的专业领域，突出专业特点，使学生熟练掌握运载火箭、弹道导弹弹道学及制导方面的专业基础知识，提高他们的理论分析和解决工程问题的应用能力，培养符合我国航天事业未来发展要求的专业性人材。
default.en: Long-Range Rocket Ballistics and Guidance is taken as an elective major course by college students of Spacecraft Design Disciplines and intended to give practical training to reinforce theoretical knowledge. The course contents include introduction about long-range rocket, reference frames, dynamics and kinematics, ballistics, states estimate, perturbed guidance, explicit guidance and integrated guidance. The main objectives of this course is to familiarize the students with concepts, principles and applications of the long-range rocket ballistics and guidance, and train them to acquire the necessary skills to analyze and research the long-range rocket ballistics and guidance so that the students’ abilities in analysis and applications can be improved and they can contribute their knowledge to national aerospace science and technology.

default.zh: 飞向太空是人类千百年来的梦想，第一颗人造地球卫星的发射成功把这个梦想变成了现实。半个世纪以来航天技术获得了飞跃性的发展，航天飞行器也达到了一个相当高的水平。人类的航天器可以飞的更远，可以造的更复杂完成更多的任务。 航天器轨道动力学是研究航天器在引力和其它外力作用下如何运动问题的科学，是航天工程的基础。航天工程中的轨道设计、轨道确定、轨道控制、轨道拦截、交会对接、编队飞行和返回轨道等技术问题，都需要有轨道动力学理论的支持。本课程主要研究航天器轨道动力学的基本概念、原理和应用，其主要任务是培养学生：建立航天器动力学的基本概念，理解飞行器的运动与受力之间的关系，掌握航天器轨道动力学问题的基本分析方法；掌握应用航天器轨道动力学的基本理论，解决一般的航天器轨道动力学应用问题的基本技能；了解航天器轨道动力学理论、方法及其应用的最新发展；掌握使用相关的参考文献、计算机应用软件进行动力学问题研究分析的能力。
default.en: Flying into space has been a human dream for thousands of years, and the successful launch of the first artificial Earth satellite has turned this dream into a reality. Over the past half century, space technology has achieved leapfrog development, and spacecraft have also reached a considerable level. Human spacecraft can fly farther and be built more complex to complete more tasks. Orbital dynamics of spacecraft is the science that studies how spacecraft move under the influence of gravity and other external forces, and is the foundation of aerospace engineering. The technical issues of orbit design, orbit determination, orbit control, orbit interception, rendezvous and docking, formation flight, and return orbit in aerospace engineering all require the support of orbital dynamics theory. This course mainly studies the basic concepts, principles, and applications of spacecraft orbital dynamics. Its main task is to cultivate students to establish the basic concepts of spacecraft dynamics, understand the relationship between the motion and force of spacecraft, and master the basic analysis methods of spacecraft orbital dynamics problems; Master the basic theory of spacecraft orbital dynamics and the basic skills to solve general spacecraft orbital dynamics application problems; Understand the latest developments in the theory, methods, and applications of spacecraft orbital dynamics; Master the ability to use relevant references and computer application software for dynamic problem research and analysis.

default.zh: 《导弹飞行力学》是工科高等学校航天类专业的一门主干技术基础课，重点讲授导弹飞行动力学的基本概念与基础知识，主要包括：飞行器运动方程组、方案飞行与方案弹道、导引弹道的运动学分析、导弹纵向动态特性分析、导弹侧向动态特性分析、扰动运动的自动稳定与控制等。并强调其在导弹制导系统设计中的应用，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和导弹制导系统设计实践能力方面占有重要的地位。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学和项目研究等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和飞行力学科学知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Missile Flight Dynamics is a backbone basic technical course for aerospace majors in engineering colleges and universities. It focuses on the basic concepts and knowledge of missile flight dynamics, including: Equations of aircraft motion, program flight and program trajectory, kinematics analysis of guided trajectory, analysis of missile longitudinal dynamic characteristics, analysis of missile lateral dynamic characteristics, automatic stabilization and control of disturbance motion, etc. It is emphasized that its application in missile guidance system design plays an important role in training students' creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and practical ability of missile guidance system design. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' innovation consciousness and ability and application ability of flight mechanics scientific knowledge through classroom teaching and project research, so as to support the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results.

default.zh: 导弹及运载总体设计是飞行器设计专业的一门专业课，是作为将来要从事航天事业的学子所必须掌握的一门专业知识，学习这门课的主要目的是让学生掌握导弹及运载火箭各分系统在总体设计阶段需要遵循的设计思路及设计方法等基础知识；了解这样一类大的系统在设计初级阶段需要给出的主要设计参数及以后详细设计时可依据的经验公式等经验知识；掌握导弹及运载火箭发展现状及未来趋势的新兴知识；初步了解未来导弹及运载火箭设计需要掌握的相关交叉学科基本知识；通过课程学习使学生具备从总体设计的角度出发给出设计结果的基本设计能力，具备导弹及运载火箭的战术技术指标论证分析能力；通过课程学习使学生具备团队协作和沟通的基本素质，因此在本专业的教学计划中占有比较重要的地位，也会为今后走向航天领域工作岗位打下一定的理论基础。 本课程的主要内容有战术导弹及运载火箭总体设计阶段的设计原理及有关设计方法，其中包括导弹的研制过程与发展、战术技术要求的拟定、主要设计参数的确定、导弹外形设计、部位安排与质心定位计算及导弹系统性能分析；运载火箭的弹道及运载能力的分析、运载火箭总体方案的选择；导弹及火箭总体参数设计优化；导弹武器系统作战效能分析等内容。要求学生掌握导弹及运载火箭的基本设计原理、设计流程、设计方法等。
default.en: The System Design of Missile and Launch Vehicle is taken as a required major course by college students of Spacecraft Design Disciplines and intended to give practical training to reinforce theoretical knowledge. The course contents include introduction about System Design of the Missile and Launch Vehicle, reference frames, principles, theories and methods. The main objectives of this course is to familiarize the students with concepts, principles and applications of the general design of missile and launch vehicle, and train them to acquire the necessary skills to analyze and research the design theories and methods so that the students’ abilities in analysis and applications can be improved and they can contribute their knowledge to national aerospace science and technology.

default.zh: 《航天器总体设计》是飞行器设计专业的一门专业课程，从工程设计的角度讲授航天器总体设计知识，了解航天器设计的特点与设计原则，掌握任务分析、总体方案设计、航天器构形设计、航天器工程系统等相关知识，分析航天器工程设计中的各种实际问题，形成初步的航天器总体设计与系统分析能力。 本课程主要包括：航天工程系统、航天器研制阶段划分、航天器总体设计的任务及特点、航天器任务分析及运行轨道方案选择、总体方案可行性论证及航天工程系统接口、总体方案设计及航天器构型设计、总体详细设计、空间环境影响及对策、航天器研制技术流程。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时成绩、课下作业成绩、期末考试成绩。期末考试采取闭卷笔试的方式。
default.en: This lesson is the major course for students from spacecraft design and engineering and lectured by introducing spacecraft overall design concept, design principle, design methodology and relative overall design knowledge. The detail content of the lesson includes space engineering system and spacecraft system constitution; spacecraft task analysis and orbit design; feasibility demonstration spacecraft overall scheme design and interface of space engineering system; spacecraft overall scheme design and spacecraft structure & allocation design principle; the influence of space environment to spacecraft； research flow of spacecraft manufacturing.

default.zh: 飞行器制导、导航及控制系统是飞行器的核心系统，是表征飞行器性能先进与否的关键系统。该系统由先进的敏感器、执行机构、控制计算机及控制软件组成，数字控制是飞行器制导、导航及控制系统的发展方向。飞行器设计综合实验这门课程包括飞行器制导、导航及姿态控制系统的理论方法，硬件如DSP、三轴台、光纤陀螺敏感器、IMU、视觉敏感器、太阳敏感器、喷气系统和反作用飞轮等的功能及应用方法，控制回路设计及算法具体实现方法。培养专业科研动手能力，提高软件、硬件综合开发能力，给本科学生学习专业课和作毕业论文打下实践基础。实验项目包括卫星姿态控制全物理仿真实验、导弹目标模拟识别及跟踪半物理仿真实验和导弹动力学与控制虚拟仿真实验。
default.en: The guidance, navigation, and control system of aircraft is the core system of aircraft and a key system that characterizes the advanced performance of aircraft. This system consists of advanced sensors, actuators, control computers, and control software. Digital control is the development direction of aircraft guidance, navigation, and control systems. The course of Comprehensive Experiment in Spacecraft Design includes the theoretical methods of aircraft guidance, navigation, and attitude control systems, the functions and application methods of hardware such as DSP, three-axis platform, fiber optic gyroscope sensor, IMU, visual sensor, sun sensor, jet system, and reaction flywheel, as well as the specific implementation methods of control circuit design and algorithms. So, professional research hands-on ability is Cultivated, comprehensive software and hardware development ability is improved, and a practical foundation is laid for undergraduate students to study professional courses and write graduation theses. The experimental projects include full physical simulation experiments for satellite attitude control, semi physical simulation experiments for missile target recognition and tracking, and virtual simulation experiments for missile dynamics and control.

default.zh: 《航天器姿态动力学与控制》是飞行器设计与工程类专业的一门主干专业核心课。本课程是学生从基础课学习阶段过渡到专业课学习阶段的重要环节，利用基础课所学的知识和技能进行综合，进一步学习航天器姿态动力学、姿态控制方面的基本原理和方法，具有较强的理论性和实际应用性，使学生掌握基本的航天器姿态动力学建模的原理和方法以及姿态控制设计相关概念和原理。本课程将为学生进一步学习本专业其他专业课程打下基础。 教学内容包括：航天器姿态运动学和姿态动力学的基本概念，以及姿态动力学建模基本原理；自旋航天器、三轴姿态稳定航天器的姿态动力学建模方法及姿态运动分析；航天器姿态确定原理，航天器的姿态确定方法；自旋稳定航天器和三轴稳定航天器的姿态控制原理及设计方法；航天器姿态控制系统设计过程。 通过本门课程的学习，使学生初步掌握航天器姿态动力学与姿态控制的基本原理和方法，为将来从事航天器姿态动力学以及姿态控制系统设计等相关应用专业的研究工作或本专业进一步深造奠定初步的理论基础。
default.en: Attitude Dynamics and Control of Spacecraft’, is one of branch and basic courses for Specialty of Spacecraft Design and Engineering. This course transfers students from basic course learning step to specialized course learning step. This course concentrate on theory and application. It will enhances the ability of students for mastering knowledge and skill in basic course. Students will have a deeper understanding on principles of attitude dynamics and control. The purpose of this course is to make student possess the capacity on dynamic modeling and attitude control. This course will give a basic understanding for learning other specialized courses. The main contents of the course include: the basic concepts and knowledge of attitude kinematics and dynamics for spacecraft, and the modeling principles of attitude dynamics, and the attitude dynamical equations and modeling method for spin, dual-spin and three axis stabilization spacecraft; And also the basic principle and methods of attitude determination; the main methods of attitude determination for spacecraft; The principles and methods of attitude control for spin, dual-spin spacecraft and three axis stabilization spacecraft; and the design and implement process of attitude control system for spacecraft. Students will possess the capacity of attitude dynamic modeling and control when the course is finished. It is a foundation for students to engage in related work or have further learning on this major field.

default.zh: 导弹及运载总体设计是飞行器设计专业的一门专业课，是作为将来要从事航天事业的学子所必须掌握的一门专业知识，学习这门课的主要目的是让学生掌握导弹及运载火箭各分系统在总体设计阶段需要遵循的设计思路及设计方法等基础知识；了解这样一类大的系统在设计初级阶段需要给出的主要设计参数及以后详细设计时可依据的经验公式等经验知识；掌握导弹及运载火箭发展现状及未来趋势的新兴知识；初步了解未来导弹及运载火箭设计需要掌握的相关交叉学科基本知识；通过课程学习使学生具备从总体设计的角度出发给出设计结果的基本设计能力，具备导弹及运载火箭的战术技术指标论证分析能力；通过课程学习使学生具备团队协作和沟通的基本素质，因此在本专业的教学计划中占有比较重要的地位，也会为今后走向航天领域工作岗位打下一定的理论基础。 本课程的主要内容有战术导弹及运载火箭总体设计阶段的设计原理及有关设计方法，其中包括导弹的研制过程与发展、战术技术要求的拟定、主要设计参数的确定、导弹外形设计、部位安排与质心定位计算及导弹系统性能分析；运载火箭的弹道及运载能力的分析、运载火箭总体方案的选择；导弹及火箭总体参数设计优化等内容。要求学生掌握导弹及运载火箭的基本设计原理、设计流程、设计方法等。
default.en: The System Design of Missile and Launch Vehicle is taken as a required major course by college students of Spacecraft Design Disciplines and intended to give practical training to reinforce theoretical knowledge. The course contents include introduction about System Design of the Missile and Launch Vehicle, reference frames, principles, theories and methods. The main objectives of this course is to familiarize the students with concepts, principles and applications of the general design of missile and launch vehicle, and train them to acquire the necessary skills to analyze and research the design theories and methods so that the students’abilities in analysis and applications can be improved and they can contribute their knowledge to national aerospace science and technology.

default.zh: 飞行器结构力学是固体力学领域中重要学科，在工程设计中，结构设计起到了举足轻重的作用，而飞行器结构力学是结构设计中所必备的基础知识。只有充分应用结构力学的概念，才可以在工程结构设计中做到优化结构方案、优化结构投资组合、合理设计构件的受力。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学等环节培养学生的创新意识与应用能力。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： （1）培养学生具有结构优化设计的思想和能力，了解结构设计主要研究内容是研究工程结构的受力和传力规律，研究如何进行结构优化的学科。在结构设计的过程中具有对结构形式进行简化，对结构的体系进行整体布置；对结构荷载、构件受力的优化、传力途径的优化等方面的能力。 （2）通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握杆系和薄壁结构的组成原理及其受力和变形分析的方法、薄壁结构理论，使学生了解和掌握结构的受力和传力特点以及薄壁结构的基本理论和基本计算方法，培养学生对结构设计和强度计算的概念和综合处理能力，培养从事飞行器结构设计和强度计算的高技术人才。 （3）能够独立研究平面杆系结构的强度、刚度和稳定性，了解各类结构的受力性能，为学习有关专业课程以及进行结构设计和科学研究打好力学基础，培养飞行器结构分析与计算等方面的能力。
default.en: Structural design plays an important role in engineering design, and Structural Mechanics of Spacecraft is the necessary basic knowledge in structural design. Only by fully applying the concept of Structural Mechanics of Spacecraft can optimize the structural scheme, optimize the structural investment portfolio and rationally design the stress of components in the design of Engineering structures. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' innovative consciousness and application ability through classroom teaching and other links. The requirements for students' abilities are as follows: (1) To train students to have the idea and ability of structural optimization design, understand the main content of structural design is to study the force and force law of Engineering structure, and study how to optimize the structure. In the process of structural design, it has the ability to simplify the structure form, to arrange the structure system as a whole, to optimize the structure load, the stress of components, and the way of transmission. (2) Through the study of this course, the students can master the composition principle of the bar structure, the force and displacement method of its stress and deformation analysis, the theory of thin-walled engineering beam, so that they can understand and master the mechanical and force characteristics of the structure and the basic theory and calculation method of thin-walled engineering beam, and train the students to design and strengthen the structure. Degree calculation concept and comprehensive processing ability, training high-tech personnel engaged in aircraft structure design and strength calculation. (3) Ability to independently study the strength, stiffness and stability of planar truss structures, understand the mechanical properties of various structures, lay a good mechanical foundation for learning relevant professional courses, structural design and scientific research, and train the ability of aircraft structural analysis and calculation.

default.zh: 多体系统动力学是研究关于由多个部件组成的约束复杂机械系统在外力作用下的运动规律与动态特性的理论。飞行器多体动力学基础以现代空间飞行器为服务对象，讲授基于矢量力学和分析力学原理的多体系统动力学建模与仿真的基本概念、原理和方法及其在航天器工程中的应用，通过本课程学习使学生了解和掌握多体系统动力学建模基本原理及方法，初步具备多体系统动力学分析的理论基础和基本应用技能，为今后进一步学习和从事多体系统动力学与控制研究奠定基础。
default.en: Dynamics of multibody system is the theory of the constraint complex mechanical system which consists of multiple components, and it studies the law of motion and the dynamical performances under the external force. Foundations of dynamics of multibody systems for vehicle, serviced for space vehicle, it mainly teaches the basic concepts, principles and methods of the multibody system dynamics, including modeling and simulation based on the vector mechanics and the analytic mechanics, and its application in the spacecraft engineering. This course helps the undergraduate students understand and master the principles and the basic methods of the multi-rigid-body system dynamics modeling, equip with the theoretical foundation and basic application skills of the multibody system dynamics analysis for further learning and engaging in the research of the multibody system dynamics and control.

default.zh: 弹性力学及有限元课程是飞行器环境与生命保障工程专业本科生的一门专业核心课，也是学生们学习后续相关专业方向课的基础。课程主要讲授理想弹性体力学分析的基本理论及基本解答，以及应用有限单元法求解弹性力学问题的基本理论和基本方法，重点使学生理解弹性力学及有限单元法的基本概念与基本理论，掌握应用弹性力学理论及有限单元法分析问题及解决问题的基本方法。 课程主要包括平面问题、空间问题以及薄板弯曲问题的基本理论和解答，以及用有限单元法求解弹性力学平面问题的基本理论和方法。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时作业、大作业和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Mechanics of Elastic Solids and Finite Elements Method is a core specialty course to undergraduates of Aircraft Environment and Life Support Engineering major. It is also a knowledge foundation of following relevant specialty direction courses. The course mainly concerns basic theories and solutions of mechanic analysis of ideal elastic body, as well as basic theories and methods of solving problems of elastic mechanics with application of Finite Element Method. The emphasis of the course is understanding of basic concepts and theories of mechanics of elasticity and Finite Element Method, as well as mastering of basic methods of problem analysis and solution with theories of elastic mechanics and Finite Element Method. The course mainly concerns basic theories and solutions of plane problem, space problem and bending problem of thin plate, as well as basic theories and methods of solving plane problem of elastic mechanics with application of Finite Element Method. The cumulative type of examination of the course is adopted, which includes usual homework, project homework and final exam.

default.zh: 《飞行器导航原理》是面向航天学院第三学年本科生的一门专业课程。课程主要讲述引导飞行器等载体完成航行任务的多项导航技术。 课程主要讲述了导航技术的相关内容，介绍了导航技术的发展过程、发展现状与未来趋势，介绍了导航的基本概念、原理和方法，深入介绍了惯性导航系统、卫星导航系统、天文导航系统等导航系统的系统组成、工作原理、特点与应用范围，并分析了导航系统及其组合系统的选择、应用与关键技术，可为学生在相关领域的研究工作打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: The Principles of Flight Vehicle Navigation is a specialized course for Junior Undergraduates of School of Astronautics, which focuses on multiple navigation techniques to guide the navigation vehicle to complete navigation tasks. The Principles of Flight Vehicle Navigation is mainly about the navigation technology. The course describes the development history, the current situation and future trends of navigation technology, and introduces basic concepts, principles and methods of navigation. Then in depth exploration the system composition, working principle, characteristics and application field of inertial navigation system, satellite navigation system, celestial navigation system and so on. At last, analysis the selection, application and key technology of navigation system and its combination system. Through the study of this course, the students will lay a solid theoretical foundation for future research work in related fields.

default.zh: 基础天文学是飞行器设计与工程大类空间科学与技术专业的一门自然科学基础核心课程。通过本课程的讲授，综合展示天文学各分支学科中对于太阳系、恒星、星系和宇宙的研究成果，了解天文学的历史、现状和发展前景，掌握时空度量、天体运动和演化、宇宙的构成和基本特征等天文学基础知识以及天文观测的基本原理和方法，具备进行空间观测和分析的初步能力，为深入学习后续专业课程奠定坚实的理论基础和专业素养。
default.en: Fundamental Astronomy is a core physical science course for space science and technology direction of flight vehicle design and engineering major. Through the course, fruit of research on solar system, star, galaxy up-to universe taken by sub-disciplines of astronomy are brought forth. You will get the essential knowledge about history, development and foreground of astronomy; rules of celestial-body motion and evolution; the space-time metric; characteristic and structure of cosmos; the principle and method of space observation through studying. Foundation of continue research capacity and academic culture would be possessed.

default.zh: 自主导航与组合导航是21世纪飞行器导航技术发展的主要方向之一，是未来导航技术应用的主要模式。为适应本专业更新教学内容的需要并结合用人单位对组合导航系统科研、生产和应用的需求，本课程向飞行器设计与工程大类空间科学与技术专业三年级学生系统讲授飞行器组合导航系统的原理、分析与设计方面的知识。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解和掌握：当前飞行器组合导航技术的发展趋势、组合导航系统的设计方法、导航系统的误差分析和建模、组合导航数据处理和卡尔曼滤波器设计、多导航传感器信息融合等五方面的内容。
default.en: Autonomous and Integrated Navigation has become the main tendency of navigation of flight vehicles in 21st, at the same time, become the chief mode of navigation technology in the future. For requests from instructional content’s updating and enterprises need more personnel who can research, develop and produce integrated navigation system. By the course principles, knowledge of analysis and design of autonomous and integrated navigation system of flight vehicles are included for 3 grade students in aerospace engineering department, space science and technology major mainly. Through the studying, students can get and grasp: developing tendency, designing method, error analyzing, model building, data processing, Kalman Filtering designing and multiple-navigation-sensor information fusion of modern integrated navigation system etc., about 5 aspects.

default.zh: 实测天文学是现代天体物理学发展的基础，对于本专业学生空间观测能力的培养尤为重要。本课程有两大目标：一是通过课堂教学，使同学们了解现代天文观测的一系列基本知识，了解基本天象，掌握观测仪器和技术，学会初步的天文观测数据处理方法，了解各波段天文观测理论和方法；二是通过分组讨论、实验设计与实际天文观测实验，让同学们学以至用，感受自然。
default.en: Measurement astronomy is the foundation of the development of modern astrophysics, which is important for the cultivation of students' spatial observation ability. Two main objectives in our course: First, by class teaching, show us some basic knowledge about modern astronomical observation and understand basic celestial phenomena, some observation instruments and techniques; we can learn preliminary astronomical observation data processing methods, and understand astronomical observation theories and methods in various bands. Second, through group discussion, experimental design and actual astronomical observation experiment, we can feel seeing the nature by knowledge application.

default.zh: “激光原理A”是电子科学与技术专业本科生的一门专业基础课，主要讲授激光的光与物质的相互作用、激光器的基本原理、光学谐振腔和激光的典型应用。学习本课程的目的是使学生能掌握有关激光的基本原理，深入理解激光的产生过程，掌握激光光束的特性和谐振腔理论。在光与物质相互作用方面，重点讲授光与物质相互作用的自发发射、受激发射和受激吸收的概念和公式，为后续激光器的基本原理的学习打下基础。此外，有关光谱线加宽的内容也为后续激光原理的定量描述奠定了基础。在激光器的基本原理方面，重点讲授产生激光所需具备的条件、激光器的结构、激光形成过程和激光特性等内容。在定量描述方面，重点介绍激光器速率方程、增益系数、激光振荡的阈值条件、激光输出能量和功率等内容。在光学谐振腔方面，介绍谐振腔的稳定性、谐振腔的损耗、谐振腔中的模式、高斯光束的特性和传输变换、非稳腔等相关内容，重点讲授激光光束的特点和对激光光束的定量描述，为激光应用中，传输和控制激光光束提供理论指导。同时会简要讲授激光的典型应用。
default.en: PRINCIPLES OF LASERS A is a basic course for undergraduates majoring in Electronic Science and technology. In this course, the interaction of light and matter, basic principle of laser, optical resonator and typical applications of laser are mainly taught. The aim for this course is to make students master the basic principles of lasers, learn about the production mechanism of laser, the properties of laser beam and theory of optical resonators. In the chapter of the interaction of light and matter, the concepts and formulas about spontaneous emission, stimulated emission and stimulated absorption are taught. It lays a foundation for the study of the basic principle of laser. In addition, the contents about the broadening of spectral lines also laid the foundation for the quantitative description of the subsequent laser principle. In the chapter of the basic principle of laser, the conditions required to generate the laser, laser structure, formation of laser, and characteristics of laser are mainly taught. In order to quantitatively describe, the rate equation of laser, gain coefficient of medium, threshold conditions of laser oscillation, output energy and power of laser and so on are mainly introduced. In the chapter of optical resonator, stability conditions of coaxial spherical cavity, loss of the resonator, characteristics of Gaussian beam, propagation and transformation of Gaussian beam, unstable cavity are introduced. The characteristics of laser beam and quantitative description of laser beam are mainly taught. It provides theoretical guidance for transmitting and controlling laser beam in laser applications. At the same time, the typical applications of laser are briefly taught.

default.zh: 光电子技术是现代信息技术的主要支柱，在通信、工业检测、精密测量、医学、安保及国防等领域广泛应用。作为光电子技术的核心之一，光电子器件在实际应用需求牵引下，发展非常迅速，新技术不断出现，性能不断提升，有力推动了相关产业的进步。 本课程包括绪论、光电子器件物理基础、典型光电子探测与成像器件、光电调制与传输控制器件、光电显示以及微纳光电子器件等内容。从光电子器件基本理论出发，重点分析了光电导、PN结以及真空电子倍增类光电探测器件的工作原理、结构特性及应用；随着半导体技术和器件制备工艺的进步，阵列探测器发展非常迅速，课程对目前主流的阵列探测器件，如CMOS相机、阵列单光子探测器、像增强器等成像器件的工作机理、性能及应用等进行讲解；此外还对光通信领域调制与传输控制关键器件、基于液晶和OLED技术的主流光电显示器件、光子晶体超材料为代表的新兴微纳光电子功能器件等相关原理及技术进行了介绍和分析。 本课程面向光电子专业本科生，完善光学生专业知识结构，提高专业水平和能力，为今后从事光电子相关工作或研究打下一定专业知识基础。
default.en: Optoelectronic technology is the main pillar of modern information technology, widely applied in areas such as communication, industrial inspection, precision measurement, medical field, security, and defense. As one of the core components of optoelectronic technology, optoelectronic devices have rapidly developed, with constant emergence of new technologies and improved performance, effectively driving progress in related industries. This course covers an introduction to optoelectronic devices, the physics foundation of optoelectronic devices, typical optoelectronic detection and imaging devices, optoelectronic modulation and transmission control devices, optoelectronic displays, as well as micro-nano optoelectronic devices. Starting from the basic theory of optoelectronic devices, the course focuses on the working principles, structural characteristics, and applications of optoelectronic devices such as photoconductors, PN junctions, and vacuum electron multiplier-based photodetectors. With advancements in semiconductor technology and device fabrication processes, array detectors have seen rapid development. The course explains the working mechanisms, performance, and applications of mainstream array detectors such as CMOS cameras, array single-photon detectors, and image intensifiers. Additionally, it introduces and analyzes key devices for modulation and transmission control in the field of optical communications, mainstream optoelectronic display devices based on liquid crystal and OLED technologies, as well as emerging micro-nano optoelectronic functional devices represented by photonic crystal metamaterials. This course targets undergraduate students majoring in optoelectronics, aiming to enhance their knowledge structure in optics, improve their professional level and capabilities, and lay a solid foundation of professional knowledge for future work or research in the field of optoelectronics.

default.zh: 《激光技术》为电子科学与技术专业的核心课程。激光技术从20世纪60年代发展至今，其内容（包括基本器件、基本理论和基本技术）日益成熟丰富，已成为电子科学与技术学科建设的重要组成部分，它也是从事光电子技术及在诸方面应用的科技工作者必须掌握的基本知识。通过本课程学习，学生需要掌握气体激光器、固体激光器、光纤激光器和其他类型激光器的基本组成、工作原理和激光输出特性，了解激光器的基本设计；掌握激光调制技术、调Q技术、锁模技术、模式选择技术、稳频技术、非线性光学技术等几种典型激光技术的基本原理、工作过程及设计方法；了解激光器件和激光技术在工业、军事和科研等领域中的应用，培养学生具备分析解决激光物理问题的能力，为今后从事激光方向的科学研究打下基础。
default.en: Laser Technology is the core course of the Electronic Science and Technology major. Laser technology has been developing since the 1960s, and its content (including basic devices, basic theories, and basic technologies) has become increasingly mature and rich. It has become an important component of the construction of electronic science and technology disciplines. It is also a basic knowledge that must be mastered by scientific and technical workers engaged in optoelectronic technology and its applications in various aspects. Through this course, students need to master the basic composition, working principles, and laser output characteristics of gas lasers, solid-state lasers, fiber lasers, and other types of lasers, and understand the basic design of lasers; Master the basic principles, working processes, and design methods of several typical laser technologies, including laser modulation technology, Q-modulation technology, mode locking technology, mode selection technology, frequency stabilization technology, nonlinear optical technology, etc; Understand the applications of laser devices and laser technology in industries, military, and scientific research, cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve laser physics problems, and lay a foundation for future scientific research in the field of laser.

default.zh: 本课程为电子科学与技术专业学生必修的专业技术综合实验课程。它涉及本专业的基本理论与技术。本实验课主要分为气体激光技术实验和固体激光技术实验两部分内容。.气体激光技术实验包括对气体激光器的输出特性测量，对激光束散角的测量，对He-Ne激光纵横模的观测，及对激光波长线宽的测量，对气体激光介质中荧光强度的放电特性也进行了实验研究。固体激光技术实验涉及固体激光器装调、调Q、倍频、半导体泵浦、锁模技术等实际操作。另外， 对激光相关的其它技术及应用也有一定的训练和分析，并且每次实验课还安排了3个相关的光电子技术实验英语视频教学。 这些实验旨在使学生掌握多种光电测试仪器的原理和使用，提高联系实际的能力，巩固专业基础理论知识，奠定学生实际工作中良好的分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This course is compulsory for the students whose specialty is electronic science and technology. It is professional, technical, integrated and experimental.This course involves the basic theories and technology of this specialty. This experiment is mainly divided into two parts: the gas laser technology experiment and the solid laser technology experiment. Gas laser technology experiments include measurement of output characteristics of gas lasers, to measure the laser beam divergence angle, observation of He-Ne laser longitudinal mode, measurement of laser wavelength and linewidth, on the discharge characteristics of the fluorescence intensity of gas laser medium is also studied. Solid laser technology experiments are related to solid laser tuning, Q modulation, frequency doubling, semiconductor pump, mode locking technology and other practical operations. In addition, some other technologies and applications related to laser are also trained and analyzed, and each experiment also arranged 3 related optoelectronic technology experimental English video teaching. These experiments aim to help students to master principles and application of multiform optoelectronic testing instruments, improve their ability of connecting with practice, consolidate their basal theoretical knowledge, and establish their ability of analyzing and solving problems while working.

default.zh: 本课程是面向由未来技术学院转入电子科学与技术专业学习的大三学生开设的专业入门实践课，是该类学生迈向光电子激光领域实践的第一步。通过与激光、激光器、激光束控制技术的初步接触，使学生对专业知识在实践中的再现形式和原理形成较深刻的认识。课程采用实验室现场讲解和学生实操实训相结合的教学方式，依托光电子激光领域典型技术案例，将“物理光学”、“应用光学”、“激光原理”的若干知识点和基本概念融入实验环节中，在实践动手和分析思考过程中领会激光系统的调试方法和设计思路，培养学生逐步树立理论和实践并重并行的学习意识，培养学生逐步构建将所学理论知识用于工程实践并从实践中探索新知的能力素养。
default.en: This course is a professional introductory practice course for junior students who have transferred to the major of electronic science and technology from the future Institute of Technology, and is the first step for such students to practice in the field of optoelectronic laser. Through the initial contact with laser, laser and laser beam control technology, students can form a deeper understanding of the representation form and principle of professional knowledge in practice. The course adopts the teaching method of combining on-site laboratory explanation with students' practical operation and training. Relying on typical technical cases in the field of optoelectronic laser, several knowledge points and basic concepts of "physical optics", "applied optics" and "laser principle" are integrated into the experimental link, and the debugging methods and design ideas of laser system are understood in the process of practical operation and analytical thinking. Cultivate students to gradually establish the learning consciousness of both theory and practice, and cultivate students to gradually build the ability to apply the theoretical knowledge to engineering practice and explore new knowledge from practice.

default.zh: “激光原理B”是光学工程专业本科生的一门专业基础课，主要讲授激光的基本概念、激光器的基本原理、光学谐振腔、高斯光束的传输与变换、激光器特性的控制与改善。学习本课程的目的是使学生能掌握有关激光的基本原理，理解激光的产生过程，掌握激光光束的特性和谐振腔理论。在激光器的基本原理方面，重点讲授产生激光所需具备的条件、激光器的结构、激光形成过程和激光特性等内容。在光学谐振腔方面，介绍谐振腔的稳定性、谐振腔的损耗、稳定腔中的模式、非稳腔等。在高斯光束的传输与变换方面，讲授了高斯光束的特性与描述方法、ABCD公式、高斯光束的聚焦与准直、高斯光束的自再现变换、高斯模的匹配等相关内容。在激光器特性的控制与改善方面，介绍了激光选模技术、激光稳频技术、激光Q开关技术、激光锁模技术、激光放大技术的基本概念。
default.en: PRINCIPLES OF LASERS B is a basic course for undergraduates majoring in Optical Engineering. In this course, the basic concepts and principle of laser, optical resonator, propagation & transformation of Gaussian beam, control & improvement of laser properties are mainly taught. The aim for this course is to make students master the basic principles of lasers, learn about the production mechanism of laser, the properties of laser beam and theory of optical resonator. In the chapter of the basic principle of laser, the conditions required to generate the laser, laser structure, formation of laser, and characteristics of laser are mainly taught. In the chapter of optical resonator, stability conditions of coaxial spherical cavity, loss of the resonator, modes of stable cavity, unstable cavity are introduced. In the chapter of propagation & transformation of Gaussian beam, characteristics & description methods of Gaussian beam, ABCD equation, focusing & collimation of Gaussian beam, reconstruction of Gaussian beam, matching of Gaussian beam are mainly taught. In the chapter of control & improvement of laser properties, basic concepts of laser mode selection, laser frequency stabilization, laser Q-switch, laser mode locking, laser amplification are introduced.

default.zh: 主要掌握和熟悉微电子器件基本结构的工作原理、物理概念和主要性质。本课程为学生介绍微电子器件单元结构的基本物理规律和性质，包括pn结、金属和半导体接触和MIS结构的基本物理性质、器件物理和半导体传感器等基础，为从事集成电路、微电子器件、传感器及应用、光电子技术等方面的工作打下必备的理论基础。
default.en: Master and be familiar with the working principles, physical concepts, and main properties of the basic structure of microelectronic devices. This course introduces the basic physical laws and properties of the unit structure of microelectronic devices, including the basic physical properties of p-n junctions, metal and semiconductor contact and MIS structures, device physics, and semiconductor sensors, etc. This course lays a necessary theoretical foundation for the integrated circuits, microelectronic devices, sensor applications, and optoelectronic technology.

default.zh: 本课程是本科生专业核心课程，使学生了解并掌握p-n结、双极型和场效应晶体管的基本结构、工作原理和电特性规律，为本专业学生后续课程的学习建立相关知识基础。要求学生掌握p-n结、双极型和场效应晶体管的基本结构、工作原理和直流特性、交流特性、频率特性和功率特性规律；了解并掌握主要微电子器件工作原理和基本特性与其内部载流子运动基本规律和微观过程的内在联系；具备认识和分析分立器件和集成电路工作原理及电特性的基本能力。
default.en: This is a core professional course for undergraduates majoring. The course enables students to understand and master the p-n junction, knows well the basic structure, the working principle, and the electrical characteristics of the bipolar and field effect transistors, to establish a knowledge base for students of this major to learn subsequent courses. Students are required to master the p-n junction, the basic structure, working principle, DC characteristics, AC characteristics, frequency characteristics, and power characteristics of the bipolar and field effect transistors; Understand and master the internal relations between the working principles and basic characteristics of major microelectronic devices and the basic laws and microscopic processes of their internal carrier movement; Have the basic ability to understand and analyze the working principles and electrical characteristics of discrete devices and integrated circuits.

default.zh: 《微电子工艺》是集成电路学科学生非常重要的专业核心课，是学习后续专业课如数字集成电路设计基础、模拟集成电路设计基础、MEMS基础等课程的基础。本课程主要讲授半导体集成电路制造技术流程，单项工艺技术基本原理、工艺方法及所依托的技术基础，常用的工艺设备，近年出现的新工艺技术以及集成电路制造工艺未来发展趋势。 重点使学生熟悉和掌握微电子芯片制造当前普遍采用的单项工艺方法，包括：硅片制备，外延，氧化，扩散，离子注入，化学汽相淀积，物理汽相淀积，光刻，腐蚀，金属互连等；掌握各单项工艺中常见问题以及解决措施；了解典型器件工艺集成（流程）技术。内容涉及面广，信息量大，而且新技术、新工艺、新设备不断涌现，是一门实践性和理论性均较强的技术类专业核心课程，承担着技术基础掌握与技术传承两个任务。 本课程学习包括两个部分：线上网络MOOC课程学习和线下翻转课堂学习，二者是互为补充的关系，线上网络课程学习强调广度，线下课堂学习强调深度。课程期末考试采取累加式计分方式，期末笔试成绩占总成绩的60%，平时成绩占10%（讨论、小测验等）； 线上MOOC课程占30%（线上课程总分100分，记录成绩总分30分）。
default.en: Microelectronics Processing is one of the most important courses to all the students in Integrated Circuit discipline, which is a knowledge foundation of the subsequent specialty lessons such as Digital Integrated Circuit Design, Analog Integrated Circuit Design, Base of MEMS technique. Microelectronics Processing is a specialized course studied the manufacture technique of Integrated Circuit on semi-conductors, including the technique principles，methods, application, and the physics basis of the relative individual item of fabrication method. The usual process equipment, as well as the newly developed techniques these years, and the future development tendency of the microelectronic processes are also recommended in this course. After finishing the lesson, students should be familiar with each individual fabrication method for semiconductor devices and integrated circuit chips, including: wafer fabrication. epitaxy, oxidation, diffusion, ion implantation, chemical vapor deposition (CVD), physical vapor deposition, photography and etching technique, metal interconnect, etc. Furthermore, they should know and master the common problems and typical solutions in each individual process; they must understand and grasp the technique of fabrication integration (flow) for the typical devices. The content covered a wide range and a large amount of information, accompanying with the constant emergence of new technology, new fabrication method and new equipment. It is a practical and theoretical technical core curriculum, undertaken the two tasks to master the technical basis and technical inheritance. The course studying consists of two parts: online MOOC courses and Flipped Classroom. These two are complementary to each other. It emphasizes the breadth for the online learning, while the classroom learning emphasizes the depth in the flipped classroom. The final exam take the cumulative scoring method. Final written examination results accounted for 60% of the total score; Regular grades accounted for 10% of the total score (including discussions, quizzes and others); MOOC online courses accounted for 30% of the total score ( the total score 100 points, record score of 30).

default.zh: 硬件描述语言是自顶向下、SoC设计方法的基础，Verilog HDL是目前电子设计自动化（EDA）工具支持的三种硬件描述语言之一。本课程是大规模数字集成电路设计与实现的基础课程，课程目的是通过本课程的学习，学生能够完成实际硬件行为的Verilog HDL建模，并运用到大规模数字集成电路芯片设计流程中。课程主要内容包括集成电路设计领域背景知识，CMOS数字集成电路单元结构、特性、设计及应用；Verilog HDL的框架结构、语法基础、编程风格、任务与函数，基础元件的RTL建模，验证平台结构与设计，复杂硬件功能的RTL建模、验证与综合等。
default.en: Hardware description language is the basis of top-down and SoC design method. Verilog HDL is one of the three hardware description languages supported by electronic design automation (EDA) tools at present. This course is a basic course for the design and implementation of large-scale digital integrated circuits. The purpose of this course is to enable students to complete Verilog HDL modeling of actual hardware behavior and apply it to the design process of large-scale digital integrated circuits. The course contents include background knowledge in the field of integrated circuit design, Basic cell structure, characteristics, design, and application of CMOS digital integrated circuits; Verilog HDL framework structure, syntax basis, programming style, tasks and functions, RTL modeling of basic components, verification platform structure and design, RTL modeling, verification and synthesis of complex hardware functions, etc.

default.zh: 本课程讨论模拟集成电路的分析与设计，既着重基本原理，也着重于学生需要掌握的现代工业中新的范例。本课程从如下几方面介绍模拟集成电路设计技术：讲述器件的基本物理原理和工作原理，介绍器件结构、分析器件的I/V特性、器件模型；讲述CMOS单级和差分级放大器以及电流电压基准电路，通过对基本电路性能的量化建立有效的分析工具；介绍电路的二个非理想性，即频率响应和噪声；讲授反馈、运放和反馈系统中的稳定性，利用反馈的有益特性，可以设计出高性能、稳定的运放，并学会在速度、精度和功耗之间进行折中考虑。本课程成绩采用累加式，包括期末考试、大作业和实验。
default.en: The course deals with the analysis and design of analog integrated circuits, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new examples that students need to master in today’s industry. The course introduces and discusses design of analog integrated circuits as below: First, the course describes basic physics and operation of devices, and introduces the structure and I/V characteristic of devices; then deals with single-stage and differential amplifiers and current references and voltage references, developing efficient analytical tools for quantifying the behavior of basic circuits; introduces two imperfections of circuits, frequency response and noise; describes feedback operational OPAMP and stability in feedback systems. With the useful properties of feedback analyzed, to design high performance, stable OPAMPs, and understand the trade-offs between speed, precision and power dissipation. The course score is given according the exam, the homework and the report of experiment.

default.zh: 嵌入式系统已经从8位发展到16位、32位，系统的设计和应用也更加复杂。掌握32位嵌入式系统的设计及其应用的相关知识在现实工程领域中具有重要意义。《嵌入式系统及应用》重点介绍了32位ARM嵌入式处理器及其组成，对嵌入式系统实现过程中软/硬件的设计环节和步骤进行了分析和讲解。本课程的目的是通过对目前常用嵌入式系统的介绍和分析，使学生熟悉和掌握嵌入式系统设计与应用的方法，并具备开发现代电子系统的能力。
default.en: The data-width of embedded systems has been enhanced from 8 bits, 16 bits to 32 bits, hence the embedded applications or systems are more and more complex. So it’s of great importance to master the corresponding knowledge of 32 bits embedded system, which could be applied to engineering. Applications of Embedded System mainly introduces ARM, a 32 bits embedded processor, and its architecture. In the course, the design flow of the embedded system, included software design and hardware design is analyzed and explained. After learning the various design methods of embedded systems, the students should understand the methodology of design and application of embedded systems, and have the capability to develop the modern electronic systems.

default.zh: 《微电子系列实验》包含固态电子论实验与微电子器件与工艺实验两部分内容。 固态电子论实验是与面向微电子科学与技术系本科生所开设的核心课程《固态电子论》相配套的实验教学课程。开设的目的是使学生通过实验熟悉半导体物理的基础理论和半导体的主要性质，为以后的半导体器件、传感器及应用、集成电路等专业课程的学习，以及学生将来从事电子科学与技术方面的工作打下必备的基础。本课程涵盖了固态电子学的电学、光学等特性的一系列基础性实验，使学生们掌握了固态电子论中一些重要现象和理论,并使学生在实验中观察现象，发现问题，分析原因，提高解决问题的能力。实践证明，该课程的开设取得了很理想的效果。 微电子器件与工艺实验是涵盖“微电子器件原理”与“微电子工艺”两门课程内容的实验课程。其中，实验类型以综合型为主，具有先进性。在教师组织指导下，要求学生课前预习，学会使用实验仪器，自己动手完成实验操作内容，分析实验现象，进行数据处理，写出实验报告。通过本门课程学习，使学生掌握微电子重要元器件性能及其关键工艺参数的测试实验原理、方法，熟悉微电子行业常用测试仪器、设备，加深对微电子技术理论的理解。并在实验操作中观察现象，发现问题，分析原因，从而提高动手能力和综合素质。 本课程的考核采用累加方式计分，成绩按各实验项目学时权重进行累加，各实验项目又按实验操作40%和实验报告60%计分，满分100分。
default.en: "Microelectronics Series Experiments" includes two parts: The Solid-State Electron Theory Experiment and Microelectronic Devices and Process Experiment. The Solid-State Electron Theory Experiment is an experimental teaching course that is compatible with the core course "Solid-State Electrons" for undergraduates of the Department of Microelectronics Science and Technology. The purpose of the program is to enable students to become familiar with the basic theories of semiconductor physics and the main properties of semiconductors through experiments, so as to lay the necessary foundation for the study of semiconductor devices, sensors and applications, integrated circuits and other professional courses in the future, as well as for students to engage in electronic science and technology in the future. This course covers a series of basic experiments on the electrical, optical and other characteristics of solid-state electronics, so that students can master some important phenomena and theories in solid-state electronics, and enable students to observe phenomena, find problems, analyze causes, and improve their ability to solve problems in experiments. Practice has proved that the course has achieved very satisfactory results. Microelectronic Devices and Process Experiment is an experimental course covering two courses: "Principles of Microelectronic Devices" and "Microelectronic Technology". Among them, the experimental type is mainly comprehensive and advanced. Under the guidance of the teacher, students are required to preview before class, learn to use experimental instruments, complete the experimental operation content by themselves, analyze experimental phenomena, process data, and write experimental reports. Through the study of this course, students will master the testing and experimental principles and methods of the performance of important components of microelectronics and their key process parameters, be familiar with the commonly used testing instruments and equipment in the microelectronics industry, and deepen their understanding of the theory of microelectronics technology. And observe the phenomenon in the experimental operation, find the problem, and analyze the cause, so as to improve the hands-on ability and comprehensive quality. The assessment of this course is scored by accumulation, and the results are accumulated according to the weight of the credit hours of each experimental item, and each experimental item is scored according to 40% of the experimental operation and 60% of the experimental report, with a full score of 100 points.

default.zh: 硬件描述语言是自顶向下、SoC设计方法的基础，Verilog HDL是目前电子设计自动化（EDA）工具支持的三种硬件描述语言之一。本课程是大规模数字集成电路设计与实现的基础课程，课程目的是通过本课程的学习，学生能够完成实际硬件行为的Verilog HDL建模，并运用到大规模数字集成电路芯片设计流程中。课程主要内容包括集成电路设计领域背景知识，Verilog HDL的框架结构、语法基础、编程风格、任务与函数，基础元件的功能及其RTL建模、电路建模及版图设计，验证平台结构与设计，复杂硬件功能的RTL建模、验证与综合等。
default.en: Hardware description language is the basis of top-down and SoC design method. Verilog HDL is one of the three hardware description languages supported by electronic design automation (EDA) tools at present. This course is a basic course for the design and implementation of large-scale digital integrated circuits. The purpose of this course is to enable students to complete Verilog HDL modeling of actual hardware behavior and apply it to the design process of large-scale digital integrated circuits. The course contents include background knowledge in the field of integrated circuit design, Verilog HDL framework structure, syntax basis, programming style, tasks and functions, RTL modeling, circuit modeling and layout design of basic components, verification platform structure and design, RTL modeling, verification and synthesis of complex hardware functions, etc.

default.zh: 本课程讨论模拟集成电路的分析与设计，既着重基本原理，也着重于学生需要掌握的现代工业中新的范例。本课程从如下几方面介绍模拟集成电路设计技术：讲述器件的基本物理原理和工作原理，介绍器件结构、分析器件的I/V特性、器件模型；讲述CMOS单级和差分级放大器以及电流电压基准电路，通过对基本电路性能的量化建立有效的分析工具；介绍电路的二个非理想性，即频率响应和噪声；讲授反馈、运放和反馈系统中的稳定性，利用反馈的有益特性，可以设计出高性能、稳定的运放，并学会在速度、精度和功耗之间进行折中考虑。本课程成绩采用累加式，包括期末考试、大作业报告。
default.en: The course deals with the analysis and design of analog integrated circuits, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new examples that students need to master in today’s industry. The course introduces and discusses design of analog integrated circuits as below: First, the course describes basic physics and operation of devices, and introduces the structure and I/V characteristic of devices; then deals with single-stage and differential amplifiers and current references and voltage references, developing efficient analytical tools for quantifying the behavior of basic circuits; introduces two imperfections of circuits, frequency response and noise; describes feedback operational OPAMP and stability in feedback systems. With the useful properties of feedback analyzed, to design high performance, stable OPAMPs, and understand the trade-offs between speed, precision and power dissipation. The course score is given according the exam and the report of homework.

default.zh: 主要掌握和熟悉半导体物理的基础理论、物理概念和主要性质。本课程为学生介绍半导体物理的基本规律和性质，包括半导体材料的基本物理性质、半导体中的载流子及其运动状态、器件物理和半导体传感器等基础，为从事集成电路、微电子器件、传感器及应用、光电子技术等方面的工作打下必备的理论基础。
default.en: Master and be familiar with the basic theories, physical concepts and main properties of semiconductor physics. This course introduces the basic laws and properties of semiconductor physics, including the basic physical properties of semiconductor materials, carriers and their motion states in semiconductors, and device physics and semiconductor sensors, etc. This course lays the necessary theoretical foundation for the integrated circuits, microelectronic devices, sensor applications, and optoelectronic technology.

default.zh: 本课程是本科生专业核心课程，使学生了解并掌握集成电路基本制造工艺、集成电路中常用器件的结构及其寄生效应、集成电路版图设计基础知识；二极管、双极型晶体管和MOS场效应晶体管的各种模型及主要模型参数；TTL集成电路各种单元电路、单管逻辑门电路、ECL和I2L电路的分析、设计及其版图设计特点；CMOS反相器、传输门、标准CMOS静态逻辑、伪NMOS逻辑与差分级联电压开关逻辑、传输门逻辑与差动传输管逻辑、CMOS动态逻辑、触发器、加法器、存储器等电路的分析与设计，以及CMOS集成电路版图设计特点和实现方法；电流镜电路、电流和电压基准源电路、单级及差分放大器电路、比较器电路、开关电容电路、DAC和ADC电路的工作原理和主要特性的分析与设计，以及模拟集成电路版图设计特点；数字集成电路自动化设计方法和流程、行为建模与Verilog硬件描述语言、设计综合技术和设计验证技术。
default.en: This course is the core course of undergraduate majors, which enables students to understand and master the basic manufacturing process of integrated circuits, the structure and parasitic effects of commonly used devices in integrated circuits, and the basic knowledge of integrated circuit layout design. Various models of diodes, bipolar transistors and MOS field-effect transistors and their main model parameters; Analysis, design and layout design characteristics of various unit circuits, single-tube logic gate circuits, ECL and I2L circuits of TTL integrated circuits; Analysis and design of CMOS inverter, transmission gate, standard CMOS static logic, pseudo-NMOS logic and differential graded voltage switching logic, transmission gate logic and differential transfer tube logic, CMOS dynamic logic, flip-flop, adder, memory and other circuits, as well as CMOS integrated circuit layout design characteristics and implementation methods; Analysis and design of the working principles and main characteristics of current mirror circuits, current and voltage reference circuits, single-stage and differential amplifier circuits, comparator circuits, switching capacitor circuits, DAC and ADC circuits, as well as the layout design characteristics of analog integrated circuits; Digital integrated circuit automation design methods and processes, behavior modeling and Verilog hardware description language, design synthesis technology and design verification technology.

default.zh: 光电子器件正在逐步实现小型化，多功能化，开展光电集成技术有望实现这一要求。本课程要求学生掌握集成波导模式分析与求解。学生需要知道各种集成光电器件的工作原理，掌握其设计的方法。针对不同的需求，学生应能自主设计出符合要求的光电子器件。经过课程的学习，学生也对基于新型材料的集成光电子器件前沿发展方向有一定了解。
default.en: Optoelectronic devices are gradually becoming miniaturized and multifunctional, and the development of optoelectronic integration technology is expected to achieve this requirement. This course requires students to master the analysis and solution of integrated waveguide modes. Students need to know the working principles of various integrated optoelectronic devices and master their design methods. Students should be able to independently design optoelectronic devices that meet different needs. Through the course, students also have a certain understanding of the cutting-edge development direction of integrated optoelectronic devices based on new materials.

default.zh: 本课程是本科生专业核心课程，为本专业学生后续课程的学习建立相关知识基础。本课程旨在揭示构成各类半导体器件（如二极管、晶体管等）的内部物理机理、电气特性与性能极限。课程内容以PN结为基础，系统讲授双极型晶体管（BJT）和金属-氧化物-半导体场效应晶体管（MOSFET）的核心工作原理，重点分析其I-V特性、频率响应、开关特性及非理想效应。同时，课程将进一步拓展至化合物半导体器件、光电器件等前沿专题。
default.en: This course is a core undergraduate specialization course designed to establish the essential knowledge base for students' subsequent studies in the program. It aims to reveal the internal physical mechanisms, electrical characteristics, and performance limits of various semiconductor devices (such as diodes, transistors, etc.). The curriculum begins with the PN junction as its foundation, then systematically covers the core operating principles of the Bipolar Junction Transistor (BJT) and the Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistor (MOSFET). Key analyses focus on their I-V characteristics, frequency response, switching behavior, and non-ideal effects. Furthermore, the course extends into advanced topics, including compound semiconductor devices and optoelectronic devices.

default.zh: 本课程的主要内容有光电测试技术的基础理论和基本知识、基本光电测试技术及其应用，以及现代光学测试技术及其应用。系统、全面地介绍用于光学量和非光学量测量的光电测试技术的基础理论、主要测量原理、方法、仪器组成、主要技术特点及发展前景。既包括经典光学测量的主要内容，又要反映最新的测量技术的发展。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握光电测试技术的基本理论和主要方法，了解常规设备的工作原理、实现方法和使用。
default.en: The main contents of this course include the basic theory and basic knowledge of photoelectric testing technology, primary photoelectric testing technology and its application, as well as the modern optical testing technology and its application. The fundamental theory, primary measuring principle, method, composition of instrument, characteristic and prospect of this technology to measure the optical and non-optical quantity are introduced thoroughly and entirely. The main contents of this course not only include the primary content of classic optical measurement, but also report the development of it. Through the studying of this course, students will master the basic theories and main method of photoelectric testing technology, understanding the working principle of conventional equipments, realization method and application.

default.zh: 《红外辐射与计量》课程是为光电信息科学与工程（光学工程方向）本科生开设的专业理论基础课程。该课程是从事红外辐射计算、红外辐射测温、红外辐射源设计、红外辐射参数测量、红外探测器设计、红外诱饵研制、红外成像系统设计、红外诊疗仪器设计、红外对地遥感、红外制导、红外探测与识别等领域工作的基础和前提。该课程既有系统的基础理论，又有广泛的应用领域，并且是不断发展的活跃学科，本着处理好基础与应用、面与点及系统理论与新进展的关系，同时考虑我校的学科特色，课程除了重点讲授红外辐射基本概念、红外辐射基本规律外，还主要介绍了典型红外辐射源、典型目标与背景红外辐射特性、红外辐射定标、量值传递与溯源等内容，能够让学生掌握红外辐射的基本概念与定律、红外辐射的发生、成像等相关理论知识，了解红外辐射标准的建立、辐射定标以及量值传递与溯源等基本概念和方法，从而具备解决红外辐射分析计算、测量、成像、探测等红外技术问题的基本素质与能力，为从事光电信息科学与工程方面的工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: Infrared Radiation and Metrology is a professional theoretical foundation course for undergraduates (Optical Engineering) majoring in Optoelectronic Information Science and Engineering. It is a specialized required curriculum, which is the research basis and premise for those who engage in infrared radiation calculation, infrared radiation thermometry, infrared radiation source design, infrared radiation parameters metrology, infrared detector design, infrared decoy development, infrared imaging system design, infrared diagnosis instrument constructor, infrared remote sensing of the earth, infrared guidance, infrared detection and recognition and other fields of works. This course has both the basic system theory and a wide range of application directions, and is an active discipline of sustained development. In accordance with the principle of handle well the relationship between foundation and application, and also between surface, point, system theory and new progress in the meanwhile considering the subject characteristics of our curriculum, this course is mainly focus on the basic concepts, basic laws of infrared radiation, and at the same time introduce the typical infrared radiation sources, the infrared radiation characteristics of typical targets and backgrounds, infrared radiometric calibration, transfer and traceability in length, which is able to help students master the basic concepts and laws of infrared radiation, infrared radiation occurrence, infrared imaging, and at the same time, comprehend the basic concepts and methods of the radiation standard establishment, radiation calibration and quantity transmission and traceability of radiation standard. By studying this course, students can be provided with the basic quality and ability of solving infrared radiation calculation, metrology, imaging and detection etc. Furthermore, students can possess a solid foundation for the follow-up work of Optoelectronics Information Science and Engineering.

default.zh: 傅里叶光学课程面向光电信息科学与工程专业本科开课，是重要的专业基础课程之一，也是学生学习后续专业课的基础。课程主要讲授基于傅里叶分析和线性系统理论开展光学问题研究的方法，包括光的传播、衍射、成像和变换等。重点使学生了解傅里叶光学的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用，熟悉和掌握常见光学问题的频域分析方法和实验技能，并通过相关理论方法在实际工程中的应用研究，培养学生独立思考问题、分析问题与解决问题的能力，加强学生对傅里叶光学相关知识的理解与运用，为今后从事光学全息、光学信息处理等研究奠定理论基础。 课程主要包括绪论、傅里叶分析、二维线性系统理论、标量衍射理论、透镜位相调制和傅里叶变换性质、光学成像系统的频率特性、光学全息等内容。傅里叶分析和二维线性系统理论为在光学中借鉴通信理论的分析方法建立了必要的数学基础。标量衍射理论、透镜位相调制和傅里叶变换性质、光学成像系统的频率特性运用空间域和频率域方法讨论了光波携带信息在自由空间或经过光学系统的传播问题。光学全息介绍了傅里叶光学的应用情况。本课程的考核采用累加式方法，包括平时成绩、课堂小测、仿真实验和期末考试。
default.en: The Fourier Optics course is one of the most important basic courses for optoelectronic information science and engineering. Also, it is the basis for students to follow up on specialized courses. The course mainly teaches the methods of optical problem research based on Fourier analysis and linear system theory, including the propagation of light, diffraction, imaging and transformation. The students will understand the theoretical basis of Fourier optics, research hotspots, trends and frontier applications, also familiar with and master the common optical problem of frequency domain analysis methods and experimental skills. And through the application of relevant theoretical methods in practical engineering research, the students will be trained to think independently of the problem, analyze the problem and solve the problem, and strengthen the Fourier optical knowledge and understanding, which will lay the theoretical foundation in the future for optical holography, optical information processing and so on. The courses mainly include the introduction, Fourier analysis, two-dimensional linear system theory, scalar diffraction theory, the phase modulation and Fourier transform properties of lens, frequency characteristics of optical imaging system, optical holography and so on. Fourier analysis and two-dimensional linear system theory establish the necessary mathematical basis for referencing the communication theory of the analytical method to optics. Scalar diffraction theory, the phase modulation and Fourier transform properties, optical imaging system frequency characteristics of the use of spatial domain and frequency domain method are used to discuss the problems about the light wave carrying information in free space or through the optical system propagation. In the optical holography part, the application of Fourier optics will be introduced. The course is assessed in a cumulative way, which includes regular grades, classroom quizzes, simulation experiments and final exams.

default.zh: 图像中目标检测与识别是光学信息获取、信息挖掘的重要途径和手段，在信息处理领域中起着至关重要的作用。本课程作为光电信息科学与工程基础课程，旨在培养学生分析和解决目标检测识别相关问题的能力。 本课程包括理论和实践两部分。理论本部分包括目标检测与识别的基本理论、经典目标检测与识别方法、检测性能评估方等；实践部分为上机算法实践。 目标检测与识别的基本原理主要讲解人类视觉的认知模式、基本分类器、非参数估计、尺度空间以及背景建模等基本理论。通过对基本理论的学习，使学生初步掌握目标检测与识别中基础理论；经典目标检测与识别方法主要讲解本领域中背景建模、均值位移、不变矩、角点匹配、深度学习等经典方法。通过学习开拓学生视野，使学生初步掌握解决目标检测与识别问题的能力。 实践部分主要内容为结合课堂讲授的经典理论与方法，解决实际应用中遇到的不同类型目标检测与识别的相关问题。
default.en: Target detection and recognition in the imagery is an important way in optical information acquisition, information mining and its application, which plays an important role in the field of information processing. As a basic course in optoelectronic information science and engineering, the course is designed to develop students' ability to analyze and solve target detection and recognition issues. The course consists of two parts: theory and practice. This part of the theory includes the basic theory of target detection and recognition, the classical target detection and recognition methods, and performance evaluation methods; the practice part is algorithm practice. The basic principles of target detection and recognition mainly teach the basic theory such as human visual cognitive model, basic classifier, nonparametric estimation, scale space and background modeling. Through the study of the basic theory, enable students to master the basic theory on target detection and recognition; The classical target detection and recognition methods mainly introduces the classical methods such as background modeling, mean shift, invariant moment, corner matching and depth learning. Through learning, open up students’ vision, so that students initially master the ability to solve the target detection and identification problems.

default.zh: 《红外技术与系统》课程是为光电信息科学与工程（光学工程方向）本科生开设的专业拓展课程。掌握红外技术与系统的基本概念、基本原理以及相关工程技术知识，是从事红外辐射计算、红外辐射测温、红外辐射源设计、红外辐射参数测量、红外探测器设计、红外诱饵研制、红外成像系统设计、红外诊疗仪器设计、红外对地遥感、红外制导、红外探测与识别等领域工作的基本前提。课程在先修课程《红外辐射与计量》的基础上，重点研究红外成像系统的设计方法，在内容上涉及目标与背景的热辐射特性、大气传输特性及其计算方法、红外光学系统典型结构、红外探测器及其制冷器类型、信号处理与显示以及红外成像系统评价方法与指标等内容。通过本课程的学习，能够使学生具备解决红外辐射分析计算、测量、成像、探测等红外技术问题的基本素质与能力，为从事光电信息科学与工程方面的工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: Infrared Technology and Systems is a specialized extended course for undergraduates (Optical Engineering) majoring in Optoelectronic Information Science and Engineering. It is a specialized curriculum, which is the research basis and premise for those who engage in infrared radiation calculation, infrared radiation thermometry, infrared radiation source design, infrared radiation parameters measurement, infrared detector design, infrared decoy development, infrared imaging system design, infrared diagnosis instrument constructor, infrared remote sensing of the earth, infrared guidance, infrared detection and recognition and other fields of works. On the basis of the prior curriculum "infrared radiation and measurement", the main point of this course is to focus on the design method of infrared imaging system. The content of this curriculum is mainly concerned with thermal radiation characteristics of goal and background, atmospheric transmission characteristics and its calculation methods, typical structure of infrared optical system, infrared detector and its refrigerator type, signal processing and display method, infrared imaging system evaluation methods and evaluating indicators and so on. Through learning this course enable students to have the ability to solve the basic quality and ability of infrared radiation analysis, measurement, imaging, infrared detection technology problems. Furthermore, students can possess a solid foundation for the follow-up work of Optoelectronics Information Science and Engineering.

default.zh: 光电图像处理课程面向光电信息科学与工程专业的本科生开课，是一门光学、成像、数字图像处理、计算机应用等多学科交叉的综合性很强的专业课。本课程结合当前光电图像处理的国内外最新研究成果和应用进展，力求使学生全面了解光电图像处理的基本概念及其在航空航天、国民经济等各个领域的应用。熟悉和掌握经典光电图像处理方法的基本原理、方法和实现步骤。 课程主要包括概论及应用介绍、图像增强、空域滤波、频域滤波、图像分割、图像复原及其它经典图像处理方法。需要学生们独立完成5个上机实验，培养学生的计算机编程能力。本课程成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、平时作业、上机实验及期末考试四部分。 通过本课程的课堂教学、上机编程练习，着重培养学生解决实际光电图像处理问题的能力，为从事光电信息处理、图像分析与识别等相关行业的研究打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The Optoelectronic Image Processing is a multidisciplinary specialized course, involving optics, imaging, digital image processing, computer applications, for students majoring in Optoelectronic Information Science and Engineering. This course introduces the new development and application of image processing technology at home and abroad. This course aims to make students fully understand the basic concepts of optoelectronic image processing and its applications in aerospace, national economy and other fields, and make students master the basic principles, methods and implementation steps of classical optoelectronic image processing methods. The main contents of this course include application introduction, image enhancement, spatial filtering, frequency filtering, image segmentation, image restoration and other classical image processing methods. Students are required to complete five image processing experiments independently to cultivate the programming capability. The grade of this course is cumulative, including four parts of the classroom performance, course assignment, computer experiment and final examination. This course focuses on enhancing students' ability to solve practical optoelectronic image processing problems with classroom teaching and programming practice. And this course is a foundation for the research of optoelectronic information processing, image analysis and recognition and other related technologies.

default.zh: 《光电信号探测》课是覆盖光电信息科学与工程、电子科学与技术、光学工程等多学科和专业的专业基础课，是培养能在应用光学、光电子学、光信息科学、电子信息科学以及测量与控制领域从事科学研究、教学、产品设计、生产技术或管理工作的高级专门人才所必须重要基础课。 本课的主要教学目的是向学生介绍光电信号探测的基本理论和基本知识，各种光辐射的基本原理、光电检测器件的工作原理、光电检测器件的结构特点与应用方法、以及实际的典型光电探测系统。在教学过程中，注意培养学生的逻辑思维能力、实际动手能力和创新能力。 通过本课程的学习，学生可以根据光辐射的特性来计算光电探测系统的性能参数、分析光电系统的探测性能，从而正确地进行光电系统的具体设计。此外，在研究和工作中，可针对现有的探测器性能提出光学系统的设计指标，通过系统的优化来提升光电探测的整体性能。 通过本课程的学习，学生能够将数学、物理光学、工程光学专业知识用于解决复杂光电探测系统设计问题；学生能够应用数学、物理光学、工程光学的基本原理，识别、表达、并通过文献研究分析复杂光电探测系统性能优化工程问题，以获得有效结论；学生能够具有自主学习和终身学习新型光电探测前沿技术的意识，有不断学习和适应发展光电探测技术的能力。
default.en: 《Photoelectric Signal Detection》 course is a professional basic course covering optoelectronic information Science and engineering, electronic science and technology, optical engineering and other disciplines and professional. It is an important basic course to train senior specialized talents in applied optics, optoelectronics, optical information science, information science and electronic measurement and control field in scientific research, teaching, product design production technology or management work. This main aims of this course to introduce the basic theory and basic knowledge of photoelectric signal detection, various optical radiation principle, the principle of photoelectric detection device, photoelectric detection device of the structure and the application method, as well as the actual typical photoelectric detection system. In the process of teaching, we should pay attention to train students' logical thinking ability, practical ability and creative ability. Through the study of this course, students can calculate the performance parameters of photoelectric detection system and analyze the detection performance of photoelectric system according to the characteristics of light radiation, so that the specific design of photoelectric system can be carried out correctly. In addition, in the research and work, the design index of optical system can be put forward according to the performance of existing detectors, and the whole performance of photoelectric detection can be improved by optimizing the system. Through this course, the students will be able to use mathematics, physical optics and optical engineering expertise to solve complex photoelectric detection system design problems. And students can apply the basic principle of mathematics, physical optics, optical engineering, identification, expression, and through literature research on the optimization performance of photoelectric detection system, to obtain a valid conclusion. Finally, students can have independent learning and lifelong learning of new photoelectric front detection technology has consciousness, continuous learning and ability to adapt to the development of photoelectric detection technology.

default.zh: 光学系统设计和机械结构设计交叉产生光机系统设计。通过该课程的学习，使学生从系统设计、系统分析、系统装配对光机系统设计课程具有系统的掌握，为学生在将来科研过程、实验过程、生产实际过程中对光学工程的实际应用提供工具方法、分析方法和借鉴技术，使学生应用光学设计更加接近实际，更有利于操作化和工程化。 本课程首先通过仿真方式演示光学元件非理想状态引起的成像变化；从光学系统误差设计引出光机系统误差，通过误差分配方法指导光机系统设计，进而开展设计软件使用的学习，讲述光机系统设计基本方法、机械设计软件与光学设计软件之间的数据转换方法、光机系统数值分析方法。在基本方法基础上，课程从光机系统装调方法与机构设计讲述光机系统装配设计原则和具体实用机构，包括透镜机构、扫描系统机构、大型光学系统机构。 通过该课程的学习，使学生能够从系统设计、系统分析、系统装配等方面解决光学仪器在设计与分析方面的系统问题，能够将数学、自然科学、工程基础和专业知识用于解决应用中涉及的应用光学领域的复杂工程问题，针对复杂应用光学工程问题，开发、选择与使用恰当的技术、资源、现代工程工具和信息技术工具，对复杂工程问题进行预测及模拟分析，并能够理解其局限性。
default.en: Opto-mechanical system design produces from optical system designing crossing with mechanical structure designing. After system learning, students master the course from some sides including the system designing, analyzing, constructing. And the course provides utility methods, analytical methods, and reference technologies for students to apply optical engineering in future scientific research, experimental processes, and practical production processes, as to make the application of optical design more practical and conducive to operationalization and engineering. Firstly, the course shows the imaging changing for optical lens in non-ideal state with simulating type. And then it introduces the opto-mechanical system error from optical system design error, and introduces optic-mechanical system designing from the system error assignment methods. It introduces the application of some designing software, in which it tells the base optical mechanical design methods, the data transition way from optical design software and mechanical design software, and opto-mechanical numerical analysis method. Then the curriculum introduces the design principle of opto-mechanical assembling and specific practical structure from opto-mechanical assemble method and structure design, including lens assemble structure, scanning optical system structure, large optical structure. From the course, students could solve systematically the optical instrument designing and analyzing engineering problems in the sides of opto-mechanical system design from system design, system analysis, system assemble, and solve the optical engineer application problems applying with basic mathematics、nature science, engineering basics and the professional knowledge. And according to the complex problems of optical engineering, students could develop, select, and use fitting technology, resource, mordant engineering instruments and informational technical tools to calculate and simulate the practical problems and find the limitations。

default.zh: 本课程为光电信息科学与工程的专业基础课，课程分为理论和实践两部分。理论部分包括：典型光学系统基本工作原理、基本像差理论；实践部分采用上机操作形式。 典型光学系统基本工作原理部分主要讲解人眼、放大镜、显微镜、望远镜及照相系统等典型光学仪器的基本工作原理。深入理解典型光学系统的光学特性、功能指标，对于光学仪器设计的初始阶段时光学仪器总体方案的确定是十分必要的。 基本像差理论包括：几何像差理论和波像差理论。几何像差理论常用于光学设计阶段，它能够定性、定量地反映光学系统的像质情况，指导像差校正；波像差理论多用于光学系统的检测与像差容限的制定。 上机部分：结合课堂讲授的典型光学系统基本原理、像差知识，学生将初步学会应用光学设计软件Zemax设计一些简单的光学系统。
default.en: This course is the basic course of Optoelectronic Information Science and Engineering. The course is divided into two parts: theory and practice. The theoretical part includes the basic working principle of the typical optical system and the fundamental aberration theory. The practical part adopts the form of computer operation. The basic working principle of typical optical system mainly deals with the basic working principle of typical optical instruments such as human eye, magnifier, microscope, telescope and photographic system. The depth understanding of the optical characteristics and functional indexes of typical optical systems is necessary for determining the overall scheme of optical instruments at the initial stage of optical instrument design. The basic aberration theory includes geometrical aberration theory and wave aberration theory. Geometrical aberration theory is often used in optical design stage. It can qualitatively and quantitatively reflect the image quality of optical system and guide the aberration correction. The theory of wave aberration is mostly used in the testing of optical system and the formulation of aberration tolerance. In the practical part: combining the typical principles of optical system and the knowledge of aberration in classroom teaching, students will initially learn to design some simple optical systems by using optical design software Zemax.

default.zh: 本课程主要包含两方面内容：薄膜光学理论基础与真空镀膜技术；薄膜光学理论基础部分主要介绍与光学薄膜特性相关的电磁理论、薄膜特性计算方法、薄膜设计相关的定理与方法，减反射膜、反射膜等常用膜系的分析与设计方法。真空镀膜技术部分主要介绍真空基础知识，真空薄膜沉积技术，包括热蒸发镀膜技术、溅射镀膜技术、离子镀膜技术，真空沉积薄膜的结构与特性，光学薄膜的性能测试方法。
default.en: This course mainly contains two parts: the theoretical basis of thin film optics and the vacuum coating technology. The theoretical basis part of thin film optics focuses on the electromagnetic theory related to the characteristics of optical film, the calculation methods of film properties, the theorem and methods related to film design, and then goes on to cite the analysis and design methods of common film systems such as reflective films, anti-reflection film. The vacuum coating technology part emphasizes the basic knowledge of vacuum, vacuum thin film deposition technology which includes thermal evaporation coating technology, sputter coating technology, ion plating technology, also introduces the structure and characteristics of vacuum deposited film, and the performance test methods of optical film.

default.zh: 《智能视觉系统设计》课是覆盖智能视觉工程、光电信息科学与工程、电子科学与技术、光学工程等多学科和专业的专业基础课，是培养能在智能视觉工程、应用光学、光电子学、光信息科学、电子信息科学以及测量与控制领域从事科学研究、教学、产品设计、生产技术或管理工作的高级专门人才所必须重要基础课。 本课的主要教学目的是向学生介绍智能视觉系统设计的基本理论、基本知识和基本方法，各种智能视觉系统的成像原理、光电转换原理、成像链路及优化方法，在此基础上进行实际设计案例训练。在教学过程中，注意培养学生的逻辑思维能力、实际动手能力和创新能力。 通过本课程的学习，学生可以根据智能视觉系统光学成像原理来计算智能视觉系统的性能参数、分析智能视觉系统的成像性能，从而正确地进行智能视觉系统的具体设计。此外，在研究和工作中，可针对现有的智能视觉系统提出光学系统的设计指标，通过系统的优化来提升智能视觉系统的整体性能。 通过本课程的学习，学生能够将应用光学、物理光学、信息光学、微纳光学专业知识用于解决复杂智能视觉系统的设计问题；学生能够利用应用光学、物理光学、信息光学、微纳光学的基本原理选择适当的智能视觉系统结构，识别、表达、并通过文献研究分析复杂智能视觉系统设计与性能优化的工程问题，以获得有效结论；学生能够具有自主学习和终身学习新型智能视觉系统设计前沿技术的意识，有不断学习和适应发展智能视觉系统设计的能力。
default.en: 《Intelligent Visual System Design》 course is a professional foundation course that covers multiple disciplines and majors such as intelligent visual engineering, optoelectronic information science and engineering, electronic science and technology, optical engineering, etc. It is an important basic course for cultivating advanced specialized talents who can engage in scientific research, teaching, product design, production technology or management work in the fields of intelligent visual engineering, applied optics, optoelectronics, optical information science, electronic information science, and measurement and control. The main teaching purpose of this lesson is to introduce students to the basic theory, knowledge, and methods of intelligent vision system design, as well as the imaging principles, photoelectric conversion principles, imaging links, and optimization methods of various intelligent vision systems. Based on this, practical design case training will be conducted. In the teaching process, attention should be paid to cultivating students' logical thinking ability, practical hands-on ability, and innovative ability. Through the study of this course, students can calculate the performance parameters of intelligent vision systems and analyze their imaging performance based on the optical imaging principles of intelligent vision systems, thereby correctly designing intelligent vision systems. In addition, in research and work, design indicators for optical systems can be proposed for existing intelligent vision systems, and the overall performance of intelligent vision systems can be improved through system optimization. Through the study of this course, students will be able to apply professional knowledge in applied optics, physical optics, information optics, and micro/nano optics to solve design problems of complex intelligent vision systems; Students are able to use the basic principles of applied optics, physical optics, information optics, and micro/nano optics to select appropriate intelligent vision system structures, identify, express, and analyze engineering problems related to the design and performance optimization of complex intelligent vision systems through literature research, in order to obtain effective conclusions; Students have the awareness of self-learning and lifelong learning of cutting-edge technologies in the design of new intelligent visual systems, and have the ability to continuously learn and adapt to the development of intelligent visual system design.

default.zh: 视觉仿真技术课程面向智能视觉工程专业本科开课，是重要的专业基础课程之一，也是学生学习后续专业课的基础。本专业核心课程通过深入探讨视觉仿真技术的前沿发展，涵盖视觉仿真理论基础、材质特性测量建模、蒙特卡洛积分原理、视觉仿真模型构建、光线追迹算法原理、GPU并行实时仿真以及视觉仿真实践方法等基本理论与技术。学生将学习应用数学建模与光线追迹等技术构建复杂场景下的全链路视觉仿真模型，培养解决实际工程问题的能力。通过课程学习，学生将了解视觉仿真技术的基本概念、研究热点、发展趋势和前沿应用，具备分析复杂场景下全链路视觉仿真问题的理论基础，以及利用光线追迹方法进行定量仿真分析的能力。实验方案设计和实验技能训练将逐步提升学生应用视觉仿真技术解决实际工程问题的能力，为今后从事数字孪生、视景仿真等研究奠定理论基础。 课程主要包括绪论、视觉仿真理论基础、材质特性测量建模、蒙特卡洛积分原理、视觉仿真模型构建、光线追迹算法原理、GPU并行实时仿真以及视觉仿真实践等内容。学生将通过课堂学习和动手实践，掌握视觉仿真技术的基本理论、技术方法以及实践技能。考核方式采用累加式方法，包括平时成绩、课堂小测、仿真实验和期末考试，以全面评价学生的学习效果和能力水平。
default.en: The course of visual simulation technology is one of the important basic courses for undergraduate students majoring in intelligent visual engineering, and it is also the basis for students to learn subsequent professional courses. The core course of this major deeply discusses the cutting-edge development of visual simulation technology, covering the basic theories and technologies of visual simulation theory, material property measurement modeling, Monte Carlo integration principle, visual simulation model construction, ray tracing algorithm principle, GPU parallel real-time simulation and visual simulation practice methods. Students will learn to apply techniques such as mathematical modeling and ray tracing to build full-link visual simulation models in complex scenarios and develop the ability to solve practical engineering problems. Through the course study, students will understand the basic concepts, research hotspots, development trends and cutting-edge applications of visual simulation technology, have the theoretical basis for analyzing full-link visual simulation problems in complex scenarios, and the ability to use ray tracing method for quantitative simulation analysis. Experimental scheme design and experimental skill training will gradually improve students' ability to apply visual simulation technology to solve practical engineering problems, and lay a theoretical foundation for future research on digital twin and visual simulation. The course mainly includes introduction, theoretical basis of visual simulation, material property measurement modeling, Monte Carlo integration principle, visual simulation model construction, ray tracing algorithm principle, GPU parallel real-time simulation and visual simulation practice, etc. Students will master the basic theories, technical methods and practical skills of visual simulation technology through classroom learning and hands-on practice. The assessment method is cumulative, including ordinary scores, classroom quizzes, simulation experiments and final exams, so as to comprehensively evaluate students' learning effect and ability level.

default.zh: 视觉测量技术课程面向智能视觉工程专业本科开课，是重要的专业核心课程之一，也是学生学习后续专业课的基础。课程主要讲授视觉测量的概念、方法、原理、流程及应用，包括单目视觉测量、双目立体视觉测量、结构光三维视觉测量等。重点使学生了解视觉测量的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用，熟悉和掌握常见视觉测量问题的分析方法和实验技能，并通过相关理论方法在实际工程中的应用研究，培养学生独立思考问题、分析问题与解决问题的能力，加强学生对视觉测量技术相关知识的理解与运用，为今后从事光电信息获取与处理等研究奠定理论基础。 课程主要包括绪论、视觉测量基本原理、视觉图像特征提取、视觉测量相机标定、单目视觉测量方法、双目视觉测量方法、结构光视觉测量方法、视觉测量仿真实验等内容。视觉测量基本原理为视觉测量建立了必要的理论基础。视觉图像特征提取、视觉测量相机标定讨论了如何提取感兴趣的图像特性并修正相机畸变影响的问题。单目视觉测量、双目视觉测量、结构光视觉测量阐述了常见的视觉测量技术。本课程的考核采用累加式方法，包括平时成绩、课堂小测、仿真实验和期末考试。
default.en: The course of visual measurement technology is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in intelligent visual engineering, which is one of the important core courses of the major and also the basis for students to learn the subsequent professional courses. The course mainly teaches the concept, method, principle, process and application of vision measurement, including monocular vision measurement, binocular stereo vision measurement, structured light three-dimensional vision measurement, etc. Focus on making students understand the theoretical basis, research hotspots, development trends and cutting-edge applications of visual measurement, familiar with and master the analytical methods and experimental skills of common visual measurement problems, and cultivate students' ability to think independently, analyze and solve problems through the application research of relevant theoretical methods in practical projects. Strengthen students' understanding and application of knowledge related to visual measurement technology, and lay a theoretical foundation for future research on optoelectronic information acquisition and processing.
