The course mainly includes introduction, basic principles of visual measurement, visual image feature extraction, visual measurement camera calibration, monocular visual measurement method, binocular visual measurement method, structured light visual measurement method, visual measurement simulation experiment and so on. The basic principle of visual measurement establishes the necessary theoretical basis for visual measurement. Feature extraction and camera calibration for visual image measurement The problem of how to extract interesting image features and correct camera distortion is discussed. Monocular vision measurement, binocular vision measurement and structured light vision measurement are described. The assessment of this course is cumulative, including regular grades, classroom quizzes, simulation experiments and final exams.

default.zh: 智能图像处理技术课程面向智能视觉工程专业的本科生开课，是一门数字图像（信号）处理、计算机应用、人工智能等多学科交叉的综合性很强的专业课。本课程结合当前智能图像处理技术的国内外最新研究成果和应用进展，力求使学生全面了解智能图像处理技术的基本概念及其在航空航天、国民经济等各个领域的应用。熟悉和掌握典型智能图像处理技术的基本原理、方法和实现步骤。 课程主要包括概论及应用介绍、神经网络基本概念、网络优化基本方法、卷积神经网络原理以及图像分类/分割网络、目标识别网络等智能图像处理方法。需要学生们独立完成8个上机实验，培养学生的计算机编程能力。本课程成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、上机实验及期末考试三部分。 通过本课程的课堂教学、上机编程练习，着重培养学生解决实际智能图像处理问题的能力，为从事信息智能处理、图像分析与识别、深度学习等相关行业的研究打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The Intelligent Image Processing Technology is a multidisciplinary specialized course, involving digital image processing, computer applications, artificial intelligence, for students majoring in Intelligent Vision Engineering. This course introduces the new development and application of intelligent image processing technology at home and abroad. This course aims to make students fully understand the basic concepts of intelligent image processing technology and its applications in aerospace, national economy, and other fields, and make students master the basic principles, methods, and implementation steps of classical intelligent image processing methods. The main contents of this course include application introduction, basic concepts of neural networks, basic methods of network optimization, principles of convolutional neural networks, and intelligent image processing methods such as image classification/segmentation network, and target recognition network. Students are required to complete 8 computer-based experiments independently to cultivate the programming capability. The grade of this course is cumulative, including three parts of the classroom performance, computer experiment and final examination. This course focuses on enhancing students' ability to solve practical intelligent image processing problems with classroom teaching and programming practice. And this course is a foundation for the research of intelligent information processing, image analysis and recognition, deep learning, and other related technologies.

default.zh: 深度学习和人工智能技术颠覆了传统的目标识别框架，是当前和未来相当长时间内解决数字图像中目标识别问题的主流方法。本课程作为智能视觉工程的基础课程，旨在介绍智能目标识别的基础概念和相关基础知识，培养学生在实践中分析目标识别问题，并使用智能方法解决问题的能力。 本课程采用授课教学为主，结合演示教学的方式进行。授课教学主要包括目标识别的定义与基本框架、基于匹配的智能识别、基于特征学习的智能识别、基于深度学习的智能识别、智能识别的优化机制、智能识别算法的性能评估等内容。现场演示教学包括典型大尺度目标识别、典型小尺度目标识别、目标连续跟踪、目标性能评估等实验，在授课过程中向学生演示。 通过对基本理论的学习，和相应算法演示，使学生初步掌握智能目标识别基础理论；经典识别方法以及相应评价方法。通过学习开拓学生视野，使学生初步掌握解决目标识别问题的能力。
default.en: Deep learning and artificial intelligence technologies have revolutionized the traditional frameworks of target recognition and stand as the predominant methodology for addressing target recognition issues within digital imagery, both currently and for the foreseeable future. This course serves as the fundamental curriculum of Intelligent Vision Engineering, and aims to impart the basic concepts and knowledge for intelligent target recognition. It seeks to cultivate the students' analytical skills in analyzing target recognition problems and to enhance their competency in employing intelligent methodologies for problem-solving. The instructional strategy of this course is primarily lecture-based, supplemented by demonstrative teaching methods. The lectures encompass a broad array of topics, including the definition and fundamental framework of target recognition, intelligent recognition based on matching techniques, intelligent recognition based on feature learning, DL-driven intelligent recognition, optimization mechanisms for intelligent recognition, and the performance evaluation of intelligent recognition algorithms. Demonstrative teaching sessions include experiments on typical large-scale and small-scale target recognition, continuous target tracking, and performance evaluation all showcased to students during the lectures. Through the study of fundamental theories and algorithm demonstrations, students are expected to gain a rudimentary command of the basic theory of intelligent target recognition, classical recognition methodologies, and corresponding evaluation techniques. The course is designed to broaden the students’ horizons and to equip them with the foundational skills required to address target recognition challenges.

default.zh: 空间光学卫星能够迅速、准确捕获地球表面特定区域的最新时空信息，具有空间覆盖性广、重访时间短、成像光谱波段多、图像纹理信息丰富、可长时间凝视成像等优点，是获取重点区域态势信息的重要手段。空间光学图像处理技术已被广泛应用于数字城市、地理国情监测、环境保护、灾害应急响应等各个领域。 本课程主要内容包括空间光学成像原理、空间光学图像辐射校正、几何校正、反演恢复、融合超分、解译应用等基础理论课程以及相应实验课程，旨在让学生了解光学遥感系统成像原理、图像质量退化机理，掌握校正、增强、解译等空间光学图像处理应用的基本概念与方法，通过遥感图像处理典型案例实践，锻炼“光学+信息+智能”多学科知识的交叉应用能力，以及适用先进工具解决工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: Space optical satellites can quickly and accurately capture the latest spatiotemporal information of specific areas on the Earth's surface. They have advantages such as wide spatial coverage, short revisit time, multiple imaging spectral bands, rich image texture information, and the ability to gaze for a long time. They are an important means of obtaining situational information in key areas. Space optical image processing technology has been widely applied in various fields such as digital cities, geographical and national monitoring, environmental protection, and disaster emergency response. The main content of this course includes basic theoretical courses such as spatial optical imaging principles, spatial optical image radiometric correction, geometric correction, inversion restoration, fusion super-resolution, visual interpretation, machine interpretation, as well as corresponding experimental courses. The aim is to enable students to understand the imaging principles of optical remote sensing systems and the degradation mechanism of image quality, and to master the basic concepts and methods of spatial optical image processing applications such as correction, enhancement, and interpretation. Through the practice of typical cases of remote sensing image processing, students will develop the interdisciplinary application ability of "optics+information+intelligence" and the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 航天电子与控制导论课程紧密围绕杰出人才培养目标，以人才培养供给侧改革为抓手，结合航天学院相关专业的发展趋势、专业特点、培养目标、研究内容及应用领域，通过智能视觉工程专业知识、智能视觉军民典型场景中的需求与应用、集成电路设计与集成系统专业知识、航天集成电路技术发展、自动化类专业的发展历程与未来趋势、自动化类专业知识、自动化技术在工业现场中的应用、商业航天控制技术发展等方面的主题式授课，凝练校内专业知识内容，拓展校外前沿知识讲解。使学生对航天学院相关专业的发展趋势、专业特点、培养目标、研究内容及应用领域等形成宏观认识，为后续开展专业知识学习奠定相关基础。
default.en: The course Introduction to Aerospace Electronics and Control is closely aligned with the goal of cultivating outstanding talent. Using supply-side reform in talent training as a key approach, and taking into account the development trends, disciplinary characteristics, training objectives, research content, and application fields of the relevant majors in the School of Astronautics, the course delivers thematic lectures on topics including professional knowledge in intelligent vision engineering; the needs and applications of intelligent vision in typical military and civilian scenarios; professional knowledge in integrated circuit design and integrated systems; developments in aerospace integrated circuit technology; the development history and future trends of automation-related disciplines; professional knowledge in automation; applications of automation technology in industrial settings; and developments in commercial aerospace control technology. The course refines and consolidates on-campus disciplinary knowledge while also expanding students’ horizons through the introduction of cutting-edge developments beyond the university. In this way, it helps students develop a broad understanding of the development trends, disciplinary characteristics, training objectives, research content, and application fields of the majors related to the School of Astronautics, thereby laying the groundwork for their subsequent study of specialized knowledge.

default.zh: 《飞行力学》是工科高等院校控制科学与工程学科或航空宇航科学与技术学科一门专业课程。本课程通过课堂教学和上机实验环节，培养学生运用高等数学、理论力学和空气动力学基础知识进行飞行器制导控制系统动力学建模的能力。 本课程以大气层内拦截导弹为主要背景，讲述飞行力学中常用的坐标系和坐标转换关系、作用在导弹上的气动力和气动力矩的基本特性和数学描述方法、作用在导弹上的反作用推力以及推力产生的反作用力矩的基本性质和数学描述方法、直接侧向力与气动力复合控制导弹的侧向喷流气动干扰效应及其数学描述方法、重力的特性和数学描述方法、大气层内导弹运动方程组的推导方法。学生通过学习飞行力学的基础知识，具备推导任何类型飞行器运动方程组的能力，掌握飞行器制导控制系统的基本建模原理和方法。通过计算机仿真实验，令学生设计大气层内飞行器机动飞行弹道，掌握飞行器质点运动模型的数值求解能力。
default.en: “Flight Dynamics” is a specialized course for engineering students who are major in Control Science and Engineering or Science and Technology in Aeronautics and Astronautics in technical universities. Via lectures and computer experiments, the purpose of this course is to train the students to have the capability of establishing dynamic mathematical models to describe the motions of flight vehicles via using knowledge on advanced mathematics, theoretical mechanics, and aerodynamics. The typical background of this course is that an endo-atmospheric interceptor missile intercepting a maneuvering target. Based on the motion of this interceptor missile, some normal coordinates and coordinates transformations in flight dynamics are introduced. Then the properties and mathematical descriptions of aerodynamic forces and the moments yielded by aerodynamic forces are given. Next, the properties and mathematical descriptions of reaction propulsion and its moments are presented. It follows that the properties of aerodynamic disturbance effect on side direction reaction propulsion are analyzed and a mathematical description for this effect is given. Moreover, the gravity on the missile is studied and mathematically depicted. Using the above results, equations to describe the missile motion are derived from the principles of Newton’s mechanics. Via studying the above knowledge on flight dynamics, the students will master the fundamental principle and method of modeling the flight motion and so have the capability of deriving motion equations for any type of flight vehicles. In computer simulation experiments, the students will design maneuvering flight paths of an aircraft, such that they are able to obtain numerical solutions for flight motions.

default.zh: 《飞行器控制与制导》是工科高等院校控制科学与工程学科或航空宇航科学与技术学科一门专业课程，本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、实验教学及上机实验等环节培养学生建立面向控制系统设计的飞行器运动数学模型的能力，以及运用自动控制理论知识设计飞行器制导控制系统的能力。 本课程以大气层内拦截导弹拦截空中机动目标为典型背景，在已经建立起拦截导弹全弹道运动数学模型的基础上，讲授导弹制导控制系统的分析、设计和仿真方法。导弹制导控制系统总体设计方面的内容包括：导弹制导控制系统的基本组成；制导控制系统设计的基本阶段和步骤。导弹控制系统设计方面的内容包括：导弹运动方程组的简化；导弹稳定控制系统设计中的线性控制方法；导弹稳定控制系统设计中的非线性控制方法；新型导弹稳定控制系统设计技术的发展趋势。导弹制导律设计方面的内容包括：古典导引规律分析，即追踪法、平行接近法、比例导引法及改进的比例导引法；导弹导引头探测目标并输出制导信息的基本工作原理；导弹现代导引规律设计方法，即线性二次型最优制导律及微分对策制导律、变结构制导律、非线性制导律等。
default.en: “Flight Control and Guidance” is a specialized course for engineering students who are major in Control Science and Engineering or Science and Technology in Aeronautics and Astronautics in technical universities. Via lectures and computer experiments, the purpose of this course is to train the students to have the capability of establishing mathematical models to describe the motions of flight vehicles for the design of flight control systems and the capability of designing flight control systems using knowledge on control theories. The typical background of this course is that an endo-atmospheric interceptor missile intercepts a flying target with maneuvers. Based on some missile motion models and target-missile relative motion models, some methods to analyze and design missile guidance and control systems are presented, and some methods to simulate missile guidance and control systems are practiced here. In essence, this course presents the constitution of a missile guidance and control system and the basic phase of designing the system. In order to practice the design of missile control system, the equations to describe missile motions are simplified and linearized. Some missile autopilot design methods such as classical design method in frequency domain and modern design method using Linear Quadratic Regulator are presented. Moreover, detailed analyses of classical guidance laws are provided, such as target pursuit approach，parallel Line-of-sight approach, Proportional Navigation Guidance Law and its modifications. In meanwhile the principle of how target seekers work is introduced. Finally, some modern guidance laws, such as Linear quadratic optimal guidance law, differential games guidance law, sliding-mode guidance law and nonlinear guidance law are presented.

default.zh: 随着社会的进步、经济和科技的不断发展，人类已经将活动范围扩展到外太空，并且加快了迈向整个宇宙的步伐，进而推动了航天事业的迅猛发展。作为航天工程的重要组成部分，航天器控制技术是航天器完成特定的空间探测、开发以及应用任务的有效保障。控制系统的性能直接影响着航天器自身的在轨寿命、工作性能甚至任务的成败。通过本课程，使得学生掌握航天器控制系统主要组成、基本工作原理以及未来的发展方向，并注重培养学生对航天器控制问题的研究兴趣，为今后继续从事相关研究奠定基础。
default.en: With the progress of society as well as the continuous development of the economy, science and technology, humanity has already extended their activities to outer space, and accelerated the pace towards the entire universe, thus promoting the rapid development of the space industry. As an important subsystem of aerospace engineering, effective spacecraft control is an important guarantee for spacecraft to complete certain specific space exploration, development, and application tasks effectively. The performance of the spacecraft control system has important meaning for spacecraft on-orbit life, operating characteristics or even success of space missions. By learning this course, the students are expected to grasp the composition of spacecraft control system, fundamental working principle, as well as the development direction in the future. It also focuses on fostering students’ interests on spacecraft control problems, and lays the foundations for future scientific research activities.

default.zh: 现代导航传感器技术与实践是探测制导与控制专业本科生的核心专业课，是学生从事探测制导与控制领域研究工作的基础。本课程利用授课教师所在中心科研设备包括惯性传感器、视觉传感器、北斗（GPS）、磁传感器等传感器和无人机、无人车等运行载体，搭建专业理论与工程实践高度结合的学习和研究平台，增强学生对导航传感器基础理论理解和实际工程应用的掌握，培养和提高学生动手实践和自主创新能力。
default.en: Modern Navigation Sensor Technology and Practice is the core professional course for undergraduate students majoring in detection guidance and control, which is the foundation for students to engage in research work in the field of detection guidance and control. This course utilizes the scientific research equipment of Sapce Control and Inertial Technology Research Cente , including inertial sensors, visual sensors, Beidou (GPS), magnetic sensors, and operational carriers such as drones and unmanned vehicles. These help establish a learning and research platform that highly integrates professional theory and engineering practice to enhance students' understanding of the basic theory of navigation sensors and practical engineering applications, and cultivate and improve their hands-on practice and independent innovation abilities.

default.zh: 《飞行器先进制导与控制》是探测制导与控制技术专业的重要课程，也是自动化专业导航制导与控制模块的关键组成，旨在培养学生对于飞行器先进制导控制系统的分析、设计、综合等能力。课程围绕飞行器先进制导与控制技术，主要讲授四部分内容：①飞行器数学建模，包括飞行器建模基础和典型模型；②飞行器先进姿态控制技术，包括基于动态逆的姿态控制和基于反步法的姿态控制；③飞行器先进制导技术，包括标称轨迹再入制导、预测校正制导和准平衡滑翔制导；④飞行器先进制导控制一体化技术，包括基于高阶模型的制导控制一体化和基于降阶模型的制导控制一体化。通过本课程的课堂教学以及后续的实验环节，学生将较为全面地认识飞行器先进制导与控制技术。
default.en: Advanced Guidance and Control of Flight Vehicles is an important course in the Detection Guidance and Control major and a key component of the navigation guidance and control module of the Automation major. It aims to cultivate students' abilities in analysis, design, and synthesis of advanced guidance and control systems for flight vehicles. The course focuses on advanced guidance and control technologies and mainly teaches four parts: ① mathematical modeling of flight vehicles, including modeling basics and typical models; ② advanced attitude control technologies of flight vehicles, including attitude control strategies based on dynamic inverse and back-stepping control; ③ advanced guidance technologies of flight vehicles, including nominal trajectory-based re-entry guidance, predictor-corrector guidance and quasi-equilibrium gliding guidance; ④ advanced integrated guidance and control (IG&C) of flight vehicles, including IG&C strategies based on full-order model and reduced-order model. Through the theoretical teaching and subsequent experimental session of this course, students will have a more comprehensive understanding of advanced guidance and control technologies of flight vehicles.

default.zh: 本课程以惯性仪表、惯导系统和自动控制元件等在实际工程中的应用为牵引，旨在加强学生对惯性导航、惯性测试技术、运动控制系统等基础知识的理解，提升学生解决工程应用问题的能力，增强学生学以致用的自我进化。本课程主要将惯性测试标定方法和惯性测试设备融合贯联，让学生了解惯导测试设备的运动参数基准激励源的产生、精密控制、精准传递，通过运动参数激励惯性仪表及系统，精确测试惯性仪表的基本性能参数和误差模型系数。本课程可作为探测制导与控制专业和自动控制专业本科生就业或继续深造的纽带课程。
default.en: Guided by the application of inertial instruments, inertial navigation systems and automatic control elements in practical engineering, this course aims to strengthen students understanding of basic knowledge such as inertial navigation, inertial testing technology and motion control system, improve students' ability to solve engineering application problems, and enhance students' self-evolution of applying what they have learned. This course mainly integrates the inertial test calibration method and inertial test equipment, so that students can understand the generation, precise control and accurate transmission of the reference excitation source of the motion parameters of inertial test equipment, and precisely test the basic performance parameters and error model coefficient of the inertial instrument by stimulating the inertial instrument and system through the motion parameters. This course can be used as a link course for undergraduates majoring in detection guidance and control and automatic control to find employment or further study.

default.zh: “天文导航技术实践”是面向“探测制导与控制”专业本科的一门课。该课程不但要求学生掌握到天文导航的基本原理和方法，而且还要求学生积极性，启发学生自己思考问题、解决问题以及动手能力，使学生最终达到学以致用的目的。课堂讲授中应引入实践环节，将理论讲授与实践操作相结合，在实践操作环节，学生可以操作课题组近几年完成相关项目过程中的调试和测试模块，学生也可以根据自身需要对这些调试和测试模块设置相关参数来输出模块化之间结果和最终结果。 比如学生可以调整“星敏感器模型教学演示”软件的镜头与探测器之间安装误差、镜头光学畸变以及色差等参数，观测导航相机调整参数前后的输出结果，学生能够进一步了解视觉导航方面误差机理和来源。 学生可以利用和操作实验室的“星敏感器+单星模拟器+双轴转台”系统，使学生对视觉导航精度的概念有进一步认识，为后续探索新方法和新技术奠定基础。 学生可以利用实验室的“星敏感器实验”系统，星敏感器的输出姿态和图像随着三维旋转平台变化而变化，使学生对载体三轴姿态（偏航角、俯仰角和滚动角）有进一步认识，同时也培养了学生的独立思考问题和分析问题的能力。 这些实践环节的加强，使得学生能够从具体的案例实验中掌握知识、运用知识，同时启发学生运用所学知识解决实际问题，探索新知识。
default.en: Astronomical Navigation Technology Practice is a course for undergraduates majoring in "detection guidance and control". This course not only requires students to master the basic principles and methods of astronomical navigation, but also requires students to be active, inspire students to think, solve problems and hands-on ability, so that students ultimately achieve the purpose of applying what they have learned. Practical links should be introduced into classroom teaching, combining theoretical teaching with practical operation. In the practical operation link, students can operate the debugging and testing modules in the course of related projects completed by the research group in recent years, and students can also set relevant parameters for these debugging and testing modules according to their own needs to output the results between modules and the final results. For example, students can adjust the installation error between lens and detector, lens optical distortion and color difference and other parameters of the "Star Sensor Model teaching demonstration" software, observe the output results before and after adjusting parameters of the navigation camera, and students can further understand the error mechanism and sources in visual navigation. Students can use and operate the "star sensor + single star simulator + two-axis turntable" system in the laboratory, so that students have a further understanding of the concept of visual navigation accuracy, and lay the foundation for subsequent exploration of new methods and technologies. Students can make use of the "star sensor experiment" system in the laboratory. The output attitude and image of the star sensor change with the change of the three-dimensional rotating platform, so that students can further understand the three-axis attitude of the carrier (yaw Angle, pitch Angle and rolling Angle), and also cultivate students' ability to think independently and analyze problems. The strengthening of these practical links enables students to master and apply knowledge from specific case experiments, and at the same time inspires students to apply knowledge to solve practical problems and explore new knowledge.

default.zh: 视觉导航原理与实践是控制科学与工程学科的一门比较重要的基础理论和工程实践相结合的专业选修课，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和导航制导工程实践能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要以智能移动机器人为授课对象，主要讲述机器人在未知环境下的位姿估计和环境地图构建方面的基础理论知识和工程实际应用算法。本课程的教学内容既包含了大量视觉导航方面的基本理论，又包含了许多与应用设计相关的基本设计方法，帮助学生建立一个视觉导航的基本知识框架。 课程以主讲教师承担的智能机器人领域科研项目为背景，以实验室已具备的仪器和自主研发的系统样机为依托，通过理论学习和实验设计，增强学生对智能机器人视觉导航系统基础知识的理解，增强对智能机器人领域的研究兴趣，提高学生自主创新能力和技术应用水平。为学生将来进一步从事与机器人导航、智能视频监控、飞行器末制导和视觉伺服等方面的研究和工作打下坚实的基础。同时，通过学习视觉导航原理与实践技术，完成对现有的传统导航技术的补充。
default.en: Principle and Practice of Visual Navigation is a professional elective course that combines the basic theory and engineering practice of controlling science and engineering disciplines. It plays an important role in cultivating students' creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and navigation guidance engineering practice ability. This course mainly focuses on intelligent mobile robots. It mainly introduces the basic theoretical knowledge and engineering application algorithms of mobile robots pose estimation and environment map construction under unknown environments. The content of this course covers a large number of basic theories of visual navigation, and contains many basic design methods related to application design to help students establish a basic knowledge framework for visual navigation. The course is based on the research projects of the intelligent robots undertaken by the lecturer. Based on the instruments already in the laboratory and the self-developed system prototype, the students can understand the basic knowledge of the intelligent robots visual navigation system through theoretical study and experimental design. To enhance research interest in the field of robots and improve students' independent innovation ability and technology application level. It will lay a solid foundation for students to further research and work in robot navigation, intelligent video surveillance, aircraft terminal guidance and visual serving. At the same time, by learning principle and practice of visual navigation, the existing traditional navigation technology is complemented.

default.zh: 磁测量原理、技术与应用是探测制导与控制专业本科生一门重要的选修课程，旨在使学生了解探测、导航与制导中的磁测量原理的基本概念、适用条件与发展趋势，掌握磁测量核心技术，增强学生对探测制导与控制领域的科学研究兴趣，培养学生在工程实践中的独立分析解决问题、团队协作和自主创新能力，也为学生从事深空探测、水下目标探测、资源探测；地、海、空、天各类载体的地磁导航；磁定向、磁定位、磁制导；卫星、无人机等载体的姿态控制；磁传感器研发与测试、磁环境模拟等领域研究工作奠定基础。 本课程主要讲述以下内容：阐述磁测量的基本原理、主要特点及其在地、海、空、天各领域内的应用；磁场基本概念和基本公式；磁电阻效应、巨磁阻抗原理、霍尔效应、电磁感应定律、基于量子理论的磁测量原理；各种磁传感器工作原理、适用条件与发展趋势；磁测量在现代磁探测、磁导航、磁制导等军事领域中的应用；了解磁传感器测试与标定原理，地磁仿真实验需求、基本原理、实验环境搭建与常用设备等。对所学的核心内容采用理论和实验课结合的形式，通过实验加深对所学内容的理解与应用，以实验室已具备的实验仪器和自主研发的系统样机为依托，进一步培养和训练学生的独立分析和解决问题、团队协作和综述表达等能力。
default.en: The principle, technology, and application of magnetic measurement are important elective courses for undergraduate students majoring in detection, guidance, and control. The aim is to enable students to understand the basic concepts, applicable conditions, and development trends of magnetic measurement principles in detection, navigation, and guidance, master the core technology of magnetic measurement, enhance students' interest in scientific research in the field of detection, guidance, and control, and cultivate their independent analysis and problem-solving skills in engineering practice Team collaboration and independent innovation capabilities, also providing students with opportunities to engage in deep space exploration, underwater target exploration, and resource exploration; Geomagnetic navigation using various carriers such as earth, sea, air, and sky; Magnetic orientation, magnetic positioning, magnetic guidance; Attitude control of carriers such as satellites and drones; Laying the foundation for research and development of magnetic sensors, testing, and magnetic environment simulation. This course mainly discusses the following content: explaining the basic principles, main characteristics, and applications of magnetic measurement in various fields such as earth, sea, air, and space; Basic concepts and formulas of magnetic fields; Magnetoresistance effect, giant magnetoimpedance principle, Hall effect, electromagnetic induction law, magnetic measurement principle based on quantum theory; The working principles, applicable conditions, and development trends of various magnetic sensors; The application of magnetic measurement in military fields such as modern magnetic detection, magnetic navigation, and magnetic guidance; Understand the testing and calibration principles of magnetic sensors, the requirements, basic principles, experimental environment construction, and commonly used equipment for geomagnetic simulation experiments. Adopting a combination of theoretical and experimental courses for the core content learned, we deepen our understanding and application of the content through experiments. Based on the laboratory's existing experimental instruments and independently developed system prototypes, we further cultivate and train students' abilities in independent analysis and problem-solving, teamwork, and summary expression.

default.zh: 机器人操作系统ROS（Robot Operating System）正逐渐成为机器人研发领域的通用软件平台。本课程重点讲授ROS的系统架构与基本概念、各功能模块的使用方法及编程技巧、导航与路径规划原理、视觉SLAM（同时定位与地图构建）的基础知识与核心算法，以及ROS在实时地图建模与导航中的应用等内容。此外，课程还将结合典型应用实例，讲解基于ROS的智能机器人控制系统的设计与仿真方法。
default.en: The Robot Operating System (ROS) is gradually becoming a general software platform in the field of robot research and development. This course focuses on teaching the system architecture and basic concepts of ROS, the usage methods and programming skills of each functional module, the principles of navigation and path planning, the basic knowledge and core algorithms of visual SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping), as well as the applications of ROS in real-time map modeling and navigation. In addition, the course will also combine typical application examples to explain the design and simulation methods of intelligent robot control systems based on ROS.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述计算机控制系统中作为控制单元的计算机与外围设备间接口的设计与实现问题。结合工程实例，介绍模拟信号、数字信号的采集；模拟信号、数字信号的输出，以及多个计算机间的通讯等计算机控制相关的接口电路的设计原则与实现方法。同时包括作为控制用计算机的选择与配置策略，计算机控制系统应用程序的设计特点；计算机控制系统中相应的抗干扰措施等。通过实验，熟悉并掌握计算机控制系统接口的一般方法。
default.en: The control of physical system with a digital computer or microcontroller is becoming more and more common. The course deals mostly with the analog and digital interfacing techniques. The analog-to-digital interface consists of an analog prefilter for each channel, a multiplexer if an analog-to-digital converter(ADC) is to be shared among several inputs, a sample hold circuit, and the ADC. The purpose of of prefilters is to avoid aliasing due to spectral components of the input signal. At the analog outputs of a controller the are commonly digital-to-analog coverter (DAC).Standard components are fast enough for conversion time to be neglected. But spectrum shaping or correspondingly to remove the extra high frequency components by the zero-order hold device. The last point to be discussed is the sequencing of inputs and outputs.

default.zh: 《信号检测技术基础》课程面向控制科学与工程系的本科生开课，是自动化类专业选修课中检测技术与自动化装置方向的课程。课程主要讲授信号检测的基本概念、检测系统的设计方法、信号数据的获取、转换与预处理方法、信号的基本检测与分析方法。以信号-信号数据获取-信号特征分析-信号检测处理为主线，始终围绕着“对实际中的信号进行检测”的核心理念开展教学，并结合信号与检测的工程应用问题进行讲解。 课程主要包括：信号检测技术的概述与研究内容、检测系统的基本设计方法、信号采集与误差处理、信号的转换与预处理、信号的基本特征分析方法、信号的检测与分析方法以及相关的实验部分。课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括作业、实验、研究设计和期末考试。
default.en: Fundamentals of Signal Detection Technology is for all the undergraduate students in the Department of Control Science and Engineering, which is a course in the direction of Detection Technology and Automatic Equipment for the major elective courses of Automation. In this course, the basic concepts of signal detection, the design method of detection system, the acquisition of signal data, the methods of conversion and preprocessing, and the basic methods of signal detection and analysis are introduced. The main line of the course is “signal - signal data acquisition - signal conversion and preprocessing - signal feature analysis and processing”, the core idea of teaching is “detecting the actual signal in practice”, and the course is also explained with the engineering application of signal detection. The course mainly includes: the overview and research content of signal detection technology, the basic design method of detection system, signal acquisition and error processing, signal conversion and processing, signal characteristic analysis method, signal detection and analysis method, and the related experiments. The course examination results are cumulative, including assignments, experiment, research design and final exams.

default.zh: 数字图像处理是自动化类专业的一门专业基础课，也是面向视觉感知与认知、智能无人系统领域的一门专业课。 学生通过数字图像处理课程的学习，能够掌握数字图像处理的基本概念、理论、方法和技术，包括数字图像的数学描述、空频域变换、图像增强与复原、图像的表达与描述、图像分割与目标检测、目标的跟踪等内容，并了解本领域最新发展成果与动态。通过本课程的课堂教学、实例演示、实验操作以及计算机仿真等环节的培养，着重培养学生对数字图像处理系统的综合分析与设计能力，实际的动手与实践能力，以及相关科学知识的综合运用能力，增强学生的创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Digital image processing is a fundamental course in automation majors, as well as a specialized course in the fields of visual perception and cognition, and intelligent unmanned systems. Through the study of digital image processing courses，the students can master the basic concepts, theories, methods and techniques of this course, including mathematical description of digital images, spatial frequency domain transform, image enhancement and restoration, image representation and description,image segmentation and object detection, object tracking et al. At the same time, the students can know and understand the latest developments in the field. Through the training of classroom teaching, experimental demonstration and operation, computer simulation, this course focuses on the cultivation of the students' comprehensive analysis and design ability of digital image processing system and practical ability. On the other hand, the course can promote the students’ the comprehensive utilization ability of related theoretical knowledge, enhance students' awareness of innovation.

default.zh: 系统辨识是现代控制理论的重要分支，是进行复杂系统仿真、自适应控制不可缺少的技术手段。系统辨识主要研究如何确定控制系统数学模型及其参数的问题，系统辨识基础课程旨在让自动化及相关专业本科生掌握系统辨识的基本原理和方法，了解系统辨识过程。 课程主要包括:系统辨识的定义及步骤，系统辨识常用输入信号产生方法及性质，经典辨识方法，最小二乘辨识方法及其改进方法、极大似然辨识法，系统结构辨识等内容。并通过上机实验，使得学生加深对系统辨识理论方法的理解，提高分析解决实际问题的能力。 课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时和实验等。
default.en: System identification is an important branch of modern control theory. It is an indispensable technical mean of the complex system simulation and adaptive control. System identification mainly focuses on the problem of how to determine the control system mathematical model and its parameters. This course is designed for automation undergraduate students to master the basic theory and method of system identification. It mainly includes: the definition and steps of system identification, common method and nature of input signal generation, classical identification method, least square method and its improved method, maximum likelihood identification method, system structure identification and so on. In addition, the experiment on the computer will make the students to deepen the understanding of theory of system identification method and improve the ability to analyze and solve practical problems. The final exam, daily work and experiment constitute the total mark of this course.

default.zh: 本课程是一门综合性强，在理论与实践相上多学科交叉，强调控制系统设计工程化的一门专业课。 本课程讲解常见的直流电动机和交流电动机的拖动工作原理和控制系统设计方法，建立电动机运动控制系统的运动学和动力学数学模型，利用自动控制理论的基本原理和分析方法对其进行分析。直流电机部分的主要课程内容包括速度反馈单闭环控制系统设计、电流速度双闭环系统的基本结构和工程设计方法等。交流电机部分则主要分析交流电动机的速度控制方法，研究和掌握矢量控制和直接转矩控制的基本原理。然后在此基础上，本课程以转台例具体讲解一类实际伺服运动控制系统。 本课程着眼于提高学生解决运动控制系统设计中的工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: This course is a professional course which has strong comprehensiveness. It is multidisciplinary in theory and practice. It lays stress on engineering designing of control system. This course studies the driving principle and motion control system design of electrical machines, including direct current motor and asynchronous current motor, builds the kinematics and dynamics model of motor motion control system ,and analyzes the control system by applying the theory and analysis method of Automatic Control Principle. For the direct current motor, the main contents include the speed closed loop design of electrical machine, the structure of the current and speed double closed loop and the engineering design methods. For the asynchronous current motor, the course mainly analyzes the speed control method and studies the principle of the vector control and direct torque control. And on these bases, this course studies one kind of practical Servo motion control system taking Turn-table as an example This course looks at improving the students’ ability of analyzing and solving realistic engineering problems of motion control system.

default.zh: 过程控制面向自动化专业类学生开设，是一门与实际生产过程联系十分密切的课程，是自动控制理论、自动控制实践课程的延伸和发展。课程主要讲授过程控制系统的组成、基本分析设计步骤与设计方法，以及过程控制中的建模方法与仪表选用等内容。章节包括过程控制概述、检测与变送仪表、执行器、过程建模和PID控制系统、串级控制系统、前馈控制系统、大时延控制系统、解耦控制系统的分析与设计以及模型预测控制。重点是使学生知道如何将控制理论与系统实际结合、熟悉掌握过程控制系统的常用设计方法、并知晓这些设计方法的使用场合。课程采用累加式考试方式，包括平时课堂表现、课程报告及实验报告。
default.en: Process Control is an elective course of automation, and it's closely related to the actual production process, and is the extension and development of automatic control theory and automatic control practice course. The course mainly introduces the composition of process control system, basic analysis and design methods, as well as modeling methods and instrument selection in process control. This course includes an overview of process control, detection and transmitter, actuator, process modeling, the analysis and design of PID control system, cascade control system, feedforward control system, time-delay control system, and decoupling control system, as well as model predictive control. The key is to let students know how to combine control theory with system reality, familiar with the common design methods of process control system, and know how to use these design methods. The course adopts accumulative examination method, including daily classroom performance, course reports, and experimental report.

default.zh: 《汽车动力学与控制》课程是为控制科学与工程学科及相关专业学生的发展而开设的，旨在拓宽学生视野，激发科研兴趣，锻炼科研能力。本课程介绍了汽车动力学建模的基础理论、轮胎力学及汽车空气动力学；重点介绍以纵向运动为主的驱动动力学和制动动力学，以及以垂向运动为主的行驶动力学和以侧向运动为主操纵动力学等内容。本课程结合实际工程项目开发经验，从动力学分析与建模、控制系统分析与设计和仿真验证几个方面讲授车辆驱动、制动、悬架系统的动力学与控制相关内容。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解汽车系统动力学研究的主要内容，熟悉系统建模的基础理论、轮胎力学和空气动力学的基础，掌握纵向、垂向和侧向动力学的建模和分析方法以及三向动力学对整车性能的影响，了解车辆计算机建模与仿真相关的软件；引导学生学习运用动力学、运动学知识建立汽车模型和仿真分析汽车动态特性的方法，掌握汽车系统动力学分析与建模、以及控制器设计和应用的基本思路，以此培养学生解决科学、工程问题的能力；使学生理解汽车技术与国民经济、环境、社会、可持续发展的关系，了解未来技术发展趋势和主要特点，为其今后从事相关领域的工程设计工作打下良好的理论、技术和实验基础。
default.en: The course ‘Vehicle Dynamics and Control' is designed for the development of students in the fields of control science and engineering. It aims to broaden students' horizons, stimulate their research interests, and exercise their research abilities. This course introduces the basic theory of automotive dynamics modeling, tire mechanics, and automotive aerodynamics. It focuses on the driving dynamics and braking dynamics dominated by longitudinal motion, as well as the driving dynamics dominated by vertical motion and the control dynamics dominated by lateral motion. This course combines practical engineering project development experience to teach the dynamics and control related content of vehicle driving, braking, and suspension systems from the aspects of dynamic analysis and modeling, control system analysis and design, and simulation verification. Through the study of this course, students will understand the main content of automotive system dynamics research, become familiar with the basic theories of system modeling, tire mechanics, and aerodynamics, master the modeling and analysis methods of longitudinal, vertical, and lateral dynamics, as well as the impact of three-dimensional dynamics on overall vehicle performance, and understand software related to vehicle computer modeling and simulation. It guides students to learn the methods of using dynamics and kinematics knowledge to establish car models and simulate and analyze their dynamic characteristics, master the basic ideas of car system dynamics analysis and modeling, as well as controller design and application, in order to cultivate students' ability to solve scientific and engineering problems. It enables students to understand the relationship between automotive technology and national economy, environment, society, and sustainable development, understand the future trends and main characteristics of technological development, and lay a solid theoretical, technical, and experimental foundation for their future engineering design work in related fields.

default.zh: 系统工程是组织管理系统的规划、研究、设计、制造、试验和使用的科学方法，是从整体出发合理开发、设计、实施和运用系统的工程技术，是控制科学与工程学科下的重要学科方向，内容涉及系统模型、系统评价、系统决策、系统优化等。本课程的主要内容包括：系统来源与定义、系统属性与分类、系统工程定义和特点、系统工程方法论概述、系统工程应用方法、系统工程模型概述、典型的系统工程模型、时间序列模型的概念和形式、系统工程建模工具、常用的综合评价方法及应用、系统决策概述、多目标决策方法概述、系统对策概述、典型对策方法的应用、系统优化问题概述、线性规划方法理论等。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂讲授、实例介绍和上机实践等环节，使学生掌握系统的概念，熟悉系统模型分类，掌握系统决策和优化方法，培养学生运用系统工程理论分析工程问题、设计并优化系统解决方案的能力，提高学生的综合能力、宏观问题处理能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: System Engineering is a scientific domain in which system planning, research, design, manufacture, test and use are discussed. It is also an engineering approach about how to develop, design and use system. System engineering is an important research direction in control science and engineering community. It covers system modeling, system evaluation, system decision and system optimization. It is a preliminary course for future learning on system engineering domain. It is also important in helping the student to learn the concept of system, optimization and global system. It is also important for helping the student to become an innovative and creative person.

default.zh: 博弈论自从诞生以后快速发展，不仅其理论日臻成熟完善，而且应用范围日益广泛。博弈论的应用已涵盖经济学、生物学、社会与管理科学、军事与决策理论、计算机、 人工智能等，特别是它与控制论的相互影响和促进。博弈论或者控制论属于普适性的学科，与传统的物理学、力学或数学等不同, 控制与博弈不仅要认识世界, 而且更重要地是能动地改造世界。控制与博弈之间有着深刻的内在联系：控制论所处理的对象主要是机器等没有智能的力学系统，目的是设计控制，让客观事物按照控制者的主观愿望运行；而博弈可以看作控制的延伸或发展，它所控制的对象是有智能的。对象可能有着不同的目标，这就形成了非合作博弈；对象也可能同你合作，但必需兼顾它的利益，这就形成了合作博弈。未来的被控对象范围将更为广泛，无人驾驶、移动机器人、可以在线规划弹道的飞行器等均可被视为有智能的被控对象。作为控制论与博弈论的交叉学科，基于博弈的控制理论与控制导向的博弈理论，可望成为一个从理论到应用都极具重要性的交叉学科发展方向。 本课程的研究对象是博弈论，为自动化类的本科生开设。课程希望能够使得学生了解和掌握博弈方面的基本概念、相关理论方法和最新研究成果，实现博弈论与实际应用的交叉结合，内容强调基础理论以及前沿性与探索性，课程具体目标包括： (1)使学生了解和掌握博弈论的基本思想、理论和方法，能够在自动化领域的系统建模中运用博弈论的思想和方法。 (2)启发学生能够使用博弈论方法思考，能够应用博弈论的模型、基本理论和方法分析和解决实际问题，并通过文献研究，从系统的角度对自动化领域的自主系统工程问题进行建模和分析，以获得有效结论。 (3)训练学生能够针对自动化领域的系统工程问题，基于博弈论方法设计和开发适当的解决方案，设计满足特定需求的系统，并能够在设计环节中体现创新意识,使得学生在未来控制领域的工作与研究活动中更具有竞争力。 (4)通过上机实验课培养学生对相关编程语言、数据结构和算法的使用。
default.en: Game theory has rapidly developed, not only maturing and improving its theories but also expanding its applications. The application of game theory has covered various fields, including economics, biology, social and management sciences, military and decision theory, computer science, artificial intelligence, and especially its mutual influence and promotion with control theory. Game theory and control theory belong to universal disciplines, unlike traditional disciplines such as physics, mechanics, or mathematics. Control and game theory not only aim to understand the world but, more importantly, to actively transform it. There is a profound intrinsic connection between control and game theory: control theory primarily deals with non-intelligent mechanical systems such as machines, aiming to design controls that make objective things operate according to the subjective desires of the controller. On the other hand, game theory can be seen as an extension or development of control, controlling intelligent objects with different objectives, leading to non-cooperative games, and cooperative games where the object must balance its interests. The scope of controlled objects in the future will be broader, encompassing intelligent controlled objects such as unmanned vehicles, robots, and flying machines capable of planning trajectories online. As an interdisciplinary field at the intersection of control and game theory, control theory based on games and game theory oriented towards control is expected to become an extremely important direction of interdisciplinary development, both in theory and application. This course focuses on the study of game theory and is designed for undergraduate students majoring in control. This course aims to enable students to understand and grasp the basic concepts, relevant theoretical methods, and the latest research results in game theory, achieving an interdisciplinary combination of game theory and practical applications. The course emphasizes both fundamental theory and cutting-edge explorations, with specific objectives including: (1) Enabling students to understand and grasp the fundamental ideas, theories, and methods of game theory, allowing them to apply the ideas and methods of game theory in system modeling in the field of automation. (2) Inspiring students to think using game theory methods, applying models, basic theories, and methods of game theory to analyze and solve practical problems, and conducting literature research from a systematic perspective to model and analyze engineering problems of autonomous systems in the field of automation, in order to obtain effective conclusions. (3) Training students to design and develop appropriate solutions based on game theory methods for engineering problems in the field of automation, designing systems that meet specific requirements, and demonstrating innovative thinking in the design process, making students more competitive in their future work and research activities in the field of control. (4) Cultivating students' abilities to use tools including computer programming, data structure and algorithms through practical lab sessions.

default.zh: 控制系统仿真是根据真实系统的数学模型研究系统性能的技术，是实际工程任务分析和设计的重要参考，也是控制理论教学与实验的重要辅助工具。本课程将采用课堂教学和上机实验结合的形式，通过航天领域实例讲解优秀的控制系统仿真软件的应用方法，培养学生开发和应用仿真系统的能力，加深对所学自动控制原理等专业课的理解，提高学生的科研和设计水平，为后续科研活动的开展等奠定基础。
default.en: Based on the mathematical model of practical system, system simulation technology is a useful tool for engineers during system analysis and design of real engineering missions. It is also an important auxiliary tool during control theory teaching and experiment. Through combining the teaching methods of classroom teaching and computer experiments, this course would introduce the application methods of two excellent control system simulation software to cultivate students' ability of development of simulation system, and also deepen their understanding of learned specialized courses such as automatic control principle, so that to lay a foundation for subsequent research activities.

default.zh: 无人机相关技术是当前的热点研究领域，无人机在军用及民用领域都实现了较广泛的应用。无人机系统包括飞行器系统、控制系统、地面站系统、作业系统等，其设计、实现与应用均采用系统工程的原理与方法。本课程基于系统工程理论，以无人机系统为研究对象，讲解无人机系统工程导论（无人机系统的分类、组成与飞行原理等）、无人机系统的分析方法（模型驱动法、需求获取法等）、无人机系统的设计方法（动力系统设计、飞行控制系统设计等）、无人机系统的实现方法（飞行器的实现、控制系统的实现等）、无人机系统的集成与试飞等内容，旨在以多学科交叉的方式帮助学生加深对系统工程、自动控制原理、控制系统设计、单片机控制等专业知识的理解和运用，充分调动学生的主观能动性，增强学生的控制系统实现能力和动手能力。 课程包含24个学时的理论授课及8个学时的实验授课，在讲解必要理论及方法的基础上，使用多旋翼/直升机/垂起固定翼无人机系统、无线电遥控系统、飞行控制系统、云台作业系统等实物进行演示讲解与实验操作，并使用STM32单片机及相关硬件进行单片机编程及系统实现。本课程是一门理论与实践相结合的专业选修课，在系统工程与仿真研究方向为本科生提供了基于一个热点应用的学习机会。
default.en: UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) related technology is the hotspot today. UAV is widely used in the fields of military and civilian applications. A UAV system contains aerial vehicle system, flight control system, ground station system, task operation system etc. It adopts the principles and methods of system engineering to realize design, development and application. Based on the theory of system engineering, the lecture takes the UAV system as the studying object, and explains the introduction of UAV system engineering (including UAV system’s category, components and flying principle etc.), the analysis methods of UAV system (including model-driven method, requirement acquisition etc.), the design methods of UAV system (including power system design, flight control system design etc.), the implementation methods of UAV system (including aerial vehicle implementation, control system implementation etc.), and the integration & test flight of UAV system etc. The lecture aims at helping students understand and use the knowledge of system engineering, automation control theory, control system design, MCU (Micro Controller Unit) control etc. more efficiently, with the teaching method of multiple correlated disciplines. Meanwhile, the lecture emphasizes on stimulating the study motivation of the students, and enhancing the student's ability of control system implementation and manipulation. The lecture contains 24 class hours of theory and 8 class hours of experiment. On the basis of explaining necessary knowledge principles and theory methods, the lecture uses the real machines of multi-rotor/helicopter/VTOL fixed-wing UAV system, remote control system, flight control system, and cradle head system etc. to perform demonstration and experiment manipulation, and uses STM32 MCU with related hardware to realize programming and system implementation. The lecture is a theory and practice combined professional elective course, and provides a studying opportunity on hot application of system engineering and simulation technology to undergraduate students.

default.zh: 机器人学是一门高度交叉的前沿学科，它的巨大进步和应用是二十世纪自动控制最有说服力的成就，并随着各相关领域的技术进步，在生产加工制造、医疗、服务等众多行业得到了越来越广泛的成功应用。本课程为机器人学的基础课程，为自动化类专业本科生掌握工业机械臂的基本特性、掌握对其进行分析、设计和控制的基本方法以及从事相关研究奠定基础。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握机器人的概念、种类和分类方法，了解机器人学的研究领域及其发展方向，掌握机器人数学描述、机器人运动学、动力学、轨迹规划的基本分析方法，并掌握简单的机器人控制方法。学习本课程将为进一步学习机器人学课程提供有效的基础和承接。
default.en: Robotics is a highly interdisciplinary and cutting-edge discipline, and its tremendous progress and application are the most convincing achievements of automatic control in the 20th century. With the technological progress in various related fields, it has been widely and successfully applied in many industries such as production, processing, manufacturing, healthcare, and services. This course is a fundamental course in robotics, laying the foundation for undergraduate students majoring in automation to master the basic characteristics of industrial robotic arms, master the basic methods of analyzing, designing, and controlling them, and engage in related research. Through the study of this course, students will master the concepts, types, and classification methods of robots, understand the research fields and development directions of robotics, master the basic analysis methods of robot mathematical description, robot kinematics, dynamics, and trajectory planning, and master simple robot control methods. Studying this course will provide an effective foundation and continuation for further learning of robotics courses.

default.zh: 智能控制是一个十分活跃和具有挑战性的发展方向，近年来随着人工智能的兴起得到迅速发展和广泛重视。课程作为自动化类及相关专业的一门主要选修课，系统讲述了智能控制的基本概念、原理、典型智能控制方法与智能控制系统、系统应用等内容。课程包括智能系统与智能控制、智能无人系统与自动驾驶技术、模糊系统与模糊控制、智能计算、强化学习控制等，涵盖自主智能系统与智能控制的概念、方法、关键技术及应用实例等内容。课程讲述和启发相结合，同时采用实例、图片等形象化的教学方式，反映国内外智能控制研究和应用的最新进展，通过课堂教学、实验等环节，培养学生掌握现代智能系统与智能控制思想、控制系统设计与实践能力、培养学生的协作及创新能力。
default.en: Intelligent control is an active and challenging direction and attracts wide attention in recent years with the rise of artificial intelligence. As a major elective course of automation and relative majors, the course systematically teaches basic concepts and principles of intelligent control, typical intelligent control methods and intelligent control systems, system applications with illustrative examples. The course includes intelligent systems and intelligent control, intelligent unmanned systems and autonomous driving, fuzzy systems and fuzzy control, intelligent computing, reinforcement learning control, covering basic concepts and application examples of autonomous systems and intelligent control. The course combines presentation and heuristic teaching methods, and visualize teaching with examples and pictures to reflect recent advances in international intelligent field. Through classroom teaching and experiments, students can master basic knowledge of modern intelligent system and intelligent control, design and engineering capability of intelligent control system, and train teamwork and innovation capabilities.

default.zh: 模式识别基础课程是自动化类专业高年级本科生的一门重要的选修课。模式识别是利用计算机技术自动的实现事物的识别和分类，主要包括模式采集、特征提取和特征选择以及类型判别三大任务。本课程主要讲授模式识别中特征提取、特征选择、分类器设计和分类决策的基本原理和理论，重点是学生了解模式识别的理论基础、研究现状和热点问题、发展趋势以及前沿工程应用，熟悉和掌握模式识别中各个步骤的主要方法、算法原理以及实现技能。课程主要包括贝叶斯决策理论、线性分类器、近邻法、决策树、集成学习、最优/次优特征选择方法、K-L变换、主成分分析、无监督学习方法、支持向量机、卷积神经网络、循环神经网络以及Transformer等。通过本课程的课堂教学、实验和案例分析等环节，使学生具备模式识别问题分析的知识基础，能够分析和解决实际工程中的模式识别问题。通过方案设计和实验技能的基本训练，逐步具有运用模式识别知识和技术解决本专业及相关领域工程实际问题的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末考查成绩、实验成绩和随堂测试成绩三部分。
default.en: Pattern Recognition Basis is an important elective course for senior undergraduate students of automation major. Pattern recognition utilizes the computer technology to achieve recognition and classification of things automatically and it mainly includes three tasks, which are pattern acquisition, feature extraction and selection, and type identification. This course mainly introduces the basic principles and theories of feature extraction, feature selection, classifier design, and classification decision in pattern recognition. After finishing the lesson, the students should know the theoretical foundation, current research status and hot issues, tendency, and the engineering applications, master the main methods, algorithm principles, and experimental skills of every steps in pattern recognition. The methods introduced in this course are Bayes decision theory, linear classifiers, nearest neighbor method, decision tree, ensemble learning, the optimal/suboptimal feature selection methods, K-L transformation, principal component analysis, unsupervised leaning method, support vector machine, convolutional neural network, recurrent neural network, and transformer, etc. Through classroom teaching, experiment, and case studies, knowledge foundation for pattern recognition problem analysis for students is established. Through the basic training of program design and experimental skills, the students can have the ability to analyze and solve practical engineering problems in the related fields by applying the learned pattern recognition knowledge and technology. The score of this course is the summation of three parts, which are the final examination score, experiment scores, and quizzes scores.

default.zh: 人工智能技术是研究如何运用计算来模拟人脑所从事的感知、推理、学习、思考和规划等人类智能活动，解决需要人脑智能才能解决的问题。自动化专业的学生学习人工智能基础与传统的计算机相关专业强调算法不同，更强调人工智能算法在专家系统、机器学习、深度学习及模糊推理结构在控制系统方面的应用。通过本课程学习掌握人工智能的基本概念、基本原理、知识的表示、机器学习技术、深度学习技术、神经网络技术，掌握人工智能的一个问题和三大技术。通过本课程的学习，为相关专业本科生了解人工智能技术的基本特点，掌握人工智能在工程实际中的应用奠定基础。
default.en: Artificial intelligence technology is the study of how to use computation to simulate human intelligence activities such as perception, reasoning, learning, thinking, and planning, in order to solve problems that require human brain intelligence. Students majoring in automation to learn the Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence is different from traditional computer related majors emphasizing algorithms. It emphasizes the application of artificial intelligence algorithms in expert systems, machine learning, deep learning, and fuzzy inference structures in control systems. Through this course, students will master the basic concepts, principles, knowledge representation, machine learning technology, deep learning technology, and neural network technology of artificial intelligence, and master one problem and three major technologies of artificial intelligence. Through the study of this course, it lays the foundation for undergraduate students in relevant majors to understand the basic characteristics of artificial intelligence technology and master the application of artificial intelligence in engineering practice.

default.zh: 随着数字技术的发展和成熟，自动控制系统从已经从模拟系统过渡到数字系统，数字信号处理的能力是本科生应该具备的能力之一。数字信号处理课程主要为自动化及探测与制导专业的本科三年级学生开设，课程主要讲授数字信号处理的基本理论和方法。本课程的主要内容分为离散信号及系统的时域分析方法、变换域分析方法以及时域离散系统的设计方法两大部分。时域分析方法主要包括典型序列及其表示和运算、系统的时域表示和时域特性分析，线性常系数差分方程的求解，信号的采样及重建等；变换域分析方法主要包括离散时间傅立叶变换（DTFT），周期序列的傅立叶级数（DFS），离散傅立叶变换（DFT）及快速傅立叶变换算法（FFT）；离散系统的设计部分包括数字滤波器的结构、无限冲激响应（IIR）和有限冲激响应（FIR）滤波器的设计方法。此外，本课程将结合实际系统，介绍数字信号处理理论的应用实例。由于数字信号处理的基本理论涉及到很多抽象的数学推导过程，为了使学生对理论知识有更具象的了解，本课程还将结合MWorks软件在课堂上做图形及动画演示，介绍使用MWorks软件进行简单数字信号处理的方法。
default.en: With the development and maturity of digital technology, the automatic control system has been transferred from analog system to digital system. The ability of digital signal processing should be mastered by the undergraduate students. The course of Digital Signal Processing is designed for junior students of specialty of automation, detection, and guidance. This course is mainly about the basic theory and method of digital signal processing. The main contents of this course can be divided into two parts: the method of time-domain analysis and transform-domain analysis of discrete signal and system; and the designing method of discrete system. The time-domain analysis method mainly includes the analysis of typical sequences and their time-domain representation and operation; the time-domain representation and characteristics of systems; the solution of linear constant coefficient difference equation; the sampling and reconstruction theory of signal, etc. The transform domain analysis methods mainly include the discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT), the discrete Fourier series (DFS), the discrete Fourier transform (DFT), and the fast Fourier transform algorithm (FFT); the design of the discrete system including the structure of digital filter; the designing methods of infinite impulse response (IIR) and finite impulse response (FIR) filter. In addition, the application of digital signal processing theory in the actual system will be introduced. The basic theory of digital signal processing involves many abstract mathematical derivations, in order to enable the students to have a more concrete understanding of theoretical knowledge, this course also introduces MWorks software to demonstrate graphics and animation, and the methods of simple digital signal processing using MWorks software.

default.zh: 智能无人车是融合传感、网络、通信、自动控制等技术于一体的智能无人系统。本课程结合实际工程项目开发经验，主要讲授汽车智能化的基本概念、无人车的环境感知与网络通信技术、车辆建模与状态估计方法、无人车的定位与轨迹规划、无人车的运动控制方法。课程内容涵盖系统运动学与动力学建模、控制系统设计与分析、仿真验证等方面的内容，并对融合电动化和智能化技术的智能电动汽车所带来的科学问题做出展望。
default.en: An intelligent unmanned vehicle is an intelligent unmanned system which integrates sensing, network, communication, automatic control and other technologies. Combined with practical project development experience, the teaching material chosen for this course mainly consists of the basic concepts of vehicle intelligence, environmental awareness and network communication technology of unmanned vehicle, vehicle modeling and state estimation method, location and trajectory planning of unmanned vehicle, and motion control method of unmanned vehicle. The course covers system kinematics and dynamics modeling, control system design and analysis, simulation and validation, etc. It also prospects the scientific problems brought by intelligent electric vehicles which integrate electrification and intelligent technology.

default.zh: 本课程嵌入式系统开发的综合教程， 是嵌入式系统方向高级课程。通过本课程的学习，使学生深入了解嵌入式技术的理论、知识，较为深入的掌握基于ARM处理器的应用设计方法和ARM应用系统的开发方法及手段，并应用嵌入式系统设计方法解决实际应用问题。 本课程分成两大部分来讲授。第一部分侧重ARM硬件平台和体系结构的介绍，第二部分侧重嵌入式系统设计方法及操作系统驱动程序的介绍，并给出若干嵌入式开发应用实例。通过本课程学习，不同软硬件基础的同学们，通过本课程均能熟悉并掌握嵌入式系统原理和应用的设计开发能力，使学生达到如下基本要求： 课程目标1.了解嵌入式系统的定义与组成，嵌入式微处理器体系结构，嵌入式系统结构设计、接口设计、程序设计等，掌握嵌入式系统的核心思想、基本理论和设计方法； 课程目标2. 掌握ARM处理器与系统核心模块的接口功能分析与选型、ARM体系结构设计的理论和方法，具有基本的嵌入式原理图与模块交互设计的方案设计能力，以及分析和解决实际项目问题的创新思维和创新设计能力； 课程目标3. 掌握汇编语言和C语言的编程设计方法，获得嵌入式系统实际开发的基本训练； 课程目标4. 熟练嵌入式系统的交叉编译开发与移植方法，分析嵌入式系统的自底层硬件至高层软件的启动流程，掌握嵌入式系统软件及操作系统开发能力，具备利用嵌入式开发技术解决实际工程项目的能力； 课程目标5. 在具体项目应用实例分析和设计中培养和锻炼学生的嵌入式系统设计能力，对所学的知识的综合运用能力以及团队合作解决问题的能力。
default.en: This course is a comprehensive tutorial on the development of embedded systems, which is the advanced courses of embedded system. Through the study of this course, students can deeply understand the theory and knowledge of embedded system technology, master the application design method based on ARM processor and the development method of ARM application system, and apply the embedded system design method to solve the practical application problem. This course is divided into two parts to teach. The first part focuses on the introduction of ARM hardware platform and architecture. The second part focuses on the design of embedded system and the introduction of operating system driver, and gives some examples of embedded application. Students, through this course can be familiar with and master the embedded system theory and application design and development capabilities, so that students meet the following basic requirements: Course objectives 1. Understand the definition and composition of embedded systems, embedded microprocessor architecture, embedded system structure design, interface design, programming, master the embedded system core ideas, basic theory and design methods; Course objectives 2. Master the ARM processor and the system core module interface function analysis and selection, ARM architecture design theory and methods, with the basic embedded schematic diagram and module interactive design of the program design capabilities, as well as analysis and solve the actual innovative thinking and design capabilities for project issues; Course objectives 3. Master assembly language and C language programming design methods, access to embedded systems, the basic development of basic training; Course objectives 4. Cross-compiler development and transplantation of skilled embedded systems, analysis of embedded systems from the bottom of the hardware to the high-level software startup process, master the embedded system software and operating system development capabilities, with the use of embedded development technology to solve the actual capacity of the project; Course Objectives 5. Develop and train students' embedded system design capabilities in the application and analysis of specific project applications, and the ability to synthesize knowledge, and teamwork to solve problems.

default.zh: DSP(数字信号处理器)是现代电子技术在自动控制领域应用的核心方向，因其独特的结构和快速实现各种数字信号处理算法的突出优点，在数字控制、导航、通信、语音合成识别、图像处理、医疗设备等领域获得了广泛的应用。DSP芯片种类繁多，本课程以TMS320F2812芯片为例，着重介绍DSP技术在控制领域的工程化应用。该DSP是目前控制领域最先进的32位DSP处理器，其频率达150MHZ，是控制专业在高精度伺服控制、变频设备等领域工程应用的基础。本课程内容主要为硬件原理学习和设计（包括电源、时钟、RAM、JTAG、AD、GPIO）、集成开发环境（包括仿真工具和CCS）的建立和使用以及常用的调试技巧、库函数和头文件的使用、TI最新的编程方法等。此外，课程还包括14学时实验内容。本课程采用理论和实验相结合方式，通过对TMS320F2812的全面学习，培养学生掌握DSP的原理知识和工程应用能力。
default.en: DSP (Digital Signal Processor) have become an importance branch and kernel developing direction in modern electron technology. Since the first release of DSP which have unique structure and fast digital signal process algorithms, it was widely applied in a number of areas, such as communication, radar, speech recognition and synthesis, image process, medical facilities and so on. As the development of DSP technology, it forms many kind of die. This course mainly focuses on TMS320F2812, and thorough represents related application. TMS320F2812 is the most advanced 32 processor of control area. Its frequency reaches to 150 MHz, and was adopted in high precision servo-control system and frequency conversion devices. The major contents includes: hardware principle and design (such as Power, Clock, RAM, JTAG, AD, GPIO), the creation and usage of integrated development environment (Simulation tool and CCS), the debug technique, library function, header files and the latest program skill is to be introduced. Moreover, the course contains 14 class hour experiments. In this course, the principle of DSP and develop skill is to be introduced by combining theory and experiments.

default.zh: 本课程是自动控制专业的一门专业选修课程，同时它也是一门实践性和工程性很强的课程。通过本课程的教学使学生掌握硬件描述语言Verilog HDL的设计方法，能够进行初步的基于FPGA器件的数字系统设计，为学生以后从事控制领域的工程开发打下坚实的基础。 本课程的目标是提供足够的FPGA及其设计方法的信息，让学生实现良好的FPGA设计，并能够验证结果的正确性。由于课程时间紧张，所以本课程没有涵盖Verilog HDL全部特性，而是向学生展示如何简洁，高效，正确的利用Verilog语言描述硬件设计。 本课程采用累加式考核方法，包括随堂作业、综合实验及综合报告，以此培养学生的创新思维能力。我们将把科研项目中遇到的具体问题结合到教学中，使学生对FPGA技术产生了浓厚的兴趣。
default.en: This course is a professional elective course of the automatic control, at the same time is also a very practical and engineering course. Through the teaching of this course to enable students to master the hardware description language Verilog HDL design methodology, carry out the preliminary digital systems design based on the FPGA device, lay a solid foundation for students engaged in the field of control engineering development in the future. The goal of this course is to provide sufficient information of the FPGA and its design method to enable students to achieve good FPGA design, and be able to verify the correctness of the results. Course time constraints, this course does not cover all the features of Verilog HDL, but rather to show the students how to write concise, efficient, and correct Verilog descriptions of hardware designs. This course adopts an accumulative method, including Quiz exams, comprehensive experiment and comprehensive reports, in order to train the students' creative thinking ability. The specific problems encountered in research projects will be incorporated into teaching. So that students had a strong interest in the FPGA technology.

default.zh: 《快速控制原型与硬件在环仿真技术》是一门应用性强、实践为主的课程，是为控制科学与工程学科及相关专业学生的发展而开设的，主要是对基于模型设计这一国际先进开发理念的培养和普及，是控制系统实践过程的重要环节。讲授内容是目前国际上控制系统设计的重要方法，将基于模型的功能设计和后续实践验证无缝连接，从而提高开发效率。快速控制原型是将算法模型编译后下载到特定仿真硬件平台中实时运行并控制实际对象，从而可以快速验证和修改设计算法，降低开发周期和成本。当控制器设计完成后，需在闭环下对其进行详细测试。由于可能面临极限测试、失效测试或在真实环境中测试费用较昂贵等问题，硬件在环仿真技术成为一个行之有效的方式。硬件在环仿真利用特定仿真硬件平台在实验室中模拟对象在实际工作条件下的运动过程，来达到全面验证控制器开发质量及控制算法可靠程度，降低测试周期和成本，提高测试的安全性。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学及亲手实践，使学生们掌握快速控制原型与硬件在环仿真技术的建立方法以及在控制系统设计中的应用，培养学生的理论联系实际、并解决问题的能力。
default.en: Rapid Control Prototype (RCP) and Hardware in the Loop (HIL) Simulation Technology is a highly applied and practical course designed for the development of students in the field of control science and engineering and related majors. It mainly cultivates and popularizes the international advanced development concept of model-based design, and is an important part of the practical process of control systems. The teaching content is currently an important method for control system design internationally, seamlessly connecting model based functional design and subsequent practical verification to improve development efficiency. RCP is a system that compiles and downloads algorithm models to a specific simulation hardware platform for real-time operation and control of actual objects, enabling rapid verification and modification of design algorithms, reducing development cycles and costs. After the controller design is completed, it needs to be tested in detail in a closed-loop system. Due to potential challenges such as extreme testing, failure testing, or high testing costs in real-world environments, HIL simulation technology has become an effective approach. HIL utilizes computer hardware platforms to simulate the motion process of objects under actual working conditions in the laboratory, in order to comprehensively verify the quality of controller development and the reliability of control algorithms, reduce testing cycles and costs, and improve testing safety. The main task of this course is to enable students to master the methods of establishing RCP and HIL simulation technology, as well as their application in control system design, through classroom teaching and hands-on practice, and to cultivate their ability to connect theory with practice and solve problems.

default.zh: 《新能源功率变换器原理及控制技术》是一门主要介绍变换器在新能源系统中如何应用的课程。它主要包括基本电力转换器件介绍、交-直流变换器原理与控制、直-直流变换器原理与控制以及直-交流变换器原理与控制四大部分，全面涵盖了最基本的电流电压变换拓扑形式。目前，功率变换器作为电力系统中不可或缺的部分，对变换器工作原理的熟练掌握有助于学生建立牢固的电力电子技术基础知识，了解最新的功率变换器技术前沿，为后续的专业研究提供理论和技术保障。
default.en: 《Fundamental and Control of Power Converter in New Energy Systems》 is a course that focuses on how converters are used in new energy systems. It mainly consists of four parts: introduction of basic power conversion devices, AC-DC converter principle and control, DC-DC converter principle and control, and DC-AC converter principle and control, which comprehensively cover the most basic current-voltage converter topology forms. At present, power converter as an indispensable part of the power system, a good grasp of the working principle of the converter will help students to establish a solid basic knowledge of power electronics technology, understand the latest power converter technology frontier, and provide theoretical and technical protection for the subsequent professional research.

default.zh: 本门课程作为本科生选修课，主要面对控制和导航专业以及将来有可能从事类似专业工作的学生，以最新的相关产品和技术为背景，以实验配合理论教学的形式，通过实验从实践中进一步学习，掌握和运用相关的理论和技术。讲授微惯性测量系统的基本原理和应用，通过对最新的应用技术和应用背景的介绍和分析培养、训练学生的独立分析和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This undergraduate elective course is designed for students majoring in control and navigation, as well as those preparing for related careers. Grounded in the latest industry products and technologies, it combines hands-on experiments with theoretical instruction to help students master practical applications of relevant theories and techniques. The curriculum covers fundamental principles and real-world applications of micro-inertial measurement systems. Through analyzing cutting-edge technologies and their real-world implementations, the program cultivates students' ability to independently analyze and solve complex problems.

default.zh: 《博弈与智能》是一门面向航天学院未来技术相关专业本科生的课程，总学时32小时（理论24小时，实验8小时），学分2分，开设于第3学期（春季）。本课程以博弈论为核心，结合人工智能（AI）技术，旨在培养学生在智能自动化领域的决策与优化能力。 课程内容聚焦博弈论的核心框架与AI的前沿应用，涵盖静态与动态博弈、完全信息与不完全信息博弈的基本理论，以及Nash均衡的数学求解与多重均衡分析。学生将深入学习经典博弈案例（如囚徒困境、信号博弈）及其在自动化中的映射，同时探索AI驱动的技术模块，包括强化学习（如Q-learning）、多智能体强化学习（MARL，如MADDPG算法）及生成式对抗网络（GAN）在策略生成中的作用。课程还通过案例分析（如AlphaGo的博弈应用）与上机实验，讲解AI如何优化决策过程、多智能体协作及对抗性环境下的系统设计。此外，学生将接触大语言模型在博弈策略生成中的潜力及其实时适应性，拓宽技术视野，锻炼实践能力。
default.en: "Game Theory and Intelligence" is a course designed for undergraduate students majoring in future technologies within the School of Aerospace Engineering. The course totals 32 class hours (24 hours of theory and 8 hours of laboratory work), carries 2 credits, and is offered in the 3rd semester (spring). Centered on game theory and integrated with artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, this course aims to cultivate students' capabilities in decision-making and optimization within the field of intelligent automation. The course content focuses on the core framework of game theory and cutting-edge AI applications, covering fundamental theories of static and dynamic games, games with complete and incomplete information, as well as mathematical solutions of Nash equilibrium and analysis of multiple equilibria. Students will delve into classical game cases (such as the Prisoner's Dilemma and signaling games) and their mappings in automation, while also exploring AI-driven technical modules, including reinforcement learning (e.g., Q-learning), multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL, e.g., the MADDPG algorithm), and the role of generative adversarial networks (GANs) in strategy generation. Through case studies (e.g., AlphaGo’s application of game theory) and hands-on laboratory experiments, the course illustrates how AI optimizes decision-making processes, enables multi-agent collaboration, and informs system design in adversarial environments. Additionally, students will be introduced to the potential of large language models in generating game strategies and their real-time adaptability, broadening their technical perspectives and enhancing practical skills.

default.zh: 随着空中机器人、无人驾驶、人形机器人以及人工智能等技术的飞速发展，智能自主移动机器人的研究引起了持续的关注。智能自主移动机器人是指能够在没有外界操纵的情况下高自主的完成行为或者任务的机器，其自主执行任务需要解决感知、定位、规划、决策和控制等问题。本课程将系统性地讲解智能自主移动机器人系统技术的核心内容，并结合实际案例和应用场景，帮助学生深入理解相关技术的原理和应用方法。课程内容主要包括：智能自主移动机器人概述、环境感知与定位、自主导航、自主决策与运动规划、运动控制以及具身智能等前沿技术等。课程主要面向对智能自主移动机器人以及人工智能等领域感兴趣的自动化、智能装备、探测制导专业本科生。课程旨在培养学生掌握智能自主移动机器人领域的人工智能核心技术，并结合深度学习、大语言模型、具身智能等前沿技术，提升其在感知、定位、导航、控制及具身智能等方面的理论水平和实践能力，了解和掌握基本概念、相关理论方法和最新研究成果，使其能够设计和开发具备自主学习和决策能力的智能机器人系统，实现理论技术与实际应用的交叉结合，内容强调基础理论以及前沿性与探索性。
default.en: With the rapid development of technologies such as aerial robots, autonomous driving, humanoid robots, and artificial intelligence, research on intelligent autonomous mobile robots has attracted sustained attention. Intelligent autonomous mobile robots refer to machines capable of performing actions or tasks with a high degree of autonomy without external manipulation. Their autonomous execution of tasks requires solving problems related to perception, localization, planning, decision-making, and control. This course will systematically explain the core technologies of intelligent autonomous mobile robot systems and, combined with real-world cases and application scenarios, help students gain an in-depth understanding of the principles and application methods of related technologies. The course content mainly includes: an overview of intelligent autonomous mobile robots, environmental perception and localization, autonomous navigation, autonomous decision-making and motion planning, motion control, and cutting-edge technologies such as embodied intelligence. This course is primarily designed for undergraduate students majoring in automation, intelligent equipment, and detection, guidance, and control technology who are interested in fields such as intelligent autonomous mobile robots and artificial intelligence. The course aims to equip students with core AI technologies in the field of intelligent autonomous mobile robots. By integrating cutting-edge technologies such as deep learning, large language models, and embodied intelligence, it seeks to enhance their theoretical knowledge and practical abilities in perception, localization, navigation, control, and embodied intelligence. Students will learn and master fundamental concepts, relevant theoretical methods, and the latest research findings, enabling them to design and develop intelligent robotic systems capable of autonomous learning and decision-making. The course emphasizes the integration of theoretical knowledge with practical applications, focusing on foundational theories while also highlighting frontier and exploratory aspects.

default.zh: 飞行器结构力学是工程力学专业的一门专业基础课，本课程以杆系和薄壁结构为研究对象，研究杆系和薄壁结构的组成原理及其在载荷作用下内力和变形计算的科学。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解和认识一些结构基本体系，掌握其受力特点和传力特点，掌握结构内力和变形计算的基本原理和方法，同时对杆系和薄壁结构的稳定性基本概念和分析方法有所了解。 内容包括结构组成原理、静定结构内力和位移计算、薄壁结构几何组成分析与内力计算、超静定结构计算的力法和位移法、结构稳定和薄壁工程梁理论的基本知识，求解超静定问题是结构力学的重点和难点。为了加强基础、注重创新精神和工程实践能力的培养，我们在结构力学教学中强调基本概念、基本原理和基本方法的阐述。 本课程的考试成绩采用累加方式，包括平时作业、课堂测试、大作业、课堂讨论及期末考试，合计五个部分。
default.en: Structural Mechanics of Aircraft is a fundamental specialized course of Engineering Mechanics. This course investigates framed and thin-wall structures, looking into their composition principles and the science of calculating internal force and deformation under load. After the study of this course, students should understand some basic structural systems, master the mechanical characteristics and the force transfer behavior and grasp the fundamental principles and methods to calculate structural stress and deformation. Meanwhile, students are expected to have a basic understanding of the concept and analysis methods of stability of these structures. The contents include the composition principle of structure, the calculation of internal force and displacement of statically determinate structure, geometric composition analysis and the calculation of internal force of thin-walled structures, force method, displacement method and finite element method of the statically indeterminate structure, elementary knowledge about structural stability and bending and torsion of thin-walled beams. The important and difficult point is to solve the statically indeterminate structure problems. To strengthen the foundation, pay attention to the initiative spirit and cultivate the practiced project ability of the students, we emphasize the exposition of the basic conception, basic principle and method in course teaching. The final score of this course is consist of five parts: daily assignment, in-class quizzes,project, major assignment, class discussions and final exam

default.zh: 塑性力学研究物体在塑性屈服状态下材料的本构关系和塑性区域发展变化及破坏规律，是一门既有较强的理论性、又有较高实用价值的专业课，也是工程力学、材料塑性加工等专业的一门必修课。其主要内容有：塑性变形基本特征和经典塑性本构模型，桁架的拉压弹塑性变形，粱的弯曲弹塑性变形，粱和刚架的塑性极限载荷分析，应力应变状态分析，塑性屈服条件，塑性本构基础，简单弹塑性问题，柱体扭转及沙堆比拟等。其前期课程有《理论力学》、《材料力学》、《弹性力学》等。通过课程学习，学生可了解塑性力学的经典内容及其在工程中的典型应用，从而培养分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Plasticity is a subject that addresses the constitutive relations, development of plastic regions and failure behaviors of material under plastic yielding. It is a professional course being highly theoretical and practical at the same time, and is compulsory for students of engineering mechanics and plastic working. The main contents covered in the course are as follows: the characters of plastic deformation and classic plastic constitutive models, the plastic tension/compression in truss, plastic bending in beams, analysis of plastic ultimate load of beams and frames, stress and strain state analysis, plastic yielding conditions, basics of plastic constitutive relations, simple elastic-plastic problems, torsion of bars and sand-heap analogy, etc. The prerequisite courses are theoretical mechanics, mechanics of materials, and elasticity. Students will learn in this course the classics of plasticity and their typical applications in engineering, through which skills of analysis and problem solving will be strengthened.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22AS32255 课程名称：振动测试与信号处理 总学时：32 理论学时：24 实验学时：6 上机学时：2 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：2 开课单位：航天学院 授课对象：工程力学专业本科 开课学期：3 春 先修课程：结构动力学前6章 二、课程简介 《振动测试与信号处理》是为力学专业本科生开设的一门专业基础课，它以机械结构中常见的振动问题为出发点，研究振动测试技术基础理论及信号变换、测量、试验数据处理与分析等内容。课程设计从振动响应的时域波形分析入手，通过振动频率的变化，深入到频域分析，进而叙述振动信号的数据处理，建立起这三个方面的有机联系。课程包含了模拟信号处理和数字信号处理的主要内容，包括振动测试基础、常用传感器测量原理及相应的测量方法、测试系统静动态特性以及振动信号分析基础。振动信号处理主要包括傅里叶级数展开、离散傅里叶变换、快速傅里叶变换、短时傅里叶变换、时频统计特征、窗函数滤波器等。课程设计从实际应用出发，由浅入深，在兼顾数学推理的基础上，通过引用教研室最近已经完成的最新的和非常典型的振动测试项目的案列，通过对科研课题中复杂结构振动问题的背景分析、提炼出科学问题，简化试验模型，提出解决问题的方法以及最终的研究结果，强调物理概念和实际应用知识的结合，理论分析和工程实践的结合。通过学习使学生能根据测量实际要求选择设计合理的测试系统，能够对测试系统的性能进行分析、对测试的数据进行处理，初步具有综合利用振动测试技术基础知识和技能来分析、解决工程实际问题的能力。 撰写人：梁廷伟 审核人：李忠刚 日期：2023.11.12
default.en: Introduction to Vibration testing and signal processing 1.General Information Course Code：22AS32259 Course Title：Vibration testing and signal processing Credit Hours：32 Lecture：24 Lab：6 Computer Lab: 2 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：2 Offering Department: School of AStronautics Students: Undergraduate of Engineering Mechanics Term: Spring, Third grade; Open Prerequisites: Chapter 6 of Structural Dynamics 2.Course Description The vibration testing and signal processing is a professional basic course of universities for students who major in mechanics. Based on the common vibration problems in mechanical structure, the basic theory and signal transformation, measurement, data processing and analysis of vibration test are studied. Curriculum design from the time domain waveform analysis of vibration response, through the change of the vibration frequency, go deep into the frequency domain analysis, thus the data processing of vibration signal set up of these three aspects. Course includes the main content of the analog signal processing and digital signal processing, including vibration test, commonly used sensors measuring principle and the corresponding measurement method, the test system static and dynamic characteristics and vibration signal analysis. Vibration signal processing mainly includes Fourier series expansion, discrete Fourier transform, fast Fourier transform, short-time Fourier transform, time-frequency statistical feature, window function filter, etc. The course design is based on practical application, and in the light of mathematical reasoning, it refers to the latest and very typical cases of vibration test projects completed by the teaching and research office. Based on the background of the complex structure vibration problems in the scientific research subject analysis, refined science problem, simplify the test model, and puts forward the method to solve the problem and the final results, emphasizes the combination of physical concepts and practical application of knowledge, the combination of theoretical analysis and engineering practice. By learning to make the students can choose according to the actual measurement requirements design reasonable test system, able to analyze the performance of the test system, the test data, preliminary has the comprehensive utilization of vibration test technology basic knowledge and skills to analysis, the ability to solve practical engineering problems. Author: Tingwei Liang Reviewer：Zhonggang Li Date：2023.11.12

default.zh: 空间飞行器动力学与控制是研究卫星、载人飞船等飞行器的动力学特性、轨道运动及控制方法等的学科。本课程主要教学内容是航天发展史，飞行器动力学分析的基本理论，飞行器的轨道动力学与姿态动力学问题，轨道控制和姿态控制的基本方法，载人航天及星际航行控制方法等。 通过本课程的课堂教学和大作业的完成，可拓展学生们的知识面，为以后从事空间飞行器的动力学与控制等应用专业的研究，或是相关领域的工作奠定初步的理论基础。培养学生对航天事业的兴趣以及勇于探索的精神。 具体教学内容如下： （1）绪论 （2）近地空间环境 （3）二体问题 （4）中心引力场中的运动和轨道摄动 （5）轨道控制 （6）姿态运动学 （7）姿态动力学 （8）姿态控制系统的硬件组成 （9）重力稳定飞行器姿态动力学与控制 （10）自旋稳定飞行器姿态动力学与控制 （11）三轴稳定飞行器姿态动力学与控制 （12）载人飞船的控制技术 （13）航天飞机的控制技术 （14）空间站的控制技术 （15）空间航行的基本理论 （16）星际探测
default.en: Spacecraft dynamics and control is a science studying the dynamics characteristics, orbit motion and control methods of the spacecrafts, such as satellites and manned spacecrafts. The main contents of "Spacecraft dynamics and control" include: the history of spaceflight, the fundamentals of aircraft dynamics, the orbital dynamics and attitude dynamics, the basic methods for orbital control and attitude control, the control method of manned space flight and so on. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of spacecraft dynamics and control. This course can foster the interests in the aerospace industry, cultivate the spirit of exploration and establish the theoretical foundation for students who may engage in the field of spacecraft dynamics and control applications and other related fields in the future. The specific teaching content is as follows: (1) Introduction (2) Near Earth Space Environment (3) Two-body Problem (4) Motion and Orbital Perturbation in a Central Gravitational Field (5) Orbital control (6) Attitude kinematics (7) Attitude dynamics (8) Hardware composition of attitude control system (9) Attitude Dynamics and Control of Gravity Stabilized Aircraft (10) Attitude Dynamics and Control of Spin Stabilized Aircraft (11) Attitude Dynamics and Control of Three Axis Stable Aircraft (12) Control Technology of Manned Spaceship (13) Control Technology of Space Shuttle (14) Control Technology for Space Station (15) Basic Theory of Space Navigation (16) Interstellar exploration

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍机械设备故障诊断技术的基础理论及其工程应用。主要内容包括：设备故障诊断的基本概念，振动传感器原理，振动信号的时域和频域分析方法，油样分析技术和声发射检测技术在故障诊断中的应用，基于专家系统和神经网络的智能诊断技术，旋转机械的振动监测和振动信号分析方法，往复机械的故障类型和诊断方法，齿轮和滚动轴承典型故障的机理分析，故障诊断系统的组成。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the basic theory and engineering applications of mechanical equipment fault diagnosis technology.
