The main content includes: basic concepts of equipment fault diagnosis, principles of vibration sensors, time-domain and frequency-domain analysis methods of vibration signals, application of oil sample analysis technology and acoustic emission detection technology in fault diagnosis, intelligent diagnosis technology based on expert systems and neural networks, vibration monitoring and signal analysis methods of rotating machinery, fault types and diagnosis methods of reciprocating machinery, Mechanism analysis of typical faults in gears and rolling bearings, and composition of fault diagnosis system.

default.zh: 非线性振动基础是立志于航空航天动力学与控制问题研究的工程力学专业学生的一门重要课程。主要内容包括单自由度系统非线性振动的基础知识，涉及研究非线性振动问题的定性理论（如稳定性理论、相平面分析等）和定量方法（如Lindstedt-Poincare摄动技术、平均法和多尺度法等）。课程内容还涉及到非线性振动理论与方法在航空航天领域实际问题的应用等方面。
default.en: Nonlinear Vibration is an important course for undergraduates aspiring to study Dynamics and Control in Aeronautics and Astronautics majoring in Engineering Mechanics. This course provides a fundamental coverage of nonlinear vibrations of single-degree-of-freedom systems. Qualitative theory (e.g., stability analysis, phase plane analysis) and quantitative methods (e.g., Lindstedt-Poincare perturbation techniques, Average method, Multiple scale method) will be illustrated in detail. Applications of the methodologies to practical systems in the fields of Aeronautics and Astronautics will be addressed.

default.zh: 本门课程主要研究由不同激励引起的随机振动响应的统计规律，以及这些规律与系统特性之间的关系，着重研究线性单、多自由度、连续体系统在单个和多个平稳随机激励作用下的响应分析。对这些规律我们可以利用概率论的知识对他们进行定量或定性的研究，即对随机振动的各个量进行数学描述，进而揭示随机振动过程的固有规律。
default.en: This course is mainly focused on studying the statistic laws of random vibration response caused by various excitations and the relationships between these laws and system features. Especially, the response analysis of linear single-, multiple-degree and continuum systems under single and multiple stable random excitations will be studied. These laws can be quantitatively and qualitatively investigated by the probability theory. Namely, the quantities of random vibration can be depicted by mathematical descriptions, thus revealing the intrinsic laws of random vibration process.

default.zh: 随着计算机及大数据和人工智能的飞速发展，科学工程计算在自然与社会科学和工程技术等许多领域有着广泛的应用，是解决诸如热学、力学、电磁学、经济和金融等问题的重要手段。《计算方法》课程也叫《数值分析》是数学、土木和人工智能等理工科众多专业的一门必修的基础课程。通过本课程的学习，使学生基本掌握计算方法的基本知识、方法及其原理，培养学生的分析、判断、计算和实验能力，使其基本具备应用计算机从事科学和工程计算的能力，为继续学习专业课程奠定基础。
default.en: With the rapid development of computers, big data and artificial intelligence, scientific engineering computing has been widely applied in many fields such as natural and social sciences and engineering technology. It is an important means to solve problems such as heat, mechanics, electromagnetics, economics, and finance. The course "Computational Methods", also known as "Numerical Analysis", is a compulsory basic course for many science and engineering majors such as mathematics, civil engineering and artificial intelligence. Through studying this course, students will be able to master the basic knowledge, methods and principles of computational methods. This course can also cultivate the students’ analytical, judgmental, computational and experimental abilities with the ability to apply computers in scientific and engineering calculations. In particular, this course can lay the foundation for continuing learning professional courses.

default.zh: 应用软件工程是工程力学专业一门实践型专业课，学生在掌握了力学基础和力学专业先修课程内容后，应具备应用大型通用有限元软件解决实际工程力学问题的能力。本课程应教会学生掌握应用Ansys有限元软件的技能，同时介绍其他通用有限元软件的共同特点，启发学生自主学习其它大型有限元软件。 课程主要内容包括Ansys基本功能简介、结构分析的基本过程、几何建模、网格划分、加载和求解、结果后处理、结构静力分析、结构动力分析、结构非线性静力分析、复合材料结构分析等。 通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握现代计算机大型软件计算和分析工具使用方法和理论，能够对复杂工程问题进行预测与模拟，为学生完成毕业论文和毕业后工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: Engineering of Applied Software is a professional practical course. The students should have the ability to utilize the finite element software solve the mechanics problem after they learn the basic and professional mechanical courses. This course will teach the students how to use the software package - ANSYS. We will also introduce the characteristic of other software and enlighten the technical ability of using other large-scale software. The main content includes the basic concept of the finite element analyses, the basic operation method of Ansys which includes preprocess procedures, modeling and meshing, loading and solution, post processing, structural static analysis, modal analysis, structural nonlinear static analysis, composite structures analysis. The characteristic of this course is that teaches only the essential and ensures plenty of practice. Students should practice after the teacher taught the main content. The course is taken in the computer laboratory. The students can master the method and theory to use the modern computer large-scale software. They can also predict and simulate the complex engineering problems. Study of this course will be beneficial to the thesis and job after their graduation from the school for the students.

This course investigates framed and thin-wall structures, looking into their composition principles and the science of calculating internal force and deformation under load. After the study of this course, students should understand some basic structural systems, master the mechanical characteristics and the force transfer behavior and grasp the fundamental principles and methods to calculate structural stress and deformation. default.zh: 结构动力学设计是结构动力学及其它相关力学课程的深入和扩展，要求利用动力学相关的理论、试验和数值计算等方法，解决相对复杂且有一定工程应用背景的综合性问题。主要是通过理论建模，有限元建模和模态试验等方法来研究模拟工程结构的动特性和动响应，进行结构的动力学设计研究。培养学生科学素养和知识的应用实践能力。
default.en: Course design in structural dynamics is the extension of the course of structural dynamics and related mechanical courses. The target is to resolve complicated problems having engineering background by applying dynamics theory, experiment and numerical calculation means and to develop students' scientific literacy and to cultivate the ability of combining theory with practice. The students are required to research the effects of physical parameters on the previous order natural frequencies and mode shapes for the simulated engineering structure by applying theory analysis, finite element method and modal test analysis. The goal of the course is to cultivate students' scientific literacy and the ability to apply knowledge to practice

default.zh: (1)本大纲是根据教育部力学101计划的新标准，为适应新时期拔尖创新人才的培养而设定的新课程大纲。它是力学类相关专业拔尖创新人才培养的一门必修课程，是本科生接触到的第一门综合训练课程，它通过系统地介绍工程科学思想的原理、方法，培养学生的系统科学思维和综合能力。 (2)在保证基本教学要求的前提下，教师可以根据实际情况，对内容进行适当的调整，尤其是工程案例的调整。 (3)本大纲适用于力学类相关专业。 课程教学目标： (1) 让学生了解科学、技术和工程的关系，工程科学思想和工程科学方法； (2) 通过各种例题和案例介绍，让学生了解工程力学的定性研究、机理研究和数据研究方法，打破传统力学教学对动力学、固体力学、流体力学的等二级学科的划分界限，引导学生从科学研究方法论高度来理解工程力学的研究方法。 (3) 通过对深空探测、船舶结构、高超声速飞行、武器战斗部等领域的工程案例分析，让学生学会如何基于动力学、固体力学、流体力学基本原理，发挥新方法，解决工程问题。 (4) 站在超越具体问题的思维层次，从系统科学的角度来审视力学问题在工程系统中的作用，与系统各部分的主要关联；构思解决力学问题的研究方案；通过研究获得初步结果后，再回到该力学问题所处的系统中去，检验和改进结果；经过迭代，以满足工程设计、研制和运行之需。
default.en: This course is an optional course for cultivating innovative talents in mechanics-related majors. It is the first comprehensive training course that undergraduate students are exposed to. By systematically introducing the principles and methods of engineering science thoughts, it aims to cultivate students' systematic scientific thoughts and comprehensive abilities. Through the study of this course, students are required to realize the following points: (1) Understand the relationship between science, technology and engineering, as well as the thoughts and methods of engineering science. (2) Through various examples and case studies, students can understand the qualitative research, mechanism research and data research methods of engineering mechanics, break the traditional division boundaries of secondary disciplines such as dynamics and solid mechanics in mechanics teaching, and understand the research methods of engineering mechanics from the level of scientific research methodology. (3) Through the analysis of engineering cases in fields such as engineering fracture, aircraft structure, and elastic wave detection, students will learn how to solve engineering problems based on fundamental principles of mechanics such as dynamics and solid mechanics. (4) Standing at a thinking level that transcends specific issues, examine the role of mechanical problems in engineering systems and their main connections with each part of the system from the perspective of systems science; Conceive the research plan for solving mechanical problems. After obtaining the preliminary results through research, return to the system where the mechanical problem is located to test and improve the results. After iteration, the needs of engineering design, development and operation are met.

default.zh: 航天器环境是航天工程重要的技术基础课程，课程内容包括：真空环境、临近空间环境、离子体环境、辐射环境、微流星体/轨道碎片环境、热环境等介绍，同时讲述空间环境效应、地面模拟试验技术，以及热防护系统设计等内容。通过本课程的学习学生应掌握空间环境因素对航天器影响的分析方法，并善于应用这些方法解决航天工程实际问题，为从事航天器系统设计打下基础。
default.en: Spacecraft environment is one of the important technical and basal curriculums in space engineering. The contents of the course involve: introduction of the vacuum environment, the near space environment, the plasma environment, the radiation environment, the micro-meteoroid /orbital fragmentation environment, and the thermal environment. It also involves: space environment effect, ground simulation test technology, as well as the thermal protection system design, etc. Through this curriculum, the students should master the analysis methods of the influence of space environment factors on spacecraft, and further apply them to the space engineering problems, so as to lay the foundation for the design of spacecraft systems.

default.zh: 本课程旨在拓展学生航天视野，了解并认识到空天飞行器热防护材料与结构的关键作用和重要意义；着力提升学生试验方法技巧及材料表征能力，了解并掌握相关热防护材料与结构的制备方法和表征手段；力争引起学生学习兴趣、终身学习意识，为国家航天领域输送高水平人才。 理论教学以讲授热防护材料与结构需求背景及应用、研究进展、设计理念及方法、现代制备工艺、性能测试手段与评价、地面模拟环境试验考核与飞行演示验证、超高温热防护材料与结构等为主，并依托哈尔滨工业大学航天学院复合材料与结构研究所超高温热防护实验室，以特种环境超高温热防护材料UHTCC、新一代飞船再入热防护材料PICA和空天飞行器防隔热一体化材料TUFROC为主要内容，诠释课程内容的烧蚀热防护材料及非烧蚀热防护材料的设计思想、制备方法，讲授多种基本仪器设备的原理及使用方法，使学生可以加深课堂内容理解，为学生专业学习、毕业设计实验奠定良好基础。
default.en: This course aims to broaden students' understanding of aerospace, emphasizing the crucial role and significance of thermal protection materials and structures in aerospace vehicles. It focuses on enhancing students' skills in experimental methods and material characterization, as well as understanding and mastering the preparation methods and characterization techniques of relevant thermal protection materials and structures. The goal is to stimulate students' interests in learning and cultivate a lifelong learning mindset, contributing to the development of highly skilled talent in the field of national aerospace. Lecture teaching mainly focuses on teaching the background and application, research progress, design concepts and methods, modern preparation processes, performance testing methods and evaluations, ground simulation environmental test assessments and flight demonstration verification of ultra-high temperature thermal protection materials and structures, etc. On site teaching relies on the ultra-high temperature thermal protection laboratory of the Institute of Composite Materials and Structures, the main content of on-site teaching is the ultra-high temperature thermal protection material UHTCC in special environments, the new generation spacecraft re-entry thermal protection material PICA, and the integrated thermal insulation material TUFROC for aerospace vehicles. The design concepts and preparation methods of ablative and non-ablative thermal protection materials in the course content are explained, and the principles and usage methods of various basic instruments and equipment are taught, enabling students to deepen their understanding of the course content, laying a solid foundation for their professional learning and graduation design experiments.

default.zh: 工程结构建模与模拟方法课程主要讲授关于典型航天器结构的承载性能建模流程与模拟方法。课程内容主要包括：航天器结构与材料、数值分析方法基础、杆梁有限元建模与分析方法、Abaqus软件与有限元、复合材料建模及分析方法、典型结构建模及模拟技术（动力学、断裂、屈曲、冲击、传热及烧蚀分析）。 通过学习本课程，使学生能够掌握航天器结构设计领域典型工程结构建模与模拟方法，掌握简单构件的多物理场作用有限元分析方法，为以后的科研工作奠定基础。
default.en: The Engineering Structure Modeling and Simulation Method course mainly teaches the modeling process and simulation method of the bearing performance of typical spacecraft structures. The course content mainly includes: spacecraft structure and materials, foundation of numerical analysis method, finite element modeling and analysis method of beam and rod, Abaqus software and finite element, composite material modeling and analysis method, typical structure modeling and simulation technology (dynamics, fracture, buckling, impact, heat transfer and ablation analysis). Through the study of this course, students can grasp basic performance about modeling and simulation methods of typical engineering structures in the field of spacecraft structure design, mastering the finite element analysis method of multi-physical field action for simple components, besides open up the mind of composite structure analysis and design, and build the foundation for future research work.

default.zh: 结构动力学是研究结构在动载荷作用下响应规律的科学，是复合材料与工程专业学生在修完理论力学、材料力学等课程之后必修的一门专业基础课。结构动力学B的教学内容包括：离散系统（单自由度系统和多自由度系统）振动、连续弹性系统振动、复合材料结构系统振动。 通过本课程的教学，使学生了解和掌握结构线性振动的基本概念和基本研究方法，熟悉结构在动载荷作用下的动态特性和计算方法（如自振频率及振型等），了解结构动力学在复合材料工程中的应用和发展，使学生将已学到的力学基础理论得到进一步的理解和应用，为学生将来从事结构（尤其是复合材料结构）的振动分析和安全评价打好理论基础。
default.en: Structural Dynamics is a science studying the responses of structures under dynamic loading. It is a foundation course for students majored in Composites Materials and Engineering. The contents of the course of Structural Dynamics B involved: vibration of discrete system (one degrees of freedom system and more degrees of freedom system), vibration of continuous system, vibration of composite structures. Through this course, the students should have a good command of knowledge on the basic theories and methods of linear vibration of structures, be familiar with dynamical characteristics and response of structures, understand the applications and developments of structural dynamics in the field of composite materials and engineering, established foundation to composite structures vibration analysis and safety evaluation for students.

default.zh: 力学中的数学方法在工程力学教学过程中将综合运用先修课程中的有关知识与技能，结合实践教学环节，进行专业技术人员的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事工程力学的研究工作打下基础，在工程力学专业的教学计划中占有重要的地位和作用。 本课程的主要内容包括力学与数学方法的基本关系，基本的积分变换方法在工程力学典型问题求解中的应用，微分方程求解方法在弹性动力学、断裂动力学和振动理论和复合材料力学等问题求解中的应用，积分方程基本求解方法在断裂力学问题求解中的应用，复变函数及特殊函数在典型断裂问题中的应用，同时结合具体实例和相关资料分析数学方法在工程力学中的应用。
default.en: In the teaching process of engineering mechanics, the mathematics method in mechanics will carry out basic training for the professional technical personnel with comprehensively applying the relation knowledge and skills in the pro-training courses and combining the practice teaching. This will lay the foundation for the further study of related courses and the future research in engineering mechanics. It plays an important role in the teaching plan of engineering mechanics. The main contents of this course include the basic relationship between mechanics and mathematical methods, the application of basic integration transformation method in solving typical problems in engineering mechanics, the application of solving method of differential equation in solving problems of elastic dynamics, fracture dynamics and vibration theory and composite mechanics, the application of basic solving method of integral equation in the solution of fracture mechanics problems, the application of complex function and special function in typical fracture problems. At the same time, the application of mathematical method in engineering mechanics is analyzed with specific examples and related data analysis.

default.zh: 复合材料结构设计是复合材料与工程本科生专业的选修课。本课程进一步讲解复合材料力学基础，复合材料结构设计基础以及典型复合材料结构设计等课程内容。为了充分发挥复合材料可设计性特点，本课程利用复合材料力学基础知识对复合材料典型结构设计，培养学生具备针对具体环境使用对复合材料结构进行分析和设计的能力，提高解决实际工程中复合材料结构设计问题的能力。
default.en: Composite material structure design is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in composite materials and engineering. This course further explains the mechanics foundation of composite materials, the design foundation of composite structures and the design of typical composite structures. In order to exert the design characteristics of composite materials, this course utilizes the basic knowledge of composite mechanics to design typical composite structures, cultivates students'ability to analyze and design composite structures used in the specific environment, and improves the ability to solve the design problems of composite structures in engineering.

default.zh: 结构可靠度理论是现代结构设计和安全评价的重要方法，复合材料结构可靠性是从事复合材料结构设计以及安全评价的基本方法。本课程是复合材料与工程专业的主干课程，可用于本科教学以及研究生课程。课程主要讲述复合材料结构的安全性与可靠性评价理论与方法,，将从结构可靠度的基本理论和方法出发，结合复合材料及其结构特点，主要讲授结构可靠度理论、复合材料性能离散性分析方法以及复合材料结构可靠性分析方法，使学生较深入地了解和掌握分析复合材料结构可靠性的理论与方法。通过本课程的教学，着重培养学生在复合材料结构可靠度理论、可靠性数值模拟方法等方面的分析、设计和应用能力，为今后进行复合材料与结构工程实践与科学研究奠定基础。
default.en: Reliability of structures is an important method for design and evaluation of modern structures and their safety. The analytical method of reliability is a key tool to design and safety evaluation of composite material structures. Structural safety and reliability assessment for composite structures is a main course of composite materials and engineering major in high engineering college. It is intended for use in a senior-year undergraduate or first-year graduate course devoted to structural reliability analyses of composite materials and structures. The text contains the theory and method of reliability analysis. The students should master the basic concept of structural reliability, the analytical method and the numerical simulation method of structural reliability in the teaching process. The course is also to help the students to understand the design approach of composite materials and structures based on reliability. Through this course, the students should have the ability in application of reliability theory and method on composite materials and structures, which will lay the foundation for the further engineering practice and investigation on composite materials and structures.

default.zh: 微纳米复合材料是一个多学科交叉的研究领域，内涵十分丰富的学科。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握微纳米复合材料的基本概念、内涵、微纳米复合材料的性质、制备技术、表征手段以及应用领域。由于该学科内容涉及过于广泛，本课程将精选代表性微纳米复合材料，用以点带面的方法进行深入浅出的讲解。课程内容包括：微纳米材料基本内涵，微纳米复合材料的定义，微纳米科技的研究意义，微纳米材料的研究范畴，微纳米化的机遇与挑战，微纳米复合材料的发展；微纳米材料的分类，微纳米材料的性质，微纳米材料的制备方法；典型的微纳米复合材料的制备方法；典型的微纳米复合材料的制备方法。使学生掌握掌握微纳米复合材料的基本概念、尺寸效应、表面效应、介电限域效应等，微纳米复合材料的发展；掌握典型微纳米复合材料的制备方法，制备过程中的关键技术，纳米分散原理与分散技术、表面改性技术、原位制备技术、杂化制备技术；掌握典型微纳米复合材料的性质与功能，结合其特点在航空航天领域的应用，了解微纳米复合材料的研究进展，初步掌握微纳米复合材料的科学研究以及开发应用的基本知识。从而拓宽学生的科学视野，引导学生从事新颖性、前瞻性的科研活动，培养学生的创造力和想象力，为其今后的发展打下基础。
default.en: Micro nano composite materials are a multidisciplinary research field with rich connotations. Through this course, students will master the basic concepts, connotations, properties, preparation techniques, characterization methods, and application fields of micro nano composite materials. Due to the extensive coverage of this subject, this course will select representative micro nano composite materials and provide a point-to-point and comprehensive explanation in simple and profound terms. The course content includes: the basic connotation of micro nano materials, the definition of micro nano composite materials, the research significance of micro nano technology, the research scope of micro nano materials, the opportunities and challenges of micro nano industrialization, and the development of micro nano composite materials; Classification of micro and nano materials, properties of micro and nano materials, and preparation methods of micro and nano materials; Preparation methods of typical micro nano composite materials; The preparation method of typical micro nano composite materials. Enable students to master the basic concepts, size effects, surface effects, dielectric confinement effects, etc. of micro nano composite materials, and the development of micro nano composite materials; Master the preparation methods of typical micro nano composite materials, key technologies in the preparation process, nano dispersion principles and dispersion techniques, surface modification techniques, in-situ preparation techniques, and hybrid preparation techniques; Master the properties and functions of typical micro nano composite materials, combine their characteristics with their applications in the aerospace field, understand the research progress of micro nano composite materials, and preliminarily grasp the basic knowledge of scientific research and development application of micro nano composite materials. In order to broaden students' scientific perspective, guide them to engage in innovative and forward-looking scientific research activities, cultivate their creativity and imagination, and lay a foundation for their future development.

default.zh: 《陶瓷材料制备技术》为复合材料与工程专业本科生开设的选修课。其目的在于使学生系统地了解陶瓷材料的基本概念、主要性能、成型工艺、烧结机理等，了解陶瓷粉体的基本晶型结构，掌握陶瓷材料的成型工艺和烧结方法，掌握陶瓷材料的韧化和强化方法及机理，明确陶瓷材料制备工艺、微结构和性能之间的相互关系，为高性能陶瓷材料设计与制备正确选择和合理使用材料提供依据。
default.en: “Fabrication and Technology of Ceramic Materials” is a selective course established for undergraduate students of composite materials and engineering. It aims to enable the students to systematically understand the basic concept, main property, molding process and sintering mechanism of ceramic materials. The students must understand the basic crystal structure of ceramic, and master the molding process and sintering methods. The students should master common reinforcing and toughening method of ceramic materials. The relationship between preparation process, microstructure and properties should be comprehended. All above issues can supply right selection and help in ceramic materials design and fabrication, which can provide the direction and foundation for preparing high-performance ceramics.

default.zh: 高分子物理是高分子科学的理论基础，是指导高分子化合物的分子设计和高聚物合理使用的一门科学，是工科大学生特别是复合材料与工程方向大学生的重要基础课程。 通过课程学习能够使学生建立高分子材料各种物理性能是受其结构形式、成型方法和使用条件影响的思想，为今后从事先进树脂基复合材料的学习、研究和使用奠定基础。 通过学习本课程，可使对学生获得以下能力： 1、掌握高分子链构型和构象理论和高分子聚集态结构，为设计和选取符合不同使用要求的高分子材料提供结构上的理论支撑。 2、能够利用这些聚合物微结构变化原理分析聚合物的热机性能。 3、通过学习聚合物的力学、电学、光学及形状记忆性能，能够利用所学高分子物理知识分析聚合物性能进行较系统的分析和初步设计。
default.en: Polymer physics is the theoretical foundation of polymer science, and it is a science to guide the molecular design of macromolecule and the rational use of polymers, it is an important basic course for engineering students, especially for those majoring in composite materials and engineering. Through the course study can enable students to establish a variety of polymer material physical properties is the structure of its form, molding methods and conditions of use of the idea, it lays a foundation for the study, research and application of advanced resin matrix composites in the future. By studying this course, students can acquire the following abilities: 1. To master the theory of polymer chain configuration and conformational structure, it provides theoretical support for the design and selection of polymer materials meeting different requirements. 2. The thermo-mechanical properties of the polymers can be analyzed by the principle of microstructure change of the polymers. By studying the mechanical, electrical, optical and shape memory properties of polymers, we can analyze the properties of polymers with the polymer physics knowledge and carry out more systematic analysis and preliminary design.

default.zh: 材料力学性能分析为复合材料与工程专业本科生开设的专业选修课。本课程讲授的是工程材料在各种载荷作用及服役条件下的力学性能。课程建设目的是使学生系统地了解金属、陶瓷、高分子材料、复合材料的力学性能分析测试方法，包括力学性能（拉伸、弯曲、压缩、扭转、屈服、硬度、磨损、断裂、抗热冲击等）测试的基本原理、仪器设备、样品制备、分析方法及应用。能够从各种材料或构件最常见的服役条件和失效现象出发，了解失效现象的微观机制，提出衡量材料失效抗力的力学性能指标；掌握各种指标的物理概念、实用意义和测试方法；明确它们之间的相互关系；分析各种因素对力学性能指标的影响，为材料设计与制备过程中正确选择和合理使用材料提供依据，为研制新材料、改进冷热加工新工艺，充分发挥材料性能潜力指明方向。该课程在培养学生理论分析能力、解决工程领域材料选择和使用问题的能力等方面具有重要作用，能够使学生具备在航空航天、船舶、土木工程、能源等领域就业的基础知识储备。
default.en: "Analysis for Mechanical Properties of Materials" is a required course provided for the composite materials and engineering undergraduate students. This course teaches the mechanical properties of engineering materials under various load conditions and service conditions. The purpose of the course is to enable students to systematically understand the mechanical properties of metal, ceramics, polymer materials, composite materials, including the basic principles of mechanical properties testing (tensile, bending, compression, torsion, yield, hardness, wear, fracture, thermal shock Etc.), equipment, sample preparation, analysis methods and applications. It is possible to understand the microscopic mechanism of failure phenomena from the most common service conditions and failure phenomena of various materials or components, and to propose the mechanical properties to measure the failure resistance of materials. To understand the physical concepts, practical significance and test methods of various parameters, to clarify the relationship between them, to analyze the impact of various factors on the mechanical parameters, which providing the basis for the correctly choice and rational use of materials in the design and preparation process, and specifying the direction for the development of new materials, the improvement of new technology and the full development of material performance potential. This course plays an important role in cultivating students' theoretical analysis ability and solving the problem of material selection and use in engineering field, so that students can have the basic knowledge reserve in the fields of aerospace, shipbuilding, civil engineering and energy.

default.zh: 粉末冶金是一种制取金属粉末，并采用成形和烧结工艺将金属粉末（或金属粉末与非金属粉末的混合物）制成产品的工艺技术。作为一门新兴技术，它在材料科学领域具有举足轻重的地位。《粉末冶金原理》主要讲述粉末的制备以及粉末性能的测定，粉末成型的方法以及压制制品的质量，粉末烧结原理以及烧结工艺，粉末冶金材料以及制品，聚合物衍生陶瓷（PDCs）以及冷烧结技术（CSP）等粉末冶金新技术新工艺。培养学生对粉末冶金原理有一个比较深刻的认识，了解粉末冶金工艺的整个过程，能运用粉末冶金工艺设计并开发新型工程材料。本课讲授对象主要为工科院校复合材料、材料学、材料加工工程、无机材料等非粉末冶金专业本科生和硕士研究生。
default.en: Powder Metallurgy is a processing technology to produce metal powders, and manufacture goods by molding and sintering from metal powders or mixture of metal and nonmetal powders. As a burgeoning technology, it has been an important field in the material science. The course of “Principles of Powder Metallurgy” will be mainly related powder preparation, molding method of powders and its effects on the billets, theory and process of powder sintering, materials and goods of powder metallurgy, the new processes like polymer derived ceramics (PDCs) and cold sintering process (CSP), so as to let students understand the theory of powder metallurgy more profoundly, comprehend the whole course of powder metallurgy process, and design and exploit new engineering materials via powder metallurgy technology. The students attending this lesson are the undergraduate or graduate students from the non-powder-metallurgy specialties in the engineering academies such as compound materials, materials science, materials processing engineering, inorganic materials.

default.zh: 功能材料与器件课程是一门涉及材料科学、物理、化学、电子工程等多学科交叉的课程，主要关注于具有特定功能和器件应用的新型材料和器件。 本课程首先介绍了功能材料与器件的基本概念、分类、研究内容和发展趋势。在此基础上，详细讲解了各种功能材料和器件的组成、结构、性能、制备方法及应用领域，包括半导体材料、光电子材料、磁性材料、纳米材料等。同时，还介绍了各种现代分析技术在功能材料和器件研究中的应用。在学习过程中，学生将通过理论学习和实验操作相结合的方式，了解和掌握各种功能材料和器件的基本知识和技能。通过实验操作，学生可以加深对理论知识的理解，提高动手能力和解决问题的能力。此外，本课程还设置了专题报告和课堂互动环节，鼓励学生积极参与讨论，提高他们的思维能力和表达能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将全面了解功能材料与器件的基本概念、分类、研究内容和发展趋势，掌握各种功能材料和器件的组成、结构、性能、制备方法及应用领域，以及现代分析技术在功能材料和器件研究中的应用。此外，学生还将提高动手能力和解决问题的能力，以及小组讨论和课堂互动能力。 总之，本课程是一门具有重要实际意义的课程，它将为学生今后从事相关领域的工作和研究打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The course of Functional Materials and Devices is an interdisciplinary course that involves materials science, physics, chemistry, electronic engineering, and other disciplines. It mainly focuses on new materials and devices with specific functions and device applications. This course first introduces the basic concepts, classifications, research content, and development trends of functional materials and devices. On this basis, the composition, structure, performance, preparation methods, and application fields of various functional materials and devices were explained in detail, including semiconductor materials, optoelectronic materials, magnetic materials, nanomaterials, etc. At the same time, the application of various modern analytical techniques in the research of functional materials and devices was also introduced. During the learning process, students will combine theoretical learning with experimental operations to understand and master the basic knowledge and skills of various functional materials and devices. Through experimental operations, students can deepen their understanding of theoretical knowledge, improve their hands-on skills, and problem-solving abilities. In addition, this course also features special presentations and classroom interactive sessions to encourage students to actively participate in discussions and improve their thinking and expression abilities. Through the study of this course, students will have a comprehensive understanding of the basic concepts, classifications, research content, and development trends of functional materials and devices. They will master the composition, structure, performance, preparation methods, and application fields of various functional materials and devices, as well as the application of modern analytical technology in the research of functional materials and devices. In addition, students will also improve their hands-on and problem-solving abilities, as well as their group discussion and classroom interaction skills. In summary, this course is of great practical significance and will lay a solid foundation for students to pursue work and research in related fields in the future.

default.zh: 智能材料与结构是研究智能特性的材料、结构或系统的学科，是一门以培养学生掌握智能材料和结构知识的专业基础课。本门课以材料-元件-结构-系统为主线，介绍智能材料相关的概念、基本理论及设计方法等内容。 通过本课程的学习学生应掌握智能材料与结构相关的基础知识和设计理论和方法，拓展学生知识面，为后续的工作、学习打下基础。
default.en: Smart materials and structure is a science studying the intelligent properties of materials, structures and system. It is a professional curriculum to cultivate students understanding the knowledge of smart materials and structures. Based on the main line of material-component-structure-system, It is introduced the knowledge of smart materials and structures, such as definitions, basic principles and theories, and designing methods, etc. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic knowledge and designing theories and method of smart materials and structures, broaden their knowledge, which lay the foundation for their future working and studying.

default.zh: 本课程介绍超材料的基本概念、分类、不同功能、设计方法，包括五零模超材料、手性超材料、非局部效应超材料、声学超材料、热超材料等，详解其超常规功能以及主要设计、试验方法。使学生对超材料建立初步、全面的认识，并掌握基本的设计方法，培养其科研兴趣。
default.en: This course introduces the basic concepts, classifications, different functions, and design methods of metamaterials, including pentamode metamaterials, chiral metamaterials, non-local metamaterials, acoustic and thermal metamaterials, etc. Samples are prepared and experiments are conducted. Through this course, students will establish a preliminary and comprehensive understanding on metamaterials, design methods, and cultivate interests in scientific research.

default.zh: 该课程主要是引导学生从单纯的上课学习，向从事科学研究转变。引导同学们规划自己的学业生涯的和未来发展方向。课程通过示范性讲解，分享成功人士的经验和教训。课程重点介绍读研过程中涉及到的文献检索方法、文章/专利撰写方法、实验/计算工作经验、项目申请/报告撰写、论文开题/中期/答辩、沟通交流/团队合作方式、情感生活等一系列可能问题的解决方法和建议，帮助新生答疑解惑。激发学生的学习热情，训练学术基本素养。
default.en: The main purpose of this course is to guide students from simple classroom learning to engaging in scientific research. Guide students to plan their academic career and future development direction. The course shares the experiences and lessons of successful individuals through exemplary explanations. The course focuses on introducing literature retrieval methods, article/patent writing methods, experimental/computational work experience, project application/report writing, paper proposal/mid-term/defense, communication and communication/team cooperation methods, emotional life, and a series of possible problem-solving methods and suggestions involved in the postgraduate study process, to help freshmen answer questions and doubts. Stimulate students' enthusiasm for learning and train their basic academic literacy.

default.zh: 高超声速飞行器是指飞行速度超过5倍音速的飞行器，在未来的军事、政治和经济中发挥着极为重要的战略作用，是未来航空航天技术的重要发展方向，在近20年来获得各大国的广泛关注。在飞行过程中，飞行器表面会遭受严酷的热/力载荷，其表面最高响应温度可达2000℃以上，为保障飞行器内部仪器设备的正常运转与飞行器的可靠服役，需要研制具有优异耐温性的热防护材料与结构。本课程将系统介绍热防护材料与结构的需求背景、发展历程、设计理念与方法、关键性能测试方法等基础知识，并与授课人所在团队的创新性研究成果相结合，系统介绍超高温陶瓷及其复合材料、轻质防隔热复合材料与结构、轻质抗烧蚀防热复合材料与结构、C/C复合材料等典型热防护材料与结构的制备工艺，并引导学生利用课程所学知识，给出特定服役环境下的高超声速飞行器热防护系统设计方案并进行共同讨论，在此过程中加深对课程知识的理解与认识，拓宽学生的科学视野，培养学生从事相关领域研究兴趣并奠定基础。
default.en: Hypersonic vehicles are vehicles travelling at speeds exceeding five times the speed of sound, which play an extremely important strategic role in future military, political and economic affairs and are an important development direction for future aerospace technology, and have received extensive attention from major countries in the past 20 years. In the process of flight, the surface of the vehicle will be subjected to severe thermal/force loads, and the maximum response temperature of its surface can reach more than 2000 °C. To guarantee the normal operation of the internal instrumentation of the vehicle and the reliable service of the vehicle, it is necessary to develop thermal protection materials and structures with excellent temperature resistance. This course will systematically introduce the background, development history, design concepts and methods, key performance test methods and other basic knowledge of thermal protection materials and structures, and with the innovative research results of the lecturer's team, systematically introduce the preparation process of typical thermal protection materials and structures, such as ultra-high-temperature ceramics and their composites, lightweight anti-insulation composites and structures, lightweight anti-burning and anti-heat composites and structures, C/C composites, etc., and guide the preparation process of typical thermal protection materials and structures. The preparation process of typical thermal protection materials and structures such as ultra-high temperature ceramics and their composites, lightweight anti-corrosion thermal protection composites and structures, C/C composites and other typical thermal protection materials and structures is systematically introduced, and the students are guided to make use of the knowledge learnt in the course to give the design scheme of the thermal protection system of hypersonic vehicle under the specific service environment and discuss it together, in the process of which, they can deepen the understanding and knowledge on the knowledge of the course, broaden the scientific vision of the students, and cultivate the interest of students to engage in the related fields and lay the foundation.

default.zh: 本课程主要围绕数据科学及其在力学中的应用，以人工智能等为主要技术手段，教授如何从数据中获取知识的基本方法与理论，能够培养学生综合应用数学工具和力学原理解决实际工程问题的能力，这些能力的培养是创新型人才必须具备的基本素质。
default.en: This course mainly focuses on data science and its application in mechanics, using artificial intelligence and other technical means. It teaches the basic methods and theories of how to acquire knowledge from data, and can cultivate students' ability to comprehensively apply mathematical tools and mechanical principles to solve practical engineering problems. The cultivation of these abilities is a basic quality that innovative talents must possess.

default.zh: 《轻量化复合材料材料与结构》是一门介绍轻量化复合材料的性质、制备、性能及其在工程结构中应用的综合性课程。本课程的主要目标是让学生了解轻量化复合材料的工程应用，掌握其设计、制备和性能优化的基本方法，培养学生在轻量化复合材料领域的创新和实践能力。课程内容涵盖了轻量化复合材料的多种类型，如聚合物基、陶瓷基和金属基复合材料等。学生将学习这类材料的组成、结构、性质及其在航空航天、汽车船舶等领域的应用。同时，课程还包括轻量化复合材料的制造工艺等。通过本课程的学习，掌握轻量化复合材料的性能及应用，理解其基本原理和制备工艺，掌握其性能测试和评价方法，并了解轻量化复合材料在节能减排、环保可持续发展等方面的社会意义和价值，为以后的科研工作奠定基础。
default.en: Lightweight Composite Materials and Structures is a comprehensive course that introduces the nature, preparation and properties of lightweight composites and their applications in engineering structures. The main objective of this course is to provide students with an understanding of the engineering applications of lightweight composites, to master the basic methods of their design, preparation and performance optimization, and to cultivate students' innovative and practical abilities in the field of lightweight composites. The course covers various types of lightweight composites, such as polymer-based, ceramic-based and metal-based composites. Students will study the composition, structure, properties of such materials and their applications in aerospace, automotive marine and other fields. The course also covers the manufacturing process of lightweight composites. Through the study of this course, students will master the properties and applications of lightweight composites, understand their basic principles and preparation processes, master their performance testing and evaluation methods, and understand the social significance and value of lightweight composites in energy conservation and emission reduction, environmental protection and sustainable development, laying a foundation for future scientific research work.

default.zh: 微纳米复合材料是一个多学科交叉的研究领域，内涵十分丰富的学科。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握微纳米复合材料的基本概念、内涵、微纳米复合材料的性质、制备技术、表征手段以及应用领域。由于该学科内容涉及过于广泛，本课程将精选代表性微纳米复合材料，用以点带面的方法进行深入浅出的讲解。课程内容包括：微纳米材料基本内涵，微纳米复合材料的定义，微纳米科技的研究意义，微纳米材料的研究范畴，微纳米化的机遇与挑战，微纳米复合材料的发展；微纳米材料的分类，微纳米材料的性质，微纳米材料的制备方法；典型的微纳米复合材料的制备方法；典型的微纳米复合材料的制备方法。使学生掌握掌握微纳米复合材料的基本概念、尺寸效应、表面效应、介电限域效应等，微纳米复合材料的发展；掌握典型微纳米复合材料的制备方法，制备过程中的关键技术，纳米分散原理与分散技术、表面改性技术、原位制备技术、杂化制备技术；掌握典型微纳米复合材料的性质与功能，结合其特点在航空航天领域的应用，了解微纳米复合材料的研究进展，初步掌握微纳米复合材料的科学研究以及开发应用的基本知识。从而拓宽学生的科学视野，引导学生从事新颖性、前瞻性的科研活动，培养学生的创造力和想象力，为其今后的发展打下基础。
default.en: Micro nano composite materials are a multidisciplinary research field with rich connotations. Through this course, students will master the basic concepts, connotations, properties, preparation techniques, characterization methods, and application fields of micro nano composite materials. Due to the extensive coverage of this subject, this course will select representative micro nano composite materials and provide a point-to-point and comprehensive explanation in simple and profound terms. The course content includes: the basic connotation of micro nano materials, the definition of micro nano composite materials, the research significance of micro nano technology, the research scope of micro nano materials, the opportunities and challenges of micro nano industrialization, and the development of micro nano composite materials; Classification of micro and nano materials, properties of micro and nano materials, and preparation methods of micro and nano materials; Preparation methods of typical micro nano composite materials; The preparation method of typical micro nano composite materials. Enable students to master the basic concepts, size effects, surface effects, dielectric confinement effects, etc. of micro nano composite materials, and the development of micro nano composite materials; Master the preparation methods of typical micro nano composite materials, key technologies in the preparation process, nano dispersion principles and dispersion techniques, surface modification techniques, in-situ preparation techniques, and hybrid preparation techniques; Master the properties and functions of typical micro nano composite materials, combine their characteristics with their applications in the aerospace field, understand the research progress of micro nano composite materials, and preliminarily grasp the basic knowledge of scientific research and development application of micro nano composite materials. In order to broaden students' scientific perspective, guide them to engage in innovative and forward-looking scientific research activities, cultivate their creativity and imagination, and lay a foundation for their future development.

default.zh: 功能材料是具有特殊电、磁、光、声、热、力等耦合功能的材料，功能材料器件是信息技术、生物技术、能源技术等高技术领域和社会经济发展的重要基础的支撑。通过学习本课程可以使学生了解和掌握固体物理、界面化学、真空技术、器件微细加工等基础知识，同时通过课堂演示教学环节的支撑和配合，使学生掌握功能材料与器件相关复杂工程问题的综合分析能力，为后续从事功能材料与器件领域奠定理论与实践基础。 本课程主要讲授光电材料与器件、功能转换材料与器件、新型半导体材料与器件、磁性材料、激光器等方面的内容，通过课堂教学、课堂演示等环节，使学生较深入地了解并掌握功能材料生长、性能和应用的基础知识和综合分析能力，培养学生解决基础科学和技术复杂问题的应用创新能力，支撑相关专业毕业要求指标点的达成。
default.en: Functional materials are materials with special coupling functions such as electricity, magnetism, light, sound, heat, and force. Functional material devices are important foundations for high-tech fields such as information technology, biotechnology, energy technology, and socio-economic development. By studying this course, students can understand and master basic knowledge such as solid physics, interface chemistry, vacuum technology, and device microfabrication. At the same time, with the support and cooperation of classroom demonstration teaching, students can master the comprehensive analysis ability of complex engineering problems related to functional materials and devices, laying a theoretical and practical foundation for future work in the field of functional materials and devices. This course mainly teaches about optoelectronic materials and devices, functional conversion materials and devices, new semiconductor materials and devices, magnetic materials, lasers, and other aspects. Through classroom teaching and demonstrations, students can have a deeper understanding and mastery of the basic knowledge and comprehensive analysis ability of functional material growth, performance, and application, and cultivate their application innovation ability to solve complex problems in basic science and technology, Support the achievement of graduation requirements for relevant majors.

default.zh: 本门课程主要研究由不同激励引起的随机振动响应的统计规律，以及这些规律与系统特性之间的关系，着重研究线性单、多自由度、连续体系统在单个和多个平稳随机激励作用下的响应分析。对这些规律我们可以利用概率论的知识对他们进行定量或定性的研究，即对随机振动的各个量进行数学描述，进而揭示随机振动过程的固有规律。
default.en: This course is mainly focused on studying the statistic laws of random vibration response caused by various excitations and the relationships between these laws and system features. Especially, the response analysis of linear single-, multiple-degree and continuum systems under single and multiple stable random excitations will be studied. These laws can be quantitatively and qualitatively investigated by the probability theory. Namely, the quantities of random vibration can be depicted by mathematical descriptions, thus revealing the intrinsic laws of random vibration process.

default.zh: 本课程以高分子凝聚态系统中的固体体系作为研究对象，主要包括无定型高分子长程分子结构、分子链及其聚集体运动及其宏观力学行为的结构-运动-性能本构关系。课程以基本理论和实验知识为基础，结合高分子凝聚态物理与力学的前沿领域最新研究发展和成果，着重讲解玻璃态物质的本质、玻璃化转变热力学、高分子溶液理论及其标度律、高分子凝聚态力学行为的相分离热力学、松弛动力学、分子量离散表征及其分子运动随机动力学、Maxwell唯象粘弹方程、Boltzmann叠加原理、软物质力学等方面基础研究进展。通过本课程学习，培养学生掌握高分子凝聚态物理中的思维方式及研究方法，为进一步深入学习其他课程打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This study aims on the solid mechanics and physics of polymeric condensed-matter. In this course, we will focus on the long-term molecular structure, relaxation behavior of macromolecules and their aggregates, to formulate the constitutive relationships between molecular structure-relaxation-performance of the polymeric condensed-matter. In combination of theoretical basis and research outcome of solid mechanics and physics of polymeric condensed-matter, the nature of glassy matter, thermodynamics in glass transition, polymer solution theory and scaling law, thermodynamic phase separation of polymeric condensed-matter, dynamic relaxation, Gaussian distribution of molecular weight and transition probability, Maxwell equation for viscoelastic relaxation, Boltzmann superposition and mechanics of soft matter. Their potential applications will be also discussed. With aid of this course, it is helpful for students to know the cutting edge researchers in solid mechanics and physics of polymeric condensed-matter, which is then be used as a fundamental basis for further study and research.

default.zh: 智能复合材料是一门以培养学生了解智能复合材料的结构与性能的内在关系的选修课。本课程主要以典型智能材料为例，讲解智能材料的基本原理、智能材料成型工艺技术、智能材料应用领域、智能材料在特殊环境下的性能评价、结构设计及其结构与性能之间的关系等。本课程教学中将采用课堂教学、学生课外自主学习相结合。课堂教学以讲课为主，辅以结构演示动画视频等多媒体方法介绍智能复合材料的基本知识。通过结合该方向的科技前沿动态与应用实例，以形状记忆材料、压电复合材料等典型智能材料为例深入地论述智能复合材料的结构设计、性能与实际应用之间的关系，加深学生对相关知识点的理解。学生课外自主学习，通过分组合作的形式，完成智能复合材料领域的文献调研工作，并完成课堂汇报与交流。本课程旨在开发学生对智能复合材料的兴趣、培养学生查阅文献的能力，培养学生科学探索的综合能力。
default.en: Smart Composites is an elective course designed to train students to understand the intrinsic relationship between the structure and properties of smart composites. This course mainly takes typical intelligent materials as examples to explain the basic principles of intelligent materials, intelligent material forming technology, intelligent material application fields, performance evaluation of intelligent materials in special environments, structural design, and the relationship between structure and performance. In the teaching of this course, the combination of classroom teaching and students' independent learning after class will be used. The classroom teaching mainly focuses on lectures, supplemented by structural demonstration, animation video etc. to introduce the basic knowledge of smart composites. By combining the scientific and technological trends and application examples, taking typical shape memory materials and piezoelectric materials as an example, this course deeply discusses the relationship between the structural design, performance and practical application of intelligent composites, so as to deepen students' understanding of relevant knowledge points. Students are engaged to learn independently after class, completing literature research in the field of intelligent composite materials through teamwork, and conducting presentations. This course aims to develop students' interest in smart composite materials, cultivate students' ability to consult literature, and cultivate students' comprehensive ability to explore science.

default.zh: 超材料与结构具体指的是由人工微结构单元组成的功能材料与功能结构，这些结构单元决定着超材料与结构的宏观属性。本课程将超材料的设计理念拓展到力学领域，主要围绕力学超材料的基本理论、构筑准则、分类以及超材料的制备和应用背景等方面展开。通过本门课程的学习，要求了解力学超材料的定义与范畴；理解并分析力学超材料的超常力学性能；可通过运用基本的力学知识获得简单力学超材料的设计。
default.en: Metamaterials and structures specifically refer to functional materials and structures composed of artificial microstructural units, which determine the macroscopic properties of metamaterials and structures. This course extends the design concept of metamaterials to the mechanics field, mainly focusing on the basic theory, construction criteria, classification, preparation and application background of mechanical metamaterials. By studying this course, it is required to understand the definition and category of mechanical metamaterials; understand and analyze the supernormal mechanical properties of mechanical metamaterials; and design simple mechanical metamaterials using basic mechanics knowledge.

default.zh: 《仿生材料与结构》是为智能材料与结构专业开设的一门专业课程，仿生材料与结构是仿生学在材料学科的分支，是模仿自然界的动物、植物结构的特点或特性而研制开发的人工材料，通过从分子、微观结构到宏观结构研究生物材料的化学组成、结构特点、构效关系, 进而模仿研发出类似或优于原生物材料的新型材料与结构, 是化学、材料学、生物学、物理学等学科的交叉。拟通过本课程的教学和讨论，使学生获得仿生材料与结构相关基础知识和应用技能，拓展学生的创新思维空间，提高学生的创新能力，旨在介绍仿生材料的设计理念与方法、仿生材料结构与功能的关系、智能驱动原理与生产应用等。
default.en: Biomimetic Materials and Structures is a professional course for the major of Smart Materials and Structures. Biomimetic Materials and Structures are a branch of Bionics materials science. They are artificial materials developed by imitating the characteristics or characteristics of animals and plants in nature. Based the study of the chemical composition, structural characteristics and structure-activity relationship of biomaterials and structures from molecules level, microstructure to macro structure, new materials similar to or better than raw biological materials are developed. Biomimetic Materials and Structures is the intersection of chemistry, materials science, biology, physics and other disciplines. Through the teaching and discussion of this course, it is planned to enable students to obtain the basic knowledge and application skills related to Biomimetic Materials and Structures, expand students' innovative thinking space and improve students' innovative ability. The purpose is to introduce the design concept and method of bionic materials, the relationship between structure and function of bionic materials, intelligent driving principle and production application, etc.

default.zh: 医用生物高分子材料是一门多学科交叉的课程，涉及材料科学、化学、生命科学和医学等领域。本课程致力于使同学们掌握生物高分子材料的基本概念，了解生物医用高分子材料研究的最新进展。课程还致力于让学生着重掌握材料与生物体相互作用规律、生物医用高分子材料的生物相容性和安全性评价、生物医学应用的高分子材料的分类。此外，还将介绍医用高分子材料的设计，并通过各种典型的医疗器件展示生物医用高分子的生物应用。
default.en: Medical biopolymers is a multidisciplinary cross-disciplinary course, involving the fields of materials science, chemistry, life science and medicine. This course is dedicated to enable students to master the basic concepts of biopolymers and understand the latest progress in the research of biomedical polymer materials. The course is also committed to enable students to focus on mastering the law of interaction between materials and organisms, biocompatibility and safety evaluation of biomedical polymer materials, and classification of polymer materials for biomedical applications. In addition, the design of medical polymer materials will be introduced and the biological applications of biomedical polymers will be demonstrated through various typical medical devices.

default.zh: 变体飞行器可以根据不同的飞行任务和飞行环境改变自身形状，以获得最佳的气动性能，已经成为未来先进飞行器的重要特征和发展方向之一。本课程教学中课堂教学与实验相结合。课堂教学以讲课为主，内容包括飞行器总体设计、空气动力学基础、飞行器的材料、自适应结构设计、折叠翼/后掠翼/变前后缘弯度翼/扑翼等变体飞行器设计等。本课程旨在开发学生对变体飞行器的兴趣、加深学生对航空知识的理解，培养学生解决工程实际问题的综合能力。
default.en: Morphing aircraft can change its shape according to different flying tasks and flying environments to obtain the best aerodynamic performance, which has become an important feature and development direction of advanced aircraft in the future. This course combines classroom teaching with experiment. The classroom teaching is mainly lectures, including the overall design of aircraft, theoretical knowledge of aerodynamics, aircraft materials and adaptive structural design, folding wing/swept-back wing/ variable camber wing /flapping wing morphing aircraft design, etc. This course aims to improve students' interest in morphing aircraft, deepen their understanding of aviation knowledge, and develop students' comprehensive ability to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 《微纳米材料与人工智能技术》课程是一门融合人工智能技术与微纳米材料加工技术相结合的交叉学科课程，旨在通过理论与实践结合，以“算法驱动+微纳米材料设计”为核心理念，培养运用人工智能思维解决复杂工程问题的能力，理解AI算法（机器学习、深度学习）在材料设计加工、性能预测及工艺优化中的应用原理，提升学生解决实际工程问题的能力。
default.en: Micro Nano Materials and Artificial Intelligence Technology is an interdisciplinary course that combines artificial intelligence technology with micro/nano material processing technology. It aims to help the students to cultivate the ability of artificial intelligence to solve complex engineering problems, and understand the application principles of AI algorithms (machine learning, deep learning) in material design and processing, performance prediction, and process optimization. In addition, it can enhance students' ability to solve practical engineering problems through the combination of theory and practice, with the core concept of "algorithm driven+micro nano material design".

default.zh: 《力学基本问题》是面向初具力学知识的本科高年级学生的专业通识课程。本课程主要讲授基础力学、流体力学、固体力学和交叉力学的一般研究内容以及力学发展中的根本性和前沿性问题。本课程的教学注重培养学生的兴趣，着重培养学生对力学学科框架及交叉学科基本知识的掌握，为从事专业技术和科学研究打下基础。
default.en: Basic inssues in mechanics is a general course for undergraduates with a basic knowledge of mechanics. It covers the general topics of fundamental mechanics, fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, and cross-disciplinary mechanics, as well as the fundamental and cutting-edge issues in the development of mechanics. The course aims cultivate to students' interest and enhance their understanding of the mechanics framework and cross-disciplinary basics, laying a solid foundation for their future professional work and scientific research.

default.zh: 以当前世界新一轮月球和火星探测活动为背景，讲授深空探测的基本概念和基本知识，使学生对深空探测能够有全面的了解，培养学生对深空探测领域的兴趣。主要内容包括深空探测的基本概念、深空探测的目标天体和科学目标、国内外深空探测的发展概况、三体问题、深空探测轨道初步设计方法、非霍曼行星际转移轨道设计、深空探测自主导航技术、深空测控与通信技术简介等，为进一步深入学习深空探测的具体领域方向打下基础。课程最后的成绩采用课后作业和课程大作业两部分累加的方式。
default.en: Deep space exploration is a popular issue and a research focus now. On the basis of new round of the Moon and Mars exploration activities, this course is to teach basic concepts and knowledge of deep space exploration, cultivate student’s interests in deep space exploration. This course includes overview of development in deep space exploration, basic concepts and principles of deep space exploration, the target celestial bodies and scientific objectives of deep space exploration, the three-body problem, preliminary interplanetary orbit design, interplanetary non-Hohmann transfer orbit technique, deep space autonomous navigation technology, introduction of deep space tracking telemetry, control and communication, etc. The course will lay the foundation for learning the specific field of deep space exploration. The final grade for the course is calculated using a cumulative method, which includes homework, and a course project.

default.zh: 鉴于航天器敏感元件与执行机构是航天器控制系统的基本组成和设计关键，本课程重点讲述如太阳敏感器、星敏感器、惯性敏感器、冷气推进器、电推进、飞轮、控制力矩陀螺等常用敏感元件和执行机构，具体阐述其工作原理、分类、特点、测试以及应用等，并辅以实物演示，让学生对航天器姿态控制系统的设计有一个较为全面的了解和认知。通过本课程的学习，为将来从事航天领域科研和研究，特别是从事航天器总体设计、姿态控制系统设计、敏感器或执行机构设计的学生奠定理论和技术基础。
default.en: In view that sensors and actuators are the key to spacecraft control systems design, this course will focuses on commonly used sensors and actuators such as solar sensor, star sensor, inertial sensor, cold-gas propulsion system, electric propulsion, flywheel, control moment gyro, etc. The working principle, classification, characteristics, testing and application method for each component will be explained in detail in order to let students have a comprehensive understanding of the design of spacecraft attitude control system. Through the study of this course, we will lay a theoretical and technical foundation for future research in the aerospace field, especially for the spacecraft system design, attitude control system design, sensor or actuator design.

default.zh: 《航天器电源系统》是一门理论知识与工程设计相结合的课程，通过本课程的学习，使学生了解航天器电源系统的设计特点与设计方法，能够开展航天器电源系统方案选择与方案设计。 本课程主要包括：电源系统的设计准则与设计步骤、空间环境对电源系统的主要影响及对策、太阳电池电性能计算及电路布局设计、锂离子蓄电池组的工作特性及充电策略、电源功率调节原理及全调节母线电源系统、电源能量平衡策略及电源系统设计计算。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂提问成绩、课下作业成绩、期末考试成绩。
default.en: This lesson is the basic course for students from spacecraft design and lectured by introducing spacecraft power system design principle, design methodology and relative overall design knowledge. The detail content of the lesson includes spacecraft power system constitution and design principle; the influence of space environment to spacecraft power system; the design of solar cell panel, battery and power control equipment; power system technical parameters selecting; design examples of LEO spacecraft.

default.zh: 卫星星务系统是卫星六大系统中最重要的分系统之一，星务系统是卫星的数据中心，同时是卫星的控制中心。星务系统以综合电子系统硬件为载体，与卫星全部部件通过不同的数据接口相连，各部件按约定协议将产生的工程参数发送至星务系统，星务系统对各工程参数进行正确性与有效性的判断，并做出相应处置；然后星务系统按协议将工程参数进行解析与编排，根据卫星管理控制要求，将重新编排后的工程参数发送至对应单机或地面系统。 上述管理控制过程的全部环节所涉及到的硬件以软件逻辑就是本课程的讲授核心，涉及到星载嵌入式系统、测控系统、计算机网络、软件工程等学科，是一门综合性较强的课程，卫星星务系统设计的好坏，直接决定了地面管控人员能够对卫星的管控程度，以及卫星的好用、易用程度。通过本课程的学习，不仅能够掌握星务系统的设计方法，同时对卫星总体设计能够产生深刻的认识。 《微纳卫星星务系统》是飞行器设计与工程专业的重要专业选修课，是与工程实际联系极为紧密的一门课程，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和实践能力方面占有重要的地位。
default.en: Housekeeping system is one of the most important subsystems among the six major satellite systems. Housekeeping system is both the data center and control center of the satellite. This system takes the integrated electronic system hardware as the carrier, and is connected with all components of the satellite through different data interfaces. Each component sends the generated engineering parameters to the housekeeping system according to the agreed protocol. The satellite system judges the correctness and effectiveness of each engineering parameter and makes corresponding disposal. Then the satellite system parses and arranges the engineering parameters according to the protocol, and sends the rearranged engineering parameters to the corresponding component or ground system according to the requirements of satellite management and control. The hardware and software logic involved in all aspects of the above management and control process is the core of this course. It involves on-board embedded systems, measurement and control systems, computer networks, software engineering and other disciplines. It is a comprehensive course. The quality of housekeeping system design directly determines the degree of control of satellites by ground control personnel, as well as the ease of use and ease of use of satellites. Through the study of this course, we can not only master the design method of the housekeeping system, but also have a deep understanding of the overall design of the satellite. ' Design of Housekeeping System of Microsatellite ' is an important professional elective course for aircraft design and engineering. It is a course closely related to engineering practice. It plays an important role in cultivating students ' creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and practical ability.

default.zh: 飞行器结构动力学是面向航天类飞行器设计与工程专业高年级本科生开设的具有鲜明航天特色的一门必修专业基础课。本课程结合飞行器结构设计和验证需求，系统地阐述飞行器结构动力学的基本概念、基本理论、基本分析方法及其工程应用。课程分为基础理论和专业内容两大部分：基础理论部分包括单自由度系统的振动、多自由度系统的振动、连续弹性体系统的振动；专业内容部分包括航天器力学环境概述，航天器结构动力学建模、航天器结构模态分析、航天器结构动力响应分析以及航天器动力学环境预示分析示例等。
default.en: The Dynamics of Aircraft Structures is a compulsory fundamental course for senior year students majoring in aircraft design, aircraft environment and safeguard engineering, which is centered around space technology. The course thoroughly discusses the fundamental concepts, theory and analytical methods of the dynamics of aircraft structures as well as the engineering application. This course is divided into two major parts: basic theories and industrial application. The former part consists of single-freedom system vibration, multi-freedom system vibration, continuous elastic system vibration and random vibration. The latter part includes overview of the spacecraft mechanical environment, modeling of spacecraft structure dynamics, modal analysis of aircraft structures, dynamic response of aircraft structures, the examples of spacecraft dynamics environment simulation, as so on.

default.zh: 飞行器轨道动力学中的数学方法是飞行器设计学科的一门专业选修课，是轨道任务设计的基础。讲解航天器轨道动力学中的基本问题和基本数学方法，并应用于轨道转移和轨道交会等任务。是必修课《航天器轨道动力学》的补充，是培养从事轨道动力学领域研究和工程设计专业人才的重要组成部分。 本课程将在轨道力学经典书籍《An Introduction to the Mathematics and Methods of Astrodynamics》 (Battin R.H.著，1999年)的基础上，讲解航天器轨道动力学中的基本问题和基本数学方法，并应用于轨道设计、轨道转移和轨道交会等任务。培养本科生在所学轨道动力学基础知识上，掌握轨道动力学领域所需的基本数学方法，并用于轨道工程任务的分析和设计；培养学生创新思维能力，为以后科学研究打下基础；了解目前轨道动力学中的热点问题和分析方法。
default.en: Mathematical methods in spacecraft orbit dynamics is a professional elective course for the discipline of flight vehicle design, and it is the basis of orbit mission designs. The course mainly learns the basic problems and the basic mathematical methods for spacecraft orbit dynamics, and applies these methods in the orbit transfer and the orbit rendezvous missions. The course is an important supplement for the required course “spacecraft orbit dynamics”. It is an important component for training the talents working on studies and engineering design in the field of orbit dynamics. The course is based on the classic book in orbit dynamics, i.e., An Introduction to the Mathematics and Methods of Astrodynamics, Battin R.H., 1999. The main contents include the fundamental problem and the fundamental mathematical method in orbit dynamics and their applications in orbit transfer and rendezvous missions. The purpose of the course is to train the undergraduates to grasp the fundamental method in the field of orbit dynamics and to apply this technique into orbit mission analysis and design. Moreover, we will train the undergraduates' innovative thinking, which may be used in their future scientific research. In addition, the research hot topics and the methods in orbit dynamics will be introduced in the course.

default.zh: 《飞行器智能控制基础》是面向飞行器设计与工程专业本科第三学年学生开设的专业方向选修课。本课程首先回顾人工智能、飞行器及飞行器控制的基本概念，讲授飞行器控制系统设计常用准则及方法。随后讲授课程学习所需的人工智能基础知识，包括神经网络、模糊系统、强化学习等。之后结合导弹自动驾驶仪设计、火箭姿态控制系统设计、再入飞行器姿态控制系统设计等实例，讲授BP神经网络控制、RBF神经网络控制、模糊控制、强化学习控制、自适应动态规划等智能控制方法。 通过本课程的学习，学生能够全面、系统地掌握飞行器控制系统设计方法与人工智能基础理论知识，结合工程实例深入理解智能控制应用途径，可为后续从事飞行器智能控制系统设计工作提供基础；并可对先进人工智能方法的学习，开阔视野、培养创新思维。
default.en: "Basics of aircraft Intelligent Control" is a specialized elective course offered to third-year undergraduate students majoring in aircraft design and engineering. This course begins by reviewing the basic concepts of artificial intelligence, aircraft, and aircraft control, and it covers commonly used criteria and methods in the design of aircraft control systems. Subsequently, the course teaches the foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence required for the study, including neural networks, fuzzy systems, reinforcement learning, and more. Following that, the course integrates examples such as the design of missile autopilots, rocket attitude control systems, and re-entry aircraft attitude control systems. It covers intelligent control methods such as BP neural network control, RBF neural network control, fuzzy control, reinforcement learning control, adaptive dynamic programming, and others. Through the study of this course, students will be able to comprehensively and systematically grasp the methods of designing aircraft control systems and the foundational theoretical knowledge of artificial intelligence. By combining engineering examples, they will gain an in-depth understanding of the application of intelligent control and be equipped with a solid foundation for future work in the design of aircraft intelligent control systems. Additionally, the course enables students to explore advanced artificial intelligence methods, broaden their perspectives, and foster innovative thinking.

default.zh: 本课程是飞行器设计与工程专业的主要专业课程之一。课程的主要内容有：喷气发动机概述；化学火箭发动机的主要参数；火箭发动机喷管理想流动的基本关系式；液体火箭发动机挤压式推进剂供应系统和泵压式推进剂供应系统；液体火箭发动机和固体火箭发动机的基本部件；固体火箭发动机装药和内弹道计算；固体推进剂、液体推进剂及其燃烧；电推进系统。通过该课程的学习，学生能够掌握化学火箭发动机的基本概念、基本工作原理，学会化学火箭发动机的性能计算方法，了解电推进系统的特点，为后续专业课的学习打下基础。
default.en: The course is one of the main professional courses for graduates at major of Aerospace design and engineering. It includes that the introduction of jet engine, the main parameters of the chemical rocket engine, the basic relations for an ideal gas flow through a rocket nozzle, the pressurized gas propellant feed system and turbo-pump propellant feed system of liquid rocket engine, the essential components of liquid rocket engine and solid rocket engine, the grain and interior ballistics calculation of solid rocket engine, solid rocket propellant, liquid rocket propellant and their combustion; electric rocket engine. Through this course, the students could know the concept of chemical rocket engine, the essential theory, the method of calculating the performance, the characteristics of the propulsion system. Accordingly, it will be the foundation of the next courses.

default.zh: 本课程是高等学校飞行器设计与工程类专业的一门专业限选课。课程的主要教学任务是使学生系统地了解和掌握燃气涡轮发动机的工作原理、性能指标、共同工作条件、调节规律和发动机特性，掌握燃气轮发动机部件的结构特点和工作原理，了解超燃冲压发动机的工作原理及发展状况。本课程的学习可以为后续专业课程学习提供知识支撑，并为学生毕业后从事飞行器设计相关领域的工作奠定理论基础。
default.en: This course is an elective course in the major of aerospace design and engineering of universities. The main task of this course is to enable students to understand and grasp the working principle, performances, working conditions, regulation and motivation characteristics of gas turbine engine. The engine part’s structure characteristics and working principle of gas turbine will be illustrated in this course. The working principle and development of the scramjet engine will be introduced as well. This course can provide knowledge support for the following professional courses, and laid the theoretical foundation for the overall design in the field of aircraft for the students after graduation.

default.zh: 智能故障诊断是根据观察到的状况、领域知识和经验、推断出系统、部件或器官的故障原因，以便尽可能发现和排除故障，以提高系统或装备的可靠性。智能故障诊断系统一般由知识库、诊断推理机构、接口和数据库等组成。飞行器故障智能诊断是飞行器设计等学科一门适用课程，是保证航天器安全、可靠的重要技术。它是一门跨学科、多领域的综合课程。本课程知识面广、应用性强，技术新，人工智能应用较多。本课重点介绍智能诊断基本原理与方法，以及本领域的研究现状与发展趋势。课程包括故障诊断研究范围；智能诊断原理与方法；故障诊断系统的建模与仿真；状态监测等内容。具体学习的故障诊断方法包括：专家系统、神经网络、故障树诊断、案例推理、决策树诊断和遗传算法等，需要掌握这些方法的原理及应用。
default.en: The so-called intelligent fault diagnosis is based on the observed condition, the field of knowledge and experience which can infer failure parts of the system, components or organ. So, the fault can be found and removed, and the reliability of the system or equipment is improved. Intelligent fault diagnosis system is composed of knowledge base, diagnosis inference mechanism, interface and database. Intelligent fault diagnosis of spacecraft is an applicable course for some subjects such as spacecraft design etc. It is an important technique for assuring safety and credibility of spacecraft. It is an interdisciplinary and multi-domain synthesis course. The knowledge of the course relates to a lot of fields, its application performance is good, its technique is new, and it utilizes more artificial intelligence. The basic principle and method of intelligent diagnosis and the research present state and perspectives are the major contents of the course. The main contents include research scope of fault diagnosis, principle and method of intelligent diagnosis, model and simulation of fault diagnosis system, and state monitoring. The specific methods of fault diagnosis include: expert system, neural network, fault tree, case reasoning, decision tree and genetic algorithm, etc. The principles and applications of these methods should be mastered.

default.zh: 《系统工程》作为 20 世纪中期开始兴起的一门交叉学科，已经成为管理类相关专业的核心课程，是飞行器设计与工程、飞行器环境与生命保障工程、工程力学等专业的基础课程之一。系统工程是从总体出发，合理开发、运行和革新一个大规模复杂系统，特别是管理系统所需的思想、理论、程序和方法体系，属于一门综合性的工程技术。系统工程的应用领域十分广泛，其研究内容也十分丰富，本课程主要讲授系统及系统工程的基本概念与特点、系统工程方法论、系统模型与模型化、系统评价原理及常用方法和系统工程应用实例。 本课程的主要任务是通过系统工程学基本概念与基本理论的概述，培养学生的系统工程观念，使之树立将工程技术、组织管理和工程哲学相统一的基本思想；帮助学生掌握包含统筹规划、精心组织、权衡择优、妥善善后等工程战略意识的系统工程方法论，重点在于引导学生以后能自觉地将系统论的基本思想应用于飞行器研制等一系列复杂工程问题的处理的整个工作过程中（包括规划、预研、设计、制造、试验、使用及善后处理等各个阶段）。
default.en: As an interdisciplinary discipline that began to emerge in the mid-20th century, "System Engineering" has become the core course of management-related majors, and is one of the basic courses of aircraft design and engineering, aircraft environment and life support engineering, engineering mechanics and other majors. System engineering is a comprehensive engineering technology that rationally develops, operates and innovates a large-scale complex system, especially the ideas, theories, procedures and methods required for the management system, starting from the whole. This course mainly teaches the basic concepts and characteristics of systems and systems engineering, system engineering methodology, system model and modeling, system evaluation principles and common methods and system engineering application examples. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' concepts of systems engineering through the overview of basic concepts and basic theories of systems engineering, so that they can establish the basic ideas of unifying engineering technology, organizational management and engineering philosophy; To help students master the system engineering methodology including overall planning, careful organization, weighing and selection, proper aftercare and other engineering strategic awareness, the focus is to guide students to consciously apply the basic ideas of systems theory to the entire work process of dealing with a series of complex engineering problems such as aircraft development (including planning, pre-research, design, manufacturing, testing, use and aftercare processing).

default.zh: 现代控制理论是飞行器设计与工程专业、飞行器环境与生命保障工程专业及其他相关专业的专业基础课程之一，其主要内容包括基于状态空间方法的线性系统理论、最优控制及最优估计理论等几方面的基本理论与基本方法。通过本课程的学习，学生可以掌握现代控制理论的基础知识与理论，为今后从事飞行器系统的设计与工程工作或其他与现代控制系统相关的工作奠定基础。 一、课程的性质与基本要求 现代控制理论是飞行器设计与工程等专业本科生的一门技术基础课，主要基于状态空间描述研究线性控制系统状态的分析与综合。要求学生通过本课程的学习掌握以下基本理论： 线性控制系统的状态空间描述。 线性控制系统的运动分析与离散化。 线性控制系统的李亚普诺夫稳定性。 线性控制系统的能控性与能观测性。 线性控制系统的状态反馈与状态观测器。 卡尔曼滤波。 系统最优控制。 二、基本教材 1．于长官主编，现代控制理论，哈尔滨工业大学出版社，1997年7月第2版。
default.en: Modern Control System Theory is one of the basic academic curriculums for students majored in spacecraft engineering, Flight vehicle environment and life safeguard project, and other relevant subjects. The primary contents are some foundational theories and methods such as linear system theory based on state space, optimal control and optimal estimate, etc. By the study of this course, the students could grasp the foundational knowledge and theory about Modern Control Theory, preparing for further space engineering or modern control related work. 1. Nature and basic requirement of the course Modern control system theory, which is a basic course on technology for undergraduates who study spacecraft design and Engineering etc., studies the analysis and integration of state based on the state-space representation of linear control system. It requires students to comprehend the basic knowledge in the following through studying the course. The state-space representation of linear control system. The motion analysis and discretization of linear control system. Liapunov’s stability of linear control system. The controllability and observability of linear control system. The state-variable feedback and state observer of linear control system. Kalman filtering. System Optimal Control. 2. Teaching material Yu Zhangguan, Modern Control System Theory, 2nd ed., Harbin, Harbin Institute of Technology Press, 1997.

default.zh: 导弹及火箭结构设计》简介 课程编码： 22AS32525 课程中文名称：导弹及火箭结构设计 总学时：32 讲课学时：32 课程简介：导弹及火箭结构设计课程是飞行器设计与工程专业的一门专业基础课。课程主要讲述：结构设计准则及结构设计的基本概念；静载荷的计算与传力分析；翼面的结构设计与分析；舱段的结构设计与分析；贮箱的结构设计与分析、弹上机构及结构的动态设计。整个教学主要通过课堂讲授的教学形式完成。通过学习使学生掌握以导弹为代表的飞行器结构设计的主要概念、结构设计准则及弹翼、舱段、贮箱、弹上操纵机构、分离机构等主要结构部件的设计方法，在结构设计中贯穿气动加热机理与防护、气动弹性机理与规避等设计理念，理解飞行器零、部件结构设计的具体思路，为今后从事航天工程研究工作奠定良好的基础。
default.en: Course Description：this course structure design of missile and rocket is a professional basic course of aircraft design and engineering. This course is divided into several major sections, that include: the basic concept and rules of structure design of the guided missile; the calculation of the static load and the theory of the structure transfer force, the structure design and analysis of the wing panel; the structure design and analysis of the missile bodies; the structure design and analysis of the tanks; playing on the body and dynamic design of the structure. Teaching is used to complete this course. Students should grasp the main concept of the spacecraft structure design, the rule of the structure design and the design method of the main structure parts. Pneumatic heating mechanism and protection, and pneumatic elasticity mechanism and avoidance are used in the structural design. The basic thinking of the structure design on spacecraft is understood.

default.zh: 《火箭控制系统设计》是面向飞行器设计与工程专业本科第四学年学生开设的专业选修课。本课程首先介绍运载火箭控制系统的构成、作用意义与实现方式，给出以牵连关系及其推广形式为基础的，火箭运动方程的详细建立过程，以及基于小扰动线性化的火箭控制模型处理方法。然后，重点阐述火箭无控运动稳定性分析方法，以明确控制对象的自由运动特性。之后逐步讲授火箭设计工程实践中广泛采用的姿态稳定控制、偏差最小控制和载荷最小控制的基本知识与设计方法，并结合实际火箭型号设计实例对其进行强化理解。最后，介绍几种典型的火箭先进控制方法，重点对目前NASA主推的重型运载火箭将采用的自适应增广控制的构成框架与设计方法进行阐述。 通过本课程的学习，学生能够全面、系统地掌握火箭这一复杂对象的控制特性分析方法，深入理解火箭控制系统设计的基本原理，可为后续从事火箭总体设计或火箭控制系统设计的工作提供基础。并可通过对火箭先进控制方法的学习，开阔视野、培养创新思维。
default.en: Design for Rocket Control System is a specialized elective course for the fourth year of undergraduate students majoring in vehicle design and engineering. This course firstly introduces the composition, significance and realization of the launch vehicle control system, gives the detailed establishment process of the rocket motion equations based on the implicit relation and its promotion form, and the processing method of the rocket control model based on the linearization of small perturbation. Then, it focuses on the method of analyzing the stability of the uncontrolled motion of the rocket in order to clarify the free motion characteristics of the control object. After that, the basic knowledge and design methods of attitude stabilization control, deviation minimization control and load minimization control, which are widely used in the engineering practice of rocket design, are taught step by step, and their understanding is strengthened by combining them with actual rocket model design examples. Finally, several typical rocket advanced control methods are introduced, focusing on the composition framework and design method of adaptive broadening control, which will be adopted by NASA's main heavy launch vehicle. Through the study of this course, students can comprehensively and systematically master the control characteristics of the rocket as a complex object analysis method, in-depth understanding of the basic principles of the rocket control system design, can be engaged in the overall design of the rocket or rocket control system design for subsequent work to provide the basis. And through the study of rocket advanced control methods, broaden the horizons, cultivate innovative thinking.

default.zh: 《航天器结构设计》课程面向飞行器设计与工程专业本科生开课，是飞行器设计专业重要的专业基础课之一，对将来从事飞行器设计工作的学生具有重要意义。课程首先从理论与工程应用的角度讲授飞行器结构设计的基础性知识，使学生了解飞行器结构设计的主要内容、特点及研制程序；熟悉飞行器结构设计的设计方法及验证方法；最后，以典型飞行器结构为例，重点讲授并使学生掌握几类飞行器结构研制的方法及程序。 课程的教学重点是卫星结构设计的一般性技术内容，卫星结构设计、分析及验证方法；卫星结构设计的具体技术内容，典型的卫星结构及机构的设计、分析与工程应用。 本课程的成绩采用累加式，包括期末考试和作业二部分。
default.en: Structure Design of Spacecraft is one of the most important professional basic courses for undergraduates in Spacecraft Design and Engineering. This course is of great significance for students who will get into the spacecraft design industry in the future. Firstly, foundational knowledge will be introduced from the perspective of theory and engineering application so that students can understand main contents, characteristics and development program of spacecraft structure design, and know design and verification methods well. Finally, several typical spacecraft structures will be concentrated on and students will master the development methods and development process of the spacecraft structures through the study. Key points of this course are the general technical contents and the specific technical contents. The general technical contents include design, analysis and verification methods of spacecraft structures, and the specific technical contents include design, analysis and engineering applications of several typical spacecraft structures. The examination method of the Structure Design of Spacecraft is as follows: the final examination scores and homework scores.

default.zh: 优化设计是将数值优化算法应用于航天器设计以辅助设计师提高系统性能、可靠性，降低重量和成本的一项技术，是提高航天器设计水平的重要途径，对实现航天器“快、好、省”的设计思想有着重要的意义。本课程针对航天任务设计过程几个主要阶段的优化问题，介绍其实现途径、问题建模以及优化求解等。同时，结合典型的航天器设计优化问题工程实例，对所采用的优化理论、算法及工程应用进行讲解，促进学生对优化设计方法及其实际应用的理解与掌握，增加学生的学习兴趣和感性认识。
default.en: Design optimization is the application of numerical algorithms and techniques to spacecraft design to assist the designers in improving the system's performance, weight, reliability, and/or cost. It is an important way to improve the performance of spacecraft design, and also an effective method to reach the 'faster, better, cheaper' goal of the spacecraft design. The course focuses on some optimization problems encountered in space mission engineering, and to introduce students to formulate a real problem in mathematical terms; to recognize whether the problem can be solved numerically; to choose a suitable method; to understand the conditions required for the method to work; to evaluate the results and to estimate their accuracy and their sensitivity to changes in the data.

default.zh: 航天器综合测试方法课程面向飞行器设计与工程全系的本科生开课，是一门多学科交叉的主干专业选修课程，课程立足于航天工程的总体设计角度出发，把测试原理、数据处理、计算机应用等知识与航天器工程应用相结合，是培养从事航天器综合测试领域和航天器总体研究和工程设计专业人才的重要组成部分。 课程主要讲授航天器综合测试的基本任务、基本原理、分级分阶段测试策略和测试支撑技术，重点使学生了解航天器综合测试的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；了解航天器综合测试的特点与设计原则，深入理解与综合测试相关的专业知识和设计方法；掌握航天器研制过程中综合测试任务的分析、方案设计、测试方法、测试支撑技术、测试过程的组织实施等相关知识，并通过典型航天器综合测试系统设计实例，使学生能够站在系统的、全局的角度运用所学的专业知识去分析工程设计中的实际问题，形成初步的航天器综合测试总体设计和系统分析能力等。 课程主要包括概论及航天器测试的任务介绍、分系统级测试、系统级测试、测试基本流程、测试基本结构、测试接口设计、测试数据获取与处理、电气地面支持系统设计和测试故障分析等介绍。 本课程期末成绩采用累加式，包括日常作业和期末大作业两部分。
default.en: Spacecraft Comprehensive Test Method is a multi-disciplinary major undergraduate elective course for flight vehicle design and engineering, which combines the knowledge of test principle, data processing and computer application with the application of spacecraft engineering based on the overall design of aerospace engineering. It is an important part for training the professionals engaged in the field of spacecraft integrated testing and spacecraft overall research and engineering design. The course mainly includes basic tasks, basic principles, hierarchical and phased testing strategy, test supporting technology of spacecraft integrated testing. The objective of this course is that students are aware of the theoretical basis, research focus, development trend and frontier application of spacecraft integrated testing. Besides, the course is designed to make the students: deeply understand the characteristics and design principles of spacecraft integrated testing, and the professional knowledge and design methods associated with integrated testing; master the analysis, scheme design, test method, test support technology, organization and implementation of test procedure in the development of spacecraft; form a preliminary overall design and system analysis capability of the spacecraft integrated test through the design example of typical spacecraft integrated test system. Spacecraft Comprehensive Test Method is constituted by the introduction, mission of spacecraft testing, the system level test, system level test, test process, test the basic structure, test interface design, test data acquisition and processing, electrical ground support system design and test failure analysis. The course exam grade is accumulative and consists of two parts: the assignment after class and the major final assignment.

default.zh: 了解航天器系统仿真的基本概念以及航天器特别是卫星系统仿真的相关理论与设计方法，主要包括航天器系统仿真概述、数学仿真技术、半物理仿真技术以及基于一些典型商业软件在航天器系统仿真工程中的应用，最后，以对某卫星的系统仿真设计和分析为例来结束本课程教学。
default.en: The basic concepts, theories and approaches of spacecraft especially satellite system simulation will be understood after the study of this course. There are four major contents in this course: a short survey of spacecraft system simulation, the technology of mathematical simulation, the technology of hardware-in-the-loop simulation and the applications of popular commercial software for satellite system simulation. In the end, an example to design and analyze the system simulation of one satellite is presented as a benchmark of the completion of this course.

default.zh: 本课程内容主要包括航天器在整个运行寿命期间所经历的各种空间环境；航天器热控制采用的各种被动热控技术，包括涂层、多层隔热材料、热管、导热填料等；各种主动热控技术，包括辐射式、传导式及对流式主动热控技术，电加热主动热控技术，制冷主动热控技术等；航天器热分析计算，包括外热流的分析计算、温度场的分析计算等；航天器热设计方法，包括航天器热设计任务、原则、输入条件、工况选择、热控措施选择等，以及设计实例；航天器热模拟试验方法，包括真空模拟方法、低温热沉模拟方法、外热流模拟方法，热平衡试验方法等。
default.en: The lectures of this course will cover the following issues： A description of the space environment, specially spacecraft thermal environments on orbit; Passive thermal control technology, including thermal control coatings, multilayer insulation (MLI), heat pipes, interstitial materials to decrease the thermal contact resistance; Active thermal control technology, including conduction method, convection method, radiation method, electrical heating method, cooling method of the spacecraft; Spacecraft thermal analysis and calculation method, including environmental heating calculation on orbit, spacecraft temperature calculation; Method of spacecraft thermal design, including the task and rule of spacecraft thermal design ,input parameters, choice of working condition, choice of different thermal control technology, and examples of spacecraft thermal design; Method of spacecraft thermal modeling test, including modeling method of vacuum environment, modeling method of low temperature heat sink, modeling method of space heat flux, and heat balance test method etc. .
