default.zh: 空间碎片环境与航天器防护是面向飞行器设计与工程类高年级本科生开设的具有鲜明航天特色的一门选修课。空间碎片环境作为危害航天器安全运行的空间环境因素之一，是随着航天事业的发展而产生的人为空间环境污染，受航天界关注程度日益增加。本课程主要讲授与空间碎片环境及其防护有关的基本知识，重点使学生掌握和了解空间碎片来源、环境特性与表征方法、危害及其减缓与防护技术等方面的知识，对空间碎片问题有较全面的认识，培养学生解决航天工程问题时的环境保护与可持续发展意识。 课程主要包括绪论、当前空间碎片环境及其来源、空间碎片环境工程模型、空间碎片减缓措施及其作用、空间碎片超高速撞击防护技术、空间碎片撞击航天器风险评估。
default.en: Space Debris Environment and Spacecraft Shielding is an optional course for senior undergraduates majoring in Flight Vehicle Design and Engineering. Space debris threatening the safety of spacecrafts is originated and generated from artificial space activities. Concern for it is growing in space engineering. This course covers essential knowledge of space debris environment and spacecraft shielding. Students can learn the sources, environmental characterization, the hazards, and the mitigation technologies of space debris, and spacecraft shielding technologies. They also will enhance the environmental and sustainable consciousness in space engineering. This course includes introduction, space debris environment and its source, engineering model of space debris environment, space debris mitigation, protection against hypervelocity impact of space debris, and risk assessment of space debris impact.

default.zh: 《飞行器制导控制仿真》是航天工程专业的技术基础课，介绍如何利用数学工具与可视化分析工具进行飞行器动态系统仿真和分析，主要讲授以下知识点：编程语言对矩阵的构建和基本操作语句；矩阵线性代数运算指令、特殊运算符指令和专用数学函数；程序流程控制指令和程序设计；图形基本操作指令和绘制图形的一般过程；图形句柄和函数句柄；飞行器动态系统建模仿真与分析流程。通过该课学习，可为学生进行《航天器轨道动力学》、《航天器姿态动力学》、《远程火箭弹道学与制导方法》、《导弹飞行力学》等核心课程实践训练提供基础。
default.en: Spacecraft Guidance and Control Simulation is a technical foundation course for aerospace engineering majors. It introduces how to use mathematical and visual analysis tools to simulate and analyze dynamic systems of spacecraft. The following knowledge points are mainly introduced: programming language for matrix construction and basic operation statements; Matrix linear algebra operation instructions, special operator instructions, and specialized mathematical functions; Program flow control instructions and program design; Basic operation instructions for graphics and the general process of drawing graphics; Graph handles and function handles; Modeling, simulation, and analysis process of aircraft dynamic systems. Through this course, students can receive practical training in core courses such as spacecraft orbit dynamics, spacecraft attitude dynamics, long-range rocket trajectory and guidance methods, and missile flight mechanics.

default.zh: 弹性力学及有限元B课程是飞行器设计与工程类本科生的一门专业核心课，也是学生们学习后续相关专业方向课的基础。课程主要讲授理想弹性体平面问题力学分析的基本理论及基本解答，以及应用有限单元法求解弹性力学平面问题的基本理论和基本方法，重点使学生理解弹性力学及有限单元法的基本概念与基本理论，掌握应用弹性力学理论及有限单元法分析问题及解决问题的基本方法。 课程主要包括平面问题的基本理论和解答，以及用有限单元法求解弹性力学平面问题的基本理论和方法。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时作业、大作业和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Mechanics of Elastic Solids and Finite Elements Method B is a core specialty course to undergraduates of Spacecraft Design and Engineering category. It is also a knowledge foundation of following relevant specialty direction courses. The course mainly concerns basic theories and solutions of mechanic analysis of plane problems in ideal elastic body, as well as basic theories and methods of solving plane problems of elastic mechanics with application of Finite Element Method. The emphasis of the course is understanding of basic concepts and theories of mechanics of elasticity and Finite Element Method, as well as mastering of basic methods of problem analysis and solution with theories of elastic mechanics and Finite Element Method. The course mainly concerns basic theories and solutions of plane problem as well as basic theories and methods of solving plane problem of elastic mechanics with application of Finite Element Method. The cumulative type of examination of the course is adopted, which includes usual homework, project homework and final exam.

default.zh: “导弹制导控制系统设计B”是哈尔滨工业大学航天学院航天工程系开设的一门航天类专业技术基础课，是面向飞行器设计与工程专业高年级本科生开设的一门专业必修课，其教学任务是使学生掌握导弹的基本概念、系统组成、制导控制系统的基本原理，掌握导弹制导系统原理、自寻的制导系统、遥控制导系统、自主制导系统等制导体制及对应制导律，掌握导弹的控制模型、两回路、三回路等经典控制系统设计方法。了解目前导弹制导控制技术发展的趋势。
default.en: " Guidance and Control System Design of Missile B"is a fundamental course in aerospace engineering offered by the Aerospace Engineering Department of Harbin Institute of Technology. It is a compulsory course for senior undergraduate students majoring in aircraft design and engineering. Its teaching task is to enable students to grasp the basic concepts, system composition, and basic principles of guidance and control systems of missiles, master the principles of missile guidance systems, self-seeking guidance systems, remote control guidance systems, autonomous guidance systems, and corresponding guidance laws, and master the control models, two loop, three loop and other classic control system design methods of missiles. Understand the current trends in missile guidance and control technology development.

default.zh: 可靠性工程是介于技术和管理科学之间的一门边缘学科，具有技术与管理的双重性。本课程主要是介绍在进行系统设计、分析、可靠性管理和维护等工作时所必备的可靠性理论知识。它包括可靠性的数学基础理论，系统可靠性模型建立与分析，故障模式影响及危害度分析和故障树分析（FMEA、FMECA、FTA），系统可靠性指标论证与确定，可靠性指标预计，分配及可靠性设计和评估等方面的内容。具体方法包括最小割集法、最小路集法、枚举法，冗余设计，机械系统可靠性设计，潜在通路分析等。本课程的宗旨是为初学者启蒙和为应用者打下基础，因此课程以基本概念为主，以应用为目的，通过介绍概念及推导引出应用公式，并给出详细计算步骤。
default.en: Reliability engineering is a range of technology and management science between the edge of a discipline, with the dual nature of technology and management. This course is mainly introduced during system design, analysis, reliability management and maintenance work necessary for the reliability of theoretical knowledge. It includes the mathematical basis of reliability theory, system reliability modeling and analysis, Failure Mode Effect and Criticality Analysis and Fault Tree Analysis (FMEA, FMECA, FTA), Demonstration and Determination of system reliability parameters, Forecasting and Assigning of system reliability parameters, reliability design and evaluation etc. Specific methods include the minimal cut set method, minimal path sets method, enumeration, redundant design, mechanical system reliability design, the potential pathway analysis etc. The purpose of this course is to enlighten the beginners and lay the foundation for the application. So the concepts are basic and application is the purpose for the course. The application formulas are drawn off through the introduction of concepst and the derivation, and the detailed calculation steps are given.

default.zh: 本课程是面向控制专业本科生的介绍性课程，目的是通过课程讲授和教学演示，使学生对飞航技术有初步的了解认识，促使学生了解飞航技术的历史沿袭、熟悉当前应用、把握未来发展方向。课程主要内容包括：飞航装备发展、装备需求与体系设计、制导控制技术、精确制导技术、智能协同技术、复杂系统仿真技术等
default.en: As an introduction course to the students who major in Control Science and Engineering, its main aim is to provide students with a basic understanding of aeronautics technology through lectures and demonstrations. The course aims to encourage students to learn about the historical evolution of aeronautics technology, familiarize themselves with current applications, and grasp the direction of future development. The main content of the course includes: the development of aeronautics equipment, equipment requirements and system design, guidance and control technology, precise guidance technology, intelligent cooperative technology, complex system simulation technology.

default.zh: 《无人集群系统智能决策与控制》课程聚焦于人工智能在无人集群系统自主协同决策与控制中的技术原理、应用与发展。课程分为理论与实验两部分。理论课程内容涵盖智能无人集群与群智涌现、集群智能分布式决策、智能协同感知与认知推理、智能任务规划与协同控制等核心内容。实验部分，学生将通过仿真与真实无人系统实验智能算法在无人集群系统的应用。通过理论与实践相结合，学生将学习如何设计并优化无人集群系统，以应对复杂环境下的协同任务需求，为未来智能无人集群系统的研发与应用奠定基础。
default.en: The course "Intelligent Decision-Making and Control for Unmanned Swarm Systems" focuses on the technical principles, applications, and development of artificial intelligence in autonomous collaborative decision-making and control for unmanned swarm systems. The course is divided into theoretical and experimental sections. The theoretical part covers core topics such as intelligent unmanned swarms and emergent swarm intelligence, distributed decision-making for swarm intelligence, intelligent collaborative perception and cognitive reasoning, and intelligent task planning and coordinated control. In the experimental section, students will apply intelligent algorithms to unmanned swarm systems through simulations and real-world unmanned system experiments. By integrating theory with practice, students will learn how to design and optimize unmanned swarm systems to meet the demands of collaborative tasks in complex environments, laying a solid foundation for the research and application of future intelligent unmanned swarm systems.

default.zh: 航天器结构健康监测是面向“飞行器设计与工程类”和“飞行器环境与生命保障工程类”本科生的专业选修课。随着人类航天事业的发展，日益恶化的空间碎片对航天器结构健康状态造成巨大了威胁，越来越受到关注。本课程紧密贴合当前智能监测热点，重点关注复杂航天器结构健康状态在线感知、监测、主动诊断等核心技术内涵、实现方法以及实例化应用。课程的主要任务是帮助学生了解和掌握航天器结构健康监测的需求、基本理论和技术原理、国内外最新研究成果、工程应用现状及所面临的挑战等内容，从而为学生开展研究工作打下基础。
default.en: Structural health monitoring of spacecraft is an optional course for undergraduate students of "Aircraft Design and Engineering" and "Aircraft Environment and Life Support Engineering". With the development of space industry, the deteriorating space debris poses a great threat to the spacecraft structure, which attracts more and more attention. This course is closely aligned with the current intelligent monitoring hotspot, focusing on the core technologies, implementation methods and practical applications of the online perception, monitoring and active diagnosis of the health state of complex spacecraft structures. The main task of this course is to help students understand and master the needs, basic theories and technical principles, the latest research results, and the engineering application status and challenges of the structural health monitoring of spacecraft, so as to lay a foundation for students to carry out research work.

default.zh: 《飞行器结构强度分析》是飞行器设计与工程、飞行器环境与生命保障工程、空间科学与技术专业本科生的一门专业课程，通过本课程的学习，使学生初步了解飞行器结构强度的设计原理和分析方法，在内容上兼顾飞行器结构的特殊性与机械结构的一般性，重点掌握飞行器结构对载荷和环境条件的响应及其分析方法，包括静强度分析、动强度分析、疲劳与断裂分析等。使学生树立正确的工程结构强度设计思想，培养学生对所学理论的综合运用能力，为学生进一步从事飞行器设计工作打下基础。
default.en: Structure Strength Analysis of Spacecraft is a specialized course for undergraduate students majoring in Aircraft Design and Engineering, Aircraft Environment and Life Support Engineering, Space Science and Technology. This course has a simple object to provide an insight into related knowledge regarding design theory and analysis method of spacecraft structure strength, including particularity of spacecraft and universality of mechanism. This course focuses on elucidating the effects of load and environment on spacecraft structure and analysis method of strength, including statics strength analysis, dynamics strength analysis, fatigue and fracture mechanics analysis. It is an important course to form the design idea of structure. This course emphasizes the combination of physics theory with practical applications. It can be used for some practical purpose including spacecraft and weapon design.

default.zh: “量子力学”是为电子科学与技术专业本科生开设的专业基础课，共40学时。 该课程采用从物理问题引入入手，由浅入深引入物理思想、物理方法及建立物理模型的讲授方法，依次向学生讲授：（1）波函数和薛定谔方程（2）一维定态问题（3）力学量用算符表达与表象变换（4）中心力场（5）粒子在电磁场中的运动（6）微扰理论（7）散射（8）自旋与全同粒子等内容。使学生掌握量子力学的基本理论与基本方法，为今后在近代光学、微电子、光电子等后续的专业课程及进一步的学习和今后的实际工作奠定一定的理论基础。 通过讲授课程，引导学生学会如何解决问题和处理问题，提高分析和解决实际物理问题的能力。同时，让学生从对一些自然现象的观察，了解怎样发现和建立新的理论。
default.en: “Quantum Mechanics ” is the profession foundation course that sets up for the professional undergraduate students in Science and Technology of Electronics, totally 40 learning-hours. This course, beginning with the basic physical problems, leads into the physics thoughts, physics methods and establishes the physics model step by step. The main contents are:(1) wave function and Schrodinger equation; (2)one-dimensional stationary state problems; (3)observables expressed as operators and the transformation of representation;(4)central field ;(5)particles in electromagnetic field;(6)perturbation theory ;(7)scattering; (8)spin and identical particles, etc. The basic theories can make the students master the basic methods of quantum mechanics, and set up a theoretic base for the following professional courses in modern-optics, micro-electronics, optoelectronics, etc. After the course, the students will be led how to solve problems, how to improve its ability to analysis the physics problems.

default.zh: 本课程主要阐释宏观电磁场理论。首先，该课程分析电学与磁学的各个实验定律，总结出电磁场的普遍规律，建立麦克斯韦方程组、电磁场需满足的边界条件以及洛伦兹力公式；接着针对恒定电磁场问题说明恒定场的基本性质和求解电场和磁场问题的一些基本方法（主要为三种：分离变量求解拉普拉斯方程，镜像法和格林函数方法）；然后，重点讨论电磁波的传播和辐射，包括自由空间的电磁波的性质、界面上的反射折射以及金属中的电测波的传播问题，在介绍金属波导和谐振腔之后进一步拓展至光波导和等离子体的概念；介绍一般情况下势的概念、势满足方程和解的形式，介绍辐射电磁场的计算，以及电磁波衍射的计算方法。
default.en: This course focuses on the theory of macro electromagnetic field. Firstly, the course analyses the various experimental law of electricity and magnetism, summarizes the general law of the electromagnetic field, establishes the Maxwell equations, boundary conditions for electromagnetic fields and the Lorenz force formula; next, for the constant electromagnetic field problem, some basic methods that constant field and basic properties for electric field and magnetic field problems(mainly three kinds: separation solution Laplasse equation, variable mirror method and Green function method); then discusses the propagation of electromagnetic waves and radiation, including the properties of electromagnetic waves existing in the free space, reflection and refraction on the interface, and the problem of electromagnetic wave propagation in metal, the concept of optical wave-guides and plasma ex-citations are given after the introduction of metal wave-guide and resonant cavity; introduces the concept of the general situation, the form of potential and the form of the equation, presents the calculation of radiated electromagnetic fields and calculation method of electromagnetic wave diffraction.

default.zh: 导波光学与集成光学是以经典电磁波理论为基础，研究光和光信号在各类介质光波导中传播特性；在光电子学和微电子学基础上，采用集成方法研究和发展光学器件和混合光学-电子学器件系统的一门学科。随着集成光路技术的发展，尤其是光通讯、光学信息处理和光传感等领域的广泛应用，使这门学科的内容愈来愈丰富。本课程主要内容有：介质光波导的电磁波理论、射线光学理论和模式的概念；平面光波导、矩形介质波导和圆光波导中光的传播特性；光波导的耦合模理论及耦合器件；晶体在外场作用下的光学性质；集成光无源和有源器件；集成光学与纳米光子学。
default.en: Waveguide optics and integrated optics is a discipline that studies the propagation characteristics of light and optical signals in various dielectric optical waveguides based on classical electromagnetic wave theory; and uses integrated methods to research and develop optical devices and hybrid optoelectronic device systems based on optoelectronics and microelectronics. With the development of integrated optical circuit technology, especially the widespread application in fields such as optical communication, optical information processing, and optical sensing, the content of this discipline has become more and more abundant. The main content of this course includes: electromagnetic wave theory of dielectric optical waveguides, ray optics theory, and the concept of modes; The propagation characteristics of light in planar optical waveguides, rectangular dielectric waveguides, and circular optical waveguides; Mode coupling theory and coupling devices of optical waveguides; The optical properties of crystals under external field action; Integrated optical passive and active devices; Integrated optics and nanophotonics.

default.zh: 《实验设计与数据处理》是一门重要的专业课。它利用数理统计的原理和方法解决实际生产过程的问题。它不仅提供如何正确地设计科学实验和收集数据的方法，而且也提供如何正确地整理、分析数据，得出客观、科学的结论的方法。本课程任务使学生能够掌握常用的实验设计原理及设计方法、实验结果的统计分析方法，了解常用的数理统计软件。通过该门课程的学习，可以掌握基本的实验（调查）设计和统计分析方法，为学生毕业论文以及将来从事科研工作打基础，支撑人才培养规格中设计实验、数据分析要求的实现。
default.en: The course ‘Experimental Design and Data Processing’ is an important course that uses principles and methods of mathematical statistics to solve practical problems in production processes. It not only provides methods for designing scientific experiments and collecting data correctly, but also provides methods for organizing and analyzing data correctly to draw objective and scientific conclusions. The task of this course is to enable students to master commonly used principles and methods of experimental design, statistical analysis of experimental results, and familiarize themselves with commonly used mathematical statistical software. Through this course, students can master the basic methods of experimental (survey) design and statistical analysis, which will lay the foundation for their graduation thesis and future research work, and support the implementation of design experiment and data analysis requirements in the talent training specifications.

default.zh: 光纤传感技术与应用是一门专业选修课。光纤传感技术是随着现代光纤技术的成熟而发展起来的传感技术中的一个新领域。和常规传感器相比，光纤传感器具有许多独特的优点，因此在短短几十年内，光纤传感技术迅速发展并在众多领域得到了广泛应用。本课程旨在向学生介绍光纤传感器的基本原理、构成及其应用。通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握光纤传感技术基础、常用的光纤传感器件基础、主要光纤传感技术原理和前沿发展，以及光纤传感技术的主要应用。
default.en: Optical fiber sensor technology and applications is a professional elective course. Optical fiber sensor technology is a new area of the developed sensor technology with modern optical fiber technology matures. Thanks to many unique advantages compared with conventional sensors, optical fiber sensor technology has been developed rapidly in the past a few decades, and has been finding applications in many fields. This course aims to introduce the basic principles, compositions and applications of optical fiber sensors to students. Through the study of this course, students will be able to master the basics of fiber optic sensing technologies, commonly used fiber optic sensor components, main principles and cutting-edge developments of fiber optic sensing technologies, as well as the main applications of fiber optic sensing technologies.

default.zh: 激光成像雷达是国内正在逐渐发展的一项新光电成像技术，其图像处理技术是新兴研究领域。本课程面向电子科学与技术学科的本科生，主要介绍激光成像雷达体制分类及成像基本原理，图像噪声产生的成因及噪声抑制算法，目标检测提取算法和像素级信息融合算法。本课程将理论联系实际，介绍和分析这一领域的最新研究动态和实验结果，对本科生理解和掌握光电成像技术是有积极意义的。
default.en: The laser radar is a new electro-optical imaging technology which is progressive development in domestic, so its image processing is a new emerging research field. The course is face to the undergraduate which is belonged to the subject of electronic science and technology. The course is include the system of laser radar and its imaging theory, the origin causing the image noise and its algorithm of suppressing noise, the algorithm of target detecting and extracting, and the algorithm of pixel-level information fusion. The characteristic of the course is theory with practice, and the newest research trend and experiment results are introduced and analyzed. So course has the positive significance to the undergraduates on understanding and mastering the electron-optical imaging.

default.zh: 激光成像技术是一种主动式成像技术。它通过主动发射激光脉冲，利用探测目标的反射特性，对其产生的激光回波信号进行采集和分析，用来获取目标的三维几何图像。与被动成像系统相比，激光成像系统具有高的空间分辨率和时间分辨率，在激光制导、激光测绘、激光跟踪、复杂环境感知等领域有着非常广阔的应用前景。
default.en: Laser imaging technique is an active imaging technology. Through the active emission of the laser pulse and the use of reflection characteristic of the probe target, the three-dimensional geometry image by collecting and analyzing the generated laser echo signal are introduced. Compared with the passive imaging system, the laser imaging system has a high spatial resolution and time resolution, it also has a very broad application prospects in the field of laser-guided, laser mapping, laser tracking and complex environment perception.

default.zh: 激光遥感技术是一种主动式远距离探测和监测自然环境变化的前沿技术。它通过主动发射激光脉冲，与大气、海洋或具有固定几何形状的物质相互作用，利用其吸收、散射或反射等光学特性，对光学回波信号进行采集和分析，用来测量大气、海洋或固定目标的三维分布 、污染物的传播和扩散、中小尺度大气矢量风场等气象数据。激光遥感系统具有高的空间分辨率和时间分辨率，是气象监测和大气化学和大气物理参数变化监测的强有力的新概念技术手段，也是现有微波、红外、GPS等现代遥感技术发展中孕育成长的新方向和新技术。 课程将以简洁的方式讲述激光遥感技术的基础理论知识，包括激光与物质作用过程、激光大气传输特性、激光雷达组成和激光雷达方程；激光测距雷达基本原理及典型应用；多普勒效应及风速测量基本原理、直接和间接多普勒测风激光雷达；差分吸收效应及激光雷达方程、在气体探测领域的典型应用及发展趋势；拉曼散射效应、拉曼散射激光雷达方程、典型实例分析与发展趋势。
default.en: Laser remote sensing, a forefront technology for active long-range detection and monitoring the changes of the natural environment, is mainly refer to that by transmitting laser pulses actively which will interacted with atmospheric air, oceans or some substances with fixed shapes, and taking the advantage of the optical characteristics of absorption, scattering or reflection, after collecting and analyzing optical signal arising from that, the meteorological data will be obtained, including the 3D distributions of the atmosphere, oceans or fixed targets, the propagation and diffusion of pollutions, the atmospheric vector wind field with small or medium scale, etc. With the high spatial resolution and high temporal resolution, laser remote sensing system is not only a powerful new concept instrument for monitoring the atmosphere air, measuring the chemical and physical parameters changes of the atmosphere, but also a new direction and new technology growing up in the development of modern remote technologies which includes the existing microwave, infrared radiation, GPS and so on. This course describes the basic theoretical knowledge of laser remote sensing technology. It covers the interaction process of laser and matter, laser atmospheric transmission characteristics, lidar composition and lidar equations. Typical lidar systems are introduced briefly including laser ranging radars, wind lidar, differential absorption lidar (DIAL), and Raman lidar.

default.zh: “红外技术”是光电子学的重要组成部分，属于光学的应用分支。红外技术是一门培养学生掌握红外基本理论和相关的红外探测技术的应用基础课。本课程主要研究红外辐射发射、吸收、传输的一般原理与探测方法，阐述红外探测仪器的基本概念、组成、工作原理及一般实验设计方法，其主要内容：红外辐射的基本概念，黑体和普朗克公式；红外辐射在大气中的传输；红外探测器的分类、噪声和性能参数，热探测器与光子探测器，检测微弱信号的方法；热成像系统，辐射计，红外光谱仪，红外无损检测。
default.en: Infrared Technology is an important component of optoelectronics，a branch of optics, and a basic course for students to master basic infrared theories and applications of corresponding infrared detecting technology. The course mainly studies the common principles and detecting methods of infrared emanation, absorbability, transmission, and expatiates on the basic concepts, composition, principles and the common experimental methods. Its main contents are black radiation, Planck formula; various infrared radiation source; transmission of infrared radiation in atmosphere; the infrared detectors’ classification, noise, performance parameters; thermal detectors and photon detectors; the methods of weak signal detection; thermal imaging system, radiometer; infrared spectral analyzer; and infrared lossless detection.

default.zh: “光电子信息技术”课程共24学时，详细介绍了光信息的采集和显示技术、光信息的传输技术、光信息的存储技术、光信息的加工及其处理技术、以及光学的图像识别技术。课程采用讲述基本原理和介绍基本技术的主要应用背景的方法，让学生了解光电子信息的采集、显示、传输、存储技术以及光学处理技术。 通过对本课程的学习，可以让学生了解光电子技术在信息领域的一些应用及最新进展情况，掌握光电子信息技术的基本原理和主要技术，为今后在实际中应用打下基础。
default.en: The "Optoelectronic Information Technology" course has a total of 24 hours, which details the acquisition and display technology of optical information, optical information transmission technology, optical information storage technology, optical information processing and processing technology, as well as optical image recognition technology. The course describes the basic principles and introduces the main application background of the basic technology so that students can understand the collection, display, transmission, storage technology, and optical processing technology of optoelectronic information. Through the study of this course, students can understand some applications of optoelectronic technology in the field of information and the latest progress, master the basic principles and main technologies of optoelectronic information technology, and lay a foundation for future practical application.

default.zh: 本课程讲述光电显示技术的基本原理、各种显示器件的驱动方法、相应的电路技术及特性。介绍了光电显示技术及其在各领域的应用，对现有的光电显示技术进行了全面的讲解和比较。主要内容有：绪论；视觉特性与光度学、色度学原理；显示系统的要求与图象质量评价；真空阴极射线管显示技术；液晶显示；等离子体显示；电致发光与有机电致发光显示；发光二极管显示；激光显示；投影显示等。
default.en: In this course，we will teach the principle of optoelectronic display, the drive methods for series of display device, relevant circuit technology and characteristics. In addition, we will introduce the applications of optoelectronic display technology in various fields and make a system comparison for all kinds of the display technology. Main content: introduction, visual characteristics and photometry, principle of chromaticity; index for display system and evaluation of image quality; vacuum cathode ray tube display technology; LCD; plasma display; electroluminescent and organic electroluminescent display; light emitting diode display; laser display; projection display etc.

default.zh: 光谱作为信息载体，已经在军事、工业、生活和医疗等各领域中得到越来越广泛的应用。光谱测量技术及应用课程是电子科学与技术、光电信息科学与工程专业非常重要的专业选修课，知识点涵盖基础光学、原子物理学、非线性光学、激光原理等学科领域。本课程主要讲授激光光谱学基本原理、基本知识与方法，使学生了解光谱测量技术与应用方向，使本科生掌握光谱学及测量基本知识及起步相关专业方向研究奠定扎实基础，是一门应用广泛、前沿性强的课程。通过本课程的课堂教学，使学生了解激光光谱测量技术的基本原理和技术特点，掌握典型的激光光谱测量技术，初步具备光谱测量技术的应用能力，增强创新意识，具备光谱测量技术的应用能力。
default.en: As a carrier of information, spectroscopy has been increasingly applied in various fields such as the military, industry, daily life, and medical science. Spectroscopic measurement technology and its applications course is an important elective course for the majors of electronic science and technology, optoelectronic information science, and engineering, covering the knowledge of fundamental optics, atomic physics, nonlinear optics, laser principles, and other related subjects. This course mainly teaches the basic principles, knowledge, and methods of laser spectroscopy, enabling students to understand the direction and application of spectroscopic measurement technology and laying a solid foundation for related professional research directions. It is a widely applicable and cutting-edge course. Through the classroom teaching of this course, students can understand the basic principles and technical characteristics of laser spectroscopic measurement technology, master typical laser spectroscopic measurement technology, have preliminary application ability of spectroscopic measurement technology, enhance innovation consciousness, and possess the application ability of spectroscopic measurement technology.

default.zh: 本课程为一门专业课，通过对该课程的学习，学生可以掌握光通信技术的基本原理和方法，提高学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，为学生今后的学习和研究奠定一定的理论基础。课程的主要内容包括光通信技术的发展，光纤通信系统的基本原理、关键技术、关键器件；卫星光通信系统的基本原理、卫星光通信光信号的发射与接收技术，卫星光通信系统主要参量分析，及卫星光通信中信号的瞄准、捕获和跟踪技术。本课程教学以讲课为主，配合讨论的方式教学。讲课形式采取PPT与板书相结合，教师讲授与学生讨论相结合的形式。讲课重点在于介绍光通信技术领域的基本知识和前沿进展。
default.en: This course is a specialized course. Through studying this course, students can master the basic principles and methods of optical communication technology, improve their problem analysis and problem-solving abilities, and lay a certain theoretical foundation for their future learning and research. The main content of the course includes the development of optical communication technology, the basic principles, key technologies, and key devices of optical fiber communication systems, the basic principles of satellite optical communication systems, the transmission and reception techniques of satellite optical communication optical signals, the main parameter analysis of satellite optical communication systems, and the signal pointing, acquisition, and tracking techniques in satellite optical communication. The teaching of this course is mainly lecture-based, supplemented by discussion. The lecture format combines PowerPoint presentations and blackboard writing, and the teaching involves a combination of teacher-led instruction and student discussion. The emphasis of the lecture is on introducing basic knowledge and cutting-edge advancements in the field of optical communication technology.

default.zh: 本课在复习光电转换原理与传感器技术、成像原理与焦平面器件应用技术和几何光学与典型光学系统结构的基础上，介绍空间光电仪器或系统的概念及用途，成像类、光谱类、通信类空间光电仪器或系统的原理，空间光电对抗技术的原理及相应的空间环境防护、可靠性等知识，并介绍空间光电技术的未来发展，为下阶段理论及应用课程提供支持。
default.en: This course’s foundations are photo-electronics and instrumental optics. The typical optics structure and space photo-electronics system will be introduced. As the samples, the principle and structures of space image optics system, space optical spectrum system and space optical communication system will be discussed. For the knowledge support, the space environment and protection and reliability also will be introduced.

default.zh: 光信息处理是应用光学、计算机和信息科学相结合而发展起来的一门新的光学技术，是信息科学的一个重要组成部分，也是现代光学的核心之一，是也光电子专业学生的必修专业课程。主要学习光学系统的二维线性系统分析法、标量衍射理论、光学全息理论与应用、计算全息及其深远意义、空间滤波器的频谱分析法及其典型应用、相干光学处理的概念和主要方法及其主要特征、非相干光学处理的概念和主要方法及其主要特征。通过该课程的学习，学生可以掌握如何将数学中的傅里叶分析方法和通信领域中的线性系统理论引入到光学信息的处理过程中，通过这些内容的学习，使学生初步掌握用“频域分析”的方法处理光学信息的传递和变换等，为其在近现代光电子信息处理技术方面的进一步学习奠定一定的理论和应用基础，并可以使本科生初步掌握应用以往学过的理论解决实际问题的方法。
default.en: Optical Information Processing is a new optical technology, which is developed by the combination of applied optics, computer science and information science. Information Optics is not only an important portion of information science, but also the key of modern optics. It is one of the required courses for the students majoring in Physical Electronics. The main contents are as follows: two-dimensional linear system analysis, scalar diffraction theory, optical holography theory and application, computing holography and its significance, spectrum analysis for space filter and its typical application, notion for coherent optical processing and its main method and characteristics and the notion for non-coherent optical processing and its main method and characteristics. Through the study of this course, students can master how to introduce Fourier analysis methods in mathematics and linear system theory in the field of communication into the processing of optical information. Through the learning of these contents, students can preliminarily master the use of "frequency domain analysis" methods to process the transmission and transformation of optical information, laying a certain theoretical and application foundation for their further learning in modern optoelectronic information processing technology, And it can enable undergraduate students to preliminarily master the methods of applying previously learned theories to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 光电信号检测与处理课程为一门主要专业方向课程，是从事光学工程、仪器仪表、测量与控制研究人员所必须具备的专业基础，是一门与现代科学技术紧密相连的正在发展的新兴学科。 本课程主要讲述光电检测理论基础知识以及光电检测的结构组成、设计思路和应用特点。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解和掌握光电转换的基本原理及光电检测技术所必须的各种知识，了解和掌握常用光电测量方法及常用测量仪器的使用，具备进行各种基本光电测量所需技能和设计光电检测电路的能力。 本门课程在注重信号处理基本理论的阐述，结合现代光电信号的相关新概念和前沿课题；注重启发式教学，形成师生间的互动；注重课程内容的系统性、综合性，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: The Detecting and processing of Photoelectric signal course is a professional course, and it is also a professional basic course of the researchers who engage in optical engineering, instrumentation, measurement and control. In addition, it is a developing new subject close relationship with modern science and technology. This course introduces the basic knowledge and theory of the photoelectric detection structure of photoelectric detection component, design idea and application characteristics. Through this course, the students will understand and grasp the basic principle of photoelectric conversion and all the necessary knowledge of photoelectric detection technology, they also will understand and master the commonly used photoelectric measuring method and common measuring instrument. Finally, they will have all the basic skills required to design and measurement of photoelectric detection circuit. This course focuses on explaining the basic theory in signal processing, combined with the new concept of modern photoelectric signal and frontier topics; the heuristic education way will be emphasized for interaction between teachers and students; , students' comprehensive ability should be analyzed and solve problems by the system characteristics of curriculum content.

default.zh: 课程以固体激光放大和传输系统为脉络，以丰富的单元级、系统级工程技术案例为依托，引导电子科学与技术、光电信息科学与工程等专业高年级本科生将以往所学专业基础知识进行一次综合交叉的实践演练。课程探讨在固体激光系统的设计、研制和运行过程中，所要面临的典型工程问题和所需掌握的基本技术方法。通过对当前主流固体激光放大和传输系统中的关键技术原理及其工程实现形式的学习，引导学生建立对实际工程问题的思考判断能力和分析解决能力，深化对专业知识的理解和掌握，同时拓宽专业视野，提升专业知识的综合运用能力。 课程分为课堂授课和实验室实操两部分。授课部分对固体激光工程以系统技术和单元技术分层次进行介绍，使学生了解其基本原理、关键要素和工程实施手段，了解该领域国际前沿技术动向。所有关键知识点均以实际工程案例相配合进行讲解。实验部分包括哈尔滨工业大学百焦耳级大型钕玻璃激光装置的现场讨论，基于该装置完成对各种关键技术原理的认知实践；还包括几组有代表性的单元实验，培养学生将来从事复杂激光系统调试的动手能力。
default.en: The course takes the solid-state laser amplification and transmission system as its framework, with a wealth of unit-level and system-level engineering technology case studies as support, guiding senior undergraduate students in electronic science and technology, optoelectronic information science and engineering and other related majors to conduct a comprehensive cross-disciplinary practical exercise with their previous professional foundation knowledge. The course explores the typical engineering problems faced in the design, development and operation of solid-state laser systems, and the basic technical methods required to address these problems. Through the study of the key technology principles and engineering implementation forms of the current mainstream solid-state laser amplification and transmission systems, the course guides students to develop their ability to think and judge about actual engineering problems and their ability to analyze and solve them, deepen their understanding and mastery of professional knowledge, and broaden their professional horizons, thereby enhancing their ability to apply their professional knowledge comprehensively. The course consists of classroom lectures and laboratory practicals. The lecture part provides an in-depth introduction to solid-state laser engineering, dividing it into system and unit technologies in a hierarchical manner, enabling students to understand its basic principles, key elements, and engineering implementation methods, and to keep abreast of the latest international trends in the field. All key knowledge points are illustrated with practical engineering case studies. The practical part includes a field discussion of the 100-joule-level large neodymium glass laser device at Harbin Institute of Technology, where students complete cognitive practice on various key technology principles based on the device; it also includes several representative unit experiments to cultivate students' hands-on ability for the future operation of complex laser systems.

default.zh: “半导体激光器及应用”为电子科学与技术专业的一门专业课，课程分两大部分，第一部分介绍半导体激光器基本原理、器件基本结构的知识，第二部分介绍半导体激光器的应用。课程主要内容包括半导体激光器的物理基础、半导体激光器的基本结构、半导体激光器的主要性能、半导体激光器在光纤通信中的应用、可见光半导体激光器及其应用、大功率半导体激光器及其应用、半导体激光器的安全使用及电源。 通过学习该课程，能够对半导体激光器的工作原理、性能和发展动向有所了解，能够掌握半导体激光器在各个领域的应用原理以及根据实际应用对半导体激光器的性能要求进行设计。
default.en: Semiconductor-Laser and its Applications is a professional course of electronic science and technology. The course is composed of two parts: one is about the basic principle of semiconductor-laser and the details of laser configuration; the other is about the applications of semiconductor-laser. The main contents of this course are: the basic physics of semiconductor-laser, the basic structure of semiconductor-laser, the main performance of semiconductor-laser, the applications of semiconductor-laser in optical fiber communication, visible semiconductor-laser and its applications, high power semiconductor-laser and its applications, optical output coupling technology of semiconductor-laser. After this course, one can not only learn the theory, the performance and the developing trends of semiconductor-laser, but also understands the applications of semiconductor-laser in every field and its performance demand for actual applications.

default.zh: 中红外光谱范围一般为2-20微米，是分子指纹区，大气透射窗口，热辐射区，以及水、聚合物等材料的高吸收区。中红外激光在痕迹量气体检测、大飞机复合材料构件无损超声检测、人眼安全激光测风雷达、激光生物医疗及光电对抗等方面有重要应用。本课程是对《激光技术》等专业核心课程的进一步拓展，是光电子专业理论知识指导新波段激光器件设计的一个典型范例；同时也是第三学年夏季学期《中红外激光技术实践》课程的延伸，是先有相关器件的感官和先验知识，后进行深入探讨，并针对具体应用进行再设计的学习过程。对激光器件的设计和制备者来说，通常是材料决定器件性能。中红外激光材料种类繁多，如何选择合适的激光材料，结合合理的谐振腔型设计以实现高性能激光输出，是新波段激光器设计和制备面临的重要问题。本课程首先概述了中红外谱区特性，中红外激光材料、器件发展和应用情况，课程主体先介绍了晶体对称性、单晶生长及光波在晶体中传播特性，重点讲解掺铥、掺钬2微米固体和光纤激光材料、器件及应用， 和3~5微米非线性光学波长转换器件的基本原理。
default.en: The mid-infrared spectral range is generally 2-20 microns, which is the molecular fingerprint region, the atmospheric transmission window, the thermal radiation region, and the high-absorption region of materials such as water and polymers. Mid-infrared lasers have important applications in trace gas detection, non-destructive ultrasonic testing of composite components of large aircraft, laser wind radar for human eye safety, laser biomedical treatment and countermeasures. This course is a further expansion of the basic courses such as "Laser Technology", and is a typical example of the theoretical knowledge of optoelectronics to guide the design of novel laser devices. At the same time, it is also an extension of the "Mid-infrared Laser Technology Practice" course in the summer semester of the third year, which is a learning process that first has the sensory and prior knowledge of the relevant devices, and then conducts in-depth discussions and redesigns for specific applications. For designers and fabricators of laser devices, it is often the material that determines the device performance. There are many kinds of mid-infrared laser materials, and how to select the appropriate materials and combine the reasonably designed resonant cavity type to achieve high-performance laser output is an important problem in the design and preparation of new band lasers. The course first summarizes the characteristics of the mid-infrared spectral region, the development and application of mid-infrared laser materials and devices, and the main body of the course first introduces the crystal symmetry, single crystal growth and light wave propagation characteristics in the crystal, focusing on the materials, devices and applications of thulium-doped, holmium-doped 2 micron solids and fiber lasers, and learns the light-wave coupling equation in nonlinear optical crystals and the basic principles of 3~5 micron wavelength-conversion devices.

default.zh: 物理光学是电子科学与技术专业的一门重要的专业基础课，具有承前启后的作用，是学习后续专业课的基础，也是今后从事科研不可缺少的基础。通过该课程的学习将使学生掌握物理光学的基本知识，掌握分析问题的基本方法，培养学生运用光学知识解决后续课程以及以后工作中所遇有关问题的能力。 本门课程的教学内容前一部分讨论光的传播，以经典光学为主线，以光的电磁理论为基础，着重讲授光在各向同性介质、各向异性介质中的传播规律以及光的干涉、衍射、偏振特性。后一部分讨论光与物质的相互作用，包括晶体的感应双折射，光的吸收、色散和散射。 本门课程在注重物理思想的阐述的同时，适当引入现代光学的有关新概念和前沿课题，如激光原理，傅立叶光学基础等；注重启发式教学，形成师生间的互动；注重课程内容的系统性、综合性，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Physical Optics as an important fundamental and specialized course holds an important position for students majoring in Electronic Science and Technology. It is a link between the previous and follow-up courses. Therefore, it becomes a necessary base for the students to learn later specialized courses and engage in future scientific researches. After the course, the students will master the basic ways of analyzing problems and gain the ability of solving the problems that may be encountered in later courses and research work. The main contents of this course fall into two parts. The first part, based on the electromagnetism theory of optics, is to discuss the propagation of optics, it puts much emphasis on the optical propagation law through isotropy medium and anisotropism medium and the optical characteristics of interference, diffraction and polarization. The second part is to discuss the interaction between optics and substances, including induction double refraction, absorption, dispersion and scattering of the optics. It will pay much attention to the interpretation of physical ideas and the introduction of new concepts and front projects of modern optics, such as the principle of laser, the basis of Fourier Optics and so on. In addition, the heuristic education way will be emphasized so as to foster the students’ ability of analyzing and solving problems.

default.zh: 量子电子学导论课程是光电工程大类专业本科生基础课，为学生后续开展光电子器件、激光及激光应用技术等各类专业课的学习提供必要的基础知识，为建立分析微观物理问题的基本思维方法奠定基础。课程以科学原子模型的探索进程为主线，介绍近现代物理学及相关理论体系的重大发展飞跃，讨论原子中电子运动的基本特征和重要规律及其对原子能态、光谱现象的决定关系，并以原子物理为载体阐述量子力学基本概念，建立运用量子理论处理微观物理问题的基本思维范式和方法，掌握量子力学求解的氢原子模型基本特征和规律；同时，掌握电子自旋与轨道角动量耦合等重要概念以及能级精细结构、光谱跃迁等机制。
default.en: Introduction to Quantum Electronics is a basic course for undergraduates majoring in optoelectronic engineering. It provides necessary basic knowledge for students to carry out the subsequent study of various professional courses such as optoelectronic devices, laser and laser application technology, and lays a foundation for the establishment of basic thinking methods for analyzing microphysical problems. The course focuses on the exploration process of scientific atomic model, introduces the major development leap of modern physics and related theoretical systems, discusses the basic characteristics and important laws of electron motion in atoms and their determining relations to atomic energy states and spectral phenomena, and expounds the basic concepts of quantum mechanics with atomic physics as the carrier. Establish the basic thinking paradigm and method of applying quantum theory to deal with microphysical problems, and master the basic characteristics and laws of the hydrogen atom model solved by quantum mechanics; At the same time, the important concepts such as the coupling of electron spin and orbital angular momentum, as well as the mechanism of energy level fine structure and spectral transition are mastered.

default.zh: 本课程包含热力学和统计物理两大部分，为研究热运动提供了理论方法。其中热力学部分包括热力学的基本规律、均匀物质的热力学性质、单元系的相变等三部分，重点在于介绍热力学的基本概念以及利用热力学处理问题的方式方法。统计物理部分包括近独立粒子系统的概率分布，玻尔兹曼统计，玻色统计和费米统计，系综理论等，介绍了统计物理的基本思想和概念，以及用统计物理解决问题的方法。热力学和统计物理是本课程的两条主线，既相互独立，又相互联系，在处理热力学问题上是相辅相成的。本课程的教学目的是使学生学习关于热现象的宏观理论和微观理论；培养学生分析问题解决问题的能力。通过本课程的学习,学生能够掌握热力学和统计物理分析问题、处理问题的理论、方法, 并能应用该理论、方法解决具体系统的热力学问题。
default.en: The course, composed of thermodynamics and statistical physics, provides a method for studying thermal motion. Thermodynamics includes basic thermodynamic concepts and laws, thermodynamic characteristics of the uniform material, and department of the phase-change unit. The emphasis of Thermodynamics is to present the basic thermodynamic concepts and the ways to solve problems with thermodynamics. Statistical physics includes probability distribution, Bolrzmann distribution, Boson distribution and Fermion distribution. The basic concepts and methods of statistical physics are presented. Thermodynamics and statistical physics are the main threads of the course. They are connected with while independent from each other in solving thermodynamic problems. The purpose of this course is to provide students with macro-scopical and microcosmic theories on thermal phenomena and to cultivate students’ ability of analyzing solving problems. Through this course, students can master the theories and methods to solve the problems in specific thermodynamic systems.

default.zh: 可调谐激光是现代激光技术的重要分支。可调谐激光等特殊光源在光谱诊断、激光制造及信息处理等方面发挥着其它光源无法替代的作用。本课程是为本科生开设的专业方向选修课程，要求学生具有三年级大学物理及激光原理基础。通过本课程的学习，了解可调谐激光光源基本原理、特性及其应用。结合主讲人承担的科研项目及具体实物使学生感受以可调谐激光为代表的特殊光源技术在生产生活中的作用。从中找到相关科学技术的发展进程及研究前沿，激发其从事相关学科学习的热情。
default.en: Tunable lasers are important branches of modern laser technology. Special light sources like tunable lasers play irreplaceable roles in areas such as spectroscopic diagnostics, laser manufacturing and information processing. This course is designed as an elective course for undergraduate students and requires a foundation in third-year university physics and laser principles. Through this course, students will learn the basic principles, characteristics, and applications of tunable lasers light sources. They will also gain practical experience by exploring the role of these special light source technologies, represented by tunable lasers, in production and daily life through the instructor's research projects and tangible examples. This will help students understand the development process and research frontiers of related scientific and technological fields, igniting their passion for pursuing relevant disciplines.

default.zh: 极紫外激光是现代激光技术的重要分支。极紫外激光在光谱诊断、激光制造及激光成像等方面发挥着其它光源无法替代的作用。本课程以人工智能赋能极紫外激光技术为核心定位，聚焦同步辐射、自由电子激光、高次谐波等核心光源技术，帮助学生拓展知识领域，突破传统教学照本宣科的尴尬情景，培养跨学科创新能力，为集成电路、先进制造等领域输送高端技术人才。
default.en: Extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lasers are a vital branch of modern laser technology. They play an irreplaceable role in spectral diagnostics, laser manufacturing, laser imaging, and other fields. This course is centered on empowering EUV laser technology with artificial intelligence, focusing on core light source technologies such as synchrotron radiation, free-electron lasers, and high-harmonic generation. It aims to help students broaden their knowledge domains, break away from the rigid traditional teaching methods, cultivate interdisciplinary innovation capabilities, and nurture high-end technical talent for sectors like integrated circuits and advanced manufacturing.

default.zh: 极紫外激光是现代激光技术的重要分支。极紫外激光在光谱诊断、激光制造及激光成像等方面发挥着其它光源无法替代的作用。本课程以人工智能赋能极紫外激光技术为核心定位，聚焦同步辐射、自由电子激光、高次谐波等核心光源技术，依托AI教学平台帮助学生拓展知识领域，突破传统教学照本宣科的尴尬情景，培养“光子科学+AI”的跨学科创新能力，为集成电路、先进制造等领域输送高端技术人才。
default.en: Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lasers represent a critical branch of modern laser technology. They play an irreplaceable role in spectral diagnostics, laser manufacturing, and laser imaging, among other applications. This course is centered on empowering EUV laser technology with artificial intelligence (AI). It focuses on core light source technologies such as synchrotron radiation, free-electron lasers, and high-harmonic generation. Leveraging an AI teaching platform, the course aims to help students expand their knowledge domains, break away from the limitations of traditional textbook-based instruction, and develop interdisciplinary innovation capabilities in "photon science + AI." The goal is to cultivate high-level technical talent for fields such as integrated circuits and advanced manufacturing.

default.zh: 本课程讲授几种主要微能源系统的工作原理、基本结构以及输出特性，让学生能够深入的了解微能源系统内部的微结构对其输出性能的影响。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验操作以及计算机仿真等环节，着重培养学生们对微能源系统的综合分析和设计能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程目标要求如下：（1）讲授微型燃料电池的工作原理和基本结构，使学生具备微能源系统分析问题的知识基础，掌握微能源系统的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；（2）讲授微型氢氧燃料电池/微型甲醇燃料电池的输出特点和主要分析方法，培养学生分析和解决工程实践中微能源系统的能力；（3）介绍常见微能源系统问题的基本实验技能和计算机仿真方法，使学生得到实验方案设计和实验技能的基本培训，逐步具备应用先进工具解决工作实际问题的能力。
default.en: This course teaches the working principles, basic structures and output characteristics of several major micro power sourcesm, allowing students to have a deep understanding of the impact of the internal microstructure on the output performance of micro power sources. Through the classroom teaching, subsequent experimental operations, and computer simulation of this course, we focus on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design capabilities for micro power sources, increasing their awareness of innovation, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes. The course objectives are as follows: (1) Teach the working principle and basic structure of micro fuel cells, so that students have the ability to analysis the problems of micro power sources, and master the theoretical basis, research hot spots, development trends and cutting-edge applications of micro power sources; (2) ) Teach the output characteristics and main analysis methods of micro hydrogen-oxygen fuel cells/micro methanol fuel cells, and cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve the problems of micro power sources in engineering practice; (3) Introduce basic experimental skills and computer simulation of common micro power sources. This method enables students to get basic training in experimental plan design and experimental skills, and gradually acquire the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical work problems.

default.zh: 本课程是无线通信集成电路设计的基础课程。授课教师从射频微电子技术的前沿出发，结合工程经验，对无线通信电路集成设计的原理以及容易被忽略的问题给出了详尽的阐述，阐述了通信集成电路设计特征。课程分5部分，主要介绍了无线通信集成电路系统发展史，以及当今射频集成电路前沿简介、无线通信（模拟/射频集成电路）设计的约束和要求；电路设计中谐波失真机理及分析；电路的噪声机理与噪声分析；电路阻抗匹配机理及分析；模拟/数字信号的调制技术与无线通信标准中集成电路性能要求和接收机架构简介。本课程针对许多工业界人士的需求和问题进行了分析和解释，同时可作为相关专业的高年级本科生的课程。
default.en: This course is a fundamental subject of wireless communication integrated circuits. The keynote speaker, from the insight cut-edge of Radio-Frequency(RF) microelectronics, presents a great of details on the principles of the technologies of integration circuits about communications and the omitted problems about RF microelectronics. The course expatiates on the design methodologies of RF integrated circuits. The course contains five parts. It introduces the history of wireless communication and integrated circuits, and cut-edge of RF integrated circuits, and the rule of discipline and constraints of analog/radio frequency integrated circuits designs in communication systems, the circuit mechanism and analysis of harmonic distortion; the mechanism and analysis of circuit noise; the mechanism and analysis of circuit resistance matching; the technology modulation of analog/digital signal, and demands of integrated circuits for wireless standards, and brief introduction of Receiver architecture. The course is presented the analysis and interpretation for the problems and needs of many industrial people. It acts as the course of the relative high-grade students.

default.zh: MEMS课程是一门针对高等工科院校中微电子科学与工程专业开设的重要选修课程，涉及物理学、化学、生物学、电子学、机械学等多个学科领域，旨在培养学生从事MEMS研究开发及应用的专业技术课。主要讲述MEMS的定义、发展及其作用，重点讲述硅体微机械加工、表面微机械加工、DRIE、LIGA等MEMS工艺技术基础；讲述MEMS微传感器与微执行器、光与射频MEMS等典型MEMS器件；介绍MEMS在航天、国防、汽车电子、消费电子、生物医学等方面的应用实例。
default.en: MEMS is one of the most important new courses for the students of Micro electronic Science and Enginering in advanced technology college, involves a wide and diverse range of technical areas including physics, chemistry, biology, electronics and mechanics, aiming to enhance the students’ skills in MEMS researching and application. This course introduces the definition, development and effect of MEMS, particularly basics of manufacture process，such as bulk and surface micromachining and DRIE, LIGA, MEMS sensors and actuators, optical and RF MEMS, as well as the application in spaceflight, national defense, automotive and consumption electronics, and biomedicine.

default.zh: 微传感器课程是高等工科院校中微电子专业一门新开设的重要课程之一，涉及物理学、化学、生物学、电子学等多个学科领域，在教学过程中综合运用先修课程所学的有关知识技能及相关学科领域的知识，进行从事微传感器研究开发及应用方面的技术人员所需要的基本技能的训练，为学生以后从事微传感器研究开发打下坚实的基础。因此在微电子专业的教学计划中占有重要地位。
default.en: Microsensor curriculum in engineering colleges are microelectronics professionals to open a new one of the essential curriculum, involving physics, chemistry, biology, electronics and other fields, in the teaching process by the integrated use of pre-study curriculum relevant knowledge, skills and knowledge in the field of related disciplines to conduct engaged in micro sensor research and development and application of technical personnel required by the basic skills training for students to engage in future micro-sensor research and development and lay a solid foundation. Therefore, in micro-electronic professional teaching programs occupies an important position.

default.zh: 本课程结合无线网络和传感器技术的最新发展及应用现状，介绍了无线传感器网络的基本概念和发展现状。针对无线传感器网络节点探测功能，介绍了常用微型传感器的工作原理和选型技术。要求学生重点掌握无线传感器网络通信技术、关键支撑技术和网络协议标准。最后，课程针对近年来海洋无线传感器网络快速发展的需求，阐述了海洋无线传感器网络节点的构成和通信协议。
default.en: This course introduces the wireless sensor networks’ basic concepts and development status according to the latest developments and applications. We introduced the working principles and selection techniques about some common micro sensors which are used to target detecting. Students need to focus on mastering wireless sensor network communication technology, key supporting technologies and standards of network protocol in this course. Finally, the composition and communication protocols are introduced focusing on the rapid development of ocean wireless sensor networks in recent years.

default.zh: 随着计算机科学在现代各种学科的日益深入，结合各学科的知识特点，掌握相关计算机软件技术基础知识在学习各学科知识的过程中日益重要。《计算机软件技术基础》概括了软件工程、现代操作系统和数据结构在计算机体系中的地位，特点和作用等基础知识，课程侧重于基本概念和基础理论知识的介绍，以一个软件工程师的角度看待和处理现实问题。这些都有利于学生们在专业学习中理解硬件设计语言以及其他各种辅助设计软件在微电子设计、实现、模拟和仿真中所起的各种作用。有利于学生充分利用计算机这一系统工具，将更多的精力集中在微电子学科的学习和创新上。
default.en: The deeper various subjects were penetrated with computer technologies, the more important it is to grasp corresponding basic knowledge of software technologies integrated with the knowledge characteristics of various disciplines. The course of fundamental technology of the computer software introduces the primitive theory of software engineering, modern operating system and data structure, and concludes their characteristics, status and functions in the computer system. The course focuses on the introduction of basic concepts and knowledge. It could help the students to understand and handle questions about the real world as a software engineer. It is beneficial to help students master the hardware description language and other design aided tools, which are used to design and implement chips in microelectronics. Students could pay more attention to study and innovation in the field of microelectronics by taking full advantage of computer system tools.

default.zh: 本课程是各类微电子器件及装备的基础课程。授课教师从微电子技术的发展出发，结合工程经验，对微电子器件的原理以及容易被忽略的问题给出了详尽的论述，阐述了微电子器件失效机理。课程分2大部分，主要介绍了微电子器件可靠性的背景知识、常用的数学模型、相关的统计理论、微电子器件的失效原理与分析、可靠性设计、器件的选用与控制、以及可靠性评价和标准等。本课程针对许多工业界人士的需求和问题进行了分析和解释，同时作为相关专业的高年级本科生和低年级研究生的课程。
default.en: This course is a fundamental subject of all kinds of microelectronic devices and equipments. The school teacher, from the development of microelectronics technologies, gives a great of details on the principles of the microelectronic devices and the omitted problems about microelectronics. The course expatiates on the invalidation effects of microelectronics. The course contains two parts. It mainly introduces the background of microelectronic devices, the common mathematical modules of microelectronic devices, the relative statistical theories, the principles and analysis of invalidation for microelectronic devices, design reliability of microelectronic devices, the selection and control of the devices, and reliable evaluation and standards of microelectronic devices. The course is presented the analysis and interpretation for the problems and needs of many industrial people. It acts as the course of the relative high-grade students and junior postgraduates.

default.zh: 近年嵌入式系统中软件所占的比例越来越大，嵌入式软件是专为特定嵌入式环境设计的软件，在许多方面与通用软件具有很大的差异。本课程的目的是使学生了解嵌入式软件的应用环境，掌握嵌入式软件的特点，学习嵌入式软件的系统分析，设计和实现的要点。主要内容包括嵌入式软件开发工具与方法，嵌入式软件调试工具与调试技术；嵌入式操作系统结构与工作原理。本课程帮助学生建立系统级的概念、分析和设计方法，为培养具有系统观念的工程师打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The software is taking the increasing portion of the embedded system. Embedded software is usually customized for specific application environment, and it is quite different from the general software. This course will help students to understand the character of embedded software and its application environment, learn the analysis, design and implementation of embedded software. The course consists of development tools and methods of embedded software, debug tools and techniques of embedded software, the structures and mechanism of embedded OS (operating system). This course will help the students establish the concepts, analysis and design capabilities at the system level and lay the foundations of engineer with system perspectives.

default.zh: 微处理器结构主要介绍微处理器结构设计的原理与方法。本课程首先对微处理器的发展历程及特点、计算机体系结构与组织、当代先进系统级芯片结构进行概述，然后重点介绍微处理器性能和成本定义及评估方法，基于此详细介绍指令集体系结构设计原则，分析了数据通路和控制逻辑的设计技术。RISC技术是微处理器设计主流技术，本课程重点介绍了RISC结构的特点，以MIPS处理器为例，分析了其指令集的特点及组成，给出了采用该指令集进行汇编语言程序实现的方法和规则，详细分析并介绍了基于MIPS指令集的单周期处理器、多周期处理器以及流水结构处理器数据通路及控制结构设计方法。介绍了层次式存储系统以及cache的原理及设计方法。本课程为面向应用的系统解决方案设计打下理论基础。
default.en: Microprocessor architecture mainly introduces the principles and methods to design the microprocessor architecture. The course first gives an overview of the development history and characteristics of microprocessors, computer architecture and organization, and contemporary advanced system level chip architecture. Then the definition and evaluation methods of microprocessor performance and cost are focused on. Based on this, the design principles of instruction set architecture are introduced in detail, and the design techniques of data path and control logic are analyzed. RISC technology is the mainstream technology of microprocessor design. This course focuses on the characteristics of RISC architecture, taking MIPS processor as an example, analyzes the characteristics and composition of MIPS’ instruction set, gives the methods and rules of implementing assembly language with this instruction set, analyzes and introduces the design methods of the data path and control structure of single-cycle processor, multi-cycle processor and pipeline processor based on the MIPS instruction set in detail. And principles and design methods of memory hierarchy system and cache are introduced. The course lays a theoretical foundation for designing the application-oriented system solutions.

default.zh: 课程从空间辐射环境的介绍及对器件/电路的危害开始，从器件/电路材料选择、工艺和设计加固等方面，讲述辐射环境下对集成电路的特殊要求和设计方法。课程内容分为5章。首先对辐射环境进行介绍，包括空间辐射环境、大气辐射环境和地面辐射环境，描述空间辐射环境对集成电路产生的危害，即辐射效应，主要是总剂量效应和单粒子效应。第2章对集成电路制造采用的材料及其辐射特性进行介绍，同时介绍从工艺上对集成电路的加固技术，包括硅材料和SOI材料。第3章主要讲述存储器的加固设计技术，系统层面主要是错误修正编码技术，讲述汉明码的加固方法，可以纠正存储器中的1位错误；在电路层面主要是存储单元的加固；探测修正加固技术主要是通过加入探测电路来达到检错、纠错的目的。第4章主要讲述瞬态错误在组合电路中的传播，包括电屏蔽，逻辑屏蔽和锁存窗口屏蔽效应，及其抑制技术，时序电路的加固主要讲述锁存器和触发器的加固。第5章主要讲述电路抗总剂量辐射性能和抗单粒子辐射性能的评估方法，包括在计算机环境的评估技术，以及地面模拟试验系统和测试方法。
default.en: The course will first introduce space radiation environment and the harm to the device / circuit, and how to select device / circuit material, process and hardened design technique. Then the special requirements for integrated circuit and design method under the radiation environment will be proposed. The content of the course is divided into five chapters. The radiation environments are introduced first, including the space radiation environment, atmospheric radiation environmental and terrestrial radiation environment. The hazards of the space radiation environment to the integrated circuit, which is mainly total ionizing dose effects and single event effects are summarized. In the second chapter, the material and radiation characteristics used for integrated circuit are introduced, and the hardened techniques of integrated circuit, including silicon material and SOI material, are introduced. The third chapter focuses on memory hardened design techniques, the system level is mainly error correction code technique, Hamming code hardened method, which can correct one bit error in a memory. At the circuit level, the hardened method for memory cell is introduced. Detection and correction technique is mainly through adding detection circuit to achieve the purpose of error detection and error correction. The fourth chapter focuses on transient error propagation in combinational circuits, including electrical masking, logic masking and window masking effects, and suppression techniques to transient error propagation. For sequential circuits mainly deals with the hardness of latches and triggers. The fifth chapter focuses on the evaluation methods of total dose radiation performance and single event effect radiation performance of the circuits, including computer environment evaluation technique, ground simulation test system and test methods.

default.zh: 《生物芯片技术》是电子信息科学与技术专业现在和未来的一个重要发展分支，借助于集成电路制备技术，根据分子间特异性地相互作用的原理，将生命科学领域中不连续的分析过程集成于衬底表面以制备微型生物化学分析系统。 本课程以微电子工艺为基础，主要讲授生物芯片领域的基础理论、实用工艺基础、主要研究成果、最新进展及未来发展趋势，使学生初步掌握各种生物芯片的基本原理和制作工艺方法，明晰微加工和微电子技术在固相表面构建微型生物化学分析系统当中的应用，为其在微电子学专业方面的进一步学习奠定一定的理论和应用基础。 重点使学生熟悉和掌握微生物芯片类型以及当前普遍采用的工艺制作方法，包括：微阵列芯片，蛋白质芯片，微流控芯片，体硅加工技术，腐蚀，键合技术，功能薄膜制备等；掌握各类型芯片工作原理，常见问题以及解决措施。内容涉及面广，信息量大，而且新技术、新工艺、新设备不断涌现，是一门实践性和理论性均较强的技术类专业选修课程。 该课程以讲授为主，累加式计分方式，结课考核需提交一篇不少于3000字课程报告，内容针对一种类型的生物芯片展开，附主要参考文献，文献阅读量不少于5篇，占成绩60%；平时成绩占10%（讨论、课程难点讲解等）； 实验成绩占30%（实验操作以及实验报告）。
default.en: Biochip technique is an important branch for the growing trend in the field of electronic information science and technology. With the help of integrated circuit fabrication technology, the biochip integrated some un-continuous analysis process on the substrate surface, which based on the principle of intermolecular specific interactions in the field of life science. Therefore, the biochip offers exciting possibilities for the miniaturization of analytical instruments, called micro total analysis system (μ-TAS). Based on MEMS engineering and biochemistry, this course will mainly introduce the basic theory in the field of biochip, as well as practical process, the main research results, the latest progress and trend in the future. The student should master the basic principle for all kinds of biochip and the fabrication methods. The studying of biochip course is beneficial for the students, improving their ability that use their learning to solve and analysis some practical problems, which lay the theoretical foundation for the application and further study in microelectronics field. Micro total analysis system (μ-TAS) offers the potential for highly efficient, simultaneous analysis of a large number of biologically important molecules in genomic, proteomic and metabolic studies. Students should be familiarized with the types and fabrication methods of biochip widely used in current production, including: microarray chip, protein chip, microfluidic chip, silicon bulk machining, corrosion, bonding technology, function film fabrication; grasp the working principle of various types biochip, common problems and solutions. With the new technology, new equipment constantly emerging, biochip technology raises fascinating possibilities for new analytical assays in various fields such as bioelectronics assembly, biomechanics and sampling techniques, as well as in chips or micro-devices. This course aims to describe the present state-of-the-art of microsystems for use in biotechnological research, medicine and diagnostics. The cumulative scoring method was adopted in this course. a course report about one kind of biochip, should be submitted, no less than 3,000 words, with main references，at least 5 papers reading, accounting 60% of the total score; usually 10% of the results (discussion, curriculum difficulties, lectures, etc.); experimental scores accounted for30% (experimental operations and experimental reports, etc.).

default.zh: 本课程以国家需求为导向，集成电路设计技术为基本教学内容，结合学校理论教学优势和国企研究所面向应用设计技术优势，力争架起理论学习、校园教育与国家急需集成电路设计技术之间的桥梁，抓住集成电路发展的时代机遇，培养能够满足实用化需求的、具备新颖和灵活的设计技术的高水平人才。课程聘请中电集团第14研究所专家讲授，课程分析集成电路产业需求和技术人才需求，探讨国家亟待解决的芯片技术难题，讲授集成电路芯片设计技术及产品实用化技术。课程结合高校关键技术难点研发能力和知名企业集成电路可靠性、实用性以及全面性等优势，涵盖高精度ADC、DAC、PLL单元设计、芯片系统规划及原理分析以及芯片应用与设计技巧等课程内容。
default.en: With national demand-oriented and IC design technology as the basic teaching content, this course combines the theoretical teaching advantages of schools and application-oriented design technology advantages of state-owned research institutes, and strives to build a bridge between theoretical learning, campus education and the country's urgent need for IC design technology, seize the opportunities of the era of IC development. Cultivate high-level talents with novel and flexible design techniques that can meet practical needs. The course is taught by experts from the 14th Research Institute of CLP Group. The course analyzes the needs of integrated circuit industry and technical talents, discusses the chip technology problems that need to be solved in the country, and teaches integrated circuit chip design technology and product practical technology. The course combines the research and development ability of key technical difficulties of colleges and universities with the reliability, practicability and comprehensiveness of integrated circuits of well-known enterprises, covering high-precision ADC, DAC, PLL unit design, chip system planning and principle analysis, chip application and design skills and other courses.

default.zh: 主要掌握和熟悉集成电路和电子科学与技术等专业方向的基础理论，涉及到固体物理和半导体物理等方面的物理概念和主要性质。本课程为学生介绍固态电子学的基本物理规律和性质，包括集成电路材料的基本物理性质、导电性以及半导体中的载流子及其运动状态，为从事集成电路、微电子器件、传感器及应用、光电子技术等方面的研究和工作打下必备的理论基础。
default.en: Master and be familiar with the basic theories of integrated circuits and electronic science and technology, involving the physical concepts and main properties of solid physics and semiconductor physics. This course introduces the basic physical laws and properties of solid-state electronics, including the basic physical properties and conductivity of integrated circuit materials, as well as the carrier and its motion state in semiconductors. This course lays a necessary theoretical foundation for the research and work in integrated circuits, microelectronics devices, sensor applications, and optoelectronic technology.

default.zh: 本课程面向微电子科学与工程专业大二本科生，主要介绍光电微系统这一后摩尔时代的微电子先进技术，让学生了解及掌握相关方向的前沿进展。本课程采用课堂讲授及课堂分组讨论的授课方式，结合科研项目实例，以充分激发学生的学习兴趣，开拓学生的眼界。 本课程以光电微系统的简要介绍开篇，讲授相关的基本概念、特性、发展历史及各项领域中的典型应用，概述光电微系统现今面临的技术瓶颈。本课程重点讲授光电微系统所涉及到的几种关键技术：光电探测器、硅光芯片以及异构异质集成技术。首先介绍光电探测器这一光——电之间的桥梁，讲解各种材料、器件结构、探测架构和器件功能及读出电路，结合中电11所优势方向，讲述第四代焦平面技术。其次介绍硅基光电子芯片，分别讲述光波导、调制器、耦合器、光发生模块、光收集集成模块等的基本概念、功能、原理及发展趋势。再次，围绕光电微系统必不可少的封装集成技术展开讲解，介绍chiplet芯粒概念、芯片级封装、系统级封装、多芯片模块、2D/3D异构集成架构以及各种软件异构集成方法等。最后，对于半导体IDM模式进行概述，介绍国内外光电工艺相关布局。通过本课程的学习，学生将对光电微系统技术形成初步认知，同时学生的科研素质得到一定提升。
default.en: This course is aimed at sophomore students majoring in microelectronics science and engineering. It mainly introduces optoelectronic microsystems, an advanced technology of microelectronics in the post-Moorish era, so that students can understand and master the frontier progress in related fields. This course adopts the teaching methods of classroom teaching and classroom group discussion, combined with examples of scientific research projects, in order to fully stimulate students' interest in learning and broaden their horizons. This course begins with a brief introduction of optoelectronic microsystems, teaching the basic concepts, characteristics, development history and typical applications in various fields, and outlining the technical bottlenecks faced by optoelectronic microsystems today. This course focuses on several key technologies involved in optoelectronic microsystems: photodetectors, silicon photonic chips, and heterogeneous integration technologies. First of all, the photodetector is introduced as a bridge between light and electricity, explaining various materials, device structure, detection architecture and device function and readout circuit, combined with the advantages of the CETC 11th Institute to describe the fourth generation of focal plane technology. Secondly, silicon photonic chips are introduced, including the basic concepts, functions, principles and development trends of optical waveguide, modulator, coupler, optical generation module and optical collection integrated module. Thirdly, it focuses on the essential packaging and integration technology of optoelectronic microsystem, introducing the chiplet concept, chip level packaging, system level packaging, multi-chip module, 2D/3D heterogeneous integration architecture and various software heterogeneous integration methods. Finally, the semiconductor IDM mode is summarized, and the domestic and foreign layout of photoelectric technology is introduced. Through the study of this course, students will form a preliminary cognition of optoelectronic microsystem technology, and their scientific research quality will be improved to a certain extent.

default.zh: 对于航天器而言，辐射损伤是一个严重的问题，因为航天器在空间环境中长时间暴露于高能辐射，如宇宙射线、太阳风和地球辐射带。这些辐射源会对航天器的电子器件造成连续和间歇的辐射损伤，可能导致不可修复的故障和性能下降。“宇航集成电路辐射效应与表征技术”是随着航天技术发展而产生的新的基础研究领域之一。本课程的主要任务是使学生了解和掌握电子器件在辐射环境中的行为和性能。学生将了解辐射对材料和器件的影响，深入了解辐射效应的物理机制和相关概念，以及应对和预防辐射引起的故障问题的方法
default.en: For spacecraft, radiation damage is a serious problem as they are exposed to high-energy radiation such as cosmic rays, solar wind, and Earth's radiation belts for a long time in the space environment. These radiation sources can cause continuous and intermittent radiation damage to the electronic components of spacecraft, potentially leading to irreparable failures and performance degradation. Radiation effects and characterization techniques in aerospace integrated circuits are one of the new fundamental research fields that have emerged with the development of aerospace technology. The main task of this course is to enable students to understand and master the behavior and performance of integrated circuits in radiation environments. Students will understand the impact of radiation on semiconductor materials and integrated circuits, gain a deeper understanding of the physical mechanisms and related concepts of radiation effects, as well as methods for addressing and preventing radiation induced failures

default.zh: 课程是专业选修课程，在半导体器件原理等先修课程基础上，使学生了解元器件可靠性试验及分析方法，元器件可靠性分析及试验技术贯穿于元器件产品的研制开发、设计定型、批量生成和使用的各个阶段，简要的说，为评价分析元器件的可靠性而进行的试验和分析统称为元器件可靠性分析技术。开设本课程的目的在于让学生能够在半导体器件性能分析和失效分析领域掌握半导体器件失效的基本原理及判断方法，从而掌握元器件可靠性分析的基本理论知识。
default.en: This course is a professional elective offered on the basis of prerequisite courses such as Principles of Semiconductor Devices. It aims to equip students with knowledge of reliability testing and analysis methods for electronic components. Reliability analysis and testing techniques for components are applied throughout various stages, including product development, design finalization, mass production, and usage. In brief, the tests and analyses conducted to evaluate and assess the reliability of components are collectively referred to as component reliability analysis technology. The objective of this course is to enable students to master the fundamental principles and evaluation methods of semiconductor device failures in the fields of performance analysis and failure analysis, thereby equipping them with the essential theoretical knowledge of component reliability analysis.

default.zh: 空间太阳电池是现代航天器电源系统核心组件，它们在空间任务中承担着能量转换的关键功能。然而，恶劣的空间环境，如极端温度变化、真空状态、粒子辐射，紫外/原子氧等，对空间太阳电池的性能和寿命构成了巨大挑战。课程内容包括空间太阳电池的基础理论、空间环境的特点、环境因素对空间太阳电池性能的影响机制，以及性能评估与可靠性测试方法。通过分析轨道数据、模拟实验及案例研究，评估空间环境对空间太阳电池的具体影响，并掌握提高器件在空间环境中稳定性和可靠性的策略。本课程特别强调实践与理论相结合的教学方式，学生将有机会参与到“国家大科学工程-空间环境地面模拟装置”平台，使用专业设备进行光电器件测试和分析。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够熟练识别和分析空间环境中的各种效应，掌握光电器件性能评价的关键技术，为未来的空间任务设计和执行奠定坚实的技术基础。
default.en: Space solar cells are core components of the power systems in modern spacecraft, playing a critical role in energy conversion during space missions. However, the harsh space environment—including extreme temperature variations, vacuum conditions, particle radiation, ultraviolet radiation, atomic oxygen, and more—poses significant challenges to the performance and lifespan of these solar cells. This course covers the fundamental theories of space solar cells, the characteristics of the space environment, the mechanisms through which environmental factors affect solar cell performance, as well as performance evaluation and reliability testing methods. By analyzing orbital data, conducting simulation experiments, and examining case studies, students will learn to assess the specific impacts of the space environment on space solar cells and develop strategies to enhance device stability and reliability. With a strong emphasis on integrating theory with practice, the course offers students the opportunity to engage with the "National Major Science and Technology Infrastructure – Ground-based Space Environment Simulation Facility," where they will utilize professional equipment to test and analyze photoelectric devices. Upon completion of the course, students will be proficient in identifying and analyzing various space environmental effects, mastering key techniques for evaluating the performance of photoelectric devices, and laying a solid technical foundation for the design and execution of future space missions.

default.zh: 光谱技术在集成电路（IC）研究中扮演着重要的角色，特别是在材料表征、质量控制、缺陷检测和微观结构分析等领域。通过利用不同类型的光谱技术，研究人员能够获得集成电路中各种物质的精确信息，包括材料的化学组成、晶体结构、应力状态等，从而提高IC的性能、可靠性和生产效率。本课程的主要任务是深入探讨光谱技术在集成电路（IC）研究与制造中的关键应用，重点介绍如何利用各种光谱技术对半导体材料、薄膜、缺陷及微观结构进行表征与分析。使学生了解光谱技术如何帮助提升集成电路的性能、可靠性与制造效率。
default.en: Spectroscopy techniques play a crucial role in the research of integrated circuits (ICs), especially in areas such as material characterization, quality control, defect detection, and microstructure analysis. By utilizing different types of spectroscopy, researchers can obtain precise information about various substances in integrated circuits, including the chemical composition, crystal structure, and stress state of materials, thereby improving the performance, reliability, and production efficiency of ICs. The main objective of this course is to explore the key applications of spectroscopy techniques in IC research and manufacturing. The course will focus on how to use various spectroscopy techniques to characterize and analyze semiconductor materials, thin films, defects, and microstructures. Students will gain an understanding of how spectroscopy can help enhance the performance, reliability, and manufacturing efficiency of integrated circuits.

default.zh: 本课程面向我国先进试验与测试领域对高层次研发人才需求，推进光电测试方向工程硕士、博士产教融合培养改革，结合国内多个优秀教学科研团队的理论知识储备，以及产业界的一些经典应用案例，开设了先进光电测试技术课程。 本课程以前沿科学与重大工程应用中对先进光电测试技术的需求为导向，例如光刻机中急需的激光位移测量干涉仪、大口径光学元件检测中急需的面型检测干涉仪、大科学装置中需要的精密角度测量、航空、航天中需要的面型测量和位姿反馈等。这门课将从实际需求出发，根据学生的知识基础特点，讲授各种测量基础理论和方法，深入剖析各种测量方法的工程应用实例，引导学生分析思考其中的核心关键技术，锻炼科研素养，优秀学生还可以前往合作院校或业界头部企业进行参观学习，从而培养卓越工程人才。
default.en: This course is aimed at the demand for high-level R&D talents in the field of advanced experimentation and testing in China. It promotes the reform of integrated cultivation of engineering master's and doctoral degrees in optoelectronic testing, and combines the theoretical knowledge reserves of multiple excellent teaching and research teams in China, as well as some classic application cases in the industry, to offer an advanced optoelectronic testing technology course. This course was previously oriented towards the demand for advanced optoelectronic testing technologies in scientific and major engineering applications, such as laser displacement measurement interferometers urgently needed in lithography machines, surface detection interferometers urgently needed in large-aperture optical component testing, precision angle measurement required in large scientific devices, surface measurement and pose feedback required in aviation and aerospace. This course will start from practical needs and teach various basic measurement theories and methods based on students' knowledge and characteristics. It will deeply analyze the engineering application examples of various measurement methods, guide students to analyze and think about the core key technologies, and exercise scientific research literacy. Excellent students can also visit cooperative universities or industry leading enterprises for learning, in order to cultivate outstanding engineering talents.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍光学遥感技术的基础理论和基本知识、光学遥感器的种类及其工作原理和常用的光学系统，对光学遥感技术的应用、发展状况及前景亦有所介绍。主要内容包括：光学遥感概论（光学遥感基本概念、技术体系、主要应用、遥感技术发展过程及展望）；光学遥感中的信息载体——光辐射（光辐射的基本特性、基本定律、被动式资源遥感中两种最重要的自然资源、地球大气对光学遥感的影响）；光学遥感传感器（摄影型遥感器、光机扫描方式的遥感器、推扫式扫描仪、成像光谱仪）；CCD成像电路系统设计。
default.en: Optical remote sensing technology mainly introduces the fundamental theory and basic knowledge, the variety of optical remote sensors, optical principle and optical systems. In addition, the application, current developing status and prospect about optical remote sensing will be also involved. This course mainly consists of the outline of optical remote sensing including basic conceptions, technical system, main application, developing process and prospect; the optical radiation including the basic characteristics, primary theory, two most important natural resources applied in passive resource remote sensing, the influence of atmosphere on optical remote sensing; optical remote sensors including the film remote sensors, the scanning remote sensors, push-broom scanners, imaging spectrometers; optoelectronic detectors and corresponding detecting system.

default.zh: 光学遥感卫星能够迅速、准确捕获地球表面特定区域的最新时空信息，具有空间覆盖性广、重访时间短、成像光谱波段多、图像纹理信息丰富、可长时间凝视成像等优点，是获取重点区域态势信息的重要手段。光学遥感图像处理技术已被广泛应用于数字城市、地理国情监测、环境保护、灾害应急响应等各个领域。 本课程主要内容包括遥感图像辐射校正、几何校正、反演恢复、融合超分、目视解译、机器解译等基础理论课程以及相应实验课程，旨在让学生了解光学遥感系统成像原理、图像质量退化机理，掌握校正、增强、解译等光学遥感图像处理应用的基本概念与方法，通过遥感图像处理典型案例实践，锻炼“光学+信息+智能”多学科知识的交叉应用能力，以及适用先进工具解决工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: Optical remote sensing satellites can quickly and accurately capture the latest spatiotemporal information of specific areas on the Earth's surface. They have the advantages of wide spatial coverage, short revisit time, multiple imaging spectral bands, rich image texture information, and can be used for long-term staring imaging. They are important means of obtaining situational information in key regions. Optical remote sensing image processing technology has been widely applied in various fields such as digital cities, geographical and national monitoring, environmental protection, and disaster emergency response. The main content of this course includes basic theoretical courses such as remote sensing image radiometric correction, geometric correction, inversion restoration, fusion superresolution, visual interpretation, machine interpretation, and corresponding experimental courses. The aim is to enable students to understand the imaging principles of optical remote sensing systems and the degradation mechanism of image quality, master the basic concepts and methods of optical remote sensing image processing applications such as correction, enhancement, and interpretation, and practice through typical cases of remote sensing image processing, Exercise the interdisciplinary application ability of "optics+information+intelligence" and the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 光纤技术与应用课程面向光电信息科学与工程专业的本科生开课，是一门涉及光学、光纤、数字电路等多学科交叉的综合性很强的专业选修课。该课程讲授光纤传光原理及特性、光通信系统和光纤传感技术等知识，以培养学生独立获取知识的能力为第一位，在重点讲授基本原理、基础知识、关键技术和适用技术上，结合实际研究结果，拓宽学生知识面，使学生掌握实际的光纤应用技术，为学生将来参加相关科研、就业、继续深造奠定技术基础。 本课程介绍光纤技术应用领域所涉及的基础知识和相关技术，包光纤通信技术及系统和光纤传感技术，和新型应用方向。该课程能够培养学生多学科综合运用能力以及实际光纤应用问题的解决能力。除课堂讲授外，通过让学生自己查阅资料、完成设计作业和计算仿真等方式，提高学生学习的自主性和使用现代化信息工具的能力，同时根据该领域的发展，介绍新技术、新应用等，扩展学生视野，为将来深入学习和解决实际问题提供思路。 通过该课程学习，了解和掌握经典光纤通信基本特性和基本原理，了解与掌握光纤传感问题分析的知识基础，了解光纤应用领域的研究热点、发展趋势以及前沿应用；了解和掌握经典光纤系统特性，具备分析工程实践中光纤通信和传感问题的能力；熟悉和掌握光纤器件设计方法和仿真方法，得到相关光学仿真编程软件的基本训练，逐步具有应用编程软件工具解决应用光学实际问题的能力。
default.en: The Fiber Optic Technology and Applications course is open to undergraduate students majoring in optoelectronic information science and engineering. It is a highly comprehensive elective course that involves interdisciplinary subjects such as optics, fiber optics, and digital circuits. This course teaches the principles and characteristics of fiber optic transmission, optical communication systems, and fiber optic sensing technology, with the primary focus on cultivating students' ability to independently acquire knowledge. It focuses on teaching basic principles, basic knowledge, key technologies, and applicable technologies, and combines practical research results to broaden students' knowledge, enabling them to master practical fiber optic application technology and participate in relevant scientific research, employment Continue to further study and lay a technical foundation. This course introduces the basic knowledge and related technologies involved in the application field of fiber optic technology, including fiber optic communication technology and systems, fiber optic sensing technology, and new application directions. This course can cultivate students' comprehensive interdisciplinary application abilities and problem-solving abilities in practical fiber optic applications. In addition to classroom lectures, by allowing students to access materials, complete design assignments, and perform computational simulations on their own, students' autonomy in learning and the ability to use modern information tools are enhanced. At the same time, based on the development of this field, new technologies and applications are introduced to expand students' horizons and provide ideas for future in-depth learning and practical problem-solving.
