From the course, students will understand and master the basic characteristics and principles of classical fiber optic communication, the knowledge foundation of fiber optic sensing problem analysis, and the research hotspots, development trends, and cutting-edge applications in the field of fiber optic applications; Understand and master the characteristics of classic fiber optic systems, and have the ability to analyze fiber optic communication and sensing problems in engineering practice; Familiarize and master the design and simulation methods of fiber optic devices, obtain basic training in relevant optical simulation programming software, and gradually develop the ability to apply programming software tools to solve practical problems in applied optics.

default.zh: 光谱成像技术课程面向光电信息科学与工程专业的本科生开课，是一门光谱特性、成像探测、目标识别等多学科交叉的综合性很强的专业课。本课程结合当前光谱成像技术的国内外最新研究成果和应用进展，力求使学生全面了解光谱成像在航空航天、国民经济等各个领域的应用，熟悉和掌握典型光谱成像系统中涉及的基本概念及基本理论，掌握光谱目标分类识别应用中涉及的原理、方法。 课程主要包括概论、物质的光谱特性、光谱成像探测技术、光谱图像变换技术、光谱特征选择技术、光谱目标检测技术、光谱分类识别技术、新型光谱成像技术及相关应用。本课程成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、平时作业及期末考试三部分。 通过本课程的教学，着重培养学生综合运用知识解决实际问题的能力，为从事光电系统设计、光谱成像系统及应用等领域的研究打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The Spectral Imaging Technology is a multidisciplinary specialized course, involving spectral characteristics, imaging detection and object recognition, for students majoring in Optoelectronic Information Science and Engineering. This course introduces the new development and application of spectral imaging technique at home and abroad. This course aims to make students fully understand the basic concepts of Spectral imaging and its applications in aerospace, national economy and other fields, and make students master the basic concepts and basic theories in typical spectral imaging systems, and master the principles and methods in spectral classification and recognition. The main contents of this course include the introduction, the spectral characteristics of the material, the spectral imaging detection technology, the transformation technology for spectral image, the spectral feature extraction technology, the target detection technology for spectral image, the classification recognition technology for spectral image and the new spectral imaging technology. The grade of this course is cumulative, including three parts of the classroom performance, course assignment and final examination. This course focuses on enhancing students' ability to solve practical problems with comprehensive knowledge. And this course is a foundation for the research of optoelectronic system design, spectral imaging application and other related technologies.

default.zh: 光学计算成像是集几何光学、信息光学、计算光学、现代信号处理等理论与一体的新兴交叉技术研究领域，将光学系统设计与数字图像处理相结合，获取传统成像光学系统无法发挥的光学极限。通过光学计算成像技术课程的讲授，使学生能够了解光学计算成像技术可应用的领域和发展方向，为未来计算成像领域研究建立理论基础。课程主要内容包括：计算成像技术概述、计算孔径编码成像技术、计算光场成像技术、计算超分辨率成像技术、计算偏振成像技术、以及相关技术应用及未来方向等。
default.en: Computational Optics (CO) is a modern and novel research field and relates with the Geometry optics, the Information optics, the Computational optics and the Modern signal process. By using optical system design and digital imaging process, CO can achieve a higher performance which the traditional imaging system cannot gain due to some optical limits. At this course, we make the students to understand the essential theory, application and development of CO in order to establish the consciousness of CO. The course content includes: the theory of CO, the computational coded aperture imaging technology, the computational optical field imaging technology, the computational super-resolution imaging technology, the computational polarization imaging technology, and the applied and future of CO.

default.zh: 应用光学是空天光电信息领域非常重要的专业基础课，是后续专业课的基础。本课程系统地讲授光学成像系统的基本理论和知识、理想光学系统的分析方法、典型光学系统的成像原理及分析方法等。主要内容包括：几何光学基本定律；球面与球面系统；平面与平面系统（平面反射镜、棱镜等）；理想光学系统；光学系统中的光束限制（孔径光阑、视场光阑、景深等）；光能及其计算等。本课程实践性比较强，需要做大量的习题来帮助学生加深对各种光学系统的理解，培养学生光学系统综合分析能力和工程应用能力，增加创新意识。 课程成绩采用累加式，综合考虑平时成绩和期末笔试成绩。
default.en: Applied Optics is a very important foundational course in the field of Aerospace Optoelectronic Information, which is the basis of learning the following specialized courses. This course systematically lectures on basic theories and knowledge of optical imaging system, analytical methods of ideal optical systems, imaging principles and analytical methods of typical optical systems. The contents include: fundamental laws of geometrical optics; spherical surface and spherical surface systems; plane surface and plane surface systems (plane mirror, prism, etc.); ideal optical system; restriction of light beam in optical systems (aperture stop, field aperture, field depth, etc.); light energy and its calculation. This course has strong practicality and requires a large number of exercises to help students deepen their understanding of various optical systems, cultivate their comprehensive analysis and engineering application abilities in optical systems, and increase their innovation awareness. The courses score is cumulative, taking into account the regular grades and final exam score.

default.zh: AI辅助的视觉测量技术课程面向光电信息科学与工程（光学工程方向）本科开课，课程主要讲授视觉测量的概念、方法、原理、流程及AI技术在视觉测量领域应用，包括单目视觉测量、双目立体视觉测量等。重点使学生了解AI辅助视觉测量技术的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用，熟悉和掌握常见视觉测量问题的分析方法和实验技能，并通过相关理论方法在实际工程中的应用研究，培养学生独立思考问题、分析问题与解决问题的能力，加强学生对AI辅助视觉测量相关知识的理解与运用，为今后从事光电信息处理、视觉测量等研究奠定理论基础。 课程主要包括绪论、空间几何变换与摄像机模型、视觉图像特征信息提取、摄像机标定、单目视觉测量、双目立体视觉测量等内容。本课程的考核采用累加式方法，包括平时成绩、仿真实验和期末作业。
default.en: AI assisted visual measurement technology is a course for undergraduate students of Optoelectronic Information Science and Engineering (Optical Engineering). The course mainly teaches the concept, method, principle, process of visual measurement and the application of AI technology in the field of visual measurement, including monocular visual measurement, binocular stereo vision measurement, etc. The focus is to enable students to understand the theoretical basis, research hotspots, development trends and cutting-edge applications of AI assisted visual measurement technology, be familiar with and master the analysis methods and experimental skills of common visual measurement problems, and cultivate students' ability to think, analyze and solve problems independently through the application research of relevant theoretical methods in practical engineering, strengthen students' understanding and application of AI assisted visual measurement related knowledge, and lay a theoretical foundation for future research on optoelectronic information processing and visual measurement. The course mainly includes introduction, spatial geometry transformation and camera model, visual image feature information extraction, camera calibration, monocular vision measurement, binocular stereo vision measurement, etc. The assessment of this course adopts the cumulative method, including usual grades, simulation experiments and final assignments.

default.zh: 《智能视觉工程导论》是一门面向国家重大战略需求与科技前沿的多学科交叉课程。本课程秉承立足航天、服务国防的特色，系统阐述智能视觉工程的核心概念、基本原理及技术体系。课程内容贯通人类视觉机理与机器视觉技术，涵盖从平面视觉感知、立体视觉重建到可感知特征表示等关键理论，并深入剖析智能视觉在国防安全、工业生产、城市治理等关键领域的应用现状与发展趋势。通过本课程学习，学生将掌握智能视觉工程的专业知识，了解三维视觉、实时分析等前沿动态，并重点培养运用光学、数学、计算机科学和人工智能等多学科知识解决复杂工程问题的能力。课程致力于培养具备扎实理论基础、熟练工程实践能力、创新意识及国际视野的拔尖创新人才，使其能够胜任智能视觉相关领域的技术攻关、系统设计与前瞻性研究工作。
default.en: "Introduction to Intelligent Vision Engineering" is a multidisciplinary course designed to address the nation's major strategic needs and scientific frontiers. Adhering to the unique focus of aerospace and serving national defense, this course systematically explains the core concepts, fundamental principles, and technical systems of intelligent vision engineering. The content bridges human visual mechanisms and machine vision technologies, covering key theories from planar visual perception, stereo vision reconstruction, to perceptible feature representation. It also deeply analyzes the current applications and development trends of intelligent vision in critical fields such as national security, industrial production, and urban governance. Through this course, students acquire professional knowledge in intelligent vision engineering, gain insights into cutting-edge advancements such as 3D vision and real-time analysis, and focus on developing the ability to solve complex engineering problems by integrating knowledge from optics, mathematics, computer science, and artificial intelligence. The course aims to cultivate outstanding innovative talents with solid theoretical foundations, proficient engineering skills, creative thinking, and an international perspective, enabling them to excel in technical innovation, system design, and forward-looking research in intelligent vision-related fields.

default.zh: 机器学习和深度学习是近年来非常火爆的研究方向，其应用范围广泛，包括医学、自动驾驶、能源勘探等。机器学习理论和算法包含了很多数学知识，能够体现数学在解决实际问题中的重大作用。本课程将概述机器学习理论的发展、机器学习中的数学基础，并以支持向量机、卷积神经网络等具体例子来解释数学工具的强大之处，引导和培养学生的数学思维和用数学解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Machine learning and deep learning have been very popular research directions in recent years, with a wide range of applications, including medicine, autonomous driving, energy exploration, and so on. Machine learning theory and algorithms contain a lot of mathematical knowledge, which can reflect the significant role of mathematics in solving practical problems. This course will provide an overview of the development of machine learning theory, the mathematical foundations in machine learning, and explain the power of mathematical tools through specific examples such as support vector machines and convolutional neural networks, guiding and cultivating students' mathematical thinking and ability to solve practical problems using mathematics.

default.zh: 本课程聚焦计算感知技术的理论体系与实践应用，系统性地探讨多模态感知、计算思维与智能算法的深度融合。课程以光学传感器、雷达感知等核心技术为切入点，深入分析从数据采集到智能决策的全流程计算感知方法，特别关注视觉分类、检测、分割以及图像复原等关键技术在实际场景中的应用。课程将引导学生运用计算思维方法处理感知数据，通过抽象建模和算法设计解决复杂感知问题。学生将学习如何从多源感知数据中提取有效特征，构建数学模型，并优化算法性能。在实践环节中，课程着重培养基于深度学习的感知系统开发能力，包括状态感知、行为识别等典型应用的实现与优化。通过跨学科的知识整合，课程帮助学生建立人工智能、信号处理与感知技术的联系，培养分析前沿技术局限性与创新解决方案的能力。学生将通过文献研究、实验验证和技术报告等形式，深入理解计算感知领域的最新进展，提升解决实际工程问题的专业素养。课程内容设计注重理论与实践的结合，为学生未来在航天技术、自动驾驶、工业检测等领域的职业发展奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course focuses on the theoretical framework and practical applications of computational perception technology, systematically exploring the deep integration of multimodal perception, computational thinking, and intelligent algorithms. Taking core technologies such as optical sensors and radar perception as entry points, the course provides in-depth analysis of end-to-end computational perception methodologies from data acquisition to intelligent decision-making, with particular emphasis on key technologies including visual classification, detection, segmentation, and image restoration in practical scenarios. The course guides students to apply computational thinking methods for processing perceptual data and solving complex perception problems through abstract modeling and algorithmic design. Students will learn how to extract effective features from multi-source perception data, construct mathematical models, and optimize algorithm performance. In practical sessions, the course emphasizes developing deep learning-based perception system development capabilities, including implementation and optimization of typical applications such as state perception and behavior recognition. Through interdisciplinary knowledge integration, the course helps students establish connections between artificial intelligence, signal processing, and perception technologies, while cultivating abilities to analyze limitations of cutting-edge technologies and propose innovative solutions. Students will gain profound understanding of the latest advancements in computational perception through literature research, experimental verification, and technical reports, thereby enhancing their professional competence in solving real-world engineering problems. The course design emphasizes the combination of theory and practice, laying a solid foundation for students' future career development in aerospace technology, autonomous driving, industrial inspection, and related fields.

default.zh: 计算成像是集几何光学、信息光学、计算光学、现代信号处理等理论与一体的新兴交叉技术研究领域，将光学系统设计与数字图像处理相结合，获取传统成像光学系统无法发挥的光学极限。通过光学计算成像技术课程的讲授，使学生能够了解光学计算成像技术可应用的领域和发展方向，为未来计算成像领域研究建立理论基础。课程主要内容包括：（1）计算成像技术概述；（2）计算孔径编码成像技术；（3）计算光场成像技术；（4）计算三维成像技术；（5）计算超分辨率成像技术；（6）计算成像技术应用及未来方向。
default.en: Optical Computational Imaging (OCI) is a modern and novel research field and relates with the Geometry optics, the Information optics, the Computational optics and the Modern signal process. By using optical system design and digital imaging process, OCI can achieve a higher performance which the traditional imaging system cannot gain due to some optical limits. At this course, we make the students to understand the essential theory, application and development of OCI in order to establish the consciousness of OCI. The course content includes (1) the theory of OCI, (2) the computational coded aperture imaging technology, (3) the computational optical field imaging technology, (4) the computational 3D imaging technology, (5) the computational superresolution imaging technology, and the applied and future of OCI.

default.zh: 《红外视觉系统原理与应用》课程是智能视觉工程专业唯一一门涉及红外技术的专业基础课程。该课程是从事红外视觉成像系统设计、红外辐射计算、红外辐射测温、红外辐射源设计、红外辐射参数测量、红外探测器设计、红外诱饵研制、红外检测及诊疗仪器设计、红外对地遥感、红外制导、红外探测与识别等领域工作的基础和前提。该课程既有系统的基础理论，又有广泛的应用领域，且理论不断发展、技术持续迭代更新。本着处理好基础与应用、面与点及系统理论与新进展的关系，同时考虑我校的智能+专业学科建设特色，课程除了重点讲授成像与视觉的基本概念、红外辐射基本概念、红外辐射基本规律外，还主要介绍典型红外辐射源及目标与背景的红外光谱辐射特性、红外的大气传输、红外光学系统、红外探测器及其制冷技术、信号处理与显示、红外定标及量值传递与溯源、红外技术的工程应用等内容，让学生掌握红外辐射的基本概念与定律、红外辐射的发生、传输、成像、显示等相关理论知识，了解红外辐射标准的建立、辐射定标以及量值传递与溯源等基本概念和方法，具备解决红外辐射分析计算、成像、测量、探测等红外技术的基础知识、应用技能与专业素质，为今后从事光电信息科学与工程方面的工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: Principles and Applications of Infrared Vision Systems is the sole specialized foundational course in the Intelligent Visual Engineering program that covers infrared technology. This course serves as the fundamental prerequisite for careers involving the design of infrared visual imaging systems, infrared radiation calculations, infrared radiation thermometry, infrared radiation source design, infrared radiation parameter measurements, infrared detector development, infrared decoy fabrication, infrared-based diagnostic and therapeutic instrument design, infrared Earth remote sensing, infrared guidance, and infrared detection/recognition technologies. The curriculum integrates systematic foundational theories with broad application domains, reflecting continuous advancements in both theoretical frameworks and technological iterations. Guided by the principles of balancing foundational knowledge with practical applications, comprehensive coverage with focused depth, and established system theories with cutting-edge developments—while aligning with our university's "Intelligence+" disciplinary development strategy—the course emphasizes core concepts in imaging and vision, fundamental principles of infrared radiation, and key laws governing infrared phenomena. Key teaching contents include: basic concepts of imaging and vision, basic concepts and laws of infrared radiation, typical infrared radiation sources, infrared spectral radiation characteristics of targets and backgrounds, infrared atmospheric transmission, infrared optical systems, infrared detectors and their cooling technologies, signal processing and display, infrared calibration, measurement value transfer and traceability, and engineering applications of infrared technology. Through this program, students will master: the basic concepts and laws of infrared radiation; theories related to infrared radiation generation, transmission, imaging, and display; methods for establishing infrared radiation standards, radiation calibration, and measurement value transfer/traceability; and acquire foundational knowledge, applied skills, and professional qualities to solve practical problems in infrared radiation analysis, infrared imaging, infrared measurement, and infrared detection, laying a solid foundation for future careers in optoelectronic information science and engineering.

default.zh: 光纤视觉传输技术课程面向智能视觉工程专业的本科生开课，是一门涉及光学、光纤、数字电路等多学科交叉的综合性很强的专业选修课。该课程讲授光纤传光原理及特性、光视觉传输传输系统和信息光纤传感技术等知识，以培养学生独立获取知识的能力为第一位，在重点讲授基本原理、基础知识、关键技术和适用技术上，结合实际研究结果，拓宽学生知识面，使学生掌握实际的光纤应用技术，为学生将来参加相关科研、就业、继续深造奠定技术基础。通过课程向大家介绍光纤视觉传输应用领域所涉及的基础知识和相关技术，包光纤视觉传输技术及系统和光纤传感技术和新型应用方向。该课程能够培养学生多学科综合运用能力以及高通量视觉传输问题的解决能力。除课堂讲授外，通过让学生自己查阅资料、完成设计作业和计算仿真等方式，提高学生学习的自主性和使用现代化信息工具的能力，同时根据该领域的发展，介绍新技术、新应用等，扩展学生视野，为将来深入学习和解决实际问题提供思路。
default.en: The Fiber Optic Vision Transmission Technology course is designed for undergraduate students majoring in Intelligent Vision Engineering. It is an interdisciplinary elective course that integrates optics, fiber optics, digital circuits, and other fields. The course covers the principles and characteristics of fiber optic light transmission, optical vision transmission systems, and information fiber optic sensing technology. Its primary goal is to cultivate students' ability to independently acquire knowledge, with a focus on fundamental principles, core concepts, key technologies, and applicable techniques. By incorporating practical research findings, the course broadens students' knowledge base, equips them with practical fiber optic application skills, and lays a technical foundation for their future participation in related research, employment, or further studies. The course introduces foundational knowledge and relevant technologies in the field of fiber optic vision transmission applications, including fiber optic vision transmission technology and systems, fiber optic sensing technology, and emerging application directions. It aims to develop students' multidisciplinary integration capabilities and their ability to solve high-throughput vision transmission problems. Beyond classroom instruction, the course enhances students' autonomy in learning and their proficiency in using modern information tools. Additionally, it keeps students updated on the latest advancements in the field, introducing new technologies and applications to broaden their perspectives and provide insights for future in-depth studies and practical problem-solving.

default.zh: 机器视觉相机是智能视觉工程的核心硬件，通过该课程的学习，使学生从系统设计、系统分析、系统装配对机器视觉相机课程具有系统的掌握，为学生在将来科研过程、实验过程、生产实际过程中对机器视觉的实际应用提供工具方法、分析方法和借鉴技术，使学生视觉相机设计更加接近实际，更有利于操作化和工程化。通过仿真方式使学生感性认识相机元件非理想状态引起的成像变化，使学生理解视觉相机设计的必要性和重要性。从相机光学系统误差设计引出视觉误差，通过误差分配方法指导相机设计，通过对设计软件的使用的学习，使学生掌握基本的相机设计方法、机械设计软件与光学设计软件之间的数据转换方法；通过对机器视觉相机数值分析，使学生掌握机器视觉性能评估方法和相应的分析工具及分析方法；通过光学系统装调方法与机构设计使学生掌握具体视觉相机装调设计原则和典型实用机构，为学生在将来实际工作中提供设计思路和设计参考。
default.en: Machine vision cameras are the core hardware of intelligent vision engineering. Through this course, students will systematically master the design, analysis, and assembly of machine vision cameras, providing them with practical tools, analytical methods, and reference techniques for the real-world application of machine vision in future research, experimentation, and production processes. This enables students to design vision cameras that are more practical, operational, and engineering-oriented. By simulating the effects of non-ideal states of camera components on imaging, students will gain an intuitive understanding of the necessity and importance of vision camera design. Starting from the error design of the camera's optical system, the course introduces visual errors and guides camera design through error allocation methods. Through the study of design software usage, students will acquire fundamental camera design techniques and data conversion methods between mechanical design software and optical design software. Numerical analysis of machine vision cameras will equip students with performance evaluation methods, along with corresponding analytical tools and techniques. Additionally, by learning optical system alignment and mechanism design, students will grasp the principles of visual camera alignment and assembly as well as practical mechanisms, offering them design insights and references for future practical work.

default.zh: 《多传感器智能融合成像技术》课是基于多谱段成像信息融合、多类型传感器像质增强的智能融合成像专业课，可服务于智能视觉工程、光电信息科学与工程、电子科学与技术、光学工程等学科，作为专业选修课为本科生未来从事应用光学、智能视觉、精密仪器等领域的科学研究、工程实践应用提供引导性支持。作为大三、大四学生选修课，注重学生实践操作，给学生提供基本可见光/红外成像系统图像视频的操作过程，结合图像数据信号，实现像素融合的算法试验。 课程目标1：了解和掌握多波段光学成像系统设计的理论基础、技术途径、核心难点、发展趋势和前沿应用；了解和掌握惯性传感器、位置传感器、温度传感器等对补偿环境变化、增强成像像质的作用，具备根据不同应用环境，开展成像性能分析、智能成像增强的设计理念，能够综合运用多传感器信息融合方法提升成像系统的鲁棒性与适应性。 课程目标2：通过可见光和红外多波段成像实验与案例分析，培养学生对多传感器智能融合成像系统的建模、仿真、优化与集成能力，形成对影响成像因素的分析能力，结合多传感器信息开展补偿、标定，提升图像像质和光谱信息可信度。 课程目标3：通过多多因素的分析，使学生其具备解决复杂工程问题的实践素养和创新意识能力。
default.en: 《Multi-sensor Fusion for Intelligent Imaging》 is a professional course based on multi-spectral imaging information fusion and multi-sensor image quality enhancement. It mainly serves disciplines such as Intelligent Vision Engineering, Optoelectronic Information Science and Engineering, Electronic Science and Technology, and Optical Engineering. As a professional elective course, it provides guiding support for undergraduates who intend to engage in scientific research and engineering applications in the fields of applied optics, intelligent vision, and precision instrumentation in the future. Designed for junior and senior undergraduates, the course emphasizes practice, offering students operational experience with basic visible-light/infrared imaging systems for images and videos, combined with image data signals, to conduct algorithmic experiments for pixels fusion. Target 1:？？ Understand and master the theoretical foundations, technical approaches, core challenges, development trends, and cutting-edge applications of multi-band optical imaging system design; learn the roles of inertial sensors, position sensors, temperature sensors, and others in compensating for environmental changes and enhancing imaging quality. Develop the ability to conduct imaging performance analysis and intelligent imaging enhancement design tailored to different application environments, and be capable of comprehensively utilizing multi-sensor information fusion methods to improve the robustness and adaptability of imaging systems. Target 2:？ Through experiments and case studies involving visible and infrared multi-band imaging, cultivate students' abilities in modeling, simulation, optimization, and integration of multi-sensor intelligent fusion imaging systems. Foster analytical skills for identifying factors affecting imaging, and enable the use of multi-sensor information for compensation and calibration to enhance image quality and the reliability of spectral information. Target 3:？？ Through multi-factorial analysis, equip students with practical literacy and innovative problem-solving capabilities to address complex engineering challenges.

default.zh: 为了转变传统教育思想观念，变被动教学为主动开放式求学，培养学生协作攻关、善于创新、勤于实践、攻坚克难的科研精神，特此在整个大二春季学期开设创新科研实践课程。本课程以项目实践为主，要求每位学生根据自身的兴趣和需求，从创新科研实践数据库中自主选择项目内容，在对应的科研项目导师指导下，掌握科学研究基本方法，熟悉整个科学研究流程，将所学的理论知识与具体实际问题相结合，自主完成创新性研究项目设计，研究实施方案论证，最终完成项目结题报告、成果汇报等工作。课程考核方式主要分为：项目开题，中期检查，结题答辩验收等。
default.en: 划译 In order to transform traditional educational ideas and concepts, change passive teaching into active and open learning, and cultivate students' scientific research spirit of collaborating, innovating, practicing, and tackling difficulties, an innovative scientific research practice course is specially offered throughout the spring semester of sophomore year. This course is mainly based on project practice, requiring each student to independently choose project content from the innovative scientific research practice database based on their own interests and needs.Under the guidance of the corresponding scientific research project mentor, students will master basic methods of scientific research, familiarize themselves with the entire scientific research process, combine the theoretical knowledge learned with specific practical problems, independently complete the design of innovative research projects, and complete the research content of the project.Finally, they will complete project conclusion reports, results reporting, and other work.The assessment methods of the course mainly include project proposal, mid-term inspection, and conclusion defense and acceptance.

default.zh: 毕业实习是工程力学专业的必修课程，对学生专业素质能力的培养具有重要意义，在本科培养阶段占有重要地位。工程力学专业培养具备力学领域宽厚的理论基础、先进的专业技术，具有良好的数理分析、建模、计算、解决工程实际问题和良好的表述问题的能力，可在力学、航空航天、机械、土木、交通、材料、能源动力等领域从事科研、设计、开发、试验、教学和管理等工作，具有社会责任、专业知识、人文关怀、国际视野和创新能力的领军人才。为了达到这一目标，特别是作为一所具备航天背景的院校，需要加强学生对航天领域的力学相关知识的了解。此外，生产实习是工科院校学生工程知识教育的重要环节,通过生产实习使学生在掌握控制学科基本知识的基础上，了解理论知识与工程实际的联系，可以在理论和工程实践之间起到一个桥梁作用，并为学生从学校走向社会起到一个很好的过渡作用。通过生产实习培养学生的实际操作能力，在生产实际中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力，使学生了解理论知识与工程实际的联系，扩大眼界，丰富知识，为学生走向工作岗位奠定基础，对于培养具有国际视野的领军人才具有重要意义。 实习的主要内容包括：了解和掌握火箭结构设计中的力学问题以及所涉及和运用的力学原理及理论，能够针对某一设计指标要求依据力学原理给出可行的设计方案。掌握火箭整体及部分结构的强度、模态、极端环境下的力学性能的测试方法及力学原理，并能设计实验测试所需要的力学性能。培养学生在工程实践中自觉遵守工程职业道德，承担社会责任，增强人文关怀，强调环境保护和可持续发展。 实习方式有：听取报告、组织参观、实践实习、阅读实习教材、实习日记、实习报告、其它活动。
default.en: Graduation practice is a compulsory course for engineering mechanics majors, which is of great significance to the cultivation of students' professional quality and ability, and plays an important role in the undergraduate training stage. Engineering mechanics training has a broad theoretical foundation in the field of mechanics, advanced professional technology, good mathematical analysis, modeling, calculation, ability to solve practical engineering problems and good presentation problems, and can be used in mechanics, aerospace, machinery, civil engineering , Transportation, materials, energy, power and other fields engaged in scientific research, design, development, testing, teaching and management, with social responsibility, professional knowledge, humanistic care, international perspective and innovative ability. In order to achieve this goal, especially as a college with aerospace background, it is necessary to strengthen students' knowledge of mechanics-related knowledge in the aerospace field. In addition, production practice is an important part of engineering knowledge education for engineering college students. Through production practice, students can master the basic knowledge of control disciplines and understand the connection between theoretical knowledge and engineering practice. It can play a role between theory and engineering practice. It acts as a bridge and plays a good transition role for students from school to society. Through production practice, students' practical ability is cultivated, and the ability to investigate, observe, analyze, and solve problems in production practice is provided, so that students understand the connection between theoretical knowledge and engineering practice, expand their horizons, enrich their knowledge, and move students to work positions. Laying the foundation is of great significance for training leading talents with an international perspective. The main contents of the internship include: understanding and mastering the mechanical problems in the design of rocket structure, the mechanical principles and theories involved and applied, and being able to give a feasible design scheme based on the mechanical principles according to a design index requirement. Master the test methods and mechanics of the strength, modal, and mechanical properties of the rocket in the whole and part of the structure, and be able to design the mechanical properties required for experimental testing. Cultivate students to consciously abide by engineering ethics in engineering practice, assume social responsibility, enhance humanistic care, and emphasize environmental protection and sustainable development. The internship methods include: listening to reports, organizing visits, practical internships, reading internship teaching materials, internship diaries, internship reports, and other activities.

default.zh: 《先进复合材料结构设计课程设计》旨在为学生提供深入了解复合材料设计领域的机会。课程以传授复合材料设计的基本知识和典型结构件、典型产品的设计过程为主线，旨在培养学生对先进复合材料结构设计的深刻理解与应用能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握复合材料结构设计的方法和特点，具备开拓复合材料结构的分析与设计的能力，为未来的科研工作奠定坚实基础。 在本课程中，学生将深入研究复合材料的基本性质、结构设计原理以及先进复合材料产品的设计流程。通过系统学习，学生将理解不同类型复合材料的特性，学习如何选择合适的复合材料以满足特定工程需求。重点将放在典型结构件和产品的设计上，以真实案例为基础，培养学生解决实际工程问题的能力。本课程还将注重培养学生的团队协作和创新思维。通过项目合作和实践案例，学生将有机会运用所学知识解决实际设计挑战，锻炼他们的团队合作和创新能力。课程设计的实践性质将使学生能够将理论知识应用于实际项目中，从而更好地理解和掌握先进复合材料结构设计的要点。 通过本课程的学习，学生将不仅具备扎实的复合材料结构设计理论基础，还将具备独立分析和解决实际问题的能力。能够在复合材料领域从事科研、工程设计等工作，为推动先进复合材料技术的发展贡献力量。因此，本课程不仅是为学生提供专业知识，更是为培养他们的实际操作能力和创新思维，使其在复合材料领域具备竞争力和创造力。
default.en: "Course Design of Advanced Composites Structural Design" aims to provide students with the opportunity to gain an in-depth understanding of the field of composite materials design. The course focuses on teaching the basic knowledge of composite material design and the design process of typical structural parts and typical products, aiming to cultivate students' in-depth understanding and application ability of advanced composite material structural design. Through the study of this course, students will master the methods and characteristics of composite material structure design, have the ability to develop the analysis and design of composite material structures, and lay a solid foundation for future scientific research work. In this course, students will delve into the basic properties of composite materials, structural design principles, and the design process of advanced composite products. Through systematic study, students will understand the characteristics of different types of composite materials and learn how to select appropriate composite materials to meet specific engineering needs. The focus will be on the design of typical structural parts and products, based on real cases, to cultivate students' ability to solve practical engineering problems. This course will also focus on cultivating students' teamwork and innovative thinking. Through project collaboration and practical cases, students will have the opportunity to apply the knowledge they have learned to solve practical design challenges and exercise their teamwork and innovation abilities. The practical nature of the course design will enable students to apply theoretical knowledge to actual projects, thereby better understanding and mastering the key points of advanced composite structural design. Through the study of this course, students will not only have a solid theoretical foundation of composite material structural design, but also have the ability to independently analyze and solve practical problems. Be able to engage in scientific research, engineering design and other work in the field of composite materials, and contribute to the development of advanced composite materials technology. Therefore, this course not only provides students with professional knowledge, but also cultivates their practical ability and innovative thinking, making them competitive and creative in the field of composite materials.

(2) Improve the hands-on ability of experiments, improve the ability of self-study and the ability to work independently, so that students receive the basic training that engineers should have, and have the basic ability to carry out scientific research. (3) Cultivate students' expression ability and team spirit, cultivate innovative consciousness and spirit, establish correct outlook on life and values, and further improve their ideological and political quality.

default.zh: 认识实习是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生了解基本生产知识、印证、巩固和丰富已学过的专业课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在实际工作中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。通过安排学生前往山东工业陶瓷研究设计院、山东硅元集团公司等单位认识实习，听专家与现场技术员讲座，参观陶瓷复合材料的生产环节，熟悉复合材料的设计、制备、应用等相关专业知识。使学生了解现代化生产方式和先进制造技术，培养学生对本专业的浓厚兴趣，努力学好本专业知识。
default.en: Cognition practice is very important practical teaching link in undergraduate teaching plan, and its purpose is to make students understand the basic professional knowledge, confirm, strengthen and rich the learned professional curriculum content, train students to integrate theory with practice, and improve the ability and the method to investigate, study, observe, analyze and solve the problem in the practical work, in order to lay the foundation for follow-up professional courses. In Prime Planet Energy Dalian Company Limited, the students listen to lectures from the experts and the field technicians, visit composite materials production in lithium battery, familiar with the design, preparation and application of composite materials and other related professional knowledge, in order to make the students understand the modern production mode and advanced manufacturing technology, and cultivate students to be interest in this professional and make great efforts to learn the professional knowledge.

default.zh: 生产实习是为即将进行的毕业论文做好准备的关键性环节，其目的是使学生深入理解毕业论文的意义，为毕业论文收集资料，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实践中调查研究、发现问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为毕业论文打下良好基础。通过安排学生前往中国航天科工集团第六研究院，听专家与现场技术人员讲座，参观树脂基复合材料生产环节，熟悉复合材料的设计、制备、应用等相关专业知识；使学生了解复合材料的现代化生产方式、先进制造技术以及先进的管理方法，培养学生热爱专业、致力于祖国社会主义建设的思想。
default.en: Production practice is the key link for the upcoming graduation thesis, and its purpose is to make students understand the meaning of the thesis and collect data for graduation thesis, to train the students to integrate theory with practice, and to improve their ability and methods to investigate, study, find, analyze and solve the problems in the production practice, in order to lay a good foundation for their thesis. In The Sixth Research Academy of China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation, the students listen to the lectures from the experts and the field technicians, visit the production processes of resin matrix composites, and familiar with the design, preparation and application of composite materials and other related professional knowledge. The production practice can make the students understand the modern mode of production, advanced composite materials manufacturing technology and advanced management methods, and cultivate students to love this professional and have the idea to dedicate to the motherland socialist construction.

default.zh: 《先进复合材料结构智能设计课程设计》是复合材料与工程相关专业学生完成专业基础课和专业课后开设的一门专业基础课程设计。目的在于让学生掌握复合材料结构智能设计的基础知识和方法，能够在给定设计条件和设计要求下，通过分组合作、查阅文献资料完成材料结构智能设计，并通过计算校核材料的强度和刚度，分析评估其力学性能，并在此基础下独立完成设计报告；最后，分组进行设计结果的报告。 通过本课程的学习，旨在让学生掌握先进复合材料结构智能设计的基本理论、基本方法和过程。为拓宽学科方向和今后从事相关研究奠定必要的基础。
default.en: " Course Design of Intelligent Design for Advanced Composite Material Structures " is a professional basic curriculum design for students of composite materials and engineering, who have completed the professional basic and professional courses. So that students can master the basic knowledge and methods of structural design of composite materials. Given certain conditions and requirements, they can complete the material structure intelligent design through the group cooperation and consult literature, and then calculate the strength and stiffness of the material, analysis and evaluation mechanics performance. Everyone should complete the design report independently. Finally, each group represents will have a report about their design. Through the study of this course, students are required to master the basic theory, basic methods and processes of advanced composite structure intelligent design. To lay the necessary foundation for broadening the direction of discipline and engaging in relevant research in the future.

default.zh: 《复合材料结构智能制备与表征》这门课程旨在面向未来复合材料与结构技术的前沿需求。系统地介绍智能复合材料的分类，并展示该领域的创新研究方向，例如4D打印智能结构。课程旨在帮助学生了解复合材料技术从传统的被动承力向现代的主动变形、智能传感与功能集成方向发展的趋势，系统地构建关于复合材料的完整知识体系，该课程涵盖从材料、成型工艺、性能表征到前沿应用的各个环节。
default.en: Intelligent Manufacturing and Characterization of Composite Structures" addresses future demands in composite material technologies. It covers classifications of smart composites and explores innovative fields such as 4D printing. The course highlights the shift from passive load-bearing to active deformation and integrated functionality, helping students build a comprehensive understanding of composites—from raw materials and manufacturing processes to performance evaluation and advanced applications.

default.zh: 为了转变传统教育思想观念，变被动教学为主动开放式求学，培养学生协作攻关、善于创新、勤于实践、攻坚克难的科研精神，特此在整个大三学期开设航天科技创新挑战研究课程。 本课程以项目实践为主，要求每位学生根据自身的兴趣和需求，从航天科技创新挑战研究数据库中自主选择项目内容，在对应的科研项目导师指导下，掌握科学研究基本方法，熟悉整个科学研究流程，将所学的理论知识与具体实际问题相结合，自主完成创新性研究项目设计，研究实施方案论证，最终完成项目结题报告、成果汇报等工作。课程考核方式主要分为：项目开题，中期检查，结题答辩验收等。
default.en: In order to transform traditional educational ideas and concepts, change passive teaching into active and open learning, and cultivate students' scientific research spirit of collaborating, innovating, practicing, and tackling difficulties, an innovative scientific research practice course is specially offered throughout the spring semester of sophomore year. This course is mainly based on project practice, requiring each student to independently choose project content from the study on innovation challenges in aerospace science and technology database based on their own interests and needs.Under the guidance of the corresponding scientific research project mentor, students will master basic methods of scientific research, familiarize themselves with the entire scientific research process, combine the theoretical knowledge learned with specific practical problems, independently complete the design of innovative research projects, and complete the research content of the project.Finally, they will complete project conclusion reports, results reporting, and other work.The assessment methods of the course mainly include project proposal, mid-term inspection, and conclusion defense and acceptance.

default.zh: 综合毕业论文（设计）是本科生专业培养的最后一个环节，是通过实践教学全面锻炼和提升学生专业综合能量和素养的关键环节。其课程目标包括： （1）进一步深化和扩展所学到的基础知识、专业知识；培养学生综合运用所学的知识，分析和解决航天、材料和力学领域的工程技术问题的能力。 （2）提高实验动手能力，提高自学能力和独立工作的能力，使学生受到工程师所应具有的基本训练，具备开展科学研究工作的基本能力。 （3）培养学生的表达能力和团队精神，培养创新意识和创新精神，树立正确的人生观、价值观，在思想政治素质方面得到进一步的提高。
default.en: Comprehensive graduation thesis (design) is the last link of undergraduate professional training, and it is a key link to comprehensively exercise and enhance students' professional comprehensive energy and quality through practical teaching.Its course objectives include: (1) Further deepen and expand the basic knowledge and professional knowledge learned;To develop students' ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve engineering problems in the field of aerospace, materials, and mechanics. (2) Improve the hands-on ability of experiments, improve the ability of self-study and the ability to work independently, so that students receive the basic training that engineers should have, and have the basic ability to carry out scientific research. (3) Cultivate students' expression ability and team spirit, cultivate innovative consciousness and spirit, establish correct outlook on life and values, and further improve their ideological and political quality.

default.zh: 企业导师短期项目是为善义班本科生开设的实践性教学环节。课程建设目的是使学生将所学的理论知识与生产实际联系起来，巩固和扩大所学的理论知识，加深学生对所学专业知识的理解，促使其更好地掌握专业课知识，提高学生分析问题与解决问题的能力；通过深入企业内部，使学生直接了解相关企业的运行模式，掌握设计、工艺、检测、质量等方面相关知识，感受企业精神，了解企业经营战略，增长经验，开拓思路，通过组织技术难题项目实践，充分发挥学生的积极性和创造力，提升学生的工程实践能力及沟通协作能力。该课程在培养学生综合能力、提升职业素养等方面具有重要作用，也为产学研的京一部紧密结合奠定了基础。
default.en: The purpose of curriculum construction is to enable students to connect the theoretical knowledge they have learned with the practical production, consolidate and expand the theoretical knowledge they have learned, deepen their understanding of the professional knowledge they have learned, promote them to better grasp the professional knowledge, and improve their ability to analyze and solve problems; By going deep into the enterprise, students can directly understand the operation mode of relevant enterprises, master the relevant knowledge of design, technology, testing, quality, etc., feel the spirit of enterprise, understand the business strategy of enterprises, increase experience, and develop ideas. Through organizing the practice of technical problems, students can give full play to their enthusiasm and creativity, and improve their engineering practice ability and communication and cooperation ability. This course plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive ability and improving their professional quality, and also lays a foundation for further close integration of industry, university and research.

default.zh: 毕业实习是为即将进行的毕业论文做好准备的关键性环节，其目的是使学生深入理解毕业论文的意义，为毕业论文收集资料，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实践中调查研究、发现问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为毕业论文打下良好基础。 通过安排学生前往相关研究院所或相关企事业单位，听专家与现场技术人员讲座，参观院所/企业生产/设计环节，熟悉复合材料/飞行器的设计、制备、应用等相关专业知识；使学生了解复合材料/飞行器的研究设计方式、先进制造技术以及先进的管理方法，培养学生热爱专业、致力于祖国社会主义建设的思想。
default.en: Graduation practice is a key link to prepare for the upcoming graduation thesis. Its purpose is to enable students to deeply understand the significance of the graduation thesis, collect data for the graduation thesis, train students to integrate theory with practice, improve their ability and methods to investigate, find, analyze and solve problems in production practice, and lay a good foundation for the graduation thesis. By arranging students to go to relevant research institutes or enterprises and institutions, listen to lectures from experts and on-site technical personnel, visit the production/design processes of institutes/enterprises, and become familiar with professional knowledge related to the design, preparation, and application of composite materials/aircraft; Enable students to understand the research and design methods, advanced manufacturing technologies, and advanced management methods of composite materials/aircraft, and cultivate their love for their profession and dedication to the construction of socialism in the motherland.

default.zh: 国内航天院所研学课程旨在通过直接参与和体验来提升对航天科学和技术的理解和兴趣。这些课程覆盖航天科技的各个方面,结合理论学习和实践操作，介绍航天历史、基本原理、主要技术和未来趋势,从基础的航天知识到先进的航天技术应用，邀请航天领域的专家学者进行讲座，分享最新的航天科研成果和探索经验，增进学生的学术视野和职业认识,培养学生的科学素养、技术技能、创新思维和团队合作能力。
default.en: Domestic aerospace institutions' research and study programs aim to enhance understanding and interest in aerospace science and technology through direct participation and experience. These courses cover all aspects of aerospace technology, combining theoretical learning and practical operations. They introduce the history of aerospace, basic principles, main technologies, and future trends, from basic aerospace knowledge to advanced aerospace technology applications. Experts and scholars in the field of aerospace are invited to give lectures, share the latest aerospace research findings and exploration experiences, broaden students' academic horizons and professional understanding, and cultivate students' scientific literacy, technical skills, innovative thinking, and teamwork abilities.

default.zh: 国外研学与实习课程结合教育学习和实践经验的国际化教育项目，旨在通过海外学习和实践机会，提升学生的专业能力、跨文化交流技巧和全球视野。课程让学生将有机会深入了解和体验目的地国家的文化、语言和社会习俗，增进对不同文化的理解和尊重，通过在实验室实习环节，学生可以在实际工作环境中应用所学知识，培养专业技能和工作素养，为未来职业生涯做好准备，参与这些项目的学生将与来自世界各地的同学和专业人士交流合作，有机会构建国际化的职业网络，为在全球化的世界中取得成功奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Overseas study and internship programs are international education initiatives that combine educational learning with practical experience, aimed at enhancing students' professional abilities, cross-cultural communication skills, and global perspectives through overseas study and practice opportunities. These programs provide students with the opportunity to deeply understand and experience the culture, language, and social customs of the host country, enriching their appreciation and respect for diverse cultures. Through internship components in laboratories, students can apply their acquired knowledge in real work environments, developing professional skills and work ethic, and preparing for their future careers. Participants in these programs will engage in exchanges and collaborations with peers and professionals from around the world, creating an international professional network and laying a solid foundation for success in a globalized world.

Its course objectives include: (1) Further deepen and expand the basic knowledge and professional knowledge learned; To develop students' ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve engineering problems. (2) Improve the hands-on ability of experiments, improve the ability of self-study and the ability to work independently, so that students receive the basic training that engineers should have, and have the basic ability to carry out scientific research. default.en: Production practice is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan. The purpose is to enable students to understand basic production knowledge, confirm and consolidate the content of professional courses they have learned, cultivate students' theory to practice, and improve their investigation and research in actual work Problems, analytical problems and problem-solving abilities and methods lay the foundation for subsequent professional courses and completion of graduation thesis. To enable students to understand the development of modern aerospace technology, modern spacecraft production methods, advanced manufacturing technology and advanced management methods, and understand the role of the theory and skills of this specialty in modern science and technology and national defense. It is beneficial to the students in this major to better master the basic knowledge and professional knowledge of control theory and control skills, and to improve their ability to use existing knowledge to solve practical problems. Students can be specifically and vividly educated on labor perspectives, organizational discipline, professional ethics, etc., and cultivate students' ambitions to love majors and commit to socialist construction in the motherland.

default.zh: 《飞行器创新设计与实践》是一门飞行器设计类（未来技术模块）学生的课程。本课程作为学生正式毕业设计前的预演牵引和成果储备，以学生成长为中心，促进导师团队与学生互动，以学生成果为导向，丰富学生毕业成果及奖励。学生通过选择及联系导师、进入团队、参加组会、记录科研及心得、选定题目、开展研究、凝练成果，最终通过发表论文、申请专利、竞赛获奖等形式完成结题评审、评优。通过该课程的学习，学生可以初步掌握解决科学问题的基本方法和技能，为日后从事航天器应用专业的研究工作奠定初步基础。
default.en: “Innovative Design and Practice of Aircraft" is a course for students majoring in Aircraft Design (Future Technology Module). This course serves as a rehearsal guide and achievement reserve for students before their formal graduation project. It focuses on student growth, promotes interaction between the mentor team and students, and is guided by student achievements, enriching students' graduation achievements and rewards. Students select and contact mentors, join teams, participate in group meetings, record research and experience, choose topics, conduct research, condense results, and ultimately complete project review and evaluation through publishing papers, applying for patents, and winning competitions. Through the study of this course, students can initially master the basic methods and skills for solving scientific problems, laying a preliminary foundation for future research in the field of spacecraft applications.

Its course objectives include: (1) Further deepen and expand the basic knowledge and professional knowledge learned;To develop students' ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve engineering problems in the aerospace field. (2) Improve the hands-on ability of experiments, improve the ability of self-study and the ability to work independently, so that students receive the basic training that engineers should have, and have the basic ability to carry out scientific research. default.zh: 《激光技术课程设计》为电子科学与技术专业的核心课程。在先修课程《激光技术》的学习基础上，通过“高重频全固态激光器的设计”、“固体激光器中基横模激光产生与实现”、“甜甜圈激光器设计”、“小型化电光调Q激光器设计”等在内的八个设计题目的理论学习与实验实践，可使学生在理论学习的基础上，进一步加强对激光技术理论知识的理解和掌握，加深学生对激光器件组成、激光原理和激光技术的理解，了解激光器件和激光技术在工业、军事和科研等领域中的应用。学生在完成本课程学习后，应能够掌握课程设计内容，开展实验实践并完成设计要求；通过具有综合性的课程设计题目的锻炼，提升综合运用所学知识进行分析和解决问题的能力，同时在课程设计过程中进一步锻炼语言表达能力、团队协作能力和实践动手能力，为今后从事激光方向的科学研究打下基础。
default.en: Course Design of Laser Technology is a core course for the Electronic Science and Technology major. Building on the prerequisite Laser Technology, the course combines theory and practice through design topics such as high-repetition-rate all-solid-state lasers, fundamental transverse mode generation in solid-state lasers, doughnut lasers, and miniaturized electro-optically Q-switched lasers. Students will deepen their understanding of laser principles, device structures, and applications in industry, defense, and research. The course also strengthens problem-solving, teamwork, communication, and hands-on skills, providing a solid foundation for future research in the laser field.

default.zh: 微电子科学与工程专业生产实习在校内微电子实验室指导学生进行微电子器件（如双极型晶体管）制作，完成工艺操作及工艺参数测试。 双极型晶体管主要工艺步骤：（1）清洗→（2）一氧→（3）光刻基区→（4）硼扩→(5)光刻发射区→(6)磷扩→(7)光刻引线孔→(8)镀铝→(9)反刻铝→(10)去胶并合金化→(11)中测→(12)划片→(13)上架烧结→(14)压焊→(15)封帽→(16)成测。其中，重点应掌握氧化、光刻、扩散关键单项工艺。 采取累加式考核方式计分：30%平时表现+30%结课考试+40%实习报告，满分100分。 通过生产实习教学环节培养，使学生了解微电子产品生产现状，熟悉常用生产设备、仪器，产品制作过程，巩固和丰富已学过的专业知识。培养学生的动手能力，理论联系实际能力。提高解决实际问题的能力和综合素质。并为后续课程学习打好基础。
default.en: The course of Production Practice in Microelectronics science & engineering, guide the students to fabricate the microelectronics devices (such as bipolar transistor) on the silicone substrate in the intramural microelectronics Laboratory, completing all the operation of the process flow and the measure of the process parameters. To carry out the process production of Bipolar Transistor at the microelectronics laboratory, the main process are as follows: (1)Cleaning→(2)First oxidation→(3)Lithography base→(4)B-diffusion→(5)Lithography emitter→(6)P-diffusion→(7)Lithography stack contact→(8)Aluminum Evaporation→(9) Etchback Aluminum→(10) Phototesist stripping and Alloying→(11)Middle test→(12)Scribe→(13)Sintering on the cassette→(14)Wirebonding→(15)Packaging→(16)Final test. Among these processes, the students should focus on the key individual processes such as oxidation, photolithography and diffusion. The evaluation of this course adopts cumulative assessment score: usual performance accounted for 30% of the total score, the final exam accounted for 30% of the total score, internship report accounted for 40% of total score. The score was 100 points Through the training of production practice, students could understand the status quo of microelectronic products. They may be familiar with production equipment and production process with the professional knowledge to consolidate and enrich what they learned from the books. This course aims at developing students' practical ability, integrating theory with practical ability, improving the ability to solve practical problems. The studying of this course lays a good foundation for the follows courses.

default.zh: 光学遥感卫星能够迅速、准确捕获地球表面特定区域的最新时空信息，具有空间覆盖性广、重访时间短、成像光谱波段多、图像纹理信息丰富、可长时间凝视成像等优点，是获取重点区域态势信息的重要手段。光学遥感图像处理技术已被广泛应用于数字城市、地理国情监测、环境保护、灾害应急响应等各个领域。 本课程主要通过引导学生学会如何针对任务需求，进行遥感图像处理方法设计，熟悉小目标检测、舰船目标检测、飞机目标检测、目标跟踪、图像复原、超分辨率重建等处理应用方法，学会使用常用编程软件，培养学生工程实践创新能力。
default.en: Optical remote sensing satellites can quickly and accurately capture the latest spatiotemporal information of specific areas on the Earth's surface. They have the advantages of wide spatial coverage, short revisit time, multiple imaging spectral bands, rich image texture information, and can be used for long-term staring imaging. They are important means of obtaining situational information in key regions. Optical remote sensing image processing technology has been widely applied in various fields such as digital cities, geographical and national monitoring, environmental protection, and disaster emergency response. This course mainly guides students to learn how to design remote sensing image processing methods based on task requirements, familiarize themselves with processing application methods such as small target detection, ship target detection, aircraft target detection, target tracking, image restoration, super-resolution reconstruction, etc., learn to use commonly used programming software, and cultivate students' engineering practical innovation ability.
