default.zh: 智能视觉系统课程设计是衔接智能视觉理论知识与工程实践的核心实践环节，立足智能制造、人工智能等前沿领域需求，以培养学生系统设计、工程应用及创新能力为核心目标。本课程设计紧密结合智能视觉系统的核心技术体系，涵盖图像采集、预处理、特征提取、目标检测与识别、系统集成等关键模块，整合传感器技术、CCD/CMOS成像原理、数字图像处理算法及嵌入式视觉系统等核心知识点，实现理论与实践的深度融合。 课程设计采用“理论引导-实践操作-项目落地”的分层教学模式，引导学生从硬件选型（相机、镜头、光源等）、软件编程（基于OpenCV、PyTorch等工具）到系统调试，完整掌握智能视觉系统的设计流程与实现方法。通过模拟工业检测、目标定位、智能识别等真实应用场景，学生将分组完成综合性设计项目，在实践中深化对机器视觉与人工智能交叉融合的理解，提升问题分析、团队协作及工程创新能力，为后续从事智能视觉相关领域的研发、应用与维护工作奠定坚实的实践基础，助力学生适应智能制造产业对复合型技术人才的需求。
default.en: The course design of Intelligent Vision System is a core practical link connecting theoretical knowledge and engineering practice of intelligent vision. Based on the needs of cutting-edge fields such as intelligent manufacturing and artificial intelligence, it aims to cultivate students' abilities in system design, engineering application and innovation. Closely integrated with the core technology system of intelligent vision systems, this course design covers key modules including image acquisition, preprocessing, feature extraction, target detection and recognition, and system integration. It integrates core knowledge points such as sensor technology, CCD/CMOS imaging principles, digital image processing algorithms and embedded vision systems, realizing in-depth integration of theory and practice. Adopting a hierarchical teaching mode of "theoretical guidance - practical operation - project implementation", the course design guides students to fully master the design process and implementation methods of intelligent vision systems from hardware selection (cameras, lenses, light sources, etc.), software programming (based on tools such as OpenCV and PyTorch) to system debugging. By simulating real application scenarios such as industrial inspection, target positioning and intelligent recognition, students will complete comprehensive design projects in groups, deepen their understanding of the cross-integration of machine vision and artificial intelligence in practice, and improve their abilities in problem analysis, team collaboration and engineering innovation. This course design lays a solid practical foundation for students to engage in research and development, application and maintenance in intelligent vision-related fields, helping them adapt to the demand for compound technical talents in the intelligent manufacturing industry.

default.zh: 世界在发展，科技在进步，为了拓宽同学们的视野，了解飞行器制导控制技术方面的前沿科学进展，掌握飞行器制导与控制的基本概念和基本设计过程，故开设此课程。 目前，世界各国都在投入大量的精力去推动飞行器各类相关技术与产业的发展，期望通过本门课程，使同学们了解飞行器的发展趋势，了解飞行器相关技术尤其是制导与控制技术的前沿动态。通过动手实践，促进学生将理论知识与实践相结合，灵活应用高等数学、大学物理、自动控制等基础知识。带领学生完成方法研究、程序编写与数学仿真的全过程，一方面培养同学们的思考能力和创新能力，另一方面帮助同学们初步体会科学研究工作中的设计、分析、修正设计、再次分析的研究过程。本门课程的重点在于强调训练环节，期望突出专业特色，通过学习，提高学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This course is set up in order to broaden students' horizons, understand the cutting-edge scientific progress of aircraft vehicles guidance and control technology, and master the basic concepts and basic design process of aircraft guidance and control. Today, all countries in the world are investing a lot of energy to promote the development of various types of aircraft vehicles related technologies and industries. It is expected that through this course, students can understand the development trend of aircraft-related technologies, understand the frontier dynamics of aircraft vehicles related technologies, especially guidance and control technologies. Through hands-on practice, students are encouraged to combine theoretical knowledge with practice and flexibly apply basic knowledge such as advanced mathematics, university physics and automatic control. Lead students to complete the whole process of method research, software programming and mathematical simulation, on the one hand, cultivate students' thinking ability and innovation ability, on the other hand, help students to preliminarily understand the research process of design, analysis, revision design and re-analysis in scientific research work. The focus of this course is to emphasize training links, hoping to highlight professional characteristics, and improve students' ability to analyze and solve problems through learning.

default.zh: 机器人的任务规划与控制是实现自主化、无人化、智能化的核心技术。本课程面向机器人的任务规划与控制技术，侧重各种任务规划与控制算法的学习和实践，使学生掌握任务规划技术的基本方法，并初步掌握对任务规划与控制的工程实现手段。了解任务规划技术的基础概念及其在自动控制专业的应用，学习运动规划与路径规划、任务分配、机器人任务规划与控制系统的基本方法，并对掌握其工程实现技术；增强学生的逻辑思维与实践应用能力，提高学生将理论和实际结合能力，为今后在各自领域开拓高水平的自动化与机器人技术应用奠定基础。
default.en: Robotic mission planning and control is the core technology to realize autonomy, unmanned and intelligence. This course is oriented to robotic mission planning and control technology, focusing on the learning and practice of various planning and control algorithms, so that students can master the basic methods of mission planning technology and preliminarily master the engineering implementation means of mission planning and control. Understand the basic concept of task planning technology and its application in automatic control specialty, learn the basic methods of motion planning and path planning, task allocation, robot task planning and control system, and master its engineering implementation technology; Enhance students' logical thinking and practical application ability, improve students' ability to combine theory with practice, and lay a foundation for developing high-level automation and robot technology applications in their respective fields in the future.

default.zh: 该课程涵盖了网络物理系统的建模、控制设计及分析方法，尤其关注预测控制方法。该方法通过调整模型以适应变化的环境、预测可能的行为以及优化网络物理系统的操作来实现高度的自治。除了涵盖设计方法外，该课程将会采用不同的应用实例进行讲解，以便于学生理解。
default.en: The course covers different techniques for modeling, control design, and analysis of Cyber-physical Systems (CPS). A particular focus is set on predictive control, which enables a high degree of autonomy by adapting models to changed situations, predicting likely behaviors, and optimizing the operation of CPS. In addition to the coverage of design techniques, different application examples are included for illustration.

default.zh: 图像处理与机器视觉今年来得到迅速发展。课程从工程的角度介绍视觉处理的基本知识，主要讲述底层图像处理，各类基本图像变换和视觉特征的提取，特征描述与目标识别等内容，在激发学生学习兴趣的同时使学生切实理解教学内容并能应用到实践中，为日后的专业领域研究及工程实践打好基础。课程的主要任务是，通过形象化的课堂教学、实验上机题目及实践环节，培养学生图像处理和机器视觉方向基础知识的理解和工程应用能力，培养学生的创新意识和团队协作能力。
default.en: Image processing and machine vision develop rapidly in recent years. The course introduces the basic knowledge of image and vision processing from the perspective of engineering. It mainly covers low-level image processing, various basic image transformation, visual feature extraction, feature description and target recognition, which can stimulate students' interest in learning and enable students to effectively understand course content and apply it to practice, therefore lay a good foundation for future professional research and engineering practice. The main task of the course is to cultivate students' understanding and engineering capability of basic knowledge in image processing and machine vision, and to foster students' innovation and team cooperation capability through knowledge point visualization, designed experiment topics and programming practice.

default.zh: 微电子机械系统（Micro Electro Mechanical Systems, MEMS）是近年来发展起来的一种新型多学科交叉的技术，应用该技术的陀螺仪具有体积小、成本低、功耗少、抗冲击能力强等优点，目前MEMS陀螺仪已广泛应用于航空航天、机械制造、生物化学、汽车电子等各个领域。本课程通过授课与实验形式，结合MEMS陀螺仪原理、结构和性能特点，使学生对惯性传感器件的开发和应用有直观的认知，在此基础上通过实际惯性系统设计，培养和锻炼学生的创新精神、创新思维能力和科学研究水平。同时，在教学与实验过程中，结合本学科具体情况，介绍本学科体系、学科发展过程、学科前沿和本学科特色，增进学生对本专业技术和发展方向的了解。
default.en: Micro Electro Mechanical Systems (MEMS) are new multidisciplinary technology that developed in recent years. At the moment, the MEMS gyroscope is widely used in aerospace, machinery manufacturing, biological chemistry, automotive electronics and other fields, which has with the advantages of small size, low cost, low power consumption, strong shock resistance ability, etc. In this course, the principle, the structure and the performance feature of the MEMS gyroscope is introduced by lectures and lab tutorial to show the development and application of inertial sensor to the students. On this basis, the spirit of innovation and the scientific research level are cultivated through designing the inertial system. Simultaneously, according to the subject specific situation, the subject system, developing, frontier and feature will be given in the course to enhance student’s knowledge about this professional technology and development direction.

default.zh: 信息物理系统（Cyber-Physical System， CPS）深度融合了通信、计算与控制， 能够实现信息层与物理层实时交互、动态优化。信息物理系统在智能家居、智能交通、远程医疗、智能制造以及军事等领域具有广泛的应用前景。然而，随着“震网病毒”攻击事件的发生，信息物理系统的安全问题受到极大关注。围绕信息物理系统的安全问题，本课程主要学习信息物理系统的概念、介绍相关攻击案例、学习如何从自动控制的角度分析信息物理系统的安全性、设计安全控制策略。在此基础上，依托实验室自主智能无人系统实验平台（包括无人车、无人机、机械臂、气浮平台等），带领学生开展相关实验。通过实验演示网络攻击对系统安全性的影响、验证设计的安全控制算法。 该课程属于新兴的交叉研究领域，课程主要内容包括：信息物理系统概述、信息物理系统安全性介绍、信息物理系统安全性分析、欺骗攻击情形下信息物理系统的安全滑模控制设计。
default.en: Cyber-Physical System (CPS) closely integrates communication, computing and control, enabling real-time interaction and dynamic optimization between the cyber layer and the physical layer. CPS has a wide range of applications in the fields of smart home, smart transportation, telemedicine, smart manufacturing and military, etc. However, with the occurrence of the Stuxnet attack, the security issue of cyber- physical systems has received great attention. Focusing on the security of cyber- physical systems, this course focuses on the concept of cyber-physical systems, introduces relevant attack cases, talks about how to analyze the security of cyber- physical systems from the perspective of automatic control, and designs security control strategies. On this basis, the students are led to conduct relevant experiments based on the laboratory's autonomous intelligent unmanned system experimental platform (unmanned vehicles, drones, robotic arms, air-floating platforms, etc.). The experiments demonstrate the impact of network attacks on system security and verify the designed security control algorithms. The course belongs to an emerging cross-study area, and the main contents of the course include: overview of cyber-physical systems, introduction to cyber-physical system security, cyber-physical system security analysis, and secure sliding-mode control design under deception attack scenarios.

default.zh: 光学镀膜技术是现代社会中应用广泛的材料制备技术，消费电子产品、光学元器件等都与之密切相关，在建筑节能玻璃，装饰等领域也有广泛应用。本课程开设主要培养学生学习了解光学镀膜技术的基本原理、实验与生产设备、设计软件、光学镀膜快速检测方法等。同时，通过实操上机学习，了解光学镀膜设备的使用方法。本课程共计24学时，包括8学时理论课程和16学时实验课程。
default.en: Optical coating technology is a widely used material preparation technology in modern society. Consumer electronics and optical components are closely related to it and it is also widely applied in building energy-saving glass, decoration and other fields. This course aims to train students to learn and understand the basic principle of optical coating technology, experimental and production equipment, design software, rapid detection method of optical coating, etc. At the same time, learn how to use optical coating equipment through practical operation. This course has a total of 24 course hours, including 8 course hours of theoretical courses and 16 course hours of experimental courses.

default.zh: 开发和利用生物质材料是实现“双碳”目标的有效途径，《“十四五”工业绿色发展规划》中明确将生物基材料纳入了需要重点突破的关键材料领域。本课程将通过实践引导学生了解生物质基碳材料的制备及其改性方法，熟练掌握仪器设备操作，熟悉材料关键性能评价手段，带领学生切身体验木材、竹子等常见的生物质材料由原材料转化为高效隔热碳泡沫、高性能电磁屏蔽材料等先进功能材料的全过程。课程旨在让学生近距离感受科技创新魅力，培养学生科研思维，为今后学习材料学相关专业奠定基础，并积极引导学生参加学科竞赛，帮助学生积累参赛经验，提升学生科技竞赛能力。
default.en: The development and utilization of biomass materials are effective ways to achieve “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” goals. Bio-based materials have been included in key material areas that require major breakthroughs explicitly in the “The Green Plan for Industrial Development in the 14th Five-Year Period”. This course will guide students to understand the preparation and modification methods of the biomass-based carbon materials and make them skilled in the operation of the equipment and familiar with the evaluation methods of key performance of the biomass-based carbon materials through experiment. Simultaneously, the course will guide students to prepare high-efficiency heat-insulating carbon foams and high-performance electromagnetic shielding materials using wood and bamboo as raw materials. This course aims to make students feel the charm of scientific and technological innovation closely and cultivate students' scientific research mind and lay a foundation for their future study of the majors related to materials science. Meanwhile, this course will actively guide students to participate in subject competitions, help them accumulate competition experience and improve their relative skills.

default.zh: 碳达峰、碳中和已经成为全球共识，新能源锂电池在无人机领域得到广泛应用。本课程主要讲授飞行器结构设计和姿态控制的基本方法、新能源锂电池理论和实验测试基本原理，使学生了解典型飞行器结构设计思想、关键技术方法和技术难点，熟悉飞行器能源系统发展的主要趋势，掌握先进新能源锂电池设计方法，提升实验动手能力，指导学生制备新能源飞行器模型，激发学生面向国防和国民经济关键领域进行技术创新的热情。
default.en: Carbon peaking and carbon neutrality have become a global consensus, and new energy lithium batteries have been widely used in the field of drones. This course mainly teaches the basic methods of aircraft structural design and attitude control, the theory of new energy lithium batteries and the basic principles of experimental testing, so that students can understand the structural design ideas, key technical methods and technical difficulties of typical aircraft, and be familiar with the main trends in the development of aircraft energy systems. Understand advanced new energy lithium battery design methods, improve experimental ability, guide students to prepare new energy aircraft models, and stimulate students' enthusiasm for technological innovation in key areas of national defense and national economy.

default.zh: 新型材料的EBPVD制备技术与性能表征是一门创新研究课，主要内容通过对本单位具体研究范例研发过程的解析和相应的材料性能表征实验课，使同学们清楚科学研究的整个脉络，掌握科学创新研究的基本方法，提高对科学研究的认识和兴趣。通过学生亲自动手查找、整理和总结资料，掌握科研资料的查找方法和提高对资料的综合整理分析能力。为同学们未来参与科学研究工作打下良好基础。 通过研究新型材料微观组织结构因素对测试的物理参数影响机制，加强对《材料物理性能分析》和《材料力学性能分析》等课程基本原理的充分理解和掌握。本课程充分利用多媒体课件和实验课教学优势，将科研过程详尽清楚的展示给同学们，并通过实际测量训练强化分析试验的操作能力，提高同学们科研动手能力，促进同学们对前期一些基础专业课程的理解和掌握。
default.en: EBPVD Preparation Technology and Performance Characterization of New Materials is an innovative research course. The main content of this course is to make students understand the whole chain of scientific research, master the basic methods of scientific innovation research, and enhance their understanding and interest in scientific research by explaining the specific research examples and corresponding experimental courses. Through students to find and organize and summarize the materials by themselves, let them master the search methods of scientific research materials and improve the comprehensive and analysis ability of the data. It will lay a good foundation for students to participate in scientific research work in the near future. By studying on the mechanism of new material microstructure factors affecting the test physical parameters, we can strengthen our understanding on the foundation and principles of the courses, such as “Material Physical Properties Analysis” and “Material Mechanical Properties Analysis”. This course makes full use of the advantages of multimedia courseware and experiment teaching, shows the scientific research process to students in detail and clearly, and strengthens the operation ability of experiment through actual measurement training, improves the students' scientific research ability, and promotes students' understanding and mastery of some basic professional courses in the early stage.

default.zh: 该课程以纤维增强复合材料桥梁为创新训练对象，通过桥梁设计方法和成型工艺的讲解以及桥梁实物的设计、成型和测试来提高复合材料专业本科生的实践动手能力，同时为相关高水平竞赛储备优秀人才并提高我校学生的竞赛水平。该课程主要包括纤维增强复合材料桥梁设计与成型基本理论、模具准备、铺层优化与预浸料裁剪铺放和固化成型、制品脱模与机械加工、弯曲测试等主要教学内容。
default.en: The course takes the fiber-reinforced composite bridge as the innovative training object, improves the practical ability of undergraduates majoring in composite materials through the explanation of bridge design method, composite material forming process and wing physical forming operation, and reserves excellent talents for relevant high-level competitions and improves the competition level of our school's students. The course mainly includes the basic theory of composite bridge design and molding, mold preparation, ply opt and mechanical processing, bending testing, and other main teaching contents.

default.zh: 有效载荷是空间飞行器实现航天任务的核心组成部分，《空间飞行器有效载荷设计》是研究这一核心组成部分的基本原理和设计方法的一门课程， 在培养学生航天器总体设计、有效载荷设计分析及航天器工程实践能力等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要通过讲授几类常见的、重要的航天器有效载荷（光学、通信、雷达等），使学生了解和掌握航天器有效载荷设计、使用、分析的基本原理。通过本课程的课堂教学、讨论、随堂问卷等环节，着重培养学生们航天器有效载荷设计与分析能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标的达成。
default.en: Payload is the core component of the space vehicle to realize the space mission. 'Space Vehicle Payload Design' is a course to study the basic principles and design methods of this core component. It plays an important role in cultivating students ' overall spacecraft design, payload design analysis and spacecraft engineering practice ability. This course mainly teaches several common and important spacecraft payloads (optics, communication, radar, etc.), so that students can understand and master the basic principles of spacecraft payload design, use, and analysis. Through the classroom teaching, discussion, in-class questionnaire and other links of this course, we focus on cultivating students ' ability of spacecraft payload design and analysis, increasing their awareness of innovation, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results..

default.zh: 开设本创新训练课的目的是使学生初步掌握飞行器制导与控制方法与该系统设计的基本过程，同时对新概念飞行器飞行时序、运动动力学模型及制导控制方法有一定理解。通过该课可进一步引导学生以下几方面的专业技能：1）飞行器制导与控制的基本理论；2）科研信息检索以及消化吸收；3) 熟悉并掌握VC++对飞行器制导控制方法的基本仿真思路和操作使用方法，逐步具有应用现代数字化工具解决工程实际问题的能力；4）科研报告的撰写规范。
default.en: The purpose of offering this innovative training course is to enable students to have a preliminary understanding of spacecraft guidance and control methods and the basic process of system design, while also having a certain understanding of the new concept of spacecraft flight timing, motion dynamics models, and guidance control methods. This course can further guide students in the following professional skills: 1) Basic theory of spacecraft guidance and control; 2) Research information retrieval and digestion and absorption; 3) Familiarize and master the basic simulation ideas and operation methods of VC++for spacecraft guidance and control, gradually possessing the ability to apply modern digital tools to solve practical engineering problems; 4) Writing standards for scientific research reports.

default.zh: 本课程的名称为《运载火箭设计方法与实践》，主要包括四部分内容。首先，简要介绍运载火箭的发展历史，同时介绍运载火箭的基本结构和基本概念。其次，介绍如何基于典型关机点参数反向设计运载火箭的总体参数，包括推重比、质量、直径、长度、发动机推力等。再次，简要介绍运载火箭的基本弹道形式，同时初步介绍运载火箭优化设计的基本理论。最后，讲解运载火箭总体设计的基本步骤，制导学生基于典型关机点参数完成运载火箭总体设计实践。
default.en: The course is “Launch Vehicle Design Methods and Practice”, which mainly comprises four parts: 1) the course will first introduce the developments of launch vehicles, and then fundamental concepts in overall design of launch vehicles. 2) Second, we will teach the students how to calculate the key parameters of a launch vehicle according to a specified mission. These parameters are essential for a launch vehicle and can dramatically affect control systems, trajectories, structural strengths, et al. 3) As the course proceeds, we will preliminarily introduce some knowledge on trajectory design as well as trajectory optimization in the ascending phase of a launch vehicle. 4) Finally, in the 4th part of the course, the students will learn the overall design procedure of a launch vehicle; and then, try to calculate and optimize some key parameters of a launch vehicle.

default.zh: 本课程将系统介绍当前国际航天高校和商业航天公司流行的微纳卫星设计与研制的各方面，并针对典型的微纳卫星项目的方案特点进行剖析，帮助学生更好的认识微纳卫星、了解微纳卫星的设计思路。基于紫丁香创新工场开展实验实践，锻炼学生独立解决问题能力和团队配合能力，为我校培养高水平航天人才。教学内容主要包括：微纳卫星发展现状、基本概念以及系统组成；典型微纳卫星任务剖析；微纳卫星分系统和典型载荷介绍；面向任务的微纳卫星需求分析与方案设计。
default.en: This course will give a brief introduction of the latest technology development of the field of nano-satellite, and analyse the characteristics of typical nano-satellite projects to help students better understand nano-satellites and the design arts of nano-satellites. Experimental practice based on the Lilac Nano-satellite Workshop will help students to develop independent problem-solving and teamwork skills. The content of the course includes: the current development of nano-satellite and basic concepts; typical nano-satellite mission analysis; introduction of nano-satellite subsystems and typical payloads; nano-satellite mission analysis and design.

default.zh: 本课程主要围绕弹箭姿态控制系统展开，通过本课程的学习学生将了解并学会综合运用《航天器轨道动力学》、《航天器姿态动力学》、《远程火箭弹道学与制导方法》、《导弹飞行力学》等航空宇航学科本科生核心课程和自动控制原理等知识，具备弹箭运动学和动力学建模方法、控制系统线性设计方法以及频域分析法知识基础；了解针对复杂问题的数字化设计与分析流程，具备问题分析与解决工程实践中弹箭控制系统问题的基本能力；熟悉并掌握数字化仿真软件对弹箭姿控系统的基本仿真思路和操作使用方法，逐步具有应用现代数字化工具解决工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: This course mainly focuses on the attitude control system of missiles and rockets. Through the study of this course, students will understand and learn how to comprehensively apply core courses and automatic control principles in aerospace disciplines such as "Spacecraft Orbital Dynamics", "Spacecraft Attitude Dynamics", "Remote Rocket Ballistics and Guidance Methods", "Missile Flight Mechanics", etc., and possess knowledge of missile kinematics and dynamic modeling methods Knowledge foundation of linear design methods and frequency domain analysis methods for control systems; Understand the digital design and analysis process for complex problems, and have the basic ability to analyze and solve problems in missile control systems in engineering practice; Familiarize oneself with and master the basic simulation ideas and operation methods of digital simulation software for missile attitude control systems, gradually possessing the ability to apply modern digital tools to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 卫星数字化设计课程面向飞行器设计与工程全系的本科生开课，是一门多学科交叉的主干专业选修课程，课程立足于航天工程的卫星数字化设计角度出发，把卫星设计、数字化原理、数据处理、计算机应用等知识与航天器卫星设计工程应用相结合，是培养从事数字化卫星设计和工程设计专业人才的重要组成部分。 课程主要是通过基于产品描述的数字化平台，建立数字化产品模型并在产品开发过程应用，达到减少或避免使用实物模型的一种开发技术，是提高卫星设计水平的重要途径，对实现卫星“多、快、好、省”的设计思想有着重要的意义。本课程针对卫星总体设计过程几个主要阶段的数字化问题，介绍其基本概念、原理和方法的阐述，同时，结合典型的卫星数字化设计问题工程实例，对所采用的理论、算法以及应用进行讲解，促进学生对数字化设计方法及其实际应用的理解与掌握，增加学生的学习兴趣和感性认识。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、实验教学及课程设计等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和卫星知识的应用能力，使学生进一步熟悉和掌握卫星数字化设计方法与技术，掌握三维数字化建模软件的使用方法，注重工程实践中提高学生的综合能力，使学生走上工作岗位时能很快进入“角色”。 本课程期末成绩采用累加式，包括实验完成情况和期末大作业两部分。
default.en: The Digital Design of Satellite course is offered to undergraduate students majoring in Aircraft Design and Engineering across the entire department. It serves as a multidisciplinary core elective course, grounded in the perspective of satellite digital design within aerospace engineering. This course integrates knowledge encompassing satellite design, principles of digitization, data processing, computer applications, and their practical application in spacecraft satellite design engineering. It plays a vital role in the education and training of professionals specializing in digital satellite design and engineering, forming an essential component of the curriculum. The primary focus of this course centers on the establishment of digital product models and their practical utilization within the product development process, employing a digital platform based on product descriptions. This approach is instrumental in elevating the standards of satellite design and holds paramount significance in the realization of the satellite design concept of "more, faster, better, and cost-effective." The course delves into fundamental concepts, principles, and methodologies essential for the digitization of key phases in the overarching satellite design process. Additionally, it seamlessly blends typical challenges encountered in satellite digital design with real-world engineering examples to expound upon the theories, algorithms, and applications involved. This approach not only fosters a comprehensive understanding and mastery of digital design methods and their practical applications among students but also serves to kindle their enthusiasm for learning and foster heightened perceptual awareness. The primary objective of this course is to cultivate students' innovation awareness and capabilities, as well as their ability to apply satellite knowledge, achieved through classroom instruction, hands-on experiments, and course projects. This further equips students to become well-acquainted with and proficient in satellite digital design methodologies and technologies, while also mastering the use of three-dimensional digital modeling software. The course places a strong emphasis on enhancing students' comprehensive skills through engineering practice, ensuring that they can seamlessly transition into their roles upon entering the workforce. The course exam grade is accumulative and consists of two parts: the completion of the experiments and the major final assignment.

default.zh: 本课程主要围绕四旋翼无人机导航与控制系统展开，使学生对四旋翼无人机系统的基本组成、导航与控制系统设计与实验进行更为深入地了解。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验操作和计算机仿真等环节，着重培养学生对导弹飞行力学、自动控制原理和飞行器自主导航与组合导航的相关基础知识的综合运用能力，四旋翼无人机飞控系统的综合分析与设计能力，以及对硬件系统开发应用能力。本课既可培养学生进行科研问题软件设计工作的能力，又可训练他们开发硬件的能力，为毕业设计及今后从事科研工作打下坚实基础。 课程讲授环节集中介绍四旋翼无人机发展现状、总体以及综合电子、电源系统、结构与减振、导航与控制系统等分系统的设计方法等内容。在实验环节，拟将学生划分若干小组，分别独立承担某一分系统设计与研制工作，最后将各个分系统样机综合集成与测试，形成由学生亲自设计、加工、开发、调试与测试的四旋翼无人机。本课程可面向航空宇航、力学、控制、通信、机电、微电子等诸多航天相关专业的学生开放。
default.en: This course mainly focuses on the navigation and control system of quadcopter drones, enabling students to have a deeper understanding of the basic components, navigation and control system design, and experiments of quadcopter drones. Through the classroom teaching, subsequent experimental operations, and computer simulation of this course, the focus is on cultivating students' comprehensive application ability of missile flight mechanics, automatic control principles, and related basic knowledge of autonomous and integrated navigation of aircraft. The comprehensive analysis and design ability of quadcopter unmanned aerial vehicle flight control system, as well as the ability to develop and apply hardware systems, will also be emphasized. This course can not only cultivate students' ability to design software for scientific research problems, but also train their ability to develop hardware, laying a solid foundation for graduation design and future scientific research work. The course lecture focuses on introducing the current development status, overall situation, and design methods of subsystems such as integrated electronics, power systems, structure and vibration reduction, navigation and control systems, etc. of quadcopter unmanned aerial vehicles. In the experimental phase, students will be divided into several small groups to independently undertake the design and development of a certain subsystem. Finally, the prototypes of each subsystem will be integrated and tested to form a quadcopter drone designed, processed, developed, debugged, and tested by the students themselves. This course is open to students majoring in aerospace, mechanics, control, communication, electromechanical, microelectronics, and many other aerospace related majors.

default.zh: 本课程将系统地讲授当前国际航天高校普遍流行的立方体卫星设计与研制涉及的各个方面，借助紫丁香学生微纳卫星工场开展实验实践，让学生了解与掌握紫丁香一号卫星的研制过程，锻炼其独立解决问题的能力和团队相互配合的能力，为我校培养高水平的航天专业相关人才。课程讲授环节集中介绍微纳卫星发展现状、卫星总体以及综合电子、电源系统、结构与热控、姿轨控、测控通信、载荷应用等分系统的设计方法等8部分内容。在实验环节，拟将学生划分若4-6个小组分别独立承担某一分系统设计与研制工作，最后将各个分系统样机综合集成与测试，形成由学生亲自设计、加工、开发、调试与测试的2U立方体卫星（紫丁香一号）。本课程可面向航空宇航、力学、控制、通信、机电、微电子、热能等诸多航天相关专业的学生开放。
default.en: This course will systematically teach all aspects involved in the design and development of the cube satellite which is popular in international aerospace universities. With the help of the Lilac student nano/micro satellite laboratory, it will enable students to understand and master the development process of Lilacsat-1, exercise their ability to solve problems independently and cooperate with teams, and train high-level aerospace professionals for our university. The course focuses on the development of nano/micro satellite, the overall satellite and the design methods of integrated electronics, power system, structure and thermal control, attitude and orbit control, TT&C communication, payload & application and other subsystems. In the process of experiment, the students are divided into 4-6 groups to undertake the design and development of a subsystem independently. Finally, the prototypes of each subsystem are integrated and tested to form a 2U cube satellite (Lilacsat-1) designed, processed, developed, debugged and tested by the students themselves. This course is open to students majoring in aeronautics and astronautics, mechanics, control, communications, electromechanics, microelectronics, thermal energy, etc.

default.zh: 激光是20世纪以来人类最重要的发明之一。经过多年的激光技术更新迭代和科学问题的探索，激光已在多种场景发挥了不可替代的作用。本课程根据激光领域的发展现状，以应用光学、物理光学和激光原理等先修课程的理论内容为基础，结合授课教师的研究方向，从极紫外激光光源及应用、高功率固体激光系统的发展历程及当前的主流工程设计方案、单光子成像技术和激光雷达场景图像重建技术等方面为学生介绍目前激光领域的前沿技术和应用。同时，结合实验室条件设计相关实验，让学生体验大型短波长激光光源的操作流程；深入了解高功率固体激光装置运行中的损伤风险来源，理解激光传输与放大过程中光束质量控制的重要性；实际操作单光子测量大气衰减系数实验和单光子成像实验；了解激光雷达数据采集原理，并采用三维重建方法实现不同场景无人机目标三维重建，了解真实探测场景的处理方法差异。通过理论授课和应用实践相结合的方式，让学生快速了解激光领域的前沿科学技术，培养学生设计实验、分析数据和探索科学问题的能力以及团队合作能力.
default.en: Laser is one of the most important inventions of the 20th century. After years of technological advancements and scientific exploration, lasers have played an irreplaceable role in various fields. This course is based on the current development status of the laser field, and combines theoretical contents of applied optics, physical optics, and laser principles as prerequisites. It introduces students to the cutting-edge technologies and applications in the field of lasers, such as extreme ultraviolet laser sources and applications, the development process and current mainstream engineering design schemes of high-power solid-state laser systems, single-photon imaging technology, and lidar scene image reconstruction technology, based on the research directions of the teaching staff. Additionally, according to laboratory conditions, the course provides opportunities for students to experience the operation process of large-scale short-wavelength laser sources, gain in-depth understanding of damage risks in the operation of high-power solid-state laser installation, grasp the importance of beam quality control during laser transmission and amplification, conduct practical experiments on single-photon measurement of atmospheric attenuation coefficients and single-photon imaging, and learn about the principles of data acquisition for lidar and use 3D reconstruction methods to reconstruct unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) targets in different scenarios, understanding the differences in processing methods for real detection scenarios. Through a combination of theoretical teaching and practical application, this course enables students to quickly grasp the cutting-edge scientific and technological advancements in the field of lasers, cultivate their abilities to design experiments, analyze data, explore scientific problems, and promote teamwork skills.

default.zh: 中红外光谱范围一般为2-20微米，是分子指纹区，大气透射窗口，热辐射区，以及水、聚合物等材料的高吸收区。中红外激光在痕迹量气体检测、大飞机复合材料构件无损超声检测、人眼安全激光测风雷达、激光生物医疗及光电对抗有重要应用。中红外激光材料种类繁多，如何选择合适的晶体材料，结合设计合理的谐振腔型以实现高性能激光输出，是新波段激光器设计和制备面临的重要问题。本实践课程基于掺铥、掺钬2微米激光材料，通过仿真激光输出性能、晶体在强泵浦条件下的热效应，选择优化激光介质掺杂浓度和尺寸、泵浦方式和泵浦光参数以及谐振腔型和腔镜参数，并通过实验进一步迭代优化，从而实现最佳性能的2微米激光输出。在此基础上，以2微米声光调Q掺钬激光器泵浦源，泵浦ZnGeP2光学参量振荡器(OPO)，产生3~5微米可调谐激光输出。本课程要求学生掌握2微米固体激光器设计和调试方法，掌握2微米激光参数测试方法，特别是光束质量M2因子测量和光束变换，了解非线性光学器件OPO的结构及可调谐波长测量方法。
default.en: The mid-infrared spectral range is generally 2-20 microns, which is the molecular fingerprint region, the atmospheric transmission window, the thermal radiation region, and the high-absorption region of materials such as water and polymers. Mid-infrared lasers have important applications in trace gas detection, non-destructive ultrasonic testing of composite components of large aircraft, eye-safety laser wind radar, laser biomedical treatment and countermeasures. There are many kinds of mid-infrared laser materials, and how to select the appropriate materials and combine the reasonably designed resonant cavity type to achieve high-performance laser output is an important problem in the design and preparation of new band lasers. Based on thulium-doped and holmium-doped 2-micron laser materials, this practical course selects and optimizes the doping concentration and size, pumping ways and pumping optical parameters, resonator structure and mirrors parameters of the laser by simulating the laser output performance and the thermal effect of the crystal under strong pumping conditions, and further iterative optimization through experiments to achieve the best performance of the 2-micron laser output. On this basis, a 2-micron acousto-optic Q-switched holmium-doped laser was used as a pumping source, and the ZnGeP2 optical parametric oscillator (OPO) was pumped to generate a 3~5 micron tunable laser output. This course requires students to master the design and adjusting methods of 2-micron solid-state lasers, master the measurement methods of 2-micron laser parameters, especially the M2 factor measurement and beam transformation, and understand the structure and tunable wavelength measurement methods of nonlinear optical devices OPO.

default.zh: 生物芯片是互联网医疗、智能家居的重要组成部分，具有广阔的创新空间。今年来，生物芯片的研究与发展逐渐成熟，由实验室研究向实用化产品发展。生物芯片设计多领域知识的交叉，辐射射计算机、自动控制、通信、机电一体化、生化检测等专业的知识和技术。其中的嵌入式技术是微流控芯片的流体控制与生化检测的控制核心。 本课程的目的是使学生了解以生物芯片为主的智能健康监控设备的概念，了解生物检测方法的类别，学习掌握嵌入式软件的系统分析，设计和实现的要点，围绕生物芯片中嵌入式系统的设计和应用，培养学生创新实践的兴趣和能力。 主要内容包括生物芯片的发展简介，最新生物芯片等智能健康监控设备分析，生物芯片对嵌入式系统的功能需求；嵌入式软件开发工具与方法，嵌入式软件调试工具与调试技术；嵌入式操作系统结构与工作原理；面向嵌入式软件的软件工程。本课程帮助学生建立系统级的概念、分析和设计方法，为培养具有系统观念的工程师打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Biochips are an important part of Internet medical care and smart home, and have a broad space for innovation. This year, the research and development of biochips has gradually matured, from laboratory research to practical products. Intersection of knowledge in multiple fields of biochip design, professional knowledge and technology of radiation computer, automatic control, communication, mechatronics, biochemical detection, etc. The embedded technology is the control core of the fluid control and biochemical detection of the microfluidic chip. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the concept of intelligent health monitoring equipment based on biochips, understand the categories of biodetection methods, learn to master the key points of system analysis, design and implementation of embedded software, and focus on embedded systems in biochips Design and application, cultivate students' interest and ability in innovative practice. The main contents include an introduction to the development of biochips, the analysis of the latest biochips and other intelligent health monitoring equipment, the functional requirements of biochips for embedded systems; embedded software development tools and methods, embedded software debugging tools and debugging techniques; embedded operating systems Structure and working principle; software engineering for embedded software. This course helps students develop systems-level conceptual, analytical, and design methods, providing a solid foundation for developing systems-minded engineers.

default.zh: 本课程是面向本科生开设的集成电路创新创业大赛的培训课程，课程目标在于通过有针对性的项目分析、管理和技术培训，使学生能够系统、准确地了解竞赛内容，推动学生积极参加相关设计竞赛，培养学生在集成电路和智能传感器应用方面的创新实践能力，适应我国集成电路人才培养要求。课程内容包括讲授集成电路设计和智能传感器应用相关的设计流程和软件使用方法。并通过典型竞赛题目设立全部流程的实践实验，培养学生全面掌握项目规划、方案设计、晶体管级设计、后端版图和智能传感器应用等方面的创新能力。课程要求学生能够掌握matlab、candence、altium designer等软件的使用，正确完成典型案例的设计。
default.en: This course is an undergraduate courses in China College IC Competition training. Through targeted project analysis, management and technical training, the curriculum goal is to enable students to understand the content of the competition systematically and accurately and to promote students to actively participate in relevant design competitions, to cultivate students’innovative and practical ability in the application of IC and intelligent sensors, in order to adapt to the requirement of cultivating integrated circuit talents in China. The course content includes integrated circuit design and intelligent sensor application related design process and software usage. Furthermore, through the typical competition topics, the course is to set up the whole process of practical experiments, training students to master the comprehensive project planning, scheme design, transistor level design, back-end layout and intelligent sensor application and other aspects of innovation. Students are required to master the use of Matlab, Candence, Altium Designer and other software to correctly complete the design of typical cases.

default.zh: 在介绍物理光学课程中的平行平板多光束干涉原理的基础上，讲授光学介质膜系的特性计算方法，主要包括递推法与导纳矩阵法。设计完成光学介质膜系的特性计算软件，并进行可见光减反射膜的设计。软件能够计算并画出单层膜、双层膜与周期性膜系的反射光谱曲线，可以分析基底折射率改变时，光谱曲线的变化趋势。
default.en: Multiple-beam interference principle for parallel plates was introduced in physical optics. The performance calculation for optical medium films includes admittance matrix method and recursive method. The optical thin-film software will be designed and developed, and the anti-reflection film will be designed at the curse closing. The software can calculate and draw the reflection spectrum curves of single-layer, double-layer, and periodic film systems, and analyze the trend of spectral curve changes when the substrate refractive index changes.

default.zh: 本课程为工程类本科生的选修课程。超精密光学元件的加工与检测是工程领域的重要分支，现代光学系统设计中越来越多地采用大口径非球面元件，这对光学加工与检测技术提出了更高的要求，已经成为制约空间光学、天文、航天、激光聚变等领域发展的重要因素，大口径非球面及自由曲面的超精密成形与检测技术一直是先进光学制造领域的前沿课题，该课程中，David Walker教授将并结合其团队近年来的科研实例，围绕当前国内外先进光学制造领域的关键技术与挑战，对国际上用于大口径非球面加工与检测的主要方法进行介绍，其中包括美国亚利桑那大学的主动抛光盘技术、英国伦敦大学学院的气囊抛光技术、离子束加工技术、磁流变加工技术、等离子体加工技术及射流加工技术等。以David Walker教授所主持的项目为实例：欧洲超大望远镜项目（The Extremely Large Telescope， E-ELT），介绍大口径光学系统主镜的拼接技术、子镜加工的关键技术、大型光学镜体先进支撑设计及其团队所开发的加工工艺；以‘哈勃’望远镜等为实例，介绍光学检测在光学超精密加工过程中的重要性。
default.en: This course is optional that is suitable for the undergraduate students in engineering discipline， also in ultraprecision instrumentation and fabrication engineering. Ultra-precision optical surfacing and metrology is one of the most important parts in the engineering domain. More and more large aspherical surfaces with extremely high specifications are adopted in modern optical system design. Manufacturing and testing large aspheric and freeform surfaces pose many challenges. Therefore, the development of space optics, astronomy, aerospace and laser fusion strongly depend on the manufacturing accuracy of the optical components. The aim of this course is to review the current situation in the developments of fabrication and metrology techniques for large aspheric and freeform surfaces. In this course, Prof. David Walker will introduce the current main polishing and figuring techniques for the fabrication of large aspheric parts that are from the developments of his own research team to other important processes including: University of Arizona stressed lap, early UCL stressed lap, bonnet polishing, fluid-jet polishing, MRF, reactive-plasma, ion-figuring etc. As a case study, the project of ‘The European Extremely Large Telescope – prototype mirror segments’ that has been led by Walker’s team will be introduced including the significant role of segmentation in extremely large telescope, the challenges in fabrication of segments and metrology, and the importance of support technique. Metrology and the NASA Hubble Space Telescope also will be introduced as a Case study.

default.zh: 领导力是高素质人才能力体系的重要组成部分，沟通能力是领导力的重要体现。《领导力与沟通》通过对沟通能力的系统讲授和训练，提高学生沟通技能，继而达到提升领导力的目的。课程以对领导力的理解为切入点，分别从领导的职能和领导者的日常工作重点两个角度，让学生领会沟通能力在领导力中的重要作用。无论领导的三个基本职能，即确定目标、寻找路径和激励和培养下属，还是在日常的管理活动中，领导者有70%的时间花在沟通上，并且管理中70%的问题来源于沟通，沟通活动都是领导工作的主体内容。关于对沟通能力的理解，课程注重思维和技能的训练。课程带领学生系统地理解沟通基本概念及特征、管理沟通过程与要素、基本沟通技能，如倾听与反馈、演讲、写作、招聘面试等，课程贯穿始终地强调有效沟通的三个关键词：良好意愿（goodwill）、换位思考（you-attitude）和可信度（credibility）。通过对项目答辩、社团活动组织与呈现、个人成长面试等真实组织环境中学生沟通技能综合运用的实践模拟，培养学生分析和解决实际管理问题、鼓励创造性思维、注重系统性思考的领导能力训练，为培养适应未来不确定环境下管理企业的优秀领导者奠定通识性素质基础。
default.en: ？Leadership is the core elements of the ability system of highly qualified personnel, and communication ability is an important manifestation of leadership. Through teaching and training systematically, will promote students' communication ability, and then achieve the goal of improving students' leadership. The course takes the understanding of leadership as the breakthrough point, and makes the students understand the important role of communication ability in leadership from two perspectives, namely, the functions of lead and the daily management focuses of leaders. Not only achieving the three basic functions of lead, determining target, finding path, and supervising and cultivating subordinates, but also in the daily management activities, the leaders have 70% of time spent in communication, and in management 70% of the problems derived from communication. Communication is the main content of leadership. With regard to the understanding of communication skills, the course focuses on the training of thinking and skills. The course will guide students to systematically understand the basic concepts and characteristics of communication, communication process and management elements, and basic communication skills, such as listening and feedback, speech, writing, interviews, meetings and so on. Throughout the course, three key words will be emphasized: good will, you-attitude, and credibility. By simulating the real organization environment, such as project defense, organization and presentation of university activities, recruitment interview and so on, the students could comprehensively use the communication skill, which could improve students' ability to analyze and solve practical management problems, encourage creative thinking, concentrate on the leadership training of systematic thinking, in order to cultivate general foundation for future excellent leaders to adapt to uncertain management surroundings.

default.zh: 组织行为学是研究组织与环境的相互作用，人们从事工作的心理活动和行为反应规律性的科学。它综合运用心理学、社会学、经济学和政治学等知识，研究组织中人的心理和行为规律，从而提高领导者和管理者对人的行为预测、引导和控制。并以此为基础，改进和提高组织效能，从而更有效地实现组织的目标。
default.en: Organizational Behavior is an introductory course which analyses human behavior at work with a focus on issues of personality, motivation, group interaction, occupational stress and health and organizational change. The course integrates knowledge from psychology, sociology, social psychology, anthropology and political science to examine issues related to aspects of the working environment and to the relationship between managerial strategies, organizational structures and their effects on performance, health and autonomy.

default.zh: 市场营销学是商学院的平台课。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解市场营销的基本概念、掌握市场营销的基本理论，提升对市场及需求认识的高度,建立正确的市场观念，熟悉市场营销环境因素以及消费者分析方法，熟悉目标市场战略制定的相关理论和方法，熟练运用各种营销策略及其策略组合，为解决企业所遇到的各种各样营销问题提供理论支持和解决方案。
default.en: Marketing Management is a platform course in the School of Business. Through this course, students will understand the basic concepts of marketing, master fundamental marketing theories, enhance their understanding of markets and customer needs, establish an appropriate market-oriented mindset, become familiar with factors in the marketing environment and methods for analyzing consumers, learn the relevant theories and methods for formulating target market strategies, and skillfully utilize various marketing tactics and their combinations. The course aims to provide theoretical support and solutions for solving various marketing problems encountered by enterprises.

default.zh: 经管类《跨专业综合实训》是一门认识实习课程，基于管理类平台课，通过高度仿真的商业环境，让学生扮演不同岗位，体验企业从创立到运营的完整过程。课程强调工商管理、市场营销、会计、财务等知识的融会贯通，帮助学生理解各职能部门的协同与工作特性，建立系统性经营认知。通过情景驱动的任务、数据分析与团队协作，培养观察、分析、判断与解决问题的能力，提升在战略制定、市场分析、财务决策、流程治理等方面的执行与决策水平。同时弘扬守法守信、爱岗敬业、社会责任与协作精神，为后续专业学习和职业发展奠定扎实基础。
default.en: The Interdisciplinary Integrated Practicum in Management (IIPM) is a recognition-based internship course designed within the management curriculum. Built on the foundation of platform-based management coursework, it places students in a highly realistic business environment where they assume different roles and experience the full lifecycle of a company, from inception to operation. The course emphasizes the integration of core disciplines—business administration, marketing, accounting, and financial management—to illustrate how functional units collaborate and how business processes unfold. Through scenario-driven tasks, data analysis, and teamwork, students develop essential competencies in observation, analysis, judgment, and problem-solving. They are guided to apply their knowledge to strategic decisions, market analysis, financial planning, and process governance, thereby enhancing their ability to execute and decide across organizational activities. The program also aims to cultivate professional ethics and soft skills, including compliance with laws, dedication, integrity, social responsibility, and collaboration.

default.zh: 《会计学基础》是为本科生设计的一门专业基础课程，旨在系统介绍会计学的基本原理、方法和实务操作。课程涵盖会计循环、经济业务分析、账项调整、财务报表编制、资产与负债核算、内部控制及财务报表分析等核心内容。通过理论讲解、案例分析与课堂讨论，学生将掌握会计信息的形成与使用方法，培养运用会计知识解决实际管理问题的能力，并为未来职业发展奠定坚实的会计基础。
default.en: "Principle of Accounting" is a foundational course designed for undergraduates, which systematically introduces the basic principles, methods, and practical operations of accounting. The course covers core topics such as the accounting cycle, business transaction analysis, adjusting entries, financial statement preparation, asset and liability accounting, internal controls, and financial statement analysis. Through theoretical instruction, case studies, and in-class discussions, students will learn how accounting information is generated and used, develop the ability to apply accounting knowledge to solve practical management problems, and build a solid accounting foundation for future professional development.

default.zh: 知识目标：掌握智能财务的核心理论框架与技术体系，包括GAI、机器人流程自动化（RPA）及Python在财务场景中的应用逻辑，理解其对会计流程自动化、决策优化及行业生态重构的作用机制。熟悉智能财务在会计核算、税务管理、预算控制等领域的业务逻辑。 能力目标：具备运用DeepSeek大模型和Python完成财务报表文本分析、凭证生成及自动化对账的技术能力，能独立设计基于AI的会计核算与税务管理解决方案。熟练操作RPA工具（如Uipath）实现数据采集与流程自动化，掌握GAI与RPA技术协同应用方法，能够构建业财一体化的智能决策支持系统。 素质目标：培养技术驱动下的创新思维，形成主动适应智能财务转型的职业意识，具备跨领域技术工具融合应用的探索精神。通过团队协作与实操训练，提升解决复杂财务问题的系统性思维和跨学科协作能力，为职业发展奠定复合型能力基础。
default.en: - **Knowledge Objectives:** Master the core theoretical framework and technical system of intelligent finance, including the application logic of GAI, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), and Python in financial scenarios. Understand their mechanisms of action in accounting process automation, decision optimization, and industry ecosystem reconstruction. Be familiar with the business logic of intelligent finance in the fields of accounting, tax management, budget control, etc. ### 能力目标： - **Ability Objectives:** Possess the technical capabilities to use DeepSeek large models and Python to complete financial statement text analysis, voucher generation, and automated reconciliation. Independently design AI-based accounting and tax management solutions. Proficiently operate RPA tools (such as UiPath) to achieve data collection and process automation. Master the collaborative application methods of GAI and RPA technologies, and be able to build an integrated business-finance intelligent decision support system. ### 素质目标： - **Quality Objectives:** Cultivate innovative thinking driven by technology, form a professional awareness of actively adapting to the transformation of intelligent finance, and possess the exploratory spirit of integrated application of cross-domain technical tools. Through team collaboration and practical training, enhance systematic thinking and interdisciplinary collaboration capabilities to solve complex financial problems, and lay a foundation for compound capability development in career development.

default.zh: 《AIGC辅助财务数据分析》是一门跨学科融合的创新课程，旨在通过AIGC技术赋能传统财务数据分析，培养学生利用AI工具解决财务领域复杂问题的能力。通过案例驱动、工具实操和伦理探讨，帮助学生掌握从数据预处理、智能分析到可视化报告的全流程技能，并提升其在企业并购与企业破产重组等场景中的创新实践能力。课程有选择的围绕Excel、SQL和Stata这3大常用的数据分析工具，从方法和实践2个维度系统讲解如何使用AIGC工具来辅助提升效率，注重技术与专业的深度结合，培养具备“AI+财务”双核竞争力的复合型人才。
default.en: "AIGC-assisted Financial Data Analysis" is an innovative interdisciplinary course designed to empower traditional financial data analysis with AIGC technology, equipping students with the ability to leverage AI tools to solve complex problems in the financial domain. Through case-driven learning, hands-on tool practice, and ethical discussions, the course helps students master end-to-end skills—from data preprocessing and intelligent analysis to visual reporting—while enhancing their innovative practical capabilities in scenarios such as corporate mergers & acquisitions and bankruptcy restructuring. The course selectively focuses on three widely used data analysis tools—Excel, SQL, and Stata—and systematically explains how to employ AIGC tools to improve efficiency from both methodological and practical perspectives. Emphasizing the deep integration of technology and professional expertise, it cultivates versatile talent with dual-core competencies in "AI + Finance."

default.zh: 《大学化学B》是对非化类学科与专业本科生开设的公共基础类课程，其简明地反映了化学学科的基本原理以及与工程实际和日常生活的联系。该课程是高等工科院校不可缺少的一门基础课，是工科院校本科学生科学文化素质教育的重要环节，是培养全面发展的工程技术人才知识结构和实践与创新能力的重要组成部分，在化学与工程之间起到桥梁作用。 大学化学B 共32学时（讲课32学时）。主要介绍化学反应热、化学反应的方向和限度、化学反应速率、稀溶液定律和溶液中的离子平衡、氧化还原反应与电化学、原子结构与同期系、分子结构与晶体结构等知识。并介绍化学知识在材料、能源等领域中的应用。 通过本课程的学习，使学生在中学化学的基础上，对化学反应的基本规律、能量关系以及物质组成、结构与性能的关系等有比较全面的认识和一定程度的掌握；对当前化学学科发展的特点及与其他学科的联系、交叉和渗透有所了解。 通过本课程的学习，使学生能够在工程实践及日常生活中能够运用化学的观点和所学化学知识分析和解决问题。
default.en: General Chemistry (B) is a compulsive course for college students of non chemistry related specialty and non chemical engineering related specialties. It concisely reflects the basic principles of chemistry, seeks to reflect the actual contact with the engineering, and is an indispensable basic course for advanced engineering colleges. These contents are important to engineers, and are a bridge that connects engineering with chemistry. The course includes the classroom teaching of 32 class hours. In this class, the topics will be discussed as below: Chemical reaction heat，Chemical reaction direction and chemical equilibrium，Velocity of chemical reaction，Law of diluted solution，Single-phase and multiphase ion-balance in solution，Oxidation- reduction reaction and electrochemistry，Atom structure and periodic law of elements，Molecular structure and crystal structure，The application of chemistry in material, energy, etc. Learning this course can make students have a more comprehensive understanding on the basic law of chemical reaction, the relationship between energy, the relationship between matter’ composition and structure with t their performance. Learning this course can make students have a proper understanding of the current development of chemical subjects, the links and the cross-penetration of chemistry with other subjects. Learning this course can make students having the abilities to some extent to use chemical opinion and knowledge to analyze and solve problem that related with their own subjects.

default.zh: 《大学化学C》是面对高等工学院校非化学化工类本科生开设的化学类公共基础课程，课程简明反映化学学科的基本原理以及其与工程实际以及日常生活的密切联系。该课程是高等工科院校不可缺少的一门基础课，也是工科院校学生科学文化素质教育的重要环节，作为培养全面发展的工程技术人才知识结构和能力的重要组成部分，该课程内容在化学与工程之间起到桥梁作用。 课程目标1 工程知识：通过本课程的学习，使学生对化学反应的基本规律、能量关系以及物质组成、结构与性能的关系等有比较全面的认识和一定程度的掌握；对当前化学学科发展的特点及与其他学科的联系、交叉和渗透有所了解。 课程目标2问题分析：通过本课程的学习，使学生能够在工程实践及日常生活中能够运用化学的观点和所学化学知识分析和解决问题，建立科学思维。 课程目标3终身学习：课程包括8学时化学实验，对化学实验基本技术、方法和手段作进一步训练，学生可以设计实验、分析与解释实验数据、并通过科学方法得到合理有效的实验结论。为学习后继课、新理论、新工艺、新技术和进行其他实验与研究提供参考，从而提升理论联系实践解决问题的能力。 本大纲针对32学时（讲课24学时，实验8学时）教学制定。
default.en: General Chemistry (C) is an indispensable basic course for college students of non chemistry related specialty and non chemical engineering related specialties. It concisely reflects the basic principles of chemistry, seeks to reflect the actual connection with engineering practice and our daily life. These contents an important link in the scientific and quality education of students in colleges, and an important component of the knowledge structure and ability of comprehensively developing engineering and technical talents. It plays a bridge role between chemistry and engineering. The course includes the classroom teaching of 24 class hours. In this class, the topics will be discussed as below: Chemical reaction heat，Chemical reaction direction and chemical equilibrium，Velocity of chemical reaction，Law of diluted solution，Single-phase and multiphase ion-balance in solution，Oxidation- reduction reaction and electrochemistry，Atom structure and periodic law of elements，Molecular structure and crystal structure, The application of chemistry in material, energy, etc. The course objective 1 is the grasping of the engineering knowledge: Students will have a comprehensive understanding of the basic laws of chemical reactions, energy relationships, and the relationship between material composition, structure, and performance on the basis of high school chemistry after studying this course. Students will have a understanding of the development of chemistry and its connection, intersection, and penetration with other disciplines.The course objective 2 is the ability of the problem analysis: Students can analyze, solve problems from a chemical perspective in engineering practice and daily life after studying this course and establish scientific thinking. The course objective 3 is the research ability: The course includes 8 class hours of chemical experiments, providing further training in the basic techniques and methods of chemical experiments. Students can design experiments, analyze and interpret experimental data, and obtain reasonable and effective experimental conclusions further. All of this can provide the necessary chemical foundation for learning follow-up courses, new theories, new processes, new technologies, and other experiments and research. All of these can improve the ability to combine theory with practice to solve problems.

default.zh: 大学化学D简明地反映了化学学科的基本原理以及与工程实际和日常生活的联系，是高等院校不可缺少的一门基础课，是文管类专业学生科学文化素质教育的重要一环。 大学化学D（化学专题） 共16学时，适用于文管类专业学生学习。主要介绍化学反应基本原理（化学反应热、化学反应的方向和限度、化学反应速率），并介绍化学知识在能源、环境领域中的应用。 通过本课程的学习，使学生在中学化学的基础上，在对化学反应规律有一定了解的同时，了解化学与环境、化学与能源等相关知识，对当前化学学科发展的特点及与其他学科的联系、交叉和渗透有所了解。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够确立化学观点，在以后的工作和日常生活中能够运用化学的观点和所学化学知识分析问题。
default.en: General Chemistry D concisely reflects the basic principles of chemistry, seeks to reflect the actual contact with the engineering, and is an indispensable basic course for advanced colleges. The course is offered for the undergraduate students who are major in liberal arts or management specialty, and designed to get associated with basic chemistry knowledge. It will play an important role during scientific and cultural quality education. The course includes the classroom teaching of 16 class hours. The course applies to study for the undergraduate students who are major in liberal arts or management specialty. In this class, the topics will be discussed as below: the basic principles of chemical reaction(Chemical reaction heat，Velocity of chemical reaction , etc),application of chemistry in the field of energy, environment. The students will understand the regulations of chemical reactions during this course based on the chemistry studied in middle school and learn about the relationships between chemistry and environment, chemistry and energy, etc. Learning this course can make students have a proper understanding of the current development of the chemical subject and links and cross-penetration with other subjects. In the meanwhile, they will find out the great effect of chemistry on the development of science and technology. Consequently, the students will keep the chemical viewpoint in mind and analyze the problems in the viewpoint as well as the knowledge of chemistry in the future work and life.

default.zh: 《大学化学X》是面对未来技术学院及针对小班课类型设置的短学时和多讨论类型的化学公共基础课程。课程简明地反映了化学学科的基本原理以及与工程实际和日常生活的联系，是高等工科院校不可缺少的一门基础课，是工科院校学生科学文化素质教育的重要环节，是培养全面发展的工程技术人才知识结构和能力的重要组成部分，在化学与工程之间起到桥梁作用。 课程目标1 工程知识：通过本课程的学习，使学生对化学反应的基本规律、能量关系以及物质组成、结构与性能的关系等有比较全面的认识和一定程度的掌握；对当前化学学科发展的特点及与其他学科的联系、交叉和渗透有所了解。 课程目标2问题分析：通过本课程的学习，使学生能够在工程实践及日常生活中能够运用化学的观点和所学化学知识分析和解决问题，建立科学思维。 课程目标3终身学习：课程包括8学时化学实验，对化学实验基本技术、方法和手段作进一步训练，学生可以设计实验、分析与解释实验数据、并通过科学方法得到合理有效的实验结论。为学习后继课、新理论、新工艺、新技术和进行其他实验与研究提供参考，从而提升理论联系实践解决问题的能力。 本大纲针对32学时（讲课24学时，实验8学时）教学制定。
default.en: General Chemistry X is a short class and multi discussion type chemistry public basic course designed for future technical colleges and small class types. The course succinctly reflects the basic principles of chemistry and its connection with engineering practice and daily life. It is an indispensable basic course in higher engineering colleges, an important part of scientific and cultural quality education for students in engineering colleges, and an important component of cultivating comprehensive engineering and technical talents with knowledge structure and abilities. It plays a bridging role between chemistry and engineering. Course objective 1: Engineering knowledge: Through the study of this course, students will have a comprehensive understanding and a certain degree of mastery of the basic laws of chemical reactions, energy relationships, and the relationship between material composition, structure, and properties; Have an understanding of the characteristics of the current development of chemistry and its connection, intersection, and infiltration with other disciplines. Course Objective 2 Problem Analysis: Through the study of this course, students will be able to apply chemical perspectives and knowledge to analyze and solve problems in engineering practice and daily life, and establish scientific thinking. Course objective 3: Lifelong learning: The course includes 8 hours of chemical experiments, providing further training on basic techniques, methods, and means of chemical experiments. Students can design experiments, analyze and interpret experimental data, and obtain reasonable and effective experimental conclusions through scientific methods. To provide reference for learning follow-up courses, new theories, new processes, new technologies, and conducting other experiments and research, thereby enhancing the ability to combine theory with practice to solve problems. This outline is designed for 32 class hours (24 class hours for lectures and 8 class hours for experiments) of teaching.

default.zh: 有机化学实验是化学系相关专业的基础实验课。通过实验使学生掌握有机化学实验的基础知识和基本实验操作技能，掌握有机实验完整的环节，学会物质的合成、分离、提纯和分析鉴定等过程正确的选择方法。使学生养成良好的实验习惯，提高学生的实验动手能力。培养学生理论联系实际、观察问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力。本课程包括基本实验技术知识，基本操作知识和实验训练三部分。
default.en: The course “Experiments in Organic Chemistry is the basic experimental course for related majors in Department of Chemistry. The course is to make the students master the basic knowledge and experimental skills of experiments in organic chemistry, master the complete aspect of organic synthesis and learn the right method for material synthesis, separation, purification, analysis and identification. The purpose of this course is to enable students to develop good experimental habits, improve their ability of experiment and cultivate their abilities of integrating theory with practice, observing, analyzing and solving problems. This course includes three parts: the basic knowledge of the experimental technology, the basic knowledge of the experimental manipulation and experimental training.

default.zh: 《无机与分析化学》是化工与化学学院化工大类本科生的第一门学科基础课，起着承前启后的关键作用。本课程的主要内容由化学基础知识、化学热力学、化学平衡、物质结构以及元素化学、误差分析、分析化学原理等几部分组成，目的是使学生能够初步学会运用所学理论去解释元素及其化合物的结构、性质和化学反应规律等问题。 通过本课程学习，要求学生掌握理想气体、晶体结构的基本概念、酸碱理论及化学反应速率等基础化学知识，在此基础上，进一步掌握化学热力学、化学平衡、物质结构的基础理论、元素化学、分析化学的基础知识，了解无机与分析化学发展的新兴领域。培养学生具有初步的分析问题和解决问题的独立能力，认识化学与生产和生活实践相结合的重大意义。本课程将为后续课程学习和掌握新的科学技术打下必要的基础。
default.en: "Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry" is the first basic course of the undergraduate students in school of chemistry and chemical engineering and it will play a key role. The main contents of this course are composed of chemical basic knowledge, chemical thermodynamics, chemical balance, structural chemistry, elemental chemistry, error analysis and principles of analytical chemistry. The aim is to enable students to explain the structure, properties and the disciplinarian of chemical reaction by learned theory. Through this course, students are required to master the basic chemistry knowledge of ideal gas, basic knowledge of crystal structure, acid-base theory and chemical reaction rate. On this basis, more knowledge about chemical thermodynamics, chemical balance, structure chemistry theory, elemental chemistry and analytical chemistry will be mastered. In addition, the new development of inorganic chemistry and analytical chemistry will be introduced. This course will culture students to analyze problem and solve problem of independently, enhancing the ability to understand the chemical and production and life practice combined with learned knowledge. In addition, this course will lay a necessary foundation for the follow-up courses and the other new science and technology.

The main contents of this course are composed of chemical basic knowledge, chemical thermodynamics, chemical balance, structural chemistry, elemental chemistry, error analysis and principles of analytical chemistry. The aim is to enable students to explain the structure, properties and the disciplinarian of chemical reaction by learned theory. Through this course, students are required to master the basic chemistry knowledge of ideal gas, basic knowledge of crystal structure, acid-base theory and chemical reaction rate. On this basis, more knowledge about chemical thermodynamics, chemical balance, structure chemistry theory, elemental chemistry and analytical chemistry will be mastered. In addition, the new development of inorganic chemistry and analytical chemistry will be introduced. This course will culture students to analyze problem and solve problem of independently, enhancing the ability to understand the chemical and production and life practice combined with learned knowledge. In addition, this course will lay a necessary foundation for the follow-up courses and the other new science and technology.

default.zh: 新材料化工专业导论主要讲授新材料化工的基本概念、基本原理、在各类应用中的创新实践以及发展趋势，由具有影响力教师、企业家、学术先锋等共同授课，提供对问题多方面视角的理解与看法。希望学生能通过对新材料的化工制备技术、应用场景、热点问题的系统性认识，培养前瞻性思维与创新能力。
default.en: Introduction to Chemical Engineering of New Materials mainly teaches the basic concepts, principles, innovative practices in various applications, and development trends of chemical engineering of new materials. The courses are taught by influential teachers, entrepreneurs, and academic pioneers, providing a multifaceted understanding and perspective on the issue. We hope that students will enhance forward-looking thinking and innovative abilities through a systematic understanding of the chemical preparation technologies, application scenarios, and hot issues of the new materials.

default.zh: 分析化学课程是高等学校化学、化工、生命科学、环境科学、材料科学等专业的一门基础课程，在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学有关知识，结合实验教学环节，进行分析测试方法的基本训练，为日后的专业学习打下基础。
default.en: Analytical chemistry course is a basic course for chemistry, chemical engineering, life science, environmental science, material science and other majors in colleges and universities. In the teaching process, the relevant knowledge learned in the prerequisite courses is comprehensively applied, combined with the experimental teaching link, to carry out analytical testing methods basic training to lay the foundation for future professional study.

default.zh: 化学是与我们的生活密切相关，随着化学的发展，化学既提高了我们的生活质量，同时， 带来了许多污染问题，甚至危害我们的身心健康。 随着社会的发展和当前科技的进步，现代化学正在成为一门重要科学，创造着现代物质文明和精神文明，深刻地影响着人的全面发展。科学家们发明的新型药物，为人类的健康带来了福音；一些新型的合成材料，提高了人们的生活质量。然而，化学给我们的生活带来便利的同时，也给我们的环境造成了极大的危害。日益严重的全球气候变暖，空气质量的日益下降，水污染的日益严重，这些问题极大的影响了我们的身心健康。 因此，在我看来，我们要充分认识到化学与我们生活的关系，看到化学给我们生活带来的利弊。我们要充分利用化学的知识，让化学更好的为人类服务，提高人们的生活质量。相信在我们的共同努力下，我们的生活质量会有明显的提高。只要大家留心，多观察、多发现，化学的发展将会突飞猛进，我们生活中的奥秘也将进一步被发现，生活将会更加方便、舒适，用心去体验，生活本身就是一本化学书。
default.en: Chemistry is closely related with our life, with the development of chemistry, chemistry can improve our quality of life, at the same time, brought a lot of problems of pollution, even do harm to our physical and mental health. With the development of society and the progress of science and technology, modern chemistry is becoming an important science, creating the modern material civilization and spiritual civilization, profoundly affects people's all-round development. Scientists have invented a new drug, for human health to bring the gospel; some new synthetic materials, improve people's quality of life. However, the chemical brought convenience to us at the same time, we also give the environment caused great harm. Increasingly serious global warming, air quality declining, water pollution is increasingly serious, these problems greatly affect our physical and mental health Therefore, in my opinion, we should be fully aware of chemistry and its relationship with our life, see the advantages and disadvantages of chemical to our life. We should make full use of the knowledge of chemistry, chemistry to better serve humanity, improve people's quality of life. I believe in our joint efforts, our quality of life will be improved. As long as we watch, observe, discover, chemical development will make a spurt of progress, we the mysteries in life will also have further been found, life will be more convenient, comfortable, intentions to experience, life itself is a chemistry book.

default.zh: 《无机化学实验》是化学及其相关专业学生第一门必修的基础化学实验课程。包括基础实验、综合实验和设计实验。包括无机制备、化学基本原理的验证、元素及化合物的性质实验及无机实验中一些常用仪器的基本原理和使用方法，使学生加深对基础知识和基本理论的理解；理解并掌握重要元素及其化合物的组成、结构、性质及其变化规律；熟悉无机化合物的一般制备、分离、提纯及分析鉴定方法；牢固掌握无机化学实验的基本实验方法和操作技能。学生可以全面系统地学习化学研究的全过程，培养学生动手、观测、查阅、记忆、思维、归纳、总结及表达等综合能力，从而使学生具备分析问题、解决问题的独立工作能力，逐步地掌握科学的研究方法。
default.en: IInorganic Chemistry Experiments is the first compulsory basic chemistry experimental course for students majoring in chemistry and related fields. Including basic experiments, comprehensive experiments, and design experiments. Including inorganic preparation, verification of basic chemical principles, experiments on the properties of elements and compounds, and basic principles and usage methods of some commonly used instruments in inorganic experiments, to deepen students' understanding of basic knowledge and theories; Understand and master the composition, structure, properties, and variation patterns of important elements and their compounds; Familiar with the general preparation, separation, purification, and analytical identification methods of inorganic compounds; Firmly grasp the basic experimental methods and operational skills of inorganic chemistry experiments. Students can comprehensively and systematically learn the entire process of chemical research, cultivate comprehensive abilities such as hands-on, observation, reference, memory, thinking, induction, summary, and expression, so as to enable students to have independent work ability to analyze and solve problems, and gradually master scientific research methods.

default.zh: 《无机与分析化学》是化工与化学学院为本科生开设第一门学科基础课，起着承前启后的关键作用。本课程的主要内容由化学基础知识、化学平衡、物质结构以及元素化学、分析化学基本原理等几部分组成，目的是使学生能够初步学会运用所学理论去解释元素及其化合物的结构、性质和化学反应规律以及化学成份的分析等问题。 通过本课程学习，要求学生掌握物质结构基本理论、化学平衡等基础化学知识，在此基础上，进一步掌握化学元素化学、分析化学的基础知识，了解无机与分析化学发展的新兴领域。培养学生具有初步的分析问题和解决问题的独立能力，认识化学与生产和生活实践相结合的重大意义。本课程将为后续课程学习打下必要的基础。
default.en: Inorganic and Analytical chemistry is the first basic course for undergraduates in the College of Chemical Engineering and Chemistry, which plays a key role in connecting the past and the future. The main content of this course consists of basic chemical knowledge, Chemical equilibrium, material structure, basic principles of element chemistry and Analytical chemistry. The purpose of this course is to enable students to initially learn to use the theory they have learned to explain the structure, properties and chemical reaction laws of elements and their compounds, as well as the analysis of Chemical composition and other issues.Through this course, students are required to master the basic chemical knowledge such as the basic theory of material structure and Chemical equilibrium. On this basis, they will further master the basic knowledge of chemical element chemistry and Analytical chemistry, and understand the emerging fields of inorganic and Analytical chemistry development. Cultivate students' independent ability to analyze and solve problems, and recognize the significant significance of combining chemistry with production and life practice. This course will lay the necessary foundation for subsequent course learning.

default.zh: 物理化学实验课程主要面向化学系的学生开设，共开设14个实验项目，实验学时共计72学时。本实验课程的特点是综合性强和注重方法的掌握，通过典型实验使学生熟悉物理化学研究方法，掌握物理化学实验的基本操作技术和技能，从而加深对物理化学基本理论和概念的理解，培养解决实际化学问题的能力，为后续课程及科研工作奠定基础。
default.en: The course “Experiments of Physical Chemistry”is mainly open to students from the department of Chemistry, with a total of 14 experimental project, and 72 teaching hours. This experimental course is characterized by strong comprehensiveness and emphasis on the mastery of methods. Through typical experiments, students will be familiar with the research methods of physical chemistry, master the basic operating techniques and skills of physical chemistry experiments, thus deepening the understanding of basic theories and concepts of physical chemistry, cultivating the ability to solve practical chemical problems, and laying the foundation for subsequent courses and scientific research.

default.zh: 《有机化学》是化工学院各专业本科学生必修的基础课之一，在教学计划中占有重要的地位。它是研究各类有机化合物的结构、性质、相互转化及其规律的一门学科。有机化学与其它学科的渗透、交叉十分广泛，对生命科学，材料科学、环境科学等研究起着十分重要作用。本课程主要内容包括：烷烃和环烷烃，立体化学基础、卤代烷，醇和醚，烯烃，炔烃和二烯烃，芳香烃，羰基化合物，酚、醌，羰酸和取代羧酸，羧酸衍生物，有机含氮化合物，杂环化合物，周环反应，氨基酸，多肽，糖类，核酸和辅酶化学等。
default.en: Organic Chemistry is a basic theory course in Chemical Engineering and Technology, which plays a highly important role in major course system. It is a course to study the structures, properties and the law of mutual transformation of organic compounds. It overlaps extensively with other courses, and is important for the development of life science, material science and environmental science. It includes mainly the contents below: Alkanes and cycloalkanes, stereochemistry, alkyl halides, alcohols and ethers, olefins, acetylenes and dienes, aromatic hydrocarbon, carbonyl compounds, phenol, quinone, carbonyl acid and substituted carboxylic acid, carboxylic acid derivatives, organic nitrogen compounds, heterocyclic compounds, pericyclic reactions, amino acids, peptides, proteins, , carbohydrate, nucleic acid and coenzyme chemistry.

default.zh: 化学基础实验课程主要面向全校非化学专业辅修化学类专业的学生开设，共20个实验项目，其中无机化学实验6个、分析化学实验6个、有机化学实验4个、物理化学实验4个。学生每年根据具体情况，从中选择12个实验，实验学时共计48学时。本实验课程的特点是面向非化学专业的学生，通过典型实验使学生熟悉化学基本研究方法，掌握化学实验的基本操作技术和技能，从而加深对化学基本理论和概念的理解，培养解决实际化学问题的能力，为后续从事学科交叉性质的工作及科研奠定基础。
default.en: The course “Basic Chemistry Experiment”, is set for the students whose minor program is Chemistry. There are 20 experiments in total, including six inorganic chemistry experiments, six analytical chemistry experiments, four organic chemistry experiments and four physical chemistry experiments. Each student has to do 12 experiments, containing 48 teaching hours. This course is focuses on the students whose minor program is chemistry. The students will get to know the common research methods in basic chemistry and master basic skills and technology experimental skills through typical experiments, and thus have a deeper understanding of some basic theories and conceptions. Also, it can train their abilities in solving practical problems of chemistry, providing a favorable base for interdisciplinary work and scientific research.

default.zh: 物理化学主要研究物质变化及与化学变化相关的物理变化中所遵循的规律和基本原理，是化工类、材料类（工科）和药学、化学类（理科）专业的一门必修基础课。通过本课程，学生可以学习物理化学研究问题的一些特殊方法（热力学方法和动力学方法等），使学生具备：建立假设和模型、上升到理论、分析和解决具体问题的能力，增加创新意识，为化工、材料等专业学生的后续课程学习和进一步掌握新的科学知识打下必要的基础。
default.en: Physical chemistry mainly studies the laws and basic principles followed in the changes of substances and the physical changes related to chemical changes. It is a compulsory basic course for majors in chemical engineering, materials (engineering), pharmacy, and chemistry (science). Through this course, students can learn some special methods of physical chemistry research problems (thermodynamic and kinetic methods, etc.), enabling them to have the ability to establish hypotheses and models, rise to theory, analyze and solve specific problems, increase innovation awareness, and lay a necessary foundation for subsequent course learning and further mastery of new scientific knowledge for students majoring in chemical engineering, materials, etc.

default.zh: 《物理化学》是化学与材料化学专业基础课程，主要讲授热力学第一定律、第二定律，多组分系统，相平衡，电解质溶液，可逆电池的电动势及其应用，化学动力学基础，表面物理化学内容。通过本课程的学习，使学生系统地掌握物理化学基本原理和处理方法，熟悉化学反应过程中与之而来物理量变化规律，能够定量研究物质物理化学性质与化学反应规律，并加以灵活应用用于处理实际化工生产过程中的工程问题和实验数据归纳与分析。
default.en: Physical Chemistry is a basic course of chemistry and material chemistry, which mainly teaches the first and second laws of thermodynamics, multicomponent systems, phase equilibrium, electrolyte solution, electromotive force of reversible battery and its application, the basis of chemical kinetics, and the content of surface physical chemistry. Through the study of this course, students can systematically master the basic principles and treatment methods of physical chemistry, be familiar with the law of physical quantity change in the process of chemical reaction, and be able to study the physical and chemical properties and chemical reaction law quantitatively. It is flexibly applied to deal with engineering problems and experimental data induction and analysis in the actual chemical production process.

default.zh: 物理化学主要研究物质变化及与化学变化相关的物理变化中所遵循的规律和基本原理，是化工类、材料类（工科）和药学、化学类（理科）专业的一门必修基础课。物理化学是集物理、数学和化学于一身的一门学科，是用物理和数学的方法研究化学问题。本课程包括热力学三大定律和基本方程、多组分系统热力学、相平衡、化学平衡、化学动力学和表面现象等。通过本课程，学生可以学习物理化学研究问题的一些特殊方法（热力学方法和动力学方法等），使学生具备建立假设和模型、上升到理论、分析和解决具体问题的能力，增加创新意识。作为辅修课程，本课程将为航天、能源、材料等专业学生的后续课程学习和进一步掌握新的科学知识打下必要的基础。
default.en: Physical chemistry mainly studies the laws and basic principles followed in the physical changes related to chemical changes. It is a compulsory basic course for the majors of chemical engineering, materials (engineering), pharmacy and chemistry (science). Physical chemistry is a subject which integrates physics, mathematics and chemistry, which studies chemical problems with physical and mathematical tools. This course includes the three laws of thermodynamics and basic equations, multi-component system thermodynamics, phase equilibrium, chemical equilibrium, chemical kinetics and surface phenomena. Through this course, students can learn some special methods of physical chemistry research problems (thermodynamic methods and kinetic methods, etc.), so that students have the ability to establish hypotheses and models, rise to theories, analyze and solve specific problems, and increase awareness of innovation. As a minor course, it lays the necessary foundation for the follow-up course study and the further mastering of new scientific knowledge for students majoring in aerospace, energy and materials.

default.zh: 分析化学课程是高等学校化学、化工、生命科学、环境科学、材料科学等专业的一门基础课程，在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学有关知识，结合实验教学环节，进行分析测试方法的基本训练，为日后的专业学习打下基础。
default.en: Analytical chemistry course is a basic course for chemistry, chemical engineering, life science, environmental science, material science and other majors in colleges and universities. In the teaching process, the relevant knowledge learned in the prerequisite courses is comprehensively applied, combined with the experimental teaching link, to carry out analytical testing methods basic training to lay the foundation for future professional study.

default.zh: 分析化学实验是大学本科化学各专业的重要基础课之一，是一门实践性很强的必修课程，它密切配合分析化学课堂教学，通过该课程的学习使学生加深对分析化学中有关理论的理解，巩固学生所学的理论知识。通过分析化学实验技能的严格训练，使学生正确掌握实验的基本操作技能，建立“量”的概念，提高学生分析问题和解决实际问题的技能，培养严谨、实事求是的科学态度和科学素养，逐步养成良好的科学研究作风，为学习后续课程及将来从事具体工作打下良好的实验基础。
default.en: The course “Experiments of Analytical Chemistry” is one of the basic undergraduate chemistry courses and it is a very practical Compulsory Course, which relates closely with the course of Analytical Chemistry. This course can deepen students’ understanding of principles and theories in Analytical Chemistry course and consolidate their theoretical knowledge. With strict training of the experimental skills, students will master the operational skills, establish the concept of “Quantity”, and develop their skills of analyzing and solving problems. This course also fosters their rigorous scientific attitude, scientific literacy of seeking truth from facts and good scientific work style. This course will also lay a good foundation for further study in other courses.

default.zh: 有机化学对于本科生是一门基础理论课。 本课程将系统地讲授有机化合物的组成、结构、性质、合成、相互转化方法及有关理论知识。 使非化工学院的学生掌握有机化学的基本概念、基本理论、基本技能，了解本学科的最新成果和发展趋势，为日后学生继续深造、从事化学、化工和材料学科的教学、科研与开发，打下坚实的基础，同时训练学生能够在多学科背景下的团队中担任成员或管理者的角色，并有效地进行合作交流。
default.en: Organic Chemistry is a basic theory course for undergraduate students. This course will systematically teach the composition, structure, properties, synthesis, interconversion methods and related theoretical knowledge of organic compounds. The course will enable non-Chemistry students to master the basic concepts, theories and skills of organic chemistry, to understand the latest achievements and development trends of the discipline, to lay a solid foundation for students to pursue further education and to engage in the teaching, research and development of chemistry, chemical engineering and materials disciplines, and to train students to be able to act as a member or manager of a multidisciplinary team and to communicate effectively in a cooperative manner.

default.zh: 计算化学是在原子分子水平下研究物质的结构、物理和化学性质、构效关系、变化规律的一门主要工具，在生物大分子结构预测、蛋白质设计、药物设计等生命科学领域有着重要应用，成为实验研究的必要补充。课程主要讲授包括量子化学计算、分子模拟、机器学习等方法的基本原理、在生命科学中的应用等内容，使学生们了解计算化学的基本方法、基本原理、计算流程、前沿应用和发展趋势，熟悉计算化学的计算流程设计及结果分析，预测、解释实验现象，总结一般性规律。 本课程考试成绩采取累加式，包括作业和期末考试两个部分。
default.en: Computational chemistry is a major tool to study the structure, physical and chemical properties, structure-activity relationship, and general rules at the atomic and molecular level. It has been widely used to structure prediction of biological macromolecules, enzyme design, and drug design, being a necessary supplement for the experimental study. In the course, several major methods including quantum chemical calculations, molecular modeling, and machine learning are introduced about the principles and the applications. the students could know the theoretical foundation, computational procedure, advanced studies, development tendency, and front applications. They will learn and understand how to design the computational procedure, analyze the computational results, explain the experimental phenomenon, and finally conclude the general rule. The overall assessment of the course is the sum of two parts, including the homework and the final exam.

default.zh: 有机化学实验是化学相关专业的基础实验课。通过实验使学生掌握有机化学实验的基础知识和基本实验操作技能，掌握有机实验完整的环节，学会物质的合成、分离、提纯和分析鉴定等过程正确的选择方法。使学生养成良好的实验习惯，提高学生的实验动手能力。培养学生理论联系实际、观察问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力。本课程包括基本实验技术知识，基本操作知识和实验训练三部分。
default.en: The course “Experiments in Organic Chemistry is the basic experimental course for related majors in Department of Chemistry. The course is to make the students master the basic knowledge and experimental skills of experiments in organic chemistry, master the complete aspect of organic synthesis and learn the right method for material synthesis, separation, purification, analysis and identification. The purpose of this course is to enable students to develop good experimental habits, improve their ability of experiment and cultivate their abilities of integrating theory with practice, observing, analyzing and solving problems. This course includes three parts: the basic knowledge of the experimental technology, the basic knowledge of the experimental manipulation and experimental training.
