default.zh: 《有机化学基础》的授课对象是针对化工与化学学院，如材料化学、应用化学、化学系等理科化学专业的最为重要的专业基础课之一。它也是应化、材料、生物等各专业学生后续专业学习的重要基础课。如果有机化学基本概念和基本理论掌握得不好，学生在随后的专业课程的学习中将会受到很大影响。那么我们研究型大学的本质就是“研究与教学相结合”，其发展目标必然是把研究放在首位，在大学的本科阶段即提供全面的学位计划，宽基础的学习也是为今后的科学研究打基础做铺垫。因此，作为专业基础课程的有机化学，我们在讲授过程中特别地提出对学生创新能力的培养，这是研究型大学今后发展的必然趋势，也是为培养多层次人才所必备的教书育人模式。
default.en: "Fundamentals of Organic Chemistry" is the most important professional foundation course for science and chemistry majors such as materials chemistry, applied chemistry, and chemistry. It is also an important basic course for professional study of students of various majors. If the basic concepts and basic theories of organic chemistry are not well mastered, students will be greatly affected by the subsequent study of professional courses. The essence of our research university is “the combination of research and teaching”. Its development goal is to put the research first. Therefore, the organic chemistry is professional basic courses. We specially propose the cultivation of students' innovative ability in the process of teaching. This is the inevitable trend of the future development of research universities, and also the necessary teaching and education mode for cultivating multi-level talents.

default.zh: 本课程是相关化学专业必修的技术基础课，主要任务是通过本课程的学习，使学生在中学化学的基础上，对化学反应的基本规律，变化过程中的能量关系以及物质组成、结构与性能的关系等有一个比较全面的认识；对化学实验基本技术、方法和手段做进一步训练，为学习后继课、新理论、新工艺、新技术和进行其他实验与研究奠定必要的化学基础。通过对自然原理学习研究，培养学生分析和解决实际问题的能力，理解化学是以实验科学，对培养学生具有正确的世界观和方法论具有重要的作用。
default.en: The subject is the basic technical lesson of some other chemistry related. It aims to make the students have full knowledge about the basic rules of chemical reactions, both energy relationship and composition of substances during the course of reactions, the relationship between structures and characteristics, etc. Training on basic techniques and methods on chemical experiment will be very beneficial to the students for their later study on new theory and new techniques, as well as the other research work. The capability of solving problems with the basic chemical ideas and skills during the daily life and work are all the key factors in this subject. It is also very important for the students to form a correct world outlook and methodology.

default.zh: 《有机化学X》是哈尔滨工业大学化工与化学学院针对未来技术学院生命健康领域方向开设的一门基础必修课。有机化学主要是研究有机化合物的结构、性质、合成、反应机理和有机化合物间相互转变规律的一门科学。通过本课程的学习，向学生系统地传授有机化学的基本原理和方法，加深对其化学课程内容的理解，并初步具有应用有机化学基本知识原理分析和解决实际问题的能力。本课程内容包括：绪论；烷烃、环烷烃和自由基取代反应；对映异构；烯烃、亲电加成和自由基加成；炔烃、二烯烃、共振论和离域键；芳香烃、芳核上的亲电取代反应及Hückel规则；卤代烃和亲核取代反应；醇、酚、醚；醛、酮、醌和亲核加成反应；羧酸、取代羧酸和亲核加成-消除；羧酸衍生物；有机含氮化合物；杂环化合物；糖类；氨基酸和多肽；蛋白质；核酸；脂类、萜类和甾族化合物。
default.en: Course required for chemistry majors. This course explores the structure of organic molecules, the physical properties defined by these structures, and the manner in which we can manipulate molecules by altering their structure. This course will focus specifically on the structure, properties, bonding, stereochemistry, reactions, and reaction mechanisms of carbon based molecules.

default.zh: 《无机化学》是化工与化学学院化工大类本科生的第一门学科基础课，起着承前启后的关键作用。本课程的主要内容由化学基础知识、化学热力学、化学平衡、物质结构以及元素化学等几部分组成，目的是使学生能够初步学会运用所学理论去解释元素及其化合物的结构、性质和化学反应规律等问题。 通过本课程学习，要求学生掌握理想气体、晶体结构的基本概念、酸碱理论及化学反应速率等基础化学知识，在此基础上，进一步掌握化学热力学、化学平衡、物质结构的基础理论，元素化学的基础知识，了解无机化学发展的新兴领域。培养学生具有初步的分析问题和解决问题的独立能力，认识化学与生产和生活实践相结合的重大意义。本课程将为后续课程学习和掌握新的科学技术打下必要的基础。
default.en: "Inorganic chemistry" is the first basic course of the undergraduate students in school of chemistry and chemical engineering and it will play a key role. The main contents of this course are composed of chemical basic knowledge, chemical thermodynamics, chemical balance, structural chemistry and elemental chemistry. The aim is to enable students to explain the structure, properties and the disciplinarian of chemical reaction by learned theory. Through this course, students are required to master the basic chemistry knowledge of ideal gas, basic knowledge of crystal structure, acid-base theory and chemical reaction rate. On this basis, more knowledge about chemical thermodynamics, chemical balance, structure chemistry theory and elemental chemistry will be mastered. In addition, the new development of inorganic chemistry will be introduced. This course will culture students to analyze problem and solve problem of independently, enhancing the ability to understand the chemical and production and life practice combined with learned knowledge. In addition, this course will lay a necessary foundation for the follow-up courses and the other new science and technology

default.zh: 《无机化学》课是化学的一个重要分支，是化学中的四大基础课的重要组成部分，是应用化学、化工、轻工、材料、冶金、纺织、环境科学、医学、药学、食品、生物技术等类专业的第一门化学基础课。本课程深入浅出地教授化学学科的基础理论，如物质存在的形态，物质结构、热力学、动力学和四大平衡的知识，在基础理论的指导下讲授周期表中各族元素及其性质，为后继课程和化学实验打下理论基础。
default.en: Inorganic chemistry is an important branch of chemistry, an important part of the four basic courses in chemistry, and the first basic chemical course for applied chemistry, chemical engineering, light industry, materials, metallurgy, textiles, environmental science, medicine, pharmacy, food, biotechnology and other majors. This course teaches the basic theories of chemistry in simple and profound terms, such as the forms of matter existence, material structure, thermodynamics, kinetics, and the four major equilibria. Under the guidance of basic theories, it teaches the various groups of elements in the periodic table and their properties, laying a theoretical foundation for subsequent courses and chemical experiments.

default.zh: 《安全教育与实践》是化学工程与工艺专业的大类专业基础课程，理论授课主要讲授物质性质、物化原理与安全、燃烧和爆炸与防火防爆安全技术、职业毒害与防毒措施、实验室安全等内容。实验教学主要标准实验室参观学习、消防安全实践、急救实践、趣味实验、重金属废液处理实验、腐蚀品处理实验。该课程理论结合实例，简明地介绍了实验室及化工生产过程中的危险因素和安全生产技术的基本概念、基础理论和基本方法。使学生系统学习危险化学品的危险性、了解实验室的危险隐患、掌握燃烧和爆炸与防火防爆安全技术、了解毒害与防毒措施、了解危险化学品造成的环境危害，能分析和评价专业工程实践对社会、健康、安全、法律、文化的影响，理解工程师对公众的安全、健康和福祉，以及环境保护的社会责任。并结合实验学习，理论联系实践，将实验室安全意识落在实处。通过本课程学习，使学生树立起牢固的安全生产第一的思想观念；为学生向一线卓越工程师转化打下坚实的安全理论基础。
default.en: Safety Education and Practice "is a major foundational course for chemical engineering and technology majors. Theoretical teaching mainly focuses on material properties, physicochemical principles and safety, combustion and explosion, fire and explosion prevention and explosion prevention safety technologies, occupational poisoning and prevention measures, and laboratory safety. Experimental teaching mainly includes standard laboratory visits and learning, fire safety practices, first aid practices, fun experiments, heavy metal waste liquid treatment experiments, and corrosive product treatment experiments. This course combines theory with examples to concisely introduce the basic concepts, theories, and methods of hazardous factors and safety production technologies in laboratories and chemical production processes. Enable students to systematically learn the dangers of hazardous chemicals, understand the hazards in the laboratory, master combustion, explosion, fire and explosion safety technologies, understand toxicity and anti toxicity measures, understand the environmental hazards caused by hazardous chemicals, analyze and evaluate the impact of professional engineering practices on society, health, safety, law, and culture, understand the safety, health, and well-being of engineers to the public, and the social responsibility of environmental protection. And combine experimental learning, theory with practice, and put laboratory safety awareness into practice. Through the study of this course, students will establish a solid concept of safety production first; To lay a solid foundation in safety theory for students to transform into outstanding frontline engineers.

default.zh: 材料科学基础是化工学院新材料化工类和材料化学专业的基础理论课程，讲授材料的成分、组织结构与材料性能和应用之间的相互关系，它将金属、陶瓷、高分子等不同材料的微观特性和宏观规律建立在共同的理论基础上，指导材料的选择、设计和应用。本课程的内容将为学习后继专业课程、从事材料相关的科学研究和工程技术工作打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: The course "Fundamentals of Materials Science" is one of basic theoretical courses for the program "New materials and chemical engineering" and “Material Chemistry”. The course is offered to address the relationship between the composition, structure and material properties as well as applications of new functional materials. A unified knowledge foundation will be clearly established by considering the common microscale structural characteristics and measured performance of various materials including metals, ceramics, polymers in order to enable students to rationally select, design and application of materials. This course will lay a solid theoretical foundation for students to learn more advanced courses and to take part in scientific research and engineering technology development regarding new functional materials and devices.

default.zh: 人工智能课程主要研究如何利用计算机自动模拟人类智能行为的原理和方法，这些技术在计算机科学以及其他相关专业都有非常广泛的应用。课程具体目标如下： 课程目标1.具备计算思维能力，初步掌握知识表示、知识推理、搜索原理和推理技术、机器学习算法，理解人工智能方法在自然语言处理、计算机视觉等领域中的应用；能够综合运用所学知识，将相对简单的具体应用问题抽象化，并应用人工智能技术加以求解； 课程目标2.具备一定计算相关的理论创新能力和工程创新能力，能够简述人工智能系统设计的基本原理和方法； 课程目标3.具有团队合作等跨学科交流能力，能够通过团队协作完成人工智能系统的初步构建。了解人工智能国内外现状和发展趋势，具有创新精神和国际视野，通过网络/文献检索等方式，了解人工智能概念、应用范围以及发展方向并能够根据专业知识论述人工智能与人类社会的关系与演进趋势。 人工智能课程在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合对各种实际应用问题的分析，进行人工智能基本概念和基本原理的教授，为学生将人工智能技术应用于未来的工作中，以及进一步深造打下基础。
default.en: The artificial intelligence course mainly studies the principles and methods of using computers to automatically simulate human intelligent behavior, and these technologies are widely applied in computer science and other related majors. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Course objective 1. Possess computational thinking skills, have a preliminary understanding of knowledge representation, knowledge reasoning, search principles and reasoning techniques, machine learning algorithms, and understand the application of artificial intelligence methods in natural language processing, computer vision, and other fields; Be able to comprehensively apply the knowledge learned, abstract relatively simple specific application problems, and apply artificial intelligence technology to solve them; Course objective 2. Possess certain theoretical and engineering innovation abilities related to computation, and be able to briefly describe the basic principles and methods of artificial intelligence system design; Course objective 3. Possess interdisciplinary communication skills such as teamwork, and be able to complete the initial construction of artificial intelligence systems through teamwork. Understand the current situation and development trends of artificial intelligence both domestically and internationally, possess innovative spirit and international perspective, understand the concept, application scope, and development direction of artificial intelligence through online/literature search, and be able to discuss the relationship and evolution trend between artificial intelligence and human society based on professional knowledge. The artificial intelligence course comprehensively utilizes the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses in the teaching process, combined with the analysis of various practical application problems, to teach the basic concepts and principles of artificial intelligence, laying the foundation for students to apply artificial intelligence technology to future work and further education.

default.zh: 《化学基础实验A》是哈尔滨工业大学化工与化学学院面相化学、化工（及相关学科）专业本科生开设的独立设课的实践课程，是学生学习后续化学实验的重要基础。 开设时间为大二上学期，开设内容与课程相关的理论课程教学大纲保持一致，更好地将理论与实践相融合，加深学生对理论知识的理解，使学生在知识、能力、素质三个方面有机融合，符合教育教学目标和规律，锻炼学生化学实验操作基本功、养成良好的实验习惯，为学生今后的实验课程学习和科研工作打下坚实的实验技能基础。
default.en: Chemical Basic Experiment A is an independent practical course offered by undergraduate students majoring in Facial Chemistry and Chemical Engineering (and related disciplines) at the School of Chemical Engineering and Chemistry, Harbin Institute of Technology. It is an important foundation for students to learn subsequent chemical experiments. The opening time is the first semester of the sophomore year, and the content is consistent with the theoretical course teaching outline related to the course. It better integrates theory and practice, deepens students' understanding of theoretical knowledge, and enables them to organically integrate knowledge, abilities, and qualities, which is in line with educational objectives and laws. It exercises students' basic skills in chemical experimental operations and develops good experimental habits, To lay a solid foundation of experimental skills for students in their future experimental course learning and scientific research work.

default.zh: 本课程是为化学类各专业学生的开设一门重要的基础课。具体内容包括结构和键、酸和碱、烷烃、烯烃、炔烃、芳香族化合物、结构与光谱、立体化学、卤代烃等内容。该课程的主要目的是使学生掌握最基本的有机化学概念和理论，在此基础上理解各种有机化合物的物理化学特性，建立如何设计和合成一些重要的有机化合物并解决实际生活中的有机化学问题的能力和思维。
default.en: Organic chemistry is one of the most important courses for second year undergraduate students majoring in department of chemistry. It includes structure and bond, acid and base, alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, arenes, structure and spectra, stereochemistry and halides. The main objective of organic chemistry is to provide a basic understanding of its principles, introduce the physical and chemical characteristics of organic compounds, learn how to design and synthesis some important active compounds and solve some problem in real life. During the process, develop students’ abilities of thinking in organic way.

default.zh: 你理想了解真正的数学、物理、化学的交叉课程吗？这里可能是对自然规律揭示最多的课程。你想知道纳米、新能源电池、材料化学等学科源头吗？你想知道如何判断化学反应以及自然界一些过程能否发生以及发生的极限怎么判定吗？你想知道为什么怎么控制反应的快慢吗？你想知道生活中诸多的现象怎么解释吗？请您来到《物理化学》课程。 物理化学运用数学、物理等基础科学的理论和实验方法来研究物质变化及与化学变化相关的物理变化中所遵循的规律和基本原理，是现代工程与应用科学学院相关专业的一门必修专业课。作为化学学科的一个分支，它主要探讨两个问题，一个是化学变化的方向和限度问题，属于化学热力学的范畴；另外一个就是化学反应的速率和机理问题，也就是化学动力学问题。学生通过本课程的学习，能够利用物理化学研究问题的一些特殊方法，其中包括的一般科学方法，掌握针对问题建立假设和模型，并逐渐上升到到理论高度。同时能够结合具体问题，培养分析和解决问题的能力。为后续的相关课程如高分子化学、材料化学等学习打下必要的基础。
default.en: Do you want to know the real cross-curricular of mathematics, physics and chemistry? This is probably the most revealing lesson about the laws of nature. Do you want to know the origin of Nano, new energy battery, material chemistry and other disciplines? Do you want to know how to judge the chemical reactions and some of the natural processes can occur and the limits of how to determine? You Want to know why you control how fast you react? Do you want to know how to explain many phenomena in life? Please come to the physical chemistry class. The physical chemistry uses fundamental science theoretical and experimental methods, such as mathematics and physics, to study the laws and fundamental principles that govern changes in matter and chemical reaction physical processes, it is a required course for a major in modern engineering and applied science. As a branch of chemistry, it deals mainly with the direction and limits of chemical reaction, which belong to the category of Chemical thermodynamics, and with the rate and mechanism of chemical reactions, the chemical kinetics problem. Through this course, students will be able to use physical chemistry specific approaches to problems, including the general scientific approach, to develop hypotheses and models for the problems and to move up to the theoretical level. At the same time can be combined with specific problems, and cultivate the ability to analyze and solve problems. Lay the necessary foundation for the following related courses such as polymer chemistry, material chemistry, etc. .

default.zh: 化学基础实验B是化学相关专业的基础实验课，包括物理化学实验和有机化学实验两部分，共设20个实验项目，学生通过自选实验项目完成“化学基础实验B”48学时的实验内容，其中物理化学实验24学时、有机化学实验24学时。化学基础实验B课程将原有的物理化学实验和有机化学实验的教学内容进行更新和重组，以基础实验知识和基础操作为主，着力设置相关理论的有机化学实验和物理化学实验，力求通过知识点的重现帮助学生对物理化学和有机化学深层理论的掌握。
default.en: The course “Experiments in Organic Chemistry B” is the basic experimental course for related majors in Department of Chemistry, including physical chemistry experiment and organic chemistry experiment. There are 20 experimental items in Chemical Basic Experiment B. Students will complete 48 experiment hours through self-selected experimental items, including 24 hours of physical chemistry experiments and 24 hours of organic chemistry experiments. The original physical chemistry experiment and organic chemistry experiment teaching content is updated and reorganized in chemical basic experiment B. Based on the basic experimental knowledge and basic operation, we focus on setting experiments of relevant theories between organic chemistry and physical chemistry, and strive to help students grasp the deep theory of physical chemistry and organic chemistry through the recurrence of knowledge points.

default.zh: 化学基础实验D是在化学基础实验B课程基础上设置的一门必修综合实验课，主要面向化学工程与工艺、新能源材料与器件、高分子材料与工程和应用化学专业的本科生，包括物理化学实验、有机化学实验和化工原理实验三大部分。化学基础实验D共设17个实验项目，其中物理化学实验6个、有机化学实验5个、化工原理实验6个，学生通过自选实验项目完成72学时实验内容，其中物理化学实验24学时、有机化学实验24学时、化工原理实验24学时。 化学基础实验D开设时间为大三上学期，开设时间与课堂教学匹配、开设内容与理论课程教学大纲保持一致，更好促进理论与实践相融合，加深和巩固学生对化学基本理论和概念的理解，培养学生实验操作能力、提高学生的技术能力和创造能力，使学生在知识、能力、素质三个方面有机融合，为后续实践课程、毕业设计和科研打下坚实基础。
default.en: Chemical Basic Experiment D is a compulsory comprehensive experiment course based on Chemical Basic Experiment B, which is mainly for undergraduates majoring in chemical engineering and technology, new energy materials and devices, polymer materials and engineering and applied chemistry, including physical chemistry experiment, organic chemistry experiment and chemical engineering principle experiment. There are 27 experimental items in Chemical Basic Experiment D, including 6 physical chemistry experiments, 5 organic chemistry experiments and 6 chemical engineering principle experiments. Students will complete 72 experiment hours through self-selected experimental items, including 24 hours of physical chemistry experiments, 24 hours of organic chemistry experiments and 24 hours of chemical engineering principle experiments. The Chemical Basic Experiment D is set in the last semester of junior year, and the opening time is matched with the lecture, and the content is consistent with the theoretical course syllabus, so as to better promote the integration of theory and practice, deepen and consolidate students' understanding of basic chemistry theories and concepts, cultivate students' experimental operation ability, improve students' technical ability and creativity, and effectively integrate students' knowledge, ability and quality, constructing a solid foundation for subsequent practical courses, graduation design and future scientific research.

default.zh: 大型仪器分析实验是大学本科化学学科的重要基础课，是培养学生有关理论与实践相结合的重要课程。大型仪器分析实验是表征和测定物质的化学组成、状态、结构和进行化学研究的重要手段；通过实验教学使学生牢固掌握重要仪器分析方法的原理、技术、优缺点以及重要应用；旨在加强基础理论知识和基本技能训练的同时，着重培养学生应用仪器分析原理和技术来分析问题和解决问题的能力，提升学生的观察能力、动手能力、思维能力和创新能力，为学生今后从事科研和各项分析工作打下良好的基础。
default.en: The course “Modern Instrumental Analysis Experiment” is one of the basic undergraduate courses for chemistry major, which aims to develop students’ ability of integrating theory with practice. In this course, students will learn how to characterize and measure chemical composition, state, and structure, and how to apply them in chemical researches. The target of the course is to make the students master the principles, techniques, applications, merits and drawbacks of Instrumental Analysis. In order to make the students develop the basic skills in scientific research and other jobs, this course aims to cultivate their ability of analyzing and solving problems using instrumental analysis principles and techniques, and foster their capabilities of observation, practice, thinking and innovation. This course can lay a good foundation for students’ research and analytical work in the future.

default.zh: 本课程是为化学类各专业学生的开设一门重要的基础课。具体内容包括结构和键、酸和碱、烷烃、烯烃、炔烃、芳香族化合物、结构与光谱、立体化学、卤代烃等内容。该课程的主要目的是使学生掌握最基本的有机化学概念和理论，在此基础上理解各种有机化合物的物理化学特性，建立如何设计和合成一些重要的有机化合物并解决实际生活中的有机化学问题的能力和思维。
default.en: Organic chemistry is one of the most important courses for second year undergraduate students majoring in department of chemistry. It includes structure and bond, acid and base, alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, arenes, structure and spectra, stereochemistry and halides. The main objective of organic chemistry is to provide a basic understanding of its principles, introduce the physical and chemical characteristics of organic compounds, learn how to design and synthesis some important active compounds and solve some problem in real life. During the process, develop students’ abilities of thinking in organic way.

default.zh: 你理想了解真正的数学、物理、化学的交叉课程吗？这里可能是对自然规律揭示最多的课程。你想知道纳米、新能源电池、材料化学等学科源头吗？你想知道如何判断化学反应以及自然界一些过程能否发生以及发生的极限怎么判定吗？你想知道为什么怎么控制反应的快慢吗？你想知道生活中诸多的现象怎么解释吗？请您来到《物理化学》课程。 物理化学运用数学、物理等基础科学的理论和实验方法来研究物质变化及与化学变化相关的物理变化中所遵循的规律和基本原理，是现代工程与应用科学学院相关专业的一门必修专业课。作为化学学科的一个分支，它主要探讨两个问题，一个是化学变化的方向和限度问题，属于化学热力学的范畴；另外一个就是化学反应的速率和机理问题，也就是化学动力学问题。学生通过本课程的学习，能够利用物理化学研究问题的一些特殊方法，其中包括的一般科学方法，掌握针对问题建立假设和模型，并逐渐上升到到理论高度。同时能够结合具体问题，培养分析和解决问题的能力。为后续的相关课程如高分子化学、材料化学等学习打下必要的基础。
default.en: Do you want to know the real cross-curricular of mathematics, physics and chemistry? This is probably the most revealing lesson about the laws of nature. Do you want to know the origin of Nano, new energy battery, material chemistry and other disciplines? Do you want to know how to judge the chemical reactions and some of the natural processes can occur and the limits of how to determine? You Want to know why you control how fast you react? Do you want to know how to explain many phenomena in life? Please come to the physical chemistry class. The physical chemistry uses fundamental science theoretical and experimental methods, such as mathematics and physics, to study the laws and fundamental principles that govern changes in matter and chemical reaction physical processes, it is a required course for a major in modern engineering and applied science. As a branch of chemistry, it deals mainly with the direction and limits of chemical reaction, which belong to the category of Chemical thermodynamics, and with the rate and mechanism of chemical reactions, the chemical kinetics problem. Through this course, students will be able to use physical chemistry specific approaches to problems, including the general scientific approach, to develop hypotheses and models for the problems and to move up to the theoretical level. At the same time can be combined with specific problems, and cultivate the ability to analyze and solve problems. Lay the necessary foundation for the following related courses such as polymer chemistry, material chemistry, etc. .

default.zh: 计算化学B课程是化学系本科生的主要课程之一。计算化学是物理化学的重要分支，是在原子或电子尺度上研究分子的结构、性质和化学反应等的主要工具，在化学化工、生命科学、材料科学、纳米科学、环境科学等相关交叉学科具有重要的应用。课程主要讲授量子化学计算方法、分子力学方法、分子动力学模拟方法和量子力学/分子力学相结合的方法的基本原理及其在相关领域的实际应用，重点使学生们了解计算化学的理论基础、计算流程、研究热点、发展趋势以及前沿应用，熟悉计算化学的计算设计和结果分析，解释实验现象，总结一般规律。
default.en: Computational Chemistry B is one of the major courses to all the students in Department of Chemistry. Computational chemistry is an important branch of physical chemistry. It is the primary tool to investigate molecule structures, properties, and chemical reactions at the electronic or molecular level, widely used in chemistry, chemical Engineering, life science, materials science, nano technology, environment science and related interdisciplinary sciences. In the course, several major computational methods, such as Quantum Chemical Calculation, Molecular Mechanics, Molecular Dynamics Simulation, and Combined Quantum Mechanical/Molecular Mechanical methods are introduced about the principles and the applications. After the lesson, the students could know the theoretical foundation, computational procedure, advanced studies, development tendency, and front applications. They will learn and understand how to design the computational procedure, analyze the computational results, explain the experimental phenomenon, and finally conclude the general rule.

default.zh: 随着计算机硬件性能的迅猛发展以及化学理论方法的不断创新，计算与模拟研究体系结构与性质显得越发重要，已是科研工作不可或缺的研究工具。本课程集化学基础理论与计算模拟技术于一体，通过讲解科研具体实例，利用上机实践操作，使学生深刻领悟量子化学计算的基础理论知识，掌握计算模拟技术，熟练运用计算软件，实现理论计算与模拟研究化学反应过程，加深对课本基础理论的理解及其科学研究中的实际应用。通过本课程的学习，培养学生利用计算与模拟等研究手段进行化学信息的理论预测和科学研究的能力，从而在更高层次上分析和解决化学及相关科学问题。
default.en: With the rapid development of computer hardware performance and the continuous innovation of chemical theory and methods, the calculations and simulations have become an indispensable research tool for scientific research. This course integrates basic chemical theory and computational simulation technology. By explaining specific examples of scientific research and using computer practice, students can deeply understand the basic theoretical knowledge of quantum chemical calculation, master computational simulation technology, skillfully use computing software, realize theoretical calculation and Simulation Research on chemical reaction process, and deepen their understanding of the basic theory of textbooks and its practical application in scientific research. Through the study of this course, students will be trained to use research means such as calculation and simulation to carry out theoretical prediction and scientific research of chemical information, so as to analyze and solve chemical and related scientific problems at a higher level.

default.zh: 化工原理是化学工程与工艺类及相近专业的一门技术基础课，以单元操作为内容，以传递过程原理和研究方法论为主线，培养学生在专业学习和工作中分析、计算和解决化工生产实际问题的能力。通过本课程的学习，要使学生掌握流体输送、传热、蒸馏、吸收等单元操作的基本原理及典型设备的设计计算方法，为进一步学习专业课程及从事工程实践奠定必要的理论基础。同时，要求通过各个教学环节培养学生的工程观点，使学生理解流体流动、传热与传质的共性与特殊性，提高分析和解决工程实际问题的能力。针对化工过程设计课程特点，在教学过程中通过加强基础、面向实际、引导思维、启发创新，使学生掌握一定的化工设计知识，培养学生的工程概念和理论联系实际的能力。
default.en: << Principles of Chemical Engineering >> is a technical foundation course of chemical engineering ＆ technology and other similar specialties. With transmission principles and research methodology as the mainline and unit operations as contents, this course focuses on training students to get the abilities of specialty learning and analyzing, calculating and solving problems in practical chemical production simultaneously. Specifically, through learning the curriculum, students will grasp the design and calculation methods of typical equipment and the basic theories of unit operations such as fluid transmission, heat transmission, distillation, absorption etc. All of these theories and methods will lay the foundation for further learning of specialty curriculum and undertaking engineering practice. At the same time, we will take efforts to help students develop the engineering viewpoint through each teaching link so as to enable them understand the commonality and particularity of fluid flow, heat and mass transfer and to improve their abilities of analyzing and solving practical engineering problems. Taking the characteristic of chemical process design curriculum into account, we will help students develop engineering concepts and the ability of linking theory with practice through helping students grasping some knowledge of chemical engineering design via strengthening basic, facing the practice, guiding thinking and inspiring innovation in the process of teaching.

default.zh: 量子力学是研究微观粒子（原子，电子等）运动规律的科学，是一门技术基础理论课。课程主要是讲述量子力学的基本原理，逐步深入地让学生认识表述原理的数学结构，如薛定谔波动力学、海森伯矩阵力学以及抽象表述的希尔伯特空间的代数结构。同时讲述量子力学的应用，比如一维定态问题，氢原子问题等，使同学们在分析清楚各类基本应用问题的物理内容基础上，掌握量子力学对一些基本问题的处理方法。
default.en: Quantum mechanics is a science that studies the laws of motion of microscopic particles (atoms, electrons, etc.), and is a technical basic theoretical course. The course mainly introduces the basic principles of quantum mechanics, and gradually allows students to understand the mathematical structures that express the principles, such as Schrodinger wave dynamics, Heisenberg matrix mechanics, and the algebraic structure of abstract Hilbert space. At the same time, it describes the applications of quantum mechanics, such as one-dimensional stationary state problems, hydrogen atom problems, etc., so that students can master the methods of dealing with some basic problems in quantum mechanics on the basis of analyzing the physical content of various basic application problems.

default.zh: 《物理化学x进阶》是化学工程与工艺专业的专业基础课程，主要讲授电解质溶液，可逆电池的电动势及其应用，电解及极化作用，化学反应动力学等内容。通过本课程的学习，使学生系统地掌握物理化学基本原理和处理方法，熟悉化学反应过程中与之而来物理量变化规律，能够定量研究物质物理化学性质与化学反应规律，并加以灵活应用用于处理实际化工生产过程中的工程问题和实验数据归纳与分析。
default.en: "Physical Chemistry x (Advance)" is a professional basic course for the major of Chemical Engineering and Technology. It mainly covers topics such as electrolyte solutions, the electromotive force of reversible cells and its applications, electrolysis and polarization, chemical reaction kinetics, etc. Through the study of this course, students can systematically master the basic principles and treatment methods of physical chemistry, be familiar with the variation laws of physical quantities in chemical reaction processes, be capable of quantitatively researching the physical and chemical properties of substances and the laws of chemical reactions, and flexibly apply them to handle engineering problems and experimental data analysis in actual chemical engineering production processes.

default.zh: 化学实验创新实践是未来技术学院化学方向学生大三学年的实践课程，也是一门为了衔接本-硕-博教学而设置的综合性、交叉性、创新性实验课程。本课程在无机化学、有机化学、分析化学、物理化学以及结构化学理论课程以及系列基础化学实验课程的基础上，通过实践项目和实验技能的综合运用，锻炼和发掘学生面对复杂科研实验问题的综合解决能力。课程引入全国大学生化学实验邀请赛、全国大学生化学创新设计大赛实验项目以及计算化学实验、虚拟仿真实验等新形态实验内容，集成化学合成、分离、结构表征、理化性能测试为一体，激发学生的好奇心和自主学习能力，促进学生在专业研究和多元化发展上的素质形成，以服务国家“双碳”目标、能源安全、航天新材料等重大战略需求为牵引，着力培养具备高度创新精神和专业素养的“干细胞式”拔尖人才，并强化学生的家国情怀和使命担当。
default.en: The innovative practice of chemical experiment is a practical course for chemistry students in the junior year of College of the School of Future Technology. It is a comprehensive, cross-cutting and innovative experimental course set up to link the teaching of university-master and doctoral courses. On the basis of inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, structural chemistry theory courses and a series of basic chemistry experiment courses, this course exercises and explores students' comprehensive ability to solve complex scientific research and experiment problems through the comprehensive application of practical projects and experimental skills. The course introduces the experimental projects of the National Invitational Chemistry Experiment Competition for College Students, the National Chemistry Innovation Design Competition for College Students, computational chemistry experiment, virtual simulation experiment and other new experimental content, integrates chemical synthesis, separation, structural characterization, physical and chemical performance test, and stimulates students' curiosity and independent learning ability. To promote the formation of students' quality in professional research and diversified development, to serve the national "double carbon" goal, energy security, aerospace new materials and other major strategic needs as a guide, focus on cultivating "stem cell" top-notch talents with a high degree of innovation and professional literacy, and strengthen students' feelings of home and country and mission.

default.zh: 仪器分析创新实践是材料科学与工程、高分子材料与工程等相关学科的重要核心课程，利用大型现代分析仪器、通过测量物质的理化性质，获取相关材料的化学组成、含量及化学结构，使学生牢固掌握仪器分析方法的原理、技术、优缺点以及重要应用，旨在加强基础理论知识和基本技能训练的同时，着重培养学生应用仪器分析原理和技术、提高分析问题和解决问题的能力，从而提升学生的观察能力、动手能力、思维能力和创新能力，为学生今后从事科研和各项分析工作打下良好的基础。
default.en: Instrumental Analysis Innovative Practice is an important core course in disciplines such as Materials Science and Engineering, Polymer Materials and Engineering, and other related fields. This course utilizes large modern analytical instruments to measure the physical and chemical properties of materials, enabling students to obtain relevant data on the chemical composition, content, and chemical structure of various materials. The goal is for students to firmly grasp the principles, techniques, advantages and disadvantages, and key applications of instrumental analysis methods. While strengthening fundamental theoretical knowledge and basic skills, the course emphasizes cultivating students' ability to apply instrumental analysis principles and techniques, improve their analytical and problem-solving skills, and enhance their observation, hands-on, thinking, and innovation abilities. This provides a solid foundation for students to engage in scientific research and various analytical tasks in the future.

default.zh: 《无机与分析化学》是化工与化学学院化工大类本科生的第一门学科基础课，起着承前启后的关键作用。本课程的主要内容由化学基础知识、化学热力学、化学平衡、物质结构以及元素化学、误差分析、分析化学原理等几部分组成，目的是使学生能够初步学会运用所学理论去解释元素及其化合物的结构、性质和化学反应规律等问题。 通过本课程学习，要求学生掌握理想气体、晶体结构的基本概念、酸碱理论及化学反应速率等基础化学知识，在此基础上，进一步掌握化学热力学、化学平衡、物质结构的基础理论、元素化学、分析化学的基础知识，了解无机与分析化学发展的新兴领域。培养学生具有初步的分析问题和解决问题的独立能力，认识化学与生产和生活实践相结合的重大意义。本课程将为后续课程学习和掌握新的科学技术打下必要的基础。
default.en: "Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry" is the first basic course of the undergraduate students in school of chemistry and chemical engineering and it will play a key role. The main contents of this course are composed of chemical basic knowledge, chemical thermodynamics, chemical balance, structural chemistry, elemental chemistry, error analysis and principles of analytical chemistry. The aim is to enable students to explain the structure, properties and the disciplinarian of chemical reaction by learned theory. Through this course, students are required to master the basic chemistry knowledge of ideal gas, basic knowledge of crystal structure, acid-base theory and chemical reaction rate. On this basis, more knowledge about chemical thermodynamics, chemical balance, structure chemistry theory, elemental chemistry and analytical chemistry will be mastered. In addition, the new development of inorganic chemistry and analytical chemistry will be introduced. This course will culture students to analyze problem and solve problem of independently, enhancing the ability to understand the chemical and production and life practice combined with learned knowledge. In addition, this course will lay a necessary foundation for the follow-up courses and the other new science and technology.

default.zh: “无机与分析化学实验”是化工学院、生命学院等相关专业学生必修的一门独立的基础化学实验课程，也是学生学习物理化学实验等后续化学实验的重要基础。通过在课堂中认真观察实验现象，获得化学感性认识，巩固课堂所学的知识，理论联系实际；掌握实验操作的基本技能，了解和掌握无机与分析化学实验中常用仪器的基本原理及使用方法；学会测定实验数据并加以正确处理，培养独立思考问题、分析问题、解决问题的能力，逐步地掌握科学的研究方法。
default.en: Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry Experiments is an independent basic chemical experimental course that students majoring in chemical engineering, life sciences, and other related majors must take. It is also an important foundation for students to learn physical chemistry experiments and subsequent chemical experiments. By carefully observing experimental phenomena in the classroom, gaining a perceptual understanding of chemistry, consolidating the knowledge learned in the classroom, and linking theory with practice; Master the basic skills of experimental operations, understand and master the basic principles and usage methods of commonly used instruments in inorganic and analytical chemistry experiments; Learn to measure experimental data and process it correctly, cultivate the ability to think independently, analyze and solve problems, and gradually master scientific research methods.

default.zh: 本课程是相关化学专业必修的技术基础课，主要任务是通过本课程的学习，使学生在中学化学的基础上，对化学反应的基本规律，变化过程中的能量关系以及物质组成、结构与性能的关系等有一个比较全面的认识；对化学实验基本技术、方法和手段做进一步训练，为学习后继课、新理论、新工艺、新技术和进行其他实验与研究奠定必要的化学基础；适当了解当前化学学科发展的特点及与其他学科的联系、交叉和渗透。通过对自然原理学习研究，培养学生分析和解决实际问题的能力，理解化学是以实验科学，对培养学生具有正确的世界观和方法论具有重要的作用。
default.en: The subject is the basic technical lesson of some other chemistry related. It aims to make the students have full knowledge about the basic rules of chemical reactions, both energy relationship and composition of substances during the course of reactions, the relationship between structures and characteristics, etc. Training on basic techniques and methods on chemical experiment will be very beneficial to the students for their later study on new theory and new techniques, as well as the other research work. Learning more deeply knowledge about the effect of science and technology on social development, the capability of solving problems with the basic chemical ideas and skills during the daily life and work are all the key factors in this subject. It is also very important for the students to form a correct world outlook and methodology.

default.zh: 化学生物前沿是一门关于化学和生物领域的前沿进展课程。授课教师结合自身科研方向主要向学生讲授化学生物相关领域的基础知识和前沿进展。包括人工合成细胞的研究进展，蛋白酶驱动的微纳米机器人的设计与疾病诊疗应用，配位化学基础知识和与其相关的金属有机框架化学方面的研究进展，超分子作用力类型、主-客体识别原理及自组装体系在功能材料中的前沿进展，新能源电化学中的化学生物学工具，新型电极材料的设计、金属-氮-碳（M-N-C）单原子催化剂的仿生设计与生物制氢等。开拓学生的视野，为期从事科创活动奠定基础。
default.en: Progress on chemistry and chemical Biology is a course on the latest developments in the fields of chemistry and biology. The teachers, combining their own research focus, mainly teach students the basic knowledge and cutting-edge progress in chemistry and chemical biology. This includes research progress on artificially synthesized cells; the design of protease-driven micro- and nanorobots and their applications in disease diagnosis and treatment; basic knowledge of coordination chemistry and research progress in related metal-organic framework chemistry; types of supramolecular interactions, principles of host-guest recognition, and forefront developments of self-assembly systems in functional materials; chemical biology tools in new energy electrochemistry, the design of new electrode materials, biomimetic design of metal-nitrogen-carbon (M-N-C) single-atom catalysts, and bio-hydrogen production. The course broadens students' perspectives and lays a foundation for future engagement in scientific and technological innovation activities.

default.zh: 《高分子物理》是高分子科学与工程专业的专业基础课，在专业课程体系中占有非常重要的地位。本课程第一章介绍了高聚物分子量和分子量分布的测量方法。第二章介绍了高分子的近程结构、高分子链的远程结构、高分子链的构象统计。第三章介绍了高聚物的溶解、高分子溶液的热力学性质、高分子浓溶液及Flory-Huggins高分子溶液理论。第四章介绍了高聚物的非晶态结构模型、非晶态聚合物的玻璃化转变、非晶态聚合物的粘性流动。第五章介绍了高聚物结晶的形态及结构、结晶聚合物的结构模型、聚合物的结晶过程、结晶聚合物的熔融、结晶度对聚合物物理和机械性能的影响以及聚合物的液晶态。第六章介绍了聚合物的拉伸行为、聚合物的断裂理论和理论强度、影响聚合物实际强度的因素。第七章介绍了聚合物的高弹性以及粘弹性的力学模型。
default.en: Polymer Physics is a basic course for the major of polymer science and engineering, and occupies a very important position in the professional curriculum system. In Chapter 1 of this course, the measurement methods of molecular weight and molecular weight distribution of polymers are introduced. In Chapter 2, the short-range structure, the far-range structure and the conformation statistics of polymer chains are introduced. In Chapter 3, the dissolution of polymers, thermodynamic properties of polymer solutions, polymer concentrated solutions and Flory-Huggins theory of polymer solutions are introduced. In Chapter 4, the amorphous structure models, glass transition and viscous flow of amorphous polymers are introduced. In Chapter 5, the morphology and structure of polymer crystals, the structure model of polymer crystals, the crystallization process of polymer, the melting of polymer crystals, the influence of crystallinity on the physical and mechanical properties of polymer, and the liquid crystal state of polymer are introduced. In Chapter 6, the tensile behavior of polymers, the fracture theory and theoretical strength of polymers, and the factors affecting the actual strength of polymers are introduced. In Chapter 7, rubber elasticity of polymers, the mechanical models of polymer viscoelasticity are introduced.

default.zh: 本课程旨在对理论科学的一个分支进行论述。它从一组实验定律出发，这些定律首先产生一组热力学参数的主要概念和将它们联系起来的约束(状态方程)。连续地，这些定律的一部分(第0 - 3定律)的形式化验证了关于一组称为状态函数(温度，内能，熵，热力学势)的形式对象存在的分析推论。根据上述宏观系统在接近平衡状态时的行为量，将制定某些标准，这些标准在科学、自然和信息通量中具有重要意义。后一项任务将通过一个没有化学转化的系统中的非均相平衡问题、扩散通量的条件和有化学反应的均相系统来举例说明。在明确的Jabobi行列式算法的基础上，给出了各种热力学性质与标准参数(即热容、等温压缩系数、热膨胀系数等)之间的数值相互关系的简明算法。 本课程也将针对系统中发生的各种涨落过程，给出热力学平衡稳定性的观点。学生将在热物理和热化学的一些可行的情况下处理平衡的概念和如何宏观地描述它的热力学参数。
default.en: This lecture course aims to give a discursive narrative of a branch in the theoretical science. It embarks from the set of experimental laws, who, in first instance, give rise to a set of the principal notions of thermodynamic parameters and constraints linking them (equations of state). Consecutively, formalization in a part of these laws (0th – 3rd laws) validates analytical corollaries about existence of a set of formal objects termed state functions (temperature, internal energy, entropy, thermodynamic potentials). Certain criteria will be formulated in terms of the said quantities about the behavior of the macroscopic system in the proximity of equilibrium, these criteria having the principal importance in science, nature and information fluxes. The latter assignment will be exemplified by an issue of heterogeneous equilibrium in a system with no chemical transformations, conditions of diffusion fluxes and a homogeneous system with a chemical reaction. There will come about concise algorithm of finding numerical inter-relation of various thermodynamic properties with the standard parameters, viz.: heat capacities, isothermal compressibility, thermal expansion coefficients, etc., basing on a clear-cut Jabobi determinants algorithm. This lecture course will also give a view-point on the stability of thermodynamic equilibrium regarding various fluctuation processes occurring in the system. The students will handle the concepts of equilibrium and ways to macroscopically describe it in terms of thermodynamic parameters for a number of viable cases in the thermo-physics and thermo-chemistry.

default.zh: 《高分子化学A》是高分子材料与工程专业的专业核心课程，以“有机化学”和“物理化学”等课程作为基础。高分子化学是研究高分子的合成原理及其化学反应的一门科学。本课程的任务是使学生掌握高分子的基本概念、合成高分子化合物的基本原理及控制聚合物反应速率和分子量的方法、高分子化学反应的特征以及聚合方法的选择。通过本课程的学习，使学生对高分子材料的合成、制备和改性有基本认识，培养学生具有应用高分子材料的实际能力，具有分析解决科研和生产实际问题的方法。
default.en: Polymer Chemistry A is the core course for the major of Polymer Science and Engineering, which is based on courses such as Organic Chemistry and Physical Chemistry. Polymer Chemistry is a science whose research field is polymer synthesis theories and polymer reactions. The task of this course is to guide students to grasp the basic concepts of polymer, the basic principles of polymerization, the methods to control polymerization rate and polymer molecular weight, the features of polymerization and the selection of polymerization methods. Through the study of this course, the students will be familiar with the polymer synthesis, preparation and modification, and be provided with the ability of applying polymer materials, and with abilities of analyzing and solving practical problems in polymer research and processing.

default.zh: 生命安全是各培训领域的必修课。 生命安全教育的目标是塑造安全人格素质、世界观态度、基本知识、技能和能力。具有高学历的专家，确保在紧急情况下对人、社会、环境的全面保护，掌握健康生活方式技能和健康防护技术，熟悉劳动防护要求。 通过培训，有效的专业活动概念与确保安全和保护人类，环境，物质和文化财产免受各种威胁的要求密不可分，并确保毕业生准备使用基本方法保护自己免受自然，技术，生物社会和军事政治紧急情况的可能后果。
default.en: Life safety is a compulsory course in various training fields. The goal of life safety education is to shape safe personality quality, world outlook attitude, basic knowledge, skills and ability. Experts with higher education ensure comprehensive protection of people, society and environment in emergency situations, master the skills of healthy lifestyle and health protection technology, and be familiar with the requirements of labor protection. Through the training, the concept of effective professional activity as inseparable from the requirements of ensuring the safety and protection of human beings, the environment, material and cultural property from various threats has been developed, and graduates are ensured to be prepared to use basic methods to protect themselves from the possible consequences of natural, technological, bio-social and military-political emergencies.

default.zh: 《高分子专业实验》是高分子材料与工程专业的一门工程实践课程，囊括了高分子化学实验、高分子物理实验和高分子材料综合实验三部分的相关知识内容。其中高分子化学实验部分在教学环节中运用高分子化学和有机化学的有关知识，对学生进行高分子化学实验基本研究方法的培养；高分子物理实验部分主要涉及现代测定高分子结构及性能的方法和手段，与理论教学相配合；高分子材料综合实验主要讲授高分子材料相关实验，包括材料加工、材料改性和性能表征。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握高聚物的合成原理、实验操作方法和实验控制方法；学会将理论教学内容与实际应用相结合，加强实际操作能力。通过实验验证所学知识、理论的可靠性及正确性；掌握实际影响因素对实验的作用，更好地理解专业课程中材料加工、改性与性能的关系，加工过程对结构及性能的影响。基于实验的辅助教学，使学生对理论知识的掌握有所提高，加强动手能力的培养，掌握实验技巧和规范操作；使学生在实验和亲自设计、制造中逐渐学会把理论知识运用于生产实践中，培养学生的工程意识，为今后的科学研究和工作打下基础。
default.en: 《Experiments for Polymer Major》 is an engineering practice course for polymer materials and engineering majors, which includes three parts of related knowledge contents: polymer chemistry experiments, polymer physics experiments, and polymer materials comprehensive experiments. The polymer chemistry experiment section utilizes relevant knowledge of polymer chemistry and organic chemistry in the teaching process to cultivate students' basic research methods in polymer chemistry experiments; The experimental part of polymer physics mainly involves modern methods and means for measuring the structure and properties of polymers, in conjunction with theoretical teaching; The comprehensive experiment of polymer materials mainly teaches experiments related to polymer materials, including material processing, material modification, and performance characterization. Through the study of this course, students will master the synthesis principles, experimental operation methods, and experimental control methods of polymers; Learn to combine theoretical teaching content with practical applications, and enhance practical operational abilities. Verify the reliability and correctness of the knowledge and theory learned through experiments; master the role of actual influencing factors in experiments, and better understand the relationship between material processing, modification, and performance in professional courses, as well as the impact of processing processes on structure and performance. Assisted teaching based on experiments can improve students' mastery of theoretical knowledge, strengthen the cultivation of hands-on skills, master experimental techniques, and standardize operations; Enable students to gradually learn to apply theoretical knowledge to production practice through experiments, personal design, and manufacturing, cultivate their engineering awareness, and lay a foundation for future scientific research and work.

default.zh: 以通识教育模式开展俄罗斯概况课程教学，旨在帮助学生全面认识俄罗斯的国际定位 —— 它是当代世界政治的核心参与主体之一、苏联的继承国、联合国安理会常任理事国，更是中国在国际关系领域的重要合作伙伴。 本课程内容涵盖以下核心目标： 引导学生研习俄罗斯国家与社会形成发展进程中的主要历史阶段与分期； 帮助学生构建起各历史阶段与客观历史进程、俄罗斯社会各阶层利益诉求之间的关联互动体系； 带领学生了解俄罗斯在不同发展阶段推动社会政治演变的核心世界观与思想体系； 使学生充分认识俄罗斯在科技与文化领域为世界文明发展作出的历史贡献。
default.en: Studying the history of Russia in a general education format is aimed at giving students a general idea of Russia as one of the key subjects of modern world politics, the successor state of the Soviet Union, a permanent member of the UN Security Council and, in particular, an important partner of China in international relations. As part of the course, students are invited to study the main historical stages and periods in the history of the formation of the Russian state and society; to build a system of interrelations and Mutuality of these periods with the objective historical process and the interests of various social groups of Russian society; to get acquainted with the basic range of worldviews and ideas underlying the socio-political evolution of Russia at different stages of its existence; to get an idea of the historical significance of Russia's scientific and cultural contribution to world civilization.

default.zh: 《高分子材料分析表征技术》是在掌握了高分子物理、高分子化学等知识基础上，运用现代技术去分析聚合物的结构特点，了解材料的基本性能的课程，通过本课程的学习可以进一步补充学生的知识体系，了解并掌握基本的测试技术，提高学生分析问题的能力。进行高分子方面技术人员所需的基本知识和技能训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事该领域的生产、研究和开发工作奠定基础。 通过高分子材料技术表征课程的学习，根据实际情况，能够提出聚合物链结构、聚集态结构的基本表征手段及剖析未知物的方法；掌握紫外、红外、核磁、热分析等使用范围、基本操作以及图像（谱图）解析，同时了解高分子结构解析的基本思想方法，为后续的从事高分子专业课程的学习、研究与生产等实践打下良好的理论基础，主要达到以下3点目标：； 课程目标1：掌握分子吸收光谱、核磁和热分析等表征方法的基本理论，能够运用基本原理，借助文献研究，分析高分子聚合或加工等过程的影响因素并获得有效结论。 课程目标2：能够综合运用各种研究方法，对高分子材料与工程专业的复杂工程问题进行研究，针对实验结果、现象进行分析和解释，并通过信息综合得到合理有效的结论。 课程目标3：具有自主学习的能力，综合运用各种方法能够针对具体的对象，开发或选用满足特定需求的现代工具或者方法，并能够分析其局限性。
default.en: 《Analysis and Characterization Technology of Polymer Materials》 is a course based on mastering polymer physics, polymer chemistry and other knowledge, using modern technology to analyze the structural characteristics of polymers and understand the basic properties of materials. Through the study of this course, students can further supplement their knowledge system, understand and master basic testing technology, and improve their ability to analyze problems. Aiming to train the students with basic polymer-related knowledge and skills, so as to lay the foundation for the students to further study the relevant professional courses and engage in the production and research in the future. Through the study of this course, the students are expected to master the ability to put forward the basic characterization means of polymer chain structure and aggregate structure and the method of analyzing unknown objects; master the application scope, basic operation and image (spectrum) analysis of UV, IR, NMR, thermal analysis, etc., and understand the basic ideas and methods of polymer structure analysis, so as to provide reference for the follow-up work and lay a good theoretical foundation for the study, research and production of polymer. In general, the following three goals are expected to be achieved: Course objective 1: master the basic theory of characterization methods such as molecular absorption spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance and thermal analysis, and be able to use the basic principles to analyze the influencing factors of polymer polymerization or processing and obtain effective conclusions with the help of literature research. Course objective 2: be able to comprehensively use various research methods to study the complex engineering problems of polymer materials and engineering, analyze and explain the experimental results and phenomena, and get reasonable and effective conclusions through information synthesis. Course objective 3: have the ability of initiative learning; be able to use or develop modern tools or methods to meet specific needs for specific objects.

default.zh: 《热力学与动力学的应用方面》是专业必修课之一。该课程为物理化学领域的部分应用问题（例如分离方法、相平衡描述等）提供基础知识。 在本课程中，学生将运用热力学与化学动力学的物理原理及方法 / 工具，继续深入学习相平衡与化学平衡的现象及基本规律，以及相关的物理化学过程。通过该课程的学习，学生能够提升运用理论方法、分析并解决各类实际应用问题的能力。 本课程的精选主题包括：纯物质与混合物（理想及实际气 / 液体系）的热力学描述、多相平衡及化学平衡。
default.en: Applied Aspects of Thermodynamics and Kinetics is one of the professional compulsory courses. It provides fundamental knowledge for some applied issues of physical chemistry, for example, separation methods, description of phase equilibria. In this course, the students continue to study the phenomena and underlying laws of phase and chemical equilibria, relevant physico-chemical processes, using physical principles and methods/tools of thermodynamics and chemical kinetics. Through this course, the students can develop their abilities for applying of theoretical approaches, and analyzing and solving various problems having practical usage. Selected topics of this course are thermodynamic description of pure components and mixtures (ideal and real gas/liquid systems), heterogeneous and chemical equilibria.

default.zh: 《高分子流变学》是为高分子材料与工程专业本科生开设的一门专业必修课，为培养高分子材料与工程专业的高级工程技术人才服务，主要应用于高分子复合材料的配方设计、高分子加工设备的设计、制造及高分子成型加工工艺的改进等领域。通过《高分子流变学》课程的学习，使学生正确理解和掌握高分子流变学的基本概念、高分子流变行为及其数学模型、高分子流变行为与环境参数的关系、高分子的结构对高分子流变性能的影响、高分子流变性能的表征方法、高分子流变学的实际应用等，要求学生在系统地掌握高分子流变学基础理论的同时，对流变性能测定原理、步骤、结果评价和实际应用有一个全面的了解。此课程的学习对学生专业知识的培养和提高有着举足轻重的作用，为其今后就业提供基础技术支撑。
default.en: Polymer rheology is one of the main courses for the students majoring in the polymer material and engineering, which service for training the advanced engineering and technology talents who will work in fields such as designing polymer matrix composites formulation, designing and manufacturing the polymer molding equipments, and improving the polymer molding process. The knowledge and abilities which the students should grasp through the learning of this course are as follows: the student should understand and master the basic concept of polymer rheology, the behavior and mathematical model of polymer rheology, the relationship between polymer rheology behavior and environment parameter, the effect of polymer structure on polymer rheology behavior, the determination and characterization on polymer rheology behavior and the application of polymer rheology, and while mastering the basic theory of polymer rheology, the students should overall understand the principle, the process and the result evaluation and the application of the rheology. So this course is important for culturing and improving the professional knowledge of the students. It will provide support of basic techniques for the students in the future work.

default.zh: 生物材料和药物输送系统是生物医学里一门发展非常迅速的科学和实用的领域。 在本课程结束时，学生应： 1)了解生物材料在现代医学实践中的重要性以及新生物材料的发展现状； 认识生物材料发展的主要历史阶段； 了解人体解剖学和组织结构的主要定义；了解免疫系统功能与机体相互作用的基本原理； 了解小分子和生物药物动力学的主要问题。 2)了解材料科学的基本定义：金属，陶瓷，聚合物和复合材料； 结构-性质关系：原子结构，分子结构和晶体结构对机械和生物学性质的影响。 生物相容性，生物降解性和生物功能性定义。 了解当前医学实践中生物材料应用的主要领域。 3)了解与药物输送系统有关的胶体化学的定义。 制剂类型对药代动力学的影响。 了解当前使用的控释制剂和靶向药物递送方法。 4)了解组织工程学和支架制造方法的基本原理。 了解生物制药的主要方向（酶，pDNA，siRNA等）及其靶向方法。
default.en: Biomaterials and drug delivery systems is the very fast developing scientific and practical area of biomedicine. At the end of this course, students should: 5)Understand the importance of biomaterials application in the modern medical practice as well as actuality of development of new biomaterials; realize the main historical stages of biomaterials evolution; understand the main definitions of anatomy and tissue structures, know the basic principles of immune system functioning with relation to the body-material interaction; understand the main problems of small molecules and biopharmaceutics pharmacokinetics. 6)Know the basic definitions of materials science: metal, ceramics, polymer and composites; Structure-properties relationship: effect of atomic structure, molecular structure and crystal structure on mechanical and biological properties. Biocompatibility, Biodegradability and Biofunctionality definitions. Knowledge of the main areas of biomaterials application in current medical practice. 7)Know the definitions of colloid chemistry in relation to the drug delivery systems. Effect of formulation type on pharmacokinetics. Knowledge of currently used controlled release formulations and targeted drug delivery approaches. Understand the basic principles of tissue engineering and scaffold fabrication methods. Realize the main directions of biopharmaceutics (enzymes, pDNA, siRNA etc.) application as well as their targeting approaches.

default.zh: 《理论电化学》是非化学工程与工艺（电化学）专业学生的辅修课程。它是在无机化学与物理化学中有关电化学热力学理论的基础上，从电化学动力学观点出发，深刻地揭示了电化学反应的内在本质和基本规律，全面阐述了电化学反应速度与电极电位之间的关系。本课程的主要内容有：电极／溶液界面的结构与性质；电荷交换过程动力学、液相传质过程动力学。通过本门课程的学习使学生掌握现代电化学科学的基本理论及其思想方法，认识一些典型电极过程的动力学规律，为后续的电化学专业课程的学习和从事电化学研究与生产等实践打下良好的理论基础。
default.en: Theoretical Electrochemistry is a supplementary course for students majoring in Non Chemical Engineering and Technology (Electrochemistry). Based on the theoritics of electrochemical thermodynamics introduced in inorganic chemistry and physical chemistry, this course gives the inwardness and basic discipline of electrochemical reaction from the standpoint of electrochemical kinetics, expatiates the relationship between reaction rate and over-potential fully. As a theoritics course, Theory of Electrochemistry requests the students have fully mastered advanced mathematics, physical chemistry, inorganic chemistry, electrotechnics and electronics. The main contents of this course are as follow: the structure and characteristics of the electrode/solution interface, kinetics of charge exchange process, kinetics of mass transfer process. The main purpose of this course is to make students master the basic theories and investigation method of modern electrochemical science, understand the kinetics principle of some typical electrodes processes, and establish the theoritcal foundation for their job.

default.zh: 《固体物理基础》是研究固体的结构、对称性、晶体周期场中电子的运动，以及固体的热学、力学以及光学性质的学科。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握，晶体结构、晶格振动、能带理论等相关知识，要求其深入理解其基本概念，有清楚的物理图象，能够熟练掌握基本的物理方法，并具有综合运用所学知识分析问题和解决问题的能力，为今后从事半导体等固体器件的设计打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The course entitled, fundamentals of solid state physics, deals with the formation of crystals, the symmetry of crystals, the movement of electrons in periodic crystal field, as well as the thermal, mechanical, and optical attributes of solid-state materials, typically of crystals. The aim of this course is to instruct students to understand the crystal structure, the lattice vibration, the energy band theory, and the movement of electrons in solid state materials, etc. The attenders to this course are expected to have a clear physical picture on the educated subjects, and be able to independently analyze and solve problems when designing a solid-state-related device.

default.zh: 化学动力学是研究化学反应速率和机理的学科。在本课程结束时，学生应： 1)了解化学动力学作为化学过程的的重要性。 能够将一般定律和方程式应用于特定的反应和过程。 2)掌握动力学的基本概念，如：反应速率，质量作用定律，反应级数； 了解不同阶反应的动力学方程； 熟悉反向，连续，同时，催化，自催化和振荡反应的主要动力学特征； 区分基元反应和复合反应； 知道如何将稳态近似应用于复杂反应的动力学。 3)了解反应速率如何取决于温度以及原因。 了解Arrhenius方程和活化能的定义。 了解分子动力学的基本概念，例如：碰撞理论，过渡态理论，Lindemann理论和RRK理论。 了解反应速率与反应物的分子特性之间的关系。
default.en: Chemical kinetics is a subject that studies the rates and mechanisms of chemical reactions. At the end of this course, students should: 1)Understand the importance of chemical kinetics as a general teaching of chemical process. Be able to apply the general laws and equations studied to specific reactions and processes. 2)Master the basic concepts of formal kinetics, such as: reaction rate, mass action law, reaction order; know the kinetic equations for reactions with different order; be familiar with the main kinetic features of opposing, consecutive, simultaneous, catalytic, autocatalytic and oscillating reactions; distinguish between elementary and composite reactions; know how to apply the steady-state approximation to the kinetics of complex reactions. 3)Understand how the reaction rate depends on temperature and why. Know the Arrhenius equation and the definition of activation energy. Be aware of the basic concepts of molecular kinetics such as: collision theory, transition-state theory, Lindemann and RRK theory. Realize how the reaction rate is related to the molecular properties of reactants.

default.zh: 电化学技术的应用正日益受到人们的高度重视，例如，燃料电池和电池提供了轻便的可移动式的供能方式，成为高性能电动车、微电子技术、通信技术的重要组成部分；基于电化学原理的电分析技术和化学传感器为生物技术、工业和环境监测以及日常生活提供了研究和分析的手段；电解工业可以实现大量无机物、有机物的电解合成，金属的提取和精炼；电化学技术还可以实现材料的表面处理；在微纳米材料、微纳米器件的制备和构筑方面电化学技术也取得了重要的进展。目前，所有这些热点的电化学应用领域均有大量的论著和教材，然而，用于电化学体系研究的通用的测量方法却非常少，或者只关注电化学研究的理论而较少论及测量的实验手段和实验细节。本课程较为系统讲述电化学动力学研究各类测量方法的原理、测量技术和数据解析方法，希望能够对希望了解电化学领域的同学或者正在从事电化学领域的同学起到帮助作用。
default.en: The application of electrochemical technology is attracting increasing attention. For example, fuel cells and batteries provide portable and portable energy supply methods and have become an important part of high-performance electric vehicles, microelectronics technology, and communication technology. Electroanalytical technology and chemical sensors based on chemical principles provide research and analysis methods for biotechnology, industrial and environmental monitoring, and daily life. Electrolysis industry can realize the electrolytic synthesis of a large number of inorganic and organic substances, and the extraction and refining of metals. Surface treatment of materials can also be achieved. Electrochemical technology has also made important progress in the preparation and construction of micro-nano materials and micro-nano devices. At present, there are a large number of treatises and textbooks on all these hot electrochemical application fields. However, there are very few general measurement methods for electrochemical system research, or they only focus on the theory of electrochemical research and rarely discuss measurement. This course systematically introduces the principles, measurement techniques and data analysis methods of various measurement methods in electrochemical kinetics research. It is hoped that it will be helpful to students who want to understand the field of electrochemistry or students who are currently engaged in the field of electrochemistry.

default.zh: 本课程为基础实验课程，主要面向《能源材料制备与分析技术》、《能源催化原理》、《电化学器件原理》、《太阳能电池工艺与器件》等课程，帮助学生掌握新能源材料的常规制备方法、分析方法。通过本课程，加深对新能源的理解，建立由化学试剂、化工到绿色能源、新型能源的思路，加深对课堂所学固体物理、太阳能电池与器件等相关理论知识的理解，并通过实验验证部分理论的内容，锻炼学生基础制备、分析表征实验技能，培养学生独立工作和综合分析的能力。 本课程具体包括“一步法制备二硫化钼/亚氧化钛电解水析氢催化剂”等9个实验项目，共计48 学时。
default.en: This course is a basic experimental course mainly aimed at courses such as "Energy Material Preparation and Analysis Technology", "Energy Catalytic Principles", "Electrochemical Device Principles", "Solar Cell Processes and Devices", etc., to help students master the conventional preparation and analysis methods of new energy materials. Through this course, we aim to deepen our understanding of new energy, establish a train of thought from chemical reagents and chemical engineering to green energy and new energy, deepen our understanding of theoretical knowledge related to solid physics, solar cells and devices learned in the classroom, and validate some theoretical content through experiments. We aim to train students' basic preparation, analysis and characterization experimental skills, and cultivate their ability to work independently and comprehensively analyze. This course specifically includes 9 experimental projects, including "one-step preparation of molybdenum disulfide/titanium dioxide electrolysis water hydrogen evolution catalyst", totaling 48 class hours.

default.zh: 本课程旨在使学生熟悉化学传感器的基本原理。化学传感器基于（主要）明确的基本规律基础上，应用科学领域的一个快速发展的分支。 学生将了解“属于”不同的科学领域：数学，物理和化学的基本定律如何在实际相关的设备上发挥相互作用。 课程目标具体如下： 1.对各种化学传感器（特别是基于离子载体的传感器）进行系统描述，并对传感器响应机理进行简要描述； 2.概述特定种类的化学传感器和生物传感器在特定应用中的优缺点； 3.概述化学传感器的现代发展趋势； 4.了解用于气体和液体分析的多传感器系统； 5.了解多元数据处理技术； 6.了解多传感器系统的适用范围。
default.en: The course is aimed at making students acquainted with the basic principles of chemical sensors: a fast developing branch in the applied science based on (mostly) clear fundamental regularities. Students will see how fundamental laws which “belong” to different sciences: mathematics, physics and chemistry interplay when it comes to practically relevant devices. The course objectives are to give 1.a systematic description of various sorts of chemical sensors ( with a special attention to ionophore-based sensors), and a brief characterization of the mechanism of the sensor response; 2.an overview of the advantages and disadvantages of particular kinds of chemical sensors and biosensors in particular applications; 3.an overview of the modern trends in chemical sensors; 4.an understanding of multisensor systems for gas and liquid analysis; 5.an understanding of multivariate data processing techniques; 6.an understanding of the applicability domain of multisensor systems.

default.zh: 随着经济发展，科技进步，对能源需求越来越大，环境污染越来越严重。因此绿色、清洁新型能源的开发越来越受到重视，其产业化发展速度越来越快，产业规模逐渐增大，其应用也越来越广，在国民经济中发挥的作用越显著。新型化学电源这门课程就是讲述在科技发展过程中，出现的新型锂离子电池、低温燃料电池、氧化还原液流电池和钠硫电池等知识的一门课程。 新型化学电源是化学工程与工艺专业（电化学专业）的辅修课程之一。新型化学电源课程系统阐述了锂离子电池基本原理、正负极材料的种类、特性、生产和应用等；低温燃料电池基本的基本原理、结构、电极材料、制备关键技术；氧化还原液流电池的原理、特性、应用、研究进展；钠硫电池的基本原理、结构、性能以及电极材料和电解质溶液的概况等。通过新型化学电源课程的学习，要求学生在明确锂离子电池、低温燃料电池、氧化还原液流电池和钠硫电池基本概念的基础上，掌握相关基础理论和性能指标，了解各种新型化学电源的原理、应用领域、生产关键技术以及制造工艺技术等，为以后从事新型化学电源的研究、开发、生产等工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Environment pollution is worse and worse with economic development and technology advancement. So, the exploitation of novel electrochemical power sources has been paid attention in the past decades. Its industrialization development is more and more fast. Its scale of industry is sharply increasing. Its applications are of diversification. Novel electrochemical power sources are playing an important role in national economy. Novel electrochemical power source is a course about the lithium ion battery, low-temperature fuel cells, redox flow battery, Na-S battery, and so on. Novel electrochemical power source is one of the minors for students studying in the specialty of chemical engineering and technology. This course expounds the production, storage, transportation and utilization of lithium ion battery; the detailed introduces the integrated utilization of lithium ion battery and the principle, structure of fuel cells, electrode materials and preparation technology, the generate electricity, getting heat and storage of redox flow battery, the primary principle, structure and performances of Na-S battery. Students having studied this course should grasp the basic concepts of lithium ion battery, low-temperature fuel cells, redox flow battery, and Na-S battery, master their important theories and performances, understand the general situation of the production, transformation, and utilization of different novel electrochemical power sources and their preparation technology. After having studied this course, students should make a stable foundation for engaging in the research and development and manufacture of novel electrochemical power sources.

default.zh: 本课程为基础实验课程，主要面向《能源材料制备与分析技术》、《能源催化原理》、《电化学器件原理》、《太阳能电池工艺与器件》等课程，帮助学生掌握新能源材料的综合设计制备方法、分析方法。通过本课程，加深对新能源的理解，建立绿色新型能源的全局思路，加深对课堂所学固体物理、太阳能电池与器件等相关理论知识的理解，并通过实验验证部分理论的内容，锻炼学生基础制备、分析表征实验技能，培养学生独立工作和综合分析的能力。 本课程具体包括“FeS2热电池正极薄膜的制备及性能评价”等8个实验项目，共计48 学时。
default.en: This course is a basic experimental course, mainly aimed at courses such as "Energy Material Preparation and Analysis Technology", "Energy Catalytic Principles", "Electrochemical Device Principles", "Solar Cell Processes and Devices", etc., to help students master the comprehensive design, preparation, and analysis methods of new energy materials. Through this course, we aim to deepen our understanding of new energy, establish a global approach to green and new energy, deepen our understanding of theoretical knowledge related to solid physics, solar cells and devices learned in the classroom, and validate some theoretical content through experiments. We aim to train students' basic preparation, analysis, and characterization experimental skills, and cultivate their ability to work independently and comprehensively analyze. This course specifically includes 8 experimental projects, including "Preparation and Performance Evaluation of FeS2 Thermal Battery Positive Electrode Thin Film", totaling 48 class hours.

default.zh: 化学（主要是有机化合物转化的化学）是生命系统健康运转的基础。同时，各种疾病-从普通感冒到令人衰弱的疾病，例如癌症和终级病毒感染，都有其潜在的机制，掌握该知识可以帮助我们设计药物。该课程将概述生命细胞功能的化学方面的知识，从遗传信息转化为生物分子，到这些生物分子作为生物催化剂发挥作用产生人体所必需的分子。课程的另一部分将重点讨论这些经过良好调整的系统开始出现故障从而触发疾病状态的范例。最后，了解这些疾病背后的化学反应，以帮助设计新颖的治疗方法。在本课程结束时，学生应： 1）了解真核细胞功能的化学基础知识； 2）了解各种生物分子的功能与小分子细胞成分的作用之间的关系； 3）了解寻找使人衰弱的疾病的治疗方法以及药物化学和药物发现的基础； 4）学习并记住细胞中重要的小分子成分和常见生物活性化合物的化学结构。
default.en: Chemistry (primarily, chemistry of transformations of organic compounds) is the foundation of healthy functioning of living systems. At the same time, various diseases – from common cold to such debilitating ailments as cancer and terminal viral infections – have underlying mechanisms whose knowledge can help design drugs. The course will provide a general overview of chemical aspects of live cell functioning, from translation of genetic information into biomolecules all the way through these biomolecules functioning as biocatalysts which themselves are necessary for producing essential molecules in the human body. The other part of the course will focus on discussing examples of these well-tuned systems beginning to malfunction thus triggering the disease state. Finally, understanding chemistry behind these diseases can aid in designing novel treatments. At the end of this course, students are expected to: 1)understand chemical foundations of the functioning of the eukaryotic cell; 2)understand the relationship between functioning of various biomolecules and the role of small molecule cell components; 3) understand modern approaches to finding treatment to debilitating diseases and foundations of medicinal chemistry and drug discovery; 4)Learn and memorize the chemical structures of essential small-molecule constituents of the cell and common bioactive chemical compounds.

default.zh: 本课程以讲授电镀的基本理论、工艺、维护管理等为主。授课内容包括： 电镀的基本概念、金属电结晶的基本理论和电镀液的性能，电镀锌、铜、镍、铬的工艺，金属共沉积理论、影响金属共沉积的因素及几种典型的电镀合金；化学镀原理、化学镀镍工艺和化学镀铜工艺；镀层性能测试等。
default.en: This course mainly focuses on teaching the basic theory, process, maintenance management, etc. of electroplating. The teaching content includes: basic concepts of electroplating, basic theories of metal electrocrystallization, properties of electroplating solutions, processes of electroplating zinc, copper, nickel, and chromium, theory of metal co deposition, factors affecting metal co deposition, and several typical electroplating alloys; Principles of chemical plating, chemical nickel plating process, and chemical copper plating process; Coating performance testing, etc.

default.zh: 本课程是一门综合性实验课程，是将材料化学专业所涉及的一些典型实验，在尽量与本专业基础理论和研究方向相结合的基础上，经过综合考虑、筛选而定。通过本课程的学习，可以使学生加深课堂所学理论知识，通过实验验证部分理论的内容，使学生基本实验技能得到训练。为将来科学研究和技术开发打下良好的实验基础。
default.en: Synthetic experiment of materials chemistry is a comprehensive experiment course, the experiments referred in this course is obtained through comprehensively considering the combination of the classical experiments referred to the major of materials chemistry, specialized basic theory and research fields. Through the study of the course, the student can consolidate the theory knowledge from the class. Beside, the basic experiment skill can also be trained by validating the part of the theory contents, which can lay a good foundation for the future scientific research.

default.zh: 《高分子化合物化学》是专业必修课之一，主要讲授高分子相关的基础知识。该课程旨在培养学生掌握高分子化合物（聚合物）化学的核心原理，并明确聚合物与低分子化合物之间的根本区别。 课程内容以高分子链概念为基础，系统阐述高分子化学与高分子物理化学的所有核心领域，具体分为 7 个章节：高分子化学导论、自由基聚合制备聚合物、离子聚合与共聚、缩聚反应、聚合物的化学改性、高分子溶液以及高分子力学。 课程中既探讨了聚合物制备的经典方法，也涵盖了相关创新技术，并重点关注用于研究聚合物性能的现代物理化学方法。此外，还会讨论最常用的聚合物及高分子材料在科学与技术各领域的应用可能性。
default.en: Chemistry of Macromolecular Compounds is one of the professional compulsory courses, which provides fundamental knowledge about polymers. The course is aimed at the developing the main principles of chemistry of high molecular compounds (polymers) and identifying the fundamental differences between polymers and low molecular compounds. All the essential aspects of the chemistry and physical chemistry of polymers are presented based on the polymer chain concept. The course consists of 7 sections: introduction to polymer chemistry, polymer synthesis by radical polymerization, ionic polymerization and copolymerization, polycondensation, chemical modification of polymers, polymer solutions, and polymer mechanics. Both typical and innovative approaches to the polymers obtaining are considered. Particular attention is paid to modern physical and chemical methods for studying the properties of polymers. The possibilities of using the most widespread polymers and polymer materials in various fields of science and technology are discussed.

default.zh: 《电化学实验》是化学工程与工艺专业开设的课程，主要针对“碳中和”目标实现的电化学储能、氢能等相关方向，讲授基本电化学实验及具体操作方法，既包括一些经典的实验方法和有关实验基本技能训练的实验，又涵盖了一些使用仪器设备比较复杂、实验方法比较先进的实验内容。 通过本课程的学习，加深电化学方向所学理论知识，使学生基本实验技能得到训练。培养学生利用电化学方法解决问题的动手能力，并为学生获得独立工作和从事科学研究工作的能力奠定基础。主要达到4点目标： 课程目标1： 基于电化学极化、电化学阻抗模型，能正确开展相关实验，并进行数据处理分析。 课程目标2： 能够针对电化学装置和测试项目的需求，完成极化曲线、循环伏安曲线等测试单元的设计，能利用该单元（部件）进行相关实验，并进行数据处理分析。 课程目标3： 能够利用合适的仪器和测试方法构建电极材料测试系统、电化学阻抗谱测试系统，安全地开展实验，科学地采集实验数据，达到研究目的。 课程目标4：在课程学习中通过了解行业动态与国计民生的关系，培养学生优良品德、对电化学相关行业的执着信念、相应国家号召的家国情怀、良好的科学素养和强烈的社会任感，能够在工程实践中理解并遵守工程职业道德和规范，履行责任。
default.en: Electrochemical Experiments is a course offered by the Chemical Engineering and Technology major, it is mainly aimed at achieving the goal of carbon neutrality through electrochemical energy storage, hydrogen energy, and other related directions. It teaches basic electrochemical experiments and specific operating methods, including some classic experimental methods and experiments related to basic experimental skill training, as well as some experimental content with complex equipment and advanced experimental methods. From this course, the theoretical knowledge can be deepen in the field of electrochemistry and the basic experimental skills can be trained . students' hands-on ability can be cultivated to use electrochemical methods to solve problems, and it will help students to work independently and engage in scientific research.

default.zh: 《化学电源原理》是新能源材料与器件专业中电化学培养方向的主干基础课程，是在电化学原理以及电化学测试技术基础上，进一步阐述电化学基本原理在电化学生产中的运用。通过本课程的学习，使学生理解和掌握各类化学电源的结构、工作原理、性能和制造工艺，同时了解各类化学电源的发展趋势和应用场景。本课程注重基本理论与实际应用的结合，培养学生运用理论电化学知识分析、判断、解决电化学生产中实际问题的能力，为今后从事电化学领域的工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: "Principles of Chemical Power Sources" is the main basic course for electrochemistry cultivation in the major of new energy materials and devices. It further elaborates on the application of electrochemical basic principles in electrochemical production based on electrochemical principles and electrochemical measurement methods. Students who has successfully finished this course will understand the structure, working principle, performance and manufacturing techniques of various chemical power sources. Students will also know the development trends and application scenarios of chemical power sources. This course focuses on the combination of basic theory and practical application, cultivating students' ability to use theoretical electrochemistry knowledge to analyze, judge and solve the practical problems in electrochemical production. This will build solid foundation for future work in the field of electrochemistry.

default.zh: 《专业实验》为我系中俄联合办学四年级本科学生春季学期开设的一门专业内实验课程，实验学时共计96课时。专业实验在实验内容上不再以基础操作、单一合成、仪器测试为主。而是围绕电化学、实验数据处理，量子化学、实验数据处理、生物材料与药物输送系统等专业核心课程为主线，结合仪器分析测量手段和物理化学方法，设计不同方向，不同层次的综合化学实验。目前有15个综合实验被选入课程中，全部实验分为四个模块包括：能源化学实验模块、生物化学实验模块、材料化学实验模块和计算化学实验模块。每个模块均围绕某一主题成系统的进行，其中计算化学模块的实验项目辅助配合实际操作实验展开。通过系统化的实验设计、操作与数据分析，不仅能够深化学生对理论知识的理解，更能锻炼其独立思考和解决实际问题的能力。在激发其创新思维的同时，为未来从事科研工作或解决实际问题奠定坚实基础，提升学生的综合素质和科研竞争力。
default.en: "Cognition Practice" is a specialized laboratory course offered in the spring semester for fourth-year undergraduate students our department. The course comprises a total of 96 lab hours. In terms of content, the experiments move beyond basic operations, single-step syntheses, or instrument testing. Instead, they are designed as comprehensive chemical experiments across various directions and levels, centered around core professional courses such as electrochemistry, experimental data processing, quantum chemistry, biomaterials, and drug delivery systems. These experiments integrate instrumental analysis techniques and physicochemical methods. Currently, 15 comprehensive experiments have been selected for the course, divided into four modules: Energy Chemistry, Biochemistry, Materials Chemistry, and Computational Chemistry. Each module is systematically organized around a specific theme, with the Computational Chemistry experiments serving as auxiliary support for the hands-on experiments. Through systematic experimental design, operation, and data analysis, students can deepen their understanding of theoretical knowledge while enhancing their ability to think independently and solve practical problems. The course not only stimulates innovative thinking but also lays a solid foundation for future scientific research or real-world problem-solving, ultimately improving students' overall competence and research competitiveness.

default.zh: 《太阳能电池原理》学习内容包括：太阳能光电材料和半导体材料的基本性质及半导体的光生伏特效应。研究太阳能电池材料制备原理、制备工艺和基本性能，学习太阳能电池材料的结构、组成以及对太阳能电池性能的影响。以晶硅太阳能电池、非晶硅薄膜太阳能电池及化合物太阳能电池为基础，具体学习相关工艺的特点及特征，并讨论相关材料的新概念、新技术及最前沿的技术发展现状，为学习后续课程及从事光伏器件相关研究打下基础。
default.en: 《Principles of Solar Cells》learning content: basic properties and semiconductor photovoltaic effect of the solar photoelectric materials and semiconductor materials. Research on preparation principle, preparation technology and basic performance of solar cell materials. Study structure, composition and effect on it’s performance of solar cell materials. Based on crystal silicon solar cell, amorphous silicon films solar cell and compounds solar cell, learn characters of related technology, discuss new concept, new technology and front current situation of technology of related materials, objective to make foundation for further curriculums and engaging in photovoltaics.

default.zh: 胶体化学是化学、化学工程和化学相关领域的本科生必修的必修课程之一，它还为后续课程提供了基础知识。在本课程中，学生学习表面现象和分散系统的物理化学的主要原理，纳米体系行为的主要特点，并可以建立将所获得的知识应用于解决实际问题的能力。在本课程结束时，学生应： 1）掌握有关胶体行为的主要定律和原理以及表面现象热力学基本概念的知识。有能力运用以上知识解决实际问题。 2）熟悉纳米系统行为的特性以及这些系统在开发新材料时的作用。有能力根据理论知识分析和解决实际问题。 3）了解应用现代热力学和流体力学方法描述胶体体系的主要原理。 4）获得有关主要分散体系性质的知识。
default.en: Colloid chemistry is one of required core courses for undergraduates who major in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and chemistry related fields, and it also provides fundamental knowledge for subsequent courses. In this course, students learn the main principles of the physical chemistry of surface phenomena and disperse systems, the main peculiarities of the behavior of nanosystems and can build up the abilities to apply the obtained knowledge to solve practical problems. At the end of this course, students should: 1)Acquire knowledge of the main laws and principles of the behavior of colloids and of the basic concepts of the thermodynamics of surface phenomena. Have ability to apply the above knowledge to solve practical problems. 2)Be familiar with the peculiarities of the nanosystem behavior and the use of these systems at the development of new materials. Have the ability to analyze and solve the practical problems based on theoretical knowledge. 3)Know the main principles of the application of modern methods of thermodynamics and hydrodynamics to describe colloid systems. 4)Acquire knowledge on the properties of the main groups of disperse systems.

default.zh: 《能源系统智能管理》是新能源材料与器件专业的主干技术基础课程，是专业必修课。本课程主要介绍以化学能源为主的新型能源系统、锂离子电池系统的智能管理技术，以及展望智能管理对前沿新能源技术的推进作用。通过本课程学习，让学生熟悉全球范围内先进（化学）能源系统的技术原理与特点，了解人工智能在先进能源技术的应用进展，基本掌握动力电池、大数据中心的主要智能管理技术及实施方案，从而提高学生的科研视野与理论水平，具备一定从事前沿新能源技术、智能管理驱动的跨学科交叉能力。
default.en: "Energy Systems and Intelligent Management" is the main basic and compulsory course for students majoring in new energy materials and devices. This course mainly introduces the intelligent management technology of new energy and lithium-ion battery systems based on chemical energy. It also looks into the role of intelligent management in promoting advanced new energy technologies. Through the study of this course, students will be familiar with the technical principles and characteristics of advanced (chemical) energy systems around the world, understand the application progress of artificial intelligence in advanced energy technology, and basically master the main intelligent management technologies and implementation plans of power batteries and big data centers. Therefore, this course will improve the students' scientific research vision and theoretical level, enabling students the certain interdisciplinary abilities to engage in advanced new energy technologies and intelligent management-driven.

default.zh: 掌握复合纳米材料合成领域的科学背景和实践知识; 通过物理化学和物理方法研究其功能特性，并掌握运用这些知识创造具有特定性能的现代复合纳米材料的实践技能。在本课程结束时，学生应: 1)了解物质的低维状态、合成材料(包括纳米复合材料)的基本原理及其应用。 2)了解复合纳米材料的主要合成方法，获得复合纳米材料的主要化学和物理过程。 3)能够对文献和其他信息资源的数据进行独立分析，并在此基础上制定与专业功能实现相关的任务; 4) 能够分析复合纳米材料的组成和结构数据。 5)掌握分析复合纳米材料合成及物理化学研究的实验结果的技能。
default.en: Mastering the scientific backgrounds and practical knowledge in the field of composite nanomaterials synthesis; their research by physicochemical and physical methods and studying their functional properties, as well as mastering the practical skills of applying this knowledge to create modern composite nanomaterials with specified properties. At the end of this course, students should: 1) to acquire knowledge about the low-dimensional state of matter, the basic principles of composite materials creating, including nanostructured composite materials, and their application. 2) to know the main methods of nanocomposite materials synthesis, the main chemical and physical processes occurring while obtaining nanocomposite materials; 3) to analyze data from scientific literature, scientific and technical documentation, and other information resources, and on this basis formulate tasks related to the implementation of professional functions, 4) to be able to analyze data on the nanostructured solids synthesis, including composite nanomaterials; analyze data on the structure of these materials. 5) to master the skills of experimental results description for the synthesis and physical and chemical study of composites, including nanostructured materials.
