default.zh: 《电化学理论与方法》是新能源材料与器件专业的一门专业课。课程是在物理化学等课程的基础上，介绍电化学的基本概念、规律、理论及测试方法，阐述电化学器件中电化学热力学、电极过程动力学，包括“电极/溶液”界面的性质、电极过程、液相传质步骤动力学、电子转移步骤动力学、电催化的反应机理、稳态测量方法、暂态测量方法、伏安法、电化学阻抗谱等。为进一步选修化学电源、能源材料制备技术、化学电源工艺设计等课程奠定基础。
default.en: Electrochemical Fundamentals and Methods is a specialized course for the New Energy and Devices major. Based on courses such as Physical Chemistry, it introduces the basic concepts, laws, theories, and testing methods of electrochemistry, and explains the thermodynamics and kinetics of electrochemical processes in electrochemical devices, including the properties of the "electrode/solution" interface, electrode processes, liquid-phase mass transfer kinetics, electron transfer kinetics, reaction mechanisms of electrocatalysis, steady-state measurement methods, transient measurement methods, voltammetry, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy. This course lays a foundation for further studies in Chemical Power Sources, Energy Material Preparation Technology, and Chemical Power Source Process Design.

default.zh: 配位化学是无机化学的一门重要分支。但近年来，配位化学已经突破了无机化学的范畴，逐渐渗透到有机、生物、高分子等学科领域，形成了一些崭新的富有生命力的新兴学科，成为当代化学学科中最活跃的领域之一。《配位化学》是化学相关学科的重要选修课程，通过本课程的学习，使学生初步掌握配位化学的基本概念和基本理论，了解配合物反应的基本规律；对配位化合物的基本性质和用途有比较理性化的认识。另外，由于配位化学与分析、有机、物化等学科相互渗透，所以通过本课程的学习能够拓宽学生的知识面，有助于学生将原来分散学习的各学科知识关联起来理解运用，使学生对化学学科有更系统的了解，进而对其后继课程的学习及以后科研工作的进行有一定指导性作用。
default.en: Coordination chemistry is an important branch of inorganic chemistry. Recently, coordination chemistry has broken through the field of inorganic chemistry, and gradually penetrate into organic, biological, polymer and other fields, and then form a new field of research. Coordintion chemistry has been one of the most active areas of chemistry. The elective course of coordination chemistry is an important for chemistry-related disciplines. By studying this course, students can grasp the basic concepts and basic theories of coordination chemistry and understand the basic laws of complex reaction, and have a more rational understanding of the basic properties and uses of the complexes. In addition, the coordination chemistry is interdisciplinary field that covers analytical, organic, physical and other areas of chemistry. Thus, by leaning this course, the students' knowledge will be broadened, and students may summarize and understand the separate knowledge of the subject, and then students may have a more systematic understanding to chemistry subject, which will guide the students to excel in their follow-up courses and research work.

default.zh: 材料化学创新课程内容含有新型材料的概念、组成、结构与性能，以及材料的制备化学等，涉及材料及化学两个一级学科的各个二级学科。本课程系统介绍了纳米材料、智能材料、能源材料、高熵材料、超材料、仿生材料等一些新型材料的基本概念、阐述了各类新材料的合成、结构与性质的关系，以及材料设计、化学创制新材料的相关内容，并对当前各种最新材料的应用进行了简介。此课程的学习有利于培养学生去认识和理解新材料开发过程中的化学问题，使学生建立材料化学创新的概念，为基于化学手段进行新材料的研究与开发打下坚实的基础。通过本课程的课堂教学及讨论培养学生科学的思维方法和严谨的科学作风，正确掌握有关的科学思路及科学方法，提高分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: The Innovative Course in Materials Chemistry includes the concept, composition, structure, and properties of new materials, as well as the preparation chemistry of materials, involving various secondary disciplines of materials and chemistry. This course systematically introduces the basic concepts of new materials such as nanomaterials, intelligent materials, energy materials, high entropy materials, metamaterials, biomimetic materials, etc. It elaborates on the synthesis, structure, and properties of various new materials, as well as related content on material design and chemical creation of new materials. It also introduces the current applications of various latest materials. The study of this course is beneficial for cultivating students' understanding of chemical issues in the process of developing new materials, enabling them to establish the concept of material chemistry innovation, and laying a solid foundation for the research and development of new materials based on chemical methods. Through the classroom teaching and discussion of this course, we aim to cultivate students' scientific thinking methods and rigorous scientific style, correctly grasp relevant scientific ideas and methods, and improve their ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 本课程旨在为学生提供有关现代分析化学最重要领域之一电化学分析方法领域的知识。 在课堂上，将系统介绍和解释电化学分析方法的理论，介绍电化学分析的设备和设备的操作原理，以及现代电化学方法的主要发展趋势。在本课程结束时，学生应: 1)了解电化学分析方法的理论基础，了解电化学分析的最新成果和发展趋势; 2)了解电化学器件、电极、电化学传感器的设计和工作原理; 3)了解电化学分析方法的应用。
default.en: The purpose of the course is to provide students with knowledge in one of the most important areas of modern analytical chemistry - in the field of electrochemical methods of analysis. In the classes, a systematic presentation and explanation of the theory of electrochemical methods of analysis, an examination of the principles of operation of devices and equipment for conducting electrochemical analysis, and a presentation of the main trends in the development of modern electrochemical methods will be given. At the end of this course, students should: 1)know the theoretical foundations of electrochemical methods of analysis as well as the latest achievements and development trends of electroanalytical chemistry; 2)know the designs and principles of operation of electrochemical devices, electrodes and electrochemical sensors; 3)know the applications of electrochemical methods of analysis.

default.zh: 《应用表面化学与技术Ⅰ》是材料化学专业的专业必修课程，也可作为化学工程与工艺相关专业学生的选修课程。本课程主要介绍表面热力学基础、固体对气体的吸附、固体表面的润湿和洗涤的过程及影响因素和规律、乳状液的性质及其制备、泡沫性能及起泡与消泡原理、表面活性剂的分类和基本作用以及结构与性能关系等。通过本课程的学习，培养学生建立界面观点，为今后从事科学研究、开发和生产提供界面科学的基本知识和理论基础。
default.en: Applied Surface Chemistry and Technology Ⅰ is a compulsory course for students majoring in Materials Chemistry, as well as an elective course for students majoring in Chemical Engineering and Technology. This course mainly introduces the basis of surface thermodynamics, the adsorption of solid to gas, the wetting and washing process of solid surface and its influencing factors and laws, the properties and preparation of emulsion, foam properties and foaming and defoaming principles, the classification and basic functions of surfactants, and the relationship between structure and performance. Through the study of this course, students are trained to establish an interface perspective, providing basic knowledge and theoretical foundation of interface science for future scientific research, development, and production.

default.zh: 电化学是化学、化工及相关专业本科生必修的核心课程之一。在本课程中，学生将学习电化学反应的现象和基本规律，以及相关的物理过程。通过本课程的学习，使学生初步掌握双电层结构、电极吸附、电极过程动力学等基本理论概念。本门课程总成绩是积累的，包括期末考试、课堂表现和作业三个方面的成绩。在本课程结束时，学生应: 1.了解和掌握电极反应平衡和动力学的基本原理，双层结构及其对电化学过程速度的影响; 2.了解并能够应用研究电化学体系中电极过程的平衡和速率的方法。
default.en: Electrochemistry is one of required core courses for undergraduates who major in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and chemistry related fields. In the course, the students learn the phenomena and underlying laws of electrochemical reactions and relevant physical processes involved. Through this course, the students can build up the abilities of understand the basic theoretical concepts of the structure of a double electric layer, adsorption on electrodes, kinetics of electrode processes The final exam scores are cumulative including the final exam, ordinary performance and assignments. At the end of this course, students should: 1.Understand and acquire the fundamentals of about the equilibrium and kinetics of electrode reactions, the structure of the double layer and its effect on the speed of the electrochemical processes; 2.Understand and be able to apply methods for studying the equilibria and rates of electrode processes in electrochemical systems.

default.zh: 本课程旨在帮助学生提高写作和口语能力，掌握新词汇，增加英语语法知识。在课程中，学生应该学习新的语法规则，做语法练习，学习日常生活中的新单词，表达自己的观点，讨论一般问题。学生们还应该在科学研究领域扩大词汇量。在本课程中，学生将学习撰写关于他们的研究的简短摘要，并将练习口头科学报告和与同学讨论他们的研究主题。除了扩大学生的词汇量和语法知识外，课程的主要收获将是书面摘要和口头报告的脚本，学生将能够在他们未来的科学事业中使用，同时参加国际会议或向国际科学杂志提交文章。
default.en: The course is aimed to help the students develop their writing and speaking skills, master new vocabulary and increase their knowledge of English grammar. During the course the students are supposed to learn new grammar rules and do grammar exercises, to learn new words for everyday life situations, express their opinions and discuss general issues. The students are also supposed to expand their vocabulary in the sphere of their scientific research. In the course the students will learn to write short summaries about their research and will practice making oral scientific reports and discussing the topics of their research with their fellow students. Apart from expending students’ vocabulary and their knowledge of grammar, the key takeaways of the course will be a written abstract and a script of an oral report the students will be able to use in their further scientific career while participating in international conferences or submitting articles to international science magazines.

default.zh: 《材料化学基础》是一门多学科交叉的新兴科学，是材料化学专业的最重要专业课程之一。本课程主要讲述的内容为材料化学领域的基本概念、基础理论、材料制备化学和新材料，重点使学生从化学角度了解材料科学的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握材料化学组成、微观结构与性能间的相互关系和材料制备化学的原理与工艺；了解当前的新材料和新方法。 课程主要包括固体材料的结构和性能、材料化学热力学、金属材料化学、无机非金属材料化学、高分子材料化学、复合材料化学等。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时测评、论文报告和课堂讨论四部分。
default.en: Fundamental of Materials Chemistry, as an emerging multidisciplinary science, is one of the most important specialized courses of materials chemistry major. The main contents of this course are the basic concepts and theories of materials chemistry, preparative chemistry of materials and new materials. Through this course, students will learn the basics knowledge, research hotspots, developing trends and cutting-edge applications of material science from a chemical perspective. And they can also understand and master the chemical composition and the relationship between structure and properties of materials from molecular level to macroscopic scale. Meanwhile, the course gives students a chance to learn about the new materials and new methods. The curriculum contents mainly include the structure and properties of solid materials, chemical thermodynamics of materials, metal material chemistry, inorganic material chemistry, polymer material chemistry, composite material chemistry. The examination results are using accumulation method, including four parts: the final written test, the usual assessment, the paper report and the class discussion.

default.zh: 《无机合成基础》课程的目的是学习各类无机化合物合成的基本原理，并在此基础上获得具有所需性质的化合物和材料的实践技能。无机合成的基础与化学学科的理论和实验技术的发展密切相关。通过本课程的学习可以帮助大四学生扩展无机化学领域的知识，有助于他们将早期学过的《物理化学》、《有机化学》、《分析化学》应用到无机合成领域当中，包括实验条件的选取、提纯方法等等。本课程的目标是: (1) 计算和证明给定无机物合成的热力学可行性; (2) 研究物质和材料合成反应的动力学和结构原理; (3) 现代纯化和鉴定方法的发展; (4) 利用化学元素的周期性作为无机合成物质和材料的方法基础。
default.en: The purpose of the discipline "Fundamentals of Inorganic Synthesis" is to learn the basic principles of the synthesis of inorganic compounds of various classes and to acquire practical skills in obtaining chemical compounds and materials based on them with desired properties. The objectives of this section of the course are: 1) calculation and justification of the thermodynamic capabilities of the synthesis of inorganic substances of certain classes; 2) the study of the kinetic and structural principles of the reactions of synthesis of substances and materials; 3) the development of modern methods of purification and identification of selected compounds; 4) the use of the periodic law and the periodic system of chemical elements as the methodological basis of inorganic synthesis of substances and materials. The “Fundamentals of Inorganic Synthesis” discipline is closely related in structure to the theoretical foundations and the experimental part of chemical science, expands the knowledge of fourth-year students in the field of “Inorganic Chemistry”, allows them to apply the knowledge gained earlier in the courses “Physical Chemistry”, “Organic Chemistry”, “ Analytical chemistry ”, to predict the possibility of the desired synthesis, the choice of conditions for its implementation, methods of purification of the obtained substance, chemical and physical methods of its research.

default.zh: 精细有机合成原理是为应用化学专业的学生开设的一门专业基础课, 通过本课程的学习,使学生进一步了解有机合成反应的基本原理和基本操作,了解一些精细化学品的合成方法和合成工艺,掌握复杂有机化合物的合成路线设计技巧,为学生将来从事精细化学品的生产和新产品的开发奠定必要的理论基础和技术基础。本课程在有机化学的基础上较完整地介绍精细化学品合成过程中所涉及的重要单元反应和精细化学品的合成设计技巧。以有机合成反应为中心，介绍各类单元反应的基本原理和应用范围；联系反应物的结构特点，探讨影响反应的主要因素；结合精细化学品合成实例，讲述合成原理、工艺过程、技术操作和产品用途等内容。
default.en: The principle of fine organic synthesis is a professional basic course for applied chemistry students. Through this course, students will learn more about the basic principles and operations of organic synthesis reaction, understand some synthetic methods and technologies of fine chemicals, master the synthesis design techniques of complex organic compound. This course provides a complete introduction to the important unit reactions involved in the synthesis of fine chemicals and the synthetic design techniques for fine chemicals on the basis of organic chemistry. Taking organic synthesis as center, the basic principle and application range of various kinds of unit reactions are introduced. Considering reactant structure as reference, the main factors influencing the reaction are discussed. Combining with the synthesis examples of fine chemicals, the synthesis principle, synthesis process, technical operation and product use are described.

default.zh: 《材料分析测试技术》这门课程系统地介绍了XRD、SEM、TEM、XPS、AFM等20余种仪器分析方法的原理、仪器装置的结构及仪器使用方法、各类仪器分析方法在测定物质化学组成、状态、含量和结构中的应用。通过本课程的学习，学生可以系统地掌握各类常用仪器分析方法的基本原理和仪器的简单结构，了解仪器分析的发展动向，同时具备根据分析目的和要求，结合学到的各种仪器分析方法的特点、方法的应用范围，在科研中选择适宜的分析方法的能力。
default.en: The course of materials analysis and testing technology systematically introduces more than 20 kinds of applications of instruments, such as XRD, SEM, TEM, XPS, AFM, etc. It shows the principles of analysis methods, apparatus, device structures, the use of instruments, and all kinds of instrumental analysis methods in the determination of physical chemistry composition, status, content and structure of applications. Through the introduction of this course, students can master basic principles; instrumental analysis methods and structure of the various types of instrumentation system, commonly understand the development trend of instrumental analysis, while with the purpose of the analysis and requirements, combined with analytical methods in a variety of instruments. Finally, students obtain the ability of characteristics, methods, scope of application in scientific research by selecting appropriate analytical methods.

default.zh: 本课程是化学、化学工程、材料科学及相关专业本科生的选修课。它从(1)关于直接观测的置信度和(2)关于观测集之间的关系的推测这两个观点出发，获得了一个系统的范式和算法机制来分析实验数据。通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握运用数理统计与概率论来处理问题，掌握统计评估的计算(包括点和时间间隔)，训练假设测试模型，通过线性回归的方法进行经验表示，掌握色散和相关分析的概念。根据本课程的要求，学生应准备好习惯地使用统计学方法来分析他们在实践中以及从文献中获得的数据的有效性。该课程旨在为学生提供常规和技能，以增强他们在专业兴趣领域的创造力。总成绩将包括期末考试、平时表现和作业。在本课程结束时，学生应: (1)理解和掌握概率论、数理统计、实验简化的基本概念和方法；掌握几种分析统计分布、分布参数估计量的符号；牢固掌握假设检验算法和回归技术。它们应该能够实现对一维倒易关系的任意经验映射的完全回归分析的单独分配; (2)训练学生了解用于计算有价值的评估器的方法与概率演算的逻辑结构之间的联系。在科学叙述中插入还原过程，在充分理由原则的基础上，发展经验观察分析中的归纳法和演绎法。
default.en: Mathematical Reduction of Experiment is enrolled in optional courses for undergraduates whose profile concerns Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Material Science and related fields. It procures a systematic paradigm and algorithmic machinery for analysis of experimental data from the standpoint 1) of confidence regarding direct observations and 2) conjectures with respect to reciprocities between sets of observables. In this course, students handle a basic formal apparatus of applied mathematical statistics in connection with fundaments of the calculus in probabilities, master calculations of statistical estimators (both point and interval), get trained in hypotheses testing, representation of empirical dependences via linear regression methods, acquire concepts of the dispersion and correlation analysis. On the grounds of this course, the students are presumed to get ready for habitually applying statistical methods to the end of analyzing validity of experimental data they would come across in their practice and get from literature sources. The course is meant to provide students with routines and skills bolstering their creativity in the fields of professional interest. The final exam will embrace the exam per se, ordinary performance and assignments. At the end of this course, students should: 1)Handle, understand and acquire basic concepts and methodologies of probability calculus, mathematical statistics and reduction of experiment. Master the several analytical statistical distributions, notions of estimators of distribution parameters; firmly acquire algorithms of hypotheses testing and regression techniques. They should be in a position to implement an individual assignment of a full regression analysis of an arbitrary empirical mapping of a one-dimensional reciprocity. 2)Train understanding a linkage between methodologies employed in calculating of valuable estimators and logical structure of probability calculus. To plug in reduction procedures in the scientific narration, basing upon the Principle of sufficient reason, develop techniques of induction and deduction in analysis of empirical observations.

default.zh: 本课程旨在介绍化合物组成的基本原理，树立“结构化学”的观点，掌握结构化学的基础理论和基本知识，了解结构化学研究和解决问题的思路，并为以后的学习和科研工作打下必要的结构基础。 要求学生通过本课程的学习，了解微观粒子的运动特征，掌握量子力学基本假设的应用和量子力学处理问题的基本方法、一般步骤，原子的结构，核外电子的运动状态，分子的对称性和分子轨道理论的相关知识。
default.en: This course is an introduction into the principles of the compound formation. After taking this course, the students will establish the view point of structural chemistry, understand the basic principles of structural chemistry, know about the methods of solving problems with structure chemistry, and prepare a foundation for study and research in future. The students have to know about the properties of a micro-particle, the basic method and steps of problem solving with quantum mechanics, the structure of an atom, the state of the electrons, symmetrical properties of a molecule, and principles of molecular orbitals.

default.zh: 应用化学综合实验是为应用化学专业本科生开设的必修实验课程。是配合应用化学专业所开设的“精细有机合成原理”、“材料化学”、“表面化学”、“材料分析测试技术”等理论课程而开设的一门实验课。本课程单独设课，分为专业基础和专业特色两部分。专业基础实验主要分为基本操作和基本测试；专业特色实验主要分为功能材料的制备和性能检测，以及精细化学品的设计合成与结构表征等综合型和设计型实验，在每部分中均提供了选作内容。通过本课程的学习，可以使学生在基础化学实验基础上，进一步提高和增强化学实验操作技能和解决实际问题的能力，并掌握较多的精细化学品和功能材料的合成/制备原理、方法、工艺和过程、性能及应用情况，强化实验操作和动手能力。本课程主要包括添加剂、涂料、胶黏剂、催化剂等各类精细化学品；香波、洗洁精、护发素、雪花膏等日用化学品的配方设计和配制；纳米粉、纳米陶瓷、功能薄膜、微纳米纤维等功能新材料的制备和表征等19个实验，学生选作其中部分实验（合计96学时）。
default.en: Integrated Experiment for Applied Chemistry is a compulsory course for the undergraduates of Applied Chemistry Specialty. It is a kind of experimental course which is based on the theory courses of "fine organic synthesis principle", "material chemistry", "surface chemistry" and "material analysis and testing technology". This course is divided into two parts：professional basis and professional characteristics. Professional basic experiments are mainly included basic operations and testing. Professional characteristics experiments are consisted of functional materials preparation and performance testing, as well as fine chemical design and structural characterization. There are selectable experiment contents for students in each part. Through this course, students can further improve the ability of chemical experiment operations and solving practical problems, master the synthesis/preparation principles，methods，processing, performance and application of more fine chemicals and functional materials. The main contents of this course includes: the synthesis of additives, coatings, adhesives, catalysts; the formulation design and preparation of shampoo, detergents, hair-conditioner, and creams; the preparation and characterization of nano-powder, nano-ceramic, functional film, micro-nano fiber and other functional materials; the properties detection of the above fine chemicals. Every student can choose 96 hrs from the 19 experiments in the list of the contents.

default.zh: 含能材料课程是应用化学及相关专业方向的专业课。一直以来，含能材料在国防和工业生产中扮演着非常重要的角色。本课程主要任务是介绍含能炸药、纳米材料及其复合材料的合成、表征、燃烧性能，同时介绍含能材料的发展趋势及其应用情况。通过本课程的课堂教学，着重培养学生们的综合分析与设计能力以及合成化学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑应用化学专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成，为大学本科生了解含能材料的合成提供一些必要的基础知识，为将来更加深入的学习材料化学专业知识奠定基础。主要包括含能材料导论、含能材料应用要求、火炸药合成中的化学基础、绿色硝化技术、纳米材料制备方法、各种复合含能材料及其在推进剂中的应用。通过本课程的学习，要求学生系统地掌握含能材料的制备、加工工艺、工程化技术、结构分析技术、关键性能和质量控制等，具备一定从事含能材料方面科研、工程实践能力。
default.en: The course of energetic materials is a specialized course in applied chemistry and related fields. Energetic materials have always played a very important role in national defense and industrial production. The main task of this course is to introduce the synthesis, characterization, and combustion performance of energetic explosives, nanomaterials, and their composites, as well as the development trends and applications of energetic materials. In this course, the focus is on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design abilities as well as the application ability of synthetic chemistry knowledge, increasing their innovation awareness, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in the learning outcomes of applied chemistry. This course provides necessary basic knowledge for undergraduate students to understand the synthesis of energetic materials, and lays a foundation for further in-depth learning of materials chemistry in the future. The course mainly includes an introduction to energetic materials, application requirements for energetic materials, chemical foundations in the synthesis of explosives, green nitration technology, preparation methods for nanomaterials, various composite energetic materials and their applications in propellants. Students are required to systematically master the preparation, processing technology, engineering technology, structural analysis technology, key performance, and quality control of energetic materials, and possess certain scientific research and engineering practical abilities in the field of energetic materials.

default.zh: 本课程讲授计算化学基本原理，基本方法，常用的计算化学软件，将理论方法和具体应用相结合，让学生了解在物质微观电子结构分析、物理和化学性质表征、化学反应机理、新型功能材料和药物分子设计等研究领域的应用案例。结合当前的热点课题，让学生理解并掌握计算化学在化工、化学、能源、材料，生物工程等领域的前沿应用，拓展科学研究的视野。该课程旨在培养学生的计算模拟思维，使学生能够结合自己的兴趣，有针对性的开展交叉科学方面的研究工作。
default.en: In this course, the basic principles and methods of computational chemistry and commonly used computational chemistry software are included. Combining theoretical methods with practical applications, it allows students to understand application cases in research fields such as material microstructure analysis, physical and chemical property characterization, chemical reaction mechanisms, new functional materials, and drug molecule design etc. Taking the current hot research topics as examples, it enables students to understand and master the cutting-edge applications of computational chemistry in fields such as chemical engineering, chemistry, energy, materials, and biotechnology, and expand their scientific research perspectives. This course aims to cultivate students' computational thinking, and enable them to combine their interests to carry out targeted research in interdisciplinary fields.

default.zh: 通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握量子力学的基本原理及其实验验证。了解原子的电子结构，对于量子化学计算方法有整体的理解，包括从头算、密度泛函理论、以及在复杂环境中模拟分子体系的计算方法。学生将掌握热化学和光化学反应建模的基本原理。通过本课程所出示的例子，学生将学习如何理解包含量子化学计算结果的研究论文，同时学习如何使用量子化学程序包进行简单的计算。主修这门课程也将为进一步学习高等计算化学的知识奠定基础。 (1)学生将学习量子化学的基本原理及其在热化学和光化学反应研究中的应用。 (2)学生将有能力从量子化学的角度分析实验结果，能理解量子化学计算领域方面的科研论文。
default.en: In this course, the students will learn the basic principles of quantum mechanics and their experimental justification, students will learn about the electronic structure of atoms, get an overview of methods in computational quantum chemistry, including ab initio, DFT, and methods for modeling molecular systems in a complex environment. Students will learn the fundamental principles used for modeling thermal and photochemical reactions. Using the examples considered in the course, students will study how to understand research articles that contain results of quantum-chemical calculations. Students will learn how to perform simple calculations using quantum-chemical program packages. Students will obtain knowledge for further studying advanced computational chemistry if they wish to major in this discipline. Learning outcomes: 1)Students will learn about the basic principles of quantum chemistry and its applications for studying thermal and photochemical reactions. 2)Students will have the ability to analyze experimental results from the quantum-chemical point of view, analyze the literature that contains the results of quantum-chemical calculations.

default.zh: 生物化学是生命科学各专业的一门重要的专业基础课。生物化学是用化学的理论和方法研究生物体的化学组成以及在生命活动中所发生的化学变化及其调控规律，从而阐明生命现象本质的一门学科。通过生物化学的学习，使学生系统地掌握现代生物化学的基本理论、基本知识，掌握生物化学的基本技术，培养学生从分子水平认识生命现象的能力，训练学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，了解近期生物化学的新进展，启发学生的创新精神，为学生进一步学习生物学的有关后续课程准备必要的生物化学知识，并为以后从事与生命科学有关的教学、科研与生产奠定基础。
default.en: Biochemistry is an important course for all major of life sciences. Biochemistry is a discipline that uses chemical theories and methods to study the chemical composition of organisms, the chemical changes that occur in their life activities, and their regulations. Through the study of biochemistry, students should systematically master the basic theory and basic knowledge of modern biochemistry, master the basic techniques of biochemistry, develop students' abilities to recognize life phenomena at the molecular level, train their ability to analyze and solve problems, and understand recent advances in biochemistry, prepare necessary biochemical knowledge for students' further follow-up courses in biology, and lay the foundation for future teaching, research and production related to life sciences.

default.zh: 配位化学是无机化学的一门重要分支。但近年来，配位化学已经突破了无机化学的范畴，逐渐渗透到有机、生物、高分子等学科领域，形成了一些崭新的富有生命力的新兴学科，成为当代化学学科中最活跃的领域之一。《配位化学》是化学相关学科的重要选修课程，通过本课程的学习，使学生初步掌握配位化学的基本概念和基本理论，了解配合物反应的基本规律；对配位化合物的基本性质和用途有比较理性化的认识。另外，由于配位化学与分析、有机、物化等学科相互渗透，所以通过本课程的学习能够拓宽学生的知识面，有助于学生将原来分散学习的各学科知识关联起来理解运用，使学生对化学学科有更系统的了解，进而对其后继课程的学习及以后科研工作的进行有一定指导性作用。
default.en: Coordination chemistry is an important branch of inorganic chemistry. Recently, coordination chemistry has broken through the field of inorganic chemistry, and gradually penetrate into organic, biological, polymer and other fields, and then form a new field of research. Coordintion chemistry has been one of the most active areas of chemistry. The elective course of coordination chemistry is an important for chemistry-related disciplines. By studying this course, students can grasp the basic concepts and basic theories of coordination chemistry and understand the basic laws of complex reaction, and have a more rational understanding of the basic properties and uses of the complexes. In addition, the coordination chemistry is interdisciplinary field that covers analytical, organic, physical and other areas of chemistry. Thus, by leaning this course, the students' knowledge will be broadened, and students may summarize and understand the separate knowledge of the subject, and then students may have a more systematic understanding to chemistry subject, which will guide the students to excel in their follow-up courses and research work.

default.zh: 课程目标: 1. 了解俄语系统，以便在专业领域进行成功的口头和书面交流 2. 获得学风的大致概念 本课程的目的是向学生介绍应用于化学专业的科学风格的基础知识。在这门课程中，学生将学习文本的类型(描述、叙述、推理和证明)，计划的类型(论文、引文、问题、提纲)，阅读和分析科学出版物中的特殊文本。研究一般科学语体、词汇、术语的语法结构。书面演讲是通过自己写各种体裁的文章(论文、摘要、评论、散文等)来练习的。将给出科学论文的设计示例(结构，部分，参考文献列表，来源，引文等)，将考虑准备和展示演示文稿的原则。 对于作业会积极运用翻译，独立完成各种作业，在老师的课堂指导下进行作业。计划与专业教师共同组织培训。作为最后一项任务，建议准备一个学生感兴趣的话题的演讲，但在俄罗斯专业的框架内。 课堂材料是专门编写的教材，改编自本专业课本和手册的文本，视频课程。
default.en: Course Objectives: 1. to know the Russian Language System for successful oral and written communication in professional area 2. to acquire general conception of academic style The purpose of this course is to introduce students to the basics of scientific style as applied to the specialty of chemistry. In this course students will study the typology of texts (description, narrative, reasoning and proof), types of plans (thesis, quotation, question, nominative), read and analyze special texts from scientific publications. The study of grammatical constructions of general scientific style, vocabulary, terminology is assumed. Written speech is practiced by writing own texts of various genres (theses, abstracts, reviews, essays, etc.). Examples of the design of a scientific paper will be given (structure, parts, list of references, sources, citations, etc.), the principles of preparing and presenting presentations will be considered. For work will be actively used translation, a variety of independent assignments, work in the classroom under the guidance of the teacher. Training is planned to be organized jointly with specialist teachers. As a final task it is proposed to prepare a presentation on a topic of interest to the student, but within the framework of the specialty in Russian. The materials for classes are specially prepared teaching materials, adapted texts from textbooks and manuals on the specialty, video lessons.

default.zh: 《基因的奥秘》是研究核酸等生物大分子的功能、形态结构特征及其重要性和规律性的科学，内容涵盖基因的分子生物学的核心问题，包括DNA复制、转录、翻译、调控等。 课程目标为： 1）掌握生命活动中基因的结构与功能、遗传信息的表达及其调控等内容；掌握分子生物学基本理论、技术和方法； 2）掌握基因的分子生物学发展趋势，培养分子生物学理论和技术的专业人才，并为研究生学习和科研培养一定的研究和思维能力。 课程教学方法为： 1）以问题为导向，采用启发式教学，激发学生的学习兴趣。 2）结合多媒体教学、黑板书、雨课堂、教具等多种教学模式，增加课堂教学中的信息量和活跃度。 3）理论教学与案例教学相结合，将分子生物学技术相关知识融合到各章知识点，引导学生设计翻转课题，启发学生“像科学家”一样思考，培养学生独立思考、分析和解决问题的能力。
default.en: "The Mystery of Genes" is a science that studies the function, morphological and structural characteristics, importance and regularity of biological macromolecules such as nucleic acids, covering the core issues of molecular biology of genes, including DNA replication, transcription, translation, regulation, etc. The course objectives are: 1) To master the structure and function of genes, the expression and regulation of genetic information in life activities; Master the basic theories, techniques and methods of molecular biology; 2) Master the development trend of gene molecular biology, train professionals in molecular biology theory and technology, and train certain research and thinking ability for postgraduate study and scientific research. The course teaching method is: 1) Problem-oriented, heuristic teaching is adopted to stimulate students' interest in learning. 2) Combine multimedia teaching, blackboard book, rain class, teaching AIDS and other teaching modes to increase the information and activity in classroom teaching. 3) Combine theoretical teaching with case teaching, integrate molecular biology technology related knowledge into each chapter of knowledge, guide students to design flipped topics, inspire students to think like scientists, and cultivate students' ability to think independently, analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 《固态化学》是是研究固体物质（包括材料）的制备、组成、结构和性质的科学。虽然早在20世纪20年代就已经开始研究有固态物质参加的化学反应，但是由于缺少探测固相内部微观结构的实验手段，所以发展缓慢。到了60年代，一些新的科学技术兴起，要求越来越多的具有特殊性质的固体材料，对固体材料的制备、结构和性质等方面提出许多需要探索和急待解决的问题；现代科学技术提供了各种实验手段（如各种光谱、波谱、能谱和质谱等），从而能够深入认识固体的体相和表面的组成和结构，测试各种物理和化学性质，固体化学才进入蓬勃发展的新阶段。固体化学和固体物理、材料工程学等学科互相交叉渗透、互相补充配合，形成了现代固体科学和技术。固体化学着重研究实际固体物质的化学反应、合成方法、晶体生长、化学组成和结构，特别是固体中的缺陷及其对物质的物理及化学性质的影响，探索固体物质作为材料实际应用的可能性。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握分子对称性、群论、晶体结构、固体物质的化学反应、合成（生长）方法、化学组成的表征方法等；了解固体中缺陷及其对物质的物理和化学性质的影响；强调培养学生独立分析问题、解决问题的能力和创新精神；为学生从事固体材料的研究、生产、设计和开发打下必要的固体化学基础。
default.en: "Solid chemistry" is a science that studies the preparation, composition, structure and properties of solid matter (including materials). Although as early as the 1920s, people has begun to study the solid matters to participate in the chemical reactions, due to the lack of detection of internal solid microstructure of the experimental means, the development of slowness. In the 1960s, the rise of some new science and technology, the demand for more and more special materials with special properties, the preparation of solid materials, structure and nature of the need to explore and need to solve many problems; modern science and technology (Such as various spectra, spectra, spectra, mass spectra, etc.), which can be a solid understanding of the solid body and surface composition and structure, testing a variety of physical and chemical properties, solid chemistry into the vigorous development New stage. Solid chemistry and solid physics, materials engineering and other disciplines cross each other, complement each other, forming a modern solid science and technology. Solid chemistry focuses on the chemical reactions of solid materials, synthetic methods, crystal growth, chemical composition and structure, in particular the defects in solids and their physical and chemical properties of the material, to explore the practical application of solid materials as a possibility. Through the study of this course, students should master the molecular symmetry, group theory, crystal structure, solid chemical reaction, synthesis (growth) methods, chemical composition of the characterization method; understanding of defects in the solid and its physical and chemical substances. Training students to independently analyze problems, solve problems and innovative spirit; for students engaged in solid materials research, production, design and development to lay the necessary solid chemical basis.

default.zh: 结构化学是高等院校化学专业的一门主干基础课程。它主要在原子、分子水平上讨论物质的性质与电子结构和空间结构间的关系，是物理化学的重要分支。随着学科间的相互交叉，结构化学为许多前沿的理论问题以及实验技术提供了理论基础。它依据结构决定性能、性能反映结构的基本原则，研究物质的结构与性能间的关系，使学生掌握微观物质运动的基本规律，获得原子和分子结构、性质的基本理论和基础知识，加深对无机化学、有机化学等前修课程的理解，为后续课程的学习以及从事科学研究打下坚实的基础。 课程内容主要包括绪论，量子力学基础知识，原子和分子的结构及性质，涉及微观粒子所遵循的量子力学规律，原子中电子的分布和能级、分子的化学组成、分子的空间构型和构象、分子中电子的分布、化学键的性质和分子的能量状态等。课程考试成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末笔试，出席、平时表现和作业完成情况。
default.en: Structural chemistry, as one important branching of physical chemistry, is a major course for chemistry studies in university. It probes the electron and space structures at the atomistic and molecular levels and relates them with physical properties. With the development of interdiscipline, structure chemistry provides fundamentals for the latest issues and techniques in theories and experiments. It investigates the relationship between the structures and properties of substances based on the fact that structures determine properties and in turn the properties reveal structures. In this course, knowledge of quantum mechanics and structures and characteristics of atoms and molecules are introduced, concerning quantum rules for microscopic particles, distributions and energy levels of electrons in an atom, components, space structure and configuration, electron distributions, bonding, and energy states of molecules. After finishing the course students should know the intrinsic rules of motions at a microscopic state, learn the knowledge and basic principles about the structures and features of atoms and molecules, better understand the contents of inorganic and organic chemistry they previous studied, and have a knowledge foundation for the latter specialty lessons and scientific research.

default.zh: 纳米材料科学在20世纪80年代末期兴起，近年来引起广泛关注的一个新的科学领域。纳米材料是新材料的一个重要组成部分，包含丰富的科学内涵。《纳米材料导论》课程是第二学位辅修化学专业课程。该课程通过系统介绍纳米材料的基本知识和纳米材料的最新研究进展，使学生了解和掌握纳米材料的特殊性能、结构特点、分类，制备方法及在高新技术领域的应用及其发展趋势，以拓宽学生的知识面，培养学生在前沿学科的创新能力，为学生今后从事新材料的研究和开发奠定基础。
default.en: This course covers the subject of nanomaterials and provides students with the basic concepts and advanced knowledge of nanomaterials, including the synthesis, characterization, applications, the scale-dependent properties of materials, and their link to functionality and applications. They will explore strategies for nanomaterials synthesis with a view on their advantages and limitations. They will be provided with an overview of the potential socio-economic and environmental impacts of nanomaterials as a disruptive technology.

default.zh: 理论化学技术是建立在化学、物理和工业经济学的基础上的。掌握化学技术的理论原理和模式，可以帮助人们管理复杂的化学和工艺过程，确定最佳的流程，提高产品质量，加强生产。通过本课的学习，学生将熟悉化学技术系统、化学技术过程、流体力学基本装置、传热传质过程和化学反应等概念。课程中将介绍化学技术原理应用于基本工业产品，如苏打、氨、硫酸、矿物肥料、燃料和油以及有机产品的生产问题。总成绩包括期末考试成绩、平时成绩和作业成绩。在本课程结束时，学生应: (1)了解和掌握工艺流程发展的基本概念和规律，化工行业发展的当前趋势，原材料和能源的综合利用，无废物工业，环境保护等。具备运用上述知识解决实际问题的能力，例如对实施化学过程的方法进行有意义的选择、对实施过程可能产生的经济和环境结果进行评估、将技术成本和风险降到最低等。 (2)培养基于现象的归纳法和演绎法的科学思维，从假设和建立模型中学习如何提出理论。具备运用理论知识分析解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Theoretical chemical technology is based on the laws of chemistry, physics and industrial economics. Knowledge of the theoretical principles and patterns of chemical technology allows you to manage complex chemical and technological processes, determine the optimal conditions for their flow, improve the quality of products and intensify production. In this course, the students will become familiar with such concepts as chemical-technological systems, processes of chemical technology, basic apparatuses for hydromechanical, heat- and mass- transfer processes and chemical reactions. The issues of applying the laws of chemical technology to the production of basic industrial products, such as soda, ammonia, sulfuric acid, mineral fertilizers, fuels and oils, and organic products will be considered. The final exam scores are cumulative including the final exam, ordinary performance and assignments. At the end of this course, students should: 1)Understand and acquire the basic concepts and laws/principles of technological processes development, current trends in the development of chemical industries, integrated use of raw materials and energy, creation of waste-free industries, and environmental protection. Have ability to apply the above knowledge to solve practical problems such as a meaningful choice of a method for implementing a chemical process, an assessment of the possible economic and environmental results of its implementation, minimization of technological costs and risks etc. 2)Train the scientific thinking of induction and deduction based on phenomena, and learn how to propose a theory from hypothesis and model built. Have the ability to analyze and solve the practical problems based on theoretical knowledge.

default.zh: 对称性是分子和晶体的重要属性之一，对于理解化学物质的“结构和性质”的构效关系具有重要意义。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握群的定义和基本概念，熟练判断分子和晶体所属点群，理解群的矩阵表示和特征标表的含义，并掌握群论在量子力学、分子轨道理论、红外和拉曼振动光谱、紫外可见吸收光谱、偶极矩和旋光性、非线性光学、铁电压电材料等领域的应用。该课程涵盖数学、物理、理论和计算化学、光谱化学、光化学、晶体材料化学等众多学科，培养学生的交叉科学思维，建立利用“群论”的思想来分析和解决化学中的实际问题的能力。
default.en: Symmetry is one of the important properties of molecules and crystals, which is of great significance for understanding the structure-activity relationship of "structure and properties" of chemical substances. Through the study of this course, the students can master the definition and basic concepts of group, skillfully judge the point group of molecules and crystals, understand the matrix representation of group and the meaning of characteristic table, and master the application of group theory in the fields of quantum mechanics, molecular orbital theory, infrared and Raman vibration spectra, ultraviolet visible absorption spectra, dipole moment and optical rotation, nonlinear optics, ferroelectric materials, etc. This course covers many subjects such as mathematics, physics, theoretical and computational chemistry, spectral chemistry, photochemistry, crystal material chemistry and so on, and it aims to cultivate students' cross scientific thinking and establish the ability to analyze and solve practical problems in chemistry by using "group theory".

default.zh: 《电化学原理A》是化学工程与工艺（电化学）专业的专业核心课程。它是在无机化学与物理化学中有关电化学热力学理论的基础上，从电化学动力学观点出发，深刻地揭示了电化学反应的内在本质和基本规律，全面阐述了电化学反应速率与电极电位之间的关系，是从事电化学工程方面研究和生产的技术人员不可缺少的专业理论知识。 通过本门课程的学习应能使学生认识电极／溶液界面结构与性质，掌握电化学反应中各个基元步骤控制反应速率的若干种典型电化学过程的基本规律，以及一些典型电极过程的研究方法及基本动力学性质。同时使学生了解现代电化学科学研究的基本思想方法，为后续的电化学专业课程学习和从事电化学研究与生产实践打下坚实的理论基础。通过将德育元素融入课程教学内容的隐性教育案例，培养大学生责任心和使命感，增强学生专业自信。通过将学术研究、科技发展前沿成果引入课程，提升学生对电化学最新理论的理解和应用能力。
default.en: 《Theory of Electrochemistry A》is a core course for chemical engineering and technology (electrochemical engineering) specialty. Based on the theory of electrochemical thermodynamics in inorganic chemistry and physical chemistry and from the point of view of electrochemical kinetics, it profoundly reveals the intrinsic nature and basic principles of electrochemical reaction, and comprehensively expounds the relationship between electrochemical reaction rate and electrode potential. It provides indispensable professional theoretical knowledge for technical personnel engaged in electrochemical engineering research and production. Through the study of this course, the students will be able to understand the electrode/solution interface structure and properties, master the basic laws of several typical electrochemical processes in which each elementary step controls the reaction rate in electrochemical reactions, as well as the research methods and basic kinetics properties of some typical electrode processes. At the same time, it enables students to understand the basic ideas and methods of modern electrochemical scientific research, and lays a solid theoretical foundation for the subsequent study of electrochemical professional courses and electrochemical research and production practice. By integrating moral education elements into the curriculum teaching content of the recessive education case, it will be useful to cultivate college students' sense of responsibility and enhance students' confidence in electrochemistry major. By introducing the cutting-edge achievements of academic research and scientific & technological development into the curriculum, it will improve the understanding of the latest theories on electrochemistry and its application capability for the students.

default.zh: 本课程的目的是使学生熟悉热分析的主要方法。由于课程时间短，只包含了热分析(TA)的主要方法，大多没有详细的技术细节：它提供了机会，为不同培训水平的学生呈现TA的本质，包括热重法(TG)，差示扫描量热法(DSC)，同步热分析(STA)，膨胀法(DL)和热机械分析(TMA)，动态蒸汽吸附(DVS)，可视热分析(VTA)。同时结合质谱(MS)和红外光谱(FTIR)来研究气体的演化。本课程也着重于训练学生解释不同的物理化学过程和现代材料的热行为的热图。总成绩包括期末考试成绩、平时成绩和作业成绩。在本课程结束时，学生应： (1) 了解和掌握热分析的主要方法，能运用以上知识通过热分析方法解决实际问题，解释热图，确定不同工艺的热化学特性和化合物及材料的热力学性质； (2) TA是分析化学的一个广阔领域，在自然科学的各个分支都有应用。它处理的是大范围温度下的真实过程，是现代科学研究的一种重要而必要的方法。因此，学生将通过学习TA方法获得提出解决不同基础和应用问题的能力。
default.en: The aim of the course is to acquaint students with main methods of thermal analysis (TA). Due to short duration the course includes only the main methods of TA, mostly without detailed technical analysis: it gives the opportunities to present the essentials of TA for students of various training levels. The following methods of TA will be considered: thermogravimetry (TG), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), simultaneous thermal analysis (STA), dilatometry(DL) and thermomechanical analysis (TMA), dynamic vapor sorption (DVS), visual thermal analysis (VTA). Using of some supported methods will be also considered: mass spectrometry (MS) and IR spectroscopy (FTIR) for the investigation of gas evolution. The course also focus on training the students on interpretation of thermograms for different physical-chemical processes and the thermal behavior of modern materials. The final test scores are cumulative including the final test, ordinary performance and assignments. At the end of this course, students should: 1) Understand and acquire the main methods of thermal analysis. Have ability to apply the above knowledge to solve practical problems by methods of thermal analysis and to interpret thermograms, to determine thermochemical characteristics of different processes and thermodynamic properties of compounds and materials. 2) TA is a vast field of analytical chemistry and has applications in all branches of natural science. TA deals with real processes in wide range of temperature and is an important and necessary methods of modern scientific researches. Accordingly, students will obtain the ability to propose a solving of different basic and applied problems using methods of TA.

default.zh: 电化学测量是化学工程与工艺专业本科生重要的专业基础课程之一。本课程系统讲授电化学测量的理论和实验技术，重点介绍实验对象、仪器手段和测量方法，培养学生准确选用测量方法，合理设计实验方案，正确开展实验研究的能力和素质。主要内容包括：进行电化学测量的指导原则；电化学体系的数学描述；电势、电流的测量和控制；电解池体系的选择和设计；测量仪器和测量技术；稳态方法的基本原理；电流阶跃法、电势阶跃法、线性电势扫描伏安法和交流阻抗法等暂态方法的基本原理。
default.en: Electrochemical Measurement is one of the most important courses for undergraduate students majoring in Chemical Engineering and Technology. This program systematically instructs in the theory and experimental techniques of electrochemical measurement, mainly introducing experimental objects, measurement instruments, and measurement methods. This course is to help students have the capability to precisely choose measurement methods, reasonably design experimental schemes, and correctly perform experimental researches. The main contents include: the fundamental principles to perform electrochemical measurements; the mathematical description of electrochemical systems; the measurement and control of potential and current; the choose and design of electrolytic cells; the measurement instruments and techniques; the primary principles of the steady-state methods; the primary principles of the transient methods including the current step method, potential step method, linear sweep voltammetry and AC impedance method.

default.zh: 《现代电化学电源》课程旨在让学生全面深入地理解现代电化学电源的理论基础、原理及其实际应用。课程涵盖多种电源，包括锂离子电池、钠离子电池、燃料电池和超级电容器等，并着重强调能源技术中的创新与可持续性。课程结束时，学生将：理解电化学电源背后的理论原理；掌握现代电化学电源的设计、运行与应用知识；能够将理论概念应用于实际场景，提升在电化学能源领域解决问题与创新的能力。
default.en: The Modern Electrochemical Power Sources course aims to provide students with a thorough understanding of the theoretical foundations, principles, and practical applications of modern electrochemical power sources. The course covers various power sources, including Li-ion and Na-ion batteries, fuel cells, and supercapacitors, with an emphasis on innovation and sustainability in energy technology. By the end of the course, students will: ？ Understand the theoretical principles behind electrochemical power sources. ？ Gain knowledge of the design, operation, and application of modern electrochemical power sources. Apply theoretical concepts to practical scenarios, enhancing skills in problem-solving and innovation within the field of electrochemical energy sources.

default.zh: 本课程以讲授电镀的基本理论、工艺、维护管理等为主。授课内容包括： 电镀的基本概念、金属电结晶的基本理论和电镀液的性能，电镀锌、铜、镍、铬的工艺，金属共沉积理论、影响金属共沉积的因素及几种典型的电镀合金；化学镀原理、化学镀镍工艺和化学镀铜工艺；镀层性能测试等。
default.en: This course mainly focuses on teaching the basic theory, process, maintenance management, etc. of electroplating. The teaching content includes: basic concepts of electroplating, basic theories of metal electrocrystallization, properties of electroplating solutions, processes of electroplating zinc, copper, nickel, and chromium, theory of metal co deposition, factors affecting metal co deposition, and several typical electroplating alloys; Principles of chemical plating, chemical nickel plating process, and chemical copper plating process; Coating performance testing, etc.

default.zh: 《化学电源基础理论》是化学工程与工艺（电化学）专业的专业方向核心课程。化学电源广泛应用于车辆、飞机、便携式用电设备、通讯设备、航空航天、军事等各个行业，在国民经济中发挥着重要作用，本课程在阐明化学电源基本理论和基本概念的基础上，系统地介绍了锌锰电池、铅酸电池、镉镍电池、氢镍电池、锌银电池、金属空气电池、锂电池、锂离子电池、燃料电池等的工作原理和电池特性。通过本课程的学习，同时了解化学电源的发展方向，为以后从事化学电源的相关工作打下良好的基础。
default.en: Principle and Fundamental of Chemical Power Source is a core course for students of Chemical Engineering and Technology (Electrochemistry). Chemical power sources are widely used in vehicles, aircraft, portable electronics, communication equipment, aerospace, military and other industries, and play an important role in the national economy. Based on understanding the basic principles, concepts and performance of chemical power source, the operating principle, basic constructions, characteristics and manufacturing processes of a variety of primary and secondary batteries, such as Zn-MnO2, Pb-acid, Cd-NiOOH, MH-NiOOH, Zn-AgO, Zn-air, lithium battery, lithium ion battery, and fuel cells, are introduced in this course.Through the study of this course, as well as realizing the direction of development of chemical power source, a good foundation can be layed for students to engaging in relevant work.

default.zh: 《电化学综合实验》是化学工程与工艺专业的核心课程，主要讲授电化学专业基本实验方法及具体操作，既包括一些比较经典的实验方法和有关实验基本技能训练的实验，又涵盖了一些使用仪器设备比较复杂、实验方法比较先进、实验技巧难度比较大的实验内容。 通过本课程的学习，加深课堂所学理论知识，通过实验验证部分理论的内容，使学生基本实验技能得到训练。培养学生独立工作和从事科学研究工作的能力，并为学生进行毕业设计时的动手能力，打下一定的基础。
default.en: "Comprehensive Experiments on Electrochemistry" " is a core course in the field of Chemical Engineering and Technology, focusing primarily on the fundamental experimental methods and specific operations in electrochemistry. The course encompasses both classical experimental approaches and experiments aimed at basic skills training. Additionally, it covers experiments involving more intricate instrumentation, advanced experimental methods, and challenging experimental techniques. Through the study of this course, students deepen their theoretical knowledge acquired in the classroom, validate certain theoretical concepts through practical experiments, and receive training in basic experimental skills. The course aims to cultivate students' abilities for independent work and engagement in scientific research. Furthermore, it establishes a foundation for students to develop hands-on skills essential for their graduation design projects.

default.zh: 《电化学工程实验》是化学工程与工艺（电化学）专业方向核心课程，主要讲授工程设计及工艺的基本知识，并将基本的电化学原理和测量方法与工艺相结合，综合应用于化学电源系统和电镀工艺中。 通过本课程的学习，学生应该能够结合电化学原理、电化学测量、化学电源、电镀的基本知识，制备出典型化学电源体系并掌握其研究方法、设计并实现典型电镀工艺及性能评价方法，提高分析问题、解决问题的能力，建立简单的科学研究思想，为后续从事电化学研究与生产等实践打下良好的工程基础。主要达到以下4点目标： 课程目标1： 能够化学电源、电镀工艺学的基本原理，通过文献研究或相关方法，调研和分析实际电池体系及电镀工艺实现的解决方案。 课程目标2： 能够根据具体的电源及电镀特征，选择研究路线，设计具有创新性的实验方案。 课程目标3： 掌握锂离子电池、超级电容器等化学电源制备和电镀、化学镀工艺实现常用的仪器、测试及相关软件的工作原理和使用方法，并理解其局限性。 课程目标4：在课程学习中通过了解行业动态与国计民生的关系，培养学生优良品德、对电化学相关行业的执着信念、相应国家号召的家国情怀、良好的科学素养和强烈的社会任感，能够在工程实践中理解并遵守工程职业道德和规范，履行责任。
default.en: Electrochemical Engineering Experiments is a core course in the field of Chemical Engineering and Technology (Electrochemistry). It mainly teaches the basic knowledge of engineering design and technology, and combines basic electrochemical principles and measurement methods with technology to comprehensively apply them to chemical power supply systems and electroplating processes. From this course, students should be able to combine the basic knowledge of electrochemical principles, electrochemical measurement, chemical power supply, and electroplating, prepare typical chemical power supply systems, master their research methods, design and implement typical electroplating processes and performance evaluation methods, improve their ability to analyze and solve problems, and establish simple scientific research ideas. Four goals can be reached from this course: Course objective 1: The students are able to understand the basic principles of chemical power supply and electroplating technology, and conduct literature research or related methods to investigate and analyze practical battery systems and solutions implemented in electroplating processes. Course objective 2: The students are able to choose a research route and design innovative experimental plans based on specific power supply and electroplating characteristics. Course objective 3: The students can master the working principles and usage methods of commonly used instruments, testing, and related software for the preparation and electroplating of chemical power sources such as lithium-ion batteries and supercapacitors, as well as the implementation of chemical plating processes, and understand their limitations. Course objective 4: Through understanding the relationship between industry dynamics and national economy and people's livelihood in the course of learning, students will be cultivated with excellent moral character, persistent belief in the electrochemical related industry, patriotism corresponding to the national call, good scientific literacy, and strong sense of social responsibility. They will be able to understand and abide by engineering professional ethics and norms in engineering practice, and fulfill their responsibilities.

default.zh: 材料分析测试方法是高等学校化学、化工相关专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是学生开展科技创新、从事毕业设计过程中所涉及的材料分析测试方法在课程体系中的深入学习，是学习后续研究生专业课物质结构分析的课程基础。面向材料化学的本科生，综合运用先修课程中所学有关知识，掌握先进材料分析测试方法的基本原理，进行分析测试方法的基本训练，了解仪器分析领域的前沿性问题，培养学生应用分析仪器，解决专业问题的能力，为学生日后的专业学习、科研工作打下基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Material analysis and testing method is a very important professional basic course for students majoring in chemistry and chemical engineering in colleges and universities. It is the in-depth study of material analysis and testing method involved in the process of scientific and technological innovation and graduation design in the course system, and the course basis for learning the material structure analysis of subsequent professional courses for graduate students. For undergraduates in materials chemistry, comprehensive application of relevant knowledge learned in the pre-course, master the basic principles of advanced material analysis and testing methods, conduct basic training of analysis and testing methods, understand cutting-edge problems in the field of instrumental analysis, cultivate students' ability to apply analytical instruments and solve professional problems, and lay a foundation for students' future professional learning and scientific research. Support the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 物理化学通过物理学的原理、实验方法及数学手段来研究化学现象普遍规律性的一门交叉学科，从物理学角度分析物质体系化学行为的原理、规律和方法，涵盖化学系统从宏观到微观与性质的关系规律、化学过程机理及其控制的研究，是近代化学的原理根基，是化工类、材料类（工科）和药学、化学类（理科）专业的一门必修基础课。本课程包括热力学三大定律和基本方程、多组分系统热力学、相平衡、化学平衡和表面现象等。通过本课程，学生可以学习物理化学研究问题的一些特殊方法（热力学方法和动力学方法等），使学生具备：建立假设和模型、上升到理论、分析和解决具体问题的能力，培养逻辑思维和抽象思维能力，增加创新意识，为化工、材料等专业学生的后续课程学习和进一步掌握新的科学知识打下必要的基础。
default.en: Physical chemistry is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the general principles of chemical phenomena through the principles of physics, experimental methods and mathematical means. It analyzes the principles, laws and methods of the chemical behavior of material systems from the perspective of physics, covering chemical systems from macroscopic to microcosmic. It is a compulsory basic course for the majors of chemical engineering, materials(engineering), pharmacy and chemistry(science). This course includes the three laws of thermodynamics and basic equations, multi-component system thermodynamics, phase equilibrium, chemical equilibrium and surface phenomena. Through this course, students can learn some special methods of physical chemistry research problems(thermodynamic methods and kinetic methods, etc.). so that students have the ability to establish hypotheses and modes, rise to theories, analyze the solve specific problems, and increase awareness of innovation. It lays the necessary foundation for the follow-up course study and the further mastering of new scientific knowledge for students majoring in chemical engineering and materials.

default.zh: 《电化学实验x》是化学工程与工艺（电化学）专业的工程实践课程，主要讲授工程设计及工艺的基本知识，并将基本的电化学原理和测量方法与工艺相结合，综合应用于储能电源和表面处理领域。 通过本课程的学习，学生应该能够结合电化学原理、电化学测量、化学电源的基本知识，制备出典型化学电源体系并掌握其研究方法、设计并实现典型表面处理工艺及性能评价方法，提高分析问题、解决问题的能力，建立简单的科学研究思想，为后续从事电化学研究与生产等实践打下良好的工程基础。
default.en: Electrochemical Experiments is a core course in the field of Chemical Engineering and Technology (Electrochemistry). It mainly teaches the basic knowledge of engineering design and technology, and combines basic electrochemical principles and measurement methods with technology to comprehensively apply them to chemical power supply systems and electroplating processes. From this course, students should be able to combine the basic knowledge of electrochemical principles, electrochemical measurement, chemical power supply, and electroplating, prepare typical chemical power supply systems, master their research methods, design and implement typical electroplating processes and performance evaluation methods, improve their ability to analyze and solve problems, and establish simple scientific research ideas. Four goals can be reached from this course: Course objective 1: The students are able to understand the basic principles of chemical power supply and electroplating technology, and conduct literature research or related methods to investigate and analyze practical battery systems and solutions implemented in electroplating processes. Course objective 2: The students are able to choose a research route and design innovative experimental plans based on specific power supply and electroplating characteristics. Course objective 3: The students can master the working principles and usage methods of commonly used instruments, testing, and related software for the preparation and electroplating of chemical power sources such as lithium-ion batteries and supercapacitors, as well as the implementation of chemical plating processes, and understand their limitations. Course objective 4: Through understanding the relationship between industry dynamics and national economy and people's livelihood in the course of learning, students will be cultivated with excellent moral character, persistent belief in the electrochemical related industry, patriotism corresponding to the national call, good scientific literacy, and strong sense of social responsibility. They will be able to understand and abide by engineering professional ethics and norms in engineering practice, and fulfill their responsibilities.

default.zh: 《高分子综合实验》是高分子材料与工程专业的一门工程实践课程，囊括了高分子化学实验、高分子物理实验和高分子材料综合实验三部分的相关知识内容。其中高分子化学实验部分在教学环节中运用高分子化学和有机化学的有关知识，对学生进行高分子化学实验基本研究方法的培养；高分子物理实验部分主要涉及现代测定高分子结构及性能的方法和手段，与理论教学相配合；高分子材料综合实验主要讲授高分子材料相关实验，包括材料加工、材料改性和性能表征。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握高聚物的合成原理、实验操作方法和实验控制方法；学会将理论教学内容与实际应用相结合，加强实际操作能力。通过实验验证所学知识、理论的可靠性及正确性；掌握实际影响因素对实验的作用，更好地理解专业课程中材料加工、改性与性能的关系，加工过程对结构及性能的影响。基于实验的辅助教学，使学生对理论知识的掌握有所提高，加强动手能力的培养，掌握实验技巧和规范操作；使学生在实验和亲自设计、制造中逐渐学会把理论知识运用于生产实践中，培养学生的工程意识，为今后的科学研究和工作打下基础。
default.en: 《Integrated Polymer Experiments》 is an engineering practice course for polymer materials and engineering majors, which includes three parts of related knowledge contents: polymer chemistry experiments, polymer physics experiments, and polymer materials comprehensive experiments. The polymer chemistry experiment section utilizes relevant knowledge of polymer chemistry and organic chemistry in the teaching process to cultivate students' basic research methods in polymer chemistry experiments; The experimental part of polymer physics mainly involves modern methods and means for measuring the structure and properties of polymers, in conjunction with theoretical teaching; The comprehensive experiment of polymer materials mainly teaches experiments related to polymer materials, including material processing, material modification, and performance characterization. Through the study of this course, students will master the synthesis principles, experimental operation methods, and experimental control methods of polymers; Learn to combine theoretical teaching content with practical applications, and enhance practical operational abilities. Verify the reliability and correctness of the knowledge and theory learned through experiments; master the role of actual influencing factors in experiments, and better understand the relationship between material processing, modification, and performance in professional courses, as well as the impact of processing processes on structure and performance. Assisted teaching based on experiments can improve students' mastery of theoretical knowledge, strengthen the cultivation of hands-on skills, master experimental techniques, and standardize operations; Enable students to gradually learn to apply theoretical knowledge to production practice through experiments, personal design, and manufacturing, cultivate their engineering awareness, and lay a foundation for future scientific research and work.

default.zh: 有机化学实验C是化学相关专业的基础实验课。通过实验，使学生掌握有机化学实验的基础知识和基本实验操作技能，掌握有机实验完整的环节，学会物质的合成、分离、提纯和分析鉴定等过程正确的选择方法。使学生养成良好的实验习惯，提高学生的实验动手能力。培养学生理论联系实际、观察问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力。本课程包括基本实验技术知识，基本操作知识和实验训练三部分。
default.en: Experimental Organic Chemistry C is to train students to master basic skills and techniques in organic chemistry experiment to improve the ability of the compulsory basic experimental class. In inorganic chemistry and analytical chemistry experiment ⅠⅠ experimental basis, to enable students to learn through this course to deepen the understanding of basic theoretical knowledge of organic chemistry; training students to master the basic operation of Organic Chemistry and skills to improve the analysis of the problem and solve problems capacity; chemistry students creative thinking and innovation, theory with practice, rigorous scientific attitude and pragmatic work style and habits laboratory; same time, through micro-experiment will help students awareness of green chemistry and environmental awareness.

default.zh: 良好的写作能力及语言表达能力对与现在的学生至关重要，本课程主要培训学生的科学英语写作能力，包括写作锻炼及语言表达。课堂中除了学习、分析、阅读学术论文外，还将对于科学写作的真实案例进行讨论，并根据学习内容完成课后作业。根据讲座中教授的内容及方法，学生们将学习科学的写作方式方法，进行有效的摘要写作训练。这门课程需要学生在作业中投入相当多的精力。
default.en: The course is designed to train graduate students in their scientific writing in English, covering aspects of good practices in writing and language issues. In addition to theoretical classes about the anatomy of a good paper and acquisition of academic English, some lectures will be dedicated to discussing real cases of scientific writing, including materials from the students’ homework. The students will be trained to write effective abstracts based on a corpus linguistics approach which will be taught in the initial lectures. Therefore, the course will require considerable dedication by the students for homework.

default.zh: 综合俄语是一门语言课程，旨在帮助学生从A2水平提高到B1水平。本课程涵盖日常交流场景，包括社会互动、教育背景和基本的专业情况，特别注重培养学术语言技能。学生将培养听、说、读、写的能力；将学习特定学科的术语，并练习简单的科学交流模式。
default.en: Integrated Russian is a language course designed to help students progress from A2 to B1 proficiency. The course covers everyday communication scenarios including social interactions, educational contexts, and basic professional situations, with particular attention to developing academic language skills. Students will develop listening, speaking, reading, and writing competencies: will learn discipline-specific terminology and practice simple scientific communication patterns.

default.zh: 本课程系统扼要地介绍了光电材料的基本概念、原理、材料类型及其相关器件的制作、性能与应用知识。全书涉及的光电材料类型主要包括：太阳能转换材料、荧光材料、光催化材料、有机光致变色材料、有机电致变色材料、光聚合凝胶材料等。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the basic concept of optoelectronic materials and devices, and its background conditions of development, and some application in related fields (photovoltaic power generation, OLED, etc.), and some research progress of new type of photoelectric materials. So that the readers can have a preliminary knowledge of optoelectronic materials and devices, and have interests to explore more about them.

default.zh: 基础俄语语法是一门语言课程，旨在培养学生从A2到B1的语法能力水平。本课程研究核心语法结构，包括动词及其上下文用法，动态动词及其微妙的前缀系统，以及简单句和复合句的形成。通过重点练习和情境化应用，学生掌握了这些语法元素，同时培养了自我纠正常见错误的能力。
default.en: Russian Basic Grammar is a language course designed to develop students’ grammatical competence from A2 to B1 proficiency levels. This course examines core grammatical structures including verb aspects and their contextual usage, verbs of motion with their nuanced prefix system, and the formation of both simple and compound sentences. Through focused practice and contextualized application, students master these grammatical elements while developing the ability to self-correct common mistakes.

default.zh: 本课程是应用化学专业的本科生开设的一门专业基础课。使学生掌握表面化学领域的基本概念、理论和研究方法以及本领域内的最新进展；基本内容包括：（1）表面热力学基础：表面张力与表面Gibbs焓，弯曲液面蒸气压（开尔文公式），表面润湿、洗涤与接触角。（2）固体表面吸附：表面的物理、化学吸附理论，（3）表面活性剂：表面活性剂的分类及特点；表面活性剂的基本作用，表面活性剂界面铺展，胶束结构，临界胶束浓度和胶束形成过程；表面活性剂的结构与性能关系；表面活性剂的典型应用。（4）乳化和起泡过程：乳状液的稳定性及制备方法，破乳，微乳液。 通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握表面化学相关的基本理论原理、基本知识和技能；通过师生互动及讨论课等形式拓宽学生知识面，增强学生分析界面问题、解决界面问题及表述问题等相关能力，最终提高学生综合素质。能够使用现代工具对表界面问题进行科学研究，得到合理有效的结论。
default.en: The course is offered for the undergraduate students who are major in applied chemistry. The goal of this course is to let students have a good understanding towards the basic concepts and theories of surface chemistry, as well as characterization methods in surface science. The major content includes: （1）Fundamentals of surface thermodynamics: surface tension and Gibbs free energy of the surface, effects of curved interfaces on phase equilibrium and nucleation（the Kelvin equation）,surface wetting and washing, contact angle.(2) Solid surface adsorption: the physical and chemical adsorption theory of the surface.（3）Surfactants：classification and characteristics of surfactants, the basic function of surfactant, interfacial spreading of surfactants, micelle structure, critical micelle concentration, relationship between structure and properties of surfactants, typical applications of surfactants.(4)Emulsification and foaming process: emulsion stability and preparation method, demulsification methods, preparation methods of micro emulsion. By learning, the students can master the basic theory and basic knowledge of surface chemistry, widen the scope of knowledge, enhance ability of analysis and solving interface problems, improve students' comprehensive quality at last. The students can study the interface problem by modern tools, come to the reasonable and effective conclusions.

default.zh: 课程目标 1.提高已习得的读、说、听、写技能。 2.掌握日常话题的对话和独白 3.学习为不同目的构建写作文本的方法 本课程是为那些已经掌握了基本的俄语语法，词汇量约为1500个单词，可以就日常话题进行小对话，可以就熟悉的话题撰写小独白，可以阅读简单的文本，并具有初级水平的书面演讲的人设计的。本课程的目标是将学生的词汇量扩展到2000个单词，熟悉额外的结构和语法形式(动词类型、复合句、分词)、构词法、不同风格文本的结构特点、一般科学词汇。 专门编写的学术原版课文、语法和词汇教材、练习本以及视频和音频材料作为课堂材料。特别注意的是工作和知识测试的互动形式。主要采用集体劳动形式。熟悉俄罗斯文化、艺术和文学是基于互联网上可用的材料。学生根据自己感兴趣的主题准备自己的信息、报告和演示文稿。
default.en: Course Objectives 1.Improvement of acquired skills in reading, speaking, listening and writing. 2.mastering in making dialogues and monologues on everyday topics 3.studying ways to build writing texts for different purposes This course is designed for those who have already mastered the basics of Russian grammar, have a vocabulary of about 1500 words, can conduct small dialogues on everyday topics, can compose a small monologue on a familiar topic, can read simple texts, and have an elementary level of written speech. The aim of this course is to expand the student's vocabulary up to 2000 words, to familiarize him/her with additional structures and grammatical forms (types of verbs, complex sentences, participles), word formation, peculiarities of construction of texts of different styles, general scientific vocabulary. Specially prepared academic and authentic texts, textbooks on grammar and vocabulary, exercise books, as well as video and audio materials serve as materials for classes. Special attention is paid to interactive forms of work and testing of knowledge. Collective forms of work are predominantly used. Familiarization with Russian culture, art and literature is based on available material on the Internet. Students prepare their own messages, reports and presentations on topics of interest to them.

default.zh: 《纳米材料与纳米技术》是化学相关专业的硕士研究生选修课程。本课程系统地讲授各类纳米材料的概念、制备方法、结构和性能特征以及表征技术和方法，并在此基础上，归纳相关领域的最新研究进展与发展趋势。通过本课程的学习，引导硕士研究生对纳米科学与技术进行认知与了解，帮助他们掌握纳米科技和纳米材料学的基本概念、基本原理和研究现状，从而启发他们的创新思维、拓宽其科学视野，辅助研究课题的进行。
default.en: Nanomaterials and Nanotechnology is an optional course for postgraduates majoring in chemistry. This course systematically teaches the concepts, preparation methods, structure and properties of various nanomaterials, as well as characterization techniques and methods. On this basis, the latest research progress and development trends in related fields are summarized. Through the study of this course, we can guide students to understand nanoscience and technology, help them grasp the basic concepts, basic principles and research status of nanoscience and nanomaterials, so as to inspire their innovative thinking, broaden their scientific horizons and assist the research projects.

default.zh: 课程目标 1.了解俄语系统，以便在语言环境之外进行成功的口头和书面交流 2.获得针对特定领域的一般学术风格概念 在本课程结束时，学生应该 在阅读中——理解社会、文化和经济文本以及一般主题的特殊文本 在写作方面——创作日常、学术和官方风格的文本，足以满足交际需求 在听力方面——理解通俗、日常和学术风格的一般文本 在关于一般社会和科学主题的对话中，对不同的话题进行独白。 本课程假定学生熟悉俄语语法的基本模式，掌握俄语发音的基本知识，掌握1500个单词的词汇量。在口语方面，学生学习理解和撰写关于日常话题(家庭、朋友、空闲时间、爱好、运动、旅行)的简单对话(4-5行)，构建5-7句的小独白。在写作方面，学生们学习写贺卡、小纸条和短信。提供简短的叙事故事(200-300字)供阅读。视频、录音、电影剪辑和节目向学生介绍这个国家的文化。当学生学习材料时，他们会写小测验，并在课程结束时参加期末考试。
default.en: Course Objectives 1.to know the Russian Language System for successful oral and written communication out of language environment 2.to acquire conceptions of general academic style referring to specific area At the end of this course, students should ？in reading – understand social, cultural and economical texts as well as special texts of general topics ？in writing – create texts in everyday, academic and official styles enough to meet communicative needs ？in listening – understand in general texts created in popular, everyday and academic style ？in talking – support dialogues on general social and science themes, make monologue on different topics. This course assumes familiarization with the basic models of Russian grammar, knowledge of the basics of Russian pronunciation, and mastery of a vocabulary of 1500 words. In oral speech, students learn to understand and compose simple dialogues (4-5 lines) on everyday topics (family, friends, free time, hobbies, sports, travel), build small monologues of 5-7 sentences. In writing, students learn to write greeting cards, small notes and text messages. Short narrative stories (200-300 words) are offered for reading. Videos, audio recordings, film clips, and programs introduce students to the culture of the country. As students study the material, they write quizzes and take a final test at the end of the course.

default.zh: 合成化学是为化工学院应用化学系本科生开设的一门专业选修课。本课程旨在为功能材料制备工艺基础及实验等后续课程和学位论文及科研工作奠定必要的理论基础。要求学生掌握无机化合物合成中涉及的基础理论，并掌握高温合成、低温合成、高压合成等原理和方法；掌握有机化合物的合成设计方法和技巧，学会根据已知分子结构，通过逆向切断设计其合成路线的方法；掌握有机无机杂化材料的合成与表征方法。使同学们具备分析目的和要求，结合学到的各种仪器分析方法的特点、方法的应用范围，在科研中选择适宜的分析方法的能力。培养学生独立分析和解决材料方面问题的能力。
default.en: Synthetic Chemistry is a major elective course for undergraduate students in the Department of Applied Chemistry of the School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering. This course aims to lay the necessary theoretical foundation for subsequent courses, dissertations and scientific research work such as the foundation and experiment of the preparation process of functional materials. Students are required to master the basic theories involved in the synthesis of inorganic compounds and master the principles and methods of high-temperature synthesis, low-temperature synthesis, high-pressure synthesis, etc., master the synthesis design methods and skills of organic compounds, learn how to design their synthesis routes by reverse cutting according to the known molecular structure, and master the synthesis and characterization methods of organic-inorganic hybrid materials. To enable students to have the purpose and requirements of analysis, combined with the characteristics of various instrumental analysis methods they have learned, the application scope of the methods, and the ability to select appropriate analysis methods in scientific research. Develop students' ability to analyze and solve problems with materials independently.

default.zh: 《应用表面化学与技术Ⅱ》 是化学及相关专业本科生(中俄联合办学)的选修课。本课程主要介绍表面热力学基础、固体对气体的吸附、固体表面的润湿和洗涤的过程及影响因素和规律、乳状液的性质及其制备、泡沫性能及起泡与消泡原理、表面活性剂的分类和基本作用以及结构与性能关系等。通过本课程的学习，培养学生建立界面观点，为今后从事科学研究、开发和生产提供界面科学的基本知识和理论基础。
default.en: Applied Surface Chemistry and Technology II is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in chemistry and related fields (jointly run by China and Russia). This course mainly introduces the basis of surface thermodynamics, the adsorption of solid to gas, the wetting and washing process of solid surface and its influencing factors and laws, the properties and preparation of emulsion, foam properties and foaming and defoaming principles, the classification and basic functions of surfactants, and the relationship between structure and performance. Through the study of this course, students are trained to establish an interface perspective, providing basic knowledge and theoretical foundation of interface science for future scientific research, development, and production.

default.zh: 固体推进剂化学与技术是为化学工程与技术和化学学科本科生开设的一门专业选修课。本课程面向和服务国防科研。通过讲解我国在固体推进剂领域中遇到的实际问题，国内现有研究的不足和重要前沿方向，激发学生们解决问题的热情和积极性，达到爱国教育和课堂思政教学的目的。本课程系统地讲授固体推进剂的定义、分类、基本组成及功能性指标，特别是固体推进剂的能量性能、燃烧性能、力学性能、安定性和危险性等。根据实际国防需求背景，介绍固体推进剂中涉及的化学原理，研究含能材料的物质组成与固体推进剂性能的内在关系，培养学生服务国防科研的意识和解决问题的思维方式。
default.en: Solid Propellant Chemistry and Technology is a professional elective course for the undergraduate students in the discipline of Chemical Engineering and Technology as well in the discipline of Chemistry. This course is intended to serve for the national defense research. Through the explanation of the practical problems encountered in the field of solid propellants in China as well as the shortcomings of the existing domestic research and the important frontier directions, the course will stimulate the enthusiasm and enthusiasm of the students to solve the problems, the purpose of patriotic education and classroom civic teaching will be achieved. This course systematically teaches the definition, classification, basic composition and functional indexes of solid propellants, especially for the energy performance, combustion performance, mechanical performance, stability and danger of solid propellants. Based on the background of actual national defense needs, the course will introduce the chemical principles involved in solid propellants, study the intrinsic relationship between the material composition of energy-containing materials and the performance of solid propellants, and cultivate the students' awareness of serving national defense scientific research and encourage their thinking of problem solving.

default.zh: 生物化学是生命科学各专业的一门重要的专业基础课。生物化学是用化学的理论和方法研究生物体的化学组成以及在生命活动中所发生的化学变化及其调控规律，从而阐明生命现象本质的一门学科。通过生物化学的学习，使学生系统地掌握现代生物化学的基本理论、基本知识，掌握生物化学的基本技术，培养学生从分子水平认识生命现象的能力，训练学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，了解近期生物化学的新进展，启发学生的创新精神，为学生进一步学习生物学的有关后续课程准备必要的生物化学知识，并为以后从事与生命科学有关的教学、科研与生产奠定基础。
default.en: Biochemistry is an important course for all major of life sciences. Biochemistry is a discipline that uses chemical theories and methods to study the chemical composition of organisms, the chemical changes that occur in their life activities, and their regulations. Through the study of biochemistry, students should systematically master the basic theory and basic knowledge of modern biochemistry, master the basic techniques of biochemistry, develop students' abilities to recognize life phenomena at the molecular level, train their ability to analyze and solve problems, and understand recent advances in biochemistry, prepare necessary biochemical knowledge for students' further follow-up courses in biology, and lay the foundation for future teaching, research and production related to life sciences.

default.zh: 自现代化学工业诞生以来，控制技术一直是化学工业发展的关键推动力之一，决定了化学工业的过程性。与机械、汽车、电子设备等离散制造行业相比，多尺度构成了应用化学及化工行业的典型特点，化工行业需要在分子、单元、过程等尺度上，通过人工智能的互联、耦合与协同，科学地解决跨尺度间的传递与协同机制问题。把人工智能等现代信息技术与化工知识相融合，构建综合性的知识体系，突出数字技术对应用化学学科发展在方法论方面的重要意义。内容包括：材料基因工程、魔幻的团簇与合金材料、AI构筑多孔材料万花筒、AI为锂离子电池助威、AI让有机光电材料大放异彩、AI助力药物设计、AI助力波谱分析、典型化学反应的催化材料与反应机制、高端专用化学品功能调控机制、AI前沿在过程系统工程中的应用及功能纳米材料介尺度结构形成机制与性能调控、装备/过程层次的介科学研究与应用、层次界面与跨层次耦合的介科学研究与应用以及从虚拟过程到无人工厂-介科学驱动的过程工业智能化。
default.en: Since the birth of modern chemical industry, control technology has always been one of the key driving forces for the development of chemical industry, determining the processability of the chemical industry. Compared with discrete manufacturing industries such as machinery, automobiles, and electronic equipment, multi-scale composition is a typical feature of the applied chemistry and chemical industry. The chemical industry needs to scientifically solve the problem of transmission and collaboration mechanisms across scales through the interconnection, coupling, and collaboration of artificial intelligence at molecular, unit, and process scales. Integrating modern information technologies such as artificial intelligence with chemical knowledge, constructing a comprehensive knowledge system, and highlighting the significant methodological significance of digital technology in the development of applied chemistry. The content includes: material genetic engineering, magical clusters and alloy materials, AI building a porous material kaleidoscope, AI boosting lithium-ion batteries, AI making organic optoelectronic materials shine, AI assisting drug design, AI assisting spectral analysis, catalytic materials and reaction mechanisms for typical chemical reactions, functional regulation mechanisms for high-end specialized chemicals.

default.zh: 催化在国民经济中起着十分重要的作用，它在炼油、化工、环保、制药、能源、材料等行业中已创造出巨大的经济效益和社会效益，特别是目前人们面临着能源利用、环境保护等重大问题，都要依赖于催化过程来解决，催化科学已成为发展现代工业和高新技术不可缺少的科学基础。 本课程对化工与化学学院三年级本科生开课，通过本课程的学习，学生应对催化科学和技术的发展趋势有一个概括的认识和了解；掌握有关催化作用的基本知识、掌握酸碱催化、金属催化、金属氧化物催化、工业中的重要催化反应过程及绿色催化化学等相关知识，掌握催化剂的制备、生产和表征方法等。
default.en: Catalysis plays a very important role in the national economy, it creates enormous economic and social benefits especially in petrochemical industry, environmental protection, pharmacy, energy, materials and other industries. Catalytic science has become indispensable for modern industry and practically for the solution to the facing major issues such as energy and environmental protection. This course is open to the junior students of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering. Through this course study, students should have a broad knowledge and understanding of the developments in the catalytic science and technology; grasp the knowledge about the nature of catalysis, acid-base catalysis, oxidation catalysis, green chemistry and so on. Also students should understand the preparation and characterization of catalysts.

default.zh: 杂化材料化学与物理课程面向应用化学系的本科生开课，是学生们学习的后续专业课。课程主要讲授常见的几种杂化材料制备方法、结构和性能表征，以及几种典型的杂化材料和少量高分子材料基本知识。重点使学生了解杂化材料的理论知识、实验方法、研究热点及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握化学理论研究的基本计算方法和实验技能等。 课程主要包括溶胶凝胶法、原位聚合法、插层法和自组装法，石墨烯、介孔氧化硅、POSS杂化材料、聚酰亚胺杂化材料、高分子材料的化学与物理基本知识的介绍；不同有机高分子与固定纳米粒子形成的杂化材料的讨论，独立完成4个不同类型化学物质的上机计算。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时测评和上机实验。
default.en: Chemistry and Physics of Hybrid Materials is one course to all the undergraduates in Applied Chemistry Department, which is the latter specialty lesson. In this course, a few elementary knowledge of polymer materials, several commonly used synthesis methods and several typical kinds of hybrid materials are introduced about their scientific principle and the characterization of the structure and properties. After finishing the lesson students should know the theoretical foundation, preparation scheme, advanced studies, tendency and applications of the above hybrid materials, be familiar to the basic calculation methods of chemical theoretical research and the calculation of experimental skills. This course consists of the introduction about different synthetic methods (e.g. sol-gel, in situ polymerization, intercalation and selfassembly methods) and different hybrid materials (e.g. grapheme, mesoporous silica, POSS and polyimide materials), the basic knowledge of polymer chemistry and physics, the discussion about the hybrid materials of different polymers and fixed nanoparticles, four computer calculations with the different chemical materials on one's own. This course grade is cumulative scores, including the final written examination, peacetime evaluation and computer experiments.

default.zh: 细胞工程是一门专业选修课。细胞工程是生物技术的重要组成部分, 是生物技术产业化的重要环节。总的来说，它是应用细胞生物学和分子生物学的理论和方法，按照人们的设计蓝图，进行在细胞水平上的遗传操作及进行大规模的细胞和组织培养。当前细胞工程所涉及的主要技术领域有细胞培养、细胞融合、染色体操作及基因转移等方面。通过细胞工程可以生产有用的生物产品或培养有价值的植株，并可以产生新的物种或品系。
default.en: Cell engineering is one of the professional elective courses. It is the main component of the biotechnology and is also an important link of the biotechnology industrialization. In general, it is a theory and method of biology and molecular cell biological applications, according to the design blueprint of the people, the genetic operations on the cell level and large scale culture of cell and tissue. The main technology in the field of the current cell engineering involved in cell culture, cell fusion, chromosome manipulation and gene transfer. Through cell engineering can produce useful biological products or develop valuable plants, and can generate new species or strains.
