Structural limit load calculations mainly address the elastoplastic failure of engineering structures (mainly reinforced concrete structures), teaching the evolution process from elastic to plastic failure of structures and the corresponding limit load determination methods, closely related to the content of the subsequent professional courses "Basic Principles of Concrete Structures" and "Seismic Resistance of Engineering Structures." This course primarily aims to cultivate students' ability to apply the knowledge learned in the preceding "Structural Mechanics" course to solve practical engineering problems, with particular emphasis on developing students' ability to use computers to solve complex engineering problems. Through the study of this course, a bridge is built to solve engineering problems using mechanics principles, laying a solid theoretical foundation for students' future structural design and scientific research work after graduation.

default.zh: 结构振动控制技术具有严密的科学理论、优良的控制效果和广泛的适应范围，是提高土木工程结构的防灾减灾能力和安全服役水平的重要手段之一。目前，被动控制技术已经在结构抗震，抗风等领域获得了广泛的工程应用；主动，半主动和智能控制技术也在世界范围内进行了很好的典型工程应用，吸引了国内外众多科技工作者的研究兴趣。结构振动控制课程是土木工程专业的重要课程，目的在于通过本课程的学习理解和掌握结构被动控制方法(包括基础隔振和消能、耗能减振)及各类装置，主动、半主动和智能控制系统的基本概念、基本原理和分析设计方法等专业知识；能够利用所学专业知识，对土木工程结构抗风、抗震等工程需求，进行结构振动控制方案的设计、分析，从而提高结构防灾减灾性能和安全服役水平；理解土木工程防灾减灾的基本原理及一般方法，了解结构振动控制方向的发展趋势和前沿课题，具有初步的科学研究思路和方法。
default.en: The technology of structural vibration control has exact theory and superior control efficacy, which had been widely applicate in many engineering to improve the ability of disaster prevention and deduction and the safe service level of the civil engineering. At present, passive structural vibration control has been widely used to the seismic resistance and wind resistance for the civil engineering. And the active, semi-active and intelligent vibration control has been used on the typical enormous engineering. Many researchers and engineers pay attentions to the structural vibration in the civil engineering. The course of Structural Vibration Control is opened to the undergraduate students in the school of civil engineering. The course of Structural Vibration Control mainly presents primary theories, design approaches, control devices and systems of passive vibration control, active, semi-active and intelligent vibration control. The students would learn about some kinds of passive control devices including the design and analysis method, and their design fundamental principle. Design methodologies of active, semi-active and intelligent control systems are also introduced to the undergraduate students in mechanics. On the basis of what students learned, the preliminary ability of designing the structural vibration control system and primary researching would be achieved for the students.

default.zh: 《工程岩体力学》课程是城市地下空间工程专业本科生的一门必修专业课。本课程主要研究不同受力条件下岩体的变形和破坏规律，并在工程地质定性分析的基础上定量研究工程岩体稳定性。在工程岩体力学课程教学中通过基本概念、基本理论、基本方法的教学，培养学生发现问题、分析问题和解决岩体力学问题的能力。为今后从事生产实际工作和科学研究打好基础。本课程共计32学时，2学分。通过闭卷考试的形式考核学生的学习情况，以百分制打分。
default.en: Rock Mechanics of Engineering is a compulsory course for undergraduates majoring in urban underground space engineering. This course mainly studies the deformation and failure rules of rock mass under different stress conditions, and quantitatively studies the stability of engineering rock mass on the basis of qualitative analysis of engineering geology. Through the teaching of basic concepts, basic theories and basic methods, students are trained to discover, analyze and solve problems in rock mechanics. It will lay a solid foundation for future production practice and scientific research. This course is with a total of 32 hours and 2 credits. This course examines student learning through a closed-book examination and scores by percentage grading system.

default.zh: 《地基处理》是城市地下空间工程专业本科生的一门专业方向选修课程。本课程主要培养学生改善不良场地条件、降低地基基础工程风险的能力，提高学生解决基础工程问题的综合分析能力。本课程主要讲授地基处理的基本原理、计算设计方法和施工方法，系统讲述地基处理的基本过程和主要检验依据。通过该课程的学习，学生能够理解地基处理的理论，掌握处理复杂岩土工程的方法，提高学生地下空间工程系统知识的综合应用能力。为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事地下工程领域的设计与研究工作打下基础，在城市地下空间工程专业的教学计划中占有重要的地位。
default.en: This course is accessible to undergraduate students majoring in urban underground space engineering. This course involves the basic knowledge and main technologies of ground treatment, containing the principles and methods, treatment technology, and design calculation manners. The students who finished this course could be capable to design a safe, economic, and reasonable foundation and ground engineering based on varied conditions, demands, and construction schemes. It lays a foundation for further study on the relevant major courses and being engaged in urban underground space engineering or research in the future. So it plays an important role in the teaching of urban underground space engineering specialty.

default.zh: 1、线弹性断裂力学：基本方程和基本断裂模式、裂纹尖端场与应力强度因子、能量释放率、应力强度因子的计算方法、复合型裂纹扩展准则、界面裂纹、断裂动力学概要。 2、疲劳和腐蚀裂纹: 等幅载荷下裂纹扩展、影响疲劳裂纹扩展的因素、裂纹闭合效应、疲劳裂纹扩展门槛值及寿命预测、腐蚀介质中裂纹扩展概述、应力腐蚀裂纹扩展及腐蚀条件下结构的安全设计。 3、弹塑性断裂力学: 小范围屈服理论、Dugdale-Barenblatt条带塑性区模型、裂尖张开位移和COD准则、J积分及J积分准则、弹塑性裂纹尖端场（HRR）。 4、断裂测试: ASTM标准测试、层间断裂韧度测试、压痕法、Chevron 切口法。 5、系统阐述了损伤力学的基本概念、基本理论和基本方法，特别强调介绍损伤变量的选取、损伤演化方程的确定、损伤本构关系的建立以及含损伤结构边值问题的求解方法，和损伤的宏观测量及其在结构寿命预测中的工程应用。主要内容包括：损伤力学的概念分类和研究方法、一维损伤理论、三维各向同性损伤理论、各向异性损伤理论、考虑损伤的断裂力学、基于细观力学损伤理论、损伤力学应用与损伤的测量、其他损伤理论。
default.en: 1、Linear elastic fracture Mechanics: basic equations and fracture modes; Asymptotic crack tip fields and stress intensity factors(SIFs); Energetic consideration and energy release rate; Methods for calculation of stress intensity factors; Criteria for mix-mode fracture; Interface crack problems; Brief introduction of dynamic fracture 2、Fatigue and stress corrosion crack propagation: Fatigue and crack propagation; Key factors and thresholds for fatigue crack propagation; Crack closure effect; Life estimation of structures; Overview of the stress corrosion crack propagation; SCC propagation laws and safety evaluation in corrosive media. 3、Elastoplastic fracture Mechanics: Small scale yielding model; Dugdale-Barenblatt strip model; COD and COD criterion; J integral and J integral criterion; Elastoplastic crack tip fields. 4、Fracture tests: ASTM standard fracture test; Interlaminar fracture toughness test; Indentation method; Chevron notch method. 5、This course systematically expounds the basic concepts of damage mechanics, basic theories and methods, especially the selection of damage variables, the determination of damage evolution equation, the establishment of damage constitutive relation and the method of solving the boundary value problem of damage structure, and the macroscopic measurement of damage and its engineering application in structural life prediction. The main contents include: Concept classification and research methods of damage mechanics, one-dimensional damage theory, three-dimensional isotropic damage theory, anisotropic damage theory, fracture mechanics considering damage, meso-Mechanics damage Theory, damage mechanics application and damage measurement, other damage theory.

default.zh: 《结构健康监测》是哈尔滨工业大学土木工程学院土木工程(土木菁华班)专业本科生的限选课。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握结构健康监测和智能运维基本技术，了解波动监测技术，光纤光栅传感器原理，掌握模态参数识别的基本方法，掌握结构损伤识别、模型修正与安全评定、结构智能运维的机器学习和深度学习基本方法。理论讲解结合课后作业，加深对课堂理论教学内容的理解，使学生对结构健康监测有一定深度的理解。
default.en: This course is the distributional elective course of civil engineering major. Through the learning of this course, the students will understand the basic theories and techniques of structural health monitoring and intelligent operation and maintenance. The main contents are: basic concepts of signal processing, damage detection based on guided wave using PZT sensors, scouring monitoring, sensing theory of optical fiber, modal analysis, frequency and time domain based modal parameters identification methods, modal parameters-based damage identification, structural model updating and safety assessment, machine learning and deep learning in structural health monitoring. To enhance the student understanding of the theory of structural health monitoring, necessary classroom tests and homework will be carried out in the course.

default.zh: 高分子材料被广泛地应用于土木工程领域，如纤维增强高分子FRP结构的加固、修复与升级、高分子涂料与高分子混凝土等， 成为传统土木工程材料的重要补充。本课程作为理论与应用力学专业和土木工程专业（特别是土木工程材料方向）的限选课，系统教授高分子合成、高分子材料结构与性能及高分子材料性能等，简要介绍高分子材料的加工成型方法。目的是使学生掌握高分子材料的成型-结构-性能关系，为高分子材料的研发与工程应用奠定基础。该课程将拓展学生视野，扩大学生知识面，符合学校“厚基础、宽专业”的培养目的。
default.en: Polymer materials have already been widely used in civil engineering, such as FRP (Fiber Reinforced Polymer) used for structural strengthening, various polymer coatings, as well as polymer concrete etc. This course will introduce the manufacturing, structures and properties of polymer materials. Students who participate the class will get the fundamental knowledge about the synthesis method of the polymer materials, the structure and properties and application field of various polymer materials. In addition, the manufacturing methods of polymer materials are also provided. As believed, the class will widen student’s knowledge and perspective of novel engineering materials, which is accordant to the school’s education requirement, deep foundation and wide major.

default.zh: 随着国际上先进功能材料，特别是纳米科技的快速发展，无机材料的力、电、光、磁、热等物理性能逐渐在纳米感知与人工智能、纳米摩擦绿色发电、柔性电子传感、生物功能增强、极端防隔热等多个领域发挥重要作用。本课程结合目前国际在无机材料研究前沿领域最新研究成果，与时俱进的将新一代无机纳米材料物理性能教授给学生。要求学生通过学习，初步掌握目前国际最新无机材料的基本理论原理，理解先进纳米无机材料的工作原理及制备方法，具备将所学无机材料物理性能知识交叉应用到土木工程等领域科学研究的能力。
default.en: With the fast development of advanced materials, especially the nanotechnology in the world, the physical properties of inorganic materials, such as mechanical, electrical, optical, magnetic and thermal properties, will play key effect to develop the nanosensing and artificial intelligence, TENG, flexible electrical sensor, bionic structure and the thermal protection under extreme conditions. This class will follow the most innovative works on the frontier of inorganic materials in the world, and teach the next-generation physical properties of inorganic nanomaterials to the students. The students will learn the fundamental theory of the newest inorganic materials, understand the working principle and fabrication method, and obtain the ability to apply the interdisciplinary to their research on civil engineering, etc.

default.zh: 《材料计算与模拟》是面向土木工程材料专业本科开课，是本科学生的选修课。课程主要讲授材料仿真与模拟的基本原理及方法。重点使学生了解材料仿真与模拟的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握材料仿真与模拟的基本原理及技法等。 课程主要包括概论及应用介绍、数值分析及解法、Monte Carlo法、多物理场分析、量子力学方法、晶体形貌的分子模拟与预测等基本计算方法。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时测试和作业三部分。
default.en: “Calculation and simulation of materials” is the elective course for the undergraduate students majoring in Civil Engineering (Civil Engineering Materials Direction). In this course, several commonly material calculation and simulation are introduced about their basic principles and methods. After finishing the lesson student know the theoretical foundation, advanced studies, tendency and applications of the above material calculation and simulation. Be familiar to material calculation and simulation principles and method of ordinary and special techniques. This course mainly includes the introduction, numerical analysis and solution, Monte Carlo method, multi-physics analysis, quantum mechanics method and the molecular simulation and prediction of crystal morphology and so on. The course scores are cumulative, including three parts: classroom test, homework and written examinations.

default.zh: 《功能建筑材料》是土木工程专业土木工程材料方向的限选课程，是土木工程专业学生把握建筑材料在土木工程领域发展趋势的重要基础。主要内容包括建筑吸声和隔声材料、防水材料、保温材料、嵌缝材料、防火材料以及耐磨材料，主要讲述上述功能材料的原料、原理、生产、性能以及应用。通过该课程的学习，使学生了解建筑功能材料的基本作用原理和相关基础知识，掌握建筑材料生态化设计、分析的基本原理及方法；了解建筑功能材料的组成、性能和影响因素，具备根椐工程要求合理地选择和使用功能材料的能力；熟悉建筑功能材料基本生产过程，逐步具有研究和开发建筑功能材料的能力。
default.en: “Functional Building Materials” is a limited elective course in the field of civil engineering materials for civil engineering majors, and is an important foundation for civil engineering students to grasp the development trend of building materials in the field of civil Engineering. Its main contents include building sound absorption and sound insulation materials, waterproof materials, heat insulation materials, fireproof materials, wear resistant materials and so on. The course mainly describes the material, principle, production, performance and application of the functional materials mentioned above. Through the study of this course, students understand the basic action principles and related basic knowledge of functional materials for building, the basic principles of analysis and methods of building materials, understand the composition, performance and influencing factors of functional materials, and have the abilities of reasonable selection and use of functional materials according to engineering requirements. Students also are familiar with the basic production process of functional materials for building, and gradually have the ability to research and develop functional materials for building materials.

default.zh: 《材料制备工艺》是土木工程专业土木工程材料方向本科生的选修课。对将来从事本专业的具体工作时有非常重要的作用。只有先进的工艺与先进的机械设备，才能生产出高质量、高品质的建筑材料制品。 本课程主要讲授粉体生产工艺与设备、材料热工过程与设备、混合搅拌过程与设备，以及土木工程材料预制构件工厂工艺设计方法及原理等内容。 通过学习常用的及最新的材料工艺与设备，使学生掌握主要土木工程材料的工艺原理和机械设备，掌握材料生产过程中的主要工艺参数及主要机械设备的型号、工作原理、工作参数，掌握材料工艺流程的特点，并能够根据要求合理地设计产品的生产工艺和选择使用先进的机械设备。
default.en: “Manufacture Process of Inorganic Materials” is one required course for the undergraduate students in Civil Engineering materials. Only the advanced technology, advanced machinery and equipment can produce high-quality construction and building materials products. This course mainly includes powder production technology and equipment, Material thermal processes and equipment, material mixing process and equipment, as well as the process design and theoretical method of civil engineering materials prefabricated components. Through the study of commonly used and the latest materials technology and equipment, this course enables students to master the main principles of the process technology and machinery of civil engineering materials, to master the main process parameters and the major type of mechanical equipment, working principle, working parameters in the production process, to master the characteristics of process and be able to design the production process and to choose advanced machinery and equipment.

default.zh: 《混凝土外加剂》课程是一门土木工程的专业课，掌握混凝土外加剂的原理及应用对土木工程结构的使用寿命具有重要意义。课程主要包括减水剂、引气剂、调凝剂、早强剂、膨胀剂、泵送剂、防水剂及阻锈剂等混凝土外加剂的作用机理、合成方法和对混凝土的作用。通过该课程的学习，使学生了解混凝土外加剂的相关知识和基本原理，把握其研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；了解各种混凝土外加剂的基本结构、作用机理及对混凝土性能的影响规律，具备根椐具体工程要求合理地选择和使用混凝土外加剂的能力；了解混凝土外加剂的合成工艺和复配技术，能够指导生产、改进工艺、调整参数，初步具有研发新型混凝土外加剂的能力。
default.en: “Concrete Admixtures” is a professional elective course in civil engineering, and it is great significant to master the principle and application of concrete admixture for the service life of civil engineering structures. The content of the course mainly covers action mechanisms of concrete admixture, synthesis principle of concrete admixture and effects of concrete admixture on the concrete properties, and the types of concrete admixtures include Water-reducing admixture, Air-entraining admixture, Setting admixture, Accelerating admixture, Expansion admixture, Pumping aids, Permeability reducing admixture and Corrosion inhibitor. Through the study of this course, students can understand the relevant knowledge and basic principles of concrete admixtures, grasp the research focus, development trends and cutting-edge applications, understand the basic structure, action mechanisms and influence laws on concrete properties from all kinds of concrete admixture, obtain reasonable selection and use ability of concrete admixtures according to the specific engineering requirements. Students also are provided with the synthetic processes and mixed technology of concrete admixture, guide production, improve process, adjust parameters, and initially have the ability to develop new concrete admixtures.

default.zh: 特种混凝土在实际工程应用中占有重要地位，在多数常规混凝土结构和重大混凝土结构广泛应用。新型结构形式、施工方法、服役环境、特定功能的实现往往对混凝土材料提出特殊的要求，特种混凝土应运而生。材料的性能由其组成和微结构决定，具有特殊性能的特种混凝土的开发与应用必须从材料的组成和微结构入手，并通过配合比设计和生产工艺予以实现。在胶凝材料和混凝土现代科学技术等相关知识基础上，本课程主要介绍具有特殊力学性能、工作性能、耐久性能和体积稳定性的高强与超高强混凝土、自密实混凝土、高性能混凝土、补偿收缩混凝土和大体积混凝土等的具体方法与技术路线；介绍具有特殊材料组成和施工工艺的透水混凝土、泡沫混凝土和聚合物混凝土的组成、微结构和性能，掌握根据具体功能需求灵活设计材料的组成和微结构来设计满足各种特别需求的混凝土材料，掌握他们的具体配合比设计方法、性能分析方法和生产工艺，了解特种混凝土的典型工程应用。
default.en: In engineering practice, some special concretes besides common concrete material play important roles and broadly used in general concrete structures and especially some great infrastructures. In order to satisfy special requirements of new types of infrastructures, construction technology, environmental conditions under real services and special functions, special types of concrete materials are then developed and broadly applied. The performances and properties of special concrete materials are of course determined by their constitutes and micro-structures. In this course, based on the basic knowledge of modern cementitious materials and common concrete materials, high/ultra-high strength concrete, self-compacting concrete, high performance concrete, shrinkage compensating concrete and mass concrete are introduced with great emphases on mechanical property, workability, durability, dimensional stability, and the technical ways to achieve these special performances. Additionally, pervious concrete, foam concrete and polymer-modified concrete are announced with special constitutes and performance. According to the practical need of concrete materials, one is required to acquire the approaches to design the constitutes, adjust its microstructures, construction technique and sometimes other techniques in the preparation and production of these fundamentally special concrete materials. Moreover, the engineering applications of them should be also mastered with respect to their special performances.

default.zh: 本课程为专业基础课，主要针对智能建造专业三年级本科生，通过理论讲解，深入理解流体动力学基本概念、原理和分析方法，掌握张量基本运算、粘性流体动力学基本方程组、边界层理论；掌握流动稳定性与层流到湍流的转捩、湍流基本理论；掌握智能风工程基本理论。培养使用数学工具描述并解决问题的素养和思维，从而在各自研究与工程领域中取得进展，并能进一步从事相关科学与工程问题研究，引领智能力学、智能建造行业发展。
default.en: This course is a professional basic course, mainly aimed at third-year undergraduate students majoring in intelligent construction. Through theoretical explanations, students will gain a deep understanding of the basic concepts, principles, and analysis methods of fluid dynamics, master tensor operations, basic equations of viscous fluid dynamics, and boundary layer theory. Additionally, they will acquire knowledge of flow stability, transition from laminar to turbulent flow, basic theories of turbulence, and basic theories of intelligent wind engineering. Students will also develop the ability to use mathematical tools to describe and solve problems, thereby making progress in their respective research and engineering fields. They will be able to further engage in relevant scientific and engineering research, and lead the development of intelligent mechanics and intelligent construction industries.

default.zh: 本课程围绕土木工程结构材料的腐蚀与防护基础理论、主要方法与实用技术展开。主要内容包括：腐蚀与防护的意义；金属材料腐蚀学原理，如腐蚀电化学基本概念、电极反应动力学等；金属材料腐蚀主要类型，如全面腐蚀、局部腐蚀、应力腐蚀等；腐蚀的测量方法，如非电化学测量方法、电化学阻抗谱、稳态和瞬态测量方法等；腐蚀监/检测器件，如腐蚀感知元件及应用、腐蚀监测网络等；材料腐蚀防护方法，如材料设计主动防腐、电化学防腐、电驱动综合防腐等；材料腐蚀基因组工程简介。
default.en: This course focuses on the fundamental theory, major methods and operative techniques of the corrosion and protection in the field of civil engineering materials. The main contents include: significance of corrosion and protection; corrosion mechanism of the metal corrosion, e.g., the basic concepts of electrochemical corrosion, electrode reaction dynamics, etc; typical corrosion types of the metal corrosion, e.g., general corrosion, local corrosion, stress corrosion, etc; corrosion measurement methods, e.g., non-electrochemical methods, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, steady and transient measurement methods, etc; corrosion monitoring and detection devices, e.g., corrosion sensing elements and application, corrosion monitoring networks, etc; corrosion prevention and protection techniques, e.g., anti- corrosion materials design, electrochemical corrosion protection, synthesis corrosion protection driven by the electric field, etc; introduction of the material corrosion genomic engineering.

default.zh: 本课程为具有现代特色的土木工程专业土木工程材料方向的专业课程,本课程内容是新时代条件下土木工程相关专业本科生应掌握的重要专业知识。本课程重点讲授工程材料可持续化的内涵、特点、主要内容及发展趋势；资源、环境与材料的相互关系；材料生态化评价基本理论及工程材料可持续性评价的基本原理及方法；工程材料可持续性发展的策略、设计思想；土木工程材料可持续性发展与评价等内容。培养学生在明确工程材料可持续性发展内涵及特点的基础上，具备掌握其可持续性评价基本原则及方法的基本能力。
default.en: This course is a professional course in the direction of civil engineering materials for civil engineering majors with modern characteristics.The content of this course is the important professional knowledge that undergraduates of civil engineering related majors should master under the conditions of the new era. This course focuses on the concept, characteristics, main content and development trend of engineering materials sustainability; The interrelationship between resources, environment and materials; The basic theory of material ecological evaluation and the basic principle and method of engineering material sustainability evaluation; Strategies and design ideas of sustainable development of engineering materials; Sustainable development and evaluation of civil engineering materials. Train students to master the basic principles and methods of sustainability evaluation on the basis of clarifying the connotation and characteristics of sustainable development of engineering materials.

default.zh: 《岩土工程勘察》是城市地下空间工程专业的一门重要专业技术基础课。通过本课程的学习，能够使城市地下空间工程专业的学生全面了解岩土工程勘察的基本知识、基本步骤、基本原理和基本方法，初步掌握工程地质勘察和岩土工程勘察的基本原则、工作程序以及勘察手段等。
default.en: Geotechnical engineering investigation is an important basic technical course of civil engineering (geotechnical and underground engineering). Through the study of this course, students majoring in civil engineering (geotechnical and underground engineering) can fully understand the basic knowledge, basic steps, basic principles and basic methods of geotechnical engineering investigation, and preliminarily master the basic principles, working procedures and survey methods of engineering geological investigation and geotechnical engineering investigation.

default.zh: 本课程是城市地下空间工程专业本科生课程体系中一门重要的专业选修课。主要研究地下工程常遇到的风险及灾害的分类、特点，并提供相应的解决应对策略。通过学习本课程可以使学生了解地下空间工程环境与灾害的基本概念以及防灾减灾的基本目标、原理、措施，掌握地下空间工程相关的各类灾害成因与防治，具备分析灾害孕育、形成、发展过程与提出有效防灾减灾措施的能力。 本课程的先修课程有《地下空间规划与建筑》和《工程岩体力学》等，本课程的特点是理论密切联系工程实践，能够培养学生的逻辑思维能力，并且能够灵活地利用本课程的内容去分析工程实际问题，提高学生综合运用所学知识解决复杂工程问题的能力。为学生今后从事地下工程防灾与减灾工作奠定一定的基础，以便提供社会需要的具备全面专业素养的工程技术型人才。 本课程安排于微积分、土力学、基础工程A等先修基础课程之后，共计32学时，2.0学分。通过闭卷考试的形式考核学生的学习情况，以百分制打分。
default.en: This course is an important professional optional course in the curriculum system of urban underground space engineering major. This paper mainly studies the classification and characteristics of common risks and disasters encountered in underground engineering, and provides corresponding solutions and countermeasures. Through learning this course, students can understand the basic concepts of underground space engineering environment and disasters as well as the basic objectives, principles and measures of disaster prevention and reduction, master the causes and prevention of various disasters related to underground space engineering, and have the ability to analyze the breeding, formation and development process of disasters and propose effective measures for disaster prevention and reduction. The pre-courses of this course include Underground Space Planning and Construction and Engineering Rock Mechanics, etc. The feature of this course is that theories are closely connected with engineering practice, which can cultivate students' logical thinking ability and flexibly use the content of this course to analyze practical engineering problems, so as to improve students' ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge to solve complex engineering problems. It will lay a foundation for students to engage in disaster prevention and mitigation work of underground engineering in the future, so as to provide engineering and technical talents with comprehensive professional quality that the society needs. This course is arranged after calculus, soil mechanics, foundation engineering A and other basic courses, with a total of 32 credit hours and 2.0 credits. This course examines student learning through a close-book examination and scores by percentage grading system.

default.zh: 《地下工程灾害超前辨识》课程主要研究岩土地下工程灾害超前预测、超前支护和超前评估等新理论和新技术，并学习复杂环境下岩土工程超前识别最前沿的科学理论和工程装备核心技术，并在大数据智能处理的基础上定量研究工岩土工程施工与地下空间维护的安全性与稳定性。在地下工程灾害超前辨识课程教学中通过基本概念、基本理论、基本方法的教学，培养学生发现问题、分析问题和解决岩土地下工程灾害超前辨识问题的能力。为今后从事生产实际工作和科学研究打好基础。
default.en: The course "Early Identification of Underground Geohazards" mainly studies the new theories and technologies of geotechnical underground engineering disaster advance prediction, support and assessment, and learns the cutting-edge scientific theories and core technologies of geotechnical engineering advance identification under complex environment. On the basis of intelligent processing of big data, the safety and stability of geotechnical engineering construction and underground space maintenance are quantitatively studied. Through the teaching of basic concepts, basic theories and basic methods in the course of underground engineering disaster advance identification, students' ability to find, analyze and solve the problems of geotechnical underground engineering disaster advance identification is cultivated. Lay a good foundation for practical work and scientific research in the future.

default.zh: 地铁与轻轨交通是土木工程城市地下空间工程本科专业选修课，本课程的任务和目的是使学生了解和掌握城市地铁和轻轨轨道交通所涉及的线路规划、建筑设计、结构设计、施工工艺及灾害控制等方面的专业知识。本课程的主要内容包括：（1）绪论，主要介绍城市轨道交通历史、概况和发展方向；（2）地铁与轻轨交通线路规划与设计，包括城市轨道交通系统的构成、客流预测方法、交通线网规划和线路设计；（3）轨道工程，包括轨道结构、车辆基本结构与轨道几何形位、无咋轨道与道岔、轨道建造与施工；（4）地铁与轻轨车站与车辆基地设计，包括城市轨道交通车站与换乘设计、车辆基地设计；（5）城市轨道交通供电与信号系统，包括轨道交通供电系统、轨道交通通信与信号系统；（6）城市轨道交通系统运营，包括运营规划概念与内容、客流量等级划分与能力配置、设备选型。通过本课程的学习，培养具有综合建筑、结构、轨道、线路、管理多学科交叉知识，从事地铁和轻轨交通规划、设计和施工的复合型人才。
default.en: Subway and Light Track Transportation is an optional course of the specialty for the undergraduate students majored in Urban Underground Space Engineering. The objective and aim of this course is to help the students understanding the professional knowledge concerned about the subway and light track engineering, including the route planning, architectural and structural design, construction technology and hazard control et al. The main contents of this course include: Introduction about the history and development tendency of subway and light track engineering; Subway and light rail transit line planning and design, including the composition of the urban rail transit system, passenger flow prediction methods, traffic network planning and line design; Track engineering, including track structure, basic vehicle structure and track geometry, track and turnouts, track building and construction; Subway and light rail station and vehicle base design, including urban rail transit station and interchange design, Vehicle base design; Urban rail transit power supply and signaling system, including rail transit power supply system, rail transit communication and signaling system; Urban rail transit system operation, including the concept and content of operation planning, passenger flow class division and capacity configuration, equipment selection. Through the study of this course, we cultivate compound talents with comprehensive knowledge of multi-disciplinary cross-discipline of architecture, structure, track, line and management, who are engaged in the planning, design and construction of subway and light rail transportation.

default.zh: 《地下工程施工》课程是城市地下空间工程专业学生的一门选修专业课。主要内容包括土方工程施工、深基础工程施工和隧道工程施工。本课程在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，对学生进行地下工程专业工程技术方面的培养，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事城市地下空间工程工作打下基础，因此在城市地下空间工程专业的教学中占有重要的地位。
default.en: This is an elective professional course for students majoring in Urban Underground Space Engineering.The main contents include earthwork construction, deep foundation construction and tunnel engineering construction.In the teaching process, it comprehensively uses the knowledges and skills learned in prerequisite courses to train the students on underground engineering technology. It lays a foundation for further study on the relevant major courses and being engaged in urban underground space engineering career in the future.So it plays an important role in the teaching of Urban Underground Space Engineering.

default.zh: 本课程是土木工程专业核心课程之一，是一门实践性很强的工程类专业课程，包含了从事土木工程工作必备的专业知识，也是学生在土木工程专业方向上进一步学习和发展的基础。 本课程的教学目的是通过讲授土木工程施工技术，使学生掌握土木工程施工主要环节的技术方法、措施和有关的施工计算方法，了解相关的施工规范和规程，掌握主要分部分项工程施工的质量控制要点和安全措施，以保证土木工程项目施工的质量、安全目标的实现。通过本课程的学习，学生可以掌握土木工程施工技术的基本知识和技术方法，了解土木工程施工技术的发展现状和趋势，具备从事施工技术应用、开发和技术交流的基本技能，为学生将来从事土木工程施工、管理和开发工作乃至科学研究工作奠定良好的基础。 本课程的特点是理论计算少，实践操作性强，文字叙述多，内容涉及面广，章节关联性较弱。因此在课堂教学中，教师不仅要按照教材章节抓住土木工程施工工艺流程的主线，而且要面向质量和安全控制目标，强调质量的过程控制。在此基础上，教师需要密切联系工程实际，培养学生应用土木工程施工技术知识，分析、解决工程的实际问题的能力。此外，要尽力培养学生严谨求实的工作态度和不断进取、努力创新的钻研精神；培养学生自主学习和终身学习的意识，结合所学内容不断学习和解决问题的能力；让学生具备社会责任感和使命感，拥有全球视野，适应社会发展变化，服务于祖国建设的能力。
default.en: This course is one of the core courses of civil engineering. It is a highly practical engineering professional course, which contains the necessary professional knowledge for civil engineering work. It is also the basis for students to further study and develop in the direction of civil engineering major. The teaching purpose of this course is to teach civil engineering construction techniques, so that students can master the technical methods, measures and related construction calculation methods of civil engineering construction, and understand the relevant construction norms and regulations. Master the key points of quality control and safety measures in the construction of civil engineering projects in order to ensure the quality of civil engineering projects and the realization of safety objectives. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic knowledge and technical methods of civil engineering construction technology, understand the development status and trends of civil engineering construction technology, and possess the basic skills in the application, development and technical exchange of construction technology. For the future of students To be engaged in civil engineering construction, management and development, and even scientific research to lay a good foundation. This course is characterized by less theoretical calculation, strong practical operation, more narration, wide coverage and weak relevance of chapters . Therefore, in the classroom teaching, teachers should not only grasp the main line of the civil engineering construction process according to the textbook chapter, but also face the quality and safety control objectives and emphasize the process control of the quality. On this basis, teachers should closely connect with engineering practice, cultivate students' ability to apply civil engineering construction technology knowledge, analyze and solve engineering practical problems and attach importance to engineering quality and safety professional accomplishment.

default.zh: 工程信息管理与数字建造课程旨在顺应工程建设领域信息化与数字化发展的趋势，推动学生形成跨学科的综合能力。随着工程项目复杂度的不断提升，信息技术在工程管理中的作用日益突出。本课程通过理论与实践相结合的教学，使学生能够系统理解工程信息管理的核心思想，掌握数字化建造的主要方法与工具，从而为未来适应行业发展需求打下坚实基础。 本课程是一门融合计算机科学、管理科学、系统理论与工程管理知识的交叉学科。通过学习，学生应能够： ？ 掌握工程管理信息系统的基本概念、理论与方法； ？ 具备工程项目全寿命周期信息的获取、协同与共享管理能力； ？ 掌握BIM及相关数字化建造技术的基本原理和应用方法； ？ 形成利用现代信息技术开展工程信息化管理与项目管理的能力。 课程的学习不仅帮助学生夯实BIM与工程信息化管理的理论与实践基础，还将培养其运用现代信息技术开展工程项目管理与科学研究的综合素养，为将来从事工程信息管理与数字建造相关工作奠定坚实的理论支撑和实践能力。
default.en: The course Construction Information Management and Digital Fabrication is designed to meet the growing trend of informatization and digitalization in the construction industry, fostering students’ interdisciplinary competencies. As engineering projects become increasingly complex, the role of information technology in engineering management has become ever more significant. By integrating theory with practice, this course enables students to systematically understand the core concepts of engineering information management and to master the key methods and tools of digital construction, thereby laying a solid foundation for adapting to future industry developments. This course is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates knowledge from computer science, management science, systems theory, and engineering management. Upon completion, students are expected to: ？ Master the fundamental concepts, theories, and methods of engineering management information systems; ？ Acquire the ability to manage information across the entire life cycle of engineering projects, including information collection, collaboration, and sharing; ？ Understand the fundamental principles and application methods of BIM and related digital construction technologies; ？ Develop the capability to apply modern information technologies to engineering informatization management and project management. The study of this course not only strengthens students’ theoretical and practical foundation in BIM and engineering information management but also cultivates their comprehensive competence in applying modern information technologies to project management and scientific research. Ultimately, it provides the essential theoretical support and practical skills required for future work in engineering information management and digital construction.

default.zh: 《建设项目HSE管理》课程是工程管理专业本科生的专业方向选修课程。通过学习，使学生掌握建设工程中的职业健康管理、安全管理与环境管理相关的理论与方法，熟悉职业健康安全与环境管理方面的标准与规范，培养学生具有职业健康与安全、环境管理意识，具备分析论证和解决建设工程实践中职业健康安全与环境管理问题的能力。
default.en: HSE Management of Construction Projects is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in Engineering Management. Through learning, students will master the theories and methods related to occupational health management, safety management and environmental management in construction projects, be familiar with the standards and norms of occupational health and safety and environmental management, cultivate students' awareness of occupational health and safety and environmental management, and have the ability to analyze, demonstrate and solve occupational health and safety and environmental problems in construction projects.

default.zh: 城市开发与更新课程主要研究城市发展模式及方法、城市土地开发、城市基础设施建设、城市住宅开发、城市综合体发展模式与方法、城市新区开发产业策划、新城开发模式与方法、城市更新概念内涵与外延、城市更新政策法律框架、城市更新干系人博弈、城市更新模式与方法。在教学过程中综合运用所学知识进行城市开发与更新管理的基本训练，为学生从事城市开发与城市更新策划工作打下基础。课程培养目标可以分解为：掌握城市发展模式定位与综合分析方法，城市土地开发的区位、功能、经济分析方法，城市基础设施项目开发与融资模式分析，城市住宅开发模式分析，城市综合体发展模式分析，城市新区开发产业策划，新城开发模式与方法，城市更新基本概念与政策法律框架，城市更新模式与方法等知识；具有应用城市开发与更新知识分析问题的能力；具有综合应用城市开发与更新原理和要点解决复杂城市管理问题的素质。
default.en: The course of Urban Development and Renewal mainly studies urban development models and methods, urban land development, urban infrastructure construction, urban residential development, urban complex development models and methods, urban new area development industry planning, new city development models and methods, urban renewal concept connotation and extension, urban renewal policy and legal framework, urban renewal stakeholder game, and urban renewal models and methods. In the teaching process, comprehensively apply the knowledge learned to provide basic training in urban development and renewal management, laying the foundation for students to engage in urban development and renewal planning work. The training objectives of the course can be divided into: mastering the positioning and comprehensive analysis methods of urban development models, the location, function, and economic analysis methods of urban land development, the analysis of urban infrastructure project development and financing models, the analysis of urban residential development models, the analysis of urban complex development models, the planning of urban new area development industries, the development models and methods of new towns, the basic concepts and policy legal frameworks of urban renewal, Knowledge of urban renewal models and methods; Having the ability to apply urban development and updating knowledge to analyze problems; Having the ability to comprehensively apply the principles and key points of urban development and renewal to solve complex urban management problems.

default.zh: 房地产估价是理论与实践高度统一的课程，开发训练学生的实际估价能力及分析判断市场的眼力（将积极引导学生学习巴菲特、索罗斯等投资大师）是课程的根本任务。估价实例和估价算例将贯穿课程的终始，课程将围绕各种各样的居住地产、商业地产和特殊地产的一般和特殊估价问题系统地阐述房地产估价的基本理论和估价方法。具体内容主要包括：房地产估价的基本概念、房地产价格种类及其影响因素、房地产估价原则等基础理论知识；市场比较法、收益法、成本法、剩余法、路线价法、基准地价修正法及其他估价方法等常用的房地产估价方法。通过本课程的学习使学生透彻掌握房地产估价的基本理论和基本方法，熟悉房地产估价业务中的各种参数、数据的分析确定方法与思路，具备一定的实际操作能力，能够独立从事住宅评估业务，掌握商业、办公、宾馆、厂房及其它特殊房地产估价的一般知识，培养学生初步形成对房地产价格的直觉判断能力，初步具备分析某个城市或区域房地产价格变动趋势的基本能力。
default.en: Real estate valuation is a course with a high degree of integration of theory and practice, and the fundamental task of the course is to develop and train students' actual valuation ability and ability to analyze and judge the market (which will actively guide students to learn investment masters such as Buffett and Soros). Valuation examples and valuation examples will run through the end of the course, and the course will systematically explain the basic theory and valuation methods of real estate valuation around a variety of general and special valuation issues for residential real estate, commercial real estate and special real estate. The specific content mainly includes: the basic concept of real estate valuation, the types of real estate prices and their influencing factors, the principles of real estate valuation and other basic theoretical knowledge; Commonly used real estate valuation methods such as market comparison method, income method, cost method, surplus method, route price method, benchmark land price revision method and other valuation methods. Through the study of this course, students can thoroughly master the basic theories and basic methods of real estate valuation, be familiar with the analysis and determination methods and ideas of various parameters and data in real estate valuation business, have certain practical operation ability, be able to independently engage in residential appraisal business, master the general knowledge of commercial, office, hotel, factory and other special real estate valuation, cultivate students' ability to initially form an intuitive judgment of real estate prices, and initially have the basic ability to analyze the trend of real estate price changes in a city or region.

default.zh: 本课程是工程管理专业（房地产模块）的核心专业课，以开发项目全程策划为主线，教学内容包括：房地产开发的基本概念、基本程序、开发项目定位与规划设计、招标与投标、土地开发、基础设施开发建设、开发项目营销及管理等内容。通过本课程的学习，全面培养学生的市场调查、分析、预测的实际能力；针对具体的开发项目，能够独立形成清晰的策划思路，在动态的市场环境下能够判断项目的市场前景；熟练掌握项目的客户定位、产品定位、形象定位、文化定位、园林景观定位，项目定价方法及价格策略，项目市场推广的基本原理和方法，项目销售管理及控制的方法与技巧等。课程的基本教学目标如下：熟悉房地产项目开发管理与全程策划的关键节点知识；掌握房地产开发项目定位、规划设计、定价及营销的基本思路和方法；具备房地产市场研究的初步能力，具备房地产项目开发管理的基本能力。
default.en: This course is the core professional course of the Engineering Management major (Real Estate Module), with the overall planning of development projects as the main thread. The teaching content includes: basic concepts and procedures of real estate development, project positioning and planning design, bidding and tendering, land development, infrastructure development and construction, development project marketing and management, etc. Through the study of this course, comprehensively cultivate students' practical abilities in market research, analysis, and prediction; Capable of independently forming clear planning ideas for specific development projects, and able to determine the market prospects of the project in a dynamic market environment; Proficient in customer positioning, product positioning, image positioning, cultural positioning, landscape positioning, project pricing methods and pricing strategies, basic principles and methods of project marketing promotion, and methods and techniques of project sales management and control. The basic teaching objectives of the course are as follows: familiarize oneself with the key node knowledge of real estate project development management and overall planning; Master the basic ideas and methods of real estate development project positioning, planning and design, pricing, and marketing; Possess preliminary abilities in real estate market research and basic abilities in real estate project development and management.

default.zh: 城市与房地产经济学包括城市经济学和房地产经济学。城市经济学研究城市经济发展规律，，房地产经济学研究房地产经济活动、经济现象、经济规律。 通过本课程的学习使学生理解城市经济学原理；熟悉城市规模、城市增长及城市化的内涵；理解城市土地租金、掌握土地利用模式；了解城市经济的内部结构、空间结构和经济关系；掌握城市经济运行规律以及城市发展战略；了解房地产业在国民经济中的地位和作用；掌握房地产市场的供求及运行机制；了解房地产经济周期的一般理论，掌握房地产经济周期的形成机制；了解投机与泡沫的一般理论，熟悉房地产投机与泡沫的度量与预警；熟悉我国现行房地产政策；能够运用房地产经济学的基本原理解释房地产行业的经济现象，理解政府有关的法规政策。
default.en: Urban and real estate economics includes urban economics and real estate economics. Urban economics studies the laws of urban economic development, and real estate economics studies real estate economic activities, economic phenomena, and economic laws. Through the study of this course, students can understand the principles of urban economics; Familiar with the connotation of urban scale, urban growth, and urbanization; Understand the basic content of urban land rent and master land use models; Understand the internal structure, spatial structure, and economic relationships of the urban economy; Mastering the laws of urban economic operation and urban development strategies; Understand the position and role of the real estate industry in the national economy; Master the supply and demand and operational mechanism of the real estate market; Understand the general theory of real estate business cycle, and master the formation mechanism of real estate business cycle; Understand the general theory of speculation and foam, and be familiar with the measurement and early warning of real estate speculation and foam; Familiar with the current real estate policies in China; Able to apply the basic principles of real estate economics to explain the economic phenomena in the real estate industry, and understand relevant government regulations and policies.

default.zh: 量子力学是是物理学的分支学科，与相对论一起被认为是现代物理学的两大基本支柱，许多物理学理论和科学，如原子物理学、固体物理学、核物理学和粒子物理学以及其它相关的学科，均以量子力学为基础。以研究微观物质（比如原子、分子，电子等）运动规律为基本出发点建立的量子力学，开辟了人类认识客观世界运动规律的新途径，开创了物理学的新时代。量子力学作为智慧专业的选修课，不仅可以培养学生扎实的理论基本功，同时开阔了学生视野，为开展创新与交叉研究奠定坚实的基础。本课程重点介绍量子力学（非相对论）的基本概念、基本原理与基本方法。课程共六个章节。第一章为绪论:量子物理学发展史，量子力学研究的对象及特点，波粒二象性。第二章为波函数和薛定谔方程: 波函数的统计解释，态迭加原理，薛定谔方程，粒子流密度和粒子数守恒定律，定态薛定谔方程，一维无限势阱，线性谐振子，势垒贯穿。第三章为量子力学中的力学量:表示力学量的算符，动量算符和角动量算符，氢原子，厄密算符本征函数的正交性，算符与力学量的关系，算符的对易关系。第四章为态和力学量的表象：态的表象，算符矩阵表示，量子力学公式的矩阵表述，么正变换，狄拉克符号。第五章为微扰理论:非简并定态微扰理论。第六章为自旋与全同粒子:电子自旋。
default.en: Quantum mechanics is considered as one of the two foundations of modern physics. Many physical theories and sciences, such as atomic physics, solid state physics, nuclear physics, particle physics and other related disciplines, are based on it. Quantum mechanics is the established by study of the laws of motion of microscopic substances (such as atoms, molecules, electrons, etc.), which opened a new way for humans to understand the objective world. Quantum mechanics can provide a solid foundation for innovation and cross disciplinary research. This course focuses on introducing the basic concepts, principles, and methods of quantum mechanics. The course consists of six chapters. The first chapter is an introduction: the development history of quantum physics, the objects and characteristics of quantum mechanics research, and wave particle duality. The second chapter is about wave function and Schrodinger equation: statistical interpretation of wave function, state superposition principle, Schrodinger equation, conservation law of particle flow density and particle number, stationary Schrodinger equation, one-dimensional infinite potential well, linear harmonic oscillator, barrier penetration. The third chapter is about the mechanical quantities in quantum mechanics: operators representing mechanical quantities, momentum operators and angular momentum operator, hydrogen atoms, the orthogonality of Hermite operator eigenfunctions, the relationship between operators and mechanical quantities, the commutation relationship between operators. The fourth chapter is the representation of states and mechanical quantities. Chapter 5 is about Approximation methods (Perturbation theory and Variational principle). Chapter 6 is about spin and identical particles.

default.zh: 弹性力学课程是在修完理论力学、材料力学等课程之后的一门重要的力学课程，是固体力学的重要分支。弹性力学是研究在外荷载作用下的位移、应变和应力分布规律并分析变形体的强度和刚度的一门理论课程，也称为弹性理论。弹性力学课程以能量原理为基础，针对材料在小变形线弹性范围内的变形，分析各种结构或构件在弹性阶段的应力和位移，校核其强度和刚度。该课程它是从事变形固体力学的研究人员及从事结构强度分析的工程技术人员必备的基础知识，同时为进一步学习塑性力学，断裂力学和复合材料力学等固体力学分支学科提供必要的理论基础和研究方法。 该课程的教学任务是培养学生全面地掌握弹性力学的基本概念、基本原理及处理弹性力学问题的基本方法，了解线弹性经典问题的计算方法和基本解答，提高学生的分析和计算能力，培养学生的逻辑思维能力；并培养学生利用弹性力学方法来研究分析一般结构在外力作用下的变形、内力分布与承载能力，进一步提高学生对工程结构或工程材料的强度、刚度稳定性等实际力学问题的分析解决能力，使其满足建筑、机械、化工、航天等工程领域工作人员的基本科研素质需求。
default.en: On the base of theoretical mechanics and mechanics of materials, theory of elasticity is one of the most important mechanics courses for undergraduate students whose major are intelligent construction, this course is a component of solid state mechanics. The course will focus on the displacement of an elasticity body under external force based on the strain and stress distributions. By analysis of the displacements, strain and stress, the strength and stiffness materials are studied for particular applications. This course is a not only a fundamental for researches in the field of solid mechanics, but also very useful for technicians related with strength of structures. For students, this course will provide the basic skills and methods for a further research on plastic mechanics, fracture mechanics and composites mechanics, and so on. The objective of this course is to make undergraduate students grasp the basic concept, basic theory and basic method of theory of elasticity, undergraduate students should understand the calculation method and the basic solution of the classical problem of linear elasticity, and improve their analytical calculation capability and logical thinking capability. At the same time, students should can analyze the deformation, distribution of internal force and carrying capacity of general structure by using theory of elasticity, and should further improve their personal capabilities of solving practical mechanical problems of strength, rigidity and stability for engineering structure and engineering materials. This can meet the basic quality of scientific research of working person in the field of building, machinery, chemical industry, and aerospace.

default.zh: 本课程以概率论和图论为基础，讲解概率图模型原理，包括概率图模型的表示方法、概率图模型的推理算法和概率图模型的学习理论。在此基础上，介绍概率图模型在人工智能、机器学习和计算机视觉等领域的应用。通过本门课程的学习，使学生深入了解并掌握概率图模型的原理，并具备使用概率图模型解决实际问题的能力；掌握概率图模型国内外研究现状以及未来的发展方向与趋势，能进一步从事相关研究工作。
default.en: Based on the probability theory and graph theory, this course explains the principles of probabilistic graphical models, including the representation of probabilistic graphical models, inference algorithms of probabilistic graphical models and the learning theory of probabilistic graphical models. On this basis, the applications of probabilistic graphical models in the fields of artificial intelligence, machine learning and computer vision will be introduced. Through the study of this course, students will have an in-depth understanding of the principles of probabilistic graphical models and the ability to use probabilistic graphical models to solve practical problems; they will master the current status of domestic and international research on probabilistic graphical models and the future development directions and trends, and be able to further engage in related research work.

default.zh: 《结构健康监测与智能运维》是哈尔滨工业大学土木工程学院智能建造专业本科生的限选课。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握结构健康监测和智能运维基本技术，了解波动监测技术，光纤光栅传感器原理，掌握模态参数识别的基本方法，掌握结构损伤识别、模型修正与安全评定、结构智能运维的机器学习和深度学习基本方法。理论讲解结合课后作业，加深对课堂理论教学内容的理解，使学生对结构健康监测有一定深度的理解。
default.en: This course is the distributional elective course of intelligent construction major. Through the learning of this course, the students will understand the basic theories and techniques of structural health monitoring and intelligent operation and maintenance. The main contents are: basic concepts of signal processing, damage detection based on guided wave using PZT sensors, scouring monitoring, sensing theory of optical fiber, modal analysis, frequency and time domain based modal parameters identification methods, modal parameters-based damage identification, structural model updating and safety assessment, machine learning and deep learning in structural health monitoring. To enhance the student understanding of the theory of structural health monitoring, necessary classroom tests and homework will be carried out in the course.

default.zh: 随着全球气候变化的不断加剧，人们对新能源和环保的需求日益增长。中国政府提出了建设“海洋强国”和实现“双碳目标”的战略目标，旨在通过加快海上新能源开发和海上交通基础设施建设，推动经济转型升级和可持续发展。在这一背景下，确定海洋环境荷载对于保障海洋工程结构的安全具有重要意义。海洋环境的特殊性质，如海浪、海流等，给海洋工程的设计、建设和维护带来了极大的挑战。因此，海洋环境荷载的准确计算和分析是保证海洋工程结构安全稳定的重要前提。 本课程主要涉及基础波浪理论和海洋结构水动力计算方法。通过课程学习，学生可以掌握海洋环境的特征，包括海浪的频率、波高、波长等参数；了解基础的波浪理论，掌握波浪的传播、反射、折射等基本原理；学习柱体结构波浪力计算方法，熟悉柱体受波荷载的特征和计算方法。同时，课程还将初步介绍浅水波浪理论、结构水动力数值计算方法和商业软件等内容。学生将学会如何利用数学模型和计算机模拟等技术手段，对海洋工程结构在不同海洋环境下的荷载进行准确计算和分析。通过课程学习，学生将具备基本的海洋工程设计和分析能力，为海洋工程的实际应用奠定基础。
default.en: With the increasingly severe global climate change, the demand for new energy and environmental protection is growing. The Chinese government has proposed strategic goals of building a "marine power" and achieving "dual-carbon targets", aiming to promote economic transformation and sustainable development by accelerating the development of offshore new energy and the construction of maritime transportation infrastructure. In this context, the accurate calculation and analysis of marine environmental loads are of great significance for ensuring the safety of ocean engineering structures. The unique characteristics of marine environments, such as waves and currents, bring great challenges to the design, construction, and maintenance of ocean engineering. Therefore, the accurate calculation and analysis of marine environmental loads are important prerequisites for ensuring the safety and stability of ocean engineering structures. This course mainly involves the basic wave theory and hydrodynamic calculation methods for marine structures. Through the course, students can grasp the characteristics of marine environments, including the parameters of wave frequency, wave height, and wavelength. They can understand the basic wave theory and master the basic principles of wave propagation, reflection, and refraction. They will learn the wave force calculation method for cylindrical structures and be familiar with the characteristics and calculation methods of wave loads on cylindrical structures. At the same time, the course will also introduce shallow water wave theory, structural hydrodynamic numerical calculation methods, commercial software, and other contents. Students will learn how to use mathematical models and computer simulation techniques to accurately calculate and analyze the loads on ocean engineering structures under different marine environments. Through the course, students will have the basic ability to design and analyze ocean engineering, laying a foundation for the practical application of ocean engineering.

default.zh: 智慧施工前沿技术课程主要包含智能化时代背景、数字建造理论与技术、智慧工地基本理论与技术、基于数字化的全过程建造技术、基于政府视角的数字监管技术、超高层建筑智能建造技术-以上海中心为例、跨海大桥智能建造技术-以港珠澳大桥为例、装配式建筑智能建造技术-以装配式地铁为例8个课程章节内容。 智能化时代背景课程主要讲授智能化的概念、智能化在现代土木工程行业的应用、了解智能化时代背景下涉及的大数据、物联网、互联网、智慧城市、人工智能、BIM技术、数字经济等相关领域的基本概念和基础知识；数字建造理论与技术课程主要讲授数字建造的概念、了解数字建造涉及的新技术、新材料、新工艺，具有精确、高效、高性能的创新建造模式；智慧工地基本理论与技术课程主要讲授智慧工地的基本概念和基础知识，了解智慧工地应用平台整体解决方案的应用与实施；基于数字化的全过程建造技术课程主要讲授数字化的概念以及现代土木工程行业数字化施工建造技术，了解基于BIM+的数字化建造模式；基于政府视角的数字监管技术课程主要讲授数字监管的概念和数字监管技术的基础知识，了解建立数据驱动的智慧监管理念，探索数字赋能的新型监管模式，提升智慧加权的政府监管效能；超高层建筑智能建造技术、跨海大桥智能建造技术、装配式建筑智能建造技术课程分别以上海中心、港珠澳大桥、装配式地铁为例讲授智能化时代背景下数字建造技术、智慧工地技术、数字监管技术、装配式建造技术等智慧施工前沿技术在实际项目案例中的具体实施应用。 通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解现代土木工程智慧建造领域的相关政策与国内外发展趋势，掌握现代土木工程施工建造过程中应用的前沿的、先进的智慧施工技术与智慧建造理念。
default.en: The courses of smart construction frontier technology mainly include the background of intelligent era, digital construction theory and technology, basic theory and technology of smart construction site, digital based whole process construction technology, digital supervision technology based on government perspective, intelligent construction technology of super high-rise buildings - taking Shanghai center as an example, intelligent construction technology of sea crossing bridges - taking Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge as an example Intelligent construction technology of prefabricated building - take prefabricated subway as an example, 8 course chapters. The background course of the intelligent era mainly teaches the concept of intelligence, the application of intelligence in the modern civil engineering industry, and the basic concepts and knowledge of big data, the Internet of Things, the smart city, artificial intelligence, BIM technology, digital economy and other related fields involved in the background of the intelligent era;The course of Digital Construction Theory and Technology mainly teaches the concept of digital construction, understands the new technologies, materials, and processes involved in digital construction, and has innovative construction models that are precise, efficient, and high-performance;The basic theory and technology course of smart construction sites mainly teaches the basic concepts and knowledge of smart construction sites, and understands the application and implementation of the overall solution of the smart construction site application platform;The course on digitalization based full process construction technology mainly teaches the concept of digitalization and digital construction technology in the modern civil engineering industry, and understands the digital construction mode based on BIM+;The course on digital regulatory technology from a government perspective mainly teaches the concept of digital regulation and the basic knowledge of digital regulatory technology, understands the establishment of data-driven smart regulatory concepts, explores new regulatory models empowered by digital technology, and enhances the efficiency of smart weighted government regulation;The courses of intelligent construction technology for super high-rise buildings, intelligent construction technology for cross sea bridges, and intelligent construction technology for prefabricated building take Shanghai center, Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge, and prefabricated subway as examples to teach the specific implementation and application of digital construction technology, smart site technology, digital supervision technology, prefabricated construction technology and other cutting-edge technologies of smart construction in the context of the intelligent era in actual project cases. Through the study of this course, students can understand the relevant policies and domestic and international development trends in the field of smart construction in modern civil engineering, and master the cutting-edge and advanced smart construction technologies and concepts applied in the construction process of modern civil engineering.

default.zh: 本课程围绕计算机视觉原理及其在土木工程中的应用，主要内容包括：计算机视觉基础知识、神经网络和卷积神经网络基本原理、图像分类模型和算法、目标检测模型和算法、语义分割模型和算法、自注意力机制和预训练大模型、对比学习模型和算法、生成式模型和算法、三维建模原理和方法、土木工程计算机视觉研究进展。本课程通过讲授计算机视觉基本知识、概念方法和模型算法，使同学们掌握计算机视觉的基本原理和理论方法，介绍土木工程计算机视觉的发展现状、前沿科学问题和研究方法，使同学们了解和掌握解决土木工程计算机视觉问题的基本范式和技术手段。通过学科交叉将先进计算机视觉方法与传统土木工程基础知识结合，学会运用现代高新技术解决土木工程问题，了解现代计算机视觉技术强化下的土木工程新前景，激发科学研究热情，培养创新思想、科学素养与学术思维，配合启发式教学，培养团队合作与领导力、思辨与表达能力。
default.en: This course revolves around the principles of computer vision and its application in civil engineering. The main content includes: basic knowledge of computer vision, fundamental principles of neural networks and convolutional neural networks, image classification models and algorithms, object detection models and algorithms, semantic segmentation models and algorithms, self-attention mechanisms and pre-training large models, contrastive learning models and algorithms, generative models and algorithms, principles and methods of 3D modeling, and recent advances of computer vision in civil engineering. By teaching the basic knowledge, conceptual methods, and model algorithms of computer vision, this course enables students to master the basic principles and theoretical methods of computer vision. By introducing the development status, frontier scientific issues, and research methods of computer vision in civil engineering, this course also enables students to understand and master the basic paradigms and technical means to solve computer vision issues in civil engineering. Through interdisciplinary integration, advanced computer vision methods are combined with conventional civil engineering basics, through which students can learn to use modern high-tech to solve civil engineering problems, understand the new prospects of civil engineering under the enhancement of modern computer vision technology, stimulate enthusiasm for scientific research, cultivate innovative thought, scientific literacy, and academic ability, and enhance the abilities of teamwork, leadership, critical thinking, and expression skills by heuristic teaching.

default.zh: 岩土工程监测是地下工程类专业非常重要的核心专业课，是后续地下建筑结构设计、地下通风、地下防火、地下设备等专业课的基础，在培养学生地下空间结构设计综合分析能力、综合设计能力具有重要作用。 本课程在讲授岩土工程原位测试的基础上，主要讲授地基与基础、桩基静力、动力测试、深基坑开挖测试与监测、隧道检测与监测、沉桩对环境的影响、特殊土地区岩土检测与监测、探地雷达检测技术等岩土工程的测试方法、传感器特性、系统构成、以及测试数据的基本处理和应用。培养学生复核设计理论、验证解决复杂岩土工程结构新方法的综合分析与突发事故的处理能力，提高学生地下空间工程系统知识的综合应用能力，启迪学生创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 通过本课程的学习，学生除了掌握岩土工程基本力学性能的原位测试原理和技术、重要岩土工程测试参数计算的基本概念、岩土工程专用传感设备研究热点、发展趋势及应用前景之外，还将掌握防水、防渗、沉降、软弱不良地层等地下工程及特殊岩土工程处理的测试与监测系统设计、结构分析方法，初步具备分析和解决地下空间复杂岩土工程安全性系统综合分析能力，并培养学生运用信息、智能等交叉知识与技术，激发学生研发地下结构测试新设备的兴趣和独立工作能力个团队意识。
default.en: Geotechnical engineering monitoring is is one of the core professional course of underground space engineering and/or engineering-like speciality which is base of follow-up major courses such as foundation structure design and underground structure ventilation and fireproofing and devices. It is very important for training student comprehensive analysis and integrated design for complicated geotechnical engineering. Basing of instructing of in-situ testing of geotechnical engineering, the main teaching of this course will emphasize of subgrade and foundation and pile-foundation static and dynamic testing and deep excavation measurement and monitoring and tunnel testing and monitoring and environment effect caused by pile sinking and special soil area geotechnical detection and surveying and GPR probing technique whose measurement methods and sensors properties and system component and acquisition data processing and their handling and application will be discussed with students. This course aims to help students to have a thorough comprehension of geotechnical engineering review design theoretics and verifying the novel method to solve complex geotechnical engineering comprehensive analysis ability and solving of emergence problem. Addition to above hopes we also want to improve college student innovation capability and consciousness and fulfil the index points which are established to support the specialty learning. Participating in this course, except for knowing well of geotechnical engineering essential mechanical property in-situ testing theory and technology and important geotechnical engineering measurement parameter computation basic concepts and geotechnical engineering dedicated sensors research focus and developing and application prospect, students will be require to grasp of leakage and percolation e and sedimentation and soft and/or bad earth underground engineering and special section processing testing and monitoring system design and structural analysis method. Students have the possession of disposing of underground space geotechnical structural engineering systemic capacity and be able to apply information and intelligence technology and interdiscipline knowledge to deal with the underground structure testing and proving and monitoring so as to edify student’s creative project competence and interesting about research original device which will be used for geotechnical engineering and its underground structure security and optimal procedure.

default.zh: 高强钢结构因其强度高、设计尺寸和自重小的优势，在大跨、高耸和重载工程中具有良好的应用前景，其推广应用有助于推动建筑行业的可持续发展和双碳目标达成。《高强钢结构性能与设计》是与新加坡南洋理工大学赵欧副教授共同建设的一门专业选修课。主要面向已有《钢结构》、《钢结构设计》、《钢结构稳定理论》等课程基础的本科生。通过本课程的学习，使学生较全面地了解高强钢材料的力学性能，掌握高强钢焊接截面残余应力分布特征、各类型高强钢构件的承载力计算方法以及高强钢结构的基本连接构造。课程一共分为4个部分，每个部分4个学时，总计16个学时；课程学分为1.0；课程的主要考核方式为课程结束后的学习报告。
default.en: High strength steels have superior strength-to-weight ratios in comparison with normal strength steels, enabling structural members to be designed with smaller cross-section sizes and lighter self-weights. The use of high strength steels thus has a good prospect in construction of long-span, high-rise and heavy-duty structures, facilitating the achievement of sustainable development and dual carbon goals in civil engineering. Developed in collaboration with Associate Professor Zhao Ou from Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, “Behaviour and Design of High Strength Steel Structures” is an elective course tailored for undergraduate students who have completed prerequisite courses “Steel Structures”, “Design of Steel Structures” and “Stability of Steel Structures: Theory and Design”. This course aims to provide students with a thorough understanding of the behaviour and design of high strength steel structures, including the material properties of high strength steels, residual stresses of high strength steel welded sections, design of different types of high strength steel structural members and design of high strength steel connections. The course is divided into 4 parts, with each part lasting 4 class hours. Finally, this course is scheduled for a total of 16 class hours, with a credit value of 1.0; The main assessment method for this course is the study report after the course ends.

default.zh: 人工智能（AI）已广泛应用于土木工程，如自动化汽车、建筑和桥梁退化检测、优化设计和施工管理等。本课程将介绍尖端的人工智能算法及其在土木工程领域各方面的应用。
default.en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been widely applied in Civil Engineering, such as Automated Cars, Building and Bridge Deterioration Detection, Optimized Design and Construction Management, etc. This class will introduce cutting-edge AI algorithms and their application in all aspects of the civil engineering field.

default.zh: 专业思维训练A是一门讲授基于力学课程，学习思维训练思想、技巧、方法的专业课程，课程第一章主要介绍力学发展简史，近代力学发展中突出贡献的巨匠以及重要方法节点，第二章介绍数学思维训练方法，包括假设、比较、符号化、类比、转化、分类、集合、数形结合、统计、极限、代换、可逆、化归、数学模型、整体思想方法等；第三、四章介绍发散思维和收敛思维、横向思维和纵向思维、正向思维和逆向思维、求同思维和求异思维的概念，包括整体思考法、多屏幕法，解决发明问题的基本技巧，以及运用创新思维方法去解决技术问题。第五章介绍科学思维概念，揭示科学研究对象的性质、结构和功能、掌握揭示事物间的因果关系、揭示事务变化的规律性能能力和方法，；第六章介绍力学思维特点、力学思维的自然语言、几何语言、数学语言、力学建模思维方法，第七章介绍工程思维训练，使得学生树立工程技术观、工程系统观、工程社会观、工程生态观、工程伦理观和工程文化观概念，并掌握工程写作技能、沟通技能，具备工程实践能力以及反应性思维、发现性思维，形象思维、抽象思维、辩证逻辑思维、创造性思维的能力。通过本课程的学习，学生应该能熟练掌握各种专业思维训练的方法和技巧。
default.en: Major Thinking Training A is a professional course that teaches the thinking training ideas, techniques, and methods based on mechanics. The first chapter of the course mainly introduces the brief history of mechanics, the outstanding masters who made significant contributions to modern mechanics, and important method nodes. The second chapter introduces mathematical thinking training methods, including assumptions, comparisons, symbolization, analogy, transformation, classification, sets, graphical representation, statistics, limits, substitution, reversibility, reduction, mathematical models, and the overall thinking method. The third and fourth chapters introduce the concepts of divergent thinking, convergent thinking, lateral thinking, and vertical thinking, including the overall thinking method and the multi-screen method, the basic skills for solving inventive problems, and the use of innovative thinking methods to solve technical problems. The fifth chapter introduces the concept of scientific thinking, revealing the nature, structure, and function of scientific research objects, the ability and method of revealing the causal relationship between things and the laws of change of affairs. The sixth chapter introduces the characteristics of mechanics thinking, the natural language, geometric language, mathematical language, and mechanics modeling thinking method of mechanics thinking. The seventh chapter introduces engineering thinking training, enabling students to establish the concepts of engineering technology view, engineering system view, engineering social view, engineering ecological view, engineering ethical view, and engineering cultural view, and to master engineering writing skills, communication skills, and engineering practical ability, as well as reactive thinking, discovery thinking, imaginative thinking, abstract thinking, dialectical logical thinking, and creative thinking ability. Through the study of this course, students should be able to master various professional thinking training methods and techniques.

default.zh: 专业思维训练B是土木工程类专业学生的选修课程。该课程可以让学生掌握数学，物理和化学与土木工程和材料科学交叉学科的应用。从宏观，中观和微观层次了解工程与科学的关系。从实际案例中探索新理论，再把新理论应用于工程中。目的是培养学生使用理论知识的能力。 在教学过程中综合运用前沿学术案例，生活案例和工程案例验证某些重要科学理论，总结案例中出现的科学规律，强化基础理论的同时，达到灵活应用的目的。通过实例培养创新思维，学生学会从材料原理和机理的角度分析制品破坏的原因，利用材料原理制造新材料和工艺，在实践中提升科学理论水平。学生具有解决生产和科技实际问题的能力。
default.en: Major Thinking Training B is an elective course for civil engineering students. Students should master the application of mathematics, physics and chemistry at the intersection of civil engineering and materials science in this course. Students can understand the relationship between engineering and science at the macro, meso, and micro levels. Explore new theories from practical cases and then apply them to engineering. The course aim is to develop students' ability to use theoretical knowledge. In the teaching process, academic cases, life cases and engineering cases are comprehensively used to verify some important scientific theories, summarize scientific laws that appear in the cases, strengthen the basic theories, and achieve the purpose of flexible application. Through examples, students learn to analyze the causes of product failure from the perspective of material principles and mechanisms, use material principles to manufacture new materials and processes, and improve the level of scientific theories in practice. Students have the ability to solve practical problems in production and science and technology.

default.zh: 专业思维训练C是一门面向工程管理专业本科生的选修课程，旨在培养学生的统计分析和数据处理能力。课程主要内容包括应用统计的基本概念和数据分类、统计资料的收集与整理、总量指标和相对指标的计算与解释、概率与统计量的基本原理、参数估计与假设检验的方法、方差分析和回归分析的应用、以及时间数列和指数分析的方法。课程开设的目的是为了使学生掌握统计学基本理论和方法，培养数据收集、分析和解释能力，以便在工程管理中进行科学决策和问题解决。
default.en: Professional Thinking Training C is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in construction management, which aims to cultivate students' statistical analysis and data processing capabilities. The main contents of the course include the basic concepts of applied statistics and data classification, the collection and organization of statistical data, the calculation and interpretation of total indicators and relative indicators, the basic principles of probability and statistics, parameter estimation and hypothesis testing methods, the application of variance analysis and regression analysis, and the methods of time series and index analysis. The purpose of the course is to enable students to master the basic theories and methods of statistics, and cultivate the ability to collect, analyze and interpret data so as to make scientific decisions and solve problems in engineering management.

default.zh: 主要讲解日本正在积极推动的混凝土二氧化碳减排放技术的最新研究成果及动向，包括自修复混凝土、减碳混凝土、3D打印混凝土、蓄电混凝土等，介绍日本国内对于AI在混凝土方面的应用技术，针对哈尔滨特有的严寒气候特色，讲解日本的寒冷地混凝土施工技术。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the latest research results and trends of concrete carbon dioxide emission reduction technology that Japan is actively promoting, including self-healing concrete, carbon reducing concrete, 3D printed concrete, electric storage concrete, etc. It also introduces the application technology of AI in concrete in Japan, and focuses on the unique cold climate characteristics of Harbin to explain Japan's cold ground concrete construction technology.

default.zh: 课程是面向土木工程相关专业的大三本科生开设的前沿交叉学科课程。课程以传统计算力学中矩阵位移法、有限单元法为基础，融合人工智能（AI）技术，旨在让学生掌握结构分析计算的相关概念和方法，解决复杂工程结构分析中的困难，课程结合理论知识与案例分析，培养具备“计算+力学”双引擎驱动能力的复合型工程人才。 具体内容包括： 1.矩阵位移法的理论基础，求解连续梁、刚架、桁架的分析方法以及编程介绍 2.有限元方法的理论基础、杆系问题的单元划分及整体刚度矩阵的构造等内容。 3.工程结构分析的典型案例。
default.en: The course is a cutting-edge interdisciplinary course designed for junior undergraduate students majoring in civil engineering and related fields. Based on the matrix displacement method and finite element method in traditional computational mechanics, the course integrates artificial intelligence (AI) technology, aiming to enable students to master relevant concepts and methods of structural analysis and calculation, and solve difficulties in complex engineering structural analysis. The course combines theoretical knowledge with case analysis to cultivate composite engineering talents with dual-engine driving capabilities of "computation + mechanics". The specific content includes: 1. The theoretical basis of the matrix displacement method, analysis methods for solving continuous beams, rigid frames, and trusses, as well as an introduction to programming 2. The theoretical basis of the finite element method, element division for frame problems, and the construction of the overall stiffness matrix, etc. 3. Typical cases of engineering structural analysis.

default.zh: “人工智能助力下的城市建筑结构更新改造”课程是一门理论与实际相结合，多学科综合性的创新研修课。培养本科生的科研素养和科学精神为目标，通过授课教师在实际工程中的科研工作为依托，从科研成果中凝练出教学内容。课程将结合城市更新工程案例与实践经验，深入剖析人工智能在城市建筑更新全生命周期（涵盖设计、施工、运营等阶段）中的关键技术和应用方法。本课程将通过理论教学、实际工程案例演示、实验等教学环节，使学生理解城市更新的背景及需要解决的问题，掌握建筑结构性能升级、加固改造的基本原则与方法；熟悉建筑结构可靠性检测鉴定、重大工程健康监测的基本知识。本课程突出科学性、实践性和创新性，进而激发学生对土木方向深入研究的兴趣，并引导学生进行研究性学习；培养学生分析问题、解决问题的能力，提高学生对专业知识的理解能力和灵活运用能力，注重解决工程实际工程问题，增强专业素质与创新意识。
default.en: The course of Building Upgrading and Renovation in Urban Renewal is an innovative training course that combines theory and practice with multidisciplinary synthesis. It aims to cultivate undergraduates' research literacy and scientific spirit, and to condense the teaching content from the research results through the lecturers' scientific research work in actual projects. Through theoretical teaching, demonstration of actual engineering cases, hands-on experiments and other teaching links, this course will enable students to understand the background of urban renewal and the problems that need to be solved, to master the basic principles and methods of upgrading the performance of building structures, strengthening and renovation; and to familiarize with the basic knowledge of the reliability testing and appraisal of building structures and the health monitoring of major projects. This course highlights the scientific, practical and innovative nature, which in turn stimulates students' interest in in-depth study in the direction of civil engineering and guides them to conduct research studies; cultivates students' ability to analyze and solve problems, improves students' understanding of professional knowledge and ability to flexibly apply them, focuses on solving practical engineering problems in engineering, and enhances their professional qualities and sense of innovation.

default.zh: 《AI+工程结构抗震》是计划面向土木工程专业、城市地下空间工程专业、智能建造专业本科生的一门专业方向选修课程。课程依托智能化教学平台构建知识体系，着重培养学生两方面的核心能力：一是科学认知地震灾害特征及工程抗震关键问题的专业素养，二是运用人工智能技术解决工程实际问题的创新思维。课程内容聚焦人工智能技术原理及其在工程抗震领域的创新应用，通过构建“理论学习-实践应用-科研启蒙”三位一体的教学模式，着力培育学生跨学科思维与学术探究能力。教学过程中注重以真实工程问题为牵引，引导学生在解决复杂抗震课题的过程中深化专业认知，既为后续专业学习奠定坚实基础，也为未来从事工程抗震与智能技术融合领域的工作储备关键能力，在相关专业人才培养体系中具有重要支撑作用。
default.en: The AI+Seismic Design of Buildings course is a professional elective designed for undergraduate students pursuing degrees in Civil Engineering, Urban Underground Space Engineering, and Intelligent Construction. This course utilizes an intelligent teaching platform to establish a comprehensive knowledge system, with a primary focus on developing students' core competencies in two key areas: first, professional literacy in the scientific understanding of earthquake disaster characteristics and critical issues related to engineering seismic resistance; and second, innovative thinking in the application of artificial intelligence technology to address practical engineering challenges.

default.zh: 近年来，智能信息技术逐渐成为各大工程领域的创新动力和重点发展方向，旨在建立物理实体与数字对象之间的同步孪生。在结构工程领域，数字化、智能化转型需求贯穿了工程全寿命周期，包括设计、建造、运维等各个阶段，成为推动产业升级与技术革新的核心动力。以机器学习、深度学习为核心的新一代人工智能技术凭借其卓越的计算效力与广泛的场景适用性，受到研究者与工程师的密切关注。这些技术不仅能够大幅提升结构设计的精准度与效率，在施工阶段实现智能管理和质量控制，还能在运维阶段通过实时监测与智能决策，实现对结构健康状态的精准评估与预测，有效延长工程使用寿命，降低运维成本。为了培养学生的通识素养，充实学生在人工智能领域与结构工程领域的专业知识，提升学生利用人工智能技术解决土木工程问题的能力，本课程采用“讲-学-用”的新模式,系统性地引领学生探索机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉等人工智能前沿技术的原理和实践，帮助学生入门人工智能基础编程和了解人工智能的工程应用。课程将对机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉等人工智能方法进行详细介绍，并对这些人工智能在工程中的应用展开详细讨论。
default.en: In recent years, intelligent information technology has gradually become the innovation propulsion and key development direction in engineering fields, aiming to establish a synchronous twin between physical entities and digital objects. In structural engineering field, the demand for digital and intelligent transformation runs spans the entire project lifecycle, including design, construction, operation and maintenance, and becomes the core driving force to promote industrial upgrading and technological innovation. The new generation of artificial intelligence (AI) technology with machine learning and deep learning as the core has attracted close attention from researchers and engineers due to its excellent computing efficiency and wide applicability. These technologies can not only greatly improve the accuracy and efficiency of structural design, achieve intelligent management and quality control in the construction stage, but also realize accurate assessment and prediction of structural health status through real-time intelligent monitoring in the operation and maintenance stage, effectively extending the service life of the project and reducing cost. To improve the professional knowledge of students in the field of AI and engineering structure, this course adopts the new mode of "lecture–learn–application" to systematically guide students to explore the principles and practices of AI technologies such as machine learning, deep learning and computer vision, and to help students get started with AI programming and understand the application of AI in engineering. This course will provide an in-depth introduction to AI methods and the application of AI in engineering.

default.zh: 《机器视觉智能监测》课程通过学科交叉方式将先进的机器视觉方法与土木工程领域结构健康监测的实际广泛工程需求紧密结合，采用工业相机作为结构健康监测的测量工具，使用机器视觉方法处理工业相机采集的结构变形图像，以获得结构位移或应变等变形信息的一门人工智能视觉监测课程。通过该课程培养学生运用人工智能视觉技术解决结构健康监测领域存在的远距离非接触实时监测的瓶颈问题，通过工程案例解析和试验训练来培养土木工程领域复合型高端人工智能人才，以满足土木、交通、航天、材料、机械、能源等众多领域采用非接触方式监测结构变形的迫切需求。该课程内容主要包括相机标定方法、结构面内变形视觉监测方法、结构三维变形立体视觉监测方法、结构表观缺陷三维重建评定方法、结构表面全场变形监测方法，并列举出每种视觉监测方法相应的具体工程监测案例，如桥梁挠度变形监测、风机六自由度运动监测、混凝土表观缺陷三维重建评定、山体滑坡变形全场监测、大型体育场馆结构健康监测系统设计、传感器选型及监测系统开发等案例，同时提供相机标定试验及各种视觉监测方法教学试验训练。
default.en: Intelligent Monitoring based on Machine Vision is one of the optional courses for undergraduate students whose major are Civil Engineering. On the base of University physics, undergraduate students need to further study the course of Intelligent Monitoring based on Machine Vision. Through practical teaching, undergraduate students need to familiar with the error analysis and data processing, machine vision measurement method, and grasp the basic theories and experimental skills. This lays foundation for further learning the professional research and experimental measurement for graduation thesis of students. The objective of the course is to develop that students grasp the working principles and experimental skills of intelligent monitoring based on machine vision, and measure structural deformation parameters such as stress, strain, displacement, surface flaw, etc. for satisfying the demands of non-contact measurement of structural deformations in civil engineering, transportation, aerospace, materials, etc. The main contents include: experimental data processing, image acquisition, the principles and applications of 2D and 3D structural deformation measurement method based on monocular vison, the principle and application of 3D reconstruction method of structural surface flaws and the full-field deformation monitoring method.

default.zh: 弹性力学是土木工程和工程力学的专业基础课，是在理论力学和材料力学基础上进一步学习弹性力学的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法，了解线弹性经典问题的计算方法和基本解答，分析各种结构或构件在弹性阶段的应力和位移，校核其强度和刚度，提高分析和计算能力，培养学生的逻辑思维能力，利用弹性力学方法研究和掌握分析一般结构在外力作用下的变形、内力分布与承载能力的方法，以及为进一步研究工程结构的强度、刚度稳定性等力学问题并解决实际工程或材料中的力学问题的能力，为学习有关专业课程打好初步的弹性力学基础。
default.en: Elasticity Theory is a fundamental course for students majoring in civil engineering or engineering mechanics. It is a continue course focusing on the elastic properties of materials after the study of mechanical theory and materials mechanics. The main intention of the study of elasticity theory is to promote the understanding of the concepts and formulation of elasticity problems, and analyzing results obtained from commercial tools such as ANSYS and ABAQUS. Problem solving skills and techniques related with civil engineer or materials are relegated to an adjunct role with a solid basic of elasticity theory.

default.zh: 课程共计32学时，包括24学时课题讲授，8学时实验教学。通过课堂讲授和实验教学使学生掌握建筑结构、构件的静力、动力实验的加载方法、测量方法、试验方法、数据分析方法，掌握建筑结构试验的模型相似理论、结构试验数据误差分析及解决方法，为今后从事科学实验研究工作提供必要的基础知识。 课程的主要内容包括： (1) 模型相似(6h) (2) 试验加载方法(4h) (3) 数据测量方法(6h) (4) 数据处理与误差分析(2h) (5) 静载试验方法(1h) (6) 动载试验方法(1h) (7) 结构抗震试验方法(4h) (8) 动力特性识别(4h，试验) (9) 拟动力试验(4h，试验)
default.en: In this course, basic experimental methods will be introduced 24h, and two experimental tests will be conducted with 8h in the lab. This course is intended to introduce students to static and dynamic experimental methods, loading systems, instrumentation, seismic testing method, similitude and dimensional analysis, data processing, etc. The course covers aspects of static and structural dynamics problems. The course provides an overview of laboratory work and is complemented with several “hands-on” applications in laboratory using testing and computing equipment. The students will get acquainted with the following subjects: (1) Similitude, modeling, and dimensional analysis (6h) (2) Loading systems(4h) (3) Instrumentation(6h) (4) Data quality, Errors, and Processing(2h) (5) Static testing method(1h) (6) Dynamic testing method(1h) (7) Seismic testing methods(4h) (8) Dynamic performance identification (4h，experiment) (9) Pseudo-dynamic test (4h, experiment)

default.zh: 根据哈尔滨工业大学关于印发《哈尔滨工业大学2022版本科生培养方案修订指导性意见》的通知，要求学生毕业前至少必修1门海外专家课程，该类课程包括海外专家共建本科课程，国际暑期学校中海外专家课程，学院、学部、校区认定的其他海外课程或活动等。该门课程为学院、学部、校区认定的其他海外课程或活动等学分认定所设置。
default.en: According to the notice issued by Harbin Institute of Technology regarding the revision of the "Guiding Opinions on the 2022 Undergraduate Education Curriculum Plan of Harbin Institute of Technology", students are required to complete at least one overseas expert course before graduation. Such courses include jointly established undergraduate courses by overseas experts, overseas expert courses in international summer schools, and other overseas courses or activities recognized by the college, faculty, and campus. This course is designed for the credit recognition of other overseas courses or activities recognized by the college, faculty, and campus.

default.zh: 认识实习是教学计划中的一个重要实践性教学环节，是理论联系实际，增强感性认识的必要途径。是全面贯彻教育方针，培养学生实践能力和独立工作能力的一项重要措施。本实习是土木工程学院所有学生必经的教学环节。
default.en: Cognitive practice is the link between theory and practice in the teaching plan. It is the necessary way to enhance the perceptual knowledge. It is the comprehensive implementation education policy. It is to train students' practical ability and work independently ability. The cognitive practice is a key teaching link for the students of the civil engineering.
