default.zh: 针对土木工程中量大面广应用的整体式单向板肋梁楼盖，开展设计计算，将使土木工程专业本科生巩固课堂相关章节所学的内容，强化整体式单向板肋梁楼盖设计思路和方法的认识，熟悉整体式单向板肋梁楼盖结构布置及构造，学会查阅设计资料，掌握整体式单向板肋梁楼盖的规定，使其在设计计算、理解规范、提高专业绘图能力等得到有效训练，最终熟练掌握整体式肋梁楼盖的结构布置方法、设计计算和绘制结构施工图。
default.en: The design and calculation for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are carried out, which are applied widely and abundantly in civil engineering. It can make undergraduates of civil engineering obtain more skills. For example, the contents of the relevant sections in class are consolidated; the understanding of design ideas and methods for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams is strengthened; the layout and construction of integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are more familiar; the method of consulting the design data is studied; and the specifications of the integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are mastered. Besides, undergraduates can obtain effective trainings on studying the design and calculation, understanding the specifications and enhancing the ability of professional drawing. Finally, some skills for undergraduates are mastered expertly, including the structural layout method, design and calculation and the ability of drawing structure construction drawings for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams.

default.zh: 《基础工程B课程设计》是土木工程专业的一门必修专业课。基础工程课程设计是学生在完成教学计划规定的课程学习后，所进行的一个重要的实践教学球节，是继课堂教学、实验教学等环节之后的一个综合性较强的教学阶段。通过课程设计使学生受到设计方法的初步训统。本课程教学目的是培养学生的设计能力，经过本课程的学习，要求学生能够掌握大、中型建筑物的地基基础设计方法。 本课程的特点是理论密切联系工程实践，能够培养学生的逻辑思维能力，并且能够灵活地利用本课程的内容去分析工程实际问题，提高学生综合运用所学知识解决复杂工程问题的能力。 本课程充分利用模型、实物、多媒体软件，增强学生感性分析，以培养学生空间形象思维能力、工程实践应用能力和创新能力。
default.en: The design of foundation engineering B is a compulsory course in civil engineering. The design of the basic engineering course is an important practice teaching ball festival, which is a comprehensive and strong teaching stage after the teaching of classroom teaching and experimental teaching. Through the course design, the students are subject to the preliminary training of the design method. The purpose of this course is to develop the students' design ability, which requires students to master the foundation of large and medium-sized buildings. The characteristics of this course are the practice of close contact engineering of theory, can cultivate students' logical thinking ability, and can use the content of this course to analyze the practical problems of the project, and improve the ability of students to solve complex engineering problems. This course should make full use of models, physical, multimedia software, enhance student perceptual analysis, and cultivate students' spatial image thinking ability, engineering practice application ability and innovation ability.

default.zh: 针对土木工程中各类厂房常用的单层工业厂房，开展设计计算，使土木工程专业本科生巩固课程相关章节所学的内容，强化领会厂房结构设计思路和方法的认识，熟悉单层厂房的结构型式及构造，学会查阅设计资料，掌握厂房设计的规定，是其在设计计算、理解规范、提高专业绘图能力等获得有效训练，最终熟练掌握单层工业厂房的设计计算与构造、预制结构构件设计要点与构造、支撑体系的布置与连接、绘制排架结构和基础施工图。
default.en: The design and calculation for single-story industrial buildings are carried out, which are applied commonly in civil engineering. It can make undergraduates of civil engineering obtain more skills. For example, the contents of the relevant sections in class are consolidated; the understanding of design ideas and methods for single-story industrial buildings is strengthened; the structural type and construction of single-story industrial buildings are more familiar; the method of consulting the design data is studied; and the specifications of the single-story industrial buildings are mastered. Besides, undergraduates can obtain effective trainings on studying the design and calculation, understanding the specifications and enhancing the ability of professional drawing. Finally, some skills for undergraduates are mastered expertly, including the structural design, calculation and construction for single-story industrial buildings, design features and construction for prefabricated structural element, arrangement and connection for support system and drawing construction drawings for bent structure and foundations.

default.zh: 钢结构课程设计是土木工程专业建筑工程方向的实践类课程之一，是继钢结构基本原理和钢结构设计等理论课之后开设的一门专业实践型课程。要求学生综合运用钢结构基本原理和设计方法，完成某典型钢结构工程（钢屋架结构、钢平台结构或其他结构形式）的体系选择、结构布置、内力计算、构件设计、节点设计和施工图纸的绘制工作。培养学生在钢结构工程设计方面的分析问题和解决问题的能力，使学生能够独立完成普通钢结构工程的设计，为学生从事钢结构设计、制造、安装等工作奠定基础。
default.en: The course of Engineering Design of Steel Buildings is one of the practical course for civil engineering undergraduates following the course of Basic Principle of Steel Structures and Design of Steel Structures. Using the basic principles and design specifications, students should complete the design for a typical steel building (steel roof structure, steel platform structure, or other appointed steel structures). The detailed content includes system selection, structural arrangement, element force calculation, design of steel members, design of connections and plot construction drawings. The engaging on this course can cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve problems in steel structure engineering design, and form students’ ability to complete the design work independently. This course can also build foundations for the students to engage in the future works of structural design, fabrication and construction about steel structures.

default.zh: 智慧施工组织设计是建筑工程专业十分重要的教学实践环节，通过本课程设计加深学生对《土木制图基础》、《土木工程材料》、《房屋建筑学》、《土力学》、《基础工程B》、《混凝土与砌体结构》、《土木工程施工》等教学内容及相关课程知识的感性理解。 智慧施工组织设计促使学生深入学习建设工程项目施工现场管理的基本理论，掌握工程项目进度控制、质量控制的基本方法，掌握实际施工的工艺流程、施工顺序与施工方法，为学生建立起管理建设工程项目知识、技术和方法的基本体系，同时进一步巩固和深化理解各专业基础课与专业课程的教学内容，能够结合生产实习等实践，加强实践性教学环节的基本训练，培养学生综合运用所学知识解决实际问题的基本能力。
default.en: Smart construction organization design is a very important teaching practice link in the field of construction engineering. Through the design of this course, students will deepen their perceptual understanding of the teaching content and related course knowledge such as "Fundamentals of Civil Engineering Drawing", "Civil Engineering Materials", "Housing Architecture", "Soil Mechanics", "Foundation Engineering B", "Concrete and Masonry Structures", "Civil Engineering Construction" and other teaching contents. Intelligent construction organization design prompts students to deeply learn basic theories of construction site management of construction projects，master the basic methods of project progress control and quality control, the process flow, construction sequence,construction methods of actual construction, establish a basic system of knowledge, technology and methods for students to manage construction projects. It could further consolidates and deepen the understanding of the teaching content of basic courses and professional courses of various majors, strengthen the basic training of practical teaching links in combination with practical practices. Cultivate students' basic ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 生产实习是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生能够理论联系实际，巩固所学的理论知识，并为后续课程的学习增加感性知识。在生产实习中，学生深入工地现场等实践场所，了解工作环境，熟悉本工程施工图纸，学习本工程的施工组织设计、监理规划，学习施工项目管理的基本内容、工作流程及相关管理方法。希望通过生产实习，使学生受到工程项目管理人员的基本训练，了解工程项目的先进建造方式和现代化管理方法，培养和提高学生的学习能力、应用知识能力、工程实践能力、使用现代工具能力、沟通协调能力。
default.en: Production practice is an important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan. Its purpose is that students associate the theory knowledge with the practice, deepen their theoretical knowledge, and increase perceptual knowledge for civil engineering. During the production practice, students go into the construction site or other practical places, understand the working situation, get familiar with the project drawings, learn the construction organization design and supervision planning of the project, and learn the basic content, working process and related management methods of construction project management. By production practice, students can receive basic training of engineering project management, know advanced construction methods and modern management methods of engineering projects, and students' learning ability, knowledge application ability, engineering practice ability, use of modern tools and communication and coordination ability can be cultivated and improved.

default.zh: 毕业实习是土木工程专业重要的实践性教学环节。实习内容包括参观已建/在建典型及特色工程，听取专题讲座，结合毕业设计题目有针对性地收集已建或在建工程资料，完成专题报告、撰写实习日记、完成实习报告。通过实习，使土木工程专业本科生深化认识国内外土木工程的最新发展与前景，巩固专业知识，应用所学专业解决实际问题，系统理解土木工程的规划、设计、施工及管理等工作，认识工程师和工程管理人员职责，培育专业精神，为毕业设计的开展及毕业后尽快适应专业技术或管理工作奠定基础，强化土木工程本科生热爱专业，立志土木工程发展，致力于祖国现代化建设和两个一百年宏伟目标的实现。
default.en: Graduation internship is a significant practical teaching link for civil engineering undergraduates. The internship includes visiting typical and special projects already built or under construction, attending special lectures, collecting information on projects in combination with the graduation projects, completing special reports, writing internship diaries and completing internship reports. Through the internship, civil engineering undergraduates can deepen their understanding of the latest development and prospect of both domestic and overseas civil engineering, consolidate their professional knowledge, apply their professional knowledge to solve practical problems. Furthermore, they can systematically understand the process of planning, design, construction and management of civil engineering and cultivate the responsibilities and professionalism of engineers and project managers, which would help them to lay the foundation for the graduation design and adapt to professional technical or management work as soon as possible after graduation. The aim is to strengthen the passion of undergraduate civil engineering students for their majors, motivate their determination to develop civil engineering, which inspire them to devote themselves to the modernization of the motherland and the realization of the Two Centenary Goals.

default.zh: 建筑工程方向本科生、土木菁华班本科生的毕业论文（设计）培养学生综合运用所学基础课、专业基础课、专业课等方面的知识，分析和解决实际工程设计问题的能力。通过毕业设计的全过程训练，促进学生更加深入地理解所学的基本理论，进一步深化和扩展所学知识，提高自学能力和独立解决问题的能力，提高团队合作、与专业人员沟通交流的能力。 在毕业论文（设计）课程教学过程中，通过调查研究、查阅资料、请教教师，进一步深化拓宽所学的基础知识、专业知识。毕业论文（设计）题目应保证基本工程训练，掌握本专业的基本功，并增强学生设计和计算，以及绘制工程图纸的能力。通过毕业设计，加强同学之间以及师生之间的学术交流，培养学生的合作精神、创新精神。毕业论文（设计）将作为学生毕业及学位资格认定的重要依据，作为衡量高等教育质量和办学效果的重要评价内容。对于能力较强、有余力的学生可在工程设计的基础上，加深加宽，做一些提高性研究专题，完成毕业设计计算书。
default.en: Graduation project of undergraduate students in the field of architectural engineering and civil engineering is to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve practical problems by comprehensively using the knowledge of basic courses, professional basic courses and professional courses. Through the whole design process of graduation project, students can understand the basic theory more deeply, deepen and expand their knowledge, and improve their ability of self-study and independent problem-solving. Through investigation and research, consulting materials and consulting teachers, students can further deepen and broaden the basic knowledge and professional knowledge learned. The topic of graduation project should ensure basic engineering training, master the basic skills of the major, and enhance the students' ability of theoretical analysis, design and calculation, and drawing engineering drawings. Through the graduation project, strengthen the academic exchanges between students and teachers, and cultivate students' spirit of cooperation and innovation. Graduation project will be an important basis for students to evaluate graduate and degree qualification, as well as an important content to measure the quality of higher education and school running effect. For the students with stronger ability, they can do some research topics in the graduation project, then complete their graduation thesis.

default.zh: 针对土木工程中量大面广应用的整体式单向板肋梁楼盖，开展设计计算，将使土木工程专业本科生巩固课堂相关章节所学的内容，强化整体式单向板肋梁楼盖设计思路和方法的认识，熟悉整体式单向板肋梁楼盖结构布置及构造，学会查阅设计资料，掌握整体式单向板肋梁楼盖的规定，使其在设计计算、理解规范、提高专业绘图能力等得到有效训练，最终熟练掌握整体式肋梁楼盖的结构布置方法、设计计算和绘制结构施工图。
default.en: The design and calculation for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are carried out, which are applied widely and abundantly in civil engineering. It can make undergraduates of civil engineering obtain more skills. For example, the contents of the relevant sections in class are consolidated; the understanding of design ideas and methods for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams is strengthened; the layout and construction of integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are more familiar; the method of consulting the design data is studied; and the specifications of the integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are mastered. Besides, undergraduates can obtain effective trainings on studying the design and calculation, understanding the specifications and enhancing the ability of professional drawing. Finally, some skills for undergraduates are mastered expertly, including the structural layout method, design and calculation and the ability of drawing structure construction drawings for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams.

default.zh: 《基础工程B课程设计与电算分析》是土木工程专业土木菁华班本科生的一门必修专业课。本课程教学目的是培养学生的设计能力，经过本课程的学习，要求学生能够掌握大、中型建筑物的地基基础设计方法及相应的设计内容，能够了解一种基础结构设计的电算软件或掌握一种数值分析方法。
default.en: “Foundation Engineering B Course Design and Computer Analysis " is a compulsory professional course for the students majoring in Civil Engineering (Civil Engineering Elite Class). The purpose of this course is to cultivate students' design ability. After the study of this course, students are required to master the foundation design method and design content of large and medium-sized buildings. Furthermore, the students should be proficient in commonly used designing software or a numerical analysis method.

default.zh: 针对土木工程中广泛应用的装配式混凝土结构，装配式混凝土工艺设计，将使土木工程专业材料方向本科生巩固课堂相关所学的知识内容，强化装配式混凝土构件制备工艺设计思路和方法的认识，熟悉装配式混凝土构件工艺流程布置及构造，掌握装配式混凝土制备工艺的规定，使其在设计、理解规范、提高专业绘图能力等得到有效训练，最终熟练掌握装配式混凝土构件制备工艺过程的布置方法、设计计算和绘制工程施工图。
default.en: For the widely used prefabricated concrete structures in civil engineering, the design of prefabricated concrete technology will enable undergraduate students majoring in materials in civil engineering to consolidate the relevant knowledge learned in the classroom, strengthen their understanding of the design ideas and methods of prefabricated concrete component preparation technology, become familiar with the layout and structure of prefabricated concrete component process flow, master the regulations of prefabricated concrete preparation technology, and enable them to design, understand specifications Improve professional drawing skills and receive effective training, ultimately mastering the layout methods, design calculations, and drawing of engineering construction drawings in the preparation process of prefabricated concrete components.

default.zh: 生产实习是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践教学环节，目的是使学生了解和掌握有关土木工程材料方面的生产知识，加深和丰富专业课程教学内容，提高学生在生产实际中的调查研究、观察和解决实际问题的能力。通过深入工作现场，在生产第一线进行观摩实践，使学生进一步掌握相关生产工艺、生产管理、产品质量检测、控制等方面的知识，同时了解企业的产品结构和经营战略，增长经验并开拓思路，培养对工程实际问题的见解，为后续专门知识的学习和参加社会生产打基础。
default.en: The course “Production Practice” is an important practical teaching component in undergraduate education plan. The purpose is to enable students to understand and master production knowledge related to civil engineering materials, deepen and enrich teaching content of professional courses, and improve students' ability to investigate, observe and solve practical problems in production practice. By working in the production frontline and observing practices at the work site, students further develop their understanding of production processes, production management, product quality testing, control, and other related knowledge. Meanwhile, they also gain knowledge about the enterprise's product structure and business strategy, broaden their experience and develop their thinking, cultivate insights into practical engineering problems, and lay a foundation for subsequent specialized knowledge learning and participation in social production.

default.zh: 毕业实习是本专业十分重要的实践教学环节，主要目的在于进一步巩固学生在课堂学到的理论知识，并做到理论知识与生产实践相结合，对学生能否更好地完成毕业论文具有重要作用。要求学生能够理论联系实际，验证、巩固、深化及综合运用课堂所学的基础理论和专业知识，进一步学习新型建筑材料生产工艺和组织管理方面的实际知识，对新型建筑材料在建筑工程中的应用有更全面的了解和深刻的认识；能将所学的理论知识灵活应用到生产实际中去，培养学生分析问题、解决实际问题的独立工作能力；详细了解我国目前混凝土制品及新材料的生产工艺和技术水平，广泛收集有关毕业论文和设计方面的相关资料，为最后的毕业论文或设计做好充分准备；深入了解我国土木工程材料的发展水平，为今后步入工作岗位打下基础。
default.en: The course “Fieldwork for graduation” is an important practical teaching component in this major. It aims to further consolidate students' theoretical knowledge learned in the classroom and integrate theoretical knowledge with practical production, thus playing an important role in helping students complete their graduation thesis. Students are required to link theory with practice, verify, consolidate, deepen and comprehensively apply the basic theory and professional knowledge learned in the classroom. They should further learn practical knowledge on the production technology and organizational management of new building materials, and have a more comprehensive and profound understanding of the application of new building materials in construction engineering. They should be able to flexibly apply their theoretical knowledge to production practices, cultivate their independent working ability to analyze and solve practical problems. Students should also have a detailed understanding of China's current production technology and technical level of concrete products and new materials, widely collect related information and become ready for graduation thesis (design). They should also have a deep understanding of the development level of civil engineering materials in China, laying a foundation for future participation into social production.

default.zh: 《毕业论文（设计）》课程重点培养学生系统运用所学基础理论、专门知识和技能，进而分析和解决实际工程技术问题的能力。在教师的指导下，学生系统检索中外文献并进行调查研究，深化并扩展培养自主学习能力和意识，强化对工程技术问题的理解、归纳和分析能力；针对具体问题合理确定研究内容、实施方案和技术路线，统筹安排各项工作，完成试验研究或工艺流程设计，取得系统的试验数据并整理分析得到有效结论，训练并提高学生独立工作能力和实践创新精神；通过论文撰写和口头汇报答辩等，提高就工程问题与同行进行书面和口头沟通交流的能力，促进学生建立起参与工业生产和科学研究、为国家经济建设做贡献的热情。
default.en: The course "Graduation thesis (design)" focuses on cultivating student’s ability to systematically apply their basic theories, specialized knowledge and skills to solve practical engineering problems. After collecting and reviewing domestic and foreign literature systematically, each student carries out researches and investigations into practical engineering problems under the guidance of supervisor. As a result, his/her ability and awareness of self-learning are expanded, and his/her capabilities of understanding, induction and analysis on engineering problems are strengthened. From detailed analyses of targeting problems, they gradually learn to determine the research contents reasonably, implementation plan and technical route, arrange all required works, complete experimental research or process design, and finally obtain systematic experimental data, from which effective conclusions can be derived through thorough analyses. The course aims to train and improve each student’s ability of independent working and innovative spirit. Through writing a thesis and presenting oral defense, each student can improve his/her capability of communicating with professional peers in both written and oral forms on engineering problems, and foster their enthusiasm to participate in social production and scientific research, and contribute to national economic development.

default.zh: 《地下空间规划与建筑课程设计》是土木工程专业的一门必修专业课。本课程的先修课程为工程制图与识图、城市地下空间概论、土力学和地下工程施工技术等。学生通过本课程的学习，掌握或熟悉地下空间规划与设计的基本内容和设计方法，如城市地下空间规划理论、规划编制内容和编制程序，城市地下空间资源评估、需求预测，城市地下空间总体布局与形态，城市地下交通规划、公共服务空间规划、市政设施规划、物流系统规划，城市居住区地下空间规划，历史文化保护下的地下空间开发，城市地下空间综合防灾等。全面熟悉和了解地下工程基本知识，充分认识地下工程是国家的重要社会资源，是我国重点开发的土木工程领域，为进一步的专业实习打下扎实基础。 课堂讲授通过启发式教学、讨论式教学等教学方法和手段培养学生对城市地下空间规划与设计的了解，丰富学生的专业视野，对于目前城市地下空间规划与设计的发展具有一定程度的掌握，提高其应用基本概念和理论，提高分析问题和解决问题的能力，同时对我国目前城市地下空间规划与设计领域所取得成绩有一定了解，增加学生的爱国情操和专业精神。本课程会适当地安排一些课下调研和小组作业,使学生能够亲身体验城市地下空间规划与设计的现状和发展，培养学生发现问题和解决问题的能力、实际动手能力、团队合作能力、获取和处理信息的能力，激发学生的创新思维。
default.en: “Course Design of Underground Space Planning and Architecture Designing” is a compulsory course for civil engineering. The prerequisites for this course are engineering drawing and mapping, introduction to urban underground space, soil mechanics and underground engineering construction technology. Through the study of this course, students can master or be familiar with the basic content and design methods of underground space planning and design, such as urban underground space planning theory, planning content and preparation procedures, urban underground space resource assessment, demand forecasting, urban underground space overall layout and form, urban underground transportation planning, public service space planning, municipal facilities planning, logistics system planning, urban residential area underground space planning, underground space development under historical and cultural protection, urban underground space comprehensive disaster prevention, etc. Comprehensively familiar with and understand the basic knowledge of underground engineering, fully understand that underground engineering is an important social resource of the country, and is a key development of civil engineering fields in China, laying a solid foundation for further professional internship. Through heuristic teaching, discussion teaching and other teaching methods and means, classroom teaching cultivates students' understanding of urban underground space planning and design, enriches students' professional vision, has a certain degree of mastery of the current development of urban underground space planning and design, improves its application of basic concepts and theories, improves the ability to analyze and solve problems, and at the same time has a certain understanding of the achievements in the field of urban underground space planning and design in China, and increases students' patriotism and professionalism. This course will arrange some after-class research and group assignments appropriately, so that students can experience the current situation and development of urban underground space planning and design, cultivate students' ability to find and solve problems, practical ability, teamwork ability, ability to obtain and process information, and stimulate students' innovative thinking.

default.zh: 针对土木工程中量大面广应用的整体式单向板肋梁楼盖，开展设计计算，将使土木工程专业本科生巩固课堂相关章节所学的内容，强化整体式单向板肋梁楼盖设计思路和方法的认识，熟悉整体式单向板肋梁楼盖结构布置及构造，学会查阅设计资料，掌握整体式单向板肋梁楼盖的规定，使其在设计计算、理解规范、提高专业绘图能力等得到有效训练，最终熟练掌握整体式肋梁楼盖的结构布置方法、设计计算和绘制结构施工图。
default.en: The design and calculation for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are carried out, which are applied widely and abundantly in civil engineering. It can make undergraduates of civil engineering obtain more skills. For example, the contents of the relevant sections in class are consolidated; the understanding of design ideas and methods for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams is strengthened; the layout and construction of integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are more familiar; the method of consulting the design data is studied; and the specifications of the integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are mastered. Besides, undergraduates can obtain effective trainings on studying the design and calculation, understanding the specifications and enhancing the ability of professional drawing. Finally, some skills for undergraduates are mastered expertly, including the structural layout method, design and calculation and the ability of drawing structure construction drawings for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams.

default.zh: 《基础工程A课程设计》是土木工程专业的一门必修专业课。基础工程课程设计是学生在完成教学计划规定的课程学习后，所进行的一个重要的实践教学球节，是继课堂教学、实验教学等环节之后的一个综合性较强的教学阶段。通过课程设计使学生受到设计方法的初步训统。本课程教学目的是培养学生的设计能力，经过本课程的学习，要求学生能够掌握大、中型建筑物的地基基础设计方法。 本课程的特点是理论密切联系工程实践，能够培养学生的逻辑思维能力，并且能够灵活地利用本课程的内容去分析工程实际问题，提高学生综合运用所学知识解决复杂工程问题的能力。 本课程充分利用模型、实物、多媒体软件，增强学生感性分析，以培养学生空间形象思维能力、工程实践应用能力和创新能力。
default.en: The design of foundation engineering A is a compulsory course in civil engineering. The design of the basic engineering course is an important practice teaching ball festival, which is a comprehensive and strong teaching stage after the teaching of classroom teaching and experimental teaching. Through the course design, the students are subject to the preliminary training of the design method. The purpose of this course is to develop the students' design ability, which requires students to master the foundation of large and medium-sized buildings. The characteristics of this course are the practice of close contact engineering of theory, can cultivate students' logical thinking ability, and can use the content of this course to analyze the practical problems of the project, and improve the ability of students to solve complex engineering problems. This course should make full use of models, physical, multimedia software, enhance student perceptual analysis, and cultivate students' spatial image thinking ability, engineering practice application ability and innovation ability.

default.zh: 本课程主要针对工程地质课程的理论内容进行野外实践工作方法、工作原理、实践内容、基本技能等方面的教学。主要的实习内容：岩石识别、地层和地质构造辨识与参数量测、主要的工程地质灾害认识与防控措施设计、填海技术和海岸工程地质设计、内外动力地质作用、工程选址等。
default.en: This course is mainly aimed at teaching the theoretical content of the engineering geology course on field practice working methods, working principles, practical content, and basic skills. The main practice content includes: rock identification, stratum and geological structure identification and parameter measurement, major engineering geological hazard recognition and prevention and control measures design, reclamation technology and coastal engineering geological design, internal and external dynamic geological effects, project site selection, etc.

default.zh: 《地下建筑结构课程设计》是应用《地下建筑结构》课程所学基本概念于具体地下工程关键构件进行专门设计的技术应用课。对培养本科生深刻理解《地下建筑结构》课程中的核心内容在国内外规范与标准、地下空间科学规划中的具体应用状况、练习地下结构基本概念计算理论、初步应用地下建筑结构设备知识、了解地下工程面临的科学问题、认识亟待解决的地下空间技术以及维护地下空间既有工程所需专业知识等综合能力的训练、提升具有十分重要的作用。 本课程主要在《地下建筑结构》课程内容的基础上，初步介绍地下空间工程结构设计的主要内容、方法和理论；介绍地下空间结构设计应遵循、参考的规范、标准；讲授地下结构设计如何满足地下空间科学的要求；初步讲授地下结构健康运维设备智能化计算及数据管理技术的应用；初步讲授地下结构形成及全寿命施工、安全与成本优化的应用；最后讲授地下结构设计重大问题解决途径、新方法、新测试的基本原理、创新思维与框架性应用。 该课程通过教学和工程结构设计，重点培训学生地下结构计算理论应用的水平，开拓学生应用专门技术理论和资料分析处理的综合能力，启迪学生创新解决地下工程问题的思维能力，推动学生深刻理解地下结构设计的本质与核心，初步掌握地下空间工程结构设计计算的主要步骤和内容，深刻认识地下空间设备与环境分析计算对地下空间结构基础知识要求的重要性，为毕业设计提供扎实的训练，从而执行并完成地下空间结构综合应用达成度的专业培养。
default.en: This project，which will use the fundamental belowground structural special knowledge acquired from course of 《Underground Structure （1）》 which just finished compulsory course in the same semester，is going to let students design the practical projection related with key component of subterranean engineering and have students do an design exercise using underground technical theory. This course will also introduce how to follow and consult the underground space codes and standards and/or specifications issued in China and/or other countries in which the impact techniques and theories are accept in the world. This course shall, therefore, train students to profound understanding application situation that corresponding core contents of 《Underground structure （1）》 applied in domestic and overseas’ codes and standards and underground space scientific panning. This course will take students to exercise basic concepts supported by theoretical calculation and preliminary use of intellectual technology onto underground building and structure equipment including comprehending the underground engineering what inevitable confronts scientific problems and even to know the urgent technology and maintain method and art used or to be used in underground existing engineering what students need learn and grasp professional skill and comprehensive ability to have a good maintenance of underground building’s structure one of theses days. This course considers that above training and promotion are essential and important to student to develop into eligible underground structural engineer. Base on 《Underground Structure （1）》course， this projection main focus in underground structure design contents include of methods selection and taking advantage of theoretical tools. Certainly, this course emphasizes to understand and how to analyze the requirement of different of codes and standards and specifications put into use in practice. This course will plan a lecture how to meet the need of underground space science. As an important consideration, the underground device and equipment’s smart monitoring and intelligent computing technology will also be shown in this projection course at the same time. This course hope students can obtain how to design the production of underground structure and full life construction and safety and application of cost optimization. During of the lectures arrangement, the underground engineering top concern solving ways and the new methods and creative test and check techniques as well as the innovative idea frame application will also be explained in last part.

default.zh: 生产实习目的是通过学生直接参与工程实践，提升学生将所学的本专业理论知识应用到实际的 工程设计、施工和管理等土木工程生产的多个环节的能力，增强理论知识与工程实践的相结合的学 习意识，培养良好的工程设计、施工和管理全过程的实践能力。通过本次实习，不仅提高学生的专 业素养，也提高学生在实践中分析问题、解决问题的能力。具体的课程要求： 1）读懂工程的建筑、结构和施工图；熟悉设计规范，能利用商业软件进行结构的建模和进行相 关的力学分析；能绘制图件。 2）熟悉并掌握地下建筑、地铁车站和盾构隧道的设计流程、施工技术和施工组织。
default.en: The purpose of production internship is to enhance students' ability to apply their theoretical knowledge of civil engineering to various aspects of engineering design, construction, and management through their direct participation in engineering practice. It aims to strengthen the integration of theoretical knowledge and engineering practice, and cultivate practical skills in the entire process of engineering design, construction, and management. Through this internship, students not only improve their professional competence, but also enhance their ability to analyze and solve problems in practice. The specific requirements of the course are: 1) To read and understand the construction, structure, and construction drawings of the engineering project; to be familiar with design specifications, and to be able to use commercial software for structural modeling and related mechanical analysis; to be able to draw drawings. 2) To be familiar with and master the design process, construction techniques, and construction organization of underground structures, subway stations, and shield tunnels.

default.zh: 毕业实习是教学计划中的一个重要教学环节，是理论联系实际，培养德才兼备的四有人才，增 强学生的土木工程建设行业责任感、职业道德和专业素养的重要措施。其目的是通过生产实践学习有关本专业的实践知识，增强感性认识，补充课堂教学的不足，为后续课程的学习和毕业后融入社会打下基础。生产实习是学生接触社会良好的实践机会，利用这一有利时机开展社会调查，了解我国社会主义现代化建设取得的伟大成就，使学生在德、智、体、美诸方面得到全面发展。具体的课程目标如下： 1）专业知识的系统掌握，包括工程图纸绘制与读懂、对一般土木工程的整个施工过程和施工前 的准备工作有较深入了解，理论联系实际，巩固和深入理解所学的理论知识(如测量、建材、建筑学、 结构、桥梁、道路、岩土和施工等)。 2）亲身参加施工实践，培养观察、分析和解决问题的独立工作能力，为将来工作打下基础。了 解当今我国土木工程的设计、施工技术与施工组织管理的实际水平，联系专业培养目标，树立献身 社会主义现代化建设，提高我国土木工程施工水平的远大志向。 3）实际震害的考察，明晰土木工程师的社会责任和人类的安全的贡献，增强社会责任意识和职业道德修养、报效祖国的责任意识。
default.en: Graduation internship is an important teaching element in the curriculum, which aims to bridge theory and practice, cultivate talents with both moral and intellectual virtues, and enhance students' sense of responsibility, professional ethics, and expertise in civil engineering. The purpose of the internship is to learn practical knowledge related to the profession through production practice, enhance sensory perception, complement classroom teaching, and lay a foundation for subsequent courses and future integration into society. Production internship is an excellent opportunity for students to have contact with society, conduct social investigations, and understand the great achievements of China's socialist modernization construction, so as to achieve comprehensive development in morality, intelligence, physical fitness, and aesthetics. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: 1) Systematically master professional knowledge, including the ability to draw and read engineering drawings, have a deeper understanding of the entire construction process of general civil engineering and the preparatory work before construction, and consolidate and deepen the theoretical knowledge learned (such as measurement, building materials, architecture, structures, bridges, roads, geotechnical engineering, and construction). 2) Personally participate in construction practice, cultivate the ability to observe, analyze and solve problems independently, and lay a foundation for future work. Understand the actual level of design, construction technology, and construction organization management of civil engineering in China today, link it to the professional training objectives, establish lofty aspirations to dedicate to socialist modernization construction, and improve the level of civil engineering construction in China. 3) Investigate actual seismic damage, clarify the social responsibility of civil engineers and their contribution to human safety, enhance social responsibility awareness, professional ethics, and the sense of responsibility to serve the motherland.

default.zh: 毕业设计是培养学生综合运用所学基础课、专业基础课、专业课等方面的知识，分析和解决与实际问题的能力。通过毕业设计的全过程，促进学生更加深入地理解所学的基本理论，进一步深化和扩展所学知识，提高自学能力和独立解决问题的能力。 通过调查研究，查阅资料、请教教师，进一步深化拓宽所学的基础知识、专业知识。所选题目应保证基本工程训练，掌握本专业的基本功，并增强学生理论分析、设计和计算，以及绘制工程图纸的能力。通过毕业设计，加强同学之间以及师生之间的学术交流，培养学生的合作精神、创新精神。毕业设计将作为学生毕业及学位资格认定的重要依据，作为衡量高等教育质量和办学效果的重要评价内容。对于能力较强、有余力的学生可在此基础上，加深加宽，做一些提高性研究专题，完成毕业论文。
default.en: Graduation project is to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve practical problems by comprehensively using the knowledge of basic courses, professional basic courses and professional courses, etc. Through the whole process of graduation project, students can be promoted to understand the basic theories, deepen and expand their knowledge, and improve their self-study ability and independent problem-solving ability. Through investigation and research, consulting materials, and consulting teachers, students can further deepen and broaden the basic knowledge and professional knowledge learned. The selected topic should ensure basic engineering training, master the basic skills of the major, and enhance students' ability to theoretical analysis, design and calculation, as well as drawing engineering drawings. Through the graduation project, the academic exchanges between students and between teachers and students are strengthened, and the spirit of cooperation and innovation is cultivated. Graduation project will be an important basis for students' graduation and degree qualification, and as an important evaluation content for measuring the quality and effectiveness of higher education. For students with strong ability and spare ability, on this basis, they can deepen and broaden, do some improved research topics, and complete their graduation thesis.For students with strong ability and spare capacity, they can deepen and broaden their knowledge on this basis, do some improvement research projects, and complete their graduation thesis.

default.zh: 工程经济学课程设计是工程经济学课程的配套实践环节及课程教学内容的深化环节。通过课程设计使学生进一步掌握投资项目可行性研究的阶段和内容，市场分析与预测方法、可行性研究报告的编制步骤、格式与内容。从而提高学生应用工程经济的基本原理和基本方法，对复杂投资项目的科学决策能力和应用信息技术解决问题的实际操作能力和综合应用能力。课程的基本教学目标如下：理解基础经济要素的概念，掌握销售收入、成本、税金及利润之间的关系，现金流量的估算及现金流量图的画法；理解经济效益评价指标体系中各项指标的基本概念及含义。掌握两个以上技术方案经济效益比较方法、熟练应用资金的时间价值换算关系公式；掌握财务评价报表的编制和评价指标的计算，不确定分析和方案比选与优化方法；熟练应用软件对工程项目方案的经济性进行分析，建立各种工程经济定量评价模型和经济指标的计算模型，实现数据的自动处理，建立直观的计算机分析图形，提高学生借助信息技术分析和解决问题的能力；通过对工程项目的经济分析，培养学生对工程方案/项目进行可行性研究的综合应用能力。
default.en: The Course Exercise of Engineering Economy A is a supporting practical part of the engineering economics course and a deepening of the course teaching content. Through course design, students will further master the stages and content of investment project feasibility study, market analysis and prediction methods, and the preparation steps, format, and content of feasibility study reports. Improve students' ability to apply the basic principles and methods of engineering economy, make scientific decisions on complex investment projects, and apply information technology to solve practical problems. The basic teaching objectives of the course are as follows: to understand the concepts of basic economic factors, master the relationship between sales revenue, costs, taxes, and profits, estimate cash flow, and draw cash flow charts; Understand the basic concepts and meanings of various indicators in the economic benefit evaluation index system. Master the method of comparing the economic benefits of two or more technical solutions, and proficiently apply the time value conversion formula of funds; Master the preparation of financial evaluation reports and the calculation of evaluation indicators, uncertainty analysis, scheme comparison and optimization methods; Proficient in applying software to analyze the economy of engineering project plans, establish various quantitative evaluation models for engineering economy and calculation models for economic indicators, achieve automatic data processing, establish intuitive computer analysis graphics, and improve students' ability to analyze and solve problems using information technology; Through economic analysis of engineering projects, cultivate students' comprehensive application ability to conduct feasibility studies on engineering solutions/projects.

default.zh: 建设项目管理A是土木工程学院工程管理专业本科生专业方向核心课程。它是一门理论与实践紧密结合、技能操作性和应用性较强的一门专业课程。建设项目管理作为一门实践性很强的课程，课程设计是教学中的重要环节，是对学生学习《建设项目管理A》课程的掌握和应用能力的检验，该课程设计使学生掌握建设工程项目管理规划的编制原则、方法和步骤；培养学生运用《建设项目管理A》课程中所学的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，以及综合运用相关学科的基本知识和技能，与工程实际相结合的能力。通过编制一个建设工程项目的管理规划，强化实践性环节的基本训练，培养学生独立分析和解决问题的能力。 本课程设计采用集中指导，自主练习的教学方式，由学生各自独立完成给定实际工程项目的项目管理规划（完整框架、详细的进度管理规划和质量管理规划）的编制。
default.en: Construction project management A is a core course for Undergraduate students majoring in Engineering Management in the School of Civil Engineering. It is a professional course with close combination of theory and practice, strong skill operability and application. Construction project management A is a highly practical course, and course design is an important link in teaching, which is the test of students' mastering and application ability of "Construction Project Management A". The course design enables students to master the principles, methods and steps of construction project management planning. Cultivate students' ability to apply the basic theories, basic knowledge and basic skills learned in the course of Construction Project Management, as well as the comprehensive application of the basic knowledge and skills of related disciplines to combine with engineering practice. Through the preparation of a construction project management plan, strengthen the basic training of practical links, and cultivate students' ability to independently analyze and solve problems. The course design adopts the teaching method of centralized guidance and independent practice, and the students independently complete the preparation of the project management plan (complete framework, detailed schedule management plan and quality management plan) for a given practical engineering project.

default.zh: 工程估价”课程是理论与实践紧密结合、技能操作性和应用性较强的一门专业技术课程，是工程管理、工程造价、土木工程、房地产经营管理、建筑工程等专业课程体系中的主干课程之一。该课程的学习为学生日后从事工程管理及工程造价相关工作奠定了一个扎实的理论基础。《工程估价》全面系统的介绍了我国现行工程造价的构成、工程定额、工程造价工程量清单计价方法，建筑面积和清单工程量的计算规则，工程项目建设各阶段造价文件的编制等内容。 工程估价作为一门实践性很强的课程，课程设计是教学中的重要环节，是对学生学习《工程估价》的检验，培养学生运用《工程估价》课程中所学的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，以及综合运用相关学科的基本知识和技能，加强实践性环节的基本训练，本设计要求学生完成工程量清单的编制和综合单位的分析计算。通过本设计可以培养学生独立分析和解决问题的能力。 本课程设计采用集中指导，自主练习的教学方式，由学生各自独立完成给定实际工程项目的建筑工程分部分项工程清单和措施项目清单的编制，并完成一个分部工程的综合单价分析。通过本课程设计使学生基本能掌握一般建筑工程的招投标编制技能。
default.en: Cost Estimation is a professional and technological course which closely integrates theory and practice, which also requires strong operational and practical skills. It is one of the main courses in construction management, cost estimation, civil engineering, real estate management and construction engineering. The course lays a solid theoretical foundation for students in their engagement in future work of construction management and cost estimation. This course introduces current composition of cost estimation in China, construction quota, the valuation method of cost estimation based on bill of quantities, the calculation rules of construction areas and bill quantities in a comprehensive and systematic way, and cost estimation document making in each phase in construction. Cost estimation, as a practical course, needs course design as an important part to test students’ learning of cost estimation. It serves as a training of students to apply basic theory, knowledge, and skills. Also it improves their comprehensive use of knowledge and skill, and strengthen basic training of practical skill. The design requires student to complete the calculation of bill of quantities and the analysis and calculation of integrated unit price. This design cultivates students' ability to analyze and solve problems independently. This course designed employ a teaching method of centralized instruction and practice by students themselves. Students are required to complete the making of bill of quantities and bill of measures for a given actual construction project independently, and also a comprehensive unit price analysis. Through this course design, students can master the basic bid making skills of construction projects.

default.zh: 由于学生分两个方向，课程介绍也分成两个模块（建设项目管理和房地产开发与管理）。 建设项目管理模块： 生产实习是工程管理专业教学计划中的一个重要实践性教学环节，是理论联系实际、巩固所学理论、综合所学知识、为毕业设计做准备的必要途径。是全面贯彻教育方针，培养学生实践能力和独立工作能力的一项重要措施。 通过生产实习，学生在巩固所学的理论知识，为后续课程的学习增加感性知识的同时，了解土木建筑工程的施工全过程，学习工程项目管理的基本内容和实际运用，使学生受到工程项目管理人员的基本训练，了解工程项目的先进建造方式和现代化管理方法，培养学生独立分析问题、解决工程实际问题、协同合作及组织工作的能力。 房地产开发与管理模块： 生产实习是房地产开发与管理专业方向教学计划中的一个重要实践性教学环节，是理论联系实际、巩固和应用所学专业学知识，为后续课程的学习和进行毕业设计做准备的必要途径。是全面贯彻教育方针，培养学生实践能力和独立工作能力的一项重要措施，是培养“外向型”、“经营型”、“创新型”、“复合型”人才的重要手段。 通过生产实习，使学生能够理论联系实际，巩固所学的理论知识，为后续课程的学习增加感性知识；对房地产业与国民经济、建筑业、城市建设的关系有较为清晰的认识和理解；对房地产企业组织机构与职能，以及房地产企业与建筑业、金融机构、政府主管部门和用户等方面的关系有进一步了解；对房地产企业的全部经营活动，即从开发建设到经营、服务的全过程、即每一环节的开发与管理问题均有一完整的掌握；通过参加房地产企业开发管理的业务实践，对企业的投资决策、前期工作、项目设计、土地估价、投资分析、项目管理、销售、物业管理等环节有一个全面了解。 同时，可以为做好毕业设计选题，收集毕业设计所需各种资料；使学生受到房地产项目管理和咨询工程师的基本训练，应用投资决策和先进管理方法，培养学生独立分析问题、解决工程实际问题、协同合作及组织工作的能力。
default.en: As students are divided into two directions, the course description is also divided into two directions (construction project management and real estate development and management). Construction project management model: The specialized production internship of the Engineering project management is an important practical teaching link between the theory and the practice. It can be cultivate the students comprehensive knowledge and is the necessary way to prepare for graduation design. It is the comprehensive implementation education policy, to train students' practical ability and work independently ability. Through the specialized production internship, students will consolidate the theoretical knowledge and increase the perceptual knowledge of follow-up course learning. Meanwhile it allows students to learn the basic content and practical application of project management. The course also makes students receive basic training of project managers. The study of this course enables students to understand the advanced construction methods and modern management methods of construction project, also cultivate students' ability to analyze problems independently, solve practical problems, cooperate and coordinate with others. Real estate development and management model： Specialized production internship is one of the important practical teaching procedures in the teaching plan of the real estate development and management. And it is a necessary approach to integrate theory with practice, consolidate and apply professional knowledge, and prepare for follow-up courses and preparation for graduation thesis. It is also a vital measure to comprehensively implement the education policy and cultivate students' practical ability and independent work ability, as well as an important means to cultivate "extroverted," "managing," "innovative," and "versatile" talent. Through the specialized production internship, students can integrate theory with practice, consolidate the theoretical knowledge they have learned, and strengthen their perceptual knowledge for the following course. Then according to this internship，they will get a clear idea and understanding of the relationship among national economy, construction industry and urban development. Moreover, students will know more particular knowledge of the organizational structure of the real estate enterprise; the stakeholders’ complex relationship; the whole operation process of the real estate enterprise, which includes the exploitation, construction, operation, service and so on. Then through the business practice, students can get the whole picture of the development phases from the investment decision-making phase, project design phase to sales phase and property management phase. Meanwhile, this internship will help students to lay the foundation to choose their research orientation, which enhances their basic skills in project management and cost consulting. Ultimately, as a practice of the professional course, this internship will teach the advanced management methods, will cultivate students’ ability to solve practical and professional problem independently, and will train their ability to work cooperatively.

It can be cultivate the students comprehensive knowledge and is the necessary way to prepare for graduation design. Through the graduation internship, students can consolidate the theoretical knowledge they have learned and further increase their perceptual knowledge. default.en: As students are divided into two directions, the course description is also divided into two modules (construction project management and real estate development and management). Construction project management module: The aim of Graduation project is to cultivate students' ability to comprehensively apply knowledge of basic lessons, basic technology courses, professional courses and other aspects they have learned, to analyze and solve the theoretical and practical issues of the whole process of project management in the field of engineering construction, such as bidding, project planning, pre-bidding project evaluation, project risk assessment and avoidance, health, safety and environment (HSE) , project dispute resolution mechanism and so on. Through the whole process of graduation project, students are encouraged to deeply understand basic theories they have learned, to further deepen and expand their knowledge, to improve the ability of self-learning and their ability to solve problems independently. It provides students the basic training to be engineers, the improvement of writing skills on essays and design brochures, and abilities of cooperation, organization, coordination, teamwork and innovation. Real estate development and management module： Through the whole process of graduation project, students are trained to integrate their professional knowledge and skills. The purpose of the course is to plan real estate development projects, or write the related papers in the field of real estate economic management. Students will master the new knowledge and new methods systematically to enhance the abilities of analyzing problems, the abilities of solving the practical problems, the innovation abilities and the research abilities, and to make the students receiving basic trainings of engineers and economists. After graduation, students will have the basic abilities and qualities to adapt to the needs of work or to carry out the scientific researches quickly.

default.zh: 智能建造与课程设计课程主要涵盖钢结构设计、钢筋混凝土设计、智能设计以及智能机械控制等关键内容,旨在深入探讨智能建造领域的核心概念、先进技术和应用方法。 智能设计是建筑行业与先进技术相融合的产物，通过利用人工智能、现代图形计算设备、以及高效优化算法等技术，实现结构设计和优化的自动化和智能化。智能设计提供了更高效、精确和可持续的设计解决方案，促进了建筑行业的创新发展，并为建筑师和工程师提供了更高水平的设计和决策支持。在智能建造与课程设计课程中，钢结构设计部分主要讲授钢结构的钢屋架结构体系构成、屋架形式和截面设计、内力计算方法、构件和节点设计方法，使学生能够独立完成钢屋架结构工程的设计；钢筋混凝土设计部分主要讲授整体式单向板肋梁楼盖的结构布置和整体式单向板肋梁楼盖的内力计算等，使学生能够独立完成普通单向板肋梁楼盖工程的设计；智能设计部分主要介绍前沿人工智能原理和技术、现代图形计算设备等，讲解python语言程序设计和固体线性有限元的程序编写，使学生能够初步实现结构智能设计；智能机械控制部分主要介绍智能机械控制原理和实践，包括ROS机械仿真系统、四足仿生机器人、轮式机器人和搬运机械臂的智能控制等。 通过该课程设计，应使学生首先了解钢结构设计和钢筋混凝土结构设计方法，熟练掌握传统结构设计流程。然后，介绍前沿人工智能原理和技术、现代图形计算设备、以及高效优化算法等，掌握python语言，并编写通用有限元和优化程序、深度学习算法等，实现初步结构智能设计。
default.en: The intelligent construction and course design course mainly covers key topics such as steel structure design, reinforced concrete design, intelligent design and intelligent control of machinery. Its purpose is to deeply explore the core concepts, advanced technologies, and application methods in the field of intelligent construction. Intelligent design is a product of the integration between the construction industry and advanced technologies. By utilizing techniques such as artificial intelligence, modern graphic computing devices, and efficient optimization algorithms, it achieves automation and intelligence in structural design and optimization. Intelligent design provides more efficient, precise, and sustainable design solutions, fostering innovative development in the construction industry and offering architects and engineers higher levels of design and decision-making support. In the intelligent construction and course design course, the steel structure design primarily focuses on teaching the Steel roof truss structural system composition, Steel roof truss form and section design, internal force calculation methods, and component and node design methods for steel structures. This enables students to independently complete the design of steel roof truss structure projects. The reinforced concrete design mainly covers the structural layout and internal force calculation of integral one-way slab-ribbed beam floor systems, empowering students to independently accomplish the design of ordinary one-way slab-ribbed beam floor projects. The intelligent design primarily introduces cutting-edge principles and technologies of artificial intelligence, modern graphic computing devices, and explores programming in the Python language and writing programs for solid linear finite elements. This equips students with the ability to preliminarily implement intelligent design in structures. The intelligent control of machinery section mainly introduces the principles and practices of intelligent mechanical control, including intelligent control on platforms such as the ROS simulation system, quadruped bionic robots, wheeled robots, and handling robotic arms. Through this course design, students are expected to first acquire an understanding of steel structure design and reinforced concrete structure design methods, and become proficient in traditional structural design processes. Subsequently, they will be introduced to cutting-edge principles and technologies of artificial intelligence, modern graphic computing devices, efficient optimization algorithms, etc., mastering the Python language and developing general finite element and optimization programs, deep learning algorithms, etc., thus achieving preliminary structural intelligent design.

default.zh: 智慧施工前沿技术课程设计课程主要包含施工场地数字模型建立、施工要素构建、开展仿真分析、深基坑、装配式建筑、钢结构厂房建造全过程虚拟仿真4个课程章节内容。 施工场地数字模型建立课程主要讲授建立施工场地数字模型，基于BIM建模软件完成项目主体模型、施工场地模型的建立，同时完成项目所需工装、设备模型的建立及临建标准化模型的建立，基于BIM虚拟仿真软件建立施工场地数字模型。同时讲授智能化的概念、智能化在现代土木工程行业的应用、了解智能化时代背景下涉及的大数据、物联网、互联网、智慧城市、人工智能、BIM技术、数字经济等相关领域的基本概念和基础知识，讲授数字建造的概念、了解数字建造涉及的新技术、新材料、新工艺，具有精确、高效、高性能的创新建造模式，讲授智慧工地的基本概念和基础知识，了解智慧工地应用平台整体解决方案的应用与实施，讲授数字化的概念以及现代土木工程行业数字化施工建造技术，了解基于BIM+的数字化建造模式；施工要素构建课程主要讲授构建施工场地的人、材、机等关键要素，基于BIM虚拟仿真软件在已建立的施工场地数字模型中构建人、材、机等关键要素；开展仿真分析课程主要讲授通过动态仿真模拟施工关键工序，形成三维作业指导书进行三维可视化技术交底，有效增加了交底内容的直观性和精确度，极大提高了工作效率，施工人员也能很快理解设计方案和施工方案，保证了施工目标的顺利实现；深基坑、装配式建筑、钢结构厂房建造全过程虚拟仿真课程主要以“深基坑、装配式建筑、钢结构厂房”为例讲授智能建造全过程虚拟仿真技术在实际项目案例中的具体实施应用。将创建好的BIM模型导入到BIM虚拟仿真软件中进行三维场地布置虚拟仿真漫游展示，通过展示使管理者直观地了解场地修建好的布置情况，达到所见即所得、真实直观的效果，辅助场地布置方案的论证及调整。通过场地虚拟仿真模拟并合理的规划、布置场地，可减少临时用地，优化场地布置、减少临建空间冲突，符合绿色施工。基于BIM虚拟仿真软件进行特殊工序、工艺模拟展示。通过工艺的模拟使现场的施工人员与技术人员直观的了解到施工工艺，提高现场施工效率。 通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解现代土木工程智慧建造领域的相关政策与国内外发展趋势，掌握现代土木工程施工建造过程中应用的前沿的、先进的智慧施工技术与智慧建造理念。同时学习掌握了BIM软件、BIM虚拟仿真软件的应用，掌握了智能建造全过程虚拟仿真技术的应用。
default.en: The curriculum design of intelligent construction frontier technology mainly includes the construction site digital model establishment, the construction essential factor construction, carries out the simulation analysis, the Deep Foundation Pit, the prefabricated building, the steel structure factory building entire process virtual simulation four curriculum chapters contents. The course of construction site digital model establishment mainly teaches the establishment of construction site digital model, based on BIM modeling software to complete the establishment of the main project model, construction site model, at the same time, the establishment of tooling and equipment model and standardization model is completed, and the digital model of construction site is built based on BIM. At the same time, we will teach the concept of intelligentization, its application in the modern civil engineering industry, and understand the basic concepts and knowledge in the related fields such as big data, Internet of things, Internet, Smart City, artificial intelligence, BIM technology, digital economy, etc. , to teach the concept of digital construction, to understand the new technologies, new materials and new techniques involved in digital construction, and to have an accurate, efficient and high-performance innovative construction mode, to teach the basic concept and knowledge of smart site, to understand the application and implementation of the whole solution of smart site application platform, to teach the concept of digitization and the digital construction technology of modern civil engineering industry, to understand the digital construction model based on BIM + , construction elements construction course mainly teaches the construction site of people, materials, machinery and other key elements, based on BIM virtual simulation software, the key elements of man, material and machine are built in the digital model of construction site,Carrying out the course of simulation and analysis mainly teaches the key process of construction through dynamic simulation, forming the 3D work instruction and giving the 3D visualization technical disclosure, which effectively increases the intuitiveness and accuracy of the contents of the disclosure, greatly improve the work efficiency, the construction staff can also quickly understand the design and construction plans to ensure the smooth realization of construction goals; The course of virtual simulation for the whole process of construction of deep foundation pit, prefabricated building and steel structure workshop mainly takes “Deep Foundation Pit, prefabricated building and steel structure workshop” as an example to teach the application of virtual simulation technology for the whole process of intelligent construction in actual project cases. Through the study of this course, students can understand the related policies and development trends in the field of intelligent construction of modern civil engineering, master the cutting-edge, advanced intelligent construction technology and intelligent construction concept applied in the construction process of modern civil engineering. At the same time learn to master the application of BIM software, BIM virtual simulation software, master the entire process of intelligent construction of virtual simulation technology.

default.zh: 生产实习是智能建造本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生能够理论联系实际，巩固所学的理论知识，并为后续课程的学习增加感性知识。在生产实习中，学生深入工地现场等实践场所，了解工作环境，熟悉本工程施工图纸，学习本工程的施工组织设计、监理规划，学习施工项目管理的基本内容、工作流程及相关管理方法。希望通过生产实习，使学生受到工程项目管理人员的基本训练，了解工程项目的先进建造方式和现代化管理方法，培养和提高学生的学习能力、应用知识能力、工程实践能力、使用现代工具能力、沟通协调能力。
default.en: Production practice is an important practical teaching link in the intelligent construction undergraduate teaching plan. Its purpose is that students associate the theory knowledge with the practice, deepen their theoretical knowledge, and increase perceptual knowledge for civil engineering. During the production practice, students go into the construction site or other practical places, understand the working situation, get familiar with the project drawings, learn the construction organization design and supervision planning of the project, and learn the basic content, working process and related management methods of construction project management. By production practice, students can receive basic training of engineering project management, know advanced construction methods and modern management methods of engineering projects, and students' learning ability, knowledge application ability, engineering practice ability, use of modern tools and communication and coordination ability can be cultivated and improved.

default.zh: 毕业实习是智能建造专业重要的实践性教学环节。实习内容包括参观已建/在建典型及特色工程，听取专题讲座，结合毕业设计题目有针对性地收集已建或在建工程资料，完成专题报告、撰写实习日记、完成实习报告。通过实习，使智能建造专业本科生深化认识国内外智能建造的最新发展与前景，巩固专业知识，应用所学专业解决实际问题，系统理解智能建造的规划、设计、施工及管理等工作，认识工程师和工程管理人员职责，培育专业精神，为毕业设计的开展及毕业后尽快适应专业技术或管理工作奠定基础，强化智能建造本科生热爱专业，立志智能建造发展，致力于祖国现代化建设和两个一百年宏伟目标的实现。
default.en: Graduation field work is a significant practical teaching link for intelligent construction undergraduates. The internship includes visiting typical and special projects already built or under construction, attending special lectures, collecting information on projects in combination with the graduation projects, completing special reports, writing internship diaries and completing internship reports. Through the internship, intelligent construction undergraduates can deepen their understanding of the latest development and prospect of both domestic and overseas intelligent construction, consolidate their professional knowledge, apply their professional knowledge to solve practical problems. Furthermore, they can systematically understand the process of planning, design, construction and management of intelligent construction and cultivate the responsibilities and professionalism of engineers and project managers, which would help them to lay the foundation for the graduation design and adapt to professional technical or management work as soon as possible after graduation. The aim is to strengthen the passion of undergraduate intelligent construction students for their majors, motivate their determination to develop intelligent construction, which inspire them to devote themselves to the modernization of the motherland and the realization of the Two Centenary Goals.

default.zh: 智能建造专业本科生的毕业论文（设计）培养学生综合运用所学基础课、专业基础课、专业课等方面的知识，分析和解决实际工程设计问题的能力。通过毕业设计的全过程训练，促进学生更加深入地理解所学的基本理论，进一步深化和扩展所学知识，提高自学能力和独立解决问题的能力，提高团队合作、与专业人员沟通交流的能力。 在毕业论文（设计）课程教学过程中，通过调查研究、查阅资料、请教教师，进一步深化拓宽所学的基础知识、专业知识。毕业论文（设计）题目应保证基本工程训练，掌握本专业的基本功，并增强学生设计和计算，以及绘制工程图纸的能力。通过毕业设计，加强同学之间以及师生之间的学术交流，培养学生的合作精神、创新精神。毕业论文（设计）将作为学生毕业及学位资格认定的重要依据，作为衡量高等教育质量和办学效果的重要评价内容。对于能力较强、有余力的学生可在工程设计的基础上，加深加宽，做一些提高性研究专题，完成毕业设计计算书。
default.en: Graduation project of undergraduate students in the field of intelligent construction is to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve practical problems by comprehensively using the knowledge of basic courses, professional basic courses and professional courses. Through the whole design process of graduation project, students can understand the basic theory more deeply, deepen and expand their knowledge, and improve their ability of self-study and independent problem-solving. Through investigation and research, consulting materials and consulting teachers, students can further deepen and broaden the basic knowledge and professional knowledge learned. The topic of graduation project should ensure basic engineering training, master the basic skills of the major, and enhance the students' ability of theoretical analysis, design and calculation, and drawing engineering drawings. Through the graduation project, strengthen the academic exchanges between students and teachers, and cultivate students' spirit of cooperation and innovation. Graduation project will be an important basis for students to evaluate graduate and degree qualification, as well as an important content to measure the quality of higher education and school running effect. For the students with stronger ability, they can do some research topics in the graduation project, then complete their graduation thesis.

default.zh: 本课程是土木工程建设管理系的专业必选课，以现代建造技术为主线，涵盖了前沿施工技术、装配式建筑、数字建造和绿色建造等方面的内容。不仅要求学生掌握现代建造技术的基本原理和相关技术手段，更重要的是通过教学和实践，培养学生自主思考和解决问题的能力。 在课程教学中，教师主要采用课堂讲授及多媒体工具的方式，为学生全面地介绍现代建造技术的发展及应用情况，展示各种案例，并注重结合实际工程案例进行案例分析。此外，在课程设计中，还增加了由学生参与的研讨课，鼓励学生围绕某些具体问题进行深入思考和交流，并形成科学见解。 本课程的毕业要求包括学生掌握前沿施工技术基本原理、了解我国土木工程专业相关规范和规程、至少初步掌握一种工具的使用方法；认识到现代建造技术的重要引领作用和其对我国土木工程领域创新发展的影响；具备独立分析和解决问题的能力，以及自主学习和终身学习的意识。 通过本课程，学生可以全面了解现代建造技术的基本原理和发展趋势，掌握综合分析和解决现代建造过程中的问题的能力，为日后从事土木工程相关职业提供扎实基础。本课程还将引导学生注重环境保护和资源利用，使其在未来工作中规范施工、提高效率同时关注环境。
default.en: This course is a core course in Civil Engineering, focusing on modern construction technology and covering cutting-edge construction techniques, prefabricated buildings, digital construction, and green construction. It not only requires students to master the basic principles and relevant techniques of modern construction technology but also emphasizes the cultivation of independent thinking and problem-solving abilities through teaching and practice. In teaching this course, instructors mainly use classroom lectures and multimedia tools to comprehensively introduce the development and application of modern construction technology, showcase various cases, and pay attention to combining actual engineering cases for case analysis. In addition, student participation in seminars has been added to the course design, encouraging students to think deeply and exchange ideas about specific issues and form scientific opinions. The graduation requirements for this course include mastering the basic principles of cutting-edge construction technology, understanding related regulations and codes in the field of Civil Engineering in China, and at least having preliminary proficiency in using one tool. Students should also recognize the important leading role of modern construction technology and its impact on innovative development in the field of Civil Engineering in China, possess the ability to analyze and solve problems independently, and have awareness and abilities of self-learning and lifelong learning. Through this course, students can gain a comprehensive understanding of the basic principles and development trends of modern construction technology, master the ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems in modern construction processes, and lay a solid foundation for future careers in Civil Engineering. This course will also guide students to prioritize environmental protection and resource utilization, ensuring that in their future work, they focus on standardizing construction, improving efficiency, and protecting the environment.

default.zh: 本课程设计是学生综合运用工程信息管理与数字建造课程中所学的基本理论和基本方法，通过课程设计，使学生掌握信息技术在建设工程项目应用的方法、步骤和内容，进一步巩固和深化课程的教学内容，加强实践性教学环节的基本训练，学生运用本专业课程中所学到的相关知识和技能，结合课程设计可以使学生能把已掌握的管理理论、工程知识、计算机应用技术与工程管理的专业知识相结合，加深对过去已修课程的理解，为学生今后从事工程信息管理领域的工作打下基础。
default.en: The design of this course integrates the basic theories and methods learned in the " Construction Information Management and Digital Fabrication " course. Through this course design, students are expected to master the methods, procedures, and content of applying information technology in construction engineering projects. It aims to further consolidate and deepen the teaching content of the course, strengthen the basic training of practical teaching, and enable students to apply the relevant knowledge and skills learned in this professional course. By combining the mastered management theories, engineering knowledge, computer application technology, and professional knowledge of engineering management, students deepen their understanding of past courses and lay the foundation for future work in the field of engineering information management. Course Objective 1: Master the basic skills of using BIM software for modeling, acquire the ability to obtain project data using models, and receive basic training in applying BIM software for digital construction. Course Objective 2: Be familiar with and master the functions of engineering project management software, receive basic training in using software to solve engineering project management planning, and gain the ability to apply modern information management tools to solve engineering information management problems.

default.zh: 《城市开发与城市更新课程设计》主要任务就是使学生通过理论课程学习，在给定城市更新具体工程对象背景下，综合运用其理论教学中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合城市建设与发展需求，对更新对象现状进行实际调研、价值点提炼发掘、产业业态优选、规划与建筑设计建议、项目管理与融资模式构思等方面进行城市开发与更新管理的基本训练，为学生进一步从事城市开发与城市更新策划工作打下基础。课程目标为：掌握更新项目对象实际调查手段与方法，训练更新项目对象产业业态优选能力；训练更新项目对象管理组织与融资策划能力；训练综合应用城市开发与城市更新原理和要点解决实际问题的基本素质。
default.en: The main task of Curriculum Design of Urban Development and Urban Renewal is to enable students to learn through theoretical courses, comprehensively apply the relevant knowledge and skills learned in theoretical teaching under the background of specific urban renewal engineering objects, and combine with the needs of urban construction and development to conduct actual research, value point extraction and excavation, industrial format optimization, planning and architectural design suggestions on the current status of renewal objects Basic training in urban development and renewal management, including project management and financing model conception, lays the foundation for students to further engage in urban development and renewal planning work. The course objective is to master the actual investigation methods and methods for updating project objects, and train the ability to optimize the industrial formats of the updated project objects; Train and update project object management, organization, and financing planning abilities; Train the basic qualities of comprehensively applying the principles and key points of urban development and urban renewal to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 《房地产开发与管理课程设计》是房地产开发与管理课程的配套实践环节及课程教学内容的深化环节。通过课程设计使学生进一步掌握房地产开发项目定位策划的基本内容，包括选择开发项目用地、项目业主定位、项目产品定位、项目形象定位、项目文化定位、项目园林景观定位等基本要求。在课程设计全过程中将积极鼓励学生深入进行定位理念创新，应用VR等新的信息技术完成项目定位策划方案，突出培养学生的策划创新能力和市场开拓能力。课程的基本教学目标如下：掌握房地产开发项目定位策划的基本知识及其内在逻辑关系；培养学生综合运用相关学科的基本知识和技能，提高开发项目策划能力；引导学生提升策划创新能力。
default.en: The course design of real estate development and management is a supporting practical aspect of the course and a deepening of the teaching content. Through course design, students can further master the basic content of real estate development project positioning planning, including selecting development project land, project owner positioning, project product positioning, project image positioning, project cultural positioning, project landscape positioning, and other basic requirements. Throughout the course design process, students will be actively encouraged to innovate their positioning concepts, apply new information technologies such as VR to complete project positioning planning plans, and highlight the cultivation of students' planning innovation and market development abilities. The basic teaching objectives of the course are as follows: to master the basic knowledge and internal logical relationships of real estate development project positioning and planning; Cultivate students' comprehensive application of basic knowledge and skills in relevant disciplines, and improve their ability to plan development projects; Guide students to enhance their planning and innovation abilities.

default.zh: 认识实习是土木工程专业实践教学的关键环节之一，通过参观和现场教学，使学生在学习专业课之前对本专业的学习内容和工程范围有一定的感性认识和初步了解，激发学生学习专业课的兴趣，增强学生学习的主观能动性，使学生在专业课学习时不断联系认识实习，为专业知识的学习奠定基础，认识实习可使学生初步了解本专业的学习内容，专业范围，了解本专业的现状和发展前景，认识实习为培养专业型人才起着重要作用。
default.en: Cognition practice is one of the key links in the practical teaching of civil engineering major. Through visits and on-site teaching, students can have a certain perceptual knowledge and preliminary understanding of the learning content and engineering scope of the major before learning professional courses, stimulate students' interest in learning professional courses, enhance students' subjective initiative in learning, and enable students to constantly contact cognition practice when learning professional courses, so as to lay the foundation for the study of professional knowledge. Cognition practice can enable students to initially understand the learning content and scope of the major, understand the current situation and development prospects of the major, and realize that practice plays an important role in cultivating professional talents.

default.zh: 掌握各种基础类型及基础设计的原则；了解基坑工程设计与施工；了解地下工程监测与检测技术。技能层面：能够计算地基承载力并进行基础选型；能够设计天然地基上浅基础；能够进行桩基础设计；初步掌握基坑工程设计与施工。态度层面：在学习知识和实践训练中发展智力、培养能力、掌握技能，重在工程应用；培养良好的情操，科学的工程意识。努力参与各种科学实践、工程实践和社会实践活动。
default.en: Master various foundation types and principles of foundation design; understand foundation pit engineering design and construction; understand underground engineering monitoring and detection technology. Skill level: able to calculate the bearing capacity of the foundation and select the foundation; be able to design shallow foundations on natural foundations; be able to design pile foundations; have a preliminary grasp of the design and construction of foundation pit engineering. Attitude level: developing intelligence, cultivating abilities, and mastering skills in learning knowledge and practical training, focusing on engineering applications; cultivating good sentiment and scientific engineering awareness. Efforts to participate in various scientific practice, engineering practice and social practice activities.

default.zh: 针对土木工程中量大面广应用的整体式单向板肋梁楼盖，开展设计计算，将使土木工程专业本科生巩固课堂相关章节所学的内容，强化整体式单向板肋梁楼盖设计思路和方法的认识，熟悉整体式单向板肋梁楼盖结构布置及构造，学会查阅设计资料，掌握整体式单向板肋梁楼盖的规定，使其在设计计算、理解规范、提高专业绘图能力等得到有效训练，最终熟练掌握整体式肋梁楼盖的结构布置方法、设计计算和绘制结构施工图。
default.en: The design and calculation for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are carried out, which are applied widely and abundantly in civil engineering. It can make undergraduates of civil engineering obtain more skills. For example, the contents of the relevant sections in class are consolidated; the understanding of design ideas and methods for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams is strengthened; the layout and construction of integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are more familiar; the method of consulting the design data is studied; and the specifications of the integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are mastered. Besides, undergraduates can obtain effective trainings on studying the design and calculation, understanding the specifications and enhancing the ability of professional drawing. Finally, some skills for undergraduates are mastered expertly, including the structural layout method, design and calculation and the ability of drawing structure construction drawings for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams.

default.zh: 测量学实习是土木工程专业的一门实习课程，通过学习本课程，使学生掌握测量仪器的基本构造及其操作。主要包括水准测量、角度测量、地形图测绘等内容。通过实习，使学生具备进行大比例尺地形图测绘测量能力。
default.en: Surveying practice is an internship course for civil engineering majors. By studying this course, students can master the basic structure and operation of measuring instruments. Mainly including leveling measurement, angle measurement, topographic mapping and other contents. Through internships, students will acquire the ability to conduct large-scale topographic mapping and surveying.

default.zh: 房屋建筑学课程设计，是配合房屋建筑学同步开设的设计类课程。是哈尔滨工业大 学土木工程学院为本科留学生开设的一门实践性较强的综合技术科学，通过本课程，培 养学生建筑构造设计，建筑方案设计与绘图的能力。具体目标如下： 1． 培养学生逐渐地，从合理选择标准构造图集中的节点，到独立完成具有方案特 征的，如节能建筑，绿色建筑的构造节点设计及整体构造方案构建能力。 2． 培养学生举一反三，自主学习的能力，从而使学生在未来职业生涯中，面对日 益出现的新材料，新技术，做到迅速的掌握新型构造做法。
default.en: The Design of Building Architecture course is a design-focused curriculum component offered in parallel with the course of Building Architecture, which is a comprehensive technical curriculum offered by the School of Civil Engineering at the Harbin Institute of Technology for international students. The course is designed to cultivate students' competencies in architectural structural design, schematic architectural planning, and technical drawing proficiency. The specific pedagogical objectives are delineated as follows: 1. To cultivate students' ability to progressively transition from appropriately selecting nodal details in standard construction atlases to independently developing structural node designs and holistic construction schemes with programmatic characteristics, such as those for energy-efficient buildings and green architecture. 2. To foster students' capacity to generalize knowledge through self-directed learning, enabling them to rapidly master emerging construction methodologies in response to novel materials and technologies encountered in future professional practice.

default.zh: 本课程面向大学一年级学生开设，培养学生的科学与工程思维--计算思维，促进学生的计算思维与各专业思维交叉融合形成复合型思维，为各专业学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算系统求解学科问题奠定思维基础，帮助学习者提高解读真实世界系统并解决全球范围复杂问题的能力。 本课程以“机器自动计算==>机器难于计算==>计算与社会/自然的融合”为脉络，引导学生建立“计算机世界观”，理解社会/自然问题利用计算手段进行求解的基本思维模式；理解高级语言/机器语言程序是如何被执行的,了解复杂系统化复杂为简单的基本思维；理解由问题、到算法、再到程序的问题求解思维模式，了解问题、算法与计算系统(资源和环境)之间的关系，了解难解性问题求解的基本思路；理解数据管理的手段(数据库与数据挖掘)，理解数据库和大数据的社会影响。理解机器网络、信息网络和网络化社会的形成机理，理解网络化的社会影响。
default.en: This course is an introductory technical one for all freshmen of university. Students will learn computational thinking which can lay a foundation for the further study to design, to construct and to apply computer systems or software systems or computer-based sysyems,and also which can help students to understand complicated systems in real worlds,such as social/natural network system based on Internet. This version of the course is suitable for the majors which are weakly related to computer techniques. The main contents of this course are as following: (1) Understand basic computational thinking and know how to build a simple computing system based on computational thinking; (2) Understand how program is compiled level by level and finally executed on hardware, and how complex system is built on simple component; (3)Understand problem solving procedure,i.e.problem anlysis, algorithm design,and programming, relations among problem, algorithm and computing system, and know how to solve (hard) problem by constructing algorithm and executing algorithm; (4) Understand computational thinking about data management and data mining. Understand the relationship between data and social/natural problems; (5) Understand computational thinking about machine network(Computer network),information networks, and social/natural network based on internet. Underatand the relationship between Internet and social/natural problems.

default.zh: 自动化、网络化、智能化是各学科未来发展的重要方向之一，面向各学科的计算系统或计算工具的开发与应用也成为各学科未来创新的关键领域，计算手段已发展为与理论手段和实验手段并存的科学研究的第三种手段，计算思维（含计算+、互联网+、大数据+和人工智能+）已成为各专业学生都应掌握的思维方式。本课程面向大学一年级学生开设，培养学生的科学与工程思维--计算思维（含计算+、互联网+、大数据+和人工智能+）以及必要的信息技术基础，促进学生计算思维与各专业思维交叉融合形成复合型思维，为各专业学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算系统求解学科问题奠定思维基础，培养数据获取、分析和处理能力，帮助学习者提高解读真实世界系统并解决全球范围复杂问题的能力。
default.en: Automation, networking and intelligence are one of the important directions for the future development of all disciplines. The development and application of computing systems or computing tools for all disciplines has also become a key field for future innovation of all disciplines. Computing means have developed into the third means of scientific research coexisting with theoretical means and experimental means, computational thinking (including computing+, Internet plus, big data+and artificial intelligence+) It has become a way of thinking that students of all majors should master. This course is open to freshmen in college, to cultivate their scientific and engineering thinking -- computational thinking (including computing+, Internet plus, big data+and artificial intelligence+) and necessary information technology foundation, promote the cross integration of students' computational thinking and professional thinking to form a composite thinking, lay a thinking foundation for students of all majors to design, construct and apply various computing systems to solve disciplinary problems in the future, and cultivate data acquisition Analysis and processing abilities help learners improve their ability to interpret real-world systems and solve complex global problems.

default.zh: 《程序设计思维与实践》是我校优秀本科生培养框架下的入门级课程，是面向未来技术学院培养多工科专业领域拔尖生专门开设的计算机专业素养课和软件设计基础课，旨在帮助学生奠定坚实的计算机技术基础，积累程序设计实践经验，拓展学生运用计算机进行问题求解与工程应用的能力。 课程以学生掌握C语言语法和编程技术为基本要求，以在待求解问题域中建立数据思维、计算思维为培养目标；教学内容主要涵盖计算机基础、程序设计语言、面向任务的数据抽象与操作等内容，教学环节既包含为熟练驾驭计算机进行问题求解必备的程序设计思想、数据操作算法化及代码化等思维训练，设置了编程训练和实践环节。
default.en: Paradigm and Practice in Programing is an entry-level course under the framework of cultivating excellent undergraduate students in HIT. It is a computer literacy course and software design foundation course specifically designed for School of Future Technical, HIT, to cultivate students in engineering fields and majors. The aim is to help students lay a solid foundation in computer technology, accumulate practical experience in programming, and expand their ability to use computers for problem solving and engineering applications. The basic requirement of the course is to learn C language grammar and programming techniques, thereby, establish data thinking and computational thinking in the problem domain to be solved. Based on which, programming and practical training of data operations necessary for proficient computer problem-solving are designed as the key segment for students' ability promotion.
