General Information Course Code：22CS31200 Course Title：Network Attack and Defense Technology A Credit Hours：48 Lecture：32 Lab：16 Computer Lab: Practical: Tutoring: Credit(s)： 3 Offering Department: Faculty of Computing Students: Cyberspace Security，Undergraduates Term: Spring，Second year Prerequisites: Introduction to Information Security, Practice in Information Security Program Design 2. Course Description Network Attack and Defense Technology is a professional course designed for the majors of cyberspace security and information security. The purpose is to enable students to understand and master the basic technical principles and ideas of network attack and defense, master commonly used network security tools, and have the ability to solve common attack and defense problems in network security by studying network attack and defense theory and conducting relevant attack and defense practices. The course content mainly includes network security situation, network security history, introduction to network security laws and regulations, network vulnerability analysis, information collection, web vulnerability attacks, SQL injection attacks, software security, reverse analysis technology, PWN and other contents. Students are required to master the principles and technologies of network attack and defense, and skillfully use relevant security tools.

default.zh: 《软件安全与逆向分析A》是网络空间安全专业的一门综合性课程，侧重于增强学生对软件缺陷的本质和恶意代码危害机理的理解，促使学生掌握软件安全的基本理论、分析方法和核心技术，提升学生在软件安全设计、分析和防护方面的实践能力。通过本课程的学习，使得学生掌握软件安全与逆向分析领域相关的基础知识和技能，熟悉软件安全与逆向分析的理论和方法，熟练运用逆向分析的常用工具，认识逆向分析技术在软件漏洞分析、恶意代码检测、安全编程等领域的运用，提高学生在系统设计和软件开发中的网络信息安全意识。
default.en: Software Security and Reverse Analysis A is a comprehensive course of cyberspace security major, focusing on enhancing students' understanding of the nature of software defects and the mechanism of malicious codes, promoting students to master the basic theories, analysis methods and core technologies of software security, and improving students' practical ability in software security design, analysis and protection. Through this course, students can master the basic knowledge and skills related to software security and reverse analysis, which can be familiar with the theory and methods of software security and reverse analysis, proficient in the common tools of reverse analysis, understand the application of reverse analysis technology in software vulnerability analysis, malicious code detection, security programming and other fields, and improve students' awareness of network information security in system design and software development.

default.zh: 互联网基础设施是互联网运转必不可少的系统集合，关键互联网基础设施主要包括域名系统（Domain Name System，DNS）和域际路由系统（Border Gateway Protocol，BGP）。互联网是网络空间的主要载体，保障互联网基础设施安全也是保障网络空间安全、维护网络主权的关键。全面、深入地掌握互联网基础设施的攻防方法及原理是对网络空间安全人才的重要需求。本课程涵盖4个部分：互联网体系与安全，域名系统安全，域间路由安全，安全思维与新进展。每个部分教学内容都涉及3个方面：原理与系统、安全分析、安全防护。本课程从互联网体系的设计出发，揭示网络体系和协议的设计与安全性之间的内在联系，介绍相关的安全性分析方法，进而结合具体安全事件对维系互联网正常运行所必不可少的DNS和BGP协议及实际系统进行原理及安全性介绍，同时介绍如何使用ping、traceroute、dig等常见网络工具进行安全分析实操。通过学习本课程，你将从安全的角度重新认识互联网体系和网络协议，并认识到通信需求和安全需求之间存在着天然的矛盾；你将具备互联网基础设施安全思维，能够使用理论和工具的分析互联网基础设施系统的安全性，并解读相关安全事件。
default.en: Internet infrastructure is a collection of systems that are essential for the operation of the Internet. The key Internet infrastructure mainly includes the Domain Name System (DNS) and the Border Gateway Protocol, (BGP). The Internet is the main carrier of cyberspace, and ensuring the security of Internet infrastructure is also the key to safeguarding cyberspace security and maintaining cyber sovereignty. A comprehensive and in-depth grasp of the attack and defense methods and principles of Internet infrastructure is an important demand for cyberspace security talents. This course covers 4 parts: Internet system and security, domain name system security, inter-domain routing security, and security thinking and new developments. Each part of the teaching content involves three aspects: principles and systems, safety analysis, and safety protection. Starting from the design of the Internet system, this course reveals the internal relationship between the design and security of the network system and protocols, introduces relevant security analysis methods, and then, alongside the introduction of specific security events, introduces the principle and security of the DNS and BGP protocol as well as the actual system, which are critical for maintaining the normal operation of the Internet. At the same time, this course introduces how to use common network tools such as ping, traceroute, and dig to conduct security analysis and practical operations. By studying this course, you will re-understand the Internet system and network protocols from the perspective of security, and realize that there is a natural contradiction between communication requirements and security requirements; you will develop infrastructure security thinking, be able to analyze the security of Internet infrastructure systems both from a theoretical perspective and by using tools, be able to interpret relevant security events.

Through the study of this course, students can master the basic knowledge and skills related to the field of network attack and defense, and improve their ability in security design, analysis and evaluation.

default.zh: 互联网基础设施是互联网运转必不可少的系统集合，关键互联网基础设施主要包括域名系统（Domain Name System，DNS）和域际路由系统（Border Gateway Protocol，BGP）。互联网是网络空间的主要载体，保障互联网基础设施安全也是保障网络空间安全、维护网络主权的关键。全面、深入地掌握互联网基础设施的攻防方法及原理是对网络空间安全人才的重要需求。本课程培养互联网基础设施安全实操能力，涵盖4个部分：网络拓扑测量，域间路由安全，域名系统安全，安全网络协议设计与实现。针对网络拓扑测量，将进行网络拓扑探测实操实验，为指定网段绘制IP级拓扑图；针对域间路由安全，将进行BGP系统攻防实操实验，基于虚拟靶场平台模拟前缀劫持攻击和路由泄漏风险，观察攻击过程并分析攻击的影响，演练BGPSec、RPKI等防护方案，评价防护效果和代价；针对域名系统安全，将进行DNS系统攻防实操实验，基于虚拟靶场平台模拟缓存投毒和反射攻击，观察攻击过程并分析攻击的影响，演练DNSSEC、DoH等防护方案，评价防护效果和代价；针对安全网络协议设计与实现，将选取一种常见网络协议，以小组协作的形式设计一种安全保护方案，并基于ns3模拟实验平台进行实现和验证。提交代码和报告，并做系统展示。通过学习本课程，学生将具备扎实的互联网基础设施安全实操能力，对于相关攻防原理有深刻的认识。
default.en: Internet infrastructure is a collection of systems that are essential for the operation of the Internet. Key Internet infrastructure mainly includes Domain Name System (DNS) and Inter-domain Routing System (Border Gateway Protocol, BGP). The Internet is the main carrier of cyberspace, and ensuring the security of Internet infrastructure is also the key to ensuring the security of cyberspace and maintaining network sovereignty. Comprehensive and in-depth mastery of the attack and defense methods and principles of Internet infrastructure is an important demand for cyberspace security talents. This course cultivates the practical ability of Internet infrastructure security, covering 4 parts: network topology measurement, inter-domain routing security, domain name system security, and secure network protocol design and implementation. For network topology measurement, practical experiments on network topology detection will be carried out, and IP-level topology maps will be drawn for designated network segments; for inter-domain routing security, practical experiments on BGP system attack and defense will be carried out, and prefix hijacking attacks and route leaks will be simulated based on the virtual shooting range platform. Risks, observe the attack process and analyze the impact of the attack, practice BGPSec, RPKI and other protection solutions, and evaluate the protection effect and cost; for domain name system security, we will conduct practical experiments on DNS system attack and defense, and simulate cache poisoning and reflection attacks based on the virtual shooting range platform , observe the attack process and analyze the impact of the attack, practice DNSSEC, DoH and other protection solutions, and evaluate the protection effect and cost; for the design and implementation of secure network protocols, a common network protocol will be selected to design a security protection in the form of group collaboration The solution is implemented and verified based on the ns3 simulation experiment platform. Submit code and reports, and demonstrate the system. By studying this course, students will have solid practical capabilities in Internet infrastructure security and have a deep understanding of relevant attack and defense principles.

default.zh: 软件安全与逆向分析C是网络空间安全专业的一门综合性课程，侧重于增强学生对软件缺陷的本质和恶意代码危害机理的理解，促使学生掌握软件安全的基本理论、分析方法和核心技术，提升学生在软件安全设计、分析和防护方面的实践能力。通过本课程的学习，使得学生掌握软件安全与逆向分析领域相关的基础知识和技能，熟悉软件安全与逆向分析的理论和方法，熟练运用逆向分析的常用工具，认识逆向分析技术在软件漏洞分析、恶意代码检测、安全编程等领域的运用，提高学生在系统设计和软件开发中的网络信息安全意识。
default.en: Software Security and Reverse Analysis C is a comprehensive course in the field of cyberspace security. It focuses on enhancing students' understanding of the nature of software defects and the mechanisms of harm caused by malicious code, enabling them to master the fundamental theories, analytical methods, and core technologies of software security. The course aims to improve students' practical abilities in software security design, analysis, and protection. Through this course, students will acquire the foundational knowledge and skills related to software security and reverse analysis, become familiar with the theories and methods in this field, and gain proficiency in using common reverse analysis tools. They will also learn about the application of reverse analysis techniques in areas such as software vulnerability analysis, malicious code detection, and secure programming, thereby enhancing their awareness of cybersecurity in system design and software development.

default.zh: 《信息物理系统-理论与建模》是物联网工程专业的专业核心课程，目的是使学生初步认识和了解物理世界与信息系统的连接与交互作用方式、信息物理系统（Cyber-Physical System, CPS）的组织与调度方法，建立宏观的信息物理系统概念，掌握物理系统的数学建模方法、计算模型的建模方法、实时调度基本理论、信息物理系统的分解与抽象技术、需求的形式化建模与分析方法，能够为典型信息物理系统正确地建立模型，为学生今后深入学习信息物理系统的设计、验证技术和求解信息物理系统中的科学及工程问题奠定理论基础。
default.en: "Cyber Physical Systems - Theory and Modeling" is a core course in the field of Internet of Things engineering. Its purpose is to enable students to have a preliminary understanding of the connection and interaction between the physical world and information systems, the organization and tuning methods of Cyber Physical Systems (CPS), establish macro concepts of information physical systems, master mathematical modeling methods of physical systems, and modeling methods of computational models The basic theory of real-time scheduling, the decomposition and abstraction techniques of information physical systems, and the formal modeling and analysis methods of requirements can accurately establish models for typical information physical systems, laying a theoretical foundation for students to further study the design, verification techniques, and solving scientific and engineering problems in information physical systems in the future.

default.zh: 从实际软件角度出发，介绍一些相关理论知识，并设计了4个基本任务和1个进阶任务，涉及路径规划、避障、多任务优化、目标识别、跟踪等方面的内容，培养学生良好的自主学习习惯。所有任务都是物联网应用为背景设计实践任务，以多个子任务的形式进阶完善任务功能，引导学生掌握对程序模块化分解的方法。
default.en: From the perspective of practical software, this article introduces some relevant theoretical knowledge and designs four basic tasks and one advanced task, which involve path planning, obstacle avoidance, multi task optimization, target recognition, tracking, and other aspects, in order to cultivate students' good self-directed learning habits. All tasks are designed with the background of IoT applications as practical tasks, which are advanced and improved in the form of multiple subtasks, guiding students to master the method of modular decomposition of programs.

default.zh: 复杂系统建模与分析是人工智能、计算机科学、计算机应用等专业限选课程，目的是使学生初步认识和了解物理世界与信息系统的连接与交互作用方式、复杂系统的组织与调度方法，建立宏观的信息物理系统概念，掌握复杂物理系统的数学建模与分析方法、计算模型的建模方法、实时调度基本理论、信息物理系统的分解与抽象技术，能够为典型信息物理系统正确地建立模型，为学生今后深入学习复杂系统的设计、验证技术和求解复杂系统中的科学及工程问题奠定理论基础。
default.en: Modeling and Analyzing of Complex System is an optional course for majors such as Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, and Computer Applications. Its objective is to help students develop a preliminary understanding of the connection and interaction between the physical world and information systems, as well as the organization and scheduling methods of complex systems. The course aims to establish a macroscopic concept of Cyber-Physical systems, enabling students to master mathematical modeling and analysis methods for complex physical systems, computational modeling techniques, fundamental theories of real-time scheduling, and the decomposition and abstraction techniques of Cyber-Physical systems. Students will learn to correctly model typical Cyber-Physical systems, laying a theoretical foundation for further in-depth study of complex system design, verification technologies, and solving scientific and engineering problems within complex systems.

default.zh: 物联网是我国抢占新一轮经济科技发展制高点的重大战略，万物互联的物联网是未来社会智能化、信息化发展的最终方向。物联网作为新一代信息技术的重要组成部分，引领了继计算机、互联网之后世界信息产业发展的第三次浪潮。物联网系统是我国国家层面技术及产业创新的重点方向，也是我国新型基础设施的重要组成部分。物联网系统课程是物联网工程专业核心课程，将向学生们大视角展现物联网技术体系、知识体系和课程体系的概貌，培养学生们的物理空间与信息空间一体化的计算思维能力和创新意识。本课程系统介绍了物联网系统的起源与发展、概念与特征、体系结构与关键技术，并从物联网系统的“架构-感知-通信-网络-信息处理-应用”六个维度出发，深入讲解物联网系统架构与特征、物联网系统感知技术、物联网系统通信技术、物联网系统网络技术、物联网系统信息处理技术、物联网系统应用等。课程兼顾通识性知识和专业性技术，内容丰富、覆盖面广、难易适度，既可作为物联网工程专业的基础课程，也可作为其他专业的信息技术类通识课程。
default.en: The Internet of Things (IoT) represents a major strategic initiative for China to seize the high ground in the new round of economic and technological development. The interconnected IoT ecosystem embodies the ultimate direction of intelligent and information-driven societal evolution. As a crucial component of next-generation information technology, IoT has spearheaded the third wave of global information industry development following computers and the internet. IoT systems constitute a key focus for national-level technological and industrial innovation in China, as well as an essential part of the country's new infrastructure development. The IoT Systems course serves as a core curriculum for IoT Engineering majors, providing students with a comprehensive perspective on IoT technological frameworks, knowledge systems, and educational structures. It cultivates students' computational thinking capabilities and innovative consciousness in integrating physical and information spaces. This course systematically introduces the origins and evolution of IoT systems, their conceptual definitions and characteristics, architectural frameworks, and critical technologies. Through six analytical dimensions - "Architecture-Sensing-Communication-Networking-Information Processing-Application" - it offers in-depth exploration of: 1. IoT system architectures and characteristics 2. Sensing technologies in IoT systems 3. IoT communication technologies 4. IoT networking technologies 5. Information processing technologies for IoT 6. Practical IoT applications Balancing foundational knowledge with professional technical content, the course features rich subject matter, broad coverage, and appropriately calibrated difficulty levels. It serves both as a fundamental course for IoT Engineering majors and as an interdisciplinary information technology curriculum for other academic programs.

default.zh: 泛在计算原理是物联网专业核心课程之一，面向物联网专业的大三本科生。泛在计算是一种新型的计算模式，它将计算与通信、传感、控制等技术融合在一起，智能化、自适应、无处不在的计算人和环境状态。泛在计算原理课程内容包括：定位技术、传感技术和识别技术三大章节。其中，定位技术主要讲授室外定位技术、室内定位技术、惯性导航技术；传感技术主要讲授各类传感器的原理、计算方法与应用，以及传感器接口技术和非传感器感知技术；识别技术主要讲授视觉识别技术、RFID等其他识别技术。泛在计算原理课程注重理论知识与硬件知识的结合，为学生今后从事物联网方向或其他计算机、自动化、人工智能类研究方向的深入学习和研究打下扎实的基础，并培养学生具备针对泛在计算工程问题提出解决方案或系统的能力，使学生能够综合运用所掌握的泛在计算相关知识、方法和技术，进行实验设计、分析和评价的能力。
default.en: Principles of Ubiquitous Computing is one of the core courses in the Internet of Things major, designed for third-year undergraduate students specializing in IoT. Ubiquitous computing represents a novel computational paradigm that integrates computing with communication, sensing, control, and other technologies to enable intelligent, adaptive, and omnipresent monitoring of human and environmental states. The course content is divided into three main sections: positioning technology, sensing technology, and recognition technology. Positioning Technology: Covers outdoor positioning techniques, indoor positioning systems, and inertial navigation technology. Sensing Technology: Focuses on the principles, computational methods, and applications of various sensors, as well as sensor interface technologies and non-sensor-based perception methods. Recognition Technology: Explores visual recognition technologies, RFID, and other identification systems. The Principles of Ubiquitous Computing course emphasizes the integration of theoretical knowledge and hardware expertise. It aims to lay a solid foundation for students pursuing advanced studies or research in IoT, computer science, automation, artificial intelligence, or related fields. Additionally, the course cultivates students' ability to propose solutions or systems for ubiquitous computing engineering challenges. It equips them with the skills to comprehensively apply acquired knowledge, methodologies, and technologies in experimental design, analysis, and evaluation, fostering problem-solving capabilities in real-world scenarios.

default.zh: 旨在深入探讨嵌入式系统与边缘计算的基本概念、技术架构和应用实践，帮助学生全面理解现代智能计算系统的发展趋势及其技术挑战。课程内容涉及边缘计算的基本概念、架构、技术、嵌入式系统的设计与实现、边缘智能、边缘推理技术、分布式训练技术及大模型优化等关键领域。
default.en: The course "Embedded Systems and Edge Computing" aims to explore the fundamental concepts, technical architecture, and practical applications of embedded systems and edge computing. It helps students gain a comprehensive understanding of the development trends and technical challenges in modern intelligent computing systems. The course covers key areas such as the basics of edge computing, its architecture, technologies, embedded system design and implementation, edge intelligence, edge inference technologies, distributed training techniques, and large model optimization. Through lectures and real-world case studies, students will learn how to integrate edge computing with embedded systems to build efficient, intelligent, and scalable computing solutions. Specifically, the course starts with the basic knowledge of edge computing, introducing its architecture, system design, and relevant operating systems, helping students understand the collaborative role of edge computing between cloud and end devices. In the edge computing technology section, the course explains access technologies, offloading techniques, and caching strategies in detail, analyzing how optimizing transmission mechanisms, offloading strategies, and caching strategies can enhance system performance. In the embedded system section, students will learn about common embedded hardware and software architectures, laying the foundation for system design. Then the course focuses on edge intelligence applications, particularly in image, video, and text domains, and explores advanced technologies such as edge inference, distributed training, and large model optimization. Through these topics, students will not only master core technologies in embedded systems and edge computing but also be equipped to tackle various challenges in the evolving field of technology.

default.zh: 本课程是软件工程专业的一门基础课程，教学内容围绕软件开发过程的需求获取、需求分析、系统分析、系统设计等内容进行组织。教学重点内容是系统分析与系统设计的建模技术和方法。 通过该课程的学习，学生能够理解软件工程思想，掌握软件需求分析、系统分析和系统设计的模型和建模方法，具备运用工程化的思想完成复杂软件系统的分析与设计能力，同时具备撰写需求规格说明书、系统设计说明书等规范化文档的能力。
default.en: This course is a foundation course for software engineering majors. The teaching contents are organized around the requirements acquisition, requirements analysis, system analysis, system design and other contents in the software development process. The teaching focuses on the modeling techniques and methods of system analysis and system design. Through the study of this course, students can understand the idea of software engineering, master the models and modeling methods of software requirements analysis, system analysis and system design, have the ability to complete the analysis and design of complex software systems with the idea of engineering, and have the ability to write standardized documents such as requirements specification and system design specification.

default.zh: 本课程是软件工程专业的一门基础课程，目的是使学生理解软件工程思想，培养学生具有工程化观念，掌握软件开发过程模型和项目管理方法，掌握流行的项目管理方法和工具、软件维护和配置管理方法和工具，使学生具有掌控复杂软件系统开发与管理的综合能力 通过该课程的学习，学生能够掌握软件开发过程模型和项目管理方法，具有管理复杂软件工程项目的综合能力；掌握交流沟通技巧，具备管理团队、组织团队协作的综合能力；能够撰写项目可行性分析报告、项目计划书、项目预算报告等规范化文档。
default.en: This course is a basic course for software engineering majors. Its purpose is to enable students to understand software engineering ideas, cultivate their engineering concepts, master software development process models and project management methods, master popular project management methods and tools, software maintenance and configuration management methods and tools, and enable students to have comprehensive ability to master the development and management of complex software systems. Through this course, students can master the software development process model and project management methods, and have comprehensive ability to manage complex software engineering projects; Mastering communication skills and possessing comprehensive abilities in managing and organizing team collaboration; Able to write standardized documents such as project feasibility analysis reports, project plans, and project budget reports.

default.zh: 《软件架构与中间件A》是软件工程大类的专业核心课程之一，目标是使学生在理解软件工程过程和初步掌握软件开发方法的基础上，进一步学习分析复杂的软件工程领域问题的方法，掌握基于架构思维及中间件技术的复杂软件系统开发方法。本门课程将全面提升学生的工程问题分析能力、系统架构设计能力、软件系统开发能力、软件系统维护能力、面向性能的软件系统开发及优化能力等，将为学生进入软件企业工作和从事软件工程领域科研工作奠定良好的技术基础。 通过本课程的学习，让学生理解软件架构的定义及其重要性，明确软件架构与功能性需求的关系，理解非功能需求对软件质量的重要影响，掌握基本的软件架构设计样式，及分层设计的方法；让学生深入理解不同软件架构设计决策对软件非功能性的满足所提供的不同支持，进而能够针对具体的非功能性需求点对软件架构做出合理的选择并进行评估；让学生明确具体非功能性需求点对不同层面的架构设计与实现的影响，掌握典型的架构设计决策；培养学生在架构设计中的灵活使用当前主流的架构技术及中间件，能够利用这些技术设计/实现具备高并发响应、数据可靠存储、可灵活拓展、可重用、及分布式高效计算等能力的软件系统；掌握针对各项非功能性需求的测试技术、方法与工具，具有对架构设计方案进行评价、分析、优化的能力。
default.en: Software Architecture and Middleware A is one of the core professional course of Software Engineering major. It aims at training the students with the knowledge and skills of analyzing complex software engineering practical issues. This course offers the architecture driven and middleware technique based software implementation methods that are specifically oriented to complex software system development. This course willing to promote students’ abilities of engineering problem analysis, system architecture design, software system development, software system maintenance, and performance-oriented software system development and optimization. This course may help student to gain the fundamental techniques and abilities for working in ICT enterprises or software related research institutes. After this course’s training, the students must fully understand the definition and significance of software architecture and software middleware. They must be clear with the concept and relations of software architecture and functional requirement. They must fully understand important impact of non-functional requirements on software quality, and master the basic software architecture design techniques. Furthermore, the students must be able to make reasonable selection and evaluation of software architecture for specific non-functional requirements. They must be able to use typical architecture design techniques to handle the issues caused by different non-functional requirement and its evolution. The students must master current mainstream architecture technologies and middle wares, and use them in architecture design proficiently. Also, based on these technologies, students can develop the distributed software system that is capable of responding the high concurrency, with reliable data storage ability, scalability, and reusability. At last but not least, the student must master the testing techniques, methods and tools for the non-functional requirements, and have the ability to evaluate, analyze and optimize the architecture design solutions.

default.zh: 《软件测试与质量保障》是一门涉及软件测试和质量保障核心知识的课程，主要介绍软件测试的方法、工具和技术等内容。本课程涵盖了软件测试流程的各个环节，包括测试计划与策略、测试用例设计、测试执行、缺陷管理和度量等。通过本课程的学习，学生将会在软件测试领域掌握一系列的技术和工具，包括测试分析与设计技巧、测试执行及管理策略、自动化测试等。此外，本课程还将涉及质量保障的相关知识和技能，如软件质量度量和分析、质量管理等。
default.en: Software Testing and Quality Assurance is a course that covers the core knowledge of software testing and quality assurance, mainly introducing the methods, tools, and techniques of software testing. This course covers various parts of the software testing process, including test planning and strategy, test case design, test execution, defect management, and measurement. By learning this course, students will master a series of techniques and tools in the field of software testing, including testing analysis and design skills, test execution and management strategies, and automated testing. In addition, this course will also involve the relevant knowledge and skills of quality assurance, such as software quality measurement and analysis, and quality management. By learning this course, students will gain the following abilities and skills: 1.Ability to conduct effective software testing and improve software quality through testing; 2.Ability to develop and implement software testing plans and strategies; 3.Ability to establish high-quality test cases through testing analysis and design skills; 4.Master test execution and management strategies and successfully manage the testing process; 5.Ability to manage and track defects and conduct defect analysis; 6.Understand and apply software quality measurement and management techniques to improve software quality through data analysis.

default.zh: 开源软件开发实践课是软件工程专业的一门专业核心课程，课程目标是通过动手实践，使得计算机领域的学生对于开源软件的开发方法、开发过程和支持技术有深入的了解，对于如何将抽象方法和理论知识结合到工程中有更好的锻炼，对于参与开源软件社区有基本的掌握，提升编程能力，为使用开源软件以及参与开源软件的开发打下基础。
default.en: The course, Open Source Software Development Practice, is an essential core course for software engineering majors that aims to provide students with an extensive comprehension of open source software development practices, processes, and technologies through practical application. Beyond that, it also offers an opportunity to integrate abstract methodologies and theoretical knowledge, which are fundamental for engineering applications, enhancing their programming skills. Furthermore, the course focuses on imparting knowledge on how to participate in open source software communities, providing a foundation for students to use open source software and contribute to its development.

default.zh: “云原生技术实践A”课程是现代软件开发领域中最为前沿的课程之一。它主要着眼于云原生应用开发和管理。课程以“学中做、做中学“为核心理念，通过实际的应用场景，让学员能够更深入的理解和实践云原生技术，课程采用了基于Kubernetes等工具的云原生案例实践，全面让学生了解和掌握云原生技术的应用场景、核心原理、关键概念和重要实践，做到学以致用。 本课程分为理论教学和实践教学两部分内容。 通过本课程理论知识的学习使学生系统的了解云原生技术及相关概念，掌握云原生技术的应用及基础设施的构成。 本课不仅有理论知识的学习，更注重将理论知识与实践结合的过程。通过实践内容的学习，使学生掌握云原生应用开发和部署的全流程，学会使用云原生技术来构建一套通用的互联网系统架构，包括Kubernetes的快速搭建、容器的创建及使用、在云上开发微服务应用，服务的编排及在CI/CD平台上将前端及后端微服务应用自动化部署到云环境中。实践环节以小组的方式完成实践内容，这样可以使学生更好的了解项目中不同角色承担的职责和任务。 通过本课程的学习可以使学生积累更多的云原生实践经验、能够在实际项目中应用所学技能，提升自己的实战能力和职业竞争力，更好地应对现如今的云时代发展趋势。
default.en: The "Cloud Native Technology Practice A" course is one of the most cutting-edge courses in the field of modern software development. It primarily focuses on cloud-native application development and management. The course's core philosophy is "Learning by Doing," which allows students to gain a deeper understanding and practical experience in cloud-native technology through real-world application scenarios. The course uses cloud-native case practices based on tools like Kubernetes to allow students to comprehensively understand and master cloud-native technology's application scenarios, core principles, key concepts, and important practices. The course is divided into two parts: theoretical teaching and practical teaching. The theoretical knowledge section enables students to systematically understand cloud-native technology and related concepts and the application and infrastructure of cloud-native technology. Moreover, the course emphasizes that the combination of theoretical knowledge and practice is essential. Through practical exercises, students will acquire the skills necessary to develop and deploy cloud-native applications entirely. The exercises cover creating and using containers, developing microservice applications on the cloud, service orchestration, and automating deployment of front-end and back-end microservices on a CI/CD platform based on Kubernetes. Students will complete practical exercises in groups to gain a better understanding of the responsibilities and tasks of different roles in the project. Through this course, students can accumulate more practical experience in cloud-native technology. They will be able to apply learned skills to actual projects, thereby enhancing their practical skills and competitiveness in their careers, and better adapt to the current trend of cloud computing development.

default.zh: “云原生技术实践B”课程是现代软件开发领域中最为前沿的课程之一。它主要着眼于云原生应用开发和管理。课程以“学中做、做中学“为核心理念，通过实际的应用场景，让学员能够更深入的理解和实践云原生技术，课程采用了基于Kubernetes等工具的云原生案例实践，全面让学生了解和掌握云原生技术的应用场景、核心原理、关键概念和重要实践，做到学以致用。 本课程分为理论教学和实践教学两部分内容。 通过本课程理论知识的学习使学生系统的了解云原生技术及相关概念，掌握云原生技术的应用及基础设施的构成。 本课不仅有理论知识的学习，更注重将理论知识与实践结合的过程。通过实践内容的学习，使学生掌握云原生应用开发和部署的全流程，学会使用云原生技术来构建一套通用的互联网系统架构，包括Kubernetes的快速搭建、容器的创建及使用、在云上开发微服务应用，服务的编排及在CI/CD平台上将前端及后端微服务应用自动化部署到云环境中。实践环节以小组的方式完成实践内容，这样可以使学生更好的了解项目中不同角色承担的职责和任务。 通过本课程的学习可以使学生积累更多的云原生实践经验、能够在实际项目中应用所学技能，提升自己的实战能力和职业竞争力，更好地应对现如今的云时代发展趋势。
default.en: The "Cloud Native Technology Practice B" course is one of the most cutting-edge courses in the field of modern software development. It primarily focuses on cloud-native application development and management. The course's core philosophy is "Learning by Doing," which allows students to gain a deeper understanding and practical experience in cloud-native technology through real-world application scenarios. The course uses cloud-native case practices based on tools like Kubernetes to allow students to comprehensively understand and master cloud-native technology's application scenarios, core principles, key concepts, and important practices. The course is divided into two parts: theoretical teaching and practical teaching. The theoretical knowledge section enables students to systematically understand cloud-native technology and related concepts and the application and infrastructure of cloud-native technology. Moreover, the course emphasizes that the combination of theoretical knowledge and practice is essential. Through practical exercises, students will acquire the skills necessary to develop and deploy cloud-native applications entirely. The exercises cover creating and using containers, developing microservice applications on the cloud, service orchestration, and automating deployment of front-end and back-end microservices on a CI/CD platform based on Kubernetes. Students will complete practical exercises in groups to gain a better understanding of the responsibilities and tasks of different roles in the project. Through this course, students can accumulate more practical experience in cloud-native technology. They will be able to apply learned skills to actual projects, thereby enhancing their practical skills and competitiveness in their careers, and better adapt to the current trend of cloud computing development.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22CS31308 课程名称：软件过程与项目管理C 总学时： 40 理论学时： 32 实验学时： 8 上机学时： 0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时： 0 学分：2.5 开课单位：软件学院 授课对象：软件工程专业3年级本科生 开课学期：3秋 先修课程：高级语言程序设计、面向对象编程语言（Java程序设计/C++程序设计）、软件工程专业导论 二、课程简介 本课程是软件工程专业的一门基础课程，教学内容围绕软件开发过程的需求获取、需求分析、系统分析、系统设计、软件过程模型及项目管理等内容进行组织。教学重点内容是系统分析与系统设计的建模技术和方法、敏捷开发模型及应用等。 通过该课程的学习，目的是使学生理解软件工程思想，培养学生具有工程化观念。掌握软件需求分析、系统分析和系统设计的模型和建模方法，掌握软件开发过程模型和项目管理方法，掌握流行的项目管理方法和工具、软件维护和配置管理方法和工具，使学生具有掌控复杂软件系统开发与管理的综合能力，掌握交流沟通技巧，具备管理团队、组织团队协作的综合能力。能够撰写项目可行性分析报告、项目计划书、项目预算报告等规范化文档。
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22CS31308 Course Title： Software Process and Project Management C Credit Hours： 40 Lecture： 32 Lab： 8 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 2.5 Offering Department: School of Software Students: 3nd year undergraduate student majoring in software engineering Term: Fall, 3nd year; Open Prerequisites: Advanced Language Programming, Object-Oriented Programming Languages (Java Programming / C++ Programming)，Introduction to Software Engineering Major 2.Course Description This course is a foundational course in the Software Engineering major. The teaching content is organized around the processes of software development, including requirements acquisition, requirements analysis, system analysis, system design, software process models, and project management. The key focuses of the course are the modeling techniques and methods for system analysis and design, agile development models, and their applications. The objective of this course is to enable students to understand the principles of software engineering and to cultivate an engineering mindset. Students will master the models and modeling methods for software requirements analysis, system analysis, and system design. They will also gain proficiency in software development process models and project management methods. Additionally, students will learn popular project management methods and tools, as well as methods and tools for software maintenance and configuration management. This course aims to equip students with the comprehensive ability to manage and develop complex software systems, effective communication skills, and the ability to manage and organize team collaboration. Students will also be able to write standardized documents such as project feasibility analysis reports, project plans, and project budget reports.

default.zh: 本课程是软件工程或计算机大类的专业核心课程之一，目标是使学生在理解软件工程过程和初步掌握软件开发方法的基础上，进一步学习分析复杂的软件工程领域问题的方法，掌握基于架构思维及中间件技术的复杂软件系统开发方法。本门课程将全面提升学生的工程问题分析能力、系统架构设计能力、软件系统开发能力、软件系统维护能力、面向性能的软件系统开发及优化能力等，将为学生进入软件企业工作和从事软件工程领域科研工作奠定良好的技术基础。 通过本课程的学习，让学生理解软件架构的定义及其重要性，明确软件架构与功能性需求的关系，理解非功能需求对软件质量的重要影响，掌握基本的软件架构设计样式，及分层设计的方法；让学生深入理解不同软件架构设计决策对软件非功能性的满足所提供的不同支持，进而能够针对具体的非功能性需求点对软件架构做出合理的选择并进行评估；让学生明确具体非功能性需求点对不同层面的架构设计与实现的影响，掌握典型的架构设计决策；培养学生在架构设计中的灵活使用当前主流的架构技术及中间件，能够利用这些技术设计/实现具备高并发响应、数据可靠存储、可灵活拓展、可重用、及分布式高效计算等能力的软件系统；掌握针对各项非功能性需求的测试技术、方法与工具，具有对架构设计方案进行评价、分析、优化的能力。
default.en: This course is one of the core professional course of Software Engineering/ Compute Science major. It aims at training the students with the knowledge and skills of analyzing complex software engineering practical issues. This course offers the architecture driven and middleware technique based software implementation methods that are specifically oriented to complex software system development. This course willing to promote students’ abilities of engineering problem analysis, system architecture design, software system development, software system maintenance, and performance-oriented software system development and optimization. This course may help student to gain the fundamental techniques and abilities for working in ICT enterprises or software related research institutes. After this course’s training, the students must fully understand the definition and significance of software architecture and software middleware. They must be clear with the concept and relations of software architecture and functional requirement. They must fully understand important impact of non-functional requirements on software quality, and master the basic software architecture design techniques. Furthermore, the students must be able to make reasonable selection and evaluation of software architecture for specific non-functional requirements. They must be able to use typical architecture design techniques to handle the issues caused by different non-functional requirement and its evolution. The students must master current mainstream architecture technologies and middle wares, and use them in architecture design proficiently. Also, based on these technologies, students can develop the distributed software system that is capable of responding the high concurrency, with reliable data storage ability, scalability, and reusability. At last but not least, the student must master the testing techniques, methods and tools for the non-functional requirements, and have the ability to evaluate, analyze and optimize the architecture design solutions.

default.zh: 本课程面向人工智能相关专业本科生开设。该课程分为基础技术和高级技术两部分。基础技术 是信息检索这门课必须掌握的基本概念、基本原理和基本技能。高级技术部分是近年来出现的新的 检索方法或者新的研究动态。基础技术包括:绪论、经典信息检索模型、信息检索的评价、查询(Query) 处理与扩展技术、索引与匹配技术、Web 检索与排序算法。高级技术包括:交互式推荐系统，检索 增强生成(RAG)技术。通过本课程的学习，学生将系统掌握智能检索与生成领域的基本算法与核 心理论，了解常用的关键技术方法，建立起完整的知识体系。课程注重理论与实践相结合，培养学 生具备智能检索与生成系统的开发能力，为其今后从事信息检索及相关领域的研发工作奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students in Artificial Intelligence and related majors. The course is divided into two parts: Fundamental Techniques and Advanced Techniques. The Fundamental Techniques are the basic concepts, principles, and skills that must be mastered in the subject of information retrieval. The Advanced Techniques part covers newly emerging retrieval methods or recent research trends. The Fundamental Techniques include: Introduction, Classical Information Retrieval Models, Evaluation of Information Retrieval, Query Processing and Expansion Techniques, Indexing and Matching Techniques, Web Retrieval and Ranking Algorithms. The Advanced Techniques include: Interactive Recommendation Systems, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Technology. Through studying this course, students will systematically master the fundamental algorithms and core theories in the field of intelligent retrieval and generation, understand commonly used key technical methods, and establish a complete knowledge system. The course emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, cultivating students' development capabilities for intelligent retrieval and generation systems, laying a solid foundation for their future work in research and development in the field of information retrieval and related areas.

default.zh: 计算建模在现代计算机科学中起着重要的作用，是计算机大类的一门专业核心课程。在现代计算机科学与技术中面临复杂的科学与工程问题，其中复杂的结构化和非结构化大数据普遍存在。要想快速有效的解决这样的复杂大数据问题，首先需要为实际问题抽象出数学模型，并能够形式化描述问题的本质和规律。本课程所包括的随机化和概率统计技术能够给建模、分析和处理这些大数据，提供强有力的描述工具和技术手段。计算建模的应用范围包括机器学习、安全协议、大数据处理、生物计算和人工智能应用等相关领域。课程核心内容包括随机变量分布和密度函数、随机采样、参数估计、经典的随机过程、随机数生成与蒙特卡洛方法、马尔科夫链和随机游走、随机模拟、随机场等内容。对连续和离散随机信号的分析和计算方法进行了全面的介绍。课程在介绍随机计算理论的基础上，对相关理论和技术的数值计算和模拟，以及对其中经典算法在现代计算机科学与技术中的实际应用也进行了较详细的描述。通过本课程的学习，学生对随机信号及处理有充分的理论储备，对后续的随机算法和其它课程的学习有很好的铺垫。课程适用于高年级本科生和研究生。
default.en: Computation modelling plays an important role in modern computer science. It is a professional kernel curriculum. There are many structural and non-structural big data in complex engineering problems in modern computer. In order to solve these problems effectively and efficiently, it is necessary that you can model these problems into mathematical formal representation and simulate them by computational methods. Randomizing and probability statistics techniques in this course provide the powerful tools and technical methods to model, analyze and process these big data. It is commonly used in machine learning, secure protocols, big data processing, biometrics computing and artificial intelligence et. al. Its main contents include random variable distribution and density function, random sampling techniques, parameters estimation, classical random process, random number generation, Monte Carlo methods, Markov chains and random walks, random simulation, random fields and so on. It not only introduces the analysis and computation methods of continuous and discrete signal but also describes the numerical computation and simulation techniques. In addition, it also takes some practical applications in computer science as examples to demonstrate the power of random computing. All in all, this course gives a rigorous yet accessible treatment of the related topics in random signal processing. With its comprehensive selection of topics, along with many examples and exercises, this course is an indispensable for continuing learning other related courses, such as random algorithms.

default.zh: 本课程围绕随机算法设计与分析的理论、方法和技术展开。随机算法在近二十多年来从单纯的数论理论演变成为一整套工具和技术，并被越来越多地应用到各种信息技术中。随机算法的三大特性：简洁性、高效性和健壮性正是这种演变的源动力。本课程旨在为本科学生介绍高级算法的基本概念、随机算法设计和分析的主要技术和工具，以及随机算法的典型应用。 课程以随机算法设计和分析技术和工具作为主线，穿插随机算法的典型应用。要讲授的技术和工具主要包括：博弈论技术、矩与方差、球与箱子模型、概率方法、马尔科夫链与随机游走、蒙特卡罗方法、代数技术等；而主要应用包括网页去重、随即图、流算法、在线算法等。
default.en: The last twenty five years have witnessed a tremendous growth in the area of randomized algorithms. During this period, randomized algorithms have gone from being a tool in computational number theory to a mainstream set of tools and techniques with widespread application. Three benefits of randomization have spearheaded this growth: simplicity, speed, and robustness to input parameters. This course presents the basic concepts in the design and analysis of randomized algorithms at a level accessible to advanced undergraduates and to graduate students. The course will be organized into two interleaved parts. The first thread will develop basic probabilistic tools that are recurrent in algorithmic applications. The second thread will focus on specific areas of application. Applications will be given along with each tool to illustrate it in concrete settings.

default.zh: 随着多核处理器和高性能计算系统的发展，并行计算已经成为计算机科学与工程领域的必要基础之一。本课程介绍并行计算的理论、概念和技术，讨论并行计算机系统结构、并行算法和并行编程方法。主要内容包括：并行计算机的发展和分类，并行程序设计基础，OpenMP、MPI和CUDA等并行编程，并行程序性能分析和优化等。目标是使学生了解并行计算机的系统结构特征和并行计算的基本原理，掌握并行算法的设计、分析和编程实现方法，培养面向高性能计算系统的并行程序设计和优化人才。
default.en: With the development of multi-core processors and high-performance computing systems, parallel computing has become one of the necessary foundations in the field of computer science and engineering. This course introduces the theory, concept and technology of parallel computing, and discusses the system structure, parallel algorithm and parallel programming method of parallel computer. The main contents include the development and classification of parallel computers, basis of parallel programming, parallel programming methods such as OpenMP, MPI and CUDA, parallel program performance analysis and optimization, etc. The goal of this course is to enable students to understand the characteristics of the system architecture of parallel computers and the basic principles of parallel computing, master the design, analysis and programming methods of parallel algorithms, and cultivate talents for parallel programming and optimization of high-performance computing system.

default.zh: 本课程是计算机类的专业选修课程。本课程主要内容包括：分布式系统的分类、特征、分布式文件系统、分布式事务处理、分布式共识的基本概念与基础理论、典型的分布式共识算法，以及典型的分布式系统；针对分布式通信、分布式计算、基于投票分布式共识等理论方法，结合具体的分布式应用场景进行上机实验，达到理论和实践有机结合，使学生能够从认识理解分布式系统的复杂性与不确定性，掌握分布式系统钟同步算法、掌握选举算法、互斥算法、以及典型的分布式共识算法，培养学生针对不同分布式场景问题，选择优化应用分布式算法求解问题能力，提高学生分布式系统修养，为以后科研与实践打下坚实基础。
default.en: This course is an elective course in the field of computer science. The main content of this course includes: the classification and characteristics of distributed systems, distributed file systems, distributed transaction processing, fundamental concepts and foundational theories of distributed consensus, typical distributed consensus algorithms, and typical distributed systems. Through hands-on experiments involving theoretical methods such as distributed communication, distributed computing, and voting-based distributed consensus, combined with specific distributed application scenarios, the course aims to achieve an organic integration of theory and practice. This enables students to understand the complexity and uncertainty of distributed systems, master distributed system clock synchronization algorithms, election algorithms, mutual exclusion algorithms, and typical distributed consensus algorithms. It also cultivates students' ability to choose and optimize distributed algorithms for solving problems in different distributed scenarios, enhances their understanding of distributed systems, and lays a solid foundation for future research and practical applications.

default.zh: 语音处理是研究语音发声过程、语音信号的统计特性、语音的自动识别、机器合成以及语音感知等各种处理技术的总称，也是人工智能技术的一个重要应用领域，得到了研究者们的广泛关注，新技术新方法不断涌现。《智能语音处理》是面向计算学部学生的专业选修课程。以智能语音处理过程的总体框架为线索，全面阐述语音领域各项智能处理技术。培养学生树立智能语音处理领域的基本观念、基础概念、数学基础和专业理论与方法，建立起专业的思维方式和解决问题的领域专业素养。掌握数字信号处理的定义、采集、运算方法；掌握语音信号的表示和分析方法、语音的产生模型和感知模型，语音信号处理的关键技术：语音识别、语音合成、语音编码和说话人识别等。培养学生研究兴趣和科研动手能力，为今后开展本领域的科研开发工作形成完善的知识储备。
default.en: Speech processing is a general term for various processing technologies such as the study of speech production process, statistical characteristics of speech signals, automatic speech recognition, machine synthesis, and speech perception. It is also an important application field of artificial intelligence technology and has received widespread attention from researchers, with new technologies and methods constantly emerging. Intelligent Speech Processing is a professional elective course aimed at students in the faculty of computing. Taking the overall framework of intelligent speech processing as a clue, comprehensively elaborate on various intelligent processing technologies in the field of speech. Cultivate students to establish basic concepts, mathematical foundations, and professional theories and methods in the field of intelligent speech processing, and establish professional thinking patterns and problem-solving skills. Master the definition, acquisition, and operation methods of digital signal processing; Master the representation and analysis methods of speech signals, the generation and perception models of speech, and the key technologies of speech signal processing, such as speech recognition, speech synthesis, speech coding, and speaker recognition. Cultivate students' research interests and practical research abilities, and form a comprehensive knowledge reserve for future scientific research and development in this field.

default.zh: 自然语言被认为是思维的物质外壳，是最理想的人机交互方式。自然语言处理（即利用计算机自动处理人类语言）被视为"人工智能皇冠上的明珠"，是目前人工智能中的一个前沿技术。 《自然语言处理》是人工智能方向中的一门专业课，课程基于人工智能、机器学习的理论和方法对人类语言信息进行智能处理，实现自然语言的自动理解，提供更自然的人机交互方式。 该课程的目的是使学生理解计算机处理人类语言的基本原理，了解和掌握利用深度学习和预训练策略对自然语言建模和计算的常用方法，为学生今后设计、开发面向自然语言的人工智能应用系统奠定技术基础，提高学生的形式化思维、计算建模能力。 课程主要内容包括： 1．自然语言处理的核心知识，包括自然语言处理的基本概念、语言模型、子词切分、分布式表示、深度学习和Transformer模型。 2．大规模语言模型的核心知识，包括提示学习、语境学习、思维链以及基于人类反馈的强化学习等。
default.en: Natural language as the tool and means of thinking is regarded as the most ideal way of human-computer interaction. Natural language processing (ie, using computers to automatically process human language) is considered as the "crown jewel of artificial intelligence" and is currently a cutting-edge technology in artificial intelligence. "Natural Language Processing" is a core course for artificial intelligence major. Based on the theories and methods of artificial intelligence and machine learning, the course is focused on automatic understanding of natural language, so as to providing a more natural way of human-computer interaction. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the basic principles of computer processing of human language, and master common methods of modeling natural language via deep learning and pre-training strategies. It is commissioned to lay a technical foundation for students to design and develop artificial intelligence application systems for natural language in the future, and improve students' formal thinking and computational modeling capabilities. The main contents of the course include: 1. Core knowledge of natural language processing, including basic concepts of natural language processing, language models, sub-word segmentation, distributed representations, deep learning, and Transformer models. 2. Core knowledge of large language models, including prompt learning, contextual learning, chains of thought, and reinforcement learning based on human feedback.

default.zh: 信息检索技术是自然语言处理中的一个重要的内容，在自动文摘、情感分析、智能问答、用户 画像等领域有着重要的应用，为学生们后续从事与自然语言处理技术相关的科研工作打下基础。本 课程是一门针对高年级本科生的专业课，主要讲授信息检索基本模型及相关理论。课程的内容包括: 经典的信息检索模型，如布尔模型、向量空间模型等;检索技术的评价方法和评价指标;文本处理和查询扩展等相关技术;索引的建立方法及检索过程中采用的一些数据结构及方法;针对互联网的 Web 检索技术及排序。本课程可以帮助学生了解信息检索技术的基本概念、发展历史及其在未来工 作中的应用，掌握基础的信息检索理论和相关技术，结合人工智能、机器学习、语言处理技术对信 息进行加工处理，并能够对系统进行合理的评价与分析。为学生今后设计、开发基于检索技术的应 用系统奠定技术基础，提高学生形式化思维、建模的能力。
default.en: Information retrieval is an important aspect of natural language processing, with important applications in fields such as automatic summarization, sentiment analysis, intelligent question answering, and user profiling, laying the foundation for students to engage in scientific research related to natural language processing technology in the future. This course is a professional course aimed at senior undergraduate students, mainly teaching the basic models and related theories of information retrieval. The course content includes: classic information retrieval models, such as Boolean models, vector space models, etc.; The evaluation methods and indicators of retrieval technology; Text processing and query expansion related technologies; The methods for establishing indexes and the data structures and methods used in the retrieval process; Web search technology and Ranking. This course can help students understand the basic concepts, development history, and future applications of information retrieval technology, master basic information retrieval theories and related technologies, combine artificial intelligence, machine learning, and language processing technologies to process information, and be able to conduct reasonable evaluation and analysis of the system. To lay a technical foundation for students to design and develop application systems based on retrieval technology in the future, and improve their formal thinking and modeling abilities.

default.zh: 计算机视觉是人工智能领域的重要分支，主要涉及利用计算机和人工智能技术模仿人类视觉系统，并处理、分析、理解和决策图像或视频等视觉信息的理论、方法和技术。近年来，计算机视觉在理论研究和应用落地等层面都取得了重要进展，并已广泛应用于人们的生产和生活中。 本课程旨在系统讲授计算机视觉领域的基本概念、原理和技术框架，揭示计算机视觉的科学内涵，并初步探讨它们在工业检测、无人驾驶、智能安防、医学图像、数码娱乐等人工智能领域的前沿应用和发展趋势。同时，本课程致力于培养学生在计算机视觉领域的专业技能，拓展学术视野，为其未来的学术研究和职业发展奠定坚实基础。 通过本课程的学习，学生将理解和掌握计算机视觉的基本原理和概念，包括图像滤波、特征检测、拟合与匹配、图像分类、分割、光流和立体视觉等核心算法；掌握基于深度学习的计算机视觉工具，并将其应用于图像识别、检测与分析等典型视觉任务场景。 本课程适用于本科三年级的学生，先修课程包括微积分、代数与几何、概率论与数理统计和高级语言程序设计等。本课程的授课教师具有丰富的教学经验和计算机视觉领域的背景。课程学时为32学时，其中理论授课24学时，实验实践8学时。课程内容由浅入深，难度水平逐步提升，学生需要在规定的时间内完成相应的作业和实验任务。本课程将采用多种教学方法，包括课堂讲授、案例分析、小组讨论和课程实验，以帮助学生全面理解和掌握计算机视觉相关知识，并培养解决实际问题的能力。本课程的考核方式包括平时成绩、实验成绩和期末考试。平时成绩包括课堂表现、出勤情况和课后作业；实验成绩包括实验课的表现和实验完成情况等；期末考试包括期末考试成绩等。 随着人工智能技术的不断发展，计算机视觉领域的研究和应用也将不断深化和拓展。本课程的目的是为学生打下坚实的计算机视觉理论基础，并培养学生在实际应用中的创新能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将具备计算机视觉领域的基本知识和技能，能够在未来的科研和工作中学以致用。
default.en: Computer vision represents a formidable subfield within artificial intelligence, encompassing the development of theories, methods, and sophisticated techniques that enable computers to emulate the human visual apparatus. This domain leverages the prowess of artificial intelligence to interpret, analyze, and make informed decisions based on visual data, including images and videos. The recent advancement of computer vision has been remarkable, showcasing significant strides in both theoretical foundations and practical applications, permeating through various facets of industrial production and everyday life. The objective of this course is to deliver a coherent and comprehensive exposition of the fundamental notions, underlying principles, and technical infrastructure intrinsic to computer vision. It aims to unravel the scientific essence of the discipline and acquaint students with the forefront of computer vision applications, such as autonomous vehicular technology, intelligent surveillance, medical imaging analytics, and the burgeoning sector of digital entertainment. Concurrently, this curriculum is designed to hone the students' expertise in computer vision, broaden their academic vista, and establish a robust groundwork for their scholarly inquiries and professional pursuits. Throughout the course, participants will gain fluency in the core tenets of computer vision. This includes a thorough treatment of image filtering, feature extraction, pattern fitting and matching, image categorization, segmentation, optical flow, and stereo vision principles. Students will become adept with prevalent computer vision instruments and deploy them across various visual processing tasks, including but not limited to facial recognition, object identification, and comprehensive image analysis. This curriculum is tailored for third-year undergraduate scholars, presupposing proficiency in calculus, algebra, geometry, probability theory, mathematical statistics, and advanced programming languages. Our seasoned instructors bring a wealth of pedagogical experience and domain-specific expertise. The course spans 32 instructional hours—24 dedicated to theoretical instruction and 8 to practical laboratory work. The curriculum is structured to progressively intensify in complexity, with students expected to fulfill designated homework and laboratory assignments within established timelines. Our pedagogical approach, encompassing lectures, case studies, collaborative discourse, and hands-on experimentation, is intended to facilitate a deep-rooted comprehension of computer vision and to nurture practical problem-solving capabilities. The evaluative framework of this course comprises continuous assessment, laboratory performance, and a culminating examination. Continuous assessment entails classroom engagement, attendance, and homework submission. The laboratory grade reflects students' experimental diligence and achievements. The final examination will gauge the comprehensive understanding of the course material. With artificial intelligence continually evolving, the scope and depth of computer vision research and applications are set to broaden. This course aspires to solidify students' theoretical knowledge in computer vision and foster innovative acumen in its application. Upon completion, students will possess the essential acumen and technical skill set pertinent to computer vision, equipping them for subsequent research endeavors and professional engagements.

default.zh: 语音处理是研究语音发声过程、语音信号的统计特性、语音的自动识别、机器合成以及语音感知等各种处理技术的总称，也是人工智能技术的一个重要应用领域，得到了研究者们的广泛关注，新技术新方法不断涌现。《智能语音处理》是面向计算学部学生的专业选修课程。以智能语音处理过程的总体框架为线索，全面阐述语音领域各项智能处理技术。培养学生树立智能语音处理领域的基本观念、基础概念、数学基础和专业理论与方法，建立起专业的思维方式和解决问题的领域专业素养。掌握数字信号处理的定义、采集、运算方法；掌握语音信号的表示和分析方法、语音的产生模型和感知模型，语音信号处理的关键技术：语音识别、语音合成、语音编码和说话人识别等。培养学生研究兴趣和科研动手能力，为今后开展本领域的科研开发工作形成完善的知识储备。
default.en: Speech processing is a general term for various processing technologies such as the study of speech production process, statistical characteristics of speech signals, automatic speech recognition, machine synthesis, and speech perception. It is also an important application field of artificial intelligence technology and has received widespread attention from researchers, with new technologies and methods constantly emerging. Intelligent Speech Processing is a professional elective course aimed at students in the faculty of computing. Taking the overall framework of intelligent speech processing as a clue, comprehensively elaborate on various intelligent processing technologies in the field of speech. Cultivate students to establish basic concepts, mathematical foundations, and professional theories and methods in the field of intelligent speech processing, and establish professional thinking patterns and problem-solving skills. Master the definition, acquisition, and operation methods of digital signal processing; Master the representation and analysis methods of speech signals, the generation and perception models of speech, and the key technologies of speech signal processing, such as speech recognition, speech synthesis, speech coding, and speaker recognition. Cultivate students' research interests and practical research abilities, and form a comprehensive knowledge reserve for future scientific research and development in this field.

default.zh: 《数字媒体处理技术》是人工智能大类专业和计算机大类专业的一门专业核心课程，目的是使学生了解数字媒体系统的基本组成，掌握数字媒体技术的基本内容，理解并掌握媒体的获取、存储、处理、分析与应用的关键技术与算法，在此基础上，能够设计并实现具有对上述技术与算法进行组合应用的数字媒体系统，并具备对系统以及关键技术与算法进行分析与评价的能力。能够阅读最新的多媒体技术方面的论文，从而能够设计和实现基于数字媒体的复杂工程问题。
default.en: The course "Digital Media Processing Technology" is a core course for majors in Artificial Intelligence and Computer Science. Its aim is to help students understand the basic components of digital media systems, master the fundamental content of digital media technology, comprehend and master the key technologies and algorithms for media acquisition, storage, processing, analysis, and application. Based on this foundation, students should be able to design and implement digital media systems that combine the above technologies and algorithms, as well as possess the ability to analyze and evaluate systems and key technologies and algorithms. They should also be able to read the latest papers on multimedia technology in order to design and implement solutions to complex engineering problems based on digital media.

default.zh: 图形学与虚拟现实作为专业选修课，是许多后续课程（如图像处理、模式识别、多媒体技术、计算机视觉等）的理论基础。本课程旨在使学生能够全面认识和理解计算机图形学和虚拟现实技术的研究内容及其应用方向。学生将了解计算机图形学与图像处理、模式识别、计算几何等相关学科的关系，掌握基本图形生成算法、图形变换与裁剪、图形建模与表示、真实感图形生成算法等知识，并了解计算机图形学的前沿进展。 通过本课程学习，学生将通过编写算法实现程序加深对图形学基本内容的理解，提高理论指导实践的能力。本课程旨在培养学生利用计算机进行图形生成、处理和显示算法设计与实现的能力，掌握“问题分析—算法设计—编程实现”的思想、技术和方法。这将为学生今后学习其他相关课程和从事计算机图形学及其应用方面的研究打下坚实基础。
default.en: As an elective course for majors, Graphics and Virtual Reality serve as the theoretical foundation for many subsequent courses, such as Image Processing, Pattern Recognition, Multimedia Technology, and Computer Vision. The course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the research content and application directions of computer graphics and virtual reality technology. Students will explore the relationship between computer graphics and related disciplines such as image processing, pattern recognition, and computational geometry. They will also acquire knowledge of fundamental graphics generation algorithms, graphics transformation and clipping, graphics modeling and representation, as well as realistic graphics generation algorithms, and stay informed about the latest developments in computer graphics. Throughout the course, students will deepen their understanding of fundamental graphics concepts by implementing algorithms and enhancing their ability to apply theory to practice. The course aims to cultivate students' ability to design and implement graphics generation, processing, and display algorithms using computers, while mastering the thought process, techniques, and methods of "problem analysis—algorithm design—programming implementation". This will lay a solid foundation for students to study other related courses and engage in research in the field of computer graphics and its applications in the future.

default.zh: 《神经计算与类脑智能原理》课程是人工智能专业开设的一门面向前沿技术与最新计算思维理论体系的专业限选课，旨在为智能科学与技术专业学生建立类脑智能理论、神经计算的理论、科研思维框架、相关领域前沿技术的知识体系，并提供基础的类脑智能、神经计算方法设计实战技能训练。本课程的教学内容主要包括神经计算基础、深度神经计算、广度神经计算、脉冲神经网络计算、类脑认知与类脑智能等五部分核心内容，围绕类脑智能的理论依据与实现方法两大主题，由微观到宏观、面向不同的智能处理场景逐次阐述，同时还穿插了神经优化、逻辑推理、知识工程等内容的介绍。 本课程的教学目标是使学生了解及掌握理解神经元的编码与信息处理机制、神经元的数学模型与简单神经网络、自然感知原理与机制的计算机实现方法、类脑归纳学习与推理原则、学习理论与知识表达等相关内容，并通过实验课程深化理解相关知识、能够学以致用。通过本课程的教学，使学生掌握基础的类脑计算与认知系统体系结构、了解相关领域的前沿知识并初步具备类脑计算的科学思维方法；通过本课程的学习，学生应建立系统的神经计算与类脑智能科研知识架构，并初步具备将脑认知机制应用于计算机算法设计的能力。
default.en: This is an elective course offered by the artificial intelligence major, aimed at providing students in the field of intelligent science and technology with a knowledge system of brain like intelligence theory, neural computing theory, research thinking framework, and cutting-edge technologies in related fields. It also provides basic training in practical skills for designing brain like intelligence and neural computing methods. The teaching content of this course mainly includes five core parts: Fundamentals of Neural Computing, Deep Neural Computing, Breadth Neural Computing, Pulse Neural Network Computing, Brain like Cognition, and Brain like Intelligence. It revolves around two main themes of the theoretical basis and implementation methods of Brain like Intelligence, and elaborates on different intelligent processing scenarios from micro to macro, with introductions to neural optimization, logical reasoning, knowledge engineering, and other content interspersed. The teaching objective of this course is to enable students to understand and master the encoding and information processing mechanisms of neurons, mathematical models and simple neural networks of neurons, computer implementation methods of natural perception principles and mechanisms, principles of brain like inductive learning and reasoning, learning theories and knowledge expression, and other related content. Through experimental courses, students will deepen their understanding of relevant knowledge and be able to apply what they have learned. Through the teaching of this course, students will master the basic brain like computing and cognitive system architecture, understand the cutting-edge knowledge in related fields, and have a preliminary understanding of the scientific thinking methods of brain like computing; Through the study of this course, students should establish a systematic knowledge framework for neural computing and neuromorphic intelligence research, and have a preliminary ability to apply brain cognitive mechanisms to computer algorithm design.

default.zh: 脑机接口是认知神经科学和工程技术学科交叉产生的一项具有深远意义的创新性发明。作为人机交互的新技术，它在医疗、娱乐乃至国防领域有着广泛的应用前景。脑机接口为科学家揭示大脑奥秘提供了一个强有力的平台。正在逐渐影响着人类生活的方方面面，是信息科学技术发展的未来与热点。 本课程是计算机专业本科生选修课，使学生了解脑-机接口（BCI）的基本原理和应用，为后续深入研究打下基础。教学内容包括：神经心理学基础、脑活动信号的处理技术、基于ECOG的脑机接口技术、基于EEG的脑机接口技术、脑机接口的应用及展望等；开展基于P300的BCI和基于SSVEP的BCI两项实验内容。 本课程将引导学生到一个全新的知识领域进行探索性研究，需要学生综合运用本科阶段所学的计算机、数学以及物理知识，在全新的知识领域进行探索性研究的尝试，培养学生科学精神和科研实践能力。
default.en: Brain computer interface is an innovative invention with profound significance that emerged from the intersection of cognitive neuroscience and engineering technology disciplines. As a new technology of human-computer interaction, it has broad application prospects in medical, entertainment, and even national defense fields. The brain computer interface provides a powerful platform for scientists to reveal the mysteries of the brain. It is gradually affecting all aspects of human life and is the future and hotspot of information science and technology development. This course is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in computer science, which enables them to understand the basic principles and applications of Brain Computer Interface (BCI), laying a foundation for further in-depth research. The teaching content includes: Fundamentals of neuropsychology, processing techniques for brain activity signals, ECOG based brain computer interface technology, EEG based brain computer interface technology, applications and prospects of brain computer interfaces, etc; Conduct two experimental contents: P300 based BCI and SSVEP based BCI. This course will guide students to conduct exploratory research in a completely new field of knowledge. Students need to comprehensively apply their undergraduate knowledge of computer, mathematics, and physics to attempt exploratory research in a new field of knowledge, cultivating their scientific spirit and practical research abilities.

default.zh: 本课程面向人工智能、计算机科学与技术等相关专业本科生，系统讲解大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的核心技术原理、开发实践与前沿应用，培养兼具理论深度、工程能力和伦理意识的复合型人才。课程以“从原理到产业，从代码到责任”为主线，聚焦大模型领域的四大大核心环节——预训练、微调、对齐、部署评测，结合学术界最新成果与工业界落地场景，构建“学-做-思”一体化的知识体系。
default.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students in artificial intelligence, computer science, and related fields. It systematically explores the core technical principles, development practices, and cutting-edge applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), cultivating interdisciplinary talents with theoretical depth, engineering capabilities, and ethical awareness. Following the thread of "from principles to industry, from code to responsibility," the course focuses on four core LLM development phases—pre-training, fine-tuning, alignment, and deployment/evaluation—integrating the latest academic achievements with industrial implementation scenarios to build a "learn-do-reflect" integrated knowledge system.

default.zh: 本课程旨在研究人工智能内容生成（AIGC）的核心技术与应用，帮助学生掌握变分自编码器、生成对抗网络、扩散模型等前沿技术的核心原理，理解自然语言生成、视觉生成与编辑、多模态生成等技术的基本原理与实现方法。课程还将探讨 AIGC 技术在科学计算、元宇宙、具身智能等领域的广泛应用与最新进展，并引导学生关注 AIGC 技术的社会责任，树立安全使用和伦理审视的意识。 通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握 AIGC 的基本概念、技术框架及研究热点，熟悉其在文本、图像、音频等领域的实际应用；具备将实际问题抽象化并运用 AIGC 技术进行求解与分析的能力；能够设计、开发和优化相关系统，解决复杂问题；同时培养创新能力与国际视野，为进一步学习相关课程或从事人工智能生成方面的研究打下坚实基础。
default.en: This course aims to explore the core technologies and applications of Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC). It equips students with an understanding of the fundamental principles of cutting-edge technologies such as Variational Autoencoders, Generative Adversarial Networks, and Diffusion Models. Students will learn the basic principles and implementation methods of natural language generation, visual content generation and editing, as well as multimodal generation. The course will also investigate the wide-ranging applications and latest advancements of AIGC technologies in fields such as scientific computing, the metaverse, and embodied intelligence. Additionally, it will guide students to consider the social responsibilities of AIGC technologies, fostering awareness of safe usage and ethical considerations. Through this course, students will master the basic concepts, technical frameworks, and research hotspots of AIGC, and become familiar with its practical applications in text, image, and audio generation. They will develop the ability to abstract complex real-world problems, apply AIGC technologies for problem-solving and analysis, and design, develop, and optimize related systems to address complex challenges. Furthermore, the course will cultivate students' innovative capabilities and global perspectives, laying a solid foundation for further studies in related fields or research in artificial intelligence content generation.

default.zh: 大数据系统主要讲解大数据系统的技术原理和应用。通过本课学习，使学生掌握大数据技术的主要原理和应用，形成对大数据知识体系及其应用领域的认识；能够搭建大数据处理的平台，并在所建平台上掌握大数据编程的基本方法；掌握如何利用大数据技术分析大数据。使学生具备大数据平台搭建、分布式文件存储、数据处理和分析的能力。 具体目标包括：了解大数据相关技术的发展历史和应用；掌握Hadoop的架构原理和使用场景，深入理解Hadoop技术架构,对Hadoop运作机制有清晰全面的认识; 可以独立安装及使用Hadoop环境；掌握分布式文件系统HDFS相关概念、体系结构、存储原理、数据读写过程；掌握分布式数据库HBase数据模型、实现原理及运行机制；掌握 Spark 的原理,了解Spark的生态系统,能够实现Spark编程,利用相关组件完成大数据分析；掌握MapReduce的体系结构、工作流程、过程原理；初步具备利用大数据技术解决大数据问题的能力。
default.en: The big data system mainly explains the technical principles and applications of big data systems. Through this course, students will master the main principles and applications of big data technology, forming an understanding of the knowledge system and application fields of big data; Able to build a platform for big data processing and master the basic methods of big data programming on the built platform; Master how to use big data technology to analyze big data. Enable students to have the ability to build big data platforms, store distributed files, process and analyze data. The specific goals include: understanding the development history and application of big data related technologies; Master the architectural principles and usage scenarios of Hadoop, have a deep understanding of Hadoop technology architecture, have a clear and comprehensive understanding of Hadoop operating mechanisms, and can independently install and use the Hadoop environment; Master the concepts, architecture, storage principles, and data reading and writing processes related to the distributed file system HDFS; Master the distributed database HBase data model, implementation principles, and operating mechanisms; Master the principles of Spark, understand the Spark ecosystem, be able to implement Spark programming, and use related components to complete big data analysis; Master the architecture, workflow, and process principles of MapReduce; Preliminary ability to utilize big data technology to solve big data problems.

default.zh: 《高级数据库系统》是数据科学与大数据技术专业一门学科方向性课程，目的是使学生了解高级数据库设计与关键问题解决的基础知识，为学生今后深入研究数据库管理系统中关键问题奠定思维基础，认识和了解目前数据库系统的研究方法及技术应用体系, 较为深入了解多种数据库管理系统中问题求解思路及能力培养思路，进而理解未来数据库管理系统研究与开发中中的专业要求及能力要求，提高学生对大数据系统方向求职的核心竞争力。 通过学习本课程，学生可以理解高级数据系统的概念，掌握评测数据系统优劣的标准；能够从数据存储、索引结构、查询优化、查询处理等多个角度面向不同数据、工作负载和软硬件结构设计数据库系统；系统了解NoSQL和NewSQL的概念和算法；了解利用人工智能增强数据库系统的思路和方法；具备阅读数据库管理系统文献的能力和灵活运用算法和系统知识解决数据库系统中实际问题的能力以及数据管理系统实现和评测系统优劣的能力。
default.en: Advanced Database System is a disciplinary orientation course for data science and big data technology majors. The purpose is to make students understand the basic knowledge of advanced database design and key problem solving, lay a thinking foundation for students to further study the key problems in the database management system in the future, understand the research methods and technical application system of the current database system, have a deep understanding of the problem solving ideas and ability training ideas in various database management systems, and then understand the professional requirements and ability requirements in the research and development of the future database management system, and improve the core competitiveness of students for the job of big data system. Through the study of this course, students can understand the concept of advanced data system, master the criteria for evaluating the pros and cons of data systems, design database systems for different data, workload and software and hardware structures from multiple angles such as data storage, index structure, query optimization, query processing, systematically understand the concepts and algorithms of NoSQL and NewSQL, understand the ideas and methods of using artificial intelligence to enhance the database system and have the ability to read database management system literature and flexibly use algorithms and system knowledge to solve practical problems in the database system, as well as the ability to implement and evaluate the pros and cons of the data management system.

default.zh: 《基因组大数据分析》是生物信息学专业的核心专业基础课程，目的是使学生掌握基因组基本结构与信息，基因组信息分析的基本原理和方法, 海量基因组数据表示与分析模型，在对众多处理基因组问题的信息学解决方法有清晰的认识后，具备严谨的科学态度与分析问题、解决问题的能力，为以后的科学研究打下基础。课程具体内容如下： 课程内容1：能够设计并实现面向高通量基因组数据分析的计算系统，可以集成DNA、RNA、表观、元基因组等多层面高通量数据构建计算系统来解决具体生物问题。 课程内容2：掌握解决基因组数据分析计算系统相关的关键技术、方法与工具。掌握基因组的基本结构与信息表示模型，基因组分析方法，具备从生物数据中构建基因组并挖掘功能元件的能力。 课程内容3：具备在多学科背景下将数学、计算机算法与具体基因组问题相结合，对高通量基因组数据分析计算系统进行分析与评价的能力。 课程内容4：能够撰写高通量基因组数据分析计算系统相关的报告并进行交流与沟通。
default.en: "Genomics Big Data Analysis" is the core professional basic course of bioinformatics, which aims to enable students to master the basic structure and information of the genome, the basic principles and methods of genomic information analysis, the representation and analysis model of massive genomic data, and have a rigorous scientific attitude and the ability to analyze and solve problems after having a clear understanding of many informatics solutions to deal with genomic problems, laying a foundation for future scientific research. The specific content of the course is as follows: Course content 1: Be able to design and implement a computing system for high-throughput genomic data analysis, and integrate DNA, RNA, epigenetic, metagenomic and other high-throughput data to build a computing system to solve specific biological problems. Course content 2: Master the key technologies, methods and tools related to solving the computational system of genomic data analysis. Master the basic structure and information representation model of the genome, genome analysis methods, and have the ability to construct genomes from biological data and mine functional elements. Course content 3: Have the ability to combine mathematics, computer algorithms and specific genomic problems in a multidisciplinary context, and analyze and evaluate high-throughput genomic data analysis and computing systems. Course content 4: Be able to write reports related to high-throughput genomic data analysis computing systems and communicate and communicate.

default.zh: 当前，随着生命组学测序等高通量生物实验技术的快速发展和广泛应用，生物大数据持续爆发式增长，已成为规模最大的数据集合之一，并使生命科学和生物医药领域转向数据驱动发展模式，进入新的快速发展时期。在此背景下，对生物大数据的开发和利用成为生命科学与生物医药的新发展引擎，其核心在于创造可以有效处理、分析、挖掘、应用生物大数据的算法，以实现对PB-ZB级生物大数据的分析挑战。 本课程是生物信息学专业的是数据科学与大数据专业的专业限选课，目的是使学生认识和理解以基因组大数据为代表的生物大数据领域的计算问题，掌握生物大数据的表示与组织模型，生物大数据处理与分析的核心算法，及生物大数据算法系统的基本原理、组成与运行方式，为学生今后设计、构造和应用生物信息学算法与系统，解决生命科学与生物医药领域的计算问题，特别是大数据分析与应用问题，奠定坚实的理论和技术基础。本课程的主要内容涉及基因组大数据等重要生物大数据的表示、组织、索引的数据结构，大规模生物序列比对、搜索、拼接、变异检测等基础核心算法，及生物数据质量评估的基本方法。重点通过课程讲解配合较为系统的算法实验，培养学生的生物信息学算法设计与实践能力，达成课程目标。
default.en: Currently, with the rapid development and widespread application of high-throughput biological experimental technologies such as life genomics sequencing, biological big data continues to experience explosive growth, becoming one of the largest datasets. This trend has led the fields of life science and biomedicine to shift towards a data-driven development model, entering a new era of rapid growth. In this context, the development and utilization of biological big data have become a new driving force for the development of life science and biomedicine. The core lies in the creation of algorithms that can effectively process, analyze, mine, and apply biological big data, aiming to address the analytical challenges of PB-ZB scale biological big data. This course is a core foundational course for the bioinformatics major. Its primary objectives are to enable students to understand and comprehend computational issues in life sciences, the representation and organization of biological data, basic algorithms for biological data management, analysis, mining, and application. Additionally, students will gain insight into the fundamental principles, components, and operation of bioinformatics algorithm systems. The course aims to prepare students for designing, constructing, and applying bioinformatics algorithms and systems to solve computational problems in the fields of life science and biomedicine, particularly in the realm of big data analysis and applications. The main content of the course covers data structures for representing, organizing, and indexing biological bigdata, core algorithms for large-scale sequence alignment, searching, variant calling, as well as basic methods for assessing the quality of biological data. Emphasis is placed on hands-on algorithm experiments to cultivate students' abilities in the design and practical application of bioinformatics algorithms, laying a solid theoretical and technical foundation to achieve the course objectives.

default.zh: 《信息隐藏技术基础》是一门面向计算机大类/软件工程大类开设的信息安全领域的基础课程，目的是使学生对多媒体安全知识领域有一个较全面的了解，掌握多媒体安全领域的基本原理和工作机制，具有解决一些多媒体内容安全及数据传输安全问题的能力，为学生进一步在信息安全领域进行深入学习打下基础。课程具体目标是帮助学生建立信息隐藏技术的基本原理和应用方面的知识框架，通过对应用背景、基本理论、基本算法的学习，掌握信息隐藏技术所必需的基本知识和技能。
default.en: 《Fundamental Technology of Information Hiding》is a basic course in the field of information security for computer/software engineering majors. The purpose is to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the field of multimedia security knowledge, master the basic principles and working mechanisms of multimedia security, and have the ability to solve some multimedia content security and data transmission security problems, To lay the foundation for students to further deepen their learning in the field of information security. The specific goal of the course is to help students establish a knowledge framework for the basic principles and applications of information hiding technology. By studying the application background, basic theories, and basic algorithms, they can master the basic knowledge and skills necessary for information hiding technology.

default.zh: 《软件安全与逆向分析B》是信息安全专业的一门选修课程，侧重于增强学生对软件缺陷的本质和恶意代码危害机理的理解，促使学生掌握软件安全的基本理论、分析方法和核心技术，提升学生在软件安全设计、分析和防护方面的实践能力。通过本课程的学习，使得学生掌握软件安全与逆向分析领域相关的基础知识和技能，熟练运用逆向分析的常用工具，认识逆向分析技术在软件漏洞分析、恶意代码检测、安全编程等领域的运用。
default.en: Software Security and Reverse Analysis B is a course of information security major, focusing on enhancing students' understanding of the nature of software defects and the mechanism of malicious codes, promoting students to master the basic theories, analysis methods and core technologies of software security, and improving students' practical ability in software security design, analysis and protection. Through this course, students can master the basic knowledge and skills related to software security and reverse analysis, proficient in the common tools of reverse analysis, understand the application of reverse analysis technology in software vulnerability analysis, malicious code detection, security programming and other fields.

default.zh: 《云安全》是信息安全/网络空间安全专业的一门选修课程，旨在提高学生的专业素质，增进学生对信息安全/网络空间安全新问题的了解，培养云计算系统上的安全意识，掌握对云计算系统进行防护的常用技术手段。通过本门课程的学习，要求学生全面、系统地掌握云计算及其安全方面的基本知识，包括云计算的定义、发展、分类，云安全与安全模型，云数据与网络安全，虚拟机安全等，并具备较强的分析问题、解决问题能力。
default.en: Cloud Security is an elective course for information security/cyberspace security majors, aiming to improve students' professional quality, enhance their understanding of new issues in information security/cyberspace security, cultivate security awareness on cloud computing systems, and master common technical means to protect cloud computing systems. Through the study of this course, students are required to comprehensively and systematically master the basic knowledge of cloud computing and its security, including the definition, development and classification of cloud computing, cloud security and security model, cloud data and network security, virtual machine security, etc., and have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

default.zh: 社交网络是一种在信息网络上由社会个体集合及个体之间的连接关系构成的社会性结构。这种社会结构主要包含关系结构、网络群体与网络信息三个要素。其中，社交网络的关系结构是社会个体成员之间通过社会关系结成的网络系统。个体也称为节点，可以是组织、个人、网络ID等不同含义的实体或虚拟个体；而个体间的相互关系可以是亲友、动作行为、收发消息等多种关系。基于这些关系，社交网络中的个体自组织成各种各样的虚拟社区，虚拟社区是社交网络的一个子集，具有虚拟社区内节点之间关联密切、不同虚拟社区的节点间关联稀疏等特点。在上述关系的基础上，社交网络中个体与个体之间、个体与群体之间、群体与群体之间传递着各种各样的信息，这种信息传递的不断迭代便是社交网络中的信息传播。本课程主要介绍社交网络分析的现状、发展以及面临的挑战，从结构与演化-群体与互动-信息与传播三个方面展开，系统、深入地阐述了社交网络分析中的基本理论、关键方法和技术，并且进行相关实践及技术分享。
default.en: A social network is a social structure composed of individuals and the connections between individuals on an information network. This social structure mainly includes three elements: relationship structure, network groups, and network information. Among them, the relationship structure is a network system formed between individuals through social relationships. Individuals, also known as nodes, can be entities or virtual individuals with different meanings, e.g., organizations, people, and network ID; The relationships between individuals can be friendships, behaviors, and communication. Based on these relationships, individuals in social networks self-organize into various virtual communities. A virtual community is a subset of a social network, characterized by dense connections within the virtual community and sparse connections between nodes in different virtual communities. On the basis of the above relationships, various types of information are transmitted between individuals and groups in social networks, which is also referred to as the dissemination of information. This course mainly introduces the status quo, development and challenges of social network analysis. It starts from three aspects: structure and evolution - group and interaction - information and communication, and systematically and deeply expounds the basic theory, key methods and technologies in social network analysis, and conducts related practices and technology sharing.

default.zh: 《人工智能安全》是信息安全专业的一门综合性课程，侧重于学生对计算机和信息安全领域各门课程知识的综合运用，加强学生动手实践能力的培养。通过本课程的学习，学生掌握人工智能的安全领域相关的基础知识和技能，熟悉人工智能安全的理论和方法，掌握人工智能的攻击方法、人工智能的数据安全、算法模型安全、软硬件平台安全、人工智能的安全性设计等领域知识的运用，提高学生在人工智能设计和软件开发中的安全设计意识。课程主要内容包括人工智能安全内涵、人工智能的安全风险分析、人工智能的内生安全、人工智能的数据安全性、人工智能的算法安全性等内容。本课程采用 “课堂讲授+实验教学+实验报告+项目报告”的教学模式，教师将在课堂上围绕教学内容讲授重点、组织讨论和随堂演示，学生按规定的要求参加课堂学习，参与讨论，完成课程实验内容。利用教材阅读和文献检索等方式开展自学，充分激发学生的好奇心与学习动力，锻炼同学自学、独立思考与创新的能力，以课程实验、课堂报告和课程研究报告的形式考察学生对课程内容知识的掌握，锻炼学生未来开展人工智能相关的研究工作的基本能力。
default.en: “Security of Artificial Intelligence” is a comprehensive course in the field of information security, focusing on the comprehensive application of knowledge in various courses in the field of computer and information security by students, and strengthening the cultivation of students' hands-on practical abilities.
