The purpose of this course is to study human mind and cognitive process through the introduction of neuroscience by introducing neuroscience paradigm, enable the students to understand the neural mechanism of human vision、auditory sense and logical thinking，to get a preliminary understanding of the process of human information processing and the reasons for its special advantages, to understand the latest research results and future directions of cognitive science and brain intelligence, and to provide the knowledge accumulation and method reference for machine learning, especially the brain intelligence direction and the subsequent theory and method innovation of brain computer interface technology. This course covers the fundamentals of cognitive theory and physiology and neuroscience, audio-visual and other external cognitive processing mechanism and neural mechanisms of memory, language, logic thinking inherent cognition, a brief introduction of research methods and the latest achievements of cognitive psychology, cognitive neuroscience, brain computer interface and artificial intelligence. Through the combination of the above fields ，we introduce the Brain-inspied Intelligent concept, and its development status and future trend are discussed. This course covers a number of research focus in the field of neuroscience, cognitive science and computer science, focus on the future development direction of computer science and artificial intelligence technology. It offers originality content and strong inspiration at the same time, has a reference value for the students planning for a career in the field of artificial intelligence、cognitive computing and brain machine interface. The course examination is mainly the offline examination, and the experiment and the course theme report occupy a certain proportion in the final results.

default.zh: 身份识别是人们加强系统和信息安全性的基本方法之一。利用人体本身所拥有的生物特征(如指纹等) 来进行身份识别的技术称为生物识别技术(Biometrics)。人的生物特征不会被盗，不会丢失或遗忘，也很难伪造或模仿，所以生物识别技术是系统和信息安全领域的发展趋势。当前国际形势动荡不安，恐怖活动时有发生，对世界各国人民的生命财产安全造成极大的危害，是国家安全的极大威胁。因此对恐怖分子进行及时、有效的监控和抓捕是至关重要的。生物识别技术在“反恐”方面具有不可替代的作用。在法律上，也只有生物识别技术才能完成诸如死者身份鉴定、罪犯认定、亲子鉴定等任务。本课程将全面介绍生物识别技术领域中的各种理论、算法和技术，以及各种生物识别技术的优缺点和各自的应用范围，最终使学生在全面了解各种技术的基础上，能设计一些简单的生物识别系统。
default.en: Personal authentication is a basic method to enforce the system and information security. Biometrics is the automated technique of recognizing a person based on his physiological or behavioral characteristics. Biometric features cannot be stolen, lost, forgotten, forged and copied, so biometric technology is the developing trend in the system and information security filed. The current international situation is turbulent and unstable, with terrorist activities occurring from time to time, which resulted in a great loss to the people and governments in the world. Therefore, it is very important to scout and seize the terrorists in time. Biometrics plays an important role in the anti-terrorism war. Additionally, biometrics can be widely used in Forensics, such as identify a dead and criminals, etc. This course will introduce the theory, algorithm, techniques and application about biometrics.

default.zh: 中文信息处理是面向计算机相关专业本科生的一门选修课。中文信息处理是指用计算机对中文的音、形、义等信息进行处理和加工。中文信息处理是自然语言信息处理的一个分支，是人工智能的重要研究内容，是一门与计算机科学、语言学、数学、信息学、声学、心理学等多种学科相关联的综合性学科。随着互联网的广泛普及，中文信息处理广泛应用于人机交互、信息传播、舆情分析、电子商务、决策支持、信息安全等领域，对推动中国信息产业发展、促进中外文化交流、繁荣中国传统文化具有重要作用。中文信息处理分为汉字信息处理与汉语信息处理两部分。本课程的主要内容包括中文编码原理、中文输入输出技术、中文分词方法、统计语言建模、中文词性标注、中文句法分析、汉英机器翻译、问答系统、以及知识推理、深度学习、语言大模型在中文信息处理中的应用等。目的是使学生掌握中文信息处理的主要方法和基本理论,了解中文语言处理研究的最新发展动态、主要研究对象及所面临的问题，为将来从事中文信息处理技术研究与系统开发奠定扎实的基础。
default.en: Chinese Information Processing is a professional course for undergraduate students majoring in computer science. Chinese Information Processing is refered to as processing pronunciation, form and meaning of Chinese Language using computer, which is a branch of natural language processing, an important area of artificial intelligence, and is an interdiscipline of computer science, linguistics, mathematics, information theory, acoustics and psychology. With development of Internet, Chinese Information Processing is widely used in human-machine interaction, information dissemination, public opinion analysis, electronic commerce, decision support, and information safety, etc.. and plays important role in promoting Chinese information industry, propelling international cultural exchange, and flourishing Chinese traditional culture. Contents of this course include: Chinese character coding, principle of Chinese character input and output, Chinese word segmentation, statistical language modeling, Chinese part-of-speech tagging, Chinese parsing, Chinese-English machine translation, question and answering, and applications of knowledge inference, deep learning and big language model on Chinese Information Processing. The aim of this course is to make students grasp main methodology and fundamental theory of Chinese Information processing, understand research status, research objects of and problems confronted in Chinese information processing and to establish the foundation for future work on research and engineering in this area.

default.zh: 《计算机体系结构D》重点介绍计算机系统各种基本结构、设计技术和性能分析方法，使学生掌握计算机体系结构设计的核心要素。通过设计实现计算机硬件系统中的主要部件（例如CPU、Cache等），并采用量化方法对性能进行分析，培养学生计算机设计、调试、实现、分析及优化的能力。 课程具体目标如下： 课程目标1：理解计算机系统软硬件功能分配和分界面的确定，掌握计算机体系结构的基本概念和基本原理，建立计算机系统的完整概念，掌握计算机硬件系统的基本设计和分析方法，理解并掌握计算机软硬件系统协同设计方法，能够设计并实现计算机硬件的主要部件（例如缓存、运算器等），能够应用工程基础知识解决复杂工程问题。 课程目标2：理解计算机软硬件对计算机系统性能的影响，掌握计算机软硬件系统性能的量化分析方法，掌握计算机硬件系统设计的优化方法以及基于硬件特点优化软件系统的方法，能够对整个计算机系统进行性能优化,能够设计满足特定需求的系统。 课程目标3：通过文献检索，阅读计算机体系结构领域的相关文献，了解计算机体系结构的发展趋势，能够分析和评价新应用、新技术、新材料对计算机体系结构发展的影响，并完成相关的分析报告，能够应用工程科学基本原理，并通过文献研究分析复杂工程问题。
default.en: This course provides an introduction of basic computer components, computer design technology, and performance analysis methods, enabling students to master the core elements of computer architecture design. By designing and implementing the main components of computer hardware systems (such as CPU, Cache, etc.), and using quantitative methods to analyze performance, students' abilities in computer design, debugging, implementation, analysis, and optimization are cultivated. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Course Goal 1: Understand the organizational structure and working principle of the computer hardware system, with the computer hardware system cognitive ability; Students can design and implement the basic components of computer system (i.e., Cache, ALU) and improve the ability of hardware system design. Course Goal 2: Learn the effect of hardware on the whole computer system; Understand the performance of the computer hardware system quantitative analysis approach; Understand the optimization approach of the computer hardware system design and the optimization approach of the software system based on the hardware characters; Able to propose the performance optimization plan for the whole computer system. Course Goal 3: Understand the main research directions related to modern computer architecture; Know the new theory and new technology related to the hardware system of computer science through network or document retrieval; Able to write the related analysis report.

default.zh: 计算建模在现代计算机科学中起着重要的作用，是计算机大类的一门专业核心课程。在现代计算机科学与技术中面临复杂的科学与工程问题，其中复杂的结构化和非结构化大数据普遍存在。要想快速有效的解决这样的复杂大数据问题，首先需要为实际问题抽象出数学模型，并能够形式化描述问题的本质和规律。本课程所包括的随机化和概率统计技术能够给建模、分析和处理这些大数据，提供强有力的描述工具和技术手段。计算建模的应用范围包括机器学习、安全协议、大数据处理、生物计算和人工智能应用等相关领域。课程核心内容包括随机变量分布和密度函数、随机采样、参数估计、经典的随机过程、随机数生成与蒙特卡洛方法、马尔科夫链和随机游走、随机模拟、随机场等内容。对连续和离散随机信号的分析和计算方法进行了全面的介绍。课程在介绍随机计算理论的基础上，对相关理论和技术的数值计算和模拟，以及对其中经典算法在现代计算机科学与技术中的实际应用也进行了较详细的描述。通过本课程的学习，学生对随机信号及处理有充分的理论储备，对后续的随机算法和其它课程的学习有很好的铺垫。课程适用于高年级本科生和研究生。
default.en: Computation modelling plays an important role in modern computer science. It is a professional kernel curriculum. There are many structural and non-structural big data in complex engineering problems in modern computer. In order to solve these problems effectively and efficiently, it is necessary that you can model these problems into mathematical formal representation and simulate them by computational methods. Randomizing and probability statistics techniques in this course provide the powerful tools and technical methods to model, analyze and process these big data. It is commonly used in machine learning, secure protocols, big data processing, biometrics computing and artificial intelligence et. al. Its main contents include random variable distribution and density function, random sampling techniques, parameters estimation, classical random process, random number generation, Monte Carlo methods, Markov chains and random walks, random simulation, random fields and so on. It not only introduces the analysis and computation methods of continuous and discrete signal but also describes the numerical computation and simulation techniques. In addition, it also takes some practical applications in computer science as examples to demonstrate the power of random computing. All in all, this course gives a rigorous yet accessible treatment of the related topics in random signal processing. With its comprehensive selection of topics, along with many examples and exercises, this course is an indispensable for continuing learning other related courses, such as random algorithms.

default.zh: 本课程围绕随机算法设计与分析的理论、方法和技术展开。随机算法在近二十多年来从单纯的数论理论演变成为一整套工具和技术，并被越来越多地应用到各种信息技术中。随机算法的三大特性：简洁性、高效性和健壮性正是这种演变的源动力。本课程旨在为本科学生介绍高级算法的基本概念、随机算法设计和分析的主要技术和工具，以及随机算法的典型应用。 课程以随机算法设计和分析技术和工具作为主线，穿插随机算法的典型应用。要讲授的技术和工具主要包括：博弈论技术、矩与方差、球与箱子模型、概率方法、马尔科夫链与随机游走、蒙特卡罗方法、代数技术等；而主要应用包括网页去重、随即图、流算法、在线算法等。
default.en: The last twenty five years have witnessed a tremendous growth in the area of randomized algorithms. During this period, randomized algorithms have gone from being a tool in computational number theory to a mainstream set of tools and techniques with widespread application. Three benefits of randomization have spearheaded this growth: simplicity, speed, and robustness to input parameters. This course presents the basic concepts in the design and analysis of randomized algorithms at a level accessible to advanced undergraduates and to graduate students. The course will be organized into two interleaved parts. The first thread will develop basic probabilistic tools that are recurrent in algorithmic applications. The second thread will focus on specific areas of application. Applications will be given along with each tool to illustrate it in concrete settings. The following is a tentative outline of the course. Tools and Techniques:？Basic probability theory; randomized complexity theory; game-theoretic techniques; Markov, Chebyshev, and moment inequalities; limited independence; coupon collection and occupancy problems; tail inequalities and Chernoff bounds; conditional expectation and martingales; Markov chains and random walks; stable distributions; probability amplification. Applications:？ data structures; combinatorial optimization and graph algorithms; online and streaming algorithms; algorithms for massive data sets including similarity search, nearest neighbors, and clustering; number-theoretic algorithms.

default.zh: 随着多核处理器和高性能计算系统的发展，并行计算已经成为计算机科学与工程领域的必要基础之一。本课程介绍并行计算的理论、概念和技术，讨论并行计算机系统结构、并行算法和并行编程方法。主要内容包括：并行计算机的发展和分类，并行程序设计基础，OpenMP、MPI和CUDA等并行编程，并行程序性能分析和优化等。目标是使学生了解并行计算机的系统结构特征和并行计算的基本原理，掌握并行算法的设计、分析和编程实现方法，培养面向高性能计算系统的并行程序设计和优化人才。
default.en: With the development of multi-core processors and high-performance computing systems, parallel computing has become one of the necessary foundations in the field of computer science and engineering. This course introduces the theory, concept and technology of parallel computing, and discusses the system structure, parallel algorithm and parallel programming method of parallel computer. The main contents include the development and classification of parallel computers, basis of parallel programming, parallel programming methods such as OpenMP, MPI and CUDA, parallel program performance analysis and optimization, etc. The goal of this course is to enable students to understand the characteristics of the system architecture of parallel computers and the basic principles of parallel computing, master the design, analysis and programming methods of parallel algorithms, and cultivate talents for parallel programming and optimization of high-performance computing system.

default.zh: 本课程是计算机类的专业辅修课程。本课程主要内容包括：分布式系统的分类、特征、分布式文件系统、分布式事务处理、分布式共识的基本概念与基础理论、典型的分布式共识算法，以及典型的分布式系统；针对分布式通信、分布式计算、基于投票分布式共识等理论方法，结合具体的分布式应用场景进行上机实验，达到理论和实践有机结合，使学生能够从认识理解分布式系统的复杂性与不确定性，掌握布式系统钟同步算法、掌握选举算法、互斥算法、以及典型的分布式共识算法，培养学生针对不同分布式场景问题，选择优化应用分布式算法求解问题能力，提高学生分布式系统修养，为以后科研与实践打下坚实基础。
default.en: This course is minor course in the field of computer science. The main content of this course includes: the classification and characteristics of distributed systems, distributed file systems, distributed transaction processing, fundamental concepts and foundational theories of distributed consensus, typical distributed consensus algorithms, and typical distributed systems. Through hands-on experiments involving theoretical methods such as distributed communication, distributed computing, and voting-based distributed consensus, combined with specific distributed application scenarios, the course aims to achieve an organic integration of theory and practice. This enables students to understand the complexity and uncertainty of distributed systems, master distributed system clock synchronization algorithms, election algorithms, mutual exclusion algorithms, and typical distributed consensus algorithms. It also cultivates students' ability to choose and optimize distributed algorithms for solving problems in different distributed scenarios, enhances their understanding of distributed systems, and lays a solid foundation for future research and practical applications.

default.zh: 人工智能是计算机科学的一个分支，是一门研究机器智能的学科，即用人工的方法和技术，研制智能机器或智能系统来模仿、延伸和扩展人的智能，实现智能行为。它与生物工程和空间技术被称为当今世界的三大尖端技术，在高技术领域具有十分广泛而重要的作用。该课程的学习旨在掌握人工智能的基本概念和研究方法及其未来的发展趋势，为以后在该领域的深入研究打下基础。本课程要求学生学会知识的不同表示方法，了解各种表示方法的优缺点，在面临具体问题时可以选取合适的方法对问题进行表示。本课程以程序语言作为算法描述的工具，本课程要求在数理逻辑的经典谓词逻辑以及贝叶斯网络的基础上，学会不同的推理方法，并能够利用不同的方法实现推理。课程最终需要让学生在学会推理策略的基础上，利用不同的搜索策略（如盲目搜索与启发式搜索）对问题进行求解，并掌握不同的搜索方法的优缺点，并了解机器学习深度学习的基本方法。
default.en: Artificial intelligence is an interdiscipline. It is related to computer science, brain science, neurophysiology, psychology, linguistics, logic, cognitive science, thought science, behavioral science and mathematics. In addition, it is also related to information theory, control theory and systems theory etc. In this course, we give the basic theory and basic method of artificial intelligence. It contains knowledge representation, machine reasoning techniques, logic refutation principle, searching algorithm of graphs, production system and expert system, machine learning and application of artificial intelligence.

default.zh: 本课程是自动化专业，测控专业，生物医学工程专业的选修课，本课程主要目的是使学生初步了解脑-机接口（BCI）的基本原理和应用，为后续深入研究打下基础。通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解BCI使用的不同类型的大脑信号，了解BCI系统的每个组件以及命令控制的应用；熟悉BCI的主要类型，并掌握信号采集、处理、特征提取和转化的基本原理，熟悉现有BCI的具体原理和实现方法。
default.en: This course is an elective for majors in Automation, Measurement and Control, and Biomedical Engineering. Its primary objective is to provide students with a foundational understanding of the basic principles and applications of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), laying the groundwork for further in-depth study. Through this course, students will learn about the various types of brain signals used in BCIs, the components of BCIs and their command-control applications; familiarize themselves with the main types of BCIs, and grasp the fundamental principles of signal acquisition, processing, feature extraction, and transformation. They will also become acquainted with the specific principles and implementation methods of existing BCIs.

default.zh: 信息检索技术是自然语言处理中的一个重要的内容，在自动文摘、情感分析、智能问答、用户画像等领域有着重要的应用，为学生们后续从事与自然语言处理技术相关的科研工作打下基础。本课程是一门针对高年级本科生的专业课，主要讲授信息检索基本模型及相关理论。课程的内容包括：经典的信息检索模型，如布尔模型、向量空间模型等；检索技术的评价方法和评价指标；文本处理和查询扩展等相关技术；索引的建立方法及检索过程中采用的一些数据结构及方法；针对互联网的Web检索技术及排序。本课程可以帮助学生了解信息检索技术的基本概念、发展历史及其在未来工作中的应用，掌握基础的信息检索理论和相关技术，结合人工智能、机器学习、语言处理技术对信息进行加工处理，并能够对系统进行合理的评价与分析。为学生今后设计、开发基于检索技术的应用系统奠定技术基础，提高学生形式化思维、建模的能力。
default.en: Information retrieval is an important aspect of natural language processing, with important applications in fields such as automatic summarization, sentiment analysis, intelligent question answering, and user profiling, laying the foundation for students to engage in scientific research related to natural language processing technology in the future. This course is a professional course aimed at senior undergraduate students, mainly teaching the basic models and related theories of information retrieval. The course content includes: classic information retrieval models, such as Boolean models, vector space models, etc.; The evaluation methods and indicators of retrieval technology; Text processing and query expansion related technologies; The methods for establishing indexes and the data structures and methods used in the retrieval process; Web search technology and Ranking. This course can help students understand the basic concepts, development history, and future applications of information retrieval technology, master basic information retrieval theories and related technologies, combine artificial intelligence, machine learning, and language processing technologies to process information, and be able to conduct reasonable evaluation and analysis of the system. To lay a technical foundation for students to design and develop application systems based on retrieval technology in the future, and improve their formal thinking and modeling abilities.

default.zh: 本课程将结合大数据计算平台提供的数据分析算法，培养学生研究与实践相结合的能力。通过本课程的学习，学生可以掌握大数据平台中各种算法的基本原理，计算平台的基本技能，了解最新发展、前沿的研究领域、以及在不同学科中的应用，为将来从事大数据研究与实践打下初步的基础。
default.en: With the rapid development of information technology and the explosive growth of data volumes, big data has become a central component of modern society. Not only does big data cover information in every field from social media interactions and e-commerce transactions to scientific research and medical records, it also provides unprecedented insights and predictive capabilities. Against this backdrop, big data computing platforms are becoming increasingly important. Big data computing platforms are capable of efficiently processing and analyzing massive amounts of data and unearthing the value hidden within. Through powerful computing capabilities and advanced algorithms, these platforms can clean, classify, aggregate and correlate data to analyze it, thus discovering the inherent patterns and potential trends between data. This ability to process and analyze data is of great guiding significance for corporate decision-making, policy formulation and scientific research. This course will combine the data analysis algorithms provided by the Big Data computing platform to develop students' ability to combine research and practice. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic principles of various algorithms in big data platforms, the basic skills of computing platforms, understand the latest development, cutting-edge research areas, and applications in different disciplines, and lay a preliminary foundation for future engagement in big data research and practice.

default.zh: 医疗知识图谱构建技术是面向本科高年级学生开设的一门专业选修课，本课程聚焦人工智能与医疗领域交叉前沿，旨在培养本科生掌握医疗知识图谱构建的核心技术与应用。通过理论授课、案例研讨与项目实践，使学生具备从医疗多源数据中自动提取知识、构建知识图谱并解决临床与科研问题的能力，为智慧医疗、医疗大数据分析等方向奠定基础。 课程可以分为理论基础—构建流程—应用场景三个部分。在理论基础部分，对知识图谱的定义、核心要素、核心技术、医疗领域特殊性、医疗知识图谱的典型应用场景进行深入全面的介绍。进而详细讲述医疗知识图谱的构建技术，介绍数据层的多源医疗数据整合，数据清洗与标准化。知识提取层的实体识别、关系抽取。知识融合层的实体消歧、知识推理与补全等实用技术。最后介绍医疗知识图谱的典型应用场景，如疾病诊断、健康管理等等。课程还安排了小型医疗知识图谱的构建实践，分组构建“慢性病管理”小型知识图谱。 课程兼具系统性、前沿性和实践性，目标是培养具备专业基础知识的“医学+AI”复合型人才。通过本课程，学生将掌握医疗知识图谱这一“AI+医疗”的核心工具，为参与智慧医院建设、临床决策支持系统开发等前沿工作铺平道路。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduate students. It focuses on the intersection of artificial intelligence and medical fields, aiming to cultivate undergraduate students' mastery of the core technologies and applications of medical knowledge graph construction. Through theoretical lectures, case studies, and project practice, students are equipped with the ability to extract knowledge from medical multi-source data, construct knowledge graphs, and solve clinical and scientific research problems, laying the foundation for directions such as smart healthcare and medical big data analysis. The course can be divided into three parts: theoretical foundation, construction process, and application scenarios. In the theoretical foundation section, a comprehensive and in-depth introduction is given to the definition, core elements, core techniques, medical field specificity, and typical application scenarios of medical knowledge graphs. Further elaborate on the construction techniques of medical knowledge graph, introduce the integration of multi-source medical data, data cleaning and standardization at the data layer. Entity recognition and entity relation extraction in the knowledge extraction layer. Practical technologies such as entity disambiguation, knowledge inference, and completion in the knowledge fusion layer. Finally, typical application scenarios of medical knowledge graphs are introduced, such as disease diagnosis, health management, and so on. The course also arranged for the construction practice of a small-scale medical knowledge graph, grouping to construct a small-scale knowledge graph of "chronic disease management". The course combines systematicity, cutting-edge and practicality, with the goal of cultivating "medical+AI" composite talents with professional basic knowledge. Through this course, students will master the medical knowledge graph, the core tool of "AI+healthcare", paving the way for participation in cutting-edge work such as smart hospital construction and clinical decision support system development.

default.zh: 随着计算机应用的越来越广泛，计算机已经进入一些关键部门，如航天、军事、银行等，它的可靠性问题就变得异乎寻常的重要。容错计算技术这门课通过给学生讲授计算机可靠性的相关概念和基础理论，介绍一些国内外常用的容错设计技术以及容错系统，使学生通过这门课的学习，对计算机可靠性有一个比较全面地认识，并掌握常用的容错设计技术，能够进行简单的容错系统的分析与设计。 主要内容包括： 1. 计算机可靠性的基本理论及模型 2. 软、硬件冗余设计技术 3. 故障检测技术（编码技术） 4. 故障注入技术
default.en: With the computer applying more and more extensively, computer has already equipped into key departments, for example, aerospace, military, bank etc. The reliability of computer has already become an important problem. The basic theory and conception, and some fault tolerance technologies and systems are introduced in this course. In the studying, the students can have a general view of the reliability of computer, and can analyze and design the simple system of fault tolerance. Including: 1. The basic theory and model 2. The redundant technology of software and hardware 3. Technology of fault detection ( Coding Technology) 4. Technology of fault injecting

default.zh: 现代服务是经济增长与创新的动力。服务运营管理这门课的目的是引导学生理解如何通过组织转变来提升服务价值。这个过程既包括客户体验，也包括员工感受与组织绩效。这门课有四大模块：涵盖基础运营管理与创新理论，也涉及网络运营与系统设计方法。授课语言是英语。
default.en: Modern services are a driving force of economic growth and innovation. The course Service Operations Management aims to guide students in understanding how to enhance service value through organizational transformation. This process encompasses not only customer experience, but also employee well-being and organizational performance. The course consists of four main modules: it covers fundamental operations management and innovation theories, as well as network operations and system design methodologies. The language of instruction is English.

default.zh: 《生物大模型与科学计算》是一门面向生物信息学、计算生物学及人工智能交叉学科的高年级本科生与研究生课程。课程立足于当前生命科学领域数据爆炸式增长与精准医学需求的实际背景，系统讲授如何利用大语言模型（如Transformer、BERT、GPT等）与高性能科学计算方法，对DNA、RNA、蛋白质序列、单细胞转录组乃至空间转录组等多模态生物数据进行建模与知识挖掘。内容涵盖生物序列的嵌入表示、预训练与微调技术、蛋白质结构与功能预测、非编码调控元件分析、单细胞状态解析、多模态对齐，以及分布式训练、可解释性AI、隐私计算等科学计算关键技术。课程采用“启发式课堂讲授+自主问题设计与汇报”的教学模式，前半段通过前沿案例与问题牵引引导学生理解大模型与生物问题的耦合方式，后半段以翻转课堂形式鼓励学生围绕自身科研兴趣设计跨学科解决方案并进行互评。通过本课程的学习，学生将具备独立构建、微调与评估生物领域大模型的能力，并能够运用科学计算思维解决复杂的生命科学问题。
default.en: Biological Foundation Models and Scientific Computing is a course designed for senior undergraduate and graduate students in bioinformatics, computational biology, and artificial intelligence. In the context of the explosive growth of life science data and the pressing need for precision medicine, this course systematically teaches how to leverage large language models (e.g., Transformers, BERT, GPT) and high-performance scientific computing methods to model and mine knowledge from multimodal biological data, including DNA, RNA, protein sequences, single-cell transcriptomics, and spatial transcriptomics. The topics cover biological sequence embedding, pre？training and fine？tuning techniques, protein structure and function prediction, non？coding regulatory element analysis, single？cell state annotation, multimodal alignment, as well as key scientific computing techniques such as distributed training, explainable AI, and privacy computing. The course adopts a teaching model of “heuristic lectures plus student？driven problem design and presentation”. In the first half, cutting？edge cases and problem？based learning guide students to understand how foundation models couple with biological problems. In the second half, a flipped classroom encourages students to design interdisciplinary solutions based on their own research interests and to evaluate each other’s work. Upon completing the course, students will be equipped to independently construct, fine？tune, and evaluate biological foundation models, and to apply scientific computing thinking to solve complex life？science problems.

default.zh: 《大数据系统实践及应用》是计算机大类/软件工程大类的一门选修课程，大数据基础理论并与实践相结合的课程，本课程在注重大数据时代应用环境前提下，从初学者角度出发，结合企业案例使学生由浅入深、由点到面地逐步提高，能结合具体实验熟悉大数据基础技术，提高学生的综合实践能力。目的是使学生在认识和了解大数据基本概念的基础上，掌握大数据处理技术及其在行业领域中的应用情况。这是一门实战性较强的课程，可为学生今后深入学习、设计、开发大数据相关问题奠定基础。 课程内容包括，第一章 大数据相关概念和基本知识及大数据在行业中的应用状况；第二章 数据源调研；第三章 数据汇聚； 第四章 数据融合； 第五章 数据治理； 第六章 大数据系统应用之数据分析；第七章 大数据系统应用之数据挖掘。
default.en: This course is jointly built with Beijing Shenzhou Aerospace Software Technology Co., Ltd., a specialized software enterprise controlled by China Aerospace Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd. It is a nationally recognized key high-tech software enterprise. Industry big data is an important business content of the unit. “Industry Big Data System Practice and Application "is an elective course of computer science/software engineering, which combines the basic theory of big data with practice. This course focuses on the application environment of the big data era, starting from the perspective of beginners and combining enterprise cases, enable students to gradually improve from shallow to deep, from point to surface, and be familiar with basic big data technology through specific experiments, thereby improving their comprehensive practical abilities. The purpose is to enable students to master big data processing technology and its application in industry fields on the basis of understanding and understanding the basic concepts of big data. This is a highly practical course that can lay the foundation for students to further study, design, and develop big data-related issues in the future. The course content includes Chapter 1, concepts and basic knowledge related to big data, as well as the application status of big data in the industry; Chapter 2 Data Source Research; Chapter 3 Data Aggregation; Chapter 4 Data Fusion; Chapter V data governance; Chapter 6: Data Analysis of Big Data System Applications; Chapter 7: Data Mining for Big Data System Applications.

default.zh: 本课程是面向工科试验班（计算机与电子通信）、信息与通信工程类本科生开设的一门计算机技术选修课。本课程主要讲授程序设计基本概念、术语、思想、过程及方法，重点讲授面向对象的思想及程序设计方法。设置本课程的主要目的是培养学生程序阅读、程序设计、程序实现及程序调试能力，培养学生面向对象程序设计的思维，使学生掌握面向对象程序设计的基本思想和基本方法，掌握面向对象程序设计与面向过程程序设计的区别和优缺点；最终达到能够运用Java语言进行面向对象程序设计、解决实际应用问题的目的，为将来从事软件开发，解决工程问题和科学技术问题，以及后继相关课程的学习奠定基础。
default.en: This course is an elective course in computer technology designed for undergraduate students in engineering experimental programs (Computer and Electronic Communication), Information and Communication Engineering majors. This course primarily focuses on the fundamental principles, terminologies, concepts, processes, and methodologies in program design, focusing on the concepts of object-oriented programming and programming methodologies. The main objectives of this course are to develop students' skills in code comprehension, software design, implementation, and debugging programs, and debugging programs, nurturing their thinking in object-oriented programming. The aim is to enable students to master the fundamental concepts and techniques of object-oriented software design, understand the differences and advantages/disadvantages between object-oriented and procedural programming. Ultimately, the goal is to equip students with the skills to apply Java language for object-oriented programming and solve practical problems. This course lays the groundwork for future software development, addressing engineering problems, scientific and technological issues, and preparing students for subsequent related courses.

default.zh: 《C++程序设计》是一门针对全校本科生开设的计算机技术基础课程。这门课程的核心目标是为了培养学生扎实的程序设计能力，为他们在未来的软件开发领域奠定坚实的基础。本课程的主要内容包括程序设计的基本概念、术语、设计思想、编程过程和方法。其中，重点讲解面向过程和面向对象的设计理念及相应的程序设计技巧。通过学习本课程，学生将能够掌握面向过程和面向对象程序设计的基本原则和常用方法。课程设置的初衷是培养学生具备良好的程序阅读、设计、实现和调试能力。在此基础上，课程还致力于培养学生养成面向对象程序设计的思维方式，使他们能够运用所学知识解决实际问题。为了帮助学生更好地掌握C++程序设计的方法和技巧，课程中提供了丰富的程序实例和练习。学生将通过这些实例和练习，逐步深入了解C++语言的特点和运用方法，从而实现从面向过程程序设计向面向对象程序设计的平稳过渡。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够运用C++语言进行面向对象程序设计，解决实际应用问题。这将为他们未来从事软件开发、解决工程问题和科学技术问题，以及继续学习相关课程奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: C++ Programming is a basic computer technology course for all undergraduate students. The core objective of this course is to develop students' solid programming skills and provide them with a solid foundation for future careers in software development. The main content of this course includes the basic concepts, terminology, design ideas, programming processes, and methods of programming. In particular, it focuses on process-oriented and object-oriented design concepts and corresponding programming techniques. Through studying this course, students will be able to master the basic principles and common methods of process-oriented and object-oriented program design. The original intention of the course is to cultivate students with good program reading, design, implementation, and debugging skills. On this basis, the course is also committed to cultivating students to develop a mindset of object-oriented programming, so that they can apply what they have learned to solve real-world problems. In order to help students better master the methods and techniques of C++ programming, the course provides abundant program examples and exercises. Through these examples and exercises, students will gradually gain a deeper understanding of the characteristics of the C++ language and how to use it, so as to realize a smooth transition from process-oriented programming to object-oriented programming. Through this course, students will be able to use the C++ language to carry out object-oriented programming and solve real-world application problems. This will lay a solid foundation for them to engage in software development, solve engineering problems and scientific and technological problems in the future, as well as continue to study related courses.

default.zh: 本课程首先介绍 Python语言的基本要素，包括基本数据类型、运算、控制结构、函数，接着讲授数据结构的概念和应用、算法时空复杂性的概念等知识。使学生了解基本的算法和数据结构、良好的程序设计风格，具备熟练使用Python语言分析和解决实际问题的能力。为进一步学习其他专业课程和今后从事软件开发工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This course first introduces the basic elements of the Python Programming language, including the basic data types, operations, control structures, functions. And then we teach the concept of data structures and applications, algorithms, such as the concept of time and space complexity. So that students can understand the basic algorithms and data structure, a good programming style, with skilled use of Python language analysis and solve practical problems. To lay a solid foundation for further study of other professional courses and future software development.

default.zh: 《基于.NET平台的软件开发》课程旨在教授学生使用.NET技术开发软件的技能和知识。通过该课程的学习使学生能够掌握.NET框架的基本原理、Visual Studio .NET开发环境及常见的.NET平台应用程序开发模式,并能使用C#程序设计语言在.Net平台下进行应用程序开发。在这门课程中，学生将学习使用.NET平台的主要工具和框架，如C#编程语言、ASP.NET等。课程的内容涵盖了： C#编程基础：学生将学习C#语言的基本语法、面向对象编程的概念和技巧，以及常用的编程模式和技术。 .NET框架和类库：学生将了解.NET框架的基本组成部分，包括常用的类库、数据访问技术、异常处理和多线程编程等。 通过完成课程项目和实践任务，学生将能够运用所学知识开发.NET平台下的实际软件应用程序。这门课程旨在培养学生的编程和软件开发能力，为他们在.NET领域的职业发展打下坚实基础，更好地应对现如今的云时代发展趋势。
default.en: The main purpose of the course "Software Development Based on .NET Platform" is because the .NET platform provides a complete enterprise-level application solution for Windows. The course aims to teach students the skills and knowledge to develop software using .NET technology. Through this course, students will be able to master the basic principles of the .NET framework, the Visual Studio .NET development environment, and common application development patterns on the .NET platform. They will also learn to use the C# programming language for application development on the .NET platform. In this course, students will learn the main tools and frameworks of the .NET platform, such as the C# programming language and ASP.NET. The course covers the following topics: C# programming fundamentals: Students will learn the basic syntax of the C# language, the concepts and techniques of object-oriented programming, as well as commonly used programming patterns and techniques. .NET framework and libraries: Students will gain an understanding of the basic components of the .NET framework, including commonly used libraries, data access techniques, exception handling, and multi-threaded programming. By completing course projects and practical tasks, students will be able to apply their knowledge to develop practical software applications on the .NET platform. This course aims to cultivate students' programming and software development abilities, and provide them with a solid foundation for their career development in the .NET field, better equipping them to cope with the current trends of the cloud era.

default.zh: Java EE是目前市场占有率较高的Web和企业应用开发平台。其开放的体系结构、跨平台部署的特性使其广泛应用于电子商务、金融、电信、生产制造等各个领域。 基于Java EE平台的软件开发是面向计算机大类专业本科生开设的软件开发实践类课程。目的是使学生掌握Java EE平台的Web开发技术，能够开发出Java EE平台的Web应用程序。为学生今后深入学习，开发企业级应用系统奠定基础。
default.en: Java EE is currently a web and enterprise application development platform with a high market share. Its open architecture and cross platform deployment characteristics make it widely used in various fields such as e-commerce, finance, telecommunications, production and manufacturing. Software development based on the Java EE platform is a practical course for undergraduate students majoring in computer science. The purpose is to enable students to master the web development technology of the Java EE platform and be able to develop web applications on the Java EE platform. To lay the foundation for students' future in-depth learning and development of enterprise level application systems.

default.zh: 《网络安全的技术演进与创新》课程以网络安全的技术演进和创新规律为脉络，分析IT环境和场景演进规律对网络安全的影响因素，归纳网络安全和信息化的基本逻辑，分析系统脆弱性、安全威胁和对抗代价演进规律，揭示网络安全的内在逻辑，分析创新、商业竞争与供给的演进过程，构建网络安全的能力定义与封装，分析网络安全需求侧、动力与模式演进规律，发现网络安全发展的驱动推动力，分析如何分析需求、规划、设计实现网络安全产品，通过具体产品设计实现经验教训的案例解析教学，建立网络安全产品的规划和设计方法，介绍如何组织网络安全工程研究和创业团队，了解网络安全团队的运营和管理。
default.en: This course examines the evolution principles of IT environment and scenarios on network security,while summarize the fundamental logic of network security and information technology. It also explores the system vulnerability, security threats, and confrontation evolution, and reveals the internal principles of network security. Moreover,it analyzes the evolution process of innovation, business competition, and supply, and builds upon prior knowledge. This course includes the demand side, dynamics, and mode evolution of network security, identifies the motivating force behind network security development, examines how to analyze demand, plan, design, and produce network security products, imparts knowledge through the case study analysis of particular product design realization lessons, and establishes the planning and design methodology for network security.

default.zh: 计算机科学与技术专业导论课是为大一本科生开设的专业入门课程。本课程通过对计算机科学与技术专业范畴及其相关知识、技术内涵的介绍，使学生认知计算机科学与技术专业的核心知识结构、主要技术方向、培养方案和职业发展路径，对计算机科学与技术专业形成较全面的初步认识，为后续专业学习打下良好基础。 本课程围绕计算机科学方向、物联网方向、大数据方向和生物计算方向展开教学，引导学生理解计算机领域不同方向的等核心知识结构，认识大型软硬结合复杂计算系统的设计与构造思路，了解相关领域的前沿发展与典型应用，为专业及职业选择打好基础。
default.en: The Introductory Course to Computer Science and Technology is a foundational course designed for first-year undergraduate students. By introducing the scope of the computer science and technology discipline, along with its related knowledge and technical concepts, this course helps students understand the core knowledge structure, major technical directions, training programs, and career development pathways in the field. It provides students with a comprehensive preliminary understanding of the computer science and technology discipline, laying a solid foundation for subsequent professional studies. The course is structured around four main directions: computer science, the Internet of Things, big data, and biocomputing. It guides students in grasping the core knowledge structures of different areas within the computer discipline, understanding the design and construction principles of large-scale, software-hardware integrated complex computing systems, and becoming familiar with cutting-edge developments and typical applications in related fields. This prepares students for informed choices in their professional and career paths.

default.zh: 人工智能专业导论是面向大类培养的一年级本科生的专业先导课程。课程以“纵览AI全貌、激发专业志趣”为宗旨，从智能的本质出发，沿着符号智能、统计学习、连接智能、生成智能到具身智能的历史脉络，系统介绍人工智能的核心概念、关键技术、学科分支与发展前沿。课程注重培养计算思维、AI意识与跨学科视角，为学生后续深入学习人工智能专业、参与科研实践和创新创业奠定认知基础。
default.en: The Introduction to Artificial Intelligence is an introductory course for artificical intelligence(AI) major for first-year undergraduates. With the purpose of providing an overview of AI and arising professional interest, the course systematically introduces core concepts, key technologies, main research areas and the frontiers of AI. Starting from the concpetion of intelligence, it traces the development from symbolic intelligence, statistical learning, connectionist intelligence, generative intelligence to embodied intelligence. The course emphasizes cultivating computational thinking, AI awareness, and interdisciplinary perspectives, laying a perceptual foundation for students to pursue advanced studies in AI, engage in research practices, and participate in innovation and entrepreneurship.

default.zh: 《信息安全专业导论》是为信息安全本科生开设的专业入门课程。本课程通过对信息安全专业范畴和学科内涵及其相关知识与技术原理的介绍，使学生熟悉信息安全专业学科、知识体系、主要技术以及大模型对信息安全的影响等，对信息安全专业有较全面的认识，为后续专业学习打下良好基础。通过课程的学习，学生能够了解信息安全/网络空间安全的重要性；了解网络空间安全学科涉及的知识全貌、各个研究方向及关键技术；了解网络空间安全的应用需求；了解应对各种网络空间安全威胁所需要采用的解决方案；了解网络空间安全的相关法律法规和重要标准等；掌握网络空间常见的攻击手段和一般性的安全防护措施；了解信息安全产业人才需求、信息安全人才成长要素与职业发展途径，提高终身学习能力和综合素质，为网络强国做出贡献。
default.en: Introduction to Information Security is an entry-level course designed for undergraduate students majoring in Information Security. This course introduces the scope, disciplinary connotation, and related technical principles of the information security field. It aims to familiarize students with the information security discipline, its body of knowledge, major technologies, and the impact of large language models on information security. Through this course, students will develop a comprehensive understanding of the information security profession, laying a solid foundation for subsequent specialized studies. By the end of this course, students will be able to understand the importance of information security / cyberspace security; grasp the full scope of knowledge in cyberspace security, including various research directions and key technologies; recognize the application demands of cyberspace security; understand the solutions required to address various cyberspace security threats; be familiar with relevant laws, regulations, and important standards in cyberspace security; master common attack methods and general security protection measures in cyberspace; understand the industry’s demand for information security professionals, the factors contributing to talent development, and career pathways in the field; enhance lifelong learning capabilities and overall comprehensive qualities, contributing to the goal of building China’s strength in cyberspace.

default.zh: 生物医学图像处理是生物医学与计算机科学相结合的一门新兴交叉学科。作为计算成像与感知领域中的最重要组成部分之一，它旨在解决生物医学和生物信息学中的各类计算成像及图像处理与分析等关键问题。《生物医学图像处理》课程将结合生物和医学图像处理与分析、基因芯片、生物大分子结构测定等科研实践领域的前沿成果，重点讲授各类计算成像原理和处理算法等基本知识和关键技术。课程内容既涵盖X线、CT、MRI、PET/CT等现代医学成像领域十余个诺贝尔奖成果的关键原理与思想，也涉及到以深度学习方法为代表的计算成像领域最新发展，从而为学生展示学科领域的学术发展蓝图，启发和拓展学生的学术视野，助力学生准确把握领域技术发展趋势。
default.en: Biomedical Image Processing (BIP) is a burgeoning interdisciplinary field that merges biomedicine with computer science. As one of the most pivotal components within the realm of computational imaging and perception, it is dedicated to addressing critical issues in computational imaging, as well as image processing and analysis within the spheres of biomedicine and bioinformatics. The "Biomedical Image Processing" course synthesizes cutting-edge research outcomes from scientific practices in biological and medical image processing and analysis, gene microarrays, and macromolecular structure determination. It emphasizes the instruction of fundamental knowledge and key technologies, including various computational imaging principles and processing algorithms. The course content encompasses the core principles and innovations of over a dozen Nobel Prize-winning advancements in modern medical imaging domains such as X-ray, CT, MRI, and PET/CT, while also engaging with the latest developments in computational imaging, notably those involving deep learning methodologies. This curriculum is designed to unveil an academic blueprint of the discipline, to inspire and broaden students' scholarly perspectives, and to empower them with a precise understanding of the technological trends within the field.

default.zh: 本课程是面向计算机科学与工程专业学生的专业实践课。课程通过让学生使用C/C++语言在 Linux平台下完成指定的程序设计题目，包括熟悉开发平台、软件模块开发、较复杂软件的设计与实现、将X86平台的程序迁移到ARM平台等任务，训练学生的程序设计能力、利用大模型编程的能力、积累跨平台程序移植经验，全方面强化并提高学生在程序设计实践方面的能力，包括：基本编码能力、调试能力、初步的算法设计能力、较大规模软件工程的设计与实现能力、跨平台程序移植能力等。
default.en: It is a professional practical course for students majoring in Computer Science and Technology. By guiding students to complete designated programming tasks using C/C++ language on the Intel X86 + Linux platform, the course covers tasks such as familiarizing with the development platform, developing software modules, designing and implementing relatively complex software, and migrating programs from the X86 platform to the ARM platform. It aims to train students' programming skills, help them accumulate experience in cross-platform program migration, and comprehensively strengthen and improve their capabilities in programming practice, including: basic coding ability, debugging ability, preliminary algorithm design ability, ability to design and implement large-scale software engineering, and cross-platform program migration ability.

default.zh: 《处理器设计与实践C》开发真正以学生为中心的教学模式，使学生通过实验教学，深入理解硬件设计思想与方法，引导学生通过解决问题学习硬件设计的相关知识。通过进行设计性与综合性实践教学内容的设计，使学生通过学习和实践，掌握有关硬件设计语言和工具的功能和用法。着重引导学生以整体观念看待CPU和设计CPU，有助于计算机整体结构的理解，培养学生系统设计能力和理论与实践结合的能力，锻炼学生的设计能力和动手能力，进一步提高学生的自学能力和解决实际问题的能力，培养学生的综合素质。
default.en: Processor Design and Practice C develops a truly student-centered teaching model that enables students to deeply understand hardware design ideas and methods through experimental teaching, guide students to learn and discover knowledge through problem-solving, and comprehensive practical teaching content. Through learning and practice, Master the functions and usage of hardware design languages and tools. Emphasis should be placed on guiding students to view and design CPUs with a holistic perspective, which helps to understand the overall structure of computers, cultivate students' ability to design systems and combine theory with practice, exercise their design and hands-on abilities, further improve their self-learning and problem-solving abilities, and cultivate their comprehensive qualities.

default.zh: 本课程是面向计算机科学与技术专业（第二学士学位）本科生的专业实践课。课程通过让学生使用C/C++语言在Intel X86 + Linux平台下，以项目程序开发为目标，完成指定题目的软件系统程序设计、开发、调试以及软件迁移等内容，训练学生的程序设计能力、积累跨平台程序移植经验，全方面强化并提高学生在程序设计实践方面的能力，包括：基本编码能力、调试能力、初步的算法设计能力、较大规模软件工程的设计与实现能力、跨平台程序移植能力。
default.en: The course aimed at students majoring in computer science and technology, as well as students from Future Technology College. The course aims to train students' programming skills, accumulate experience in cross platform program porting, and comprehensively enhance and enhance their practical abilities in programming by allowing them to complete designated programming tasks using C/C++language on the Intel X86+Linux platform, including familiarization with development platforms, software module development, design and implementation of complex software, and migration of programs from the X86 platform to the ARM platform, Including basic coding ability, debugging ability, preliminary algorithm design ability, design and implementation ability for large-scale software engineering, and cross platform program transplantation ability.

default.zh: 在掌握人工智能初步知识和具备高级程序设计语言能力的基础上，通过本课程为人工智能专业学生提供充分的程序设计实践平台，以典型人工智能算法为案例，充分锻炼学生基础的程序设计实践能力，并为后续人工智能高阶课程提供基础。本课程教学与学生已有基础相结合，提高学生的编程能力与人工智能算法理解能力，完善与之配套的“重基础、强能力”的教学模式。课程核心指导思想为使学生充分提高程序实践能力，并对人工智能算法具有较为深入的理解，通过3个独立人工智能算法案例、1个综合实践案例，在不同层面锻炼学生人工智能程序设计与实践能力。完善实验现场代码验收流程及评分体系，指导学生实验报告的书写规范，提升实验报告的评价质量。
default.en: Building on the foundation of basic knowledge in artificial intelligence and advanced programming language skills, this course offers a comprehensive platform for program design practice to students majoring in artificial intelligence. By employing typical AI algorithms as case studies, the course enhances students' fundamental program design and practical skills, while providing a solid groundwork for subsequent advanced AI courses. The teaching methodology combines existing student knowledge with instruction to improve both programming abilities and understanding of AI algorithms, thus enhancing the "emphasis on fundamentals and strong capabilities" teaching model. The core guiding principle of this course is to fully enhance students' program practical abilities and foster a deeper understanding of AI algorithms. This is achieved through three independent AI algorithm case studies and one comprehensive practical case study, which exercise students' AI program design and practical skills at various levels. Furthermore, the course refines the on-site code acceptance process and grading system, guides students in writing standardized experiment reports, and improves the quality of report evaluations. By the end of this course, students will have gained comprehensive hands-on experience in designing and implementing AI programs and developing a deep understanding of AI algorithms. They will be well-equipped to tackle advanced AI courses and contribute effectively to the field of AI.

default.zh: 在掌握人工智能初步知识和具备高级程序设计语言能力的基础上，通过本课程为人工智能专业学生提供充分的程序设计实践平台，以典型人工智能算法为案例，充分锻炼学生基础的程序设计实践能力，并为后续人工智能高阶课程提供基础。本课程教学与学生已有基础相结合，提高学生的编程能力与人工智能算法理解能力，完善与之配套的“重基础、强能力”的教学模式。课程核心指导思想为使学生充分提高程序实践能力，并对人工智能算法具有较为深入的理解，通过3个独立人工智能算法案例、1个综合实践案例，在不同层面锻炼学生人工智能程序设计与实践能力。完善实验现场代码验收流程及评分体系，指导学生实验报告的书写规范，提升实验报告的评价质量。
default.en: This course provides a sufficient programming practice platform for students majoring in artificial intelligence who have mastered preliminary knowledge of artificial intelligence and possessing advanced programming language skills. Using typical artificial intelligence algorithms as cases, it fully exercises students' basic programming practice abilities and provides a foundation for subsequent advanced courses in artificial intelligence. This course combines teaching with students' existing foundations to enhance their programming skills and understanding of artificial intelligence algorithms, and to improve the corresponding teaching model of "emphasizing foundations and strengthening abilities". The core guiding ideology of the course is to enable students to fully improve their practical skills in programming and have a deeper understanding of artificial intelligence algorithms. Through three independent artificial intelligence algorithm cases and one comprehensive practical case, students can exercise their abilities in artificial intelligence programming and practice at different levels. Improve the code acceptance process and scoring system at the experimental site, guide students to write experimental reports in a standardized manner, and enhance the evaluation quality of experimental reports.

default.zh: 《深度学习全栈开发项目实践》面向人工智能与计算机科学等专业本科生，重点讲授将深度学习模型集成到Web应用中的全流程技术栈。课程涵盖前端开发、后端框架、模型服务化及系统部署等核心内容。通过项目驱动，培养学生独立设计、实现并部署支持图像识别、自然语言处理等功能的端到端全栈应用的能力，使其掌握从需求分析到产品上线的工程化开发思维，具备将AI模型转化为实际应用产品的综合技能。
default.en: "Deep Learning Full-Stack Development Project Practice" is designed for undergraduate students in artificial intelligence, computer science, and related majors. The course focuses on teaching the full-stack technology pipeline for integrating deep learning models into web applications. It covers core components including front-end development, back-end frameworks, model serving, and system deployment. Through project-driven learning, the course cultivates students' ability to independently design, implement, and deploy end-to-end full-stack applications that support functions such as image recognition and natural language processing. This enables students to master engineering development thinking from requirements analysis to product launch and acquire comprehensive skills for transforming AI models into practical application products.

default.zh: 《人工智能综合项目实践》是一门面向具备一定人工智能理论基础的学生开设的核心实践课程。本课程旨在打破传统理论教学与工程应用之间的壁垒，通过一个完整的、贴近工业界的项目周期，全面提升学生在人工智能领域的综合实践能力、创新思维与团队协作精神。 课程的核心教学模式为“项目驱动学习”。学生将以小组为单位，围绕一个具有实际应用背景的复杂问题（如智能推荐系统、计算机视觉应用、自然语言处理任务或智能决策模型等），亲历从问题定义、数据采集与处理、模型选型与训练、系统集成开发到最终部署上线的全流程。这一过程不仅是对机器学习、深度学习等核心技术的深度运用，更是对软件工程、项目管理知识的综合考验。 课程内容将涵盖几个关键阶段：首先，是项目立项与需求分析，培养学生将模糊需求转化为具体技术指标的能力。其次，是数据工程环节，让学生在实践中掌握数据清洗、标注、增强等关键预处理技术。随后，进入核心的模型构建与优化阶段，学生需要灵活运用所学算法，并通过实验设计、超参数调优等手段追求最佳性能。最后，课程将重点指导如何将训练好的模型封装为可用的服务或应用，并探讨模型部署、性能监控及迭代维护等生产环节中的实际问题。 本课程的特色在于其高度的综合性与前沿性。它不仅是所学理论的“试金石”，更是激发学生创新能力的“练兵场”。通过解决真实世界中的挑战，学生将深刻理解理论模型的局限性以及工程实践中的各种权衡。同时，课程将强调团队协作、项目管理、文档撰写和成果展示，全方位塑造符合产业需求的AI人才。 完成本课程后，学生将能够独立或协作完成一个中等复杂度的AI项目，具备将创新想法转化为实际解决方案的强大执行力，为未来从事人工智能相关的研发、工程岗位或深造研究奠定坚实的实践基础。
default.en: Comprehensive Artificial Intelligence Project Practice" is a core practical course designed for students who already possess a foundational theoretical understanding of artificial intelligence. This course aims to bridge the gap between traditional theoretical teaching and engineering application. Through a complete project lifecycle that closely mirrors real-world industry scenarios, it comprehensively enhances students' hands-on capabilities, innovative thinking, and team collaboration spirit in the AI field. The core teaching methodology is "Project-Driven Learning." Students will work in small groups to tackle a complex problem with practical application background (e.g., an intelligent recommendation system, computer vision application, natural language processing task, or intelligent decision-making model). They will experience the entire project workflow firsthand: from problem definition, data collection and processing, and model selection and training, to system integration, development, and final deployment. This process is not only an in-depth application of core technologies like machine learning and deep learning but also a comprehensive test of software engineering and project management knowledge. The course content covers several key phases. First, project initiation and requirements analysis, cultivating the ability to translate vague needs into specific technical specifications. Second, the data engineering phase, where students master crucial preprocessing techniques like data cleaning, labeling, and augmentation through practice. Subsequently, the core model building and optimization stage requires students to flexibly apply learned algorithms and pursue optimal performance through experimental design and hyperparameter tuning. Finally, the course focuses on guiding students on how to package trained models into usable services or applications and explores practical aspects of production environments like model deployment, performance monitoring, and iterative maintenance. A key feature of this course is its highly comprehensive and cutting-edge nature. It serves not only as a "touchstone" for testing theoretical knowledge but also as a "training ground" for stimulating students' innovative abilities. By solving real-world challenges, students will deeply understand the limitations of theoretical models and the various trade-offs inherent in engineering practice. Simultaneously, the course emphasizes teamwork, project management, documentation, and presentation skills, holistically shaping AI talent that meets industry demands. Upon completion, students will be capable of independently or collaboratively completing a moderately complex AI project. They will possess the strong execution skills needed to transform innovative ideas into practical solutions, laying a solid practical foundation for future careers in AI-related research, development, engineering roles, or further academic pursuits.

default.zh: 使学生掌握和运用网站前后端开发知识，实现一个具有实用价值的网站。训练和提高学生的编程技能，全面掌握web系统开发知识，具有应用体系架构和系统实现能力。 系统设计和开发过程中树立安全意识，思考底层架构如何影响可维护性和可用性等安全问题，设计具有安全性的应用系统，为后续专业课程打牢编程基础。
default.en: The purpose of this course is to enable students to have the ability of application architecture and system implementation, master the knowledge of web site development, train and improve students' programming skills, and realize a website development with practical value. Establish security awareness in the process of system design and development, consider how the underlying architecture affects security issues such as maintainability and availability, design application systems with security, and lay a solid programming foundation for subsequent professional courses.

default.zh: 毕业设计是综合运用所学理论知识技术工具完成毕业设计题目的实践环节，要求学生完成毕业设计选题，系统的设计、实现、测试、运行等任务环节，并撰写开题报告、中期报告，毕业设计论文等文档，并完成毕业设计答辩。通过该环节，锻炼学生调查研究和文献综述能力，培养学生利用现代工具，综合运用所学的基础理论知识和专业知识分析和解决复杂工程问题的综合能力。
default.en: The Graduation Thesis (project) is a practical process that comprehensively applies the theoretical knowledge and technical tools learned to complete the graduation project topic. Students are required to complete the graduation project topic selection, system design, implementation, testing, operation and other tasks, and write opening reports, mid-term reports, graduation project papers and other documents, as well as complete the graduation project defense. Through this section, students will develop their ability to conduct research and literature review, and develop their comprehensive ability to analyze and solve complex engineering problems by utilizing modern tools and integrating their basic theoretical and professional knowledge.

default.zh: 《工业实践》是软件工程专业本科的专业核心课程，目的是通过在企业实习的经历，将学校教授的理论知识应用到实际的项目开发中，使学生深刻体会真实环境下的软件开发过程，感受实习公司的企业文化，提高软件开发复杂软件系统的综合实战能力，提高专业技术水平，提升观察、分析和解决问题的能力，培养团队协作精神，建立起软件工程师职业素养，增强职业自信，为成为合格的软件工程师打下坚实的基础。 学生进入实习企业后，经过短时间的培训，选择实习项目，进入到项目组。在企业工程师导师的指导下，以项目为驱动，从项目需求获取开始，实践需求分析、系统分析和系统设计、编码实现、软件测试及维护等全过程，在“做中学”，最后完成一个系统或者子系统或模块，并进行系统验收测试，参与项目评审环节，最终撰写实习总结报告设计报告和开发文档。 课程学时为4周，但要求学生在实习公司连续工作时间不得少于3个月。 工业实习最早开始时间为3年级的夏季学期第1周，最晚结束时间为4年级的春季学期毕业论文答辩前1个月（一般为每年的4月末）。
default.en: Industrial Practice is a core course for undergraduate software engineering majors. The purpose is to apply the theoretical knowledge taught by the school to practical project development through internship experience in enterprises, so that students can deeply experience the software development process in a real environment, feel the corporate culture of the internship company, improve the comprehensive practical ability of software development for complex software systems, improve professional technical level, and enhance observation. The ability to analyze and solve problems, cultivate teamwork spirit, establish professional literacy for software engineers, enhance professional confidence, and lay a solid foundation for becoming a qualified software engineer. After entering the internship company, students undergo a short period of training, choose internship projects, and enter the project team. The course duration is 4 weeks, but students are required to work continuously at the internship company for no less than 3 months. The earliest start time for industrial internships is the first week of the summer semester in grade 3, and the latest end time is one month before the graduation thesis defense in the spring semester of grade 4 (usually at the end of April each year).

default.zh: 电路课程是电气与电子信息类各专业的一门专业基础核心课程。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电路理论的基本知识、电路分析计算的基本方法、电路仿真的基本技能，培养学生科学思维和分析、解决工程实际电路问题的基本能力和素质，为后续专业课程的学习和科研实践打下坚实的理论基础。 本课程将介绍电路的基本定律、定理、现象、基本分析和仿真方法。主要内容包括：基本电路元件；线性直流电路分析；电路定理及其应用；正弦稳态电路分析。 课程考核采用累加式考核方式，具体考核环节包括：平时及作业、线上学习和期末考试等部分。
default.en: The ELECTRIC CIRCUIT is a core course specifically for students from Electric and Electronics & Information. By learning this course, these students can acquire knowledge on circuits, including basic principles, basic analysis methods, as well as fundamental experimental skills. What’s more, it also enhances their capability on logical analyzing and their ability to solve practical circuit problems. Those abilities will serve as a solid foundation for learning further relevant specialized courses. This course will introduce basic theory, basic principles, phenomena, analysis methods, simulating methods, as well as experiment skills on electric circuits. It contains: the basic circuit components, the analysis on linear DC circuits, the circuit theorems and their applications, the analysis on sinusoidal stationary state circuits. The course examination adopts accumulative examinations, and the specific examination consists of three parts: routine and assignments, online course, as well as a final examination.

default.zh: 电路与电子学是为未来技术学院工科电类专业开设的电路及电子技术 基础入门课程。课程围绕信号的产生、放大、处理与变换展开，主要研究电路基础理论、电子器件和电子电路的基本工作原理及其应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电路与电子技术的基本概念、基本电路和基本分析方法，培养学生判断、识别、分析和解决复杂电子电路工程问题能力，培养学生创新意识、创新思维与创新能力。电路与电子学课程内容主要包括电路元件和电路定律、线性电路的稳态分析、线性电路的暂态分析、正弦电流电路的稳态分析、运算放大器的基本应用电路、放大电路中的反馈、信号发生电路、信号的处理与变换、逻辑代数基础、组合逻辑电路、时序逻辑电路、数模与模数转换等。
default.en: Circuits and Electronics is a basic and introductory course on circuits and electronics technology for Electronic Engineering majors of the School of Future Technology. The course revolves around the generation, amplification, processing and transformation of signals, and mainly studies the basic theories of circuits, the basic working principles and applications of electronic devices and circuits. By taking this course, students will grasp the fundamental concepts of circuits and electronics technology, be familiar with basic circuits, and learn basic analytical methodologies in the subject matter. This course aims to develop students’ abilities to assess, identify, analyze and solve complex electronics and circuits related engineering problems. It further aims to develop their awareness for, mindset of, and capacity in innovation. The content of Circuits and Electronics mainly consist of the laws of electronic devices and circuits, steady-state analysis and transient analysis of a linear circuit, steady-state analysis of a sinusoidal current circuit, basic operational amplifier circuits, feedback in amplifiers circuits, signal generator circuits, the processing and transformation of signals, basics of Boolean Algebra, combinational logic circuits, sequential logic circuits, D/A and A/D conversion, etc.

default.zh: 电路与电子技术基础是电气工程及其自动化辅修专业的一门专业基础课，为后续电机原理、电力电子学、控制原理与应用、电力系统分析等专业课程的学习奠定必要的电路与电子技术基础知识和分析方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生获得电路与电子技术的基本理论、基本分析方法和基本技能，了解电路、电子技术的应用情况和发展趋势。着重培养学生们解决电路与电子技术相关复杂工程问题的能力，为学生后续的课程学习、创新和从事科学研究工作打下扎实的理论基础。
default.en: Circuit and Electronic Technology Foundation is a fundamental course for the Electrical Engineering and Automation Minor Program. It lays the necessary circuit and electronic technology knowledge and analysis methods for the subsequent study of professional courses such as Motor Principles, Power Electronics, Control Principles and Applications, and Power System Analysis. Through the study of this course, students will acquire the basic theories, basic analysis methods and basic skills of circuit and electronic technology, and understand the application and development trends of circuits and electronic technology. It focuses on cultivating students' ability to solve complex engineering problems related to circuit and electronic technology, laying a solid theoretical foundation for their subsequent course studies, innovation and scientific research work.

default.zh: 电路与电子学实验是电路与电子课程体系的重要组成部分，是其实践教学环节。通过搭建实验环境，规划验证测试方案，获取合理直接测量数据，辨析实验过程中出现的误差，统计、分析数据等实验教学过程，帮助学生掌握课程知识点，培养学生动手实践能力，为分析、解决复杂工程问题提供必要基本知识和能力培养。课程融合电路和电子学内容，实验项目包括基础实验和研究型实验两部分，具有高阶性和挑战度，有效促进学生个性化培养。
default.en: The course "Circuits and Electronic Experiment" is an important part of the course system of circuits and electronic technology. Students could master the knowledge points of the course through the experimental teaching process of building experimental environment, planning verification test scheme, obtaining reasonable direct measurement data, discrimination of errors in the experimental process, statistics and analysis of data. And could cultivate students' practical ability, and provide necessary basic knowledge and ability cultivation for analyzing and solving complex engineering problems. The course integrates the content of circuit and electronics. The experimental projects include basic and research-based experiment, which is of high level and challenging, and effectively promotes the personalized training of students.

default.zh: 电路与电子技术实验是电路与电子课程体系的重要组成部分，是其实践教学环节，目的是加深学生对基础理论知识的掌握，通过具体的实验操作，掌握电路与电子技术现象和原理，以及其内在关系。通过搭建具体实验环境，统筹测试测量工具，规划具体验证测试方案，获取合理的直接测量数据，辨析测量过程中出现的各类误差，统计、分析直接测量数据，结合电路与电子技术知识及其工作原理等实验教学过程，让学生掌握课程要求的知识点，培养学生基本实验技能和动手实践能力，利用理论知识解释具体自然现象能力，为后续利用所学知识分析复杂的具体问题、解决复杂工程问题提供必要基本知识和能力培养。 电路与电子技术实验以电路和电子学理论课程内容为对象，统筹理论课程基本概念、基本电路等知识点，融合电路基础的电子技术内容，开发了具体模块化实验教学平台，有针对性的规划开发了设计性、综合性实验项目，整理、录制、制作了丰富的数字化实验教学资源，学生可以通过信息化教学平台自主学习使用。 通过本课程的学习实践，强化学生对基本概念的理解，使学生掌握实验的基本技能及操作规范、常用电子仪器仪表的使用方法和利用仿真软件分析电路问题的方法，并能够完成具有一定内深度、难度和高阶性的综合研究型实验。
default.en: Circuit and electronic technology experiment is an important part of circuit and electronic curriculum system. The purpose is to deepen the students to grasp the basic theoretical knowledge. Students could grasp the phenomenon and principle of circuit and electronic technology, as well as its internal relationship, through the specific experimental operation. It could cultivate students' basic experimental skills and practical ability, and using theoretical knowledge to explain specific natural phenomena. And it provides necessary basic knowledge and ability training for subsequent analysis of complex specific problems and solving complex engineering problems with the knowledge learned. Circuit and electronic technique experiment integrated circuit and electronic technology. This course adopted modular teaching platform, developed designed and comprehensive experimental projects. A wealth of digital experimental teaching resources were arranged, recorded and produced, and students can learn and use them by themselves through the information teaching platform. Students could be strengthened to understand the basic concepts through the learning and practice of this course. And then help students master the basic skills and operation specifications of the experiment, the use of common electronic instruments and meters, and the method of using simulation software to analyze circuit problems, and complete the comprehensive research experiment with a certain depth, difficulty.

default.zh: 电路分析是电气信息类专业必修的、非常重要的技术基础课，为后续如电子技术等课程的学习准备必要的电路分析基础知识、分析方法。电路在整个电气类专业的人才培养方案和课程体系中起着承前启后的重要作用，对于培养学生的科学思维能力、综合运用电路理论分析和解决实际问题的能力都起到重要的作用。 本课程主要让学生掌握直流电路、交流电路和暂态电路的基本概念、原理和分析方法等，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电路的基本理论知识和分析计算方法，同时培养学生利用数学手段和现代化工具进行电路综合分析与设计的能力，为学生后续的课程学习、创新和从事科学研究工作打下扎实的理论基础。
default.en: The Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis is a core course specifically for students from Electric and Electronics & Information. By learning this course, these students can acquire knowledge on circuits, including basic principles, basic analysis methods, as well as fundamental experimental skills. What’s more, it also enhances their capability on logical analyzing and their ability to solve practical circuit problems. Those abilities will serve as a solid foundation for learning further relevant specialized courses. This course will introduce basic theory, basic principles, phenomena, analysis methods, simulating methods, as well as experiment skills on electric circuits. It contains: the basic circuit components, the analysis on linear DC circuits, the circuit theorems and their applications, the analysis on sinusoidal stationary state circuits.

default.zh: 电路课程是电气与电子信息类各专业的一门专业基础核心课程。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电路理论的基本知识、电路分析计算的基本方法、电路仿真的基本技能，培养学生科学思维和分析、解决工程实际电路问题的基本能力和素质，为后续专业课程的学习和科研实践打下坚实的理论基础。 本课程将介绍电路的基本定律、定理、现象、基本分析和仿真方法。主要内容包括：非正弦稳态电路分析；电路的频率特性与谐振电路分析；线性动态电路的时域及复频域分析。 课程考核采用累加式考核方式，具体考核环节包括：平时及作业、课程报告和期末考试三部分。
default.en: The ELECTRIC CIRCUIT is a core course specifically for students from Electric and Electronics & Information. By learning this course, these students can acquire knowledge on circuits, including basic principles, basic analysis methods, as well as fundamental experimental skills. What’s more, it also enhances their capability on logical analyzing and their ability to solve practical circuit problems. Those abilities will serve as a solid foundation for learning further relevant specialized courses. This course will introduce the basic theory, basic principles, phenomena, analysis methods, simulating methods, as well as experiment skills on electric circuits. It contains: analysis on the non-sinusoidal stationary state circuits, analysis on frequency response and resonant circuits, linear dynamic circuit in time-domain and complex frequency-domain. The course examination adopts accumulative examinations, and the specific examination consists of three parts: routine and assignments, course reports, as well as a final examination.

default.zh: 自动控制广泛应用于现代工业的各个领域，而控制理论是自动控制系统分析和设计的基础理论。课程的主要任务是通过本课程的学习，使学生了解自动控制相关的基本概念、原理和方法，学习并掌握古典控制理论的基本分析、设计方法，了解现代控制和智能控制基本理论和思想，为工程实践打下理论基础。 本课程主要的主要内容包括：反馈的相关概念和自动控制系统的种类、组成、要求等；控制系统的数学模型，古典控制方法的时域频域法的分析和综合等。通过本课程的学习，使学生理解自动控制的核心思想，掌握基本的分析综合方法，学会应用理论理解和分析实际的控制对象，培养学生解决实际的控制工程问题的能力。对学生构建跨学科知识体系，培养系统的思维方法和创新意识，掌握正确的科学研究方法有重要的作用。
default.en: Automatic control is widely used in various fields of modern industry, and the control theory is the basic theory of the analysis and design of automatic control systems. The main task of the course is to make students understand the basic concepts, principles and methods related to automatic control through the study of this course, learn and master the basic analysis and design methods of classical control theory, and understand the basic theories and ideas of modern control and intelligent control, so as to lay a theoretical foundation for engineering practice. The main contents of this course include: the related concepts of feedback and the types, composition and requirements of automatic control system; the mathematical model of control system, the analysis and synthesis of classical control method. Through the study of this course, students can understand the core idea of automatic control, master the basic analysis and comprehensive methods, learn to analyze the practical control objects, and cultivate students' ability to solve practical control engineering problems. This course has the characteristics of general methodology, which plays an important role in constructing students' interdisciplinary knowledge system, cultivating systematic thinking methods and innovative consciousness, mastering the correct scientific research methods.

default.zh: 信号与系统是电类相关专业学生重要的专业基础课之一。 本课程主要讲授内容包括:信号与系统的基本概念，连续时间系统的时域分析，连续时间信号与系统的频域分析，连续时间信号与系统的复频域分析，离散时间系统的时域与频域分析，离散时间系统的Z域分析以及系统分析的状态变量法等内容。通过上述内容的讲授，使学生掌握信号与系统的基本概念，学会连续时间信号与系统及离散时间信号与系统的基本分析方法，包括时域分析方法、频域分析方法、复频域分析方法以及Z域分析方法等；结合电气工程领域背景，着重培养学生机电系统的综合分析与设计能力以及应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。本课程通过课堂讲授、课堂练习、课后作业以及课后计算机仿真等环节，完成上述培养目标。 本课程突出电气工程领域应用特点，结合工程实例，突出各种分析方法、手段的物理背景与含义。通过该课程学习，为学生学习后续专业课，如电机驱动控制系统设计、电力系统分析、电力电子装置及系统、数字控制系统等课程，奠定基础。
default.en: The course named Signals and Systems is one of the important professional basic courses for electronic specialties. The course includes the following contents: the conceptual framework of signals and systems, the time-domain analysis of continuous-time system, the frequency-domain analysis and s-domain analysis of continuous-time signals and systems, the time-domain analysis and the frequency-domain analysis and the Z-domain analysis of discrete-time systems, the state variable method for system analysis and so on. Through learning above contents, students will know the fundamental concepts of signals and systems well, master the analytical methods for continuous-time signals and systems and discrete-time signals and systems, including the time-domain analysis method, the frequency-domain analysis method, s-domain analysis method and z-domain analysis method, etc. The course will take the electrical engineering field as reference, and focus on training the students’ comprehensive analyzing ability and designing ability and applying ability in mechanical and electrical systems. On the base of these, the course will improve the students’ consciousness of innovation, and help to reach the goal of index points of professional learning outcomes. The course includes some typical teaching links, such as lecture, exercises in class, homework and computer simulation after class and so on. Through above teaching links, the course will reach the training goal. Combining with engineering examples, the course will focus on the features in electrical engineering application, and make clear the physics background and the meaning of various analysis methods. This course will help students to learn well the follow-up professional courses, such as design of driving and controlling motor, electric power system analysis, electric power system analysis, digital control system and so on.

default.zh: 电工技术A是为本科生开设的一门重要的专业基础课，包括电路、磁路、电机和电机控制等内容。其目的是使学生通过本课程的学习，使了解电工技术的发展和应用概况，掌握电工技术必要的基本理论、基本知识和基本分析方法，以及常用电机与控制电器的工作原理、特性及使用方法。通过本课程的课堂教学和课后训练等环节，增强学生的实践和创新意识，为后续专业基础课和专业课学习及为从事与本专业有关的工程技术等工作打下一定的电的基础。 本课程主要内容包括直流电路、交流电路、三相电路、暂态电路、磁路与铁心线圈电路、三相交流异步电动机、直流电机及控制电机简介、继电接触器控制系统等。
default.en: Electrotechnics A is an important professional basic course for undergraduates. This course strives to achieve objective and philosophy of focusing on the fundamental principles, models, and technical requirements needed for analyzing and designing practical electrical systems. The purpose of this course is for students to have a general idea of the applications and advancements of electrical technology, and build a strong foundation on pursuing the relative engineering work. Electrotechnics A is a course with strong practicality and comprehensiveness. Through the analysis of some practical cases, this course will cultivate students' abilities to apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems. The main contents include: Basic concepts, laws and analysis methods of DC circuits; Transient state analysis of First-order linear circuits; Analysis and calculation of sinusoidal AC circuits; Analysis and calculation of three phase AC circuits; Magnetic circuit analysis; Transformer; Three-phase AC asynchronous motor, Single phase asynchronous motor and DC motor; Control circuit apparatus and their applications in motor control.

default.zh: 电子技术A是一门重要的专业基础课，包括模拟电子技术与数字电子技术。其目的是使学生通过本课程的学习，了解电子技术的发展和应用概况，获得电子技术必要的基本理论，基本知识和基本分析方法，熟悉常用模拟电路和数字电路的工作原理、特点及使用方法。通过本课程的课堂教学和课后训练等环节，增强学生的实践和创新意识，为后续专业基础课和专业课学习及为从事与本专业有关的工程技术等工作打下一定的电子技术基础。 本课程主要内容包括常用半导体元器件、基本放大电路及其分析方法、集成运算放大电路的线性与非线性应用、信号发生与变换电路、直流电源电路、数字电路基础知识、门电路与组合逻辑电路、触发器与时序逻辑电路、数模与模数转换电路等。
default.en: Electronics A is an important professional basic course for undergraduates. This course is presented with the goal of understanding the behavior of electronic devices, circuits, and systems before the nitty-gritty details of calculating the behavior, having a general idea of the applications and advancements of electronic technology, and building a strong foundation on pursuing the relative engineering work. Electronics A is a course with strong practicality and comprehensiveness. Through the analysis of some practical cases, this course will cultivate students' abilities to apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems. The main contents of this course include: Common semiconductor devices; Basic amplification circuits and their analysis methods; Linear and nonlinear applications of integrated operational amplifier circuits; Signal generation and transformation circuits; DC power supply circuits; Basic knowledge of digital circuits; Gate circuits and combinational logic circuits; Flip-flops and sequential logic circuits; Digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital conversion circuits.

The main contents include: The basic working principle and characteristics of semiconductor devices; Transistor amplifiers; Operational amplifiers; Active working principles of rectifier circuits, Filter circuits and DC regulators; Logic gates; Analysis and design of digital logic circuits.

default.zh: 电工与电子技术A是一门重要的专业基础课，本课程主要讲授电路基础、模拟电路和数字电路的基础理论和相关分析方法。具体内容包括：直流电路的基本概念、基本定律和基本分析方法；电路瞬态过程产生的原因和条件，一阶电路瞬态过程中电压和电流的变化规律；交流电的基本概念，正弦量的相量表示法与计算；三相电源和负载的连接方式，三相电路中的电压、电流和功率计算；常用半导体器件；由分立元件构成的基本放大电路的电路结构、工作原理以及分析方法；集成运算放大器的特性及典型应用电路；整流电路、滤波电路以及直流稳压电路的工作原理；数字逻辑基础知识以及组合逻辑电路的分析与设计；双稳态触发器的类型与逻辑功能，典型时序逻辑电路的分析方法与应用。 通过本课程的学习，使学生获得电工与电子技术的基本理论、基本分析方法和基本技能，了解电工、电子技术的应用情况和发展趋势。通过本课程的课堂教学以及后续实验操作等环节，培养学生对电工以及电子系统的综合分析、综合设计能力，在日后工程实践及日常生活中能够运用所学的电学知识分析和解决实际问题。
default.en: Electrical and Electronic Technology A is an important professional basic course for undergraduates. The course focuses on basic theories and analysis methods of circuits and electronics, and its contents include: Basic concepts, laws and analysis methods of DC circuits; Transient state analysis of First-order linear circuits; Analysis and calculation of sinusoidal AC circuits; Analysis and calculation of three phase AC circuits; Working principle of commonly used semiconductor devices; Transistor amplifiers; Operational amplifiers and their applications; Working principle of rectifier circuits, filter circuits and DC regulators; Logic gates; Analysis and design of digital logic circuits, etc. The purpose of this course is for students to obtain basic theory, knowledge and technical skill in electrical and electronic technology field, have a general idea of the applications and advancements of electrical and electronic technology, and build a strong foundation on pursuing the relative engineering work. Through the analysis of some practical cases, this course will cultivate students' abilities to apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 电工与电子技术B是一门重要的专业基础课。其目的是使学生通过本课程的学习，获得电子技术及电机方面必要的基本理论，基本知识和基本技能，了解电工与电子技术的应用和发展概况，为从事与本专业有关的工程技术等工作打下一定的基础。 本课程主要内容包括：模拟电子技术、数字电子技术和电机及控制。电工与电子技术是一门实践性较强的技术基础课，通过本课程的学习，着重培养学生分析问题、解决问题及综合用电的能力，增强创新意识。

default.zh: 电工与电子技术C是一门非常重要的专业基础课，本课程主要讲授电路基础、模拟电路和数字电路的基础理论和相关分析方法。具体内容包括：直流电路的基本概念、基本定律和基本分析方法；电路瞬态过程产生的原因和条件，一阶电路瞬态过程中电压和电流的变化规律；交流电的基本概念，正弦量的相量表示法与计算；三相电源和负载的连接方式，三相电路中的电压、电流和功率计算；常用半导体器件；由分立元件构成的基本放大电路的电路结构、工作原理以及分析方法；集成运算放大器的特性及典型应用电路；数字逻辑基础知识以及组合逻辑电路的分析与设计；双稳态触发器的类型与逻辑功能，典型时序逻辑电路的分析方法与应用。 通过本课程的学习，使学生获得电工与电子技术的基本理论、基本分析方法和基本技能，了解电工、电子技术的应用情况和发展趋势。通过本课程的课堂教学以及后续实验操作等环节，培养学生对电工以及电子系统的综合分析、综合设计能力，在日后工程实践及日常生活中能够运用所学的电学知识分析和解决实际问题。

default.zh: 电子技术基础是为高校工科电类专业本科生开设的电子技术入门性质的技术基础课。电子技术基础包括模拟电子技术基础和数字电子技术基础。电子技术基础课程主要研究电子器件、电子电路的基本工作原理及其应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电子技术的基本理论、基本知识，培养学生分析电子电路和初步设计电子电路的能力。 模拟电子技术基础课程内容包括半导体二极管及其基本应用电路、双极型晶体管及其基本放大电路、场效应管及其基本放大电路、集成运算放大器的单元电路、集成运算放大器基本应用电路、放大电路中的反馈、信号发生电路、信号的处理与变换和直流电源。
default.en: Fundamentals of electronics is a rudimental course of electronic technology for undergraduates majoring in the specialty of electricity. This course consists of two parts: fundamentals of analog electronics and fundamentals of digital electronics. It chiefly studies the working principles and applications of electronic devices and electronic circuits. Through this course, students can acquire elementary theory and knowledge of electronic technology, and develop their initial ability of analyzing and designing electronic circuits. The major contents of fundamentals of analog electronics include semiconductor diode with its basic application circuits, bipolar junction transistor with its basic amplifying circuits, field effect transistor with its basic amplifying circuits, element circuits of integrated operational amplifiers, basic application circuits of integrated operational amplifiers, feedback in amplifying circuits, signal generator, signal processing and transformation, direct current source.
