default.en: Fundamentals of electronics is a rudimental course of electronic technology for undergraduates majoring in the specialty of electricity. This course consists of two parts: fundamentals of analog electronics and fundamentals of digital electronics. It chiefly studies the working principles and applications of electronic devices and electronic circuits. Through this course, students can acquire elementary theory and knowledge of electronic technology, and develop their initial ability of analyzing and designing electronic circuits. The major contents of fundamentals of digital electronics include basic of logic algebra, logic gate circuit, combinational logic circuit, trigger, sequential logic circuits, semiconductor memory, programmable logic device, pulse waveform generation and transform, analog-digital and digital-analog converter.

default.zh: 电路实验D是本科电类专业第一门重要的专业技术基础实验课程，与之相对应的理论课程为电路D。通过本课程的学习，要求学生掌握常用仪器仪表的使用、基本电路参数的测量、测量误差的分析与计算；学会实验方案设计、实验曲线的测试与绘制、以及PSpice仿真软件的使用。 本课程采用全开放自主学习的实验模式，通过基于网络数字化资源的预习、实验硬件操作和计算机仿真等教学环节的训练，旨在加深学生对基础理论知识的理解，培养学生进行电类实验的基本技能、数据分析的能力和正确处理工程问题的能力。为后续专业课程和从事工程技术工作奠定良好的基础。
default.en: Electric Circuit Experiment D are the first and important professional basic experimental curriculum for undergraduates major in electricity, its corresponding theoretical courses is “Electric Circuit D”. The main task of this course is to make the students master the basic experiment skills, operation of common instruments, measurements of basic circuit parameters, error analysis, design of experimental scheme, drawing experimental curve, and using of simulation software PSpice. All open and self-directed learning models are used in this experimental curriculum. Through preparing lessons before class based on network digital resources, experimental operation, and computer simulation, aims at enhancing students’ understanding of basic theoretical knowledge, cultivating students' practice ability, comprehensive design ability, self-regulated learning ability and the ability to correctly solve engineering problems, which lays a good foundation for the follow-up professional courses and working in engineering technology filed.

default.zh: 电工学实验是培养本科非电类专业学生理论联系实际的实践性环节，为学生提供了一个培养动手能力、综合设计能力和创新能力的实践平台。本课程主要讲授常见电工仪器仪表的使用方法、直流、交流、单管等基础原理的验证、电动机的继电接触器控制、数字逻辑及时序逻辑电路的设计、OrCAD仿真高新技术的应用，既包括基础性验证实验，又包括综合性、设计性创新实验。 通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、后续的实验操作和计算机仿真等环节，使学生掌握常用电工仪器的使用方法和常用电路的调试测量方法，加深理解基础电路的工作原理，提高学生的分析设计能力，了解高新技术，培养学生的综合素质及工程能力。
default.en: The main purpose of the Electrotechnics Experiment is to foster the undergraduate of non–electrical specialties to apply in practice the knowledge they had acquired in theory class, and construct a platform for students that can develop their practical ability, comprehensive design ability and innovation ability. This course teaches students the usage of instruments and meters, the validation of basic principles, such as DC, AC and single tube etc, the control of relay contactor of the electromotor, the design of digital logic and sequential logic circuit, and the application of OrCAD simulation technology. This course includes the design of the confirmatory experiments, comprehensive experiments, and also includes creative experiments. Through the preview which is based on network digital resources, experimental operation, and computer simulation, students could easily master the usage of the instruments and meters, and the debugging and measuring methods of common circuits, and deeply understand circuit operational principles, and improve their abilities to analyze issues, understand new and high technology, and develop students' comprehensive quality and engineering ability.

default.zh: “电工技术实验”是面向未来技术学院智能机器人专业的一门主要实验课程，是一门培养学生电工技术基本技能的实验教学课。“电工技术实验”这门课和“电工技术”理论课是相辅相成互相促进的，许多理论概念必须通过实验才能获得更清晰、更深入的理解；在实验中获得的丰富知识和经验有利于主动地学习理论，实验过程会加深对理论教学内容的理解。 本课程主要讲授常见电工仪器仪表的使用方法、直流和交流电路硬件实验、计算机仿真实验等内容。课程采用全开放的实验教学方法，学生自主学习、教师辅导为辅助的实验教学模式，利用网络教学平台，为学生提供实验选课、课件预习、预考核、仪器仪表使用视频以及成绩查询等服务。课程考核方法包括平时成绩和期末考试两部分，总成绩以百分计。 通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、后续的实验操作等环节，使学生熟练掌握电子仪器仪表的使用方法和常用电子电路的调试测量方法，提高学生设计、调试电子电路的能力，培养科学作风、创新精神和研究性思维。
default.en: “Electrotechnics Experiment” is a main experiment course of intelligent robot major in the school of future technology， which is an experimental course to develop students' basic skills in electrical technology. “Electrical Technology Experiments” and “Electrical Technology” are complementary each other, then many theoretical principles must be put into experiments to get a clearer and deeper understanding. The knowledge and experience acquired during the experiment is beneficial to study the principle actively, and the procedure of the experiment will deepen the understanding of the content of the subject. This course mainly includes the use of common electrical instruments and meters, DC and AC circuit hardware experiments, and computer simulation experiments, etc. This course adopts an open totally experimental teaching method with students’ autonomous learning and teachers' guidance as the auxiliary teaching mode. The network teaching platform provides the system of selecting experimental course for students, courseware preparation, pre assessment, instrument using video and record inquiry service. The assessment methods of this course include two parts, the usual score and the final exam. The total score is 100 percent. Through the preview based on network digital resources and subsequent experimental operation, this course enables students to master the use of electronic instruments and electronic circuits, improve the students' ability to design and debug of electronic circuits, training scientific style, the spirit of innovation and research thinking.

default.zh: 电工与电子技术实验D是培养本科非电类专业学生理论联系实际的实践性环节，为学生提供了一个培养动手能力、综合设计能力和创新能力的实践平台。本课程主要讲授常见电工电子仪器仪表的使用方法、电工与电子技术实验，既包括基础性验证实验，又包括综合性、设计性实验。 通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、实验操作等环节，使学生掌握常用电工电子仪器仪表的使用方法和常用电路的调试测量方法，加深理解基础电路的工作原理，提高学生的分析设计能力，培养学生根据技术要求，设计、调试电路和分析、排查故障的能力。
default.en: The main purpose of the Experiment of Electrotechnics and Electronic Technology D is to foster the undergraduate of non–electrical specialties to apply in practice the knowledge they had acquired in theory class, and construct a platform for students that can develop their practical ability, comprehensive design ability and innovation ability. This course includes the usage of the instruments and meters, and the design of the confirmatory experiments and comprehensive experiments. Through the preview, experimental operation and other links based on network digital resources of this course, students can master the use methods of common electrical and electronic instruments and the debugging and measurement methods of common circuits, deepen their understanding of the working principles of basic circuits, improve their analysis and design ability, and cultivate their ability to design, debug circuits, analyze and troubleshoot according to technical requirements.

default.zh: 电工与电子技术实验E是培养本科非电类专业学生理论联系实际的实践性环节，为学生提供了一个培养动手能力、综合设计能力和创新能力的实践平台。本课程主要讲授常见电工电子仪器仪表的使用方法、电工与电子技术实验，既包括基础性验证实验，又包括综合性、设计性实验。 通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、实验操作等环节，使学生掌握常用电工电子仪器仪表的使用方法和常用电路的调试测量方法，加深理解基础电路的工作原理，提高学生的分析设计能力，培养学生根据技术要求，设计、调试电路和分析、排查故障的能力。
default.en: The main purpose of the Experiment of Electrotechnics and Electronic Technology E is to foster the undergraduate of non–electrical specialties to apply in practice the knowledge they had acquired in theory class, and construct a platform for students that can develop their practical ability, comprehensive design ability and innovation ability. This course includes the usage of the instruments and meters, and the design of the confirmatory experiments and comprehensive experiments. Through the preview, experimental operation and other links based on network digital resources of this course, students can master the use methods of common electrical and electronic instruments and the debugging and measurement methods of common circuits, deepen their understanding of the working principles of basic circuits, improve their analysis and design ability, and cultivate their ability to design, debug circuits, analyze and troubleshoot according to technical requirements.

default.zh: 模拟电子技术实验是高等工科院校中电气信息类及相关专业的一门主要实验课程，是一门培养学生电子技术基本技能的实验教学课，是学生学习后续专业课程的基础。实验中获得的丰富知识和经验有利于学生主动学习理论，有助于提升学生模拟电子电路系统的综合分析能力和综合设计能力。 本课程主要讲授常见电子仪器仪表的使用方法、模拟电子电路硬件实验、仿真实验、电路板焊接实验。通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、后续的实验操作和计算机仿真等环节，使学生掌握常用电子仪器的使用方法和常用电子电路的调试测量方法，加深理解电子电路的基本工作原理和电子电路的分析设计方法。培养学生查阅电子器件手册并选用合适的元器件的能力，了解和初步掌握电子电路的设计、安装、调试和故障的排除，以及培养学生科学作风、创新精神和研究性思维。
default.en: Analog Electronics Experiment is a major experimental course for electrical information and related majors in higher engineering colleges. It is an experimental teaching course that cultivates students' basic skills in electronic technology, and is the foundation for students to learn subsequent professional courses. The rich knowledge and experience gained through experiments is conducive to students' active learning of theory and to improving their comprehensive analysis and design capabilities of analog electronic circuit systems. This course mainly teaches the use of common electronic instruments and meters, analog electronic circuit hardware experiments, simulation experiments, and circuit board welding experiments. Through the preview of web-based digital resources, subsequent experimental operations, and computer simulations in this course, students will be able to master the usage methods of commonly used electronic instruments and the debugging and measurement methods of commonly used electronic circuits, and deepen their understanding of the basic working principles of electronic circuits and the analysis and design methods of electronic circuits. Cultivate students' ability to consult electronic device manuals and select appropriate components, understand and master the selection of electronic devices and basic experimental methods of electronic circuits, understand and initially master the design, installation, debugging, and troubleshooting of electronic circuits, and cultivate students' scientific style, innovative spirit, and research thinking.

default.zh: 数字电子技术实验B是高等工科院校中电气信息类及相关专业的一门主要实验课程，是一门培养学生电子技术基本技能的实验教学课，是学生学习后续专业课程的基础，在培养学生数字电子电路系统的综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授数字电子电路硬件实验、仿真实验等内容。课程采用全开放的实验教学方法，学生自主学习、教师辅导的实验教学模式。通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、后续的实验操作和计算机仿真等环节，使学生了解和掌握常用集成数字芯片的使用方法；了解可编程逻辑器件的使用方法；了解和掌握电子器件的选择和数字电子电路的基本实验方法；掌握数字电子电路的设计、安装、调试和故障的排除。
default.en: Digital Electronics Experiment B is a major experimental course for electrical information and related majors in higher engineering colleges. It is an experimental teaching course that cultivates students' basic skills in electronic technology, and is the foundation for students to learn subsequent professional courses. The rich knowledge and experience gained through experiments is conducive to students' active learning of theory and to improving their comprehensive analysis and design capabilities of digital electronic circuit systems. This course mainly includes digital electronic circuit hardware experiments, computer simulation experiments, and so on. This course adopts an open totally experimental teaching method with students’ autonomous learning and teachers' guidance as the auxiliary teaching mode. Through the preview of web-based digital resources, subsequent experimental operations, and computer simulations in this course, students will be able to understand and master the methods of using commonly used integrated digital chips, understand the methods of using FPGA, understand and master the selection of electronic devices and basic experimental methods of digital electronic circuits, and master the design, installation debugging and troubleshooting.

default.zh: 电磁场是电气信息类学生非常重要的专业基础课。它所涉及的内容是电类专业学生应具备的知识结构的必要组成部分，同时又是一些交叉领域的学科生长点和新兴边缘学科发展的基础。 课程强调电磁现象的物理原理和数学描述的统一性。本课程将介绍电磁场的基本定律、定理、基本的分析和仿真方法及基本的电磁场实验方法。主要内容包括：静电场、恒定电场、恒定磁场、时变电磁场、准静态电磁场、电路参数的定义和计算方法、电磁场的能量及其转换规律、平面电磁波以及电气工程中的典型电磁场问题。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握宏观电磁场的基本理论，并能够解决实际工程电磁场问题。 课程最后成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时、实验和仿真等。 撰写人： 金钊 审核人： 杨旭强 日 期： 2025年10月23日
default.en: The course in Electromagnetic Fields is a fundamental and technological course for the students belong to the electrical information class. The content involved in this course is an essential part of the knowledge structure for electrical major students. It is the basis what they must control. Meanwhile, it is also the growth point for the knowledge of interdisciplinary and the foundation for the development of the emerging edge discipline. This course emphasizes itself on the unity of the physical principle behind the electromagnetic phenomena and mathematical description. The main contents are as follows: the electrostatic fields, the electric current fields, the magneto static fields, the time-varying fields, the quasi-static field, the definition and calculation method of circuit parameters, the energy transformation of the electromagnetic fields, the uniform plane wave and the typical electromagnetic problems in electric engineering. The main purpose of this course is to lead the students to matter the basis theory in macro electromagnetic filed and use the knowledge to solve problems in electro-magnetic engineering. The final score for the course consists of attends at ordinary times, in-class quiz, experiment report, experiment on computer performance and the final exam. Author: Zhao Jin ReViewer: Xuqiang Yang Date:October 23,2025

default.zh: 《信号与系统》是电类专业学生重要的专业基础课之一。在电气工程领域，无论你是从事电机设计与电机驱动控制，还是电力系统的遥测、遥信、遥控和遥调与电力系统故障诊断；无论你是从事电力电子能源变换与伺服驱动，还是电工理论与新技术等领域，解决这些领域的复杂工程问题，都离不开信号与系统相关知识的应用。 本课程从信号与系统的基本概念出发，以微分方程的不同方法求取方法为线索，通过引导学生学习经典傅立叶变换、拉普拉斯变换和z变换等系统知识，使学生掌握时域分析、频域分析、复频域分析和z域分析等多种连续时间域和离散时间域的信号与系统的分析方法，以及掌握系统分析的状态变量法等内容。 课程深度结合电气工程领域背景，着重培养学生对机电系统的综合分析能力、设计能力以及应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成；并通过课堂教学、课堂讨论、仿真实验和课后作业等环节，使学生具备信号与系统分析、处理的一般性知识和方法，具备机电系统的综合分析与设计能力；使学生能够学会运用适当的专业知识解决电气领域具体复杂工程问题。 本课程突出电气工程领域应用特点，突出各种分析方法、手段的物理背景。通过该课程学习，为学生学习后续专业课，如电机驱动控制系统设计、电力系统分析、电力电子装置及系统、数字控制系统等课程，奠定基础。 本课程是电气工程学科专业基础课，40学时，2.5学分，属必修课。
default.en: Signal and System is one of the important professional basic courses for students majoring in electrical engineering. In the field of electrical engineering, whether you are engaged in motor design and motor drive control, or remote metering, remote signaling, remote controlling, or remote adjustment of power systems, as well as fault diagnosis of power systems; and whether you are engaged in power electronic energy conversion and servo drive, or electrical theory and new technologies, you are required to master the related knowledge of signal and system to solve these complex engineering problems. Being used different methods of solving differential equations as clues, this course starts from the basic concepts of signals and systems, and guides students to learn the system knowledge such as classical Fourier transform, Laplace transform, and z-transform, and help students master various analysis methods for signals and systems in continuous and discrete time domains, such as time-domain analysis, frequency-domain analysis, complex frequency-domain analysis, and z-domain analysis. On the basis of these, the course help students mastering the state variable method of system analysis. The course deeply combines the background of the field of electrical engineering, focusing on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis, design, and application abilities in electromechanical systems, increasing innovation awareness, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes; And through classroom teaching, classroom discussions, simulation experiments, and after-school assignments, students are equipped with general knowledge and methods of signal and system analyzing and processing, as well as comprehensive analysis and design capabilities of electromechanical systems; The course will enable students to apply appropriate professional knowledge to solve specific and complex engineering problems in the electrical field. This course highlights the application characteristics in the field of electrical engineering, highlighting the physical background and meaning of various analysis methods. Through this course, students will lay the foundation for learning subsequent professional courses such as motor drive control system design, power system analysis, power electronic devices and systems, digital control systems, etc. This course is a basic course for the Electrical Engineering discipline, with 40 class hours and 2.5 credits. It is a compulsory course.

default.zh: 自动控制理论是电气工程及其自动化专业重要的专业基础课，重点学习分析和设计反馈控制系统的经典理论和应用方法。主要内容包括：自动控制的基本概念、线性系统数学模型及变换、控制系统性能的时域分析法、根轨迹法、控制系统的频域法分析和校正、非线性系统的相平面和描述函数分析方法。 本课程的目标是使学生深入理解并熟练掌握经典控制理论的基本原理与方法，能够运用其对电气工程领域相关的控制系统进行分析和设计，提出合理控制方案，应用仿真和实验的手段对控制性能进行验证、评估和改进。 本课程有一般方法论的特点，对于培养学生系统和科学的思维方法，提高解决实际控制问题的能力有重要的作用。
default.en: Automatic control theory is an important professional basic course for students majoring in electrical engineering and automation, focusing on learning the classic theory and application method of analyzing and designing feedback control system. The main contents include: the basic concept of automatic control, mathematical model and transformation of linear system, time-domain performance analysis method of control system , root locus method, frequency domain method analysis and correction of control system, phase plane and descriptive function analysis method of nonlinear system. The goal of this course is to enable students to deeply understand and master the basic principles and methods of classical control theory, to use them to analyze and design related control systems in the field of electrical engineering, to put forward reasonable control schemes, and to verify, evaluate and improve the control performance by means of simulation and experiment. This course has the characteristics of general methodology, which plays an important role in cultivating students' systematic and scientific thinking methods and improving their ability to solve practical control problems.

default.zh: 自动控制广泛应用于现代工业的各个领域，而控制理论是自动控制系统分析和设计的基础理论。课程的主要任务是通过本课程的学习，使学生了解自动控制相关的基本概念、原理和方法，学习并掌握古典控制理论的基本分析、设计方法，了解现代控制和智能控制基本理论和思想，为工程实践打下理论基础。 本课程主要的主要内容包括：反馈的相关概念和自动控制系统的种类、组成、要求等；控制系统的数学模型，古典控制方法的时域频域法的分析和综合；自动控制率及系统校正；自动控制原理的应用等。通过本课程的学习，使学生理解自动控制的核心思想，掌握基本的分析综合方法，学会应用理论理解和分析实际的控制对象，培养学生解决实际的控制工程问题的能力。对学生构建跨学科知识体系，培养系统的思维方法和创新意识，掌握正确的科学研究方法有重要的作用。
default.en: Automatic control is widely applied in various fields of modern industry, and control theory serves as the fundamental basis for the analysis and design of automatic control systems. The primary objective of this course is to enable students to understand the basic concepts, principles, and methods related to automatic control, learn and master the fundamental analysis and design approaches of classical control theory, grasp the basic theories and ideas of modern and intelligent control, and lay a theoretical foundation for engineering practice. The main content of this course includes: related concepts of feedback and the types, composition, and requirements of automatic control systems; mathematical models of control systems, analysis and synthesis methods of classical control theory in the time and frequency domains; automatic control rates and system correction; applications of automatic control principles, etc. Through this course, students will comprehend the core ideas of automatic control, acquire fundamental analysis and synthesis methods, learn to apply theoretical understanding to analyze practical control objects, and develop their ability to solve real-world control engineering problems. It plays a crucial role in helping students build an interdisciplinary knowledge system, cultivate systematic thinking methods and innovative awareness, and master proper scientific research methodologies.

default.zh: 模拟电子技术基础B课程内容包括半导体二极管及其基本应用电路、双极型晶体管及其基本放大电路、场效应管及其基本放大电路、集成运算放大器的单元电路、集成运算放大器基本应用电路、放大电路中的反馈、信号发生电路、信号的处理与变换和直流电源。相比模拟电子技术基础A，本课程略去了运放运算电路的精度分析、测量电路的抗干扰、调制解调、锁相环、函数发生器等内容，并对第5、6、8、9、10章的授课学时进行了压缩，总学时压缩至48学时。
default.en: The major contents of fundamentals of analog electronics B include semiconductor diode with its basic application circuits, bipolar junction transistor with its basic amplifying circuits, field effect transistor with its basic amplifying circuits, element circuits of integrated operational amplifiers, basic application circuits of integrated operational amplifiers, feedback in amplifying circuits, signal generator, signal processing and transformation, direct current source. This course leaves out some contents with respect to fundamentals of analog electronics A, such as analysis of the precision of operational amplifier, anti-interference of metering circuit, modulation and demodulation, phase locked loop and function generator. The total teaching hours are compressed to 56 by refining chapters 5, 6, 8, 9, 10.

default.zh: 电工与电子技术F是一门重要的专业基础课，本课程主要讲授电路基础、模拟电路和数字电路的基础理论和相关分析方法。具体内容包括：直流电路的基本概念、基本定律和基本分析方法；电路瞬态过程产生的原因和条件，一阶电路瞬态过程中电压和电流的变化规律；交流电的基本概念，正弦量的相量表示法与计算；三相电源和负载的连接方式，三相电路中的电压、电流和功率计算；常用半导体器件；由分立元件构成的基本放大电路的电路结构、工作原理以及分析方法；集成运算放大器的特性及典型应用电路；数字逻辑基础知识以及组合逻辑电路的分析与设计；双稳态触发器的类型与逻辑功能，典型时序逻辑电路的分析方法与应用。 通过本课程的学习，使学生获得电工与电子技术的基本理论、基本分析方法和基本技能，了解电工、电子技术的应用情况和发展趋势。通过本课程的课堂教学以及后续实验操作等环节，培养学生对电工以及电子系统的综合分析、综合设计能力，在日后工程实践及日常生活中能够运用所学的电学知识分析和解决实际问题。
default.en: Electrical and Electronic Technology F is an important professional basic course for undergraduates. The course focuses on basic theories and analysis methods of circuits and electronics, and its contents include: Basic concepts, laws and analysis methods of DC circuits; Transient state analysis of First-order linear circuits; Analysis and calculation of sinusoidal AC circuits; Analysis and calculation of three phase AC circuits; Working principle of commonly used semiconductor devices; Transistor amplifiers; Operational amplifiers and their applications; Logic gates; Analysis and design of digital logic circuits, etc. The purpose of this course is for students to obtain basic theory, knowledge and technical skill in electrical and electronic technology field, have a general idea of the applications and advancements of electrical and electronic technology, and build a strong foundation on pursuing the relative engineering work. Through the analysis of some practical cases, this course will cultivate students' abilities to apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 电工与电子技术实验F是培养本科非电类专业学生理论联系实际的实践性环节，为学生提供了一个培养动手能力、综合设计能力和创新能力的实践平台。本课程主要讲授常见电工仪器仪表的使用方法、直流、交流、单管等基础原理的验证、电动机的继电接触器控制、数字逻辑及时序逻辑电路的设计、OrCAD仿真高新技术的应用，既包括基础性验证实验，又包括综合性、设计性创新实验。 通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、后续的实验操作和计算机仿真等环节，使学生掌握常用电工仪器的使用方法和常用电路的调试测量方法，加深理解基础电路的工作原理，提高学生的分析设计能力，了解高新技术，培养学生的综合素质及工程能力。
default.en: The main purpose of the Electrotechnics and Electronic Technology F is to foster the undergraduate of non–electrical specialties to apply in practice the knowledge they had acquired in theory class, and construct a platform for students that can develop their practical ability, comprehensive design ability and innovation ability. This course teaches students the usage of instruments and meters, the validation of basic principles, such as DC, AC and single tube etc, the control of relay contactor of the electromotor, the design of digital logic and sequential logic circuit, and the application of OrCAD simulation technology. This course includes the design of the confirmatory experiments, comprehensive experiments, and also includes creative experiments. Through the preview which is based on network digital resources, experimental operation, and computer simulation, students could easily master the usage of the instruments and meters, and the debugging and measuring methods of common circuits, and deeply understand circuit operational principles, and improve their abilities to analyze issues, understand new and high technology, and develop students' comprehensive quality and engineering ability.

default.zh: 电路课程是电气与电子信息类各专业的一门专业基础核心课程。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电路理论的基本知识、电路分析计算的基本方法、电路仿真的基本技能，培养学生科学思维和分析、解决工程实际电路问题的基本能力和素质，为后续专业课程的学习和科研实践打下坚实的理论基础。 本课程将介绍电路的基本定律、定理、现象、基本分析和仿真方法。主要内容包括：基本电路元件；线性直流电路分析；电路定理及其应用；正弦稳态电路分析；非正弦稳态电路分析；电路的频率特性与谐振电路分析；线性动态电路的时域分析。 课程考核采用累加式考核方式，具体考核环节包括：平时及作业、课程报告和期末考试三部分。
default.en: The Electric Circuit is a core course specifically for students from Electric and Electronics & Information. By learning this course, these students can acquire knowledge on circuits, including basic principles, basic analysis methods, as well as fundamental experimental skills. What’s more, it also enhances their capability on logical analyzing and their ability to solve practical circuit problems. Those abilities will serve as a solid foundation for learning further relevant specialized courses. This course will introduce basic theory, basic principles, phenomena, analysis methods, simulating methods, as well as experiment skills on electric circuits. It contains: the basic circuit components, the analysis on linear DC circuits, the circuit theorems and their applications, the analysis on sinusoidal stationary state circuits, non-sinusoidal stationary state circuits, analysis on frequency response and resonant circuits, linear dynamic circuit in time-domain. The course examination adopts accumulative examinations, and the specific examination consists of three parts: routine and assignments, course reports, as well as a final examination.

default.zh: 电路是“应用物理学+电气工程及其自动化”双学士学位必修的专业基础课，为后续如电子技术基础、电机学、自动控制理论、电力电子技术等专业基础和核心课程的学习准备必要的电路基础知识、分析方法。电路在“应用物理学+电气工程及其自动化”双学士学位的人才培养方案和课程体系中起着承前启后的重要作用，对于培养学生的科学思维能力、综合运用电路理论分析和解决复杂实际工程问题的能力都起到重要的作用。 本课程主要讲授直流电路、交流电路、暂态电路、二端口网络的基本概念、原理和相关电流的分析方法等，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电路的基本理论知识和分析计算方法，同时培养学生利用数学手段和现代化工具进行电路综合分析与设计的能力，为学生后续的课程学习、创新和从事科学研究工作打下扎实的理论基础。
default.en: The ELECTRIC CIRCUIT is a core course specifically for the double bachelor degree students of “Applied Physics & Electrical Engineering and Automation”, which prepares necessary basic knowledge and analysis methods of circuits for the subsequent study of professional basic and core courses such as electronic technology fundamental, electrical machinery, automatic control theory, and power electronic technology. Circuit plays an important role in the talent training program and curriculum system of “Applied Physics & Electrical Engineering and Automation” double bachelor degree, and plays an important role in cultivating students' scientific thinking ability, comprehensive application of circuit theory to analyze and solve complex practical engineering problems. The course mainly teaches the basic concepts, principles and relevant current analysis methods of DC circuit, AC circuit, transient circuit and two-port network, etc. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theoretical knowledge and analysis and calculation methods of circuits, and cultivate their ability to make comprehensive analysis and design of circuits by using mathematical means and modern tools. It lays a solid theoretical foundation for students' follow-up course learning, innovation and scientific research.

default.zh: 电路与电子技术实验A是航天与自动化类本科生和“应用物理学+电气工程及其自动化”双学士学位本科生必修的实验课程，是培养学生理论联系实际的实践性环节，是学生学习后续专业课程的基础，对于培养学生的动手能力、综合设计能力和创新能力起到了重要作用。 本课程主要讲授常见电工电子仪器仪表的使用方法、电路实验、模拟电子技术实验和数字电子技术实验，包含硬件实验、仿真实验、基础实验和综合设计型实验。通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、后续的实验操作和计算机仿真等环节，使学生掌握常用电工电子仪器的使用方法，加深理解电子电路的基本工作原理和分析设计方法。培养学生根据技术要求，设计常用的电子电路小系统并进行组装调试的能力，了解和初步掌握电子电路的设计、安装、调试和故障的排除。
default.en: Experiment of Circuit and Electronic Technology A is a compulsory experimental course for undergraduate students majoring in Aerospace and Automation and dual bachelor's degrees in Applied Physics and Electrical Engineering and Automation. It is a practical link in cultivating students' ability to connect theory with practice, and serves as the foundation for their subsequent professional courses. It plays an important role in cultivating students' manual dexterity, comprehensive design ability, and innovation ability. This course mainly teaches the usage methods of common electrical and electronic instruments, electric circuit experiments, analog electronic technology experiments, and digital electronic technology experiments, including hardware experiments, simulation experiments, basic experiments, and comprehensive design experiments. Through the preview of network digital teaching resources, subsequent experimental operations, and computer simulation in this course, students will master the usage methods of common electrical and electronic instruments, deepen their understanding of the basic operating principles and analysis and design methods of electronic circuits. Cultivate the ability of students to design common electronic circuit small systems and assemble and debug them according to technical requirements, understand and preliminarily master the design, installation, debugging, and troubleshooting of electronic circuits.

default.zh: 信号与系统B是电类相关专业学生重要的专业基础课之一。 本课程主要讲授内容包括：信号与系统的基本概念，连续时间系统的时域分析，连续时间信号与系统的频域分析，连续时间信号与系统的复频域分析，离散时间系统的时域与频域分析，离散时间系统的Z域分析以及系统分析的状态变量法等内容。通过上述内容的讲授，使学生掌握信号与系统的基本概念，学会连续时间信号与系统及离散时间信号与系统的基本分析方法，包括时域分析方法、频域分析方法、复频域分析方法以及Z域分析方法等；结合电气工程领域背景，着重培养学生机电系统的综合分析与设计能力以及应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。本课程通过课堂讲授、课堂练习、课后作业以及课后计算机仿真等环节，完成上述培养目标。 本课程突出电气工程领域应用特点，结合工程实例，突出各种分析方法、手段的物理背景与含义。通过该课程学习，为学生学习后续专业课，如电机驱动控制系统设计、电力系统分析、电力电子装置及系统、数字控制系统等课程，奠定基础。
default.en: The course named Signals and Systems B is one of the important professional basic courses for electronic specialties. The course includes the following contents: the conceptual framework of signals and systems, the time-domain analysis of continuous-time system, the frequency-domain analysis and s-domain analysis of continuous-time signals and systems, the time-domain analysis and the frequency-domain analysis and the Z-domain analysis of discrete-time systems, the state variable method for system analysis and so on. Through learning above contents, students will know the fundamental concepts of signals and systems well, master the analytical methods for continuous-time signals and systems and discrete-time signals and systems, including the time-domain analysis method, the frequency-domain analysis method, s-domain analysis method and z-domain analysis method, etc. The course will take the electrical engineering field as reference, and focus on training the students’ comprehensive analyzing ability and designing ability and applying ability in mechanical and electrical systems. On the base of these, the course will improve the students’ consciousness of innovation, and help to reach the goal of index points of professional learning outcomes. The course includes some typical teaching links, such as lecture, exercises in class, homework and computer simulation after class and so on. Through above teaching links, the course will reach the training goal. Combining with engineering examples, the course will focus on the features in electrical engineering application, and make clear the physics background and the meaning of various analysis methods. This course will help students to learn well the follow-up professional courses, such as design of driving and controlling motor, electric power system analysis, electric power system analysis, digital control system and so on.

default.zh: 电子技术基础课程是数学与应用数学（自动化方向）（强基计划）专业本科生的专业基础课程，重点培养学生电子技术基本技能，讲授常用模拟/数字电子器件、模拟/数字电子电路的基本原理及其应用相关知识。
default.en: The course of Electronic Technology Foundation is a professional basic course for undergraduate students majoring in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics (Automation Direction) (Strong Foundation Program). It focuses on cultivating students' basic skills in electronic technology and teaches the basic principles and application-related knowledge of commonly used analog/digital electronic devices and analog/digital electronic circuits.

default.zh: 通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电路理论的基本知识、电路分析计算的基本方法、电路仿真的基本技能，培养学生科学思维和分析、解决工程实际电路问题的基本能力和素质，为后续专业课程的学习和科研实践打下坚实的理论基础。 本课程将介绍电路的基本定律、定理、现象、基本分析和仿真方法。主要内容包括：基本电路元件；线性直流电路分析；电路定理及其应用；正弦稳态电路分析。 课程考核采用累加式考核方式，具体考核环节包括：平时及作业、线上学习和期末考试等部分。
default.en: By learning this course, these students can acquire knowledge on circuits, including basic principles, basic analysis methods, as well as fundamental experimental skills. What’s more, it also enhances their capability on logical analyzing and their ability to solve practical circuit problems. Those abilities will serve as a solid foundation for learning further relevant specialized courses. This course will introduce basic theory, basic principles, phenomena, analysis methods, simulating methods, as well as experiment skills on electric circuits. It contains: the basic circuit components, the analysis on linear DC circuits, the circuit theorems and their applications, the analysis on sinusoidal stationary state circuits. The course examination adopts accumulative examinations, and the specific assessment components include: regular and homework assignments, online learning, and the final examination, etc.

default.zh: 通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电路理论的基本知识、电路分析计算的基本方法、电路仿真的基本技能，培养学生科学思维和分析、解决工程实际电路问题的基本能力和素质，为后续专业课程的学习和科研实践打下坚实的理论基础。 本课程将介绍电路的基本定律、定理、现象、基本分析和仿真方法。主要内容包括：含磁耦合元件的电路分析、三相电路分析、非正弦稳态电路分析；电路的频率特性与谐振电路分析；线性动态电路的时域及复频域分析；二端口网络，网络图论与网络方程。 课程考核采用累加式考核方式，具体考核环节包括平时及作业、课程报告和期末考试。
default.en: By learning this course, these students can acquire knowledge on circuits, including basic principles, basic analysis methods, as well as fundamental experimental skills. What’s more, it also enhances their capability on logical analyzing and their ability to solve practical circuit problems. Those abilities will serve as a solid foundation for learning further relevant specialized courses. This course will introduce the basic theory, basic principles, phenomena, analysis methods, simulating methods, as well as experiment skills on electric circuits. It contains: analysis of circuits with magnetic coupling elements, three-phase circuit analysis, analysis on the non-sinusoidal stationary state circuits, analysis on frequency response and resonant circuits, linear dynamic circuit in time-domain and complex frequency-domain, two-port networks, the graph theory and network equations. The course examination adopts accumulative examinations, and the specific assessment components include: regular and homework assignments, online learning, and the final examination, etc.

default.zh: 嵌入式系统已广泛的应用于工业控制系统、智能仪器仪表、信息家电等领域，代表当前硬件电路设计的最新进展。本课程讲授MCS-51、ARM内核微控制器结构及应用系统设计方法，讲授嵌入式实时操作系统的基础知识。通过授课及教学实验，使学生掌握嵌入式系统的基本组成和设计原理，掌握嵌入式微控制器应用系统硬件电路的设计方法，锻炼学生的软件设计及调试能力。
default.en: The embedded system which represents the latest progress of the hardware circuit design, has been applied in many fields, such as industrial control systems, information appliances, intelligent instruments and meters ,and so on. This course instructs students on the kernel micro controller structure and application system design method of MCS-51 and ARM9, it also instructs students on the rudimentary knowledge of embedded operating systems. Through the course and experiments, the students can understand the basic structure and the principle of designing embedded systems, master the system hardware designing method, and train the ability of software developing and debugging.

default.zh: 电机学课程面向电气工程全系的本科生开课，是平台课中最重要的课程之一，也是学生们学习后续专业课的基础。课程主要讲授常见的几个机种电机的基本原理、结构和运行特性，重点使学生了解电机的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握常见电机问题的基本计算方法和实验技能；了解常用的微特电机的基本原理和主要特点等。 课程主要包括概论及应用介绍、变压器、直流电机、交流绕组、感应电机、同步电机和其他常用的微特电机介绍。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时测评和作业三部分。另外，需要学生们独立完成3个实验和计算机仿真。 课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时、实验和仿真等。
default.en: Electric Machinery is one of the most important courses to all the students in Electrical Engineering Department, which is a knowledge foundation of the latter specialty lessons such as Motor Design, Motor Control, Power System and Electrical Driving System. In this course, several commonly used electric machines are introduced about their working principle, basic structure and running characteristics. After finishing the lesson students should know the theoretical foundation, advanced studies, tendency and applications of the above electric machines, be familiar to the basic calculation and test methods of ordinary motor problems, and have some knowledge of commonly used small and special motors. The course includes introduction, DC motors, transformers, induction motors, synchronous motors and some small and special motors. The grade consists of three parts: examination at the end of semester, daily performance and home works. And, three tests and computer aided simulations should be completed by the students themselves, which grades will be considered in the last score comprehensively.

default.zh: 电力电子技术是电气工程领域中高新技术产业发展的基础技术之一，由电力学、电子学和控制理论三个学科交叉而形成的，是电气工程学科最重要的研究领域之一，得到了国内外学术界和产业部门的极大重视。本课程主要包括常用电力半导体器件的工作原理、特性及主要参数，交-直变换电路，直流-直流变换电路，交流调压与交-交变频电路，直-交变换电路以及PWM控制技术等。目的是使学生形成弱电控制强电、不同形式强电之间转换及其控制的知识结构体系，掌握一些新型结构如矩阵变换器、高频整流器和SiC/GaN等新结构和新材料，并为学习后续专业课如电机驱动控制系统设计、电力传动、运动控制系统、电源技术、高压输电技术、电能质量控制技术和电力电子装置及系统等课程奠定基础。
default.en: Power electronics is one of the fundamental techniques of electrical engineering, formed by the intersection of three disciplines: electricity, electronics, and control theory，and is also one of the most pioneering research field, drawing great attention from the academics and industries. This course introduces the basics of power electronic devices and converters. Working principles, operating modes and analysis of DC-DC, DC-AC, AC-DC, and AC-AC converters would be covered for a variety of loads. Control of power electronic converters would be explained. Certain specialized concepts in power electronics like matrix converter, active rectifiers and SiC/GaN devices would be included, along with some of the popular applications of power electronics such as renewable energy conversion and power quality enhancement. This course lays the foundation for future specialized courses such as motor drive, motion control system, power supply, HVDC technology, power quality control, power electronics devices and systems, etc.

default.zh: 电力系统分析是电气工程及其自动化专业本科生的专业核心课。是学习后续专业课如高电压技术、发电厂电气系统、电力系统继电保护、电力系统自动装置、电力系统动态仿真等课程的基础，在培养学生电力系统综合分析与设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。课程主要内容包括：电力系统元件的数学模型及等值电路；电力系统潮流计算；电力系统无功功率平衡及电压调整；电力系统的频率特性及电力系统的频率调整；有功功率负荷的经济分配；电力系统三相短路的暂态过程分析,电力系统各元件的序阻抗及等值电路, 简单不对称故障的分析与计算；电力系统稳定的基本概念，电力系统的暂态稳定性和静态稳定性分析，提高电力系统稳定性的措施。
default.en: Power System Analysis is a core course for third-year university students majored in electrical engineering and automation. It has an extremely vital role to cultivate students' problem-solving ability,comprehensive design ability and creativity.The main contents of this course are as follows: Models of power system components; the power flow calculation;the reactive power balance and the voltage adjustment; the frequency control of power system; the issues of economic dispatch;the transient analysis of three-phase short-circuit; sequence impedance and equivalent circuit of power system components,simple unbalanced fault analysis;the basic concepts of power system stability,the analysis of transient stability and steady-state stability, the measures to enhance system stability.

default.zh: 电机学课程面向电气工程本科核心课程，是平台课中最重要的课程之一，也是学生们学习后续专业课的基础。课程主要讲授常见的几个机种电机的基本原理、结构和运行特性，重点使学生了解电机的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握常见电机问题的基本计算方法和实验技能；了解常用的微特电机的基本原理和主要特点等。 课程主要包括概论及应用介绍、变压器、直流电机、交流绕组、感应电机、同步电机和其他常用的微特电机介绍。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时测评和作业三部分。另外，需要学生们独立完成3个计算机仿真实验。 课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时和仿真实验等。
default.en: Electric Machinery is oriented to the undergraduate core course of electrical engineering, which is one of the most important courses in the platform course, and it is also the basis for students to study the subsequent professional courses. The course mainly teaches the basic principles, structure and operating characteristics of several common types of motors, focusing on enabling students to understand the theoretical basis, research hotspots, development trends and cutting-edge applications of motors, to be familiar with and master the basic calculation methods and experimental skills of common electric machines problems, and to understand the basic principles and main characteristics of commonly used micro and special motors. The course mainly includes an introduction to the introduction and application of transformers, DC motors, AC windings, induction motors, synchronous motors and other commonly used micro and special motors. The test results of this course are cumulative, including three parts: final written test, usual assessment and homework. In addition, students are required to complete 3 computer simulation experiments independently. The final grade of the course is cumulative, taking into account the final semester, the usual period and the simulation experiment.

default.zh: 嵌入式系统已广泛的应用于工业控制系统、智能仪器仪表、信息家电等领域，代表当前硬件电路设计的最新进展。本课程讲授MCS-51、ARM内核微控制器结构及应用系统设计方法，讲授嵌入式实时操作系统的基础知识。通过授课及教学实验，使学生掌握嵌入式系统的基本组成和设计原理，掌握嵌入式微控制器应用系统硬件电路的设计方法，培养学生的软件设计及调试能力。
default.en: The embedded system which represents the latest progress of the hardware circuit design, has been applied in many fields, such as industrial control systems, information appliances, intelligent instruments and meters, and so on. This course instructs students on the kernel micro controller structure and application system design method of MCS-51 and ARM. It also instructs students on the rudimentary knowledge of embedded operating systems. Through the course and experiments, the students can understand the basic structure and the principle of designing embedded system, master the system hardware designing method, and train the ability of software developing and debugging.

default.zh: 电机原理是电类专业学生非常重要的专业核心课，是学习电气工程专业课如电机设计、电机控制、电力系统分析、电力拖动等课程的基础，在培养学生电气系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要讲授常见的几个机种电机的基本原理、结构和运行特性，使学生较深入地了解电机内部的基本电磁关系和基本分析方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的课后大作业和计算机仿真等环节，着重培养学生们机电系统的综合分析与设计能力，以及电气系统科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Principles of Electric Machines is a crucial core course for students majoring in electrical engineering. It serves as the fundamental basis for advanced professional courses such as Electric Machine Design, Motor Control, Power System Analysis, and Electric Drives, playing a vital role in cultivating students' capabilities in the comprehensive analysis and design of electrical systems. This course primarily covers the basic principles, structures, and operating characteristics of several common types of electric machines, enabling students to gain a profound understanding of the internal electromagnetic relationships and fundamental analysis methods. Through classroom instruction, subsequent major assignments, and computer simulations, the course emphasizes the development of students' comprehensive analysis and design skills for electromechanical systems, as well as their ability to apply scientific knowledge of electrical systems. Furthermore, it aims to foster innovation awareness and support the achievement of corresponding performance indicators within the program learning outcomes.

default.zh: “电机原理及应用”是能源互联网专业基础课程，结合电机的发展趋势和前沿应用，学习机电能量转换的原理，在培养学生电气系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要讲授几种常见电机的基本原理、结构和运行特性，使学生较深入地了解电机内部的基本电磁关系和基本分析方法。
default.en: This course is a basic course for the energy Internet specialty. Combining the development trend and cutting-edge application of motors, learning the principle of electromechanical energy conversion can cultivate students' comprehensive analysis ability and comprehensive design ability of electrical systems. This course mainly teaches the basic principles, structures, and operating characteristics of several common motors, enabling students to have a deeper understanding of the basic electromagnetic relationships and analysis methods inside the motor

default.zh: 电力电子技术是电气工程领域中高新技术产业发展的基础技术，因而成为电气工程学科最重要的研究领域之一，得到了国内外学术界和产业部门的极大重视。电力电子技术中的电能变换技术主要研究有关各类交流装置中发生的电磁过程、基本原理、控制方法、设计计算及其技术经济指标。目的是使学生形成弱电控制强电、不同形式强电之间转换及其控制的知识结构体系，并为学习后续专业课如运动控制系统，电源技术，高压输电技术，新能源并网技术等课程奠定基础。
default.en: Power electronics is one of the fundamental techniques of electrical engineering, and is also one of the most pioneering research field, drawing great attention from the academics and industries. This course introduces the basics of power electronic devices and converters. Working principles, operating modes and analysis of DC-DC, DC-AC, AC-DC, and AC-AC converters would be covered for a variety of loads. Control of power electronic converters would be explained. Certain specialized concepts in power electronics like matrix converter, active rectifiers and SiC/GaN devices would be included, along with some of the popular applications of power electronics such as renewable energy conversion and power quality enhancement. This course lays the foundation for future specialized courses such as motor drive, motion control system, power supply, HVDC technology, power quality control, power electronics devices and systems, etc.

default.zh: 通过展示与分析大数据与人工智能在电力系统与能源工程方面的应用案例，引领学生掌握大数据与人工智能的基本学科理论框架，并通过上机练习培养学生扎实的实操能力。
default.en: By demonstrating and analyzing the application cases of big data and artificial intelligence in power systems and energy engineering, students are guided to master the basic theoretical framework of big data and artificial intelligence, and their solid practical skills are cultivated through computer exercises.

default.zh: 本课程为专业方向核心课程。教学目的是面对能源经济与电力市场，让能源动力专业的学生拓展思维方式，不仅补充经济、金融方面的知识，还能够全面审视和更新传统的电力运行理论和技术。主要介绍能源经济与电力市场的基础知识和有关理论，重点讲述国内外能源经济发展模式、电力市场改革、电力市场结构、不同类型能源的竞价模式、交易方式、交易品种以及辅助服务市场等方面内容。
default.en: This course is a core course in the professional track. Its teaching objective is to target energy economics and electricity markets, enabling students majoring in Energy and Power Engineering to broaden their way of thinking. It not only helps them supplement their knowledge in economics and finance, but also allows them to comprehensively examine and update the traditional theories and technologies of power operation. The course mainly introduces the basic knowledge and relevant theories of energy economics and electricity markets, with a focus on content such as domestic and international energy economic development models, electricity market reform, electricity market structure, bidding models for different types of energy, trading methods, trading varieties, and the ancillary services market.

default.zh: 能源互联网与大数据是电力系统、能源动力及信息学科的交叉学科,是以互联网技术为基础，以电力系统为中心，横向实现电、气、热、可再生能源等“多源互补”，纵向实现“源网荷储”各环节高度协调，生产和消费双向互动，集中于分布相结合的能源服务网络。本课程系统介绍能源互联网与大数据的发展背景、定义、功能、特征和技术架构，详细阐述能源互联网需要的关键技术，包括电力系统关键技术、能源基础设施关键技术、信息和通信关键技术、电力电子技术和平台技术，并结合典型案例进行能源互联网关键技术和应用剖析，使学生了解能源互联网与大数据基本原理、核心技术、产业现状以及发展脉络，为学生毕业后从事能源互联网与智慧能源建设提供相关专业技术和科学研究工作打下必要的基础。
default.en: Energy Internet and Big Data is an interdisciplinary field that encompasses power systems, energy dynamics, and information science. It is based on Internet technology with a focus on the power system as its core. Horizontally, it achieves the "multi-source complementarity" of electricity, gas, heat, renewable energy, and more. Vertically, it ensures highly coordinated links between "source, grid, load, and storage," facilitating two-way interactions between production and consumption. This approach is centralized within a distributed yet integrated energy service network. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the background, definition, functions, features, and technical architecture of Energy Internet and Big Data. It elaborates on the key technologies required for Energy Internet, including crucial technologies related to the power system, energy infrastructure, information and communication, power electronics, and platform technology. Through the analysis of typical cases, the course explores the key technologies and applications of Energy Internet, equipping students with an understanding of the fundamental principles, core technologies, current industry status, and the development trajectory of Energy Internet and Big Data. This foundation provides students with the necessary groundwork for pursuing professional careers and engaging in scientific research in the field of Energy Internet and smart energy construction after graduation.

default.zh: 本课程是自动控制领域的基础课程，电气工程专业学生可选修学习。学习目的是使学生掌握现代控制理论线性多变量系统的基本理论和方法，为进一步学习后续课程和研究相关学科打下基础。本课程内容以线性定常系统为主，用状态空间法，建立系统的状态模型，分析系统和校正系统。 通过本课程的学习，要使学生了解现代控制理论的内容、研究方法和关注问题；熟练掌握状态变量及状态空间表达式的建立方法；熟练掌握线性连续定常系统的定义与能控性、能观性判别准则；掌握李雅普诺夫关于稳定性的定义、李雅普诺夫第二法、李雅普诺夫方法在线性/非线性系统中的应用；掌握线性反馈控制系统的基本结构及其特性、极点配置问题、系统镇定问题、系统解耦问题、状态观测器、利用状态观测器实现状态反馈的系统。
default.en: This course is a basic course in the field of automatic control and is optional for students majoring in electrical engineering. The purpose is to enable students to master the basic theories and methods of linear multivariable systems in modern control theory, laying a foundation for further study of subsequent courses and research on related disciplines. The content of this course mainly focuses on linear steady systems, using the state space method to establish the state model of the system, analyze the system and correct the system. Through the study of this course, students should understand the content, research methods and concerns of modern control theory; be proficient in the establishment of state variables and state space expressions; master the definition, controllability and observability of linear continuous steady systems; master Lyapunov's definition of stability, Lyapunov's second method, and the application of Lyapunov's method in linear/nonlinear systems; master the basic structure and characteristics of linear feedback control systems, solve pole configuration problems, system stabilization problem, system decoupling problem, design state observer and use state observer to realize state feedback system.

default.zh: EDA即电子设计自动化，目前已成为现代数字电子系统设计的主要手段，是现代电子设计工程师所必需掌握的技术。它可以将几片到上千片中小规模集成电路集成到一块芯片中，便于可重用性设计。本课程主要通过FPGA实验平台掌握Verilog HDL语言设计方法、程序开发技巧、SOPC(片上可编程）系统设计等内容。可使学生掌握数字电子系统的前沿技术和设计方法，培养学生的创新能力。课程采用讲练结合模式，通过对Verilog HDL的语法讲解与动手实践，独立编程并仿真验证，实物下载相结合的方式，使学生能够独立完成基于FPGA的工程应用项目，强化培养学生工程实践能力和创新能力。
default.en: EDA （Electronic Design Automation） has become the main means of modern digital system design and the necessary skills of modern electronic design engineers. It could integrate thousands of IC into a chip, which greatly increases the integration of products. Moreover, the chip is easy to modify and write repeatedly. This course mainly includes the FPGA experimental platform to master Verilog HDL language design methods, program development skills, SOPC (on-chip programmable) system design and so on. So that students can master the forefront of digital electronic systems technology and design methods to develop students' innovative ability. The course uses a combination of lectures and practice exercises. Using independent programming and simulation verification, physical download a combination of hands-on practice that make students can quickly master the core technology. So that students can independently complete the FPGA-based engineering applications. This can strengthen the cultivation of student engineering practice and innovation ability.

default.zh: 目前微特电机及其控制系统已经成为智能制造、电气化交通、新能源发电、储能等各个领域中不可缺少的元件，它可以作为控制元件、驱动元件等应用于各种系统中。对于电气工程及其自动化专业的学生而言，掌握各种微特电机及其控制技术的基础知识和实现方法，了解各种控制方法的实际应用技术是必要的。 本课程面向电气工程及其自动化专业方向的本科学生，讲授几种典型微特电机的结构，工作原理及其控制技术以及基于现代数字化实现方法，使学生了解和掌握相应的基础知识，具备初步设计与应用能力。讲解时结合具体电机及实际的控制系统，以基础概念、基本知识和基本原理为主，使学生明确电机控制技术的基本概念及关键技术。同时，结合当前电机及其控制技术领域发展的趋势，介绍一些新结构、新原理的电机及其控制方法，开扩学生的思路和视野，增加创新意识。
default.en: At present, the micromotors and control systems have become indispensable components in various fields such as the intelligent manufacture, electrified transportation, new energy generation, energy storage. They can be used as the control or drive components and have applications in a variety of systems. For the students of the electrical engineering department, it is necessary to understand the basic knowledge and implementation methods of various micromotors, and the practical applications of various control methods as well. This course will be taught to undergraduates in Electrical Machines and Apparatus on the structure, principle and control technology of several typical micromotors. By this course, students can understand and master the corresponding basic knowledge, and also can have the preliminary design and application ability. This course gives priority to the basic concepts, knowledge and principles of motors based on actual motors and control systems, so that the students can understand the basic concepts and key knowledge of motor control technologies. At the same time, this course is combined with the development and trend of motor control technology, and introduces some new structure, principle and control methods of motors, so as to open the thinking and vision of the students, increase the sense of innovation.

default.zh: 现代电机设计与CAD是电机专业方向本科生重要的专业课程，是联系电机学所学理论和电机设计工程实践与研究生深入学习之间的桥梁，是学生分析和解决实际电机设计复杂工程问题的基石，在培养学生电气系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力，工程实践能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程讲授电机设计及计算机辅助设计方法，以磁路计算、参数计算为主干，讲解电机设计的原理和方法。使学生能在电机中电、磁、机、热四个物理层面的矛盾相互制约的条件下，实现满足设计指标的电磁设计。通过本课程的课堂教学、计算机辅助设计、有限元计算验证等环节，着重培养学生们对于电机中复杂问题的综合分析与设计能力，以及电气系统科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Modern Electric Machine Design and CAD Technology is an important course for undergraduate students majoring electric machine. This course bridges the gap of engineering practice and future postgraduate study, while laying the fundamental for analyzing and resolving the complex comprehensive problem in motor design engineering. This course gives the necessary knowledge and methodology on electric machine design, based on the backbone of magnetic-circuit calculations and parameter calculation. The objective is to make the students understand the key physical conflicts on electric, magnetic, mechanical, thermal issues, to give satisfactory design using modern computer tools, and eventually to develop the ability of analyzing and solving complex engineering problems. Through lectures, computer-aided design and finite element calculation, this course focuses on training students for comprehensive analysis and design of the complex problem in electric machine design and electric system, as well as increasing awareness of innovation, and supports professional learning credit points reached in the outcome.

default.zh: 《微电机结构工艺学》是一门用以培养学生了解微电机结构和制造工艺的一门专业课，在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种教学实践环节，为学生即将进行的毕业设计和日后从事微电机设计工作打下基础。通过讲授微电机（含小功率及特殊电机）的结构、制造工艺和结构工艺性的基本知识，采取课堂讲授、观看电教片相结合的方式，使学生能够掌握微电机产品结构、工艺原理、设计确定典型产品结构的要素，同时对典型产品和生产过程，制造技术，工艺方案和方法等有基本了解，并使学生树立正确的产品设计观点和正确的工艺观点，为今后从事产品的设计制造和知识与能力的提高打下基础。 本课程主要围绕微电机和结构、工艺、结构工艺性问题进行讲授，主要包括软磁铁心、永磁体和磁滞体、绕组、绝缘与涂覆、塑料件、机械加工件、加工制造及装配等内容。结合制造工艺视频等方式加深学生对相关学习内容的理解。同时还介绍新结构，新材料，新工艺在微电机中的应用以及微电机的发展趋势，以拓广学生的知识面。
default.en: Micro Electric Machine Structure Technology is a professional course for students to understand the micro-motor structure and manufacturing process, and comprehensive use of the prerequisite learned knowledge and skills is combined with a variety of teaching practices in the teaching process of the course to lay the foundation of the graduation design and future micro electric machine design work. By teaching the micro electric machine (including low-power and special electric machine) structure, manufacturing process and the basic knowledge of the structure technics, classroom teaching and teaching videos watching are combined to teach students to master the structure of the micro electric machine, technics principle, and the typical elements for the structure technics. Meanwhile students should understand the typical products and production processes, manufacturing technology, technology programs and methods to establish correct design and technic points of view for the future design and manufacture of products and improve the foundation of knowledge and ability for products. This course mainly focuses on the micro electric machine and structure, process, structure and technic issues, mainly including soft magnetic core, permanent magnet and hysteresis, winding, insulation and coating, plastic parts, mechanical parts, manufacture processes, assembly and so on. The manufacturing process videos are combined to deepen the understanding of the relevant learning contents. At the same time, the new structure, new materials, new technology in the application and development trends of micro electric machine are introduced to broaden the students’ knowledge.

default.zh: 电网络分析主要是帮助电气工程及自动化辅修专业学生在已经较为完整地学习了线性时不变集中参数小规模电路的时域分析方法的基础上，掌握或了解三相电路、非正弦周期电流电路、线性动态电路暂态过程的复频域分析、二端口网络、分布参数电路的系统化分析方法、为后续课程（如自动控制理论、信号与系统、电机学、电力系统分析、电力电子电路等）学习奠定良好基础。课程对于培养学生的科学思维能力、综合运用电网络分析解决实际问题的能力都起到重要的作用。
default.en: Electric network analysis primarily aims to help students majoring in Electrical Engineering and Automation, who have already gained a relatively comprehensive understanding of time-domain analysis methods for small-scale linear time-invariant lumped-parameter circuits, to master or become familiar with three-phase circuits, non-sinusoidal periodic current circuits, the complex frequency domain analysis of transient processes in linear dynamic circuits, two-port networks, and systematic analysis methods for distributed-parameter circuits. This course lays a solid foundation for subsequent studies (such as Automatic Control Theory, Signals and Systems, Electric Machinery, Power System Analysis, and Power Electronic Circuits). It plays a crucial role in cultivating students' scientific thinking abilities and their capacity to comprehensively apply electrical network analysis to solve practical problems

default.zh: 电机测试技术是电类专业学生非常重要的专业选修课，是学生毕业课程设计以及未来深入学习高阶电类专业课程的基础，是电类学生在社会就业及科研中的重要技能，在培养学生以电机为代表的电气系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力和综合测试能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要讲授电机测试的基本原理、电机测试工具结构和运行特性、电机测试中涉及的传感器技术及使用方法、先进分析测试技术及发展趋势，使学生深入了解电机参数测试基本方案，掌握电机测试基本方法，具备工程研究和工业生产中电机等电气测试数据处理和分析能力。通过本课程的课堂教学、课堂典型课题测试方案讨论、上机仿真与分析等环节，着重培养学生们机电系统的电气参数测试方案设计能力和分析能力，以及电气系统科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Electric Machine Measurement Technology is a very important course for students majoring in electrical engineering. This course is the foundation for their graduation course design and future in-depth study of advanced electrical engineering courses. It is also an important skill for electrical engineering students in social employment and scientific research, and plays an important role in cultivating their comprehensive analysis, design, and testing abilities in electrical systems represented by machines. This course mainly teaches the basic principles of machine test, the structure and operating characteristics of machine measurement tools, sensor technology and usage methods involved in machine test, advanced analysis and testing technology and development trends. It enables students to have a deep understanding of the basic scheme of machine parameter testing, master the basic methods of electrical testing, and possess the ability to process and analyze electrical testing data such as machines in engineering research and industrial production. Through classroom teaching, discussion of typical topic testing plans, and computer simulation and analysis, this course focuses on cultivating students' ability to design and analyze electrical parameter testing plans for electromechanical systems, as well as their ability to apply scientific knowledge of electrical systems, increasing innovation awareness, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 在电气工程领域，各种电力电子装置应用于电能质量控制、电力拖动和其它电能变换系统中，拓宽了电能的应用并提高了电能转换效率。但与此同时电磁干扰问题越显突出，严重的影响到系统的正常运行，电磁兼容问题越来越受到关注，电磁兼容技术日益重要。 本课程面向电气工程及其自动化专业的本科生，讲授电磁兼容基本概念、电磁兼容问题的危害、电磁兼容相关标准、电磁兼容分析方法、电磁兼容设计方法、电磁兼容测量方法以及电机驱动系统中的电磁兼容问题，使学生了解和掌握电磁兼容技术。本课程的教学要求是在概述电磁兼容技术的基础上，讲述各种分析、设计、测量方法等。讲解时结合具体工程实际，以概念、基本知识和基本原理为主，提高学生理论联系实际的能力；同时，还要结合当前电磁兼容领域发展的趋势，介绍一些新的研究成果和趋势，开扩学生的思路和视野。
default.en: In the field of electrical engineering, all kinds of power electronic devices are used in power quality control, electric drive and other electrical energy conversion systems, which can broaden the application of electric energy and improve the efficiency of energy conversion. But at the same time, the problem of electromagnetic interference is more and more prominent, which seriously affects the normal operation of the system. The problem of electromagnetic compatibility is paid more and more attention, and electromagnetic compatibility technology is becoming more and more important. This course is for undergraduate students in electrical engineering and automation specialty, teaching basic concept of electromagnetic compatibility and hazards of electromagnetic compatibility, standards of EMC, EMC analysis method, design method of electromagnetic compatibility, measurement method of electromagnetic compatibility and electromagnetic compatibility problems in motor drive system. This course enables students to understand and master the electromagnetic compatibility technology. The teaching requirement of this course is overview of electromagnetic compatibility technology, and various methods of analysis, design, measurement, etc. teachers explain the concept, basic knowledge and basic principle combining the specific engineering practice to improve the students ability of combining theory with practice. At the same time, with the current development trend in the field of electromagnetic compatibility, teachers introduce some new research achievements and trends to broaden ideas and vision of students.

default.zh: 本课程通过对电动机驱动控制原理，驱动控制器各部分构成、设计特点、设计方法及相关技术，电机控制器的电磁兼容技术和电机控制器电路实例的介绍、讲解，使学生对电动机驱动控制及其相关的理论和实用技术有一个比较全面的了解。使学生能够掌握电机驱动控制原理、驱动控制器各部分构成和功能、性能指标的评价和分析方法；了解和掌握电机驱动控制器设计方法，熟练运用计算机辅助设计工具；培养学生电机驱动控制器原理分析和设计的能力。课程包括驱动控制原理和设计方法的讲授环节和应用计算机辅助设计工具的仿真分析和设计环节。前者以教师讲授为主，后者以学生上机和自学为主。 课程内容包括：AC电机基于转子磁场的转矩控制，从定转子磁场相互作用视角的稳态转矩和动态转矩控制；坐标变换，ABC坐标系、任意同步转速旋转坐标系和转子磁场定向下的电感、磁链、电压、电流方程；转子磁场定向的控制系统设计；最大转矩电流比控制和弱磁控制；七段式SVPWM的设计，偶次谐波产生机理和消除偶次谐波方法；了解特定消谐PWM方法，了解电流型PWM方法，了解死区时间对控制特性的影响；电机驱动系统中的传感器；电机驱动系统中功率开关器件及其驱动电路设计；电机驱动系统中保护电路的设计等。
default.en: This course covers topics including: fundamental of motor drives, parts and design characteristics of motor drives, EMC in motor drives and design examples. From these subjects, students will get knowledge of theory, design and analytical method, evaluation method and simulation method of motor drives. It is a course specifically for the undergraduate students in Department of Electrical Engineering. At the end of the course, students will have capability of design major class of motor drives. The course includes two parts: teaching of theory and design method, simulation and design on computers. The course content includes: AC motor torque control based on rotor magnetic field, steady state torque control and dynamic torque control from the perspective of fixed rotor magnetic field interaction; The inductance, flux linkage, voltage and current equations of coordinate transformation, ABC coordinate system, rotating coordinate system with arbitrary synchronous speed and rotor magnetic field orientation; Design of rotor magnetic field orientation control system; Maximum torque current ratio control and flux-weaken control; The design of seven-stage SVPWM, the mechanism of even harmonic generation and the method of eliminating even harmonic; Understand the specific tuning PWM method, understand the current mode PWM method, and understand the influence of dead time on the control characteristics; Sensors in motor drive systems; Design of power switch device and driving circuit in motor drive system; The design of protection circuit in motor drive system.

default.zh: 随着科学技术的不断进步，新的原理、新的技术、新的工艺、新的结构、新的材料层出不穷，为电机与电磁机构的发展提供了更为广阔的空间。课程体系发展的需要对传统意义上的电机与电磁机构提出了更高的要求，新原理电机与新型电磁机构是在继承传统电磁理论的基础上，引入新原理、新技术、新工艺、新结构、新材料，为学生拓宽知识面提供必要的支撑。 新型电机原理与应用以电机和电磁机构的基本原理、新原理电机的工作机理和结构、新型电磁机构的基本原理和结构、电机驱动新技术及其应用、电磁应用新技术为主要授课内容，全面系统的介绍新原理电机与新型电磁机构发展，为学生知识体系的延伸、为学生知识面的拓宽提供必要的支撑。
default.en: With the development of science and technology, new principles, technology, structure, materials emerges, which provides a wider space for the development of the motor and the electromagnetic mechanism. The need of the development of the curriculum system puts forward higher requirements to the traditional sense of the motor and the electromagnetic mechanism. The new principle of motor and new electromagnetic mechanism is based on the inheritance of traditional electromagnetic theory, New principles, technology, craft, structure, materials based on the inheritance of traditional electromagnetic theory are introduced, which provide the necessary support for students to broaden their knowledge. Principle and Application of Novel Motor to the basic principles of motor and electromagnetic institutions, the new principle of the motor mechanism and structure, the new electromagnetic mechanism of the basic principles and structure, motor drive new technology and its application, electromagnetic application of new technology as the main content. A comprehensive introduction to the new principle of electric machines and the development of new electromagnetic mechanisms is provided. It also provide the necessary support for the extension of the students' knowledge system and broaden the students' knowledge.

default.zh: 该课程属于系统设计类课程。以电动汽车及混合动力汽车为应用对象，主要讲授驱动电机及其驱动控制系统设计和控制方法。要求学生能把所学电气、化学、力学、控制等多个学科知识结合起来使用，培养学生综合运用知识解决问题的能力。 1、 电动汽车驱动系统的基本构成 （讲课4学时）： 讲授系统基本构成及要求，有限电源类型、特点、要求；变工况下动力性及经济性与系统参数、指标间的关系。 2、 能量和动力混合系统的构型和特点。（讲课4学时） 讲授混合能源的结构、多电机动力系统和混合动力系统。 3、 永磁电机控制原理及动力系统模型建立方法（讲课4学时） 学习电机MAP图、电池模型，传动系模型，驾驶模型、工况等模型的建立方法和系统建模方法。 4、 变工况电驱动系统设计与优化方法（讲课，6学时）： 通过教授和实例设计，学习变工况情况下电机指标确定方法；成本与性能对电池的要求与约束；传动系变速比和动力耦合方式设计和选择方法。 5、 电动汽车系统仿真（讲课+上机，6学时）： 进行电动汽车系统建模和控制策略优化，实现工况跟踪、达成系统效率、动力性等控制目标。
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code： 22EE32013 Course Title： Electric Drive Systems for Electric Vehicles Credit Hours： 24 Lecture： 12 Lab： 12 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: Credit(s)： 1.5 Offering Department: School of Electrical Engineering and Automation Students: 4th year of undergraduate Term: Fall Prerequisites: Non 2.Course Description Course Description： In this course, electrical vehicle is the object of study; the design and control of pure electrical powertrain and hybrid powertrain for electrical vehicle is main course content. To be different from electromechanics, power electronics and other courses, the study object is multi-component system; and the control conditions and objectives are not single. The students are trained to learn how to combine the different knowledge to solve problems synthetically. 1、 The basic scheme of electrical vehicle powertrain (4 hours course): Teach the basic system scheme and system requirement, the types, characteristics and requirement of restrict power source; teach the relationship of dynamic performance, economics, system parameters and performance index for various work cycles. 2、 The scheme and characteristics of hybrid powertrain and power source(4 hours course): Teach the hybrid power source scheme, multi-motor system and hybrid system. 3、 Fundamentals of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) drive and Modeling of power system (4 hours, course): Teach the basic drive and control principle of PMSMs and the methods to construct the motor map, battery model, transmission model, drive model and system modeling so on. 4、 The design and optimization of electrical drive system for various work cycles (6 hours, course+ computer practice): By course and example design, teach the methods to determine motor performance index in various work cycles, battery requirement and restriction for the cost and performance, the design of transmission ratio and power coupling methods. 5、 Electric vehicle simulation (6 hours, course+ computer practice): Construct electric vehicle system model and optimize control strategy to achieve the control objectives such as system efficiency, dynamic performance.

default.zh: 电器是实现电路控制、保护、调节和测量的基本元器件，电器产品的“高可靠、高性能、小型化、长寿命”与电气工程自动化与智能化关系密切。本课程主要讲授电器设计相关的基本理论，即发热理论、电动力理论、电弧理论、电接触理论和电磁机构理论。了解电器相关的设计原理与基本特性及其分析方法。课程中将穿插讲授电磁电器的工作原理、构造与设计计算,包括电磁继电器、接触器、小型断路器、电连接器和微动开关等。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验操作环节，理解电器产品机、电、磁、热、等离子体物理特性及机电能量转换过程，培养应用新原理与新材料设计电器的创新意识。
default.en: Electrical apparatuses is the basic components for circuit controlling, protection, adjustment and measurement. Electrical engineering automation and intelligence corelates closely with the electrical switch products, which has high reliability, high performance, miniaturization and long life characters. This course mainly introduces the five basic theories involved in electrical apparatus, i.e. heat transfer theory, electrodynamics, electrical arc theory, electrical contact theory and electromagnetic mechanism theory. The course mainly focuses on working principle, structure and design analysis of typical electrical apparatus, including electromagnetic relay, contactor, miniature circuit breaker, electric connector and micro switch etc. Through the classroom teaching of this course and the following experimental operation, understanding mechanical, electrical, magnetic, thermal, plasma physical properties and electromechanical energy conversion process of low voltage apparatus, cultivating innovative consciousness of applying new principles and new materials to design electrical apparatus.

default.zh: 工业生产中使用的电器分为低压电器和高压电器两部分。通过该课程使学生了解配电线路及用电设备对低压电器继电器的基本要求，掌握主要低压电器的结构原理及主要技术参数，掌握电器控制线路的设计方法。掌握断路器开断高压线路短路故障以及投切负荷时电压及电流的变化规律，掌握高压断路器的工作原理及结构特点，掌握高压电器设备在电力系统中组合应用的方法。
default.en: The electrical appliances used in industrial production are divided into two parts: low-voltage electrical appliances and high-voltage electrical appliances. Through this course, students can understand the basic requirements of distribution lines and electrical equipment for low-voltage electrical relays, master the structural principle and main technical parameters of main low-voltage electrical appliances, and master the design method of electrical control lines. Master the change law of voltage and current when the circuit breaker breaks the short circuit fault of the high voltage line and the load switching, master the working principle and structural characteristics of the high voltage circuit breaker, master the method of combining the high voltage electrical equipment in the power system.

default.zh: 电器设计与仿真是一门用以培养学生掌握电器产品的基本设计理念，并能够运用先进的数字化工具来完成电器本体设计的专业核心课程，是学生将其所学的电器理论知识应用到实际的工程设计中的非常关键的一环，在培养电器专业的学生在工程问题分析、综合设计能力方面具有重要地位。 本课程主要讲授典型电器产品，包括继电器、接触器等的基本设计方法，包括电磁系统的磁路分析与计算、接触系统的反力计算、吸反力配合关系分析、电器产品的三次设计（总体设计、参数设计、容差设计）思想、基于有限元法的电磁特性计算方法、基于多体动力学的接触系统特性计算方法等。通过本课程的课堂教学和上机仿真等环节，着重培养学生们对于机电系统的综合分析与设计能力，以及电气系统科学知识的应用能力，增加其创新意识。
default.en: Design and simulation of electrical apparatus is a fundamental course that teaches students to master the basic design concept of the electrical apparatus and makes them utilize the advanced digital software to accomplish the design of the electrical apparatus. The course is very significant for students to apply their learned theory to finish the real industrial design. Meanwhile, it also plays an important role in training the students of electrical engineering in the engineering problem analysis and integrated design capabilities. The course mainly teaches students the basic design method of the typical electrical apparatus, such as relays and contactors. The content of the course includes magnetic circuit analysis and calculation of the electromagnetic system, resistant force calculation of the contact system, analysis of the relationship between the attractive and resistant force, three stages design theory of electrical apparatus (system design, parameter design and tolerance design), finite element method of calculating the electromagnetic characteristics, multi-body dynamics method of calculating the contact system characteristics, etc. Through the classroom teaching and practice in the computer, the course is focused on training students the integrated analysis and design capabilities of the electro-mechanical system. Meanwhile, the course will enhance students applicable ability of electrical knowledge and make them have more innovative and constructive thoughts.

default.zh: 应用于工业领域/环境中的工业通信与网络技术，是自动化及电气工程领域当前和今后的发展热点之一。《工业通信与网络技术》课程包括通信与网络以及现场总线/以太网技术两部分。其主要内容为：现代通信与网络基本技术，基于UART的串行通信技术，主流（典型）现场总线/以太网主要技术，现场总线节点设计，以及现场总线系统应用技术基础。本课程可使学生掌握现代通信与网络的基本知识，学会阅读并理解现场总线协议/规范/标准；能够设计一般设备的现场总线通信接口，掌握典型现场总线系统的基本应用技术；并为学生进行工业通信网络设计和网络（系统）分析奠定一定的基础。
default.en: Technology of industrial communication & network applied in industrial fields has always been one of the hot spots in the development of automation and electrical engineering. “Technology of industrial communication & network” consists of two parts: communication and network, and technology of fieldbus/ Ethernet. Main contents of this course are: basic techniques in modern communication and network, serial communication techniques based on UART, major techniques of mainstream (typical) fieldbus /Ethernet, design of a field-bus node, as well as the basic knowledge in the application of a field-bus/ Ethernet system. This course provides the students of the basic knowledge of modern communication and network, and approaches in reading and understanding the field-bus protocols/ specifications/ standards; enables them in the designing of common field-bus interfaces, and in the mastery of basic application techniques of typical field-bus system; and meanwhile lays the foundation for the students in their further industrial communication network design and network (system) analysis.

default.zh: 《电器智能化原理及应用》是电类专业的一门重要课程，结合电器智能化应用，联系前期学习的电路、电子技术基础等课程内容，使学生对电器智能化形成系统和深入的认识，培养学生实际分析问题、独立思考和对知识的综合运用能力。 本课程主要讲授电器智能化的基本概念和发展现状，电器智能化中一次设备的分类、功能和控制方法，电器智能化的控制条件和原理，及其现场参量传感原理、测量电路和数字化处理方法，电器智能化中监控器的硬件和软件设计原理，相关的电磁兼容设计和测试标准，以及电器智能化网络及其设计方法，使学生对电器智能化有一个系统性的认识和深层次的理解，具备电器智能化系统分析设计相关的基础知识，构建从理论分析到工程应用的完整理论体系，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Theory and Applications of Intelligent Electrical Apparatus is an important course for electric specialty. By combining the application of intelligent electrical apparatus with the content of basic circuit and electronic technology in early stages, this course enables students to form a systematic and deep understanding of intelligent electrical apparatus, and enhance ability to analyze problems, think independently, and comprehensively apply knowledge in practice. This course mainly focuses on the basic concepts and development of intelligent electrical apparatus, the classification, functions, and control methods of primary equipment with respect to electrical intelligence, the control conditions and principles of electrical intelligence, the principles of field sensing, measurement circuits, and digital processing methods, the hardware and software design principles of monitors in electrical intelligence, relevant electromagnetic compatibility design and testing standards, as well as the design methods of electrical intelligence networks. This course enables students to have a systematic and deep understanding of electrical intelligence, to possess fundamental knowledge related to electrical intelligence system analysis and design, and to construct a complete theoretical system from theoretical analysis to engineering applications, which support the achievement of corresponding index points in professional education.

default.zh: 电力工程及工厂供电指工厂所需电能的供应和分配，其重要性和实际意义不言自明。本门课程主要讲授电力系统中性点运行方式、电力负荷计算方法、三相短路电流计算方法、工厂供电系统一次设备及主接线，定时限和反时限过电流保护、电流速断保护、低电压闭锁保护、电动机综合保护及其微机保护等，使学生熟悉和掌握与工厂相关电力系统及继电保护的基本理论和分析计算方法，为将来从事工厂电力工程及继电保护技术工作打下良好的基础。
default.en: Power Engineering and Plant Power Supply means the supply and distribution of power energy for factories, its importance and significance go without saying. The contents of this course mainly include: operation modes of neutral point of power system, calculation method of power load, calculation method of three-phase short-circuit current, primary equipments and their main connecting lines of electrical-supply system in factories, definite and inverse time over current protection, current quick break protection, low voltage latch-up protection, motor comprehensive protection and its microcomputer protection, etc. Students are required to handle the basic theories, analytical calculation methods and relay protection of power system, so that they are able to lay a good foundation for the future work in electricity engineering and relay protection technology.

default.zh: 汽车电气技术是电类专业的一门重要的选修课，本课程围绕电气技术在现代汽车中的应用，着重培养学生电气相关知识的关联和运用能力，能够与前期学习的电路、电子技术基础、电机学等课程做到很好的关联和衔接，使学生对汽车电气技术这一系统性的理论和应用体系形成更为全面和直观的认识。 本课程主要讲授汽车电子技术的发展、汽车供电系统、起动系统、点火系统、仪表及照明系统、发动机综合控制系统、汽车自动变速器、汽车电子控制助力转向系统、汽车行驶安全性控制系统、车载网络技术、汽车新型电子控制系统等汽车电气系统相关知识，从系统的分类、组成、结构和基本原理等方面对汽车电气系统各组成部分进行介绍、剖析和探讨，使学生对汽车电气技术有一个系统性的认识和深层次的理解，具备汽车电气系统分析设计相关的基础知识，构建从理论分析到工程应用的完整理论体系，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Automobile Electrical Technology is an important elective course of electric specialty. This course focus on the application of electrical technology in modern automobile to cultivate the ability of linking and using electrical knowledge. This course can be connected well with the “Circuit”, “Basic Electronic Technology” and “Electric machinery” which are taught before, so that the students can get more comprehensive and intuitive understanding on the theoretical and application system of automobile electrical technology. This course mainly focuses on the development and related knowledge of automobile electronic technology and systems, such as power supply system, automobile starters, ignition system, instrument and lighting system, engine integrated control system, automatic transmission, electric-assisted steering system, safety-control system, vehicle network and new electronic control systems. Introduction, analysis and discussion of the automobile electrical system will be carried out in aspects of classification, composition, structure and basic principles of the system. By this course, the students can have a systemic and deep understanding of the automobile electrical technology and get fundamental knowledge of automobile electrical system analysis and design. Besides, this course will build a complete theoretical system from theory analysis to engineering application and support the achievement of corresponding index points in professional education.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授电气系统可靠性特征量、可靠性预计与分配、可靠性分析方法、可靠性设计技术以及可靠性试验技术，使学生熟悉和掌握电气系统可靠性的基本理论和分析计算方法，为将来从事电气系统可靠性以及其他电气产品、设备乃至系统的质量管理与可靠性工作打下良好的基础。由于本门课程的许多分析方法是建立在概率论与数理统计的基础上，所以在本门课的开始阶段介绍可靠性特征量、常见的失效分布类型以及可靠性特征量的估计，帮助学生回顾已学知识，并建立本门课程基本概念的物理意义与数学描述之间的对应关系。然后再具体介绍可靠性分析方法、可靠性设计技术、试验技术以及产品质量管理的相关内容。
default.en: This course mainly teaches electrical system reliability index, reliability prediction and allocation, reliability analysis methods, reliability design methods and reliability test methods, leading students to understand and master the basic theory and methods of electrical system reliability for future work. Since many concepts in this course are based on the probability theory and the mathematical statistics, thus reliability index, some widely used failure distributions, as well as estimation methods of reliability index are introduced at the beginning of this course to help students review learned knowledge and establish the correspondence between physical meanings and mathematical description of the basic concepts of this course. Then we will introduce the relevant content of reliability analysis methods, reliability design methods, reliability test methods and product quality management in detail.

default.zh: 电力系统继电保护课程是电气工程及自动化专业最重要的专业技术课之一。电力系统继电保护是电力系统故障后的紧急措施，是电网安全运行的重要保证，在现代电力系统中具有十分重要的地位。 IEEE这样定义继电保护：“继电保护是这样一种电气装置，它反应于输入信号，当信号达到某一设定的条件时，通过电气控制电路进行通断操作。”电力系统继电保护的作用就是当电力系统发生短路故障时，将故障部分从系统分离，保证非故障部分正常运行，尽量减少停电范围。 本课程全面介绍了电力系统继电保护的基本概念、基本原理和体系结构，包括过电流保护，差动保护，低电压保护，方向保护，距离保护以及自动重合闸；结合上述原理介绍了电力系统主要电气设备的保护，如变压器保护、母线保护和输电线路保护等；介绍了自动重合闸装置；随着计算机技术的发展，微机保护成为当前电力系统主流保护装置，本课程还将简要介绍微机型继电保护的基本原理和实现技术。
