default.en: Power system relay protection is one of the most important courses in electrical engineering and automation. The relay protection of power system is an important measure to ensure the safe operation of power system, and it plays an important role in modern power system. The Institute of Electrical and Electronic Engineers (IEEE) defines a relay as “an electric device that is designed to respond to input conditions in a prescribed manner and, after specified conditions are met, to cause contact operation or similar abrupt change in associated electric control circuits.” The fundamental objective of system protection is to provide isolation of a problem area in the power system quickly, so that the shock to the rest of the system is minimized and as much as possible is left intact. The course provides a comprehensive coverage of power system protection fundamentals and philosophies, such as over-current protection, differential protection, under-voltage protection, directional protection, distance protection and auto-reclosing. And the course introduces the protective relaying applications, including transformer protection, bus protection and line protection. The growing application of microprocessors in the field of power system automation has created an unprecedented good opportunity for improving the performance of traditional protection and developing new types of protective relaying. The basic principles and realization technology are introduced in the course.

default.zh: 这门课是电力系统及其自动化专业方向的主要基础课，首先介绍：电气主接线的基本形式；限制短路电流的方法；各种类型发电厂和变电所主接线的特点；厂用接线的设计原则和接线形式；不同类型发电厂的厂用电接线；厂用电动机的选择和自启动校验。导体、电缆、绝缘子和套管的选择；高压断路器的原理与选择；隔离开关的选择；电流互感器、电压互感器的原理与选择；限流电抗器的选择；高压熔断器的选择。最后介绍同步发电机的运行；变压器的运行。
default.en: This is the main basic course for the specialty of power system and automation. We begin with the introduction to the main connection line of power system and its form, the method of restricting the short circuit current and peculiarity of all kinds of main connection lines of the power plants and power substations. Secondly, we introduce various types of main lines of plant itself, and how to design these main lines. And we introduce how to select the motors for the plant and verify whether it can start up. Thirdly, we introduce how to select the lines, cables, insulators, thimbles and high voltage breaks and switches, and other electric equipments including current transformers, voltage transformers, the reactors and high voltage fuses. Finally，we discuss the running problems of synchronous generators and power transformers.

default.zh: 《电力系统动态仿真》课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22EE32024 课程名称： 电力系统动态仿真 总学时：32 理论学时：24 实验学时：0 上机学时：8 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：2 开课单位：电气工程及自动化学院 授课对象：电气工程及其自动化专业 开课学期：4秋 先修课程：电力系统分析；自动控制原理 二、课程简介 这门课是电气工程及其自动化专业的限选课。主要介绍电力系统动态仿真的现状、发展方向及其仿真的基本概念、原理与方法。课程涵盖了电力系统仿真建模、全数字仿真原理与方法、实时半实物仿真、采样控制系统仿真及MWORKS 在电力系统仿真中的应用等内容。 电力系统全数字仿真原理和方法包括简单替换法、双线性替换法、根匹配法、离散相似法以及基于离散相似法建立的欧拉法、梯形法和多步Adams法和基于Taylor级数匹配原理建立的Runge-Kutta方法。分析了仿真方法误差产生的原因、仿真方法的精度、仿真方法的稳定性及仿真方法的变步长原理。介绍了电力系统实时半实物仿真的概念、仿真系统的运行方式、仿真模型的特点及常用的仿真方法。介绍了含有数字控制器的电力系统仿真方法，并给出了采样周期改变时数字控制器的重构方法。介绍了MWORKS 的仿真环境、编程语言与编程方法及其在电力系统仿真中的应用，并给出了简单电力系统仿真实验。 撰写人：王建赜 审核人：张国庆 日 期：2023.12.31 电力系统全数字仿真原理和方法包括简单替换法、双线性替换法、根匹配法、离散相似法以及基于离散相似法建立的欧拉法、梯形法和多步Adams法和基于Taylor级数匹配原理建立的Runge-Kutta方法。分析了仿真方法误差产生的原因、仿真方法的精度、仿真方法的稳定性及仿真方法的变步长原理。介绍了电力系统实时半实物仿真的概念、仿真系统的运行方式、仿真模型的特点及常用的仿真方法。介绍了含有数字控制器的电力系统仿真方法，并给出了采样周期改变时数字控制器的重构方法。介绍了MWORKS 的仿真环境、编程语言与编程方法及其在电力系统仿真中的应用，并给出了简单电力系统仿真实验。
default.en: Introduction to Power System Dynamic Simulation 1.General Information Course Code：22EE32024 Course Title：Power System Dynamic Simulation Credit Hours：32 Lecture: 24 Lab: 0 Computer Lab: 8 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：2 Offering Department: School of Electrical Engineering and Automation Students: Electrical Engineering and Automation Term: Fall, Fourth year. Prerequisites: Power System Analysis, Automatic Control Principle 2.Course Description Power System Dynamic Simulation is a elective course for electrical engineering and automation. This course mainly introduces the status, development direction of power system simulation and basic concepts, principles and methods of simulation. The course covers Power system modeling, Principle and methods for full digital simulation, Real-Time Semi-Physical simulation, Simulation of sampled-data system, Application of MWORKS in Power System Simulation etc.. The principle and method of full-digital simulation of power system include Simple alternative method, Bilinear substitution method, Root matching method, the numerical value simulation method and the Euler method , the betterment Euler method and Adams method based on it, Runge-Kutta method based on Taylor Series matching principle. The reason of the error of the simulation method, the precision of and the stability of the simulation method, the variable step principle of the simulation method are analyzed. We will discuss the concept of real-time hardware-in-the-loop simulation, the operation mode of simulation system, the characteristics of simulation model and the commonly used simulation method in power system simulation. The simulation method of power system with digital controller and the reconstruction method of the digital controller when the sampling period is changed are introduced in the course. The simulation environment of MWORKS, programming language , programming method and its application in power system simulation are introduced. Simulation experiments of simple power system are given in the end. Author: Jianze Wang Reviewer：Guoqing Zhang Date：2023.12.31

default.zh: 高电压技术的发展始于20世纪初期，也称为高电压与绝缘技术，是电力工程学科的一个重要分支，它主要研究高电压、强电场下的各种电气物理问题。对于电力工程类专业的学生来说，学习本课程的主要目的是学会如何正确处理电力系统中过电压和绝缘这一对矛盾，研究的出发点是如何将电力系统绝缘确定在既经济又可靠的水平。本课程主要内容包括各种电介质和绝缘结构在高电场强度下的特性、电气设备绝缘试验技术、电力系统中的过电压及其防护措施、电力系统绝缘配合等。这些内容是从事电力系统设计、安装、调试、操作和研究的工程技术人员的基本知识。 在目前电力工程类专业的教学计划中，高电压技术是唯一研讨电力系统过电压和绝缘的一门课程，在电力工程中具有较强的理论性、实践性的应用价值，而且本课程还具有专业基础知识的性质，是电气工程及其自动化专业学生知识结构中不可或缺的部分。高电压技术是电气工程及其自动化专业方向的任选课程。
default.en: The development of high voltage technology began in the early 20th century, also known as high voltage and insulation technology. Studying all kinds of electrical and physical problems under high voltage and strong electric field, high voltage technology is an important branch of electrical engineering disciplines. For the students of electrical engineering, the main purpose of this course is to learn how to correctly understanding and dealing with the pair of contradiction between overvoltage and insulation in the power system. The starting point of the study is how to determine the insulation of the power system in an economically and reliable level. The main contents of this course include the characteristics of all kinds of characteristics of various dielectric and insulation structures under high electric field intensity, the electrical equipment insulation test techniques, the power system overvoltage and its protective measures, power system insulation coordination, and so on. These contents are the essential basic knowledge for the engineering and technical personnel who engage in power system design, installation, debugging, operation and research. In the current teaching program of electrical power engineering, high voltage technology is the only course of studying of power system overvoltage and insulation, which has a strong theoretical and practical value. The high voltage technology course is an indispensable part of the knowledge structure for the students of electrical engineering and its automation. The high voltage technology is an optional course.

default.zh: 该课程是电气工程及其自动化专业的任选课，主要讲授电力系统常用自动装置的基本构成、基本作用、基本要求、基本原理、基本特性等。 其主要内容包括：1、同步发电机的自动并列。2、同步发电机励磁自动控制系统。3、励磁自动控制系统的动态特性。4、电力系统的有功及频率自动调节。5、自动低频减载及其它安全自动装置。
default.en: This is an optional course for the specialty of electrical engineering and its automation, mainly introducing basic constructions, functions, requests, principia and characteristics of common automatic devices of power system. The main contents of the course include the following 5 aspects: automatic parallel operation of synchronous generators, excitation automatic control system of synchronous generators, dynamic characteristics of excitation automatic control system, automatic regulation of real power and frequency of power system, and automatic load shedding with lower frequency and other safety automatic devices.

default.zh: 电力系统分析是电力系统及其自动化方向学生的一门主要专业课。本课程作为电力系统分析直接的后续课程，将基于Visual C++平台或CodeBlock平台的C语言实用编程技术与专业理论基础知识紧密结合，既加深了学生对专业理论的综合理解,又提高了学生的计算机实际编程水平。 基于节点导纳矩阵计算原理和牛顿-拉夫逊法的潮流计算原理，本课程理论部分详细讲述常用电力网络的计算机建模方法和编程技术，给出电力系统计算程序的一般设计思路。实战编程环节主要演示如何使用企业版的Visual C++平台或CodeBlock平台，以及在该平台上实现电力系统的稳态计算，包括如何编写和调试C语言的节点导纳阵程序，短路电流计算程序和牛顿-拉夫逊法的潮流计算应用程序。通过本课程的学习，培养学生对电网络的实际建模与设计分析能力，提高学生的计算机应用能力和编程水平，一方面为学生即将面临的毕业设计任务打下了坚实的实战基础，另一方面为学生提供了更多的择业机会，这样的毕业生能更好地契合当前社会发展的需求。
default.en: Power system analysis is the main course for students majoring in power system and its automation. This course following the above course combines the basic theoretical knowledge with the useful programming techniques based on the Visual C++ platform or CodeBlock, which deepens students’ understanding of the specialized theory and enhances their programming levels. Based on the Nodal admittance matrix and Newton-Raphson method for power flow, this course describes the common modeling methods and programming techniques for power networks by computers in detail and gives the general design idea for power systems computation programs. This course also demonstrates how to use the enterprise Visual C++ platform or CodeBlock fully including how to coding and debugging projects such as the nodal admittance matrix , short-cut current computation and the complex power flow calculation based on the Newton-Raphson method. This course will help students be capable to design and model the practical power network and enhance their computer programming levels, which lays the good foundation for their graduation tasks and provide them more job chances for they meet the society’s demands better.

default.zh: 电力系统综合实验是面向电气工程及自动化专业本科生的专业实验课程，是配合《电力系统分析》、《电力系统继电保护》和《发电厂电气系统》等专业理论课程的实验环节。通过本门课程学习，加强对电力系统分析、电力系统继电保护和发电厂电气系统的基本概念和基本原理的理解，培养学生的实践能力、综合分析能力和理论联系实际的能力。 全部课程共包含7个实验，其中3个实验是关于电力系统分析课程，3个实验是关于电力系统继电保护课程，1个实验是关于发电厂电气系统课程。通过本课程实践环节的学习，培养学生们运用实验方法研究电力系统科学和工程问题的能力，增强对实际电力系统运行控制方式的感性认识，提高学生理论联系实际的能力。
default.en: Power system analysis is the main course for students majoring in power system and its automation. This course following the above course combines the basic theoretical knowledge with the useful programming techniques based on the Visual C++ platform or CodeBlock, which deepens students’ understanding of the specialized theory and enhances their programming levels. Based on the Nodal admittance matrix and Newton-Raphson method for power flow, this course describes the common modeling methods and programming techniques for power networks by computers in detail and gives the general design idea for power systems computation programs. This course also demonstrates how to use the enterprise Visual C++ platform or CodeBlock fully including how to coding and debugging projects such as the nodal admittance matrix , short-cut current computation and the complex power flow calculation based on the Newton-Raphson method. This course will help students be capable to design and model the practical power network and enhance their computer programming levels, which lays the good foundation for their graduation tasks and provide them more job chances for they meet the society’s demands better.

default.zh: 电能质量控制技术是电力电子技术在电力系统中重要的应用方向，具有重要的理论研究和工程实践价值，也是后续高压、大功率电力电子装置与控制类课程的先修课程。本课程从电能质量基本概念入手，介绍电能质量的评估指标和方法，阐述电能质量的国际标准和国家标准；通过对电力系统中电能质量问题的分类（系统暂态、电压暂升与跌落、波形畸变、谐波、开关、雷击等引起的浪涌等），说明典型电能质量问题产生的原因及危害，介绍电能质量控制技术的发展趋势；通过对谐波分析、瞬时无功功率理论等电能质量控制理论的讲解，引入基于电力电子技术的电能质量控制技术，包括有源电力滤波器、静止无功功率补偿装置（晶闸管控制电抗器TCR、晶闸管投切电容器TSC、静止无功补偿器SVC、晶闸管控制串联电容器TCSC）以及柔性交流输电装置（静止同步补偿器STATCOM、静止同步串联补偿器SSSC、统一潮流控制器UPFC）等，重点讨论各种控制方法的电路拓扑、控制原理及应用。本课程以课堂讲授为主，采用案例教学方式，通过一些实际问题的分析帮助学生将理论与工程实践相结合，利用理论分析与仿真分析相结合，培养同学们分析和解决本领域相关工程问题的思维方法和实践能力。
default.en: Electrical Power Quality Control Techniques, focusing on the applications of power electronic technology in power system, is a prerequisite for courses in High voltage, High power electronic devices and control. Starting from the basic concept of power quality, this course expounds the power quality indicators and measurements, the international standards and national standards of power quality. The causes and harms of typical power quality problems are analyzed, based on the classification of power quality problems in power system, such as impulsive transient, voltage sag and swell, waveform distortion, harmonic, flicker, and so on. Along with the analysis of power quality control theory, such as harmonic analysis and instantaneous reactive power theory, the power quality control techniques based on power electronics are introduced, including the Active Power Filter, Static Var Compensator (Thyristor Controlled Reactor, Thyristor Switched Capacitor, Static Var Compensator, Thyristor Controlled Series Capacitor ), Flexible AC Transmission (STATCOM, SSSC, UPFC), etc. The circuit topology, control principle and applications of various control techniques are discussed in detail. Through the analysis of some practical cases, this course will cultivate students' ability to apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 电气传动自动控制系统是电气类专业学生重要的专业课，学生在掌握了专业基础知识后，培养学生利用所掌握的电机学、电力电子技术、自动控制理论等理论知识对电气传动控制系统进行综合分析和综合设计，培养学生学以致用的能力。 本课程主要讲授直流电动机单闭环调速系统、直流电动机双闭环调速系统、直流电动机调速数字控制技术、基于稳态模型的异步电动机调速系统和基于动态模型的异步电动机调速系统。针对电气传动控制问题，讲述如何运用自动控制理论来分析和设计运动控制系统。以转矩和磁链控制为主线，从开环控制到闭环控制、从直流电机驱动到交流电机驱动循序渐进讲述运动控制系统的分析和设计方法。重点培养学生运用基础理论知识对复杂的工程问题进行分析与设计的能力，提升学生创新研究能力。
default.en: The Control System of Electric Drives is an important professional course for students majoring in electrical engineering. After mastering the basic knowledge of the profession, students are trained to use their theoretical knowledge of Electric Machinery, Power Electronics Technology, Automatic Control Theory, etc. to comprehensively analyze and design control system of electric drives, and cultivate their ability to apply what they have learned. This course mainly teaches the single closed-loop speed control system of DC motor, the double closed-loop speed control system of DC motor, the digital control technology of DC motor control, asynchronous motor speed control system based on static model, and asynchronous motor speed control system based on dynamic model. Aiming the problem of electric drives control, this course explains how to apply automatic control theory to analyze and design motion control systems. Tracking the torque and flux control, the analysis and design methods of motion control systems are gradually explained from open-loop control to closed-loop control, and from DC motor drive to AC motor drive. Focus on cultivating students' ability to analyze and design complex engineering problems using basic theoretical knowledge, this course emphasizes improving the students’ innovation ability.

default.zh: 《电力电子数字控制系统》课是一门专业基础课，主要讲述计算机控制系统的分析方法，控制器的设计方法，以及计算机控制系统的实际应用。计算机控制系统的分析包括对系统稳定性、静态和动态性能的分析。计算机控制系统的设计方法包括基于连续控制理论的间接设计法、基于离散控制理论的直接设计法、和基于现代控制理论的状态空间法等。计算机控制系统的实际应用分别讲述永磁同步电机和感应电机的计算机控制系统设计。本课具有相对独立的理论体系、且其基本理论知识和工程方法对控制系统设计具有较为普遍的作用，从而为以后其它各种专门领域的控制课程（如过程控制、机器人控制、智能控制等）提供了必要的基础。 通过本课程的学习，要使学生了解计算机控制系统的基本概念，掌握数字控制器的设计方法，并将传统的控制理论与具体的计算机实现有机地结合起来。本课程要求学生在课堂面授的同时认真完成实验课和计算机仿真的内容，从而达到培养学生系统分析与设计能力的目的。
default.en: As a professional basic course, Digital Control Systems in Power Electronics mainly focuses on the analysis, controller design methods, as well as the practical applications of the computer control systems. The analysis of the computer control systems provides insight into the analysis of the system stability, static and dynamic performances. The design methods of the computer control system include indirect design method based on the continuous control theory, the direct design method based on the discrete control theory, and the state space method based on the modern control theory. Two case studies, the design of the computer control systems of permanent magnet synchronous motors and induction motors, will be described respectively. This course has relatively independent systematic theoretical framework. Its basic theoretical knowledge and the engineering methods have significant meanings to the design of the control systems. Therefore it provides necessary basis for the forthcoming courses related to control engineering, such as process control, ,robot control, intelligent control, and so on. The objectives of this course are to make the students understand the basic concepts of computer control systems, master digital controller design methods, and combine traditional control theory and computer implementations. This course requires students to complete experiments and computer simulations, so as to achieve at the purpose of training students’ capabilities in the system analysis and design.

default.zh: 本课程是电力电子和电机学课程的延伸，课程的教学目的是使学生具有较为全面的交流传动系统设计与仿真分析的基础与实践知识，为今后的毕业设计、攻读研究生做好准备。 课程的主要内容包括： 首先介绍电力电子和电机控制系统的发展，仿真工具MATLAB电气系统模型库及其模块功能简介，然后以实例介绍了电力电子和电机控制系统的建模和仿真方法，包括直流电机控制、感应电机控制、永磁电机控制、风力发电控制等四个模块。 课程的教学目标是使学生有效掌握电力电子控制系统的仿真分析方法，建立各类电机和电力电子器件的数学模型，了解并掌握坐标变换、空间矢量控制、脉冲宽度调制和并网逆变器控制等理论基础知识，通过本课程的学习使学生了解交流传动系统的技术动向和新的应用领域，能依据研究方案选用或搭建仿真模型并能够完成初步的系统设计和调试，提高同学们利用软件仿真工具解决实际工程问题的能力，同时又可为工作中解决理论和实践问题打好坚实的基础。
default.en: Design and Simulation of AC Drives is extended from Power Electronics and Electrical Machines, the destination of this course is to make students understand the theory of power electronic control system and ac drives and prepare for graduation project and graduated works. The main contents is described as followed: Firstly, the development of power electronics and motor control systems are introduced, the electrical modules of Matlab are described. Secondly, the model and simulation of power electronic and motor control system are introduced by some examples, including DC motor control、induction motor control、permanent magnet motor control and wind power control. The goal of this course is to make students get the methods of power electronic control system simulation, build the mathematic model of several kinds of power electric devices and machines, and know the frame transformation theory, space vector control, pulse width modulation and grid-connected inverter control. Through the study of this course, students can understand the developments and novel applications of power electronics and AC drives; they can select the methods of control, build the model and finish the system design. The engineering problems are solved by simulation software and the foundations are established for future work.

default.zh: 本课程在电力电子技术教学内容基础上，主要讲授基于全控型功率器件和脉冲调制技术的电能变换系统的分析、设计和基本控制方法。主要内容包括：现代电能变换技术的发展和展望；主流功率开关器件的动态特性和应力分析，电路运行条件对器件性能的影响，驱动、缓冲和保护电路的设计方法；高频磁性材料的基本特性，开关变换器中的磁性元件的参数计算方法；直流变换拓扑的衍生与组合，各自的应用特点、调制方式、运行模态、输出特性及电路动态性能的提升和参数设计方法；有源功率因数校正的典型拓扑、基本原理和常用控制方法。 通过本课程学习，将掌握功率开关器件和高频磁性元件的开关特性和参数选取、设计方法；熟悉各类电能变换电路拓扑的应用特点、工作原理和控制策略，掌握典型变换电路的分析、设计、实现方法和实验技能；熟悉提高电能变换质量、变换效率的技术方案和评价方法。为进一步学习和研究复杂电能变换系统奠定基础。
default.en: Based on the course contents of power electronic technologies, this course focuses on the analysis, design and control methods of power conversion systems adopting fully-controlled power electronic devices and Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) technology. The main contents include: Development and prospect of modern power conversion technology; Analysis of dynamic characteristics and stress of major power switching devices, influence of operating conditions on device performance, design methods of driving circuits, buffer circuits and protection circuits; Basic properties of high frequency magnetic materials, approaches to calculating parameters of magnetic components in switching converters; Derivation and combination of DC converter topologies, and respective application characteristics, modulation modes, operation modes, output characteristics, measures to improve the dynamic performance of circuit, and parameter design methods; Typical topologies, working principles and common control methods of active power factor correction. Through this course participants will have a good understanding of the switching characteristics, parameter selection and design methods of power switch devices and high frequency magnetic components, have an intimate knowledge of the application characteristics, working principle and control strategy of major power conversion circuit topologies, master the analysis, design, implementation, and experiment methods of typical conversion circuits, acquaint with the technical schemes and evaluation methods to improve the quality and efficiency of power conversion. This course lays the foundation for further study and research of complex power conversion systems.

default.zh: 工业电气控制技术是强电类专业重要的专业基础课程，它包含“工厂电气控制技术”和“PLC原理与应用”两部分内容，是一门实用性很强的专业课，在培养学生工业电气控制系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程的主要内容以电动机或其他执行电器为控制对象，讲解继电接触式控制系统和可编程逻辑控制器控制系统的原理、设计方法和实际应用。主要内容包括熟悉常用控制电器(低压电器、变频器、软启动器)的工作原理和用途，达到正确选型和使用的目的。熟练掌握电气控制线路的基本环节，熟悉图形文字符号的国家标准，具备阅读和分析电气控制线路的能力，掌握电气控制线路的设计方法，具备分析和解决工程实践中电气控制系统问题的能力。 熟悉PLC的基本概况，深刻理解PLC的工作原理。熟练掌握西门子S7-200系列PLC的基本指令系统和典型电路编程，掌握基于S7-200 PLC的实际系统软硬件设计方法，通过实物实验部分的学习，掌握实际电气控制系统的设计方法，具有解决工程实际问题的能力； 课程考核以检验课程目标的达成度为手段，进而评价学生学习成果的达成度。考核的环节包括课堂考核、大作业和实验。
default.en: Industrial Electrical Control Technology is a fundamental course in the field of electrical engineering. It encompasses two main components: 'Factory Electrical Control Technology' and 'PLC Principles and Applications.' This course is highly practical and holds a significant position in developing students' comprehensive abilities in analyzing and designing industrial electrical control systems. The primary focus of this course is on control systems for electric motors and other actuating devices. It covers the principles, design methods, and practical applications of both relay control systems and programmable logic controller (PLC) systems. The key topics include: Familiarization with the principles and applications of commonly used control devices, such as low-voltage electric appliance, variable frequency converters, and soft starters, for correct selection and usage.Proficiency in understanding the fundamental elements of electrical control circuits, familiarity with national standards for graphical symbols, and the ability to read and analyze electrical control circuits. Mastery of electrical control circuit design methods and the ability to analyze and solve issues in electrical control systems encountered in engineering practice. Understanding the historical development of PLC and gaining a deep insight into its operational principles. Proficiency in programming Siemens S7-200 series PLC with basic instruction sets and typical circuit designs. Mastery of practical hardware and software design methods for systems based on the S7-200 PLC series. Learning how to design real electrical control systems and developing problem-solving skills for engineering applications through practical exercises. The course evaluation includes attendance rate, laboratory work, and a final project. The maximum of final grade is 100.

default.zh: 本课程是电气工程与自动化专业的一门专业选修课程。本课程的主要以风力并网发电技术和光伏并网发电技术为主，讲解风力发电并网系统及光伏发电并网系统的原理、设计方法和应用。具体内容包含新能源发电概述、风力发电原理与并网系统、光伏发电原理与并网系统、并网发电中的关键技术、并网逆变器结构与控制原理、光伏并网发电系统设计、更多类型可再生能源发电系统等。通过本课程的学习，使学生在了解能源的概念、分类与利用历史的基础上，熟悉光伏发电、风力发电、潮汐发电等新能源发电的基本原理与关键技术，掌握新能源发电并网变换器的电力电子拓扑结构、工作原理及控制方法，熟悉新能源并入大电网需具备的最大功率跟踪、反孤岛策略、低电压穿越等功能，授课过程中通过提问和分组讨论激发学生主动学习的兴趣，培养学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力，并介绍并网发电系统设计与仿真的常用软件与工具，从而使学生对新能源并网发电技术这一热门领域形成较深刻的认识，初步具备光伏发电并网系统设计与开发能力。
default.en: This course mainly focuses on wind power grid-connected generation technology and photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected generation technology, explaining the principles, design methods, and applications of wind power and PV power grid-connected systems. The specific content includes an overview of renewable energy generations (REGs), principles of wind power generation and grid-connected system, principles of PV power generation and grid-connected system, key technologies in grid-connected power generation, structure and control principles of grid-connected inverters, design of PV grid-connected power generation systems, and more types of REGs. Through the study of this course, students will be familiar with the basic principles and key technologies of REGs such as PV power generation, wind power generation, and tidal power generation etc., based on their understanding of the concept, classification, and utilization history of energy. They will also master the power electronic topology, working principles, and control methods of grid-connected converters for REGs, and become familiar with the maximum power tracking, anti-islanding strategy, low voltage ride through, and other requirement for the integration of renewable energy into the main power grid. During the teaching process, questions and group discussions are used to improve students' interest, cultivate their ability to analyze and solve problems independently. By introducing corresponding software and tools for grid-connected power generation system design and simulation, students are able to form a deeper understanding of grid-connected REGs technology, and initially obtain the ability to design and develop PV power generation grid-connected systems.

default.zh: 作为电气类学生的选修课，无线电能传输技术是学生前续学习过的电路理论、电磁场理论、嵌入式系统、电力电子、自动控制等学科综合交叉应用技术。以无线电能传输技术为例来巩固学生的基础理论，培养学生综合运用多种技术解决实际问题的能力，对于学生理论与实践相结合具有很好的引导作用。 本课程首先介绍无线电能传输的发展历程，综合比较各种无线电能传输技术的优缺点，使学生真正了解感应式无线电能传输技术成为当前主流技术的前因后果。在此基础上，依次讲解无线电能传输的关键技术：高频开关电源技术、无功补偿技术、高效磁耦合技术、整流滤波技术、反馈控制技术以及能量信号同步传输技术，通过由浅入深的介绍，使学生对无线电能传输技术有一个全面的了解，掌握无线电能传输系统的设计方法、流程，并能熟练使用电路、磁路仿真软件。本课程理论联系实际，着重培养学生综合运用各种技术解决实际问题的能力，提高创新意识，培养技术与理论兼备的研究型人才。
default.en: As an elective course for electrical engineering students, wireless power transfer technology is a comprehensive interdisciplinary application of circuit theory, electromagnetic field theory, embedded systems, power electronics, and automatic control, which students have previously studied. By using wireless power transfer technology as an example, this course aims to consolidate students' basic theories, cultivate their ability to use multiple technologies to solve practical problems, and guide the integration of theory and practice. This course first introduces the development history of wireless power transfer, comprehensively compares the advantages and disadvantages of various wireless power transfer technologies, and enables students to truly understand the reasons and consequences of inductive wireless power transfer technology becoming the mainstream technology. Based on this, the course sequentially explains the key technologies of wireless power transfer, including high-frequency switch power supply technology, reactive power compensation technology, efficient magnetic coupling technology, rectification and filtering technology, feedback control technology, and energy signal synchronous transmission technology. Through a gradual introduction, students gain a comprehensive understanding of wireless power transfer technology, master the design methods and processes of wireless power transfer systems, and become proficient in using circuit and magnetic circuit simulation software. This course emphasizes the practical application of theoretical knowledge, focuses on cultivating students' ability to use various technologies to solve practical problems, enhances their innovation consciousness, and cultivates research-oriented talents with both technical and theoretical capabilities.

default.zh: 本门课程主要讲授电力电子与电力变换方向中基于脉宽调制的开关变换器动态模型建立与控制系统设计方法。通过对电力电子功率器件（二极管、MOSFET、IGBT）及其组成的多种功率变换拓扑（以DC-DC变换器为主）的稳态、动态特性分析，分别建立器件与拓扑的电路与数学模型，进而建立其平均模型，利用经典自动控制理论进行控制器设计从而实现电压、电流闭环的多种工作模式；分析占空比、输入电压、负载电流等对输出电压、电流的影响，研究变换器控制-输出、输入-输出传递函数的频域特性，实现高稳定、快动态响应的功率开关变换系统。通过本课程学习，将掌握功率开关器件的电路模型和电力电子开关电路的平均模型、小信号模型的建立方法，并能够利用电路级仿真软件（Pspice）与系统级（Matlab或Plecs）仿真软件实现器件、电路与系统的分析与设计，为今后复杂电力电子拓扑与系统的建模与控制研究奠定基础。
default.en: In this course, with the research field of power electronics and power converting, the establishing approaches of dynamic models of switching power converters based on pulse width modulation (PWM), and the design methods of its control system are taught. Based on the steady-state and dynamic characteristics analysis of high-frequency power devices (diodes, MOSFET, IGBT) and different power conversion topologies (mainly DC-to-DC power converters) composed of the mentioned devices. In this course, the circuit and mathematical and average models are established, both the devices and topologies. Then this course introduces the controller design methods based on the classical automatic control theory to realize different operating modes of voltage and current closed-loop control. Moreover, the course analyzes the effects of the duty cycle, the input voltage and the load current on the output voltage and current, as well as the frequency-domain characteristics of the control-to-output and input-to-output transfer functions to design a switching power converter system with high stability and fast dynamic response. Through studying this course, students will master the methods for establishing both the circuit model of power-switching devices and the average and small-signal model of power-switching circuits. In addition, students should be able to analyze and design the devices, the circuits and the closed-loop system by means of circuit simulation software (Pspice) and closed-loop system simulation software (Matlab or Plecs). The study of this course will lay the foundations for the modeling and control of more complex power electronic topology and systems in the future.

default.zh: “电工材料技术及应用”是电气信息类学生非常重要的专业课程。它所涉及的内容是电类专业学生应具备的知识结构的必要组成部分，同时又是一些交叉领域的学科生长点和新兴边缘学科发展的基础。其课程定位为面向国际化工程教育，培养学生电气系统科学知识的应用能力，并服务于高素质创新型科技人才培养目标的需求。 本课程主要讲授当代电气工程领域所使用的电工材料，以麦克斯韦方程组为核心构架，分析材料的特点、电磁性能和应用技术。内容包括材料中的麦克斯韦方程组、导电材料、电阻材料、电介质材料、半导体材料和磁性材料。目的在于引导学生熟悉电工材料的电磁性能、特点、用途、使用范围、型号、规格及表示方法，能在实践和应用中正确合理地选用电工材料，并且能从材料的基本电磁性能出发来分析复杂的电气工程问题。通过课程学习，开拓学生科研思路，培养学生正确的思维方法和严谨的科学态度，为将来从事科学研究工作的前瞻性和创新性奠定基础。 撰写人： 金钊 审核人： 杨旭强 日 期： 2023年10月23日
default.en: Electrical Materials Technology and Its Application are of great importance for students majored in information technology and engineering for its fundamental significance in students’ knowledge structure. It is also the foundation of growing and crossing points for many novel technologies, and the basis for the development of emerging interdisciplinary. The course orientation is set for international engineering education of promoting the ability in applying comprehensions systematically. It can also satisfy the requirements aimed at training students for high quality and innovation capability. This course is mainly linked with electrical materials in the field of contemporary electrical engineering. Maxwell equations layout the basis of crucial architecture of the course. Characteristic features, electromagnetic properties, and application technology of the materials are analyzed in this course including Maxwell electromagnetic theory, and conductive materials, resistance materials, dielectric materials, semiconductor materials, magnetic materials. It aims to guide the students to get familiar with electromagnetic properties, as well as other characteristics, purposes, application scopes, material types, specifications and representation methods of the electrical materials. It can lead students to make a reasonable choice of electrical materials in practical applications and operations, as well as analyze electrical engineering problems from the basic electromagnetic properties of the materials. As extending the students' scientific vision, the course can also train the students in reasoning methods and rigorous attitudes toward scientific and technological challenges, which lays a foundation for students engaging in scientific research from a forward-looking and innovation view. Author: Zhao Jin Reviewer: Xuqiang Yang Date: 23/10/2023

default.zh: 气体放电技术是一个与科学工程紧密结合、具有很强应用背景的研究分支，在气体照明、材料处理与制备、环境保护、生物医学、空间研究与开发、以及诸多先进科学技术领域具有广泛的应用前景。本课程面向电类专业本科学生和工程师，以气体放电的基本原理及基本理论、气体放电相关实用技术及典型应用为主要内容，结合学科前沿进展，讲述气体放电中的基本过程和分类、气体放电等离子体基本性质、气体放电基本理论及主要形式、气体放电等离子体产生方法、气体放电技术的主要应用以及常用测量诊断方法及其原理。通过课程的学习，使学生能了解气体放电基本理论、研究现状、相关工程学科的最新进展及其在工业、国防等领域的典型应用，培养学生理论联系实际对电气系统科学知识的应用能力，以及在相关工程领域进一步开展学习和研究工作的能力，增加创新意识。课程中提供了大量的应用实例和详细的分析以帮助学生逐步形成针对特定需求分析并正确选择对应技术的能力。通过师生的直接互动，引领学生探讨与思辨，拓展视野，激发学生学习及对科研的兴趣，为后续课程学习奠定基础。
default.en: Gas discharge technology is closely related to contemporary science and technology with comprehensive applications in various fields, such as gaseous illumination, materials modification and manufacture, environment protection, bio-medicine, space exploration, and many other innovative science and technology areas. The course is for electrical engineering students and engineers, with subjects of fundamental principles/theories and typical technology/applications of gaseous discharge. Focusing on frontier advances in the area, the course addresses basic gaseous discharge processes and manifestations, essential features of gaseous discharge plasmas, theoretical basis of the discharge, plasma discharge sources, major applications, and conventional measurements and diagnostic methods. It is planned for students to learn fundamental gas discharge theory, processes, current states of research, technological advances, and typical applications in industry and national security and to promote their capability in performing electrical engineering understandings in technique practice and for further study and research, as well as future innovation. It is also designed with a great amount of practical examples and detailed analyses for students to elevate their ability in responding to real-world challenges with specific requests. Further, by teaching-learning interaction, the course scheme organizes students to reason and explore the projects by extending their visions and ideas and exciting their desires of learning and studying, which then provides a solid basis for their future studies.

default.zh: 脉冲功率技术是电气工程类学生非常重要的专业课程，是电类专业学生应具备的知识结构的必要组成部分，是学生综合运用所学知识来分析和解决实际复杂工程问题的基石，在培养学生综合分析能力、综合设计能力，工程实践能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授功率脉冲技术的基本原理及应用，以能量的储存、脉冲形成理论、开关技术及测量技术为主体来讲解高功率脉冲产生的原理和方法。通过本课程的学习，引导学生理论联系实际，能从工程实际应用角度出发来分析问题。在培养学生们对脉冲功率系统的综合分析与设计能力基础上，开拓学生科研思路，培养学生电气系统科学知识的综合应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1. 熟悉和掌握功率脉冲形成的理论分析基础，各种Marx发生器、Blumlein传输线理论的基本分析方法和计算方法，掌握脉冲功率技术中的开关技术、脉冲电流的测量方法，具备对工程问题进行数学表达、建立电磁模型及综合分析脉冲功率技术的能力； 课程目标2. 熟悉和掌握电感储能、电容储能、机械储能的特点，了解功率脉冲形成线理论及功率脉冲技术结构的最新研究的热点、发展趋势及前沿应用； 课程目标3. 熟悉和掌握常见脉冲功率技术中所涉及的计算机辅助设计方法，能使用相关电路仿真工具对设计方案进行仿真验证，并能通过仿真工具分析电路参数对系统性能的影响，逐步具有应用先进工具解决工程实际问题的能力，完成电气工程问题的模拟和仿真分析。
default.en: Pulsed power technology is a very important professional course for students majoring in electrical engineering. It is a necessary part of the knowledge structure for students majoring in electrical engineering. It is the cornerstone for students to analyze and solve practical complex engineering problems by comprehensively using what they have learned. It plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability, comprehensive design ability and engineering practice ability. This course mainly introduces the basic principle and application of power pulse technology. It mainly introduces the principle and method of high power pulse generation with energy storage, pulse forming theory, switching technology and measurement technology as the main body. Through the study of this course, students can be guided to integrate theory with practice and analyze problems from the perspective of practical engineering application. On the basis of cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design ability of pulse power system, we should develop students' scientific research ideas, cultivate students' comprehensive application ability of electrical system scientific knowledge, increase their innovation consciousness, and support the achievement of corresponding index points in professional learning achievements.

default.zh: 电磁场设计是一个与国家大科学工程紧密结合、具有很强应用背景的研究分支，在高端科学仪器、高能物理研究和能源发展战略等先进科学技术方面占有重要地位。本课程在工程电磁场的基础上，以核磁共振、粒子加速器和磁约束核聚变三个领域的典型工程应用为主要内容，结合学科的前沿进展，讲述电磁场设计的原理和方法。通过课程的学习，使学生能了解工程电磁场学科的最新进展及其应用现状，培养学生理论联系实际，在相关领域进一步开展学习和研究工作的能力。这些能力包括：一、熟悉和掌握电磁场的应用原理和理论分析基础，掌握设计方法；二、熟悉和掌握各种应用场合的指标要求、建模方法、计算手段和分析方法，对多学科交叉、以电工理论为主的复杂工程问题进行多层次数学表达、正确建立物理模型和分析计算；三、掌握电磁场设计的基本技能和计算机数值模拟方法，能够熟练运用计算机软件资源和仿真技术工具完成电磁场型领域复杂工程问题的分析、预测与模拟，理解其局限性并作出适当的工程处理。
default.en: Electromagnetic field design is a research branch closely integrated with national scientific engineering and has a strong application background. It plays an important role in advanced science and technology such as high-end scientific instruments, high-energy physics research, and energy development strategies. On the basis of engineering electromagnetic fields, this course mainly focuses on typical engineering applications in the fields of nuclear magnetic resonance, particle accelerators, and magnetic confinement fusion. Combining with the cutting-edge developments of the discipline, it introduces the principles and methods of electromagnetic field design. Through course learning, students can understand the latest progress and application status of engineering electromagnetic fields, cultivate their ability to integrate theory with practice, and further carry out learning and research work in related fields. These abilities include: firstly, familiarity and mastery of the application principles and theoretical analysis foundations of electromagnetic fields, mastery of design methods; secondly, familiarize and master the indicator requirements, modeling methods, calculation methods, and analysis methods for various application scenarios, conduct multi-level mathematical expression, correctly establish physical models, and analyze and calculate complex engineering problems with interdisciplinary and electrical theory as the main focus; thirdly, master the basic skills of electromagnetic field design and computer numerical simulation methods, be proficient in using computer software resources and simulation technology tools to analyze, predict, and simulate complex engineering problems in the field of electromagnetic fields, understand their limitations, and make appropriate engineering treatments.

default.zh: 在超导材料及机理的探索和应用的百年历史中已有10人获得了5次诺贝尔奖。超导技术是21世纪电能输送与存储、高速轨道交通、高精尖科学仪器、可控核聚变、量子计算等若干前沿技术领域发生革命性进步的希望所在。本课程以超导材料相关技术及其典型应用为主要内容，结合学科前沿进展，讲述超导体的基本特性、应用物理基础、实用超导材料种类及其制备过程、超导材料的主要电力应用领域。通过课程的学习，使学生能了解超导技术的研究现状、研究热点、相关工程学科的最新进展及其在工业、前沿科学等领域的典型应用，引导学生理论联系实际，从工程实际应用角度出发来分析问题，并获得进一步开展学习和研究工作的能力。
default.en: In the 100-year history of the researches on superconducting materials and mechanisms, 10 people have been awarded five Nobel Prizes. Currently, superconductivity has been widely used in fields of medical industry, energy, transportation, and information technology. Superconductivity has been regarded as the possible hope for revolutionary progress in the 21st century in several frontier technologies such as electric energy transmission and storage, high-speed rail transportation, high precision scientific instruments, controlled nuclear fusion, and quantum computing. The main contents of the course are introduction to superconductivity, the properties and physics of superconductors, practical superconducting materials and their preparation processes, AC losses, and energy applications of superconducting materials. Through the course, students can understand the state of the art of superconductivity technology, the latest progress of the technology, and their typical applications in industry, frontier science and other fields. Moreover, students are able to carry on further studies and conduct research works in the related fields.

default.zh: 电磁测量技术是研究电学量、磁学量以及可转化为电学量的各种非电量的测量原理、方法和所用仪器仪表的技术科学。本课程主要讲授电磁测量技术的基本原理、电磁测量工具结构和运行特性、电磁测量中常用的传感器技术及使用方法、现代先进数字测量及发展趋势，使学生较深入地了解设备电气参数测试基本方案，掌握电磁测量的基本方法，具备工程研究和工业生产中电磁测量数据处理和分析能力。主要内容包括：电磁测量的基本知识及数据处理方法；直读式和比较式电测仪表（电气参量的传统测量方法）；电子式电测仪表（电子示波器和数字示波器）；数字化电测仪表（结构及特点）；磁性测量（磁场测量的基本定理及静、动态磁特性的测量方法）；非电量电测量（几类传感器的原理及应用）；虚拟仪器基础训练；工程应用实例以及测量系统的干扰与抑制技术。在教学上结合电气工程领域的具体实例进行讲授和研讨，使学生掌握电磁测量的理论、技术和方法，提高分析和解决电气工程领域测量问题的应用和创新能力。
default.en: Electromagnetic measurement technology is a technological science that studies the principles, methods, and instruments used for measuring electrical and magnetic quantities, as well as various non electrical quantities that can be converted into electrical quantities. This course mainly teaches the basic principles of electromagnetic measurement technology, the structure and operating characteristics of electromagnetic measurement tools, commonly used sensor technologies and usage methods in electromagnetic measurement, modern advanced digital measurement and development trends. It enables students to have a deeper understanding of the basic scheme of equipment electrical parameter testing, master the basic methods of electromagnetic measurement, and possess the ability to process and analyze electromagnetic measurement data in engineering research and industrial production. The main content includes: basic knowledge of electromagnetic measurement and data processing methods; Direct reading and comparative electrical measuring instruments (traditional measurement methods for electrical parameters); Electronic measuring instruments (electronic oscilloscopes and digital oscilloscopes); Digital measuring instruments (structure and characteristics); Magnetic measurement (basic theorem of magnetic field measurement, measurement methods for static and dynamic magnetic characteristics); Non electrical measurement (principles and applications of several types of sensors); Basic training of virtual instruments; Engineering application examples, interference and suppression techniques for measurement systems. Combining specific examples in the field of electrical engineering in teaching and discussion, to enable students to master the theory, technology, and methods of electromagnetic measurement, and improve their application and innovation abilities in analyzing and solving measurement problems in the field of electrical engineering.

default.zh: 《电气测控系统设计》是电气工程及自动化专业的一门综合性、实践性很强的选修课程。课程从总体设计角度出发，对系统共性的核心问题进行讲解，介绍电气测控系统设计的基础内容，对系统的误差原理、实用硬件电路与核心软件技术设计方法作以介绍，并给出综合设计实例，突出电气测控系统设计的应用性和实践性。课程系统地阐述了电气测控系统的原理、主要技术和设计方法，讲授的具体内容包括：电气测控系统概述、嵌入式处理技术、数据采集技术、模拟量与数字量输出技术、波形记录与波形输出技术、系统外设处理及测量结果可视化技术、系统通信及总线接口技术、数据处理及程序设计、基于智能理论的信息处理技术、系统的自检、自校准与自动测量技术、系统的软硬件抗干扰技术、电气测控系统的设计方法及应用实例与电气测控系统课程设计等。本课程的体系结构在于从整机的角度阐述电气测控系统的设计原理和设计方法，通过实验和课程设计等实践环节使学生加深对课程内容的理解，为学生扎实掌握电气测控系统的原理，进而进行系统的设计奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: “Electrical Measurement and Control System Design” is a elective course of Electrical Engineering and Automation Major and it is a comprehensive and practical course. Based on the system design as well as the core problem of common systems, the course introduces the basic content of the design of electrical measurement and control system, the errors of system principle, practical hardware circuits and core software technology design methods. Also, it takes the system design for examples and provides the outstanding applications of electrical measurement and control system. This course systematically introduces the principle of electrical measurement and control system, main techniques and design methods. The content of the course consists of the following parts: overview of electrical measurement and control system, embedded processing technology, data acquisition technology, analog and digital output technology, waveform recording and waveform output technology, system peripheral processing and visualization of measurement results, system communication and bus interface technology, data processing and program design, information processing technology based on intelligent theory, self-test, self-calibration and automatic measurement technology, system anti-jamming technology, examples of system design, etc. This course aims to describe the principle and design methods of systems from the perspective of the whole machine. Assisted with experiment and curriculum design, it will help students reinforce their understanding of the course content, which may lay a solid foundation for mastering the principles and design of electrical measurement and control system.

default.zh: 耦合谐振电能变换技术是指以耦合谐振原理为基础，实现电能的交直流变换和非接触式传输的先进技术，广泛应用于电动汽车、轨道交通、储能技术和便携式电子设备等领域。本课程是电气工程及自动化学院的选修课程，旨在通过课程学习使学生了解耦合谐振电能变换技术的基础知识，具备应用课堂学习内容对耦合谐振电能变换技术在实际工程应用中的相关科学与工程问题展开研究的能力。课程的主要内容包括基本耦合谐振电能变换拓扑、耦合机构的结构与特性分析、耦合机构有限元分析工具及建模方法、耦合谐振系统的建模方法、谐振补偿拓扑、系统电路控制方法、系统电路仿真工具与数据分析等内容。通过对这门课程的学习，使学生了解国内外耦合谐振电能变换技术的应用前景，形成清晰的课程思维导图，建立课程的知识体系，掌握电能变换原理、电路拓扑、磁耦合机构结构、磁耦合机构建模及仿真方法、系统控制方法、电路仿真方法等耦合谐振电能变换技术的相关基础知识，为学生从事相关科学研究、技术开发、工程设计奠定基础。
default.en: Coupled-resonant electric power conversion, which takes the coupled-resonant principle as the basis, is an advanced technology to achieve AC/DC conversion and non-contact transmission of electric power. This technology is widely applied to electric vehicles, rail transportation, energy storage and portable electronic equipment and other fields. This course is an elective course offered by the School of Electrical Engineering and Automation, aiming at enabling students to understand the basics of coupled-resonant power conversion, raising the awareness to combine theory with practice, and cultivating the ability to address relevant theoretical and practical problems with the classroom learning content. The course includes the coupled-resonant power converter topology, the structural characteristic analysis of the coupler, finite-element analysis tools and modelling method of the coupler, modelling method of coupled-resonant system, resonant compensation topology, control method of system circuits, circuit simulation tools and data analysis method. The course helps students to realize the application prospect at home and abroad of the coupled-resonant power conversion technology, form a clear thinking map of the course, establish the knowledge system of the course, take command of the principle of power conversion, circuit topology, magnetic coupler structure, magnetic coupler modelling and simulation methods, system control methods, circuit simulation methods and other relevant basic knowledge of coupled-resonant power conversion technology. It will help laying the foundation for students to engage in related scientific research, technology development and engineering design.

default.zh: 储能技术是构建新型电力系统的核心技术，被认为是支撑能源革命、实现“碳达峰”与“碳中和”最核心的物理手段。储能技术涉及物理、化学、材料、机械、电气、经济等多个专业，是一个典型的交叉学科。作为高等院校电气工程专业的本科生及研究生，很有必要了解储能技术的相关知识。本课程主要讲述物理储能、电化学储能以及储热技术的相关概念和工作原理，使学生了解和掌握各种储能技术的概念、原理、特点及发展应用前景。通过本课程的课堂教学以及实验课程，着重培养学生应用所学习的理论解决实际问题能力，提高学生综合分析及设计的能力，重视学生自学能力与创新能力的培养，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Energy storage technology is the core technology for building a new type of power system, and is considered the most core physical means to support the energy revolution and achieve "carbon peaking" and "carbon neutrality". Energy storage technology involves multiple majors such as physics, chemistry, materials, machinery, electrical, and economics, and is a typical interdisciplinary field. As undergraduate and graduate students majoring in electrical engineering in higher education institutions, it is necessary to have knowledge of energy storage technology. This course mainly introduces the concepts and working principles of physical energy storage, electrochemical energy storage, and thermal storage technology, enabling students to understand and master the concepts, principles, characteristics, and development prospects of various energy storage technologies. Through the classroom teaching and experimental courses of this course, the focus is on cultivating students' ability to apply the theories they have learned to solve practical problems, improving their comprehensive analysis and design abilities, emphasizing the cultivation of students' self-learning and innovation abilities, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 能量转换原理与技术是电类专业和能源专业学生非常重要的专业选修课，是学习后续课程如储能系统设计、储能系统测试、储能系统应用等课程的基础，在培养学生能量存储与转换系统综合理解能力、综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授能源转换的基本概念、基本原理、能量转换分析方法、光电能量转换、光热能量转换、热机能量转换、机电能量转换、风能技术、海洋能技术、核能技术以及氢能技术，使学生较深入地了解掌握各种重要能量之间相互转换的基本原理和主要方法。本课程通过课堂教学和后续的实验操作环节，着重培养学生们能量存储与转换系统的综合分析与设计能力，以及能量存储与转换系统科学知识的运用能力，增强创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Principles and Technologies of Energy Conversion is a vital elective course for students in electrical and energy-related disciplines. It serves as the foundation for subsequent courses like Energy Storage System Design, Energy Storage System Testing, and Energy Storage System Applications. This course plays a significant role in nurturing students' comprehensive understanding, analytical skills, and design capabilities in the field of energy storage and conversion systems. The course primarily focuses on fundamental concepts, basic principles, methods of energy conversion analysis, photovoltaic energy conversion, solar-thermal energy conversion, thermodynamic energy conversion, electromechanical energy conversion, wind energy technologies, ocean energy technologies, nuclear energy technologies, and hydrogen energy technologies. Through classroom instruction and subsequent practical laboratory sessions, students will gain a deep understanding of the fundamental principles and key methods involved in the interconversion of various important forms of energy. This course aims to emphasize the development of students' comprehensive analytical and design skills in the field of energy storage and conversion systems, as well as the application of scientific knowledge in these systems. It seeks to enhance their innovative thinking and support the achievement of relevant performance indicators within their academic pursuits.

default.zh: 本课程是电气工程与自动化学院储能方向选修课程，讲授多种技术类型储能系统的工作原理、系统结构、优缺点内容，具体包括抽水蓄能、压缩空气储能、飞轮储能、电池储能等；重点学习锂电池储能电性能、热性能、寿命及安全性等知识；重点学习不同应用场景下大规模锂电池储能系统设计方法，包括电气设计、电子设计、热设计等知识。讲解时结合具体工程实际，以概念、基本知识和基本原理为主，提高学生理论联系实际的能力；同时，还要结合当前储能技术领域发展的趋势，介绍一些新的研究成果和趋势，开扩学生的思路和视野。
default.en: This course is an elective course in the energy storage field of the school of electrical engineering and automation. This course teaches the working principle, system structure, advantages and disadvantages of various technology types of energy storage systems, including pumped storage, compressed air energy storage, flywheel energy storage, battery energy storage, etc. Focus on lithium battery energy storage electrical performance, thermal performance, life and safety knowledge; Focus on learning the design method of large-scale lithium battery energy storage system in different application scenarios, including electrical design, electronic design, thermal design and other knowledge. When explaining the concrete engineering practice, it focuses on concepts, basic knowledge and basic principles to improve students' ability to combine theory with practice. At the same time, it is also necessary to introduce some new research results and trends in combination with the current development trend in the field of energy storage technology, and expand students' ideas and horizons.

default.zh: 储能与电力变换技术是储能学科方向的重要专业基础课程，通过该门课程的学习，使学生掌握储能系统功率变换的基本原理和应用。储能技术主要分为物理储能(如抽水储能、压缩空气储能、飞轮储能等)、化学储能(如铅酸电池、锂离子电池等)和电磁储能(如超级电容等)三大类，各种储能中功率变换技术不可或缺的关键环节。是学生毕业后从事储能技术研究、开发、设计、制造和管理工作的基石，是联系储能技术理论和研究生深入学习的桥梁，在培养国家急需的储能技术领域人才方面占有重要地位。 本课程系统而全面地讲授几种典型类型的储能系统功率变换技术的基础知识、关键技术和应用实例，共分为八个方面，主要是前言与绪论、电化学储能系统功率变换、储能系统功率扩展技术、飞轮储能系统功率变换、抽水蓄能系统功率变换、混合储能功率变换、储能系统实验等。通过上机仿真环节能够更直观和深刻的体会储能系统功率变换技术的基本知识和应用要点。通过本课程的课堂教学、储能系统功率变换技术上机仿真等环节，着重培养学生们对于储能系统功率变换技术交叉学科问题的综合分析能力，以及多学科知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 储能与电力变换技术是储能学科方向的重要专业基础课程，通过该门课程的学习，使学生掌握储能系统功率变换的基本原理和应用。储能技术主要分为物理储能(如抽水储能、压缩空气储能、飞轮储能等)、化学储能(如铅酸电池、锂离子电池等)和电磁储能(如超级电容等)三大类，各种储能中功率变换技术不可或缺的关键环节。是学生毕业后从事储能技术研究、开发、设计、制造和管理工作的基石，是联系储能技术理论和研究生深入学习的桥梁，在培养国家急需的储能技术领域人才方面占有重要地位。 本课程系统而全面地讲授几种典型类型的储能系统功率变换技术的基础知识、关键技术和应用实例，共分为八个方面，主要是前言与绪论、电化学储能系统功率变换、储能系统功率扩展技术、飞轮储能系统功率变换、抽水蓄能系统功率变换、混合储能功率变换、储能系统实验等。通过上机仿真环节能够更直观和深刻的体会储能系统功率变换技术的基本知识和应用要点。通过本课程的课堂教学、储能系统功率变换技术上机仿真等环节，着重培养学生们对于储能系统功率变换技术交叉学科问题的综合分析能力，以及多学科知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: The power conversion technology of energy storage systems is an important professional basic course in the field of energy storage. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic principles and applications of power conversion in energy storage systems. Energy storage technology is mainly divided into three categories: physical energy storage (such as pumped energy storage, compressed air energy storage, flywheel energy storage, etc.), chemical energy storage (such as lead-acid batteries, lithium-ion batteries, etc.), and electromagnetic energy storage (such as supercapacitors, etc.). Power conversion technology is an indispensable key link in various energy storage technologies. It is the cornerstone for students to engage in research, development, design, manufacturing, and management of energy storage technology after graduation, and serves as a bridge between energy storage technology theory and graduate students' in-depth learning. It plays an important role in cultivating urgently needed talents in the field of energy storage technology in the country. This course systematically and comprehensively teaches the basic knowledge, key technologies, and application examples of several typical types of energy storage system power conversion technology. It is divided into eight aspects, mainly including introduction and introduction, electrochemical energy storage system power conversion, energy storage system power expansion technology, flywheel energy storage system power conversion, pumped storage system power conversion, hybrid energy storage power conversion, energy storage system experiments, etc. Through the computer simulation process, one can have a more intuitive and profound understanding of the basic knowledge and application points of power conversion technology in energy storage systems. Through the classroom teaching and computer simulation of energy storage system power conversion technology in this course, the focus is on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability for interdisciplinary problems of energy storage system power conversion technology, as well as the application ability of multidisciplinary knowledge, increasing innovation awareness, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.
