It is divided into eight aspects, mainly including introduction and introduction, electrochemical energy storage system power conversion, energy storage system power expansion technology, flywheel energy storage system power conversion, pumped storage system power conversion, hybrid energy storage power conversion, energy storage system experiments, etc. Through the computer simulation process, one can have a more intuitive and profound understanding of the basic knowledge and application points of power conversion technology in energy storage systems. Through the classroom teaching and computer simulation of energy storage system power conversion technology in this course, the focus is on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability for interdisciplinary problems of energy storage system power conversion technology, as well as the application ability of multidisciplinary knowledge, increasing innovation awareness, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 储能系统应用是电类专业的一门重要的选修课，主要对当前国内外储能技术的发展及应用进行了系统性阐述，包括各种储氢技术与燃料电池、电化学储能、超级电容储能与微电源等储能技术在电力系统、交通运输、新能源发电和移动电子设备中的应用，以及在典型应用系统中的技术经济性等。着重培养学生储能相关知识的关联和运用能力，使学生对储能技术及其在电力系统、交通运输等方向中的应用形成初步认识。能够与前期学习的电路、电子技术基础等课程做到很好的关联和衔接，熟悉掌握储能系统与应用对象进行能量互动的关键技术，使学生对储能系统应用体系形成更为全面和直观的认识，深入理解课程知识的实用价值。
default.en: Energy Storage System Application is an important elective course for electrical majors, mainly providing a systematic exposition of the current development and application of energy storage technology, including the application of hydrogen storage technologies and fuel cells, electrochemical energy storage, supercapacitor energy storage, and micro power supply in power systems, transportation, new energy generation, and mobile electronic devices, as well as the technical and economic benefits in typical application systems. Emphasis is placed on cultivating students' ability to relate and apply knowledge related to energy storage, so as to form a preliminary understanding of energy storage technology and its applications in power systems, transportation, and other fields. Students can achieve good correlation and connection with courses such as circuit and electronic technology fundamentals that were previously studied, and become familiar with and master key technologies for energy interaction between energy storage systems and application objects. Enable students to form a more comprehensive and intuitive understanding of the energy storage system application system, and deepen their understanding of the practical value of course knowledge.

default.zh: 课程的目的是以储能学科方向为核心，各类储能技术为骨架，各类储能系统测试专业知识为脉络，培养学生的电气储能系统技术综合分析能力、综合设计能力和综合测试能力。课程通过深入地了解各类储能系统测试特点，熟悉各类储能系统的测试内容和测试标准，掌握各类储能系统参数测试基本方案和基本方法，培养学生具备工程研究和工业生产中储能系统测试数据处理和分析能力。本课程是电类专业学生非常重要的专业选修课，在储能专业学生的专业知识基础上，通过主要储能形式如：超导储能、飞轮储能、重力储能、压缩空气储能、化学电池储能、超级电容储能等测试特点分析，结合电气测试方法和测试理论，构建储能系统测试技术教学路线。课程要求学生了解典型的储能系统测试的基本原理、测试工具结构和运行特性、储能系统测试中涉及的传感器技术及使用方法、现代先进数字电气测试及发展趋势。熟悉储能系统测试重点参数、主要测试工具基本特性及其测试使用方法，掌握各类传感器使用和测试方法，具有储能系统的电气参数测试方案设计能力和数据分析能力，以及电气系统科学知识的应用能力。
default.en: The purpose of 《Energy Storage System Test Technology》is to train students' comprehensive analysis ability comprehensive design ability and comprehensive test ability of electrical energy storage system technology. The architecture of the course is various energy storage technologies. Its context is all kinds of energy storage system testing expertise. The course has a deeper understanding of the characteristics of various energy storage system testing. It is familiar with all kinds of energy storage system test content and test standards, master all kinds of energy storage system parameter test basic scheme and basic method. To cultivate students with engineering research and industrial production of energy storage system test data processing and analysis ability. This course is a very important professional elective course for students majoring in electricity. Based on the professional knowledge of students majoring in energy storage, through the main forms of energy storage, such as: superconducting energy storage, flywheel energy storage, gravity energy storage, compressed air energy storage, chemical battery energy storage, super capacitor energy storage and other test characteristics analysis. Combined with electrical testing methods and testing theory, the teaching route of energy storage system testing technology is constructed. The course requires students to understand the basic principles of typical energy storage system testing, the structure and operation characteristics of testing tools, the sensor technology and use methods involved in energy storage system testing, modern advanced digital electrical testing and development trends. Familiar with key parameters of energy storage system test, basic characteristics of main test tools and test methods. Master all kinds of sensor use and test methods. Students are trained to have the ability of electrical parameter test scheme design and data analysis of energy storage system, as well as the application ability of electrical system science knowledge.

default.zh: 2020年9月22日，中国政府在第七十五届联合国大会上提出：“中国将提高国家自主贡献力度，采取更加有力的政策和措施，二氧化碳排放力争于2030年前达到峰值，努力争取2060年前实现碳中和。”本课程旨在针对我国碳中和技术创新重大需求，系统介绍各项碳中和技术的基本原理、工艺过程、技术特点和发展趋势，增进学生对碳中和技术的理解，并结合基础知识和应用实例、理论与实践、科研与产业导论，培养学生分析问题、解决问题的能力，以及工程实践和创新精神。课程内容主要包括碳中和的概念、形式与挑战，能源结构转型与低碳电力系统，工业系统减碳及主要技术，交通系统减碳与主要技术，建筑领域的碳中和，生态环境的碳中和，碳捕集、利用、封存与监理，碳中和碳达峰的举措与未来等。
default.en: On September 22, 2020, the Chinese government proposed at the 75th United Nations General Assembly that "China will increase the strength of its national autonomous contribution, adopt more vigorous policies and measures, strive to peak carbon dioxide emissions by 2030, and strive to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060." This course aims to address the major needs of carbon neutral technology innovation in China, systematically introduce the basic principles, process, technical characteristics and development trend of each carbon neutral technology, enhance students' understanding of carbon neutral technology, and combine basic knowledge and application examples, theory and practice, scientific research and industry introduction to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve problems, as well as the spirit of engineering practice and innovation. The course contents mainly include the concept, forms and challenges of carbon neutrality, energy structure transformation and low-carbon power system, carbon reduction and major technologies in industrial systems, carbon reduction and major technologies in transportation systems, carbon neutrality in buildings, carbon neutrality in ecological environments, carbon capture, utilization, sequestration and supervision, and carbon neutrality and carbon peaking initiatives and the future.

default.zh: 机械学基础是一门培养学生了解电气装备中通用机械基本原理的专业课。在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合实践环节，培养学生设计电气传动装置及机械结构的能力，为学生进一步学习专业课和今后从事电气高端装备设计相关行业打下基础。课程涵盖了机械原理、机械设计、理论力学、材料力学、电气装备等内容。通过讲授平面连杆机构的基本原理，使学生掌握电气传动类装备中的基本机械结构和原理，了解电气装备机械设计中的基本要素和基本方法。采用课堂讲授、课后实践作业和课上讨论测试相结合的方式，使学生掌握齿轮机构、常用机械材料的基础知识和齿轮类、轴类零部件的设计方法，为今后从事相关产品设计制造打下理论基础。 本课程主要围绕电气装备中的基本机械结构和原理开展课程知识讲授，主要包括平面连杆机构原理、齿轮机构原理、常用机械材料及性能、零件精度设计、轴系零部件设计方法、齿轮传动设计方法等内容。结合视频介绍等方式，加深学生对相关学习内容的理解。介绍齿轮、轴系、零件精度等设计方法和设计理论在电气装备机械设计中的具体应用，讲述机械零件设计和应用在高端装备中的发展趋势，拓宽学生的知识面。
default.en: Fundamentals of Mechanics is a professional course that cultivates students' understanding of the basic principles of general machinery in electrical equipment. In the teaching process, the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses are comprehensively applied, combined with practical links, to cultivate students' ability to design electrical transmission devices and mechanical structures, laying a foundation for further learning professional courses and engaging in high-end electrical equipment design related industries in the future. The course covers mechanical principles, mechanical design, theoretical mechanics, material mechanics, electrical equipment, and more. By teaching the basic principles of planar linkage mechanisms, students can master the basic mechanical structures and principles in electrical transmission equipment and understand the basic elements and methods in mechanical design of electrical equipment. By combining classroom lectures, practical assignments after class, and in class discussions and tests, students can master the basic knowledge of gear mechanisms and commonly used mechanical materials, as well as the design methods of gear and shaft components, laying a theoretical foundation for future engagement in related product design and manufacturing. This course mainly focuses on the basic mechanical structure and principles in electrical equipment, including the principles of planar linkage mechanisms, gear mechanisms, commonly used mechanical materials and performance, component accuracy design, shaft system component design methods, gear transmission design methods, and other content. By combining video introductions and other methods, students can deepen their understanding of relevant learning content. At the same time, the specific application of design methods and theories such as gears, shafting, and component accuracy in the mechanical design of electrical equipment will be discussed, and the development trend of mechanical component design and application in high-end equipment will be discussed to broaden students' knowledge.

default.zh: 电气测试技术及可靠性基础是电气工程及其自动化专业的一门通用专业课，该课程可以支撑电气工程及其自动化专业毕业要求，学生将其所学的基础理论知识应用到实际电气测试中的非常关键的一环，在培养电气专业的学生在工程问题分析、综合设计能力方面具有重要地位。 本课程主要讲授典型常用传感器的工作原理、基本结构、测量电路和各种应用，熟悉非电量测量的基本知识，了解电气被测参数的检测方法、电气检测系统的设计步骤，了解电气检测技术的发展趋势，同时了解基本可靠性理论、可靠性评价方法，培养学生运用前修课及本课程的知识，逐步掌握根据以可靠性为目标的具体检测的要求、技术性能，运用典型的系统自动检测装置进行测试，为学生的毕业设计和毕业后从事电气工程及其自动化等方面的工作打下良好的基础，并增加其创新意识。
default.en: Electrical Testing Technology and Fundamentals of Reliability is a general professional course for Electrical Engineering and Automation majors. This course can support the graduation requirements of Electrical Engineering and Automation majors. It is a crucial step for students to apply the basic theoretical knowledge they have learned to practical electrical testing, and plays an important role in cultivating their engineering problem analysis and comprehensive design abilities. This course mainly teaches the working principles, basic structures, measurement circuits, and various applications of typical commonly used sensors. Students are familiar with the basic knowledge of non electrical measurement, understand the detection methods of electrical measured parameters, the design steps of electrical detection systems, understand the development trends of electrical detection technology, and understand the basic reliability theory. Students are trained to apply the knowledge of previous courses and this course, Gradually master the specific testing requirements and technical performance based on reliability as the goal, and use typical system automatic testing devices for testing, laying a good foundation for students' graduation design and their work in electrical engineering and automation after graduation, and increasing their innovation awareness.

default.zh: 电磁场是电气信息类学生非常重要的专业基础课。它所涉及的内容是电类专业学生应具备的知识结构的必要组成部分，同时又是一些交叉领域的学科生长点和新兴边缘学科发展的基础。 课程强调电磁现象的物理原理和数学描述的统一性。本课程将介绍电磁场的基本定律、定理、基本的分析和仿真方法及基本的电磁场实验方法。主要内容包括：静电场、恒定电场、恒定磁场、时变电磁场、准静态电磁场、电路参数的定义和计算方法、电磁场的能量及其转换规律、平面电磁波以及电气工程中的典型电磁场问题。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握宏观电磁场的基本理论，并能够解决实际工程电磁场问题。 课程最后成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时、实验和仿真等。 撰写人： 金钊 审核人： 杨旭强 日 期： 2023年10月23日
default.en: The course in Electromagnetic Fields is a fundamental and technological course for the students belong to the electrical information class. The content involved in this course is an essential part of the knowledge structure for electrical major students. It is the basis what they must control. Meanwhile, it is also the growth point for the knowledge of interdisciplinary and the foundation for the development of the emerging edge discipline. This course emphasizes itself on the unity of the physical principle behind the electromagnetic phenomena and mathematical description. The main contents are as follows: the electrostatic fields, the electric current fields, the magneto static fields, the time-varying fields, the quasi-static field, the definition and calculation method of circuit parameters, the energy transformation of the electromagnetic fields, the uniform plane wave and the typical electromagnetic problems in electric engineering. The main purpose of this course is to lead the students to matter the basis theory in macro electromagnetic filed and use the knowledge to solve problems in electro-magnetic engineering. The final score for the course consists of attends at ordinary times, in-class quiz, experiment report, experiment on computer performance and the final exam. Author: Zhao Jin ReViewer: Xuqiang Yang Date:October 23,2023

default.zh: 高等电路分析主要是帮助电气信息类专业学生在已经较为完整地学习了线性时不变集中参数小规模电路的时域分析方法的基础上，掌握或了解图论、非线性或分布参数或大规模电路的系统化分析方法、为后续课程（如自动控制理论、信号与系统、电机学、电力系统分析、电力电子电路等）学习奠定良好基础。课程对于培养学生的科学思维能力、综合运用高等电路理论分析和解决实际问题的能力都起到重要的作用。 本课程主要让学生掌握图论、非线性电路和分布参数电路的基本概念、基本原理和电路行为的分析方法等，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握高等电路的基本理论知识和分析计算方法，同时培养学生利用数学手段和现代化工具进行电路的综合分析与设计能力，为学生以后的学习、创新和从事科学研究工作打下扎实的理论和能力基础。
default.en: Advanced Circuit Analysis is mainly to help students majoring in electrical information to master or understand the systematic analysis methods of graph theory, nonlinear or distributed parameters or large-scale circuits on the basis of having already learned the time domain analysis methods of linear time-invariant concentrated parameter small-scale circuits in a relatively complete manner, and to lay a good foundation for the study of subsequent courses (such as Automatic Control Theory, Signals and Systems, Motor Science, Power System Analysis, Power Electronic Circuits, etc.). The course plays an important role in cultivating students' scientific thinking ability, comprehensive application of advanced circuit theory analysis and ability to solve practical problems. This course aims to enable students to master the basic concepts, basic principles and analysis methods of circuit behavior of graph theory, nonlinear circuits and distributed parameter circuits. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic theoretical knowledge and analysis and calculation methods of advanced circuits. At the same time, it will cultivate students' ability to use mathematical means and modern tools to conduct comprehensive analysis and design of circuits, laying a solid theoretical and ability foundation for students' future learning, innovation and scientific research.

default.zh: 本课程主要让学生掌握线性直流电路、电路定理、正弦交流电路，三相电路、非正弦周期电流电路、谐振电路、暂态电路和二端口网络的分析方法和工程应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握用电路的理论知识和分析计算方法来解决工程实际问题，使学生能利用数学手段和现代化工具进行电路综合分析与设计，培养学生创新思维，为学生今后从事科学研究工作打下扎实的理论基础。

《多能流智慧能量管理系统》是能源互联网工程专业方向的任选课程。课程主要讲授多能流智慧能量管理系统的基本构成、主要功能、工作原理及其关键模型和计算方法，介绍智慧能量管理系统的基本概念、研究领域及关键技术。通过本课程的学习，学生能够系统掌握信息采集与执行系统、信息传输系统和信息处理系统的工作原理，初步具备设计现代电力调度自动化系统架构的能力。同时，课程还将深入讲解状态估计、静态安全分析与控制、自动发电控制等数学模型及其主要计算方法，使学生具备分析与解决工程实践中问题的能力。此外，课程介绍多能流系统的优化调度与控制技术，以及人工智能和大数据分析在智慧能量管理中的应用，帮助学生熟练掌握科技文献检索与分析方法，了解能源互联网领域理论与技术的最新进展。本课程强调信息自动化系统综合分析与设计能力和能源系统科学知识应用能力的培养，注重提升学生的创新意识和前沿把握能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Smart Multi-Carrier Energy Management System is is an elective course under the Energy Internet Engineering program. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental components, main functions, operating principles, and key models and computational methods of multi-energy flow smart energy management systems. It introduces the concepts, research areas, and core technologies of smart energy management systems. Through this course, students will gain a solid understanding of information acquisition and execution systems, information transmission systems, and information processing systems, and develop an initial ability to design the architecture of modern power dispatch automation systems. The course also covers mathematical models and computational methods for state estimation, static security analysis and control, and automatic generation control, enabling students to analyze and solve problems encountered in engineering practice. In addition, it introduces optimization and control technologies for multi-energy flow systems, as well as applications of artificial intelligence and big data analytics in energy management. Students will also acquire skills in literature retrieval and analysis, while keeping up with the latest theoretical and technological advances in the Energy Internet field. The course focuses on cultivating students’ abilities in comprehensive analysis and design of information automation systems, applying energy system scientific knowledge, enhancing innovation awareness, and supporting the achievement of the corresponding program learning outcomes.

default.zh: 电力系统继电保护与控制是新型电力系统安全运行的重要保障。《新型电力系统保护与控制》是能源互联网工程专业最重要的专业技术课之一，是从事电力系统科研和实践工作必修课。本课是一门综合性非常强的课程，奠基于理论电工、电机学、电力系统等基础理论，还与电子技术、通讯技术、计算机科学与信息技术等新技术密切相关，同时也是一门理论与实践并重的学科。 本门课程主要讲述新型电力系统保护与控制的基本概念、基本原理和思考方法。通过课堂教学和实验教学等环节，加强学生对新型电力系统运行规律和继电保护的理解，着重培养学生在电力系统继电保护方面综合分析能力、设计能力、实践能力和创新能力。
default.en: Relay protection and control of power systems serve as a crucial guarantee for the safe operation of new power systems. Protection and Control of New Power Systems stands as one of the most important professional technical courses for the major of Energy Internet Engineering, and it is a compulsory course for those engaged in scientific research and practical work in the field of power systems. This course is highly comprehensive. It is grounded in basic theories such as theoretical electrical engineering, electrical machinery, and power systems, while also being closely associated with emerging technologies including electronic technology, communication technology, and computer science and information technology. Meanwhile, it is a discipline that emphasizes both theory and practice in equal measure. The main content of this course covers the basic concepts, fundamental principles, and thinking methods related to the protection and control of new power systems. Through teaching links such as classroom instruction and experimental teaching, students’ understanding of the operating laws of new power systems and relay protection is enhanced. The course also focuses on cultivating students’ comprehensive analysis capabilities, design capabilities, practical skills, and innovative abilities in the field of power system relay protection.

default.zh: 以美国著名学者里夫金在其《第三次工业革命》一书中所提出的“能源互联网”研究为依托，以新能源技术和信息技术深入结合为背景，系统介绍能源互联网的产生背景、基本概念、研究现状和发展趋势，详细阐述能源互联网基础设施与技术架构、能量管理与故障管理技术、通信和信息安全技术、需求响应与源网荷储协同控制技术等关键技术，并探讨云大物移智等新型技术在能源互联网中的应用。本课程旨在使学生掌握能源互联网基本原理、核心技术、产业现状以及发展脉络，为学生毕业后从事能源互联网与智慧能源建设提供相关专业技术和科学研究工作打下必要的基础。
default.en: Based on the research of "Energy Internet" proposed by the famous American scholar Rifkin in his book 《The Third Industrial Revolution》, and against the background of the in-depth combination of new energy technology and information technology, this course systematically introduces the generation background, basic concepts, research status and development trend of the energy Internet. It describes in detail the key technologies such as the energy Internet infrastructure and technical architecture, energy management and fault management technology, communication and information security technology, demand response and collaborative control technology of power supply, power grid, power load and energy storage. And it discusses the application of new technologies such as cloud computing, bigdata, mobile Internet, artificial intelligence in the energy Internet. This course aims to enable students to master the basic principles, core technologies, industrial status and development context of energy Internet. And it lays a necessary foundation for students to engage in professional technology and scientific research related to energy Internet and smart energy construction after graduation.

default.zh: 《现代电站工程》是能源互联网工程专业方向的主要课程，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握新型电力系统的电气主接线形式及主要的电气设备工作原理，具备走向能源互联网行业工作的基础知识，在培养学生现代电站综合分析及设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要讲授新型电力系统电气主系统设计与电站运行的理论和计算方法，使学生了解电气主接线的基本形式、设计原则，掌握主要电气设备的原理和性能，并了解新能源电站设计与电站现代技术应用。通过本课程的课堂教学以及后面的课程设计，培养学生应用所学习的理论解决实际问题的能力，提高学生综合分析及设计的能力，重视学生自学能力与创新能力的培养，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程目标包括：了解和掌握电气主接线的基本形式及其特点，具备电气主接线设计的知识基础，了解电气主接线设计的基本原则及行业标准；了解和掌握现代电站中主要设备的工作原理、运行特性和运行限制条件，具备在工程实践中合理选择设备及对其运行进行控制的能力。
default.en: Modern Power Plant Engineering is a major course in the Energy Internet Engineering program. Through this course, students will master the electrical main connection forms of new-type power systems and the operating principles of major electrical equipment, acquire the basic knowledge required for entering the Energy Internet industry, and the course plays an important role in cultivating students’ comprehensive analysis and design ability of modern power plants. The course mainly teaches the theories and computational methods of electrical main system design and power plant operation in new-type power systems, enabling students to understand the basic forms and design principles of electrical main connections, master the principles and performance of major electrical equipment, and learn about renewable energy power plant design and the application of modern technologies in power stations. Through classroom teaching and subsequent course design, students will be trained to apply the learned theories to solve practical problems, improve their comprehensive analysis and design ability, and enhance their self-learning and innovation capabilities, thereby supporting the achievement of the corresponding program learning outcomes. The course objectives include: understanding and mastering the basic forms and characteristics of electrical main connections, acquiring the fundamental knowledge for main connection design, and understanding the basic principles and industry standards of such design; understanding and mastering the working principles, operating characteristics, and operational constraints of major equipment in modern power plants, and developing the ability to reasonably select equipment and control its operation in engineering practice.

default.zh: 这门课是能源互联网专业选修课。主要介绍综合能源系统仿真的现状、发展方向及其仿真的基本概念、原理与方法。课程涵盖了综合能源系统仿真建模、全数字仿真原理与方法、实时半实物仿真、采样控制系统仿真及专业仿真软件在综合能源系统仿真中的应用等内容。 综合能源系统全数字仿真原理和方法包括简单替换法、双线性替换法、根匹配法、离散相似法以及基于离散相似法建立的欧拉法、梯形法和多步Adams法和基于Taylor级数匹配原理建立的Runge-Kutta方法。分析了仿真方法误差产生的原因、仿真方法的精度、仿真方法的稳定性及仿真方法的变步长原理。介绍了综合能源系统实时半实物仿真的概念、仿真系统的运行方式、仿真模型的特点及常用的仿真方法。介绍了含有数字控制器的综合能源系统仿真方法，并给出了采样周期改变时数字控制器的重构方法。介绍了专业仿真软件的仿真环境、编程语言与编程方法及其在综合能源系统仿真中的应用，并给出了简单综合能源系统的仿真实验。
default.en: Dynamic Simulation of Integrated Energy System is a elective course for electrical engineering and automation. This course mainly introduces the status, development direction of Integrated Energy System simulation and basic concepts, principles and methods of simulation. The course covers Integrated Energy System modeling, Principle and methods for full digital simulation, Real-Time Semi-Physical simulation, Simulation of sampled-data system, Application of Professional simulation software in Integrated Energy System Simulation etc.. The principle and method of full-digital simulation of Integrated Energy System include Simple alternative method, Bilinear substitution method, Root matching method, the numerical value simulation method and the Euler method , the betterment Euler method and Adams method based on it, Runge-Kutta method based on Taylor Series matching principle. The reason of the error of the simulation method, the precision of and the stability of the simulation method, the variable step principle of the simulation method are analyzed. We will dicuss the concept of real-time hardware-in-the-loop simulation, the operation mode of simulation system, the characteristics of simulation model and the commonly used simulation method in Integrated Energy System simulation. The simulation method of Integrated Energy System with digital controller and the reconstruction method of the digital controller when the sampling period is changed are introduced in the course. The simulation environment of Professional simulation software, programming language , programming method and its application in Integrated Energy System simulation are introduced. Simulation experiments of simple Integrated Energy System are given in the end.

default.zh: 以电、热、气为代表的多种能源网络紧密耦合，形成了多能优化互补的综合能源系统，提高了综合用能效率，成为国内外研究的热点与前沿。综合能源系统的规划和运行是以各个能源网络的建模和分析为基础的。 本课程理论部分主要讲授综合能源系统的能流计算，包含三部分的内容：（1）综合能源系统结构（2）构建综合能源系统的电力网模型，讲述电力网的潮流计算原理（3）构建综合能源系统的水力模型-热力模型，讲述热网络的稳态计算原理（4）构建热力网，天然气网和电力网的联合求解模型，并给出相关模型的求解算法
default.en: The tight coupling of multiple energy networks represented by electricity, heat, and gas has formed a comprehensive energy system that optimizes and complements multiple energy sources, improving overall energy efficiency and becoming a hot and cutting-edge research topic both domestically and internationally. The planning and operation of integrated energy systems are based on the modeling and analysis of various energy networks. The theoretical part of this course mainly teaches the energy flow calculation of integrated energy systems, which includes three parts: (1) the structure of integrated energy systems; (2) constructing a power grid model of integrated energy systems, explaining the principles of power flow calculation in power grids; (3) constructing a hydraulic thermal model of integrated energy systems, explaining the steady-state calculation principles of thermal networks; (4) constructing a joint solution model for thermal networks, natural gas networks, and power grids, and providing the solution algorithms for relevant models.

default.zh: AI驱动的电机系统分析：从算法到工程实践是电气工程及自动化学院开设的一门选修课，通过将电机系统与当今热门AI算法相结合，培养学生对于电气和人工智能相关知识的综合应用能力，与前置课程形成鲜明的关联和融合，使学生在学习过程中将电机这类拥有百余年历史的专业与新兴产业进行融合，有助于实现知识的创新性发展。 本课程主要讲授人工智能发展史和核心算法、当下热门人工智能软件及其产生的科技成果、人工智能在各领域的应用介绍；电机故障诊断发展现状、故障类型、特征提取、类型辨识以及与人工智能的融合情况介绍等，从人工智能算法逻辑、电机故障机理等方面，分析人工智能与电机故障诊断的共通性与可移植性，并通过上机实验，让学生在实际操作中充分利用人工智能的大数据分析优势，实现电机故障的特征判断。使学生对于基于AI算法的电机系统分析有一个系统性的认知和更深层次的理解，加强自身的数据分析和处理能力，从而支撑学习生涯中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: AI-Driven Motor System Analysis: From Algorithms to Engineering Practice is an elective course offered by the School of Electrical Engineering and Automation. It aims to cultivate students' ability to comprehensively apply knowledge related to electricity and artificial intelligence by integrating motor systems with AI algorithms which are popularly used now. This course creates a strong connection and integration with prerequisite courses, allows students to merge a discipline with over a century of history with emerging industries during their learning process, and promotes the innovative development of knowledge. This course mainly covers the history of artificial intelligence development and core algorithms, popular AI software and its technological achievements, and the introduction of AI applications across various fields; the current status of motor fault diagnosis development, types of faults, feature extraction, type identification, and the integration with artificial intelligence. It analyzes the commonality and portability of artificial intelligence and motor fault diagnosis from aspects such as the logic of AI algorithms and the mechanisms of motor faults. Through hands-on experiments, students leverage the advantages of big data analysis in artificial intelligence to determine characteristics of motor faults. Besides, this course enables students to have a systematic understanding and deeper insight into analysis of motor systems based on AI algorithms, strengthens their data analysis and processing capabilities, and thus supports the achievement of relevant indicators in their learning career.

default.zh: 电气智能测试技术与人工智能应用基础是电气工程及其自动化专业的一门通用专业课，该课程以电气测试技术为基础，介绍人工智能基础知识，讲解人工智能（AI）电气领域最新应用实践案例，结合国际知名行业头部企业（厦门宏发电声股份有限公司）生产前沿应用为案例。课程支撑电气工程及其自动化专业毕业要求，是学生将其所学的基础理论知识结合AI应用的重要一环，在培养电气专业的学生在工程问题分析、综合设计、数智时代AI应用能力方面具有重要地位。 课程内容主要包括：电气测试技术基础、人工智能应用、实践教学、课程实验四个部分。 电气测试技术部分主要讲授：典型常用传感器的工作原理、基本结构、测量电路和各种应用，熟悉非电量测量的基本知识，掌握电气被测参数的检测方法与电气检测系统的设计基本步骤，了解电气测试技术的发展趋势。 人工智能（AI）应用部分主要结合实例讲授：人工智能基本概念、AI核心算法-云计算与边缘计算基础、AI智能检测技术（基于神经网络的电磁超声无损探伤应用实例）、算力相关基础知识（基于大数据模型的AI本地部署专家系统应用实例）、多模态融合学习模型（电网相关国际标准多模态辅助应用实例）、人工智能在电气领域的前沿发展动态、AI风险及工程伦理。 智能测试实践与校外专家结合企业产线讲授（信号继电器智能生产线架构及智能测试技术）。 课程实验部分讲授：电器检测自动化核心算法编程及硬件实践（产线机械臂智能驱动核心硬件实现）、电机可靠性分析（威布尔分布可靠性预计AI辅助软件编程）等内容。 本课程培养学生运用前修课及本课程的知识，逐步掌握根据以电气领域测试的基础知识、测试技术，运用典型的系统自动检测装置进行测试，运用AI相关基础知识进行电气领域实践的知识与应用基础。本课程将为学生的毕业设计和毕业后从事电气工程及其自动化等方面的测试工作及AI应用打下良好的基础，提升创新驱动意识。
default.en: The Fundamentals of Electrical Intelligence Testing Technology and Artificial Intelligence Applications （22EE32073）is a general professional course in Electrical Engineering and Automation. This course is based on electrical testing technology, introduces basic knowledge of artificial intelligence, explains the latest practical cases of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in the electrical field, and combines the cutting-edge production applications of internationally renowned industry leader (Xiamen Hongfa Acoustics Co., Ltd.) as a case study. The curriculum supports the graduation requirements of the Electrical Engineering and Automation major, which is an important part of students' ability to combine their basic theoretical knowledge with AI applications. It plays an important role in cultivating electrical students' abilities in engineering problem analysis, comprehensive design, and AI application in the digital age. The course content mainly includes four parts: Fundamentals of Electrical Testing Technology, Application of Artificial Intelligence, Practical Teaching, and Course Experiments. The electrical testing technology section mainly teaches the working principle, basic structure, measurement circuit, and various applications of typical commonly used sensors, familiarizes oneself with the basic knowledge of non electric quantity measurement, masters the detection methods of electrical measured parameters and the basic steps of electrical detection system design, and understands the development trend of electrical testing technology. The application part of artificial intelligence (AI) is mainly taught with examples: basic concepts of AI, AI core algorithms cloud computing and edge computing foundation, AI intelligent detection technology (application examples of electromagnetic ultrasonic nondestructive testing based on neural network), basic knowledge related to computing power (application examples of AI local deployment expert system based on big data model), multi-mode fusion learning model (application examples of multi-mode auxiliary application of power grid related international standards), cutting-edge development trends of AI in the electrical field, AI risk and engineering ethics. Intelligent testing practice combined with external experts for enterprise production line teaching (signal relay intelligent production line architecture and intelligent testing technology). The experimental part of the course teaches: programming and hardware practice of core algorithms for electrical detection automation (implementation of intelligent drive core hardware for production line robotic arms), motor reliability analysis (Weibull distribution reliability prediction AI assisted software programming), and other content. This course cultivates students to apply the knowledge from previous courses and this course, gradually mastering the basic knowledge and testing techniques based on electrical field testing, using typical system automatic detection devices for testing, and applying AI related basic knowledge for practical knowledge and application in the electrical field. This course will lay a solid foundation for students' graduation projects, as well as their testing work and AI applications in electrical engineering and automation after graduation, and enhance their innovation driven awareness.

default.zh: 随着AI大模型的兴起，分布式发电与AI大模型的结合越来越提到了日程，也是可再生能源利用和发展的重要途径之一。分布式发电安装容量的持续攀升，在配电网中渗透率也逐渐提高，其与AI大模型的结合必然会对传统电力系统形成不可小觑的力量。微电网的提出旨在实现分布式电源的灵活、高效应用，解决数量庞大、形式多样的分布式电源并网问题，其中有大量的海洋数据可以挖掘。本课程通过介绍由光伏发电、风力发电等构成的分布式发电系统的组成结构、电力电子装置、电能变换和运行控制技术，使学生了解微网的组成、分布式发电系统中的电力变换器拓扑；熟悉微电网的构成、运行；再通过其与AI大模型的结合，了解AI及微电网技术对构建新型电力系统的安全支撑作用。本课程是电力电子、计算机、电机及电力系统等技术的综合应用。
default.en: With the rise of AI big model, the combination of distributed generation and AI big model is more and more on the agenda, and it is also one of the important ways of renewable energy utilization and development. The continuous climb of installed capacity of distributed power generation and the gradual increase of penetration rate in the distribution network, and its combination with AI big model will inevitably form a force that cannot be underestimated on the traditional power system. The proposal of microgrid aims at realizing the flexible and efficient application of distributed power and solving the problem of grid-connection of a huge number of distributed power sources in various forms, in which there is a large amount of ocean data that can be mined. This course introduces the composition structure of distributed power generation system composed of photovoltaic power generation, wind power generation, etc., power electronic devices, power conversion and operation and control technology, so that students can understand the composition of microgrid, power converter topology in distributed power generation system; familiarize with the composition and operation of microgrid; and then, through the combination of its and AI big model, understand the security of AI and microgrid technology to build a new type of power system Supporting role. This course is a comprehensive application of power electronics, computer, electrical machinery and power system technologies.

default.zh: 电路与电子技术 B是生物工程专业核心领域基础课程，是支撑专业学习与交叉创新的重要基石。本课程是后续学习生物医学信号处理、医学电子学、生物传感器、脑机接口、智能医学工程及人工智能等课程的必备基础，对于培养生物工程专业学生工程科学思维、电路电子理论应用能力、生物医学工程问题分析与解决能力具有至关重要的作用，为开展生命健康、智能诊疗、脑机融合等前沿研究与技术创新奠定坚实工程基础。 课程主要围绕直流电路、交流电路、暂态电路、模拟电路和数字电路展开讲解，通过课堂教学、线上MOOC学习及课后作业实践，着重讲授电路和电子技术的基本概念、基本原理及基本分析方法，同时培养学生利用数学手段和现代化工具进行电路电子的综合分析与设计能力，为学生后续的课程学习、创新实践及从事科学研究工作打下扎实的理论基础。
default.en: Circuit and Electronic Technology B is a core fundamental course for Bioengineering majors and an essential cornerstone for professional cultivation and interdisciplinary innovation. As a prerequisite course for Biomedical Signal Processing, Medical Electronics, Biosensors, Brain-Computer Interface, Intelligent Medical Engineering and Artificial Intelligence, it is instrumental in fostering students' engineering thinking, theoretical application capabilities of circuits and electronics, as well as the ability to analyze and solve biomedical engineering problems. This course consolidates a sound engineering foundation for advanced research and technological innovation in life health, intelligent diagnosis and treatment, and brain-computer integration. This course covers DC circuits, AC circuits, transient circuits, analog circuits and digital circuits. Combining classroom teaching, online MOOC resources and after-class practical assignments, it systematically elaborates on the basic concepts, principles and analytical methods of circuits and electronic technologies. Furthermore, it cultivates students' competencies in comprehensive circuit analysis and design by adopting mathematical approaches and modern engineering tools, laying a solid theoretical foundation for their further study, innovative practice and scientific research.

default.zh: 电路与电子技术实验B是培养学生电路与电子技术理论联系实际的实践性环节，为学生提供了一个培养动手能力、综合设计能力和创新能力的实践平台。本课程主要讲授常见电工电子仪器仪表的使用方法、电路实验、模拟电子技术实验和数字电子技术实验，包含硬件实验、仿真实验、基础实验和综合设计型实验。 通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、实验操作等环节，使学生掌握常用电工电子仪器仪表的使用方法和常用电路的调试测量方法，加深理解基础电路的工作原理，提高学生的分析设计能力，培养学生查阅电子器件手册并选用合适的元器件的能力，培养学生根据技术要求，设计、调试电路和分析、排查故障的能力。
default.en: Experiment of Circuit and Electronic Technology B is a practical component designed to cultivate students' ability to connect theory with practice in circuit and electronic technology, providing a hands-on platform for developing practical skills, comprehensive design capabilities, and innovation. This course primarily covers the usage of common electrical and electronic instruments, circuit experiments, analog electronic technology experiments, and digital electronic technology experiments, encompassing hardware experiments, simulation experiments, basic experiments, and comprehensive design-based experiments.

default.zh: 电路与电子技术（1）是电类相关专业（如电气工程、自动化、电子信息工程、通信工程、计算机科学与技术、人工智能、微电子科学与技术等）非常重要的、必修的一门领域基础课程，是学习后续电力电子技术、自动控制理论、信号与系统及人工智能等课程的基础，对于培养学生的科学思维能力、综合运用电路及电子技术理论分析和解决实际问题的能力起到非常重要的作用。 课程主要围绕直流电路、交流电路、暂态电路、放大电路展开讲解，通过课堂教学、线上MOOC学习及课后作业实践，着重讲授电路和电子技术的基本概念、基本原理及基本分析方法，同时培养学生利用数学手段和现代化工具进行电路电子的综合分析与设计能力，为学生后续的课程学习、创新实践及从事科学研究工作打下扎实的理论基础。
default.en: Circuit and Electronic Technology (1) is an extremely important foundational course for majors such as Electrical Engineering, Automation, Electronic and Information Engineering, Communication Engineering, Computer Science and Technology, Artificial Intelligence, and Microelectronics Science and Technology. It serves as the cornerstone for subsequent courses like Power Electronics Technology, Automatic Control Theory, Signals and Systems, and Artificial Intelligence. This course plays a pivotal role in fostering students' scientific thinking abilities and their capacity to comprehensively apply circuit and electronic technology theories to analyze and resolve practical issues. The course primarily revolves around the explanation of direct-current circuits, alternating-current circuits, transient circuits, and amplifier circuits. Through classroom instruction, online MOOC learning, and post-class assignment practices, it places emphasis on teaching the fundamental concepts, principles, and analytical methods of circuits and electronics. Simultaneously, it cultivates students' abilities to conduct comprehensive analysis and design of circuits and electronics using mathematical tools and modern techniques, thereby laying a solid theoretical foundation for their subsequent coursework, innovative practices, and engagement in scientific research.

default.zh: 电路与电子（1）是电类相关专业（如电气工程、自动化、电子信息工程、通信工程、计算机科学与技术、人工智能、微电子科学与技术等）非常重要的、必修的一门领域基础课程，是学习后续电力电子技术、自动控制理论、信号与系统及人工智能等课程的基础，对于培养学生的科学思维能力、综合运用电路及电子技术理论分析和解决实际问题的能力起到非常重要的作用。 课程主要围绕直流电路、交流电路、暂态电路、放大电路展开讲解，通过课堂教学、线上MOOC学习及课后作业实践，着重讲授电路和电子技术的基本概念、基本原理及基本分析方法，同时培养学生利用数学手段和现代化工具进行电路电子的综合分析与设计能力，为学生后续的课程学习、创新实践及从事科学研究工作打下扎实的理论基础。
default.en: Circuit and Electronic Technology (1) is a fundamental and compulsory course for majors related to electrical engineering (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Automation, Electronic Information Engineering, Communication Engineering, Computer Science and Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Microelectronics Science and Technology, etc.). It serves as a foundation for subsequent courses such as Power Electronics, Automatic Control Theory, Signals and Systems, and Artificial Intelligence. This course plays a vital role in cultivating students' scientific thinking ability and their capacity to comprehensively apply circuit and electronic technology theories to analyze and solve practical problems. The course focuses on DC circuits, AC circuits, transient circuits, and amplifier circuits. Through classroom instruction, online MOOC learning, and assignments, it emphasizes the basic concepts, fundamental principles, and basic analysis methods of circuits and electronic technology. Simultaneously, it cultivates students' ability to comprehensively analyze and design circuits and electronics using mathematical tools and modern instruments, thereby laying a solid theoretical foundation for their subsequent studies, innovative practice, and scientific research.

default.zh: 电路与电子技术（2）是电类相关专业（如电气工程、自动化、电子信息工程、通信工程、计算机科学与技术、人工智能、微电子科学与技术等）非常重要的、必修的一门领域基础课程，是学习后续电力电子技术、自动控制理论、信号与系统及人工智能等课程的基础，对于培养学生的科学思维能力、综合运用电路及电子技术理论分析和解决实际问题的能力起到非常重要的作用。 课程主要围绕半导体器件、基本放大电路、场效应管、滤波电路、直流电源、组合逻辑电路、时序逻辑电路、数模和模数转换电路展开讲解，通过课堂教学、线上MOOC学习及课后作业实践，使学生了解电子技术的发展和新知识、新器件、新技术等应用概况，着重培养学生具备一定的模拟与数字电子电路的综合分析能力、综合设计能力及计算机仿真技能，加强理论联系实际、提高实践与创新意识，激发学生科技报国的家国情怀和使命担当，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Circuit and Electronic Technology (2) is an extremely important foundational course for majors such as Electrical Engineering, Automation, Electronic and Information Engineering, Communication Engineering, Computer Science and Technology, Artificial Intelligence, and Microelectronics Science and Technology. It serves as the cornerstone for subsequent courses like Power Electronics Technology, Automatic Control Theory, Signals and Systems, and Artificial Intelligence. This course plays a pivotal role in fostering students' scientific thinking abilities and their capacity to comprehensively apply circuit and electronic technology theories to analyze and resolve practical issues. The course primarily focuses on explaining semiconductor devices, basic amplifier circuits, field-effect transistors, filter circuits, DC power supplies, combinational logic circuits, sequential logic circuits, as well as digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital conversion circuits. Through classroom instruction, online MOOC learning, and post-class assignment practices, it enables students to gain an understanding of the development trends in electronic technology and the application overview of new knowledge, devices, and technologies. The course places particular emphasis on cultivating students' comprehensive analytical and design capabilities in both analog and digital electronic circuits, as well as their computer simulation skills. It strengthens the connection between theory and practice, enhances students' awareness of practical application and innovation, and inspires their patriotism and sense of mission to contribute to the nation through technological advancements, thereby supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in their professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 新时代对大学生的知识结构和能力提出了新的要求，对学生的培养已经从知识传授向身心全面发展转变，从应试教育向素质教育转变，从强调知识积累向注重创新能力培养转变。本课程主要聚焦智能电气、智慧能源的发展背景与体系架构，使学生了解电气工程学科的发展历程和未来发展趋势，掌握智能电气、智慧能源、大科学装置与电气科学技术、电器可靠性前沿等关键技术；了解物联网、大数据、人工智能、数字孪生等在智能电气、智慧能源中的应用。培养学生的系统思维、创新意识与数据驱动决策的思维习惯，跟踪行业前沿动态，理解我国在智能电网与智慧能源领域的发展优势与战略意义。
default.en: The new era has set new requirements for the knowledge structure and abilities of college students. The cultivation of students has shifted from knowledge imparting to all-round development of physical and mental abilities, from exam-oriented education to quality-oriented education, and from emphasizing knowledge accumulation to focusing on the cultivation of innovation capabilities. This course mainly focuses on the development background and system architecture of intelligent electrical engineering and smart energy, enabling students to understand the development history and future trends of the electrical engineering discipline, master key technologies such as intelligent electrical engineering, smart energy, large scientific facilities and electrical science and technology, and electrical equipment reliability; understand the application of Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence, and digital twin in intelligent electrical engineering and smart energy. It aims to cultivate students' systematic thinking, innovative consciousness, and data-driven decision-making thinking habits, keep track of industry frontiers, and understand China's development advantages and strategic significance in the fields of smart grids and smart energy.

default.zh: 《专业综合实践I》是在《电子技术实验》的基础上进行的综合性的实践训练，是电气工程及其自动化专业、建筑电气与智能化专业本科生的必修课。本课程的实验内容侧重综合应用所学知识，设计制作较为复杂的功能电路或小型电子系统。一般是给出实验任务和设计要求，学生通过阅读资料、选择方案、设计电路、编程、电路安装调试和指标测试、撰写报告等过程，培养学生电路设计与综合应用能力，提高电路设计水平和实验技能。
default.en: This course is a comprehensive experimental training based on electronic technology experiments. The students from specialties of electrical engineering and automation, building electrical and intelligent are required to learn this course. The content of this course focuses on the integrated application of knowledge, designing and producing more complex circuit or small electronic system. The experimental tasks and requirements are generally given. Through the process of reading references, selecting schemes, designing circuits, programming, testing circuits, writing reports, this course cultivates the ability of circuit design and comprehensive application of students, improves the design level and experimental skills.

default.zh: 专业课程设计本课程为电类专业学生重要的实践性课程。学生在掌握了相关专业的基础知识和理论后，培养学生利用所掌握的理论和知识解决实际工程设计问题的能力和创新能力，解决理论联系实际的问题，达到学以致用的目的。 本课程根据专业方向分为五个主要模块，分别是（1）电机专业模块（2）电力系统专业模块（3）工业自动化专业模块（4）电器专业模块（5）电能变换模块。通过本课程的教学与实验操作，培养学生对相关专业中较为复杂系统的分析与设计能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: This course is an important practical course for students majoring in electrical engineering. After mastering the basic knowledge and theories of relevant majors, students are trained to have the ability to use the theories and knowledge to solve practical engineering design problems, solve the problem of integrating theory with practice, and achieve the goal of applying what they have learned. This course is divided into five main modules based on professional direction, namely (1) Motor module, (2) Power system module, (3) Industrial automation module, (4) Electrical appliance module, and (5) Electric energy conversion module. Through the teaching and experimental operations of this course, the students are trained to have the ability to analyze and design complex systems in related majors, increase their innovation awareness, and support the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 生产实习是工科院校为培养高素质工程技术人才安排的一个重要实践性教学环节，是将学校教学与生产实际相结合，理论与实践相联系的重要途径。其目的是使学生通过实习在专业知识和人才素质两方面得到锻炼和培养，从而为毕业后走向工作岗位尽快成为业务骨干打下良好基础。 生产实习主要应当使学生了解和掌握专业方向中的主要产品的生产技术和工艺过程；使用的主要工装设备，产品的生产组织管理等内容，使学生能够把学习过的书本知识和实际产品结合起来，为学好专业课积累必要的感性知识。学生结合各专业方向的特点，利用校内生产实习基地的条件和设备，独立或者合作完成具备相关专业方向特点的生产实习活动，提高学生的实际动手能力。通过参观一些与专业相关的，有代表性的工厂、研究所及自动化程度较高的生产设备，了解工厂组织系统及生产管理方面的情况，使学生开阔眼界，拓宽知识面，为今后从事电气工程领域相关工作打下有力基础。
default.en: Production practice is an important practical teaching task for engineering colleges to train high-quality engineering technicians, by combining theoretic teaching and production practices. It aims to culture students in both professional knowledge and personal quality, so as to blend into the workplace as soon as possible after graduation. Production practice helps students to understand and master the main direction of the main products of the production technology and process, the use of the main equipment, the production of product management and other content, which make them associate their knowledge and practical products, and accumulate necessary perceptual knowledge for future studies of subject courses. Combing with the characteristics of the professional direction and using of the production practice base conditions and equipment, students need to complete the production practice independently or in cooperation, which may improve their practical ability a lot. Additionally, through the technical visits for representative factories and research institutes, it make students to learn more details about factory organization and production management, and further enable them to broaden their horizon and knowledge and to lay a strong foundation for their future business in the electrical engineering field.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本科生综合能力培养与技能训练的一个重要教学环节。学生完整地经历文献资料查阅、文献综述、方案设计、详细设计计算、理论分析、仿真分析、实验与数据处理、毕业论文撰写等各个方面的综合训练，使学生能够运用所学基础理论、专业知识和基本技能解决复杂工程问题。培养学生的工程实践能力、创新精神、创业意识和创新创业能力。 毕业论文(设计)主要安排在第四学年春季学期进行，为期至少16周。需要通过开题检查、中期检查、毕业答辩等各个环节的过程管理，每个环节都要经历答辩且答辩以公开方式进行。另外，毕业论文（设计）的工作量、论文及图纸必须满足《哈尔滨工业大学本科毕业论文（设计）写作指南（理工类）》、《哈尔滨工业大学本科毕业论文（设计）书写规范（理工类）》的要求。
default.en: The graduation thesis (design) is an important teaching link in the cultivation of comprehensive ability and skill training of undergraduates. Students have undergone comprehensive training in literature review, literature review, scheme design, detailed design calculation, theoretical analysis, simulation analysis, experiment and data processing, graduation thesis writing and other aspects, so that students can apply the basic theory, professional knowledge and basic skills to solve complex engineering problems. Cultivate students' engineering practice ability, innovative spirit, entrepreneurial consciousness and innovative entrepreneurial ability. The graduation thesis (design) is mainly scheduled for the spring semester of the fourth academic year and lasts at least 16 weeks. It is necessary to pass the process management of each link such as proposal examination, mid-term examination and graduation defense, and each link should undergo defense and defense should be conducted in an open way. In addition, the workload of graduation thesis (design), papers and drawings must meet the requirements of "Harbin Institute of Technology Undergraduate Thesis (Design) Writing Guide (Science and Technology)" and "Harbin Institute of Technology Undergraduate Thesis (Design) Writing standards (Science and technology)".

default.zh: 《电子设计创新实践》是在《电子技术实验》的基础上进行的综合性的实践训练，是电气工程及其自动化专业、建筑电气与智能化专业本科生的必修课。本课程的实验内容侧重综合应用所学知识，设计制作较为复杂的功能电路或小型电子系统。一般是给出实验任务和设计要求，学生通过阅读资料、选择方案、设计电路、编程、电路安装调试和指标测试、撰写报告等过程，培养学生电路设计与综合应用能力，提高电路设计水平和实验技能。
default.en: This course is a comprehensive experimental training based on electronic technology experiments. The students from specialties of electrical engineering and automation, building electrical and intelligent are required to learn this course. The content of this course focuses on the integrated application of knowledge, designing and producing more complex circuit or small electronic system. The experimental tasks and requirements are generally given. Through the process of reading references, selecting schemes, designing circuits, programming, testing circuits, writing reports, this course cultivates the ability of circuit design and comprehensive application of students, improves the design level and experimental skills.

default.zh: 专业课程设计本课程为应用物理专业学生重要的实践性课程。学生在掌握了相关专业的基础知识和理论后，培养学生利用所掌握的理论和知识解决实际工程设计问题的能力和创新能力，解决理论联系实际的问题，达到学以致用的目的。 本课程根据专业方向分为五个主要模块，分别是（1）电机专业模块（2）电力系统专业模块（3）工业自动化专业模块（4）电器专业模块（5）电能变换模块。通过本课程的教学与实验操作，培养学生对相关专业中较为复杂系统的分析与设计能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: This course is an important practical course for students majoring in applied physics. After mastering the basic knowledge and theories of relevant majors, students are trained to have the ability to use the theories and knowledge to solve practical engineering design problems, solve the problem of integrating theory with practice, and achieve the goal of applying what they have learned. This course is divided into five main modules based on professional direction, namely (1) Motor module, (2) Power system module, (3) Industrial automation module, (4) Electrical appliance module, and (5) Electric energy conversion module. Through the teaching and experimental operations of this course, the students are trained to have the ability to analyze and design complex systems in related majors, increase their innovation awareness, and support the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: “电子设计综合实践”是在电子技术实验的基础上进行的综合性的实践训练，是电气工程本科生的必修课。本课程侧重综合应用所学知识，设计制作较为复杂的小型电子系统。一般是给出实验任务和要求，学生通过阅读资料、选择方案、设计电路、编程、电路安装调试和指标测试、撰写报告等过程，培养学生综合运用所学知识解决实际问题的能力、团队分工协作能力和创新研究能力，提高电路设计水平和实验技能。
default.en: This course is a comprehensive experimental training based on electronic technology experiments. The students from specialties of electrical engineering and automation, building electrical and intelligent are required to learn this course. The content of this course focuses on the integrated application of knowledge, designing and producing more complex circuit or small electronic system. The experimental tasks and requirements are generally given. Through the process of reading references, selecting schemes, designing circuits, programming, testing circuits, writing reports, this course cultivates the ability of circuit design and comprehensive application of students, improves the design level and experimental skills.

default.zh: 这门课是能源互联网专业选修课，是连接能源互联网理论知识与工程应用的核心纽带，通过本课的学习，使学生能够熟练运用专业工具解决能源互联网领域的工程技术问题，具备参与新型电力系统规划设计、系统运行维护的核心素养，具备走向能源互联网行业工作的基础知识，在培养学生能源互联网系统综合分析及设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程使学生掌握新型电力系统一次组成；各种新能源电厂一次系统运行参数、运行方式及对设计保护的要求；分析各种电厂类型、设计规模、在系统中地位、附近电力系统电压等级、自然条件及负荷资料等，进行逐年电力电量平衡分析；并进行复杂电力系统运行方式设计及实验。通过本课程的设计和实验，培养学生应用所学习的理论解决实际问题能力，提高学生综合分析及设计的能力，重视学生自学能力与创新能力的培养，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Professional practice of Energy Internet is a elective course for the Energy Internet major, serving as a core link between theoretical knowledge of the Energy Internet and engineering applications. Through studying this course, students will be able to use professional tools to solve engineering and technical problems in the field of Energy Internet, possess literacy for participating in the planning and design of new type power systems, system operation and maintenance, and acquire basic knowledge for working in the Energy Internet industry. It plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design abilities in the Energy Internet system. This course enables students to master the primary composition of new type power systems; the operating parameters and modes of various primary systems in new energy power plants; and the requirements for design protection. It analyzes various types of power plants, design scales, positions in the system, voltage levels of nearby power systems, natural conditions, and load data, and conducts annual power and energy balance analysis. It also involves the design and experiment of complex power system operation mode. Through the design and experimentation of this course, students are trained to apply the theories they have learned to solve practical problems, improve their comprehensive analysis and design abilities, and emphasize the cultivation of students' self-learning and innovation abilities, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 计算机组成原理与嵌入式系统课程是电子信息类专业本科生的计算机类基础课。主要讲计算机组成原理和嵌入式单片机原理与应用。该课程实践性很强，强调理论联系实际，注重培养学生分析、解决实际问题的能力和工程实践能力。课程主要内容：讲授计算机组成原理原理，包括微型计算机结构和工作原理、存储器、总线、输入输出及控制、微机的中断系统等。本课程主要以微型计算机为主讲授微机系统设计中涉及的存储器、总线技术、中断和输入输出控制等基本知识。该课程是电子线路基础与计算机系统、嵌入式系统、微控制器等硬件系统应用与实现之间的纽带，主要教学目标是帮助学生建立计算机组成、微控制器以及嵌入式系统的基本概念，使学生掌握计算机与嵌入式系统的组成结构及各组成部分工作原理，进一步掌握软硬件实现技术，最终掌握计算机及嵌入式系统实践应用的基本技能和设计方法。本课程的目的是培养学生了解并掌握嵌入式系统和微型计算机所涉及到的关键技术以及系统内部功能与设计的能力，通过对微控制器等嵌入式系统和微型计算机的基本原理、硬件结构和应用学习，使学生较深入地了解计算机组成原理、微机和微控制器硬件结构的基本原理以及应用系统的基本设计方法和应用技能。培养学生们建立计算机组成的硬件系统的综合分析与设计能力，以及计算机类科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，为培养学生解决复杂工程问题的能力奠定基础。通过本课程的教学实践，使学生建立计算机系统的整体概念，掌握计算机与嵌入式系统器各组成部分的基本理论知识、基本技能及实现技术，具备硬件接口设计与软件开发能力，掌握分析和解决实际嵌入式系统系统设计和计算机系统设计中的相关技术问题和工程问题的能力，培养学生的创新思维以及工程意识、工程实践能力。为学生后续学习硬件相关技术及本学科专业知识打下良好的基础，同时为学生在未来工作中适应电子信息领域的电子技术发展奠定基础。
default.en: Principle of Computer Organization and Embedded System are elementary technical courses on electronic technology for majors of electronic information, computers technology, electrical engineering, and automation.. It is a practical course, and it emphasizes theory aligning with practice and develops students’ abilities in analyzing, solving the problems and engineering practice. Main contents of the course include the introduction of microcomputers. mainly includes hardware structure and the working principle of microcomputers, memorizer, bus, I/O interface, interrupt system of Microcomputers, etc. The main content is the principle and applications of Microcomputers, architectures of microcomputers，application which are related to memorizer, bus, interrupt system, I/O interface of Microcomputers. This course is the link between the foundation of electronic circuits and the application and implementation of hardware systems such as computer systems, embedded systems, and microcontrollers. The main teaching objective is to help students establish the basic concepts of computer composition, and embedded systems, so that they can master the composition structure and working principles of computers and embedded systems, and further master software and hardware implementation techniques, Finally, master the basic skills and design methods for practical applications of computers and embedded systems. The purpose of this course is to cultivate students' ability to understand and master the key technologies involved in embedded systems and microcomputers, as well as the internal functions and designs of the system. By studying the basic principles, hardware structures, and applications of embedded systems and microcomputers such as microcontrollers, students can gain a deeper understanding of the principles of computer composition The basic principles of the hardware structure of microcomputers and microcontrollers, as well as the basic design methods and application skills of application systems. Cultivate students' ability to comprehensively analyze and design hardware systems composed of computers, as well as their ability to apply computer science knowledge, increase their innovation awareness, and lay the foundation for cultivating students' ability to solve complex engineering problems. Through the teaching practice, it can train the student’s ability to apply the knowledge of the microcomputer in practice. By taking this course, students can establish an overall conception of computer system, and acquire the basic theoretical knowledge and skills on microcomputers and microcontrollers, to improve basic skills of microcomputer/microcontroller development both in software and hardware. It make students develop the creative thinking and engineering consciousness and abilities, and to master the abilities of analyzing and solving technical and engineering problems related to microcomputers and microcontrollers in practical electronic system design in order to lay a good foundation for the future in-depth study in the application of hardware electronic technology and the expertise of the discipline. In order to fit the development of electronic technology in the field of electronic information, this course is helpful for the elementary knowledge for future works.

default.zh: 本课程名为“基于项目学习与科技创新”，是针对计算机与电子通信各专业开设的课程，主要介绍在基于项目学习和科技创新活动中所面临的常见问题及其解决方法。课程教学目标是通过项目“做中学（Learn by doing）”培养学生的自主学习能力、问题求解能力、综合创新能力、团队协作能力和项目管理能力以及工程领导能力。通过本课程的学习，能够使学生掌握创新的一般方法并且为其今后从事科研活动奠定基础。
default.en: The course, “PjBL and technological innovation”, which Introduces the common problems faced by project based learning and technological innovation and their solutions is set up for the majors of Computer Science and Electronic Information. The purpose of the teaching, whose Characteristic is “Learn by doing”, is developing the abilities of autonomous learning ability, problem solving ability, innovation ability, team cooperation ability and the ability of project management and project leadership. Through the studying of this course, students will catch the general method of innovation and be good for their future research foundation.

default.zh: 电磁场与电磁波是一门通信、雷达、遥感和对抗等工程技术的重要的理论基础课程，是电子信息类专业本科生必须具备的基础知识中不可缺少的部分，尤其对于电磁场与无线技术专业的本科生来说是必备的理论知识。本课程主要内容包括：矢量分析、麦克斯韦方程组、边界条件、波动方程、坡印廷定理、均匀电磁波在无耗媒质和有耗媒质中的传播特性、电磁波在媒质分界面上的反射和折射、电磁波在导波系统中的传播特性、电磁波的辐射及静态场的解法等，通过对本课程的学习，培养学生用电磁场的方法去分析和解决工程技术中所遇到的电磁问题的基本能力，并为学好其他相关课程打好基础。
default.en: Electromagnetic Field and Wave is an important theoretical foundation course for communication, radar, remote sensing and electronic countermeasure technology and an indispensable part of the basic knowledge which the undergraduates of electronic information major must possess, especially for the students of electromagnetic field and wireless technology. The main contents include: vector analysis, Maxwell’s Equations, boundary conditions, wave equation, Poynting Theorem, propagation characteristics of uniform plane wave in lossless and lossy medium, reflection and refraction of electromagnetic wave in the medium interface, propagation characteristics of electromagnetic wave in wave-guided system, radiation of electromagnetic wave and static field solution. By learning this course, it can develop the basic capability of students to analyze and solve the electromagnetic problems encountered in engineering technology utilizing the electromagnetic field method, and lay a solid foundation to learn other related courses.

default.zh: 信号与系统是高等工科院校中电子信息类专业本科生必选的技术基础课程，它集中了该领域后续课程所涉及的信号与系统的基本概念、基本原理和基本分析方法。该课程以电子与信息工程作为主要应用背景，主要研究确定性（连续和离散）信号和线性时不变（连续和离散）系统的基本概念与基本理论、信号的频谱分析以及确定性信号经线性时不变系统的基本分析方法。具体包括：1）基于线性叠加原理，掌握典型信号的分析或分解方法，建立信号频谱的概念；2）建立系统数学模型，通过数学手段学习系统求解方法，进而建立系统的物理概念；3）通过卷积定理的学习与应用，建立信号与系统在时域和变换域的统一分析方法；4）通过抽样定理的学习与应用，建立信号与系统在连续域和离散域的统一分析方法；5）对课程涉及的典型信号和系统进行实验验证，了解基本理论在电子与信息工程中的地位和作用。培养学生综合运用所学数学知识，并结合各种实践教学环节，由数学模型向物理模型过渡，进而培养学生对信号与系统的分析能力以及基本应用技能，使学生具备对复杂工程问题的表达、论证和解决能力。为学生进一步学习后续专业课程和日后从事信息技术研究工作打下基础，因此在电子信息类专业的教学计划中占有重要地位。
default.en: ‘Signals and Systems’ is a mandatory technical foundation course for the undergraduates majoring in electronic information in higher engineering universities, which concentrates the basic concepts, principles and fundamental analysis methods involved in subsequent courses in this field. Considering electronic and information engineering as its major application background, this course focuses on the basic concepts and basic theories of deterministic (continuous and discrete) signal and linear time-invariant (continuous and discrete) system, spectrum analysis of signals, as well as basic analysis methods of deterministic signals passing through linear time-invariant systems. The contents mainly include: 1) Based on the principle of linear superposition, master the method of analysis or decomposition of typical signals, and establish the concept of signal spectrum; 2) Learn to establish the mathematical model of the systems, learn the solution method of the system through mathematical means, and then establish the physical concept of the system; 3) Through the study and application of convolution theorem, the unified analysis method of signal and system in time domain and transform domain is established; 4) Through the study and application of sampling theorem, the unified analysis method of signal and system in continuous domain and discrete domain is established; 5) Experimental verification of the typical signals and systems involved in the course makes the students understand the status and role of the basic theory in electronic and information engineering. Students are trained to make comprehensive use of their mathematical knowledge and transition from mathematical model to physical model in combination with various practical teaching links, so as to cultivate students’ analysis ability and basic application ability of Signals and Systems, make the students have the ability to express, demonstrate and solve complex engineering problems, and then lay a foundation for further study of the subsequent professional courses and engaging in information technology in the future. Therefore, the course plays an important role in the teaching programs of electronic information majors.

default.zh: 《电路基础》课程是电子与信息工程学科的学科基础课，它既是电子与信息工程类专业课程体系中高等数学、线性代数、大学物理等基础课的后续课程，又是电子与信息工程类所有专业的后续技术专业课和专业基础课的基础。在整个电子与信息工程类专业的人才培养方案和课程体系中起着承前启后的重要作用。 《电路基础》课程首先从5个基本电路模型及基尔霍夫2个基本定律开始，然后从简单到复杂分别分析了直流、正弦电流和非正弦周期电流稳态情况下的线性电路，最后对线性动态电路暂态过程进行了时域分析。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握电路的基本理论、分析计算电路的基本方法和进行实验的初步技能，并为后续课程准备必要的电路知识。 《电路基础》课程理论严密，逻辑性强，有广阔的工程背景，对培养学生的辩证思维能力，树立理论联系实际的科学观点和提高学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，都有重要的作用。通过本课程的学习，应使学生掌握电路理论的基础知识，电路分析的基本方法。
default.en: “Fundamentals of Electric Circuits “course is the subject of electronic and information engineering course. It is the Follow-up course of higher mathematics, linear algebra, university physics course in electronic and information engineering specialty course system, and is the foundation of electronic and information engineering technology professional all subsequent professional courses and professional courses. It plays an important role in the personnel training program and curriculum system of the electronic and Information Engineering specialty. “Fundamentals of Electric Circuits " course begins from 5 basic circuit model and Kirchhoff 2 basic laws, and then from simple to complex linear circuit were analyzed by DC, sinusoidal and non-sinusoidal periodic current under steady-state conditions, finally is domain analysis of the process of linear dynamic circuit in the transient time. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theory of the circuit, the basic methods of analysis and calculation circuit and the preliminary skills of the experiment, and prepare the necessary circuit knowledge for the follow-up courses. “Fundamentals of Electric Circuits " curriculum is rigid in theory, logical, broad engineering background. It has an important role to cultivate the student’s ability of dialectical thinking, establish the theory and practice of the scientific view and improve the students' ability to analyze and solve problems. Through the study of this course, students should be able to master the basic knowledge of circuit theory and the basic methods of circuit analysis.
