This course enables students engaged in information and communication engineering to integrate artificial intelligence and wireless communication organically by combining specific problems in communication and information engineering. By explaining the basic principles of deep learning and realizing the process of deep learning combined with communication system simulation, this course aims to let students understand the knowledge of deep learning and the basic theory of digital communication, and further use the knowledge and ability to master the physical layer design based on deep learning in intelligent communication, focusing on cultivating students' original innovation quality.

default.zh: 本课程的教学目的就是使学生掌握信息理论的基础知识、通信系统的组成及各组成部分的基本工作原理和性能分析方法，了解通信系统设计的基本方法，使学生具有进行通信系统设计和开发的初步能力。主要内容包括：(1) 通信系统的组成、分类、通信方式及主要性能指标；(2) 信道的定义、数学模型和特性；(3) 脉冲编码调制，数字基带信号的频谱特性及噪声对传输性能的影响；(4) 数字调制系统的调制和解调原理及抗噪声性能；(5) 数字信号的最佳接收准则；(6) 载波同步、位同步和群同步的方法、性能等；(7) 差错控制编码的基本概念和线性分组码编译码原理。
default.en: This course focuses on the fundamental conceptions of information theory, the components of communication systems, and the basic principle of each component. The students should understand how to design a basic communication system. The main contents include seven sections. (1) First of all, some fundamental conceptions of communication systems are introduced in details, including the basic composition, classification, communication mode, and the key performance parameters. (2) The mathematical model and characteristics of different channels are then presented. (3) In the baseband signal transmission section, we will introduce pulse code modulation, spectral characteristics of digital baseband signal, and the impact of noise on the transmission performances. (4) Digital modulation theory is one of the most important issues, and different modulation schemes and their corresponding BER (bit error rate) performances are deduced and analyzed in details. (5) Some optimal detection criterions are also presented for digital communications, for example, maximum likelihood (ML) criterion. (6) Synchronization issue is also analyzed in this course, including carrier synchronization, bit synchronization and frame synchronization. (7) Some basic conceptions of channel coding are introduced, for example, the encoding and decoding processing of linear block codes.

default.zh: 现代通信原理基础课程是通信工程辅修专业的专业核心课程。本课程的教学目的是使学生掌握信息理论的基础知识、通信系统的组成及各组成部分的基本工作原理和性能分析方法，了解通信系统设计的基本方法，使学生具有进行通信系统设计和开发的能力。在教学过程中综合先修课程中所学到的有关知识和技能，进一步学习通信系统的基本原理，结合各种实践教学环节，培养学生具备通信工程领域技术人员所需的基本能力，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础。
default.en: "Fundamentals of Modern Communication Principles" is a core course in the Communication Engineering minor program. The teaching objectives of this course are to enable students to master the foundational knowledge of information theory, understand the composition of communication systems, the basic working principles and performance analysis methods of each component, and to acquaint them with the fundamental approaches to communication system design. This course aims to equip students with the ability to design and develop communication systems. By integrating knowledge and skills acquired from prerequisite courses, students will further study the basic principles of communication systems. Combined with various practical teaching components, the course cultivates students' essential competencies required for technical professionals in the field of communication engineering, laying a foundation for their ability to solve complex engineering problems.

default.zh: 电子信息技术是自上世纪40年代以来始终高速发展的新时代技术，特别是数字信号处理、信号与系统、电磁场理论等理论体系的不断完善，在通信、雷达、遥感、导航、地球物理、生物电子等领域得到了最前沿应用，是引发第三次产业革命-信息革命的核心驱动。 本课程旨在为大学一年级新生展示电子信息技术的前沿发展、变革技术，激发学生投身国家信息时代建设的意愿，将邀请电子、通信、电磁场、信息、测量领域的资深专家以深入浅出的方式讲述各自领域的基础理论，技术发展渊源、最新的理念、最新应用，并让学生理解信息领域科研的特色、科研思路，为学生对自身素质建设、知识储备提供建设性规划。
default.en: Electronic information technology is a new era of technology that has been developing rapidly since the 1940s, especially the continuous improvement of digital signal processing, signal and system, electromagnetic field theory and other theoretical systems, and has been applied at the forefront in the fields of communications, radar, remote sensing, navigation, geophysics science, bioelectronics and other fields, and is the core driving force that triggered the third industrial revolution - information revolution. This course aims to show the cutting-edge development of electronic information technology for first grade student in university, stimulates students' willingness to devote themselves to the construction of the national information age, and will invite senior experts in the fields of electronics, communications, electromagnetic fields, information and measurement to show the basic principle and theories, technological development sources, latest concepts, and latest applications in their respective fields in an in-depth and simple way, and lets students understand the characteristics of scientific research in the field of information, scientific research ideas, and provides constructive planning for students to build their own quality and knowledge reserves.

default.zh: “随机信号分析”电子信息类专业本科生的技术基础课。本课程主要介绍随机信号的基本理论、随机信号的各种分析方法及应用。分别在时域和频域讨论随机信号的特点，以电子技术领域的应用为背景给出随机信号的各种分析方法，讨论电子系统中常用的窄带随机过程的一些性质和应用。教学目的是使学生更加全面地掌握信号理论，为学生打下牢固的随机信号的基础，为后续的电子与通信学科的其他课程的学习奠定基础，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础，使之适应现代信号处理的发展。
default.en: "Random Signal Analysis A" is a foundation course for undergraduate students majoring in electronic information. This course mainly introduces the basic theory of random signals, various analysis methods and applications of random signals. This course discuss the characteristics of random signals in both time and frequency domains, and provide various analysis methods for random signals based on the applications in electronic technologies. This course also discusses some properties and applications of narrowband random processes commonly used in electronic systems. The teaching purpose is to enable students to have a more comprehensive understanding of signal theory and random signals, lay a foundation for the subsequent study of other courses in the field of electronics and communication, cultivate students' ability to solve complex engineering problems, and adapt them to the development of modern signal processing.

default.zh: “随机信号分析 B”电子信息类专业本科生的技术基础课。本课程主要介绍随机信号的基本理论、随机信号的各种分析方法及应用。分别在时域和频域讨论随机信号的特点，以电子技术领域的应用为背景给出随机信号的各种分析方法，讨论电子系统中常用的窄带随机过程的一些性质和应用。教学目的是使学生更加全面地掌握信号理论，为学生打下牢固的随机信号的基础，为后续的电子与通信学科的其他课程的学习奠定基础，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础，使之适应现代信号处理的发展。
default.en: "Random Signal Analysis B" is a foundation course for undergraduate students majoring in electronic information. This course mainly introduces the basic theory of random signals, various analysis methods and applications of random signals. This course discuss the characteristics of random signals in both time and frequency domains, and provide various analysis methods for random signals based on the applications in electronic technologies. This course also discusses some properties and applications of narrowband random processes commonly used in electronic systems. The teaching purpose is to enable students to have a more comprehensive understanding of signal theory and random signals, lay a foundation for the subsequent study of other courses in the field of electronics and communication, cultivate students' ability to solve complex engineering problems, and adapt them to the development of modern signal processing.

default.zh: 该课程是一门使学生了解和掌握无线电定位系统的一般设计和工作原理的专业课程。该课程介绍了无线电定位技术的发展现状及应用领域，其主要内容包括雷达的基本组成，雷达工作基本方程，雷达各分系统的工作原理；雷达目标检测原理、雷达测距原理、测角原理、测速原理、距离高分辨原理、角度高分辨原理、成像基本方法以及典型新体制雷达发射机和接收机工作原理分析等。通过该课程的学习，可以培养学生对雷达系统分析与设计的基本能力，为电子信息工程专业学生从事该领域工作打下良好基础。
default.en: Principle and Technique of Radio Detection and Ranging are the specialized course that the students could learn the foundational theory and engineering design methods of Radio Detection and Ranging system. This course introduces the development status and application areas of radio location technology. Its contents mainly include the basic composition of radar, radar basic equation, the working principle of each radar subsystem, radar target detection principle, radar ranging principle, principle of angle measurement and velocity measurement, high resolution principle in range, high resolution principle in angle, radar imaging foundational methods, the working principles of transmitter and receiver of typical new radar system, etc. The course would train students developing their ability of analysis and design of radar system.

default.zh: 该课程是电子信息工程专业的一门重要的专业限选课。主要介绍智能信号及信息处理的基本概念、基本原理、基本计算方法及应用，包括机器学习基础、神经网络基础、深度神经网络、迁移学习及实验等内容。该课程在教学过程中注重结合实际应用训练学生综合运用有关知识与技能，结合研讨、文献阅读综述和实践教学环节，实现课程目标。课程完成后使学生达到能够阅读相关中外文献并使用相应工具进行研究的基本能力，从而为日后从事项目开发和科学研究打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This course is an important elective course for electronic information engineering majors. This article mainly introduces the basic concepts, principles, calculation methods, and applications of intelligent signal and information processing, including fundamental of machine learning basics, neural network , deep neural networks, transfer learning, and experiments. In the teaching process, this course focuses on combining practical applications to train students in the comprehensive application of relevant knowledge and skills. It combines discussions, literature review, and practical teaching to achieve the course objectives. After completing the course, students will develop the basic ability to read relevant Chinese and foreign literature and use corresponding tools for research, laying a solid foundation for future project development and scientific research.

default.zh: 微波成像原理是电子信息工程专业学生专业核心课，是选择电子信息类专业的未来技术学院及特色班学生的专业选修课。随着宽带无线电技术的发展，无线电定位系统已远超出了仅能测距、测速等功能，可获得感兴趣目标的几何图像。本课程以微波频段成像原理为主要内容，其主要任务是培养学生了解和掌握先进的信号处理方法，理论联系实际，增加创新意识；使学生能够利用现代工具，针对微波成像领域复杂工程问题设计研究方案，分析处理实验获取的数据和结果；在掌握微波成像基本原理和方法的理论知识同时，具有进行实验研究的初步能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Microwave Imaging Principle is a specialized course for students of electronic information specialty. With the development of broadband radio technology, wireless positioning systems not only have the ability to measure the distance and the speed of a target, but also can obtain geometric images of the target of interst. This course mainly focuses on the principles of microwave imaging, and its main task is to cultivate students' understanding and mastery of the advanced signal processing methods, to integrate theory with practice, and to increase the innovation consciousness of the students. Furthermore, this course enables the students to use modern tools to design research approach for complex engineering problems in the field of microwave imaging, analyze and process experimental data and results. Through the course of Microwave Imaging Principle, the students have the ability to master the theoretical knowledge of the basic principles and methods of microwave imaging, and to conduct experimental research, which supports the achievement of the corresponding indicator points in professional learning.

default.zh: 电子对抗技术A是信息对抗技术专业的专业核心课。本课程主要讲授电子对抗的基本概念、基本理论和技术，课程以雷达对抗为主线，内容涉及通信对抗、光电对抗等领域的部分相关知识。通过教学和实验相结合，让学生既学到相关理论知识，又通过实验获得更多的感性认识，使学生了解电子对抗技术在现代战争中的重要性，培养学生解决电子对抗系统中复杂工程问题的能力。电子对抗技术主要包括电子侦察、电子干扰和电子防护等内容。电子侦察主要讲解如何通过对敌方设备辐射信号的截获、测量、分析、识别及定位，获取技术参数及位置、类型、部署等情报。内容涉及信号环境与信号截获的基本知识、搜索式超外差接收机、信道化接收机、常用测向技术的基本原理、对辐射源的定位等。电子干扰主要介绍有源、无源干扰及干扰机原理，以及降低目标截面积的原理和方法。内容涉及遮盖性干扰、欺骗性干扰、干扰机构成及干扰能量计算等。电子防护包括电子反侦察、抗干扰等相关技术。本课程需要学生掌握电子侦察的基本概念、基本原理以及无线电信号侦察的相关技术；掌握电子干扰的相关原理和技术，了解干扰机的基本组成；掌握电子战中保护己方电子设备的相关技术和基本方法。
default.en: Electronic Countermeasure Technology A is a core course in the Information Countermeasure Technology major. This course mainly teaches the basic concepts, theories, and techniques of electronic countermeasures. The course focuses on radar countermeasures and covers some related knowledge in the fields of communication countermeasures, optoelectronic countermeasures, etc. By combining teaching and experiments, students can learn relevant theoretical knowledge and gain more intuitive understanding through experiments, enabling them to understand the importance of electronic warfare technology in modern warfare and cultivating their ability to solve complex engineering problems in electronic warfare systems. The main content includes electronic reconnaissance, electronic jamming and electronic protection etc. Electronic reconnaissance mainly explains how to intercept, measure, analyze, identify and locate the radiation signal of an enemy equipment, and access to technical parameters, location, type, and deployment information. The content involves basic knowledge of signal environment and signal interception, search based superheterodyne receivers, channelized receivers, basic principles of commonly used direction finding techniques, and localization of radiation sources. Electronic jamming introduces the principles of active and passive interferences and the jammer, as well as the principles and methods that reduce the radar cross section. The content involves covering interference, deceptive interference, interference machine composition, and interference energy calculation. Electronic protection includes electronic anti-reconnaissance, anti-interference technology. In this course, students need to master the basic concepts, the basic principles and the related technologies of radio signal reconnaissance; grasp the principles and techniques of radar interference, understand the basic components of the electronic jammer; master the related technology and basic methods to protect one's own equipment during the electronic warfare.

default.zh: 数字信号处理的应用领域涉及通信、雷达与声呐、图像处理、地震信号分析、声学工程、智能测控等诸多方面。本课程的教学目的是使学生掌握数字信号处理的基础理论，培养学生正确应用数字信号处理技术解决实际问题的能力。课程主要内容分为三大部分：离散时间系统、数字频谱分析与数字滤波。离散时间系统包括：连续时间信号的采样、离散时间系统、Z变换、Z反变换等等。数字频谱分析包括：离散傅里叶级数、离散傅里叶变换、逆离散傅里叶变换、快速傅里叶变换。数字滤波包括数字滤波器的设计和数字滤波器的实现两部分。数字滤波器设计部分介绍了有限长冲激响应（FIR）数字滤波器和无限长冲激响应（IIR）数字滤波器的设计方法。其中FIR数字滤波器的主要设计方法有窗函数法、频率抽样设计法，IIR数字滤波器的主要设计方法有冲激不变法、双线性变换法等。数字滤波器实现部分介绍了有限冲激响应（FIR）数字滤波器和无限冲激响应（IIR）数字滤波器的网络结构，包括直接型结构、规范型结构、级联型结构等内容。
default.en: The application fields of Digital Signal Processing involve communication, radar and sonar, image processing, seismic signal analysis, acoustic engineering, intelligent measurement and control, and many other aspects. The teaching purpose of this course is to enable students to master the basic theory of digital signal processing and cultivate their ability to correctly apply digital signal processing technology to solve practical problems. The main content may be divided into three parts, that is, discrete-time systems, digital spectrum analysis and digital filter. Discrete-time systems contain sampling of continuous time signal, discrete-time systems, z-transforms, inverse z-transforms and so on. Digital spectrum analysis contains Discrete Fourier Series, Discrete Fourier Transform，Inverse Discrete Fourier Transform and Fast Fourier Transform. Digital filter contains digital filter design and digital filter realizations. Design methods of finite impulse response filter and infinite impulse response filter are introduced in digital filter design. Design methods of FIR filter contain window method, frequency sampling method. Design methods of IIR filter contain impulse-invariance method, dual linearity method and so on. Net forms of finite impulse response filter and infinite impulse response filter are introduced in digital filter realizations, including direct form, canonical form, cascade form and so on.

default.zh: “随机信号分析及应用”是面向选择电子信息类的未来技术学院学生的专业基础课。本课程主要介绍随机信号的基本理论、随机信号的各种分析方法及应用。分别在时域和频域讨论随机信号的特点，以电子技术领域的应用为背景给出随机信号的各种分析方法，讨论电子系统中常用的窄带随机过程的一些性质和应用，介绍随机过程理论中常用的马尔可夫过程。教学目的是使学生更加全面地掌握信号理论，为学生打下牢固的随机信号的基础，为后续的电子与通信学科的其他课程的学习奠定基础，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础，使之适应现代信号处理的发展。
default.en: “Stochastic Process Analysis and Application’’ is a major foundation course for students in the School of Future Technology who choose to study electronic information. This course introduces the basic theory of random signals, analysis methods of random signals, and applications of random signals. The characteristics of random signals in the time domain and in the frequency domain are also discussed in this course. Taking the electronic technology as background, the applications of many analysis methods for random signals are provided. Properties and applications of narrowband random processes, which are commonly used in electronic systems, are discussed. The basic knowledge of Markov processes, which is widely used in random process theory, is also introduced. The purpose of this course is to enable students to have a more comprehensive understanding of signal theory, lay a solid foundation for random signals and for future learning of other courses in the field of electronics and communication. This course will also cultivate the capability of solving complex engineering problems, so as to adapt to the development of modern signal processing.

default.zh: 离散时间信号处理的应用领域涉及通信、雷达与声呐、图像处理、地震信号分析、声学工程、智能测控等诸多方面。本课程的教学目的是使学生掌握离散时间信号处理的基础理论，培养学生正确应用离散时间信号处理技术解决实际问题的能力。课程主要内容分为三大部分：离散时间系统、数字频谱分析与数字滤波。离散时间系统包括：连续时间信号的采样、离散时间系统、Z变换、Z反变换等等。数字频谱分析包括：离散傅里叶级数、离散傅里叶变换、逆离散傅里叶变换、快速傅里叶变换。数字滤波包括数字滤波器的设计和数字滤波器的实现两部分。数字滤波器设计部分介绍了有限长冲激响应（FIR）数字滤波器和无限长冲激响应（IIR）数字滤波器的设计方法。其中FIR数字滤波器的主要设计方法有窗函数法、频率抽样设计法，IIR数字滤波器的主要设计方法有冲激不变法、双线性变换法等。数字滤波器实现部分介绍了有限冲激响应（FIR）数字滤波器和无限冲激响应（IIR）数字滤波器的网络结构，包括直接型结构、规范型结构、级联型结构等内容。
default.en: The application fields of Discrete-time Signal Processing involve communication, radar and sonar, image processing, seismic signal analysis, acoustic engineering, intelligent measurement and control, and many other aspects. The teaching purpose of this course is to enable students to master the basic theory of discrete-time signal processing and cultivate their ability to correctly apply discrete-time signal processing technology to solve practical problems. The main content may be divided into three parts, that is, discrete-time systems, digital spectrum analysis and digital filter. Discrete-time systems contain sampling of continuous time signal, discrete-time systems, z-transforms, inverse z-transforms and so on. Digital spectrum analysis contains Discrete Fourier Series, Discrete Fourier Transform，Inverse Discrete Fourier Transform and Fast Fourier Transform. Digital filter contains digital filter design and digital filter realizations. Design methods of finite impulse response filter and infinite impulse response filter are introduced in digital filter design. Design methods of FIR filter contain window method, frequency sampling method. Design methods of IIR filter contain impulse-invariance method, dual linearity method and so on. Net forms of finite impulse response filter and infinite impulse response filter are introduced in digital filter realizations, including direct form, canonical form, cascade form and so on.

default.zh: 雷达原理及对抗是数学与应用数学（+电子信息工程双学士学位）专业的专业核心课程。本课程以雷达系统为主讲解其探测原理以及对抗技术。具体包括雷达系统的基本组成及工作原理、雷达测距原理、雷达测角原理、雷达测速原理、雷达成像技术、雷达对抗信号环境及测频接收机、测向技术及辐射源定位、雷达干扰技术等。通过教学和实验相结合，让学生既学到相关理论知识，又通过实验获得更多的感性认识，使学生了解雷达在现代战争中的重要性，培养学生解决雷达探测及对抗系统中复杂工程问题的能力。
default.en: Radar Principles and Countermeasures is a core professional course for the major of Mathematics and Applied Mathematics (with a dual bachelor's degree in Electronic Information Engineering). This course primarily focuses on radar systems, explaining their detection principles and countermeasure technologies. Specific topics include the basic composition and working principles of radar systems, radar ranging principles, radar angle measurement principles, radar velocity measurement principles, radar imaging technology, radar countermeasure signal environments and frequency measurement receivers, direction-finding technology and radiation source localization, as well as radar jamming techniques. Through a combination of teaching and experimentation, students will not only acquire relevant theoretical knowledge but also gain more intuitive understanding through hands-on experiments. This enables students to recognize the importance of radar in modern warfare and cultivate their ability to solve complex engineering problems in radar detection and countermeasure systems.

default.zh: “统计信号处理与随机过程”电子信息类专业特色班本科生的专业基础课。本课程从概率论的视角出发构建信号处理框架。主要介绍随机信号的基本理论及分析方法、马尔可夫随机过程及信号检测估计等统计处理方法。具体介绍了随机信号在时域和频域的特点，以电子技术领域的应用为背景给出随机信号的各种分析方法，讨论电子系统中常用的窄带随机过程的一些性质和应用，介绍统计信号理论中常用的马尔可夫过程理论、信号检测理论和信号估计理论。教学目的是使学生更加全面地掌握信号理论，为学生打下牢固的随机信号的基础，为后续的电子与通信学科的其他课程的学习奠定基础，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础，使之适应现代信号处理的发展。
default.en: “Fundamental of Statistical Signal Processing and Stochastic Process’’ is a major foundation course for students from the Academician Featured Class in the School of Future Technology who majors in electronic information. This course rebuilds the signal processing framework from the aspect of the probbility theory. It introduces the basic theory of random signals, analysis methods of random signals, Markov Processes and basic theory of signal detection and estimation. Specifically, the characteristics of random signals in the time domain and in the frequency domain are also discussed in this course. Taking the electronic technology as background, the applications of many analysis methods for random signals are provided. Properties and applications of narrowband random processes, which are commonly used in electronic systems, are discussed. The basic konwledge of Markov processes, which is widely used in random process theory, is also introduced. The basic theory of signal detection and estimation are also discussed. The purpose of this course is to enable students to have a more comprehensive understanding of signal theory, lay a solid foundation for random signals and for future learning of other courses in the field of electronics and communication. This course will also cultivate the capability of solving complex engineering problems, so as to adapt to the development of modern signal processing.

default.zh: 雷达原理是电子信息类等专业对于无线电定位与探测能力培养的专业课程，课程以雷达系统为主讲授应用无线电技术进行目标距离、速度、角度测量以及高分辨成像的原理与应用，使学生了解和掌握无线电定位系统的一般设计和工作原理。该课程强调理论联系实际，注重培养学生分析、解决实际问题的能力和工程实践能力。课程主要内容包括雷达的基本组成，雷达工作基本方程，雷达各分系统的工作原理、雷达目标检测原理、雷达测距原理、测角原理、测速原理、距离高分辨原理、角度高分辨原理、成像基本方法以及典型新体制雷达发射机和接收机工作原理分析等。通过该课程的学习，可以培养学生对雷达系统分析与设计的基本能力，通过本课程的实践教学，使学生掌握采用无线电技术进行目标位置和速度测量的基本理论知识、基本技能及实现技术，具备软件开发能力，掌握分析和解决实际无线电定位技术中的相关技术问题和工程问题的能力，培养学生的创新思维以及工程意识、工程实践能力，为学生在未来工作中适应电子信息领域的电子技术发展奠定基础。面向国家重大需求及电子信息技术发展前沿，从雷达原理讲解，培养学生理论创新、关键技术突破和系统创新的能力，培养具有雷达及智能探测方向坚实基础、系统思维、创新能力、国际视野、家国情怀的电子信息领域拔尖创新领军人才。
default.en: “Principles of Radar” is a major course for electronic information majors to train positioning ability by the Radio technique，principles and technique of radio detection and ranging. Base on radar (Radio Detection and Ranging) system, it mainly introduces the principles and applications of ranging measurement, angle measurement and velocity measurement by radar, and high resolution imaging, which the general make students understand and grasp the design of radar. It emphasizes theory aligning with practice and develops students’ abilities in analyzing, solving the problems and engineering practice. Main contents of the course include the basic composition of radar, radar basic equation, the working principle of each radar subsystem, radar target detection principle, radar ranging principle, principle of angle measurement and velocity measurement, high resolution principle in range, high resolution principle in angle, radar imaging foundational methods, the working principles of transmitter and receiver of typical new radar system, etc. By taking this course, students can develop the basic ability of analysis and design of radar system. Through the practice in the course, it can train the student’s ability to apply the knowledge of the radar system in practice. Students can acquire the basic theoretical knowledge and skills on microcomputers and microcontrollers, to improve basic skills of Radio Detection and Ranging development. It make students develop the creative thinking and engineering consciousness and abilities, and to master the abilities of analyzing and solving technical and engineering problems related to Radio Detection and Ranging in practical electronic system design in order to lay a good foundation for the future in-depth study. In order to fit the development of electronic technology in the field of electronic information, this course is helpful for the elementary knowledge for future works. Facing the major national needs and the forefront of electronic information technology development, we will explain the principles of radar, cultivate students' abilities in theoretical innovation, key technology breakthroughs, and system innovation, and cultivate top-notch innovative leaders in the field of electronic information with a solid foundation in radar and intelligent detection, system thinking, innovation ability, international perspective, and patriotism.

default.zh: 《电子系统综合设计与实践》是针对电子信息类I本科生开设的一门专业基础性实验课程。 本课程通过设置一系列的实验项目，对先修课程《电子线路基础》、《数字逻辑电路与系统》所学理论知识做进一步巩固和提高，属于集技能训练与理论知识的综合及应用于一体的实践性环节。本课程采取“做中学，学中做”的教学模式，实验项目设计由易到难，循序渐进，学生在了解理论知识的基础上，将课程知识综合运用于电子系统的设计过程中，进而掌握电子系统的构建、调试、测试方法，并初步具备电子系统软硬件设计能力。
default.en: The course of Integrated Design and Practice of Electronic Systems is a professional basic experimental course for electronics and information engineering major and other related majors. Through the design and implementation of a series of experimental projects, this course further consolidated and improved the theoretical knowledge learned in " Foundation of Electronics Circuits" and "Digital Logic Circuits and Systems", and it is also a practical link that integrates skill training and application of theoretical knowledge. This course adopts the teaching mode of "Learning by Doing, Doing by Learning". The experimental project design is from easy to difficult, step by step. This course enables students to not only understand the basics of the theoretical knowledge, but also to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned in Foundation of Electronics Circuits, Digital Logic Circuit and Systems. Then master the construction, debugging, and testing methods of electronic systems, and initially possess the ability to design software and hardware of electronic systems.

default.zh: 网络安全与对抗技术是一门电子信息工程与计算机应用技术交叉领域的专业课程。本课程的目的是使学生掌握网络安全与信息对抗的基本概念原理和体系结构，较为系统地了解网络中存在的安全问题和各类对抗技术手段的运用，明确网络安全的机制、标准及法规等。教学内容涵盖网络安全的基础知识、物理安全技术、网络攻击技术、网络防护技术、网络信息安全技术、网络安全管理技术等。通过课堂讲授、专题研讨和上机实验等教学方式，提高学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，同时培养学生正确的网络道德观念和专业操守。
default.en: Network security and countermeasure technology is a professional interdiscipline course of electronic information engineering and computer application technology. The focus of this course is on the basic concepts, principles, architecture and implementation of network security and information countermeasure techniques. Besides the comprehension of security problems and safeguards in the network, the security protocols, standards and policies are introduced. Topics covered include but are not limited to the followings: introduction to network security, physical security, network attack, network defense, information security in network, network security management. Through lectures combined with seminars and experiments, the students could not only improve the capabilities of analysis and solution, but also obtain the proper understanding of network ethics and professional conduct.

default.zh: 光电对抗技术课是电子信息类专业、信息对抗技术专业本科生的核心课。本课程主要讲授光电对抗的基础知识和基本原理，各类常见的光电对抗、反对抗技术的系统构成和实现手段等，使学生建立起光电对抗的基本概念，掌握以红外、可见光、紫外、激光等传感器为基础的典型的光电制导、光电侦察、光电干扰、光电防护的系统特性、物理原理和关键技术。
default.en: The Electro-optical Countermeasure Technology course is a core course for undergraduates majoring in electronic information and information countermeasures technology. This course mainly teaches the basic knowledge and principles of photoelectric countermeasures, the system composition and implementation methods of various common photoelectric countermeasures and anti-countermeasures technologies, etc. After learning this course, students can establish the basic concepts of photoelectric countermeasures and master the methods of infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, laser system characteristics, physical principles and key technologies of typical photoelectric guidance, photoelectric reconnaissance, photoelectric interference, and photoelectric protection based on other sensors.

default.zh: 模式识别是对数据分析及根据模式类进行决策的行为，已广泛用于文字识别、数据挖掘、医学诊断、图像处理、计算机视觉、生物识别、语音识别、欺骗检测、股票预测等。本门课程主要介绍模式识别的各种方法。主要内容包括：贝叶斯决策理论、各种分类器设计、监督与非监督学习方法、分类能力的评价、特征提取和选择。本课程的目的是使学生能了解分类决策的基本模型及算法，使他们能了解诸如模式识别等信息处理的有关概念。通过该门课程的学习及上机实验，培养学生利用模式识别方法解决本专业及相关领域实际问题的能力，为将来深入学习或进行科学研究、工程实践打下坚实的基础。 本课程主要学习模式识别的基本概念、基本理论和方法。主要内容包括：（1）模式和模式识别的概念；（2）贝叶斯决策理论：主要讲述最小错误率贝叶斯决策、最小风险贝叶斯决策以及错误率的计算；（3）非参数判别分类方法：介绍判别函数的概念、线性分类器的主要设计方法以及近邻法；（4）特征提取和选择方法：主要介绍类别可分离性判据、特征提取方法及特征选择方法；以及（5）在不利用样本或没有样本类别信息的情况下的非监督模式识别方法。
default.en: Pattern recognition - the act of taking raw data and making decisions based on the categories of the pattern - has applied to such diverse areas as character recognition, data mining, medical diagnosis, image processing, computer vision, bioinformatics, speech recognition, fraud detection, and stock market prediction. This course will provide underlying of principles and various approaches of pattern recognition and decision making processes. The topics include the theory of Bayesian decision, diverse classifier designs, evaluation of classify ability, methods for supervised learning and unsupervised learning, and feature extraction and Selection. The goal of this course is to introduce students to the fundamental models of decision making in order to prepare them for applying the associated concepts to information processing such as Pattern Recognition. Through the teaching practice it can train the student’s ability solving actual problem and lay a solid foundation for future study and work. The course mainly introduces the concepts, theory and methods of Pattern Recognition. It includes: (1) The concepts of Pattern and Pattern Recognition；(2) Classifiers based on Bayes Decision Theory: Bayes Decision Theory, Discriminate functions and Decision Surfaces; (3) Non-Parameter Classifiers: Linear Classifiers and Nonlinear Classifiers, The Nearest Neighbor Rule; (4) Feature Selection and Feature Extraction: Class Separability Measures and K-L Transform; (5)Unsupervised algorithms: Clustering, Clustering Algorithms and K-means clustering.

default.zh: 数字图像处理基础是模式识别、计算机视觉、图像通讯、多媒体技术、遥感信息处理等学科和专业的基础，是一门多学科交叉、理论性和实践性都很强的综合性课程，是电子信息类专业学生的一门重要专业课程。通过对本课程学习，使学生了解数字图像的基本概念、数字图像形成的原理，掌握数字图像处理的理论基础和技术方法，着重掌握图像增强、图像编码、图像复原相关基本理论和实现方法，为将来从事相关领域工作和科学研究奠定基础。
default.en: Digital image processing is the basis of pattern recognition, computer vision, image communication, multimedia technology, remote sensing information processing and other disciplines and specialties. It is a multidisciplinary, theoretical and practical comprehensive course, and an important professional course for students majoring in electronic information. Through the study of this course, students can understand the basic concepts of digital images, the principles of digital image formation, master the theoretical basis and technical methods of digital image processing, and focus on mastering the basic theories and implementation methods related to image enhancement, image coding and image restoration, laying the foundation for future work and scientific research in related fields.

default.zh: 微波遥感基础是遥感科学与技术专业本科生必修的一门专业课，是理论与实践结合较强的专业课程。课程主要以电磁波传播及其与各种物质相互作用为出发点，介绍微波遥感的基本理论以及主被动遥感的各种传感器，具体内容包括微波遥感基础、辐射测量学、成像雷达基础、真实孔径及合成孔径雷达遥感、微波遥感图像解译、微波遥感应用等。教学目的是使学生初步掌握微波遥感基本原理与方法，掌握常用微波遥感数据的处理方法，了解微波遥感的应用，为将来进行相关领域的研究做好理论和技术上的储备。
default.en: Microwave Remote Sensing is one major course for Remote Sensing Science and Technology specialty and is a combination of both theory and practice. Starting from microwave propagation and its mutual interaction with different materials, the course is mainly concentrated on basic theories of microwave remote sensing and various active and passive sensors, including foundation of microwave remote sensing, microwave radiometry, basic principle of imaging radar, real and synthetic aperture radar, microwave remote sensing image interpretation, microwave remote sensing application. The aim of the course is to enable student understand basic theory of microwave remote sensing and the commonly used microwave remote sensing techniques, master the algorithms for data processing, comprehend microwave remote sensing application, etc. and to enable students be prepared for further research in related works, both in theory and in techniques.

default.zh: 光学与红外遥感是一门用以培养学生了解光学与红外遥感基础理论、数据处理及其应用的专业技术课。本课程主要内容包括：光学与红外遥感基本概念、光学与红外遥感物理基础、光学与红外遥感成像机理、光学(包括全色影像、多光谱影像、高光谱影像)与红外遥感影像专题数据处理方法和光学与红外遥感应用技术。通过本课程的课堂教学、实验设计和计算机编程等环节，着重培养学生具备红外遥感数据的分析及处理的能力，增加创新意识，为遥感科学与技术专业的学生从事光学与红外遥感的相关工作打下良好基础。
default.en: Optics and Infrared Remote Sensing is the technology course that the students can learn the foundational theory, data processing and the applications of optics and infrared remote sensing system. It contents mainly include the basic concepts of optics and infrared remote sensing, the physical basis of optics and infrared remote sensing, the imaging mechanism of optics and infrared remote sensing, the information processing methods and the application of optics( including panchromatic image, multispectral image and hyperspectral image ) and infrared remote sensing. Through the teaching practice, experimental design and programming, it can train the student’s ability in analysis and use of optics and infrared remote sensing system, and lay a solid foundation for further work.

default.zh: 《测量学》是测绘学科的重要技术基础课，也是遥感科学与技术专业本科生的必修课。本课程旨在使学生系统地掌握地形信息获取、处理与应用的核心理论与方法，并初步具备解决相关领域测量问题的实践能力与职业素养。通过本课程学习，学生应达成以下目标： 课程目标1： 掌握测量学的定义、作用与基本原则，系统理解从地面点定位到地形图成图与应用的全过程知识体系。在知识层面，学生应重点掌握地球形状与坐标系、地面点测定、控制测量、地形图基本知识及摄影测量基础等核心概念与原理。在能力层面，能够运用这些知识分析和阐述地形图测绘工作的整体技术流程与逻辑关系，具备识读地形图并从中提取基本信息的初步能力。在素质层面，通过了解测绘学科的整体框架，建立宏观的系统工程思维，并培养对测绘工作精确性、规范性的初步认识。 课程目标2. 掌握高程测量、角度测量、距离测量及电子全站仪测量等基本测量工作的原理、方法与技术。在知识层面，学生应深入理解各项测量的基本原理、仪器操作要领、观测方法与精度评定标准。在能力层面，能够正确使用基本测量仪器进行规范的数据采集，具备完成外业观测、内业计算及成果整理的实际动手能力，并能对测量结果的精度进行初步分析和评定。在素质层面，通过实践操作训练，培养严谨求实、一丝不苟的科学态度，树立仪器操作的安全意识和团队协作精神。
default.en: "Surveying" is an essential technical foundation course in the geomatics discipline and a compulsory subject for undergraduates majoring in Remote Sensing Science and Technology. This course aims to equip students with a systematic mastery of the core theories and methods for acquiring, processing, and applying topographic information, as well as to develop preliminary practical abilities and professional competence in solving measurement-related problems in relevant fields. Upon completion of this course, students are expected to achieve the following objectives: Course Objective 1: Master the definition, role, and fundamental principles of surveying, and systematically understand the complete knowledge system from ground point positioning to topographic mapping and application. In terms of knowledge, students should focus on mastering core concepts and principles such as the shape of the Earth and coordinate systems, ground point determination, control surveying, basic knowledge of topographic maps, and fundamentals of photogrammetry. In terms of abilities, students should be able to use this knowledge to analyze and explain the overall technical process and logical relationships of topographic mapping, and possess preliminary skills in interpreting topographic maps and extracting basic information from them. In terms of qualities, by understanding the overall framework of the geomatics discipline, students will develop macro-level systems engineering thinking and cultivate an initial awareness of the precision and standardization required in surveying work. Course Objective 2: Master the principles, methods, and techniques of basic surveying tasks, including elevation measurement, angle measurement, distance measurement, and electronic total station measurement. In terms of knowledge, students should deeply understand the fundamental principles of various measurements, key points of instrument operation, observation methods, and accuracy evaluation standards. In terms of abilities, students should be able to correctly use basic surveying instruments for standardized data collection, possess practical hands-on skills to complete field observations, indoor calculations, and result organization, and be capable of conducting preliminary analysis and evaluation of the accuracy of measurement results. In terms of qualities, through practical training, students will develop a rigorous, truthful, and meticulous scientific attitude, establish safety awareness in instrument operation, and foster a spirit of teamwork.

default.zh: 地理信息系统（GIS）是遥感科学与技术专业的专业限选课，是信息科学、空间科学、管理科学之间的交叉学科。它以地理数据为基础，采用地理模型分析方法，提供多种空间动态的地理信息，用于管理和决策过程的计算机系统。地理信息系统在国土资源管理、环境评估、区域发展规划、公共设施管理、交通安全、城市大数据、新型智慧城市和应急减灾等方面有着重要应用，与互联网、全球定位系统（GPS)、无线技术和Web服务的结合后，在定位服务、交互式地图、汽车导航和精准农业等方面有着广泛的应用。 通过课程的学习，使学生掌握地理信息系统的基本概念、空间数据的采集、空间数据的结构及其相互关系、编辑及空间信息处理方法、GIS空间分析的原理方法、GIS设计的技术方法等内容，并掌握GIS基本软件的应用与操作。对培养学生数据信息处理系统综合分析、设计能力等方面有重要的作用。通过本课程的课堂教学和实验操作等环节，着重培养学生们信息系统的综合分析与设计能力，以及信息系统科学知识的应用能力，增强创新意识。 地理信息系统课程教学的目标，定位在专业技能培养和实际操作训练上。在内容上强调概念与实践并重，实现理论与应用相结合，达到地理信息技术的学以致用的需求。 课程目标1. 了解和掌握地理信息系统的基本原理和主要结构，具备地理信息数据分析的知识基础，了解地理信息系统的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；课程目标2. 了解和掌握空间数据的基本特征和主要分析方法，掌握空间数据库的概念、设计方法，了解空间数据库的实现技术。了解位置选择、发展预测等地理信息系统的应用模型。掌握地理信息系统的设计方法，具备分析和解决工程实践中空间数据处理的能力；课程目标3. 熟悉和掌握地理信息系统通用软件和进行空间数据分析的基本实验技能，得到实验方案设计和实验技能获得的基本训练，逐步具有应用先进工具解决工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: Geographic Information System (GIS) is an elective course in the field of Remote Sensing Science and Technology, and it is an interdisciplinary subject that intersects information science, spatial science, and management science. It is a computer system that utilizes geographic data, employs geographic modeling and analysis methods, and provides various dynamic spatial information for management and decision-making processes. GIS finds important applications in land resources management, environmental assessment, regional development planning, public facilities management, traffic safety, urban big data, smart cities, and emergency response and disaster reduction. With the integration of the Internet, Global Positioning System (GPS), wireless technology, and web services, GIS has extensive applications in location services, interactive maps, car navigation, and precision agriculture. Through the study of this course, students will acquire a grasp of the basic concepts of GIS, spatial data acquisition, the structure and interrelationships of spatial data, editing and spatial information processing methods, principles and methods of GIS spatial analysis, and technical methods for GIS design. They will also master the application and operation of basic GIS software. This course plays an important role in developing students' comprehensive analysis and design capabilities in data information processing systems. Through classroom teaching and practical exercises, students will focus on cultivating their abilities in comprehensive analysis and design of information systems, as well as the application of knowledge in information system science, and enhancing their innovative awareness. The teaching objectives of the GIS course are focused on professional skills development and practical operation training. The content emphasizes a balance between concepts and practice, achieving the integration of theory and application to meet the demand for practical application of geographic information technology. Course Objective 1: Understand and master the basic principles and main structure of GIS, possess the knowledge foundation for geographic information data analysis, understand the theoretical foundation, research hotspots, development trends, and cutting-edge applications of GIS. Course Objective 2: Understand and master the basic characteristics and main analysis methods of spatial data, grasp the concept and design methods of spatial databases, understand the implementation technologies of spatial databases. Gain knowledge of application models of GIS, such as location selection and development prediction. Acquire the design methods of GIS and possess the ability to analyze and solve spatial data processing issues in engineering practices. Course Objective 3: Familiarize and master the general software of GIS and basic experimental skills for spatial data analysis, receive basic training in experimental plan design and skill acquisition, and gradually develop the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 通信电子线路设计是未来技术学院本科生电子信息类专业的技术基础课。该课程主要教学目标是帮助学生建立通信系统的概念，明确无线通信系统的基本构成及信号传输的基本理论，并进一步掌握采用电子线路来实现通信链路的各部分模块，继而掌握各模块电路分析和电路设计的方法，最终实现通信系统的设计。该课程是该领域本科生后续专业课程学习的基础，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础。同时，在授课过程中，注重知识背后科学精神、实践过程协作精神以及学生终身学习意识的培养。
default.en: Design of communication electronic circuits is a fundamental technical course for undergraduate students majoring in electronic information at Future Technology College. The main teaching objective of this course is to help students establish the concept of communication systems, clarify the basic composition of wireless communication systems and the basic theory of signal transmission, and further master the various modules of using electronic circuits to achieve communication links. Then, they will master the methods of circuit analysis and design for each module, and ultimately achieve the design of communication systems. This course serves as the foundation for undergraduate students in this field to pursue further professional courses, laying the foundation for cultivating their ability to solve complex engineering problems. At the same time, in the teaching process, emphasis should be placed on cultivating the scientific spirit behind knowledge, the collaborative spirit in the practical process, and the lifelong learning awareness of students.

default.zh: 数字图像处理基础是模式识别、计算机视觉、图像通讯、多媒体技术、遥感信息处理等学科和专业的基础，是一门多学科交叉、理论性和实践性都很强的综合性课程，是电子信息类专业学生的一门重要专业课程。通过对本课程学习，使学生了解数字图像的基本概念、数字图像形成的原理，掌握数字图像处理的理论基础和技术方法，着重掌握图像增强、图像编码、图像复原相关基本理论和实现方法，为将来从事相关领域工作和科学研究奠定基础。
default.en: Digital image processing is the basis of pattern recognition, computer vision, image communication, multimedia technology, remote sensing information processing and other disciplines and specialties. It is a multidisciplinary, theoretical and practical comprehensive course, and an important professional course for students majoring in electronic information. Through the study of this course, students can understand the basic concepts of digital images, the principles of digital image formation, master the theoretical basis and technical methods of digital image processing, and focus on mastering the basic theories and implementation methods related to image enhancement, image coding and image restoration, laying the foundation for future work and scientific research in related fields.

default.zh: 通信原理与对抗课程是一门核心专业基础课，要求学生掌握通信系统和通信对抗系统的组成及各组成部分的基本工作原理和性能分析方法，了解通信及通信对抗系统设计的基本方法，使学生具有进行系统设计和开发的能力。通过该门课程的教学实践，培养学生具备通信工程领域技术人员所需的基本能力，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础；同时也可使得学生对电子战中的通信对抗有一个全面的把握，从而为本专业学生从事电子战相关工作打下良好基础，为国防建设培养优秀人才。
default.en: Communication principle and countermeasure course is a core professional basic course, which requires students to master the composition of communication system and communication countermeasure system, the basic working principle and performance analysis method of each component, and understand the basic methods of communication and communication countermeasure system design, so that students can have the ability to design and develop the system. Through the teaching practice of this course, students are trained to have the basic abilities required by technicians in the field of communication engineering, which lays the foundation for cultivating students' ability to solve complex engineering problems. At the same time, it can make students have a comprehensive grasp of communication countermeasures in electronic warfare, thus laying a good foundation for students majoring in electronic warfare and cultivating outstanding talents for national defense construction.

default.zh: 通信电子线路设计与实践是电子信息类专业未来技术学院本科生的技术基础课。该课程主要教学目标是帮助学生建立通信系统的概念，明确无线通信系统的基本构成及信号传输的基本理论，并进一步掌握采用电子线路来实现通信链路的各部分模块，继而掌握各模块电路分析和电路设计的方法，最终实现通信系统硬件设计开发。该课程是该领域本科生后续专业课程学习的基础，同时也将“电子线路”、“信号处理”和“电波传播”三大课程体系实现了有机结合，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础。同时，在授课过程中，注重知识背后科学精神、实践过程协作精神以及学生终身学习意识的培养。
default.en: he design and practice of communication electronic circuits is a fundamental technical course for undergraduate students majoring in electronic information at the Future Technology College. The main teaching objective of this course is to help students establish the concept of communication systems, clarify the basic composition of wireless communication systems and the basic theory of signal transmission, and further master the use of electronic circuits to implement various modules of communication links. Then, they will master the methods of circuit analysis and design for each module, and ultimately achieve the hardware design and development of communication systems. This course serves as the foundation for undergraduate students in this field to continue their professional studies, while also organically integrating the three major course systems of "Electronic Circuits," "Signal Processing," and "Radio Wave Propagation," laying the foundation for cultivating students' ability to solve complex engineering problems. At the same time, in the teaching process, emphasis is placed on cultivating the scientific spirit behind the knowledge, the collaborative spirit in the practical process, and the lifelong learning awareness of students.

default.zh: “信号处理”是高等工科院校中电子信息类专业本科生必选的技术基础课程，它集中了该领域后续课程所涉及的信号处理的基本概念、基本原理和基本分析方法。该课程以电子与信息工程作为主要应用背景，主要研究确定性（连续和离散）信号和线性时不变（连续和离散）系统的基本概念与基本理论、信号的频谱分析以及确定性信号经线性时不变系统的基本分析方法。具体包括：1）基于线性叠加原理，掌握典型信号的分析或分解方法，建立信号频谱的概念；2）建立系统数学模型，通过数学手段学习系统求解方法，进而建立系统的物理概念；3）通过卷积定理的学习与应用，建立信号与系统在时域和变换域的统一分析方法；4）通过抽样定理的学习与应用，建立信号与系统在连续域和离散域的统一分析方法；5）对课程涉及的典型信号和系统进行实验验证，了解基本理论在电子与信息工程中的地位和作用。培养学生综合运用所学数学知识，并结合各种实践教学环节，由数学模型向物理模型过渡，进而培养学生对信号处理和系统分析能力以及基本应用技能，使学生具备对复杂工程问题的表达、论证和解决能力。为学生进一步学习后续专业课程和日后从事信息技术研究工作打下基础，因此在电子信息类专业的教学计划中占有重要地位。
default.en: ‘Signals Processing’ is the mandatory technical foundation course for the undergraduates in the major of electronic information technology in higher engineering universities, which focuses on basic concepts, principles and fundamental analysis methods for the subsequent courses. Considering electronics and information engineering as the major application background, the basic concepts and basic theories of deterministic (continuous and discrete) signal and linear time-invariant (continuous and discrete) system, spectral analysis of signals as well as basic analytical methods of deterministic signals passing a linear time-invariant system are studied in this course. The contents mainly include:1) Based on the principle of linear superposition, the method of analysis or decomposition of typical signals is acquired to establish the concept of signal spectrum; 2) The mathematical model of the system is established, and the system is solved by means of mathematical means, then the physical concept of the system is established; 3) Through the study and application of convolution theorem, the uniform analysis method of signal and system in time domain and transform domain is established; 4) Through the study and application of sampling theorem, the uniform analysis method of signal and system in continuous domain and discrete domain is established; 5) Experimental verification of the typical signals and systems involved in the course makes the students understand the status and role of the basic theory in electronic and information engineering. Take advantage of the comprehension of the studied mathematical knowledge, combine with a variety of practice teaching, and transit the mathematical models to the physical models, during the teaching and study, so as to cultivate students’ analysis ability and basic application ability of Signals and Systems analysis, make the students have the ability to express, demonstrate and solve complex engineering problems, and then lay a foundation for further study of the subsequent professional courses and future research of information technology. Therefore, the course plays an important role in the teaching programs of the information technology majors.

default.zh: 《微波技术》课程是将电子信息、通信、电子科学与技术等专业有机结合而形成的一门重要技术基础课，是当今从事电子、信息和通信等领域科学研究所必备的基础知识。微波技术主要是研究微波信号的产生、放大、传输、发射、接收和测量的学科。本课程是在电路理论、电磁场与电磁波课程学习的基础上，涉足无线电频谱中及其重要的波段——微波领域的重要科目。所要求的工程数学基础知识包括：数理方程、线性代数、复变函数、矢量分析与场论等。本课程主要研究微波传输的基本理论，是研究其他射频/微波技术问题的基础。随着科学技术的进步，微波技术的应用领域更加广泛，尤其是当前无线通信技术领域产生的新变革、新应用，使得无线电频谱应用更加拥挤，必须向更高的频段发展，因此微波技术已经发展成为一门独立的科学，而微波技术基础知识成为从事电子信息领域研究中必不可缺的学科知识。
default.en: The course of Microwave Technology is an important technical foundation course that combines electronic information, communication, electronic science and technology, and is an essential foundational knowledge for scientific research in the fields of electronics, information, and communication. Microwave technology is mainly a discipline that studies the generation, amplification, transmission, transmission, reception, and measurement of microwave signals. This course is based on the study of circuit theory, electromagnetic fields, and electromagnetic waves, and delves into important subjects in the microwave field, which is an important band in the radio spectrum. The required basic knowledge of engineering mathematics includes mathematical equations, linear algebra, complex functions, vector analysis, and field theory. This course mainly studies the basic theory of microwave transmission and serves as the foundation for studying other RF/microwave technology issues. With the progress of science and technology, the application fields of microwave technology have become more extensive, especially the new changes and applications in the field of wireless communication technology, which have made wireless spectrum applications more crowded and must develop towards higher frequency bands. Therefore, microwave technology has developed into an independent science, and basic knowledge of microwave technology has become an indispensable subject knowledge in the field of electronic information research.

default.zh: 本课程主要结合常用的典型天线讲授天线的基本原理、主要参数和基本分析方法，内容包括天线基本理论，主要有基本振子辐射、天线的电参数、天线阵的方向特性和特性阻抗等；常用的线天线的基本工作原理、分析方法和特性，包括对称振子、水平对称振子、直立振子、引向天线、对数周期天线和螺旋天线等；面天线基础，包括面天线的辐射基础和喇叭天线、旋转抛物面天线以及卡塞格伦天线等常用的面天线的基本组成、工作原理和基本分析方法；天线的主要电气参数的测量原理和方法。通过对本课程的学习，要求学生掌握天线技术的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法，了解常用的天线的工作原理、基本分析计算方法，为学生今后的学习和工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This course instructs the basic theories and the main parameters and the analysis method of the antennas including several aspects content as follows: the basic operating theories of the antennas including the radiation of the basic electric dipole and magnetic dipole and the electric parameters of the antennas and the direction characteristic and the characteristic impedance of the antenna array are presented. Basic operating principles and analysis methods and characteristic of the antennas in common use including balanced dipole and horizontal balanced dipole and perpendicularity balanced dipole and yagi antenna and log periodic antenna and helix antenna are introduced. Basis of the area antennas including the radiation basis of the area antennas and basic structure and operating principles and analysis methods of the area antennas in the common use as horn antennas and parabolic antennas and cassegrain antennas are focused on. The measurement theories and ways and means of the electric parameters of the antennas are presented. Through the study of this course, students should master the basic concepts and the theories and the methods of the antennas and understand basic operating principles and analysis calculation method of the antennas so as to establish foundation for the study and work in the future.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍电磁波在自然环境空间中传播的基本理论与应用。首先回顾了电磁场与电磁波的基本理论，讲解了惠更斯-菲涅尔原理、菲涅尔区和电磁波的绕射理论；其次着重介绍了电磁波受地面和大气影响下，电波传播的相关理论与概念。其中包含了沿着地面传播的地波、同时受地面和大气影响的视距传播以及由大气电离层反射形成的天波传播。本课程还介绍了场强、天线接收功率及通信链路方面的相关知识，其中无线链路预算知识及应用贯穿于各章内容之中。
default.en: This course mainly deals with the theory of electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation in natural environment and its application. Firstly, basic EM wave theory is introduced. Besides Maxwell’s equation, it also includes the Principle of Huygens-Fresnel, Fresnel zone and the theory of diffraction, and so on. Secondly, the concepts and theories elaborated in detail are the influence of the earth surface and atmosphere on EM wave propagation, including ground wave propagation, LOS wave propagation and sky wave propagation. The knowledge related to field strength, antenna received power and link budget is also discussed. The application of link budget is demonstrated in several chapters when necessary.

default.zh: 微波无源电路课程是电磁场与无线技术专业学生的专业必修课，是学生后续学习无线通信系统与电子系统的基础，在培养学生的无线通信与电子系统的综合分析能力和设计能力以及解决复杂工程问题的能力方面是十分重要的。 微波无源电路课程的主要内容包括传输线模型及传输线不均匀区域的等效电路，微带电路中的电抗元件的实现方法，集总元件匹配网络、分布元件匹配网络以及滤波器、功率分配器、定向耦合器等典型的微波无源器件的工作原理、指标计算和设计方法。重点研究平面结构的微波无源电路。 课程的实践环节包括阻抗变换器、滤波器、功分器、定向耦合器的仿真设计和矢网使用操作及微波无源器件的测量。实验项目具有代表性和可操作性，可以解决课堂教学所无法实现的动手能力培养的问题，同时使得学生加深对知识的理解。 通过本课程的学习，学生将具备正确选择、使用和设计常用微波无源电路能力。能够对微波无源器件进行等效电路分析、使用电磁场模拟软件进行仿真设计及使用现代仪器进行实验测试。能够针对电子信息领域复杂工程问题中具体的对象，开发或选用满足特定需求的现代工具对其进行模拟和预测，并能够分析其局限性。
default.en: The Microwave Passive Circuits course is a core requirement for students specializing in electromagnetic fields and wireless technology. It forms the foundation for subsequent studies in wireless communication systems and electronic systems, playing a crucial role in developing students' comprehensive analysis, design capabilities, and problem-solving skills for complex engineering challenges. The course primarily covers topics such as transmission line models and equivalent circuits for non-uniform regions of transmission lines, methods for implementing reactive elements in microstrip circuits, and the principles, performance metrics, and design methodologies of typical microwave passive components like lumped element matching networks, distributed element matching networks, filters, power dividers, and directional couplers. Special emphasis is placed on planar structures of microwave passive circuits. Practical components of the course include the simulation and design of impedance transformers, filters, power dividers, and directional couplers, as well as the operation of vector network analyzers and the measurement of microwave passive devices. These hands-on projects are representative and practical, addressing the limitations of theoretical classroom teaching and enhancing students' understanding through active participation. By completing this course, students will acquire the skills to correctly select, use, and design common microwave passive circuits. They will be able to perform equivalent circuit analysis on microwave passive components, use electromagnetic simulation software for design, and conduct experimental testing with modern instruments. Furthermore, students will be equipped to develop or select modern tools to simulate and predict specific needs in the electronic information field, understand their limitations, and apply these tools to analyze complex engineering problems effectively.

default.zh: 本课程是电磁场与无线技术专业的专业课程，主要研究射频与微波信号的发生、处理和频率转换等所需要用到的电子电路。根据专业培养目标和要求以及加强素质教育和能力培养的原则，结合本专业的特点与发展方向，本课程主要讲授微波电路的基本概念和分析方法，包括随着频率的提高，当工作波长与分立电路元件尺寸相比拟时基本电路理论失效的原因和以反射系数为基础来分析处理阻抗变化性质的阻抗圆图；微波半导体器件的基本工作原理及其等效电路模型；双极晶体管和场效应晶体管的阻抗匹配和偏置网络，以消除有害的反射并优化功率输出；微波放大器电路的基本工作原理、分析设计方法以及在低噪声和高功率应用中的设计难点；微波非线性电路，包括振荡器和混频器在内的微波非线性电路的设计方法。通过对本课程的学习，要求学生掌握微波电子线路的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法，了解常用微波电路的工作原理、基本分析计算方法，为学生今后的学习和工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This course is a professional course for electromagnetic field and wireless technology majors. It mainly studies the electronic circuits needed for the generation, processing and frequency conversion of RF and microwave signals. According to the training objectives and requirements of the major and the principle of strengthening quality education and ability training, combined with the characteristics and development direction of the major, this course mainly teaches the basic concepts and analysis methods of microwave circuits, including the reason for the theoretical failure of the basic circuit when the working wavelength is similar to the size of discrete circuit components as the frequency increases, and the impedance circle chart based on reflection coefficient to analyze and handle the impedance change properties; The basic working principle and equivalent circuit model of microwave semiconductor devices; Impedance matching and bias network of bipolar transistor and field effect transistor to eliminate harmful reflection and optimize power output; The basic working principle, analysis and design method of microwave amplifier circuit and the design difficulties in low noise and high power applications; Microwave nonlinear circuit, including oscillator and mixer. Through the study of this course, students are required to master the basic concepts, principles and methods of microwave electronic circuits, understand the working principles and basic analysis and calculation methods of common microwave circuits, and lay a solid foundation for students' future study and work.

default.zh: 电磁兼容是一门新兴的综合性交叉学科。随着电子、电气设备数量、种类的不断增加，及其在生产、生活、国防、航天等各个领域应用范围的不断扩大，在无线电抗干扰技术的基础上，经过扩展、延伸和系统化进而形成了电磁兼容这一自然科学和工程学的交叉学科。电磁兼容课程将以电磁场与无线技术专业为本，课程教学目的是让学生在学完大学基础课程和专业基础课程之后，再学习具有鲜明特色的电磁兼容原理与技术，培养综合运用所学的知识解决实际的工程问题的能力。本课程立足于经典电磁学理论，结合我校所属国防航天领域的特色，引导学生系统地掌握电磁兼容的基本知识、基本概念和基本的分析综合方法，了解典型的电磁兼容性问题，使得教学更具有针对性，让学生对电磁场与无线技术专业知识及其交叉学科技术产生浓厚兴趣，为今后进一步深造或工作奠定坚实的基础
default.en: Electromagnetic compatibility is an emerging comprehensive interdisciplinary field. With the continuous increase in the number and types of electronic and electrical equipment, and the continuous expansion of their application scope in various fields such as production, life, national defense, and aerospace, electromagnetic compatibility has been formed as an interdisciplinary field of natural science and engineering through expansion, extension, and systematization based on wireless reactance interference technology. The electromagnetic compatibility course will be based on the electromagnetic field and wireless technology major. The teaching purpose of the course is to enable students to learn distinctive electromagnetic compatibility principles and technologies after completing university and professional basic courses, and cultivate the ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge learned to solve practical engineering problems. This course is based on classical electromagnetic theory, combined with the characteristics of our school's national defense and aerospace field, guiding students to systematically master the basic knowledge, concepts, and analysis methods of electromagnetic compatibility, understand typical electromagnetic compatibility problems, make teaching more targeted, and cultivate a strong interest in the professional knowledge of electromagnetic field and wireless technology and their interdisciplinary technologies, To lay a solid foundation for further education or work in the future

default.zh: 电磁场与电磁波是一门通信、雷达、遥感和对抗等工程技术的重要的理论基础课程，是电子信息类专业本科生必须具备的基础知识中不可缺少的部分，尤其对于电磁场与无线技术专业的本科生来说是必备的理论知识。本课程主要内容包括：矢量分析、麦克斯韦方程组、边界条件、波动方程、坡印廷定理、均匀电磁波在无耗媒质和有耗媒质中的传播特性、电磁波在媒质分界面上的反射和折射、电磁波在导波系统中的传播特性、电磁波的辐射及静态场的解法等，通过对本课程的学习，培养学生用电磁场的方法去分析和解决工程技术中所遇到的电磁问题的基本能力，并为学好其他相关课程打好基础。
default.en: Electromagnetic Field and Wave is an important theoretical foundation course for communication, radar, remote sensing and electronic countermeasure technology and an indispensable part of the basic knowledge which the undergraduates of electronic information major must possess, especially for the students of electromagnetic field and wireless technology. The main contents include: vector analysis, Maxwell’s Equations, boundary conditions, wave equation, Poynting Theorem, propagation characteristics of uniform plane wave in lossless and lossy medium, reflection and refraction of electromagnetic wave in the medium interface, propagation characteristics of electromagnetic wave in wave-guided system, radiation of electromagnetic wave and static field solution. By learning this course, it can develop the basic capability of students to analyze and solve the electromagnetic problems encountered in engineering technology utilizing the electromagnetic field method, and lay a solid foundation to learn other related courses.

default.zh: 《微波技术设计与实践》课程是将电子信息、通信、电子科学与技术等专业有机结合而形成的一门重要技术基础课，是当今从事电子、信息和通信等领域科学研究所必备的基础知识。微波技术主要是研究微波信号的产生、放大、传输、发射、接收和测量的学科。本课程是在电路理论、电磁场与电磁波课程学习的基础上，涉足无线电频谱中及其重要的波段——微波领域的重要科目。所要求的工程数学基础知识包括：数理方程、线性代数、复变函数、矢量分析与场论等。本课程主要研究微波传输的基本理论，是研究其他射频/微波技术问题的基础。随着科学技术的进步，微波技术的应用领域更加广泛，尤其是当前无线通信技术领域产生的新变革、新应用，使得无线电频谱应用更加拥挤，必须向更高的频段发展，因此微波技术已经发展成为一门独立的科学，而微波技术基础知识成为从事电子信息领域研究中必不可缺的学科知识。
default.en: Microwave Technology is an important basic technology course formed by the organic combination of electronic information, communication, electronic science and technology and other majors. It is a necessary basic knowledge for scientific research in the fields of electronics, information and communication. Microwave technology is mainly a subject that studies the generation, amplification, transmission, transmission, reception and measurement of microwave signals. This course is an important subject in the field of microwave, an important band in the radio spectrum, based on the study of circuit theory, electromagnetic field and electromagnetic wave. The required basic knowledge of engineering mathematics includes mathematical equations, linear algebra, complex variable functions, vector analysis and field theory. This course mainly studies the basic theory of microwave transmission, which is the basis for studying other RF/microwave technology problems. With the progress of science and technology, the application fields of microwave technology are more extensive, especially the new changes and new applications in the current wireless communication technology field, which make the radio spectrum application more crowded and must develop to a higher frequency band. Therefore, microwave technology has developed into an independent science, and the basic knowledge of microwave technology has become an indispensable subject in the field of electronic information research.

default.zh: 本课程主要结合常用的典型天线讲授天线的基本原理、主要参数和基本分析方法，内容包括天线基本理论，主要有基本振子辐射、天线的电参数、天线阵的方向特性和特性阻抗等；常用的线天线的基本工作原理、分析方法和特性，包括对称振子、水平对称振子、直立振子、引向天线、对数周期天线和螺旋天线等；面天线基础，包括面天线的辐射基础和喇叭天线、旋转抛物面天线以及卡塞格伦天线等常用的面天线的基本组成、工作原理和基本分析方法；天线的主要电气参数的测量原理和方法。通过对本课程的学习，要求学生掌握天线技术的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法，了解常用的天线的工作原理、基本分析计算方法，为学生今后的学习和工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This course instructs the basic theories and the main parameters and the analysis method of the antennas including several aspects content as follows: the basic operating theories of the antennas including the radiation of the basic electric dipole and magnetic dipole and the electric parameters of the antennas and the direction characteristic and the characteristic impedance of the antenna array are presented. Basic operating principles and analysis methods and characteristic of the antennas in common use including balanced dipole and horizontal balanced dipole and perpendicularity balanced dipole and yagi antenna and log periodic antenna and helix antenna are introduced. Basis of the area antennas including the radiation basis of the area antennas and basic structure and operating principles and analysis methods of the area antennas in the common use as horn antennas and parabolic antennas and cassegrain antennas are focused on. The measurement theories and ways and means of the electric parameters of the antennas are presented. Through the study of this course, students should master the basic concepts and the theories and the methods of the antennas and understand basic operating principles and analysis calculation method of the antennas so as to establish foundation for the study and work in the future.

default.zh: 本课程是电磁场与无线技术专业的专业课程，主要研究射频与微波信号的发生、处理和频率转换等所需要用到的电子电路。根据专业培养目标和要求以及加强素质教育和能力培养的原则，结合本专业的特点与发展方向，本课程主要讲授微波电路的基本概念和分析方法，包括随着频率的提高，当工作波长与分立电路元件尺寸相比拟时基本电路理论失效的原因和以反射系数为基础来分析处理阻抗变化性质的阻抗圆图；微波半导体器件的基本工作原理及其等效电路模型；双极晶体管和场效应晶体管的阻抗匹配和偏置网络，以消除有害的反射并优化功率输出；微波放大器电路的基本工作原理、分析设计方法以及在低噪声和高功率应用中的设计难点；微波非线性电路，包括振荡器和混频器在内的微波非线性电路的设计方法。通过对本课程的学习，要求学生掌握微波电子线路的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法，了解常用微波电路的工作原理、基本分析计算方法，为学生今后的学习和工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This course is a professional course for electromagnetic field and wireless technology majors. It mainly studies the electronic circuits needed for the generation, processing and frequency conversion of RF and microwave signals. According to the training objectives and requirements of the major and the principle of strengthening quality education and ability training, combined with the characteristics and dev

default.en: The course of Microwave Technology A is an important technical foundation course that combines electronic information, communication, electronic science and technology, and is an essential foundational knowledge for scientific research in the fields of electronics, information, and communication. Microwave technology is mainly a discipline that studies the generation, amplification, transmission, transmission, reception, and measurement of microwave signals. This course is based on the study of circuit theory, electromagnetic fields, and electromagnetic waves, and delves into important subjects in the microwave field, which is an important band in the radio spectrum. The required basic knowledge of engineering mathematics includes mathematical equations, linear algebra, complex functions, vector analysis, and field theory. This course mainly studies the basic theory of microwave transmission and serves as the foundation for studying other RF/microwave technology issues. With the progress of science and technology, the application fields of microwave technology have become more extensive, especially the new changes and applications in the field of wireless communication technology, which have made wireless spectrum applications more crowded and must develop towards higher frequency bands. Therefore, microwave technology has developed into an independent science, and basic knowledge of microwave technology has become an indispensable subject knowledge in the field of electronic information research.

The measurement theories and ways and means of the electric parameters of the antennas are presented. default.zh: 本课程是工科院校电子类专业的一门专业基础课，也是智能测控工程专业本科生的必修课程。 本课程重点讲解时间和频率、电压、信号波形、信号频谱的基本方法及相关测量仪器的工作原理；讲解数据域测试及逻辑分析仪的基本原理；简介现代新技术在电子测量中的应用及电子测量仪器和测量技术发展的状况。通过本课程的学习，使学生具备电子测量的基本理论、基础知识，为后续专业课程的学习及为今后的科研工作提供坚实的理论基础和实际知识。
default.en: The Principle of Electronic Measurement is a basic specialty course for electronic majors in engineering universities, it is also a compulsory course for the undergraduates who are in the major of Intelligent Measurement and Control Engineering. This course mainly discusses the basic measuring methods of time, frequency, voltage, signal waveform, signal spectrum and the working principle of related measuring instruments. Then the basic principles of data domain test and the instruments of logic analyzer are discussed. At last, the application of modern new technology in electronic measurement and the development of electronic measurement instruments and measurement technology are introduced. Upon successful completion of this course, students are expected to master the basic theory and knowledge of electronic measurement, which will provide solid theoretical basis and practical knowledge for the subsequent study of professional courses and for the future scientific research work.

default.zh: 自动测试系统是现代科技发展必需的测试手段，是测量学科的前沿技术，其关键技术是总线接口和软件。课程介绍自动测试系统的基本概念与发展、现代自动测试系统的体系结构和工作原理，重点讲述测试仪器标准总线接口技术（GPIB、VXI、PXI、LXI）、软件设计规范和自动测试系统的集成方法。通过课堂和实验教学，培养学生具备一定的自动测试系统仪器硬件接口和软件设计能力，能正确选择标准接口的自动测试设备并编写相应系统软件组建现代自动测试系统。
default.en: As a cutting-edge technology of measurement disciplines, Automatic Test System, with bus interface and software as its key technology, is a necessary testing facility for modern science and technology development. This course introduces the basic concept and the development trend of the modern Automatic Test System. And then formulates its architecture and working principles in detail, focus on the standard bus interface technology (GPIB, VXI, PXI, LXI), software design specifications, and automatic test system integration methods. Through classroom and laboratory teaching, the students will possess design capabilities for both the hardware interface and software for automatic test system instruments, who also should be able to select the automatic test equipment with standard interfaces and design the corresponding system software to build a modern automatic test system correctly.

default.zh: 《人工智能基础》课程是一门理论性、应用性较强的专业基础课。课堂教学中主要讲授人工智能的基本概念、问题求解方法、知识推理与规划、简单决策系统、通讯与感知等内容，研讨教学中主要通过典型人工智能系统设计及验证帮助学生体验人工智能方法的应用实践过程。 本课程中涉及到的人工智能方法主要包括智能系统中的搜索方法、知识推理与规划方法、简单决策方法、图像感知方法等。 本课程旨在奠定学生在人工智能领域的理论与技术基础，建立学生在人工智能方面的知识结构，培养使用人工智能方法分析智能化问题、设计人工智能系统的能力，为后续智能专业技术学习与应用奠定基础，起到顶层引导作用，也为学生未来从事信息与通信工程、计算机等相关领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要基础。 本课程中涉及到的人工智能方法主要包括智能系统中的搜索方法、知识推理与规划方法、简单决策方法、图像感知方法等。 本课程旨在奠定学生在人工智能领域的理论与技术基础，建立学生在人工智能方面的知识结构，培养使用人工智能方法分析智能化问题、设计人工智能系统的能力，为后续智能专业技术学习与应用奠定基础，起到顶层引导作用，也为学生未来从事信息与通信工程、计算机等相关领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要基础。
default.en: Artificial Intelligence(AI) is a professional foundation course that is really theoretical and useful. The basic concepts, methods about sloving problems, inferencing and planning, simple decision system, communication and perception will be mainly introduced in this course. This course can truly help student experience the whole process of implementing AI methods through designing and verifying some typical AI system in discussing class. AI methods in this course mainly include the searching method, inferencing and planning, simple decision-making methods and image processing. The aim of this course is to lay a good foundation about AI theory for students, help them build up the theoretical structure and have the ability to analyze some problems by AI methods and design some AI systems. This course can also be good for their future learning on more professional AI technology and lead them to the right way. In addition, students who major in information and communication engineering, computer science and other related fields can also get better performance after taking this class.

default.zh: 《智能感知理论与技术》是智能测控工程专业的专业核心课。信息感知利用传感系统对被测对象变化进行测量，是信息处理的首要环节。信息感知与计算机技术的发展促进了信息感知系统的智能化。现代智能感知系统具有“感、知、联”一体化的功能，涉及数据采集、数据传输与信息处理，包括传感、信息采集、过滤、压缩、多源信息融合等环节，是环境监测、智能制造、智能测控装备等多种应用系统的重要知识基础。 本课程主要介绍智能感知系统的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法。课程教学内容主要包括智能感知系统体系结构、智能传感器设计与应用、多源信息融合模型及结构、统计推断与估计理论、智能计算与识别理论、多传感器检测融合、估计融合及识别融合方法等。通过课程的学习，使学生了解智能感知理论与技术的历史、发展以及国内外研究热点，理解智能感知系统的组成、原理及应用，掌握智能感知系统的基本概念、基础理论、基本原理及基本方法等。
default.en: “Theory and Technology of Intelligent Sensing” is the core course of intelligent measurement and control engineering. Sensing is the first step of information processing, which uses the sensor system to measure the changes of the object. The development of sensing and computer technology promotes the intelligence of information sensing system. Modern intelligent sensing system has the function of "sense, knowledge and connection" integration, which involves data acquisition, data transmission and information processing, including sensing, information acquisition, filtering, compression, multi-source information fusion and other links. It is an important knowledge base for various application systems such as environmental monitoring, intelligent manufacturing, intelligent measurement and control equipment. This course mainly introduces the basic concepts, principles and methods of intelligent sensing system. The course mainly includes the architecture of intelligent sensing system, design and application of intelligent sensors, multi-source information fusion model and structure, statistical inference and estimation theory, intelligent computing and recognition theory, multi-sensor detection fusion, estimation fusion and recognition fusion methods. Through the study of the course, students can understand the history and development of intelligent sensing theory and technology, as well as research hotspots at home and abroad, understand the composition, principle and application of intelligent perception system, and master the basic concepts, basic theories, basic principles and basic methods of intelligent sensing system.

default.zh: 嵌入式系统是测控技术及仪器专业的重要应用技术基础课程。随着后PC时代的到来，嵌入式系统已成为当前应用最广、最有发展前景的IT应用技术之一，它融合了电子、计算机、微电子等多种学科和技术，被广泛应用于航天、航空、工业控制、消费类电子、医疗仪器、汽车电子等领域。目前，嵌入式系统产品正不断渗透各个行业，并以其应用领域广、人才需求大等优势，获得更大的关注，特别是将来3G和物联网的普及与推广，应用前景非常好。嵌入式系统是在单片机上发展而来，它是以应用为中心，以计算机技术为基础，软硬件可裁剪，适用于系统，对功能、可靠性、成本、体积、功耗有严格要求的专用计算机系统。它涉及硬件设计和软件开发，具有综合性、系统性和实践性等特点。 本课程针对嵌入式系统设计入门起点高，对计算机基础理论及实践能力要求较高的特点，采用课程课堂讲授与实验相结合的教学方法，突出基础和全面，采用最主流的处理器和操作系统，让学生完整地实践嵌入式系统项目开发的基本流程， 从而使学生深刻理解嵌入式系统的基本要素和概念，掌握嵌入式系统软硬件设计基本原理和方法，使其初步具备嵌入式系统设计能力，为学生未来从事电子设计及相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要的基础。
default.en: In this class, the fundamentals of embedded system hardware and firmware design will be explored. Issues such as embedded processor selection, hardware/firmware partitioning, design methods of embedded system, development tools, firmware architecture, firmware design, and firmware debugging will be discussed. ARM microprocessor and Linux are one of the most popular embedded microprocessors and embedded operating systems, respectively. By using an ARM9 experimental box, each student will experience how to develop and download bootloader, transplant Linux operating system, and develop application programs and drivers of peripheral equipments. The course will culminate with a significant final project which will help students to deepen their comprehension to most knowledge of this course. Depending on the interests of the students, other topics may be covered.

default.zh: 试验与评估是为了解产品功能性能或事件结果而进行的活动，是科学研究、工程技术与管理中得到广泛应用的理论与方法。随着产品的日益复杂化，诸如车辆、飞行器、船舶、智能系统、分布式系统等复杂产品广泛应用，需要通过试验完成其性能、效能及体系能力的评估。 “试验理论与方法”课程主要面向智能测控工程专业本科生开设。课程面向电子信息（含网络）领域的设备级、系统级及体系级的产品试验评估。课程理论部分讲授与电子信息类产品试验评估相关的基本概念，以及基于贝叶斯方法的小子样试验评估方法、序贯试验方法、回归分析试验方法、蒙特卡洛试验法等基础理论，注重基础性、注重共性方法、偏重电子信息类产品的共性基础。课程实现部分讲授试验设计方法，基于真实资源、全数字仿真和虚实混合的试验系统构建方法/技术，运行控制方法/技术、试验数据分析与处理方法，性能评估和效能评估方法，聚焦电子信息类产品、基于网络的信息系统、聚焦更大规模的分布式体系级产品。实验课内容则以武器装备系统/体系试验与评估为题，既体现产品试验的复杂特征和广域特征，又契合我校办学和人才培养特色。 通过课程学习，使学生初步具备设计复杂系统产品试验系统和评估复杂系统产品的能力，为开展复杂和大规模系统产品的试验与评估建立基础。
default.en: Test and evaluation is an activity to understand product performance or event results. It is a theory and method widely used in scientific research, engineering technology and management. With the increasing complexity of products, such as vehicles, aircraft, ships, intelligent systems, distributed systems and other complex products are widely used. It is necessary to complete the evaluation of their performance, effectiveness and system capability through test. The course of "The Theory and Method of Test" is mainly offered for undergraduates majoring in intelligent measurement and control engineering. The course is oriented to the equipment level, system level and system of system (SOS) level product test evaluation in the field of electronic information (including network). The theory part of the course teaches the basic concepts related to the test and evaluation of electronic information products, as well as the basic theories such as small sample test and evaluation method based on Bayesian method, sequential test method, regression analysis test method, and Monte Carlo test method. It focuses on the basics, common methods, and the common basis of electronic information products. The implementation part of the course teaches experimental design methods, construction methods/technologies of test systems based on real resources, all-digital simulation and mixture of virtual and real, operation control methods/technologies, test data analysis and processing methods, performance evaluation and effectiveness evaluation methods, focusing on electronic information products, web-based information systems, and more large-scale distributed system level products. The content of the experiment course is themed with weapon equipment system/SOS test and evaluation, which not only reflects the complex characteristics and wide area characteristics of product test, but also conforms to the characteristics of our school running and talent training. Through the course study, students will initially have the ability to design complex system product test systems and evaluate complex system products, so as to establish a foundation for conducting complex and large-scale system product test and evaluation.

default.zh: 《生物医学传感技术》是生物技术（+智能测控工程双学士学位）专业的专业核心课。生物医学传感技术是生物医学工程领域的一个重要研究方向，也是当前国际上发展最为迅速的生命科学与人工智能领域中智能感知的重要研究内容，该技术有效地促进了传感技术在生物医学领域的基础研究、疾病的诊断和治疗等领域的广泛应用。 本课程主要介绍生物医学传感技术的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法。课程教学内容主要包括人体生理信息和传感技术的基础知识、物理量传感技术、化学量传感技术、生物量传感技术以及新型生物医学传感技术。通过课程的学习，使学生了解生物医学传感技术的历史、发展以及国内外研究热点，理解生物医学传感器的组成、原理及应用，掌握生物医学传感技术的基本概念、基础理论、基本原理及基本方法等。
default.en: “Biomedical Sensing Technology” is a core course for the Biotechnology (+Intelligent Measurement and Control Engineering Double Bachelor's Degree) major. Biomedical sensing technology is an important research direction in the field of biomedical engineering, and also an important research content of intelligent perception in the rapidly developing life sciences and artificial intelligence fields internationally. This technology effectively promotes the widespread application of sensing technology in basic research, disease diagnosis and treatment in the biomedical field. This course mainly introduces the basic concepts, principles, and methods of biomedical sensing technology. The course teaching content mainly includes the basic knowledge of human physiological information and sensing technology, physical quantity sensing technology, chemical quantity sensing technology, biomass sensing technology, and new biomedical sensing technology. Through the study of the course, students will understand the history, development, and research hotspots of biomedical sensing technology at home and abroad, comprehend the composition, principles, and applications of biomedical sensors, and master the basic concepts, theories, principles, and methods of biomedical sensing technology.

default.zh: “医学信号分析与处理”是生物技术（+智能测控工程双学士学位）专业的核心课程，集中了该领域的基本概念、基本原理和基本分析方法，其教学目的是综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关数学知识与专业技能，构建医学信号分析与处理的数学模型，进而向技术实现过渡，从而培养学生对医学信号分析与处理的能力以及基本应用技能训练，为该领域相关的技术研究构建理论基础。本课程以现代医学诊断和医疗设备的研制作为主要应用背景，立足于医学信号的检测、估计、滤波和处理的基本概念和基本分析方法，开展对平稳随机和非平稳随机两大类信号的分析与处理，并结合实例，力图将基础知识学习与后续科研工作相结合。通过本课程的学习，使学生对医学信号分析与处理的综合分析与解决问题的能力，以及生物医学领域基本知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: "Medical Signal Analysis and Processing" is the core course of the Biotechnology (+Double Bachelor's Degree in Intelligent Measurement and Control Engineering) major, which focuses on the basic concepts, principles, and analysis methods in the field. Its teaching purpose is to comprehensively apply the mathematical knowledge and professional skills learned in the prerequisite courses, construct mathematical models for medical signal analysis and processing, and then transition to technological implementation, to cultivate students' abilities in medical signal analysis and processing, as well as basic application skills training, and to build a theoretical foundation for related technological research in this field.
