This course takes the development of modern medical diagnosis and medical equipment as the main application background, focusing on the basic concepts and analysis methods of medical signal detection, estimation, filtering, and processing. It conducts analysis and processing of stationary and non-stationary random signals, and combines examples to strive to combine basic knowledge learning with subsequent scientific research work. Through the study of this course, students will have the ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems in medical signal analysis and processing, as well as the ability to apply basic knowledge in the biomedical field, increase their innovation awareness, and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in learning outcomes.

default.zh: 生物医学测量是以人体及其它生物体为对象，研究对各种生命现象、状态、性质和成分进行测量的原理和技术的学科，是生物医学工程的重要分支。生物医学测量的任务旨在提供认识生命奥秘，了解生物体的结构、功能和疾病状态的方法和仪器，以促进生理学、诊断学及医学各领域的进步，并带动各种医疗器械的研究与开发。现代生物医学的进步是与生物医学测量与仪器的发展分不开的，而生物医学测量与仪器又是物理学、化学、信息科学和以电子技术为代表的各种现代工程技术与生物学和医学相结合的产物。
default.en: Biomedical measurement is a discipline that focuses on studying the principles and techniques for measuring various life phenomena, states, properties, and components in the human body and other biological organisms. It is an important branch of biomedical engineering. The mission of biomedical measurement is to provide methods and instruments to understand the mysteries of life, comprehend the structure, function, and disease states of organisms, thus promoting progress in physiology, diagnostics, and various medical fields, as well as driving research and development in various medical devices. The advancement of modern biomedicine is closely intertwined with the development of biomedical measurement and instruments, which in turn are products of the integration of physics, chemistry, information science, various modern engineering technologies represented by electronics, and biology and medicine.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向生物技术（+智能测控工程双学士学位）专业本科生开设。本课程基于Qt平台，介绍医用电子技术领域的典型应用开发，旨在帮助学生全面掌握医用仪器软件的基本原理和技术，深入理解医用仪器软件的设计与实现，并能够根据实际应用需求进行医用仪器软件设计开发。通过课程的学习，学生将掌握Qt开发环境、面向对象软件开发方法、以及基于Qt的人体生理参数检测、影像数据采集、传输及后处理软件的开发方法。此外，课程还将通过实验和案例分析，培养学生的问题分析和解决能力，提高其实际医用仪器软件设计应用的能力，使学生具备解决工程应用问题的能力。
default.en: This course is primarily designed for undergraduate students majoring in Biotechnology (dual bachelor's degree in Intelligent Measurement and Control Engineering). Based on the Qt platform, the course introduces the development of typical applications in the field of medical electronic technology. It aims to help students comprehensively master the fundamental principles and techniques of medical instrument software, gain an in-depth understanding of its design and implementation, and enable them to design and develop medical instrument software according to practical application requirements. Through this course, students will acquire knowledge of the Qt development environment, object-oriented software development methods, and the development approaches for software related to human physiological parameter detection, medical imaging data acquisition, transmission, and post-processing using Qt. Additionally, the course will cultivate students' problem analysis and solving abilities through experiments and case studies, enhance their practical skills in medical instrument software design and application, and equip them with the capability to address engineering application challenges.

default.zh: 《人工智能生物学》是生物技术（+智能测控工程双学士学位）专业的专业方向核心课程，目的是使学生认识和理解生命科学计算问题，生物数据的表示与组织，生物数据管理、分析、挖掘、应用的基本算法，生物信息系统的基本原理、组成与运行方式，为学生今后设计、构造和应用生物信息学算法与系统，解决生命科学领域的计算问题奠定坚实的理论和技术基础。
default.en: "Artificial intelligence in Biomedical" is a core course in the Biotechnology (dual bachelor's degree in Intelligent Measurement and Control Engineering) program. It aims to enable students to recognize and understand computational problems in life sciences, the representation and organization of biological data, fundamental algorithms for managing, analyzing, mining, and applying biological data, as well as the basic principles, composition, and operational methods of biological information systems. This course lays a solid theoretical and technical foundation for students to design, construct, and apply bioinformatics algorithms and systems to address computational challenges in the field of life sciences.

default.zh: 《电磁场与微波技术》是工科电子工程、通信工程和测控技术类专业的一门重要技术基础课，是在学习了“大学物理”、“电路”等课程的基础上，深入学习无线电频谱中极为重要波段——微波领域的重要科目，是理论与工程性、实践性较强的课程。本课程的任务是使学生获得微波技术方面的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，全面系统地掌握现代微波工程领域的分析问题和解决问题的手段和方法，培养学生分析和解决实际问题的能力，为今后的深入学习和实际运用打好基础
default.en: Electromagnetic Field and Microwave Technology is an important technical basic course for students whose major is Electronic Engineering, Communication Engineering or Measurement and Control Technology. On the basis of preparatory courses like College Physics, Circuitry, this course continues to study in depth about Microwave which is a very important band in the radio spectrum, and it is a strong theoretical, engineering and practical comprehensive course. By studying this course, students could acquire the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic skills of microwave technology, and could master the means and methods of solving problems in the field of modern microwave engineering comprehensively and systematically. The course aims to develop students' abilities for analyzing and solving problems, which will lay the groundwork for further study and practical application.

default.zh: 《人工智能与机器学习》课程是一门理论性、应用性较强的专业基础课。课堂教学中主要讲授人工智能的基本概念、问题求解方法、知识推理与规划、简单决策系统、通讯与感知等内容，研讨教学中主要通过典型人工智能系统设计及验证帮助学生体验人工智能方法的应用实践过程。 本课程中涉及到的人工智能方法主要包括智能系统中的搜索方法、知识推理与规划方法、简单决策方法、通讯自然语言处理方法、图像感知方法等。 本课程旨在奠定学生在人工智能领域的理论与技术基础，建立学生在人工智能方面的知识结构，培养使用人工智能方法分析智能化问题、设计人工智能系统的能力，为后续智能专业技术学习与应用奠定基础，起到顶层引导作用，也为学生未来从事信息与通信工程、计算机等相关领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要基础。
default.en: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence is a professional foundation course that is really theoretical and useful. The basic concepts, methods about sloving problems, inferencing and planning, simple decision system, communication and perception will be mainly introduced in this course. This course can truly help student experience the whole process of implementing AI methods through designing and verifying some typical AI system in discussing class. AI methods in this course mainly include the searching method, inferencing and planning, simple decision-making methods, natural language processing and image processing. The aim of this course is to lay a good foundation about AI theory for students, help them build up the theoretical structure and have the ability to analyze some problems by AI methods and design some AI systems. This course can also be good for their future learning on more professional AI technology and lead them to the right way. In addition, students who major in information and communication engineering, computer science and other related fields can also get better performance after taking this class.

default.zh: 自动测试系统是现代科技发展必需的测试手段，是测量学科的前沿技术，其关键技术是总线接口和软件。课程介绍自动测试系统的基本概念与发展、现代自动测试系统的体系结构和工作原理，重点讲述测试仪器标准总线接口技术（VXI、PXI、LXI等）、软件设计规范和自动测试系统的集成方法。通过课堂和实验教学，培养学生具备一定的自动测试系统仪器硬件接口和软件设计能力，能正确选择标准接口的自动测试设备并编写相应系统软件组建现代自动测试系统。
default.en: As a cutting-edge technology of measurement disciplines, Automatic Test System, with bus interface and software as its key technology, is a necessary test facility for modern science and technology development. This curriculum firstly gives an overview of the basic concept and development trend of modern Automatic Test System. And then formulates its architecture and working principles in detail, focus on the standard bus interface technology (VXI, PXI, LXI), software design specifications, and automatic test system integration methods. Through classroom and laboratory teaching, the students will, to a certain extent, possess design capabilities for both the hardware interface and software for automatic test system instruments. They should be able to correctly select the automatic test equipment with standard interfaces and design the corresponding system software to build a modern automatic test system.

default.zh: 数学建模方法是电子信息类学生的的一门选修课，课程的目的是要系统地学习数学建模的理论及应用，培养学生能将实际问题和数学模型相结合的能力，锻炼学生用一种科学的思维方法思考建模问题；学习如何使用数学建模方法解决实际问题，学习从不同的角度进行思考，应用不同的数学模型解决类似的问题，为今后进一步深造或工作奠定坚实的基础。 课程目标对学生的要求如下： 课程目标1. 理解和掌握数学建模五步法的过程和重要性，学习稳健性以及灵敏性等模型相关的概念以及在模型分析中作用，学习最优化模型、动力模型以及概率模型的主要特征以及分析方法。 课程目标2. 培养学生根据实际问题的进行独立思考，进行适当的简化和抽象，进而能和具体数学模型建立关联的能力，培养学生根据模型求解或者仿真结果对物理世界进行合理解释的能力。
default.en: Mathematical modeling is an elective course for students of electronic information. The purpose of the course is to enable students to s&ystematically study the theory and application of mathematical modeling, to cultivate students' ability to combine practical problems with mathematical models and to train students to think about modeling problems in a scientific way. Let students learn how to use mathematical modeling methods to solve practical problems, to think from different perspectives, to apply different mathematical models to solve similar problems, laying a solid foundation for further study or work in the future. The curriculum objectives for students are as follows: Objective 1. Understand and master the process and importance of five-steps in mathematical modeling. Learn about model-related concepts, for instance, robustness and sensitivity, and their roles in model analysis. Study the main characteristics and analysis methods of optimization model, dynamic model and probability model. Objective 2. Develop students’ abilities to think, simplify and abstract practical problems independently and properly, as well as establish contact between specific mathematical models and practical problems. Cultivate students to make a reasonable explanation of the physical world according to the simulation results of the established model.

default.zh: 课堂讲解主要内容如下： 第1章，计算机通信网络概论：计算机通信网络的形成与发展、计算机通信网络的定义与分类、计算机通信网络的组成与结构、计算机通信网络的分组交换技术的基本概念、网络体系结构与网络协议。 第2章，物理层：物理层与物理层协议基本概念、数据通信的基本概念、基带传输技术基本概念、频带传输技术基本概念。 第3章，数据链路层：数据链路层的基本概念、数据链路层协议的演变与发展、PPP协议基本工作原理。 第4章，介质访问控制子层：局域网技术的发展与演变、以太网的基本工作原理、交换式局域网与虚拟局域网技术、无线局域网的基本概念。 第5章，网络层：网络层与IP协议、IPv4协议、路由选择算法与分组交付、控制报文协议、地址解析协议、移动IP协议、IPv6协议。 第6章，传输层：传输层与传输层协议、UDP协议、TCP协议。 第7章，应用层：Internet应用与应用层协议的分类、域名系统、电子邮件服务与SMTP协议、Web与基于Web的网络应用。 实验主要内容如下： 实验1，组建局域网：完成双绞线的制作与测试、组建无线局域网。 实验2，常用网络命令的使用：ping命令、ipconfig命令、tracert命令、netstat命令、arp命令、hostname命令、nslookup命令、net命令。 实验3，协议分析实验：使用Wireshark分析IP协议、TCP协议、ARP协议、ICMP和DHCP协议。 实验4，Windows服务器安装与配置：利用MS IIS服务器安装与配置Web网站并在服务端和客户端进行验证、FTP服务器的配置及功能验证。
default.en: Lecture: Chapter 1, Introduction to Computer Communication Networks: The Formation, Development, Definition, Composition and Structure of Computer Communication Networks; the Basic Concept of Packet Switching Technology in Computer Communication Networks; Network Architecture and Network Protocols. Chapter 2, Physical Layer: The Basic Concepts of Physical Layer and Physical Layer Protocols; Basic Concepts of Data Communication; The Basic Concept of Base Band Transmission Technology; The Basic Concept of Frequency Band Transmission Technology. Chapter 3, Data Link Layer: The Causes of Transmission Error; The Basic Concept of Data Link Layer; The Evolution and Development of Data Link Layer Protocols; The Basic Working Principle of PPP. Chapter 4, MAC Sublayer: The Development and Evolution of LAN Technology; The Basic Working Principle of Ethernet, Switch LAN and Virtual LAN; The Basic Concept of WLAN. Chapter 5, Network layer: Network Layer and IP; IPv4; Routing Algorithms and Packet Forwarding; ICMP; ARP; IPv6. Chapter 6, Transport Layer: Transport Layer and Transport Layer Protocol; UDP; TCP. Chapter 7, Application Layer: Internet Applications and The Classification of Application Layer Protocols; Domain Name System; E-mail Service and SMTP; Web and Web-based Network Applications. Lab: Experiment 1, Setting up LAN: Production and Testing of Twisted pair; Setting up WLAN. Experiment 2, The Use of Commonly Used Network Commands: ping Command; ipconfig Command; tracert Command; netstat Command; arp Command; hostname Command; nslookup Command; net Command. Experiment 3, Protocol Analysis Experiment: Using Wireshark to Analysis IP, TCP, ARP, ICMP and DHCP. Experiment 4, Windows Server Installation and Configuration: Building a Web site and FTP server with MS IIS, and making basically function test on both server and client sides.

default.zh: 无线自组织网络是通信工程专业学生的一门专业课，通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握无线自组织网络的特点和典型应用，理解无线自组织网络的Mac层，路由协议等关键原理和技术，为设计各种实际环境下的无线自组织网络打下基础。本课程可培养学生综合运用之前所学的通信原理、计算机网络等课程知识的能力。
default.en: Ad hoc network and application is an optional course in communication major. With the study of this course, students can understand the features and application of Ad hoc network. On this basis, students can grasp various concepts about MAC layer of network and fundamentals of various routing protocols. All these help students lay a foundation for designing a practical ad hoc network. What’s more, this course can improve the ability of students in solving practical problems of communication and computer network.

default.zh: 光通信网是通信工程专业学生的专业选修课，该课程作为电通信和光通信之间的纽带，主要教学目标是帮助学生建立光纤通信网络的概念，明确光纤通信网络的基本构成及光信号传输的基本理论，并进一步掌握光纤通信网络中的各项指标，继而掌握系统及网络各组成部分的实现过程，最终掌握光纤通信系统、网络的设计方法。该课程是通信工程专业本科生继续学习各种光通信课程的基础，同时也是帮助学生将之前所学的各门专业课程有机结合起来的桥梁，为培养学生解决光纤通信系统及网络的实际问题的能力奠定基础。
default.en: As an optional course in communication major, optical communication network acts as a bridge between electric communication and optical communication. With the study in this course, students can understand the important concepts and theories about optical network. On this basis, students can grasp various network metrics and working process of each component of network. At last, this course can help students learn the design method of optical network. With regard to students who want to study further in optical communication, this course provides an access to learning other optical course. This course is the integration of some courses, such as fundamental of communication, electromagnetic field and electromagnetic wave, microwave technology, computer communication network. What’s more, this course can enhance the ability of students in solving the practical problem about optical communication system and network.

default.zh: 媒体通信是信息网络时代数字汇聚的产物，是多媒体技术和通信网络两个领域结合的交叉学科。本课程首先为学生讲解多媒体业务及其应用给通信网络传输带来的问题，然后讨论多媒体通信网络中的协议涉及问题，并逐个阐述多媒体业务传输过程中所采用的方法和措施。本课程注重阐述技术和方法，把多媒体和通信网络技术产生和发展相关的知识融入到教学内容中，重点讲解多媒体通信网络及其应用相关的基本概念、原理、思路、应用和技术发展，让学生了解并感受到信息技术的创新和发展。
default.en: Along with digital convergence in Information Network era, Multimedia Communication is a cross discipline integration of Multimedia Technology and Communication Networks. This course firstly explain communication problems for multimedia service and application. Then protocols in multimedia communication networks are discussed for multimedia transmission. Finally, methods and solutions are introduced to support multimedia service in transmission processes. Based on development and relevant knowledges for multimedia transmission in communications networks, techniques and methods are focused in this course. With explanation for the basic concept, principle, method, application and the technical development in multimedia communication network, students can understand and feel the innovation and development of information technology.

default.zh: 物联网通信技术与应用是通信工程专业本科生的专业任选课，本课程的目标是在前期通信工程方向课程学习的基础上，进一步与物联网应用相结合，培养学生在物联网通信技术应用方面的综合分析能力与设计能力，进而了解物联网通信技术的需求及其发展。 本课程主要讲授物联网的基础知识及物联网通信技术的综合应用，使学生在对物联网有一个全局认识的基础上，较深入地了解物联网感知控制层及网络传输层主要通信技术，并进一步激发学生探索物联网通信技术应用的兴趣。掌握ZigBee通信、蓝牙通信、RFID技术及Wi-Fi通信技术的基础上，进一步掌握移动通信网络、M2M及WSN技术在物联网网络传输层的应用，了解物联网在电网、交通、物流及环境监测方面的综合应用，并在此基础上掌握短距离无线通信模块的基本使用。
default.en: The course “Internet of Things Communication Technology and Applications” is an optional course offered by the Department of Communication Engineering. This course aims at improving students’ comprehensive analysis ability and design ability to apply communication technologies in the study of IOT on the basis of early communication engineering courses, and also understand the requirements and developments of the IOT-Communication technologies. This course mainly lectures the basic knowledge of IOT and the applications of communication technologies in the field of IOT. Improve students’ comprehensive understanding of IOT technology and further more study the major communication technologies applied in the IOT to create interesting to combine the communication technologies with IOT applications. This course requests students study knowledge of ZigBee, Blustooth, RFID and Wi-Fi communication technologies and further more earn a good command of knowledge in the IOT application of mobile communication network, M2M and WSN technology, and also know about the IOT applications in the fields of Smart Grid, Intelligent Transportation System, logistics industry and environment monitoring.

default.zh: 《智能车联网技术与应用》是通信工程专业本科生选修课，是一个集中运用通信工程、人工智能、汽车工程、自动控制等技术多学科交叉的新兴课程，是一门培养学生了解车联网基础知识，掌握智能车联网系统工程设计能力的专业技术课。通过课程学习，有助于学生了解智能车联网前沿技术，对于学生未来的发展有很好的促进作用。课程的主要内容包括：（1）面向车联网系统总体设计的应用需求，学习车联网基本概念、原理、组成，了解国内外技术标准化发展现状和未来发展趋势，明确其基本应用需求、增强应用需求；（2）针对智能车联网系统的工程设计需求和运行维护需求，学习智能网联汽车概念、体系架构以及关键技术（环境感知技术和高精度定位技术等）；（3）面向车联网系统的性能设计要求，学习国内标准体系C-V2X两个阶段（LTE-V2X和NR-V2X）的网络架构和关键技术，了解国外标准体系IEEE 802.11p的网络架构和关键技术及其与C-V2X的对比分析结论；（4）面向智能车联网系统工程仿真实践需求，开展一系列典型车联网应用场景建模和仿真。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握智能车联网技术的原理和应用，了解其在智能交通系统中的作用和价值，为将来从事车联网相关领域的研究和工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: “Technology and application in intelligent Internet of vehicles” is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in communication engineering. It is an emerging interdisciplinary course that focuses on communication engineering, artificial intelligence, automotive engineering, automatic control and other technologies. It is a professional technical course to train students to understand the basic knowledge of Internet of vehicles and master the engineering design ability of intelligent Internet of vehicle system. Through the course learning, it helps students to understand the advanced technology of intelligent Internet of vehicles, which plays a beneficial role in promoting the future development of students. The main contents of this course are presented as follows: (1) Facing the application needs of the overall design of Internet of vehicles system, students should learn the basic concepts, principles and compositions of Internet of vehicles, understand its research status and future development trend of technological standardization in China and abroad, and clarify its basic application needs and enhanced application needs; (2) According to the engineering design requirements and operation and maintenance requirements of the intelligent Internet of vehicles system, students learn the concepts, network architectures and key technologies (environmental awareness technology and high-precision positioning technology, etc.) of intelligent Internet of vehicles. (3) Students learn the network architectures and key technologies of the two stages of the standard system C-V2X in China, i.e., LTE-V2X and NR-V2X, and understand the network architectures and key technologies of the standard system IEEE 802.11p abroad and the comparison analysis conclusions with C-V2X, for the performance design requirements of Internet of vehicles system. (4) Aiming at the practical requirements of intelligent Internet of vehicles system during engineering simulation, a series of typical Internet of vehicles application scenario modeling and simulation are carried out. Through the study of this course, students will master the principle and application of intelligent Internet of vehicles, understand its role and value in intelligent transportation system, and lay a solid foundation for future research and work in related fields of Internet of vehicles.

default.zh: LabVIEW是一种图形化的编程语言，同时也是虚拟仪器技术、软件无线电技术、FPGA及嵌入式系统的开发、仿真、演示、验证环境。在自动化测控、通信工程、信号处理、机器人开发等领域有着广泛的应用。尤其是LabVIEW在软件无线电中的应用，为后续通信技术的教学、实验、研究和发展开辟全新的、直观的途径。本课程目的是使学生掌握LabVIEW语言程序设计的基本方法并逐步形成正确的程序设计思想，能够熟练地使用LabVIEW语言进行程序设计并具备调试程序的能力；从信号的产生、接收和处理入手，让学生进一步对通信系统有一个基本概念，对通信专业知识产生浓厚兴趣。基于项目开发的实验实践教学，进一步激发学生对实际工程项目的兴趣，培养学生的创新能力和程序设计的能力以及综合运用所学知识和解决实际的工程问题的能力，为学生在科创项目中提供新的实现方法。
default.en: LabVIEW is a kind of graph programming language. It is also a development, simulation, demonstration, verification environment of virtual instrument, software radio, FPGA and embedded system. It’s widely used in the automatical measure and control, communication engineering, signal processing, robot development and other fields. Especially, LabVIEW in the application of software radio provides a new way for the teaching, experiment, research and development of communication technology. The purpose of this course is to enable students to master the basic method of LabVIEW language programming and gradually form the correct programming ideas, and to enable to use the LabVIEW language programming and achieve the ability to debug the program. From the programming of signal generation, reception and processing, Students can acquire basic concepts of communication system and a strong interest in communication knowledge. The experimental teaching practice of project development will stimulate students’ interest in practical projects, cultivate students’ ability of innovation and programming and the ability of using knowledges to solve practical problems. It lays a solid foundation for the following courses like principles of communication and mobile communication.

default.zh: 《基于FPGA的创新实践》是电子信息类本科生的工程实践课。该课程作为学习硬件编程语言的入门课程，主要教学目标是帮助学生了解FPGA设计原理，建立FPGA开发和并行处理的概念，掌握使用EDA设计软件开发FPGA应用的基本方法，熟悉模块化设计以及功能建模和代码描述的转换。该课程是该领域本科生后续工程实践的基石，同时也是帮助学生将“串行处理”思维扩展到“并行处理”思维的导航，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础。 通过本课程的课堂教学、实验操作和计算机仿真等环节，着重培养学生们软硬件的综合分析与设计能力，增加创新意识。 课程的主要内容如下： 1. 掌握Verilog HDL语言设计方法，掌握Verilog HDL工程的逻辑结构，了解硬件描述语言与实际硬件资源的对应关系，并能根据设计要求利用Verilog HDL语言进行程序设计。 2. 了解FPGA的开发流程，熟悉FPGA开发板的功能，掌握FPGA设计软件的使用方法，学习利用FPGA设计软件实现具体功能并进行调试。 3. 掌握从理论描述到功能建模并实现具体功能的开发过程。熟悉FPGA IP核资源的使用方法，了解FPGA的开发设计流程。掌握工程项目的分解方法，理解FPGA的模块化设计思想，培养团队合作解决问题的能力，锻炼工程项目实践中的设计、组织与调试等方面的能力。
default.en: Innovative Practice Based on FPGA is an engineering practice course for undergraduates majoring in electronic information. This course serves as an introductory course for learning hardware programming languages, the main teaching goal is to help students understand the principle of the design of FPGA, establish the concept of development and parallel processing of FPGA, grasp the basic method of developing the application of FPGA by EDA design software, be familiar with modular design and conversion between functional modeling and code description. This course is the cornerstone of the follow-up engineering practice for undergraduates in this field. At the same time, it is also a navigation to help students expand the thinking of "serial processing" to "parallel processing" thinking. This course lays a foundation for cultivating students'ability to solve complex engineering problems. Through the classroom teaching, experimental operation and computer simulation, this course focuses on training students'comprehensive analysis and design ability of software and hardware, and increasing their innovative consciousness. The main contents of the course are as follows. 1. Grasp the design method of Verilog HDL language, master the logical structure of Verilog HDL project, understand the corresponding relationship between hardware description language and actual hardware resources, and use Verilog HDL language to program according to the design requirements. 2. Understanding the development process of the FPGA, familiarizing with the functions of the development board of the FPGA, mastering the methods of using the design software of the FPGA, learning to use the design software of the FPGA to realize the specific functions and debug them. 3. Master the development process from theoretical description to functional modeling and realization of specific functions. Familiar with the use of the IP core resources of the FPGA, understand the development and design process of the FPGA. Master the decomposition method of engineering project, understand the modular design idea of FPGA, cultivate the ability of team cooperation to solve problems, and exercise the ability of design, organization and debugging in engineering project practice.

default.zh: 《基于ARM的嵌入式系统设计与应用》属于电子信息类实践课II，是电子与信息工程学院技术基础课和具体工程实践之间的纽带。该课程是微机与微控制器原理、C语言与数据结构、电子线路基础、数字逻辑电路与系统等课程知识的综合实践应用，着重培养学生的硬件设计与应用能力。该课程的主要教学目标是帮助学生建立嵌入式系统的概念，掌握嵌入式系统软硬件的基本体系结构，掌握软硬件的开发方法以及相关开发工具的使用。通过本课程的学习，能够培养学生获得解决复杂工程问题的能力。本课程支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Applications and Designs of Embedded System Based on ARM belongs to the electronic information practical course II, which is the link between the technical foundation course and specific engineering practice of the School of Electronic and Information Engineering. This course is a comprehensive practical application of knowledge in courses such as principles of microcontrollers and microcontrollers, C language and data structures, fundamentals of electronic circuits, digital logic circuits and systems, with a focus on cultivating students' hardware design and application abilities. The main teaching objective of this course is to help students establish the concept of embedded systems, master the basic architecture of embedded system software and hardware, master the development methods of software and hardware, and use related development tools. Through the study of this course, students can be trained to acquire the ability to solve complex engineering problems. This course supports the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 本课程旨在给本科生介绍当前国际前沿的三维视频信号处理、压缩以及传输技术。内容涵盖立体视频和裸眼3D显示技术、3D信号深度图预测、多视点加深度图编码、以及抗误码的3D信号移动传输技术。
default.en: This course explains the basic principles and the state-of-the-art 3D video processing, compression and communications techniques. It covers several challenging issues of 3D video processing, including stereoscopic and autostereoscopic 3D display, depth estimation, multi-view video-plus-depth coding, and loss-resilient mobile 3D video transmission over error-prone networks.

default.zh: 作为通信系统中的一个重要环节，本课程重点讲授关于数据通信网络的基本概念、相关通信协议、数据通信网络的分析和建模技能、数据通信网络及网络节点的结构设计，以及数据通信网络的相关应用。课程对近年来发展迅猛的多跳无线数据通信网络进行了讨论，并以机会路由与网络编码的结合在有效数据转发中的应用，无线移动自组网络，水声无线传感器网络中的多项关键技术问题展开了分析和探讨。
default.en: As an important part in communication systems, this course includes the fundamental concepts, protocols, analysis and modelling techniques, architectures, and applications pertaining to data communications networks. In addition, this course conducts discussions on the challenges and solutions for the recently fast developing multi-hop wireless networks. The key technologies involved in the joint opportunistic routing and network coding approach for effective data forwarding, wireless mobile ad hoc networks, and underwater acoustic sensor networks are introduced and analyzed.

default.zh: 通过学习本课程，学生可以掌握：a）新一代物联网基本概况，关键技术及国际前沿研究课题； b）典型物联网系统（智能电网，智能交通）的基本概况，关键技术及国际前沿研究课题。帮助学生了解相关论题的最新发展动态，有助于本科生毕业论文选题和进行相关的学术发展规划。
default.en: Through learning this course, students can master: a) a new generation of Internet basic situation, key technology and the international frontier research topic; b) typical iot system (smart grid, smart transportation) basic situation, key technology and international frontier research topic. Help students understand the topic of the latest developments, help them selected topic and related academic development plan.

default.zh: 随着互联网与智能化技术的深度融合，计算机网络已成为信息社会的核心基础设施。本课程以"互联网+教育"理念为指引，采用理论与实践相结合的教学方式，旨在帮助学生系统建立计算机网络的整体知识架构，深入理解五层协议体系结构的基本原理与核心协议，掌握数据封装与传输全过程。 课程内容涵盖计算机网络五层协议体系结构的完整知识体系：物理层数据传输基础、数据链路层帧封装与差错控制、网络层IP协议与路由算法、传输层TCP与UDP机制、应用层典型协议（HTTP、DNS、FTP、SMTP等）。通过精心设计的课程内容，学生能够从整体上把握互联网的工作机制，理解数据包从源主机到目的主机的完整传输流程，具备基本的网络分析能力。 课程注重能力培养的双重达成：聚焦网络体系结构认知与核心协议原理的掌握，培养学生运用网络知识分析实际问题的能力；侧重文献检索与综述撰写能力，通过引导学生跟踪智能网络（尤其是基于强化学习的网络设计）等前沿领域，查阅国际前沿研究论文，撰写计算机网络技术综述报告，锻炼归纳总结与学术视野拓展能力。 教学方法采用启发式、互动式与案例式教学相结合的模式。教师通过层层递进的问题链设计，引导学生从被动接受知识转变为主动探索知识，建立系统的逻辑思维框架；同时结合小组讨论与汇报展示，培养学生团队协作能力与沟通表达能力。考核方式多元，全面评估学生对网络知识体系的理解深度与工程实践能力。
default.en: As the deep integration of internet and intelligent technologies continues to reshape modern society, computer networks have become a fundamental infrastructure of the information age. Guided by the philosophy of "Internet + Education," this course adopts a blended approach combining theory and practice, aiming to help students establish a systematic knowledge framework of computer networks, thoroughly understand the fundamental principles of the five-layer protocol architecture and core protocols, and master the complete process of data encapsulation and transmission. The course content covers the comprehensive five-layer protocol architecture: foundational physical layer data transmission, data link layer frame encapsulation and error control, network layer IP protocol and routing algorithms, transport layer TCP and UDP mechanisms, and application layer protocols including HTTP, DNS, FTP, and SMTP. Through carefully designed coursework, students will gain an overall understanding of how the internet operates, comprehend the end-to-end data packet transmission process, and develop essential capabilities in network analysis. The course emphasizes a dual-track approach to capability development. Goal 1 focuses on building a thorough understanding of network architecture and core protocol principles, cultivating students' ability to apply network knowledge to analyze practical problems. Goal 2 emphasizes literature retrieval and technical review writing, guiding students to track cutting-edge developments in intelligent networking—particularly reinforcement learning-based network design—by consulting international frontier research papers and writing technical review reports, thereby enhancing their synthesis skills and academic perspective. The teaching methodology integrates heuristic, interactive, and case-based approaches. Teachers guide students through progressively structured question chains, transitioning them from passive knowledge reception to active exploration, thereby building systematic logical thinking frameworks. Collaborative learning through group discussions and presentations nurtures teamwork skills and communication abilities. Assessment is diversified to comprehensively evaluate students' depth of understanding and engineering practical capabilities.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22EI32181F 课程名称： 信息处理的数学基础 总学时：32 理论学时：24 实验学时：8 学分：2.0 开课单位：电子与信息工程学院 授课对象：智能信息工程辅修专业 开课学期：2秋 先修课程：工科数学分析、代数与几何 二、课程简介 信息处理的数学基础是智能信息工程辅修专业一门基础课，其内容是通过提炼智能信息工程专业课程中所涉及的主要数学知识，并不失严谨性和准确性地有机融合在一起而形成，其基本概念、基本理论与基本方法在电子信息类学科中都发挥着重要作用。 本课程的教学目的是为辅修智能信息工程专业的学生打好数学基础，为其学习智能信息工程专业的后续课程提供必要的数学支撑。通过理论学习，使学生能够正确地理解智能信息工程专业所涉及的基本数学概念，启发学生的学习兴趣，培养学生的数学思维和创新能力，使学生具备较强的运用基础理论知识分析、解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22EI32181F Course Title：Mathematical Foundations for Information Processing Credit Hours：32 Lecture：24 Lab：8 Credit(s)：2.0 Offering Department: School of Electronics and Information Engineering Students: Intelligent Information Engineering Term: Fall, Second year; Open Prerequisites: Mathematical Analysis for Engineering, Algebra and Geometry 2.Course Description Mathematical Foundations for Information Processing is a basic course of the minor in intelligent information engineering. Its content is formed by refining the main mathematical knowledge involved in the courses of intelligent information engineering, without any rigor and accuracy. Basic concepts, basic theories, and basic methods of this course play an important role in the electronic information discipline. The aim of this course is to lay a solid foundation for students majoring in intelligent information engineering, and to provide necessary mathematical support for students to study the follow-up courses of intelligent information engineering. Through theoretical study, the course makes students correctly understand the basic mathematical concepts involved in the major in intelligent information engineering, inspires students' interest in learning, cultivates students' mathematical thinking and innovative ability, and equips students with the ability to apply basic theoretical knowledge to analyze and solve practical problems.

default.zh: 课堂讲解主要内容如下： 第1章，计算机通信网络概论：计算机通信网络的形成与发展、计算机通信网络的定义与分类、计算机通信网络的组成与结构、计算机通信网络的分组交换技术的基本概念、网络体系结构与网络协议。 第2章，物理层：物理层与物理层协议基本概念、数据通信的基本概念、基带传输技术基本概念、频带传输技术基本概念。 第3章，数据链路层：数据链路层的基本概念、数据链路层协议的演变与发展、PPP协议基本工作原理。 第4章，介质访问控制子层：局域网技术的发展与演变、以太网的基本工作原理、交换式局域网与虚拟局域网技术、无线局域网的基本概念。 第5章，网络层：网络层与IP协议、IPv4协议、路由选择算法与分组交付、控制报文协议、地址解析协议、移动IP协议、IPv6协议。 第6章，传输层：传输层与传输层协议、UDP协议、TCP协议。 第7章，应用层：Internet应用与应用层协议的分类、域名系统、电子邮件服务与SMTP协议、Web与基于Web的网络应用。 实验主要内容如下： 实验1，组建局域网：完成双绞线的制作与测试、组建无线局域网。 实验2，常用网络命令的使用：ping命令、ipconfig命令、tracert命令、netstat命令、arp命令、hostname命令、nslookup命令、net命令。 实验3，协议分析实验：使用Wireshark分析IP协议、TCP协议、ARP协议、ICMP和DHCP协议。 实验4，Windows服务器安装与配置：利用MS IIS服务器安装与配置Web网站并在服务端和客户端进行验证、FTP服务器的配置及功能验证。
default.en: Lecture: Chapter 1, Introduction to Computer Communication Networks: The Formation, Development, Definition, Composition and Structure of Computer Communication Networks; the Basic Concept of Packet Switching Technology in Computer Communication Networks; Network Architecture and Network Protocols. Chapter 2, Physical Layer: The Basic Concepts of Physical Layer and Physical Layer Protocols; Basic Concepts of Data Communication; The Basic Concept of Base Band Transmission Technology; The Basic Concept of Frequency Band Transmission Technology. Chapter 3, Data Link Layer: The Causes of Transmission Error; The Basic Concept of Data Link Layer; The Evolution and Development of Data Link Layer Protocols; The Basic Working Principle of PPP. Chapter 4, MAC Sublayer: The Development and Evolution of LAN Technology; The Basic Working Principle of Ethernet, Switch LAN and Virtual LAN; The Basic Concept of WLAN. Chapter 5, Network layer: Network Layer and IP; IPv4; Routing Algorithms and Packet Forwarding; ICMP; ARP; IPv6. Chapter 6, Transport Layer: Transport Layer and Transport Layer Protocol; UDP; TCP. Chapter 7, Application Layer: Internet Applications and The Classification of Application Layer Protocols; Domain Name System; E-mail Service and SMTP; Web and Web-based Network Applications. Lab: Experiment 1, Setting up LAN: Production and Testing of Twisted pair; Setting up WLAN. Experiment 2, The Use of Commonly Used Network Commands: ping Command; ipconfig Command; tracert Command; netstat Command; ARP Command; hostname Command; nslookup Command; net Command. Experiment 3, Protocol Analysis Experiment: Using Wireshark to Analysis IP, TCP, ARP, ICMP and DHCP. Experiment 4, Windows Server Installation and Configuration: Building a Web site and FTP server with MS IIS, and making basically function test on both server and client sides.

default.zh: 无线通信信号处理是通信技术的核心和基础，该领域传统方法基本上都是基于随机过程的建模方法。由于人工智能技术的发展，深度学习已经逐步成为无线通信信号处理领域的强有力工具。 本课程主要讲授深度学习技术的基本原理、深度学习训练方法和华为昇腾310人工智能芯片架构。以上述技术为基础，讲解利用深度学习解决调制方式识别、信号参数识别等无线通信信号处理核心问题的步骤和方法。形成具有我校通信专业特色的AI+专业课程。
default.en: communication signal processing is the core and foundation of communication technology, and traditional methods in this field are mostly based on stochastic process modeling methods. Due to the development of artificial intelligence technology, deep learning has gradually become a powerful tool in the field of wireless communication signal processing. the content of this course mainly includes the basic principles of deep learning technology, deep learning training methods, and the architecture of Huawei Ascend 310 artificial intelligence chip. Based on the above techniques, explain the steps and methods of using deep learning to solve core wireless communication signal processing problems such as modulation recognition and signal parameter recognition. Formulate AI+professional courses with the characteristics of our school's communication major.

default.zh: 无线电定位原理与技术是电子信息类等专业对于无线电定位能力培养的专业课程，课程以雷达系统为主讲授应用无线电技术进行目标距离、速度、角度测量以及高分辨成像的原理与应用，使学生了解和掌握无线电定位系统的一般设计和工作原理。该课程强调理论联系实际，注重培养学生分析、解决实际问题的能力和工程实践能力。课程主要内容包括雷达的基本组成，雷达工作基本方程，雷达各分系统的工作原理、雷达目标检测原理、雷达测距原理、测角原理、测速原理、以及典型新体制雷达发射机和接收机工作原理分析等。通过该课程的学习，可以培养学生对雷达系统分析与设计的基本能力，通过本课程的实践教学，使学生掌握采用无线电技术进行目标位置和速度测量的基本理论知识、基本技能及实现技术，具备软件开发能力，掌握分析和解决实际无线电定位技术中的相关技术问题和工程问题的能力，培养学生的创新思维以及工程意识、工程实践能力，为学生在未来工作中适应电子信息领域的电子技术发展奠定基础。
default.en: “Principles and Technique of Radio Detection and Ranging B” is a major course for electronic information majors to train positioning ability by the Radio technique. Base on radar (Radio Detection and Ranging) system, it mainly introduces the principles and applications of ranging measurement, angle measurement and velocity measurement by radar, which the general make students understand and grasp the design of radar. It emphasizes theory aligning with practice and develops students’ abilities in analyzing, solving the problems and engineering practice. Main contents of the course include the basic composition of radar, radar basic equation, the working principle of each radar subsystem, radar target detection principle, radar ranging principle, principle of angle measurement and velocity measurement, the working principles of transmitter and receiver of typical new radar system, etc. By taking this course, students can develop the basic ability of analysis and design of radar system. Through the practice in the course, it can train the student’s ability to apply the knowledge of the radar system in practice. Students can acquire the basic theoretical knowledge and skills on microcomputers and microcontrollers, to improve basic skills of Radio Detection and Ranging development. It make students develop the creative thinking and engineering consciousness and abilities, and to master the abilities of analyzing and solving technical and engineering problems related to Radio Detection and Ranging in practical electronic system design in order to lay a good foundation for the future in-depth study. In order to fit the development of electronic technology in the field of electronic information, this course is helpful for the elementary knowledge for future works.

default.zh: 主要讲授TMS320C54X的特点和硬件组成、总线结构、存储器分配、中央处理单元（CPU）、片内外设、硬件复位操作；寻址方式和指令系统；TMS320C54X的软件开发过程及开发工具、公共目标文件格式、常用汇编伪指令、链接器命令文件的编写与使用、汇编语言程序编写方法；CCS系统安装与设置、CCS菜单和工具栏、CCS中的编译器、汇编器和链接器选项设置、CCS中读取数据和数据的图形显示；程序流程控制、数据块传送、定点数的基本运算、长字运算和并行运算、FIR滤波器的DSP实现。TMS320C54X基本系统硬件设计。
default.en: In this course, the following aspects are described in detail: TMS320C54x serials fixed DSP’s characteristics and hardware Composition、bus-structure、memory allocation、central processing unit (CPU)、peripherals in chip、hardware reset operation; addressing mode and instruction system; software development process and development tools for TMS320C54x development、public object file format、assembly pseudo-commands used commonly、writing and using a linker command file、method of assembly language programming; CCS installation and setup、CCS menus and toolbars、CCS compiler、assembler and linker options、procedures developed by CCS、reading data and graphics display of the data in CCS; program flow control、data block transmission、basic operation of pointing-number、long word operation and parallel operation、DSP realization of FIR filter ;Hardware design of basic system.

default.zh: 电子对抗技术B是电子信息工程专业的专业选修课。本课程主要讲授电子对抗的基本概念、基本理论和技术，课程以雷达对抗为主线，内容涉及通信对抗、光电对抗等领域的部分相关知识。通过教学和实验相结合，让学生既学到相关理论知识，又通过实验获得更多的感性认识，使学生了解电子对抗技术在现代战争中的重要性，培养学生解决电子对抗系统中复杂工程问题的能力。电子对抗技术主要包括电子侦察、电子干扰和电子防护等内容。电子侦察主要讲解如何通过对敌方设备辐射信号的截获、测量、分析、识别及定位，获取技术参数及位置、类型、部署等情报。内容涉及信号环境与信号截获的基本知识、搜索式超外差接收机、信道化接收机、常用测向技术的基本原理、对辐射源的定位等。电子干扰主要介绍有源、无源干扰及干扰机原理，以及降低目标截面积的原理和方法。内容涉及遮盖性干扰、欺骗性干扰、干扰机构成及干扰能量计算等。电子防护包括电子反侦察、抗干扰等相关技术。本课程需要学生掌握电子侦察的基本概念、基本原理以及无线电信号侦察的相关技术；掌握电子干扰的相关原理和技术，了解干扰机的基本组成；掌握电子战中保护己方电子设备的相关技术和基本方法。
default.en: Electronic Countermeasure Technology B is an elective course for electronic information engineering majors. This course mainly teaches the basic concepts, theories, and techniques of electronic countermeasures. The course focuses on radar countermeasures and covers some related knowledge in the fields of communication countermeasures, optoelectronic countermeasures, etc. By combining teaching and experiments, students can learn relevant theoretical knowledge and gain more intuitive understanding through experiments, enabling them to understand the importance of electronic warfare technology in modern warfare and cultivating their ability to solve complex engineering problems in electronic warfare systems. The main content includes electronic reconnaissance, electronic jamming and electronic protection etc. Electronic reconnaissance mainly explains how to intercept, measure, analyze, identify and locate the radiation signal of an enemy equipment, and access to technical parameters, location, type, and deployment information. The content involves basic knowledge of signal environment and signal interception, search based superheterodyne receivers, channelized receivers, basic principles of commonly used direction finding techniques, and localization of radiation sources. Electronic jamming introduces the principles of active and passive interferences and the jammer, as well as the principles and methods that reduce the radar cross section. The content involves covering interference, deceptive interference, interference machine composition, and interference energy calculation. Electronic protection includes electronic anti-reconnaissance, anti-interference technology. In this course, students need to master the basic concepts, the basic principles and the related technologies of radio signal reconnaissance; grasp the principles and techniques of radar interference, understand the basic components of the electronic jammer; master the related technology and basic methods to protect one's own equipment during the electronic warfare.

default.zh: 软件无线电是本世纪初的成熟并发展起来的一项新兴的无线电技术。它利用日益发展的计算机技术，将无线电系统逐步软件化，使得当前无线电系统的功能、结构发生了变革性的变化。这些变化的基本内涵叶同时向其他领域蔓延和扩散，引发了雷达、导航、声纳、生物电子等信息获取与处理系统的根本性变化传。 本课程立足于实际通信、雷达、图像处理等系统，采用理论结合实践方式教学，直接从当今无线电系统实现的先进理念和基本概念入手，着重系统软件化结构、软件化基本方法等原理，着重培养学生软件无线电的基本理论和基本技能，提高综合运用所学专业知识的能力，加强学生对现代无线电技术的理解和应用能力。 课程主要内容包括：软件无线电的基本概念和原理、模型；软件无线电系统的实现方法、系统结构；数字上/下变频技术；数字信号调制及处理算法；软件无线电实际系统构成、系统设计方法；无线传感器软件化典型应用，如软件雷达、认知无线电、多源图像软件融合处理等。
default.en: Being a new essential radio technology, Software defined radio(SDR) plays most of important role in modern radio system. Utilizing computer technologies, SDR transfers classical radio system to an assembled software and makes revolution in many aspects of radio mechanism, such as radio functionality, system structure, and etc. Spreading in information sensing and processing fields, such as radar, sonar, navigation and bioelectronics, the fundamental connotation of SDR has been altering their foundation permanently. This course aims at cultivating SDR skills of student and improving their comprehensive knowledge of excising synthetically. Several primary principles are taught in this course, including basic concepts, principles, mathematical models, implements and structures of SDR, Digital Up/Down Converter and digital signal modulation and processing algorithms, SDR system design and application, software wireless sensor and etc.

default.zh: 电子系统建模与仿真基础是电子信息类I电子信息工程专业本科生的一门重要专业选修课，该课程是以雷达系统为核心的专业课程学习、研究及毕业设计的基础，同时也是帮助学生将“数理与自然科学基础课程”、“大类专业基础课程”、“专业方向核心课程”和“专业方向选修课程”等课程知识有机结合并融会贯通的桥梁，在培养学生分析、解决复杂工程问题的能力及雷达系统综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程以先修课程相关知识为基础，全面地讲述各种统计特性（概率密度函数、功率谱密度）杂波的产生、参数估计及检验方法，并从目标散射模型、雷达信号波形、雷达信号处理等方面介绍雷达系统建模与仿真的基本概念与方法。该课程作为以“随机信号分析”为代表的信号分析与处理系列课程与以“雷达系统”为代表的电子系统应用之间的纽带，主要教学目标是培养学生扎实的系统建模和仿真理论基础，提高综合运用专业知识水平，掌握电子系统仿真的基本原理和方法，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成，并为从事雷达等复杂电子系统的设计与分析打下坚实基础。
default.en: is a professional selected course for senior undergraduates in electronic and information engineering, which is the fundamental of subsequent courses and graduation project. The course aims to build bridges among the following four types of curriculum system for students: mathematics and physics fundamental courses, major basic courses, professional compulsory courses, professional selected courses. The course introduces generation, parameter estimation and test methods for clutter with specific PDF and PSD, and explores fundamental methods for radar system simulation from target models, radar waveform and radar signal processing etc. Topics covered include: outline of system simulation, radar system simulation types; Monte Carlo method and importance sampling; random white and color noise generation; non-Gaussian coherent clutter generation; clutter parameter and PDF estimation; goodness-of-fit and correlation test; target and clutter models; target detection models; target parameter estimation models; spatial signal and noise models, and beam-forming simulation; radar data processing models, etc.

default.zh: 在互联网、政治经济、社会、公共卫生、金融、医疗健康、环境、海洋等等各个领域，都存在着PB量级的数据有待研究，且大数据分析的结果已经产生实际效应。本课程将从数据统计分析的数学基础、大数据智能分析与处理方法、大数据的分布式处理与并行计算以及大数据的多领域应用等不同层次，教授大数据分析与处理的基本方法、工具及应用。具体内容包括：（1）大数据分析与处理基础：数据科学发展情况；大数据的时代背景及其重要性；大数据分析与处理的典型应用。（2）数据统计分析的数学基础：聚类分析；多维数据分布；主成份分析；线性相关与回归。（3）大数据的智能处理：动态贝叶斯网络；机器学习；支持向量机；大规模数据上的模型应用。（4）大数据的分布式存储、处理与并行计算：HDFS；Hadoop与MapReduce，MapReduce并行计算；基于MapReduce的数据分析与智能处理方法的并行化。（5）大数据的信息融合问题：大数据时代，信息融合是关键。了解和掌握决策与估计理论；完成大数据处理与信息融合问题的模拟和仿真，并进行大数据信息融合性能分析。(6)大数据的可视分析问题：了解并运用已掌握的与人类视认知相一致的图形或者图像知识与软件，生动展示高维数据的内在结构与规律性。
default.en: In various fields such as the Internet, political economy, society, public health, finance, medical health, environment, ocean, etc., there are petabytes of data to be studied, and the results of big data analysis have produced practical effects. This course will teach the basic methods, tools and applications of big data analysis and processing from different levels, such as the mathematical basis of data statistical analysis, the intelligent analysis and processing methods of big data, the distributed processing and parallel computing of big data, and the multi-field application of big data. The specific contents include: (1) the basics of big data analysis and processing: the development of data science; the historical background of big data and its importance; Typical applications of big data analysis and processing. (2) Mathematical basis of statistical analysis of data: cluster analysis; multi-dimensional data distribution; principal component analysis; Linear correlation and regression. (3) Intelligent processing of big data: dynamic Bayesian network; Machine learning; support vector machines; Model applications on large-scale data. (4) Distributed storage, processing and parallel computing of big data: HDFS; Hadoop and MapReduce, MapReduce parallel computing; Parallelization of data analysis and intelligent processing methods based on MapReduce. (5) Information fusion of big data: In the era of big data, information fusion is the key. understand and master the theory of decision making and estimation; Complete the simulation and simulation of big data processing and information fusion problems, and analyze the performance of big data information fusion. (6) Visual analysis of big data: understand and use the knowledge and software of graphics or images that are consistent with human visual cognition to vividly demonstrate the internal structure and regularity of high-dimensional data.

default.zh: FPGA是可重新编程的半导体芯片。利用其内部预制的逻辑资源和可编程布线资源，用户可以将其配置为自己所需的用硬件来实现的各种功能电路。Verilog HDL是硬件描述语言的一种，用于数字电子系统设计。该语言允许设计者进行各种级别的逻辑设计，进行数字逻辑系统的仿真验证、时序分析和逻辑综合。 本课程的目的是为了让学生掌握FPGA应用设计、设计方法和Verilog语言相关技术和知识，为日后从事相关科研工作打下基础。 本课程的主要内容包括FPGA的硬件资源、Verilog HDL语言、数字系统设计和FPGA的开发工作等。 为了让学生掌握FPGA应用设计、设计方法和Verilog语言相关技术和知识，为日后从事相关科研工作打下基础。
default.en: FPGAs are reprogrammable silicon chips. Using prebuilt logic blocks and programmable routing resources, you can configure these resources to implement custom hardware functionality. Verilog HDL is a hardware description language which is used to design digital systems. Using Verilog HDL, you can implement digital logic designs, simulation and analysis. The main purpose of this course is to enable students to master the theoretical knowledge of Verilog HDL and FPGA, and to master the basic design methods with Verilog HDL and FPGA for days after engaged in related research work to lay the foundation. The main contents of the class include the hardware resources in FPGAs, Verilog HDL, digital systems design and Xilinx FPGA development tool.

default.zh: 优化算法基础与应用课程是电子工程系的一门选修课程。优化理论是一个重要的数学分支，它所研究的问题是讨论在众多的方案中什么样的方案最优以及怎样找出最优方案。优化问题在工程技术领域普遍存在，许多实际工程问题都需要用优化算法来解决。本课程主要是系统地讲述优化问题的基本概念和基本理论方法，着重讨论解决无约束优化问题、线性规划问题和有约束的非线性优化问题的基本算法。课程教学从优化理论的基本概念和基本原理入手，结合实践教学环节，培养学生运用所学知识解决实际优化问题的能力，进行工程技术人员所需的基本能力训练，为学生日后从事相关工作奠定坚实的基础。 本课程的教学目标是使学生具备以下能力：1. 掌握优化问题的基本概念和基本理论方法，具体包括无约束优化问题、线性规划问题以及有约束的非线性优化问题的基本特点和经典求解方法；2. 熟悉和掌握优化问题的主要分析和解决方法，熟悉将实际工程问题建模成数学优化问题并求解的基本方法，具备分析和解决实际优化问题的能力；3. 了解优化算法的计算机求解方法，逐步具有应用先进工具解决实际优化问题的能力。
default.en: Fundamentals and Applications of Optimization Algorithms is an elective course of the Department of Electronic Engineering. Optimization theory is an important branch of mathematics. The problem it studies is to discuss what kind of scheme is best in many schemes and how to find the optimal solution. Optimization problems are prevalent in the field of engineering technology, and many practical engineering problems need to be solved by optimization algorithm. This course mainly focuses on the basic concepts and basic theoretical methods of optimization problems, and focuses on the basic algorithms for solving unconstrained optimization problems, linear programming problems and constrained nonlinear optimization problems. The course is based on the basic concepts and basic principles of the optimization theory, combined with the practical teaching procedure, training students to use the knowledge to solve the practical optimization problem. This course is designed to conduct the basic competency training required by engineering and technical personnel to lay a solid foundation for students to carry out related work in the future. The goal of this course is to enable students: 1. To master the basic concepts and basic theoretical methods of the optimization problem, including the basic characteristics of the unconstrained optimization problem, the linear programming problem and the constrained nonlinear optimization problem and the classical solution method; 2. To be familiar with and master the main analysis and solving methods of optimization problems, to be familiar with the basic methods of modelling the practical engineering problems into mathematical optimization problems and solving them, and to have the ability to analyze and solve practical optimization problems; 3. To understand the computer optimization method of solving the optimization algorithm, and to gradually have the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical optimization problems.

default.zh: 信号采样是联系模拟信源和数字信息的桥梁。人们对信息的巨量需求造成了信号采样、传输和存储的巨大压力。如何缓解这种压力又能有效提取承载在信号中的有用信息是信号与信息处理中急需解决的问题之一。压缩感知技术导论课程是基于近年来国际上提出的压缩感知理论，概述性地讲解为缓解这些压力提供的新颖有效的解决途径。压缩感知是建立在统计概率论、优化理论等基础上的一种全新信息获取与处理的理论框架，它基于信号的可压缩性，通过低维空间、低分辨、欠Nyquist采样数据的非相关观测来实现高维信号的感知。压缩感知不仅让我们重新审视线性问题，而且丰富了关于信号恢复的优化策略，极大促进了数学理论和工程应用的结合。本课程讲解的理论方法可以应用到无线通信、雷达探测、模式识别、图像压缩、图像超分辨重建等众多领域，通过对这门课程的学习，不仅为以后深入学习研究信号处理问题开拓了思路，也为其它学科领域的研究提供了新的契机。
default.en: Sampling is the bridge between analog source signal and digital signal. With the rapid progress of information technologies, the demands for information are increasing dramatically. So the existing system are very difficult to meet the challenges of high speed sampling, large volume data transmission and storage. How to acquire information in signal efficiently is an urgent problem in electronic information fields. Introduction to Compressed Sensing Technology course is from Compressed Sensing theory, which is an emerging theory of signal acquirement in recent years, and provides an overview of novel and effective solutions to alleviate these pressures. Compressed Sensing is a new developed theoretical framework for information acquisition and processing, which is based on optimization and statistical probability theory and so on. The high-dimensional signal can be recovered from the low-dimensional and sub-Nyquist sampling data based on the compressibility of signals. It not only inspires us to survey the linear problem again, but also enriches the optimization approaches for signal recovery to promote the combination of mathematics with engineering application. This course explains the theories and methods can be applied to wireless communication, radar detection, pattern recognition, image compression, image super-resolution reconstruction and many other fields. By learning the course, it not only develops our idea of further studying signal processing problems, but also provides a new opportunity for the study of other disciplines.

default.zh: 实时操作系统课程内容主要包括两大部分：实时操作系统理论和实时信号处理系统设计与实现。实时操作系统理论包括任务管理和调度、实时通信、信号量和消息队列、事件、异步信号和管道、时钟及同步方法；信号处理系统设计与实现包括实时信号处理系统设计、典型信号处理算法的多处理器实现、嵌入式Linux实时操作系统概述、嵌入式Linux实时操作系统开发环境及工具。通过课堂教学和课程设计，使学生将实时操作系统理论与数字信号处理方法的实现联系起来，加深对实时操作系统的理解，掌握实时信号处理系统设计的方法，具备独立开发实时信号处理模块的能力。
default.en: The main content of this course includes two parts: theory of Real-Time Operation System, design and implementation of Real-Time Signal Processing System. Theory of Real-Time Operation System mainly explains task assignment and scheduling, Real-Time communication, semaphore and message queue, event, asynchronous signal and pips, clock synchronization; Design and implementation of Real-Time Signal Processing System explains design of Real-Time signal processing system, implementation of classical signal process algorithms, introduction of embedded Linux system, development environment and tools for embedded Linux system. Through learning this course and projects, students can connect the theory of Real-Time operation system with the implementation of digital signal processing for a further comprehension. Further, the students can master the principle for Real-Time Signal Processing System designation and obtain the ability of developing Real-Time signal processing module independently.

default.zh: 机器视觉与人机交互是一门涵盖计算机科学、模式识别、人工智能等多个学科的综合性课程，本课程结合机器视觉在人机智能交互领域应用的前沿方向，进行基本理论讲授。通过本课程的讲授，使学生建立人工智能领域新兴技术的基本概念，使学生建立机器视觉与人机交互技术的基本概念，掌握机器视觉与人机交互的基本理论和方法，培养学生应用机器视觉与人机交互方法解决实际问题的能力，提高综合运用所学理论知识独立分析和解决问题的综合能力，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础。通过对前沿技术的介绍，培养学生具有国际视野，和文献综述能力，具备一定的专业沟通和表达能力，具备多渠道获取新知识能力，撰写学术报告能力，具有不断学习和适应发展的能力。本课程主要讲解机器视觉与人机交互领域中的主要算法以及在的一些具体应用实例，课程内容包括机器视觉与人机交互的基本概念和发展历程、数字图像处理基础、机器视觉算法、人机交互基础、机器视觉在人机交互中的应用、人工神经网络和深度学习。通过应用实例分析，使学生掌握基本理论，并将理论与实际相结合，为未来的科研或工程实践提供有力支持。
default.en: Machine vision and human-computer interaction is a comprehensive course covering computer science, pattern recognition, artificial intelligence, and other disciplines. This course combines the frontier direction of machine vision in the field of human-computer intelligent interaction to teach basic theories. Through the teaching of this course, students can establish the basic concepts of emerging technologies in the field of artificial intelligence, machine vision, and human-computer interaction technology, master the basic theories and methods of machine vision and human-computer interaction, cultivate students ability to solve practical problems by using machine vision and human-computer interaction methods, improve their comprehensive ability to analyze and solve problems independently by using the theoretical knowledge they have learned, and lay a foundation for cultivating students' ability to solve complex engineering problems. Through the introduction of cutting-edge technology, students are trained to have an international vision, the ability to summarize documents, the ability to communicate and express professionally, the ability to acquire new knowledge through multiple channels, the ability to write academic reports, and the ability to keep learning and adapt to development. This course mainly explains the main algorithms in the field of machine vision and human-computer interaction and some concrete application examples. The course content includes the basic concepts and development process of machine vision and human-computer interaction, the foundation of digital image processing, the algorithm of machine vision, the foundation of human-computer interaction, the application of machine vision in human-computer interaction, artificial neural network, and deep learning. Through the analysis of application examples, students can master the basic theory and combine theory with practice to provide strong support for future scientific research or engineering practice.

default.zh: 程序设计是一门注重实践的课程，大学一年级学生虽然已修完C语言及部分数据结构等程序设计相关课程，但由于大部分学生为初学者，很少接触规模较大程序设计的实践和训练，程序设计水平停留于初级阶段，难以满足工程实际开发的要求。开设本课程的目的是，在学生修完C语言等基础课程之后，为学生提供程序设计实践指导和训练，结合实时信息处理软件设计的特点，介绍模块化程序设计思想和方法，讲授基于Visual Studio集成开发环境的工程创建、代码编写以及调试技能与技巧，介绍模块化、规范化高质量程序设计思想，通过较大规模程序的设计与上机实践，教授学生常用编程技能和技巧，使学生真正掌握大型程序设计方法，具备根据具体问题需求设计算法、通过团队沟通协作解决复杂工程问题的能力，快速成为能够担当工程研发任务的人才。
default.en: Programming is a practical course that emphasizes practical skills. Although first-year college students have completed courses related to programming such as C language and some data structures, most of them are beginners and have little exposure to large-scale programming practice and training. As a result, their programming skills remain at the initial stage, making it difficult to meet the requirements of practical engineering development. The purpose of offering this course is to provide students with practical guidance and training in programming design after completing basic courses such as C language. Combining the characteristics of real-time information processing software design, it introduces modular programming ideas and methods, teaches engineering creation, code writing, and debugging skills and techniques based on the Visual Studio integrated development environment, and introduces the concept of modular and standardized high-quality programming design. Through the design and practical application of large-scale programs, students are taught common programming skills and techniques, enabling them to truly master large-scale program design methods and possess the ability to design algorithms based on specific problem requirements, solve complex engineering problems through team communication and collaboration, and quickly become talents capable of undertaking engineering research and development tasks.

default.zh: 科学计算创新实践是本专业的一门选修实践课，主要是培养学生的工程实践能力、利用工具软件解决工程问题的能力，是后续学习和科学研究的基础，在培养学生系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。科学计算语言已经成为科学与工程界的通用计算机语言，并为很多领域的首选计算机语言，为现代科学技术的发展做出了重要的贡献。随着科学计算集成开发环境中通信、信号处理专业函数库以及专业工具箱的成熟，它们逐渐为广大通信技术领域的专家、学者和工程师所熟悉，在通信理论研究、算法设计、系统设计、建模仿真和性能分析验证等方面的应用也越来越广泛。本课程以科学计算集成开发环境的基础为入门，先介绍科学计算工具的强大功能，然后进一步让学生对电子、通信和微波系统有一个基本概念，从系统建模原理和仿真的数值计算方法入手，让学生对科学有一个从量到质的认识。教学具有针对性，培养学生综合运用所学知识和解决实际的工程问题的能力，让学生对通信专业知识产生浓厚兴趣，为今后进一步深造或工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: The innovative practice of scientific computing is an elective practice course in this major, mainly to cultivate students' engineering practice ability, the ability to solve engineering problems using tools and software, and is the foundation for subsequent learning and scientific research. It occupies an important position in cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability, comprehensive design ability, etc. Scientific computing language has become a universal computer programming language in the scientific and engineering fields, and is the preferred computer programming language for many fields, making important contributions to the development of modern science and technology. With the maturity of communication, signal processing professional function libraries, and professional toolboxes in scientific computing integrated development environments, they have gradually become familiar to experts, scholars, and engineers in the communication technology field. The application in communication theory research, algorithm design, system design, modeling and simulation, and performance analysis and verification is also becoming more and more extensive. This course is based on the foundation of scientific computing integrated development environment as an introduction, first introduces the powerful functions of scientific computing tools, and then further allows students to have a basic concept of electronic, communication, and microwave systems, starting from the principles of system modeling and simulation. Numerical calculation methods, let students have a quantitative understanding of science. The teaching is targeted, cultivating students' ability to comprehensively apply what they have learned and solve practical engineering problems, allowing students to have a strong interest in communication professional knowledge, and laying a solid foundation for further study or work in the future.

default.zh: Python科学计算与混合编程实践是电子信息方向的一门选修实践课，主要是培养学生的工程实践能力、利用工具软件解决工程问题的能力，是后续学习和科学研究的基础，在培养学生系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 Python已经成为科学与工程界的通用计算机语言，并为很多领域的首选计算机语言，为现代科学技术的发展做出了重要的贡献。随着Anaconda集成环境的推出，Python逐渐为科学计算领域的专家、学者和工程师所熟悉，在人工智能理论研究、算法设计、系统设计、建模仿真和性能分析验证等方面的应用也越来越广泛。 本课程以Python语言的基础为入门，先介绍Python的强大功能，然后进一步让学生对科学计算有一个基本概念，从系统建模原理和仿真的数值计算方法入手，让学生对Python仿真有一个从量到质的认识。教学具有针对性，培养学生综合运用所学知识和解决实际的工程问题的能力，让学生对通信专业知识产生浓厚兴趣，为今后进一步深造或工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Python Scientific Computing and Hybrid Programming Practice is an elective practical course for students majoring in electronic information. Its primary objective is to cultivate students' engineering practice skills and their ability to use software tools to solve engineering problems. This course serves as the foundation for subsequent studies and scientific research, and it plays a significant role in developing students' comprehensive analytical and design capabilities. Python has become a universal programming language in the fields of science and engineering. It has made significant contributions to the advancement of modern science and technology. With the introduction of the Anaconda integrated environment, Python has gained familiarity among experts, scholars, and engineers in the field of scientific computing. Its applications have become increasingly widespread in areas such as artificial intelligence theory, algorithm design, system design, modeling and simulation, as well as performance analysis and validation. This course begins with the basics of the Python language, introducing its powerful features. It further provides students with a fundamental understanding of scientific computing, starting from the principles of system modeling and numerical computational methods for simulation. Students will develop a deeper comprehension of Python simulation, progressing from quantity to quality. The teaching is tailored to cultivate students' ability to apply their knowledge comprehensively to solve real engineering problems, thereby fostering a strong interest in communication-related knowledge and establishing a solid foundation for further study or work.

default.zh: 机器学习是新兴的多领域交叉方向，是人工智能领域的重要组成部分，本课程结合模式识别与统计机器学习在遥感技术和智能车领域应用的前沿方向，进行基本理论讲授。通过本课程的讲授，使学生建立人工智能领域新兴技术的基本概念，使学生掌握模式识别和机器学习的基本理论和方法，培养学生应用模式识别和机器学习方法解决实际问题的能力，提高综合运用所学理论知识独立分析和解决问题的综合能力，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础。通过对前沿技术的介绍，培养学生具有国际视野，和文献综述能力，具备一定的专业沟通和表达能力，具备多渠道获取新知识能力，撰写学术报告能力，具有不断学习和适应发展的能力。本课程主要讲解模式识别和统计机器学习领域中的主要算法以及在的一些具体应用实例，包括光学目标识别、计算机视觉、搜索引擎、遥感技术和智能车等领域。课程内容包括监督学习（参数估计/非参数估计、支持向量机、核函数法、神经网络）和非监督学习（回归、聚类、深度学习）的机器学习方法与基本理论。通过遥感领域应用实例分析，使学生掌握基本理论，并将理论与实际相结合，深入理解模式识别与统计机器学习在遥感和智能车等领域的应用。
default.en: Machine learning is a scientific discipline that explores the construction and study of algorithms that can learn from data. This course combines the basic directions of the theory of and statistical machine learning in the frontier of remote sensing technology and intelligent vehicle. Through the course, students can establish the basic concepts of the emerging technology in artificial intelligence field. It can enable students to master the basic theories and methods of and machine learning, develop the engineering consciousness and ability, and train students' abilities of independent thinking and of analyzing and solving the complex engineering problems in and machine learning. Through the introduction of cutting-edge technology, cultivate students with an international perspective, improving the ability of literature review. During this course, the communication skills on complex engineering problems, and self-learning capabilities with multi-channel access to adapt the development can be enhanced. The main content is the main algorithms of and statistical machine learning in the field and in some specific applications, including optical target recognition, computer vision, remote sensing technology, search engine and intelligent vehicle etc.. The contents of the course include supervised learning (parameter estimation / non parametric estimation, SVM, kernel function, neural network) and unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction, recommender systems, deep learning). Through the application of remote sensing field analysis, it develops students to master the basic theory, combining theory with practice, in-depth understanding of and statistical machine learning in remote sensing and intelligent vehicles and other fields of application.

default.zh: 模式识别与机器学习是近20多年兴起的一门多领域交叉学科，是人工智能领域的一个重要组成部分。主要涉及概率论、统计学、逼近论、凸分析、算法复杂度理论等多门学科。机器学习理论主要是设计和分析一些让计算机可以自动“学习”的算法，从数据中自动分析获得规律，并利用规律对未知数据进行预测。机器学习在实际工业生产中已经有了十分广泛的应用，例如：数据挖掘、计算机视觉、自然语言处理、生物特征识别、搜索引擎、医学诊断、DNA序列测序、语音和手写识别、遥感应用和无人系统运用。本课程分为24个学时，主要讲解模式识别和统计机器学习领域中的主要算法以及在遥感领域的一些具体应用实例。从数据的角度来看，机器学习一般分为监督学习和非监督学习。 从模型的输出角度来看，主要分为分类，回归，聚类，密度估计和数据降维。本课程培养学生应用模式识别与统计机器学习的基本技能和方法，具备机器学习程序设计与开发能力，为学生后续相关的学习及工作打下基础。
default.en: Machine learning and pattern recognition is a scientific discipline that explores the construction and study of algorithms that can learn from data. Such algorithms operate by building a model from example inputs and using that to make predictions or decisions; rather than following strictly static program instructions. Machine learning is employed in a range of computing tasks where designing and programming explicit. Example applications include spam filtering, optical character recognition, search engines and computer vision. This course provides a broad introduction to machine learning, data mining, and statistical pattern recognition, together with some typical applications from image processing and remote sensing. In this class, you will learn about the most effective machine learning techniques, and gain practice implementing them and getting them to work for your application. More importantly, you'll learn about not only the theoretical underpinnings of learning, but also gain the practical know-how needed to quickly and powerfully apply these techniques to new problems. Topics include supervised learning (parametric/non-parametric algorithms, support vector machines, kernels, neural networks). Unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction, recommender systems, deep.The distinguishing feature of this course is that it combines the practice with the theoretical knowledge and the design skills. This is helpful for studying of other relative courses and future works.

default.zh: 本课程立足低年级本科生专业启蒙与学科认知核心需求，以电子信息学科全景解读、前沿技术普及、工程实践认知、职业发展引导为导向，融合校内名师系统讲授与行业专家专题授课，系统传递学科核心理论、技术脉络、前沿应用与发展前景，引导学生构建电子信息领域完整认知框架，厚植专业兴趣与家国情怀，明晰学习路径与成长方向。
default.en: This course is designed to meet the core needs of professional enlightenment and subject cognition for lower-grade undergraduates. It aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of electronic information disciplines, popularize cutting-edge technologies, foster an understanding of engineering practice, and guide career development. By integrating systematic lectures from renowned professors within the university and specialized courses from industry experts, the course systematically conveys the core theories, technological trajectories, cutting-edge applications, and development prospects of the discipline. It guides students to build a complete cognitive framework in the field of electronic information, cultivates their professional interests and national sentiments, and clarifies their learning paths and growth directions.

default.zh: 随着国产软件、国产操作系统、国产芯片研究和应用的不断深入和拓展，开源开发平台已经成为国内研究所、企业研发信息类处理应用的主要平台。Qt是一个功能强大的跨平台应用程序框架，其开源版本使得开发者可以在Windows、MacOS、Linux、Android等多个操作系统上使用它来开发信息处理、图形界面、数据库管理等工程应用，涉及信息处理、汽车、机器人、自动化、AI等行业。作为信息与通信工程类学生，需要尽快掌握开源开发工具及C++编程知识，打下信息与通信系统、信号与信息处理等方面应用的软件实现基础，培养工程化实践素质，提升学生们独立设计软件系统、动手编程实践的能力。 课程将面向对象编程的各种概念融入Qt开发平台的讲述之中，使得学生们具像化理解Qt中的面向对象理念，同时利用课程中大量的实践练习题、课后编程设计题等多种方式提升学生对面向对象概念的理解，熟悉软件开发过程，锻炼设计能力。 课程主要内容既包含面向对象基础、类和对象概念、类的定义和实现、继承与派生、静态成员、常成员、数据I/O等面向对象的方法，还包含开源Qt的环境、类、信号与槽、事件与绘图、窗口编程等Qt编程框架等等。
default.en: With the expanding application of domestic software, operating system, and chips, open source development platforms have become the most important platform for institutes and enterprises to research and develop their own information processing applications. Qt is a powerful cross-platform application framework, and its’ open source version enables developers to use it to program information processing applications on multiple operating systems, such as Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android, and so on. Meanwhile, Qt-based engineering applications for information processing, graphical interfaces, database management, have deeply involved in the industries of information processing, automobiles, robotics, automation, and AI. For students majoring in information and communication engineering, to master open source development tools and C++ programming knowledge should be done as soon as possible. This course is aiming at laying the foundation of software implementation for applications in information and communication systems, signal and information processing, cultivating the quality of engineering practice, and enhancing the students' ability to independently design software systems and hands-on programming practices.

default.zh: “非平稳信号分析” 是电子信息类专业高年级本科生的在信号处理方向的进阶课程。作为专业选修课，本课程系统宏观地介绍了非平稳信号分析的理论框架、分析方法及应用场景。课程通过非平稳信号的时频域分析、盲源分离、线性回归等三个典型方法的应用，分别从线性代数、概率论和凸优化的角度，剖析数学工具在非平稳信号处理中的核心作用与应用逻辑。课程选取雷达目标回波信号的时变特征提取、模式识别中的动态数据分类、参数估计中的非平稳模型优化及信号去噪中的时变噪声抑制等典型案例，借助科学计算仿真软件开展计算机仿真实验，实现理论知识与工程实践的深度融合。帮助学生突破传统平稳信号分析的局限，构建全面的信号处理知识体系，掌握处理复杂时变信号的核心能力，提升学生解决实际工程问题的创新思维与实践能力，从而适应现代复杂工程场景下信号处理技术的高速发展需求。
default.en: "Non-stationary Signal Analysis" is an advanced course for senior undergraduate students majoring in electronic information engineering, focusing on the signal processing domain. As a specialized elective, this course provides a systematic and macro-level introduction to the theoretical framework, analytical methods, and application scenarios of non-stationary signal analysis. Through three representative applications—time-frequency domain analysis of non-stationary signals, blind source separation, and linear regression—the course dissects the core role and application logic of mathematical tools in non-stationary signal processing from the perspectives of linear algebra, probability theory, and convex optimization. By examining typical cases such as time-varying feature extraction in radar target echo signals, dynamic data classification in pattern recognition, non-stationary model optimization in parameter estimation, and time-varying noise suppression in signal denoising, the course integrates scientific computing simulation software to conduct computer simulation experiments. This approach achieves a deep convergence of theoretical knowledge and engineering practice. The course aims to help students move beyond the limitations of traditional stationary signal analysis, establish a comprehensive knowledge framework in signal processing, master core competencies for handling complex time-varying signals, and enhance innovative thinking and practical skills for solving real-world engineering problems. Ultimately, it prepares students to adapt to the rapidly evolving demands of signal processing technologies in modern complex engineering scenarios.

default.zh: 高级语言程序设计是本专业的一门选修课，主要是培养学生的工程计算编程能力、利用工具软件解决工程问题的能力，是后续学习和科学研究的基础。本课程包括MATLAB的基础为入门，程序设计，数据可视化，科学计算应用和GUI程序设计等内容。教学具有针对性，培养学生综合运用所学知识和解决实际的工程问题的能力。
default.en: This course develops students' computational programming skills for engineering applications and their ability to solve engineering problems using specialized tools. Serving as a foundation for advanced studies and scientific research, the curriculum covers: MATLAB Fundamentals - Syntax and core operations Programming Techniques - Algorithm design and debugging Data Visualization - Scientific plotting and graphical representation Scientific Computing Applications - Numerical methods and simulations GUI Programming - Interactive interface development

default.zh: 单片机原理应用课程是电子信息类专业本科生的计算机类课程。本课程主要讲授单片机的基本原理、硬件结构和应用。课程教学目标是帮助学生建立单片机的基本概念，使学生掌握单片机的组成结构及各部分工作原理，掌握软硬件综合开发工具，进一步掌握软硬件实现技术，最终掌握单片机系统的实践应用基本技能和设计方法，使学生具备基于单片机的基本设计和应用能力。通过本课程的课堂教学、实践教学环节，培养学生硬件系统的综合分析与应用设计能力，以及运用计算机类科学知识的能力，为培养学生在智能系统中的单片机应用设计能力、系统综合分析能力、解决人工智能的复杂工程问题能力奠定基础。
default.en: Principle of Single Chip Microcomputer and Application is technical courses on electronic technology for majors of electronic information. It mainly introduces the principles of microcomputers, the principles and applications of the MCU. This course mainly teaches the basic principles, hardware structure, and applications of microcontrollers. The teaching objective of the course is to help students establish the basic concepts of microcontrollers, master the composition structure and working principles of microcontrollers, master software and hardware development tools, further master software and hardware implementation technology, and ultimately master the practical application skills and design methods of microcontroller systems, so that students have the basic design and application abilities based on microcontrollers. Through the classroom teaching and practical teaching of this course, aim to cultivate students' comprehensive analysis and design abilities in hardware systems, as well as their ability to apply computer science knowledge. This lays the foundation for cultivating students' microcontroller application design ability, system comprehensive analysis ability, and ability to solve complex engineering problems in intelligent systems.

default.zh: 《人工智能与信号处理》课程将人工智能（AI）与信号处理这两个密切相关且相互促进的领域结合起来。传统的信号处理涉及对信号（例如音频、图像、视频、传感器数据等）的分析、修改和合成，而人工智能则通过机器学习、深度学习等方法赋予其智能化处理能力，两者的结合将大大提升信号处理的效率，具有广泛的应用前景。课程具体内容包括：机器学习、深度学习、强化学习、人工智能与视觉信号处理、人工智能与医学信号处理等。
default.en: The course "Artificial Intelligence and Signal Processing" combines the closely related and mutually reinforcing fields of artificial intelligence (AI) and signal processing. Traditional signal processing involves the analysis, modification, and synthesis of signals (such as audio, images, videos, sensor data, etc.), while artificial intelligence endows it with intelligent processing capabilities through machine learning, deep learning, and other methods. The combination of the two will greatly improve the efficiency of signal processing and has broad application prospects. The specific content of the course includes: machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, artificial intelligence and visual signal processing, artificial intelligence and medical signal processing, etc.

default.zh: 《人工智能与无线电探测感知》课程以无线电探测与定位中的PD雷达、新体制雷达、毫米波雷达和合成孔径雷达（SAR）、逆合成孔径雷达（ISAR）等典型探测感知系统为切入点，聚焦实际电磁环境下的干扰问题，系统讲授人工智能技术在时频分析、目标识别与检测、参数估计、轨迹跟踪等核心任务中的前沿应用。课程深度融合深度学习、目标检测与智能识别、复数域神经网络、注意力机制先进人工智能方法与无线电波传播物理模型，通过本课程的课堂教学、实验设计和实践等环节，着重培养学生解决复杂电磁环境下目标高精度感知问题的能力。
default.en: This course focuses on the field of satellite clusters and intelligent sensing technology, and is oriented towards cutting-edge directions such as spatial information fusion, multi-source heterogeneous data processing, and intelligent collaborative detection. It systematically explains satellite distributed network detection, multi-source sensor (optical/infrared/radar) sensing principles, data alignment and fusion methods, and intelligent recognition technology. The course combines theoretical teaching with experimental practice to cultivate students' mastery of the core theoretical system of satellite cluster collaborative perception, their ability to design and implement multi-source information fusion systems, and their ability to form innovative thinking and teamwork skills for complex engineering problems.

default.zh: 本课程是电子与信息工程学院开设的一门面向未来技术学院（永坦班）的夏季实践类课程，其目的是使学生了解和掌握复杂嵌入式系统硬件开发知识、丰富已学过的专业基础课程内容，以嵌入式综合项目培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在项目开发过程中发现问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力，同时也培养了学生注重团队协作的意识，为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。课程内容还包括学校对学科竞赛的政策，电子信息类学科竞赛解读、优秀项目作品分享，注重课赛结合，以课促赛。
default.en: This course is a summer practical course offered by the School of Electronic and Information Engineering for the School of Future Technology (Yongtan Class). Its purpose is to enable students to understand and master the hardware development knowledge of complex embedded systems, enrich the professional basic course content that they have learned, and train students to combine theory with practice through embedded comprehensive projects. Improve their ability to find, analyze and solve problems in the process of project development, and cultivate their awareness of teamwork, which lays a foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses. At the same time, the course content also includes the school's policy on discipline competitions, the interpretation of electronic information discipline competitions, the sharing of excellent project works, the combination of lessons and competitions, and the promotion of competitions with lessons.

default.zh: 本课程是电子与信息工程学院开设的一门面向未来技术学院（永坦班）学生的夏季实践类课程，其目的是使学生了解和掌握综合电子系统开发流程、丰富已学过的电子信息类专业核心课程内容，以毫米波雷达这一典型电子系统设置不同层次的实验项目，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在项目开发过程中发现问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力，同时也锻炼了学生的创新思维，培养了学生注重团队协作的意识，为后续的科学研究打下基础。
default.en: This course is a summer practical course offered by the School of Electronic and Information Engineering for students of the School of Future Technology (Yongtan Class). Its purpose is to enable students to understand and master the development process of integrated electronic systems, enrich the core courses of electronic information majors that they have learned, and set up experimental projects at different levels with millimeter wave radar, a typical electronic system. Cultivate students' ability to combine theory with practice, improve their ability to find, analyze and solve problems in the process of project development, train their innovative thinking, cultivate their awareness of teamwork, and lay a foundation for subsequent scientific research.

default.zh: 本课程是电气类、电子信息类及自控类等专业在电子技术方面面向实际应用的技术技能类专业课。它具有自身的体系，是实践性很强的一门课程，以半定制专用数字集成电路为设计目标，以可编程逻辑器件为设计载体，以硬件描述语言为设计方法，以EDA软件为设计工具。本课程的任务是：使学生获得电子设计自动化方面的基本理论知识和基本技能，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力以及动手设计简单电子系统的能力，为今后深入学习电子技术在专业中的应用及本学科前沿知识打下良好的基础。 课程内容：EDA绪论 EDA技术的发展过程、现状和未来的发展方向，CPLD和FPGA系列芯片的特点以及应用场合介绍。VHDL语言 综合介绍，包括语法应用和设计思想介绍，用VHDL设计常用数字逻辑电路等。 常用EDA软件的使用 介绍各种常用EDA软件的使用。用VHDL设计状态机 介绍两种状态机的VHDL语言设计方法，以及有限状态机时序控制电路的通用设计思想和方法。
default.en: This course is the practical technical and application courses for electrical category, automation, electronics information and other professional in the electronics technology. It is a highly practical course which has its own system. This course takes semi-custom digital integrated circuits as the design goals, uses the programmable logic device as the design carrier, choses the hardware description language as the design method, and design project with the EDA software. The task of this course is to enable students to obtain electronic design automation of the basic theoretical knowledge and basic skills. Developing the ability of analyzing and solving problems is the key aim of this course, as well as hands-on ability of designing a simple electronics system in the professional application.
