Therefore, the course is to lay a good foundation for future study of electronic technology and knowledge. Content: EDA Introduction; Development process of EDA technology; Current status and future direction of EDA development, Introduction of CPLD and FPGA chips; Integrated presentation of VHDL language; Introduction of EDA software, highlighting the Quartus Ⅱ development environment; Design state machine with VHDL, two kinds of state machine; General design idea and method of timing control circuit for finite state machine.

default.zh: 语音信号处理是信息科学与信息处理技术的组成部分, 是跨学科的综合性应用领域与交叉学科, 在移动通信、多媒体信息处理、人机智能接口、移动互联网等领域有重要应用, 研究成果具有重要的社会和经济效益。本课程介绍语音信号处理的基础、原理、方法、应用、系统、研发、新成果与新技术、研究现状和发展趋势; 基础、理论、技术、系统和应用兼顾。教学内容包括语音信号处理的基础知识, 语音信号分析, 语音信号处理, 及语音处理的新兴与前沿技术。具体包括语音信号处理的数学模型, 语音信号的时域、频域、倒谱及线性预测分析, 语音参数估计, 语音编码, 语音合成, 语音识别, 语音增强, 麦克风阵列语音处理, 现代信号处理及智能信息处理技术在语音处理中的应用等, 涉及互联网语音处理、语音-图像融合处理以及高阶统计量、盲分离、时频分析、现代谱估计、神经网络、支持向量机、模糊集、遗传算法(及其它智能优化方法)、混沌与分形在语音处理中的应用等前沿技术。同时,通过计算机编程模拟和基于实验平台的教学实践环节，进行语音处理的技能培养与训练，为今后从事相关信息处理领域的研究与研发工作打下基础。课程内容结合国防特色，并反映课程组在该领域的研究成果。
default.en: Focusing on the speech signal processing, this course mainly concerns with the foundation, theories, methods, applications, system, develope, as well as researching hot topics and developing trend. The contents of this course include the introduction of speech signal processing; the fundamental knowledge of speech signal processing; the time-domain analyses, frequency-domain analyses, cepstrum analyses and LPC analyses of speech signal; the speech parameters estimation; the speech coding, synthesis, recognition and enhancement; the microphone array-based speech signal processing; the application of modern signal processing and intelligent information processing in speech processing; the developing trend and direction of speech signal processing. This course involves emerging theories and techniques in speech processing, including internet speech processing, speech-image joint processing, high-order statistics, blind separation, time-frequency analyses, modern spectral estimation, artificial neural network, support vector machine, fuzzy set, genetic algorithm, chaos and fractal.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生对电磁空间对抗的理论与实践的综合能力，包括雷达信号分选与识别、通信信号协议行为分析、敌我识别信号模式识别和电磁对抗博弈等方面的知识与能力。通过本课程的学习，使学生将理解电磁空间对抗的基本原理，培养学生解决电子对抗系统中复杂工程问题的能力，掌握电磁对抗的实践技巧，为电子战领域的研究和应用奠定基础。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 1. 要求学生具备电子侦察信号截获原理和测频接收机技术、无源测向和辐射源定位技术、信号处理技术及侦察系统、电子干扰原理和技术、电子干扰系统、隐身与反辐射武器硬摧毁技术、电子防护技术等基础知识；具有应用电磁空间对抗实践的理论知识和科学方法对电子对抗领域复杂工程问题中技术层面的内容进行表达、分析与论证的能力；能够将相关知识用于电子对抗工程问题解决方案的比较与综合。 2. 要求学生掌握对电子对抗系统功能模块进行建模与仿真的方法，具备利用现代工具完成实验的能力，能够分析、解释实验数据并通过信息综合得到合理有效的结论。
default.en: This course aims to cultivate students' comprehensive abilities in the theory and practice of electromagnetic space countermeasures, including knowledge and abilities in radar signal sorting and recognition, communication signal protocol behavior analysis, identification of friend or foe signal pattern recognition, and electromagnetic countermeasure games. Through the study of this course, students will understand the basic principles of electromagnetic space countermeasures, cultivate their ability to solve complex engineering problems in electronic countermeasures systems, master practical skills in electromagnetic countermeasures, and lay a foundation for research and application in the field of electronic warfare. The course objectives require students to have the following abilities: 1. Students are required to have basic knowledge of electronic reconnaissance signal interception principle and frequency measurement receiver technology, passive direction finding and radiation source positioning technology, signal processing technology and reconnaissance system, electronic interference principle and technology, electronic interference system, stealth and anti radiation weapon hard destruction technology, electronic defense technology, etc; Has the ability to express, analyze, and demonstrate the technical aspects of complex engineering problems in the field of electronic countermeasures using theoretical knowledge and scientific methods of electromagnetic space countermeasures; Be able to apply relevant knowledge to compare and synthesize solutions for electronic warfare engineering problems. 2. Students are required to master the methods of modeling and simulating the functional modules of electronic countermeasures systems, possess the ability to complete experiments using modern tools, analyze and interpret experimental data, and obtain reasonable and effective conclusions through information synthesis.

default.zh: 神经网络理论与应用是一门用以培养学生了解神经网络基础理论、数据处理及其应用的专业技术课。本课程主要讲授神经网络的基本理论及现代形式，包括神经网络的基本结构、训练方法、深度学习模型以及神经网络在图像、遥感等领域的应用。通过本课程的课堂教学、实验设计和计算机编程等环节，着重培养学生具备神经网络模型设计、分析及应用的能力，增加创新意识，为学生从事相关工作打下良好基础。
default.en: The theory and application of neural network is a technology course that the students can learn the foundational theory, data processing and the applications of neural network. It contents mainly include the basic concepts and modern forms of neural network, the basic structures, the training methods, deep learning models, and the applications of neural networks. Through the teaching practice, experimental design and programming, it can train the student’s ability in neural network architecture design, analysis and use of neural network, and lay a solid foundation for further work.

default.zh: 遥感图像智能处理课程授课对象为遥感科学与技术专业大四本科生，是遥感科学与技术学科和计算机科学、人工智能交叉领域的延伸性课程，主要介绍以深度学习为代表的智能处理方法在遥感成像探测领域中的应用。该课程讲授的主要内容包括：遥感成像探测基础（包括高空间分辨率成像、高光谱分辨率成像和高时间分辨率成像），高分遥感图像语义分割、场景分类、目标检测，高光谱遥感图像地物分类、光谱解混、超分辨，卫星视频遥感图像目标检测、跟踪，以及基于深度学习框架的代表性方法。通过该门课程的教学与实践，使得学生了解遥感成像探测的前沿理论和研究方法、掌握典型智能方法的原理和在遥感成像探测中的分析、设计以及遥感科学与技术系统科学知识的应用能力，并使学生具备初步开展遥感探测相关科研项目的能力，同时增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: The course of Intelligent Processing of Remote Sensing Images is aimed at senior undergraduate students majoring in Remote Sensing Science and Technology. It is an extended course in the interdisciplinary fields of Remote Sensing Science and Technology, Computer Science, and Artificial Intelligence. It mainly introduces the application of intelligent processing methods represented by deep learning in the field of remote sensing image detection. The main content taught in this course includes: Fundamentals of Remote Sensing Imaging Detection (including High Spatial Resolution Imaging, High Spectral Resolution Imaging, and High Time Resolution Imaging), Semantic Segmentation, Scene Classification, and Object Detection of High Resolution Remote Sensing Images, Landcovers Classification, Spectral Unmixing, and Super Resolution of Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Images, Target Detection and Tracking of Satellite Video Remote Sensing Images, and Representative Methods Based on Deep Learning Frameworks. Through the teaching and practice of this course, students can understand the frontier theory and research methods of remote sensing imaging detection, master the principle of typical intelligent methods and the analysis and design in remote sensing imaging detection as well as the application ability of scientific knowledge of remote sensing science and technology system, and have the ability to initially carry out scientific research projects related to remote sensing detection and increase their awareness of innovation.

default.zh: 先进微波遥感成像技术是遥感科学与技术专业学生的一门选修课。该课程在教学过程中综合信号处理与微波遥感等运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识和技能，通过对目前该领域最新技术的讲解和实验，完成微波遥感工程技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生日后从事相关工作打下基础。 本课程从电磁波极化传播入手，主要介绍极化合成孔径雷达成像的基本原理及相关的各种图像处理和智能处理算法。教学目的是使学生了解微波遥感成像技术的最新发展，熟悉当前最新的图像处理技术和应用技术。通过课堂教学、研讨等教学环节，培养学生们对先进微波遥感系统的应用能力。
default.en: Advanced Technology of Microwave Remote Sensing Imaging is an elective course for students whose major is remote sensing science and technology. This course integrates the relevant knowledge and skills learned from prerequisite courses such as signal processing and microwave remote sensing. This course provides a basic training for microwave remote sensing engineering technicians through the Introduction and experimentation of the latest technologies in this field. It provides sufficient preparation for students to engage in related work in the future. Starting from the propagation of electromagnetic wave polarization, this course mainly introduces the basic principles of PolSAR imaging and various image processing and intelligent processing algorithms. The teaching objective of this course is to help students understand the latest developments in microwave remote sensing imaging technology and familiarize them with the latest image processing and application techniques. Through classroom teaching, discussions, and other teaching activities, students will make significant progress in their application skills of advanced microwave remote sensing systems.

default.zh: 该课程是一门学习数学建模知识并运用计算机软件实践典型数学建模项目的综合性课程。本课程在课堂教学部分主要讲授:(1)如何利用数学理论和方法分析和解决实际的工程问题，重点讲授创造性的思维方法，问题的前期分析，模型的整体设计、变量关系的数学描述、数学模型的求解、模型解的分析与检验；(2)针对仿真软件的使用，讲解该软件的使用基础和常用数学建模工具包的使用；本课程在上机实验部分，由易到难，从层次上分为基础实验、综合实验和项目实践。通过本课程的课堂教学及后续项目实践和计算机仿真等环节，使学生能应用数学、物理、计算机及相关理论知识和科学方法对复杂工程问题中技术层面的内容进行表达、分析与论证，培养学生分析实际问题、解决复杂环境下工程实践问题的能力，增加创新意识，并在项目实践中培养团队合作精神，支撑本专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Mathematical modeling is a bridge between mathematics and the real question, as well as the main way of transformation from mathematics to practical productive forces. Mathematical modeling is widely used in various fields, by combining mathematical knowledge and computer software. The main contents of this course include an overview of mathematical modeling, simple model, elementary optimization model and programming model, Matlab project-based practices. By teaching the practice of the course, students would master the basic methods and principles of mathematical modeling for real-life problems, learn to analyze real problems, establish appropriate mathematical model and solve competency model. The course would lay the foundation for future research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 《基于Windows界面的高级程序设计》是电子信息类专业本科生的创新实践课。本门课程主要介绍面向对象的程序设计的基本思想，介绍Visual C++的开发环境，以及开发环境中各主要成分的作用和使用方法。让学生初步掌握C++语言、学会使用Visual C++开发环境，并在此基础上，初步掌握Visual C++平台上的编程实现方法。通过这门课学习，使学生具有一定编程实际能力，学会数学工具和计算机相结合来解决实际问题，为后续课程打下良好的软件编程能力基础。 本课程主要讲解C++数据类型、类和对象、控制结构和函数等基础知识。介绍Visual C++的开发环境，开发环境中各主要成分的作用和使用方法。讲解创建，编写，执行工程的步骤。介绍MFC的相关内容。介绍工具条和状态条的设计和控制。介绍对话框的设计和空间的使用。介绍如何创建文档、视图结构的应用程序。介绍VC在数字图像处理程序设计中的应用。
default.en: “Advanced Programming Based on Windows Interface” is an innovative practice course for undergraduates majoring in electronic information engineering. The course aims to introduce the basic principles of object-oriented programming, the integrated development environment (IDE) of Visual C++, and the usage of the main components in the IDE. From this course, the students will learn the C++ language, Visual C++ integrated development environment, and moreover they could learn the programming method based on the Visual C++ platform. Through this course, the students will have a certain programming ability, and with this capability they could use mathematics tools and computer techniques to solve practical problems. This course focuses on the C++ data types, classes and objects, control structures, and functions. It will introduce the integrated development environment of Visual C++, the function and usage of the main components in the Visual C++ 6.0 IDE. In this course, we will explain how to create, write, and execute projects. Besides, the related content of MFC will also be introduced. The design and control of toolbars and status bars will be described. The design of the dialog box will be emphasized. The application of Visual C++ in the design of digital image processing program will be presented also in the course.

default.zh: 电子系统硬件设计与实践课程为电子信息类专业选修课，本课程以教师讲授为辅、学生动手实践为主，以培养学生的工程意识、创新意识为目标，以电子电路的设计应用为基础，要求学生能够综合运用模-数混合电路、单片机、嵌入式系统、DSP、可编程器件、EDA软件等知识和工程技能。经过需求分析、资料查询、方案论证、设计调试、指标测试、分析总结等过程，完成一个独立电子系统的创新设计与实现。通过本课程的学习，学生可以掌握电子系统分析与设计的整个流程，形成系统级设计的理念，锻炼团队合作能力，并最终设计出独立的中小型应用电子系统。
default.en: The course of Electronic system hardware design and innovation practice is an elective course for electronics and information engineering major and other related majors. Through lecture and practice, this course aims to develop student’s awareness of engineering and innovation. Based on the design and applications of electronic circuits, this course requires students to master the integrated use of analog-digital hybrid circuits, microcontrollers, embedded systems, DSP, programmable devices, EDA software etc. engineering knowledge and skills. After requirement analysis, information enquiry, scheme demonstration, designing and debugging, performance testing, summary and other processes, students can design an independent electronic system. Through teaching and experiments, students can master the entire process analysis and design of electronic systems, form a concept of system-level design, exercise the ability of teamwork, and finally design a small or medium independent applied electronic systems.

default.zh: 《基于Windows界面的机器学习程序设计》是电子信息类专业本科生的创新实践课。本门课程主要介绍面向对象的程序设计的基本思想，介绍Visual C++开发环境中各主要成分的作用和使用方法，以及机器学习中的强化学习和深度学习的相关概念与程序实现方法。让学生初步掌握C++语言、学会使用Visual C++开发环境，并在此基础上，初步掌握Visual C++平台上的强化学习、深度学习、以及深度强化学习编程实现方法。在项目开发实践中，掌握基于Visual C++的强化学习、深度学习、以及深度强化学习程序设计的综合项目，包括基于人机交互界面的强化程序设计、基于人机交互界面的深度神经网络程序设计、以及基于人机交互界面的深度强化学习程序设计等。通过这门课的学习，使学生具有一定的机器学习编程实际能力，学会数学工具和计算机相结合来解决实际问题，为后续课程打下良好的机器学习软件编程能力基础。
default.en: This innovative practical course for electronic information undergraduates integrates theory and hands-on practice to develop machine learning applications on the Windows platform. The curriculum begins with foundational knowledge, including object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts (e.g., classes, inheritance, polymorphism) in C++ and the use of Visual C++ tools such as MFC for interface design and project management. It then progresses to machine learning algorithms: reinforcement learning (RL) principles like Markov Decision Processes and Q-learning are applied to projects like game AI; deep learning (DL) fundamentals such as neural networks are implemented in C++ for tasks like handwritten digit recognition; and deep reinforcement learning (DRL) combines DL and RL for complex decision-making systems, exemplified by DQN-based autonomous control. Through project-based learning, students design interactive Windows GUI applications, such as RL-driven board game interfaces, visualized DL training systems for image classification, and real-time DRL demonstrations for dynamic environments. The course emphasizes translating mathematical tools (linear algebra, probability) into code for solving practical problems like loss optimization and policy gradients. Objectives include mastering C++ and Visual C++ tools, building end-to-end engineering skills from theory to deployment, and preparing students for advanced courses in intelligent systems or industrial software. Key features include a Windows-centric focus aligned with industry standards and an interdisciplinary blend of hardware-oriented thinking and software engineering to cultivate versatile technical expertise.

default.zh: “专业思维训练A”是本专业的一门选修课，它培养学生基于信号与系统以及数字信号处理等课程的专业思维能力，其教学目的是综合运用课程中所学到的有关基础知识与专业技能，结合模拟测试教学环节，加强学生对信号与系统以及数字信号处理等知识点的分析能力以及基本应用技能，系统地掌握信号与系统和数字信号处理课程的基本概念、原理、方法与应用，具备较强的分析、设计和解决问题的能力，增强其专业技能知识。
default.en: "Major Thinking Training A" is an elective course for this major. It cultivates students’ professional thinking abilities built upon courses such as Signals and Systems and Digital Signal Processing. The teaching objective is to enable students to comprehensively apply the basic knowledge and professional skills acquired from these courses. Combined with simulation？based teaching sessions, the course strengthens students’ analytical capabilities and basic application skills for knowledge points in Signals and Systems and Digital Signal Processing. Students are expected to systematically master the fundamental concepts, principles, methods and applications of the two courses, develop strong capabilities for analysis, design and problem？solving, and enhance their professional expertise.

default.zh: 网络安全与对抗技术是一门电子信息工程与计算机应用技术交叉领域的专业课程。本课程的目的是使学生掌握网络安全与信息对抗的基本概念原理和体系结构，较为系统地了解网络中存在的安全问题和各类对抗技术手段的运用，明确网络安全的机制、标准及法规等。教学内容涵盖网络安全的基础知识、物理安全技术、网络攻击技术、网络防护技术、网络信息安全技术、网络安全管理技术等。通过课堂讲授、专题研讨和上机实验等教学方式，提高学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，同时培养学生正确的网络道德观念和专业操守。
default.en: Network security and countermeasure technology is a professional interdiscipline course of electronic information engineering and computer application technology. The focus of this course is on the basic concepts, principles, architecture and implementation of network security and information countermeasure techniques. Besides the comprehension of security problems and safeguards in the network, the security protocols, standards and policies are introduced. Topics covered include but are not limited to the followings: introduction to network security, physical security, network attack, network defense, information security in network, network security management. Through lectures combined with seminars and experiments, the students could not only improve the capabilities of analysis and solution, but also obtain the proper understanding of network ethics and professional conduct.

default.zh: 作为当代电子与信息技术的理论基础和技术基础，信息论与编码是电子信息工程专业信息对抗方向知识体系中的重要一环。课程分为Shannon信息论为主要内容，同时涵盖通信技术中主要编码理论及方法。课程系统包含信息度量、信息熵、信息熵速率、信道容量及熵函数的基本概念和基本性质，信源编码定理及最佳编码、理想通信系统与最佳接收以及差错控制编码等主要内容。通过本课程的学习，可以使学生了解和掌握Shannon信息论与编码的基本原理和方法，为学生在后续信息对抗技术领域的深造进行相关知识的储备。
default.en: As the theoretical and technical foundation of contemporary electronic and information technology, Information Theory and Coding is an important part of the knowledge system of the students majoring in Information Confrontation direction of Electronics and Information Engineering. The course mainly covers Shannon information theory and also includes coding theories and methodologies of communication technology. The course systematically covers basic concepts and properties of information measurement, information entropy, information entropy rate, channel capacity and entropy function, source coding theorems and optimal coding, ideal communication systems and optimal reception, as well as error control coding and other main contents. Through the study of this course, students can understand and master the basic principles and methods of Shannon information theory and coding, and lay a foundation of relevant knowledge for their further studies in the field of information confrontation technology.

default.zh: 随着信息技术的发展，微波电路的设计越来越复杂，电路的功能越来越多，对电路的指标要求也越来越高，电路的尺寸要求越做越小，而设计周期却越来越短。传统的设计方法已经不能满足微波电路设计的需要，使用微波EDA 软件工具进行微波元器件与微波系统的设计已经成为微波电路设计的必然趋势。EDA即Electronic Design Automation, 电子设计自动化。目前，国外各种商业化的微波EDA 软件工具不断涌现，根据各自的特点，在微波工程中起着不同的作用。本课程在学生所学先修课程《电磁场与电磁波》、《微波技术》的基础上，讲解常用的微波电路、器件的特点和设计方法，以CST公司的MW Studio仿真软件为主要工具，实现微波元器件与微波系统的设计、仿真、优化。
default.en: With the development of information technology, the design of microwave circuit becomes more and more complex, which makes it hard to be realized by traditional methods. Using microwave EDA (Electronic Design Automation) softwares to design microwave components and microwave systems has become an inevitable trend of microwave circuit design. At present, various commercial microwave EDA softwares are emerging in foreign countries, which play different roles in microwave engineering according to their respective characteristics. On the basis of the course "Electromagnetic Field Theory" and "Microwave Technology", this course explains the characteristics and design methods of commonly used microwave circuits and devices. It realizes the design and simulation of microwave components and microwave systems by using three-dimensional electromagnetic field simulation software, which is CST Microwave Studio.

default.zh: 本课程结合理论知识与实际工程经验，系统讲授毫米波辐射特点、测量感知手段、主被动成像原理、图像处理技术、系统样机实现等内容。结合上机和实验内容，让学生有效掌握毫米波成像基础知识和技术要点，理解毫米波成像系统组成、工程实现难点。
default.en: This course reflects both the theoretical basis and the engineering experiences. We will systematically present the characteristics of the millimeter-wave radiation, sensing and measuring approaches, active and passive imaging techniques, imaging processing, and system implementation. Combined with the simulation and experimental practices, the lecture intends to equip the students with key basis and techniques of millimeter-wave imaging, components of millimeter-wave imaging system, and the engineering difficulties.

default.zh: 在现代电子工程设计中，需要对工程中复杂的电磁系统进行分析。电磁分析就是根据电磁场理论，如Maxwell 方程，求解系统中的电流、电场和磁场等。对于ＲCS 分析与隐身技术、目标识别等这些复杂的电磁问题，传统的解析方法无能为力，实验手段也不可能给予全面的解决。随着计算机技术的应用与发展，现代电磁场工程的设计过程越来越多地依赖计算机辅助设计。这就是计算电磁学。 计算电磁学是一门集电磁场理论、数理知识及编程能力于一体的综合课程，是电磁场理论的重要组成部分，也是对电磁场理论的进一步理解与应用。其专业性强、知识面广，是学生将来从事科学研究、产品开发、工程设计等工作所必需的基本素质。 本课程的内容主要包括有限差分法、时域有限差分法、有限元法和矩量法四种基本数值方法。通过这门课程的理论学习和编程训练，使学生对计算电磁学的基本方法有初步的了解，领会并掌握运用这门学科的知识去解决问题的思路和技巧。培养学生的逻辑思维能力和解决工程问题的能力，并为将来的学习、研究和工作打下基础。培养学生解决专业问题的综合计算能力和实际应用能力，全面提升学生的综合专业素质，将来毕业后更好地服务社会。
default.en: In modern electronic engineering design, it is necessary to analyze complex electromagnetic systems. Electromagnetic analysis involves solving for the current, electric field, and magnetic field in a system based on electromagnetic field theory, such as Maxwell's equations. Traditional analytical methods are inadequate for complex electromagnetic problems such as RCS (Radar Cross Section) analysis, stealth technology, and target identification, and experimental techniques cannot provide comprehensive solutions. With the application and development of computer technology, the design process of modern electromagnetic field engineering increasingly relies on computer-aided design. This is computational electromagnetics. Computational electromagnetics is an interdisciplinary course that integrates electromagnetic field theory, mathematical knowledge, and programming skills. It is a critical component of electromagnetic field theory and represents a further understanding and application of this theory. With its strong professional focus and broad scope of knowledge, it equips students with the essential skills for future scientific research, product development, and engineering design. The course content primarily includes four fundamental numerical methods: the finite difference method, the finite-difference time-domain method, the finite element method, and the method of moments. Through theoretical learning and programming practice, students will gain a preliminary understanding of the basic methods in computational electromagnetics. They will learn to apply this knowledge to problem-solving, developing their logical thinking and engineering problem-solving skills. This course lays the foundation for future studies, research, and professional work. It aims to cultivate students' comprehensive computational abilities and practical application skills, enhancing their overall professional competence to better serve society after graduation.

default.zh: 《基于单片机的创新实践》是一门以培养学生单片机综合运用能力的选修专业课程。本课程主要围绕C51系列单片机的工作原理及主要功能部件的设计、应用等内容设计实践课程题目。
default.en: Innovation Practice Based on MCU is an elective professional course designed to develop students' ability to use microcontrollers in an integrated manner. This course mainly focuses on the working principle of C51 series microcontroller and the design and application of main functional components to design the practical course topics.

default.zh: 本课程作为一门选修课，主要对已经学习专业课的学生进行专业思维训练。采用与《电磁场与电磁波》有关教材、学习辅导内容以及工程应用实际进行知识分析与解决问题训练。在授课过程中，强调对概念的正确理解和对理论进行比较深入的解析，在实际问题中，对所涉及的内容进行融会贯通。通过本课程的学习，使学生进一步熟悉和运用专业知识，增强专业思维能力和解决专业问题能力。
default.en: As an elective course, this course mainly provides major thinking training for students who have already studied professional courses. Using textbooks related to "Electromagnetic Fields and Waves"，“Learning Guidance” and practical engineering applications，this course provides major training through knowledge analysis and problem-solving training. During the teaching process, emphasis is placed on a correct understanding of concepts and more in-depth analysis of theories. In practical problems, the content involved is integrated and connected. Through the study of this course, students will further familiarize themselves with and apply professional knowledge, enhance their professional thinking ability and problem-solving ability.

default.zh: 电磁兼容是一门新兴的综合性交叉学科。随着电子、电气设备数量、种类的不断增加，及其在生产、生活、国防、航天等各个领域应用范围的不断扩大，在无线电抗干扰技术的基础上，经过扩展、延伸和系统化进而形成了电磁兼容这一自然科学和工程学的交叉学科。电磁兼容课程将以电磁场与无线技术专业为本，课程教学目的是让学生在学完大学基础课程和专业基础课程之后，再学习具有鲜明特色的电磁兼容原理与技术，培养综合运用所学的知识解决实际的工程问题的能力。本课程立足于经典电磁学理论，结合我校所属国防航天领域的特色，引导学生系统地掌握电磁兼容的基本知识、基本概念和基本的分析综合方法，了解典型的电磁兼容性问题，使得教学更具有针对性，让学生对电磁场与无线技术专业知识及其交叉学科技术产生浓厚兴趣，为今后进一步深造或工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Electromagnetic compatibility is an emerging comprehensive interdisciplinary field. With the continuous increase in the number and types of electronic and electrical equipment, and the continuous expansion of their application scope in various fields such as production, life, national defense, and aerospace, electromagnetic compatibility has been formed as an interdisciplinary field of natural science and engineering through expansion, extension, and systematization based on wireless reactance interference technology. The electromagnetic compatibility course will be based on the electromagnetic field and wireless technology major. The teaching purpose of the course is to enable students to learn distinctive electromagnetic compatibility principles and technologies after completing university and professional basic courses, and cultivate the ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge learned to solve practical engineering problems. This course is based on classical electromagnetic theory, combined with the characteristics of our school's national defense and aerospace field, guiding students to systematically master the basic knowledge, concepts, and analysis methods of electromagnetic compatibility, understand typical electromagnetic compatibility problems, make teaching more targeted, and cultivate a strong interest in the professional knowledge of electromagnetic field and wireless technology and their interdisciplinary technologies, To lay a solid foundation for further education or work in the future.

default.zh: 微波无源电路设计与实践课程是电磁场与无线技术专业学生的专业必修课，是学生后续学习无线通信系统与电子系统的基础，在培养学生的无线通信与电子系统的综合分析能力和设计能力以及解决复杂工程问题的能力方面是十分重要的。 微波无源电路设计与实践课程的主要内容包括传输线模型及传输线不均匀区域的等效电路，微带电路中的电抗元件的实现方法，集总元件匹配网络、分布元件匹配网络以及滤波器、功率分配器、定向耦合器等典型的微波无源器件的工作原理、指标计算和设计方法。重点研究平面结构的微波无源电路。 课程的实践环节包括阻抗变换器、滤波器、功分器、定向耦合器的仿真设计和矢网使用操作及微波无源器件的测量。实验项目具有代表性和可操作性，可以解决课堂教学所无法实现的动手能力培养的问题，同时使得学生加深对知识的理解。 通过本课程的学习，学生将具备正确选择、使用和设计常用微波无源电路能力。能够对微波无源器件进行等效电路分析、使用电磁场模拟软件进行仿真设计及使用现代仪器进行实验测试。能够针对电子信息领域复杂工程问题中具体的对象，开发或选用满足特定需求的现代工具对其进行模拟和预测，并能够分析其局限性。
default.en: The Design and Practice of Microwave Passive Circuits course is a core requirement for students specializing in electromagnetic fields and wireless technology. It forms the foundation for subsequent studies in wireless communication systems and electronic systems, playing a crucial role in developing students' comprehensive analysis, design capabilities, and problem-solving skills for complex engineering challenges. The course primarily covers topics such as transmission line models and equivalent circuits for non-uniform regions of transmission lines, methods for implementing reactive elements in microstrip circuits, and the principles, performance metrics, and design methodologies of typical microwave passive components like lumped element matching networks, distributed element matching networks, filters, power dividers, and directional couplers. Special emphasis is placed on planar structures of microwave passive circuits. Practical components of the course include the simulation and design of impedance transformers, filters, power dividers, and directional couplers, as well as the operation of vector network analyzers and the measurement of microwave passive devices. These hands-on projects are representative and practical, addressing the limitations of theoretical classroom teaching and enhancing students' understanding through active participation. By completing this course, students will acquire the skills to correctly select, use, and design common microwave passive circuits. They will be able to perform equivalent circuit analysis on microwave passive components, use electromagnetic simulation software for design, and conduct experimental testing with modern instruments. Furthermore, students will be equipped to develop or select modern tools to simulate and predict specific needs in the electronic information field, understand their limitations, and apply these tools to analyze complex engineering problems effectively.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍电磁波在自然环境空间中传播的基本理论与应用。首先回顾了电磁场与电磁波的基本理论，讲解了惠更斯-菲涅尔原理、菲涅尔区和电磁波的绕射理论；其次着重介绍了电磁波受地面和大气影响下，电波传播的相关理论与概念。其中包含了沿着地面传播的地波、同时受地面和大气影响的视距传播以及由大气电离层反射形成的天波传播。本课程还介绍了当前移动通信模型方面的相关知识，与当前通信技术发展密切相关。
default.en: This course focuses on the basic theory and application of electromagnetic wave propagation in natural environment. Firstly, the basic theories of electromagnetic fields and electromagnetic waves are reviewed, and the Huygens-Fresnel principle, Fresnel zone and the diffraction theory of electromagnetic waves are explained; secondly, the relevant theories and concepts of wave propagation are emphasized when electromagnetic waves are affected by the earth and the atmosphere. This includes ground wave propagation along the ground, line-of-sight propagation influenced by both the ground and the atmosphere, and sky wave propagation formed by reflection from the atmospheric ionosphere. The course also introduces current knowledge in the area of mobile communication models, which are closely related to current developments in communication technology.

default.zh: 本课程为面向电子信息类相关专业开设的专业选修课，计划开设32学时，其中包含24学时的理论学时和8学时的实践学时。课程内容涵盖人工智能概述、机器学习基础、深度学习原理、面向电磁科学的人工智能算法以及人工智能在电磁学中的应用等内容。同时，设有强化AI理解的实验教学环节。通过理论与实践相辅相成，帮助学生深入理解和掌握课程知识，力争为电磁领域的卓越工程人才培养提供支撑。
default.en: This course is an elective for majors related to electronics and information. It consists of 32 class hours, including 24 theoretical hours and 8 practical hours. It covers an overview of artificial intelligence, machine learning basics, deep learning principles, AI algorithms for electromagnetic science, and AI applications in electromagnetism. Experimental teaching reinforces AI understanding. By blending theory and practice, it aims to deepen students' knowledge and support the training of top-notch engineers in the electromagnetic field.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向智能测控工程专业本科生开设。该课程通过对数据结构、操作系统、数据库、计算机网络和软件工程等课程核心内容的凝练，讲授计算机软件技术的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法。本课程与“高级语言程序设计”、“微机与微控制器原理”等课程的知识相结合，可使学生较全面掌握计算机软硬件的基本原理和基本方法，为学生将本专业知识与计算机知识的综合运用奠定基础。课程中，数据结构重点讲授线性表、栈、队、数组、树的基本概念及运算，查找和排序的算法，使学生基本掌握数据在计算机中的组织、存储及处理方法。操作系统重点讲授存储器管理、处理器管理、设备管理和多线程的基本原理方法，使学生初步掌握操作系统对资源的管理机制。数据库主要介绍关系型数据库的规范化设计及SQL语言，使学生初步掌握数据库设计与操作的方法。计算机网络主要介绍网络体系结构及主要网络协议，使学生了解计算机网络的运行机制。软件工程重点讲授结构化软件开发技术，使学生初步掌握针对明确需求的规范化软件开发方法。同时介绍利用本课程的知识，开发嵌入式软件、仪器驱动软件、测控系统软件等本专业软件的方法，使学生具备解决工程应用问题的能力。
default.en: This course is mainly aimed at undergraduate students majoring in intelligent measurement and control engineering. This course condenses the core content of courses such as data structures, operating systems, databases, computer networks, and software engineering, and teaches the basic concepts, principles, and methods of computer software technology. The combination of this course with courses such as "Advanced Language Programming" and "Principles of Microcomputers and Microcontrollers" can enable students to comprehensively grasp the basic principles and methods of computer software and hardware, laying a foundation for the comprehensive application of their professional knowledge and computer knowledge. In the course, the focus is on teaching the basic concepts and operations of linear tables, stacks, queues, arrays, and trees, as well as algorithms for searching and sorting, in order to enable students to have a basic understanding of the organization, storage, and processing methods of data in computers. The operating system focuses on teaching the basic principles and methods of memory management, processor management, device management, and multithreading, enabling students to have a preliminary understanding of the resource management mechanism of the operating system. The database mainly introduces the standardized design of relational databases and SQL language, enabling students to initially master the methods of database design and operation. Computer networks mainly introduce network architecture and main network protocols, enabling students to understand the operating mechanism of computer networks. Software engineering focuses on teaching structured software development techniques, enabling students to initially master standardized software development methods tailored to specific requirements. This course introduces the methods of using the knowledge of this course to develop embedded software, instrument driver software, measurement and control system software, and other professional software, so that students have the ability to solve engineering application problems.

default.zh: 高速电路设计是一项非常复杂的设计过程，随着系统设计的复杂性和集成度的大规模提高，高速电路产生的传输线效应和信号完整性问题经常会使基于传统方法设计的数字电路无法工作。网络通信与电子技术的飞速发展使得高速电路设计技术已经成为电子系统设计工程师必备的设计手段。 “高速数字电路设计”课程主要面向哈尔滨工业大学电子与信息工程学院本科生开设。本课程重点介绍高速数字电路的术语、逻辑门电路的高速特性及标准的高速测量技术，以及高速数字设计中的涉及信号完整性方面的传输线、时钟偏移和抖动、端接、过孔等问题。通过课程的学习，使学生掌握高速数字电路设计过程中的基本概念、基本原理、基本分析方法和典型电路与设计方法；了解与高速数字设计有关的信号完整性的相关概念；了解逻辑门电路的高速特性、标准的高速测量技术以及高速数字电路设计应该注意的问题，并且能够完成一般的高速数字电路的设计。培养学生在电子测量领域的理论基础能力和实际电路设计能力，也为学生未来从事通信及测试的电子系统设计工程师的学习、研究、开发打下重要基础。
default.en: The high-speed digital circuit design is a very complex process. With the complexity and integration highly increased, the traditional methods do not work due to the transmission line effects and signal integrity issues. So the high-speed digital circuit design technique has been essential for electronic engineers, especially with the rapid development of the communication network and electronic technology. The “high-speed circuit design” course is opened for the undergraduate student of the school of electronics and information engineering in Harbin institute of technology. This course focuses on the terms of the digital circuits, high-speed characteristics of the basic logic circuits and standard high-speed measurement and some other issues that affect signal integrity in high-speed digital design, such as transmission line, clock skew and jitter, termination, etc. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic concepts, principles, basic analysis methods, typical circuits and design methods in the process of high-speed digital circuit design. They can understand the signal integrity concept which are related to the high-speed digital design, and master the high-speed characteristics of the basic logic circuits, measurement techniques and other issues about high-speed digital design that should be paid attention to, and being able to design of some typical high-speed digital circuits. This course not only improve the ability of the students in the field of electric measurement in theory and circuit design, but also build the foundation for the students who would be electronic system engineers in communication and testing area to study, research and development the high-speed digital design in the future.

default.zh: 本课程运用随机噪声理论分析噪声产生的原因和传播规律，研究被测信号和噪声的统计特征及差别；运用电子学和信号处理方法分析电路中噪声和干扰的抑制方法，从而达到检测被背景噪声覆盖的微弱信号的目的。介绍锁相放大、采样积分、相关检测、自适应降噪等几种行之有效的微弱信号检测方法和技术。微弱信号检测技术仍在持续发展，新的研究成果不断涌现。例如，基于人工神经网络、小波变换、混沌理论的微弱信号检测理论和方法都已经取得可喜的进展，本课程将简单介绍该方面最新研究成果。
default.en: This course uses the theory of random noise to analyze the causes and propagation rules of noise, and studies the statistical characteristics and differences between the measured signal and noise. In order to detect the weak signal covered by the background noise, the noise and interference suppression methods in the circuit are analyzed by means of electronics and signal processing methods. Several effective weak signal detection methods and techniques such as phase-locked amplification, sampling integration, correlation detection and adaptive noise reduction are introduced. Weak signal detection technology is still developing and new research results are emerging. For example, the theory and method of weak signal detection based on artificial neural network, wavelet transform and chaos theory have made great progress. This course will briefly introduce the latest research results in this field.

default.zh: “分布式测控系统原理与应用”课程面向智能测控工程专业本科生开设，重点讲解分布式测控系统中涉及的基本概念和系统工作原理，同时涉及本门课程在工程实践中需要专业知识，包括：分布式测控系统基本概念、信息物理系统、工业以太网、边缘计算及其网关的知识点。基于上述专业知识点的学习，使学生备分布式测控系统的基本建模与分析能力，理解研发分布式测控系统时需要重点考虑的环节，能够提出初步的方案设计思路，具备分析多种实现方案优势与不足的能力，达到综合运课程知识的基本能力，做到专业知识学习与动手实践教育的有机融合。
default.en: The course "Principle and Application of Distributed Measurement and Control System" is open to undergraduates majoring in the major of Intelligent Measurement and Control Engineering. It focuses on the basic concepts and system working principles involved in the distributed measurement and control system, as well as the professional knowledge required by the course in engineering practice, including: basic concepts of distributed measurement and control system, cyber physical system, industrial ethernet, edge computing and its gateway knowledge points. Based on the learning of the aforementioned professional knowledge points, the students can prepare the basic modeling and analysis ability of the distributed measurement and control system, understand the key links to be considered when developing the distributed measurement and control system, put forward preliminary scheme design ideas, have the ability to analyze the advantages and disadvantages of various implementation schemes, achieve the basic ability of comprehensive operation course knowledge, and achieve the organic integration of professional knowledge learning and hands-on practical education.

default.zh: 《计算机在生物学中的应用》是生物技术（+智能测控工程双学士学位）专业本科生的专业方向选修课。随着计算机和信息技术的飞速发展，计算机和信息技术在生物学中的应用也日趋广泛和深入，医学临床诊断、疾病治疗、生物信息学等研究都已经和计算机密切相关。计算机技术的发展极大促进了相关领域的发展，特别是近年来生物数据资源的膨胀使人们迫切需要一种新的工具去发现其中蕴含的生命规律，而已数据分析处理为本质的计算机科学技术刚好迎合了这一需求。 本课程主要介绍计算机在辅助医疗、医学图像处理以及生物信息学等领域的应用。课程教学内容主要包括课程介绍、计算机等基本工具的概述、计算机辅助医学技术、远程医疗技术、医学信息系统、生物医学中的建模与仿真、医学图像处理、压缩感知与医学成像技术、计算机在生物信息学中的应用等。通过课程的学习，使学生了解计算机在生物学中的应用发展现状以及国内外研究热点，理解计算机在生物学中的作用，掌握使用计算机进行生物学研究的一些基本概念、基础理论、基本原理及基本方法等。
default.en: "Applications of Computers in Biology" is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in Biotechnology (with a dual bachelor's degree in Intelligent Measurement and Control Engineering). With the rapid advancement of Computer Science and information technology, their applications in biology have become increasingly widespread and profound. Research areas such as medical clinical diagnosis, disease treatment, and bioinformatics are now inextricably linked to computing. Advancements in computer technology have significantly propelled progress in related fields. Particularly in recent years, the explosive growth of biological data resources has created an urgent need for new tools to uncover the underlying patterns of life. Computer science and technology, which fundamentally involve data analysis and processing, perfectly address this demand. This course primarily introduces the application of computers in fields such as computer-aided medicine, medical image processing, and bioinformatics. The curriculum content mainly includes course introduction, overview of basic tools like computers, computer-aided medical technology, telemedicine technology, medical information systems, modelling and simulation in biomedicine, medical image processing, compressed sensing and medical imaging technology, and the application of computers in bioinformatics. Through this course, students will understand the current state of computer applications in biology and emerging research trends domestically and internationally. They will comprehend the role of computers in biological research and master fundamental concepts, theories, principles, and methodologies for conducting biological studies using computational tools.

default.zh: 《生物信息学中的智能计算》是面向生命科学与人工智能交叉融合的前沿课程，契合智慧医疗与健康中国战略背景下对复合型人才的迫切需求。课程立足于生物信息学在疾病机制解析、药物研发、临床试验等领域的关键应用场景，强调以智能计算技术驱动生命大数据的深度挖掘与转化，旨在培养学生具备跨学科视野和面向未来的工程实践能力。 本课程系统讲授生物信息学的基本理论与多组学分析方法，介绍生物分子网络的结构与调控机制，阐释人工智能与智能计算的核心原理，并重点围绕智能优化算法、机器学习、深度学习等新一代技术在基因组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学和精准医疗中的应用展开。课程教学设计包含课堂讲授、问题研讨、报告撰写等环节，帮助学生在“生物机理+智能计算”的融合框架下构建系统化认知。 通过课程学习，学生不仅能够理解生物信息学中智能计算技术的理论体系和发展趋势，还能掌握跨组学数据整合、复杂网络建模、智能算法设计与实现等关键方法。在此过程中，重点培养三大核心能力：①生物大数据的智能处理与特征工程能力；②跨学科系统建模与因果关系挖掘能力；③面向临床与产业的智能算法应用与创新能力。作为生物技术（+智能测控工程双学士学位）专业的重要选修课程，本课程突破传统单学科边界，探索生命科学与智能计算的深度耦合，为学生未来在生物信息学研究、智慧医疗开发和交叉学科创新中奠定坚实基础。
default.en: Intelligent Computing in Bioinformatics is a cutting-edge course designed for the convergence of life sciences and artificial intelligence, addressing the urgent demand for multidisciplinary talent under the Smart Healthcare and Healthy China initiatives. Grounded in bioinformatics' critical applications across disease mechanism analysis, drug development, and clinical trials, the course emphasizes leveraging intelligent computing technologies to drive deep mining and transformation of life science big data. It aims to cultivate students' interdisciplinary perspectives and future-oriented engineering practice capabilities. This course systematically covers fundamental bioinformatics theories and multi-omics analysis methods, introduces the structure and regulatory mechanisms of biomolecular networks, and elucidates core principles of artificial intelligence and intelligent computing. It focuses on the application of next-generation technologies—including intelligent optimization algorithms, machine learning, and deep learning—in genomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and precision medicine. The course design incorporates classroom lectures, problem-based discussions, and report writing to help students build systematic understanding within an integrated “biological mechanisms + intelligent computing” framework. Through this course, students will not only grasp the theoretical framework and developmental trends of intelligent computing technologies in bioinformatics but also master key methodologies such as cross-omics data integration, complex network modeling, and intelligent algorithm design and implementation. The curriculum emphasizes cultivating three core competencies as follows. 1. Intelligent processing and feature engineering capabilities for biological big data. 2. Interdisciplinary systems modeling and causal relationship discovery. 3. Application and innovation of intelligent algorithms for clinical and industrial purposes. As a key elective for the Biotechnology (with Dual Bachelor's Degree in Intelligent Measurement and Control Engineering) program, this course transcends traditional disciplinary boundaries to explore deep integration between life sciences and intelligent computing. It lays a solid foundation for students' future endeavors in bioinformatics research, smart healthcare development, and interdisciplinary innovation.

default.zh: 专家系统是目前人工智能中最活跃、最有成效的一个研究领域，通常是指一类具有大量专门知识的计算机智能信息系统，它运用专门知识和人工智能中的推理技术来模拟人类专家解决各种复杂、具体的问题。课程通过总结前三代专家系统的设计方法和实现技术的基础上，在讲授专家系统基本知识的基础上，介绍大型分布式多级专家协作系统、广义知识表达、综合知识库与并行推理等技术，使学生了解人工神经网络专家系统、分布式人工智能专家系统以及多智能体协同系统等最新人工智能技术在专家系统中的应用。
default.en: Expert system is the most active and effective research field in artificial intelligence. It usually refers to a kind of computer intelligent information system with a lot of expertise. It uses expertise and artificial intelligence to predict the human experts. A complex and specific problem. On the basis of summarizing the design methods and implementation techniques of the first three generations of expert systems, the course introduces the techniques of large-scale distributed multi-level expert collaboration system, generalized knowledge representation, comprehensive knowledge base and parallel reasoning on the basis of teaching the basic knowledge of expert systems. Students can understand the application of the latest artificial intelligence technology such as artificial neural network expert system, distributed artificial intelligence expert system and multi-agent collaborative system in expert system.

default.zh: 《生命科学仪器综合实践》是生物技术（+智能测控工程双学士学位）专业本科生的专业选修课。本课程采用以“项目驱动”的教学方式，结合硬件搭建、软件仿真、系统开发与调试等方法，实现对所学理论知识的综合运用和实践开展。通过本课程的学习和实践，学生能够了解生命科学仪器的系统组成及工作原理、开发过程中的关键要素及难点问题，增强对生命科学仪器的原理认知能力、设计与实践能力，培养符合实际应用需求的复合型人才。

通过本课程的学习，让学生掌握深度神经网络，特别面向自然环境数据生成的AI技术——深度时空网络的工作原理和构建方法，学会利用人工智能领域最新的科技成果解决现实问题的方法，使学生理解研究创新的思路、方法，激发学生的研究兴趣，培养学生的科研素养和科学精神。具体如下： 课程目标1：熟悉几种基础的典型深度神经网络单元，即CNN、RNN、注意力机制等单元的组成结构、功能特点及使用方法； 课程目标2：理解相关领域对数字孪生自然环境的需求，能够构建出几种典型的深度时空网络，即ConvLSTM、PredRNN、Transformer，并利用它们实现对数字孪生大气、数字孪生海洋环境的构建； 课程目标3：激发学生对人工智能领域的研究兴趣，培养学生的科研素养和科学精神，具有自主学习和终身学习的意识，学会利用人工智能领域最新的科技成果解决现实问题的方法。
随着工业4.0与智能制造的快速发展，高端装备（如航空发动机、高铁、精密加工机床等）的运维技术正向智能化、数据驱动方向转型。本课程聚焦人工智能技术在高端装备运维领域的创新应用，旨在培养具备“AI+运维”复合能力的工程技术人才。课程以产教融合为路径，结合行业真实案例与前沿技术工具，构建“理论+实践+创新”三位一体的教学体系，助力学生掌握AI赋能装备运维的核心方法与工程实践能力。
default.en: With the rapid development of Industry 4.0 and smart manufacturing, operation and maintenance technologies for high-end equipment (such as aero engines, high-speed railways, precision machining tools) are transitioning toward intelligent and data-driven approaches. This course focuses on innovative applications of artificial intelligence technologies in the operation and maintenance of high-end equipment, aiming to cultivate engineering professionals with interdisciplinary competencies in "AI+maintenance". Through industry-education integration, the course combines real-world industry cases with cutting-edge technological tools to establish a tripartite educational system integrating "theory + practice + innovation". This framework empowers students to master core AI-powered equipment maintenance methodologies and engineering practical capabilities.

default.zh: 《工业智能的大与小》课程主要面向全校电子信息类专业本科生及研究生开设。通过主题式研讨，对“工业互联网”、“智能制造”、“新质生产力”三个核心主题进行分析，从重大装备和复杂工业系统日益突出的工业大数据智能分析与建模需求入手，引导学生从全寿命周期专业视角理解垂直场景轻量化智能小模型、全链条赋能泛化大模型和最新工业系统与装备间的紧密关联，重点阐述以工业互联网和工业大数据为典型代表的机器智能和计算智能在不同工业领域测试和试验中的研究、应用、发展和挑战。研讨主题将覆盖：智能感知、智能传输、智能计算、智能控制决策等智能工业系统所必需的核心技术。
default.en: This course mainly aims at undergraduate and graduate students majoring in electronic information. Through thematic discussion, three core themes of "industrial Internet", "intelligent manufacturing" and "new quality productivity" are focused. Starting with the increasingly prominent demand for intelligent analysis and modeling of industrial big data for major equipment and complex industrial systems, students are guided to understand the close relationship between vertical scene lightweight intelligent small models, full chain enabling generalization large models and the latest industrial systems and equipment from the perspective of life-cycle professionals, and focus on the research, application, development and challenges of machine intelligence and computing intelligence represented by industrial Internet and industrial big data in testing and experiments in different industrial fields. The seminar topics will cover the core technologies necessary for intelligent industrial systems, such as intelligent perception, intelligent transmission, intelligent computing, and intelligent control decision-making.

default.zh: 随着数字化与智能化的飞速发展，人工智能大模型正在引领技术变革。本课程探索人工智能大模型在测试与试验领域的创新应用。 人工智能大模型，即基于深度学习架构构建的大规模机器学习模型，以GPT、DeepSeek 等为代表，拥有海量参数与强大的学习能力，能处理多模态数据，涵盖文本、图像、音频等。通过在大规模数据上进行预训练，捕捉数据中的复杂模式与特征，展现出卓越的泛化性能。无论是自然语言处理中的文本生成、语义理解，还是计算机视觉里的图像识别、目标检测，大模型都取得了突破性进展，极大提升了相关任务的处理精度与效率。 在测试与试验领域，大模型技术展现出了广泛且深远的应用前景。在产品测试环节，大模型可依据过往产品的测试数据、故障案例等，构建智能故障预测模型，提前精准预测零部件可能出现的故障，有效降低产品在实际使用中的故障率，节省维护成本。在试验设计方面，大模型能利用算法优化试验方案，从海量潜在试验组合中筛选出最具代表性的样本，减少试验次数，缩短研发周期，同时保证试验结果的可靠性。对于试验数据的处理与分析，大模型能够快速处理和分析复杂、高维的试验数据，挖掘数据背后隐藏的规律与关联，辅助研究人员做出更科学的决策。 本课程将系统讲解大模型基础理论，结合丰富的测试与试验领域案例进行深度剖析，并安排实验项目让学生亲身体验大模型在专业场景中的应用流程。通过理论与实验相结合的教学方式，帮助学生掌握大模型在测试与试验领域的应用技巧，培养学生运用前沿技术解决专业实际问题的能力，为其未来在该领域的职业发展与创新研究筑牢坚实基础。
default.en: AI large models are leading technological changes. This course explores the innovative applications of AI large models in the field of testing and experimentation. In the field of test, large models has shown broad and far-reaching application prospects. In the product testing link, the large model can build an intelligent fault prediction model based on past product testing data, fault cases, etc., to accurately predict possible failures of components in advance, effectively reducing the failure rate of products in actual use and saving maintenance costs. In terms of experimental design, large models can use algorithms to optimize experimental plans, choose the most representative samples from a large number of potential experimental combinations, reduce the number of experiments, shorten the development cycle, and ensure the reliability of experimental results. For the processing and analysis of experimental data, large models can quickly process and analyze complex, high-dimensional experimental data, uncover hidden patterns and correlations behind the data, and assist researchers in making more scientific decisions. This course will systematically explain the basic theory of large models, conduct in-depth analysis based on rich testing and experimental field cases, and arrange experimental projects for students to personally experience the application process of large models in professional scenarios. By combining theory with experimentation in teaching, we aim to help students master the application skills of large models in the field of testing and experimentation, cultivate their ability to use cutting-edge technology to solve practical professional problems, and lay a solid foundation for their future career development and innovative research in this field.

default.zh: 在工业和科技领域信息主要通过测量获取。智能测控技术成为现代生产和高科技中的一项必不可少的基础技术。测控系统主要由传感器（测量装置）、测量控制电路（测控电路）和执行机构三部分组成，是现代生产和高科技研发中必不可少的基础技术，是电子信息领域的专业知识，在信息测量、信号处理及控制中具有广泛的应用。在整个测控系统中电路是最灵活的部分，具有便于放大、便于转换、便于传输、便于适应各种使用要求的特点。为了适应这一发展需要，并培养宽基础、具有创造性的人才，智能测控工程专业中的智能测控电路实践的内容必不可少。本课程通过多个实践环节，包括数字量控制的原理和实践、AD和DA的转换原理电路和实践、电机的控制方法及实践，智能化算法应用通过实践课程，使学生对测控电路、智能测控系统有一个更深刻的感性认识和理解，在实验中切实提高学生测控系统的实践能力。
default.en: In the industrial and technological fields, information is mainly obtained through measurement. Intelligent measurement and control technology has become an essential foundational technology in modern production and high-tech. The measurement and control system is mainly composed of three parts: sensors (measurement devices), measurement control circuits (measurement and control circuits), and execution mechanisms. It is an essential basic technology in modern production and high-tech research and development. It is a professional knowledge in the field of electronic information and has a wide range of applications in information measurement, signal processing, and control. In the entire measurement and control system, the circuit is the most flexible part, with the characteristics of easy amplification, easy conversion, easy transmission, and easy adaptation to various usage requirements. In order to adapt to this development needs and cultivate broad foundation and creative talents, the practical content of intelligent measurement and control circuits in the field of intelligent measurement and control engineering is essential. This course involves multiple practical steps, including the principles and practices of digital control, the conversion principles and circuits of AD and DA, and the control methods and practices of motors. The application of intelligent algorithms with practice, enabling students to have a deeper emotional understanding and understanding of measurement and control circuits and intelligent measurement and control systems. Through experiments, students' practical abilities in measurement and control systems are effectively improved.

default.zh: 本课程的目的是培养学生理解深度神经网络为基本骨架的现代深度学习方法的原理、组成和应用，以及软硬协同设计的基本概念和内涵；能够使用PyTorch等深度学习框架设计优化面向边缘端AI的轻量化软件算法，以及使用Verilog HDL，HLS，Vitis AI等开发工具链，进行硬件计算单元设计与系统架构调优；了解AI方法和AI工具对EDA软件及开发流程的设计辅助与优化。并且在学习过程中，学会使用AI工具辅助代码的编写、测试，以及辅助文献调研和报告撰写，为培养学生解决复杂学术、工程问题的能力奠定基础。
default.en: This course aims to equip students with a thorough understanding of the principles, components, and applications of modern deep-learning methods whose backbone is the deep neural network, as well as the fundamental concepts and implications of hardware–software co-design. Students will learn to design and optimize lightweight software algorithms for edge AI using deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, and to architect and tune hardware computing units and system architectures with the Verilog HDL, HLS, and Vitis AI toolchains. They will also explore how AI techniques and tools can assist and optimize the design flow of EDA software. Throughout the course, students will practice employing AI-based tools to aid in code writing and testing, literature research, and report composition, laying the groundwork for solving complex academic and engineering problems.

default.zh: “电子系统智能故障诊断”课程是工科高校电子信息类专业重要的专业课程。该课程以电子系统为研究对象，讲授智能故障诊断技术的内涵、技术体系、关键技术、应用方法及未来发展趋势。本课程重点介绍电子系统故障模式及影响分析方法、以及智能故障诊断技术的原理和实施手段，包括专家系统方法、模糊诊断方法、神经网络诊断方法、基于规则的方法、信息融合诊断方法等，并介绍不同类型诊断方法的特点、适用范围，以及工程实践中的具体应用实例。 通过本课程的学习，将帮助学生理解电子系统智能故障诊断技术基本概念、体系结构和关键技术。本课程采用理论学习配合仿真实验的方式进行教学，对于学生后续学习电子信息领域相关的分析、测试和诊断等智能科学技术和专业技术起到引导和启发的作用，为后续研究生学习奠定基础。
default.en: Intelligent fault diagnosis technique for electronic system is a professional basic course for students majoring in electronic and information engineering. This course focuses on the fault diagnosis problem for electronic system, and its main purpose is about the basic concept, technical architecture, key technology, application analysis and future development prospect for the intelligent fault diagnosis technique. This course detailly introduces the failure mode and effect analysis technique for electronic system, as well as the principle and implementation mean for intelligent fault diagnosis, such as expert system method, fuzzy diagnosis method, neural network method, the rule-based method, and the information fusion method. Finally, the characteristics, application scope and the implementation instance are introduced in detail. The purpose of this course is to help students to establish a theoretical basis in basic concept, architecture and key technology for intelligent fault diagnosis technique for electronic system. Through combination of theoretical knowledge and simulation application, students are trained to have the ability of solving practical problems using fault diagnosis methods. The course will benefit the students in further study, research, and development in the fields of analysis, test and diagnosis, which helps them build foundation for subsequent graduate studies.

default.zh: 实时计算在当今社会中起着至关重要的作用，越来越多的复杂系统依赖于计算系统控制，应用场景包括核电站、铁路道岔转换系统、汽车和航空电子系统、空中交通管制、电信、机器人和军事系统。近年来，实时计算在诸如医疗设备、消费电子、多媒体系统、飞行模拟系统、虚拟现实和交互式游戏等新的应用领域中得到应用。尽管应用领域广泛，当前大多数实时系统仍使用底层编程和经验技术进行设计和实现，缺乏科学方法论支持。这种方法导致缺乏可靠性，在关键应用中可能导致严重的环境破坏甚至生命损失。本课程教学面向实时计算的基础，强调可预测性调度算法。主要目的是讲授实时计算的基本概念、本领域最重要的研究结果，提供设计可预测计算系统的基本方法，用以支持关键控制应用。
default.en: Real-time computing plays a crucial role in today's society because more and more complex systems rely on computing system control. Application scenarios include nuclear power plants, railway turnout conversion systems, automotive and avionics systems, air traffic control, telecommunications, robotics, and military systems. Recently, real-time computing has been applied in new application fields such as medical devices, consumer electronics, multimedia systems, flight simulation systems, virtual reality, and interactive games. Despite its wide range of applications, most current real-time systems still use low-level programming and experiential techniques for design and implementation, lacking scientific methodological support. This method leads to a lack of reliability and may lead to serious environmental damage or even loss of life in critical applications. This course focuses on the foundation of real-time computing and emphasizes predictable scheduling algorithms. The main purpose is to teach the basic concepts of real-time computing, the most important research results in this field, and provide basic methods for designing predictable computing systems to support critical control applications.

default.zh: 嵌入式系统是测控技术及仪器专业的重要应用技术基础课程。随着后PC时代的到来，嵌入式系统已成为当前应用最广、最有发展前景的IT应用技术之一，它融合了电子、计算机、微电子等多种学科和技术，被广泛应用于航天、航空、工业控制、消费类电子、医疗仪器、汽车电子等领域。目前，嵌入式系统产品正不断渗透各个行业，并以其应用领域广、人才需求大等优势，获得更大的关注，特别是将来3G和物联网的普及与推广，应用前景非常好。嵌入式系统是在单片机上发展而来，它是以应用为中心，以计算机技术为基础，软硬件可裁剪，适用于系统，对功能、可靠性、成本、体积、功耗有严格要求的专用计算机系统。它涉及硬件设计和软件开发，具有综合性、系统性和实践性等特点。 本课程针对嵌入式系统设计入门起点高，对计算机基础理论及实践能力要求较高的特点，采用课程课堂讲授与实验相结合的教学方法，突出基础和全面，采用最主流的处理器和操作系统，让学生完整地实践嵌入式系统项目开发的基本流程， 从而使学生深刻理解嵌入式系统的基本要素和概念，掌握嵌入式系统软硬件设计基本原理和方法，使其初步具备嵌入式系统设计能力，为学生未来从事电子设计及相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要的基础。
default.en: In this class, the fundamentals of embedded system hardware and firmware design will be explored. Issues such as embedded processor selection, hardware/firmware partitioning, design methods of embedded system, development tools, firmware architecture, firmware design, and firmware debugging will be discussed. ARM microprocessor and Linux are one of the most popular embedded microprocessors and embedded operating systems, respectively. By using an ARM9 experimental box, each student will experience how to develop and download bootloader, transplant Linux operating system, and develop application programs and drivers of peripheral equipments. The course will culminate with a significant final project which will help students to deepen their comprehension to most knowledge of this course. Depending on the interests of the students, other topics may be covered.

default.zh: 本课程是面向通信工程专业的创新实践课程，针对无线通信系统蒙特卡洛仿真方法和无线信道建立方法两方面内容，包括信道传输性能，信道编码理论，调制解调技术等仿真实践项目。学生通过分组多个仿真题目，锻炼通过计算机编程来解决实际问题的能力，培养学生养成良好的编程习惯，了解软件工程或大型软件开发流程及注意事项，熟悉经典算法，开拓逻辑思路，进一步加深对通信系统和关键技术的理解，完成技术到系统，基础到尖端，理论到实践的转变，从而达到提高学生专业综合能力的教学目的。
default.en: This course is the professional courses of Electronics and Communications Engineering. By the pre-integrated in the teaching process that the courses covered the relevant knowledge and skills, this course should further deep the understanding of the basic principles of communication systems. Combination of practice teaching and training would enable students to master the system interconnect, to understand the basic components of modern communication systems, and gain a basic digital modulation / demodulation method to complete the module to the system, basic to the sophisticated types of experiments. Based on the theoretical teaching, a lot of time is used for hands-on experiments. Students can test proficient by the use of software on the computer for basic communication system simulation analysis.

default.zh: 本课程是电子与通信工程系的专业实践课程，目的是培养学生基于FPGA的通信系统设计能力和工程实践能力，在专业学习中有比较重要的地位。本课程在简介可编程器件（PLD、EPLD）发展的基础上，重点介绍FPGA的原理及基于FPGA的通信系统设计方法。该课程主要结合实例学习通信系统常用的接口技术、时序设计技术、信道编码技术和数字调制解调技术等在FPGA上的基本实现原理和设计方法。通过课程学习，学生能够运用HDL语言、EDA软件、仿真软件、数字信号处理软件和嵌入式开发软件等进行通信系统收发信机的设计，从而增强学生对专业知识的理解，培养学生的硬件设计能力和创新能力。通过实验教学，本课程可以培养学生通信系统综合分析能力、设计能力和工程问题解决能力；增强学生创新意识和团队协作能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: This course is a specialized practice course in the Department of Electronic and Communication Engineering. The purpose of this course is to train students' FPGA based communication system design capability and engineering practice ability. Therefore, this course has an important position in professional learning. This course firstly introduces the outline of programmable devices (PLD, EPLD), then focuses on the principles of FPGA and the design methods of communication systems based on FPGA. This course mainly introduces the basic realization principle and design methods of FPGA on the practical examples, such as interface technology, time sequence design technology, channel coding technology and digital modulation and demodulation technology. Through the course of learning, students can design the communication transceivers using HDL language, EDA software, simulation software, DSP software and embedded software, so as to enhance the students' understanding of professional knowledge, cultivate students' ability of hardware design and innovation ability. By experimental learning, this course can cultivate students' communication ability, comprehensive analysis of system engineering design ability and problem solving ability; enhance students' innovative consciousness and team cooperation ability, to reach the corresponding index point in support of professional learning.

default.zh: 信号处理系统综合建模与仿真是电子信类学生在高年级开设的实践类课程。本课程的主要内容：数字信号处理实践问题选讲、统计信号处理基础——信号检测、空域采样、仿真方法与课程设计。实践环节要求完成基本的设计型实验项目和基于项目的课程设计，并撰写报告。通过课程设计，培养学生的工程意识以及工程方案设计、实现能力，锻炼学生独立思考和分析、解决问题的能力，使学生熟悉和掌握利用仿真设计的应用技术，具备运用基础知识和现代工具研究解决电子信息工程领域相关复杂工程问题的能力，提高就复杂工程问题进行文献综述、独立分析、有效沟通和交流能力、解决问题能力，具备项目管理能力以及团队合作的综合能力，具备多渠道获取知识能力，具有不断学习和适应发展的能力。
default.en: Integrated Modeling and Simulation for Signal Processing Systems is the practical course for sophomore major in electronics information. Its main content includes select topic for practical problems of signal processing, statistical signal processing: signal detection, space sampling, simulation method and projects. The systematic projects should be designed by students, and reports need to be proposed. Through the project, it can develop students’ engineering consciousness and ability, and train students' abilities of independent thinking and of analyzing and solving the problems. It can also help students master the simulation technology of information confrontation by using computer, and acquire the ability of solving technical and engineering problems related to electronic system based on basic theories and modern tools. It improves the ability of literature review, independent analysis of complex engineering problems. Through this course, the communication skills on complex engineering problems, comprehensive ability of project management ability, team spirit and self-learning capabilities with multi-channel access to adapt the development can be enhanced.

default.zh: 本课程在学习和掌握电子信息工程技术基本理论的基础上，通过实验将课程知识应用于电子信息工程中的实践认识中，使学生初步了解、掌握电子信息工程中雷达系统回波建模仿真及其信号处理的基本原理和实现方法，培养学生通过项目初步掌握电子系统建模与仿真方法解决实际问题的能力，培养学生将基本理论与实践相结合能力，提高学生运用所学理论知识，查阅文献并独立分析和解决问题能力，增强沟通与表达能力，具备项目管理能力以及团队合作的综合能力。通过本课程的实验设计、实验讲解和实验操作等环节，着重培养学生对实际问题的综合分析、设计及应用能力，增加创新意识，能够通过多种不同的形式和方法获得新知识的能力。
default.en: This course applies theoretical knowledge to practical understanding of electronic information engineering, enabling students to have a preliminary understanding of radar system echo modeling and simulation, as well as the basic principles and implementation methods of signal processing. Through project-based modeling and simulation methods in radar systems, students are trained to solve practical problems, improve their ability to apply theoretical knowledge, consult literature, independently analyze and solve problems, enhance communication and expression skills, possess project management skills, and possess comprehensive teamwork abilities. Through experimental course design etc., the focus is on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis, design, and application abilities to practical problems, enhancing their innovative awareness, and being able to acquire new knowledge through various forms and methods.

default.zh: 本课程为电子工程等专业实践课程。在教学过程中综合先修课程中所学到的有关知识和技能，进一步加深对雷达等电子系统基本原理的理解。通过Matlab软件对雷达信号处理过程进行仿真，使学生能够理论联系实际的掌握系统的基本信号处理过程，并对信号处理过程中所遇到的问题能够深入探讨，通过实践活动进一步理解所学的理论和实际的关系。
default.en: This course is a professional practice course of electronic engineering. In the teaching process, the knowledge and skills acquired in the advanced courses are integrated to further deepen the understanding of the basic principles of electronic systems such as radar. The radar signal processing process is simulated by MATLAB software, so that the students can grasp the basic signal processing process of the system theoretically and practically, and the problems encountered in the signal processing process can be discussed in depth, through practical activities to further understand the relationship between theory and practice.

default.zh: 信息对抗专业电子信息类实践课III，是在学习和掌握信息对抗基本理论的基础上，将理论知识应用于信息对抗的实践认识中，使学生初步了解和掌握信息对抗技术的基本原理及实现方法。通过完成课程内比较系统的课程设计，培养学生的工程意识以及工程方案设计、实现能力，锻炼学生独立思考和分析、解决问题的能力，使学生熟悉和掌握利用计算机进行信息对抗相关仿真设计的应用技术，具备运用基础知识和现代工具研究解决信息对抗中相关复杂工程问题的能力，提高就复杂工程问题与他人进行有效的沟通和交流能力，增强团队合作意识，具备多渠道获取信息的能力。本课程的主要内容：先介绍计算机仿真和辅助设计的基本原理和应用技术，再从目标运动模型、目标RCS曲线、雷达对抗、红外对抗、电子干扰和网络对抗等方向介绍信息对抗技术的基本理论知识，在计算机技术与信息对抗中常用模型的基础上，进行目标模型、红外传感器模型、雷达模型以及电子干扰模型的计算机辅助设计，并撰写报告。
default.en: The practice class III of Electronic information in the technology of information confrontation, which is based on the basic theories in learning and mastering information technology and in applying the theoretical knowledge to the practice and recognition of the technology of information confrontation, makes students understand and master the basic principles of information confrontation technology and implementation methods. The systematic projects should be designed by students, which can develop students’ engineering consciousness and ability, and train students' abilities of independent thinking and of analyzing and solving the problems. It can also help students master the simulation technology of information confrontation by using computer, and acquire the ability of solving technical and engineering problems related to information confrontation based on basic theories and modern tools. During this course, the communication skills on complex engineering problems, team spirit and self-learning capabilities can be enhanced. Main contents of the course include the introduction of basic principles and technology of CAD, the basic theoretical knowledge of information confrontation: target’s motion model, the curve of target’s RCS, radar countermeasure, infrared countermeasure, electronic jamming and the network confrontation; the projects are designed in the field of target model, infrared sensor model, radar model and electronic jamming model, which are based on computer technology and information model in confrontation, and the reports should be written.

default.zh: 遥感图像处理及遥感系统仿真创新（实践课III）主要讲授计算机遥感数字图像处理前沿方法的实现及其在实际科学问题中的应用与创新，是一门多学科交叉的实践创新型课程。本课程采用中英双语授课方式，主要内容分为理论讲授、基础实验与创新实践三部分。理论讲授包括遥感数字图像处理创新技术，包括图像增强、图像校正、图像分类等，及其在城市遥感、水体遥感等研究领域内的应用方法；理论讲授部分结束后，学生进行遥感图像处理基础实验，实验内容涉及遥感数字图像处理的主要步骤：图像增强、图像校正以及图像中信息提取等；在创新实践部分，学生通过结合不同的遥感数字图像处理技术，对遥感数字图像处理系统进行仿真创新实践，实现其在不同实际应用下的模拟仿真。通过该门课程的学习，使学生了解遥感科学与技术的研究状态及发展趋势，掌握遥感数字图像处理技术方法的实现及其在不同科学领域内的应用，并培养学生解决实际问题的创新实践能力。在教学过程中，结合理论讲授与创新实践，从计算机遥感数字图像处理基本技术方法入手，着重培养学生的实践能力和创新精神，提高学生对遥感科学领域前沿问题的兴趣，为后续专业课程及今后在相关领域内的工作及科研奠定基础。
default.en: Remote sensing and technology innovation and practice curriculum design (Practical Course III) mainly introduces the state of the art remote sensing digital images processing techniques, and its application and innovation in practical scientific problems. The course is a multi-disciplinary practical innovative course, which is based on both Chinese and English. The main content includes three parts: theory, fundamental experiments and innovation projects. Theory part includes remote sensing digital images processing innovative techniques and the applications in the research areas of urban remote sensing, water remote sensing and etc. The theory part is followed by the remote sensing image processing fundamental experiments, which include the application of remote sensing science in different research fields. After the fundamental experiments, students will accomplish the innovation projects based on different applications of remote sensing digital image processing, including marine remote sensing, remote sensing of vegetation, urban remote sensing, geological remote sensing and etc. The course can develop students' capability in remote sensing science and technology research, and improve their interests in corresponding research areas. This course would build a solid foundation for their following courses and future research.

default.zh: 本课程主要是教授学生如何使用电磁仿真软件CST（Computer Simulation Technology）微波工作室，对不同类型的天线与微波无源电路进行电磁建模、仿真及分析，使学生巩固前期所学习的电磁学理论知识，掌握天线及微波无源电路设计技巧，通过独立完成天线及微波无源电路设计与相应实验，培养学生独立设计和解决技术问题的基本能力。
default.en: This course aims to show attendants how to use electromagnetic simulation software (Computer Simulation Technology), microwave studio to model, simulate and analyze different antennas and microwave passive circuits. This course helps attendants to enhance the theoretical foundation of electromagnetic knowledge, master the skill of antenna and microwave passive circuits design, cultivate the attendants the independence and ability of problem solutions by independently completing the design and related experiments.

default.zh: 《基于虚拟仪器的智能测控系统综合实践》面向智能测控工程专业本科生开设。本课程采用以“项目驱动”的教学方式，结合算法学习、软件仿真、系统开发与调试等方法，实现对所学理论知识的综合运用和实践开展。通过本课程的学习和实践，学生能够了解智能测控系统开发过程中的关键问题以及解决办法，增强对智能测控系统的理解、设计与实践能力，培养符合实际工业需求的应用型人才。
default.en: The Comprehensive Practice of Intelligent Measurement and Control System Based on Virtual Instruments is open to undergraduate students majoring in intelligent measurement and control engineering. This course adopts a project-driven teaching approach, combining methods such as algorithm learning, software simulation, system development and debugging, to achieve comprehensive application and practical implementation of theoretical knowledge learned. Through the study and practice of this course, students can understand the key problems and solutions in the development process of intelligent measurement and control systems, enhance their understanding, design, and practical abilities of intelligent measurement and control systems, and cultivate applied talents that meet the actual industrial needs.

default.zh: 生产实习（含认识实习）是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生了解和掌握基本生产知识，验证、巩固和丰富已学过的专业课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，同时也培养了学生注重团队协作的意识，为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。认识实习是在学生已掌握一定的专业基础知识的前提下，进一步增强感性认识，拓宽对于电子信息工程领域的设计、生产、加工过程、工艺设备及工艺装备的了解，为后续专业课程的学习奠定良好的基础。通过生产实习和认识实习，可以使学生了解信息产业发展现状和发展趋势及前沿技术，培养热爱专业、致力于祖国社会主义建设的思想。
default.en: Production practice (including cognition practice) is a very important practical teaching link in undergraduate teaching plan, the purpose is to make students understand and grasp the basic knowledge production, verify, consolidate and rich have learned professional curriculum content, training students to integrate theory with practice, to improve the ability and methods of investigating, observing, analyzing and solving problems in production. At the same time, it also cultivates students' awareness of teamwork and lays a foundation for the subsequent study of professional courses. Cognition practice is based on the students have mastered some professional knowledge under the premise of further enhance the perceptual knowledge, widen for electronic information engineering in the field of design, production, processing process, process equipment and process equipment, for the follow-up professional courses of study to lay the good foundation. Through production practice and cognition practice, can make the students understand the current situation of the development of information industry and the development trend and frontier technology, cultivate love the professional, dedicated to the thought of the construction of the socialist motherland.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本科生对大学所学课程的一次全面总结，也是对大学生学习的总验收；是在完成本专业所有课程学习后必须进行的一个重要实践性环节。通过该环节，锻炼学生调查研究和文献综述能力，培养学生利用现代工具，综合运用所学的基础理论知识和专业知识分析和解决电子信息领域复杂工程技术问题的能力。同时，拓宽学生的知识面，锻炼获取新知识的能力，提高学生的自学能力、论文撰写、独立工作能力，增强学生的社会责任感、创新精神、实践能力与综合素质。
default.en: The graduation thesis (design) is a comprehensive summary of the college courses for undergraduates, and also a general acceptance of college students' learning; It is an important practical activity that must be carried out after completing all courses of this major. Through this activity, students' abilities of investigation and research and literature review will be trained, and their abilities of using modern tools to comprehensively use the basic theoretical knowledge and professional knowledge learned to analyze and solve complex engineering and technical problems in the field of electronic information will be trained. At the same time, It will broaden the scope of students' knowledge, exercise their ability to acquire new knowledge, improve their self-study ability, thesis writing ability and independent working ability, and enhance their sense of social responsibility, innovation spirit, practical ability and comprehensive quality.

default.zh: 通信系统综合实践项目是本专业的一门选修课。本课程是将本专业在所学的《通信原理》等课程的相关知识综合运用，使学生利用软件无线电平台实现通信系统的收发功能、掌握评估通信系统的性能方法。本课程从信号的产生、接收和处理入手，使学生掌握LabVIEW语言进行软件无线电平台编程的基本方法，对调制、解调、编码、解码等通信系统的相关技术就行编程实践，将理论应用于实践，加深学生对通信系统组成、相关知识应用的理解。通过课程设计，以项目牵引、面向实际系统，进一步激发学生对实际通信系统设计的兴趣，培养学生的创新能力和程序设计的能力以及综合运用所学知识和解决实际的工程问题的能力，为后续移动通信等课程及毕业设计奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Comprehensive Practice in Communication Systems is an elective course for this major. This course is a comprehensive application of the relevant knowledge of this major in the learned "Principles of Communication" and other courses, so that students can use the software radio platform to realize the transceiver function of the communication system, and master the method of evaluating the performance of the communication system. This course starts from the generation, reception and processing of signals, so that students master LabVIEW language for software radio platform programming of the basic methods of modulation, demodulation, coding, decoding and other related technologies of the communication system on the line programming practice, the application of theory in practice to deepen students' understanding of the composition of the communication system, application of relevant knowledge. Through the course design, project-oriented, practical system, to further stimulate students' interest in the design of actual communication systems, to develop students' innovation and programming ability and the ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge gained and to solve practical engineering problems, and to lay a solid foundation for the subsequent mobile communication courses and graduation design.

default.zh: 智能感知系统创新实践入门课，是在了解和掌握电子系统基本原理、组成、结构和使用方法的基础上，学习将理论知识应用于实践应用，培养学生通过项目实践学习初步掌握系统应用创新的过程和方法，面向实际应用进行实验设计、验证和分析，培养学生将学习的知识与实践相结合的能力，提高学生自主学习、查阅文献，并通过团队合作分析和解决问题的能力，增强沟通与表达能力，初步感受团队合作的力量。通过本课程的课堂教学、实验设计和实践等环节，着重培养学生对实际问题的综合分析、设计及应用能力，增加创新意识，初步感受通过多种不同的形式和方法获得新知识的过程，为后续理论学习与科研实践活动打下良好的系统级实践入门基础。
default.en: Introduction to Innovation Practice for Intelligent Sensing System, based on understanding and mastering the basic principles, composition, structure and using methods of electronic systems, aims to let students learn apply theoretical knowledge to practical applications, initially master the process of system application innovation through projects, carry out experimental design, verification and analysis for practical applications, combine learned knowledge with practice, learn independently, consult literature, analyze and solve problems through teamwork, enhance communication and expression and initially feel the power of teamwork. Through the classroom teaching, experimental design and practice of this course, it focuses on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis, design and application ability to practical problems, increases their sense of innovation, and initially feels the process of acquiring new knowledge through a variety of different forms and methods. Follow-up theoretical study and scientific research practice activities lay a good foundation for system-level practice entry.

default.en: This course is offered by the School of Electronic and Information Engineering for undergraduates majoring in electronic and information engineering. Production practice (including cognition practice) is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan. Its purpose is to enable students to understand and master basic production knowledge, verify, consolidate and enrich the content of the professional courses they have learned, and train students to combine theory with practice. Improve their ability and method of investigation and research, observation, analysis and problem solving in production, and cultivate their awareness of teamwork, which lays a foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses. Cognitive practice is to further enhance perceptual understanding and broaden the understanding of design, production, processing, process equipment and process equipment in the field of electronic information engineering on the premise that students have mastered certain basic professional knowledge, so as to lay a good foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses. Through production practice and cognition practice, students can understand the current situation and development trend of the information industry and cutting-edge technology, and cultivate the idea of loving the profession and committing to the socialist construction of the motherland.

default.zh: 本课程由电子与信息工程学院面向电子信息工程专业本科生开设。通过毕业设计，学生可以综合运用大学期间学习获得的知识技能对毕业课题进行深入学习和创新研究，提出相应的解决方案并予以验证。锻炼提升学生综合知识应用能力、实践能力、自学能力、沟通能力、增强创新思维、培养复杂工程问题的解决能力、培养职业素养及责任感。为后续学业深造或就业打下基础。
default.en: This course is offered by the School of Electronic and Information Engineering to the students majoring in electronic information. Through graduation projects, students can comprehensively apply the knowledge and skills acquired during their undergraduate studies to conduct in-depth learning and innovative research on their graduation projects, propose corresponding solutions and verify their results. For students, Graduation Design can improve their comprehensive knowledge application ability, practical ability, self-learning ability, communication ability, enhance their innovative thinking, cultivate the ability to solve complex engineering problems, and cultivate their professional performance. It is a necessary course to prepare students for their further education or employment.

default.zh: 本课程是电子与信息工程学院开设的一门面向未来技术学院的课程设计类课程，其目的是使学生了解和掌握电子信息类专业基本硬件实践开发知识、丰富已学过的专业基础课程内容，以物联网综合项目培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在项目开发过程中发现问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力，同时也培养了学生注重团队协作的意识，为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。同时课程内容还包括学校对学科竞赛的政策，电子信息类学科竞赛解读、优秀项目作品分享，注重课赛结合，以课促赛。
default.en: This course is a future-oriented curriculum design course offered by the School of Electronic and Information Engineering for the School of Technology. Its purpose is to enable students to understand and master the basic hardware practical development knowledge of electronic and information majors, enrich the content of the basic professional courses they have learned, and train students to combine theory with practice through the comprehensive project of the Internet of Things. Improve their ability to find, analyze and solve problems in the process of project development, and cultivate their awareness of teamwork, which lays a foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses. At the same time, the course content also includes the school's policy on discipline competitions, the interpretation of electronic information discipline competitions, the sharing of excellent project works, the combination of lessons and competitions, and the promotion of competitions with lessons.
