default.en: This course is designed by the College of Electronic and Information Engineering for students majoring in electronic and information engineering (College of Future Technology). Its purpose is to enable students to understand and master the development process of integrated electronic system, enrich the core course content of electronic and information engineering that they have learned, and set up experimental projects at different levels with millimeter wave radar, a typical electronic system. Cultivate students' ability to combine theory with practice, improve their ability to find, analyze and solve problems in the process of project development, train their innovative thinking, cultivate their awareness of teamwork, and lay a foundation for subsequent scientific research.

default.en: The course of Integrated Design of Electronic Systems is a synthetic and designing practical course for electronics and information engineering major and other related majors. Through the design and implementation of an electronic system based on engineering practice, this course enables students to not only understand the basics of the composition, design principles and methods of electronic systems, but also to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned in Foundation of Electronics Circuits, Digital Logic Circuit and Systems, Principles of Microcomputers and Microcontrollers to electronic systems. Then master the construction, debugging, and testing methods of electronic systems, and initially possess the ability to design software and hardware of electronic systems.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授计算机遥感数字图像处理创新方法的实现及其在实际科学问题中的应用与创新，是一门多学科交叉的实践创新型课程。课程的教学目的是使学生了解遥感数字图像的特点及其目前的研究状态与发展趋势，掌握图像增强、图像复原、图像分割及目标检测等遥感图像处理的技术方法，并将其应用于地质遥感、植被遥感等实际问题的解决；同时，将不同遥感图像处理技术相结合，通过对遥感数字图像处理系统的仿真创新实验，全面培养学生在遥感技术领域内的科研与创新实践能力。在教学过程中，结合理论讲授与创新实践，从遥感数字图像处理基本技术方法入手，着重培养学生在遥感科学专业方面的科研创新精神与工程实践能力，提高学生对遥感科学领域前沿问题的兴趣，为后续专业课程及今后在相关领域内的工作及科研奠定基础。
default.en: This course primarily focuses on the implementation of innovative methods for digital image processing in computer-based remote sensing, as well as their application and innovation in addressing real-world scientific problems. It is a practice- and innovation-oriented course that integrates multiple disciplines. The objective of the course is to enable students to understand the characteristics of remote sensing digital images, current research status, and emerging trends. Students will master key techniques in remote sensing image processing, including image enhancement, image restoration, image segmentation, and object detection. These techniques will be applied to solve practical problems in fields such as geological and vegetation remote sensing. Furthermore, by integrating various remote sensing image processing techniques, the course includes experimental simulations aimed at fostering students' research and innovation capabilities in the field of remote sensing technology. The course combines theoretical instruction with hands-on innovation practice. Beginning with the fundamental technical methods of remote sensing digital image processing, it emphasizes cultivating students' scientific research innovation and engineering practice abilities in the field of remote sensing science. It aims to stimulate interest in cutting-edge issues in remote sensing science and lay a solid foundation for subsequent professional courses, future careers, and research in related fields.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本科生对大学所学课程的一次全面总结，也是对大学生学习的总验收；是在完成本专业所有课程学习后必须进行的一个重要实践性环节。通过该环节，锻炼学生调查研究和文献综述能力，培养学生利用现代工具，综合运用所学的基础理论知识和专业知识分析和解决电子信息领域复杂工程技术问题的能力。同时，拓宽学生的知识面，锻炼获取新知识的能力，提高学生的自学能力、论文撰写、独立工作能力，增强学生的社会责任感、创新精神、实践能力与综合素质。
default.en: The graduation thesis (design) is a comprehensive summary of the college courses for undergraduates, and also a general acceptance of college students' learning; It is an important practical activity that must be carried out after completing all courses of this major. Through this activity, students' abilities of investigation and research and literature review will be trained, and their abilities of using modern tools to comprehensively use the basic theoretical knowledge and professional knowledge learned to analyze and solve complex engineering and technical problems in the field of electronic information will be trained. At the same time, It will broaden the scope of students' knowledge, exercise their ability to acquire new knowledge, improve their self-study ability, thesis writing ability and independent working ability, and enhance their sense of social responsibility, innovation spirit, practical ability and comprehensive quality.

default.zh: 本课程主要是教授学生如何使用电磁仿真软件CST（Computer Simulation Technology）微波工作室，对不同类型的天线与微波无源电路进行电磁建模、仿真及分析，使学生巩固前期所学习的电磁学理论知识，掌握天线及微波无源电路设计技巧，通过独立完成天线及微波无源电路设计与相应实验，培养学生独立设计和解决技术问题的基本能力。
default.en: This course aims to show attendants how to use electromagnetic simulation software (Computer Simulation Technology), microwave studio to model, simulate and analyze different antennas and microwave passive circuits. This course helps attendants to enhance the theoretical foundation of electromagnetic knowledge, master the skill of antenna and microwave passive circuits design, cultivate the attendants the independence and ability of problem solutions by independently completing the design and related experiments.

default.zh: “生产实习”是电子信息类专业课中必不可少组成部分，通过生产实习学生在专业知识和人才素质两方面得到锻炼和培养，为毕业后走向工作岗位打下良好基础。生产实习过程中，培养学生观察问题、解决问题及在实际生产中学习的能力和方法，培养学生的实践能力、创新意识、团结合作精神。学生应从身边点滴做起，不断汲取他人长处补己之短，学习工程技术人员和工人师傅的敬业精神和献身精神。
default.en: "Production Practice" is an indispensable part of professional courses of electronic information class . Through production practice, students can exercise and cultivate professional knowledge and talent quality, and lay a good foundation for going to work after graduation. In the process of production practice, the students' abilities of observing problems, solving problems and learning in actual production are cultivated, and students' practical ability, innovation consciousness and unity and cooperation spirit are cultivated. Students should start from the little things around them, constantly learn from the strengths of others to make up for their shortcomings, learn from the professionalism and dedication of engineering technicians and workers.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本科生对大学所学课程的一次全面总结，也是对大学生学习的总验收；是在完成本专业所有课程学习后必须进行的一个重要实践性环节。通过该环节，锻炼学生调查研究和文献综述能力，培养学生利用现代工具，综合运用所学的基础理论知识和专业知识分析和解决电子信息领域复杂工程技术问题的能力。同时，拓宽学生的知识面，锻炼获取新知识的能力，提高学生的自学能力、论文撰写、独立工作能力，增强学生的社会责任感、创新精神、实践能力与综合素质。
default.en: The graduation thesis(design) is a comprehensive summary of the college courses for undergraduates, and also a general acceptance of college students' learning; It is an important practical activity that must be carried out after completing all courses of this major. Through this activity, students' abilities of investigation and research and literature review will be trained, and their abilities of using modern tools to comprehensively use the basic theoretical knowledge and professional knowledge learned to analyze and solve complex engineering and technical problems in the field of electronic information will be trained. At the same time, It will broaden the scope of students' knowledge, exercise their ability to acquire new knowledge, improve their self-study ability, thesis writing ability and independent working ability, and enhance their sense of social responsibility, innovation spirit, practical ability and comprehensive quality.

default.zh: 在工业和科技领域信息主要通过测量获取。智能测控技术成为现代生产和高科技中的一项必不可少的基础技术。测控系统主要由传感器（测量装置）、测量控制电路（测控电路）和执行机构三部分组成，是现代生产和高科技研发中必不可少的基础技术，是电子信息领域的专业知识，在信息测量、信号处理及控制中具有广泛的应用。在整个测控系统中电路是最灵活的部分，具有便于放大、便于转换、便于传输、便于适应各种使用要求的特点。为了适应这一发展需要，并培养宽基础、具有创造性的人才，智能测控工程专业中的智能测控电路实践的内容必不可少。本课程通过多个实践环节，包括数字量控制的原理和实践、AD和DA的转换原理电路和实践、电机的控制方法及实践，智能化算法应用通过实践课程，使学生对测控电路、智能测控系统有一个更深刻的感性认识和理解，在实验中切实提高学生测控系统的实践能力。
default.en: In the industrial and technological fields, information is mainly obtained through measurement. Intelligent measurement and control technology has become an essential foundational technology in modern production and high-tech. The measurement and control system is mainly composed of three parts: sensors (measurement devices), measurement control circuits (measurement and control circuits), and execution mechanisms. It is an essential basic technology in modern production and high-tech research and development. It is a professional knowledge in the field of electronic information and has a wide range of applications in information measurement, signal processing, and control. In the entire measurement and control system, the circuit is the most flexible part, with the characteristics of easy amplification, easy conversion, easy transmission, and easy adaptation to various usage requirements. In order to adapt to this development needs and cultivate broad foundation and creative talents, the practical content of intelligent measurement and control circuits in the field of intelligent measurement and control engineering is essential. This course involves multiple practical steps, including the principles and practices of digital control, the conversion principles and circuits of AD and DA, and the control methods and practices of motors. The application of intelligent algorithms with practice, enabling students to have a deeper emotional understanding and understanding of measurement and control circuits and intelligent measurement and control systems. Through experiments, students' practical abilities in measurement and control systems are effectively improved.

default.zh: 本课程侧重信息技术与现代管理理念的结合，帮助学生理解以信息为基础的企业变革、企业变革过程中的技术问题、企业内部信息资源管理的内容，以及如何利用新的信息技术实现管理模式的创新、支持企业的业务战略等实践性问题。通过本课程设置的教学活动，使学生能够系统地掌握管理信息系统的基本理论知识，了解云计算、大数据、物联网和移动终端应用等新兴的信息技术对个人、组织和社会的影响，了解如何应用信息技术推动管理理念和方法的实现，并掌握如何有效地实施和应用信息系统来支持企业的业务发展和创新。使学生有能力在管理实践中创造性地使用不断涌现的新技术，为他们成为信息时代的新型管理人才或继续从事信息系统理论方面的研究工作打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: This course focuses on the combination of information technology and modern management concepts, and aims to help students understand the information-based enterprise transformation, technical issues in the process of business transformation, contents of corporate internal information resource management, and how to use new information technology to support organizational strategy and business strategy. By learning this course, the students can be acquainted with the basic theoretical foundation of management information systems, understand the influences of emerging information technologies, such as cloud computing, big data, internet of things and mobile application, on individuals, organizations and societies, and master how to apply information technology to promote the implementation of management concepts and methods.

default.zh: This course focuses on the integration of information technology and modern management concepts, helping students understand information-based enterprise transformation, technical issues in the process of enterprise transformation, the content of internal information resource management, and how to use new information technologies to achieve management model innovation and support corporate business strategies and other practical issues. Through the teaching of this course, the following teaching objectives will be achieved: 1.Master the basic concepts and constituent elements of information systems, and understand the development trends of management information systems. 2.Master how enterprises use information systems to support strategic decisions and gain competitive advantages. 3.Master the main methods and software for information system development and implementation.
default.en: This course focuses on the integration of information technology and modern management concepts, helping students understand information-based enterprise transformation, technical issues in the process of enterprise transformation, the content of internal information resource management, and how to use new information technologies to achieve management model innovation and support corporate business strategies and other practical issues. Through the teaching of this course, the following teaching objectives will be achieved: 1.Master the basic concepts and constituent elements of information systems, and understand the development trends of management information systems. 2.Master how enterprises use information systems to support strategic decisions and gain competitive advantages. 3.Master the main methods and software for information system development and implementation.

default.en: This course focuses on the combination of information technology and modern management concepts, and aims to help students understand the information-based enterprise transformation, technical issues in the process of business transformation, contents of corporate internal information resource management, and how to use new information technology to support organizational strategy and business strategy. By learning this course, the students can be acquainted with the basic theoretical foundation of management information systems, understand the influences of emerging information technologies, such as cloud computing, big data, internet of things and mobile application, on individuals, organizations and societies, and master how to apply information technology to promote the implementation of management concepts and methods. 1. The following teaching objectives need to be achieved by learning this course: 2. Master the basic concepts of information systems and management information systems, and understand the role of MIS in your career. 3. Understand the application and development trend of information systems globally 4. Understand how to use MIS to achieve competitive advantage in the organization. 5. Understand the major methodologies, tool and software of information systems. 6. Understand the security and ethic issues in information systems use.

default.zh: 运筹学是管理类各专业的专业基础课，主要介绍一些优化分析方法和实用运筹学模型，为后续课程奠定数量分析的基础理论方法。本课程主要内容包括：线性规划原理及方法；对偶理论；运输问题；整数规划及0-1规划；目标规划；图与网络分析；计划评审方法和关键路线法；动态规划，涵盖运筹学的主要分支。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够掌握运筹学的一些主要理论和方法，培养学生能运用模型来研究解决管理中实际问题的能力。
default.en: Operations Research is the specialized basic course in all managerial majors, which is designed to introduce some methods of optimization analysis and some practical models to the students. It helps the students to lay a good theoretical foundation of quantitative analysis for their successive courses. And it covers the main branches of operations research, i.e. linear programming principle and method, dual theory, transportation problem, integer programming and 0-1 programming, goal programming, graph and network analysis, program evaluation and review technique, dynamic programming, etc. Through the study of this course, the students are aimed to master some primary theories and methods of operations research and are taught to apply them to solve the practical management problems.

default.zh: 运筹学是管理类各专业的专业基础课，主要介绍一些优化分析方法和实用运筹学模型，为后续课程奠定数量分析的基础理论方法。本课程主要内容包括：线性规划原理及方法；对偶理论；运输问题；整数规划及0-1规划；目标规划；图与网络分析；计划评审方法和关键路线法；动态规划，涵盖运筹学的主要分支。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够掌握运筹学的一些主要理论和方法，培养学生能运用模型来研究解决管理中实际问题的能力。
default.en: Operations Research is the specialized basic course in all managerial majors, which is designed to introduce some methods of optimization analysis and some practical models to the students. It helps the students to lay a good theoretical foundation of quantitative analysis for their successive courses. And it covers the main branches of operations research, i.e. linear programming principle and method, dual theory, transportation problem, integer programming and 0-1 programming, goal programming, graph and network analysis, program evaluation and review technique, dynamic programming, etc. Through the study of this course, the students are aimed to master some primary theories and methods of operations research and are taught to apply them to solve the practical management problems.

default.zh: 本课程是经济管理专业的基础课程，主要任务是培养学生收集数据和分析数据的能力，为后续课程的学习以及在经济管理领域从事定量研究奠定方法论基础。本课程主要讲授统计学的基本理论和基本方法，侧重统计方法在经济管理领域中的应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够正确地解释和使用常用的统计指标，掌握搜集和处理数据的基本方法，并利用统计分析软件对数据进行运算、建模和解读分析。本课程的内容包括统计资料的收集与整理、统计资料的描述、推断理论基础、参数估计、假设检验、χ2检验和方差分析、相关与回归分析、时间数列分析和指数分析。
default.en: This course is compulsory for all undergraduate students in School of Management, whose primary purpose is to develop the skills in business data analysis and to lay down the necessary theoretical foundation for future study. As an elementary level course on statistics, this course mainly focuses on how to apply statistical methods to address issues in business environment. By taking this course, the students are supposed to be able to 1) understand commonly used statistical notations and concepts, 2) collect data in a justifiable way, 3) correctly apply quantitative data analysis methods with the help of statistical software, and interpret results appropriately in business context. The contents of this course include: data collection and description, statistical inference theories, parameter estimation, hypothesis testing, χ2 test and analysis of variance, correlation and regression, time series data and index numbers.

default.zh: 本课程是面向辅修专业学生的经济管理类基础课程，主要任务是培养学生收集数据和分析数据的能力，为后续课程的学习以及在经济管理领域从事定量研究奠定方法论基础。本课程主要讲授统计学的基本理论和基本方法，侧重统计方法在经济管理领域中的应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够正确地解释和使用常用的统计指标，掌握搜集和处理数据的基本方法，并利用统计分析软件对数据进行运算、建模和解读分析。本课程的内容包括统计资料的收集与整理、统计资料的描述、推断理论基础、参数估计、假设检验、χ2检验和方差分析、相关与回归分析、时间数列分析和指数分析。

default.zh: 本课程侧重于组织基本方向的决策，以及执行这些决策的有效方法。具体来说，我们讨论了组织结构、资源和能力、战略规划和定位等，以便为组织创造和维持竞争优势。战略的成功不仅依赖于合理的战略规划，还依赖于有效的组织决策和战略实施。
default.en: This course focuses on decisions concerning basic directions of the organization, as well as effective methods to execute these decisions. Specifically, we discuss organizational structure, resources and capabilities, strategic planning and positioning, etc. in order to create and sustain competitive advantages for the organization. The success of strategy not only relies on rational strategic planning, but also on effective organizational decision-making and strategy implementation.

default.zh: 本课程旨在让学生对财务会计有一个基本的了解，涵盖了各种财务会计主题，包括基本会计理论、会计原则、记录商业交易的程序、资产和负债的计量以及财务报表的准备。更重要的是，学生将学习会计信息和数据如何帮助财务报表使用者促进决策。
default.en: This course is designed to provide a basic understanding of financial accounting and covers various financial accounting topics, including basic accounting theory, accounting principles, procedures to record business transactions, measurements of assets and liabilities and preparations for financial statements. More importantly, students will learn how accounting information and data assists financial statement users in facilitating their decision making.

default.zh: 本课程概述了应用科学(社会科学和技术)领域所需的主要统计多元数据分析工具和方法。 它将涵盖探索性统计部分，以及多元建模部分。
default.en: This course provides an overview of the main statistical multivariate data analysis tolls and methods required in the fields of applied sciences (social sciences and technology). It will cover a part on exploratory statistics, and another part in multivariate modeling.

default.zh: 运筹学是一种解决问题和决策的分析方法，在管理和商业、经济、供应链和金融中很有用。 本课程由三个部分组成，我们着重于确定性优化技术，在这里我们介绍了基本的优化技术，以及如何将实际业务问题形成数学模型。然后，我们研究了求解线性规划和整数规划的一些有效算法，并介绍了求解不同规划的一些基本计算机实现。之后，我们将介绍先进的优化技术和实际商业应用。
default.en: Operations Research is an analytical method of problem-solving and decision-making that is useful in management and business, economics, supply chain and finance. This course consists of three parts, we focus on deterministic optimization techniques where we introduce the basic optimization techniques and how to formulate real business problems into mathematical models. Then, we study some efficient algorithms for solving linear programs and integer programs and introduce some basic computer implementation of solving different programs. Next, we present advanced optimization techniques and real business applications.

default.zh: 现代商业的合规性和治理课程旨在探讨法律、商业、伦理、可持续性和企业社会责任在21世纪商业环境中的相互关系。随着企业日益全球化发展，商业伦理和社会责任成为商业本身的重要组成部分，需要考虑不同地区、管辖区域和文化之间的多种因素。 在对商业领域的综合性研究中，该课程涵盖了理解全球商业的动态环境，将商业战略与新的挑战相结合，比如现代互联但分散的全球系统以及社交媒体和国际交流的影响；识别商业伦理和社会责任的关键问题，并了解日益竞争和复杂的商业环境中的当前话题。
default.en: The Legal Ethics and Social Responsibility course is designed to explore the interplay between law, business and ethics, sustainability and corporate social responsibility as they become more critical in the business environment in the 21st. century. As businesses become more global, business ethics and social responsibility are an integral part of business itself – with many factors to consider across regions, jurisdictions and cultures. In a comprehensive approach to the field of business, this course covers understanding the dynamic environment of global business, integrating business strategy with new challenges – such as the modern interconnected, but fragmented global system and the influence of social media and international communication; identifying key issues of business ethics and social responsibility, and current topics in an increasingly competitive and complex business environment.

default.zh: 《管理学基础》是管理类专业的必修基础课，是整个管理学科体系的基础。本课程所介绍的管理基本理论和原则是其他管理学科的概括和总结，将为学生后续课程的学习奠定基础。课程以企业组织为研究对象，通过对管理的一般性问题的研究，致力于研究管理者如何有效地管理其所在的组织. 课程通过管理基本理论的讲授、管理基本思想的介绍和管理思维的培养来提升学生的管理悟性。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握管理的基础知识和基本理论，了解和掌握管理理论的产生、发展和作用，了解管理过程即计划、组织、领导、控制四个阶段及具体的活动内容，并结合课堂讨论、案例分析和角色扮演培养学生的管理思维，及综合分析和解决管理问题的能力。
default.en: "Management Fundamentals" is a compulsory course of management and the basis of the entire discipline system of management. The basic theory and principles of management introduced in this course are the generalization and summary of other management disciplines, which will lay the foundation for the students' advanced courses. This course is based on the research of corporate organization, and is devoted to the study of how managers can effectively manage their organization through the study of the general problems of management. The course introduces the basic theory and ideas of management and cultivates management thought for students to enhance their management savvy.Studying this course, students can master the basic knowledge and theory of management; understand and master the generation, development and function of management theory; understand the management process which has four stages: planning, organization, leadership and control and specific activities in each stage. And then, with classroom discussions, case studies and role play, the management thought of student and the ability to comprehensively analyze and address management issues can be well developed.

default.zh: 《管理学基础》是管理类专业的必修基础课，是整个管理学科体系的基础。本课程所介绍的管理基本理论和原则是其他管理学科的概括和总结，将为学生后续课程的学习奠定基础。课程以企业组织为研究对象，通过对管理的一般性问题的研究，致力于研究管理者如何有效地管理其所在的组织. 课程通过管理基本理论的讲授、管理基本思想的介绍和管理思维的培养来提升学生的管理悟性。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握管理的基础知识和基本理论，了解和掌握管理理论的产生、发展和作用，了解管理过程即计划、组织、领导、控制四个阶段及具体的活动内容，并结合课堂讨论、案例分析和角色扮演培养学生的管理思维，及综合分析和解决管理问题的能力。

The basic theory and principles of management introduced in this course are the generalization and summary of other management disciplines, which will lay the foundation for the students' advanced courses. This course is based on the research of corporate organization, and is devoted to the study of how managers can effectively manage their organization through the study of the general problems of management. The course introduces the basic theory and ideas of management and cultivates management thought for students to enhance their？management savvy.Studying this course, students can master the basic knowledge and theory of management; understand and master the generation, development and function of management theory; understand the management process which has four stages: planning, organization, leadership and control and specific activities in each stage. And then, with classroom discussions, case studies and role play, the management thought of student and the ability to comprehensively analyze and address management issues？can be well developed.

default.zh: 组织行为学是研究在组织中以及组织与环境相互作用，人们从事工作的心理活动和行为反应规律性的科学。它采用系统分析的方法，综合运用心理学、社会学、社会心理学、人类学、生理学、经济学和政治学等知识，研究一定组织中人的心理和行为的规律性，从而提高各级领导者和管理者对人的行为预测和引导能力，并以此为基础，设计与改进提高组织效能，从而更有效地实现组织预定的目标。 组织行为学是管理类各专业的一门专业基础课程。本课程的目标是通过系统讲授、案例分析、互动研讨、作业实践等环节，帮助学生掌握组织管理过程的普遍规律、基本原理和应用方法，能够运用所学理论分析管理中存在的各种心理现象与行为，培养正确处理和协调人际关系的能力，逐步提高分析问题和解决问题的能力，最终提高管理能力，也为进一步学习其他相关课程打下组织行为学的扎实基础。
default.en: Organizational Behavior is an introductory course which analyses human behavior at work with a focus on issues of personality, motivation, group interaction, occupational stress and health and organizational change. The course integrates knowledge from psychology, sociology, social psychology, anthropology and political science to examine issues related to aspects of the working environment and to the relationship between managerial strategies, organizational structures and their effects on performance, health and autonomy. The success of an organization depends entirely upon the actions of those within it. The individual’s behavior may be affected by many factors. The working environment, the groups he/she interacts with, the rules and roles within which he/she must operate, authority structures and the individual’s own perspectives are but a few. The practicing manager needs to understand these factors if he/she is to accurately assess the needs of working individuals.

default.zh: 组织行为学是是现代工商管理理论的重要组成部分，以心理学、社会学、社会心理学、人类学和政治学等学科为基础，以组织中人的心理活动和行为反应模式为研究对象。课程着重从工作行为的个体、群体与组织三个层次来分析影响组织绩效的有关因素，揭示人的工作行为的实质，以提高各级管理者对人的行为的预测、协调和控制能力，从而激发人的工作热情,最大限度地发挥人的工作潜能，有效实现组织目标。
default.en: Organizational Behavior is an important part of modern business management theory, which is based on psychology, sociology, social psychology, anthropology, political science and other disciplines, and studies the psychological activities and behavioral response patterns of people in organizations. This course focuses on analyzing the factors affecting organizational performance from the perspective of individuals, groups and organizations of work behavior, and reveals the essence of human work behavior, so as to improve the ability of managers at all levels to predict, coordinate and control human behavior, stimulate people's work enthusiasm, maximize their work potential and effectively achieve organizational goals.

default.zh: 领导力是高素质人才能力体系的重要组成部分，沟通能力是领导力的重要体现。《领导力与沟通》通过对沟通能力的系统讲授和训练，提高学生沟通技能，继而达到提升领导力的目的。课程以对领导力的理解为切入点，分别从领导的职能和领导者的日常工作重点两个角度，让学生领会沟通能力在领导力中的重要作用。无论领导的三个基本职能，即确定目标、寻找路径和激励和培养下属，还是在日常的管理活动中，领导者有70%的时间花在沟通上，并且管理中70%的问题来源于沟通，沟通活动都是领导工作的主体内容。关于对沟通能力的理解，课程注重思维和技能的训练。课程带领学生系统地理解沟通基本概念及特征、管理沟通过程与要素、基本沟通技能，如倾听与反馈、演讲、写作、招聘面试等，课程贯穿始终地强调有效沟通的三个关键词：良好意愿（goodwill）、换位思考（you-attitude）和可信度（credibility）。通过对项目答辩、社团活动组织与呈现、个人成长面试等真实组织环境中学生沟通技能综合运用的实践模拟，培养学生分析和解决实际管理问题、鼓励创造性思维、注重系统性思考的领导能力训练，为培养适应未来不确定环境下管理企业的优秀领导者奠定通识性素质基础。
default.en: ？Leadership is the core elements of the ability system of highly qualified personnel, and communication ability is an important manifestation of leadership. Through teaching and training systematically, will promote students' communication ability, and then achieve the goal of improving students' leadership. The course takes the understanding of leadership as the breakthrough point, and makes the students understand the important role of communication ability in leadership from two perspectives, namely, the functions of lead and the daily management focuses of leaders. Not only achieving the three basic functions of lead, determining target, finding path, and supervising and cultivating subordinates, but also in the daily management activities, the leaders have 70% of time spent in communication, and in management 70% of the problems derived from communication. Communication is the main content of leadership. With regard to the understanding of communication skills, the course focuses on the training of thinking and skills. The course will guide students to systematically understand the basic concepts and characteristics of communication, communication process and management elements, and basic communication skills, such as listening and feedback, speech, writing, interviews, meetings and so on. Throughout the course, three key words will be emphasized: good will, you-attitude, and credibility. By simulating the real organization environment, such as project defense, organization and presentation of university activities, recruitment interview and so on, the students could comprehensively use the communication skill, which could improve students' ability to analyze and solve practical management problems, encourage creative thinking, concentrate on the leadership training of systematic thinking, in order to cultivate general foundation for future excellent leaders to adapt to uncertain management surroundings.

default.zh: 本课程综合法学、伦理学以及管理学、社会学等学科的理论和方法，为学生提供法学和伦理学基础知识。法律和商业伦理既是维持社会公正和经济秩序的基本行为规范，也是企业长远健康发展的基本保证。本课程采用案例教学为主的方法，结合管理专业的需求，有针对性地培养学生树立法律意识，自觉道德操守，增强责任意识。 课程目标1: 熟悉企业法律、伦理与社会责任相关概念、理论和法律法规 课程目标2: 运用相关理论识别、分析企业法律、伦理和社会责任相关实践中的问题，并做出正确的决策 思政目标1：培养学生现代商业伦理观念和职业道德。
default.en: This course integrates the theories and methods of law, ethics, management, sociology and other disciplines to provide students with basic knowledge of law and ethics. Law and business ethics are not only the basic norms of behavior to maintain social justice and economic order, but also the basic guarantee for the long-term healthy development of enterprises. This course adopts the method of case teaching and combines with the needs of management majors to train students to establish legal consciousness, conscious moral integrity and enhance their sense of responsibility. Course objective 1: Be familiar with concepts, theories, laws and regulations related to corporate law, ethics and social responsibility Objective 2: Use relevant theories to identify and analyze problems in corporate legal, ethical and social responsibility practices and make the right decisions Ideological and political goal 1: To cultivate students' modern business ethics and professional ethics.

default.zh: 市场营销学是工商管理类各专业的平台课，在学生的知识构成中发挥着重要的作用。本课程的教学目标是在相关基础课程完成的前提下，进行专业的基础理论与方法的训练。通过本门课的教学，使学生建立市场营销学的分析框架和思维方式，掌握营销管理的核心理论，逐步培养和训练学生联系实际的营销管理能力。同时，重点培养学生发现营销管理问题、分析营销管理问题和解决营销管理问题及有效沟通的能力。
default.en: Principles of Marketing is a ecnomic management platform class for various professional courses, the composition of the student's knowledge and play an important role. The teaching objectives of this course is to complete the foundation courses related to the premise to carry out professional training in basic theories and methods to develop a solid professional basis, and to prepare for the opening of specialized courses. By enabling students to develop the analytical framework for marketing and ways of thinking to grasp the basic concepts, the basic theories and the core of marketing management theories, and gradually develop and train students to practice marketing management capacity. Meanwhile, the focus on training students to identify marketing management problems, analyze marketing management problems,solve marketing management problems and effective communication skills.

default.zh: 经管类《跨专业综合实训》是经济管理试验班的一门认识实习课程，是在管理类平台课的基础上，依托经管类跨专业虚拟仿真综合实习平台、模拟现实仿真经济社会中制造型企业的全业务链过程开展的实践类课程。 该课程可以使学生对企业经营管理的基本过程有认知体验，认识经营管理各环节的工作内容和特点，为后续的专业学习奠定良好的基础；提高学生的观察能力、分析能力、判断能力和解决问题的能力，能运用所学知识解决简单的管理实践问题。同时，培养学生遵纪守法、爱岗敬业、诚实守信、社会责任、团结合作的职业精神。
default.en: "Comprehensive virtual simulation experiment of economics and management" is a cognitive practice course of the economic management pilot class. It is a practical course based on the management platform course, relying on the economic management cross specialty virtual simulation comprehensive practice platform, and simulating the whole business chain process of manufacturing enterprises in the economic society. This course can enable students to have a cognitive experience of the basic process of business management, understand the work content and characteristics of each link of business management, and lay a good foundation for subsequent professional learning; Improve students' observation ability, analysis ability, judgment ability and problem solving ability, and be able to use the knowledge learned to solve simple management practice problems. At the same time, we will cultivate students' professional spirit of abiding by disciplines and laws, loving their jobs, being honest and trustworthy, social responsibility, solidarity and cooperation.

default.zh: 会计学课程是经济管理学院平台课程之一，这门课程是经济管理类学生的基础课程，通过本门课程的学习使初学者掌握会计的基本理论、基本方法和基本技能。《会计学》课程内容包括会计定义、会计原则、会计假设、会计要素、会计基本等式、借贷记账法等基本理论，还包括制造业主要经济业务的核算，会计凭证、会计账簿和会计报表相关内容，还讲述了财产清查及会计核算形式等内容。
default.en: Basic Accounting is one of the courses offered by the School of Economics and Management. This course is the basic course for students of economic management. Through this course, students can master the basic theory, basic methods and basic skills of accounting. The accounting course includes the accounting theory, accounting principles, accounting assumptions, accounting elements, accounting basic equation, borrowing and accounting methods and other basic theory, but also the manufacturing economy of the main economic accounting, accounting documents, accounting books and accounting statements Related content, but also about the property inventory and accounting forms and other content.

default.zh: 《金融市场学》是经济与管理类专业的专业基础课之一，这门课对于希望较为全面知晓和把握金融基础理论及金融市场知识以及金融领域热点问题的同学会有帮助。本课程从三个方面进行讲授：第一篇 金融基础篇、第二篇 金融机构篇、第三篇 金融工具篇。具体讲授内容包括：金融范畴的形成与发展、货币与货币制度、国际货币体系与汇率制度、信用与信用形式、利息与利率、金融中介及其包括的范围、西方国家的金融中介体系、中国的金融中介体系、国际金融中介体系、存款货币银行、中央银行、现代货币的创造机制、金融市场及其要素、货币市场工具、资本市场工具、衍生工具市场、投资基金、证券价格与证券价格指数、资本市场的效率等。
default.en: 《Financial Markets》is one of the basic courses for economics and management majors. This course is helpful for students who want to understand and grasp the basic financial theories, financial markets knowledge and hot issues in the financial field in a more comprehensive way. This course is taught from three aspects: the first part of financial foundation, the second part of financial institutions, and the third part of financial instruments. Specific teaching contents include: the formation and development of financial category, money and monetary system, international monetary system and exchange rate system, credit and credit form, interest and interest rate, financial intermediaries and includes the scope, western financial intermediation system, China's financial intermediation system, international financial intermediation system, deposit money Banks, central bank, mechanism of modern monetary creation, financial markets and their elements, money market, capital market tools, derivatives markets, investment funds, stock price and the stock price index, the efficiency of capital market, etc.

default.zh: 《金融时间序列分析》主要介绍如何应用时间序列分析方法定量分析和描述具有随机特征的金融变量的动态发展规律和金融变量之间的相互关系。根据时间序列分析方法对金融现象进行认识分析，能够使用相关统计软件完成建模和预测等。本课程讲授的主要内容包括：线性时间序列模型、资产波动率模型及多元时间序列模型等。
default.en: [Financial Time Series Analysis] mainly introduces how to use time series analysis methods to quantitatively analyze and describe the dynamic laws of financial variables with random characteristics and the relationship between financial variables. Through the time series analysis method, we can understand and analyze financial phenomena, and can use relevant statistical software to complete modeling and forecasting. The main contents of this course include: linear time series model, asset volatility model and multivariate time series model.

default.zh: 经济学原理课程包括微观与宏观两部分。微观经济学以价格理论为中心，研究企业、家庭和单个市场等微观供求行为与价格之间关系。学习内容包括供求的含义及均衡价格的形成、与消费相关的效用论、与生产相关的生产理论和成本理论、市场与厂商理论和市场与福利等。宏观经济学以收入理论为中心，研究一个国家整体经济运行及政府如何运用经济政策来影响经济。学习内容包括国民经济的循环流转、国内生产总值的概念及基本核算方法、均衡国民收入的决定与乘数论、宏观经济政策的政策工具及应用、失业、货膨胀的形成原因及抑制通货膨胀的经济政策、经济增长的一般规律等。
default.en: The course of Principles of Economics includes two parts: microeconomics and macroeconomics. Microeconomics focuses on price theory and studies the relationship between micro supply and demand behavior and price of enterprises, households and single markets. The learning contents include the meaning of supply and demand and the formation of equilibrium price, the utility theory related to consumption, the production theory and cost theory related to production, the market and manufacturer theory, the market and welfare, etc. Macroeconomics focuses on income theory, studying the overall economic operation of a country and how the government uses economic policies to affect the economy. The learning contents include the circulation of the national economy, the concept and basic accounting methods of GDP, the determination and multiplier theory of balanced national income, the policy tools and applications of macroeconomic policies, the causes of unemployment and inflation, the economic policies to curb inflation, and the general laws of economic growth.

Microeconomics focuses on price theory and studies the relationship between micro supply and demand behavior and price of enterprises, households and single markets. The learning contents include the meaning of supply and demand and the formation of equilibrium price, the utility theory related to consumption, the production theory and cost theory related to production, the market and manufacturer theory, the market and welfare, etc. Macroeconomics focuses on income theory, studying the overall economic operation of a country and how the government uses economic policies to affect the economy. The learning contents include the circulation of the national economy, the concept and basic accounting methods of GDP, the determination and multiplier theory of balanced national income, the policy tools and applications of macroeconomic policies, the causes of unemployment and inflation, the economic policies to curb inflation, and the general laws of economic growth.

default.zh: 《宏观经济学》课程是以微观经济学为基础，强调总量分析方法，主要研究整个国民经济的总体经济行为，内容包括国民收入的生产、分配和消费，经济增长，失业，货币与通货膨胀，总需求与总供给，宏观经济政策等理论。《宏观经济学》课程可以为学生学习后续课程和进一步探究经济学知识奠定必要的基础。
default.en: Based on Microeconomics, Macroeconomics uses the aggregate analysis methods and focuses primarily on the aggregate economic behaviors of a national economy. Macroeconomics includes the following contents: the theory of production, distribution and consumption of the national income, economic growth, unemployment, monetary and inflation, aggregate demand and aggregate supply, macro-economic policy. The course of Macroeconomics can lay the necessary foundation for students to learn and further explore the knowledge of economics.

default.zh: 经济学基础（1）主要分析个体行为及其相互作用所产生的经济后果，并据此提出促进资源配置效率提高的相关微观政策。学生应该掌握激励、供求、成本、效用、市场结构、市场失灵等核心概念，并能够运用所学理论分析消费者行为、生产者行为、社会福利等领域的微观经济问题，并据此提出解决方案。通过本课程的学习，不仅可以掌握基本的微观经济学理论，还应该通过对经济学分析范式的反复应用，提高逻辑分析能力、问题识别能力和冲突解决能力等。通过课程的学习，学生应该深入理解个体决策的目标、动机及其效果, 能够在供求分析框架下分析市场均衡、社会福利和公共政策效果，深入理解不同的市场结构类型、特征及其均衡结果，深入理解成本理论、消费者行为理论、社会公平问题等相关知识，能够运用相关经济学理论分析现实问题，有根据的提出自己的观点。
default.en: Foundations of Economics (1) mainly analyzes individual behaviors and the economic consequences arising from their interactions, and accordingly proposes relevant microeconomic policies to improve the efficiency of resource allocation. Students are expected to master core concepts such as incentives, supply and demand, costs, utility, market structures, and market failures. They should also be able to apply the learned theories to analyze microeconomic issues in areas like consumer behavior, producer behavior, and social welfare, and put forward solutions based on this analysis. Through this course, students will not only grasp basic microeconomic theories but also enhance their logical analysis ability, problem identification ability, and conflict resolution ability by repeatedly applying the economic analysis paradigm. Additionally, they should deeply understand the goals, motivations, and effects of individual decisions, analyze market equilibrium, social welfare, and the effects of public policies within the supply-and-demand analysis framework, and gain a thorough comprehension of different market structure types, their characteristics, and equilibrium outcomes. Furthermore, students are required to deeply understand relevant knowledge such as cost theory, consumer behavior theory, and social equity issues, apply relevant economic theories to analyze real-world problems, and put forward well-founded viewpoints.

default.zh: 本课程主要研究市场经济中的消费者和企业的行为及其相互作用，描述市场经济的运行过程，分析市场机制的作用原理，从而解决社会资源的最优配置问题。课程旨在向学生介绍微观经济学的基本概念、基本构架和分析逻辑，培养对现实世界经济行为与经济现象的观察和运用马克思主义立场、观点和方法进行批判分析的能力，使学生能够批判地运用经济学的基本原理去观察、分析和解释现实生活中典型的经济现象和问题，并指导实践做出最优决策。 主要内容包括：（1）对微观经济学的深入理解和再认识（2）供求均衡价格理论；（3）需求理论；（4）生产与成本理论；（5）厂商行为与市场结构理论；（6）要素市场理论；（7）福利经济学。
default.en: The course mainly focuses on the behavior and interactions of consumers and enterprises in market economy and argues the principle of market mechanism so as to solve problem of optimal allocation of social resources. The course aims at introducing the basic concepts, framework and analytical logic of micro-economics to students, cultivating the ability to observe and apply Marxist standpoints, viewpoints and methods to critically analyze the real world economic behavior and economic phenomena, so that students can critically apply the basic principles of economics to observe, analyze and explain typical economic phenomena and problems in real life. And guide the practice to make the best decision. The main content of the course includes: (1) deep understanding and re-understanding of micro-economics, the research objects and methodology of Western economics, using Marxist standpoints and viewpoints to grasp useful analytical tools and methods; (2) Equilibrium theory of supply and demand; (3) demand theory; (4) production and cost theory; (5) Firm behavior and market structure theory; (6) Factor market theory; (7)Welfare Economics.

default.zh: 本课程是以微观经济学为基础，强调总量分析方法，主要研究整个国民经济的总体经济行为，内容包括国民收入的生产、分配和消费，经济增长，失业，货币与通货膨胀，总需求与总供给，宏观经济政策等理论。本课程可以为学生学习后续课程和进一步探究经济学知识奠定必要的基础。
default.en: Based on Microeconomics, this course uses the aggregate analysis methods and focuses primarily on the aggregate economic behaviors of a national economy. The course includes the following contents: the theory of production, distribution and consumption of the national income, economic growth, unemployment, monetary and inflation, aggregate demand and aggregate supply, macro-economic policy. The course can lay the necessary foundation for students to learn and further explore the knowledge of economics.

default.zh: 国际商务是经济与管理专业的毕业生必备的专业基础知识，是一门非常重要的专业基础课程。课程主要内容包括：全球经济一体化中的国际企业、贸易自由化和贸易保护的相关理论基础、贸易政策工具和国际多边贸易体制、国际商务活动中进入外国市场的策略和方式、国际金融概述、国际收支的基本概念和理论、国际收支平衡表及其主要内容、国际收支调节理论等。通过本课程的学习，使学生透彻掌握进国际商务的基本理论和主要知识，并具备运用理论分析问题的能力，开拓学生的国际视野。
default.en: International business is an essential basic knowledge for graduates of economics and management, which is a very important professional basic course.The main contents of the course include: the international enterprise in global economic integration , free trade and protectionism of the relevant theoretical basis, instruments of trade policy and the international multilateral trade system, strategies and methods for entering foreign markets in international business activities, international financial overview, basic concepts and theories of balance of payments,balance of payments and its main contents, balance of payments adjustment theory, etc.Through the study of this course, students will be able to master the basic theories and main knowledge of international business, and have the ability to use theoretical analysis to develop their international vision.

default.zh: 电子商务、社交网络、云计算、移动互联网与金融科技的快速发展把人类社会带入一个全新的数据驱动商业时代，对多维度数据的获取、管理和分析以辅助商业决策的能力已成为企业在大数据时代的核心竞争力之一。本课程属于经济与管理专业本科生基础课程，力图引导学生从技术和商业双视角学习商务数据分析的基础知识，将介绍数据挖掘、商务智能、机器学习和统计建模等数据分析基本概念，讲授描述统计、分类、回归、关联规则挖掘、数据可视化等数据分析基础方法的原理和应用方法，并引入在线推荐系统、金融大数据分析、流水线生产管理等商务管理场景下的实践及学术案例，与学生讨论误导性信息、隐私计算、算法伦理与监管等拓展话题。课程目标为帮助学生理解并掌握商务数据分析领域的基本概念、知识和方法以解决实践问题，学习数据分析工具R语言和RStudio的基本用法以完成数据分析流程和商务决策辅助。
default.en: Advancements in E-commerce, social network, cloud computing, mobile Internet, and FinTech have brought the human society into a new era of data-driven business. The capability of assisting business decision-making from the acquirement, management, and analysis of multi-dimensional data has become one of the core competencies for firms in the era of big data. As a fundamental course for the undergraduate students in the discipline of economics and management, this course aims to guide the students to learn the essentials of business data analysis from both the technological and business perspectives. We will cover the basic concepts of BDA: data mining, business intelligence, machine learning, statistical modeling, etc., and lecture on the theory basis and applications of the key data analysis tools including summary statistics, classification, regression, association rules mining, data visualization. The course will also feature the introduction to practical cases and academic research in various business management scenarios such as online recommender systems, financial big data analysis, and production line management, and discussions of contemporary extended topics including misinformation, privacy computing, ethics and regulation of algorithms, etc. The goals of this course are to help the students utilize the basic concepts, knowledge, and tools of BDA to solve practical problems, and to train their ability of using basic functions of R language in RStudio to perform data analysis and assist business decision-making.

default.zh: 公共管理，或者说公共行政是一门以致力于发展优异的治理的科学、知识和艺术。它日益受到理论和实务部门人士的广泛重视。公共事务、治理与领导力是公共行政领导力辅修专业的统领性课程，其教学目的就是让学生从整体的视角掌握公共行政领导力的知识框架。 本课程分为三大板块，即对公共事务的全面了解、对治理的历史演变与方法的掌握和领导力的概况与基本素质要求，这三大板块既相互独立又相互联系，促使学生在认知上由专业能力向社会服务能力扩展，为整体的公共行政领导力的学习打下基础。本课程由八讲完成，公共事务板块两讲、公共管理与治理板块四讲、领导力板块两讲。
default.en: Public administration, also known as public management, is a discipline that focuses on fostering effective governance. It has garnered significant attention from both theoretical and practical fields. Public affairs, governance, and leadership is a prominent course for the minor major of public administration leadership. Its teaching objective is to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of the framework of public administration leadership. The course consists of three major components: a comprehensive understanding of public affairs, an overview of the historical evolution of governance, and an introduction to leadership methods and basic quality requirements. These three components are both independent and interconnected, and aim to enhance students' cognitive and social service abilities, providing a strong foundation for public administrative leadership. The course comprises eight lectures, including three on public affairs, three on governance, and two on leadership.

default.zh: 算法与数据结构是一门重要专业基础课，主要介绍计算机解决非数值信息处理问题时所用的各种数据组织方法、存储数据结构的方法以及在各种结构上执行操作的算法。课程帮助学生较熟练地掌握线性表、栈、队列、数组、串、树、二又树、图等基本数据结构及相关算法，以及排序和查找原理与方法等。课程培养和训练学生运用高级程序设计语言编写设计清晰、可读性好的算法及初步评价算法的能力。通过本课程的学习，使学生较全面地掌握基本数据结构和算法相关的基础理论和知识，提高抽象表达实际问题并设计有效算法解决实际问题的能力，为学习后续课程奠定基础。
default.en: This course is focus on the fundamental data structures and algorithms, along with supporting theoretical foundations and practical applications, which mainly introduces the various data organization methods used by computers to solve non-numerical information processing problems, the methods of storing data structure and the algorithms that perform operations on various structures. Topics include the following: 1. Data structures: linear tables, stacks, queues, strings, trees, heaps, hash tables, etc. 2. Efficient algorithms for sorting and searching. 3. Possible additional topics: algorithm design techniques like divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms etc. The course will help students to master the basic data structure and related algorithms, to use advanced programming language to write clearly designed, readable algorithms with preliminary algorithms evaluation, and to improve the ability to express practical problems in abstract term and solve it as well, which contributes to future study.

default.zh: 本课程系辅修学位的基础课程，旨在使学生深入了解政治学科的基本知识及其当代发展，掌握政治分析基本概念和方法，以及作为学科的“公共政策”基本的学科内容和较为系统的理论分析方法。以问题为导向，培养学生应用理论工具进行政治分析与政策分析的能力。 本课程主要包括政治科学理论以及政策科学理论两部分。具体内容包括：政治学的研究对象与研究领域，政治学的研究方法，政治学的基本框架与当代流派，现代政治运作的基本制度与政治决策过程；公共政策的基本概念、理论框架、基本要素，公共政策分析的价值观念、思维方法、模型路径；当代中国政府的结构和运行逻辑，当代中国公共政策制定与评估。 本课程以理论讲授以及案例讨论方式进行，通过本课程的学习，学生能初步掌握当代政治科学的研究范式，应用公共政策分析理论与分析工具，解构中国政府的结构和运行逻辑，培养科技领域领军人才的宏观政治意识与政策分析能力。
default.en: This course is one of the foundation courses for minor double degree, designed to enable students to master basic concepts and methods of political analysis. And it enables students to master basic subject content and systematic method of policy theoretical analysis. It trains students' ability to apply theoretical tools for problem-oriented political analysis and policy analysis. This course mainly includes political science theory and policy science theory. The curriculum including: research object and field of political science, research method of political science, basic framework of political science and contemporary research schools, basic system of modern political operation and the process of political decision-making, basic concepts, theoretical framework and elements of public policy, values, thinking methods and model path of public policy analysis, structure and operation logic of contemporary Chinese government. This course will be taught by the way of teaching and case analysis. Through the study of this course, students can master the research paradigm of contemporary political science, and apply public policy analysis theory and analysis tools. Students can deconstrue the Chinese government's structure and operation logic. Then we get the goal of cultivating the macro-political consciousness and policy analysis ability of leading talents in the field of science and technology.

default.zh: Python程序设计课程是大数据管理与应用专业的主要选修课程。通过本课程的教学使学生了解Python程序设计的基本规则，掌握运用Python处理相关数据。掌握Python数据处理的基本理论和方法，并具备一定的实践能力，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is the main elective course for big data management and application majors. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic rules of Python programming and master the use of Python to process relevant data. Master the basic theories and methods of Python data processing, and possess certain practical abilities, laying a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 为了培养学生在大数据环境下处理数据和管理数据的能力，本课程将主要通过课堂教学讲授数据、结构化数据、半结构化数据、非结构化数据、大数据等的概念及相应的数据管理理论与方法，并采用案例教学的方式讲授大数据在经济管理中的应用。结构化数据的管理主要通过关系数据库系统完成，相关内容包括关系数据库的特点、关系代数、SQL语句、关系数据库设计、数据库的安全性和完整性控制等。半结构化数据和非结构化数据的管理主要通过键值数据库、文档数据库等数据库管理系统来完成，课程的相关内容包括NoSQL的基本概念、键值数据库、文档数据库等的存储模式及其应用方法等。学生还将通过自主学习掌握一种流行的关系数据库管理系统、文档数据库管理系统及键值数据库管理系统的应用方法。
default.en: In order to develop students' ability of data processing and data management in a big data environment, this course will teach the concepts of data, structured data, semi-structured data, unstructured data, big data, and other concepts and corresponding data management theories and methods, and will teach the application of big data in economic and managerial field by case teaching. The management of structured data is mainly done through relational database system, which includes the characteristics of relational database, relational algebra, SQL statements, relational database design, database security and integrity control, etc. The management of semi-structured data and unstructured data is mainly done through the database management system such as key value database and document database, and the relevant contents of the course include the concept of NoSQL, the storage mode of key value database, document database and so on. Students will also learn how to solve the data management problems with a popular relationship database management system, document database management system and key value database management system.

default.zh: 为了培养学生量化分析经济管理问题的能力，本课程以概率论与数理统计、应用统计为基础，介绍数据挖掘中常用的多元统计建模方法以及开源统计软件R。通过课堂教学使学生了解多维数据的建模方法，掌握聚类与分类、数据压缩、相关分析与预测的基本原理和建模流程。教学主要内容包括：聚类分析、判别分析、主成分分析、因子分析和回归分析。其次，通过上机实验和探究式学习，使学生掌握各种分析方法的R实现，加深学生对这些建模方法的认识，增强学生利用统计软件处理数据和建模的能力。最后，结合实际经济管理数据，通过案例教学使学生能够根据不同类型的经济管理问题选择多元统计分析方法，进而培养学生从海量数据中发现问题、分析问题，并提供解决方案的能力。
default.en: This course aims to cultivate the students’ capability of conducting quantitative analysis on business and economics problems. Grounded in probability theory and applied statistics, this course will introduce the basic statistical methods and the most popular open-source statistical software used in data mining -- R to the students majored in E-commerce. The course will make the students understand the main techniques for manipulating the multi-dimensional big data. These techniques can be used for clustering and classification, data reduction, correlation analysis and forecasting. The course will teach cluster analysis, discriminant analysis, principal component analysis, factor analysis, and regression analysis methods. Through lab experiments and explorative study, the course also seeks to teach the students the implementation of different analysis methods in R software, and enhance their understanding of the different methods and their capability to manipulate data and construct statistical models via software. Finally, via case study approach and real data of business and economics problems, the course helps the students learn how to choose the appropriate multivariate analysis technique for different types of business problems, thus enhance the students’ ability to find, analyze, and solve problems in extensive data.

default.zh: 人工智能与机器学习课程是大数据管理与应用专业的核心课程。通过本课程的教学使学生从概念、基本理论及实际应用等方面了解机器学习。掌握机器学习的基本理论与方法，并具备一定的实践能力。通过教学提高学生利用机器学习方法解决实际管理问题的能力，扩展专业知识，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: The course of artificial intelligence and machine learning is the core course of big data management and application. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand machine learning from concepts, basic theories, and practical applications. Master the basic theories and methods of machine learning, and possess certain practical abilities. By teaching, students can enhance their ability to use machine learning methods to solve practical management problems, expand their professional knowledge, and lay a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 人工智能与机器学习课程是大数据管理与应用专业的核心课程。通过本课程的教学使学生从概念、基本理论及实际应用等方面了解机器学习。掌握机器学习的基本理论与方法，并具备一定的实践能力。通过教学提高学生利用机器学习方法解决实际管理问题的能力，扩展专业知识，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: The course of artificial intelligence and machine learning is the core course of big data management and application. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand machine learning from concepts, basic theories, and practical applications. Master the basic theories and methods of machine learning, and possess certain practical abilities. By teaching, students can enhance their ability to use machine learning methods to solve practical management problems, expand their professional knowledge, and lay a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 《大数据互联网金融》是一门培养学生理解和运用大数据互联网金融的相关专业知识、批判性思维能力的课程。本课程主要讲授大数据互联网金融的基本概念，理论基础与技术基础，多种互联网金融业务模式（第三方支付、P2P网络借贷和众筹）的特点与发展情况，银行数字化、货币数字化与区块链前沿知识，以及大数据互联网金融风险与监管科技，同时，对结合相关案例对大数据互联网金融的相关知识进行深入解析与探讨。通过课程的课堂教学与案例讨论，着重培养学生学习大数据互联网金融的专业知识，掌握和了解其在实践中的发展与应用，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Big Data and Fintech is a course to cultivate students' understanding and application of relevant professional knowledge and critical thinking ability of big data and Fintech. This course mainly teaches the basic concept, theoretical basis and technical basis of big data Internet finance, the characteristics and development of various Internet finance business models (third-party payment, P2P online lending, and crowdfunding), the frontier knowledge of bank digitalization, currency digitalization and blockchain, as well as the risk and regulatory technology of big data Internet finance. Combined with relevant cases, the relevant knowledge of big data Internet finance is deeply analyzed and discussed. Through classroom teaching and case discussion, the course focuses on cultivating students' professional knowledge of big data Internet finance, mastering and understanding its development and application in practice.

default.zh: 这门课程涉及数字时代管理的基础概念和理论。具体来说，该课程关注企业如何通过建立数字基础设施和数字管理能力来适应数字时代的各种挑战。本课程中的知识和观点将使学生能够更深入地了解数字时代的企业管理。
default.en: This course is about the foundational concepts and theories of management in the digital era. Specifically, this course focuses on how firms can adapt to the various challenges of the digital era, by building digital infrastructures and digital management capabilities. The knowledge and perspectives in this course will enable students to gain a deeper understanding about business management in the digital era.

default.zh: 本课程是经济管理专业的基础课程，主要任务是培养学生收集数据和分析数据的能力，为后续课程的学习以及在经济管理领域从事定量研究奠定方法论基础。本课程主要讲授统计学的基本理论和基本方法，侧重统计方法在经济管理领域中的应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够正确地解释和使用常用的统计指标，掌握搜集和处理数据的基本方法，并利用统计分析软件对数据进行运算、建模和解读分析。本课程的内容包括统计资料的收集与整理、统计资料的描述、推断理论基础、参数估计、假设检验、χ2检验和方差分析、相关与回归分析、时间数列分析和指数分析。
default.en: This course is compulsory for all undergraduate students in School of Management, whose primary purpose is to develop the skills in business data analysis and to lay down the necessary theoretical foundation for future study. As an elementary level course on statistics, this course mainly focuses on how to apply statistical methods to address issues in business environment. By taking this course, the students are supposed to be able to 1) understand commonly used statistical notations and concepts, 2) collect data in a justifiable way, 3) correctly apply quantitative data analysis methods with the help of statistical software, and interpret results appropriately in business context. The contents of this course include: data collection and description, statistical inference theories, parameter estimation, hypothesis testing, χ2 test and analysis of variance, correlation and regression, time series data and index numbers.

default.zh: Python程序设计课程是大数据管理与应用专业的主要选修课程。通过本课程的教学使学生了解Python程序设计的基本规则，掌握运用Python处理相关数据。掌握Python数据处理的基本理论和方法，并具备一定的实践能力，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is the main elective course for big data management and application majors. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic rules of Python programming and master the use of Python to process relevant data. Master the basic theories and methods of Python data processing, and possess certain practical abilities, laying a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 战略管理是管理的重要组成部分，是在企业面对激烈变化的环境、残酷的市场竞争情况下，企业管理人员为了企业长期的生存和发展，确定和选择达到目标的动态管理过程。通过本课程的教学，使学生了解战略管理的基础知识，理解战略管理的基本概念，掌握进行战略分析、战略选择基本方法，帮助学生树立战略管理观念和思想，培养学生独立思考的能力，为他们以后从事相关实践工作和理论研究奠定基础。
default.en: Strategic management is an important component of management, which is a dynamic management process in which enterprise managers determine and choose to achieve goals for the long-term survival and development of the enterprise in the face of fierce changes in the environment and fierce market competition. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic knowledge of strategic management, understand the basic concepts of strategic management, master the basic methods of strategic analysis and strategic selection, help students establish strategic management concepts and ideas, cultivate their independent thinking ability, and lay a foundation for their practical work and theoretical research in the future.

default.zh: 管理学研究方法是工商管理本科培养课程的重要组成部分。它是在学生掌握了一定的管理学基础课程以及统计学基本知识的前提下，进一步培养学生基本科学素养和研究能力的一门课程。该课程的授课内容主要内容包括科学哲学概述、管理学研究基本范式、研究问题提出、概念及其测量、构建概念间关系(视角、理论、机制、中介与调节)、理论贡献、研究设计以及数据分析等多个部分构成。它适合工商管理相关所有专业学生研修。它为培养具有高概念能力的管理者、高学术能力的研究生奠定基础。
default.en: Research design and method is among the core lectures of Corporation Administration. It is a lecture that can cultivate and develop students’ basic scientific quality and research skill. In order to master this lecture, students should know statistics and basic management knowledge in advance. It consists of philosophy of science, basic paradigms of management research, the proposition of research question, concept and its measurement, linking the concepts (perspective, theory, mechanism and mediator and moderators), theoretical contribution, research design and data analysis et al. it is suitable for every student of corporate management. It can be essential to cultivate managers with high conceptual skill and postgraduates with high academic skill.

default.zh: 本课程希望帮助学生了解创业基础理论、掌握识别创业机会的方法，准确捕捉市场痛 点、进行初步产品功能和服务设计，了解创业完整过程，并建立创业企业的商业模式和盈利方案，进行财务分析和融资规划。激发学生的创业激情，开发学生的创业潜能，使学生锻炼创业创意、创业计划宣讲及路演的实战技能；了解和掌握创业计划撰写的理论基础；了解和掌握创业计划撰写中关于市场分析、营销管理知识及方法，商业模式、生产计划/经商计划、财务分析、风险分析等等方法，具备分析和解决企业管理实践中积淀的系统问题的能力；熟悉和掌握常见企业创业的准备过程和实际管理过程，得到在企业创业准备和具体企业管理过程中的每一个环节的管理技能获得的基本训练，逐步具有应用先进工具解决创业企业实际管理问题的能力。
default.en: This course is expected to help students understand the basic theory of entrepreneurship, master the method of identifying entrepreneurial opportunities, accurately capture the market pain points, conduct preliminary product function and service design, establish the business model and profit plan of entrepreneurial firm, and conduct financial analysis and financing planning.Stimulate students' entrepreneurial passion, develop students' entrepreneurial potential, practice the practical skills of business plan presentation and road show; Understand and master the theoretical basis of business plan writing; Understand and master the knowledge and methods of market analysis, marketing management, business model, production plan/business plan, financial analysis, risk analysis and other methods in business plan writing, and have the ability to analyze and solve systemic problems accumulated in enterprise management practice; Familiar with and master the common preparation process and actual management process of enterprise entrepreneurship, get the basic training of management skills in every link of enterprise entrepreneurship preparation and specific enterprise management process, and gradually have the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical management problems of entrepreneurial enterprises.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向经济与管理学院工商管理专业、市场营销专业的本科学生，是专业平台核心课程。希望使同学们掌握企业组织管理中的“人”的作用，人力资源管理的意义、内容和特征。在教学环节中着重培养学生的实战能力，人力资源管理的策划能力和组织能力，以及对人力资源管理的量化能力。通过人力资源管理课程的学习，使学生能够对相关的理论体系与方法有一个较全面的了解，掌握运用相关信息做出分析，学会剖析和解决问题的思路与方法，能供理论与实际相结合，是人力资源管理中的组织思想和管理技术的运用融入企业管理体系及企业整体的发展战略之中：结合案例、讨论使学生掌握人力资源管理的基本知识和工具的使用，并使之成为一个有效的管理者知识结构中的重要组成部分。 课程主要包括：人力资源管理理论发展及特征概念基本原理、工作分析、人力资源规划、招聘、薪酬管理、绩效考核、培训。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时测评和作业三部分。 课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时测评、作业等。
default.en: This course is mainly aimed at undergraduate students majoring in business administration and marketing in the school of economics and management. It is the core course of professional platform. It is hoped that the students will grasp the role of "human" in enterprise organization and management, the meaning, content and characteristics of human resource management. The teaching process focuses on training students' practical ability, the planning ability and organizational ability of human resource management, and the quantitative ability of human resource management. Through the study of Human Resource Management courses, so that the students can of relevant theoretical system and the method has a more comprehensive understanding, to master relevant information used to make analysis, learn to analysis and the idea and method to solve the problem, can be used for integrating theory with practice, is the organization in human resources management idea and management technology used in enterprise management system and the overall development strategy: combining case, discussion to make the students master the basic knowledge and management tool of the human resource management, and make it become an effective and important management part of the knowledge structure. The courses mainly include: human resource management theory development and the basic principle of characteristic concept, job analysis, human resource planning, recruitment, salary management, performance appraisal, training. The exam results of this course are cumulative, including the final written test, the usual assessment and the assignments. The final grades of the course are accumulated, including the scores of the final, the usual assessment, homework and so on.

default.zh: 运营管理是一门非常重要的课程，它关注的是如何创造人们赖以生存的产品和服务。越来越多的公司也认识到有效的运营管理可以提高产品和服务水平，进而提高收入。本课程主要讲授了生产与运作的基本概念、生产与运作战略、产品与服务开发、运营网络设计与布置、工作设计、生产计划、质量管理等内容。另外，鉴于全球化、数字化、社会责任及可持续发展给企业运营带来的影响，本课程还将指导学生共同分析生产与运作管理在未来发展面临的挑战和机遇。在教学过程中，教师将结合具体教学内容，组织案例研讨和自主学习。通过本课程的教学，使学生能够了解生产与运作管理的基础知识，掌握生产与运作管理的基本概念和各项生产与运作工作的理论、方法，并结合案例讨论使学生熟练应用课程规定的内容，帮助学生树立系统管理观念和思想，培养学生独立思考的能力，为他们以后从事相关实践工作和理论研究奠定基础。
default.en: Production and Operations Management is important. It is concerned with creating the products and services upon which we all depend. More and more companies have come to realize that effective production and operations management gives the potential to improve revenues and, at the same time, enables goods and services to be produced more efficiently. This course mainly introduces the basic concepts of production and operations, operations strategy, products and services design, operations network design and layout, job design, production plan, quality management, etc. Otherwise, in view of the impact of globalization, digitalization, social responsibility and sustainable development on operations management, this course will guide students to analyze the challenges and opportunities of production and operations management in the future. During the class, teachers will integrate case learning and self-directed learning on the basis of teaching content. This course will help the students understand the basic concepts of production and operations management, and help them master the theory and methods of production and operations management. By discussing the cases in class, the students can not only establish the system of management knowledge but also strengthen their ability to think independently. All in all, this course will help them lay a foundation for their future studying and working.

default.zh: 毕业论文写作是大学生培养的重要环节。通过本课程的学习，可以帮助学生掌握如何确定研究选题的方法，掌握研究设计的路径和思维方法，掌握引言和文献综述的写作方法，掌握研究假设的提出方法，掌握选择研究方法和资料分析的技巧，掌握讨论与结论的写作方法，提高论文写作的基本规范。总体来说，本课程不仅能够提高学生对工商管理专业知识的理解和掌握水平，还有利于培养学生的知识运用能力、创新能力、逻辑思维、系统思维，对于培养学生严谨和科学的学术态度也大有裨益。
default.en: Dissertation Writing is an important part of university students' education. Through the study of this course, students can learn how to choose the research topic, master the path and thinking method of research design, master the writing method of introduction and literature review, master the method of positioning research hypotheses, master the skills of selecting research methods and data analysis, master the writing method of discussion and conclusion, and improve the basic standard of paper writing. In general, this course can not only improve the students' understanding of the professional knowledge of business management, but also help to cultivate the students' ability to use knowledge, innovation, logical thinking and systematic thinking, as well as the students' rigorous and scientific academic attitude.

default.zh: 数智时代的企业面临更加复杂多变的市场环境，消费者的需求呈现多样化、个性化的发展趋势。市场调查和分析是现代企业了解市场和顾客需求的重要手段，是企业进行各种决策的基础。《市场调查与分析》是一门实践性很强的课程，主要是介绍市场调研的基本理论知识和具体方法，包括市场调研的基础概念、市场调研设计、定性调查方法、问卷调查法、实验法、二手数据和在线数据库、标准化信息源、数据平台、描述性分析、差异分析和预测分析及市场调研报告的撰写等。该课程将前沿信息科学的知识融入到市场调研中，拓展调研数据的范畴、丰富调研设计的方法、挖掘调研背后的影响机制、有效分析调研的结果、清晰阐述调研的发现。 同时将这些理论、知识和方法与企业的市场调研实践紧密结合，具有很的实用性和可操作性。通过熟悉和掌握现代市场调查与分析的基本方法，使学生能够有效地利用这一基本工具，能运用于市场研究中解决实际营销工作的问题。
default.en: Enterprises in the era of digital intelligence are facing a more complex and changeable market environment, and consumers' needs are showing a trend of diversification and individualization. Market survey and analysis are important for modern enterprises to understand the market and customer needs and are the basis for enterprises to make various decisions. The course "Market Survey and Analysis" is a subject with strong practicality. It mainly introduces the basic theoretical knowledge and specific methods of market research, including the basic concepts of market survey, market survey design, qualitative survey methods, questionnaire surveys, and experiments methods, secondary data and online databases, standardized information sources, data platforms, descriptive analysis, differential analysis and predictive analysis, and writing of market research reports, etc. This course integrates the knowledge of cutting-edge information science into market research, expands the scope of research data, enriches the methods of research design, excavates the influencing mechanism behind the research, effectively analyzes the results of the research, and clearly expounds the findings of the research. At the same time, these theories, knowledge and methods are closely combined with the market research practice of the enterprise, which is very practical and operable. By familiarizing with and mastering the basic methods of modern market research and analysis, students can learn to use this basic tool effectively and apply it in market research to solve practical marketing problems.

default.zh: 《中级财务会计》是研究会计理论、会计核算方法、企业资金运动的综合性技术科学，是会计学专业的主干课程和专业必修课。它以工业企业的资金运动为研究对象，以会计信息系统的四大环节，会计要素的确认、计量、记录和报告，为主线、系统地分析引起六大会计要素变化的相关会计业务处理及会计信息提供的基本原理和方法。 课程主要介绍会计确认、计量、记录和报告的程序和方法。这既是财务会知识体系中的主体部分，又是企业会计工作中最重要、最基本的内容，既是对会计学原理中揭示的基本理论、基本知识和基本方法的具体运用，又是进一步学习高级财务会计的必要前提和基础。
default.en: Intermediate Financial Accounting is comprehensive technical science studying on the accounting theory, accounting method and the enterprise capital movement, it is a main and required course of accounting major. It regard industrial enterprise capital movement as the research object. The course introduces the four links of accounting information system: the recognition, measurement, record and report of accounting elements as the main line, systematically analyzes the accounting business processes that lead to the change of six accounting elements and the basic principle and method provided by accounting information. Namely the procedures and methods of accounting recognition, measurement, record and report. It is not only the main part of financial knowledge system , but also the most important and basic content in the enterprise accounting work. Not only the application of the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic methods revealed by the accounting principles, but also the necessary premise and basis to further study the senior financial accounting.

default.zh: 《税法》课程是会计学和财务管理专业本科生必须学习的一门课程，可以帮助学生构建完善的专业知识体系。会计学和财务管理专业的学生毕业后主要从事企业的财会税收工作，纳税知识是每一个企业、每一个财务工作者、每一个公民应具备的基本知识，需要在本科生学习阶段打好基础并提升处理涉税问题的技能。学好税法可以帮助企业更好地贯彻落实国家的税收政策、正确纳税、避免违法行为，严控偷逃税行为，促进企业健康稳健地发展，依法履行社会责任。近年来，我国不断深化税制改革，使税收政策更加适应国家发展建设的需要，推动经济可持续增长。可以说，税收关乎国家的发展大计和长治久安，税收知识不断更新，大学生必须在本科生学习阶段树立正确的纳税观念，夯实税收基础知识，掌握最新的税收政策，而且不断地提升自我学习和进步的能力，才能更好地做好将来的本职工作，正确履行纳税人应尽的纳税义务。 《税法》课程结合最新的税制改革方向，讲解最新的税收政策和税收知识，培养学生科学合理的纳税理念，解决企业和个人处理涉税问题的能力，提高企业的纳税管理水平，依法合规纳税，诚信纳税，促进企业安全稳健地发展，利国利民。
default.en: The course of Taxation Laws is a mandatory course for undergraduate students majoring in Accounting and Financial Management, which can help them build a comprehensive professional knowledge system. After graduation, students majoring in accounting and financial management mainly engage in the financial and tax work of enterprises. Tax knowledge is a basic knowledge that every enterprise, every financial worker, and every citizen should possess. It is necessary to lay a solid foundation and improve the skills to handle tax related issues during the undergraduate learning stage. Learning Taxation Laws well can help enterprises better implement national tax policies, pay taxes correctly, avoid illegal activities, strictly control tax evasion, promote healthy and stable development of enterprises, and fulfill social responsibilities in accordance with the law. In recent years, China has continuously deepened its tax system reform, making tax policies more suitable for the needs of national development and construction, and promoting sustainable economic growth. It can be said that taxation is related to the development plan and long-term stability of the country. Tax knowledge is constantly changing, and college students must establish a correct tax concept, consolidate their basic knowledge of taxation, master the latest tax policies, and continuously improve their self-learning and further abilities during the undergraduate learning stage. Only in this way can they better do their future job and fulfill the tax obligations that taxpayers should fulfill correctly. The course of Taxation Laws combines the latest direction of tax system reform, explains the latest tax policies and knowledge, cultivates students' scientific and reasonable tax concepts, solves the ability of enterprises and individuals to handle tax related issues, improves the level of tax management of enterprises, pays taxes in accordance with the law and regulations, pays taxes with integrity, promotes the safe and stable development of enterprises, and benefits the country and the people.

default.zh: “会计信息系统”是国家精品课程和国家精品在线开放课程，是会计学、财务管理、信息系统、大数据等专业学生非常重要的课程。本课程以系统的观点，软件工程学的方法，揭示了会计信息系统的内在联系和运动规律。使学生掌握会计信息系统的基本理论，会计软件的开发方法、开发步骤、系统设计思想、系统结构和应具备的基本功能，以及数据存储设计，输入输出设计等，了解会计信息系统的子系统划分，各子系统的分析、设计以及子系统之间的联系。使学生能在会计工作实践中，分析设计系统管理、凭证管理、出纳管理、账簿管理、报表管理等系统，并掌握会计软件开发方法和实际应用会计软件的能力，通过使用具有代表性的通用财务软件（如：用友ERP等），能够增强学生的实际动手能力，拓展学生的知识面。课堂理论教学与上机实验紧密融合，能够增强学生的系统设计理论水平和实际动手能力。为将来参加实际工作奠定坚实的知识基础。为培养既懂会计又懂ERP软件开发与应用的复合型人才发挥作用。
default.en: Accounting information system is a national-level quality course and national-level MOOC. It is one of important professional courses on accounting,finance management,information system,big data. With system viewpoint and the method of software engineering, it shows the inner relations of accounting information system. By learning this course, it makes students master some theories and methods, such as the basic theory of accounting information system, the development method of accounting software, the development steps, system design thoughts, system structure with basic functions, data storage design, input/output design, program design etc. students should understand the partition of subsystem, the analysis, design of each subsystem and the relation between subsystems which is of accounting information system. When students practice, they can analyze system management, credence management, receive and pay out money management, account book management and master the development method of accounting software as well as the ability to use the accounting software in practice. By using some famous financial soft wares, students not only obtain the ability to practice, but also learn system design method, the design program method and some skills about program. Accordingly student’s knowledge is expanded. Their ability to control financial decision support system is improved. Their knowledge becomes abundance. These are good for doing works in enterprise. It will play a positive role to cultivate the interdisciplinary who are both with accounting knowledge and ERP software development and application.

default.zh: 《财务管理》是经济管理大类的一门基础的、重要的主干专业课程。本课程以资本市场为背景，以现代公司制企业为对象，通过以组织企业财务活动、处理企业财务管理的一系列经济管理工作为线索展开，主要介绍企业财务管理的基本原理、概念和目标，并按照企业的经营活动着重阐述企业的资本筹集、资本运用及收益分配问题，最终实现企业的价值增长。通过本课程的学习，学生应达到如下基本要求： 1.理解并应用财务管理的基本理论和方法来分析企业的价值管理问题； 2.掌握企业财务管理的主要内容、目标及基本原则； 3.熟练掌握和运用财务决策的基本原理和决策工具； 4.使得学生能够实现对公司价值管理的全面性、综合性理解；通过财务指标、财务模型、财务函数等的学习，具备对企业的价值管理活动做出预测和决策运用的能力。
default.en: Financial Management is a basic and important main professional course of economics and management. With capital market as the background and modern corporate enterprises as the object, this course mainly introduces the basic principles, concepts and objectives of corporate financial management by focusing on a series of economic management work such as the organization of corporate financial activities and dealing with corporate financial management. In addition, it highlights the problems of capital raising, capital utilization and income distribution, and finally realizes the value growth of the enterprise according to the business activities of the enterprise. Through this course, students should meet the following basic requirements: 1.Understand and apply the basic theories and methods of financial management to analyze the value management of enterprises 2.Master the main contents, objectives and basic principles of enterprise financial management; 3.Master and apply the basic principles of financial decision-making and decision-making tools; 4.Enable students to realize a comprehensive and integrated understanding of corporate value management through the study of financial indicators, financial models, financial functions, etc., they have the ability to make predictions and decision-making applications for corporate value management activities.

default.zh: 财务管理学是一门实用性很强的课程，它融合了经济、会计、财务、法律和管理等多个领域的知识。本课程主要教授如何理解和应用资金的时间价值、如何评估风险、企业如何进行筹资和投资决策、如何管理短期资产、以及如何制定股利分配政策等。学习这门课程，学生能够掌握财务管理的基础理论和技能，提高财务决策的能力。学生还将学会如何用专业知识来分析和解决企业及个人财务管理中遇到的问题，制定出合理的解决策略。
default.en: Financial management is a practical course that blends knowledge from economics, accounting, finance, law, and management. It focuses on understanding the time value of money, assessing risks and returns, making corporate financing and investment decisions, managing short-term assets, and setting dividend policies. The goal is to equip students with fundamental financial management theories and skills, enhance their decision-making abilities, and enable them to analyze and solve real-world financial problems in both corporate and personal finance, developing professional solutions.

default.zh: 财务管理是企业管理的重要组成部分，主要研究如何有效地规划、控制和监督企业的资金运动，以达到企业价值最大化的目标。该课程涉及的内容广泛，包括财务分析、财务预测、财务决策、财务计划、财务控制和财务评价等方面。通过学习财务管理，学生可以掌握基本的财务分析方法，了解企业的财务报表和财务状况，并能够进行有效的财务决策和风险管理。
default.en: Financial management is an essential component of business management, mainly studying how to effectively plan, control, and supervise the capital movement of enterprises, in order to achieve the goal of maximizing enterprise value. This course involves a wide range of content, including financial analysis, financial forecasting, financial decision-making, financial planning, financial control, and financial evaluation. By studying financial management, students can master basic financial analysis methods, understand the financial statements and financial condition of enterprises, and be able to make effective financial decisions and risk management.

default.zh: 财务分析课程是财会大类专业的重要专业基课程，是学习会计学基础等专业集群基础课程和财务管理、中级财务会计大类专业基础课程后的一门理论性和应用性相结合的课程。主要介绍财务分析的基本理论、分析方法和应用，包括筹资活动、投资活动、经营和分销活动的分析与估算，以及企业的财务能力（盈利能力、偿债能力、运营能力和发展能力）。本课程的目标是一方面使学生掌握和应用财务分析理论和方法，同时了解财务分析发展的前沿趋势；另一方面，培养学生综合分析和解决问题的能力，使学生能够利用企业财务信息分析评价企业经营活动。
default.en: The financial analysis course is a crucial core course for majors in the field of accounting. It combines theoretical and practical aspects and is offered after students have completed foundational courses in accounting and basic courses in financial management and intermediate financial accounting. This course primarily covers fundamental theories, analytical methods, and applications of financial analysis, including the analysis and estimation of financing activities, investment activities, as well as operational and distribution activities. It also addresses a company’s financial capabilities, such as profitability, credit ability, operation ability and development ability. The objectives of this course are twofold. Firstly, it aims to equip students with the knowledge and application of financial analysis theories and methods, while keeping them informed about the latest trends in financial analysis.
