default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是工商专业的学生在毕业之前进行的论文撰写活动，是专业教学过程中的重要环节。主要内容是学生在导师的指导下，完成毕业论文的开题、中期和答辩的各个环节。培养学生掌握撰写学术论文的基本方法，具有科学研究的基本能力。学生通过毕业论文深化所学工商管理类相关理论知识的理解，了解本学科的理论前沿和发展动态。掌握文献检索、资料查询的基本方法。培养学生独立思考能力，提高分析解决问题的能力、书面表达能力及创造性思维精神，是检验学生学习成绩和研究成果的重要手段。
default.en: Graduation Thesis (Design) is an activity of paper writing for students of business administration major before their graduation and an important part of the professional teaching process. The main content is to complete whole process including the proposal, mid-term and ending defense under the guidance of the supervisor. The aim of this course is training students to master the basic methods of writing academic papers and developing their basic ability of academic research. Through the teaching activities of this course, the students can deepen the theoretical knowledge of business management, understand the theoretical frontier and development this discipline, master the basic methods of literature search and information inquiry, cultivate students' independent thinking ability, improve their ability to analyze and solve problems, written expression ability and creative thinking spirit, This course is also an important means of testing students' academic performance and research results.

default.zh: 生产实习是学生理论联系实际必要的实践教学环节，也是知识教育的重要环节。通过生产实习使学生在掌握学科基本知识的基础上，了解理论知识与经营实践的联系，并为学生从学校走向社会起到一个很好的过渡作用。通过生产实习培养学生的实际操作能力，巩固和运用所学和各门课程的知识，理论结合实际，培养管理观点，训练观察、分析和解决工程实际问题的独立工作能力，培养学生的实际操作能力，使学生了解理论知识与生产经营的实际联系，扩大眼界，丰富知识，为学生走向工作岗位奠定基础。通过实习，使学生加深对所学专业在国民经济中所占地位和作用的认识，培养学生的事业心、使命感和务实精神，巩固专业思想，增强适应性，缩短自我追求和社会需要的差距。 本课程的特点是，宽广视野与务实精神、基本理论与应用技术的统一。既充分反映现代化和国际化，又体现了当今时代的特性和中国企业现代化的要求。本课程涵盖了企业制度变革与企业管理创新、人力资源管理创新与组织团队建设、市场环境变迁与营销管理创新、技术创新与集群网络发展等方面的前沿研究理论与思想。通过大量中外企业国际化经营成功和失败案例的分析，以期提高学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力，同时培养兼具国际视野和管理能力的优秀人才。
default.en: Production practice is the practical link which make students combine the theory with practice, and it is also an important link of knowledge education. Through the production practice, students would master the basic knowledge, understand the connection of theoretical knowledge and business practice, and play a very good transition role for students from school to community. Through the production practice, cultivate students' practical ability, consolidate and use the knowledge and theory of the courses, train management thought, enhance independent work ability of observation, analysis and solve the practical problems , so that students understand the real connecting link of theoretical knowledge and production management, expand horizons, rich knowledge, to lay the foundation for work. Through the production practice, students deepen their understanding of the status and role of the profession in the national economy, cultivate students' professionalism, mission and pragmatism, consolidate professional thinking, enhance adaptability, shorten the gap between self-pursuit and social needs. This course is characterized by broad vision and pragmatic spirit, basic theory and applied technology. It not only fully reflects the modernization and internationalization, but also reflects the characteristics of the times and the requirements of Chinese enterprises modernization. This course covers the theme of institution organization and technology innovation, through exploring from different aspects and levels, covering the cutting-edge research theory and thinking of enterprise system reform and enterprise management innovation, human resource management innovation and organizational team building, market environment change and marketing management innovation, technology innovation and cluster network development and other aspects. Through a large number of successful and failure case analysis of Chinese and foreign enterprises internationalization, so as to improve students’ ability of thinking independently, analysing and solving problems, cultivate large numbers of talents who unites international vision and administrative capacity.

default.zh: 毕业实习的目的主要是通过对具体经济组织情况的了解，提出在毕业设计阶段所要解决的实际管理问题，并围绕该问题，进行详细的资料与数据的收集，拟订初步的解决问题的思路，为进一步的毕业设计奠定基础。 毕业实习要求学生结合毕业论文选题选择实习要研究的问题，并要求学生应用所学的工商管理理论知识形成解决问题的方案，掌握基本的数据收集方法和研究方法，锻炼解决工商管理理论与实际问题的能力。毕业实习最后要求学生写出一份研究问题合理、研究数据丰富、研究方法科学的实习报告。 毕业实习的主要内容包括深化与细化所学习的理论知识，掌握综述相关研究的方法，掌握毕业设计内容研究所需数据资料的收集方法，了解相关企业和行业管理实践，训练提炼管理问题的思维。
default.en: The purpose of this course is mainly to put forward the practical management problems to be solved in the graduation design stage through understanding the specific economic organization, collect detailed information and data about this problem, and draw up preliminary ideas to solve the problems, so as to lay the foundation for further graduation design. This course requires students to select the problems to be studied related to the topic selection of graduation thesis, and requires students to apply the theoretical knowledge of business administration they have learned to design a solution to the problem, master the basic data collection methods and research methods, and promote their ability to solve the theoretical and practical problems of business administration. Atudents are required to write a report with a specific research question, rich research data and scientific research methods. The main contents of this course include deepening and refining the theoretical knowledge learned, mastering the methods of summarizing relevant research, mastering the methods of collecting data required for the research of thesis, understanding the management practice of relevant enterprises and industries, and training the thinking of refining management problems.

default.zh: 通过本课程设计环节，一方面使本科生在创业管理学习及模拟实践过程中，综合运用过去所学的全部课程的理论知识，使其进一步地接触、认识、分析和处理新建企业创业过程中遇到的实际问题；真实地参与对新创企业调研，了解创业者创业历程、新创企业商业模式、新创企业融资路演等环节；其次，各个小组创业项目通过展开实际的市场调查模拟环节，一方面检验及修改创业计划项目报告撰写的可行性，另一方面检验并提升其创业意识、创新能力、创业能力及企业管理能力；最后，完成创业项目完整的创业计划，并通过答辩环节充分展示创业团队完整的创业项目及与投资者的良好的沟通能力。同时，也为学生做好毕业设计进行一次综合训练和准备。从而加深学生对所学理论知识的理解，培养学生独立思考和创新能力，增强学生分析和解决创业实际运营问题的能力，检验学生是否对创业有一个系统深刻的认识与体会，激发学生的创业热情，提升实践经验。
default.en: Through this course design link, on the one hand, the undergraduates in the process of entrepreneurial management study and simulation practice, the integrated use of theoretical knowledge learned in the past all course, make the further contact and understanding, analysis and processing of actual problems in the process of a new start-up business;Truly participate in research on new startups, understand their entrepreneurial journey, business models, and financing roadshows; Second, each team entrepreneurship programs by expanding market survey of actual simulation link, on the one hand, test and modify the business plan project feasibility report, on the other hand, inspection and improve its pioneering consciousness, innovation, entrepreneurship and enterprise management ability; At last，students can complete the start-up plan of the start-up project, and fully demonstrate the complete entrepreneurial project and good communication ability with investors through the defense link. At the same time, it is also a comprehensive training and preparation for students to complete graduation design. To deepen students' understanding of theoretical knowledge, cultivating students' independent thinking and innovative ability, strengthen students' ability to analyze and solve the problem of actual operations business, check whether students in entrepreneurship system with a deep knowledge and experience, stimulate students' entrepreneurial zeal, practice experience of ascension.

default.zh: 专业实习是市场营销专业的学生在学完基础课和部分专业课之后所进行的一次实践活动，是专业教学过程中的重要环节。通过本次实习，使学生了解本专业的主要业务内容，熟悉开展这些业务的方法及技巧，培养学生在市场调查、营销策划、推销等具体营销工作中认识问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力。使学生能够比较全面地了解一家具体企业单位营销管理的基本程序和具体方法，加强学生对所学专业理论知识的理解，培养实际操作的动手能力，提高运用营销管理基本技能的水平。它既是学生对所学理论知识实际化的初步尝试，也是对学生所学专业知识的一次综合检验和进一步提升。 通过本门课的教学活动，使学生学习和掌握实践中的营销方法和技巧，并将专业知识与实践相结合。
default.en: Productive practice is a practical activity carried out by students of marketing major after they have learned basic courses and some professional courses. It is an important link in the professional teaching process. Through this internship, the students will understand the main business contents of the major, be familiar with the methods and skills to carry out these businesses, and cultivate their ability to recognize, analyze and solve problems in specific marketing work such as market research, marketing planning and sales promotion. To enable students to comprehensively understand the basic procedures and specific methods of marketing management of a specific enterprise unit, strengthen their understanding of the theoretical knowledge of their major, cultivate their practical ability, and improve the level of using the basic skills of marketing management. It is not only a preliminary attempt for students to put the theoretical knowledge they have learned into practice, but also a comprehensive test and further improvement of the professional knowledge they have learned. Through the teaching activities of this course, students can learn and master the marketing methods and skills in practice, and combine professional knowledge with practice.

default.zh: 毕业实习是市场营销专业的学生在毕业之前进行的一次实践活动，是专业教学过程中的重要环节。通过本次实习，培养适应实习单位要求和社会工作的能力，使学生将所学习的所有专业知识与实践相对接，熟悉开展营销业务的方法及技巧，培养学生在营销工作中认识问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，提高运用营销管理综合技能的水平。它既是学生对四年所学理论知识的综合检验，也是学生毕业应聘工作的提前演练。
default.en: Graduation internship is a practical activity for students majoring in marketing before graduation, and it is an important link in the professional teaching process. Through this internship, students will be able to adapt to the requirements of the internship unit and social work, connect all the professional knowledge they have learned with practice, be familiar with the methods and skills of marketing business, cultivate their ability to recognize, analyze and solve problems in marketing work, and improve the level of using comprehensive skills of marketing management. It is not only a comprehensive test of students' theoretical knowledge learned in the past four years, but also an exercise in advance for students to apply for jobs after graduation.

default.zh: 毕业设计是市场营销专业的学生在毕业之前进行的论文撰写活动，是专业教学过程中的重要环节。主要内容是学生在导师的指导下，完成毕业论文的开题、中期和答辩的各个环节。通过本门课的教学活动，将理论与实践相结合，使学生掌握撰写学术论文和调研报告的方法，巩固深化所学市场营销相关理论知识，培养学生思维能力，提高认识营销问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力、书面表达能力及论证才能，发挥创造精神，并作为检验学生学习成绩和研究成果的重要手段。
default.en: Graduation thesis is a thesis writing activity conducted by students majoring in marketing before graduation, and it is an important link in the professional teaching process. The main content is that the students, under the guidance of their tutors, complete the opening, mid-term and defense of their graduation thesis. Through the teaching activities of this course, we will combine theory with practice to enable students to master the method of writing academic papers and research reports, consolidate and deepen the theoretical knowledge related to marketing, cultivate students' thinking ability, improve their ability to understand marketing problems, analyze and solve problems, written expression ability and demonstration ability, give play to their creativity, and serve as an important means to test students' academic achievements and research achievements.

default.zh: 毕业设计是会计学专业本科学习阶段必修的综合性实践环节，目的在于培养学生发现问题、综合运用所学的知识分析和解决实际问题的能力。通过实践使学生了解在实际工作中如何进行有关信会计学方面的业务活动，推进企事业单位的会计建设。使学生对所学会计学专业的意义和特点有更为全面的认识。通过实践环节，检查学生对所学会计学知识的理解程度、掌握程度和实际应用能力；检查学生与毕业论文（设计）有关的各项准备工作的计划性和完善程度。促进学生将所学理论与实践相结合，培养他们脚踏实地、谨慎踏实的工作作风，为今后较顺利地走上工作岗位打下定的基础。 通过专业实习，达到如下目的： 知识目标．锻炼学生综合且有创造性地使用会计学知识的能力。 能力目标．锻炼学生使用会计学知识观察问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力。 素质目标．锻炼会计学专业学生的创造能力、激发同学们对科研的兴趣和热情，建立科研信心。
default.en: The graduation project is a comprehensive practical part that is mandatory for undergraduate studies in the field of accounting. Its purpose is to cultivate students' ability to discover problems, comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve practical problems. Through practice, students will understand how to carry out business activities related to credit accounting in practical work, and promote the accounting construction of enterprises and institutions. Enable students to have a more comprehensive understanding of the significance and characteristics of their accounting major. Through practical activities, check the students' understanding, mastery, and practical application ability of the accounting knowledge they have learned; Check the planning and completeness of the preparation work related to the graduation thesis (design) for students. Promote students to combine their theoretical knowledge with practical experience, cultivate their down-to-earth, cautious and down-to-earth work style, and lay a solid foundation for their smooth entry into work positions in the future. Through professional internships, achieve the following goals: Knowledge objectives. Exercise students' ability to comprehensively and creatively use accounting knowledge. Ability goal. Exercise students' ability to use accounting knowledge to observe, analyze, and solve problems. Quality objectives. Exercise the creative ability of accounting students, stimulate their interest and enthusiasm in scientific research, and establish their confidence in scientific research.

default.zh: 《中级财务会计实训》是通过模拟实训，使学生能够系统、全面地掌握会计制度和企业会计核算的基本程序和具体方法，加强学生对会计基本理论的理解、对会计基本方法的运用和对会计基本技能的训练。 学生在课程中能够将会计专业知识和会计实务有机地结合在一起，真正掌握填写原始凭证的方法、各种业务的处理及记账凭证的填写方法、账薄的处理及账簿的登记方法、各种报表的编制方法等。
default.en: Intermediate Financial Accounting in Practice is a simulation of real environment in enterprises, trainning students to master the accounting system and basic program and means of accounting measurement systematically and thoroughly, so as to strenghthen students’ understanding of accounting theory, usage of accounting basic means and skills. In this course, students are able to combine the accounting knowledge with practice organically. They can learn how to fill the original certificate and accounting voucher, how to deal with different cases as well as the usage of account book. At last, they should be able to prepare a financial statement independently.

default.zh: 毕业实习是会计学专业本科培养方案中非常重要的实践性教学环节，为了实现培养社会主义市场经济下会计人才的目的，使学生在校期间了解企业会计实务，了解现行会计准则、会计制度、相应会计法规对会计的要求，明确自己的毕业论文调研方向，为毕业论文撰写提供有用的资料，使学生做到理论与实践相结合，提高学生的动手能力，使学生经受实际工作的基本训练，学会收集整理信息资料，掌握综合运用所学知识分析和解决实际问题的基本思路和方法。
default.en: Graduation practice is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate program of accounting specialty. In order to realize the purpose of cultivating the accounting talents in the socialist market economy, the students will understand the accounting practice and understand the current accounting standards and accounting system. Accounting regulations on the accounting requirements, clear their own graduation thesis research direction, writing for the graduation thesis to provide useful information to enable students to do the combination of theory and practice to improve students' practical ability to enable students to withstand the basic work of basic training, learn Collect and collate information, master the basic use of knowledge and analysis of practical problems to solve the basic ideas and methods.

default.zh: 专业实习是本科教学理论和实践相结合的重要环节，实习企业现场参观、模拟、实践，全面了解企业的生产经营和管理活动，培养学生综合运用专业知识，分析解决实际工作中所存在问题的能力，增强学生感性认识，提高学生实践能力。 会计学生产实习是会计学专业本科培养方案中的一个重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生了解和掌握会计学专业的有关专业知识，印证、巩固和提高已经学过的会计核算和监督的有关内容，培养学生理论联系实际、提高学生在会计监督实践中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题、解决问题的能力和方法，为将来的继续求学和毕业就业,从事会计核算、会计监督工作打下良好基础。通过本课程的学习，学生应达到如下基本要求： 1.了解会计实际工作； 2.发现实际工作中存在的有待提升之处，做深入分析并能提出改进措施和建议。 3.深入社会实践，接触实际工作，了解企业经营活动和生产实践，理解会计具体内容、操作程序及工作要求，了解会计实践活动中的新的管理理念与管理技能，丰富和扩大其专业知识领域，为今后走向社会，服务社会做好思想准备和业务准备。
default.en: Production practice is an important link in the combination of study and practice. By visiting, simulating and practicing enterprises, students can fully understand the production, operation and management activities of enterprises and comprehensively use professional knowledge, analyze and solve problems existing in practical work. It can enhance students' perceptual understanding and practical ability. Accounting Production Practice is an important practical teaching link in the training program of undergraduate accounting program, which aims to make students understand and master the relevant professional knowledge of accounting; confirm, consolidate and improve the accounting and supervision of the content that has been learned; cultivate students to link the theory with practice, and improve the students' ability to investigate, research, observe, analyze and solve problems in the practice of accounting supervision. This course is designed to provide students with a good foundation for further study and employment in accounting and accounting supervision in the future. Through the study of this course, students should meet the following basic requirements: 1. Understand the actual work of accounting; 2. Find out what needs to be improved in practical work, make in-depth analysis and put forward improvement measures and suggestions. 3. Understand the business activities and production practices of enterprises, the specific content operating procedures and work requirements of accounting, the new management concepts and management skills in accounting practice activities. Make ideological and business preparations for the future to serve the society with enriched professional knowledge.

default.zh: 毕业设计是财务管理专业本科学习阶段必修的综合性实践环节，目的在于培养学生发现问题、综合运用所学的知识分析和解决实际问题的能力。通过实践使学生了解在实际工作中如何进行有关信财务管理方面的业务活动，推进企事业单位的财务管理建设。使学生对所学财务管理专业的意义和特点有更为全面的认识。通过实践环节，检查学生对所学财务管理知识的理解程度、掌握程度和实际应用能力；检查学生与毕业论文（设计）有关的各项准备工作的计划性和完善程度。促进学生将所学理论与实践相结合，培养他们脚踏实地、谨慎踏实的工作作风，为今后较顺利地走上工作岗位打下定的基础。 通过专业实习，达到如下目的： 知识目标．锻炼学生综合且有创造性地使用财务管理知识的能力。 能力目标．锻炼学生使用财务管理知识观察问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力。 素质目标．锻炼财务管理专业学生的创造能力、激发同学对科研的兴趣和热情，建立科研信心。
default.en: The graduation project is a comprehensive practical part that is mandatory for undergraduate studies in the field of financial management. Its purpose is to cultivate students' ability to identify problems, comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve practical problems. Through practice, students will understand how to carry out business activities related to credit and financial management in practical work, and promote the construction of financial management in enterprises and institutions. Enable students to have a more comprehensive understanding of the significance and characteristics of their financial management major. Through practical activities, check the students' understanding, mastery, and practical application ability of the financial management knowledge they have learned; Check the planning and completeness of the preparation work related to the graduation thesis (design) for students. Promote students to combine their theoretical knowledge with practical experience, cultivate their down-to-earth, cautious and down-to-earth work style, and lay a solid foundation for their smooth entry into work positions in the future. Through professional internships, achieve the following goals: Knowledge objectives. Exercise students' ability to comprehensively and creatively use financial management knowledge. Ability goal. Exercise students' ability to use financial management knowledge to observe, analyze, and solve problems. Quality objectives. Exercise the creative ability of financial management students, stimulate their interest and enthusiasm in scientific research, and establish confidence in scientific research.

default.zh: 生产实习是财务管理专业教学计划所设的重要实践性教学环节，其目的是为了提高学生对所学知识的感性认识，通过对校外实习单位进行参观、学习和具体操作，帮助学生将所学的理论知识融入生产实践当中，提升技能，加深对本专业知识更深入、更系统的理解和领悟，为进一步学习专业课程打下基础；增强学生的社会适应能力，检验学生理论联系实际的能力，为学生走向社会、走向工作岗位奠定基础。
default.en: Training for working is one of the important practice teaching steps in financial management teaching program. With the purpose of increasing perceptual knowledge to theoretical knowledge and practice work, throughout looking around, studying and specific operating in companies, undergraduates can put and integrate theoretical knowledge they learned into practice to improve skills and deepen understanding of professional knowledge systematically and completely, lay the foundation for further studying major courses, enhance social adaptability, examine their abilities of theory with practice which can lay the foundation for working in few years.

default.zh: 毕业实习旨在帮助学生将所学理论知识应用于实际工作环境中，从而提升其实践能力、职业技能和综合素质。通过毕业实习，在开题报告的基础上，完善毕业论文，以达到中期检查的进度要求。通过自学《会计综合实训》、《虚拟仿真实验教学项目》，提高解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Graduation internship aims to help students apply the theoretical knowledge they have learned to actual work environments, thereby enhancing their practical abilities, vocational skills, and comprehensive qualities. Through the graduation practice, on the basis of the proposal report, improve the graduation thesis to meet the progress requirements of the mid-term inspection. Through self-study "Accounting Comprehensive Training", "Virtual simulation experiment teaching project", improve the ability to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 《财务分析实训》是财会大类的实践教学课程，课程主要使学生在掌握了财务分析的基本理论、基本分析方法的基础上，通过对上市公司财务报表的分析，锻炼对企业筹资活动、投资活动、经营活动、分配活动的分析与评价、企业财务能力（盈利能力、偿债能力、营运能力及发展能力）的分析与评价的能力。目的是培养学生综合分析问题和解决问题的能力，使其具备利用企业财务等信息进行财务分析和评价的技能。
default.en: Financial Analysis Practice & Training is a practical teaching course of the accounting category, the course mainly enables students to master the basic theory and basic analysis methods of financial analysis, through the analysis of the financial statements of listed companies, exercise the analysis and evaluation of enterprise financing activities, investment activities, business activities, distribution activities, enterprise financial ability (profitability, solvency, operation ability and development ability) analysis and evaluation ability. The purpose is to cultivate students’ ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems, and to equip them with the skills to conduct financial analysis and evaluation using information such as corporate finance.

default.zh: 生产实习主要以现场教学的方式，组织学生对金融企业和管理机构等进行参观、考察、调研，促使学生对整个大学阶段所学的理论知识进行汇总，增强学生的感性认识，提高其知识综合运用能力、解决实际问题能力以及独立工作能力，同时加强团队合作精神和敬业精神的培养，为很好地完成毕业设计和将来尽快适应工作环境打下基础。实习方式主要有：听取报告、参观、搜集相应资料、撰写实习日记和实习报告。
default.en: Production internship is carried out in the way of scene teaching. In the course we organize students to visit financial enterprise and customs, and so on. The purpose of the course is to help students promote their abilities in analyzing and solving some real problem, to bring up spirit of team-work and responsible for career. Which assistant the students to finish graduation design and adapt the future job. Styles of the Production internship are debriefing, visiting, collecting the appropriate information, writing intern diary internship report.

default.zh: 毕业实习能够使学生在校期间了解金融部门实务、现行金融法规、制度对金融工作者的要求，明确自己的论文调研方向，为论文撰写提供有用的资料。使学生做到理论与实践相结合，提高学生的动手能力，掌握综合运用所学知识分析和解决实际问题的基本思路和方法。实习内容包括：初步确定毕业论文题目、确定毕业实习提纲、信息资料的搜集等。实习方式主要有：听取报告、参观、搜集相应资料、撰写实习日记和实习报告。
default.en: Graduation practice enables students understand the financial sector practices, the current financial regulations, the requirements of financial workers to clear their own dissertation research direction and provide useful information for the graduation paper. Students do combine theory with practice to improve the abilities of students to grasp the comprehensive use of the knowledge to analyze and solve practical problems of the basic ideas and methods. The practice includes: preliminary to determine thesis topic outline, collect information to determine graduation internship. Styles of the practice are debriefing, visiting, collecting the appropriate information, writing intern diary internship report.

default.zh: 该课程是金融学专业教学中最重要的教学环节，其目的是对应届毕业生所学基本知识、基本方法运用到实际问题，分析问题和解决问题，是学以致用的综合性检验，是对学生专业知识、综合技能的全面训练和运用。学生们通过了解和认识如何围绕特定的金融实际问题，收集并分析有关参考文献，解决论文设计中的实际问题，并用统计等量化分析软件，综合运用理论分析、量化关系分析等计算，使学生受到科研的基本训练，培养其开展科学研究、解决实际问题等能力。
default.en: This course is the most important teaching link in the field of finance. Its purpose is to apply the basic knowledge and methods learned by recent graduates to know practical problems, analyze and solve problems. It is a comprehensive test of applying what is learned, and a training and application of students' professional knowledge and skills. By understanding how to revolve around specific financial practical problems, collecting and analyzing relevant references, solving practical problems in paper design, and using quantitative analysis software such as statistics to comprehensively apply theoretical analysis, quantitative relationship analysis, and other calculations, students receive basic training in scientific research and cultivate their abilities to conduct scientific research and solve practical problems.

default.zh: 自从20世纪60年代资本资产定价模型被提出以来，实证资产定价经过学术界50多年的发展，形成了完善的研究体系，并获得了丰富的实证结果，而从中演化出来的因子投资如今也早已成为海内外资产管理人必备的重要工具，其在资产配置和获取超额收益方面均大有作为。因此，本课程将系统化地介绍因子投资的研究方法和投资实务，带领学生掌握各种分析方法在研究异象、因子以及多因子模型方面的应用。 本课程分为三个模块，第一个模块搭建研究因子投资的统一视角，让学生在接触具体实践之前首先掌握因子投资的全貌。第二个模块介绍学术界在分析因子时最常用的统计学方法，例如投资组合排序法、Fama-MacBeth 回归法等，为学生进行系统性的因子研究奠定基础。第三个模块为构建基于因子的投资策略。具体来说，将组织学生从最新学术研究文献入手，解读文献，收集、整理数据和样本，构建因子选股模型，并对最后的组合结果进行展示和研究报告的撰写。
default.en: Since the introduction of the Capital Asset Pricing Model in the 1960s, empirical asset pricing has undergone over 50 years of development in the academic field, forming a comprehensive research system and yielding abundant empirical results. At the same time, factor investing developed from these studies has now become an essential tool for asset managers at home and abroad, and it has great potential in asset allocation and obtaining excess returns. Therefore, this course will systematically introduce research methods and investment practices of factor investing, and guide students in mastering the application of various analytical methods in studying anomalies and multi-factor models. The course includes three modules. The first module builds a unified perspective for studying factor-based investing. The second module introduces the statistical methods most commonly used by academia in factor research, such as portfolio sorting, Fama-MacBeth regression, etc. The third module focuses on constructing factor-based investment strategies. Specifically, students will delve into the latest academic research literature, collect data, organize samples, construct factor selection strategies, and present the final portfolio results through research reports.

default.zh: 外贸函电课程设计旨在训练学生熟练运用外贸英语函电的基本知识和技能。 本课程按照外贸业务环节的进程，系统地训练各类英文函电的格式要求和写作方法。内容涉及包括商业信函的撰写格式、建立业务关系、询盘及回复、报盘、还盘、成交、付款方式、合同、信用证、包装及运输、保险、申诉和索赔、电子邮件等。 课程要求学生通过小组成员积极协作，共同完成3个信函设计任务。通过英汉互译练习及国际贸易案例中某些环节缺失的信函的设计和书写，系统掌握、运用外贸活动中各环节函电的词汇，句式和写作技巧，培养学生翻译能力和撰写符合国际商务惯例，中心思想明确、结构合理、语言得体的英语函电的能力。
default.en: The course of Curriculum Design for English Correspondences in international Business and Trade is to help the students grasp English writing skills through application. It is aimed to cultivate English business correspondence reading, translating, and writing skills. The course is arranged according to the procedure of foreign trade business, systematically teaching various English business correspondences formats and writing methods. The content of the course includes English business correspondences formats, establishing business relations, inquiry and reply, offer and counteroffer, conclusion of business, modes of payment, contracts, letters of credit, packaging, shipping, insurance, complaints and claim. The course requires students to actively cooperate with group members to complete three tasks. Through English Chinese translation exercises and then through designing and writing missing letters that are in a practical international trade case, students can systematically master and use the vocabulary, sentence patterns and writing skills of business letters, emails and faxes in foreign trade activities, so as to develop their ability and skills in translation and writing of English business letters that are in conformity with international business practices and clear and focused in ideas, reasonable in structure and decent in language.

default.zh: 普通生物学是高等院校市政专业的一门重要的专业基础课，将主要讲述环境污染防治及生态修复工程中涉及的有关生物学原理。本课程以细胞学、植物学和动物学为核心，讲述市政工程所涉及的具有共性的基本生物现象和基本生物过程背后的生物学原理。本课程向上承接环境学、生态学原理及应用等专业基础课程，向下承接环境系统工程、环境生态工程等专业核心课程。本课程针对市政工程专业的特点，在理论学习的同时紧密联系环境生态学科中的生物学问题，同时也注重生物学原理在环境市政工程应用的实际案例讲解，使学生具有从事市政工程领域工作所需的相关生物学相关知识，掌握市政环境污染预防与控制的生物学基本理论和基本技能，并能将所学生物学知识用于解决复杂市政环境问题。
default.en: General Biology is an important foundational course in municipal engineering in higher education institutions, which mainly focuses on the biological principles involved in environmental pollution prevention and ecological restoration engineering. This course focuses on cytology, botany, and zoology, and discusses the common basic biological phenomena and biological principles behind the basic biological processes involved in municipal engineering. This course extends from basic courses in environmental science, principles and applications of ecology, to core courses in environmental systems engineering, environmental ecological engineering, and other related fields. This course is aimed at the characteristics of the municipal engineering major, closely linking theoretical learning with biological issues in the field of environmental ecology. At the same time, it also emphasizes the practical case explanation of biological principles in the application of environmental municipal engineering, so that students have relevant biological knowledge required for work in the field of municipal engineering, and master the basic theories and skills of biology in the prevention and control of municipal environmental pollution, and be able to apply the biological knowledge learned to solve complex municipal environmental problems.

default.zh: 传统水工程系统在技术调控、能量消耗、药剂添加等方面有大水漫灌、粗放经营等现象，难以保障各单元高效精准运行。人工智能的“思考”和“决策”与大数据的场景分析和应用相结合，融合数字孪生技术辐射在智慧水系统工程的全生命周期上，涵盖规划设计、施工建设、运行维护，其在感知监测、水务资产管理、供排水一体化调度、城市防洪排涝等多方面都有着重要的应用价值。本课程目标是培养学生了解和掌握水工程人工智能与大数据基础有关的各种知识，以及信息科学、计算机技术、网络技术、人工智能、系统工程等多种不同交叉学科技术在水系统数字化中的应用。通过讲授人工智能与大数据技术概述、大数据特性以及大数据全流程分析技术、数据挖掘技术、机器学习技术、机器学习算法与模型构建、城市水系统监测模型、城市水系统专家预警等内容，强化学生进一步钻研工程数字孪生与智慧运维技术的能力。
default.en: The traditional water engineering system has the phenomenon of flood irrigation and extensive management in technical regulation, energy consumption and chemical addition, which makes it difficult to ensure the efficient and accurate operation of each unit. The “Thinking” and “Decision” of artificial intelligence, combined with scenario analysis and application of big data, fuses the digital twinning radiation over the life cycle of an intelligent systems engineering, it covers planning and design, construction, operation and maintenance. It has important application value in perception monitoring, water asset management, integrated water supply and drainage dispatching, urban flood control and waterlogging. The goal of this course is to train students to understand and master all kinds of knowledge related to water engineering artificial intelligence and Big Data Foundation, and the application of different interdisciplinary technologies such as information science, computer technology, network technology, artificial intelligence, systems engineering technology in the digitization of water systems. Through the introduction of artificial intelligence and big data technology, the characteristics of big data, the whole process analysis of big data technology, data mining technology, machine learning technology, machine learning algorithm and model building, urban water system monitoring model, urban water system expert early warning, etc. , strengthen students' ability to further study the technology of engineering digital twinning and intelligent operation and maintenance.

default.zh: 水化学主要研究水处理和输送过程中的基本化学现象，研究污染物在水中迁移转化的一些基本原理。本课程是给排水科学与工程专业学生在学完无机与分析化学之后的一门专业基础课。课程的主要内容为：化学热力学和动力学、酸碱反应、配位反应、沉淀和溶解、氧化还原反应、电化学、界面化学等知识。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解或掌握水质化学与水处理化学过程中的热力学与动力学基本问题、酸碱反应的本质和规律、金属离子与一些无机离子和有机离子之间的配合反应、常见沉淀物在水中的溶解及其稳定性、氧化还原反应的基本原理、原电池与电解池、胶体与絮凝的基本知识、固-液界面的浸润与吸附等。本课程不仅可以加深学生对水处理过程中化学现象的认识，还为学生从事水处理方面的科学研究奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Water chemistry mainly studies the basic chemical phenomena in water treatment and transportation processes, and studies some basic principles of pollutant migration and transformation in water. This course is a fundamental course for students majoring in Water Supply and Drainage Science and Engineering after completing the study of Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry. The main content of the course is: chemical thermodynamics and kinetics, acid-base reactions, coordination reactions, precipitation and dissolution, redox reactions, electrochemistry, interface chemistry, and other knowledge. Through the study of this course, students will understand or master the basic problems of thermodynamics and kinetics, the essence and laws of acid-base reactions, the coordination reactions between metal ions and some inorganic and organic ions, the dissolution and stability of common precipitates in water, the basic principles of redox reactions, the basic knowledge of primary batteries and electrolytic cells, colloids and flocculation, infiltration and adsorption at the solid-liquid interface in water quality chemistry and water treatment chemistry. This course not only deepens students' understanding of chemical phenomena in water treatment processes, but also lays a solid foundation for their scientific research in water treatment.

default.zh: 作为从事防止环境污染、提高改善环境质量的一门科学，环境科学和环境工程的核心就是环境污染的治理。绝大多数环境污染物为有机化合物，因此，有机化学是与环境科学和环境工程密切相关的学科，在治理环境污染和提高资源利用率方面发挥了重要且关键的作用。 有机化学是研究有机物的组成、结构、性质、合成以及与此相关的理论问题的科学，是一门理论性和实践性并重的课程。本课程首先系统介绍有机化学的基础理论知识，主要包括价键理论、电子效应和有机化学酸碱理论等，围绕该基础理论解析不同有机化合物结构以及这种结构所导致的有机化合物的物理化学性质，进一步介绍不同有机化合物对环境的影响以及如何利用有机化学反应治理环境污染和提高资源利用率。针对环境工程专业的特点，紧密联系环境工程学科中的实际问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境科学与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实验教学达成以下目标：（1） 理解价键理论、电子效应学和酸碱理论等有机化学的基础理论知识，在此基础上掌握有机化合物的结构与物理化学性质之间的关系，分析环境污染物控制过程的关键影响因素，对复杂环境工程问题进行研究；（2）运用有机化学的基本原理，利用各个有机化合物特征反应设计环境污染物控制可行的实验方案，并能设计或搭建实验装置，采用科学的实验方法，安全地开展实验。
default.en: As a subject engaged in preventing environmental pollution and improving environmental quality, the core of environmental science and environmental engineering is the control of environmental pollution. Most environmental pollutants are organic compounds, therefore, organic chemistry is a discipline closely related to environmental science and engineering, playing an important and crucial role in controlling environmental pollution and improving resource utilization feild. Organic chemistry is a subject that studies the composition, structure, properties, synthesis, and related theoretical issues of organic compounds. This course emphasizes both theoretical and practical aspects. This course first systematically introduces the basic theoretical knowledge of organic chemistry, including valence bond theory, electronic effects, and organic chemistry acid-base theory. Based on this basic theory, the different structures of organic compounds and the physical and chemical properties of organic compounds caused by these structures are analyzed. It further introduces the impact of different organic compounds on the environment and how to use organic chemical reactions to treat environmental pollution and improve resource utilization.Based on the characteristics of the environmental engineering major, closely linking with practical problems in the field of environmental engineering, while emphasizing the role of environmental science and engineering case teaching in theoretical learning, the following goals are achieved through classroom teaching and experimental teaching: (1) understanding the basic theoretical knowledge of organic chemistry such as valence bond theory, electron effect theory, and acid-base theory, mastering the relationship between the structure and physicochemical properties of organic compounds, analyzing the key influencing factors of environmental pollutant control process, and researching complex environmental engineering problems; (2) By applying the basic principles of organic chemistry and utilizing the characteristic reactions of various organic compounds, feasible experimental plans for controlling environmental pollutants can be designed or constructed, and scientific experimental methods can be used to conduct experiments safely.

default.zh: 本课程是与《无机与分析化学》配套的课程，是环境类专业的必修课程，课程共24学时，1学分。先修课程为《无机与分析化学》、《仪器分析》、《物理化学》等。本课程密切结合环境科学与工程、环境生态领域的环境分析问题，通过对化学分析、仪器分析的实验方法与技能的讲授和学生的具体实验操作，使学生巩固和加深理解《无机与分析化学》理论课程的教学内容，培养学生掌握环境科学与工程领域环境分析的基本操作方法与技能，使学生能够使用化学分析法和现代分析仪器解决实际的环境分析问题、学会实验数据的分析与处理的能力。
default.en: This course is a supporting course for Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry, and is a required course for environmental majors. The course consists of 24 class hours and 1 credit. The pre-courses are Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry, Instrumental Analysis, Physical Chemistry, etc. This course closely combines environmental analysis problems in the fields of environmental science and engineering and environmental ecology. Through teaching experimental methods and skills of chemical analysis and instrumental analysis and students' specific experimental operations, students can consolidate and deepen their understanding of the teaching content of the theoretical course of Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry. To train students to master the basic operating methods and skills of environmental analysis in the field of environmental science and engineering, so that students can use chemical analysis and modern analytical instruments to solve practical environmental analysis problems, and learn the ability to analyze and process experimental data.

default.zh: 《水力学》是给排水科学与工程类、水利类各专业的一门重要专业基础课，是研究液体平衡和运动规律的一门学科。《水力学》课程的目的是培养学生分析和解决水力学问题的能力，使学生通过学习，掌握液体平衡和运动的一般规律和有关的基本概念及基本理论，学会必要的对于水力学问题的分析和计算的方法，初步掌握水力学实验技术、初步掌握运用计算机基础解决水力学问题的能力，为学生学好后续课程，从事本专业的技术工作、科学研究和管理工作打好必要的水力学基础。
default.en: "Hydraulics" is an important professional basic course for water supply and drainage science and engineering and water conservancy, and is a discipline that studies the balance and motion laws of liquids. The purpose of the course is to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve hydraulic problems, so that students can master the general laws of liquid balance and motion and related basic concepts and basic theories, learn the necessary methods of analysis and calculation of hydraulic problems, preliminarily master the experimental technology of hydraulics, and preliminarily master the ability to use computer foundation to solve hydraulic problems, so as to lay the necessary hydraulic foundation for students to learn follow-up courses and engage in technical work, scientific research and management of their majors.

default.zh: 《水化学实验》是给排水科学与工程专业重要主干课程之一，课程系统地进行实验教学使学生掌握水质分析的基本方法和技能，完成酸碱滴定分析法、络合滴定法、沉淀滴定法、氧化还原滴定法、电化学分析法、分子光谱法、原子光谱法、色谱法等分析方法实验过程，使学生掌握水质分析方法的基本原理和技能。 本课程的主要任务是通过实验教学，使学生掌握水化学分析中四大化学滴定方法和现代主要的仪器分析法的基本原理、基本理论、基本知识、基本概念和基本技能，掌握水化学分析的基本操作，注重培养学生严谨的科学态度，培养独立分析问题和解决实际问题的能力。实验目录如下： 实验1过氧化氢催化分解动力学实验 实验2 活性炭吸附罗丹明B动力学实验 实验3 化学平衡常数测定 实验4 利用电池电动势的测定溶液pH值 实验5 水中碱度额测定 实验6 水中硬度的测定 实验7 水中高锰酸盐指数的测定 实验8水中溶解氧的测定 实验9 水中铁的测定 实验10 液液萃取气相色谱测定水中氯苯 实验11 原子吸收光谱法测定水中铅含量
default.en: is one of the important major course of water supply and drainage science and engineering, the systematic experiment teaching to make students master the basic methods and skills of water quality analysis, completes the acid-base titration, complexation titration, precipitation titration, oxidation-reduction titration, electrochemical analysis, molecular spectroscopy, atomic spectroscopy, chromatography and other analytical methods, to help students master the basic principles and skills of water quality analysis methods. The main task of this course is through experimental teaching, enable students to master the water chemical analysis of four chemical titration method and the basic principle, basic theory, basic concept, basic knowledge and basic skills of modern instrument analysis of the main, rasp the basic operation of hydrochemical analysis, focus on cultivating students' rigorous scientific attitude, and develop the ability to analyze and solve practical problems independently. Content and requirements: Experiment 1: Kinetic experiment of hydrogen peroxide catalytic decomposition Experiment 2 Kinetic experiment on adsorption of Rhodamine B by activated carbon Experiment 3 Determination of chemical equilibrium constants Experiment 4 Determine the pH value of the solution using the electromotive force of the cell Experiment 5 Measurement of alkalinity in water Experiment 6 Determination of hardness in water Experiment 7 Determination of permanganate index in water Experiment 8 Determination of dissolved oxygen in water Experiment 9 Determination of iron in water Experiment 10 Determination of chlorobenzene in water by liquid-liquid extraction and gas chromatography Experiment 11 Determination of lead content in water by atomic absorption spectrometry

default.zh: 《生态环境与城市水系统导论》是生态环境类专业重要的主干课程之一，它是对生态环境相关知识和概念的总体概述，主要目的是强化大学生生态环境保护的责任意识，激发学生热爱环境、保护环境的兴趣。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解我国和世界的生态环境现状，了解环境科学与工程专业类和给排水科学与工程专业类的内涵及发展，以及环境与经济发展之间的关系等内容，宏观上掌握水资源等的污染状况、污染控制措施等基本知识、行业智慧化供给侧的需求和城市水系统工程技术发展状况。通过本课程的学习，使学生能更好的定位自己的学习和工作目标，同时培养学生运用生态环境的基本观点来解决环境问题的能力。
default.en: “Introduction to Ecological Environment and Urban Water System” is one of the main courses for eco-environment majors. It is a general overview of the related knowledge and concepts of eco-environment, the main goal is to strengthen the college students' sense of responsibility for environmental protection, to stimulate students' interest in loving and protecting the environment. Through this course, students will be able to understand the current state of the ecological environment in our country and the world, as well as the connotation and development of environmental science and engineering and water supply and drainage science and engineering, and the relationship between the environment and economic development, master the basic knowledge of water pollution, pollution control measures, demand of intelligent supply side and development of urban water system engineering technology. Through the study of this course, students can better position their study and work goals, and develop students' ability to solve environmental problems with the basic view of ecological environment.

default.zh: 《数字生态与可持续发展》是生态环境类专业重要的主干课程之一，它是对生态环境保护与可持续发展相关知识和概念的总体概述。课程以生态文明思想为指导，以美丽中国建设为牵引，课程面向校内外有志于投身生态文明建设与绿色发展的大一本科生，讲授内容涵盖污废水、饮用水、土壤、大气、固废、环境健康、数字生态、资源循环、环境系统、环境政策等生态文明要素。主要目的是强化大学生生态环境保护的责任意识，激发学生热爱环境、保护环境的兴趣。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解我国和世界的生态环境现状，了解环境科学与工程专业类和给排水科学与工程专业类的内涵及发展，以及环境与经济发展之间的关系等内容，宏观上掌握水资源等的污染状况、污染控制措施等基本知识、行业智慧化供给侧的需求和城市水系统工程技术发展状况。通过本课程的学习，使学生能更好的定位自己的学习和工作目标，同时培养学生运用生态环境的基本观点来解决复杂环境问题的能力。
default.en: “Introduction to Digital Ecology and Sustainable Development” is one of the main courses for eco-environment majors. The course is guided by the concept of ecological civilization and is driven by the construction of a beautiful China. It is targeted at first-year undergraduate students from both inside and outside the university who are willing to engage in ecological civilization construction and green development. The course content covers elements of ecological civilization such as wastewater and drinking water, soil, air, solid waste, environmental health, digital ecology, resource recycling, environmental systems, and environmental policies. The main purpose is to enhance the students' sense of responsibility for environmental protection and stimulate their interest in loving and protecting the environment. Through this course, students will be able to understand the current state of the ecological environment in our country and the world, as well as the connotation and development of environmental science and engineering and water supply and drainage science and engineering, and the relationship between the environment and economic development, master the basic knowledge of water pollution, pollution control measures, demand of intelligent supply side and development of urban water system engineering technology. Through the study of this course, students can better position their study and work goals, and develop students' ability to solve environmental problems with the basic view of ecological environment.

default.zh: 《物质基础与化学分析》课程聚焦未来城市书院人才培养需求和专业集群特征，融合无机结构化学基础、物理化学基础、和分析化学中的化学分析部分，是该集群第一门化学基础课。本课程深入浅出地教授化学学科的基础理论，如物质存在的形态，物质结构、热力学、四大平衡以及基于相关平衡构建的化学分析基础知识，为后继课程和化学实验打下理论基础。 通过本课程的学习，使学生获得关于物质结构的基础理论、化学反应的基本原理、四大平衡、酸碱理论及化学反应速率等方面的基础化学知识，培养学生具有分析处理一般化学问题的初步能力；培养学生分析问题、解决问题的能力，逐渐完成从中学到大学在学习方法上的过渡，使学生在听课、查阅参考书、自学等方面有提升。课程的主要目标要求如下： （1）全面理解未来城市物质循环过程中的无机及分析化学理论基础知识； （2）重点掌握未来城市能量转化过程中的热力学、物质结构基础等理论基础知识； （3）熟悉化学反应基本原理，熟悉不同反应场景下的反应速率； （4）掌握基础的实验方法及测试手段。
default.en: The "Material Basis and Chemical Analysis" course focuses on the talent cultivation needs of the Future City Academy and the characteristics of the professional cluster. It integrates the basic concepts of inorganic structural chemistry, physical chemistry, and the chemical analysis part of analytical chemistry. This is the first chemical foundation course of this cluster. This course teaches the basic theories of the chemical discipline in an easy-to-understand manner, such as the forms of matter existence, the structure of matter, thermodynamics, the four major equilibria, and the basic chemical analysis knowledge based on related equilibria. It lays a theoretical foundation for subsequent courses and chemical experiments. Through the study of this course, students will acquire basic chemical knowledge about the basic theories of matter structure, the basic principles of chemical reactions, the four major equilibria, acid-base theory, and the rate of chemical reactions, and develop the initial ability to analyze and handle general chemical problems. They will also cultivate the ability to analyze and solve problems, gradually completing the transition in learning methods from middle school to university, and improving their performance in attending lectures, consulting reference books, and self-study. The main goals of this course are as follows: (1) Comprehensively understand the basic theoretical knowledge of inorganic and analytical chemistry in the future city's material circulation process; (2) Focus on mastering the basic theoretical knowledge of thermodynamics, the foundation of matter structure, and other theoretical knowledge in the future city's energy conversion process; (3) Be familiar with the basic principles of chemical reactions and the reaction rates in different reaction scenarios; (4) Master basic experimental methods and testing means.

default.zh: 本课程为专业基础课，属于环境科学专业和环境工程专业的必修课程。环境仪器分析是环境科学与分析化学互相渗透而产生的一门新的学科，是从事环境科学与环境保护工作所必须掌握的一门基础性学科，也是了解环境状况并对环境质量做出正确评价的方法和手段。本课程既注重基本理论、基础知识的介绍，又密切结合环境科学与环境工程领域的应用情况。
default.en: This course is a fundamental course for the environmental science and environmental engineering majors. Environmental instrumental analysis is a new interdisciplinary field that integrates environmental science and analytical chemistry. It is a foundational discipline that professionals in environmental science and environmental protection must master. It provides methods and techniques for understanding the environmental conditions and making accurate evaluations of environmental quality. This course emphasizes the introduction of basic theories and fundamental knowledge, and also closely integrates with the practical applications in the field of environmental science and environmental engineering.

default.zh: 当代水文与水文地质学在给排水工程中应用广泛。《水文学和水文地质学》是给排水科学与工程相关专业的一门必修专业基础课，由《水文学》和《供水水文地质》两部门组成，《水文学》侧重于地表水，《供水水文地质》侧重于地下水。根据专业培养目标和培养方案，《水文学》系统地介绍了河川及其径流、水文统计基本理论、年径流及洪枯径流、降水资料的收集和整理、暴雨强度公式计算、小流域暴雨洪峰流量计算、城市降雨径流等内容；《供水水文地质》介绍了地质基本知识、地下水储存和循环、地下水物理化学性质、地下水运动特征的基本理论、不同地貌区地下水分布特征及供水水文地质勘察等内容。本课程的主要特点是理论性、逻辑性强，水文分析与地下水运动计算的内容复杂而且广泛，与给排水工程关系密切，是给排水科学与工程相关专业的重要基础课程之一。
default.en: Contemporary hydrology and hydrogeology are widely used in water supply and drainage engineering. "Hydrology and Hydrogeology" is a compulsory basic professional course for majors related to water supply and drainage science and engineering, consisting of two parts, "Hydrology" and "Water Supply Hydrogeology". "Hydrology" focuses on surface water, while "Water Supply Hydrogeology" focuses on groundwater. According to the professional training objectives and programs, "Hydrology" systematically introduces rivers and their runoff, basic theories of hydrological statistics, annual runoff, high and low runoff, collection and sorting of precipitation data, calculation of rainfall intensity formula, calculation of storm peak flow in small watersheds, urban rainfall runoff, etc. "Water Supply Hydrogeology" introduces basic geological knowledge, groundwater storage and circulation, physical and chemical properties of groundwater, basic theories of groundwater movement characteristics, distribution characteristics of groundwater in different landform areas, hydrogeological survey of water supply, etc. The main feature of this course is its strong theoretical and logical nature. The content of hydrological analysis and groundwater movement calculation is complex and extensive, and is closely related to water supply and drainage engineering. It is one of the important basic courses for majors related to water supply and drainage science and engineering.

default.zh: 1． 通过教学，使学生了解和掌握工程伦理相关的基本概念，对工程、伦理以及工程实践中的伦理问题有整体性认识，给出解决工程实践中的伦理问题的基本思路。 2． 通过教学，使学生了解和掌握工程伦理中有关价值、利益分配及公正的基本概念。 使学生了解工程的巨大正面价值，认识工程负面价值的产生机理，坚定从事工程职业的决心和信心。 3． 使学生对工程实践中的利益分配等公正问题有比较深刻的认识和比较强的敏感性，使学生了解有关公正的基本原则，以及在工程中实现公正的基本机制和途径。 4． 系统阐述作为工程师的伦理规范与伦理责任。结合案例分析和讨论，从价值与伦理层面分析工程伦理学思想在现实社会中的应用。
default.en: 1. The introduction of the general understanding of the engineering ethics, the basic content, and provide basic ideas for solving ethical problems in engineering practice. 2.The introduction of the basic concepts of engineering ethics concerning value, profit distribution and fairness. Enable students to understand the great positive value of the project, understand the mechanism of the negative value of the project, and firmly establish their determination and confidence in the engineering profession. 3.Enable students to have a relatively deep understanding and comparatively high sensitivity to such fair issues as the distribution of benefits in engineering practice so that students can understand the basic principles of fairness and the basic mechanisms and approaches for achieving fairness in the project. 4.Systematically explain the ethical norms and ethical responsibilities as engineers. Combined with case analysis and discussion, this paper analyzes the application of engineering ethics in real society from the aspects of value and ethics.

default.zh: 环境工程原理是高等院校环境工程专业的一门重要专业基础课。该课程从理论上系统深入的阐述了水处理工程、大气污染控制工程、固体废物处理与处置工程、物理性污染控制工程及生态修复工程等所涉及的技术原理，提炼出具有共性的基本原理、现象和过程，提出解决问题的思路和方法，是后续专业课程学习的理论基础，体现了环境科学与工程专业的特色。主要内容包括环境工程原理基础、分离过程原理和化学与生物反应工程原理三大部分。环境工程原理基础部分主要讲述单位与量纲分析、物料与能量守恒原理、热量传递、质量传递等；分离过程原理主要讲述吸收、吸附、过滤、蒸发与结晶、离子交换、萃取、膜分离等；化学与生物反应工程原理部分主要讲述化学与生物反应计量学、动力学、环境工程中常用的各类反应器等。此外，本课程还包括五个实验，即板框过滤实验、流化床干燥实验、传热实验、吸附、吸收等。通过课程学习，培养学生运用基本科学理论分析环境工艺过程的能力，使学生能独立设计研究方案，搭建试验装置，并采用科学的研究方法完成试验，同时具备运用现代化的分析检测设备进行环境工程原理试验过程分析的能力。
default.en: Principles of Environmental Engineering is an important specialized core course for Environmental engineering in colleges and universities. This course systematically elaborates the basic technical principles in Water treatment engineering, Air pollution control engineering, Solid waste treatment and disposal engineering, Physical pollution control engineering, Ecological recovery project. It also extracts the common basic principles, phenomena and processes, and proposes the problem-solving methods. This course is also the theoretical basis of the following courses and reflects the special features. The main contents include Foundation of environmental engineering principles, Separation process principles, Chemical and biological reaction engineering Principles. The first part mainly contains Unit and dimensional analysis, conservation principles of material and energy, heat transfer and mass transfer, etc. The second part contains absorption, adsorption, filtration, evaporation and crystal, ionic-exchange, extraction, membrane separation, etc. The third part mainly contains stoichiometry and kinetics of chemical and biological reaction, reactors normally used in environmental engineering. Moreover, it also includes three experiments, such as plate frame filter experiment, fluidized-bed drying experiment and heat transfer experiment. By learning this course, the students can obtain the ability of analyzing the environmental process with basic scientific theory, design the research plan independently, construct the experimental devices and finish the experiments with scientific research methods. The students can also have the ability of analyzing the experimental process with the modern analytical testing equipment.

default.zh: 环境化学是环境工程专业进行环境专业理论学习的必要基础课程。本课程与我院环境专业关系密切。是环境专业选课的必备课程。通过本课程的学习，培养和强化学生的环境意识，使他们掌握环境知识，以便将来在各自的工作岗位上决策时能与环境保护统一协调，能正确分析处理发展与环境的矛盾，具备处理实际环境问题的能力，掌握解决环境问题的知识。
default.en: Environmental chemistry is the specialized fundamental course for environmental engineering major to carry out environmental professional theory study. This course is closely related to our environmental professional. Through study this course to cultivate and strengthen students environmental awareness, make them master environmental knowledge. So that in the future work, they can unified and coordinated environmental protection in the decision-making. they also can correctly analyze the contradictions between development and environmental. Students can get the ability to solve actual environmental problems and grasp the knowledge for environmental problems.

default.zh: 环境监测是环境科学和环境工程本科专业的主干课，主要分为大气、水体、土壤/固废和生物（动物、植物）中环境化指标的监测，噪声等物理指标监测，生态环境的生物监测等，包括监测方案的制定、样品现场采样、样品保存/运输、实验室预处理与分析检测、数据分析和环境质量评价等技术环节，以及环境大气和河流水质自动监测系统的网络构建、自动分析技术和仪器原理及系统运行等专业理论与技术。
default.en: Environmental monitoring is a core component of undergraduate programs in Environmental Science and Environmental Engineering. It encompasses the surveillance of environmental indicators in the atmosphere, water bodies, soil/solid waste, and organisms (animals, plants), as well as the monitoring of physical parameters like noise levels and biological assessments of the ecological environment. Tasks include formulating monitoring strategies, conducting field sampling, preserving and transporting samples, performing laboratory analyses, interpreting data, and assessing environmental quality. Additionally, students delve into professional concepts and technologies such as network establishment, automated analysis techniques, instrument principles, and the operational mechanics of environmental atmosphere and river water quality monitoring systems.

default.zh: 流体力学是环境科学与工程专业的一门专业基础课，旨在利用流体力学的基础理论和方法解决环境过程中涉及到流体力学的问题。本课程针对环境科学与工程专业的特点，紧密联系环境科学与工程学科中与流体力学相关的实际问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境科学与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实验教学达成以下目标。 1. 使学生能够理解流体力学的基本概念、原理和方法，通过学习流体的基本概念、流体静力学、流体运动学和动力学、流动阻力和水头损失、量纲分析与相似原理等基础理论掌握流体力学的基本特点和方法，在此基础上学习有压管道流动、明渠流动、堰流、渗流等过程的水力学计算方法，使学生获得分析和解决流体力学问题的能力。 2. 掌握流体力学研究的实验方法，获得实验设计和实验技能的基本训练； 3. 能够基于流体力学的科学原理并采用科学方法对复杂环境工程问题进行研究，分析实验结果并得到合理有效的结论。 4. 通过该课程的学习，使学生在环境学科相关的科研及工作中具备提出问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，为学生继续学习环境专业其他专业课如城镇给排水管网系统、水污染控制工程等打下必要的流体力学理论基础。
default.en: Fluid Mechanics is a foundational course for the Environmental Science and Engineering major, aimed at applying the basic theories and methods of fluid mechanics to address issues related to fluid mechanics in environmental processes. This course is tailored to the characteristics of the Environmental Science and Engineering major, closely linking real-world problems related to fluid mechanics within the discipline. It emphasizes the role of practical case teaching in environmental science and engineering alongside theoretical learning. The course achieves the following objectives through classroom and laboratory teaching: Enable students to understand the basic concepts, principles, and methods of fluid mechanics. Through learning the fundamental theories such as basic fluid concepts, fluid statics, fluid kinematics and dynamics, flow resistance and head loss, dimensional analysis, and similarity principles, students will grasp the basic characteristics and methods of fluid mechanics. Based on these, they will learn the hydraulic calculation methods for processes like pressurized pipeline flow, open channel flow, weir flow, and seepage, gaining the ability to analyze and solve problems in fluid mechanics. Master the experimental methods of fluid mechanics research and acquire basic training in experimental design and skills. Be capable of conducting research on complex environmental engineering problems based on the scientific principles of fluid mechanics and using scientific methods, analyzing experimental results, and deriving reasonable and effective conclusions. Through the study of this course, students will develop the ability to pose, analyze, and solve problems in the field of environmental science, providing them with the necessary theoretical foundation in fluid mechanics for further studies in other specialized courses such as urban water supply and drainage network systems, and water pollution control engineering.

default.zh: 本课程讲述给水排水构筑物和管道工程的施工技术，质量标准及验收方法；所用材料及管材的性能、规格及检验;基本建设的程序、概(预）算的作用和施工组织设计的编制方法等。在课堂教学阶段,通过对给排水构筑物及管道的施工方法等内容的讲述,使学生对施工方案及方法进行正确的选择和制定；对施工中的重点、难点有初步了解 ；在施工中所需材料能进行选择和检验以及组织“单位工程”施工的质量关键与安全施工诸方面建立基础知识.
default.en: 《Foundation of Water Project Construction》is a basic course for the major of Water Supply and Drainage Engineering. This course introduces briefly the architecture knowledge and the recent developments about the constructure technology, and demonstrates the basic design principles and methods for the industrial and municipal buildings, and illustrates the basic knowledges about the city planning and pipeline engineering. The main contents in this course are listed as followed: recognising the constructure drawings of buildings; municipal building design; contructure of the municipal buildings; industrial building design; bearing constructure of a single floor workshop; brief introduction of a industrilizaition building; structural material.

default.zh: 水工程技术经济是给水排水工程专业课之一，通过本课程的学习使学生熟悉和掌握概预算和技术经济的基本知识，掌握概预算的编制、方案技术经济分析比较的方法。课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1. 掌握水系统工程概预算和技术经济的基本知识，了解经济评价体系对水工程建设的指导意义；（支撑毕业要求3） 课程目标2. 熟悉复杂水工程项目方案选择依据，了解技术经济评价、国民经济评价及社会经济评价方法；（支撑毕业要求6） 课程目标3. 从工程经济角度建立水系统工程对环境、社会可持续发展的影响，具备对常见工程问题进行研究分析的能力；（支撑毕业要求7） 课程目标4. 掌握概预算的编制，理解并掌握工程管理原理与经济决策方法。（支撑毕业要求11）
default.en: Economy of Water Engineering is one of the major courses of water supply and drainage engineering. Through the study of this course, students will be familiar with and master the basic knowledge of budget estimates and technical economy, master the preparation of budget estimates and the methods of technical and economic analysis and comparison of schemes. The requirements of the course objectives for students’ abilities are as follows: Course objectives 1. Master the basic knowledge of water system engineering budget and technical economy, and understand the guiding significance of the economic evaluation system to water engineering construction; (support graduation requirement 3) Course objective 2. Familiar with the selection basis of complex water engineering projects, understand the technical and economic evaluation, national economic evaluation and socio-economic evaluation methods; (support graduation requirement 6) Course objective 3. Establish the impact of water system engineering on the environment and the sustainable development of society from the perspective of engineering economy, and have the ability to research and analyze common engineering problems; (support graduation requirement 7) Course objective 4. Master the preparation of budget estimates, understand and master engineering management principles and economic decision-making methods. (Support graduation requirement 11)

default.zh: 水处理生物学课程是高等学校给排水科学与工程专业指导委员会提出的新课程体系中10门主干课程之一，是给排水科学与工程专业本科生的必修课程。该课程适用于给排水科学与工程以及环境工程和环境科学专业大学生，也可供给排水和环境污染控制领域的科研工作者、技术人员以及研究生参考。近年来随着水处理和环境水体水质净化技术的不断发展，水生生物和水生/湿生生物在水处理自然水体水质净化与污染控制以及水生生态修复工程中的应用越来越受到关注。为适应水质净化技术的新发展，在原“水处理微生物学”课程基础上发展为“水处理生物学”。水处理生物学主要研究水处理工程和环境水体水质净化过程（即水中污染物的迁移、分解与转化过程）中所涉及的生物学问题，特别是微生物问题，是一门由普通生物学、普通微生物学、环境微生物学和水质工程学相结合，为了满足水处理和环境水体水质净化工程的需要而发展起来的一门边缘性学科。水处理生物学在学科体系上属于应用（微）生物学的范畴，在研究对象和内容上与环境微生物学有一定交叉。 具体指标如下： （1）知识：该课程旨在通过学习使学生掌握与水处理相关的（微）生物学基本知识，掌握微生物、水生植物、水生动物等在水体净化和水处理中的作用机理和规律，学习水中微生物学的检测方法等。（2）能力：在有机化学、生物化学理论基础知识的基础上，能运用所学知识分析污水水质，并用生物理论提出粗略的处理意见。（3）素质：通过学习掌握本课程的基本理论、基础知识并具备独立设计、实施相关实验的基本能力，为后续课学习打下基础。同时要了解本领域最新发展动态，增强适应能力，自觉地把本课程发展与相关专业发展联系起来。
default.en: The course of " Biology of Water Treatment " is one of the 10 main courses in the new curriculum system proposed by the Steering Committee of Water Supply and Drainage Science and Engineering. It is a compulsory course for drainage science and engineering. In recent years, with the continuous development of water treatment and environmental water quality purification technology, the application of aquatic organisms and aquatic / wet organisms in water purification and pollution control and aquatic ecological restoration projects has been paid more and more attention. In order to adapt to the new development of water purification technology, in the original "water treatment microbiology" courses based on the development of water treatment biology. Biology of Water Treatment mainly studies the biological problems involved in the process of water treatment and environmental water purification (ie, the migration, decomposition and transformation of pollutants in water), especially the microbial problem, which is a common biology, Microbiology, environmental microbiology and water quality engineering, in order to meet the water treatment and environmental water quality purification project needs to develop a marginal discipline. Water treatment biology in the discipline system belongs to the application (micro) biology category, in the research object and the content and environmental microbiology have a certain cross. This course aims to help students master the shape, structure and function of microbes, nutrition, respiration, material metabolism, growth and reproduction, genetic and variation of microbes and the role of microorganisms in the purification of environmental engineering such as water treatment and remediation of contaminated soil. On the basis of the basic knowledge of organic chemistry and biochemistry theory, we can use the knowledge to analyze the quality of sewage, and put forward the rough processing opinions with microbial theory. Through the study of the basic theory of this course, basic knowledge and have an independent design, the implementation of the basic ability of the relevant experiments, lay the foundation for the follow-up study. At the same time to understand the latest developments in the field, enhance the ability to adapt, and consciously put the curriculum development and related professional development linked.

"Water Analytical Chemistry" is one of the important main courses for water supply and drainage science and engineering majors. The course systematically teaches the principle and scope of application of analytical methods such as chemical properties and tasks of water analysis, acid-base titration, complexation titration, precipitation titration, REDOX titration, electrochemical analysis, molecular spectrometry, atomic spectrometry, chromatography and mass spectrometry. Enable students to master the analysis method of water quality index.

default.zh: 物理化学是化学的理论基础课程之一，是用物理的原理和方法来研究化学中的最基本的规律和理论。本课程针对环境科学与工程专业的特点，紧密联系环境科学与工程学科中的实际问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境科学与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实验教学使学生能够将物理化学中关于热力学、相平衡、电化学、表面化学、化学动力学及胶体化学等方面的基本科学理论用于环境工艺过程分析；通过物理化学基础知识讲授、案例教学及实验教学等环节，使学生能够运用现代信息技术获取环境科学与工程领域中物理化学相关信息及知识，能够使用现代化的分析检测设备，应用计算机进行数据处理，预测和模拟环境中的物理化学问题，并理解其局限性；通过该课程的学习，使学生在环境学科相关的科研及工作中具备提出问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，为学生继续学习环境专业其他专业课打下必要的物理化学理论基础。
default.en: Physical chemistry is one of the basic theoretical courses of chemistry, which principle and method of physics is used to study the most basic laws and theories of chemistry. This course pays attention to the role of environmental science and engineering practical teaching during the theoretical study. It is closely linked to the practical problems in environmental science and engineering and the characteristics of environmental science and engineering is focused. Through the classroom teaching and experimental teaching to enable students to use the thermodynamics, phase balance, electrochemistry, surface chemistry, chemical kinetics, colloid chemistry and other aspects of the basic scientific theory in physical chemistry into environmental process analysis; Through the physical chemistry basic knowledge, case, experimental and other aspects teaching to enable students to obtain physical and chemical information and knowledge in the field of environmental science and engineering using modern information technology, in addition, enable students to forecast and simulate the physical and chemical problems in the environment and understand its limitations using modern analysis, testing equipment and computer data processing; Through the study of the course enable students to have the ability of asking questions, analyzing and solving problem in the scientific research and work related to environmental science, hoping to lay the necessary theoretical basis of physical chemistry for students to continue to study the environment professional and other professional courses.

default.zh: 生态学是一门新兴的综合性很强的专业课，从微观到宏观渗透到不同学科领域，甚至发展为一种思想。因此本课程在介绍生态学基本理论的同时，注重培养学生的生态意识观念，同时注重生态工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实验教学达成以下目标： 1. 使学生能够将生态学中关于生态因子效应、种群增长及调节、群落演替动态及生态系统物、能流过程等方面的基本科学理论应用于解决日益复杂的生态环境问题； 2.通过该课程的课堂讲授与实验教学环节，使学生建立起生态文明的意识观念，掌握相关学科的发展现状与趋势，能够科学评价生态系统的复杂性以及生态工程实践对社会可持续发展的影响。
default.en: Ecology is an interdisciplinary discipline and also a new branch of science. The scope of ecology encompasses a broad spectrum of fields from individuals to ecosystem. This course will introduce the concepts, research methods, latest development and applications in ecology. We will develop the students' ability to analyze and solve environmental problems by using ecological theories we taught in the class. 1. This course provides a systematic framework of ecology concepts including ecological factors，regulation of population growth，dynamics of community succession, and nutrient cycling & energy flow process in the eco-system. And, the ability of students for solving environmental problems is training in the process of theory learning, 2. Through the lecture and experiment in class, environmental consciousness will be established, and the development of relative study will be grasped by students. They will be able to evaluate the complication of eco-system and the effects of ecological engineering to social sustainable development in practice.

default.zh: 本课程为城市水系统工程专业的导论课，它是对城市水系统相关知识和概念的总体概述，使新生对城市水系统工程专业内涵有初步的了解，提升学生对所学专业知识背景的认知度，引导学生深入理解所学专业对社会发展和国民经济建设的重要作用与贡献，从而能更好的激发学生的学习热情与兴趣。课程目标为： 城市水系统是在一定地域空间内,以城市水资源为主体，以水资源的开发利用和保护为过程,并与自然和社会环境密切相关,且随时空变化的动态系统。该系统不仅包含了相关的自然因素,也融人了社会、经济甚至政治等因素。通过介绍城市水系统工程专业的内涵和外延和城市水系统的特性、环节及可持续管理等，提高学生对专业学科发展历史、现状和未来发展趋势的认知。
default.en: This course is an introduction to the major of urban water system engineering. It is a general overview of the related knowledge and concepts of urban water system, to raise students' awareness of the background of their major knowledge, and to guide students to understand the important role and contribution of their major to social development and national economic construction, thus can better stimulate the student's study enthusiasm and the interest. The aim of the course is: the urban water system is in a certain regional space, taking the urban water resources as the main body, taking the development and protection of the water resources as the process, and is closely related to the natural and social environment, and space-time dynamical system. The system contains not only the relevant natural factors, but also social, economic and even political factors. This paper introduces the connotation and extension of urban water system engineering and the characteristics, links and sustainable management of urban water system, so as to improve students' cognition of the history, Present Situation and future development trend of the subject.

default.zh: 环境系统分析基础是利用系统分析方法来寻求解决环境质量与经济发展之间矛盾的途径，是系统分析在环境保护中的应用。它由三大部分内容组成：环境质量模型、环境系统模型、环境污染控制系统规划。其中，环境系统模型部分包括：河流水质模型、湖库水质模型、大气质量模型；环境系统规划部分包括：水污染控制系统规划、大气污染控制系统规划。课程同时训练学生利用计算机完成相关系统分析技能的演习，主要包括：模型参数的估计、预测模型的求解和规划模型的求解；编程语言使用OCtave/Python/Julia等编程计算语言,重点掌握其绘图功能、矩阵运算、符号计算、无条件极值的求解和有条件极值的求解等。
default.en: Environmental System Analysis teaches the way of solving contradictions between environmental quality and economic development by using system analysis. It consists of three main parts: environmental quality model, environmental system model, and environmental pollution control system programming. Among them, the environmental system model includes: river water quality model, lake and reservoir water quality model, and atmospheric quality model; The environmental system programming section includes: water pollution control system programming, and air pollution control system programming. This course also offers training for students to practise system analysis techniques on a computer, mainly including the distinguishing of estimation of model parameters, calculation of prediction models and solution seeking of programming models. OCtave/Python/Julia are the programming language applied, and students are required to grasp their functions as plotting, matrix calculation, symbolic calculation, solution seeking of extremum without restriction and solution seeking of extremum with restriction.

default.zh: 《污染控制微生物学》是环境科学与工程等专业的必修专业基础课。课程以自然环境和人工控制系统中微生物的形态结构、生理特征、新陈代谢、生长繁殖、遗传变异及生态学等知识的学习为基础，进一步学习污染控制和生态修复的微生物学原理，使学生对环境污染防治的微生物学原理及工程技术有全面和深入的了解和认识，能够：（1）利用环境污染治理的微生物学原理识别和表达污（废）水生物处理、废气生物处理、固体垃圾处理以及土壤生态修复等复杂工程问题，并获得有效结论；（2）理解环境微生物学的一般实验方法，针对环境工程问题具有设计和实施实验的能力；（3）具备利用污染控制微生物原理和实验方法解决复杂环境工程问题的能力，为今后从事环境科学与工程的实践、研究和管理等工作奠定基础。
default.en: Pollution Control Microbiology is a fundamental and compulsory course for students who major in environmental science-related specialties. Morphology, physiological characteristics, metabolism, growth and reproduction, genetic variation and ecology of microorganisms in natural and controlled environments are introduced and discussed as the basic knowledge in the course. To have a better comprehensive and in-depth understanding of microbiology theory and engineering technology for preventing environmental pollution, microbiology principles of pollution control and ecological restoration are further instructed. Purpose of this course is to enable students to 1) identify and express complex problems in biological treatment of wastewater, exhaust gas and solid waste, as well as ecological restoration, to obtain the effective conclusions in view of the principles of microbiology for environmental pollution control; 2) understand the general experimental methods of environmental microbiology, and have the ability to design and implement experiments for resolving environmental engineering problems; 3) have the ability to solve complex engineering problems using the principles and experimental methods in Pollution Control Microbiology, laying the foundation for future practice, research and management in environmental science and engineering.

default.zh: 本课程为市政工程系给排水科学与工程专业、城市水系统专业的重要课程之一。该课程主要介绍水工程设备的基本原理（如水泵、搅拌设备、曝气设备、分离设备、投药设备），以及给水泵站、污水泵站、雨水泵站的设计计算等。 本课程的主要特点是理论与工程实践联系密切。通过该课程的学习，可使学生能够系统地掌握与水工程设备的基本原理、设计、运行管理等有关的基础知识，了解常用水工程设备的基本结构、工作原理和工艺性能，使学生初步具备水工艺设备开发、设计、选型和运行管理的素质与能力，为后续专业课程的学习奠定基础。
default.en: This course is one of the important courses of the Department of Municipal Engineering, majoring in water supply and drainage science and engineering, and majoring in urban water system. This course mainly introduces the basic principles of water engineering equipment (such as water pumps, mixing equipment, aeration equipment, separation equipment, and dosing equipment), as well as the design and calculation of water supply pumping stations, sewage pumping stations, and rainwater pumping stations. The main feature of this course is the close connection between theory and engineering practice. Through the study of this course, students can systematically master the basic knowledge related to the basic principles, design, operation and management of water engineering equipment, understand the basic structure, working principle and process performance of commonly used water engineering equipment, so that students can initially have the quality and ability of water process equipment development, design, selection and operation management, and lay the foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses.

default.zh: 本课程为市政工程系给水排水工程专业的必修专业基础课。本课程从城市水系统工艺技术的角度来讲授相关的自动化仪器仪表设备、常用控制技术与方法。内容包括：自动控制基础知识，水工艺自动化常用仪表与设备，水泵及管道系统的控制调节，给水处理系统控制技术，污水处理系统的专用检测仪表与检测技术，污水处理系统的控制技术等。课程的目的是使本专业学生通过学习，能够了解有关水工艺仪器仪表的基本原理、特点与应用技术，水工艺控制技术概况，以及本专业各个工艺环节需要监测与控制的内容、能够采取的技术方法、国内外发展趋势，从而为他们今后从事相关的工作或进一步学习奠定基础。
default.en: The course, Basis of Water Process Control, is a compulsory basic course for the major of Water supply and Drainage in the department of Municipal Engineering. This course teach the automatization instruments and the commonly control technology base on urban water system treatment process technics. The content include basic knowledge about the autocontrol, automatization instruments of water technics, control and adjust of water pump and ductwork, control technology about the feedwater treatment, special sensing meter and technology, control technology about the sewage treatment. The purpose is to make students understand the basic principle, the characteristic and the applied technology about water technics instruments, know the general situation of water technics control and know what to monitor and to control , what technique can take, and keep abreast of current development at home and abroad, thus establish foundation for their work and further study in future.

default.zh: 《水系统模拟与仿真基础》是给水排水专业本科生的专业课。这是一门结合了计算机应用基础理论和给排水专业知识的课程，具有很强的实践性和综合性。该课程的主要内容包括给排水工程建模的数学基础（包括线性方程组求解、插值法及曲线拟合等）、给水管网、排水管网、雨水管网计算建模的理论与程序编写、MATLAB程序设计初步、给排水计算机应用的最新进展等技术理论及方法。学生通过本课程的课堂学习和上机实操，了解计算机技术在给排水专业领域的应用，熟练掌握已有的给排水专业软件的操作方法，练习自主编写或改写的程序，应用软件解决毕业设计和实践中的具体工程问题。 本课程的主要目的是通过本课程的学习使学生初步掌握给排水专业应用程序设计的基本理论、基本步骤、基本方法以及上机操作的基本知识与技能，以便使学生能在毕业设计（论文）中使用计算机，使学生初步具备专业应用程序设计的能力，切实提高在专业工作中应用计算机的实际能力，以适应今后的工作。
default.en: The course "Fundamentals of Water System Simulation and Simulation" is a professional optional course for ndergraduates majoring in Water Supply and Drainage Engineering. The course combines the basic theory of computer application with the professional knowledge of Water Supply and Drainage Engineering. It has a strong practicality and comprehend ability. The main content of this course include water supply and drainage engineering modeling mathematical basis (including linear equations solving, interpolation and curve fitting, etc.), water supply pipe network, drainage pipes, rainwater pipe network computing model of preliminary theory and programming, MATLAB programming, water supply and drainage of the progress of the computer application technology such as theory and method. Through classroom learning and actual computer operation of this course, students can understand the application of computer technology in the field of Water Supply and Drainage Engineering, master the operation methods of existing water supply and drainage professional software, practice the self-written or rewritten program, and use the software to solve the specific engineering problems in graduation design and practice. The main purpose of this course is to make students master the basic theory of water supply and drainage professional application design, basic steps, basic methods and computer basic knowledge and skills of operation, so that students can use a computer in the graduation design (paper), causes the student to the basic capability of professional application design, application of computer in professional work and improve the practical ability, to adapt to the work in the future.

default.zh: “水污染控制工程”被教指委列为环境工程专业核心课程之一。该课程在介绍污水的性质、来源、水质标准的基础上，重点讲授污水物理、化学及生物处理工艺的基本概念、工程设计和运行管理的基础理论和方法；将污水水质指标、污水处理理论、原理和工艺技术设计计算紧密结合，并对常见的处理工艺进行系统化介绍，使学生对不同水质的水处理理论及方法有全面整体的认识。
default.en: "Water Pollution Control " has been listed as one of the core courses in the Environmental Engineering major by the Education Commission. On the basis of introducing the properties, sources, and water quality standards of sewage, this course focuses on teaching the basic concepts of sewage physics, chemistry, and biological treatment processes, as well as the basic theories and methods of engineering design and operation management; Integrate sewage quality indicators, sewage treatment theories, principles, and process technology design calculations closely, and systematically introduce common treatment processes, so that students have a comprehensive understanding of water treatment theories and methods with different water qualities.

default.zh: 工业废水的无组织排放是导致水环境污染的主要原因，若得不到有效处理，将影响到国民经济可持续发展、自然资源持续保存和永续利用。为了保障人民身心健康、社会和经济可持续发展以及子孙后代可持续生存，必须严格控制工业废水污染。水污染控制工程2课程主要针对的是工业废水的处理与处理后水的回用，内容包括工业废水的来源、特征、危害与控制途径，工业废水的物理处理法（调节、离心分离、除油、过滤）、化学处理法（中和、化学沉淀、氧化还原）、物理化学处理法（混凝、气浮、吸附、离子交换、膜分离）以及生物处理法（可生化性、好氧处理、厌氧处理、复合生物处理工艺）等，对可用于废水深度处理与回用的单元工艺及应用也分别地做全面阐述。通过对工业废水处理与回用的基本概念、原理、工艺、应用等的讲授，使学生能够针对工业废水的水质状况与处理后水的回用目标，选择确定适宜的处理工艺（流程），设计相应的处理构筑物。
default.en: The uncontrolled discharge of industrial wastewater is the main cause of water environment pollution. If industrial wastewater is not properly treated, if will affect the sustainable development of national economy, sustainable conservation and use of natural resources. In order to ensure the people's physical and mental health, sustainable development of society and economy, and the sustainable survival of future generations, the industrial wastewater pollution must be strictly prevented. The course of Water Pollution Control Engineering 2 is mainly directed for industrial wastewater treatment and water reuse after processing, with the contents including industrial wastewater source, characteristics, harm and control ways, physical treatment processes (equalization, centrifugal separation, oil removal and filtration), chemical treatment processes (neutralization, chemical precipitation, oxidation and reduction), physical and chemical treatment processes (coagulation, air flotation, adsorption, ion exchange, membrane separation), and biological treatment processes (biodegradability, aerobic treatment, anaerobic treatment, hybrid treatment) etc. The unit operation and process for wastewater treatment and reuse and application are also separately introduced. Based on the teaching of basic concept, principle, processes and application of industrial wastewater treatment and reuse, the students can finally choose the suitable treatment processes and design the corresponding structures based on the water quality status of industrial wastewater and the recycling targets of the treated water.

default.zh: 本课程结合大气污染控制工程实践和学科发展前沿，通过全面讲解大气污染控制工程的基本概念、基本原理、基本方法及有关设计计算问题，使学生能够循序渐进地接受和掌握基本知识，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。能够综合运用所学知识辨识复杂环境问题，熟悉相关法规、标准、规范，掌握能源利用产生空气污染的原理，燃烧产生污染物的定量计算，颗粒物净化的流体动力学基础，以及颗粒物及气态污染物净化的原理、工艺和设备的基本知识，提出合理的解决方案，设计满足特定需求的系统、单元和工艺流程。在巩固和理解课程的专业知识基础上，根据设计说明书内容计算污染物排放量，并按照相应标准、规范对文丘里水膜除尘器进行设计计算，运用CAD完成除尘器的主体结构设计图和流程图，并基于相关背景知识评价设计所能实现的污染物控制效能。树立环保意识，理论与实际相结合，具有运用基本理论技术及查阅的相关资料，解决实际大气污染问题的能力，为今后从事空气污染治理工作奠定良好基础。
