default.en: This course combines the practice of air pollution control engineering and the frontiers of the development of the discipline, through a comprehensive explanation of the basic concepts, basic principles, basic methods and related design and calculation problems of air pollution control engineering, so that students can accept and master the basic knowledge step by step, and cultivate the ability of students to analyze and solve problems. Students will be able to use the knowledge gained to identify complex environmental problems, familiarize themselves with relevant regulations, standards and codes, master the principles of air pollution generated by energy use, quantitative calculation of pollutants generated by combustion, the basis of fluid dynamics of particulate matter purification, as well as the principles of purification of particulate matter and gaseous pollutants, the basic knowledge of the process and equipment, and put forward a reasonable solution to the problem, and design the systems, units and processes. On the basis of consolidating and understanding the professional knowledge of the course, calculate the pollutant emissions according to the content of the design specification, and design and calculate the venturi water film dust collector in accordance with the corresponding standards and codes, complete the design drawings of the main structure of the dust collector and the flow charts by using CAD, and evaluate the efficacy of the pollutant control that can be achieved by the design based on the relevant background knowledge. To establish environmental protection awareness, combine theory and practice, have the ability to solve actual air pollution problems by using basic theoretical techniques and the relevant information consulted, and lay a good foundation for future work in air pollution control.

default.zh: 《城镇给排水系统工程》是环境工程专业本科生的专业核心课程之一。本课程旨在向学生全面讲授城镇给排水系统工程的基本原理和特点，规划设计原则、水力计算方法以及运行管理等，并了解相关内容的国内外最新进展。整个课程分为给水系统、排水系统、水泵与泵站等三部分内容。给水系统工程主要包括给水管道系统的功能、规划设计原则、水量计算等，输配水管道的水力计算理论和方法，取水构筑物、管道附属构筑物的设计和运行管理等；排水系统工程主要包括排水管道的功能、规划设计原则、水量计算、水力计算理论和方法、管道附属构筑物以及管道系统的运行管理等；水泵与泵站主要包括水泵的基本工作原理与设计计算、水泵站的设计与运行管理等。通过课程的教学，培养学生能够利用专业知识解决城镇给排水系统中的复杂工程问题，具有系统性分析和设计城镇给排水系统的能力，同时理解我国给排水系统发展过程中的成就与不足，增强学生的荣誉感、使命感和责任感。为进一步进行城镇给排水系统工程相关的科研和工程实践奠定基础。
default.en: Urban water supply and drainage system engineering is one of the major courses for undergraduates majoring in environmental engineering. The purpose of this course is to give students a comprehensive introduction to the basic principles and characteristics of urban water supply and drainage system engineering, planning and design principles, hydraulic calculation methods and operation management, and to understand the latest progress in relevant contents at home and abroad. The whole course is divided into three parts: water supply system, drainage system, water pump and pump station. The water supply system project mainly includes the function, planning and design principle, water quantity calculation, etc. ; the hydraulic calculation theory and method of the water transmission and distribution pipeline, the design and operation management of the water intake structure and the auxiliary structure of the pipeline, etc.; the drainage system project mainly includes the function, planning and design principle, water quantity calculation, hydraulic calculation theory and method, the operation management of auxiliary structures and pipeline system, etc.; the pump and pump station mainly include the basic working principle and design calculation of the pump, the design and operation management of the pump station, etc. Through the teaching of the course, students have the basic skills in planning, design and operation management of water supply and drainage system, ability to solve the complex engineering problems and systematically design urban water supply and drainage systems by using professional knowledge. Students can simultaneously understand the achievements and shortcomings in the development of China's water supply and drainage system, enhancing their sense of honor, mission, and responsibility. These knowledge and abilities lay the foundation for further scientific research and engineering practice related to urban water supply and drainage system engineering.

default.zh: 《固体废物处理与资源化》是环境工程专业的专业核心课之一，课程紧密结合国家政策导向和实际应用需求，力争通过课堂教学，使学生们更多地了解国外最先进的固体废物处理、处置与资源化技术，培养为满足国内该领域的发展所需要的专业技术人才。本课程内容主要包括固体废物处理处置工程和资源化的理论知识及固体废物综合处理园区工程设计的理论和技术方法等。通过该课程的学习，能够使学生扎实掌握固体废物处理处置工程和资源化的基础知识和工程技术方法，具备一定的实践动手能力和一定的解决工程问题的能力，提升学生工程素质。结合国家政策导向和课程学习内容，为实现城市固体废物减量化、资源化、无害化目标，进行固体废物综合处理园区设计，使学生对所学习的固体废物处理处置技术有更深层次的理解，并能够综合运用理论知识和技术手段设计固体废物处理系统和工艺过程，提高解决实际问题的能力，能够就复杂固体废物处理工程问题与业界同行及社会公众进行沟通和交流，为今后的实际工作打下良好的基础。
default.en: 《Treatment and Reuse of Solid Waste》is one of the core courses of the Environmental Engineering major. The course closely combines national policy guidance and practical application needs, striving to enable students to have a better understanding of the most advanced solid waste treatment, disposal and resource utilization technologies abroad through classroom teaching, and cultivate professional and technical talents to meet the development needs of this field in China. The content of this course mainly includes theoretical knowledge of solid waste treatment and disposal engineering and resource utilization, as well as the theory and technical methods of solid waste comprehensive treatment park engineering design. Through the study of this course, students can solidly grasp the basic knowledge and engineering technology methods of solid waste treatment and disposal engineering and resource utilization, possess certain practical skills and the ability to solve engineering problems, and improve their engineering quality. Based on national policy guidance and course learning content, in order to achieve the goals of reducing, resourceful, and harmless urban solid waste, the design of a comprehensive solid waste treatment park is carried out. This will enable students to have a deeper understanding of the solid waste treatment and disposal technology they have learned, and to comprehensively apply theoretical knowledge and technical means to design solid waste treatment systems and processes, improve their ability to solve practical problems, and communicate and exchange with industry peers and the public on complex solid waste treatment engineering problems, laying a solid foundation for future practical work.

default.zh: 《环境影响评价与规划管理A》环境科学与工程专业学生的专业核心课程，是关于环境质量现状与变异规律的原理、方法的技术应用，以及在可持续发展理论、区域复合生态系统理论、环境政策学理论等相关学科理论与技术支持下，将环境影响评价、规划与环境管理有机地结的理论与方法。本课程针对环境科学与工程专业的特点，紧密联系环境科学与工程学科中的实际问题，在理论、方法、技术规范学习的同时注重建设项目环境影响评价实际案例教学及相应的规划与管理实际案例的作用，使学生能够从环境影响评价出发，以可持续发展的理念指定合理的规划管理方案。
default.en: “Environmental Impact Assessment, Planning and Management A” is a core course for students majoring in environmental science and engineering . It is about the technical application of the principles and methods of the status and variation of environmental quality. Under the theoretical and technical support of sustainable development theory, regional complex ecosystem theory, environmental policy theory and other related disciplines, the course will develop the theory and method of integrating environmental impact assessment, planning and environmental management. Aiming at the characteristics of environmental science and engineering, this course is closely related to practical problems in the discipline of environmental science and engineering. While learning theories, methods and technical norms, it pays attention to the practical case teaching of environmental impact assessment of construction projects and the corresponding practical cases of planning and management. Students can provide reasonable planning and management programs with the concept of sustainable development base on environmental impact assessment.

default.zh: 本课程是环境工程专业的专业必修课，属于本科教学计划中的主要课程之一。本课程针对生态文明建设过程中环境保护工程建设的实际需求，将当前大型生态环境保护工程建设过程中涉及的土石方工程、混凝土工程、工程取水与排水、管道安装、黑臭河道治理、综合管廊等施工与建设工程中基础原理、基本工艺、典型案例、经济成本分析等进行综合讲授。通过本课程的学习，可使学生掌握土建的基本知识并获得工程施工的技术能力，掌握工业与民用建筑设计的基本原理和方法，获得建筑物的组成构造原理知识并具有建筑物做法的能力，理解并掌握环境工程常用的施工技术方法，熟悉环境工程土建施工过程中的标准规范。紧密联系环境工程学科中的工作中将遇到的经济、预算、造价等实际问题，将环境工程技术和项目进行经济分析进行耦合，使学生理解技术经济学的基本理论、基本方法，能将经济学基本技能运用在环境工程项目前期决策中，掌握经济评价指标和方法、不确定性分析、项目可行性研究等内容，使学生熟悉环境专业相关工程项目经济分析过程,以达到能对环境工程项目进行公正、客观、合理评价的目的；使学生理解项目定额、固定资产、折旧、税费等概念，理解预算、概算、决算过程及算法，能够完成项目的造价计算。能够运用基本建设的相关知识进行环境工程的施工，并从全链条做到工程施工与建设的经济合理，为学生未来从事环境工程设计、建设、施工、运维等打下必要的工程基础。
default.en: This course is a compulsory course for environmental engineering majors, and it has been regarded as one of the main courses in the undergraduate teaching plan. Aims at the actual needs of environmental protection engineering construction in the process of ecological civilization construction, this course will comprehensively teach the basic principles, basic processes, typical cases, and economic cost analysis in the construction of large-scale ecological environmental projects, such as earthwork, concrete engineering, engineering water inlet and drainage, pipeline installation, black and smelly river management, and integrated pipe corridor. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic knowledge of civil construction and acquire the technical ability of engineering construction, master the basic principles and methods of industrial and civil building design, acquire the knowledge of the composition and construction principles of buildings and have the ability of building practices, understand and master the common construction techniques and methods of environmental engineering, and be familiar with the standards and norms in the process of environmental engineering civil construction. Integrate economic, budgetary, and cost-related practical issues encountered in the field of environmental engineering into the work, coupling economic analysis with environmental engineering technology and projects. This enables students to grasp the basic theories and methods of techno-economic analysis, apply fundamental economic skills to preliminary decision-making in environmental engineering projects, and master economic evaluation indicators and methods, uncertainty analysis, and feasibility studies. Students become familiar with the economic analysis process of environmental engineering projects, aiming to achieve the objective of conducting fair, objective, and rational evaluations of environmental engineering projects. Additionally, students understand concepts such as project quotas, fixed assets, depreciation, taxes, and fees, comprehend the budgeting, cost estimation, and final accounting processes and algorithms, and are capable of completing project cost calculations. Be able to use relevant knowledge of capital construction to carry out environmental engineering construction, and achieve economic rationality of engineering construction and construction from the whole chain, laying the necessary engineering foundation for students to engage in environmental engineering design, construction, construction, operation and maintenance in the future.

default.zh: 《环境影响评价与规划管理B》是环境科学专业学生的专业核心课程，其在环境污染控制工程、环境监测、可持续发展理论、区域复合生态系统理论、环境政策学理论等相关学科理论与技术支持下，将环境影响评价、环境规划、环境管的理论与方法理有机地结合在一起。通过本门课程的学习，使学生掌握环境影响、环境评价、环境规划与管理的基本技术方法及国家环境保护相关政策、法律、法规、标准；能够基于环境影响评价及规划管理的基本原理并采用科学方法对复杂工程项目和区域环境问题进行系统分析和评价，制定合理的环境评价及规划管理方案；能够从可持续发展的观点评价工程实践对环境、社会的影响。本门课程的考核方法包括随堂小作业（10分），课后大作业（10分），期末考试（80分）。
default.en: Environmental Planning, Management, and Impact Assessment "is a core course for students majoring in environmental science. With the support of relevant disciplines such as environmental pollution control engineering, environmental monitoring, theory of sustainable development, theory of regional complex ecosystem, and theory of environmental policy, it combines the theories and methods of environmental impact assessment, environmental planning, and environmental management. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic technical methods of environmental impact, environmental assessment, environmental planning and management, as well as relevant national environmental protection policies, laws, regulations, and standards; Be able to systematically analyze and evaluate complex engineering projects and regional environmental issues based on the basic principles of environmental impact assessment, planning, and management, as well as use scientific methods to develop reasonable environmental assessment and planning management plans; Able to evaluate the impact of practical engineering projects on the environment and society from a sustainable development perspective. The assessment methods for this course include exercises during class (10 points), assignment (10 points), and final exams (80 points).

default.zh: 本课程从理论上系统深入的阐述了利用生态学原理与技术处理环境污染问题，通过基本原理、案例分析及相关技术设计的讲授，使学生掌握环境生态技术的思路和方法。本课程的主要研究内容包括环境生态工程绪论、环境生态工程基本原理、湿地环境生态过程、河道环境生态工程、城市雨水管理工程、农业环境生态工程、工业环境生态工程、流域环境生态工程等。通过课程学习，使学生掌握环境生态工程技术的基本理论和基本技能，能够进行环境问题的识别、判断和生态技术的选取能力。
default.en: This course focuses on the environmental issues tackled by ecological principles and technologies. Students will enhance their skills and broaden minds towards environmental ecological technologies through the study of the basic principles, case studies and technical design. The main content of this course includes the Introduction to Environmental Ecological Engineering, Basic Principles of Environmental Ecological Engineering, Wetland Environmental Ecological Processes, River Environmental Ecological Engineering, Urban Rainwater Management Engineering, Agricultural Environmental Ecological Engineering, Industrial Environmental Ecological Engineering, and Watershed Environmental Ecological Engineering. Through curriculum learning, students will get the basic thoughts and skills of environmental ecological engineering technology, and be able to identify and choose ecological technologies for environmental issues.

default.zh: 《水源工程原理》课程作为高等学校给排水科学与工程专业的专业课，全面介绍水源工程的现代理论、方法和工程要素。通过课程学习，使学生了解水资源概况、水循环与水资源开发利用状况、水资源评价、水资源供需平衡分析，掌握取水构筑物形式构造、设计计算、施工、运维等方面的知识。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1. 了解水资源概况，掌握水循环与水资源开发利用状况、水资源评价、水资源供需平衡分析的基本理论及计算方法；（支撑毕业要求7） 课程目标2. 了解取水构筑物水源及位置选择的原则，掌握取水构筑物设计、计算方法，具备分析和解决复杂工程问题的能力。（支撑毕业要求1、3）
default.en: Principles of Water Source Engineering, as a specialized course for the Water Supply and Drainage Science and Engineering major in higher education institutions, provides a comprehensive introduction to the modern theories, methods, and engineering elements of water source engineering. Through this course, students will learn about the general situation of water resources, the water cycle, the status of water resources development and utilization, water resources assessment, and water resources supply-demand balance analysis. They will master knowledge related to the types, structures, design calculations, construction, operation, and maintenance of water intake structures. The course objectives set the following competency requirements for students: · Course Objective 1: Understand the general situation of water resources; master the basic theories and calculation methods for the water cycle, the status of water resources development and utilization, water resources assessment, and water resources supply-demand balance analysis. (Supports Graduation Requirement 7) · Course Objective 2: Understand the principles for selecting water sources and sites for intake structures; master the design and calculation methods for intake structures; be equipped with the ability to analyze and solve complex engineering problems. (Supports Graduation Requirements 1 and 3)

default.zh: 《水工程输配系统（1）》是给水排水工程专业本科生的重要主干课程之一，针对给水工程中水的输送、分配的管道系统的工程设计及计算理论所需求的内容，系统地论述管道系统的功能、布置原理、水量计算、水力计算理论和方法、工程优化设计理论和方法及管道系统的运行管理理论及实践。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、案例剖析和课程设计等环节培养学生的工程思维和专业知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。使学生系统完整地学习和掌握给水管道系统的基本概念、工程设计和运行管理的基础理论和方法；使学生初步掌握给水管道系统规划、管道系统的设计和计算及运行管理方面的基本技能，初步具备给水管道系统设计和管理的工程实践能力；培养学生对给水管道工程基础理论的理解、掌握和分析运用能力，初步具备给水管道系统的科学研究能力。 该课程的主要特点是工程实践性强，反映出工程设计的基本环节。
default.en: “Water Transmission and Distribution System (1) ” is one of the main courses for the undergraduate students of water supply and drainage engineering. Aiming at design and calculation of water transportation and distribution of water supply engineering, functions, arrangement, water yield and hydraulic calculation theory and methods of pipe system will be discussed. The course will also introduce engineering optimization design theory and methods and operational management and practice of pipe system. The main objective of this course is to train engineering thinking and professional knowledge application ability of students, supporting professional learning. Through this course, students could master basic conceptions of water supply system, theory and methods of engineering design and operational management. The students could possess the ability of water supply system planning, design, calculation and operational management. They could possess the ability of design and management of water supply pipeline system. The students will be trained to possess the ability of understanding, analyzing and applying basic theories of water supply engineering. They will be able to do the research of water supply system. The main characteristic of this course is its strong engineering practicality, reflecting basic step of engineering design.

default.zh: 《水工程输配系统（2）》是城市水系统工程专业重要主干课程之一，课程系统地讲授了城市排水体制、排水系统布置原理、管段流量计算、水力计算理论和方法、排水管道工程设计方法、排水管道的智慧化运行管理，使学生掌握城市污水、雨水收集及排放所需管道系统的设计和现代化运行管理方面的专业知识。
default.en: "Water Transmission and Distribution System（2）" is one of the important backbone courses of urban water system engineering. The course systematically teaches the urban drainage system, drainage system layout principles, pipe flow calculation, hydraulic calculation theory and methods, drainage pipeline engineering design methods, and intelligent operation and management of drainage pipelines, enabling students to master urban sewage Professional knowledge in the design and modern operation management of pipeline systems required for rainwater collection and discharge. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' engineering thinking and professional knowledge application abilities through classroom teaching, case analysis, and course design, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 城市水系统是水的自然循环和水的社会循环的耦合。城市水系统的良性循环是实现水资源可持续利用和城市可持续发展的重要保障。《水系统工程运行与管理》是给排水科学与工程专业重要课程之一，课程从运营与管理的角度系统地讲授了城市水系统良性循环的技术保障和科学管理方法,主要包括城市水资源、水系统的概念及其基本属性；城市水系统的构成要素和主要设施；城市水系统的功能和基本调控措施；城市取水构筑物的运行维护措施；城市自来水水厂和污水处理厂的处理工艺系统、主要设备与辅助系统的运行、维护、控制与管理措施；城市给水厂、污水厂各单元典型运行故障分析和解决措施；给水管网、排水管网的监测、检漏与维护方法；GIS在城市给水排水管网系统管理中的应用方式；泵站及相应设备的安全运行技术保障措施和科学管理方法；现行的水务企业运营管理模式和投资融资方法等。
default.en: The urban water system is the the coupling of the natural circulation and the social circulation of water. The virtuous circle of urban water system is an important guarantee for sustainable utilization of water resources and urban development.Operation and Management of Water Systems Engineering is one of the important courses in Water Supply and Drainage Engineering. The course systematically teaches the technical support and scientific management methods of the virtuous circle of urban water system from the perspective of operation and management, including the concept of urban water resources, water system and its basic attributes; the components and major facilities of urban water system; functions and basic control measures of the urban water system;the operation and maintenance measures of the urban water intake structure; the operation, maintenance, control and management measures of processing technology system, the main equipment and auxiliary system of urban waterworks and wastewater treatment plant; the typical operation failure analysis and solution measures of urban water supply and wastewater treatment plant unit; the monitoring, leak detection and maintenance methods of water supply and drainage pipe network; the application mode of GIS in the city water supply and drainage pipe network system management; the safe operation technical support measures and scientific management methods of the pump station and corresponding equipment; the current water business operation and management mode and investment financing methods.

default.zh: 《水质工程学(1)》是给排水科学与工程专业的重要主干课。它是围绕着水的性质、给水水质特征与水质指标、水体污染及危害、改善给水水质的工程学原理、设计计算方法、各种水处理的理论、方法、技术以及各种给水处理系统而展开的。本课程阐述了水的自然循环与社会循环规律及水质变化，介绍了水质特性与水质标准，详细地阐述了凝聚和絮凝、沉淀、过滤、吸附、除铁除锰、消毒、离子交换、膜技术、腐蚀与结垢等单元过程的物理化学原理。本课程介绍了给水处理工艺系统的选择原则，针对给水处理各单元过程设置了相应的实验课，并安排了课程实习与毕业实习。
default.en: Water Quality Engineering is one of the core courses for the major of Water and Wastewater Engineering. The course is developed based on the discussions of water property, water quality and related parameters, water pollution, principles of water treatment. It also introduces the selection and design of water treatment systems based on raw and required purified water quality. The course will introduce the principle of natural water cycle and social water cycle, as well as the water quality variations in the process. The course will introduce in detail the physical chemical principles of water treatment such as coagulation and flocculation, sedimentation and flotation, filtration, adsorption, and disinfection, iron and mangenese removal, ion exchange, membrane technology, corrosion and scaling etc. Related experiments on various processes are arranged. Field work for course and graduation design will also be arranged.

default.zh: 《水质工程学Ⅱ》为市政工程系给排水科学与工程专业的必修专业课。《水质工程学Ⅱ》课程包括概述、城市污水处理及工业废水处理三部分。概述部分介绍污水的性质与污染指标、水体污染与水体自净。城市污水处理介绍污水的物理处理、活性污泥法、生物膜法、污水的自然处理、污水深度处理与回用、污泥处理及污水厂设计。工业废水处理部分介绍工业废水水质、工业废水处理涉及的物理、化学、物理化学及生物处理方法。
default.en: Water Quality Engineering II is a compulsory course for Water Supply and Drainage Science and Engineering of Municipal Engineering Department. "Water Quality Engineering II" course includes overview, urban sewage treatment and industrial wastewater treatment three parts. In the overview section, the character and pollution index of sewage, water pollution and water self-purification are introduced. In the urban sewage treatment section, the physical treatment of sewage, activated sludge method, biofilm method, natural treatment of sewage, advanced treatment and reuse of sewage, sludge treatment and sewage plant design are introduced. In the industrial Wastewater treatment section, the water quality of industrial wastewater, the treatment methods of physical, chemical, physical chemical and biological are introduced.

default.zh: 本课程针对我国面临的水体有关的生态破坏和环境污染问题，以水体生态保护、修复与工程治理为主线，以可持续发展思想为指导，通过理论知识及应用实践相结合，从应用的角度进行全面系统地介绍水体的保护与修复的理论、方法，在介绍基本理论与方法的基础上，介绍了水体生态保护修复方面的最新研究成果，并配有必要的实例，便于学生掌握水生态保护与修复的实际技能，是一门从工程实践角度进行探讨水体生态系统的保护与修复的课程。本课程具有综合性、实践性、技术前沿性、环保意识培养和跨学科等特点， 课程突出理论与实践相结合，通过案例分析等方式，使学生能够直观地了解和掌握水体污染治理与修复的技术和方法，关注最新的技术动态，确保学生接触到的是最前沿、最有效的治理和修复技术，注重培养学生的环保意识、团队协作和沟通能力，以更好地应对复杂多变的环境问题。
default.en: This course focuses on the ecological damage and environmental pollution issues related to water bodies in China. With water body ecological protection, restoration, and engineering management as the main thread, guided by the idea of sustainable development, it combines theoretical knowledge with practical applications to comprehensively and systematically introduce the theories and methods of water body protection and restoration from an applied perspective. Based on the introduction of basic theories and methods, the latest research achievements in water body ecological protection and restoration are presented, along with necessary examples to facilitate students' mastery of practical skills in water ecological protection and restoration. This course explores the protection and restoration of aquatic ecosystems from an engineering practice perspective. This course is comprehensive, practical, technically cutting-edge, environmentally aware, and interdisciplinary. It emphasizes the combination of theory and practice. Through case studies and other methods, students can intuitively understand and master the techniques and methods of water pollution control and restoration, keeping up with the latest technological developments. The course ensures that students are exposed to the most cutting-edge and effective treatment and restoration technologies, focusing on cultivating students' environmental awareness, team collaboration, and communication skills to better address complex and changing environmental issues.

default.zh: 《城市供水系统智能化》是城市水系统工程专业的重要主干课程之一，针对城市水系统工程中水的输送、分配过程，系统论述管网水力计算理论及方法、管网优化设计理论及方法，并基于此，论述如何通过计算机编程、软件应用等智慧化手段，实现管道系统的设计、计算、模型构建及运维管理。
default.en: As a core course in the Urban Water Systems Engineering curriculum, Intelligentization of Urban Water Supply Systems focuses on the processes of water transmission and distribution within urban water infrastructure. It systematically elaborates on the theories and methods for hydraulic calculation and optimal design of pipeline networks. Building upon this foundation, the course discusses how to apply smart solutions, such as computer programming and software applications, to achieve the design, calculation, modeling, operation, and maintenance of pipeline systems.

default.zh: 《城市排水系统计算与模拟》是城市水系统工程专业重要主干课程之一，课程系统地讲授了城市排水体制、排水系统布置原理、管段流量计算、水力计算理论和方法、排水管道工程设计方法、排水管道的智慧化运行管理，使学生掌握城市污水、雨水收集及排放所需管道系统的设计和现代化运行管理方面的专业知识。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、案例剖析和课程设计等环节培养学生的工程思维和专业知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: "Calculation and Simulation of Urban Drainage System" is one of the important backbone courses of urban water system engineering. The course systematically teaches the urban drainage system, drainage system layout principles, pipe flow calculation, hydraulic calculation theory and methods, drainage pipeline engineering design methods, and intelligent operation and management of drainage pipelines, enabling students to master urban sewage Professional knowledge in the design and modern operation management of pipeline systems required for rainwater collection and discharge. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' engineering thinking and professional knowledge application abilities through classroom teaching, case analysis, and course design, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《城市水环境规划》是城市水系统工程本科生的专业主干课之一。本课程以城市“人水和谐”为目标，以城市水环境发展历程为线索，以水环境中的物质循环、能量流动和信息传递分析为着眼点，阐述探讨城市与水环境之间的相互关系，明确城市水安全、水资源、水生态、水景观、水文化、水管理和水经济体系建设的重要内涵。通过课堂学习，了解城市水健康循环理论、城市水环境规划原则及方式、城市水环境容量与恢复、城市水环境健康循环方略、城市水环境生态调控、健康城市水环境建设与修复、水生态经济与水文化传承等，使学生掌握城市水环境规划基本概念与规划思路；结合案例分析和课程设计，进一步明确健康城市水环境的思想和理念，使学生学会应用宏观的、超前的、基础的视角看待城市水问题演化，依据最新的理论、理念、方法和技术来规划设计城市的水环境。
default.en: Urban Water Environment Planning is one of the main major courses for urban water system engineering undergraduates. This course takes the development of the urban water environment as the mainline. It focuses on analyzing material circulation, energy flow, and information transmission in the water environment, aiming at the urban development with harmony between human and water environment. Importantly, the relationship between the city and the water environment, including urban water security, water resources, water ecology, water landscape, water culture, water management, and water economic system construction, would be expounded and explored in this course. Through classroom teaching, students need to learn about healthy cycling of water, urban water environment planning principles and methods, urban water environment capacity and its restoration, urban water environment cycle strategy, urban water environment ecological regulation, construction and restoration of healthy urban water environment, ecological water economy, and inheritance of water culture. In addition to mastering the basic concepts and planning ideas of urban water environment, students must also further understand a healthy urban water environment by learning the actual planning case and planning the urban water environment system. Finally, students are hoped to analyze the evolution of urban water issues by themselves with a macro, advanced and basic perspective, and independently design the urban water environment based on the latest theories, ideas, methods and technologies.

default.zh: 城市水系统生态学是一门研究生物与城市水环境之间相互关系的科学，它涉及到生物种群、群落、生态系统以及全球生态系统的各个方面。在《城市水系统生态学》课程中，学生将学习生态学的基本概念、原理和方法，以及生态学在城市水环境保护、生态恢复和可持续发展等领域的应用。掌握生态学的基本概念、原理和方法，理解生物与城市水环境之间的相互作用和相互依赖关系学习如何运用生态学的知识，分析和解决城市水环境保护、生态恢复和可持续发展等实际问题培养学生对城市水生态环境的热爱和保护意识，树立可持续发展的观念。培养学生的实验设计、数据分析和科学研究的技能，提高其独立思考和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Urban water system ecology is a science that studies the relationship between organisms and urban water environment. It involves all aspects of biological population, community, ecosystem and global ecosystem. In the course "Ecology of Urban Water Systems", students will learn the basic concepts, principles and methods of ecology, as well as its application in the fields of urban water environment protection, ecological restoration and sustainable development. Master the basic concepts, principles and methods of ecology, understand the interaction and interdependence between organisms and urban water environment, learn how to apply the knowledge of ecology, analyze and solve practical problems such as urban water environment protection, ecological restoration and sustainable development, and cultivate students' love for urban water ecological environment and protection consciousness, and establish the concept of sustainable development. Develop students' skills in experimental design, data analysis and scientific research, and improve their ability to think independently and solve problems.

default.zh: 面向生态文明建设国家战略，服务于海绵城市建设、黑臭水体治理及智慧水务等城市水系统重构层面的复杂工程问题等国家重大需求，以“保护城市水资源、提升城市水环境、重构城市水生态、保障城市水安全”为导向，国民经济可持续发展的关键所在。《海绵城市原理与应用》是《城市水系统工程专业》核心课。全面介绍了海绵城市相关的基本知识、方法和技能，设计洪水基本理论和设计计算、海绵城市设计技术措施、案例分析等。通过本课程的学习可以让学生掌握海绵城市原理与应用的基本理论和设计计算方法，提高分析和解决实际工程问题的能力，具备海绵城市原理与应用相关规划、设计和管理的能力。
default.en: Facing the national strategy of ecological civilization construction, it serves the important needs of the country, such as the construction of Sponge City, the treatment of black and smelly water body and the complex engineering problems in the reconstruction of urban water system, such as the intelligent water affairs, etc. , the key to sustainable development of national economy is to protect urban water resources, improve urban water environment, reconstruct urban water ecology and ensure urban water security. The principle and application of sponge city is the core course of urban water system engineering. The basic knowledge, methods and skills of sponge city, basic theory and calculation of design flood, technical measures of sponge city design and case analysis are introduced. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theory and design calculation method of Sponge City, and improve the ability of analyzing and solving practical engineering problems, ability to plan, design and manage sponge city principles and applications.

default.zh: 《水质工程原理与系统模拟（1）》是城市水系统工程专业的重要主干课程之一，课程系统地讲授了水质与水质标准，给水的物理、化学及物理化学处理工艺原理及水处理工艺系统、水处理工艺单元的机理模型与数据模型以及智慧水务方面的内容，使学生掌握给水处理工艺基本原理、设计和运行管理，以及水质工程系统与过程模拟方面的专业知识。
default.en: Water quality engineering principles and system simulation (1) is one of the important backbone courses in the urban water system engineering major. The course systematically teaches water quality and water quality standards, the physics, chemistry and physicochemical treatment process principles of water supply and water treatment, the process system, the mechanism model and data model of the water treatment process unit, and the content of smart water affairs enable students to master the basic principles, design and operation management of water supply treatment process, as well as professional knowledge in water quality engineering systems and process simulation.

default.zh: 《水质工程原理与系统模拟（2）》为市政工程系城市水系统工程专业的必修专业课，通过该课程的学习，掌握水质工程基本原理和工艺，能够应用水质工程原理和过程模拟技术解决城镇污水处理及资源化利用中的工程问题。要求学生应用所学知识提出设计方案，并具备工程设计计算、净化过程模拟的能力，为将来从事本专业的工程规划、设计、科研及运行管理工作等奠定必要的理论和应用基础。
default.en: Principles of Water Quality Engineering and System Simulation（2） "Principles and System Simulation of Water Quality Engineering (2)" is a compulsory course for urban water system engineering. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic principles and processes of water quality engineering and apply simulation technology to solve engineering problems in wastewater treatment and reuse. Students are required to apply their knowledge and ability to perform engineering design calculations and purification process simulations, laying the necessary theoretical and practical foundation for future work in engineering planning, design, scientific research, and operation management in their respective fields.

default.zh: 水环境科学是新版环境科学本科专业培养计划调整后，全新设立的一门专业课。本课程是一门学科交叉强的，与天文学、地理学、生态学、生命科学、社会学、哲学、数学、化学、物理学等密切相关，重点介绍天然水的组成，天然水化学及气象变化、地质异动、人为活动等对天然水组成的影响及其对水环境生态功能的破坏; 掌握我国水资源现状及其在合理开发利用与修复保护水资源间的相互关系；熟悉水污染成因与危害以及治理与修复的技术措施，了解水环境科学一般研究方法。
default.en: Water Environmental Science is a newly established professional course after the adjustment of the new version of the undergraduate training plan for environmental science. This course is a highly interdisciplinary subject closely related to astronomy, geography, ecology, life sciences, sociology, philosophy, mathematics, chemistry, physics, etc. It focuses on the composition of natural water, the impact of natural hydrochemistry and meteorological changes, geological anomalies, human activities, etc. on the composition of natural water, and the damage to the ecological function of water environment; Master the current situation of water resources in China and the interrelationship between rational development, utilization, restoration, and protection of water resources; Familiar with the causes and hazards of water pollution, as well as the technical measures for treatment and restoration, and understand the general research methods of water environment science.

default.zh: 大气环境科学是大气科学和环境科学两种学科交叉的分支学科。全球气候变化、大气污染、新能源开发等，对人类经济和社会生活正产生广泛而深刻的影响。大气环境科学是从人类环境的角度研究地球大气，是一门理论和应用兼容的科学。它主要研究大气组分的物理和化学特性、迁移转化规律以及它们与人类活动、气象和生态系统之间的相互影响。此外，大气科学还包括大气与陆地、海洋及生物圈之间的相互作用，在环境、海洋、新能源科学、人类活动及日常生活等各方面都有广泛的应用。本课程注重基础理论学习与科研实践相结合，通过课堂教学，使学生熟悉大气中主要组分的来源、影响和传输扩散过程；理解全球气候变化和平流层臭氧损耗的化学过程，以及对流层化学、平流层化学和气候变化之间的本质联系；掌握大气环境科学的基础理论和方法，并为以后灵活地应用到深入的专业学习和日常生活中打下基础。
default.en: Atmospheric environmental science is a sub-discipline at the intersection of two disciplines: atmospheric science and environmental science. Global climate change, atmospheric pollution, new energy development, etc., are having a wide and profound impact on human economic and social life. Atmospheric environmental science is the study of the earth's atmosphere from the perspective of the human environment, and is a science compatible with theory and application. It mainly studies the physical and chemical properties of atmospheric components, the laws of transport and transformation, and their interactions with human activities, meteorology and ecosystems. In addition, atmospheric science also includes the interactions between the atmosphere and the land, ocean and biosphere, and has a wide range of applications in various aspects of the environment, oceans, new energy science, human activities and daily life. This course emphasizes the combination of basic theoretical study and scientific research practice. Through classroom teaching, students will be familiar with the sources, effects and transport-diffusion processes of the major components of the atmosphere; understand the chemical processes of global climate change and stratospheric ozone depletion, as well as the essential connection between tropospheric chemistry, stratospheric chemistry and climate change; master the basic theories and methods of atmospheric environmental science, and lay the foundation for flexible application to in-depth professional studies and daily life in the future.

default.zh: 《环境污染控制工程》是环境科学专业的专业核心课程。本课程针对环境科学专业特点，在“双碳”战略思想指导下，紧密联系环境科学专业在工程实践中的实际问题，注重环境科学实际案例教学的作用。主要内容包括环境污染控制工程的基本概念、基本原理、基本方法、典型工艺及有关设计计算问题。重点内容为大气及水污染物控制方法的基本原理和工艺：跟踪大气污染控制的最新前沿，针对不同大气污染物的理化特性，明晰其产生、净化特点，设计可行的研究和实验方案，培养低碳综合化、区域化、系统化的大气污染防控思维；将污水水质指标、污水处理理论、原理和工艺技术设计计算紧密结合，全面系统地解读不同污水的水质状况及环境要素所适用的水处理工艺流程，训练开发综合新型水处理工艺的设计思路。通过课堂讲解、课后练习及期末考试要求学生能够综合运用所学知识分析大气污染种类及污染过程，具备开发大气污染协同碳中和控制技术、大气污染协同重金属去除技术等新型大气污染防控技术的能力；掌握水环境污染预防与控制的理论知识，能够应用水污染控制工程的基础理论和设计原理，分析水污染控制工艺过程的关键影响因素及碳流途径，提出自然、工业、生活等不同水污染控制工程问题的低碳解决方案。考核方式为课后习题和期末考试。
default.en: Environmental Pollution Control Engineering is a core course in the field of environmental science. This course is aimed at the characteristics of environmental science majors, guided by the "dual carbon" strategy, closely related to the practical problems of environmental science majors in engineering practice, and emphasizes the role of practical case teaching in environmental science. The main content includes the basic concepts, principles, methods, typical processes, and related design and calculation issues of environmental pollution control engineering. The key content is the basic principles and processes of air and water pollution control methods: tracking the latest frontier of air pollution control, clarifying the physical and chemical characteristics of different air pollutants, designing feasible research and experimental plans, and cultivating low-carbon, comprehensive, regional, and systematic air pollution prevention and control thinking; Integrating sewage quality indicators, sewage treatment theories, principles, and process technology design calculations closely, comprehensively and systematically interpreting the water quality conditions of different sewage and the applicable water treatment process flow for environmental factors, and training and developing design ideas for comprehensive new water treatment processes. Through classroom explanations, after-school exercises, and final exams, students are required to comprehensively apply their knowledge to analyze the types and processes of air pollution, and have the ability to develop new air pollution prevention and control technologies such as collaborative carbon neutrality control technology and collaborative heavy metal removal technology; Master the theoretical knowledge of water pollution prevention and control, be able to apply the basic theories and design principles of water pollution control engineering, analyze the key influencing factors and carbon flow pathways of water pollution control process, and propose low-carbon solutions for different water pollution control engineering problems in nature, industry, and life. The assessment methods include after-school exercises and final exams.

default.zh: 《固体废物处理与处置》是环境类专业的专业核心课之一，课程紧密结合国家相关固废政策和行业发展需求，通过课堂教学，使学生了解国内外最先进的固体废物处理处置与资源化技术，内容主要包括固体废物处理处置工程和资源化的理论知识和技术方法等，为固废行业发展培养所亟需的专业技术人才。通过该课程的学习，能够使学生扎实掌握固体废物处理与处置的基础知识和技术方法，具备一定的解决复杂环境问题的能力，为今后从事与本专业有关的工作奠定扎实的基础。
default.en: Solid Waste Treatment and Disposal is one of the core courses for environmental majors, which is closely related to national solid waste policies and industry development needs. Through classroom teaching, students can understand the most advanced solid waste treatment, disposal, and resource utilization technologies worldwide. The course content mainly includes theoretical knowledge and technical methods of solid waste treatment, disposal and resource utilization etc, to cultivate urgently needed professional and technical talents for the development of the solid waste industry. Through the study of this course, students can solidly grasp the basic knowledge and technical methods of solid waste treatment and disposal, and have the ability to solve complex environmental problems, laying a solid foundation for future work related to this major.

default.zh: 本课程围绕环境污染、生态安全和人体健康等科学问题，讲授环境污染物的毒性特征、对生物体的生物学作用、致毒致害机理和对人体健康的影响等。课程共32学时，2学分。通过本课程学习，使学生基本掌握环境中重要污染物的毒理作用、致毒致害机制，能够科学分析和评价环境污染物对生态环境和人体健康的影响。
default.en: This course focuses on scientific issues such as environmental pollution, ecological safety and human health, and teaches the toxic characteristics of environmental pollutants, their biological effects on organisms, mechanisms of toxicity and harm, and their effects on human health. The course consists of 32 class hours and 2 credits. Through the study of this course, students can basically master the toxicological effects of important pollutants in the environment and the mechanism of causing toxicity and harm, and can scientifically analyze and evaluate the impact of environmental pollutants on the ecological environment and human health.

default.zh: 环境生态系统是人类赖以生存、活动、繁衍和发展的场所和物质条件。它是指以人类为中心的、充满各种有生命和无生命物质的空间，既包括无机界的各种物质，也包括有机界的各种物质。环境生态系统由物理系统、生物系统和社会经济系统构成，它们相互间存在着物质、能量和信息的交换。这个庞大而复杂的系统的主要特点是具有维持自身相对稳定的负反馈自我调节机能和满足人类合理利用的能力，即所谓承载力。但这种机能和能力有一定的限度；超过了限度,系统就要失去平衡,甚至可能崩溃。 环境生态系统工程的研究对象一般分为微观和宏观两大类：空气、水质、废弃物、噪声等污染防治方案的选优和水库、大坝、河流、农场等生态环境影响的评价，均属于微观问题；而城市环境生态质量评价、区域环境生态系统规划、环境生态系统的经济社会分析，以及环境生态系统的预测、规划和决策等全局性和战略性的问题，则是宏观问题。环境生态系统工程的理论和方法大多是应用于宏观方面，用以解决环境保护的评价、预测、规划和决策问题。 本课程将系统工程的思想、理论和方法应用于环境保护领域，以解决防治环境污染和生态破坏等重大问题的工程技术。它从系统总体出发，运用系统分析方法，研究环境污染和生态破坏的现象、产生的原因、消除的办法及其所需的工程和措施。环境生态系统工程着重分析和协调环境生态系统各组成部分之间的相互关系；分析和协调环境生态系统在整个经济、技术、社会大系统中所处的地位及其与经济、社会等其他系统的相互关系，以便有目的、有步骤地选定研究的目标、建立数学模型、应用优化方法和计算机技术，对大量的可供选择的环境保护方案进行定量的分析和综合评价，提出总体最优方案，供决策机关进行决策，以期实现对环境生态系统的最优治理。环境生态系统工程和环境系统工程相互联系又有所区别。后者解决环境污染的防治问题，前者重点解决生态破坏的防治问题。
default.en: This course applies the ideas, theories, and methods of systems engineering to the field of environmental protection, aiming to solve major problems such as environmental pollution prevention and ecological damage through engineering techniques. It starts from the overall system and applies system analysis methods to study the phenomena, causes, elimination methods, and required engineering and measures of environmental pollution and ecological damage. Environmental ecosystem engineering focuses on analyzing and coordinating the interrelationships between the various components of the environmental ecosystem; Analyze and coordinate the position of the environmental ecosystem in the entire economic, technological, and social system, as well as its interrelationships with other systems such as the economy and society, in order to purposefully and systematically select research objectives, establish mathematical models, apply optimization methods and computer technology, quantitatively analyze and comprehensively evaluate a large number of available environmental protection plans, propose the overall optimal plan for decision-making organs, and achieve optimal governance of the environmental ecosystem. Environmental ecosystem engineering and environmental system engineering are interrelated and have differences. The latter solves the problem of environmental pollution prevention and control, while the former focuses on solving the problem of ecological damage prevention and control.

default.zh: 课程从宏观层面对景观学科的理论体系进行梳理，使学生能够较为全面地了解与掌握地质、地貌、水文、土壤、生物多样性等相关方向的基本研究方式与重点，进而能够更深入地在景观生态学、景观文化、可持续设计、保护生态学等研究方向进行研究与学习。在课程理论学习的基础上逐步消化与理解景观生态学的设计宗旨与秉持原则，将其转化为具体方案设计中的知识点与技巧。通过课程的理论讲授与实践学习，使学生对景观学的主要研究领域有一定程度的熟悉与掌握，并通过文献查询、对比分析等学习方式来锻炼论文写作能力，最终形成具有较高学术水平的课程作业成果。
default.en: The course combs the theoretical system of landscape science from a macro level, enabling students to comprehensively understand and master the basic research methods and priorities of geology, geomorphology, hydrology, soil, biodiversity and other related directions, so as to carry out more in-depth research and study in landscape ecology, landscape culture, sustainable design, conservation ecology and other research directions. On the basis of the learning of curriculum theory, we will gradually digest and understand the design purposes and principles of landscape ecology, and convert them into knowledge points and skills in specific scheme design. Through the theoretical teaching and practical learning of the course, students will have a certain degree of familiarity and mastery of the main research fields of landscape science, and exercise their paper writing ability through literature inquiry, comparative analysis and other learning methods, and finally form a higher academic level of the course work results.

default.zh: 普通生物学是高等院校环境生态专业的一门重要的专业基础课，将主要讲述环境污染防治及生态修复工程中涉及的有关生物学原理。与污染控制微生物学各所侧重，本课程尤其以细胞学、植物学和动物学为核心，讲述环境生态工程所涉及的具有共性的基本生物现象和基本生物过程背后的生物学原理。使学生具有从事环境生态工程领域工作所需的相关生物学相关知识，掌握生态环境污染预防与控制的生物学基本理论和基本技能，并能将所学生物学原理用于解决复杂生态环境问题。本课程向上承接环境学、生态学原理及应用等专业基础课程，向下承接环境系统工程、环境生态工程等专业核心课程。本课程针对环境生态专业的特点，在理论学习的同时紧密联系环境生态学科中的生物学问题，同时也注重生物学原理在环境生态工程应用的实际案例讲解。 （1）本课程教学目标： 1.使学生具有从事环境生态工程领域工作所需的相关生物学相关知识，掌握生态环境污染预防与控制的生物学基本理论和基本技能，并能将所学生物学知识用于解决复杂生态环境问题。 2.培养学生运用现代化的分析检测设备和技术手段对生物学相关的环境生态过程进行系统分析的能力，能够基于生物学的基本原理面向环境治理、生态修复及生态管理等领域复杂工程问题，开发、选择与使用恰当的生物技术和生物资源。 （2）本课程的主要内容 1. 普通生物学绪论：主要介绍生物的生物的基本特征、生物界的多层次组织结构等生物学基本内容，明确本课程在环境生态工程中的任务、定位及主要研究对象。 2. 生物的基本结构：简述生命起源基本假说、细胞周期等概念，重点讲解重要大分子的单体结构特色与大分子—小分子间的化学转化，结合环境污染案例讲述细胞结构损伤及细胞死亡的途径。 3. 细胞代谢与细胞信号：重点介绍生物的能量代谢基本过程和关键酶系、物质的跨膜运输的方式和原理、细胞呼吸作用以及细胞信号和通讯的概念和基本过程。 4. 植物细胞的结构：主要介绍植物体的基本特征与分类，重点强调植物细胞结构特征并详细讲解重要内膜系统及其生理功能。 5. 植物的生存环境与生态作用：主要讲授地球的物理环境圈层和生物圈、环境因子的分类和生态学分析、水和土壤环境中关键生态因子对植物的影响、水和土壤环境中污染物对植物的影响。 6. 植物摄取水和矿质营养：主要介绍水分和植物细胞的关系，讲解植物的水分与矿质营养的摄取与运输，举例说明植物在土壤修复中的作用。 7. 植物的光合作用：讲述光合色素的化学特性与光学特性，重点讲解光合作用的机理及影响光合作用的因素，介绍植物对光能的利用途径及光合产物的转运。 8. 动物与环境：重点讲解生物与环境关系的基本原理，说明污染物在环境中的行为及其生态效应。 9. 生态系统的组成与特征：掌握生态系统的结构：三大功能类群＋无机环境，及食物链、食物网、营养级等概念。重点掌握生态系统的物质生产、能量流动和信息传递过程。 10. 环境污染对生物的影响：简述不同生境的典型污染对生物的生态作用，重点讲解主要的生物多样性评价指标及其生态学意义。 11. 生态修复前沿技术探讨：举例说明生态修复领域的热点问题，重点引导学生分析生态修复领域热点问题中的生物学原理及其应用。 （3）本课程主要教材： 1.《陈阅增普通生物学(第四版)》，主编吴相钰、陈守良、葛明德， 2014年高等教育出版社出版 2.《植物生理学(第五版)(中译本)》，主编(美)Lincoln Taiz等，宋纯鹏等译,2015年科学出版社。
default.en: General Biology is an important foundational course for the Environmental Ecology major at institutions of higher education. It primarily addresses biological principles related to environmental pollution control and ecological restoration engineering. Unlike the more specialized focus of Pollution Control Microbiology, this course centers on cytology, botany, and zoology, discussing the common basic biological phenomena and underlying principles that are relevant to environmental ecological engineering. The aim is to equip students with the biological knowledge necessary for working in the field of environmental ecological engineering, a mastery of the fundamental biological theories and skills for the prevention and control of ecological environmental pollution, and the ability to apply biological principles to solve complex ecological environmental problems. This course builds upon foundational courses such as Environmental Science and Principles and Applications of Ecology, and leads into core courses like Environmental Systems Engineering and Environmental Ecological Engineering. Tailored to the characteristics of the Environmental Ecology major, the course integrates theoretical learning with biological issues in environmental ecology while emphasizing practical case studies where biological principles are applied in environmental ecological engineering projects.

default.zh: 生态毒理学是一门多学科交叉发展起来的科学，它的学习不仅需要综合应用多种学科知识，同时还必须学习相关的新概念、新理论、新技术，即可以帮助学生进一步提高环境意识，提高综合应用多种学科知识分析问题、解决问题的能力，同时还可以学习到以往未曾接触过的，关于生态毒理学的科学理论、实验手段和应用技术。总之，生态毒理学是一门综合性很强的科学，它对培养学生综合技能有着非常重要的作用，是环境生态工程等专业学生的必修课程。
default.en: Ecotoxicology is a multidisciplinary science that has developed through the integration of various fields. Its study not only requires the comprehensive application of knowledge from multiple disciplines, but also necessitates learning about new concepts, theories, and technologies. This can help students further enhance their environmental awareness and improve their ability to analyze and solve problems by integrating knowledge from various disciplines. Additionally, students can learn about scientific theories, experimental methods, and application techniques in ecotoxicology that they may not have encountered before. In summary, ecotoxicology is a highly integrated science that plays a very important role in cultivating students' comprehensive skills. It is a required course for students in environmental ecology engineering and related majors.

default.zh: 《生态环境应急管理》课程简介 随着社会、经济的快速发展，环境安全隐患和突发环境事件呈现出高度复合化、叠加化、非常规化的趋势，对人民群众的生命财产安全和社会稳定构成了威胁。因此，做好环境生态应急管理，即环境应急工作势在必行。 20世纪发生的多起环境公害事件极大地促进了西方发达国家对环境问题的重视和环境管理水平的提高。发达国家环境应急管理经历了三个阶段：单项防灾阶段、综合防灾阶段、应急预警管理阶段，目前已基本形成完善的环境应急管理体系。改革开放以来，与工业发展相伴随的环境问题和突发环境事件逐渐得到重视，我国环境应急管理工作伴随着生态环境保护事业发展而不断成长，经历了萌芽起步阶段、快速发展阶段和战略转型阶段等过程，逐渐形成了层次分明、重点突出的环境应急管理体系。 环境生态应急管理涉及环境风险管理和突发环境事件应急处置两大部分。 本课程共分9章，第1章主要介绍应急和环境应急管理的内涵和主要任务，环境应急管理体系和国内外环境应急管理的发展历程；第2章介绍安全与环境安全的内涵，安全科学的主要任务，我国环境安全的现状及影响因素；第3章介绍环境风险内涵和相关理论，环境风险评价方法和评估技术；第4章围绕环境风险管理，介绍环境风险源管理、控制及环境风险受体保护；第5章介绍突发环境事件应急准备，包括应急预案、应急资源准备、应急指挥系统、应急演练；第6章突发环境事件应急处置流程概述，包括突发环境事件的内涵、分类，相关的法律法规、基本流程；第7章介绍应急监测和应急技术，包括应急监测的特点、分类，应急技术选择和主要应急技术；第8章介绍生态环境损害评估，包括事后评估的内涵、任务和工作流程，生态环境损害评估的方法和工作流程；第9章突发环境事件处置典型案例分析，介绍不同类型的突发环境事件应急处置的全过程，以及相关报告的撰写。
default.en: 《Emergency Management of Ecological Environment》Course Description With the rapid development of society and economy, potential environmental safety hazards and abrupt environmental pollution accidents have shown a highly complex, overlapping, and unconventional trend, posing a threat to the safety of people's lives and property, and social stability. Therefore, it is imperative to do environmental ecological emergency management. Several environmental pollution events in the 20th century greatly promoted the western developed countries to attach importance to environmental problems and the improvement of environmental management levels. Environmental emergency management in developed countries has gone through three stages: single disaster prevention stage, comprehensive disaster prevention stage, and emergency warning management stage. At present, a complete environmental emergency management system has been basically formed. Environmental problems and environmental emergencies accompanied by industrial development have been attached much importance gradually since China's reform and opening-up. Environmental emergency management in China is growing with the development of ecological environmental protection. It has experienced several processes including budding stage, rapid development stage, and strategic transformation stage, and gradually formed a structured and prominent environmental emergency management system. Environmental ecological emergency management includes two major parts, namely, environmental risk management and environmental emergency management. This course is divided into 9 chapters. Chapter 1 introduces the connotation and main tasks of emergency and environmental emergency management, environmental emergency management system, and the history of environmental emergency management at home and abroad. Chapter 2 introduces the connotation of safety and environmental safety, the main tasks of safety science, and the status and influence factors of the environmental security in our country; Chapter 3 introduces the connotation of environmental risk and related theories, and environmental risk assessment methods and assessment techniques; Chapter 4 focuses on environmental risk management, introduces management and control of environmental risk source, and environmental risk receptor protection; Chapter 5 introduces emergency preparedness for environmental emergencies, including emergency plan, emergency resource preparation, emergency command system, and emergency drill. Chapter 6 overview of the emergency handling process of environmental emergencies, including the connotation, classification, relevant laws and regulations, and basic process of environmental emergencies; Chapter 7 introduces emergency monitoring and emergency technology, including the characteristics and classification of emergency monitoring, and selection of emergency technology and the main emergency technology; Chapter 8 introduces the damage assessment of ecological environment, including the connotation, task and workflow of the post assessment, and the method and workflow of the damage assessment of ecological environment. Chapter 9 analysis of typical cases of environmental emergency treatment, introduces the whole process of different types of environmental emergency treatment, and reports writing.

default.zh: 生物化学基础是运用化学的方法和理论研究生命物质的科学，主要任务是研究生命物质的化学组成、结构及生命活动过程中各种化学变化的基础生命科学。它研究生物体组成成分，如糖、脂、蛋白质、核酸、酶等的性质，结构及结构与功能的关系，研究生物体各种物质的新陈代谢，生物体的遗传信息的传递。在生命科学大发展的今天，生物化学作为环境学科多门主干课程的基础支撑课程，对学生后期专业研学至关重要。可以说，生物化学基础理论与实验课程在环境学科本科生的课程体系中，起着承上启下、多学科贯穿的重要作用，为进一步学习后续专业课程奠定坚实的理论基础。
default.en: The basic of biochemistry is the science that applies chemical methods and theories to study living materials, with the main task of studying the chemical composition, structure, and various chemical changes in the process of life activities of living materials as the foundation of life science. It studies the properties, structure, and relationship between structure and function of the components of living organisms, such as sugars, lipids, proteins, nucleic acids, enzymes, etc. It studies the metabolism of various substances in living organisms and the transmission of genetic information. In the era of great development in life sciences, biochemistry, as a fundamental supporting course for multiple backbone courses in environmental science, is crucial for students to pursue their professional studies in the later stage. It can be said that the basic theory and experimental courses of biochemistry play an important role in the curriculum system of undergraduate students in environmental science in bridging the gap and integrating multiple disciplines, laying a solid theoretical foundation for further learning of subsequent professional courses.

default.zh: 水污染控制工程（设计）是环境生态工程专业核心课程之一。该课程在介绍污水的性质、来源、水质标准的基础上，重点讲授污水物理、化学及生物处理工艺的基本概念、工程设计和运行管理的基础理论和方法；将污水水质指标、污水处理理论、原理和工艺技术设计计算紧密结合，并对常见的处理工艺进行系统化介绍，使学生对不同水质的水处理理论及方法有全面整体的认识。并通过课程设计强化学生对知识的理解与应用
default.en: “Water pollution control engineering (design)” is one of the core courses in the field of environmental and ecological engineering. On the basis of introducing the properties, sources, and water quality standards of sewage, this course focuses on teaching the basic concepts of sewage physics, chemistry, and biological treatment processes, as well as the basic theories and methods of engineering design and operation management; Integrate sewage quality indicators, sewage treatment theories, principles, and process technology design calculations closely, and systematically introduce common treatment processes, so that students have a comprehensive understanding of water treatment theories and methods with different water qualities. And strengthen students' understanding and application of knowledge through course design

default.zh: 污染控制理论与技术是环境生态工程专业的一门重要专业核心课。该课程从理论上系统深入的阐述了大气污染控制工程及固体废物处理与处置工程所涉及的原理及过程，体现了环境生态工程专业多介质污染联合治理的特色。本课程的主要研究内容包括燃烧与大气污染、大气污染气象学、颗粒物去除原理、技术及装置、硫化物及氮化物的污染控制；还包括固废收集及预处理、厌氧处理、热处理及资源化处理及填埋等技术。此外，本课程还包括四个实验。通过课程学习及实验操作，培养学生识别大气及固废污染的能力，并运用相关理论提出解决问题的能力。
default.en: Theory and Technology Pollution Control is an important course for students majored in environmental and ecological engineering. This course systematically and deeply expounds the principles and processes involved in air pollution control and solid waste treatment and disposal, and embodies the characteristics of multi-media pollution joint control in environmental and ecological engineering. The main research contents of this course include combustion and air pollution, meteorology of air pollution, principles, technologies and devices for particulate matter removal, pollution control of sulfide and nitride, solid waste collection and pretreatment, anaerobic treatment, heat treatment and resource treatment and landfill treatment. In addition, the course includes four experiments. Students will develop the ability to identify air and solid waste pollution, and apply relevant theories to propose and solve problems through course learning and experimental operation.

default.zh: 本课程针对生态工程专业的特点，紧密联系升天工程学科中的工作中将遇到的经济与各类文件写作等实际问题，在理论学习的同时注重生态工程实际案例教学的作用，通过本课程的学习，使学生理解技术经济学的基本理论、基本方法，能将经济学基本技能运用在生态工程项目前期决策中，在设计中综合工艺和经济分析两个因素进行分析。以达到能对生态工程项目进行公正、客观、合理评价的目的。 理解预算、概算、决算过程及算法，能够完成项目的造价计算。使学生具有运用造价软件的能力；并在造价软件的帮助下，完成项目的预算和概算。通过学习学生能够撰写项目建议书、可行性研究报告和施工图说明文件，并理解专业文件撰写的规范性和完整性。
default.en: Based on the characteristics of ecological engineering, this course is closely related to the practical problems encountered in the work of Shengtian Engineering, such as economy and various documents writing, and pays attention to the role of practical case teaching of ecological engineering while learning theories. Through this course, students can understand the basic theories and basic methods of technical economics. I can apply the basic skills of economics to the early decision-making of ecological engineering projects, and analyze the two factors of process and economic analysis in the design. In order to achieve the purpose of fair, objective and reasonable evaluation of ecological engineering projects. Understand budget, budget estimate, final accounting process and algorithm, and be able to complete the project cost calculation. Make students have the ability to use cost software; And with the help of the cost software, complete the project budget and budget estimates. Students will be able to write project proposals, feasibility studies and construction drawing descriptions, and understand the normality and integrity of professional document writing.

default.zh: 本课程是《水污染控制工程》的实验课，使学生通过实验巩固和理解理论知识，并实现如下目标：（1）使学生加深对水污染控制原理的理解，理解并准确表达水污染控制工程中的物化、生化处理工艺过程；（2）掌握一般水处理实验技能和仪器、设备的使用方法，学会设计实验方案和组织实验的方法，掌握数据处理方法；（3）培养和提高学生动手能力、实验（含虚拟仿真）操作技能、观察及分析问题的能力，进一步培养学生综合利用所学知识解决水污染控制实际问题的能力。
default.en: This experimental course belongs to the course of "Water Pollution Control Engineering", which aims to help students consolidate and understand theoretical knowledge through experiments, and achieve the following goals: (1) deepen their understanding of the principles of water pollution control, understand and accurately express the physicochemical and biochemical treatment processes in water pollution control engineering; (2) Master general water treatment experimental skills and the use of instruments and equipment, learn how to design experimental plans and organize experiments, and master data processing methods; (3) Cultivate and improve students' hands-on ability, experimental (including virtual simulation) operation skills, observation and analysis ability, and further cultivate their ability to comprehensively use the knowledge they have learned to solve practical problems in water pollution control.

default.zh: 《水质工程学实验》是给排水科学与工程专业必修的专业课。本课程详细介绍了水质工程学实验的原理、方式、方法、过程等，同时也介绍了常用的水质工程仪器设备的使用方法及操作过程。本课程重点培养学生理论联系实践的能力、分析问题解决问题的能力。学生在课程学习中独立完成实验的各个环节，通过课程学习提高与完善学生的操作技能，培养学生初步的科研能力，并培养学生团队协作和吃苦耐劳的精神。
default.en: Experiment of Water Quality Engineering is one of a required professional course for the major of Water and Wastewater Engineering. The course will introduce the principles, means, methods and processes of water treatment engineering experiment. It also introduces the use-method and operational process of the frequently-used water and wastewater treatment equipment. This course focuses on training the abilities for the students of linking theory with practice, analyzing problems and solving problems. The students must finish all aspects of the experiment independently. With this training, the course will improve the operational skills, primary research capacity and team spirit and tough spirit of the students.

default.zh: 水环境科学实验课程结合环境科学大尺度与微尺度兼有、以及测重检测分析的特点，培养学生掌握水环境科学一般研究方法，并结合环境科学前沿新兴热点水环境问题引入新手段和新技术。课程内容包括6部分实验。其中典型传统实验包括，水质分析的悬浮物和总有机碳测定、反映活性污泥性能的污泥沉降比、污泥指数等综合性指标的检测分析方法以及混凝工艺条件优化实验；探索性实验包括，细菌的紫外消杀和纳米材料除菌新技术、基于拉曼散射和表面增强拉曼技术的新污染物检测分析方法、使用python语言构建基于机器学习的定量结构-效应关系模型的方法及污染物性质预测应用。通过本实验课程的学习，能够使环境科学学生在环境化学、微生物学、纳米材料、机器学习等交叉领域，扩大知识领域、拓展前瞻性分析能力、提升未来科研素质，使学生具有更好的潜力更长远的发展。
default.en: The typical feature of Experiments for Water Environmental Science is to use different detection methods which should cover both traditional methods and new technologies for emerging or hot topics in the macroscale and microscale of environmental sciences. The course follows the keywords of emerging environmental pollutants and bacteria. It includes totally 6 parts. The typical traditional experiments cover water quality analysis, performance assessment of activated sludge, and optimization for coagulation process. The new ones include sterilization methods by ultraviolet and nanomaterials, emerging pollutant detection by Raman spectrum and surface enhanced Raman scattering, and the method of using python language to build a quantitative structure effect relationship model based on machine learning for pollutant property prediction. The course provides a broad, interdisciplinary learning experience, students therefore can get the ability of forward-looking, scientific consideration in the fields of environmental chemistry, microbiology, nanomaterials and machine learning, so as to make students have better potential in the future.

default.zh: 本课程结合大气环境科学课程理论教学，通过科学实验向学生讲授大气环境科学知识的实践与应用，包括大气化学实验、大气污染物监测、大气颗粒物化学组分分析实验、大气污染物检测方法、气象参数监测及数据分析实验。通过实验实践巩固大气环境科学课程讲授的知识重点和难点，结合国内外最新研究进展，培养学生分析大气环境质量参数、解决大气污染防治问题的能力，为同学们进一步从事大气环境监测和污染控制相关的科研及环境管理工作打下系统的基础。本课程要求学生掌握气态污染物和颗粒态污染物的物理和化学特性，气象与大气污染传输的关系，大气复合污染的形成机制，以及大气颗粒物化学组分分析的技术方法。本课程注重基础理论学习与科研实践相结合，通过实验教学达成以下目标。以实验教学为主，实验课前发放实验操作教程，短视频描述实验难点和要点，帮助学生课前预习实验课内容。实验课由主讲教师演示实验，学生同步开展实验，规范学生的实验操作，确保学生掌握符合国家标准和学科前沿的实验方法。以提交六次实验报告的方式考核，提醒学生对实验过程进行记录，做实验课观察日记。
default.en: Associated with the theoretical teaching of atmospheric environmental science course, and the practice and application of atmospheric environmental science knowledge to students through scientific experiments, including atmospheric chemistry experiment, atmospheric pollutant monitoring, atmospheric particulate matter chemical component analysis experiment, atmospheric pollutant detection method, meteorological parameter monitoring and data analysis experiment. Through experimental practice to consolidate atmospheric environmental science course knowledge emphases and difficulties, combined with the latest research progress worldwide, training students to analyze the atmospheric environmental quality parameters, gained the abilities to solve the problem of atmospheric pollution control, for the further engagement in atmospheric environmental monitoring and pollution control related scientific research and environmental management work to lay the foundation of the system. The course requires students to master the physical and chemical characteristics of gaseous and particulate pollutants, the relationship between meteorology and atmospheric pollution transmission, the formation mechanism of atmospheric compound pollution, and the technical methods of the chemical component analysis of atmospheric particulate matter. This course focuses on the combination of basic theory study with scientific research practice, and achieves the following goals through experimental teaching. Based on experimental teaching, experimental operation courses are issued before the experimental class, and short videos describe the difficulties and key points of the experiment, to help students preview the content of the experimental class before class. The experiment class is demonstrated by the lecturer, and the students carry out the experiment simultaneously. The lecturer will standardize the experiment operation of the students, and ensure that the students master the experiment methods that comply with the national standards and discipline frontier. The student will gain the credits by submitting 6 experiment reports. The lecturer will remind the students to record the experiment process and make the observation diary during the class.

default.zh: 通过环境科学综合实验的学习实践，使学生加深对相关基础课程理论知识的理解，强化动手能力和操作技能的训练，培养学生严谨的科学态度、良好的工作习惯和独立分析问题、解决问题的能力，掌握环境样品采集、保存、运输与处理水、大气、土壤等环境中痕量有机污染物的监测技术检测方法。
default.en: Through the study and practice of comprehensive experiments in environmental science, students can deepen their understanding of the theoretical knowledge of relevant basic courses, strengthen the training of hands-on ability and operational skills, and cultivate students' rigorous scientific attitude, good working habits, and ability to independently analyze and solve problems. Master environmental sample collection, preservation, transportation and treatment of trace organic pollutants in water, atmosphere, soil and other environmental monitoring technology detection methods.

default.zh: 本课程是在环境科学基础实验训练的基础上开设，着重探讨污水污泥处理过程中污染物的迁移转化规律、微生物驱动机制、及资源化利用途径。通过微生物技术与环境科学的交叉融合，深化学生对污染控制与资源回收协同策略的理解，掌握污水污泥处理的核心实验方法与分析手段，提升从微观机理到宏观工艺设计的贯通能力。
default.en: This course builds upon foundational training in environmental science experiments, focusing on the investigation of pollutant migration and transformation mechanisms, microbial-driven processes, and resource utilization pathways in sewage and sludge treatment. Through the interdisciplinary integration of microbial technologies and environmental sciences, it aims to deepen students' understanding of synergistic strategies for pollution control and resource recovery. Participants will master core experimental methods and analytical techniques for sewage and sludge treatment, while enhancing their ability to bridge the gap between microscopic mechanisms and macroscopic process design.

default.zh: 本课程基于《大气污染控制工程》和《固体废物处理与资源化》基础理论及专业知识学习的基础上开展实验教学内容。本课程分为大气污染控制工程课程实验和固体废物处理与资源化课程实验两部分。大气污染控制工程课程实验主要针对不同大气污染物的理化特性，明晰其产生、净化特点，能够设计可行的研究和实验方案，利用大气污染控制方面仪器和设备完成采集、数据整理及实验结果的分析讨论。固体废物处理与资源化课程实验主要包括固体废物预处理、性质分析、资源化与安全处理等方面，培养学生设计实验、动手操作及分析实验能力。
default.en: This course is based on "air pollution control engineering" and "solid waste treatment and resource utilization" basic theory and professional knowledge based on the study of experimental teaching content. This course is divided into two parts: air pollution control engineering course experiment and solid waste treatment and resource utilization course experiment. Air pollution control engineering course experiments mainly for different physical and chemical properties of air pollutants, clear its generation, purification characteristics, to be able to design feasible research and experimental programs, the use of air pollution control instruments and equipment to complete the collection, data sorting and analysis and discussion of experimental results. Solid waste treatment and resource utilization course experiments mainly include solid waste pre-treatment, property analysis, resource utilization and safe treatment, etc., to train students to design experiments, hands-on operation and analysis of experimental capabilities.

default.zh: 《水质工程原理与系统模拟实验》是城市水系统工程专业实验课程之一。通过实验要点讲授和引导学生实际操作与城市水系统水质净化与资源化课程重点理论知识密切相关的实验项目，强化学生对水质净化与资源化相关理论知识理解，培养学生知识检索、方案设计与实施、数据整理、实验结果分析评述等方面的综合能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: "Water Quality Engineering Principle and System Simulation Experiment" is one of the main courses of urban water system engineering. By teaching and guiding students to operate experimental projects closely related to the key theoretical knowledge of urban water system water quality purification and resource utilization through key experimental points, we aim to strengthen their understanding of theoretical knowledge related to water quality purification and resource utilization, cultivate their comprehensive abilities in knowledge retrieval, scheme design and implementation, data organization, and analysis and evaluation of experimental results, and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《建筑给水排水工程A》是给水排水工程专业的专业主干课之一。是一门为工业和民用建筑提供必需的生产条件和舒适、卫生、安全的生活环境的应用科学。本课程共包含两部分内容：建筑给水排水部分和高层建筑给水排水部分。建筑给水排水部分主要内容包括建筑内部的给水、消防给水、排水、雨水、热水供应等有关内容的基本理论、设计原理及设计方法。同时还涉及安装、管理方面的基本知识和技术。通过此部分内容的学习，可以使学生进一步巩固基础课和专业基础课知识；培养学生运用先修课程的基本理论解决应用学科问题的能力。同时为学生开展毕业设计奠定了基础。 高层建筑给水排水部分内容是为高层工业和民用建筑提供必需的生产条件和舒适、卫生、安全的生活环境的应用科学。通过本课程的学习，要求学生掌握高层建筑给水排水工程的基本理论、设计原理和方法及安装、管理方面的基本知识。具有高层建筑给水排水工程的设计、施工及管理能力，了解本学科国内外发展动向和先进技术。该课程是为给排水工程专业学生毕业设计和毕业后就业做准备的必修课程。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、案例剖析和课程设计等环节培养学生的工程思维和专业知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: “Water supply and drainage engineering in building A " is one of the major courses of Water supply and drainage engineering. It is an applied science that provides necessary production conditions and comfortable, sanitary and safe living environment for industrial and civil buildings. This course contains two parts: building water supply and drainage part and high-rise building water supply and drainage part. The building water supply and drainage part mainly includes the basic theory, design principle and design method of the building internal water supply, fire water supply, drainage, rainwater, hot water supply and other related contents. At the same time, it also involves the basic knowledge and technology of installation and management. Through the study of this part, students can further consolidate the knowledge of basic courses and specialized basic courses. To cultivate the students' ability to solve the problems of applied subjects by using the basic theories of the preparatory courses. At the same time for the students to carry out the graduation design to lay a foundation. The water supply and drainage of high-rise buildings is an applied science that provides necessary production conditions and comfortable, sanitary and safe living environment for high-rise industrial and civil buildings. Through the study of this course, students are required to master the basic theories, design principles and methods of water supply and drainage engineering of high-rise buildings, as well as the basic knowledge of installation and management. With the design, construction and management ability of high-rise building water supply and drainage engineering, understand the development trend and advanced technology of this discipline at home and abroad. This course is a required course for students majoring in Water supply and drainage engineering to prepare for their graduation design and employment after graduation. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' engineering thinking and application ability of professional knowledge through classroom teaching, case analysis and course design, and support the achievement of corresponding index points in professional learning results.

default.zh: 本门课程内容专为城市规划系本科生设计,目的是使该专业学生具有强烈的生态意识、环境保护意识，了解掌握基本的城市生态学与环境保护知识常识，具备将生态学理念、环境保护理念运用于城市规划设计中的能力。课程共包含6个专题内容:城市水资源与水污染控制规划、城市空气与大气污染控制规划、城市固体废弃物的管理与资源化、城市物理环境保护、城市生态学基础。
default.en: The contents of this course are designed for undergraduates of urban planning department in special to bring on their sense of ecology and environmental protection, provide them the common knowledge of Urban Ecology and Environmental Protection, and make them capable of applying the principles of ecology and environmental protection in urban planning. It includes six subjects totally: summarization of environmental protection, urban water resource and water pollution control planning, urban air and atmosphere pollution control planning, management and recycle of urban solid wastes, urban physical environment protection, urban ecology basics.

default.zh: 环境决策支持系统是环境科学专业的必修课。该课程是一门计算机技术与环境科学的交叉学科，是研究如何更好的利用计算机技术来预防和控制环境污染的课程，它为决策者提供分析问题、建立模型、模拟决策过程和方案的环境，调用各种信息资源和分析工具，帮助决策者提高环境决策水平和质量。本课程针对计算机技术发展现状和环境科学专业特点，紧密联系当前出现的主要环境污染问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境科学与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实验教学达成以下目标：第一，使学生能够将环境大数据分析方法、知识库系统、数据库设计方法、地理信息系统、全球定位系统、遥感技术等基本科学理论和方法应用到建立环境决策支持系统中，进而运用系统得到预防与控制环境污染的合理决策方案；第二，通过GIS软件的上机学习、GPS接收仪的操作练习，使得同学们获得对于环境空间数据的获取、分析和处理的能力，进而更好的分析空间现象，解决环境问题。
default.en: Environmental Decision Support System (EDSS) is a compulsory course of the major of environmental science. As an interdiscipline of computer science and environmental science, this course focus on environmental pollution controlling based on computer technology. EDSS provides the deciders a platform for analyzing problems, building models, simulating decision making processes and projects, and helps the deciders improve the environmental decision-making levels and quality. This course integrates the current situation of computer technology and the characteristics of environmental science with major environmental pollution problems, and combines the theoretical study with actual project case. The mainly teaching objects: Firstly, help the students to apply basic scientific theories and methods including environment big data analysis method, knowledge base system, database design method, geographic information system, global positioning system, and remote sensing technology to EDSS, and obtain an optimal plan for preventing and controlling environmental pollution. Secondly, based on the application of GIS and the operation of GPS receiver, help the students to obtain, analyze, and process environmental data, analyze the spatial phenomena, and solve the environmental problems.

default.zh: 环境统计学是统计学基本原理应用到环境领域的学科，是一门关于收集、整理和分析环境领域统计数据的方法论科学，其目的在于揭示环境问题与现象的数量表现、数量关系以及规律性。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解和掌握统计设计、统计调查、统计整理和统计分析的基本理论和方法。在教学的过程中除引入应用于环境领域的实例教学，培养学生的统计学思想方法的应用能力，教学引入Excel和SPSS软件完成统计计算操作，加强对统计学方法的应用训练，提高学生的计算机应用能力。
default.en: This course focuses on the application of statistics in the environmental sciences. Environemt Statistics is a scientific methodology for collecting, organizing, and analyzing data related to the environment to identify environmental issues, trends, and relationships quantitatively. The course aims to equip students with a solid understanding of fundamental statistical theories and methods, including statistical design, data collection, organization, and analysis. Practical applications in environmental fields are integrated into the curriculum to enhance students' proficiency in applying statistical reasoning. Instruction will involve the use of Excel and SPSS software for calculations, aiming to enhance students' adeptness on statistical methods and computer applications.

default.zh: 智慧水务管理概论是环境专业的选修课。智慧水务是智慧城市的重要组成部分，是综合运用现代科学技术，以创新思维、科技赋能来加强和统筹城市规划、建设和管理的新模式，通过数字化手段，对城市的供水、排水设施系统的运行全程进行实时监测，及早发现问题和解决问题，以智慧手段提高城市的韧性，也是推进城市生命线安全工程建设的重要内容。智慧水务管理概论是一门信息技术与环境科学与工程技术的交叉学科，是研究如何更好的利用现代信息技术解决如城市内涝防治、城市水资源保护、黑臭水体治理等问题的课程。本课程针对信息技术发展现状和环境科学与工程专业特点，紧密联系当前出现的主要城市水务问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境科学与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实践教学助力水务行业交叉学科拔尖创新人才培养。
default.en: Introduction to Smart Water Management is an elective course for environmental majors. Smart water management is an essential part of smart cities, representing a new model that comprehensively applies modern science and technology, empowered by innovative thinking and technology, to enhance and coordinate urban planning, construction, and management. Through digital means, it involves real-time monitoring of the city's water supply and drainage system operations, promptly identifying and solving problems. This approach aims to improve the city's resilience with smart measures and is a crucial aspect of advancing the construction of urban lifeline safety projects. Introduction to Smart Water Management is an interdisciplinary subject that intersects information technology with environmental science and engineering. It explores how to better utilize modern information technology to address issues such as urban waterlogging prevention, urban water resource protection, and the management of polluted and foul-smelling water bodies. This course is tailored to the current state of information technology development and the characteristics of the environmental science and engineering discipline. It closely relates to the main urban water issues emerging today, emphasizing the role of actual environmental science and engineering case studies in theoretical learning. Through classroom and practical teaching, the course aims to support the training of top innovative talents in interdisciplinary fields within the water industry.

default.zh: 海绵城市建设是一个系统工程，海绵城市建设涉及城市水系、绿地系统、排水防涝、道路交通等多领域规划，同时需要政府规划、排水、道路、园林、交通等部门与地产项目业主之间协调合作，以及排水、园林、道路、交通、建筑等多专业领域协作，涉及许多重要学科，包括给排水科学与工程、园林景观、道路桥梁、交通工程、水利工程、建筑工程、环境工程等。海绵城市建设得到全民关注，作为相关专业的学生，有必要增加相应的学科知识和学科技能，本门课程着重于海绵城市建设理念的解读、海绵城市规划建设的技术与案例拓展，以及工程案例的应用介绍，旨在补充学生在海绵城市规划和建设中的知识技能。
default.en: Sponge city construction is a systematic project, sponge city construction involves urban water system, green space system, drainage and flood prevention, road traffic and other areas of planning, and at the same time, it requires coordination and cooperation between the government departments of planning, drainage, roads, landscaping, transportation and real estate project owners, as well as collaboration in multi-disciplinary fields such as drainage, landscaping, roads, transportation, construction, etc., which involves many important disciplines, including water supply and drainage science and engineering, Landscaping, roads and bridges, transportation engineering, water conservancy engineering, architectural engineering, environmental engineering and so on. The construction of sponge city gets the attention of all people, as the students of related majors, it is necessary to increase the corresponding subject knowledge and subject skills. This course focuses on the interpretation of the concept of sponge city construction, the expansion of the technology and cases of sponge city planning and construction, as well as the introduction of the application of the engineering cases, which is aimed at supplementing the knowledge and skills of the students in the planning and construction of sponge city.

default.zh: 本课程为环境工程相关专业本科生提供水文学和水资源管理工程的概览，要求学生掌握基本的水文资料收集、计算、水资源优化调度等工程技能，用于解决复杂环境工程问题；同时培养和训练学生在处理复杂的工程问题和环境决策方面的实际问题时的系统分析思维习惯,地找到合理有效的解决问题的思路。
default.en: This course offers undergraduate students majoring in environmental engineering an introduction to water supply literature and water resource management engineering. Students will develop essential engineering skills, including hydrological data collection, calculation, and water resource optimization scheduling, to address intricate environmental engineering issues. The course aims to foster systematic analytical thinking and equip students with the ability to tackle complex engineering and environmental decision-making challenges effectively and rationally.

default.zh: 景观生态学作为上世纪70年代以来迅速崛起的新兴学科，除了传统生态学的基本原理和思想外，还体现了地理学、生态学、系统论等多个学科交叉，为综合解决资源环境问题，全面开展生态文明建设，提供了全新的理论和科学方法，并开辟了新的思路。 本课程主要融合地理学上的景观与环境学中的生态，把地理学对地理现象的空间相互作用的横向研究和生态学对生态系统机能相互作用的纵向研究集合为一体，以景观为对象，通过物质流、能量流、信息流和物种流在地球表层的迁移与交换，研究景观的空间结构、功能及各部分之间的相互关系，研究景观的动态变化及景观优化利用和保护的原理与途径。尤其是将景观生态学的理念融入到景观设计应用中，把景观作为一个有机生命体来考虑，投入较少的能量与物质，通过系统内部物质循环和能量转换获得较大的生态效益和社会效益，达到自然与人类和谐发展的目标。 本课程通过教学使学生能够掌握景观生态学的基本概念、基本理论、基本原理，全面深入地了解和掌握景观生态学原理的应用，在景观设计过程中科学地解决所面临的实际问题，提高学生解决复杂工程问题的能力。
default.en: Landscape ecology as a rapid rise emerging disciplines since 1970s, consists not only the basic principles and ideas of traditional ecology, but also the geography, ecology, system theory and many other disciplines. Landscape ecology offers a new theoretical and scientific methods for the comprehensive solution to the problem of resources and environment and the construction of ecological civilization. It also opens up a new way of thinking. This course focus on combining the landscape in geography and ecology in environmental science. It takes a horizontal study on the spatial interaction of geographical phenomenon in geography and a longitudinal study on the interaction of ecosystem function in ecology as one to study. The course takes the landscape as object, providing the spatial structure and function of the landscape through the material flow, energy flow, information flow and species flow’s migration and exchange in the Earth's surface, and the interrelationship between the various parts.
