It also introduces the dynamic changes in the landscape and the principles and ways to landscape optimization and protection. In particularly, the course introduces landscape design and its methods based on landscape ecology concept, taking the landscape as an organic life to consider, consuming less energy and material, through the system of material circulation and energy conversion to obtain greater ecological and social benefits and to achieve the goal of natural and human harmonious development. This course enables students to master the basic concepts, basic theories and basic principles of landscape ecology, to comprehensively and thoroughly understand and master the application of landscape ecology principles, to scientifically solve the practical problems in the process of landscape design, and to improve their abilities to solve complex engineering problems.

default.zh: 本课程通过讲解植物对环境污染的响应与反馈机制，介绍功能植物在大气、水、土壤污染的净化机制及影响因素，结合具体功能植物的应用实例、科研前沿与行业发展，提高学生对工程的概念与对科研的理解；使学生能够基于工程相关背景，合理分析和评价工程项目和复杂工程问题解决方案对社会、健康、安全、法律及文化的影响；同时能够合理评价针对复杂工程问题的工程实践对环境、社会可持续发展的影响。 课程内容包括绪论、植物的基础代谢、植物对环境污染的响应与反馈、植物对环境污染的监测作用、植物对大气、水、土壤污染的净化功能等7章。课程考核主要包括课堂参与情况和专题汇报。
default.en: This course aims to improve students' understanding of engineering concepts and scientific research by explaining the response and feedback mechanisms of plants to environmental pollution, introducing the purification mechanisms and influencing factors of functional plants in air, water, and soil pollution, and combining specific application examples, research frontiers, and industry development of functional plants; Enable students to analyze and evaluate the impact of engineering projects and complex engineering problem solutions on society, health, safety, law, and culture based on engineering related backgrounds; At the same time, it is possible to reasonably evaluate the impact of engineering practices targeting complex engineering problems on environmental and social sustainable development. The course content includes 7 chapters: Introduction, Basic Metabolism of Plants, Response and Feedback of Plants to Environmental Pollution, Monitoring Role of Plants in Environmental Pollution, and Purification Function of Plants in Air, Water, and Soil Pollution. The course assessment mainly includes classroom participation and special reports.

default.zh: 村镇环境治理是指导学生通过村镇环境污染特点的学习，运用水污染的治理与固体废弃物的处理及资源化技术，解决村镇的面源污染和点源污染问题的一门课程。本课程立足生态文明建设，解决村镇环境遇到的实际问题，在理论学习的同时实现村镇实际案例教学，加强大家对村镇环境保护责任的认知，理解我国村镇可持续发展的内涵。
default.en: The Environmental Governance in Villages and Towns course aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills to address non-point source and point source pollution issues prevalent in rural areas. By examining the unique characteristics of environmental pollution in villages and towns, and utilizing techniques such as water pollution management, solid waste treatment, and resource technology, students are able to tackle practical environmental challenges within these communities. Through the lens of constructing an ecological civilization, this course facilitates the resolution of environmental issues specific to rural environments. It also delves into practical case studies pertaining to villages and towns, enhancing the awareness and accountability for environmental protection in these areas. Ultimately, this course contributes to a deeper understanding of the principles of sustainable development within Chinese villages and towns.

default.zh: 通过本课程的学习使学生熟练掌握以城市排水工程设计为代表的工程设计的任务书组成、设计要求与重点参数、计算要点及工程设计标准规范，在此基础上通过对 “工程是什么、设计如何做”等问题的深入剖析，配合案例分析，深化学生对如何做好城市排水工程设计的认识（包括选题、工艺选择原则、工艺方案比较、工程总体布局优化、图纸的正确绘制），深入了解相关标准规范对设计的影响，构建优秀工程案例设计具备的要素。通过对本课程的学习，使学生具备做好以排水工程为代表的工程设计的能力，做到设计方案选择的科学性、设计的系统性、构图的规范性、计算的准确性和运行的节能性，为进入相关研究生的学习及实际工作储备背景知识和专业技巧。
default.en: This course is a compulsory course for environmental engineering majors, and it has been regarded as one of the main courses for urban drainage engineering design, especially in understanding of the task compositions, design requirements, key parameters, calculation points and engineering design standards. On this basis, make the concept of "what is engineering and how to design" deeply to the understanding of all students. This course would deepen students' understanding of how to master the skills in drainage engineering design (including topic selection, process selection principles, process scheme comparison, overall project layout optimization, and correct drawing of drawings), and further understand the impact of relevant standards on design, and build the elements of excellent engineering case design. Through the study of this course, students will be equipped with the ability to do a good job in engineering design represented by drainage engineering, so as to achieve scientific design scheme selection, systematic design, normative composition, accurate calculation and energy-saving operation. The course would support professional skills for the study and practical work of relevant postgraduate students.

default.zh: 生物技术是环境治理的主要手段，现代生物学技术的合理利用是保障环境保护工程顺利实施及环境保护新技术创新研发的基础。环境生物技术是一门由现代生物技术与环境工程相结合的新兴交叉学科，可以直接或间接利用完整的生物体或生物体的某些组成部分或某些机能，降解环境中的污染物质。本课程通过介绍基因工程、细胞工程、环境微生物群落的检测技术等现代生物技术的基本原理，能够将现代生物技术的基本科学理论用于环境问题及工程分析，获得应用生物技术解决复杂环境工程问题的能力；通过讲解生物技术在环境工程领域应用的实例，使学生可以应用生物学的基本理论和技术方法，分析复杂环境工程问题，选择研究路线，设计可行的实验方案；通过介绍环境生物技术的前沿动态，使学生可以了解到环境生物技术的发展趋势，可以设计、研发环境保护新技术。
default.en: Biotechnology is the primary method to treat the environmental issues. The rational use of modern biological technology is the basis for implementation of environmental protection projects and development of the innovative environmental protection technology. Environmental biotechnology is an emerging discipline which combines biotechnology and environmental engineering. The discipline can directly or indirectly utilizes certain components or certain functions of a complete organism to establish a reduction or elimination of pollutants in environment. This course introduces the principles of modern biotechnology such as genetic engineering, cell engineering, and environmental microbial community detection techniques to enable students to apply biotechnology to solve environmental problems. Applications of environmental biotechnology are also introduced in this course to help students analyze environmental issues and determine rational solution by using biotechnology. By introducing the cutting edge of environmental biotechnology in this course, students can understand the development trend of environmental biotechnology, designing and developing new technologies for environmental protection.

default.zh: 《建筑给水排水工程B》是适用于工程类各专业的选修课，涉及人们赖以生活、工作和社会活动的各种建筑，是一门为工业和民用建筑提供必需的生产条件和舒适、卫生、安全的生活环境的应用科学。该课程主要内容包括建筑内部的给水、消防给水、排水、雨水等有关内容的基本理论、设计原理及设计方法。同时还涉及安装、管理方面的基本知识和技术。通过本课程的学习，使学生系统地学习和掌握建筑内部的给水、消防给水、排水、雨水系统的基本理论、相关计算、主要材料和设施，以及安装管理等方面的基本知识；使学生初步掌握建筑给水排水工程中各系统设计原理、设计方法，以及安装、管理方面的基本技能，培养学生具备建筑给水排水工程设计、运行管理等方面的初步工程实践能力。
default.en: 《Enginering of Water Supply and Drainage in Building B》is an elective course applicable to various engineering majors, involving various buildings that people rely on for life, work, and social activities. It is an applied science that provides necessary production conditions and a comfortable, hygienic, and safe living environment for industrial and civil buildings. The main content of this course includes basic theories, design principles, and design methods related to internal water supply, fire water supply, drainage, rainwater, and other related content in buildings. At the same time, it also involves basic knowledge and technology in installation and management. Through the study of this course, students will systematically learn and master the basic theories, related calculations, main materials and facilities, as well as installation management of water supply, fire water supply, drainage, and rainwater systems inside buildings; To enable students to initially master the design principles and methods of various systems in building water supply and drainage engineering, as well as basic skills in installation and management, and to cultivate students with preliminary engineering practical abilities in building water supply and drainage engineering design, operation management, and other aspects.

default.zh: 《给水处理》是环境工程和环境科学专业的专业选修课，是水工程学科的重要组成部分。本课程旨在向学生全面讲授给水处理中主要技术单元的基本原理和特点、工艺的基本计算方法和应用范围、主要构筑物的构成和运行特点、典型给水处理工艺以及相关技术的国内外最新研究进展。紧密联系环境科学与工程学科中的实际问题，在理论学习的同时注重实际案例教学的作用，通过课程学习达成以下目标： 1.能够基于混凝、沉淀、过滤、消毒的原理并采用科学方法，对给水处理过程中复杂环境工程问题进行分析并得到合理有效的结论； 2.通过该课程的学习，培养学生具有给水处理过程设计、运行管理与科学研究的基础能力，为进一步的工程设计、科研及运行管理等工作奠定理论和应用基础； 3.运用现代信息技术/文献研究获取给水处理领域的新理论和前沿技术进展，启发学生的独立思考和创新思维能力。
default.en: "Treatment for Drinking Water" is a specialized optional course for undergraduates who major in Environmental Engineering and Environmental Science, an important part of the water engineering discipline. This course will provide students with a comprehensive introduction of the basic principles and characteristics of the main technical units in water treatment, the basic calculation methods and application of the treatment process, the composition and operation characteristics of the main treatment structures, the typical water treatment processes and the latest research progress of related technologies worldwide. Closely relating to the practical problems in the environmental disciplines, this course focus on the role of case study on theory teaching in order to achieve the following targets: 1. Based on the principles of coagulation, sedimentation, filtration and disinfection processes, the complex environmental engineering problems in the process of water treatment can be analyzed as well as the reasonable and effective conclusions can be obtained; 2. Through this course, the students will develop the basic ability of water treatment process design, operation management and scientific research, and lay a theoretical and application foundation for further engineering design, scientific research and operation management; 3. Using modern information technology, the students can obtain new theories and cutting-edge technological advances in the field of water treatment, and inspire students' independent and innovative thinking ability.

default.zh: 特种水处理是环境工程、环境科学等专业的专业课之一。通过该门课程的教学，使学生掌握不同种类废水的来源、特性及其对环境、社会的危害。熟悉相关法律法规、标准、规范，能够基于环境工程相关背景知识合理分析水量水质特征并提出相应处理工艺。在学生的专业知识培养与技能训练中，具有很强的工程实践性。本课程的作用训练和培养环境工程、环境科学本科生分析实际问题和解决实际问题的能力，为学生今后在解决特种废水处理的科研、工程设计及运行管理等方面打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Special water treatment is one of the specialized courses in environmental engineering and environmental science. Through the teaching of this course, students can master the sources and characteristics of different kinds of wastewater and its harm to the environment and society. Familiar with the relevant laws and regulations, standards and norms, and be able to reasonably analyze the characteristics of water quantity and quality and propose the corresponding treatment process based on the background knowledge of environmental engineering. In the students' professional knowledge training and skills training, it has strong engineering practice. The role of this course to train and cultivate environmental engineering, environmental science undergraduate students to analyze practical problems and solve practical problems, for students to solve the future of special wastewater treatment in scientific research, engineering design and operation management to lay a solid foundation.

default.zh: 环境政策与案例分析课程包括环境问题的概念与成因，环境法的基本原则，以及环境问题预防、管制和救济环节的基本法律制度（如环境标准、环境计划、环境影响评价、环境许可、排污权交易、信息公开、公众参与、排污费、行政处罚、公益诉讼和环境侵权）；帮助学生掌握环境法的交叉特性，识别环境法议题，了解国家、一般人民及产业界在环境保护中的角色定位及相应的权力、权利和义务，掌握环境法在预防、管制和救济各环节中基本法律制度，能够运用本课程所学知识、方法，理性分析环境问题的成因以及法律制度。
default.en: The course on environmental policy and case study includes the concepts and causes of environmental problems, the basic principles of environmental law, and the basic legal systems in the prevention, control and relief of environmental problems (such as environmental standards, environmental plans, environmental impact assessment, environmental permits, emissions trading, information disclosure, public participation, sewage charges, administrative penalties, public interest litigation, and environmental torts). To help students understand the cross-cutting nature of environmental law; to identify the issues of environmental law; to understand the roles of the state, the general public and the industry in environmental protection and their corresponding powers, rights and obligations; to grasp the basic legal system of environmental law in the prevention, control and relief aspects; and to be able to rationally analyze the causes of environmental problems as well as the legal system by applying the knowledge and methods learned in this course.

default.zh: 环境经济学是环境科学专业环境管理方向的重要课程，通门课程的教学内容将为学生今后从事环境管理等工作打下坚实的基础。通过对《环境经济学》课程的学习，使学生熟悉“环境经济学”这一交叉学科的总体轮廓和最主要的内容，掌握其基本的理论知识和分析评价方法及其应用，了解当今主要的环境经济政策。本门课程的考核方法包括随堂小作业（10分），课后大作业（10分），期末考试（80分）。
default.en: Environmental economics is an important course in the field of environmental management for the major of environmental science. The content of this course will lay a solid foundation for students to engage in environmental management and other work in the future. By studying this course, students will become familiar with the overall outline and main content of the interdisciplinary field' Environmental Economics', master its basic theoretical knowledge and application by the economic analysis and evaluation methods ,as well as understand the main environmental and economic policies at present. . The assessment methods for this course include exercises during class (10 points), assignment (10 points), and final exams (80 points).

default.zh: 长期以来，我国以煤为主的能源结构，使得全国城市大气环境呈现高浓度的二氧化硫和可吸入颗粒物污染。近20年来，随着经济的快速发展，城市化进程不断加速，高速发展的城市交通和汽车产业又导致了严重的机动车尾气污染。发达国家经历了近百年的环境污染问题在我国经济发达地区二三十年内便集中爆发，老的污染问题尚未解决，新的污染问题又接踵而至。在我国城市群出现了煤烟型与机动车污染共存的特殊大气复合污染，具有明显的局地污染和区域污染相结合、污染物之间相互耦合的特征，其表现为大气氧化能力不断增强、高浓度细颗粒物（PM2.5）使大气能见度下降。大气环境形势总体上进入了以多污染物共存、多污染源叠加、多尺度关联、多过程演化、多介质影响为特征的复合型大气污染阶段，已经对我国公众健康和生态安全构成巨大威胁，并存在发生环境灾变的隐患。在这样的背景下，我国相继实施了大气污染防治行动计划、打赢蓝天保卫战三年行动计划、深入打好重污染天气消除攻坚战行动方案，以区域性PM2.5污染为集中体现的灰霾问题得到了有效遏制，形成了国际公认的治霾“中国经验”。通过本课程的学习，将使学生深刻认识过去50年间我国大气污染治理的辉煌历程，增强学生的文化自信，培养有志于生态文明建设的培养拔尖管理人才；掌握与空气质量管理相关的基础知识，特别是我国在治霾过程中自主提出的霾化学理论、PM2.5与O3协同治理理论、空气质量改善与气候变化应对协同增效理论。
default.en: For a long time, China's coal-based energy structure has caused the national urban atmospheric environment to show high concentrations of sulfur dioxide and respirable particulate matter pollution. In the past 20 years, with the rapid development of the economy, the process of urbanization has been accelerating, and the rapid development of urban transportation and the automobile industry has led to serious motor vehicle exhaust pollution. Developed countries have experienced nearly a century of environmental pollution problems in China's economically developed areas within two to three decades will be concentrated outbreaks, the old pollution problems have not yet been resolved, the new pollution problems and come one after another. In China's urban agglomerations appeared soot type and motor vehicle pollution coexistence of special atmospheric compound pollution, with obvious local pollution and regional pollution combined with the characteristics of pollutants coupled with each other, which is manifested in the increasing oxidizing capacity of the atmosphere, high concentrations of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) so that atmospheric visibility decreased. The atmospheric environmental situation in general has entered the stage of compound air pollution characterized by the coexistence of multiple pollutants, superposition of multiple pollution sources, multi-scale correlation, multi-process evolution, and multi-media influence, which has already posed a great threat to China's public health and ecological safety, and there is a hidden danger of environmental catastrophe. In this context, China has implemented the Action Plan for Prevention and Control of Air Pollution, the Three-Year Action Plan for Winning the Battle for the Blue Sky, and the Action Plan for Eliminating Heavily Polluted Weather, which has effectively curbed the haze problem concentrated in regional PM2.5 pollution, and formed the internationally recognized haze control "Chinese experience". Through the study of this course, students will have a deep understanding of China's brilliant course of air pollution control in the past 50 years, enhance students' cultural confidence, and cultivate top management talents who are interested in the construction of ecological civilization; and master the basic knowledge related to air quality management, especially the haze chemistry theory, the theory of synergistic management of PM2.5 and O3, and the theory of synergistic effect of air quality improvement and climate change response, which have been independently put forward by our country in the process of haze control.

default.zh: 近年来，由于全球气候变暖，导致自然灾害频发、环境污染加剧，已成为国际重大问题。双碳政策指导下，我们正面临向“低碳”模式转变的关键时期。通过本课程的学习，旨在掌握应对以气候变化为核心的全球性环境问题的基础知识，树立科学的低碳发展意识，为未来从事环保、能源、资源等方面的科研、技术或管理工作打下基础。本课程主要通过教师讲授，学习基础概念、理论知识，引导学生理解能源使用及气象学与气候变化之间的关系；采用学生分组讨论的方法，加强学生对概念和知识的理解，培养学生分析污染排放、控制及气候变化之间关系的能力，以实现呈现、发现到强化的学习过程。
default.en: In recent years, owe to the global warming, frequent extreme events, and environmental pollution, it has become a significant international issue. Under the guidance of the dual-carbon policy, we are facing a critical period of transition to a "low-carbon" stage. Through the study of this course, it aims to make students to master the basic knowledge of dealing with global environmental problems with climate change as the core, establish a scientific awareness of low-carbon development, and lay a foundation for the future scientific research, technology or management work in environmental protection, energy, resources, and other aspects. This course guides students to learn basic concepts and theoretical knowledge to understand the relationship between energy consumption, meteorology, and climate change, adopts group discussion to strengthen students 'understanding of concepts and knowledge, and cultivate students' ability to analyze the relationship between pollution emission, control, and climate change, so as to realize the learning process of presentation, discovery, and strengthening.

default.zh: This course is a core course for undergraduate of Environmental Science, and an elective course for Environmental Engineering. It will be conducted mainly in the style of classroom teaching. During the course, students will understand the basic concepts and the basic theory of the indoor environment, including the evaluation method of indoor air quality, indoor environmental standards, types of indoor air pollutants and its harm to human body, pollution source and migration of indoor pollutants. This course will cultivate students' pragmatic attitude. It will teach students the detection methods of pollutants in indoor environment, the control technologies of indoor pollutants, the purification technologies of indoor air, and let them understand the basic principle and operation specification. After the course, student will have the following abilities: experimental design, experimental research, data and conclusion analysis.
default.en: This course is a core course for undergraduate of Environmental Science, and an elective course for Environmental Engineering. It will be conducted mainly in the style of classroom teaching. During the course, students will understand the basic concepts and the basic theory of the indoor environment, including the evaluation method of indoor air quality, indoor environmental standards, types of indoor air pollutants and its harm to human body, pollution source and migration of indoor pollutants. This course will cultivate students' pragmatic attitude. It will teach students the detection methods of pollutants in indoor environment, the control technologies of indoor pollutants, the purification technologies of indoor air, and let them understand the basic principle and operation specification. After the course, student will have the following abilities: experimental design, experimental research, data and conclusion analysis.

default.zh: 大气和气候物理学是研究大气的物理现象、物理过程及其演变规律的大气科学的分支学科。它既是大气科学的基础理论部分，又是环境科学的一个部分。该课程的学习，使学生系统掌握大气物理学各方面的基础理论知识，大气污染控制工程专业课的学习奠定基础。
default.en: Atmospheric and climate physics is a branch of atmospheric science that studies the physical phenomena, processes, and evolution laws of the atmosphere. It is not only the fundamental theoretical part of atmospheric science, but also a part of environmental science. The study of this course enables students to systematically master the basic theoretical knowledge of various aspects of atmospheric physics, laying the foundation for the study of atmospheric pollution control engineering courses.

default.zh: 大气环境化学是大气科学的重要分支学科，是环境学专业的重要基础课程之一。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握大气化学组成，大气中对环境有影响的重要组分在大气中的来源、存在形式、迁移过程中的化学转化、归宿以及对大气质量的影响，对温室效应、酸雨、光化学烟雾等全球关注的环境问题的经典研究结果及最新研究动向进行讨论。本课程注重基础理论学习与科研实践相结合，力求使学生掌握大气化学组成，大气组分的源、汇和化学转化过程，培养学生从化学本质分析和解决大气科学问题的能力；具备一定的处理实际大气环境问题的思路、方法和技术，能够利用所学知识评价分析解决复杂环境工程问题。
default.en: Atmospheric environmental chemistry is an important sub-discipline of atmospheric science, and is one of the important basic courses for environmental science majors. Through the study of this course, students can master the chemical composition of the atmosphere, the source of the important components of the atmosphere that have an impact on the environment, the form of existence in the atmosphere, the chemical transformation of the migration process, the fate and the impact on the quality of the atmosphere, the greenhouse effect, acid rain, photochemical smog and other global concerns of the environmental issues of the classic research results and the latest trends in the research will be discussed. This course focuses on the combination of basic theoretical study and scientific research practice, and strives to enable students to master the chemical composition of the atmosphere, the sources, sinks and chemical transformation processes of atmospheric components, and to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve atmospheric scientific problems from the nature of chemistry; to have a certain amount of ideas, methods and techniques to deal with actual atmospheric environmental problems, and to be able to utilize the knowledge gained to evaluate and analyze and solve complex environmental engineering problems.

default.zh: 本课程是环境科学专业选修课。从地球的化学组成、物理性质和圈层结构入手，从元素、矿物和岩石三个层次简要介绍地球的物质组成特点，系统介绍人类活动对地球环境变化的影响，讲授地球的环境与人体健康的关系、地球的自然环境（包括地球化学背景、地球物理背景）以及人为因素导致的环境变化对人类健康的影响。通过本课程学校实现以下目标： （1）使学生了解地球环境及其变化特点，掌握合理利用地质资源，防治环境污染的知识，培养利用环境地质学知识解决人类活动与地质环境相互作用问题的能力。 （2）学习应用地质学原理、从地质演变过程入手来分析地质环境及其变化规律，使学生了解环境地球科学研究的最新进展和趋势，能够利用环境地球科学知识分析和解决环境科学问题。
default.en: This course is an elective course for environmental science majors. Starting from the chemical composition, physical properties, and stratigraphic structure of the Earth, this article briefly introduces the material composition characteristics of the Earth from three levels: elements, minerals, and rocks. It systematically introduces the impact of human activities on the Earth's environmental changes, teaches about the relationship between the Earth's environment and human health, the natural environment of the Earth (including geochemical and geophysical backgrounds), and the impact of environmental changes caused by human factors on human health. Through this course, the school aims to achieve the following objectives: (1) Enable students to understand the Earth's environment and its changing characteristics, master the knowledge of rational utilization of geological resources, prevention and control of environmental pollution, and cultivate the ability to use environmental geology knowledge to solve the interaction problems between human activities and geological environment. (2) Learn to apply the principles of geology and analyze the geological environment and its changing laws from the perspective of geological evolution, so that students can understand the latest progress and trends in environmental geoscience research, and be able to use environmental geoscience knowledge to analyze and solve environmental science problems.

default.zh: 大尺度环境研究方案与技术是一门研究大尺度环境污染特征及形成机制的课程，该课程不仅涉及环境污染特征的学习，还涉及研究环境污染及形成机制的具体研究方案和研究技术等。本课程是环境科学专业的综合性课程，目的是教授学生利用环境科学的基本理论和基础知识分析复杂的环境问题，具有初步解决复杂环境问题的能力，培养学生的综合素质能力。本课程的目标是使学生掌握研究复杂环境污染问题的基本思路和研究技术，通过让学生接触环境科学前沿和最新发展动态了解国内外的研究热点，培养学生的创新性思维和国际视野。
default.en: Large scale environmental research programs and technologies focus on the characteristics and formation mechanisms of large-scale environmental pollution. This course not only involves learning the characteristics of environmental pollution, but also involves specific research programs and technologies for studying environmental pollution and its formation mechanisms. This course is a comprehensive course for Environmental Science. In this course, students will learn the basic theories and knowledge of environmental science with complex environmental problems, have the ability to preliminarily solve complex environmental problems, and cultivate their comprehensive quality abilities. The goal of this course is to enable students to master the basic ideas and research techniques for studying complex environmental pollution problems. After learning the forefront and latest developments in environmental science, students can understand domestic and international research hotspots, and cultivate their innovative thinking and international perspective.

default.zh: 《水系统氮硫元素循环理论及温室气体减排》这门课程旨在深入探讨水系统中氮、硫元素的生物地球化学循环，及其在全球气候变化和温室气体减排中的关键作用。作为环境科学与工程领域的重要组成部分，本课程不仅提供了关于氮硫元素循环的基本理论和最新研究进展，还着重讨论了这些循环在水环境治理和温室气体减排策略中的应用。通过对氮硫循环机制的分析，以及温室气体生成和减排技术的研究，本课程旨在使学生掌握相关的科学原理和实践技术，理解其在环境保护和气候变化缓解中的重要性。学生将通过课堂讲授、案例分析和小组讨论等多种教学方式，不仅学习到相关的专业知识，还将培养其综合分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: The course "Theory and Greenhouse Gas Emission Reduction in Nitrogen and Sulfur Element Cycles in Water Systems" aims to delve into the biogeochemical cycles of nitrogen and sulfur elements in water systems and their pivotal roles in global climate change and greenhouse gas emission reduction. As an integral component of environmental science and engineering, this course not only provides fundamental theories and recent research advancements regarding nitrogen and sulfur element cycles but also emphasizes their applications in water environment management and greenhouse gas emission reduction strategies. Through the analysis of nitrogen and sulfur cycle mechanisms, as well as research on greenhouse gas generation and emission reduction technologies, this course aims to equip students with relevant scientific principles and practical skills, enabling them to comprehend the significance of these cycles in environmental protection and climate change mitigation. Students will learn through various teaching methods such as classroom lectures, case studies, and group discussions, fostering not only the acquisition of specialized knowledge but also the cultivation of their abilities to comprehensively analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 《绿色化学》课程是环境科学与工程专业本科生的专业任选课。绿色化学体现了生态文明建设思想，是减少资源消耗，实现循环经济和经济的可持续发展的重要科学基础。通过本课程学习，学生将系统学习绿色化学的基本概念，基本原理和发展规律，并能在今后的科研及生产实践中，运用这些规律去分析问题和解决问题。本课程主要讲授绿色化学的基本原理、绿色化学方法、绿色化学在在环境领域如化工品生产、能源、清洁生产及生态工业园的应用实例等。
default.en: The "Green Chemistry" is a professional alternative course for undergraduates majoring in environmental science and engineering. Green chemistry embodies the idea of ecological civilization construction and is an important scientific basis for reducing resource consumption and realizing the sustainable development of circular economy. Through this course, students will systematically learn the basic concepts, basic principles and development laws of green chemistry, and can use these laws to analyze and solve problems in the gradual scientific research and production practice.

default.zh: 纳米化学的典型特征是利用自下而上的合成化学来制备不同大小和形状、组成和表面结构、电荷和功能的纳米尺度结构单元。课程以化学的视角进行展开，内容的选择和组织旨在通过纳米化学来描述纳米科学的基本原理，结构制备、性质表征及在界面、材料、催化和环境科学中的应用。课程以自下而上的有序自组装和图案化纳米结构制备为主线， 以各领域特别是环境科学应用实例为副线，分九部分别介绍纳米材料发展史、化学图案化与软印刷、层层自组装、纳米印刷、典型一维材料制备及应用、纳米晶体合成及应用、微孔及介孔材料生长及调控、聚合物自组装、生物启示与仿生等内容。通过本课程的学习，能够使环境科学学生在纳米材料、纳米结构、纳米表征、纳米器件等方面，扩大知识领域、拓展前瞻性分析能力、提升未来科研素质，使学生具有更好的潜力更长远的发展。
default.en: The typical feature of nanochemistry is to use bottom-up synthetic chemistry to prepare nanoscale structural units of different sizes and shapes, composition and surface structure, charge and function. The course is carried out from the perspective of chemistry. The selection and organization of content aims at describing the basic principles of nanoscience, structure preparation, characterization of properties and applications in interface, materials, catalysis and environmental sciences through nanochemistry. The course follows the keywords of bottom-up orderly self-assembly and patterned nanostructure preparation, and shows various applications, especially from environmental science. It introduces totally nine parts, which includes the development history of nanomaterials, chemical patterning and soft printing, layer-by-layer self-assembly, nanoprinting, preparation and application of typical one-dimensional materials, synthesis and application of nanocrystals, growth and regulation of microporous and mesoporous materials, polymer self-assembly, bioinspiration and bionics. The course provides a broad, interdisciplinary learning experience, students therefore can get the ability of forward-looking, scientific consideration in the fields of nanomaterials, nanostructures, nano-characterization and nanodevices, so as to make students have better potential in the future.

default.zh: 土壤是地球陆地表面上能够生长植物的疏松表层，具有肥力特征，能够不断地供应和协调作物生长发育所必需的的水分、养分、空气、热量和其他生活必须条件。土壤除了具有生产力、能生长植物以外，还具有缓冲自调和净化两大功能。 目前，世界范围的土壤的污染等问题造成了越来越多的经济损失，土壤污染、水土流失、土壤沙化、退化及土壤次生盐碱化，均是生态失衡所带来的恶果。由于土壤介质的非均质各向异性等造成其物质迁移、转化特点，与其他环境子系统如水环境和大气环境相比有很大差异，因此土壤环境问题有较强的隐蔽性和潜伏性，会造成更大的危害。鉴于土壤污染的危害及土地资源的重要性，土壤环境问题及其治理已成为环境、资源、生态等相关领域的重要研究课题。“土壤化学”是针对环境科学与工程专业本科生开设的一门较为基础的土壤学分支课程，教学内容结合我国的土壤资源与环境这个主题进一步阐述土壤化学过程的基本原理，适当地增加国内外土壤化学研究的新进展。 土壤化学性质影响土壤中的化学过程、物理化学过程、生物化学过程以及生物学过程的进行，其中重要的有土壤的酸碱性、缓冲性、氧化还原性质、吸附性、表面电化学性质与胶体性能等。这些性质深刻影响土壤的形成与发育过程，对土壤的保肥能力、缓冲能力、自净能力和养分循环等也有显著影响。 土壤化学作为环境科学与工程的重要组成部分，其研究内容和相关规律、定律等涉及环境化学、生态学、土壤学 、化工原理等相关内容，具有较强的综合性和科学交叉性。本课程主要涵盖的知识内容：土壤中的有机质、黏粒矿物、胶体表面化学、溶液与溶质迁移、酸碱化学、化学动力学、氧化还原、根际化学及污染化学等基础知识。各章节都围绕主题，有重点地介绍基础知识、并结合我国的实际情况进行讨论，提高学生的学术水平与联系实际的创新思维能力，尽可能地结合学科研究和发展的新动态、选好切入点，既反映该领域的新进展、新知识，又体现本门课程教学的循序渐进和系统性。
default.en: Soil is the loose top layer of the earth's land surface that can grow plants. It has the characteristics of fertility and continuously supply and coordinate the water, nutrients, air, heat and other living conditions necessary for crop’s growth and development. Soil not only has productivity and can grow plants, but also has two functions of buffer, self-adjustment and purification. At present, the problems of soil pollution all over the world have caused more and more economic losses. Soil pollution, soil erosion, soil desertification, degradation and secondary salinization are all the bad consequences of ecological imbalance. Because of the heterogeneous anisotropy of soil media, the characteristics of material migration and transformation are quite different from other environmental subsystems, such as water environment and atmospheric environment. Furthermore, soil environmental problems have strong concealment and latent nature, which will cause greater harm. In view of the harm of soil pollution and the importance of land resources, soil environmental problems and the treament have become an important research topic in the related fields of environment, resources and ecology. "Soil Chemistry" is a basic branch course of soil science for undergraduates majoring in Environmental Science and Engineering. The teaching content will further elaborate the basic principles of soil chemistry process based on the theme of soil resources and environment in China, and will appropriately add the new progress in soil chemistry research at home and abroad. Soil chemical properties affect the chemical processes, physicochemical processes, biochemical processes and biological processes in the soil. Among them, soil acidity and alkalinity, buffering, redox, adsorption, surface electrochemical properties and colloidal properties are important. These properties have a profound impact on the formation and development of soil, as well as soil fertility retention, buffer capacity, self-purification capacity and nutrient cycling. Soil chemistry is an important part of environmental science and engineering. Its research content and related laws involve environmental chemistry, ecology, soil science, chemical principles and other related contents, and have a strong comprehensive and scientific intersection. This course mainly covers the basic knowledge of soil organic matter, clay minerals, colloid surface chemistry, solution and solute migration, acid-base chemistry, chemical kinetics, redox, rhizosphere chemistry and pollution chemistry. All chapters focus on the theme, introduce especislly basic knowledge and discuss it in light of the actual situation in our country, so as to improve the students'academic level and innovative thinking ability in connection with reality. In addition, this course combines the new trends of subject research and development as far as possible and selects a good entry point, which not only reflects the new progress and new knowledge in this field, but also reflects the gradual and systematic course teaching.

default.zh: 污染控制化学新技术侧重研究污染控制过程中有关的化学问题，是环境科学学科的重要组成部分，最终为化学污染的治理提供理论与方法。本课程通过对污染控制化学新技术以及其中所涉及的新型材料介绍，同时结合污染物控制技术的案列教学作用，使学生掌握各种化学技术的基本原理、基本过程、操作要领和适用范围，同时明确各种技术涉及的典型环境材料。运用本课程学习到的知识分析污染的成因、处理/处置过程中所涉及的化学变化。本课程将通过课堂教学、实例展示、讨论能够实现学生“知识、能力和素质”有机融合。
default.en: The new technology of pollution control chemistry focuses on researching chemical issues related to the pollution control process and is an integral part of the environmental science discipline. Ultimately, it aims to provide theories and methods for the governance of chemical pollution. This course introduces new technologies in pollution control chemistry and the associated new materials. It combines case studies of pollution control techniques, enabling students to grasp the fundamental principles, basic processes, operational essentials, and application scopes of various chemical technologies. Additionally, it clarifies the typical environmental materials involved in each technique. Using the knowledge acquired in this course, students will analyze the causes of pollution and the chemical changes involved in the treatment/disposal process. The course achieves the organic integration of students' "knowledge, abilities, and qualities" through classroom teaching, practical examples, and discussions.

default.zh: 课程是面向大一及以上年级同学开设的专业选修课程，主要讲述内容包括环境催化相关的基础概念、新型环境催化剂的种类及其在环境净化、环境修复等方面发挥的重要作用，了解环境催化剂的种类、设计制备原则及其在固体酸碱催化、光催化、电催化、纳米催化、单原子及多原子催化、热催化以及新型绿色催化中的应用。通过课堂教学，使学生系统完整地学习环境催化的基本概念、基本理论，了解不断涌现的新型环境催化技术，明确具有良好性能的催化剂是社会发展的迫切需求，同时初步具备从事环境催化相关科学研究及技术开发的能力。 具体教学目标如下： 1. 通过理论课程学习，使学生知悉环境功能材料的基本概念和基本理论，理解环境催化科学是环境、数学、化学、生物学等自然科学相结合形成的一门交叉学科，理解环境催化科学的基本理论框架体系，了解新型环境催化材料的应用前景。 2. 通过课程学习，使学生掌握环境催化材料在污染物的吸附、催化降解及检测中的作用、相关原理，初步具备从事环境催化相关科学研究及技术开发的能力，明确环境催化设计的基本原则。
default.en: The course is a professional elective course for freshmen and above. It mainly covers the basic concepts related to environmental catalysis, the types of new environmental catalysts and their important role in environmental purification, environmental restoration, etc., and understands the functions of environmental catalysts. Types, design and preparation principles and their applications in solid acid-base catalysis, photocatalysis, electrocatalysis, nanocatalysis, single-atom and multi-atom catalysis, thermal catalysis and new green catalysis. Through classroom teaching, students can systematically and completely learn the basic concepts and theories of environmental catalysis, understand the emerging new environmental catalysis technologies, and understand that catalysts with good performance are an urgent need for social development. At the same time, they are initially equipped to engage in scientific research related to environmental catalysis. and technology development capabilities. The specific teaching objectives are as follows: 1. Through the study of theoretical courses, students can understand the basic concepts and basic theories of environmental functional materials, understand that environmental catalysis science is an interdisciplinary subject formed by the combination of environment, mathematics, chemistry, biology and other natural sciences, and understand the nature of environmental catalysis science. Basic theoretical framework system to understand the application prospects of new environmental catalytic materials. 2. Through course study, students can master the role and related principles of environmental catalytic materials in the adsorption, catalytic degradation and detection of pollutants, initially have the ability to engage in scientific research and technology development related to environmental catalysis, and clarify the basic principles of environmental catalysis design.

default.zh: 《光化学处理技术》课程是环境科学专业本科生的专业任选课。太阳能的高效快捷利用、转化和存储是实现可持续发展的重要途径，光催化高效降解有机污染物的技术既是绿色技术也是低耗技术，同时是实现碳减排碳中和的重要手段。通过本课程的学习，学生将系统性的了解光催化技术的基本概念、基础原理、发展规律及前沿进展，并能在今后的学习、科研、工作等实践过程中能够掌握与运用这些知识分析问题，解决问题。本课程将从理论与应用两个方面讲授光催化环境净化技术，首先简要介绍光催化发展历史、基本原理及研究方法，着重介绍光催化水体净化技术及空气净化技术等的产业现状及发展前景，结合实例介绍光催化技术与其他技术耦合工艺的运行效果。本课程针对环境科学专业的特点，紧密联系环境科学学科中的实际问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境科学实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学达成以下目标： 1.本课程为环境科学等相关专业本科生提供光化学处理技术的基础概念，掌握光催化技术的相关基本理论，了解光催化水体净化、空气净化等技术的产业现状及发展前景，培养学生根据实际问题整合现有技术工艺，处理问题的能力。 2.本课程培养和训练学生们在处理复杂的工程问题和环境决策方面的实际问题时的系统分析思维习惯，具备能利用科学原理分析实验结果，尽快地找到合理有效的解决问题的思路、提供科学的判断依据以做出正确决策的能力。 3.本课程通过课堂讲授与课堂引导培养学生提出问题，自主学习，解决问题的能力。
default.en: “Photochemical treatment technology” is an optional course for environmental science undergraduates. The efficient utilization, conversion and storage of solar energy is an important way to achieve sustainable development. The technology of photocatalytic degradation of organic pollutants is both green technology and Low-cost technology, at the same time, it is an important means to achieve carbon emission reduction and carbon neutrality. Through the study of this course, students will have a systematic understanding of the basic concepts, basic principles, development laws and cutting-edge progress of photocatalytic technology, and in the future study, scientific research, work and other practical processes to grasp and use the knowledge to analyze problems and solve problems. This course will teach photocatalytic environmental purification technology from two aspects of theory and application. First, the history, basic principle and research methods of photocatalysis are briefly introduced, the industrial status and development prospect of photocatalytic water purification technology and air purification technology are introduced. The operation effect of photocatalytic technology coupled with other technology is introduced. This course focuses on the characteristics of environmental science and environmental science subjects, and focuses on the role of case studies in environmental science while learning theories. The following objectives are achieved through classroom teaching: 1. This course provides the basic concepts of photochemical treatment technology for environmental science and related majors, to understand the industrial status and development prospect of photocatalytic water purification and air purification, and to train students' ability to integrate existing technology and process according to practical problems. 2. This course trains students in the habit of systematic analytical thinking when dealing with complex engineering problems and practical problems in environmental decision-making, the ability to find a reasonable and effective solution to the problem as soon as possible and to provide scientific basis for judgment in order to make correct decisions. 3. This course trains students' ability to ask questions, study independently and solve problems through classroom instruction and guidance.

default.zh: 膜技术具有空间利用率高、分离精度好、无副产物等优势，在水处理领域具有广泛的应用前景。串联多种膜技术或耦合膜技术和传统水处理技术，可有效提高水处理工艺产水质量，强化工艺运行效率，减小水处理设备占地面积等。本课程拟以水处理膜为核心，介绍膜分离的科学原理，对比不同膜材料的结构与制备方法，解析不同膜技术的原理与应用特色，分析多种以膜技术为核心的优秀水处理工艺。单元膜技术包括微滤、超滤、纳滤、反渗透、正渗透、电渗析、膜蒸馏、膜生物反应器和催化膜，水处理工艺涉及集中式、家庭式和便携式饮用水处理工艺、污水处理排放与回用工艺、海水/苦咸水淡化工艺和水资源再利用工艺。课程内容将适度引入人工智能在膜材料设计与膜系统运维中的辅助应用，包括数据驱动的材料性能预测、运行状态监测与故障预警等新兴方法，以帮助学生了解膜技术与数字化智能工具的融合趋势。课程的基本目标是，使学生理解膜技术涉及的科学问题，包括孔径筛分原理、微界面静电作用、溶解-扩散机制等，能够基于热力学和动力学正确认识与分析多种膜过程，掌握多种单元膜技术在水处理领域的应用调控和运行维护方法，了解多种膜材料的核心结构与制备方法。课程的进阶目标是，使学生能够以目标为导向，设计构建或升级优化以膜技术为核心的水处理系统，实现水资源多级利用、循环利用；培养学生统合经济、政策和技术领域的跨学科思维，以及团队精神和协作能力。课程亦鼓励学生关注前沿技术，如人工智能对膜过程建模与优化的潜在支持作用，提升系统运行的智能化与精细化水平。
default.en: Membrane technology offers advantages such as high space efficiency, excellent separation precision, and the absence of by-products, making it highly promising for water treatment applications. Integrating multiple membrane technologies or coupling them with conventional treatment processes can significantly improve water quality, enhance operational efficiency, and reduce the footprint of treatment systems. This course centers on water treatment membranes, introducing the scientific principles of membrane separation, comparing the structures and fabrication methods of various membrane materials, explaining the mechanisms and application features of different membrane technologies, and analyzing outstanding membrane-based water treatment processes. The course covers individual membrane technologies including microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, reverse osmosis, forward osmosis, electrodialysis, membrane distillation, membrane bioreactors, and catalytic membranes. Water treatment applications span centralized, household, and portable drinking water systems, wastewater treatment and reuse, seawater/brackish water desalination, and water recycling processes. The course will also introduce the emerging role of artificial intelligence in membrane material design and system operation, such as data-driven performance prediction, operational monitoring, and fault detection, to familiarize students with the integration of digital tools and membrane technology. The basic objective of the course is to enable students to understand the scientific issues underlying membrane technologies, including size exclusion principles, interfacial electrostatic interactions, and solution-diffusion mechanisms. Students will learn to analyze various membrane processes based on thermodynamic and kinetic concepts, master the regulation and maintenance of individual membrane technologies in water treatment, and understand the core structures and fabrication methods of various membrane materials. The advanced goal is to train students to design, construct, or upgrade membrane-based water treatment systems with clear objectives in mind, aiming for multi-stage and circular use of water resources. The course also fosters interdisciplinary thinking across economic, policy, and technical domains, as well as teamwork and collaboration skills. Students will be encouraged to explore cutting-edge approaches, including the potential of AI to support membrane process modeling and optimization, enhancing system intelligence and precision.

default.zh: 环境微生物代谢转换与物质循环是新版环境科学本科专业培养计划调整后，全新设立的一门专业课。作为环境科学本科专业的一个重要研究方向，同时涉及微生物学、生态学、环境科学、地球科学、化学、物理学、数学和工程学等多个学科交叉的研究领域。课程旨在帮助学生了解环境微生物物质元素循环的基本原理和过程，掌握相关的研究方法和技能。课程重点介绍介绍生态系统物质循环的概念，微生物进行物质循环的基本原理，微生物胞内能量流动、物质循环和信息传递，物质循环与生物地球化学循环的区别与联系；熟悉生态环境污染成因与危害以及治理与修复的技术措施，实现在自然环境和人工生态系统中的具体应用。
default.en: Environmental microbial metabolic transformation and material cycling is a newly introduced course within the revised curriculum for the environmental science undergraduate program. This course is a crucial research area within the environmental science major, encompassing interdisciplinary fields such as microbiology, ecology, environmental science, earth science, chemistry, physics, mathematics, and engineering. The primary objective of this course is to provide students with an understanding of the fundamental principles and processes involved in environmental microbial material cycling, as well as to equip them with relevant research methods and skills. The course delves into topics such as ecosystem material cycling, the basic principles of microbial material cycling, intracellular energy flow, material cycling, and information transfer, as well as the distinctions and connections between material cycling and biogeochemical cycling. Students are expected to comprehend the causes and consequences of ecological environmental pollution, learn about technical measures for treatment and restoration, and apply this knowledge to both natural environments and artificial ecosystems.

default.zh: 水处理高级氧化技术是近 20 年来兴起的新的水处理技术，已成为当前国内外水处理研究领域的热点课题。通过本课程的教学，使学生掌握化学氧化、光化学氧化、电化学氧化、Fenton氧化、湿式氧化、超声氧化等高级氧化技术的基本原理、影响因素以及这些氧化技术在废水处理中的应用进展，拓宽知识面，为本科生开展研究工作提供更多的思路。
default.en: Advanced oxidation technology for water treatment is a new water treatment technology that has emerged in the past 20 years and has become a hot topic in the field of water treatment research both domestically and internationally. Through the teaching of this course, students will master the basic principles, influencing factors, and application progress of advanced oxidation technologies such as chemical oxidation, photochemical oxidation, electrochemical oxidation, Fenton oxidation, wet oxidation, and ultrasonic oxidation in wastewater treatment, broaden their knowledge, and provide more ideas for undergraduate students to carry out research work.

default.zh: 生态环境大数据分析是一门生态专业本科生的课程，这门课程是将当前国际前沿研究热点问题应用到生态环境研究领域的一个新兴交叉学科的课程。该课程从生态环境数据的基本分析方法入手，抽象的方法会以图表及案例的方式向同学们介绍，尽量做到让这门课程通俗易懂。并且针对每种分析方法都介绍了生态环境领域相关的实例。这不仅让学生理解数据分析方法的基本概念、原理，还学会了如何运用数据分析方法对生态环境实际数据和案例进行分析和应用，有效的避免了大数据分析挖掘过程中的枯燥、难懂的普遍问题，能够让同学们对课程内容真正产生兴趣，并学以致用，将上述知识和方法应用到生态环境大数据分析及应用中，获取数据价值，指导生态环境管理实践。同时为了避免数据分析方法的枯燥性和抽象性，本课程还设置了上机课，上机课程与课堂授课紧密联系，在课堂授课中介绍的方法，通过上机操作都可以掌握并理解，因此这门课程是将理论学习与实践操作紧密有机结合的课程。在上机课中，学生学会利用当前较为流行的软件python中的各种数据挖掘工具对生态数据进行处理分析等操作，为后续生态环境领域其它研究工作的深入开展打好基础。
default.en: Ecological Environment Big Data Analysis is a course for undergraduate students majoring in ecology, which is an emerging interdisciplinary course that applies current international cutting-edge research hotspots to the field of ecological environment research. This course starts with the basic analysis methods of ecological environment data, and abstract methods will be introduced to students in the form of charts and cases, striving to make this course easy to understand. And relevant examples in the field of ecological environment were introduced for each analysis method. This not only enables students to understand the basic concepts and principles of data analysis methods, but also learns how to apply data analysis methods to analyze and apply actual ecological environment data and cases, effectively avoiding the tedious and difficult to understand common problems in the process of big data analysis and mining. It can make students truly interested in the course content and apply the above knowledge and methods to ecological environment big data analysis and application, obtain data value, and guide ecological environment management practice. At the same time, in order to avoid the dryness and abstraction of data analysis methods, this course also includes a computer course. The computer course is closely related to classroom teaching, and the methods introduced in classroom teaching can be mastered and understood through computer operation. Therefore, this course is a closely organic combination of theoretical learning and practical operation. In the computer class, students learn to use various data mining tools in the popular software Python to process and analyze ecological data, laying a foundation for further research in the field of ecological environment.

default.zh: 该课程除了涉及Python的基本理论知识，基础上机操作练习以外，还涉及目前比较流行的机器学习（模型应用）的内容，注重生态大数据的机器学习研究。可以根据学生的实际情况，调整教学难度，让同学们在短短的16课时就能够对Python有较好的掌握。
default.en: This course not only covers the basic theoretical knowledge of Python and basic computer operation exercises, but also covers the popular content of machine learning (model application), focusing on the research of machine learning in ecological big data. The teaching difficulty can be adjusted according to the actual situation of students, so that they can have a good grasp of Python in just 16 class hours.

default.zh: 环境与生物统计学是运用数理统计的原理和方法来分析和解释环境领域与生物界各种现象的一门科学。本课程在介绍统计原理和各种统计方法的同时，注重培养学生熟练应用的能力，使学生了解环境科学与工程以及生物学试验的任务、要求，掌握科学试验设计的原则和技术，能熟练制定试验方案，进行生物科学试验的设计，并能根据生物统计学原理正确选用统计分析模型，进行数据的处理与分析，分析和解释试验结果中的数量变化，从而做出符合科学实际的推断。
default.en: Biostatistics provides the essential methodological and quantitative underpinning necessary for much of ecological research, environmental science, environmental engineering et al. Environment and biostatistics is an innovative field that involves the design, analysis, and interpretation of data for studies in biology and environmental science. Focus on training students to master the various methods and technology of biostatistics. The development and application of techniques to better understand such data is the fundamental concern in the course. The theories and application of statistical methods to the design and analysis will be taught to studies in microbiology, environmental science and engineering research.

default.zh: 《环境生态风险评价》在介绍生态风险评价相关理论及国内外进展的基础上，使学生了解环境风险评价的基本概念和应用发展现状，掌握环境风险评价的一般流程，方法以及模型应用，增强学生对人类活动与生态环境关系有的认识。
default.en: On the basis of introducing the relevant theories of ecological risk assessment and the progress at home and abroad,, students will understand the basic concepts and application development status of environmental risk assessment, master the general process, methods and model application of environmental risk assessment, enhance their understanding of the relationship between human activities and the ecological environment.

default.zh: 《生命周期评价与碳中和》是全校本科生创新能力培养方案的一门选修课程，通过本课程的学习，使学生能对我国“双碳”战略和水务领域碳中和的全生命周期评价有一个概要的了解，以增强学生的危机感和使命感，使新生能对给排水科学与工程专业的主要内容有一个概括的了解，增强学习和思考的目的性。通过课程的学习要求同学针对水务领域碳中和的全生命周期评价的具体问题提出自己的见解和解决方案，并进行相关的理论论证。此课程的主要特色是结合国家政策背景，掌握理论前沿的同时认识到专业与国家宏观政策的关联性及专业发展前景，激发同学们解决问题的热情，培养同学的社会责任感，以增强学生投身水环境和环境材料学科事业的决心。
default.en: "Life Cycle Assessment and Carbon Neutrality" is an elective course in the undergraduate innovation ability training program of the university. Through the study of this course, students can have a general understanding of China's "two-carbon" strategy and the whole life cycle assessment of carbon neutrality in the water industry, so as to enhance their sense of crisis and mission. So that the new students can have a general understanding of the main content of water supply and drainage science and engineering, enhance the purpose of learning and thinking. Through the study of the course, students are required to put forward their own opinions and solutions for the specific problems of the whole life cycle evaluation of carbon neutrality in the water industry, and carry out relevant theoretical demonstration. The main feature of this course is to combine the national policy background, grasp the theoretical frontier, and realize the correlation between the major and the national macro policy and the professional development prospect, stimulate students' enthusiasm to solve problems, cultivate students' social responsibility, and strengthen students' determination to devote themselves to the water environment and environmental materials discipline.

default.zh: 近年来，全球气温逐年攀升，温室效应愈发严重，全球气候变化愈演愈烈。2021年两会期间的政府工作报告中出现“碳达峰”和碳中和两个词汇，我国对外宣布“力争2030年前实现碳达峰，2060年前实现碳中和”，展现了负责任大国的使命与担当。目前，碳达峰、碳中和已经成为全球的广泛共识，已经有194个缔约方批准了应对气候变化的《巴黎协定》，制定了“到本世纪末，地表平均温度升高值不超过2 ℃、争取不超过1.5 ℃”这一长期目标，已经有130多个国家提出了碳中和或净零排放的目标，并为此制定了一系列的行动规划。 碳中和涉及学科多、行业多、范围广，是一个系统复杂的技术体系。实现碳中和是一场广泛而深刻的经济社会系统性变革，是着力解决资源环境约束突出问题的必然选择，事关中华民族永续发展和构建人类命运共同体。本课程将主要介绍“气候变化”与碳中和概念，通过本课程学习，学能能够理解“气候变化”与碳中和之间的紧密关系、气候变化带来的危害以及碳中和的必要性；了解碳中和前沿技术方法和前瞻性、系统性思维方式；培养学生强烈的家国情怀、可持续发展理念和人类命运共同体意识，使学生成为善于解决碳中和系统中复杂科学技术和治理问题，具有国际竞争力和全球胜任力的高层次、创新性、复合型人才。
default.en: In recent years, global temperatures have been rising year by year, and the greenhouse effect has become increasingly serious, leading to more and more severe global climate change. During the National People's Congress and Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in 2021, the terms "peak carbon emissions" and "carbon neutrality" were mentioned in the Chinese government's work report, and China announced to the world that it will strive to achieve carbon emissions peak before 2030 and carbon neutrality before 2060. This demonstrates China's mission and responsibility as a responsible great power. Currently, reaching peak carbon emissions and achieving carbon neutrality have become a widespread consensus globally. 194 contracting parties have approved the Paris Agreement for combating climate change, which sets a long-term goal that the global temperature rise should remain below 2 ℃ by the end of this century, and strive for no more than 1.5 ℃. Over 130 countries have proposed carbon neutrality or net zero emissions targets and have formulated a series of action plans to achieve them. Reaching carbon neutrality involves multiple disciplines, industries, and a wide range of areas. It is a systemically complex technological system. Achieving carbon neutrality is a broad and profound economic and social systemic change that seeks to address the most pressing resource and environmental constraints issues. It directly relates to the sustainable development of the Chinese nation and the construction of a community with a shared future for humanity. This course will mainly introduce the concepts of "climate change" and "carbon neutrality." Through this course, students will be able to understand the close relationship between climate change and carbon neutrality, the hazards brought about by climate change, and the necessity of achieving carbon neutrality. Students will also learn about cutting-edge technology and innovative, systematic ways of thinking concerning carbon neutrality and cultivate a strong sense of patriotism, sustainable development concepts, and a sense of a shared future for humanity. With this knowledge and training, students will be able to handle complex technical and governance problems in the carbon neutrality system, and become high-level, innovative, and composite talents with international competitiveness and global competence.

default.zh: 《低碳水处理技术》课程旨在向学生介绍和深入探讨用于水资源管理和处理的低碳技术。本课程将覆盖各种水处理技术，包括但不限于节能净化系统、可再生能源驱动的水处理解决方案以及最新的生物技术应用。学生将学习如何评估各种技术在实际应用中的可行性、效率及其环境影响。通过理论学习与实践操作相结合，本课程旨在培养学生解决实际水处理问题的能力，推动可持续发展和环境保护。
default.en: The "Low Carbon Water Treatment Technologies" course is designed to introduce and explore advanced low carbon technologies for water resource management and treatment. This course will cover a variety of water treatment technologies, including but not limited to energy-saving purification systems, renewable energy-driven water treatment solutions, and cutting-edge biotechnological applications. Students will learn to assess the feasibility, efficiency, and environmental impacts of various technologies in practical applications. By integrating theoretical knowledge with practical operations, this course aims to equip students with the skills to tackle real-world water treatment challenges and promote sustainable development and environmental protection.

default.zh: 《碳计算与碳核算》课程旨在培养学生对碳排放和碳足迹进行量化、监测、报告和核查的能力。本课程将介绍碳排放的基本概念、碳计算的方法和工具，以及碳核算的标准和流程。通过学习本课程，学生将能够理解和应用碳计算与核算的原理，为企业或组织的低碳转型和可持续发展提供支持。
default.en: The course "Carbon Measurement and Carbon Accounting" aims to cultivate students' abilities to quantify, monitor, report, and verify carbon emissions and carbon footprints. This course will introduce the basic concepts of carbon emissions, methods and tools for carbon calculation, as well as standards and processes for carbon accounting. By studying this course, students will be able to understand and apply the principles of carbon calculation and accounting, providing support for the low-carbon transformation and sustainable development of enterprises or organizations.

default.zh: 建筑信息模型（BIM）技术已成为现代建筑行业的核心，通过创建和使用数字信息模型，可以在整个建筑生命周期中实现更高效的设计、施工和运维管理。BIM不仅仅是一个3D建模工具，它涵盖了建筑、结构、机电等多个领域，实现了信息的集成，优化了项目管理，并显著提高了建筑项目的生产效率和质量。 本课程旨在全面介绍和探索BIM技术及其在建筑行业的广泛应用。课程设计旨在通过理论与实践的结合，使学生能够深入了解BIM的基本原理、掌握主要BIM软件工具的使用，并应用于建筑项目的设计、施工和运维阶段。
default.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM) technology has become a cornerstone of the modern construction industry. By creating and utilizing digital information models, it facilitates more efficient design, construction, and operational management throughout the entire lifecycle of a building. BIM is not merely a 3D modeling tool; it encompasses multiple disciplines including architecture, structural engineering, and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems, achieving an integration of information that optimizes project management and significantly enhances the productivity and quality of construction projects. This course aims to provide a comprehensive introduction and exploration of BIM technology and its extensive applications in the construction industry. Designed to merge theory with practice, the course enables students to deeply understand the fundamental principles of BIM, master the use of major BIM software tools, and apply them in the design, construction, and operational phases of building projects.

default.zh: 当前，我国对环境保护工作日益重视，生态文明建设上升为国家战略。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握保护与恢复生态学的基本概念、基本理论和基础研究方法；掌握生态系统退化的原因、退化生态系统恢复与重建的原则、技术和方法，并通过对多种生态系统保护与恢复的典型案例的讲解使学生掌握保护与恢复生态学的应用，达到能进行生态系统保护与恢复建设的目的，并让学生初步了解该领域研究发展的成果以及新动向，使学生具有分析和处理当前敏感生态系统保护与退化生态系统恢复的能力，提高学生生态文明建设意识，为今后的学习和研究奠定基础。
default.en: Currently, our country is increasingly emphasizing environmental protection, with ecological civilization construction being elevated to a national strategy. Through this course, students will grasp the basic concepts, theories, and fundamental research methods of conservation and restoration ecology. They will understand the causes of ecosystem degradation, principles, techniques, and methods for restoring and rebuilding degraded ecosystems. By elucidating typical cases of ecosystem conservation and restoration, students will acquire practical applications of conservation and restoration ecology. The aim is to enable students to engage in ecosystem conservation and restoration construction, while also providing them with a preliminary understanding of research developments and new trends in this field. This will equip students with the ability to analyze and address issues related to sensitive ecosystem protection and degraded ecosystem restoration, thereby enhancing their awareness of ecological civilization construction and laying the foundation for future learning and research.

default.zh: 本课程是本科生专业选修课，在讲授过程中突出选修课的特点：（1）拓展学生知识面，发展完善学生知识结构；（2）对课程内容正确进行定位，结合环境生态学专业特点，掌握好讲授内容的难易程度；（3）尽可能的突出授课内容的理论性，并结合实际工程分析，补充计算知识。 流域生态治理与修复设计同环境学科有着极其密切的联系。本课程针对环境生态学专业的特点，紧密联系环境生态与工程学科中的实际问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境生态与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实验教学达成以下目标。 1. 本课程为环境生态与工程等相关专业本科生提供流域污染治理与生态修复概览，掌握流域水环境概述与流域模型及应用的相关的基本理论。主题包括（1）流域保护与修复理论基础及其基本概念和组成，使学生了解流域水循环过程、流域地表水环境概况及污染迁移转化原、流域土壤侵蚀过程、物质循环过程等；（2）流域污染观测方法与模型分析，使学生掌握使学生了解流域模型基础、典型流域模型介绍、及污染源调研方法，掌握污染源溯源模型、河道-湖泊模型基础、典型河道-湖泊模型；（3）流域水环境污染观测技术方法，使学生并掌握流域水环境污染观测方法、上覆水体观测方法、多介质观测方法，了解水文测站与站网、水位、流量的测算，水样的采集及水质监测方法，熟悉土壤监测、植被监测及沉积物监测原理及方法等。 2. 在教学的过程中，学生可以掌握基本的流域模型、典型流域模型、污染源调研方法、流域水系联通及水力调控要点、流域水环境规划方法、环境污染应急措施等工程技能，用于解决我国流域主要生态环境问题及生态修复等复杂问题。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduate students, highlighting the characteristics of the elective course during the teaching process: (1) expanding students' knowledge and developing and improving their knowledge structure; (2) Properly positioning the course content, combining with the characteristics of the Environmental Ecology major, and mastering the difficulty level of the teaching content; (3) Highlight the theoretical nature of the teaching content as much as possible, and combine it with practical engineering analysis to supplement computational knowledge. The ecological governance and restoration design of river basins are closely related to environmental disciplines. This course is aimed at the characteristics of the Environmental Ecology major, closely related to practical problems in the discipline of Environmental Ecology and Engineering. While studying theory, it also emphasizes the role of practical case teaching in Environmental Ecology and Engineering. Through classroom teaching and experimental teaching, the following goals are achieved. 1. This course provides an overview of watershed pollution control and ecological restoration for undergraduate students majoring in environmental ecology and engineering, mastering the basic theories related to watershed water environment overview, watershed models, and applications. The theme includes (1) the theoretical basis, basic concepts, and components of watershed protection and restoration, enabling students to understand the watershed water cycle process, surface water environment overview and pollution migration and transformation sources, watershed soil erosion process, material cycle process, etc; (2) Observation methods and model analysis for watershed pollution, enabling students to master the basics of watershed models, introduction of typical watershed models, and methods for investigating pollution sources, as well as the basics of pollution source tracing models, river lake models, and typical river lake models; (3) The observation technology and methods for water environment pollution in river basins enable students to master the observation methods for water environment pollution in river basins, overlying water bodies, and multimedia observation methods, understand hydrological stations and station networks, water level and flow calculation, water sample collection and water quality monitoring methods, and be familiar with the principles and methods of soil monitoring, vegetation monitoring, and sediment monitoring. During the teaching process, students can master basic watershed models, typical watershed models, pollution source research methods, key points of watershed water system connectivity and hydraulic regulation, watershed water environment planning methods, environmental pollution emergency measures, and other engineering skills, which can be used to solve complex problems such as the main ecological environment problems and ecological restoration in China's watersheds.

default.zh: 人类进入21世纪，环境与发展成为国际社会更加关注的重大问题。如何保护生态环境，实现可持续发展是全人类面临的紧迫而艰巨的任务。本课程在生态学理论的基础上，采取理论与案例分析相结合的方式，从城市生态系统的组成形态与功能、城市人口、城市环境、城市灾害及防范，城市景观、城市与区域发展等方面，全面论述城市生态学的基本理论、研究方法及其重要意义，以达到培养训练学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: As human beings enter the 21st century, environment and development have become a major issue that the international community pays more attention to. How to protect the ecological environment and achieve sustainable development is an urgent and arduous task facing all mankind. On the basis of ecological theory, this course adopts the method of combining theory and case analysis, from the composition form and function of urban ecosystem, urban population, urban environment, urban disaster and prevention, urban landscape, urban and regional development, etc. , comprehensively discuss the basic theory, research methods and significance of urban ecology, in order to cultivate and train students' ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 随着社会经济的发展，工业化和城市化的不断推进，资源短缺、环境污染、粮食和食品安全、生态失衡等问题日益突出，严重威胁着人类的生存和发展。如何正确处理人与自然、经济与生态、资源利用与保护、当前利益和长远利益的关系，使得社会、经济、生态三个效益得以全面协调发展，已成为学者、决策者和管理者们必须面对和考虑的问题。在这种背景下环境生态规划与管理应运而生。它区别于传统的经济优先型的规划理论和方法，旨在关注生态系统的多元性、完整性和连续性，以确保和恢复生态系统健康为最高目标。生态规划为解决人类与自然的关系问题提供了契机，也为实现以人为本、全面协调的科学发展观，建设稳定和谐社会，提供了重要的理论支撑和方法指导。运用生态学、经济学和社会学等跨学科的原理和现代科学技术来管理人类行动对生态环境的影响，力图平衡发展和生态环境保护之间的冲突，最终实现经济、社会和生态环境的协调可持续发展。环境生态规划与管理以生态系统学、宏观经济学和城乡规划学的基本原理为指导，应用系统科学、环境科学、管理科学、软件工程学、运筹学、数理统计学、计算机技术学等多学科的手段，去辨别、模拟和设计人工复合生态系统内的各种生态关系，确保资源开发利用和保护的生态适宜度，探讨改善系统结构与功能的生态建设对策，从而促人与自然关系的持续协调发展的一种规划和管理。
default.en: With the development of socio-economic factors, continuous industrialization, and urbanization, issues such as resource scarcity, environmental pollution, food and food safety, and ecological imbalance are becoming increasingly prominent, posing a serious threat to human survival and development. How to handle the relationship between humans and nature, economy and ecology, resource utilization and protection, as well as the balance between immediate and long-term interests, has become a crucial concern for scholars, decision-makers, and managers. Against this backdrop, environmental ecological planning and management have emerged. Distinguished from traditional economic-centric planning theories and methods, environmental ecological planning and management focus on the diversity, integrity, and continuity of ecosystems, with the ultimate goal of ensuring and restoring ecosystem health. It provides an opportunity to address the relationship between humans and nature, supporting the realization of a people-centered, comprehensively coordinated scientific development outlook, and the construction of a stable and harmonious society. Environmental ecological planning utilizes interdisciplinary principles from ecology, economics, sociology, and modern scientific and technological methods to manage human actions' impact on the ecological environment. The aim is to balance the conflict between development and ecological environment protection, ultimately achieving coordinated and sustainable development of the economy, society, and ecological environment. Guided by principles from ecosystem science, macroeconomics, and urban and rural planning, environmental ecological planning and management employ methods from various disciplines such as systems science, environmental science, management science, software engineering, operations research, mathematical statistics, and computer technology. The goal is to identify, simulate, and design various ecological relationships within artificial composite ecosystems, ensuring the ecological suitability of resource development and protection. It explores strategies for improving the ecological construction of system structure and function, promoting the sustained and coordinated development of the relationship between humans and nature.

default.zh: 本课程是本科生专业选修课，在讲授过程中突出课程特点：（1）拓展学生知识面，发展完善学生知识结构；（2）对课程内容正确进行定位，结合环境生态学专业特点，掌握好讲授内容的难易程度；（3）尽可能的突出授课内容的理论性，并结合实际工程分析，补充模型建模知识。通过本课程的讲授，使学生了解生态环境管理学概念与环境管理的对象，明晰主要生态环境问题，熟悉数字孪生系统与关键技术方法内容，基本掌握数字孪生技术在生态环境智慧管控中的应用实践。 生态环境智慧管控中的数字孪生技术同环境学科有着极其密切的联系，紧密联系环境生态与工程学科中的实际问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境生态与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实验教学达成以下目标。 本课程为环境生态与工程等相关专业本科生提供生态环境智慧管控中的数字孪生技术概览，掌握数字孪生系统与关键技术方法及其在生态环境智慧管控中的应用的相关的基本理论。 1. 介绍数字孪生的概述，包括数字孪生的发展历史、数字孪生的特征和关键技术、系统架构以及数字孪生的应用场景等，掌握实现数字孪生所必须的几大关键技术、目前国内外常见的实现工具和数字孪生集成开发平台，并开展场景模型的搭建、数据可视化、数据对接、场景数据的交互等进阶的应用，由浅入深进行介绍。 2. 掌握基本的数字孪生技术在城市环境管理、农村环境管理、流域环境管理、区域开发行为的环境管理、气体废弃物的环境管理、水体废弃物的环境管理、水资源保护与管理、全球环境管理的现状与特点等技能，用于解决生态环境问题与环境管理等复杂问题；并通过数字孪生技术在实际生态环境管控中的应用案例进行教学和实践，从需求分析、方案设计到具体实现过程进行介绍，让学生对实现数字孪生技术在生态环境智慧管控中的应用有更深入的理解 3. 除了要求学生掌握上述课程知识和技能外，本课程培养和训练学生们在处理复杂的生态环境管控实际问题时的智慧、系统分析思维习惯，具备能利用基于数字孪生技术科学原理分析结果，尽快地找到合理有效的解决问题的思路、提供科学的判断依据以做出正确决策的能力。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduate students, highlighting the characteristics of the course during the teaching process: (1) expanding students' knowledge and developing and improving their knowledge structure; (2) Properly positioning the course content, combining with the characteristics of the Environmental Ecology major, and mastering the difficulty level of the teaching content; (3) Highlight the theoretical nature of the teaching content as much as possible, and combine it with practical engineering analysis to supplement the knowledge of model modeling. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the concepts of ecological environment management and the objects of environmental management, clarify the main ecological environment issues, become familiar with the content of digital twin systems and key technical methods, and have a basic understanding of the application and practice of digital twin technology in intelligent control of ecological environment. The digital twin technology in intelligent control of ecological environment is closely related to environmental disciplines, closely related to practical problems in environmental ecology and engineering disciplines. While studying theory, it emphasizes the role of practical case teaching in environmental ecology and engineering, and achieves the following goals through classroom teaching and experimental teaching. This course provides undergraduate students majoring in Environmental Ecology and Engineering with an overview of digital twin technology in ecological environment intelligent control, mastering the basic theories of digital twin systems and key technical methods, as well as their application in ecological environment intelligent control. 1. Introduce an overview of digital twins, including their development history, characteristics and key technologies, system architecture, and application scenarios. Master the key technologies necessary to achieve digital twins, common implementation tools and integrated development platforms both domestically and internationally, and carry out advanced applications such as scene model construction, data visualization, data docking, and scene data interaction, starting from simple to deep. 2. Master the basic skills of digital twin technology in urban environmental management, rural environmental management, watershed environmental management, regional development behavior environmental management, gas waste environmental management, water waste environmental management, water resource protection and management, global environmental management, etc., and use them to solve complex problems such as ecological and environmental management; And through the application cases of digital twin technology in actual ecological environment control, teaching and practice will be conducted, introducing the process from demand analysis, scheme design to specific implementation, so that students can have a deeper understanding of the application of digital twin technology in intelligent ecological environment control 3. In addition to requiring students to master the knowledge and skills mentioned above, this course cultivates and trains their intelligence and systematic analytical thinking habits when dealing with complex ecological environment control practical problems. Students should have the ability to use the scientific principles of digital twin technology to analyze results, quickly find reasonable and effective problem-solving ideas, and provide scientific judgment basis to make correct decisions.

default.zh: 随着工业化的不断扩大，土壤及水体生态系统的污染与受损问题已经成为世界各国面临的主要环境问题。近自然修复系统理论与技术是解决这一问题的重要手段，在传统环境修复理论与技术基础上，更遵循生态文明理念和生态系统工程技术原理，以实现对受损、退化和污染生态系统的结构与功能恢复。本课程在介绍近自然修复系统理论与技术的研究内容、研究方法以及最新发展和成果的同时，注重培养学生掌握近自然修复的各种方法与技术，使其能够将近自然修复原理应用于环境治理实践当中。
default.en: With the continuous expansion of industrialization, soil and water ecosystem pollution and damage have become one of the major environmental problems faced by countries around the world. The theory and technology of near-natural restoration systems are an important means of solving this problem, based on traditional environmental restoration theory and technology, and following the principles of ecological civilization and ecosystem engineering technology to achieve the restoration of the structure and function of damaged, degraded, and polluted ecosystems. This course introduces the research content, research methods, and latest developments and achievements of near-natural restoration system theory and technology while emphasizing the training of students in various methods and technologies of near-natural restoration, enabling them to apply the principles of near-natural restoration to environmental governance practice.

default.zh: 随着中国经济的快速发展和许多重大工程项目的实施，越来越多的工程伦理问题显露在我们面前，如：工程质量、公共安全、工程与环境、工程与生态、工程中的诚信和道德问题，已经成为社会关注的伦理问题。本课程讲授了工程中的伦理问题、工程师的伦理责任和需要遵循的职业道德、工程利益相关方的博弈、工程与生态责任、工程伦理的应用等内容，注重培养学生作为工程师所必须具备的科学态度和职业精神。
default.en: Along with the rapid development of China's economy and the implementation of many major projects, More and more engineering ethics problems revealed, such as engineering quality, public safety, engineering and environment, engineering and ecology, and integrity and ethical issues of engineering, which has become an ethical issue of social concern. In this course, ethical issues in engineering, ethical responsibility and professional ethics of engineers, game of stakeholders in engineering, engineering and ecological responsibility, application of Engineering Ethics are introduced. We also pay attention to foster scientific attitude and professional spirit of students.

default.zh: 城市水系统智慧管理是一种集成信息技术、物联网技术、大数据分析以及云计算等现代科技手段，旨在对城市供水、排水、污水处理等水务环节进行全面、精细化管理和高效运营的智能解决方案。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、案例剖析等环节培养学生的工程思维和专业知识的应用能力，通过智慧水系统、城市供水数据采集与监视控制、城市水系统通信技术、城市水系统监测模型以及城市水系统预测模型等的讲解，使学生对城市水系统智慧管理技术的发展有较为全面的了解并掌握相应的理论与工程技术，加深对城市水系统智慧化运维管理技术的系统认识。
default.en: Intelligent Management of urban water system is a kind of modern scientific and technological means, such as integrated information technology, Internet of Things Technology, Big Data Analysis and cloud computing, etc. , the purpose of the city water supply, drainage, sewage treatment and other water links for comprehensive, fine management and efficient operation of intelligent solutions. The main task of this course is to train students' ability of engineering thinking and application of professional knowledge through classroom teaching and case analysis, through intelligent water system, urban water supply data collection and monitoring control, urban water system communication technology, urban water system monitoring model and urban water system prediction model, etc. , to enable students to have a more comprehensive understanding of the development of intelligent management technology of urban water system and grasp the corresponding theory and engineering technology, deepen the systematic understanding of intelligent operation and maintenance management technology of urban water system.

default.zh: 在工业生产或产品加工过程中，都不可避免地产生大量的废水；在较为广泛应用于固体废弃物的卫生填埋处理过程中，也将产生一种高浓度的废水——垃圾渗滤液。与一般城市污水相比，这些废水抑或含有较高的悬浮物，抑或呈强烈的酸碱特性，抑或含有重金属，抑或含有大量的病原微生物等等，亦即呈现具有特殊的物理、化学或生物学特性。废水的特性不同，所采用的废水处理工艺流程也就不同，为了开拓学生的视野，增强学生解决实际问题的能力，我们开设了《特种水处理技术》课程。 本课程针对10种常见的废水，其中包括发酵工业废水、制革工业废水、煤气生产废水、制浆造纸工业废水、医院污水、精细化工废水、重金属工业废水、肉类加工废水、石油化工废水和垃圾渗滤液。全面系统的阐述了有关各种废水的产生过程、水量与水质特性和处理工艺与工程实践经验。 通过本课程的学习，可以训练与培养给排水科学工程与环境工程专业的本科生的分析与解决实际问题的能力，使其做到能够根据水量、水质特性提出适宜的处理工艺流程和参数，增长实践知识。
default.en: In industry production and product processing，there can’t avoid generate a large amount wastewater。In the process of sanitation landfill treating solid-waste, it may generate a high concentration wastewater-leachate. Comparing with the typical municipal wastewater, it may contain high concentration SS, or have strong acid-alkali characteristic, or contain heavy metal, or a great number of pathogen and etc., or have special physical, chemistry or biological characteristic. Since the characteristic of wastewater is different, the adopted wastewater treatment process is also different. In order to widen the view and strength the faculty in carrying out the practical question of students, the is set up. In the course, the generation process, flux, water quality, treatment process and engineering practical experiment of fertilization wastewater, tannery wastewater, coal gasification wastewater, mill wastewater, hospital wastewater, synthetic fiber wastewater, heavy metal wastewater, packinghouse wastewater, petrol wastewater and leachate, are full-scale explained. The study of the course can train and discipline the capability of analyzing and carrying out question of graduate student of water and wastewater engineering and environmental engineering major, make them take appropriate treatment process and parameter according to flux and water quality, increase their practical knowledge.

default.zh: 本课程主要内容包括：将水质分析中最常用的几种仪器分析测试方法如分子光谱分析法(紫外-可见吸收光谱、荧光光谱、红外吸收光谱)、原子光谱分析法（原子吸收光谱、原子发射光谱）、色谱分析法（气相色谱、液相色谱、离子色谱）、质谱分析法（质谱分析、气相色谱-质谱联用、液相色谱-质谱联用）等传授给学生，突出基本原理、基本概念、基本操作，提高学生对各种仪器分析方法在环境水样分析中的应用能力，同时使学生了解相关分析仪器的国内外最新发展动态。 本课程的特色是围绕水质指标体系的不断发展和对现代检测分析方法快速准确的要求，将仪器分析方法分类讲解并与给水排水专业水质分析任务紧密联系，了解本领域国内外先进分析仪器基本原理、相关分析方法和仪器分析进展动态，重点培养学生在今后的工程实践中遇到水中环境污染物和水质指标分析检测任务时的综合分析与应对能力。
default.en: The main contents of this course include: Several instrument analysis and test methods commonly used in water quality analysis, such as molecular spectrum analysis methods (UV-visible absorption spectrum, fluorescence spectrum, infrared absorption spectrum), atomic spectrum analysis methods (atomic absorption spectrum, atomic emission spectrum), chromatographic analysis methods (gas chromatography, liquid chromatography, ion chromatography), mass spectrometry analysis method (mass spectrometry，gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS)) are taught to students, highlighting the basic principles, basic concepts and basic operations, improving students' application ability of various instrumental analysis methods in environmental water sample analysis, and enabling students to understand the latest development of relevant analytical instruments around the world. The feature of this course is to focus on the continuous development of water quality index system and the rapid and accurate requirements of modern detection and analysis methods, classify and explain instrumental analysis methods, closely link with water quality analysis tasks of water supply and drainage specialty, let the students understand the basic principles of advanced analytical instruments around the world, relevant analysis methods and instrumental analysis progress in this field, and focus on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and response ability of water environmental pollutants and water quality indicators in the future engineering practice.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授水质安全的基本定义、水质安全对公共安全的影响；水处理工艺的基本原理、水处理工艺内容、水处理工艺存在的问题和未来的发展方向；水的输送与收集系统的主要模式与应用；水环境安全的基本概念和界定及对生态环境安全的意义；城市水循环的基本概念、实现方式、需要解决的问题、和发展趋势等内容。
default.en: Principle of water quality engineering

default.zh: 《城市垃圾处理技术》是给排水科学与工程专业的一门专业选修课之一。本课程以城市垃圾处理与利用流程为主线，从城市垃圾的来源与组成出发，重点介绍城市垃圾管理情况、收集运输方法、主要处理技术和经济分析等内容；结合传统内容与科技前沿，熟悉城市垃圾处理的历史脉络；融合理论与实践，掌握城市垃圾处理的技术和方法，为智慧城市、生态城市、“无废”城市的建设培养复合型人才。
default.en: Urban Waste Treatment Technology is one of the elective courses for water science and engineering undergraduates. This course uses the process of urban waste treatment and utilization as the mainline. It starts from the source and composition of urban waste and focuses on urban waste management, collection and transportation methods, treatment technologies, and economic analysis. During the study, the traditional knowledge and advanced technology will be combined to familiarize students with the historical development of urban waste treatment. Besides, theory and practice will also be integrated so that students can master the technologies and methods better. This course aims to train compound talents for building smart cities, ecological cities, and "no-waste" cities.
