default.zh: 本课程对环境保护的重要概念和主要技术分支给予综合介绍，使学生对环境保护的科学理论发展有较为全面的了解并掌握相应工程技术的概貌。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂讲授、学生互动环节培养学生掌握对于环境保护技术的概貌，并掌握相关技术的专业英语词汇，支撑学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1. 掌握环境保护相关基本概念，掌握大气污染及防治、水污染及防治、固体废物处置利用、环境噪声及控制的工程技术概貌。（支撑毕业要求1） 课程目标2. 具有使用现代实验手段、工具进行数据分析、处理的能力；（支撑毕业要求5） 课程目标3. 使学生具备通过环境保护工程技术知识的掌握来理解环境保护与可持续发展的关联。（支撑毕业要求7） 课程目标4. 学生培养起具有较好的合作意识（支撑毕业要求9） 课程目标5. 掌握环境保护工程技术知识英文专业词汇，具备一定的国际视野，能够在跨文化背景下进行环境保护技术相关的沟通和交流。（支撑毕业要求10）
default.en: This course gives a comprehensive introduction to the important concepts and main technical branches of environmental protection, so that students can have a comprehensive understanding of the development of scientific theories of environmental protection and master the overview of corresponding engineering technologies. The main task of this course is to train students to master the overview of environmental protection technology through classroom lectures and student interaction, and to master the professional English vocabulary of related technologies, so as to support the achievement of corresponding indicators in the learning outcomes. The course objectives require the following abilities of students: Course Objectives 1. Master the basic concepts related to environmental protection, and master the engineering technology overview of air pollution and prevention, water pollution and prevention, solid waste disposal and utilization, and environmental noise and control. (Support Graduation Requirement 1) Course Objective 2. Have the ability to use modern experimental methods and tools for data analysis and processing; (support graduation requirement 5) Course Objective 3. To equip students to understand the relationship between environmental protection and sustainable development through the mastery of environmental protection engineering and technical knowledge. (Support Graduation Requirement 7) Course Objective 4. Students develop a good sense of cooperation (support graduation requirement 9) Course Objective 5. Master the English professional vocabulary of environmental protection engineering technology knowledge, have a certain international perspective, and be able to communicate and exchange related to environmental protection technology in a cross-cultural context. (Support Graduation Requirement 10)

default.zh: 本课程为市政工程系给水排水工程专业的选修专业课，属于我系本科教学计划中的选修课程之一。通过该课程的学习，使学生基本掌握水污染控制所用材料（包括氧化剂、催化剂、滤池滤料、反应池填料、吸附剂、磁性稀土絮凝剂、污泥脱水剂等）的化学性质、使用范围、使用方法、使用量、材料成本等内容；较扎实地掌握水的各种处理的基本概念、基本理论、基本方法及其发展状况；基本掌握应用于水处理的各种功能材料的化学分析技术、合成与制备方法以及在水处理工艺应用现状等，为将来从事本专业的科研及运行管理工作等奠定一定的理论和应用基础。
default.en: This course is an elective course for the water supply and drainage engineering major of the Department of Municipal Engineering, and belongs to one of the elective courses in the undergraduate teaching plan of my department. Through the study of this course, students can basically master the chemical properties, application scope, application method, usage amount and material cost of materials used in water pollution control (including oxidant, catalyst, filter media, reaction tank filler, adsorbent, magnetic rare earth flocculant, sludge dehydrating agent, etc.). A solid grasp of the basic concepts, basic theories, basic methods of water treatment and their development; Basic grasp of the chemical analysis technology, synthesis and preparation methods of various functional materials applied to water treatment and the application status of water treatment technology, etc., to lay a certain theoretical and application foundation for the future scientific research and operation management of this major.

default.zh: 《城市水体治理与修复》是给水排水工程专业的选修课。它是在讨论城市内河社会经济和生态环境功能、水体污染的严峻现状、水体污染与生态退化成因和过程的基础上，系统介绍城市内河污染治理与生态修复的理论、方法与实践，包括城市内河资源环境生态调查、污染源控制与治理、水体与滨岸带生态修复及城市水资源可持续管理等内容。
default.en: Urban Water Treatment and Restoration is an elective course for water supply and drainage engineering. It systematically introduces the theory, method and practice of urban inland river pollution treatment and ecological restoration on the basis of discussing the social economy and ecological environment function of urban inland river, the serious situation of water pollution, the causes and processes of water pollution and ecological degradation, including urban inland river resource and environmental ecological investigation, pollution source control and treatment, water body and riparian zone ecological restoration and sustainable management of urban water resources.

default.zh: 城市消防工程智能计算是给水排水专业必修的一门专业课程，是为高层工业和民用建筑提供必需的生产条件和舒适、卫生、安全的生活环境的应用科学。随着城市化进程加快，建筑业迅猛发展，高层建筑、商业建筑、公共娱乐建筑、大型多功能建筑、工业建筑和地下建筑等越来越多，建筑布局及功能日益复杂，物资和人员聚集，用火、用电、用气频繁，使建筑火灾隐患大大增加，特大建筑恶性建筑火灾经常发生，给城市和人民的生命财产安全造成极大威胁。分析建筑火灾发生和造成严重后果的原因，其中最主要的是一点是缺乏完善的消防给水系统。可见，建筑消防给水系统对于确保建筑物的安全，减少火灾危险，保护人生和财产安全起着十分重要的作用。本课程要求学生掌握消防工程的基本理论、设计原理和方法及安装、管理方面的基本知识；具有消防工程的设计、施工及管理能力，了解本学科国内外发展动向和先进技术。该课程是为给排水工程专业学生毕业设计和毕业后就业做准备的必修课程。
default.en: "Intelligent Calculation of Urban Fire Engineering" is a required professional course of Water Supply and Drainage Engineering, which is to provide the necessary production conditions and comfortable, health, safe living environment for high-rise industrial and civil buildings of the application of science. With the accelerating urbanization, the rapid development of construction industry, high-rise buildings, commercial building, public entertainment, large multifunctional buildings, industrial buildings and underground buildings, such as more and more, increasingly complex building layout and function, material and personnel gathered, with fire, electricity, gas, which increases the building fire hazards, super-large malignant buildings fire happen frequently, and those factors have caused great threat to the city and people's life and property security. Analysis of building fire and the cause of serious consequences, one of the most important is the lack of perfect fire water supply system. It can be seen that the building fire water supply system plays a very important role in ensuring the safety of the building, reducing the fire risk, and protecting the safety of life and property. This course requires students to master the basic theory, design principles and methods of fire engineering, as well as the basic knowledge of installation and management. Have the design, construction and management ability of fire engineering, understand the development trend and advanced technology of this discipline at home and abroad. This course is a required course for students majoring in Water Supply and Drainage Engineering to prepare for their graduation design and employment after graduation.

default.zh: 给排水工程监理是给排水工程领域的专业课之一。本课程是在掌握了水质工程学、水工程输配系统等课程知识基础上，进入一步深入学习给排水专业的知识。本课程的教学定位是为了让学生掌握给排水工程建设项目监理主要理论与相关实务，熟悉建设工程设计方案的优选和设计文件的审查，掌握建设工程的质量、投资和工期控制，了解建设合同履行监督及安全管理等内容。本课程的主要特点是实践性较强，在教学中采用理论和实践相结合的教学方法，以典型施工任务为载体，以项目为导向，建立起基于监理工作过程的课程体系，培养学生解决施工中实际问题的工作能力。
default.en: Supervision of water supply and drainage engineering is one of the professional courses in the field of water supply and drainage engineering. This course is designed to further study the knowledge of water supply and drainage based on the mastery of water quality engineering, water transmission and distribution systems, and other courses. The teaching orientation of this course is to enable students to master the main theories and related practices of supervision in water supply and drainage construction projects, familiarize themselves with the optimization of construction engineering design schemes and the review of design documents, grasp the quality, investment, and duration control of construction projects, and understand the supervision of construction contract performance and safety management. The main feature of this course is its strong practicality. A teaching method combining theory and practice is adopted in teaching. With typical construction tasks as the carrier and projects as the orientation, a curriculum system based on the supervision work process is established to cultivate students' ability to solve practical problems in construction.

default.zh: 本课程着重从专业角度研究水环境质量、水工程建设、水工程管理等方面的有关法规，是给排水科学与工程专业的人文课程之一。学生通过本课程的学习，培养水工程法律意识，了解我国给排水科学与工程法规的发展，了解给排水科学与工程的法规体系及与其它相关法规的关系，掌握“水法”、“水污染防治法”基本原则、基本制度、基本规定，水环境质量标准、水污染物排放标准，以及水工程设施法规中有关“规划、设计、施工”等基本规定，在以后的工作中做到“知法、守法、用法”。本课程的主要特点是理论和逻辑性较强，教学难点主要包括水工程标准、水污染控制相关的法规、水工程合同的基本要素和特点、水工程规划与城市规划的法律关系、水工程设计活动的管理法规、水工程建设的强制标准、水工程的水质标准等内容。在教学中采用理论和实践相结合的教学方法，以项目为导向，引导学生独立思考，强化科学思维的训练，培养学生解决水工程实际问题的工作能力。
default.en: This course focuses on studying relevant regulations on water environmental quality, water engineering construction, and water engineering management from a professional perspective. It is one of the humanities courses for Water Supply and Drainage Science and Engineering majors. Through this course, students develop legal awareness in water engineering, understand the development of water supply and drainage science and engineering regulations in China, comprehend the regulatory system of water supply and drainage science and engineering and its relationship with other relevant laws and regulations, grasp the basic principles, basic systems, and basic provisions of the "Water Law" and "Water Pollution Prevention and Control Law", water environmental quality standards, water pollutant emission standards, as well as the basic provisions related to "planning, design, and construction" in water engineering facilities regulations. The goal is to ensure that students can "know the law, abide by the law, and apply the law" in their future work. The main characteristics of this course are strong theoretical and logical nature. The teaching difficulties mainly include water engineering standards, water pollution control-related regulations, basic elements and characteristics of water engineering contracts, legal relationships between water engineering planning and urban planning, management regulations for water engineering design activities, mandatory standards for water engineering construction, water quality standards for water engineering, etc. A combination of theory and practice is adopted in teaching, with a project-oriented approach to guide students to think independently, strengthen scientific thinking training, and cultivate students' ability to solve practical problems in water engineering.

default.zh: 面向生态文明建设国家战略，服务于海绵城市建设、黑臭水体治理及智慧水务等城市水系统重构层面的复杂工程问题等国家重大需求，以“保护城市水资源、提升城市水环境、重构城市水生态、保障城市水安全”为导向，国民经济可持续发展的关键所在。《海绵城市与雨洪控制》是《给排水科学与工程专业》核心课。全面介绍了海绵城市相关的基本知识、方法和技能，雨洪控制理念与原则、城镇雨洪控制措施、基本理论和设计计算、海绵城市设计技术措施、案例分析等。通过本课程的学习可以让学生掌握城市雨洪控制的基本理论和设计计算方法，提高分析和解决实际工程问题的能力，具备海绵城市与雨洪控制相关规划、设计和管理的能力。
default.en: Facing the national strategy of ecological civilization construction, it serves the important needs of the country, such as the construction of Sponge City, the treatment of black and smelly water body and the complex engineering problems in the reconstruction of urban water system, such as the intelligent water affairs, etc. , the key to sustainable development of national economy is to protect urban water resources, improve urban water environment, reconstruct urban water ecology and ensure urban water security. "Sponge City and rain flood control" is the core course of"Water supply and drainage science and engineering specialty". The basic knowledge, methods and skills related to Sponge City were introduced comprehensively, concept and principle of rain and flood control, urban rain and flood control measures, basic theory and design calculation, Sponge City design technical measures, case analysis, etc. . Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theory of urban rain and flood control and design calculation methods, and improve the ability to analyze and solve practical engineering problems, ability to plan, design and manage sponge cities and storm and flood control.

default.zh: 建筑小区雨水利用是给排水工程专业的一门专家选修课，是海绵城市建设的技术支撑。随着城市化进程加快，水资源是不可再生的资源， 必须给与最大的保护。实现“四节”必须立足地区特点，充分考虑 水资源条件与承受能力，充分利用新型能源和可再生能源，充分节 约能源，同时保持和体现建筑的地方特色和民族文化。本课程要求 学生掌握我国建筑与小区雨水控制与利用的背景、国内外雨水控制 与利用经验与现状（日本雨水利用、德国雨水利用、深圳雨水利用 和北京雨水利用）、雨水控制与利用的概念与术语、雨水控制与利 用系统与工程技术要点、建筑与小区雨水控制与利用工程案例（新 加坡滨海湾花园、英国诺丁汉大学朱比利校区）、活水兴城 皖北坐标——宿州黑臭水体治理工程及城市形象提升方案、海绵城市建设实践——低影响开发雨水系统构建、宿州市中心区海绵城市建设专项规划（2016-2030）、国家体育场雨洪利用系统与奥运理念。该课程是为给排水工程专业学生毕业设计和毕业后就业做准备的必修课程。
default.en: Rain Utilization In Building and Sub-district Rainwater utilization in building community is an elective course of water supply and drainage engineering, which is the technical support of sponge city construction. With the acceleration of urbanization, water is a non-renewable resource that must be given maximum protection. The realization of the "four sections" must be based on regional characteristics, fully consider the conditions and bearing capacity of water resources, make full use of new and renewable energy sources, and fully save energy, while maintaining and reflecting the local characteristics and national culture of the building. This course requires students to master the background of stormwater control and utilization in buildings and residential areas in China, experience and status quo of stormwater control and utilization at home and abroad (stormwater utilization in Japan, stormwater utilization in Germany, stormwater utilization in Shenzhen and stormwater utilization in Beijing), concepts and terms of stormwater control and utilization, key points of stormwater control and utilization system and engineering technology, stormwater control and utilization engineering cases in buildings and residential areas ( Gardens by the Bay, Singapore, Jubilee Campus, University of Nottingham, UK), Living Water Xingcity North Anhui coordinates - Suzhou Black and odor-water treatment Project and urban image enhancement Scheme, Sponge city construction practice - Construction of low-impact development rainwater system, Special Planning for Sponge City Construction in downtown Suzhou (2016-2030), National Stadium rainwater utilization system and Olympic concept. This course is a required course for students majoring in water supply and drainage engineering to prepare for graduation design and employment after graduation.

default.zh: 消防给水及灭火设施是一门专业课程，是为高层工业和民用建筑提供必需的生产条件和舒适、卫生、安全的生活环境的应用科学。随着城市化进程加快，建筑业迅猛发展，高层建筑、商业建筑、公共娱乐建筑、大型多功能建筑、工业建筑和地下建筑等越来越多，建筑布局及功能日益复杂，物资和人员聚集，用火、用电、用气频繁，使建筑火灾隐患大大增加，特大建筑恶性建筑火灾经常发生，给城市和人民的生命财产安全造成极大威胁。分析建筑火灾发生和造成严重后果的原因，其中最主要的是一点是缺乏完善的消防给水系统。可见，建筑消防给水系统对于确保建筑物的安全，减少火灾危险，保护人生和财产安全起着十分重要的作用。本课程要求学生掌握消防工程的基本理论、设计原理和方法及安装、管理方面的基本知识；具有消防工程的设计、施工及管理能力，了解本学科国内外发展动向和先进技术。该课程是为给排水工程专业学生毕业设计和毕业后就业做准备的必修课程。
default.en: "Fire Protection Water Supply and Fire Extinguishing" is a required professional course of Water Supply and Drainage Engineering, which is to provide the necessary production conditions and comfortable, health, safe living environment for high-rise industrial and civil buildings of the application of science. With the accelerating urbanization, the rapid development of construction industry, high-rise buildings, commercial buildings, public entertainment, large multifunctional buildings, industrial buildings and underground buildings, such as more and more, increasingly complex building layout and function, material and personnel gathered, with fire, electricity, gas, which increases the building fire hazards, super-large malignant buildings fire happen frequently, and those factors have caused great threat to the city and people's life and property security. Analysis of building fire and the cause of serious consequences, one of the most important is the lack of perfect fire water supply system. It can be seen that the building fire water supply system plays a very important role in ensuring the safety of the building, reducing the fire risk, and protecting the safety of life and property. This course requires students to master the basic theory, design principles and methods of fire engineering, as well as the basic knowledge of installation and management. Have the design, construction and management ability of fire engineering, understand the development trend and advanced technology of this discipline at home and abroad. This course is a required course for students majoring in Water Supply and Drainage Engineering to prepare for their graduation design and employment after graduation.

default.zh: 《建筑给水排水工程技术应用》是专业必修的一门专业课程，属于为工业和民用建筑提供必也对建筑给水排水的理论研究提出了更高要求。同时随着新技术、新设备、新材料在工程中的不断应用，理论和实践都对建筑给水排水工程的设计施工管理提出了更高的要求。本课程主要内容包括建筑内部的给水、消防给水、排水、雨水、热水供应等有关内容的基本理论、设计原理及设计方法。同时还涉及安装、管理方面的基本知识和技术。
default.en: Application of Building Water Supply and Drainage Engineering" is a professional compulsory course, belongs to the industrial and civil buildings to provide the necessary production conditions and comfortable, health, safe living environment of the applied science. With the increase of the number of high-rise buildings, the construction water supply and drainage engineering technology has been continuously developed, and higher requirements have been put forward for the theoretical research of building water supply and drainage. At the same time, with the continuous application of new technology, new equipment and new materials in engineering, both theory and practice have put forward higher requirements for the design and construction management of building water supply and drainage other related contents in the building. At the same time, it also involves the basic knowledge and technology of installation and management.

default.zh: 管廊是将城市生活所必需的供水、供电、照明、通信、燃气、热力、雨水、污水等管线集成于地下隧道空间，实施统一管理，有效改善生命线工程的运营及维护，从而有力地保障城市社会生产与生活的正常进行，是增强现代城市韧性的有效手段。自2015年8月10日，国务院发布推进城市地下综合管廊建设的指导意见以来，我国管廊工程迎来了跨越式发展，在规划、设计、施工与运营管理方面积累了一定的经验。 本课程是给排水科学与工程专业的一门较重要的专业选修课，主要讲授专业性强的综合管廊内容，如综合管廊的基本理论、规划、总体设计。管线设计、附属设施设计、结构设计等。通过本课程的学习，使学生形成初步的工程实践能力，培养更多能够掌握综合管廊技术的专业性人才。
default.en: The pipe gallery is the integration of water supply, power supply, lighting, communication, communication, gas, heat, rain, sewage, sewage and other pipelines necessary for urban life. The normal development of social production and life is an effective means to strengthen the toughness of modern urban. Since August 10, 2015, when the State Council released the guidance of promoting the construction of urban underground comprehensive pipe corridors, the Chinese pipeline corridor project has ushered in leapfrog development and has accumulated some experience in planning, design, construction and operation management. This course is a more important professional elective course for water drainage science and engineering. It mainly teaches professional integrated pipe corridors, such as the basic theory, planning, and overall design of the comprehensive pipe gallery. Pipeline design, auxiliary facilities design, structural design, etc. Through the study of this course, students can form preliminary engineering practical ability, and cultivate more professional talents that can master the technology of comprehensive pipe galleries.

default.zh: 本课程是给排水工程专业的一门专业技术课程，其主要任务是使学生初步掌握水工程项目组织建设等方面的基本知识和基本技能，能够进行水工程施工组织管理、工程建设项目管理和工程预算等方面工作，为学生毕业后从事设计、施工、运行管理和科研等工作方面打下基础。本课程的主要特点是涉及项目的规划、组织、指挥、协调和控制等多个方面，课程内容丰富，涵盖了项目管理的各个方面，体现出较高的综合性。在教学中将工程项目管理的理论知识与实践相结合，通过工程项目管理案例的分析，引导学生从工程项目管理的角度看待问题，应用工程项目管理的理念和方法分析问题、解决问题，为解决复杂工程实践管理问题奠定扎实的理论和方法基础，培养学生解决水工程建设与运营实际问题的工作能力。
default.en: This course is a professional technical course for Water Supply and Drainage Engineering majors. Its main task is to enable students to initially grasp the basic knowledge and skills related to the organization and construction of water engineering projects, so that they can perform work such as water engineering construction organization and management, engineering construction project management, and engineering budgeting. This lays a foundation for students to engage in design, construction, operation management, and scientific research after graduation. The main characteristic of this course is that it involves multiple aspects such as project planning, organization, command, coordination, and control. The course content is rich, covering various aspects of project management, reflecting a high degree of comprehensiveness. In teaching, the theoretical knowledge of engineering project management is combined with practice. Through the analysis of engineering project management cases, students are guided to view problems from the perspective of engineering project management, and apply the concepts and methods of engineering project management to analyze and solve problems. This lays a solid theoretical and methodological foundation for solving complex engineering practice management problems and cultivates students' ability to solve practical problems in water engineering construction and operation.

default.zh: 《水系统信息化技术》是给排水科学与工程专业与城市水系统工程专业本科生的选修课，主要目的是对水系统信息化相关的基本概念、关键技术和典型应用给予综合介绍，使学生对水系统信息化技术的发展有较为全面的了解并掌握相应工程技术的概貌。本课程的特色在于与大数据、人工智能等相关领域知识相结合，建立本专业与计算机专业之间的联系与“接口”。同时，课程内容结合水系统信息化技术的最新进展和发展趋势,强调水系统信息化技术在实际水务工作中的应用,使学生了解行业技术前沿,支撑学习成果中相应指标点的达成，为从事相关工作做好准备。课程主要讲解水系统信息化技术中智慧水利、智慧水务等系统的相关理念和关键技术，以及城市水系统监测及预警模型的基本架构及应用场景。旨在培养学生具有综合应用多种信息化手段解决实际水系统工程问题的能力，进一步培养与时俱进、发展新方法和新技术的创新思维和创新能力。
default.en: “Water system information technology” is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in Science and engineering of water supply and drainage and Urban water system engineering, the main objective is to give a comprehensive introduction to the basic concepts, key technologies and typical applications related to water system informatization, to enable students to have a more comprehensive understanding of the development of water system information technology and grasp the general situation of the corresponding engineering technology. The characteristic of this course is to combine the knowledge of big data, artificial intelligence and other related fields, and establish the connection and“Interface” between this major and computer major. At the same time, the content of the course, combined with the latest progress and development trend of water system information technology, emphasizes the application of water system information technology in the actual water affairs work, so that students can understand the leading edge of industry technology, support learning results in the corresponding indicators to achieve points, in order to prepare for related work. This course mainly introduces the related concepts and key technologies of Intelligent Water Conservancy and intelligent water affair in water system information technology, as well as the basic structure and application scenario of urban water system monitoring and early warning model. The aim is to develop students' ability to solve practical systems engineering problems through a comprehensive application of various information-based means, and to further develop their innovative thinking and ability to keep abreast of the times and develop new methods and technologies.

default.zh: 《高层建筑给排水系统设计》是给水排水专业必修的一门专业课程，属于为高层工业和民用建筑提供必需的生产条件和舒适、卫生、安全的生活环境的应用科学。随着高层建筑数量的增加，高层建筑给水排水工程技术也不断发展进步，同时也对高层建筑给水排水的理论研究提出了更高要求。同时随着新技术、新设备、新材料在工程中的不断应用，理论和实践都对高层建筑给水排水工程的设计施工管理提出了更高的要求。本课程主要内容包括高层建筑内部的给水、消防给水、排水、雨水、热水供应等有关内容的基本理论、设计原理及设计方法。同时还涉及安装、管理方面的基本知识和技术。
default.en: Water Supply and Drainage in High-rise Building is a required professional course for water supply and drainage major, which belongs to the applied science of providing necessary production conditions and comfortable, hygienic and safe living environment for high-rise industrial and civil buildings. With the increase of the number of high-rise buildings, the water supply and drainage engineering technology of high-rise buildings has been continuously developed, and higher requirements have been put forward for the theoretical research of water supply and drainage of high-rise buildings. At the same time, with the continuous application of new technology, new equipment and new materials in engineering, both theory and practice have put forward higher requirements for the design and construction management of water supply and drainage engineering of high-rise buildings. The main content of this course includes the basic theory, design principle and design method of water supply, fire water supply, drainage, rainwater, hot water supply and other related contents in high-rise buildings. At the same time, it also involves the basic knowledge and technology of installation and management.

default.zh: 智能水厂是以智能化的方法，利用先进的模拟和信息技术来改变传统水务业务系统的运作方式，以提高决策、运营和管理能力。而水厂的管控则向“数字化精细管理、智能化全流程控制”的趋势发展，站在水厂整体运维的角度，解决水厂设备、生产和运维的疑难问题。 课程任务是通过智能控制技术的发展与特点、智慧水系统、城市供水数据采集与监视控制（SCADA）系统、城市水系统监测模型及水处理典型工艺单元的智能控制等内容培养学生了解和掌握与水工艺智能控制有关的基本知识，以及人工智能及自动化技术在水科学与工程中的各种应用，并具有进一步钻研水工艺智能控制技术的能力。
default.en: The intelligent water plant uses the advanced simulation and information technology to change the operation mode of the traditional water business system in order to improve the ability of decision-making, operation and management. The management and control of waterworks is developing towards“Digital fine management and intelligent whole process control”, which solves the problems of equipment, production and operation of waterworks. The task of this course is to train students to understand and master the basic knowledge related to intelligent control of water technology through the development and characteristics of intelligent control technology, intelligent water system, urban water supply data collection and monitoring control (SCADA) system, urban water system monitoring model and intelligent control of typical process units of water treatment, and artificial intelligence and automation in water science and engineering applications, and has the ability to further study the water technology of intelligent control technology.

default.zh: 《城市雨洪模拟与控制》是《城市水系统工程专业》核心主干课。这是一门结合了给水排水、水文、水利和计算机等多学科专业知识的课程，具有很强的理论性和实践性。该课程的主要内容包括海绵城市雨洪管理规划、城市雨水系统设计理论、雨水管网建模基础、常见的城市雨洪管理模型（SWMM）, 城市防洪排涝技术与方法、工程案例分析等。课程以海绵城市建设规划为引导，以雨洪预测、模拟、控制和排除为技术手段，使学生掌握城市雨水收集、调蓄、下渗、回用和排放等设计计算方法。本课程设置案例设计，让学生根据背景资料提出城市雨洪控制设计方案；通过建立水力水文模型，验证各方案在不同暴雨强度下的排水能力；然后分析结果并不断优化方案；得出最终设计方案。通过本课程的学习可以让学生掌握城市雨洪控制的基本理论和设计计算方法，提高分析和解决实际工程问题的能力，具备城市雨洪控制相关规划、设计和管理的能力。
default.en: Urban Stormwater Simulation and Control is the core course of Urban Water System Engineering. This is a course that combines multi-disciplinary expertise such as water supply and drainage, hydrology, water conservancy and computer, with strong theoretical and practical characteristics. The main contents of this course include sponge city stormwater management planning, urban stormwater system design theory, stormwater pipe network modeling basis, common urban stormwater management model (SWMM), urban flood control and drainage technology and methods, project case analysis, etc. Guided by sponge city construction planning, the course uses stormwater prediction, simulation, control and elimination as technical means to enable students to master the design and calculation methods of urban rainwater collection, regulation and storage, infiltration, reuse and discharge. This course provides case design, allowing students to propose urban stormwater control design scheme according to background information; Through the establishment of hydraulic hydrological model, the drainage capacity of each scheme under different rainstorm intensity was verified. Then analyze the results and continuously optimize the scheme; Come up with the final design.Through the study of this course, students can master the stormwater control, improve the ability to analyze and solve practical engineering problems, and acquire the ability of planning, design and management of urban stormwater control.

default.zh: 本课程积极响应海绵城市建设、黑臭水体治理及智慧水务等城市水系统重构层面国际前沿科学与工程问题及国家的重大需求，以“保护城市水资源、提升城市水环境、重构城市水生态、保障城市水安全”为导向，从污染物水文地质学基础、地下水污染调查、地下水污染的评价、模拟与预测以及地下水污染防治四个方面较全面、系统地介绍有关地下水污染与防治的基本概念、基本理论、基本模型和技术方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握有关地下水污染与防治的基本概念、基本理论和基本方法，具备从事地下水污染与防治的科学研究与实践的基本能力，并能够综合运用专业知识解决当前我国城市水系统发展过程中面临的水环境问题。 本课程的重点内容包括：地下水污染、地下水污染源和地下水污染物的概念和地下水污染的特点及四种污染途径，地下水污染源和污染物的分类与特征；污染物在地下水中运移的水动力弥散理论和方程；污染物在地下水中经历的主要物理、化学和生物过程；地下水污染调查的主要方法、内容和步骤；国内外研究趋势以及我国地下水污染现状；地下水污染现状评价的主要方法和步骤；地下水污染的“以防为主、以治为辅”的基本策略（含《全国地下水污染防治规划》）等。
default.en: This course responds positively to the sponge city construction, black smelly water body management and intelligent water affairs and other urban water system reconstruction level of international frontier science and engineering issues and the country's major needs, to “protect urban water resources, enhance the urban water environment, reconstruct urban water ecology, safeguard urban water security” as the guide, from the pollutants hydrogeology foundation, It introduces the basic concepts, basic theories, basic models and technical methods of groundwater pollution and prevention in a comprehensive and systematic way in four aspects: investigation of groundwater pollution, evaluation, simulation and prediction of groundwater pollution and prevention of groundwater pollution. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic concepts, basic theories and basic methods of groundwater pollution and prevention, have the basic ability to engage in groundwater pollution and prevention of scientific research and practice, and be able to comprehensively utilize their professional knowledge to solve the current water environment problems facing the development of China's urban water system. The key contents of this course include: the concepts of groundwater pollution, groundwater pollution sources and groundwater pollutants and the characteristics of groundwater pollution and the four pollution pathways, the classification and characteristics of groundwater pollution sources and pollutants; the hydrodynamic dispersion theory and equations of pollutant transport in groundwater; the main physical, chemical and biological processes experienced by the pollutants in groundwater; the main methods, contents and steps of groundwater pollution investigation; domestic and international research trends and the groundwater environment problems faced in the development of China's urban water system. The main methods, contents and steps of groundwater pollution investigation; research trends at home and abroad and the current status of groundwater pollution in China; the main methods and steps of groundwater pollution status evaluation; the basic strategy of “preventing and treating” groundwater pollution (including the National Groundwater Pollution Prevention and Control Plan).

default.zh: 本课程立足于传统建筑给排水的智能化发展，结合行业发展趋势，系统讲解建筑给水、排水、消防、热水等子系统的智能化升级体系。课程聚焦物联网、传感监测、自动控制与大数据等关键技术，解析智能水务设备选型、系统集成及运行逻辑。同时融合绿色建筑、海绵城市、水资源回收与源分离等前沿理念，结合 BIM 协同设计等工程应用方向，衔接理论知识与实践场景。通过课程学习，可帮助同学们完善专业知识体系，掌握智慧水务核心技术，夯实工程设计、运维管理与技术研发的专业基础，适配智慧城市与绿色建筑领域的行业发展需求。
default.en: This course focuses on the intelligent development of traditional building water supply and drainage. Combined with industry development trends, it systematically elaborates the intelligent upgrading system of building water supply, drainage, fire protection, hot water and other subsystems. Centering on key technologies such as the Internet of Things, sensor monitoring, automatic control and big data, the course analyzes the selection of intelligent water service equipment, system integration and operational logic. It also integrates cutting-edge concepts including green buildings, sponge cities, water resource recycling and source separation, and incorporates engineering application directions such as BIM collaborative design to connect theoretical knowledge with practical scenarios. Upon completion of this course, students will improve their professional knowledge system, master core technologies of smart water services, and consolidate the professional foundation for engineering design, operation and maintenance management, as well as technological research and development, so as to adapt to the industry development demands in the fields of smart cities and green buildings.

default.zh: 本课程设置泵与泵站、水工艺设备与控制、水工程经济、水工程施工与运行管理等基础性专业内容。了解各类水泵的工作原理，解决城市系统不断发展过程中凸显的城市水资源调配问题；掌握城市水工艺设备设计、控制、应用相关知识，学习概预算、基本建设程序等工程经济学知识，夯实城市水系统建立过程中科学性、宏观性、经济性支撑；明确水工程施工与运行管理要点与重点，从城市水环境、城市水生态、城市水安全等多维度保障城市水系统运维完善。
default.en: This course offers fundamental professional content such as pumps and pumping stations, water process equipment and control, water engineering economics, water engineering construction, and operation management. Understand the working principles of various water pumps and solve the prominent urban water resource allocation problems in the continuous development of urban systems; Mastering the design, control, and application of urban water process equipment; Learn engineering economics knowledge such as preliminary budgeting and basic construction procedures, and strengthen the scientific, macro, and economic support in the process of establishing urban water systems; Clarify the key points and priorities of water engineering construction and operation management, and ensure the improvement of urban water system operation and maintenance from multiple dimensions such as urban water environment, urban water ecology, and urban water safety.

default.zh: 主要任务是讲解水体自然修复技术的基本概念和原理、技术的实施步骤和方法、应用案例和效果评估、与其他环境管理手段的综合应用、新兴研究和趋势、实际案例分析。掌握水体自然修复技术的定义、分类、修复机制、修复原理等基本概念。例如湿地恢复、生物修复、物理修复等技术的原理和应用。学习修复设计、实施、监测和维护等步骤，以及不同修复技术的实施方法。例如湿地的构建与管理、生物修复的策略与操作、物理修复的工程方法等。介绍实际应用中的水体自然修复案例，包括湖泊、河流、地下水等不同水体类型的修复案例，并介绍修复效果的评估方法。介绍水体自然修复技术与其他环境管理手段（如生物技术、物理技术、化学技术等）的综合应用，以及在实际应用中的技术选择、组合和优化。介绍水体自然修复技术领域的最新研究进展和趋势，包括新兴技术、新的修复策略和方法，并引导学生进行深入思考和讨论。通过实际案例分析，让学生深入了解水体自然修复技术的应用、过程，培养学生的问题解决能力。
default.en: The main task is to explain the basic concepts and principles of natural water body restoration technology, technology implementation steps and methods, application cases and effect evaluation, comprehensive application with other environmental management methods, emerging research and trends, and actual case analysis. Master the basic concepts such as the definition, classification, repair mechanism, and repair principles of natural water body restoration technology. For example, the principles and applications of wetland restoration, bioremediation, physical restoration and other technologies. Learn the steps of restoration design, implementation, monitoring and maintenance, as well as how different restoration techniques are implemented. For example, the construction and management of wetlands, strategies and operations of bioremediation, engineering methods of physical restoration, etc. This article introduces cases of natural restoration of water bodies in practical applications, including restoration cases of different types of water bodies such as lakes, rivers, and groundwater, and introduces methods for evaluating the restoration effects. Introduces the comprehensive application of natural water body restoration technology and other environmental management methods (such as biotechnology, physical technology, chemical technology, etc.), as well as technology selection, combination and optimization in practical applications. Introduce the latest research progress and trends in the field of natural water body restoration technology, including emerging technologies, new restoration strategies and methods, and guide students to have in-depth thinking and discussion. Through actual case analysis, students can gain an in-depth understanding of the application and process of natural water restoration technology and cultivate students' problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 本课程是给城市水系统工程及相关专业根据学科发展需要新设置的一门专业性课程。课程系统地讲授了新时代背景下水的利用新途径与处理新技术，水回用技术的理论及应用实例、工艺流程与应用前景等，使学生掌握不同工艺及水回用基本原理及相关工艺的设计和运行管理方面的专业知识。
default.en: This course is a newly established professional course for urban water system engineering and related majors according to the needs of disciplinary development. The course systematically teaches new ways of utilizing and treating wastewater in the context of the new era, the theory and application examples of water reuse technology, process flow and application prospects, etc., enabling students to master professional knowledge of different processes and basic principles of water reuse, as well as the design and operation management of related processes.

default.zh: 《城市水系统智慧化》是城市水系统工程专业的专业选修课之一，课程讲授了水处理工艺单元的机理模型与数据模型以及智慧水务方面的内容。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂讲授、邀请国际知名专家讲授的环节培养学生的工程思维和专业知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1. 掌握给水处理工艺系统设计原理和计算理论方法；（支撑毕业要求1） 课程目标2. 了解给水处理工艺系统技术发展方向，具备对常见工程问题进行研究分析的能力；（支撑毕业要求2） 课程目标3. 掌握给水处理工艺系统工程设计的基本方法，具备分析和解决复杂工程问题的能力；（支撑毕业要求3） 课程目标4. 具有利用机理模型和数据模型分析研究水工艺处理工艺的相关理论；（支撑毕业要求4） 课程目标5. 了解智慧水务发展历史和技术特点，了解城市给水处理工艺系统对社会健康、安全和文化的影响；（支撑毕业要求6） 课程目标6. 了解城市给水处理工艺系统建设对环境、社会和可持续发展的影响。（支撑毕业要求7）
default.en: "Intelligent urban water system" is one of the elective courses in the field of urban water system engineering. The course covers the mechanistic models and data models of water treatment process units, as well as content related to smart water management. The main objective of this course is to cultivate students' engineering thinking and the application ability of professional knowledge through classroom lectures and sessions with internationally renowned experts, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes. The course objectives for students' abilities are as follows: Course Objective 1: Master the design principles and theoretical calculation methods of water treatment process systems; (Supporting graduation requirement 1) Course Objective 2: Understand the technological development direction of water treatment process systems, and have the ability to research and analyze common engineering problems; (Supporting graduation requirement 2) Course Objective 3: Master the basic methods of engineering design for water treatment process systems, and have the ability to analyze and solve complex engineering problems; (Supporting graduation requirement 3) Course Objective 4: Utilize mechanistic models and data models to analyze the relevant theories of water treatment processes; (Supporting graduation requirement 4) Course Objective 5: Understand the historical development and technical characteristics of smart water management, and comprehend the impact of urban water treatment process systems on social health, safety, and culture; (Supporting graduation requirement 6) Course Objective 6: Understand the impact of the construction of urban water treatment process systems on the environment, society, and sustainable development. (Supporting graduation requirement 7)

default.zh: 本课程属于环境科学与工程类本科生的新技术课程范畴，主要讲授污染物在环境中的迁移转化过程涉及的最新研究技术和手段。本课程首先介绍环境污染物的性质和种类，污染物的多介质分配过程，污染物的迁移转化过程和污染物降解过程中涉及的基本理论和知识；其次，讲授环境监测和环境模拟涉及的最新研究技术和手段，并且会介绍相关的研究案例；最后，讲授气粒分配理论的最新研究成果及应用。本课程的目标是，通过本课程的学习，学生可以掌握污染物迁移转化过程涉及的基本原理，了解相关的最新研究技术，培养学生的创新性思维和综合素质能力。
default.en: This course belongs to the category of new technology courses for undergraduate students majoring in environmental science and engineering, which mainly focuses the latest research technologies and methods on the migration and transformation process of pollutants in the environment. Firstly, this course will introduce the basic theories and knowledge involved in the properties and types of environmental pollutants, the multimedia distribution process of pollutants, the migration and transformation process of pollutants, and the degradation process of pollutants. Secondly, this course will teach the latest research technologies and methods related to environmental monitoring and simulation, and relevant research cases will also be introduced. Finally, this course will introduce the latest research achievements and applications of gas-particle distribution theory. The objective of this course is to enable students to master the basic principles involved in the process of pollutant migration and transformation, understand the latest research technologies, and cultivate their innovative thinking and comprehensive abilities through the study of this course.

default.zh: 《环境物理性污染与控制》是环境工程专业本科生的选修课程。本课程旨在向学生全面讲授我国经济社会和城市化进程的快速发展过程中亟待解决的环境物理性污染问题，在融会相关专业课程知识基础上，理解环境物理污染控制的理论知识和技术方法及国内外最新进展。整个课程包括噪声污染及其控制、振动污染及其控制、放射性污染及其控制、电磁辐射污染及其控制、热污染及其控制、光污染及其控制等。通过课程的教学，培养学生具有综合分析和解决环境物理污染问题的能力，同时能够理解国内外环境物理性污染与控制的现状与发展，为进一步从事相关的科研和工程实践工作奠定基础。
default.en: Environmental Physical Pollution and Control is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in Environmental Engineering. This course aims to comprehensively teach students the environmental physical pollution problems that urgently need to be solved in the rapid development process of China's economy, society, and urbanization. Based on the integration of relevant professional course knowledge, students will understand the theoretical knowledge and technical methods of environmental physical pollution control, as well as the latest progress at home and abroad. The entire course includes noise pollution and its control, vibration pollution and its control, radioactive pollution and its control, electromagnetic radiation pollution and its control, thermal pollution and its control, light pollution and its control, etc. Through the teaching of the course, students are trained to have the ability to comprehensively analyze and solve environmental physical pollution problems, and to understand the current situation and development of environmental physical pollution control at home and abroad, laying a foundation for further engaging in related scientific research and engineering practice work.

default.zh: AI+环境决策支持系统是一门计算机技术与环境科学与工程技术的交叉学科，是研究如何更好的利用计算机技术来预防和控制环境污染的课程。本课程针对计算机技术发展现状和环境科学与工程专业特点，紧密联系当前出现的主要环境污染问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境科学与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实验教学达成以下目标。 使学生能够将环境大数据分析方法、知识库系统、数据库设计方法、地理信息系统、全球定位系统、遥感技术等现代基本科学理论和方法应用到建立环境决策支持系统中，进而运用系统得到预防与控制环境污染的合理决策方案。同时利用生成式人工智能辅助解决环境决策领域的问题，提高学生利用AI解决环境问题的能力。

《水系统信息化技术与人工智能应用》是给排水科学与工程专业、城市水系统工程专业本科生的选修课。本课程旨在融合现代信息技术与人工智能前沿，深入探讨水系统在数据采集、处理、分析及智能决策等方面的最新发展。课程内容涵盖水系统信息化相关的基本概念、关键技术以及人工智能核心技术在水资源管理、水环境治理、给排水工程及智慧水务中的创新应用。通过理论教学、案例分析与项目实践相结合等方式，课程致力于培养学生运用人工智能技术解决水系统复杂工程问题的能力，提升其在智慧水务、可持续发展等领域的专业素养与创新能力。课程更加注重实践与创新，帮助学生掌握行业前沿动态，提升专业竞争力。本课程的特色在于与大数据、人工智能等相关领域知识相结合，建立本专业与计算机专业之间的联系与“接口”。课程内容更注重结合人工智能的最新进展和发展趋势，强调水系统信息化技术及人工智能在实际水处理工作中的应用，使学生了解行业技术前沿，支撑学习成果中相应指标点的达成，为从事科研或相关工作做好准备。
default.en: "Water System Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence Application" is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in Water Supply and Drainage Science & Engineering and Urban Water Systems Engineering. This course aims to integrate modern information technology with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, delving into the latest advancements in water systems regarding data collection, processing, analysis, and intelligent decision-making. The curriculum covers fundamental concepts of water system informatization, key technologies, and innovative applications of AI core technologies in water resource management, water environment governance, water supply and drainage engineering, and smart water services. Through a combination of theoretical instruction, case studies, and project-based learning, the course seeks to cultivate students' ability to apply AI technologies in solving complex engineering problems in water systems, enhancing their professional competence and innovative capabilities in fields such as smart water services and sustainable development.The course places a strong emphasis on practice and innovation, helping students grasp industry trends and improve their professional competitiveness. A distinctive feature of this course is its integration with knowledge from related fields such as big data and artificial intelligence, establishing connections and "interfaces" between this discipline and computer science. The content prioritizes the latest AI advancements and development trends, emphasizing the application of water system informatization and AI in practical water treatment operations. This enables students to understand cutting-edge industry technologies, supports the achievement of corresponding learning outcome indicators, and prepares them for careers in research or related fields.

default.zh: 通过课堂教学和实践活动，本课程旨在实现以下教学目标： 1. 关键问题识别与科学思维培养：学生将通过对城市污水处理相关领域的专业知识学 习和文献研究，识别当前城市污水处理厂在运营过程中面临的关键技术问题。课程将激发学生运用人工智能技术进行污水处理系统优化、故障检测和数据预测的兴趣，培养学生在解决 复杂工程问题时的科学思维和创新精神。 2. 人工智能技术基础与实践能力培养：学生将掌握人工智能的基本概念、主要技术及 其在城市污水处理中的应用。课程内容将涵盖机器学习和深度学习的基本理论、常见的模型及其优化方法，同时介绍数据采集、处理与清洗的技术。通过实践项目，学生将能够运用人工智能技术，设计并实现适用于污水处理厂的智能控制系统，例如污水处理过程的实时监控与优化调度。通过案例分析与实操，学生将全面了解人工智能技术在污水处理厂中的实际应用，并掌握技术落地的全过程。 3. 复杂问题解决能力与决策支持能力：结合实际城市污水处理厂的运营案例，课程将 训练学生在解决污水处理等复杂城市水务系统问题时的综合分析能力与系统思维。学生将学习如何应用人工智能技术进行污水处理工艺优化、能源消耗预测、设备故障诊断等工作，通过数据分析和模型预测为决策提供科学依据。课程通过课堂讲解、案例研讨和情境模拟等多种教学方式，提升学生在实际工程项目中快速决策和问题解决的能力，培养具备高水平工程实践能力的污水处理领域专业人才
default.en: Through classroom teaching and practical activities, this course aims to achieve the following teaching objectives: 1. **Identification of Key Issues and Cultivation of Scientific Thinking**: Students will learn professional knowledge and conduct literature research in the field of urban wastewater treatment to identify the key technical challenges currently faced by urban wastewater treatment plants during operation. The course will inspire students to apply artificial intelligence (AI) technologies for optimizing wastewater treatment systems, fault detection, and data prediction, fostering their scientific thinking and innovative spirit in addressing complex engineering problems. 2. **Fundamentals of AI Technology and Development of Practical Skills**: Students will acquire a solid understanding of the basic concepts and main technologies of artificial intelligence, as well as their applications in urban wastewater treatment. The curriculum will cover fundamental theories of machine learning and deep learning, common models and their optimization methods, along with techniques for data collection, processing, and cleaning. Through hands-on projects, students will learn to apply AI technologies to design and implement intelligent control systems for wastewater treatment plants, such as real-time monitoring and optimized scheduling of treatment processes. Case studies and practical exercises will provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the real-world applications of AI in wastewater treatment plants and the entire process of technology implementation. 3. **Problem-Solving and Decision-Making Support Capabilities**: Using real-world operational cases from urban wastewater treatment plants, the course will train students in comprehensive analysis and systems thinking when tackling complex urban water system challenges, such as wastewater treatment. Students will learn how to apply AI technologies for optimizing treatment processes, predicting energy consumption, diagnosing equipment failures, and other tasks, using data analysis and model predictions to provide scientific support for decision-making. Through lectures, case discussions, and scenario simulations, the course will enhance students' ability to make quick decisions and solve problems in real-world engineering projects, cultivating highly skilled professionals in the field of wastewater treatment.

default.zh: 本课程围绕“AI+环境统计与数据分析”开展，聚焦AI 在环境大数据处理的创新应用，目的在于揭示环境问题与现象的数量表现、数量关系以及规律性。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解和掌握统计设计、统计调查、统计整理和统计分析的基本理论和方法。在教学的过程中除引入应用于环境领域的实例教学，培养学生的统计学思想方法的应用能力，教学引入AI完成统计计算操作。教学方法通过理论讲授、数据处理实操与模拟案例场景实练的深度融合，培养学生创新能力和核心能力。
default.en: This course focuses on the application of AI in processing environmental big data to analyze quantitative manifestations, relationships, and patterns of environmental issues. Students will learn fundamental theories and methods of statistical design, investigation, organization, and analysis. The teaching approach includes practical examples from the environmental field to enhance students' statistical thinking skills and utilize AI for statistical calculations. The course integrates theoretical lectures, hands-on data processing, and simulated case studies to develop students' innovative and core competencies.

default.zh: 《景观生态源代码》是环境学院开设的一门专业选修课。本课程的教学目标是通过将人工智能+技术与景观生态设计深度融合，使学生可以在掌握景观生态学的基础理论的同时，了解人工智能在景观生态领域的应用，培养具备前瞻性思维和实践能力的复合型景观设计人才，并为学生提供一种解释和研究自然格局、自然过程的新思路与途径，为今后在生态、资源环境等领域工作打下基础。
default.en: "Landscape Ecology Source Code" is a specialized elective course offered by the School of Environmental Science. The teaching objectives of this course are to deeply integrate AI+ technologies with landscape ecological design, enabling students to master the fundamental theories of landscape ecology while understanding artificial intelligence applications in this field. It aims to cultivate interdisciplinary talents with forward-thinking perspectives and practical capabilities in landscape design, while providing students with innovative approaches to interpret and study natural patterns and processes. The course establishes a foundation for future careers in ecology, resource management, and environmental protection sectors.

default.zh: 本课程是以国家“人工智能+”战略为引领，面向环境工程专业智慧化转型需求设计的前沿交叉课程。课程以环境大数据为触角、人工智能先进技术为驱动，系统阐释AI+大数据在污染物排放智能核算、多介质污染协同防控、空天地一体化监测等场景中的创新应用。通过融合大数据、人工智能等新一代信息技术，培养学生构建“污染核算-模拟推演-智能调控”全链条解决方案的能力，塑造“环境系统认知、算法模型开发、智慧科学决策”的复合型知识结构，培养兼具环境工程专业知识与人工智能实践素养的复合型创新人才，为美丽中国、数字中国建设提供人才保障。
default.en: This course is a cutting-edge interdisciplinary course designed for the intelligent transformation needs of environmental engineering professionals, guided by the national "Artificial Intelligence+" strategy. The course takes environmental big data as its antenna and advanced AI technology as its driving force, systematically explaining the innovative applications of AI+big data in intelligent accounting of pollutant emissions, collaborative prevention and control of multi-media pollution, and integrated monitoring of air, land and space. By integrating big data, artificial intelligence and other new generation information technologies, we will cultivate students' ability to build a full-chain solution of "pollution accounting-simulation deduction-intelligent regulation", shape a compound knowledge structure of "environmental system cognition, algorithm model development, and intelligent scientific decision-making", and cultivate compound innovative talents with both environmental engineering expertise and artificial intelligence practical literacy, providing talent support for the construction of beautiful China and digital China.

default.zh: 《AI赋能环境数智化》是运用AI技术助力推动环境专业数据统计分析与应用的一门课程。本课程以SPSS为基础软件结合实例详述基础数据统计分析方法，在此基础上引入AI模型进行环保大数据多元统计分析与可视化的高阶能力培养，并以实际案例引导结合minitab软件平台讲授科学实验设计的基本原则与实验数据的深度挖掘方法。课程从基础原理、软件操作到智能分析，使学生能够通过有效的数据处理与分析，从而做出符合实际的科学问题的解决能力，具备合理选用并使用AI模型将统计学专业知识用于解决复杂工程问题的能力。
default.en: " AI-Supported Environmental Digitalization" is a course that uses AI technology to assist in promoting the statistical analysis and application of environmental professional data. This course, based on SPSS as the fundamental software, elaborates on basic data statistical analysis methods through practical examples. On this basis, it introduces AI models to cultivate advanced capabilities in multivariate statistical analysis and visualization of environmental big data. It also uses actual cases to guide the teaching of the basic principles of scientific experimental design and the in-depth mining methods of experimental data through the Minitab software platform. The course covers basic principles, software operation, and intelligent analysis, enabling students to effectively process and analyze data, thereby developing the ability to solve practical scientific problems. Students will also be capable of reasonably selecting and applying AI models to apply statistical knowledge to solve complex engineering problems.

default.zh: 通过介绍AI的概念、发展历史、技术分支和发展趋势，使学生建立对AI系统的认知，掌握AI基础知识，了解AI技术设计的底层逻辑；通过讲授将AI与专业知识深度融合的实际案例，帮助学生建立面向专业领域的AI知识库。 针对专业具体工程问题，通过上机实操，让学生掌握典型大模型技术的部署、接入以及知识库搭建，指导学生自建智能体应用，从而提升学生利用AI技术解决专业实际工程的水平。
课程旨在系统介绍自然资源管理的基本理论、治理框架及可持续发展实践。课程内容涵盖自然资源系统特征、产权制度设计、适应性治理模式以及全球可持续发展目标的实施策略。通过案例分析，学生将掌握自然资源综合治理方法，理解社会-生态系统的复杂性，并培养制定可持续资源管理方案的能力。本课程为环境科学、生态学及相关专业学生提供必要的专业知识基础，帮助其形成系统的自然资源治理思维
default.en: course designed to provide a systematic understanding of natural resource management theories, governance frameworks, and sustainable development practices. The curriculum covers the characteristics of natural resource systems, property rights design, adaptive governance models, and implementation strategies for global sustainability goals. Through case studies, students will learn integrated approaches to natural resource management, comprehend the complexity of social-ecological systems, and develop skills to formulate sustainable resource management plans. This course offers essential professional knowledge for students majoring in environmental science, ecology, and related fields, helping them build systematic thinking in natural resource governance

default.zh: 本课程旨在引导学生认识复杂的全球环境问题，并深入探讨其背后的能源与环境之间的相互关系。课程将重点介绍和讨论与能源-环境关联相关的主要物理化学过程及其现象。本课程将深入探讨能源系统与全球环境变化间的动态关系，重点关注可持续能源发展所需的科学与技术。学生将系统学习传统能源与可再生能源的环境影响，包括它们在气候变化、空气污染、水污染以及生态系统破坏等方面所扮演的角色。课程内容涵盖碳循环、大气科学与全球变暖、能源转换中的氧化还原过程及相关环境效应、多种能源-环境关联议题，以及国际环境协议等。通过课堂讲授、案例分析与小组讨论，学生将建立对能源生产与消耗如何影响全球环境的基础性理解。
default.en: This course aims to introduce the complex global environmental problems and the underlying energy-environment nexus. The physicochemical processes and phenomena that are related with the energy-environment nexus will be introduced and discussed. This course explores the dynamic relationship between energy systems and global environmental change, with a focus on the scientific and technological dimensions of sustainable energy development. Students will examine the environmental impacts of conventional and renewable energy sources, including their roles in climate change, air and water pollution, and ecosystem disruption. Topics include the carbon cycle, atmospheric science and global warming, redox processes in energy conversion and the related environmental processes, various energy-environment nexus issues, and international environmental agreements. Through lectures, case studies, and group discussions, students will gain a foundational understanding of how energy production and consumption shape global environmental outcomes.

default.zh: 《绿色化学导论》课程系统讲授绿色化学的基本原理、评价方法及其在环境工程源头减排中的实际应用。内容涵盖绿色化学十二原则、原子经济性评价、绿色合成路线设计、绿色溶剂与催化技术、化工过程强化与系统集成等核心知识，并结合精细化工、制药等行业清洁工艺改造案例，探讨绿色化学与环境末端治理设施的协同优化路径。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握从分子层面设计环境友好工艺的基本方法，树立源头削减与全过程控制的污染预防理念，培养综合运用绿色化学原理分析和解决实际清洁生产问题的初步能力。
default.en: The "Introduction to Green Chemistry" course systematically teaches the fundamental principles, evaluation methods of green chemistry, and its practical applications in the source reduction of environmental engineering. The content covers core knowledge such as the twelve principles of green chemistry, atomic economy evaluation, green synthetic routes design, green solvents and catalytic technologies, and process intensification and system integration in chemical engineering. It also combines cases of clean process transformation in industries like fine chemicals and pharmaceuticals to explore the collaborative optimization path between green chemistry and environmental end-of-pipe treatment facilities. Through this course, students will master the basic methods of designing environmentally friendly processes at the molecular level, establish the pollution prevention concept of source reduction and overall control, and develop the initial ability to analyze and solve actual clean production problems by comprehensively applying the principles of green chemistry.

default.zh: 本课程旨在介绍高级氧化工艺在水处理中的基本原理与应用。课程内容包括高级氧化技术（如紫外光解、臭氧氧化、芬顿工艺、光催化等）的原理、活性氧物种及其生成机制、反应动力学以及降解机理等。
default.en: The goal of this course is to provide fundamentals and applications of advanced oxidation processes (AOPs) in water treatment. Topics of the course cover the principle of AOP technologies (UV photolysis, Ozonation, Fenton process, photocatalysis, etc.), the role of reactive oxygen species (ROSs) and their generation, reaction kinetics, and degradation mechanisms.

default.zh: 《水污染控制工程课程设计》是专业核心课课程设计，通过了解污水处理厂工艺选择设计的原则及方法，基于相关环保标准、法规对污水处理厂设计的基本要求，能够在平面图中正确布设污水处理厂各构筑物；同时，掌握污水处理厂各构筑物设计的基本要求，了解设计参数选择原则，通过对相关设计软件和电算工具的使用，能够准确计算并设计污水处理厂初沉池、沉砂池、生物处理单元和二沉池，能够独立完成污水处理厂平面布置图和高程图的图纸绘制，提高综合运用所学的污水处理相关的理论知识独立分析和解决实际设计问题的能力；最后，通过对国家相关环境保护政策、法律法规和标准的讲解，全面理解工程设计中需要体现的节能、高效、经济等基本要求，以期达到设计工程的经济、社会和环境效益最大化。
default.en: 《Course Design of Water Pollution Control Engineering》is one of the core courses of the major of Environmental Engineering. By understanding the principles and methods for wastewater treatment plants designing, deepen the understanding to scientific designing of wastewater treatment plant, meanwhile satisfy the basic requirements of relevant environmental protection standards and regulations. At the same time, master the basic requirements of the design of various structures of the sewage treatment plant, understand the principles of design parameter selection, and be able to accurately calculate and design the primary sedimentation tank, sand sedimentation tank, biological treatment unit and secondary sedimentation tank of the sewage treatment plant, via the utilization of relevant design software and computer tools, and be able to independently complete the drawing of the layout and elevation of the sewage treatment plant. The course would improve the ability to analyze and solve practical design problems independently using the theoretical knowledge of sewage treatment; Finally, through the explanation of relevant national environmental protection policies, laws, regulations and standards, a comprehensive understanding of the basic requirements of energy saving, high efficiency and economy in engineering design is needed to maximize the economic, social and environmental benefits of design engineering.

default.zh: 水质工程学综合设计， 1．根据所给的原始资料，计算出进厂的设计流量和水质；2．根据水质情况，地形和上述计算结果，确定给水处理方法以及有关的处理构筑物，确定污水处理方法和污水、污泥处理的流量以及有关的处理构筑物；3．对各处理构筑物进行工艺计算，确定其形式、数目与尺寸；4．进行各处理构筑物的总体布置和给水处理流程的高程设计、污水与污泥处理流程的高程设计。
default.en: Integrated design for water quality engineering, 1. According to the original data given, calculate the design flow and water quality into the plant; 2. According to the water quality, the topography and the above calculation results, the method of water supply treatment and the related treatment structures are determined, and the method of sewage treatment and the flow rate of sewage and sludge treatment and the related treatment structures are determined. 3. Process calculation is carried out for each treatment structure to determine its form, number and size. 4. The overall layout of the treatment structures and the elevation design of the water treatment process, sewage and sludge treatment process elevation design.

default.zh: 环境科学实践是在学生完成规定的课程学习任务之后，针对环境科学专业培养目标而进行的一项实践活动，要求学生综合运用所学知识，结合实践单位工作岗位要求，解决实际问题。实践也是对学生各方面综合素质的一次检验，通过走访环境科学相关的企业事业单位，了解环境科学专业特点及人才素质的要求，增加本专业学生对专业了解，奠定就业的基础，为今后走上工作岗位打下良好基础，进一步锻炼学生参与实践的能力，培养其认真、良好的工作习惯，为今后走上工作岗位打下良好基础。同时，实践还可培养学生健康的人生观、世界观和价值观，塑造积极向上的学习、就业和择业心态，铸牢为中华民族伟大复兴而励志奋斗的情操。理顺理论知识与环境科学专业实践的衔接过程，掌握相关学习技能；环境科学实践内容以主题线路串连，实践过程以观察、讲解、访谈和讨论方式展开，本着“且行且思且学”的原则，学生在考察中“看到”环境问题所在，“思考”环境科学问题发生的根由和解决之道，“学习”其中包含的环境科学的知识，体会环境保护和可持续发展的重要性和必要性。具体而言，旨在达成以下目标：熟悉资源环境科学专业领域基本素养，提高实践能力、动手能力、解决问题和分析问题的能力，以获得有效结论；培养良好的实践与团结协作能力，为实际工作打下良好基础，能够在多学科背景下的团队中承担个体、团队成员以及负责人的角色。
default.en: Environmental science practice is an activity conducted for students after completing prescribed course learning tasks, focusing on the training objectives of environmental science majors. It requires students to comprehensively apply their acquired knowledge, integrate with the requirements of practical work positions, and solve real-world problems. Practice also serves as a comprehensive assessment of students' overall qualities. By visiting enterprises and institutions related to environmental science, students gain an understanding of the characteristics and talent qualities required in the field, enhancing their knowledge of the profession and laying the foundation for future employment. This practice also helps students develop practical skills, cultivate a serious and good work ethic, and establish a solid foundation for their future careers. Simultaneously, practice cultivates students' healthy outlook on life, worldview, and values, shaping a positive attitude towards learning, employment, and career choices. It forges the spirit of striving for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. To align theoretical knowledge with the practical aspects of environmental science, students master relevant learning skills. The content of environmental science practice follows thematic routes, incorporating observation, explanations, interviews, and discussions. Guided by the principle of "walk, think, and learn," students "see" environmental issues during inspections, "reflect" on the causes and solutions to environmental science problems, and "learn" the knowledge contained within. This helps them appreciate the importance and necessity of environmental protection and sustainable development. Specifically, the goals of environmental science practice include: becoming familiar with the basic qualities of the resource and environmental science field, enhancing practical skills, hands-on abilities, problem-solving, and analytical abilities to obtain effective conclusions; cultivating good practical and collaborative abilities to lay a solid foundation for actual work, enabling students to assume roles as individuals, team members, and leaders in multidisciplinary teams.

default.zh: 水质工程原理与系统模拟综合设计， 1．根据所给的原始资料，计算出进厂的设计流量和水质；2．根据水质情况，地形和上述计算结果，确定给水处理方法以及有关的处理构筑物，确定污水处理方法和污水、污泥处理的流量以及有关的处理构筑物；3．对各处理构筑物进行工艺计算，确定其形式、数目与尺寸；4．进行各处理构筑物的总体布置和给水处理流程的高程设计、污水与污泥处理流程的高程设计。
default.en: Integrated design of water quality engineering principles and system simulation, 1. According to the original data given, calculate the design flow and water quality into the plant; 2. According to the water quality, the topography and the above calculation results, the method of water supply treatment and the related treatment structures are determined, and the method of sewage treatment and the flow rate of sewage and sludge treatment and the related treatment structures are determined. 3. Process calculation is carried out for each treatment structure to determine its form, number and size. 4. The overall layout of the treatment structures and the elevation design of the water treatment process, sewage and sludge treatment process elevation design.

default.zh: 毕业论文是环境科学本科教学的重要环节，目的是使学生充分利用所学专业知识，熟悉本专业的研究方向和工作内容，指导学生通过查阅专业资料，了解环境科学领域最新研究进展，确定研究方案，进行实验和数据处理，获得研究结果，通过分析和归纳获得科学结论，撰写本科生毕业论文。通过环境科学基本理论和基本技能学习，使学生能识别、表达、并通过文献研究分析复杂环境问题，具有初步的科学研究和科技开发能力，具备解决复杂环境问题的能力，培养学生的创新性思维和综合素质能力。
default.en: Graduation thesis is an important part of undergraduate teaching in environmental science. Its purpose is to enable students to fully utilize their professional knowledge, familiarize themselves with the research direction and work content of their major, guide them to understand the latest research progress in the field of environmental science, determine research plans, conduct experiments and data processing, obtain research results, analyze and summarize scientific conclusions, and write undergraduate graduation thesis. Through the study of basic theories and skills in environmental science, students can identify, express, and analyze complex environmental problems through literature research. They have preliminary scientific research and technological development abilities, the ability to solve complex environmental problems, and the ability to cultivate innovative thinking and comprehensive qualities.

default.zh: 毕业设计是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，主要培养学生综合运用所学的知识（基础课、技术基础课、专业方向课等方面的知识）分析和解决生态环境领域的工程技术问题的能力；使学生受到工程师的基础训练，培养其开展工程设计和科学研究工作的初步能力。主要内容包括：1、在下达毕业设计（论文）任务书时，必须明确每个学生的工作任务。题目每人一题。其工作量要适度，在有效的毕业设计期间，经过努力可以完成。2、尽管不同题目的毕业设计（论文）内容各不相同，但一般都应包括：中英文摘要、文献综述、任务的提出：本设计（论文）采用的方案（方案技术经济比较、论证），设计与计算或理论分析与计算；实验、方针；技术经济分析；设计概算、运营成本；结束语等。设计类题目要交出相应的设计图纸（不少于12张1#图纸），实验研究类的题目有相应的实验装置系统图（不少于4张2#图纸）。3、毕业设计的工作量及图纸的要求详见《哈尔滨工业大学本科生毕业设计（论文）的规定和撰写规范》的2—6页。设计计算说明书一般不应少于90页（含计算图、表）。通过毕业设计的训练，使学生初步具有进行工程设计的能力。
default.en: The graduation design is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan, which mainly cultivates the students' ability to analyze and solve the engineering and technical problems in the field of ecological environment by comprehensively applying the knowledge they have learned (basic courses, basic technical courses, specialized courses, etc.). Students receive basic training as engineers, and cultivate their initial ability to carry out engineering design and scientific research. The main contents include: 1, when issuing the graduation project (thesis) assignment, each student's work task must be clearly defined. One question for each person. Its workload should be moderate, and it can be completed through efforts during the effective graduation design period. 2, although different topics of the graduation project (thesis) content is different, but generally should include: Chinese and English abstract, literature review, task proposal: the design (thesis) adopted scheme (scheme technical and economic comparison, demonstration), design and calculation or theoretical analysis and calculation; Experiments, policies; Technical and economic analysis; Design estimates, operating costs; Closing remarks, etc. The corresponding design drawings (not less than 12 1# drawings) should be submitted for design questions, and the corresponding experimental device system drawings (not less than 4 2# drawings) should be provided for experimental research questions. 3. Please refer to pages 2 to 6 of "Regulations and Writing Standards for Undergraduate Graduation Design (Thesis) of Harbin Institute of Technology" for the workload and drawing requirements of the graduation project. The design calculation specification should not be less than 90 pages (including calculation drawings and tables). Through the training of graduation design, students have the ability of engineering design.

default.zh: 本课程基于文献查阅和设计手册/标准的认真阅读，通过对工程设计说明书要求的深入理解和工程设计目标的清晰认识。通过对本课程的学习，能够准确理解设计任务书对工程设计的影响，全面了解待设计城市的城市概况、城市的地形与城市规划资料、气象资料、地质资料、受纳水体水质与水文资料等对设计的影响，能够基于上述基本条件进行工程设计，做到工程建设的科学合理、因地制宜；能够合理的选择工艺和工艺参数；通过对不同工艺及方案的综合论证，做到工艺设计计算科学合理、设计参数选择准确得当、工程建设经济节约、运行效能经济高效；能够独立完成工程所含各构筑物的设计、计算、绘图，并能够将上述构筑物在工程区域内进行科学合理布设，并准确计算各构筑物间的水头、压力损失，做到各构筑物高效配置，并高效发挥各自的功能；能够基于工程中涉及的构筑物参数计算和工程设计，进行设计说明书的编写，锻炼文、表、图、公式的录入与编辑能力，通过设计说明书写作规范的严格要求，全面提升学生的写作能力；通过开题、中期、结题以及毕业设计过程中学生和答辩组教师的沟通，全面提升学生的语言表达、清晰回答问题的能力，做到思维逻辑清晰，汇报准确。
default.en: This course cultivates the students based on a thorough reading of the literature and design manual/standards, to thoroughly understand the requirements of the engineering design specification and the objectives of the engineering designing. By the course studying, to accurately understand the design plan descriptions, as well as the influence of the urban city situation, meteorological condition, geological data, receiving water quality and hydrology information on the whole designing. Based on the above basic conditions, to ensure the scientific and reasonable designing of the engineering construction, reasonable selection of operational parameters. Through the comprehensive demonstration of different technologies and schemes, we can achieve the scientific and rational calculation of technological design, accurate selection of design parameters to ensure economical efficiency of construction, and to an efficiency of operation. Individuals could be complete the project, contains the structure design, calculation, drawing, and to the above structures in engineering area for scientific and reasonable layout. Moreover, accurately calculate the pressure loss, to achieve the structures efficiency, and effective play to their respective functions. Based on the parameter calculations, the exercise of formula calculation, table, figure, inputting, to achieve an editing ability. Via the strict requirements of design specification writing specification, improve students' writing ability; Through the opening, middle, concluding and graduation design of defense group of teachers and students in the process of communication, improve students' ability of language expression, clear answer this question and logic presentation.

default.zh: 给排水专业毕业设计（Capstone Design）是指高等学校学生毕业前夕总结性的独立作业，是实践性教学最后一个环节，旨在检验学生综合运用所学理论、知识和技能解决实际问题的能力，包括给水厂设计、污水厂设计、建筑给排水设计。在指导老师提供设计任务书（包括水质信息、地理位置信息、设计要求等），在教师指导下，学生就给定设计任务书及要求，进行方案选择、参数设置和工艺设计和研究，包括设计、计算、绘图、工艺技术、概预算等，最后提交一份设计说明书。应尽量选与生产、科学研究任务结合的现实题目。
default.en: Capstone Design refers to the summative independent homework of college students before graduation. It is the last link of practical teaching and aims to test students' ability to comprehensively apply the theories, knowledge and skills they have learned to solve practical problems, including water supply plant design, sewage plant design and building water supply and drainage design. The instructor will provide the design specification (including water quality information, geographical location information, design requirements, etc.). Under the guidance of the instructor, the students will select the scheme, set the parameters, design and research on the given design specification and requirements, including design, calculation, drawing, process technology, budget estimate, etc., and finally submit a design specification. We should try our best to choose realistic topics that combine with the tasks of production and scientific research.

default.zh: 毕业设计是城市水系统专业本科生教学阶段必不可少的一个环节，它具有周期长、环节多、任务重等特点。毕业设计主要是考查学生的文献/规范/手册查找能力、专业知识的综合应用能力、方案选择及工艺设计能力、独立思考问题的能力、解决复杂工程问题的能力、理论知识与实际工程项目结合的能力等，是对城市水系统专业学生大学四年学习成果的全面考查，毕业设计的实践性和综合性是其他环节所不能替代的。主要包括水源保护、输配水、城市水用水及排水、城市水规划等设计内容。
default.en: The graduation project is an indispensable link in the teaching stage of urban water system major. It has the characteristics of long cycle, multiple links and heavy tasks. The graduation design mainly tests the students' ability to find documents/norms/manuals, the comprehensive application ability of professional knowledge, the ability to choose solutions and process design, the ability to think independently, the ability to solve complex engineering problems, the ability to combine theoretical knowledge with practical engineering projects, etc. It is a comprehensive examination of the four years' learning achievements of urban water system major students. The practicality and comprehensiveness of graduation project can not be replaced by other links. It mainly includes water source protection, water distribution, urban water use and drainage, urban water planning and other design contents.

default.zh: 毕业实习是本科教学计划中重要的教学环节之一，是用实践教学的模式引领学生学习工程知识和巩固所学的理论。本课程发挥环境学科工程特色，培养学生认识并解决工程实际问题的思路和方法，将理论学习与工程实践相结合，通过现场实地驻厂学习达成以下目标。1. 使学生了解环境工程专业相关的职业和行业的生产、设计等，深刻感悟环境事业在人类自然社会中扮演的角色，明确相关工作的具体社会责任；2.使学生了解环境工程专业相关工作中各环节的具体任务与相互配合，加深团队合作意识，加快从学生到职业人的角色转变；3.使学生具备良好的交流沟通能力，用心听讲、勤学多问、认真思考，把所学理论与实践相结合，具备良好的科技报告撰写能力和文本展示技巧。4.使学生了解行业发展动态，自觉弥补知识和能力的缺陷，在以后的学习和工作中不断完善自我知识和技能。
default.en: Graduation Practice is one of the important teaching section in the undergraduate teaching plans, which guides students to learn engineering knowledge and consolidate their theoretical knowledge through practical teaching mode. This course leverages the engineering characteristics of the environmental discipline to cultivate students' understanding and methods of solving practical engineering problems. It combines theoretical learning with engineering practice and achieves the following goals through on-site on-site on-site learning. 1. Enable students to understand the production, design, and other related professions and industries in the field of environmental engineering, deeply understand the role that environmental undertakings play in human natural society, and clarify the specific social responsibilities of related work; 2. Enable students to understand the specific tasks and mutual cooperation in various aspects of environmental engineering related work, deepen their awareness of teamwork, and accelerate the role transition from students to professionals; 3. Enable students to have good communication and communication skills, listen attentively, study diligently, ask questions, and think seriously. Combine the theory they have learned with practice, and possess good skills in writing scientific reports and displaying texts. 4. Enable students to understand the development trends of the industry, consciously make up for deficiencies in knowledge and abilities, and continuously improve their own knowledge and skills in future learning and work.

default.zh: 毕业实习是环境科学专业在完成教学大纲规定的所有专业课之后开展的重要的实践性教学环节。通过毕业实习，使学生了解有关环境科学与工程相关的理论、技术、工艺及管理概况，获得有关环境科学的实际感性认识，将理论联系实际，巩固和加深所学基本理论知识。目的是培养学生运用所学知识观察、分析、解决实际问题的能力和团队精神，培养学生勤劳、创新、进取的优秀品质和为环保事业奋斗的精神，提高学生的实践工作能力，为将来从事环境科学相关研究和工作奠定良好的基础。
default.en: Graduation internship is an important practical teaching process for environmental science majors after completing all the professional courses specified in the teaching syllabus. Through graduation internship, enable students to understand the theories, technologies, processes, and management overview related to environmental science and engineering, to gain practical and intuitive understanding of environmental science, connect theory with practice, and consolidate and deepen the basic theoretical knowledge learned. The purpose is to cultivate students' ability to observe, analyze, and solve practical problems using the knowledge they have learned, as well as their teamwork spirit. This will cultivate their excellent qualities of diligence, innovation, and progress, as well as their spirit of striving for environmental protection. It will also improve their practical work abilities and lay a solid foundation for future research and work in environmental science.

default.zh: 毕业实习是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生更加深入地了解和掌握专业知识，巩固和丰富已学过的专业课程的内容，了解工程设计程序及各设计阶段的设计深度及要求，提高学生综合运用专业知识解决工程实际问题的能力。毕业实习采取集中到外地的方式，到一个城市中生态湿地公园、污水厂和典型生态工程施工现场实习。主要包括：1．收集毕业设计所需的原始资料；2．熟悉国家有关的设计规范、政策法规；3．在实习中去寻找毕业设计中遇到问题的解决措施；4．掌握生态水处理构筑物的工作原理和主要工艺。掌握各细部的设计方法，熟悉各个部分的作用；5．参考工程设计的图纸，熟悉工程图纸的表达方式。通过实习，使同学们对所学专业知识在实际工程中的应用有更加深刻的认识，做到学以致用。
default.en: Graduation practice is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan. Its purpose is to enable students to have a deeper understanding and grasp of professional knowledge, consolidate and enrich the content of the professional courses they have learned, understand the engineering design procedures and the design depth and requirements of each design stage, and improve the ability of students to comprehensively apply professional knowledge to solve practical engineering problems. The graduation practice takes the way of focusing on the field, and goes to the ecological wetland park, sewage plant and typical ecological engineering construction site in a city. It mainly includes: 1. Collect the original materials needed for graduation design; 2. Familiar with relevant national design codes, policies and regulations; 3. In the internship to find solutions to problems encountered in graduation design; 4. Master the working principle and main process of ecological water treatment structures. Master the design method of each detail, familiar with the role of each part; 5. Be familiar with the expression of engineering drawings by referring to engineering design drawings. Through the practice, students have a deeper understanding of the application of professional knowledge in practical projects, so that they can apply what they have learned.

default.zh: 毕业实习是城市水系统工程专业教学计划中重要的实践性教学环节之一，通过此环节使学生更加加深和巩固所学的理论知识，通过现场的观察、资料收集、向经验丰富的专家和技术人员请教学习，掌握更多的实际工程知识提高学生解决问题及分析问题的能力，巩固和加深对所学知识的掌握，增强综合运用专业知识解决工程实际问题的能力;收集到更多的与毕业设计题目有关的资料，为顺利完成毕业设计作好充分准备。
default.en: Graduation practice is one of the important practical teaching links in the teaching plan of water supply and drainage science and engineering major. Through this link, students can deepen and consolidate the theoretical knowledge they have learned. Through on-site observation, data collection, consulting and learning from experienced experts and technicians, students can master more practical engineering knowledge and improve their ability to solve and analyze problems. Consolidate and deepen the mastery of the learned knowledge, and enhance the ability to comprehensively apply professional knowledge to solve practical engineering problems; Collect more information related to the graduation project, and make full preparation for the successful completion of the graduation project.

default.zh: 毕业实习是给排水科学与工程专业教学计划中重要的实践性教学环节之一，通过此环节使学生更加加深和巩固所学的理论知识，通过现场的观察、资料收集、向经验丰富的专家和技术人员请教学习，掌握更多的实际工程知识提高学生解决问题及分析问题的能力，巩固和加深对所学知识的掌握，增强综合运用专业知识解决工程实际问题的能力;收集到更多的与毕业设计题目有关的资料，为顺利完成毕业设计作好充分准备。
default.en: Graduation practice is one of the important practical teaching links in the teaching plan of urban water system major. Through this link, students can deepen and consolidate the theoretical knowledge they have learned. Through on-site observation, data collection, consulting and learning from experienced experts and technicians, students can master more practical engineering knowledge and improve their ability to solve and analyze problems. Consolidate and deepen the mastery of the learned knowledge, and enhance the ability to comprehensively apply professional knowledge to solve practical engineering problems; Collect more information related to the graduation project, and make full preparation for the successful completion of the graduation project.

default.zh: 生产实习是本科教学计划中重要的实践性教学环节，使学生了解和掌握基本生产知识，印证、巩固和丰富已学过的专业课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实际中观察问题、调查研究、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为后续专业课程的学习打下基础，通过生产实习达成如下目标。1.通过现场实习及工艺流程参观，掌握环境工程污染防治的代表性处理工程工艺及应用特征，能够正确认识复杂工程问题解决的综合解决方案，理解相关社会、健康、安全、法律以及文化因素对工程设计、建设运行的影响；2. 使学生具备提出问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，能够在实习实践中体现团队协作，发挥个人作为个体、团队成员以及负责人的角色功能，并推动团队能力建设；3.在实习实践参观、答辩等过程中提高学生就复杂环境工程问题与同行/教师交流的能力，能够高质量撰写报告和设计文稿，进行有组织的陈述发言；并具备开阔的国际视野，能够在跨文化背景下进行理想的工程实习实训沟通和交流；4.在实习实训中实现创新创业精神的培养，能够通过实习实训培养对工程技术和社会发展的观察、总结能力。
default.en: Production Practice is an important practical teaching section in the undergraduate teaching plans, which enables students to understand and master basic production knowledge, confirm, consolidate, and enrich the professional course content they have learned, cultivate students to connect theory with practice, improve their ability and methods to observe, investigate, analyze, and solve problems in production practice, and lay a foundation for subsequent professional course learning. Through production internship, the following goals are achieved. 1. Through on-site internships and process visits, grasp representative treatment engineering processes and application characteristics of environmental engineering pollution prevention and control, be able to correctly understand comprehensive solutions to complex engineering problems, and understand the impact of relevant social, health, safety, legal, and cultural factors on engineering design, construction and operation; 2. Enable students to have the ability to raise, analyze, and solve problems, demonstrate teamwork in internship practice, play the role of individuals, team members, and leaders, and promote team capacity building; 3. Improve students' ability to communicate with peers/teachers on complex environmental engineering issues during internship visits, defense, etc., and be able to write high-quality reports and design drafts, as well as make organized presentations and speeches; And possess a broad international perspective, able to engage in ideal engineering internships, practical training, communication, and exchange in cross-cultural contexts; 4. To cultivate the spirit of innovation and entrepreneurship through internship and training, and to cultivate the ability to observe and summarize engineering technology and social development through internship and training.

default.zh: 生产实习是环境科学专业在完成教学大纲规定的部分专业课之后开展的重要的实践性教学环节。通过毕业实习，使学生掌握环境科学理论知识在实际的环境领域相关工作中的应用，熟悉生产环境中常见的环境污染问题，学会监测、评估和解决环境问题的方法，了解环境科学实验技术和仪器设备的操作和运行，培养学生运用所学知识分析、解决实际问题的能力和团队精神，培养学生勤劳、创新、进取的优秀品质，提高学生的实践工作能力。
