default.en: Production internship is an important practical teaching process for environmental science majors after completing some of the professional courses specified in the teaching syllabus. The purpose is to enable students to master the application of environmental science theoretical knowledge in practical environmental related work through graduation internships, to familiarize themselves with common environmental pollution problems in production environments, to learn methods for monitoring, evaluating, and solving environmental problems, and understand the operation and operation of environmental science experimental technology and equipment. Cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve practical problems using the knowledge they have learned, as well as their teamwork spirit, cultivate their excellent qualities of diligence, innovation, and progress, and improve their practical work abilities.

default.zh: 生产实习是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生了解和掌握基本的生产知识，巩固和丰富已学过的专业课程的内容，培养学生理论联系实际的能力，提高其在生产中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为后续的专业课程学习打下良好的基础。实习内容主要包括：1、参观人工湿地，了解人工湿地进行水质净化的基本原理和主要工艺。2、进行农村生态环境的调研，为农村的饮用水、污水处理、垃圾处理等提出建设意见。3、对生态农村生态文明建设情况进行调研。通过实习，使同学们将自己所学的环境生态工程专业知识应用到国家的生态文明建设中。
default.en: Production practice is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan. Its purpose is to enable students to understand and master basic production knowledge, consolidate and enrich the content of the professional courses they have learned, cultivate students' ability to combine theory with practice, and improve their ability and method of investigating, observing, analyzing and solving problems in production. Lay a good foundation for the subsequent professional course study. The internship mainly includes: 1. Visit constructed wetlands and understand the basic principles and main processes of water purification in constructed wetlands. 2, Conduct research on the rural ecological environment, and put forward suggestions for the construction of rural drinking water, sewage treatment, garbage treatment, etc. 3. Investigate the construction of ecological civilization in ecological countryside. Through the internship, students will apply their professional knowledge of environmental and ecological engineering to the construction of national ecological civilization.

default.zh: 城市水系统专业生产实习在基础课、专业基础课和部分专业课教学内容完成后进行，是一个理论联系实际的十分重要的实践教学环节。其目的是让学生深入到实践中去，在实践中学习生产实际知识通过生产实习，达到验证、巩固、深化和完善课堂所学理论知识，培养综合运用基础理论的能力，并初步认识实际生产过程，为后续课程学习打下良好的基础;此外，通过调研工作、实际生产环节的训练，磨砺学生的吃苦耐劳的意志，有利于学生综合素质的培养和提高。
default.en: The engineering practice of water supply and drainage science and engineering specialty is carried out after the completion of the teaching content of basic courses, specialized basic courses and some specialized courses, which is a very important practical teaching link combining theory with practice. Its purpose is to let students go deep into practice and learn practical engineering knowledge in practice. Through engineering practice, they can verify, consolidate, deepen and improve the theoretical knowledge learned in class, cultivate the ability to comprehensively use basic theories, and preliminarily understand the actual engineering process, laying a good foundation for the follow-up course learning. In addition, through the research work, the training of actual engineering links, sharpen the students' will to bear hardships and stand hard work, which is conducive to the cultivation and improvement of students' comprehensive quality.

default.zh: 给排水科学与工程专业生产实习在基础课、专业基础课和部分专业课教学内容完成后进行，是一个理论联系实际的十分重要的实践教学环节。其目的是让学生深入到实践中去，在实践中学习生产实际知识通过生产实习，达到验证、巩固、深化和完善课堂所学理论知识，培养综合运用基础理论的能力，并初步认识实际生产过程，为后续课程学习打下良好的基础;此外，通过调研工作、实际生产环节的训练，磨砺学生的吃苦耐劳的意志，有利于学生综合素质的培养和提高。
default.en: The engineering practice of urban water system major is carried out after the completion of the teaching content of basic courses, specialized basic courses and some specialized courses, which is a very important practical teaching link combining theory with practice. Its purpose is to let students go deep into practice and learn practical engineering knowledge in practice. Through engineering practice, they can verify, consolidate, deepen and improve the theoretical knowledge learned in class, cultivate the ability to comprehensively use basic theories, and preliminarily understand the actual engineering process, laying a good foundation for the follow-up course learning. In addition, through the research work, the training of actual engineering links, sharpen the students' will to bear hardships and stand hard work, which is conducive to the cultivation and improvement of students' comprehensive quality.

default.zh: 课程以全球能源转型和国家建设新型能源系统为大背景、针对未来能源领域前沿性、交叉性、不确定性，重点探讨绿色氢能、核聚变能、新型储能、新能源电力系统、绿电算力协同等未来能源核心领域的基本概念、主要原理与当前产业发展阶段。使学生理解未来能源系统跨领域、多技术融合的核心逻辑，能够分辨不同技术路线的技术优势、适用场景与亟待突破的关键问题。课程鼓励学生合理运用AI工具整合跨领域信息，形成对复杂技术路线或整体解决方案的系统认知。帮助学生树立面向未来的创新探索意识；养成问题导向的学习与研究习惯，激发对前沿问题的好奇心；培养跨学科进行整合思考的能力；深刻认识到能源转型对我国生态文明建设、全球可持续发展的重要意义。
default.en: The course is set against the backdrop of global energy transition and the construction of new energy systems nationwide, addressing the cutting-edge, intersectional, and uncertain aspects of future energy. It focuses on exploring the basic concepts, main principles, and current stages of industrial development in core areas of future energy, such as green hydrogen energy, nuclear fusion energy, new energy storage, new energy power systems, and green power computing power collaboration. Students will understand the core logic of cross-disciplinary and multi-technology integration in future energy systems, enabling them to distinguish the technical advantages, applicable scenarios, and key issues urgently needed for breakthroughs in different technological routes. The course encourages students to skillfully use AI tools to integrate cross-disciplinary information and develop a systematic understanding of complex technical routes or overall solutions. Help students develop a forward-looking awareness of innovation and exploration; Develop problem-oriented learning and research habits to stimulate curiosity about cutting-edge issues; Cultivate the ability to think integrally across disciplines; Deeply recognize the important significance of energy transition for China's ecological civilization construction and global sustainable development.

default.zh: 《核科学与技术导论》是“核工程与核技术”强基计划的概论性课程，让学生对核科学技术的基本原理和应用有一个全面了解和较深入的认识，使低年级学生在较短的学时内综合了解核工程与技术的主要知识、基本原理和应用，对学科和专业建立全面、准确、概括的认识。在内容选取上力求反映现代核科学与技术的发展趋势，注意与工程实际相结合。主要包括核裂变、核聚变、核燃料、核电站、核动力、核武器，核技术应用部分主要包括加速器、核探测与核测量、放射医学与核医学、核地学、辐射成像、辐射加工、工业及农业应用等知识。培养能够综合应用所学知识，发现和分析解决核科学与技术概论实际问题的能力。
default.en: Introduction to Nuclear Science and Technology is an introductory course of the Strong Foundation Program for Nuclear Engineering and Technology. It provides students with a comprehensive and in-depth understanding of the basic principles and applications of nuclear science and technology, enabling lower grade students to comprehensively understand the main knowledge, basic principles, and applications of nuclear engineering and technology in a short period of time, and establish a comprehensive, accurate, and summarized understanding of the discipline and major. Strive to reflect the development trends of modern nuclear science and technology in content selection, and pay attention to combining it with engineering practice. Mainly including nuclear fission, nuclear fusion, nuclear fuel, nuclear power plants, nuclear power, nuclear weapons. The application of nuclear technology mainly includes knowledge of accelerators, nuclear detection and measurement, radiation medicine and nuclear medicine, nuclear geology, radiation imaging, radiation processing, industrial and agricultural applications, etc. Cultivate the ability to comprehensively apply learned knowledge, discover and analyze practical problems in nuclear science and technology introduction.

default.zh: 飞行器动力领域正在经历从旧航空航天向新航空航天转变的过程，新技术层出不穷，企业盛衰加快，内在逻辑难寻。成本视角是理解技术优胜劣汰、产业兴衰的核心视角之一，但也偏偏是理工科教学的盲区。能源学院立足长远，决定开设这门课程，培养学生控制成本的基本意识，和审视技术优劣、选择发展路径的基本视角。 本门课程首先介绍成本管理的概念，它在欧美和前苏联体系中的不同形式，以及新时代我国航空航天产业的成本管理。之后本门课程会用四节课的时间，介绍成本的不同分类，和各自的主要计算方法，包括固定成本与变动成本的平衡，采购与生产成本的平衡，资本成本的计算等。再之后，综合上述不同成本构成，讲解本量利分析中保本点和保利点的计算方法。另一方面，将花一节课的时间，讲解成本控制中的目标成本与标准成本概念，结合实例展示成本控制的重要性。最后，将花一节课的时间，结合飞动某一细分领域，展示全面预算的编制过程，成本构成分析和成本控制的主要方向。 本门课程的主要考核方式为大作业，结合学生自选飞动新技术，从成本分析角度分析技术前景。
default.en: Aircraft propulsion is undergoing a transformation from old aerospace to new aerospace, with new technologies emerging endlessly, accelerating the rise and fall of enterprises, and the inherent logic is difficult to find. The cost perspective is one of the core perspectives for understanding the survival of the fittest in technology and the rise and fall of industries, but it is also a blind spot in science and engineering teaching. Based on the long-term perspective, the Energy College has decided to offer this course to cultivate students' basic awareness of cost control, as well as a basic perspective of examining the advantages and disadvantages of technology and choosing development paths. This course first introduces the concept of cost management, its different forms in the systems of Europe, America, and the former Soviet Union, as well as the cost management of China's aerospace industry in the new era. Afterwards, this course will take four lectures to introduce the different classifications of costs and their main calculation methods, including the balance between fixed and variable costs, the balance between procurement and production costs, and the calculation of capital costs. Afterwards, taking into account the different cost components mentioned above, we will explain the calculation methods of breakeven points and breakeven points in cost volume profit analysis. On the other hand, we will spend one lecture explaining the concepts of target cost and standard cost in cost control, and demonstrate the importance of cost control through examples. Finally, we will spend one lecture, combined with propulsion sub field, to demonstrate the process of comprehensive budget preparation, cost composition analysis, and the main direction of cost control. The main assessment method for this course is a final essay, combined with students' self selected new technologies, and analyzing the technological prospects from a cost analysis perspective.

default.zh: 本课程为能源动力类专业的一门重要技术基础课，面向能源科学与工程、飞行器动力工程专业、核工程与核技术专业的本科生，讲授流体力学的基本概念和基本理论，以及流体平衡和运动的基本规律，使学生了解流体的基本概念和性质，掌握流体静力学、流体运动学、流体动力学、流动阻力与损失等方面的基础知识和基本理论，并通过一定数量的实验和习题，使学生对流体力学具有足够的感性认识和实际动手的能力，基本掌握运用流体力学知识解决工程实际计算和问题分析的能力。本课程的教学注重培养学生的兴趣，着重培养学生对工程流体力学基础理论知识的掌握，不仅为学生学习后续的专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且也为学生将来继续深造打下坚实的基础。本课程主要培养学生具有以下几方面的能力： （1）正确理解流体的性质及流动现象，运用数学知识对流体力学的重要理论公式进行推导和应用，掌握流体力学问题的计算方法； （2）能够运用流体力学的理论和方法对能源动力领域的流动问题进行分析和计算，锻炼学生能够从复杂的自然现象和工程应用中提炼问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力； （3）能够运用流体力学的理论和方法，结合专业知识进行科学实验，并能对实验过程和结果进行正确分析，得出合理有效的结论。
default.en: This course is an important technical foundation course for energy and power majors. It is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in energy science and engineering, aircraft power engineering, nuclear engineering and nuclear technology. It teaches the basic concepts and theories of fluid mechanics, as well as the basic laws of fluid balance and motion, enabling students to understand the basic concepts and properties of fluids, master fluid statics, fluid kinematics, and fluid dynamics Basic knowledge and theories related to flow resistance and loss, and through a certain number of experiments and exercises, enable students to have sufficient perceptual understanding and practical skills in fluid mechanics, and have a basic grasp of the ability to apply fluid mechanics knowledge to solve engineering practical calculations and problem analysis. The teaching of this course focuses on cultivating students' interest and mastering the basic theoretical knowledge of engineering fluid mechanics. It not only provides students with necessary basic theoretical knowledge for subsequent professional courses, but also lays a solid foundation for their future further studies. This course mainly cultivates students' abilities in the following aspects: (1) Correctly understand the properties and flow phenomena of fluids, use mathematical knowledge to derive and apply important theoretical formulas in fluid mechanics, and master the calculation methods of fluid mechanics problems; (2) Be able to apply the theories and methods of fluid mechanics to analyze and calculate flow problems in the field of energy and power, and exercise students' ability to extract, analyze, and solve problems from complex natural phenomena and engineering applications; (3) Able to apply the theories and methods of fluid mechanics, combine professional knowledge to conduct scientific experiments, and correctly analyze the experimental process and results to draw reasonable and effective conclusions.

default.zh: 航空是指载人或不载人的飞行器在地球大气层中的航行活动，航天是指载人或不载人的航天器在地球大气层之外的航行活动，又称空间飞行或宇宙航行。人类为了扩大社会生产，必然要开拓新的活动空间。从陆地到海洋，从海洋到大气层，再到宇宙空间，就是这样一个人类逐渐扩展活动范围的过程。航空航天是人类拓展大气层和宇宙空间的产物。经过百余年的快速发展，航空航天已经成为21世纪最活跃和最有影响的科学技术领域之一，该领域取得的重大成就标志着人类文明的最新发展，也表征着一个国家科学技术的先进水平。本课程以飞行器(航空器和航天器)为中心，阐述了航空航天领域涉及的基本概念、基本原理和基础知识，梳理了航空航天发展过程中的技术特点、发展规律及最新动态，系统地、完整地再现了航空航天技术的发展历程及技术成果，为航空航天专业领域本科生的初级入门课程，为未来进一步学习相关理论知识、认识和了解航空航天专业打好基础。
default.en: Aviation refers to the navigation activities of manned or unmanned vehicles in the Earth's atmosphere, and spaceflight refers to the navigation activities of manned or unmanned spacecraft outside the Earth's atmosphere, also known as space flight or cosmic voyage. In order to expand social production, mankind is bound to open up new space for activities. From the land to the sea, from the sea to the atmosphere, and then to the cosmic space, is such a process of human gradually expanding the scope of activities. Aerospace is the product of human expansion of the atmosphere and cosmic space. After more than a hundred years of rapid development, aerospace has become one of the most active and influential fields of science and technology in the 21st century, and the major achievements in this field mark the latest development of human civilization and characterize the advanced level of science and technology of a country. This course takes aircraft (aircraft and spacecraft) as the center, elaborates the basic concepts, basic principles and fundamental knowledge involved in the field of aerospace, sorts out the technical characteristics, development laws and latest developments in the process of aerospace development, systematically and completely reproduces the development history and technical achievements of aerospace technology, and is an introductory course for undergraduates in the field of aerospace, for further study in the future. It is an introductory course for undergraduates in the field of aerospace and provides a good foundation for further study of relevant theoretical knowledge, understanding and appreciation of aerospace profession.

default.zh: 工程热力学是研究热能有效利用以及热能和机械能等其它能量转换规律及其应用的工程技术科学。课程的主要目标是使学生掌握热力学的基本规律，并能正确运用这些规律对热工过程和热力循环进行分析和计算。该课程的主要内容包括：热力学的基本概念，热力学第一定律和第二定律，气体的热力性质和热力过程，气体的流动与压缩，气体动力循环，水蒸气的性质和蒸汽动力循环，制冷循环。
default.en: Engineering thermodynamics is an engineering technical science that studies the effective utilization of thermal energy and the conversion laws between thermal energy and other energies including mechanical energy etc. The main goal of the course is to enable students to master the basic laws of thermodynamics and to correctly use these laws to analyze and calculate thermal processes and thermodynamic cycles. The main contents of this course include: basic concepts of thermodynamics, the first and second laws of thermodynamics, thermodynamic properties and thermodynamic processes of gases, flow and compression of gases, gas power cycle, properties of water vapor and steam power cycle, refrigeration cycle.

default.zh: 热力学基础是热工技术理论的基础，是研究热能的传递、热能有效利用以及热能和机械能等其它能量转换规律及其应用的工程技术学科。课程的主要目标是使学生掌握工程热力学的基本概念与方程，并能正确运用这些方程对热工过程进行分析和计算。本课程不仅为学生学习有关专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且为学生毕业后从事热能利用、热设计、热管理和热控制等方面的专业技术工作和科学研究工作打下必要的理论基础。在教学过程中结合本课程特点，注意培养学生辨证思维和逻辑推理的能力；训练其建立热力学和传热学模型的能力；着重培养学生对热工问题的判断、计算和综合能力分析能力；着重培养学生的创新精神和实践能力。
default.en: Thermodynamics is the foundation of thermal technology theory, which is an engineering and technical discipline that studies the transfer and effective utilization of thermal energy, as well as other energy conversion laws and their applications such as thermal and mechanical energy. The main objective of the course is to enable students to master the basic concepts and equations of engineering thermodynamics, and to be able to correctly apply these equations to analyze and calculate thermal processes. This course not only provides students with necessary basic theoretical knowledge for studying relevant professional courses, but also lays a necessary theoretical foundation for students to engage in professional technical work and scientific research in areas such as thermal energy utilization, thermal design, thermal management, and thermal control after graduation. In the teaching process, combining the characteristics of this course, pay attention to cultivating students' dialectical thinking and logical reasoning abilities; Train their ability to establish thermodynamic and heat transfer models; Emphasize the cultivation of students' ability to judge, calculate, and analyze thermal engineering problems comprehensively; Emphasis is placed on cultivating students' innovative spirit and practical abilities.

default.zh: 传热学是研究温差驱动下热量传递规律的一门科学，主要内容包括：导热基本定律，稳态导热，非稳态导热，导热问题数值解法，单相对流换热理论，对流换热的实验关联式，沸腾与凝结换热，热辐射基本定律，物体辐射特性，表面辐射换热，火焰辐射换热，传热过程及换热器，传质学等。通过本门课程的学习，使学生对热量传递这一普遍存在的现象有深入理性的认识，掌握传热学的基本理论、基本定律及基本计算，并初步具有解决实际传热问题的能力。传热学是热能动力、机械制造、航空航天、材料加工、电子电气、建筑工程等相关专业的一门技术基础课
default.en: Heat transfer is about the movement of thermal energy from high temperature place to low temperature place . The course includes: the basic laws of heat conduction and steady state heat conduction, unsteady state heat conduction, and numerical heat conduction, convection heat transfer, the condensation and boiling heat transfer, the basic laws of thermal radiation, radiative properties of materials, the surface radiative heat exchange, fire radiative heat exchange, heat transfer process and heat exchanger, mass transfer. Heat Transfer is a fundamental course for the undergraduates who are majoring in thermal energy power, machine manufacturing, aeronautics and space, material processing, electronics or electrical engineering.

default.zh: 数字电路与嵌入式系统是一门交叉性学科很强的课程，它涵盖了电子科学与技术、计算机工程、软件工程等多个领域，是集成电路设计与集成系统专业的学科基础选修课程。本课从嵌入式系统应用的角度，全面介绍了数字电路基本概念和嵌入式系统开发技术，重点阐述了核心内容和关键环节的知识点。通过这门课程，使学生了解嵌入式系统的应用，不仅扩大了学生的视野，还能对今后从事核工业领域的嵌入式系统设计与开发有一定的促进作用。在教学过程中结合本课程特点，注意培养学生辨证思维和逻辑推理的能力；训练其建立嵌入式系统及数字电路相关问题的判断、计算和综合能力分析能力；着重培养学生的创新精神和实践能力。 本课程的主要目标为：（1）了解微型计算机及嵌入式系统的基本硬件组成、工作原理和体系结构；（2）掌握嵌入式系统接口、端口的概念；掌握嵌入式系统堆栈、中断、IO及各种外设的基本概念和机制；掌握嵌入式系统的C语言编程；能够综合运用嵌入式系统的理论知识进行嵌入式程序开发；（3）激发学生动手实践的兴趣，培养学生分析和解决实际问题的能力，全面提高学生的职业素养。
default.en: Digital Circuitry and Embedded Systems is a course with strong interdisciplinary attributes, encompassing various fields such as electronic science and technology, computer engineering, software engineering, and more. It is a foundational elective course for students specializing in integrated circuit design and integrated systems. From the perspective of embedded systems applications, this course offers a comprehensive introduction to the basic concepts of digital circuits and the development techniques of embedded systems, emphasizing the core content and critical aspects of the subject matter. Through this course, students not only broaden their horizons by understanding the applications of embedded systems but also gain valuable insights that can significantly benefit their future endeavors in the design and development of embedded systems within the nuclear industry sector. In line with the course's characteristics, the teaching process is designed to cultivate students' dialectical thinking and logical reasoning skills; train their judgment, calculation, and comprehensive analysis abilities regarding embedded systems and digital circuit-related issues; and focus on fostering students' spirit of innovation and practical abilities. The primary objectives of this course are: (1) to understand the basic hardware components, working principles, and architecture of microcomputers and embedded systems; (2) to grasp the concepts of embedded system interfaces and ports; to understand the basic concepts and mechanisms of embedded system stacks, interrupts, I/O, and various peripherals; to master C language programming for embedded systems; and to be able to apply theoretical knowledge of embedded systems comprehensively in the development of embedded programs; (3) to stimulate students' interest in hands-on practice, develop their ability to analyze and solve practical problems, and enhance their overall professional competence.

default.zh: 核工程具有规模庞大、结构复杂、材料特殊、环境恶劣、安全性与可靠性要求极高等显著特点，由核工程引出的力学问题能否有效、可信地解决，事关国家战略安全和国计民生。同时，工程力学课程是航天、机械、材料、能源、建筑等专业必修的专业基础课，是基础课和专业课之间的桥梁，起承上启下的作用。核工程力学课程最基础的内容包括理论力学静力学、材料力学和核工程原理部分。本课程通过课堂上的理论教学，旨在使学生掌握刚体的基本概念和公理、力系的简化和平衡，以及应力应变分析中最基本的概念、原理和方法及其在核工程中的应用，培养学生分析和解决工程结构强度、刚度和稳定性问题的能力。
default.en: Most of nuclear engineering problems have large scale, complex structure, special materials, harsh environment, as well as extremely high safety and reliability requirements. Whether the mechanical problems induced by nuclear engineering can be effectively and credibly solved is a matter of national strategic security and national economy and people’s livelihood. At the same time, engineering mechanics courses are compulsory professional basic courses for aerospace, machinery, materials, energy, architecture and other majors. It is a bridge between basic courses and professional courses, and serves as a link between the previous and the next. The most basic content of the nuclear engineering mechanics course includes theoretical mechanics statics, material mechanics and nuclear engineering principles. Through theoretical teaching in class, this course aims to enable students to master the basic concepts and axioms of rigid bodies, the simplification and balance of force systems, and the most basic concepts, principles and methods in stress-strain analysis and their applications in nuclear engineering. Cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve the problems of engineering structure strength, stiffness and stability.

default.zh: 《数理方程与特殊函数》课程旨在介绍数学物理中的基本方程及其解法，特别是特殊函数的性质和应用。本课程涵盖了偏微分方程、积分方程以及它们的解析解和数值解方法。学生将学习到如何应用这些数学工具来解决物理、工程和其他科学领域中的问题。课程内容包括贝塞尔函数、勒让德多项式等特殊函数，以及它们在量子力学、电磁学和流体力学中的应用。通过本课程，学生不仅能够掌握解决复杂物理问题的数学方法，还能深入理解这些问题的物理背景。
default.en: The course "Mathematical Equations and Special Functions" is designed to introduce the fundamental equations in mathematical physics and their solutions, with a particular emphasis on the properties and applications of special functions. The course covers partial differential equations, integral equations, and their analytical and numerical solution methods. Students will learn how to apply these mathematical tools to solve problems in physics, engineering, and other scientific fields. The course content includes special functions such as Bessel functions, Legendre polynomials, along with their applications in quantum mechanics, electromagnetism, and fluid dynamics. Through this course, students will not only master the mathematical methods to tackle complex physical problems but also gain a deep understanding of the physical context of these problems.

default.zh: 核反应堆物理分析II”是辅修核反应堆工程专业的基础理论课程和核心课程。课程的主要目标是培养学生具备从事核反应堆工程领域或相关工作的基础知识，任务是使学生掌握核反应堆基础理论知识和基本原理，具备应用数学工具和数值方法解决反应堆工程中实际问题的初步技能，为今后学习其他专业课程和毕业后从事核反应堆物理计算、核反应堆设计等工作奠定理论基础。
default.en: The main objective of the course is to cultivate students with the elementals in the field of nuclear reactor engineering or related work. The task is to enable students to master the basic theoretical information and principles of nuclear reactors, and to have preliminary skills in applying mathematical tools and numerical methods to solve practical problems in reactor engineering. This will create the fundamentals for future studies of other professional courses and work of post-graduation in nuclear reactor physics calculation, nuclear reactor design, etc.

default.zh: 核工程热流基础I课程主要涉及核工程与核技术中的流体力学理论及分析。主要包括以下内容：核工程流体力学的基本概念，流体的性质，压强与流体静力学，流体运动学，伯努利方程与能量方程，流动系统的动量分析，量纲分析与模型化，内流，流体流动的微分分析，纳维-斯托克斯方程的近似解，阻力和升力，可压缩流动，计算流体力学导论。课程内容涉及核工程与核技术中以及工业生产及生活中流体力学的典型示例。课程内容同时包括核工程与核技术领域相关科技创新理念与项目学习知识，以及核工程与核技术中的流体流动形态、气泡运动、池沸腾等现象和流体运动基本规律的相关实验技能。
default.en: The course of Fundamentals of thermal fluid in Nuclear Engineering I mainly involves the theory and analysis of fluid mechanics in nuclear engineering and technology. The main content includes the following: basic concepts of fluid mechanics in nuclear engineering, properties of fluids, pressure and fluid statics, fluid kinematics, Bernoulli equation and energy equation, momentum analysis of flow systems, dimensional analysis and modeling, differential analysis of internal flow and fluid flow, approximate solutions to the Navier Stokes equation, drag and lift, compressible flow, and introduction to computational fluid mechanics. The course content covers typical examples of fluid mechanics in nuclear engineering and technology, as well as in industrial production and daily life. The course content includes both scientific and technological innovation concepts and project learning knowledge related to nuclear engineering and technology, as well as experimental skills related to fluid flow patterns, bubble motion, pool boiling, and basic laws of fluid motion in nuclear engineering and technology.

default.zh: 核反应堆热工水力学课程是核工程专业一门专业课，着重讲述了反应堆热工水力计算的基本模型和计算方法。课程需要掌握各种核反应堆结构材料的基本热物理性质；掌握核反应堆热工分析中涉及的堆芯释热、传热、流体力学等方面的基本知识和计算原理；掌握核反应堆稳态热工设计原理，了解单通道模型和子通道模型热工设计的步骤和计算方法；了解核反应堆瞬态热工水力分析中的基本模型和方法。课程的教学目的是使本科学生在学习了反应堆物理学、传热学、工程流体力学等课程中的核反应、流动、传热基本原理基础上，进一步了解、掌握对相关反应堆中热工分析的原理与计算方法，扩大知识面，培养根据基本原理进行技术研发、创新的能力。课程教学以课堂讲授为主，辅之以适当的课堂讨论。通过资料搜集、分析整理、评判，培养学生主动获取知识能力。通过课程学习实现以下三个目标：（1）牢固地掌握核反应堆中堆芯热量输运过程，深刻了解热量的来源及去处；（2）掌握反应堆内热输运的计算方法，了解压水堆热工分析计算的核心问题；（3）理解压水反应堆中热量传递涉及的基本原理和方法以及目前存在的主要问题的与解决方向，并增强工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力、创新意识。
default.en: The course is mainly concentrated on the theoretical models and calculation methods in the nuclear reactors. The basic thermal properties of materials used in the nuclear reactors are studied. The principal knowledge and calculation methods for heat transfer, fluid mechanism and releasing heat properties used in the analysis of thermodynamics and hydraulics of nuclear reactor are mustered. The thermodynamic and hydraulic methods at the steady state are understood. The single channel and sub-channel thermodynamic and hydraulic calculation methods and processes are performed. The basic theoretical models and calculation methods of instantaneous thermodynamic and hydraulic are performed. The purpose of the course is to make sure that the undergraduate study the basic principles of nuclear reaction、flow and heat transfer from the Reactor physics、Heat Transfer 、Engineering Fluid Mechanics and other courses, Further understand and master the principle and implementation scheme of thermal environment simulation in related numerical simulation technology, Expand the scope of knowledge and cultivate the ability of development and innovation based on the principle. Course teaching is mainly taught in class, supplemented by appropriate class discussion. By collecting and analyzing data can trained students acquire knowledge ability ;by topic designing、demonstrating and preliminary design training can cultivated students practical ability emphatically.These objectives can be achieved through this course: (1) Masting the heat transport process of nuclear reactor firmly and understanding the basic principles and main ways to improve the efficiency of heat transfer;(2) Grasping the calculation method of heat transport in the reactor and understanding the core problem of thermal analysis calculation of pressurized water reactor;(3) Understanding the basic principle and main technology of heat transfer in pressurized water reactor as well as the main problems existing at present, and enhance engineering practice ability, logical thinking ability and innovation consciousness.

default.zh: 核工程热流基础II是能源与环境领域以及核工程领域重要的基础课程，是培养学生掌握和综合运用传热理论知识解决传热工程问题的重要环节。本课程总共40学时（其中实验4学时），课程的主要内容及课时安排包括了：绪论，主要内容包括三种基本传热方式（导热、对流及热辐射）及其基本计算公式及传热过程简介。导热基本原理，主要内容包括导热微分方程的定解条件：初始条件和三类边界条件。稳态导热，主要内容第一类边界条件下大平板、长圆筒壁一维稳态导热计算。非稳态导热，主要内容包括第三类边界条件下一维非稳态导热计算，准稳态导热。导热问题数值解，主要内容包括导热微分方程的离散方法——控制容积法。导热问题的数值编程及商业软件操作，主要内容简单二维稳态导热问题编程，商业软件使用方法。对流传热的理论基础，主要内容包括对流换热的特点及分类，换热基本公式等。单相对流传热的实验关联式，主要包括相似原理，准则方程，努谢尔特准则，普朗特准则，雷诺准则等。相变对流传热，主要包括凝结现象，膜状凝结分析解及实验关联式等。热辐射基本定律及物体的辐射特性，主要包括黑体，辐射力，光谱辐射力，普朗克定律，维恩位移定律等。辐射换热，主要包括黑体间的辐射换热，角系数，角系数的性质及求解等。实验，主要包括准稳态法测不良导体的导热系数，空气横掠单管对流换热系数的测定等。
default.en: Fundamentals of thermo-fluid in nuclear engineering II is an important basic course in the field of energy and environment and nuclear engineering, and is an important part of cultivating students to master and comprehensively apply theoretical knowledge of heat transfer to solve heat transfer engineering problems. A total of 40 courses (including 4 courses of experiments), the main content of the course and the class schedule include: Introduction, the main content includes three basic heat transfer methods (heat conduction, convection and heat radiation) and their basic calculation formulas and an introduction to the heat transfer process. The basic principle of thermal conductivity, the main content includes the definite solution conditions of differential equations for thermal conductivity: initial conditions and three types of boundary conditions. Steady-state thermal conductivity, the main content of the first type of boundary conditions of large plates, long cylinder walls one-dimensional steady-state thermal conductivity calculation. Non-steady state thermal conductivity, the main contents include one-dimensional non-steady state thermal conductivity calculation under the third type of boundary conditions, quasi-steady state thermal conductivity. Numerical solution of thermal conductivity problem, the main content includes the discrete method of thermal conductivity differential equation - control volume method. Numerical programming of thermal conductivity problems and commercial software operation, the main content includes simple two-dimensional steady-state thermal conductivity problem programming, and commercial software usage methods. The theoretical basis of convective heat transfer, the main contents include the characteristics and classification of convective heat transfer, the basic formula of heat exchange, etc. Experimental correlation formulas for heat transfer, mainly including similarity principle, criterion equation, Nuchert criterion, Plante criterion, Reynolds criterion, etc. Phase change convective heat transfer, mainly including condensation phenomenon, membrane condensation analysis and solution, and experimental correlation formula. The basic law of thermal radiation and the radiation characteristics of objects, mainly including blackbody, radiation force, spectral radiation force, Planck's law, Wien displacement law, etc. Radiative heat transfer, mainly including radiative heat transfer between black bodies, angular coefficients, the properties and solutions of angular coefficients, etc. The experiment mainly includes the measurement of the thermal conductivity of the poor conductor by the quasi-steady-state method and the determination of the convective heat transfer coefficient of the single tube by air sweeping.

default.zh: 本课程是核工程与核技术专业方向的一门专业基础课。核技术电动力学应用基础是宏观电磁现象的经典理论，是研究电磁场的基本属性、运动规律以及电磁场与物质相互作用的一门重要基础理论课，对培养学生掌握电磁和光现象与规律、运用所学知识处理电磁问题能力、科学研究意识与基本素养等方面具有重要作用。本课程面向核工程与核技术专业方向本科生开设。课程目标要求如下：（1）通过对电磁运动基本规律的学习，加深对电磁场基本性质的理解；（2）通过学习电磁场运动规律和狭义相对论，更深刻领会电磁场的物质性，帮助加深辩证唯物主义世界观；（3）通过在课程中适当引入科技前沿，促进教学内容与学术前沿和现实直接对接。
default.en: This course is a basic course of Nuclear Engineering and Nuclear Technology. The foundation of the application of electrodynamics in nuclear technology is the classical theory of macroscopic electromagnetic phenomena, which is an important basic theoretical course to study the basic properties and motion laws of electromagnetic field and the interaction between electromagnetic field and matter. It plays an important role in training students to master electromagnetic and light phenomena and laws, apply the knowledge to solve electromagnetic problems, and have scientific research awareness and basic literacy. This course is designed for undergraduates majoring in Nuclear Engineering and Nuclear Technology. The course objectives are as follows: (1) By studying the basic laws of electromagnetic motion, deepen the understanding of the basic properties of the electromagnetic field; (2) By studying the laws of electromagnetic field motion and the special theory of relativity, gain a deeper understanding of the materiality of the electromagnetic field and help deepen dialectical materialism world view; (3) Promote direct connection between teaching content and academic frontiers and reality by appropriately introducing technological frontiers into courses.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述流体的基本概念和属性，尤其是流体与刚体和固体在力学行为方面的区别。以此为基础和出发点，介绍流体静平衡所遵循规律及点压和面压的计算方法，并以介绍流体运动的一系列基本概念为前提，推求流体力学的三大基本方程。然后介绍管路系统的水力计算和流体出流计算以及水击现象的基本概念。本课程以讲述流体力学基本概念、基础知识和基本原理为主，着重培养学生解决工程问题的能力。并通过一定数量习题和实验，使学生具有足够的感性认识和实际动手的能力。
default.en: This course introduces the basic concepts and properties of fluids, especially the differences between the fluid and the solid in mechanical actions. Based on this, the course introduces the fluid statics and the calculation of pressure at a point and pressure forces on surfaces. By illustrating the basic principle of fluid kinematics as premise, the three fundamental equations of fluid mechanics are deduced. Then we introduced the hydraulic calculation of flows in pipelines, orifice outlet flow and the basic concepts of water hammer. The course emphasizes basic concepts of fluid mechanics, and cultivates students to get enough perceptual knowledge and practical abilities through a certain amount of exercises and experiments.

default.zh: 工程热力学是研究热能和机械能相互转换规律及热能有效利用的科学。工程热力学课程是能源动力、机械、化工、市政、航空航天等多个工程类专业的重要技术基础课之一。本课程的教学目的和主要任务是使学生掌握能量转换的基本规律，并能正确运用这些规律进行热工过程和热力循环的分析计算。本课程的学习不仅为学生学习专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且为学生毕业后解决生产实际问题和参加科学研究工作打下一定的理论基础。
default.en: Engineering Thermodynamics mainly concerns on the transforming rules between thermal energy and mechanical energy, together with the effective utilization of energy. It is the main elementary courses for undergraduates majoring engineering, such as thermal engineering, astronautic and aeronautic engineering, municipal engineering and so on. The main purpose and mission of the course is to make the students master basic rules of energy transformation, and perform calculation for the thermal process and cycle. It can not only provide a necessary theory foundation for the undergraduates, but also form a certain basis for the attendants to solve the practical industrial problem and to participate in scientific research.

default.zh: 传热学是研究温差驱动下热量传递规律的一门技术科学，主要内容包括：导热基本定律，稳态导热，非稳态导热，导热问题数值解法，单相对流换热理论，对流换热的实验关联式，沸腾与凝结换热，热辐射基本定律，物体辐射特性，表面辐射换热，火焰辐射换热，传热过程及换热器等。传热学课程，是热能动力、机械制造、航空航天、材料加工、电子电气、建筑工程等相关专业的一门技术基础课。通过本门课程的学习，使学生对热量传递这一普遍存在的现象有深入理性的认识，掌握传热学的基本理论、基本定律及基本计算，并初步具有解决实际传热问题的能力。
default.en: Heat transfer is about the movement of thermal energy from high temperature place to low temperature place . The course includes: the basic laws of heat conduction and steady state heat conduction, unsteady state heat conduction, and numerical heat conduction, convection heat transfer, the condensation and boiling heat transfer, the basic laws of thermal radiation, radiative properties of materials, the surface radiative heat exchange, fire radiative heat exchange, heat transfer process and heat exchanger, mass transfer. Heat Transfer is a fundamental course for the undergraduates who are majoring in thermal energy power, machine manufacturing, aeronautics and space, material processing, electronics or electrical engineering.

default.zh: 传热学与流体力学、工程热力学并称能源动力类三大支柱课程，在热能动力、机械制造、航空航天、化工、材料加工、冶金、电子与电气、建筑工程等生产技术领域中存在大量的传热问题。传热学是相关各学科专业的一门重要技术基础课，通过本门课程的学习，使学生对热量传递这一普遍存在的物理现象有理性的认识，掌握传热学的基本理论、基本定律及基本计算，为解决以后课程学习或工作中涉及到的热问题，打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Heat transfer, fluid mechanics and engineering thermodynamics are known as the three pillar courses of energy and power, and there are a lot of heat transfer problems in the production technology fields of thermal energy and power, mechanical manufacturing, aerospace, chemical industry, material processing, metallurgy, electronics and electrical, and building engineering. Heat transfer is an important basic technical course for related disciplines. Through the study of this course, students can have a rational understanding of the universal physical phenomenon of heat transfer, master the basic theory, basic law and basic calculation of heat transfer, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for solving the heat problems involved in future course study or work.

default.zh: 气体动力学是能源与动力工程专业、飞行器动力工程专业的基础课，主要阐述气体动力学基本概念和气体运动所遵循的基本方程。通过对典型流动现象的分析，帮助学生建立起气体动力学的基本概念，掌握气体运动的基本规律，能够对简单的流动现象给出正确的解释，为专业课的学习打下基础。 课程内容包括：流体力学、热力学基础知识及场论初步；气体运动基本方程组；滞止参数与气动函数；膨胀波和激波；一维定常可压缩管道流动。
default.en: GASDYNAMICS is one of the major fundamental courses for the undergraduate students in Energy and Power Engineering as well as Flight Vehicle Power Engineering, focusing on the basic concepts of aerodynamics and the basic equations governing the gas flow. The purpose of this course is to help the student understand the basic principles of aerodynamics through the analysis of the typical flow phenomena, and to have the ability to reveal the mechanisms of some simple flow phenomena. The contents of GASDYNAMICS include Fundamental Knowledge of Fluid Mechanics and Thermodynamics as well as Field Theory; Three-Dimensional Flow Equations; Stagnation Parameters and Aerodynamic Functions; Expansion Wave and Shock Wave; One-Dimensional Equations of Steady Pipe Flow.

default.zh: 可压缩气体动力学是压缩空气储能的关键基础，本课程的目的是使学生熟悉和掌握用于储能的压缩气体动力学基本知识，有别于常规气体动力学，本课程更注重储能中气体动力学的使用背景。通过对课程的学习，引导学生用气体动力学基本知识，快速分析压缩空气储能关键参数变化规律，掌握压缩气体动力学可压流动等特性，具备根据实际需要进行全面考虑和分析，具备用于压缩空气储能技术的气体动力学基本知识。
default.en: Compressible aerodynamics is key foundation for energy storage. The purpose of this course is to familiarize students with and master the basic knowledge of compressed aerodynamics used for energy storage. Unlike conventional aerodynamics, this course focuses more on the background of the use of aerodynamics in energy storage. Through the study of the course, guide students to use basic knowledge of aerodynamics to analyze the changes in key parameters of the energy storage, master the compressible flow characteristics of compressed gas dynamics, and have the ability to comprehensively consider and analyze according to actual needs. Possess basic knowledge of aerodynamics for energy storage technology.

default.zh: “燃烧学”是能源与动力工程专业的主干技术基础课之一，是研究燃料化学能向热能转换规律的一门科学，主要涉及气、液、固等各种燃料在强烈放热反应，即燃烧反应过程中的流动、传热、传质和化学反应等相互作用规律。教学目的是使学生能够从理论上准确地认识燃烧现象，了解燃烧过程发生、发展的规律，掌握对燃烧过程进行理论分析的基本方法，以及对物理过程进行数学处理的基本方法，学会研究燃烧过程的一些基本实验方法，能够初步利用一些经典实验手段研究燃烧过程，并了解燃烧理论和燃烧研究方法的新发展，为学生进一步学习工业燃烧设备、发动机等装备类课程奠定基础。
default.en: Combustion Theory is one of the main technical basic courses in the field of energy and power engineering. It is a science that studies the conversion of fuel chemical energy to thermal energy. It mainly involves the interaction laws of flow, heat transfer, mass transfer, and chemical reactions of various fuels such as gas, liquid, and solid in strong exothermic reactions during combustion reactions. The teaching purpose is to enable students to accurately understand the phenomenon of combustion from a theoretical perspective, understand the laws of the occurrence and development of the combustion process, master the basic methods of theoretical analysis of the combustion process, as well as the basic methods of mathematical processing of physical processes, learn some basic experimental methods for studying the combustion process, and be able to preliminarily use some classic experimental methods to study the combustion process, and to understand the new developments in combustion theory and research methods, laying a foundation for students to further study equipment courses such as industrial combustion equipment and engines.

default.zh: 本课程面向能源科学与工程学院各专业的本科生，是本学院重要基础课程。通过本课程的学习和实践环节，学生应掌握动态系统的建模过程、热能动力控制系统分析和设计中的一般问题。熟练掌握建立线性定常系统数学模型方法，熟练掌握方块图化简求取系统的各种传递函数。领会“反馈控制”的基本原理，掌握线性定常系统的时域分析法。掌握线性系统的稳定性代数判据和频域判据。掌握线性定常系统的频率特性分析法。熟练掌握用Bode图分析系统动、静态性能分析；了解闭环频率特性及其性能估算。较熟练掌握用频率法综合系统，能正确选择校正环节及参数。了解控制系统中解决纯延迟、简单非线性问题的方法。
default.en: This course is for the students from school of energy science and engineering related majors, which is a very important basic course for this department. This course is aiming at teaching the modelling and control design process of thermal power systems. Through the teaching process, the students should have basic understanding of how to establish a model of linear system, simplify the system and get the transfer function. The students should understand the concept of “feedback control” and the method to analyze the system using time/frequency zone analysis method.

default.zh: 本课程是为能源科学与工程学院储能专业的学生开设，是该专业重要的基础课程。本课程旨在讲授系统的建模和控制设计过程。通过教学过程，学生应该对如何建立线性系统的模型、简化系统和得到传递函数有基本的了解，理解“反馈控制”的概念。掌握线性稳定系统的时域分析方法，线性系统的代数和频域稳定性准则，以及线性稳定系统频率特性分析方法。掌握波德图分析系统的动态和静态性能，了解闭环频率特性及其性能估计，并利用频率法对系统进行综合，正确选择校准步骤和参数。
default.en: This course is for the students from school of energy science and engineering majoring in energy storage, which is a very important basic course for this department. This course is aiming at teaching the modelling and control design process of thermal storage systems. Through the teaching process, the students should have basic understanding of how to establish a model of linear system, simplify the system and get the transfer function. The students should understand the concept of “feedback control”. They also should master the time-domain analysis method of linear steady systems, the algebraic and frequency domain stability criteria for linear systems, and the frequency characteristic analysis method of linear steady systems. They would also study to analyze the dynamic and static performance of systems with Bode diagrams, understand the closed-loop frequency characteristics and their performance estimation. and use frequency method to synthesize systems and to correctly choose calibration steps and parameters.

default.zh: 《储能系统测试技术》课程是储能专业的一门专业课，也可作为能源动力、机械、电子、化工类相关专业的选修课。课程的教学目的是使学生进一步了解、掌握对储能系统测试技术的重要性、关键实验设备的原理及应用，扩大知识面，培养根据基本原理进行技术研发、创新的能力。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解当前国内外该领域的研究热点和发展方向，增强学生运用所学知识分析并解决实际问题的能力；掌握部分实验设备的基本操作规范，培养学生主动获取知识能力；通过学生自主拟定设计题目、进行论证与初步设计训练，着重培养学生的实践能力，为其后独立从事相关研究与开发工作奠定基础。
default.en: Testing Technology of Energy Storage System is a specialized course in the field of energy storage, and it can also be used as an elective course for related majors in the fields of energy power, machinery, electronics and chemical industry. The teaching objective of the course is to enable students to further understand and master the importance of the test technology of energy storage system, the principle and application of key experimental equipment, to expand their knowledge, and to cultivate the ability to carry out technological research and development and innovation according to the basic principles. Through the study of this course, students can understand the current domestic and international research hot spots and development direction of the field, enhance the ability of students to use the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve practical problems; master the basic operation of some experimental equipment, cultivate students to take the initiative to acquire knowledge; through the students to independently formulate the design of the topic, the argumentation and preliminary design training, focusing on the cultivation of students' practical ability, and laying the foundation for the students to engage in relevant research and development work independently. Through the training of students' independent design topics, the program focuses on cultivating students' practical ability and laying a foundation for them to engage in relevant research and development work independently.

default.zh: 半导体物理是固体物理学的一个分支，《半导体物理》课程是帮助学生研究半导体原子状态和电子状态以及各种半导体器件内部电子过程的学科。本课程主要介绍：半导体的特征、晶体结构、半导体中的电子状态、半导体中杂质和能级缺陷、载流子的统计分布、载流子的输运、非平衡载流子、复合理论、载流子的扩散运动、平衡p-n节特性、p-n电流电压电容特性、金半接触的整流输运理论、半导体表面与MIS结构、表面电场效应、异质结与霍尔效应。
default.en: Semiconductor physics is a branch of solid-state physics, and the course "Semiconductor Physics" is a discipline that helps students study the atomic and electronic states of semiconductors, as well as the electronic processes inside various semiconductor devices. This course mainly introduces the characteristics of semiconductors, crystal structure, electronic states in semiconductors, impurities and energy level defects in semiconductors, statistical distribution of charge carriers, transport of charge carriers, non-equilibrium charge carriers, recombination theory, diffusion motion of charge carriers, equilibrium p-n junction characteristics, p-n current voltage capacitance characteristics, rectification transport theory of gold semi contact, semiconductor surface and MIS structure, surface electric field effect Heterojunction and Hall effect.

default.zh: 碳中和背景下，储能技术是提高电网灵活性及安全性、支撑可再生能源发展的关键技术之一。各类储能技术中，电化学储能是应用最广、最具发展潜力的储能技术。本课程面向储能领域，通过对多学科领域知识和进展的整合及梳理，引导学生在电化学储能技术的研究前沿开阔眼界，形成从基础知识到技术前沿的贯通性思维。 在基础知识方面，课程从电化学热力学、动力学以及典型电化学储能原理和技术等方面，通过数学、物理、化学、材料、能源等相关学科知识整合与交叉，引领学生理解电化学储能的科学原理和发展脉络，形成多学科整体知识体系。培养学生建立从基础知识到技术前沿的深化理解能力；培养学生理解、解决复杂问题的能力。 在问题导向方面，引导学生分析、总结目前电化学储能及电催化技术的发展现状和关键瓶颈，在此基础上针对典型技术，运用基本原理、文献调研等方法提出新想法，通过数学、计算模拟、实验测试等手段进行验证，培养学生使用相关工具进行问题分析、方案设计和研究的能力。 在研讨交流方面，针对典型电化学储能技术，在基本原理的讲授基础上，重点通过分组研讨式教学引领学生围绕感兴趣的主题收集资料、开阔眼界、提出想法。激发学生的学习兴趣，培养学生的自主学习与终生学习能力。
default.en: Under the background of carbon neutrality, energy storage technology is one of the key technologies to improve the flexibility and safety of the power grid, and to support the development of renewable energy. Among various energy storage technologies, electrochemical energy storage is the most widely used and promising energy storage technology. This course is aimed at the field of energy storage, guiding students to broaden their horizons in the research frontier of electrochemical energy storage technology through the integration and sorting of knowledge and progress in multiple disciplines, and forming a coherent thinking from basic knowledge to the forefront of technology. In terms of basic knowledge, the course integrates and crosses related disciplines such as mathematics, physics, chemistry, materials, energy, etc. from the aspects of electrochemical thermodynamics, kinetics, and typical principles and technologies of electrochemical energy storage, leading students to understand the scientific principles and development trends of electrochemical energy storage, and forming a multidisciplinary overall knowledge system. The course cultivates students' ability to deepen their understanding from basic knowledge to the forefront of technology. In terms of problem orientation, guide students to analyze and summarize the current development status and key bottlenecks of electrochemical energy storage technology. Based on this, students can propose new ideas for typical technologies using basic principles, literature research, and other methods. Through mathematical, computational simulation, experimental testing and other means of verification, this course aims to cultivate students' ability to use relevant tools for problem analysis, scheme design, and research. In terms of discussion and exchange, based on the basic principles of typical electrochemical energy storage technologies, emphasis is placed on group discussion teaching to guide students to collect information, broaden their horizons, and propose ideas around topics of interest. This course aims to stimulate students' interest in learning, cultivate their ability for self-directed and lifelong learning.

default.zh: 本课程的目的是使学生熟悉和掌握储能材料相关的基础知识；储能材料涉及光学、电学、磁学、热学、化学以及材料学等多学科交叉，是实现能源的转化和利用以及发展新能源技术的基础。通过对课程的学习，引导学生在以“能源为体”的格局下，关注材料科学与技术的发展，形成以“材料为翼”，服务能源科学与技术发展和进步的材料学知识体系。通过对课程的学习，学生能够掌握储能材料的设计、制备、表征等基础知识，具备根据实际需要进行全面考虑和分析，设计筛选相关储能材料的能力。
default.en: The purpose of this course is to make students familiar with and master the basic knowledge of energy storage materials. Energy storage materials involve multiple disciplines such as optics, electricity, magnetism, heat, chemistry and materials science, and are the basis for realizing energy conversion and utilization and developing new energy technologies. Through the study of the course, students are guided to pay attention to the development of materials science and technology under the pattern of "energy as the body", and form a material science knowledge system with "materials as the wing" to serve the development and progress of energy science and technology. Through the study of the course, students can master the basic knowledge of the design, preparation and characterization of energy storage materials, and can conduct comprehensive consideration and analysis according to actual needs, and design and screen relevant energy storage materials.

default.zh: 与环境保护相容协调的能源系统，即多领域学科交叉渗透、多能源与多输出一体化的广义能源系统，是能源动力系统发展的主流方向和前沿。作为能源系统中的重要模块，储能可弥补风、光等新能源发电随机性强与可调度性低的先天缺陷，促进新能源汽车与能源互联网发展，在生产侧与消费侧实现主体能源由化石能源向新能源的更替，被认为是支撑能源革命、实现“碳达峰”与“碳中和”最核心的物理手段。储能的种类较多，常见的包括抽水蓄能、压缩空气储能、电化学储能、热储能、氢储能等。然而，由于受技术、成本、政策、商业模式等因素的影响，储能对环境可能产生各种影响，需深入学习研究。 本课程目标是使学生了解各种储能技术、设备、材料、系统原理，通过对各类储能技术工作原理与特点深入分析，建立一套储能系统与环境耦合分析体系，针对该体系进行较深层次剖析与讲解，将环境工程与储能技术深度耦合，分析储能系统对环境影响机制，探究储能系统全生命周期内环保方式，可帮助学生深入了解各种储能工作原理及体系。为学生更好地掌握储能系统科学与工程应用理论，拓展视野和储备知识，激发学生研究兴趣，引导学生进行系统性学习。
default.en: The energy system that is compatible and coordinated with environmental protection, that is, the generalized energy system with cross-penetration of multiple disciplines and the integration of multiple energy and multiple outputs, is the mainstream direction and frontier of the development of energy power system. As an important module in the energy system, energy storage can make up for the congenital defects of strong randomness and low dispatchability of new energy power generation such as wind and solar, promote the development of new energy vehicles and energy Internet, and realize the replacement of the main energy from fossil energy to new energy on the production side and consumption side, which is considered to be the core physical means to support the energy revolution and achieve "carbon peak" and "carbon neutrality". There are many types of energy storage, including pumped hydro storage, compressed air energy storage, electrochemical energy storage, thermal energy storage, hydrogen energy storage, etc. However, due to the influence of technology, cost, policy, business model and other factors, energy storage may have various impacts on the environment, which requires in-depth study and research. The goal of this course is to enable students to understand the principles of various energy storage technologies, equipment, materials and systems, establish a set of energy storage system and environmental coupling analysis system through in-depth analysis of the working principles and characteristics of various energy storage technologies, conduct in-depth analysis and explanation of the system, deeply couple environmental engineering and energy storage technology, analyze the environmental impact mechanism of energy storage systems, and explore environmental protection methods in the whole life cycle of energy storage systems, which can help students have an in-depth understanding of various energy storage working principles and systems. To help students better grasp the application theory of energy storage system science and engineering, expand their horizons and reserve knowledge, stimulate students' interest in research, and guide students to carry out systematic learning.

default.zh: 本课程为流体力学、能源动力类等专业的一门重要技术基础课，面向未来技术学院智能制造模块的本科生，讲授流体力学的基本概念和基本理论，以及流体平衡和运动的基本规律，使学生了解流体的基本概念和性质，掌握流体静力学、流体运动学、流体动力学等方面的基础知识和基本理论，并通过一定数量的实验和习题，使学生对流体力学具有足够的感性认识和实际动手的能力，基本掌握运用流体力学知识解决航空航天工程实际的计算和分析能力。本课程的教学注重培养学生的兴趣，着重培养学生对流体力学基础理论知识的掌握，不仅为学生学习后续的专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且也为学生将来继续深造打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This course is an important basic technical course for majors such as fluid mechanics and energy power. It is intended for undergraduates in the intelligent manufacturing module for the school of future technical to teach the basic concepts and theories of fluid mechanics, as well as the basic laws of fluid balance and motion, so that students can understand the basic concepts and properties of fluids, master the basic knowledge and theories of hydrostatics, fluid kinematics, fluid dynamics, etc, Through a certain number of experiments and exercises, the students will have enough perceptual knowledge of fluid mechanics and practical ability to basically master the ability to use fluid mechanics knowledge to solve the actual calculation and analysis of aerospace engineering. The teaching of this course focuses on cultivating students' interest and mastering the basic theoretical knowledge of fluid mechanics, which not only provides students with the necessary basic theoretical knowledge for their subsequent professional courses, but also lays a solid foundation for their further study in the future.

default.zh: 工程热力学是研究热能和机械能相互转换规律及热能有效利用的科学。工程热力学课程是能源动力、机械、化工、市政、航空航天等多个工程类专业的重要技术基础课之一。本课程的教学目的和主要任务是使学生掌握能量转换的基本规律，并能正确运用这些规律进行热工过程和热力循环的分析计算。本课程的学习不仅为学生学习专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且为学生毕业后解决生产实际问题和参加科学研究工作打下一定的理论基础。
default.en: Engineering Thermodynamics mainly concerns on the transforming rules between thermal energy and mechanical energy, together with the effective utilization of energy. It is the main elementary courses for undergraduates majoring engineering, such as thermal engineering, astronautic and aeronautic engineering, municipal engineering and so on. The main purpose and mission of the course is to make the students master basic rules of energy transformation, and perform calculation for the thermal process and cycle. It can not only provide a necessary theory foundation for the undergraduates, but also form a certain basis for the attendants to solve the practical industrial problem and to participate in scientific research.

default.zh: 工程热力学是研究热能和机械能相互转换规律及热能有效利用的科学。工程热力学课程是能源动力、机械、化工、市政、航空航天等多个工程类专业的重要技术基础课之一。本课程的教学目的和主要任务是使学生掌握能量转换的基本规律，并能正确运用这些规律进行热工过程和热力循环的分析计算。本课程的学习不仅为学生学习专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且为学生毕业后解决生产实际问题和参加科学研究工作打下一定的理论基础。
default.en: Engineering Thermodynamics mainly concerns on the transforming rules between thermal energy and mechanical energy, together with the effective utilization of energy. It is the main elementary courses for undergraduates majoring engineering, such as thermal engineering, astronautic and aeronautic engineering, municipal engineering and so on. The main purpose and mission of the course is to make the students master basic rules of energy transformation, and perform calculation for the thermal process and cycle. It can not only provide a necessary theory foundation for the undergraduates, but also form a certain basis for the attendants to solve the practical industrial problem and to participate in scientific research.

default.zh: 太阳能热推进（Solar Thermal Propulsion，STP）系统是一种高效且经济的空间运输系统，具有小尺寸和高比冲的特点，为空间任务提供了性能优势。学习太阳能热推进涉及航空航天工程、推进系统设计、物理学、热力学和计算机模拟等多个学科和领域。通过探索太空太阳能利用，培养可持续能源应用的认识和技能。这一领域的学习既提供专业知识，又培养跨学科和综合能力，为航空航天工程领域的专业人才提供了宝贵的学习机会。
default.en: Solar Thermal Propulsion (STP) system, as a highly efficient and economical space transportation system, features small size and high specific impulse, offering performance advantages for space missions. Learning about STP involves disciplines such as aerospace engineering, propulsion system design, physics, thermodynamics, and computer simulation. Exploring solar energy utilization in space fosters awareness and skills in sustainable energy applications. This field of study not only provides specialized knowledge but also cultivates interdisciplinary and comprehensive abilities, which provides valuable learning opportunities for professionals in aerospace engineering and related fields.

default.zh: 飞行器动力空天力学实践是哈工大和莫航联培本科项目的重要实践课程。本课程的教学定位旨在通过水火箭的制作、调试以及相关理论预测模型的研发，将理论知识应用于解决工程实践中的实际问题，加深理论知识理解，提高动手能力，并在团队合作中提升协作意识增强沟通能力，激发对航空航天领域的兴趣和对工程实践的热情。
default.en: The Aerospace Propulsion Mechanics Practicum is an important practice course for the joint undergraduate program between Harbin Institute of Technology and Moscow Aviation Institute. The objective of this course is to apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems in engineering practice, deepen theoretical knowledge understanding, enhance hands-on ability, and improve teamwork and communication skills through the making and debugging of water rockets and the development of related theoretical prediction models. The course aims to inspire interest in the aerospace field and enthusiasm for engineering practice.

default.zh: 本课程是面向航空航天、能源动力类专业本科生开设的实验课程，重点讲授航空发动机主要气动部件的设计方法、性能实验研究原理与气动性能测试方法，并对航空发动机整机模型进行结构拆卸分解与装配。课程的主要目标是帮助学生建立起航空发动机系统的基本概念，并掌握其关键气动部件实验方法和原理、发动机通流结构特征及其工作性能参数的设计和评价方法，提升学生对于航空发动机系统的认知能力，并深入理解航空发动机通流设计的底层逻辑结构，为学生将来在本领域进一步深造奠定坚实的理论基础。本课程通过采用课堂理论教学、试验件设计、发动机模型拆装与数值仿真相结合的教学方法，将航空发动机的通流设计理论、研制过程与发动机模型实物拆装相结合进行实训，在使学生获得理论知识的同时，提升其解决工程实际问题的综合能力。
default.en: This course is an experimental course designed for undergraduates majoring in aerospace and energy & power. It focuses on teaching the design methods, performance experimental principles, and aerodynamic performance testing methods for the main aerodynamic components of aircraft engines, as well as the structural disassembly and assembly of aircraft engine models. The main objective of the course is to help students establish the basic concepts of aircraft engine systems, master the experimental methods and principles for main aerodynamic components of aircraft engine, throughflow structure characteristics, and design & evaluation methods of aerodynamic performance parameters. Additionally, it enhances undergraduates' cognitive ability for aircraft engine systems, deepens their understanding of the underlying logical structure for aircraft engine throughflow design, and lays theoretical foundation for their future studies in this field. This course applies a teaching method that combines classroom theory teaching, experimental devices design, engine model disassembly & assembly and numerical simulation. It combines the throughflow design theory and development process of aircraft engines with the physical disassembly and assembly of engine models for practical training. Not only it enables students to acquire theoretical knowledge, but also it also enhances their comprehensive ability to solve engineering practical problems.

default.zh: 《微纳尺度流动与传热实践》是一门以实验为主体的课程，重在培养学生的实验设计、实践操作能力，从微纳尺度条件下流动与传热的基础理论入手，以微流控实验平台为核心基础，通过开展具体实验，学习微尺度下的流动与传热技术、机理、现象，通过实验过程强化理论知识的掌握。通过本课程实践，使本科生了解微纳流动基本概念及特点、微纳尺度流动与传热现象及机理，掌握芯片实验室中芯片的光刻、显影、封装等方法，建立微流控实验技术框架，培养本科生思考、设计、实践能力，以及一定的创新科研思想。
default.en: "Micro and nano scale Flow and Heat Transfer Practice" is a course mainly based on experiments, focusing on cultivating students' experimental design and practical operation abilities. Starting from the basic theory of flow and heat transfer under micro and nano scale conditions, with the microfluidic experimental platform as the core foundation. Experiments tall flow and heat transfer technology, mechanisms, and phenomena at the micro scale, and strengthening theoretical knowledge through the experimental practices. Using the practical experience in this course, undergraduate students will understand the basic concepts and characteristics of micro and nano flow, as well as the phenomena and mechanisms of the heat transfer. They will also learn the methods of lithography, development, and packaging in the lab-on-a-chip, establish a microfluidic experimental technology framework, and cultivate their thinking, design, and practical abilities, as well as certain innovative scientific research ideas.

default.zh: 《空气动力学》是力学与航天等类专业的学科基础课。主要讲述流体运动的基本方程、基本规律和基本现象，以及解决流体力学和空气动力学问题的基本方法。流体力学的核心知识、核心研究方法和思维方式将为丰富和深化学生的知识结构、启迪思维和创新做出贡献。 通过本课程的教学及实践，学生须掌握流体力学和空气动力学的基本概念、基本原理和方法，包括：流体的主要物理性质、流体运动学、流体动力学的基本方程组、理想不可压平面无旋流动、无黏可压缩流动、黏性不可压流动与边界层、翼型气动特性的近似计算方法。学会描述流体运动，分析基本流动现象，应用不同形式的流体动力学方程解决简单流体力学和空气动力学问题。
default.en: Aerodynamics is a fundamental course for majors such as Mechanics and Aerospace. This course mainly discusses the basic equations, laws, and phenomena of fluid motion, as well as the basic methods for solving fluid mechanics and aerodynamics problems. The core knowledge, research methods, and thinking methods of fluid mechanics will contribute to enriching and deepening students' knowledge structure, inspiring thinking, and innovation. Through the teaching and practice of this course, students should master the basic concepts, principles, and methods of fluid mechanics and aerodynamics, including: the main physical properties of fluids, fluid kinematics, basic equations of fluid dynamics, ideal incompressible plane irrotational flow, inviscid compressible flow, viscous incompressible flow and boundary layer, approximate calculation methods of aerodynamic characteristics of airfoils. Learn to describe fluid motion, analyze basic flow phenomena, and apply different forms of fluid dynamics equations to solve simple fluid dynamics and aerodynamics problems.

default.zh: 知识建构能力 掌握温室气体核算方法、碳源碳汇动态平衡模型、能源系统生命周期评价（LCA）等核心理论；理解碳交易市场（EU-ETS/中国碳市场）运作机制、碳边境调节（CBAM）对工业的影响；掌握风光储一体化、氢能产业链、特高压电网等清洁能源技术原理；熟悉碳捕集与封存（CCUS）技术路径及工业脱碳创新案例。 系统分析与设计能力 能够运用质量平衡法、遥感数据建模等方法构建碳源碳汇动态平衡模型；掌握排放因子法、直接测量法进行碳排放核算；具备设计多能互补能源系统（如张北柔性直流电网）、优化工业脱碳路径（如UCG-IGCC-CCUS技术链）的能力；能够通过碳足迹计算工具（Simapro/GaBi）评估全生命周期环境影响。 创新与实践能力 通过案例研究（苹果碳中和供应链管理、宁德时代零碳工厂），培养解决复杂工程问题的系统思维；掌握区块链技术在碳数据溯源中的应用、AI驱动的碳排放预测与调控策略；能够撰写技术分析报告（如校园能源系统碳中和路径优化方案），提出符合SDGs的创新解决方案。
default.en: Knowledge Building Ability Master core theories such as greenhouse gas accounting methods, dynamic carbon source and sink balance models, and life cycle assessment (LCA) of energy systems; understand the operational mechanisms of carbon trading markets (EU-ETS/China Carbon Market), and the impact of carbon border adjustment mechanisms (CBAM) on industry; grasp the principles of clean energy technologies such as integrated wind-solar-storage systems, hydrogen energy industry chains, and ultra-high voltage power grids; and be familiar with carbon capture and storage (CCUS) technology pathways and innovative industrial decarbonization case studies. System Analysis and Design Ability Capable of constructing dynamic carbon source and sink balance models using methods such as mass balance and remote sensing data modeling; proficient in carbon emission accounting using emission factor methods and direct measurement techniques; able to design multi-energy complementary energy systems (e.g., Zhangbei flexible DC grid) and optimize industrial decarbonization pathways (e.g., UCG-IGCC-CCUS technology chain); and able to evaluate full lifecycle environmental impacts using carbon footprint calculation tools (e.g., Simapro/GaBi). Innovation and Practical Ability Through case studies (e.g., Apple’s carbon-neutral supply chain management, CATL’s zero-carbon factory), cultivate systematic thinking for solving complex engineering problems; master the application of blockchain technology in carbon data traceability and AI-driven carbon emission prediction and control strategies; able to write technical analysis reports (e.g., optimization schemes for campus energy system carbon neutrality pathways) and propose innovative solutions aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

default.zh: 本课程在融合多学科知识的基础上，重点介绍热能与动力装备智能测试技术的基本原理、方法及数字化应用，涵盖传统测试技术和现代智能化方法的结合。课程紧跟智能制造发展趋势，融入人工智能测试技术、数据驱动的物理场重构方法以及数字孪生等新型技术手段，力求理论联系实际，注重培养学生的工程实践能力和创新意识，为能源与动力工程专业的学生今后从事智能测试与数字化相关领域的工作打下坚实基础。具体如下： （1）掌握测量设计的基本知识，测量结果的数据处理及分析方法； （2）掌握相关测量仪表的基本原理与使用方法、主要参数的测试技术，包括温度、压力、流速等关键参数的测量方法； （3）了解人工智能在装备测试中的应用，掌握基于数据的物理场重构与预测方法； （4）掌握智能装备数字孪生的基本概念与构建方法，能够应用于装备状态监测与智能诊断； （5）增强实验动手能力、工程实践能力、数字化思维能力和创新意识。
default.en: This course integrates multidisciplinary knowledge to focus on the fundamental principles, methodologies, and digital applications of intelligent measurement technology for thermal and power equipment. It combines traditional measurement techniques with modern intelligent approaches, closely following the trends in smart manufacturing. The curriculum incorporates cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence-based testing, data-driven physical field reconstruction methods, and digital twin systems, emphasizing the integration of theory and practice. It aims to cultivate students' engineering practical skills and innovative thinking, laying a solid foundation for future careers in intelligent testing and digitalization within the energy and power engineering field. Specific objectives include: (1) Mastering the fundamental knowledge of measurement design, data processing, and analysis methods for measurement results; (2) Acquiring the principles and applications of measurement instruments, as well as key parameter testing techniques (e.g., temperature, pressure, flow velocity); (3) Understanding AI applications in equipment testing and mastering data-driven physical field reconstruction and prediction methods; (4) Grasping the core concepts and construction methods of digital twins for intelligent equipment, enabling their application in equipment state monitoring and intelligent diagnostics; (5) Enhancing hands-on experimental skills, engineering practical abilities, digital thinking, and innovative awareness.

default.zh: 能动类传热基础课程是热能与动力工程专业一门专业课，也可作为航天、机械、电子、化工类相关专业的选修课。课程的教学目的是使本科学生在学习了大学物理、工程流体力学、工程热力学等课程中热物理基本原理基础上，对热量传递这一普遍存在的物理现象有理性的认识，掌握热量传递的基本理论、基本定律及基本计算，扩大知识面，培养根据基本原理进行技术研发、创新的能力。课程教学以课堂讲授为主，辅之以适当的课堂讨论。通过资料搜集、分析整理、评判，培养学生主动获取知识能力；通过学生自主拟定设计题目、进行论证与初步设计训练，着重培养学生的实践能力。
default.en: The course of Fundamentals of Heat Transfer is a professional course for the major of thermal energy and power engineering. It can also be used as an elective course for related majors such as aerospace, machinery, electronics, and chemical engineering. The teaching goal of the course is to enable undergraduate students to have a rational understanding of the universal physical phenomenon of heat transfer on the basis of learning the basic principles of thermal physics in courses such as university physics, engineering fluid mechanics, and engineering thermodynamics, master the basic theories, basic laws, and basic calculations of heat transfer, expand their knowledge, and cultivate the ability to conduct technical research and innovation based on basic principles. The course teaching is mainly classroom lectures, supplemented by appropriate classroom discussions. Through data collection, analysis, collation, and evaluation, students' ability to actively acquire knowledge is cultivated; through students' independent formulation of design topics, demonstration and preliminary design training, students' practical ability is emphasized.

default.zh: 能动机械包括航空发动机、燃气轮机、汽轮机和火箭发动机等将化学能、内能转化为机械能的机械系统，广泛应用于航空动力、航天动力、舰船动力、发电和工业领域。能动机械工程设计是根据所学知识，开展各类能动机械结构和系统的设计工作，需要具备叶片、轮盘、转轴、轴承和齿轮传动等典型结构的工作原理、结构特征和设计方法基础知识。 本课程是选取能源动力专业第二学位本科生的专业课程之一。课程讲授能源动力领域机械组成、工作原理、结构特征和设计方法，主要内容包括叶片结构特征及强度振动分析、轮盘结构及强度振动分析、转轴结构及强度振动分析、轴承结构及选型、螺纹连接及分析、齿轮传动及分析等。通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解燃气轮机和汽轮机的工作原理，掌握叶片、轮盘、转轴等部件的设计方法，了解能动机械设计的研究进展和关键技术，培养学生根据运用基础知识和方法，开展能动机械零部件及整机结构设计的能力，为学生毕业设计及今后从事能动机械的设计、研发及运行打下基础。
default.en: Power machinery includes the mechanical systems as aircraft engines, gas turbines, steam turbines, and rocket engines, which convert chemical energy and internal energy into mechanical energy. Power machinery are widely applied in aviation power, aerospace power, ship power, power generation and industrial fields. The mechanical design of power machinery involves the design of various dynamic mechanical components and systems based on acquired knowledge. It requires a fundamental understanding of the working principles, structural characteristics, and design methods of typical components such as blades, disks, shafts, bearings, and gear transmissions. This course is one of the specialized courses for undergraduate students pursuing a second degree in Energy and Power engineering. This course covers the mechanical components, working principles, structural characteristics, and design methods of power machinery. The main content includes the structural characteristics and strength-vibration analysis of blades, the structure and strength-vibration analysis of disks, the structure and strength-vibration analysis of shafts, the structure and selection of bearings, threaded connections and their analysis, and gear transmission and its analysis. Through this course, students will gain an understanding of working principles of gas turbines and steam turbines, master the design methods of components such as blades, disks, and shafts, and learn about the research progress and key technologies in power machinery design. The course aims to develop students' ability to apply basic knowledge and methods to design components and overall structures of power machinery, laying a foundation for their graduation projects and future careers in the design, research and operation of dynamic machinery.

default.zh: “燃烧学”是能源与动力工程专业的主干技术基础课之一，是研究燃料化学能向热能转换规律的一门科学，主要涉及气、液、固等各种燃料在强烈放热反应，即燃烧反应过程中的流动、传热、传质和化学反应等相互作用规律。教学目的是使学生能够从理论上准确地认识燃烧现象，了解燃烧过程发生、发展的规律，掌握对燃烧过程进行理论分析的基本方法，以及对物理过程进行数学处理的基本方法，学会研究燃烧过程的一些基本实验方法，能够初步利用一些经典实验手段研究燃烧过程，并了解燃烧理论和燃烧研究方法的新发展，为学生进一步学习工业燃烧设备、发动机等装备类课程奠定基础。
default.en: Combustion B is one of the main technical basic courses in the field of energy and power engineering. It is a science that studies the conversion of fuel chemical energy to thermal energy. It mainly involves the interaction laws of flow, heat transfer, mass transfer, and chemical reactions of various fuels such as gas, liquid, and solid in strong exothermic reactions during combustion reactions. The teaching purpose is to enable students to accurately understand the phenomenon of combustion from a theoretical perspective, understand the laws of the occurrence and development of the combustion process, master the basic methods of theoretical analysis of the combustion process, as well as the basic methods of mathematical processing of physical processes, learn some basic experimental methods for studying the combustion process, and be able to preliminarily use some classic experimental methods to study the combustion process, and to understand the new developments in combustion theory and research methods, laying a foundation for students to further study equipment courses such as industrial combustion equipment and engines.

default.zh: The course of Fundamentals of thermal fluid in Nuclear Engineering mainly involves the theory and analysis of fluid mechanics in nuclear engineering and technology. The main content includes the following: basic concepts of fluid mechanics in nuclear engineering, properties of fluids, pressure and fluid statics, fluid kinematics, Bernoulli equation and energy equation, momentum analysis of flow systems, dimensional analysis and modeling, differential analysis of internal flow and fluid flow, approximate solutions to the Navier Stokes equation, drag and lift, compressible flow, and introduction to computational fluid mechanics. The course content covers typical examples of fluid mechanics in nuclear engineering and technology, as well as in industrial production and daily life. The course content includes both scientific and technological innovation concepts and project learning knowledge related to nuclear engineering and technology, as well as experimental skills related to fluid flow patterns, bubble motion, pool boiling, and basic laws of fluid motion in nuclear engineering and technology.
default.en: 核工程热流基础课程主要涉及核工程与核技术中的流体力学理论及分析。主要包括以下内容：核工程流体力学的基本概念，流体的性质，压强与流体静力学，流体运动学，伯努利方程与能量方程，流动系统的动量分析，量纲分析与模型化，内流，流体流动的微分分析，纳维-斯托克斯方程的近似解，阻力和升力，可压缩流动，计算流体力学导论。课程内容涉及核工程与核技术中以及工业生产及生活中流体力学的典型示例。课程内容同时包括核工程与核技术领域相关科技创新理念与项目学习知识，以及核工程与核技术中的流体流动形态、气泡运动、池沸腾等现象和流体运动基本规律的相关实验技能。

default.zh: 核反应堆热工水力学课程是核工程专业一门专业课，着重讲述了反应堆热工水力计算的基本模型和计算方法。课程需要掌握各种核反应堆结构材料的基本热物理性质；掌握核反应堆热工分析中涉及的堆芯释热、传热、流体力学等方面的基本知识和计算原理；掌握核反应堆稳态热工设计原理，了解单通道模型和子通道模型热工设计的步骤和计算方法；了解核反应堆瞬态热工水力分析中的基本模型和方法。课程的教学目的是使本科学生在学习了反应堆物理学、传热学、工程流体力学等课程中的核反应、流动、传热基本原理基础上，进一步了解、掌握对相关反应堆中热工分析的原理与计算方法，扩大知识面，培养根据基本原理进行技术研发、创新的能力。课程教学以课堂讲授为主，辅之以适当的课堂讨论。通过资料搜集、分析整理、评判，培养学生主动获取知识能力。通过课程学习实现以下三个目标：（1）牢固地掌握核反应堆中堆芯热量输运过程，深刻了解热量的来源及去处；（2）掌握反应堆内热输运的计算方法，了解压水堆热工分析计算的核心问题；（3）理解压水反应堆中热量传递涉及的基本原理和方法以及目前存在的主要问题的与解决方向，并增强工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力、创新意识。
default.en: The course is mainly concentrated on the theoretical models and calculation methods in the nuclear reactors. The basic thermal properties of materials used in the nuclear reactors are studied. The principal knowledge and calculation methods for heat transfer, fluid mechanism and releasing heat properties used in the analysis of thermodynamics and hydraulics of nuclear reactor are mustered. The thermodynamic and hydraulic methods at the steady state are understood. The single channel and sub-channel thermodynamic and hydraulic calculation methods and processes are performed. The basic theoretical models and calculation methods of instantaneous thermodynamic and hydraulic are performed. The purpose of the course is to make sure that the undergraduate study the basic principles of nuclear reaction、flow and heat transfer from the Reactor physics、Heat Transfer 、Engineering Fluid Mechanics and other courses, Further understand and master the principle and implementation scheme of thermal environment simulation in related numerical simulation technology, Expand the scope of knowledge and cultivate the ability of development and innovation based on the principle. Course teaching is mainly taught in class, supplemented by appropriate class discussion. By collecting and analyzing data can trained students acquire knowledge ability ;by topic designing、demonstrating and preliminary design training can cultivated students practical ability emphatically.These objectives can be achieved through this course: (1) Masting the heat transport process of nuclear reactor firmly and understanding the basic principles and main ways to improve the efficiency of heat transfer;(2) Grasping the calculation method of heat transport in the reactor and understanding the core problem of thermal analysis calculation of pressurized water reactor;(3) Understanding the basic principle and main technology of heat transfer in pressurized water reactor as well as the main problems existing at present, and enhance engineering practice ability, logical thinking ability and innovation consciousness.

default.zh: 本课程为专业基础必修课，主要讲述原子核物理的基本概念、基本性质和基本原理，并注重联系实际，适当介绍有关应用以及当代核物理发展的一些前沿领域。使学生能够掌握自然环境及核工程与核技术实践中存在的放射性现象及其基本原理；并了解现代核能利用，包括裂变与聚变的基本原理。为后续课程，包括反应堆物理分析、辐射防护、辐射探测学等打下良好理论基础。
default.en: This course is a compulsory basic course for the major. It mainly covers the fundamental concepts, properties and principles of nuclear physics, emphasizes practical relevance, and appropriately introduces relevant applications as well as several frontier areas of contemporary nuclear physics research. Upon completion of the course, students will master radioactive phenomena encountered in the natural environment and nuclear engineering & nuclear technology practices, together with their underlying principles. Students will also gain an understanding of modern nuclear energy utilization, including the basic principles of nuclear fission and fusion. This course lays a solid theoretical foundation for subsequent courses such as Reactor Physics Analysis, Radiation Protection, and Radiation Detection.

default.zh: 发动机控制原理主要面向飞行器动力工程专业的本科生，讲授典型发动机控制系统的基本知识，使学生了解发动机控制的基本问题和最新进展。课程的主要目标是使学生掌握发动机控制系统的专业知识，并能正确运用自动控制理论去解决各类型发动机的基本控制问题。作为飞行器动力工程专业的核心课程，本课程在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识和技能，并结合各类型发动机的运行特点，进行发动机控制方面的基本训练，着重培养学生对发动机系统方案的构建、系统动态特性分析、控制规律优化以及控制器设计方面的综合能力。本课程不仅为学生学习相关专业课程提供必要的基础知识，而且为学生毕业后从事飞行器动力方面的专业技术工作和科学研究打下必要的理论基础。
default.en: The PRINCIPLE of ENGINE CONTROL is mainly aimed at undergraduates majoring in aircraft power engineering. The basic knowledge of typical engine control system is provided to enable students to understand the basic problems and latest progress of engine control. The main objective of the course is to enable students to master the professional knowledge of engine control system and to correctly use automatic control theory to solve the basic control problems of various types of engines. As a core course of aircraft power engineering, this course comprehensively uses the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prior courses in the teaching process, and combines the operation characteristics of various types of engines to conduct basic training in engine control. This course focuses on training students' comprehensive ability in the construction of engine system scheme, system dynamic characteristics analysis, control law optimization and controller design. This course not only provides the necessary basic knowledge for students to learn the relevant professional courses, but also lays the necessary theoretical foundation for students to engage in the professional technical work and scientific research on aircraft power after graduation.

default.zh: 发动机在完成热力循环实现推力过程中，发动机结构受到离心载荷、气动载荷和热载荷等共同作用，具有复杂的静/动应力分布，易发生强度和振动问题，严重影响发动机整体的安全性、可靠性和寿命。目前，发动机强度与振动的计算分析是发动机设计、研制和运行维护的重要内容之一。随着发动机性能参数的不断提高，发动机结构面临的强度振动问题愈加突出，成为影响先进发动机技术成败的关键技术。 本课程是飞行器动力工程专业的核心专业基础课程之一，主要面向飞行器动力工程专业的本科生。课程讲授发动机强度与振动的理论知识和计算分析方法，主要内容包括叶片强度分析、轮盘强度分析、叶片振动理论基础及分析方法、转子动力学理论基础、整机振动特性及叶片和转子振动试验等。通过本课程的学习，使学生认识航空发动机结构面临的强度与振动问题，掌握发动机典型结构强度和振动的计算分析方法，了解该领域的最新研究进展和关键技术，培养学生根据发动机各组件的受力情况，应用所学的前续力学知识分析发动机主要部件强度与振动特性的能力，初步掌握发动机结构强度设计方法，为学生毕业设计及今后从事发动机的设计、实验及运行打下基础。
default.en: In the process of completing thermal cycle and generating thrust, the engine structure subjects to the centrifugal load, aerodynamic load and thermal load. It has a complex static / dynamic stress distribution, and is prone to have strength and vibration problems, which seriously affects the overall safety, reliability and life of the engine. At present, the calculation and analysis of engine strength and vibration is one of the important contents of engine design, research and maintenance. With the continuous improvement of engine performance, the problem of strength and vibration of engine structure is becoming more and more important, which has become the key technology affecting the success or failure of advanced engine technology. This course is one of the core fundamental courses of Aircraft Power Engineering, mainly for undergraduates majoring in Aircraft Power Engineering.
