The course teaches the theoretical knowledge and calculation methods of engine strength and vibration, including blade strength analysis, disc strength analysis, theoretical basis and analysis method of blade vibration, theoretical basis of rotor dynamics, vibration characteristics of the whole engine, experiments for blade and rotor vibration, etc. Through the study of this course, the students are able to know the problem of aero engine structure strength and vibration, master the calculation and analysis method of stress and vibration, understand the latest research progress and the key technology in this field, train students to apply the knowledge of strength and vibration, grasp the engine structure strength design method to graduate design and the future engine design, experiment and research.

default.zh: 飞行器动力装置是飞行器动力工程专业的专业课，重点阐述常规飞行器动力装置各组成部件的工作原理，基本热力循环理论及计算方法，部件的共同工作特性及控制规律，并对该研究领域的一些新技术、新概念的应用和发展加以简单介绍。通过上述知识的学习，使学生对飞行器动力装置的基本概念有清晰的理解，掌握其结构特征和主要工作指标，具有独立分析动力装置热力循环及其工作特性的能力。课程内容包括：绪论；飞行器动力装置性能指标和热力循环分析；航空燃气涡轮发动机设计点气动热力计算与分析；部件匹配和涡轮发动机特性；液体火箭发动机循环系统、涡轮泵和推进剂；固体火箭发动机。
default.en: The Flight Vehicle Power Plant is a specialized course for the flight vehicle power engineering specialty. It focuses on the working principle of each component of the conventional flight vehicle power plant, the basic thermal cycle theory and calculation method, the combined operational performance and control laws of the components, and briefly introduces the application and development of some new technologies and concepts in this research field. Through the study of the above knowledge, students can have a clear understanding of the basic concepts of flight vehicle power plant, master its structural features and main operational specifications, and have the ability to independently analyze the thermal cycle and working characteristics of power plant. The course content includes: introduction; performance specifications and thermal cycle analysis of flight vehicle power plant; aero-thermodynamic calculation and analysis of aero-engine at design point; component matching and turbine engine characteristics; liquid rocket engine circulation system, turbine pump and propellant; solid rocket engine.

default.zh: 本课程针对目前国际主流电推进装置，围绕电推力器的结构，工作原理以及适用范围来对电推进技术进行介绍，重点介绍电热式推力器、静电加速器以及电磁加速器。该课程对学生的基本要求是了解等离子体的概念及基本参数，掌握等离子体的微观运动与宏观描述，深刻了解霍尔漂移的本质；掌握电推进技术在航天领域中的应用，包括电热式、静电式和电磁式推力器的特点，各种电推进的工作原理及适用范围。明确磁场对推力器放电特性的影响规律，了解霍尔推力器的设计以及影响推力器寿命的关键问题，并通过实验探究霍尔推力器的磁安特性曲线和伏安特性曲线，加深对霍尔推力器的认识，提高实践能力和动手能力。通过本课程的学习，能够使学生对航天推进技术有一个较为深入的了解，不仅为学生学习有关等离子体物理和空间推进方面的专业课程提供必要的基础知识，而且为学生毕业后从事结构设计、发动机系统设计等方面的专业技术工作和科学研究工作打下必要的理论基础。在教学过程中结合本课程特点，注意培养学生的逻辑思维能力；着重培养学生对问题的判断、分析和解决能力。既保证了基本理论、内容和方法的教学需要，又反映了新技术、新发展的时代特色。
default.en: Aiming at the current international mainstream electric propulsion device and centering on the structure, working principle and application field of electric thrusters, the introduction of the electric propulsion technology will be given, and focus on the electrothermal thruster, Hall thruster, ion thruster and MPD. The basic requirements of the course to students are to know the concept and basic parameters of plasma, grasp the microscopic movement and macroscopic description of plasma, have a deep understanding of the nature of Hall drift; grasp the applications of the electric propulsion technology in the aerospace field, including the characteristics of electrothermal thruster, electrostatic thruster and electromagnetic thruster, and the working principle and application scope of various kinds of electric propulsion technology; specify the influence of magnetic field to the discharge characteristics of thruster, understand the design of Hall thruster and the key issues that influence the lifetime of thruster, and investigate the magnetism-ampere and the volt-ampere characteristics of Hall thruster through experiments, so as to deepen the understanding of Hall thruster and improve their practical ability. After the learning of this course, students will have a relatively better understanding of the aerospace propulsion technology, which will not only provides necessary knowledge for students to learn other specialized courses concerning plasma physics and space propulsion, but also establishes a solid theoretical foundation if they work on the technical work or scientific research work involving structural design, engine systematic design and so on. after graduation. In the teaching process, the characteristics of the course are considered, and more attention is paid to cultivating students’ logic thinking ability, judging ability, and the ability to analyzing and solving problems. It not only guarantees the teaching requests of basic theories, contents and methods, but also reflects the time features of new technologies and new development.

default.zh: 本课程作为核工程与核技术专业课，核心任务是通过对物理知识和工程实例的学习与分析，让学生掌握以托卡马克为代表的聚变反应堆的基本结构和工作原理，了解聚变装置的核心物理要素、工程技术难点以及聚变能源商业化利用的前景，激发学生对以核聚变为代表的未来能源系统的学习和研究兴趣，为其从事聚变工程及相关领域的工作打好基础。具体的教学目标包括：（1）了解核聚变研究的发展历程、掌握聚变反应的原理和基本判据；（2）掌握托卡马克装置的结构和工作原理，了解仿星器等其他磁约束聚变装置，以及惯性约束聚变装置；（3）掌握聚变等离子体的基本物理特性、了解等离子体的诊断监测技术；（4）了解约束磁场的设计思想，了解聚变相关的工程技术；（5）增强实验动手能力、工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力和创新意识。
default.en: As a major course of nuclear engineering and nuclear technology, the core task of this course is to enable students to master the basic structure and working principle of fusion reactor represented by Tokamak, understand the core physical elements of fusion device, difficulties in engineering technology and prospects of commercial utilization of fusion energy through the study and analysis of physics knowledge and engineering examples. Stimulate students' interest in the study and research of future energy systems represented by nuclear fusion, and lay a solid foundation for their work in fusion engineering and related fields. Specific teaching objectives include: (1) to understand the development process of nuclear fusion research and master the principles and basic criteria of fusion reaction; (2) Master the structure and working principle of Tokamak devices, and understand other magnetic confinement fusion devices such as star imitation devices, as well as inertial confinement fusion devices; (3) Master the basic physical characteristics of fusion plasma and understand the diagnostic and monitoring technology of plasma; (4) Understand the design idea of restrained magnetic field and the engineering technology related to fusion; (5) Enhance hands-on ability, engineering practice ability, logical thinking ability and innovation consciousness.

default.zh: 叶片机原理是飞行器动力工程专业的专业课，重点介绍和讲授航空及弹用发动机的主要气动部件—压气机的气动特性、工作原理、设计概要和非设计工况特性，并对该研究领域的一些新技术、新概念的应用和发展加以相应介绍。其主要任务是帮助学生建立起航空、弹用叶片机的基本概念，掌握对其结构特征和工作指标的判定和设计方法，使其具有完成航空及弹用发动机主要气动部件初步设计的能力。课程内容包括：绪论；叶片机中的气体流动的性质和控制方程；轴流压气机工作原理及设计基础；多级轴流压气机及其变工况特性；叶片机叶栅气动性能实验。
default.en: TURBOMACHINERY PRINCIPLE is one of the major courses for the undergraduate students in Aircraft Power Engineering, focusing on the aerodynamic characteristics, operating principles, performance at design and off-design conditions of the main components in the aero-engine or missile engine. The application and development of new techniques and new concepts involved in the aircraft power plants is also introduced to help the students understand the basic concepts of turbomachinery for the aero-engine or missile engine; have the ability to utilize the relevant knowledge to complete the initial design of the compressor and turbine in the aero-engine or missile engine. The contents of TURBOMACHINERY PRINCIPLE include Introduction; Basic Equations of Fluid Flow and Flow Characteristic in the Turbomachine; Principles of Axial Flow Compressor and its Design Method; Centrifugal Compressor; Multistage Axial Flow Compressor and its Off-Design Characteristics; Experiment on Aerodynamic Performance of the Cascade in Turbomachine.

default.zh: 本课程是储能科学与工程专业的一门专业课。通过对本课程学习，学生比较系统地学习储能原理的基础知识、基本工艺和一些应用实例，重点掌握能量转换和储存与利用、储热原理与技术、低温储热原理与技术、蓄冷原理与技术、化学储能原理与技术、气体水合物储能等原理。通过对课程的学习，学生能够掌握储能技术基本原理，利用有关的基础知识全面考虑和分析，独立解决工程实际问题。
default.en: This course is a specialized subject for the Energy Storage Science and Engineering major. Through this course, students will systematically learn the fundamental principles of energy storage, basic processes, and practical applications, with a focus on mastering energy conversion and utilization, thermal energy storage principles and technologies, low-temperature thermal energy storage principles and technologies, cold energy storage principles and technologies, chemical energy storage principles and technologies, and gas hydrate energy storage principles. By completing this course, students will be able to grasp the fundamental principles of energy storage technologies, utilize relevant foundational knowledge to comprehensively analyze and address practical engineering problems independently.

default.zh: 碳中和背景下，储能技术是提高电网灵活性及安全性、支撑可再生能源发展的关键技术之一。各类储能技术中，电化学储能是应用最广、最具发展潜力的储能技术。本课程面向储能领域，通过对多学科领域知识和进展的整合及梳理，引导学生在电化学储能技术的研究前沿开阔眼界，形成从基础知识到技术前沿的贯通性思维。 在基础知识方面，课程从电化学热力学、动力学以及典型电化学储能原理和技术等方面，通过数学、物理、化学、材料、能源等相关学科知识整合与交叉，引领学生理解电化学储能的科学原理和发展脉络，形成多学科整体知识体系。培养学生建立从基础知识到技术前沿的深化理解能力；培养学生理解、解决复杂问题的能力。 在问题导向方面，引导学生分析、总结目前电化学储能及电催化技术的发展现状和关键瓶颈，在此基础上针对典型技术，运用基本原理、文献调研等方法提出新想法，通过数学、计算模拟、实验测试等手段进行验证，培养学生使用相关工具进行问题分析、方案设计和研究的能力。 在研讨交流方面，针对典型电化学储能技术，在基本原理的讲授基础上，重点通过分组研讨式教学引领学生围绕感兴趣的主题收集资料、开阔眼界、提出想法。激发学生的学习兴趣，培养学生的自主学习与终生学习能力。
default.en: Under the background of carbon neutrality, energy storage technology is one of the key technologies for enhancing grid flexibility and security while supporting renewable energy development. Among various energy storage technologies, electrochemical energy storage stands out as the most widely applied and promising approach. This course focuses on the energy storage field, integrating multidisciplinary knowledge and advancements to broaden students' perspectives on cutting-edge electrochemical energy storage research and cultivate holistic thinking from fundamental principles to technological frontiers. In terms of foundational knowledge, the course integrates mathematics, physics, chemistry, materials science, and energy-related disciplines through electrochemical thermodynamics, kinetics, and the principles and technologies of typical electrochemical energy storage systems. It guides students to comprehend the scientific principles and developmental trajectory of electrochemical energy storage, establishing a holistic multidisciplinary knowledge framework. The course cultivates students' ability to develop a deepened understanding from foundational knowledge to technological frontiers, as well as their capacity to comprehend and resolve complex challenges. Adopting a problem-oriented approach, the course guides students to analyze and summarize the current status and critical bottlenecks in electrochemical energy storage and electrocatalytic technologies. Building on this foundation, students employ fundamental principles and literature research to propose novel ideas for representative technologies, subsequently validating them through mathematical modeling, computational simulations, and experimental testing. This cultivates students' ability to utilize relevant tools for problem analysis, solution design, and research execution. Regarding interactive development, the course employs group discussion-based teaching centered on typical electrochemical energy storage technologies. Beyond instructing fundamental principles, it emphasizes guiding students to collect resources, broaden perspectives, and generate innovative ideas around topics of interest. This methodology stimulates students' learning motivation while cultivating their capacity for autonomous and lifelong learning.

default.zh: 压缩空气储能是目前较为成熟的大规模储能技术之一，而其中的可压缩气体动力学是其中的关键基础，本课程的目的是使学生熟悉和掌握用于储能的压缩气体动力学基本知识，有别于常规气体动力学，本课程更注重储能中气体动力学的使用背景。通过对课程的学习，引导学生用气体动力学基本知识，快速分析压缩空气储能关键参数变化规律，掌握压缩气体动力学可压流动、超声速流动等特性，具备根据实际需要进行全面考虑和分析，具备用于压缩空气储能技术的气体动力学基本知识。 课程培养目标如下： 1、知识获取方面：通过对储能气体动力学的学习，储能中可压缩气体动力学的原理和方法，培养学生应用数学、自然科学和工程科学的基本原理，掌握扎实的理论和实践知识； 2、能力培养方面：通过学习储能气体动力学，掌握对储能气体动力学的分析方法，培养学生结合数据获得有效结论的问题分析能力，基于科学原理并采用科学方法对复杂工程问题进行研究的能力； 3、综合素养方面：培养学生使用现代工具对复杂工程问题进行预测和模拟的能力，针对国家双碳战略需求培养爱国情怀和人文素质，强化课程思政，培养团队协作精神、拓展视野。
default.en: Compressed air energy storage is currently one of the more mature large-scale energy storage technologies, and compressible gas dynamics is its key foundation. The aim of this course is to help students become familiar with and master the fundamental knowledge of compressible gas dynamics for energy storage. Unlike conventional gas dynamics, this course places greater emphasis on the application context of gas dynamics within energy storage. Through the study of this course, students will be guided to use the basic principles of gas dynamics to quickly analyze the variation patterns of key parameters in compressed air energy storage, master characteristics such as compressible flow and supersonic flow in compressible gas dynamics, and develop the ability to consider and analyze comprehensively according to practical needs, thereby acquiring the foundational gas dynamics knowledge required for compressed air energy storage technology. Course training objectives are as follows: Knowledge acquisition: Through studying gas dynamics for energy storage—namely the principles and methods of compressible gas dynamics in the context of energy storage—cultivate students’ ability to apply fundamental principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering science, and enable them to master solid theoretical and practical knowledge. Ability development: By learning energy storage gas dynamics, master analytical methods for energy storage gas dynamics; cultivate students’ ability to analyze problems and, by integrating data, draw valid conclusions; and develop the capability to research complex engineering problems grounded in scientific principles and employing scientific methods. Comprehensive qualities: Cultivate students’ ability to use modern tools to predict and simulate complex engineering problems; in response to the national dual？carbon strategy (carbon peaking and carbon neutrality), foster patriotism and humanistic qualities; strengthen the integration of ideological education into the curriculum; and cultivate team collaboration while broadening horizons.

default.zh: 燃烧及热化学转化，是利用碳氢基燃料的主要技术途径，在碳中和能源体系中占有重要地位。本课程讲授燃烧及热化学转化过程的物质平衡和热平衡，气体燃料、液体燃料、固体燃料的燃烧，固体燃料和废弃物的热解气化等相关技术与设备的原理、设计、运行；介绍碳氢燃料利用的“原料-处理-反应-产物-利用”全链条热转化体系，为能源与动力工程专业学生奠定良好的科学理论和工程应用基础。
default.en: Combustion and thermochemical conversion are the main technological pathways for utilizing hydrocarbon based fuels and play an important role in carbon neutral energy systems. This course teaches the principles, design, and operation of materials and heat balance in combustion and thermochemical conversion processes, combustion of gas fuels, liquid fuels, solid fuels, pyrolysis and gasification of solid fuels and waste, and related technologies and equipment. It introduces the full chain thermal conversion system of "raw material treatment reaction product utilization" for the utilization of hydrocarbon fuels, laying a solid scientific theory and engineering application foundation for students majoring in energy and power engineering.

default.zh: 本课程是面向能源与动力专业碳中和能源技术与热科学方向的本科生专业必修课。热能是人类使用最为广泛的一种能量形式，有85~90%的能源是转换成热能后加以利用。热能转换装置是利用化学能、核能、太阳能转换的热能加热工质到一定参数的装置。课程的主要目标是使学生掌握热能转换装置的结构及热力计算过程，并能正确运用于对热能转换装置的设计。在教学中综合利用先修课程中所学的有关知识及技能，结合课堂讨论、实验课教学，进行能源与动力工程技术人员所需的基本训练，着重培养学生在热能转换装置方面的设计、计算和综合运用知识进行分析的能力；着重培养学生的创新精神和实践能力。具体培养目标：（1）牢固掌握化学能-热能转换装置（锅炉）燃烧室结构及热力计算，气-汽、气-水、气-气、汽-水、汽汽换热器结构及其热力计算；牢固地掌握化学能-热能转换装置（锅炉）的基本工作原理、结构和基本计算方法，熟练地运用所学公式和图表进行结构设计、热力计算。（2）掌握化学能-热能转换装置（锅炉）运行的热力特性及其调节方法、燃烧烟气对换热器工作的影响，并能综合运用分析。（3）深刻了解核能-热能转换装置、太阳能-热能转换装置系统，掌握其关键设备的结构及设计计算。（4）掌握化学能-热能转换装置（锅炉）热平衡实验方法，增强实验动手能力。（5）锻炼工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力、创新意识、节能环保意识和一定的科研能力。本课程为学生进一步学习其他专业课程和日后从事热能转换装置的设计、安装、运行及相关技术管理工作打下基础。
default.en: Devices of Thermal Energy Conversion is a compulsory professional subject for undergraduate students majoring in Carbon Neutrality Energy Technology and Thermal Science. Thermal energy is one of the most widely used energy forms of humans, and about 85 to 90% of the energy is converted into heat to be used. Thermal energy conversion devices could heat the working fluid to a specific parameter using chemical, nuclear, or solar energy. The course's primary objective is to enable students to master the structure of thermal energy conversion devices and the thermal calculation process and to correctly apply the knowledge gained to the design process of thermal energy conversion devices. In this course, we comprehensively use the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the previous courses, combined with classroom discussions and experimental teaching, to carry out the basic training required by energy and power engineering technicians. This course focuses on cultivating students' ability to design, calculate and analyze the comprehensive application of knowledge in thermal energy conversion devices and cultivating students' innovative spirit and practical ability. Specific training goals: (1) Solid grasp of chemical energy - heat energy conversion device (boiler) combustion chamber structure and thermal calculations, gas - steam, gas - water, gas - gas, steam - water, steam heat exchanger structure and its thermal calculations. Students need to grasp the basic working principle, structure solidly, and basic calculation methods of chemical-thermal energy conversion devices (boilers) and skillfully use the formulas and diagrams for structural design and thermal calculations. (2) To master the thermal characteristics of the operation of chemical-thermal energy conversion units (boilers) and their regulation methods, the influence of combustion flue gases on the work of heat exchangers, and to analyze them comprehensively. (3) Deep understanding of nuclear-thermal energy conversion device and solar-thermal energy conversion device system, and master the structure and design calculation of crucial equipment. (4) To master the experimental method of the heat balance of chemical-thermal energy conversion device (boiler) and enhance the experimental skills. (5) Students will be able to exercise their practical engineering skills, logical thinking, innovation consciousness, energy saving, environmental protection consciousness, and scientific research ability. And through the basic training offered by the course, the students could obtain solid prerequisites for further learning of professional courses and further working on thermal energy conversion devices, fixing, operation and administration.

default.zh: 热控制原理是能源科学与工程学院能源动力类专业碳中和能源与热科学模块的一门专业核心课，也可作为能源学院其他专业以及航天、机械、电子、化工、材料类相关专业的选修课。 热控制是对热量的产生、传递、转化、储存各环节进行全链路控制，包含着强化换热、削弱换热、温度控制、热量管理以及热分析、热设计等内容。因此，热控制原理在能源的高效转换和利用过程中起重要的理论支撑，也是解决芯片、空天飞行器等国之重器研制过程中所面临极端热问题的基本理论依据。 本课程的目的是使学生深入认识、掌握传热学理论，并结合控制理论解决空天飞行器研制过程中面临的热问题，兼顾提高新型/智慧型能源利用与转换效率。培养学生将理论知识与工程实际相结合的能力，在强化学生理论知识学习的深度和广度基础上，拓展本科生的工程应用视野，围绕国之重器研制中面临的传热“卡脖子”问题，使学生认识到热控制原理的内涵，提升学生发现问题、尝试解决问题的能力。通过对空天飞行器热控制的系统论述、技术需求与现状、环境条件约束、原理机制、分析方法、设计原则及典型案例等环节的讲授与探讨，启发学生根据基本原理进行技术研发与技术创新的能力，并实现热控领域的全链条培养。开展智能热控学习，为学生未来创新发展打基础，激发学生的学习兴趣以及科学的敏锐性和前瞻性。结合实验训练，锻炼学生的动手能力，并对热量的产生、传递、调控及效果有更为直观和深入的理解。通过课程设计，引导学生对所学知识进行综合应用，经历自主设计题目、搜集-分析-整理资料、论证与初步设计、课堂表达与陈述，锻炼学生自主学习、团队科研以及表达能力。
default.en: Thermal Control principle is a professional core course in the Carbon Neutral Energy and Thermal Science Module, which belongs to the major of the school of energy science and engineering. It can also be used as an elective course for the other majors in the school of energy and related majors in aerospace, machinery, electronics, chemical industry and materials. The purpose of this course is to enable students to deeply understand and master the theory of heat transfer, and to solve the engineering thermal problems faced during the development of aerospace vehicles. In combination with control theory, the energy utilization and conversion efficiency will be improved. This course will cultivate the students’ ability to combine theoretical knowledge with engineering practice, strengthen the depth of students’ theoretical knowledge learning and expand the engineering application vision of undergraduates. Through the teaching and discussion of the system structure, technical requirements, current situation, environmental condition constraints, principle mechanism, analysis method, design principle and typical cases of aerospace vehicle thermal control, students are inspired to improve theory and technique, and then realize the whole chain training in the field of thermal control. Carrying out the intelligent thermal control learning, the student will realize the future innovation and development and stimulate the interest in learning and scientific sensitivity and forward-looking. Combined with experimental training, the student’s practical ability is training, and have a more intuitive and in-depth understanding of the generation, transmission, regulation and effect of the heat. By the section of curriculum design, students are guided to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned. They experience independent design topics, collection-analysis-arrangement of data, demonstration and preliminary design, classroom expression and presentation, and exercise students' independent learning, team scientific research and expression ability.

default.zh: 课程的教学目的是使本科学生在学习了大学物理、工程流体力学、传热学、工程热力学等课程基础上，掌握能源动力领域中，用于燃烧火焰、高温热化学、高温热设备、热环境控制等过程的常用热参数（温度、热流、物性参数、宽光谱辐射能量等信息）的测量原理和方法，掌握传感器的工作原理、性能、误差传递理论、信号转换过程等，在此基础上掌握基于不同原理及器件的针对不同对象的热信息感知技术；了解常见的智慧能源动力领域温度/速度/浓度等热物理量场测量感知和反演重构原理和流程；进行热物理参数/热信息测量系统设计训练，了解新时代下智慧能源领域的热信息感知技术前沿、发展动态。
default.en: The teaching objectives of this course are to enable undergraduate students, after studying courses such as University Physics, Engineering Fluid Mechanics, Heat Transfer, and Engineering Thermodynamics, to master the measurement principles and methods of commonly used thermal parameters (such as temperature, heat flux, physical property parameters, wide-spectrum radiant energy, etc.) in processes like combustion flames, high-temperature thermochemistry, high-temperature heat equipment, and thermal environment control in the field of energy and power. Students should acquire a good understanding of the working principles, performance, error propagation theory, and signal conversion processes of sensors. Based on this foundation, they are expected to master thermal information perception technologies for different objects based on various principles and devices. Moreover, students should be familiar with the measurement, perception, and inversion reconstruction principles and procedures of common thermal physical quantity fields such as temperature, velocity, and concentration in the field of smart energy and power. They will also undergo training in the design of thermal physical parameter/thermal information measurement systems and gain an understanding of the frontiers and development trends of thermal information perception technologies in the smart energy field in the new era.

default.zh: 《流体机械原理及设计》主要阐述流体机械（水泵、水轮机）的工作原理及设计方法。着重讲解叶片式流体机械的基本性能与特性曲线、能量传递或转换过程、能量方程、能量转换过程中的损失、叶片式流体机械的中的相似理论、水力机械的空化与空蚀的机理以及叶片式流体机械基本结构型式与选型。它是能源科学与工程专业的一门必修专业课，是从事流体机械研究的基础。
default.en: Principle and Design of Fluid Machinery mainly describes the working principle and design method of fluid machinery (pump, and hydraulic turbine). It focuses on the basic performance and characteristic curve, energy transfer or conversion process, energy equation, loss in energy conversion process, similarity theory, cavitation mechanism, and basic structural type and selection of blade type fluid machinery. It is a required professional course for energy science and engineering majors, which is the basis for a further study on fluid machinery.

default.zh: 流体传动及控制系统是本专业学生的一门必修专业课，面向世界科技前沿、面向国家重大需求、面向能源与动力工程系统领域，主要研究各流体传动元件及系统的工作原理、结构特点和基本设计计算方法，目的是使学生能够根据实际需要正确地进行选型设计及水力设计。学习本课程要求学生掌握液压传动的基本特点及主要液压元件的结构、传动系统、控制系统的工作原理及设计方法，掌握液力作为传动装置的典型结构和应用，为今后从事流体机械的应用及设计工作打下理论基础。使学生掌握以下几方面能力，即课程目标如下 （1）掌握流体传动元件的分类，工作原理，结构功用； （2）掌握流体传动系统的工作原理，特点及主要回路的特性分析，典型传动系统的分析方法； （3）基本掌握流体传动控制系统的基本理论及应用； （4）掌握传动元件的测试与系统调试，了解传动控制系统的调试方法及其特点； （5）增强基本知识和理论的应用能力、逻辑思维能力和创新意识； （6）培养具有优良品德、执着信念和社会责任感，具备多维知识结构、创新思维和国际视野，具备组织协调和解决复杂工程问题能力，在能源动力及相关领域引领未来发展的杰出人才。
default.en: Hydraulic Transmission and Control System is a compulsory professional course for students in this major. It is aimed at the forefront of world technology, major national needs, and the field of energy and power engineering systems. The main research focuses on the working principles, structural characteristics, and basic design calculation methods of various fluid transmission components and systems, with the aim of enabling students to correctly select and design hydraulic systems according to actual needs. This course requires students to master the basic characteristics of hydraulic transmission, the structure of main hydraulic components, the working principles and design methods of transmission systems and control systems, and to master the typical structure and application of hydraulic transmission devices, laying a theoretical foundation for future work in the application and design of fluid machinery. Enable students to master the following abilities, namely the course objectives are as follows (1) Master the classification, working principle, structural function of fluid transmission components; (2) Master the working principle, characteristics, and analysis of the main circuit characteristics of fluid transmission systems, as well as the analysis methods of typical transmission systems; (3) Have a basic understanding of the basic theories and applications of fluid transmission control systems; (4) Master the testing and system debugging of transmission components, understand the debugging methods and characteristics of transmission control systems; (5) Enhance the application ability, logical thinking ability, and innovative consciousness of basic knowledge and theory; (6) To cultivate outstanding talents with excellent moral character, persistent beliefs, and a sense of social responsibility, possessing a multidimensional knowledge structure, innovative thinking, and international perspective, possessing the ability to organize, coordinate, and solve complex engineering problems, and leading future development in the fields of energy and power.

default.zh: 本课程的教学目标是，面向能源与动力工程专业智能动力及自动化模块的本科生，讲授燃气轮机动力系统及其各组成部件的基本知识及工作原理，使学生了解燃气轮机动力的各组成部件及其工作原理；掌握燃气轮机动力循环理论及其轴功率计算方法；重点了解燃气涡轮动力系统燃烧系统的结构与燃烧的组织；会对燃气轮机动力系统的变工况性能进行分析。 本课程的教学要求是：首先要讲清燃气涡轮动力系统的主要结构和发展简史以及进一步发展所要面临的主要问题，使学生对燃气涡轮动力系统发展现状有一定的了解。在此基础上，介绍燃气涡轮动力系统的基本循环理论，使学生达到独立地对采用不同循环方式的燃气涡轮动力系统的循环进行分析的目的，熟练地在温—熵图上画出循环过程，并根据循环过程进行各部件进出口处的热力计算。本课程重点介绍燃气涡轮动力系统燃烧室这一部件的结构与作用和基本的燃烧理论，使学生了解使燃烧稳定的措施。最后要求重点介绍燃气涡轮动力系统的变工况性能，根据各部件的变工况性能对不同形式的燃气涡轮动力系统轴组合方案进行分析，使学生了解各种组合方式燃气涡轮动力系统的适应条件。通过本门课程的学习，使学生对燃气涡轮动力系统具有一定程度的了解，为毕业设计和将来的工作打下基础。 本课程主要面向能源与动力工程专业的学生，要求学生学过《工程热力学》、《气体动力学》等课程的基本内容。本课程的地位和作用：现代热能动力工业的发展迫切依赖于燃气涡轮发动机的不断改进，因此掌握燃气涡轮动力原理对于有志于在该领域工作的人才是至关重要的。
default.en: The teaching objective of this course is to teach the basic knowledge and working principle of gas turbine power system and its components to undergraduates majoring in intelligent power and automation module of energy and power engineering, so that students can understand the components and working principle of gas turbine power; Master the gas turbine power cycle theory and shaft power calculation method; Focus on the combustion system structure and combustion organization of gas turbine power system; The variable operating performance of gas turbine power system will be analyzed. The teaching requirements of this course are as follows: First, the main structure and brief history of development of gas turbine power system as well as the main problems to be faced for further development should be explained clearly, so that students can have a certain understanding of the development status of gas turbine power system. On this basis, the basic cycle theory of gas turbine power system is introduced, so that students can independently analyze the cycle of gas turbine power system with different cycle modes, skillfully draw the cycle process on the temperature-entropy diagram, and perform thermal calculation at the inlet and outlet of each component according to the cycle process. This course focuses on the structure and function of the combustion chamber of the gas turbine power system and the basic combustion theory, so that students can understand the measures to make the combustion stable. Finally, it is required to focus on the variable working condition performance of the gas turbine power system, and analyze the shaft combination schemes of different forms of gas turbine power system according to the variable working condition performance of each component, so that students can understand the adaptation conditions of various combined gas turbine power systems. Through the study of this course, students will have a certain understanding of gas turbine power system, which will lay a foundation for graduation design and future work. This course is mainly for students majoring in energy and power engineering. Students are required to have learned the basic content of Engineering Thermodynamics, Gas Dynamics and other courses. Status and role of this course: The development of the modern thermal power industry urgently depends on the continuous improvement of the gas turbine engine, so mastering the principles of the gas turbine is essential for those who are interested in working in this field.

default.zh: 该课程是热力发动机专业方向的学位课。主要面向热力发动机专业的本科生，讲解燃气轮机结构强度与振动的基本知识，使学生了解热力发动机及其它动力机械在工程中存在的强度与振动问题以及最新的研究进展，在该课程中，主要讲解：结构强度分析及计算在发动机设计中的地位，它与其它课程之间的关系，目前在这一领域的主要研究方法；叶片的受力分析和计算；叶根及轮缘的强度计算方法；叶片的高温蠕变分析及计算；叶片的静强度校核；叶片振动的激振力产生的原因及特性分析；叶片振动形式分析；等截面叶片自振频率的计算方法；能量法计算叶片的固有频率；成组叶片的振动特性计算；叶片的动应力分析；叶片动强度校核；旋转薄圆环的应力计算；叶轮应力计算的基本计算公式；等厚度叶轮应力计算；转子振动的基本概念；单盘转子振动特性分析；等直径转子的振动特性；转子动平衡理论及应用。通过对该门课程的学习，使学生掌握透平机械主要部件强度与振动特性计算方法，培养学生分析和解决发动机强度与振动方面问题的能力。同时使学生具有透平机械强度与振动领域的计算机辅助设计和应用计算机进行数据处理及分析的能力，理解所学知识对于社会经济发展的影响。
default.en: Power Machinery Intensity and Vibration is a professional course offered by the Department of Thermal Engine. The course is mainly for the Thermal engine of the undergraduates, explain the basic knowledge of the strength and vibration of turbomachinery structure, and to make students to understand the strength and vibration problems in engineering of heat engine and other power machinery. The course mainly introduces the structural strength analysis and calculation in the engine design position, and its relationship with other courses. At present, the main research methods in this field are presented: the blade stress analysis and calculation; calculation method of blade root and rim strength; high temperature creep analysis and calculation of leaf blade; static strength check; causes and characteristics analysis of the vibration force generated by the blade vibration analysis; vibration analysis of blade; method of calculating natural frequency of uniform section blade; vibration analysis of group blades; dynamic stress analysis of blade; dynamic strength check of blade; stress calculation of rotating thin circle ring; basic calculation formula of impeller stress calculation; calculation of equal thickness impeller stress; the basic concept of rotor vibration; vibration characteristic analysis of single disk rotor; vibration characteristics of equal diameter rotor; rotor dynamic balancing theory and application. Through learning the course, the students will have a good command of methods in intensity computation of main engine components and vibration characteristics, and also improve their abilities of analyzing and solving problems in both engine intensity and vibration aspects. At the same time, students have the ability of designing by computer and application of computer data processing and analysis in the field of turbine mechanical strength and vibration, and understand the influence of knowledge on social and economic development.

default.zh: “储能系统控制技术”的学科属性是电力系统、能源动力及信息学科的交叉学科，是储能、新能源科学与工程、能源互联网等相关学科的重要选修课之一，具有较广的使用范围，本课程面向大学三年级以上的学生，设置在学生了解基础电工学、热力学、自动控制等知识的基础上。 课程目的是以新能源电力系统调峰、调频、备用、黑启动、需求响应支撑等多容量、多尺度、多层次调节需求及分析为出发点，首先讲授风、光新能源高比例接入电网场景下发电波动不确定性量化分析及建模技术与方法；然后重点展开介绍抽水储能、压缩空气储能、熔盐储热、电化学储能、飞轮储能、超级电容储能等各种典型容量型和功率型新型储能系统的模型、动态调节特性以及运行控制规律；最后面向新能源电力系统，讲授储能系统的集成优化调度、储能系统与新能源电力系统的智能协同运行控制等，使学生全面掌握储能系统控制相关原理和技术。 课程任务是通过本课程学习，使学生了解和掌握双碳能源转型新能源电力系统背景下储能系统控制的需求、原理、核心技术、产业现状以及发展脉络，为学生毕业后从事储能系统控制提供相关专业技术和科学研究工作打下必要的基础。
default.en: "Energy Storage System Control Technology" is an interdisciplinary field of power systems, energy dynamics, and information science. It is one of the important elective courses in related disciplines such as energy storage, new energy science and engineering, and energy internet, with a wide range of applications. This course is aimed at students in third year or above, and is designed based on their understanding of basic knowledge of electrical engineering, thermodynamics, and automatic control. Course purpose: The purpose of the course is to start from the analysis of multi capacity, multi-scale, and multi-level demand regulation in the new energy power system, such as peak shaving, frequency regulation, backup, black start, and demand response support. Firstly, it will teach the quantitative analysis and modeling techniques and methods of power generation fluctuation uncertainty in the scenario of wind and solar new energy being highly integrated into the power grid; Then, the focus is on introducing the models, dynamic adjustment characteristics, and operational control laws of various typical capacity and power type new energy storage systems, such as pumped energy storage, compressed air energy storage, molten salt heat storage, electrochemical energy storage, flywheel energy storage, supercapacitor energy storage, etc; Finally, for the new energy power system, lectures will be given on the integrated optimization and scheduling of energy storage systems, as well as the intelligent collaborative operation and control of energy storage systems and new energy power systems, so that students can comprehensively grasp the relevant principles and technologies of energy storage system control. Course Tasks: The course task is to enable students to understand and master the requirements, principles, core technologies, industry status, and development context of energy storage system control in the context of dual carbon energy transformation into new energy power systems through the study of this course. This will lay a necessary foundation for students to engage in relevant professional technology and scientific research work in energy storage system control after graduation.

default.zh: 储能原理I课程主要涉及储能科学与工程中的储能原理与技术的基础知识、基本工艺和一些应用实例。主要包括以下内容：能量转换和储存与利用、储热原理与技术、低温储热原理与技术、冰蓄冷原理与技术、化学储能原理与技术、气体水合物储能等原理。课程内容涉及储能科学与工程中的储能原理与技术的典型示例。课程内容同时包括储能科学与工程领域相关科技创新理念与知识，以及储能科学与工程中的相变储热、电化学储能、气体水合物储能等涉及的现象和相关实验技能。
default.en: The course of Energy Storage Theory I mainly involves the basic knowledge, basic processes, and some application examples of energy storage principles in energy storage science and engineering. This mainly includes the following contents: energy storage concept and basic knowledge, thermal storage principles and technologies, low-grade thermal energy storage, ice storage air conditioning technology, chemical energy storage, gas hydrate energy storage, and other principles. The course content covers typical examples of energy storage principles and technologies in energy storage science and engineering. The course content includes technological innovation concepts and knowledge related to energy storage science and engineering, as well as phenomena and related experimental skills related to phase change heat storage, electrochemical energy storage, gas hydrate energy storage, etc. in energy storage science and engineering.

default.zh: “储能原理II”是新能源科学与工程、新能源材料与器件、材料物理等学科必修的一门专业基础课，也是凝聚态物理、材料学以及物理化学等相关学科的重要选修课之一，具有较广的使用范围；本课程面向大学三年级以上的学生，设置在学生了解基础材料科学基础及分析方法与物理化学知识的基础上。 课程目的：使学生了解世界和中国储能的发展现状，使学生比较地系统学习储能原理与技术的基础知识、基本工艺和一些应用实例，重点掌握掌握能量转换储存与利用、储热原理与技术、相变材料与相变储能技术、抽水储能、压缩空气储能、液态空气储能、飞轮储能、电容超级电容储能、超导储能等的发展历史、工作原理、设计、测试技术、安全性、经济性等，了解储能技术在电力系统、核电系统、风力和光伏发电系统、太阳能热发电系统、工业余热回收、交通运输系统等行业中的应用。 课程任务：使学生获得有关储能的基本理论和基本知识；掌握储能技术的开发与利用，使学生获得较全面的储能技术知识；为下一步在一定指导下完成本科毕业设计，及独立开展电池等储能技术的相关研究打下基础。
default.en: "Principles of Energy Storage II" is a compulsory basic course in new energy science and engineering, new energy materials and devices, materials physics and other disciplines, and is also one of the important elective courses in condensed matter physics, materials science, physical chemistry and other related disciplines, with a wide range of applications. This course is designed for students in the third year of university and above, and is based on students' understanding of the fundamentals of basic materials science, analytical methods and physical chemistry. Course purpose: to enable students to understand the development status of energy storage in the world and China, to enable students to systematically learn the basic knowledge, basic technology and some application examples of energy storage principles and technologies, focusing on mastering the development history, working principle, design, testing technology, safety, economy, etc. Learn about the application of energy storage technology in power systems, nuclear power systems, wind and photovoltaic power generation systems, solar thermal power generation systems, industrial waste heat recovery, transportation systems, and other industries. Course Tasks: To enable students to acquire basic theories and basic knowledge about energy storage; Master the development and utilization of energy storage technology, so that students can obtain a more comprehensive knowledge of energy storage technology; In the next step, it will lay the foundation for completing the undergraduate graduation project under certain guidance and independently carrying out relevant research on energy storage technologies such as batteries.

default.zh: 储热储冷技术是储能科学与工程、新能源科学与工程专业的重要组成部分。使学生了解世界和中国储热储冷的发展现状。使学生比较系统学习储热储冷技术的基础知识、基本装备和一些应用实例。重点掌握能量转换储存与利用、储热技术、相变储热技术、热化学储热技术、储冷技术。以及掌握相关的发展历史、工作原理、基本特点、分类、储热材料、装备设计与制造、测试技术、安全性等。为学生未来从事储热储冷等相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下基础。
default.en: Heat and cold storage technology is an important component of energy storage science and engineering and new energy science and engineering. To enable students to understand the development status of heat and cold storage in the world and China. Enable students to systematically learn the basic knowledge, basic equipment, and some application examples of heat and cold storage technology. Focus on mastering energy conversion storage and utilization, heat storage technology, phase change heat storage technology, thermochemical heat storage technology, and cold storage technology. And master the relevant development history, working principles, basic characteristics, classification, heat storage materials, equipment design and manufacturing, testing technology, safety, etc. It lays a foundation for students to engage in future study, research, and development in related technical fields such as heat and cold storage.

default.zh: 《新能源系统基础》是一门必（选）修课，用于培养新能源方向学生的专业知识，本课程以能的梯级利用及冷热电转换原理为主，讲授新能源与再生能源体系、分布式冷热电系统集成及利用技术、制冷与热泵（制冷剂、蒸汽压缩式、吸收式、热电制冷（热泵），斯特林循环，ORC循环）、太阳能光热利用及光伏利用技术、氢能与燃料电池技术等。通过本课程的学习使学生了解太阳能、浅层地能、空气能等的冷热电转换利用技术，为从事新能源领域的可再生能源、分布式能源、冷热电联产系统的设计及研发打下基础。
default.en: "Fundamentals of New Energy System" is a required (optional) course for cultivating the professional knowledge of students in the direction of renewable energy. This course focuses on the cascade utilization of energy and the principle of cold, hot, and electricity conversion. It teaches new energy and renewable energy systems, distributed cold, hot, and electricity system integration and utilization technology, refrigeration and heat pump (refrigerant, steam compression, absorption, thermoelectric refrigeration (heat pump), refrigeration and heat pump, Stirling cycle, ORC cycle), solar thermal utilization and photovoltaic utilization technology, hydrogen energy and fuel cell technology. Through the study of this course, students can understand the cold, heat, and electricity conversion and utilization technology of solar energy, shallow ground energy, air energy, etc., and lay a foundation for the design and development of renewable energy, distributed energy, cold, heat and electricity cogeneration system in the field of new energy.

default.zh: 本课程为核工程与核技术专业本科生基础必修课。 本门课程主要讲述原子核物理的基本概念、基本性质和基本原理，包括原子核的组成及性质，放射性衰变基本规律，α衰变、β衰变、γ衰变的基本原理，原子核反应及中子物理等。课程还将适当介绍有关放射性应用以及当代核物理发展的一些前沿领域。 通过本门课程的学习，学生能够掌握自然环境及核工程实践中存在的放射性现象及其基本原理；并了解现代核能利用，包括裂变与聚变的基本原理。 本门课程的学习将为后续课程，包括核反应堆物理分析、辐射防护、辐射探测学等打下良好的理论基础。
default.en: This course is a basic compulsory course for undergraduates majoring in nuclear engineering and technology. This course mainly tells the basic concepts, properties and principles of atomic nuclear physics, including the composition and properties of atomic nucleus, the basic laws of radioactive decay, the basic principles of α decay, β decay and γ decay, nuclear reactions and neutron physics. The course will also appropriately introduce some frontier fields related to radioactive applications and the development of contemporary nuclear physics. Through the study of this course, students can master the radioactive phenomena and their basic principles in the natural environment as well as nuclear engineering practice. In addition, students will also understand the basic principles of modern nuclear energy utilization, such as fission and fusion. The study of this course will lay a good theoretical foundation for subsequent courses, such as nuclear reactor physical analysis, radiation protection, radiation detection, etc.

default.zh: 本课程是核工程与核技术专业方向的一门重要基础课。核工程量子力学涉及数学、物理等多学科交叉，是发展核工程与和核技术的基础。通过对课程的学习，引导学生在以核工程量子力学为基础，关注量子力学对核科学与技术应用的发展，掌握量子力学基本知识。本课程面向核工程与核技术专业方向本科生开设。 本课程授课内容包括量子力学的诞生、波函数和薛定谔方程、量子力学中的力学量、态和力学量的表象等内容。
default.en: This course is an important basic course for nuclear engineering and nuclear technology majors. Principles of Quantum Mechanics in Nuclear Engineering involves the intersection of mathematics, physics and other disciplines, and is the basis for the development of nuclear engineering and nuclear technology. Through the study of the course, students are guided to master the basic knowledge of quantum mechanics based on the quantum mechanics of nuclear engineering, pay attention to the development of quantum mechanics in the application of nuclear science and technology. This course is open to undergraduates majoring in nuclear engineering and nuclear technology. The teaching content of this course includes the birth of quantum mechanics, wave function and Schr dinger equation, mechanical quantities in quantum mechanics, states and representations of mechanical quantities.

default.zh: 核反应堆物理分析是核反应堆工程专业的一门核心课程。本课程介绍核裂变反应堆相关的物理基础理论、裂变反应堆能量产生及控制的原理方法、反应堆设计与运行等涉及的关键物理现象及相关分析计算方法。主要内容包括：与反应堆物理有关的核物理知识，中子的基本性质，中子在介质中的慢化和扩散，临界理论，扩散方程的数值解，栅格的均匀化计算、燃耗、反应性控制和反应堆动力学。本课程的内容是核反应堆工程专业学生学习核反应堆运行及燃料管理等课程的基础。
default.en: Nuclear Reactor Physics and Analysis is a core course in nuclear reactor engineering. This course introduces the basic theory of nuclear physics in fission reactor, the principle and method of energy generation and control of fission reactor, the key physical phenomena involved in reactor operation and the related analysis and calculation methods. It covers concepts of reactor physics, properties of neutrons and reactions induced by neutrons, nuclear fission, slowing down of neutrons in infinite media, diffusion theory, critical theory, the few-group approximation and numerical solution of diffusion equations, fission-product poisoning, reactivity control, and point kinetics. This course is the basis for nuclear reactor engineering students to study following courses, such as nuclear reactor operations and fuel management courses et. al.

default.zh: 核反应堆热工水力学课程是核工程专业一门专业课，着重讲述了反应堆热工水力计算的基本模型和计算方法。课程需要掌握各种核反应堆结构材料的基本热物理性质；掌握核反应堆热工分析中涉及的堆芯释热、传热、流体力学等方面的基本知识和计算原理；掌握核反应堆稳态热工设计原理，了解单通道模型和子通道模型热工设计的步骤和计算方法；了解核反应堆瞬态热工水力分析中的基本模型和方法。课程的教学目的是使本科学生在学习了反应堆物理学、传热学、工程流体力学等课程中的核反应、流动、传热基本原理基础上，进一步了解、掌握对相关反应堆中热工分析的原理与计算方法，扩大知识面，培养根据基本原理进行技术研发、创新的能力。课程教学以课堂讲授为主，辅之以适当的课堂讨论。通过资料搜集、分析整理、评判，培养学生主动获取知识能力。通过课程学习实现以下三个目标：（1）牢固地掌握核反应堆中堆芯热量输运过程，深刻了解热量的来源及去处；（2）掌握反应堆内热输运的计算方法，了解压水堆热工分析计算的核心问题；（3）理解压水反应堆中热量传递涉及的基本原理和方法以及目前存在的主要问题的与解决方向，并增强工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力、创新意识。
default.en: The course is mainly concentrated on the theoretical models and calculation methods in the nuclear reactors. The basic thermal properties of materials used in the nuclear reactors are studied. The principal knowledge and calculation methods for heat transfer, fluid mechanism and releasing heat properties used in the analysis of thermodynamics and hydraulics of nuclear reactor are mustered. The thermodynamic and hydraulic methods at the steady state are understood. The single channel and sub-channel thermodynamic and hydraulic calculation methods and processes are performed. The basic theoretical models and calculation methods of instantaneous thermodynamic and hydraulic are performed. The purpose of the course is to make sure that the undergraduate study the basic principles of nuclear reaction、flow and heat transfer from the Reactor physics、Heat Transfer 、Engineering Fluid Mechanics and other courses, Further understand and master the principle and implementation scheme of thermal environment simulation in related numerical simulation technology, Expand the scope of knowledge and cultivate the ability of development and innovation based on the principle. Course teaching is mainly taught in class, supplemented by appropriate class discussion. By collecting and analyzing data can trained students acquire knowledge ability ;by topic designing、demonstrating and preliminary design training can cultivated students practical ability emphatically.These objectives can be achieved through this course: (1) Masting the heat transport process of nuclear reactor firmly and understanding the basic principles and main ways to improve the efficiency of heat transfer;(2) Grasping the calculation method of heat transport in the reactor and understanding the core problem of thermal analysis calculation of pressurized water reactor;(3) Understanding the basic principle and main technology of heat transfer in pressurized water reactor as well as the main problems existing at present, and enhance engineering practice ability, logical thinking ability and innovation consciousness.

default.zh: 核反应堆安全分析程以压水堆型核电厂为主要对象，学习核反应堆的安全特性及掌握反应堆安全及事故分析方法。课程的主要目标是使学生掌握核反应堆安全的基本原则，以及确定性和概率安全分析方法分析，并能够利用这些方法分析核安全事故及严重事故。了解新一代压水堆安全性的改进与发展，知道国际先进的快堆、高温气冷堆和重水堆核电厂的安全性。本课程不仅使学生掌握安全分析的基本理论和方法，而且为学生毕业后从事核方向的工作打下理论基础。树立核安全观以及生态文明世界观。课程目标 ； （1）知识目标：掌握核安全与核事故分析的基本原理与技术方法； （2）能力目标：掌握并熟练运用确定性分析、概率安全分析方法解决复杂工程系统的安全分析--安全分析； （3）素质目标：具有严重事故管理及放射性物质环境释放趋势分析增强对事故问题的判断处理及应急能力-事故分析及管理。
default.en: The nuclear reactor safety analysis program focuses on PWR type nuclear power plants, learning the safety characteristics of nuclear reactors, and mastering the methods of reactor safety and accident analysis. The main objective of the course is to enable students to master the basic principles of nuclear reactor safety, as well as deterministic and probabilistic safety analysis methods, and to be able to use these methods to analyze nuclear safety accidents and serious accidents. Understand the safety improvement and development of the new generation of pressurized water reactors, and know the safety of international advanced fast reactor, high temperature gas cooled reactor and heavy water reactor nuclear power plants. This course not only enables students to master the basic theories and methods of safety analysis, but also lays a theoretical foundation for students to engage in nuclear work after graduation. Specific objectives include: (1) Master the basic principles of nuclear safety system safety function and transient analysis basis - safety design (2) Master and skilled use of deterministic analysis and probabilistic safety analysis methods to solve the safety analysis of complex engineering systems - safety analysis (3) Master serious accident management and environmental release trend analysis of radioactive substances to enhance the judgment and handling of accident problems and emergency response ability - Accident analysis and management.

default.zh: 本课程全面介绍压水堆核动力装置的组成、功用和基本原理，核动力装置循环热力分析的基本理论和方法，核动力装置水质监督和水处理的基本知识，压水堆核动力装置运行的基本知识，核安全的基本概念。压水堆核动力装置中的蒸汽发生器，稳压器和冷凝器的功用和特点，泵与阀门的基本知识；主要设备的工作原理、换热过程和流体动力过程；主要设备的基本参数和设计计算方法；主要设备的结构形式。
default.en: The contents including: Components, function and basic principle of the PWR; basic analytical theory and method of nuclear power equipments thermal cycles; some basic knowledge on monitoring and treatment of water quality; equipments operation; basic conception of nuclear security; function and parameters of steam generator, pressure stabilizer and condenser; knowledge of pumps and valves; working principles, heat transfer process and fluid kinetics of main equipments; main parameters, design calculation method and structure type of main equipments.

default.zh: 辐射测量与防护是核科学领域中的重要研究方向之一，是专门研究防止辐射对人体危害的综合性边缘学科。主要研究内容可以归结为：核辐射测量学、辐射剂量学、辐射防护标准、辐射屏蔽设计以及辐射防护与环境安全评价和辐射安全管理等。本课程旨在向核物理、核工程与核技术等专业学生介绍与辐射测量防护有关的基本概念、常用辐射量和单位、常用辐射测量仪器及其使用方法、辐射防护标准、剂量计算和屏蔽计算等内容。通过本门课程的学习，使学生熟悉各种核工程检测仪表的功能和使用方法，掌握核电站在启动、停闭、和正常运行过程中辐射剂量的测量方法；同时，使学生了解核辐射对人体的危害，掌握辐射防护标准、剂量的计算、内外照射线防护、剂量测量原理和方法、环境辐射监测与评价等。本课是能源学院的专业选修课。
default.en: Radiation measurement and protection is one of the important research directions in the field of nuclear science, and is a comprehensive interdisciplinary field specialized in preventing radiation hazards to human health. The main research content can be summarized as: nuclear radiation measurement, radiation dosimetry, radiation protection standards, radiation shielding design, radiation protection and environmental safety evaluation, and radiation safety management. This course aims to introduce basic concepts related to radiation measurement and protection, commonly used radiation quantities and units, commonly used radiation measurement instruments and their usage methods, radiation protection standards, dose calculation, and shielding calculation to students majoring in nuclear physics, nuclear engineering, and nuclear technology. Through the study of this course, students will become familiar with the functions and usage methods of various nuclear engineering detection instruments, and master the measurement methods of radiation dose during the start-up, shutdown, and normal operation of nuclear power plants; At the same time, enable students to understand the harm of nuclear radiation to the human body, master radiation protection standards, dose calculation, internal and external radiation protection, dose measurement principles and methods, environmental radiation monitoring and evaluation, etc. This course is an elective course offered by the School of Energy Science and Technology.

default.zh: 本课程作为核工程与核技术专业课，核心任务是通过对物理知识和工程实例的学习与分析，让学生掌握以托卡马克为代表的聚变反应堆的基本结构和工作原理，了解聚变装置的核心物理要素、工程技术难点以及聚变能源商业化利用的前景，激发学生对以核聚变为代表的未来能源系统的学习和研究兴趣，为其从事聚变工程及相关领域的工作打好基础。具体的教学目标包括：（1）了解核聚变研究的发展历程、掌握聚变反应的原理和基本判据；（2）掌握托卡马克装置的结构和工作原理，了解仿星器等其他磁约束聚变装置，以及惯性约束聚变装置；（3）掌握聚变等离子体的基本物理特性、了解等离子体的诊断监测技术；（4）了解约束磁场的设计思想，了解聚变相关的工程技术；（5）增强实验动手能力、工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力和创新意识。
default.en: As a major course of nuclear engineering and nuclear technology, the core task of this course is to enable students to master the basic structure and working principle of fusion reactor represented by Tokamak, understand the core physical elements of fusion device, difficulties in engineering technology and prospects of commercial utilization of fusion energy through the study and analysis of physics knowledge and engineering examples. Stimulate students' interest in the study and research of future energy systems represented by nuclear fusion, and lay a solid foundation for their work in fusion engineering and related fields. Specific teaching objectives include: (1) to understand the development process of nuclear fusion research and master the principles and basic criteria of fusion reaction; (2) Master the structure and working principle of Tokamak devices, and understand other magnetic confinement fusion devices such as star imitation devices, as well as inertial confinement fusion devices; (3) Master the basic physical characteristics of fusion plasma and understand the diagnostic and monitoring technology of plasma; (4) Understand the design idea of restrained magnetic field and the engineering technology related to fusion; (5) Enhance hands-on ability, engineering practice ability, logical thinking ability and innovation consciousness.

default.zh: 核医学是专门研究原子核科学技术在医学上的应用及其理论的学科，本课程是阐明核技术在医学领域应用的基本原理的一门学科。主要内容就是放射性核素分子水平的靶向显像诊断，放射性核素分子水平的靶向治疗，利用放射性核素靶向、灵敏等特点进行医学研究。随着PET/CT、SPECT/CT的应用，放射性核素分子水平靶向治疗的发展，核医学已突破了传统内容而与其他学科相结合，形成分子影像技术。它是从分子水平研究和观察导致疾病发生的分子，从体外显示疾病的病理生理变化和代谢、功能改变，更能早期诊断，是对传统医学诊断的变革，是实现早诊断、早治疗的重要手段。
default.en: Nuclear medicine is a discipline that studies the application and theory of nuclear science and technology in medicine. This course clarifies the basic principles of nuclear medicine. The main content is the radionuclide targeted imaging diagnosis of molecular level, which is targeting and sensitive applied in the medical research. With the mature application of the PET/CT, the SPECT/CT and the molecular level targeted therapy of radionuclides, nuclear medicine has already broken through the traditional content and combined with other disciplines to form the molecular imaging technology. It studies and observes the molecules leading to the occurrence of diseases from the molecular level and shows the pathophysiological changes and metabolic and functional changes of diseases in vitro to achieve early diagnosis. It is a reform of traditional medical diagnosis and an important means to achieve early diagnosis and treatment.

default.zh: 本课程是核工程与核技术专业的一门选修课。智能核电技术涉及核科学与核技术、人工智能等多学科交叉，是实现先进核能利用的基础。通过对本课程的学习，引导学生在掌握核技术相关知识体系下，通过学习人工智能基本原理，开展人工智能在核能发电行业的应用与探索，推进人工智能技术与核电技术产业的融合创新。本课程面向核工程与核技术专业方向本科生开设。
default.en: This course is an elective course of nuclear Engineering and Nuclear technology. Intelligent nuclear power technology involves the intersection of nuclear science, nuclear technology and artificial intelligence, which is the basis for the realization of advanced nuclear energy utilization. Through the study of this course, students will be guided to carry out the application and exploration of artificial intelligence in the nuclear power generation industry and promote the integration and innovation of artificial intelligence technology and nuclear power technology industry by learning the basic principles of artificial intelligence under the mastery of the relevant knowledge system of nuclear technology. This course is offered to undergraduate students majoring in nuclear Engineering and Nuclear technology.

default.zh: 《核工程概论及实践》是核工程与核技术专业的入门课程，采取双语教学并辅以实践性环节，介绍核工程的基本原理、在各个领域的应用及其发展趋势，在内容选取上力求反映现代核科学与技术的发展趋势，注意与工程实际相结合。主要内容包括：核能的特点及发展趋势、核动力反应堆、核反应堆物理基础、核工程设计原理、压水堆本体结构、核反应堆安全、核反应堆的环境保护、核技术应用等。使学生在较短的学时内综合了解核工程与技术的主要知识、基本原理和应用，涵盖面广，综合性强。
default.en: Introduction to Nuclear Engineering and Practice is the introductory course for the nuclear engineering and nuclear technology major, taking bilingual teaching and with supplemented by practical aspects. It introduces the basic principles of nuclear engineering, applications in various fields and its development trend. In the content selection, it shows the trends of modern nuclear science and technology, which pay more attention to practical combination. The main contents include: characteristics and trends of nuclear energy, nuclear power reactors, the physical basis of the nuclear reactor, nuclear engineering design principles, PWR body structure, nuclear reactor safety, environmental protection of nuclear reactors and nuclear technology applications. Students could gain a comprehensive understanding of nuclear engineering and technology knowledge with shorter hours goes comprehensively master the basic principles and applications, covering a wide range.

default.zh: 本课程面向能源科学与工程学院各专业的本科生，通过本课程的学习和实践环节，使学生理解要求解的工程数学问题的物理意义、用计算机能够接受的方式将数学问题输入并调用恰当的函数方法将工程问题得以求解，了解常用计算机数学语言的优势和局限性、了解常见数学问题建模思想和方法；掌握工科常见高等数学、线性代数、统计学问题的计算求解方法具备工程计算中常用的数据插值、函数逼近和优化问题的计算求解能力问题的计算求解方法；了解时间序列数据的处理、数据展示与应用绘图方法。
default.en: This course is for undergraduate students of energy science and engineering college. Through the study and practice of this course, students can understand the physical meaning of the engineering mathematical problems that need to be solved, input the mathematical problems in a way acceptable to the computer and call the appropriate function method to solve the engineering problems, understand the advantages and limitations of computer mathematical languages, and understand ideas and methods of a mathematical problem modeling. They can also master common advanced mathematics, linear algebra, statistical problems calculation and solution methods in engineering applications; Through the study and practice of this course, students would have the ability of data interpolation, function approximation and optimization problems commonly used in engineering calculation; also understand the calculation and solution methods of time series data processing, data display and application drawing methods.

default.zh: 《工业过程中的节能原理与技术》 主要讲授对流换热、沸腾换热、凝结换热的强化原理；典型分布式能源系统原理以及新型分布式能源系统的设计方法；典型动力联合循环系统原理及工作过程；热泵分类、工作原理以及热泵系统的工程设计方法；机械储能、化学储能、电磁储能技术原理及发展方向；清洁高效燃烧原理以及设备的设计方法，工业炉窑节能改造方案和措施。通过本课程的学习使学生了解目前常用的工业节能技术，掌握各种节能技术的基本原理。培养学生理论与实践相结合的基本方法和思维习惯，使其具有一定的分析问题和解决实际工程问题的能力，能够利用基本原理设计工业过程中的节能方案。
default.en: 《Principles and Technologies of Energy Saving in Industrial Process》 mainly teaches the principles of convection heat transfer, boiling heat transfer and condensation heat transfer; The principle of typical distributed energy system and the design method of new distributed energy system; Principle and working process of typical power combined cycle system; Heat pump classification, working principle and engineering design method; Mechanical energy storage, chemical energy storage, electromagnetic energy storage technology principle and development direction; The principle of clean and efficient combustion and the design method of equipment, the energy-saving scheme of industrial furnace. By this course, students can understand the current commonly used industrial energy-saving technologies and master the basic principles of them. By cultivating thinking habits combining theory and practice, students will have the ability to analyze and solve practical engineering problems and design energy-saving programs in industrial processes by using basic principles.

default.zh: 为了营造浓厚的学术氛围，促使学生了解能源动力领域或相关学科领域的前沿知识，掌握最新的研究动态，不断提升科研能力，引发学生对科研方向和方法的深入思考，本课程将邀请国际学术大师、校外导师、行业专家进校，围绕智慧能源、空天动力等主题开展了精彩的讲座。同时，讲座结束之后，立刻安排学生进入学院实验室进行参观学习，能更好理解讲座核心知识。 课程分四个模块（热流基础前沿、航空动力、航天动力、储能科学等），具体模块会根据每年邀请到的专家的领域背景做适当调整。每个模块分成四个学时，其中（2个学时我们邀请了各个领域的国际知名专家进行前沿讲座，2个学时我们邀请了学院内的优秀青年教师分享团队的最新有影响力的成果）。8个学时将参观4个主要实验室，分别对应航空动力、先进动力、流动传热、储能等实验室。
default.en: The course is divided into four modules (Frontiers of Heat Flow Fundamentals, Aviation Power, Aerospace Power, Energy Storage Science, etc.), and the specific modules will be adjusted according to the field background of the experts invited each year. Each module is divided into four semester hours, of which (2 semester hours we invite internationally renowned experts in various fields to give cutting-edge lectures, and 2 semester hours we invite outstanding young teachers in the college to share the latest influential achievements of the team). The 8 hours will visit 4 laboratories, corresponding to aviation power, advanced power system, flow heat transfer, energy storage and other laboratories.

default.zh: 本课程为能源动力类专业的一门重要创新实践课，面向能源科学与工程、飞行器动力工程专业、核工程与核技术专业的本科生，讲授能源与空天动力相关智慧创新新知识，结合微型燃机实践创新平台、微型航发实践创新平台、空天热物理实践创新平台、高超推进实践创新平台以及空天电推进五个能源与空天动力的小型实践创新平台开展实践教学，使学生从理论上了解智慧能源与空天动力的基本原理和最新创新知识，并从实践上亲自感受相关新技术，使学生对智慧能源与空天动力具有足够的感性认识和实际动手的能力，对智慧能源与空天动力有足够立体的认识。
default.en: This innovation practice course is oriented to undergraduates in the major of energy and power, including the fields of energy science and engineering, aircraft power engineering, nuclear engineering and nuclear technology. This course concentrates on new knowledge and latest innovation-driven developments related to energy and aerospace propulsion. The teaching process is based on five small practice innovation platforms which covers topics of micro gas turbine, micro aero-engine, aerospace thermal physics and hypersonic propulsion. This course introduces fundamental theories and innovative knowledge about intelligent energy and aerospace propulsion, simultaneously accompanied by practical perceptivity about relative innovative technology, aiming to give students adequate perceptual cognition and sufficient hands-on operation which finally forms a stereoscopic understanding about the intelligent energy and aerospace propulsion.

default.zh: 本课程介绍多孔介质和流动的基本概念。通过讲座、讨论和实践练习，学生将全面了解多孔介质定义、具体几何结构定义、多孔介质流动以及纳维-斯托克斯方程中达西定律等数学模型的应用。此外，学生还将参与实践项目，应用并掌握所教授的理论概念。
default.en: This course provides an introduction to the fundamental concepts of porous media and flow. Through lectures, discussions, and practical exercises, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of porous media definitions, specific geometrical definitions, porous media flow, and the application of mathematical models such as Darcy's law from Navier-Stokes equations. Additionally, students will engage in hands-on projects to apply theoretical concepts.

default.zh: 构建以新能源为主体的新型电力系统，是实现“双碳”目标的重要基础。在新型电力系统中，以核电为基荷，推动风电、太阳能发电、储能等多种清洁能源融合发展、协调互补，是我国实现“双碳”目标的重要保障，也是我国能源产业适应新时期高质量发展目标的重大要求和长久研究方向。核电具有清洁低碳、出力稳定、边际成本低等特征，可以有效替代煤电，承担起保障或增强电力稳定供应的重任，有效推动其他清洁能源共同发展。加快构建核能与其他清洁低碳能源的协同发展机制，通过风、光、核以及储能等多能互补协同，有助于打造安全高效的清洁能源体系以及推动实现“双碳”目标。在此背景下，改造传统火电，提升其灵活性的同时，有必要加强电力系统灵活调节能力建设，统筹核电配套新型储能的基础设施建设，多角度、多层次、多途径发展新型储能技术，积极构建与电力系统协调发展的电力储能体系。随着核电规模的进一步提升，结合核电特点及其发展实际，以及电力系统灵活调节的需求，发展灵活性核能，统筹核能发电与新型储能的开发利用，增强核能系统的可调节性十分重要。核电配套新型储能要尽可能灵活部署于各类应用场景。 本课程聚焦核能与储能技术的综合应用，介绍发展灵活性核能的技术路径以及核能与新型储能技术综合利用的各种场景。主要包括：1）核能领域相关内容：包括介绍典型反应堆、特殊用途反应堆、典型核能热电联产等综合利用；2）储能领域相关内容：包括各类新型储能技术特点以及目前的工程应用情况等；3）核能与储能综合应用：（1）介绍“风光核储”一体化发展新模式：介绍目前打造“风光核储”一体化智慧能源系统的新趋势，以核电站为中心，在一定区域范围内实现“风光核储”的互联互通、协同调度和智能控制，构建具有自我调节能力的区域智慧能源互联网，充分挖掘核电在我国清洁能源体系中的支撑带动，以及在电网中的协调平衡作用，有效推进多种清洁能源形式一体化融合发展；（2）核电配套新型储能如何尽可能灵活部署于各类应用场景：突出不同用途的反应堆如何与新型储能技术相连接：例如，华龙一号等大堆与新型储能匹配，可以参与负荷调节，保障区域电力供应和不同时段的用电负荷，提高核电的安全性和经济性；小堆及先进核能系统与储能匹配，可拓展在分布式能源供应以及综合能源服务等方面的应用；此外，核电配套储能不仅可以辅助调频、稳定电压，还可以作为备用电源提高核电厂最大输出功率；（3）介绍核能与制氢的联合发展：介绍利用核电、核热与清洁能源耦合制氢前景以及核能制氢的技术路线与工艺方法，尤其是高温气冷堆高温热解制氢技术；介绍我国核能制氢的产业基础。 理论课采用“讲解—提问—归纳”方法，利用课堂“教”的灵活性，充分调动“学”的积极性。本课程不仅使学生学习到有关核能与储能技术综合应用的基础知识，而且为学生毕业后从事核专业方面的研究、设计、制造、运行、应用和管理等方面的专业技术工作和科学研究工作打下必要的理论基础。在教学过程中结合本课程特点，注意培养学生辨证思维和逻辑推理的能力；训练建立核专业与储能应用相关问题的判断、计算和综合能力分析能力；着重培养学生的创新精神和实践能力。 本课程的主要目标为：（1）了解各类型反应堆以及典型核热联产等各种利用方式以及各类新型储能技术特点以及目前的工程应用情况，理解各种能源系统的基本原理和主要技术以及目前存在的主要问题的与解决方向；（2）重点掌握核能与储能综合应用，包括“风光核储”一体化发展新模式、核电配套新型储能如何尽可能灵活部署于各类应用场景、核能制氢等基本原理，在熟练掌握本学科知识技能基础上，深刻认识到新时代各科学技术领域广泛交叉的现状，深入理解如何增强核电的灵活性；（3）增强对科学问题和技术难点的好奇心和探索钻研精神；增强逻辑思维能力、创新意识、团队合作精神；对现有知识和方法具有批判精神，独立分析和解决问题，具备成为高水平管理人才的潜力。
default.en: With the characteristics of clean and low-carbon, stable output and low marginal cost, nuclear power can effectively replace coal power, enhance the stable supply of electricity, and effectively promote the development of other clean energy sources. Accelerating the establishment of a mechanism for the coordinated development of nuclear energy and other clean and low-carbon energy sources will promote the realization of the dual carbon goal. With the further improvement of the scale of nuclear power, combined with the characteristics of nuclear power and its actual development, as well as the demand for flexible regulation of the power system, it is very important to develop flexible nuclear energy, coordinate the development and utilization of nuclear power generation and new energy storage, and enhance the adjustability of the nuclear energy system. This course focuses on the integrated application of nuclear energy and energy storage technology, and introduces the technical path of developing flexible nuclear energy and various scenarios for the comprehensive utilization of nuclear energy and new energy storage technology. It mainly includes: 1) Related contents in the field of nuclear energy: including the comprehensive utilization of typical reactors, special purpose reactors, and typical nuclear cogeneration; 2) Related contents in the field of energy storage: including the characteristics of various new energy storage technologies and current engineering applications; 3) Integrated application of nuclear energy and energy storage. The main objectives of this course are as follows: (1) To understand various utilization modes of reactors and typical nuclear thermal cogeneration, as well as the characteristics and current engineering applications of various novel energy storage technologies, and to understand the basic principles and main technologies as well as the main existing problems and solutions; (2) To focus on the comprehensive application of nuclear energy and energy storage, including the new integrated development model of the wind-solar-nuclear-energy storage system, the basic principles of how to flexibly deploy new energy storage supporting nuclear power in various application scenarios, such as nuclear energy hydrogen production. And to deeply understand the current situation of the extensive intersection of various scientific and technological fields and how nuclear power can be more flexible; (3) To enhance the curiosity and exploration spirit of scientific problems and technical difficulties, the logical thinking ability, the innovation consciousness and the teamwork spirit.

default.zh: 本课程针对压水堆，开展仿真系统应用实践教学，将核工程与核技术专业的重点研究领域的关键系统、设备及现象通过理论与实践相结合的方式进行讲授。课程基于SIREP 1300MW四环路核电站原理机、ALICE实时仿真软件平台开展教学，该仿真平台是根据法国INSTN工程师学院的教学要求开发的，是法国高等工科院校能源动力类工程师实践教学平台主修课程。 课程教学内容共包含四个模块，包括热工模块、堆物理模块、核安全分析模块、工况运行模块。其中热工模块包括稳压器与安全阀组、蒸汽发生器、化学容积与控制系统、余热排出系统四个部分；堆物理模块涵盖重要的反应堆物理现象，包括氙毒、慢化剂温度效应、多谱勒效应、负温度、硼浓度、燃耗；核安全分析模块开展两个事故的模拟，包括一回路小破口事故与蒸汽发生器传热管破损事故；工况运行模块为2选1，从厂用电系统与冷态启动至满功率中选择1个开展实践。 通过本课程的学习，将使学生牢固掌握压水堆核电站的主要系统及设备知识、工艺流程，准确理解各子系统、各变量在不同工况下的控制关系，掌握核电站实验规程等专业知识与实践技能。同时，将培养学生的工程实践、科学创新、协同工作能力。
default.en: This course focuses on pressurized water reactors and conducts practical teaching of simulation system applications. It combines theory with practice to teach key systems, equipment, and phenomena in the key research fields of nuclear engineering and nuclear technology. The course is based on the SIREP 1300MW four loop nuclear power plant principal machine and ALICE real-time simulation software platform for teaching. This simulation platform is developed according to the teaching requirements of the French INSTN Institute of Engineers and is a major course in the practical teaching platform for energy and power engineers in higher engineering colleges in France. The course teaching content consists of four modules, including thermal engineering module, reactor physics module, nuclear safety analysis module, and operating condition module. The thermal module includes four parts: regulator and safety valve group, steam generator, chemical volume and control system, and waste heat removal system; The reactor physics module covers important reactor physics phenomena, including xenon toxicity, moderator temperature effect, Doppler effect, negative temperature, boron concentration, and burn-up; The nuclear safety analysis module simulates two accidents, including a small break accident in the primary circuit and a heat transfer tube damage accident in the steam generator; The operating mode module is 2 out of 1, and one is selected from the plant power system and cold start to full power for practice. Through the study of this course, students will firmly grasp the main system and equipment knowledge, process flow of pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants, accurately understand the control relationships of various subsystems and variables under different operating conditions, and master professional knowledge and practical skills such as nuclear power plant experimental procedures. At the same time, it will cultivate students' abilities in engineering practice, scientific innovation, and collaborative work.

default.zh: 本课程的主要目标是加强工程热力学的知识基础，提升专业思维与运用能力。工程热力学是研究热能有效利用以及热能和机械能等其它能量转换规律及其应用的工程技术科学。课程的目标是使学生掌握热力学的基本概念与基本规律，并能正确运用这些规律对热工过程和热力循环进行分析和计算。课程内容主要包括以下几部分：（1）热力学的基本概念，以及热能与机械能相互转换的两大定律；（2）热力过程和热力循环的分析方法，以及提高能量利用率的基本原则和主要途径；（3）热力计算常用工质的物性公式和图表。
default.en: The main goal of this course is to strengthen the knowledge base of engineering thermodynamics and improve professional thinking and application capabilities. Engineering thermodynamics is an engineering science that studies the effective use of thermal energy and the laws governing the conversion between thermal energy and mechanical energy or other energy together with their applications. The goal of the course is to enable students to master the basic concepts and laws of thermodynamics and to correctly apply these laws to analyze and calculate thermodynamic processes and cycles. The content of this course mainly includes the following parts: (1) the basic concepts of thermodynamics and the two laws of mutual conversion between thermal energy and mechanical energy; (2) the analysis methods of thermodynamic processes and cycles, and the basic principles and main ways to improve energy utilization; (3) the physical property formulas and diagrams of common working fluids for thermodynamic calculations.

default.zh: 《专业思维训练B》是能源动力类专业的一门重要选修课，面向能源与动力工程、飞行器动力工程、储能科学与工程、新能源科学与工程各专业的本科生，讲授流体力学的基本概念和基本理论，以及流体平衡和运动的基本规律，使学生了解流体的基本概念和性质，掌握流体静力学、流体运动学、流体动力学、流动阻力与损失等方面的基础知识和基本理论，并通过一定数量的习题，使学生对流体力学具有足够的感性认识能力，基本掌握运用流体力学知识解决工程实际的计算和分析能力。本课程的教学注重培养学生的兴趣，着重培养学生对工程流体力学基础理论知识的掌握，不仅为学生学习后续的专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且也为学生将来继续深造打下坚实的基础，同时通过本课程训练提升学生的专业思维水平。
default.en: 《Major Thinking Training B》 is an important elective course for energy and power majors. It teaches the basic concepts and theories of fluid mechanics, as well as the basic laws of fluid balance and movement for undergraduates majoring in energy and power engineering, aircraft power engineering, energy storage science and engineering, and new energy science and engineering, so that students can understand the basic concepts and properties of fluids. Master the basic knowledge and theory of hydrostatics, fluid kinematics, fluid dynamics, flow resistance and loss, etc., and through a certain number of exercises, students will have enough perceptual understanding ability of convection mechanics, and basic grasp of the application of fluid mechanics knowledge to solve engineering practical calculation and analysis ability. The teaching of this course focuses on cultivating students' interest and mastering the basic theoretical knowledge of engineering fluid mechanics, which not only provides necessary basic theoretical knowledge for students to learn subsequent professional courses, but also lays a solid foundation for students to continue their studies in the future. At the same time, through this course training, students can improve their professional thinking level.

default.zh: 本课程聚焦于辐射传热的高级理论与应用，旨在为学生提供全面而深入的知识体系。课程内容涵盖辐射传热的基础理论，包括电动力学和光学的基本概念，使学生理解辐射传热的物理本质。进一步探讨气体辐射理论，分析气体分子的能级跃迁、谱线形成及加宽机制，帮助学生掌握气体辐射特性。课程还深入讲解非均匀介质中的辐射传热现象，分析多相介质、复杂几何结构中的辐射传输过程，使学生理解实际工程问题中的辐射传热行为。此外，课程介绍先进的蒙特卡洛射线追踪方法，包括基本原理、算法实现及应用技巧，帮助学生掌握数值模拟工具。通过理论讲解与实例分析，学生将深入理解辐射传热的核心机制，并掌握其在实际工程问题中的应用方法。 辐射传热理论在工程和科学研究中具有重要意义。它不仅是热传递研究的关键组成部分，还在能源利用、环境科学及航空航天等领域发挥着关键作用。通过本课程的学习，学生将深入理解辐射传热的基本原理和最新研究进展，掌握气体辐射、非均匀介质辐射传热等关键概念。这些理论不仅为学生提供了深入研究辐射传热现象的工具，还为解决实际工程问题提供了科学依据。例如，在太阳能利用中，辐射传热理论有助于设计高效的集热器和光伏系统；在航空航天领域，辐射传热理论对于飞行器的热防护系统设计至关重要。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够将理论知识应用于实际问题，提升解决复杂工程问题的能力，为未来的研究和职业发展奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course focuses on the advanced theory and application of radiative heat transfer, providing students with a comprehensive and in-depth knowledge system. The course content covers the basic theory of radiative heat transfer, including the fundamental concepts of electrodynamics and optics, enabling students to understand the physical nature of radiative heat transfer. It further explores the theory of gas radiation, analyzing the energy level transitions, spectral line formation, and broadening mechanisms of gas molecules to help students grasp the characteristics of gas radiation. The course also delves into radiative heat transfer in non-homogeneous media, analyzing the radiative transfer processes in multiphase media and complex geometric structures, allowing students to understand the behavior of radiative heat transfer in practical engineering problems. In addition, the course introduces advanced Monte Carlo ray-tracing methods, including the basic principles, algorithm implementation, and application skills, to help students master numerical simulation tools. Through theoretical lectures and case analyses, students will gain a deep understanding of the core mechanisms of radiative heat transfer and learn how to apply this knowledge to practical engineering problems. Radiative heat transfer theory is of great significance in engineering and scientific research. It is not only a key component of heat transfer studies but also plays a crucial role in fields such as energy utilization, environmental science, and aerospace. By learning this course, students will gain a deep understanding of the basic principles and the latest research progress of radiative heat transfer, and master key concepts such as gas radiation and radiative heat transfer in non-homogeneous media. These theories not only provide students with tools for in-depth research on radiative heat transfer phenomena but also offer a scientific basis for solving practical engineering problems. For example, in solar energy utilization, radiative heat transfer theory helps design efficient solar collectors and photovoltaic systems; in the aerospace field, radiative heat transfer theory is essential for the design of thermal protection systems for spacecraft. Through this course, students will be able to apply theoretical knowledge to practical problems, enhancing their ability to solve complex engineering problems and laying a solid foundation for future research and career development.

default.zh: 流动控制技术是伴随航空工业的发展而发展起来的，先进的流动控制技术为20世纪航空宇航工业的发展做出了重要贡献。课程流动控制为背景，讲授在开展流动控制技术的基础研究工作中，如何利用科学的方法探索和分析控制位置、控制参数、来流条件等设计变量的影响规律，了解并认识流动控制技术中主控参数及其基本特性、控制效果的数据库。同时针对现有的流动控制技术并且发展新概念流动控制技术，为其在飞行器的应用提供新思路。该部分将结合具体的流动控制方法介绍如何改进现有的流动控制技术，提高其控制能力以及可靠性等，同时与其他学科相结合，发展新型、高效的流动控制技术。
default.en: Flow control technology has evolved alongside the development of the aviation industry. Advanced flow control technology made significant contributions to the progress of the aerospace industry in the 20th century. With aircraft flow control as the background, the course teaches how to use scientific methods to explore and analyze the influence laws of design variables such as control positions, control parameters and incoming flow conditions in basic research on flow control technology. It helps students understand and recognize the key control parameters, their basic characteristics and the database of control effects in flow control technology. Meanwhile, focusing on existing flow control technologies and developing new-concept ones, the course provides new ideas for their application in aircraft. This section will combine specific flow control methods to introduce how to improve existing technologies, enhance their control capability and reliability, and integrate with other disciplines to develop new, high-efficiency flow control technologies.

default.zh: 本课程系统阐述应用热力学、热化学的基础理论，并重点讲解生物质能作为一种重要的低碳与可再生资源，其转化利用的技术路径。通过本课程的学习，学生将建立起从基本原理到前沿技术的知识体系，培养分析和评估低碳能源系统的能力。
default.en: This course systematically covers the basic theories of applied thermodynamics and thermo-chemistry, with a special focus on biomass as a crucial low-carbon and renewable resource, detailing its conversion pathways. Students will establish a knowledge framework spanning from fundamental principles to advanced technologies, equipping them with the ability to analyze and evaluate low-carbon energy systems.

default.zh: 《运载火箭发动机概论》是一门面向能源、航天、机械、材料等专业本科生的专业选修课。课程系统阐述运载火箭发动机的基本原理与关键技术。通过课堂讲授与案例研讨相结合的方式，帮助学生建立对航天运载火箭动力系统的基本认知，掌握世界著名运载火箭发动机的结构特点与工作模式。课程将引入全球典型发动机案例，通过对比中外运载火箭发动机发展脉络和特点，引入最新商业火箭技术发展前沿，深化对发动机设计要素与核心思想的理解，培养学生的创新思维和国际视野。本课程致力于衔接专业基础理论与工程实践应用，激发学生对空天推进领域的科研兴趣，为未来从事航天推进研究奠定坚实基础。
default.en: Introduction to Launch Vehicle Engine Design is a specialized elective course for undergraduate students in energy, aerospace, mechanical, and materials engineering. The course systematically elaborates principles and key technologies of launch vehicle rocket engines. Through combinations of lectures and case study discussions, it helps students establish a foundational understanding of aerospace propulsion systems and master the structural characteristics, operational modes, and fundamental principles of world-renowned launch vehicle rocket engines. The course emphasizes the analysis of global typical engine cases, incorporating a comparative analysis of the developmental history and characteristics of Chinese and international launch vehicle rocket engines, as well as introducing the latest technological frontiers in commercial rockets. This approach deepens students' comprehension of engine design, while fostering innovative thinking and a global perspective. The course aims to bridge the gap between fundamental theoretical knowledge and engineering practical applications, spark students' research interest in the field of aerospace propulsion, and lay a solid foundation for future engagement in aerospace propulsion research.

default.zh: 本课程面向新型电力系统智能化转型需求，立足国家“双碳”战略与能源数字化转型背景，培养兼具能源系统认知与AI工具化应用能力的复合型人才。通过聚焦风光储协同预测、火电机组智能调频等核心场景，系统讲解AI算法在发电功率预测（如LSTM）、设备异常诊断（如1D-CNN）中的工程化实现路径。学生将掌握从数据清洗、模型调用到结果分析的全流程实践技能，能够运用Scikit-learn、MATLAB等工具完成典型发电场景的建模与优化，具备解决中小型场站“源-网-荷”协同问题的初级工程能力，为能源行业智能化升级储备技术应用型人才。
default.en: This course addresses the intelligent transformation needs of the new power system, grounded in the context of China's "dual-carbon" strategy and energy digitalization. It aims to cultivate interdisciplinary talent with both energy system expertise and applied AI capabilities. By focusing on core scenarios such as wind-PV-storage collaborative forecasting and intelligent frequency regulation of thermal power units, the course systematically explains the engineering implementation of AI algorithms in power generation forecasting (e.g., LSTM) and equipment fault diagnosis (e.g., 1D-CNN). Students will acquire hands-on skills covering the entire workflow—from data cleaning and model deployment to result analysis—and learn to use tools like Scikit-learn and MATLAB for modeling and optimizing typical power generation scenarios. They will develop foundational engineering capabilities to address small and medium-scale "source-grid-load" coordination challenges, preparing them to contribute to the intelligent upgrading of the energy sector as technically skilled professionals.
