default.zh: 《AI驱动的新型微纳米辐射热管理技术》是一门面向能源科学与工程、航空航天工程、机械工程、人工智能应用等相关专业本科高年级学生的专业课程，旨在培养学生在微纳尺度热管理技术领域具备扎实的理论基础和前沿的AI应用能力。本课程总学时为16学时，其中理论学时14学时，实验学时2学时，通过理论讲授、案例分析、实验实践与项目驱动学习相结合的方式，使学生深入理解微纳米辐射热管理的基础理论，掌握人工智能（AI）在热管理中的应用原理及工具，包括机器学习、深度学习及优化算法。学生将学习如何利用Python、MATLAB等工具进行微尺度传热建模、实验数据处理和智能优化设计，同时，通过观摩和参与实验，掌握微纳米固体表面辐射特性测量及椭偏光学测量的原理与方法。此外，课程注重培养学生的跨学科思维、创新能力和工程实践能力，鼓励学生围绕真实热管理问题开展AI预测建模、优化设计和实验数据分析，形成解决实际复杂传热问题的能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够在航空航天、能源动力、半导体散热等领域运用AI进行智能热管理技术的开发与应用，为未来的科研和职业发展奠定坚实基础。
default.en: ？"AI-Driven Advanced Micro/Nano Radiative Thermal Management Technology"？ is a specialized course designed for senior undergraduate students in energy science and engineering, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, artificial intelligence applications, and related disciplines. It aims to equip students with a robust theoretical foundation in micro/nano-scale thermal management technologies and cutting-edge AI application capabilities. The course comprises 16 credit hours, including 14 hours of theoretical instruction and 2 hours of laboratory sessions. Through integrated approaches combining lectures, case studies, experimental practices, and project-driven learning, students will gain an in-depth understanding of the fundamental theories of micro/nano radiative thermal management and master the principles and tools of artificial intelligence (AI) in thermal regulation, including machine learning, deep learning, and optimization algorithms. Students will learn to utilize tools like Python and MATLAB for micro-scale heat transfer modeling, experimental data processing, and intelligent optimization design. Through observational and hands-on experiments, they will acquire the principles and methods of radiation characteristics measurement for micro/nano solid surfaces and ellipsometric optical measurement. Furthermore, the course emphasizes cultivating interdisciplinary thinking, innovative capacity, and engineering practical skills. Students are encouraged to address real-world thermal management challenges through AI predictive modeling, optimized design, and experimental data analysis, thereby developing the ability to solve complex heat transfer problems. Upon completion of the course, students will be capable of applying AI-driven intelligent thermal management technologies in aerospace, energy systems, semiconductor cooling, and related fields, laying a solid foundation for future scientific research and professional advancement. This translation maintains the technical accuracy of key terms (e.g., "radiative thermal management," "ellipsometric optical measurement") while ensuring coherence and readability. The structure aligns with standard academic course descriptions, highlighting pedagogical methods, skill development, and career relevance.

default.zh: 海洋可再生能源具有总蕴藏量大、可永续利用、绿色清洁等特点，是有利于人类社会和谐发展的重要能源之一。在当今海洋强国建设背景下，加快推进中国海洋可再生能源的开发利用，对缓解沿海地区用电紧张，解决边远沿海地区特别是海岛电力供应短缺、满足沿海经济社会的发展具有十分重要意义。因此海洋能可再生能源利用技术研究方向是能源科学与工程专业一个重要学科分支，是未来我国重点发展方向之一。本课程讲解海洋能分类以及相应转换设备，着重讲解波浪能、潮汐能、潮流能、温差能和盐差能等转换装备工作原理以及国内外研究现状。
default.en: Marine energy features the characteristics of large total reserves, sustainable utilization, green and clean, and is one of the important energy sources conducive to the harmonious development of human society. In the context of building a maritime power, accelerating the development and utilization of China's marine renewable energy is of great significance to ease the shortage of electricity in coastal areas, solve the shortage of power supply in remote coastal areas, especially islands, and meet the development of coastal economy and society. Therefore, the study on marine renewable energy utilization technology is an important branch of energy science and engineering and one of the key development directions in China in the future. This course introduces the classification of marine energy and corresponding conversion equipment, focusing on the working principle of wave energy, tidal energy, tidal current energy, temperature difference energy, salt difference energy and other conversion equipment, as well as the research status at home and abroad.

default.zh: 《微流动与芯片实验室》课程主要以集成电路芯片、微机械、微精密仪器设备中微纳结构为背景，学习微尺度条件下不同作用力驱动的流体流动现象及机理，了解微流控芯片中流体流动及操控机理。通过本课程的教学，使本科生了解微尺度流动基本概念及特点、微尺度条件下流体现象及原理、微尺度流动作用力等，建立微尺度流动的基本理论框架，初步了解微流控实验的原理、设备、操作方法等。
default.en: "Microfluidics and Lab-on-a-chip" mainly use a background of the micro nano structures in integrated circuit chips, micro machinery, and micro precision instrument equipment. It learns the fluid flow phenomena and mechanisms driven by different forces under micro scale conditions, and understands the fluid flow and control mechanisms in microfluidic chips. Through the teaching of this course, undergraduate students will understand the basic concepts and characteristics of micro scale flow, fluid phenomena and principles under micro scale conditions, microfluidics forces, etc., establish the basic theoretical framework of micro scale flow, and have a preliminary understanding of the principles, equipment, and operating methods of microfluidic experiments.

default.zh: 该课程从实践的角度上加深学生对从实验测量和数值计算中获得的各种类型的流动数据。通过数据对应的物理现象的认识，从而深入对流体流动的理解。目的是使学生具备数据分析的能力并提高科研素养。学习本课程要求学生掌握流动数据可视化及分析的基本理论和实践技能，能够基于模拟和实验获取流动数据。而且，要能通过流行的后处理软件处理流动数据，获得可视化的数据结果，并进行二次处理及分析。该课程为今后从事流体力学相关的研究与工作打下理论和实验基础。使学生掌握以下几方面能力： （1）将课堂上学习的理论知识应用于工程实践的能力； （2）掌握使用流体软件或程序获得流动数据的能力； （3）熟悉基于实验获取流动数据的过程，掌握流场速度测试技术的原理和实验流程； （4）掌握误差分析理论，能应用误差分析理论对获得进行特征分析及误差分析； （5）熟练运用后处理软件处理通过实验和数值方法获得的流动数据； （6）掌握流动数据的二次处理、特征参数计算以及基于数据的流动分析能力。
default.en: The course provides students with a practical understanding of the various types of flow data obtained from experimental measurements and numerical calculations. Through the understanding of physical phenomena corresponding to the data, we can deepen the understanding of fluid flow. The aim is to equip students with the ability to analyze data and improve their research literacy. This course requires students to master the basic theoretical and practical skills of visualization and analysis of flow data, and to be able to obtain flow data based on simulations and experiments. In addition, it is necessary to be able to process the flow data through popular post-processing software, obtain visual data results, and perform secondary processing and analysis. This course lays a theoretical and experimental foundation for future research and work related to fluid mechanics.

default.zh: 流体动力系统在国民经济各个行业动力传输与流体输送应用领域都发挥着重要的作用，小到居民楼宇供水的管道末端恒压控制，大到核电工程核主泵随负荷变化的流量调节，为了适应系统参数和工况的变化，保证流体动力系统经济可靠地运行，自动化调节与控制手段的应用是必不可少的。流体动力系统调节及控制课程主要讲授液力传动基本理论、调速型液力偶合器、可调式液力变矩器、液力传动元件与动力机共同工作特性及叶片泵与风机工作系统水力调节基本原理，课程以液力装置工作特性、调节特性为主线，综合介绍流体机械工作系统、调节控制装置与应用，包括变频调速、液力调节装置、叶片泵与风机工作系统、液力调速应用系统等方面的调节与控制应用技术，并给出多个工程实际应用案例的介绍与分析。本课程通过教学与实验，学习调节装置的基本原理与流体动力系统工作特性分析方法，树立过程调节控制的基本思想，培养系统综合开发的能力，为从事相关产品技术研发和科学研究工作奠定基础。
default.en: Fluid power system in the national economy in various industries power transmission and fluid transportation applications play an important role, small to the residential building water supply pipeline end constant pressure control, large to the nuclear power engineering nuclear main pump with the load changes in flow regulation, in order to adapt to changes in system parameters and conditions, to ensure that the fluid power system to operate economically and reliably, automated regulation and control means of the application of the means is indispensable. Fluid power system regulation and control course mainly teaches the basic theory of hydraulic transmission, speed-regulating hydraulic coupling, adjustable hydraulic torque converter, hydraulic transmission components and power machine common working characteristics and vane pumps and fans working system hydraulic regulation of the basic principles, the course to the working characteristics of the hydraulic device, regulating the characteristics of the main line, a comprehensive introduction to the working system of the fluid machinery, regulating and control devices and applications, including variable frequency speed control, Hydraulic regulation device, vane pump and fan working system, hydraulic speed control application system and other aspects of the regulation and control of application technology, and gives a number of engineering practical application cases of introduction and analysis. Through teaching and experiments, the course learns the basic principles of regulating devices and analyzing the working characteristics of fluid power systems, establishes the basic idea of process regulation and control, cultivates the ability of comprehensive development of the system, and lays the foundation for engaging in the technical research and development of related products and scientific research work.

default.zh: 作为一种气液两相流现象，空化在多数场合空化现象是有害的，例如流体机械中空化现象的出现会带来噪声、振动和过流部件的空蚀破坏等负面影响。在“如果无法避免，那就利用起来”这一思想的指导下，近年来众多利用空化效应的技术被应用到工程实际当中。《流体机械气液两相流基础》是掌握本专业相关原理和设计知识的结构性课程，是研究流体机械内部复杂流动过程及应用的工程技术课程，主要讲解空化与空泡动力学的基本概念和基本特性。课程不仅为学生本科毕业后从事流体机械（如泵、水轮机等）设计、测试等方面提供必要的基础理论知识，而且也为学生将来继续深造作铺垫。在教学过程中结合本课程特点，注重培养学生的兴趣，着重培养学生对流体机械内部复杂流动的判断、计算思想和综合分析能力；训练其具备从事数值模拟、实验测量和后处理分析的能力。
default.en: As a gas-liquid two-phase flow phenomenon, cavitation is harmful in most cases. For example, the occurrence of cavitation in fluid machinery will induce negative effects such as noise, vibration, and cavitation erosion of components. Under the guidance of the idea of "if we can't avoid it, then use it", many technologies using cavitation effects have been applied to engineering practice in recent years. "Fundamentals of Gas-Liquid Two-Phase Flow in Fluid Machinery" is an engineering technology course that studies complex flows in fluid machinery and the applications. This course mainly focuses on the fundamental concept、theory、method and phenomenon of cavitating flows and cavitation bubble dynamics. The purpose of this course is to let students grasp the fundamental characteristics and mechanisms of cavitation and cavitation bubble dynamics. The course not only provides the necessary basic theoretical knowledge for students to engage in the design and testing of fluid machinery (such as pumps, turbines, etc.) after graduation, but also lays the groundwork for students to continue their advanced studies in the future. Combining with its characteristics, this course focuses on cultivating students' interest and their abilities of judgment, calculation and comprehensive analysis for complex flows inside fluid machinery, and training them to have the ability to engage in numerical simulation, experimental test and post-processing.

default.zh: 《抽水蓄能技术及应用》主要阐述抽水蓄能系统的运行原理及其在新型电力系统中的作用。着重讲解抽水蓄能系统的组成和运行特性、过渡过程水力稳定性与控制、抽水蓄能机组在新型电力系统中的作用及其应用。它是能源科学与工程专业的一门选修专业课，是从事抽水蓄能相关研究的基础。
default.en: Pumped Storage Technology and Utilization mainly describes the operation principle of pumped storage system and its role in the new power system. It focuses on the composition and operation characteristics of pumped storage system, hydraulic stability and control of transition process, the role of pumped storage unit in new power system and its application. It is an elective professional course of energy science and engineering, and it is the basis of related research on pumped storage.

default.zh: 教学目标：面向能源与动力工程专业的本科生，讲授燃气轮机及其各组成部件的基本知识及工作原理，使学生了解燃气轮机的各组成部件及其工作原理。旨在全面培养学生的理论知识和实践技能，使其能够胜任燃气轮机及相关发动机领域的专业工作。 教学要求：聚焦于培养学生的专业技能与理论知识，涵盖燃气轮机的广泛应用与基本特性，深入解析活塞、涡轮轴、涡轮螺旋桨、涡轮喷气及涡轮风扇发动机的结构、性能与工作原理，尤其强调重型燃气轮机的部件构造与材料，以及与航空发动机的结构差异。课程还介绍燃气轮机循环的前沿技术，如SCO2循环和联合循环，同时通过小型涡喷发动机的实际操作，强化理论与实践的结合，旨在全面提高学生在燃气轮机领域的综合素养与专业能力。 授课对象：本课程主要面向能源与动力工程专业的学生，要求学生学过《工程热力学》、《燃气涡轮动力原理》等课程的基本内容。 课程目标：（1）能够利用已有知识对燃气轮机装置进行简要分析；（2）深入理解不同类型燃气轮机的结构、工作原理和性能特点，包括航空活塞发动机、航空涡轮轴、涡轮螺旋桨发动机、航空涡轮喷气、涡轮风扇发动机以及重型燃气轮机等；（3）培养学生的实践能力和分析问题的能力，增强实验动手能力、工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力、创新意识。
default.en: Teaching Objectives: This course is designed for undergraduates majoring in Energy and Power Engineering, aiming to teach them the basic knowledge and working principles of gas turbine engines and their constituent components. It seeks to enable students to understand the various components of gas turbine engines and their operational mechanisms. The ultimate goal is to comprehensively cultivate students' theoretical knowledge and practical skills, equipping them to excel in professional work related to gas turbine engines and other relevant engine fields. Teaching Requirements: The focus is on developing students' professional skills and theoretical knowledge, covering the wide range of applications and fundamental characteristics of gas turbine engines. It delves into the structures, performances, and working principles of piston engines, turboshaft engines, turboprop engines, turbojet engines, and turbofan engines, with special emphasis on the component construction and materials of heavy-duty gas turbine engines, as well as the structural differences from aerospace engines. The course also introduces cutting-edge technologies in gas turbine engine cycles, such as SCO2 cycles and combined cycles. Through practical operations with small turbojet engines, it reinforces the integration of theory and practice, aiming to comprehensively enhance students' overall qualities and professional capabilities in the field of gas turbine engines. Target Audience: This course is primarily for students majoring in Energy and Power Engineering, requiring them to have a basic understanding of courses such as "Engineering Thermodynamics" and "Principles of Gas Turbine Power." Course Objectives: (1) To enable students to conduct brief analyses of gas turbine engine systems using their existing knowledge; (2) To foster a deep understanding of the structures, working principles, and performance characteristics of different types of gas turbine engines, including aviation piston engines, aviation turboshaft engines, turboprop engines, aviation turbojet engines, turbofan engines, and heavy-duty gas turbine engines; (3) To cultivate students' practical abilities and problem-solving skills, enhancing their experimental proficiency, engineering practice abilities, logical thinking capabilities, and innovative consciousness.

default.zh: 燃气涡轮动力机械是复杂的系统，涉及流体力学、热力学、材料科学和控制理论等多个学科。仿真计算实训提供了一个平台，使学生能够将理论知识应用于实际模拟的环境中，从而加深理解并提高实际操作能力。因此本课程的教学面向能源与动力工程专业本科生，讲授数值模拟及仿真技术在航空发动机的应用，使学生能够采用现代化工具完成多学科的分析工作。根据本门课程培养目标如下： 1.掌握数值方法进行航空发动机设计和计算的基本概念； 2.掌握计算流体力学的基本知识，了解流动控制方程的离散及数值求解； 3.利用软件研究航空发动机中典型的流动和传热问题，掌握基于商业软件进行发动机设计和局部流场研究的方法和流程； 4.培养学生发现问题-分析问题-解决问题的能力，解决工程中的实际问题，激发对航空领域的兴趣； 本课程是将专业基础和应用加以结合的课程，对于培养学生们将知识转化为工程实践的能力具有很大的促进作用，通过本课程的学习可使学生能够快速上手并自主完成后续航空发动机设计及研究任务。
default.en: Gas turbine power machinery is a complex system that involves multiple disciplines such as fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, materials science, and control theory. Simulation computing training provides a platform for students to apply theoretical knowledge to practical simulation environments, thereby deepening their understanding and improving their practical operational abilities. Therefore, the teaching of this course is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in Energy and Power Engineering, teaching the application of numerical simulation and simulation technology in aviation engines, enabling students to use modern tools to complete interdisciplinary analysis work. The training objectives of this course are as follows: 1. Master the basic concepts of numerical methods for aircraft engine design and calculation; 2. Master the basic knowledge of computational fluid dynamics, understand the discretization and numerical solution of flow control equations; 3. Use software to study typical flow and heat transfer problems in aircraft engines, and master the methods and processes for engine design and local flow field research based on commercial software; 4. Cultivate students' ability to discover, analyze, and solve problems, solve practical problems in engineering, and stimulate interest in the aviation field; This course combines professional foundation and application, and has a great promoting effect on cultivating students' ability to transform knowledge into engineering practice. Through the study of this course, students can quickly get started and independently complete subsequent aviation engine design and research tasks.

default.zh: 燃气涡轮机运行与控制主要面向智能动力与自动化专业的本科生，讲授典型燃气轮机控制系统的基本知识，使学生了解燃气轮机控制的基本问题和最新进展。课程的主要目标是使学生掌握燃气轮机控制系统的专业知识，并能正确运用自动控制理论去解决燃气轮机的基本控制问题。作为前言专题课程，本课程在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识和技能，并结合各类型燃气轮机的运行特点进行控制方面的基本训练，着重培养学生对燃气轮机系统方案的构建、系统动态特性分析、控制规律优化以及控制器设计方面的综合能力。本课程不仅为学生学习相关专业课程提供必要的基础知识，而且为学生毕业后从事燃气轮机方面的专业技术工作和科学研究打下必要的理论基础。
default.en: The Operation and Control of Gas Turbine is mainly aimed at undergraduate students majoring in smart power and automatic classes. The basic knowledge of typical engine control system is provided to enable students to understand the basic problems and latest progress of gas turbine engine control. The main objective of the course is to enable students to master the professional knowledge of engine control system and to correctly use automatic control theory to solve the basic control problems of various types of engines. As a preface topic course, this course comprehensively uses the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prior courses in the teaching process, and combines the operation characteristics of various types of engines to conduct basic training in engine control. This course focuses on training students' comprehensive ability in the construction of engine system scheme, system dynamic characteristics analysis, control law optimization and controller design. This course not only provides the necessary basic knowledge for students to learn the relevant professional courses, but also lays the necessary theoretical foundation for students to engage in the professional technical work and scientific research on aircraft power after graduation.

default.zh: 人工智能在发动机设计中的应用是人工智能学科与航空发动机设计学科交叉的前沿应用性课程。该课程借助深度学习在航空发动机设计中的应用案例，介绍人工智能在辅助设计航空发动机方面的应用成果，让学生建立人工智能辅助设计航空发动机的架构体系、理解在发动机设计中使用的深度神经网络模型的特点、掌握基于深度神经网络预测部件性能的流程。本课程要求学生注重人工智能与航空发动机设计学科交叉的理念，能利用深度神经网络算法构建航空发动机部件辅助设计流程。
default.en: AI Applications in Gas Turbine is a cutting-edge applied course that intersects the disciplines of artificial intelligence and aviation engine design. This course utilizes the application case of deep learning in aircraft engine design to introduce the achievements of artificial intelligence in assisting in the design of aircraft engines. Students are encouraged to establish an architecture system for AI assisted design of aircraft engines, understand the characteristics of deep neural network models used in engine design, and master the process of predicting component performance based on deep neural networks. This course requires students to pay attention to the interdisciplinary concept of artificial intelligence and aviation engine design, and be able to use deep neural network algorithms to construct an auxiliary design process for aviation engine components.

default.zh: 本课程是为热能动力工程专业动力机械方向本科生开设的一门选修课。现代动力机械装置是一种理论比较成熟、生产上得到充分应用和发展的科学技术。有关现代动力机械装置热力循环及现代涡轮机的一般工作原理已在先修课“工程热力学”及“透平机械原理”中论述过。本课程讨论现代动力机械装置总体系统及其主要设备的实际应用特点、工作原理及变工况特性、计算方法、总体结构及发展趋势，是从事动力机械工作的科研与工程技术人员必备的专业知识之一。
default.en: This is an elective for students majoring in thermal and power engineering, or in power machinery and engineering. The theories of the modern power machine equipment and the application and development in production will be introduced. The normal working principles of the modern power machine and the thermal circulation of the modern power machine equipment are introduced in detail. This course discusses the overall system of modern power machine and the real applying characteristics of the main equipment, working principles, off-design condition characteristics, computational methods, overall structure and the development trends are also included in the course, so it is one of the necessary professional knowledge areas for those who engage in the scientific research or engineering work in power machinery.

default.zh: 叶轮机械在国民经济尤其是整个重工业体系中占有十分重要的地位。实验是叶轮机械研究的不可替代的重要手段。数字孪生是充分利用物理模型、传感器更新、运行历史等数据，综合多学科、多物理量、多尺度、多概率的仿真技术。数字孪生技术已广泛应用于叶轮机械实验设计、加工、运行和维护的产品生命周期管理中。 通过本课程的学习，使学生了解叶轮机械实验的基本理论与方法，了解叶轮机械实验的数字孪生技术，为学生从事叶轮机械的研究工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Turbomachinery plays a significant role in the economy, especially in large-scale industrial systems. Experimental research is an irreplaceable and important means in turbomachinery. Digital twin technology is the simulation technology that integrates multidisciplinary, multi-physical quantity, multiscale and multi probability by making full use of physical model, sensor update, operation history and other data. The digital twin has been widely used in product life-cycle management of aeroengine design, processing, operation and maintenance. Through the study of this course, students can understand the basic theory and method of experimental technology in turbomachinery, understand the digital twin technology in turbomachinery, and lay a solid foundation for students to engage in turbomachinery research.

default.zh: 本课程系统介绍先进核电技术的理论基础、工程实践和发展前沿。从全球核电发展现状与运行实绩出发，全面讲解第三代、第四代等先进核电反应堆堆型的设计理念和典型技术方案，深入阐述核电站能量转换与传输、反应堆内传热与流动等热工基础理论，课程目标具体为： （1）掌握先进核电技术的基本概念、原理和发展现状，了解典型反应堆技术方案和可控核聚变技术进展，为从事先进核电技术研究奠定基础； （2）了解先进核电反应堆系统及其安全管理，培养学生综合运用核电相关知识的能力，强化学生分析和解决核电工程实际问题的意识； （3）能够针对核电工程实际中的安全性、经济性、可靠性等问题进行分析评价、提出解决方案，具备持续学习和解决复杂核电工程问题的素养。
default.en: This course provides a systematic introduction to the theoretical foundations, engineering practices, and cutting-edge developments of advanced nuclear power technology. Starting from the global nuclear power development status and operational performance, the course comprehensively covers the design concepts and typical technical solutions of advanced nuclear reactor types including Generation III and Generation IV reactors, and thoroughly elaborates on fundamental thermal-hydraulic theories such as energy conversion and transmission in nuclear power plants, as well as heat transfer and fluid flow within reactors. The specific course objectives are: (1) To master the fundamental concepts, principles, and development status of advanced nuclear power technology; to understand typical reactor technical solutions and controlled nuclear fusion technology progress, thereby establishing a foundation for engaging in advanced nuclear power technology research; (2) To understand advanced nuclear reactor systems and their safety management; to cultivate students' ability to comprehensively apply nuclear power-related knowledge and strengthen their awareness of analyzing and solving practical nuclear power engineering problems; (3) To develop the capability to analyze and evaluate safety, economic, and reliability issues in practical nuclear power engineering and propose solutions; to acquire the competence for continuous learning and solving complex nuclear power engineering problems.

default.zh: 《核燃料及核燃料循环》是指核燃料的获取、加工、使用、回收利用的全过程。具体教学内容为：（1）核燃料的分类及核燃料循环概述；（2）铀矿的勘探、开采、加工和转化；（3）铀浓缩的方法和原理；（4）核燃料元件的制造；（5）辐照过乏燃料的后处理；（6）放射性废物的处理与处置。通过该课程的学习，学生应掌握核燃料循环各技术环节的基本原理和常用方法。并能够利用相关学科知识和理论综合分析和理解核燃料循环中的主要技术要点和技术发展趋势。
default.en: 《Nuclear Fuel and Nuclear Fuel Cycle》refers to the integral process of the exploration, processing, utilization, and disposal of the nuclear fuels. The main contents of this course are as follows: (1) the classification of nuclear fuels and the principles of nuclear fuel cycle; (2) the exploration, extraction and processing of nuclear fuels; (3) the principles and methods of the uranium enrichment; (4) the fabrication of nuclear fuel elements; (5) the disposal methods of the used nuclear fuels; (6) the disposal methods of nuclear wastes. Through this course, students should master the basic principles and processes of the nuclear cycle, and should be able to resolve the basic problems involving in the nuclear cycle, and have the insight on the development trends of nuclear cycle technology.

default.zh: 核动力装置测试技术课程的主要目标是结合核动力装置，着重培养学生的创新和工程实践能力。核工程检测是用于检测核岛及常规岛中有关参数，是保证核设备安全、可靠及经济运行的重要手段。检测核电站在启动、停闭和运行过程中温度、压力、流量、液位、中子通量、辐射剂量及机械量等工艺参数，自动调节和控制过程参数，保证核电站安全、可靠、正常运行。
default.en: The main objective of the nuclear power plant test technology is to train students' ability of innovation and engineering practice combine the equipment of nuclear power plants. Nuclear engineering test technology is used to detect nuclear islands and conventional islands in the relevant parameters, is to ensure the safety of nuclear equipment, reliable and economical operation of the important means. The parameters of temperature, pressure, flow rate, liquid level, neutron flux, radiation dose and mechanical quantity of the nuclear power plant are detected, stopped and controlled during the start, stop and operation of the nuclear power plant. The parameters of the nuclear power plant are automatically adjusted and controlled to ensure the safe, reliable and normal operation of the nuclear power plant.

default.zh: 核动力装置智能运行与控制是研究核动力装置动态数学模型建立、动态特性分析、控制规律设计与智能运行的工程技术学科，是核工程与核技术学科、控制学科的交叉学科,是核工程与核技术的重要选修课之一，具有较广的使用范围，本课程面向大学三年级以上的学生，设置在学生了解核反应堆物理分析、热力学、自动控制等知识的基础上。 课程目的是使学生掌握核动力装置智能运行与控制的设计原理、理论和实现方法，重点掌握核反应堆、冷却剂系统、稳压器、蒸汽发生器等核动力装置主要设备的工作原理及动态数学模型建立方法，熟悉核反应堆功率控制、功率分布控制、稳压器水位和压力控制、蒸汽发生器水位控制等核动力装置主要控制系统的原理，掌握核动力装置运行状态智能监测、故障预警诊断和智能运行控制基本原理及方法。本课程不仅使学生学习和掌握核动力装置智能运行与控制系统分析、设计和实现的基础理论知识和方法，而且为学生毕业后从事其它动力系统的智能运行与控制相关专业技术工作和科学研究工作打下必要的理论基础。在教学过程中结合本课程特点，注意培养学生辨证思维、逻辑推理和实践能力，训练学生面向控制的数学模型建立、系统动态响应特性理解以及对控制系统设计相关问题的判断、计算和综合能力。 课程任务是通过本课程的学习，使学生学习和掌握核动力装置智能运行与控制系统分析、设计和实现相关基础知识和方法，了解“双碳”能源转型背景下核动力装置智能运行与控制的发展趋势，为学生毕业后从事核动力装置智能运行与控制相关专业技术和科学研究工作打下必要的基础。
default.en: The intelligent operation and control of nuclear power plants is an engineering and technical discipline that studies the establishment of dynamic mathematical models, dynamic characteristics analysis, control law design, and intelligent operation of nuclear power plants. It is an interdisciplinary subject between nuclear engineering and nuclear technology, as well as a control discipline. It is one of the important elective courses in nuclear engineering and nuclear technology, and has a wide range of applications. This course is aimed at students from third year and above in universities, Based on students' understanding of nuclear reactor physics analysis, thermodynamics, automatic control, and other knowledge. Course purpose: The purpose of the course is to enable students to master the design principles, theories, and implementation methods of intelligent operation and control of nuclear power plants, with a focus on mastering the working principles and dynamic mathematical model establishment methods of main equipment of nuclear power plants such as nuclear reactors, coolant systems, regulators, steam generators, etc. Familiarize themselves with nuclear reactor power control, power distribution control, regulator water level and pressure control Master the principles and methods of intelligent monitoring, fault early warning diagnosis, and intelligent operation control of the main control systems of nuclear power plants such as steam generator water level control. This course not only enables students to learn and master the basic theoretical knowledge and methods of analyzing, designing, and implementing intelligent operation and control systems for nuclear power plants, but also lays the necessary theoretical foundation for students to engage in professional technical and scientific research related to intelligent operation and control of other power systems after graduation. In the teaching process, combined with the characteristics of this course, attention should be paid to cultivating students' dialectical thinking, logical reasoning, and practical abilities. Students should be trained to establish mathematical models for control, understand system dynamic response characteristics, and have the ability to judge, calculate, and synthesize control system design related issues. Course Tasks: The course task is to enable students to learn and master the basic knowledge and methods related to the analysis, design, and implementation of intelligent operation and control systems for nuclear power plants, understand the development trend of intelligent operation and control of nuclear power plants in the context of the "dual carbon" energy transformation, and lay a necessary foundation for students to engage in professional technical and scientific research related to intelligent operation and control of nuclear power plants after graduation.

default.zh: 数字化核反应堆工程技术是能源科学与工程学院核工程与核技术专业方向的一门专业基础课，同时是专业课程设计的前期基础课程。数字反应堆是未来核能系统的重要研究平台，本课程主要讲解数字化核反应堆的基础理论和分析计算方法，是核相关行业中必须的常识性理论基础课。在本课程中，学生不仅学习到有关核工程技术的基础知识，而且为学生毕业后从事核工程及核技术方面的研究、设计、制造、运行、应用和管理等方面的专业技术工作和科学研究打下必要的理论基础。在教学过程中结合本课程特点，使学生具有核反应堆设计相关问题的判断、计算和综合能力分析能力，注意训练学生的辨证思维和逻辑推理能力，着重培养学生的创新精神和实践能力。本课程主要针对核工程与核技术专业方向学生开设，也对工程热物理及新能源等专业的学生开放。
default.en: Digital Nuclear Reactor Engineering Technology is a professional basic course in the direction of nuclear engineering and nuclear technology in the School of Energy Science and Engineering, and it is also a preliminary basic course for professional course design. Digital reactors are an important research platform for future nuclear energy systems. This course mainly explains the basic theory and analysis and calculation methods of digital nuclear reactors. It is a necessary common-sense theoretical basic course in nuclear-related industries. In this course, students not only learn the basic knowledge of nuclear engineering technology, but also provide students with professional technical work and scientific research in nuclear engineering and nuclear technology research, design, manufacture, operation, application and management after graduation. Lay the necessary theoretical foundation. Combined with the characteristics of this course in the teaching process, students have the ability to judge, calculate and comprehensively analyze problems related to nuclear reactor design, pay attention to training students' dialectical thinking and logical reasoning ability, and focus on cultivating students' innovative spirit and practical ability. This course is mainly for students majoring in nuclear engineering and nuclear technology, and is also open to students majoring in engineering thermophysics and new energy.

default.zh: 《先进核技术及应用》课程是核工程与核技术专业一门专业课，也可作为能源动力、机械、电子、化工类相关专业的选修课。课程的教学目的是使本科学生在学习了大学传热学、工程流体力学、工程热力学等课程中的流动、传热基本原理基础上，进一步了解、掌握对先进核技术的应用，扩大知识面，培养根据基本原理进行技术研发、创新的能力。课程教学以课堂讲授为主，辅之以适当的课堂讨论。通过资料搜集、分析整理、评判，培养学生主动获取知识能力；通过学生自主拟定设计题目、进行论证与初步设计训练，着重培养学生的实践能力。
default.en: Advanced Nuclear Technology and Applications is a specialized course for nuclear engineering and technology major’s students, and can also be used as for power engineering, mechanical engineering, and chemical engineering related majors’ students. The teaching purpose of this course is to enable undergraduate students to further understand and master the application of advanced nuclear technology, expand their knowledge, and cultivate their ability to carry out technology research innovation. The soused is based on the basic knowledge of flow and heat transfer, engineering fluid mechanics, engineering thermodynamics and other courses. Course teaching is mainly based on classroom teaching, supplemented by appropriate classroom discussion. Through data collection, analysis, sorting and evaluation, cultivate students' ability to actively acquire knowledge. Through students' independent preparation of design topics, demonstration and preliminary design training, students' practical ability is mainly cultivated.

default.zh: 本课程的任务是使学生了解同位素技术的基本原理及其在国民经济和科研领域的前沿应用，激发学生对以同位素技术为代表的现代核技术的学习和研究兴趣，为其从事核技术及相关领域的工作打好基础。具体课程目标如下： （1） 知识目标：掌握同位素生产基本原理、方法及技术特点； （2） 能力目标：具有将同位素技术应用于工业、农业、生物医药以及环境保护领域的的能力。 （3） 素质目标：能针对具体技术问题给出利用同位素技术的解决方案。
default.en: The mission of this course is to enable students to understand the basic principles of isotope technology and its cutting-edge applications in the national economy and scientific research fields, stimulate students' interest in learning and research of modern nuclear technology represented by isotope technology, and lay a good foundation for their work in nuclear technology and related fields：(1) Knowledge Objective: Master the basic principles, methods and technical characteristics of isotope production; (2) Competency Objectives: Possess the ability to apply isotope technology in the fields of industry, agriculture, biomedicine, and environmental protection. (3) Quality objective: Be capable of providing solutions using isotope technology for specific technical problems.

default.zh: “压缩空气储能技术”是能源动力类专业储能科学与工程学科的一门专业课，结合本领域最新科学研究进展，开展讲座研讨式教学，具有较广的使用范围；本课程面向能源科学与工程学院储能科学与工程专业本科生，要求学生已修读高等数学、工程热力学及流体力学等专业基础课。 课程目的：通过对压缩空气储能系统原理的介绍，培养学生应用数学、自然科学和工程科学的基本原理，解决复杂工程问题的能力；通过学习压缩空气储能系统循环形式和关键部件的基本原理，掌握采用基本物理和数学知识进行关键部件性能分析，培养学生结合数据获得有效结论的问题分析能力；了解压缩空气储能的应用要求，建立相关基本知识体系，形成解决能源问题所必须的知识基础储备。 课程任务：使学生熟悉和掌压缩空气储能技术的基本原理，掌握各种形式压缩空气储能系统的优劣，熟悉各个关键部件的工作原理，能够从系统层面进行初步设计工作。为下一步在一定指导下完成本科毕业设计，及独立开展压缩空气储能技术的相关研究打下基础。
default.en: “Compressed Air Energy Storage Technology” is a professional course in the field of energy storage science and engineering for energy and power majors. It is taught in a lecture-discussion format, incorporating the latest scientific research in the field. The course has a wide range of applications and is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in energy storage science and engineering at the School of Energy Science and Engineering. Students are required to have completed basic courses in advanced mathematics, engineering thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics. Course purpose: To introduce the principles of compressed air energy storage systems, cultivate students’ ability to apply basic principles of mathematics, natural science, and engineering science to solve complex engineering problems. By studying the basic principles of the cycle form and key components of compressed air energy storage systems, students will learn how to analyze the performance of key components using basic physics and mathematical knowledge, and develop problem-solving skills by combining data to obtain effective conclusions. The course also aims to provide an understanding of the application requirements of compressed air energy storage and establish a relevant basic knowledge system, forming a knowledge base reserve necessary to solve energy problems. Course Tasks: To familiarize students with the basic principles of compressed air energy storage technology, understand the advantages and disadvantages of various forms of compressed air energy storage systems, be familiar with the working principles of various key components, and be able to conduct preliminary design work at the system level. The course aims to lay a foundation for students to complete their undergraduate thesis under certain guidance and to independently carry out related research on compressed air energy storage technology.

default.zh: 《抽水储能技术》主要阐述抽水储能系统的运行原理及其在新型电力系统中的作用。着重讲解抽水储能系统的组成和运行特性、过渡过程水力稳定性与控制、抽水储能机组在新型电力系统中的作用及其应用。它是能源科学与工程专业的一门选修专业课，是从事抽水储能相关研究的基础。
default.en: Pumped Storage Technology mainly describes the operation principle of pumped storage system and its role in the new power system. It focuses on the composition and operation characteristics of pumped storage system, hydraulic stability and control of transition process, the role of pumped storage unit in new power system and its application. It is an elective professional course of energy science and engineering, and it is the basis of related research on pumped storage.

default.zh: 本课程是储能专业方向的一门重要基础课。飞轮储能涉及数学、能源、机械等多学科交叉，是发展储能技术的一个分支。通过对课程的学习，引导学生在以飞轮储能为基础，关注储能领域的发展，以自己专业所学投身我国储能事业。本课程面向储能科学与工程专业方向本科生开设。 本课程内容包括飞轮储能技术概论、飞轮材料应用结构设计及试验、飞轮电机设计与分析、飞轮电机转子轴承系统动力学等。
default.en: This course is an important foundational course in the field of energy storage. Flywheel energy storage involves interdisciplinary fields such as mathematics, energy, and machinery, and is a branch of energy storage technology development. Through the study of the course, guide students to focus on the development of energy storage based on flywheel energy storage, and apply their professional knowledge to the energy storage industry in China. This course is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in energy storage science and engineering. The content of this course includes an introduction to flywheel energy storage technology, design and testing of flywheel material application structures, design and analysis of flywheel motors, dynamics of flywheel motor rotor bearing systems, etc.

default.zh: 建设清洁低碳、安全高效的现代能源体系，力争2030年前实现碳达峰、2060年前实现碳中和，成为我国能源革命的主要目标。储能可弥补风、光等新能源发电随机性强与可调度性低的先天缺陷，促进新能源汽车与能源互联网的发展，在生产侧与消费侧实现主体能源由化石能源向新能源的更替，被认为是支撑能源革命、实现“碳达峰”与“碳中和”最核心的物理手段。储能的种类较多，常见的包括抽水蓄能、压缩空气储能、电化学储能、热储能、氢储能等。然而，由于受技术、成本、政策、商业模式等因素的影响，储能的规模化发展与商业化应用之路依然任重道远。本课程结合当代碳中和战略背景，通过对物理储能循环系统发展需求及相关技术阐释，建立一套基于物理储能循环系统为核心的碳中和发展体系，针对该体系进行较深层次剖析与讲解，有助于学生深入了解物理储能方法及体系。为学生更好地掌握物理储能循环系统科学，拓展视野和储备知识，激发学生研究兴趣，引导学生进行研究性学习。
default.en: Building a clean, low-carbon, safe and efficient modern energy system, and striving to achieve carbon peak by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2060 have become the main goals of China's energy revolution. Energy storage can make up for the congenital defects of strong randomness and low dispatchability of new energy power generation such as wind and solar, promote the development of new energy vehicles and energy Internet, and realize the replacement of the main energy from fossil energy to new energy on the production side and consumption side, which is considered to be the core physical means to support the energy revolution and achieve "carbon peak" and "carbon neutrality". There are many types of energy storage, including pumped hydro storage, compressed air energy storage, electrochemical energy storage, thermal energy storage, hydrogen energy storage, etc. However, due to the influence of technology, cost, policy, business model and other factors, the large-scale development and commercial application of energy storage still have a long way to go. Combined with the background of contemporary carbon neutrality strategy, this course establishes a set of carbon neutral development system based on physical energy storage cycle system as the core through the interpretation of the development needs of physical energy storage cycle system and related technologies, and conducts in-depth analysis and explanation of the system, which is helpful for students to have an in-depth understanding of physical energy storage methods and systems. To help students better grasp the science of physical energy storage cycle system, expand their horizons and reserve knowledge, stimulate students' research interest, and guide students to conduct research-based learning.

default.zh: 发展高效、稳定、成本低廉的储能蓄热技术，对提升不稳定热源的能量利用效率、增加电网对可再生能源的消纳具有重要作用，是提高能源利用效率、增加可再生能源占比的重要途径。相比显热储热及相变储热，热化学储热技术通过化学键的断裂重组实现能量的储存和释放，具有更大的储能密度（约为显热储能的10倍及相变储能的5倍）和更广的储能温度范围，且能量损失小，可实现能量的季节性存储而不需特殊的绝热措施。本课程的目标是通过讲授热化学储能技术基本原理，使学生了解热化学储热相比显热及相变储热在储能密度、热损失、储能温度、储能周期等方面的优点；通过讲授各种典型热化学储热体系的原理、材料、储热规律、系统优化，使学生掌握各典型体系的关键材料及工艺流程；通过2次课堂研讨，使学生掌握运用所学基础理论知识综合分析典型热化学储热体系的方法。本课程主要培养学生以下几方面能力： （1）分析计算能力：正确理解热化学储热技术的基本原理及特点，运用数学知识对体系热力学和动力学相关理论公式进行推导和应用；计算各类热化学储热技术的体积/质量储能密度等关键技术指标；（支撑毕业要求1、2、5） （2）思辨能力：热化学储热技术尚处于实验室研究向工程示范的过渡阶段，部分理论仍处于百家争鸣阶段。通过作业及课堂讨论的设计，本课程着力培养学生基于基本科学原理，发现各类热化学储热体系中问题的能力，通过合作学习搜集素材进行论证及展望；（支撑毕业要求4、6、7、10、12） （3）解决工程问题能力：通过讲授各类典型热化学储热体系的技术原理、工艺流程及单元装备，使学生初步具备运用数学、工程热力学、化学等所学基础知识解决热化学储热技术相关的复杂工程问题的能力；（支撑毕业要求1、3、4）
default.en: Developing efficient, stable, and low-cost heat storage technologies plays an important role in improving the energy utilization efficiency of unstable heat sources and increasing the consumption of renewable energy by the power grid. It is an important way to improve energy utilization efficiency and increase the proportion of renewable energy. Compared to sensible heat storage and phase change heat storage, thermochemical heat storage technology achieves energy storage and release through the breaking and recombination of chemical bonds, with a larger energy storage density (about 10 times that of sensible heat storage and 5 times that of phase change storage) and a wider range of energy storage temperatures, and with less energy loss, it can achieve seasonal energy storage without the need for special insulation measures. The goal of this course is to teach students the basic principles of thermochemical heat storage technology, and to enable them to understand the advantages of thermochemical heat storage over sensible and phase change heat storage in terms of energy density, heat loss, storage temperature, and storage period; By teaching the principles, materials, thermal storage laws, and system optimization of various typical thermochemical thermal storage systems, students can master the key materials and process flows of each typical system; Through two discussions, students will master the method of applying their basic theoretical knowledge to comprehensively analyze typical thermochemical thermal storage systems. This course mainly cultivates students' abilities in the following areas: (1) Analytical and computational abilities: Correctly understand the basic principles and characteristics of thermochemical heat storage technology, apply mathematical knowledge to derive and apply theoretical formulas related to system thermodynamics and kinetics;？Calculate key technical indicators such as volume/mass energy storage density for various thermochemical heat storage technologies; (2) Speculative ability: Thermochemical thermal storage technology is still in the transitional stage from laboratory research to engineering demonstration, and some theories are still in the early stage.？Through the design of assignments and discussions, this course focuses on cultivating students' ability to discover problems in various thermochemical thermal storage systems based on basic scientific principles. Through collaborative learning, materials are collected for argumentation; (3) Ability to solve engineering problems: By teaching the technical principles, process flow, and unit equipment of various typical thermochemical heat storage systems, students will have the ability to apply basic knowledge such as mathematics, engineering thermodynamics, and chemistry to solve complex engineering problems related to thermochemical heat storage technology.

default.zh: 《化学储能循环系统》课程是一门用以培养学生掌握化学储能循环与系统的专业课程。本课程主要介绍化学储能技术基础理论、化学循环系统热力学基础以及化学储能具体（液流电池、锂离子电池、钠系高温电池、镍氢电池、金属空气电池）的系统构造及热力循环。
default.en: "Chemical Energy Storage Cycle System" is a professional course designed to train students to master the chemical energy storage cycle and system. This course mainly introduces the basic theory of chemical energy storage technology, the thermodynamic fundamentals of chemical cycle system, and the system structures and thermal cycles of chemical energy storage systems (i.e., flow battery, lithium-ion battery, sodium-based high-temperature battery, nickel-metal hydride battery, metal-air battery, etc.).

default.zh: 本课程是储能专业方向的一门重要基础课。材料计算与模拟涉及数学、能源、机械以及物理等多学科交叉，是了解储能材料结构设计的方法之一。通过对课程的学习，引导学生在以材料计算与模拟为基础，关注储能领域的发展，以自己专业所学投身我国储能事业。本课程面向储能科学与工程专业方向本科生开设。 课程教学包括课堂教学和实践教学。课堂内容包括引言、第一性原理计算方法、分子动力学计算方法、光学性质模拟与计算、晶体弹性及其模拟计算、磁性材料的模拟计算以及电化学储能中材料模拟与计算应用等。实践教学包括材料数值模拟上机操作等内容。
default.en: This course is an important foundational course in the field of energy storage. Material calculation and simulation involve interdisciplinary fields such as mathematics, energy, machinery, and physics, and are one of the methods for understanding the structural design of energy storage materials. By studying the course, guide students to focus on the development of energy storage based on material calculation and simulation, and apply their professional knowledge to the energy storage industry in China. This course is designed for undergraduate students majoring in energy storage science and engineering. The course teaching includes classroom teaching and practical teaching. The classroom content includes introduction, first principles calculation methods, molecular dynamics calculation methods, optical property simulation and calculation, crystal elasticity and simulation calculation, simulation calculation of magnetic materials, and material simulation and calculation application in electrochemical energy storage. Practical teaching includes material numerical simulation and computer operation.

default.zh: 《移动式储能技术》课程是储能科学与工程专业中一门涉及移动式储能技术基本原理和应用优化调控等相关技术的专业课程。移动式储能技术因具备灵活性强、响应速度快且覆盖范围广等优势而备受关注，可参与削峰填谷和配电网的经济调度、可提高灾后配电网弹性恢复能力、可作为备用电源供应偏远地区、可为应急情况提供电力支持等。本课程主要介绍移动式储能技术的发展和研究情况、锂离子电池技术、液流电池技术、钠电池技术、移动式储能技术的应用情况等内容。本课程目标是使学生熟练掌握移动式储能技术的发展历程及基本原理，掌握移动式储能技术在常规运营和供电保障中的基本运作规律，帮助学生在移动式储能应用领域搭建创新性思维，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事移动式储能技术等储能产业和研发领域的工作打下专业基础。
default.en: 《Mobile energy storage technology》is a professional course in the major of Energy Storage Science and Engineering, which involves the basic principle of mobile energy storage technology, application, optimization, regulation, and other related technologies. Mobile energy storage technology has attracted much attention due to its advantages of strong flexibility, fast response speed, and wide coverage. It can participate in the economic dispatch of peak cutting and valley filling and distribution network, improve the resilience of distribution network after disaster, supply remote areas as backup power supply, and provide power support for emergency situations. This course mainly introduces the development and research of mobile energy storage technology, lithium-ion battery technology, flow battery technology, sodium battery technology, and application of mobile energy storage technology. The goal of this course is to enable students to master the development history and basic principles of mobile energy storage technology, master the basic operation rules of mobile energy storage technology in conventional operation and power supply assurance, and help students build innovative thinking in the application field of mobile energy storage. It lays a professional foundation for students to further study relevant professional courses and work in the energy storage industry and research and development fields such as mobile energy storage technology in the future.

default.zh: 《空天储能系统及能量管理》课程是储能专业中一门涉及各种空天科技发展和能源储存和应用技术相结合的专业课程。随着空天一体化飞行器、组合循环发动机、深空探测、星球基地建设等空天科技发展目标的制定。与其相关的能源科技也面临着全新的技术挑战。储能技术作为能源综合高效利用的一项关键技术也逐渐在空天能量系统中被提及和应用。
default.en: The course “Aerospace Energy Storage and Energy Management Systems” is a professional course involving the development of various aerospace technologies and the combination of energy storage application technologies. With the development goals of aerospace science and technology such as aerospace integrated vehicle, combined cycle engine, deep space exploration, and planet base construction. Related energy technologies also face new technological challenges. Energy storage technology, as a aerospace technology of comprehensive and efficient utilization of energy, has gradually been mentioned and applied in aerospace energy systems.

default.zh: 本课程是面向能源与动力专业新能源与储能方向本科生的专业选修课。空天电热氢复合储能是指结合电解水制氢、燃料电池、余热回收等技术的新兴复合储能形式，包含太阳能、氢、电、热等多种能源转换与储存部件，多能互补，过程耦合，具有区域分布式电热氢联产、基于月球基地光伏的氢电复合补能等广泛的应用场景。 本课程的目的是使学生熟悉各种空天电热氢复合储能的基本原理、工作特性、应用范围、产业现状、最新进展及技术经济性，掌握一定的储能方案设计方法、调控方法与性能指标评价方法。在教学中综合利用先修课程中所学的有关知识及技能，通过课堂教学与讨论，培养学生在空天电热氢复合储能方面设计、计算和综合运用知识分析问题、解决问题的能力，并着重培养学生的创新精神，为今后深入学习空天电热氢复合储能领域中的内容以及从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in new energy and energy storage in the field of energy and power. Aerospace electric hydrogen composite energy storage refers to an emerging form of composite energy storage that combines technologies such as electrolysis of water for hydrogen production, fuel cells, and waste heat recovery. It includes various energy conversion and storage components such as solar energy, hydrogen, electricity, and heat, with multiple complementary energy sources and process coupling. It has a wide range of application scenarios, such as regional distributed electric hydrogen cogeneration and hydrogen electric composite energy supplementation based on lunar base photovoltaics. The purpose of this course is to familiarize students with the basic principles, working characteristics, application scope, industrial status, latest progress, and technical economy of various aerospace electric hydrogen composite energy storage systems, and to master certain energy storage scheme design methods, regulation methods, and performance index evaluation methods. By comprehensively utilizing the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses in teaching, and through classroom teaching and discussion, cultivate students' ability to design, calculate, and comprehensively apply knowledge to analyze and solve problems in the field of aerospace electric hydrogen composite energy storage, with a focus on cultivating students' innovative spirit, laying a foundation for future in-depth learning of the content in the field of aerospace electric hydrogen composite energy storage and related work.

default.zh: 《空天太阳能电池》是能源科学与工程学院能源与动力工程专业航天热科学与控制技术方向的一门专业选修课程，同时面向航空航天、材料科学、电子工程及物理学等相关专业本科生开放选修。本课程系统介绍太阳能电池在空天环境中的应用，重点阐述光伏转换基本原理、关键材料特性、电池设计与性能优化方法，以及未来技术发展趋势。课程旨在帮助学生深入理解空天太阳能电池的工作机制与系统集成，培养学生在相关领域分析、设计与创新的能力。 课程培养目标如下： 1、掌握空天太阳能电池技术的基本发展历程，了解其工程应用背景及国家空天战略需求，具备将数理、工程知识用于空天光伏系统分析的能力； 2、理解光伏物理与材料科学基础，掌握空天太阳能电池的工作原理与特性，具备初步的电池性能分析与设计能力，并能够在实践环节中体现创新意识； 3、了解空天光伏系统的组成与设计原则，能够展望新兴电池技术与发展趋势，具备在跨学科背景下开展系统级思考和初步技术评估的素质。
default.en: 《Space Solar Cells》 is a specialized elective course offered for the Aerospace Thermal Science and Control Technology track within the Energy and Power Engineering program at the School of Energy Science and Engineering. It is also open to undergraduates from related disciplines such as aerospace engineering, materials science, electronic engineering, and physics. This course systematically introduces the application of solar cells in space environments, focusing on the fundamental principles of photovoltaic conversion, key material properties, cell design and performance optimization methods, as well as future technology trends. It aims to help students develop a deep understanding of the operational mechanisms and system integration of space-based solar cells, and to cultivate their ability to analyze, design, and innovate in this field. The course objectives are as follows: 1.Master the basic development history of space solar cell technology, understand its engineering application context and national strategic needs in aerospace, and acquire the ability to apply mathematical, physical, and engineering knowledge to the analysis of aerospace photovoltaic systems. 2. Understand the fundamentals of photovoltaic physics and materials science, master the working principles and characteristics of space solar cells, develop preliminary capabilities in cell performance analysis and design, and demonstrate innovative thinking in practical applications. 3. Gain knowledge of the composition and design principles of space photovoltaic systems, be able to anticipate emerging battery technologies and development trends, and develop the ability to perform system-level thinking and preliminary technical evaluation in an interdisciplinary context.

default.zh: “能源互联网”是电力系统、能源动力及信息学科的交叉学科, 是储能、新能源科学与工程、能源互联网等相关学科的重要选修课之一，具有较广的使用范围，本课程面向大学三年级以上的学生，设置在学生了解基础电工学、热力学、自动控制等知识的基础上。 课程目的是使学生了解和掌握“双碳”能源转型背景下能源互联网的原理与技术，深刻理解能源互联网是以互联网技术为基础，以电力系统为中心，横向实现电、气、热、可再生能源等“多源互补”，纵向实现“源网荷储”各环节高度协调，生产和消费双向互动，集中于分布相结合的能源服务网络。本课程系统讲授能源互联网的发展背景、定义、功能、特征和技术架构，详细阐述能源互联网需要的关键技术，包括电力系统关键技术、能源基础设施关键技术、信息和通信关键技术、电力电子技术和平台技术，结合典型案例进行能源互联网关键技术和应用剖析，并通过课程相关的仿真实验与实践操作掌握能源互联网的规划设计及优化方法与技术。 课程任务是通过本课程的学习，使学生了解能源互联网基本原理、核心技术、产业现状以及发展脉络，为学生毕业后从事能源互联网相关专业技术和科学研究工作打下必要的基础。
default.en: “Energy Internet” is an interdisciplinary field of power systems, energy dynamics, and information technology. It is one of the important elective courses in related disciplines such as energy storage, new energy science and engineering, and energy internet. It has a wide range of applications. This course is aimed at students in their third year or above, and is designed based on their understanding of basic knowledge in electrical engineering, thermodynamics, automatic control, and other related fields. Course purpose: The purpose of the course is to enable students to understand and master the principles and technologies of the energy internet in the context of the "dual carbon" energy transformation, deeply understand that the energy internet is based on internet technology, centered on the power system, horizontally achieving "multi source complementarity" of electricity, gas, heat, renewable energy, etc., vertically achieving high coordination of various links of "source network load storage", two-way interaction between production and consumption, and focusing on a distributed energy service network. This course systematically teaches the development background, definition, function, characteristics, and technical architecture of the energy internet. It elaborates on the key technologies required for the energy internet, including key technologies in the power system, energy infrastructure, information and communication, power electronics, and platform technologies. It combines typical cases to analyze the key technologies and applications of the energy internet, and through simulation experiments and practical operations related to the course, master the planning, design, and optimization methods and technologies of the energy internet. Course Tasks: The course task is to enable students to understand the basic principles, core technologies, industry status, and development context of energy internet through the study of this course, laying a necessary foundation for students to engage in professional technology and scientific research related to energy internet after graduation.

default.zh: 《太阳能工程+AI》是一门培养学生了解和掌握太阳能工程利用的基础知识的专业课程。太阳能是最重要的可再生清洁能源，可为人类提供巨大的能源，太阳能有效利用已成为目前世界范围内可持续能源的热点研究领域。本课程旨在培养掌握太阳能工程基础理论与现代技术应用的专业人才。课程聚焦太阳辐射计算、集热系统设计、热储能优化等核心工程技术，融入人工智能辅助分析方法，使学生具备太阳能系统设计研发能力。
default.en: "Solar Energy Engineering + AI" is a professional course designed to help students acquire and master the fundamental knowledge of solar energy engineering utilization. Solar energy is the most important renewable clean energy source, capable of providing humans with vast amounts of energy. The effective utilization of solar energy has become a hot research area in sustainable energy worldwide. This course aims to cultivate professional talents who can master the basic theories and modern technology applications of solar energy engineering. The course focuses on core engineering technologies such as solar radiation calculation, collector system design, and thermal energy storage optimization, and integrates artificial intelligence-assisted analysis methods to enable students to possess the ability to design and develop solar energy systems.

default.zh: 本课程是飞行器动力工程专业的基础课，主要阐述航空发动机燃烧和燃烧室的基本概念和基本理论，研究航空发动机燃烧室的工作特点、基本要求和工作特性。在此基础上分析和讨论航空发动机燃烧室中燃料的雾化、燃烧稳定性原理、燃烧室的工作过程、熄火特性以及结构设计特点等，掌握燃烧过程的物质平衡与能量平衡的计算，了解现代高性能航空燃气轮机、超燃冲压发动机、TBCC、RBCC组合动力发动机等的燃烧技术、燃烧室设计理念的新发展及应用前景，为飞行器动力领域的专业学习和发展打下一定的基础。通过本课程的学习，旨在使学生将本科阶段获得的燃烧学基础知识从理论层面提升到初步解决实际问题的高度，能够从发动机燃烧室的技术变革中理解高效燃烧技术的精髓和发展趋势，达到培养学生创新性思维能力的目的。同时，能够让学生真正的开始审视发动机燃烧室，这一五颜六色万花簇拥下的发动机心脏的美妙科学机理，引领以更完整的专业知识结构，去进一步探索高深奥妙的航空航天发动机研究领域。
default.en: This course is a fundamental course for the specialty of aircraft power engineering, which includes basic concepts and theories of aero-engine combustion and combustors and studies their working characteristics, basic demands and performances. Based on the analysis, the fuel atomization, working process and design of combustors are discussed and the substance and energy balance of combustion process are explained. Furthermore, from this course, students can know about the new development and prospect of modern high performance combustion technologies, combustors and afterburners of the newest engines, such as the new type of high performance aerospace engine, the scramjet, hypersonic TBCC and RBCC composite engine, etc. Therefore, this is an important course in the teaching of aircraft power engineering, which helps to cultivate the ability to solve practical engineering problems, understand the essence of combustion technological, and achieve the purpose of creative ability. Through the study of this course, students can really begin to examine the wonderful scientific mechanism of the engine heart, the engine combustion chamber, surrounded by colorful flowers, and lead to a more complete professional knowledge structure, to further explore the profound aerospace engine research field.

default.zh: 本课程是面向飞行器动力工程专业本科生开设的一门专业课，它基于学习推进系统的设计过程是飞行器动力工程专业教学计划中的核心环节这一初衷，重点讲授航空推进系统的总体设计方法及其数值仿真实训、飞推一体化设计方法与设计过程的多学科优化匹配原理、完整地设计一台完成预定任务的航空发动机所需要的专业知识与设计工具等相关课程内容。通过本课程的学习，让学生充分理解航空发动机设计问题的本质，为学生将来从事飞行器-发动机系统集成设计以及推进系统总体设计相关研究奠定坚实的专业理论基础，并提升其解决工程实际问题的综合能力。
default.en: This course is one of professional courses of craft power engineering major for the undergraduates. It is based on the original intention of learning that the design process of propulsion system is the core link in the teaching plan of aero-engine major. The system design methods and its numerical simulation practice for aeronautical propulsion system, the multi-disciplinary optimization and matching principle of design method and process in the engine and craft coupled system, the professional knowledge and design tools required to completely design an aero-engine to complete the predetermined task and other related course contents will be presented. Through the study of this course, students can fully understand the nature of aero-engine design problem, build a solid professional theoretical foundation for students to engage in craft and engine integrated system design and related system design research in the future, and improve their comprehensive ability to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 回顾人类对飞行的探索，低速-高速-超音速-高超音速，动力装置间断式的跨越发展蕴含着“物竞天择，适者生存”的必然逻辑。火箭发动机在空天任务中是不可或缺的环节，吸气式发动机在大气层内飞行具有高比冲优势。同时，长航时侦察、高超声速飞行、空天往返、可重复使用等工作任务对飞行器设计提出了新的需求，面向未来的飞行器动力技术亟待创新。因此，有必要梳理飞行器动力装置发展脉络，了解飞行器动力装置的性能优势区，研究多种发动机有机组合的创新型动力形式。 本课程以飞行器动力需求与实际代价约束为牵引，剖析喷气式推进的动量守恒物理基础，重点梳理当前各种飞行器动力装置发展脉络，传授从发现新需求到运用所学知识解决新需求的创新性思维研究方法论。提升学生对当前新型飞行器动力技术发展历程的理解，帮助其了解各种动力装置热力循环的工作特点，具备独立分析各类飞行器动力装置工作特性的能力。同时，开拓学生创新性思维、培养学生自主思考，领悟飞行器动力技术创新过程的思想方法，提高学生运用创新手段分析和解决问题的能力，激发学生寻求新场景、新需求下的新型飞行器动力装置形式。
default.en: Review of human exploration of low speed to high speed to supersonic and then hypersonic flight, the intermittent leap in propulsion development contains the inevitable logic of superiority and inferiority. Rocket engines are an integral part of aerospace missions. Air-breathing engines have the advantage of high specific impulse when flying in the atmosphere. Meanwhile, tasks such as long-endurance reconnaissance, hypersonic flight, space shuttle, and reusability have put forward new requirements for the vehicle design, and future-oriented vehicle power technology is in urgent need of innovation. Therefore, it is necessary to sort out the development of aircraft power technology, learn the performance advantages of different engines, and study the innovative combined power forms. This course analyzes the physical basis of momentum conservation in jet propulsion, taking the demand for aircraft power and the actual cost constraints as the traction. The course focuses on the development of various aircraft power units and teaches innovative thinking research methodology from discovering to solving new needs with the knowledge learned. Students will deepen their understanding of the development of current new aircraft power technology, understand the thermal cycle of various engines, and can independently analyze the operating characteristics of various types of aircraft power units. Meanwhile, the course will develop students’ innovative thinking and independent thinking and improve students’ ability to analyze and solve problems using innovative means. Further, students will be encouraged to seek new forms of aircraft power units for new scenarios and new needs.

default.zh: 高超声速技术是当前航空航天发展的前沿，其推力动力装置主要以双模态冲压发动机和组合动力装置为主，掌握冲压发动机、高超组合动力的工作原理以及当前的技术发展趋势具有重要意义。 通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握亚燃冲压发动机、超燃冲压发动机和组合发动机的工作原理、特点、发展历程、发展趋势和发展方向，培养学生对高超声速推进技术的兴趣和爱好，提高学生对双模态冲压发动机和组合动力装置多个工作过程的认知水平，为今后从事航空航天推进动力装置方面的研究打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Hypersonic technology is the leading edge of the current aerospace development. Its thrust power devices are mainly dual-mode ramjet engines and combined power devices. It is of great significance to master the working principles of ramjet engines and hypersonic combined power and the current technology development trend. Through the study of this course, students can master the working principle, characteristics, development process, development trend and development direction of sub combustion ramjet, scramjet and combined engine, cultivate students' interest and interest in hypersonic propulsion technology, and improve students' cognitive level of multiple working processes of dual-mode ramjet and combined power plant, It will lay a solid foundation for future research on aerospace propulsion power plant.

default.zh: 航空发动机前沿技术以现代典型航空发动机总体性能设计和结构特征分析为重点，分别对先进发动机各主要部件特性、总体性能、先进结构设计、新结构、新工艺、新材料在发动机上的应用和典型结构故障分析进行系统阐述，同时也探索了现代航空燃气涡轮发动机设计技术的发展方向。具体的本课程将围绕国内外涡喷系列、涡扇系列、涡浆系类和涡轴系列发动机，通过理论讲解和模型展示等手段，展示不同种类航空发动机的发展历程和结构特性，带领同学感受航空发动机设计中的神奇之处，培养同学对航空领域的兴趣。
default.en: Discussion on the progress and innovation of advanced aeroengine focuses on the overall performance design and structural characteristics analysis of modern typical aeroengines. It systematically describes the characteristics, overall performance, advanced structural design, new structure, new process, new material application in engines and typical structural failure analysis of advanced engines, and also explores the development direction of modern aero gas turbine engine design technology. The specific course will focus on the turbojet series, turbofan series, turboprop series and turboshaft series engines at home and abroad, demonstrate the development process and structural characteristics of different types of aeroengines by means of theoretical explanation and model display, lead students to experience the wonders of aeroengine design, and cultivate students' interest in the aviation field.

default.zh: 本课程是飞行器动力工程专业的必修课。智能发动机技术以发动机运行过程的数字化、自动化、信息化、标准化为基础，以管控一体化、大数据、云计算、物联网为平台，集成智能传感与执行、智能控制与优化、智能管理与决策等技术，形成一种具备自学习、自适应、自趋优、自恢复、自组织的智能发动机运行控制管理模式，在复杂时变环境下实现更加安全、高效的运行目标。 本课程的任务是使学生了解航空发动机的发展历程和未来发展趋势，掌握面向未来的智能发动机总体架构，掌握未来发动机即将采用的智能化技术，主要包括智能部件、智能感知、智能诊断、智能控制和智能维护等。本课程意在使学生对未来航空发动机推进技术有所了解和认识，为日后从事相关吸气式推进装置研究工作奠定理论基础。
default.en: This course is a required course for aircraft power engineering. The intelligent engine technology is based on the digitalization, automation, informatization and standardization of the engine operation process, with the integration of management and control, big data, cloud computing, and the Internet of Things as the platform, integrating technologies such as intelligent sensing and execution, intelligent control and optimization, intelligent management and decision-making, and forming an intelligent engine operation control management mode with self-learning, adaptive, self optimizing, self recovering, and self-organization, In the complex time-varying environment, it can achieve more safe and efficient operation goals. The task of this course is to enable students to understand the development history and future development trend of aeroengines, master the overall architecture of future oriented intelligent engines, and master the intelligent technologies to be adopted by future engines, mainly including intelligent components, intelligent perception, intelligent diagnosis, intelligent control, intelligent maintenance, etc. This course is intended to enable students to understand and understand the future aeroengine propulsion technology, and lay a theoretical foundation for future research on air breathing propulsion devices.

default.zh: 《电推进仿真计算实训》是面向飞行器动力工程专业方向高年级本科生的一门专业选修课。课程主要教学内容包括：概述、稀薄气体流动模拟方法、电推进电磁学模拟方法、等离子体放电模拟方法、电推进装置热学仿真、电推进装置力学仿真。课程的主要目标是建立学生对电推进等离子体放电模拟的兴趣，掌握电推进装置的基本原理，培养学生电推进装置数值模拟研究的思维方式和研究方法。（1）了解电推进等离子体常见的模拟方法和模拟软件；（2）能够进行电推进相关数值模拟工作，为学生日后从事电推进装置及相关领域的设计模拟工作或进一步深造打下一定的专业基础；（3）提高理论结合实际、工程实践、逻辑思维和创新能力。
default.en: Electric propulsion Plasma Simulation Training is an elective course for senior undergraduate students majoring in aerodynamic engineering. The main contents of the course include: overview, thin gas flow simulation method, electric propulsion electromagnetism simulation method, plasma discharge simulation method, electric propulsion thermal simulation, electric propulsion mechanical simulation. The main objectives of the course are to establish students' interest in plasma discharge simulation, master the basic principles of electric propulsion devices, and train students' thinking and research methods for numerical simulation of electric propulsion devices. (1) Understanding common simulation methods and software for electric propulsion plasma; (2) To be able to carry out numerical simulation of electrical propulsion, and to lay a professional foundation for students to engage in design and simulation of electrical propulsion devices and related fields in the future or to further study; (3) Improving the ability of combining theory with practice, engineering practice, logical thinking and innovation.

default.zh: 近年来航天电推进技术快速发展，国内外多个大规模星座均使霍尔和离子电推进进行轨道提升、位置保持、碰撞规避和快速离轨。阴极作为电子源与中和器，是现有航天电推进系统的关键核心部组件，被誉为电推进的心脏，阴极电子发射特性的衰减会直接导致推进系统的永久性失效，因此阴极已经成为航天电推进技术的关键支撑。 本课程以此为背景并结合当前国际上电推进阴极技术的研究前沿，开展空心阴极、射频与微波阴极以及无工质阴极等方向的教学，重点阐述空心阴极的工作原理、描述模型、失效机理和不稳定特性等，讲解空心阴极与霍尔推力器、离子推力器的耦合原理，补充介绍射频与微波电离产生等离子体原理，了解冷等离子体电子引出机制及其应用场景，介绍真空场发射电子引出原理、工作特性及应用领域，使学生掌握多种电推进电子源与中和器工作原理、基本构型和工作特性，培养学生逻辑思维能力、创新意识和工程设计能力。课程主要通过专业理论、文献调研与大作业以及实践教学相结合的形式展开，在培养学生科研能力的同时，还着重强调拓宽学术视野，加深学生对科学研究和工程实践之间的联系与认识。
default.en: Electric propulsion technology is developing rapidly. Hall thrusters and ion thrusters are being deployed for orbit transfer, position-keeping, collision avoidance and de-orbit of satellites in many constellation programs. Onboard the thrusters, the cathode, known as the heart of electric propulsion, is a key component. It functions as the electron source and the neutralizer. The decay of the electron emission characteristics of the cathode will instantly lead to the permanent failure of the propulsion system. Therefore, the cathode has always been the key support of aerospace electric propulsion technology. This course gives lectures on hollow cathodes, radio-frequency cathodes, microwave cathodes and propellant-less cathodes in combination with the current international research frontier of electric propulsion cathode technology based on above background. Then this course will discuss the working principle, description model, failure mechanism and instability characteristics of hollow cathodes. After that, this course will supplement the coupling principle of hollow cathodes with Hall thrusters and ion thrusters, and the principle of plasma generation by radio-frequency and microwave ionization, the extraction mechanism of electrons in low temperature plasma and the field emission in vacuum surrounding. The scope of this course is to enable students to grasp the working principles, structures and characteristics of several kinds of plasma neutralizers, and to cultivate critical thinking, innovation mindness and engineering capabilities. The course includes theoretical explanation, article reading, essays and practical operations. These will cultivate the scientific potiential and academic overview of students, and deepen the connection between research and engineering.

default.zh: 本课程面向能源与动力工程专业的本科生，讲授飞机电推进目前的发展以及电推进装置的主要原理和结构，使学生了解飞机电推进装置的各组成部件及其工作原理；掌握全电电推进和混合电推进的理论及其基本性能参数计算方法；重点了解几种先进电推进的发展特点以及技术特点。
default.en: This course is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in energy and power engineering. It teaches the current development of aircraft electric propulsion and the main principles and structures of electric propulsion devices, so that students can understand the components of aircraft electric propulsion devices and their working principles. Master the theory of all-electric propulsion and hybrid propulsion and the calculation method of basic performance parameters; Focus on understanding the development characteristics and technical characteristics of several advanced electric propulsion.

default.zh: 本课程的目的是使学生对静电加速和霍尔加速电推进装置的结构有清晰的理解，掌握其结构特征和主要工作特点，具有独立完成主要功能结构设计的能力，为飞行器动力工程专业的学生从事相关专业研究奠定基础。 课程培养目标如下： 1、熟悉静电加速和霍尔加速电推进装置的多种结构形式、工作特点、一般设计流程、材料工艺及方法； 2、掌握初步的设计能力，为从事相关工作打好基础； 3、具备一定的学术报告撰写能力。
default.en: The purpose of this course is to enable students to gain a clear understanding of the structures of electrostatic acceleration and Hall acceleration electric propulsion devices, master their structural characteristics and main operating features, and acquire the ability to independently complete the design of key functional structures. It aims to lay a solid foundation for students majoring in Aircraft power engineering to engage in relevant professional research. The specific training objectives of the course are as follows: 1. Familiarizing with various structural forms, operating characteristics, general design processes, material technologies and methods of electrostatic acceleration and Hall acceleration electric propulsion devices; 2. Mastering basic design capabilities to lay a good foundation for engaging in related work; 3. Developing a certain ability to write academic reports.

default.zh: 《微纳卫星电推进技术》是面向飞行器动力工程专业方向高年级本科生的一门专业选修课。课程主要教学内容包括：概述、微纳卫星电推进装置主要物理过程与系统构成、霍尔电推进、离子电推进、场致发射电推进、其他微推进装置、微纳卫星典型动力任务及推进系统设计、新一代高精度空间科学探测卫星电推进设计。课程的主要目标是面向我国航天动力对电推进技术的迫切需求，基于新兴的微纳卫星电推进装置，建立学生对微纳卫星电推进技术的兴趣，掌握微纳卫星电推进装置的基本原理，培养学生电推进装置设计的思维方式和研究方法。（1）掌握常见的微纳卫星电推进装置及技术特点；（2）能够进行微纳卫星电推进的设计，为学生日后从事电推进装置及相关领域工作或进一步深造打下一定的专业基础；（3）提高理论结合实际、工程实践、逻辑思维和创新能力。
default.en: Electric Propulsion Technology on Micro Nano Satellite is an elective course for advanced undergraduate students majoring in aircraft power engineering. The main teaching contents of the course include: overview, main physical processes and system composition of the micro-nano satellite electric propulsion device, Hall electric propulsion, ion electric propulsion, field-launched electric propulsion, other micro-propulsion devices, typical microsatellite power mission and propulsion system design, and electric propulsion design of a new generation of high-precision space science exploration satellites. The main objectives of the course are to meet the urgent needs of space power for electric propulsion technology in our country, establish students' interest in electric propulsion technology, master the basic principles of electric propulsion device, and train students' thinking way and research method of electric propulsion device design. (1) Mastering common micro-nano satellite electric propulsion devices and technical characteristics; (2) Being able to design microsatellite electric propulsion, which will provide students with a professional basis for future work in electric propulsion and related fields or for further study; (3) Improving the ability of combining theory with practice, engineering practice, logical thinking and innovation.

default.zh: AI智能气动设计及优化是近年来空气动力学与人工智能交叉领域的前沿方向，旨在通过机器学习、深度学习、强化学习等技术，提升气动外形设计、流场预测和优化效率，降低传统方法（如计算流体力学仿真CFD和风洞实验）的高昂成本。AI智能气动设计通过数据驱动与物理气动设计的结合，正在颠覆传统设计流程，实现从“经验驱动”到“智能驱动”的转变。其在航空航天、新能源汽车、绿色能源等领域的应用潜力巨大，未来有望成为工程设计的标准范式。课程讲授内容包括AI智能气动设计及优化中涵盖的几何参数化建模、流场预测模型、多目标与多学科优化以及数字孪生与实时控制等内容，旨在通过跨学科知识整合、工程实践赋能和伦理意识培养，塑造能够应对未来智能工程挑战的高端人才。
default.en: AI-Based Intelligent Aerodynamic Design and Optimization is a cutting-edge interdisciplinary field combining aerodynamics and artificial intelligence (AI). It leverages machine learning, deep learning, and reinforcement learning to enhance aerodynamic shape design, flow field prediction, and optimization efficiency, while significantly reducing the high costs associated with traditional methods (e.g., computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations and wind tunnel experiments). By integrating data-driven approaches with physics-based aerodynamic design, AI-driven methods are revolutionizing conventional workflows, shifting from "experience-driven" to "intelligence-driven" paradigms. This field holds immense potential in aerospace, new energy vehicles, green energy, and other sectors, and is poised to become a standard framework in future engineering design. The curriculum covers key topics in AI-based aerodynamic design and optimization, including: Geometric parametric modeling; Flow field prediction models; Multi-objective and multidisciplinary optimization; Digital twins and real-time control. Through interdisciplinary knowledge integration, hands-on engineering practice, and ethical awareness training, this course aims to cultivate high-end talent capable of addressing future challenges in intelligent engineering.

default.zh: 能源技术发展到今天，智能化和节能成为主旋律，区域能源系统是实现这一目标的关键，是国家能源学科发展的重要方向。 区域能源系统是一种利用多能互补和智慧能源技术的区域级综合能源系统，该系统可实现能源的梯级利用，提高综合能源利用效率，减少污染物排放。区域能源系统能量来源和用户终端多样化，是一个涉及多能流、多尺度、多学科、多领域的复杂系统。 为此，本课程以完成区域能源系统设计为目标，采用项目式的分组合作进行研讨式学习，培养学生沟通能力、项目管理能力、团队合作协同攻关的能力。
default.en: Nowadays, with the development of energy technology, intelligence and energy conservation have become the main theme. Distributed energy system is the key to achieve this goal and an important direction of the national energy discipline. The distributed energy system is a regional integrated energy system that uses multi energy complementation and smart energy technology. The system can realize the step utilization of energy, improve the integrated energy utilization efficiency and reduce pollutant emissions. The distributed energy system has diversified energy sources and user terminals, which is a complex system involving multiple energy flows, multi-scale, multidisciplinary and multi subject. For this reason, this course aims to design a distributed energy system for a special purpose. Group cooperation based on project is adopted with discussion learning approach. The abilities of communication, project management, team cooperation to tackle key problems will be improved.

default.zh: 《粒子模拟算法与应用》是一门面向理工科学生的课程，旨在介绍粒子模拟的基本原理、算法实现及其在物理、化学、生物、材料、工程等领域的广泛应用。通过本课程，学生将学习粒子运动方程的数值求解方法（如Verlet算法）、粒子间相互作用形式、以及场与粒子的耦合过程，并通过编程实践掌握粒子模拟的基本技能。课程采用理论讲解与案例分析相结合的教学方式，帮助学生培养解决实际问题的能力，为未来的科研和工程实践奠定基础。
default.en: Particle Simulation Algorithms and Applications is a course designed for students in science and engineering disciplines, aiming to introduce the fundamental principles, algorithmic implementations, and wide-ranging applications of particle simulation in fields such as physics, chemistry, biology, materials science, and engineering. Through this course, students will learn numerical methods for solving particle motion equations (e.g., the Verlet algorithm), forms of particle interactions, and the coupling processes between fields and particles. They will also gain hands-on programming experience to master the essential skills of particle simulation. The course combines theoretical instruction with case studies, helping students develop problem-solving abilities and laying a solid foundation for future research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 本课程针对航空发动机和燃气轮机中的关键部件——压气机和涡轮，讲授压气机和涡轮的三维气动设计方法，并通过项目学习增强理解和掌握。本课程从叶轮机械的基本理论出发，将学生的专业知识拓展到叶轮机械三维气动设计领域，更加侧重理论知识的应用方法，提高学生独立分析能力和科研素养。 本课程在以下三方面给予学生具体指导：（1）学习并掌握压气机/涡轮的三维气动设计基础理论及方法——包括气动设计体系、几何和气动参数的选取、子午流道设计方法、叶型设计方法、以及叶片三维积叠设计方法等等；（2）培养独立设计压气机/涡轮的叶型设计、子午通流设计、以及三维叶片设计能力；（3）通过数值模拟验证学生提出的气动设计方案，激发学生的学习兴趣，促进学生更加深入的学习和探索，提高学生在叶轮机械领域的独立工作能力和科研素养。
default.en: This course provides three dimensional aerodynamic design theory and method of the key parts of aircraft engines and gas turbine - compressor and turbine, and through the way of project learning to enhance the effect of student understanding and mastering. This course contains not only the turbomachinery machine basic theory, but also the turbomachinery aerodynamic design method, and lays a lot of emphasis on the application of theoretical knowledge, in order to improve the students' independent analysis ability and scientific literacy. This course gives specific guidance to students in the following three areas: 1. To learn and master the three-dimensional aerodynamic design basic theory and method of gas compressor / turbine, including the aerodynamic design process, selection of geometric and aerodynamic parameters, the meridian channel design method, blade profile design method, and three-dimensional stacked design method etc. 2. Independently work capability of gas compressor / turbine, including blade profile design, the meridian channel design, and three-dimensional blade design. 3. Numerical simulation validation of the aerodynamic design provided by students, to stimulate the student's study interest, to promote the student further study and the exploration, to enhance student's independent work ability and scientific literacy in the turbomachinery machine domain.

default.zh: 微纳米流体力学是近年来在流体力学、表界面科学及其交叉学科领域中发展起来的一个全新学科分支。诺贝尔物理学奖得主理查·费曼曾在“There’s plenty of room at the bottom”一文中指出，在微小化物质领域存在大量有价值的科学问题。随着物质尺寸的不断微小化，其表面积与体积之比迅速增大，使得纳米微流体呈现出与宏观尺度下截然不同的流动特征及规律，表界面效应逐渐凸显，从而带来一系列崭新的物理现象，以及十分广阔的应用前景和潜在的重大经济价值。例如，在微机电领域（MEMS）和微流控芯片（Microchips）中，通过对微尺度流体输运的精确控制，实现了化学分析、药物筛选、细胞培养等多种功能。本课程旨在使学生深入了解目前国际上关于微纳尺度流体力学以及表界面学等领域的最新基础研究与应用成果，激发学生的科研探索兴趣，并培养其应用创新能力。课程将强调对生活中和工业生产中常见现象的物理机制分析方法，训练学生从实际问题中抽象出典型微纳米流体问题的能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握微纳米尺度下流体流动的基本概念与规律，并能够运用这些基本原理分析常见生活及工程问题，同时了解微纳流控技术在能源动力、机械、生物、材料与化学工程等领域的具体应用。
default.en: Micro/nanofluidics is a novel disciplinary branch that has emerged in recent years within the fields of fluid mechanics, interfacial science and the interdisciplinary domains. Nobel laureate Richard Feynman highlighted in his seminal essay "There’s Plenty of Room at the Bottom" the abundance of valuable scientific challenges in the realm of miniaturized matter. As material dimensions shrink to microscopic scales, the surface-to-volume ratio increases dramatically, endowing nano/microfluidic systems with flow characteristics and principles fundamentally distinct from those observed at macroscopic scales. This pronounced interfacial dominance gives rise to novel physical phenomena, along with expansive application prospects and significant potential economic value. For instance, in microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) and microfluidic chips, precise control of microscale fluid transport has enabled diverse functionalities ranging from chemical analysis and drug screening to cell culture. This course aims to provide students with an in-depth understanding of cutting-edge fundamental research and applied advancements in micro/nanofluidics and interfacial science on the international stage, while stimulating scientific curiosity and fostering applied innovation capabilities. This course also emphasizes analytical methodologies for deciphering physical mechanisms underlying common phenomena in daily life and industrial processes, training students to abstract practical challenges into representative micro/nanofluidic problems. Through systematic learning, students will master fundamental concepts governing fluid behavior at micro/nano scales, acquire the ability to apply these principles to analyze real-world and engineering problems, and gain insights into concrete applications of micro/nanofluidic technologies across energy systems, mechanical engineering, biotechnology, materials science, and chemical engineering.
