default.zh: 《湍流模型基本理论及应用》课程通过介绍计算流体力学（CFD）仿真中常用湍流模型的基本概念和基本理论，以及在湍流数值计算中的工程应用，使学生学习湍流模型的基本提出思路和使用方法。课程将使用最简单、直接的教学方式和工具，提供可以线上运行的算例，降低对学生的先修课程要求，提高跨学科、跨专业选修此课程的可能性。本课程旨在帮助学生花费较少的代价，在课程结束时掌握数值计算、湍流理论和湍流模型等方面的基本理论知识，熟悉应用流程，为后续的科研和专业课打下基础。本课程的主要目标是使学生系统掌握湍流模型及其在计算流体力学中的应用，培养解决实际工程问题和科研探索能力。
default.en: The course "Fundamental Theory and Applications of Turbulence Models" introduces the basic concepts and fundamental theories of commonly used turbulence models in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations, as well as their engineering applications in numerical turbulence calculations. Students will learn the principles behind turbulence model development and their practical implementation. The course adopts a simple and direct teaching approach, utilizing accessible tools and providing online executable examples to minimize prerequisite requirements. This makes it more accessible for students from diverse academic backgrounds and disciplines. By the end of the course, students will have acquired essential theoretical knowledge in numerical computation, turbulence theory, and turbulence modeling, as well as familiarity with application processes. This will provide a solid foundation for future research and advanced coursework. The primary objective of the course is to equip students with a systematic understanding of turbulence models and their applications in CFD, while fostering problem-solving skills for real-world engineering challenges and scientific research.

default.zh: 在全球能源结构加速转型的背景下，太阳能作为最具开发潜力的可再生能源之一，已成为实现碳达峰与碳中和目标的核心支柱。本课程立足于能源科学、热物理与材料工程的交叉领域，系统阐述太阳能热利用的关键理论与技术进展，通过理论与实践结合的教学模式，引导学生掌握太阳能从资源评估到能量转换、存储及系统集成的全链条知识体系，培养解决复杂光热工程问题的能力。 第一部分：能源挑战与太阳能使命 课程以全球能源现状为切入点，剖析化石能源引发的环境危机与资源瓶颈，揭示可再生能源发展的紧迫性。通过对比风能、水能及生物质能的技术经济性，阐明太阳能的独特优势——广泛分布、零碳排放与近乎无限的资源储量。回溯太阳能利用历史，从公元前人类利用凸透镜聚光取火，至20世纪真空管集热器与光伏电池的技术突破，梳理政策扶持、材料创新与工程实践如何共同推动太阳能从辅助能源跃升为未来能源主力。作为课程导引，本部分将明确课程目标：围绕光热转换的核心场景，构建从太阳辐射物理本质到复杂热力系统设计的完整知识框架。 第二部分：太阳辐射的定量化解析 太阳能利用的起点是精准评估辐射资源的时空分布。课程从太阳核聚变能量释放机制出发，解析太阳常数（1361 W/m2）的物理意义及其与地日距离的动态关联。基于大气层对辐射的散射、吸收作用（如臭氧层对紫外线的过滤，水蒸气对红外波段的削弱），建立地外辐射至地表接收的衰减模型。为应对工程实际需求，课程重点引入倾斜表面辐射接收量的计算方法，结合天文几何参数（太阳高度角、赤纬角）与大气透射率修正，指导学生掌握集热器布局优化的理论工具。 第三部分：传热科学与材料特性的共轭耦合 太阳能集热系统的效率优化依赖于对传热过程与材料辐射特性的深刻理解。课程深入探讨集热器的能量传递三环节：吸热板对光能的高效吸收、热能向传热介质的定向转移，以及透明盖板与保温层对热损失的最小化控制。通过引入努塞尔数关联式与热损系数模型，定量分析对流、传导与辐射的交互作用。同时，聚焦光谱选择性材料（如黑铬涂层）的“高吸收-低发射”特性，揭示其如何突破传统黑体材料的热辐射限制，为低温、中温及高温集热场景提供差异化的材料解决方案。 第四部分：集热装置与热存储技术创新 作为光热转换的核心设备，太阳能集热器的性能直接决定系统能效。课程以平板式集热器为典型范例，剖析其吸热流道设计、选择性涂层应用与真空保温技术的协同机制，结合效率方程（η=η？？aΔT/G）阐释温度差、辐照度与热损的动力学平衡。对比分析真空管与平板集热器在低温热水与中温热发电场景的适用性差异。针对太阳能的间歇性挑战，课程系统讲解显热储热（水罐储热的热力学响应）、潜热储热（相变材料的固-液相变调控）及热化学储能（如金属氧化物可逆反应的高能量密度优势），探讨不同储热方式在响应速度、容量与成本上的工程取舍策略。 第五部分：从组件到系统的集成实践 太阳能热水系统与热发电技术的教学模块，着力于培养学生的系统工程思维。在太阳能热水系统设计中，课程以热力学循环为脉络，详解集热器阵列、储热水箱、循环泵与辅助加热设备的匹配逻辑，结合季节辐照度变化与热负荷需求，指导学生完成系统容量配置与管路优化。在热发电技术领域，聚焦槽式聚光（抛物面反射镜的线聚焦特性）与塔式聚光（定日镜场的点聚焦能流汇聚）两大主流技术，对比分析传热工质（导热油、熔融盐）的温度适应性，探讨布雷顿循环与斯特林循环的热功转换效率边界，并通过案例研究（如西班牙Gemasolar电站的24小时持续发电实践）印证技术可行性。 第六部分：辐射特性测量的实验赋能 面向工程实践需求，课程设置光谱选择性测量的实验教学环节。通过演示光谱仪对材料法向反射率、透射率的精准测定，揭示涂层表面的光谱响应特性与集热效率的关联规律。进一步引入积分球装置测量材料的半球反射率，深化学生对各向异性辐射行为的认知。基于实验数据，指导学生完成选择性吸收涂层的性能评估报告，并尝试提出针对特定应用场景（如高温聚焦式集热）的材料改性方案。 本课程突破传统能源学科的理论边界，强调多物理场耦合分析（光-热-材料-流体）与工程经济性评价的双重视角。通过理论推演、数值仿真与实验操作的有机结合，使学生能够独立完成太阳能热利用系统的初步设计与性能预测，并理解技术创新的潜在方向（如纳米流体强化传热、人工智能驱动的聚光场控制）。课程最终目标是为能源行业输送具备扎实理论基础、创新意识与实践能力的复合型人才，助力太阳能技术在建筑供暖、工业蒸汽与清洁电力领域的规模化应用。
default.en: This course examines solar energy as a critical solution to global energy challenges, combining theoretical foundations in thermodynamics, optics, and materials science with practical engineering applications. Students will master solar resource assessment, thermal conversion processes, storage technologies, and system integration strategies to address real-world energy demands. 1. Energy Transition and Solar Energy's Role The course begins by analyzing the environmental and geopolitical risks of fossil fuels, emphasizing solar energy's potential for scalability and sustainability. A historical overview traces milestones like the discovery of the photovoltaic effect and modern CSP (Concentrated Solar Power) systems. By contrasting solar with other renewables, students gain insights into its unique advantages: geographic flexibility, low maintenance, and compatibility with energy storage. 2. Solar Radiation Dynamics The physics of solar radiation is explored, starting with fusion reactions in the Sun and the concept of extraterrestrial solar flux (1,361 W/m2). Atmospheric effects—including scattering by aerosols and absorption by ozone—are modeled to predict ground-level irradiance. Students learn to calculate radiation on inclined surfaces using solar geometry (declination, hour angles) and atmospheric transmittance, enabling optimized solar field layouts. 3. Heat Transfer and Material Innovations The interplay between heat transfer and material properties drives solar collector efficiency. Conduction-convection-radiation coupling is analyzed, with formulas like the Nusselt correlation quantifying convective losses. Spectrally selective coatings are highlighted for their ability to maximize solar absorption (>90%) while minimizing thermal emission (<10%), with case studies on black chromium and advanced nanoceramic films. 4. Collector Technologies and Thermal Storage Flat-plate and evacuated tube collectors are compared in terms of cost, temperature ranges, and climatic adaptability. For instance, vacuum insulation in tubes reduces convective losses, enabling efficient operation in cold regions. Thermal storage solutions—sensible heat (water tanks), latent heat (phase-change materials like paraffin), and thermochemical systems (metal oxide redox reactions)—are evaluated for capacity, response time, and scalability. 5. System Integration: From Water Heating to Power Generation Design principles for solar water heating systems cover collector sizing, heat exchanger configurations, and antifreeze strategies for cold climates. In CSP technologies, parabolic troughs (using synthetic oil) and solar towers (molten salt storage) are analyzed for their operational temperatures (>400°C) and synergy with Rankine cycles. Case studies demonstrate 24/7 power generation through hybrid systems integrating thermal storage. 6. Experimental Characterization Lab sessions focus on measuring radiative properties. Spectrophotometry identifies the absorption/emission spectra of materials, while integrating spheres quantify hemispherical reflectance. Students correlate these properties with collector efficiency and propose material optimizations. Graduates will master multiphysics modeling of solar thermal systems, assess techno-economic viability, and innovate solutions for energy storage and grid integration. The course bridges academia and industry, preparing students for roles in clean energy R&D, system design, and policy advocacy.

default.zh: 氢能原理与技术课程以培养氢能全产业链科学和技术人才为目标，涵盖基础理论、核心技术和实践应用模块，学生需具备数学、物理、化学、英语等基础知识，课程将强化数理化基础与工程思维，课程核心内容涵盖制氢技术：电解水制氢、天然气重整、生物质制氢等，储运技术：高压气态储氢、低温液态储氢、固体储氢材料等，应用技术：燃料电池技术、氢燃气轮机、氢动力循环系统等，并探讨氢能安全与综合能源：氢安全、氢能及综合能源系统、氢能燃烧技术等。课程具备跨学科融合特性：融合动力工程、材料科学、电化学等方向，目标培养双碳领域复合型人才。
default.en: The Hydrogen Energy Principles and Technology course aims to cultivate scientific and technical talents of the whole hydrogen energy industry chain, covering basic theory, core technology and practical application modules. Students are required to have basic knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry, English, etc. The course will strengthen the basic knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry and engineering thinking, and the core content of the course covers hydrogen production technology:

default.zh: 我国发电用煤占煤炭消耗量的60%左右，在役电站锅炉90%以上采用煤粉燃烧方式。煤粉燃烧普遍存在NOx排放量高、稳燃能力差、结渣、高温腐蚀等问题。NOx是产生雾霾的主要前驱物之一。迫切需要通过燃烧理论的创新，为开发高效、稳燃、防结渣及高温腐蚀、低污染煤燃烧技术提供理论支撑。本课程在燃烧基本知识介绍的基础上，通过介绍三高区理论、水平浓淡燃烧理论、中心给粉燃烧理论、多次引射分级燃烧理论，引导学生理解和掌握煤燃烧理论的创新历程，了解燃烧理论在洁净低碳发电技术的应用以及理论的创新带来的技术创新和突破。掌握通过实验的总结、分析，凝炼、提出理论的科学研究方法。培养学生的创新意识和研发能力。课程主要通过课堂讲授及研讨交流的形式展开。在培养学生科研能力的同时，还着重强调拓宽学术视野，加深学生对科学研究和工程实践之间联系的认识。
default.en: In China, coal used for power generation accounts for about 60% of coal consumption, and more than 90% of utility boilers in service use pulverized coal for combustion. There are many problems in pulverized coal combustion, such as high NOx emissions, poor combustion stability, slagging and high temperature corrosion. NOx is one of the major precursors of the fog and haze. It is urgent to meet the combustion with high combustion efficiency and low NO x emission, and to solve the problems of flame stability, slagging and fire side high-temperature corrosion of furnace water-cooled wall tubes through the innovation of coal combustion theory. Based on the introduction of the basic knowledge of combustion, this course introduces the three high zones theory, the horizontal bias combustion theory, the central-fuel-rich swirling combustion theory and the multiple-injection and multiple-staging combustion theory, so as to guide students to understand and master the innovation process of combustion theory. It makes students fully understand the application of coal combustion theory in clean power generation technology and the technological innovation and breakthrough bring by theory development. Students can experience the scientific research methods of summarizing, analyzing, condensing and putting forward theories through doing experiments by themselves. It can cultivate the innovative consciousness, research and development ability of students. Classes are conducted in the forms of lectures and discussions. While cultivating students' research capabilities, it also emphasizes broadening academic horizons and deepening students' understanding of the connection between scientific research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 通过课程认知实习，使学生将所学的理论知识与现实应用场景结合起来，使学生了解和掌握基本应用方向和方式。培养学生理论联系实际，开拓学生视野，引领学生树立航天报国之志，将所学理论更好地应用于实践，同时加深学生与学院飞行器动力工程专业实验室间的交流联系。使学生了解我国航空航天动力技术发展现状，培养学生作为航天人的家国情怀，点燃学生作为航天人的骄傲自豪和使命感，成为指引他们投身中国航天事业的明灯。
default.en: Through course cognitive internships, students can combine their theoretical knowledge with practical application scenarios, enabling them to understand and master basic application directions and methods. Cultivate students to connect theory with practice, broaden their horizons, lead them to establish the aspiration of serving the country through aerospace, better apply the theories they have learned to practice, and deepen the communication and connection between students and the laboratory of the college's Aerospace Power Engineering major. To enable students to understand the current development status of China's aerospace power technology, cultivate their patriotism as astronauts, ignite their pride and sense of mission as astronauts, and become a guiding light for them to devote themselves to China's aerospace industry.

default.zh: 通过认知实习，让学生能够基于工程相关背景知识进行合理分析，评价专业工程实践和复杂工程问题解决方案对社会、健康、安全、法律以及文化的影响，并理解应承担的责任；能够理解和评价针对复杂工程问题的专业工程实践对环境、社会可持续发展的影响。通过实习，培养人文社会科学素养、社会责任感，能够在工程实践中理解并遵守工程职业道德和规范，履行责任。能够就复杂工程问题与业界同行及社会公众进行有效沟通和交流，包括撰写报告和设计文稿、陈述发言、清晰表达或回应指令，具备一定的国际视野，能够在跨文化背景下进行沟通和交流。具有自主学习和终身学习的意识，有不断学习和适应发展的能力。
default.en: Through Professional Cognition Practice, students are able to conduct reasonable analysis based on engineering related background knowledge, evaluate the impact of professional engineering practices and complex engineering problem solutions on society, health, safety, law, and culture, and understand the responsibilities they should undertake; Be able to understand and evaluate the impact of professional engineering practices targeting complex engineering problems on environmental and social sustainable development. Through internships, cultivate humanistic and social science literacy, a sense of social responsibility, and be able to understand and abide by engineering professional ethics and norms in engineering practice, fulfilling responsibilities. Capable of effective communication and exchange with industry peers and the public on complex engineering issues, including writing reports and design drafts, presenting speeches, clearly expressing or responding to instructions, possessing a certain international perspective, and able to communicate and exchange in cross-cultural contexts. Having the awareness of self-directed learning and lifelong learning, and the ability to continuously learn and adapt to development.

default.zh: 生产实习是高等教育工科专业实践教学非常重要的一环，作为能够亲临实践现场的一门课程，其能够实现结合基础课程、知识，训练学生运用专业知识解决实际问题的能力，实现基础知识与实践操作相结合，贯通从基本原理学习到实际产品研发和生产之间的各种环节，充分增强学生实践创新的能力，这对学生当前的学习和今后的工作都有很重要的作用。通过生产实习培养学生观察问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，特别要培养学生综合运用所学知识与实际相联系，提高工程实践能力和创新能力，培养学生的团结合作精神，树立正确的职业道德理想。
default.en: Production Practice is a very important part of practical teaching in higher education engineering majors. As a course that allows for hands-on experience, it can combine basic courses and knowledge, train students to apply professional knowledge to solve practical problems, combine basic knowledge with practical operations, connect various links from basic principle learning to actual product development and production, and fully enhance students' practical innovation ability. This plays an important role in students' current learning and future work. Through production internships, we aim to cultivate students' abilities to observe, analyze, and solve problems, particularly in integrating their knowledge with practice, improving their engineering and innovation abilities, fostering a spirit of unity and cooperation, and establishing correct professional ethics.

default.zh: 毕业实习是毕业实习是重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是巩固所学的理论知识，使理论紧密结合生产实践，使学生获得实际生产技术和管理知识，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实践中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为毕业设计打下基础。通过毕业实习，还应使学生了解现代化生产方式和先进制造技术，培养艰苦创业的精神和社会事业心与责任感。 课程培养目标如下： （1）通过毕业实习课程，提高其在生产实践中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为毕业设计打下基础。 （2）通过毕业实习课程，学生了解专业相关技术和原理，熟悉专业发展，掌握专业相关根本原理、主要方法和基本原则，增强专业的实践知识和感性认识。 （3）通过毕业实习课程，学生积极参加实习实践，培养学生的动手能力、分析问题和创新的能力，为科研工作打下一定的基础。 （4）增强理论联系实际能力、工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力、创新意识。培养艰苦创业的精神和社会事业心与责任感。
default.en: Fieldwork for Graduation is an important practical teaching link for graduation practice. Its purpose is to consolidate the theoretical knowledge learned, closely integrate theory with production practice, enable students to obtain practical production technology and management knowledge, train students to integrate theory with practice, improve their ability and methods to investigate, observe, analyze and solve problems in production practice, and lay a foundation for graduation design. Through graduation internships, students should also learn about modern production methods and advanced manufacturing technologies, cultivate a spirit of hard work and entrepreneurship, as well as a sense of social responsibility and dedication. The training objectives of the course are as follows: (1) Through gFieldwork for Graduation, improve their ability and methods to investigate, observe, analyze and solve problems in production practice, and lay a foundation for graduation design. (2) Through graduation internship courses, students will understand the relevant technologies and principles of their profession, become familiar with professional development, master the fundamental principles, main methods, and basic principles related to their profession, and enhance their practical knowledge and intuitive understanding of the profession. (3) Through graduation internship courses, students actively participate in internship practice, cultivate their hands-on ability, problem-solving and innovation abilities, and lay a certain foundation for scientific research work. (4) Enhance the ability to connect theory with practice, engineering practice, logical thinking, and innovation awareness. Cultivate a spirit of hard work and entrepreneurship, as well as a sense of social responsibility and dedication.

default.zh: 通过课程设计不仅加强了理论与实际的联系，进一步巩固所学课程的内容，而且要求学生综合地应用先修课程中的知识、学会使用有关技术资料，既完成一个工程技术人员在设计方面所必须具备的基本技能训练，它也是培养学生分析和解决工程实际问题能力的重要环节之一。 （1）学生在相关专业知识的基础上，通过实际设计工作深入理解基本理论与设计计算方法等知识，并熟练掌握计算原理和流程； （2）学生应掌握运用已有基础专业知识解决实际设计问题的方法； （3）通过对实际参数进行计算，熟练掌握计算机辅助设计方法； （4）学生应学会使用设计手册，按设计标准完成设计任务； （5）培养学生独立完成设计工作以及与他人交流沟通解决问题的能力。
default.en: The Project Design in Major-related Course not only strengthens the connection between theory and practice, further consolidates the content of the course, but also requires students to comprehensively apply the knowledge in the prerequisite courses and learn to use relevant technical materials. It not only completes the basic skills training that an engineering technician must have in design, but also is an important link in cultivating students' ability to analyze and solve practical engineering problems. (1) On the basis of relevant professional knowledge, students deepen their understanding of basic theories and design calculation methods through practical design work, and proficiently master calculation principles and processes; (2) Students should master the methods of applying existing professional knowledge to solve practical design problems; (3) Proficient in computer-aided design methods by calculating actual parameters; (4) Students should learn to use design manuals and complete design tasks according to design standards; (5) Cultivate the ability of students to independently complete design work and communicate with others to solve problems.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本科生专业培养的最后一个环节，是通过实践教学全面锻炼和提升学生专业综合能量和素养的关键环节。其课程目标包括： 1、培养学生综合运用所学的知识（基础课、技术基础课、专业方向课等方面的知识），分析和解决工程技术问题的能力。 2、进一步深化和扩展所学的基础知识、专业知识，提高实验动手能力；提高自学能力和独立工作的能力，使学生受到工程师的基本训练，培养其开展科学研究工作的初步能力。 3、培养学生的表达能力和团队精神，培养创新意识和创新精神，树立正确的人生观、价值观，在思想政治素质方面得到进一步的提高。
default.en: The graduation thesis (design) is the final stage of undergraduate professional training, and it is a key link to comprehensively exercise and enhance students' professional comprehensive energy and literacy through practical teaching. The course objectives include: 1. Cultivate the ability of students to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned (basic courses, technical basic courses, professional direction courses, etc.), analyze and solve engineering and technical problems. 2. Further deepen and expand the basic and professional knowledge learned, and improve experimental hands-on ability; Improve self-learning ability and independent work ability, provide students with basic training as engineers, and cultivate their preliminary ability to carry out scientific research work. 3. Cultivate students' expression ability and team spirit, cultivate innovative consciousness and spirit, establish correct outlook on life and values, and further improve their ideological and political qualities.

default.zh: 本课程面向能源与动力工程专业的本科生，讲授无人机动力系统目前的发展以及无人机动力系统的主要原理和结构，使学生了解无人机动力系统的各组成部件及其工作原理；掌握无人机动力系统的基本理论和功能；通过观摩和实践提升对无人机动力系统的认识。
default.en: This course is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in energy and power engineering. It teaches the current development of UAV power system and the main principle and structure of UAV power system, so that students can understand the components and working principles of UAV power system. Master the basic theory and function of UAV power system; Improve the understanding of UAV power system through observation and practice.

default.zh: 《大学外语》是面向非英语专业本科生开设的一门外语必修课。本课程涵盖听说读写四项技能的综合训练，旨在提高学生外语综合水平和应用能力。本课程结合文本讲解听力技巧，通过真实语料提高听力理解能力；借助主题任务培养口语表达能力；通过文本阅读与分析，巩固阅读技能，提高阅读效率和文本分析能力；以读促写，将阅读技能应用于外文写作训练，培养写作能力和批判性思维能力。教学内容以主题单元设计展开，展现多元文化、拓展国际视野、涵养中国情怀。课程采用累加式考核方式，由课程成绩50%和期末综合考试成绩50%构成学期总成绩。
default.en: College Foreign Language is a required foreign language course for freshmen. It contains an integrated foreign language skill training, progressing from listening and speaking to reading and writing, aiming to improve the overall foreign language proficiency and application ability of undergraduates. Listening skills are explicated in combination with text analyses as taught in reading. Authentic materials are used to motivate listening comprehension. Speaking ability is to be developed in thematic units. Through text reading and analysis, reading skills are consolidated, and reading efficiency and text-analysis ability are improved. Reading skills are subsequently applied to promoting writing ability as well as critical thinking ability. Thematic tasks are assigned to showcase rich multiculturalism, expand international perspectives, and cultivate Chinese sentiments. The course adopts the cumulative assessment method and the total score for one semester is composed of 50% of the course performance and 50% of the final proficiency test.

default.en: College Foreign Language is a compulsory course for non-language major undergraduates. This course is aimed to improve students’ academic foreign language proficiency and application skills. It focuses on developing students’ academic foreign language skills, including academic reading, listening, speaking and writing skills, training students in acquiring, analyzing, integrating, evaluating and utilizing information, enabling students to use foreign language effectively and appropriately for academic study and academic communication, enhancing their academic and research literacy and improving their international academic communication skills.

default.zh: 外语综合（1）课程是面向未来技术学院一年级本科生发展级开设的一门必修课，旨在提高学生英语综合能力及英语应用技能，并为进一步参与各领域国际交流打下坚实的基础。本课程以雅思听、说、读、写技能要求为标准，精选听、说、读、写训练素材。听力材料精选自不同生活场景素材；口语训练涉及各种话题；阅读训练紧扣题型并精选材料；写作涵盖各类图表作文和论述文写作技能训练。本课程同时侧重扩大学生的词汇量，熟悉复杂语法结构，扩展背景知识。最终学生在听力方面能够基本无障碍听懂日常对话、学术讨论、讲座以及各种媒体信息；在口语方面能够迅速整理思路，清晰准确地表达观点，从容参与日常交流及各种场合的口语互动；在阅读方面能够快速准确地接纳学术期刊和论著的文字信息和各种媒体文字信息；在写作方面能够准确地描述科学数据和各种图表，有条理地分析多种社会领域问题并提出解决方案，清晰流畅地表达较复杂的学术观点。
default.en: Integrated Skills of English （I）is a a compulsory course designed for first-year undergraduate students in the School of Future Technology who are enrolled in the Development Level of College English. It aims to develop students’ comprehensive abilities of the English language (listening, speaking, reading and writing) so that solid foundation will be laid for the students to communicate and interact internationally in various fields and on different occasions. This course covers four parts (listening, speaking, reading and writing) and teaching materials are carefully collected strictly according to the requirements of IELTS tests. Listening materials are chosen from different situations in real life; speaking materials include all kinds of related topics; reading materials closely model IELTS tests; writing materials cover seven possible variations for task 1 and three possible variations for task 2. This course also helps students to develop lexical and syntactic skills specifically focusing on the building of vocabulary and the understanding of complex sentence structures as well as the broadening of their English background knowledge. At the end of this course, students’ comprehensive abilities are good enough to understand daily conversations, academic lectures and seminars, etc. in English; speak English fluently and clearly; read English journal articles and books with accurate comprehension; write English essays cohesively and coherently and describe information given in charts and graphs logically and clearly.

default.zh: 外语综合（2）课程是面向未来技术学院一年级本科生发展级开设的一门必修课，旨在培养他们在高等教育环境中的学术英语能力与素养。本课程围绕科技文献阅读、学术论文撰写与宣读、学术讨论等核心技能展开，提升学生的学术英语思辨能力，强调学术英语的实际应用能力，采用“以成果为导向”的学术英语教学法，帮助学生进行论文撰写、投稿沟通和参加国际会议。本课程的主要教学内容包括：1. 学术英语素养培养──掌握国际学术交流所需的语言规范；2. 科技论文阅读与分析──深入理解并解析科技论文的结构；3. 学术论文写作──撰写符合学术规范的论文；4. 国际学术交流—论文投稿、回应审稿意见、制作学术海报、学术报告展示等。课程教材选用《学术英语理工进阶》，内容涵盖研究准备、论文结构分析与写作、学术交流等多个模块。通过课堂互动、案例分析和项目驱动式学习，学生将掌握从研究选题到成果展示的完整学术流程，为后续学术发展奠定坚实基础。本课程具有以下特色：首先是学科导向，紧密结合工程背景──本课程立足计算机科学与航空航天两大工程类学科，精选相关领域的词汇、案例和实践任务，强化学生在科研环境中的语言应用能力，并培养其学术规范意识；二是课题驱动，结合竞赛实践──课程采用“课项结合”与“课赛结合”机制，学生可基于大一年度项目的研究过程与数据撰写学术论文，并有机会参加“中国大学生5分钟科研英语演讲大赛”，在实践中提升学术表达能力；三是模拟国际学术交流全过程──课程包括学术论文投稿、回应审稿意见、会议海报制作及学术成果展示等环节，使学生在模拟真实学术环境的过程中积累经验，提高国际学术交流能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将具备在学术研究、国际学术交流及科技创新领域使用英语进行有效沟通的能力，为未来的科研与职业发展奠定扎实的语言基础。
default.en: Integrated Skills of English (II) is a a compulsory course designed for first-year undergraduate students in the School of Future Technology who are enrolled in the Development Level of College English. It aims to cultivate their academic English proficiency and literacy within a higher education environment. The course focuses on key academic skills such as reading scientific literature, writing and presenting academic papers, and participating in academic discussions, with an emphasis on enhancing students’ critical thinking in academic English and practical application skills. Employing an outcome-oriented approach to academic English instruction, the course guides students through the processes of academic writing, submission communication, and participation in international conferences. The course covers four core areas: 1. Academic English Literacy Development – Mastering the linguistic norms required for international academic communication; 2. Scientific Paper Reading and Analysis – Understanding and analyzing the structure of scientific research papers; 3. Academic Paper Writing – Composing research papers that adhere to academic conventions; 4. International Academic Communication – Engaging in academic paper submission, responding to reviewers’ comments, creating academic posters, and delivering academic presentations. The course adopts the textbook Advanced Academic English for Science and Engineering, which includes modules on research preparation, paper structure analysis and writing, and academic communication. Through interactive classroom activities, case studies, and project-based learning, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the academic research process, from topic selection to presenting their findings. This course has the following key features. Firstly, it adopts discipline-oriented approach aligned with engineering fields. Secondly, it is project-driven learning integrated with competition practice – the course follows a “course-project integration” and “course-competition integration” model, allowing students to write academic papers based on their first-year research projects and data. Thirdly, it simulates international academic exchange process. By completing this course, students will acquire the ability to effectively communicate in English within academic research, international scholarly exchange, and technological innovation, equipped with a strong linguistic foundation for future scientific research and career development.

default.zh: 《外语综合3》是面向未来技术学院二年级学生开设的一门英语选修课。该课程旨在提高学生学术英语技能以及英语综合技能，能够达到雅思考试的语言要求并能进行国际交流。教学内容主要包括提高雅思听、说、读、写综合能力，阅读科技文献、撰写学术论文、宣读论文、参加学术讨论等。该课程采用“以结果为导向”的学术英语教学法，结合正式期刊或会议论文，训练学术英语写作技能，培养学术素养。本课程采用形成性和终结性评价相结合的累加式考核方式，包括小组汇报、论文写作和演讲，以及英语水平测试等。
default.en: Integrated Skills of English III is an optional English course for sophomores from the School of Future Technology of HIT. The aim of this course is to develop students’ comprehensive abilities of the English language and academic English abilities to reach the requirements of IELTS tests and communicate internationally in various fields. This course covers developing comprehensive abilities for IELTS (listening, speaking, reading and writing), reading academic literature, writing and presenting academic papers, and attending academic panel discussions etc. The course adopts outcome-oriented teaching method and uses official journal articles and conference papers as teaching materials so that students’ academic English writing skills are acquired, academic quality improved and four skills of English listening, speaking, reading and writing developed at the same time. Based on the theories of formative and summative assessments, the course employs an accumulative grading system, including group reports, paper writings and presentations, and an English proficiency test.

default.zh: 《大学外语（俄语LP2）》是为能源学院中俄联合办学一年级学生在第二学期开设的必修课程，该课程在整个知识结构中占有重要地位。通过听说读写的全面训练，培养学生的俄语基本功，为其学习后续课程、掌握俄语的实际运用能力打下扎实的基础。本课程的主要目标是使学生在掌握 《大学外语（俄语LP1）》的条件下继续学习俄语语言（语音、语法、词汇）知识，培养学生具有听、说、读、写的基本技能和初步的言语交际能力，掌握一般的俄罗斯国情知识，培养学生具有自主学习获取和更新专业知识的能力。本课程贯彻以话题为纲的原则，所提供的对话、课文和所涉及到的词汇主要是日常生活题材，在日常生活题材范围内教授常用的词语、句式，讲授实用的基础语法，通过大量练习把语法知识转化为语言技能。同时，注重教材中更多文化元素的发掘，以提高学生的兴趣，增加对俄罗斯的了解。
default.en: "College Foreign Language (Russian LP2)" is a compulsory course offered in the second semester for first-year students of the Energy Institute jointly run by China and Russia. This course occupies an important position in the entire knowledge structure. Through comprehensive training in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, students will be trained in their basic Russian skills, laying a solid foundation for their ability to learn subsequent courses and master the practical application of Russian. The main goal of this course is to enable students to continue learning Russian language (pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary) knowledge under the condition of mastering "College Foreign Language (Russian LP1)", cultivate students' basic skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, and preliminary verbal communication skills, master general knowledge of Russian national conditions, and cultivate students' ability to independently learn, acquire, and update professional knowledge. This course follows the principle of taking topics as the main topic, and provides dialogues, texts, and vocabulary related to daily life topics. It teaches commonly used words and sentence patterns within the scope of daily life topics, teaches practical basic grammar, converts grammatical knowledge into language skills through a large amount of practice, and focuses on exploring more cultural elements in the textbooks to enhance students' interest and increase their understanding of Russia.

Through comprehensive training in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, students will be trained in their basic Russian skills, laying a solid foundation for their ability to learn subsequent courses and master the practical application of Russian. The main goal of this course is to enable students to continue learning Russian language (pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary) knowledge under the condition of mastering "College Foreign Language (Russian LP2)", cultivate students' basic skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, and preliminary verbal communication skills, master general knowledge of Russian national conditions, and cultivate students' ability to independently learn, acquire, and update professional knowledge. default.zh: 大学外语（俄语LP5）面向中俄联合校园二年级学生，本课程在提高学生语言基本功、培养实际运用语言的能力、提升学生的语篇交际能力等方面占重要的地位。本课程将提高学生对课文的鉴赏能力、提高相关技能的运用水平。通过对阅读材料的全面分析，学生理解所读文章的背景知识、文章体裁、写作特点、语言知识，理解文章蕴含的深层次意义。在一般社会文化、历史、人文、环境和科技等题材范围内教授最常用的词语和句式，培养学生听说读写言语技能，发展叙述的交际能力，同时侧重独白语能力的培养，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。
default.en: College Foreigh Language (Russian LP5) is a Russian major course offered in the spring semester of the second grade jointly run by Chinese and Russian universities. This course plays an important role in improving the basic skills of students, cultivating practical ability to use language, and improving students’ discourse competence ability. This course will improve students' appreciation of the text and improve the level of relevant skills. Through the comprehensive analysis of reading materials, students understand the background knowledge of the article, article genre, writing characteristics, language knowledge and the deep implication of the article. In the general social culture, history, humanities, environment and science and technology within the scope of the subject to teach the most commonly used words and sentences, to train students’ speech skills of listening, speaking, reading and writing, and develop their narrative communication skills. At the same time, it focuses on the cultivation of monologue ability, and lays a solid foundation for their follow-up courses.

default.zh: 英语二外（高起点）(1)的教学对象是具有一定英语基础的日语和俄语专业本科生，目的是强化学生英语交流及获取信息的能力, 提高学生英语听说读写的综合能力，特别是培养学生对不同体裁和风格的英语文章的理解、赏析和应用的能力，使其在今后的工作和社会交往中能用英语有效地进行口头和书面交流；同时培养学生批判性跨文化意识，提高其跨文化差异敏感性和本民族文化身份认同，并为其后续的英语语言学习和实际应用奠定良好的基础。
default.en: College English （Intermediate）（1） is designed for the students majoring in Japanese and Russian who have learned English as a foreign language in high schools. The course aims to enhance the students’ competence to communicate in English and to obtain information in English, and to develop their comprehensive ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing in English. The students will read and appreciate English texts of different genres, and they will develop their skills in written and oral communication. Meanwhile, the course will help the students to develop their cultural awareness, cross-cultural sensitivity and cultural identity so as to build a good foundation for their future study and application of English.

default.zh: 英语二外（高起点）(2) 是英语二外（高起点）(1)的延续，目的是强化学生用英语获取信息和交流的能力，特别是培养学生对不同体裁和风格的英语文章的理解和赏析的能力，提高英语听说读写译的综合能力，为其后续的英语语言学习奠定良好的基础；同时培养学生的思辨能力，为其在今后的工作和社会交往中能用英语有效地解决现实问题做准备。本课程采用累加式考核方式，考核内容包括课堂表现、口头报告、课后习题作业、课堂测试和期末考试。
default.en: This course is designed for Russian majors and Japanese majors who have learned College English (Intermediate) (1). It aims to enhance students’ competence to obtain information as well as communicate in English. Students will be able to understand and appreciate English texts of different genres and styles, improve skills of listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, which will lay a good foundation for their future English study. Meanwhile, the course cultivates students’ critical thinking and prepares them to solve practical problems effectively in English in their future work and social communication. The final score is achieved by adding up the scores of the following: in-class performance, presentation, assignments, quizzes and final exam.

default.zh: 《英语二外（高起点）(3)》是日语和俄语专业三年级高起点学生的二外课程，是英语二外（高起点）(2)的延续性课程，共36学时。本课程讲授议论文、短篇小说等不同体裁的文章，通过讲解词汇、语法、篇章等语言知识和课文所涉及到的英语国家历史、地理、政治、哲学、文学等文化方面的知识，并辅之以相应的听、说、读、写、译等各项英语实践技能的训练。经过本课程的学习，学生能够打下扎实的英语语言基础，增强用英语获取知识和交流的技能，增加对英语国家文化的了解，提高综合的英语应用能力、跨文化交流能力和思辨能力。本课程采用累加式考核方式，考核内容包括课堂出勤及表现、口头报告、课后习题作业、课堂测试和期末考试。
default.en: College English (Intermediate) (3), with 36 class hours, is the second foreign language course for third-year Japanese and Russian majors, and also the further development of College English (Intermediate) (2). It focuses on the following: the teaching of basic knowledge of the English language including vocabulary, grammar, discourse etc.; the instruction of English-speaking countries’ history, geography, politics, philosophy, literature and other aspects in culture; and the cultivation of listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation skills. The course aims to enable students to lay a solid foundation of the English language, enhance their competence to obtain information and communicate in English, increase the understanding of English-speaking countries’ culture, and develop the integrated ability of English application and promote intercultural communication and critical thinking. The final score is achieved by adding up the scores of the following: attendance, in-class performance, presentation, after-class assignments, quizzes and final exam.

default.zh: 《英语二外（高起点）(4)》是日语和俄语专业三年级高起点学生的二外课程，是英语二外（高起点）(3)的延续性课程，共36学时。本课程讲授议论文、短篇小说等不同体裁的文章，通过讲解词汇、语法、篇章等语言知识和课文所涉及到的英语国家历史、地理、政治、哲学、文学等文化方面的知识，并辅之以相应的听、说、读、写、译等各项英语实践技能的训练。经过本课程的学习，学生能够打下扎实的英语语言基础，增强用英语获取知识的技能，增加对英语国家文化的了解，提高英语综合应用能力、思辨能力和跨文化交际能力。本课程采用累加式考核方式，考核内容包括课堂出勤及表现、口头报告、课后习题作业、课堂测试和期末考试。
default.en: College English (Intermediate) (4), with 36 class hours, is the second foreign language course for third-year Japanese and Russian majors, and also the further development of College English (Intermediate) (3). It focuses on the following: the teaching of basic knowledge of English including vocabulary, grammar, discourse etc.; the instruction of English-speaking countries’ history, geography, politics, philosophy, literature and other aspects in culture; and the cultivation of listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation skills. The course aims to enable students to lay a solid foundation of the English language, enhance their competence to obtain information in English, increase the understanding of English-speaking countries’ culture, and develop the abilities to use English skillfully, to think critically and to communicate interculturally. The final score is achieved by adding up the scores of the following: attendance, in-class performance, presentation, after-class assignments, quizzes and final exam.

default.zh: 英语二外（零起点）(1)是日语和俄语专业二年级学生的专业必修课，是培养学生的英语语言能力的入门性课程，旨在为学生进一步学习英语打下牢固的基础。本课程通过对英语语音、词性、时态等基本语法、对话和百字左右的课文的学习，使学生能够掌握英语语音知识，熟练地使用音标进行拼读单词；掌握所学材料涉及到的词汇和语法知识以及英语国家的文化背景知识，理解对话的交际价值和课文的意义；初步培养学生的听、说、读、写能力，英语语言的综合运用能力和跨文化交际能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、平时作业、课堂测试和期末考试成绩。
default.en: As a required course for sophomores majoring in Japanese and Russian, this course is an elementary one to cultivate students’ ability to use the English language. The ultimate goal is to lay a solid foundation for students’ further English learning.By learning English pronunciation, fundamental grammar concerning parts of speech and tenses, dialogues and texts of about 100 words, students will be enabled to acquire the knowledge of English pronunciation, pronounce words with the help of phonetic symbols proficiently, grasp the usages of words and expressions, acquaint themselves with related cultural settings, understand the communicative and informative meanings of dialogues and the texts, develop their skills of listening, speaking, reading, and writing in English, improve their comprehensive abilities of using the English language, and thus cultivate their cross-cultural communicative competence. Students’ performances will be evaluated with regard to class participation, assignments, quizzes, and the final exam.

default.zh: 英语二外（零起点）(2)是日语和俄语专业二年级学生的专业必修课，是初步培养学生英语语言能力的课程，旨在为学生进一步学习英语打下牢固的基础。本课程通过对情态动词、被动语态、不定式、各种从句等英语基本语法、日常情景对话和200-300字课文的学习，使学生能够掌握所学材料涉及到的语言和文化背景知识，理解对话的交际功能和课文的意义；合理利用教材，通过多种形式的教学活动，培养学生的听、说、读、写、译能力、英语语言的综合运用能力和跨文化交际能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、平时作业、课堂测试和期末考试成绩。
default.en: Aimed at cultivating students’ ability to use the English language, this course is a required one for sophomores majoring in Japanese and Russian. The ultimate goal is to lay a solid foundation for students’ further English learning in the future. By learning fundamental English grammar such as modal verbs, passive voice, infinitives and clauses, dialogues with settings of everyday life and texts of 200 to 300 words, students will be enabled to grasp related linguistic and cultural knowledge, understand the communicative and informative meanings of dialogues and texts, develop skills of listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation through effective use of the textbook and various in-class activities, improve their comprehensive abilities of using the English language, and thus cultivate their cross-cultural communicative competence. Students’ performances will be evaluated with regard to class participation, assignments, quizzes, and the final exam.

default.zh: 英语二外（零起点）(3)是日语和俄语专业高年级零起点学生的二外课程，是英语二外（零起点）(2)的延续性课程。本课程主要讲授英语语法、对话和短文，传授学生英语语言和文化知识。学生将掌握基本英语语言能力，培养听、说、读、写、译等各种语言技能，进而提高其英语口头表达能力、阅读能力和跨文化交际能力。本课程教授的语法主要包括虚拟语气、代词it、verb-ing形式、倒装、标点符号的用法、平行句、强调句和其它重点句型，每个单元包括日常情景对话和400词左右的课文。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括课堂测试、课后作业和期末考试。
default.en: College English (Preliminary) (3) is the second foreign language course for higher-level Japanese and Russian major students, and also the further development of College English (Preliminary)(2). The course provides students with English grammar, dialogues, and short passages, and it aims to inform students of language and culture knowledge. The students should master fundamental English language competence and foster the skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation, so as to improve their English speaking ability, reading competence, and intercultural communication competence. The contents include the subjunctive mood, the pronoun it, verb-ing form, inversion, the use of punctuation marks, parallel structure, emphasis sentences, and other important sentences and structures. There are dialogues and 400-word texts in each unit. The course evaluation is cumulative, which includes in-class presentation, after-class assignments, and final exam.

default.zh: 英语二外（零起点）(4)是日语和俄语专业高年级英语零起点学生的二外课程，是英语二外（零起点）(3)的延续性课程。本课程主要讲授英语语法、对话和短文，传授学生英语语言和文化知识。学生将掌握中等水平的英语语言能力，培养听、说、读、写、译等各种语言技能，进而提高其批判性阅读能力、思辨能力和跨文化交际能力。本课程教授的语法主要包括with … being …、 vice versa、despite…、…while…、as well、in case、 as well as、as many as、 it will be…before…、however、be of great benefit和其它重点句型，每个单元包括日常情景对话和600词左右的课文。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括课堂测试、课后作业和期末考试。
default.en: College English (Preliminary) (4) is the second foreign language course for higher-level Japanese and Russian major students, and also the further development of College English (Preliminary) (3). The course provides students with English grammar, dialogues, and short passages, and it aims to inform students of language and culture knowledge. The students should master intermediate English language competence, foster the skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, so as to improve their critical reading ability, critical thinking ability and intercultural communication competence. The contents include with … being …, vice versa、despite…, …while…, as well, in case, as well as, as many as, it will be…before…, however, be of great benefit, and other important sentences and structures. There are dialogues and 600-word texts in each unit. The course evaluation is cumulative, which includes in-class presentation, after-class assignments, and final exam.

default.zh: 俄语二外（2）是英语、日语专业二年级学生的第二外语课程，是其专业学习的组成部分。通过本课程的学习，学生应掌握基本的俄语语言知识，具备一定的俄语听、说、读、写能力。教学过程中采取多媒体教学法和互动式教学法，激发学生主动学习的兴趣，打好语言基础，提高语言熟练程度。掌握第二外语有助于外语专业学生拓宽视野，使之具有更加丰富的语言知识，加深对于外国语言文化的理解，对于学生的专业学习也具有一定的促进作用，而且可以进一步提高学生的跨文化交际能力。
default.en: College Russian for Language Majors（2） is a professional limited elective course for second grade students of English and Japanese, and is an integral part of their professional learning. Through this course, students should master the basic Russian language knowledge, have the certain Russian listening, speaking, reading and writing skills. The course aims to develop English and Japanese undergraduates’ studying, while students learn and master the second foreign language - Russian, it helps improve students' multilingual ability and meta-language awareness, as well as multilingual comparability. Mastering the second foreign language will benefit the foreign language students to broaden their horizons, and they will have wealthy language knowledge, and this course will deepen their understanding of foreign language and culture, have a certain role in promoting students' professional learning, and can further improve students' cross-culture Communicative competence.

default.zh: 俄语二外课（3）是为我校外语学院英语、日语专业本科生开设的第二外语课程，是英语、日语专业二、三年级学生的专业必修课。 本门课程旨在培养英语、日语专业本科生在专业学习的同时，了解并掌握第二门外语——俄语。本课程培养学生具备多语言能力和元语言意识，以及多语言比较能力。 通过本课程的学习，学生将具备俄语听、说、读、写、译的基本技能和初步的俄语言语交际能力，还将了解俄罗斯的社会、历史与文化知识，提高跨文化交际能力、鉴赏能力和思辨能力。
default.en: Russian as Second Foreign Language （3） is a second foreign language course for English and Japanese undergraduate students, which is a compulsory course for second grade and third grade students in English and Japanese. This course is a starting point for Russian teaching. The total course is 192 hours and is divided into four stages following 48 hours per semester. The course aims to facilitate English and Japanese professional undergraduate students in the learning stage, understand and master the second foreign language – Russian at the same time. This course teaches students to have multiple language skills and meta-language awareness, as well as multilingual comparability. Through this course, students will have the basic skills of Russian listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation, the initial Russian verbal communication skills. They will also learn about Russian social, historical and cultural knowledge, improve cross-cultural communication ability, appreciation ability and speculative ability.

default.zh: 俄语二外课是为我校外语学院英语、日语专业本科生开设的第二外语课程，是英语、日语专业二、三年级学生的专业必修课。本课程为俄语零起点教学。课程总学时192学时，共分为四个阶段完成。每学期上课48学时。 本门课程旨在培养英语、日语专业本科生在专业学习的同时，了解并掌握第二门外语——俄语。本课程培养学生具备多语言能力和元语言意识，以及多语言比较能力。 俄语二外IV讲授《东方大学俄语（新版）2》后6个单元的内容。在教学中，采用灵活多样的教学方法，使学生牢固掌握俄语语法知识，具备较熟练的听、说、读、写、译的技能，促进学生跨文化交际能力的形成。
default.en: Russian as Second Foreign Language （4） is a second foreign language course for English and Japanese undergraduate students, which is a compulsory course for second grade and third grade students in English and Japanese. This course is a starting point for Russian teaching. The total course is 192 hours and is divided into four stages following 48 hours per semester. The course aims to facilitate English and Japanese professional undergraduate students in the learning stage, understand and master the second foreign language – Russian at the same time. This course teaches students to have multiple language skills and meta-language awareness, as well as multilingual comparability. Russian as Second Foreign Language（4） teaches the content of the posterior six units of "Eastern University Russian (new version) 2". In the teaching, it uses the flexible and diverse teaching methods, so that students firmly get the Russian grammar knowledge and have the practical listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation skills in order to promote the formation of cross-cultural communication skills.

default.zh: 日语二外（1）是为英语专业二年级学生开设的第二外语入门课程。通过听、说、读、写、译等基本训练，使学生掌握日语入门阶段的基础知识、基本技能及日语学习策略，为进一步学习日语打下良好的基础。本阶段课程主要讲授日语语音，基础语法。内容包括语音知识和基本句式的判断句、存在句、描写句，涉及名词、形容词、动词及各种助词？助动词等基础语法现象。课程采取累加式考核方式，包括平时成绩40%，期末成绩60%。为初级阶段学习打下良好的基础，通过本课程的学习，支撑学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: College Japanese for Language Majors（1）is a second foreign language introductory course for second-year English majors. Through entry-level training in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating, students are supposed to master the fundamentals of Japanese, basic language skills, and Japanese learning strategy, so as to lay a solid foundation for further Japanese learning. This course focuses on Japanese phonetics and basic grammar, including phonetic knowledge, basic sentence structures such as declarative sentences, existential sentences, and descriptive sentences, and other basic grammatical phenomena that involve nouns, adjectives, verbs, and various auxiliaries and auxiliary verbs. The course adopts a cumulative assessment method, made up of class performance (40%) and final exam (60%). The course objective is to lay a solid foundation for entry-level Japanese learning. By the end of this course, students’ achievements should meet the corresponding goals of this course.

default.zh: 日语二外（2）是为英语专业二年级学生开设的第二外语初级课程。通过听、说、读、写、译等的基本训练，使学生掌握日语初级阶段的基础知识、一定技能及日语学习的策略。本阶段课程主要讲授日语基本语法。内容包括名词句、形容词句、动词句的各种丰富表达，涉及形容词、动词的各种活用变形。课程采取累加式考核方式，包括平时成绩40%，期末成绩60%。为进一步学习打下良好基础，通过本课程的学习，支撑学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: College Japanese for Language Majors （2） is a second foreign language elementary course for second-year English majors. Through basic training in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating, students are supposed to master the fundamental knowledge of entry-level Japanese, basic language skills, and Japanese learning strategy. This course focuses on basic Japanese grammar, including a variety of expressions of noun sentences, adjective sentences, and verb sentences, and involves a variety of living deformations of adjectives and verbs. The course adopts a cumulative assessment method, made up of class performance (40%) and final exam (60%). The course objective is to lay a solid foundation for further Japanese learning. By the end of this course, students’ achievements should meet the corresponding goals of this course.

default.zh: 《日语二外（3）》是面向英语专业三年级学生开设的第二外语课程。通过本课程的教学，使学生熟练掌握日语初级阶段的相关语言知识，掌握听、说、读、写等基本语言技能。培养学生具有初步的日语表达能力和阅读理解能力。同时，通过对日本社会文化知识的学习，提高学生的跨文化交际能力和综合文化素养。 本课程的主要教学内容是《新大学日语标准教程（基础篇2）》的第6课至第15课。具体包括初级词汇、语法、句型、会话、短文阅读等语言知识和语言技能的学习。课程采取累加式考核方式，课堂表现和作业成绩占40%，期末成绩60%。通过本课程的学习，支撑学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: College Japanese for Language Majors（3） is a second foreign language intermediate course for third-year English major. Through basic training in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating, students are supposed to master intermediate-level language knowledge, related language skills, and Japanese learning strategy. Students will develop a preliminary ability to express themselves in Japanese and to read and understand. At the same time, through the study of Japanese social and cultural knowledge, students will improve their cross-cultural communication ability and comprehensive cultural literacy. The main teaching content of this course is Lesson 6 to Lesson 15 of the New University Japanese Standard Course (Basic 2). Specifically, it includes the learning of language knowledge and skills such as elementary vocabulary, grammar, sentence patterns, conversation, and short-text reading.Course grade is cumulative, made up of class performance and homework grades (40%), and final exam (60%). The course supports the achievement of the corresponding indicator points in the learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《日语二外（4）》是面向英语专业学生开设的第二外语课程。通过本课程的教学，使学生熟练掌握日语初级向中级阶段过渡的相关语言知识，掌握听、说、读、写、译等基本语言技能。培养学生具有一定的日语综合运用能力。在本课程结束时，学生可以借助工具书读懂一般难度的文章，从中获取所需要的信息。同时，通过对日本社会文化知识的学习，提高学生的跨文化交际能力和综合文化素养。 本课程的主要教学内容是《新大学日语标准教程（提高篇1）》第1课至第10课。具体内容包括初级向中级过渡阶段的词汇、语法、句式、篇章阅读等语言知识和语言技能的学习。课程采取累加式考核方式，课堂表现和作业占40%，期末成绩60%。通过本课程的学习，支撑学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: College Japanese for Language Majors（4） is a second foreign language intermediate course for third-year English major. Through basic training in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating, students are supposed to master language knowledge related to the transition from elementary to intermediate levels, related language skills, and Japanese learning strategy. Students will develop a certain level of ability to utilize Japanese in a comprehensive manner. By the end of this course, students will be able to read and understand texts of average difficulty with the help of a toolkit, from which they can obtain the information they need. At the same time, through the study of Japanese social and cultural knowledge, students will improve their cross-cultural communication ability and comprehensive cultural literacy. The main teaching content of this course is Lesson 1 to Lesson 10 of the New University Japanese Standard Course Enhanced Part 1). Specifically, it includes the learning of language knowledge and skills such as vocabulary, grammar, sentence patterns, and chapter reading in the transition from beginner to intermediate level.. Course grade is cumulative, made up of class performance and homework grades (40%), and final exam (60%). The course supports the achievement of the corresponding indicator points in the learning outcomes.

default.zh: 本课程是英语专业必修课，主要是通过德语语音的学习，使学生掌握德语发音，能够自己拼读德语单词、句子以及简单的对话和短文。选题主要包括在机场、家庭、购物、预约以及在邮局，使学生初步掌握德语基本日常会话。语法点包括动词变位、人称代词、物主代词、冠词、否定词、情态动词、过去式和可分动词。通过语法的学习，使学生了解句子的框架结构、词法和句法现象。教材内容多与德国国情和校园生活息息相关，通过对课文的学习，也引入德国的风土人情、地理、历史、文化等方面的介绍，可以丰富学生的国际视野，也可以提高学生的跨文化交际能力。同时课堂运用交际教学法，围绕一个主题，确定一个交际意向，以小组为单位，自己组织对话，使学生在课堂上开口讲德语，参与到课堂教学中来。每周授课学时4学时，成绩采用累加式考核。
default.en: This course is a foreign language course for English majors. Through the learning of German pronunciation, so that students can spell out German words, sentences, simple dialogs and texts by themselves. Topics are mainly included in airport, family, shopping, appointment and post office to enable students to master basic German daily conversation. Grammatical points include conjugation, personal pronouns, possessive pronouns, articles, negative words, modal verbs, past tense and separable verbs. Through the learning of grammar, students can understand the structure, morphology and syntax of sentences. Teaching material is closely related with the German national conditions and the campus life, through the learning of the text and the introduction of the German customs, geography, history and culture, can enrich the students' international vision and improve the students' ability of intercultural communication. Communicative teaching method will be used in class, around a theme, determine a communicative intention, the students make their dialogs in groups, so that the students can speak German in class. Four hours per week, cumulative assessment.

default.zh: 德语二外(2)课程面向外国语学院英语专业二年级学生开课，是一门必修课程，也是学生继续学习后续德语二外课程的基础。课程主要讲授德语语音知识、德语常用词汇及德语基础语法知识，重点是使学生了解初级德语语言知识及德语国家基本国情知识，熟悉日常生活场景下的德语基本词汇和套用句型，掌握德语听、说、读、写的基本技能。课程主要包括邀请、简历、服装、比较、房屋、旅行等主题内容。语法点包括动词二分词、形容词词尾变化、形容词的比较级与最高级、过去时以及介词。通过语法的学习使学生重点了解德语动词、形容词和介词的使用规则，进而更加全面地了解德语句子的框架结构、词法和句法现象。教材内容多与德国国情和校园生活息息相关，通过对课文的学习，也引入德国的风土人情、地理、历史、文化等方面的介绍，可以丰富学生的国际视野，也可以提高学生的跨文化交际能力。同时课堂运用交际教学法，围绕一个主题，确定一个交际意向，以小组为单位，自己组织对话，使学生在课堂上开口讲德语，参与到课堂教学中来。课堂也会借助英语和德语中词汇和语法的对比，使英语系学生在自身掌握的英语知识的基础上更快更好地接受德语。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、课后作业和期末考试。每周授课学时4学时。
default.en: College German II is open to the second year English majors of the English department. As a required course, it is also a knowledge foundation of the latter College German lessons. In this course, German pronunciation, German in common used words and basic German grammar are introduced. Students are supposed to master basic German language and the basic situation of Germany as well. They are familiar with the German in common used words and sentences, and they can listen, speak, read and write in German. Topics of this Course are mainly concerning inviting, resume, costume, comparing, building and trip. Grammatical points are participle II, adjective conjugation, comparative degree of adjective, superlative degree of adjective, imperfect and preposition. Through learning of German grammar students can master the using principles of German verbs, adjectives and prepositions. They are able to analyze the sentence structures, especially the morphological and syntactic rules of sentences. Teaching material is also closely related with the German culture and the campus life. Information about German customs, geography, history and culture can enrich the students' international vision and improve the students' ability of intercultural communication. Communicative teaching methods will be used in class, around a theme. After determining a communicative intention the students are assisted to make their dialog in groups, so that the students can exercise oral German in class. The class will also use English and German to compare the vocabulary and grammar, so that English major students will accept German faster and easier on the basis of their own knowledge of English. After finishing this course students can pass the basic calculations and tests such as participation in class, homework and term examination. Four hours per week.

default.zh: 本课程为英语专业本科生第二外语课程，总学时224学时，共分为五个阶段完成。前四阶段192学时，为专业必修课；第五阶段32学时，为专业限选课。德语二外(3)课程面向外国语学院英语专业三年级学生开课，是一门必修课程，也是学生继续学习后续德语二外课程的基础。课程主要讲授德语常用词汇及德语基础语法知识，重点是使学生了解初级德语语言知识及德语国家基本国情知识，熟悉日常生活场景下的德语基本词汇和套用句型，掌握德语听、说、读、写、译的基本技能。课程主要包括交通、运动、女性、孩子和青年、中国和德国等主题内容。语法点包括并列复合句、主从复合句、原因状语从句、目的状语从句、关系从句以及时间状语从句等。通过语法的学习使学生重点了解德语各类主从复合句的使用规则，进而更加全面地了解德语句子的框架结构、词法和句法现象。教材内容多与中德国情和校园生活息息相关，通过对课文的学习，也引入德国的风土人情、地理、历史、文化等方面的介绍，可以丰富学生的国际视野，也可以提高学生的跨文化交际能力。同时课堂运用交际教学法，围绕一个主题，确定一个交际意向，以小组为单位，自己组织对话，使学生在课堂上开口讲德语，参与到课堂教学中来。课堂也会借助英语和德语中词汇和语法的对比，使英语系学生在自身掌握的英语知识的基础上更快更好地接受德语。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、课后作业和期末考试。每周授课学时4学时。
default.en: College German (3), this course is a second foreign language course for English majors. The total class hours are 224 and it is completed in five stages. 192 class hours in the first four stages, which are professional compulsory courses; The fifth stage is 32 class hours, which is a professional limited elective course. College German (3) is a compulsory course for third year students majoring in English in foreign language schools, and it is also the basis for students to continue to learn German as a second foreign language. The course mainly teaches common German vocabulary and basic German grammar, focusing on enabling students to understand basic German language knowledge and basic national conditions of German speaking countries, be familiar with basic German vocabulary and sentence patterns in daily life, and master the basic skills of German listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating. The course mainly includes topics such as transportation, sports, women, children and youth, China and Germany. Grammatical points include coordinate compound sentences, subject subordinate compound sentences, cause adverbial clauses, target adverbial clauses, relative clauses and time adverbial clauses. Through the study of grammar, students can focus on understanding the rules of use of various kinds of master-slave compound sentences in German, and then more comprehensively understand the frame structure, morphology and syntax of German sentences. The content of the textbook is closely related to the Chinese and German conditions and campus life. By learning the text and introducing German customs, geography, history, culture and other aspects, students can enrich their international vision and improve their cross-cultural communication ability. At the same time, the communicative teaching method is used in the classroom to determine a communicative intention around a theme, and to organize a dialogue in groups, so that students can speak German in class and participate in classroom teaching. The classroom will also make use of the comparison of vocabulary and grammar between English and German, so that English students can quickly and better accept German based on their own English knowledge. The test scores of this course are cumulative, including class participation, homework and final exam. 4 class hours per week.

default.en: College German (4), this course is a second foreign language course for English majors. The total class hours are 224 and it is completed in five stages. 192 class hours in the first four stages, which are professional compulsory courses; The fifth stage is 32 class hours, which is a professional limited elective course. College German (4) is a compulsory course for third year students majoring in English in foreign language schools, and it is also the basis for students to continue to learn German as a second foreign language. The course mainly teaches common German vocabulary and basic German grammar, focusing on enabling students to understand basic German language knowledge and basic national conditions of German speaking countries, be familiar with basic German vocabulary and sentence patterns in daily life, and master the basic skills of German listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating.
