Grammatical points include comparative adverbial clauses, process passive, state passive, special verbs and subjunctive forms. Through the study of grammar, students can focus on understanding the dynamic and virtual usage rules of German, and then more comprehensively understand the frame structure, morphology and syntax of German sentences. The content of the textbook is closely related to the Chinese and German conditions and campus life. By learning the text and introducing German customs, geography, history, culture and other aspects, students can enrich their international vision and improve their cross-cultural communication ability. At the same time, the communicative teaching method is used in the classroom to determine a communicative intention around a theme, and to organize a dialogue in groups, so that students can speak German in class and participate in classroom teaching. The classroom will also make use of the comparison of vocabulary and grammar between English and German, so that English students can quickly and better accept German based on their own English knowledge. The test scores of this course are cumulative, including class participation, homework and final exam. 4 class hours per week.

default.zh: 本门课程旨在培养英语专业本科生在英语专业学习的同时，认识并了解第二门外语——德语。通过对德语语言知识的系统学习，学生逐步具备多语言能力和元语言意识，以及多语言比较能力，从而支撑其专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。德语二外（5）是为以德语为第二外语的英语专业学生开设的第五阶段课程，旨在满足学生的考研需求。课程汇总基础阶段德语语法知识，帮助学生积累常用词汇，并提升考研所需的听说读写译能力。
default.en: This course aims to train English majors to know and understand German, a second foreign language, while studying English majors. Through systematic study of German language knowledge, students gradually acquire multilingual competence, meta-linguistic awareness, and multilingual comparison ability, thus supporting the achievement of corresponding index points in their professional learning results. College German (5) is a fifth stage course for English majors who take German as a second foreign language. It is designed to meet the needs of students for postgraduate entrance examination. This course will summarize the basic German grammar knowledge, help students accumulate common vocabulary, and improve their listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating skills required for postgraduate entrance examination.

default.zh: 本门课程旨在培养英语专业本科生在英语学习的同时，认识并掌握第二门外语--法语。通过对法语的学习，最终达到听、说、读、写、译等能力的具备与完善。并通过对第二外语的学习，提高外语整体水平和竞争力。本学期主要是语音阶段的学习，通过26个字母的学习，36个音素规则的学习与理解，让学生掌握法语的发音，以便流利地读出法语。同时学习动词变位、名词性数、品质形容词的位置、主有形容词、指示形容词等基本语法现象，让学生学会造词组句，为以后的学习打下坚实的基础。每周授课学时4学时，在学习基本知识的同时，为学生介绍法国国情及人文、历史等相关知识，从而提高学生跨文化交际能力。考核采取成绩累加式，即学生的课堂表现、出勤率、作业以及期末考试等方面综合评价学生在本学期本课程的学习成果
default.en: This course aims to cultivate English majors to know and master French, the second foreign language, while learning English. Through the study of French, the ability of listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating will be improved. And through the learning of a second foreign language, improve the overall level of foreign language and competitiveness. This semester is mainly about the learning of pronunciation. Through the learning of 26 letters and the learning and understanding of 36 phoneme rules, students can master the pronunciation of French so that they can read French fluently. At the same time, learn the basic grammatical phenomena such as verb displacement, nominal number, position of quality adjectives, subjective adjectives, demonstrative adjectives, etc., so that students can learn to make phrases and sentences, and lay a solid foundation for future learning. The course lasts 4 class hours a week. While learning basic knowledge, it introduces French national conditions, humanities, history and other related knowledge to students, so as to improve their intercultural communication ability. The assessment is based on cumulative results, that is, students' classroom performance, attendance, homework, final examination, etc.

default.zh: 本学期主要是通过基础语法的掌握，如简单将来时、未完成过去时、复合过去时等，来学会组织句子结构，分析文章。同时加大阅读量，进一步开展法语听说读写译等各方面的能力，让学生真正的开口说法语。每周授课学时4学时，在学习基本知识的同时，为学生介绍法国国情及人文、历史等相关知识，从而提高学生跨文化交际能力。考核采取成绩累加式，即学生的课堂表现、出勤率、作业以及期末考试等方面综合评价学生在本学期本课程的学习成果。
default.en: This semester is mainly to learn to organize sentence structures and analyze articles by mastering basic grammar, such as simple future tense, uncompleted past tense, compound past tense, etc. At the same time, increase the amount of reading, further develop the ability of listening, speaking, reading, writing, translating and other aspects of French, so that students can really speak French. The course lasts 4 class hours a week. While learning basic knowledge, it introduces French national conditions, humanities, history and other related knowledge to students, so as to improve their intercultural communication ability. The assessment is based on cumulative results, that is, students' classroom performance, attendance, homework, final examination, etc.

default.zh: 法语二外(3)课程面向英语专业学生开课，是英语专业的必修课，也是学生参加各种法语考试的基础。本阶段课程主要讲授法语时态、宾语人称代词、语态等基本语法及法语听说训练，重点是使学生了解法语语言特点及法国文化，熟悉日常对话表达，掌握熟练运用法语这门语言的技能。课程主要通过语法知识、听写以及段落翻译等方法进行有针对性的实践训练，增加听说的训练，介绍不同语法的时态构成和大量的语法知识和单词，促进综合能力的共同提高，为将来的研究生考试和非专业四级考试作储备。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂出勤（10分）、课堂测试（10分）、课堂表现（10分）及期末考试 （70分）。
default.en: College French (3) as a Second Foreign Language, is a compulsory course for English majors and the basis for students to take various French examinations. This stage of the course mainly teaches French tenses, object personal pronouns, voice and other basic grammar and French listening and speaking training. The focus is to enable students to understand the characteristics of French language and French culture, be familiar with daily dialogue and expression, and master the skills to use French skillfully. The course mainly carries out targeted practical training through grammar knowledge, dictation, paragraph translation and other methods, increases the training of listening and speaking, introduces the tense composition of different grammars and a large number of grammar knowledge and words, promotes the common improvement of comprehensive ability, and makes preparations for the future postgraduate examination and the non professional CET-4 examination. The test scores of this course are cumulative, including class attendance (10 points), class test (10 points), class performance (10 points) and final exam (70 points).

default.zh: 法语二外(4)课程面向英语专业学生开课，是英语专业的必修课，也是学生参加各种法语考试的基础。课程主要讲授的是语法词汇及句型，法语听说训练，重点是使学生了解法语语言特点及法国文化，熟悉日常对话表达，掌握熟练运用法语这门语言的技能。课程主要包括面对法语各种等级考试或研究生应试考试中所需要的基础知识及练习的考试方法及技巧，进一步提升学生做题能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂出勤（10分）、课堂测试（10分）、课堂表现（10分）及期末考试 （70分）。
default.en: This course is for students of English majors and is a required course for English majors, as well as the basis for the preparation for all kinds of French language tests. The course is for the knowledge of grammar, vocabulary, sentence related training: dictation and reading and writing training, this course aims to enable students to know language features and French culture, be familiar with daily dialogues and master skilled use of the French language. It is important to counsel students in preparing for French level exams or graduate entrance exams, so this course is targeted to train students to prepare for exams with the basic knowledge, related exercises and exam skills. The final score is cumulate, including attendance (10’), classroom testing(10’), performance (10’) and final exam (70’) .

default.zh: 法语二外(5)课程面向英语专业学生开课，是英语专业的限选课，此课程主要为备战考研的学生提供更深层次的语法讲解及题型练习，也为准备非专业法语四级考试的学生提供高级语法及习题练习。课程主要讲授高级语法及专项练习，同时进行法语听说训练，让学生在熟练掌握语法结构及运用的基础上，更多地了解法国文化，熟悉日常对话表达，提高跨文化交际地能力。
default.en: College French V as a Second Foreign Language, is a limited optional course for English majors. This course mainly provides students preparing for the postgraduate entrance examination with in-depth grammar explanation and question type exercises, as well as advanced grammar and exercise exercises for students preparing for the non professional French Test Band 4. The course mainly teaches advanced grammar and special exercises, as well as French listening and speaking training, so that students can learn more about French culture, be familiar with daily dialogue and expression, and improve their intercultural communication ability on the basis of mastering grammar structure and application.

default.zh: 俄语二外 （1）是英语、日语专业二年级学生的第二外语课程，是其专业学习的组成部分。通过本课程的学习，学生应掌握基本的俄语语言知识，具备一定的俄语听、说、读、写能力。本门课程旨在培养英语、日语专业本科生在专业学习的同时，了解并掌握第二门外语——俄语,培养学生具备多语言能力和元语言意识，以及多语言比较能力。 掌握第二外语有助于外语专业学生拓宽视野，使之具有更加丰富的语言知识，加深对于外国语言文化的理解，对于学生的专业学习也具有一定的促进作用，而且可以进一步提高学生的跨文化交际能力。
default.en: College Russian for Language Majors（1） is a professional limited elective course for second grade students of English and Japanese, and is an integral part of their professional learning. Through this course, students should master the basic Russian language knowledge, have the certain Russian listening, speaking, reading and writing skills. The course aims to develop English and Japanese undergraduates’ studying, while students learn and master the second foreign language - Russian, it helps improve students' multilingual ability and meta-language awareness, as well as multilingual comparability. Mastering the second foreign language will benefit the foreign language students to broaden their horizons, and they will have wealthy language knowledge, and this course will deepen their understanding of foreign language and culture, have a certain role in promoting students' professional learning, and can further improve students' cross-culture Communicative competence.

default.zh: 英语名篇阅读(1)是英语系一年级学生的专业必修课, 是一门专业基础技能课。课程主要通过讲授不同体裁的英语课文，如短篇小说、戏剧、科普文章和散文等帮助学生掌握基础词汇和系统的语法知识，培养学生听、读、写、译的基本技能，提高学生的文化意识。 课程内容主要包括英语国家的社会、历史等文化背景知识、词汇和语法知识的讲解和实践、课文的结构和写作特点分析、讨论、阅读理解能力的训练以及写作的实践。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、课后练习作业，平时测试、期末考试等成绩。
default.en: Intensive Reading of English Classic Works (1) , as a compulsory course for the first-year students of the English Department, is one of the fundamental skill-training courses. The course aims to improve the students’ proficiency in using English and develop their cultural awareness. It integrates the listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation activities into the study of the English texts of different genres, such as short stories, dramas, essays, and popular science articles. The course deals with the cultural backgrounds of the English-speaking countries and language use, vocabulary and grammar, organization and writing techniques of each text. It also provides opportunities for discussion and reading and writing practice. The final assessment of the course consists of the following part: classroom participation; exercises of each text, quiz and final written examination.

default.zh: 思辨英语听力（工作与生活） 课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22FL22115 课程名称：思辨英语听力（工作与生活） 总学时：48 理论学时：48 学分：3.0 开课单位：外国语学院 授课对象：英语系本科生 开课学期：1秋 先修课程：高中英语 二、课程简介 思辨英语听力（工作与生活）是为英语系一年级本科生开设的专业基础课程，旨在帮助学生熟悉和运用英语语音知识，学习听力技巧，听懂难度中等、语速适中、长度较短的各种题材和体裁的听力材料，以帮助学生利用英语获取信息，开阔眼界，增长知识。该课程通过倾听大量符合英语国家现实语境的材料，帮助学生掌握和操练基本听力技巧，累积词汇，促进英语口语习得，熟悉热门话题，了解英语国家的文化和习俗，提高跨文化交际能力。本课程利用多媒体手段辅助教学，选取最具时效性的听音材料，创造融真实性、知识性、交际性和趣味性为一体的课堂教学氛围，指导学生巩固基础语音知识，熟悉各种语音变体；听懂基本的日常英语对话、情节简单的英语故事、语速适中的英语演讲，简短的英语新闻、以及其它各种场合及场景下的英语信息；能够概括大意，抓住细节，完成听写和复述，速记关键信息。本课程的考核采用累加式评价，涵盖课堂表现、作业、测验和期末考试。
default.en: Introduction to [Listening Critically: Work and Life] 1. General Information Course Code：22FL22115 Course Title：Listening Critically: Work and Life Credit Hours：48 Lecture：48 Credit(s)：3.0 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: English Majors Term: Fall, First Year Prerequisites 2. Course Description Listening Critically: Work and Life is a basic training course for first-year English majors. It aims to help students practise the knowledge of phonetics and learn basic listening skills so as to understand English materials of intermediary level, moderate speaking rate, and medium length, covering various topics and multiple genres. It provides a platform for students to receive information, broaden their vision, and increase their knowledge in diverse fields. With abundant listening materials in real contexts in English speaking countries, this course helps students grasp basic listening skills, enrich their vocabulary, facilitate their acquisition of spoken English, get updated on hot topics, and increase their exposure to cultures and customs of English speaking countries so as to improve their cross-cultural communicative competence. The course chooses the latest materials and uses multi-media to create a class atmosphere that is authentic, informative, communicative and recreational. Through study and practice, on the basis of solidifying their knowledge of phonetics and recognizing variants of sounds, students are instructed to understand short conversations, stories with simple plot, lectures of appropriate speaking rate, short news reports， and English in other situations. They can also recognize the main idea, identify details, accomplish dictation and rephrasing, and take notes of important messages. The grading system consists of class participation, homework, quizzes, and the final examination.

default.zh: 英语专业导论课 课程描述 一、课程基本描述 课程名称：英语专业导论 课程类别：专业必修课 学 时：16 学 分：1 适用对象: 英语专业一年级学生 开课时间：第1学期 考核方式：读书报告（根据本课程所学内容，将自己在知识、认识、学习方法等方面的收获、感想、心得等做出总结） 二、课程教学目的 英语专业导论课是为英语专业一年级新生开设的专业引导课，该课程重点介绍英语专业发展、课程设置、人才培养目标以及关于英语专业学习的基本要求等，结合《指南》中的《必读书目》，进行学术训练。通过本课程的教学使学生了解英语专业的发展历史，各个学科方向所包含的内容、所从事的工作以及继续深造的途径，培养学生的专业意识。了解本专业的培养目标和课程体系，使学生明确本专业的学习任务，明确学习目标、掌握学习方法，为今后的专业学习打下良好的思想和方法基础。
default.en: Introduction to the English Major Course description I. Basic description of the course Course Title: Introduction to the English Major Course Category: Compulsory courses for English majors Learn: 16 Credit: 1. Intended Audience: First-year English majors Start time: Semester 1 Assessment method: Term paper (According to the content of this course, you can write about a book in the Guide you have read or an issue in the development of the English major.) II.Teaching purpose of the course Introduction to the English major is a professional guidance course for freshmen English majors. This course focuses on the development of the English major, curriculum, training objectives, and basic requirements for English majors, etc., and in consideration of the "Required Reading List" in the Guide, academic training is carried out. Through the teaching in this course, students can understand the history of the development of the English major, the contents of various disciplines, the work they would be engaged, in and the ways of further study, so as to cultivate their professional awareness. Students are to understand the training objectives and curriculum system of the major, so that they can clarify the learning tasks of the major, Students are to be clear about their learning objectives, master learning methods, and lay a good foundation for their future learning.

default.zh: 英语语音课面向英语系一年级的本科生开课, 是一门专业基础技能必修课。课程目的是让学生全面了解英语语音的基本知识，训练发音和朗读技巧，为学生进一步提高英语听力和口头交际水平奠定基础，同时培养学生对英语语音特点及规律性的认知与探究能力。课堂讲授语音的基础知识，涉及国际音标、单词重音、弱读、连读、节奏和语调等语音现象，以实践为主，从听辨入手，进而模仿，反复训练，直到能自觉运用。学生在课程的学习过程中要不断纠正以往错误的发音习惯，课程结束时学生要达到基本准确而清晰的发音和使用自然的语调。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时测验和期末的口试与笔试。
default.en: English Pronunciation is a course for the first-year students of the English Department. It is one of the fundamental skill-training courses. As a foundation for the speaking and listening courses, this course aims to help the students grasp the basic knowledge and features of English pronunciation and to provide them with opportunities to practice and explore the rules. It will focus on pronunciation basics -- International Phonetic Alphabet, word stress, weak forms, rhythm and intonation. A combination of sounds distinction exercises, imitation exercises, and drills serve to develop the students’ speech awareness so that they can consciously remedy their own pronunciation problems. By the end of the course, students are supposed to be able to speak intelligible English with proper rhythm and natural intonation. The evaluation of the course consists of two parts: quizzes and the final exam.

default.zh: 思辨英语听力（文化与艺术）是面对英语专业二年级学生开设的专业基础课。本课程从文化、文学、神话、艺术、建筑、哲学等方面，帮助学生系统学习人文知识，培养英语听力技能，掌握有效的听力策略，克服听力障碍，提高听力水平。通过对听力材料的处理，促进语言表达能力和文化知识积累，培养学生获取和更新专业知识的能力。本课程注重培养学生思辨能力、跨文化能力和自主学习能力；通过本课程的学习，学生能够结合中国文化和国情对所听信息进行批判性理解，对作者的观点进行批判性分析和解读，从而提高文化自信和文化主体意识。
default.en: Listening Critically: Culture and Art is a fundamental course offered to second year English majors. This course helps students systematically learn humanistic knowledge, develop English listening skills, master effective listening strategies, overcome listening obstacles and improve listening ability from the aspects of culture, literature, mythology, art, architecture, philosophy, etc. By processing listening materials, it promotes language expression ability and cultural knowledge accumulation, and cultivates students' ability to acquire and update professional knowledge. This course focuses on cultivating students’ critical thinking ability, cross-cultural competence, and self-learning ability. Through this course, students will be able to critically understand the information they listen to, analyze and interpret the speaker’s viewpoints, and improve their cultural confidence and cultural awareness.

default.zh: 思辨英语听力（学术与科技）是英语专业二年级学生专业必修课，对培养学生语言综合使用能力和培养学生获取和更新专业知识的能力。通过对不同体裁和不同语速的英语语音材料的学习和理解，使学生能够逐渐无障碍地通过语音输入得到准确信息，并达到进一步理解、交流和学习的目的，并为学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。本课程在英语听力(3)的基础上，进一步培养学生对所听材料进行预测、分析、判断、归纳，领会说话人的态度、感情和意图的能力，使学生进一步正确掌握语音，熟悉各种英语变体，听懂正常语速的，有关政治、经济、文化、教育、科技等英语新闻、演讲等语音材料。通过本课程的学习学生可以进一步掌握英语语言发音规律，词语在句子中的轻重读规律及词语连读规律；了解和熟悉课文背景知识，了解和熟悉相关人文社会科学知识及数学与自然科学知识，了解和熟悉相关国家社会、历史与文化知识；获取对所听语言信息的综合分析能力，通过理解背景知识和上下文逻辑关系理解整片语言的信息；获取跨文化交际能力和思辨能力，能够结合中国文化和国情对所听信息进行批判性理解，对作者的观点进行批判性分析和解读。具有获取和更新专业知识的能力，能够利用所听到的信息补充知识储存。本课的考核方法包括课下完成对听力内容的精听、课上的积极参与和期末考试。
default.en: Listening Critically: Academics and Technology is a required course for second year English major students. Continued from Listing III, it aims to train students to use English as a tool to gain more knowledge related to their special fields，and it further facilities students to gradually be able to obtain precise information through aural input, so that they can understand, communicate with and learn about the language, which will form a firm foundation for their future studies. This course helps student learn to predict, analyze, make judgments about and understand the speakers’ attitudes, emotions and intentions. In addition, they can understand information spoken at different speeds about politics, economy, culture, education, science and technology. Through this course, students can learn more about how English individual words and sentences are correctly pronounced and stressed, grasp the correct way of articulating the words and expressions of the language and learn to understand information through relevant contexts. Meanwhile through vast amount of information input, their background knowledge about English and many other related fields will be broadened, and they will also learn to make their own critical judgments about what they are hearing. The final grades of the course will include how well students finish the listening assignments, how well they participate in the class and their performance in the final examination.

default.zh: 英语原著阅读(1)作为英语专业二年级秋季学期的主干课程。课程侧重英语基础知识的教学以及听、说、读、写、译等各项实践技能的综合培养；课程教学同时兼顾英语国家地理、历史、政治、文学、经济等方面文化知识的讲授。本课程通过对语言点的详细阐释、功能性会话的练习、篇章结构的整体把握、相关文化背景知识的介绍、以及相关问题的讨论，帮助学生打下扎实的英语语言基础，增强英语交流技能，增加对英语国家文化的了解，提高英语综合运用能力。课程采用累加式考核形式，包括课堂讨论、平时测验、课后作业和期末考试等。
default.en: Intensive Reading of English Masterpieces I is the main course in the fall semester of English majors’ second year. It focuses on the teaching of basic knowledge of English language, the cultivation of skills including listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, and the instruction of English-speaking countries’ culture in geography, history, politics, literature and other aspects. The course, by means of explaining difficulties in language, drills of functional dialogue, mastery of discourse structures, introduction to relevant cultural background knowledge and discussion of relevant issues, aims to enable students to form a solid basis of English language, enhance the skills in English communication, increase the understanding of English-speaking countries’ culture, and develop the integrated ability of English application. The final score is achieved by adding up the score of following items: discussion in class, unit quizzes, homework and final examination.

default.zh: 英语名篇阅读(2)是英语专业一年级学生的专业必修课，在培养学生语言基本功及语言综合运用能力方面占重要的地位，本课程为后续专业学习奠定扎实的基础。本课程侧重于听、说、读、写、译等各项语言基本技能的培养，培养学生综合的语言运用能力。通过本课程的学习，学生应该了解和熟悉与课文相关的背景知识，扩大知识面；熟练运用所学关键词语、句式，解释重要语句、理解课文主旨；熟悉文章的体裁、结构、内容、写作技巧；具备分析，欣赏和批判的能力；掌握综合运用语言的能力，能把所学知识得体地输出。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、课后练习、平时测试、期末考试等成绩。
default.en: Intensive Reading of English Classic Works II, as a compulsory course for the first year English majors, plays an indispensable role in consolidating students’ language skills for subsequent other major-related courses. The teaching contents focus on cultivating the students’ abilities in listening, speaking reading, writing and translation with the purpose of improving the students’ comprehensive English skills. Through this course, students are expected to learn about the background information related to the texts, broadening their horizon; to skillfully apply the key vocabulary and sentence structure in their own language practice and paraphrase the difficult sentences and get the main idea of the text; to get familiar with the different genres and writing techniques; to develop the analytic, appreciative, and critical abilities; to appropriately output what they have learned from the text. The final assessment of the course consists of the following part: classroom participation; exercises of each text, quiz and final written examination.

default.zh: 思辨英语听力（社会与时事） 课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22FL22123 课程名称：思辨英语听力（社会与时事） 总学时：48 理论学时：48 学分：3.0 开课单位：外国语学院 授课对象：英语系本科生 开课学期：1春 先修课程：思辨英语听力(工作与生活) 二、课程简介 思辨英语听力（社会与时事）是为英语系一年级本科生开设的专业基础课程，旨在帮助学生巩固已有的语音知识和听力技巧，学习新的听力技能和听力理解方法，听懂相较于思辨英语听力（工作与生活）难度稍大、语速稍快、篇幅稍长的各种题材和体裁的英语材料，以帮助学生利用英语获取信息，开阔眼界，提高归纳总结、逻辑分析和甄别批判能力。该课程通过倾听大量符合英语国家现实语境的材料，帮助学生掌握和操练听力技巧，累积词汇，熟悉热门话题，了解英语国家的文化和习俗，提高跨文化交际能力和思辨能力。本课程利用多媒体手段辅助教学，选取最具时效性的听音材料，创造融真实性、知识性、交际性和趣味性为一体的课堂教学氛围，指导学生熟悉各种英语变体和语调，听懂中等难度的日常英语对话、采访、故事、演讲、新闻和其它场景的英语材料， 完成概括大意、辨认细节、复述要义、速记信息和列提纲等听力任务。本课程的考核采用累加式评价，涵盖课堂表现、作业、测验和期末考试。
default.en: Introduction to [Listening Critically: Society and Contemporary World] 1. General Information Course Code：22FL22123 Course Title：Listening Critically: Society and Contemporary World Credit Hours：48 Lecture：48 Credit(s)：3.0 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: English Majors Term: Spring, First Year Prerequisites: Listening Critically: Work and Life 2. Course Description Listening Critically: Society and Contemporary World is a basic training course for first-year English majors. It aims to solidify students’ knowledge of phonetics and listening skills and to learn new strategies of listening comprehension so as to understand English materials of higher level, faster speaking rate, and greater length than those in Listening Critically: Work and Life, covering various topics and multiple genres. It provides a platform for students to receive information, broaden their vision, and improve their ability of summarization, analysis and critical thinking. With abundant listening materials in real contexts in English speaking countries, this course helps students practise and grasp listening skills, enrich their vocabulary, get updated on hot topics, and increase their exposure to cultures and customs of English speaking countries so as to improve their cross-cultural communicative competence and critical thinking. The course chooses the latest materials and uses multi-media to create a class atmosphere that is authentic, informative, communicative and recreational. Through study and practice, familiarized with different variants and intonations, students are instructed to understand conversations, stories, interviews, lectures, news reports, and English in other situations featured by moderate speaking rate and length. They can also accomplish the tasks of recognizing the main idea, identifying details, retelling, notetaking, and outlining. The grading system consists of class participation, homework, quizzes, and the final examination.

default.zh: 英语写作是英语专业的必修课,旨在培养学生用英语写作的习惯，鼓励学生利用英语的交际功能，通过写作表达思想，为必修课。学生将在用词、语法、句法、段落、修辞等不同层面了解英语写作的特点，掌握英语写作统一性、连贯性和充实性等基本原则、不同文体类型的英语的语言和结构特征及英汉书面语表达上的异同；培养学生掌握写故事概要的要领，用自己的话写出约150字的主要情节；使他们掌握段落的基本结构以及写作要领，就有关自己的生活和经历写出格式规范、内容充实、语言基本流畅、含有约150个字的完整的段落；使他们学会写常用的便条以及有关校园活动的通知。
default.en: This course, targeting English major freshmen, aims to help them form the habit of writing in English and expressing their ideas by making use of the communicative function of the target language. Students are supposed to learn the principles of unity and coherence, the linguistic features of English essays of different styles, and the differences between English and Chinese writings in addition to their distinctive characteristics of diction, grammar, sentence, paragraph structures, and figurative speech. Students are going to learn to write a summary of about 150 words on main plots of a story and a paragraph of about 150 words on personal experiences with correct format and basic fluency. In addition, students are going to learn how to write note and notification on campus activities.

default.zh: 英语演讲与辩论是英语专业二年级学生的专业基础课，是一门语言技能和专业知识相结合的课程，目的是培养学生用英语演讲和辩论的能力。课程主要介绍演讲和辩论的基本知识和技巧，采用理论传授与实际操练相结合；教师讲解和学生参与相结合；教师点评和学生试评相结合的教学方法，通过小组研究、课上小组汇报和模拟比赛等实践，进一步培养学生口语表达能力和思辨的能力。
default.en: English Public Speaking and Debate is a compulsory course for the second year students majoring in English. This course is an integration of language skills and special expertise. It aims to help students explore the art of persuasive speaking and public speech. The course contents include, but not limited to, the basic techniques of public speaking and debate, weekly group discussion and report, and model speech and debates. The teaching method of combining teacher feedback and student trial evaluation further cultivates students’ oral expression and critical thinking abilities through group research, in class group presentations, and simulated competitions.

default.zh: 英语原著阅读(2)作为英语专业二年级春季学期的主干课程。课程侧重于英语基础知识的教学以及听、说、读、写、译等各项实践技能的综合培养；课程教学同时兼顾英语国家地理、历史、政治、文学、经济等方面文化知识的讲授。本课程通过对语言点的详细阐释、功能性会话的练习、篇章结构的整体把握、相关背景文化知识的介绍、以及相关问题的讨论，帮助学生打下扎实的英语语言基础，增强英语交流技能，增加对英语国家文化的了解，提高英语综合运用能力。课程采用累加式考核形式，包括课堂讨论、平时测验、课后作业和期末考试等。
default.en: Intensive Reading of English Masterpieces II is the main course in the spring semester of English majors’ second year. It focuses on the teaching of basic knowledge of English language, the cultivation of skills including listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, and the instruction of English-speaking countries’ culture in geography, history, politics, literature, economy and other aspects. The course, by means of explaining difficulties in language, drills of functional dialogue, mastery of discourse structures, introduction to relevant cultural background knowledge and discussion of relevant issues, aims to enable students to form a solid basis of English language, enhance the skills in English communication, increase the understanding of English-speaking countries’ culture, and develop the integrated ability of English application. The final score is achieved by adding up the score of following items: discussion in class, unit quizzes, homework and final examination.

default.zh: 基础英语(1)是二学位第一年级的专业必修课，在培养学生语言基本功及语言综合运用能力方面占重要的地位，本课程为后续专业学习奠定扎实的基础。本课程侧重于听、说、读、写、译等各项语言基本技能的培养，培养学生综合的语言运用能力。通过本课程的学习，学生应该了解和熟悉与课文相关的背景知识，扩大知识面；熟练运用所学关键词语、句式，解释重要语句、理解课文主旨；熟悉文章的体裁、结构、内容、写作技巧；具备分析，欣赏和批判的能力；掌握综合运用语言的能力，能把所学知识得体地输出。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、课后练习、期末考试等成绩。
default.en: Fundamental English (1), as a compulsory course for the first year Second- majors, plays an indispensable role in consolidating students’ language skills for subsequent other major-related courses. The teaching contents focus on cultivating the students’ abilities in listening, speaking reading, writing and translation with the purpose of improving the students’ comprehensive English skills. Through this course, students are expected to learn about the background information related to the texts, broadening their horizon; to skillfully apply the key vocabulary and sentence structure in their own language practice and paraphrase the difficult sentences and get the main idea of the text; to get familiar with the different genres and writing techniques; to develop the analytic, appreciative, and critical abilities; to appropriately output what they have learned from the text. The final assessment of the course consists of the following part: classroom participation; exercises of each text, and final written examination.

default.zh: 基础英语(2)作为英语专业（第二学士学位）一年级春季学期的主干课程，共64学时。课程侧重于英语基础知识的教学以及听、说、读、写、译等各项英语实践技能的综合培养，课程教学中同时兼顾英美国家地理、历史、政治、文学、经济等方面文化知识的教育。在本课程的教学过程中，通过对语言点的详细阐释、功能性会话的练习、篇章结构的整体把握、相关背景文化知识的介绍、以及相关问题的讨论，学生能够打下扎实的英语语言基础，增强英语交流技能，增加对英语国家文化的了解，提高综合的英语应用能力。课程采用累加式考核形式，包括课堂讨论、课后作业和期末考试等。
default.en: Fundamental English II, with 64 class hours, is the main course in the first year spring semester of the English major (second bachelor’s degree). It focuses on the teaching of basic knowledge of English language, the cultivation of skills including listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, and the instruction of English-speaking countries’ culture in geography, history, politics, literature, economy and other aspects. The course, by means of explanation on language points, drills of functional dialogue, mastery of discourse structures, introduction to relevant cultural background knowledge and discussion of relevant issues, aims to enable students to form a solid basis of English language, enhance the skills in English communication, increase the understanding of English-speaking countries’ culture, and develop the integrated ability of English application. The final score is achieved by adding up the score of following items: discussion in class, homework and final examination.

default.zh: 英语听力（1）课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22FL22132 课程名称：英语听力（1） 总学时：64 理论学时：64 学分：4.0 开课单位：外国语学院 授课对象：英语专业第二学士学位学生 开课学期：1秋 先修课程：大学英语 二、课程简介 英语听力（1）是为英语专业第二学士学位学生开设的专业基础课程，旨在帮助学生熟悉和运用英语语音知识，学习听力技巧，听懂难度中等、语速适中、长度较短的各种题材和体裁的听力材料，以帮助学生利用英语获取信息，开阔眼界，增长知识。该课程通过倾听大量符合英语国家现实语境的材料，帮助学生掌握和操练基本听力技巧，累积词汇，促进英语口语习得，熟悉热门话题，了解英语国家的文化和习俗，提高跨文化交际能力。本课程利用多媒体手段辅助教学，选取最具时效性的听音材料，创造融真实性、知识性、交际性和趣味性为一体的课堂教学氛围，指导学生巩固基础语音知识，熟悉各种语音变体；听懂基本的日常英语对话、情节简单的英语故事、语速适中的英语演讲，简短的英语新闻、以及其它各种场合及场景下的英语信息；能够概括大意，抓住细节，完成听写和复述，速记关键信息。本课程的考核采用累加式评价，涵盖课堂表现和期末考试。
default.en: Introduction to [English Listening (1)] 1. General Information Course Code：22FL22132 Course Title：English Listening (1) Credit Hours：64 Lecture：64 Credit(s)：4.0 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: Second Degree English Majors Term: Fall, First Year Prerequisites: Open 2. Course Description English Listening (1) is a basic training course for Second Degree English Majors. It aims to help students practise the knowledge of phonetics and learn basic listening skills so as to understand English materials of intermediary level, moderate speaking rate, and medium length, covering various topics and multiple genres. It provides a platform for students to receive information, broaden their vision, and increase their knowledge in diverse fields. With abundant listening materials in real contexts in English speaking countries, this course helps students grasp basic listening skills, enrich their vocabulary, facilitate their acquisition of spoken English, get updated on hot topics, and increase their exposure to cultures and customs of English speaking countries so as to improve their cross-cultural communicative competence. The course chooses the latest materials and uses multi-media to create a class atmosphere that is authentic, informative, communicative and recreational. Through study and practice, on the basis of solidifying their knowledge of phonetics and recognizing variants of sounds, students are instructed to understand short conversations, stories with simple plot, lectures of appropriate speaking rate, short news reports， and English in other situations. They can also recognize the main idea, identify details, accomplish dictation and rephrasing, and take notes of important messages. The grading system consists of class participation and the final examination.

default.zh: 英语听力（2） 课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22FL22133 课程名称：英语听力（2） 总学时：64 理论学时：64 学分：4.0 开课单位：外国语学院 授课对象：英语专业第二学士学位学生 开课学期：1春 先修课程：英语听力(1) 二、课程简介 英语听力（2）是为英语专业第二学士学位学生开设的专业基础课程，旨在帮助学生巩固已有的语音知识和听力技巧，学习新的听力技能和听力理解方法，听懂相较于英语听力（1）难度稍大、语速稍快、篇幅稍长的各种题材和体裁的英语材料，以帮助学生利用英语获取信息，开阔眼界，提高归纳总结、逻辑分析和甄别批判能力。该课程通过倾听大量符合英语国家现实语境的材料，帮助学生掌握和操练听力技巧，累积词汇，熟悉热门话题，了解英语国家的文化和习俗，提高跨文化交际能力和思辨能力。本课程利用多媒体手段辅助教学，选取最具时效性的听音材料，创造融真实性、知识性、交际性和趣味性为一体的课堂教学氛围，指导学生熟悉各种英语变体和语调，听懂中等难度的日常英语对话、采访、故事、演讲、新闻和其它场景的英语材料， 完成概括大意、辨认细节、复述要义、速记信息和列提纲等听力任务。本课程的考核采用累加式评价，涵盖课堂表现、作业、测验和期末考试。
default.en: Introduction to [English Listening (2)] 1. General Information Course Code：22FL22133 Course Title：English Listening (2) Credit Hours：64 Lecture：64 Credit(s)：4.0 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: Second Degree English Majors Term: Spring, First Year Prerequisites: Listening Critically: Work and Life 2. Course Description English Listening (2) is a basic training course for Second Degree English Majors. It aims to solidify students’ knowledge of phonetics and listening skills and to learn new strategies of listening comprehension so as to understand English materials of higher level, faster speaking rate, and greater length than those in English Listening (1), covering various topics and multiple genres. It provides a platform for students to receive information, broaden their vision, and improve their ability of summarization, analysis and critical thinking. With abundant listening materials in real contexts in English speaking countries, this course helps students practise and grasp listening skills, enrich their vocabulary, get updated on hot topics, and increase their exposure to cultures and customs of English speaking countries so as to improve their cross-cultural communicative competence and critical thinking. The course chooses the latest materials and uses multi-media to create a class atmosphere that is authentic, informative, communicative and recreational. Through study and practice, familiarized with different variants and intonations, students are instructed to understand conversations, stories, interviews, lectures, news reports, and English in other situations featured by moderate speaking rate and length. They can also accomplish the tasks of recognizing the main idea, identifying details, retelling, notetaking, and outlining. The grading system consists of class participation, homework, quizzes, and the final examination.

default.zh: 英语基础写作是英语专业（第二学士学位）的必修课,旨在培养学生用英语写作的习惯，鼓励学生利用英语的交际功能，通过写作表达思想。学生将在用词、语法、句法、段落、修辞等不同层面了解英语写作的特点，掌握英语写作统一性、连贯性和充实性等基本原则、不同文体类型的英语的语言和结构特征及英汉书面语表达上的异同；培养学生掌握写故事概要的要领，用自己的话写出约150字的主要情节；使他们掌握段落的基本结构以及写作要领，就有关自己的生活和经历写出格式规范、内容充实、语言基本流畅、含有约150个字的完整的段落；使他们学会写常用的便条以及有关校园活动的通知。
default.en: Basic English Writing is a compulsory course for English majors (second bachelor’s degree), aiming to cultivate students’ habits of writing in English, encourage them to utilize the communicative functions of English, and express their thoughts through writing. Students will acquire an understanding of the characteristics of English writing at various levels, such as vocabulary, grammar, syntax, paragraphs, and rhetoric. They will also master the fundamental principles of unity, coherence, and richness in English writing, as well as the language and structural features of different genres and the similarities and differences between English and Chinese written expressions. The course aims to train students in grasping the essentials of writing story outlines, using their own words to write a main plot of about 150 words. Additionally, students will acquire the basic structure and writing techniques of paragraphs, enabling them to write well-structured, content-rich, linguistically fluent paragraphs of approximately 150 words, focusing on their own lives and experiences. Finally, students will learn how to write commonly used notes and campus activity announcements.

default.zh: 英语学术写作是英语第二学位的专业必修课，是学生撰写毕业论文和学术期刊论文的基础。课程主要讲授学术论文写作方法，重点是使学生掌握现代语言学会（MLA)和美国心理学会(APA)的学术论文格式，掌握如何按照学术写作规范确定文章结构并陈述主要观点。本课程结合英语专业本科毕业论文写作规范，主要内容包括选择题目、查阅和筛选文献资料、文体与格式、论文主要观点、提纲和行文、APA和MLA格式、摘要、关键词和绪论、正文主要章节、结论和参考文献。
default.en: Academic English Writing is a compulsive course for English major students, and also the foundation of writing graduation thesis and articles in academic journals. This course provides students with the skills and techniques of writing academic papers. The students will master MLA and APA style, and learn how to organize the structure and express the main points of an academic paper. This course collaborates with the writing standard of English major thesis, and the contents cover subject selection, retrieving references, genre and format, thesis statement, contents, APA and MLA style, abstract, key words, introduction, main body, conclusion and references.

default.zh: 高级英语是英语专业（第二学士学位）二年级秋季学期的专业基础课。课程目标将价值塑造、知识传授和能力培养融为一体。本课程主要传授学生英语语言知识和国内外文化知识，在开展听说读写译等活动的过程中，引导学生全面分析阅读材料，理解所读文章的背景知识，掌握篇章结构、写作特点和语言知识，理解文章蕴含的深层次意义。课程旨在提升学生的高阶阅读能力、写作能力、翻译能力、口语表达能力和思辨能力。 本课程采用累加式考核方式，考核环节包括课堂表现、测验、作业和期末考试等。
default.en: Advanced English is a course for English minor students in the second year. The course integrates value shaping, knowledge imparting, and skill development as its objectives. It mainly focuses on teaching students English language and cultural knowledge from both domestic and international perspectives. Through activities such as listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, it guides students to comprehensively analyze reading materials, understand the background knowledge of the articles, master text structure, writing characteristics, and linguistic knowledge, and comprehend the deep meanings contained within the articles. The course aims to enhance students’ advanced reading, writing, translation, oral expression, and critical thinking abilities. This course adopts an accumulative evaluation method, which includes class performance, quizzes, assignments, and a final examination.

default.zh: 英语高级听力是英语专业二年级学生专业必修课，对培养学生语言综合使用能力和培养学生获取和更新专业知识的能力。通过对不同体裁和不同语速的英语语音材料的学习和理解，使学生能够逐渐无障碍地通过语音输入得到准确信息，并达到进一步理解、交流和学习的目的，并为学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。本课程在英语听力(2)的基础上，进一步培养学生对所听材料进行预测、分析、判断、归纳，领会说话人的态度、感情和意图的能力，使学生进一步正确掌握语音，熟悉各种英语变体，听懂正常语速的，有关政治、经济、文化、教育、科技等英语新闻、演讲等语音材料。通过本课程的学习学生可以进一步掌握英语语言发音规律，词语在句子中的轻重读规律及词语连读规律；了解和熟悉课文背景知识，了解和熟悉相关人文社会科学知识及数学与自然科学知识，了解和熟悉相关国家社会、历史与文化知识；获取对所听语言信息的综合分析能力，通过理解背景知识和上下文逻辑关系理解整片语言的信息；获取跨文化交际能力和思辨能力，能够结合中国文化和国情对所听信息进行批判性理解，对作者的观点进行批判性分析和解读。具有获取和更新专业知识的能力，能够利用所听到的信息补充知识储存。本课的考核方法包括课下完成对听力内容的精听、课上的积极参与和期末考试。
default.en: Advanced English Listening is a required course for second year English major students. Continued from Listening II, it aims to train students to use English as a tool to gain more knowledge related to their special fields and it further facilities students to gradually be able to obtain precise information through aural input, so that they can understand, communicate with and learn about the language, which will form a firm foundation for their future studies. This course helps student learn to predict, analyze, make judgments about and understand the speakers’ attitudes, emotions and intentions. In addition, they can understand information spoken at different speeds about politics, economy, culture, education, science and technology. Through this course, students can learn more about how English individual words and sentences are correctly pronounced and stressed, grasp the correct way of articulating the words and expressions of the language and learn to understand information through relevant contexts. Meanwhile through vast amount of information input, their background knowledge about English and many other related fields will be broadened, and they will also learn to make their own critical judgments about what they are hearing. The final grades of the course will include how well students finish the listening assignments, how well they participate in the class and their performance in the final examination.

default.zh: 英语演讲课面向英语第二学位的本科生开课，是一门综合技能必修课，旨在培养学生“说”的能力，训练学生语言表达的连贯性、思维的逻辑性、以及独立思考和思辨能力。课程内容分为基础理论、实例分析和实践三个环节，注重学生的实际演练，着重训练三种类型的演讲—自我介绍、信息性演讲和说服性演讲。课程讲授公共演讲的基本知识和技巧，包括英语演讲的选题、确立演讲主题、谋篇布局的方法，演讲稿的撰写和分析，同时也训练学生在演讲过程中对身体语言的使用，例如姿态、眼神、动作等。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂演讲、平时测验和期末笔试。
default.en: English Public Speaking is a course for the second-year students of the English Department. It is a comprehensive skill-training course, aiming to develop the students’ “speaking” skills through the training of language use, logic and independent and critical thinking ability. It consists of three parts: theory introduction, speech analysis and speech practice, and will focus on applying the principles of public speaking to three types of speeches, namely self-introductory speeches, informative speeches and persuasive speeches. It will lead the students to explore how to choose a topic, how to decide on the theme, how to organize the speech, how to analyze a speech and how to deliver a prepared speech. Meanwhile the non-verbal factors will also be dealt with in class, such as gestures, eye-contact and hand movements. The evaluation of the course consists of three parts: speeches, quizzes and the final exam.

default.zh: 英汉笔译是英语专业（第二学士学位）的专业必修课，对于培养学生的对翻译的基本认识，翻译技巧有很重要的意义。学生通过对翻译基础的全面分析，理解翻译的要求，掌握英汉翻译的基本技巧。本课程将提高学生的翻译能力以及相关技能的运用水平，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。本课程的目的是让学生掌握翻译的基本原理，并通过大量的实践，具备一定的翻译能力，掌握不同文体（主要是应用文体）的英汉翻译的基本特点和技巧，最后能够借助字典翻译一般难度的文章。本课程的主要内容包括英语和汉语之间的差别，如形合与意合等；翻译的基本原理、标准、技巧，如增词、减词、转换等；不同层次的翻译，如词语层、句子层、段落层、篇章层等；不同文体的翻译，如文学文体、科技文体、旅游文体、新闻文体、广告文体等。学习本课程，学生需将翻译理论与翻译实践紧密结合，进而掌握翻译基本原理、不同文体（主要为应用文体）英汉翻译基本特点、不同文体英汉翻译的技巧。本课程将通过大量实践培养学生翻译能力，让其学习英译汉的技巧、层次、难点、疑点、文体、译文质量评估等相关知识，并采用启发式、互动式教学法，培养学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: English-Chinese Translation is a required course for English majors pursuing a second bachelor’s degree, which holds significant importance in cultivating students’ basic understanding of translation and translation skills. Through a comprehensive analysis of translation fundamentals, students will grasp the essential requirements and fundamental skills of English-Chinese translation. This course aims to improve students’ translation ability and application of related skills, laying a solid foundation for subsequent courses. The course aims to enable students to master the basic principles of translation, acquire certain translation capabilities through extensive practice, and grasp the basic characteristics and techniques of English-Chinese translation in different genres, primarily focusing on applied text types. By the end of this course, students will be able to translate general difficulty articles with the aid of a dictionary. The course covers a wide range of topics, including differences between English and Chinese, such as formalization and semantic unification, basic principles, standards, and skills of translation, such as insertion, deletion, and transformation, translation at different levels, such as word level, sentence level, paragraph level, and discourse level, and the translation of different genres, such as literary style, technical style, tourism style, news style, and advertising style. When learning this course, students need to closely combine translation theory with translation practice, thereby mastering the basic principles of translation and the fundamental characteristics and skills of English-Chinese translation in different genres, mainly applied text types. The course will foster students’ translation ability in extensive practice, enabling them to learn the skills, levels, difficulties, ambiguities, genres, and quality assessment of English-Chinese translation, and adopt heuristic and interactive teaching methods, cultivating students’ independent thinking, problem analysis, and resolution abilities.

default.zh: 法语 1 作为中法数学菁英班法语选修体系的第一阶段课程，以培养学生运用法语开展专业学习与国际学术交流的核心能力为导向。课程聚焦数学法语语法的继续学习与学术跨文化能力提升，实现听说读写全维度进阶。本课程在教授专业法语知识、法语国家文化知识，构建法语语言知识体系以及中西方文化知识体系的同时，培养学生掌握相关人文社会科学知识、语言综合使用能力、跨文化交流能力及思辨能力。
default.en: French 1, as the first stage of the French elective system of the Sino-French Mathematics Elite Programme, is oriented to the development of students' core competence in the use of French in their professional studies and international academic exchanges. The course focuses on the further study of French grammar in mathematics and the improvement of academic intercultural competence, and achieves the full-dimensional advancement of listening, reading, writing and speaking. The course teaches professional French knowledge, knowledge of French-speaking countries and cultures, and builds a knowledge system of the French language as well as knowledge systems of Chinese and Western cultures, while at the same time cultivating students' knowledge of relevant humanities and social sciences, their ability to use the language in an integrated manner, and their ability to communicate cross-culturally and to think critically.

default.zh: 《基础俄语（3）》是俄语专业二年级学生的专业课，旨在使学生熟练朗读俄语的同时，进一步加强语法、词汇等基础知识的学习，具有听、说、读、写、译的基本技能和初步的言语交际能力，掌握俄罗斯国情文化知识，从而为提高阶段的学习奠定坚实的基础。 本课程是基础阶段重要的言语训练时期，应做到听、说、读、写、译全面发展。为贯彻交际性原则，本阶段听说训练占突出位置，重视培养学生的言语交际能力。课堂上应使学生有尽量多的听说实践，提升语音、音调素质，逐步提高言语质量。同时也要重视读、译和写的训练，培养阅读习惯，加大词汇量，逐步增加阅读量，提高阅读速度，使阅读成为学生获取知识的主要途径之一；培养学生正确理解俄语语义的能力，对比分析俄汉两种语言表达上的差异，掌握简单的互译技巧；进行严格的笔语训练，使学生能够运用所学的词语、语句等手段表达较为复杂的思想， 及早解决思想丰富而表达匮乏的矛盾逐步提高书面表达思想的能力。此阶段教学注重听、说、读、写、译能力的综合训练，全面发展，正确处理口语与笔语、理解与表达、准确与熟练的关系，进一步培养学生独立学习的能力。
default.en: Practice Russian （3） is a professional compulsory course of the second year of Russian majors. It aims to enable students to read Russian fluently and to further strengthen the learning of basic knowledge such as grammar and vocabulary, to develop students' basic skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation, initial verbal communication skills and general knowledge of Russian national conditions, so as to lay a solid foundation for the study of the enhancement phase. This course is an important period of speech training in the basic stage, to comprehensively develop listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation. Teaching must pay attention to comprehensive training of listening, speaking, reading, writing, translation ability. In order to implement the communicative principle, listening and speaking training occupies a prominent position in this stage, and attaches great importance to the cultivation of students' verbal communicative ability. In class, students should have as much listening and speaking practice as possible, improve pronunciation, tone quality, and gradually improve the quality of speech. At the same time, we should also pay attention to the training of reading, translation and writing, cultivate the reading habit, increase the vocabulary, gradually increase the amount of reading, improve reading speed, so that reading becomes one of the main ways for students to acquire knowledge. Cultivate students' ability to correctly understand Russian semantics, compare and analyze the differences in expression between Russian and Chinese, and master simple translation skills; Strict pen language training enables students to express more complex thoughts with the words and sentences they have learned, solve the contradiction of rich thoughts and lack of expression as early as possible, and gradually improve the ability to express thoughts in writing, comprehensive development, and correct handling of relationship between spoken and written language, understanding and expression, accurate and skilled, Further cultivate students' ability of independent study.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练俄语初学者的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to train students' listening and oral expression abilities, comprehensively develop their Russian language ability, Russian communication ability, and comprehensive Russian application ability, improve their language expression interest, and accurately receive, understand, and output Russian information skills. Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 俄语口语（3）是俄语专业二年级学生的专业基础课，在培养学生形成扎实的俄语听说能力方面占重要的地位。本课程通过教授标准的俄语语音语调、基本词汇、基本俄语句型及典型情境中的对话，将培养学生过硬的俄语语言基本功和实际运用语言的能力，提高俄语会话技能，为其学习后续课程、通过俄语专业四、八级考试打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Spoken Russian (3) is a professional basic course for sophomores majoring in Russian, and plays an important role in cultivating students' solid Russian listening and speaking abilities. default.zh: 《俄语实践语法（3）》是俄语专业二年级学生的专业必修课，在讲授基础语言知识和提高学生语言表达准确性方面起到重要作用。教学过程中采取多媒体教学法和互动式教学法，为学生提供准确、直观的语法范例，深入详尽地讲解各种俄语词法、句法项目，同时指导学生进行大量的语法实践练习，力求将语法知识学习与技能训练相结合，不仅帮助学生牢固掌握最基本的语法知识，而且致力于提高学生灵活运用所学语言知识的能力，提升学生的言语质量，提高口头和书面表达的准确性，为中、高级阶段的俄语学习打下坚实的基础。
default.en: 《Practical Russian Grammar（3）》is a compulsory course for second-year students majoring in Russian, which plays an important role in teaching basic language knowledge and improving the accuracy of language expression. The teaching process adopts multimedia teaching method and interactive teaching method. Provide students with accurate and intuitive examples of grammar, in-depth and detailed explanation of various Russian lexical, syntactic projects, meanwhile guide students to practice a lot of grammar practice, and try to combine grammar knowledge with skill training. This course not only help students to master the most basic grammatical knowledge, but also improves students' ability of flexible use of the language knowledge, the quality of the words of the students, and the accuracy of the oral and written expression, and lays a solid foundation for the middle and advanced stage of Russian learning.

default.en: “Practice Russian grammar（2）” is a compulsory course for first-grade students majoring in Russian and plays an important role in cultivating students' basic knowledge of Russian language. This course mainly teaches students the basic knowledge of Russian grammar, and converts the basic knowledge of grammar taught into language skills through a large amount of practice, laying a foundation for supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.en: Basic Russian（2）A is a professional compulsory course offered in the second semester of the first year of Russian majors, which occupies an important position throughout the knowledge structure.
