The main goal of this course is to enable students to continue to learn Russian language (voice, grammar, vocabulary) knowledge under the conditions of basic Russian language, and to develop students' basic skills in listening, speaking, reading and writing, initial verbal communication skills and general knowledge of Russian national conditions, to develop the ability of students to independently learn to acquire and update the professional knowledge. The conversation provided in this course, the text and the vocabulary involved are mainly the theme of daily life.

default.zh: 本课程是为俄语专业四年级学生开设的高级俄语实践课，分为理论授课和课外辅导两部分，理论授课将围绕教材中的课文和练习展开，课外辅导主要针对俄语专业八级测试进行相关的言语训练。本课程的宗旨在于进一步发展和完善学生的语言基本功，提高口笔语交际能力；增加学生的人文知识储备，提高认识水平，加强对俄罗斯国情的了解和理解；使学生具有语言分析能力和文章鉴赏能力，提高言语素养。
default.en: This course is an advanced Russian practical course for fourth-year students majoring in Russian. It is divided into two parts: theoretical teaching and extracurricular tutoring. The theoretical teaching will focus on the text and exercises in the textbooks. The extracurricular tutoring mainly focuses on language training related to the Band 8 test for Russian majors. The purpose of this course is to further develop and improve students' basic language skills and improve their oral and written communication skills; Increase students' humanistic knowledge reserves, improve their understanding level, and strengthen their understanding of the national conditions of Russia; To enable students to have the ability of language analysis and article appreciation, and improve their language literacy.

default.zh: 《俄语实践语法（1）》是在俄语专业一年级第一学期开设的一门专业必修课,是专门讲授俄语基本语法知识的主要课程。授课学时为24，课程学分为1.5。本课程旨在使进入大学俄语专业学习的学生在俄语学习之初获取最基本的俄语语法知识，构筑俄语语法知识的基本框架，熟练掌握最基本的语法变化形式、特点、用法和规则，同时了解语法规则适用的场景，促进针对语法项目而编排的句型、对话、课文等言语训练内容的学习，为俄语实践教学打下牢固的基础。
default.en: Practical Russian Grammar (1) is a professional compulsory course offered in the first semester of the first year of Russian majors. It is a main course specialized in teaching basic Russian grammar knowledge. The teaching hours are 24and the course credits are 1.5 This course aims to enable students entering university Russian majors to acquire the most basic knowledge of Russian grammar at the beginning of Russian learning, construct a basic framework of Russian grammar knowledge, master the most basic forms, characteristics, usages, and rules of grammatical changes, understand the applicable scenarios of grammatical rules, and promote the learning of sentence patterns, dialogues, texts, and other language training content arranged for grammatical items, Laying a solid foundation for the practical teaching of Russian.

default.zh: 俄语口语（1）是俄语专业低年级学生的专业基础课，在培养学生形成初步的俄语听说能力方面占重要的地位。本课程通过教授标准的俄语语音语调、基本词汇、基本俄语句型及对话，将培养学生的俄语语言基本功和实际运用语言的能力，提高俄语会话技能，为其学习后续课程、通过俄语专业四、八级考试打下坚实的基础。 本课程以训练学生的听力和口语表达能力为主，传授学生基本的俄语语言知识，培养学生的听说能力和言语交际能力。
default.en: Spoken Russian（1）is a professional basic course for junior students majoring in Russian, which plays an important role in cultivating students’ initial Russian listening and speaking ability. This course will teach students the basic skills of Russian language and the ability to use language effectively by teaching the standard Russian pronunciation and intonation, basic vocabulary, basic Russian sentence patterns and dialogue, to improve the Russian conversation skills, to lay a solid foundation for its follow-up courses, and through the Russian major in the fourth and eighth grade examinations This course focuses on training students’listening and speaking skills, teaching students basic Russian language knowledge, and cultivating students' listening and speaking skills and verbal communication skills.

default.zh: 《基础俄语（1）》课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22FL22232 课程名称：基础俄语（1） 总学时：96 理论学时：72 实验学时： 上机学时： 实践学时： 课外辅导学时：24 学分：4.5 开课单位：外国语学院 授课对象：俄语专业 开课学期：1秋 先修课程：无 二、课程简介 《基础俄语（1）》是在俄语专业一年级第一学期开设的一门专业必修课程，授课理论学时为72，课外辅导学时为24，课程学分为4.5。本课程旨在为刚刚进入大学俄语专业学习的俄语零起点学生和少数有一定俄语基础的高起点学生打下扎实的语音基础，培养其基本拼写书写能力和拼读朗读能力，同时使学生掌握一定数量的俄语基本词汇和句子的用法，具有初步的语言基础知识和初步的口笔语交际能力，掌握一般的俄罗斯国情知识，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。 撰写人：李玉娟 审核人：童丹 日 期：2023年3月
default.en: Introduction to Basic Russian（1） 1.General Information Course Code：22FL22232 Course Title：Basic Russian (1) Credit Hours：96 Lecture：72 Lab： Computer Lab: Practical: Tutoring: 24 Credit(s)：4.5 Offering Department: College of Foreign Languages Students: Russian major Term: Autumn, First year Prerequisites: null 2.Course Description Basic Russian (1) is a professional compulsory course offered in the first semester of the first year of Russian majors. The theoretical teaching hours are 72, the extracurricular tutoring hours are 24, and the course credits are 4.5. This course aims at laying a solid foundation of voice for students who have just entered the Russian language program and a few students with a certain Russian base, developing their basic spelling writing skills and spelling reading skills, meanwhile keeping students in a certain amount of Russian basic vocabulary and the use of the sentence, with the basic language knowledge and the initial communication skills, to master the general knowledge of the Russian national conditions, and finally laying a solid foundation for their follow-up courses. Author: Li Yujuan Reviewer：Tong Dan Date：March, 2023

default.zh: 基础日语（3）作为日语专业的专业基础课程，在培养学生专业基础知识掌握及运用能力方面占重要的地位。主要讲授日语基础阶段相关的语言知识，训练听、说、读、写、译的基本语言技能，进而逐步培养语言的基础交际运用能力，丰富日本社会文化知识。本课程目标是使学生全面掌握日语语音、文字、词汇、语法等基础知识，培养学生实际灵活运用日语语言基础知识的能力，并进一步拓展全方位的基础语言技能训练，使学生逐步提高日语表达的准确性和流利性，同时也为学生学习《基础日语Ⅳ》以及听、说、读、写、译等综合技能的培养和提高打下坚实的基础。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括平时课堂表现、作业、期中考试和期末考试。
default.en: BASIC JAPANESE (3), as a specialized basic course for Japanese majors, plays an important role in cultivating the ability to master and apply the basic knowledge of Japanese. This course mainly includes language knowledge in the elementary stage of Japanese learning, and trains the basic language skills of listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating, gradually developing the ability to use the language communicatively, and then enriching the knowledge of the Japanese society and culture. The aim of this course is to enable students to comprehensively master phonetic, written, vocabulary, grammar, and other basic knowledge of Japanese, to cultivate students to practically and flexibly utilize the language fundamentals of Japanese. It further expands all-around basic language skill training, so that students can gradually improve the accuracy and fluency of their expressions. Further, it provides a solid foundation for students to study BASIC JAPANESE (4) and improve their comprehensive listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating skills. This course is assessed in a cumulative manner, including regular classroom performance, assignments, a midterm exam, and a final exam.

default.zh: 基础日语（4）作为日语专业的专业基础课程，在培养学生专业基础知识掌握及运用能力方面占重要的地位。主要讲授日语基础阶段相关的语言知识，训练听、说、读、写、译的基本语言技能，进而逐步培养语言的基础交际运用能力，丰富日本社会文化知识。本课程目标是使学生全面掌握日语语音、文字、词汇、语法等基础知识，培养学生实际灵活运用日语语言基础知识的能力，并进一步拓展全方位的基础语言技能训练，使学生逐步提高日语表达的准确性和流利性，同时也为学生学习高年级阶段的专业理论课程以及通过日语能力测试2级（N2）打下坚实的基础。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括平时课堂表现、作业、期中考试和期末考试。
default.en: Basic Japanese (4), as a specialized basic course for Japanese majors, plays an important role in cultivating the ability to master and apply the basic knowledge of Japanese. This course mainly includes language knowledge in the elementary stage of Japanese learning, and trains the basic language skills of listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating, gradually developing the ability to use the language communicatively, and then enriching the knowledge of the Japanese society and culture. The aim of this course is to enable students to comprehensively master phonetic, written, vocabulary, grammar, and other basic knowledge of Japanese, to cultivate students to practically and flexibly utilize the language fundamentals of Japanese. It further expands all-around basic language skill training, so that students can gradually improve the accuracy and fluency of their expressions. At the same time, it also prepares students for the study of specialized theoretical courses at the advanced level, as well as for passing the Japanese Language Proficiency Test Level 2 (N2). This course is assessed in a cumulative manner, including regular classroom performance, assignments, a midterm exam, and a final exam.

default.zh: 日语视听说（1）是日语专业低年级专业必修课，是日语专业的技能课程，在培养学生日语听说能力方面占重要的地位。通过本课程的学习，使学生牢固把握包括音节、词重音、语调及语流音变等基础语音项目的发音方法和规律，培养学生具有初步的听说能力。本课程采用模仿式教学方法强化自然语境下的基础听说技能。主要内容包括基础语音的发音、与基础日语课程同步的所有基本功能意念项目的听力练习和模仿复述训练。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，由课堂表现、课后作业、期中考试成绩和期末考试成绩构成。
default.en: Japanese Viewing, Listening and Speaking（1）is a compulsory course for first-year Japanese majors. It is a skill-training course that plays an important role in developing students’ Japanese speaking and listening ability. This course helps students master the pronunciation methods and rules of basic phonetic items including syllable, word stress, intonation and speech flow change, and cultivate students' initial listening and speaking ability. The main content includes the pronunciation of basic sounds, the listening exercises of all basic functional idea items synchronized with the basic Japanese course, and the imitation and repetition training. The exam score of this course is cumulative, consisting of class performance, homework, midterm exam score and final exam score.

default.zh: 日语视听说（2）是日语专业低年级专业必修课，是日语专业的技能课程，在培养学生日语听说能力方面占重要的地位。通过本课程的学习，使学生牢固把握包括音节、词重音、语调及语流音变等基础语音项目的发音方法和规律，培养学生具有初步的听说能力。本课程采用模仿式教学方法强化自然语境下的基础听说技能。主要内容包括基础语音的发音、与基础日语课程同步的所有基本功能意念项目的听力练习和模仿复述训练。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，由课堂表现、课后作业、期中考试成绩和期末考试成绩构成。
default.en: Japanese Viewing, Listening and Speaking（2）is a compulsory course for first-year Japanese majors. It is a skill-training course that plays an important role in developing students’ Japanese speaking and listening ability. This course helps students master the pronunciation methods and rules of basic phonetic items including syllable, word stress, intonation and speech flow change, and cultivate students' initial listening and speaking ability. The main content includes the pronunciation of basic sounds, the listening exercises of all basic functional idea items synchronized with the basic Japanese course, and the imitation and repetition training. The exam score of this course is cumulative, consisting of class performance, homework, midterm exam score and final exam score.

default.zh: 日语视听说（3）是日语专业低年级专业必修课，是日语专业的技能课程，在培养学生日语听说能力方面占重要的地位。本课程是初级到中级日语听力水平的过渡，采用模仿式教学方法强化自然语境下的基础听说技能，培养学生具有一定的听说能力。本课程的主要内容包括与基础日语课程同步的所有基本功能意念项目的听力练习和模仿能力训练、日语能力考试N3级的听力理解和模仿复述训练。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，由课堂表现、课后作业、期中考试成绩和期末考试成绩构成。
default.en: Japanese Viewing, Listening and Speaking（3）is a compulsory course for second-year Japanese majors. It is a skill-training course that plays an important role in developing students’ Japanese speaking and listening ability. This course serves as a transition in Japanese listening from elementary to intermediate level. It simulates real-life situation to reinforce students’ basic listening and speaking skills in natural context, thereby improving students’ communication skills. The main content of this course includes listening exercises and imitation skills training for all basic functional ideas that are synchronized with the basic Japanese language course, and listening comprehension and imitation repetition training for Japanese Language Proficiency Test N3. The exam score for this course is cumulative, consisting of classroom performance, homework, mid-term exam score, and final exam score.

default.zh: 日语视听说（4）是日语专业二年级专业必修课，在培养学生日语应用能力方面占重要地位。本课程的教学目的旨在培养学生的日语听说能力，提高日语交际能力，丰富学生的日本社会文化知识。 本课程主要教学内容是新日语能力考试N2听力真题和模拟题的听力理解与模仿复述训练。按照能力考试中包含的五种题型，即“课题理解”、“重点理解”、“概要理解”、“即时问答”、“综合理解”，分项进行训练。学生通过本课程的学习，了解日常生活中各种场景的常用表达方式，掌握听懂各种类型会话的技巧，具备听懂篇幅较长、信息量较大的听力材料的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，由课堂表现、课后作业和期末考试成绩构成。通过本课程的学习，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Japanese Viewing, Listening and Speaking (4) is a required course for second-year Japanese majors which plays an important role in developing students’ Japanese application ability. The teaching purpose of this course is to cultivate students' Japanese listening and speaking skills, improve their Japanese communication skills, and enrich their knowledge of Japanese society and culture. The main teaching content of this course is the listening comprehension and imitation retelling training of the real and simulated listening questions of the New Japanese Language Proficiency Test N2. According to the five types of questions included in the test, the training is carried out separately, 5 types, i.e., "topic comprehension", "key comprehension", "summary comprehension", "instant question and answer" and "comprehensive understanding". Through this course, students will be able to understand the common expressions of various scenes in daily life, master the skills of listening to and understanding various types of conversations. You will be able to understand listening materials that are longer, more informative and more complex. The exam score for this course is cumulative, consisting of classroom performance, homework,and final exam score. This course supports the achievement of the appropriate indicator points in the professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 日语口语（2）是日语专业的专业基础课，在日语教学中占有重要的地位。该课程为学生打开了一个直接认识和了解日本社会的窗口，同时可以丰富学生的社会文化知识，培养文化理解能力，使学生具有较高的跨文化理解意识和国际交流意识以及在交流中能够灵活机智地去处理和解决问题通过本课程的学习，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。学生通过与日语老师、同学的灵活多样的会话练习和严格的反复强化训练，逐步掌握日语会话的技能，学会运用日语交际的过程，进一步培养和提高学生的语言表达能力，逐渐掌握综合语言运用能力，为其后续课程及今后的就业打下坚实的基础。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括课堂表现、小测、期末考试等。
default.en: Spoken Japanese (2) is a basic major course for Japanese majors and occupies an important position in Japanese teaching. It opens a window for students to directly learn about Japanese society and culture. The course helps students improve their ability in understanding Japanese culture and raise their awareness in intercultural understanding, so that they are able to deal with intercultural problems flexibly. By the end of this course, students’ achievements are supposed to meet the corresponding goals of this course. By multiple conversational drilling with Japanese teachers and classmates and reinforced repetition drilling, students will be able to master daily conversational skills and learn the process of Japanese communication. All of these further develop students’ language proficiency, prepare them for follow-up courses, and lay a solid foundation for their future career. Course grade is cumulative, which includes class performance, midterm, and final exam.

default.zh: 《基础日语（2）A》是日语专业基础阶段必修的综合课程，是日语学习的入门课，在培养学生专业基础知识掌握及运用能力方面占重要的地位，是基础日语阶段的重中之重。主要讲授日语基础阶段相关的语言知识，训练日语基础初级阶段听、说、读、写、译的基本语言技能。本课程目标是使学生全面掌握日语语音、文字、词汇、语法等基础知识，培养学生实际灵活运用日语语言基础知识的能力，同时也为学生学习《基础日语（3）》作充分的知识储备，并为听、说、读、写、译等综合技能的培养和提高以及通过日语专业四级考试打下坚实的基础。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括平时考核、期中考试和期末考试。
default.en: As a comprehensive entry-level course, [Basic Japanese（2）A] is an important required course for Japanese majors. It teaches students the fundamental knowledge in Japanese and develops students’ basic language skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating. The course objective is to help students grasp basic Japanese knowledge such as phonetics, characters, vocabulary, and grammar, and to train them in the flexible use of basic language knowledge. Meanwhile, it prepares students for the study of Basic Japanese（3）and lays a solid foundation for their training and reinforcement in comprehensive language skills. Course grade is cumulative, made up of usual assessment, midterm, and final exam.

default.zh: 本课程是日语专业本科教学中重要的实践环节。旨在培养学生拥有热爱本职工作的思想，严谨的工作作风，认真的工作态度和综合运用所学知识的能力。使学生通过实践，检验并巩固、提高所学的专业知识，为毕业以后尽快适应所从事的工作，成为社会欢迎的合格的毕业生而打下良好的基础。实习内容包括全面了解实习公司的组织结构、管理制度，熟悉实习公司的业务内容及操作规程，直接参与公司的业务活动，熟悉办公室工作的各个环节；掌握常用专业术语的表达、培养训练公文写作及文书翻译能力；参与实习公司的外事接待等工作，培养和提高日语口语和口译能力。实习成绩采用累加式考核方式，实习贡献20%，实习日志30%，实习单位反馈情况15%，实习报告35%。
default.en: Practicum is an important practical step in the undergraduate education for Japanese majors. It aims to develop students’ enthusiasm for work, earnest work ethic, and ability to apply professional knowledge in practice. Internship helps students in testing and reinforcing professional knowledge, thereby laying a solid foundation for them to adapt to future work and become a qualified graduate welcomed by society. The content of internship involves (1) learning about host company’s organization structure and administrative regulations, (2) familiarizing with job duties, operating rules, and office work procedures, and (3) direct participation in work, especially reception work of foreign affairs. In doing so students will master technical terms frequently used in working context, further enhance their competence in writing and translating official document and other paperwork, as well as improve their oral Japanese and interpretation skills. Course grade is cumulative, consisting of Contribution to practice(20%), internship log (30%), feedback from host company (15%), and internship report (35%).

default.zh: 《日语专业导论》课程作为日语专业的导论课程，目的是让日语专业新生尽早了解外语专业的特点以及日语学科的性质、发展沿革、知识体系、培养目标、学习及研究方法以及毕业去向等基本情况，同时对本专业和大学四年的学习生活有一个系统的认知和精神准备。结合本专业及其拓展专业的基本要求和学生自身特点和发展潜力，及早规划出兼顾本专业培养目标和个性化需求的学习生活目标，确立未来发展方向。该课程采用平时成绩+调查报告+参观交流的累加式考核方式。
default.en: As an introductory course for Japanese majors, the objective of this course is to introduce to first-year Japanese major the characteristics of foreign language major and the basic information about the discipline of Japanese, which includes its features, development, body of knowledge, educational objectives, study and research methods, and students’ future career. Meanwhile, it also systematically orients and prepares students to the 4-year college life. Having learned the requirement of this major and other related major, students can assess their own characteristics and potential, set up individualized goals, and plan for future development. Course grade is cumulative, made up of usual assessment, report, and on-site visit and communication.

default.zh: 日语口语（1）是日语专业的专业基础课，在日语教学中占有重要的地位。该课程为学生打开了一个直接认识和了解日本社会的窗口，同时可以丰富学生的社会文化知识，培养文化理解能力，使学生具有较高的跨文化理解意识和国际交流意识以及在交流中能够灵活机智地去处理和解决问题通过本课程的学习，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。学生通过与外教、同学的灵活多样的会话练习和严格的反复强化训练，逐步掌握日语会话的技能，学会运用日语交际的过程，进一步培养和提高学生的语言表达能力，逐渐掌握综合语言运用能力，为其后续课程及今后的就业打下坚实的基础。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括课堂表现、期末考试等。
default.en: Spoken Japanese (1) is a specialized basic course for Japanese majors and occupies an important position in Japanese language teaching. The course opens a channel for students to know and understand Japanese society directly, and at the same time enriches students' social and cultural knowledge, cultivates their cultural comprehension ability, and enables them to have a high sense of cross-cultural understanding and international exchange, as well as to be able to deal with and solve problems flexibly and tactfully in communication. The study of this course supports the achievement of the corresponding index points in the professional learning outcomes. Through practice of flexible and varied conversations with foreign teachers and classmates and rigorous and repeated intensive training, students will gradually master the skills of Japanese conversation, learn the process of using Japanese to communicate, further develop and improve students' language expression ability, and gradually master the ability of comprehensive language use, which lay solid foundations for their subsequent courses and future employment. This course adopts a cumulative assessment method, including class performance, and final examination.

default.zh: 《基础日语（1）》是日语专业基础阶段必修的综合课程，是日语学习的入门课，是基础日语阶段的重中之重。主要讲授日语基础阶段相关的语言知识，训练日语基础初级阶段听、说、读、写、译的基本语言技能。本课程目标是使学生全面掌握日语语音、文字、词汇、语法等基础知识，培养学生实际灵活运用日语语言基础知识的能力，同时也为学生学习《基础日语（2）》及听、说、读、写、译等综合技能的培养和提高打下坚实的基础。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括平时考核、期中考试和期末考试。
default.en: As a comprehensive entry-level course, [Basic Japanese (1)] is a important required course for Japanese majors. It teaches students the fundamental knowledge in Japanese and develops students’ basic language skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating. The objective of this course is to help students grasp basic Japanese knowledge such as phonetics, characters, vocabulary, and grammar, and to train them in the flexible use of basic language knowledge. Meanwhile, it prepares students for the study of [Basic Japanese （2）A]and lays a solid foundation for their training and reinforcement in comprehensive language skills. Course grade is cumulative, made up of usual assessment, midterm, and final exam.

default.zh: 高级日语（1）作为基础日语的提高课程，不仅加强听说能力教学，更加注重学生写、读方面的训练，以及日本文化、风俗等方面的内容。通过本学年的系统学习，学生将能够达到日语国际能力测试N1级水平，并具备高级的听说能力以及一定的写作能力，特别是应用文写作能力。 教学内容包括文字与词汇方面，重点传授词语用法和近义词辨析等内容。另外，语法与句型方面，重点教授专业日语八级考试和国际日语能力测试N1级考试所要求的语法和句型。阅读理解方面，根据专业日语八级考试和国际日语能力测试N1级考试的出题趋势，培养学生的字面意思理解和抓住关键词理解全文的能力。此外，还增补了与日本人思维方式、习惯等相关的文章，以加强对日本文化的理解。 课程目标包括培养学生阅读各类相关文章的能力，掌握高级词汇和语法的适当使用方法，了解和熟悉课文背景知识，以及相关国家社会、历史和文化知识。 课程考核方式是平时成绩30分，小测30分，期末考试40分。测试按照文章的阅读能力，单词方面的知识，惯用表达的适当的使用。
default.en: As the extension of Basic Japanese, Advanced Japanese （1） aims to continue developing students’ listening and speaking skill, but more emphasis is on reinforcing their reading and writing skill. Meanwhile, the course also covers content concerning Japanese culture and custom. On the basis of Basic Japanese, the systematic training of this course will improve students’ Japanese proficiency in order to meet the standard of New Japanese Language Proficiency Test, Band 1 (N1). Besides, it also further develops students’ advanced listening, speaking, and writing skill, especially practical writing skill. Course content mainly includes characters and vocabulary, grammar and sentence patterns, reading, and class presentation. Course grade is cumulative, made up of assignment, word quizzes, and class performance (altogether 30 points), midterm (30 points), and final exam (40 points). Quizzes test students reading ability, knowledge on words, and the proper use of frequently used expressions.

default.zh: 高级日语（2）作为基础日语的提高课程，不仅加强听说能力教学，更加注重学生写、读方面的训练，以及日本文化、风俗等方面的内容。通过本学年的系统学习，学生将能够达到日语国际能力测试N1级水平，并具备高级的听说能力以及一定的写作能力，特别是应用文写作能力。 教学内容包括文字与词汇方面，重点传授词语用法和近义词辨析等内容。另外，语法与句型方面，重点教授专业日语八级考试和国际日语能力测试N1级考试所要求的语法和句型。阅读理解方面，根据专业日语八级考试和国际日语能力测试N1级考试的出题趋势，培养学生的字面意思理解和抓住关键词理解全文的能力。此外，还增补了与日本人思维方式、习惯等相关的文章，以加强对日本文化的理解。 课程教学方法方面，采用多媒体教学法，结合使用PPT和音频材料，强化课程信息传达。PPT呈现课文背景知识和语言知识，音频材料提供规范的课文朗读示范。同时，采用互动式教学法，通过提问和互动激发学生的主动学习兴趣，培养他们的独立思考、问题分析和问题解决能力。 课程考核方式是平时成绩30分，小测20分，期末考试50分。测试按照文章的阅读能力，单词方面的知识，惯用表达的适当的使用。
default.en: As the extension of Basic Japanese, Advanced Japanese （2） aims to continue developing students’ listening and speaking skill, but more emphasis is on reinforcing their reading and writing skill. Meanwhile, the course also covers content concerning Japanese culture and custom. On the basis of Basic Japanese, the systematic training of this course will improve students’ Japanese proficiency in order to meet the standard of New Japanese Language Proficiency Test, Band 1 (N1). Besides, it also further develops students’ advanced listening, speaking, and writing skill, especially practical writing skill. Course content mainly includes characters and vocabulary, grammar and sentence patterns, reading, and class presentation. Course grade is cumulative, made up of assignment, word quizzes, and class performance (altogether 30 points), mini test (20 points), and final exam (50 points). Tests assess students' reading ability, knowledge of words, and the proper use of frequently used expressions.

default.zh: 《日语视听说（5）》 是日语专业三年级专业必修课，在培养学生日语应用能力方面占重要的地位。本课程的教学目的旨在培养学生具有高级日语听说能力，具有跨文化交际能力，具有运用日语讲好中国故事的能力。 本课程主要教学内容是2023-2024年度公开播放的新闻，涉及政治、经济、文化、社会、交通等领域，内容新，覆盖面广，信息量大，通过本课程的学习，可以帮助学生接触专业术语和热点词汇，培养提高听力和语言应用能力的双重能力。听力资料的实时性还能同步了解日本社会动态、政策变化及文化热点等，增强对日本社会的认知，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: [Japanese Viewing, Listening, and Speaking （5） ]is a required course for third-year Japanese majors which plays an important role in developing students’ Japanese application ability. The teaching purpose of this course is to cultivate students with advanced Japanese listening and speaking skills, intercultural communication skills, and the ability to tell Chinese stories in Japanese. The main teaching content of this course consists of news broadcast publicly during the 2023 - 2024 period, covering fields such as politics, economy, culture, society, and transportation. The content is new, has a wide coverage, and contains a large amount of information. Through studying this course, students can be helped to come into contact with professional terms and hot - topic vocabularies, and cultivate and improve the dual abilities of listening comprehension and language application. The real - time nature of the listening materials can also enable students to understand the social dynamics, policy changes, and cultural hotspots of Japan simultaneously, enhance the understanding of Japanese society, and support the achievement of corresponding indicator points in the professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《大学英语综合（1）》课程旨在培养“国际组织与全球治理”专业的本科生的英语交流水平，在提高高等教育对外开放的背景下，着眼培养具有国际视野和全球竞争力的人才，提高学生英语应用技能，为进一步参与国际化的活动和未来的工作打下坚实的语言和交流技能基础。本课程以国际化交流的读、写、听、说、译技能要求为依托，夯实语言基础，通过高质量的语言输入和高要求的语言输出实践全方位提高学生语言读写听说译的能力，使目标语言成为获取信息、交流沟通和表达观点的有效工具。
default.en: Comprehensive English Course (1) is for first-year undergraduates majoring in International Organizations and Global Governance. The main purpose of the course is to improve students’ English language proficiency and communication skills within the context of the internationalized higher education. This course is to facilitate students’ competence and capacity to become competitive leaders with international awareness, capable of engaging in global endeavors. Embedded with high quality language input of reading, writing, speaking, listening and interpreting materials, this course encourages students’ output in these aspects so as to make English language a tool to ensure their continued efforts in acquiring information, communicating, and expressing their ideas, thoughts, and knowledge.

default.zh: 《大学英语综合（2）》是面向人文社科学部国际组织与全球治理系一年级本科生开设的英语必修课。在第一学期日常综合英语学习的基础上，本学期课程旨在提高学生在高等教育环境中的学术英语能力，提高学生的英语学术学习能力，如听讲座、记笔记、阅读学术文献、撰写论文、宣读论文、参加学术讨论等。该课程采用“以结果为导向”的学术英语教学法，结合正式期刊或会议论文，传授英语听说读写技能，训练学术英语写作技能，培养学术素养。
default.en: Comprehensive English Course (2) is a compulsory English course for the first-year students in the major of International Organizations and Global Governance. The aim of this course is to develop academic English abilities, including understanding English lectures, reading academic literature, writing academic papers, presenting their own research project, and communicating in model academic conferences. The course adopts outcome-oriented teaching method and uses peer-reviewed journal articles as teaching materials. This course features integration of academic English paradigm and practical research projects to cultivate students’ academic competence.

default.zh: 《学术英语素养》是面向国际组织与全球治理专业学生开设的素质教育通识课。本课程以跨文化学术交流为导向，引导学生结合知识创新和技术创新参与国际活动与事务、进行英语学术演讲与写作，促进学术英语能力内涵的培养, 提高语言素养、科学思维、学习自主管理三大维度的学术英语综合素养，提升我校学生在国际舞台的学术竞争力；课程以国际组织为切入点，引导学生对重要的国际组织进行初步了解，掌握参与国际组织活动的社交礼仪及基本素养从而满足百年变局下国家对高层次，高素养国际组织人才培养的迫切需要，进一步顺应“全球经济一体化，世界命运共同体”的发展要求，提升学生的国际化意识，扎实理论基础，培养具有“中国立场，国际表达”能力的高层次国际化人才。
default.en: Academic English literacies is designed and implemented for students majoring in international organizations and global governance, specifically to develop the productive skills of university students in English communication. Oriented towards intercultural communication, the course channels university students to have their voice heard in the form of spoken or written communication and to engage them in international affairs and activities for knowledge advancement and technical innovation. To enhance the academic competitiveness of our students on the international stage, the course improves the comprehensive quality of academic English in three dimensions: language ability, scientific thinking and self-management of learning. In addition, it introduces some key international organizations, guides students to have a preliminary understanding in this field and to masters the social etiquette and basic literacy of participating in international activities, so as to meet the urgent needs of our country for the cultivation of high-level and high-quality international organizational talents facing great changes not seen in a century. Most striking is that the top priority of the course is placed on the notion “have your voice heard globally”, thus realizing the aim of international awareness and academic literacies’ education.

default.zh: 英语笔译是专业限选课，在培养学生实际翻译能力占有重要地位。通过对大量中英材料的翻译训练，使学生更好地了解不同文体的语言特点、翻译的定义与标准、语言文化背景知识、口译基本方法和常用技巧。本课程是国际组织专业的一门基础课。本课程根据复合型和实用型翻译人才的特点和需要，突出实用性，重点讲授专题小组讨论口译的形式、内容以及口译的基本应对技巧，着重进行专题小组讨论形式下的翻译实践能力的培养。通过教学，要求做到以下三点： 1、 使学生了解常见的国际组织文本讨论翻译的形式； 2、 使学生掌握最基本的翻译技能和应对策略； 3、 培养学生在翻译方面的自学能力。
default.en: English-Chinese Trnalsation is a course for International studies majors, and plays an important role in training students’ actual translation ability. Through the translation training of a large number of Chinese-English materials, students can better understand the language characteristics of different styles, the definition and standards of translation, the knowledge of language and culture background, the basic methods and common skills of interpretation. This course is a basic course for English majors. According to the characteristics and needs of complex and practical translation talents, this course highlights practicality, focuses on the form, content and basic coping skills of translation in the form of panel discussion, and focuses on the training of translation practice ability in the form of panel discussion. Through teaching, the following three points are required: 1. To enable students to understand the common forms of translation for panel discussions; 2. To enable students to master the most basic translation skills and coping strategies; 3. Cultivate students’ self-study ability in translation

default.zh: 口译能力是国际组织与全球治理专业专业学生必备的一项基本专业技能。英语口译课是一门语言技能与专业知识相结合的重要课程，该课程旨在培养学生熟练的口译技巧，日后能较好地负担起一般性会议和商务洽谈等口译任务。因此，本课程从口译基础入手，通过训练学生的短时记忆能力、综合概括能力、记笔记能力等来综合提高学生听和口译的能力。然后按主题分单元讲授，穿插以语音室模拟训练，让学生在笔记的辅助下，迅速调整思路，并考虑应对策略，在最短的时间内，准确无误地将听到的信息传递给听众。
default.en: Interpretation ability is a basic professional skill for students majoring in international relations and international organizations. Interpretation is an important course combining language skills and professional knowledge. The course aims to cultivate students' skilled interpretation skills and be able to better undertake interpretation tasks such as general meetings and business negotiations in the future. Therefore, this course starts with the foundation of interpretation and comprehensively improves students' listening and interpretation ability by training students' short-term memory ability, comprehensive generalization ability and note taking ability. Then the lecture is divided into units according to the theme, interspersed with voice room simulation training, so that students can quickly adjust their ideas with the help of notes, consider coping strategies, and accurately transmit the information they hear to the audience in the shortest time.

default.zh: 《基础法语（1）》是国际组织与全球治理专业必修课。本课程将语言知识为主要内容，结合文化知识，从听说读写各个角度完成语言的学习并能够理解法国文化，培养和提高学生的语言运用能力、跨文化交际能力并拓宽国际视野。通过本课程的学习，学生掌握法语语言基础阶段的主要内容，能够熟练使用日常交流领域的词汇、表达方式和句法；能够灵活运用所学法语知识，较清楚地简单表达自己的思想，批判性地评价西方文化。该课程有助于学生在国际组织顺利开展工作并避免工作过程文化差异造成困难，使他们更快地融入国际组织。
default.en: Basic French (I) is a compulsory course for international organizations and global governance majors. This course takes language knowledge as the main content, combined with cultural knowledge, completes language learning from various perspectives of listening, speaking, reading and writing, and can understand French culture, cultivate and improve students' language ability, cross-cultural communication ability and broaden their international perspective. Through the study of this course, students will master the main contents of the basic stage of French language, be able to use vocabulary, expressions and syntax in the field of daily communication proficiently; be able to use the knowledge of French flexibly, express their thoughts clearly and simply, and critically Evaluate Western culture. This course helps students to work smoothly in international organizations and avoid difficulties caused by cultural differences in the work process, so that they can integrate into international organizations more quickly.

default.zh: 《基础法语（2）》是国际组织与全球治理专业必修课。本课程将语言知识为主要内容， 结合文化知识，从听说读写各个角度完成语言的学习并能够理解法国文化，培养和提高学生 的语言运用能力、跨文化交际能力并拓宽国际视野。通过本课程的学习，学生掌握法语语言 基础阶段的主要内容，能够熟练使用日常交流领域的词汇、表达方式和句法；能够灵活运用 所学法语知识，较清楚地简单表达自己的思想，批判性地评价西方文化。该课程有助于学生 在国际组织顺利开展工作并避免工作过程文化差异造成困难，使他们更快地融入国际组织。
default.en: Basic French (II) is a compulsory course for international organizations and global governance majors. This course takes language knowledge as the main content, combined with cultural knowledge, completes language learning from various perspectives of listening, speaking, reading and writing, and can understand French culture, cultivate and improve students' language ability, cross-cultural communication ability and broaden their international perspective. Through the study of this course, students will master the main contents of the basic stage of French language, be able to use vocabulary, expressions and syntax in the field of daily communication proficiently; be able to use the knowledge of French flexibly, express their thoughts clearly and simply, and critically Evaluate Western culture. This course helps students to work smoothly in international organizations and avoid difficulties caused by cultural differences in the work process, so that they can integrate into international organizations more quickly.

default.zh: 《高级法语（1）》是国际组织与全球治理专业学生的必修课，是法语专业学习的主干课程，为其它基础课程和高年级专业课程的学习打下坚实的基础。本课程讲授小说、议论文、戏剧、科普文章及散文等不同风格及体裁的文章。通过讲解语言用法、篇章结构、写作手法、背景知识、主要观点、现实意义等内容，辅助相关语法、词汇、修辞、阅读、翻译、写作等方面的练习，帮助学生获取知识和提高能力。 本课程在教授专业法语知识、法语国家文化知识，构建法语语言知识体系以及中西方文化知识体系的同时，培养学生掌握相关人文社会科学知识、语言综合使用能力、跨文化交流能力及思辨能力。
default.en: Advanced French (1) is a compulsory course for students majoring in International Organizations and Global Governance. It is the main course for French majors and lays a solid foundation for other basic courses and senior professional courses. This course teaches novels, argumentative essays, dramas, popular science articles and essays in different styles and genres. By explaining language usage, discourse structure, writing techniques, background knowledge, main points, practical significance and other contents, it helps students to practice grammar, vocabulary, rhetoric, reading, translation, writing and other aspects to help them acquire knowledge and improve their ability. This course not only teaches professional French knowledge and cultural knowledge of French-speaking countries, but also builds French language knowledge system and Knowledge system of Chinese and Western cultures. At the same time, students are trained to master relevant humanities and social science knowledge, comprehensive language use ability, intercultural communication ability and critical thinking ability.
