It is the main course for French majors and lays a solid foundation for other basic courses and senior professional courses. This course teaches novels, argumentative essays, dramas, popular science articles and essays in different styles and genres. By explaining language usage, discourse structure, writing techniques, background knowledge, main points, practical significance and other contents, it helps students to practice grammar, vocabulary, rhetoric, reading, translation, writing and other aspects to help them acquire knowledge and improve their ability. This course not only teaches professional French knowledge and cultural knowledge of French-speaking countries, but also builds French language knowledge system and Knowledge system of Chinese and Western cultures. At the same time, students are trained to master relevant humanities and social science knowledge, comprehensive language use ability, intercultural communication ability and critical thinking ability.

default.zh: 《法语视听说（1）》是国际组织与全球治理专业必修课。本课程将口语语言知识为主要内容，结合文化知识，从听说角度完成语言的开口学习并能够理解法国文化，培养和提高学生的语言运用能力、跨文化交际能力并拓宽国际视野。通过本课程的学习，学生掌握法语语言基础阶段的主要内容，能够熟练使用日常交流领域的词汇、表达方式和句法；能够灵活运用所学法语知识，较清楚地简单表达自己的思想，批判性地评价西方文化。该课程有助于学生在国际组织顺利开展工作并避免工作过程文化差异造成困难，使他们更快地融入国际组织。
default.en: French Audio-Visual and Oral Practice I is a compulsory course for international organizations and global governance majors. This course takes oral language knowledge as the main content, combined with cultural knowledge, completes the oral learning of language from the perspective of listening and speaking and can understand French culture, cultivate and improve students' language ability, cross-cultural communication ability and broaden their international perspective. Through the study of this course, students will master the main contents of the basic stage of French language, be able to use vocabulary, expressions and syntax in the field of daily communication proficiently; be able to use the knowledge of French flexibly, express their thoughts clearly and simply, and critically Evaluate Western culture. This course helps students to work smoothly in international organizations and avoid difficulties caused by cultural differences in the work process, so that they can integrate into international organizations more quickly.

default.zh: 《法语视听说（2）》是国际组织与全球治理专业必修课。本课程将口语语言知识为主要内容，结合文化知识，从听说角度完成语言的开口学习并能够理解法国文化，培养和提高学生的语言运用能力、跨文化交际能力并拓宽国际视野。通过本课程的学习，学生掌握法语语言基础阶段的主要内容，能够熟练使用日常交流领域的词汇、表达方式和句法；能够灵活运用所学法语知识，较清楚地简单表达自己的思想，批判性地评价西方文化。该课程有助于学生在国际组织顺利开展工作并避免工作过程文化差异造成困难，使他们更快地融入国际组织。
default.en: French Audio-Visual and Oral Practice II is a compulsory course for international organizations and global governance majors. This course takes oral language knowledge as the main content, combined with cultural knowledge, completes the oral learning of language from the perspective of listening and speaking and can understand French culture, cultivate and improve students' language ability, cross-cultural communication ability and broaden their international perspective. Through the study of this course, students will master the main contents of the basic stage of French language, be able to use vocabulary, expressions and syntax in the field of daily communication proficiently; be able to use the knowledge of French flexibly, express their thoughts clearly and simply, and critically Evaluate Western culture. This course helps students to work smoothly in international organizations and avoid difficulties caused by cultural differences in the work process, so that they can integrate into international organizations more quickly.

default.zh: 《国际公务员法语演讲与写作》是国际组织与全球治理专业必修课。本课程以《理解当代中国》系列教材中的法语演讲、法语写作两本教材为依托，结合中西方文化及国际组织日常工作等相关知识，以国际公务员身份为起点，法语演讲与写作的语言运用能力为工具，东西方文化为内容，培养和提高学生的语言运用能力、跨文化交际能力以及讲好中国故事的能力。通过本课程的学习，学生掌握法语语言高级运用的主要内容和能力，能够顺畅理解法语文章、论文；能够灵活运用所学法语知识，能够有条理地、清楚地、有逻辑地表达自己的思想，批判性地评价西方文化。该课程有助于学生在国际组织顺利开展工作并避免工作过程文化差异造成困难，使他们更快地融入国际组织。
default.en: French speech and writing for working in the international public functionary system is a compulsory course for international organizations and global governance majors. This course is based on the two textbooks of French speech and French writing in the series of "Understanding Contemporary China", combined with the relevant knowledge of Chinese and Western culture and the daily work of international organizations, taking the identity of international civil servants as the starting point, the language use ability of French speech and writing as the tool, and the content of Eastern and Western culture, to cultivate and improve students' language use ability, cross-cultural communication ability and the ability to tell Chinese stories. Through the study of this course, students can master the main content and ability of advanced use of French language, and can smoothly understand French articles and papers; Be able to flexibly use the French knowledge learned, be able to express your thoughts in an orderly, clear and logical way, and critically evaluate western culture. This course will help students to work smoothly in international organizations and avoid difficulties caused by cultural differences in the work process, so that they can integrate into international organizations more quickly.

default.zh: 《跨文化沟通》是国际组织与全球治理专业基础课。本课程旨在培养学生全球化时代以构建人类命运共同体为终极目标的跨文化沟通与交流能力。通过本课程学生将学习跨文化交际的基本概念与原理，体验跨文化交际的多样性和复杂性，认识中华传统文化的世界观、价值观和伦理观对全球跨文化交际的重要启示，掌握全球化背景下跨文化交际的基本特点、动态机制和跨文化对话之道, 提高跨文化思辨能力、跨文化理解与沟通能力，自觉实现自我身份再建构与跨文化转变，灵活运用所学正确理解和处理全球工作环境中的跨文化冲突与障碍，为其将来在国际组织中发挥跨文化领导力和全球胜任力、推动构建人类命运共同体奠定坚实的专业基础。
default.en: Intercultural Communication is a foundation course for Minors in International Relations and Global Governance. This course aims to develop students' global intercultural communicative competence with the ultimate goal of building a community of a commonly shared future for humanity. Through this course, students will be able to achieve the following outcomes: learn about the basic concepts and principles of intercultural communication; experience the diversity and complexity of intercultural communication; recognize the important inspirations of the worldview, values and ethics of traditional Chinese culture on global intercultural communication; understand the basic characteristics, dynamic mechanisms and the Dao of intercultural dialogue in the context of globalization; enhance their intercultural criticality, intercultural understanding and communication; and be able to apply what they have learnt to understand and deal with intercultural conflicts and barriers in the global work environment. The course will lay a solid foundation for students to demonstrate in the future their intercultural leadership and global competence in international organizations and to make contributions to the building of a global community of a shared future.

default.zh: 《跨文化沟通》是国际组织与全球治理专业的选修课程。本课程旨在培养学生探究全球议题、理解多元视角、开展有效跨文化互动，并采取负责任行动以推动构建人类命运共同体的能力。课程遵循从理论认知到实践应用的系统化进阶逻辑： ？态度与意识：学生首先通过培养批判性跨文化意识，挑战刻板印象，构建对文化多样性尊重、开放的跨文化态度。 ？知识与理论：学生掌握跨文化沟通核心理论，并通过中西方哲学传统的比较研究，深入理解文化差异的深层根源。 ？策略与叙事：课程重点聚焦“讲述中国故事”。学生学习将当代中国的真实叙事与联合国可持续发展目标等国际价值锚点相结合，并接受言语与非言语沟通策略、语用学及礼仪的训练，确保其信息表达既符合文化规范又具有全球共鸣。 ？实践与治理：通过学期小组项目及国际组织案例分析，学生演练冲突解决、协作领导力及跨文化谈判技巧。 ？课程结束时，学生不仅将掌握分析跨文化现象的理论工具，更将具备在国际组织中充当高效文化桥梁的实践胜任力，为全球治理与相互理解做出贡献。
default.en: Intercultural Communication is a foundational course for the major in International Organizations and Global Governance. The course aims to cultivate students’ ability to investigate global issues, understand diverse perspectives, engage in effective cross-cultural interaction, and take responsible action to promote a Community with a Shared Future for Mankind. The course follows a structured progression from theoretical understanding to practical application: Attitude & Awareness: Students begin by developing critical intercultural awareness, challenging stereotypes, and constructing a respectful, open-minded attitude toward cultural diversity. Knowledge & Theory: Students master core theories and engage in comparative studies of Chinese and Western philosophical traditions to understand the deep-seated roots of cultural differences. Strategy & Narrative: A significant focus is placed on “Telling China’s Stories.” Students learn to integrate authentic narratives of Contemporary China with international value anchors such as the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). They are trained in verbal and non-verbal communication strategies, pragmatics, and etiquette to ensure their messages are culturally appropriate and globally resonant. Practice & Governance: Through a semester-long group project and case studies of International Organizations, students practice conflict resolution, collaborative leadership, and cross-cultural negotiation. By the end of the course, students will not only possess the theoretical tools to analyze intercultural phenomena but also the practical competence to act as effective cultural bridges in international organizations, contributing to global governance and mutual understanding.

default.zh: 本课程系国际组织与全球治理专业本科生的基础课程，旨在使学生深入了解政治学科的基本知识及其当代发展，掌握政治分析基本概念和方法。目标是使学生系统掌握政治学的基本概念、范畴和原理，特别是马克思主义政治学的基本理论和方法论，深入了解政治学科的基本知识及当代发展；掌握政治分析的基本概念和方法；理解政治研究所取得的理论成果；形成和确立基本的政治思维。 本课程主要包括政治学基本范畴、概念和理论，现代政治科学理论以及中国政治与政治过程等政治实践模块。具体内容包括：政治学的研究对象与研究领域，政治学的研究方法，政治学的基本框架与当代流派，现代政治运作的基本制度、政治主体与政治决策过程；政治过程，官僚制相关理论；当代中国政治与政治过程，中国政府结构和运行逻辑。
default.en: This course is a foundational course for undergraduate students majoring in International Organizations and Global Governance, aiming to deepen their understanding of the basic knowledge and contemporary development of the political discipline, and to master the basic concepts and methods of political analysis. The goal is to enable students to systematically grasp the basic concepts, categories, and principles of political science, especially the basic theories and methodologies of Marxist political science, and to have a deep understanding of the basic knowledge and contemporary development of political science; Mastering the basic concepts and methods of political analysis; Understand the theoretical achievements of political research institutes; Develop and establish basic political thinking. This course mainly includes basic categories, concepts, and theories of political science, modern political science theory, and political practice modules such as Chinese politics and political processes. The specific content includes: the research objects and fields of political science, the research methods of political science, the basic framework and contemporary schools of political science, the basic system of modern political operation, political subjects, and political decision-making processes; Political process, bureaucratic theory; Contemporary Chinese politics and political processes, Chinese government structure and operational logic, contemporary Chinese public policy formulation and evaluation.

default.zh: 国际组织与全球治理专业导论课是为国际组织与全球治理专业一年级新生开设的专业引导课，该课程重点介绍国际组织与全球治理专业发展、课程设置、人才培养目标以及关于国际组织与全球治理专业学习的基本要求等。通过本课程的教学使学生了解国际组织与全球治理专业的发展历史，各个学科方向所包含的内容、所从事的工作以及继续深造的途径，培养学生的专业意识。了解本专业的培养目标和课程体系，使学生明确本专业的学习任务，明确学习目标、掌握学习方法，为今后的专业学习打下良好的思想和方法基础。
default.en: International Organizations and Global Governance is an introductory course for freshmen majoring in international organizations and global governance. The course focuses on introducing the development of the major, curriculum setting, training objectives and basic requirements for further studying. Through the teaching of this course, students may comprehend the development history of international organizations and global governance, the contents of various disciplines, the position they would be engaged in， the way to continue their further study and cultivate their professional awareness. Leading students to understand the training objectives and curriculum system of this major may help them clarify the learning tasks, identify the learning objectives and master the learning methods, laying a good ideological and methodological foundation for professional learning in the future.

default.zh: 本课程的教学目的主要是通过对国际关系基本概念、历史及实践等内容的系统介绍，使学生能够深入把握国际关系的深层逻辑、基本价值与规则规范，可以从历史和现实的维度，全方位、多角度地了解国际关系理论的发展历史和学术流派。本课立足于国际关系研究所固有的宽广视域，通过理论框架与实证分析的结合来揭示国际合作与冲突的主要成因，国家发展与经济全球化的基本逻辑，帮助学生奠定理解国际关系所需的史学根底，掌握解释国际关系所需的基础概念、理论范式与方法论，培养学生的跨文化沟通能力与涉外事务的工作能力。
default.en: The purpose of this course is to systematically introduce the major concepts, history and practice of international relations, so that students can deeply grasp the logic, rules and norms of international relations, and understand the development history and academic schools of international relations theories from both historical and realistic ways. Based on the broad perspective of international relations, this course will reveal the main causes of international cooperation and conflict, as well as the basic logic of national development and economic globalization through the combination of theoretical framework and empirical analysis. It will help students lay the historical foundation for understanding international relations and master the concepts, theoretical paradigms and methodology required for explaining international relations. It will also improve students’ cross-cultural communication skills in foreign affairs.

default.zh: 《国际组织概论》是国际组织与全球治理专业核心课程。本课程讲授主要国际组织的概念特征、发展历程、运行机制、用人机制及实习任职途径和方法，通过本课程的学习，学生正确认识国际组织在国际事务中的地位与重要作用及其对中国的意义，明确中国未来参与全球治理的根本目标和重要使命，培养学生的国际交往能力和处理国际事务的基本素质，提升学生对世情分析、推理判断的能力及思辨能力。该课程有助于学生的人文情怀、民族精神和社会责任感的培养，引导学生为国际组织实习任职付出积极的努力。
default.en: Overview of International Organizations is a main course for the major of International Organizations and Global Governance. It includes the main characteristics, development course, operation mechanism, employment mechanism and application methods of international organizations. Students will understand the important role of international organizations in international affairs and their significance to China, and know the basic goal of China's future participation and important mission in global governance. Students will enhance their international communication ability and basic international affair quality, and improve the social analysis, reasoning, judgment and thinking capability. This course helps to cultivate students' humanistic feelings, national spirit and sense of social responsibility, and guides them to make positive efforts to enter international organizations.

default.zh: 社会调查研究方法是社会学领域的一门基础课程，为我们观察社会变化、分析社会关系、解释社会现象和把握社会规律提供重要的理论依据和手段。本课程的首要目的，是培养学生独立提出科学问题，并利用社会调查研究的相关方法开展学术研究的能力。 通过本课程的学习，学生将充分了解社会调查研究的基本概念和基本原理，并掌握分析和研究社会问题的定量方法。此外，通过个人研究计划的撰写，使学生熟练掌握社会调查研究的收据收集和分析方法，培养学生运用这些方法解决现实问题的能力。
default.en: Methods of social research is fundamental course in the discipline of sociology. It provides us the important theoretical basis and methods for observing social changes, analyzing social relations, explaining causes and consequences of a phenomenon, and understanding the law of social changes. The primary goals of this course are to train the students’ skills in proposing research questions independently and exploit the relevant methods to conduct academic investigation. By learning this course, students will be able to understand and interpret the basic concepts and principles in social research methods and understand the quantitative methods for analyzing social research questions. Additionally, the students will be able to develop skills in data collection and analysis in process of writing individual research proposal, which may enhance their capability of solving practical problems.

default.zh: 全球治理概论的教学目的就是让学生从全球的视角掌握公共行政领导力的知识框架。本课程分为三大板块，即对国际公共事务的全面了解、对治理的历史演变与方法的掌握和领导力的概况与基本素质要求，这三大板块既相互独立又相互联系，促使学生在认知上由专业能力向社会服务能力扩展。本课程由八讲完成，国际公共事务板块三讲、治理板块三讲、全球化领导力两讲。
default.en: 全球治理概论的教学目的就是让学生从全球的视角掌握公共行政领导力的知识框架。本课程分为三大板块，即对国际公共事务的全面了解、对治理的历史演变与方法的掌握和领导力的概况与基本素质要求，这三大板块既相互独立又相互联系，促使学生在认知上由专业能力向社会服务能力扩展。本课程由八讲完成，国际公共事务板块三讲、治理板块三讲、全球化领导力两讲。

default.zh: 《国际政治概论》是大学国际政治、外交学和政治学专业本科生必修的学科基础课，主要讲授内容是国际体系中各个国际行为体之间的政治关系及其发展变化的一般规律。国际政治体系实际上是一般政治系统的延伸与部分重合。作为一种国际系统，它是国际行为体之间相互联系、相互作用的整体。它的构成要素主要是国家行为体和非国家行为体，它集中表现为国际政治力量之间相互作用而形成的一定结构状态，即国际政治格局。
default.en: Introduction to International Politics is a compulsory subject foundation course for undergraduate students of international politics, diplomacy and political science in universities, which focuses on the political relations between various international actors in the international system and the general laws of their development and changes. The international political system is actually an extension and partial overlap of the general political system. As an international system, it is a whole of interconnection and interaction among international actors. Its constituent elements are mainly state actors and non-state actors, and it concentrates on a certain structural state formed by the interaction between international political forces, namely the international political pattern.

default.zh: 《外交学概论》是国际组织与全球治理专业专业核心课。本课程重点介绍职业外交官的工作制度、工作规范和工作技巧，培养和提高学生对外交工作和平本质的理解。通过本课程的学习，学生掌握外交工作的基本规范、流程，能够掌握外交官的情报职能、谈判职能、礼宾礼仪。该课程有助于学生在国际组织工作过程中完成国家交办的谈判、情报、接待等多元化的外交任务，使他们更快地融入国际组织。
default.en: Introduction to Diplomacy is a core course for the undergraduate students in International Organizations and Global Governance. This course focuses on the working system, working norms and working skills of professional diplomats. It improves students' understanding of the peace in diplomatic work. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic norms and procedures of diplomatic work, and can master the intelligence functions, negotiation functions and protocol of diplomats. The course helps students complete the various diplomatic tasks of negotiation, intelligence and reception assigned by the state in the process of working in international organizations, so that they can integrate into international organizations faster.

default.zh: 实习是国际组织与全球治理专业培养方案的必修环节，主要目的是帮助学生树立全球视野、认识国际组织就业、拓宽职业选择空间。通过教师的课堂讲授学习国际组织的分类与概况、求职途径、人才素质要求等相关知识，以及通过模拟面试、小组讨论、实地参访、交流沙龙等实践活动对国际组织产生更直观的认识，提高自身的国际组织求职能力。侧重外交领导力与国际就业能力培养，通过线下线上相结合的方式，接受来自联合国开发计划署、世贸组织等热门国际组织现任或前任官员的学术指导，提高实践能力。
default.en: Internship is a mandatory part of the training program for international organizations and global governance, with the main purpose of helping students establish a global perspective, understand employment opportunities in international organizations, and broaden their career choices. Through classroom teaching by teachers, students can learn about the classification and overview of international organizations, job seeking approaches, talent quality requirements, and other related knowledge. Through practical activities such as simulated interviews, group discussions, on-site visits, and exchange salons, students can gain a more intuitive understanding of international organizations and improve their ability to seek employment in international organizations. Emphasis is placed on the cultivation of diplomatic leadership and international employability, through a combination of offline and online approaches, receiving academic guidance from current or former officials of popular international organizations such as the United Nations Development Programme and the World Trade Organization to enhance practical skills.

default.zh: 《国际关系史》是国际组织与全球治理系的专业基础课。国际关系史指国际行为体之间相互关系产生、发展和演变的历史。本课程主要介绍近现代意义上的国际关系史，分十二个专题介绍从十六世纪到全球化时代的国际关系。本课程主要选择国际关系史上的重大事件，以大国关系演变为主轴，注重历史事件在时间上的纵向延续性，注重全球各区域之间的横向关联性。学生通过学习能够提高对国际关系发展的历史进程及当今国际事务的科学认识能力，成长为具有全球视野、符合我国和平发展需要的人才。
default.en: History of International Relations is a fundamental course for the International Organizations and Global Governance. The history of international relations refers to the history of the emergence, development, and evolution across nations over time. The course introduces international relations from the 16th century to the globalization era with twelve major topics. This course focuses on major events in the international history to reveal the causal relations of historical events and the interactions of regions in the world. With this course, students will improve their understanding of the historical process of the international relations and today’s international affairs, and expand their global vision for the needs of China’s peaceful development.

default.zh: 《英语读写》是英语辅修专业主要课程，讲课32学时。课程侧重英语基础知识的教学以及读、写、译等各项实践技能的综合培养；课程教学兼顾英语国家文化知识的讲授。本课程通过对语言点的详细阐释、篇章结构的整体把握、相关文化背景知识的介绍、以及相关问题的讨论，帮助学生打下扎实的英语语言基础，增强英语读写能力，增加对英语国家文化的了解，提高英语综合运用能力。课程采用累加式考核形式，包括课堂讨论、平时测验、课后作业和期末考试等。
default.en: English Reading and Writing, with 32 lecture hours, is the main course of English minors. It focuses on the teaching of basic knowledge of English language, the cultivation of skills including reading, writing, and translation, and the instruction of English-speaking countries’ culture. The course, by means of explaining difficulties in language, mastery of discourse structures, introduction to relevant cultural background knowledge and discussion of relevant issues, aims to enable students to form a solid basis of English language, enhance the skills in English reading and writing, increase the understanding of English-speaking countries’ culture, and develop the integrated ability of English application. The final score is achieved by adding up the score of following items: discussion in class, unit quizzes, homework and final examination.

default.zh: 英语读写进阶是辅修学生的必修课，在培养学生语言基本功及语言综合运用能力方面占重要的地位，本课程为后续专业学习奠定扎实的基础。本课程侧重于读、写结合的语言基本技能的培养，培养学生综合的语言运用能力。通过本课程的学习，学生应该了解和熟悉与课文相关的背景知识，扩大知识面；熟练运用所学关键词语、句式，解释重要语句、理解课文主旨；熟悉文章的体裁、结构、内容、写作技巧；具备分析，欣赏和批判的能力；掌握综合运用语言的能力，能把所学知识写出地道的英文。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、课后练习、期末考试等成绩。
default.en: Advanced English Reading and Writing, as a compulsory course for Minors in English, plays an indispensable role in consolidating students’ language skills for subsequent other major-related courses. The teaching contents focus on cultivating the students’ abilities in reading and writing with the purpose of improving the students’ comprehensive English skills. Through this course, students are expected to learn about the background information related to the texts, broadening their horizon; to skillfully apply the key vocabulary and sentence structure in their own language practice and paraphrase the difficult sentences and get the main idea of the text; to get familiar with the different genres and writing techniques; to develop the analytic, appreciative, and critical abilities; to appropriately output what they have learned from the text. The final assessment of the course consists of the following part: classroom participation; exercises of each text, and final written examination.

default.zh: 英语演讲课面向英语辅修学生开课，是一门综合技能必修课，旨在培养学生“说”的能力，训练学生语言表达的连贯性、思维的逻辑性、以及独立思考和思辨能力。课程内容分为基础理论、实例分析和实践三个环节，注重学生的实际演练，着重训练三种类型的演讲—自我介绍、信息性演讲和说服性演讲。课程讲授公共演讲的基本知识和技巧，包括英语演讲的选题、确立演讲主题、谋篇布局的方法，演讲稿的撰写和分析，同时也训练学生在演讲过程中对身体语言的使用，例如姿态、眼神、动作等。
default.en: English Public Speaking is a course for the second-year English minors. It is a comprehensive skill-training course, aiming to develop the students’ speaking skills through the training of language use, logic and independent and critical thinking ability. It consists of three parts: theory introduction, speech analysis and speech practice, and will focus on applying the principles of public speaking to three types of speeches, namely self-introductory speeches, informative speeches and persuasive speeches. It will lead the students to explore how to choose a topic, how to decide on the theme, how to organize the speech, how to analyze a speech and how to deliver a prepared speech. Meanwhile the non-verbal factors will also be dealt with in class, such as gestures, eye-contact and hand movements.

default.zh: 英汉笔译是英语辅修专业的专业必修课，对于培养学生的对翻译的基本认识，翻译技巧有很重要的意义。学生通过对翻译基础的全面分析，理解翻译的要求，掌握英汉翻译的基本技巧。本课程将提高学生的翻译能力以及相关技能的运用水平，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。本课程的目的是让学生掌握翻译的基本原理，并通过大量的实践，具备一定的翻译能力，掌握不同文体（主要是应用文体）的英汉翻译的基本特点和技巧，最后能够借助字典翻译一般难度的文章。本课程的主要内容包括英语和汉语之间的差别，如形合与意合等；翻译的基本原理、标准、技巧，如增词、减词、转换等；不同层次的翻译，如词语层、句子层、段落层、篇章层等；不同文体的翻译，如文学文体、科技文体、旅游文体、新闻文体、广告文体等。学习本课程，学生需将翻译理论与翻译实践紧密结合，进而掌握翻译基本原理、不同文体（主要为应用文体）英汉翻译基本特点、不同文体英汉翻译的技巧。本课程将通过大量实践培养学生翻译能力，让其学习英译汉的技巧、层次、难点、疑点、文体、译文质量评估等相关知识，并采用启发式、互动式教学法，培养学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: English-Chinese Translation is a required course for English minors, which holds significant importance in cultivating students’ basic understanding of translation and translation skills. Through a comprehensive analysis of translation fundamentals, students will grasp the essential requirements and fundamental skills of English-Chinese translation. This course aims to improve students’ translation ability and application of related skills, laying a solid foundation for subsequent courses. The course aims to enable students to master the basic principles of translation, acquire certain translation capabilities through extensive practice, and grasp the basic characteristics and techniques of English-Chinese translation in different genres, primarily focusing on applied text types. By the end of this course, students will be able to translate general difficulty articles with the aid of a dictionary. The course covers a wide range of topics, including differences between English and Chinese, such as formalization and semantic unification, basic principles, standards, and skills of translation, such as insertion, deletion, and transformation, translation at different levels, such as word level, sentence level, paragraph level, and discourse level, and the translation of different genres, such as literary style, technical style, tourism style, news style, and advertising style. When learning this course, students need to closely combine translation theory with translation practice, thereby mastering the basic principles of translation and the fundamental characteristics and skills of English-Chinese translation in different genres, mainly applied text types. The course will foster students’ translation ability in extensive practice, enabling them to learn the skills, levels, difficulties, ambiguities, genres, and quality assessment of English-Chinese translation, and adopt heuristic and interactive teaching methods, cultivating students’ independent thinking, problem analysis, and resolution abilities.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养“国际组织与全球治理”专业的本科生在国际舞台和国际组织中进行沟通和商谈并最终解决问题的能力，在提高高等教育对外开放的背景下，着眼培养具有国际视野和全球竞争力的人才，提高学生英语应用技能，为进一步参与国际化的活动和未来的工作打下坚实的语言和交流技能基，并提高对全球问题的见解和背景的理解，提高解决国际问题的能力。
default.en: Negotiations in International Organizations is a course for students who major or minor in “International organizations and global governance”. The major purpose of the course is to help students improve their ability to discuss and negotiate in international organizations or institutions to solve issues and problems. In doing this, the course enables students to become competitive in international platforms in their language usage and their communication skills, and also in their understanding and perspectives for international issues, crises and problems.

default.zh: 《中西文化对比》课程旨在深度解析中西文化在价值取向、社会规范、认知模式等维度的碰撞与交融。课程构建“语言—文化”双螺旋教学体系，将语言要素与文化内涵深度绑定，通过跨学科视角系统梳理中西文化的历史脉络、社会结构和思维特质，运用比较研究法揭示文化差异的显性表征与隐性逻辑。课程围绕文化意识、知识体系、实践能力三维目标，设计培养方案：其一，通过文化冲突情境模拟训练，培育学生的文化相对主义思维；其二，搭建中西文化认知框架，强化文化符号解码与意义重构能力；其三，构建“英语表达+文化阐释+批判思维”三位一体的实践平台，重点提升跨文化语境下的语言转换能力、文化价值判断能力及有效沟通能力。课程致力于培育具有文化自觉意识、全球胜任力和创新实践能力的复合型跨文化人才，为构建人类命运共同体提供人才支撑。
default.en: The course "Comparison between Chinese and Western Cultures" aims to deeply analyze the collisions and integrations between Chinese and Western cultures in dimensions such as value orientations, social norms, and cognitive models. The course constructs a "language - culture" double helix teaching system, deeply integrating linguistic elements with cultural connotations. It systematically sorts out the historical context, social structures, and thinking characteristics of Chinese and Western cultures from an interdisciplinary perspective, and employs the comparative research method to reveal both the explicit manifestations and implicit logic of cultural differences. Centering on the three-dimensional goals of cultural awareness, knowledge system, and practical ability, the course designs a cultivation plan: firstly, it cultivates students' cultural relativism thinking through cultural conflict situation simulation training; secondly, it builds a cognitive framework for Chinese and Western cultures, strengthening students' ability to decode cultural symbols and reconstruct meanings; thirdly, it constructs a "English expression + cultural interpretation + critical thinking" three-in-one practical platform, focusing on enhancing students' language conversion ability, cultural value judgment ability, and effective communication ability in cross-cultural contexts. The course is committed to nurturing compound cross-cultural talents with cultural self-awareness, global competence, and innovative practical abilities, providing talent support for building a community with a shared future for mankind.

default.zh: 法语是辅修专业国际关系与国际组织专业必修课，通过对法语语言的应用性学习，学生理解所学内容的语境用法、语法词汇、语言特点、文化背景，熟练运用特定场景下的语言。本课程将提高学生对法语作为工作语言的语言运用能力、提高对国际组织的了解程度、促进对国际关系的理解，为其学习后续课程、进入国际组织工作等打下坚实的基础。具体内容包括音标学习、介绍与自我介绍、工作联络、活动参与辅助、简历及动机信写作及相关文化背景知识等。在传授学生法语语言知识和国际组织相关文化知识的同时，构建法语语言知识体系和中西方文化知识体系，培养学生的阅读理解能力、分析欣赏能力、批判性思维能力和跨文化交际能力。课文题材以对话和科普国际关系国际组织相关内容为主，词汇涉及国际组织工作的各个对话场景。通过本课程的学习，达到能够在国际组织中用法语开展简单工作，并能够对国际关系有一定的认识和理解。
default.en: French is a course of the major of international relations and international organization. Through the learning of French language, students understand the contextual usage, grammar vocabulary, language characteristics and cultural background of the content, and skillfully use the language in specific scenes. This course will improve students' ability to use French as a working language, improve their understanding of international organizations, promote understanding of international relations, and lay a solid foundation for learning follow-up courses and entering international organizations. Specific content includes phonetic learning, introduction and self-introduction, work contact, activity participation assistance, resume and motivation letter writing and related cultural background knowledge. While teaching students French language knowledge and relevant cultural knowledge of international organizations, the French language knowledge system and Chinese and Western cultural knowledge systems are constructed to cultivate students' reading comprehension ability, analytical appreciation ability, critical thinking ability and intercultural communication ability. The text is mainly related to the dialogue and the knowledge and information about the international organization, and the vocabulary involves various dialogue scenes of the work. Through the study of this course, we can achieve simple work in French inside international organizations and have a certain understanding of international relations.

default.zh: 《世界通史》为国际组织与全球治理辅修专业的必修课程。针对本专业的特点及需求，课程聚焦世界历史中的国际关系体系部分，以影响世界历史发展各个阶段的重大事件为基础，探究事件在全球国际关系体系中的互动以及影响。帮助学生掌握世界历史发展的普遍规律及发展进程；探讨这些重大事件是如何改变世界政治、经济等领域并影响到今天的制度、宗教和文化，从而加深学生对人类社会和当今世界的认识，帮助学生树立科学的世界观；同时提高学生的人文素养和审美能力，拓展学生的知识面和文化视野，提高学生的思辨能力，为了解当今国际关系及中外文化打下基础。
default.en: General History of the World is a compulsory course for the minor major in International Organizations and Global Governance. In view of the characteristics and needs of this major, the course focuses on the international relations in world history, and explores the interaction and impact of events in the global international relations based on the major events that affect the development of world history. The course helps students grasp the general laws and development process by exploring how major events have changed the world’s politics, economy and society. This may facilitate students’ understanding of human society and the world today so as to establish a scientific outlook and critical thinking ability to lay a foundation for understanding today’s world and cultures.

default.zh: 《跨文化沟通》是国际组织与全球治理专业基础课。本课程旨在培养学生全球化时代以构建人类命运共同体为终极目标的跨文化沟通与交流能力。通过本课程学生将学习跨文化交际的基本概念与原理，体验跨文化交际的多样性和复杂性，认识中华传统文化的世界观、价值观和伦理观对全球跨文化交际的重要启示，掌握全球化背景下跨文化交际的基本特点、动态机制和跨文化对话之道, 提高跨文化思辨能力、跨文化理解与沟通能力，自觉实现自我身份再建构与跨文化转变，灵活运用所学正确理解和处理全球工作环境中的跨文化冲突与障碍，为其将来在国际组织中发挥跨文化领导力和全球胜任力、推动构建人类命运共同体奠定坚实的专业基础。
default.en: Intercultural Communication is a foundation course for Minors in International Relations and Global Governance. This course aims to develop students' global intercultural communicative competence with the ultimate goal of building a community of a commonly shared future for humanity. Through this course, students will be able to achieve the following outcomes: learn about the basic concepts and principles of intercultural communication; experience the diversity and complexity of intercultural communication; recognize the important inspirations of the worldview, values and ethics of traditional Chinese culture on global intercultural communication; understand the basic characteristics, dynamic mechanisms and the Dao of intercultural dialogue in the context of globalization; enhance their intercultural criticality, intercultural understanding and communication; and be able to apply what they have learnt to understand and deal with intercultural conflicts and barriers in the global work environment. The course will lay a solid foundation for students to demonstrate in the future their intercultural leadership and global competence in international organizations and to make contributions to the building of a global community of a shared future.

default.zh: 本课程为英语专业二年级学生开设，是一门集英国背景知识和英语语言知识为一体的英语专业必修课，其根本任务是全面提高学生的文化素养。通过对英国的地理、人口、经济、政治、社会、特别是历史等各方面学习，争取让学生对英国有一个整体的概观，扩大学生的知识面，使他们能较好地理解其文化和价值观。同时，本课程旨在提供理解英国文学和跨文化交际课所必需的背景知识，使学生在跨国跨文化的交际中，成功地运用他们所学的知识与技能。在了解以上知识的同时，学习者可以扩充大量的相关英语词汇，为其它课程提供有关英国的背景知识，为进一步学习、研究语言和文学等打好基础。另外，学生在学习知识的同时，还可以提高英语阅读能力，提高学生对文化差异的宽容性和处理文化差异的灵活性。此外，本课程要求学生熟悉中国文化传统，具有较多的人文知识和科技知识，较强的创新意识和一定的创新能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，总成绩是期末试卷、学期论文、课堂演示等项的总和。
default.en: The course is designed for the sophomore students of the English major. This is an English major compulsory course which, mingling together the background information of UK and knowledge of the English language, aims at cultivating the students’ cultural awareness and enabling them to acquire the desired traits. This course introduces to students information about the geography, people, economy, politics, society, and particularly the history of the United Kingdom, thus enlarging their sphere of knowledge and enhancing their power to better understand English culture and values. Meanwhile, it provides the essential background knowledge for the study of English literature and cross-cultural communication, enabling the students to successfully manipulate the knowledge and skills they have acquired in cross-national and cross-cultural communication. Through the learning of the previous lectures, learners can broaden their pool of vocabulary, therefore offering British culture-based knowledge for further research in linguistics and literature. Meanwhile, the learners’ reading comprehension competence can be improved, the tolerance of treating cross-cultural differences can be strengthened and the ability of handling cultural differences flexibly can be improved. Also, this course requires that students be familiar with Chinese culture, acquire more knowledge of liberal arts and technology, and improve their initiative awareness and abilities. The total score of this course is based on the following parts: final exam paper, term paper and class presentation.

default.zh: 本课程为英语专业二年级学生开设，是一门集美国背景知识和英语语言知识为一体的英语专业必修课，其根本任务是全面提高学生的文化素养。通过对美国的地理、人口、经济、政治、社会、特别是历史等各方面学习，争取让学生对美国有一个整体的概观，扩大学生的知识面，使他们能较好地理解其文化和价值观。同时，本课程旨在提供理解美国文学和跨文化交际课所必需的背景知识，使学生在跨国跨文化的交际中，成功地运用他们所学的知识与技能。在了解以上知识的同时，学习者可以扩充大量的相关英语语词汇，为其它课程提供有关美国的背景知识，为进一步学习、研究语言和文学等打好基础。另外，学生在学习知识的同时，还可以提高英语阅读能力，提高学生对文化差异的宽容性和处理文化差异的灵活性。同时，本课程要求学生熟悉中国文化传统，具有较多的人文知识和科技知识，较强的创新意识和一定的创新能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，总成绩是期末试卷、学期论文、课堂演示等项的总和。
default.en: The course is designed for the sophomore students of the English major. This is an English major compulsory course which mingles together with the background information of USA and knowledge of the English language, aims at cultivating the students’ cultural awareness and enabling them to acquire the desired traits. This course introduces the information on the geography, people, economy, politics, society and particularly the history of the United States of America, thus enlarging their sphere of knowledge and enhancing their power to better understand American culture and values. Meanwhile, it provides the essential background knowledge for the study of American literature and cross-cultural communication, enabling the students to successfully manipulate the knowledge and skills they have acquired in cross-cultural communication. Through the learning of the previous lectures, learners can broaden their pool of vocabulary, therefore offering American culture-based knowledge for further research in linguistics and literature. Meanwhile, the learners’ reading comprehension competence can be improved, the tolerance of treating cross-cultural differences can be strengthened and the ability of handling cultural differences flexibly can be improved. Also, this course requires that students be familiar with Chinese culture, acquire more knowledge of liberal arts and technology, and improve their initiative awareness and abilities. The total score of this course is based on the following parts: final exam paper, term paper and class presentation.

default.zh: 英国文学史是为英语专业三年级学生开设的专业核心课。课程旨在使学生了解英国文学的发展全貌，系统掌握英国文学的相关知识、文学体裁的基础知识以及文学批评的基本方法，培养学生理解和鉴赏英国文学作品的能力以及初步的独立研究能力，促进其思辨能力的提高。课程以时间为主线，全面介绍影响英国文学发展的历史背景、社会背景及文化思潮，追溯英国文学的发展历史，探讨主要文学流派及其代表作家和作品的特点，同时选取各个阶段有代表性作家的作品进行细致的文本分析。课程采用累加式考核方式，考核环节包括课堂表现、测验、研读报告、小组项目学习、课程论文以及期末考试。
default.en: History of English Literature is a compulsory course offered to the English juniors. This course aims to help the students get an overview of the development of English literature, and systematically grasp the knowledge of English literature and literary genres as well as the basic methods of literary criticism. It also aims to cultivate students’ ability to understand and appreciate English literature, do some preliminary research independently and improve their critical thinking. This course chronologically traces the history of English literature within the historical, social and ideological context, explores the characteristics of the dominant literary schools, representative writers and works, with a close textual analysis of the selected works from different periods in the development of English literature. The outcome of the course will be evaluated in an accumulative way, including classroom participation, quizzes, report, group project study, term paper, and final exam.

default.zh: 美国文学史是为英语专业三年级学生开设的专业核心课，在培养学生文学鉴赏能力、思辨能力和批判阅读能力方面占有重要的地位。通过对美国文学发展史的学习，学生了解熟悉美国文学的全貌，掌握文学批评的基本知识和方法以及不同文学流派的主要特征；通过对所选文学作品的解读分析，培养学生阅读、欣赏、理解美国文学原著的能力，提高文学修养。本课程将提高学生对英语的敏感性，促进他们语言综合使用能力的提高。本课程以时间为主线，较系统地介绍美国文学的发展历史、主要文学流派及其代表作家和作品。主要讲授美国文学的主要发展阶段和主要文学流派，构建美国文学发展流变的知识体系，通过代表作家介绍和经典作品分析，传授文学批评的基本知识和主要方法。本课程主要涉及以下流派：印第安文学传统、殖民时期的美国文学、美国民族文学、浪漫主义文学、现实主义文学、自然主义文学、现代主义文学、后现代主义文学、女性文学、美国黑人文学、美国犹太文学和美国华裔文学。本课程考核采用累加式，总成绩包括平时表现、作业、测验和期末考试成绩。
default.en: History of American Literature is a compulsory course offered to the junior English majors. It is an important part of English majors’ literature courses and paves the way to other literature courses to be learnt later. This course covers briefly the historical development of American literature with its respective historical, social and ideological context. In the chronological order, taking into consideration the historical background and the ideological context, this course systematically traces the historical development of American literature. It introduces students to the various literary schools in the different stages of American literature and their respective features, explores the writing styles of the representative writers of different literary periods as displayed in their masterpieces, analyzes the major themes and artistic features of the important works, and explains some basic literary terms and their general features, so that the students can have an overall view of the history of American literature and grasp the fundamental knowledge of literature. This course aims at cultivating students’ interest in English literature and enhancing their understanding of American culture through the reading and analysis of individual literary works. History of American Literature helps to improve students’ sensibility towards English, promote their basic language skills and enhance their understanding of American literature and culture. The course consists of the following chapters：Literature of Native Indians, Literature of Colonial Period, American National Literature, Romanticism, Realism, Naturalism, Modernism, Post-Modernism, Women Writings, Afro-American literature, American Jewish Literature and Chinese American Literature. The grading system consists of class participation, homework, quizzes, and the final examination.

default.zh: 《跨文化交际课程》的主要内容涵盖全球化背景下跨文化交际的主要理论、核心概念、基本原理及其社会文化实践，旨在培养学生在全球化时代以构建人类命运共同体为目标的跨文化沟通与交流的能力。通过本课程学生将学习跨文化交际的基本概念与原理，体验跨文化交际的多样性和复杂性，认识中华传统文化的世界观、价值观和伦理观对全球跨文化交际的重要启示，掌握全球化背景下跨文化交际的基本特点、动态机制和跨文化对话之道, 提高跨文化思辨能力、跨文化理解与沟通能力，并能够灵活运用所学知识正确理解和处理实际生活、学习及工作环境中的跨文化冲突与障碍，提升自身在全球化多元化时代的跨文化适应能力和胜任能力。
default.en: Intercultural Communication is a compulsory course for all English majors. The course aims to develop students' ability to communicate with people of different cultural backgrounds with the ultimate goal of building a community of human destiny in the era of globalization. The main content covers the main features, core concepts and basic principles of intercultural communication as well as its socio-cultural practices in the context of globalization. Through this course, students will learn about the basic concepts and principles of global intercultural communication, experience its diversity and complexity, recognize the insights that the anthropocosmic worldview, values and ethics of traditional Chinese culture offers for global intercultural communication. The students are required to understand the basic characteristics, dynamic mechanisms and ways of intercultural dialogue in the context of globalization, and develop their abilities and skills in intercultural criticality, intercultural interactions and intercultural adaptation in the era of globalization and diversity, and be able to deal with intercultural conflicts and barriers in their real-life intercultural encounters. This course will provide students with a solid professional foundation for intercultural personhood development and prepare them for active participation in building a global community of a shared future. The course assessment is based on the overall performance of students’ class participation, class presentations, course project report and final examination.

default.zh: 英语语言学导论为英语专业三年级学生开设，是英语专业本科高年级专业必修课程，是使学生对于语言学这门系统、严谨的科学启蒙、入门的课程。课程目的在于为学生系统展现语言学的整体领域和研究概貌、培养学生的语言分析能力、抽象思辨能力和学术研究能力。本课程能够为毕业论文写作、为学生将来在语言学和翻译学方向的研究生阶段的学习和研究奠定理论和方法基础。本课程的内容包括语言学以及语言学各分支的基本概念、以及主要理论与分析方法，涵盖了语言的本质及设计特征、语言的起源、功能、结构特征，语音、词汇、句法、语义、语用，以及心理语言学、语言习得、社会语言学等现代语言学的主要方面的基础知识。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括课堂参与、平时作业、期末考试和期末课程论文。
default.en: Introduction to English Linguistics is a compulsory course for the juniors majoring in English language which introduces the students to linguistics, the rigorous, systematic and scientific study of human language. It aims at providing a bird’s eye view on the existing knowledge and the current status of research in the field of linguistics and meanwhile cultivating the abilities of linguistic analysis, critical thinking and academic research. The course mainly involves introductions to the basic concepts, major theories and ways of analysis concerning linguistics in general and the different branches of linguistics, including such major aspects of language and linguistics as the nature and the design features of language, the origin of language, the functions of language, the phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics and pragmatics of language, psycholinguistics, language acquisition, and language in society. Students’ performances are evaluated with regard to class participation, assignments, the final exam, and the course paper.

default.zh: 汉英笔译是英语专业高年级学生的专业必修课，对于培养学生翻译技巧有很重要的意义。本门课程中，实践占据较大比重，大约为50%左右。课程重点是加强各类文体科技文本的翻译实践。选择典型的材料，让学生翻译，之后在课堂上有效利用时间，集中讲评。课程将分六个主要章节：分别去了解英汉语言差异，了解翻译基本原理和标准，掌握一定的翻译技巧。在此基础上，集中针对科技文本中的新闻类、学术类和科普介绍类文本进行大量的翻译实践。要求学生掌握基本的翻译理论和翻译技巧，大量地进行翻译实践，将理论和技巧运用到实践中去。能够解决翻译中常见的各种问题，独立承担起翻译工作。本课程采取笔译考试形式。
default.en: Chinese-English translation is a compulsory course for junior English majors, which is of great significance for cultivating students' basic understanding of translation and translation skills. This course attaches great importance to practice, which accounts for 50% of the total course time. The focus of the course is to enhance translation skills for different text types. The course will be divided into six major parts, including the introduction of language differences, translation principles and standards, and translation techniques at the beginning of the course. After students grasp the basic concepts and principles of translation, the course will move into translation practice. Translation of various genres of technical texts will be the course focuses, taking about 50% of the class time. The texts students will be facing comprise news, academic papers and introductory texts of technology. The purpose of the course is to guide students to understand the basics of translation, based on which students will be able to complete translation independently and to solve translation problems. The course will have a translation test.

default.zh: 汉英口译 课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程编号：22FL31108 课程名称：汉英口译 总学时：32 理论学时：32 学分：2 开课单位：外国语学院英语系 授课对象：英语专业 开课学期：4秋 先修课程：英汉口译、汉英笔译 二、课程简介 本课程的授课对象是英语专业四年级学生，为核心课，主要培养学生的汉英口译知识和技巧。通过本课程的学习，学生应该具有在会议和商务谈判等活动中进行口译一般性材料的能力，优秀学生具有能通过上海外国语大学中级英语翻译资格证书考试的水平。本课程主要对学生进行词汇对等、句型转换和篇章转换等方面的口译能力训练，帮助学生掌握目的论指导下的本地化翻译原则及相应的口译技巧。本课程所使用教材为上海外语教育出版社出版的《中级口译教程》2019第四版（梅德明编著）及任课教师整理的补充材料。课文内容包括:口译技巧、称谓口译、言语口译、引语口译、数字口译、笔记口译、接待口译、会谈口译、访谈口译、礼仪性口译、介绍性口译、说服性口译、学术性口译、商务性口译、科普性口译等章节。本课程的期末成绩采用累加式，包括平时测试成绩和期末卷面成绩。其中平时测试成绩占总成绩的30%，期末卷面成绩占总成绩的70%。 撰写人：张春星 审核人： 韩晓蕙 日 期：2022.11.12 ？
default.en: Introduction to [Chinese-English Interpretation] 1. General Information Course Code：22FL31108 Course Title：Chinese-English Interpretation Credit Hours：32 Lecture：32 Credit(s)：2 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: English Majors Term: Fall, Fourth year Prerequisites: English-Chinese Interpretation, Chinese-English Translation 2. Course Description The course of Chinese-English Interpretation is open to the senior year English major students. In this course, students will get their training on techniques and skills of Chinese-English interpretation. After the study, students are expected to be able to interpret general material on conferences and business negotiations. The top of them can reach the level required by the Intermediate Level of Interpretation Certificate Test of SISU. The course provides training to students on word equivalence, and lexical and textual transformation. Students will also learn localization principles under Skopo theories. The text book used is An Intermediate Course of Interpretation (fourth edition) compiled by Mei Deming，published by Shanghai Foreign Language Education Press in 2019. Updated complimentary materials are applied to class training as well. The course covers the following topics: the interpretation of titles, proverbs, quotations and number, and interpreting materials on reception service, conversations, interviews, ceremonial speeches, informative speeches, persuasive speeches, academic speeches, business speeches, and popular science speeches. Class practice counts30% in final evaluation，and final exam 70%。 Author: Zhang Chunxing Reviewer： Han Xiaohui Date：2022.11.12

default.zh: 本课程为英语第二专业学生开设，是一门集英国背景知识和英语语言知识为一体的英语专业核心课，其根本任务是全面提高学生的文化素养。通过对英国的地理、人口、经济、政治、社会、特别是历史等各方面学习，争取让学生对英国有一个整体的概观，扩大学生的知识面，使他们能较好地理解其文化和价值观。同时，本课程旨在提供理解英国文学和跨文化交际课所必需的背景知识，使学生在跨国跨文化的交际中，成功地运用他们所学的知识与技能。在了解以上知识的同时，学习者可以扩充大量的相关英语词汇，为其它课程提供有关英国的背景知识，为进一步学习、研究语言和文学等打好基础。另外，学生在学习知识的同时，还可以提高英语阅读能力，提高学生对文化差异的宽容性和处理文化差异的灵活性。此外，本课程要求学生熟悉中国文化传统，具有较多的人文知识和科技知识，较强的创新意识和一定的创新能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，总成绩是期末试卷、学期论文、课堂演示等项的总和。
default.en: The course is designed for the students taking English as the second major. This is an English major compulsory course which, mingling together the background information of UK and knowledge of the English language, aims at cultivating the students’ cultural awareness and enabling them to acquire the desired traits. This course introduces to students information about the geography, people, economy, politics, society, and particularly the history of the United Kingdom, thus enlarging their sphere of knowledge and enhancing their power to better understand English culture and values. Meanwhile, it provides the essential background knowledge for the study of English literature and cross-cultural communication, enabling the students to successfully manipulate the knowledge and skills they have acquired in cross-national and cross-cultural communication. Through the learning of the previous lectures, learners can broaden their pool of vocabulary, therefore offering British culture-based knowledge for further research in linguistics and literature. Meanwhile, the learners’ reading comprehension competence can be improved, the tolerance of treating cross-cultural differences can be strengthened and the ability of handling cultural differences flexibly can be improved. Also, this course requires that students be familiar with Chinese culture, acquire more knowledge of liberal arts and technology, and improve their initiative awareness and abilities. The total score of this course is based on the following parts: final exam paper, term paper and class presentation.

default.zh: 英国文学史及选读是针对第二学位学生开设的课程。课程旨在使学生了解英国文学的发展全貌，并阅读其中经典的篇目。帮助学生系统掌握英国文学的相关知识、文学体裁的基础知识以及文学批评的基本方法，培养学生理解和鉴赏英国文学作品的能力以及初步的独立研究能力，促进其思辨能力的提高。课程以时间为主线，全面介绍影响英国文学发展的历史背景、社会背景及文化思潮，追溯英国文学的发展历史，探讨主要文学流派及其代表作家和作品的特点，同时选取各个阶段有代表性作家的作品进行细致的文本分析。课程采用累加式考核方式，考核环节包括课堂表现与课堂参与、课程论文以及期末考试部分。
default.en: History and Survey of British Literature is a course for English as a second degree students. The course aims to give students an overview of the development of British literature and to read the classic texts. To help students systematically master the relevant knowledge of British literature, the basic knowledge of literary genres and the basic methods of literary criticism, cultivate students' ability to understand and appreciate British literary works and their initial independent research ability, and promote the improvement of their critical thinking ability. Taking time as the main line, the course comprehensively introduces the historical background, social background and cultural trend of thought that affect the development of British literature, traces the development history of British literature, explores the main literary schools and the characteristics of their representative writers and works, and selects the works of representative writers in each stage for detailed textual analysis. The course is assessed in a cumulative manner, including class performance and contribution, course paper and final exam.

default.zh: 英汉口译 课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程编码：22FL31134 课程名称：英汉口译 总学时：32 讲课学时：32 学分：2 开课单位：外国语学院英语系 授课对象：第二学位 开课学期：秋季 先修课程：基础英语、汉英笔译等 二、课程简介 本课程是英语第二学位考试课。教学内容分为四部分：口译笔记、口译技巧、数字口译、交替口译。本课程旨在介绍口译笔记特点，帮助学生设计自身特色的口译笔记符号；了解应对复杂的长难句的方法；掌握数字的记录方法和快速翻译方法，并通过实践练习掌握数字翻译要领。在奠定基础能力之后让学生进行大量的真实材料口译练习，练习内容广泛包含领导人讲话访谈、会议口译、政治实务口译、科技口译和大篇幅新闻口译。英汉口译课程建立在学生良好的听力和口语阐述能力基础之上，开发学生听记、理解、转换的能力。逐步使学生具有承担一般性正式会议、技术和商务谈判，以及外事活动的口译工作，达到通过初级英语翻译资格证书考试的水平。本课程所使用教材为上海外语教育出版社出版的《中级口译教程》2019第四版（梅德明编著）及任课教师整理的补充材料。本课程的期末成绩采用累加式，包括平时测试成绩和期末卷面成绩。其中平时测试成绩占总成绩的30%，期末卷面成绩占总成绩的70%。 撰写人：张春星 审核人：许丽莹 日 期：2023.11.8
default.en: Introduction to [English-Chinese Interpretation] 1.General Information Course Code：22FL31134 Course Title：English-Chinese Interpretation Credit Hours：32 Lecture：32 Credit(s)：2 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: English as the second major Term: Fall Prerequisites: Basic English, Chinese English Translation 2.Course Description The course mainly covers four parts, which focus on note taking, interpretation techniques, figures, and consecutive interpreting respectively. The course aims to help students master basic skills in note taking, as well as problem solving related to long and complicated sentences. The course also targets special issues such as figures in interpreting. The general purpose is to guide students into the field of interpretation, while the ultimate purpose is to equip students with the skill to complete consecutive interpreting independently. To achieve the purposes, the course will offer large amount of exercise, during which real-life materials are going to be used to insure the authenticity. Materials include interview, meeting, news, and technology-related materials. The text book used is An Intermediate Course of Interpretation (fourth edition) compiled by Mei Deming，published by Shanghai Foreign Language Education Press in 2019. Class practice and final exam count 30% and 70% in final evaluation respectively. Author: Zhang Chunxing Reviewer：Xu Liying Date：2023.11.8

default.zh: 科技翻译是英语第二学士学位的专业课。要求学生在掌握了一定双语知识、语言背景和科技英语基础知识的情况下，能够将汉英两种语言中的科技文献资料通顺互译，首先要保持科技文献的内容忠实，同时保持其风格，而译文的通顺程度又得让读者所接受。 根据教材内容安排，教学上从词、句翻译到篇章翻译，循序渐进，注重翻译基本功的训练；同时兼顾不同科技领域的专业词汇的掌握和帮助学生理解科技原理。另外，加强英语语言基本功的训练，尤其是句法分析，因为在科技英语长句多，通过句法分析巩固学生的语言知识，促进理解，提高翻译技能。
default.en: Sci-Tech translation is a course for English second majors. Students are required to be able to translate Sci-Tech documents in both Chinese and English fluently, with a certain amount of bilingual knowledge, language background and basic knowledge of scientific and technological English. First of all, they should keep the content of scientific and technological documents faithful, while maintaining their style, and the smoothness of the translation should be acceptable to readers. According to the content arrangement of the textbook, teaching should be gradual from word and sentence translation to text translation, and pay attention to the training of basic translation skills; at the same time, it also takes into account the mastery of professional vocabulary in different fields of science and technology and helps students understand the principles of science and technology. In addition, the teacher should strengthen the training of basic English language skills, especially syntax analysis, because there are many long sentences in EST. Through syntax analysis, the teacher can consolidate students' language knowledge, promote understanding and improve translation skills.

default.zh: 汉英笔译课程是英语二学位一门必修课，目的是让学生了解基本的翻译知识、原理，在此基础上，通过大量的实践，掌握一定的翻译能力，掌握不同文体（含科技类文本）的汉英翻译的基本特点和技巧。其预期目标是能够借助工具字典翻译一般难度的文章。 英汉翻译实践涉及汉语语言的运用，对于英语专业的学生来说，显然可以弥补他们在汉语学习方面的不足。另外，加强学生汉语能力的培养也有助于对学生进行思想教育，提高对本族语语言文化的认识、了解和理解。而且，对汉语语言文化的了解更有助于提高学生的语言潜能，从而使学生能够更有效地学习外语。 课程目标对学生能力要求如下： 课程目标1：要求学生通过各种文体文本的翻译实践，提高翻译意识、职业素质，使教学工作在一定程度上面向市场，满足市场需求，提高外语专业毕业生的就业率，从而提高外语学科在国内的声誉，扩大影响范围，进而有助于招生工作的开展。 课程目标2：要求学生翻译练习材料涉及各种文体和学科，诸如文学、科技、历史、社会学、自然科学，等等。这样，在大量实践的基础上，学生的知识结构会得到相当程度的丰富和完善，有利于培养复合性人才，实施复合性人才培养的教育战略。 课程目标3：要求学生能够掌握理论和技巧的，从理论的高度上提高对翻译实践的认识，提高翻译能力，同时也能提高学生的理论水平，丰富知识结构，为最后的学位论文写作进行积极而充分的准备。
default.en: Chinese-English Translation Course is a compulsory subject for undergraduate students pursuing a second bachelor’s degree in English. Its aim is to help students acquire fundamental knowledge and principles of translation. Through extensive practice, students will develop certain translation competencies and master the basic features and techniques of Chinese-English translation across various genres (including scientific and technical texts). The expected outcome is that students will be able to translate texts of general difficulty with the aid of dictionaries. Practical English-Chinese translation involves the application of Chinese language skills, which can effectively compensate for the gaps in Chinese language learning among English majors. Additionally, strengthening students’ proficiency in Chinese contributes to their ideological education and enhances their recognition, understanding, and appreciation of their native language and culture. Moreover, a deeper knowledge of Chinese language and culture can further develop students’ linguistic potential, thereby enabling them to learn foreign languages more effectively. The course objectives set the following competency requirements for students: Course Objective 1: Through translation practice across various genres, students are expected to enhance their translation awareness and professional competence. This will help align the teaching process, to some extent, with market demands, improve the employment rate of foreign language graduates, enhance the reputation and influence of the foreign language discipline domestically, and consequently support student recruitment efforts. Course Objective 2: Students will work with translation materials covering a wide range of genres and disciplines, such as literature, science and technology, history, sociology, natural sciences, etc. Through extensive practice, students’ knowledge structure will be significantly enriched and refined, facilitating the cultivation of interdisciplinary talent and supporting the educational strategy of training versatile professionals. Course Objective 3: Students are required to master relevant theories and techniques, thereby deepening their understanding of translation practice from a theoretical perspective and improving their translation skills. This will also enhance their theoretical knowledge, broaden their intellectual framework, and prepare them actively and thoroughly for their final degree thesis.

default.zh: 英语语言学导论是为英语专业第二学士学位学生开设的必修课，是语言学的启蒙课程。课程目的在于为学生展现语言学的主要领域、培养学生的对语言科学的兴趣，使其具有初步的语言分析能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将会：1）对语言系统有一定的理论认识；2）概观性地了解语言学主要领域的基础概念、基本内容和分析方法；3）对于此前所学的英语语言知识能够开展一定程度的理论思考，能够运用所学的语言学知识和方法认识、分析相关语言现象的特点，并能够形成自己的观点。本课程有助于英语专业第二学士学位学生在英语方向的毕业论文写作，并对写作、翻译等课程的学习有指导意义。本课程的内容包括语言的概念、设计特征、起源、功能以及英语的语音、词义、句法、语言使用、语言心理等方面的简介，授课过程中要求学生积极发言、参加小组讨论、展示课堂报告并完成4-5篇250词的小论文。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括课堂参与、课堂报告，期末考试和平时作业。
default.en: Introduction to English Linguistics is a compulsory course for students who study English for the second bachelor’s degree. As a course of enlightenment, it aims at providing a bird’s eye view on language and the major fields of linguistics, arousing interest in language science and cultivating preliminary abilities of linguistic analysis. By taking this course, the students will: 1) be able to take theoretical perspectives on language system; 2) have a general understanding of the fundamentals and ways of analysis concerning major fields of linguistics; 3) have a theoretical retrospection on the language knowledge previously learned, be able to find out language features through linguistic analysis and be able to formulate their own ideas. Therefore, this course is conducive to graduation thesis writing in the English major and the learning of courses related such as English writing and translation practice. The course mainly involves brief introductions to the definition, design features, origin and functions of language, and the phonetics, word meaning, sentence structure, language use and psychology of the English language. Active participation, group discussions, a PPT presentation and 4-5 essay assignments of about 250 words will be required as the course goes on. The final score involves class participation, PPT presentation, the final examination, and essay assignments.

default.zh: 《跨文化交际课程》的主要内容涵盖全球化背景下跨文化交际的主要理论、核心概念、基本原理及其社会文化实践，旨在培养学生在全球化时代以构建人类命运共同体为目标的跨文化沟通与交流的能力。通过本课程学生将学习跨文化交际的基本概念与原理，体验跨文化交际的多样性和复杂性，认识中华传统文化的世界观、价值观和伦理观对全球跨文化交际的重要启示，掌握全球化背景下跨文化交际的基本特点、动态机制和跨文化对话之道, 提高跨文化思辨能力、跨文化理解与沟通能力，并能够灵活运用所学知识正确理解和处理实际生活、学习及工作环境中的跨文化冲突与障碍，提升自身在全球化多元化时代的跨文化适应能力和胜任能力。
default.en: Intercultural Communication is a compulsory course for all English majors. The course aims to develop students' ability to communicate with people of different cultural backgrounds with the ultimate goal of building a community of human destiny in the era of globalization. The main content covers the main features, core concepts and basic principles of intercultural communication as well as its socio-cultural practices in the context of globalization. Through this course, students will learn about the basic concepts and principles of global intercultural communication, experience its diversity and complexity, recognize the insights that the anthropocosmic worldview, values and ethics of traditional Chinese culture offers for global intercultural communication. The students are required to understand the basic characteristics, dynamic mechanisms and ways of intercultural dialogue in the context of globalization, and develop their abilities and skills in intercultural criticality, intercultural interactions and intercultural adaptation in the era of globalization and diversity, and be able to deal with intercultural conflicts and barriers in their real-life intercultural encounters. This course will provide students with a solid professional foundation for intercultural personhood development and prepare them for active participation in building a global community of a shared future. The course assessment is based on the overall performance of students’ class participation, class presentations, course project report and final examination.

default.zh: 俄罗斯概况（1）》主要讲授俄罗斯地理基本知识，并要求课外阅读相关的参考书籍。教材选取外语教学与研究出版社出版的《俄罗斯地理》，内容涵盖俄罗斯地理位置、地形、资源等自然地理知识，还包括人口、民族、宗教和经济发展等人文地理知识，教材突出了知识的系统性，并采用多媒体教学新手段，将抽象的知识具体化和形象化。本课程在学生具备了一定的俄语语言基础之上，用俄文和汉语讲授，不但能够使学生了解俄罗斯的基本概况，同时又能对学生进行语言训练，全面提高学生的语言和文化素养。
default.en: Introduction to Russia （1）mainly introduces the basic knowledge of Russian geography and requires extracurricular reading of the relevant reference books. Textbooks Select "Russian Geography" published by Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press, cover natural geographical knowledge such as Russian geography, topography and resources, as well as human geography knowledge, such as population, ethnicity, religion and economic development, highlight the systematic character of knowledge and use the multimedia teaching new means, convert the abstract knowledge into concrete and visualization. This course which teaches in Russian and Chinese, is based on that students master certain Russian language foundation, it not only enables students to understand the basic situation of Russia, but also trains students language skills comprehensively, improves students' language and cultural literacy.

default.zh: 通过科技俄语阅读课的学习与训练，使学生了解俄语科学语言的词法、句法特点，引导学生掌握科技文献资料的阅读技巧和方法，学会正确运用工具书和专业文献处理科技俄语阅读中遇到的问题，借助词典能阅读有一定难度的科技文章，提高学生阅读科技俄语文献的速度，使学生具有较高的科技俄语阅读能力。本课程的重点是对科技俄语术语的理解和定名，以及长难复合句的理解，课程的难点是对相关专业知识的运用和理解。
default.en: Through the study and training of Science Russian Reading classes, students can understand the lexical and syntactic features of Russian scientific language. Guide students to master the reading skills and methods of scientific and technical literature, learn to use reference books and professional documents to deal with problems encountered in Russian reading, and be able to read a certain degree of difficulty of science and technology articles with the help of dictionary. Improve the speed of students' reading of Russian literature and technology, so that students have a high technology Russian reading ability. The focus of this course is on the understanding and naming of Russian terminology of science and technology, as well as the understanding of the difficult complex sentence, the difficulty of the course is the use of relevant professional knowledge and understanding.

default.zh: 《俄罗斯概况（2）》主要讲授俄罗斯历史基本知识，并要求课外阅读相关的参考书籍。教材选取外语教学与研究出版社出版的《俄罗斯历史》，内容涵盖千余年的俄罗斯历史发展，教材突出了知识的系统性，并采用多媒体教学新手段，将抽象的知识具体化和形象化。本课程在学生具备了一定的俄语语言基础之上，用俄文和汉语讲授，不但能够使学生了解俄罗斯的基本概况，同时又能对学生进行语言训练，全面提高学生的语言和文化素养。
default.en: Introduction to Russia （2） mainly introduces the basic knowledge of Russian history and requires extracurricular reading of the relevant reference books. Textbooks Select "Russian History" published by Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press, cover the history of Russia for more than a thousand years, highlight the systematic character of knowledge and use the multimedia teaching new means, convert the abstract knowledge into concrete and visualization. This course which teaches in Russian and Chinese, is based on that students master certain Russian language foundation, it not only enables students to understand the basic situation of Russia, but also trains students language skills comprehensively, improves students' language and cultural literacy.

default.zh: 本课程通过对物理学方面阅读材料的全面分析，使学生理解所读文章的背景知识、科学语言的词法、句法特点、语言知识等，使学生了解物理学基础知识，掌握一些符号、概念、定义在俄语中的表达，掌握俄语科学语言的基本特点，奠定阅读俄语科技文献基础，较熟练地阅读一定难度的科技文章。通过对物理学方面阅读材料的全面分析，使学生理解所读文章的背景知识、科学语言的词法、句法特点、语言知识等。 课文题材涵盖物理学的多个方面，如测量，物理量，功与能，温度与传热，物质与运动，相对运动，自由落体与万有引力，压力与帕斯卡定律，声音的传播速度等等。
default.en: This course is based on the comprehensive analysis of the reading materials in physics, so that students understand the background knowledge of the reading articles, the lexical and syntactic features and language knowledge of the scientific language, and so on, so that students can understand the basic knowledge of physics and master the expression of some symbols, concepts and definitions in Russian, master the basic characteristics of the Russian scientific language, lay the foundation for reading Russian science and technology literature, more skilled to read some difficult technical articles. Through the comprehensive analysis of the physical reading materials, students understand the background knowledge of the reading articles, the lexical, syntactic and linguistic knowledge of the scientific language. The subject matter covers many aspects of physics, such as measurement, physical quantity, power and energy, temperature and heat transfer, matter and movement, relative movement, free fall and gravity, pressure and Pascal's law, the speed of sound transmission and so on.

default.zh: 《俄罗斯文学史（1）》是俄语专业高年级学生的专业必修课， 通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握以下知识和技能：熟知俄罗斯民间口头创作时期至19世纪俄罗斯文学史的发展过程。系统掌握各个时期不同文学流派的主要特征、代表作家及作品的特点。获得独立阅读和欣赏文学作品的能力。提高文学鉴赏能力和人文素质，把握俄罗斯民族文化心理特征和艺术范式。 本课程的重点是俄罗斯民间口头创作时期至19世纪上半叶俄罗斯文学史的发展过程、各个时期呈现出的文学发展态势、不同文学流派的主要特征以及经典作家及其代表作品的特点。课程的难点是文学流派的思想根源探究、对俄罗斯文学经典的重新评价，以及对俄罗斯人文文化精神的把握。
default.en: History of Russian Literature （1）is a compulsory course for senior students majoring in Russian. Through this course, students can acquire the following knowledge and skills: Familiar with the development process of Russian folk oral creation period to 19th century Russian literary history. Systematically master the main characteristics, representative writers and features of the work of literary genre in different periods. Develop the ability to read and appreciate literary works independently. Improve the literary appreciation ability and humanistic quality, grasp the Russian national culture psychological characteristics and artistic paradigm. The focus of this course is the development process of Russian folk oral creation period to the 19th century Russian literary history, the literary development trend of each period, the main features of different literary schools and the characteristics of classical writers and their representative works. The difficulty of the course is the exploration of the ideological roots of the literary genre, the re-evaluation of the Russian literary classics, and the grasp of the Russian humanistic cultural spirit.

default.zh: 《科技俄语阅读（3）》是俄语专业高年级学生的必修课，在培养学生阅读能力和思辨能力方面占重要的地位。通过对电学方面阅读材料的全面分析，使学生理解所读文章的背景知识、科学语言的词法、句法特点、语言知识等。本课程将提高学生对课文的阅读能力、提高相关科技俄语技能的运用水平，为其将来的科技俄语相关工作打下坚实的基础。 课文题材涵盖电学的多个方面，如导体和绝缘体，电压，电场、电表、电源，电磁感应现象等。通过本课程的学习，达到专业学习成果，完成毕业要求。
default.en: 《Science Russian reading （3）》 is a compulsory course for senior students majoring in Russian and plays an important role in cultivating students' reading ability and speculative ability. Through the comprehensive analysis of electrical reading materials, students understand the background knowledge of the article, the lexical, syntactic and linguistic knowledge of the scientific language. This course will improve students' reading ability and improve the level of relevant Russian skills in science and technology, lay a solid foundation for their future Russian-related work. The subject covers all aspects of electricity, such as conductors and insulators, voltage, electric field, electricity meter, power supply, electromagnetic induction phenomenon and so on. Through the study of this course, achieve professional learning results, complete the graduation requirements.

default.zh: 《俄罗斯文学史（2）》是俄语专业高年级学生的专业必修课，通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握以下知识和技能：熟知十九世纪下半叶、白银时代、20世纪及解体后俄罗斯文学史的发展过程。系统掌握各个时期不同文学流派的主要特征、代表作家及作品的特点。获得独立阅读和欣赏文学作品的能力。提高文学鉴赏能力和人文素质，把握俄罗斯民族文化心理特征和艺术范式。 本课程的重点是十九世纪下半叶、白银时代、20世纪及解体后俄罗斯文学史的发展过程、各个时期呈现出的文学发展态势、不同文学流派的主要特征以及经典作家及其代表作品的特点。课程的难点是文学流派的思想根源探究、对俄罗斯文学经典的重新评价，以及对俄罗斯人文文化精神的把握。
default.en: History of Russian Literature （2） is a compulsory course for senior students majoring in Russian. Through this course, students can acquire the following knowledge and skills: Familiar with the development process of the Russian literary history during the silver age, 20th century and after the disintegration. Systematically master the main characteristics, representative writers and features of the work of literary genre in different periods. Develop the ability to read and appreciate literary works independently. Improve the literary appreciation ability and humanistic quality, grasp the Russian national culture psychological characteristics and artistic paradigm. The focus of this course is the development process of the Russian literary history during the silver age, 20th century and after the disintegration, the literary development trend of each period, the main features of different literary schools and the characteristics of classical writers and their representative works. The difficulty of the course is the exploration of the ideological roots of the literary genre, the re-evaluation of the Russian literary classics, and the grasp of the Russian humanistic cultural spirit.

default.zh: 《俄语写作》是俄语专业四年级学生的专业基础课，在培养学生俄语写作能力方面起到重要作用。 本课程具有较强的实践性，在介绍基础写作知识和各种体裁文章写作方法的同时，要求学生进行大量的俄语写作训练，帮助学生掌握写作技巧，提高俄语表达的准确性及写作水平，使其具备一定的俄语书面交际能力，为撰写毕业论文和将来从事俄语专业工作打下坚实的基础。 本课程主要讲授公文事务文体和科学文体的文体特征和写作方法，要求学生掌握基础写作知识，独立拟定作文提纲，构建篇章结构，完成写作练习；通过实例说明俄语日常应用文和公务信函的写作要领和规则，帮助学生熟悉各类应用文的书写格式和语言特点，掌握一些惯用句式和词语、各类科学分文体的文体特征和写作，以及毕业论文撰写的基本要求和规范。
default.en: "Russian Writing" is a professional basic course for fourth year students majoring in Russian, and plays an important role in cultivating students' Russian writing ability. This course is highly practical. While introducing basic writing knowledge and writing methods for various genres of articles, students are required to undergo extensive Russian writing training to help them master writing skills, improve the accuracy of Russian expression and writing proficiency, and equip them with a certain level of written communication skills in Russian, laying a solid foundation for writing their graduation thesis and engaging in future Russian professional work. This course mainly teaches the stylistic characteristics and writing methods of official document and scientific writing styles. It requires students to master basic writing knowledge, independently formulate composition outlines, construct textual structures, and complete writing exercises; Through examples, this article explains the essentials and rules for writing daily Russian practical writing and official letters, helps students become familiar with the writing format and language characteristics of various types of practical writing, master some commonly used sentence patterns and words, the stylistic features and writing of various scientific sub styles, and the basic requirements and norms for writing graduation theses.

default.zh: 《翻译实践》是俄语专业高年级学生的专业核心课，它以学生在校所学各门语言课程的综合知识为基础，侧重培养学生的翻译实践能力、语言运用能力和跨文化交际能力，这也是新世纪高等学校俄语专业的重要教学任务之一。通过翻译理论的学习和大量的翻译实践，本课程可促进学生的语言知识学习和翻译技能训练，增强学生对中俄语言文化的了解，提高学生的翻译能力和语言综合素质。
default.en: Russian-Chinese translation practice is a compulsory course for senior students majoring in Russian, it is based on the comprehensive knowledge of all the courses, which students have learned during the university, and it is focusing on cultivating students' practical ability of translation, language application ability and the ability of cross culture communication, this is also one of the most important teaching tasks of Russian major in colleges or universities in the new century. This course through descriptive translation theories and a large number of translation practices promotes students' motivation to learn the language knowledge and translation skills, enhances their understanding of Russian and Chinese linguistic cultures, and improves students' translation ability and comprehensive Linguistic quality.

default.zh: 《日语翻译基础》是日语专业三年级必修课，是一门理论与实践紧密结合的课程，在培养学生日语应用能力方面占重要的地位。通过本课程的学习，培养学生掌握基本翻译理论以及具有规律性的翻译方法和翻译技巧。另外，通过对汉日两种语言进行对比，让学生了解汉语和日语在语言表达习惯上的差异。 课程主要内容包括各种翻译方法和技巧的传授，如直译、意译、顺译、变译、加译、减译、分译、合译、反译等。还包括日语长定语句和状语句等各种句子成分、语态及常用句式的翻译策略。通过讲练结合的方式，让学生将掌握的日语语言知识和文化知识进行具体运用，培养学生具有初步的日汉翻译能力。同时培养学生具有跨文化交际能力，运用日语讲好中国话语的能力。本课程采用累加式考核方式，主要包括：课堂表现、课堂作业、期末考试等。
default.en: [Basic Japanese Translation] is a required core course for third-year Japanese majors. This course combines theory with practice and plays an important role in developing students’ Japanese proficiency. It teaches students the basic translation theories and regular translation skills. Through the study of this course, students are trained to master the basic translation theories as well as the regular translation methods and translation skills. In addition, through the comparison of Chinese and Japanese, students can understand the differences in language expression habits between Chinese and Japanese. The main content of the course includes the teaching of various translation methods and techniques, such as literal translation, free translation, linear translation, adaptation, amplification, omission, division, combination, and converse translation. It also includes translation strategies for sentence elements such as long attributive clause and adverbial clause, voices, and regular sentence patterns. Through the combination of lectures and practice, enable students to apply their knowledge of Japanese language and culture, and develop their preliminary Japanese-Chinese translation skills. At the same time, students will develop cross-cultural communication skills and the ability to use Japanese to speak well in Chinese topic. Course grade is cumulative,made up of classroom performance,assignment,and final exam, etc.

default.zh: 《日语翻译实践》是日语专业高年级专业必修课，是日语翻译基础课的延伸，也是一门实践性很强的技能课程，在培养学生日语应用能力方面占重要的地位。通过本课程对《理解当代中国》翻译类教材的学习，学生将在了解基本的翻译理论，掌握基本的翻译方法和技巧的基础上进行大量的翻译实践，培养学生用日语讲好中国故事的能力。课程主要内容包括汉日语言对比，汉语各种句子成分、语态及常用句式的日译规律，不同文本类型和体裁的文章在日汉互译时应遵循的翻译准则和采取的翻译策略等。通过大量实践培养学生具有熟练的日汉互译翻译技能。本课程考试成绩采取累加式，包括期中考试、期末考试、课堂表现和平时作业。
default.en: As an extension of Basic Japanese Translation, Japanese Translation Practice is a required course for third-year Japanese majors. It trains students’ practical translation skills and is important for developing students Japanese proficiency. Through the study of the translation textbook Understanding Contemporary China in this course, students will carry out a lot of translation practice on the basis of understanding basic translation theories, mastering basic translation methods and skills, and cultivate students' ability to tell Chinese stories well in Japanese. Course contents include comparison of Chinese and Japanese, translation rules for Chinese sentence element, voices, and sentence patterns, translation principles and strategies for articles of different types and styles. Students are given multiple translation practice to develop and reinforce translation skills. Course grade is cumulative, made up of midterm, final exam, class performance, and assignment.

default.zh: 日语基础写作课程作为日语专业的核心课程，旨在综合利用基础日语词汇和语法等语言知识，在充分理解日语口语和日语书面语文章文体特点的基础上，培养学生能够利用书面语言正确、灵活通顺表达所思所想、叙述和描述事物等方面的基本技能。为专业写作和应用写作实践奠定基础。
default.en: The Basic Japanese Writing Course is a core course in Japanese language studies. This course is designed to nurture students' basic skills in effectively and flexibly expressing thoughts, narrating, describing objects, and more, using written language correctly and coherently on the basis of comprehensively utilizing fundamental Japanese vocabulary and language knowledge, as well as incorporating a deep understanding of the characteristics of spoken and written Japanese. This course serves as a foundation for professional writing and practical applied writing.

default.zh: 日语应用写作是日语专业的重要基础课之一，是面向日语专业三年级学生开设，在培养学生日语应用能力方面占重要的地位。本课程在传授写作知识的基础上，使学生掌握日语中各类实用性文章的文体特点、篇章结构、修辞手段、写作技巧及要领，提高文章写作的表现力，达到培养学生能使用准确流畅的语言，书写摘要、说明文、意见文，小论文各类体裁文章的目的。本课程在基础写作课程中习得的书面表达基础上，进一步强化学生的写作专项技能，为学生撰写毕业论文和参加作文比赛以及工作实践打下坚实基础。课程最后的成绩采用累加式课后作业、小测、期末考试等。
default.en: Practical Japanese Writing is one of the most important basic courses for third-year Japanese majors and plays an important role in developing students’ language proficiency. This course enables students to grasp the stylistic features, discourse structures, rhetorical devices, and writing skills of different practical writings in Japanese. It aims to cultivate students’ ability to write with fluency and accuracy, thereby improving the expressiveness of their writing. Students will practice different writing types such as reflection, narration, exposition, and argumentation. On the basis of the writing skills in Basic Writing course, it further reinforces students’ specialized writing skills and lays a solid foundation for their participation in writing contests and work. Course grade is cumulative, made up of classes quizzes, assignment, midterm, and final exam.

default.zh: 日语泛读课程作为日语专业基础阶段的必修课程，在选材上，通过以点带面、点面结合的方式精选各类日语文章素材；在方法上，通过课上重“质”，课下重“量”的方式兼顾阅读深度和广度；在内容上，通过实践阅读，传授基本的阅读方法和不同体裁文章的结构特点，培养学生阅读习惯和兴趣，在提高阅读速度的同时全面提升学生的阅读理解能力，为专业阅读奠定坚实基础。
default.en: Japanese language studies, employs a selection of diverse Japanese articles using an approach that combines focal and comprehensive materials. The course emphasizes quality during class and quantity during self-study to balance both the depth and breadth of reading. It instructs students in basic reading techniques and the structural characteristics of articles in various genres through practical reading. This course aims to cultivate reading habits and interests, enhance reading speed, and comprehensively improve students' reading comprehension skills, laying a strong foundation for professional reading.

default.zh: 《世界经济概况》是国际组织与全球治理专业必修课程，是一门涉及经济、国际关系等学科综合课程。本课程的将系统地介绍科技革命推动的经济全球化、国际分工和世界市场条件下世界经济相互联系、 相互依存和发展的趋势，分析当代世界经济运行的基本经济规律以及面临的主要问题。课程将同时介绍全球性经济危机、新科技革命、中美关系发展历程及中国在国际市场上的地位变化。通过《世界经济概况》的学习，学生能系统地掌握世界经济运行的基本理论及基本分析方法，具备对世界基本经济活动和重大事件进行评判和分析能力，学生将具备国际视野和全球化意识，对分析和理解我国宏观经济发展以及国际市场变动具有重要意义。
default.en: Introduction of World Economy is a compulsory course designed for the minor major of international organization and global governance. This is a course involve economics, international relationship and international trade. The course will systematically introduce the interconnectedness, interdependence and development of world economy under globalization and international division of labor. It will further introduce the basic economic laws and major challenges faced by the world.
