This course will also introduce the economics crisis, new technology revolution, history of China-US relationship and the role of China in world market. By taking the course, students will understand the basic theories and important methods in the running of world economy. They will have the ability to discuss and analysis on the regular activities and important events in world economy. Students will equip with global view and international perspectives, which is important for understanding the macroeconomic development and international market of China.

default.zh: 国际法是一门具有悠久发展历史、主要调整国家之间关系的法律原则和规则，涉及国家间政治、经济、法律、文化和科学交往的各个领域的法律专门学科。讲授这门课程的目的是使学生了解国际公法是国家进行国际交往的行为规范，是国家必须遵守的法律原则和规则。国家只有严格遵守国际法，才能与别国建立和发展友好关系，促进本国与别国的交流与合作，以利于本国的政治、经济、文化和科学的建设与发展，更好地保护本国和本国人民在外国的合法权益。在此基础上学习和掌握国际法的基本理论和基础知识，并在以后的工作中能运用它们维护我国的权益，服务于我国参与全球治理的大局。
default.en: International law is a legal discipline with a long history of development, which mainly adjusts the legal principles and rules of state-to-state relations and involves various fields of political, economic, legal, cultural and scientific exchanges between states. The purpose of teaching this course is to make students understand that public international law is the code of conduct for countries to conduct international exchanges and the legal principles and rules that countries must abide by. Only by strictly abiding by international law can a country establish and develop friendly relations with other countries, promote exchanges and cooperation between itself and other countries, facilitate its own political, economic, cultural and scientific development, and better protect the lawful rights and interests of itself and its people in foreign countries. On this basis, learning and mastering the basic theories and knowledge of international law, and trying to use it in the future work will safeguard Chinese rights, interests and serve the overall situation of China participation in global governance.

default.zh: 国际新闻传播是国际组织与全球治理专业核心必修课。国际新闻传播主要研究国际新闻现象和新闻活动规律、国际新闻传播发展现实需要和未来前景等，培养能够掌握现代电子媒体技术，特别是网络多媒体传播等对外宣传及涉外新闻报道技能的国际传播应用型人才。本课程通过对相关知识和新闻实例的讲解，旨在帮助学生理解、识别、解读各类国际新闻，掌握一定的新闻写作技巧，培养学生对中外新闻的跨文化理解和思辨能力，从而更好地应对国际组织和全球治理新局势。
default.en: International News Communication is a core compulsory course for majors of international organizations and global governance. This course mainly studies international news phenomena and the law of news activities, the current needs and future prospects of the development of international news communication, and cultivates international communication application-oriented talents who can master modern electronic media technology, especially network multimedia communication and other foreign publicity and foreign news reporting skills. Through the explanation of relevant knowledge and news examples, this course aims to help students understand, recognize and interpret all kinds of international news, master certain news writing skills, and cultivate students' cross-cultural understanding and critical thinking towards Chinese and foreign news, so as to better deal with the new situation of international organizations and global governance.

default.zh: 《国际公文写作》是国际组织与全球治理专业第三学年春季学期专业核心课程。本课程讲授国际公文写作基本内涵、格式、行文规则、语言规范等基本知识与技能，使学生掌握国际组织日常公文的文种用法、写法以及文种间用法、写法上的同异，使学生能运用所学开展国际组织日常公文写作与处理工作。通过本课程的学习，培养学生的国际交往能力和处理国际事务的基本素质。该课程有助于学生的民族精神和社会责任感的培养，引导学生为国际组织实习任职付出积极的努力。
default.en: Writing for International Organizations is a core course for students in International Organizations and Global Governance. It includes knowledge and skills in writing official documents for international organization, including stylistic, discoursal, textual and transitional features as well as formats. Students will understand the important role of official document writing for international organizations in international affairs and their significance to China, and master the goal of China’s participation and mission in global governance in the future. Students will enhance their international communication competence and problem-solving ability in dealing with international affairs. Students will also improve their abilities in reasoning, judgment and critical thinking. This course assists students to cultivate a national spirit and sense of social responsibility, which may inspire them to enter international organizations in the future.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养“国际组织与全球治理”专业的本科生在国际舞台和国际组织中进行沟通和商谈并最终解决问题的能力，在提高高等教育对外开放的背景下，着眼培养具有国际视野和全球竞争力的人才，提高学生英语应用技能，为进一步参与国际化的活动和未来的工作打下坚实的语言和交流技能基，并提高对全球问题的见解和背景的理解，提高解决国际问题的能力。
default.en: Negotiations in International Organizations is a course for students who major or minor in “International organizations and global governance”. The major purpose of the course is to help students improve their ability to discuss and negotiate in international organizations or institutions to solve issues and problems. In doing this, the course enables students to become competitive in international platforms in their language usage and their communication skills, and also in their understanding and perspectives for international issues, crises and problems.

default.zh: 《国际演讲与辩论》课程是国际组织与全球治理专业的必修课程，课程由三部分内容组成，第一、演讲；第二、辩论；第三、个人语言风格。通过课程的学习提高学生语言表达能力，帮助学生纠正英语表达的各种问题，克服在公共场合语言表达时的心理障碍，掌握演讲和辩论技巧。引导学生增加阅读量，观察生活，提高自我修养，适应社会对新时代国际人才的要求，丰富文化知识，了解中西文化的异同，学会向世界传达中国声音
default.en: The course "International Speech and Debate" is a compulsory course for international organizations and global governance majors. The course consists of three parts, first, speech; second, debate; and third, personal language style. The course will improve students' language expression ability, help them correct various problems in English expression, customer service psychological barriers when expressing language in public, and master speech skills. Students are guided to increase their reading, observe life, improve their self-cultivation, adapt to society's requirements for international talents in the new era, enrich their cultural knowledge, understand the similarities and differences between Chinese and Western cultures, and learn to convey the voice of China to the world.

default.zh: 《中国文化国际传播》是国际组织与全球治理专业选修课。在这16小时的课程中，我们将重新熟悉中国文化，并准备在全球或国际背景下展示中国文化的方方面面，为国际观众讲述关于中国文化的优秀故事，帮助他们理解中国传统文化，将它们与中国文化的最新发展相结合，从而在文化差异的背景下寻求共通之处。我们将阅读有关中国文化的经典文本，展示中国文化的方方面面，讨论文化问题，分享文化案例，并制定策略，使中国文化全球化，并最好地应对文化差异和偏见。主题包括但不限于民族、文化融合、多元文化、中国人的性格、中国人的思想、生活方式、性别差异、中国家庭制度、文学、艺术、建筑、饮食文化、经济、节日、民俗、武术、婚礼仪式、历史和哲学。
default.en: In this 16-hour course, we will reacquaint ourselves with Chinese culture and prepare ourselves to present aspects of it in a global or international context, so as to tell our international audience inspiring stories about Chinese culture, help them understand traditional Chinese culture, update them with the latest development of Chinese culture, and hence seek common ground and agreement in the context of cultural differences. We will read classical or canonical texts about Chinese culture, present aspects of Chinese culture, discuss cultural issues, share cultural cases, and develop strategies to globalize Chinese culture and best cope with cultural differences and preconceptions. Topics include but are not limited to people and ethnicity, cultural integration, multiculturalism, the Chinese character, the Chinese mind, ideals of life, gender differences, the Chinese family system, literature, art, architecture, food culture, economy, festivals, folklore, martial art, wedding and ceremonies, history, and philosophy. We plan to do ethnography: to tell stories from our personal experience. Persuasive examples should be given. We need to differentiate and contextualize. We use a non-essentialist method. Cultural difference should be considered. Questionnaires and interviews will help. Misconceptions or stereotypes should be addressed. Everything will ideally be conducted in English.

default.zh: 《外事礼仪》是国际组织与全球治理专业必修课。本课程力求通过理论讲解、案例分析、实操演练、问题反思等教学方法为学生传授外事礼仪规范，从文化意识、文化知识、文化能力三个维度全方位提高学生的跨文化交际素养，课程由三大模块组成，分别是个人礼仪、接待礼仪、访问礼仪，首先提高学生的个人形象意识及不断提升自我修养的内在动力，普及外事活动的类型和基本礼仪，对比中西文化差异，培养学生的跨文化交流能力以及通过塑造个人形象来维护国家形象的意识。通过报告、模拟演练等形式让学生亲身体验外事活动，学会反思交流中的问题、自身的不足之处，培养学生自我提升、不断学习的意识。
default.en: Foreign Affairs Etiquette is a required course for International Organizations and Global Governance majors. This course aims to teach students the norms of foreign affairs etiquette through theoretical lectures, case studies, practical exercises and problem reflections, and to improve students' cross-cultural communication literacy in all aspects from three dimensions: cultural awareness, cultural knowledge and cultural ability. The course consists of three major modules, namely personal etiquette, reception etiquette and visiting etiquette, to firstly raise students' awareness of personal image and the continuous improvement of self-cultivation The course will firstly raise students' awareness of personal image and their motivation to continuously improve their self-cultivation, popularize the types of foreign affairs activities and basic etiquette, compare the cultural differences between Chinese and Western cultures, and cultivate students' cross-cultural communication skills as well as their awareness of maintaining the country's image by shaping their personal image. Through reports and simulations, students will experience foreign affairs activities, learn to reflect on problems in communication and their own shortcomings, and develop a sense of self-improvement and continuous learning.

default.zh: 国际组织认知与实践课程是国际组织人才培养训练营的培训课程，训练营面向全校对国际组织运作机制感兴趣，希望深入了解国际事务的学生。课程以国际组织的运作机制、历史背景、发展趋势以及在全球治理中的作用为主要内容。相关教学任务包括：理解国际组织的定义、分类和功能，掌握国际组织的基本知识；分析国际组织在全球治理中的作用和影响，了解国际组织的发展历程和趋势；熟悉国际组织的决策机构、决策程序和决策影响，能够评估国际组织的效能和局限性；掌握国际组织的运作方式、成员国关系、议程设置等实践操作，能够运用相关知识解决国际事务中的问题；通过小组讨论、案例分析等教学环节，建立团队合作意识和能力，提高协作效率。通过学习本课程，学生将能够建立对国际组织的系统性认知，掌握相关理论知识，并能够运用所学知识分析解决国际事务中的实际问题。
default.en: The course on Understanding and Practice of International Organizations is a training program within the talent development camp for international organizations. The camp is open to students across the school who are interested in the operational mechanisms of international organizations and wish to gain a deep understanding of international affairs. The course focuses on the operational mechanisms, historical background, development trends, and role in global governance of international organizations. Relevant teaching tasks include: understanding the definition, classification, and functions of international organizations, mastering the basic knowledge of international organizations, analyzing the role and impact of international organizations in global governance, understanding the development process and trends of international organizations, familiarizing with the decision-making bodies, procedures, and influence of international organizations, able to evaluate the effectiveness and limitations of international organizations, mastering the operational methods of international organizations, member country relationships, agenda setting, and other practical operations, able to apply relevant knowledge to solve international affairs issues, establishing a sense of teamwork and cooperation, enhancing collaborative efficiency through group discussions, case studies, and other teaching activities. By studying this course, students will be able to develop a systematic understanding of international organizations, master relevant theoretical knowledge, and apply the knowledge learned to analyze and solve practical issues in international affairs.

default.zh: 国际组织知识与技能课程是国际组织人才培养训练营的培训课程，训练营面向全校对国际组织运作机制感兴趣，希望深入了解国际事务的学生。课程以国际组织的运作机制、相关理论和实践技能为主要内容。相关教学任务包括：理解国际组织的概念、分类和功能，掌握相关理论知识；掌握国际组织在全球治理中的作用和影响，了解其发展历程和未来趋势；熟悉国际组织的决策机构、运作方式和决策影响，能够分析评估其效能和挑战；培养学生的跨文化沟通能力、团队合作能力和解决问题的能力，为将来从事国际事务工作做好准备。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够全面掌握国际组织领域的知识和技能，建立跨学科思维的综合能力，能够综合运用多学科知识解决复杂国际事务问题。
default.en: The International Organizations Knowledge and Skills course is a training program within the talent development camp for international organizations, open to students across the school who are interested in the operational mechanisms of international organizations and wish to gain a deep understanding of international affairs. The course focuses on the operational mechanisms, relevant theories, and practical skills of international organizations. Relevant teaching tasks include: Understanding the concepts, classifications, and functions of international organizations, and mastering relevant theoretical knowledge. Mastering the role and impact of international organizations in global governance, understanding their development process and future trends. Becoming familiar with the decision-making bodies, operational methods, and decision impacts of international organizations, and being able to analyze and evaluate their effectiveness and challenges. Cultivating students' cross-cultural communication skills, teamwork abilities, and problem-solving skills, preparing them for future careers in international affairs. Through the study of this course, students will be able to comprehensively master the knowledge and skills in the field of international organizations, establish interdisciplinary thinking capabilities, and apply multidisciplinary knowledge to solve complex international affairs issues.

default.zh: 本课程为英语辅修专业学生第二学年开设，是一门集英国背景知识和英语语言知识为一体的英语专业必修课，其根本任务是全面提高学生的文化素养。通过对英国的地理、人口、经济、政治、社会、特别是历史等各方面学习，争取让学生对英国有一个整体的概观，扩大学生的知识面，使他们能较好地理解其文化和价值观。同时，本课程旨在提供理解英国文学和跨文化交际课所必需的背景知识，使学生在跨国跨文化的交际中，成功地运用他们所学的知识与技能。在了解以上知识的同时，学习者可以扩充大量的相关英语词汇，为其它课程提供有关英国的背景知识，为进一步学习、研究语言和文学等打好基础。另外，学生在学习知识的同时，还可以提高英语阅读能力，提高学生对文化差异的宽容性和处理文化差异的灵活性。此外，本课程要求学生熟悉中国文化传统，具有较多的人文知识和科技知识，较强的创新意识和一定的创新能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，总成绩是期末试卷、学期论文、课堂演示等项的总和。
default.en: The course is designed for English minor students. This is an English major compulsory course which, mingling together the background information of the UK and knowledge of the English language, aims at cultivating the students’ cultural awareness and enabling them to acquire the desired traits. This course introduces to students information about the geography, people, economy, politics, society, and particularly the history of the United Kingdom, thus enlarging their sphere of knowledge and enhancing their power to better understand English culture and values. Meanwhile, it provides the essential background knowledge for the study of English literature and cross-cultural communication, enabling the students to successfully manipulate the knowledge and skills they have acquired in cross-national and cross-cultural communication. Through the learning of the previous lectures, learners can broaden their pool of vocabulary, therefore offering British culture-based knowledge for further research in linguistics and literature. Meanwhile, the learners’ reading comprehension competence can be improved, the tolerance of treating cross-cultural differences can be strengthened and the ability of handling cultural differences flexibly can be improved. Also, this course requires that students be familiar with Chinese culture, acquire more knowledge of liberal arts and technology, and improve their initiative awareness and abilities. The total score of this course is based on the following parts: final exam paper, term paper and class attendance.

default.zh: 本课程为英语辅修专业学生第二学年开设，是一门集美国背景知识和英语语言知识为一体的英语专业必修课，其根本任务是全面提高学生的文化素养。通过对美国的地理、人口、经济、政治、社会、特别是历史等各方面学习，争取让学生对美国有一个整体的概观，扩大学生的知识面，使他们能较好地理解其文化和价值观。同时，本课程旨在提供理解美国文学和跨文化交际课所必需的背景知识，使学生在跨国跨文化的交际中，成功地运用他们所学的知识与技能。在了解以上知识的同时，学习者可以扩充大量的相关英语语词汇，为其它课程提供有关美国的背景知识，为进一步学习、研究语言和文学等打好基础。另外，学生在学习知识的同时，还可以提高英语阅读能力，提高学生对文化差异的宽容性和处理文化差异的灵活性。同时，本课程要求学生熟悉中国文化传统，具有较多的人文知识和科技知识，较强的创新意识和一定的创新能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，总成绩是期末试卷、学期论文、课堂演示等项的总和。
default.en: The course is designed for English minor students. This is an English major compulsory course which mingles together with the background information of USA and knowledge of the English language, aims at cultivating the students’ cultural awareness and enabling them to acquire the desired traits. This course introduces the information on the geography, people, economy, politics, society and particularly the history of the United States of America, thus enlarging their sphere of knowledge and enhancing their power to better understand American culture and values. Meanwhile, it provides the essential background knowledge for the study of American literature and cross-cultural communication, enabling the students to successfully manipulate the knowledge and skills they have acquired in cross-cultural communication. Through the learning of the previous lectures, learners can broaden their pool of vocabulary, therefore offering American culture-based knowledge for further research in linguistics and literature. Meanwhile, the learners’ reading comprehension competence can be improved, the tolerance of treating cross-cultural differences can be strengthened and the ability of handling cultural differences flexibly can be improved. Also, this course requires that students be familiar with Chinese culture, acquire more knowledge of liberal arts and technology, and improve their initiative awareness and abilities. The total score of this course is based on the following parts: final exam paper, term paper and class presentation.

default.zh: 《中国文化》是面向英语专业辅修学生的限选课，课程采用全英文授课。本课程旨在拓展学生中国文化知识与理解能力，增强学生对中华文化的认同与自信，培养中国情怀和国际视野，学会用英文恰当表达和建构中国文化身份，提高批判性跨文化思辨能力与以英语为媒介传播中华文化的能力。本课程的内容涵盖中国传统文化和现当代文化的精髓与特点，包括中华文明与文化产生与发展的自然经济基础、哲学与人文精神传统、历史文化脉络、神话传说、语言文字与文学、政府与社会、教育制度与学习文化、民族与民俗、流行文化等主题内容。本课程采用累加式考核方法，根据学生平时学习表现、作业及课程项目完成情况以及期末考试情况综合评定。
default.en: Chinese Culture is an elective course offered to undergraduate English minors. Being designed as both extension and expansion of the students’ Chinese cultural knowledge in English, this course aims to enhance the students’ understanding as well as their identification with the Chinese culture, integrating students’ learning of English and Chinese culture with the development of their intercultural communicative competence. Upon completion of this content-based course, students should be able to express，negotiate and construct their Chinese cultural identity and promote Chinese culture in the English language with critical cultural awareness and from both Chinese and global perspectives. The content of this course highlights the major themes of Chinese culture ranging from the traditional to the contemporary, including geo-economic conditions, historical heritage, philosophical and spiritual heritage, language and literature, government and society, educational system and culture of learning, ethnicity and customs, and popular culture etc. Course evaluation is based on formative assessment of the students’ overall performance in class participation, presentation, and course paper.

default.zh: 英语文学基础课程系统地介绍英语诗歌、小说、戏剧等主要文学样式的体裁特征、构成要素、不同类型和历史演变。除了介绍基础知识，还帮助学生了解不同文学流派的历史文化背景和文学批评的基本方法。课程选取各个体裁有代表性作家的作品进行细致的文本分析，通过阅读、分析英语文学原著、结合所学知识用英语进行诗歌或小说创作等方式，培养学生理解和鉴赏英语文学作品的能力和创新能力。
default.en: Introduction to English Literature introduces to students the generic features, elements, types and historical development of English poetry, novels and plays. It familiarizes students with the various literary schools, different socio-cultural and historical context in which they are embedded and critical approaches to English literature. Representative literary works by influential writers in different periods are selected for close-reading and analysis. Students will read unabridged texts, and create English poems or short stories using generic knowledge as well as their personal experiences so as to improve their understanding of English literature and to foster creative thinking.

default.zh: 《国际组织概论》是国际组织与全球治理辅修专业核心课程。本课程讲授主要国际组织的概念特征、发展历程、运行机制、用人机制及实习任职途径和方法，通过本课程的学习，学生正确认识国际组织在国际事务中的地位与重要作用及其对中国的意义，明确中国未来参与全球治理的根本目标和重要使命，培养学生的国际交往能力和处理国际事务的基本素质，提升学生对世情分析、推理判断的能力及思辨能力。该课程有助于学生的人文情怀、民族精神和社会责任感的培养，引导学生为国际组织实习任职付出积极的努力。
default.en: Overview of International Organizations is a main course for the major of International Organizations and Global Governance. It includes the main characteristics, development course, operation mechanism, employment mechanism and application methods of international organizations. Students will understand the important role of international organizations in international affairs and their significance to China, and know the basic goal of China's future participation and important mission in global governance. Students will enhance their international communication ability and basic international affair quality, and improve the social analysis, reasoning, judgment and thinking capability. This course helps to cultivate students' humanistic feelings, national spirit and sense of social responsibility, and guides them to make positive efforts to enter international organizations.

default.zh: 国际关系本身，以及研究国际关系的学科，始终处于常变常新的动态发展之中。连接跨国行为体的依存网络日趋深化，国际关系现实亦随之愈益复杂。国际关系研究，既不是简单的史实描述，也不是抽象概念的堆叠。仅仅诉诸历史，或是单纯依靠理论，都不足以解释现实问题。只有在历史与理论之间找到具规律性的衔接，才能据以廓清形势与趋势。本课立足于国际关系研究所固有的宽广视域，通过理论框架与实证分析的结合来揭示国际合作与冲突的主要成因，国家发展与经济全球化的基本逻辑，重要国际组织的变迁历程与世界秩序的治理机制，帮助学生奠定理解国际关系所需的史学根底，掌握解释国际关系所需的基础概念、理论范式与方法论，培养学生的跨文化沟通能力与涉外事务的工作能力。此外，本课还将设置实际操作环节，通过择取国际关系史中的经典案例、采行模拟国际组织的方式来开展课堂训练，运用探究式与参与式的教学方法来帮助学生提升思辨与表达能力，熟悉外交语言与外事工作机理，为学生今后的国际组织实习与任职申请储备必要的职业素养。
default.en: The international relations itself, as well as the discipline of International Relations, are always in the dynamic development of constant changes. The reality of international relations is becoming more complicated as the network of dependencies connecting transnational actors deepens. The research on international relations is neither a simple historical description nor a stack of abstract concepts. Just resorting to histories or relying solely on theories is not enough to explain real problems. Only by finding a regular connection between histories and theories can the situation and trend be clarified. The course is based on the broad perspectives inherent in the study on international relations. Through the combination of theoretical framework and empirical analysis, the course reveals the main causes of international cooperation and conflict, the basic logic of national development and economic globalization, the history of changes about the important international organizations, and the governance mechanism of the world order, which will be needed to help students establish the historical knowledge to understand international relations, master the basic concepts, theoretical paradigms, and methodologies to explain international relations, and cultivate students’ cross-cultural communication skills and working abilities in foreign affairs. In addition, the course will also set up practical operations to utilize inquiry and participatory teaching methods to help students improve thinking and expression abilities, to understand the diplomatic languages and the working mechanisms of foreign affairs to prepare the necessary professional qualities for students’ future internship and job applications in international organizations by the selections of classic cases in the history of international relations and the use of simulations of international organizations to carry out classroom training.

default.zh: 传授学生语言学、文学、跨文化和翻译知识。
default.en: It aims to inform students of the knowledge of English linguistics, literature, intercultural communication and translation.

default.zh: 《专业思维训练 B》是面向俄语专业大四学生开设的核心提升类课程，精准对标俄语专业考研人才培养需求，聚焦学生专业核心素质、综合知识体系与科研创新能力的全方位塑造，是衔接俄语专业基础学习与高阶学术研究、升学深造的关键课程。课程立足俄语专业人才培养标准，紧扣专业毕业要求，以素养培育为根基、知识传授为载体、能力提升为核心，构建系统化、专业化的思维训练体系，助力学生夯实专业功底、锤炼学术思维，适配考研深造与专业发展的双重需求。
default.en: Professional Thinking Training B is a core advanced course for fourth-year Russian majors. Tailored to the competency requirements of postgraduate admission in Russian studies, this course aims to comprehensively cultivate students’ core professional literacy, disciplinary knowledge system, and research and innovation capabilities. As a pivotal bridge between foundational coursework and advanced academic research and postgraduate studies, it strictly aligns with the talent cultivation standards and graduation criteria for Russian majors. Prioritizing literacy development, knowledge instruction and competency enhancement, the course establishes a systematic and discipline-specific thinking training framework, enabling students to solidify their professional foundation and refine their academic thinking for both postgraduate pursuit and future professional development.

default.zh: 英语泛读是英语专业基础阶段教学的一门限选课，同时也是使学生大量接触英语读物和培养阅读能力的一门实践基础课。英语阅读课的目的在于培养学生的英语阅读能力和提高学生的阅读速度；培养学生细致观察语言的能力以及假设判断、分析归纳、推理检验等逻辑思维能力；提高学生的阅读技能，包括略读、寻读、细读、评读等能力；并通过阅读训练帮助学生扩大词汇量，增强语感，不断积累各种语言知识，加深文化沉淀。阅读课教学应注重阅读理解能力与提高阅读速度并重。教材应选用题材广泛的阅读材料，以便向学生提供广泛的语言和文化素材，扩大学生的知识面，培养学生的阅读兴趣。课外指定长篇简易读物和浅显原著，培养学生细致观察语言的能力，要求学生定期写读书报告。阅读课教学中，要加强学生思维能力和创新能力的培养；要有意识地训练学生分析与综合、抽象与概括、多角度分析问题等多种思维能力以及发现问题、解决难题等创新能力；正确处理语言技能训练与创新能力培养的关系；并注重培养学生对文化差异的敏感性、宽容性以及处理文化差异的灵活性，注重培养跨文化交际能力。本课程通过具体的文章阅读，训练阅读方法和技巧。要求学生在规定的时间内，完成指定的阅读篇数。本课程的重点是提高阅读速度，增强阅读能力。难点是不同体裁的文章的阅读理解，词汇量的增加，不同类型的篇章结构的把握。
default.en: English Extensive Reading is an elective course for English majors, and it is also a practical course for students to have access to authentic English books and improve their ability in reading English materials. The course aims to develop several key abilities related to reading in English: Students are able to practice their reading ability and improve their reading speed; they can also develop an insight into careful observation and judgment, inductive reasoning and logical thinking ability; students can also improve their reading skills, including skimming and scanning, critical reading ability. Through extensive exposure to reading materials of all kinds, the course hopes to train students to enlarge their vocabulary, enhance their sense of language, and deepen their understanding of a variety of language knowledge points and cultures. The reading materials cover a wide range of topics, providing students with a wide variety of language and cultural materials, expanding students' knowledge, and cultivating students' interest in reading. After-class reading materials are assigned to students to nurture students' ability to observe language carefully and pick up language unconsciously. The instructions on reading will strengthen the cultivation of students' thinking ability and innovation ability; to consciously train students for analysis and synthesis, abstraction and generalization, multi angle analysis as well as other problem-solving innovative abilities. This course reads through specific articles and trains reading methods and techniques. Students are required to complete the assigned readings within the specified time. The emphasis of this course is on improving students’ reading comprehension and speed. The difficult points of this course are the comprehension of articles of different styles and of different structures, and the expansion of vocabulary.

default.zh: 英语语法是外国语学院英语系开设的一门专业限选课。这门课程和其他专业课程之间有着千丝万缕的关系，是基础中的基础。本课程的设计思路是围绕专业基础课的性质，按照英语语言的科学构成，开展语料引入，语法讨论，实践应用的学习途径，并在此基础上循序渐进，层层推进，形成对英语语言规律的完整认识，同时实现培养学生的独立思考和实践操作能力的目标。内容设计上该课程帮助学生比较系统地了解分析英语语法的方法，使他们认识、了解英语口语和书面语的区别以及从词到句再至语篇的构造。通过对各个语法层次，即词素、词、词组、分句和句子的系统认识和分析，提高学生使用英语的规范性以及传递信息、表达思想的准确性和逻辑性。教学模式思路上，根据启发式、发现式、互动式、情景式等教学理念，围绕英语语言的具体内容，开展个人思考、双人切磋、小组讨论，共同分享等发现总结语言规律的教学活动，遵循理论实践相结合和循序渐进以及深入浅出的教学原则，反复锻炼学生的观察力、理解力、逻辑思维能力以及合作学习能力，从而最终实现学生的自主学习习惯的养成。由于学生在中学阶段已经了解、掌握了一定的语法知识，本课程不求面面俱到，而是有所侧重。通过一学期的学习，本课程旨在进一步提高学生实际运用英语的能力，为后来的学习和研究英语语言、文学奠定基础。
default.en: English Grammar is an elementary course for English Majors. It is closely related to other major courses and is the foundation of the foundation. Based on the nature of the course and the science of the English language, the design idea of this course is to carry out the introduction of corpus, grammar discussion and learning practices gradually so that students are able to formulate a complete understanding of the English language rules, and cultivate independent thinking and practical problem-solving abilities. In terms of content design, this course helps students to learn different ways to analyze English grammar systematically and differences between spoken English and written English. It introduces the formation of words, sentences and discourses. Through systematic learning and analysis of grammatical hierarchy, including morphemes, words, phrases, clauses and sentences, students are expected to use Standard English and improve their accuracy and logic in expressing information and their opinions. In terms of the teaching mode, with the consideration to several teaching concepts such as heuristic, discovery, interactive and situational, the course requires students to do independent observation, pair work and group discussion as well as share the language rules together. It is hoped that through repeated training that students can develop a good observation, understanding, logical thinking ability and cooperative learning ability, and ultimately their independent learning capabilities. Due to the fact that students must have obtained a certain degree of mastery of English grammatical rules in their pre-university stages, this course focuses on some key points of English grammar instead of every aspect of it. This course aims to improve students’ ability to use English so as to lay a foundation for further study in Linguistics and Literature.

default.zh: 高级英语阅读（1）是英语专业高年级限选课，课程目标将价值塑造、知识传授和能力培养融为一体。本课程主要传授学生英语语言知识和国内外文化知识，在开展听说读写译语言活动过程中，引导学生系统学习和深入领会习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的核心要义，掌握中国特色时政文献的语篇特点与规律。通过对阅读材料的全面分析，学生理解所读文章的背景知识，掌握篇章结构、写作特点和语言知识，理解文章蕴含的深层次意义。课程旨在提升学生的高阶阅读能力、写作能力、翻译能力、思辨能力、跨文化交流能力和中国文化国际传播能力。本课程采用累加式考核方式，考核环节包括演讲、写作、翻译、课堂测试和期末考试等。
default.en: Advanced English Reading (1) is an elective course for higher-level English major students and the teaching objectives integrate soul forming, knowledge spreading and competence developing. It aims to inform students of the knowledge of English language and the culture of both China and English-speaking countries. During the teaching activity of developing students’ competence of listening, speaking, reading, writing, translating, the course directs students to understand the implications of the new era of socialism with Chinese characteristics and master the discourse features of current political literature with Chinese Characteristics. Students understand the background information, structure, writing features, language knowledge, and implications of the texts. The course improves the students’ higher-level reading ability, writing ability, translating ability, critical thinking ability, intercultural competence and international communication capacity. Accumulative assessment includes classroom participation, writing, translation, quizzes, and final exam.

default.zh: 高级英语阅读（2）是英语专业高年级选修课。课程目标将价值塑造、知识传授和能力培养融为一体。本课程主要传授学生英语语言知识和国内外文化知识，在开展听说读写译语言活动过程中，引导学生系统学习和深入领会习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的核心要义，掌握中国特色时政文献的语篇特点与规律。通过对阅读材料的全面分析，学生理解所读文章的背景知识，掌握篇章结构、写作特点和语言知识，理解文章蕴含的深层次意义。课程旨在提升学生的高阶阅读能力、写作能力、翻译能力、思辨能力、跨文化交流能力和中国文化国际传播能力。本课程采用累加式考核方式，考核环节包括演讲、写作、翻译、课堂测试和期末考试等。
default.en: Advanced English Reading (2) is an elective course for higher-level English major students. The teaching objectives integrate soul forming, knowledge spreading and competence developing. It aims to inform students of the knowledge of English language and the culture of both China and English-speaking countries. During the teaching activity of developing students’ competence of listening, speaking, reading, writing, translating, the course directs students to understand the implications of the new era of socialism with Chinese characteristics and master the discourse features of current political literature with Chinese Characteristics. Students understand the background information, structure, writing features, language knowledge, and implications of the texts. The course improves the students’ higher-level reading ability, writing ability, translating ability, critical thinking ability, intercultural competence and international communication capacity. Accumulative assessment includes classroom participation, writing, translation, quizzes, and final exam.

default.zh: 本课程为英语专业本科高年级专业限选课程，对于培养学生的语言分析能力和解释能力具有重要意义。通过学习词汇学的相关基础概念、理论和分析方法，学生将会全面、系统、深入地掌握英语词汇的相关知识，掌握英语词汇现象的分析手段和解释机制，从而拥有对于语言特点及规律性的认知与探究的能力；同时，通过词源学知识的学习，能够加深对于英美国家的社会、历史与文化知识的了解。本课程也将为下一阶段的英语学习和语言理论学习打下基础。本课程的内容包括词汇学的基本概念和基础理论，以及英语词汇的分类与组织、词的发展过程、外来词现象、词的构成方法、词的意义、意义关系及其变化、词的理据、词的认知理解与语境等诸多方面。为了增加趣味性、丰富学生的知识，每堂课都包括一至两个词源学“故事”，包括大量的词语、成语、谚语等，其来源涉及英美等国家的社会、历史与文化的方方面面。本课程的考核方式为累加式，包括课堂参与、课堂测验、课堂报告、课程论文与期末考试。
default.en: Aimed at promoting abilities to analyze and explain lexical phenomena, English Lexicology is an optional course for juniors majoring in English. Through this course, the students will have an overall, systematic and in-depth knowledge about English vocabulary, will master the ways to analyze and the mechanisms to explain lexical phenomena in the English language, and thus will be able to study into the rules and laws governing the English vocabulary. Meanwhile, through the study of etymology, the students will have a deeper understanding of British and American society, history and culture. This course also facilitates further English language learning and courses in linguistics. This course mainly involves: basic concepts and theories of lexicology; the classification, organization and development of English vocabulary; borrowing and sources of borrowing; ways of word formation; types of motivation; word meaning, meaning relations and meaning changes; word cognition, understanding and context. Besides, in order to improve the students’ interest in the course, one or two “stories of etymology” involving large numbers of English words, idioms and sayings are provided at the beginning of each lecture concerning various aspects of the society, history and culture of English speaking nations, which will also enrich their cultural knowledge. Students’ performances will be evaluated with regard to class participation, quizzes, class presentation, course paper and the final exam.

default.zh: 语言与社会是英语专业高年级学生的专业限选课，旨在培养学生的批判性的英语运用能力、思辨能力，培养学生通过语言学理论解释社会语言生活现象的学术思维能力。本课程为社会语言学的基础课，主要讲授语言与社会、语言与社会阶层、语言与群体、语言与性别、语言与语境、语言与社会互动、语言与国家以及语言与地理。学生阅读相关文献资料，学习社会语言学的基本概念和术语，在建立基本语言科研观的基础上，着重培养学生们的社会语言分析意识和批判意识，了解其与社会的密切关系，并提高学生在全球化过程中在不同场合的文化意识和跨文化交际能力。本课程以课堂参与、平时作业、课程论文、课程项目答辩等多种形式，对学生学习进行立体的评估。
default.en: Language and Society is an optional course for Seniors majoring in English, which is designed to provide students with critical English language skills, cognitive abilities, and to enable students to understand and explain social linguistic phenomena from a scientific perspective. This is an introductory course of Sociolinguistics. It covers major topics about language and society, such as language and social stratification, language and social groups, language and gender, language and context, language and social interaction, language and country, and language and geography. Students will be trained through reading relevant literature materials, learning the basic concepts and terms of sociolinguistics, with special focus on cultivating students' language awareness concerning analysis and criticality, and understanding the close relationship between language use and society. Students will also be enabled to develop their cultural awareness and enhance their intercultural communicative competence in different scenarios in the age of globalization. The assessment is multidimensional, incorporating class participation, essays, project defense, and course paper.

default.zh: 欧洲文学史 课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22FL32112 课程名称：欧洲文学史 总学时： 32 理论学时：32 学分：2.0 开课单位：外国语学院 授课对象：英语专业本科生 开课学期：2秋 先修课程：英语名篇选读 二、课程简介 欧洲文学史是为英语系二年级本科生开设的专业限选课，是其他文学课程的基础课程。本课程以时间为主线，结合影响欧洲文学发展的历史背景和文化思潮，系统地讲解欧洲文学的发展历程，介绍不同历史时期欧洲各国的文学流派及其文学特征，探讨各个阶段代表作家的创作风格，分析重要作品的主要内容、主旨和艺术特点，简介多个文学术语的基本定义和主要特征。本课程以史为纲，辅之以文本分析，旨在使学生了解欧洲文学发展的基本脉络，掌握重要的文学知识，培养学生理解和欣赏文学作品的能力，提高学生的文学素养。；指导学生从历史和文化的角度理解文学作品，启发学生对文学作品中人类发展的共性问题进行哲学思考，从而树立正确的人生观。课程内容主要包括古希腊罗马文学、中世纪文学、文艺复兴文学、十七世纪新古典主义文学、十八世纪启蒙文学、十九世纪浪漫主义文学、十九世纪现实主义文学、二十世纪现实主义文学、现代主义文学和后现代主义文学。本课程考核采用累加式，总成绩包括课堂表现、研学作业和测验。
default.en: Introduction to [History of European Literature] 1.General Information Course Code：22FL32112 Course Title：History of European Literature Credit Hours：32 Lecture：32 Credit(s)：2.0 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: English majors Term: Fall, Second Year Prerequisites: Intensive Reading of English Classic Works 2. Course Description History of European Literature is a selective course for the sophomores of English Department. It is a preliminary course for other literature courses. In the chronological order, taking into consideration the historical background and the cultural context, this course traces the historical development of European literature. It introduces students to the various literary schools in the different stages of European literature and their respective features, explores the style of the representative writers of different literary periods as displayed in their masterpieces, analyzes the major themes and artistic features of the important works, and explains some basic literary terms and their general features. With the history of European literature as the framework, supplemented by textual analysis, this course aims to facilitate students’ overall view of the history of European literature and mastery of the fundamental knowledge of literature so as to improve students’ capability of comprehending and appreciating literary works and cultivate their literary temperament. It also aims to instruct students to understand literary works from the historical and cultural perspectives and inspire students’ philosophical reflection of the common problems of humanity to help students establish correct life value. The course consists of the following chapters; the ancient Greek and Roman literature, the renaissance literature, the 17th-century Neoclassical literature, the 18th-century Enlightenment literature, the 19th-century Romanticism, the 19th-century Realism, the 20th-century Realism, Modernism and Postmodernism. The grading system consists of class participation, homework, and quizzes.

default.zh: 20世纪英国文学是为英语专业二年级学生开设的专业限选课。课程主要讲授20世纪英国文坛重要作家和其代表作品，使学生了解20世纪重大社会历史事件及社会文化思潮，如现代主义、后现代主义、后殖民主义、女权主义等对英国文学创作的影响，熟悉诗歌、小说、短篇小说、戏剧等主要文学体裁特征及相应作品的人物形象、主题、技巧、语言风格等，掌握英语文学论文写作的基本技能和论文格式规范。课程涉及主要作家包括诗人叶芝、奥登和托马斯；剧作家萧伯纳与贝克特；小说家伍尔夫、乔伊斯、曼斯菲尔德、莱辛、洛奇等。课程采用累加式考核方式，考核环节包括课堂表现、研读报告、小组学习、论文和期末考试。
default.en: 20th Century English Literature is an elective course offered to sophomore English majors. Focusing on major writers and their major works in the first and second halves of the 20th century English literature, this course aims to explore how significant social events and movements and socio-cultural thoughts, such as Modernism, Post-modernism, Post-colonialism and Feminism, have impacted the literary tradition and inspired literary endeavors. This course engages students in textual analysis of poems, short stories, novels, and dramas in the 20th century. Students will read for relatedness with historical background, themes, characterization, techniques, and language style. This course is to cultivate students’ ability to understand and appreciate English literary works and improve their basic language skills and critical thinking. It also aims to develop students’ ability to do research and literature review as well as write critical essays following the MLA format. Major authors include Yeats, Auden, Thomas; Bernard Shaw, Beckett; Woolf, Joyce, Mansfield, Lessing, Lodge, etc. Accumulative assessment includes classroom participation, report, group study, papers and final exam.

default.zh: 英国浪漫主义文学是英语专业二年级学生秋季学期的专业限选课。课程旨在培养学生理解和鉴赏英国浪漫主义文学作品的能力，促进其语言基本功、思辨能力和人文素质的提高。同时培养学生自主调研，就既定范围内的题目做研读报告的能力，以及用英语进行诗歌创作的能力。课程主要介绍英国浪漫主义文学的发展全貌，讲授英语诗歌体裁的基本知识，指导学生阅读英国浪漫主义时期经典的诗歌和长篇小说，结合历史文化语境对所选作品进行细致的文本分析。课程采用累加式考核方式，考核环节包括课堂表现、研读报告、诗歌创作、诗歌朗诵和期末考试。
default.en: Romantic English Literature is an elective course for English sophomores in the autumn term. This course aims to cultivate students’ ability to understand and appreciate Romantic English literature, improve their basic language skills, critical thinking and humanistic quality. It also aims to develop students’ ability to do researches independently, give presentations on assigned topics, and create poems in English. This course traces the history of English literature in the Romantic period, introduces students to the basic knowledge of poetry as a genre, and engages them in a careful reading of some classic poems and novels in the Romantic period with a close textual analysis of them in historical and cultural contexts. The final score is achieved by adding up the scores of the following: in-class participation, presentation, poetry writing, poetry recitation and final exam.

default.zh: 19世纪美国文学是为英语专业三年级学生开设的专业限选课。课程旨在培养学生理解和鉴赏19世纪美国文学作品的能力，促进学生语言基本功、思辨能力和人文素质的提高。同时培养学生收集、整理相关资料，并规范地撰写英语文学论文的能力。课程主要讲授19世纪美国文学重要作家的代表作品，重点是使学生了解19世纪美国文学浪漫主义和现实主义流派产生的社会历史文化背景，以及美国身份、历史和现状的文学想象。课程结合历史文化语境对所选作品进行细致的文本分析，使学生掌握作品的人物形象、主题、技巧、语言风格等，掌握英语文学论文写作的基本技能和论文格式规范。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂表现、研读报告、小组项目学习、课程论文和期末考试。
default.en: 19th Century American Literature is an elective course offered to senior English majors. This course aims to cultivate students’ ability to understand and appreciate American literature in the 19th Century, improve their basic language skills, critical thinking and humanistic quality. It also aims to develop students’ ability to do research, and write critical essays about literature in English following the standard format. This course covers the representative works of some important American writers in the 19th Century. It focuses on two literary trends, namely American Romanticism and Realism, examines the interconnection between these literary activities and socio-historical and cultural factors and explores the literary imagination of the American identity, American past and its present. This course engages students in close textual analysis of selected works in the historical and cultural context so as to enable them to grasp the characterization, themes, techniques, and language style and grasp the basis skills and format for writing critical essays about literature in English. Accumulative assessment includes classroom participation, report, group project study, term paper and final exam.

default.zh: 族裔文学专题是英语专业四年级专业限选课程。该课程主要研究英语国家少数族裔的文学作品，如美国少数族裔文学，含美国印第安裔文学、华裔文学、非裔文学、犹太裔文学、西班牙裔文学等，又如英国族裔文学、加拿大族裔文学、澳大利亚族裔文学、新西兰族裔文学等。可以加入中西对比的内容，即可以涉及中国族裔文学英译本的研究。课程将对族裔文化与主流文化的关系、族裔主人公的成长历程和身份形成进行探讨。要求学生有较强的文本及文献阅读能力。本课程的主要内容，以美国印第安文学专题为例，包括：莫马黛、金、阿莱克西和厄德里克等作家的写作特点研究和代表作品的主题分析。四位作家的作品分析以文化融合与共同体构建为主线进行串联。课程采用累加式评价方式，总成绩由平时表现、课堂报告和课程论文累加而成。
default.en: Ethnic Literature is an elective course offered to the fourth-year English majors. It is a seminar concerning Ethnic Literature in English speaking countries, e. g. American Ethnic Literature (including Native American Literature, Chinese American Literature, Afro-American Literature, Jewish American Literature, and Hispanic Literature), British Ethnic Literature, Canadian Ethnic Literature, Australian Ethnic Literature, and New Zealand Ethnic Literature. Every time, the instructor can choose one or more of the above mentioned series. Comparison between Chinese Ethnic Literature and Western Ethnic Literature is also an option, i. e. Chinese Ethnic literature in English, or translated into English. In this course, the relationship between mainstream culture and ethnic culture, the initiation and identification of the ethnic protagonist will be explored. Students are required to have strong capability in reading literary texts and second hand literature. The course, taking Native American Literature for example, consists of the analysis of the writing features of major Native American writers like Momaday, King, Alexie, and Erdrich, and the thematic study of their respective works. The thematic analysis centers around Native Americans’ cultural syncretism and the construction of communities The grading system of this course consists of class participation, presentation, and a term paper.

default.zh: 《中国文化国际传播》是面向基础阶段英语专业本科生的限选课，课程采用全英文授课。本课程旨在拓展学生中国文化知识与理解能力，增强学生对中华文化的认同与自信，培养中国情怀和国际视野，学会用英文恰当表达和建构中国文化身份，提高批判性跨文化思辨能力与以英语为媒介传播中华文化的能力。本课程的内容涵盖中国传统文化和现当代文化的精髓与特点，包括中华文明与文化产生与发展的自然经济基础、哲学与人文精神传统、历史文化脉络、神话传说、语言文字与文学、政府与社会、教育制度与学习文化、民族与民俗、流行文化等主题内容。本课程采用累加式考核方法，根据学生平时学习表现、作业及课程项目完成情况以及期末考试情况综合评定。 是培养学生理解和英语表达中华民族文化身份能力及跨文化交际能力的重要专业限选课。
default.en: International Communication of Chinese Culture is an elective course offered to undergraduate English majors. Being designed as both extension and expansion of the students’ Chinese cultural knowledge in English, this course aims to enhance the students’ understanding as well as their identification with the Chinese culture, integrating students’ learning of English and Chinese culture with the development of their intercultural communicative competence. Upon completion of this content-based course, students should be able to express，negotiate and construct their Chinese cultural identity and promote Chinese culture in the English language with critical cultural awareness and from both Chinese and global perspectives. The content of this course highlights the major themes of Chinese culture ranging from the traditional to the contemporary, including geo-economic conditions, historical heritage, philosophical and spiritual heritage, language and literature, government and society, educational system and culture of learning, ethnicity and customs, and popular culture etc. Course evaluation is based on formative assessment of the students’ overall performance in class participation, assignments, course project and final exam.

default.zh: 《西方文明史》是国际组织与全球治理专业学生的专业限选课。本课程主要讲授古代文明与近代文明，西方文明突出的人文科学成就和自然科学成就的各个层面，如历史事件、哲学思想、文学艺术等等。通过该课程学习，学生比较系统地了解西方文明的起源和发展进程，掌握西方文明的特征及发展的一般规律，进而提高其思辨能力、文化修养和审美能力。课程主要内容包括：人类早期文明、古希腊文明、古罗马文明、圣经和基督教的起源、中世纪的欧洲、欧洲文艺复兴、宗教改革、巴洛克时代、启蒙运动、法国大革命、浪漫主义、现实主义以及现代主义。课程要求学生在掌握各主要文明常识性知识的基础上，能够简要分析西方文明的演变及影响，根据所学知识对比中西文化、文学等系统的异同。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括平时表现、报告、课堂测试和期末考试。
default.en: History of Western Civilization is an elective course for students majoring in the International Organization and Global Governance. This course provides students with the outstanding achievements of western civilization in arts and natural sciences, historical events, philosophical ideas, literature, and so on. This course enables students to systematically understand the origin and development of western civilization, master the characteristics of western cultures, and therefore to improve their capacity for critical thinking and cultural cultivation as well as aesthetic faculties. The contents include the early civilizations, ancient Greek, ancient Roman, the Bible and the rise of Christianity, the Middle Ages, renaissance, the reformation, the Baroque age, the enlightenment, the France revolution, romanticism, realism, and modernism. This course requires students to analyze the development and the influence of western civilization, and furthermore to make distinctions between eastern and western culture and literature. The course evaluation is accumulated, which covers usual performance, report，in-class tests and final exam.

default.zh: 本课程为英语专业三年级学生开设，是专业限选课,目的在于通过英语发展历史的全面介绍，让专业学生对于语言知识和专业有一个更加系统和理性的了解和掌握。本课程为一学期课程，整个英语发展过程可以被分成三个阶段，分别是：古英语时期、中古英语时期和现代英语时期。而现代英语时期又可以分为早期现代英语和当代英语。此课程把重点放在早期现代英语阶段，因为关于早期现代英语的知识通常容易被忽视。而这方面的知识是一切深入学习英语语言和英国文学的学生都十分需要的。而且，对于专门研究英语语音、语法、词汇的学生来说，这门课也是相当有帮助的， 因为该课程让他们学会了如何从历史发展的演变角度来研究语言现象。本课程以时间为线索，以英语语言发展史的分界为界定的主要根据，同时兼顾英美国家正史记录的脉络，采用历史叙述和语料相结合的方式。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，总成绩是期末试卷、学期论文、课堂演示等项的总和。
default.en: The course is designed for the junior students of the English major. It aims at motivating learners to get a more systematic and rational understanding and mastery , through the learning of the history of the English language, of the knowledge of the language. It can be finished in one semester. The development of English language can be divided into three stages: Old English period, Middle English period and Modern English period. The modern English Period covers two stages: the Early Modern English period and Late Modern English period. The most important part is put on the Early Modern English period because this part is always ignored by learners, and the knowledge of this part is necessary for learners who are majoring in English and English literature. Also, it is very helpful for those who specialize in English pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary because it offers a historical perspective in their research. The course follows the timeline with divisions set up mainly in accordance with the features of the development of the language. The course combines the narration of the history with the demonstration of documentary records. The total score of this course is based on the following parts: final exam paper, term paper and class presentation.

default.zh: 科技英语阅读课程面向英语专业及英语专业双学位的学生开课。是选修课程，也是英语专业学生英语学习的提高课程。课程主要通过科技英语语篇，讲授其语篇特点，句法结构，科技词根词缀等。重点是使学生在阅读科技发展文献，了解科技内容的同时，掌握科技英语特有的语言体系，尤其是独特的语言结构，理解篇章内容，精准、迅速地了解科技发展动态，提高实际运用英语的能力。通过科技英语课程的学习，使学生能够放眼世界，增强全球观念和文化意识, 理解不同文化的思维及表达方式。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，其中学生课堂表现、课堂报告、课后作业占总成绩的40%， 期末考试成绩占总成绩的60%。
default.en: English for Science and Technology is designed for English major and English double major students. It aims to help language students to understand the linguistic and discourse features, syntactic structures and vocabulary features which include stems and affixes of scientific and technical texts. The students are expected to achieve clarity, accuracy, conciseness and overall effectiveness in writing for science and technology. They are also expected to increase their global outlook and an awareness of cultural diversity constructed through English for science and technology texts. Assessment is based on the student’s performance of the whole term, with in-class performance, assignments and presentations accounting for 40% of the final score and final examination 60% of the final score.

default.zh: 世界科学技术史是为英语专业学生开设的一门知识类综合性课程。本课程是关于世界科学技术发展过程及其规律的阅读和讨论。其目的是使学生了解科学技术发展的基本规律、历史特点和经验教训，以及科学技术发展同其它社会因素的关系。通过阅读，学生还将讨论中西科技发展的特点。本课程主要介绍历史上科学技术的重要发现和发明及其发展、演变过程，着重介绍现代科学技术的由来及发展、演变过程，介绍有关当代高新技术。同时本课程还将比较系统地阐述自然科学发展过程中的科学思想和科研方法。
default.en: The course of A History of Science and Technology in the World is a comprehensive, knowledge-based course for English majors. In the course, students will go through materials on the history and patterns of science and technology. Students are expected to have an understanding of the origins of civilizations, their historical characteristics, and experiences and lessons of human being along the development of science and technology. Students will also think about the relationship between social factors and the development of science and technology. Discussions on different characteristics between China and the West's history of science and technology will be carried out in the course. The course introduces major discoveries and inventions in history, with a focus on the birth, evolution and major turning points of modern science and technology, and on contemporary high technology. Besides, the course systematically introduces the scientists’ thinking patterns and their technological methodology.

default.zh: 英汉笔译是英语专业高年级学生的专业选修课，对于培养学生的对翻译的基本认识，翻译技巧有很重要的意义。学生通过对翻译基础的全面分析，理解翻译的要求，掌握英汉翻译的基本技巧。本课程将提高学生的翻译能力以及相关技能的运用水平，为其学习后续课程、通过英语专业八级考试打下坚实的基础。本课程的目的是让学生掌握翻译的基本原理，并通过大量的实践，具备一定的翻译能力，掌握不同文体（主要是应用文体）的英汉翻译的基本特点和技巧，最后能够借助字典翻译一般难度的文章。本课程的主要内容包括英语和汉语之间的差别，如形合与意合等；翻译的基本原理、标准、技巧，如增词、减词、转换等；不同层次的翻译，如词语层、句子层、段落层、篇章层等；不同文体的翻译，如文学文体、科技文体、旅游文体、新闻文体、广告文体等，但侧重应用文体的翻译，其理论指导是“翻译目的论”。学习本课程，学生需将翻译理论与翻译实践紧密结合，进而掌握翻译基本原理、不同文体（主要为应用文体）英汉翻译基本特点、不同文体英汉翻译的技巧。本课程将通过大量实践培养学生翻译能力，让其学习英译汉的技巧、层次、难点、疑点、文体、译文质量评估等相关知识，并采用启发式、互动式教学法，培养学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: English-Chinese translation is an elective course for junior English majors, which is of great significance for cultivating students' basic understanding of translation and translation skills. Through a comprehensive analysis of the basis of translation, students will understand the requirements of translation and master the basic skills of English-Chinese translation. This course will improve students' translation ability and application level of relevant skills, and lay a solid foundation for them to learn subsequent courses and pass TEM-8. The purpose of this course is to enable students to master the basic principles of translation, acquire certain translation ability through a lot of practice, master the basic features and skills of English-Chinese translation in different styles, and finally be able to translate articles of general difficulty with the help of dictionaries. The main content of this course includes the differences between English and Chinese, such as hypotaxis and parataxis; the basic principles, standards and skills of translation, such as amplification, omission, conversion, etc.; different levels of translation, such as word level, sentence level, paragraph level, text level, etc.; the translation of different styles, such as literary style, scientific style, tourism style, news style, advertising style and so on, and a focus on the translation of applied style with "Skopos theory of translation" as its theoretical guidance. In this course, students are required to combine translation theory with translation practice, and master the basic principles of translation, the basic characteristics of English-Chinese translation in different styles, and the skills of English-Chinese translation in different styles. This course aims to develop students' translation ability through a lot of practice, allowing them to learn the skills and other relevant knowledge of English-Chinese translation. It also adopts heuristic and interactive teaching method to develop students' ability to think independently, analyze problems and solve problems.

default.zh: 英汉口译 课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程编码：22FL32133 课程名称：英汉口译 总学时：32 讲课学时：32 学分：2 开课单位：外国语学院英语系 授课对象：英语专业三年级学生 开课学期：3春 先修课程：英汉笔译 二、课程简介 本课程是英语专业选修课。教学内容分为四部分：口译笔记、口译技巧、数字口译、交替口译。本课程旨在介绍口译笔记特点，帮助学生设计自身特色的口译笔记符号；了解应对复杂的长难句的方法；掌握数字的记录方法和快速翻译方法，并通过实践练习掌握数字翻译要领。在奠定基础能力之后让学生进行大量的真实材料口译练习，练习内容广泛包含领导人讲话访谈、会议口译、政治实务口译、科技口译和大篇幅新闻口译。英汉口译课程建立在学生良好的听力和口语阐述能力基础之上，开发学生听记、理解、转换的能力。逐步使学生具有承担一般性正式会议、技术和商务谈判，以及外事活动的口译工作，达到通过初级英语翻译资格证书考试的水平。本课程所使用教材为上海外语教育出版社出版的《中级口译教程》2019第四版（梅德明编著）及任课教师整理的补充材料。本课程的期末成绩采用累加式，包括平时测试成绩和期末卷面成绩。其中平时测试成绩占总成绩的30%，期末卷面成绩占总成绩的70%。
default.en: Introduction to [English-Chinese Interpretation] 1.General Information Course Code：22FL32133 Course Title：English-Chinese Interpretation Credit Hours：32 Lecture：32 Credit(s)：2 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: English Majors Term: Spring, Third year Prerequisites: English-Chinese Translation 2.Course Description The course mainly covers four parts, which focus on note taking, interpretation techniques, figures, and consecutive interpreting. The course aims to help students master the note taking skills, as well as solve problems related to long and complicated sentences. The course also targets special issues such as figures in interpreting. The general purpose is to guide students into the field of interpretation, with the ultimate purpose being that students should be able to complete consecutive interpreting independently. To achieve the purpose, the course will offer large amount of exercises. During the exercise, real-life materials shall be used to insure the authenticity. Materials will include interview, meeting, news, and technology-related materials. The text book used isAn Intermediate Course of Interpretation (fourth edition) compiled by Mei Deming，published by Shanghai Foreign Language Education Press in 2019. Classpractice counts 30% in final evaluation，and final exam will rate70%。 Author: Zhang Chunxing Reviewer：Xu Liying Date：2022.11.12

default.zh: 本课程是专业限选课，针对具有扎实的英文和中文语言功底的学生，培养学生双语文学与文化修养和熟练的双语转换能力。通过短期学习了解同声传译基本原理和工作方法，为学生成为出色的学习、创造和合作能力的优秀翻译人才奠定基础。学生在选择此课程之前应该具有较高水平的英语听说读译能力。通过本课程学习，学生可以掌握基本的同声传译原理和技巧。经过课堂上大量的实践和讲解，能够进行初步的同声传译自主练习。但完成本课程的修习还不能达到同声传译要求，需要进行更高级别的同声传译训练。课程采取现场同传形式进行考核。
default.en: This course will lay foundation for on-site simultaneous interpreting. Students will be imparted the basics of interpretation, the background knowledge and the essential skills of simultaneous interpretation on special topics so that they can hold a good grasp of the basic principles of interpretation. Students will also be developed to the learn the methods of how to memorize what has been heard, oral presentation, note-taking and the techniques of public speeches for the purpose of the accurate and fluent bilingual interpretation of Chinese and English. The course will offer theoretical knowledge of interpretation together with practical examples. The theoretical part mainly includes the importance of interpretation, the definition and the characteristics of interpretation. Students then are instructed to simulate real-life interpreting and try to grasp essential skills at the same time. However, this course alone is not enough for Simultaneous Interpretation, it also requires further training to accomplish that. The course will test by oral interpretation.

default.zh: 由学业成绩40%和期末水平考试成绩60%构成学期总成绩。
default.en: The course adopts the cumulative assessment method, which consists of 40% of the academic performance and 60% of the final level examination score.

default.zh: 《俄语报刊选读（1）》课程是俄语专业高年级学生的专业限选课，在拓宽学生知识面和提高学生阅读能力及思辨能力方面占有重要地位。本课程向学生传授俄语政论语体的语言特点，表述规范，培养学生在了解相关政治、经济、社会等背景知识基础上阅读、分析报刊语篇的能力，使学生通过阅读拓宽视野、认知社会、提高综合素质水平。 本课程向学生传授俄语政论语言知识，俄罗斯社会、政治、经济及文化知识等，提高学生的阅读理解能力、分析能力、思维能力和社会认知能力。
default.en: Reader’s Digest of Russian newspapers （1） is a professional limited elective course for Russian senior students, and occupies an important position in broadening students' knowledge, improving students' reading ability and speculative ability. This course teaches students the language features of Russian political style and the norms of expressing, cultivates students' ability to read and analyze the language of periodicals on the basis of understanding the relevant background of political, economic and social aspects, helps students broaden their horizons, cognitive the society, and through reading improve the overall quality level. This course teaches students to learn Russian political and linguistic knowledge, Russian social, political, economic, cultural knowledge and so on. This course also promotes students' reading comprehension competence, analytical ability, thinking ability and social cognitive ability.

default.zh: 课程采用累加式考核方式，由学业成绩20%和期末水平考试成绩80%构成学期总成绩。
default.en: The course adopts the cumulative assessment method, which consists of 20% of the academic performance and 80% of the final level examination score.

default.zh: 《俄语口译（1）》是俄语专业三年级学生的专业限选课，在强化学生听力理解能力、口头表达能力，俄—汉、汉—俄快速转换能力及提高口头翻译熟练程度等方面起到重要作用。本课程采用的教材是《俄汉口译高级教程》及《俄语演讲教程》，教学内容包括俄译汉和汉译俄两部分，重点训练学生的接续传译和视阅传译能力。本课程强调技能训练，并且力求将口译技能训练与语言文化知识的学习有机地结合起来。通过大量的快速听记、俄汉互译练习，帮助学生掌握各种口译技巧，具备一定的口译能力，同时注意提高学生的听力理解能力、俄汉语口头表达能力，改善学生的知识结构，全面提升学生的知识水平和专业素养，为其学习后续课程及将来从事翻译工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Russian Interpreting （1） is a professional limited elective course for Russian grade three students, it plays an important role in strengthening students' listening comprehension, verbal communication, Russian-Chinese and Chinese-Russian rapid conversion ability and improving oral translation proficiency. The teaching materials used in this course are "Advanced Course of Russian and Chinese Interpreters" and "Russian speech course". The teaching contents include Russian translation and Chinese translation two parts, which focus on training students' continuous interpretation and reading interpreting capacity. This course emphasizes skills training, and strives to organically combine the interpreting skills training with language and cultural knowledge of learning. Students experience a large number of fast listening and Russian and Chinese translation practices, which can help students master a variety of interpretation skills, have a certain interpretation skills, and at the same time, pay attention to improving students' listening comprehension skills, Russian and Chinese oral expression skills, improving students' knowledge structure, comprehensively improving Students' knowledge and professionalism, laying a firm foundation for their follow-up courses and future translations.

default.zh: 《俄罗斯文化艺术》课程阐释相关的美学理论和艺术赏析知识，系统讲解俄罗斯艺术（绘画、音乐、戏剧、电影）发展，赏析俄罗斯具有代表性的艺术作品。通过对美学知识的传授和俄罗斯文化艺术的欣赏，使学生不仅能够了解俄罗斯文化艺术的发展脉络，掌握俄罗斯当今的文化艺术状况，而且具备一定的艺术欣赏能力，从而提高学生的人文素养。
default.en: The course "Russian Culture and Art" explains relevant aesthetic theories and art appreciation knowledge, systematically explains the development of Russian art (painting, music, drama, film), and appreciates representative Russian art works. Through the teaching of aesthetic knowledge and appreciation of Russian culture and art, students can not only understand the development of Russian culture and art, master the current state of Russian culture and art, but also have a certain ability to appreciate art, thereby improving their humanistic literacy.

default.zh: 课程采用累加式考核方式，由学业成绩40%和期末水平考试成绩60%构成学期总成绩。
default.en: The course adopts the cumulative assessment method, which consists of 40% of the academic performance and 60% of the final level examination score.

default.zh: 《俄语报刊选读（2）》是俄语专业高年级学生的专业限选课，在拓宽学生知识面和提高学生阅读能力及思辨能力方面占有重要地位。本课程向学生传授俄语政论语体的语言特点，表述规范，培养学生在了解相关政治、经济、社会等背景知识基础上阅读、分析报刊语篇的能力，使学生通过阅读拓宽视野、认知社会、提高综合素质水平。 本课程向学生传授俄语政论语言知识，俄罗斯社会、政治、经济及文化知识等，提高学生的阅读理解能力、分析能力、思维能力和社会认知能力。
default.en: Reader’s Digest of Russian newspapers（2） is a professional limited elective course for Russian senior students, and occupies an important position in broadening students' knowledge, improving students' reading ability and speculative ability. This course teaches students the language features of Russian political style and the norms of expressing, cultivates students' ability to read and analyze the language of periodicals on the basis of understanding the relevant background of political, economic and social aspects, helps students broaden their horizons, cognitive the society, and through reading improve the overall quality level. This course teaches students to learn Russian political and linguistic knowledge, Russian social, political, economic, cultural knowledge and so on. This course also promotes students' reading comprehension competence, analytical ability, thinking ability and social cognitive ability.

default.zh: 课程采用累加式考核方式，由学业成绩20%和期末水平考试成绩80%构成学期总成绩。
default.en: The course adopts the cumulative assessment method, which consists of 20% of the academic performance and 80% of the final level examination score.

default.zh: 《俄语口译（2）》是俄语专业三年级学生的专业限选课，在强化学生听力理解能力、口头表达能力，俄—汉、汉—俄快速转换能力及提高口头翻译熟练程度等方面起到重要作用。本课程强调技能训练，并且力求将口译技能训练与语言文化知识的学习有机地结合起来。通过大量的快速听记、俄汉互译练习，帮助学生掌握各种口译技巧，具备一定的口译能力，同时注意提高学生的听力理解能力、俄汉语口头表达能力，改善学生的知识结构，全面提升学生的知识水平和专业素养，为其学习后续课程及将来从事翻译工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Russian Interpreting （2） is a professional limited elective course for Russian grade three students, it plays an important role in strengthening students' listening comprehension, verbal communication, Russian-Chinese and Chinese-Russian rapid conversion ability and improving oral translation proficiency. This course emphasizes skills training, and strives to organically combine the interpreting skills training with language and cultural knowledge of learning. Students experience a large number of fast listening and translation practices between Russian and Chinese, which can help students master a variety of interpretation skills, have a certain interpretation skills, and at the same time, pay attention to improving students' listening comprehension skills, Russian and Chinese oral expression skills, improving students' knowledge structure, comprehensively improving students' knowledge and professionalism, laying a firm foundation for their follow-up courses and future translations.

default.zh: 《俄罗斯文学名著选读》是俄语专业高年级学生的专业限选课，学习对象是一部部具体的作品。这门课程给作品文本以独立的地位，强调通过作品的直接阅读，以获得俄罗斯文学的感性认识和直观感受，达到陶冶情操，提高审美趣味的目的。引领学生通过俄罗斯经典文学作品的鉴赏而提升人文素养、培养学生的文学修养和文学批评能力。同时透过文学现象理解俄罗斯文化，为进一步深入研究俄罗斯文学准备条件。本课程以俄罗斯文学发展的脉络为纲，主要选读19世纪俄罗斯文学重要发展阶段经典作家的作品（涵盖诗歌、小说），如普希金、莱蒙托夫、屠格涅夫、丘特切夫等作家的代表作品，以及20世纪卫国战争时期的诗歌。
default.en: Selected Works of Russian Literature is a specialized elective course for senior students majoring in Russian. Its focus lies in the study of specific literary works. This course accords independent status to the texts, emphasizing direct engagement with the works to cultivate a perceptual and intuitive understanding of Russian literature, thereby achieving the goals of moral edification and the enhancement of aesthetic taste. It guides students to elevate their humanistic qualities through the appreciation of Russian literary classics, fostering their literary cultivation and critical abilities. Simultaneously, it encourages an understanding of Russian culture through literary phenomena, laying the groundwork for further in-depth research into Russian literature. The course is structured along the developmental trajectory of Russian literature, primarily selecting classic works from key periods of 19th-century Russian literature (covering poetry and fiction), including representative works by writers such as Pushkin, Lermontov, Turgenev, and Tyutchev, as well as poetry from the 20th-century period of the Great Patriotic War.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练学生的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to train students' listening and oral expression abilities, comprehensively develop their Russian language ability, Russian communication ability, and comprehensive Russian application ability, improve their language expression interest, and accurately receive, understand, and output Russian information skills. Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 《科技俄语阅读（4）》是俄语专业高年级学生的必修课，在培养学生阅读能力和思辨能力方面占重要的地位。通过对计算机方面阅读材料的全面分析，使学生理解所读文章的背景知识、科学语言的词法、句法特点、语言知识等。 本课程将使学生了解计算机基础知识,开阔学生视野,渗透专业知识,为学生科技俄语语言实践积累必要的知识和术语；了解计算机及网络术语，以及计算机的结构原理；提高学生俄语专业文献阅读技巧；提高学生的阅读能力,为将来其它科技专业俄语阅读打下坚实基础。
default.en: 《Science Russian reading （4）》 is a compulsory course for senior students majoring in Russian and plays an important role in cultivating students' reading ability and speculative ability. Through the comprehensive analysis of computer reading materials, students understand the background knowledge of the article, the lexical, syntactic and linguistic knowledge of the scientific language. This course will enable students to understand the basics of computer, broaden students' vision, penetrate professional knowledge, accumulate necessary knowledge and terminology for students' technical Russian language practice; understand computer and network terminology, and computer structure principles; improve students Russian professional literature reading skills ; improve students' reading ability, lay a solid foundation for other scientific Russian reading in the future.

default.zh: 《俄语电视新闻》是俄语专业高年级学生的专业限选课，在培养学生听说和翻译能力方面占重要的地位。通过对俄语电视时事新闻和专题节目的收听、收看，学生理解所学内容的背景知识、鲜活的词汇、语言特点、新闻修辞，分析相关新闻的深层次意义。本课程将提高学生的听说能力、翻译能力、外语表述能力、欣赏水平、思维水平，为其学习后续课程，通过俄语专业八级考试打下坚实的基础。
default.en: "Russian TV News" is a professional restricted elective course for senior students majoring in Russian, and plays an important role in cultivating students' listening, speaking, and translation abilities. Through listening to and watching Russian TV current affairs news and special programs, students can understand the background knowledge, vivid vocabulary, language characteristics, and news rhetoric of the content they have learned, and analyze the deep meaning of relevant news. This course will improve students' listening and speaking ability, translation ability, foreign language expression ability, appreciation level, and thinking level, laying a solid foundation for them to learn subsequent courses and pass the Band 8 examination for Russian majors.

default.zh: 《中国文化概论》面向俄语专业大四上学期的学生，旨在培养学生用俄语传播中华优秀文化，向世界展示中国软实力的意识和能力。通过本课程的学习，学生在用外语介绍本民族文化的时候会充满信心和民族自豪感，会更加主动自觉地弘扬祖国的美好文化，能够更加理解当代中国，用外语讲好中国故事。
default.en: "Introduction to Chinese Culture" is aimed at senior students majoring in Russian in the first semester. It aims to cultivate students' awareness and ability to disseminate excellent Chinese culture in Russian and demonstrate China's soft power to the world. Through the study of this course, students will be confident and proud when introducing their own national culture in a foreign language, will be more proactive and conscious in promoting the beautiful culture of their motherland, will be able to better understand contemporary China, and tell Chinese stories well in foreign languages.

default.zh: 《俄语演讲与辩论》面向俄语专业大三下学期的学生，主要目标是发展学生的思辨能力和创新能力，同时为学生提供一个高质量的语言训练平台,培养学生的俄语语言输出能力，对俄语专业四、八级考试的口语表述和写作备考也有极大的帮助。课程以社会热点话题为主线，内容涵盖文化、科技、教育、环境、时尚等各个方面，每个话题下面拟定多个开放性议题，鼓励学生自主查找资料，分析、判断、推理、甄别，冷静思辨，逐渐能够进行逻辑缜密、论证充分、表达清晰的演讲或辩论。
default.en: "Russian Speech and Debate" is aimed at students majoring in Russian in the second semester of their junior year. Its main goal is to develop students' speculative and innovative abilities, while providing them with a high-quality language training platform to cultivate their Russian language output ability. It is also greatly helpful for the oral expression and writing preparation of the Band 4 and Band 8 exams for Russian majors. The course focuses on social hot topics, covering various aspects such as culture, technology, education, environment, and fashion. Under each topic, multiple open topics are proposed to encourage students to independently search for information, analyze, judge, reason, screen, and calmly think, gradually being able to conduct speeches or debates that are logical, fully reasoned, and clearly expressed.

default.zh: 本门课程将立足俄罗斯当代生活，从俄语母语者视角出发对俄罗斯的历史、民俗传统、文学文化、教育等多角度进行较为全面的介绍，使俄语系学生对俄罗斯国情有基本了解。
default.en: The course based on contemporary situation in Russia, gives a comprehensive introduction to Russian history, folk traditions, literature and culture, education and other aspects from the perspective of Russian native speakers, so that the junior students of the Russian Department can have a basic understanding of Russia.

default.zh: 《综合俄语1》是为中俄联合校园一年级第一学期开设的一门必修课程，旨在为刚进入大学学习俄语的零起点学生和少数有一定俄语基础的高起点学生打下扎实的语音基础，培养其基本拼写书写能力和拼读朗读能力，同时使学生掌握一定数量的俄语基本词汇和句子的用法，获取最基本的语法知识，熟练掌握最基本的语法变化形式和用法，具备初步的语言基础知识和初步的语言交际能力，掌握一般的俄罗斯国情知识，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Comprehensive Russian 1 is a professional compulsory course offered in the first semester of the first year of Sino-Russian joint campus School of Mathematics and School of Chemistry. This course aims at laying a solid foundation of voice for students who have just entered the Russian language program and a few students with a certain Russian base, developing their basic spelling writing skills and spelling reading skills, meanwhile keeping students in a certain amount of Russian basic vocabulary and the use of the sentence, getting the most basic knowledge of grammar, and master the most basic forms and usage of grammar, with the basic language knowledge and the initial communication skills, to master the general knowledge of the Russian national conditions, and finally laying a solid foundation for their follow-up courses.

default.zh: 《俄语基础语法1》是面向数学、物理专业一年级第一学期开设的一门必修课,专门讲授俄语基本语法知识。授课学时24，课程学分1。 课程旨在使数学、物理专业的学生在俄语学习之初获取最基本的俄语语法知识，构筑俄语语法知识的基本框架，熟练掌握最基本的语法变化形式、特点、用法和规则，同时了解语法规则适用的场景，促进针对语法项目而编排的句型、对话、课文等言语训练内容的学习，为俄语实践教学打下牢固的基础。
default.en: 《Basic Russian Grammer 1》is a a required Russian course offered in the first semester of the first year for the Mathematics major and Physics major freshmen. It is a major course devoted to Russian basic grammar knowledge. The teaching hours are 24, and course credit is 1. This course aims to make students acquire the most basic Russian grammar knowledge in Russian language at the beginning of Russian learning, build the basic framework of Russian grammar knowledge, master the most basic forms of grammatical changes, features, usage and rules, and meanwhile understand grammar rules applicable to the scene, to promote the learning of speech training content organized for grammar items, such as sentence pattern, dialogue, text, etc, lay a solid foundation for the Russian practice teaching.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练俄语初学者的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to comprehensively develop students' Russian language ability, Russian communication ability, and comprehensive Russian application ability by training Russian beginners' listening and oral expression abilities, and improve students' interest in language expression and skills of accurately receiving, understanding, and outputting Russian information. Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 《俄罗斯历史与文化》主要讲授俄罗斯历史和文化的基本知识，并要求课外阅读相关的参考书籍。教材选取外语教学与研究出版社出版的《俄罗斯历史》和《俄罗斯文化》，内容涵盖千余年的俄罗斯历史和文化发展。本课程主要以中文讲授，在学生具备了一定的俄语语言基础之上，辅之以俄文讲授，重点是使学生了解俄罗斯的历史与文化，同时又能对学生进行基础的俄语语言训练，全面提高学生的历史文化素养和语言能力。
default.en: "Russian History and Culture" mainly teaches the basic knowledge of Russian history and culture, and requires extra-curricular reading related reference books. The textbooks are "Russian History" and "Russian Culture" published by the Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press. The content covers more than a thousand years of Russian history and cultural development. This course is mainly taught in Chinese, on the basis that students have a certain foundation of Russian language, supplemented by Russian teaching, the focus is to enable students to understand the history and culture of Russia, and at the same time to provide students with basic Russian language training, comprehensively improve students' historical and cultural literacy and language ability.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练俄语初学者的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。

Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练学生的专业俄语听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的专业俄语语言能力、俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的专业语言表达和准确接收、理解及输出专业俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生专业俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习能力。从飞行器发动机整体结构，到发动机各个部件，以及发动机基本工作原理，本着从易到难、重点突出的原则，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项专业俄语技能，以及熟练运用专业俄语的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to train students in their professional Russian listening and speaking abilities, comprehensively develop their professional Russian language abilities and comprehensive Russian language application abilities, and improve their professional language expression and skills in accurately receiving, understanding, and outputting professional Russian information. Teach students the application ability of professional Russian language while teaching, and cultivate their self-learning ability. From the overall structure of the aircraft engine, to the various components of the engine, as well as the basic working principles of the engine, based on the principle of starting from easy to difficult and highlighting the key points, we aim to improve students' professional Russian skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to proficiently use professional Russian.

default.zh: 《俄语基础语法1》是面向化学专业一年级第一学期开设的一门必修课,专门讲授俄语基本语法知识。授课学时24，课程学分1。 课程旨在使化学专业的学生在俄语学习之初获取最基本的俄语语法知识，构筑俄语语法知识的基本框架，熟练掌握最基本的语法变化形式、特点、用法和规则，同时了解语法规则适用的场景，促进针对语法项目而编排的句型、对话、课文等言语训练内容的学习，为俄语实践教学打下牢固的基础。
default.en: 《Basic Russian Grammer 1》is a required Russian course offered in the first semester of the first year for the chemistry major freshmen. It is a major course devoted to Russian basic grammar knowledge. The teaching hours are 24, and course credits are 1. This course aims to make students acquire the most basic Russian grammar knowledge in Russian language at the beginning of Russian learning, build the basic framework of Russian grammar knowledge, master the most basic forms of grammatical changes, features, usage and rules, and meanwhile understand grammar rules applicable to the scene, to promote the learning of speech training content organized for grammar items, such as sentence pattern, dialogue, text, etc, lay a solid foundation for the Russian practice teaching.

default.zh: 《综合俄语2》是公共俄语一年级学生第二学期的课程，该课程在整个知识结构中占有重要地位。通过听说读写的全面训练，培养学生的俄语基本功，为其学习后续课程、掌握俄语的实际运用能力打下扎实的基础。本课程的主要目标是使学生在掌握综合俄语1的条件下继续学习俄语语言（语音、语法、词汇）知识，培养学生具有听、说、读、写的基本技能和初步的言语交际能力，掌握一般的俄罗斯国情知识，培养学生具有自主学习获取和更新专业知识的能力。本课程所提供的对话、课文和所涉及到的词汇主要是日常生活题材。
default.en: Comprehensive Russian 2 is a course offered in the second semester of the first year of Public Russian, which occupies an important position throughout the knowledge structure. Through the comprehensive training of listening, speaking, reading and writing, the Russian basic skills of the students are trained to lay a solid foundation for learning the follow-up courses and mastering the actual use of Russian. The main goal of this course is to enable students to continue to learn Russian language (voice, grammar, vocabulary) knowledge under the conditions of mastering Comprehensive Russian 1, and to develop students' basic skills in listening, speaking, reading and writing, initial verbal communication skills and general knowledge of Russian national conditions, to develop the ability of students to independently learn to acquire and update the professional knowledge. The conversation provided in this course, the text and the vocabulary involved are mainly the theme of daily life.

default.zh: 《俄语基础语法2》是为化工学院中俄联合培养一年级学生开设的必修课，在培养学生俄语语言基础知识方面占有重要地位。通过对俄语词类基本知识和各类句子结构模式的讲解和训练，学生要在运用各类句子模式的过程中逐步掌握和完善词的构形熟巧，并在常用的简单句和复合句句子模式的范围内，熟练进行句式转换，提高语言运用能力。本课程将使学生熟练掌握俄语语法的形态变化及基本特点，为其后续学习打下基础。
