default.en: Marketing is a new subject which mainly studies how the enterprise guides its products or services to consumers or users, and guides enterprises to develop new markets successfully.This course mainly aims to train the students to establish a correct concept of the market, theory with practice and innovation; grasp the basic theory and basic methods of marketing; exploring the law of marketing; through case analysis to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve problems.At the same time, this course can also provide the necessary theoretical guidance for marketing personnel.This course mainly includes an overview of marketing; marketing environment analysis: the analysis includes marketing and cultural environment, economic environment and political environment; Market Research; market segmentation, target market selection and market positioning; consumer behavior analysis; competitive strategy; product strategy; price strategy; channel strategy; content promotion strategy.And through the study of these content, grasp the formation and development of marketing, understand the scientific connotation of marketing and marketing management tasks. Mastering the fundamentals of marketing This theory and method have the ability to solve practical problems by using what they have learned.

default.zh: 本课程是国际经济与贸易、经济学专业的一门专业基础课，是一门融贸易业务与英语为一体的专业课，本课程主要研究如何用地道的外贸英语与外商建立关系，如何进行询盘、报盘、还盘、接受，商讨装运、支付、保险及索赔等。其主要任务是培养学生具有在业务活动中正确地使用英语的能力，以及对外进行各项业务联系和通讯活动的能力；能翻译、写出内容确切、表达得体、符合规范、语句通顺、没有语法错误的信函。本课程本着“学生的创新能力不是教出来的，也不是学出来的，而是练出来的”教学理念，“致知在格物，物格而后知至”，把实践教学贯穿于学生培养全过程，使学生学有所成、学有所用。学生可以在学习之中体验到快乐，主动学习，能够根据经济环境的具体情景灵活应用所学知识，形成高素质、强能力、善动手、易就业的优势，体现哈工大人的“规格严格，功夫到家”，并于深邃之处见素质，微细之处见功夫。
default.en: Professional English is an important specialized course, it is also an important course that mix the foreign trade business and English. This course mainly studies how to use the real foreign trade English to build the foreign relations, how to make an inquiry, offer, counter-offer, acceptance, to talk about shipment, payment, insurance and claims. Its main task is to cultivate students with the ability to use English correctly in business activities, as well as the international business relations and communication activities; So they can translate and write the business correspondence that the content is exact, the expression is proper, and it should conform to the specifications, its sentence is fluent and there are no letter grammar mistakes. This course is in line with the teaching philosophy of "the innovation ability of students is not taught, not to learn, but the practice ", "knowledge depends on the practice, we understand it after practicing", so the practice teaching is carried out through the full process of the cultivation of students, so that the students have learned something and use it. default.zh: 该课程旨在提高经济系学生的学术研究水平，同时为毕业打下良好基础。通过该课程的学习，使学生掌握研究课题选择的方式方法，掌握论文撰写的技巧，检验学生对专业知识和技能的掌握程度，使学生可以通过互联网、学校图书馆、学院资料室等途径收集和处理资料的能力，掌握本专业学科的基本研究方法和学习方法，具备提出问题、分析问题和思考问题的能力。
default.en: Research topics and thesis writing is a professional limited elective course, aimed at improving students’ academic research ability, while laying a good foundation for graduation. Through the study of this course, students can master how to choose research methods, master the skills of writing paper, test students' mastery of professional knowledge and skills, so that students can have the ability to collect and process information through the Internet and school libraries, know the basic research methods and learning methods for the subject, have the ability to ask questions, analyze problems and think about problems.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22HS32285 课程名称： 国际经济合作A 总学时： 24 理论学时： 24 实验学时：0 上机学时： 0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1.5 开课单位：社会科学学院 授课对象：经济学专业(第二学士学位) 开课学期：2秋 先修课程：国际经济学A 二、课程简介 《国际经济合作》是经济学专业学生选修的专业主干课程之一，本课程主要内容包括:重点分析国际间各种生产要素流动的客观规律，介绍西方有关国家国际经济合作的理论政策和惯例，侧重讲授当代国际经济合作发展的客观基础与巩固、主要方式、业务程序以及中国参加国际经济合作的方针政策及实务知识。通过教学，培养学生树立正确的专业思想，使其掌握各类国际经济合作项目基本理论，基本知识和基本技能，了解当代国际经济合作的运作程序，具备进行国际经济合作实践的初步能力。
default.en: Introduction to International Economic Cooperation A 1.General Information Course Code： 22HS32285 Course Title： International Economic Cooperation A Credit Hours： 24 Lecture： 24 Lab： 0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 1.5 Offering Department: Department of Economics, School of Social Sciences Students: Undergraduate majoring in Economics(Second Bachelor's Degree) Term: Fall /Second Prerequisites: International Economics A 2.Course Description International Economic Cooperation is a specialized essential course of the students majored in l economy . By means of teaching we can cultivate the student attitude towards the major make them master all kinds of basic theories, knowledge, skills of international economic cooperation. default.zh: 企业会计实务是一门重要的专业基础课，也是一门重要的入门课。主要包括必须掌握的一些财务会计基础知识与方法，如会计的基本概念与原则、会计核算的基本方法尤其是会计科目与账户的设置、借贷记账法的运用，以及有关会计的基本实务，如会计凭证的填制与审核、会计账簿的设置与登记和会计报表的编制与分析等。由于会计学原理是一门既有较强的理论性，又有很强的实践性的课程，学习时应着重掌握会计核算的各种基本方法，既要知其然，又要知其所以然，既要学会操作，又要弄清道理，要能独立地进行操作核算。本课程本着“学生的创新能力不是教出来的，也不是学出来的，而是练出来的”教学理念，“致知在格物，物格而后知至”，把实践教学贯穿于学生培养全过程，使学生学有所成、学有所用。学生可以在学习之中体验到快乐，主动学习，能够根据经济环境的具体情景灵活应用所学知识，形成高素质、强能力、善动手、易就业的优势，体现哈工大人的“规格严格，功夫到家”，并于深邃之处见素质，微细之处见功夫。
default.en: Enterprise Accounting Practice is an important specialized basic course, it is also an important elementary course. It includes some essential basic knowledge and methods such as the basic concept and principle, the basic method for the setting of accounting account, the application of debit and credit method and the basic practice for accounting, such as the filling in and checking of accounting voucher, the setting and registration of accounting books and drawing up and analysis of report forms. Because accounting is the mix of theory and practice, we should master all kinds of basic methods of accounting and know the hows and the whys. We should learn operation and the theory so that we can operate independently. This course is in line with the teaching philosophy of "the innovation ability of students is not taught, not to learn, but the practice ", "knowledge depends on the practice, we understand it after practicing", so the practice teaching is carried out through the full process of the cultivation of students, so that the students have learned something and use it. The students can experience the happiness in the learning, they take the active learning, and they can make the flexible application of knowledge according to the specific situation in the economic environment to form the advantages of high quality and strong ability to start work. It also manifests the spirit of Harbin institute of Technology, and we can see the quality in the deep place and kung fu in the fine place.

default.zh: 投资项目评估是用以培养学生吸取经济学知识的重要的专业基础课，本课程主要研究如何应用技术经济学的投资项目效果分析和决策的理论与方法，进行各种投资项目的评价和决策，以达到提高投资收益、降低投资风险、优化资源配置的目的。其主要任务是培养学生：掌握资金的等值计算的方法，并能理论联系实际，具有创新精神；掌握投资效果评价指标；了解当前关于投资评价的热点及新理论。具有准确、快速分析相关资料的能力。本课程研究的重点是对投资项目进行可靠评价，以便于在实践环节进行可行性研究。
default.en: nvestment and project appraisal is an important and basic course dedicating on students’ understanding on economics. This course mainly concerns how to apply theories and methods of the investment project evaluation analysis and decision making in the technical economics field, and how to conduct appraisal and reach decisions toward investment projects so as to meet the goals of elevating investment profit, reducing investment risks, optimizing resource allocation, etc. Its major tasks are to help students to master the method of equivalence calculation of costs in an innovative way to integrate the theories with the practice, to master the investment evaluation index system, to understand the hot topics and new theories concerning investment evaluation at present, and to possess the capability of analyzing relevant financial data accurately and promptly. The course focuses on the reliability appraisal of investment project in order to conduct the feasibility study in practical aspects.

default.zh: 在过去的四十年里，人们对供应链管理的兴趣不断增长。许多企业认识到制造成本的减少可以通过有效管理供应链来实现。随着制造业运营外包的持续增加，供应链管理的区域化和全球化也愈益凸显和重要。《供应链管理》一课从供应链管理的基本概念与理论框架入手，系统讲授供应管理，供应链协调，供应链的不确定性与风险管理，供应链集成与外包决策等内容，帮助学生掌握有效管理供应链所需的理论基础、实践工具与决策支持系统，培养学生的战略思维能力，使其能运用经济全球化的思维逻辑来把握当今和未来的商业脉动与企业经营。
default.en: Interest in supply chain management has grown over the past four decades. Many companies realize that reduction of manufacturing costs could be achieved by managing their supply chains effectively. As offshoring of manufacturing operations continue to rise, regionalization and globalization of supply chain management become more and more obvious and important. The course Supply Chain Management systematically lectures on supply management, supply chain coordination, uncertainties and risk management of supply chains, integration of supply chains and offshoring decision-makings from the basic concepts and theoretical framework of supply chain management to help students master the required theoretical basis, practical tools, and decision support systems to effectively manage supply chains, to develop students’ strategic thinking ability, so that they can use the thinking logic of SCM to grasp the current and future business pulses and enterprise managements.

default.zh: 《国际结算》是国际经济与贸易、金融等专业本科生的专业必修课程。通过本门课程的学习，学生应初步对国际结算业务有一个全面、细致的了解；能准确理解国际结算基本概念；熟知国际结算业务分类；掌握国际结算各种具体方式的适用范围、操作流程；了解国际结算相关法律；具备进行国际结算实务的理论基础。
default.en: International Settlement is a compulsory course for undergraduates majoring in international economics, trade and finance. Through the study of this course, students should initially have a comprehensive and detailed understanding of international settlement business; Can accurately understand the basic concepts of international settlement; Familiar with international settlement business classification; Master the scope of application and operation process of various specific methods of international settlement; Understanding of international settlement laws; Have a theoretical basis for international settlement practice.

default.zh: WTO规则与应用课程A 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22HS32290 课程名称： WTO规则与应用A 总学时： 24 理论学时： 24 实验学时：0 上机学时： 0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1.5 开课单位：社会科学学院 授课对象：经济学专业(第二学士学位) 开课学期：2春 先修课程：国际经济学 A 二、课程简介 《WTO规则与应用》是一门用以培养学生国际贸易知识能力的选修课，本课程将多边贸易体制（WTO）与国际贸易的实际应用结合起来，在多边贸易体制框架下讲述当代国际贸易的理论、政策措施及实践。主要培养目的是:培养理论联系实际的能力；掌握WTO与国际贸易的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，了解在多边贸易体制下国际贸易的运作程序和一般规律；把握WTO的发展趋向及其对国际贸易的影响。本课程主要讲授世界贸易组织框架下的主要规则及其应用，主要内容包括：货物贸易规则、服务贸易规则、与贸易有关的投资与知识产权保护规则、促进公平贸易规则、贸易争端解决规则、例外和保障措施规则等。
default.en: Introduction to WTO Rules and Application A 1.General Information Course Code： 22HS32290 Course Title： WTO Rules and Application A Credit Hours： 24 Lecture： 24 Lab： 0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 1.5 Offering Department: Department of Economics, School of Social Sciences Students: Undergraduate majoring in Economics(Second Bachelor's Degree) Term: Spring /Second Prerequisites: International Economics 2.Course Description WTO Rules and Application A is a selective course aimed at cultivating students’ capacity of international trade knowledge. This course combines the multilateral trading system (WTO) and the practical application of international trade, and elaborates the theory, policy and practice of the contemporary international trade under the framework of the multilateral international trading system. The main goals are: To cultivate the capacity of relating theory with practice. To grasp the basic theory, knowledge and skills of WTO and international trade and know about the operational procedures and general laws of international trade under the multilateral trading system. To grasp the trend of WTO and its effects on international trade. This course mainly tells about the rules of WTO and their application, including rules of trade in goods, rules of trade in services, rules of the trade-related investment and intellectual property rights protection, rules of promoting fair trade, rules of trade dispute settlement, rules of exception and safeguards and so on. Author: Yangzunliang Reviewer： Zhangxin Date：October 22, 2023

default.zh: 证券投资是用以培养学生吸取经济学知识的重要的专业课，本课程主要研究股票市场、债券市场和其它金融衍生市场的基本运行规律，包括证券监管的有效性分析和证券发行上市、流通的特征分析。我们在分析的过程中力求其主要任务是培养学生：掌握股票的技术分析方法和基本分析方法，并能理论联系实际，具有创新精神；掌握证券市场的基本理论、基本概念；了解当前国际证券投资的研究前沿、热点及新理论。具有准确、快速分析相关资料的能力。本课程主要研究的是证券投资工具和证券市场，以及证券的基本分析和技术分析方法。
default.en: Securities investment is an important financial course aiming to help students acquire economics knowledge. This course mainly deals with the basic operation laws governing stock market, bond market and market of other financial derivatives, including effective analysis of securities supervision and characteristics analysis of going on the market and circulation of securities. The major tasks of this course are to help students master the methods of technical analysis and basic analysis on stocks in an innovative way in integrating the theories with the practice, to master the basic theories and basic concepts concerning the securities market, to understand the research frontiers, hot topics and new theories concerning the current international securities investment, and to possess the capabilities of analyzing relevant data accurately and promptly. The course mainly focuses on securities investment tools and securities market, as well as the methods of basic analysis and technical analysis of securities.

default.zh: 经济学是诸多学科中的显学，究其原因在于经济学家是参与国家治理最广泛的一个群体，他们的思想与理论塑造了形形色色的国家经济。本课程主要讲授与评析20世纪30年代以来的西方经济学的流派和它们的奠基人，当代西方经济学学派林立，各家流派的奠基人既是睿智的学者，也是主要经济体的经济决策顾问，他们留给这个世界的既有智慧的结晶，也有实实在在的产业政策。这正是经济学统治整个世界实际证据。通过本课程的教学，向学生介绍从二战以来在国际范围内占据过主导的经济学流派以及这些流派的奠基人，让学生们知晓当今世界经济如何演化到这个模样，从而提升学生认知世界的基础能力，更好地理解习近平主席所倡导的“命运共同体”理念和“协同治理”范式，也激发学生们对社会科学的兴趣。
default.en: Economics is the most prominent subject among all the subjects. The reason is that economists deeply attend the national governance, and their thoughts and theories mould different economic systems. This course will introduce and review the dominating economic theory systems and their founders. There are so many modern economic theory systems, whose founders are sagacious scholars and economic counselors for decision-making.They give their wisdom and concrete industry policies. It is the actual evidence that economy rules this world. Through teaching, we introduce the dominant economic theory systems and their founders since the second world war. Let the students know how the world economy evolves, in order to improve their cognitive competence. Let them understand chairman Xi Jinping’s proposes which are “community with common future” and “cooperative governance”. And then, motivating students’ interest in social science.

default.zh: 网络经济学是20世纪90年代中后期伴随着网络技术的进步和信息产业的发展而产生的，它是专门研究各种网络经济运行方式的科学。网络经济学针对网络经济这一新兴现象进行探讨，从理论层面对网络经济进行剖析。本课程立足数字网络时代经济运行规律，系统讲解网络外部性、数字产品、平台经济、网络市场竞争等核心理论，剖析网络经济运行机制与政策规制逻辑，培养学生了解数字经济领域前沿发展动态和运用经济学理论分析数字经济现实问题的能力。
default.en: Network economics emerged in the mid-to-late 1990s alongside advancements in network technology and the development of the information industry. It is a discipline dedicated to studying various operational models of network economies. Focusing on the emerging phenomenon of network economies, it provides theoretical analysis of this field. This course is grounded in the economic laws of the digital network era, systematically explaining core theories such as network externalities, digital products, platform economies, and online market competition. It dissects the operational mechanisms of network economies and the logic of policy regulation, aiming to cultivate students' ability to grasp cutting-edge developments in the digital economy and apply economic theories to analyze real-world issues in this domain.

default.zh: 行为经济学是一门与心理学有机结合，通过可控实验、调查等方式考察人们在不完全理性的市场中参与各种经济活动时的行为模式，分析影响行为的内外部因素，理解并解释经济现象，以检验并修正先验理论，提出自己的理论的一门现代经济学学科。本课程主要的教学目的是：通过对本课程的主要内容即包括对行为经济学和主流经济学的比较、参照系和偏好、实验经济学的理论和方法、国内外实验结果分析等理论的学习，使学生了解并掌握行为经济学的内核是实用的经济学，它将行为分析理论与经济运行规律、心理学与经济科学有机结合起来，以发现当今经济学模型中的错误或遗漏，进而修正主流经济学关于人的理性、自利、完全信息、效用最大化及偏好一致基本假设的不足。并且通过这些内容的学习了解掌握行为经济学与传统经济学的差异；达到学校对本科毕业生培养方案规定的个性化发展课程目标。
default.en: Behavioral economics is an organic combination of psychology, through controlled experiments and investigation, investigation of people involved in various economic activities in the irrational market behavior when mode, internal and external factors affecting behavior, understand and explain the economic phenomenon, in order to test and revise the transcendental theory, put forward a modern economics discipline its own theory. The main teaching purpose of this course is: through the main content of this course, the comparison of behavioral economics and mainstream economics reference system and preference, experimental economics theories and methods at home and abroad, analysis of the experimental results including learning theory, to enable students to understand and master of behavioral economics is the kernel of practical economics,And through the study of these content, understand the difference between behavioral economics and traditional economics, to achieve the goal of personalized development curriculum stipulated by the school graduate training program.

default.zh: 知识产权法是法学专业核心主干课，是与物权法、债权法并列的专门财产法律制度。知识产权法学既是民法学科的重要分支，也是相对独立的领域法学。在知识经济时代和全球经济一体化进程中，知识产权法在经济贸易、科学技术等领域具有重要作用。知识产权法主要讲授著作权、专利权、商标权的原理和基本制度。 通过本课程的学习使学生系统掌握知识产权法的基本理论、基本制度、基本原则，培养学生运用知识产权法理论以及知识产权法律、法规、政策来分析和解决现实生活中的实际问题的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Intellectual property law is an important professional basic course ，and it is tied with Property law、law of obligations in property law system. On the one hand it is an important branch of civil law, on the other hand It is also a relatively independent field law. In the era of knowledge economy and the process of global economic integration, intellectual property law has an important function in economy and trade、science and technology and other fields. The principle and basic system of copyright, patent right and trademark right is the core of teaching. By learning the course, students can master the basic theory, the basic system and the basic principles of intellectual property law, can analyze and solve practical problems in life by using the theory、laws、regulations and policies of intellectual property law. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 物权法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是学习后续专业课如合同法、侵权行为法、亲属法与继承法等课程的基础，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述所有权、有益物权、担保物权和占有。通过对其基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握物权法方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握物权法方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括论文报告和期末考试。
default.en: Property law is a very important professional foundation course for law students, and it is the foundation for learning subsequent professional courses such as contract law, tort law, Family law, and inheritance law. It plays an important role in cultivating students' legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses ownership, beneficial property rights, security rights, and possession. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of property law, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases of property law lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, including paper reports and final exams.

default.zh: 合同法是调整市场经济关系的基本法，是民商法的重要组成部分，在社会主义市场经济中发挥着重要的作用。本课程主要讲述合同法学基本理论及合同法基本制度，使学生熟悉并掌握我国合同法律制度的内容，了解合同法在民法体系中的地位、了解合同债权与物权的区别。内容包括：合同法的概念、性质、基本原则。合同的订立、合同的成立与生效、合同的履行、变更、转让和终止、违约责任等；同时，介绍各种合同的订立履行规则。要求学生在学习本课程后，对我国的合同法制度所了解，了解并掌握合同法理论研究的前沿动向，能够娴熟运用合同法基本原理处理解决合同实务问题。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Contract law is the basic law to adjust the relation of market economy. It is an important part of civil and commercial law, and plays an important role in the socialist market economy.This course focuses on the basic theory and the basic system of Contract Law, which enable the students to be familiar with and master the contract law system of our country, to have a general idea of the status of the Contract Law in the Civil Law System, to distinguish contract creditor's rights from property rights. The content mainly include: the concept, nature and basic principles of the Contract Law; conclusion of contracts, formation and validity of contracts; performance of contracts, the amendment, assignment and termination of contracts, breach of contracts, etc.; At the same time, the course also introduces rules entering into various contracts. This course requires students to have a general understanding of the contract law system of our country, to understand and master the forefront trends of the theory of Contract Law, to apply the basic principles of the Contract Law to solve the practical problems of contracts skillfully. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 侵权责任法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是前期专业课如民法总论、物权法、合同法等课程的逆向思维课程，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要讲述侵权责任概述、侵权行为的归责原则、一般侵权行为的构成要件、侵害财产权与人身权的行为、侵权责任的方式与侵权责任的承担、数人侵权行为与责任、各类侵权责任。通过基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，使学生不仅掌握侵权责任法方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握侵权责任法方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括报告和论文。
default.en: Tort liability law is an important part of civil law，Including the concept of the infringement, tort liability law protection range，Tort liability imputation principle,Tort liability of the defense,The concept of joint tort characteristics,The specific standard of personal injury compensation with the project, The application of the mental damage compensation,The guardian, legal, education institutions, special provisions of the main responsibility, such as the Internet,The division of traffic accident tort liability and responsibility main body,The application of the medical damage compensation,Product liability,Damage caused by the animal responsibility imputation principle and responsibility main body,Environmental infringement, Objects cause person damage liability and the damage caused by the highly dangerous homework, etc.The word tort liability law sounds far away from life and seems to have nothing to do with your major, but in fact it exists in every aspect of life. The implementation of tort liability law is a blessing for the common people to protect their rights.I believe that what I have learned will be useful in my future life. The course examination results are cumulative, including paper reports and paper.

default.zh: 亲属法与继承法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述婚姻家庭关系与继承关系。通过对其基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握婚姻家庭与继承方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握婚姻家庭与继承方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括作业与论文报告。
default.en: Family law and inheritance law are very important professional foundational courses for law students, playing an important role in cultivating their legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses marriage and family relationships and inheritance relationships. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of marriage, family, and inheritance, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases related to marriage, family, and inheritance lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, homework and paper reports.

default.zh: 本课程旨在介绍商事法律体系中基本原理及商事主体法律制度、商事行为法律制度，主要包括商法总论（商法体系及渊源、商法基本原则等）、公司法、证券法、保险法、破产法。其中，商法总论与公司法、证券法、保险法是整个课程的核心内容。通过本课程的教学，使学生的民商法理论和知识得以巩固和提高，使学生掌握商事行为的具体规则，理解各行为的专业性和技术性特点，巩固和提高商事法律基本原理，能够熟练地应用商法理论去分析问题和解决问题。
default.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental principles and subject system of the commercial law and commercial conducts. Include ：the part of general introduction (business law system and it’s source、the fundamental principles, etc.) 、company law、securities acts、insurance law、bankruptcy law. Among them, the part of general introduction、company law 、securities acts and insurance law are the core of the course content.In this course, the students are required to consolidate theory and knowledge， the students are required to master the detailed rules of commercial conducts, understand the specialty and technicality, consolidate the fundamentals and heighten ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 劳动与社会保障法是法学专业核心主干课，包括劳动法和社会保障法两部分。劳动法调整劳动关系以及与劳动关系密切联系的其他关系，对协调劳动关系，促进经济发展与社会进步有重要的意义。社会保障法是与全体社会成员有着密切关系的法律，涉及社会保险、社会救助、社会福利和社会优抚等人们基本生活的诸多方面，其宗旨是保障全体社会成员的基本生活，维护社会的稳定。 通过全面学习劳动与社会保障法的基本理论、基本知识，加强学生对劳动与社会保障法的立法理念的理解，提高学生劳动与社会保障法的理论水平以及运用劳动与社会保障基本理论解决实际问题的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Labor and Social Security Law is an important professional basic course. It covers two topics: Labor Law 、Social Security Law. Labor law regulates labor relations and other relations closely related to labor relations，and it is of great significance to coordinate labor relations and promote economic development and social progress. Social security law is closely related to all social members of the law, relating to social insurance, social relief, social welfare and social care etc. The purpose of Social security law is to protect the basic life of all members of society and maintain social stability. Through teaching the basic theory and the basic knowledge of Labor and Social Security Law, we can Enhance students’ understanding of the legislative concept and the theoretical level about labor and social security law, furthermore foster the students’ ability to analyze and solve practical problems in life by using the theory of Labor and Social Security Law. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22HS32328 课程名称：国际私法A 总学时：32 理论学时：32 实验学时： 0 上机学时：0 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：2 开课单位：人文社科学部 授课对象：法学二学位 开课学期：2秋 先修课程：国际法，民法 二、课程简介（黑体、小四、加粗、段前段后0.5、行距20磅） 国际私法是以涉外民商事法律关系为调整对象，以解决法律冲突为中心任务，以冲突规范为基本规范，同时包括统一实体规范，外国人民事法律地位规范及国际民事诉讼和仲裁程序规范在内的独立的法律部门。课程以冲突法的学习为核心内容，使学生了解涉外民商事领域法律冲突是如何产生的，掌握国际私法基本规则和涉外民商事法律冲突的法律适用方法，最终达到使学生能在未来实际生活中运用上述知识解决实际问题的目的。
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22HS32328 Course Title：Private international law Credit Hours：32 Lecture：32 Lab：0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：2 Offering Department: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences Students: Second degree in law Term: Autumn, second year Prerequisites: International law, Civil law 2.Course Description Private international law is an independent legal department that takes the foreign civil and commercial legal relations as the adjustment object, takes the legal conflict as the central task, the conflict norms as the basic standard, including the unified entity norms, the civil legal status of foreigners and the international civil litigation and arbitration procedures. The course takes the study of conflict law as the core content, enabling students to understand how the legal conflicts in the field of foreign civil and commercial affairs arise, master the basic rules of international private law and the legal application methods of foreign civil and commercial laws conflict, and finally enable students to use the above knowledge to solve practical problems in the future practical life.

default.zh: 国际经济法课程是一门用以培养学生掌握国际经济法基本原理和知识的专业核心课。它是每一个法律专业学生必修课程之一。改革开放以后，中国的对外经济交往日益频繁，特别是在中国成为WTO成员后，国家更加需要涉外法律类人才。因此，国际经济法课程的基本目标是培养适应对外经济交往需要，既懂国内法、又懂国际条约和国际商业惯例的涉外专业法律人才。本课程的主要内容包括：国际经济法基础理论、《联合国国际货物买卖合同公约》、《国际贸易术语解释通则》、国际货物运输法律制度、国际贸易结算和支付法及国际投资法等。在教学过程中学生需综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关法律知识和原理，结合各种国际经济法经典案例教学，接受涉外经济法律人才所需的基本训练，为其进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事涉外经济法律工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The course of International Economic Law is a professional core course aimed at cultivating students' mastery of the basic principles and knowledge of international economic law. It is one of the mandatory courses for every law major student. After the reform and opening up, China's foreign economic exchanges have become increasingly frequent, especially after China became a member of the WTO, the country has a greater need for foreign-related legal talents. Therefore, the basic goal of the International Economic Law course is to cultivate foreign-related professional legal talents who meet the needs of foreign economic exchanges, understand both domestic law, international treaties, and international business practices. The main content of this course includes: basic theory of International Economic Law, United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods, Incoterms, legal system for international carriage of goods, international trade payment law, and International Investment Law. In the teaching process, students need to comprehensively apply the relevant legal knowledge and principles learned in the prerequisite courses, combine various classic cases of international economic law teaching, receive basic training required by foreign-related economic and legal talents, and lay a solid foundation for them to further learn relevant professional courses and engage in foreign-related economic and legal work in the future.

default.zh: 宏观经济学B以整个国民经济活动作为考察对象，以国内生产总值为切入点，主要讲授影响、决定国民收入总量的一些基本原理，以及政府依据这些规律性对经济进行调整的政策选择。重点使学生掌握宏观经济学的理论基础、了解其发展趋势及前沿热点；掌握决定国民收入的三大模型、失业与通货膨胀的关系、经济增长的基本原理与模型等内容，并能运用这些基本原理对现实经济问题进行一定的剖析。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、课后作业和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Macroeconomics B takes the whole national economic activity as the study object. Based on GDP, the students are introduced some basic principles and how the government to adjust the economy using these laws. After finishing the course, students should know the theoretical foundation, tendency and advanced studies of Macroeconomics, be familiar to the three models of national income, the relationship between unemployment and inflation, the basic principles and models of economic growth. Meanwhile we focus on cultivating students to master the basic theory of macroeconomics, to improve their ability to analyze some realistic macroeconomic problem under the scientific theory frame. The score consists of three parts: usual performance, homework and final exam .

default.zh: 西方法律思想史是一部以研究西方法律思想的产生、发展和流变为研究对象的学科，属于法学体系中的理论基础课程。本课程的教学目的在于，通过对西方法律思想演变过程的了解和掌握，扩大学生的知识视野，掌握西方两大法系的相关法律理论和制度的演变，并体验法律思想对法律制度的重要影响。
default.en: The history of Western legal thought is a discipline that focuses on studying the emergence, development, and evolution of Western legal thought, and belongs to the theoretical foundation curriculum in the legal system. The teaching purpose of this course is to broaden students' knowledge horizons, master the relevant legal theories and systems of the two major Western legal systems, and experience the important impact of legal thinking on the legal system by understanding and mastering the evolution process of Western legal thought.

default.zh: 《管理学》课程通过对管理的一般性问题的研究，致力于研究管理者如何有效地管理其所在的组织. 课程通过管理基本理论的讲授、管理基本思想的介绍和管理思维的培养来提升学生的管理悟性。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握管理的基础知识和基本理论，了解和掌握管理理论的产生、发展和作用，了解管理过程即计划、组织、领导、控制四个阶段及具体的活动内容，并结合课堂讨论和案例分析培养学生的管理思维，及综合分析和解决管理问题的能力。
default.en: "Principles of Management " is based on the research of corporate organization, and is devoted to the study of how managers can effectively manage their organization through the study of the general problems of management. The course introduces the basic theory and ideas of management and cultivates management thought for students to enhance their management savvy. Studying this course, students can master the basic knowledge and theory of management; understand and master the generation, development and function of management theory; understand the management process which has four stages: planning, organization, leadership and control and specific activities in each stage. And then, with classroom discussions, case studies and role play, the management thought of student and the ability to comprehensively analyze and address management issues can be well developed.

default.zh: 《人工智能法学概论》是一门交叉法学课程，是为培养学生人工智能与法律的相关 理论知识和应用能力而设置的选修课。本课程主要关注对人工智能的法律规制，力图将人工智能纳入法治轨道，使科技向善，技术风险可控，使学生能系统掌握与人工智能相关的法律和政策，认识人工智能带来的风险以及法律规制的必要性，熟悉人工智能在立法、执法和司法实践中的应用及影响，提高学生人工智能法学的理论水平，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: An Introduction to Artificial Intelligence Law is an interdisciplinary law course designed to cultivate students' relevant theoretical knowledge and application abilities in artificial intelligence and law. This mainly focuses on the legal regulation of artificial intelligence, aiming to incorporate artificial intelligence into the track of the rule of law, to make technology good and controllable, and enable students to systematically master the relevant laws and policies of artificial intelligence, to understand the risks brought by artificial intelligence and the necessity of legal regulation, to be familiar with application and influence of artificial intelligence in legislative, executive and judicial practice, and to improve students' theoretical level of artificial intelligence law, and to cultivate students' ability analyze and solve problems. is an interdisciplinary law course designed to cultivate students' relevant theoretical knowledge and application abilities in artificial intelligence and law. This mainly focuses on the legal regulation of artificial intelligence, aiming to incorporate artificial intelligence into the track of the rule of law, to make technology good and controllable, and enable students to systematically master the relevant laws and policies of artificial intelligence, to understand the risks brought by artificial intelligence and the necessity of legal regulation, to be familiar with application and influence of artificial intelligence in legislative, executive and judicial practice, and to improve students' theoretical level of artificial intelligence law, and to cultivate students' ability analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 法学二学位“习近平国际经济法治思想”课程简介 课程编号：HS74006 课程名称：习近平国际经济法治思想：WTO全球市场规则体系与中国实践研究 开课院系： 人文社科学部 人文社科与法学学院法律系 赵宏瑞 考核方式：课程论文PPT+课后学业进步表现 课程目标和基本要求：（200字左右） 本课程致力于打通本硕博，涵盖多学科，内涵文理交叉，培养新时代习近平法治思想下的具有人类命运共同体“文明观”的涉外法治人才。 本课程有待达成的具体目标如下： 课程目标1. 厚基础——立足习近平“统筹国内法治与涉外法治”思想，从WTO规则体系22个协定看中国经济全球发展，深化学生的具有学术功底的爱国主义。 课程目标2. 强创新——以“网络主权、数据主权、网络空间国际治理”为主线，串联WTO规则体系所塑造的世界市场、竞争规则、主权例外、治理体制，启发学生多视角、多方向、多学科交叉的数字经济规则意识。 课程主要内容：（1000~1500字） 习近平国际经济法治思想，是习近平法治思想的核心组成部分之一。随着2021年5月28日教育部印发《关于推进习近平法治思想纳入高校法治理论教学体系的通知》和2021年9月1日《习近平法治思想概论》教材出版发行，我国法学高等教育核心课程体系已经开始形成“习近平法治思想+10门核心课+特色专业必修课”的新模式。本课程以“习近平国际经济法治思想：WTO规则体系全球治理与中国改革方案”为视阈，聚焦习近平法治思想中的国际经济法治思想，将其落实到中国加入WTO后的20余年来的法治发展与实践中，分为六大模块，总括WTO规则体系22个全球性协定，总体地展示习近平在国内外讲话中引领国际经济发展的新思想、新战略、新法治、新秩序。六大模块分为： 1、导论：从习近平“改革开放是改变中国命运的关键一招”看WTO规则 2、建制：WTO构筑了全球性国际经济组织：马拉喀什协定与中国“入世” 3、市场：GATT 1947构筑的全球市场——最惠国、国民待遇等市场联通性 4、竞争：全球市场竞争规则——WTO的22个协定系统构建世界市场秩序 5、例外：贸易政策的合规与例外——国家安全例外、一般例外与长臂管辖 6、改革：WTO改革博弈——中国对全球贸易投资便利化与电子商务的引领 本课程立足国家战略，围绕全部现行有效的WTO国际经济法治规则体系，辅以阐释“文明总量理论”、“货币总量理论”、“法律总量理论”、“网络主权理论”、 “数字文明理论”、“全球合规理论”，介绍国内外代表性观点和案例，构建人类命运共同体的国际经济法治观。 本课程聚焦前沿问题，重点既在于“宽”、更在于“尖”，其难点是在“宽”与“尖”之间把握网络时代国际经济法治领域中的学术热点与前沿问题，树立以“社科总量方法论”为特色的“计算社会科学”国际化研究新范式。 本课程采用多元教学手段，组织学生提出“国际经济法与社会治理”领域中的具体问题并分组讨论、专题辩论、模拟抗辩，以提高国际经济治理的法治思维、达成课程目标。 课程主要教材： 1.习近平法治思想概论[M]，高等教育出版社. 2021-9-1. 主要参考文献： 1.WTO网站、IMF网站、WB网站、UN网站； 2.中国人大网、中国政府网； 3.[德]斯宾格勒 著，吴琼 译，《西方的没落》（全译本 全二卷），上海三联书店，2014年1月。 4.[英]阿诺德·约瑟夫·汤因比？著，[英]D·C·萨默维尔？编，郭小凌，杜挺广，梁洁 等 译，《历史研究（套装上下卷）[A Study of History]》，上海人民出版社，2010年1月。 5.[美]威尔·杜兰？著，幼狮文化公司？译，《世界文明史（全24册）》（1935-1968年首版），东方出版社，1999年1月。 6.[美]塞缪尔·P. 亨廷顿？著，周琪 等 译，《文明的冲突与世界秩序的重建（修订版）》（1996年），新华出版社，2010年1月。 7.[美]贾雷德·戴蒙德？著；？谢延光？译，《枪炮、病菌与钢铁：人类社会的命运（修订版）》（1997年），上海译文出版社，2006年4月。 8.[美]伊恩·莫里斯？著，李阳 译，《文明的度量：社会发展如何决定国家命运》（2013年），中信出版社，2014年5月。 9.[英]李约瑟 著，[英]罗南 改编，上海交通大学科学史系 译，《中华科学文明史》，上海人民出版社，2014年3月。 10.赵宏瑞: 世界文明总量论[M]，中国法制出版社. 2015；中国货币总量论[M]，中国经济出版社. 2013；网络主权论[M]，九州出版社. 2018。 11.Niall Ferguson. Civilization: The West and the Rest[M]. Penguin Group,2011. 12.Geoffrey Parsons Miller. The Law of Governance, Risk Management, And Compliance[M]. Wolters Kluwer. 2017.
default.en: Second degree in Law: Course Description on “Xi Jinping’s Rule of Law Thoughts on Intl. Economic Law” Course ID: HS74006 Teaching Department: Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, School of Humanities, Social Sciences and Law, Department of Law, Zhao Hongrui Assessment method: Course paper PPT+academic progress performance after class Course objectives and basic requirements: Taking "network sovereignty, data sovereignty, and international governance of cyberspace" as the main line, linking the world market, competition rules, sovereignty exceptions, and governance system shaped by the WTO rule system, inspiring students' awareness of digital economic rules from multiple perspectives, directions, and disciplines. Main content of the course is divided into six parts: 1.Introduction: Xi Jinping’s "Reform and opening up is a key move to change China's destiny" and the international economic system 2.Institutionalization: why WTO is the most important multilateral system from the Marrakech Agreement to China's WTO Accession Protocol 3.Marketization: GATT 1947 and the global market -- MFN and National Treatment Forge Transnational Connectivity 4.Competition: Operation Rules of the World Economy -- Global Market Order Regulated within WTO’s 22 agreements system 5.Protection: Compliance and Exceptions to International Economic Practice -- General Exceptions, National Security Exceptions and Long-Arm Jurisdiction 6.Practice: China Leads the Facilitation of Global Trade, Investment and E-Commerce -- Prospect of WTO Reform Main textbooks for the course: Introduction to Xi Jinping’s Rule of Law Thoughts[M]. Higher Education Press 2021-9-1. Main references: 1. WTO website, IMF website, WB website, UN website; 2. China National People's Congress website and China Government website; 3. [German] Spengler, translated by Wu Qiong, "The Decline of the West" (full translation in two volumes), Shanghai Sanlian Bookstore, January 2014. 4. Arnold Joseph Toynbee, edited by D.C. Somerville, translated by Guo Xiaoling, Du Tingguang, Liang Jie, et al., "A Study of History", Shanghai People's Publishing House, January 2010.

default.zh: 本课程以课堂讲授为主，采用启发式教学方式，通过案例分析和课堂讨论，激发学生的学习积极性，结合实务案例进行剖析，达到培养学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力。使学生全面系统地掌握网络空间治理及数据、信息安全法律法规的基本理论与基本知识，了解中国的网络信息安全立法和司法现状；掌握我国网络安全法、数据安全法、电子商务法、个人信息保护法等基本制度；培养和提高学生信息安全意识。通过本课程的学习，使学生在主修专业的学习及未来工作中，能够在数据活动及网络信息安全活动中，遵守相关法律法规的规定，具备在网络数据及信息安全活动中基本的法律素养，能够正确运用所学的网络法律知识，强化主修专业的网络数据信息安全从业道德规范。
default.en: This course mainly focuses on classroom teaching, and adopts heuristic teaching method, stimulates students' enthusiasm for learning through case analysis and classroom discussion, and analyzes them with practical cases, so as to cultivate students' ability to think independently, analyze and solve problems. For students to comprehensively and systematically master the basic theories and knowledge of cyberspace governance, data and information security laws and regulations, understand the legislative and judicial situation of network information security in China; master the basic systems of Chinese Cyber Security Law, Data Security Law, Electronic Commerce Law and Personal Information Protection law; cultivate and improve students' awareness of information security. Through the study of this course, In the major study and future work, students can abide by the relevant laws and regulations in data activities and network information security activities, have basic legal literacy in data and network information security activities, correctly apply the network law knowledge they have learned, and strengthen the ethics of network data information security practitioners in major majors.

default.zh: 法律社会学课程是面向法学专业（第二学士学位）的专业方向选修课程，侧重于学生对法律社会学知识的综合运用，通过社会学和法律知识的交叉运用，深入理解法律社会学的基本概念，主要理论和运行领域，使得学生通过法律分析和社会认知，确保法律制度和法治建设得以促进国家社会治理现代化。通过本课程的理论学习和案例教学，使得学生掌握法律社会学领域相关的基础知识和社会实践技能，熟悉法律社会学的理论、方法和发展趋势，深度理解法律与社会变迁、法律与社会冲突、法律与社会控制、法律与社会整合、法律与社会政策、法律与社会文化，以及法律与中国式现代化等之间的关系。
default.en: The Sociology of law course is a professional-oriented elective for law majors (second bachelor's degree) . It focuses on the integrated application of Sociology of law knowledge through the cross-fertilization of sociological and legal knowledge, an in-depth understanding of the basic concepts of Sociology of law, the main theoretical and operational areas, enables students to ensure that legal and rule-of-law development contributes to the modernization of the country's social governance through legal analysis and social cognition. Through theoretical studies and case studies, students will acquire basic knowledge and social skills related to the Sociology of law field, and become familiar with the theories, methods and trends of Sociology of law, a deep understanding of law and social change, law and social conflict, law and social control, law and social integration, law and social policy, law and social culture, and the relationship between law and chinese-style modernization.

default.zh: 法律经济学是法学与经济学的交叉学科与重要方法论，它主要是借鉴经济学的原理和方法以研究法律制度的形成、结构、过程、效率及未来发展，具有突出的实用性和鲜明的时代特色。自20世纪60年代在美国诞生以来，已汇聚而成国际性的法律经济学运动，扩展至全球不同国家和领域，展现出对法治实践的独特分析思路及广阔前景，为中国特色法律体系的构建提供了崭新视角，其借鉴作用极大。 本课程从认识法学与经济学基本原理出发，以案例分析为主要教学手段，以制度变迁与制度绩效评价为主要内容，试图通过法经济学最新研究成果的体现，使学生了解制度的重要性，人的选择与制度的关系，掌握基本分析制度的方法与完善制度的具体路径。
default.en: Legal economics is an interdisciplinary subject and a crucial methodology in the field of law and economics. It primarily draws upon economic principles and methods to examine the formation, structure, process, efficiency, and future development of legal systems. With its exceptional practicality and distinct contemporary characteristics, it has evolved into an international movement since its inception in the United States during the 1960s. This movement has expandedLegal economics is an interdisciplinary subject and a crucial methodology in the field of law and economics. It primarily draws upon economic principles and methods to examine the formation, structure, process, efficiency, and future development of legal systems. With its exceptional practicality and distinct contemporary characteristics, it has evolved into It has been extended to different countries and fields in the world, showing a unique analysis of the practice of the rule of law and broad prospects, providing a new perspective for the construction of the legal system with Chinese characteristics, and its reference is of great significance. This course starts from the understanding of the basic principles of law and economics, takes case analysis as the main teaching method, and institutional change and institutional performance evaluation as the main content. Through the embodiment of the latest research results of law and economics, it attempts to make students understand the importance of the system, the relationship between people's choice and the system, and master the basic analysis methods of the system and the specific path to improve the system.

default.zh: 《法律英语》是法学专业学生的专业选修课。它是法律科学和英语语言学有机结合而形成的一门新兴交叉学科，是专门用途英语（ESP）的重要分支之一，也是高校英语、法学等专业教学改革的新方向。随着大学英语教学改革不断深化，国内许多高校在法学、商学、国际关系等专业的本科课程中开设了法律英语，探索新的人才培养模式。本课程的基本目标是培养适应对外政治和经济交往需要，既懂国内法、国际法又懂英语的专业法律人才。本课程的主要内容包括：国际法、宪法、合同法和WTO法中的英文专业术语、短语及表达。在教学过程中学生需综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关法律知识，结合各种英文法律和判例的研读，接受涉外法律人才所需的基本学术训练，为其进一步学习有关法学专业课程和日后从事法律研究和实务工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Legal English is an elective course for law students. It is an emerging interdisciplinary field formed by the organic combination of legal science and English linguistics. It is an important branch of English for Specific Purposes (ESP) and a new direction for teaching reform in majors such as English and law in universities. With the continuous deepening of college English teaching reform, many domestic universities have opened Legal English courses in undergraduate programs such as law, business, and international relations, exploring new talent cultivation models. The basic goal of this course is to cultivate professional legal talents who are adaptable to the needs of foreign political and economic exchanges, and understand both domestic and international law as well as English. The main content of this course includes English professional terms, phrases, and expressions in international law, constitution, contract law, and WTO law. In the teaching process, students need to comprehensively apply the relevant legal knowledge learned in the prerequisite courses, combined with the study of various English laws and precedents, and receive basic academic training required by foreign-related legal talents, laying a solid foundation for their further study of relevant legal courses and future legal research and practical work.

default.zh: 计算机软件保护是面向法学专业（第二学士学位）的专业课程，侧重于学生对计算机软件保护知识的综合运用，通过工程技术和法律知识的交叉运用，深入理解软件保护的基本概念、主要方法和应用领域，使得学生通过综合运用技术手段和法律保护，确保软件的知识产权得到充分保护。通过本课程的学生，使得学生掌握计算机软件保护领域相关的基础知识和技能，熟悉计算机软件保护的理论和方法，掌握计算机软件保护涉及知识产权法律框架中的各种概念、原则和规定。
default.en: Computer Software Protection is a specialized course for law majors (second bachelor's degree), focusing on the comprehensive application of students' knowledge of computer software protection, through the cross-application of engineering technology and legal knowledge, in-depth understanding of the basic concepts, main methods and application fields of software protection, so as to make students ensure that the intellectual property rights of the software are adequately protected through the comprehensive application of technical means and legal protection. Through this course, students master the basic knowledge and skills related to the field of computer software protection, familiarize themselves with the theories and methods of computer software protection, and master the concepts, principles and provisions of the legal framework of intellectual property rights related to computer software protection.

default.zh: 文献检索课程是一门以信息源及其相关检索系统为研究对象的工具性方法课，帮助学生了解文献信息和文献检索的基本知识，掌握信息获取的正确渠道、各类型检索工具的使用方法和基本的检索技巧；培养学生的信息素养，使学生具备信息获取、评价、分析、利用的能力；增强学生信息道德意识，树立正确的世界观和价值观；培养学生自主学习和终身学习习惯，提高科研水平，达到知识、能力、素质协调发展的目的。重点内容从如下几方面展开： 1.培养良好的信息素养和信息道德：包括理解信息的本质，培养获取信息的能力和效率，掌握评价和筛选、分析、利用信息的能力。 2.文献检索基本知识：掌握一般检索工具的使用方法和检索技巧，具备获取学术文献和信息的能力；了解常用学术资源数据库和文件管理软件的使用方法。 3.知识产权基础知识：了解知识产权与创新的内在联系，知识产权保护相关法律和原则，掌握专利信息的检索、分析和利用能力，了解专利信息数据库的使用方法。
default.en: The course of Literature Retrieval and Application is a tool based method course that focuses on information sources and related retrieval systems. It helps students understand the basic knowledge of literature information and literature retrieval, master the correct channels for information acquisition, the use of various types of retrieval tools, and basic retrieval skills; Cultivate students' information literacy, enabling them to have the ability to acquire, evaluate, analyze, and utilize information; Enhance students' awareness of information ethics, establish correct worldviews and values; Cultivate students' habits of self-directed and lifelong learning, improve their research level, and achieve the goal of coordinated development of knowledge, ability, and quality. The key content will be elaborated from the following aspects: 1.Cultivate good information literacy and information ethics: including understanding the essence of information, cultivating the ability and efficiency to obtain information, and mastering the ability to evaluate, screen, analyze, and utilize information. 2.Basic knowledge of literature retrieval: Master the usage methods and retrieval skills of general retrieval tools, and have the ability to obtain academic literature and information; Understand the usage methods of commonly used academic resource databases and file management software. 3.Basic knowledge of intellectual property: Understand the inherent connection between intellectual property and innovation, relevant laws and principles of intellectual property protection, master the ability to search, analyze and utilize patent information, and understand the usage methods of patent information databases.

default.zh: 应急管理是一门融合管理学、法学、社会学、政治学、传播学、心理学和信息科学等多学科知识的新兴学科，既包括宏观层面的应急管理与决策基础理论知识，也包括应用层面的应急管理全生命周期实践过程。本课程主要对应急管理的基础理论知识和现实发展历程进行介绍，重点讲述应急管理法制体系、应急预防与准备、监测与预警、处置与救援、恢复与重建等应急管理过程。课程以文献阅读为基础，结合课堂讲授与讨论等教学方式，旨在让学生深入理解应急管理法制的基本知识和突发事件的事前、事发、事中和事后所涉及的全过程应急管理知识，并能够结合中国应急管理的实践来系统地研究国家治理体系和治理能力现代化进程中的应急管理问题，提升学生的专业素养、应急管理观念和对基本应急管理问题的处理能力，为学生以后开展应急管理领域的科研、教学、交流和社会服务奠定良好的基础。
default.en: Emergency management is an emerging discipline that integrates multi-disciplinary knowledge such as management, law, sociology, politics, communication science, psychology, and information science. It includes both the basic theoretical knowledge of emergency management and decision-making at the macro level and the practical process of the entire lifecycle of emergency management at the application level. This course mainly introduces the basic theoretical knowledge and practical development history of emergency management, focusing on the emergency management legal system, emergency management process of prevention and preparedness, monitoring and early warning, handling and rescue, recovery and reconstruction. Based on literature reading and combined with teaching methods such as classroom teaching and discussion, the course aims to enable students to have a deep understanding of the basic knowledge of emergency management legal system and the whole process of emergency management knowledge in emergencies, enable students to systematically study emergency management issues in the process of modernization of national governance system and governance capacity based on emergency management practice in China, and improve students’ professional literacy and emergency management concepts. It lays a good foundation for students to carry out scientific research, teaching, communication and social services in the field of emergency management in the future.

default.zh: 法律文书写作实训课是法学专业的一门实践课程，专注于培养学生在各类法律事务中撰写专业文书的能力。课程内容涵盖了法律文书的基础理论知识，包括其定义、特点、分类以及重要作用。同时，着重训练常用诉讼类法律文书，如刑事、民事、行政诉讼中的起诉状、答辩状、代理词等的写作技巧；也深入探讨非诉讼类法律文书，像合同、仲裁文书、法律意见书的起草与审查要点。使学生具备独立撰写基本法律文书的能力，为未来从事法律职业打下坚实基础。
default.en: It is a practical course in the law major, focusing on cultivating students' ability to write professional legal documents in various legal affairs. The course content covers the basic theoretical knowledge of legal documents, including their definitions, characteristics, classifications, and important functions. At the same time, it focuses on training the writing skills of common litigation - related legal documents, such as the writing techniques of indictments, pleadings, and representation statements in criminal, civil, and administrative litigations. It also deeply explores the drafting and review key points of non - litigation legal documents, such as contracts, arbitration documents, and legal opinions.

default.zh: 模拟法庭是法学专业（第二学位）的选修课。通过刑事诉讼控辩与审判、民事诉讼代理与审判的演练，有机地将法学理论、法律规定与司法实践结合起来，增强学生对司法程序的感性认知水平，培养基本法律实务技能，课程目标包括：1.初步掌握从事法律实务必须具备的基本思辨能力、口头表达能力、写作能力；2.具备从事法律实务工作的基本证据意识、程序意识；3.全方位培养和训练学生的法律职业素养和职业技能。
default.en: Moot court is an optional course for law majors (second degree) . Through the practice of criminal prosecution and trial, civil litigation agency and trial, it organically combines the theory of law, legal provisions and judicial practice, and enhances the students' perceptual cognition level of judicial procedure, develop basic legal skills. Objectives: 1. Have a basic grasp of the legal practice must have the basic ability to reason, oral expression, writing skills; 2. Basic awareness of evidence and procedure in legal practice; 3. To cultivate and train students' legal professional quality and professional skills in an all-round way.

default.zh: 物权法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是学习后续专业课如合同法、侵权行为法、亲属法与继承法等课程的基础，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述所有权、有益物权、担保物权和占有。通过对其基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握物权法方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握物权法方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括论文报告和期末考试。
default.en: Property law is a very important professional foundation course for law students, and it is the foundation for learning subsequent professional courses such as contract law, tort law, Family law, and inheritance law. It plays an important role in cultivating students' legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses ownership, beneficial property rights, security rights, and possession. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of property law, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases of property law lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, including paper reports and final exams.

default.zh: 侵权责任法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是前期专业课如民法总论、物权法、合同法等课程的逆向思维课程，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要讲述侵权责任概述、侵权行为的归责原则、一般侵权行为的构成要件、侵害财产权与人身权的行为、侵权责任的方式与侵权责任的承担、数人侵权行为与责任、各类侵权责任。通过基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，使学生不仅掌握侵权责任法方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握侵权责任法方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括作业和论文。
default.en: Property law is a very important professional foundation course for law students, and it is the foundation for learning subsequent professional courses such as contract law, tort law, Family law, and inheritance law. It plays an important role in cultivating students' legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses ownership, beneficial property rights, security rights, and possession. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of property law, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases of property law lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, including paper reports and final exams.

default.zh: 合同法是调整平等主体之间交易关系的法律规范的总称，是市场经济的基本法律制度。课程以讲述合同法的基本理论和基本制度为核心内容，使学生理解并掌握基本原理、具体法律制度及其相应规范，并能在实践中灵活运用，分析处理合同实务问题。主要内容包括：合同法的概念、性质、基本原则，合同的成立，合同的内容和形式，合同的效力，合同的履行，合同的保全，合同的变更和转让，合同权利义务的终止，违约责任。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Contract law is the general term for legal norms that regulate the transactional relationships between equal parties, and is the basic legal system of a market economy. This course focuses on the basic theory and the basic system of Contract Law, which enable the students to apply the basic principles of the Contract Law to solve the practical problems of contracts skillfully. The content mainly include: the concept, nature and basic principles of the Contract Law; conclusion of contracts, formation and validity of contracts; performance of contracts, the amendment, assignment and termination of contracts, breach of contracts. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 亲属法与继承法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述婚姻家庭关系与继承关系。通过对其基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握婚姻家庭与继承方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握婚姻家庭与继承方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括作业与论文报告。
default.en: Family law and inheritance law are very important professional foundational courses for law students, playing an important role in cultivating their legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses marriage and family relationships and inheritance relationships. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of marriage, family, and inheritance, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases related to marriage, family, and inheritance lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, homework and paper reports.

default.zh: 人格权法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述一般人权与具体人格权。通过对其基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握婚姻家庭与继承方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握婚姻家庭与继承方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括出勤与论文报告。
default.en: Personality Rights Law are very important professional foundational courses for law students, playing an important role in cultivating their legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses general personality rights and specific personality rights. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of personal right, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases related to personal right lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, including attendance and paper reports.

default.zh: 知识产权法属于民法学科的重要分支，是与物权法、债权法并列的财产法律制度。在知识经济时代和全球经济一体化进程中，知识产权法在经济贸易、科学技术等领域具有重要作用。知识产权法主要讲授著作权、专利权、商标权的原理和基本制度。 通过本课程的学习使学生掌握知识产权法的基本理论、基本制度，培养学生运用知识产权法理论以及知识产权法律、法规来分析和解决现实生活中的实际问题的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Intellectual property law is an important branch of the discipline of civil law, and it is tied with Property law、law of obligations in property law system. In the era of knowledge economy and the process of global economic integration, intellectual property law has an important function in economy and trade、science and technology and other fields. The principle and basic system of copyright, patent right and trademark right is the core of teaching. By learning the course, students can master the basic theory, the basic system, can analyze and solve practical problems in life by using the theory、laws、regulations and policies of intellectual property law. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 国际经济法课程是一门用以培养学生掌握国际经济法基本原理和知识的专业基础课。是高等院校中法学类专业一门主干课程。改革开放以后，中国的对外经济交往日益频繁，特别是在中国成为WTO成员后，国家更加需要涉外法律类人才。因此，国际经济法课程的基本目标是培养适应对外经济交往需要，既懂国内法、又懂国际条约和国际商业惯例的涉外专业法律人才。本课程的主要内容包括：国际经济法基础理论、《联合国国际货物买卖合同公约》、《国际贸易术语解释通则》、国际货物运输法律制度、国际贸易结算和支付法律制度等。在教学过程中学生需综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关法律知识和原理，结合各种国际经济法经典案例教学，接受涉外经济法律人才所需的基本训练，为其进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事涉外经济法律工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The course of International Economic Law is a professional fundamental course aimed at cultivating students' mastery of the basic principles and knowledge of international economic law. It is a core course for every law major student in higher education institutions. After the reform and opening up, China's foreign economic exchanges have become increasingly frequent, especially after China became a member of the WTO, the country has a greater need for foreign-related legal talents. Therefore, the basic goal of the International Economic Law course is to cultivate foreign-related professional legal talents who meet the needs of foreign economic exchanges, understand both domestic law, international treaties, and international business practices. The main content of this course includes: basic theory of International Economic Law, United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods, Incoterms, legal system for international carriage of goods, and international trade payment law. In the teaching process, students need to comprehensively apply the relevant legal knowledge and principles learned in the prerequisite courses, combine various classic cases of international economic law teaching, receive basic training required by foreign-related economic and legal talents, and lay a solid foundation for them to further learn relevant professional courses and engage in foreign-related economic and legal work in the future.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22HS32357 课程名称：法学名著导读B 总学时：16 理论学时：16 实验学时：0 上机学时：0 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1 开课单位：人文社科学部 授课对象：法学专业本科 开课学期：3春 先修课程：法理学 二、课程简介 法学名著导读课程是法律系学生的专业选修课，本门课程重点介绍一些最有重要影响的法学经典著作创作的历史背景、主要内容、主要观点，对于法学理论和法学研究发展的影响等内容。法学名著导读课程具有很强的理论性，在教学中将综合运用先修课程中所学的相关知识和技能，综合各种理论研究方法，对学生进行法律专门人才所必需的理论研究与分析基本训练，为把学生培养成为高素质的法律人才奠定基础。课程主要选取了八本从古希腊开始到20世纪90年代不同时期不同国家的代表性著作，使学生把握整个法学理论发展的变迁过程，并分析这种变迁的深刻历史和社会背景，使学生对现今法学理论发展的现状有更为客观的认识。 撰写人：李晶珠 审核人： 日 期：2025年1月9日
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code： 22HS32357 Course Title： Introduction to legal classics B Credit Hours： 16 Lecture： 16 Lab：0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：1 Offering Department: Faculty of Humanities and Social Science Students: Undergraduate students in law Term: Spring, Third year Prerequisites: jurisprudence 2.Course Description The introduction course is an elective course for law students. This course focuses on the historical background, main content and main views of some of the most important and influential legal classics, and the influence on the development of legal theory and legal research. Law classics reading course has a strong theory, in the teaching of the relevant knowledge and skills, comprehensive theoretical research methods, to the student legal specialized talents necessary theoretical research and analysis of basic training, to train students to become high-quality legal talents to lay the foundation. The course mainly selects eight representative works from ancient Greece in different periods to the 1990s, so that students can grasp the whole change process of the development of legal theory, and analyze the profound history and social background of this change, so that students can have a more objective understanding of the current situation of the development of legal theory. Author: Jingzhu Li Reviewer： Date：January 9, 2025

default.zh: 艺术文化在世间涉及范围极广，然而出现了问题是懂艺术文化的人却不懂法，有极强法律知识的法律工作者却不懂艺术里面深奥的内在，最终无法运用法律进行维护艺术。 艺术文化与单一的专利问题、单一的著作版权问题等区别较大，所以艺术法应当是有专业性、高视角的行业法，目前艺术法主要比较粗放的归为知识产权、著作法等，这样就不能细致解决规避一些问题。 艺术法最表面浅显的作用是解决关于艺术创作、艺术品收藏等领域争端，维护权益、防止触碰法律红线。艺术法的实际重任是保护民族非遗文化财富、艺术文化保护、国家文化安全的维护等问题。 通过本课程的学习，法学专业学生在法学专业中知识产权法、著作法等中的艺术文化法律行业门类有更深的认识，非法学专业学生可维护工作与创作维护己方权益、防止触碰法律底线，或有同学在今后成为国家级文化教育方面领导，在民族非遗文化艺术保护、文物保护方面有更深层的思考与决策。
default.en: Art and culture have a wide range of implications in the world, but when problems arise, those who understand art and culture do not understand the law, while legal professionals with strong legal knowledge do not understand the profound essence of art, ultimately unable to use the law to uphold art. There is a significant difference between art and culture and a single patent issue, a single copyright issue, etc. Therefore, art law should be a professional and high perspective industry law. Currently, art law is mainly broadly classified as intellectual property, copyright law, etc., which cannot solve and avoid some problems in detail. The most superficial function of art law is to resolve disputes in areas such as artistic creation and art collection, safeguard rights and interests, and prevent legal red lines from being violated. The actual responsibility of art law is to protect national intangible cultural heritage, artistic and cultural heritage, and maintain national cultural security. Through the study of this course, law students have a deeper understanding of the art, culture, and legal industry categories in intellectual property law, copyright law, and other areas of law. Non law students can protect their own rights and interests in their work and creation, and prevent them from touching the legal bottom line. Some students may become leaders in national cultural education in the future, and have deeper thinking and decision-making in the protection of national intangible cultural heritage, art, and cultural relics.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22HS32359 课程名称：国际法实务B 总学时：16 理论学时：0 实验学时：0 上机学时：0 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1 开课单位：人文社科学部 授课对象：法学专业本科 开课学期：4秋 先修课程：国际法 二、课程简介 课程服务于中国以负责任大国形象参与国际事务和构建人类命运共同体的大局。在学生掌握国际法的基本原理基础上，带领学生分析研讨国际法的原则、规范以及典型案例。通过实践案例的演示，学习运用客观的立场、观点和方法从国际法角度去研究和评判重大国际事件，提高研究国际法律问题的能力及水平，理解我国的对外政策，捍卫我国主权及国家利益。 撰写人： 李晶珠 审核人： 日 期：2025年1月9日
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22HS32359 Course Title：Practice of International Law B Credit Hours：16 Lecture：0 Lab：0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：1 Offering Department: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences Students: Undergraduate students in law Term: Autumn, Fourth year Prerequisites: International law 2.Course Description The course serves the overall situation of China participating in international affairs and building a community with a shared future for mankind as a responsible major country. On the basis of students mastering the basic principles of international law, lead students to analyze and discuss the principles, norms and typical cases of international law. Through the demonstration of practical cases, we can learn to use objective positions, viewpoints and methods to study and evaluate major international events from the perspective of international law, improve the ability and level of studying international legal issues, understand China's foreign policy, and defend China's sovereignty and national interests. Author: Jingzhu Li Reviewer： Date：January 9, 2025

default.zh: 法理学以整个法律现象的共同规律和共同性问题作为研究对象，例如，法起源、演进、变化、消亡的规律，法运行的规律，法的定义、功能、体系、价值，法律关系、法律行为、法治问题，等等。因此，法理学在法学体系中具有特殊地位，是法学的一般理论、基础理论和方法论。本课程系法理学课程的组成部分之一，主要是针对法学研究领域的基础和前沿问题，做深入的专题研究，深化学生的法学理论知识，提高学生运用理论知识分析、解决实际问题的实践能力，以及形成严谨的法律思维。本课程与本专业第一学期开设的《法理学》是前后连贯、相互配套的一个整体。学习本课程要求有较好的法律基础，同时具备相应的哲学、社会学知识，有一定的理论抽象和思维能力。
default.en: Jurisprudence focuses on the common laws and issues of the entire legal phenomenon, such as the laws of the origin, evolution, change, and extinction of law, the laws of the operation of law, the definition, function, system, value of law, legal relationships, legal acts, and issues related to the rule of law. Therefore, jurisprudence holds a special position in the legal system and is the general theory, fundamental theory, and methodology of law. This course is one of the components of the jurisprudence course, mainly focusing on the fundamental and cutting-edge issues in the field of legal research, conducting in-depth thematic research, deepening students' theoretical knowledge of law, improving their practical ability to analyze and solve practical problems using theoretical knowledge, and forming rigorous legal thinking. This course is a coherent and complementary whole with the course "Jurisprudence" offered in the first semester of this major. Studying this course requires a good legal foundation, as well as corresponding knowledge of philosophy and sociology, as well as a certain level of theoretical abstraction and thinking ability.

default.zh: 法律与社会是将法律置于社会背景之中，研究法律现象与其他社会现象的相互关系的一门社会学和法学之间的交叉学科。法律社会学既从宏观角度要研究社会的基本条件对法律制度的影响；也从微观的角度研究法律在社会中的实施过程。本课程的目的是通过对经典法社会学理论的分析和介绍，帮助学生从社会整体观念出发，认识法律的社会基础和社会作用，培养学生的法律社会学的思维方式，从而培养学生更好地利用法律的控制作用分析和解决社会问题的能力。
default.en: Law and Sociology is a cross-discipline between sociology and law that places law in the social context and studies the relationship between legal phenomena and other social phenomena. Sociology of law not only needs to study the influence of the basic conditions of society on the legal system from the macro perspective, but also studies the implementation process of the law in society from the micro perspective. The purpose of this course is to help the students understand the social and social roles of the law through the analysis and introduction of sociological theories of classical law, help students develop a legal sociology way of thinking, so as to train students to better Use legal control to analyze and solve social problems.

default.zh: 《人工智能与法律》是一门交叉法学课程，是为培养学生人工智能与法律的相关 理论知识和应用能力而设置的选修课。本课程主要关注对人工智能的法律规制，力图将人工智能纳入法治轨道，使科技向善，技术风险可控，使学生能系统掌握与人工智能相关的法律和政策，认识人工智能带来的风险以及法律规制的必要性，熟悉人工智能在立法、执法和司法实践中的应用及影响，提高学生人工智能法学的理论水平，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: AI and Law B is a powerful driving force to promote economic development and transform human society, but it also contains great risks and brings great challenges to information security, national security, human life security, legal norms and social ethics. Therefore, it is necessary to regulate artificial intelligence and form a legal system of artificial intelligence with Chinese characteristics that adapts to China's national conditions. This course mainly discusses the relationship between artificial intelligence and research paradigm of law, artificial intelligence and legislation, law enforcement and justice, artificial intelligence and departmental law, pays attention to the profound changes in the constitutional, departmental and judicial legal application fields caused by artificial intelligence, and combs and prospects the legal norms and policies in big data, artificial intelligence and other fields from a global perspective, promotes the cross research of artificial intelligence and law under the background of new liberal arts, and better grasps the transformation and development prospect of legal order in the era of artificial intelligence.

default.zh: 《环境资源法》是以环境与自然资源保护法为主要研究对象的一门新兴学科，作为法学与环境科学相结合的一门边缘性科学，具有明显的自然科学和社会科学交叉渗透的特点。本课程主要讲述环境与资源保护法基本理论和基本知识，包括环境与自然资源概念、环境与资源保护法的框架、环境与资源保护法的基本原则与基本制度、环境污染防治法律制度、自然资源法律制度、生态保护法律制度、环境法律责任以及国际环境法等内容。该课程在培养学生环境保护意识、倡导低碳、节俭的生活方式的基础上，注重提高学生扎实的法学理论基础和熟练的法律实践技能使之具备高效高质量法律服务能力和创新创业能力，胜任诉讼和非诉法律业务等各类涉环境与资源领域的法律服务工作。
default.en: Environment and resources law is based on environment and resources protection law as the main research object is an emerging discipline, as a combination of law and environmental science a borderline science, it has obvious characteristics of penetrating into natural science and social science. The course focuses on the environment and resources protection law basic theory and basic knowledge, including the concept of environment and natural resources, environment and resources protection law of the outline, the basic principles of environmental and resources protection law and basic system, the legal system for the prevention and control of environmental pollution and natural resources law, legal system of ecological protection, environmental legal liability as well as, international environmental law, etc. It is not only developing students' consciousness of environmental protection and advocating low carbon, frugal lifestyle, but also improving students' solid legal theoretical foundation and skilled legal practice skills to enable them to have efficient and high-quality legal service ability and innovation and entrepreneurship ability, competent for litigation and non-litigation legal business and other legal service in Environment and resources field.

default.zh: 本课程旨在介绍商事法律体系中基本原理及商事主体法律制度、商事行为法律制度，主要包括商法总论（商法体系及渊源、商法基本原则等）、公司法、证券法、保险法、破产法。其中，商法总论与公司法、证券法、保险法是整个课程的核心内容。通过本课程的教学，使学生们的民商法理论和知识得以巩固和提高，使学生掌握商事行为的具体规则，理解各行为的专业性和技术性特点，巩固和提高商事法律基本原理，能够熟练地应用商法理论去分析问题和解决问题。
default.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental principles and subject system of the commercial law and commercial conducts. Include ：the part of general introduction (business law system and it’s source、the fundamental principles, etc.) 、company law、securities acts、insurance law、bankruptcy law. Among them, the part of general introduction、company law 、securities acts and insurance law are the core of the course content.In this course, the students are required to consolidate theory and knowledge， the students are required to master the detailed rules of commercial conducts, understand the specialty and technicality, consolidate the fundamentals and heighten ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 西方法律思想史是一部以研究西方法律思想的产生、发展和流变为研究对象的学科，属于法学体系中的理论基础课程。本课程的教学目的在于，通过对西方法律思想演变过程的了解和掌握，扩大学生的知识视野，掌握西方两大法系的相关法律理论和制度的演变，并体验法律思想对法律制度的重要影响。
default.en: The history of Western legal thought is a discipline that focuses on studying the emergence, development, and evolution of Western legal thought, and belongs to the theoretical foundation curriculum in the legal system. The teaching purpose of this course is to broaden students' knowledge horizons, master the relevant legal theories and systems of the two major Western legal systems, and experience the important impact of legal thinking on the legal system by understanding and mastering the evolution process of Western legal thought.

default.zh: 《WTO规则与案例》课程是一门用以培养学生掌握WTO法基本原理和知识的专业选修课。中国实施改革开放政策以来，对外经济交往日益频繁，特别是在中国成为WTO成员后，国家更加需要涉外法律类人才。因此，本课程的基本目标是培养适应对外经济交往需要，既懂国内法、又懂WTO规则和国际商业惯例的涉外专业法律人才。通过综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，学生需重点掌握WTO的基本概念、基本原理和基础知识，特别是一些重要协定和经典案例的内容，学会以WTO基本理论分析案例和实践中遇到的问题，使理论真正应用于实践。本课程的主要教学内容包括：WTO的组织法（关贸总协定的产生和发展过程及WTO的建立、职能、机构、决策表决机制、宗旨及作用）、WTO的基本法律原则（最惠国待遇和国民待遇等基本法律原则及例外）、WTO的实体法（关税及非关税措施、“两反一保”等贸易救济措施的相关法律制度、服务贸易协定和与贸易有关的知识产权协定）和WTO的争端解决制度等。
default.en: The course "WTO Rules and Cases" is a professional elective course designed to cultivate students' mastery of the basic principles and knowledge of WTO law. Since China implemented the policy of reform and opening up, foreign economic exchanges have become increasingly frequent, especially after China became a member of the WTO, and the country is in greater need of foreign-related legal talents. Therefore, the basic goal of this course is to cultivate foreign-related legal professionals who meet the needs of foreign economic exchanges and understand domestic law, WTO rules, and international business practices. By comprehensively applying the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses, students need to focus on mastering the basic concepts, principles, and knowledge of the WTO, especially the content of some important agreements and classic cases. They will learn to analyze cases and problems encountered in practice based on the basic theory of the WTO, so that the theory can be truly applied to practice. The main teaching content of this course includes: the organizational law of the WTO (the emergence and development process of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, as well as the establishment, functions, institutions, decision-making and voting mechanisms, purposes and roles of the WTO), the basic legal principles of the WTO (most favored nation treatment and national treatment and exceptions), the substantive law of the WTO (relevant legal systems of tariff and non-tariff measures and trade remedies, such as "two countermeasures and one guarantee", GATS and TRIPS), the dispute settlement system of the WTO etc.

default.zh: 劳动与社会保障法包括劳动法和社会保障法两部分，对协调劳动关系，维护社会稳定，促进经济发展具有重要的意义。课程以劳动合同、劳动基准、社会保险、劳动争议处理为核心展开。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握劳动与社会保障法的基本理论、基本制度，培养学生运用理论以及法律、法规来分析和解决现实生活中的实际问题的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Labor and Social Security Law covers two topics: Labor Law and Social Security Law. It is of great significance to coordinate labor relations,maintain social stability and promote economic development. This course focuses on Labor contract, labor standards, social insurance and labor dispute resolution. By learning the course, students can master the basic theory, the basic system, can analyze and solve practical problems in life. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22HS32369 课程名称：国际私法C 总学时：16 理论学时：16 实验学时： 0 上机学时：0 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1 开课单位：人文社科学部 授课对象：法学专业本科 开课学期：3春 先修课程：国际法，民法 二、课程简介 国际私法是以涉外民商事法律关系为调整对象，以解决法律冲突为中心任务，以冲突规范为基本规范，同时包括统一实体规范，外国人民事法律地位规范及国际民事诉讼和仲裁程序规范在内的独立的法律部门。课程以冲突法的学习为核心内容，使学生了解涉外民商事领域法律冲突是如何产生的，掌握国际私法基本规则和涉外民商事法律冲突的法律适用方法，最终达到使学生能在未来实际生活中运用上述知识解决实际问题的目的。 撰写人: 李晶珠 审核人： 日 期：2025年1月9日
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22HS32369 Course Title：Private international law C Credit Hours：16 Lecture：16 Lab：0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 1 Offering Department: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences Students: Undergraduate students in Law Term: Spring, Third year Prerequisites: International law, Civil law 2.Course Description Private international law is an independent legal department that takes the foreign civil and commercial legal relations as the adjustment object, takes the legal conflict as the central task, the conflict norms as the basic standard, including the unified entity norms, the civil legal status of foreigners and the international civil litigation and arbitration procedures. The course takes the study of conflict law as the core content, enabling students to understand how the legal conflicts in the field of foreign civil and commercial affairs arise, master the basic rules of international private law and the legal application methods of foreign civil and commercial laws conflict, and finally enable students to use the above knowledge to solve practical problems in the future practical life. Author: Jingzhu Li Reviewer： Date: January 9, 2025

default.zh: 本课程内容包括中国的行政区划、地理历史、民族人口、科技教育、传统思想、民俗民生等知识。课程以课堂讲授为主，配合丰富详实的视觉资料，并进行适当讨论，使学生了解相应的中国人文与社会发展的基本情况，帮助其更好地适应在中国的学习生活，并具备深入研究专门领域的中国文化基础，以便胜任今后与中国有关的工作。
default.en: The content of this course includes China's administrative divisions, geography and history, ethnic population, science and technology education, traditional thought, folk customs and people's livelihood knowledge. The course is mainly taught in class, combined with rich and detailed visual materials and appropriate discussion, so that students can understand the basic situation of the corresponding human and social development in China, help them better adapt to the study and life in China, and have the foundation of in-depth study of Chinese culture in specialized fields, in order to be competent in the future work related to China.

default.zh: 本课程是为汉语言文学专业留学生开设的理论技能课程，目的在于让学生比较系统地了解现代汉语语法项目，把过去接触到的比较分散的语法知识整合起来，使其更加系统化，提高学生的语言表达能力，为进入高阶汉语的学习打下基础。
default.en: This course is a theoretical skills course for international students majoring in Chinese language and literature. It aims to enable students to systematically understand modern Chinese grammar items, integrate the relatively scattered grammar knowledge in the past, make it more systematic, improve students' language expression ability, and lay a foundation for advanced Chinese learning.

default.zh: 修辞，是语言运用的高级技巧。在世界各国的语言和文学中，修辞有相同的，也有不同的。汉语修辞十分复杂，因此需要系统的理论学习，本课程讲解常见的修辞方法，并进行大量的实例分析和练习，要求学生能够运用常见的修辞方法造句。本课程对提高学生的写作水平有较大的帮助。
default.en: Rhetoric is the use of high-level language skills. In the languages and literatures of different coutries in the world, rhetoric have same points, but also have some different aspects.Rhetoric of Chinese language is very complex, requiring systematic study in theories.
