This course explain the common figures of speech, and do a lot of case analysis and exercises,requiring students to be able to use common rhetoric methods to make sentences. This course will help students to improve thier writing skills.

default.zh: 《中国现当代文学》通过选读“五四”以来各个时期的优秀作品，讲解中国现当代文学史上的小说、诗歌、散文等体裁的文学作品，从而使学生了解这个时期的文学创作概况，以及重要作家的创作特色、创作成就，掌握重要的文学史常识，学会分析“精读作品”的思想艺术特色，能根据时代背景解读某一篇作品的主题内容、人物形象、艺术特色、组织结构、语言风格等，并且能够进一步独立解析教材以外的现当代文学作品的思想艺术特色。
default.en: The course “modern and contemporary literature of China” selects novels, poetry, prose and other genres of literary works in the history of modern and contemporary Chinese Literature. In the course, the students can know the profile of the literature in this period. They can understand the creation features of important writers, get the knowledge of the history of literature and analyse the ideological and artistic features of the intensive works. They can learn to interpret the thematic content, characters, artistic features, structure and language style of the work according to the background. Furthermore, they can understand the ideological and artistic features of the works outside the books by themselves.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授中国古代文学知识，使外国学生较多地了解中国优秀的文学遗产，提高对中国古代文学的阅读能力。要求学生大致了解中国古代文学的发展概况，熟悉中国古代文学的重要样式、源流变化，以及有代表性的重要作家。要求学生了解、熟悉一定数量的中国古代文学作品，并对古代作品的艺术表现特点有初步认识。在内容安排上以时代先后为序，将中国古代文学分为诗歌（词曲）、散文和小说三大类，突出重要作家作品的介绍，力求突出重点，让学生形象而具体地掌握中国古代文学的基本知识。
default.en: This course is mainly teaching the knowledge of ancient Chinese literature, so that foreign students can understand China's ancient outstanding literary heritage, and improve their reading skills. The course equire students to have an overview of the development of ancient Chinese literature, familiar with the style of ancient Chinese literature, the origins of change, as well as the important representative writer. Students must understand, familiar with a number of ancient Chinese literature works, have an initial understanding to the characters of ancient works. In the arrangement of contents, the lesson divide the ancient Chinese literature into three categories of poetry (songs), prose and fiction to the time sequence, highlighting the introduction to important writers and works, and strive to highlight the focal points ,to enable students to grasp the basic knowledge of Chinese ancient literature vividly and specifically.

default.zh: 本课程力图囊括中国传统文化的器物、制度和理念等三个主要方面。主要内容涉及中国文化的起源与发展，核心价值与主要特征，重要的科技和文化发明等。旨在通过学习本课程，可以使留学生更广泛地了解汉字、词汇和文学作品的发生与背景，从而更深刻领悟文学作品的含义。同时，作为在中国学习和生活的外国人，也有必要了解中国文化发展的历史，熟悉中华民族的民俗礼仪，从而消除生活与学习中的文化隔阂。
default.en: This course seeks to include three main aspects：the artifacts of traditional Chinese culture,institutions and ideas.The main contents involve the origin and development of Chinese culture,core values and the main features,important scientific and cultural inventions.So the students can learn the cultural background of Chinese word and literature.Then they can deeply understand the meaning of the literary works.At the same time,the students live and study in China as foreigners.It is necessary for them to understand the history of Chinese cultural and be familiar with Chinese custom and etiquette.The cultural barriers in life and study will be eliminated.

default.zh: 中华民族具有五千年的文明史，留学生对此缺乏了解。本课程概要地讲授中国从远古社会到当今的历史，重点讲授中国封建社会的形成、发展、衰落的过程，中国古代思想文化主要特点和成就，以及中华民族逐渐走向繁荣富强的历史。通过本课程，留学生对中国历史的朝代变迁、重要历史事件和人物有一个大概的了解，有助于学生学习中国的语言文学，并更深刻地理解中国文化和国情。
default.en: Foreign students lack understanding of Chinese nation’s five thousand years of history of civilization.This course is an overview of China history from ancient society to today, which focused on the formation , development and decline of China's feudal society , the main characteristics and achievements of ideology and culture in ancient China, as well as gradually moved toward the prosperity. Through this course, students can take a general understanding about dynasties of Chinese history, important historical events and figures.This course can help them to learn the Chinese language and literature, deepen the understanding of Chinese culture and national conditions.

default.zh: 本课程是为母语非汉语的留学生开设的一门专业课程。本课程拟对现当代出现于中国文坛的重要的小说进行缕析和评述，通过分析重要作家及作品进行细致解读，介绍重要的小说团体及流派，对小说流派的文化内涵和艺术风格予以概括和揭示等等。从而使大家既对中国现当代小说创作有一个概貌式的了解，又能够掌握重要作品的思想内涵和艺术特色等。 本课程的教学目的即是是让学生通过对所选小说专题的认真研读，养成文学鉴赏、评析的习惯和眼光，并引发学生思考小说与社会、小说与意识形态、经济、道德等等问题，从而实现学有所用。
default.en: This course is a professional course set up for foreign students. The course will do analysis and observations to the important novel which appeared on the contemporary literary scene in China,conducts careful reading of the important writers and works by analyzing,describes important organizations and schools.The cultural connotation of fiction genres and artistic styles will be summarized in the class. So that we can take an overview of contemporary novel in China, also be able to grasp the ideological content and artistic characteristics of the important works . The purpose of this course is to provide students with the habits of literature appreciation and assessment through carefully studing on the chosen novels,caused students to think about the questions of novel and society, novel and ideology, novle and economic, novel and moral and so on, finally they can use what they have learned.

default.zh: 电影与文学有着密切的联系，观看电影，也是学习汉语的捷径。本课程的主要目的是帮助学生了解、学习影视文学作品及提高对文学作品的分析能力。同时，选择文学作品改编的电影，可以帮助学生更简捷、快速地了解文学作品，提高留学生的文艺修养和和分析能力。
default.en: Movies are closely related to literature. Watching Movies is also a shortcut to learning Chinese. The main purpose of this course is to help students understand, learn film and television literature and improve the ability to analyze literary works. At the same time, the choice of film adaptation of literary works can help students understand literary works more simply and quickly, and improve their literary and artistic cultivation and analytical ability.

default.zh: 本课程主要包括汉字的产生与演变的历史，汉字的独特的造字方式，造字方式对识读的帮助，现代汉字的规范化要求，汉字与中国传统文化的关系等。其中汉字的六种造字法是本课程最关键最基础的内容，另外，了解汉字的结构演变和书写历史，对提高学生对汉字的兴趣、使用规范化汉语也很有裨益。因为是汉字基础课程，所以适合安排在二年级。但本课教材生字很多，听讲难度较高，所以要求学生具备较高水平的汉语听力，并在课前一定预习。从教学目标来看，要求学生通过本课程的学习，了解中国汉字的基本特点，能够熟练分析汉字造字方式，从而根据形音要素理解字的意义，并在此基础上规范地使用汉字与汉语。汉字在世界上独树一帜，其发生与使用都有鲜明特征，其历史变迁和构造方式也十分复杂，学习难度也很大。通过学习《汉字的故事》，学生学可以知晓汉字发展的历史，了解汉字的造字原理，从而更快捷地识读、记忆汉字，更深刻准确地理解汉字的字义。另外，汉字的发生演变与生活和历史有密切关系，学习汉字学，有助于了解中国文化的方方面面。
default.en: This course mainly includes the history of the emergence and evolution of Chinese characters, the unique way of making Chinese characters, the help of the way of making Chinese characters to read, the standardization requirements of modern Chinese characters, and the relationship between Chinese characters and traditional Chinese culture. Among them, the six forms of Chinese characters are the most crucial and basic content of this course. In addition, understanding the structural evolution and writing history of Chinese characters is also helpful to improve students' interest in Chinese characters and use standardized Chinese. Because it is a basic course of Chinese characters, it is suitable for the second grade. However, there are a lot of new words in this course, and it is difficult to listen to it, so students are required to have a high level of Chinese listening and preview before class. From the perspective of teaching objectives, students are required to understand the basic characteristics of Chinese characters through the study of this course, and be able to skillfully analyze the way of Chinese character formation, so as to understand the meaning of characters according to the elements of shape and sound, and on this basis, use Chinese characters and Chinese in a standardized way. Chinese character is unique in the world, its occurrence and use have distinct characteristics, its historical change and structure are also very complicated, and it is difficult to learn. By learning "The Story of Chinese Characters", students can know the history of the development of Chinese characters, understand the principle of Chinese characters, so as to read and remember Chinese characters more quickly, and understand the meaning of Chinese characters more deeply and accurately. In addition, the evolution of Chinese characters is closely related to life and history, and learning Chinese characters helps to understand all aspects of Chinese culture.

default.zh: 本课主要是普及世界文学知识兼欣赏性阅读，因此要求留学生能够了解世界文学的基本知识，能够阅读简单的文学作品，分析作品的思想内涵和艺术特点。《世界文学赏析》主要是通过对外国文学名家名著的讲解、分析，帮助学生了解世界文学史上重要作家的生平简介及创作情况，并对经典作品的情节内容、人物形象、思想主题等有较为深刻的认识；并帮助学生学会鉴赏名著的技巧。通过本课程的学习，提高学生对文学的阅读欣赏水平和分析能力，学会鉴赏并正确评价世界文学遗产，全面提高文学素养，使学生在对文学名著的阅读欣赏过程中获得思想的启迪、审美的愉快、道德的熏陶、性情的陶冶、人格的塑造等综合素质培养。
default.en: This course is mainly to popularize the knowledge of world literature and enjoy reading, so international students are required to understand the basic knowledge of world literature, read simple literary works, and analyze the ideological connotation and artistic characteristics of the works. "World Literature Appreciation" mainly through the explanation and analysis of foreign literary masterpieces, to help students understand the life and creation of important writers in the history of world literature, and to have a more profound understanding of the plot content, characters, ideological themes of classic works; And help students learn the skills of appreciating masterpieces. Through the study of this course, students can improve their reading and appreciation level and analytical ability of literature, learn to appreciate and correctly evaluate the world literary heritage, and comprehensively improve their literary literacy, so that students can obtain comprehensive quality training such as ideological enlightenment, aesthetic pleasure, moral edification, temperament cultivation and personality shaping in the process of reading and appreciating literary classics.

default.zh: 通过本课程教学介绍社会工作理论的基础部分。从社会工作理论缘起、理论流派的发展和主要的理论视角的教授和研究开始，使学生全面了解西方社会工作基础理论的内容，尤其要熟练掌握实践性理论的内涵和应用。课程以西方社会工作理论发展史为基点，通过厘清社会工作理论演进，从心理动力理论、行为理论、系统视角等几个方面介绍西方社会工作理论，内容从社会工作经典理论入手，结合中国社会工作理论发展的基础和实践经验，介绍中国社会工作理论的发端。夯实学生理论知识学习广度和深度，完善学生的知识结构。
default.en: This course will introduce the fundamental parts of social work theory. By discussion through the beginning of the social work theories, theoretical schools and some perspectives, students will understand the fundamental parts of social work theories, especially grasp the practical theories. This course will introduce from psychological dynamics, behaviors theories to the systematical perspectives by the evolution of western social work theories. Finally with Chinese practices, it will introduce the beginning of China social work theories.

default.zh: 普通心理学是研究心理学基本原理和心理现象的一般规律的心理学，是所有心理学分支的最基础和一般的学科。在普通心理学中，心理现象一般规律的研究常分为几个领域：感觉与知觉；学习与记忆；思维与言语；情感与意志；人格与个别心理特征。这些领域包括了人的心理活动的极为重要的方面。在心理学许多分支中，普通心理学占有特殊的地位。它从更广阔的理论角度来研究心理现象，是心理学的基础研究领域，对心理学的发展起重要作用，并能反映出心理学的发展水平和倾向。
default.en: General psychology is a discipline that studies the basic principles and general laws of psychological phenomena, and is the most fundamental and general discipline of all branches of psychology. In general psychology, the study of the general laws of psychological phenomena is often divided into several fields: sensation and perception; Learning and memory; Thinking and speech; Emotions and willpower; Personality and individual psychological characteristics. These fields include extremely important aspects of human psychological activity. In many branches of psychology, general psychology holds a special position. It studies psychological phenomena from a broader theoretical perspective and is a fundamental research field in psychology, playing an important role in the development of psychology and reflecting its level and tendency of development.

default.zh: 作为一个新兴的交叉学科研究领域，计算社会科学在近年来得到了来自社会科学领域的关注。本课程对计算社会科学的基础理论与研究进展进行了全面的讲述。特别地，本课程从心理学、行为学、神经科学等多学科交叉的研究视角出发，重点讲述了个体研究相关的前沿理论。同时，本课程也对实验科学的研究范式与数据分析方法进行了讲授。通过本课程，学生可以更加深入的了解计算社会科学的相关理论、作为计算社会科学基础的个体行为心理研究、以及实验科学研究方法，对传统社会学研究理论与方法形成补充。
default.en: As an emerging interdisciplinary research field, Computational Social Science has gained attention from the social science community in recent years. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the foundational theories and research advancements in Computational Social Science. Specifically, the course focuses on cutting-edge theories related to individual research from interdisciplinary perspectives, including psychology, behavioral science, and neuroscience. Additionally, the course covers research paradigms and data analysis methods in experimental science. Through this course, students will gain a deeper understanding of the relevant theories in Computational Social Science, individual behavior psychology as the foundation of Computational Social Science, and experimental research methods, which complement traditional sociological research theories and methods.

default.zh: 家庭社会学是社会学一个重要分支学科。本课程主要研究家庭的基本结构、功能及其演化的客观规律，阐释家庭和社会的相互关系以及家庭在社会中的地位与作用。 （1）通过本课程的学习，让学生了解社会学在性别、婚姻及家庭领域的相关理论，掌握家庭形态的历史发展过程和相关概念，学会用社会学理论分析性别、婚姻及家庭领域出现的社会问题。 （2）从社会学视角研究家庭，是从社会学的根本价值目标出发研究如何维系社会与家庭之间的协调关系。旨在使学生明晰是在社会发生重大变迁时去研究、探索如何避免或减少社会与家庭之间的不协调，使社会和家庭保持一种动态的平衡关系。同时，探索作为社会生活基本单位的家庭在社会影响下的演变规律，探索家庭与社会相互作用的机制及其对社会发展的影响也有重大的理论意义。
default.en: Sociology of Family is an important branch of sociology. This course mainly studies the basic structure, function, and objective laws of the evolution of the family, explains the mutual relationship between the family and society, as well as the status and role of the family in society. (1) Through the study of this course, students will understand the relevant theories of sociology in the fields of gender, marriage, and family, master the historical development process and related concepts of family forms, and learn to use sociological theories to analyze social problems that arise in the fields of gender, marriage, and family. (2) Studying the family from a sociological perspective is a study of how to maintain a harmonious relationship between society and the family from the fundamental value goals of sociology. The aim is to make it clear to students that studying and exploring how to avoid or reduce the disharmony between society and family during major social changes, and to maintain a dynamic balance between society and family. At the same time, exploring the evolution laws of the family as the basic unit of social life under social influence, exploring the mechanisms of interaction between the family and society, and its impact on social development also have significant theoretical significance.

default.zh: 社会政策是党和政府在特定时间为实现或服务于一定的社会工作和管理的目标所采取的政府行为准则，它是一系列政策、策略、法规、措施、办法、方法、规章、条例等的总称，是国家对社会公共事务实行有效管理的重要手段。同时，社会政策也是国家治理现代化的本质要求，是实现社会治理的重要路径。 通过课程的学习，希望学生能够了解社会政策的基本概念和各国社会政策的发展历史，掌握社会政策的形成、发展、调整的相关知识，并在此基础上将社会政策分析的理论和方法与社会治理相结合，从而形成实现社会治理的有效路径。
default.en: Social policy is the government code of conduct adopted by the Party and the government at a specific time to achieve or serve certain social work and management goals, it is a series of policies, strategies, regulations, measures, methods, methods, rules, regulations, etc., is an important means for the state to effectively manage social and public affairs. At the same time, social policy is also the essential requirement of national governance modernization and an important path to achieve social governance. Through the study of the course, it is hoped that students can understand the basic concepts of social policy and the development history of social policies in various countries, master the relevant knowledge of the formation, development and adjustment of social policies, and combine the theories and methods of social policy analysis with social governance on this basis, so as to form an effective path to achieve social governance.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授作为心理学与人力资源管理的交叉学科的应用心理学。一方面它是工业与组织心理学的一个分支，随着工业与组织心理学在多个方向上迅速发展，人力资源管理已经越来越成为工业与组织心理学关注的重要领域；另一方面，作为人力资源管理的一个分支，人力资源管理的前身是人事管理，当人在组织中越来越被看做“人力资源”的时候，“人事管理”也就开始逐步被“人力资源管理”所取代。本课程尝试打破基础心理学的结构框架，在简单呈现心理学研究基本程序、概念和原则的基础上，将心理学的基本知识和理论纳入到人力资源管理的各个功能模块，针对人力资源管理中的工作分析、招聘、培训、绩效、领导激励人际关系等诸方面内容分别介绍特定领域中最常涉及的心理学知识和理论。学生通过本课程的学习，可以了解和初步掌握心理学知识和理论应用到实际的基本规律和方法，进而能够把心理学理论和实践的工具方法结合起来。
default.en: This course mainly teaches applied psychology as an interdisciplinary field between psychology and human resource management. On the one hand, it is a branch of industrial and organizational psychology. With the rapid development of industrial and organizational psychology in multiple directions, human resource management has become an increasingly important field of concern in industrial and organizational psychology; On the other hand, as a branch of human resource management, the predecessor of human resource management was personnel management. As people were increasingly seen as "human resources" in organizations, "personnel management" began to be gradually replaced by "human resource management". This course attempts to break the structural framework of basic psychology. Based on a simple presentation of the basic procedures, concepts, and principles of psychological research, it incorporates the basic knowledge and theories of psychology into various functional modules of human resource management. It introduces the most commonly involved psychological knowledge and theories in specific fields, focusing on job analysis, recruitment, training, performance, leadership motivation, and interpersonal relationships in human resource management. Through the study of this course, students can understand and initially master the basic laws and methods of applying psychological knowledge and theory to practice, and then be able to combine psychological theory with practical tools and methods.

default.zh: 灾害社会治理B是一门融合管理学、社会学、政治学、传播学、心理学、法学和信息科学等多学科知识的新兴学科，既包括宏观层面的灾害社会学与灾害治理决策基础理论知识，也包括应用层面的灾害社会治理全生命周期实践过程。本课程主要对灾害社会治理的基础理论知识和现实发展历程进行介绍，重点讲述灾害与人何环境、灾害与社会、灾害与社会变迁、灾害与社会组织、灾害文化、灾害心理、灾时行为与社会秩序、灾害与信息传播、灾害社会的能动性、防灾减灾与应急管理、灾后恢复重建与可持续发展等与灾害社会治理相关的重要内容。课程以文献阅读为基础，结合课堂讲授与讨论等教学方式，旨在让学生深入理解灾害社会治理的全过程应急管理知识，并能够结合中国灾害社会治理的实践来系统地研究国家治理体系和治理能力现代化进程中的灾害社会治理问题，提升学生的专业素养、灾害治理观念和对基本灾害社会治理问题的处理能力，为学生以后开展灾害社会治理领域的科研、教学、交流和社会服务奠定良好的基础。
default.en: Disaster social governance B is an emerging discipline that integrates multi-disciplinary knowledge such as management, sociology, politics, communication science, psychology, law, and information science. It includes both the basic theoretical knowledge of disaster sociology and disaster management decision-making at the macro level, and the life-cycle practice process of disaster social governance at the application level. This course mainly introduces the basic theoretical knowledge and practical development process of disaster social governance, focusing on the disaster and human, disaster and environment, disaster and society, disaster and social change, disaster and social organization, disaster culture, disaster psychology, behavior during disaster and social order, disaster and information dissemination, initiative of disaster society, disaster prevention and reduction and emergency management, post-disaster recovery and reconstruction and sustainable development. Based on literature reading and combined with teaching methods such as classroom teaching and discussion, the course aims to enable students to have a deep understanding of the whole process of emergency management knowledge of disaster social governance, and to systematically study disaster social governance issues in the process of modernization of national governance system and governance capacity based on disaster social governance practice in China, and improve students’ professional literacy and disaster management concept and ability to deal with basic disaster social governance issues, and lay a good foundation for students to carry out scientific research, teaching, communication and social services in the field of disaster social governance in the future.

default.zh: 社会工作实务课程要求学生获得专业社会工作者具有多元技能。本课程主要内容包括总体社会工作实务、社会工作实务目标、微观、中观和宏观实务目标设定、社会工作实务的价值观，案件评估、个案工作技术和方法。要求达到学生以专业的要求帮助人们提高其解决和应对问题的能力，帮助他们获得所需的资源，促进个体与个体、群体与群体、个体和群体与环境之间的相互作用，促成组织对人们及其社会政策的影响。
default.en: Introduction to Social Work is a main course for sociology undergraduates. Social work belongs to the application-oriented social sciences with a set of scientific methods. This course mainly discusses the connotation, theoretical models, implementation methods, and the specific application of social work. It introduces the background of social work’s appearance and development. The students are required to achieve a solid proficiency in the basic concepts, theories, methods, and modes of social work that prepare them for future actual social work practices.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍人工智能与心理动力学的交叉思维与问题共识的基本问题、理论及研究方法。结合人工智能研究的视角与心理动力学知识，对人工智能演进的逻辑、个案、技术伦理与心理动力学关心的群体心理动力、群体潜意识的呈现、挫折心理与创伤心理的动力溯源等重要范畴予以分析阐释，剖析日常现象背后的心理动力机制与人工智能情境下的心理风险与认知成本。本课程的目标是使学生了解心理动力学的基本问题意识、理论框架，掌握心理动力学与人工智能的交叉分析方法，更深入的理解技术演进过程中社会现象的心理动力成因，提升对于技术思维与心理规律发生发展的认识水平，并初步掌握心理动力治疗中将潜意识意识化的动力治愈原理，并尝试将人工智能的思维范式与心理干预的一般原理和方法结合，提高学生的自我心理成长和技术思维多元延展的能力。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the basic problems, theories, and research methods of cross thinking and problem consensus between artificial intelligence and psychodynamics. Combining the perspective of artificial intelligence research and the knowledge of psychological dynamics, this paper analyzes and explains the logic, individual cases, technical ethics, and important categories of group psychological dynamics that concern the evolution of artificial intelligence, the presentation of group subconscious consciousness, and the tracing of motivation for frustration and trauma psychology. It also analyzes the psychological driving mechanisms behind daily phenomena and the psychological risks and cognitive costs in artificial intelligence contexts. The goal of this course is to enable students to understand the basic problem awareness and theoretical framework of psychodynamics, master the cross analysis methods of psychodynamics and artificial intelligence, have a deeper understanding of the causes of social phenomena in the process of technological evolution, improve their understanding of the development of technological thinking and psychological laws, and preliminarily grasp the dynamic healing principle of subconscious consciousness in psychodynamic therapy, And try to combine the thinking paradigm of artificial intelligence with the general principles and methods of psychological intervention, to improve students' ability to self psychological growth and diverse extension of technical thinking.

default.zh: 社会学名著选读关注的是社会学学科发展史上的经典著作。通过引导学生有选择地研究和阅读一些社会学经典著作，期望学生能够对近百年以来一些经典社会学名著有更具体的理解。这会最终有助于学生深入了解国外社会学研究的状况和进一步增长社会学知识，并为毕业论文及今后可能进行的研究工作进一步夯实理论基础，了解一些重要的、基础理论文献。我们试图把阅读原著融合到对社会学学派和社会学历史的发展过程的理解之中，并使对社会学名著的阅读与对其所解释的社会生活和所处的社会历史背景的理解相联系。
default.en: This course studies and introduces important sociology classics in last century. Besides an overview of western sociology development and sociology knowledge, it requires students to read them thoroughly based on their understanding of the intellectual history of sociology and the background of the book. It helps students to get a more concrete and in-deep understanding of sociology classics and social theories, which prepares them for thesis and future scholarly research.

default.zh: 社会问题选讲是一门讲授中国当代社会问题现状，并传授学生如何通过社会理论解读社会问题的专业基础课。本课程为双语教学，通过对当代主要社会问题的基本状况、特征的分析和对其进行的解读，使学生：掌握当代中国主要社会问题的特征及致使其产生的主要社会因素；掌握社会问题的主要研究方法；学会使用社会学的方法分析和解决社会问题。本课程是社会学专业的专业基础课。对于运用专业知识认识、解读社会问题的课程，其重要性在于对培养学生运用社会学理论进行实际问题分析的能力。
default.en: This is a specialized foundation and bilingual course for sociological undergraduates which discusses social problems of contemporary China. It requires the students to have a good understanding on the characteristics of major social problems in contemporary China and their social causes. The importance of this course is that it can lead students to analyze and interpret these issues using social theories and social methods acquired in this course.

default.zh: 本课程通过学习大数据、云计算、区块链、人工智能等前沿技术推动城市管理手段、管理模式、管理理念创新的实践经验，发现大数据治理从数字化到智能化再到智慧化的演进过程。了解当前我国大数据社会治理的现实需求、治理效果、政策焦点和导向，探究当前或未来政策与公众期望之间差距形成的原因，以及弥合差距的可行路径。学习基于公众满意度的大数据社会治理服务质量提升模型，认识各地方政府信息服务能力可视化程度。学习大数据社会治理创新发展的空间连通与地区互助策略，为发挥大数据和社会治理决策的科学性、推进我国大数据社会治理精细化提供有效参考。
default.en: This course discovers the evolution process of big data governance from digitalization to intelligence to intelligence by learning the practical experience of big data, cloud computing, blockchain, artificial intelligence and other cutting-edge technologies to promote the innovation of urban management methods, management models and management concepts. To understand the current practical needs, governance effects, policy focus and orientation of big data social governance in China, and to explore the reasons for the gap between current or future policies and public expectations, as well as feasible ways to bridge the gap. Learn the big data social governance service quality improvement model based on public satisfaction, and understand the visualization degree of information service capabilities of local governments. This paper will study the spatial connectivity and regional mutual assistance strategies for the innovative development of big data social governance, so as to provide an effective reference for giving full play to the scientificity of big data and social governance decision-making and promoting the refinement of big data social governance in China.

default.zh: 本课程分别从信息文明的根基——大数据引领的认知革命，人与技术的关系，人工智能发展简史，人工智能对世界经济的影响，人工智能对人类社会的影响，人工智能与人类文明的未来等几个重要的方面引领学生认识人工智能与社会发展。有助于学生思考信息文明时代一系列社会问题出现的根源、背景以及发展趋势，做出关于人工智能技术发展和智能社会建设在智识上的思考与回应。
default.en: This course guides students to understand the relationship between artificial intelligence and social development from several important aspects, including the foundation of information civilization - the cognitive revolution led by big data, the relationship between humans and technology, a brief history of artificial intelligence development, the impact of artificial intelligence on the world economy, the impact of artificial intelligence on human society, and the future of artificial intelligence and human civilization. It helps students to think about the root causes, background, and development trends of a series of social problems in the era of information civilization, and make intellectual reflections and responses on the development of artificial intelligence technology and the construction of an intelligent society.

default.zh: 随着大数据和人工智能的发展，海量数据获得的日益便易与计算技术的飞速发展推动了新闻传播学者利用计算思维来研究传播问题，从而催生了“计算传播学”这一传播学领域的新兴前沿方向。计算传播学致力于寻找传播学可计算化的基因，以传播网络分析、传播文本挖掘、数据科学等为主要分析工具，大规模地收集并分析人类传播行为数据，挖掘人类传播行为背后的模式和法则。
default.en: With the development of big data and artificial intelligence, the increasing ease of obtaining massive data and the rapid development of computing technology have promoted the use of computational thinking by journalism and communication scholars to study communication problems, thus giving birth to the emerging frontier direction of "computational communication" in the field of communication. Computational communication is committed to finding computable genes in communication, using communication network analysis, communication text mining, data science, etc. as the main analysis tools to collect and analyze data on human communication behavior on a large scale, and to explore the patterns and laws behind human communication behavior.

default.zh: 人口社会学课程是社会学的重要分支学科。主要研究和分析人口的规模、组成、分布、增减、流动、变化等人口现象，揭示人口问题和人口发展变化的规律，探寻人口发展与社会发展的关系。课程主要是培养学生掌握人口社会学基本理论、基本知识，进一步培养和提高学生的社会学理论素养和研究能力。掌握人口社会学的研究方法，具有运用定量分析方法和测量技术分析人口现象的能力。了解当今世界的人口发展态势，培养学生运用社会学理论分析阐释社会现象，进而提出应用性对策的能力。人口社会学侧重两大视角来增进对人类社会与人口问题的认识。一是结构差异性视角。人口的异质性或变异性是所有社会科学的基础。通过总体逻辑思维，通过在分组或个人特征的差异性上来研究把握总体现象。二是人口变迁视角。也是历史变迁的长时段视角。人口自身再生产有其自身的变化规律，如人口转变、人口变动周期性、人口增长惯性等等，都需要长时段的时间维度考察，而人口变迁的视角恰恰是我们把握人口变化规律的重要手段。 在社会变迁的研究中，人口学家提供了队列分析和生命历程的思路。
default.en: The Sociology for Demography, or Sociology of Population, is a sub-field of sociology, focusing on population phenomena such as size, composition, distribution, growth, movement, and change. It seeks to uncover the principles of population issues and its developmental changes, exploring the relationship between population development and social evolution. The course aims to equip students with the foundational theories and knowledge of the Sociology of Population, further nurturing and enhancing their theoretical understanding of sociology and their research capabilities. The course ensures students are well-informed about current global population development trends and nurtures their capability to apply sociological theories to interpret social phenomena, subsequently proposing practical solutions. Two main perspectives are stressed here. First, the Perspective of Structural Differences. The heterogeneity or variability of populations is fundamental to all social sciences. By employing population thinking, the discipline studies and comprehends general phenomena based on differences in group or individual characteristics. Second, the Demographic Transition Perspective. The natural reproduction of a population follows its own principles of change, such as demographic transitions, cyclical population changes, inertia of population growth, etc. All of these require a long-term time dimension for investigation. In studies of social transitions, scholars in this field offer insights through cohort analysis and the concept of the life course.

default.zh: 中国社会课程将在加强学生研究方法的训练及拓展学生研究视野的前提下，帮助学生了解中国社会发展的脉络，加深学生对中国社会的认识。一方面，本门课程结合国内外社会学发展的最新前沿成果，向学生介绍口述史、社会记忆等研究方法与研究视角，提高学生的方法论素养；另一方面，本门课程将有针对性地向学生介绍中国社会变迁研究的经典文献及主要成果，通过讲授现代中国社会的形成、当代中国的经济改革与社会变迁、政治治理与社会结构、社会生活与社会阶层等内容，使学生对中国社会、特别是当代中国社会的概貌有清晰的了解及深刻的认识。
default.en: The course will help students to understand the characteristics and development logic of Chinese society and deepen their recognitions by enhancing their proficiency in research methods and expanding their research perspectives. On the one hand, this course introduces research fields, methods and perspectives newly developed in western and domestic sociology, such as oral history and social memory, in order to improve students’ methodological attainments. On the other hand, this course provides a clear overview of contemporary society in China, by systemically introducing the selected research cases and documents on Chinese social change, and focusing on the formation of modern China, the economic reform and social change, political governance and social structure, social life and social stratification in contemporary China.

default.zh: 当代政治社会学仍是一个发展中的学科，还没有形成完全一致的体系和方法论。从一定程度上，政治社会学可以看作是用社会学的观点和方法研究政治现象的一门综合性学科。它着重研究政治系统与社会环境的相互关系，探讨政治体系在社会结构中的存在条件等。通过从社会学的角度去观察和解释政治生活，解读政治现象的社会基础。课程首先梳理政治社会学的理论根基，然后具体围绕着如下几个重要问题展开教学：政党与政治团体、革命的比较研究、政治参与与社会运动、都市政治、转型中国的政治以及风险社会的政治问题等。
default.en: Contemporary political sociology is still a developing discipline observing and analyzing political phenomena with sociological methods from sociological perspective. It has not formed a mature methodology or theory. This course mainly focuses on issues including the relationship between political system and social environment, the structural conditions of existence of political system, and so on. Generally speaking, it explains the social foundation of political phenomena. This course firstly examines the theoretical foundation of political sociology then discusses several important issues including political parties, political groups, comparative study of revolution, political participation, social movements, urban politics, risk society, and political problem in transforming China.

default.zh: 数字时代的公共治理是当前公共管理研究中的前沿领域。各种新技术为政府赋能，极大的提高了治理效率与治理效能，细化了治理精度，拓展了治理领域，在理念、组织、流程等多个领域带来了新的变革。 本课程在总结国内外现有实践创新与经验的基础上，结合理论发展，讲授数字时代公共治理过程中的数字政府组织建设、数字时代的行政程序、数据共享与开放等具体制度的完善等相关内容。
default.en: Public governance in the digital age is a frontier field in current public management research. Various new technologies have empowered the government, greatly improved governance efficiency and governance effectiveness, refined governance accuracy, expanded the field of governance, and brought new changes in concepts, organizations, processes and other fields. On the basis of summarizing the existing practical innovations and experiences at home and abroad, this course combines theoretical development to teach the construction of digital government organizations, administrative procedures in the digital era, and the improvement of specific systems such as data sharing and openness in the process of public governance in the digital era.

default.zh: 本课程将通过梳理文化概念在社会学理论中独特的地位，引导学生对文化与社会、意义与结构等社会学的基本问题进行反思；通过介绍文化社会学的理论渊源——英国文化研究与欧美的文化社会学，帮助学生把握文化社会学的学科属性；通过对符号与仪式分析、文化霸权与后殖民主义、社会分层与亚文化、时尚与消费研究、文化生产与文化接受、身体与性别文化等问题的介绍，引导学生阅读文化社会学的经典著作，帮助学生了解社会学的文化维度，通过向学生讲授文化社会学的分析方法与分析逻辑，提高学生利用社会学理论分析文化现象的能力。
default.en: This course will guide students to rethink the primary pairwise problems of sociology, such as culture and society as well as meaning and structure, by emphasizing the special position of culture in sociological theory. It will introduce British cultural studies and western cultural sociology, the origin of cultural sociology, which helps students to get intimate knowledge on the characteristics of cultural sociology. By exploring key issues of culture sociology, such as analysis of symbols and rituals, cultural hegemony, post-colonialism, subculture, research of fashion and consuming, production and reception of culture, and culture of body and gender, it requires students to understand the cultural dimension of sociology. It also requires them to read the classics of cultural sociology so as to improve their abilities to analyze cultural phenomena.

default.zh: 本课程是专业学生进入社区实习的环节，帮助学生掌握有关社区的基本知识，学会运用有关理论和方法开展社区研究、实践社区管理，引导学生探索解决当前中国城市社区发展过程中出现的问题。运用社会工作的社区工作理论与方法，实践社区工作过程，完成理论与实践的结合。
default.en: This course is the practical part of the students in undergraduate sociology program. It develops their knowledge of community acquired from Introduction to Community. It provides an opportunity to carry out community research and community management. Therefore, it leads them to explore the issues during the developing progress of urban communities in China.

default.zh: 毕业论文是学生在教师的指导下自主开展的一次具有创新性的科研活动，要求学生独立完成包括选题、文献考察、研究设计、实践调查、数据或资料分析、提出结论等一系列的具体环节，是对学生的学习及实践技能的一次全面检验。毕业论文旨在考察学生对所学的理论知识与方法知识进行综合运用的能力，评估学生对本专业的各种基础知识掌握的扎实程度以及创新应用能力。
default.en: A creative Capstone Project is needed for sociological students to obtain Bachelor degree. It consists of a series of research activities with high innovation, including proposing a selected subject of this study, fulfilling a thorough literature review in this academic sector, working out a targeted study design, conducting the social survey, collecting the information and data, analyzing the data or the interview transcription, and drawing the conclusions. Capstone Project is designed for students to examine their social investigative capacity and their capacity in using sociological theory.

default.zh: 毕业论文是学生在教师的指导下自主开展的一次具有创新性的科研活动，要求学生独立完成包括选题、文献考察、研究设计、实践调查、数据或资料分析、提出结论等一系列的具体环节，是对学生的学习及实践技能的一次全面检验。毕业论文旨在考察学生对所学的理论知识与方法知识进行综合运用的能力，评估学生对本专业的各种基础知识掌握的扎实程度以及创新应用能力。

It consists of a series of research activities with high innovation, including proposing a selected subject of this study, fulfilling a thorough literature review in this academic sector, working out a targeted study design, conducting the social survey, collecting the information and data, analyzing the data or the interview transcription, and drawing the conclusions. Capstone Project is designed for students to examine their social investigative capacity and their capacity in using sociological theory.

default.zh: 认识实习是经济学专业人才培养计划的重要组成部分，是本科教学过程中重要的实践教学环节。
default.en: Practice is an important part of the talent training plan for economics majors and an important practical teaching link in the course of undergraduate teaching.

default.zh: 毕业论文撰写是经济学专业教学计划规定的最后一个环节。通过毕业论文撰写，锻炼学生综合运用所学专业的基础理论和基本方法，对国际上以及我国对外经济贸易活动中出现的问题，对我国外经贸企业以及外贸生产企业在深化改革和经营管理中所出现的问题进行分析研究，探讨提高我国外经贸管理水平，提高企业经营管理水平的途径和方法，提出政策和措施以及改进的建议和方案，以培养学生独立分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Graduation Design is the last part of teaching plans for students major in Economic. By designing gradation thesis, the skills of using the basic theories and basic methods of major to analysis the problems exist in the international trade & China's foreign economic trade activities and to do research on the problems of China foreign trade enterprises，which are produced in the process of deepening reform and management will be exercised. To explore methods of improving the level of foreign trade and economic management and the enterprise management, meanwhile, to propose policies and measures as well as suggestions for improvement. By this way, achieve the aims that improve students’ abilities for independent analysis and solve problems.

default.zh: 毕业实习是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节。本课程从理论和实践两个方面系统的向学生介绍了进出口业务各个环节的内容、操作和技能，外经贸公司、涉外企业的经营管理工作，同时介绍了国家的国际经济与贸易政策及管理措施，及本地的国际经贸状况等内容。毕业实习的方式采取集体统一到实习基地实习与分散个人到企事业机关单位实习相结合的方式进行。具体做法如下： 1.请实习单位资深业务员担任实习教师，带领和指导学生进行实际工作。 2.在指导教师和实际部门工作人员理论讲解的基础上，实行观摩和实训活动相结合。 3.顶岗参加实习单位的业务工作，认真完成实习单位交给的工作任务。 目的在于使学生在实践中印证、巩固已学过的国际经济与贸易基本理论与技能，丰富并拓展国际经济与贸易的专业知识，明晰社会对本专业人才的需要，明确提升知识与技能的努力方向，强化认识能力、动手能力、责任意识，为今后的工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Graduation Practice is a very important practical teaching link in undergraduate teaching plan. This course introduces the contents, operation and skills of all aspects of the import and export business from the theoretical and practical aspects, and introduces the management and management of the international economy and trade of the country. Measures, and the local international economic and trade situation and so on. Graduation practice to take a unified approach to practice base practice and decentralized individuals to enterprises and institutions to practice a combination of units of the way. The specific approach is as follows: 1. Please internship unit senior salesman as an internship teacher, lead and guide students to carry out practical work. 2. In the guidance of teachers and the actual department staff on the basis of the theory, the implementation of observation and training activities combined. 3. Kong Kong to participate in the practice of business units, earnestly completed the internship to the work of the task. The purpose is to enable students to prove in practice, to consolidate the basic theory and skills of international economy and trade that have been learned, to enrich and expand the international economic and trade expertise, to clarify the needs of the professional talents and to clear the direction of knowledge and skills , To strengthen the understanding of ability, practical ability, sense of responsibility for the future work to lay a solid foundation.

default.zh: 毕业论文撰写是经济学专业教学计划规定的最后一个环节。通过毕业论文撰写，锻炼学生综合运用所学专业的基础理论和基本方法，对国际上以及我国对外经济贸易活动中出现的问题，对我国外经贸企业以及外贸生产企业在深化改革和经营管理中所出现的问题进行分析研究，探讨提高我国外经贸管理水平，提高企业经营管理水平的途径和方法，提出政策和措施以及改进的建议和方案，以培养学生独立分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Graduation Design is the last part of teaching plans for students major in Economic. By designing gradation thesis, the skills of using the basic theories and basic methods of major to analysis the problems exist in the international trade & China's foreign economic trade activities and to do research on the problems of China foreign trade enterprises，which are produced in the process of deepening reform and management will be exercised. To explore methods of improving the level of foreign trade and economic management and the enterprise management, meanwhile, to propose policies and measures as well as suggestions for improvement. By this way, achieve the aims that improve students’ abilities for independent analysis and solve problems.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是法学教育最后一个环节（毕业论文）的预备环节，为对本专业学生集中进行科学研究训练而要求学生提前独立撰写的论文。目的在于培养学生的法学研究能力，加强综合运用所学知识、理论和技能解决实际问题的训练，从总体上考查学生学习所达到的学业水平。论文题目由教师指定或由学生提出，经教师同意确定并由指导教师评分。均应是本专业学科发展或实践中提出的理论问题和实际问题。通过这一环节，应使学生受到有关科学研究选题，查阅、评述文献，制订研究方案，设计进行科学实验或社会调查，处理数据或整理调查结果，对结果进行分析、论证并得出结论，撰写论文等项初步训练。
default.en: Academic year thesis is the preparation for the last link of Legal Education (graduation thesis). It is a thesis that students are required to write independently in advance for the purpose of scientific research training. The purpose is to cultivate the students' ability of legal research, strengthen the training of comprehensively using the knowledge, theory and skills to solve practical problems, and examine the students' academic level in general. The title of the thesis is designated by the teacher or proposed by the students, and determined with the consent of the teacher and graded by the instructor. Both should be theoretical and practical problems raised in the development or practice of the discipline. Through this link, the students should receive some preliminary training, such as selecting scientific research topics, consulting and commenting literature, formulating research plans, designing scientific experiments or social surveys, processing data or sorting out survey results, analyzing and demonstrating the results, drawing conclusions, and writing papers.

default.zh: 毕业论文是法学教育的最后一个环节，为对本专业学生集中进行科学研究训练而要求学生在毕业前独立撰写的论文。目的在于培养学生的法学研究能力，加强综合运用所学知识、理论和技能解决实际问题的训练，从总体上考查学生学习所达到的学业水平。论文题目由教师指定或由学生提出，经教师同意确定。均应是本专业学科发展或实践中提出的理论问题和实际问题。通过这一环节，应使学生受到有关科学研究选题，查阅、评述文献，制订研究方案，设计进行科学实验或社会调查，处理数据或整理调查结果，对结果进行分析、论证并得出结论，撰写论文等项初步训练。学生应当认真阅读并严格遵守学校的本科论文写作规范要求。
default.en: Graduation thesis is the last link of law education, which is required to be written independently before graduation for the purpose of scientific research training. The purpose is to cultivate the students' ability of legal research, strengthen the training of comprehensively using the knowledge, theory and skills to solve practical problems, and examine the students' academic level in general. The title of the thesis shall be designated by the teacher or proposed by the students with the consent of the teacher. Both should be theoretical and practical problems raised in the development or practice of the discipline. Through this link, the students should receive some preliminary training, such as selecting scientific research topics, consulting and commenting literature, formulating research plans, designing scientific experiments or social surveys, processing data or sorting out survey results, analyzing and demonstrating the results, drawing conclusions, and writing papers. Students should carefully read and strictly abide by the University's undergraduate thesis writing requirements.

default.zh: 法务劳动教育（原法学创新研修课）是人文社科部新近开设的一门全新课程。其主要特征是限于法学领域的创新。创新既可以来自实践领域，也可以来自学术领域。法学的本质特征则鼓励学生注重实践问题的发掘，尽管学理创新同等重要。例如，一套同步而又完整的诉讼卷宗或者一份极为重要的法律文书，都是绝佳的学习和研讨样本。学生可以模拟整个法律程序或法律语境，从中发现很多有趣而又精彩的问题。在教师的指导下，学生可以学习如何阅卷、起草各类法律文书，甚至还可以集体来一次模拟法庭秀。通过本课程的学习，多数学生都可以强化阅卷、起草、沟通、协作、表达能力，而这一切，都是对一个合格法律人的基本要求。本课程的教学与考核方法也十分特殊，选课学生需要格外关注。以同步案件模拟法庭为例，教师首先要集中宣讲司法过程的主要特性、基本办案技能与注意事项，还要简述教师办案经历与诉讼背景和难点。学生代表拷贝教师制作的电子卷宗进行第一阶段的独立、集体阅卷并准备提交独立阅卷报告。随后进行第二阶段的自由分组，确定各组诉讼角色与任务，准备并提交小组报告。最后进行第三阶段的模拟法庭集体秀，表现质量按组评判。教师进行最后的总结、评价与答疑。从始至终贯彻各种实践教学法，法律实践性创新需要胆识、智慧和技能。（本课程也可以与时俱进，调整研修内容与模式，例如可进行国际司法机构进行数字法院等研修）
default.en: Legal Labor Education（Legal Innovation and Research） is a brand new course in School/Division of humanities and social sciences. Its key specific is innovation which is limited in legal fields. Innovation may come from either practice or theory. Legal science’s nature encourages students to focus on practical issues while academic ones are important either. For instance, a concurrent and total lawsuit file or an extremely important legal instrument is a very good sample for study or research. Students may stimulate the whole legal process or context to finger out many both interest and wonderful points. Guided by teachers, students may learn to read legal files, to prepare various legal instruments, and even to collectively have an excellent moot court show. Through this course most of students may enhance their legal reading, writing, communicating，coordinating and expressing skills which are basic requirements of a qualified lawyer. Students should pay attention to its teaching and studying method which is relatively special. Take a concurrent moot court for example. Teachers may collectively introduce key features of judicial process，basic lawsuit skills including attention issues, field experience of the teacher as a regarding lawyer, particular proceedings, the context, the hard points and so on. Students should copy an e-file prepared by the teacher in advance, then totally take on a reading and study task while independently preparing their own report which should be submitted finally. Following that, students should be willy divided into different groups to ensure their various poles in court while preparing their group report which should be submitted finally. Finally, all students must play a moot court show together, and scores may be made by group’s exhibition. Teachers will host a final concluding, valuing and questioning or answering stage. The whole process is filled with rich experimental teaching and study methods, and indeed, legal practical innovations need graveness, intelligence and skills. (This course can also be adjusted with the times, the content and mode of study. For example, training in digital courts for international judicial institutions)

default.zh: 毕业实习是哈尔滨工业大学人文社科学部开设的一门必修课程，也是高等院校本科教学后期的重要实践教学环节。其主要特征是，不论目标单位性质如何，必须是严格限于法学、尤其是法务领域的“实习”。法学的本质特征则鼓励学生注重实践问题的发掘，尽管学理创新同等重要。作为法学专业的毕业实习，本课程倾向于司法、仲裁等法务领域的实践。本课程的核心特征（主要教学法）是观察、体验、感悟，尤其是动手操作，强调的是对特种法律实践的确实理解和掌握。感悟之余若能顺便“动手”并有自身收益，虽属意外收获和惊喜，但也并非不可能。例如，在对“房地产交易的法制化运行”集中进行特别实践的过程中，学生很有可能直接“中介”甚至（代亲友）购买一套理想房产。很显然，这种实践的效果是无法估量的。再比如，在对“仲裁程序的法制化运行”集中进行特别实践的过程中，学生也很有可能直接协助亲友“选定”己方仲裁员，并可直接监视“独立仲裁员”指定过程的正义性。再比如，在对“庭审程序的正当化运行”集中进行特别实践的过程中，学生更有可能引导亲友如何选择好的律师，还可直接训导亲友如何谨慎表达、妥善诉讼。通过本课程的学习，多数学生都可以强化阅卷、起草、沟通、协作、表达能力，而这一切，都是对一个合格法律人的基本要求。本课程的教学与考核方法也十分特殊，选课学生需要格外关注。从始至终贯彻各种实践教学法，法律实践性认知需要胆识、智慧和耐心。
default.en: Course Description： Course Description： Graduation Field Work is both a course in HIT Law School and a very key, experimental teaching link in higher education. Its key specifics are understanding and practice which are strictly limited in legal fields regardless of the nature of unites. Legal science’s nature encourages students to focus on practical issues while academic ones are important either. As a legal course of Law School, this course is inclined to encourage students to be engaged in practice with distinguishing features of law. The key characteristics of this course are observation, experience，perception and most of all, operation, of which is a kind of sure understanding and grasp of special legal practice. If students really want to do something more, it is not impossible for them to do something real which may be a great gift or surprise to them. For instance, in process of so-called Practice of Property Transaction, students may not only understand the real situation, but also sell or buy estate through an agency for their relatives or friends or even themselves. Obviously, the effect of this kind of Practice is unimaginable and incalculable. Still more, in process of so-called Practice of Arbitration, students may not only understand the real proceedings, but also select an arbitrator for their relatives or friends or even themselves and by the way, supervise the fairness of the arrangement of an independent arbitrator. What’s more, in process of so-called Practice of Court Proceedings, students may not only understand the real particulars, but also help their relatives or friends to select a good lawyer or guide them how to rightly appear in court and deal with a lawsuit. Through this course most of students may enhance their legal reading, writing, communicating，coordinating and expressing skills which are basic requirements of a qualified lawyer. Students should pay attention to its teaching and studying method which is relatively special. The whole process is filled with rich experimental teaching and study met

default.zh: 本课程为实践类课程，面向三年级留学生，在课程设计上，以前修的听力和口语课程为基础，进一步强化日常用语和习惯用法；实行讲授与实践结合，但以实践为主。通过本课程，留学生能增强汉语交际能力和生活能力, 进一步适应中国社会，为今后的学习、生活和工作奠定基础。
default.en: This course is a practical course for third-year students. In the course design, based on the previous listening and speaking courses, it will further strengthen the daily expressions and idioms, but practice is the main thing. Through this course, foreign students can enhance the ability of Chinese communication and life, further adapt to the Chinese society, for the future study, life and work to lay the foundation.

default.zh: 本课程为实践类课程，要求理论与实践结合，但以实践为主，目的在于加深留学生对中国文化的印象和认识。《民俗劳动实践》课程包括：中国美食，可现场制作粽子、包饺子；学生可把自己在中国的生活片段拍成视频与大家分享，剪纸艺术，中国书法、中国画，品赏中国茶，学做中国结、体验汉服文化等。通过本课程，留学生能进一步了解中国文化和地方文化、民俗等，从而减少生活和学习中的文化隔阂，为今后进一步学习深造以及从事国际交流工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is a practical one, which requires the combination of theory and practice, but is mainly practical. It aims to deepen the foreign students' impression and understanding of Chinese culture.“Folk labor practice”courses include: Chinese food, can be made on-site dumplings, dumplings; students can put their life in China video clips to share with you, paper-cut art, Chinese calligraphy, Chinese painting, enjoy Chinese tea, learn to do Chinese knot, experience Hanfu culture. Through this course, foreign students can further understand the Chinese culture and local culture, folk customs, and so on, thus reducing the life and study of the cultural gap, it lays a foundation for further study and international exchange in the future.

default.zh: 作为汉语言文学专业（留学生）教育的最后一个环节，毕业论文持续时间长，实践性、互动性很强，是对留学生汉语听说读写能力的综合检验。该教学环节能够强化培养学生的文献检索和阅读能力、理论分析能力、应用写作能力和现场表达能力，可以加深留学生对中国文学和中国社会的理解和感情，并为他们本科毕业后继续攻读硕士学位或进行学术研究打下基础。 毕业论文撰写包括如下环节,即研究文献、选题开题、中期检查和毕业答辩等。整个撰写过程中，要保证程序的合理性和成果的真实性。
default.en: As a major in Chinese language and Literature at the last link of education, writing graduation thesis takes long period of time, gives practice, makes student very interactive, is good for Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing skills. The teaching can strengthen the student’s literature research and reading ability, analysis skills, writing and the expression ability, can deepen students understanding in Chinese literature and society, inspire to continue pursuing a master's degree or to build the foundation for academic research after the graduation. The graduation thesis includes the following aspects: researching literature, selecting a topic for the research, the mid-term examination and defence of the thesis. During the whole writing process one should ensure the authenticity and the rationality of procedure and results.

default.zh: 中国法律文化是中国文化知识的重要部分，是留学生了解中国社会的重要视角。通过实践课程让留学生更直接、感性、生动地接触社会，更好地理解中国社会主义法治社会的精神内涵。课程通过对中国法律文化和基本法律制度的讲授与讨论，通过法律实践部门的参观访问，提高学生的中文书面表达能力、口头表达能力和跨文化交流能力。
default.en: Chinese legal culture is an important part of Chinese cultural knowledge, and it is an important perspective for international students to understand Chinese society. Through practical courses, students can have a more direct, perceptual and vivid contact with the society, and better understand the spiritual connotation of China's socialist society ruled by law. By teaching and discussing Chinese legal culture and basic legal system, and by visiting the legal practice department, the course improves students' written writing, oral expression and cross-cultural communication skills.

default.zh: 本课程为四年级春季学期的实践类课程，在课程设置上，课堂教学与社会实践结合，但以实践为主。基于本地的历史文化和现实条件，《文学与社会实践》课程围绕中国现当代文学和中国社会生活两个方面，充分利用哈尔滨独特的历史遗迹、工业景观、市井生活和文化场所，将文本阅读置于鲜活的现实语境中。
default.en: This course is a practical course for the spring semester of fourth grade. In terms of curriculum design, classroom teaching is combined with social practice, but practice is the main focus. Based on the local historical, cultural, and current conditions, the course of "Literature and Social Practice" revolves around two aspects: Chinese modern and contemporary literature and Chinese social life. It fully utilizes Harbin's unique historical relics, industrial landscapes, urban life, and cultural venues, placing text reading in a vivid and realistic context.

default.zh: 中国经济发展实践 课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22HS33406 课程名称： 中国经济发展实践 总学时： 3周 实践学时： 3周 学分：4 开课单位：人文社科学部 授课对象：留学生本科同学 开课学期：4秋 先修课程：中国概况 二、课程简介 “中国经济发展实践”，是一门以中国经济发展历程与现实实践为核心，兼顾理论解读与案例分析的综合实践性课程。课程通过梳理关键改革节点、剖析特色经济模式，结合宏观经济数据与产业、民生领域的真实案例，帮助留学生系统理解中国经济发展的历史脉络、实践路径与核心成果，掌握中国经济发展各阶段经济特征与核心政策，理解中国特色经济模式的核心内容。通过案例分析和互动体验，帮助留学生建立对中国经济的全面认知，初步具备运用基础经济学理论分析中国经济实际问题的能力和跨文化经济观察能力。使留学生同学树立客观、全面的国际视野，认识中国经济在全球经济体系中的角色与影响；培养留学生同学尊重事实、基于数据的理性思维，形成对中国经济发展的独立判断。
default.en: Introduction to The Practice of China's Economic Development 1.General Information Course Code： 22HS33406 Course Title： The Practice of China's Economic Development Credit Hours： 3 weeks Practical: 3 weeks Credit(s)： 3 Offering Department: Department of Humanities and Social Sciences Students: Undergraduate international students Term: Fall /4 Prerequisites: Introduction to China 2.Course Description "China's Economic Development Practice" is a comprehensive practical course centered on the history and real-world practices of China's economic development, incorporating theoretical interpretation and case analysis. By examining key reform milestones, analyzing distinctive economic models, and combining macroeconomic data with real-world cases in industries and livelihood sectors, the course helps international students systematically understand the historical trajectory, practical approaches, and core achievements of China's economic development. It enables students to grasp the economic characteristics and key policies at various stages of China's development, comprehend the core elements of the Chinese economic model with distinctive features. Through case analysis and interactive experiences, the course fosters a holistic understanding of China's economy, equipping students with the ability to apply basic economic theories to analyze practical issues in China's economy and develop cross-cultural economic observation skills. This empowers international students to cultivate an objective, comprehensive global perspective, recognize China's role and influence within the global economic system; nurture a fact-based, data-driven rational mindset, and form independent judgments on China's economic development. Date: September 10, 2025

default.zh: 毕业实习是实践教学过程中的重要组成部分，要求学生进入到实习单位中，确实体验社会生活，在实习中做到理论联系实际，加深对所学专业的感性认识，巩固和提高所学的基础理论及专业知识。同时，在实习中获得实际知识和实际工作技能并培养独立工作和解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Graduation Practices play a very important role in practice teaching system. It usually happens in the last term. Every student is required to work in some organization to finish his/her internship. In this period, they can deal with some real problems using their acquired sociological knowledge. Consequently, they will have deep understanding of sociological theories. Meanwhile, they can acquire more practical knowledge and skills to fulfill work in an even better fashion in the future.

default.zh: 电路与信号处理（2）是电子类、信息类等专业的重要专业基础课，是一门理论性较强的课程。本课程以离散傅里叶变换和数字滤波器为重点，强调离散时间信号和系统的基本理论和分析方法，强调理论与实践、原理与应用相结合。 课程主要内容为：采样定理及其应用；离散时间信号和系统在时域、频域和z域的分析方法；离散傅里叶变换的概念、计算及其应用；数字滤波器的结构、IIR滤波器和FIR滤波器的设计原理。 本课程旨在奠定学生在数字信号处理领域的基本理论基础，通过理论知识与应用方法的有机结合，培养学生利用数字信号处理方法解决实际问题的能力。为学生未来从事电子、信息及相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要的基础。
default.en: Circuits and Signal Processing (2) is a professional basic course for students majoring electronics and information, and it is a course with strong theoretical requirements. In this course, Discrete Fourier Transform and Digital Filter are the main points. We focus on the basic theory and analytical method on discrete time signal and system. We emphasis on the combination of theory and practice, and we also focus on the relationship between principle and application. The main points of course are: Sampling theory of signal and its application; analytical method for discrete-time signal in time-domain, frequency domain and z-domain; concept, computation and application of Discrete Fourier Transform; basic structure of digital filter; and the design principle of FIR and IIR filter. The purpose of this course is to help students to establish a theoretical basis in digital signal processing field. Through combination of theoretical knowledge and practical application, students are trained to have the ability of solving practical problems using basic digital signal processing methods. The course will benefit the students in further study, research, and development in the fields of electronics and information.

default.zh: 电磁场与电磁波课程提供了经典电磁理论的基本物理原理，数学方法及其典型应用的介绍。课程从标量场、矢量和矢量场等数学概念出发，介绍了静电场、恒定电场、恒定磁场，然后给出了时变电磁场并推出了麦克斯韦方程组，从而给出电磁波传播及辐射的基本规律。尽管需要学生们具有物理和微积分的基础知识，但是课程仍然给出了足够的矢量运算等数学准备知识。课程中的例题和习题帮助学生测试是否掌握了相关知识，有助于同学们掌握那些抽象的、难以可视化的知识。
default.en: The Electromagnetic Field and Electromagnetic Wave course provides an introduction to the basic physical principles, mathematical methods, and typical applications of classical electromagnetic theory. Starting from the mathematical concepts of scalar field, vector field and vector field, the course introduces electrostatic field, constant electric field and constant magnetic field, then gives the time-varying electromagnetic field and deduces Maxwell equations, thus giving the basic laws of electromagnetic wave propagation and radiation. Although students are required to have a basic knowledge of physics and calculus, the course still gives enough mathematical preparation knowledge such as vector operations. Examples and exercises in the course help students test whether they have mastered relevant knowledge, and help students grasp the abstract and difficult to visualize knowledge.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述六个学科的主体内容，即理论力学、材料力学、机械原理、机械零件、仪器零件、公差，是非机类专业必修的一门主干课程。主要讲述机械中通用零、部件及常用精密机械机构的工作原理及设计方法。主要内容有静力学、材料力学、平面四连杆机构、齿轮传动、凸轮与间歇机构、联接、轴与联轴器、支承、导轨、公差、带传动、螺旋传动、弹性元件和微机械。 通过本课的学习，可使学生综合应用多门课程知识，掌握通用机械的基本原理，通用机械零、部件的设计方法，培养学生具有设计精密机械传动机构及机械结构的能力，也为学生进一步学习专业课和今后从事精密机械技术工作打下基础。 开设的必修实验有：开锁器结构设计实验；柔性导轨与铰链的分析与设计；光机电一体化实训系统；公差综合实验。选修实验有弹性开关动态特性测试；组合机构类型分析与结构设计。
default.en: The course includes six subjects, such as Theoretical Mechanics, Material Mechanics, Mechanical Principle, Mechanical Part, Instrument Component and Tolerance, which is a kernel compulsory course for non-mechanical specialty. It mainly introduces operating principles and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary precision mechanism. The main content includes statics, material mechanics, plane four-bar linkage, gear drive, cam and intermittent, join, axis and coupling, bearing, guide way, tolerance, tape handler, screw-driven, elastic element, micro-mechanism. Via learning the curriculum, students can comprehensively apply much course knowledge, master basic principle of universal machine and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary mechanism, which can cultivate students the ability of designing actuating mechanism and machine structure and supply with basic information for professional lessons and mechanical technique work in the future. Compulsory experiments established are shown as follows: Unlocking engine structural design experiment, analysis and design for flexible guide way and hinge, Electro-mechanical integrated training system, comprehensive experiment of tolerance. Elective experiments are shown as follows: Elastic switch dynamic characteristic testing, type analysis and design for combined mechanism.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述六个学科的主体内容，即理论力学、材料力学、机械原理、机械零件、仪器零件、公差，是非机类专业必修的一门主干课程。主要讲述机械中通用零、部件及常用精密机械机构的工作原理及设计方法。主要内容有静力学、材料力学、平面四连杆机构、齿轮传动、凸轮与间歇机构、联接、轴与联轴器、支承、导轨、公差、带传动、螺旋传动、弹性元件和微机械。 通过本课的学习，可使学生综合应用多门课程知识，掌握通用机械的基本原理，通用机械零、部件的设计方法，培养学生具有设计精密机械传动机构及机械结构的能力，也为学生进一步学习专业课和今后从事精密机械技术工作打下基础。 开设的必修实验有：开锁器结构设计实验；柔性导轨与铰链的分析与设计；光机电一体化实训系统；公差综合实验。选修实验有弹性开关动态特性测试；组合机构类型分析与结构设计。
default.en: The course includes six subjects, such as Theoretical Mechanics, Material Mechanics, Mechanical Principle, Mechanical Part, Instrument Component and Tolerance, which is a kernel compulsory course for non-mechanical specialty. It mainly introduces operating principles and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary precision mechanism. The main content includes statics, material mechanics, plane four-bar linkage, gear drive, cam and intermittent, join, axis and coupling, bearing, guide way, tolerance, tape handler, screw-driven, elastic element, micro-mechanism. Via learning the curriculum, students can comprehensively apply much course knowledge, master basic principle of universal machine and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary mechanism, which can cultivate students the ability of designing actuating mechanism and machine structure and supply with basic information for professional lessons and mechanical technique work in the future. Compulsory experiments established are shown as follows: Unlocking engine structural design experiment, analysis and design for flexible guide way and hinge, Electro-mechanical integrated training system, comprehensive experiment of tolerance. Elective experiments are shown as follows: Elastic switch dynamic characteristic testing, type analysis and design for combined mechanism.

default.zh: 本课程是仪器科学与技术学科的一门主干专业技术基础课，主要研究成像规律和成像仪器。学生通过本门课程的学习，对现有光学系统应具有分解、分析的能力，了解各基本功能元素及相互关系和作用。另一方面，应具有外形尺寸的结构设计、将基本元素组合集成为系统的能力。对于光电、光学类专业，本门课程还是许多专业课的基础。 本课程包括几何光学、典型光学系统和像差理论三大部分。几何光学部分以高斯光学理论为核心内容，包括了光线光学的基本概念与成像理论、球面和平面光学系统及其成像原理、理想光学系统原理、光能和光束限制等基础内容；典型光学系统部分包括了眼睛、显微镜与照明系统、望远镜与转像系统、摄影光学系统和投影光学系统等成像原理、光束限制、放大倍率及其外形尺寸计算；像差理论详细叙述了光学系统的轴上点像差、轴外点像差和色差的形成原因、概念、现象、基本计算、典型结构的像差特征和校正像差的基本方法，使学生具胡结构设计和计算的能力。
default.en: The course is a major basic technical course in discipline of Instrumentation Science and Technology which is mainly research in imaging law and imaging instrument. Through studying of the course, students will have the ability to analyze the existing optical system, to understand the mutual relations and actions between the basic function units. And students will able to do structural design in dimensions, and to integrate the basic unit into a system. The course is still the basis of many professional courses for the students major in opto-electronic and optics. The course includes Geometrical Optics, Typical Optical System and Theory of Aberration. Theory of Gaussian Optics is the core content of Geometrical Optics, comprising basic definitions and imaging theory of ray optics, optical system and imaging principle of sphere and plane, principle of the ideal optical system, energy and optical limiting theory and so on. Typical Optical System consists of imaging principle, optical limiting, magnification and dimension calculation of eye, microscope and illuminative system, telescope and optical inversion system, photo-optical system and projection optical system. Aberration theory states reason of formation, concept, phenomena, basic calculation, characterization of aberration, the basic approach of aberration correction of spherical aberration, off-axis aberration and chromatic aberration in detail, making students have the capacity for structural design and calculation.

default.zh: 《嵌入式系统及应用》以单片机为例，介绍嵌入式处理器的组成原理、指令系统、软件设计、串行通讯、接口技术与应用的一门课程，具有较强的理论性和鲜明的实践性。嵌入式处理器是测量与控制仪表、控制系统的核心部件，硬件设计原理是其根本，软件设计方法是其精髓。学生通过本课程的学习，熟悉单片机的硬件结构和指令系统，掌握嵌入式系统的开发流程，以及嵌入式系统的硬件电路设计方法，初步掌握C51的编程与调试方法，为后续的专业课程和实践教学环节（如毕业设计）奠定坚实理论与实践基础。 课程涵盖如下内容： 1、介绍AT89S52单片机的引脚功能、片内存储器结构、时钟电路、复位电路； 2、介绍的C51语言指令系统，包括数据类型、存储类型、函数组成、程序设计方法； 3、介绍嵌入式软硬件开发环境与使用方法，包括Proteus和Keil等； 4、介绍AT89S52单片机的中断系统、定时器/计数器、串行口的结构与工作原理； 5、介绍AT89S52单片机与LED数码管、LCD液晶显示器、键盘等外设的接口设计方法； 6、以I2C总线、单总线、SPI总线为例，介绍单片机的串行扩展技术； 7、介绍AT89S52单片机与ADC和DAC的硬件接口设计与驱动程序设计。
default.en: Embedded System and Application is a course that integrates the principle of embedded processor, instruction system, software design, serial communication, interface technology and application based on Micro Controller Unit (MCU). It has strong theory and distinct practicality. Embedded processor is the core component of measurement and control instrument and system. The principle of hardware design is its foundation, and the software design method is its essence. Through the course of learning, students will be familiar with the hardware structure and command system of SCM, and master the development process of embedded system, microcomputer embedded system design method, preliminary programming and debugging method of C51 language. It will lay a solid foundation of theory and practice for professional courses and graduation project. The course introduces the following content. 1．Pin function of AT89S52 microcontroller, as well as the memory structure, the clock circuit, and the reset circuit. 2．C51 language instruction system, including data types, storage types, functions, programming design methods. 3．Development tools and application method of embedded software and hardware, including Proteus and Keil. 4．Structures and working principles of the interrupt system, timer / counter, serial interface. 5．Peripheral interface design of LED, LCD, and keyboard. 6．Serial extension technologies of single chip microcomputer such as the single bus, SPI, and I2C bus. 7．Hardware interface designs and driver designs of AT89S52 microcontroller and ADC/DAC.

default.zh: “工程光学（2）”课程主要面向哈尔滨工业大学仪器类专业本科生开设，通过课程的学习，使学生能够运用运用麦克斯韦电磁理论分析光在各向同性介质和各向异性介质中的传播规律；掌握光的干涉、光的衍射、光的偏振等特性及这些特性在光电仪器和精密仪器领域应用的基础理论；通过实验与工程实践，培养学生综合运用专业基础知识和工程技术进行系统设计、实验以及数据分析和处理的能力。为学生未来从事光电测量与仪器设计等相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下基础。
default.en: The course "Engineering Optics (2)" is mainly offered to undergraduate students majoring in instrumentation and related minors at Harbin Institute of Technology.After this course, the students can obtain the ability of analyzing the propagation laws of light in isotropic and anisotropic materials by using the Maxwell electromagnetic theory, and master the properties of interference, diffraction and polarization of light and their related applications on precision photoelectric instruments. Besides, by experiments and engineering training, this course can cultivate students the ability on system design based on professional knowledge and skills, and the ability on processing and analysis of experimental data. This course can lay the basis for students’ research activities on photoelectric measurement and instruments in the near future.

default.zh: 《误差理论与不确定度分析》 为我校测控技术与仪器和光电信息科学与工程(光电仪器方向)两个本科专业学生的重要专业基础课。开设时间为大三春季学期，总学时为42学时，包含38学时课堂授课学时和2学时实验学时和2学时上机学时。先修课程为高等数学、大学物理、电路、机械学基础和概率论与数理统计等课程。 课堂内容包括：1. 概述(测量、测量误差和数理统计的基本概念、有效数字和舍入规则)；2. 测量误差的规律性及其表述(随机误差、正态分布和非正态分布的随机误差、系统误差的特征及其表述)；3. 测量误差的传递(定义法、线性化法、线性叠加法则和传递系数的计算)；4. 一般测量问题中的数据处理方法(算术平均值和加权算数平均值原理、测量数据的修正)；5. 不确定度的估计和合成(不确定度的表征参数与估计、标准不确定度、扩展不确定度和算术平均值不确定度的合成，t分布合成扩展不确定度、不确定度的自由度、误差间相关关系和相关系数的估计)；6. 不确定度合成规则的应用(1/3原则和等作用原则)；7. 最小二乘法(原理、正规方程、正规方程的解算和精度估计)；8. 线性回归(一元线性回归)。 实验内容为电感测微仪的参数特性测试。 上机内容为按照t分布合成扩展不确定度编程。
default.en: Error theory and uncertainty analysis》is a key professional basic course for the undergraduate students majored in measurement technology & instrument and optoelectronic information science & engineering (photoelectric instrument direction) in our school. The opening hours are set in junior spring semester, and the total hours are 42 hours, including 38 hours of class course, 2 hours of measurement experiment and 2 hours of computer programming. Prerequisites courses for this course are higher mathematics, universal physics, circuit, basic mechanics and probability theory and mathematical statistics. The contents of the class include: 1. Overview (the basic concept of measurement, measurement error and mathematical statistics, effective figures and rounding rules); 2. Measurement error regularity and its expression (random error, normal distribution and non-normal distribution random error, systematic error’s characteristics and its expression); 3. Measurement error’s transmission (definition method, linearization method, linear superposition rule and the calculation of the transfer coefficient); 4. General data processing methods in ordinary measurement problem (the principles of arithmetic mean and the weighted arithmetic mean method, the correction of the measured data); 5. The estimation and synthesis of the uncertainty (the characterization parameters and estimates of uncertainty, the synthesis of standard uncertainty, extended uncertainty and arithmetic mean uncertainty , t-distribution synthesize extension uncertainty, the freedom of uncertainty, error correlation and correlation coefficient estimation); 6. Application of uncertainty synthesis rules (1/3 principle and equivalence principle); 7. Least Square Method (principle, normal equation, normal equation’s solution and precision estimation); 8. Linear regression (one variable linear regression). The experimental content is the parameter characteristic testing of the inductance micrometer. The contents of the computer operation are programming method according to the t-distribution synthesis extension uncertainty.

Contents of the course are given as follows: (1) Components and requirements of automatic control systems. (2) Mathematical models of control systems.
