Contents of the course are given as follows: (1) Components and requirements of automatic control systems. (2) Mathematical models of control systems. (3) Time-domain analysis methods of control systems. (4) Frequency-domain methods of control systems (5) Basic principles of modern control

default.zh: “传感技术及应用”是具有较强实践性的一门专业技术课程，传感器是信息获取和组成测控系统的首要环节。本课程主要介绍传感器的基本概念，重点讲解各类传感器的基本原理、特性及相应的测量电路，同时也介绍各类传感器的实际应用及传感器技术发展的状况及新成果。 学生在完成本课程的学习后，将对各类传感器的工作原理、基本结构、特性、应用领域中较重要的敏感技术有相当的认识，对选择、使用或设计传感器的原则和方法有一定程度的掌握，并对传感器目前的发展动态和需求有一定的了解，为组建测控系统正确地选择传感器奠定基础。 传感器是电学、光学、机械学、测量、控制等综合技术的结合体，传感器的应用领域非常广泛，通过本课程的学习使学生们了解这些学科内容的相关性，同时对生态环境保护、经济的发展具有重要的作用。
default.en: Sensor technology and application is a professional technique basic course, which has strong sense of practice. The sensor is the primary link in the signal acquisition chain or the measurement and control system. The objective of this course is to introduce the concepts, principles, characteristics and the corresponding measurement circuit of sensor. Meanwhile, it also contains the actual application of all kinds of sensors and the development trend of sensor technology. Through studying this course, the student can understand the basic knowledge of sensors, such as, its working principle, structure, characteristics and application fields, etc. Meanwhile, they will grasp some principles and methods for selecting, using or designing sensors, and understand the development and demand of sensors. The course gives them the ability to choose sensors properlyfor the establishment of measurement and control system. As the combination of electrical, optical, mechanical and other technologies, sensor can be used widely in various fields. The objective of this course is to familiarize students with the relevance of each subject and the important role of sensors in environment protection and economic development.

default.zh: 课程主要面向仪器科学与技术及相关专业大二年级本科生开设。课程主要讨论确知信号描述和分析的基本方法；讨论线性时不变系统的基本概念，系统表征和分析的基本方法；讨论系统对信号的作用机理；讨论典型信号、典型系统的基本特征和应用特点。
default.en: The course is mainly aimed at second year undergraduate students majoring in Instrument Science and Technology and related majors. The course mainly discusses the basic methods of describing and analyzing deterministic signals; Discuss the basic concepts of linear time invariant systems, as well as the fundamental methods for system characterization and analysis; Discuss the mechanism of the system's impact on signals; Discuss the basic characteristics and application features of typical signals and systems.

default.zh: 数字信号处理课程是电子类、信息类等专业的重要专业基础课，是一门理论性较强的课程。本课程以离散傅里叶变换和数字滤波器为重点，强调离散时间信号和系统的基本理论和分析方法，强调理论与实践、原理与应用相结合。 课程主要内容为：信号的取样理论及其应用；离散时间信号和系统在时域、频域和z域的分析方法；离散傅里叶变换的概念、计算及其应用；数字滤波器的结构、IIR滤波器和FIR滤波器的设计原理。 本课程旨在奠定学生在数字信号处理领域的基本理论基础，通过理论知识与应用方法的有机结合，培养学生利用数字信号处理方法解决实际问题的能力。为学生未来从事电子、信息及相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要的基础
default.en: Digital Signal Processing is a professional basic course for students majoring electronics and information, and it is a course with strong theoretical requirements. In this course, Discrete Fourier Transform and Digital Filter are the main points. We focus on the basic theory and analytical method on discrete time signal and system. We emphasis on the combination of theory and practice, and we also focus on the relationship between principle and application. The main points of course are: Sampling theory of signal and its application; analytical method for discrete-time signal in time-domain, frequency domain and z-domain; concept, computation and application of Discrete Fourier Transform; basic structure of digital filter; and the design principle of FIR and IIR filter. The purpose of this course is to help students to establish a theoretical basis in digital signal processing field. Through combination of theoretical knowledge and practical application, students are trained to have the ability of solving practical problems using basic digital signal processing methods. The course will benefit the students in further study, research, and development in the fields of electronics and information.

default.zh: 《嵌入式系统及应用》以单片机为例，介绍嵌入式处理器的组成原理、指令系统、软件设计、串行通讯、接口技术与应用的一门课程，具有较强的理论性和鲜明的实践性。嵌入式处理器是测量与控制仪表、控制系统的核心部件，硬件设计原理是其根本，软件设计方法是其精髓。学生通过本课程的学习，熟悉单片机的硬件结构和指令系统，掌握嵌入式系统的开发流程，以及嵌入式系统的硬件电路设计方法，初步掌握C51的编程与调试方法，为后续的专业课程和实践教学环节（如毕业设计）奠定坚实理论与实践基础。 课程涵盖如下内容： 1、 介绍AT89S52单片机的引脚功能、片内存储器结构、时钟电路、复位电路； 2、 介绍的C51语言指令系统，包括数据类型、存储类型、函数组成、程序设计方法； 3、 介绍嵌入式软硬件开发环境与使用方法，包括Proteus和Keil等； 4、 介绍AT89S52单片机的中断系统、定时器/计数器、串行口的结构与工作原理； 5、 介绍AT89S52单片机与LED数码管、LCD液晶显示器、键盘等外设的接口设计方法； 6、 以I2C总线、单总线、SPI总线为例，介绍单片机的串行扩展技术； 7、 介绍AT89S52单片机与ADC和DAC的硬件接口设计与驱动程序设计。
default.en: Embedded System and Application is a course that integrates the principle of embedded processor, instruction system, software design, serial communication, interface technology and application based on Micro Controller Unit (MCU). It has strong theory and distinct practicality. Embedded processor is the core component of measurement and control instrument and system. The principle of hardware design is its foundation, and the software design method is its essence. Through the course of learning, students will be familiar with the hardware structure and command system of SCM, and master the development process of embedded system, microcomputer embedded system design method, preliminary programming and debugging method of C51 language. It will lay a solid foundation of theory and practice for professional courses and graduation project. The course introduces the following content. 1． Pin function of AT89S52 microcontroller, as well as the memory structure, the clock circuit, and the reset circuit. 2． C51 language instruction system, including data types, storage types, functions, programming design methods. 3． Development tools and application method of embedded software and hardware, including Proteus and Keil. 4． Structures and working principles of the interrupt system, timer / counter, serial interface. 5． Peripheral interface design of LED, LCD, and keyboard. 6． Serial extension technologies of single chip microcomputer such as the single bus, SPI, and I2C bus. 7． Hardware interface designs and driver designs of AT89S52 microcontroller and ADC/DAC.

default.zh: 本课程是仪器科学与技术学科的一门主干专业技术基础课，主要研究成像规律和成像仪器。学生通过本门课程的学习，对现有光学系统应具有分解、分析的能力，了解各基本功能元素及相互关系和作用。另一方面，应具有外形尺寸的结构设计、将基本元素组合集成为系统的能力。对于光电、光学类专业，本门课程还是许多专业课的基础。 本课程包括几何光学、典型光学系统和像差理论三大部分。几何光学部分以高斯光学理论为核心内容，包括了光线光学的基本概念与成像理论、球面和平面光学系统及其成像原理、理想光学系统原理、光能和光束限制等基础内容；典型光学系统部分包括了眼睛、显微镜与照明系统、望远镜与转像系统、摄影光学系统和投影光学系统等成像原理、光束限制、放大倍率及其外形尺寸计算；像差理论详细叙述了光学系统的轴上点像差、轴外点像差和色差的形成原因、概念、现象、基本计算、典型结构的像差特征和校正像差的基本方法，使学生具胡结构设计和计算的能力。
default.en: The course is a major basic technical course in discipline of Instrumentation Science and Technology which is mainly research in imaging law and imaging instrument. Through studying of the course, students will have the ability to analyze the existing optical system, to understand the mutual relations and actions between the basic function units. And students will able to do structural design in dimensions, and to integrate the basic unit into a system. The course is still the basis of many professional courses for the students major in opto-electronic and optics. The course includes Geometrical Optics, Typical Optical System and Theory of Aberration. Theory of Gaussian Optics is the core content of Geometrical Optics, comprising basic definitions and imaging theory of ray optics, optical system and imaging principle of sphere and plane, principle of the ideal optical system, energy and optical limiting theory and so on. Typical Optical System consists of imaging principle, optical limiting, magnification and dimension calculation of eye, microscope and illuminative system, telescope and optical inversion system, photo-optical system and projection optical system. Aberration theory states reason of formation, concept, phenomena, basic calculation, characterization of aberration, the basic approach of aberration correction of spherical aberration, off-axis aberration and chromatic aberration in detail, making students have the capacity for structural design and calculation.

default.zh: 物理光学是一门将光作为电磁波并用电磁理论研究光的传播规律和特性的基础课程，它是光学领域中最基础但又异常活跃的重要组成部分。课程将以光的波动为主基调，运用麦克斯韦电磁理论分析光在各向同性介质和各向异性介质中的传播规律、光的干涉、光的衍射、光的偏振等特性。使学生从光波动的本质上认识光的传播及光与物质相互作用过程中所遵循的规律，掌握物理光学的基本原理和分析方法，了解物理光学的新技术、新应用和新成就。本课程为学生未来从事光、电、仪器及相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要基础。
default.en: Physical Optics is a foundation course focused on the study of light propagation laws and characteristics by taking light as an electromagnetic wave and using electromagnetic theory, and it is not only the most important foundation but also an extraordinarily active part in optics field. The course introduces the propagation laws of light in isotropic and anisotropic materials based on the wave-motion of light and Maxwell electromagnetic theory. The optical characteristics of interference, diffraction and polarization of light are introduced. Through the study of the course, students will understand the propagation laws of light and the interaction between light and materials at the viewpoint of wave-motion nature of light, learn the basic theories and analytical methods of physical optics, and know the new technology, new achievements and new applications of physical optics. The course will benefit the students in further study, research and development in the fields of optics, electronics, instrument and relative field.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述六个学科的主体内容，即理论力学、材料力学、机械原理、机械零件、仪器零件、公差，是非机类专业必修的一门主干课程。主要讲述机械中通用零、部件及常用精密机械机构的工作原理及设计方法。主要内容有静力学、材料力学、平面四连杆机构、齿轮传动、凸轮与间歇机构、联接、轴与联轴器、支承、导轨、公差、带传动、螺旋传动、弹性元件和微机械。 通过本课的学习，可使学生综合应用多门课程知识，掌握通用机械的基本原理，通用机械零、部件的设计方法，培养学生具有设计精密机械传动机构及机械结构的能力，也为学生进一步学习专业课和今后从事精密机械技术工作打下基础。 开设的必修实验有：开锁器结构设计实验；柔性导轨与铰链的分析与设计；光机电一体化实训系统；公差综合实验。选修实验有弹性开关动态特性测试；组合机构类型分析与结构设计。
default.en: The course includes six subjects, such as Theoretical Mechanics, Material Mechanics, Mechanical Principle, Mechanical Part, Instrument Component and Tolerance, which is a kernel compulsory course for non-mechanical specialty. It mainly introduces operating principles and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary precision mechanism. The main content includes statics, material mechanics, plane four-bar linkage, gear drive, cam and intermittent, join, axis and coupling, bearing, guide way, tolerance, tape handler, screw-driven, elastic element, micro-mechanism. Via learning the curriculum, students can comprehensively apply much course knowledge, master basic principle of universal machine and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary mechanism, which can cultivate students the ability of designing actuating mechanism and machine structure and supply with basic information for professional lessons and mechanical technique work in the future. Compulsory experiments established are shown as follows: Unlocking engine structural design experiment, analysis and design for flexible guide way and hinge, Electro-mechanical integrated training system, comprehensive experiment of tolerance. Elective experiments are shown as follows: Elastic switch dynamic characteristic testing, type analysis and design for combined mechanism.

default.zh: 互换性与测量技术基础课程目的使学生掌握互换性、标准化的概念及机械零部件精度设计的基本原理和方法；了解典型零件极限与配合标准的组成和应用以及各种典型零件制造精度的确定方法。进一步加强学生基本理论、基本知识和基本技能的学习和训练。不仅进一步培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，还要培养学生独立工作能力及动手能力。 课程主要内容包括互换性和标准化的基本概念，尺寸精度设计，几何精度设计，表面粗糙度精度设计，典型零部件精度设计（滚动轴承、平键、花键、螺纹等）、尺寸链的计算等。
default.en: The purpose of the subject “Fundamentals of interchangeability and measurement technology” is to help students have a good mastery of the concepts of interchangeability and standardization, basic principles and design methods of machine parts; and know the composition and application of limiting and matching standards of typical parts, and the method for deciding manufacturing accuracy of typical parts; and to help students further study and train basic theory, knowledge and skill; and cultivate the ability of analyzing and solving problems and the ability of independently working and operating. Its main content includes: the design principle of geometric accuracy of mechanical parts——interchangeability and standardizationsize, dimensional accuracy design basis, geometric accuracy design basis, surface roughness, precision design of typical components accuracy(rolling bearing, flat key, rectangle spline,screw thread)，precision design of gear drive, calculation of dimension chain .

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养掌握现代智能仪器电子技术理论与应用能力的高素质工程技术人才。课程围绕"基础理论-核心技术-系统设计-工程应用"四位一体展开，通过理论教学与实践环节相结合，使学生具备智能仪器系统的分析、设计与开发能力。
default.en: This course aims to cultivate high-quality engineering and technical talents who have mastered the theory and application ability of modern intelligent instrument electronic technology. The course revolves around the four aspects of "basic theory core technology system design engineering application", combining theoretical teaching with practical activities to equip students with the ability to analyze, design, and develop intelligent instrument systems

default.zh: 课程主要面向精密仪器及智能化类专业本科生开设。本课程教授学生测量的基本概念、基本流程和经典方法，并培养解决测试与检测具体问题的能力。在课程的学习中，使学生学会如何在测试与检测任务中，将光、机、电、控制紧密配合电以解决工程实际中的测量问题；通过实验与工程实践，培养学生综合运用测试技术的方法和手段进行测量系统设计、实验以及信号分析和数据处理的能力。为学生未来从事精密仪器、精密工程、精密测控等相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下基础，同时也能更多地了解测试技术的前沿和发展趋势，扩展学生的视野，提高学生继续深入学习测量领域内容的积极性。
default.en: The course is mainly designed for undergraduate students majoring in precision instruments and intelligent engineering. This course teaches students the basic concepts, processes, and classical methods of measurement, while also fostering their ability to solve specific testing and detection problems. Through the study of the course, students learn how to integrate optics, mechanics, electronics, and control to solve measurement problems in engineering practice. Through experiments and engineering practices, students develop the ability to comprehensively apply testing techniques for measurement system design, experiments, signal analysis, and data processing. This course lays a foundation for students to engage in learning, research, and development in fields related to precision instruments, precision engineering, and precision measurement and control, while also enabling them to understand more about the forefront and trends of testing technology, broaden their horizons, and enhance their enthusiasm for further study in the field of measurement.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向测控技术与仪器本科生开设。通过本课程学习，使学生能够掌握自动控制元件的基本知识包括自动控制系统中执行、放大、测量元件的结构特点和工作原理及其在工程实际中的应用；能够把控制元件与光、机、电有机的结合起来，具有工程设计的基础知识和初步的工程设计能力；通过实验课培养实验技能，对典型自动控制元件结构及自动控制系统有更深刻的认识。教学过程中强调专业知识的深度和理论与实际应用的有机结合，为今后从事理论研究和工程设计工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This course is primarily designed for undergraduate students majoring in Measurement and Control Technology and Instrument. Through this course, students will acquire essential knowledge of automatic control components, including the structural characteristics and working principles of components involved in execution, amplification, and measurement within automatic control systems, and applying them in engineering practice. Additionally, students will develop the ability to integrate control components with optics, mechanics, and electronics, acquiring foundational knowledge and initial engineering design skills. Practical skills will be cultivated through experimental sessions, fostering a deeper understanding of the structures of typical automatic control components and control systems. The teaching process emphasizes the depth of professional knowledge and the organic integration of theory with practical applications, so as to lay a solid foundation for theoretical research and engineering design in the future.

default.zh: 课程主要面向精密仪器及智能化类专业本科生开设。通过本课程的学习使学生熟悉和掌握如何运用精密测控电路技术来解决传感、测量、驱动以及控制任务中的具体问题。培养学生学会如何在测量和控制任务中将精密电子技术与光、机、控制紧密配合；对电子测量与控制的总体思想的深入理解；如何围绕测控任务精、快、灵和其它技术要求，来选用或设计具体种类与形式的精密测控电路，实现预期的功能与技术指标；通过实验与工程实践，培养学生综合运用精密电子、电路知识和工程技术进行系统设计、实验以及数据分析和处理的能力。为学生未来从事精密仪器、精密工程、精密测控等相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下基础。
default.en: The course is mainly designed for undergraduate students majoring in precision instruments and intelligent engineering. Through this course, students will become familiar with and master the application of precision measurement and control circuit technology to solve specific problems in sensing, measurement, driving, and control tasks. The course aims to train students in integrating precision electronic technology with optics, mechanics, and control in measurement and control tasks, deepening their overall understanding of electronic measurement and control principles. Students will learn how to select or design specific types and forms of precision measurement and control circuits around measurement and control tasks, meeting the requirements for precision, speed, agility, and other technical specifications to achieve the intended functions and technical indicators. Through experiments and engineering practices, students will develop the ability to comprehensively apply precision electronics, circuit knowledge, and engineering technology in system design, experimentation, data analysis, and processing. This course lays the foundation for students to engage in learning, research, and development in the fields of precision instruments, precision engineering, precision measurement, and control, among other related technical areas in the future.

default.zh: 本课程是测控技术与仪器专业的专业核心课，本课程的目的是使学生能够综合应用光、机、电、控等方面的知识，融会贯通专业基础课程，系统掌握在线智能测控系统设计的基本原理与方法。课程内容包含在线测量、数字化测量与人工智能技术基本知识、在线智能测控系统特征、基于各类传感技术的数字化在线测量系统原理与组成、智能化前沿技术以及智能化系统设计方法等。要求学生掌握基本的在线数字化测量原理和方法及系统智能化技术，具有解决在线数字化测量领域复杂工程问题的能力，并能在智能测试系统设计和分析过程中体现创新性，考虑经济、社会、健康、安全、法律、文化以及环境等因素。
default.en: This course is a professional core course for the major of Measurement and Control Technology and Instrument. The purpose of this course is to enable students to comprehensively apply knowledge in optics, machinery, electronics, and control, integrate professional basic courses, and systematically master the basic principles and methods of online intelligent measurement and control system design. The course content includes basic knowledge of online measurement, digital measurement, and artificial intelligence technology, characteristics of online intelligent measurement and control systems, principles and compositions of digital online measurement systems based on various sensing technologies, cutting-edge intelligent technologies, and intelligent system design methods. Students are required to master the basic principles and methods of online digital measurement and system intelligence technology, have the ability to solve complex engineering problems in the field of online digital measurement, and be able to demonstrate innovation in the design and analysis process of intelligent test systems, considering economic, social, health, safety, legal, cultural, and environmental factors.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述六个学科的主体内容，即理论力学、材料力学、机械原理、机械零件、仪器零件、互换性与测量技术基础，是非机类专业必修的一门主干课程。主要讲述机械中通用零、部件及常用精密机械机构的工作原理及设计方法。主要内容有静力学、材料力学、平面四连杆机构、齿轮传动、凸轮与间歇机构、联接、轴与联轴器、支承、导轨、机械精度设计、带传动、螺旋传动、弹性元件和微机械。 通过本课的学习，可使学生综合应用多门课程知识，掌握通用机械的基本原理，通用机械零、部件的设计方法，培养学生具有设计精密机械传动机构及机械结构的能力，也为学生进一步学习专业课和今后从事精密机械技术工作打下基础。 开设的必修实验有：开锁器结构设计实验；柔性导轨与铰链的分析与设计；光机电一体化实训系统；公差综合实验。选修实验有弹性开关动态特性测试；组合机构类型分析与结构设计。
default.en: The course includes six subjects, such as Theoretical Mechanics, Material Mechanics, Mechanical Principle, Mechanical Part, Instrument Component and Tolerance, which is a kernel compulsory course for non-mechanical specialty. It mainly introduces operating principles and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary precision mechanism. The main content includes statics, material mechanics, plane four-bar linkage, gear drive, cam and intermittent, join, axis and coupling, bearing, guide way, tolerance, tape handler, screw-driven, elastic element, micro-mechanism. Via learning the curriculum, students can comprehensively apply much course knowledge, master basic principle of universal machine and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary mechanism, which can cultivate students the ability of designing actuating mechanism and machine structure and supply with basic information for professional lessons and mechanical technique work in the future. Compulsory experiments established are shown as follows: Unlocking engine structural design experiment, analysis and design for flexible guide way and hinge, Electro-mechanical integrated training system, comprehensive experiment of tolerance. Elective experiments are shown as follows: Elastic switch dynamic characteristic testing, type analysis and design for combined mechanism.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向仪器类专业本科生和辅修仪器类专业本科生开设。通过课程的学习，培养学生精密测量与仪器总体设计能力，能够将机械、光学、电子与计算机技术相结合，掌握精密测量的基本原理、精密仪器总体设计及精度设计的理论和方法，能对精密测量与仪器设计领域的复杂工程问题进行分析与评价。针对精密测量与仪器设计领域复杂工程问题提出解决方案，设计满足特定需求的精密仪器系统、单元（部件）或工艺流程，并能够在设计环节中体现创新意识，考虑社会、健康、安全、法律、文化以及环境等因素。在课程学习中，培养学生具有自主学习和终身学习的意识，能够独立的跟踪精密测量与仪器领域最新国际前沿动态，具有不断学习和适应发展的能力。
default.en: This course is mainly aimed at undergraduate students majoring in instruments and undergraduate students majoring in auxiliary instruments. Through the study of the course, students will be trained to master the ability to combine mechanical, optical, electronic, and computer technologies in precision measurement and instrument design. They will learn the basic principles of precision measurement, and the theory and methods of precision instrument overall design. Students could analyze and evaluate complex engineering problems in the field of precision measurement and instrument design. Moreover, students could propose solutions for complex engineering problems in the field of precision measurement instruments and design, and design precision instrument systems, units (components) or process flows that satisfy specific requirements, and demonstrate innovation awareness in the design process, taking into account social, health, safety, legal, cultural, and environmental factors. During the course learning, students are trained to improve the awareness of self-directed learning and lifelong learning, they could independently track the latest international cutting-edge trends in the field of precision measurement and instruments, and be of the ability of continuously learning.

default.zh: 通过课程学习，学生能够运用初级像差理论进行光学系统初始结构设计，掌握各类典型系统光学特性，熟练运用光学设计软件对望远系统、显微系统、投影系统、激光扫描系统、二元光学元件等进行仿真分析、优化设计、像质评价等，解决精密仪器光学系统设计中的复杂工程问题；通过实验与创新实践，学生具备综合运用光学设计理论、工程知识、优化设计软件等进行需求分析、概念设计、系统优化设计、数据分析处理、创新实践等能力。
default.en: Through course learning, students will be able to apply basic aberration theory to design the initial structure of optical systems, master the optical characteristics of various typical systems, proficiently use optical design software to simulate, analyze, optimize, and evaluate the image quality of telescopic systems, microscopic systems, projection systems, laser scanning systems, binary optical components, etc., and solve complex engineering problems in the design of precision instrument optical systems; Through experimentation and innovative practice, students have the ability to comprehensively apply optical design theory, engineering knowledge, optimization design software, etc. for requirement analysis, conceptual design, system optimization design, data analysis and processing, and innovative practice.

default.zh: 互换性与测量技术基础课程目的使学生掌握互换性、标准化的概念及机械零部件精度设计的基本原理和方法；了解典型零件极限与配合标准的组成和应用以及各种典型零件制造精度的确定方法。进一步加强学生基本理论、基本知识和基本技能的学习和训练。不仅进一步培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，还要培养学生独立工作能力及动手能力。 课程主要内容包括互换性和标准化的基本概念，尺寸精度设计，几何精度设计，表面粗糙度精度设计，典型零部件精度设计（滚动轴承、平键、花键、螺纹等）、尺寸链的计算等。
default.en: he purpose of the subject “Fundamentals of interchangeability and measurement technology” is to help students have a good mastery of the concepts of interchangeability and standardization, basic principles and design methods of machine parts; and know the composition and application of limiting and matching standards of typical parts, and the method for deciding manufacturing accuracy of typical parts; and to help students further study and train basic theory, knowledge and skill; and cultivate the ability of analyzing and solving problems and the ability of independently working and operating. Its main content includes: the design principle of geometric accuracy of mechanical parts——interchangeability and standardizationsize, dimensional accuracy design basis, geometric accuracy design basis, surface roughness, precision design of typical components accuracy(rolling bearing, flat key, rectangle spline,screw thread)，precision design of gear drive, calculation of dimension chain .

default.zh: 感知器件是智能时代的核心关键器件，在机器人、物联网、智慧城市、智能医疗、智能交通、智能制造等领域有着极为重要的应用前景。感知材料是多种重要感知器件的核心关键，决定了感知器件的性能和应用性。《感知材料与器件》课程旨在向本科生提供感知材料和感知器件的重要知识。通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握传感材料和感知器件的基础知识、最新进展和应用趋势，培养创新意识、辩证思维和理论与实践相结合的能力，具备在相关工程领域开展研究工作的良好素质。本课程的主要内容包括感知材料与器件简介、光感知材料与器件、热感知材料与器件、力感知材料与器件、气体感知材料与器件、生物芯片、纳米感知材料与器件、柔性感知材料与器件、智能感知材料与智能感知器件、感知材料与感知器件前沿进展。
default.en: Sensing devices are the key devices in the intelligent era, and have important application prospects in robots, the Internet of Things, smart cities, intelligent medicine, intelligent transportation, intelligent manufacturing and other fields. Sensing materials are at the core of many important sensing devices, which determines the performance and applications of sensing devices. The course of Sensing Materials and Devices aims to provide undergraduate students with important knowledge of sensing materials and sensing devices. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic knowledge, the latest progress and application trends of sensing materials and sensing devices, cultivate their innovative consciousness, dialectical thinking and the ability to integrate theory with practice, and have good quality of conducting research in relevant engineering fields. The course includes concepts and background of sensing materials and devices, optical sensing materials and devices, thermal sensing materials and devices, force sensing materials and devices, gas sensing materials and devices, biochips, sensing nanomaterials and nanosensors, flexible sensing materials and devices, smart sensing materials and smart sensing devices, and the cutting-edge developments of sensing materials and devices.

default.zh: “人工智能基础”是一门技术基础课，主要介绍人工智能的基本概念、 基本原理。课程的主要目标是让学生了解人工智能技术的基本特点，为学生掌握人工智能在工程实际中的应用奠定基础。课程内容主要包括： (1) 人工智能概述 (2) 知识表示 (3) 推理 (4) 搜索策略 (5) 机器学习与深度学习 (6) 神经网络 (7) 智能控制
default.en: “Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence” is a foundational technical course that primarily introduces the basic concepts and principles of artificial intelligence. Its aim is to provide students with a fundamental understanding of the essential characteristics of artificial intelligence technology, laying the groundwork for their practical engineering applications. The course content includes: (1) Overview of Artificial Intelligence (2) Knowledge Representation (3) Inference (4) Search Strategies (5) Machine Learning and Deep Learning (6) Neural Networks (7) Intelligent Control

default.zh: “人工智能基础”是一门技术基础课，主要介绍人工智能的基本概念、 基本原理。课程的主要目标是让学生了解人工智能技术的基本特点，为学生掌握人工智能在工程实际中的应用奠定基础。课程内容主要包括： (1) 人工智能概述 (2) 知识表示 (3) 推理 (4) 搜索策略 (5) 机器学习与深度学习 (6) 神经网络 (7) 智能控制

default.zh: 该课程是仪器学院智能感知专业的专业核心课，旨在帮助学生对物联网与智能感知系统有一个整体认识，掌握物联网体系结构和相关技术，掌握智能感知系统基础设计方法。通过对RFID、计算机网络以及大数据与云计算技术的学习，掌握物联网感知层、网络层和应用层的基本知识；通过对无线智能传感器网络、嵌入式系统和Python编程的学习，掌握智能感知系统设计方法，提高学生工程实践能力和创新能力；通过对智能交通、智能物流、智能建筑等系统的学习，了解物联网与智能感知系统技术在多个领域中的应用。
default.en: This course is the core course of the Intelligent Perception major in the School of Instrumentation, aiming to help students have a comprehensive understanding of the Internet of Things and intelligent perception systems, master the architecture and related technologies of the Internet of Things, and master the basic design methods of intelligent perception systems. By studying RFID, computer networks, big data, and cloud computing technologies, master the basic knowledge of the perception layer, network layer, and application layer of the Internet of Things. By studying wireless intelligent sensor networks, embedded systems, and Python programming, students can master the design methods of intelligent perception systems and improve their engineering practice and innovation abilities. By studying systems such as intelligent transportation, intelligent logistics, and intelligent buildings, understand the application of Internet of Things and intelligent perception system technology in multiple fields.

default.zh: 通过课程的学习，学生能够掌握视觉感知系统核心部件特性和参数计算方法，能够根据应用场景需要构建视觉感知系统；掌握图像预处理、图像分割、特征提取、特征匹配等方法，能够构建深度学习网络实现图像目标检测和语义分割；能够在视觉感知领域从事工程设计、技术开发、项目管理等工作。
default.en: Through the course, students will be able to master the core components and parameter calculation methods of visual perception systems, and be able to construct visual perception systems according to the needs of application scenarios; Master methods such as image preprocessing, image segmentation, feature extraction, and feature matching, and be able to construct deep learning networks to achieve image object detection and semantic segmentation; Capable of working in the field of visual perception, including engineering design, technical development, and project management.

default.zh: 通过课程的学习，学生能够掌握视觉感知系统核心部件特性和参数计算方法，能够根据应用场景需要构建视觉感知系统；掌握图像预处理、图像分割、特征提取、特征匹配等方法，能够构建深度学习网络实现图像目标检测和语义分割；能够在视觉感知领域从事工程设计、技术开发、项目管理等工作。

default.zh: 本课程主要面向仪器类专业本科生开设，在大三学年夏季学期进行。主要以仪器领域知名企业的技术专家和高管为授课教师，通过课程的学习，使仪器类学生能够对“四个面向”和仪器强国有更深入的了解，对当前智能制造和高端装备领域对仪器类人才的需求，以及在仪器领域发展对知识体系的需要有更深入的了解，对数字化、网络化、智能化等新技术在仪器产业的应用有更深入的了解；通过产业专家对学科发展与社会产业结构的关系、发展趋势、就业前景等进行针对性的介绍，使学生认识到仪器科学与技术的重要性，引导学生建立正确的学习理念、增强专业认同、树立正确的择业观，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事仪器类相关技术领域工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is mainly aimed at undergraduate students majoring in instruments and is conducted in the summer semester of their junior year. The course mainly focuses on technical experts and executives from well-known enterprises in the field of instruments. Through the learning of the course, students in the field of instruments can have a deeper understanding of the "four orientations" and the instrument power. They can also have a deeper understanding of the current demand for instrument talents in the fields of intelligent manufacturing and high-end equipment, as well as the need for knowledge systems in the development of the instrument field. They can also have a deeper understanding of digitization, networking A deeper understanding of the application of new technologies such as intelligence in the instrument industry; By providing targeted introductions by industry experts on the relationship between disciplinary development and social industrial structure, development trends, employment prospects, etc., students will recognize the importance of instrument science and technology, guide them to establish correct learning concepts, enhance professional identity, and establish correct career choices, laying a foundation for further learning of relevant professional courses and future work in the field of instrument related technology.

default.zh: 通过本课程的学习使学生熟悉和掌握如何运用电路知识来解决传感、测量、驱动以及控制任务中的具体问题。加强学生对电子电路基础知识与系统设计总体思想融合的深入理解；如何围绕实际工程需求，来选用或设计具体种类与形式的电路解决实际问题，实现预期的功能与技术指标；通过实验与工程实践，培养学生综合运用精密电子、电路知识和工程技术进行系统设计、实验以及数据分析和处理的能力。为学生未来从事精密仪器研究、高端装备研制等相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下基础。课程具体目标如下： 1、掌握解决电路问题所需的工程基础知识，并能将其应用于解决复杂和精密测控电路问题； 2、具备设计基本模拟、数字电路关键环节以及关键参数的能力； 3、能基于特定条件和解决方案进行设计计算，完成总体电路原理结构、单元系统的设计和关键电子元件的优化选取，同时具备考虑方案中有关健康、安全等因素的能力； 4、能撰写有关电子电路技术的实验报告、课程设计（论文）等文件，能够陈述并清晰表达相关文件内容； 5、能够自主学习相关电路技术，分工协作完成课程中相关实验内容，验证对应原理和现象。
default.en: Through the study of this course, students will be familiar with and master how to use circuit knowledge to solve specific problems in sensing, measuring, driving and control tasks. Strengthen students' in-depth understanding of the integration of basic knowledge of electronic circuits and the overall idea of system design; How to select or design specific types and forms of circuits to solve practical problems and achieve the expected functions and technical indicators around the actual engineering needs; Through experiments and engineering practice, students' ability to comprehensively use precision electronics, circuit knowledge and engineering technology for system design, experiment, data analysis and processing is cultivated. It will lay a foundation for students' future study, research and development in precision instrument research, high-end equipment development and other related technical fields. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: 1. Master the basic engineering knowledge required to solve circuit problems, and be able to apply it to solve complex and precision measurement and control circuit problems; 2、 Have the ability to design key links and key parameters of basic analog and digital circuits; 3. Be able to carry out design calculation based on specific conditions and solutions, complete the design of the overall circuit principle structure, unit system and the optimization selection of key electronic components, and have the ability to consider the health, safety and other factors in the scheme; 4. Be able to write experimental reports, course designs (Papers) and other documents related to electronic circuit technology, and be able to state and clearly express the contents of relevant documents; 5. Be able to independently learn relevant circuit technology, complete the relevant experimental content in the course by division of labor and cooperation, and verify the corresponding principles and phenomena.

default.zh: 本门课程针对仪器科学与技术各专业方向对学生的要求，从工程技术应用出发，以光电检测系统中光电转换环节所涉及到的光电检测器件为核心，深入浅出的阐述光电发射器件、光电导器件、光伏器件、热电器件、成像器件、光调制器件等各类器件的光电效应原理和现象，重点介绍光电器件的特性、典型参数、使用要点、输入电路等内容。采用启发式案例教学法，将典型光电检测系统与光电器件建立直观、有效的联系。在光电检测系统的分析设计环节，引导学生逆向思考，选择合适的光电检测器件，介绍光电检测系统的噪声特性、频率特性的计算方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生对光电检测器件的选取、使用、设计有较为深刻的理解，初步具备设计、搭建、完整分析光电检测系统的能力。
default.en: This course aims to meet the requirements of students in various fields of instrument science and technology. Starting from the application of engineering technology, it focuses on the optoelectric detection devices involved in the optoelectric conversion process of optoelectric detection systems. It provides a simple and easy explanation of the optoelectric effect principles and phenomena of various devices such as optoelectric emission devices, photoconductive devices, photovoltaic devices, thermoelectric devices, imaging devices, light modulators, etc., with a focus on introducing the characteristics, typical parameters, usage points, input circuits, and other contents of optoelectric devices. Using heuristic case teaching method, establish an intuitive and effective connection between typical optoelectric detection systems and optoelectric devices. In the analysis and design phase of the optoelectric detection system, guide students to think in reverse, select suitable optoelectric detection devices, and introduce the calculation methods of noise characteristics and frequency characteristics of the optoelectric detection system. Through the study of this course, students will have a profound understanding of the selection, use, and design of optoelectronic detection devices, and will have a preliminary ability to design, build, and analyze optoelectronic detection systems comprehensively.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向仪器类专业本科生和辅修仪器类专业本科生开设。本课程以讲授生物视觉系统的发展为起点，系统讲授机器视觉成像系统的要素、器件以及成像中的问题例如图像噪声、成像退化的起因和解决方法，目的是使学生理解和掌握机器视觉器件原理、现代计算光学的发展现状；本课程对照讲授生物视觉采集大量信息促进大脑处理能力的进化，讲授机器视觉的发展推动了人工智能的发展，讲授机器视觉中经典的方法例如图像滤波、边缘检测在人类的视觉系统中都有对应“算法”，使学生理解现代的深度学习的发展不断从人类大脑汲取灵感，未来智能视觉检测方法与仪器设计仍然可以从生物学宝库中获得启发。本课程从导向现代人工智能的角度，重新讲授机器视觉中的关键经典算法，意在使学生能由此去理解经典的深度学习处理视觉信息的案例，例如目标分割、识别，进而通识机器视觉的全貌。为了强化理论联系实际，课程详细阐述了应用到重大工程中的实际案例全貌；设置了操作实际机器视觉软件完成指定检测测量任务环节；设置了视觉标定验证实验环节；设置了机器视觉应用设计环节。
default.en: This course is mainly aimed at undergraduate students majoring in instrumentation and undergraduate students majoring in minor instrumentation. This course starts with the development of biological visual systems, systematically teaching the elements, components, and problems in machine vision imaging systems such as image noise and degradation, as well as their causes and solutions. The aim is to enable students to understand and master the principles of machine vision devices and the current development status of modern computational optics; This course focuses on the evolution of brain processing capabilities through the collection of large amounts of information in biological vision. The development of machine vision has driven the development of artificial intelligence, and classic methods in machine vision such as image filtering and edge detection have corresponding "algorithms" in the human visual system. It enables students to understand that the development of modern deep learning constantly draws inspiration from the human brain. In the future, intelligent visual detection methods and instrument designs can still draw inspiration from the treasure trove of biology. This course aims to re teach key classic algorithms in machine vision from the perspective of modern artificial intelligence, with the aim of enabling students to understand classic cases of deep learning processing visual information, such as object segmentation and recognition, and thus gain a general understanding of machine vision. In order to strengthen the connection between theory and practice, the course provides a detailed overview of practical cases applied to major engineering projects; Setting up actual machine vision software to complete designated detection and measurement tasks; Set up a visual calibration verification experimental stage; Established a machine vision application design phase.

default.zh: “视觉检测技术”是光电信息工程专业和测控技术及仪器专业重要的专业课，该课程是一门理论与实践相结合的课程。教学内容介绍了视觉检测技术基本组成与原理，涵盖了光源、镜头、相机、图像采集卡等视觉检测系统所有环节，并研究了机器视觉中的几类典型问题。通过实验，可以很好的得到视觉检测系统构成与研发、使用训练。 学习本课程能够掌握视觉检测的基础知识，了解该领域最先进的方法和技术，具备设计、开发专用视觉检测系统的初步能力，用来解决诸多领域中所遇到的各种非接触测量和检测问题，同时也为高附加值、高市场成长率的光电信息产业培养实际所需人才。 课程采用累加式考察，最终成绩由出勤与课堂表现、实验、大作业、结课报告几部分组成。
default.en: Computer vision detection technology is set as an important specialized course for the department of the technology of photoelectric information. Its instructional target is to make the students study and master the basic principles and primary knowledge of computer vision detection, and also know the most advanced methods and techniques in this area. Through this course, students are provided with the elementary capability for designing and developing the computer vision detection system to resolve the various measuring and testing problems in the Non-contect detection projects. Meanwhile, it can also cultivate practical required personnel with the ability for the photoelectric information industry with high added value and high growing rate market.

default.zh: “数字图像处理”涉及数学、计算机科学、光电信号处理、人工智能、仪器等多个学科或领域，是一门兼具交叉性和开放性的课程。数字图像处理技术利用计算机或数字系统对图像进行转换、加工、分析和处理，以强化其视觉效果，满足实际应用需要或达到识别理解的目的，是实用性强且不断发展的技术。 本课程系统地讲解数字图像处理技术的基本方法、基本原理、程序实现以及实际应用。课程具体内容包括图像处理基本概念、图像获取、图像变换、图像增强、图像分割以及图像特征识别等，覆盖了常用图像处理技术。为了适应先进光电仪器发展需求，将最新智能处理技术(如神经网络技术、寻优算法等)融入到本课程内容，借此开拓学生视野，介绍图像处理领域的前沿学术发展动态和未来趋势。结合课后习题、复杂图像处理问题、以及综合实验等实践环节加强对数字图像处理技术的理解。 仪器科学与技术专业学生通过本课程可掌握多种二维数据处理方法，毕业后可将其应用到相关工程和项目研究工作中，并具备开发图像处理类工程软件的基本能力。
default.en: Digital image processing involves multiple disciplines or fields such as mathematics, computer science, optoelectronic signal processing, artificial intelligence, instruments, etc. It is a course that combines intersection and openness. Digital image processing technology utilizes computers or digital systems to convert, process, analyze, and process images to enhance their visual effects, meet practical application needs, or achieve recognition and understanding purposes. It is a highly practical and continuously evolving technology. This course systematically explains the basic methods, principles, program implementation, and practical applications of digital image processing technology. The specific content of the course includes basic concepts of image processing, image acquisition, image transformation, image enhancement, image segmentation, and image feature recognition, covering commonly used image processing techniques. In order to meet the development needs of advanced optoelectronic instruments, the latest intelligent processing technologies (such as neural network technology, optimization algorithms, etc.) will be integrated into the content of this course, in order to broaden students' horizons and introduce the cutting-edge academic development trends and future trends in the field of image processing. Strengthen the understanding of digital image processing technology through practical exercises, complex image processing problems, and comprehensive experiments. Students majoring in Instrument Science and Technology can master various two-dimensional data processing methods through this course. After graduation, they can apply them to related engineering and project research work, and have the basic ability to develop image processing engineering software.

default.zh: 光机电一体化设计与设备是一门综合课程，其重点在于介绍光机电一体化技术的工程应用方法和实现方法，课程在介绍基本原理同时，强调实际应用以及实际动手开发能力，同时重视学生独立创新的思路和想法。由于光机电一体化技术是微电子技术、计算机技术、控制技术、光学技术及机械技术的相互交叉与融合，是诸多高新技术产业和高新技术装备的基础，因此在讲课内容上力求及时地反映光机电一体化技术在国内外的最新进展，并利用实际工作科研进一步进行详细分析。
default.en: This is an integrated curriculum which emphasize on the description of the engineering application methods and the realization methods of optical-electronic-machinery integration technique. When basic principles are presented in the curriculum, student’s abilities of practical application and self-development, as well as their innovative idea, are paid more attention. Since optical-electronic-machinery integration technique is the overlapping and fusion of microelectronic technology, computer technology, control technology, optical technology and mechanical technology, and it is also the base for new high technology industry and equipment, contents of lecture timely reflect the latest development of optical-electronic-machinery integration technique at home and abroad. Furthermore, detailed analysis is made through combing practical scientific research work.

default.zh: 振动是自然界最普遍的现象之一。大至宇宙，小至原子粒子，无不存在着振动。随着现代科技和工业的迅猛进步，这些振动对许多领域，特别是航空航天、精密制造和光学仪器等，带来了前所未有的挑战。因此，精密隔振技术应运而生，成为了确保设备性能稳定、精度高超的关键。 精密隔振理论与技术，作为一门跨学科的综合课程，巧妙融合了力学、控制科学、材料科学等多领域的精髓；不仅注重理论知识的深度，更强调实践技能的掌握，致力于培养学生的创新思维和跨学科思维能力。课程内容紧密关注精密隔振技术的最新研究成果和发展趋势，同时不忘实用性和工程应用的重要性，为学生未来的科研和工程实践提供坚实的知识基础和实践支持。学习这门课程后，学生不仅能够深入理解精密隔振技术的核心原理，还将掌握其实际应用技能。 本课程以理论教学为，主共计24学时，1.5学分。在教学内容上，主要介绍单自由度振动系统、多自由度振动系统、振动的数值计算方法和振动控制等内容，着重讨论它们的基本理论、分析方法及其在工程中应用。在教学方法方面，通过课堂讲解、案例分析，随堂测试与结题报告，使学生全面掌握精密隔振技术的核心知识和实践技能，培养学生的创新思维和解决问题能力，进而提升综合素质。在学习成效评估方面，采用出勤、课堂互动、结题报告与PPT讲解等考核方式衡量学生对精密隔振技术的掌握程度与实际应用能力。 本课程通过精心设计的理论教学与考核评估体系，旨在为学生提供一次全面学习精密隔振技术的机会，同时培养他们成为具备创新精神和实践能力的高素质人才。
default.en: Vibration is one of the most universal phenomena in nature. It exists in everything from the universe to atomic particles. With the rapid progress of modern technology and industry, these vibrations have brought unprecedented challenges to many fields, especially aerospace, precision manufacturing and optical instruments. Therefore, the precision vibration isolation technology came into being and became the key to ensure the stable performance and high precision of the equipment. Precision Vibration Isolation Theory and Technology, as an interdisciplinary comprehensive course, skillfully integrates the essence of mechanics, control science, materials science and other disciplines. This course not only focuses on the depth of theoretical knowledge, but also emphasizes the mastery of practical skills, and is committed to cultivating the innovation and interdisciplinary mindset of students. The content of this course follows closely the latest research results and trends in precision vibration isolation technology, while maintaining the importance of practicality and engineering applications. Therefore, it provides students with a solid foundation of professional knowledge and practical support for their future scientific research and engineering practice. Through the study of this course, not only can students gain an in-depth understanding of the core principles of precision vibration isolation technology, but they will also master its practical application skills. This course is based on theory teaching, with a total of 24 credit hours and 1.5 credits. In terms of teaching content, it mainly introduces single-degree-of-freedom vibration systems, multi-degree-of-freedom vibration systems, numerical calculation methods of vibration and its control, and focuses on discussing their basic theories, analysis methods and their applications in engineering. In terms of teaching methods, the combination of lectures, case studies, follow-up tests and conclusive report enables students to fully grasp the core knowledge and practical skills of precision vibration isolation technology, as well as cultivate their innovation and problem solving ability, and then enhance their comprehensive quality. In the evaluation part, we adopt a method combining attendance, classroom interaction, conclusive report and PPT presentation to measure students' mastery of precision vibration isolation technology and practical application ability. Through well-designed theory teaching and evaluation system, this course aims to provide students with an opportunity to learn precision vibration isolation technology in a comprehensive way, and at the same time, train them to become high-quality talents with innovative spirit and practical ability.

default.zh: 本课程是管理与技术相结合的一门系统化课程，涉及到现代企业管理、产品质量控制、产品可靠性设计与制造技术、现代测试技术、技术经济学、管理信息系统、概率论及数理统计等多门学科的知识结构，使本科生能够从“大系统”和“社会需求”的角度来了解并掌握“质量”的广义含义以及产品生命周期各个环节所涵盖的有关质量的基本知识，包括基本的质量设计、可靠性设计、质量控制等理论方法和技术。
default.en: Quality Engineering & Reliability Design is a systematized course which relates management with technology. This course concerns multiple knowledge structures of multi-disciplines, such as modern enterprise management, product quality control, product reliability design and manufacturing technology, modern measuring and testing technique, technical economics, management information systems, probability theory and mathematical statistics. Via the study of the course, undergraduates would understand and grasp the generalized signification of “Quality”, and the elementary knowledge on quality covered by every tache of product lifecycle, on the viewpoint of “large-scale systems” and “social needs”. Furthermore, the course includes prime theoretical methods and techniques, for example, quality design, reliability design, quality control, and so on.

default.zh: 轴承状态监测技术是一门综合性技术，它与轴承的性能和运行规律密切相关，其内涵包括故障诊断、健康监测和寿命预测等。它的实施过程主要包括信号采集、信号处理、状态识别和诊断决策等。本课程主要包括以下教学内容： 1、简要介绍常见的轴承监测手段，讲解监测信号特征与轴承状态的内在关系； 2、讲解轴承信号处理流程，包括分析、去噪、滤波等算法； 3、讲解轴承信号特征提取算法，包括时域、频域、时频域等算法； 4、讲解机器学习及深度学习方法，进行轴承故障诊断与寿命预测等内容的应用学习； 本课程授课对象为工科专业大二年级以上学生，学生需具备一定的数学基础。本课程的教学目标为讲解轴承状态监测的相关技术，通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解常见的轴承状态监测手段，对于轴承状态监测信号的处理流程具有全面的了解，并掌握对应的信号处理技术，能够应用人工智能技术进行轴承故障诊断与寿命预测等。本课程的特色与创新之处在于，将人工智能技术应用于轴承状态监测，利用人工智能强大的学习和数据处理能力，为轴承状态监测提供强有力的技术手段，通过实际操作加深学生对人工智能技术的理解和掌握。
default.en: Condition monitoring technology for bearings is a comprehensive technology that is closely related to the performance and operating patterns of bearings. Its scope includes fault diagnosis, health monitoring, and life prediction. The implementation process mainly involves signal acquisition, signal processing, condition identification, and diagnostic decision-making. This course mainly includes the following teaching contents: 1. A brief introduction to common bearing monitoring methods and an explanation of the intrinsic relationship between monitoring signal characteristics and bearing conditions. 2. An explanation of the signal processing procedures for bearings, including algorithms for analysis, noise reduction, and filtering. 3. An explanation of algorithms for feature extraction from bearing signals, including algorithms in the time domain, frequency domain, and time-frequency domain. 4. An explanation of machine learning and deep learning methods, with application learning for bearing fault diagnosis and life prediction. The target audience for this course is students in engineering majors from the second year and above, who are required to have a certain mathematical foundation. The teaching objective of this course is to explain the relevant technologies for bearing condition monitoring. Through the study of this course, students will be able to understand common bearing condition monitoring methods, have a comprehensive understanding of the signal processing procedures for bearing condition monitoring, master the corresponding signal processing techniques, and apply artificial intelligence technologies for bearing fault diagnosis and life prediction. The unique and innovative aspect of this course is the application of artificial intelligence technology to bearing condition monitoring. By leveraging the powerful learning and data processing capabilities of artificial intelligence, this course provides a robust technical means for bearing condition monitoring and deepens students' understanding and mastery of artificial intelligence technologies through practical operations.

default.zh: 光纤通讯技术是光电信息工程专业主要专业课之一。 光纤通信以光波作为信息载体、以光导纤维作为传输介质，具有巨大的带宽和极低的传输损耗，因而正在成为信息时代最主要的信息传输方式。 开设本课程使学生在掌握光纤通信基本理论的同时，较深入地学习光波导理论，使其具备从事光通信器件生产、制造、性能测试等工作的专业知识。 基本内容：掌握光纤通信系统的组成及各环节的功能，光纤的结构与导波原理，光纤的特性与测试方法，接收与发射以及光纤网络器件的工作原理。
default.en: Fiber-Optical Communications Technology is one of the main specialized courses of Optoelectronic Information Technology and Instrumentation Engineering. Fiber-Optical Communications is a technology that transfers information with light wave through fiber, the bandwidth of which is wider and the wastage lower. And it is becoming the uppermost way of information transmission in the age of information. Students will get further knowledge of the wave-guide Theory of Light, and be equipped with professional knowledge of work, such as producing, manufacturing, and capability testing of optical communications devices. Basic contents: To learn the constitute of the fiber-optical communications system and functions of all parts, structure of fiber, the theory of wave-guide, the property and testing way of fiber and the working principle of receiving, the working principle of sending and fiber network devices.

default.zh: 本课程使学生在掌握红外技术的基本概念、基本定律以及基本物理量的基础上，掌握红外光学系统的基本设计方法，并较好地掌握红外探测器和红外测温技术的国内外研究现状。本课程的主要内容包括红外辐射的基本特征、辐射测温学的基本概念、基本定律以及基本物理量、黑体辐射源、 辐射在大气中的传输、辐射温度计的分类、设计、标定及应用以及辐射温度计的数据处理方法。
default.en: This course is designed for students to master basic concepts, fundamental principle and physical quantity of infrared technology, which also provides students with basic design methods of Infrared optical system and the latest research status at home and abroad in the field of Infrared detector and infrared temperature measurement technology. This course covers basic feature of radiation, basic concepts, fundamental principle and physical quantity of radiation thermometry, source of black-body radiation, radiation transfer in the atmosphere, classify, designing, calibration and applications of radiation thermometer and data processing algorithm of radiation thermometer.

default.zh: 激光在光学科学中占有特殊的地位，因为它的用途广，深入的领域多，对科技、经济、军事、社会发展的影响大。激光及相关技术已成为当今最主要的光学手段与技术，课程讲解将围绕激光的主要特点和相关技术进行。 本门课程是测控与光电专业重要的基础课程，课程从激光的基本原理讲起，首先阐述作为激光产生物理基础的受激辐射理论，进而介绍围绕该理论激光产生所必须的激励、增益、放大等主要过程；然后介绍激光谐振腔结构与模式特点、激光线宽、输出功率等影响因素，并围绕高斯光束主要特征进行了重点介绍；此后介绍了激光器性能的控制与改善技术；最后对典型激光器分类及主要应用进行介绍。 通过本课的学习，使学生了解激光的产生机理、特性、与物质之间的相互作用，激光器的种类、用途等。学生以工程技术和应用研究为主要方向，所以，本课程的讲解力图为激光应用打下理论基础。
default.en: Laser in the optical science occupies a special status, because it is widely used, in-depth areas, science and technology, economy, military, social development, a great impact. Laser and related technology has become the most important optical means and technology, the course will focus on the main features of the laser and related technology. This course is an important basic course of measurement and control and optoelectronics. The course begins with the basic principle of laser. First, the theory of stimulated radiation as the basis of laser physics is expounded, and the necessary excitation, gain and amplification of the theory laser are introduced. And then the main factors of laser resonator structure and mode characteristics, laser line width, output power and other factors, and around the Gaussian beam main features were introduced; then introduced the laser performance control and improvement technology; Finally, the typical laser Classification and the main application of the introduction. Through the study of this lesson, so that students understand the mechanism of laser, characteristics, and the interaction between the material, the type of laser, use and so on. Students to engineering technology and applied research as the main direction, so the course of explanation for the laser application to lay the theoretical basis.

default.zh: 《电子电气仪器设计》是测控技术及仪器专业的一门主修课程，是一门综合性、实践性很强的专业课。课程从总体设计角度出发，对仪器共性的核心问题进行讲解，介绍电子电气仪器设计的基础内容，对仪器的误差原理、实用硬件电路、核心软件技术设计方法作以介绍，并给出仪器综合设计的实例，突出电子电气仪器设计的应用性和实践性。课程系统地阐述了电气电子仪器的原理、主要技术和设计方法，讲授的具体内容包括：电气电子仪器概述、嵌入式处理技术、数据采集技术、模拟量与数字量输出技术、波形记录与波形输出技术、仪器外设处理及测量结果可视化技术、仪器通信及总线接口技术、数据处理及程序设计、基于智能理论的信息处理技术、仪器的自检、自校准与自动测量技术、仪器的软硬件抗干扰技术、电气电子仪器的设计方法与应用实例、电气电子仪器课程设计等。本课程的体系结构在于从整机的角度阐述电气电子仪器的设计原理和设计方法，通过实验和课程设计等实践环节使学生加深对课程内容的理解，为学生扎实掌握电气电子仪器的原理，进而进行仪器的设计奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: “Electronic and electrical instrument design”is a major course of measurement control technology and instrument and it is a comprehensive and practical course. Based on the system design as well as the core problem of common instruments, the course introduces the basic content of the design of electrical and electronic instruments, the errors of instrument principle, practical hardware circuits and core software technology design methods. Also, it takes the instrument design for examples and provides the outstanding applications of electronic and electrical instrument. This course systematically introduces the principle of electrical and electronic instruments, main techniques and design methods. The content of the course consists of the following parts: overview of electrical and electronic instruments, embedded processing technology, data acquisition technology, analog and digital output technology, waveform recording and waveform output technology, instrument peripheral processing and visualization of measurement results, instrument communication and bus interface technology, data processing and program design, information processing technology based on intelligent theory, self test, self calibration and automatic measurement technology, instruments anti-jamming technology, examples of instrument design, etc. This course aims to describe the principle and design methods of instruments from the perspective of the whole machine. Assisted with experiment and curriculum design, it will help students reinforce their understanding of the course content, which may lay a solid foundation for mastering the principles and design of electrical and electronic instruments.

default.zh: 《过程控制技术与系统》课程适合于精密仪器、测控技术与仪器、智能感知工程等相关专业专业本科生，是测控相关专业的专业课程之一。《过程控制技术与系统》课程是一门理论性和实践性都很强的专业课程，课程主要讲解控制技术与系统（以过程控制为主）的理论知识与系统构成，重点讲解控制系统的组成、结构以及控制系统设计方法。使学生在完成本课程的学习后，了解控制系统中系统建模、信号检测、控制器设计及相关器件的基本原理，形成测控系统的基本概念。掌握控制技术与系统的基本概念、控制系统的组成、结构以及控制系统设计方法，使学生针对具体的应用需求，具备基本自动化系统工程设计能力。
default.en: The course "Process Control Technology and Systems" is designed for undergraduate students majoring in Precision Instrumentation, Measuring and Control Technology and Instruments, Intelligent Perception Engineering, and related fields. It serves as one of the key professional courses for students in measuring and control - related programs. This course is characterized by a strong combination of theoretical and practical aspects. It primarily focuses on the theoretical knowledge and system composition of control technology and systems, with an emphasis on process control. Important topics include the components, structure, and design methods of control systems. By the end of the course, students will have a good understanding of the fundamental principles of system modeling, signal detection, controller design, and related devices within control systems. They will also have formed a clear concept of measuring and control systems. Equipped with this knowledge, students will master the essential concepts of control technology and systems, including the components, structure, and design methods of control systems. This will empower them with the ability to design basic automated system projects tailored to specific application requirements.

default.zh: 自动检测技术是电子信息与电气学科的一个重要分支，以传感器为核心的检测技术，与自动控制技术、计算机技术等一起构成了信息技术的完成学科，而且正在成为自动化系统、物联网和信息领域的源头与基石。本门课程主要介绍自动检测技术及仪表的基础理论，重点讲解各类检测仪表的基本原理及检测仪表系统的原理方法。同时也介绍自动检测技术及仪表实际应用、自动检测技术发展的状况和新成果。课程旨在奠定学生在自动检测技术领域的理论基础，通过掌握自动检测技术的基本概念、基本原理、仪表结构和自动检测系统的设计方法，培养学生分析和解决实际问题的能力。 “自动检测技术”课程适合于测控技术与仪器专业及其它相关专业，是测控技术与仪器专业的专业选修课程之一。该课程理论性及实践性都很高。先修课程为：《误差理论与不确定度分析》、《模拟电子技术基础》等 。课程教学目的是使学生掌握自动检测技术及仪表的基本概念、定律和应用方法，具备基本的自动检测技术及仪表的设计能力。课程内容主要包括：自动检测技术及仪表的理论基础、温度、压力、流量测量仪表基本原理、仪表的组成、结构以及误差分析。考核采用平时成绩与期末考核相结合的方法。
default.en: Automatic Measurement Technology is an important branch of electronic information and electrical disciplines. The measurement technology with sensors as the core, together with automatic control technology and computer technology, constitutes the completed discipline of information technology. It is also becoming the source and cornerstone in field of automation systems, Internet of Things (IoT) and information. The basic theory of automatic detection technology and instruments, which focusing on the basic principles of various detection instruments and the principles and methods of detection instrument systems are mainly introduced in this course. At the same time, it also introduces the actual application of automatic measurement technology and instruments, the development status and new achievements of automatic measurement technology. The course aims to lay the students' theoretical foundation in the field of automatic measurement technology, and cultivates students' ability to analyze and solve practical problems by mastering the basic concepts, basic principles, instrument structure and design methods of automatic detection technology. “Automation Measurement Technology” faces the Specialty of Measurement and Control Technology and Instrumentation , Dept. of Automatic Testing and Control and other correlative specialties. This course is one of the central courses of Specialty of Measurement and Control Technology and Instrumentation, which have very high theory and practice. Students should learn《Error Theory》，《Analog Electronics Circuits 》first. The teaching purpose is to make students master the basic concept of automation measurement technology and instrument，theirs laws and application method. Meanwhile, students should have the ability of designing the automation measurement instrument. The teaching contents include the basic theory of automation measurement technology and instrument，the methods of measuring the parameters of temperature，the methods of measuring the parameters of pressure，the methods of measuring the parameters of flux, the basic theory, constitutes, structure of instrument and error analysis. The assessing method combines usual grades with final examination.

default.zh: 工业计算机断层扫描技术简称工业 CT或 ICT，利用射线穿过物体发生衰减这一性质，将传感器获得的数据进行重建从而获得被检测物体的三维灰度图像，清晰、准确、直观地反映物体的内部结构、材料密度和缺损状况，在无损检测和无损评价领域得到了广泛运用，是公认的最佳无损检测手段。工业 CT成像技术结合了计算机技术、自动控制、机械、光学、图像学等多学科知识，拥有一套较为完整的理论体系。因此，本课程的开设对学生融会所学知识、提升专业能力、坚定“仪器报国”决心等将起到重要作用。 本课程将全面介绍工业CT的组成、原理、应用等相关知识，内容包括：X射线物理基础、CT扫描机的发展历史与核心元部件、CT成像与重建算法、伪影分析、重要性能参数介绍、计算机仿真与分析、相衬CT成像设备与原理、应用实例介绍，以及实验课等。 精密仪器、测控技术与仪器、智能感知工程等专业本科生及辅修本科生通过对本课程的学习，可系统掌握工业CT在体视觉检测、测量领域的相关知识，达成以下目标：①提升光电测量与仪器设计领域复杂工程问题所需的光学基础理论知识；②能够应用吸收衬度成像、相位衬度成像等CT成像基本原理，对精密测量与仪器设计领域的复杂工程问题进行条件假设、模型构建和知识表达；③能够基于X射线成像基本原理搭建实验平台、采用科学的实验方法获取实验数据，并分析实验数据的合理性；④能够通过文献检索工具，获取CT基本原理在精密测量与仪器设计领域的最新应用及研究进展。
default.en: Industrial computer tomography (ICT) utilizes the property of radiation attenuation through objects to reconstruct the data obtained from sensors and obtain a three-dimensional grayscale image of the object being tested, which can clearly, accurately, and intuitively reflect the internal structure, material density, and defect status of the object. ICT has been widely used in the fields of non-destructive testing & evaluation and, now, is recognized as the best non-destructive testing method. As we known, ICT imaging technology combines multidisciplinary knowledge such as computer technology, automatic control, machinery, optics, and imaging, and has a relatively complete theoretical system. Therefore, this course will play an important role in helping the students to integrate their knowledge learned, enhance professional abilities, and strengthen their determination to serve the country. This course will comprehensively introduce the composition, principles, and applications of industrial CT, including the fundamentals of X-ray physics, the development history and core components of CT scanners, CT imaging and reconstruction algorithms, artifact analysis, introduction of the important performance parameters, computer simulation and analysis, introduction of phase contrast CT imaging equipment and principles, application examples, and experimental courses. Through the study of this course, undergraduate students majoring in precision instruments, measurement and control technology and instruments, intelligent perception engineering, etc. can systematically master the relevant knowledge of industrial CT in the field of body-vision detection & measurement, and achieve the following goals: (1) Enhance the optical basic theoretical knowledge required for complex engineering problems in the field of optoelectronic measurement and instrument design; (2) Capable of applying basic principles of CT imaging such as absorption contrast imaging and phase contrast imaging, to make conditional assumptions, model construction, and knowledge expression for complex engineering problems in the fields of precision measurement and instrument design; (3) Be able to build an experimental platform based on the basic principles of X-ray imaging, use scientific experimental methods to obtain experimental data, and analyze the rationality of experimental data; (4) The latest applications and research progress of CT basic principles in precision measurement and instrument design can be obtained through literature search tools.

default.zh: 医学超声是声学、医学、光学及电子学相结合的学科。本课程主要介绍了医用超声诊疗技术的医用超声诊断技术和医用超声治疗技术两大类：医用超声诊断技术分为B超、多普勒超声、超声听诊器、血管内超声、超声内窥镜和超声CT等诊断技术；而医用超声治疗技术包含了体外超声碎石、超声雾化治疗、超声乳化、聚焦超声治疗、声动力治疗和超声手术刀等治疗技术。通过对本课程的学习，结合相关基础知识，通过课程讲解、实验实践等环节，培养学生的科学思维能力和动手能力，以及培养学生的科研素质和激起学生的研究兴趣，为学生顺进一步学习和从事研究工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Medical ultrasound is a combination of acoustics, medicine, optics and electronics. This course mainly introduces medical ultrasonic diagnosis technology and medical ultrasonic treatment technology in two categories: medical ultrasonic diagnosis technology is divided into B ultrasound, Doppler ultrasound, ultrasonic stethoscope, intravascular ultrasound, ultrasonic endoscope and ultrasonic CT diagnosis technology; The medical ultrasound treatment technology includes extracorporeal ultrasonic lithotripsy, ultrasonic atomization therapy, phacoemulsification, focused ultrasound therapy, sonodynamic therapy and ultrasonic scalpel. Through the study of this course, combined with relevant basic knowledge, through the course explanation, experimental practice and other links, to cultivate students' scientific thinking ability and practical ability, cultivate students' scientific research quality and arouse students' research interest, and lay a solid foundation for students to further study and engage in research work.

default.zh: 没有期末笔试考试，课程成绩为：课程大作业(学习报告）成绩70%，平时成绩30%共同组成。 光谱仪器是一门将光学技术与电子技术及计算机技术相结合的仪器。是光学仪器重要的组成部分，在航天、深空探测、资源及水文探测、军事、冶金、地质、石油、化工、医药卫生、气象、环境卫生、食品及药品等领域中有重要的应用。本课为本科生开设目的是让学生了解最新的光谱仪器发展动态，掌握主要的光谱仪器原理与测量方法，了解常用的光谱仪器或系统，了解常规的光谱分析方法，了解光谱仪器的重要应用。传授学生在光谱学和光谱分析方面的知识，奠定学生设计光谱仪器（系统）的基础，培养其实际研究与科研的能力。
default.en: There is no final written exam for the course, and the course score consists of 70% for the major assignment (study report) and 30% for regular assignments. Spectral instrument is an instrument combing optical technology, electronic technology and computer technology. It is a more important branch of optical instruments. This course has important application in the fields of spaceflight, deep space exploration, exploration of resource and geohydrology, military, metallurgy, geology, petroleum, chemical industry, medicine and hygiene, meteorology, environmental hygiene, food and drug. The course is established for undergraduate to learn the newest development trend of spectrscopy measurement instrument, to study main concept and theory of spectroscopy, the principle and methods implementing spectroscopy, to understand the general instrument and system of spectroscopy, to know routine spectroscopy analysis method and its important application. The goal is to delivery the knowledge of spectroscopy technology, construct the foundation to design spectroscopy instrument (or system), to train the research ability on the practical questions.

default.zh: 磁悬浮电机是一种定子和动子无接触运行的特种电机。本课程以磁悬浮平面电机为对象，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握磁悬浮平面电机的基本结构、原理和特点；掌握磁悬浮平面电机电磁力与电磁力矩建模，掌握模型验证的主要方法；掌握磁悬浮平面电机线圈阵列的换流方法，包括磁悬浮平面电机六自由度运动电气驱动的基本原理与方法；掌握磁悬浮平面电机各自由度运动的动力学特性，并能对运动控制要求设计合适的控制器；掌握磁悬浮平面电机六自由度受控条件下的悬浮运动控制；了解磁悬浮电机的未来发展趋势和应用。
default.en: The magnetic levitation motor is a specialized type of motor that operates without contact between the stator and rotor. This course focuses on the magnetic levitation planar motor. Through the study of this course, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the basic structure, principles, and characteristics of magnetic levitation planar motors. They will master the modeling of electromagnetic forces and electromagnetic torque in magnetic levitation planar motors, along with key methods for model validation. Additionally, students will acquire proficiency in the commutation methods for coil arrays in magnetic levitation planar motors, including the fundamental principles and methods of the six-degree-of-freedom electrical drive. The course aims to provide an understanding of the dynamic characteristics of each degree of freedom in the motion of magnetic levitation planar motors, enabling students to design suitable controllers for motion control requirements. Students will also master the control of suspended motion under the conditions of six degrees of freedom for magnetic levitation planar motors. The course covers an exploration of the future development trends and applications of magnetic levitation motors. Upon completion, students will be well-equipped to comprehend the intricacies of magnetic levitation planar motors and apply this knowledge in designing and controlling these systems. Additionally, they will be informed about the evolving trends and potential applications of magnetic levitation motor technology.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍惯性传感技术中角速率陀螺和线加速度计的具体分类和工作原理等，重点讲解由速率陀螺和线加速度计所组成的惯性测量单元的测量原理和应用，通过对各个传感器的学习过程中了解并掌握其中的惯性测量技术，同时开展各个传感器的实验测试和数据分析。 通过本课程的学习，使学生了解并熟悉各类惯性传感器的工作原理和系统特性，能够掌握惯性传感的相关技术。同时，通过教学过程培养学生对理论力学、控制技术、计算机技术等知识的综合运用能力，最终使学生具备光纤传感设备的设计能力、仪器仪表开发能力、信息处理能力，为学生以后从事相关工作奠定一定的理论基础。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the specific classification and working principles of angular rate gyroscopes and linear accelerometers in inertial sensing technology, with a focus on explaining the measurement principles and applications of inertial measurement units composed of rate gyroscopes and linear accelerometers. Through the learning process of each sensor, students can understand and master the inertial measurement technology, and conduct experimental testing and data analysis of each sensor. Through the study of this course, students will understand and become familiar with the working principles and system characteristics of various inertial sensors, and be able to master the relevant technologies of inertial sensing. At the same time, through the teaching process, students are trained to have comprehensive application abilities in theoretical mechanics, control technology, computer technology, and other knowledge, ultimately enabling them to have the design ability of fiber optic sensing equipment, instrument development ability, and information processing ability, laying a certain theoretical foundation for their future work in related fields.

default.zh: 本课程以量子导航技术为教学内容，通过授课、研讨等方式使学生了解当前量子导航关键技术研究现状、掌握各类技术手段基本思想与原理，通过设计专题研究模式，引领学生学会对具体选题进行研究，学会检索文献、设计研究方案、撰写研究报告、宣讲研究成果；进而培养学生自主学习、独立思考、自由表达能力；培养学生的科学素养、创新意识、科学精神、批判性思维，为学生提供研究性学习的机会，激发学生研究兴趣，从而引领学生开展科学研究。
default.en: This course takes quantum navigation technology as the teaching content, through lectures, seminars and other ways to make students understand the current research status of key quantum navigation technologies, master the basic ideas and principles of all kinds of technical means, through the design of the thematic research mode, leading students to learn to study specific selected topics, learn to search the literature, design the research program, write a research report, and present the research results; and then cultivate the students' independent learning, independent thinking, free expression ability; cultivate students' scientific literacy, innovative consciousness, scientific spirit, critical thinking, provide students with opportunities for research study, stimulate students' research interests, and thus lead students to carry out scientific research.

default.zh: 通过本课程，学生能够了解水下自主航行器发展现状，掌握水下自主导航方法与手段，学习水下智能感知技术，认识水下自主航行器未来发展趋势。此外，学生能够综合运用专业基础知识和工程技术进行导航系统设计、传感器测试与分析，为学生未来从事相关领域并解决实际工程问题打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Through this course, students will be able to understand the current development of autonomous underwater vehicles, understand the methods and means of autonomous underwater navigation, learn the underwater intelligent perception technology, and understand the future development trend of autonomous underwater vehicles. In addition, students are able to apply a combination of professional fundamentals and engineering skills to navigation system design, sensor testing and analysis, providing a solid foundation for future careers in related fields and solving practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 现代卫星导航系统可以全天时、全天候和全球性地为陆地、海洋和空间运动载体提供高精度、连续、实时的导航状态参数和三维姿态参数，是二十世纪发展起来的新兴学科，是继惯性导航系统成功应用于导航领域后的又一次重大技术突破，被誉为二十世纪导航技术史上的一次革命。 卫星导航及应用是仪器科学与技术学科中的一门重要专业理论课，是测控技术与仪器专业的一个重要分支。本课程旨在让学生掌握仪器科学与技术学科所需的卫星导航基础理论知识，系统全面地了解卫星导航原理、技术、系统应用和发展趋势。本课程叙述卫星导航系统的发展历史、现状及现代化历程，阐述卫星导航、定位、授时的基本原理及其相关基础知识，包括导航坐标系、时间系统、卫星通讯技术和伪随机编码技术，介绍GPS、GLONASS、GALILEO以及我国的“北斗”卫星导航系统的基本原理、系统组成和信号体制，阐述卫星定位的各种导航算法、误差分析。通过课程学习，使学生全面了解卫星导航的基本原理、导航算法、误差分析，熟悉各种卫星导航算法及影响定位精度的因素，能够操作、使用GPS接收机并利用原始数据解算定位结果。
default.en: Modern GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) is a satellite system that is used to pinpoint the geographic location and attitude of a user's receiver anywhere and anytime in the world. Also, the GNSS is new disciplines developed and another important technical breakthrough after the successful application of inertial navigation system, which is hailed as a revolution in the history of navigation technology in twentieth Century. The theory and application of GNSS is one of the important professional courses in Instrument Science and Technology discipline, and is an important branch of measurement and control technology and instrument specialty. The purpose of the course is to let the students master the basic theory knowledge of GNSS which is required for the subject of Instrumental Science and Technology, and knows the principle, technology, system application and development trend of satellite navigation system. The course details the history, status, and modernization of the satellite system, and also describes some basic knowledge of satellite navigation, positioning, and timing, such as navigation coordinate system, time system, and satellite communication technology. Some typical satellite system, GPS、GLONASS、GALILEO, and Compass, are introduced in detail, including navigation algorithm, error analysis, system composition, signal structure. Through the course, students can acknowledge the basic theory, navigation algorithm, and the factors affecting positioning accuracy. Meanwhile, students can operate the GNSS receiver and calculate the position results using the raw data.

default.zh: 随着数值模拟方法不断地介入科学研究之中，并由于方法本身的不成熟，它不断引起了人们对模拟结果准确性的疑问，尤其对于涉及流动和传热过程的复杂测量系统，如核反应堆系统。相比于数值模拟方法，实验方法常作为“最终”的检验手段，很少有人怀疑实验，并天然地倾向于将实验结果作为“确定的真值”，尤其当数值模拟结果与实验结果一起出现时。实际上，实验往往也不可避免地面临不确定度问题，只是这类问题在实践过程中经常被人有意无意地忽略。对于任何一项精密测量研究工作来讲，理论分析、数值模拟和实验研究都存在不确定性的问题。为此，理论分析中测量模型的不确定性、数值模拟中算法的不确定性和实验研究中数据处理的不确定性都是导致最终测量结果不确定度的根源。本选修课针对测量对象包含但不限于几何量、热力学量、力学量、电磁量、无线电量、光学量、时间\频率量、化学量、声学量和电离辐射量等领域，介绍各类测量模型建模方法的应用和局限性，介绍GUM法和Monte-Carlo法的原理、意义和方法可靠性，介绍最小二乘法和回归分析等数据处理方法的原理、意义和假设检验，利用泰勒级数、概率论和数理统计、参数估计和系统辨识等数学方法估计总的测量不确定度，并用计算机软件实现测量不确定性的数字仿真。整个教学过程可以让学生深入了解误差理论知识，全面理解数学建模思想，系统掌握数值模拟算法，熟练运用数据处理手段和计算机仿真工具，从而提升学生举一反三，学以致用的创新能力。
default.en: With the continuous involvement of numerical simulation methods in scientific research, and due to the immaturity of the methods themselves, it has constantly raised questions about the accuracy of simulation results, especially for complex measurement systems involving flow and heat transfer processes, such as nuclear reactor systems. Compared to numerical simulation methods, experimental methods are often used as the "final" means of verification, and few people doubt experiments and naturally tend to treat experimental results as "determined true values", especially when numerical simulation results appear together with experimental results. In fact, experiments often inevitably face uncertainty issues, but such issues are often intentionally or unintentionally overlooked in the practical process. For any precision measurement research work, there are uncertainties in theoretical analysis, numerical simulation, and experimental research. Therefore, the uncertainty of measurement models in theoretical analysis, the uncertainty of algorithms in numerical simulation, and the uncertainty of data processing in experimental research are all the root causes of uncertainty in the final measurement results. This elective course is aimed at measuring objects including but not limited to geometric quantities, thermodynamic quantities, mechanical quantities, electromagnetic quantities, radio quantities, optical quantities, time/frequency quantities, chemical quantities, acoustic quantities, and ionizing radiation quantities. It introduces the applications and limitations of various measurement model modeling methods, introduces the principles, significance, and reliability of GUM and Monte Carlo methods, and introduces the principles of data processing methods such as least squares and regression analysis Meaning and hypothesis testing, using mathematical methods such as Taylor series, probability theory, mathematical statistics, parameter estimation, and system identification to estimate the total measurement uncertainty, and implementing digital simulation of measurement uncertainty using computer software. The entire teaching process can enable students to have a deep understanding of error theory knowledge, comprehensively understand mathematical modeling ideas, systematically master numerical simulation algorithms, proficiently use data processing methods and computer simulation tools, thereby enhancing their innovative ability to apply what they have learned.

default.zh: 自然科学规律通常用各种类型的数学方程式表达，科学计算的目的就是寻找这些方程式的数值解。这种计算涉及庞大的运算量，简单的计算工具难以胜任。随着计算机的迅速发展，使越来越多的复杂计算成为可能。利用计算机进行科学计算带来了巨大的经济效益，同时也使科学技术本身发生了根本变化：传统的科学技术只包括理论和试验两个组成部分，使用计算机后，计算已成为同等重要的第三个组成部分。计算过程主要包括建立数学模型、建立求解的计算方法和计算机实现三个阶段。本课程以统一而简明的方式介绍现代科学计算的基本方法及新进展，包括数值解方程、仿真模拟的思路和方法。具有大学理工科数学水平即可选择本课程，对涉及科学与工程设计计算的同学也非常有益。
default.en: The laws of natural sciences are usually expressed using various types of mathematical equations, and the purpose of scientific computing is to find numerical solutions to these equations. This kind of computation involves a huge amount of calculations that simple computing tools are unable to handle. With the rapid development of computers, more and more complex calculations have become possible. Utilizing computers for scientific computing has brought about significant economic benefits and has also fundamentally transformed science and technology itself: traditional science and technology only included theory and experimentation as two components, but with the use of computers, computation has become an equally important third component. The computational process mainly involves three stages: establishing mathematical models, developing computational methods for solving them, and implementing them on computers. This course introduces the basic methods and recent advances in modern scientific computing in a unified and concise manner, including numerical solutions to equations, as well as the concepts and methods of simulation. Students with a university-level mathematics background in science and engineering can choose this course, and it is also very beneficial for students involved in scientific and engineering design calculations.

default.zh: 《微纳传感与测量技术》课程是主要面向仪器类专业本科生和辅修仪器类专业本科生开设的一门选修课程，旨在培养学生掌握微纳传感与几何测量技术的基本原理、仪器和方法，以及解决实际精密坐标测量问题的能力。 本课程主要涉及以下几个方面的内容： （1）几何测量起源和发展：介绍加工测量技术的目的与测量对象、坐标测量技术和坐标测量机的发展； （2）坐标测量的任务：介绍几何测量的目的，几何特征的规范、互换性验证、滤波、拟合等几何测量的关键环节； （3）几何测量的基本原则、基本设备技术：介绍坐标测量技术的基本原理及坐标测量机的分类与结构及辅助设备； （4）坐标测量的核心——传感器：介绍用于坐标测量的经典传感器，包括经典接触式测量传感器、视觉传感器、非接触式距离传感器、扫描探针显微技术等； （5）新型坐标测量仪器：介绍激光跟踪仪、关节臂坐标测量机、3D纳米测量和纳米定位设备等设备的基本情况； （6）坐标测量的误差评定：介绍坐标测量的误差评定流程及确定测量结果不确定度的主要方法。 通过课程的学习，学生能够了解坐标测量技术，特别是其发展历程、经典结构与关键单元、主流的检测原理与测量方法、测量数据的处理以及精度与误差评定等内容。完成本课程学习后，学生应具备综合运用几何量坐标测量原理与方法进行坐标测量系统设计、实验以及数据分析和处理的能力，并能在系统分析和设计的过程中体现创新意识。
default.en: The course " Micro and Nano Sensing and Measurement Technology" is an elective course primarily designed for undergraduate students majoring in instrument-related disciplines or those pursuing a minor in instrument-related subjects. The course aims to cultivate students' understanding of the fundamental principles, instruments, and methods of micro/nano sensing and geometric measurement technology, as well as their ability to solve practical precision coordinate measurement problems. The course covers the following aspects: (1) Origin and development of geometric measurement: Introduction to the purpose and measurement objects of machining measurement technology, as well as the development of coordinate measurement technology and coordinate measuring machines. (2) Objectives of coordinate measurement: Introduction to the objectives of geometric measurement, standardization of geometric features, interchangeability verification, filtering, fitting, and other key aspects of geometric measurement. (3) Basic principles and equipment technology of geometric measurement: Introduction to the basic principles of coordinate measurement technology, classification and structure of coordinate measuring machines, and auxiliary equipment. (4) Core of coordinate measurement - sensors: Introduction to classical sensors used in coordinate measurement, including classic contact measurement sensors, vision sensors, non-contact distance sensors, scanning probe microscopy technology, etc. (5) New coordinate measurement instruments: Introduction to basic information about laser trackers, articulated arm coordinate measuring machines, 3D nano measurement, and nano positioning devices. (6) Error evaluation in coordinate measurement: Introduction to the error evaluation process in coordinate measurement and the main methods for determining measurement result uncertainty.
