Through this course, students will gain an understanding of coordinate measurement technology, including its development history, classical structures and key components, mainstream detection principles and measurement methods, data processing, as well as precision and error evaluation. Upon completion of the course, students should possess the ability to comprehensively apply principles and methods of geometric coordinate measurement in the design, experimentation, and data analysis of coordinate measurement systems. They should also demonstrate innovation awareness during the process of system analysis and design.

default.zh: 本课程介绍微机电系统（MEMS, Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems）技术的前沿进展与多领域应用，重点结合人工智能（AI）赋能MEMS器件的创新发展。课程聚焦微机电系统的设计、智能制造、系统测试与应用四大核心环节，介绍AI如何助力MEMS技术突破传统限制，实现更高效、更智能的智能传感系统设计与优化。课程涵盖AI在MEMS器件建模与设计、智能制造工艺集成、数据驱动的系统测试、MEMS+AI融合应用等，帮助学生掌握智能微机电系统技术前沿、应用与创新方法。
default.en: This course introduces the cutting-edge developments in Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) technology and its wide-ranging applications across various fields, with a particular focus on the innovative advancements enabled by Artificial Intelligence (AI). Centered around four core aspects—design, intelligent manufacturing, system testing, and application—the course explores how AI empowers MEMS technologies to overcome traditional limitations and drive the development of more efficient and intelligent sensing systems. Course topics include AI-driven modeling and design of MEMS devices, integration and optimization of intelligent manufacturing processes, data-driven system testing methodologies, and the convergence of MEMS and AI in practical applications. The course aims to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of the latest advancements, application scenarios, and innovative approaches in intelligent MEMS technologies.

default.zh: 本科毕业论文（设计）是仪器类专业本科生综合能力培养与技能训练的一个重要教学环节，安排在第四学年进行，为期16周。指导教师从实际工程项目及有工程背景的科学研究中选取具有适当难度与工作量、有一定综合性的题目，使学生经历查阅资料与文献综述、方案设计与方案论证、详细设计与理论分析、实验与数据处理、毕业论文撰写等各个方面的综合训练，通过开题、中期检查、结题检查、毕业答辩等各个环节的过程管理，培养学生综合运用所学知识，分析和解决精密仪器设计和测控等领域工程技术问题的能力，达到进一步深化和扩展所学基础和专业知识，提高实验动手能力，培养科学研究工作能力的目的。
default.en: The undergraduate thesis (design) is an important teaching link in the comprehensive ability cultivation and skill training of undergraduate students majoring in instruments. It is scheduled for the fourth academic year and lasts for 16 weeks. Guide teachers to select topics with appropriate difficulty and workload, as well as a certain degree of comprehensiveness, from actual engineering projects and scientific research with engineering background, so that students can undergo comprehensive training in various aspects such as reviewing materials and literature, designing and demonstrating plans, detailed design and theoretical analysis, experiments and data processing, graduation thesis writing, etc. Through opening, mid-term inspection, and closing inspection The process management of various stages such as graduation defense aims to cultivate students' ability to comprehensively apply their knowledge, analyze and solve engineering and technical problems in precision instrument design and measurement and control fields, further deepen and expand their basic and professional knowledge, improve their experimental and hands-on abilities, and cultivate their scientific research work abilities.

default.zh: 本科毕业论文（设计）是未来技术学院智能制造模块和人工智能模块汇中仪器类本科生综合能力培养与技能训练的一个重要教学环节，安排在第四学年进行，为期16周。指导教师从实际工程项目及有工程背景的科学研究中选取具有适当难度与工作量、有一定综合性的题目，使学生经历查阅资料与文献综述、方案设计与方案论证、详细设计与理论分析、实验与数据处理、毕业论文撰写等各个方面的综合训练，通过开题、中期检查、结题检查、毕业答辩等各个环节的过程管理，培养学生综合运用所学知识，分析和解决精密仪器设计和测控等领域工程技术问题的能力，达到进一步深化和扩展所学基础和专业知识，提高实验动手能力，培养科学研究工作能力的目的。
default.en: The undergraduate thesis (design) is an important teaching link in the comprehensive ability cultivation and skill training of instrument undergraduate students in the intelligent manufacturing module and artificial intelligence module of the Future Technology College. It is scheduled for the fourth academic year and lasts for 16 weeks. Guide teachers to select topics with appropriate difficulty and workload, as well as a certain degree of comprehensiveness, from actual engineering projects and scientific research with engineering background, so that students can undergo comprehensive training in various aspects such as reviewing materials and literature, designing and demonstrating plans, detailed design and theoretical analysis, experiments and data processing, graduation thesis writing, etc. Through opening, mid-term inspection, and closing inspection The process management of various stages such as graduation defense aims to cultivate students' ability to comprehensively apply their knowledge, analyze and solve engineering and technical problems in precision instrument design and measurement and control fields, further deepen and expand their basic and professional knowledge, improve their experimental and hands-on abilities, and cultivate their scientific research work abilities.

default.zh: 生产实习是本科实践教学环节中非常重要的组成部分，是本科生在校期间了解社会及专业发展现状、促进理论联系实际、提高学生实践动手能力及综合素质的重要途径。生产实习的目的是使学生通过实习在专业知识和人才素质两方面得到锻炼和培养，从而为毕业后走向工作岗位尽快成为领军人才打下良好基础。 生产实习为期2周，学生以听取报告、参观和项目实训的方式进行。通过听取企业人员的报告及参观展厅，让学生了解本专业所从事的工作对社会、健康、安全、法律及文化的影响，要树立良好的职业道德，明确承担的社会责任，具备较强沟通交流能力和协同合作精神。通过实训项目学习，培养学生综合运用所学知识解决复杂问题的能力，具备对项目进行有效的组织、管理能力，明确项目开发中承担的任务，并能够独立完成。 生产实习要求学生按时出勤参加生产实习各个教学环节，实习过程中记录实习手册，实习结束后，完成实训总结报告和实习总结报告。课程进行百分制考核，最终成绩的比例为：实习考勤占10%；实习手册占20%；实习总结报告占30%；实训项目总结报告占40%。
default.en: Production practice is a critical component in undergraduate practice and teaching process. It is an important way for undergraduate students to know the development status quo of society and their majors. It can promote the combination of theory with practice, and advance students’ practical abilities and comprehensive quality. The purpose of production practice is to bolster students professional knowledge and comprehensive quality, laying a solid foundation for them to quickly become leading talents after graduation. The production practice lasts for 2 weeks, including report presentation, on-site visits, and project training. Through presentations given by enterprise personnel and visits to exhibitions, students are aware of the social, health, safety, legal, and cultural influence of their major works. They should foster good？professional ethics, know their social responsibilities, and acquire good communication and cooperation abilities. The training project will foster students’ ability to solve complex issues by comprehensively using the knowledge they have learned, promote their abilities to conduct effective project organization and management, and give them a clear vision of their task in project development to carry it out independently. As required, students need to ensure on-time attendance in every teaching process of the production practice. The practice performance will be recorded in the practice notebook. Students need to finish the Training Summary Report and the Practice Summary Report. The course is evaluated on a 100-point basis, with attendance accounting for 10%; Practice Notebook for 20%, Practice Summary Report for 30%, and Training Summary Report for 40%.

default.zh: 《测控仪器综合设计实践》是测控技术与仪器专业的专业核心课，是"在线智能测控系统设计"的课程设计，基于在线智能测控系统基本知识、在线智能测控系统特征、在线智能测控系统原理与组成、智能化前沿技术，要求学生完成在线智能测控系统设计，具备解决在线智能测控领域复杂工程设计的能力。
default.en: This course is the core course for the major of measurement and control technology and instrument，and it is the course design for "Online Intelligent Measurement and Control System Design". The content includes basic knowledge of online intelligent measurement and control system, characteristics of online intelligent measurement and control, principle and composition of online intelligent measurement and control system based on various sensing technologies, intelligent frontier technology and intelligent system design methods. Students are required to master the basic principles and methods of online intelligent measurement and control technology, and have the ability to solve complex engineering problems in the field of online intelligent measurement and control.

default.zh: 《嵌入式系统设计实践》以单片机为例，介绍嵌入式处理器的组成原理、指令系统、软件设计、串行通讯、接口技术与应用的一门课程，具有较强的理论性和鲜明的实践性。嵌入式处理器是测量与控制仪表、控制系统的核心部件，硬件设计原理是其根本，软件设计方法是其精髓。通过本课程的学习，学生熟悉单片机的硬件结构和指令系统，掌握嵌入式系统的开发流程，以及嵌入式系统的硬件电路设计方法，初步掌握C51的编程与调试方法，并能根据功能和指标要求设计完整的嵌入式系统。本课的学习将为后续的专业课程和实践教学环节（如毕业设计）奠定坚实理论与实践基础。 课程涵盖如下内容： 1、AT89S52单片机的引脚功能、片内存储器结构、时钟电路、复位电路； 2、C51语言指令系统，包括数据类型、存储类型、函数组成、程序设计方法； 3、嵌入式软硬件开发环境与使用方法，包括Proteus和Keil等； 4、AT89S52单片机的中断系统、定时器/计数器、串行口的结构与工作原理； 5、AT89S52单片机与LED数码管、LCD液晶显示器、键盘等外设的接口设计方法； 6、AT89S52单片机与ADC和DAC的硬件接口设计与驱动程序设计。
default.en: Embedded System Design Practice is a course that integrates the principle of embedded processor, instruction system, software design, serial communication, interface technology and application based on Micro Controller Unit (MCU). It has strong theory and distinct practicality. Embedded processor is the core component of measurement and control instrument and system. The principle of hardware design is its foundation, and the software design method is its essence. Through the course of learning, students will be familiar with the hardware structure and command system of SCM, and master the development process of embedded system, microcomputer embedded system design method, preliminary programming, debugging method of C51 language, and master the design capability of embedded systems according to function and index requirements. It will lay a solid foundation of theory and practice for professional courses and graduation project. The course introduces the following content. 1. Pin function of AT89S52 microcontroller, as well as the memory structure, the clock circuit, and the reset circuit. 2. C51 language instruction system, including data types, storage types, functions, programming design methods. 3. Development tools and application method of embedded software and hardware, including Proteus and Keil. 4. Structures and working principles of the interrupt system, timer / counter, serial interface. 5. Peripheral interface design of LED, LCD, and keyboard. 6. Hardware interface designs and driver designs of AT89S52 microcontroller and ADC/DAC.

default.zh: 课程设计是“精密机械学基础（1）（2）”课程的一个重要教学环节。通过课程设计不仅加强了理论与实际的联系，进一步巩固所学课程的内容，而且要求学生综合地应用先修课程（制图、力学、金属工艺学等）中的知识，学会使用有关技术资料，完成一个简单仪表或仪器装置的设计，既完成一个工程技术人员在机械设计方面所必须具备的基本技能训练，它也是培养学生分析和解决工程实际问题能力的重要环节之一。
default.en: Course design is an important teaching segment for the course of Fundamentals of Precision Mechanics (1) (2), by which can stress the link between theory and practice and solidify the course content. Moreover, students are required to synthetically apply the knowledge of pre-elective courses such as Mechanical Drawing, Mechanics and Mental Technology, to make use of corresponding technical information and design and accomplish simple instrument equipment. It can offer not only fundamental skill training in the field of machinery design, but also important practice of cultivating students with the ability of analyzing and solving problem.

default.zh: 精密仪器综合设计实践是“精密测量原理与精密仪器设计”的实践环节，是该课程的一个重要教学环节。课程的教学目的是使学生了解和掌握精密仪器在总体设计方面的基本原理和设计理论及设计方法，掌握机、光、电、计算机相结合的仪器总体设计原则和原理，并学会仪器总体设计的方法和具有一定的精度设计能力。 通过综合设计实践不仅加强了理论与实际的联系，进一步巩固所学课程的内容，而且要求学生综合地应用先修课程（误差理论、机械学基础、精密测量原理与精密仪器设计）中的知识，能从设计任务出发，完成设计精密仪器的国内外调研，学会使用有关技术资料，完成某一个精密仪器的总体设计和精度设计，或仪器部分主要部件的设计。既完成一个工程技术人员在仪器设计方面所必须具备的基本技能训练，它也是培养学生分析和解决工程实际问题能力的重要环节之一。通过2周课程设计，使学生能掌握精密仪器设计思想精髓，举一反三，以创造性设计思维和创新设计方法进行精密仪器设计，具备独立设计分析能力和一定的创新性思维。
default.en: The Comprehensive Design practice of precision instruments is a practical part of "Precision Measurement Principles and Precision Instrument Design", and is an important teaching part of this course. The teaching purpose of the course is to enable students to understand and master the basic principles, design theories, and design methods of precision instruments in overall design, master the principles and principles of instrument overall design combining mechanics, optics, electronics, and computers, and learn the methods of instrument overall design and have a certain level of precision design ability. Through Comprehensive Design practice, not only has the connection between theory and practice been strengthened, further consolidating the content of the courses learned, but students are also required to comprehensively apply the knowledge from the prerequisite courses (optics, error theory, mechanical fundamentals, measurement and control circuits, precision measurement principles and precision instrument design), be able to start from design tasks, complete domestic and foreign research on designing precision instruments, learn to use relevant technical materials, complete the overall design and precision design of a precision instrument, or the design of some main components of the instrument. Completing the basic skills training that an engineering technician must possess in instrument design is also an important part of cultivating students' ability to analyze and solve practical engineering problems. Through two weeks of practice, students will be able to master the essence of precision instrument design ideas, draw inferences from other cases, and use creative design thinking and innovative design methods for precision instrument design.

default.zh: “智能感知仪器综合设计实践”是智能感知相关专业的重要实践课程。围绕实际应用系统，主要基于智能感知仪器的工作原理和基本特性，通过实际项目锻炼学生实现智能感知仪器系统的实现及其广泛应用。通过本课程学习能够使学习者掌握智能感知工程应用方法，根据系统要求和性能指标分析、设计或开发智能感知系统及网络，提高学习者工程实践能力和创新能力。 通过项目实践，加深学生对智能感知仪器基本概念的理解，使其深入理解智能感知仪器的基本特性，网络技术在智能感知系统中的应用，各种常用智能传感器的工作原理及应用，掌握多种网络接口协议，了解智能感知在不同领域的广泛应用，熟悉并深入掌握如何借助嵌入式系统与设备实现智能感知，以及如何借助Python编程实现智能感知。让学生深入理解并掌握智能传感器与智能感知系统的工作原理，并且能够根据应用场景实际需求和性能指标设计/开发智能感知仪器。让学生能够根据已知的测量数据，进行相应的数据分析，并具有撰写报告的能力。通过本课程的实践项目设计与动手环节，还可以增强学生自主学习意识。及时了解智能感知仪器的发展动态，促使学生有探索知识行为。
default.en: "Practice of Comprehensive Design of Intelligent Sensing Instruments" is an important practical course for majors related to intelligent sensing. Focusing on practical application systems, mainly based on the working principles and basic characteristics of intelligent sensing instruments, students will be trained through practical projects to realize the implementation and widespread application of intelligent sensing instrument systems. Through this course, learners can master the application methods of intelligent sensing engineering, analyze, design or develop intelligent sensing systems and networks based on system requirements and performance indicators, and improve learners' engineering practice and innovation abilities. Through project practice, students will deepen their understanding of the basic concepts of intelligent sensing instruments, the basic characteristics of intelligent sensing instruments, the application of network technology in intelligent sensing systems, the working principles and applications of various commonly used intelligent sensors, and master a variety of Network interface protocols, understand the wide range of applications of intelligent sensing in different fields, be familiar with and have a deep understanding of how to use embedded systems and devices to achieve intelligent sensing, and how to use Python programming to achieve intelligent sensing. Allow students to deeply understand and master the working principles of smart sensors and smart sensing systems, and be able to design/develop smart sensing instruments based on the actual needs and performance indicators of application scenarios. Enable students to conduct corresponding data analysis based on known measurement data and have the ability to write reports. Through the practical project design and hands-on aspects of this course, students' awareness of autonomous learning can also be enhanced. Keep abreast of the development trends of intelligent sensing instruments to encourage students to explore knowledge.

default.zh: 专业创新实践主要面向精密仪器及智能化大类专业本科生开设，通过传感、测量和仪器设计等专业基础知识的熟悉与学习，进行创新与创业的工程实践训练，培养学生创新意识、自主学习和获取新知识的能力，掌握解决仪器科学与技术领域复杂工程问题的应具备的综合能力。
default.en: “Innovative Practice of Precision Instrumentation and Intellectualization” is mainly aimed at undergraduate students majoring in precision instruments and intelligence. Through familiarization and learning of basic professional knowledge such as sensing, measurement, and instrument design, engineering practice training for innovation and entrepreneurship is conducted to cultivate students' innovation awareness, independent learning, and ability to acquire new knowledge, and to master the comprehensive abilities required to solve complex engineering problems in the field of instrument science and technology.

default.zh: 随着社会发展，生命科学与人类健康、环境保障、工业与技术产业发展的关系日益紧密。科学技术的发展和融合呼唤高水平的复合型人才，不仅要有良好的数、理、化和专业基础知识，还要有生命科学和信息科学的相关知识。为此，21世纪的高等教育知识体系中，需要具备生命科学的知识及其理念。本课程是面向全校学生开出的核心课程，旨在扩大学生的知识面，培养学生生命科学的思维方式，将生命科学的思想、方法运用到他们所从事的工作领域。通过学习生命科学的基础知识和基本理论，使学生了解生命科学的最新成就和发展趋势。
default.en: With the development of society, the relationship between life science and human health, environmental protection, the development of industry and technology industry is becoming increasingly close. The development and integration of science and technology calls for high level of compound talents, not only a good math, science, chemistry and professional basic knowledge, but also related knowledge of life science and information science. Therefore, in the twenty-first Century higher education knowledge system, the knowledge and concept of life science were needed. This course is a core course for all students. It aims at expanding students' knowledge, cultivating students' thinking mode of life science, and applying the ideas and methods of life science to their work field. By learning the basics of life science and basic theory, it will help students to understand the latest achievements of life science and development trends.

default.zh: 生命科学发展日新月异，尤其是进入21世纪以来，生命科学各领域突破层出不穷，以生命科学为服务对象的交叉学科发展方兴未艾。为了使学生熟悉生命科学前沿发展的状况和现代生物技术的发展趋势，我们开设生命科学基础与现代技术课程，课程基本内容涵盖生物化学、遗传学、肿瘤细胞生物学、免疫学、生物信息学和神经生物学等生命学科中发展最为迅速的学科。具体包括以下内容：1.从生命大分子（包括蛋白质、核酸和糖）的基本结构与功能出发认识生命活动的基本机制；2. 认识生命遗传信息传递的基本规律、遗传的细胞与分子基础、基因工程与基因编辑；3. 了解肿瘤流行病学现状，掌握肿瘤微环境的概念和特点，认识肿瘤最新治疗方法的基本原理； 4. 理解并掌握免疫学基本概念、原理、免疫与疾病；5. 学习生物信息学的研究范畴、组学数据、生物分子网路、生物大数据与人工智能；6. 了解神经系统的组成与基本功能，神经元结构与功能，动作电位，神经突触，神经生物学研究的新技术。
default.en: Life science has been developing rapidly. The breakthroughs in various fields of life science have emerged one after another especially since the 21st century. The development of interdisciplinary subjects serving life science is in the ascendant. In order to familiarize students with the frontier development of life science and the development trend of modern biotechnology, we set up the course of Fundamentals of Life Science and Modern Technology. The course contents include basic biochemistry, genetics, cancer cell biology, immunology, bioinformatics and neurobiology and discipline of the fastest growing fields in the life. To be specific: 1. To understand the basic mechanism of life activities from the basic structure and function of life macromolecules (including proteins, nucleic acids and glycans); 2. To understand the basic laws of genetic information transmission, the cellular and molecular basis of heredity, genetic engineering and gene editing; 3. To understand the current tumor epidemiology, the concept of tumor microenvironment and the basic principles of the edged tumor treatment methods; 4. Basic concepts, principles of immunity, immunity and human diseasesy; 5. Research scope of bioinformatics, omics data, biomolecular networks, biological big data and artificial intelligence; 6. Composition and basic function of the nervous system, neuron structure and function, action potential, synapses, new techniques of neurobiological research.

default.zh: 生命科学导论课程是一门融基础知识与前沿进展相结合的综合性课程，是我院大一学生接触的第一门生物类专业课程，该课程从生命科学最前沿的研究领域出发，从发育生物学、肿瘤生物学、结构生物学、糖组学和代谢组学到计算生物学、生物医药、航天医学等，通过这些方向的学习，使学生能够初步接触到最新最前沿的研究领域，促进大学生不断提高对现代生命科学与技术的内涵、进展及其推动经济和社会发展的认识，加深对学科交叉、渗透、融合的理解，激发探索和创新的激情，成为高水平研究型发展潜力的拔尖创新人才奠定基础。
default.en: The Introduction to Life Sciences course is a comprehensive course that combines basic knowledge with cutting-edge developments. It is the first biology major course that our freshman students are exposed to. Starting from the most cutting-edge research fields in life sciences, this course covers developmental biology, tumor biology, structural biology, glycomics, metabolomics, computational biology, biomedicine, aerospace medicine, etc. Through studying these directions, students can have preliminary exposure to the latest and cutting-edge research fields, promote their continuous improvement of understanding of the connotation, progress, and promotion of economic and social development of modern life sciences and technology, deepen their understanding of interdisciplinary, permeation, and integration, stimulate their passion for exploration and innovation, and lay the foundation for becoming top-notch innovative talents with high-level research-oriented development potential.

default.zh: 生命科学导论课程是一门融基础知识与前沿进展相结合的综合性课程，是我院大一学生接触的第一门生物类专业课程，该课程从生命科学最前沿的研究领域出发，从发育生物学、肿瘤生物学、结构生物学、糖组学和代谢组学到计算生物学、生物医药、航天医学等，通过这些方向的学习，使学生能够初步接触到最新最前沿的研究领域，促进大学生不断提高对现代生命科学与技术的内涵、进展及其推动经济和社会发展的认识，加深对学科交叉、渗透、融合的理解，激发探索和创新的激情，成为高水平研究型发展潜力的拔尖创新人才奠定基础。
default.en: The Introduction to Life Sciences course is a comprehensive course that combines basic knowledge with cutting-edge developments. It is the first biology major course that our freshman students are exposed to. Starting from the most cutting-edge research fields in life sciences, this course covers developmental biology, tumor biology, structural biology, glycomics, metabolomics, computational biology, biomedicine, aerospace medicine, etc. Through studying these directions, students can have preliminary exposure to the latest and cutting-edge research fields, promote their continuous improvement of understanding of the connotation, progress, and promotion of economic and social development of modern life sciences and technology, deepen their understanding of interdisciplinary, permeation, and integration, stimulate their passion for exploration and innovation, and lay the foundation for becoming top-notch innovative talents with high-level research-oriented development potential.

default.zh: 《医学生物学》从医学科学的角度，介绍生命现象的一般规律和发展趋势；从生命科学的角度，根据生命科学的发展规律介绍与医学相关的发展趋势。使学生在中学所学生物学的基础上，进一步学习、巩固和扩充生物学的基础理论和基本技能。并适当联系医学各学科各专业的需要,通过教学各环节，使学生逐步地从分子层次、细胞层次、个体层次、群体层次认识生物界发生发展的规律,同时，也将在教学中介绍生命科学的新进展，特别是对生命科学前沿的细胞生物学，分子生物学等领域的新成就进行介绍，以扩大学生的知识领域，使学生对生命科学中的新理论和新概念有所了解。通过《医学生物学基础及进展》课程的学习，使学生了解、掌握与医学相关的生物学基本理论、基础知识和相关的基本技能，为进一步学好其它课程奠定扎实的基础。
default.en: Medical Biology introduces the general laws and development trends of life phenomena from the perspective of medical science; introduces the development trends related medicine according to the development laws of life science from the perspective of life science. It enables students to further learn, consolidate and expand the basic theory and basic skills biology on the basis of the knowledge of biology they have learned in middle school. It also appropriately contacts the needs of various disciplines and majors in medicine. Through various teaching, students gradually understand the laws of the occurrence and development of the biological world at the molecular level, cellular level, individual level and population level. At the same time the new progress of life science, especially the new achievements in the frontier of life science such as cell biology and molecular biology, will also be introduced in the teaching process so as to expand students' knowledge fields and make students understand the new theories and concepts in life science. Through the study of the course " Fundamental and Progress of Medical Biology ", students can understand and master the basic theory, basic knowledge and related basic skills of biology related to medicine, and lay a solid foundation for further learning other courses.

default.zh: 普通生物学作为生命科学的一门基础课，其主要任务是使学生掌握有关生物学的基本概念和基本理论，使学生对分子和细胞的结构与功能、有机体的稳态、发育、遗传、适应与进化等方面有一个整体的理解，为今后其它课程的学习奠定扎实的基础。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握生物学的基本知识、基本理论、基本规律，包括生物分子、细胞的结构功能、个体生物学（高等动植物的结构、功能、生殖发育）、遗传变异、生物进化、现代生物技术等基本内容，使学生了解当前生物学技术的应用和生物学的发展现状。理解生命的基本特征以及生命科学的分支与相互关系。了解生命科学的现状、国内外研究前沿与最新动态。
default.en: General biology is a basic course of life science. Its main task is to enable students to master the basic concepts of biology and basic theory, and have a whole understanding of life about molecular and cell structure and function, organism steady state, development, genetic, adaptive and evolution. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic knowledge of biology, basic theory, basic laws, including biological molecules, cell structure and function, individual biology (the structure, function, reproductive development of higher flora plants), genetic variation, biological evolution, modern biotechnology and other basic content. Help students understand the current application of biological technology. Understand the basic characteristics of life and the relationship between the branches of life science. Understand the status of life sciences, and the latest developments.

default.zh: 生命科学特色实验是一门生命科学兴趣类实验，课程的主要任务在于引领学生初步探索生命科学专业领域，领略生命世界的新奇，培养浓厚专业兴趣，激发学生的好奇心和探究心。课程包含动物、细胞、分子等多学科内容，分为两个部分，分别开设在一年级秋季学期（生命科学特色实验1）和春季学期（生命科学特色实验2）。 以性别鉴定实验为例，生命科学的研究与应用已进入分子层面，利用少量的脱落细胞，如口腔黏膜上皮细胞就可以提取DNA，并在特异性引物的作用下大量扩增，就可以做特定基因的检测，这种技术广泛应用于性别鉴定、亲子鉴定、刑侦检测等多个方面，在生产生活中都有重大的研究价值和应用前景。 本课程为秋季学期课程，一共包括两个实验项目：（1）提取口腔黏膜上皮细胞DNA，并在特异性引物的作用下大量扩增，做特定基因的检测；（2）观察常见的模式生物斑马鱼胚胎的发育，并掌握如何解剖斑马鱼，认识斑马鱼的各种器官及其形态； 并学会如何使用显微镜并掌握在显微镜下解剖。 课程目标1.培养学生的专业兴趣，激发学生的好奇心和探究心。 课程目标2.训练学生生命科学专业的基本操作能力。
default.en: Life Science Characteristic Experiment Life Science Characteristic Experiment is an experimental course designed for students interested in life sciences. Its primary objective is to guide students in their initial exploration of the life sciences field, expose them to the wonders of the living world, cultivate a strong professional interest, and stimulate curiosity and a spirit of inquiry. The curriculum encompasses multidisciplinary content, including zoology, cell biology, and molecular biology, and is divided into two parts: Life Science Characteristic Experiment 1, offered in the fall semester of the first year, and Life Science Characteristic Experiment 2, offered in the spring semester. Take the sex determination experiment as an example. Life sciences research and application have entered the molecular realm. DNA can be extracted from a small number of shed cells, such as buccal epithelial cells, and then amplified in large quantities using specific primers. This enables the detection of particular genes. This technology is widely used in various fields, including sex determination, parentage testing, and forensic detection, and holds significant research value and application potential in production and daily life. This course is scheduled for the fall semester and comprises two experimental projects: Extract DNA from buccal epithelial cells and amplify it extensively using specific primers for the detection of particular genes. Observe the development of zebrafish embryos, a common model organism, master the techniques for zebrafish dissection, and familiarize yourself with the various organs and their morphologies. Learn to use a microscope and perform dissections under microscopic observation. Course Objective 1: Cultivate students' professional interest and stimulate their curiosity and spirit of inquiry. Course Objective 2: Train students in basic operational skills in the life sciences.

default.zh: 生命科学领域中许多重大发现与细胞生物学实验技术的不断创新和发展是紧密相关的，因此，学习和掌握细胞生物学最基本的实验技术，如用显微镜观察细胞结构，对于将要从事生命科学研究的工作者来说是非常必要的。利用显微镜观察细胞结构特征并结合免疫技术对细胞进行定性和定量的研究，在生命科学、医学和农业等领域均有重大的研究价值和应用前景。 在细胞结构的荧光显示实验项目中，通过观察活细胞，了解培养动物细胞的的形态特征。细胞经过胞荧光标记染色，利用荧光显微镜观察动物细胞的细胞膜和细胞核。初步了解荧光显微镜的工作原来与使用方法，掌握免疫荧光技术在生命科学领域的应用。 生命科学领域的数据来源广泛且结构复杂，从基因组学、蛋白质组学到临床数据，各类信息规模庞大且动态变化。大数据技术能够整合并分析这些多源异构数据，深入挖掘隐藏规律并对未来进行预测，为科学研究提供重要支持。掌握基于人工智能的数据挖掘方法，已成为生命科学领域相关研究人员的关键能力。通过讲授和实践相结合的方式，帮助学生深入理解大数据在生命科学中的应用，并系统掌握数据挖掘的基本流程与技术。 实验一了解人工智能、大数据技术及其在生命科学领域的应用；可以初步使用Python；并学习关联规则算法，掌握数据分析的基本流程，复现Python代码。 实验二通过传染病预测算法，巩固数据分析的基本流程，实现用Python复现代码。
default.en: Many important discoveries in the field of life science are closely related to the continuous innovation and development of cell biology experimental technology, so it is very necessary for workers who will engage in life science research to learn and master the most basic experimental technology of cell biology, such as observing cell structure with a microscope. It is of great research value and application prospect in the fields of life science, medicine, and agriculture to observe the structural characteristics of cells by microscopy and to study them qualitatively and quantitatively in combination with immune technology. In the fluorescence imaging experiment of cell structure, we observe live cells to gain an understanding of the morphological characteristics of cultured animal cells. Cells are stained with fluorescent markers, and the cell membrane and nucleus of animal cells are observed using a fluorescence microscope. Through this experiment, we aim to gain a preliminary understanding of the working principles and usage methods of fluorescence microscopy, as well as to master the application of immunofluorescence technology in the field of life sciences. Data in the field of life sciences has diverse source and complex in structure, including genomics data, proteomics data and clinical data. The data is vast in scale and dynamically evolving. Big data technologies can integrate and analyze these multi-sourced, heterogeneous data, deeply uncovering hidden patterns and making predictions for the future, providing critical support for scientific research. Mastering AI-based data mining methods has become a key skill for researchers in the life sciences. By combining lectures and hands-on practice, this course aims to help students gain a deep understanding of big data applications in life sciences and systematically learn the fundamental processes and techniques of data mining. Experiment 1: Understand artificial intelligence, big data technology, and their applications in the field of life sciences. Gain introductory experience with Python, and learn the association rule algorithm to grasp the basic data analysis workflow and replicate Python code. Experiment 2: Reinforce the basic data analysis workflow through an infectious disease prediction algorithm and implement Python code replication.

default.zh: 《分子细胞生物学》是生命科学研究的基础，它从细胞的整体、亚显微结构和分子三个不同的层次上把细胞的结构与功能统一起来进行探讨，以阐明生物有机体的生长、分化、衰老、死亡等基本生命活动的规律。课程主要讲授细胞分子生物学学科的形成及发展、细胞分子生物学研究方法、原核生物和真核生物DNA复制、RNA转录过程、真核生物mRNA的加工修饰过程、细胞结构及功能、细胞增殖和死亡以及信号传导等细胞生命活动规律，使学生能够深刻理解细胞的结构与功能及其分子机制，并进一步深入理解彼此之间的相关性和一致性，具备探索、分析与解决生命健康科学相关问题的基本能力。
default.en: Molecular Cell Biology is the foundation of life science research, which unifies the structure and function of cells at three different levels: overall, submicroscopic, and molecular levels, in order to elucidate the laws of basic life activities such as growth, differentiation, aging, and death in biological organisms. The course mainly teaches the formation and development of the discipline of cell biology, research methods in cell and molecular biology, DNA replication in prokaryotes and eukaryotes, RNA transcription processes, processing and modification of eukaryotic mRNA, cell structure and function, cell proliferation and death, signal transduction, and other cellular life activities. The course objective is to enable students to have a deep understanding of the structure and function of cells, as well as their molecular mechanisms, as well as the correlation and consistency between them. In addition, enable students to have the basic ability to explore, analyze, and solve problems related to life and health sciences.

default.zh: 生命科学领域中许多重大发现与细胞生物学实验技术的不断创新和发展是紧密相关的，因此，学习和掌握细胞生物学最基本的实验技术，如用显微镜观察细胞结构，对于将要从事生命科学研究的工作者来说是非常必要的。利用显微镜观察细胞结构特征并结合免疫技术对细胞进行定性和定量的研究，在生命科学、医学和农业等领域均有重大的研究价值和应用前景。 实验一学习利用荧光显微镜观察动物细胞细胞膜和细胞核，初步了解荧光显微镜的基本组件和荧光成像原理，掌握免疫荧光技术在生命科学领域的应用。 生命科学的研究与应用已进入分子层面，利用少量的脱落细胞，如口腔黏膜上皮细胞就可以提取DNA，并在特异性引物的作用下大量扩增，就可以做特定基因的检测，这种技术广泛应用于性别鉴定、亲子鉴定、刑侦检测等多个方面，在生产生活中都有重大的研究价值和应用前景。 实验二学习利用DNA的提取技术、PCR基因扩增技术、电泳操作进行性别检测的原理与技术；初步掌握相关的分子生物学技术。
default.en: Many important discoveries in the field of life science are closely related to the continuous innovation and development of cell biology experimental technology, so it is very necessary for workers who will engage in life science research to learn and master the most basic experimental technology of cell biology, such as observing cell structure with a microscope. It is of great research value and application prospect in the fields of life science, medicine, and agriculture to observe the structural characteristics of cells by microscopy and to study them qualitatively and quantitatively in combination with immune technology. In experiment 1, we learned to observe the cell membrane and nucleus of animal cells with fluorescence microscope, initially understood the basic components of fluorescence microscope and the principle of fluorescence imaging, and mastered the application of immunofluorescence technology in the field of life science. The research and application of life science have entered the molecular level. DNA can be extracted from a small number of shed cells, such as oral mucosal epithelial cells, and amplified in large quantities under the action of specific primers, so that specific genes can be detected. This technology is widely used in gender identification, paternity identification, criminal detection, and other aspects. It has great research value and application prospect in production and life. In experiment 2, we learned the principle and technology of sex detection by DNA extraction, PCR gene amplification and electrophoresis. Master the relevant molecular biology technology initially.

default.zh: 普通生物学作为生命科学的一门基础课，其主要任务是使学生掌握有关生物学的基本概念和基本理论，使学生对分子和细胞的结构与功能、有机体的稳态、发育、遗传、适应与进化等方面有一个整体的理解，为今后其它课程的学习奠定扎实的基础。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握生物学的基本知识、基本理论、基本规律，包括生物分子、细胞的结构功能、个体生物学（高等动植物的结构、功能、生殖发育）、遗传变异、生物进化、现代生物技术等基本内容，使学生了解当前生物学技术的应用和生物学的发展现状。理解生命的基本特征以及生命科学的分支与相互关系。了解生命科学的现状、国内外研究前沿与最新动态。
default.en: General biology is a basic course of life science. Its main task is to enable students to master the basic concepts of biology and basic theory, and have a whole understanding of life about molecular and cell structure and function, organism steady state, development, genetic, adaptive and evolution. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic knowledge of biology, basic theory, basic laws, including biological molecules, cell structure and function, individual biology (the structure, function, reproductive development of higher flora plants), genetic variation, biological evolution, modern biotechnology and other basic content. Help students understand the current application of biological technology. Understand the basic characteristics of life and the relationship between the branches of life science. Understand the status of life sciences, and the latest developments.

default.zh: 生物专业导论课程是一门融基础知识与前沿进展相结合的综合性课程，是我院大一学生接触的第一门生物类专业课程，该课程从生命科学最前沿的研究领域出发，从细胞生物学、肿瘤生物学、结构生物学、糖组学和代谢组学到纳米生物学、组织工程和生物信息学，通过这些方向的学习，使学生能够初步接触到最新最前沿的研究领域，促进大学生不断提高对现代生命科学与技术的内涵、进展及其推动经济和社会发展的认识，加深对学科交叉、渗透、融合的理解，激发探索和创新的激情，成为高水平研究型发展潜力的拔尖创新人才奠定基础。
default.en: Introduction to Biology is a comprehensive course integrating basic knowledge and cutting-edge progress. It is the first major course of biology for freshmen in our college. Starting from the most cutting-edge research field of life science, the course learns nanobiology, tissue engineering and bioinformatics from cell biology, tumor biology, structural biology, glycomics and metabolomics. Through the study of these directions, It enables students to initially contact the latest and cutting-edge research fields, promotes students to continuously improve their understanding of the connotation and progress of modern life sciences and technologies and their promotion of economic and social development, deepen their understanding of the intersection, penetration and integration of disciplines, stimulate their passion for exploration and innovation, and lay a foundation for becoming top-notch innovative talents with high-level research development potential.

Starting from the most cutting-edge research field of life science, the course learns nanobiology, tissue engineering and bioinformatics from cell biology, tumor biology, structural biology, glycomics and metabolomics. Through the study of these directions, It enables students to initially contact the latest and cutting-edge research fields, promotes students to continuously improve their understanding of the connotation and progress of modern life sciences and technologies and their promotion of economic and social development, deepen their understanding of the intersection, penetration and integration of disciplines, stimulate their passion for exploration and innovation, and lay a foundation for becoming top-notch innovative talents with high-level research development potential.

default.zh: 生物大分子是构成生命的基础物质，包括蛋白质、核酸、碳水化合物等。本门实验课将RNA和蛋白质的提取与检测抽提出来独立成课，旨在补充《实验室安全及基础实验训练》课程中未尽内容，并继续指引大一学生就中学时代所学生物大分子的理论知识进入先导性实操环节，学习并掌握其国际通用研究方法，建立对生命科学的兴趣，引导学生将专业知识架构根植于实验科学，形成正确的生命科学观。
default.en: Biomacromolecules are the basic substances that make up life, including proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, etc. This laboratory course separates the extraction and detection of RNA and proteins into independent courses, aiming to supplement the content not covered in the “Laboratory Safety and Basic Experiment Training” course, and continue to guide first-year students to enter the leading practical operation section of the theoretical knowledge of biomacromolecules learned in middle school, learn and master its internationally universal research methods, establish an interest in life science, guide students to root their professional knowledge in experimental science, and form a correct view of life science.

default.zh: 生物大分子（包括核酸、蛋白质、多糖等物质）是构成生命的物质基础。目前生物大分子相关研究发展迅猛，不但是生命科学研究领域的重点和热点，而且对化学、物理、材料、环境等其他学科的发展也具有巨大的推动作用，具有生物大分子研究基本实验技能已经成为许多研究领域科研人员基本素质要求。本实验课程可为学生传授核酸、蛋白质等生物大分子提取与检测相关的基本实验技能并提供实验操作条件。通过本实验课的学习，学生可了解生物大分子性质特点以及生物大分子实验研究的基本规范， 熟悉并掌握抽提、电泳、离心、PCR等生物大分子研究的基本实验技术以及相关仪器设备使用方法，提高实验动手能力以及分析问题解决问题的能力，从而可以激发学生对生命科学研究的兴趣，提高学生的生命科学研究素养，为今后发展打下良好的基础。
default.en: Biological macromolecules (including nucleic acids, proteins, polysaccharides and other substances) are the basic material of life. At present, the biological macromolecules research is rapidly developing, which not only is the focus and hot spot in the field of life science research, but also contributes to the development of other disciplines, such as chemistry, physics, materials science, environment science, etc. Therefore, the basic experimental skills in biomolecule research have become the basic quality requirements for researchers in many research fields. This course can teach students the basic experimental skills related to the extraction and detection of nucleic acids, proteins and other biomolecules, and provide opportunities for laboratory practice. This course will help students to understand the characteristics of biological macromolecules and the basic rules of biomolecule experimental research, familiarize themselves with extraction, electrophoresis, centrifugation, PCR and other basic experimental techniques of biomolecule research, as well as the operation of related laboratory equipment, and improve the ability to analyze and solve problems. This will increase students' interest in life science research, improve their quality of life science research, and lay a good foundation for future development.

default.zh: 本课程第一部分为大一新生的实验室安全训练。实验室的安全有序管理是实验工作正常进行的基本保证，凡进入实验室工作、学习的人员，必须遵守实验室有关要求。近年来，实验事故频发，加强实验室安全教育刻不容缓。本课程“实验室安全”部分培养学生安全意识，养成重视安全的习惯，获得安全保障的能力，包括水电气、消防、化学试剂、生物材料等等实验操作和实验室环境的安全以及操作使用仪器设备过程等方面的安全。 本课程第二部分为大一新生的基础实验训练，重点是规范学生对生物实验室常用设备的使用，以及各实验室部分通用分子生物学实验技术的培训。使学生在承担年度项目，进入实验室轮转方面，都能够真正参与进来，而不只是旁观打杂。基本做到在基础操作方面规范，所得数据可重复，最终渐进参与实验项目核心部分，获得科研素养的提高，以及科研能力的自信。
default.en: The first part of this course is laboratory safety training for freshmen. The safe and orderly management of the laboratory is the basic guarantee for the normal operation of the experimental work. The personnel who enter the laboratory to work and study must comply with the relevant requirements of the laboratory. In recent years, experimental accidents happen frequently, so it is urgent to strengthen laboratory safety education. The "Laboratory safety" part of this course develops students' safety awareness, develops the habit of attaching importance to safety, and obtains the ability of safety guarantee, including the safety of experimental operation and laboratory environment such as water and electricity, fire protection, chemical reagents, biological materials, and the operation and use of instruments and equipment. The second part of this course is basic laboratory training for freshmen, with a focus on standardizing students’ use of common equipment in biological laboratories, as well as training in common molecular biology experimental techniques across different laboratories. The goal is to enable students to truly participate in annual projects and laboratory rotations, rather than just observing and assisting. The basic operations are standardized, the data obtained is repeatable, and students gradually participate in the core parts of the experimental projects, gaining an improvement in scientific literacy and confidence in scientific research abilities.

default.zh: 本课程是大一新生入门实验课。实验室的安全有序管理是实验工作正常进行的基本保证，凡进入实验室工作、学习的人员，必须遵守实验室有关要求。近年来，实验事故频发，加强实验室安全教育刻不容缓。本课程“实验室安全”部分培养学生安全意识，养成重视安全的习惯，获得安全保障的能力，包括水电气、消防、化学试剂、生物材料等等实验操作和实验室环境的安全以及操作使用仪器设备过程等方面的安全。 本课程“基础实验训练”部分，练习使用微量移液器、配制试剂、提取核酸，培养实验必备的基本技能，掌握基本的试剂配制，掌握显微镜、微量移液器、水平电泳器材的使用，在实验中操作规范，所得数据可重复，培养基本的科研素养。
default.en: This course is an introductory experimental course for freshmen. The safe and orderly management of the laboratory is the basic guarantee for the normal operation of the experimental work. The personnel who enter the laboratory to work and study must comply with the relevant requirements of the laboratory. In recent years, experimental accidents happen frequently, so it is urgent to strengthen laboratory safety education. The "Laboratory safety" part of this course develops students' safety awareness, develops the habit of attaching importance to safety, and obtains the ability of safety guarantee, including the safety of experimental operation and laboratory environment such as water and electricity, fire protection, chemical reagents, biological materials, and the operation and use of instruments and equipment. In the "Basic experimental training" part of this course, students will practice micropipette, prepare reagents, extract nucleic acid and protein, and cultivate basic skills necessary for experiments. Finally, students will be able to master the annual project in the freshman year and enter the laboratory rotation later, standardize basic operations, and obtain repeatable data. Finally, they will gradually participate in the core part of experimental projects. Gain the improvement of scientific research literacy, and the confidence of scientific research ability.

default.zh: 生物学特色实验是面向大一本科生开设的富有生命科学特色的实验课程，集合了植物学、动物学、微生物学以及分子生物学等多方向多学科的富有趣味的实验内容。本门课程为第一部分，包含《植物的组织培养》、《模式动物斑马鱼》两个实验项目。 《植物的组织培养》是植物学方向的特色实验。与动物细胞不同，植物体内的任何一个细胞，都包含有发育成一株完整新植株的全部信息与潜力，这种潜能称为全能性，是植物组织培养的理论基础。本实验通过在无菌条件下，在合适的光照与湿度环境中，在人工制作的培养基质上，培养剪成小段的植物器官，诱导具有分裂能力的不定形的细胞团（愈伤组织），分化出新的嫩叶幼芽等新器官的过程，展示成熟的植物组织培养技术。 《模式动物斑马鱼》是动物学与发育生物学方向的特色实验，斑马鱼是鲤形目鲤科短担尼鱼属的鱼类，是生命科学研究中常用的模式生物的一种。实验中，学生不仅可以在体视显微镜下观察成年鱼体的生理结构，还能近距离观察受精卵的发育过程。
default.en: Biological Characteristic Experiment is an experimental course with life science characteristics for first-year undergraduates. It combines interesting experiments in various directions such as botany, zoology, microbiology and molecular biology. This course is the first part, including two experiments, “Tissue Culture of Plants” and “Model Animal Zebrafish”. “Tissue Culture of Plants” is a characteristic experiment in the direction of botany. Unlike animal cells, any cell in a plant contains all the information and potential to develop into a brand new plant. This is called totipotency. Totipotency is the theoretical basis for plant tissue culture. In this experiment, mature plant tissue culture technology was demonstrated by cultivating small segments of plant organs, under aseptic conditions, in suitable environment, and on the artificially medium, which would induce amorphous cell masses with division ability (calluses), and then differentiate into new organs such as new young leaves and shoots. “Model animal zebrafish” is a characteristic experiment in the direction of Zoology and Developmental Biology. Zebrafish is a fish of the genus Brachymonith in the family Cyprinidae, is a type of model organism commonly used in life sciences. In this experiment, students can observe not only the physiological structure of adult fish under a stereomicroscope, but also the development of fertilized eggs.

default.zh: 生物学特色实验是面向大一本科生开设的富有生命科学特色的实验课程，集合了植物学、动物学、微生物学以及分子生物学等多方向多学科的富有趣味的实验内容。本课程为第一部分，包含《植物的组织培养》、《模式动物斑马鱼》两个实验项目。 《植物的组织培养》是植物学方向的特色实验。与动物细胞不同，植物体内的任何一个细胞，都包含有发育成一株完整新植株的全部信息与潜力，这种潜能称为全能性，是植物组织培养的理论基础。本实验在无菌条件下，在合适的光照与湿度环境中，在人工制作的培养基质上，培养剪成小段的植物器官，诱导离体的植物器官转化为不定形的具有分裂能力、分化潜能的细胞团（愈伤组织）。 《模式动物斑马鱼》是动物学与发育生物学方向的特色实验，斑马鱼是鲤形目鲤科短担尼鱼属的鱼类，是生命科学研究中常用的模式生物的一种。实验中，学生不仅可以在体视显微镜下观察成年鱼体的生理结构，还能近距离观察受精卵的发育过程。
default.en: Biological Characteristic Experiment is an experimental course with life science characteristics for first-year undergraduates。It combines interesting experiments in various directions such as botany, zoology, microbiology and molecular biology. This course is the first part, including two experiments, “Tissue Culture of Plants” and “Model Animal Zebrafish”. “Tissue Culture of Plants” is a characteristic experiment in the direction of botany. Unlike animal cells, any cell in a plant contains all the information and potential to develop into a brand new plant, which is called totipotency. Totipotency is the theoretical basis for plant tissue culture. In this experiment, under aseptic conditions, in suitable environment, and on the artificially medium, plant organs would be cut into small segments and cultured. these ex vivo plant organs would be induced to amorphous cell masses (calluses), which have division ability and huge differentiation potential. “Model animal zebrafish” is a characteristic experiment in the direction of Zoology and Developmental Biology. Zebrafish is a fish of the genus Brachymonith in the family Cyprinidae， is a type of model organism commonly used in life sciences.In this experiment, students can observe not only the physiological structure of adult fish under a stereomicroscope, but also the development of fertilized eggs.

default.zh: 生物化学就是生命的化学，是研究生物体的化学组成和生命过程中的化学变化的科学。生物化学研究的是生命现象的化学本质，一切与生命有关的化学现象都是生物化学的研究对象。随着社会发展，生命科学与人类健康、环境保障、工业与技术产业发展的关系日益紧密。科学技术的发展和融合需要高水平的复合型人才，不仅要有良好的数、理、化和专业基础知识，还要有生命科学和信息科学的相关知识。而生物化学是生命科学中最重要的基础课程之一，掌握坚实的生物化学基础知识对相关专业的学生不仅是顺利完成学业的保障，也是丰富自身科学素养、培养全面科学思维的必要工具。 生物化学X1课程的主要内容是基于生物分子的组成、结构、性质与功能，以及结构与功能的关系，包括研究这些问题的主要实验方法。本课程与物理、化学基础知识、与生命科学发展历程、生命科学前沿热点均密切相关。 学生通过本课程的学习，能够有一下收获： 掌握各类生物分子的基本概念、组成和结构、功能特征，尤其是生物大分子的结构与功能的关系，理解生物化学问题的研究方法及其原理，了解生物化学及其相关学科研究的研究前言进展。建立研究和理解生物化学的基本思维方法。
default.en: Biochemistry is the chemistry of life. It is the science of studying the chemical composition of organisms and the chemical changes in the process of life. Biochemistry studies the chemical nature of life phenomena. All life-related chemical phenomena are the research objects of biochemistry. With the development of society, the relationships between life sciences and human health, environmental protection, industrial and technological industries have become increasingly close. The development and integration of science and technology calls for high-level compound talents, not only with good basic knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry and specialty, but also with relevant knowledge of life science and information science. Mastering basic knowledge of biochemistry is not only the guarantee for students to complete their studies smoothly, but also the necessary tool to enrich their scientific literacy and cultivate comprehensive scientific thinking. The main content of Biochemistry X1 course is based on the composition, structure, properties and functions of biomolecules, as well as the relationship between structure and function, including the main experimental methods for studying these issues. This course is closely related to the basic knowledge of physics and chemistry, the development history of life sciences, and the cutting-edge hotspots of life sciences Students can get some benefits through the study of this course: Mastery of basic concepts, composition, structure, and functional characteristics of various biomolecules, particularly the structure-function relationship of biological macromolecules. Understanding of research methods and principles in biochemistry. Knowledge of cutting-edge advances in biochemistry and related fields. Development of basic thinking methods for studying and understanding biochemistry.

default.zh: 生物化学是生命科学重要的基础课程之一，是研究构成生物体各种生物分子的化学组成和生命过程中的化学变化规律的科学。本课程分为上、下两个学期，第一学期课程主要侧重于静态生物化学的学习，主要教学内容包括组成生命的各种主要分子的化学组成、生物学特性及生理功能等。通过课程的学习，使学生深入理解和掌握蛋白质、酶、糖、脂类、核酸等重要生物大分子的化学组成、分子结构及功能特性，了解维生素、激素和抗生素等与生物代谢和疾病相关分子的结构和功能。第一学期还设置了与讲授课程紧密相关的实验内容，使学生通过生化实验加深对课堂学习内容的理解，并训练和培养学生生化实验的动手能力。生物化学第二学期课程主要侧重于动态生物化学的学习，主要包括生物物质和能量代谢、遗传信息的传递以及相关调控途径。通过课程的学习，使学生掌握重要的无氧代谢和有氧代谢的代谢途径、能量产生的过程和基本原理、遗传信息传递的基本过程以及基因表达调控规律。通过生物化学课程的学习，使学生具备生物化学的思想方法和基本素质，能运用所学的基础理论和实验技能，说明和解决科研实践中有关的生物化学问题。
default.en: Biochemistry is one of the most important basic courses of Life Science. It is the study of the chemical constitution of biological molecules and chemical reactions which occur in living cells and tissues. This course is divided into two semester to study. In the first semester, the main content is to be focused on the static biochemistry including chemical constitution, biological character and functions of the main biological molecules. By studying this part of course, students could further understand and grasp the chemical constitution, structure and function of biological molecules, and comprehend the structure and functions of vitamin, hormone and antibiotic related with metabolism and diseases. Moreover, some experiments are designed for the first semester course, in order to understand biochemistry deeply and train the experimental skills. The main content of the second semester of Biochemistry is to be focused on the dynamic biochemistry, including the material and energy metabolism, delivery of genetic information, and related regulation. By the study of the second semester, students should master the important metabolic pathways, the process and mechanism of energy production, the common process of delivery of genetic information, and regulation of gene expression. Through the study of this course, basic principles and thinking strategy of biochemistry could be delivered to the students, and make them be able to explain and address some biochemistry problems by using the rules of biochemistry theories and experimental skills.

default.zh: 本门实验课程是为非生物学专业辅修的学生开设，通过了解基础细胞生物学基础理论，为后续学习过程中涉及到的学科交叉内容进行基本理论和技术方法的储备。从细胞的认知、细胞的特性、细胞的行为学观察、细胞培养实验相关的基本技术等方面进行课程学习。掌握基础细胞实验基本理论，掌握基础细胞实验涉及的细胞复苏、传代、冻存等基本技术；掌握细胞计数、细胞形态观察等。课程目标是能够为学生提供良好的理论与实践结合的学习平台。
default.en: This laboratory course is for non-biology majors minor students, students understand the basic cell biology basic theory, for subsequent learning process involving the cross-disciplinary content of the basic theory and technical methods of learning reserves. The course is conducted in terms of cell cognition, cell properties, behavioral observation of cells, and basic techniques related to cell culture experiments. Master the basic theory of basic cell experiments, master the basic cell experiments involved in cell resuscitation, passaging, freezing and other basic techniques; master the cell counting, cell morphology observation and so on. The goal of the course is to be able to provide students with a good learning platform combining theory and practice.

default.zh: 生物化学是生命科学重要的主干专业课程之一，是研究构成生物体各种生物分子的化学组成和生命过程中的化学变化规律的科学。《生物化学实验》紧密联系《生物化学》课程，涵盖了样品获取与处理、蛋白浓度测定、酶的特性分析、酶活测定、电泳检测技术、血脂定量分析技术。有综合实验项目6个：蛋白质浓度测定实验、唾液淀粉酶的特性实验（温度、pH值、激活剂、抑制剂的影响）、分光光度法测血脂含量（胆固醇、甘油三酯）、同工酶电泳分离分析，设计实验项目2个：酶的提取、层析纯化、纯化效果检测、酶活测定，包含多种蛋白、脂类、糖类和维生素，和生命健康息息相关，促使大家既掌握相关的知识和技能，又注意健康工作和生活。
default.en: Biochemistry is one of the main courses of life science. It is a science that studies the chemical composition of various biomolecules and the chemical changes in the life process. Biochemistry Experiment is closely related to Biochemistry, covering sample acquisition and processing, protein concentration determination, enzyme characteristic analysis, enzyme activity determination, electrophoresis detection technology, and lipid quantitative analysis technology. There are 6 comprehensive experimental projects: protein concentration determination experiment, salivary amylase characteristic experiment (temperature, pH value, activator, inhibitor influence), spectrophotometric measurement of blood lipid content (cholesterol, triglyceride), isozyme electrophoresis separation analysis, 2 design experimental projects: Enzyme extraction, chromatography purification, purification effect detection, enzyme activity determination, including a variety of proteins, lipids, sugars and vitamins, and life and health is closely related to promote everyone to master the relevant knowledge and skills, but also pay attention to healthy work and life.

default.zh: 生物学基础是生命科学的一门基础课，其主要任务是使学生掌握有关生物学的基本概念和基本理论，使学生对分子和细胞的结构与功能、有机体的稳态、发育、遗传、适应与进化等方面有一个整体的理解，为今后其它课程的学习奠定扎实的基础。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握生物学的基本知识、基本理论、基本规律，包括生物分子、细胞的结构功能、个体生物学（高等动植物的结构、功能、生殖发育）、遗传变异、生物进化、现代生物技术等基本内容，使学生了解当前生物学技术的应用和生物学的发展现状。理解生命的基本特征以及生命科学的分支与相互关系。了解生命科学的现状、国内外研究前沿与最新动态。
default.en: The basic biology is a basic course of life science. Its main task is to enable students to master the basic concepts of biology and basic theory, and have a whole understanding of life about molecular and cell structure and function, organism steady state, development, genetic, adaptive and evolution. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic knowledge of biology, basic theory, basic laws, including biological molecules, cell structure and function, individual biology (the structure, function, reproductive development of higher flora plants), genetic variation, biological evolution, modern biotechnology and other basic content. Help students understand the current application of biological technology. Understand the basic characteristics of life and the relationship between the branches of life science. Understand the status of life sciences, and the latest developments.

default.zh: 遗传学是研究生物遗传和变异规律的科学，是分子生物学和基因工程的基础理论学科之一，因此遗传学是生物系各专业的必修课程。遗传学的研究内容包括遗传学三大定律、遗传重组、核外遗传、免疫遗传、染色体畸变、基因突变、群体和数量性状遗传。通过本课程的学习，学生应全面掌握遗传学的基本原理及研究方法及遗传学在实践中的应用。了解现代遗传学发展的新成果，并能够与农业、医学、工业领域中的传统技术相结合，为进一步学好生物技术、基因工程及有关遗传学分支学科奠定基础。
default.en: Genetics is the science about biological heredity and the rules of variation, and the basic of molecular biology and gene engineering, thus it is a required curriculum in the department of biology. Genetics systematically expounds the basic principles of heredity and variation, the basic methods and theories of genetic analysis, and the application of genetics in the prevention and cure of human genetic diseases and the breeding of agricultural animals and plants. The development of Genetics is comprised of two stages，the classical genetics and the modern genetics. It introduces important concepts concerning Mendel genetic analysis（law of segregation, law of independent assortment and law of linkage）, genetic analysis of tetrad, molecular mechanisms of genetic recombination, extranuclear inheritance, immunogenetics, genic mutation, chromosomal aberration, genetic analysis of quantitative character and population, genetic and human health，epigenetics are also provided in the course. The students should master the elementary knowledge and methods of genetic researches and they should also be able to apply the knowledge and methods in practice. They will have a cognition to some complicated vital phenomena which fits the objective rule, and get the message of new achievements in the modern genetics. Combining with traditional skills in the field of agriculture、medicine science and industry, the learner will build a strong foundation to study biotechnology, gene engineering and many other branches about genetics.

default.zh: 生物学是研究生命现象和生命活动的科学，现今已经获得的生物学知识几乎都来自于人们对自然界的观察和实验。 生物学基础实验以生活中常见的动植物为实验对象或材料，引导学习者使用科学探究的方法，认识观察身边的世界与环境。实验涉及植物、动物、细胞及遗传多方面内容。通过本课程的学习，学习者能够熟练使用显微镜观察微观世界，了解动植物组织细胞的基本观察方法，于实践中培养据事实讲话，求是求真的学习态度与科研态度。
default.en: Biology is the science that studies life phenomenon and life activity, the biology knowledge we already obtained comes from the observation and experiments of nature. This course takes material from students’ surroundings, guide students master the way to understand the world more scientifically. The course involves plant, animal, cell and genetic, etc. After the course study，we can develop students the skills of using the microscope to observe the micro world，knowing the basic methods to observe the tissue of animal and plant， and cultivating professional studying attitude。

default.zh: 遗传学（A）实验是贴合遗传学（A）设置的实验课程，旨在通过讲授遗传学经典的实验设计与理念，讲解实际的遗传实验操作，加深学生对理论课程内容的理解，拓展学生的探索研究性思维。 实验包括6个实验项目，包括经典遗传学、数量遗传学、群体遗传学、表观遗传学等遗传学不同分支方向。 经典遗传学实验主要是通过黑腹果蝇的饲养、突变体及生活史观察，果蝇杂交系列及观察果蝇唾液腺染色体三个实验项目，认识遗传学常用模式生物黑腹果蝇，了解果蝇唾液腺染色体的观察方法与应用，掌握果蝇杂交的基本要点。 人体指纹是位于手指端部的皮肤纹理，具有鲜明的个体特异性和高度的稳定性。有些异常皮纹与遗传病明显相关，皮纹分析可用于遗传病、特别是染色体病的初筛和辅助诊断。指纹是由多基因控制的性状，研究人体指纹可一窥数量遗传学的门径。 人类有多个血型系统，ABO是日常生活中比较常见的一种。O、A、B与AB四种血型，除了A、B型对应两种基因型，O与AB型均从表型就能判断其基因型，便于衡量群体遗传的平衡性。 表观遗传学是研究非DNA序列改变的基因表达与调控的可遗传修饰，探索从基因演绎为表型的过程和机制的遗传学分支，基因组印记是该分支研究的重点之一。本实验以小鼠的一段基因序列为实验对象，分别取母本、子代的DNA与子代的cDNA片段做材料，检测该序列中是否存在亲本选择性表达，即只表达一方亲本，另一方不表达的SNP位点，是否存在基因印记。
default.en: Experiments of Genetics A which is an experimental course set up for Genetics A , aims to deepen students' understanding of the theoretical course content, to expand students' exploratory and research thinking, by teaching the classic experimental design and concept of genetics, explaining the actual operation of genetic experiments. The course has 6 experiments, including classical genetics, quantitative genetics, population genetics, epigenetics and other different branches of genetics. The classical genetics experiment includes the “culture and observation of the mutant of Drosophila melanogaster and their life history”, “Genetic crosses of Drosophila melanogaster” , and “observation of salivary gland chromosomes of Drosophila”, helping studentes understand the commonly used model organism of genetics Drosophila melanogaster, and handle the methods and technology of preparing the specimen of Drosophila salivary gland chromosomes, and to master the basis of genetic crosses of Drosophila . human fingerprint is a skin texture located at the tip of fingers, having distinct individual specificity and highly stability. Some abnormal striae are clearly related to genetic diseases, and stria analysis can be used for the initial screening and auxiliary diagnosis of genetic diseases, especially chromosomal diseases. Fingerprints are traits controlled by multiple genes, and studying human fingerprints can provide a glimpse into quantitative genetics. Humans have multiple blood group systems, in which ABO is one of the more common ones in daily life. There are four blood types of O, A, B and AB, except for the two genotypes corresponding to A and B, the genotypes of O and AB can be directly detemined by the phenotype, can detect equilibrium population conveniently. Epigenetics is a branch of genetics, which studies the heritable modification of gene expression and regulation of non-DNA sequence alterations, explores the process and mechanism of gene deduction from gene to phenotype. In this experiment, a gene sequence of mice was used as the experimental object, and the DNA of the mother and offspring and the cDNA fragment of the offspring were taken as materials to detect whether there was selective expression of the parent in the sequence, in another word, to detect whether there is a genetic imprint on SNP sites that only one parent is expressed and the other parent isn't’.

default.zh: 遗传学基础系统地阐述了遗传及变异的基本原理、遗传分析的基本方法和理论，以及遗传学在人类遗传病防治和农业动植物育种中的应用。遗传学的研究内容包括遗传学三大定律（分离定律、独立分配定律和连锁交换定律）、核外遗传、免疫遗传、基因突变、染色体畸变、群体和数量性状遗传、遗传学与人类健康和表观遗传。通过本课程的学习，学生应全面掌握遗传学的基本原理和研究方法，并能够将这些原理及方法应用于遗传学实践中。同时，了解现代遗传学发展的新成果，并能够与农业、医学、工业领域中的传统技术相结合，为进一步学好生物技术、基因工程及有关遗传学分支学科奠定基础。
default.en: Fundamentals of genetics systematically expounds the basic principles of heredity and variation, the basic methods and theories of genetic analysis, and the application of genetics in the prevention and cure of human genetic diseases and the breeding of agricultural animals and plants. The development of Genetics is comprised of two stages，the classical genetics and the modern genetics. It introduces important concepts concerning Mendel genetic analysis（law of segregation, law of independent assortment and law of linkage）, extranuclear inheritance, immunogenetics, genic mutation, chromosomal aberration, genetic analysis of quantitative character and population, genetic and human health，epigenetics are also provided in the course. The students should master the elementary knowledge and methods of genetic researches and they should also be able to apply the knowledge and methods in practice. They will have a cognition to some complicated vital phenomena which fits the objective rule, and get the message of new achievements in the modern genetics. Combining with traditional skills in the field of agriculture、medicine science and industry, the learner will build a strong foundation to study biotechnology, gene engineering and many other branches about genetics.

default.zh: 生物统计是在生物科学研究中，把试验研究,调查观测所取得的数据进行科学分析的数理统计方法。生物统计学在传统生物学、医学和农学中被广泛应用，在新兴的分子生物学中也发挥着重要的作用。生物统计学已经成为现代生物学研究不可缺少的工具，是每一位生物学家必备的基本技能。本课程目的在于为生物科学本科生打下良好的统计学基础。课程设计用于半学期的生物统计学导论性课堂教学，可在生物技术和生物工程专业讲授，需要生物学和代数基础知识作为先修课程，课程举例来自生命科学的众多领域，如遗传学、生态学、农学及医学。本课程强调基础知识和基本统计理论的理解，各种统计方法的合理应用，常见统计软件的使用，以及进行科学实验设计的能力。
default.en: Biostatistics is the application of statistics to a wide range of topics in biology. The science of biostatistics encompasses the design of biological experiments, especially in medicine and agriculture and the collection, summarization, and analysis of data from those experiments. Biostatistics is also wildly applied to molecular biology fields and becomes an indispensable tool for biological research. Knowledge of basic statistics is an essential part of being a biologist. The course of is a half semester course designed to guide undergraduates majoring in biotechnology and bioengineering in statistics for the life sciences. Appropriate prerequisites include some coursework in biology and algebra. Examples are taken in a wild range of life sciences including genetics, ecology, agriculture, and medicine. The course emphasizes the understanding of key concepts and fundamental principles of statistics, the application of various statistical methods to solve biological problems based on raw data, the usage of general statistical software and the ability to design experiment.

default.zh: 遗传学基础实验是贴合遗传学基础课程设置的实验课程，旨在通过几个简单的实验，使学生对遗传学理论课的内容获得更加直观的认识与深入的理解。 黑腹果蝇是遗传学常用的实验材料，也是经典的模式动物。 染色体是DNA的载体，是生物遗传的主要物质基础。 在孟德尔遗传学基础上，通过检测群体中ABO血型的分布来了解群体遗传学。生物的遗传除了有或无的性状遗传，还有数量遗传，人体指纹遗传便是其中的一种。
default.en: Bascic Experiment of Genetics is an experimental course that fits the basic curriculum of genetics，aiming to enable students to gain a more intuitive understanding and in-depth understanding of the content of genetics theory course through a few simple experiments. Drosophila melanogaster is a commonly used experimental material in genetics and a classic model animal. Chromosomes are the carriers of DNA and are the main material basis for biological inheritance. On the basis of Mendelian genetics, population genetics is understood by detecting the distribution of ABO blood groups in the population. In addition to the inheritance of traits with or without biological inheritance, there is also quantitative inheritance, one of which is human fingerprints genetics.

default.zh: 本门实验课程是为非生物学专业辅修的学生开设，通过了解基础细胞生物学基础理论，为后续学习过程中涉及到的学科交叉内容进行基本理论和技术方法的储备。从细胞的认知、细胞的特性、细胞的行为学观察、细胞培养实验相关的基本技术等方面进行课程学习。掌握基础细胞实验基本理论，掌握基础细胞实验涉及的细胞复苏、传代、冻存等基本技术；掌握细胞计数、细胞形态观察等。课程目标是能够为学生提供良好的理论与实践结合的学习平台。
default.en: This laboratory course is for non-biology majors minor students, students understand the basic cell biology basic theory, for subsequent learning process involving the cross-disciplinary content of the basic theory and technical methods of learning reserves. The course is conducted in terms of cell cognition, cell properties, behavioral observation of cells, and basic techniques related to cell culture experiments. Master the basic theory of basic cell experiments, master the basic cell experiments involved in cell resuscitation, passaging, freezing and other basic techniques; master the cell counting, cell morphology observation and so on. The goal of the course is to be able to provide students with a good learning platform combining theory and practice.

default.zh: 随着社会发展，生命科学与人类健康、环境保障、工业与技术产业发展的关系日益紧密。科学技术的发展和融合需要高水平的复合型人才，不仅要有良好的数、理、化和专业基础知识，还要有生命科学和信息科学的相关知识。生物化学是生命科学中最重要的基础课程之一，是研究构成生物体各种生物分子的化学组成和生命过程中的化学变化规律的科学，为分子生物学、结构生物学、蛋白质工程与酶工程等课程的学习打下基础。 本课程共32个学时，包括静态生物化学和动态生物化学，分别侧重包括组成生命的各种主要分子的化学组成、生物学特性及生理功能；生物物质和能量代谢过程以及相关调控途径。通过本课程学习，使学生对于生物分子的结构与功能、物质代谢与能量代谢等重要的生物基础问题具有比较深入的了解和认识。 通过本课程的学习，可以使学生了解生物化学的基础知识以及研究进展，具备从事自身专业相关的生物化学知识背景；并在今后的学习或科学研究中能够结合生物化学的视角、方法提出新的问题或找到解决问题的新方法，促进交叉学科的发展。
default.en: With the development of society, the relationship between life sciences and human health, environmental protection, industrial and technological industry development is becoming increasingly close. The development and integration of science and technology need high-level composite talents, who not only have good basic knowledge in mathematics, physics, chemistry, and profession, but also have relevant knowledge in life sciences and information science. Biochemistry is one of the most important foundational courses in life sciences, which studies the chemical composition of various biomolecules that make up living organisms and the chemical changes in life processes. It lays the foundation for the study of courses such as molecular biology, structural biology, protein engineering, and enzyme engineering. This course consists of 32 class hours, including static biochemistry and dynamic biochemistry, with a focus on the chemical composition, biological characteristics, and physiological functions of various major molecules that make up life. The basic processes and regulatory modes of biomass and energy metabolism, as well as related regulatory pathways . Through this course, students will have a deep understanding and comprehension of important biological fundamental issues such as the structure and function of biomolecules, material and energy metabolism. The course objective of this course is to: 1: Understand the basic knowledge and research progress of biochemistry, and have a background in biochemistry related to one's own profession. 2: To enable students to combine the perspective and methods of biochemistry to propose new problems or find new solutions in their future learning or scientific research, promoting the development of interdisciplinary studies.

default.zh: 分子生物学是一门从分子水平上研究生命现象，阐明生命本质的生物学分支学科，是当代生命科学中发展最快，并与其他学科广泛交叉的重要前沿领域。分子生物学主要研究DNA、RNA、蛋白质等生物大分子的结构性质及其变化与生物大分子生理功能之间的关系，以及这种生物大分子结构与功能之间关系和生物分子之间相互作用方式在生命活动中的功能作用，从而揭示生命体的遗传、生殖、生长和发育等生命基本特征的分子机制，进而为利用和改造生命奠定理论基础和提供新的研究手段和策略。其中，揭示生物信息在细胞中的传递过程及其表达调控的机制，是分子生物学的核心研究内容。分子生物学与细胞生物学、生物化学、生物物理学、遗传学和基因组学等生命学科密切相关，是当代生命科学研究的核心基础。通过本课程的学习，旨在使学生能够了解现代分子生物学发展的新动态和最新研究成果，掌握分子生物学的基本原理和主要研究方法，提高从分子水平上揭示生命现象的科研能力，从而为后续的生命专业课程的学习和未来的生命科学研究奠定基础。
default.en: Molecular biology is a branch of biology that deals with the molecular basis of biological activities. This field has a close relationship with other areas of life sciences, particularly cell biology, biochemistry, biophysics, genetics and genomics. Molecular biology chiefly concerns itself with understanding the relationships between structure and function of biological molecules including DNA, RNA, protein and other biomolecules, as well as learning how these relations contribute to the operation and control of biological processes, of which the regulation and control of gene expression is particularly emphasized. The progress in molecular biology can deepen our understanding of the molecular mechanisms underlying inheritance, reproduction, growth and development, which will contribute to the development of novel concepts, strategies and techniques for life sciences. The purpose of this course is not only to convey an understanding of the basic concepts and principles of molecular biology to undergraduate students, but also introduce the cutting edge progress in this field to them.

default.zh: 生物化学是生命科学重要的主干专业课程之一，是研究构成生物体各种生物分子的化学组成和生命过程中的化学变化规律的科学。《生物化学基础实验》紧密联系《生物化学》课程，涵盖了蛋白浓度测定、酶的特性分析、电泳检测技术等等。有分光光度法蛋白质浓度测定实验、唾液淀粉酶的特性实验（温度、pH值、激活剂、抑制剂的影响）、同工酶电泳分离分析等等，包含多种蛋白质、酶和维生素，和生命健康息息相关，促使大家既掌握相关的知识和技能，又注意健康工作和生活。
default.en: Biochemistry is one of the main courses of life science. It is a science that studies the chemical composition of various biomolecules and the chemical changes in the life process. Biochemistry Experiment is closely related to Biochemistry, covering protein concentration determination, enzyme characteristic analysis, enzyme activity determination, and electrophoresis detection technology. There are 4 comprehensive experimental projects: spectrophotometric measurement of protein concentration determination experiment, salivary amylase characteristic experiment (temperature, pH value, activator, inhibitor influence), isozyme electrophoresis separation analysis, including a variety of proteins, enzyme, and vitamins, and life and health is closely related to promote everyone to master the relevant knowledge and skills, but also pay attention to healthy work and life.

default.zh: 生物化学是生命科学重要的基础课程之一，是研究构成生物体各种生物分子的化学组成和生命过程中的化学变化规律的科学。本课程分为上、下两个学期，第一学期课程主要侧重于静态生物化学的学习，主要教学内容包括组成生命的各种主要分子的化学组成、生物学特性及生理功能等。生物化学第二学期课程主要侧重于动态生物化学的学习，主要包括生物物质和能量代谢、遗传信息的传递以及相关调控途径。通过课程的学习，使学生掌握重要的无氧代谢和有氧代谢的代谢途径、能量产生的过程和基本原理、遗传信息传递的基本过程以及基因表达调控规律。通过生物化学A（2）课程的学习，使学生具备生物化学的思想方法和基本素质，能运用所学的基础理论和实验技能，说明和解决科研实践中有关的生物化学问题。
default.en: Biochemistry is one of the most important basic courses of Life Science. It is the study of the chemical constitution of biological molecules and chemical reactions which occur in living cells and tissues. This course is divided into two semester to study. In the first semester, the main content is to be focused on the static biochemistry including chemical constitution, biological character and functions of the main biological molecules. The main content of the second semester of Biochemistry is to be focused on the dynamic biochemistry, including the material and energy metabolism, delivery of genetic information, and related regulation. By the study of the second semester, students should master the important metabolic pathways, the process and mechanism of energy production, the common process of delivery of genetic information, and regulation of gene expression. Through the study of this course, basic principles and thinking strategy of biochemistry could be delivered to the students, and make them be able to explain and address some biochemistry problems by using the rules of biochemistry theories and experimental skills.

default.zh: 微生物是与人类长期共存的肉眼难于看清楚的微小生物。它一方面给我们生活带来了许多便利和产品如啤酒、面包、抗生素等；但另一方面又是人类健康的杀手如艾滋病、肺结核等。因此，有必要对微生物作全面的了解，这样才能指导我们更好地利用和预防病原微生物。 微生物学是生命科学的基础课，它着重阐明微生物的五大生物学规律，即微生物的形态构造，生理代谢，遗传变异，生态分布和分类进化，重点在前四个规律。这门课程共设十章，分别介绍了微生物的五大共性，微生物的形态和构造，微生物的营养和培养基，微生物的代谢和发酵，微生物的生长及其控制，微生物的遗传和育种，微生物的生态，传染和免疫，以及微生物的分类和鉴定。
default.en: Microorganism is a kind of tiny creatures that are hardly visible to the naked eyes spreading all around us. On one hand, they improve our living standard by producing some useful products, such as beer, bread, and antibiotics. On the other hand, however, some of them are the threats to human health, such as AIDS and pulmonary tuberculosis caused by microbes. Thereby, it is necessary to study the microorganism thoroughly in order to use or control different microbes. Microbiology is one of the core courses in biology. This course puts main emphasis on irradiating five of the principle laws in microorganisms, namely the morphology and the structure of the microbes; the physiology and the metabolism of the microbes; the heredity and the variety of the microbes; the ecology distribution, the classification and the evolution of the microbes. This course contains ten chapters, which deal with the five common characters of microbes, the morphology and structure of microbes, the nutrition and the mediums, the metabolism and the fermentation, the growth of the microbes and its control, the heredity of microbes and microbial breeding, microbial ecology, the infection and immunology, and the classification and identification of the microbes, respectively.

default.zh: 微生物学实验的技术和方法不仅仅是微生物建立和发展的基础，也广泛渗透到现代生命科学的各分支领域，为整个生命科学技术的发展做出了积极重要的贡献。因此，微生物学实验是一门十分重要的实验基础课程。 课程内容以基础性为主，包括常见细菌&霉菌&酵母菌的形态构造、常规制片&大小测定&数量测定、常用微生物培养基的制作、土壤微生物的分离与培养，噬菌体的分离以及微生物的生理生化反应等。实验内容的设定，与实验条件紧密相关，具有很强的可操作性。 课程目标1：使学生学会使用微生物实验室常规设备，初步认识微生物不同类群； 课程目标2：获得微生物学实验技术的基本操作方法的训练，逐步具有使用现代生物技术解决实际问题的能力； 课程目标3：加强学生的实验室素养与合作意识，培养学生的科研素质，锻炼学生发现问题、查找资料、解决问题以及归纳总结的综合能力。
default.en: The techniques and methods of basic experiments in microbiology are not only fundamental to the establishment and development of microbiology itself but also permeate extensively into various branches of modern life sciences, making a positive and significant contribution to the advancement of life science technologies overall. Therefore, basic microbiology laboratory courses are of great importance. The course content is primarily fundamental, including the morphological structures of common bacteria, molds, and yeasts, routine slide preparation, size and quantity measurement, production of commonly used microbiological media, isolation and cultivation of soil microorganisms, isolation of bacteriophages, as well as physiological and biochemical reactions of microorganisms. The settings of the experimental content are closely related to the experimental conditions and are highly operable. Course Objective 1: Enable students to use routine equipment in microbiology laboratories and gain a preliminary understanding of different microbial groups. Course Objective 2: Provide training in the basic operational methods of microbiological experimental techniques, and gradually develop the ability to solve practical problems using modern biotechnology. Course Objective 3: Cultivate students’ scientific literacy, and exercise their comprehensive abilities to identify problems, research information, solve issues, and summarize findings.

default.zh: 细胞生物学是现代生命科学中一门重要的基础前沿学科，与分子生物学、发育生物学、神经生物学等学科相互渗透与交融，研究重点揭示细胞重大生命活动的分子机制。随着细胞生物学学科的发展，生物学大师威尔逊所预言的“一切生命的关键问题都要到细胞中去寻找答案”正在成为现实。细胞生物学是生物学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，相关的研究成果正在以空前的广度和深度，直接或间接的影响和改变人类的生活。本课程主要讲授细胞生物学学科的形成及发展、细胞生物学研究方法、细胞结构及功能、细胞增殖和死亡以及信号转导等细胞生命活动。通过本课程的学习，使学生理解生命活动中复杂的细胞和分子过程，掌握细胞生物学的主要研究方法和细胞重大生命活动的分子机制，培养学生以细胞为研究对象的综合分析和实验设计的科研能力。
default.en: Cell biology is an important basic branch of the modern life science, which reveals the molecular mechanism of the major life activities in cells on the basis of molecular biology, developmental biology and neurobiology. With the development of cell biology, it becomes true that "The key to every biological problem must finally be sought in the cell" was written by the great classical cell biologist, E.B. Wilson. Cell biology is a very important basic course in biology. Related research results are affecting and changing human life directly or indirectly at an unprecedented extent. This course mainly covers the formation and development of cell biology, cell biology research methods, cell structure and function, cell proliferation and death, signal transduction and other cellular life activities. The purpose of this course is to convey an understanding of the complex cellular and molecular life activities, to master the main research methods and the molecular mechanism of the major life activities in cells, and to make the students with the ability to comprehensive analysis and experimental design in research.

default.zh: 实验教学是培养具有实践能力和创新意识的人才非常重要的教学环节。细胞生物学实验目的是通过实践环节培养学生们运用实验方法研究解决细胞生物学领域相关问题的能力。学生在学习细胞生物学理论课的基础上，学会将理论知识应用的细胞生物学相关的实验研究中。课程设置的实验涵盖了动物细胞培养的基础操作，细胞结构成分的分离与鉴定方法和技术，微丝、细胞周期和细胞凋亡的检测分析以及激光共聚焦显微镜技术和流式细胞术等。实验内容的安排和设计，目的是使学生不仅掌握细胞生物学基本的实验技术，还要掌握先进的实验方法。不仅培养学生具有实践能力，也具有创新的意识。在实验课学习过程中，形成正确的科学研究的思维方式，具备探索科学问题的能力，最终学生具备综合分析和解决问题的能力。通过课程的学习，为未来从事生命科学领域相关研究工作奠定基础。
default.en: Experimental teaching is a very important teaching process for cultivating talents with practical ability and innovative consciousness. The purpose of cell biology experiments is to cultivate students' ability to apply experimental methods to research and solve related problems in the field of cell biology through practical processes. On the basis of studying the theoretical courses of cell biology, students learn to apply theoretical knowledge to experimental research related to cell biology. The experiments offered in the course cover the basic operations of animal cell culture, methods and techniques for separating and identifying cellular structural components, detection and analysis of microfilament，cell cycle and apoptosis, as well as laser confocal microscope, and flow cytometry. The arrangement and design of experimental content aims to enable students to not only master the basic experimental techniques of cell biology, but also to master advanced experimental methods. Not only does it cultivate students' practical abilities, but also their awareness of innovation. During the learning process of experimental courses, students should develop a correct way of thinking in scientific research, possess the ability to explore scientific problems, and ultimately possess the ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems. By studying the course, lay the foundation for the future research in the field of life science.

default.zh: 《生物医学基础》是一门重要的专业基础课程。该课程综合了现代生物医学的基本知识，包括人体解剖学，人体生理学，药理学，遗传学，组织学与胚胎学，病理学，病理生理学，免疫学，以及分子生物学,生物化学等，是一门与基础医学中多学科密切交叉的综合性课程。他的研究对象是正常－异常机体，以分子－细胞－器官－系统为研究主线，适用于生物工程等与医学有关的非临床医学专业本科生。通过本课程的学习使学习者了解和掌握有关生物医学的一些基本理论和基础知识，为其后的专业课程学习打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The basis of the Biomedical is a discipline introducing basic knowledge about modern biomedical foundation such as human anatomy, human physiology, pharmacology, genetics, histology and embryology, pathology, pathophysiology, immunology and molecular biology, and biochemistry, is a basic medicine multidisciplinary cross closeintegrated curriculum. The object of this study is normal - abnormal body, molecular - cell - organ - system is the main line for this study. It is a specialized fundamental course for undergraduates majoring in biological engineering subjects. The aim of the course is to increase the student’s understandings about the basic knowledge about biomedical, help them study the following courses properly. We hope students can understand and grasp the essential theory and basic knowledge of the course.
