default.zh: 《生物医学基础实验》是围绕《生物医学基础》课程设置的实验课。 课程主要包括两部分：小鼠的大体解剖观察与各种组织观察，人体组织与病理切片观察。 小鼠的大体解剖观察与各种组织的观察的课程内容，使学生了解哺乳动物的生理结构与各组织器官之间的联系，加深对人体各种生理活动与器官功能的认识与理解。通过实验训练，培训学生掌握实验动物的基本操作知识。 各种病理切片标本的观察，则为学生提供了更加直观了解人体疾病的发生与细胞层面的表现。 课程设置从整体到局部，旨在通过实验教学，向学生提供一个渠道，经过这个渠道，学生可以对生物医学基础知识获得更加直观的认识与深入的理解。
default.en: " Experiments of the basis of the Biomedical " is an experimental course set around the "Biomedical Fundamentals" course. The Experiment course mainly consists of two parts: gross anatomical observation of mice and observation of various tissues, and observation of human tissues and pathological sections. The course content of gross anatomical observation of mice and observation of various tissues enables students to understand the relationship between the gross physiological structure of mammals and various tissues and organs, and deepen their knowledge and understanding of various physiological activities and organ functions of the human body. Through experimental training, students are trained to master the basic operation knowledge of laboratory animals. The observation of various pathological slide specimens provides students with a more intuitive understanding of the occurrence of human diseases and the manifestations at the cellular level. The curriculum is designed from the whole to the part, aiming to provide students with a channel, which provides students a more intuitive knowledge and deeper understanding of the basic knowledge of biomedicine.

default.zh: 本课程是大一新生入门实验课。 本课程第一部分重在培养学生的安全意识，建立重视安全的习惯，并获得安全保障的能力。近年来，实验事故频发，加强实验室安全教育刻不容缓。实验室的安全有序管理是实验工作正常进行的基本保证，凡进入实验室工作、学习的人员，必须遵守实验室有关要求。目标：培养强化学生具备安全意识，养成重视安全的习惯，获得安全保障的能力，包括水电气、消防、化学试剂、生物材料等等实验操作和实验室环境的安全以及操作使用仪器设备过程等方面的安全。 本课程第二部分为大一新生的基础实验训练，以生物实验室常用设备微量移液器为例，重点规范学生设备使用习惯、锻炼熟练规范的使用技能。目标：基础操作规范，微量移液精准，培养严谨的实验素养。 本课程第三部分为大一新生的细胞生物学基础实验训练。从细胞的认知、细胞的特性、细胞的行为学观察以及细胞实验相关的基本技术等方面进行学习和掌握。采用理论讲解、演示教学、科研实验案例结合的方式，通过细胞培养的普遍方法以及特殊细胞的个性化措施，并结合科研中实际的工作、已发表科研成果中涉及的细胞培养新技术和方法为牵引，让学生真正的理解细胞培养在科研实践中的应用。在互动式的教学过程中，增加师生之间的面对面交流，提高学习效果。课程学习过程中，学生独立进行全部实验操作，能够充分锻炼学生自主动手的实践能力。在规范学生们的实验操作的同时，激发他们的创新意识。目标：了解和掌握细胞培养的基本知识以及技术方法，掌握原代细胞培养、细胞复苏、细胞计数、细胞传代和增殖的方法和关键技术，培养学生的独立动手操作能力和规范性素养，夯实学生的基本实验技能，同时锻炼学生关注最新的前沿技术进展，并查阅资料、归纳问题和写总结报告的综合能力。
default.en: This freshman-level introductory laboratory course comprises three modules: 1) Laboratory Safety Training Intensifies safety awareness and establishes protocols for accident prevention in response to rising experimental incidents. Covers comprehensive safety standards for laboratory environments, including utilities management, fire control, chemical reagents handling, biological materials disposal, and equipment operation. Objectives: Cultivate safety-first mindset, develop hazard mitigation capabilities, and ensure compliance with institutional safety regulations. 2) Fundamental Techniques Certification Focuses on standardizing core instrumentation skills using micropipettes as the paradigm. Emphasizes precision liquid handling and development of rigorous experimental discipline. Objectives: Achieve technical proficiency in volumetric measurements and instill standardized operational protocols. 3) Cellular Biology Core Competencies Integrates theoretical instruction with research-relevant demonstrations in: Cell biology principles and phenotypic characterization Aseptic culture methodologies (primary cell isolation, cryopreservation/thawing, enumeration, subculturing) Contemporary cell technology applications drawn from published research Interactive training modules promoting autonomous experimental execution Objectives: Master mammalian cell culture systems and proliferation assays Develop independent technical competency with emphasis on protocol standardization Cultivate critical evaluation of emerging technologies through literature review Strengthen scientific communication via structured reporting Developed through scaffolded, hands-on experimentation within an active learning framework, this course advances evidence-based practice while stimulating innovative thinking.

default.zh: 遗传学（A）实验是贴合遗传学（A）设置的实验课程，旨在通过讲授遗传学经典的实验设计与理念，讲解实际的遗传实验操作，加深学生对理论课程内容的理解，拓展学生的探索研究性思维。 实验包括6个实验项目，包括经典遗传学、数量遗传学、群体遗传学、表观遗传学等遗传学不同分支方向。 经典遗传学实验主要是通过黑腹果蝇的饲养、突变体及生活史观察，果蝇杂交系列及观察果蝇唾液腺染色体三个实验项目，认识遗传学常用模式生物黑腹果蝇，了解果蝇唾液腺染色体的观察方法与应用，掌握果蝇杂交的基本要点。 人体指纹是位于手指端部的皮肤纹理，具有鲜明的个体特异性和高度的稳定性。有些异常皮纹与遗传病明显相关，皮纹分析可用于遗传病、特别是染色体病的初筛和辅助诊断。指纹是由多基因控制的性状，研究人体指纹可一窥数量遗传学的门径。 人类有多个血型系统，ABO是日常生活中比较常见的一种。O、A、B与AB四种血型，除了A、B型对应两种基因型，O与AB型均从表型就能判断其基因型，便于衡量群体遗传的平衡性。 分子遗传学是现代遗传研究的核心技术领域，聚焦基因操作与功能解析的关键方法，设置的相关实验项目涵盖基因扩增与重组、载体构建及转化筛选等核心实验流程，帮助学生掌握分子克隆技术体系，培养基因工程实验设计与数据分析的综合能力。 表观遗传学是研究非DNA序列改变的基因表达与调控的可遗传修饰，探索从基因演绎为表型的过程和机制的遗传学分支，基因组印记是该分支研究的重点之一。本实验以小鼠的一段基因序列为实验对象，分别取母本、子代的DNA与子代的cDNA片段做材料，检测该序列中是否存在亲本选择性表达，即只表达一方亲本，另一方不表达的SNP位点，是否存在基因印记。
default.en: The Experiments of Genetics A is an experimental course designed to complement the Genetics (A) lecture series. It aims to deepen students' understanding of theoretical course content and cultivate exploratory research thinking by teaching classic genetic experimental designs and concepts, alongside practical genetic laboratory techniques. The course comprises 9 experimental modules spanning various branches of genetics, including classical genetics, quantitative genetics, population genetics, molecular genetics, and epigenetics. Classical genetics experiments primarily involve three projects: rearing the model organism Drosophila melanogaster (fruit fly) and observing its mutants and life cycle; conducting a series of fruit fly crosses; and observing Drosophila salivary gland chromosomes. These projects enable students to familiarize themselves with this common genetic model organism, understand the methods and applications of observing salivary gland chromosomes, and master the fundamental principles of Drosophila hybridization. Human fingerprints, the skin ridge patterns located on the fingertips, exhibit distinct individual specificity and high stability. Certain abnormal dermatoglyphics are clearly associated with genetic disorders; dermatoglyphic analysis can be used for preliminary screening and auxiliary diagnosis of genetic diseases, particularly chromosomal disorders. As a polygenic trait, the study of human fingerprints offers an entry point into quantitative genetics. Humans possess multiple blood group systems, with ABO being one commonly encountered in daily life. Among the four blood types (O, A, B, AB), while A and B types correspond to multiple possible genotypes, the O and AB types allow their genotypes to be directly inferred from their phenotypes. This characteristic facilitates the assessment of population genetic equilibrium. Molecular genetics, a core technical field in modern genetic research, focuses on key methods for gene manipulation and functional analysis. The related experimental projects cover core workflows including gene amplification and recombination, vector construction, as well as transformation and screening. These projects help students master molecular cloning techniques and develop comprehensive abilities in genetic engineering experimental design and data analysis. Epigenetics is the branch of genetics that studies heritable modifications of gene expression and regulation that do not involve changes in the DNA sequence itself, exploring the processes and mechanisms from genotype to phenotype. Genomic imprinting is a key focus of research in this branch. This experiment uses a specific gene sequence in mice as the subject, employing DNA from the maternal parent, DNA from offspring, and cDNA from offspring as materials. Its objective is to detect the presence of parent-of-origin specific expression (i.e., monoallelic expression from only one parent, with the other allele silent) at SNP sites within this sequence, thereby investigating the potential existence of genomic imprinting.

default.zh: 实验教学是培养具有实践能力和创新意识的人才非常重要的教学环节。细胞生物学实验目的是通过实践环节培养学生们运用实验方法研究解决细胞生物学领域相关问题的能力。学生在学习细胞生物学理论课的基础上，学会将理论知识应用的细胞生物学相关的实验研究中。课程设置的实验涵盖了动物细胞培养的基础操作，细胞结构成分的分离与鉴定方法和技术，线粒体、微管、细胞周期和细胞凋亡的检测分析以及激光共聚焦显微镜技术和流式细胞术等。实验内容的安排和设计，目的是使学生不仅掌握细胞生物学基本的实验技术，还要掌握先进的实验方法。不仅培养学生具有实践能力，也具有创新的意识。在实验课学习过程中，形成正确的科学研究的思维方式，具备探索科学问题的能力，最终学生具备综合分析和解决问题的能力。通过课程的学习，为未来从事生命科学领域相关研究工作奠定基础。
default.en: Experimental teaching is a crucial instructional segment for cultivating talents with practical capabilities and innovative awareness. The objective of cell biology experiments is to develop students' ability to investigate and solve problems in the field of cell biology using experimental methods through practical sessions. On the basis of learning the theoretical course of cell biology, students are guided to apply theoretical knowledge to experimental research related to cell biology.？ The experiments designed in the course cover fundamental operations of animal cell culture, methods and techniques for the isolation and identification of cellular structural components, detection and analysis of mitochondria, microtubules, cell cycle and cell apoptosis, as well as advanced technologies such as laser confocal microscopy and flow cytometry.？ The arrangement and design of experimental content aim to enable students to master not only basic experimental techniques in cell biology but also advanced experimental methods. This not only fosters students' practical skills but also nurtures their innovative awareness. During the learning process of the experimental course, students will develop a correct way of thinking in scientific research, acquire the ability to explore scientific issues, and ultimately gain the comprehensive ability to analyze and solve problems. Through this course, students will lay a solid foundation for their future engagement in research work related to the life sciences field.

default.zh: 疾病与病理学基础是生命科学领域重要的专业基础课程。课程从整体与局部两个维度，系统讲授人体组织器官的正常结构功能及疾病状态下的生理病理学改变。培养学生理解疾病发生发展的过程和机制。掌握疾病相关研究的方法和能力，综合分子生物学、细胞生物学、解剖学及病理学等多学科知识，构建生物学与医学交叉的综合性知识体系。为生命科学研究奠定系统思维基础。
default.en: Fundamentals of Disease and Pathology is an important professional basic course in the field of life sciences. The course systematically teaches the normal structure and function of human tissues and organs, as well as the physiological and pathological changes under disease conditions, from both holistic and local perspectives. It trains students to understand the process and mechanism of disease occurrence and development, and master the methods and abilities related to disease research. By integrating multidisciplinary knowledge such as molecular biology, cell biology, anatomy and pathology, the course helps students build a comprehensive knowledge system at the intersection of biology and medicine, laying a foundation of systematic thinking for life science research.

default.zh: 基因工程，又称基因操作，是在实验室内对生物基因进行改造的一门科学。基因工程是指在基因水平上分离基因，对得到的基因进行修饰，将之与合适的载体连接，转移到受体细胞中，使受体细胞获得遗传信息，并传递给后代的基因操作过程。本门课程采用与工程设计十分类似的方法，按照人类的需要进行设计，然后按设计方案创建出具有某种新的性状的生物新品系，并能使之稳定地遗传给后代。授课过程将按照基因操作的关键过程进行讲解，首先会讲解基因工程基本原理，并向学生介绍不同功能的工具酶，然后会系统讲解基因工程基本技术和应用。主要讲解的基本技术包括DNA、RNA和蛋白的电泳，分子杂交，基因克隆策略，分析DNA和蛋白相互作用的方法等。授课过程中还包括针对实验设计方面的训练和探讨。 本门课程主要采用章节测试和期末测试相结合的形式作为考核方式，占最终考核成绩的80%，会要求学生完成一篇课程论文，占最终成绩的20%。 撰写人：韩凤桐 审核人： 撰写时间：2024年2月17日
default.en: Genetic engineering, or gene manipulation, is the manipulating of genetic material in the laboratory. It includes isolating, copying and multiplying genes, recombining genes or DNA from different species, and transferring genes from one species to another, bypassing the reproductive process. This course is set according to the gene manipulation progress. At the beginning, different types of enzymes are introduced, followed by the commonly used techniques. Techniques are the most important part of this course. Electrophoresis of DNA, RNA and proteins, molecular hybridization, gene cloning strategies, DNA-protein interaction analytic methods are explained in details. Moreover, experimental design training is also included. In this course, there is final exam accompanied with quizzes for every chapter, this part counts for 80% of the final score. And students are also asked to finish 1 paper, and have the opportunities to do oral deliveries, and the paper counts for the other 20% of final score. Author: Han Fengtong Reviewer： Date：2024/02/17

default.zh: 蛋白质工程与酶工程是一门理论和实践紧密结合的应用性交叉学科，与生物学、细胞生物学、生物化学、微生物学、化学和工程学等学科关系密切，伴随基因工程、细胞工程、发酵工程等现代生物技术的迅猛发展，酶工程技术逐渐成为众多生物学科间交叉的桥梁，充分体现了学科间的融会贯通。本门课程旨在传授酶学基本理论、基础知识和实践中的技术方法，同时借助于蛋白质工程的技术手段，在分子设计、结构解析、组学研究等领域又对传统酶工程的基础研究提供了系统性、高通量的技术平台。采用通俗的语言、灵活的方式，培养高科学素养，较强的创新意识和实践能力的专业人才。
default.en: Protein Engineering&Enzyme engineering technology is an integrated theory and practice of applied interdisciplinary, and closely linked with biology, cell biology, biochemistry, microbiology, chemistry. Along with the rapid development of genetic engineering, cell engineering, fermentation engineering, enzyme engineering technology gradually become an important bridge between biological courses. This course aims to teach basic enzyme theory, technology and methods, meanwhile introduces a system and high-throughout platform including the molecular design, protein structure analysis and genome annotation to support the traditional enzyme engineering by using a common language, a flexible manner, to train high scientific literacy, strong innovation consciousness and practice ability of professional talents.

default.zh: 生物工程单元操作原理是生物工程专业的一门专业基础课. 课程着眼于生化生产过程所涉及典型单元操作及相关设备。其教学目的是：使学生掌握生物化工生产过程中的基本单元操作原理、方法、典型设备的结构及设计计算；了解生物反应器及附属设备的结构原理、操作和设计计算；通过本课程教学，培养学生分析和解决生化制品生产过程中问题的能力，以及资料查阅、计算和进行生化反应工程研究开发能力。
default.en: This course is a special preliminary course of bioengineering major. Its purpose is to impart the philosophy, equipment, and calculation of unit operation, the structure and augmentation of bioreactors, etc. Its main contents are fluid transmission, matter transfer, heat transfer, bioreactor，and augmentation technologies. This course could also lay a solid foundation for the teaching of subsequent special courses.

default.zh: 细胞工程是现代生物工程与生物技术的重要组成部分，是应用细胞生物学和分子生物学原理与方法，在细胞水平上研究改造生物遗传特性，以获得具有目标性状的细胞系或生物体的有关理论和技术的学科。细胞工程技术领域内容新颖和丰富多彩，包含了细胞培养、细胞融合、单克隆抗体、干细胞、转基因动物、胚胎工程、细胞核移植和动物克隆等技术。特别是近十几年来，细胞工程与基因工程相结合培养出许多转基因动植物新材料和新品种；与蛋白质工程和发酵工程相结合生产出大量的用于医疗、食品和化妆品等行业的珍贵产品，使细胞工程在生物工程领域中的地位显得更为突出。通过本课程的学习，诣在使学生全面了解细胞工程与现代生物技术的关系，掌握细胞工程领域关键技术的基本原理、基本操作方法，对细胞工程领域的发展动态有全面的了解，培养学生对多项技术的综合运用能力。
default.en: Cell engineering is an important part of modern bioengineering and biotechnology. It is to modify genetic characteristics at the cellular level with the principle and method of cell biology and molecular biology, in order to obtain the target characters of cells or organisms. The field of cell engineering technology is novel and rich, including cell culture, cell fusion, monoclonal antibodies, stem cells, transgenic animals, embryonic engineering, nuclear transplantation and animal cloning and other technologies. Especially in recent years, many novel transgenic animals and plants are produced with combination of cell engineering and gene engineering technology. Many of costly products for medical treatment, foodstuff and cosmetics are produced by the combination of cell engineering and fermentation engineering. Therefore, the cell engineering becomes much more important in the fields of the bioengineering. The purpose of this course is not only to make the students fully understand the relationship between cell engineering and modern biological technology, but also to enable the students to master the key technology, basic principle and the operation method in cell engineering, and to understand the development of cell engineering and to have the ability of comprehensive use of various technologies.

default.zh: 这门神经生物学课程是为本科生开设的。本课程首先介绍大脑的不同细胞类型，即神经元和胶质细胞（星形胶质细胞、小胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞），强调它们的结构和特定功能。在讨论了建立静息膜电位的机制后，将更深入地讨论神经元的特定和独特特征，如相互转换电信号和化学信号以进行通信的能力，以及潜在的细胞机制和蛋白质。突触传递涵盖突触的结构、Otto Loewi对化学神经传递的开创性检测、对不同类型神经递质的解释，以及突触前神经元中神经递质从合成到释放的顺序步骤。讨论乙酰胆碱等重要神经递质的例子及其在肌肉收缩所需的神经肌肉突触上的作用。之后介绍神经系统的总体结构，包括其分为中枢神经系统和外周神经系统，以及中枢神经系统的主要部分及其一些特定功能和解剖联系。后期课程包括化学感觉、昼夜节律和睡眠和大脑情绪机制，以及介绍和讨论常见的“精神疾病”，如抑郁和焦虑，它们的神经化学异常和当前的治疗方法。最后，掌握学习“记忆系统”和“学习和记忆的分子机制”，其中涵盖了当记忆在大脑中形成和回忆时，神经元发生的一些关键分子和结构变化。将介绍“阿尔茨海默病”和大脑特定部位大脑受损的患者，以说明大脑记忆系统的缺陷是如何导致痴呆（记忆丧失）的。
default.en: This neurobiology course is for Bachelor students. The course starts with an introduction to the different cell types of the brain, i.e. neurons and glia (astrocytes, microglia and oligodendrocytes), emphasizing their structure and specific functions. After discussing mechanisms that establish the resting membrane potential, specific and unique features of neurons such as the ability to inter-convert electrical signals and chemical signals for communication, and the underlying cellular mechanisms and proteins, will be discussed in more depth. This is followed by a chapter on synaptic transmission, which covers the structure of a synapse, the seminal detection of chemical neurotransmission by Otto Loewi, an explanation of different types of neurotransmitters, and the sequential steps from synthesis to release of a neurotransmitter in the presynaptic neuron. Examples of important neurotransmitters such as acetylcholine and its action at the neuromuscular synapse required for muscle contraction will be discussed. The next chapter will introduce the overall structure of the nervous system, including its division into central and peripheral nervous system, as well as the major parts of the central nervous system (cerebrum, cerebellum, brain stem, spinal cord) with some of their specific functions and their anatomical connections. This part will emphasize the importance of neo-cortex development and differentiation as a key feature of intelligent animals and higher cognitive abilities, such as reasoning and planning. Introduction of Chemical Senses, Circadian Rhythms and Sleep and Brain Mechanisms of Emotion. The latter will lead over to an introduction and discussion of frequent Mental Illnesses such as depression and anxiety, their neurochemical abnormalities and current treatments. Towards the end of the course students will learn about “Memory Systems” and “Molecular Mechanisms of Learning and Memory”, which cover some of the key molecular and structural changes that occur in neurons when memory is formed and recalled in the brain. “Alzheimer’s disease” and patients with brain damage to specific parts of their brain will be introduced to illustrate how defects in brain memory systems cause dementia (memory loss).

default.zh: 免疫学作为现代生命科学迅猛发展的重要支撑之一，该学科的基础理论和实践技术已经广泛地渗透于生物学及其交叉学科研究的众多领域当中。免疫学主要研究的是机体免疫系统的静态结构以及生物学功能，探讨健康或疾病状态下机体免疫系统的生物学作用，同时涉及一些由于免疫系统异常改变所引发的自身免疫疾病等。从研究机体抗感染的生理学范畴发展到研究细胞的分化发育，从细胞之间的信号传递和相互作用发展到抗体、T淋巴细胞受体、细胞因子等各种免疫分子的生物学功能，从免疫细胞来源的活性物质结构和功能发展到机体神经内分泌系统的综合调控等。免疫学无论对于生物学专业或者医学专业的学生，都是有必要夯实的基础理论；同时，在当下各学科间融合度日趋加大的背景下，免疫学与肿瘤学、结构生物学等学科的交叉研究也日渐深入。免疫学的授课对象，已储备普通生物学，生物化学，动物生理学，遗传学，分子生物学，细胞生物学等课程理论与技术知识，免疫学学习能够让学生学会如何以一个系统和有序的体系，去理解生物大分子等在生命组成、结构和功能的作用，尤其对于一个生物体与环境相互作用的效应机制。
default.en: Immunology ties in with the fields of epidemiology and medicine. It studies the relationship between the body systems, pathogens, and immunity. Immunology is a branch of biology that covers the study of immune systems in all organisms. The study of the molecular and cellular components that comprise the immune system, including their function and interaction, is the central science of immunology. Clinical immunology is the study of diseases caused by disorders of the immune system (failure, aberrant action, and malignant growth of the cellular elements of the system). It also involves diseases of other systems, where immune reactions play a part in the pathology and clinical features. At the same time, the cross-study of immunology and oncology, structural biology and other disciplines is also becoming more and more in-depth. Based on the study of the general biology, biochemistry, animal physiology, genetics, molecular biology, cell biology curriculum theory, immunology can help students learn how to understand the biological macromolecules such as composition, structure and function in the life, especially for an organism and the environment interaction effect mechanism.

default.zh: 发育生物学是一门研究多细胞动物生长发育的基本过程和机理的科学，是生物科学重要的基础分支学科之一。它应用分子生物学、细胞生物学的等现代科学技术和方法研究生物体的发育机制，包括精子和卵子发生、受精、发育、生长到衰老、死亡规律的整个发育过程。本课程侧重以人及模式动物为研究模型，重点讲述多细胞动物的胚胎发育、胚后生长过程及相关的基本机制。其研究内容和许多其他学科内容相互渗透、错综联系，特别是和遗传学、细胞生物学、分子生物学的关系最为紧密，从分子水平、亚显微水平和细胞水平来研究分析生物体的过程及其机理。 通过发育生物学课程的学习，主要了解动物发育的基本规律和机理、当前发育生物学领域的新进展和新发现，为今后从事生命科学研究和教学工作打下基础。同时要求学生掌握本教学大纲所规定的基本内容, 理解多细胞动物发育的主要过程、规律与分子机制；从发育的角度来认识动物有机体, 并与其它课程相结合, 以达到对多细胞动物发育的全面认识。
default.en: Developmental biology is a science that studies the basic processes and mechanisms involved in the growth and development of multicellular animals，which is one of the most important basic branches of Biological Science. The developmental biology studies the development mechanism of organisms using the molecular biology, cell biology and other modern technology and method, including the development of sperm and oogenesis, fertilization, embryonic development, growth, aging, and the death. This course focuses on human and animal model as the research model to further study the basic multicellular animal embryonic development, postembryonic growth process and related mechanism. The research contents of this course is interconnected with many other subjects, especially the genetics, cell biology, molecular biology and so on, and study the process and mechanism of the organism at the molecular level, submicroscopic level and cell level. Through the study of developmental biology, we mainly understand the basic laws and mechanisms of animal development, and the new progress and new discoveries related to the developmental biology, which will lay a foundation for the future research and teaching of life science. At the same time, students are required to master the basic content of the teaching syllabus, understand the main process, regulation and molecular mechanism of multicellular animal development; In further, students are required to understand the animal organism from the development perspective, and achieve the comprehensive understanding development of multicellular animal combining with other courses.

default.zh: 纳米化学是化学和纳米科学的结合。纳米化学与结构单元的合成有关，后者取决于尺寸、表面、形状和缺陷性质。纳米结构的合成和构建都与纳米化学和其他纳米科学领域具有相同的核心概念，材料在纳米级尺寸上发生化学反应时。主要是在纳米级结构上的化学修饰主要取决于材料组成，表面，尺寸和形状。进一步纳米材料具有的功能缺陷对材料的电子、光子、医学或生物分析问题起重要作用，而这些功能可以通过化学方法来调控，本课程主要介绍相关的碳纳米材料化学包括碳量子点的尺寸与物理性能、化学性能和生物应用的调控，及其常用的一些碳量子点的制备方和修饰，改性方法。碳纳米管的种类及其相关的制备方法和功能调控等技术及其在生物医学中的应用。石墨烯，富勒烯的制备方法和功能调控，以及在生物医学中的相关应用；不同形貌纳米金（包括金纳米球，金纳米棒及其各种不规则形貌）的制备方法，不同形貌纳米金的光学性质和光热转化效应及其形貌对其光学性能和光热性能的调控机制，纳米金的修饰方法和生物医学中的相关应用；介绍量子点的概念，种类及其制备方法，发光特性以及在生物医学中的应用。
default.en: Nanochemistry is the combination of chemistry and nanoscience. Nanochemistry is related to the synthesis of structural units, which depend on size, surface, shape, and defect properties. The synthesis and construction of nanostructures share the same core concepts as nanochemistry and other nanoscience fields, where materials undergo chemical reactions at the nanoscale. The chemical modification on nanoscale structures mainly depends on material composition, surface, size, and shape. The functional defects of further nanomaterials play an important role in the electronic, photonic, medical, or biological analysis of materials, and these functions can be regulated through chemical methods. This course mainly introduces the related carbon nanomaterial chemistry, including the size and physical properties, chemical properties, and biological application regulation of carbon quantum dots, as well as some commonly used preparation and modification methods of carbon quantum dots. The types of carbon nanotubes and their related preparation methods and functional regulation technologies, as well as their applications in biomedicine. Preparation methods and functional regulation of graphene and fullerene, as well as related applications in biomedicine; The preparation methods of different morphologies of gold nanoparticles (including gold nanospheres, gold nanorods, and various irregular morphologies), the optical properties and photothermal conversion effects of different morphologies of gold nanoparticles, as well as the regulatory mechanisms of their morphology on their optical and photothermal properties, the modification methods of gold nanoparticles, and related applications in biomedicine; Introduce the concept, types, preparation methods, luminescent properties, and applications in biomedicine of quantum dots.

default.zh: 生物物理是生物学与物理学相结合的一门交叉学科，是生命科学的重要分支学科和领域之一。生物物理应用物理学的概念和方法，阐明生物体内有关物质、能量与信息的时间和空间的变化规律。本门课程拟为生命科学与技术学院整合生物学专业本科生开设，旨在培养学生从物理学原理出发理解生物问题乃至生命现象的思维习惯，引领学生适应生物学科越来越定量化、越来越与其他学科交叉互融的发展趋势。由于是本科课程，课程重点在介绍不同生物问题中生物物理学的概念和基础，阐述研究方法，适当辅以相关领域研究前沿。课程内容主要涵盖以下领域：分子的生物物理、膜与细胞的生物物理、感官与神经的生物物理、光生物物理、生物电磁和生物分子电子以及生物传感技术等。课程目标是通过生物物理课程的学习，使学生掌握如何运用现代物理学的理论和技术研究生物大分子和细胞的结构与功能的基本方法，如何运用多学科的方法思路考虑生物学的现象和问题，提高学生从更高和更深的水平上提出问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Biophysics, bridging biology and physics, offers an engaging and interdisciplinary exploration for undergraduate students majoring in biology. This course, a key part of the Integrative Biology curriculum in the School of Life Science and Technology, introduces the principles of physics to uncover the complex dynamics of matter, energy, and information in living organisms. Its primary aim is to cultivate a physics-based perspective in addressing biological questions and phenomena. As biology transforms into a field that increasingly values quantitative analysis and intersects with diverse scientific discipline, this course prepares students to excel in such integrated environment. Central to the course are fundamental biophysical concepts that are vital across various biological contexts. It encompasses an array of exciting topics, including molecular biophysics, membrane and cell biophysics, sensory and neural biophysics, photo-biophysics, bio-electromagnetism, biomolecular electronics, and biosensing techniques. This course not only equips students with essential techniques to study the structure and function of biological macromolecules and cells using modern physics but also encourages an interdisciplinary approach to biological challenges. It’s designed to enhance students’ ability to comprehend, analyze, and solve complex biological issues through a nuanced and profound lens, making it an ideal choice for those looking into deepen their understanding of life sciences through the fascinating perspective of physics.

default.zh: 生物大数据的指数增长引领生物学问题的研究向数据驱动的方向演变，为实现大量数据信息的有效使用和探索生物学问题的迫切需求，计算方法的应用和开发、资源的充分共享是关键。作为一门新兴学科，计算生物学使得传统生命研究走向定量化、精确化，而且可以在系统层面上进行观察研究，已经渗透到生物学和医学研究领域的各个层面。 本课程旨在为学生提供全面的计算生物学知识和技能，涵盖了该领域的多个重要主题和研究方向，包括高通量数据分析、单细胞测序数据的分析、计算蛋白质组学、计算表观遗传学、计算癌症生物学、计算免疫学、药物设计的计算方法和应用、影像组学与人工智能等。学生将学习如何处理和分析大规模的生物学数据，包括基因组学、转录组学和蛋白质组学等不同层次的数据。如何利用生物信息学工具和技术探究基因调控和疾病发生中的作用，以及如何利用计算方法对药物的活性、选择性和毒性进行预测和优化，以及如何设计新的药物分子来治疗各种疾病。 上机实验课旨在介绍计算生物学领域中基因表达数据分析、癌症生存分析和蛋白质网络分析的基本方法和应用。通过理论讲授、实验操作演示、案例分析等多种教学方法的结合运用，学生将学习如何利用GEO和TCGA等公共数据库获取基因表达和临床数据，掌握基于GEO2R软件进行基因差异表达分析的方法，运用生存分析技术评估基因与临床表型数据之间的关联性，以及利用STRING数据库进行蛋白质网络分析的技能，并学习R语言以实现数据的分析及可视化。通过实验操作和实践项目，学生将有机会将所学方法应用于真实的生物学研究中，培养其数据分析和科学研究能力。
default.en: The exponential growth of big biological data has led biological research to evolve towards a data-driven direction, meeting the urgent demand for the effective utilization of vast data information and exploration of biological issues. The application and development of computational methods, along with comprehensive resource sharing, are critical for achieving this goal. As an emerging discipline, computational biology quantifies and refines traditional life sciences research, enabling observation and study at the systemic level. It has permeated various aspects of biological and medical research fields. This course aims to provide students with comprehensive knowledge and skills in computational biology, covering multiple important topics and research directions in this field. These include high-throughput data analysis, single-cell sequencing data analysis, computational proteomics, computational epigenetics, computational oncology, computational immunology, computational methods and applications in drug design, imaging omics, and artificial intelligence. Students will learn how to process and analyze large-scale biological data, including genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data at different levels. They will explore the role of computational biology tools and techniques in understanding gene regulation and disease occurrence. Additionally, they will learn how to predict and optimize drug activity, selectivity, and toxicity using computational methods, and design new drug molecules to treat various diseases. The computer laboratory sessions aim to introduce the fundamental methods and applications of gene expression data analysis, cancer survival analysis, and protein network analysis in the field of computational biology. Through a combination of theoretical lectures, practical demonstrations, and case studies, students will learn how to acquire gene expression and clinical data from public databases such as GEO and TCGA. They will master the methods of gene differential expression analysis using GEO2R software, apply survival analysis techniques to evaluate the association between genes and clinical phenotypes, and acquire skills in protein network analysis using the STRING database. Additionally, they will learn the R language for data analysis and visualization. Through hands-on experiments and practical projects, students will have the opportunity to apply the methods learned to real biological research, cultivating their data analysis and scientific research capabilities.

default.zh: 《物理化学》是从物质的物理现象和化学现象的联系入手，探求化学变化规律的一门科学，是化学学科的理论基础，所以历史上也曾被称作“理论化学”。物理化学的理论与实验方法已渗透到生物、药学、医学检验、农学、食品、环境、能源、材料等各个领域，为这些学科的进一步发展提供了重要的理论基础与实验基础。 本课程内容包括热力学基础、化学热力学、电化学等部分。这些内容与生命科学关系密切，是生命科学专业的专业核心课程。该课程科学、系统、严谨地阐明化学的基本理论，从理论上解释无机化学、有机化学和分析化学的某些结论，并为深入学习专业课程打下坚实的基础。 课程总目标是系统地获取物理化学的基础知识、基本理论和基本技能，培养学生运用物理化学的知识解决物理化学问题的能力，培养学生进一步获取知识的能力和创新思维的习惯，为分析和解决生命科学和科研中的问题打下扎实的理论基础。
default.en: Physical Chemistry is a science that starts with the connection between physical and chemical phenomena of matter, exploring the laws of chemical change. It is the theoretical foundation of the discipline of chemistry, so it was also known as "theoretical chemistry" in history. The theory and experimental methods of physical chemistry have penetrated into various fields such as biology, pharmacy, medical testing, agriculture, food, environment, energy, materials, etc., providing important theoretical and experimental foundations for the further development of these disciplines. This course includes five major parts: fundamentals of thermodynamics, chemical thermodynamics and electrochemistry. These contents are closely related to life sciences and are the core courses of life science majors. This course scientifically, systematically, and rigorously explains the basic theories of chemistry, theoretically explaining certain conclusions of inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, and analytical chemistry, and laying a solid foundation for in-depth study of professional courses. The overall goal of the course is to systematically acquire the basic knowledge, theories, and skills of physical chemistry, cultivate students' ability to apply physical chemistry knowledge to solve physical chemistry problems, cultivate their ability to further acquire knowledge and the habit of innovative thinking, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for analyzing and solving problems in life sciences and scientific research.

default.zh: 本课程是电气工程学科和生物医学工程学科的专业课。本课程讲述生物电磁学的基本概念、生物电磁效应的机理及其在电磁防护和临床诊疗技术当中的应用。主要涉及电磁场基本概念，电磁场测量方法，细胞电生理、神经元电学模型、生物组织的电磁特性、电磁场调控神经的作用机理、电磁成像方法、生物电磁效应机理等。希望通过讲授电磁场在生物医学中的应用，使学生对生物电磁学有较为全面的了解，同时给学生在课题设计、交叉学科相关技术运用等方面带来启发。
default.en: This course is a specialized course in Electrical Engineering and Biomedical Engineering. This course introduces the basic concepts of bioelectromagnetism, the mechanisms of bioelectromagnetic effects, and their applications in electromagnetic protection and clinical diagnosis and treatment technologies. Mainly related to the basic concepts of electromagnetic fields, electromagnetic field measurement methods, cell electrophysiology, neuron electrical models, electromagnetic characteristics of biological tissues, the mechanism of electromagnetic field regulation of nerves, electromagnetic imaging methods, biological electromagnetic effect mechanisms, etc. I hope to teach students the application of electromagnetic fields in biomedicine, so that they can have a comprehensive understanding of bioelectromagnetism, and at the same time provide inspiration for students in project design, interdisciplinary technology application, and other aspects.

default.zh: 近年来，随着成像技术的发展，医学影像数据经历了飞速增长，已经成为临床疾病诊断的重要参考工具。由于影像大数据具有冗余性、多样性等特点，如何利用影像大数据帮助医生进行疾病诊断已经成为国际研究的热点之一。基于大数据技术、机器学习和人工智能的新方法已经成为影像大数据分析的有效工具，对于提高疾病诊断准确率具有重要意义。本课程的开设旨在让学生了解医学影像大数据发展的现状和趋势以及面临的问题，掌握医学影像大数据预处理方法、基本PyTorch的深度学习实现框架、常见卷积神经网络结构，了解深度学习在放射影像分析、病理影像学分析和光学影像学分析方面的应用，通过授课和示教方式让学生具备将理论知识与实践相结合的能力，通过介绍前沿技术发展趋势拓宽学生视野，为学生今后的科学研究或工作奠定基础。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1 掌握影像大数据分析的基础知识。 课程目标 2 掌握基于PyTorch的深度学习实现框架。 课程目标 3 培养学生利用深度学习进行影像数据分析的能力。
default.en: In recent years, with the development of imaging technology, medical image data has experienced rapid growth and has become an important reference tool for disease diagnosis. As medical image big data has redundancy and diversity, how to use it to help doctors diagnose diseases has become one of the hotspots of international research. New methods based on big data technology, machine learning (ML), and artificial intelligence (AI) have become effective tools for analyzing medical image big data and are of great significance for improving the accuracy of disease diagnosis. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the current situation and trends of the development of medical image big data and the problems it faces, master the preprocessing methods of medical image big data, the basic PyTorch deep learning implementation framework, common convolutional neural network structures, and understand the application of deep learning in radiographic image analysis, pathological image analysis, and optical image analysis. Through teaching and demonstration, students will have the ability to combine theoretical knowledge with practice, broaden their horizons by introducing cutting-edge technology development trends, and lay a foundation for their future scientific research or work. The aims of this course require the following capabilities of the students. Objective 1 Mastering the basic knowledge of big data analytics in medical imaging. Objective 2 Mastering the implementation of the common framework of deep learning using PyTorch Objective 3 Developing students’ ability to analyze image data using deep learning.

default.zh: 科学创新实验课程，旨在培养学生的科学思维、创新意识和实践动手能力，是连接科学理论知识与实际应用的桥梁。通过丰富多样的实验项目，突出实践性、创新性，引导学生掌握科学实验的基本方法和技能，激发学生对科学研究的兴趣和探索精神，强调学生在项目完成过程中实验动手能力的培养和科研思维的训练，使学生具备独立设计、实施和分析实验的能力，为未来从事科学研究、技术开发和相关领域工作奠定坚实基础。
default.en: The scientific innovation experiment course aims to cultivate students' scientific thinking, innovation awareness, and practical hands-on ability, and serves as a bridge connecting scientific theoretical knowledge with practical applications. By enriching and diversifying experimental projects, highlighting practicality and innovation, guiding students to master the basic methods and skills of scientific experiments, stimulating students' interest and exploratory spirit in scientific research, emphasizing the cultivation of students' hands-on experimental ability and scientific thinking training in the process of project completion, enabling students to independently design, implement, and analyze experiments, laying a solid foundation for future scientific research, technology development, and related fields.

default.zh: 这门神经基础与脑科学课程是为本科生开设的。本课程首先介绍大脑的不同细胞类型，即神经元和胶质细胞（星形胶质细胞、小胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞），强调它们的结构和特定功能。在讨论了建立静息膜电位的机制后，将更深入地讨论神经元的特定和独特特征，如相互转换电信号和化学信号以进行通信的能力，以及潜在的细胞机制和蛋白质。突触传递涵盖突触的结构、Otto Loewi对化学神经传递的开创性检测、对不同类型神经递质的解释，以及突触前神经元中神经递质从合成到释放的顺序步骤。讨论乙酰胆碱等重要神经递质的例子及其在肌肉收缩所需的神经肌肉突触上的作用。之后介绍神经系统的总体结构，包括其分为中枢神经系统和外周神经系统，以及中枢神经系统的主要部分及其一些特定功能和解剖联系。后期课程包括化学感觉、昼夜节律和睡眠和大脑情绪机制，以及介绍和讨论常见的“精神疾病”，如抑郁和焦虑，它们的神经化学异常和当前的治疗方法。最后，掌握学习“记忆系统”和“学习和记忆的分子机制”，其中涵盖了当记忆在大脑中形成和回忆时，神经元发生的一些关键分子和结构变化。将介绍“阿尔茨海默病”和大脑特定部位大脑受损的患者，以说明大脑记忆系统的缺陷是如何导致痴呆（记忆丧失）的。
default.en: This neuroscience and brain science course is for Bachelor students. The course starts with an introduction to the different cell types of the brain, i.e. neurons and glia (astrocytes, microglia and oligodendrocytes), emphasizing their structure and specific functions. After discussing mechanisms that establish the resting membrane potential, specific and unique features of neurons such as the ability to inter-convert electrical signals and chemical signals for communication, and the underlying cellular mechanisms and proteins, will be discussed in more depth. This is followed by a chapter on synaptic transmission, which covers the structure of a synapse, the seminal detection of chemical neurotransmission by Otto Loewi, an explanation of different types of neurotransmitters, and the sequential steps from synthesis to release of a neurotransmitter in the presynaptic neuron. Examples of important neurotransmitters such as acetylcholine and its action at the neuromuscular synapse required for muscle contraction will be discussed. The next chapter will introduce the overall structure of the nervous system, including its division into central and peripheral nervous system, as well as the major parts of the central nervous system (cerebrum, cerebellum, brain stem, spinal cord) with some of their specific functions and their anatomical connections. This part will emphasize the importance of neo-cortex development and differentiation as a key feature of intelligent animals and higher cognitive abilities, such as reasoning and planning. Introduction of Chemical Senses, Circadian Rhythms and Sleep and Brain Mechanisms of Emotion. The latter will lead over to an introduction and discussion of frequent Mental Illnesses such as depression and anxiety, their neurochemical abnormalities and current treatments. Towards the end of the course students will learn about “Memory Systems” and “Molecular Mechanisms of Learning and Memory”, which cover some of the key molecular and structural changes that occur in neurons when memory is formed and recalled in the brain. “Alzheimer’s disease” and patients with brain damage to specific parts of their brain will be introduced to illustrate how defects in brain memory systems cause dementia (memory loss).

default.zh: 本课程立足现代免疫学核心理论与临床免疫治疗前沿技术，系统讲解免疫识别、免疫应答、免疫调节等基础机制，衔接抗体药物、细胞治疗、疫苗研发等应用技术，兼顾基础科学性与临床实用性，适合医学、生物医学、药学等专业学习与科研入门。 课程以免疫系统结构与功能为起点，依次介绍免疫器官、免疫细胞与免疫分子的基本特性。重点阐明固有免疫与适应性免疫的应答规律，包括抗原识别、淋巴细胞活化、抗体产生、细胞免疫效应及免疫记忆形成机制，帮助学习者建立完整的免疫应答逻辑框架。同时深入讲解 MHC 分子、抗原提呈、细胞因子、补体系统等关键分子的作用通路，为理解免疫相关疾病与治疗技术奠定理论基础。 在此基础上，课程聚焦免疫治疗技术核心内容，系统介绍当前主流临床应用与科研方向：包括单克隆抗体药物、抗体偶联药物、免疫检查点抑制剂、过继性细胞免疫治疗（CAR-T、TCR-T）、肿瘤疫苗、基因编辑免疫治疗、抗感染免疫与自身免疫病治疗策略。课程结合临床案例，解析免疫治疗的作用机制、适用场景、优势与局限性，突出基础理论向临床转化的路径。 课程注重机制与应用结合，既强调免疫耐受、免疫调节、炎症与免疫病理等基础概念，也覆盖肿瘤免疫、感染免疫、自身免疫病、移植免疫等应用领域。通过梳理免疫治疗的发展历程，帮助学习者理解 PD-1/PD-L1、CTLA-4、CD19-CAR 等里程碑技术的科学原理与研发逻辑，建立 “基础机制 — 药物研发 — 临床疗效” 的连贯认知。 本课程旨在使学习者掌握免疫学核心知识框架，理解免疫治疗的关键技术原理，了解行业前沿进展与研究思路，提升理论应用与科研思维能力，为从事基础研究、药物研发、临床诊疗及生物医药产业工作提供扎实支撑。
default.en: This course is grounded in the core theories of modern immunology and cutting-edge clinical immunotherapy technologies. It systematically explains fundamental mechanisms such as immune recognition, immune response, and immune regulation, while integrating applied technologies including antibody drugs, cell therapy, and vaccine development. Balancing basic scientific principles with clinical practicality, the course is suitable as an introduction to study and research for students in medicine, biomedicine, pharmacy, and related fields. Beginning with the structure and function of the immune system, the course sequentially introduces the basic characteristics of immune organs, immune cells, and immune molecules. It focuses on elucidating the response patterns of innate and adaptive immunity, including antigen recognition, lymphocyte activation, antibody production, cellular immune effects, and the mechanisms underlying immune memory formation, helping learners establish a comprehensive logical framework for immune responses. At the same time, it provides an in-depth explanation of the signaling pathways of key molecules such as MHC molecules, antigen presentation, cytokines, and the complement system, laying a theoretical foundation for understanding immune-related diseases and therapeutic technologies. Building on this foundation, the course focuses on the core content of immunotherapy, systematically introducing current mainstream clinical applications and research directions: including monoclonal antibody drugs, antibody-drug conjugates, immune checkpoint inhibitors, adoptive cell immunotherapy (CAR-T, TCR-T), tumor vaccines, gene-edited immunotherapy, and treatment strategies for anti-infectious immunity and autoimmune diseases. Using clinical case studies, the course analyzes the mechanisms of action, applicable scenarios, advantages, and limitations of immunotherapy, highlighting the pathway from basic theory to clinical translation. The course emphasizes the integration of mechanisms and applications, covering both fundamental concepts such as immune tolerance, immune regulation, inflammation, and immunopathology, as well as applied fields including tumor immunology, infection immunology, autoimmune diseases, and transplant immunology. By tracing the development of immunotherapy, the course helps learners understand the scientific principles and R&D logic behind landmark technologies such as PD-1/PD-L1, CTLA-4, and CD19-CAR, establishing a coherent understanding of the “fundamental mechanisms—drug development—clinical efficacy” continuum. This course aims to equip learners with a core framework of immunological knowledge, an understanding of the key technical principles of immunotherapy, and insight into cutting-edge industry advancements and research approaches. It seeks to enhance their ability to apply theoretical knowledge and develop scientific research thinking, thereby providing a solid foundation for those engaged in basic research, drug development, clinical diagnosis and treatment, and the biopharmaceutical industry.

default.zh: 蛋白质设计与制造是一门理论和实践紧密结合的应用性交叉学科，与生物学、细胞生物学、生物化学、微生物学、生物信息学和工程学等学科关系密切，伴随基因工程、细胞工程、发酵工程等现代生物技术的迅猛发展，蛋白质工程技术逐渐成为众多生物学科间交叉的桥梁，充分体现了学科间的融会贯通。本门课程旨在传授蛋白质设计与制造的相关基本理论、基础知识和实践中的最新技术方法，在分子设计、结构解析、组学研究等领域又对传统蛋白质及酶工程的基础研究提供了系统性、高通量的技术平台。采用通俗的语言、灵活的方式，培养高科学素养，较强的创新意识和实践能力的专业人才。
default.en: Protein Design and Manufacturing is an integrated theory and practice of applied interdisciplinary, and closely linked with biology, cell biology, biochemistry, microbiology, chemistry. Along with the rapid development of genetic engineering, cell engineering, fermentation engineering, enzyme and protein engineering technology gradually become an important bridge between biological courses. This course aims to teach basic enzyme theory, technology and methods, meanwhile introduces a system and high-throughout platform including the molecular design, protein structure analysis and genome annotation to support the traditional enzyme engineering by using a common language, a flexible manner, to train high scientific literacy, strong innovation consciousness and practice ability of professional talents.

default.zh: 细胞改造工程是现代生物工程与生物技术的重要组成部分，是应用细胞生物学和分子生物学原理与方法，在细胞水平上研究改造生物遗传特性，以获得具有目标性状的细胞系或生物体的有关理论和技术的学科。细胞改造技术对细胞的结构、功能或行为进行定向改造，以增强其特定性能或赋予其新功能。利用如细胞培养、细胞融合、细胞拆合与克隆技术、干细胞、胚胎移植与试管动物、基因打靶与转基因动物等多种技术，培育出动植物新品种，生产出大量的用于医疗、食品和化妆品等行业的产品。通过本课程的学习，诣在使学生全面了掌握细胞工程领域关键技术的基本原理、基本操作方法，对细胞工程领域的发展动态有全面的了解，培养学生对多项技术的综合运用能力。
default.en: Cellular engineering is a crucial component of modern biotechnology and biological engineering, encompassing the theoretical and practical disciplines that apply the principles and methods of cell biology and molecular biology to study and modify biological genetic traits at the cellular level, aiming to develop cell lines or organisms with desired characteristics. This technology involves targeted modifications to the structure, function, or behavior of cells to enhance specific performance or introduce new functionalities. Utilizing techniques such as cell culture, cell fusion, cell disassembly and cloning, stem cells, embryo transfer and test-tube animals, gene targeting, and transgenic animals, it facilitates the development of new plant and animal varieties and the production of large quantities of products for industries like healthcare, food, and cosmetics. Through this course, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental principles and basic operational methods of key technologies in the field of cell engineering, as well as an in-depth awareness of its developmental trends, while cultivating their ability to integrate and apply multiple technologies.

default.zh: 《现代生物制造原理》是生物工程专业的专业基础课，聚焦生物制造生产过程中多尺度下的基本原理、生物反应器及附属设备、下游处理单元操作及其设备计算等核心知识。课程旨在使学生掌握典型单元操作与设备的结构及设计计算方法，了解生物反应器及其附属设备的工作原理与设计，培养学生分析和解决生物制造过程实际问题的能力，提升查阅专业资料、进行计算及开展生物制造项目开发的专业素养。
default.en: Principles of Modern Biomanufacturing is a fundamental course for Bioengineering majors. It focuses on the multi-scale principles underlying biomanufacturing processes, including bioreactors and auxiliary equipment, as well as downstream unit operations and related equipment calculations. The course aims to enable students to master the principles, methods, structural designs, and design calculations of typical unit operations in biomanufacturing; understand the working principles and design calculations of typical bioreactors and their auxiliary equipment; and develop abilities to analyze and solve practical problems in biomanufacturing processes, along with skills in literature consultation, calculation, and biomanufacturing project development.

default.zh: 生物医学工程是综合运用现代自然科学和工程技术的原理、方法，从工程学的角度，在多种层次上研究生物体，特别是人体的结构、功能和其它生命现象，揭示生命运动的规律，深化对生命系统的认识，提供疾病的预防、治疗和康复的新手段，设计用于疾病诊断和疾病治疗等的新装置的新兴交叉学科。生物医学工程学涉及到的学科领域极其广泛。除了生物学和医学以外，生物医学工程学还与物理学、化学、材料科学、电子科学、计算机科学等理工学科高度相关。一个生物医学工程课题往往是多个的理工学科与生物学的融合。因此，生物医学工程学的知识体系较为分散和复杂。本课程属导论性质，是生物工程专业的专业选修课。本课程从肿瘤的诊断与治疗、生物力学、生物信息学、生物传感器和生物芯片、生物医学材料、组织工程、人工器官这八方面向学生介绍生物医学工程学的基本概念、发展历史、领域分类、世界与我国生物医学工程学的研究现状和发展趋势。本门课程的任务在于拓宽学生知识面，了解生物医学工程学在科研、医疗实践过程中的所发挥的重要作用，以及生物医学工程学亟待解决的问题和面临的挑战。进一步地，激发学生从事这方面研究工作的兴趣、以及为我国在该领域赶超世界先进水平而奋斗的责任感。
default.en: Biomedical Engineering (BME) is a new interdisciplinary subject, which uses the disciplines and applications of modern science and technology, from the prospective of engineering, to investigate the structures, functions, and other phenomena of organisms, especially human beings, on multiple levels, reveal the regulations of life activities, getting a deeper insight into the living systems, provide novel methods for safety protection, decease prevention, treatment and rehabilitation, design new instruments for diagnosis and therapy. Besides biology, BME is also highly related to physics, chemistry, material science and computer science. A project of BME usually mixes many fields of science and technology. Therefore, the knowledge of BME is complex and unsystematic. This course, which is a brief introduction of BME, is a selective course for the students of Bioengineering. In this course, the basic concept, history, classification and development (domestic and international) of BME will be introduced, including cancer diagnosis & therapy, biomechanics, bioinformatics, biosensors & chips, biomaterials, tissue engineering and artificial organs. The aim of this course is broadening the students’ range of knowledge, making the students know the importance of BME in scientific research and clinic medicine, as well as the problem and challenge in the field of BME. Furtherly, this course is also expected to encourage the students to make a contribution in this field of our country in the future.

default.zh: 本门课程目的是在原核细胞中导入真核细胞的基因片段，进行蛋白表达。实验内容包括：设计特异性引物用于PCR扩增，以得到足够多真核基因，用原核表达载体作为受体质粒，将二者分别进行双酶切形成粘性末端，以连接酶将之连接成为重组子，并转化到原核细胞中，以多种方法进行鉴定，以确定得到正确的重组质粒，可以表达目标蛋白。 本门课程为综合性实验，连续性强，今日实验结果是次日实验素材，一环紧扣一环，为了排除假性结果，必须设计充足的对照，成为挑战中极大的乐趣。使学生在学习中快乐地成长，掌握基本的分子生物学实验技术，提高实验动手能力及分析解决问题的能力，为今后独立进行科学研究打下良好的基础。同时获得了严谨的科研思维训练，通过同学间的配合建立团结合作的能力，对实验进程的把握增强了科研管理的能力。
default.en: The aim of this course is to introduce gene fragments of eukaryotic cells into prokaryotic cells for protein expression. First, we need to design specific primers for PCR amplification to obtain enough CDS fragment of eukaryotic gene. Prokaryotic expression vector was used as receptor. Both of the fragment and the vector were double-cut to form sticky ends, and ligase was used to link them into recombinants. The recombinants were transformed into prokaryotic cells, and the correct insertion of the fragments into the vector was confirmed by various methods to determine the correct recombinant plasmid that could express the target protein. The course consists of a continuous series of experiments, and today's experimental results are the next day's experimental materials. In order to exclude false results, sufficient controls must be carefully designed, and this becomes a great fun in the challenge. It enables students to grow up happily in learning, while mastering basic molecular biology experimental techniques, and improving experimental hands-on ability and analytical problem-solving ability. Those will lay a good foundation for independent scientific research of the students in the future. At the same time, the students will obtain rigorous training in scientific research thinking, and acquire the ability of cooperation after cooperated practice between classmates, and enhance the potential of scientific research management through the grasp of the experimental process.

default.zh: 生物工程综合实验是实现生物工程专业培养目标的重要实践环节。参照本科生毕业论文中的一些教学方法，将综合实验课程定位为带有科研性质的系列实验，通过将相关课程内容有机地融合，拓展学生所学的知识，锻炼其查阅资料、思维创新、团队合作的能力，初步培养学生的科研能力和创新精神，有利于学生综合素质的提高。本实验将零散的专业实验教学从理论教学中脱离出来，设立一门独立的生物工程综合实验课；在前期各个基础性的、分散的、验证性的实验课程基础上，重新整合、拓展加宽，提升成综合性、设计性的“独立”的实验课程体系，进而与理论课程体系并驾齐驱，成为在人才培养目标上并重的既紧密联系又相对独立的两个支柱。课程安排在专业理论教学结束后，即学习完生物化学、微生物学、基因工程、微生物发酵工程、生物物质分离、生物工程设备等必修课程后，是生物工程专业本科生集中进行的一次专业实验的系统操作。在这一阶段，既要求学生掌握生物工程的基本实验操作和步骤，巩固所学的专业基础理论知识。又要学生根据实验项目需求设计部分相关实验。实验课的课时安排集中连续进行，使前一次实验为后一次实验做准备，实验内容环环相扣，保证实验的连续性，从而可得出比较准确的实验结果。实验内容覆盖了生物工程的上、中、下游的全过程，具体包括了从培养基配制、微生物少量培养、质粒提取、PCR扩增、电泳检测、DNA双酶切、连接、转化等基因工程菌构建过程、到较大批量发酵罐发酵、诱导表达、细胞破碎、层析分离提纯鉴定等发酵与后处理的完整过程，包括了基因工程、蛋白质工程和发酵工程等操作技术，培养了综合技能，体现了完整的学科体系。
default.en: The comprehensive experiment of bioengineering is an important practice link to achieve the training goal of bioengineering specialty. Referring to some teaching methods in undergraduate thesis, the comprehensive experiment course is defined as a series of experiments with a scientific research nature. By organically integrating the contents of related courses, the students' knowledge is expanded, their ability of consulting data, thinking innovation and teamwork is trained, and their scientific research ability and innovative spirit are preliminarily cultivated, which is beneficial to the improvement of students' comprehensive quality. In this experiment, the scattered professional experiment teaching is separated from the theoretical teaching and an independent comprehensive experiment course of biological engineering is set up. On the basis of the basic, scattered and verifiable experimental courses in the early stage, it is reintegrated, expanded and broadened to upgrade into a comprehensive and designed "independent" experimental curriculum system, which, in turn, goes hand in hand with the theoretical curriculum system and becomes two pillars that are closely related and relatively independent in terms of talent training objectives. The course is arranged after the end of the professional theory teaching, that is, after the completion of the study of biochemistry, microbiology, genetic engineering, microbial fermentation engineering, biological matter separation, biological engineering equipment and other required courses. It is a systematic operation of a professional experiment conducted by the undergraduates majoring in biological engineering. At this stage, students are required to master the basic experimental operations of bioengineering and consolidate the basic theoretical knowledge of the profession. The experimental class is arranged in a concentrated and continuous manner, so that the previous experiment is prepared for the next experiment. The experiment content is interlocked to ensure the continuity of the experiment, so that more accurate experimental results can be obtained. The experiment content covers the whole process of bioengineering, including the preparation of medium, small amount of microorganism culture, plasmid extraction, PCR amplification, electrophoresis detection, DNA double enzyme digestion, ligation, transformation for engineered bacteria, covers the complete process of fermentation and post-processing, including fermentation to a larger batch in fermenters, induced expression, cell disruption, chromatographic separation, purification and identification, including genetic engineering, protein engineering, and fermentation engineering and other operating technologies, and cultivated comprehensive skills, reflecting a complete discipline system.

default.zh: 1.计算生物学方向 “计算生物学实验课”是针对整合科学（生物科学）专业本科生开设的一门前沿课程。本课程旨在培养学生在计算生物学领域的实践能力，特别是在生物大数据分析与应用方面的技能。随着生物大数据的爆发式增长，数据驱动的生物学研究已成为当今科学的主流趋势。为了满足对大量数据信息有效利用和生物学问题探索的迫切需求，计算方法的应用和开发以及资源的充分共享变得至关重要。 本课程涵盖了四个主要领域的实验内容：生物资源数据库、RNA-seq数据分析、DNA甲基化数据分析以及单细胞RNA测序数据分析。在RNA-seq数据分析部分，学生将学习RNA测序数据的获取、预处理、转录本定量以及差异表达基因筛选等技术，同时探讨如何构建癌症诊断模型和预后模型。在DNA甲基化数据分析部分，学生将学习DNA甲基化测序数据和芯片数据的介绍，掌握数据的预处理方法、差异DNA甲基化位点的筛选以及癌症诊断和预后标志物的识别。在单细胞RNA测序数据分析部分，学生将了解单细胞测序的原理，学习数据的质控、标准化以及细胞类型的注释和分类方法，进而探讨单细胞数据在肿瘤诊断和治疗中的应用。 此外，本课程注重培养学生的团队合作和科学交流能力。学生将分组进行实验设计、数据分析和结果解释，并通过小组讨论和报告分享加深对生物学和计算生物学的理解。通过实践操作，学生将掌握常用的生物信息学工具和数据库，能够独立进行计算生物学实验并解释结果。 综上所述，本课程旨在为学生提供全面的实验经验，培养其严谨的科学思维、掌握扎实的专业知识，具有整合科学（生物科学）相关产业的研发能力和继续深造的潜力，为他们未来从事相关学术研究或工业应用打下坚实的基础。通过学习本课程，学生将能够在生物大数据时代背景下更好地应对复杂的生物学问题，为推动生命科学的发展和创新做出贡献。 2.生物物理学方向 近二三十年的时间里，科学家对RNA功能的认识不断深入。除了经典的信使RNA编码蛋白质分子之外，RNA也可以作为核糖开关和核酶等功能分子，还有广泛的发生在各种重要的生物过程中的非编码RNA调控蛋白质的功能。为适应现代生物学和生物医学发展的需求，本课程旨在引导整合科学专业的本科生探索RNA与蛋白质之间的复杂互作机制，为深入理解疾病相关的RNA与蛋白质互作提供理论和实践基础。课程从实验室的基本操作和安全规范出发，首先通过详细探讨RNA的体外转录及其纯化过程，使学生掌握核心的RNA相关的分子生物学技术；同时，课程也重点关注蛋白质的表达和纯化技术，为学生提供全面的蛋白质工程知识；课程的核心部分着重于RNA-蛋白质相互作用的检测技术，包括最先进的生物物理和生物化学方法，如液体核磁共振波谱（NMR）分析等。通过这些技术，学生将学习如何揭示RNA和蛋白质之间的结构和动态关系，理解这些相互作用在细胞功能中的重要性。此外，本课程还融入了生物信息学工具的应用，让学生掌握现代生物技术的计算方法，增强他们在生物数据分析方面的能力。课程目标是培养具有扎实的实验技能和创新科研思维的整合科学专业人才，使他们能够在生物科学的前沿领域中发挥重要作用。通过这门课程，学生不仅能学习到RNA和蛋白质相互作用的基本原理和实验方法，还能培养出独立思考和创新研究的能力、团队协作攻关解决问题的能力，为未来在生物科学领域的深入研究和职业发展打下坚实的基础。 3.化学生物学方向 《整合科学综合实验》（化学生物学方向）是一门新型的交叉学科相关实验课程，本课程将无机化学、高分子化学、生物化学、细胞生物学、分子生物学、纳米工程等实验技术手段引入到生物材料实验中，利用这些技术手段探讨纳米材料合成、高分子材料分离提纯、化学物质的细胞吞噬和细胞毒性等化学生物学研究领域的关键问题。
default.en: 1.计算生物学方向 "Computational Biology Laboratory Course" is a cutting-edge course designed for undergraduate students majoring in Integrative Science (Biological Science). The course aims to cultivate students' practical skills in the field of computational biology, particularly in the analysis and application of large-scale biological data. With the explosive growth of biological big data, data-driven biological research has become the mainstream trend in contemporary science. To meet the urgent demand for effective utilization of massive data information and exploration of biological problems, the application and development of computational methods, as well as the full sharing of resources, have become crucial. This course covers experimental content in four main areas: Biological resource database, RNA-seq data analysis, DNA methylation data analysis, and single-cell RNA sequencing data analysis. In the RNA-seq data analysis section, students will learn techniques such as acquiring RNA sequencing data, preprocessing, transcript quantification, and screening for differentially expressed genes. They will also explore how to construct cancer diagnostic models and prognosis models. In the DNA methylation data analysis section, students will learn about DNA methylation sequencing data and chip data, master data preprocessing methods, screening for differential DNA methylation sites, and the identification of cancer diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers. In the single-cell RNA sequencing data analysis section, students will understand the principles of single-cell sequencing, learn data quality control, standardization, cell type annotation, and classification methods, and then explore the application of single-cell data in cancer diagnosis and treatment. 2.生物物理学方向 Over the past two or three decades, scientists have gained a deeper understanding of RNA functions. Beyond the classic role of messenger RNA in encoding protein molecules, RNA also functions as riboswitches and ribozymes, as well as non-coding RNAs that regulate protein functions in various crucial biological processes. To meet the demands of modern biology and biomedicine, this course aims to guide undergraduates majoring in integrated science to explore the complex interactions between RNA and proteins, providing a theoretical and practical foundation for understanding disease-related RNA-protein interactions. The course begins with basic laboratory operations and safety standards, first delving into in vitro transcription of RNA and its purification process, enabling students to master core molecular biology techniques related to RNA. Additionally, the course emphasizes protein expression and purification techniques, offering comprehensive knowledge of protein engineering. The core part of the course focuses on techniques for detecting RNA-protein interactions, including cutting-edge biophysical and biochemical methods such as Liquid Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy. Through these techniques, students will learn to reveal the structural and dynamic relationships between RNA and proteins and understand the significance of these interactions in cellular functions. 3.化学生物学方向 Comprehensive Experiment of Integrated Science (Chemical Biology) is a new interdisciplinary experiment course, which integrates inorganic chemistry, polymer chemistry, biochemistry, cell biology, molecular biology and nanotechnology into biomaterials related experiments. In this course the central issues in the field of chemical biology including synthesis of nanomaterials, separation and purification of polymeric materials, cellular uptake and cytotoxicity of biomaterials are discussed.

default.zh: 生物物质分离工程是生物技术、生物工程专业本科生的一门重要专业基础课。本课程通过对生物反应工艺过程中产物的分离，提纯的方法、工艺计算及设备等内容的讲述，以工程观点揭示生物物质分离过程的本质及其规律，使学生们了解和掌握生物物质分离纯化的原理、方法及工程技术知识，并对生物物质分离技术的发展动态和实际应用有一定的了解。
default.en: Bioseparation Engineering is an important core curriculum for the major of biotechnology and bioengineering. Through teaching the contents of the methods, equipment, processing technology and calculation of extracting and refining matter from mixture of bio-reaction, enable students to understand and master the principle and engineering knowledge of separation engineering of bio-reaction matters. This course also gives up-to-date introductions of developments and practical applications in this field to the students.

default.zh: 科研设计和论文写作是科技工作者所具备的基本技能，本课程面向即将进入实验室的大三本科生而制定的，主要培养学生如何在科研中发现问题，解决问题和论文写作的能力。 本课程主要讲授科研的概念、科学精神和学术道德规范，让学生了解科研的作用和意义，遵守学术道德规范。根据教师实际经验讲授各自领域的科研方法，让学生掌握科研设计的基本方法和基本流程。讲授科研论文撰写，让学生掌握科研论文检索的技能，论文写作的规范性，了解论文投稿的基本流程。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1 理解科研概念，科研精神和学术道德和规范 课程目标2 掌握科研设计的基本方法和基本流程 课程目标3 掌握文献检索方法，具备基本论文撰写能力。
default.en: Scientific research design and paper writing are researchers’ basic skills. This course is designed for the junior students who are going to enter the laboratory, and mainly trains students’ ability of finding and solving problems, and writing papers in the scientific research. This course mainly introduces the concept and spirit of the scientific research, academic ethic, so as to let students understand the significance of the scientific research. According to their practical experience in their respective research fields, teachers give lectures on the methods in the scientific research, so that students can master the basic methods and basic processes of research design. Introduction of scientific writing can enable students to master the skills of research papers retrieval, the standardization of thesis writing, and be familiar with the basic process of manuscript submission. The objectives of the curriculum requirements for students are as follows: Objective 1. Understand the concept and spirit of scientific research, and academic ethic. Objective 2. Master the basic method and basic process of scientific research design. Objective 3. Master the methods of scientific literature retrieval, and the basic capacity of paper writing.

default.zh: 21世纪以来，生命科学理论与实验技术快速发展，产生了海量的研究成果与实验数据。大量的知识和数据通过生物数据库存储、依靠生物软件分析，了解生物数据库及软件的原理，掌握常用生物数据库和软件的应用方法，是生物技术和生物工程学科人才必须具备的素质和能力。 本课程主要讲授生物数据库和软件的应用背景和应用方法，使学生了解生物数据库和软件的一般特征和基本要素，能够熟练选择、查询常见的基因组序列、基因、RNA、蛋白质、变异、疾病等数据库，如NCBI RefSeq序列数据库、GO基因本体、GeneCard基因数据库、PDB蛋白数据库、dbSNP变异数据库、OMIM疾病数据库、ClinVar变异-疾病数据库等；掌握部署、使用基因组浏览器、序列比对、测序数据分析等生物软件的方法，如UCSC基因组浏览器、BLAST序列比对软件、FASTA、SAM等测序数据基本格式，以及常见的测序数据分析环节所使用的软件。本课程还将简介特定领域的生物数据库与软件，使学生自主学习非常用生物数据库和软件的使用方法。 本课程通过一一对应的讲授和上机实验环节，着重训练学生实际分析问题、选择并运用生物数据库和软件完成特定任务的实践技能，有效辅助本学科其它课程的实验设计和数据分析等环节，培养学生学习和应用先进工具解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Since the 21st century, the theory and experimental technology of life sciences have developed rapidly, producing a massive amount of research results and experimental data. A large amount of knowledge and data are stored in biological databases and analyzed by biological software. Understanding the principles of biological databases and software and mastering the application methods of common biological databases and software are essential qualities and abilities for talents in biotechnology and bioengineering disciplines. This course mainly teaches the application background and methods of biological databases and software, enabling students to understand the general characteristics and basic elements of biological databases and software. Students will be able to proficiently select and query common databases of genome sequences, genes, RNA, proteins, variations, diseases, etc., such as the NCBI RefSeq sequence database, GO gene ontology, GeneCard gene database, PDB protein database, dbSNP variation database, OMIM disease database, ClinVar variation-disease database, etc. The course also covers the deployment and use of genomic browsers, sequence alignment, sequencing data analysis, and other biological software methods, such as the UCSC Genome Browser, BLAST sequence alignment software, FASTA, SAM and other basic sequencing data formats, as well as software commonly used in sequencing data analysis steps. Additionally, the course will briefly introduce specific domain biological databases and software, enabling students to independently learn the usage of non-common biological databases and software. Through corresponding lectures and hands-on lab sessions, this course focuses on training students' practical skills in analyzing actual problems, selecting, and using biological databases and software to complete specific tasks. It effectively assists in the experimental design and data analysis of other courses in this discipline and cultivates students' ability to learn and apply advanced tools to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 本课程内容主要包括讲授作物育种领域的基本概念和理论，了解作物遗传育种学科的发展进程及前沿知识；学习作物遗传育种领域的经典案例及背后的遗传学知识；讲解与作物育种密切相关的、植物生命科学领域的相关知识，使学生了解植物科学领域的热点问题。帮助学生将植物遗传学、植物分子生物学、植物生物技术和作物育种学的基本知识等密切联系起来。从而提高学生对作物研究领域的了解、加深对生命科学的认知。
default.en: The content of this course mainly includes studying the basic concepts and theories in the field of crop breeding, understanding the development process and frontier knowledge of crop Genetics and breeding; studying the classic cases in the field of crop Genetics and breeding and the genetic knowledge behind them; expounding the related knowledge in the field of plant life science closely related to crop breeding. Collectively, we will help students to understand the link between basic knowledge of plant genetics, plant molecular biology, plant biotechnology and crop breeding, including molecular design breeding. Finally, this course will help to improve students' understanding of crop research field and deepen their cognition of life science.

default.zh: 生物技术制药一门综合性很强的专业课程，生物制药技术是指运用微生物学、生物学、医学、生物化学等的研究成果，从生物体、生物组织、细胞、体液等，综合应用生命科学的基础原理和方法，结合化学分离工程和药学等相关学科知识，制备一些在临床上用于治疗或者诊断用的生物药品。本课程主要讲授生物技术制药的相关概念，技术及其基本方法，主要包括细胞工程制药，基因工程制药，发酵工程制药，蛋白工程制药及其生化制药方法。另一方面，本课程讲授生物技术制药过程中涉及的一些主要分离技术和生物药品的分析和鉴定方法。通过本课程的学习，是学生基本掌握生物技术制药的基本方法及其相关产品的分离和鉴定方法，进一步了解生物药物的临床应用等相关知识，本课程密切相关的基础课程有：动物学，植物学，有机化学，无机化学，分析化学，生物化学，微生物学，分子生物学和细胞生物学等。
default.en: Biotechnological Pharmaceutics is a strong comprehensive professional course. Biotechnological Pharmaceutics refers to the use of microbiology, biology, medicine, biochemistry and other research results combined with the comprehensive application of the basic principles and methods of life science the relevant knowledge of Chemical separation engineering and pharmacy, Preparation of some biological drugs for treatment or diagnosis from an organism, a biological tissue, a cell, a body fluid, etc. This course focuses on the related concepts, techniques and basic methods of biopharmaceuticals including cell engineering pharmacy, genetic engineering pharmaceutical, fermentation engineering pharmaceuticals, protein engineering pharmaceuticals and biochemical pharmaceutical methods. On the other hand，This course is also taught some major separation techniques and methods for the analysis and identification of biological drugs，Further understanding of the clinical application of biodrugs in the process of biotechnological Pharmaceutical. The basic courses that are closely related to biotechnological Pharmaceutics are Zoology, botany, organic chemistry, inorganic chemistry, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology Cell biology and so on.

default.zh: 纳米医学是将纳米科技应用于医学领域，用以开展疾病的预防、诊断、治疗和康复的一门新兴科技。新世纪以来，随着纳米科学研究的快速发展，纳米科技在生命科学与技术、医学临床实践等方面都不断地得到应用，逐步取代了一些传统的试验和诊疗方法，产生了巨大的经济效益和社会效益。比如，金纳米粒子用于AIDS等病毒性传染病的诊断，提高了疾病检测的速度和灵敏度；磁性纳米粒子作为靶向剂用于肿瘤或其他疾病的药物治疗，减轻了药物的副作用；纳米复合材料用于骨骼或其他组织的修复和再生，给外科疾病带来了新的治疗手段。 本课程首先讲授纳米科技的基本概念、材料和手段，并在此基础上进一步介绍其在癌症、传染病、心脑血管疾病、糖尿病、外科矫形等的诊断和治疗，以及食品、药品、化妆品等医学领域的应用，使学生了解生物、医学领域中一些亟待解决的问题和所面临的挑战，以及纳米科技给这些问题和挑战的解决所提供的新思路和新方法。同时本课程还将让学生了解生命科学的外延交叉领域和纳米医学所催生的新产业，为学生今后从事与生命科学相关的前沿研究、技术研发奠定知识基础，激发学生从事科技创新工作的兴趣以及为我国生物医药事业奋斗的社会责任感。
default.en: Nanomedicine is the application of nanoscience and nanotechnology in the field of medicine, including the prevention, diagnosis, therapy, and rehabilitation of diseases. In the new century, with the fast development of nanoscience and nanotechnology, they have been continually applied in biotechnology and clinical medicine, replacing some traditional testing, diagnostic, or therapeutic techniques and producing huge economic and social benefits. For example, the use of gold nanoparticles improves the efficiency and sensitivity of AIDS diagnosis. Magic nanoparticles can be used as a targeting agent to reduce the toxicity of the drug for the treatment of cancer or other diseases. As a new method of surgical treatment, nanohybrid materials can be applied in tissue repair and regeneration. In this course, we will first illustrate the basic concepts, materials, and techniques of nanoscience and nanotechnology. Furthermore, their utility in the diagnosis and therapy of cancer, infectious diseases, cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and orthopedics as well as in food, drug, and cosmetics manufacture will be introduced. This course aims to let the students know the new ideas and methods that can solve the urgent problems in biology and medicine provided by nanoscience and nanotechnology, as well as the new industry produced by nanotechnology. This course will also encourage students to devote themselves to the development of bio- or medical technology.

default.zh: 化学生物学课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22LS32015 课程名称：化学生物学 总学时：16 理论学时：16 实验学时：0 上机学时：0 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1 开课单位：生命科学与技术学院学院 授课对象：生物技术、生物工程、整合科学大三本科生 开课学期：24秋 先修课程：无 二、课程简介 化学生物学是一门利用化学手段研究生命过程的学科。由于生命系统的复杂性，传统生物学研究手段在一些研究领域具有很大局限性。利用化学工具、原理来开发和理解复杂生命过程现象的学科叫做化学生物学。
default.en: Introduction to Chemical Biology 1.General Information Course Code：22LS32015 Course Title：Chemical Biology Credit Hours：16 Lecture：16 Lab：0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：1 Offering Department: School of Life Science and Technology Students: 3rd year Undergraduate Students from Biotechnology、Bioengineering and Integrated Science Term: 2024 Fall Prerequisites: None 2.Course Description Chemical Biology refers to the utilization of chemical tools for the investigation of life sciences. Traditional biological techniques are significantly limited in many research fields owing to the complexity of lives. Therefore a variety of chemical tools have been developed to investigate complicated biological phenomena, and this subject is called Chemical Biology.

default.zh: “空间生命科学研究技术”主要介绍空间生命科学的发展简史、空间生命科学基础知识，包括空间环境引起机体分子水平、细胞水平和整体水平变化规律，如空间辐射、微重力和磁场生物学效应的基本原理。介绍空间生命科学研究方法，如空间实验设备、辐射、微重力和亚磁场的地面模拟，空间实验技术在生物学中的应用等。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握空间生命科学的基本知识、基本原理及基本研究技术，了解空间生命科学领域背景知识，开阔学生的视野，为日后的科学研究奠定基础。
default.en: Research technology of space biology mainly introduces the development history of space biology, the basic knowledge of space biology, including the organism changes at the molecular level, cellular level caused by space environment，such as space radiation, microgravity and magnetic field. Introduces space research methods, such as space experimental equipment, radiation, simulated microgravity and sub-magnetic field on the ground, the application of space experimental technology in biology. Through the study of this course, students will grasp the basic knowledge, basic principles and basic research technology of space biology, understand the background knowledge of space biology, and broaden their horizons, lay the foundation for future scientific research.

default.zh: 随着人们对生活质量的要求不断提高，对农产品质量的要求也越来越高。要想生产出符合人们健康要求的食品，就离不开生物防治理论和实践的指导。生物防治就是研究利用生物手段来防止有害生物的科学，有害生物综合治理系统中的一个不可或缺的重要组成部分。本课程目的在于使学生掌握生物防治在有害生物综合治理中的重要作用、发展历史以及趋势，掌握生物防治的基本原理和方法，拓宽学生的知识面；并通过本课程的学习培养更多的专业人才，以提高我国生物防治水平。本门课程讲述生物防治的定义、内容、重要性、发展历史、途径和方法，以及实施生物防治的理论基础。寄生性天敌昆虫、捕食性天敌的主要类群及其生物学；天敌昆虫的引进繁殖与释放；利用病原微生物来抑制有害生物种群数量的理论与实践，介绍了病原微生物的研究方法，包含病原微生物类群、致病机理、制剂生产及其利用等；生物技术在生物防治中应用。
default.en: With the demand of the living standard of people moving steadily upward, people need more and more agricultural production with good quality. In order to produce plenteous food for people’s health, the significance of the biological control theory, either in theory or in practice, was not ignored. Biological control put main emphasis on the use of living organisms, such as predators, parasitoids, and pathogens, to control pest insects, weeds, or diseases. It is one of the indispensable components in the integrated pest control. The purposes of this course are to help the students to master the history and the trend of the biological control, and its significance in the integrated pest control; to help the students to master the basic principles and methods of biological control, which can widen the sphere of their knowledge and train many specialists for biological control in order to arise the level of the biological control in our country. The contents of this course involved the definition, the contents, the significance, the development history, and the methods of biological control, the theory basis of using biological control, the main groups and characters of the parasitic and the natural predators, the main principles in introduction, reproduction, and release of the natural predators, the theory and practice of using pathogenic microbes to control the quantity of the pests, the introduction of the research methods on pathogenic microbes, such as the characters of the groups, the mechanism of causing diseases, the production and use of such microbe preparation, and, finally, the application of biotechnology in biological control.

default.zh: 新冠疫情后，世界各国的政府与科学家越来越觉得生物安全问题是当今面临的一个重要课题。生物安全，是生物学、当代医学、公共卫生学、流行病学等专业必须学习的知识，更是社会群体需要提升的防范意识。本课程重点讲述当今最受社会关注的转基因生物、人类传染病、实验室生物安全、入侵生物、食品安全、农药安全和生物安全产业等重要领域的基本理论及研究进展。使学生提高生物安全意识，了解我国生物安全相关法律法规，规范个人健康行为；为今后从事相关专业的学生铸造正确的生物安全观和知识体系，养成良好的生物安全习惯。
default.en: After the COVID-19 epidemic, governments and scientists around the world increasingly consider that biosafety is an important issue today. Biosafety is a knowledge that must learned in majors such as biology, contemporary medicine, public health, epidemiology, and more, and a preventive awareness that social groups need to enhance. This course focuses on the basic theories and research progress in important fields such as genetically modified organisms, human infectious diseases, laboratory biosafety, invasive organisms, food safety, pesticide safety, and biosafety industries, which are currently the most concerned by society. Through this course’ learning, students can enhance their awareness of biosafety, understand relevant laws and regulations on biosafety in China, and regulate their personal health behavior and cultivate a correct biosafety concept and knowledge system for future students engaged in related majors, and to cultivate good biosafety habits.

default.zh: 植物生物学是生物专业选修课称程。主要内容包括：植物细胞的结构和功能、细胞的代谢、细胞的分裂分化和死亡、植物的组织、根茎叶器官的结构发育和生理功能、植物的代谢（蒸腾作用、矿质营养、光合作用和物质的运输等）、植物的生殖、植物的生长和发育、植物的命名及植物的系统分类（藻类植物、苔藓植物、蕨类植物、裸子植物和被子植物）。 整个教学通过课堂讲授、自学辅导、讨论、课程作业等相互配合，密切联系的教学形式完成。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握有关植物生物学的基本知识、技能和技巧，了解本学科研究现状及发展前景，培养学生思考问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Plant biology is one of basic courses of life science. This course is divided into several major sections, including: the basic structure and function of plant cell; cell metabolism; cell division, differentiation and death; plant tissue; the structures, developmental and physiological functions of root, stem and leaf; plant metabolism (transpiration, mineral nutrition, photosynthesis and substance transport); plant reproductive; plant growth and development; plant diversity (algae, bryophytes, ferns, gymnosperm and angiosperm); plant ecology. Lectures, tutorials, discuss and courses reports will be included to complete this courses. Students should grasp the basic knowledge and technique of plant biology, and know the recent research and future development.

default.zh: 《植物生物学实验》是贴合植物生物学课程设置的实验课，课程包括植物形态结构、植物的光合作用、植物的蒸腾作用、植物激素与植物在逆境中的生理表现等多方面的实验内容。 植物结构是植物生理活动的基础。所以，实验课程将植物六大器官的结构观察放在了第一个部分，这部分内容采用教师讲授与学生直接操作观察相结合的方式进行教学，使学生获得对植物器官及其显微结构和功能的直观认识。 在全面掌握植物器官结构与功能的基础上，通过叶绿体的提取与活性测定实验，剖析叶绿体这个光合作用的基本结构单位在光合作用中发挥的作用，加深学生对光合作用的理解；通过植物组织水势测定与蒸腾强度测定实验，让学生直观认识植物体内的水分代谢；通过吲哚乙酸与吲哚乙酸氧化酶的测定，植物在逆境中的生理变化与表现，使学生了解植物体内的激素调节行为与面对逆境的适应手段，体会植物作为地球上主要的生命形态之一，它们的生理活动与运行机制的独特魅力。 通过这一系列课程教学，使学生熟悉和掌握植物生物学的基本实验技能和方法，得到实验技能的基本训练。培养学生的学习能力和科学素养，扩展学生的交叉学科的视野，同时锻炼学生查找资料、归纳问题以及报告的综合能力。
default.en: Plant Biology Experiments is an experimental course that fits the curriculum of plant biology。 Course includes plant morphological structure, plant photosynthesis, plant transpiration, plant hormones and physiological performance of plants in adversity. Structure is the basis of physiological activity. The experimental course puts the observation of the structure of the six major plant organs in the first part, which adopts the combination of teachers' lectures and students' direct operation and observation, so that students can gain an intuitive understanding of plant organs and their microstructure and function. On the basis of a comprehensive grasp of the structure and function of plant organs, the role of chloroplast, the basic structural unit of photosynthesis, in photosynthesis was analyzed through the extraction and activity determination experiments of chloroplasts, so as to deepen students' understanding of photosynthesis. Through the measurement of water potential and transpiration intensity of plant tissues, students can intuitively understand the water metabolism in plants. Through the determination of indoleacetic acid and indoleacetic acid oxidase, the physiological changes and performance of plants in adversity, so that students can understand the hormone regulation behavior in plants and the means of adaptation in the face of adversity, and experience the unique charm of plants, as one of the main life forms on the earth, their physiological activities and operating mechanisms. Through this series of courses, students could master the basic experimental skills and methods of plant biology and get basic training in experimental skills. Cultivate student scientific literacy, expand students' interdisciplinary horizons, and exercise students' comprehensive ability to find information, summarize problems and report.

default.zh: 微生物发酵工程是一门综合性及实践性很强的课程，该课着重微生物发酵工程中共性知识的介绍，特别强调微生物发酵的原理、工程解决方法、发酵动力学、发酵产物的提取加工、发酵的具体应用、发酵与环境保护等内容，由于生产实践中，技术性很强，所以在讲述时应理论结合实际，使学生能对将来的工作有一定的感性认识。通过课程的学习，将使学生系统性地掌握微生物发酵原理及其工程技术方面的基本理论知识；构建学生在分析和解决微生物发酵工程中培养、发酵、产物提取等基本专业能力；并且培养学生具备在微生物发酵工程领域获得新知识、自我完善及创新的素质。 课程将通过启发式的课堂教学，激发学生主动学习的兴趣，培养学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力；同时利用翻转课堂的手段，让学生通过运用所学课堂教学，并主动从相关书籍、文献中搜集有关知识，整理出有自己独立见解的讨论题目和读书报告，在课堂上与同学进行讨论，全方位培养学生运用知识、分析文艺解决问题和自我提高完善的能力。
default.en: This subject includes 7 parts: the preface, industry microorganism cultivation, fermentation mechanisms, fermentation engineering, fermentation product isolation and formulation, advanced fermentation industry, clean fermentation and the waste water treatments. In the preface, the history and the development of fermentation are introduced. The most important part of this subject is the industry microorganism cultivation since the microorganisms play very essential part in fermentation. Fermentation mechanisms cover main material metabolizing in the industry microorganisms. Fermentation engineering focuses on the methods of culturing the microorganisms especially with bio-reactor. Fermentation product isolation and formulation study the techniques of the isolation purification and formulation of the products from those microorganisms. Advanced fermentation industry gives us many examples of the fermentation industry such as alcoholic drink production, food processing, antibiotics production etc. In clean fermentation and the waste water treatments, various methods for keeping whole fermentation process clean and recycling the waste water from the fermentation are introduced.

default.zh: 纳米科技的发展，给生物医药界带来革命性的变化。利用纳米科技研制纳米药物，在预防、诊断和治疗人类疾病方面具有重要意义。纳米药物与传统药物相比，具有高效低毒的特性，已成为国内外医药界的研究热点。 本课程系统讲述纳米药物的有关前沿问题，主要内容包括纳米药物概述、纳米材料理化性质、常规纳米给药系统（如脂质体、聚合物、纳米水凝胶、固体脂质纳米粒、无机纳米载药系统）、智能纳米给药系统、纳米基因药物、纳米诊疗试剂、纳米药物的质量评价等，并对纳米药物的给药途径、毒性机理、安全性评价、纳米药物的药代动力学等进行系统讲述。 本课程采取课堂讲授结合课后文献阅读与专题调研的方式，要求学生掌握纳米药物的基本概念、研究方法、各种纳米药物载体的制备方法、纳米药物的质量评价指标等，了解纳米药物研究领域的前沿进展和面临的挑战，使学生对纳米药物学有一个全面地了解，系统掌握该领域的最新进展，并培养独立设计实验和分析、处理结果的能力。
default.en: The development of nanotechnology has brought revolutionary changes in biomedical field. The use of nanotechnology to develop nanomedicine is of great importance in the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of human diseases. Compared with traditional drugs, nanomedicine has the characteristics of high efficiency and low toxicity, and has become a hot topic in the medical field at home and abroad.
