This course systematically describes the frontiers of nanomedicines, including the overview of nanomedicines, Physichemical properities of nanomaterilas, the nano drug delivery system (such as liposome, polymeric nanoparticles, nanohydrogel, solid lipid nanoparticles, inorganic nanoparticles etc), smart drug delivery systems, nanomedicine for gene therapy, the quality evaluation of nanomedicine agents, and the route of administration, toxicity mechanism, safety evaluation, the pharmacokinetics of nanomedicine. This course adopts instruction in class combined with literature reading and special subject investigation after class. In this course, students are required to master the basic concepts, research methods, preparation methods of various nano delivery systems, quality evaluation of nanomedicine, and understand the frontiers and challenges in the field of nanomedicine, in order to make them have a comprehensive understanding of nanomedicine, systematically grasp the latest developments in this field, and to develop the ability for independently designing experiments, analyzing and processing results.

default.zh: 现代医学成像技术的飞速发展及其在临床上的广泛应用彻底改变了传统医学的诊断和治疗方式，现代医学影像数据量也在呈指数增长，医学图像处理有助于医学影像数据的分析和高效利用。本课程的开设旨在让学生了解医学成像技术基本原理，掌握基本医学图像处理基本概念和方法，掌握医学图像处理软件（3D Slicer）进行医学图像处理技能，通过授课和示教方式让学生具备将理论知识与实践相结合的能力，通过对介绍前沿技术发展趋势拓宽学生视野，为学生今后的科学研究或工作奠定基础。
default.en: The rapid development of modern medical imaging technology and its wide application in clinical practice has completely changed the way of the traditional diagnostic and treatment in medicine. The exponential growth of modern medical imaging data has led to the need for medical image processing to assist in the analysis and utilization of medical imaging data. This course aims to provide students with an understanding of the basic principles of medical imaging technology, grasp fundamental concepts and methods of medical image processing, master the skills of medical image processing software (3D Slicer), and enable students to combine theoretical knowledge with practical skills through teaching and demonstrations. By introducing cutting-edge technological trends, the course broadens students' perspectives and lays the foundation for their future research or work.

default.zh: 结构生物学是在原子水平研究生物大分子及其复合物结构和功能之间关系的学科。这是一门具有较强学科交叉性的生命科学前沿学科。通过结构生物学概论课程的学习，使得学生们初步熟悉结构生物学研究的基本内容、基本知识、研究方法；了解结构生物学领域的新发现，研究进展和发展趋势；并能初步分析生物大分子结构和功能的关系。为将来进一步从事生命科学研究或教学工作打下知识基础。本课程教学基本内容包括：结构生物学的研究方法；蛋白质、核酸的表达、纯化；生物大分子的结构与功能；结构生物学与制药。
default.en: Structural Biology methods are used to study the relationship between structure and function of macro-molecules at the molecular and atomic level. The Introduction to Structural Biology course is dedicated to introducing undergraduate students to the principles and techniques of structural biology. The major forces determining macromolecular structure and function, such as X-ray crystallography, NMR, Cryo-electron microscopy, will be introduced in this course. The main focus of this course will include current techniques and research progress in structural biology field.

default.zh: 进化论是生物学中的最大的统一理论。生命科学各个层次的研究以及各分支学科体系的建立无不以生物进化的理论为其指导思想，它又同时吸收与综合生物学各学科的研究成果。本课程将从认识地球生命开始，进而阐述进化概念，追溯进化思想和进化学说发展历史；接着，从两个方面阐述进化过程和进化规律，即一方面从时间向度上阐述地球上生物进化的历史过程，另一方面从生物组织的不同层次（植物、动物及人类的进化）阐述进化规律及物种形成的机制；同时又从遗传角度阐述影响生物进化的因素。
default.en: Evolution, which is a main theory to direct various courses in the field of life science and meanwhile to absorb the novel accomplishment from them, is a greatest united theory in Biology. Modern Evolution is not a kind of ideological theory, but it is a specific course to explore the history process, the reason, the mechanism, the rate, the trend of biological evolution, the formation and extinction of species. In the course, the Earth history will first be explained, and then the basic concepts, the evolution thoughts and theories. The evolution process and regulations were narrated from two aspects. On the one hand, the history process of evolution was explored according to the time vector. on the other hand, the evolutionary laws and the mechanism of species formation are elaborated from the different levels of biological organizations (the evolution of plants, animals and human beings); at the same time, the factors affecting biological evolution are elaborated from the genetic perspective.

default.zh: 环境生物工程是伴随着不断发生环境问题生态问题而产生的新兴学科，包括直接或间接利用生物或生物体的某些组成部分或某些机能，建立降低或消除污染物产生的生产工艺，或者高效净化环境污染、同时又生产有用物质的工程技术，以及利用、强化生态系统的自净能力，从而对环境污染进行削减、修复与治理。 通过本课程的学习使学生能了解广受关注的生态环境问题，理解到解决环境问题的根本途径是调节人类社会活动与环境的关系，并能从工程的角度去探索解决的方法，为将来从事环境保护，生态治理和资源合理利用等方面的工作奠定扎实的基础。 通过本课程的学习使学生掌握环境生物技术的主要类型，环境生态工程设计的基本知识与方法。掌握废水、固体废弃物、大气污染物的生物处理技术，掌握生物制醇、生物制氢、生物制甲烷、生物燃料电池、生物冶金、生物脱硫、环境生物监测技术，了解农田、湖泊、河流、湿地、沙漠、土壤等生态系统的特点和自净能力，掌握强化生态系统的净化能力、削减污染负荷产生和生态修复的生态系统设计、管理和工程学技术。
default.en: Environmental bioengineering is a new discipline that accompanies the environmental problems and ecological problems, including the use of organisms or certain components or functions of organisms, either directly or indirectly, to reduce or eliminate the production processes of pollutants, to decontaminate environmental pollution efficiently while produce useful materials, and to reduce, repair and control the environmental pollution, with enhanced ecosystem self-purification capacity. Based on this course, students can understand the growing concern of the ecological environment, understand the fundamental way to solve environmental problems is to regulate the relationship between human social activities and the environment, and lay a solid foundation for exploring the solution for the future environmental protection, ecological management and rational use of resources and so on from the perspective of engineering. Based on this course, students can master the basic types of environmental biotechnology, the basic knowledge and methods of environmental ecological engineering design, master the biological treatment technology of waste water, solid waste, air pollutants, master producing alcohol, hydrogen, methane, master bio-fuel cells, bio-metallurgy, biological desulfurization, environmental biological monitoring technology, understand the characteristics and self-purification capacity of farmland, lake, river, wetlands, desert, soil and other ecosystem, master ecosystem design, management and engineering techniques to reduce pollution generation and to improve ecological restoration.

default.zh: “神经生物学前沿进展”课程将提供有关膜结构和神经细胞中膜兴奋性机制的最新进展。本课程将讨论转运蛋白、膜受体、基于结构的离子通道激活机制。同时探讨它们对引发电信号传导的作用和在细胞通讯中所起的重要作用。此外，将讨论神经营养因子，生长因子，肽或胺类神经递质的信号传导机制。接受各种因素刺激后受体会产生多种信号传导途径，细胞组分通过整合各种信号形成最终信息，并该信息将被传递至目标神经元。作为受体的激活因子其主要由神经末梢分泌。本课程将讨论突触小泡与靶膜之间的融合过程，以了解胞吐作用和内吞作用调节神经传递的机制。然后，本课程将提供有关视觉，听觉和躯体感觉等感官信息处理的讲座。最后，本课程将提供研究神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默氏病和帕金森氏病）的最新研究进展，这些疾病是大脑衰老的主要危险因素。
default.en: The course will cover topics which are not discussed in Neuroscience course. Advanced neurobiology course will provide in-depth knowledge about membrane structure and the mechanism of membrane excitability in neuronal cells. There are many kinds of transporters in the membrane such as pumps, exchangers, and ion channels. The structure-based activation mechanisms of transporters and ion channels will be discussed and their contribution to elicit electrical signaling will be discussed in detail. There are also many different types of receptors in the membrane to play an important role in cell communication. The signaling mechanisms of neurotrophic factors, growth factors, peptides or amine neurotransmitters will be discussed. There are diverse signaling pathways generated from receptors stimulated by the above factors and various signaling should be integrated to make finalized information which will be delivered to target neuron. The receptor activating factors are mostly secreted from nerve terminal. The fusion process between synaptic vesicles and target membrane will be discussed to understand the mechanism of exocytosis and endocytosis for regulated neurotransmission. Then I will give lectures for sensory information processing such as vision, hearing, and somatic sensation. Finally the course will provide recent research progress in studying neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease which are major risk factors for aging brain.

default.zh: 研究有机体及其环境相互关系的生态学， 随着生态环境问题的日益严重而受到空前的重视和关注。“绿水青山就是金山银山”，生态文明建设需要我们在生活中树立生态理念和生态意识。本课程结合人们认识事物的特点，在从整体认识生态学、生态系统的基础上，以生态系统为背景讲述生态系统中生物个体、种群、群落等不同层次生命体系的生态学规律；介绍了生态系统的结构、功能、调控、理论应用及研究方法。内容主要包括“有机体与环境”讲述生物与环境、能量环境和物质环境；“种群生态学”讲述种群、生物种的变异和进化、生活史对策及种内和种间关系；“群落生态学”讲述群落的组成、动态和群落的分类排序；“生态系统生态学”讲述生态系统的一般特征、能流流动及其中的物质循环和地球上的生态系统的主要类型；“应用生态学”讲述和我们生活息息相关的环境保护和生物多样性以及有害生物的控制等。
default.en: The ecology that studies the interrelationship between organisms and their environment has received unprecedented attention as ecological problems have become more serious. “Green mountain is gold and silver mountain”. The construction of ecological civilization requires us to establish ecological concepts and ecological consciousness in our lives. Based on the process of the cognition, taking the ecology and the ecosystem as a whole, this course puts main emphasis on two aspects. The first is the law of ecology existing among different biology systems, such as the individual organisms, the populations, and the communities. The second is the introduction of the ecology in different aspects, including the structure, the function, the regulation of ecosystem, the appliance of the ecological theory, and the ecological methodology. The contents of this course are described as follows: 1. The relationships between living things and the environments (which contains energy environments and substance environments); 2. Population ecology, with respect to the variation, the evolution, and the life history of the individual organism and the population; 3. Community ecology, with an eye to the construction, the dynastic, and the sort of the biology community; 4. Ecosystem ecology, with respect to the basic characters of the ecosystem, the energy flow, the material cycle, and the classification of the ecosystem existing on the Earth; and 5. Application ecology, which describes the environmental protection, the species diversity and the control of pests.

default.zh: 生物工程工艺设计是生物工程专业的一门专业基础课，以生物工艺、生物工程的基本原理、GMP和工程学相关科学理论和工程技术为基础，综合性、实践性很强的应用性工程学科。课程教学目的是培养学生具备生物工程工厂设计的工程能力和工程素质，结合生产实习和毕业设计，完成工程师的综合性基本训练。掌握工艺设计及相关设计过程的内容、特点及表示方法、规范和相关标准等知识，熟悉工艺设计的成果 — 设计说明书和与各设计类别交流的工程语言 — 工艺设计图的知识。
default.en: This course is a special preliminary course of bioengineering major. It’s a comprehensive, practical engineering disciplines based on the fundamental principles of bio-technology, scientific theory and engineering technology. The purpose is to develop the students’ ability of processing design of bioengineering factory and professional quality. The students should master the content, characteristics, methods, norms and standards of processing design and related design, familiar with the design instruction as the result of process design, and the knowledge of Process Flow Diagram（PFD）, layout scheme and etc.

default.zh: “空间生物学”主要介绍空间生物学的发展简史、空间生物学的研究方法；微重力环境对细胞形态、结构、生理和遗传和发育的影响，微重力生物学效应的基本原理及在生物学中的应用；空间环境中的辐射条件以及辐射的生物学效应，空间辐射环境引起机体分子水平、细胞水平和整体水平变化规律；受控生态系统的组成及其研究进展；人类对环境的反应和适应；空间生物学研究进展等，为今后有关此方面的科研打下基础。
default.en: In the course of space biology, the history and research methods, the biological effects of microgravity on cell morphology, structure, physiology, genetics and development, the mechanism of biology effects of microgravity and the use in the biological study will be introduced. The radiation situation in space and its biological effects, the changes on molecular, cells and organisms, the composition of controlled ecological life support system and its research progress, human response and adaptation to space environment, and the latest research work, will also be discussed. This course will give basic knowledge and help the study of space biology.

default.zh: 生物信息学是一门交叉学科，致力于运用计算机科学、信息科学、统计学、认知科学以及人机交互等方法，解决生物学、基因组科学、遗传学以及医学研究领域的实践问题。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握生物信息学的概念与研究对象，生物数据分析的基本原理和方法。在对众多处理生物数据的解决方法和解决问题思路有清晰的认识后，学生具备用一定的方法处理生物数据，从中发现新颖、有用知识的基本能力；熟悉并且利用Internet，AI和生物信息学分析软件进行生物数据库查询，序列比对，对基因组注释、微阵列数据、新一代测序数据进行系统性分析。
default.en: Bioinformatics is a broad discipline that is dedicated to the research and application of computer science, information science, statistics, cognitive science, and human-computer interaction in the fields of biology, genomic science, genetics, and medical research. Through this course, students will grasp the concepts and research objects of bioinformatics, as well as the basic principles and methods of biological data analysis. After having a clear understanding of the various methods and problem-solving approaches for processing biological data, students will have the basic ability to process biological data using certain methods and discover novel and useful knowledge. They will also become familiar with and utilize the Internet, AI, and bioinformatics analysis software to query biological databases, perform sequence alignments, and systematically analyze genomic annotations, microarray data, and next-generation sequencing data.

default.zh: 专业思维训练课程旨在培养学生的科学分析与批判性思维能力，重点聚焦细胞生物学和生物化学领域。通过案例研究、实验设计与文献分析，学生将掌握基础理论并提升科研逻辑。课程涵盖细胞结构、代谢途径、分子机制等核心内容，为未来学术研究或职业发展奠定坚实基础。
default.en: The Professional Thinking Training course cultivates students' scientific analysis and critical thinking skills, focusing on cell biology and biochemistry. Through case studies, experimental design, and literature analysis, students gain foundational knowledge and enhance research logic. Key topics include cell structure, metabolic pathways, and molecular mechanisms, preparing them for academic or career advancement.

default.zh: 《AI＋生物信息学》是一门面向精准医学前沿的交叉学科课程，聚焦人工智能技术在癌症研究中的创新应用，涵盖癌症遗传变异识别、表观遗传调控、病理图像分析、免疫分型及预后评估五大核心领域。课程以“解决真实临床问题”为导向，深度融合癌症生物学机理与AI核心技术（如深度学习、图神经网络、多模态数据整合），引导学生从国际癌症数据库中获取多组学数据，通过人工智能算法的实践掌握从基因变异检测到临床预后建模的全方面的生物信息分析技能。 课程内容紧密贴合目前的行业需求，例如：利用卷积神经网络（CNN）实现病理切片中肿瘤的自动分级与分子亚型预测；结合单细胞转录组数据与图神经网络解析肿瘤免疫微环境的动态特征；集成生存分析与深度学习构建个体化预后评估系统。教学中引入真实临床案例与Kaggle竞赛模式，辅以可解释性AI工具（如SHAP、Grad-CAM）和伦理讨论，培养学生“技术落地需兼顾科学性与社会价值”的跨学科思维。 通过本课程的学习，学生不仅能熟练运用Python、PyTorch等工具完成AI建模，更能将算法结果转化为生物学发现，为未来从事癌症精准医疗、AI制药或生物信息学研究奠定坚实基础。适合生物信息学、计算机科学、生物医学工程及临床医学等领域的高年级本科生学习。 本课程共32个学时，包括理论学习共24学时和8学时的上机实验。理论部分包括智能药物设计基础；AI驱动的靶点发现；生成式AI与分子设计；虚拟筛选与分子对接；生物大分子药物设计和经典智能药物研发案例分析。实验课共8学时，包括分子对接与虚拟筛选和AI驱动药物生成,通过上机实验锻炼学生的基础技能，培养学生应用所学知识观察、分析、综合和独立解决问题的能力。
default.en: AI + Bioinformatics is an interdisciplinary course on the frontiers of precision medicine, focusing on innovative applications of artificial intelligence in cancer research, it covers five core areas: cancer genetic variation identification, epigenetic regulation, pathological image analysis, immunophenotyping and prognosis evaluation. The course is guided by“Solving real clinical problems” and deeply integrates cancer biological mechanisms with core AI technologies (such as deep learning, graph neural networks, and multimodal data integration) , students are guided to obtain multi-omics data from the international cancer database, and master all aspects of bioinformatics analysis skills from gene variant detection to clinical prognosis modeling through the practice of artificial intelligence algorithms. The course content is tailored to current industry needs, such as the use of convolutional neural network (CNN) for automatic grading and molecular subtype prediction of tumors in pathological sections; The dynamic characteristics of tumor immune microenvironment were analyzed by combining single-cell transcriptome data with graph neural network. An individualized prognosis evaluation system was constructed by integrating survival analysis and deep learning. Real clinical cases and Kaggle competition models were introduced in the teaching, supplemented by interpretable AI tools (e.g. Shap, Grad-CAM) and ethical discussions, and the results were analyzed, cultivating students' interdisciplinary thinking of“Technology landing needs to take into account scientific nature and social value”. Through the study of this course, students can not only skillfully use Python, PyTorch and other tools to complete AI modeling, but also transform the algorithm results into biological discoveries, for the future in cancer precision medicine, AI pharmaceutical or bioinformatics research to lay a solid foundation. It is suitable for senior undergraduates in bioinformatics, computer science, biomedical engineering and clinical medicine. This course has 32 class hours, including 24 class hours of theory study and 8 class hours of computer experiment. The theoretical part includes the basis of intelligent drug design, AI-driven target discovery, generative AI and molecular design, virtual screening and molecular docking, biomacromolecular drug design and case analysis of classical intelligent drug research and development. The experimental class consists of 8 class hours, including molecular docking and virtual screening and AI-driven drug generation. The basic skills of students are trained through computer experiments, to develop students' ability to observe, analyze, synthesize and solve problems independently.

default.zh: 多尺度结构生物学与分子机器是物理学、化学与生物学深度交叉的前沿领域，旨在从原子、分子到细胞等多个时空尺度阐明生物大分子的结构、动态与功能，揭示分子机器高效运转的内在机理。本课程致力于培养学生从结构生物学与物理化学原理出发，在多尺度上理解生物问题乃至生命现象的思维习惯，引领学生适应生命科学日益定量化、多学科交融的发展趋势。 课程兼顾基础与前沿，重点介绍多尺度结构生物学的基本概念、研究方法与典型分子机器的工作机制。主要内容包括：蛋白质、核酸等生物大分子的三维结构与折叠原理；X射线晶体学、冷冻电镜、核磁共振及分子动力学模拟等多尺度结构解析与预测方法；驱动蛋白、ATP合酶、核糖体、分子伴侣等代表性分子机器的结构功能与能量转化机理；膜通道、转运蛋白及G蛋白偶联受体等跨膜信号机器；以及分子机器在肌肉收缩、胞内运输、突触传递等生理过程中的多尺度整合。同时，课程将简要涉及单分子操纵、荧光超分辨、生物分子电子与纳米传感等前沿技术。 通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握运用现代物理、化学和计算工具研究生物大分子与分子机器的方法，形成从多尺度结构视角分析生物学现象的能力，学会以交叉学科思维解析生命过程的分子逻辑，切实提升从更高维度提出问题、分析问题与创新解决问题的能力。
default.en: Multiscale Structural Biology and Molecular Machines explores how life works at every level—from atoms and molecules to whole cells. We study the structure, motion, and function of biomolecules and uncover how molecular machines operate so efficiently. This course encourages students to think across scales, combining ideas from physics, chemistry, and biology, and to approach life sciences in a quantitative, interdisciplinary way. We cover both the basics and the latest discoveries. Topics include the 3D structures and folding of proteins and nucleic acids; methods like X-ray crystallography, cryo-EM, NMR, and molecular simulations; key molecular machines such as motor proteins, ATP synthase, ribosomes, and chaperones; membrane channels, transporters, and GPCRs; and how these machines work together in processes like muscle contraction, intracellular transport, and nerve signaling. We’ll also introduce advanced tools like single-molecule experiments, super-resolution microscopy, and nanoscale biosensors. By the end of the course, students will know how to use modern physical, chemical, and computational tools to study biomolecules and molecular machines. They will learn to analyze biological systems from a multiscale perspective and think across disciplines, improving their ability to ask smart questions, analyze problems, and develop innovative solutions.

default.zh: 纳米仿生化学与疾病诊断是化学和纳米科学的结合。纳米化学与结构单元的合成有关，后者取决于尺寸、表面、形状和缺陷性质。纳米结构的合成和构建都与纳米化学和其他纳米科学领域具有相同的核心概念，材料在纳米级尺寸上发生化学反应时。主要是在纳米级结构上的化学修饰主要取决于材料组成，表面，尺寸和形状。进一步纳米材料具有的功能缺陷对材料的电子、光子、医学或生物分析问题起重要作用，而这些功能可以通过化学方法来调控，本课程主要介绍相关的碳纳米材料化学包括碳量子点的尺寸与物理性能、化学性能和生物应用的调控，及其常用的一些碳量子点的制备方和修饰，改性方法。碳纳米管的种类及其相关的制备方法和功能调控等技术及其在生物医学中的应用。石墨烯，富勒烯的制备方法和功能调控，以及在生物医学中的相关应用；不同形貌纳米金（包括金纳米球，金纳米棒及其各种不规则形貌）的制备方法，不同形貌纳米金的光学性质和光热转化效应及其形貌对其光学性能和光热性能的调控机制，纳米金的修饰方法和生物医学中的相关应用；介绍量子点的概念，种类及其制备方法，发光特性以及在生物医学中的应用。
default.en: Nanobionics and Disease Diagnosis is the combination of chemistry and nanoscience. Nanochemistry is related to the synthesis of structural units, which depend on size, surface, shape, and defect properties. The synthesis and construction of nanostructures share the same core concepts as nanochemistry and other nanoscience fields, where materials undergo chemical reactions at the nanoscale. The chemical modification on nanoscale structures mainly depends on material composition, surface, size, and shape. The functional defects of further nanomaterials play an important role in the electronic, photonic, medical, or biological analysis of materials, and these functions can be regulated through chemical methods. This course mainly introduces the related carbon nanomaterial chemistry, including the size and physical properties, chemical properties, and biological application regulation of carbon quantum dots, as well as some commonly used preparation and modification methods of carbon quantum dots. The types of carbon nanotubes and their related preparation methods and functional regulation technologies, as well as their applications in biomedicine. Preparation methods and functional regulation of graphene and fullerene, as well as related applications in biomedicine; The preparation methods of different morphologies of gold nanoparticles (including gold nanospheres, gold nanorods, and various irregular morphologies), the optical properties and photothermal conversion effects of different morphologies of gold nanoparticles, as well as the regulatory mechanisms of their morphology on their optical and photothermal properties, the modification methods of gold nanoparticles, and related applications in biomedicine; Introduce the concept, types, preparation methods, luminescent properties, and applications in biomedicine of quantum dots.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22LS32041 课程名称：生物化学与生物智造 总学时：16 理论学时：16 实验学时：0 上机学时：0 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1 开课单位：生命科学与技术学院学院 授课对象：本科生 开课学期：26秋 先修课程：无 二、课程简介 《生物化学与生物智造》是融合生物工程、生物制药、生物与医药、合成生物学等相关专业的专业课程，融合经典生物化学基础理论与现代生物智造前沿技术，打通生命科学基础原理与产业化应用的壁垒。课程首先系统讲解生物大分子（蛋白质、核酸、糖类、脂质）的结构、理化性质与生物学功能，阐释生物体物质代谢、能量代谢及遗传信息传递与调控的核心规律，夯实学生分子层面解析生命现象的理论基础。在此基础上，课程衔接现代生物智造产业体系，聚焦生物分子改造、代谢工程调控、生物催化转化、生物医药创制、功能性生物材料制备等核心技术，结合合成生物学、精准生物制造、生物医用制剂研发等前沿方向，讲解蛋白药物、核酸制剂、生物纳米材料、靶向制剂等生物前沿领域的最新进展。本课程坚持基础理论+工程应用+产业前沿三位一体的教学模式，旨在帮助学生掌握生物化学核心知识体系，理解生物智造的底层生化原理，熟悉现代生物制造的关键技术与应用场景，培养学生运用生化理论分析、解决生物智造研发、生产中的实际问题的能力，为学生后续开展生物药物研发、生物材料创制、合成生物制造等科研与产业工作奠定扎实的理论与应用基础。
default.en: 1. General Information Course Code：22LS32041 Course Title：Biochemistry and Biomanufacturing Credit Hours：16 Lecture：16 Lab：0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：1 Offering Department: School of Life Science and Technology Students: Undergraduate Students Term: 2026 Fall Prerequisites: None 2. Course Description Biochemistry and Bio-manufacturing is a specialized course for majors including bioengineering, biopharmaceuticals, Biology and Medicine, and synthetic biology. It integrates classic fundamental biochemistry theories with cutting-edge modern bio-manufacturing technologies, breaking down the barriers between basic life science principles and industrial applications. This course systematically expounds the structure, physicochemical properties and biological functions of biomacromolecules (proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids), and illustrates substance metabolism, energy metabolism, as well as the transmission and regulation of genetic information in organisms, consolidating students’ theoretical foundation for analyzing life phenomena at the molecular level. On this basis, the course interfaces with the modern bio-manufacturing industrial system and focuses on core technologies such as biomolecular modification, metabolic engineering regulation, biocatalytic transformation, biomedical development, and functional biomaterial preparation. Combined with frontier research directions including synthetic biology, precision bio-manufacturing and biomedical formulation development, this course presents the latest advances in cutting-edge biological fields represented by protein drugs, nucleic acid preparations, biological nanomaterials, and targeted formulations. Adhering to the three-in-one teaching model of fundamental theory, engineering application and industrial frontier, this course aims to equip students with a comprehensive core knowledge system of biochemistry and an in-depth understanding of the underlying biochemical principles of bio-manufacturing, while familiarizing them with key technologies and application scenarios of modern bio-manufacturing. It cultivates students’ competence to analyze and resolve practical problems in the research, development and production processes of bio-manufacturing, thereby laying a solid theoretical and applied foundation for students’ future scientific research and industrial practice in biopharmaceutical R&D, biomaterial creation, and synthetic bio-manufacturing.

default.zh: 通过毕业设计的训练，进一步深化和扩展所学的基础知识、专业知识，提高独立动手实验能力；提高自学能力和独立分析解决问题的能力。使学生受到工程师的基本训练，培养其开展科学研究工作的初步能力。培养学生协作精神，创新精神；树立正确的人生观、价值观，在思想政治素质方面得到进一步的提高。培养学生综合运用所学知识，分析和解决生命科学领域相关问题的能力。
default.en: Through the training of graduation project, we can further deepen and expand the basic knowledge and professional knowledge, improve the ability of independent hands-on experiment, and improve the ability of self-study and independent analysis and problem-solving. The students will receive the basic training of engineers and develop their preliminary ability to carry out scientific research. We should cultivate students' spirit of cooperation and innovation, establish correct outlook on life and values, and further improve their ideological and political quality.Cultivate the ability of students to comprehensively apply their knowledge, analyze and solve related problems in the field of life sciences.

default.zh: 生产实习是生物技术与生物工程专业的必修课，是在完成全部基础课程和专业课程的学习后所进行的实践环节，是对学生大学学习四年的专业能力和综合素质的一次全面检验。在生产实习过生中，学生有机会到生物制药企业、生物科技公司或生命科学领域相关研究结构参观和驻场实习。 生产实习是培养学生适应社会、锻炼学生综合技能的重要实践性环节，是提高教学质量和办学水平的重要保证。通过生产实习，学生将加深对理论知识的理解，进一步熟悉生物技术与生物工程的基本操作方法，提高实践能力、动手能力、解决问题和分析问题的能力。通过生产实习，学生可以了解生物技术、生物工程领域的就业状态，激励学生为自己的人生职业规划做准备。
default.en: The production practice is a required course for the students of biotechnology and biological engineering. It is the practice training after finishing the basic courses and specialized courses. It is a comprehensive examination of the student’s comprehensive quality in the four years university life. In the course of production practice, students have the opportunity to go to biopharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies or life sciences related research structures, visits and residency practice. Production practice is an important practical link to train students to adapt to society and to train students' comprehensive skills. It is also an important guarantee to improve the teaching quality. In the production practice, students will deepen the understanding of theoretical knowledge, familiar with the basic operation method of biological technology. And students will increase the practice ability to solve problem. Through the production practice, students can understand the employment environment of biotechnology and Bioengineering. It will motivate students to prepare for their life career planning.

default.zh: 植物认知实习是植物生物学教学中不可分割的重要组成部分，不仅是对理论知识的验证和巩固，是对课堂知识的补充和深化，同时也是对学生综合素质的全面锻炼和提高。本课程选择尚志市帽儿山为实习地点，该地区境内景观多样，生境类型十分丰富。通过带领学生识别该地区典型植物、制作标本以及认识不同环境的特点，使学生更多地了解大自然，认识大自然中千姿百态的植物，还对于激发学生学习兴趣，培养学生观察能力、创新思维和动手能力具有重要的意义。
default.en: Plant cognitive practice is an inseparable and important part of plant biology teaching. It is not only the verification and consolidation of theoretical knowledge, the supplement and deepening of classroom knowledge, but also the comprehensive training and improvement of students' comprehensive quality. This course is chosen as the practice site in Maoer Hill, Shangzhi City, where the landscape is diverse and the habitat type is very rich. By leading students to identify typical plants in the area, to produce specimens and to understand the characteristics of different environments, so that students learn more about nature, know the diversity of nature plants. It also has great significance to stimulate students’ interest in learning, training students to observe, innovative thinking and Hands-on ability.

default.zh: 生态学是研究生物有机体及其周围环境相互关系的科学，是生命科学在宏观层面的体现。在一个生态系统中，各物种不是杂乱堆积的，而是构成一个有序的空间格局，他们之间相互依存、相互制约，构成一个有机的整体。这些知识只有在自然环境中，才能够加深理解。 实习一周时间，实习地点为有代表性的北方森林，实习内容包括群落类型的线路调查，群落结构特征调查，群落更新、演替趋势调查，以及相应的统计分析和归纳整理。实践教学是培养大学生实践能力的重要组成部分，生态实习一方面可以巩固和充实课堂教学内容，增强感性认识，拓宽知识领域；另一方面也可以培养学生热爱自然、热爱生命、团队合作、吃苦耐劳的精神，增强独立观察、思考、解决问题的能力，以及野外生存和开展工作的能力，提高学生的综合素质。 随着国家的发展，生态破坏、环境污染受到了越来越多的重视，也成为生态学和环境生态工程的重要内容。生态实习可以直观地观察和研究生态破坏与恢复，了解国家相应的政策法规及其实践表现，也可以触发灵感，引起生态环境保护方面的兴趣，启发结合生命科学其他学科知识解决生态环境问题的思路，拓展将来研究与工作的方向。
default.en: Ecology is a science that studies the relationship between biological organisms and their surroundings, and is the embodiment of life science at the macro level. In an ecosystem, each species is not cluttered and stacked, but constitutes an orderly spatial pattern, and they are interdependent and mutually restricted to form an organic whole. These knowledge can only be deepened in the natural environment. The practice lasted for one week, and the practice site was a representative boreal forest. The practice contents included the investigation of community type lines, community structure characteristics, community renewal, succession trend, and corresponding statistical analysis and induction. Practical teaching is an important part of cultivating college students' practical ability. On the one hand, ecological practice can consolidate and enrich classroom teaching content, enhance perceptual understanding and broaden knowledge field; On the other hand, it can also cultivate students' love of nature, love of life, teamwork, hard-working spirit, enhance the ability of independent observation, thinking, problem solving, as well as the ability to survive and work in the field, and improve the comprehensive quality of students. With the development of the country, ecological damage and environmental pollution have been paid more and more attention, and have also become an important part of ecology and environmental ecological engineering. Ecological practice can intuitively observe and study ecological damage and restoration, understand the corresponding national policies and regulations and their practical performance, trigger inspiration, arouse interest in ecological environmental protection, inspire ideas to solve ecological environmental problems by combining knowledge of other disciplines of life science, and expand the direction of future research and work.

default.zh: 课程包含极限、一元微分学、一元积分学、微分方程几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.函数：函数及其性质，复合函数，初等函数。 2.极限与连续：极限定义，极限的性质与运算法则，无穷小与无穷大，函数的连续性。 3.导数与微分：导数的基本公式与四则运算法则，反函数与复合函数求导法则，隐函数与参数式函数求导法则，高阶导数，微分。 4.微分中值定理：微分中值定理，洛必达法则，泰勒公式。 5.不定积分：原函数与不定积分，换元积分法，分部积分法。 6定积分：定积分的定义与性质，微积分基本定理，定积分的换元积分法和分部积分法，反常积分。 7.导数与积分应用：函数的极值与最大（小）值，函数的分析作图法，曲线的弧长与弧微分，曲率，定积分的应用。 8.微分方程：一阶微分方程，几种可积的高阶微分方程。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including limit, unitary differential calculus, unitary integral calculus, differential equation： 1. Functions: Functions and their properties, composite functions, elementary functions. 2. Limits and continuity: Definition of limit, limit properties and laws, infinities and infinitesimals, continuity. 3. Derivatives and differentials: Differentiation formulas and rules, chain rule, implicit differentiation, higher derivatives, differentials. 4. Mean value theorem: Mean value theorem of differentials, L`hospital rule, Taylor formula. 5. Infinite integrals: Antiderivatives and infinite integrals, substitution rule, integration by parts. 6. Definite integrals: Definition and properties of definite integral, fundamental theorem of calculus, substitution rule, integration by parts, improper integrals. 7. Applications of differentiation and integration: Maximum and minimum values, curve sketching, arc length and differential of arc length, curvature, applications of integration. 8. Differential equations: First-order differential equations, some integrable higher-order differential equations.

default.zh: 课程包含多元微分学、多元积分学、微分方程及无穷级数几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.线性微分方程。 2.多元函数微分学：偏导数与高阶偏导数，全微分，复合函数求导法，隐函数求导法，偏导数的几何应用，多元函数的泰勒公式与极值，方向导数与梯度。 3.多元函数积分学：黎曼积分定义，二重积分，三重积分，第一型曲线积分，第一型曲面积分，黎曼积分的应用。 4.第二型曲线积分与第二型曲面积分：向量场，第二型曲线积分，格林公式，第二型曲面积分，高斯公式，通量与散度，斯托克斯公式，环量与旋度。 5.无穷级数：无穷级数及其性质，正项级数，任意项级数，函数项级数，幂级数，傅里叶级数。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including multivariate differential calculus, multivariate integral calculus, differential equation and infinite series： 1. linear differential equations. 2. Multivariable differential calculus: Partial derivatives and higher partial derivatives, total differentials, chain rule, implicit differentiation, applications of partial derivatives to geometry, Taylor formula and extreme values, directional derivatives and gradients. 3. Multivariable integral calculus: Definition of Riemann integrals, double integrals, triple integrals, line integrals, surface integrals, applications of Riemann integrals. 4.Infinite series: Infinite series and its properties, positive series, arbitrary series, function series, power series, Fourier series.

default.zh: 课程包含极限、一元微分学、一元积分学、微分方程几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.函数：函数及其性质，复合函数，初等函数。 2.极限与连续：极限定义，极限的性质与运算法则，无穷小与无穷大，函数的连续性。 3.导数与微分：导数的基本公式与四则运算法则，反函数与复合函数求导法则，隐函数与参数式函数求导法则，高阶导数，微分。 4.微分中值定理：微分中值定理，洛必达法则，泰勒公式。 5.不定积分：原函数与不定积分，换元积分法，分部积分法。 6定积分：定积分的定义与性质，微积分基本定理，定积分的换元积分法和分部积分法，反常积分。 7.导数与积分应用：函数的极值与最大（小）值，函数的分析作图法，曲线的弧长与弧微分，曲率，定积分的应用。 8.微分方程：一阶微分方程，几种可积的高阶微分方程。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including limit, unitary differential calculus, unitary integral calculus, differential equation： 1. Functions: Functions and their properties, composite functions, elementary functions. 2. Limits and continuity: Definition of limit, limit properties and laws, infinities and infinitesimals, continuity. 3. Derivatives and differentials: Differentiation formulas and rules, chain rule, implicit differentiation, higher derivatives, differentials. 4. Mean value theorem: Mean value theorem of differentials, L`hospital rule, Taylor formula. 5. Infinite integrals: Antiderivatives and infinite integrals, substitution rule, integration by parts. 6. Definite integrals: Definition and properties of definite integral, fundamental theorem of calculus, substitution rule, integration by parts, improper integrals. 7. Applications of differentiation and integration: Maximum and minimum values, curve sketching, arc length and differential of arc length, curvature, applications of integration. 8. Differential equations: First-order differential equations, some integrable higher-order differential equations.

default.zh: 课程包含多元微分学、多元积分学、微分方程及无穷级数几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.线性微分方程。 2.多元函数微分学：偏导数与高阶偏导数，全微分，复合函数求导法，隐函数求导法，偏导数的几何应用，多元函数的泰勒公式与极值，方向导数与梯度。 3.多元函数积分学：黎曼积分定义，二重积分，三重积分，第一型曲线积分，第一型曲面积分，黎曼积分的应用。 4.第二型曲线积分与第二型曲面积分：向量场，第二型曲线积分，格林公式，第二型曲面积分，高斯公式，通量与散度，斯托克斯公式，环量与旋度。 5.无穷级数：无穷级数及其性质，正项级数，任意项级数，函数项级数，幂级数，傅里叶级数。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including multivariate differential calculus, multivariate integral calculus, differential equation and infinite series： 1. linear differential equations. 2. Multivariable differential calculus: Partial derivatives and higher partial derivatives, total differentials, chain rule, implicit differentiation, applications of partial derivatives to geometry, Taylor formula and extreme values, directional derivatives and gradients. 3. Multivariable integral calculus: Definition of Riemann integrals, double integrals, triple integrals, line integrals, surface integrals, applications of Riemann integrals. 4.Infinite series: Infinite series and its properties, positive series, arbitrary series, function series, power series, Fourier series.

default.zh: 《建筑数学》包含微积分、线性代数及概率论的基本内容，主要通过课程内容让学生了解相关内容的应用。其中知识点包含 1.极限概念、导数概念及应用，微积分基本定理； 2.行列式、矩阵、克莱姆法则； 3.全概率公式、贝叶斯公式、方差、正态分布等。
default.en: Architectural arts mathematics contains the basic contents of calculus, linear algebra and probability theory, mainly through the course content to let students understand the application of relevant contents. The knowledge points include: 1. Limit concept, derivative concept and application, basic theorem of calculus; 2. Determinant, matrix and Clem's law; 3. Full probability formula, Bayesian formula, variance, normal distribution, etc.

default.zh: 《文科数学》包含微积分、线性代数及概率论的基本内容，主要通过课程内容让学生了解相关内容的应用。其中知识点包含 1.极限概念、导数概念及应用，微积分基本定理； 2.行列式、矩阵、克莱姆法则； 3.全概率公式、贝叶斯公式、方差、正态分布等。
default.en: Liberal arts mathematics contains the basic contents of calculus, linear algebra and probability theory, mainly through the course content to let students understand the application of relevant contents. The knowledge points include: 1. Limit concept, derivative concept and application, basic theorem of calculus; 2. Determinant, matrix and Clem's law; 3. Full probability formula, Bayesian formula, variance, normal distribution, etc.

default.zh: 该课程将系统介绍函数、极限、连续；一元函数微积分学；行列式、矩阵运算；离散概率以及统计学的基本知识，为后续课程奠定必要的数学基础。通过课程的学习，学生应具备以下能力：1. 能够将数学、自然科学、工程基础和专业知识用于解决复杂工程问题。2. 能够应用数学、自然科学和工程科学的基本原理，识别、表达、并通过文献研究分析复杂工程问题，以获得有效结论。3. 能够设计针对复杂工程问题的解决方案，设计满足特定需求的系统、单元（部件）或工艺流程，并能够在设计环节中体现创新意识。4. 能够基于科学原理并采用科学方法对复杂工程问题进行研究，包括设计实验、分析与解释数据、并通过信息综合得到合理有效的结论。5. 能够针对复杂工程问题，开发、选择与使用恰当的技术、资源、现代工程工具和信息技术工具，包括对复杂工程问题的预测与模拟，并能够理解其局限性。
default.en: This course provides a systematic introduction to functions, limits, continuity; single-variable calculus; determinants and matrix operations; discrete probability; and the basic knowledge of statistics, laying the necessary mathematical foundation for subsequent courses. Through this course, students are expected to acquire the following abilities: 1.Ability to apply mathematics, natural sciences, engineering fundamentals, and specialized knowledge to solve complex engineering problems. 2.Ability to apply the basic principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences to identify, formulate, and analyze complex engineering problems through literature research, in order to obtain effective conclusions. 3.Ability to design solutions for complex engineering problems, including systems, components, or processes that meet specific requirements, and to demonstrate innovative awareness in the design process. 4.Ability to conduct research on complex engineering problems based on scientific principles and methods, including designing experiments, analyzing and interpreting data, and synthesizing information to reach reasonable and effective conclusions. 5.Ability to develop, select, and use appropriate techniques, resources, modern engineering tools, and information technology tools for complex engineering problems, including prediction and simulation, while understanding their limitations.

default.zh: 课程包含极限、一元微分学、一元积分学、微分方程几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.函数：函数及其性质，复合函数，初等函数。 2.极限与连续：极限定义，极限的性质与运算法则，无穷小与无穷大，函数的连续性。 3.导数与微分：导数的基本公式与四则运算法则，反函数与复合函数求导法则，隐函数与参数式函数求导法则，高阶导数，微分。 4.微分中值定理：微分中值定理，洛必达法则，泰勒公式。 5.不定积分：原函数与不定积分，换元积分法，分部积分法。 6定积分：定积分的定义与性质，微积分基本定理，定积分的换元积分法和分部积分法，反常积分。 7.导数与积分应用：函数的极值与最大（小）值，函数的分析作图法，曲线的弧长与弧微分，曲率，定积分的应用。 8.微分方程：一阶微分方程，几种可积的高阶微分方程。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including limit, unitary differential calculus, unitary integral calculus, differential equation： 1. Functions: Functions and their properties, composite functions, elementary functions. 2. Limits and continuity: Definition of limit, limit properties and laws, infinities and infinitesimals, continuity. 3. Derivatives and differentials: Differentiation formulas and rules, chain rule, implicit differentiation, higher derivatives, differentials. 4. Mean value theorem: Mean value theorem of differentials, L`hospital rule, Taylor formula. 5. Infinite integrals: Antiderivatives and infinite integrals, substitution rule, integration by parts. 6. Definite integrals: Definition and properties of definite integral, fundamental theorem of calculus, substitution rule, integration by parts, improper integrals. 7. Applications of differentiation and integration: Maximum and minimum values, curve sketching, arc length and differential of arc length, curvature, applications of integration. 8. Differential equations: First-order differential equations, some integrable higher-order differential equations.

default.zh: 课程包含多元微分学、多元积分学、微分方程及无穷级数几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.线性微分方程。 2.多元函数微分学：偏导数与高阶偏导数，全微分，复合函数求导法，隐函数求导法，偏导数的几何应用，多元函数的泰勒公式与极值，方向导数与梯度。 3.多元函数积分学：黎曼积分定义，二重积分，三重积分，第一型曲线积分，第一型曲面积分，黎曼积分的应用。 4.第二型曲线积分与第二型曲面积分：向量场，第二型曲线积分，格林公式，第二型曲面积分，高斯公式，通量与散度，斯托克斯公式，环量与旋度。 5.无穷级数：无穷级数及其性质，正项级数，任意项级数，函数项级数，幂级数，傅里叶级数。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including multivariate differential calculus, multivariate integral calculus, differential equation and infinite series： 1. linear differential equations. 2. Multivariable differential calculus: Partial derivatives and higher partial derivatives, total differentials, chain rule, implicit differentiation, applications of partial derivatives to geometry, Taylor formula and extreme values, directional derivatives and gradients. 3. Multivariable integral calculus: Definition of Riemann integrals, double integrals, triple integrals, line integrals, surface integrals, applications of Riemann integrals. 4.Infinite series: Infinite series and its properties, positive series, arbitrary series, function series, power series, Fourier series.

default.zh: 本课程是为我校航天与自动化集群开设的必修自然科学基础理论课程，系统介绍线性代数与空间解析几何的基本理论和方法，是线性代数与空间解析几何的有机结合。内容包括：行列式的定义、计算及其性质；矩阵的运算，分块矩阵，矩阵求秩；向量代数，向量坐标，平面与直线的方程及其相互位置关系；n维向量，向量组的线性相关性；向量空间，向量空间的基底、维数、坐标及坐标变换；线性方程组解的结构理论；特征值与特征向量，相似变换，矩阵可相似对角化的条件和相似对角化的方法；二次型理论，讨论二次型的化简，二次曲面及其分类以及与航天和自动化相关的应用案例。 考察方式为累加式，作业及课堂表现占20%，课堂测验占5%，期中考试占15%，期末考试占60%。 课程配有同步MOOC，网址：https://www.icourse163.org/course/HIT-1002117005. 除教学视频和课件，还有章节习题讲解、期末复习等视频和学习资料。
default.en: This course is intended to introduce fundamental methods and concepts of linear algebra and analytic geometry for aerospace and automation engineering students. It is an organic combination of linear algebra and analytic geometry. Topics are usually selected from: the definition of a determinant, computations and properties of determinants; operations of matrices, partitioned matrices and the rank of a matrix; vector algebra, vector coordinates, the equations of planes and lines, and the relations between plans and lines; n-dimensional vectors, linear independence among vectors; vector spaces, the bases, dimensions of vector spaces and changing of basis; the structure of the solution set of a linear system; eigenvalues and eigenvectors, similar transformations, the conditions that determine if a matrix is diagonalizable, and the method of diagonalizing a matrix using eigenvalues and eigenvectors; the theory of quadratic forms, the canonical form of a quadratic form; quadratic surfaces and their classification; applications of linear algebra in aerospace and automation. The grade policy is as following: homework and performance in class 20%, quizzes in class 5%，the midterm exam 15%, and final exam 60%. Course videos, exercise problems and the solutions of review problems are available at: https://www.icourse163.org/course/HIT-1002117005.

default.zh: 概率论与数理统计是研究随机现象统计规律的一门数学学科。 概率论是以数学模型为基础来研究随机现象，并用数学语言描述随机现象，进而研究其基本规律，找出其内在规律，在随机现象和其他数学分支之间架起一座桥梁，利用数学工具和方法来研究随机现象。 数理统计是以概率论为基础，运用概率论和数学方法，研究如何收集具有随机影响的信息和数据，建立适当的数学模型(随机统计模型)，通过统计模型对数据和信息进行统计分析，对问题进行统计推断和决策研究。数理统计是应用数学中最重要和最活跃的学科之一，它已经在自然科学和社会科学中得到了越来越广泛的应用，在国民经济和科学技术中发挥着越来越重要的作用。 随着大数据时代的到来，作为工科本科生，应该具备概率论和数理统计的基础知识，掌握它们的思想和方法以及数据分析能力。本课程突出概率论与数理统计的特点，注重概率论与数理统计思想方法的介绍，重视概率论与数理统计的应用，培养学生随机数学思维的能力。本课程讲授概率论与数理统计的基本概念、随机事件的概率、随机变量及其分布、随机变量的数字特征与极限理论、数据分析、估计问题等内容。
default.en: Probability theory and mathematical statistics is a mathematical discipline to study the statistical laws of random phenomenon. Probability theory is based on mathematical models to random phenomenon, and describes random phenomenon by mathematical language, then to study the basic law, to find out the inherent law, building a bridge random phenomenon and other mathematics branches, using mathematical tools and methods to research random phenomena. Mathematical statistics is based on probability theory, it applies probability theory and mathematical method, researches how to collect information and data with random effects, establishes appropriate mathematical models (random statistical model), statistical analysis of the data and information by the statistical model, to make statistical inference and decision of study on the problem. Mathematical statistics is one of applied Mathematics as the most important and active subject, it has been applied in natural science and Social Science in the more extensive, in the national economy and science and technology in a more and more important role. With the advent of the era of big data, as an engineering undergraduate, we should have the basic knowledge of probability and mathematical statistics, master their ideas and methods and data analysis capabilities. This course highlights the characteristics of probability theory and mathematical statistics, pays attention to the introduction of probability and statistics thought method, attaches importance to the application of probability and statistics, and trains students' ability of random mathematical thinking. default.zh: 《复变函数与积分变换》 是电类及与电有关的理工科专业本科生的必修工程数学课。本课程是理工科院校电类专业本科生的一门基础课，是继微积分、线性代数与空间解析几何课程之后的又一门数学基础课，主要研究复变函数以及积分变换的基本理论和有关方法。它的理论和方法不仅在数学的许多分支中，而且在其它自然科学和各种工程技术领域中均有着广泛的应用。 本课程分两部分： 第一部分主要研究复变函数中的基本理论以及有关的工程技术中的常用数学方法， 重点讲授解析函数的微积分理论、 泰勒级数及洛朗级数展开、留数的计算及应用。 第二部分是积分变换理论内容，主要介绍傅立叶积分变换及其有关方法， 着重讲授相关性质和变换在工程中的应用。 通过本课程的学习，学生不仅能学到复变函数与积分变换中的基本理论及工程技术中的常用数学方法，同时还可以巩固和复习微积分等基础知识，为学习有关的后续课程和进一步扩大数学知识面奠定必要的数学基础；也使学生提高了抽象思维能力、逻辑推理能力、空间想象能力以及科学创新能力。
default.en: The course, Complex Function and Integral Transformation, is a compulsory course of Engineering Mathematics for undergraduate students majoring in Electrical and other Science and Engineering related with Electrical. As a basic course for undergraduate students majoring in Electrical Science and Engineering College, it is a basic Mathematics class after Calculus, Linear Algebra and Space Analytic Geometry, which mainly studies the complex function and integral transform basic theory and related methods. Its theory and method are widely used not only in many branches of Mathematics, but also in other natural science and various of Engineering Technology. The main content of this course is divided into two parts. The first part mainly studies the basic theory of complex variable function and common mathematical methods used in Engineering Technology, which focus on the calculus theory of analytic function, the expansion of Taylor series and Laurent series, the calculation and application of the residue. The second part is about the theory of Integral Transformation. It mainly introduces the Fourier Integral Transform and related methods, which focuses on related properties and applications of transformation in engineering. By studying this course, students can not only learn the basic theory of Complex Function and Integral Transformation and the common mathematical methods in Engineering Technology, but also consolidate and review basic knowledge of Calculus. Then, it help students to lay the necessary mathematical foundation for the following study of relevant courses and the mathematical knowledge. Meanwhile, it also improves the students' ability of abstract thinking, logical reasoning, spatial imagination and scientific creativity.

default.zh: 最优化方法包含内容十分广泛。通过本课程的学习，要求学生牢固掌握线性优化、非线性优化的基本理论和方法，培养应用最优化方法来解决实际问题的能力，了解如何从实际问题中建立相应的数学模型。本课程内容包括：优化建模，优化理论和方法，主要知识点；凸集与凸函数相关理论，线性规划模型、理论与算法，非线性优化模型、最优性条件、理论与算法。
default.en: Methods of Optimization is an important part of the operations research, contains a wide range of content. Through the course of learning, the students should make a firm grasp of linear optimization、basic theories and methods of nonlinear optimization. Cultivate the ability of the application of optimization methods to solve practical problems, learning how to establish a corresponding mathematical programming model from the actual problem. This course is intended to introduce modeling in optimization, theories and methods of optimization. Topics are usually selected from: convex sets and convex functions, foundational theories, linear programming models, theories and algorithms, nonlinear programming models, theories and algorithms, optimality conditions.

default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including multivariate differential calculus, multivariate integral calculus, differential equation and infinite series： 1. linear differential equations. 2. Multivariable differential calculus: Partial derivatives and higher partial derivatives, total differentials, chain rule, implicit differentiation, applications of partial derivatives to geometry, Taylor formula and extreme values, directional derivatives and gradients. 3. Multivariable integral calculus: Definition of Riemann integrals, double integrals, triple integrals, line integrals, surface integrals, applications of Riemann integrals. 4.Infinite series: Infinite series and its properties, positive series, arbitrary series, function series, power series, Fourier series.

default.zh: 《复变函数与积分变换A》 是电类及与电有关的理工科专业本科生的必修工程数学课。本课程是理工科院校电类专业本科生的一门基础课，是继微积分、线性代数与空间解析几何课程之后的又一门数学基础课，主要研究复变函数以及积分变换的基本理论和有关方法。它的理论和方法不仅在数学的许多分支中，而且在其它自然科学和各种工程技术领域中均有着广泛的应用。 本课程分两部分： 第一部分主要研究复变函数中的基本理论以及有关的工程技术中的常用数学方法， 重点讲授解析函数的微积分理论、 泰勒级数及洛朗级数展开、留数的计算及应用，通过初等函数的映射特点，给出保形映射的应用等。 第二部分是积分变换理论内容，主要介绍傅立叶积分变换、拉普拉斯变换及其有关方法， 着重讲授相关性质和变换在工程中的应用。通过本课程的学习，学生不仅能学到复变函数与积分变换中的基本理论及工程技术中的常用数学方法，同时还可以巩固和复习微积分等基础知识，为学习有关的后续课程和进一步扩大数学知识面奠定必要的数学基础。 通过本课程的学习，也使学生提高了抽象思维能力、逻辑推理能力、空间想象能力以及科学创新能力。
default.en: The course, Complex Function and Integral Transformation Series A, is a compulsory course of Engineering Mathematics for undergraduate students majoring in Electrical and other Science and Engineering related with Electrical. As a basic course for undergraduate students majoring in Electrical Science and Engineering College, it is a basic Mathematics class after Calculus, Linear Algebra and Space Analytic Geometry, which mainly studies the complex function and integral transform basic theory and related methods. Its theory and method are widely used not only in many branches of Mathematics, but also in other natural science and various of Engineering Technology. The main content of this course is divided into two parts. The first part mainly studies the basic theory of complex variable function and common mathematical methods used in Engineering Technology, which focus on the calculus theory of analytic function, the expansion of Taylor series and Laurent series, the calculation and application of the residue, the properties of elementary complex variable function and the application of Conformal Mapping. The second part is about the theory of Integral Transformation. It mainly introduces the Fourier Integral Transform, Laplace Transform and related methods, which focuses on related properties and applications of transformation in engineering. By studying this course, students can not only learn the basic theory of Complex Function and Integral Transformation and the common mathematical methods in Engineering Technology, but also consolidate and review basic knowledge of Calculus. Then, it help students to lay the necessary mathematical foundation for the following study of relevant courses and the mathematical knowledge. Meanwhile, it also improves the students' ability of abstract thinking, logical reasoning, spatial imagination and scientific creativity.

default.en: The course of computing methods is a public basic course for undergraduate students of science and engineering. This course has been widely used in scientific study, engineering techniques, social science research, et al. The contents of this course include: numerical methods for nonlinear equation/equations/algebraic equations, interpolation methods/numerical approximation, numerical integration, numerical methods for Ordinary Differential Equations. This course is served in training students’ ability of solving actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 本课程是为我校应用物理学开设的必修自然科学基础理论课程，系统介绍线性代数与空间解析几何的基本理论和方法，是线性代数与空间解析几何的有机结合。内容包括：行列式的定义、计算及其性质；矩阵的运算，分块矩阵，矩阵求秩；向量代数，向量坐标，平面与直线的方程及其相互位置关系；n维向量，向量组的线性相关性；向量空间，向量空间的基底、维数、坐标及坐标变换；线性方程组解的结构理论；特征值与特征向量，相似变换，矩阵可相似对角化的条件和相似对角化的方法；二次型理论，讨论二次型的化简，二次曲面及其分类以及应用物理相关的案例。 考察方式为累加式，作业及课堂表现占20%，课堂测验占5%，期中考试占15%，期末考试占60%。 课程配有同步MOOC，网址：https://www.icourse163.org/course/HIT-1002117005. 除教学视频和课件，还有章节习题讲解、期末复习等视频和学习资料。
default.en: This course is intended to introduce fundamental methods and concepts of linear algebra and analytic geometry for applied physics major students. It is an organic combination of linear algebra and analytic geometry. Topics are usually selected from: the definition of a determinant, computations and properties of determinants; operations of matrices, partitioned matrices and the rank of a matrix; vector algebra, vector coordinates, the equations of planes and lines, and the relations between plans and lines; n-dimensional vectors, linear independence among vectors; vector spaces, the bases, dimensions of vector spaces and changing of basis; the structure of the solution set of a linear system; eigenvalues and eigenvectors, similar transformations, the conditions that determine if a matrix is diagonalizable, and the method of diagonalizing a matrix using eigenvalues and eigenvectors; the theory of quadratic forms, the canonical form of a quadratic form; quadratic surfaces and their classification; applications of linear algebra in applied physics. The grade policy is as following: homework and performance in class 20%, quizzes in class 5%，the midterm exam 15%, and final exam 60%. Course videos, exercise problems and the solutions of review problems are available at: https://www.icourse163.org/course/HIT-1002117005.

default.zh: 课程包含极限、一元微分学、一元积分学、微分方程几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.函数：函数及其性质，复合函数，初等函数。 2.极限与连续：极限定义，极限的性质与运算法则，无穷小与无穷大，函数的连续性。 3.导数与微分：导数的基本公式与四则运算法则，反函数与复合函数求导法则，隐函数与参数式函数求导法则，高阶导数，微分。 4.微分中值定理：微分中值定理，洛必达法则，泰勒公式。 5.不定积分：原函数与不定积分，换元积分法，分部积分法。 6定积分：定积分的定义与性质，微积分基本定理，定积分的换元积分法和分部积分法，反常积分。 7.导数与积分应用：函数的极值与最大（小）值，函数的分析作图法，曲线的弧长与弧微分，曲率，定积分的应用。 8.微分方程：一阶微分方程，几种可积的高阶微分方程。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including limit, unitary differential calculus, unitary integral calculus, differential equation： 1. Functions: Functions and their properties, composite functions, elementary functions. 2. Limits and continuity: Definition of limit, limit properties and laws, infinities and infinitesimals, continuity. 3. Derivatives and differentials: Differentiation formulas and rules, chain rule, implicit differentiation, higher derivatives, differentials. 4. Mean value theorem: Mean value theorem of differentials, L`hospital rule, Taylor formula. 5. Infinite integrals: Antiderivatives and infinite integrals, substitution rule, integration by parts. 6. Definite integrals: Definition and properties of definite integral, fundamental theorem of calculus, substitution rule, integration by parts, improper integrals. 7. Applications of differentiation and integration: Maximum and minimum values, curve sketching, arc length and differential of arc length, curvature, applications of integration. 8. Differential equations: First-order differential equations, some integrable higher-order differential equations.

default.zh: 概率论与数理统计是研究随机现象统计规律的一门数学学科。 概率论是以数学模型为基础来研究随机现象，并用数学语言描述随机现象，进而研究其基本规律，找出其内在规律，在随机现象和其他数学分支之间架起一座桥梁，利用数学工具和方法来研究随机现象。 数理统计是以概率论为基础，运用概率论和数学方法，研究如何收集具有随机影响的信息和数据，建立适当的数学模型(随机统计模型)，通过统计模型对数据和信息进行统计分析，对问题进行统计推断和决策研究。数理统计是应用数学中最重要和最活跃的学科之一，它已经在自然科学和社会科学中得到了越来越广泛的应用，在国民经济和科学技术中发挥着越来越重要的作用。 随着大数据时代的到来，作为工科本科生，应该具备概率论和数理统计的基础知识，掌握它们的思想和方法以及数据分析能力。本课程突出概率论与数理统计的特点，注重概率论与数理统计思想方法的介绍，重视概率论与数理统计的应用，培养学生随机数学思维的能力。本课程讲授概率论与数理统计的基本概念、随机事件的概率、随机变量及其分布、随机变量的数字特征与极限理论、数据分析、估计问题等内容。
default.en: Probability theory and mathematical statistics is a mathematical discipline to study the statistical laws of random phenomenon. Probability theory is based on mathematical models to random phenomenon, and describes random phenomenon by mathematical language, then to study the basic law, to find out the inherent law, building a bridge random phenomenon and other mathematics branches, using mathematical tools and methods to research random phenomena. Mathematical statistics is based on probability theory, it applies probability theory and mathematical method, researches how to collect information and data with random effects, establishes appropriate mathematical models (random statistical model), statistical analysis of the data and information by the statistical model, to make statistical inference and decision of study on the problem. Mathematical statistics is one of applied Mathematics as the most important and active subject, it has been applied in natural science and Social Science in the more extensive, in the national economy and science and technology in a more and more important role. With the advent of the era of big data, as an engineering undergraduate, we should have the basic knowledge of probability and mathematical statistics, master their ideas and methods and data analysis capabilities. This course highlights the characteristics of probability theory and mathematical statistics, pays attention to the introduction of probability and statistics thought method, attaches importance to the application of probability and statistics, and trains students' ability of random mathematical thinking. This course teaches the basic concepts of probability theory and mathematical statistics, the probability of random events, random variable and its distribution, the number of characteristics of random variables and limit theory, data analysis, estimation and so on.

default.zh: 课程包含多元微分学、多元积分学、微分方程及无穷级数几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1. 一阶微分方程，几种可积的高阶微分方程，线性微分方程。 2.多元函数微分学：偏导数与高阶偏导数，全微分，复合函数求导法，隐函数求导法，偏导数的几何应用，多元函数的泰勒公式与极值，方向导数与梯度。 3.多元函数积分学：黎曼积分定义，二重积分，三重积分，第一型曲线积分，第一型曲面积分，黎曼积分的应用。 4.无穷级数：无穷级数及其性质，正项级数，任意项级数，函数项级数，幂级数，傅里叶级数。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including multivariate differential calculus, multivariate integral calculus, differential equation and infinite series： 1.First-order differential equations, some integrable higher-order differential equations， linear differential equations. 2. Multivariable differential calculus: Partial derivatives and higher partial derivatives, total differentials, chain rule, implicit differentiation, applications of partial derivatives to geometry, Taylor formula and extreme values, directional derivatives and gradients. 3. Multivariable integral calculus: Definition of Riemann integrals, double integrals, triple integrals, applications of Riemann integrals. 4.Infinite series: Infinite series and its properties, positive series, arbitrary series, function series, power series, Fourier series.

default.zh: 概率论与数理统计是研究随机现象统计规律的一门数学学科。 概率论是以数学模型为基础来研究随机现象，并用数学语言描述随机现象，进而研究其基本规律，找出其内在规律，在随机现象和其他数学分支之间架起一座桥梁，利用数学工具和方法来研究随机现象。 数理统计是以概率论为基础，运用概率论和数学方法，研究如何收集具有随机影响的信息和数据，建立适当的数学模型(随机统计模型)，通过统计模型对数据和信息进行统计分析，对问题进行统计推断和决策研究。数理统计是应用数学中最重要和最活跃的学科之一，它已经在自然科学和社会科学中得到了越来越广泛的应用，在国民经济和科学技术中发挥着越来越重要的作用。 随着大数据时代的到来，作为工科本科生，应该具备概率论和数理统计的基础知识，掌握它们的思想和方法以及数据分析能力。本课程突出概率论与数理统计的特点，注重概率论与数理统计思想方法的介绍，重视概率论与数理统计的应用，培养学生随机数学思维的能力。本课程讲授概率论与数理统计的基本概念、随机事件的概率、随机变量及其分布、随机变量的数字特征，估计问题等内容。
default.en: Probability theory and mathematical statistics is a mathematical discipline to study the statistical laws of random phenomenon. Probability theory is based on mathematical models to random phenomenon, and describes random phenomenon by mathematical language, then to study the basic law, to find out the inherent law, building a bridge random phenomenon and other mathematics branches, using mathematical tools and methods to research random phenomena. Mathematical statistics is based on probability theory, it applies probability theory and mathematical method, researches how to collect information and data with random effects, establishes appropriate mathematical models (random statistical model), statistical analysis of the data and information by the statistical model, to make statistical inference and decision of study on the problem. Mathematical statistics is one of applied Mathematics as the most important and active subject, it has been applied in natural science and Social Science in the more extensive, in the national economy and science and technology in a more and more important role. With the advent of the era of big data, as an engineering undergraduate, we should have the basic knowledge of probability and mathematical statistics, master their ideas and methods and data analysis capabilities. This course highlights the characteristics of probability theory and mathematical statistics, pays attention to the introduction of probability and statistics thought method, attaches importance to the application of probability and statistics, and trains students' ability of random mathematical thinking. This course teaches the basic concepts of probability theory and mathematical statistics, the probability of random events, random variable and its distribution, the number of characteristics of random variables , estimation and so on.

default.zh: 课程包含极限、一元微分学、一元积分学、微分方程几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.函数：函数及其性质，复合函数，初等函数。 2.极限与连续：极限定义，极限的性质与运算法则，无穷小与无穷大，函数的连续性，一致收敛性，实数基本理论，了解上、下极限概念，掌握Stolz定理。 3.导数与微分：导数的基本公式与四则运算法则，反函数与复合函数求导法则，隐函数与参数式函数求导法则，高阶导数，微分。 4.微分中值定理：微分中值定理，洛必达法则，泰勒公式。 5.不定积分：原函数与不定积分，换元积分法，分部积分法。 6定积分：定积分的定义与性质，微积分基本定理，定积分的换元积分法和分部积分法，反常积分，了解勒贝格积分。 7.导数与积分应用：函数的极值与最大（小）值，函数的分析作图法，曲线的弧长与弧微分，曲率，定积分的应用。 8.微分方程：一阶微分方程，几种可积的高阶微分方程。
default.en: The course includes several parts: limits, calculus, integration, and differential equations. The specific content is as follows: 1. Functions: Functions and their properties, composite functions, elementary functions. 2. Limits and Continuity: Definition of limits, properties and operation rules of limits, infinitesimal and infinity, continuity of functions, uniform convergence, basic theory of real numbers, understanding of the concepts of upper and lower limits, and mastery of Stolz's theorem. 3. Derivatives and Differentiation: The basic formula and four rules of operation for derivatives, differentiation rules for inverse functions and composite functions, differentiation rules for implicit functions and parametric functions, higher-order derivatives, and differentiation. 4. Differential mean value theorem: Differential mean value theorem, Leibniz's law, Taylor's formula. 5. Indefinite integral: Original function and indefinite integral, substitution integral method, partial integral method. 6. Definite integrals: Definition and properties of definite integrals, fundamental theorems of calculus, substitution and partial integration methods for definite integrals, anomalous integrals, and understanding Lebesgue integrals. 7. Derivative and integral applications: extreme and maximum (minimum) values of functions, graphical analysis of functions, arc length and arc differentiation of curves, curvature, and the application of definite integrals. 8. Differential equations: First order differential equations, several integrable higher-order differential equations.

default.zh: 课程包含多元微分学、多元积分学、微分方程及无穷级数几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.线性微分方程，常微分方程在数学建模中的应用。 2.多元函数微分学：偏导数与高阶偏导数，全微分，复合函数求导法，隐函数求导法，偏导数的几何应用，多元函数的泰勒公式与极值，方向导数与梯度。 3.多元函数积分学：黎曼积分定义，二重积分，三重积分，第一型曲线积分，第一型曲面积分，黎曼积分的应用。 4.第二型曲线积分与第二型曲面积分：向量场，第二型曲线积分，格林公式，第二型曲面积分，高斯公式，通量与散度，斯托克斯公式，环量与旋度，掌握含参变量积分概念及相关定理，掌握外微分形式。 5.无穷级数：无穷级数及其性质，正项级数，任意项级数，函数项级数，幂级数，傅里叶级数，了解傅里叶级数在工科中的应用。
default.en: The course includes several parts such as multivariate differentiation, multivariate integration, differential equations, and infinite series. The specific content is as follows: 1. The application of linear differential equations and ordinary differential equations in mathematical modeling. 2. Multivariate differential calculus: partial derivatives and higher-order partial derivatives, total differentiation, composite function differentiation method, implicit function differentiation method, geometric applications of partial derivatives, Taylor formula and extremum of multivariate functions, directional derivatives and gradients. 3. Multivariate function integration: Definition of Riemann integral, double integral, triple integral, type 1 curve integral, type 1 surface integral, and application of Riemann integral. 4. Second type curve integration and second type surface integration: vector field, second type curve integration, Green's formula, second type surface integration, Gaussian formula, flux and divergence, Stokes formula, circulation and curl, master the concept and related theorems of integral with parametric variables, and master the form of external differentiation. 5. Infinite series: Infinite series and their properties, positive series, arbitrary series, function series, power series, Fourier series, understand the application of Fourier series in engineering.

default.en: Probability theory and mathematical statistics is a mathematical discipline to study the statistical laws of random phenomenon. Probability theory is based on mathematical models to random phenomenon, and describes random phenomenon by mathematical language, then to study the basic law, to find out the inherent law, building a bridge random phenomenon and other mathematics branches, using mathematical tools and methods to research random phenomena. Mathematical statistics is based on probability theory, it applies probability theory and mathematical method, researches how to collect information and data with random effects, establishes appropriate mathematical models (random statistical model), statistical analysis of the data and information by the statistical model, to make statistical inference and decision of study on the problem. Mathematical statistics is one of applied Mathematics as the most important and active subject, it has been applied in natural science and Social Science in the more extensive, in the national economy and science and technology in a more and more important role. With the advent of the era of big data, as an engineering undergraduate, we should have the basic knowledge of probability and mathematical statistics, master their ideas and methods and data analysis capabilities. This course highlights the characteristics of probability theory and mathematical statistics, pays attention to the introduction of probability and statistics thought method, attaches importance to the application of probability and statistics, and trains students' ability of random mathematical thinking. This course teaches the basic concepts of probability theory and mathematical statistics, the probability of random events, random variable and its distribution, the number of characteristics of random variables and limit theory, data analysis, estimation and so on.

default.zh: 这门课程主要介绍高等代数的基础理论及其应用。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the basic theory of advanced algebra and its applications.

default.zh: 这门课程主要介绍空间解析几何理论及其应用。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the theory of analytic geometry of three dimensions and its applications.

default.zh: 本课程以极限论、实数的基本定理、函数的连续与一致连续性、函数的可导性等为研究对象来详细介绍数列极限与函数极限的定义及其性质；数列极限与函数极限的关系；实数的基本定理：子列，上、下确界，上、下确界原理，单调有界数列必有极限，区间套定理，列紧性，完备性（Cauchy收敛原理），紧性（有限覆盖定理）；6个等价定理的直接互证；函数的连续性与一致连续性；闭区间上连续函数的性质；导数与微分；微分中值定理及其应用等。
default.en: In this course we study the theory of limits, the elementary theory of real numbers, the continuity and uniform continuity of functions, the differentiability of functions etc. as the main subject to discuss in details the definitions and properties of the limits of scalar sequences and the limits of functions, the relationship between the limits of scalar sequences and the limits of functions, the elementary theory of real numbers: subsequences, supremum and infimum, the principle of supremum and infimum, the existence of limit for a monotone and bounded sequence , the theorem of nested intervals, sequential compactness, completeness (Cauchy’s criterion of convergence) , compactness (the theorem of finite covering), the mutual proofs of the six equivalent theorems, the continuity and uniform continuity of functions, the properties of continuous functions on closed invervals, derivatives and differentials, mean value theorem and its applications.

default.zh: 本课程是专为信息与计算科学，数学与应用数学本科生开设的介绍高等代数基本概念、基本理论和基本方法的课程。主要内容如下。 多项式：域，整除，最大公因式。 行列式：行列式的定义、性质和计算，Cramer 法则。 线性方程组：线性相关，极大无关组，向量组的秩，齐次、非齐次线性方程组解的结构。 矩阵：矩阵计算，矩阵初等变换，可逆矩阵，矩阵方程，矩阵的秩。 二次型：二次型的矩阵，标准形。
default.en: This course is intended to introduce fundamental methods and concepts in linear algebra for undergraduate students in mathematics and applied mathematics, information and computational science. The main contents are as follows. POLYNOMIALS: Field, Divide, Greatest Common Divisor. DETERMINANTS: Definition of Determinant, Properties of Determinant, Calculation of Determinant, Cramer Rule. SYSTEM OF LINEAR EQUATIONS: Linear Dependence, Maximal Linearly Independent Subset, Rank of Sets of Vectors, Structure of the solutions for System of Homogeneous and Non-Homogeneous Linear Equation Systems. MATRIX: Calculation of Matrix, Elementary Transformation of Matrices, Invertible Matrix, Equivalence of Matrices, Rank of a Matrix. QUADRATIC FORM: Matrix of a Quadratic Form, Canonical Form.

default.zh: 这门课程主要介绍空间解析几何理论及其应用。
default.en: This course covers the theory of analytic geometry of three dimensions and its applications.

default.zh: 解析几何是数学系数学与应用数学专业、信息与计算科学专业和统计学专业的一门专业基础课程，是学习数学分析、高等代数等其它专业课程的基础，在培养学生掌握空间解析几何的计算能力、抽象思维和逻辑思维能力等方面占有重要的地位。
default.en: Analytical geometry is a basic course for the majors mathematics and applied mathematics, information and computational science, and statistics. It is the basis for learning other courses such as mathematical analysis and advanced algebra. It is crucial for developing the students' abstract thinking and logical thinking.

default.zh: 数学分析课是各类大学数学与应用数学专业、信息与计算科学专业、统计学专业学生最主要的专业基础课，是进一步学习复变函数论、微分方程、微分几何、概率论、实变分析与泛函分析等后继课程的基础，是数学类硕士研究生入学考试的必考基础课之一。本课程基本的内容有：1. Fourier级数与Fourier变换，包括Fourier级数的计算和收敛性证明、Fourier变换简介；2. 多元函数的极限论，包括平面点集、多元函数的极限与连续；3. 多变量微分学，包括偏导数与全微分、曲线的切线与法平面、曲线的切平面与法线、方向导数与梯度、Taylor公式、极值、隐函数定理；4. 含参变量的积分和反常积分，包括收敛性的判定和积分的计算；5. 多变量积分学，包括二重和三重积分、第一类曲线积分和第二类曲线积分、第一类曲面积分和第二类曲面积分的计算及各类积分之间的联系。课程的目的是通过一个学期学习和系统的数学训练，使学生逐步提高数学修养，特别是分析的修养，积累从事进一步学习所需要的数学知识，掌握数学的基本思想和方法，培养与锻炼学生的数学思维素质，提高学生分析与解决问题的能力。
default.en: Mathematical analysis is the most important specialized core course for students majored in mathematics and applied mathematics，information and computational mathematics，statistics in various kind of universities. It is the foundation for the further study of the courses following: theory of complex functions differential equations, differential geometry, probability theory, real analysis and functional analysis. It is one of the prescribed specialized courses in the entrance examination for master degree candidates of mathematical classes. This course consists of the following content: 1. Fourier series and Fourier transformation, including the calculation and proof of convergence for Fourier series、the introduction of Fourier transformation; 2. Limit theory of multivariable functions, including sets of points on the plane、limits and continuity of multivariable functions; 3. Multivariable differential calculus, including partial derivatives and total differentials、tangent lines and normal planes of curves、tangent planes and normal lines of surfaces、directional derivatives and gradients、Taylor formula、extreme values、theory of implicit functions; 4. Integrals with parameters and improper integrals with parameters, including the judgment of convergence and the calculation of the integrals; 5. Multivariable integral calculus, including the calculation of double integrals and triple integrals、line integrals of the first type and line integrals of the second type、surface integrals of the first type and surface integrals of the second type and the relationship among these kinds of integrals. By study and systematic practice of this course throughout one semester the students should gradually improve their mathematical accomplishments, especially accomplishments of analysis, accumulate the knowledge of mathematics for further study, grasp the fundamental ideas and methods of mathematics, train and exercise their quality of mathematics thought, improve their ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 又称高级微积分，分析学中最古老、最基本的分支。一般指以微积分学和无穷级数一般理论为主要内容，并包括它们的理论基础（实数、函数和极限的基本理论）的一个较为完整的数学学科。它也是大学数学专业的一门基础课程。数学中的分析分支是专门研究实数与复数及其函数的数学分支。它的发展由微积分开始，并扩展到函数的连续性、可微分及可积分等各种特性。这些特性，有助我们应用在对物理世界的研究，研究及发现自然界的规律。
default.en: Also known as advanced calculus, it is the oldest and most fundamental branch of analysis. Generally, it refers to a relatively complete mathematical discipline with Calculus and the general theory of infinite series as its main content and including their theoretical basis (the basic theory of real numbers, functions and limits). It is also a fundamental course for university mathematics majors. The analytical branch of mathematics is a specialized branch of mathematics that studies real and complex numbers and their functions. Its development began with calculus and extended to various properties such as continuity, differentiability, and integrability of functions. These characteristics help us apply them to the study of the physical world, as well as to discover the laws of nature.

default.zh: 数论是数学的一个分支，也是最古老的分支之一，主要研究整数的性质。这里面最重要的一类正整数被称为素数，可以说对素数的研究是数论里的两大主线之一。另外一个主线是寻求方程的整数解，人们称这类方程为丢番图方程，比如费马大定理解决的就是一类非常特殊的丢番图方程。现代数论是一个庞大的体系，而初等数论也是其分支之一。这里“初等”二字指的是用的工具为初等工具，并不依赖于更高级的诸如复变函数、抽象代数、代数几何等数学理论。通过本课程的学习，需要达到的课程目标有：1. 要求学生系统的理解初等数论里的基本概念、基本理论和重要历史，掌握基本方法；2. 在传授知识的同时，要通过各个教学环节逐步培养学生具有抽象思维能力、动手实验能力和综合运用所学的知识分析和解决问题的能力；3. 同样也要联系当前数论发展，指出古老问题的解决所用的现代工具，为以后学习研究更高级数学课程培养浓厚的兴趣，更进一步为终身喜欢、自主关注和学习数论打下基础。
default.en: Number theory is one of the oldest branches of Mathematics and it studies the properties of integers. Prime number is the most important notion in number theory, and its study is one of the two main themes in number theory. The other theme is the study of polynomial equations for their integer solutions, which we call Diophantine equations. For example, the Fermat equation is one special kind. Modern number theory is a vast area in Mathematics and elementary number theory is one of its branches. Here “elementary” means the tools needed are elementary, not involving more advanced theories such as Complex Analysis, Abstract Algebra, Algebraic Geometry. There are three goals in this course: 1. The students should understand systematically the basic notions, basic theories and important events and basic methods; 2. The students should obtain various abilities on abstract thinking, experimenting and problem solving; 3. By connecting with current number theory development and mentioning the modern tools, lay the foundation for students’ interest in studying more advanced Mathematics courses and potential interest in learning then researching on number theory.

default.zh: 数论是数学的一个分支，也是最古老的分支之一，主要研究整数的性质。这里面最重要的一类正整数被称为素数，可以说对素数的研究是数论里的两大主线之一。另外一个主线是寻求方程的整数解，人们称这类方程为丢番图方程，比如费马大定理解决的就是一类非常特殊的丢番图方程。现代数论是一个庞大的体系，而初等数论也是其分支之一。这里“初等”二字指的是用的工具为初等工具，并不依赖于更高级的诸如复变函数、抽象代数、代数几何等数学理论。
default.en: Number theory is a branch of mathematics and one of the oldest branches. It mainly studies the properties of integers. One of the most important positive integers is called prime number. It can be said that the study of prime number is one of the two main lines in number theory. Another main line is to find the integer solution of the equation, which is called Diophantine equation. For example, Fermat's theorem solves a very special kind of Diophantine equation. Modern number theory is a huge system, and elementary number theory is one of its branches. The word "elementary" here refers to the tool used as the primary tool, and does not depend on higher-level mathematical theories such as complex variable function, abstract algebra, algebraic geometry, etc.

default.zh: 数论是数学的一个分支，也是最古老的分支之一，主要研究整数的性质。这里面最重要的一类正整数被称为素数，可以说对素数的研究是数论里的两大主线之一。另外一个主线是寻求方程的整数解，人们称这类方程为丢番图方程，比如费马大定理解决的就是一类非常特殊的丢番图方程。现代数论是一个庞大的体系，而初等数论也是其分支之一。这里“初等”二字指的是用的工具为初等工具，并不依赖于更高级的诸如复变函数、抽象代数、代数几何等数学理论。通过本课程的学习，需要达到的课程目标有：1. 要求学生系统的理解初等数论里的基本概念、基本理论和重要历史，掌握基本方法；2. 在传授知识的同时，要通过各个教学环节逐步培养学生具有抽象思维能力、动手实验能力和综合运用所学的知识分析和解决问题的能力；3. 同样也要联系当前数论发展，指出古老问题的解决所用的现代工具，为以后学习研究更高级数学课程培养浓厚的兴趣，更进一步为终身喜欢、自主关注和学习数论打下基础。
default.en: Number theory is one of the oldest branches of mathematics and it studies the properties of integers. Prime number is the most important notion in number theory, and its study is one of the two main themes in number theory. The other theme is the study of polynomial equations for their integer solutions, which we call Diophantine equations. For example, the Fermat equation is one special kind. Modern number theory is a vast area in Mathematics and elementary number theory is one of its branches. Here “elementary” means the tools needed are elementary, not involving more advanced theories such as complex analysis, abstract algebra, algebraic geometry. There are three goals in this course: 1. The students should understand systematically the basic notions, basic theories and important events and basic methods; 2. The students should obtain various abilities on abstract thinking, experimenting and problem solving; 3. By connecting with current number theory development and mentioning the modern tools, lay the foundation for students’ interest in studying more advanced mathematics courses and potential interest in learning then researching on number theory.

default.zh: 本课程以单变量实函数的可测性、可积性为研究对象，通过勒贝格测度、可测函数的定义与性质，建立勒贝格积分理论，应用勒贝格积分，讨论单调函数、有界变差函数的可微性，建立牛顿－莱布尼兹公式成立的充要条件，最后引入 空间，讨论 空间的完备性与可分性。
default.en: This course mainly studies measurability and integrability of a single-variable real function. Through the definition and property of Lebesgue measure and measurable functions, theory of Lebesgue integral is set up. By virtue of the Lebesgue integral, we research differentiation of monotonic functions and bounded variation function, and set up necessary and sufficient conditions for Newton - Leibniz formula. Finally, space is introduced, and the completeness and separability of this space is discussed.

default.zh: 《实变函数》是大学数学学院的重要专业基础课之一, 它是数学分析的延续和发展, 它主要应用点集分析的方法建立n维欧氏空间中点集的 Lebesgue 测度理论和点集上定义的 Lebesgue 积分理论。通过这门课程的教学应使学生熟练掌握本课程的基本概念、基本理论及其推导过程。系统掌握 Lebesgue 测度和 Lebesgue 积分理论, 使学生能以更高的视角看积分与微分, 了解和掌搌遂步深入地分析问题和解决问题的方法, 提高分析问题和解决问题的能力, 培养抽象的思维能力, 为进一步钻研现代数学数学理论打下基础。
default.en: 《Functions of Real Variables》 is one of the important foundational courses in the College of Mathematics, which is a continuation and development of mathematical analysis. It mainly applies the method of point set analysis to establish the Lebesgue measure theory for point sets in n-dimensional Euclidean space and the Lebesgue integral theory defined on point sets. The teaching of this course should enable students to proficiently master the basic concepts, theories, and derivation process of this course. Systematically mastering Lebesgue measures and Lebesgue integral theory enables students to view integrals and differentials from a higher perspective, understand and master in-depth analysis and problem-solving methods, improve their ability to analyze and solve problems, cultivate abstract thinking skills, and lay a foundation for further research into modern mathematical theories.
