default.zh: 第一章 复数与平面拓扑（上课4学时 习题课1学时）复数及其几何表示，复平面的拓扑。 第二章 解析函数（上课6学时 习题课1学时）复变函数的导数，解析函数，初等函数。 第三章 复变函数的积分（上课8学时 习题课2学时）复变函数的积分，柯西定理，莫勒拉定理，代数学基本定理，柯西公式，解析函数的高阶导数公式。 第四章 级数（上课8学时 习题课2学时）级数和序列的基本性质，泰勒展开式，复变函数项级数和复变函数序列，解析函数的洛朗展开式。 第五章 留数（上课10学时 习题课2学时）解析函数的孤立奇点，解析函数在无穷远点的性质，整函数与亚纯函数的概念，留数的一般理论，留数计算，留数计算的应用，亚纯函数的零点与极点的个数、儒歇定理。 第六章 保形映射（上课10学时 习题课2学时）导数的几何意义，单叶解析函数的映射性质，分式线性函数及其映射性质，两个特殊的分式线性函数，最大模原理、施瓦茨引理，黎曼定理及边界对应概念。 第七章 解析开拓（上课8学时 习题课2学时）解析开拓的一般概念，沿曲线的解析开拓，单值性定理。 第八章 调和函数（上课6学时 ）调和函数及其性质，中值公式与泊松公式、极值原理，狄利克雷问题。
default.en: Properties of complex numbers, Some elementary functions, Analytic functions, Complex integrals, Cauchy’s theorem, Cauchy’s integral formula, Maximum modulus theorem and harmonic functions, Convegent series of analytic functions, Power series and Taylor’s theorem, Laurent series and classifications of singularities, Calculation of residues, The resiedue theorem, Evaluation of definite integral, Basic theory of comformal mappings, Fractional linear and Schwarz-Christoffel transformations, Analytic continuation and Riemann surface, Rouch’s theorem and principle of the argument, Mapping properties of analytic functions, Riemann’s theorem, Asymptotic methods, Basic properties of harmonic functions, Construction of harmonic functions, The Poission representation.

default.zh: 复变函数理论产生于十八世纪，发展于十九世纪，主要研究复变量函数特别是复解析函数的微积分性质。相比于实变量函数，复变函数有许多特殊且有趣的性质。同时，复变函数可以天然地描述平面图形之间的变换，有很多深刻的几何性质，在工程上也有许多应用。本课程的主要内容包括：复数及其运算、复变函数的连续与极限、解析函数、复变函数的积分、级数理论、留数理论、保形映射、解析开拓、调和函数等内容。
default.en: The theory of function of a complex variable was born in the 18th century and developed in the 19th century. The theory mainly conerns calculus poperties of functions of a complex variable, in particular, complex analytic function. Compared with real functions, complex functions have many special and interesting properties. Furthermore, complex functions can describe the transformation between 2-dimensional objects and then have profund geometric properties. There are also many applications in engineering. The main contents of this course contain complex numbers and operations, continuity and limitation of complex functions, analytic functions, integral of complex functions, theory of series and residues, comformal map, analytical continuation and harmonic functions.

default.zh: 泛函分析一门具有广泛应用的数学学科。通常，我们可以直接把泛函分析理解为从对经典的欧氏空间上函数理论的研究过渡到对抽象的无限维向量空间上函数理论的研究，这和向量空间的拓扑结构形成的各种理论体系紧密相关，例如具体的Hilbert空间、Banach空间或局部凸拓扑向量空间理论等。泛函分析建立了现代分析数学的重要理论框架。这个框架已经成为很多数学学科的理论基础，比如金融数学、量子概率、数值分析和非交换几何等等。所以，泛函分析这门课程成为了数学类专业和某些应用数学专业的必修课程，是学习后续课程必不可少的基础。
default.en: Functional analysis is an important branch of modern mathematics which has a broad range of applications. Compare to the classical analysis, the object of functional analysis is to study the function theory in abstract infinite dimensional vector spaces. It has close relationship with the theoretical system derived by the topological structure of vector spaces. For instance, Hilbert space, Banach space and locally convex topology vector space etc. Functional analysis has built an important theoretical framework for modern mathematics. It has become theoretical background for many mathematical disciplines, for example financial mathematics, quantum probability, numerical analysis and noncommutative geometry etc. Therefore, functional analysis has become a compulsory course for the students who are major in mathematics and applied mathematics, and it is an indispensable foundation for learning follow-up courses.

default.zh: 本课程介绍度量空间、赋范线性空间和内空间的结构和性质，序列的收敛性、可分性、紧性、完备性，以及正规空间和内空间的线性算子理论。 通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解现代数学的基本特征，掌握无限维空间的知识，培养抽象思维和解决具体问题的能力，为今后的相关研究奠定基础。泛函分析是数学专业的一门基础课，对进一步学习偏微分方程、随机过程、最优化理论等有极大帮助，对提高抽象能力、逻辑思维能力、表达能力等也极为重要。
default.en: The course introduces the structures and properties of metric space, normed linear space and inner space, convergence of sequence, separability, compactness, completeness, and the theory of linear operators on normal and inner spaces. By studying this course, students can understand the basic characteristics of modern mathematics, grasp the knowledge about the infinite dimensional space, develop the ability of abstract thinking and solving specific problems, which lay the foundation for related research in future. Functional Analysis is a fundamental course for students major in Mathematics. It is extremely helpful in further study in partial differential equations, stochastic process, optimization theory etc. It is also extremely important in improving abstract, logic thinking ability, expression ability etc.

default.zh: 《常微分方程》 是数学专业的专业必修的基础课程之一。常微分方程是与微积分一起成长起来的学科，是各种精确自然科学中表述各种规律的基本工具之一，因而是数学联系实际问题的重要手段之一，同时本课程也是学习其它后继课，如数理方程，微分几何，泛函分析等所必需的。通过本课程的学习，不仅使学生了解微分方程和其它数学分支的联系，更能让学生深刻理解数学的重要性和广泛的应用背景，提高学生的实际应用能力，逐步培养学生探索力和创造力。
default.en: Ordinary Differential Equation is one of the compulsory basic courses for mathematics majors. Ordinary differential equation is a discipline that grew up with calculus, and is one of the basic tools for expressing various laws in various exact natural sciences, so it is one of the important means of connecting mathematics with practical problems. At the same time, this course is also necessary for learning other subsequent courses, such as mathematical equations, differential geometry, functional analysis, etc. Through the study of this course, students can not only understand the relationship between differential equations and other branches of mathematics, but also deeply understand the importance and wide application background of mathematics, improve students' practical application ability, and gradually cultivate students' exploration and creativity.

default.zh: 常微分方程是研究自然科学与社会科学中的事物、物体等的运动、演化和变化规律的有效数学工具，也是理论联系实际的重要数学分支之一。《常微分方程》课程是数学与应用数学、科学计算、统计学专业的重要基础课之一，它是联系微积分和线性代数最紧密的课程之一，是一些后续课程的基础。《常微分方程》对先修课程及后修课程起到承前启后的作用，是数学科学理论中必不可少的一个重要环节。该课程的主要任务是通过各教学环节，使得学生能够了解和掌握常微分方程的一些基本解法、常微分方程的基础理论，如解的存在性、唯一性、解关于初值和参数的连续可微性、解析微分方程解的理论、微分方程可积理论、线性微分方程解的结构、微分方程定性理论基础等，以及这些理论在物理、力学、生物和经济等学科中的应用。本课程既传授了学生常微分方程课程必备的基础知识，又培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。这些知识和能力的培养为学生后续课程的学习奠定了坚实的基础。
default.en: Ordinary differential equations are effective mathematical tools for studying the laws of motion, evolutions and changes of things and objects in natural and social sciences, and are also one of important branches of mathematics that combines theory with practice. The course 'Ordinary Differential Equation' is one of the important foundational courses in mathematics, applied mathematics, scientific calculations and statistics. It is one of the most closely related course between calculus and linear algebra and can serve as the foundation course for some subsequent courses. 'Ordinary Differential Equation' plays a crucial role in connecting the previous and subsequent courses, and is an essential part of mathematical scientific theory. The main task of this course is to enable students to understand and master some basic methods and theories of ordinary differential equations, such as the existence and uniqueness of solutions, continuous differentiability of solutions with respect to initial values and parameters, theory of analytical differential equation, integrability theory of differential equations, structure of solutions of linear differential equation, qualitative theoretical foundations of differential equations, etc., as well as the application of these theories in physics, mechanics, biology and economics. This course enables students not only to learn the essential basic knowledge of ordinary differential equations, but also to cultivates their ability to analyze and solve problems. The cultivation of these knowledge and abilities lays a solid foundation for students learning subsequent course.

default.zh: 概率论是数学系各专业学生必修的重要专业基础课，该课程也是概率与统计专业学生后续课程的基础。本课程将为学生讲授概率理论的基本思想、方法、及应用。 课程目标如下： 课程目标1. 能够认识、理解概率如何刻画随机现象，了解古典概率论一般方法，了解概率在实践中的实际应用价值，建立概率思想，提高学生的综合科学素养； 课程目标2.具备扎实的概率理论基础，掌握基本定理的证明，对测度论有较深入的了解。 课程目标 3. 学生了解概率论的前沿领域的工作，对概率论的研究产生兴趣。
default.en: Probability Theory is an important course for students from pure and applied mathematics as well as statistics. It is also a fast-developing area in modern mathematics. In this course we shall introduce basic notations and techniques of the classical and modern probability theory. The goal of this course: 1 Have basic knowledge about the classical probability theory. Understand how to build mathematical models for random phenomena. 2 Understand well the basic notions in probability theory and measure theory such as the sample space,, sigma fields, probability measure and measures in general, independence, measurable functions, random variables, the laws of large number and central lilit theorem. 3 The students can have basic ideas about the frontiers of the reasearch in probability theory, in particular work of the Fields medalists. Get interested in the research in probability theory.

default.zh: 本课程以函数的可积性、数项级数、函数列与函数项级数的一致收敛性等为研究对象来详细介绍原函数与不定积分及换元积分公式；分部积分公式；定积分的概念、性质和可积性条件；积分中值定理（包括第一、二中值定理）；可积函数类；微积分基本定理与Newton-Leibniz公式；级数的收敛性及其性质；正项级数；绝对收敛与条件收敛级数的性质；Abel变换，Abel引理，Leibniz判别法，Abel判别法和Dirichlet判别法；函数列与函数项级数的一致收敛概念；一致收敛级数的性质；一致收敛性判别法；幂级数；逼近定理等。
default.en: In this course we study the integrability of functions, series of numbers, the uniform convergence of function sequences and series of functions etc. as the main subject to discuss in details primitive functions and indefinite integrals and variable substitution method, integration by parts, the notion and properties of definite integrals and the criterions for integrability, mean value theorems of integrals (including the first and second mean value theorems), classes of integrable functions, properties of absolutely convergent and conditionally convergent series, Abel's transformation, Abel Lemma, Leibniz's criterion, Abel's criterion and Dirichlet's criterion, the notions of the uniform convergence of function sequences and series of functions, properties of uniformly convergent series, criterion of uniform convergence, power series, the theorem of approximation etc.

default.zh: 又称高级微积分，分析学中最古老、最基本的分支。一般指以微积分学和无穷级数一般理论为主要内容，并包括它们的理论基础（实数、函数和极限的基本理论）的一个较为完整的数学学科。它也是大学数学专业的一门基础课程。数学中的分析分支是专门研究实数与复数及其函数的数学分支。它的发展由微积分开始，并扩展到函数的连续性、可微分及可积分等各种特性。这些特性，有助我们应用在对物理世界的研究，研究及发现自然界的规律。
default.en: Also known as advanced calculus, it is the oldest and most fundamental branch of analysis. Generally, it refers to a relatively complete mathematical discipline with Calculus and the general theory of infinite series as its main content and including their theoretical basis (the basic theory of real numbers, functions and limits). It is also a fundamental course for university mathematics majors. The analytical branch of mathematics is a specialized branch of mathematics that studies real and complex numbers and their functions. Its development began with calculus and extended to various properties such as continuity, differentiability, and integrability of functions. These characteristics help us apply them to the study of the physical world, as well as to discover the laws of nature.

default.zh: 本课程是专为信息与计算科学，数学与应用数学本科生开设的介绍高等代数基本概念、基本理论和基本方法的课程。主要内容如下。 向量空间：线性相关，极大无关组，向量空间的基与维数，坐标向量。 线性变换：特征值，特征向量，不变子空间。 多项式矩阵：Jordan标准形，有理标准形。 欧几里得空间：内积，正交基，正交变换，酉空间 双线性函数：线性函数，双线性函数，对称双线性函数
default.en: This course is intended to introduce fundamental methods and concepts in linear algebra for undergraduate students in mathematics and applied mathematics, information and computational science. The main contents are as follows. VECTOR SPACES: Linear Dependence, Maximal Linearly Independent Subset, Rank of Sets of Vectors, Bases and Dimensions of Vector Space, Coordinates of Vectors. LINEAR TRANSFORMATION: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors, Invariant Subspaces. POLYNOMIAL-MATRIX: Jordan Canonical Form, Rational Canonical Form. EUCLID SPACES: Inner Product, Orthogonal Bases, Orthogonal Linear Transformations, Unitary Spaces. BILINEAR FUNCTION: Linear Function, Bilinear Function, Symmetric Bilinear Function

default.zh: 高等代数是数学与应用数学、信息与计算科学以及统计专业的三大基础课之一。该课程的知识体系是进一步学习常微分方程、数值代数、泛函分析等数学类后继课的基石，是学习计算机理论、控制理论、信息理论等其他现代科学的工具。贯穿该课程的抽象思维和逻辑推理对培养学生现代数学思想，形成科研创新能力有着重要作用。 课程目标1：使学生理解高等代数的基本概念、掌握高等代数的理论体系、获得高等代数的思想方法； 课程目标2：使学生受到运用高等代数方法解决实际问题的初步训练，为后续课程的学习和继续深造奠定坚实的基础： 课程目标3：使学生获得借助高等代数的理论进行合理抽象、逻辑推理、综合分析的能力。
default.en: Algebra is one of the three basic parts of mathematics. Advanced algebra is a prerequisite for ordinary differential equations, numerical algebra, functional analysis and other courses. It is widely used in computer science, control theory, information theory and other areas. Goal 1：Understanding of basic concepts, ideas and methods of advanced algebra. Goal 2：Ability of rational thinking, abstract reasoning and general analysis. Goal 3：Students will receive the preliminary training of using algebra methods to solve practical problems, laying a solid foundation for the future study and further study.

default.zh: 在数学物理方程这门课程中，我们主要介绍如下内容：一维波动方程的导出和解法，其中包括达朗贝尔解法，齐次化原理，初边值问题的分离变量法；高维波动方程的导出及柯西问题的解法，包括球平均和降维法；能量不等式，波动方程解的唯一性和稳定性；热传导方程的导出及其初边值问题的分离变量法求解；热传导方程的柯西问题的解法（傅里叶变换求解）；极值原理，定解问题解的唯一性，稳定性及解的渐进性态；调和方程的建立及相关概念；格林公式及应用，格林函数及应用；强极值原理，第二边值问题解的唯一性；二阶线性偏微分方程的分类及特征值理论；三类方程的比较，先验估计，两个自变量的一阶偏微分方程组的特征值理论；广义函数理论。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握数学物理方程的基本理论方法和发展前沿，具备应用数学物理方程来解决实际问题的能力，具有不断学习数学物理方程中的最新方法和适应发展要求的提高能力。
default.en: In this course, we shall introduce the following material: The derivation and solutions for 1-dimensional wave equations. This part includes D’Alebert’s formula, homogeneous principle and the method of separation of variables; The derivation of higher dimensions wave equations and the solution of Cauchy problems. This part includes the methods of spherical average and reducing dimensions; Energy inequality , the uniqueness and stabilities to wave equations; The derivation of heat equations and the method of separation of variables for solutions; Fourier transforms for solving Cauchy problems of heat equations; The maximum principle, uniqueness, stability and asymptotically behavior; The derivation of harmonic equations and related concepts; Green’s formula, Green’s functions and their applications; Strong maximum principle and the uniqueness of second boundary-value problems; The classification for second order partial differential equations and eigenvalue theory; The comparison of the three kind equations and prior evaluation; The eigenvalues theory for the first order partial differential equations with two variables; The brief introduction to generating functions. Through this course, we make students master the basic theory and method of equations of mathematical physics , the ability,of applying equations of mathematical physics to solve practical problems, with continuous learning new equations of mathematical physics and improve the ability to adapt to the requirements of development.

default.zh: 在数学物理方程这门课程中，我们主要介绍如下内容：一维波动方程的导出和解法，其中包括达朗贝尔解法，齐次化原理，初边值问题的分离变量法；高维波动方程的导出及柯西问题的解法，包括球平均和降维法；能量不等式，波动方程解的唯一性和稳定性；热传导方程的导出及其初边值问题的分离变量法求解；热传导方程的柯西问题的解法（傅里叶变换求解）；极值原理，定解问题解的唯一性，稳定性及解的渐进性态；调和方程的建立及相关概念；格林公式及应用，格林函数及应用；强极值原理，第二边值问题解的唯一性；二阶线性偏微分方程的分类及特征值理论；三类方程的比较，先验估计，两个自变量的一阶偏微分方程组的特征值理论；广义函数理论简介。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握数学物理方程的基本理论方法和发展前沿，具备应用数学物理方程来解决实际问题的能力，具有不断学习数学物理方程中的最新方法和适应发展要求的提高能力。
default.en: In this course, we shall introduce the following material: The derivation and solutions for 1-dimensional wave equations. This part includes D’Alebert’s formula, homogeneous principle and the method of separation of variables; The derivation of higher dimensions wave equations and the solution of Cauchy problems. This part includes the methods of spherical average and reducing dimensions; Energy inequality , the uniqueness and stabilities to wave equations; The derivation of heat equations and the method of separation of variables for solutions; Fourier transforms for solving Cauchy problems of heat equations; The maximum principle, uniqueness, stability and asymptotically behavior; The derivation of harmonic equations and related concepts; Green’s formula, Green’s functions and their applications; Strong maximum principle and the uniqueness of second boundary-value problems; The classification for second order partial differential equations and eigenvalue theory; The comparison of the three kind equations and prior evaluation; The eigenvalues theory for the first order partial differential equations with two variables; The brief introduction to generating functions. Through this course, we make students master the basic theory and method of equations of mathematical physics, the ability,of applying equations of mathematical physics to solve practical problems, with continuous learning new equations of mathematical physics and improve the ability to adapt to the requirements of development.

default.zh: 数学物理方程课程是大学理工科的一门重要的专业或技术基础课。它与现代科学与工程技术联系十分密切，是应用极其广泛的应用数学基础之一。旨在使学生了解典型数学物理方程模型建立的依据和过程、发展的科学背景，掌握经典数学物理方程基本定解问题的提法和相关的基本概念与原理，重点掌握求解基本线性偏微分方程定解问题的方法和技巧及其应用。在学生理解掌握与本课程相关的重要理论的同时，注意启发和训练他们联系其专业应用所学的知识来解决实际问题的能力，培养他们的创新思维能力和综合素质。
default.en: The course of 《Equations of Mathematics and Physics》is an important specialized basic course, which has very close relation with modern science and engineering technique and has wide use as a applying mathematical basis. By teaching students can understand the basis and processes of establishing mathematical models on typical equations of mathematics and physics, and developing scientific background. Students grasp basic problems of definite solutions on classical equations of mathematics and physics and related basic concept and principle as well as basic methods of solving definite problems on solutions for basic linear partial differential equations. Besides instructing related important theory, pay attention to enlightening and training students, so by applying learning knowledge they can enhance abilities of solving practical problems and creative new thought as well as improve their synthetic quality.

default.zh: 本课程是专为信息与计算科学，数学与应用数学本科生开设的介绍高等代数基本概念、基本理论和基本方法的课程。主要内容如下。 多项式：域，整除，最大公因式。 行列式：行列式的定义、性质和计算，Cramer 法则。 线性方程组：线性相关，极大无关组，向量组的秩，齐次、非齐次线性方程组解的结构。 矩阵：矩阵计算，矩阵初等变换，可逆矩阵，矩阵方程，矩阵的秩。 二次型：二次型的矩阵，标准形，二次型在二次曲面分类中的应用。
default.en: This course is intended to introduce fundamental methods and concepts in linear algebra for undergraduate students in mathematics and applied mathematics, information and computational science. The main contents are as follows. POLYNOMIALS: Field, Divide, Greatest Common Divisor. DETERMINANTS: Definition of Determinant, Properties of Determinant, Calculation of Determinant, Cramer Rule. SYSTEM OF LINEAR EQUATIONS: Linear Dependence, Maximal Linearly Independent Subset, Rank of Sets of Vectors, Structure of the solutions for System of Homogeneous and Non-Homogeneous Linear Equation Systems. MATRIX: Calculation of Matrix, Elementary Transformation of Matrices, Invertible Matrix, Equivalence of Matrices, Rank of a Matrix. QUADRATIC FORM: Matrix of a Quadratic Form, Canonical Form, application in the classification of quadratic surfaces.

default.zh: 通过本课程学习，使学生系统地理解和掌握数学分析的基本概念、基本理论和基本方法，培养学生综合运用数学分析的理论与方法解决问题的能力，同时也为后续课程的学习建立必要地理论基础。课程的具体建设目标如下： 1、发展数学专业低年级本科生的数学推理和证明能力：数学分析课程旨在培养学生的数学推理和证明能力。学生将学习如何运用严谨的逻辑和数学语言来构建和解决数学问题的证明。通过学习分析中的基本概念、定理和证明技巧，学生将能够理解和展示数学结论的正确性。 2、帮助数学专业本科生掌握微积分和极限理论：数学分析课程的重点之一是微积分和极限理论。学生将学习函数的极限、连续性、可微性和积分等概念，以及它们之间的关系。这将为他们提供解决实际问题的工具，例如计算曲线的斜率、确定函数的最大值和最小值，以及计算面积和体积等。 3、培养本科生抽象思维和问题解决能力：数学分析课程鼓励学生培养抽象思维和问题解决能力。学生将学习如何将实际问题转化为数学语言，并运用所学的数学工具和技巧来解决这些问题。通过分析和解决各种数学问题，学生将培养出创新思维、逻辑推理和系统化解决问题的能力。
default.en: Through the study of this course, students will systematically understand and grasp the basic concepts, theories, and methods of mathematical analysis, fostering their ability to comprehensively apply the theories and methods of mathematical analysis to solve problems. Additionally, it lays a necessary theoretical foundation for the learning of subsequent courses. The specific construction objectives of this course are as follows: Develop mathematical reasoning and proof abilities among junior undergraduate students majoring in mathematics: The mathematical analysis course aims to cultivate students' mathematical reasoning and proof abilities. Students will learn how to use rigorous logic and mathematical language to construct and solve mathematical proofs. By studying the basic concepts, theorems, and proof techniques in analysis, students will be able to understand and demonstrate the correctness of mathematical conclusions. Assist undergraduate students majoring in mathematics in mastering calculus and limit theory: One of the focal points of the mathematical analysis course is calculus and limit theory. Students will learn concepts such as limits of functions, continuity, differentiability, and integration, as well as the relationships between them. This will provide them with tools to solve practical problems, such as calculating the slope of a curve, determining the maximum and minimum values of a function, and calculating areas and volumes. Cultivate undergraduate students' abstract thinking and problem-solving abilities: The mathematical analysis course encourages students to develop abstract thinking and problem-solving abilities. Students will learn how to transform practical problems into mathematical language and apply the mathematical tools and techniques they have learned to solve these problems. Through analyzing and solving various mathematical problems, students will develop innovative thinking, logical reasoning, and systematic problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 本课程是专为信息与计算科学，数学与应用数学本科生开设的介绍高等代数基本概念、基本理论和基本方法的课程。主要内容如下。 向量空间：线性相关，极大无关组，向量空间的基与维数，坐标向量。 线性变换：特征值，特征向量，不变子空间。 多项式矩阵：Jordan标准形，有理标准形。 欧几里得空间：内积，正交基，正交变换，酉空间 双线性函数：线性函数，双线性函数，对称双线性函数
default.en: This course is intended to introduce fundamental methods and concepts in linear algebra for undergraduate students in mathematics and applied mathematics, information and computational science. The main contents are as follows. VECTOR SPACES: Linear Dependence, Maximal Linearly Independent Subset, Rank of Sets of Vectors, Bases and Dimensions of Vector Space, Coordinates of Vectors. LINEAR TRANSFORMATION: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors, Invariant Subspaces. POLYNOMIAL-MATRIX: Jordan Canonical Form, Rational Canonical Form. EUCLID SPACES: Inner Product, Orthogonal Bases, Orthogonal Linear Transformations, Unitary Spaces. BILINEAR FUNCTION: Linear Function, Bilinear Function, Symmetric Bilinear Function

default.zh: 《数学分析（2）》是数学专业本科生的一门核心基础课程，承接《数学分析（1）》的内容，进一步深入探讨级数理论、多元微积分以及函数空间等现代分析学的基础内容。本课程总学时为104学时，另设40学时课外辅导，共计6.5学分，在春季学期开设。学生需先修《数学分析（1）》和《高等代数与解析几何（1）》，具备一定的数学推理和函数分析基础。 本课程的教学目标主要体现在三个方面：一是培养学生的数学推理与证明能力，使其能够运用严谨的逻辑和数学语言构建和完成数学论证；二是使学生掌握数项级数、函数项级数、幂级数、Fourier级数以及多元函数微分与积分等核心内容，为后续课程如实变函数、泛函分析等打下坚实基础；三是通过抽象思维和问题解决训练，提升学生将实际问题转化为数学模型并运用分析工具解决问题的能力。 课程内容涵盖广泛，从数项级数的敛散性判别开始，逐步引入函数列与函数项级数的一致收敛性、幂级数展开与性质、Fourier级数及其收敛性，再到度量空间与赋范线性空间的基本概念，最后深入讲解多元函数的极限、连续性、微分与极值问题。每个主题都配有相应的课堂教学和习题训练，强调理论与应用的结合。 教学方法以教师讲授为主，结合课堂讨论、习题讲解和学生报告等多种形式，鼓励学生积极参与和主动思考。通过每周作业、随堂测验和定期考试，全面评估学生的学习成效。考核方式包括平时成绩（40%）、期中考试（20%）和期末考试（40%），注重过程性与终结性评价的结合。 教材选用J. Dixmier的《Cours de mathématiques du premier cycle》，参考书包括邹应、卓里奇和Godement的经典分析学教材，兼顾中西方数学教育的优势，帮助学生从多角度理解分析学的精髓。 总之，《数学分析（2）》不仅是一门知识传授课程，更是一种思维训练和能力培养的过程。它旨在为学生奠定坚实的数学基础，培养其严谨的逻辑思维和创新能力，为未来从事数学研究或相关应用领域工作提供必要的理论支撑和实践能力。
default.en: Course Overview Mathematical Analysis (2) is a fundamental course for mathematics majors, building upon the concepts introduced in Mathematical Analysis (1). This course delves deeper into the theories of series, multivariate calculus, and function spaces, which are essential for advanced studies in real analysis, functional analysis, and applied mathematics. The course is structured to enhance students’ abstract reasoning, proof-writing skills, and ability to solve complex mathematical problems. Course Objectives The course aims to achieve three primary goals: To develop students’ ability to construct rigorous mathematical proofs using logical reasoning and precise language. To equip students with a solid understanding of numerical series, functional series, power series, Fourier series, and multivariate differential calculus. To foster abstract thinking and problem-solving skills by applying analytical tools to theoretical and practical problems. Course Content The curriculum is comprehensive and includes the following key topics: Convergence tests for numerical series (positive, alternating, absolute, conditional) Concepts of pointwise and uniform convergence for sequences and series of functions Properties and applications of power series and Taylor expansions Fourier series: definitions, convergence modes, and applications Introduction to metric spaces, normed spaces, and Banach spaces Limits, continuity, differentiability, and extremum problems for multivariate functions Implicit and inverse function theorems Each topic is taught through lectures supplemented with problem-solving sessions, class discussions, and regular assessments to ensure conceptual clarity and practical proficiency. Teaching Methods The course employs a variety of teaching strategies: Lectures and demonstrations by instructors to explain core concepts and proofs Interactive class discussions to encourage critical thinking and collaborative learning Regular problem sets and exercises to reinforce theoretical knowledge through practice Tutorial sessions for individualized support and deeper exploration of challenging topics Assessment Methods Student performance is evaluated through a combination of: Weekly homework and in-class quizzes (40%) Midterm examination (20%) Final examination (40%) Both exams are closed-book and designed to assess understanding, application, and synthesis of course material. Textbooks and References Main Textbook: J. Dixmier, Cours de mathématiques du premier cycle (2nd ed.). Gauthier-Villars, 1976. Recommended References: Zou Ying, Mathematical Analysis (1st ed.). Higher Education Press, 1995. V.A. Zorich, Mathematical Analysis (7th ed.). Higher Education Press, 2019. R. Godement, Analysis I (2nd edition). Springer, 2004.

default.zh: 本课程以极限论、实数的基本定理、函数的连续与一致连续性、函数的可导性等为研究对象来详细介绍数列极限与函数极限的定义及其性质；数列极限与函数极限的关系；实数的基本定理：子列，上、下确界，上、下确界原理，单调有界数列必有极限，区间套定理，列紧性，完备性（Cauchy收敛原理），紧性（有限覆盖定理）；6个等价定理的直接互证；函数的连续性与一致连续性；闭区间上连续函数的性质；导数与微分；微分中值定理及其应用等。
default.en: In this course we study the theory of limits, the elementary theory of real numbers, the continuity and uniform continuity of functions, the differentiability of functions etc. as the main subject to discuss in details the definitions and properties of the limits of scalar sequences and the limits of functions, the relationship between the limits of scalar sequences and the limits of functions, the elementary theory of real numbers: subsequences, supremum and infimum, the principle of supremum and infimum, the existence of limit for a monotone and bounded sequence , the theorem of nested intervals, sequential compactness, completeness (Cauchy’s criterion of convergence) , compactness (the theorem of finite covering), the mutual proofs of the six equivalent theorems, the continuity and uniform continuity of functions, the properties of continuous functions on closed invervals, derivatives and differentials, mean value theorem and its applications.

default.zh: 又称高级微积分，分析学中最古老、最基本的分支。一般指以微积分学和无穷级数一般理论为主要内容，并包括它们的理论基础（实数、函数和极限的基本理论）的一个较为完整的数学学科。它也是大学数学专业的一门基础课程。数学中的分析分支是专门研究实数与复数及其函数的数学分支。它的发展由微积分开始，并扩展到函数的连续性、可微分及可积分等各种特性。这些特性，有助我们应用在对物理世界的研究，研究及发现自然界的规律。
default.en: Also known as advanced calculus, it is the oldest and most fundamental branch of analysis. Generally, it refers to a relatively complete mathematical discipline with Calculus and the general theory of infinite series as its main content and including their theoretical basis (the basic theory of real numbers, functions and limits). It is also a fundamental course for university mathematics majors. The analytical branch of mathematics is a specialized branch of mathematics that studies real and complex numbers and their functions. Its development began with calculus and extended to various properties such as continuity, differentiability, and integrability of functions. These characteristics help us apply them to the study of the physical world, as well as to discover the laws of nature.

default.zh: 高等代数是数学与应用数学、信息与计算科学以及统计专业的三大基础课之一。该课程的知识体系是进一步学习常微分方程、数值代数、泛函分析等数学类后继课的基石，是学习计算机理论、控制理论、信息理论等其他现代科学的工具。贯穿该课程的抽象思维和逻辑推理对培养学生现代数学思想，形成科研创新能力有着重要作用。 课程目标1：使学生理解高等代数的基本概念、掌握高等代数的理论体系、获得高等代数的思想方法； 课程目标2：使学生受到运用高等代数方法解决实际问题的初步训练，为后续课程的学习和继续深造奠定坚实的基础： 课程目标3：使学生获得借助高等代数的理论进行合理抽象、逻辑推理、综合分析的能力。
default.en: Advanced algebra is one of the three foundational courses for majors in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics, Information and Computing Science, and Statistics. The knowledge system of this course serves as the cornerstone for further studies in subsequent mathematical disciplines such as Ordinary Differential Equations, Numerical Algebra, and Functional Analysis, as well as a tool for learning other modern sciences like Computer Theory, Control Theory, and Information Theory. The abstract thinking and logical reasoning emphasized throughout the course play a vital role in cultivating students' modern mathematical thinking and fostering their ability for scientific research and innovation. Course Objective 1: Enable students to comprehend the fundamental concepts of Advanced Algebra, master its theoretical framework, and acquire its methodological approaches. Course Objective 2: Provide students with preliminary training in applying Advanced Algebra methods to solve practical problems, laying a solid foundation for subsequent courses and further academic pursuits. Course Objective 3: Equip students with the ability to engage in rational abstraction, logical reasoning, and comprehensive analysis using the theories of this course.

default.zh: 高等代数是数学与应用数学、信息与计算科学以及统计专业的三大基础课之一。该课程的知识体系是进一步学习常微分方程、数值代数、泛函分析等数学类后继课的基石，是学习计算机理论、控制理论、信息理论等其他现代科学的工具。贯穿该课程的抽象思维和逻辑推理对培养学生现代数学思想，形成科研创新能力有着重要作用。 课程目标1：使学生理解高等代数的基本概念、掌握高等代数的理论体系、获得高等代数的思想方法； 课程目标2：使学生受到运用高等代数方法解决实际问题的初步训练，为后续课程的学习和继续深造奠定坚实的基础： 课程目标3：使学生获得借助高等代数的理论进行合理抽象、逻辑推理、综合分析的能力。
default.en: Advanced algebra is one of the three foundational courses for majors in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics, Information and Computing Science, and Statistics. The knowledge system of this course serves as the cornerstone for further studies in subsequent mathematical disciplines such as Ordinary Differential Equations, Numerical Algebra, and Functional Analysis, as well as a tool for learning other modern sciences like Computer Theory, Control Theory, and Information Theory. The abstract thinking and logical reasoning emphasized throughout the course play a vital role in cultivating students' modern mathematical thinking and fostering their ability for scientific research and innovation. Course Objective 1: Enable students to comprehend the fundamental concepts of Advanced Algebra, master its theoretical framework, and acquire its methodological approaches. Course Objective 2: Provide students with preliminary training in applying Advanced Algebra methods to solve practical problems, laying a solid foundation for subsequent courses and further academic pursuits. Course Objective 3: Equip students with the ability to engage in rational abstraction, logical reasoning, and comprehensive analysis using the theories of this course.

default.zh: 实变函数是现代数学的组成部分,它与其他数学分支（概率论、梯度流等）有着广泛的联系,是数学类专业的核心课程,也是本科教育阶段最难以掌握的课程，主要原因是本课程涉及的分析方法都是构造性证明。本课程将通过带领学生熟悉课堂讲授内容、熟练掌握所学解题方法，使学生系统地理解和掌握实变函数论的基本概念、基本理论和基本方法，培养学生综合运用硬分析的理论与方法提高解决问题的能力，同时也为后续课程的学习建立必要的理论基础。
default.en: Functions of Real Variables are the integral part of modern mathematics. It has extensive connections with other branches of mathematics (probability theory, gradient flow, etc.). It is a core course for mathematics majors and the most difficult course to master in undergraduate education. The main reason is that this course The analytical methods involved in the course are all constructive proofs. This course will enable students to systematically understand and master the basic concepts, basic theories and basic methods of real variable function theory by leading students to become familiar with the classroom teaching content and master the problem-solving methods they have learned, and train students to comprehensively apply the theories and methods of hard analysis Improve problem-solving abilities while also establishing the necessary theoretical foundation for subsequent courses.

default.zh: 第一章 复数与平面拓扑 复数及其几何表示，复平面的拓扑。 第二章 解析函数 复变函数的导数，解析函数，初等函数。 第三章 复变函数的积分 复变函数的积分，柯西定理，莫勒拉定理，代数学基本定理，柯西公式，解析函数的高阶导数公式。 第四章 级数 级数和序列的基本性质，泰勒展开式，复变函数项级数和复变函数序列，解析函数的洛朗展开式。 第五章 留数 解析函数的孤立奇点，解析函数在无穷远点的性质，整函数与亚纯函数的概念，留数的一般理论，留数计算，留数计算的应用，亚纯函数的零点与极点的个数、儒歇定理。 第六章 保形映射 导数的几何意义，单叶解析函数的映射性质，分式线性函数及其映射性质，两个特殊的分式线性函数，最大模原理、施瓦茨引理，黎曼定理及边界对应概念。 第七章 解析开拓 解析开拓的一般概念，沿曲线的解析开拓，单值性定理。 第八章 调和函数 调和函数及其性质，中值公式与泊松公式、极值原理，狄利克雷问题。
default.en: Properties of complex numbers, Some elementary functions, Analytic functions, Complex integrals, Cauchy’s theorem, Cauchy’s integral formula, Maximum modulus theorem and harmonic functions, Convergent series of analytic functions, Power series and Taylor’s theorem, Laurent series and classifications of singularities, Calculation of residues, The resiedue theorem, Evaluation of definite integral, Basic theory of comformal mappings, Fractional linear and Schwarz-Christoffel transformations, Analytic continuation and Riemann surface, Rouch’s theorem and principle of the argument, Mapping properties of analytic functions, Riemann’s theorem,Asymptotic methods, Basic properties of harmonic functions, Construction of harmonic functions, The Poission representation.

default.zh: 概率论是数学系各专业学生必修的重要专业基础课，该课程也是概率与统计专业学生后续课程的基础。区别于之前数学系课程，本课程将通过课堂教学、练习，讨论等环节，带领学生们认识如何刻画和研究“随机性现象”，建立概率思想，已解决概率统计问题。 本课程将为学生讲授概率理论的思想、方法、及应用。课程以介绍基本概率理论为主，主要包括事件与概率，条件概率与统计独立性，随机变量与分布函数，数字特征与特征函数，极限定理五个部分。课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试，平时作业与课程报告三部分。
default.en: Probability theory is one of most important courses to all students in Mathematics Department, which also is a knowledge foundation of the latter specialty lessons of Probability and Statistics Major. Distinguishing from previous mathematics courses, this course focuses on research of random phenomenon. This course introduce students the thinking method and applications in probability theory, which mainly includes evens and probability, conditional probability and statistics independence, random variables and distribution functions, numerical？characteristics and characteristic functions, and limited theory. After finishing the lesson students should know the theoretical foundation and its applications, and be able to analyze common random problems. The final performance is assessed based on the final exam, homework, and course reports.

default.zh: 第一章 复数与平面拓扑：复数及其几何表示，复平面的拓扑。 第二章 解析函数：复变函数的导数，解析函数，初等函数。 第三章 复变函数的积分: 复变函数的积分，柯西定理，莫勒拉定理，代数学基本定理，柯西公式，解析函数的高阶导数公式。 第四章 级数: 级数和序列的基本性质，泰勒展开式，复变函数项级数和复变函数序列，解析函数的洛朗展开式。 第五章 留数: 解析函数的孤立奇点，解析函数在无穷远点的性质，整函数与亚纯函数的概念，留数的一般理论，留数计算，留数计算的应用，亚纯函数的零点与极点的个数、儒歇定理。 第六章 保形映射: 导数的几何意义，单叶解析函数的映射性质，分式线性函数及其映射性质，两个特殊的分式线性函数，最大模原理、施瓦茨引理，黎曼定理及边界对应概念。 第七章 解析开拓: 解析开拓的一般概念，沿曲线的解析开拓，单值性定理。 第八章 调和函数: 调和函数及其性质，中值公式与泊松公式、极值原理，狄利克雷问题。
default.en: Properties of complex numbers, Some elementary functions, Analytic functions, Complex integrals, Cauchy’s theorem, Cauchy’s integral formula, Maximum modulus theorem and harmonic functions, Convegent series of analytic functions, Power series and Taylor’s theorem, Laurent series and classifications of singularities, Calculation of residues, The resiedue theorem, Evaluation of definite integral, Basic theory of comformal mappings, Fractional linear and Schwarz-Christoffel transformations, Analytic continuation and Riemann surface, Rouch’s theorem and principle of the argument, Mapping properties of analytic functions, Riemann’s theorem, Asymptotic methods, Basic properties of harmonic functions, Construction of harmonic functions, The Poission representation.

default.zh: 近世代数是数学专业的核心课程，以研究代数结构（如群、环、域、模等）及其关系为核心，具有高度抽象性和广泛适用性。其教学要求和特点如下： 一、教学要求 核心内容： - 群论：群的定义、子群、循环群、正规子群、商群、同态基本定理、对称群与置换。 - 环论：环的定义、理想、商环、整环/域、唯一分解整环、欧几里得整环、多项式环。 - 域论：域的定义、域扩张、代数扩张域超越扩张、分裂域有限域。 - 基本应用：拉格朗日定理、中国剩余定理。 - 技能要求： - 能证明简单定理（如“阶为素数的群必为循环群”）。 - 熟悉典型例子：剩余类群、置换群、矩阵群、唯一分解整环、欧几里得整环、多项式环。 二、课程特点 1. 抽象性与公理化 - 以公理定义结构（如群的四条公理），强调严格逻辑推导。 - 例子：从“对称性”抽象出群的定义，从“整数运算”抽象出环和域。 2. 结构性思维 - 关注对象的整体性质（如阶、同构、子结构、商结构）而非单个元素。 - 例子：研究群的同态定理而非单个群元素的运算。 3. 广泛联系性 - 与数论、几何、拓扑、密码学、物理（如晶体对称性）等领域深度关联。 - 例子：伽罗瓦理论链接域扩张与多项式求根。 4. 阶梯式难度 - 从具体例子（如置换群、整数环）过渡到抽象理论（如自由群、诺特环）。 - 高阶内容（如范畴语言、同调代数）需要较强的适应能力。
default.en: Modern algebra is a core course in mathematics. It focuses on studying algebraic structures (such as groups, rings, fields, modules, etc.) and their relationships. It is highly abstract and widely applicable. Its teaching requirements and characteristics are as follows: 1. Teaching requirements Core content: - Group theory: definition of group, subgroup, cyclic group, normal subgroup, quotient group, fundamental theorem of homomorphism, symmetric group and permutation. - Ring theory: definition of ring, ideal, quotient rings, integral domain/field, unique fatorization domains, Euclidean domains, polynomial rings. - Field theory: definition of field, field extension, algebraic extension field transcendental extension, splitting fields, finite fields. - Basic application: Lagrange's theorem, Chinese remainder theorem. - Skill requirements: - Able to prove simple theorems (such as "a group with a prime order must be a cyclic group"). - Familiar with typical examples: remainder group, permutation group, matrix group, unique decomposition integral ring, Euclidean domains, polynomial rings. 2. Course features 1. Abstractness and Axiomatization - Define structures with axioms (such as the four axioms of groups), emphasizing strict logical deduction. - Example: abstract the definition of groups from "symmetry", and abstract rings and fields from "integer operations". 2. Structural thinking - Focus on the overall properties of objects (such as order, isomorphism, substructure, quotient structure) rather than individual elements. - Example: Study the homomorphism theorem of groups rather than the operations of individual group elements. 3. Extensive connections - Deeply related to number theory, geometry, topology, cryptography, physics (such as crystal symmetry) and other fields. - Example: Galois theory links field expansion with polynomial root finding. 4. Step-by-step difficulty - From concrete examples (such as permutation groups, integer rings) to abstract theories (such as free groups, Noetherian rings). - High-level content (such as categorical language, homological algebra) requires strong adaptability.

default.zh: 本课程为数学分析的进阶课程。我们将采用比较现代的观点，介绍多变元微积分的基础知识，并将以此为基础，介绍一般流形上基于微分形式等基本工具的分析。本课程同时配备旨在增进理解的大量练习题。课程也将为微分几何、代数拓扑、泛函分析、实变与复变函数、微分方程等后续课程做准备。
default.en: This course is an advanced course on mathematical analysis. Adopting a modern point of view, we shall introduce multivariable calculus, and based on this, introduce analysis on general manifolds using basic tools such as differential forms. This course will be accompanied by an abundant supply of problem sets aiming to enhance comprehension. The course also serves as preparation to subsequent courses such as differential geometry, algebraic topology, functional analysis, real and complex analysis and differential equations et cetera.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生运用基础拓扑学理论和方法解决问题的能力，同时为后续课程奠定必要的理论基础。课程分为两部分：第一部分重点讲解点集拓扑学的基本概念，第二部分将引导学生初步了解代数拓扑学。 在第一部分中，学生将学习拓扑空间中的核心概念，包括收敛性、连续性、连通性、分离公理、紧致性以及拓扑空间的紧化。课程还将探讨如何通过积拓扑、和拓扑及商拓扑等方法从已有拓扑构造新的拓扑空间，并介绍一致收敛、一致空间和贝尔纲定理等工具。这些概念和方法在数学的诸多领域（如泛函分析、高等测度与概率论以及严格分析）中均有广泛应用。 第二部分将介绍如何通过给拓扑空间赋予群结构来研究其性质，学生将学习在数学论证中运用同伦和基本群等概念。这些工具将帮助学生抽象地分析空间的结构特性，并为后续课程（如微分拓扑、泛函分析、高等代数几何和群论）打下基础。作为应用，课程将演示如何计算某些空间的基本群，并展示如何利用这些工具证明重要定理，如布劳威尔不动点定理和代数基本定理。
default.en: The course aims to develop students' ability to solve problems using the theories and methods of basic topology, while also laying the necessary theoretical foundation for subsequent courses. The course will have two parts: The first part focuses on basic notions of point-set topology, the second part will introduce students to the beginnings of algebraic topology. In the first part, students will learn to use the core concepts of convergence and continuity in topological spaces, as well as connectedness and separation axioms, compactness, and compactifications of topological spaces. We will also study various ways of making new topologies from old ones such as product, sum, and quotient topologies. We will also touch upon more specific tools such as uniform convergence and uniform spaces, as well as the Baire category theorem. These tools and ideas are used in nearly every mathematical field, for instance, in functional analysis, advanced measure and probability theory, and hard analysis. In the second part, students will be introduced to the methods of attaching groups to topological spaces in order to gain information about these spaces. Thus, they will learn to use concepts such as homotopy and fundamental groups in their mathematical arguments. These tools will enable students to abstractly analyze the structural properties of spaces and lay the groundwork for advanced courses like differential topology, functional analysis, advanced algebraic geometry and advanced group theory. As applications, we will show how to compute the fundamental groups of some spaces and we will also show how these tools can be used to prove important theorems like the Brouwer fixed point theorem and the fundamental theorem of algebra.

default.zh: 常微分方程是数学与应用数学、物理学、工程学等领域的核心课程之一，主要研究包含未知函数及其导数的方程，并探讨其解的存在性、唯一性、稳定性及实际应用。课程通常从一阶微分方程的基本解法入手，涵盖可分离变量、齐次方程、线性方程及恰当方程等经典类型，随后扩展到高阶线性微分方程，特别是常系数线性方程的特征根法与拉普拉斯变换。此外，课程还会涉及微分方程组的解法，如矩阵指数法，以及稳定性理论的初步概念，例如相平面分析和李雅普诺夫函数。在应用方面，常微分方程广泛用于描述动力系统、人口模型、电路振荡、机械振动等实际问题，学生将通过建模与求解过程深刻理解数学工具在自然科学与工程技术中的桥梁作用。 其主要内容：一阶ODE解法、高阶线性ODE、线性方程组的特征解法等、 稳定性与定性理论、数值方法、主要的应用案例。
default.en: Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) form a foundational subject in mathematics, physics, and engineering, focusing on equations that involve unknown functions and their derivatives. The course typically begins with analytical techniques for first-order ODEs, including separable variables, homogeneous equations, linear equations, and exact equations. It then progresses to higher-order linear differential equations, emphasizing methods like characteristic roots and Laplace transforms for constant-coefficient systems. Students also explore systems of ODEs solved via matrix exponentials and gain introductory insights into stability theory, such as phase plane analysis and Lyapunov functions. Practical applications are a key component, with ODEs modeling dynamical systems, population growth, electrical circuits, and mechanical vibrations. Through problem-solving and modeling exercises, learners develop the ability to translate real-world phenomena into mathematical frameworks, highlighting the interdisciplinary power of ODEs in science and technology. The key topics as follows: First-order ODEs、Higher-order Linear ODEs、Systems of ODEs involving eigenvalue solutions method. Stability & Qualitative Theory、Numerical Methods、Real world applications.

default.zh: 本课程将系统地介绍随机过程的基本概念、主要结果和推导论证，引导学生应用所学知识解决科学、工程、金融及社会生活中的问题。课程分为三个部分。第一部分介绍条件期望，内容包括条件期望的定义、性质与计算。第二部分介绍鞅论，内容包括停时，Doob极大不等式，鞅收敛定理，停止定理，倒向鞅。第三部分介绍马尔科夫链，内容包括强马氏性、状态分类、不变测度、遍历定理等。
default.en: In this course, we will introduce the basic concepts, main results and derivations of some common stochastic processes. In addition, we will try to help students learn how to solve problems in science, engineering, finance and those emerged in our ordinary life. There are three parts in this course. In the first part, we introduce conditional expectation, including the definition, basic properties and its calculations. In the second part, we will introduce the theory of martingales, including stopping times, Doob maximal inequality, convergence theorem, stopping theorems and backward martingale. In the third part, we will introduce Markov chains, including strong Markov propert, the classification of states, invariant measure and ergodic theorems.

default.zh: 点集拓扑学是近代数学的重要分支，主要研究一般拓扑空间的结构以及拓扑空间上的连续映射。点集拓扑学是学习泛函分析，拓扑群，代数拓扑，黎曼几何，微分拓扑学等数学分支的基础，点集拓扑学课程主要讲授度量空间和拓扑空间的结构及连续映射，邻域系，基和子基，子空间，积空间和商空间、连通性，连通分支，局部连通空间，道路连通空间，第一二可数公理，可分空间，各种分离性，Urysohn引理和Tietze扩张定理，各种紧致性及相互关系等内容。本课程不仅可以培养学生空间想象力，抽象思维和逻辑推理的能力，还能帮助学生开拓视野，培养学生构造例子和反例的能力。通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解现代抽象数学的基本特点，熟悉基本的拓扑学概念，深入理解收敛性的本质，掌握分析较简单空间结构的方法，为以后相关专业课程的学习奠定基础。
default.en: General topology is an important branch of modern mathematics. It mainly studies the structure of general topological spaces and the continuous mapping in topological spaces. General topology is foundation of learning a functional analysis, topological groups, algebraic topology, Riemann geometry, differential topology and other branches of mathematics. The course provides structure of metric spaces and topological spaces and continuous mappings, neighborhood system, basis and subbasis, subspace, product space and quotient space, connectivity, connected component, locally connected space, path connected space, the first and second countable axiom, separable space, various separation, Urysohn lemma and Tietze extension theorem, the contents of various compactness and relationship etc.. This course not only train students' spatial imagination, abstract thinking and logical reasoning, but also help students broaden their horizons and train students' ability of constructing examples and counterexamples. Through this course, students can understand the basic characteristics of modern abstract mathematics, familiar with the basic concepts of topology, in-depth understanding of the nature of the convergence, master the method of analyzing simple structure of spaces, and lay the foundation for related course in future.

default.zh: 点集拓扑学是数学系相关专业的专业基础课，是进一步学习代数拓扑，拓扑群，微分拓扑，黎曼几何，泛函分析，李群等后继课的基础。在培养学生抽象思维能力，逻辑分析和推理能力以及表达能力方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要讲授一般拓扑空间的结构，以及这些空间的分类。本课程可以使学生了解现代数学的特点，熟悉抽象数学的分析问题和处理问题的方式，掌握经典抽象空间的性质，通过本课程的课堂教学，着重培养学生严谨的逻辑分析和推理能力，以及运用抽象理论。方法和工具解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: General topology is a professional basic course for the related majors of the Department of Mathematics, and it is the basis for further learning algebraic topology, topological groups, differential topology, Riemannian geometry, functional analysis, Li Qun and other subsequent courses. It occupies an important position in training students' abstract thinking ability, logical analysis and reasoning ability and expression ability. This course mainly teaches the structure of general topological spaces and the classification of these spaces. This course enables students to understand the characteristics of modern mathematics, familiar with the analysis problems of abstract mathematics and the way to deal with problems, master the nature of classic abstract space, through the classroom teaching of this course, focus on training students' rigorous logic analysis and reasoning ability Abstract theory. Methods and tools to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 微分几何是用微积分学研究几何中的问题的一门数学学科，它起源于古典微分几何，即研究三维欧氏空间中的曲线和曲面的数学分支，这个分支从微积分创立最初就开始了，高斯把它系统化，并且发现了内蕴几何，粗略地讲，内蕴几何的含义就是不需要借助于三维欧氏空间就可以刻画曲面的性质，这使得我们可以脱离三维空间而独立研究二维曲面，黎曼把这个理论发展为黎曼几何，其研究对象是任意维数的弯曲空间，经过黎曼、Ricci、Levi-Civita等人的推动，流形、张量、联络、曲率等概念都建立起来了，这就是现代微分几何理论的雏形。 本课程是面向数学与应用数学专业高年级学生的一门专业课，主要内容是古典微分几何，目的是用微积分的工具研究嵌入到三维欧氏空间中的曲线和曲面，主要内容包括曲线论和曲面论。另外，本课程还将引导学生探索嵌入到更高维欧氏空间中的超曲面的性质，以及一般的微分流形概念。 本课程的目标是使学生掌握用微积分学研究几何对象的基本思想，理解曲线论和曲面论的基本内容，激发学生对数学的兴趣、体会几何学的美感，并且为继续深入学习和研究现代微分几何以及黎曼几何打好基础。
default.en: Differential geometry is a mathematical discipline which uses the techniques of calculus to study problems in geometry. The first subject of differential geometry is to study curves and surfaces in the 3-dimensial Euclidean space developing from the beginning of the establishment of Calculus which is systematized by Gauss now often called the classical differential geometry. Gauss also found the intrinsic geometry. Roughly speaking, he found some properties of 2-dimensial surfaces independent of 3-dimensial Euclidean space so that we can study surfaces without the introduction of 3-dimensial Euclidean space. Riemann develop this theory to curved space of higher dimension which is called Riemannian geometry later. With the promotion of many mathematicians such as Riemann, Ricci and Levi-Civita, the concepts of manifold, tensor, connection and curvature are established which is the beginning of modern theory of differential geometry. The course is for senior undergraduates which is focused on the classical differential geometry whose purpose is to study curves and surfaces embedding in the 3-dimensial Euclidean space using the techniques of calculus. The main parts of the course include the theory of curves and surfaces. Besides, we also lead the students to explore the properties of hypersurfaces embedding in Euclidean spaces of higher dimension and the concept of differentiable manifold. Our aim is to make the students master the main idea of using techniques of calculus to study geometric problems, understand the basic contents of the theory of curves and surfaces. We also want to arouse the interests of students and make them realize the beauty of geometry. Furthermore, this course is also a guide to Riemannian geometry and modern differential geometry.

default.zh: 信息论基础讲授信息的度量，信源编码方法，信道编码定理，并利用python实现相关应用。
default.en: Elements of information theory covers information measures, source coding, and channel coding theorem, etc. It also requires theory realization through python.

default.zh: 这门课程主要介绍常微分方程和偏微分方程的数值方法。
default.en: This course covers numerical methods for ordinary differential equations and partial differential equations.

default.zh: 回归分析是确定两种或两种以上变量间相互依赖的定量关系的一种统计分析方法，该学科是统计学中的一个重要的分支。主要学习内容包括掌握回归模型的参数估计，理解最小二乘估计的性质，会对回归方程做出显著性检验，理解预测和控制；掌握多元线性回归模型的特点和基本假设、中心化和标准化，掌握回归模型的参数估计、相关矩阵和偏相关系数等
default.en: Regression analysis is a statistical analysis method that determines the quantitative relationship between two or more variables, which is an important branch of statistics. The main learning contents include mastering the parameter estimation of the regression model, understanding the nature of the least squares estimation, making a significant test on the regression equation, understanding the prediction and control, mastering the characteristics and basic assumptions, centralization and standardization of the multiple linear regression model. Master the concepts of parameter estimation, correlation matrix and partial correlation coefficient of regression model; master the residual and its simple properties, the linear diagnosis of regression function, and the diagnosis of homogeneity of error variance.

default.zh: 通过本课程中常见的统计计算理论和方法的学习，培养学生较强的统计分析和应用能力，达到自主学习和分析解决应用统计问题的目的。要求学生较全面地掌握常见的统计计算原理和算法，基于R/MATLAB实现对统计计算原理和算法的求解和分析等，并能灵活运用；能够利用常见的统计计算算法和理论等基本知识，为应用问题设计有效的统计模型，并利用R/MATLAB进行程序设计，通过统计计算和程序实验的方法理解统计计算中的各种算法及原理，从而更好地理解统计计算的基本理论，达到可熟练应用统计计算原理和算法来求解和分析实际问题的目的。
default.en: Through the study of the statistical calculation theories and methods commonly used in this course, students will develop strong statistical analysis and application ability to achieve self-learning and analysis to solve the application of statistical problems. Students are required to have a more comprehensive grasp of common statistical calculation principles and algorithms, and to solve and analyze statistical calculation principles and algorithms based on R/MATLAB, and to use them flexibly; they can use common statistical calculation algorithms and theoretical basic knowledge. Apply an effective statistical model to the application problem, and use R/MATLAB to design the program, and understand various algorithms and principles in statistical calculation through statistical calculation and program experiment, so as to better understand the basic theory of statistical calculation and achieve proficiency. Apply statistical calculation principles and algorithms to solve and analyze the purpose of practical problems.

default.zh: 数理统计是以概率论为理论基础，应用概率论和数学方法，研究怎样收集带有随机影响的信息和数据，建立适当的随机数学模型（统计模型），并在设定的统计模型之下，对这种信息与数据进行统计分析，以对所研究的问题作出统计推断和决策。数理统计作为应用数学中最重要、最活跃的学科之一，它在自然科学和社会科学中的应用越来越广泛深入，在国民经济和科学技术中的作用也越来越重要。随着大数据时代的来临，作为本科生，应该具备数理统计的基础知识、掌握其思想方法和数据分析的能力。本课程突出数理统计的特点，注重统计思想方法的介绍，重视统计的应用性，培养学生的数据收集分析的动手能力。本课程讲授了数理统计的基本概念、数据分析、估计问题、假设检验、方差分析等内容。
default.en: Mathematical statistics is based on probability theory, it applies probability theory and mathematical method, researches how to collect information and data with random effects, establishes appropriate mathematical models (random statistical model), statistical analysis of the data and information by the statistical model, to make statistical inference and decision of study on the problem. Mathematical statistics is one of applied Mathematics as the most important and active subject, it has been applied in natural science and Social Science in the more extensive, in the national economy and science and technology in a more and more important role. With the arrival of the big data era, as a undergraduate, we should have the basic knowledge of mathematical statistics, and grasp the ability of thinking and data analysis. This course emphasizes the characteristics of mathematical statistics, pays attention to the introduction of statistical thinking methods, emphasizes the application of statistics, and trains students' ability of data collection and analysis. This course introduces the basic concepts of mathematical statistics, data analysis, estimation problems, hypothesis testing, variance analysis and so on.

default.zh: 本课程将介绍数值代数领域的重要数值方法及理论，着重讨论线性方程组及非线性方程组的直接方法和迭代方法，详细阐述数值格式的构造流程、稳定性分析及计算精度等。特别地，在学习向量范数及矩阵范数的基础上，对于线性方程组，将关注消元法、三角分解法、共轭梯度法、正交对角化法等，且也会介绍如Jacobi迭代和Gauss-Seidel迭代的构造过程及收敛性判定。对于非线性方程及方程组，将简要叙述单点迭代法及其收敛性，将详细给出Newton法及其在单根和重根上的收敛阶。通过本课程的学习，不仅让同学们掌握经典的数值方法，更提高解决实际工程问题的能力。
default.en: This course will introduce some important numerical methods and theory in the field of numerical algebra. The direct and iterative methods for solving linear and nonlinear system of equations will be discussed. Construction procedure, stability analysis and computational accuracy of numerical schemes will be explained in detail. In particular, based on the knowledge of vector and matrix norms, the elimination methods, the triangular decomposition methods, the conjugate gradient method as well as the orthogonal diagonalization methods will be concerned for solving linear systems of equations. The construction and convergence judgment of Jacobi and Gauss-Seidel iterative methods will also be presented. For nonlinear equations and systems, The Picard iterative process and its convergence analysis will be briefly given. The Newton method and the convergence order at single and multiple roots will be illustrated in detail. After auditing the current course, students are expected to grasp classical numerical methods and to enhance the ability in solving practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 数值逼近是面向数学类专业本科学生非常重要的专业核心课，是学习后续专业课的基础。课程主要讲授常见逼近问题的数值方法的基本原理、构造方式、分析方式等，重点使学生了解数值逼近的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握常见的数值逼近方法的构造和分析方法，并具有解决实际问题的能力；掌握常见的数值逼近中的实践工具，逐步具有应用先进工具解决实际逼近问题的能力。 本课程主要讲授内容包括误差分析及避免误差的方法、多项式插值方法、曲线拟合方法、最佳一致和平方逼近、数值积分和数值微分方法等。本课程在教学中会穿插平时测评，课后有作业。 课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时和上机报告等。
default.en: Numerical approximation is a very important course for undergraduate students in mathematics department. It is also the basis in their sequel studies. This course introduces basic principle of numerical methods for approximation problems, the corresponding analytic methods, and their recent applications. After finishing this course, the students should familiar with common approximation methods and analytic methods, and has the ability to solve practical problems. They should also familiar with practice tools, and gradually have the ability to use advanced tools to solve practical approximation problems. The main contents of this course include error analysis and methods to avoid errors, polynomial interpolation methods, curve fitting methods, uniformly best and least-square approximation, numerical integration and numerical differentiation methods. This course will be interspersed in the teaching of the small evaluations, and some homework. The final results of the course are cumulative, taking into account the final exam, homework, reports and so on.

default.zh: 本课程的目的是介绍群论和环论的基本内容。主要涉及以下概念：群，子群，正规子群，商群，群同构，群作用，环，理想及商环，环同构，模，商模，模同构，域，代数扩张，分裂域，Galois群。
default.en: The course aims to give a basic introduction to the theory of groups and rings. The main concepts to be discussed are as follows: group, subgroup, normal subgroup, quotient group, group isomorphism, group action, ring, ideal and quotient ring, ring isomorphism, module, quotient module, module isomorphism, field, algebraic extension, splitting field, Galois group.

default.zh: 《近世代数》是“数学与应用数学专业”专业的重要专业基础课。“数学与应用数学专业”专业课程可分为“分析”、“代数”、“几何”三条线。在“代数”这条线中，“高等代数”起基础作用课；“近世代数”课起承上启下作用。《高等代数》课主要讲授代数学十七、十八世纪的成果，《近世代数》课则讲授十九、二十世纪的成果，并为进一步学习现代数学打好基础，也为后续专业课程“李群与李代数”、“有限群表示”、“代数拓扑”、“代数几何”等打下基础。近世代数是培养学生掌握基本抽象代数结构及抽象数学思维方式的一门专业课，其主要目标是使得学生： 1．了解抽象的代数结构及公理化思想，提高数学素养以及自主学习能力； 2．熟悉基本的代数概念，掌握群论与环论的基础知识； 3．具有初步的理论推导及较强的抽象思维能力。
default.en: Modern Algebra is an important basic course of mathematics and applied mathematics.Mathematics and applied mathematics major professional courses can be roughly divided into three fields: Analysis, Algebra, and Geometry.In the field of algebra, Advanced Algebra plays a fundamental role, and Modern Algebra serves as a bridge between the preceding and the following.Advanced Algebra course is mainly about algebra in the 17th and 18th centuries, and Modern Algebra course is about achievement of algebra in the 19th and 20th centuries, and provides a basis for further study of modern mathematics, and also for the follow-up professional courses Lie Group and Lie Algebra and Finite Group Representation, Algebraic Topology, Algebraic Geometry, etc. Modern Algebra is a specialized course to train students to master basic abstract algebraic structure and abstract mathematical thinking mode. Its main goal is to train students to have the following abilities: 1．Understand the abstract algebraic structure and axiomatic thought, improve mathematical literacy and autonomous learning ability; 2．Familiar with basic algebraic concepts, grasp the basic knowledge of group theory and ring theory; 3．Has the preliminary theory derivation and the strong abstract thinking ability.

default.zh: 随着计算科学与技术的进步和发展，科学与工程计算的应用范围已扩大到许多的学科领域。数值分析是研究用计算机求解各种数学问题的数值方法及其理论的一门学科，是应用性很强的数学类课程，是工程学乃至社会科学研究中非常重要的基础工具，也是工程数学与计算机应用的桥梁。数值计算已与理论方法、实验方法并列成为科学研究的第三种基本手段。该课程介绍将连续的数学模型离散化，通过计算机程序在有限步骤内求得数值近似解的方法。通过一系列的实验帮助学生掌握基本的误差分析方法、求解非线性方程（组）和线性方程组的方法、用插值及拟合近似计算函数值、连续函数平方逼近、计算近似定积分、求解微分方程初边值问题的方法等。通过学习，学生将掌握经典算法的基本理论、使用技巧，并能够灵活应用以解决实际问题。
default.en: With the development of computer science and technology, the application of scientific and engineering computing has been extended to many fields. Numerical analysis is a subject that studies the numerical methods and theories of solving various mathematical problems by computer, it is a mathematics course with strong application. It is a very important basic tool in engineering and social science research. It is also a bridge between engineering mathematics and computer application. Numerical calculation has become the third basic method of scientific research, along with theoretical method and experimental method. This course introduces the method of discretizing continuous mathematical models and obtaining numerical approximate solutions in finite steps through computer programs. Through a series of experiments to help students to master basic error analysis method, solving the nonlinear equation (system) and the method of linear equations, using interpolation and approximation to calculate the function value, continuous function square approximation, computing the approximate definite integral, as well as the method for solving initial boundary value problems of differential equations, etc. Through the study, students will master the basic theory and skills of classical algorithms, and be able to apply them flexibly to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 数值分析主要研究在计算机上使用各种各样数值方法解决科研和工程中的实际数学问题，它既有纯数学的高度抽象性与严密科学性的特点，又有实际试验的高度技术性和广泛性的特点，内柔丰富、理论完整、实用性强。
default.en: Numerical analysis primarily investigates the use of various numerical methods on computers to solve practical mathematical problems in scientific research and engineering. It combines the high level of abstraction and rigorous scientific nature of pure mathematics with the highly technical and broadly applicable characteristics of practical experimentation. The discipline is rich in content, complete in theory, and highly practical.

default.zh: 离散数学是研究离散量的结构及其相互关系的数学学科，是现代数学的一个重要分支。离散的含义是指不同的连接在一起的元素，主要是研究基于离散量的结构和相互间的关系，其对象一般是有限个或可数个元素。本课程目标是通过离散数学的学习，不但可以掌握处理离散结构的描述工具和方法，为后续课程的学习创造条件，而且可以提高抽象思维和严格的逻辑推理能力，为将来参与创新性的研究和开发工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Discrete mathematics is a branch of modern mathematics, which studies the structure and relationship of discrete quantities. The meaning of discreteness refers to different connected elements. It mainly studies the structure based on discreteness and the relationship between them. Its objects are generally finite or countable elements. The goal of this course is not only to master the description tools and methods of dealing with discrete structure, to create conditions for the follow-up course learning, but also to improve the ability of abstract thinking and strict logic reasoning, and to lay a solid foundation for participating in innovative research and development in the future.

default.zh: 研究系统的调节与控制的一般规律的科学。这里叙述的控制理论是指20世纪50年代末至60年代初形成和发展起来的现代控制理论。它现在已成为一门独立的学科，不仅有完整的理论体系，而且已经在诸如工程、生物、生态、社会经济等许多领域有广泛的应用。现代技术特别是现代空间技术的发展是形成控制理论的推动力，数学研究积累的成果为控制理论的形成和发展提供了重要工具，电子计算机的广泛应用使控制理论的成果用于实际成为现实。当前，控制理论为实际系统的描述、分析综合和设计、预测和决策等问题提供了系统的理论和方法。由N.维纳创立的控制论(cybernetic)是一门控制和通信的科学。由Л.C.庞特里亚金、R.贝尔曼、R.E.卡尔曼等人作出了杰出贡献的现代控制理论则是系统科学的一个组成部分，又是形成信息科学的一个基本方面。
default.en: The science of studying the general laws of system regulation and control. The control theory described here refers to the modern control theory that emerged and developed from the late 1950s to the early 1960s. It has now become an independent discipline, not only with a complete theoretical system, but also widely applied in many fields such as engineering, biology, ecology, socio-economic, etc. The development of modern technology, especially modern space technology, is the driving force behind the formation of control theory. The achievements accumulated in mathematical research provide important tools for the formation and development of control theory. The widespread application of electronic computers has made the achievements of control theory practical. Currently, control theory provides systematic theories and methods for the description, analysis, synthesis, design, prediction, and decision-making of practical systems. Cybernetic, founded by N. Wiener, is a science of control and communication. from Л. C. The modern control theory, which has made outstanding contributions by Pontryagin, R. Bellman, R.E. Kalman, and others, is a component of systems science and a fundamental aspect of forming information science.

default.zh: 数学建模是将数学方法和计算机知识结合起来，用于解决实际生活中存在问题的一门综合型、实用型数学课程，优化理论是解决实际问题最常用的方法。主要利用高等数学、工程数学、数学规划、概率论与数理统计等基本数学理论和基本最优化方法，建立数学模型。 使用主流数学软件（如MATLAB、LINGO等），利用计算机编程求解众多领域中的数学建模问题。通过本门课的学习，可使学生将所学的数学知识和其它专业知识很好地应用到解决实际问题中去，强调利用计算机及各种资料，综合应用数学知识、数学软件等解决实际问题动手能力的培养。
default.en: Mathematical modeling combines mathematical methods and computer knowledge. It is used to solve problems in real life. It is a comprehensive, practical mathematics course. Optimization theory is the most commonly used method to solve practical problems A mathematical model is based on higher mathematics, engineering mathematics, mathematical programming, probability theory and mathematical statistics, optimization methods. Using of the mainstream mathematical software, and computer programming to solve the problem of mathematical modeling in many areas. Through the course of learning, students can use the learned mathematical knowledge and other expertise to solve practical problems. It focuses on training the student’s ability of using computers, all kinds of information, mathematical knowledge, and mathematical software to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 本科生的微分几何是一门培养学生用微分学的方法研究三维空间中曲线和曲面性质能力的专业课，本课程主要研究曲线、曲面在微分下的运动不变量。 微分几何是应用数学的一门主要课程，它对培养学生研究曲线、曲面及可以归为曲线、曲面问题具有重要作用，为以后从事数学研究和交叉性跨学科研究打下几何直观和分析相结合的独有基础，因而占有重要地位。
default.en: Differential geometry for undergraduates is a specialized course to cultivate the students' ability to study the properties of curves and surfaces in three-dimensional space with the method of differential calculus. This course mainly studies the motion invariants of curves and surfaces under differential calculus. Differential geometry is a major course of Applied Mathematics. It plays an important role in training students to study curves and surfaces and the problems that can be classified into curves and surfaces. It lays a unique foundation for the combination of geometric intuition and analysis for later mathematics research and interdisciplinary research, so it plays an important role.

default.zh: 数理统计是数学学院的主干课，是继概率论后的又一门随机分析类课程。通过本课程的课堂教学，使学生能够掌握数理统计的基本理论和方法，能够理解数理统计的基本概念，熟悉抽样分布理论，掌握参数估计的理论与方法、统计假设检验的主要方法、方差分析、正交试验设计，以进一步掌握随机数学的思想方法和技巧，并用于解决实际生活中遇到的统计问题，为今后进一步从事应用数学方面的研究工作打下良好的基础。
default.en: Mathematical statistics is the main course in the School of mathematics, which is another random analysis course after probability theory. Through the classroom teaching of this course, the students can master the basic theory and method of mathematical statistics, understand the basic concept of mathematical statistics, be familiar with the sampling distribution theory, master the theory and method of parameter estimation, the main method of statistical hypothesis test, variance analysis and orthogonal test design, so as to further master the thinking methods and skills of random mathematics, and use them to solve the problem The statistical problems encountered in international life lay a good foundation for further research in Applied Mathematics.

default.zh: 数值分析是信息与计算科学专业和数学与应用数学专业的一门专业核心课程，它是科学与工程计算的核心。本课程通常也称为矩阵代数，是以计算机为工具来求解各种数学模型的主要课程。随着计算机存储量及运算能力的加强，以及舍入误差理论的进一步完善，使得数值分析的教学内容逐渐发展成为借助矩阵约化过程来求解矩阵线性代数方程组、特征值问题和最小二乘问题。本课程是通过理论研究和实际问题的解决让学生掌握数值分析的基本知识和基本方法，使得学生掌握经典的矩阵计算方法并能应用于求解分析各种数值问题。
default.en: Numerical algebra is a core course of the students major in information and computing science or mathematics and applied mathematics. It is the core of science and engineering computing. This course, also commonly known as matrix algebra, is the main course for solving various mathematical models using computers as a tool. With the enhancement of computer storage and operation capacity as well as the improvement of rounding error theory, the teaching content of numerical algebra has gradually developed into solving matrix linear algebra equations, eigenvalue problems and least squares problems by matrix reduction process. This course enables students to master basic knowledge and methods of numerical algebra through theoretical research and practical problem solving, so that students can master the classical matrix calculation method and use this method to analyze and solve various numerical problems.

default.zh: 变分法是处理函数的一门数学分支。和处理数的函数的普通微积分相对，它最终寻求的是极值函数，它们使得泛函取得极大或极小值。本课程目标要求学生掌握变分法的基本引理，极值问题的确定，及利用所学的几种变分方法解决物理领域等实际问题。
default.en: Variation is a branch of mathematics dealing with function. Compared with the ordinary calculus of the function which deals with numbers, it ultimately seeks the extremum function, which makes the function obtain the maximum or minimum value. The goal of this course is for students to master the basic lemma of variational method, the determination of extreme value problem, and the use of several variational methods to solve practical problems in the field of physics.

default.zh: 以下是《近世代数2》的典型课程内容与教学要求框架，可根据具体学时和学生背景调整： 一、课程内容大纲 1. 模论 - 基本概念：模、子模、商模、模同态。 - 自由模与有限生成模：基、秩、结构定理（Euclid整环上有限生成模的分解）。 2. 域论进阶（Advanced Field Theory） - 代数扩张：代数闭包、有限域的结构（GF(p？)）。 - 可分性与正规扩张：本原元定理、分裂域的唯一性。 - 无限维扩张：超越基（可选）。 3. 伽罗瓦理论（Galois Theory） - 基本定理：伽罗瓦对应（中间域 ？ 子群）、正规扩张与正规子群。 - 应用：尺规作图问题、方程根式解的判据（阿贝尔群与可解群）。 - 示例：计算x？ - a的伽罗瓦群。 4. 可选扩展内容 - 交换代数基础：希尔伯特基定理、局部化。 - 表示论初步：群表示与模的联系（如k[G]-模）。 - 代数数论示例：代数整数环的Dedekind整性（可选）。
default.en: The following is a typical course content and teaching requirement framework for "Modern Algebra II", which can be adjusted according to specific hours and student background: I. Course Content Outline 1. Module Theory - Basic concepts: module, submodule, quotient module, module homomorphism. - Free modules and finitely generated modules: basis, rank, structure theorem (decomposition of finitely generated modules on Euclid domains). 2. Advanced Field Theory - Algebraic extension: algebraic closure, structure of finite fields (GF(p？)). - Divisibility and normal extension: primitive element theorem, uniqueness of split fields. - Infinite dimensional extension: transcendental basis (optional). 3. Galois Theory - Basic theorem: Galois correspondence (intermediate field ？ subgroup), normal extension and normal subgroup. - Application: ruler and compass construction problem, criterion for radical solution of equation (Abelian group and solvable group). - Example: Compute the Galois group of x？ - a. 4. Optional extensions - Commutative algebra foundation: Hilbert basis theorem, localization. - Introduction to representation theory: the connection between group representations and modules (such as k[G]-modules). - Algebraic number theory example: Dedekind integrity of the algebraic integer ring (optional).

default.zh: 本课程以单变量及多变量实函数的可测性、可积性为研究对象，通过抽象测度、勒贝格测度、可测函数的定义与性质，建立勒贝格积分理论。随后讨论勒贝格积分理论中的几个重要定理，如乘积测度的构造、变量替换公式、Lp空间理论等，最后讨论不同的收敛类型的定义以及它们之间的关系。
default.en: This course focuses on the measurability and integrability of real-valued functions of single and multiple variables. It begins with the definitions and properties of abstract measures, Lebesgue measures, and measurable functions, establishing the foundation of Lebesgue integration theory. Subsequently, key theorems within Lebesgue integration theory are discussed, such as the construction of product measures, change of variables formulas, and the theory of L^p spaces. Finally, different modes of convergence are examined, along with the relationships between them.

default.zh: 数理逻辑是用数学方法研究推理规律的一门学科，通过引进一套符号体系（形式化方法）来表达各种推理的逻辑关系，因此，数理逻辑也称为符号逻辑。数理逻辑是用符号语言来表达思维的形式结构和规律，把对思维规律的研究变换为对符号规律的研究。现代数理逻辑可分为逻辑演算、证明论、模型论、递归论、公理化集合论，而且逻辑演算是数理逻辑的基础内容。本课程主要介绍命题逻辑和谓词逻辑演算形式逻辑推理系统。
default.en: Mathematical logic is a branch of mathematics to study inference laws. A series of symbolic systems (formalization methods) are introduced to express logical relationship between various inferences. Mathematical logic is therefore referred to as symbolic logic. It relies on symbolic languages to express formal structures and laws of thoughts which are studied by changing them to laws of symbols. Modern mathematical logic includes logical calculations, proof theory, model theory, recursion theory, and axiomatic set theory. Logical calculations are the core and fundamental of mathematical logic. This course concerns mainly formal logical inference systems of propositional logic and of predicate logic.

default.zh: 数理逻辑是研究推理的数学分支，研究自然和社会中思维、逻辑的推理规律。通过本课程学习，培养学生学会运用所学知识分析和解决实际问题的能力。 （1）理解数理逻辑的基本概念、基本理论和方法，熟悉两种重要的逻辑体系，即命题逻辑和谓词逻辑；掌握命题逻辑推理系统和谓词逻辑推理系统。 （2）熟练运用命题逻辑推理系统和谓词逻辑推理系统解决实际推理问题。 （3）培养学生的逻辑思维能力。
default.en: Mathematical logic is a branch of mathematics that studies the laws of reasoning in thinking and logic in nature and society. Through the study of this course, students are trained to apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve practical problems. (1) Understand the basic concepts, theories, and methods of mathematical logic, be familiar with two important logical systems, namely propositional logic and predicate logic; master the propositional logic reasoning system and predicate logic reasoning system. (2) Skillfully use the propositional logic reasoning system and predicate logic reasoning system to solve practical reasoning problems. (3) Cultivate students' logical thinking abilities.

default.zh: 本课程系统讲授数学各领域通用的基本推理工具与思想方法，旨在帮助学生建立严格的数学思维框架，提升逻辑推理与抽象概括能力。 课程内容涵盖集合论基础、命题逻辑与量词、数学归纳法、实数的公理化体系、数列与不等式、复数运算、多项式与有理分式分解，以及各类数值函数与映射的性质分析。此外，课程还专门介绍计算优化技巧与快速心算规则，强化学生的计算效率与实际问题解决能力。 教学采用课堂讲授、手写作业、自主研读与讨论答疑相结合的方式。考核以大作业形式进行，综合考查学生对基本概念、推理方法和应用技巧的掌握程度。通过本课程的学习，学生将为后续分析学、代数学及算法理论等进阶课程奠定坚实的逻辑与方法论基础。
default.en: The course systematically introduces the general reasoning tools and fundamental methodologies common to various branches of mathematics, aiming to cultivate rigorous mathematical thinking and enhance students’ abilities in logical deduction and abstract generalization. The syllabus covers basic set theory, propositional logic and quantifiers, mathematical induction, the axiomatic construction of real numbers, sequences and inequalities, complex numbers and their geometric representation, polynomials and partial fraction decomposition, as well as the properties of numerical functions and mappings. Special attention is given to computational optimization techniques and mental arithmetic rules, reinforcing students’ efficiency in calculation and their capacity to tackle practical problems. Instruction combines lectures, handwritten assignments, independent study, and discussion sessions. Assessment is based on a comprehensive final project that evaluates students’ understanding of core concepts, reasoning methods, and application skills. This course prepares students for advanced studies in analysis, algebra, algorithm theory, and other related fields by providing a solid logical and methodological foundation.

default.zh: 数学应用软件是一门与计算机使用密切结合的课程，主要讲授MWORKS语言， MWORKS是一个类MATLAB的语言。本课程主要讲授MWORKS基础知识、MWORKS分支结构与循环、MWORKS函数、MWORKS作图、模型的MWORKS实现。 着重培养学生的数学软件的应用能力，培养需要版权意识和使用软件解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Mathematical application software is a course closely integrated with computer use, mainly teaching MWORKS language, which is a MATLAB-like language. This course mainly teaches the basic knowledge of MWORKS, MWORKS branch structure and loop, MWORKS functions, MWORKS plots, and the MWORKS implementations of the model. Emphasis is placed on cultivating students' mathematical software application ability, the need for copyright awareness, and the ability to use software to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 本课程将介绍数学专业英语的基本词汇、语法和表达方式，并通过阅读、写作和口语练习等方式，帮助学生掌握数学领域的英语表达和交流能力。课程内容涵盖数学基础概念、数学符号、数学公式、数学理论等各个方面，涉及代数、几何、概率统计等各个领域。学生将学习如何正确地使用数学专业英语来表达和解释数学概念、理论和问题，并能够阅读和理解英语数学文献。本课程的学习目标是培养学生的英语表达和交流能力，使学生能够正确地使用英语表达数学思想和观点，并能够与国际同行进行学术交流。学生将通过讲解、讨论、练习和阅读等多种方式，掌握数学专业英语的基本知识和技能，提高在数学领域的英语阅读和写作能力，以及在学术交流中的英语口语能力。本课程适合数学专业的学生和需要使用英语进行数学学习和研究的人员。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够更好地适应国际化的学术环境，提高自身的学术水平和竞争力。 课程目标1. 掌握基本数学专业词汇及表达方法。具备阅读英文数学文章及数学专业学术论文能力，数学学术及教学文章的英汉互译技巧。掌握英文数学学术论文的检索方法。 课程目标2. 能用英语书写文章摘要、学术交流信件等。用英语做简单的学术报告。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the knowledge of reading, writing and making reports in mathematics English. Through the course learning, students can master the basic vocabulary of English for mathematics, the essentials of writing and the precautions for making reports. Course Objective 1: Master the basic mathematical vocabulary and expression methods. Possess the ability to read English mathematics articles and academic papers in mathematics, and English-Chinese translation skills for mathematics academic and teaching articles. Master the retrieval method of English mathematics academic papers. Course Objective 2: Ability to write abstracts, academic communication letters, etc. in English. Make simple academic reports in English.

default.zh: 课程目标1: 了解俄罗斯的基本国情知识，拓展学生的知识面。 课程目标2: 掌握俄罗斯历史和文化发展的基本知识，了解俄罗斯历史和文化发展脉络。
default.en: Course Objective 1: To understand fundamental knowledge about Russia's basic national conditions and broaden students' knowledge base. Course Objective 2: To master essential knowledge of Russia's historical and cultural development and comprehend the trajectory of its historical and cultural evolution.

default.zh: 1、了解哲学的研究对象、研究方法和诸领域问题 2、学会运用哲学方法思考应用性问题
default.en: 1. Understand the subject matter, research methods, and various fields of philosophy. 2. Learn to apply philosophical methods to think about practical issues.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生对生命安全的系统理解与实践能力。通过理论知识与案例学习，使学生掌握应对自然、人为、社会、环境等紧急情况的基本知识、技能与方法，具备健康生活方式与基本医疗急救能力，并树立主动防范和应急处置的意识。课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： ？ 课程目标1：掌握生命安全与健康生活方式的基本知识。 ？ 课程目标2：掌握自然灾害、人为事故、社会与环境突发事件的分类及应对方法。 ？ 课程目标3：掌握常见突发事件下的自救互救和基本医疗急救技能，具备初步的灾难医学知识。
default.en: This course aims to cultivate students' systematic understanding and practical abilities regarding life safety. Through theoretical knowledge and case studies, students will acquire fundamental knowledge, skills, and methods to respond to emergencies caused by natural, human, social, and environmental factors. They will develop the capacity for maintaining a healthy lifestyle and performing basic medical first aid, while fostering an awareness of proactive prevention and emergency response. The course objectives outline the following competency requirements for students: ？ Course Objective 1: Acquire fundamental knowledge of life safety and healthy living. ？ Course Objective 2: Understand the classification of and response methods to natural disasters, human-induced accidents, and social and environmental emergencies. ？ Course Objective 3: Master self-rescue, mutual aid, and basic medical first aid skills in common emergency situations, and possess preliminary knowledge of disaster medicine.

default.zh: 课程阐释相关的美学理论和艺术赏析知识，系统讲解俄罗斯艺术（绘画、音乐、戏剧、电影）发展，赏析俄罗斯具有代表性的艺术作品。通过对美学知识的传授和俄罗斯文化艺术的欣赏，使学生不仅能够了解俄罗斯文化艺术的发展脉络，掌握俄罗斯当今的文化艺术状况，而且具备一定的艺术欣赏能力，从而提高学生的人文素养。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标 1：掌握俄罗斯国家社会、历史与文化知识； 课程目标 2：掌握语言学、文学及相关人文和科技方面的基础知识。
default.en: The course elucidates relevant aesthetic theories and knowledge of art appreciation, systematically explaining the development of Russian art (including painting, music, theater, and film) and analyzing representative Russian artistic works. Through the instruction of aesthetic knowledge and the appreciation of Russian culture and art, students will not only gain an understanding of the evolution of Russian cultural and artistic traditions and grasp the current state of Russian culture and art but will also develop a certain level of artistic appreciation ability, thereby enhancing their humanistic literacy. The course objectives set the following competency requirements for students: Course Objective 1: Master knowledge of Russian society, history, and culture. Course Objective 2: Acquire foundational knowledge in linguistics, literature, and related humanities and technological fields.

default.zh: 课程包含热带（幂等）数学这一快速发展的数学分支。该学科研究具有幂等运算的代数系统理论及其应用。热带数学能将传统意义上非线性的各类问题转化为热带代数中的线性问题，从而简化形式分析和求解过程。虽然沿用基础数学概念，但热带数学采用与传统数学截然不同的问题处理方式。通过学习，学生既能了解传统数学基本概念在不同数学框架下的应用，又能掌握运用新数学语言与方法解决经典及新型实际问题的能力，最终有效培养学生的创新能力。
default.en: Mathematical Foundations of Computer Science (B) contains tropical (idempotent) mathematics, which is a rapidly growing branch of mathematics. It deals with the theory and applications of algebraic systems with idempotent operations. The application of tropical mathematics allows various problems, which are nonlinear in the ordinary sense, to be transformed into linear problems in tropical algebra, and hence facilitates the formal analysis and simplifies the derivation of solution. Tropical mathematics utilizes basic mathematical concepts but exploits different ways to handle problems than the conventional mathematics.
