It offers students opportunities to see both how basic concepts of conventional mathematics may work in a different setting and how to solve classical and novel applied problems by using new mathematical language and methods. As a result, it is helpful to train students to obtain innovation ability.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生在编程、数学模型算法化、数据结构和现代信息学核心方法方面的系统性认知。课程强调数学形式化方法与编程实践的结合，为后续理论及应用信息学课程奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course is designed to develop students' systematic understanding of programming, algorithmization of mathematical models, data structures, and methods underlying modern computer science. It emphasizes the integration of formal mathematical approaches with practical programming, serving as a foundation for advanced theoretical and applied computer science studies.

default.zh: 应用数学（B）课程涵盖热带最优化，这是热带数学的一个分支领域。该学科主要研究在热带（幂等）代数体系下构建并求解的最优化问题。针对一系列热带最优化问题，可以直接获得解析形式的解。在某些情况下，热带最优化方法能够为传统数学无法解析求解的问题提供直接解决方案。本课程旨在展示新型最优化模型与方法，同时演示经典最优化问题的新解法，更有助于培养学生获得创新能力。
default.en: Applied Mathematics (B) contains tropical optimization, which is an area of tropical mathematics. It deals with optimization problems formulated and solved in the framework of tropical (idempotent) algebra. For a number of tropical optimization problems, analytical solutions can be obtained in a direct form. In some cases, methods and techniques of tropical optimization offer a direct solution to problems that have no analytical solutions available in terms of conventional mathematics. The aim of the course is both to show new models and methods of optimization and to demonstrate new solutions to known optimization problems. It is also helpful to train students to obtain innovation ability.

default.zh: 该课程主要内容为动力系统与控制理论，这是一门研究具有时变过程的研究系统的建模、分析与调控的学科。学生需具备以下能力： （1）掌握动力系统与控制理论的相关概念； （2）理解并掌握一些基本函数及相关定理； （3）研究系统的稳定性。
default.en: The content is mostly the dynamics and control theory, which is a subject that studies the modeling, analysis and regulation of the research system with time-varying process. Students are required to (1) master the related concepts of power system and control theory, (2) understand and master some basic functions and related theorems, (3) study the stability of the system.

default.zh: 掌握本课程的目标在于提升数学基础训练水平，获得解决数学问题的技能，培养数学文化素养，理解数学在各专业活动领域中的作用。课程目标还包括运用微分方程与积分方程理论的基本概念和方法。微分方程和积分方程作为基础数学概念，在解决实际问题中具有最广泛的应用价值。
default.en: The goals of mastering the course are to improve the level of fundamental training in mathematics; acquiring skills in solving mathematical problems; nurturing a mathematical culture and understanding the role of mathematics in various areas of professional activity. The goals of mastering the course are to apply the basic concepts and methods of the theory of differential and integral equations. Differential and integral equations are one of the basic mathematical concepts most widely used in solving practical problems.

default.zh: 课程目标1．理解组合数学的基本概念，掌握理论体系，学习到组合数学的思想和方法； 课程目标2．具备一定的合理抽象、逻辑推理及综合分析能力。 课程目标3．使学生对组合数学产生浓厚的兴趣，能够体会组合数学的美感。
default.en: Course Objective 1: Understand the fundamental concepts of combinatorics, master the theoretical framework, and learn the ideas and methods of combinatorics. Course Objective 2: Develop a certain level of ability in rational abstraction, logical reasoning, and comprehensive analysis. Course Objective 3: Foster a strong interest in combinatorics among students, enabling them to appreciate the beauty of the subject.

default.zh: 本课程为数学与应用数学专业夏季学期开设的组合计算课程，总学时36（理论16，课外辅导20），1学分，先修数学分析和高等代数。系统介绍组合数学基本概念与计数方法，涵盖排列与置换、莫比乌斯反演、生成函数、二进制展开、递归关系与斐波那契数列。通过理论讲解与例题，培养运用组合工具解决算术、分析及离散结构问题的能力。教学方式包括课堂讲授、问题驱动、讨论与课外辅导。考核由平时测验（40%）和期末闭卷考试（60%）组成。课程旨在为学生奠定组合数学基础，揭示数学各分支之间的联系，提升抽象思维。 基础数学(A)（康托尔集合论）是面向数学与应用数学专业中外合作办学项目开设的夏季学期选修课，总学时36（理论16、课外辅导20），1学分，先修数学分析（1）和高等代数（1）。课程系统介绍集合论的基本思想和核心方法，包括等势与无限的不同层次、良序集合的比较与刚性定理、超限归纳与超限递归、基数算术与序数基础，以及组合集合论的初步内容。通过学习，学生将掌握基本集合论工具，培养严格逻辑推理能力和抽象思维方式，为学习算法理论和现代数学各分支奠定基础。考核采用平时测验（40%）与期末闭卷笔试（60%）相结合的方式。
default.en: This course is a combinatorial computing course offered in the summer semester for students in the Mathematics and Applied Mathematics program. It comprises a total of 36 contact hours (16 hours of lectures and 20 hours of tutorials), carries 1 credit, and has Mathematical Analysis and Advanced Algebra as prerequisites. The course systematically introduces the fundamental concepts and enumeration methods of combinatorics, covering permutations, M？bius inversion, generating functions, binary expansions, recurrence relations, and Fibonacci numbers. Through theoretical exposition and worked examples, it cultivates the ability to apply combinatorial tools to problems in arithmetic, analysis, and discrete structures. Instructional methods include lectures, problem-driven learning, discussions, and tutorials. Assessment consists of regular quizzes (40%) and a final closed-book examination (60%). The course aims to provide students with a solid foundation in combinatorics, reveal connections among various branches of mathematics, and enhance abstract thinking. Fundamental Mathematics (A) (Cantor’s Set Theory) is an elective course offered in the summer semester for the Sino-foreign cooperative education programme in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics. The course has a total of 36 credit hours (comprising 16 hours of lectures and 20 hours of tutorial support) and carries 1 credit. Prerequisites for this course are Mathematical Analysis (1) and Advanced Algebra (1). The course systematically introduces the fundamental ideas and core methods of set theory, including equinumerosity and the hierarchy of infinities, comparison of well-ordered sets and the rigidity theorem, transfinite induction and transfinite recursion, cardinal arithmetic and the basics of ordinal numbers, as well as introductory topics in combinatorial set theory. Through this course, students will acquire basic tools in set theory, develop the ability to engage in rigorous logical reasoning and abstract thinking, and lay the foundation for further study in algorithmic theory and various branches of modern mathematics. Assessment will be conducted through a combination of regular quizzes (accounting for 40%) and a final closed-book written examination (accounting for 60%).

default.zh: 热带数学是数学的一个快速发展的分支，主要研究幂等运算的代数系统及其应用。通过热带数学，许多在传统意义上是非线性的问题可以转化为热带代数中的线性问题，从而简化问题的分析和求解过程。本课程旨在帮助学生理解热带数学的基本概念，掌握其理论体系和方法，为学生提供在不同数学环境中应用基础知识的机会，并培养他们运用新的数学语言和方法解决经典和新颖应用问题的能力，进而训练学生的创新能力。
default.en: Tropical mathematics is a rapidly growing field that focuses on algebraic systems with idempotent operations. It can transform various nonlinear problems into linear ones in tropical algebra, simplifying the analysis and solution process. This course aims to help students understand the basic concepts of tropical mathematics, master its theoretical system and methods. It also provides opportunities for students to apply conventional mathematical concepts in different settings and solve problems using new mathematical language and methods, thereby enhancing their innovation ability.

default.zh: 热带优化是热带数学的一个分支，专注于在热带（幂等）代数框架内制定和解决优化问题。本课程旨在向学生介绍这种新的优化模型和方法，并展示已知优化问题的新解决方案。通过学习，学生将能够理解热带优化的基本概念，掌握其理论体系和方法，培养理性抽象、逻辑推理和综合分析的能力，提升创新能力。
default.en: Tropical optimization is a branch of tropical mathematics that focuses on formulating and solving optimization problems within the framework of tropical (idempotent) algebra. This course aims to introduce students to new models and methods of optimization and to showcase novel solutions to known optimization problems. By the end of the course, students will be able to understand the basic concepts of tropical optimization, grasp its theoretical system and methods, and enhance their abilities in rational abstraction, logical reasoning, and comprehensive analysis, which are crucial for developing innovative thinking.

default.zh: 本课程旨在复习不定积分的基本方法并教授定积分的计算。学生将熟练掌握各种积分技巧，能够自信地识别并应用适当的积分方法，并处理定积分的计算问题。课程内容包括不定积分的基本方法回顾、定积分的特殊计算和转换、近似积分方法以及积分与级数的关系，还包括积分计算中一些特殊函数（如伽马函数、指数积分和椭圆积分）的应用。通过问题导向和互动式教学，结合多媒体教学工具，学生将在课堂上深入理解和练习这些积分技巧。
default.en: This course reviews the basic methods of indefinite integration and teaches the computation of definite integrals. Students will become proficient in various integration techniques, confidently identify and apply appropriate integration methods, and handle the calculation of definite integrals. The curriculum includes a review of fundamental indefinite integration methods, special calculations and transformations of definite integrals, methods of approximate integration, and the relationship between integrals and series. It also covers the application of special functions in integral calculus, such as the gamma function, exponential integral, and elliptic integrals. Through problem-based and interactive teaching, supplemented by multimedia tools, students will gain a deep understanding and practical skills in these integration techniques.

default.zh: 本课程探讨积分微积分在物理和几何中的实际应用。学生将学习如何在科学、技术和工程领域中识别和解决通过积分微积分的应用来处理的问题，从而增强应用这些数学工具解决实际问题的信心。 课程涵盖积分微积分的基础理论，包括区间函数、可加函数以及积分微积分的基本定理。课程提供了将适当的问题简化为积分形式的一般算法，并通过简单示例进行初步理解。 在几何应用方面，学生将学习使用积分计算曲线之间的面积、曲线的弧长、旋转曲面的面积、旋转体的体积（使用圆盘法和壳层法）以及质心。课程还将介绍第一和第二帕普斯-古尔丁定理，并探讨极坐标在这些计算中的应用。 在力学和物理应用方面，学生将学习计算转动惯量，并通过积分理解功和能量等概念。课程强调将自然现象的描述简化为能够获得定量结果的形式，并通过各种科学领域的实际示例进行支持。 此外，课程还涉及统计应用，教授学生使用积分计算函数的平均值、方差和标准差。还将介绍如何在涉及点状物体的问题中使用Dirac delta函数和Heaviside阶跃函数。 通过问题导向和互动式教学方法，并辅以多媒体工具，学生将深入了解如何将积分微积分应用于几何、自然科学和统计学中的各种问题。
default.en: This course explores the practical applications of integral calculus in physics and geometry. Students will learn to recognize and address problems in science, technology, and engineering through the use of integral calculus, building confidence in applying these mathematical tools to real-world scenarios. The curriculum covers the foundational theory of integral calculus, including interval functions, additive functions, and the key theorem of integral calculus. It provides a general algorithm for reducing suitable problems to integration and offers simple examples for initial understanding. In geometry, students will apply integrals to calculate areas between curves, arc lengths, surface areas of revolution, volumes of revolution using disk and shell methods, and centroids. The course also introduces the 1st and 2nd Pappus–Guldinus theorems and explores the use of polar coordinates in these calculations. In the realm of mechanics and physics, students will learn to compute moments of inertia and understand concepts like work and energy through integration. The course emphasizes reducing natural phenomena descriptions to forms yielding quantitative results, supported by practical examples across various scientific fields. Additionally, the course delves into statistical applications, teaching students to calculate the average value of a function, variance, and standard deviation using integrals. It also introduces the use of Dirac delta function and Heaviside step function in solving problems involving point-like objects. Through problem-based and interactive teaching methods, supplemented by multimedia tools, students will develop a deep understanding of how to apply integral calculus to diverse problems in geometry, natural science, and statistics.

default.zh: 初等概率论是数学系各专业学生必修的重要专业基础课，是概率与统计专业学生学习随机过程、随机分析等后续课程的基础。与数学专业的其他课程相比，初等概率论有如下不同之处。一方面，初等概率论研究的是与自然界以及社会生活中的随机现象的规律，与日常生活有密切联系。另一方面，概率现象的数学刻画以及数学结果的严格证明往往较为复杂和抽象。本课程将通过课堂教学、讨论等环节，带领学生们认识如何刻画和研究“随机性现象”，建立概率思想，掌握重要的数学结果。本课程将为学生讲授初等概率理论的基本思想、方法、理论及应用。
default.en: Elementary Probability Theory is a crucial foundational course for all majors in the mathematics department, serving as the basis for subsequent studies in stochastic processes and stochastic analysis for students specializing in probability and statistics. Compared to other mathematics courses, Elementary Probability Theory has the following distinctions. On one hand, it examines the laws governing random phenomena in nature and social life, maintaining a close connection with daily life. On the other hand, the mathematical modeling of probabilistic phenomena and the rigorous proofs of mathematical results are often complex and abstract. This course will guide students in understanding how to characterize and study "random phenomena," establish probabilistic thinking, and master key mathematical results through classroom instruction and discussions. The course will impart the fundamental ideas, methods, theories, and applications of elementary probability theory to students.

default.zh: 生产实习是一门重要的实践教学课程，对于学生从学校走入社会从事实际的工作具有指导作用。数学系生产实习工作是利用计算机从事辅助设计，完成教师所指定题目的实习报告。 本次课程使用的是PHOTOSHOP CS2软件，教师首先对软件的使用进行讲解，并指导学生完成一个独立实例的设计工作，从而锻炼学生的分析问题、解决问题以及团队合作的精神。为了保证实习效果，实习过程安排在数学实验中心进行，便于教师及时指导操作。
default.en: Production practice is a very important lacture that can supervise the stuedents who will come into society for practice use.The work of production practice in Harbin Institute of Technology Mathematic is a Computer-Aided Design that in a position to finish the practice report of the teacher's appointment. We use PHOTOSHOP CS2 in this lecture.The teacher will explain the method of use of the software and lead the student to complete the case unaided.Thereby it can make the student have ability of analyse and slove the problem by themselves and also have the spirit of team work.In order to assurance the effect of practice, the course of practice is arranged in the lab of Mathematic to offer the teachers' coach in a convenient way.

default.zh: 本科毕业论文是获得学士学位的重要依据。数学学院本科毕业论文的目的是培养学生综合运用所学知识分析和解决数学及相关领域的理论及应用问题的初步能力。进一步深化和扩展所学知识，提高理论分析、计算机应用、自学及独立工作的能力。培养学生进行科学探索的初步能力。 毕业论文的选题应在数学及其相关领域的实际问题中选定，难度适当，工作量适当。 毕业论文的内容应包括文献综述、问题背景、理论分析、主要结论等，字数在15000字左右。
default.en: A bachelor's thesis is an important basis for obtaining a bachelor's degree. The purpose of undergraduate thesis in the School of Mathematics is to cultivate students' preliminary ability to comprehensively apply their knowledge to analyze and solve theoretical and practical problems in mathematics and related fields. Further deepen and expand the knowledge learned, improve the abilities of theoretical analysis, computer application, self-learning, and independent work. Cultivate students' preliminary abilities in scientific exploration. The topic of the graduation thesis should be selected from practical problems in mathematics and related fields, with appropriate difficulty and workload. The content of the graduation thesis should include literature review, problem background, theoretical analysis, main conclusions, etc., with a word count of about 15000 words.

default.zh: 生产实践（毕业资格准备）是本科毕业论文的完成度检查环节。数学学院本科毕业论文的目的是培养学生综合运用所学知识分析和解决数学及相关领域的理论及应用问题的初步能力。进一步深化和扩展所学知识，提高理论分析、计算机应用、自学及独立工作的能力。培养学生进行科学探索的初步能力。 生产实践（毕业资格准备）阶段，学生需要按工作计划完成毕业论文，并且符合毕业论文的撰写规范。
default.en: Industrial Practice (Preparation for Graduation Qualification) is the completion check stage of undergraduate thesis. The purpose of undergraduate thesis in the School of Mathematics is to cultivate students' preliminary ability to comprehensively apply their knowledge to analyze and solve theoretical and practical problems in mathematics and related fields. Further deepen and expand the knowledge learned, improve the abilities of theoretical analysis, computer application, self-learning, and independent work. Cultivate students' preliminary abilities in scientific exploration. In the Industrial Practice (Preparation for Graduation Qualification) stage, students need to complete their graduation thesis according to the work plan and meet the writing standards for graduation thesis.

default.zh: 生产实践（科学研究活动）是本科毕业论文的中期实践环节。数学学院本科毕业论文的目的是培养学生综合运用所学知识分析和解决数学及相关领域的理论及应用问题的初步能力。进一步深化和扩展所学知识，提高理论分析、计算机应用、自学及独立工作的能力。培养学生进行科学探索的初步能力。 生产实践（科学研究活动）阶段，学生需要开始毕业论文的实践工作，最终确定毕业论文的选题，并为完成毕业论文及答辩打好基础。
default.en: Industrial Practice (scientific research activity) is the mid-term practical stage of undergraduate thesis. The purpose of undergraduate thesis in the School of Mathematics is to cultivate students' preliminary ability to comprehensively apply their knowledge to analyze and solve theoretical and practical problems in mathematics and related fields. Further deepen and expand the knowledge learned, improve the abilities of theoretical analysis, computer application, self-learning, and independent work. Cultivate students' preliminary abilities in scientific exploration. In the stage of Industrial Practice (scientific research activities), students need to start the practical work of their graduation thesis, ultimately determine the topic of their graduation thesis, and lay a solid foundation for completing the thesis and defense.

default.zh: 生产实习在理工科本科教学中占有重要地位，是非常重要的综合实践教学环节。学生通过生产实习走向科研、企业和事业单位，了解科研、现代化生产过程以及企业管理，学习生产实践知识、技术管理知识和技术开发知识。学生在实习中将理论和实践结合起来，学以致用，进一步培养独立思考问题的能力以及团队协作精神，在生产实践中学习观察问题、分析问题和解决问题的方法，特别要培养学生的实践能力和创新意识。通过实习，扩大学生的视野，培养学生热爱专业，热爱社会，为未来的学习及工作打下良好的基础。
default.en: Internship plays an important role in undergraduate education in science and engineering, serving as a crucial component of comprehensive practical teaching. Through internships, students transition to scientific research, enterprises, and career units, gaining an understanding of scientific research, modern production processes, and enterprise management. They acquire knowledge of practical production, technical management, and technology development. By integrating theory and practice during internships, students apply what they have learned and further develop their ability to think independently and collaborate in teams. They learn to observe, analyze, and solve problems in production practices, with a focus on cultivating practical skills and fostering innovation. Internships broaden students' horizons, nurture their passion for their field, and for society, laying a solid foundation for their future learning and work.

default.zh: 生产实践（科学研究工作）是本科毕业论文的准备工作。数学学院本科毕业论文的目的是培养学生综合运用所学知识分析和解决数学及相关领域的理论及应用问题的初步能力。进一步深化和扩展所学知识，提高理论分析、计算机应用、自学及独立工作的能力。培养学生进行科学探索的初步能力。 毕业论文的选题应在数学及其相关领域的实际问题中选定，难度适当，工作量适当。生产实践（科学研究工作）阶段，学生需要初步确定毕业论文的选题，工作计划及论文目标。
default.en: Industrial Practice (scientific research work) is the preparation work for undergraduate thesis. The purpose of undergraduate thesis in the School of Mathematics is to cultivate students' preliminary ability to comprehensively apply their knowledge to analyze and solve theoretical and practical problems in mathematics and related fields. Further deepen and expand the knowledge learned, improve the abilities of theoretical analysis, computer application, self-learning, and independent work. Cultivate students' preliminary abilities in scientific exploration. The topic of the graduation thesis should be selected from practical problems in mathematics and related fields, with appropriate difficulty and workload. In the stage of Industrial Practice (scientific research work), students need to preliminarily determine the topic, work plan, and thesis objectives of their graduation thesis.

default.zh: 动力系统理论是现代大范围分析这一综合性数学分支的一个重要组成部分，它以演化系统的动力学性质为研究内容，同时在数学、生物、物理、力学和经济等多个学科中有广泛的应用背景，因而在国际上受到极大的重视。本课程是大学本科数学专业的一门必修基础课，也是其它学科如力学、工程、经济等实际问题数学建模需要的必备知识。本课程系统地介绍了动力系统的基础理论知识与基本研究方法。课程分为三部分：第一部分主要介绍平面动力系统的相关知识，包括对极限集、闭轨和庞加莱映射等重要动力系统概念；第二部分主要介绍非线性微分动力系统的有关的内容，包括非线性方程的流函数解、线性化理论、庞加莱-本迪克逊定理等；第三部分主要介绍离散动力系统的相关知识。课程内容为学习本学科的近代内容和后续课程打下基础。本课程以课堂教学为主，结合同学自学，培养自主学习的意识和能力，使同学们更好地理解这个学科、初步了解它的理论体系、思维方式和研究方法，提高对常微分方程与动力系统的兴趣。
default.en: The theory of dynamical systems is an important component of modern large-scale analysis, which focuses on the dynamical properties of evolutionary systems, and has a wide range of application backgrounds in multiple disciplines such as mathematics, biology, physics, mechanics, and economics. Therefore, the theory of dynamical systems has received great attention internationally. This course is a compulsory basic course for undergraduate students who major in the applied mathematics, and is also necessary tools for mathematical modeling of practical problems in other disciplines such as mechanics, engineering, economics, etc. This course systematically introduces the basic theoretical knowledge and research methods of dynamical systems, and is divided into three parts: The first part mainly introduces the relevant knowledge of planar dynamical systems, including important concepts of dynamical systems such as limit sets, the closed orbits, and Poincaré maps; The second part mainly introduces the relevant content of nonlinear differential dynamical systems, including stream functions of nonlinear equations, the linearization theory, Poincaré-Bendixon theorem, etc; The third part mainly introduces the relevant knowledge of discrete dynamical systems. The course content lays the foundation for studying the modern contents of this subject and subsequent courses. This course mainly focuses on classroom teaching, combined with self-study by students, to cultivate the awareness and ability of self-directed learning, so that students can better understand this subject, have a preliminary understanding of its theoretical system, thinking mode, and research methods, and have greater interest in ordinary differential equations and dynamical systems.

default.zh: 本课程为未来技术学院开设，是设计与制造系列课程中的第一门。主要研究用正投影法绘制工程图样的理论和方法。课程的主要授课目标是培养学生的空间想象、空间思维能力；学习运用正确、规范的工程标准表达设计思想，绘制基本工程图的能力；运用工程图和三维建模表达设计思想的理念；培养学生建立标准化意识和创新研发意识。
default.en: This course is for school of future technology, and it is the first course in the design and manufacturing series. The course studies the theory and method of drawing engineering drawings with orthographic projection method. The main objectives of the course are to develop students' spatial imagination and spatial thinking ability; to learn the ability to use the correct and standardized engineering standards to express design ideas and to draw basic engineering drawings; to cultivate students' awareness of standardization and innovative.

default.zh: 《设计与制造（2）》是一门用以培养学生机械设计能力的技术基础课，旨在培养学生综合运用先修课程中所学知识和技能，解决机械工程实际问题的能力，结合各种实践教学环节，进行机械工程技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事机械设计工作打下基础，因此在近机械类专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和作用，是高等工科院校中近机械类专业一门主干课程，在人才培养的教学计划中占有重要的地位。 本课程主要研究： 机械的组成及课程的研究对象；机械零件设计概述；常用工程材料及钢的热处理；极限与配合；机械运动简图及自由度；连杆机构的功能及设计原理；凸轮机构的功能、强度计算及结构设计；带传动的应用基础及普通V带传动设计；齿轮机构的传动原理、齿轮传动失效形式与设计准则、圆柱直齿轮传动强度计算、圆柱斜齿轮强度计算、齿轮传动结构设计、齿轮传动效率与润滑；蜗杆传动类型、普通圆柱蜗杆失效形式、设计准则和材料选择；轮系的分类及应用、定轴轮系、周转轮系、混合轮系传动比计算；间歇机构的工作原理；螺纹连接的类型、标准件、预紧和防松、螺栓连接的强度计算、螺栓组设计；轴的结构设计、强度及刚度计算、键连接、花键连接；滚动轴承的构造、代号及其类型选择、滚动轴承的失效形式及选择计算、轴系部件结构、润滑与密封；摩擦磨损及润滑基本知识、滑动轴承的结构和轴瓦材料、非液体摩擦轴承设计计算、液体动压和静压滑动轴承原理；联轴器、离合器及制动器的类型、应用及选择； 本课程的主要任务是培养学生： 掌握机构分析与设计的基本理论和基本方法；具有对机械系统运动方案创新设计的初步能力； 掌握设计或选用通用机械零部件的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，具有设计机械传动装置和一般机械的能力；具有运用标准、规范，查阅技术资料的能力、计算能力、绘图能力；了解机械设计的新理论、新方法。
default.en: Design and Manufacturing(2) is a technical basic course designed to cultivate students 'mechanical design ability. It aims to cultivate students' comprehensive application of the knowledge and skills acquired in the prerequisite courses to solve the practical problems of mechanical engineering. The basic training for the technicist of machine engineering coupled with the practical teaching establishes the basis for the students to study professional curriculum or work for the machine design project. Therefore, Design and Manufacturing(2) is a major course and plays an important role in the teaching program related to the mechanical engineering, is a major course in mechanical engineering in higher engineering colleges and universities, occupying an important position in the teaching plan of personnel training. The main contents include:The composition of machinery and the object of study of the course; mechanical parts design overview; common engineering materials and heat treatment of steel; limits and fits; mechanical motion sketches and degrees of freedom; the function of the mechanical linkage and design principles; cam mechanism function, strength calculation and structural design; the application of the foundation of the belt drive and ordinary V-belt drive design; gear mechanism transmission principles, gear transmission failure forms and design guidelines, strength calculation of cylindrical spur gear transmission ,strength calculation of cylindrical helical gears, structural design of gear transmission, efficiency and lubrication of gear transmission; types of worm drive, failure form of common cylindrical worm, design guidelines and material selection; classification and application of wheel system, fixed shaft wheel system, turnover wheel system, mixed wheel system transmission ratio calculation; working principle of intermittent mechanism; type of screw connection, standard parts, pre tightening and anti-loosening, strength calculation of bolt connection, bolt group design; structural design, strength and stiffness calculation of shaft, key connection, spline connection the structure, code and type selection of rolling bearings, failure form and selection calculation of rolling bearings, shafting component structure, lubrication and sealing; basic knowledge of friction, wear, and lubrication, structure of sliding bearings and bearing pad materials, design and calculation of non-liquid friction bearings, principles of hydrodynamic and hydrostatic sliding bearings; type, application, and selection of couplings, clutches, and brakes;The main task of this course is to train students: Basic theory and method for the structural analysis and design; Primary ability of innovative design of mechanical system motion scheme.Basic theory, knowledge and technology for the design/option of the universal mechanical parts and the ability for the design of mechanical transmission device. Ability for reading, calculation and drawing based on the criterion and laws.. Experimental theory and methods for the machine design basis and the primary ability for experimental research. New theory and methods for the machine design.

default.zh: 智能装备类专业导论以智能装备的设计和应用为目标，针对智能装备类专业所涵盖学科专业的特点、发展历程、学科领域主要研究内容、学科发展与社会产业结构的关系、就业前景等发展趋势等进行针对性的介绍，使学生认识到智能技术的重要性，引导学生建立正确的学习理念、增强专业认同、树立正确的择业观，提供大学专业学习引导，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事相关技术领域工作打下基础，在培养学生机械系统综合设计能力、提高解决复杂机械工程问题的能力等方面占有重要的地位。
default.en: The course of Introduction to Intelligent Equipment Specialty aims to introduce the characteristics, development history, main research contentsd, the relationship between disciplinary development and social industrial structure, and employment prospects of the intelligent equipment specialty. Through targeted introductions, students can recognize the importance of intelligent technology, establish correct learning concepts, enhance professional identity, and form correct career views. This course also provides guidance for university studies, lays a foundation for further learning of related professional courses and future work in related technical fields, and plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive design capabilities for mechanical systems and improving their abilities to solve complex mechanical engineering problems.

default.zh: 本门课程是为机械类专业和近机械类学生开设的一门技术基础课，主要研究用投影法绘制工程图样和解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，主要内容如下：机械制图的基本知识，介绍有关《机械制图》的国家标准及有关绘图的一些基础技能；投影的基础理论，点、直线和平面的投影，平面立体和曲面立体的投影，截交线和相贯线的画法；组合体的画法及组合体的尺寸标注，通过这部分内容的学习，使学生能够将各种空间几何形体，正确地用三视图表达出来；学习机件的表达方法等,使学生了解有关机械图的有关知识,能够画出和读懂中等复杂程度图样。
default.en: This course is a technical basic course for mechanical and near-mechanical students. It mainly studies the theory and method of drawing engineering drawings and solving spatial geometric problems by projection method. The main contents are as follows: basic knowledge of mechanical drawing, introduction National Standards for Mechanical Drawing and some basic skills related to mapping; basic theory of projection, projection of points, lines and planes, projection of plane solids and curved surfaces, The drawing method of the intersecting line,; the drawing of the combined body and the dimensioning of the combined body, through the study of this part, the students can use various spatial geometric shapes correctly. Learning of machine expression, enable the students to understand the relevant knowledge about the mechanical drawings, and to draw and read drawings with medium comlexities.

default.zh: 工程制图基础B是为非机类专业开设的一门技术基础课，主要研究用投影法绘制工程图样和解决空间几何问题的理论和方法。使学生学会运用工程图表达设计思想的理念，作为学生最先接触的一门工程技术类课程，承担着转变学生思维观念和引领学生建立工程意识的任务。课程的主要授课目标是培养学生的空间想象、空间思维能力；学习运用正确、规范的工程标准表达设计思想，绘制基本工程图的能力。
default.en: This course is a technical basic course for non-mechanical students. It mainly studies the theory and method of drawing engineering drawings and solving spatial geometric problems by projection method. Students can learn to use engineering drawings to express the idea of design ideas. As an engineering technology course that students first contact, they undertake to change students' thinking concepts and lead students to the task of building engineering awareness. The main objectives of the course are to develop students' spatial imagination and spatial thinking ability; to learn the ability to use the correct and standardized engineering standards to express design ideas and to draw basic engineering drawings.

default.zh: 画法几何与阴影透视是一门建筑类专业必修的技术基础课。它分为投影理论、建筑阴影、建筑透视三部分。其中投影理论部分着重研究解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，为培养学生空间想象力和创新能力打下良好的基础；建筑阴影部分研究绘制建筑立面阴影和轴测图上的阴影，为学生做好建筑物的立面图阴影提供准备；建筑透视部分研究绘制透视图以及透视图的阴影，使学生能够达到初步设计的能力，同时它又为学生学习后续课程和完成课程设计和毕业设计打下基础。
default.en: Descriptive Geometry and Shadow Perspective is a compulsory technical basic courcomplete course design and grase for the Building Profession Students. It is divided into three parts: projection theory, architectural shadow, and architectural perspective. The projection theory part focuses on the theory and method of solving spatial geometry problems, and lays a good foundation for cultivating students' spatial imagination and innovation ability; the architectural shadow part studies the shadows on the building facade shadows and the axonometric drawings, and prepares for the students. The elevation of the building's elevations provides preparation; the architectural perspective section draws perspectives and perspectives to enable students to achieve initial design capabilities, while at the same time laying the groundwork for students to follow-up courses and duation design.

default.zh: 本课程是一门土木类专业必修的技术基础课，主要培养绘图能力。本课程分为投影理论、制图基础和专业制图三部分。投影理论着重研究解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，包括点、直线和平面的投影，立体的投影，轴测投影等；制图基础着重研究各种表达方法；专业制图主要研究运用国家标准规范绘制和阅读工程图样方法，使学生掌握阅读并且绘制简单工程图样的能力。
default.en: This course is a compulsory fundamental course for civil engineering specialties. The general purpose is to cultivate and train the students' ability of sketching. This course contains three parts, which are projection theory, drawing fundamental and civil engineering graphics. The projection theory introduces theories and methods of solving geometric problems in space, including projections of points, lines and planes, multi-faceted orthographic and isometric projections of solids. In the part of civil engineering drawing fundamental, students will learn different expression method. Civil engineering graphics presents reading and drawing civil engineering ghrapics by using national standards, and grants the students capability of reading and drawing civil engineering ghrapics.

default.zh: 建筑工程制图是建筑类专业必修的技术基础课，包括建筑工程制图，计算机绘图两部分。建筑工程制图主要研究用运用国家标准规范绘制和阅读建筑工程图样方法，计算机绘图主要培养学生操作绘图软件进行工程图绘制的能力。为培养学生的绘图、读图和建立空间想象能力打下必要的基础，使学生具备初步设计能力。
default.en: This course is a compulsory fundamental course for architectural engineering specialties，it contains two parts, which are architectural engineering ghrapics and computer draughting. Architectural engineering ghrapics presents reading and drawing architectural engineering ghrapics by using national standards of civil engineering and grants, and computer draughting presents the abilities of drawing architectural engineering ghrapics by using computer software. Students are trained to have abilities of drawing, reading and spatial imagining, then have the preliminary ability of design.

default.zh: 建筑工程制图是纯英授课体系中建筑类专业必修的技术基础课，包括建筑工程制图，计算机绘图两部分。建筑工程制图主要研究运用国家标准规范绘制和阅读建筑工程图样方法，计算机绘图主要培养学生操作绘图软件进行工程图绘制的能力。使学生具备初步运用工程图进行设计能力。
default.en: Architectural engineering drawing is a mandatory foundational technical course for architecture majors within a fully English-taught curriculum. It comprises two main components: architectural engineering drawing and computer-aided drafting. The former focuses on the methods of creating and interpreting architectural drawings in accordance with national standards and regulations. The latter aims to cultivate students' proficiency in utilizing drafting software to produce engineering drawings. Ultimately, this course equips students with the preliminary ability to apply engineering drawings in architectural design.

This course contains three parts, which are projection theory, drawing fundamental and civil engineering graphics. The projection theory introduces theories and methods of solving geometric problems in space, including projections of points, lines and planes, multi-faceted orthographic. In the part of engineering drawing fundamental, students will learn different expression method. Engineering graphics presents reading and drawing engineering ghrapics by using national standards, and grants the students capability of reading and drawing engineering ghrapics.

default.zh: 制图技术基础是建筑类专业必修的技术基础课。理解建筑与机械领域组合体的形成方式（叠加、切割、综合），能分析复杂形体的几何构成逻辑。本课程目标是培养学生掌握国家制图标准（GB/ISO）中组合体的视图配置、剖面图/断面图表达方法，区分建筑（如梁板柱节点）与机械（如箱体类零件）的表达差异。
default.en: Fundamentals of Cartography Technology is a compulsory technical basic course for architecture majors. Understand the formation mode (superposition, cutting and synthesis) of the assembly in the field of architecture and machinery, and analyze the geometric composition logic of complex bodies. The goal of this course is to train students to master the view configuration, sectional view/sectional view expression method of assembly in national drawing standard (GB/ISO), and to distinguish the expression differences between buildings (such as beam-column joints) and machinery (such as box parts).

default.en: Descriptive Geometry and Shadow Perspective is a compulsory technical basic courcomplete course design and grase for the Building Profession Students. It is divided into three parts: projection theory, architectural shadow, and architectural perspective. The projection theory part focuses on the theory and method of solving spatial geometry problems, and lays a good foundation for cultivating students' spatial imagination and innovation ability; the architectural shadow part studies the shadows on the building facade shadows and the axonometric drawings, and prepares for the students. The elevation of the building's elevations provides preparation; the architectural perspective section draws perspectives and perspectives to enable students to achieve initial design capabilities, while at the same time laying the groundwork for students to follow-up courses and duation design.

default.zh: 工程图样是人们用来表达和交流设计思想的重要工具，是工程技术部门一项重要技术文件，是工程界的共同“语言”，是工程技术人员必须掌握的知识，是从事技术工作的基础。机械工程制图是研究绘制和阅读工程图样的一门技术基础课，它既有系统的理论又有较强的实践性和技术性。本课程主要学习标准件和常用件，用投影理论绘制零件图和装配图的方法。为培养学生的绘图、读图和建立空间想象能力打下必要的基础，同时，又是学生学习后续课程和完成课程设计和毕业设计不可缺少的基础。
default.en: Engineering drawings are important tools used by people to express and exchange design ideas. They are an important technical document of the engineering and technical department. They are the common "language" of the engineering community, the knowledge that engineering and technical personnel must master, and the basis for engaging in technical work. Mechanical engineering drawing is a technical basic course for studying drawing and reading engineering drawings. It has both systematic theory and strong practicality and technicality. This course studies standard parts and common parts, and focuses on the method of drawing part and assembly drawings using projection theory. It lays the necessary foundation for cultivating students' drawing, reading and establishing spatial imagination. At the same time, it is also an indispensable foundation for students to learn follow-up courses and complete curriculum design and graduation design.

default.zh: 机械设计基础课程B是一门用以培养学生机械设计能力的技术基础课，旨在培养学生综合运用先修课程中所学知识和技能，解决机械工程实际问题的能力，结合各种实践教学环节，进行机械工程技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事机械设计工作打下基础，因此在近机械类专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和作用，是高等工科院校中近机械类专业一门主干课程，在人才培养的教学计划中占有重要的地位。 本课程主要研究： 机械的组成及课程的研究对象；机械零件设计概述；常用工程材料及钢的热处理；极限与配合；机械运动简图及自由度；连杆机构的功能及设计原理；凸轮机构的功能、强度计算及结构设计；带传动的应用基础及普通V带传动设计；齿轮机构的传动原理、齿轮传动失效形式与设计准则、圆柱直齿轮传动强度计算、圆柱斜齿轮强度计算、齿轮传动结构设计、齿轮传动效率与润滑；蜗杆传动类型、普通圆柱蜗杆失效形式、设计准则和材料选择；轮系的分类及应用、定轴轮系、周转轮系、混合轮系传动比计算；间歇机构的工作原理；螺纹连接的类型、标准件、预紧和防松、螺栓连接的强度计算、螺栓组设计；轴的结构设计、强度及刚度计算、键连接、花键连接；滚动轴承的构造、代号及其类型选择、滚动轴承的失效形式及选择计算、轴系部件结构、润滑与密封；摩擦磨损及润滑基本知识、滑动轴承的结构和轴瓦材料、非液体摩擦轴承设计计算、液体动压和静压滑动轴承原理；联轴器、离合器及制动器的类型、应用及选择； 本课程的主要任务是培养学生： 掌握机构分析与设计的基本理论和基本方法；具有对机械系统运动方案创新设计的初步能力； 掌握设计或选用通用机械零部件的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，具有设计机械传动装置和一般机械的能力；具有运用标准、规范，查阅技术资料的能力、计算能力、绘图能力； 掌握机械设计基础的实验原理和方法，具有进行实验研究的初步能力；了解机械设计的新理论、新方法。
default.en: Machine Design Basis B is a technical basic course designed to cultivate students 'mechanical design ability. It aims to cultivate students' comprehensive application of the knowledge and skills acquired in the prerequisite courses to solve the practical problems of mechanical engineering. The basic training for the technicist of machine engineering coupled with the practical teaching establishes the basis for the students to study professional curriculum or work for the machine design project. Therefore, Machine Design Basis B is a major course and plays an important role in the teaching program related to the mechanical engineering, is a major course in mechanical engineering in higher engineering colleges and universities, occupying an important position in the teaching plan of personnel training. The main contents include:The composition of machinery and the object of study of the course; mechanical parts design overview; common engineering materials and heat treatment of steel; limits and fits; mechanical motion sketches and degrees of freedom; the function of the mechanical linkage and design principles; cam mechanism function, strength calculation and structural design; the application of the foundation of the belt drive and ordinary V-belt drive design; gear mechanism transmission principles, gear transmission failure forms and design guidelines, strength calculation of cylindrical spur gear transmission ,strength calculation of cylindrical helical gears, structural design of gear transmission, efficiency and lubrication of gear transmission; types of worm drive, failure form of common cylindrical worm, design guidelines and material selection; classification and application of wheel system, fixed shaft wheel system, turnover wheel system, mixed wheel system transmission ratio calculation; working principle of intermittent mechanism; type of screw connection, standard parts, pre tightening and anti-loosening, strength calculation of bolt connection, bolt group design; structural design, strength and stiffness calculation of shaft, key connection, spline connection the structure, code and type selection of rolling bearings, failure form and selection calculation of rolling bearings, shafting component structure, lubrication and sealing; basic knowledge of friction, wear, and lubrication, structure of sliding bearings and bearing pad materials, design and calculation of non-liquid friction bearings, principles of hydrodynamic and hydrostatic sliding bearings; type, application, and selection of couplings, clutches, and brakes;The main task of this course is to train students: Basic theory and method for the structural analysis and design; Primary ability of innovative design of mechanical system motion scheme.Basic theory, knowledge and technology for the design/option of the universal mechanical parts and the ability for the design of mechanical transmission device. Ability for reading, calculation and drawing based on the criterion and laws.. Experimental theory and methods for the machine design basis and the primary ability for experimental research. New theory and methods for the machine design.
