default.zh: 飞行器结构设计是飞行器制造工程专业的一门专业基础课，在教学过程中综合先修课程中所学到的有关知识和技能，进一步学习飞行器结构设计的基本原理。 本课程将飞行器结构设计的基本原理、基本方法与典型结构的具体分析相结合，使学生掌握飞行器结构设计的基础知识、飞行器结构组成、各组成部分的基本结构形式，以及结构分析与设计方法。 结合飞行器典型结构的分析、设计的原理和方法，培养学生树立正确的工程结构设计思想，以及对工程结构的分析和设计的能力，掌握传力分析与强度设计等从事飞行器结构设计工作所必需的基本功。课程结合宇航空间机构及控制研究中心进行的大量研究，在相应章节介绍月球车、火星车、载人月球车、折展机构、锁解机构、采样机构等我国先进飞行器的相关技术，采用大量的启发性教育贯穿课堂，使学生尽早理解机构及结构设计的本质。在结构部分，着重强调结构中材料、空间尺度、结构形式和受力载荷等要素的把握；在机构部分中，着重开展自由度、运动学、动力学、振动学及功能性能等部分的把握，为飞行器结构设计创新奠定基础。
default.en: Aircraft structural design is a professional basic course in the aircraft manufacturing engineering major. During the teaching process, the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses are integrated to further learn the basic principles of aircraft structural design. This course combines the basic principles and methods of aircraft structural design with the specific analysis of typical structures, allowing students to master the basic knowledge of aircraft structural design, aircraft structural components, the basic structural forms of each component, and structural analysis and design methods. Combined with the analysis of typical aircraft structures, design principles and methods, students are trained to establish correct engineering structure design ideas, as well as the ability to analyze and design engineering structures, and master force transmission analysis and strength design necessary for engaging in aircraft structural design work. Basic skills. The course combines a large amount of research conducted by the aerospace agency and control research center. In the corresponding chapters, it introduces the relevant technologies of my country's advanced aircraft such as lunar rover, Mars rover, manned lunar rover, folding and unfolding mechanism, locking and unlocking mechanism, sampling mechanism, etc., using a large number of Inspiring education runs throughout the classroom to enable students to understand the nature of institutions and structural design as early as possible. In the structural part, emphasis is placed on grasping the materials, spatial scale, structural form, and mechanical loads in the structure; in the mechanism part, emphasis is placed on grasping the degrees of freedom, kinematics, dynamics, vibrations, and functional performance. Laying the foundation for aircraft structural design innovation.

default.zh: 飞行器制造工艺与装备是机械类飞行器制造工程模块学生最为主要的专业核心课程，是一门培养学生掌握飞行器制造技术和飞行器制造装备的工作原理、特点和组成的专业课，为学生进一步学习飞行器制造工程专业的其他专业课和今后从事飞行器制造工程工作打下基础。着重培养学生们对飞行器制造的工艺分析及专用装备设计能力，以及典型弹星箭结构及部件的工艺特点，以及特殊结构特殊材料的制造工艺特点，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。本课程在飞行器制造工程专业的教学计划中占有重要的地位和作用，是一门重要的必修课程。 飞行器制造工艺与装备的教学目的就是通过本课程学习，使学生掌握几种航天用特种材料构件加工工艺的基本方法及特点。通过讲授及实例分析，使学生了解掌握几种主要航天用特种材料构件加工的工艺过程和特殊设备，如钛合金、高温合金、复合材料加工及相应的装备等，并基本能进行独立分析及设计航天特种材料构件的加工工艺。
default.en: The course on Manufacturing Technology and Equipment of Aircraft stands as a cornerstone within the curriculum of aircraft manufacturing engineering, playing a pivotal role in cultivating students' expertise. It serves as a conduit for students to grasp the intricate workings, characteristics, and components comprising aircraft manufacturing technology and equipment. This foundational knowledge not only paves the way for deeper exploration into specialized areas of aircraft manufacturing engineering but also equips students with the requisite skills for future endeavors in this field. Emphasizing the analysis of aircraft manufacturing processes and the design of bespoke equipment, the course delves into the nuanced process characteristics of typical bullet, star, and arrow structures, along with the manufacturing intricacies of special materials. By fostering a culture of innovation, it aims to facilitate the attainment of key learning outcomes. Indeed, this course assumes a paramount position within the aircraft manufacturing engineering curriculum, serving as an indispensable compulsory offering.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授机电系统与数字控制技术的基本理论、系统设计、数控装备和数控编程的相关内容，包括机电一体化产品的设计方法；机电系统中机械部件的设计与选择；机电一体化系统常用传感器及其信号处理，常用传感器接口及设计；机电系统中的执行元件，常用电机伺服控制技术；专用计算机数字控制技术，数控系统的组成，数控程序编制，数控标准、指令代码、工艺基础；数控编程的数学处理和自动编程系统的基本原理；机电系统中的轨迹控制技术与实现方法。
default.en: This course addresses the relevant subjects involved in mechatronics system and numerical control technology. It includes the following aspects: the design method of mechatronics products, the design and selection of mechanical parts, the sensors and its signal processing and interface circuits, the mechanical actuators, the working and control principals of servo motors involved in mechatronics system; computer numerical control technology including its components, program design, its codes, its process basis and its trace control technology and realization methods.

default.zh: 《飞行器制造工程专题》课程讲授的目的是通过对专业性质、专业特点、专业内涵、专业研究方向等方面的深入分析与讲解，使学生深入了解专业的内涵，同时使学生了解本专业科学与技术研究的范畴和目前本专业重点科研方向和科研成果，从而能够更进一步地体会到本专业在国家建设与发展进程中所起到的重要作用，使学生进一步明确学习目，提高学生的学习动力和学习兴趣，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。本课程在飞行器制造工程专业的教学计划中占有重要的地位和作用，是一门重要的必修课程。
default.en: The purpose of the course "Aircraft Manufacture Engineering Introduction" is to deeply analyze and explain the characteristics, connotations, and research directions of the profession, so that students can have a deep understanding of the connotation of the profession. At the same time, students can understand the scope of scientific and technological research in their profession, as well as the current key research directions and achievements of their profession, In this way, students can further appreciate the important role that their major plays in the process of national construction and development, clarify their learning objectives, improve their learning motivation and interest, increase their innovation awareness, and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in the professional learning outcomes. This course occupies an important position and role in the teaching plan of aircraft manufacturing engineering, and is an important compulsory course.

default.zh: 设施规划与物流管理课程是制造工程类专业重要的学科专业课程之一，设施规划与物流管理的目的在于通过对制造业企业进行具体的规划和设计，使生产要素和各子系统按照工业工程要求进行合理的配置，组成更富有生产力的集成系统。它是工业工程实现系统整体优化，提高整体效益的关键环节。随着制造技术、控制技术、信息技术、网络技术、智能制造技术的发展，设施规划与物流管理技术从传统的加工制造领域向现代制造业、服务业、物流业、农业、行政和军事等行业和领域渗透，物联网技术等智能技术率先在物流管理领域开展了许多新的应用。设施规划与物流管理的知识、方法和工具称为制造和工程技术人才必不可少的基本技能。 本课程主要讲授系统化工业设施规划与物流分析的理论方法及其应用，使学生从观念和技术上初步掌握工业设施规划与物流分析的能力，具备系统观和最优化观念。 本课程的主要内容包括设施规划与物流分析方法中的设施选址、设施布置设计、容量规划、物料搬运系统设计、物料搬运和仓储设备和仓储规划的基本概念、原理及规划设计和评价方法。并结合智能制造背景，介绍物联网技术及工业智能方法在物流服务中的应用。 本课程为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后在企业中从事制造业、服务业设施规划与物流管理相关工作打下基础。本课程可以作为制造工程类专业本科专业课程，也可以作为其他相关专业的选修课程。
default.en: The course of facility planning and logistics management is one of the important professional courses for manufacturing engineering majors. The purpose of facility planning and logistics management is to make the production factors and subsystems reasonably configured according to the requirements of industrial engineering through planning and design of manufacturing enterprise, so as to obtain a manufacturing system with high economic and social benefits. With the development of manufacturing technology, control technology, information technology, network technology, and intelligent manufacturing technology, facility planning and logistics management technology has penetrated from traditional processing and manufacturing fields to modern manufacturing, service industry, logistics industry, agriculture, administration, and military industries and fields. Intelligent technologies such as the Internet of Things have taken the lead in many new applications in the field of logistics management. The knowledge, methods, and tools of facility planning and logistics management are essential basic skills for manufacturing and engineering technicians. This course mainly teaches the theoretical methods and applications of systematic industrial facility planning and logistics analysis, enabling students to have a preliminary understanding of industrial facility planning and logistics analysis from a conceptual and technical perspective, and possess a systematic and optimization concept. The main content of this course includes the basic concepts, principles, planning, and evaluation methods of facility location selection, facility layout design, capacity planning, material handling system design, material handling and warehousing equipment and warehousing planning in facility planning and logistics analysis methods. And combined with the background of intelligent manufacturing, introduce the application of IoT technology and industrial intelligence methods in logistics services. This course lays the foundation for students to further study relevant professional courses and engage in industrial facility planning and logistics management related work in enterprises in the future. This course can be used as an undergraduate professional course for manufacturing engineering majors, or as an optional course for other related majors.

default.zh: 本课程主要从生产（或服务）和管理系统优化的角度讲述有关工效学的思想、理论和方法，详细介绍人的生理和心理特点、作业能力、认知能力、行为方式，重点介绍系统中人的因素的重要性。以人的工作优化（高效、安全、健康、舒适）为目标，讲述与人有关的环境、工具、设备、任务、系统、作业空间的合理设计问题。本课程的主要内容包括：工效学概述；人的因素（生理及心理）；作业环境（包括特殊环境）测量、分析、评价、设计和改善；人的作业效能，包括体力作业负荷评定、人的信息处理系统、脑力负荷测量与预测；人体测量与作业空间设计；人机系统、人机界面设计；劳动安全与事故预防。
default.en: This course is primarily from the optimization of production or services and management system to talk about the ideas, theories and methods of Ergonomics. It details a person's physiological and psychological characteristics, operational capability, cognitive ability, and behavior. It highlights the importance of the human factor of the system. To optimize the work of the people to achieve the degree of efficiency, safety, health, comfort as the goal, it describes rational design problems of the environment, tools, equipment, tasks, systems and operating space with people. The main content of the course includes: Ergonomics overview; Human factors (including physical and psychological); Operating environment measurement (including special environment), analysis, evaluation, design and improvement; Person's operating performance, including assessment of physical work load, Human information processing system, Mental workload measurement and prediction; Anthropometric and work space design; Man-machine systems, Human-computer interface design; Labor safety and accident prevention.

default.zh: 本课程主要内容包括：质量的概念、质量管理发展的历程、质量管理学课程的研究对象与主要内容。介绍统计过程控制、质量控制图的重要性，控制图原理，生产或服务质量稳定或不稳定的判断原则，休哈特控制图和通用控制图。介绍质量检验各个阶段使用的手段，质量检验机构的设定和职能，不合格管理，抽样检验理论。讨论质量改进方法和手段、实验设计方法和理论。介绍质量功能展开的使用方法及要求质量的重要度概念。介绍市场准入与ISO9000族标准，企业质量体系的建立与完善。介绍质量体系审核、认证方式和方法。介绍质量成本理论以及质量经济分析方法在设计、使用等过程中的应用。介绍质量信息的重要性及内容，质量信息管理系统的职责。
default.en: The contents of this course includes: the concept of quality, the developing experience of quality management, the research object and main contents of the course of quality management, the importance of statistics process control and quality control diagram, the principle of control diagram, the standards for judging whether the quality of production or service is steady or not, the general control diagram and others control diagrams, the different measures for quality inspection in different stages, the setup and function of quality inspection organization, disqualification management, sampling inspection theory, the methods and measures for improving the quality, the method and theory of experiment design, the usage of quality function expandedness, ISO9000 series international standards, the establishment and improvement of an enterprise quality system, the auditing, authentication and method of a quality system, quality cost theory, the application of quality economy analysis method in the process of design and using, the importance and contents of quality information, the function of quality information management system.

default.zh: 生产计划与控制课程是高等工科院校中工业工程专业的一门主干课程。生产计划与控制的目的在于跟踪市场需求的变化，合理安排物料、设备、人力资源和资金等，以降低生产成本、缩短交货期和提高产品质量，提高企业运行的效率，使生产系统实现最佳化的功效。 本门课程共分9章，从介绍企业生产流程与生产方式、生产管理内容与生产计划的关系入手，对综合生产计划、主生产计划进行详细讲解。讲解了库存分析与控制、物料需求计划、能力计划、车间作业计划和项目进度计划与控制、设备维护管理的方法。从不同角度介绍了企业生产过程的计划与控制方法。并与工业发展实际相结合，讲解智能制造战略背景下智能制造的发展历程和关键技术，以及工业工程知识在其中的应用。本课程满分100分，采用累加式考核方法，课堂测验、作业、课程项目、线上学习、期末考试五部分分别占5%、15%、20%、20%、40%的分值比例。
default.en: Production Planning and Control is one of the key courses in Industrial Engineering. To reduce costs, shorten production cycles, improve the quality and efficiency of a company, and keep up with changes in market demand, it is crucial to effectively manage the allocation of materials, equipment, human resources, and capital. These are the core functions of production planning and control. The course is divided into nine chapters, starting with an introduction to the relationship between manufacturing and workflow, modes, and management, followed by a comprehensive overview of production planning and key production schemes. The course also covers topics such as storage analysis and control, material planning, production capacity planning, workshop task planning, project scheduling, and maintenance management. Various methods for production planning and control are presented from different perspectives. To keep up with industry developments, the course also includes a discussion of the history and key technologies of intelligent manufacturing, as well as the application of industrial engineering knowledge in the context of big data manufacturing factories. This course is graded out of a total of 100 points, and the cumulative assessment method is used. Quizzes, homework, course projects, online study, and final exams account for 5%, 15%,20%, 20%, and 40% of the scores, respectively.

default.zh: 随着我国工程技术水平的提升，机械、电气、控制等学科交叉融合越来越普遍，对工程师要求更严格。国家经济发展和技术创新背景下，工科大学生需要具备专业知识和技能，提高跨学科整合能力，培养创新意识和创新能力，满足产业发展需求。 《机电系统动力学》是专业基础课程，讲授机电系统动力学基础理论、建模和分析方法，以及典型机电系统的动力学问题。教学目标是理解机电系统动力学原理，学习和掌握动态特性和响应规律。学生将建立对机电系统动力学的全面认知，将实际问题抽象为数学模型，具备分析和解决实际工程问题的能力。课程还介绍机电系统动力学领域的新理论、新技术和新知识。 课程目标包括了解和掌握机电系统动力学的基本理论、知识和技能，掌握解决复杂机电工程问题所需的机械基础知识，了解机电系统动力学的发展趋向。学生将学习动力学建模和分析方法，应用基本原理解决问题；对复杂问题，选择使用工程工具和信息技术工具进行模拟、预测和分析。培养学生了解机械、电气、控制等领域，解决机械振动、动力学响应和控制问题的能力，应用知识于机电系统的设计、分析和优化。 教学方法包括课堂授课、课外辅导和大作业等环节。采用小班教学，倡导启发式教学和混合教学方法。精选教学内容，采用案例教学、多媒体资料和工程实例等多种形式，鼓励小组讨论和解决方案提出，培养团队协作和创新思维。 《机电系统动力学》课程旨在培养学生综合能力，提供基础知识和技能，适应工程领域的发展趋势。通过学习，学生将全面了解机电系统动力学，并初步具备分析和解决实际工程问题的能力。
default.en: With the advancement of our country's engineering and technological standards, there is an increasing trend towards interdisciplinary integration of fields such as mechanical, electrical, and control, demanding engineers to meet higher standards. Against the backdrop of national economic development and technological innovation, engineering students must acquire professional knowledge and skills, enhance their ability to integrate interdisciplinary concepts, develop innovative awareness and aptitude, and meet the demands of industrial progress. The course "Mechatronics System Dynamics" lays the foundation by imparting the fundamental principles, modeling techniques, and analysis methods in the domain of mechatronics system dynamics, along with addressing dynamic issues unique to mechatronics systems. The main objective is to foster an understanding of the principles behind mechatronics system dynamics and enable students to apprehend and apply dynamic characteristics and response patterns. This course equips students with a comprehensive comprehension of mechatronics system dynamics, the ability to abstract practical problems into mathematical models, and the competence to analyze and solve practical engineering problems. Additionally, the course introduces novel theories, technologies, and knowledge relevant to the field of mechatronics system dynamics. The objectives of the course encompass grasping a firm understanding of the basic principles, knowledge, and skills of mechatronics system dynamics, acquiring the mechanical foundation required to solve intricate mechatronics engineering problems, and assimilating insights into the development trends of mechatronics system dynamics. In this course, students will learn modeling and analysis techniques, and employ fundamental principles to problem-solving. For complex problems, students will select appropriate engineering and information technology tools for simulation, prediction, and analysis. It promotes students' ability to comprehend various domains like mechanical, electrical, and control, and resolve issues pertaining to mechanical vibration, dynamic response, and control, while utilizing their knowledge for the design, analysis, and optimization of mechatronic systems. The teaching methodologies encompass classroom teaching, extracurricular tutoring and large assignments. Adopting small class teaching, encouraging heuristic teaching methods and blended learning. The course content is meticulously curated, making use of case studies, multimedia resources, and engineering examples, stimulating group discussions and encouraging collaborative proposals of solutions, thereby cultivating teamwork and fostering innovative thinking. The course "Mechatronics System Dynamics" aims to nurture students' comprehensive abilities, impart essential knowledge and skills, and enable them to adapt to the emerging trends within the engineering domain. Through this course, students will develop a holistic understanding of mechatronics system dynamics and gain initial proficiency in the analysis and resolution of real-world engineering problems.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授液压传动的发展概况、工作原理和优缺点；液压传动介质的种类、特性和选择；齿轮泵、叶片泵（单、双作用）、柱塞泵（径向、轴向）工作原理、排量、流量计算、结构特点、工作特性和液压泵的选择；液压马达的工作原理和性能参数；液压缸的种类、特点和设计计算；液压阀参数、方向控制阀（单向阀、换向阀）、压力控制阀（溢流阀、顺序阀、减压阀、压力继电器）和流量控制阀（节流阀、调速阀）的工作原理、特性和应用；节流调速、容积调速和容积节流调速的工作原理、调速特性和应用；典型液压传动系统的分析；液压传动系统的设计计算。
default.en: This course addresses the development of the situation of hydraulic transmission system, working principle, virtues and shortcomings. Transmission medium is narrated at its variety, characteristic and choice method. At the same time, gear pump, sling vane pump (double acting pump and single acting pump) and piston pump (radial and axial) are introduced, as well as their working principles, calculating flow, working performance and choice of hydraulic pump. The working principles and performance parameters of hydraulic motor are explained, and the kinds and traits and design calculation of hydraulic actuator are recommended. Three kinds of valves are introduced: directional control valve (checked valve, directional valve),and pressure control valve (overflow valve, sequence valve, pressure reduction valve and pressure delays), and flow control valve (throttle valve and flow regulating valve). We introduce their working principles, traits and applications. The working principle and utilizations of flow regulating—throttle loop, flow regulating—cubage loop, flow regulating—throttle and cubage loop are also presented. In the end, we analyze typical hydraulic transmission systems. The method of designing and calculating of hydraulic system is also explained.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授机电运动系统的基本组成、主要技术指标、运动控制系统的总体设计、技术指标分解与分配。具体讲授机械系统参数对控制指标的影响以及运动控制系统的数学建模；步进电机控制系统；机电控制元件及其相关电路；直流伺服电动机的驱动控制方法及其特殊问题的解决；转速闭环直流调速系统的稳态设计与动态校正；转速电流双闭环直流调速系统的工程化设计方法等。
default.en: This course addresses the basic buildup of electromechanical moving systems, their key specifications, the general design of electromechanical moving systems, decomposition and allocation of technical specifications. Concretely to say, this course addresses the influence of mechanical parameters on the control quality; the mathematical modeling of electromechanical moving systems; control system design of stepping motors; control system elements and related signal circuits; basic control methods of dc servo motors and related special considerations; stable state design of speed control systems and dynamic regulators; engineering design method of double control loops of speed and current of dc motors.

default.zh: 传感与测试技术是机械电子工程专业本科生必需掌握的一门专业基础课，是学生们后续专业课程的基础之一。课程主要讲授传感与测试技术的基本概念，典型传感器（电阻式传感器、电容式传感器、电感式传感器、压电式传感器、磁电式传感器、光传感器、温度传感器）的工作原理、结构、特性和应用案例，信号调理和抗干扰技术。本课程可以使学生掌握传感与测试技术的基础知识和使用方法，对机械领域中出现的测量问题有明确认识和解决思路，培养学生利用所学知识在相关技术领域从事科研和开发工作的能力。
default.en: Transducer and Measurement Technology is one of the must be mastered specialty basic courses to the students of Mechanical electronic engineering, which is a knowledge foundation of the letter specialty lessons. In this course, basic concepts and general properties working principle, basic structure, running characteristics and application of commonly used transducers such as resistance transducer, capacity transducer, inductance transducer, piezoelectricity transducer, magnetism electricity transducer, photoelectricity transducer, and thermology transducer are introduced. In addition, signal conditioning technology and anti-jamming technology are also introduced in this course. This course can enable students to master basic knowledge and application of transducer and measurement technology, have a clear understanding and solution to the measurement problem in mechanical engineering. This course can also cultivate students’ ability to do scientific research and development in related fields.

default.zh: 《机电系统动力学与智能振动控制》是专业基础课程，讲授机电系统动力学基础理论、建模和分析方法，以及典型机电系统的动力学问题，介绍人工智能技术基础及其在机电系统动力学中的应用。 教学目标是理解机电系统动力学原理，学习动态特性和响应规律，掌握人工智能技术的基础理论与应用场景。学生将建立对机电系统动力学的全面认知，将实际问题抽象为数学模型，具备分析和解决实际工程问题的能力。课程还介绍机电系统动力学与智能振动控制领域领域的新理论、新技术和新知识。 课程目标包括了解和掌握机电系统动力学的基本理论、知识和技能，掌握解决复杂机电工程问题所需的机械基础知识，了解机电系统动力学的发展趋向，掌握人工智能技术在参数辨识、振动预测、多自由度系统优化中的核心原理。学生将学习动力学建模和分析方法，应用基本原理解决问题；对复杂问题，选择使用工程工具和信息技术工具进行模拟、预测和分析。培养学生了解机械、电气、控制等领域，解决机械振动、动力学响应和控制问题的能力，应用知识于机电系统的设计、分析和优化；培养学生能够借助人工智能技术对复杂机电系统中的动力学问题进行分析的能力。 教学方法包括课堂授课、课外辅导和大作业等环节。采用小班教学，倡导启发式教学和混合教学方法。精选教学内容，采用案例教学、多媒体资料和工程实例等多种形式，鼓励小组讨论和解决方案提出，培养团队协作和创新思维。 《机电系统动力学与智能振动控制》课程旨在培养学生综合能力，提供基础知识和技能，适应工程领域的发展趋势。通过学习，学生将全面了解机电系统动力学及其智能振动控制，并初步具备运用人工智能技术，实现对复杂问题的模拟、预测与分析，解决实际工程问题的能力。
default.en: The course "Dynamics of Electromechanical Systems and Intelligent Vibration Control" is a foundational professional course that imparts fundamental theories, modeling, and analysis methods for the dynamics of electromechanical systems, as well as addressing dynamic issues in typical electromechanical systems. It also introduces the fundamentals of artificial intelligence (AI) technology and its applications in electromechanical system dynamics. The teaching objectives are to enable students to comprehend the principles of electromechanical system dynamics, analyze dynamic characteristics and response laws, and master the basic theories and application scenarios of AI technology. Students will develop a comprehensive understanding of electromechanical system dynamics, abstract practical problems into mathematical models, and acquire the ability to analyze and solve practical engineering problems. The course further explores emerging theories, technologies, and knowledge in the field of electromechanical system dynamics and intelligent vibration control. The course objectives include: 1) Understanding and mastering the fundamental theories, knowledge, and skills of electromechanical system dynamics; 2) Grasping the mechanical basics necessary to address complex electromechanical engineering problems; 3) Recognizing the development trends in electromechanical system dynamics; 4) Mastering the core principles of AI technology in parameter identification, vibration prediction, and optimization of multi-degree-of-freedom systems. Students will learn dynamic modeling and analysis methods, apply fundamental principles to solve problems, and utilize engineering tools and information technology tools for simulation, prediction, and analysis of complex problems. Additionally, the course aims to cultivate students' understanding of interdisciplinary fields such as mechanics, electricity, and control, enhance their ability to solve problems related to mechanical vibration, dynamic response, and control, and apply this knowledge to the design, analysis, and optimization of electromechanical systems. Furthermore, it fosters students' proficiency in analyzing dynamic problems in complex electromechanical systems using AI technology. The teaching methodologies incorporate classroom instruction, extracurricular tutoring, and major assignments. Small-class teaching is adopted, with an emphasis on heuristic teaching methods and blended learning approaches. The course content is carefully designed, leveraging case studies, multimedia resources, and engineering examples to stimulate group discussions and encourage collaborative problem-solving, thereby promoting teamwork and innovative thinking. The course "Dynamics of Electromechanical Systems and Intelligent Vibration Control" aims to cultivate students' comprehensive abilities, provide them with foundational knowledge and skills, and align with the evolving trends in the engineering field. Upon completion, students will possess a thorough understanding of electromechanical system dynamics and intelligent vibration control, as well as the initial capability to apply AI technology for simulating, predicting, analyzing, and solving practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 本门课程是机器人工程专业的专业核心课程之一，也是学生们学习后续其他专业课的基础。传感器是机器人系统的重要组成部分，机器人检测技术是机器人系统可靠、良好运行的重要技术基础。课程阐述各种典型传感器的工作原理、结构形式、一些工程设计方法和选用的基本知识，也对各种传感器检测技术进行叙述，以及学习各种传感器的应用。通过本门课程的学习，使学生了解机器人系统所应用的传感器基本原理及检测方法，使学生具备一定的机器人传感系统设计与分析能力。
default.en: This course is one of the core courses of robot engineering, which is a knowledge foundation of the latter specialty lessons. Sensor is a very important part of the robot system. Measurement technology is also an important technical basis for reliable and good operation of robot system. This course explains the working principle, structural form, some engineering design methods and the selection of the basic knowledge. Measurement techniques are also described, and the application of various sensors is studied. After learning this course, students can understand the basic principle and structural composition of the robot system. Students also have the basic ability to design a sensor system and measuring system in robot systems.

default.zh: 本门课程是机器人工程辅修专业的专业核心课程之一，也是学生们学习后续其他专业课的基础。传感器是机器人系统的重要组成部分，机器人检测技术是机器人系统可靠、良好运行的重要技术基础。课程阐述各种典型传感器的工作原理、结构形式、一些工程设计方法和选用的基本知识，也对各种传感器检测技术进行叙述，以及学习各种传感器的应用。通过本门课程的学习，使学生了解机器人系统所应用的传感器基本原理及检测方法，使学生具备一定的机器人传感系统设计与分析能力。
default.en: This course is one of the core courses of robot engineering minor, which is a knowledge foundation of the latter specialty lessons. Sensor is a very important part of the robot system. Measurement technology is also an important technical basis for reliable and good operation of robot system. This course explains the working principle, structural form, some engineering design methods and the selection of the basic knowledge. Measurement techniques are also described, and the application of various sensors is studied. After learning this course, students can understand the basic principle and structural composition of the robot system. Students also have the basic ability to design a sensor system and measuring system in robot systems.

default.zh: 《机器人学基础》课程是机器人工程专业的一门基础课程，主要讲授机器人学相关的技术内容。从机器人的产生及发展入手，系统的介绍机器人的概念及特点，讲解系统构成、分类及设计方法，精要讲述机器人运动的数学描述与计算方法、机器人运动学、静力学、动力学的数学建模方法，机器人运动轨迹规划的基本理论和方法，并介绍相关控制基础知识。结合工程仿真软件，在教学中将数学建模方法在计算机软件中得以实现，加深学生对数学建模方法理解的同时，了解机器人设计与分析中的计算机辅助建模方法。最终，让学生掌握对机器人建模与分析的相关理论体系及建模方法，奠定今后机器人研究的相关理论基础。
default.en: "Fundamentals of Robotics" is a foundation course for Robot Engineering, mainly concerned with robotics-related technical content. Starting from the development of robots, this course will systematically introduce the concept and feature, system composition, classification and design method for robots and intensively introduce kinematics, statics, dynamics, trajectory planning theory, control and methods for robot analysis and modelling. The students can also utilize the learned methods by computing software, which will deepen the students’ understanding of robot design and analysis by computer-aided modelling methods. Finally, the students should master the theoretical system for robot analysis and modelling and establish the theoretical foundation for robot research in future.

default.zh: 《机器人学基础》课程是机器人工程专业的一门基础课程，主要讲授机器人学相关的技术内容。从机器人的产生及发展入手，系统的介绍机器人的概念及特点，讲解系统构成、分类及设计方法，精要讲述机器人运动的数学描述与计算方法、机器人运动学、静力学、动力学的数学建模方法，机器人运动轨迹规划的基本理论和方法，并介绍相关控制基础知识。结合工程仿真软件，在教学中将数学建模方法在计算机软件中得以实现，加深学生对数学建模方法理解的同时，了解机器人设计与分析中的计算机辅助建模方法。最终，让学生掌握对机器人建模与分析的相关理论体系及建模方法，奠定今后机器人研究的相关理论基础。
default.en: "Fundamentals of Robotics" is a foundation course for Robot Engineering, mainly concerned with robotics-related technical content. Starting from the development of robots, this course will systematically introduce the concept and feature, system composition, classification and design method for robots and intensively introduce kinematics, statics, dynamics, trajectory planning theory, control and methods for robot analysis and modelling. The students can also utilize the learned methods by computing software, which will deepen the students’ understanding of robot design and analysis by computer-aided modelling methods. Finally, the students should master the theoretical system for robot analysis and modelling and establish the theoretical foundation for robot research in future.

default.zh: 本门课是机器人工程专业本科生的专业核心课，是学生学习后续专业课（如并联机器人技术、医疗机器人技术等）以及机器人课程设计的基础。该课程适应国家机器人相关行业的发展需求，在培养学生的机器人综合设计、分析、仿真以及工程实践能力等方面占有重要的地位。本门课配合了国家的科技战略规划，着力使学生成长为机器人领域敢为天下先的新时代杰出人才。 机器人机构决定了机器人的作用机理，是机器人实现预期功能和性能的前提。本门课主要讲授机器人机构的三个大类，即串联机器人、并联机器人和移动机器人，所运用的理论工具是螺旋理论。通过本课程的课堂教学以及后续的虚拟样机仿真等环节，使学生熟悉机器人机构学的基本原理；掌握机器人机构的拓扑理论，并能够运用拓扑结构综合方法，优选设计方案，开发特定功能和性能的机器人机构；培养学生在机器人机构学方面原始创新和集成创新的能力，促进本课程相应目标点的达成。
default.en: This course is the core professional course for undergraduate students majoring in robotics engineering, and serves as the foundation for students to learn subsequent professional courses (such as parallel robot technology, medical robot technology, etc.) and robot course design. This course meets the development needs of the national robotics industry and plays an important role in cultivating students' abilities in comprehensive robot design, analysis, simulation, and engineering practice. This course is in line with the national science and technology strategic planning, focusing on helping students grow into outstanding talents in the field of robotics who dare to lead the world in the new era.

default.zh: 机器人运动控制技术是机械电子工程专业的主干专业课之一，机器人的应用越来越普及，它不仅广泛应用于工业生产和制造部门，在航天、海洋探测、危险及恶劣等特殊环境中也获得了大量的应用。所以运动控制技术在机器人应用中起着重要作用，是学生后续从事科学研究的基础知识，在培养学生机器人运动系统综合分析能力、设计能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要以机器人为研究对象，阐述机器人相关运动控制原理及应用技术。通过本门课程的学习, 使学生正确地理解和运用机器人运动控制基本原理及方法，具备机器人总体设计和运动控制设计能力。
default.en: Robot motion control technology is one of the main professional courses in mechanical and electrical engineering. The application of robots is becoming more and more popular. It is not only widely used in industrial production and manufacturing departments, but also has been widely used in special environments such as aerospace, marine detection, danger and harshness. Therefore, robot motion control technology plays an important role in robot application and is the basic knowledge of students' subsequent scientific research. It plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability and design ability of robotic motion system. This course mainly focuses on robots and describes the principles and application techniques of robot-related motion control. Through the study of this course, students can correctly understand and apply the basic principles and methods of robot motion control, and have the capabilities of overall design and motion control design.

default.zh: 机器人视觉课程是一门用以培养学生从事机器人视觉应用能力的课程。课程目标是使学生了解机器人视觉技术的概念及发展历程、理解视觉技术基础、熟悉常用的视觉设备；初步掌握视觉标定、视觉测量、视觉识别等常用机器人视觉技术。通过本门课的学习，希望学生了解本领域研究现状及主要方法，掌握机器人视觉的常用方法和基本理论，培养学生机器人视觉设计过程中的应用知识的能力。本门课程是理论结合实践课程，在一定程度上将高年级本科生从专业基础知识逐步带入到机器人视觉工程应用过程。许多学习内容和相关知识与当前的机器人热点研究方向息息相关，教学内容和案例具有鲜明的时代特点，生动的演示体验和良好的互动效果。在教学过程中要综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后工作打下基础。
default.en: Robot vision course is a compulsory course for minor degree, makes students to engage in the potential applications of robotic vision. The aim of the course is to enable students to know the concept and development of robotic vision, understand some basic technologies, familiarize with common robot vision equipment and also, some preliminary and useful common skills such as visual calibration, visual measurement and recognition. Through the study of this course, students are hoped to understand the current situation and main methods in the field of robot vision, master the basic theories of robot vision, the design of robot vision. This course is a combination of theory and practice. To some extent, it gradually brings senior undergraduates from basic professional knowledge to the applications of robotic vision engineering. Many learning contents are closely related to the current hotspot research directions of robots. The teaching contents of this course have distinct characteristics of state-of-art technologies, vivid demonstration and good interactive effect. With knowledge and skills acquired in the pre-course introduced, the teaching process carries out the basic training methods combined with various practical teaching steps, so as to establish the fundamentals for students who wish to further study the relevant professional courses and work in the future.

default.zh: 随着以深度学习为代表的机器学习技术在计算机视觉、自然语言处理、大数据分析等领域得到成功应用，人工智能将引领新一轮工业革命，将大大改善和影响人类的未来生活。“人工智能基础与应用”是智能制造工程专业的核心课程，课程紧密结合智能制造的国家发展规划和行业发展需求及尖端人才培养需求，系统地介绍了人工智能的基本原理、方法和应用技术，具体内容包括绪论、Python：人工智能开发语言、数据回归预测、分类器、聚类分析、听觉智能——语音识别、视觉智能——图像识别等，是从事与人工智能相关领域工作人员所必需的专业知识，是进一步发展智能制造的技术基础。通过本课程理论联系实际的学习，使学生掌握从事人工智能技术和智能制造所必备的基础知识和应用经验，增强学生的综合工程素质及解决复杂工程问题的能力，为后续课程的学习及可能开展的科学研究和工程实践奠定坚实的理论基础。
default.en: With the successful application of machine learning technology represented by deep learning in computer vision, natural language processing, big data analysis and other fields, artificial intelligence (AI) will lead a new round of industrial revolution, and will greatly improve and affect the future life of mankind. "Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence and its Applications" is the core course of the intelligent manufacturing engineering specialty. The course closely combines the national development planning of intelligent manufacturing, the industry development needs and the training needs of cutting-edge talents, and systematically introduces the basic principles, methods and application technologies of AI. The specific contents include introduction of AI, Python: artificial intelligence development language, data regression prediction, classifier, clustering analysis, auditory intelligence--speech recognition, visual intelligence-- image recognition, etc. is the necessary professional knowledge for workers engaged in the field related to artificial intelligence. And it is the technical basis for further development of intelligent manufacturing. Through the study of integrating theory with practice in this course, students can master the basic knowledge and application experience necessary for AI technology and intelligent manufacturing, enhance their comprehensive engineering quality and ability to solve complex engineering problems, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for the study of subsequent courses and possible scientific research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授智能制造技术在智能制造工程领域应用的相关基本理论和基本知识，介绍智能制造技术发展背景和意义，讲授人工智能中机器学习、人工神经网络的基本原理；讲授智能设计与智能加工系统与工艺的基本知识；介绍智能监测、诊断与预测的基本原理和方法。 对智能制造系统和智能制造装备技术进行介绍， 本课程结合先进的智能制造技术实例，加深学生对智能制造技术基本理论与应用的理解，培养学生解决实际智能制造工程问题的能力。课程具体内容包括：智能制造技术发展背景和意义；智能制造技术内涵、特征与发展趋势；机器学习与人工神经网络； 智能设计与智能加工；智能制造数据库与建模；智能监测、诊断与预测；智能制造系统与智能制造装备等。
default.en: This course mainly teaches the basic theories and basic knowledge related to the application of intelligent manufacturing technology in the field of intelligent manufacturing engineering, introduces the development background and significance of intelligent manufacturing technology, teaches the basic principles of machine learning and artificial neural networks in artificial intelligence; teaches intelligent design and intelligent processing Basic knowledge of systems and processes; introduce the basic principles and methods of intelligent monitoring, diagnosis and prediction. This course introduces intelligent manufacturing systems and intelligent manufacturing equipment technology. This course combines advanced intelligent manufacturing technology examples to deepen students' understanding of the basic theory and application of intelligent manufacturing technology and cultivate students' ability to solve practical intelligent manufacturing engineering problems. The specific content of the course includes: the development background and significance of intelligent manufacturing technology; the connotation, characteristics and development trends of intelligent manufacturing technology; machine learning and artificial neural networks; intelligent design and intelligent processing; intelligent manufacturing database and modeling; intelligent monitoring, diagnosis and prediction; Intelligent manufacturing systems and intelligent manufacturing equipment, etc.

default.zh: 智能装备与系统是智能制造工程专业和机械设计制造及其自动化专业本科生的专业核心课之一。本课程主要讲授智能制造装备及其系统涉及的智能感知、智能控制、智能驱动与执行等基础共性技术，以及智能制造装备的单元、整机和系统集成的基本概念、基础知识和核心技术。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握智能制造装备与系统的技术体系和关键问题，理解智能制造装备与系统的数字化、网络化、智能化发展路径和技术方法，具有针对复杂工程问题开展智能制造装备与系统的设计规划、研究分析、模拟仿真或实践应用的能力。课程内容主要包括：智能制造装备的内涵及其关键问题；智能制造装备基础技术，包括智能感知、智能控制、智能驱动与执行；智能制造装备单元技术，包括智能制造装备数控系统、智能主轴单元和智能刀具系统；智能整机系统，包括智能数控车床、智能数控加工中心、增材制造装备智能化和工业机器人；智能制造装备系统集成，包括智能制造生产线、智能化柔性生产系统、智能化车间与智能工厂等。
default.en: Intelligent equipment and system is one of the core courses for undergraduates majoring in intelligent manufacturing engineering and mechanical design, manufacturing and automation. This course mainly teaches basic technologies such as intelligent perception, intelligent control, intelligent drive and execution involved in intelligent manufacturing equipment and its system, as well as basic concepts, basic knowledge and core technologies of unit, whole machine and system integration of intelligent manufacturing equipment. Through the study of this course, students will master the technical system and key issues of intelligent manufacturing equipment and systems, understand the digital, networking and intelligent development paths and technical methods of intelligent manufacturing equipment and systems, and have the ability to carry out design planning, research analysis, simulation or practical application of intelligent manufacturing equipment and systems for complex engineering problems. The content of the course mainly includes: the connotation of intelligent manufacturing equipment and its key issues; Basic technology of intelligent manufacturing equipment, including intelligent perception, intelligent control and intelligent drive; Intelligent manufacturing equipment unit technology, including intelligent manufacturing equipment numerical control system, intelligent spindle unit and intelligent tool system; Intelligent machine system, including intelligent CNC lathe, intelligent CNC machining center, intelligent additive manufacturing equipment and industrial robots; Intelligent manufacturing equipment system integration, including intelligent manufacturing production line, intelligent flexible production system, intelligent workshop and intelligent factory, etc.

default.zh: 通过8次高端人才讲座，了解机器人的总体发展现状，最新的科研成果和发展方向，使学生了解机器人方向要学习哪些内容，开阔学生专业视野，增长专业见识，明确专业学习目标，为进一步探索和深入学习专业知识做好准备。
default.en: Through 8 lectures for high-end talents, students will understand the overall development status of robots, the latest scientific research achievements and development direction, so that students can understand what content to learn in the direction of robots, broaden their professional vision, increase their professional insight, clarify their professional learning goals, and prepare for further exploration and in-depth learning of professional knowledge.

default.zh: 通过7次专家讲座和1次调研交流，进一步了解机器人技术与系统全国重点实验室的科研成果和发展方向，开阔学生专业视野，增长专业见识，明确专业学习目标，为进一步探索和深入学习专业知识做好准备。
default.en: Through 7 expert lectures and 1 survey and exchange, further understand the scientific research achievements and development direction of the National Key Laboratory of Robotics Technology and system, broaden students' professional vision, increase professional insight, clarify professional learning objectives, and prepare for further exploration and in-depth study of professional knowledge.

default.zh: 仿生科学是机械、力学、材料、机器人、人工智能、生命等学科的交叉前沿方向，《仿生学基础》主要研究如何从自然界的结构、功能与进化机制中汲取灵感，并将其转化为工程技术与创新设计。课程内容涵盖仿生学的基本概念、仿生设计与应用、跨学科拓展与前沿技术等方面，重点介绍自然界典型仿生现象，如仿生运动、仿生材料、仿生感知与信息处理等，并结合建筑、医学、机器人、航空航天等领域的前沿应用案例展开分析。本课程培养学生观察自然、提炼功能原理并转化为工程问题的能力，培养学生综合运用跨学科知识，提出初步的仿生设计思路，激发对自然与工程结合的学习兴趣，树立跨学科创新意识。
default.en: Bionic Science lies at the intersection of mechanics, materials science, robotics, artificial intelligence, life sciences, and related fields. Fundamentals of Bionics focuses on drawing inspiration from the structures, functions, and evolutionary mechanisms of nature, and transforming them into engineering technologies and innovative designs. The course covers the basic concepts of bionics, bionic design and applications, interdisciplinary extensions, and emerging technologies. It emphasizes typical bionic phenomena found in nature, such as bio-inspired motion, materials, perception, and information processing, and analyzes frontier application cases in architecture, medicine, robotics, and aerospace. This course aims to cultivate students’ ability to observe nature, extract functional principles, and translate them into engineering problems. It also encourages students to apply interdisciplinary knowledge comprehensively, develop preliminary bionic design ideas, spark interest in integrating nature with engineering, and foster an awareness of interdisciplinary innovation.

default.zh: 生物信息测试技术是近年来迅猛发展的高新技术之一，是在生命科学和信息科学的基础上发展出来的，是生物、电子、机械、材料等多学科相互碰撞和交融的产物。随着生物信息与仿生材料测试技术的发展，其在生命健康、新材料、机械、农业等诸多领域中发挥着愈加重要的作用，并涌现出大量新颖的检测技术和检测设备，展示出十分广阔的应用前景。 《生物信息测试技术》是仿生科学与工程及机械类专业学生的学科基础选修课。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握各类具体生物信息的测试原理、结构和检测方法，了解生物信息测试技术的发展动向。培养学生运用所学知识解决实际问题的实践能力，为从事今后仿生工程和机械工程测试技术方面的研究和开发奠定理论基础。
default.en: Bioinformatics measurement technology is one of the rapidly developing high-tech fields in recent years. It is developed on the basis of life sciences and information science, and is the product of the collision and integration of multiple disciplines such as biology, electronics, mechanics, and materials. With the development of bioinformatics and biomimetic material testing technology, it plays an increasingly important role in many fields such as life and health, new materials, machinery, agriculture, etc., and a large number of novel detection technologies and devices have emerged, demonstrating a very broad application prospect. “Bioinformatics Measurement” is one of the main professional fundamental courses for bionic engineering and mechanical engineering students. The projects of this course are making students to grasp the working principle, the system composition, and evaluation methods of bioinformatics testing technology, understand the development trend of test technology of bioinformatics testing technology. Through learning of this course, develop the ability in the practical ability to solve the problem of actual measurement, provided a basis for dealing with research and development in bionic engineering and mechanical engineering testing technology in the future.

default.zh: 本课程《仿生智能机器人》面向本科生，系统介绍仿生机器人的基础理论与前沿技术，内容涵盖机器人学、仿生学、人工智能、机械工程、控制科学等多学科交叉知识。课程以自然界生物体的结构、功能和行为为灵感来源，重点讲解仿生机构设计、运动分析、力学建模、智能驱动、感知决策、人机交互等核心内容，并结合六足机器人、星球车、软体机器人等前沿机器人案例，帮助学生掌握仿生机器人的设计原理与智能控制方法。通过理论学习与实践结合，培养学生跨学科创新思维，为未来从事机器人研发或相关领域研究奠定基础。
default.en: Bionic Intelligent Robotics is designed for undergraduate students, providing a systematic introduction to the fundamental theories and cutting-edge technologies of bionic robots. It covers interdisciplinary knowledge in robotics, bionics, artificial intelligence, mechanical engineering, control science, and related fields. Inspired by the structures, functions, and behaviors of biological organisms in nature, the course focuses on key topics such as bionic mechanism design, motion analysis, mechanical modeling, intelligent actuation, perception and decision-making, and human-robot interaction. By incorporating real-world applications, including hexapod robots, planetary rovers, and soft robotics, students will gain hands-on experience in the design principles and intelligent control methods of bionic robots. Through a combination of theoretical study and practical training, this course aims to cultivate students' interdisciplinary innovative thinking, laying a solid foundation for future research and development in robotics and related fields.

default.zh: 先进制造技术是集机械、电子、信息、材料、能源和管理等各项先进技术而发展起来的高新技术，它是发展国民经济的重要基础技术之一。先进制造技术是制造业为提高竞争力以适应时代的要求形成的一个高技术群，经过发展，已形成了完整的体系结构。先进制造技术是当今生产力的主要构建因素，也是国民经济不可或缺的支柱。它承担着为国民经济各个部门和科学技术领域提供装备、工具和检测仪器等关键任务，并成为国民经济和科学技术赖以生存和发展的重要手段。尤其值得注意的是，在航空、航天、微电子、光电子、激光、分子生物和核能等尖端科技领域中，没有先进制造技术作为基础将无法实现这些领域内相关科学与工程目标。因此，作为机械制造及自动化专业前沿方向之一，特别对于从事机械制造专业研究的学生而言，掌握先进制造技术内容至关重要。本课程基于航空航天和医疗保健等领域介绍先进技术的新理念和装备技术，旨在使学生熟悉国外先进制造技术前沿、开阔学生思维、拓展知识面、掌握先进技术。
default.en: Advanced manufacturing technology encompasses a comprehensive range of cutting-edge machinery, electronics, information systems, materials, energy sources, and management techniques developed through high-tech advancements. It stands as a pivotal foundational technology crucial for the advancement of national economies. This sophisticated amalgamation of technologies has been strategically adopted by the manufacturing industry to enhance its competitiveness and align with contemporary demands. Over time, it has evolved into a well-structured system that underpins industrial progress. Advanced manufacturing technology plays a pivotal role in today's productivity and serves as an indispensable pillar of the national economy. It assumes crucial responsibilities in supplying equipment, tools, and testing instruments for various sectors of the national economy, as well as science and technology domains. Moreover, it has emerged as a vital means for the survival and advancement of both the national economy and scientific research. Notably, within cutting-edge fields like aviation, aerospace, microelectronics, optoelectronics, lasers, molecular biology, and nuclear energy; advanced manufacturing technology stands as an essential foundation without which achieving relevant scientific breakthroughs or engineering milestones would be unattainable. Hence, proficiency in advanced manufacturing technology is of paramount importance for students involved in mechanical manufacturing research, as it represents a pioneering domain within the field of automation and mechanical engineering. This course will introduce the new concept and equipment technology of advanced technologies based on the fields of aerospace and health care. The aim of the course is to make students familiar with the frontier of foreign advanced manufacturing technology, broad their thinking, expand their knowledge and master advanced technology.

default.zh: 面向智能制造的三维视觉技术及其应用》是一门综合性、专业性都很强的课程，以典型项目中三维视觉应用技术为基础，培养学生对工程项目中的常见工程问题与解决方案的了解，同时加深对工程项目相关理论知识的理解并培养学生面向具体工程项目的评估及方案的能力。 教学目的：让学生能够熟练运用所学的理论知识，解决实际工程问题。通过理论知识、典型项目分析与实践，通过课程的学习，学生可以提高自己的实践能力和创新能力，为将来从事工程相关工作打下坚实的基础。 教学内容：教学内容主要包括机器视觉技术应用、机器人视觉系统、人工智能技术应用等方面。通过介绍工程项目中相关技术的应用，学生可以加深对理论知识的理解，学生需要根据实际工程项目的需求，进行机器视觉技术评估和项目方案设计；学会对智能制造中工程应用项目进行问题梳理分析、机器视觉方案选择及评估，确保技术在工程项目中的顺利应用。 考核方式：课程的评价方式主要包括实验报告、设计方案。学生需要按照要求撰写课程报告，学生需要按照实际工程项目的需求，对设计过程进行总结和分析，并设计出合理的方案，并进行方案评价和改进。
default.en: 3D Vision Technology and Application for Intelligent Manufacturing" is a comprehensive and professional course, based on the application technology of 3D vision in typical projects. This course cultivates student to deal with engineering problems in engineering projects. According to the understanding of relevant theoretical knowledge, students can evaluate and offer project solutions. Teaching objective: To enable students to proficiently apply the theoretical knowledge learned and solve practical engineering problems. Through theoretical knowledge learning, typical project analysis, and practicing, students can improve their practical and innovative abilities through course learning, laying a solid foundation for future engineering related work. Teaching content: The teaching content includes the application of machine vision technology, robot vision systems, and artificial intelligence technology. By introducing the application of relevant technologies in engineering projects, students can deepen their understanding of theoretical knowledge. They need to evaluate machine vision technology and design project plans based on the actual needs of engineering projects. Learn to sort out and analyze engineering application projects in intelligent manufacturing, select and evaluate machine vision solutions, and ensure the smooth application of technology in engineering projects. Assessment method: The evaluation method of the course mainly includes experimental reports and design plans. Students need to write course reports according to requirements. They need to summarize and analyze the design process according to the actual needs of engineering projects, design reasonable plans, and evaluate and improve the plans.

default.zh: 专业思维训练课程对培养学生复杂机械系统的设计能力及提高其解决复杂机械工程问题的能力方面具有重要地位。 课程主要讲授以下内容：机构的结构分析，平面机构的运动分析、力分析和机械效率，平面连杆机构、凸轮机构、齿轮机构及其设计，轮系传动比的计算及其设计，机械的运转及速度波动的调节，机械的平衡，在一般工作条件和常用参数范围内的通用机械零部件的工作原理、结构特点、基本设计理论和设计计算方法，以及机械系统方案的设计与选择。在教学过程中要综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行机械工程技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和从事机械设计工作打下基础。
default.en: The Major thinking training course plays an important role in cultivating students' ability to comprehensively design mechanical systems and improve their ability to solve complex mechanical engineering problems. The course mainly teaches the following contents: the composition principle of the mechanism; the principle and method of mechanism kinematic analysis and force analysis; design principle and design method of linkage mechanism, cam mechanism and gear mechanism; the analysis and design of the gear transmission system; the dynamics analysis method of mechanical system and mechanism balance; the working principle, structural characteristics, basic design theory and design calculation methods of general mechanical parts within the range of general working conditions and common parameters, as well as the design and selection of mechanical system schemes. In the teaching process, it is necessary to comprehensively use the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses, combined with various practical teaching sessions, to carry out the basic training required by mechanical engineering technicians, so as to lay a foundation for students to further study relevant professional courses and engage in mechanical design work.

default.zh: 本课程特聘我国深空探测科学与工程领域高水平专家参与授课，以月球、火星、小天体以及太阳系边际采样探测与资源利用规划与先进案例为主线，主要讲授星球采样探测与资源利用领域国际前沿与发展态势、国内外深空探测创新案例解析、国内外科学与技术差距分析等内容。通过课程讲授、创新案例研讨等形式，向广大学生传授深空探测领域的新知识、新观点、新需求和新动向，树立为国助力情怀、拔高职业发展规划。
default.en: This course has specially invited high-level experts in the field of China's deep space exploration science and engineering to participate in teaching. It takes the planning and advanced cases of sampling exploration and resource utilization of the moon, Mars, small celestial bodies and the edge of the solar system as the main line, and mainly teaches the international frontiers and development trends in the field of planetary sampling exploration and resource utilization, and the analysis of the gap between domestic and foreign science and technology. Through course, it imparts new knowledge, new perspectives, new demands and new trends in the field of deep space exploration to students, strengthen their autonomous learning ability and elevate their career development plans.

default.zh: 讲授增材制造技术所涵盖的基本加工原理与工艺，如何正确选择制造工艺、材料、合理分析增材制造过程表面质量、面型精度、后处理工艺并提出控制方法的知识基础；掌握金属与非金属增材制造设计的基本知识；掌握激光选区熔化（SLM），直接能量沉积（DED）等立体光固化（SLA）, 熔融沉积成型(FDM)中影响加工尺寸与精度的主要因素；了解CAD三维结构设计与切片软件轨迹规划的选用原则和基本设计计算过程。分析高温合金（如Inconel 718）、钛合金（Ti6Al4V）、陶瓷基复合材料等在航空航天环境下的性能优化。通过ANSYS、COMSOL模拟熔池动态、残余应力分布，预测打印缺陷。
default.en: The course covers the fundamental processing principles and techniques involved in additive manufacturing, including how to correctly select manufacturing processes and materials, as well as the rational analysis of surface quality, dimensional accuracy, and post-processing techniques in additive manufacturing, along with proposed control methods. It also provides a foundational understanding of the basic knowledge required for designing metal and non-metal additive manufacturing. Additionally, it delves into the key factors influencing processing dimensions and accuracy in techniques such as SLM, DED, SLA, and FDM. The lecture further explains the selection principles for CAD-based 3D structural design and slicing software trajectory planning, along with the fundamental design calculation process. It analyzes the performance optimization of materials like superalloys (e.g., Inconel 718), titanium alloys (Ti6Al4V), and ceramic matrix composites in aerospace environments. Through ANSYS and COMSOL simulations, it models molten pool dynamics and residual stress distribution to predict printing defects.

default.zh: 本课程系统介绍增材制造技术的基本概念、工艺原理、材料体系及工程应用。课程内容涵盖增材制造的发展历程与技术分类，重点讲授激光粉末床熔融、电子束熔融、熔融沉积成形、立体光刻等典型工艺方法，并结合金属、聚合物、陶瓷及复合材料等材料体系，分析材料选择、工艺参数和零件性能之间的关系。课程还将围绕工艺优化、常见缺陷、后处理技术和质量控制方法展开教学，并通过航空航天、生物医疗、汽车制造和工业生产等领域的典型案例，帮助学生理解增材制造在先进制造中的应用价值。通过课堂讲授、案例分析、实践任务和小组汇报，培养学生分析和解决增材制造相关工程问题的能力。
default.en: This course provides a systematic introduction to the fundamental concepts, process principles, material systems, and engineering applications of additive manufacturing technology. The course covers the development history and classification of additive manufacturing, with emphasis on typical processes such as Laser Powder Bed Fusion, Electron Beam Melting, Fused Deposition Modeling, and Stereolithography. It also discusses metals, polymers, ceramics, and composite materials used in additive manufacturing, and analyzes the relationships among material selection, process parameters, and part performance. In addition, the course addresses process optimization, common defects, post-processing techniques, and quality control methods. Through case studies in aerospace, biomedical engineering, automotive manufacturing, and industrial production, students will understand the application value of additive manufacturing in advanced manufacturing. Lectures, case analyses, practical tasks, and group presentations will be used to develop students’ ability to analyze and solve engineering problems related to additive manufacturing.

default.zh: 本课程是机械设计制造及其自动化专业独具特色的专业课，课程内容涵盖机械制造自动化系统的建立与分析、制造过程自动化控制、物料传输自动化、自动化检测与监控，以及装配自动化等与制造系统自动化密切相关的重要知识点，具有综合性强、多种知识和技术相融合的特点，在培养学生制造系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要地位。课程教学注重理论与实践的结合，倡导以学生为中心的教学理念。教学中通过一些生动形象的典型自动控制系统、传动机构、物料传输机构、上下料机构、贮料机构、自动检测监控系统、自动化装配装置等的录像和动画来辅助理论教学过程，激发学生的学习兴趣，调动学生的主动学习积极性，提高学生创新意识和发现问题及解决问题的能力，培养学生综合运用制造自动化原理、设计、检测和控制等方面知识，来解决机械工程中制造系统自动化和智能化的工程实际问题能力。
default.en: This course is a unique professional course in the field of mechanical design, manufacturing, and automation. The course content covers the establishment and analysis of mechanical manufacturing automation systems, manufacturing process automation control, material transmission automation, automation detection and monitoring, as well as important knowledge points closely related to manufacturing system automation such as assembly automation. It has the characteristics of strong comprehensiveness and the integration of multiple knowledge and technologies, It plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design abilities in manufacturing systems. The course teaching emphasizes the combination of theory and practice, advocating a student-centered teaching philosophy. In teaching, vivid and typical automatic control systems, transmission mechanisms, material transmission mechanisms, loading and unloading mechanisms, storage mechanisms, automatic detection and monitoring systems, automated assembly devices, etc. are recorded and animated to assist in the theoretical teaching process, stimulate students' interest in learning, mobilize their active learning enthusiasm, improve their innovation awareness and ability to discover and solve problems, To cultivate students' ability to comprehensively apply knowledge in manufacturing automation principles, design, testing, and control to solve practical engineering problems related to automation and intelligence in manufacturing systems in mechanical engineering.

default.zh: “机床数控技术”课程是机械大类学生非常重要的专业模块课，在培养学生机械加工数字化、柔性化、智能化系统的综合分析、综合设计能力等方面占有重要地位。 课程主要讲授数控加工的基本理论，程序编制技术，插补原理，数控装置，伺服驱动技术及数控检测技术等。具体为：第1章讲述数控技术的基本概念、基本原理和方法，数控机床的组成、分类，介绍数控技术的产生历史和发展趋势；第2章详细讲解数控程序编制的内容和方法，数控标准、指令代码、工艺基础，数控程编的数学处理和自动编程系统的基本原理，并以实例介绍了数控车削、数控铣削和数控孔加工的程序编制；第3章重点分析数控插补原理（即数控加工轨迹控制的原理）：基准脉冲插补、数据采样插补及其各种插补功能的实现方法；第4章系统讲述计算机数控（CNC）装置的功能、硬件结构、软件结构，CNC装置接口，开关量控制及PLC在数控中的应用；第5章讲述数控驱动系统中检测装置在系统中应用和原理；第6章分析数控直、交流伺服驱动系统（以交流为主）的组成、功能、速度控制、位置控制的原理；第七章介绍智能数控机床与智能加工的基本知识。 课程采用累加式考核，包含三个大作业（15%）、两个实验项目（10%）和期末考试（75%）。
default.en: Computer Numerical Control of Machine Tools is one of the most important courses to the students majoring mechanical engineering, which will lay a knowledge foundation for the design of digital manufacturing system, flexible manufacturing system and intelligent manufacturing system. This course introduces the basic principles of NC machining, CNC programming, the theory of interpolation, CNC unit, techniques about servo drive and measuring，etc. The main content is as follows. Chapter 1 includes the basic concepts, principles, composition, classification, methodologies about the CNC machining, introduces the background, origin and development trends of CNC technologies. Chapter 2 discusses the CNC programming process, includes the NC encoding system, criterion, CNC machining processes, mathematics for NC programming, and automatic programming, presents several programming examples for turning, milling, and hole-making. Chapter 3 introduces the principle of interpolation (control of tool paths), functions and implementation about reference pulse interpolation and data sampling interpolation. Chapter 4 introduces the functions, hardware, software, interface, and PLC about CNC unit. Chapter 5 includes the principle and application about the NC drive system. Chapter 6 discusses the composition, function, speed control, position control of DC and AC servo drive system. Chapter 7 introduces the basic principles of intelligent machine tool and intelligent machining. Grade will be based on 3 reports, 2 experiments, and one final exam with the relative weight being 15%, 10%, and 75% respectively.

default.zh: 电火花加工作为应用最为广泛的特种加工技术之一，具有非接触式加工、加工过程不受材料硬度限制、能加工的材料广泛等诸多优点，在制造领域占据着不可替代的重要位置，被广泛地应用于模具制造、微细加工等领域。本课程在强化电火花加工基本原理、加工机理、加工中的一些基本工艺规律的基础上，结合科研和实际工程应用，使学生重点掌握以下几个方面的专业知识：（1）现代新型脉冲电源技术；（2）电火花伺服控制技术和数控技术；（3）电火花小孔加工技术和电火花磨削加工技术；（4）高效放电加工技术；（5）镜面电火花加工技术；（6）电火花表面改性技术；（7）电火花铣削加工技术；（8）非导电材料与气体介质电火花加工技术；（9）电火花加工智能工艺决策技术；（10）放电加工技术的发展趋势、需要解决的关键技术、现状与挑战。通过实验了解和掌握典型电火花加工工艺及装备的基本实验技能和测试分析方法，获得实验方案设计和实验技能以及实验数据科学性分析的基本锻炼。通过本课程的授课不仅可以拓宽本专业学生的知识面，培养学生对所学知识的综合运用能力，而且有利于培养学生辩证思维能力及创新意识等综合素质。
default.en: s one of the most widely used special machining technologies, electrical discharge machining (EDM) has many advantages such as non-contact machining, unrestricted machining process by material hardness, and a wide range of materials that can be machined. It occupies an irreplaceable important position in the manufacturing field and is widely used in mold manufacturing, micro machining, and other fields. On the basis of strengthening the basic principles and mechanisms of electrical discharge machining, as well as some basic process rules in machining, this course combines scientific research and practical engineering applications to enable students to focus on mastering the following professional knowledge: (1) Modern new pulse power supply technology; (2) Electric spark servo control technology and CNC technology; (3) Electric discharge small hole machining technology and electric discharge grinding machining technology; (4) Efficient discharge machining technology; (5) Mirror surface electrical discharge machining technology; (6) Spark surface modification technology; (7) Electric discharge milling technology; (8) Non conductive materials and gas dielectric electrical discharge machining technology; (9) Intelligent process decision-making technology for electrical discharge machining; (10) The development trend, key technologies to be solved, current situation, and challenges of discharge machining technology. By conducting experiments, one can understand and master the basic experimental skills and testing analysis methods of typical electrical discharge machining processes and equipment, and gain basic training in experimental scheme design, experimental skills, and scientific analysis of experimental data. The teaching of this course not only broadens the knowledge range of students in this major, cultivates their comprehensive application ability of the learned knowledge, but also helps to cultivate their comprehensive qualities such as dialectical thinking ability and innovative consciousness.

default.zh: 先进光学加工是机械制造中的重要领域，对尖端技术和国防工业的发展具有重要影响。本课程作为学习现代光学制造技术的基础课和入门课，是高等工科院校中机械设计制造及其自动化专业的重要专业选修课。 本课程重点介绍现代光学制造技术领域中近期的进展和成就，主要讲述光的电磁理论、光的干涉与衍射、几何光学基本定律与成像、光线的光路计算及像差理论、先进光学的检测技术、先进光学的加工装备、先进光学的制造工艺等。通过本课程的授课，不仅可以拓宽本专业学生的知识面，培养学生对所学知识的综合运用能力，而且有利于培养学生辩证思维能力及创新意识等综合素质，使学生逐步具备在相关技术领域从事先进光学加工工作和研究的能力。
default.en: The manufacturing technologies of advanced optics are quite crucial in the field of mechanical manufacturing engineering, which have significant influences on the cutting-edge technologies and defense industries. This course can be considered as a foundation or an introduction study to the modern optics manufacturing technologies, which is especially the important professional elective course for the major of mechanical design, manufacture and automation in different higher education colleges of engineering. In general, this course focuses on the recent progress and achievements in the manufacturing technology of modern advanced optics. This course discusses the electromagnetic theory of light, light interference and diffraction, basic laws of geometric optics and imaging, optical path calculation of light rays and aberration theory, testing technologies for advanced optics, machine tool equipment and related manufacturing processes to fabricate the advanced optics, and so forth. Through the teaching of this course, not only can students broaden their knowledge and cultivate their comprehensive application ability of the knowledge they have learned, but it is also beneficial to cultivate their dialectical thinking ability and innovative consciousness, and gradually equip them with the ability to engage in advanced optical manufacturing work and research in related technical fields.

default.zh: 本课程涉及的相关学科主要包括机械振动理论与振动控制技术。主要包含以下几部分内容：机械振动的分类、若干基本概念，研究概况及发展展望；单自由度系统的自由和强迫振动特性，一般激励下的振动响应，以及单自由度振动理论的工程应用；二自由度系统主振动与模态；二自由度系统的自由振动与受迫振动研究；二自由度振动系统工程实例；多自由度系统的振动建模，多自由度系统的自由与强迫振动；多自由系统的振动响应与工程应用；非线性系统振动，随机振动；弦的横向振动，轴的扭转振动，杆的纵向振动，梁的弯曲振动；振动测试与动力学仿真；振动的应用等。
default.en: This course addresses the relevant subjects involved in Mechanical vibration theory and vibration control technology. It includes the following aspects: the basic concepts and classification of mechanical vibrations, research survey and development prospect of mechanical vibrations; free and forced vibration characteristics of a single degree of freedom system, damped vibration characteristics of single degree of freedom system, general excited vibration response, engineering applications of single degree of freedom vibration theory; main vibration mode of a two degree of freedom system, free and forced vibration of a two degree of freedom system, project examples of a two degree of freedom system; vibration model of multi freedom systems, free and forced vibration of multi freedom systems, vibration responses and engineering application of multi freedom systems; shaft torsional vibration, longitudinal vibration of rod, beam bending vibration,; vibration testing and dynamic simulation; vibration application.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授工程机械金属结构的构造特点、设计理论和设计方法。主要内容包括：工程机械金属结构对材料性能的要求和材料的选择；工程机械金属结构载荷的计算和载荷组合方式；金属结构设计中的强度、刚度、稳定等基本设计准则；金属结构主要连接方式，如焊接、螺栓连接、铆接的特点及相应的设计计算方法；金属结构中轴心受力构件、受弯构件和拉弯与压弯构件等基本构件的受力形式和构造原则以及相应设计计算原理。在讲解理论分析计算方法的同时，本课程还针对各种典型工程机械如塔式起重机、轮式起重机、桥式起重机等，分别介绍了其金属结构的构造特点和设计计算方法。 本课程全面贯彻我国起重机国家设计规范(GB/T 3811-2008)和塔式起重机国家设计规范(GB/T 13752-2017)，其内容反映了近年来国内外金属结构设计与计算理论的最新成果。课程内容简洁、准确，重点突出，理论与实践相结合，便于自学。
default.en: This course mainly teaches the construction characteristics, design theory and design methods of metal structure of engineering machinery. The main contents include: the requirements of metal structure of engineering machinery for material performance and material selection; the calculation of metal structure of engineering machinery and load combination; the basic design criteria of strength, stiffness and stability in the design of metal structure; the main connection methods of metal structure, such as the characteristics of welding, bolting, riveting and the corresponding design calculation methods; the stress forms and construction principles of basic members such as axially stressed members, bending members and tension-bending and compression-bending members in metal structure and the corresponding design calculation principles. The principles of stressing and construction of basic members such as axially stressed members, bending members and tension-bending and compression-bending members in metal structures and the corresponding design calculation principles. In addition to theoretical analysis and calculation methods, the course also introduces the structural characteristics and design calculation methods of metal structures for various typical construction machinery such as tower cranes, wheeled cranes, bridge cranes, etc. This course fully implements China's crane national design specifications (GB/T3811-2008) and tower crane national design specifications (GB/T13752-2017), and its content reflects the latest achievements in recent years in the design and calculation theory of metal structures at home and abroad. The course content is concise, accurate, focused, combined with theory and practice, and easy for self-study.

default.zh: “机械结构有限元分析”是机械类学生设置的专业选修课程。本课程主要介绍机械结构有限元分析的基本理论和方法，单元类型包括刚架单元、平面单元、三维单元，介绍位移场的建立、单元刚度阵的推导、系统刚度阵的组装以及动力学和静力学方程的求解等内容。为了便于学生能有限元理论有更深入的理解，同时对有限元的计算结构能够进行定性和定量的分析，考虑到机械类学生大部分缺乏结构力学相关知识，将结构力学中的力法和位移法作为前导内容。课程结合SAP84和ANSYS软件，对有限元方法在结构静力学和动力学计算分析中的应用做了初步介绍，便于学生掌握通用有限元软件求解机械结构分析问题。对于基本理论，采用课堂讲授为主，同时引导学生能够编制简单的有限元程序，有限元仿真教学采用翻转课堂形式。考核方式采用累加式，有限元编程大作业20分，有限元仿真大作业20分，期末考试60分。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的大作业和计算机仿真等环节，着重培养学生们对机械结构的综合分析能力。
default.en: "Finite Element Analysis of Mechanical Structure" is a major elective course for mechanical students. This course mainly introduces the basic theory and method of finite element analysis of mechanical structures. The types of elements include beam element, planar element and three-dimensional element. It also introduces the construction of displacement field, the derivation of element stiffness matrix, the assembly of system stiffness matrix and the solution of dynamic and static equilibrium equations. To facilitate students to have a deeper understanding of the finite element theory, and to conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis of the calculation structure of finite element, the force method and displacement method in structural mechanics are taken as the leading content, considering that most mechanical students lack the knowledge of structural mechanics. In combination with SAP84 and ANSYS software, the course makes a preliminary introduction to the application of finite element method in structural statics and dynamic analysis, which is convenient for students to master the general finite element software to solve mechanical structure analysis problems. For basic theories, classroom teaching is adopted, and students are guided to compile simple finite element programs. The finite element simulation teaching adopts the form of flipped classroom. The assessment method is cumulative, with 20 points for major work of finite element programming, 20 points for major work of finite element simulation and 60 points for final exam. This course focuses on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability of mechanical structure through classroom teaching, assignments and computer simulation.

default.zh: 随着机电装备向着精密化、多样化、复杂化方向发展，动态设计与工程优化方法在装备的设计制造发挥着越来越重要的作用。本课程面向智能制造的未来发展要求，以机电装备的为研究分析对象，讲述动态设计与工程优化理论与方法的相关知识。主要内容包括振动分析基础、受迫振动、动态性能测试与分析、动力学模型的建立与求解、动力学分析软件及其应用、优化设计基本概念、一维搜索方法、无约束优化方法、约束优化方法、智能优化方法以及工程优化具体应用实例等。
default.en: With the development of mechanical and electrical equipment towards precision, diversification, and complexity, dynamic design and engineering optimization methods are playing an increasingly important role in the design and manufacturing of the equipment. This course is aimed at the future development requirements of intelligent manufacturing, focusing on the research and analysis of mechanical and electrical equipment, and discussing the relevant knowledge of dynamic design and engineering optimization theory and methods. The main content includes vibration analysis basics, forced vibration, dynamic performance testing and analysis, establishment and solution of dynamic models, dynamic analysis software and its applications, basic concepts of optimization design, one-dimensional search methods, unconstrained optimization methods, constrained optimization methods, intelligent optimization methods, and specific application examples of engineering optimization.

default.zh: 主要讲授现代机械系统的机构设计、机械结构设计、控制方法与技术，以及现代机械的人工智能方法与技术等内容。包括：现代机械系统设计总论（概念、特征、设计要求、设计过程、系统构成等）；设计方法及智能设计与分析工具导论（广义CAD、人工智能、专家系统等基本原理、方法与技术）；机构设计（分类、设计过程与主要内容、实际问题、创新设计方法、平面机构类型综合、参数优化设计以及创新设计实例）；机械结构设计（加工工艺与机械结构要素、各种轴系支撑形式与结构、机械精度与刚度、谐波齿轮传动、RV摆线针轮传动等精密传动原理、结构与应用、机械工程图设计等）；现代工业机器人操作臂机构、结构与控制（设计要求与特点、一般构型与分类、关节机械传动系统设计基础、六自由度操作臂实例、现状、操作臂创新设计实例、运动控制与实验等）；模块化组合式机械系统机构与结构设计（模块化设计的意义与基本条件、机构与结构设计、模块化组合设计方法与机器人实例等）；智能机械与控制（可重构、自重构与自装配系统的基本概念，平面、空间可重构、自重构与自装配系统设计——机构、结构与控制与实例）；虚拟样机设计与仿真分析；现代机械系统的工程实际与总结。
default.en: This course teaches knowledge of mechanism design, mechanical structure design, control methods and technologies of modern mechanical systems, as well as artificial intelligence methods and technologies of modern machinery. It mainly contains the following parts: 1) Introduction to modern mechanical system design; 2) Introduction to design methods and intelligent design and analysis tools; 3) Mechanism design (including classification, design process and main content, practical issues, innovative design methods, planar mechanism type synthesis, parameter optimization design, and innovative design examples); 4) Mechanical structure design (machining process and mechanical structure elements; various shafting support forms and structures; mechanical accuracy and stiffness; precision transmission principles, structures and applications of harmonic driver and RV cycloidal pinwheel transmission; mechanical engineering drawing design, etc.); 5) Mechanism, structure and control of modern industrial robot; 6) Mechanism and structure design of modular combined mechanical system; 7) Intelligent machinery and control; 8) Virtual prototype design and its simulation analysis; 9) Engineering practice and summary of modern mechanical systems.

default.zh: 本课程是机械、能源、航天等工程学科本科生专业基础课。通过本课程学习，加强学生对摩擦学基础知识的理解和应用，提高学生对工业装备发展趋势中表界面科学作用的认识以及智能与高端装备的设计能力，为提高我国高端装备产品竞争力培养人才。 课程面向智能制造发展需求，针对高端装备中关键活动部件设计与服役全寿命周期中的界面科学和技术问题，系统介绍其摩擦学设计相关的理论基础、数值仿真、分析手段、测试评价方法等。主要讲授摩擦学的基本理论，摩擦学的系统设计与基本模型，摩擦和磨损的形成及其影响因素分析，摩擦学表面的接触力学，表面的润滑防护和边界润滑，流体润滑理论基础以及相应的计算方法，典型零件的润滑设计，不同领域的摩擦学应用特征，摩擦学测试实验技和状态监测方法，摩擦学系统的智能维护与健康管理等。
default.en: This course is a basic professional course for undergraduates of mechanical engineering related major. Through this course, students' understanding and application of tribology basic knowledge will be strengthened, and students' understanding of the scientific function of surface interface in the development trend of industrial equipment will be improved, as well as their ability to design intelligent and high-end equipment. In order to improve the competitiveness of high-end equipment products, talents will be cultivated. Aiming at the development needs of intelligent manufacturing, the course systematically introduces the theoretical basis, numerical simulation, analytical means, experimental evaluation methods related to tribological design. The interface science and technology problems during the whole service life cycle are involved in the design of key moving parts in high-end equipment. The main content includes the basic theory of tribology, system design and basic model of tribology, formation and the influencing factors of friction and wear, contact mechanics of frictional surface, lubrication protection and boundary lubrication of surface, theoretical basis of fluid lubrication and corresponding calculation methods, lubrication design of typical mechanical parts, tribology application characteristics in different fields, tribology test technology and condition monitoring method, intelligent maintenance and health management of tribology system.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22ME32111 课程名称： 复杂机械装备设计分析基础 总学时：32 理论学时： 30 实验学时： 2 上机学时： 0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时： 学分：2.0 开课单位：机电工程学院 授课对象：本科生 开课学期：3春 先修课程：理论力学，材料力学，机械原理，机械设计 二、课程简介 （正文、宋体、五号、行距20磅、500字左右） 本课程为专业核心课程。讲授的内容涵盖复杂机械装备的性能参数与工作级别，复杂机械装备的载荷与计算方法；典型零部件、工作机构工作原理、类型与结构特点、设计分析基本方法，驱动形式的选择，工作机构（支腿、伸缩机构、起升机构、回转机构、变幅机构）类型特点。实例1轮胎式起重机基本结构与基本设计分析方法；实例2塔式起重机基本结构与设计分析方法四大机构（起升机构、回转机构、变幅机构、顶升机构）基本类型特点、应用、计算分析基本理论和设计开发的基本方法；实例3，高机动雷达新结构与分析方法简介。 通过本课程的课堂教学、大作业和实验等教学环节，大型复杂装备设计分析的基本理论和设计方法，具有初步解决大型装备设计分析的能力，并提高开发创新能力。
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22ME32111 Course Title： Design and Analysis Basis of Complex Mechanical Equipment Credit Hours： 32 Lecture： 30 Lab： 2 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 2.0 Offering Department: College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering School/Division of Students: Undergraduate Term: Spring ,Third year ; Open Prerequisites: Theoretical mechanics , Mechanics of materials , Mechanical principle , mechanical design 2.Course Description This course is a professional core course. The content of the lecture covers the performance parameters and working level of complex mechanical equipment, and the load and calculation method of complex mechanical equipment; Typical components, working principle of working mechanism, type and structure characteristics, basic design analysis method, selection of driving form, and working mechanism type characteristics (outrigger, telescopic mechanism, lifting mechanism, slewing mechanism, luffing mechanism). Example 1 Basic structure and basic design analysis method of tire crane; Example 2 Basic structure and design analysis method of tower crane and The basic types, characteristics, applications, basic theories of calculation and analysis and basic methods of design and development of the four major mechanisms (lifting mechanism, slewing mechanism, luffing mechanism and jacking mechanism); Example 3: Introduction to the new structure and the calculation analysis method of high mobility radar. Through the classroom teaching, large assignments and experiments of this course, the basic theories and design methods of large and complex equipment design analysis have the ability to initially solve the design analysis of large equipment and improve the development and innovation ability.

default.zh: 机械原理创新设计课程主要讲授以下内容：运动链的结构综合；常用基本机构的特性及其应用；基本机构的变异与组合；机械系统运动方案创新设计；机构组合系统的尺度综合；机构运动学性能分析；机构动力学性能分析；机器人机构简介。 机械原理创新设计课程的教学目标： 目标1. 掌握机构的结构理论。掌握平面运动链的型综合与数综合基本理论。了解空间运动链的型综合基本理论以及机器人机构运动学、静力学和动力学相关知识。 目标2. 掌握连杆机构、凸轮机构、齿轮机构、其他技术原理组成的机构的特性及其应用。掌握机构变异与组合原理，具备根据机构变异与组合原理进行创新机构设计的能力。 目标3. 具备应用计算机技术进行机械系统运动方案创新设计、机构组合系统的尺度综合和运动学、动力学分析的能力。从需求驱动创新的角度强化对学生科技报国情怀的引导与培养。
default.en: The course of Innovative Design of Machinery mainly includes the following contents: The synthesis of kinematic chains, Characteristics and applications of common basic mechanisms, Variation and combination of basic mechanism, Innovative design of mechanical system motion scheme, Scale synthesis of mechanism combination system, Kinematic performance analysis of mechanism, Dynamic performance analysis of mechanism; Introduction to robot mechanism. The learning and teaching objectives of Innovative Design of Machinery are as follows: Objective 1. Master the structure theory of the mechanical mechanism. Master the basic theory of type synthesis and number synthesis of planar kinematic chain. Understand the basic theory of type synthesis of spatial kinematic chains and the knowledge of kinematics, statics and dynamics of robot mechanisms. Objective 2. Master the characteristics and application of the mechanism composed of linkage mechanism, cam mechanism, gear mechanism and other mechanisms based on new technical principles. Master the mechanism variation and combination principle, and have the ability to carry out innovative mechanism design according to the mechanism variation and combination principle. Objective 3. Have the ability to apply computer technique to innovative design of mechanical system motion scheme, scale synthesis and kinematics and dynamics analysis of mechanism combination system. From the perspective of demand-driven innovation, strengthen the guidance and training of students' feelings of serving the country through science and technology.

default.zh: 工业产品设计方法是一门理论联系实际、创新性较强的课程，奠定工业产品的美学欣赏和设计基础，并提供科学的设计观念、方法、程序和评价方法，是工业产品创新设计的知识拓展课程。本课程的主要内容包括两部分。第一部分主要讲授工业造型设计的美学法则、形态构成的方法、产品色彩设计的基本原理和基本方法、人机工程设计，使学生初步掌握造型设计的表现技法。第二部分主要讲授工业设计的各种观念和方法，包括创造性思维、功能论设计思想、系统论设计思想、商品化设计思想、人性化的设计观念、设计和评价方法等。本课程从产品的设计美学、功能、技术、经济等各个要素及其相互关系等方面进行综合分析和系统考虑，在应用中培养学生进行工业产品设计和评价的能力，拓宽学生的设计知识面，增强学生的创新能力，从科学的角度设计出符合用户、市场和环境要求的产品。
default.en: Methodology of Industrial Product Design is a highly innovative course that integrates theory with practice, laying the foundation for aesthetic appreciation and design of industrial products, and providing scientific design concepts, methods, procedures, and evaluation methods. It is a knowledge expansion course for innovative design of industrial products. The main content of this course includes two parts. The first part mainly teaches the aesthetic principles of industrial modeling design, the method of form composition, the basic principles and methods of product color design, and ergonomic design, so that students can initially master the performance techniques of modeling design. The second part mainly teaches various concepts and methods of innovative product design, including creative thinking, functional design ideas, system design ideas, commercialized design ideas, humanized design concepts, evaluation methods. This course comprehensively analyzes and systematically considers various elements of product design aesthetics, functions, technology, economy, and their interrelationships. It cultivates students' ability to industrial design and evaluate industrial products, broadens their design knowledge, enhances their innovation ability, and designs products that meet user, market, and environmental requirements from a scientific perspective.
