default.zh: 《机械系统自动控制技术》是面向机械设计制造及其自动化专业本科生的一门技术基础课，主要讲授经典控制、智能控制的基本理论及在机械系统控制与仿真中的应用。课程主要内容包括机械系统建模技术、控制系统响应与稳定性分析、机械系统的常规控制技术、模糊逻辑控制、神经网络控制技术、数控技术基础以及自动化检测与监控技术等内容。结合工程实例与仿真工具软件介绍机械控制系统的设计与仿真分析方法。 本课程的主要任务是培养学生： 1．培养学生辩证思维方法和勇于打破陈规的创新意识，以提高科学研究和解决工程问题的能力； 2．针对本课程涵盖多领域学科知识，及以本科高年级学生为对象的特点，通过宽领域知识的介绍，与典型案例的分析，拓宽学生的知识面和思维空间。 3．掌握机械系统自动控制技术的基本原理与应用方法，培养和考察学生对机械设计、系统建模、自动控制、传感检测、计算机编程等学科知识的综合运用能力。
default.en: Automatic Control Technology for Mechanical System is a basic technical course for undergraduates who major in mechanical design manufacturing and automation. It teaches the classical control and intelligent control theory, and their application in mechanical system. It mainly includes mechanical system modeling technology, control system response and stability analysis, classical control technology of mechanical system, intelligent control technology such as fuzzy logic control and neural network control, fundamentals of CNC Technology and automatic detection and monitoring technology, etc. Combined with engineering examples and software applications, a computer aided process for mechanical control simulation is introduced. The main task of this course is to train students: 1. Cultivate students' dialectical thoughts and innovative consciousness to break the stereotypes, so as to improve the ability of scientific research and solving engineering problems; 2. In view of the characteristics of this course covering domain knowledge and targeting senior undergraduate students, through the introduction of broad domain knowledge, and the analysis of typical cases, students' knowledge and thinking space can be broadened. 3. Master the basic principles and application methods of automatic control technology for mechanical systems. Cultivate and inspect students' comprehensive application ability on mechanical design, system modeling, automatic control, system testing and other disciplines

default.zh: 《机电系统一体化技术》是一门理论性、实践性较强的综合性专业技术基础课，课程以机械设备为本体，介绍基于电力电子技术、液压传动技术、计算机控制技术的机电液一体化系统的组成要素、数学建模与分析方法。课程从机电系统的角度，结合工程实例分析，讲解机电一体化系统的设计、分析及实现过程。课程主要内容包括机电系统一体化技术的基本知识、摊捕机调平机构自动控制技术、液压挖掘机轨迹自动控制技术、起升机械变频调速技术、起重机安全监测与群塔协同作业技术。 本课程的主要目的是培养学生掌握机电系统的设计过程及其分析方法，提高学生综合运用多领域学科知识进行机电系统设计及综合分析能力，具备初步解决工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: Control Technology for Mechatronics Integration is a comprehensive technical foundational course with a strong theoretical and practical focus. The course, centered around mechanical equipment, introduces the composition and design of integrated mechatronics systems, as well as mathematical modeling and analysis methods, which are constructed from power electronics technology, hydraulic transmission technology, and computer control technology. From the perspective of integrated mechatronics systems, the course combines analysis of engineering examples to explain the design, analysis, and implementation processes of integrated mechatronics systems. The main content of the course includes fundamental knowledge of integrative technology of mechatronics systems, automatic control technology of leveling mechanisms of the paver, automatic control technology of bucket trajectory for hydraulic excavators, adjustable-frequency variable-speed technology for crane machinery, safety monitoring and collaborative operation technology for crane groups. The main purpose of this course is to train students to master the design process and analysis methods of integrated mechatronics systems, to enhance their ability to design and conduct comprehensive analysis of mechatronics systems by integrating knowledge from various disciplines, and to equip them with the elementary capability to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 汽车电子控制技术是一门全面学习汽车电器设备结构原理及其应用、汽车电子技术及其应用，以适应汽车电器与电子技术发展的要求，培养学生分析解决问题的能力和创新能力的专业课。主要内容包括汽车供电系统、起动机、点火系统、仪表、照明及信号系统、附属设备及设备总线路、发动机综合控制系统和汽车电子控制系统介绍。
default.en: Automotive electronic control technology is a professional course that comprehensively studies the structural principles and applications of automotive electrical equipment, automotive electronic technology and its applications, in order to meet the requirements of the development of automotive electrical and electronic technology, cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve problems, and innovate. The main content includes an introduction to the automotive power supply system, starter, ignition system, instruments, lighting and signal system, auxiliary equipment and overall equipment wiring, engine comprehensive control system, and automotive electronic control system.

default.zh: 课程系统地讲授新能源汽车技术，基本内容主要包括新能源汽车定义与类型、发展新能源汽车的必要性、新能源汽车的技术路线及关键技术、汽车新能源概述，电动汽车用动力电池和电动汽车用电动机的类型、特点、工作原理及基本特性，纯电动汽车、增程式电动汽车，混合动力汽车、燃料电池电动汽车的结构、原理及设计方法等。课程中既有在新能源汽车上已经广泛应用的成熟技术，又有近年来发展的一些高新技术。
default.en: The course systematically introduces new energy automotive technology. The basic content mainly includes the definition and types of new energy automotives, the necessity of developing new energy automotives, the technical route and key technologies of new energy automotives, an overview of new energy in automobiles, the types, characteristics, working principles, basic characteristics of power batteries and electric motors for electric automotives, the structures, principles, design methods of pure electric vehicles, extended range electric vehicles, hybrid electric automotives, and fuel cell electric automotives. The course includes both mature technologies that have been widely applied in new energy automotives and some high-tech developments in recent years.

default.zh: 《机电系统控制及其MWORKS实现》是机械类专业工程能力培养的选修课程，讲授机械、电子、液压、控制等多领域系统计算机辅助设计仿真分析方法。通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解机电液控制系统的基本组成、工作原理、多域物理系统的建模与控制策略仿真分析、MWORKS程序开发的相关知识等内容。课程包括理论学习、系统分析和上机实践等部分。结合工程实例介绍了“从思路到代码”的多域物理系统MWORKS建模仿真分析过程。 本课程的主要任务是培养学生： 1．培养学生主动探究思考和创新思维意识，提高科学研究和解决工程问题的能力； 2．本课程以本科高年级学生为对象，涵盖多学科领域知识，结合典型工程案例分析拓宽学生的知识面和思维空间，培养学生解决复杂工程问题的能力； 3．掌握机电控制系统的基本原理与MWORKS计算机仿真分析方法，培养和提高学生对机械、液压、检测、控制及计算机编程等多学科知识的综合运用能力；
default.en: Control of Electromechanical System with MWORKS is a Professional Elective Course of Mechanical Design. It teaches the united multi-domain physical modeling with the computer aided design, which includes mechanical, electronic and hydraulic systems application with MWORKS. It mainly includes the basic composition and principle of electromechanical control system, the united multi-domain physical modeling method, control algorithm analysis, simulation knowledge of program development with MWORKS, etc. Coursework includes theoretical study, system analysis and computer practice. Combined with engineering examples, a process for the united multi-domain physical modeling with MWORKS which goes from thinking to code is introduced. The main task of this course is to train students: 1. Cultivate students' dialectical thoughts and innovative consciousness to break the stereotypes, so as to improve the ability of scientific research and solving engineering problems; 2. In view of the characteristics of this course covering domain knowledge and targeting senior undergraduate students, through the introduction of broad domain knowledge, and the analysis of typical cases, students' knowledge and thinking space can be broadened. 3. Master the basic principles of automatic control technology for electromechanical systems and computer simulation with MWORKS. Cultivate and inspect students' comprehensive application ability in mechanical design, system modeling, automatic control, system testing and other disciplines

default.zh: 先进加工技术主要包括精密和超精密加工技术、特种加工技术等，其中精密和超精密加工技术主要利用机械能、而特种加工则利用机械能之外的其他能量进行加工。本课程是高等工科院校中机械设计制造及其自动化专业的重要专业课，主要讲授精密和超精密加工技术、特种加工技术中的基本概念、基本原理、加工工艺、加工设备、相关技术及其应用等，通过本课程的授课不仅可以拓宽本专业学生的知识面，培养学生对所学知识的综合运用能力，而且有利于培养学生辩证思维能力及创新意识等综合素质。
default.en: Advanced Machining Technology mainly includes precision and ultraprecision machining technology, non-traditional machining technology, etc. precision and ultraprecision machining technology mainly uses mechanical energy, while non-traditional machining technology uses other energy for machining. This course is an important specialized course of mechanical design, manufacturing and automation in engineering colleges and universities. It mainly teaches the basic concepts, basic principles, machining technology, machining equipment, related technologies and applications of precision and ultraprecision machining technology and non-traditional machining technology. Through the teaching of this course, it can not only broaden the scope of knowledge of students in this major, but also cultivate their comprehensive application ability of the knowledge learned, It is also conducive to cultivating students' comprehensive qualities such as dialectical thinking ability and innovative consciousness.

default.zh: 主要讲授以机器人操作臂、腿足式步行机器人、轮式移动机器人为代表的、以“移动”+“操作”+“智能”为特征的现代机器人的设计及其控制基础理论、方法与技术、应用等内容。包括：1）现代机器人系统设计、控制与应用总论；2）现代机器人设计与控制的机器人学原理（机器人机构、机构运动学、动力学、传感、驱动与控制原理等）；3）现代机器人的机械系统设计与实例（设计内容、设计过程与主要内容、实际问题、创新设计方法、机械传动原理与机器人用减速器、机器人操作臂的机构设计与机械结构设计及实例、轮式移动机器人机构设计与机械结构设计及实例、腿足式移动机器人机构设计与机械结构设计及实例、机器人机构创新设计与实例、现代机器人系统机构设计与机械结构设计的问题和解决途径）；4）现代机器人的驱动系统与感知系统设计原理（伺服驱动与控制技术的基本原理及选型设计、力传感器原理、技术参数与选用及使用、姿势传感器、加速度计等传感器原理、使用与注意事项、六维力-力矩传感器的原理、应用的力学原理与实际应用等）；5）现代机器人的计算机控制与通信系统设计（计算机控制与通信系统的结构、实时控制要求下实时操作系统与通信系统、集中控制与分布式控制的软硬件系统、机器人操作臂/集成化的超多自由度仿生仿人机器人计算机控制与通信系统的构成与设计实例）；6）现代机器人控制理论、方法与技术（“移动”+“操作”+“人工智能（AI）”现代机器人控制总论、用于机器人控制的动力学方程及逆动力学计算方法、腿足式机器人的步行稳定性准则/控制原理/方法与技术、轮式移动机器人的控制理论/方法与技术、“移动”+“操作”的现代机器人控制问题与基本原理与方法、现代机器人的非基于模型“智能学习”控制方法与基本思想等）；7）现代机器人系统设计、控制与应用实例（某机器人臂系统设计/构成/基于模型的控制的应用及实验结果分析、某双足步行机器人系统设计/系统构成/研制及稳定步行控制与实验及结果分析、轮式移动机器人及其移动控制实例、机械与控制的辩证关系、智能机器人系统：机械系统（机构与结构）、控制、人工智能的现实问题；8）课程总结。
default.en: This course teaches knowledge of robot design, control methods and technologies of robot systems, as well as its application. It mainly contains the following parts: 1) Introduction to robot design，control and its application; 2) Robotics principles for modern robot design and control (Robot mechanism, kinematics, dynamics, sensing, drive and control principles, etc.); 3) Mechanical system design and examples of modern robots (Design content, design process and main content, practical problems, innovative design methods, mechanical transmission principle and robot reducer, mechanism design and mechanical structure design of robot manipulator and its examples, wheeled mobile robot mechanism design and mechanical structure design and its examples, legged mobile robot mechanism design and mechanical structure design and its examples, robot mechanism innovation design and examples, modern robot system mechanism design and mechanical structure design problems and solutions); 4) Principles of design of drive and perception systems for modern robots (Basic principles and selection design of servo drive and control technology, principle of force sensor, technical parameters and selection and use, principle of sensor such as posture sensor and accelerometer, use and precautions, principle of six-dimensional force-torque sensor, mechanical principle and practical application, etc.); 5) Computer control and communication system design for modern robots ; 6) Modern robot control theory, method and technology; 7) Examples of modern robot system design, control and application; 8). Summary of the course.

default.zh: 以产品为导向，以“AI驱动编程优化与安全赋能”为核心，构建"AI+CAM"深度融合的新型教学模式。采用AI工具检测程序安全隐患，提升学习成效，降低技术门槛，促进不通学科背景的学生均可以高效且准确的完成从设计、优化到加工的全生命周期创意产品制作任务。课程强化数字素养，培养学生虚实结合的工程实践能力；革新教学场景，提升数控技术跨学科学习的普适性。致力于培养具备AI素养与创新能力的复合型人才，助力智能制造行业升级。
default.en: Product-oriented, with “AI-driven programming optimization and safety empowerment” as the core, we have build a new teaching mode of “AI+CAM” deep integration. AI tools detect program safety hazards, improve learning effectiveness, lower the technical threshold, and promote students of all disciplines to efficiently and accurately complete the whole life cycle of creative product production tasks from design, optimization, to processing. The course strengthens digital literacy and cultivates students' practical engineering ability by combining reality and practice; it also revolutionizes the teaching scenario and enhances the universality of interdisciplinary learning in CNC technology. The course is dedicated to cultivating composite talents with AI literacy and innovation ability, and helping to upgrade the intelligent manufacturing industry.

default.zh: 《自动驾驶与人工智能》课程旨在探讨自动驾驶技术的核心原理及其与人工智能的深度融合。课程内容涵盖自动驾驶系统架构、传感器融合、环境感知、路径规划、决策控制等关键技术，并深入讲解机器学习、深度学习、强化学习等AI算法在自动驾驶中的应用。通过理论与实践相结合，学生将掌握自动驾驶系统的设计与实现方法，了解行业前沿动态与挑战。课程适合对自动驾驶、人工智能及智能交通系统感兴趣的学生和从业者，为其未来在相关领域的研究与开发奠定坚实基础。
default.en: The course "Autonomous Driving and Artificial Intelligence" aims to explore the core principles of autonomous driving technology and its deep integration with artificial intelligence. The course covers key technologies such as auto drive system architecture, sensor fusion, environment awareness, path planning, decision control, and in-depth explanation of the application of AI algorithms such as machine learning, deep learning, and reinforcement learning in autopilot. Through the combination of theory and practice, students will master the design and implementation methods of auto drive system, and understand the cutting-edge trends and challenges of the industry. The course is suitable for students and practitioners interested in autonomous driving, artificial intelligence, and intelligent transportation systems, laying a solid foundation for their future research and development in related fields.

default.zh: 课程面向理工科本科生，以生成式AI技术与逆向工程为核心，结合三维扫描、智能设计与数字化制造，打造“数据采集→AI解析→创意生成→实体制造”的全流程创新实践能力。学生将学习如何通过AI拆解现实物体、重构设计逻辑，并利用先进制造技术将数字模型转化为实体产品，掌握未来智能制造与创意产业的核心竞争力。
default.en: The course is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in science and engineering, with generative AI technology and reverse engineering as the core, combined with 3D scanning, intelligent design, and digital manufacturing, to create a full process innovative practical ability of "data acquisition → AI analysis → creative generation → physical manufacturing". Students will learn how to use AI to disassemble real objects, reconstruct design logic, and transform digital models into physical products using advanced manufacturing technology, mastering the core competitiveness of future intelligent manufacturing and creative industries.

default.zh: 本课程旨在帮助学生掌握深度学习、大语言模型等人工智能（AI）技术在工程领域的基础理论与应用方法，重点聚焦深度学习、大语言模型等前沿技术在机械设备故障诊断中的应用。课程内容涵盖现代设备故障诊断的基本原理、人工智能基础以及人工智能在故障诊断中的具体应用、实际案例分析等。本课程将系统介绍如何利用深度学习、大语言模型等AI技术提高机械设备故障诊断的准确性与效率，讲解数据预处理、人工智能模型、模型训练与优化等核心技术，并结合工程应用场景进行实践训练。通过本课程的学习，学生将深入理解AI在智能制造、工业物联网、自动化控制等领域的应用价值，并具备利用机器学习和深度学习解决工程问题的能力，为未来从事相关技术研发与工程实践奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course aims to help students master the basic theories and application of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies such as deep learning and large language models in the engineering field, with a focus on the application of cutting-edge technologies such as deep learning and large language models in mechanical equipment fault diagnosis. The content of this course covers the basic principles of mechanical equipment fault diagnosis, the foundation of AI, the specific application of AI in fault diagnosis, and actual case analysis. This course will systematically introduce how to use AI technologies such as deep learning and large language models to improve the accuracy and efficiency of mechanical equipment fault diagnosis, explain core technologies such as engineering data preprocessing, AI models and their training and optimization, and conduct practical learning in combination with engineering application scenarios. Through the study of this course, students will have a deep understanding of the application value of AIs in the fields of intelligent manufacturing, industrial Internet of Things, and automated control, and have the ability to use machine learning and deep learning to solve practical engineering problems, laying a solid foundation for future related technology research and development and engineering practice.

default.zh: 《离散元仿真技术与应用》是一门涉及离散元理论、材料力学、计算科学等多学科知识的课程，主要讲授离散元方法基础理论和离散元仿真软件EDEM的操作与应用两方面内容，是飞行器制造专业选修的专业课之一，旨在培养学生对离散元方法在深空探测等领域中的研究兴趣和应用能力，是掌握空间技术发展前沿、从事空间技术方面科研工作不可缺少的专业课程。 离散元方法基础理论部分主要介绍离散元方法的理论知识，包括离散元理论的发展历程、基本理论体系以及其核心的接触模型等内容。通过本部分内容的学习，使学生能够掌握离散元方法的理论体系，深入理解累离散元接触模型等理论点，为后续的离散元仿真分析奠定理论基础。 离散元仿真软件EDEM的操作与应用部分主要介绍离散元仿真软件EDEM的使用，包括EDEM基本操作、EDEM-API功能、EDEM与ADAMS、FLUNT等工程软件的联合仿真，以及EDEM在航天领域的典型应用案例等内容。通过本部分内容的学习，使学生能够理解离散元仿真软件EDEM的基本架构和基础操作，以及在机械工程领域的高级操作。 最终通过本课程的系统学习，使学生能够深入地了解和掌握离散元理论的核心思想，培养学生在机构机械与离散态物质、尤其是深空探测机构与离散态星壤间相互作用方面的综合分析问题和解决问题的能力，为将来从事星表探测机器人的设计、控制、试验、科研开发等工作奠定理论与技术基础。
default.en: Discrete Element Simulation Technology and Application is a course involving the knowledge of discrete element theory, material mechanics, computational science and other disciplines. It mainly teaches the basic theory of discrete element method and the operation and application of the discrete element simulation software EDEM. It is one of the professional elective courses for aircraft manufacturing, aiming to cultivate students' research interest and application ability of the discrete element method in deep space exploration and other fields, It is an indispensable professional course to master the frontier of space technology development and engage in scientific research in space technology. The basic theory of the discrete element method mainly introduces the theoretical knowledge of the discrete element method, including the development history of the discrete element theory, the basic theoretical system and its core contact model. Through the study of this part, students can master the theoretical system of discrete element method, deeply understand the theoretical arguments such as cumulative discrete element contact model, and lay a theoretical foundation for subsequent discrete element simulation analysis. The operation and application of the discrete element simulation software EDEM mainly introduces the use of the discrete element simulation software EDEM, including the basic operation of EDEM, the EDEM-API function, the joint simulation of EDEM and ADAMS, FLUNT and other engineering software, as well as the typical application cases of EDEM in the aerospace field. Through the study of this part, students can understand the basic architecture and basic operation of the discrete element simulation software EDEM, as well as the advanced operation in the field of mechanical engineering. Finally, through the systematic study of this course, students can deeply understand and master the core idea of discrete element theory, cultivate students' ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems in the interaction between mechanism machinery and discrete matter, especially the interaction between deep space exploration mechanism and discrete satellite-soil, and lay a theoretical and technical foundation for the future design, control, test, scientific research and development of star exploration robots.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授智能材料及智能结构技术的基本理论、基本方法，及其在空间结构与机构系统设计领域的典型应用的相关内容。包括：智能材料的基本属性与应用特点，智能结构系统的概念；空间连接分离机构的设计方法及应用环境，SMA驱动的连接分离机构及其应用，其他新型连接分离机构的设计与应用；变体飞行器的研究现状及发展趋势，可变形智能机翼结构的设计方法，智能蒙皮技术的研究与发展；航天器力学环境的特点及其对结构系统的影响分析，主被动振动控制机理及实现方法，基于智能材料的振动控制执行器的设计与分析；薄膜结构的主要空间应用和发展趋势，薄膜形状控制系统组成及分类，层合/嵌入式形状控制系统设计；基于边界调整的薄膜结构形状控制方法等。
default.en: This course introduces the basic theory and method of intelligent materials and smart structure technology, and its typical application in the system design of aerospace structure and mechanism systems. Including: basic properties of smart materials and application characteristics, the concept of smart structural systems; the design method and application environment of the connection and separation mechanism, the design and applications of separation mechanism with SMA actuating devices, the applications of other new connection and separation mechanism; the research status and development trend of the morphing aircraft, the structural design method of deformable intelligence wing, the research and development of the smart skin technology; the characteristics of the mechanical environment of the spacecraft and its analysis of the impact for structural systems, active and passive vibration control mechanism and implementation, the design and analysis of vibration control actuators based on smart materials; the major space applications and trends of the thin-film structure, the classification of shape control system for the film structure, the shape control system design based on the laminated or embedded actuators; the film structure shape control methods based on the boundary adjustments.

default.zh: 逆向工程是基于CAD/CAM 和计算机测量技术基础上发展起来的一项新技术，以前，我校飞行器制造专业开设的工程制图和CAD/CAM课程教学内容以曲线、曲面造型的基本理论知识教授或CATIA、UG、PRO/E等三维造型软件的使用为主，较少或没有涉及产品逆向设计的内容。近年来，随着航空企业对逆向工程应用需求的增长，企业希望毕业生除了能运用CAD软件进行产品三维造型设计的基础上，了解逆向工程的基本理论和工作方法，能熟练运用坐标测量设备和逆向工程软件进行产品数据采集和产品的创新设计。 该课程的教学主要通过课堂理论教学进行，课堂教学要求跟踪学科发展前沿，讲授逆向工程的一般基础知识。主要有：各种测量设备介绍、各种逆向工程测量技术的工作原理、测量数据预处理、测量数据曲线曲面造型、任意拓扑曲面造型、逆向工程软件的应用的功能介绍等内容。通过理论课程的学习，学生能够掌握主要的测量方法、测量原理、测量数据预处理、基于测量数据的曲线曲面造型等基础理论。在有实验条件的情况下, 还应开展实验教学, 实验教学环节着重于学生实际应用能力的培养，要求学生学会采用先进的三坐标测量机\三维激光扫描仪进行实物数据采集的操作，然后独立使用主流的逆向工程软件Imageware对测量数据进行处理以及重建产品的CAD模型的方法和技巧，以提高学生运用逆向工程技术解决实际问题的能力。应该说，逆向工程技术的掌握对于工科学生走向工作岗位是很有帮助的。
default.en: Reverse engineering is a new technology developed based on CAD/CAM and computer measurement technology. Previously, the engineering drawing and CAD/CAM courses offered by our university's aircraft manufacturing major mainly focused on teaching basic theoretical knowledge of curve and surface modeling or the use of 3D modeling software such as CATIA, UG, PRO/E, with little or no involvement in product reverse design. In recent years, with the increasing demand for reverse engineering applications in aviation enterprises, they hope that graduates can not only use CAD software for product 3D modeling design, but also understand the basic theories and working methods of reverse engineering, and be proficient in using coordinate measurement equipment and reverse engineering software for product data collection and innovative product design. The teaching of this course is mainly carried out through classroom theoretical teaching, which requires tracking the forefront of subject development and teaching general basic knowledge of reverse engineering. The main content includes: introduction to various measurement equipment, working principles of various reverse engineering measurement technologies, measurement data preprocessing, curve and surface modeling of measurement data, arbitrary topological surface modeling, and introduction to the functions of reverse engineering software applications. Through the study of theoretical courses, students can master basic theories such as main measurement methods, measurement principles, measurement data preprocessing, and curve and surface modeling based on measurement data. In the presence of experimental conditions, experimental teaching should also be carried out, with a focus on cultivating students' practical application abilities. Students are required to learn how to use advanced coordinate measuring machines/3D laser scanners to collect physical data, and then independently use the mainstream reverse engineering software Imageware to process the measurement data and reconstruct the CAD model of the product, in order to improve their ability to use reverse engineering technology to solve practical problems. It should be said that mastering reverse engineering technology is very helpful for engineering students to move towards work positions.

default.zh: 《空间仿生机构》是一门涉及空间环境工程学、仿生学、机构学、机器人学等多学科知识的课程，主要讲授空间仿生机构理论与综合两方面内容，是飞行器制造专业选修的专业课之一，旨在培养学生对仿生机构在深空探测、在轨操控等领域中的研究兴趣和应用能力，是掌握空间技术发展前沿、从事空间技术方面科研工作不可缺少的专业课程。 空间仿生机构理论部分主要讲授空间仿生机构学相关理论基础，包括仿生学简介、典型仿生机构、空间环境效应等内容。通过本部分内容的学习，使学生能够具备机构学和仿生学等方面的理论基础，了解空间环境对仿生机构的效应和影响，为后续空间仿生机构的设计奠定基础。 空间仿生机构设计部分主要讲授空间仿生机构设计方法与设计过程，包括仿生机构设计、空间仿生机构仿真、空间仿生机构控制等内容，以及课程主讲人在空间仿生机构的典型科研案例。通过本部分内容的学习，使学生能够掌握空间仿生机构设计工具，具备开展典型空间仿生机构设计的能力，为从事空间仿生机构领域的学术研究和科研工作奠定基础。 最终通过本课程的系统学习，使学生能够深入地了解和掌握空间环境的分类、效应、模拟方法，以及空间仿生机构的设计、仿真、控制等技术，培养学生在仿生机构与空间环境相互作用方面的综合分析问题和解决问题的能力，为将来从事空间仿生机器人的设计、控制、试验、科研开发等工作奠定理论与技术基础。
default.en: Space bionic mechanism is a course involving multi-disciplinary knowledge such as space environmental engineering, bionics, mechanism, robotics, etc. It mainly teaches the theory and synthesis of space bionic mechanism, and is one of the professional courses for aircraft manufacturing majors. It aims to cultivate students' research interest and application ability of bionic mechanism in deep space exploration, on-orbit control and other fields, and is to master the development frontier of space technology It is an indispensable professional course for scientific research in space technology. The theory part of space bionic mechanism mainly teaches the theoretical basis of space bionic mechanism, including the introduction of bionics, typical bionic mechanism, space environment effect, etc. Through the study of this part, students can have the theoretical basis of mechanism and bionics, understand the effect and influence of space environment on bionic mechanism, and lay the foundation for the design of subsequent space bionic mechanism. The space bionic mechanism design part mainly teaches the design method and design process of the space bionic mechanism, including the bionic mechanism design, space bionic mechanism simulation, space bionic mechanism control and other contents, as well as the typical scientific research cases of the course lecturer in the space bionic mechanism. Through the study of this part, students can master the design tools of spatial bionic mechanism, have the ability to carry out the design of typical spatial bionic mechanism, and lay the foundation for academic research and scientific research in the field of spatial bionic mechanism. Finally, through the systematic study of this course, students can deeply understand and master the classification, effect, simulation method of the space environment, as well as the design, simulation, control and other technologies of the space bionic mechanism, and cultivate students' ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems in the interaction between the bionic mechanism and the space environment, so as to engage in the design, control, test of the space bionic robot in the future Scientific research and development and other work lay a theoretical and technical foundation.

default.zh: 激光加工技术作为20 世纪末的热点技术之一，以其独具的先进性、高效性和智能化特点成为本世纪材料加工制造领域最具发展潜力的先进加工技术。与传统的材料加工方式相比，具有非接触、无污染、低噪音、高效率的特点，目前已广泛用于航空航天、船舶及现代汽车工业中的材料加工，如激光焊接、切割、雕刻、材料的表面熔覆、合金化、强化和硬化等等；同时，激光也用于材料的微细加工、非晶化，乃至纳米材料的制备等。本课程通过课堂教学使学生了解激光产生的机理、激光在材料加工中应用的基本方法、原理和技术特点，使其在今后材料加工领域中能够采用先进的激光加工手段进行材料在工程应用中的制造和加工；同时也为推动激光加工技术在我国生产制造领域中的应用培养必要的工程技术人才。
default.en: Laser processing technology is one of the hot technologies at the end of the last century. Due to its advancement, high efficiency and intelligentization, it has been considered as one advanced processing technology with the highest development potential in the current century. In comparison with traditional materials processing methods, laser processing technology is characterized by non-contacting, no pollution, low noise and high efficiency. Laser processing technology has been widely applied in the materials processing such as welding, cutting, engraving, surface cladding, alloying, hardening and peening in the industry sectors of aeronautics and astronautics, shipbuilding, modern automobile, etc. Meanwhile laser can be also applied for microfabrication, amorphization, and even nano-materials preparation. his course tries to let students know the mechanics of laser generating, basic methods, principles and technical features of laser application in materials processing through lectures and experimental demonstrations, and furthermore let them be able to consider the application of laser processing technology for materials manufacturing and processing engineering. The course will also prompt the application of laser processing methods in the production and manufacture field in China.

default.zh: 本课主要讲授航天特殊材料的重要作用、种类、应用范围、切削加工性及切削加工特点、适用的刀具材料、机械加工新技术新工艺特点及发展现状及趋势、以及所加工工件的测量和检测技术。内容包括航天用高强度钢与超高强度钢的切削加工特点及其加工技术，航天用高温合金的切削加工特点及其加工技术，航天用钛合金的切削加工特点及其加工技术，航天用复合材料的概念、分类、发展与应用，复合材料的成型工艺及加工技术等，以及半导体、工程陶瓷、光学玻璃等高性能脆性材料的精密加工技术。最后，本课程将介绍加工工件的测量和检测技术。
default.en: This course mainly involves the function, category and cutting performance of special aeronautical materials. The principles for the selection of cutting tool materials, the development trend of new technologies for machining these kinds of materials, and measurement and detection methods of the machined materials are also introduced. The course includes the following aspects: the machining performances and cutting techniques of high-strength steels and ultrahigh-strength steels, the machining characteristic of high-temperature alloy in different cutting operations, the machining performances and cutting techniques of titanium alloys. The concept, classification, application scope and the forming and machining technique of composite materials are also introduced. In addition, the precision machining technology of high-performance brittle materials including semiconductor, engineering ceramics and optical glass will be introduced. Finally, the measurement and detection technology of the machined workpiece will be introduced.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授结构健康监测与先进无损检测的基本概念、原理和方法，包括监测系统设计、传感器选择、数据采集、信号处理、先进无损检测新技术、系统组成、检测能力等方面的知识，同时针对本专业情况重点介绍典型航空航天结构的健康监测与先进检测技术应用。在授课学习过程中使学生了解结构健康监测与无损检测领域的先进理念、方法、理论与技术，拓宽学生的知识面，为学生的知识积累提供新的学科增长点。
default.en: In this course, it emphasizes on the basic principle, methodologies, and conceptions of structure healthy monitoring (SHM) and advanced nondestructive testing technology (NDT). It includes more knowledges about monitoring system designing, sensors choosing, dataset collections, signal processing, novel NDT approaches, and the systemic components as well as inspection ability. Simultaneously, for the major cases, the SHM and advanced NDT technologies which are applied for aircraft and aerospace parts manufacturing will be specifically introduced. In the course of teaching and learning, students can understand the advanced concepts, methods, theories and technologies in the field of structural health monitoring and non-destructive testing, broaden the scope of students' knowledge, and provide a new subject growth point for students' knowledge accumulation.

default.zh: 电加工技术课程是针对喜爱特种加工、数控加工方向的学生开设的专业选修课，加强学生对电火花加工、电火花线切割加工、电火花小孔加工等方面的深入理解和应用。本课程主要讲授掌握电火花加工、电火花线切割加工和电火花小孔加工基本知识、加工工艺、关键技术与装备，以及最新电加工技术研究成果及其应用。培养学生综合分析能力、综合设计能力、增加创新意识和解决高精度复杂零件制造问题等，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: The course of Electrical Discharge Machining Technology is a professional elective course designed for students who love special machining and CNC machining. It strengthens students' deep understanding and application of electrical discharge machining, electric discharge wire cutting machining, electric discharge small hole machining, and other aspects. This course mainly teaches the basic knowledge, processing technology, key technologies and equipment of electric discharge machining, electric discharge wire cutting machining, and electric discharge small hole machining, as well as the latest research results and applications of electric discharge machining technology. Cultivate students' comprehensive analytical and design abilities, increase innovation awareness, and solve high-precision complex parts manufacturing problems, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《智能控制技术》以个性化和能力培养为目标，紧紧围绕学院机械类本科生培养目标与培养要求，培养学生具备正确选用先进成熟的控制理论与方法构建控制系统的能力。在保证学生加深控制理论理解和应用以及使用先进科学工具对系统进行分析、求解及参数估计的基础上，考虑学生的基础和时间，精心准备了实践内容。针对智能控制技术应用，提炼控制系统构建中关键内容，形成11个实践专题，保证学生顺利实现一套完整控制系统，并理解了智能控制技术在控制系统中的作用和地位以及工程实践过程中的理论指导实践的意义。通过课程的课堂教学、实验操作和分组设计等环节，活跃学生的思维，通过该对比分析学习加深理解，拓宽学生处理工程实际问题的手段和方法。
default.en: The course of Intelligent Control Technology aims to cultivate personalization and ability, closely focusing on the training goals and requirements of undergraduate students majoring in mechanical engineering in the college, and cultivating students' ability to correctly choose advanced and mature control theories and methods to construct control systems. On the basis of ensuring that students deepen their understanding and application of control theory, and use advanced scientific tools to analyze, solve, and estimate parameters of the system, practical content has been carefully prepared considering students' foundation and time. In response to the application of intelligent control technology, key content in the construction of control systems was extracted, and 11 practical topics were formed to ensure that students can successfully achieve a complete control system. The role and status of intelligent control technology in control systems were understood, as well as the significance of theoretical guidance in engineering practice. Through the classroom teaching, experimental operations, and group design of the course, students' thinking is activated, and through this comparative analysis learning, understanding is deepened, and the means and methods for students to handle practical engineering problems are expanded.

default.zh: 《机器人技术及其空间应用》是一门培养学生掌握机器人设计原则、设计方法及基本分析方法，了解空间应用机器人特点和设计要求的专业课。本课程重点讲授机器人的主要结构、机器人的驱动与传动类型及选择、机器人控制与感知的基本方法与结构、机器人运动学与力学分析的基本知识、机器人的轨迹规划以及空间机器人的结构特点和应用等。本课程涉及多个学科的知识，使学生了解相关学科理论和技术在机器人技术及相关空间机构中的应用，拓宽知识面，提高机电一体化设计的能力，能够进行简易机器人的创新设计与制作。
default.en: “Robot technology and its application in the space” is a professional course that cultivates students to master the principles, methods, and basic analysis technology of robot design, and to understand the characteristics and design requirements of space application robots. This course focuses on teaching the main structure of robots, driving and transmission types and selection of robots, basic methods and structures of robot control and perception, basic knowledge of robot kinematics and mechanical analysis, trajectory planning of robots, and structural characteristics and applications of space robots. This course involves knowledge from multiple disciplines, enabling students to understand the application of relevant discipline theories and technologies in robotics, broaden their knowledge, improve their ability in mechatronics design, and be able to carry out innovative design and making of simple robots.

default.zh: 《航天产品制造的智慧分拣技术》课程简介 课程编号： 22ME32311 课程中文名称：航天产品制造的智慧分拣技术 课程英文名称：Intelligent Sorting Technology Applied in Aircraft Manufacturing 总学时：32 讲课学时：32 学分：2.0 授课对象：机电工程学院 飞行器制造工程专业 开课单位：机电工程学院 飞行器制造工程专业 先修课程：机械制造基础 开课学期：第七学期 主要教材及参考书： 教材：冉文学主编. 物流自动化系统. 华中科技大学出版社，2023.2 参考书：金跃跃等编著. 现代化智能物流装备与技术. 化学工业出版社，2019.11 课程内容摘要： 通过本课程的学习，学生应理解和掌握以下内容： 1. 物流、物流工程、物流自动化的含义，物流自动化系统的概念、分类以及功能构成、特征；物流自动化研究意义、发展历程及趋势。 2. 物流集装的单元化理念，规范标准，集装单元化与物流信息化的作用；物流集装单元化工具，涉及各类托盘和集装箱；物流自动化的发展和应用。 3. 物料搬运的概念及物料搬运系统的组成，搬运系统分析设计，对物料搬运及物料搬运系统的总体认识；各种刚性输送系统和柔性搬运系统，物料搬运作业合理化的原则和途径，对已有的物料搬运系统进行分析和改进。 4. 物流自动化输送系统的特点和分类；物流自动化输送系统的应用范围及输送货物的特性；物流自动化输送设备的主要参数和选型；各种物流输送设备的结构和性能。 5. 仓储系统的分类和特点、仓库布局合理化的含义；自动化仓库出入库能力指标的计算以及仓库的最佳参数选择；仓储设施的结构设计，包括建筑用地内的道路、建筑物内的通道、建筑物的柱间距、建筑物的梁下高度和屋檐高度、月台高度、建筑物的进/出货开口尺寸、地面载荷等设计；自动化立体仓库系统及其构成、自动化仓库的特点、自动化仓库系统的分类、自动化立体仓库的设计等。 6. 配送分拣作业系统的概念、作用、价值；配送分拣作业分析，分拣业务构成、特性、提高分拣效率的思路；分配送拣作业系统设计与配置，包括单机能力、系统能力的计算。 7. 自动控制技术基础，包括自动控制及自动控制系统的概念、自动控制系统的分类及特点；电气控制线路概述、简单设计法及其设计案例；PLC的产生、发展、用途，PLC的组成、工作原理、特点及分类，PLC基本指令及程序设计；典型自动化物流工程控制系统设计。 8. 自动消防预警系统的含义与技术内容；自动消防预警系统在物流领域的设计及运用；自动消防预警系统的实现。 9. 自动化物流系统监控系统视频监控的含义与技术内容；监控系统在物流领域的设计及运用；GIS、GPS的基本概念、关键技术及在物流领域的应用；手机定位技术的方式、原理及在物流领域的应用；车辆监控系统的方式、原理及在物流领域的应用等。 10. 物流信息及物流信息管理的内容、特征及其功能；物联网技术和物流信息化技术及其在物流信息化中的应用方式和方法；物流信息系统的系统分析和系统设计的基本理论；物流信息管理的内容、特征及管理模式；物流信息管理系统的概念、特点、种类及功能。
default.en: The Course Brief Description of《Intelligent Sorting Technology Applied in Aircraft Manufacturing》 Course No.: 22ME32311 Course Title: Intelligent Sorting Technology Applied in Aircraft Manufacturing Overall Class Hour: 32, Lecture Hour: 32 Credit: 2.0 Course Category: elective Course Course Offered by: Dept. of Aerospace Manufacturing Engineering Object of Teaching: Students Major in Aircraft manufacturing engineering , Machinery Design, Manufacturing and Automation Prerequisite Course: Manufacturing process Time of the Course Offered: 7th Semester Abstract of the Course: Through the study of this course, students should understand and master the following content: 1. The meaning of logistics, logistics engineering, and logistics automation, as well as the concept, classification, functional composition, and characteristics of logistics automation systems; The significance, history, and trend of logistics automation research. 2. The concept of unitization in logistics containerization, regulatory standards, and the role of unitization in containerization and logistics informatization; Logistics containerization tools, involving various pallets and containers; The development and application of logistics automation. 3. The concept of material handling and the composition of material handling systems, analysis and design of handling systems, and an overall understanding of material handling and material handling systems; Various rigid conveying systems and flexible handling systems, principles and approaches for rationalizing material handling operations, and analysis and improvement of existing material handling systems. 4. Characteristics and classification of logistics automation transportation systems; The application scope of logistics automation transportation system and the characteristics of transported goods; The main parameters and selection of logistics automation conveying equipment; The structure and performance of various logistics conveying equipment. 5. Classification and characteristics of warehousing systems, and the meaning of rationalization of warehouse layout; Calculation of inbound and outbound capability indicators for automated warehouses and selection of optimal parameters for the warehouse; The structural design of storage facilities, including the design of roads within the building site, passages within the building, column spacing of the building, height of the building's beams and eaves, platform height, dimensions of the building's inlet/outlet openings, ground loads, etc; Automated three-dimensional warehouse system and its composition, characteristics of automated warehouses, classification of automated warehouse systems, design of automated three-dimensional warehouses, etc. 6. The concept, function, and value of the distribution and sorting operation system; Analysis of distribution sorting operations, composition and characteristics of sorting business, and ideas for improving sorting efficiency; Design and configuration of the delivery and picking operation system, including the calculation of single machine capacity and system capacity. 7. The content, characteristics, and functions of logistics information and logistics information management; IoT technology and logistics informatization technology, as well as their application methods and approaches in logistics informatization; The basic theory of system analysis and system design for logistics information systems; The content, characteristics, and management mode of logistics information management; The concept, characteristics, types and functions of logistics information management systems.

default.zh: 《空间机构感知与控制》是一门涉及空间环境工程学、机构学、机器人学、传感技术、自动控制等多学科知识的课程，主要讲授空间机构感知技术与控制方法两方面内容，是飞行器制造专业选修的专业课之一，旨在培养学生对空间机构在深空探测、在轨操控等领域中的研究兴趣和应用能力，是掌握空间技术发展前沿、从事空间技术方面科研工作不可缺少的专业课程。 空间机构感知技术部分主要讲授面向空间机构的感知技术，包括面向空间机构的摩擦电感知、电容式感知、摩擦电传感器设计、机器学习理论、智能识别模型等内容。通过本部分内容的学习，使学生能够了解空间机构传感器的技术特点，掌握建立空间机构感知器的能力，并为后续的空间机构控制奠定基础。 空间机构控制部分主要讲授面向空间机构的控制方法，包括面向空间机构的PID控制、神经网络控制、MPC控制等内容。通过本部分内容的学习，使学生能够了解空间机构控制方法的技术特点，掌握建立空间机构控制器的能力。 最终通过本课程的系统学习，使学生能够深入地了解和掌握空间环境的分类与效应、空间机构的感知与控制等技术，培养学生在空间机构感知与控制方面的综合分析问题和解决问题的能力，为将来从事空间仿生机器人的设计、控制、试验、科研开发等工作奠定理论与技术基础。
default.en: Sensing and Control of Space Mechanisms is a course involving multi-disciplinary knowledge of space environmental engineering, mechanics, robotics, sensing technology, automatic control and other disciplines. It mainly teaches two aspects of sensing technology and control methods of space mechanisms. It is one of the professional courses selected for the major of aircraft manufacturing, aiming to cultivate students' research interest and application ability in the field of deep space exploration, on-orbit control and other fields. It is an indispensable professional course to master the frontier of space technology development and engage in scientific research in space technology. The sensing technology of space mechanism mainly teaches the sensing technology for space mechanism, including the triboelectric sensing for space mechanism, capacitive sensing, triboelectric sensor design, machine learning theory, intelligent recognition model, etc. Through the study of this part, students can understand the technical characteristics of space mechanism sensors, master the ability to establish space mechanism sensors, and lay the foundation for the subsequent control of space mechanisms. The control of space mechanism mainly teaches the control methods for space mechanism, including PID control, neural network control, MPC control, etc. Through the study of this part, students will be able to understand the technical characteristics of the control methods of spatial mechanisms and master the ability to establish the controller of spatial mechanisms. Finally, through the systematic study of this course, students can deeply understand and master the classification and effect of space environment, the perception and control of space mechanisms and other technologies, cultivate students' ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems in the perception and control of space mechanisms, and lay a theoretical and technical foundation for the design, control, experiment, scientific research and development of space bionic robots.

default.zh: 数字孪生（Digital Twin）是以数字化方式创建物理实体的虚拟模型，借助数据模拟物理实体在现实环境中的行为，为物理实体增加或扩展新的能力，从而实现正向设计。本课程介绍数字孪生的概念、发展历史、一般架构和应用领域，介绍其在智能制造、数字工厂、智能化等方面的应用，引导学生完成复杂航天器数字孪生系统设计。教学目的在于激发学生对相关领域的研究兴趣，锻炼学生资料查询、报告撰写、规划研究路线、汇报展示等基本技能，该课程有助于培养学生独立思考、自主学习的研究能力与积极创新，勇于探索的精神。
default.en: Digital Twin is a virtual model created digitally to simulate the behavior of physical entities in the real environment, adding or expanding new capabilities to physical entities and achieving forward design. This course introduces the concept, development history, general architecture, and application fields of digital twins, and introduces their applications in intelligent manufacturing, digital factories, and intelligence, guiding students to complete the design of complex spacecraft digital twin systems. The teaching purpose is to stimulate students' interest in research in related fields, exercise their basic skills such as data inquiry, report writing, planning research routes, and report presentation. This course helps cultivate students' research abilities of independent thinking, self-directed learning, and a spirit of active innovation and exploration.

default.zh: 飞行器先进加工技术课程是飞行器制造工程专业学生非常重要的专业核心课，是学生必须掌握用于飞行器制造的先进制造技术，在培养学生综合分析能力、综合设计能力、解决高精度复杂零件制造问题等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授掌握超精密加工技术、特种加工技术、3D打印技术等基本知识、加工方法和适用范围。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验操作等环节，着重培养学生们高精度特殊复杂零件制造的综合分析与设计能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: The course of advanced machining technology for aircraft is a very important course for the students of aircraft manufacturing engineering, and it is necessary for them to master the Advanced Manufacturing Technology for aircraft manufacturing, it plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability, comprehensive design ability and solving the manufacturing problems of high-precision and complex parts. This course mainly teaches master ultra-precision machining technology, special machining technology, 3D printing technology and other basic knowledge, processing methods and scope of application. Through the course of classroom teaching, follow-up experimental operation and other links, focusing on training students high-precision special complex parts manufacturing comprehensive analysis and design ability, increase the sense of innovation, supporting the achievement of the corresponding indicators in professional learning.

default.zh: 本课程面向飞行器制造工程专业本科生，系统讲授深度学习与强化学习在宇航空间机构中的原理、方法与前沿应用。课程内容涵盖空间足式机器人、索驱机器人等典型宇航结构的感知、建模与智能控制技术，重点介绍如何利用深度神经网络进行结构状态识别、运动学计算及运动规划，以及如何通过强化学习实现机构控制策略的自优化与自适应能力。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1. 掌握宇航空间机构的基本原理与典型应用，了解足式机器人、绳索驱动机器人等宇航机构的组成部分、结构特征、运动特点与技术挑战。 课程目标2. 培养面向空间机构的智能建模与控制能力，能够将深度学习方法应用于空间机构的状态识别与性能预测，利用强化学习算法实现空间机构的智能控制与策略优化。
default.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students majoring in Aircraft Manufacturing Engineering, and systematically teaches the principles, methods, and cutting-edge applications of deep learning and reinforcement learning in aerospace mechanisms. The course content covers perception, modeling, and intelligent control technologies of typical aerospace structures such as legged robots and cable-driven robots, focusing on how to use deep neural networks for structural state recognition, kinematic calculations, and motion planning, as well as how to achieve self-optimization and adaptability of control strategies through reinforcement learning.The course objectives regarding student competencies are as follows: Course Objective 1. Master the basic principles and typical applications of aerospace mechanisms, understand the components, structural characteristics, motion features, and technical challenges of space legged robots and cable-driven robots. Course Objective 2. Cultivate intelligent modeling and control capabilities for space mechanisms, able to apply deep learning methods for state recognition and performance prediction of space mechanisms, and utilize reinforcement learning algorithms for intelligent control and strategy optimization of space mechanisms.

default.zh: 决策是工程实践中极具挑战性的管理工作。本课程主要讲授决策分析与相关理论，使学生能够掌握决策分析的主要概念、基本理论与方法，学会在复杂的、不确定的、多目标等不同情况下进行科学决策的理论知识，对决策分析的发展趋势有所了解，并为相关的课程学习与专业研究打下基础。课程内容包括构建系统化决策过程、决策目标的建立与评估属性的确定、决策方案的衡量、简易多属性评等技术与多属性评估模式、层次分析法的模式与应用步骤、数据包络分析法的基本模式与使用步骤、完全不确定状况下的决策准则、决策影响图的构建与应用、决策树的构建与应用、贝氏决策分析与贝氏网络理论与应用、期望效用理论、多属性效用模式、群体决策等。
default.en: Decision making is a very challenging management work in engineering practice. This course addresses the relevant subjects involved in decision analysis. In this course, student can learn the major concept, fundamental theory, and method in decision analysis field. They will grasp the scientific decision analysis knowledge in the complicated circumstance such as under uncertainty and conflicting multi-criteria, and catch the new trend in decision analysis development. The content of this course includes the following aspects: building the framework for decision analysis, defining the decision objective and evaluation attribute, overall judgment and measurement for alternative, Simple Multi-Attribute Ranking Technology (SMART) and multi-attribute evaluation model, analytic hierarchy process (AHP) model and its procedure steps, data envelopment analysis (DEA) model and its procedure steps, under uncertainty decision criteria, the influence diagram’s building and application, the decision tree’s building and application, Bayesian decision and Bayesian network, expected utility theory, multi-attribute utility theory (MAU), group decision, etc.

default.zh: 工程经济学课程是一门是自然科学和社会科学的相互交叉、相互渗透形成的边缘学科。它的研究对象是工程项目技术方案的经济效益。其研究内容和任务是运用工程经济分析原理与方法，对能够完成工程项目预定目标的各种可行技术方案进行技术经济论证、比较、计算和评价。 本课程的内容涵盖工程经济学基础，工程经济分析的基本经济要素，经济效益及评价指标体系，工程经济分析的可比性原理，工程经济分析的基本方法，不确定性分析及方案综合评价，工程建设项目可行性研究及企业技术改造经济分析，价值工程，资产评估等。 本课程的教学目的是提高理工科院校学生对工程项目的经济分析意识和技能，以更好地参与国际经济活动的需要。
default.en: Economics in Engineering is the key course for undergraduate students in industry engineering department, which is interdisciplinary subject of natural science and social science. The Economics in Engineering Course teach the basic principles and applications of economic analysis, supported by a large number and wide range of engineering-oriented examples and end of chapter exercises. The contents of the course include Foundations of engineering economy, Basic elements of engineering economic analysis, Nominal and effective interest rates, Index system of estimation of engineering economic benefit, Comparable principle of engineering economic analysis, Rate of return analysis: single alternative, Benefit/cost analysis and public sector economics, Replacement and retention decisions，Value engineering, Cost estimation. The course aims at teaching the basic principle of engineering economy and the basic analysis method of engineering economy, improving student’s abilities to economic analysis of engineering projects.

default.zh: 《项目管理》是一门新兴的管理学科，是研究如何管理各种大型项目的科学。随着经济全球化、信息网络化的发展以及知识经济时代的到来，人们越来越多地认识到了项目管理的重要。对一个合格的项目负责人，不仅要有其所在领域的专业技术知识，还必须懂得如何科学地管理项目。项目经理被誉为二十一世纪的黄金职业。 本课程主要对项目管理的相关内容和主要活动进行系统介绍，既从理论的角度对项目管理进行总体阐述，包括项目管理概论、项目生命周期与组织机构、项目管理过程和过程组、项目综合管理、项目范围管理、项目时间管理、项目费用管理、项目质量管理、项目人力资源管理、项目沟通管理、项目风险管理、项目采购管理等章节。 本课程旨在向学生介绍项目管理理论和实践的基本内容和发展状况，通过对上述内容的学习，使学生能掌握项目管理的基本理论和技能，建立正确的项目管理观念；使学生了解并能使用项目启动、项目计划、项目监控、项目实施和项目终止等项目生命周期各阶段管理所需的技能，为学生以后的工作奠定良好的理论基础。
default.en: The Project Management is a comprehensive course that focuses on letting students gain practical experience in project management skills, concepts, and techniques. This course provides an overview of the basic functions of project management (The Project Life Cycle, Project Management Process Groups, Project Integration Management, Project Scope Management, Project Time Management, Project Cost Management, Project Quality Management, Project Human Resource Management, Project Communications Management, Project Risk Management, and Project Procurement Management). In this course, students will master the basic principle of project management, get to know the hot topic of its present development, comprehend its basic function, grasp the theory and method of project initiation, project planning, project execution, project control, and project closure in a project life cycle.

default.zh: 供应链管理与物联网技术课程是工业工程专业的一门专业选修课程。本课程主要培养学生比较系统地掌握现代供应链、物流管理的基础知识和基本理论，物联网技术的基础知识，以及物联网技术在多行业下的应用现状。在教学过程中要综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识和技能，为后继课程和日后从事企业物流管理以及行业互联网应用工作奠定较扎实的基础。 课程讲授的主要内容包括供应链管理理论的形成背景，供应链的概念、特征和类型，供应链管理的目标、供应链管理的实施步骤。供应链运作参考模型。供应链下的采购、生产、库存、客户服务管理。供应链的设计和供应链绩效评价等。物联网的管理模式、物联网的相关技术。基于物联网的供应链仓储管理。以及物联网技术在汽车、服装、医药等行业的应用。 课程考核分为大作业一个，占总成绩的20%，课程报告，占总成绩的80%。
default.en: The course of The Supply Chain Management and Internet of Things Technology is a professional elective course for industrial engineering. This course mainly cultivates students to systematically master the basic knowledge and theories of modern supply chain and logistics management, the basic knowledge of Internet of Things technology, and the current application status of Internet of Things technology in multiple industries. In the teaching process, it is necessary to comprehensively apply the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses, laying a solid foundation for subsequent courses and future work in enterprise logistics management and industry internet applications. The main content of the course includes the background of the formation of supply chain management theory, the concept, characteristics, and types of supply chain, the goals of supply chain management, and the implementation steps of supply chain management. Supply chain operation reference model. Procurement, production, inventory, and customer service management under the supply chain. Design and performance evaluation of the supply chain. The management mode and related technologies of the Internet of Things. Supply chain warehousing management based on the Internet of Things. And the application of IoT technology in industries such as automobiles, clothing, and pharmaceuticals. The course assessment is divided into one major assignments, accounting for 20% of the total score, and the course report, accounting for 80% of the total score.

default.zh: 《工业工程技术与应用系列专题》是工业工程专业本科生的专业选修课，使得学生能利用前期所学的专业知识来解决生产系统及其管理的实际问题，了解工业工程的学科前沿，培养学生的自主学习和终身学习的意识，以及不断学习和适应发展的能力。 本课程以专题讲座的形式，概述工作研究、人因工程、生产计划与控制、生产设施规划、质量管理、人力资源管理等方面的综合应用实例以及最新发展动态等。 本课程采用累加式计分方法按照百分制进行考核：学生需从6个专题中选择2个专题各完成1份报告，每份报告占50分。
default.en: "Series Subjects on Technology & Application of Industrial Engineering" is the professional elective course for students who major in industrial engineering. Aim to make the students can use the previous learned major knowledge to solve practical problems of production system and its management, to understand the leading edge of industrial engineering discipline, to cultivate students the consciousness of autonomous learning and lifelong learning, and the ability to constantly learn and adapt to the development. In the form of seminars, this course summarize the comprehensive application examples and the latest development trends in fields of the Work Study, Human Factors Engineering, Production Planning and Control, Production Facilities Planning, Quality Management, Human Resources Management, etc. In this course, the cumulative scoring method is assessed according to the percentage system: Students are required to complete 2 reports selecting from the six topics, 50 points per report.

default.zh: 《制造管理信息系统》是我国高等学校工业工程专业的一门重要的专业选修课程。管理和信息科学与技术已经渗透到社会、经济的各个方面，制造管理信息系统的知识、方法、工具，也成为管理和工程技术人才必不可少的基本技能。 本课程旨在使学生能够综合运用所学到的制造、管理、信息、系统和计算机科学和技术的理论、方法、工具，在理解制造过程的基础上，了解企业管理理论，了解管理信息系统的系统化、形式化和结构化的规划、分析、设计、实施、运行维护和评价方法。理解制造过程所涉及的功能、信息、业务和管理方法及其相互之间的关系，学会对制造业的决策、管理、业务、流程中的信息进行采集、存储、组织、分析、处理和应用，学会应用管理和信息技术对制造过程进行设计和实施。了解以ERP为代表的制造业管理信息系统在生产计划、进销存、设备管理、质量管理、成本管理和车间作业控制领域的管理学原理、系统结构、功能和业务流程。能够熟练应用制造业企业建立的管理信息系统处理相关业务，并以此为基础增强学生的创新意识和能力。
default.en: Manufacturing Management Information System (MMIS) is an important elective course for industrial engineering majors in colleges and universities in China. Management and information science and technology have penetrated into various aspects of society and economy, and the knowledge, methods, and tools of manufacturing management information systems have become essential basic skills for management and engineering talents. This course aims to enable students to comprehensively apply the theories, methods, and tools of manufacturing, management, information, systems, and computer science and technology they have learned. On the basis of understanding the manufacturing process, they will understand management theory, system theory, and the systematic, formal, and structured planning, analysis, design, implementation, operation, maintenance, and evaluation methods of management information systems. Understand the functions, information, business, and management methods involved in the manufacturing process and their interrelationships, learn to collect, store, organize, analyze, process, and apply information in decision-making, management, business, and processes in the manufacturing industry, and learn to apply management and information technology to design and implement the manufacturing process. Understand the management principles, system structure, functions, and business processes of manufacturing management information systems represented by ERP in the fields of production planning, inventory management, equipment management, quality management, cost management, and workshop operation control. Proficient in applying the management information system established by manufacturing enterprises to handle related businesses, and based on this, enhancing students' innovation awareness and ability.

default.zh: 数据库系统及应用课程是工业工程本科专业的一门技术基础课，主要内容包括数据库系统概论、数据库技术发展简史、数据库系统特征结构、数据模型、数据结构、关系数据库理论、CIMS中的数据库集成技术、工程数据库的基本概念等方面的内容。该课程讲授数据库系统的定义与基本概念、数据库技术的发展过程、数据模型、数据结构、关系数据库理论、数据库管理系统的基本功能结构、分布式数据库系统的概念、基于客户/服务器（C/S）结构的数据库系统等基本知识，数据库的设计分析、功能需求分析的原则方法，CIMS中的的数据库集成技术原理方法，工程应用数据系统的管理方法等方面的初步专业基础知识。通过本课程的学习，要求学生了解数据库系统的基本概念、主要内容、学科性质、特点及发展方向，建立数据库系统的总体概念；了解数据库技术的发展过程；掌握数据库的一般设计原理、应用方法；了解工程数据库管理系统的基本内容和研究方法并初步形成系统概念；为后续工业工程其他课程的学习奠定基础。培养学生达成掌握数据库技术基本知识、基本设计能力、综合分析能力、创新设计素质目标。
default.en: “Application of Data Base Systems” is a technique fundamental course for the Industrial Engineering Specialty. The main contents include brief introduction to Data-Base System, development of Data-Base System, structure of Data-Base System, data model, theory of relational Data-Base System and Engineering Data-Base System. The definition of Data-Base System and related basic concepts, the developing history of Data-Base System will be briefly introduced. The following kernel fundamental knowledge are also to be lectured, such as fundamental of Data-Base System, design of Data-Base System, distributed Data-Base System, Client/Server system, development of relational Data-Base System and its application in designing, the principles and methods of design in CIMS, and principles of Engineering Data-Base System and so on. By learning this course, the students are expected to understand the basic concepts, main contents, discipline characteristics and developing trend of Data-Base System. The general idea and consciousness of Data-Base System should be established. The research methods in Data-Base System and the applications will be learned. This course will lay a foundation for students to learn the other courses of industrial engineering. To get target for Training students to master basic knowledge of database technology, basic design ability, comprehensive analysis ability and creative design quality.

default.zh: 制造执行系统作为企业级生产计划层和车间级设备控制层之间的管理信息系统，是实现现代制造企业高效运作与智能控制的关键环节。本课程主要内容包括制造执行系统的产生与发展、功能结构与体系结构、制造任务的调度及实时数据采集、在制品库存控制、车间物流配送、制造执行系统的选型及实施等内容。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够了解制造执行系统的主要结构、基本功能，并能够根据企业实际需要进行合理选型及应用。
default.en: As the management information system between the enterprise level production plan and the workshop level equipment control layer，Manufacturing execution system is the key link to realize the efficient operation and intelligent control of modern manufacturing enterprises. The course include the generation and development of manufacturing execution systems，functional structure and architecture, manufacturing task scheduling and real-time data acquisition, Wip control, Logistics delivery in the workshop, selection and implementation of manufacturing execution system etc.. The students will learn and master the following content from this course: The main structure and function of manufacturing execution system, reasonable selection and application according to the actual needs of enterprises.

default.zh: 制造工程信息集成技术分析制造工程的典型的自动化分系统的独立发展过程、集成技术的历史以及它们的研究现状和未来发展趋势。并从制造系统、制造模式、制造技术三个层次上介绍当代制造业的典型新系统、新模式和新技术，使制造业中的技术与管理融为一体。本课程主要内容包括：制造业信息化的概论、现代制造模式和先进制造技术概念、计算机集成制造系统、计算机辅助设计和辅助制造、计算机辅助工艺规程、产品数据管理、企业级信息化系统、智能数据感知技术、智能分析与决策支持。
default.en: The information integrated technique of manufacturing engineering analyzes the independent development process, the history of integrated technology and the current research stage and future development trend of typical automatic subsystem in manufacturing engineering. And, from three layers including manufacturing system, manufacturing mode and manufacturing technology, the typical new system, new mode and new technology of current manufacturing industry are introduced, which integrate technology with management in manufacturing industry. The main contents of this course are: outline of manufacturing informatization, concepts of modern manufacturing mode and advanced manufacturing technology, computer integrated manufacturing system, computer aided design and manufacturing, computer aided process planning, product data management, enterprise-class informatization system, intelligent data perception technology, intelligent analysis and decision support system, and so on.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授生产系统建模与仿真的基本理论、基本方法和实际应用的相关内容，包括系统建模与仿真的基本概念和重要意义，系统建模与仿真的一般步骤；离散事件系统及其模型分类，离散事件系统建模的基本元素，建立系统模型的常用方法；随机变量和随机分布概述，随机数的生成原理和方法，随机数发生器的检验，典型随机变量的生成；生产系统建模方法概述，活动循环图法，排队系统模型，库存系统模型；系统建模与仿真输入分析的基本方法；系统建模与仿真结果分析的基本方法；仿真软件系统及其发展，生产系统仿真软件应用实例等。
default.en: The course focus on the basic principle and theory , the basic method and practical application about modeling and simulation of production system. It contains the basic concepts and significance, the general steps of modeling and simulation, the discrete event system and its classification about model, the basic elements of discrete event system modeling, the commonly used method for established the system model. The course summarizes the random variable and distribution. It covers the principle and method of random number generation, random number generator test, typical random variable generating. It also contains the overview about manufacturing system modeling methods, the movable cycle graph, queuing system model, waiting line system model, inventory system model. It includes the basic method about input analysis and result analysis of modeling and simulation, simulation software system and its development and the application examples about production system simulation software.

default.zh: 在人工智能、工业4.0、工业互联网、中国制造2025的制造业发展背景之下，制造业正在发生着革命性的变革，在此次制造革命的浪潮中，智能制造是核心内容之一，已经成为国际研究热点议题。制造业是国民经济的中坚力量，我国已经成为世界第一制造大国，但与制造强国相比，仍有较大距离，把握智能制造的发展契机，引领制造业提速发展，是我国实施制造强国战略的重要环节。本课程将使学生了解智能制造领域的前沿动态，掌握智能制造与工业互联网的有关知识，并通过典型应用案例深入理解智能制造为传统制造业所带来的机遇和挑战，为学生将来从事制造业相关工作提供知识支持。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握智能制造与工业互联网基础知识与发展前沿，了解智能制造为传统制造业带来的机遇与挑战；深入理解智能制造与工业互联网的适用领域、实施方法，能够创造性的在相关领域应用智能制造技术；与时俱进，终身学习，能够在智能制造与工业互联网的工程实践中考虑社会、健康、安全、法律、文化以及环境。
default.en: With the background of artificial intelligence, industry 4.0, Industrial Internet and Made in China 2025, the manufacturing industry is undergoing revolutionary changes. In this wave of manufacturing revolution, intelligent manufacturing is one of the core contents and has become a hot topic of international research. Manufacturing industry is the backbone of the national economy, China has become the world's first manufacturing power, but compared with the manufacturing leader countries, there is still a large distance, grasp the development opportunity of intelligent manufacturing, leading the development of manufacturing speed, is an important link in China's implementation of manufacturing power strategy. This course will enable students to understand the cutting-edge trends in the field of intelligent manufacturing, master the knowledge related to intelligent manufacturing and industrial Internet, and deeply understand the opportunities and challenges brought by intelligent manufacturing to traditional manufacturing industry through typical application cases, so as to provide knowledge support for students to engage in manufacturing related work in the future. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic knowledge and development frontier of intelligent manufacturing and Industrial Internet, and understand the opportunities and challenges brought by intelligent manufacturing to traditional manufacturing industry. Deeply understand the applicable fields and implementation methods of intelligent manufacturing and Industrial Internet, and be able to creatively apply intelligent manufacturing technology in related fields; Keeping pace with the times, lifelong learning, can consider the society, health, safety, law, culture and environment in the engineering practice of intelligent manufacturing and Industrial Internet.

default.zh: 智能制造的主要知识领域包括设计、制造、测控、管理等方面。本课程聚焦于制造管理领域，课程内容包括四个典型制造管理场景，包括车间作业优化排程、智能决策问题求解、设备剩余寿命预测、基于深度学习的图像识别分类。能够让学生了解主流AI技术及其适用范围，了解大语言模型的特点及其部署方法，引导学生部署LLM，探索在制造领域的潜在应用。通过典型的四个制造管理AI应用场景的方案设计与实现，课程将提供完整的案例资源，包括案例原始数据、程序代码、AI求解与部署详解等，学生可以深度理解AI知识，并学会举一反三，利用AI技术解决类似的相关问题。
default.en: The main knowledge areas of intelligent manufacturing include design, manufacturing, measurement and control, management, etc. This course focuses on the field of manufacturing management. The course content covers four typical manufacturing management scenarios, including workshop operation optimization and scheduling, intelligent decision-making problem-solving, equipment remaining life prediction, and image recognition and classification based on deep learning. It enables students to understand mainstream AI technologies and their applicable scopes, the characteristics of large language models and their deployment methods, guide students to deploy LLMS, and explore potential applications in the manufacturing field. Through the design and implementation of four typical AI application scenarios in manufacturing management, the course will provide complete case resources, including original case data, program codes, detailed explanations of AI solution and deployment, etc. Students can deeply understand AI knowledge and learn to draw inferences by analogy, using AI technology to solve similar related problems.

default.zh: 柔性机器人是一种能够适应各种环境、具备高度灵活性和可变形性的机器人。它们通常采用柔性的材料和结构，以便在空间中自由移动和变形。仿生机器人是模仿生物形态、结构和运动方式的机器人。它们通常具备高度的仿生性能，可以模拟生物的感知、运动和交互能力。柔性机器人与仿生机器人的应用非常广泛，包括制造业、医疗保健、航空航天、救援等领域。课程聚焦飞行和游动两种典型仿生运动原理，使学生了解运动仿生的灵感来源和机理启发，为将来从事创新性设计打下基础。流体驱动柔性机器人是流体力学基础和机械工程基础知识的扩展和典型应用范例，具有良好的示范和指引作用，对培养学生的创新意识具有积极作用。通过课程学习，使学生了解典型运动仿生原理，掌握典型柔性仿生机器人的设计和制造方法。
default.en: Compliant robot is a kind of robot that can adapt to various environments and is highly flexible and deformable. They often employ flexible or soft materials and structures in order to freely move and deform in space. Bio-inspired robots are robots that mimic the form, structure and movement of living organisms. They often have a high degree of biomimetic performance that can simulate the perception, movement and interaction capabilities of living organisms. Compliant robots and bio-inspired robots are widely used, including manufacturing, medical care, aerospace, rescue and other fields. The course focuses on the two typical principles of flight and swimming, so that students can understand the inspiration source and mechanism of locomotion bionics, and lay a foundation for innovative design in the future. Fluid-driven compliant robot is a typical application example of the basic knowledge of fluid mechanics and mechanical engineering. It has a good demonstration and guiding role, and has a positive role in cultivating students' innovative consciousness. Through the course study, the students can understand the principle of typical locomotion bionic robot, and master the design and manufacturing method of typical compliant bionic robot.

default.zh: 微操控机器人具备微米级精度的操控能力，在晶圆检测、微器件装配和细胞批量注射等领域有着广泛的应用，半导体加工、微纳制造和生命科学等高端装备领域的一项共性支撑技术。压电驱动技术具有精度高、响应快、出力密度高等突出优势，已成为微操控机器人技术领域的一项核心技术，压电微操控机器人目前已经得到了广泛的研究。《压电驱动与微操控机器人》面向机电工程学院本科生开课，是机械电子工程专业的选修课程之一。本课程主要包括微驱动技术概述、压电材料与压电驱动基础、超声谐振式压电驱动技术、非谐振式精密压电驱动技术、基于压电驱动的微操控机器人结构设计、致动原理和典型应用。课程重点在于建立学生对压电驱动技术及微操控机器人系统的认识，掌握压电微操控机器人的基本设计思想、应用领域和发展方向，开拓学生的学术视野和创新思维，培养学生对机器人技术前沿领域的思辨能力及跨学科领域思考问题和解决问题的能力。本课程能激发学生在该领域的研究兴趣，培养书目检索和学术报告撰写的基本技能。
default.en: Micro manipulation robot has the micrometer scale precision manipulation capability and is widely applied in fields such as wafer detection, micro device assembly, and cell batch injection. It is a common support technology in high-end equipment fields such as semiconductor processing, micro nano manufacturing, and life sciences. Piezoelectric actuation technology has outstanding advantages of high accuracy, fast response, and large force density, and has become a core technology in the field of micro manipulation robot technology. Piezoelectric micro manipulation robots have been widely studied. The course Piezoelectric actuation and micro manipulation robot is open to Undergraduate student of School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, and is one of the elective courses in the major of mechanical and electronic engineering. This course mainly includes an overview of micro actuation technology, piezoelectric materials and the foundation of piezoelectric actuation, ultrasonic resonant piezoelectric actuation technology, non-resonant precision piezoelectric actuation technology, structural design of micro manipulation robots based on piezoelectric actuation, actuation principles, and typical applications. The focus of the course is to teach students to understand the piezoelectric actuation technology and micro manipulation robot systems, master the basic design ideas, application fields, and development directions of piezoelectric micro manipulation robots, broaden their academic horizons and innovative thinking, cultivate the ability of critical thinking in the forefront of robotics technology, as well as their capabilities to think and solve problems in interdisciplinary fields. This course can stimulate the research interest in this field, cultivate basic skills in bibliographic retrieval and academic report writing.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授机器人液压控制系统的基础理论、典型元件、控制系统建模与分析、电液控制系统设计等相关内容，课程主要内容包括液压控制阀的分类、特性分析和设计准则；液压动力机构的形式、工作原理以及数学建模与分析；液压动力机构的负载匹配分析；电液伺服阀类型；电液伺服阀的技术参数、选择与应用；机器人电液位置控制系统工作原理、误差分析；电液位置控制系统的控制系统校正形式与设计。
default.en: This course is devoted to teach a course in Robot hydraulic control systems and discuss detailed the relevant subjects involved in the theoretical fundamentals, topical hydraulic elements, modeling, analysis and design of hydraulic control systems. It includes the following aspects: the classification, characteristics and design criteria of hydraulic control valves; the types, principle and modeling analysis of hydraulic power elements; the load matching analysis of hydraulic power elements; the major types of electro-hydraulic servovalves; the specification, selection and usage of Robot electro-hydraulic servovalves; the principle, error analysis, compensation schemes and those design of Robot electro-hydraulic position control servos。

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授主要流体动力元件制造技术的基本理论、制造和加工工艺相关内容，包括机械制造工艺原理，主要阐述机械加工工艺规程的制定；机械加工精度，包括影响加工精度的因素、加工误差分析、机械加工表面质量等；尺寸链和夹具；流体动力元件先进制造技术；液压阀中阀芯、阀体以及集成阀块的加工和装配；液压缸的缸筒和杠杆加工；叶片泵的叶片、转子、定子等加工；齿轮泵的泵体、泵盖以及齿轮加工；柱塞泵和马达的主要零件的加工，包括内外球面加工、泵和马达轴的加工、配流盘和缸体加工等；流体动力元件的装配工艺。
default.en: This course addresses the relevant subjects involved in fluid power components manufacturing technology. It includes the following aspects: the mechanical manufacturing process principles, mainly elaborated in the formulation of the machining process planning, the machining precision, including the factors affecting the machining precision, machining error analysis, the machined surface quality, the size chain and fixture, the advanced manufactural technology of hydraulic products, the machining and assembly of hydraulic valve spool, valve body and integrated valve blocks, the machining of hydraulic cylinder tube and lever, the machining of vane pump’s vane, rotor and stator, the machining of gear pump’s pump body, pump cover and gear, the machining of main parts of piston pumps and motors, Including inner and outer spherical surface machining, pump and motor shaft machining, valve plate and cylinder machining, and last the fluid power components assembly process.

default.zh: 电液足式机器人是一门高度交叉的前沿学科，是集力学、机械学、生物学、人类学、计算机科学与工程、控制论与控制工程学、电子工程学、人工智能、社会学等多学科知识之大成，是一项综合性很强的新技术。足式重载机器人具有很强的复杂环境适应性，能够在不规则路面及各种户外环境下行走，通过性强。相比于其它行走机器人，四足重载机器人采用电液驱动形式，承载力大，具有更好的静态稳定性和动态稳定性，是未来真正投入军用实战和民用服务的仿生机器人。通过该课程的学习，使得学生基本熟悉足式重载机器人发展状况和足式重载机器人及其驱动系统设计技术，为今后从事光机电液一体化与系统设计、制造的研究工作打下基础。 本课程是机械电子工程的专业选修课，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握足式重载行走机器人机构设计、运动分析、电液动力系统、电液驱动系统、控制和使用的技术要点和基础理论。足式重载机器人是典型的机电一体化装置，它不是机械、电子的简单组合，而是机械、电子、液压、控制、检测、通信和计算机的有机融合，通过这门课的学习，使学生对足式重载行走机器人及其驱动技术有一个全面、深入的认识。培养学生综合运用所学基础理论和专业知识进行创新设计的能力。
default.en: Electro-hydraulic Legged robotics is a highly interdisciplinary and cutting-edge field that combines knowledge from various disciplines such as mechanics, biology, anthropology, computer science, engineering, cybernetics, control engineering, electrical engineering, artificial intelligence, and sociology. Quadruped robots have strong adaptability to complex environments and can traverse irregular terrains and various outdoor environments with great agility. Compared to other walking robots, quadruped robots utilize electro-hydraulic drive systems, which provide large carrying capacities and improved static and dynamic stability, making them ideal for military and civilian applications. Through the study of this course, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the development and design of legged robots and their drive systems, laying a strong foundation for future work in the design and manufacturing of integrated optical-mechanical-electrical-hydraulic systems. This course is an elective course for students majoring in mechanical and electronic engineering. Through the study of this course, students will acquire a strong grasp of the technical and theoretical aspects of legged robot mechanism design, motion analysis, electro-hydraulic power systems, electro-hydraulic drive systems, control, and applications. Legged robots are complex mechatronic devices that integrate mechanics, electronics, hydraulics, control, detection, communication, and computer systems. Through this course, students will develop a comprehensive and in-depth understanding of legged robots and their drive technologies. This will cultivate their ability to apply fundamental theories and professional knowledge to innovative design processes.

default.zh: 集成电路是信息时代的支撑，是人工智能等新兴产业的基础，是科技前沿的算力基础。我国正处于半导体制造产业的高速发展期，同时也是先进半导体制造技术的突围期。半导体制造和半导体装备相关产业是新时代高质量发展的重要支撑。我国急需熟悉装半导体制造装备和了解半导体制工艺造的复合型人才。 《半导体制造技术与装备》是融合半导体制造工艺与半导体制造装备的课程。 致力与培养了解半导体制造工艺和前沿技术、熟悉半导体制造装备的复合型人才。通过课程学习，同学们将全面了解从“沙子到芯片”的半导体制造过程，熟悉从晶圆制备到芯片封装整个过程的关键设备组成与原理。不但让同学们了解先进芯片是怎么做出来的，还让同学们熟悉先进芯片是用什么设备做出来的以及这些设备是如何保证芯片质量的。 《半导体制造技术与装备》课程内容包括：半导体制造导论、半导体材料概论、晶圆制备技术与装备、半导体制造总体工艺、先进光刻技术与装备、先进刻蚀技术与装备、离子注入与装备、先进封装技术与装备。 从制造工艺和制造装备两条线讲授先进半导体制造技术，为同学们日后从事半导体制造以及半导体装备运行、研究开发、生产制造等工作打下基础。
default.en: Integrated circuits are the support of the information age, the foundation of emerging industries such as artificial intelligence, and the computing power foundation of cutting-edge technology. Semiconductor manufacturing and semiconductor equipment related industries are important supports for high-quality development. China urgently needs composite talents who are familiar with semiconductor manufacturing equipment and understand semiconductor manufacturing processes. Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology and Equipment is a course that integrates semiconductor manufacturing processes and equipment. The course aims to cultivate composite talents who understand semiconductor manufacturing processes and cutting-edge technologies, and are familiar with semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Through course learning, students will have a comprehensive understanding of the semiconductor manufacturing process from sand to chips, and become familiar with the key equipment components and principles throughout the entire process from wafer preparation to chip packaging . The course not only helps students understand how advanced chips are made, but also familiarizes them with the equipment used to make advanced chips and how these devices ensure chip quality. The course content includes: Introduction to Semiconductor Manufacturing, Introduction to Semiconductor Materials, Wafer Preparation Technology and Equipment, Overall Semiconductor Manufacturing Process, Advanced Lithography Technology and Equipment, Advanced Etching Technology and Equipment, Ion Implantation and Equipment, and Advanced Packaging Technology and Equipment. The course teaches advanced semiconductor manufacturing technology from two lines: manufacturing process and manufacturing equipment, laying a foundation for students to engage in semiconductor manufacturing, semiconductor equipment operation, research and development, production and manufacturing in the future.

default.zh: 半导体是一种特性介于导体和绝缘体之间的物质，其电阻率易受掺杂、温度、光照等因素的影响而改变。基于半导体制作而成的各类电子元件（传感器、储存器、CPU等）及其上的各类电器（计算机、移动电话等），已广泛存在于人们日常生活的各个角落，在日新月异的信息时代中扮演重要的角色。半导体材料的理化性质，尤其是电学和光学特性，决定半导体器件的功能，因此有必要对其进行定量测试和分析。本课程旨在为学生讲解半导体测试技术，主要针对半导体的电学和光学特性，通过对其电阻率、载流子浓度、少数载流子寿命、霍尔效应等的测量，加深对半导体器件工作原理的理解。课程涉及到的测试分析技术包括：四探针法测电阻率、微波光电导衰减测试、霍尔效应测试、红外光谱测试、能级测试等。课程将对测试技术的基本原理和实验操作进行简要介绍，不涉及过深的原理和过多的实验操作细节；目的是帮助学生了解半导体测试的基础知识，培养学生对半导体研究的兴趣。
default.en: A semiconductor is a substance whose electrical resistivity can be modified by factors such as doping, temperature, and light. Various electronic components and electrical appliances built on semiconductors are playing an important role in people’s life. The physical and chemical properties of semiconductor materials, especially the electrical and optical ones, determine the function of semiconductor devices, so it is necessary to quantitatively test and analyze them. This course aims at explaining semiconductor testing technology and equipment to students to deepen their understanding of the working principle of semiconductor devices through the measurement of resistivity, carrier concentration, minority carrier lifetime, Hall effect, and so on. The testing technologies covered in this course include: four-probe resistivity measurement, microwave photoconductive attenuation test, Hall effect test, infrared spectroscopy test, energy level test, etc. The course will introduce the basic principles and experimental operations of testing technology. The purpose is to help students understand the basics of semiconductor testing and cultivate students' interest in semiconductor research.

default.zh: 微机电系统（Micro Electro Mechanical System，MEMS）是制造工程领域的重要研究方向之一。本课程主要讲授MEMS技术领域的新发展、MEMS设计与制造相关的理论、设计方法、加工工艺、检测技术，典型微机电系统的原理、结构、特性和参数，以及相关工程领域的应用方法。 通过本课程的学习，使研究生掌握MEMS的概念和技术范畴，了解MEMS技术发展动态，及其在国民经济发展中的地位和作用；掌握MEMS的常用设计方法；掌握典型MEMS的制造技术与关键问题；掌握MEMS的测量技术与方法；通过了解实际工程案例，实现针对具体工程问题选择相应的设计、制造与测试方法，提高研究生的系统设计与创新思维能力。
default.en: Micro Electro Mechanical System (MEMS) is one of the important research directions in the field of manufacturing engineering. This course mainly teaches new developments in the field of MEMS technology, theories, design methods, processing processes, and detection technologies related to MEMS design and manufacturing, the principles, structures, characteristics, and parameters of typical MEMS systems, and application methods in related engineering fields. Through the study of this course, graduate students can grasp the concept and technical scope of MEMS, understand the development dynamics of MEMS technology, and its status and role in the development of the national economy; master the common design methods of MEMS; master the manufacturing technology and key problems of typical MEMS; master the measurement technology and methods of MEMS; through understanding the actual engineering cases, realize the selection of corresponding design, manufacturing and testing methods for specific engineering problems, and improve the system design and innovative ability of graduate students.

default.zh: 《纳米技术》是机械设计制造及其自动化的专业课。本课程介绍纳米技术的前沿发展方向，介绍纳米科技的基本理论、相关技术及在生物、材料、电子、机械及其他领域的研究与应用等。 本课程的主要任务是培养学生： 1、掌握物质在纳米尺度的新现象、新规律。 2、掌握纳米科技理论基础、纳米材料与结构、微纳制造、微纳测量与材料表征、纳米机械学等方面介绍纳米科学与技术的基本理论、发展概况、应用情况。 3、了解纳米科学与技术各方面的最新发展趋势、新理论和新技术。培养学生在相关技术领域从事工作和研究的能力。
default.en: 《Nanotechnology》is a professional course in mechanical design, manufacturing, and automation. This course introduces the cutting-edge development directions of nanoscience and technology, including the basic theories and related technologies of nanotechnology, as well as its research and applications in biology, materials, electronics, machinery, and other fields. The main task of this course is to cultivate students: 1. Master the new phenomena and laws of matter at the nanoscale. 2. Master the theoretical foundation of nanotechnology, nanomaterials and structures, micro/nano manufacturing, micro/nano measurement and material characterization, nanomechanics, and other aspects to introduce the basic theories, development overview, and application of nanotechnology and technology. 3. Understand the latest development trends, new theories, and new technologies in various aspects of nanoscience and technology.
