Cultivate the ability of students to engage in work and research in relevant technical fields.

default.zh: 随着信息技术的飞速发展和社会需求的多样化，物体外形的空间三维测量在工业自动检测、产品质量控制、逆向设计、生物医学、虚拟现实、文物复制、人体测量等众多领域中得到了广泛应用。基于机器视觉的三维测量是非接触测量方法、测量精度高并且获取数据量大，容易实现自动化操作，在近年来成为研究的热点。 本课程从视觉测量的基本原理和方法出发，介绍视觉测量和三维重构技术的研究现状与发展趋势，并重点讲授对复杂三维形状的视觉测量和重构实现技术，包括：相机标定方法、基于双目和结构光的视觉测量、复杂曲面的三维重构技术和特征拟合与测量技术等。
default.en: With the diversification of the rapid development of information technology and the demand of the society, space measurement of 3-D object shape is widely used in many fields that include industrial automatic detection, product quality control, reverse engineering, biomedical, virtual reality, cultural reproduction, body measurement etc. The 3D measurement based on machine vision is a non-contact measurement, which has high measuring precision and can obtain a large amount of data, easy to realize automatic operation. Vision measurement and 3D reconstruction has become a hot spot of technical research in recent years. From the field techniques, fundamental principles, this course presents the literature review of vision measurement and 3D reconstruction. And put emphasis on the realization techniques of vision measurement and reconstruction for complex 3D shape. The techniques including: Camera calibration method, binocular vision and structured light base measurement, 3D reconstruction and feature fitting measurement for complex shape.

default.zh: 本课程内容涵盖了计算机原理与柔性制造系统的控制技术，用工业PC机与单片机、PLC组成上位机、下位机控制系统，设计计算机接口与控制方案；机械系统集散控制结构、软件设计和数据库技术；传感器、数控机床、机器人等柔性制造单元关键设备的控制技术；典型柔性制造单元的规划与运行控制等内容。使机电类学生系统深入地学习掌握工业PC机扩展及控制技术，培养学生基于计算机技术进行分析、解决问题的能力，为利用计算机进行机电系统控制、信息处理和制造单元综合规划等应用提供技术基础。
default.en: The techniques involved in this Course are as follows. Principles of computer, the control technology of Flexible Manufacturing System (FMS), control system constructing with engineering PC, micro-controller and PLC, the design of computer interface and control, mechanical system distributed control architecture, software and database technology, the control technology of key units of FM, such as sensor, CNC and robot, the planning and running control of typical FM cells. In this course, students can in-depth study and master the industrial PC expansion and control technology. Build students’ capacities for analysis and solving problems based computer techniques; construct the technical basis for comprehensive planning of electrical system control, information processing and manufacturing unit using computer techniques.

default.zh: 《误差原理与数据处理》这门课程是工科学生必须掌握的一门科学。它是机械、机电结合类专业的技术基础课，这门课程介绍了误差存在的必然性和普遍性，分析了误差产生的原因及影响因素，使学生充分认识误差的性质，并掌握数据处理方法。使学生掌握对测量精度的分析、计算，进而进行误差的合理分配，进一步完善测控系统，以便在最经济的条件下，得到最理想的设计和测量结果。 本课程的主要任务是培养学生： （1）掌握误差的基本原理，具有从事测量实践的初步能力，使学生能够对测量精度进行分析、计算，进而进行误差的合理分配； （2）充分认识误差的性质，并掌握数据处理方法； （3）具有运用标准、规范、查阅技术资料的能力、计算能力、分析处理能力。
default.en: The course is a technical foundation course for mechanical and electromechanical majors. It introduces the inevitability and universality of errors, analyzes the causes and influencing factors of errors. This course enables students to fully understand the nature of errors and master data processing methods, and master the analysis and calculation of measurement accuracy, and then allocate errors reasonably to further improve the measurement and control system. Finally, obtain the most ideal design and measurement results under the most economical conditions. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' following abilities: (1) Mastering the basic principles of error and possessing the preliminary ability to engage in measurement practice, enabling students to analyze and calculate measurement accuracy, and then allocate errors reasonably; (2) Fully understand the nature of errors and master data processing methods; (3) Possess the ability to apply standards, specifications, access technical data, calculate, analyze and process data.

default.zh: 超声技术是一门以物理、电子、机械及材料学为基础的，各行各业都要遇上的通用技术之一。超声波技术作为多门学科的边缘技术，正在不断的向各个技术领域渗透，正在形成国民经济中的一个颇有特色的产业之一。本课程的目的和基本要求是使学生了解超声波技术的基本理论，了解超声换能器的设计方法及压电换能器的结构、类型；了解超声波的空间发射与接收技术。掌握超声波检测技术的方法和应用。学会在工程技术领域中利用超声波技术，不断扩大超声波技术的应用领域和研究方向。 通过超声波检测技术的创新研修课学习，使学生对超声波检测技术形成完整和系统的认识，掌握基本理论、学会设计方法、了解实践过程、熟悉检测技术。充分发挥学生的手脑并行功能，起到开拓学生的学术视野和创新思维的作用，提高学生多学科跨领域地分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Ultrasonic is a general technology which is based on physical, electronic, machinery and materials science and meets the application requirements of many industries. Ultrasonic technique as the edge technology disciplines which is constantly to the technical field penetration and now forming distinctive industries in the national economy. The purpose of this course is to enable the students to understand the basic theory of ultrasonic technology, method and application of ultrasonic testing technology. So the students can master the design method of ultrasonic transducer and piezoelectric transducer; ultrasonic transmitting and receiving control of space technology. Learn to use ultrasonic technology in the field of engineering technology, the direction of expanding applications of ultrasonic technology and research. From this course, the students can have a comprehensive understanding about the ultrasonic testing technology based on piezoelectric effect, and master with the design and measurement method of ultrasonic technology. This course can development the students’ academic view and creative thinking, and train their ability on thinking and solving problems about the interdisciplinary field.

default.zh: 无人系统设计是当前的热点研究领域，无人系统在国防及民用等各领域实现了广泛的应用。学生拥有足够的兴趣掌握无人系统设计的相关原理和技术。利用所学的工程理论并结合实际的应用需求，分析、设计与实现一个典型的无人系统，可加深学生对系统工程、自动控制原理、控制系统设计、计算机控制等知识的理解和掌握，使各门课程有机地结合起来，充分调动学生的主观能动性，培养学生的实际动手能力和控制系统实现能力。 本课程第一张介绍了无人系统技术导论；第二章讲授无人系统的自主控制架构设计；第三章讲授无人机系统的数据采集系统；第四章讲授无人机系统的自主定位系统；第五章讲授无人机系统的环境感知系统；第六章讲授无人机系统的规划决策系统；第七章无人机系统的执行控制系统。 通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握典型无人系统设计的分类与基本设计原理、典型无人系统的分析与设计方法、无人系统的控制方法、无人系统的实现方法等。本课程在机械电子工程专业教学体系内为学生提供了一个热点应用方向的学习机会。
default.en: Unmanned system design is a hot research field at present, and unmanned systems have been widely used in various fields such as national defense and civil use. Students have sufficient interest in mastering the relevant principles and technologies of unmanned system design. Using the learned engineering theories and combined with the actual application requirements, analyzing, designing and implementing a typical unmanned system can deepen students' understanding and mastery of system engineering, automatic control principles, control system design, computer control and other knowledge, so that the courses are organically combined, fully mobilize students' subjective initiative, and cultivate students' practical hands-on ability and control system realization ability. The first sheet of this course introduces an introduction to unmanned systems technology; Chapter 2 teaches the design of autonomous control architecture for unmanned systems. Chapter 3 teaches the data acquisition system of unmanned aerial systems; Chapter 4 teaches autonomous positioning systems for unmanned aerial systems; Chapter 5 teaches the environmental perception system of unmanned aerial systems; Chapter 6 teaches the planning and decision-making system of unmanned aerial systems; Chapter 7 Execution Control Systems for Unmanned Aerial Systems. Through the study of this course, students will master the classification and basic design principles of typical unmanned system design, the analysis and design methods of typical unmanned systems, the control methods of unmanned systems, and the implementation methods of unmanned systems. This course provides students with a learning opportunity in the hot application direction within the teaching system of mechatronic engineering.

default.zh: 随着信息技术及人工智能的发展，具有自主飞行和控制能力且不需要人员直接操纵的无人机在军事、民用和科研多个领域得到广泛应用，有效地推动了智能无人系统的蓬勃发展。《无人机控制系统设计》是机器人与智能制造类专业基础理论能力培养的轨道课程，课程内涵在于紧密联系世界科技前沿发展与专业创新型人才培养需求，课程内容是从事机器人控制技术领域研究所需要的应用基础理论知识，是进一步推动智能机器人产业发展的技术需求。通过该课程的学习，培养学生主动思考和深入探究的学习能力，并且为未来从事相关领域的科学研究与工程实践奠定基础。 本课程旨在使学生掌握无人机系统的动力学模型、轨迹跟踪控制理论与方法，以及滑模控制、模型预测控制、非周期采样控制、安全控制和分布式编队控制等基本思想，使得学生具备设计自主智能无人机系统的基本能力和研究兴趣。
default.en: With the rapid developments of information technology and artificial intelligence, the unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) with autonomous decision and control abilities have been widely utilized in the in the military and civilian fields, which significantly boost the developments of autonomous unmanned systems. “Control System Design for UAV” is an undergraduate course for the students majoring in robotics and intelligent manufacturing and helps them develop the abilities of professional basic theory. This course aims at closely connecting the frontier developments of science and technology with the education requirements of innovative talents. The content of this course lies in the basic theory utilized for robotic control, which act as the technology requirements for pushing forward the developments of intelligent robots. The course will train the critical-thinking and self-exploration abilities for the students, and lay a foundation for future scientific research and engineering practice in related fields. This course aims to enable students to understand the dynamics model of UAV, trajectory tracking control theory and method, as well as the basic ideas of sliding mode control, model predictive control, aperiodic-sampled control, safety control and distributed formation control, so as to help the students develop the basic ability and research interest in designing autonomous intelligent UAVs.

default.zh: 机电一体化集成技术是机械技术与微电子技术有机结合的产物，也是微电子技术向传统技术渗透的过程中逐渐发展起来的一门新兴的综合性技术学科。《机电一体化集成技术》是机械电子工程专业本科生的专业轨道课。本课程主要讲授机电一体化系统的基本涵义、基本构成、工作原理及发展状况；机电一体化产品的共性关键技术及应用,主要包括机电一体化系统的典型机构、机电运动控制系统、执行装置、传感检测系统；机电一体化集成技术，主要包括机电一体化集成方法、机电一体化系统的集成设计、软硬件系统集成技术、微纳机电系统集成技术。
default.en: Mechatronics integration technology is the organic integration of mechanical technology and microelectronics technology, which is also an emerging comprehensive technology subject. "Mechatronics integration technology " is the specialty courses for mechatronic engineering undergraduate. Four major parts are included in this course: 1. basic concepts, basic composition, and work principle of mechatronics system from the perspective combination of electronic and machinery. 2. The commonly key technology and applications of mechatronics products. 3. Mechatronics systems such as typical mechanisms, the mechanical-electrical motion control system, the actuated equipment and sensing detection system. 4. Mechatronics integration technology mainly including mechatronics integration method, mechatronics integration system design, hardware and software system integration technology, micro-nano mechatronics system integration technology.

default.zh: 气动技术在国民经济中发挥着重要作用，广泛应用于自动化生产、机器人及各类装备中。气动技术以其特有的柔性和气体压力各向同性等特性，在机器人领域中得到创新性应用。例如气动仿人体手臂协作机器人、各类气动软体机器人机器手、气压驱动外骨骼等。 本课程主要讲授与气动机器人技术相关的气体热力学性质、气体流动等基础理论；气源发生及处理元件、执行元件、控制元件的原理、结构及特性；并以气动仿人体手臂协作机器人、气动软体机器人、气压驱动外骨骼等为实例，讲授在机器人领域中气动回路及控制的设计、计算机仿真方法。使学生较深入了解气动技术在机器人领域的专业知识、掌握系统分析及设计方法。通过本课程的课堂教学，结合实验操作环节，进行气动机器人领域所需的训练，着重培养学生气动机器人技术的综合分析与设计能力，以及应用基础理论知识及设计方法解决实际问题的能力，增强创新意识，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事机器人领域工作奠定基础。
default.en: Pneumatic technology plays an important role in the national economy, widely used in automatic production, robotics and various kinds of equipment. Pneumatic technology has been innovatively applied in the field of robotics due to its unique characteristics of flexibility and gas pressure isotropy. For example, pneumatic humanoid arm cooperative robot, various kinds of pneumatic soft robot and robot hand, pneumatic exoskeleton and so on. This course mainly teaches the basic theories of gas thermodynamic properties and gas flow related to pneumatic robot technology, the principle, structure and characteristics of air source generation ,air processing element, actuator element and control element. The design and computer simulation methods of pneumatic circuit and control in the field of robotics are also taught with examples of pneumatic humanoid arm cooperative , pneumatic soft robot and pneumatic exoskeleton. Enable students to have a deeper understanding of the professional knowledge of pneumatic technology in the field of robotics, and master the methods of system analysis and design. Through the classroom teaching of this course, combined with the experimental operation, the required training in the field of pneumatic robot is carried out, cultivate students' ability of comprehensive analysis and design of pneumatic robot technology, as well as their ability to solve practical problems with basic theoretical knowledge and design methods, and enhance their awareness of innovation. It lays the foundation for students to further study the relevant professional courses and engage in the field of robotics in the future.

default.zh: 本课程内容以一种微纳功能器件为典型对象，使学生掌握微纳功能器件的最新发展动态和相关的基本设计原理与制造方法；重点是了解一种典型微纳功能器件-微纳机器人的设计、制造、驱动、控制、集群以及应用等方面的相关知识，其次是了解一种典型的微纳微纳功能器件制造方法-微纳增材制造的先进设计理论、制造工艺、高端制造装备和功能材料等方面的关键技术，熟悉微纳功能器件在多个领域的应用案例，使学生充分掌握微纳功能器件的设计理念与制造方法，并激发学生面向国防安全、国民经济和民生健康等关键领域进行颠覆性创新的热情。
default.en: This course focuses on a type of micro/nano functional device. It enable students to grasp the latest development trends and related basic design principles and manufacturing methods of micro/nano functional devices; Firstly, to understand the design, manufacturing, driving, control and swarming of micro/nanorobots (a typical micro/nano functional device). Secondly, to understand the advanced design theory, manufacturing process, high-end manufacturing equipment, and key technologies of micro/nano additive manufacturing (a typical manufacturing method for micro/nano functional devices). Finally, to be familiar with the application cases of micro/nano functional devices in multiple fields. Enable students to fully grasp the design concepts and manufacturing methods of micro/nano functional devices. And ultimately stimulate students' enthusiasm for disruptive innovation in key areas such as national defense and security, national economy, and people's health.

default.zh: 《微流控技术及生物医学应用》是一门为机械工程、生物医学工程、化学化工等专业的本科生开设的一门选修课。课程的目的是介绍微流控技术及生物医学有关的交叉学科知识和微流控学科本身正在发展的前沿性知识，目的是提高学生的创新能力，开阔学生视野。课程内容包括：微流控技术概述，微流控技术流体力学基本理论，微流控芯片封装方法，微流控生物医学芯片，微流控生物医学应用等内容。课程共16学时，学分为1分，考核方法为在授课中提交大作业及期末提交报告。
default.en: Microfluidic technology and biomedical applications is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering, chemical engineering and so on. The aim of the course is to introduce the interdisciplinary knowledge related to microfluidic technology and biomedicine, as well as the cutting-edge knowledge being developed by the microfluidic discipline itself. The content of this course includes the introduction of microfluidic technology, the basic theory of microfluidic technology, microfluidic chip fluid mechanics, microfluidic biomedical chips, and microfluidic biomedical applications. The 16-hour course, with 1-point credit, will be assessed by submitting a major assignment during the course and a final report.

default.zh: 《智能装备控制与实践》是面向机械设计制造及其自动化专业本科生的一门综合实践类课程。以当前工业领域中新兴的以机器视觉技术、机器人控制技术为核心的智能装备为研究对象，讲授智能装备中的环境感知、任务决策以及动态执行等关键技术，通过综合实验实践，使学生掌握原理、锻炼实践能力，对培养致力于机械设计、制造及其自动化专业高素质人才具有深层意义。课程的主要目标包括： 1. 掌握智能装备中的软件系统开发基础，包括ROS系统、PLC系统的架构及基本编程方法，了解软硬件通信方法。 2.掌握智能装备中的机器视觉技术，了解无人自主设备的三维建图原理，掌握图像处理的基础算法、了解动态目标识别与跟踪方法，了解基于人工智能的图像处理技术的原理及发展趋势。 3.掌握伺服驱动系统的控制方法，能够运用闭环控制方法完成多轴协同运动控制。 4.通过实践培养学生对机电系统、控制系统、传感器以及计算机程序开发等知识的综合运用能力。
default.en: "Intelligent Equipment Control and Practice" is a comprehensive practical course for undergraduates majoring in mechanical design, manufacturing and automation.It takes the emerging intelligent equipment in the current industrial field with machine vision technology and robot control technology as the core as the research object, teaches the key technologies of environment perception, task decision-making and dynamic execution in intelligent equipment, and makes students master the principles and exercise their practical ability through comprehensive experimental practice. It has deep significance for cultivating high-quality talents committed to mechanical design, manufacturing and automation.The main objectives of the course include: 1. Grasp the foundation of software system development in intelligent equipment, including the architecture and basic programming methods of ROS system and PLC system, and understand the communication methods of software and hardware. 2. Grasp the machine vision technology in intelligent equipment, understand the principle of 3D mapping of unmanned autonomous equipment, grasp the basic algorithm of image processing, understand the dynamic target recognition and tracking method, and understand the principle and development trend of image processing technology based on artificial intelligence. 3. Grasp the control method of servo drive system, and be able to use closed-loop control method to complete multi-axis cooperative motion control. 4. Cultivate students' comprehensive application ability of electromechanical system, control system, sensor and computer program development through practice.

default.zh: 课程从系统观点出发，强调机电液系统设计的整体性、动态性、模型化与最优化四项设计原则，以系统集成优化为目标，以基于模型的设计为手段，以多学科软件工具链为支撑，系统介绍机电液系统及其典型元件的建模、动态特性分析与系统集成优化设计方法。课程内容主要包括电液系统动态分析与设计的基本概念、研究内容、方法与工具、建模、仿真和动态特性分析方法。课程介绍了机电液系统的典型环节的数学模型，包括伺服电机、内反馈式元件（溢流阀、恒压变量泵等）、力反馈两级伺服阀、液压动力机构，液压传动系统等。最后以一个工程实例演示机电液系统集成优化设计方法。
default.en: From the viewpoint of system, this course emphasizes the four design principles including integrity, dynamics, modeling and optimization of the mechanical and hydraulic system design, and takes system integration and optimization as objectives. With the aid of the model based design method, and the support of muti-discipline software tool chains, this course introduces the dynamic characteristics of typical components analysis and optimization design method of system integration of the mechanical and hydraulic system. In this course, the basic concept, research contents, study methods and tools are introduced for design and dynamic analysis of mechanical electrical and hydraulic systems. Then, the fundamental theoretical basics of mechanical electrical and hydraulic systems are briefly described. We take some typical elements of mechanical electrical and hydraulic systems, such as servo motors, self-feedback hydraulic components (relief valves and constant pressure variable displacement pumps ) , force-feedback two stage servo valves, hydraulic actuators and controllers etc. as examples, and demonstrated how to build mathematical models, and to simulate and analyze its dynamic performance. Finally, we use an engineering project to demonstrate the integrated design method of mechanical electrical and hydraulic systems.

default.zh: 机电产品设计过程涉及领域知识、数学原理和软件实现三个方面，单独讲述某个方面都不能表达设计方法的知识结构。机电产品设计过程是个复杂的创造性活动，包括需求描述、结构建模、仿真分析、优化等多个环节。本课程包括以图论为主的Sys ML、QFD系统建模方法、几何为主的CAD建模、以微分方程求解为代表的有限元仿真方法和ABAQUS应用，以规划模型为主的优化建模方法，每个环节都有专门的工具软件。本课从问题求解框架、数学模型和软件实现三个方面描述现代设计与仿真技术，使读者容易将工程问题、数学建模和软件应用结合起来
default.en: The design process of mechanical and electrical products involves three aspects: domain knowledge, mathematical principles, and software implementation. A single aspect cannot express the knowledge structure of the design method. The design process of electromechanical products is a complex and creative activity, which includes multiple stages such as requirement description, structural modeling, simulation analysis, optimization, etc. This course includes Sys ML, QFD system modeling methods based on graph theory, CAD modeling based on geometry, finite element simulation methods represented by differential equation solving, and ABAQUS applications, as well as optimization modeling methods based on planning models. Each link has specialized tool software. This lesson describes modern design and simulation techniques from three aspects: problem-solving framework, mathematical model, and software implementation, making it easy for readers to combine engineering problems, mathematical modeling, and software applications.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生在机器人辅助医学成像领域的跨学科综合能力，深度融合数学建模、机器学习、机器人技术和医学影像原理，使学生能够运用模型与数据驱动的方法解决医学成像中的复杂工程问题。通过理论学习与实践结合，强化学生在多学科团队协作、复杂问题分析、创新解决方案设计等方面的核心素养，同时注重社会责任、伦理意识与终身学习能力的培养。
default.en: This course aims to develop students' interdisciplinary comprehensive capabilities in the field of robot-assisted medical imaging. It deeply integrates mathematical modeling, machine learning, robotics, and medical imaging principles, enabling students to employ model- and data-driven approaches to solve complex engineering problems in medical imaging. Through the combination of theoretical learning and practical application, the course strengthens students' core competencies in multidisciplinary teamwork, complex problem analysis, and innovative solution design, while also emphasizing the cultivation of social responsibility, ethical awareness, and lifelong learning abilities.

default.zh: 本课程聚焦于人工智能技术在微纳尺度设计与制造中的前沿应用，旨在帮助学生理解如何利用机器学习、深度学习等AI方法对微纳加工、材料设计、工艺优化等环节进行赋能。课程将跨越微纳技术基础、智能算法原理及其在设计优化和制造过程中的实际应用，注重理论与实践相结合，培养学生跨学科解决实际工程问题的能力。
default.en: This course focuses on the cutting-edge application of artificial intelligence technology in micro-nanoscale design and manufacturing, aiming to help students understand how to use AI methods such as machine learning and deep learning to empower micro-nano processing, material design, process optimization and other links. The course will span the foundation of micro-nano technology, the principles of intelligent algorithms and their practical applications in design optimization and manufacturing processes, focusing on the combination of theory and practice, and cultivating students' ability to solve practical engineering problems across disciplines.

default.zh: 《AI智能足式重载机器人基础理论》课程以深度强化学习为核心驱动力，重构人工智能、液压伺服与机械电子系统的跨学科融合范式，聚焦高负载动态场景下的AI训练体系与工程化实践。课程突破传统液压控制框架，构建“深度强化学习训练-环境交互反馈-实时策略优化”的闭环架构，通过足式机器人多自由度协同训练、液压驱动非线性补偿模型训练及动态负载抗扰策略迭代等AI专项训练模块，攻克复杂地形步态自主生成、高精度力矩分配与冲击载荷自适应调节等核心难题。基于虚实融合的AI训练体系，学生将掌握深度强化学习奖励函数工程、神经网络控制器端到端训练、多模态感知数据驱动策略优化等关键技术，实现从仿真环境到物理系统的AI策略迁移与动态行为泛化。课程以AI训练赋能液压系统智能化升级为核心路径，强化动态扰动下的自主决策、非线性机电控制模型压缩部署及百公斤级负载实时优化能力，为智能足式重载机器人领域提供“算法-控制-执行”全栈式AI训练方法论与实践框架。
default.en: With deep reinforcement learning as the core driving force, the course " The Basic Theory of AI Intelligent Heavy-load Legged Robot" reconstructs the interdisciplinary integration paradigm of artificial intelligence, hydraulic servo and mechatronic systems, and focuses on AI training system and engineering practice in high-load dynamic scenarios. The course breaks through the traditional hydraulic control framework, builds a closed-loop architecture of "deep reinforcement learning training-environmental interactive feedback-real-time strategy optimization", and overcomes core problems such as autonomous gait generation of complex terrain, high-precision torque distribution and adaptive adjustment of shock load through AI special training modules such as multi-degree-of-freedom collaborative training of foot-type robots, training of hydraulically driven nonlinear compensation models and iteration of dynamic load anti-disturbance strategies. Based on the AI training system of virtual and real fusion, students will master key technologies such as deep reinforcement learning reward function engineering, end-to-end training of neural network controllers, and multimodal perception data-driven strategy optimization, so as to realize AI policy transfer and dynamic behavior generalization from simulated environments to physical systems. The course takes AI training to empower the intelligent upgrade of hydraulic system as the core path, strengthens the autonomous decision-making under dynamic disturbance, the compression and deployment of nonlinear electromechanical control models, and the real-time optimization ability of 100-kilogram loads, and provides a full-stack AI training methodology and practical framework of "algorithm-control-execution" for the field of Intelligent Heavy-load Legged Robots.

default.zh: 本门课程是机器人工程专业的选修课之一。人工智能是以机器为载体所展示出来的人类智能，因此以人工智能也被称为机器智能。对人类智能的模拟可以通过符号主义为核心的逻辑推理、以问题求解为核心的探询搜索、以数据驱动为核心的机器学习、以行为主义为核心的强化学习和博弈对抗为核心的决策智能等方法来实现。 本课程主要讲授人工智能的基本概念、基础算法以及在机器人感知、导航与操作方面主要应用实例，可帮助学习者掌握人工智能脉络体系，体会人工智能中的具能、使能和赋能，从算法层面对人工智能应用技术“知其意，悟其理，守其则，践其行”。课程内容包括如下：深度学习、强化学习、环境感知、智能导航、智能操作、人工智能未来发展和趋势。
default.en: This course is one of the electives for the major of Robotics Engineering. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is defined as the human-like intelligence exhibited by machines; hence it is also referred to as machine intelligence. The simulation of human intelligence can be achieved through various methodologies, including logic reasoning centered on symbolism, inquiry and search with a focus on problem-solving, data-driven machine learning, behaviorism-based reinforcement learning, and decision intelligence focusing on adversarial game theory. This course's primary focus is imparting fundamental concepts and core algorithms of artificial intelligence, and significant application examples in robotic perception, navigation, and manipulation. The course is designed to assist learners in mastering the framework of artificial intelligence, understanding its capabilities, enablement, and empowerment, and comprehending the underlying principles, reasoning, rules, and practical implementation of AI technologies from an algorithmic perspective. The course content includes the following topics: deep learning, reinforcement learning, environment perception, intelligent navigation, intelligent manipulation, and the future development and trends of artificial intelligence.

default.zh: 数字信号与图像处理是高等工科院校中机械电子工程专业一门主干课程，课程主要时间离散信号、时间离散信号处理系统(算法)和数字图像处理算法的基本概念，主要特性，使学生掌握基本设计理论和设计方法，着重培养学生数字信号处理系统的综合分析和设计能力，数字图像基本分析，处理能力增强创新意识。 课程数字信号处理部分主要包括离散时间信号和离散时间系统的典型特性，作用机制，实现方式和典型的数字信号处理系统分析，设计方法，包括傅里叶变换，z变换的收敛性和其它性质，数字滤波器的基本结构等。数字图像处理部分主要包括数字图像基础，空间域滤波和频域滤波方法。 本课程考试成绩采用累积式，包括期末笔试，实验报告1（数字信号处理部分）和实验报告2（数字图像处理部分）三部分。
default.en: Digital signal and image processing is mechanical and electronic engineering of Engineering Colleges in a professional course, the main course of time discrete signal and discrete time signal processing system (algorithm), digital image processing methods, the main characteristics of the basic concept, and make the students master the basic theory and design method, comprehensive analysis and design on cultivating the students' ability of digital signal processing system, enhancement innovation consciousness. The course’s digital signal processing part mainly includes the typical characteristics of discrete time signals and discrete time system mechanism, implementation method and typical digital signal processing system analysis, design method, including fast Fourier transform, convergence and other properties of the Z transform, structure of digital filters. In the digital image processing part, major contents include fundamental of image, spatial and frequency filters. The examination results in this course are cumulative, including the final examination, two experimental reports (about digital signal processing and digital image processing, respectively).

default.zh: 微操作与微尺度机器人在超精密制造、微机电系统、生物医学工程等领域具有广泛的应用。本门课程主要讲授微操作与微尺度机器人的基本理论和相关技术。主体讲授内容包括微操作与微尺度机器人的现状和发展趋势、微操作与微尺度机器人基础、微操作机器人精密定位技术、微操作机器人末端执行器、微机器人显微视觉技术、外场驱动微机器人等方面的基础理论和方法。此外，课程还将通过案例讲述微操作与微尺度机器人的应用及相关关键技术，培养学生应用上述知识分析和解决工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: Micromanipulation and microscale robots have extensive applications in ultra-precision manufacturing, micro-electromechanical systems, biomedical engineering, and other fields. This course mainly teaches the basic theories and related technologies of micromanipulation and microscale robots. The main teaching contents include the current situation and development trends of micromanipulation and microscale robots, fundamentals of microrobots, precision positioning technology of micromanipulation robots, end-effectors of micromanipulation robots, micro vision technology in microrobots, microrobots driven by external fields. In addition, the course will also introduce the application and related key technologies of micromanipulation and microscale robots through case studies, cultivating students' ability to apply the above knowledge to analyze and solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 本课程是智能装备与系统专业的机器人技术任选选修课程，是仿生机器人开发的重要基础，主要讲授仿生机器人的基础理论以及开发的方法。通过这门课程的学习将使学生从结构、运动、感知和控制几方面掌握基本的仿生原理和分析方法，学会分析研究仿生对象的特性，以便选择适当的仿生原型以及相应的算法解决实际问题。并初步整体认识几种典型的仿生机器人，掌握仿生基础理论在具体机器人研发过程当中的应用，为后续研究或工作奠定机器人研发过程中仿生方法应用的基础。
default.en: This course is an optional elective course in robotics for students majoring in intelligent equipment and systems, and it serves as an important foundation for the development of bionic robots. The course primarily focuses on the basic theories and development methods of bionic robots. By studying this course, students will grasp the fundamental bionic principles and analytical methods from the aspects of structure, movement, sensing, and control. They will learn to analyze and research the characteristics of bionic objects, enabling them to select appropriate bionic prototypes and corresponding algorithms to solve practical problems. Additionally, students will gain an initial overall understanding of several typical bionic robots and master the application of bionic basic theories in the specific process of robot development, laying a foundation for the application of bionic methods in robot development in their future research or work.

default.zh: 机器人交互技术课程面向机器人工程专业本科生开课，是一门重要的专业课。本课程是一门涉及人与计算机交互、人工智能、机器人、自然语言理解等的交叉学科，研究人与机器人之间通过输入输出设备进行有效交互的原理与方法。课程主要讲授常见的机器人交互设备和交互方法，重点使学生了解机器人交互的理论基础、研究热点及发展趋势，熟悉和掌握常见的机器人交互设计和实现方法，培养设计过程中运用人机交互知识的能力。 课程主要包括概论、感知和认知基础、常用的交互设备、交互技术、机器人交互仿真、人机物理交互安全、手柄、手套、语音、手势、体感与表情、机器人SLAM等交互技术的介绍。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末考试、小作业和大作业三部分。
default.en: Human–robot interaction (HRI) is an important course to the undergraduate in Robotics Engineering. It is a multidisciplinary field with contributions from human–computer interaction, artificial intelligence, robotics, natural language understanding and etc. This course discusses the principle and implementation of interactions between humans and robots through input and output devices. In this course, several commonly used devices and methods for human-robot interaction are introduced. After finishing this course, the students should understand the theoretical foundation, research focus and tendency, be familiar to the development method of commonly used HRI, master the ability of using HRI knowledge in practical projects. The contents of this course includes the development history of HRI, perceptual and cognitive foundations of HRI, commonly used HRI devices, interaction techniques, HRI simulation, human robot physical interaction, HRI based on joystick, glove, speech, gesture, kinect, emotion and SLAM and etc. The examination results are cumulative, including the final exam, regular assignments and projects.

default.zh: 本门课程是机器人工程专业的主干专业课之一。智能控制是自动控制发展的最高阶段，是人工智能、控制论、系统论、信息论、仿生学、神经生理学、进化计算和计算机等多种学科的高度集合的边缘交叉学科。本课程主要讲授模糊控制、神经网络控制和遗传算法控制等。通过本课程的学习，使学生熟悉智能控制的主要理论分支、数学基础、应用场合及发展趋势，进而掌握智能控制的基础理论及其在机器人系统中的应用方法。
default.en: This course is one of the main professional courses of robotics. Intelligent control is the highest stage of the development of automatic control. It is a highly integrated interdisciplinary discipline of artificial intelligence, cybernetics, systems theory, information theory, bionics, neurophysiology, evolutionary computing, computer and other disciplines. This course mainly teaches fuzzy control, neural network control and genetic algorithm control. Through the study of this course, students will be familiar with the main theoretical branches, mathematical basis, application occasions and development trends of intelligent control, and then master the basic theory of intelligent control and its application methods in robot systems.

default.zh: 《空间机器人》是机器人工程专业本科生的专业选修课之一，旨在帮助学生深入理解空间机器人在空间探测和在轨服务中的核心技术及其未来发展趋势。课程内容涵盖空间机器人的基本原理、关键技术和空间应用，重点讲解空间机器人系统设计、运动控制、力控制和仿真测试等方面的内容。 主要内容： 1.空间机器人概述：介绍空间机器人在航天领域的重要作用，阐述空间机器人系统的组成、工作原理及当前研究热点。分析空间机器人技术的发展历程，探索未来的技术发展方向和应用前景。 2.空间机器人运动学与动力学：讲解空间机器人在微重力环境中的运动学和动力学建模方法，为运动规划和控制提供理论基础。 3.空间机器人运动规划：研究空间机器人关节空间运动规划、笛卡尔空间运动规划，及冗余空间机器人避关节极限与奇异问题的处理方法，确保任务的顺利执行。 4.空间机器人运动控制：探讨空间机器人在执行任务过程中的运动控制策略，确保机器人精准、高效地完成任务。 5.空间机器人力控制：介绍空间机器人与外部环境交互时的力控制技术，特别是在操作任务中的力-位混合控制方法。 6.空间机器人系统：了解空间机器人机械系统、控制系统、感知系统和遥操作系统的组成与工作原理。 7.空间机器人系统仿真及测试：讲解空间机器人系统的仿真技术和实验测试方法，帮助学生掌握如何验证空间机器人性能。 8.大型空间机械臂设计：重点研究我国空间站大型机械臂的设计原理及其验证技术。 通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握空间机器人设计、运动控制、仿真测试等方面的核心技术，培养解决实际应用问题的能力。课程结合理论与实际案例，注重动手实践和创新思维的培养，为学生从事航天工程、空间机器人研发等相关领域的工作奠定坚实基础。 课程目标： 1.了解空间机器人在空间任务中的应用与发展趋势； 2.培养学生在空间机器人系统建模、运动规划、控制与仿真测试等方面的综合能力； 3.掌握空间机器人基础理论与设计方法。 适用对象： 本课程适合机器人工程专业的本科生，尤其适合对空间机器人技术感兴趣并希望从事相关领域研究与应用开发的学生。
default.en: "Space Robotics" is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in Robotics Engineering. The course aims to help students deeply understand the core technologies of space robotics in space exploration and on-orbit servicing, as well as its future development trends. The content of the course covers the basic principles, key technologies, and applications of space robotics, with a focus on system design, motion control, force control, and simulation/testing methods. Course Content: 1.Overview of Space Robotics: This section introduces the importance of space robotics in the aerospace field, describing the components, working principles, and current research hotspots of space robotic systems. It also analyzes the development history of space robotics technology and explores future technological trends and application prospects. 2.Kinematics and Dynamics of Space Robots: This part explains the kinematic and dynamic modeling methods of space robots in microgravity environments, providing the theoretical foundation for motion planning and control. 3.Motion Planning of Space Robots: This section studies joint-space motion planning, Cartesian-space motion planning, and methods for handling redundant space robots, joint limits, and singularity avoidance to ensure the smooth execution of tasks. 4.Motion Control of Space Robots: This section explores the motion control strategies of space robots during task execution, ensuring that robots can respond accurately and efficiently to mission requirements. 5.Force Control of Space Robots: This part introduces the force control techniques for space robots interacting with external environments, especially force-position hybrid control methods for operation tasks. 6.Space Robot Systems: Students will learn about the components and working principles of space robot mechanical systems, control systems, perception systems, and teleoperation systems. 7.Space Robot System Simulation and Testing: This section covers the simulation technologies and experimental testing methods for space robot systems, helping students understand how to validate the performance of space robots in practical applications. 8.Design of Large-Scale Space Manipulators: This part focuses on the design principles and verification technologies of large-scale space manipulators used in the Chinese Space Station. 9.Through this course, students will master core technologies in space robot design, motion control, and system simulation/testing. The course combines theoretical instruction with practical case studies, emphasizing hands-on practice and the development of innovative thinking, thus providing a solid foundation for students to pursue careers in aerospace engineering, space robotics research, and related fields. Course Objectives: 1.Understand the applications and development trends of space robotics in space missions. 2.Develop comprehensive abilities in space robot system modeling, motion planning, control, and simulation/testing. 3.Master the basic theories and design methods of space robotics. Target Audience: This course is suitable for undergraduate students majoring in Robotics Engineering, particularly those interested in space robotics technology and wishing to pursue research and application development in this field.

default.zh: 医疗机器人是机械电子工程专业学生非常重要的专业选修课，为学生扩展专业课如机器人学基础；传感器技术基础；机器人运动控制技术等课程提供良好的途径，在培养学生机器人系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要讲授医疗机器人系统的结构、关键技术和开发设计方法，使学生较深入地了解医疗机器人的基本概念和设计分析方法。通过本课程的课堂教学和课后作业等环节，着重培养学生们对于医疗机器人系统的综合分析与设计能力，以及医疗机器人系统科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 课程主要包括8部分内容：医疗机器人的特点与发展现状、术中传感器与配准、增强现实、医疗机器人设计、基于视觉的控制、交互模型及力觉控制、远程操作、面向体内的机器人。 课程最后成绩采用累加式，综合考虑作业成绩和课程报告成绩等。
default.en: Medical robotics is an important elective course for students majoring in mechanical and electronic engineering. It provides a good opportunity for students to broaden their knowledge in areas such as the fundamentals of robotics, sensor technology, and robot motion control. It plays a significant role in developing students’ comprehensive analysis and design abilities in the field of robotic systems, particularly in the context of medical applications. This course primarily focuses on the structure, key technologies, and development/design methods of medical robotic systems. It aims to deepen students’ understanding of the basic concepts and analytical approaches involved in medical robotics. Through classroom teaching and assignments, the course aims to cultivate students’ ability to comprehensively analyze and design medical robotic systems, apply scientific knowledge to medical robotics, foster innovation, and achieve corresponding learning outcomes. The course consists of 8 main parts: characteristics and development status of medical robotics, intraoperative sensors and registration, augmented reality, medical robot design, vision-based control, interaction modeling and force control, teleoperation, and intra-body robotics. The final grade for the course is cumulative, taking into consideration assignment scores, course reports, and other factors.

default.zh: 本课程是机器人工程专业的选修课之一。本课程以生机电一体化智能假肢为主要对象，讲授生机电一体化系统机构、传感、驱动和控制的设计与集成，肌电和脑电等生物信号的产生机理、获取和运动解码方法，电刺激和振动方式的感知反馈通道建立及双向生机接口集成，生机电一体化假手的交互控制。通过本课程的学习, 使学生掌握生机电一体化机器人的基本原理和设计方法，初步具备生机电一体化装置及生机接口的设计能力。
default.en: This course is one of the electives for undergraduates majoring in Robotic Engineering. Focusing on the biomechatronic intelligent prosthetic hand, the course will discuss: 1) the design of typical biomechatronic system and integration techniques of its mechanism, sensors, actuation, and control system; 2) neurophysiological background, measurement, and motion decoding method based on the biomedical signals, such as electromyography (EMG) and electroencephalography(EEG); 3) sensory feedback by means of transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulus (TENS) and vibrotactile, and physical integration of the bilateral human-machine interface; and 4) interactive control strategies of the prosthetic hand with human-in-the-loop. After this course, the students are expected to acquire some basic knowledge about biomechatronic robot, as well as a primary capability of designing typical biomechatronic device and bio-machine interface.

default.zh: 本课程讲授嵌入式计算机系统的基本概念和原理，着重于嵌入式系统在机器人系统的应用。课程的第一部分将涵盖嵌入式计算机体系结构、嵌入式计算机指令系统以及嵌入式系统外设等内容。通过比较新兴的RISCV架构和成熟的ARM架构，本课程将着重介绍嵌入式系统的共性特征。本课程的第二部分是嵌入式操作系统和嵌入式软件开发相关内容。其中包括嵌入式Linux的系统管理、项目管理、软件开发及调试等内容。另外，本部分还将介绍在机器人控制器中广泛应用的实时操作系统和实时以太网等技术。
default.en: This course provides an introduction to embedded computer system with an emphasis on its application to robotics. The first part will cover embedded computer architecture, embedded computer instructions and essential peripherals of embedded system. By comparing two computer architectures, namely the new emerging RISCV architecture and the more mature ARM Cortex-M architecture, common features of embedded systems are provided. The second part of this course is about embedded operating system and embedded software development, which will focus on system administration, project management, programming & debugging on embedded Linux. Moreover real-time operating system and real-time Ethernet, which are essential for robotic controllers based on embedded systems, are introduced.

default.zh: 与传统的串联型机器人相比，并联机器人在诸多方面具有绝对优势。本门课程主要讲授并联机器人的基本理论和相关技术主要内容。主要系统地讲述并联机器人系统的现状和发展趋势，并联机器人系统的体系结构、并联机器人的本体设计、并联机器人运动学、并联机器人静力学和动力学、并联机器人奇异性分析和性能优化等方面的基础理论和方法，精要讲述并联机器人的应用及相关关键技术，培养学生应用上述知识分析和解决工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: Parallel robots prevail against serial robots on some specific requirements. The course focuses on the basic principle and technology of parallel robots. The course mainly introduces the state-of-the-art and the development trend of parallel robots, and systematically discusses many important issues of parallel robots, e.g. the architecture of robot systems, mechanical design, kinematics, statics and dynamics modeling, singularity and performance analysis etc. The course also connects with engineering practices and involves with the applications and key technical points of parallel robots. The purpose of this course is to help the undergraduate students to learn the skills of applying knowledge mentioned above to analyze and solve the problems in the engineering practice.

default.zh: 本门课程主要讲授特种移动机器人的基本理论和相关技术。主体讲授内容包括特种移动机器人的现状和发展趋势，特种移动机器人的移动机构和运动学建模、基于机器学习的地面类型在线辨识方法、特种移动机器人越障动作规划及稳定性分析、移动机械臂轨迹规划技术、特种机器人同步定位及地图构建（SLAM）和基于ROS的导航和机械臂动作规划等方面的基础理论和方法。此外，课程还将精要讲述特种移动机器人的应用及相关关键技术，培养学生应用上述知识分析和解决工程实际问题的能力。 课程主要包括：特种移动机器人运动模式及运动学建模；地面物理参数在线辨识方法、移动机器人牵引力估计等基于地面力学的行驶动力学建模；地面几何参数获取、越障动作规划和越障稳定性分析等自主越障控制方法；移动机械臂设计方法和移动机械臂轨迹规划；机器人定位、环境建模等机器人室外SLAM技术；基于ROS的机器人搭建及基于Matlab的仿真。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课上小作业1份、结课后大作业1份和结课报告1份三部分。
default.en: This course aims to impart the basic theories and related advanced technologies of the specialized mobile robots to students. Theoretical contents covered by this course are as follows: Current status and development trend of the specialized mobile robots; Mobile mechanism of the specialized mobile robots; Kinematics and dynamics modeling of the specialized mobile robots; Trajectory planning theory, motion planning on obstacle-crossing problems and corresponding stability analysis of the specialized mobile robot; Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) techniques for mobile robot. While technical contents of this course including: Online identification method of ground physical parameters; Dynamic modeling based on terramechanics such as traction estimation of mobile robot; Autonomous obstacle-crossing control methods such as ground geometry parameter acquisition, obstacle-crossing action planning and obstacle-crossing stability analysis; Design and trajectory planning method for mobile manipulator; Outdoor SLAM technology for robots such as robot positioning and environment modeling; ROS - based robot construction and Matlab - based simulation. This course also focuses on associating these key technologies with practical application on specialized mobile robots to cultivate students' ability of applying the above knowledge to analyze and solve engineering problems. Examination results of this course are cumulative, which contains three parts: 1 small assignment, 1 large assignment after completion, and 1 final report.

default.zh: 工业机器人是现代制造业重要的自动化装备，是制造业实现智能化和信息化的重要载体，工业机器人及以其为主体的自动化成套设备也是提升制造业发展质量和竞争力的重要途径。工业机器人设计与应用是智能装备与系统专业学生重要的专业核心课，是基于机械设计、机器人学基础及机器人机构学等基础课的机电系统专业综合课程，在培养学生工业机器人综合分析、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位，为我国走新型工业化道路和建设创新型国家提供坚实的人才支撑和智力保证。 本课程主要讲授内容包括8部分：1、绪论；2、机器人运动学和动力学；3、工业机器人机械设计及性能测试；4、工业机器人驱动与控制；5、机器人机构及驱动系统优化；6、机器人编程及操作；7、典型工业机器人系统应用；8、工业机器人智能应用技术;9、工业机器人系统集成。课程在介绍机器人学的基本理论基础之上，使学生对工业机器人的基本概念、分类、结构特点、控制技术、编程技术及系统集成设计技术进行学习，同时结合实际的工程应用实例，掌握工业机器人的设计思路、操作方法、系统集成、现场应用及维护技术等技术。通过本课程的课堂教学，着重培养学生们工业机器人的综合分析与设计能力，以及机电系统科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Industrial robot is one of important automation equipments in modern manufacture, and important platform of realizing intelligent and information, for manufacture. The automation equipment with industrial robot is an important way to promote the quality and competitiveness of manufacture. < > is one of the elementary courses of intelligent equipment and system, which is the core mechatronics engineering based on machine design, robotics and robot mechanism. This course plays an important role in training the industrial robot comprehensive analysis and design ability for students, providing strong support of talents and intelligence for building a new-industrialized and innovation-oriented country in China. This course mainly includes eight parts: 1. Introduction; 2. Robot kinematics and dynamics; 3. industrial robot mechanical design and performance testing; 4. industrial robot drive and control; 5. robot mechanism and drive system optimization; 6. Robot programming and operation; 7. typical industrial robot system application; 8. industrial robot intelligent application technology; 9 . Industrial robot system integration. Based on the introduction of the basic theory of robotics, the course enables students to learn the basic concepts, classification, structural characteristics, control technology, programming technology and system integration design technology of industrial robots. At the same time, combined with practical engineering application examples, they can master the design ideas, operation methods, system integration, field application and maintenance technology of industrial robots. Through the classroom teaching of this course, it focuses on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design ability of industrial robots, as well as their application ability of mechanical and electrical system scientific knowledge, increasing their awareness of innovation, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授机器人共融交互的概念和设计理念，介绍机器人共融交互技术的发展历史，给出了机器人共融交互技术面临的挑战；介绍了机器人传感器基本原理和技术，实现机器人共融交互技术的基础；详细阐述了机器人与人、机器人与机器人、机器人与环境之间的交互方法；并以实例的方式介绍了机器人不同应用领域的交互技术实现。通过本门课程的学习, 使学生基本理解和运用机器人共融交互技术方法，使学生基本具备机器人共融交互系统设计能力。
default.en: This course mainly teaches the concept and design philosophy of robot fusion interaction, introduces the development history of robot fusion interaction technology, and presents the challenges faced by robot fusion interaction technology; Introduced the basic principles and technologies of robot sensors, and laid the foundation for implementing robot fusion and interaction technology; Elaborated in detail the interaction methods between robots and humans, robots and robots, and robots and the environment; And introduced the implementation of interactive technology in different application fields of robots through examples. Through the study of this course, students will have a basic understanding and application of robot inclusive interaction technology methods, and will have the basic ability to design robot inclusive interaction systems.

default.zh: 空间机械臂在空间站建造和营运、飞行器在轨维护、月球与深空探测、小天体采样返回等航天任务中发挥着重要作用，可完成对接、停泊、加油、维修、升级、救援和碎片清除等操作，是当今世界高新技术水平的集中展示，也是衡量一个国家综合国力的重要标志。 面向战略性新兴领域“十四五”高等教育教材体系建设以及新时代杰出人才培养需求，本课程紧密结合国内外相关领域的研究现状和发展趋势，以课题组在研究工作中取得的成果和经验为基础，充分发挥“大师+团队”科研优势，全面、系统地阐述空间机械臂的研究热点、难点问题，具有很强的理论性、实用性和时效性。 本课程主要内容包含：空间机械臂发展概述、空间机械臂运动学与动力学建模、空间机械臂系统组成、空间机械臂智能操控、空间环境适应性以及微重力模拟系统。课程在介绍机器人学的理论基础上，使学生对空间机械臂的基本概念、结构特点、系统组成、控制技术、环境适应性以及地面测试方法进行学习，同时以问天舱机械臂为例，结合实际的在轨操控经验，掌握空间机械臂的设计思路、系统集成及智能操控技术。通过本课程的学习，着重培养学生们机电系统科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Space manipulator plays an important role in various space missions such as space station construction and operation, spacecraft on-orbit service, lunar and deep space exploration, and extra-terrestrial sample collection. They are capable for tasks like docking, berthing, refueling, maintenance, upgrading, rescuing, and active removing. These tasks could represent a concentration of the world's space technology and are an important indicator of a country's overall national strength. This course closely integrates the current research status and development trends of space manipulator. Based on the achievements and experiences from the research team, this course takes advantage of the "Master + Team" model to comprehensively and systematically elaborate on the research developments and challenges of space manipulator. The main content of the course includes: development of space manipulator, kinematic and dynamic modeling, system composition, intelligent control, space environment adaptability, and microgravity simulation systems. While introducing the theory of robotics, the course allows students to study the basic concepts, structural characteristics, system composition, control technologies, environmental adaptability, and ground testing methods. Taking the Wentian's robotic arm as example, students could master the design concepts, system integration and intelligent control techniques of space manipulator. By the class education, the comprehensive space manipulator analysis and design ability can be developed, so as the application ability of mechatronics system knowledge and innovation consciousness, which will support the corresponding indicators of profession studying achievement.

default.zh: 特种能场主要指电、磁、声、光、热、流等特殊能量源，特别适用于切削加工难以胜任的高硬度、高强度、高熔点、高韧性、高脆性等特殊材料、特殊结构以及复杂形状零部件的精密加工，因其独特的技术优势在现代制造领域占据着不可替代的重要地位，发挥着越来越重要的作用。《特种能场制造》主要讲授特种能场制造的基本概念、加工工艺及加工设备等，包括电火花加工、电火花线切割加工、电解加工、激光加工、超声加工、电子束加工、离子束加工、水射流加工、磁性磨料研磨加工、增材制造等技术；介绍特殊、复杂、典型难加工零件的特种能场制造方法；探讨特种能场制造中所体现的创新思维方法。 对于机械类学生来说，特种加工的相关知识是必不可少的，该课程可拓宽机械类学生专业知识面，培养学生辩证思维能力及创新意识。
default.en: The course “Non-Traditional Machining Technologies” synthetically utilizes the knowledge and skills mastered in pre-completed courses, and is simultaneously combined with the innovative practice section during the teaching process. The aim of this course is to extend the comprehensive skills and qualities of mechanical engineering technicians. This course mainly involves the basic concepts, processing technics, processing equipment and other related aspects of non-traditional machining technologies, including: basic principles and laws of Electrical discharge machining (EDM); processing equipment and technics of EDM; principles and characteristics of Wire-electrical discharge machining (WEDM) and factors affecting the technical indexes of WEDM; processing technics and applications of WEDM; processing technics and applications of Electrochemical machining (ECM), Electroforming, Plating and Composite plating; basic principles and applications of Laser beam machining (LBM), Ultrasonic machining (USM), Plasma machining (PM), Water jet machining (WJM) and Magnetic abrasive machining (MAM); non-traditional machining methods for special, complex and typical difficult-to-process components; discussions on the innovative thinking methods involved in the non-traditional machining technologies. This is a major elective course that can broaden students’ knowledge of mechanical design, manufacturing and automation, and it also can cultivate the dialectical thinking ability and innovation consciousness of students.

default.zh: 精密和超精密加工是机械制造中的重要领域，对尖端技术和国防工业的发展具有重要影响。本课程作为学习现代精密和超精密加工技术的基础课和入门课，是高等工科院校中机械设计制造及其自动化专业的重要专业课，不仅可以拓宽本专业学生的知识面，而且培养学生对所学知识的综合运用能力，有利于培养高素质创新人才。 本课程主要讲述超精密切削与金刚石刀具技术、精密和超精密磨削方法、精密和超精密加工机床、超精密测量与误差补偿技术、研磨与抛光技术、微细加工技术、纳米技术、精密和超精密加工的外部支撑环境等内容，并进行常见超精密加工工艺的演示实验。通过本课程学习，培养学生对精密与超精密制造及相关科学知识的综合运用能力，培养解决机械工程实际问题的能力和辩证思维方法，使学生逐步具备在相关技术领域从事精密和超精密加工工作和研究的能力。
default.en: Precision and Ultra-precision machining technologies are quite crucial in the field of mechanical manufacturing engineering, which have significant influences on the cutting-edge technologies and defense industries. This course can be considered as a foundation or an introduction study to the modern precision and Ultra-precision machining technologies, which is especially the important professional course for the major of mechanical design, manufacture and automation in different higher education colleges of engineering. After the students in relation to the mechanical design, manufacture and automation major study this course, they can broaden their knowledge. Moreover, they also can bring up the comprehensive capability to solve any precision and ultra-precision manufacture engineering problems by using the mastered knowledge. In a word, this course is beneficial to develop the innovative talents with high qualities. In general, the contents of this course include the precision and ultra-precision cutting technologies, fabrication technologies in relation to diamond cutting tools, precision and ultra-precision grinding technologies, precision and ultra-precision machine related technologies, ultra-precision measurement and error compensation technologies, lapping and polishing technologies, micro-scale machining technologies, nanotechnoloies, external supporting environment enabling the successive implement of precision and ultra-precision machining, and etc. After studying this course, the students can bring up the comprehensive capability to use the mastered knowledge in relation to the mechanical design, manufacture and automation, or other scientific knowledge. The trained students also can develop the dialectical way of thinking and necessary ability to solve the actual problems in relation to the mechanical engineering. As a result, the students can gradually possess the professional certificate to work or do researching in the field of precision and ultra-precision machining, or other related field.

default.zh: 微结构功能表面是20世纪80年代发展起来的新兴多学科交叉研究领域，经过近40年的快速发展，已经成为机械工程领域的一个重要学科。由于独特、优异的功能属性，微结构功能表面一直是国内外众多学科领域的研究热点。面向微结构功能表面的制造是采用特定的加工方法在物体表面制造出不同形貌、不同尺 度、不同维数的功能结构。相比于传统光滑表面，微结构功能表面因其特殊的几何特征而具有强化传热、 强化出光、减阻耐磨、抗菌、脱附等多种功能。微结构功能表面种类繁多，形貌、尺寸各不相同。按其功能用途，可分为表面热功能结构、表面光功能结构、表面反应功能结构、表面减阻、脱附功能结构等。 目前表面功能结构已在各个领域得到广泛应用，成为金属冶炼、石油加工、电力生产等传统高能耗产业提高能源使用效率、实现节能减排的有效手段；是航天、高铁、3C(计算机、通讯和消费电子产品)等领域提高产品性能和保证系统安全的关键；也是促进生物产业、新兴信息产业、新能源汽车等国家战略性新兴产业发展，提升我国自主创新能力和国际竞争力的突破口。 《微结构功能表面的制造及应用》课程是一门拓宽学生相关专业知识面，培养学生辩证思维能力及创新意识的专业选修课，是针对工程学科学生的一门重要的个性化专业课。学生通过本课程关于微结构功能表面的概念和范围、典型微结构功能表面的制造理论和技术特征、典型微结构功能表面的应用等方面的学习，掌握微结构功能表面的制造及应用方面的基本原理，开拓学生的视野和知识范围，锻炼学生的科研思维，提升学生分析复杂工程问题的能力。并通过实验演示，加深对典型微结构功能表面相关制造及应用理论知识的理解，提升理论与工程实践结合能力。
default.en: Microstructured functional surface is a new interdisciplinary research field developed in the 1980s. After nearly 40 years of rapid development, it has become an important subject in the field of mechanical engineering. Because of its unique and excellent functional properties, microstructured functional surfaces have been the focus of research in many fields at home and abroad. The fabrication of microstructured functional surfaces is to use specific processing methods to produce functional structures with different morphologies, different scales and different dimensions on the surface of objects. Compared with the traditional smooth surface, the microstructured functional surface has many functions such as enhanced heat transfer, enhanced light production, resistance and wear reduction, antibacterial and desorption due to its special geometric characteristics. There are many kinds of functional surfaces with different shapes and sizes. According to its functional use, it can be divided into surface thermal functional structure, surface light functional structure, surface reaction functional structure, surface drag reduction, desorption functional structure and so on. At present, the microstructured functional surface has been widely used in various fields, and has become an effective means to improve energy efficiency and achieve energy saving and emission reduction in traditional high-energy consumption industries such as metal smelting, petroleum processing and power production. It is the key to improve product performance and ensure system safety in aerospace, high-speed rail, 3C(computer, communication and consumer electronics) and other fields; It is also a breakthrough to promote the development of national strategic emerging industries such as biological industry, emerging information industry, and new energy vehicles, and to enhance China's independent innovation capability and international competitiveness. The course 《Fabrication and Application of Microstructured Functional Surfaces》is a professional elective course that broadens students' relevant professional knowledge, cultivates students' dialectical thinking ability and innovative consciousness, and is an important personalized professional course for engineering students. Through learning the concept and scope of microstructured functional surfaces, manufacturing theories and technical characteristics of the typical microstructured functional surfaces, and application of typical the microstructured functional surfaces, students could master the basic principles of manufacturing and application of microstructured functional surfaces, broaden their horizons and scope of knowledge, and exercise their scientific research thinking. Enhance students' ability to analyze complex engineering problems. And through the experimental demonstration, deepen the understanding of the typical micro-structure functional surface related manufacturing and application theoretical knowledge, improve the ability of combining theory with engineering practice.

default.zh: 试验设计方法是自然科学研究方法论领域中一个分支学科，它是一项通用技术，是用科学的方法去安排试验，处理试验结果，以最少的人力和物力消耗，在最短的时间内取得更多、更好的生产和科研成果的技术方法。开设该课程的目的是使学生掌握当前最常用、最有效的几种试验设计方法的基本原理及其在制造领域中应用，使学生认识到正确设计试验方案及科学的统计分析是每位科研工作者必须具备的基本功，增强学生应用现代科学技术分析问题、解决问题的能力，进一步培养学生创新能力。 课程主要内容包括正交设计法、因子设计法、三次设计、稳定性设计、响应曲面试验设计及应用分析软件在数据分析中的应用等。着重介绍方法的原理、应用范围、优缺点以及如何将这些方法应用到科研和生产实际中，如何运用优化试验设计方法设计解决科研和生产实际问题的试验方案、如何设置试验参数，如何分析试验数据、如何估计试验误差、如何对试验的结果进行评价等。
default.en: Experimental design and optimization methods are a branch discipline in the field of natural science research methodology. It is a universal technique that uses scientific methods to arrange experiments, process experimental results, and achieve more and better production and research results in the shortest possible time with minimal human and material resources consumption. The purpose of offering this course is to enable students to master the basic principles of the most commonly used and effective experimental design methods and their applications in the manufacturing field. This will enable students to recognize that designing experimental plans correctly and conducting scientific statistical analysis are fundamental skills that every scientific researcher must possess, enhance their ability to apply modern science and technology to analyze and solve problems, and further cultivate their innovative abilities. The main content of the course includes orthogonal design, analysis of variance, stability design, response surface experimental design, and the application of analysis software in data analysis. Emphasis is placed on introducing the principles, application scope, advantages and disadvantages of the methods, as well as how to apply these methods to scientific research and production practice, how to use optimized experimental design methods to design experimental plans to solve scientific research and production problems, how to set experimental parameters, how to analyze experimental data, how to estimate experimental errors, and how to evaluate experimental results.

default.zh: 了解智能数控技术现状及其发展方向，掌握智能机床轨迹控制原理，开放式数控系统的构成及实现方法，结合科研项目以实例介绍智能数控加工的基本原理和实现途径，高级程序编制方法，多轴联动系统及高速高精系统结构的分析、设计及使用方法。为学生从事智能机电控制系统和现代先进制造技术工作打下基础。基本要求： 1、使学生树立现代制造技术的机电结合、多学科融合的综合系统分析，系统设计、制造和使用能力。 2、了解智能数控机床发展的新理论、新技术和最新发展趋势。 3、具有数控加工高级程序的编制、分析和调试能力。掌握数控编程中的数学处理方法。
default.en: This course introduce the current status and development direction of intelligent CNC technology, master the principle of intelligent machine tool trajectory control, the composition and implementation methods of open CNC systems, and introduce the basic principles and implementation methods of intelligent CNC machining through scientific research projects, advanced programming methods, analysis, design, and usage methods of multi axis linkage systems and high-speed high-precision system structures. To lay a foundation for students to engage in intelligent electromechanical control systems and modern advanced manufacturing technology work. Basic requirements: 1. To enable students to develop comprehensive system analysis, system design, manufacturing, and usage abilities in the integration of modern manufacturing technology with mechatronics and multiple disciplines. 2. To understand the new theories, technologies, and trends in the development of intelligent CNC machine tools. 3. Be capable of programming, analyzing, and debugging advanced CNC machining programs. Master the mathematical processing methods in CNC programming.

default.zh: 智能制造装备创新设计是智能制造工程专业和机械设计制造及其自动化专业本科生的一门专业课。本课程围绕智能制造装备发展的新理念、新进展、新结构和新方法，同时坚持以实用为主线、理论与实际相结合的原则，主要讲授数控机床、工业机器人、增材制造装备、生产线等为代表的现代制造装备设计的基本理论与方法、基础知识和核心技术。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握现代制造装备的知识体系和核心技术，理解现代制造装备的数字化、网络化、智能化发展路径和技术方法，具有针对复杂工程问题开展现代制造装备的设计规划、研究分析、模拟仿真或实践应用的能力。课程内容主要包括：现代制造装备的内涵及其关键问题；现代制造装备基础技术，包括感知、控制、驱动和执行。数控机床设计，包括总体设计、主传动与主轴系统设计、进给传动系统设计、本体和导轨设计、电气控制与数控系统、精度和测量、动态性能分析与热性能设计，以及数控机床的数字孪生和智能化等。工业机器人设计，包括运动功能设计、驱动与传动系统设计、机械结构设计等。机械加工生产线总体设计，包括工艺方案与总体布局设计、生产线的系统集成、智能制生产线等。增材制造装备，包括增材制造工艺原理和增材制造装备的关键部件等。
default.en: Innovative design of intelligent manufacturing equipment is one of the core courses for undergraduates majoring in intelligent manufacturing engineering and mechanical design, manufacturing and automation. This course focuses on the new concept, new progress, new structure and new method of the development of intelligent manufacturing equipment, while adhering to the principle of practical as the main line, combining theory with practice, mainly introduces the basic theory and method, basic knowledge and core technology of intelligent manufacturing equipment design represented by CNC machine tools, industrial robots, additive manufacturing equipment, production line, etc. Through the study of this course, students will master the knowledge system and core technology of intelligent manufacturing equipment, understand the development path and technical methods of digitization, networking and intelligence of intelligent manufacturing equipment, and have the ability to carry out the design planning, research and analysis, simulation or practical application of intelligent manufacturing equipment for complex engineering problems. The course content mainly includes: the connotation of intelligent manufacturing equipment and its key problems, the basic technology of intelligent manufacturing equipment, including perception, control, drive and execution. CNC machine tool design, including the overall design, main drive and spindle system design, feed transmission system design, body and guide rail design, electrical control and numerical control system, precision and measurement, dynamic performance analysis and thermal performance design, as well as digital twinning and intelligence of CNC machine tools. Industrial robot design, including motion function design, drive and transmission system design, mechanical structure design, etc. Overall design of machining production line, including process scheme and overall layout design, system integration of production line, intelligent production line, etc. Additive manufacturing equipment, including the principle of additive manufacturing process and the key components of additive manufacturing equipment, etc.

default.zh: 本课程是机械制造及其自动化方向的专业限选课。本课程将系统的介绍机器人技术的九个重要组成部分的基础知识，将综合运用所学数学、力学、电子、机械、计算机等多种学科知识，分析解决机器人学中的主要问题。培养学生从事多学科交叉渗透、综合运用的科学研究能力。
default.en: This course is a professional elective course in the field of mechanical manufacturing and automation. This course will systematically introduce the basic knowledge of the nine important components of robotics technology, and comprehensively apply the knowledge of various disciplines such as mathematics, mechanics, electronics, machinery, and computer science to analyze and solve the main problems in robotics. Cultivate students' scientific research abilities that involve interdisciplinary integration and comprehensive application.

default.zh: 以智能机床、智能刀具、智能工艺为特征的智能加工技术已经成为当前的研究热点，机械类本科生在大学阶段需要了解智能加工装备的特点、组成以及最新的技术特征，为从事装备制造业相关的技术工作和开展创新性技术研究奠定基础。本课程将介绍智能加工的概念、智能加工装备与技术的国际最新研究进展；讲述智能加工机床的特点、体系结构、切削机器人的最新发展现状；讲述智能加工刀具的设计、分析、制造及应用；讲述智能加工技术基础，包括智能加工自动化、复合化，智能加工的CAD/CAM，智能加工的感知与判断，智能加工的自适应控制，智能加工的工艺规划。最后，讲述典型智能加工装备与技术的工程应用案例。本课程将使学生开阔视野、了解智能加工装备及其关键技术，具备智能加工装备的设计能力、关键部件的分析能力以及系统性能的评价能力。
default.en: Intelligent machining technology characterized by intelligent machine tools, intelligent cutting tools and intelligent processing technology has become the hotspot of current research. The undergraduate students in Mechanical Engineering need to understand the characteristics, composition and most advanced technical characteristics of intelligent machining equipment. So they can lay the groundwork for engaging in technical work related to the equipment manufacturing industry and conducting innovative technical research. This course will introduce the concept of intelligent machining, the latest international research progress of intelligent machining equipment and technology. The characteristics of intelligent machine tools, architecture, the latest development status of the cutting robot; the design, analysis, manufacture and application of intelligent machining tools can also be included in the course. The basis of intelligent processing technology, including intelligent processing automation and composite, intelligent CAD/CAM processing, intelligent processing of perception, judgment, adaptive control and the process planning are involved in the course. Finally, the course will introduce the typical intelligent machining equipment and technology engineering applications. This course can broaden students’ horizons and improve the capability of mastering intelligent machining equipment and its key technology. With the intelligent machining equipment design capabilities, the key components analysis capacities and system performance evaluation capabilities can also be improved in this course.

default.zh: 本课程是机电类专业独具特色的专业选修课，课程内容涵盖智能控制系统中用到的各种接口技术，重点培养学生在计算机接口应用方面的基本知识和实际技能，掌握计算机接口的基础理论知识及其在机械智能控制领域的应用专门知识；了解计算机接口技术及智能控制系统应用领域的技术现状和发展趋势，形成综合运用所学知识建立接口技术应用的能力。在讲授智能控制接口技术的基本概念和理论时，尽量做到与具体应用实例相结合，重点突出教学内容的实用性，强调对学生实践能力和技术能力的培养。通过该课程的学习将培养学生应用智能控制接口技术进行科研、应用系统开发以及创新研究等方面的技术能力，为培养有创新思维的应用型、复合型高层次工程技术人才打下基础。
default.en: This course is a unique elective course for mechanical and electrical majors, covering various interface technologies used in intelligent control systems. The focus is on cultivating students' basic knowledge and practical skills in computer interface applications, mastering the basic theoretical knowledge of computer interfaces, and their specialized knowledge in the field of mechanical intelligent control; Understand the current status and development trends of computer interface technology and intelligent control system applications, and develop the ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge learned to establish interface technology applications. When teaching the basic concepts and theories of intelligent control interface technology, try to combine them with specific application examples, emphasize the practicality of teaching content, and emphasize the cultivation of students' practical and technical abilities. The study of this course will cultivate students' technical abilities in applying intelligent control interface technology for scientific research, application system development, and innovative research, laying a foundation for cultivating applied and composite high-level engineering and technical talents with innovative thinking.

default.zh: 本课程是机电工程学院智能制造工程专业本科学生的选修课。通过本课程及其相关实验使学生了解可编程逻辑控制器和工业控制网络的基本知识，掌握基于组态软件和可编程逻辑控制器的工业控制网络基本组建和编程方法，具备构建基于工业控制网络的典型机床监控系统的能力，为后续毕业设计和未来工作打下良好基础。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in Intelligent Manufacturing Engineering at the School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering. This course mainly contains the Configuration Software design and PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) programming method. Through the course and its associated experiments, students will master the skill of machine tool monitoring system design based on industrial control network . In addition, this course will be useful and essential for future graduation design program and working career.

default.zh: 通过该课程学习掌握汽车的外力特性，掌握汽车主要技术性能指标和评价方法以及汽车部件的结构形式和参数对汽车性能的影响，从而实现控制汽车性能的目标。培养学生运用所学知识从事汽车相关设计和研究的能力，为后续专业课程的学习和将来从事与汽车相关的工作打下必要的理论基础。课程讲授的内容是与汽车动力学有关的汽车各主要使用性能，包括汽车的动力性指标、驱动力与行驶阻力、装有液力变矩器汽车的动力性、燃油经济性的评价指标、电动汽车的动力性计算、发动机功率的选择、传动系挡数与各挡传动比的选择、汽车的制动效能及其恒定性、制动时汽车的方向稳定性、前、后制动器制动力的比例关系、汽车操纵稳定性与悬架、转向系和传动系的关系、操纵稳定性的试验、汽车平顺性试验和数据处理、车辆的挂钩牵引力、牵引通过性计算、汽车通过性试验。
default.en: Through the course, the external force characteristics of the automobile are understood, and the main technical performance indicators and evaluation methods of the automobile are grasped. The influence of the structure and parameters of the automobile parts on automobile performance also are mastered, so as to achieve the goal of controlling automobile. All these provides the necessary theoretical foundation for the study of the following specialized courses and the future work related to the automobile. The course addresses the main technical performances related to vehicle dynamics. It includes automobile dynamic performance parameters, driving force and resistance, dynamic performance of the auto equipped with a hydraulic torque converter, fuel economy of evaluation indexes, dynamics calculation the electric auto, choice of engine power, choice of transmission block number and transmission ratio of each block, auto braking performance and its constant qualitative, direction stability of the automobile braking, proportion of the relationship of frictional braking force, relationship between vehicle steering stability and suspension, steering system and transmission, vehicle steering stability test, vehicle ride comfort test and data processing, vehicle peg traction, calculation of passing ability under traction, test of auto passing ability.

default.zh: 课程系统地介绍现代汽车的典型结构、原理、设计理论、设计计算以及优化设计方法，包括整车及底盘各主要总成设计所需要的基本知识。其内容有汽车总体设计，离合器、变速器、万向传动轴、驱动桥、悬架、转向系和制动系统等各总成设计应满足的要求、典型结构方案分类与分析、主要参数及零部件载荷的确定、强度计算方法、主要结构元件分析、最新设计方法及其在汽车设计中的应用。同时还介绍了近年来在汽车设计中得到应用的最新技术成果。
default.en: The course systematically introduces the typical structural,principles, design theories, design calculations, and optimization design methods of modern automotives, including the basic knowledge required for the design of the main assemblies of the entire vehicle and chassis. It includes the following aspects: automotive overall design, various assembly design requirements and structure scheme analysis of the clutch, transmission, universal transmission shaft, drive axle, suspension, steering system, brake system and so on, the main parameters and load analysis of he various assembly design, strength calculation method, main structure element analysis, the latest design method and its application in automotive design, and the latest technical achievements applied in automotive design.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授智能制造系统建模与仿真的基本原理、基本理论、基本方法和实际应用的相关内容，包括系统建模与仿真的基本概念和重要意义，系统建模与仿真的一般步骤；离散事件系统及其模型分类，离散事件系统建模的基本元素，建立系统模型的常用方法；随机变量和随机分布概述，随机数的生成原理和方法，随机数发生器的检验，典型随机变量的生成；智能制造系统建模方法概述，活动循环图法，排队系统模型，库存系统模型，加工系统模型，工程经济分析；系统建模与仿真输入分析的基本方法；系统建模与仿真结果分析的基本方法；仿真软件系统及其发展，智能制造系统仿真软件应用于优化问题实例等。
default.en: The course focus on the basic principle and theory , the basic method and practical application about modeling and simulation of intelligent manufacturing system. It contains the basic concepts and significance, the general steps of modeling and simulation, the discrete event system and its classification about model, the basic elements of discrete event system modeling, the commonly used method for established the system model. The course summarizes the random variable and distribution. It covers the principle and method of random number generation, random number generator test, typical random variable generating. It also contains the overview about intelligent manufacturing system modeling methods, the movable cycle graph, queuing system model, waiting line system model, inventory system model, manufacturing system model, engineering economic analysis. It includes the basic method about input analysis and result analysis of modeling and simulation, simulation software system and its development and the application examples about intelligent manufacturing system simulation software.

default.zh: 《运筹学》是工业工程本科专业的一门专业基础课，主要介绍一些优化分析方法和实用运筹学模型，为后续课程奠定数量分析的基础理论方法。本课程主要内容包括：线性规划原理及方法；对偶理论；运输问题；整数规划及0-1规划；目标规划；图与网络分析，涵盖运筹学的主要分支。 本课程面向工科专业本科生，以讲授模型分析方法为主。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够掌握运筹学的一些主要理论和方法，培养学生能运用模型来研究解决工业过程中实际问题的能力；通过原理介绍、算法讲解、案例分析等，使学生建立起整体优化的观念和系统分析的能力；通过介绍基本的实用软件（如LINDO、EXCEL等）的使用方法，使学生具备会运用软件工具对各类运筹学模型进行求解和结果分析的能力，力争做到学以致用。同时，为后续工业工程其他课程的学习奠定基础。
default.en: “Operations Research” is a fundamental course for the students major in Industrial Engineering, which is designed to introduce basic methods of optimization analysis and practical models to the students. It facilitates the students to lay a good theoretical foundation of quantitative analysis for the successive courses. The course covers the main branches of operations research, such as linear programming principle and method, dual theory, transportation problem, integer programming and 0-1 programming, goal programming, graph and network analysis, dynamic programming, etc. This course is oriented to the undergraduate students in Industrial Engineering by means of analyzing models mainly. Through the study of this course, the students are aimed to master some primary theories and methods of operations research and are taught to apply them to solve the practical problems in industrial processes. It also enables the students to understand the concept of global optimization and the capability of systematical analysis via the introduction of the principles and the explanation of algorithms as well as the case study. And some practical software such as LINDO and EXCEL are also inducted to provide the students with tools for model solution and result analysis, which help them to learn for application. This course will lay a foundation for students to learn the other courses of industrial engineering.

default.zh: 作为智能制造的核心要素，数控机床和数控系统的智能化水平是实现智能制造单元智能生产线、智能车间乃至智能工厂的基础支撑和保障。课程围绕数控系统和数控机床的智能化，基于智能制造关键使能技术脉络，从数控系统、数控机床、加工工艺三个维度呈现智能化的特征和关键技术实现，重点讲授智能化技术与数控内核深度融合的方案、技术和措施。具体内容包括：智能数控系统的体系结构和实现方案、智能数控机床的结构配置、数控机床面向智能化的高性能技术、数控加工工艺及其智能化措施、智能数控机床加工程序编制、智能制造加工过程监测、柔性制造应用等。课程将提升智能制造大类学生利用人工智能技术赋能装备以及加工工艺的能力。
default.en: As a core element of intelligent manufacturing, the intelligence level of CNC machine tools and CNC systems serves as the fundamental support and guarantee for the realization of intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, intelligent workshops, and even intelligent factories. Centering on the intelligence of CNC systems and CNC machine tools, and based on the context of key enabling technologies for intelligent manufacturing, this course presents the intelligent characteristics and key technology implementations from three dimensions: CNC systems, CNC machine tools, and machining processes. It focuses on teaching the solutions, technologies, and measures for the in-depth integration of intelligent technologies with the CNC core. The specific content includes: the architecture and implementation plan of intelligent CNC systems, the structural configuration of intelligent CNC machine tools, high-performance technologies for the intelligentization of CNC machine tools, CNC machining processes and their intelligent measures, the programming of machining procedures for intelligent CNC machine tools, the monitoring of intelligent manufacturing processes, and the application of flexible manufacturing. This course will enhance the ability of students majoring in intelligent manufacturing to leverage artificial intelligence technologies to empower equipment and machining processes.

default.zh: 《人工智能与增材制造：从智能设计到智能制造》是一门聚焦数字化制造革命前沿的交叉学科课程，旨在系统探讨人工智能（AI）技术与增材制造（Additive Manufacturing，AM，即3D打印）深度融合的理论框架、关键技术及工业实践路径。本课程以"设计-工艺-制造-服务"全生命周期为脉络，构建从材料智能设计、工艺参数优化、生产过程控制到质量智能检测的完整知识体系，重点解析机器学习、深度学习、数字孪生、生成式设计等AI核心技术如何突破传统制造的物理限制，推动增材制造向高精度、高效率、高可靠性的智能范式跃迁。课程内容覆盖基础理论与工业应用双维度：在理论层面，深入剖析AI赋能的增材制造底层逻辑，包括基于神经网络的材料基因组学加速新材料开发、运用强化学习的多目标工艺参数优化、依托计算机视觉的熔池动态监控、基于数字孪生的全流程虚拟制造等核心技术原理；在实践层面，通过航空航天复杂构件轻量化设计、医疗器械个性化定制、汽车零部件拓扑优化等跨行业案例，展示AI如何重构传统制造流程——例如利用生成对抗网络（GAN）自动生成满足力学性能与轻量化需求的结构拓扑，通过时序预测模型预判SLM（选择性激光熔化）过程中的热应力变形，借助迁移学习实现小样本数据下的缺陷智能识别。课程特别强调"数据-算法-物理"三位一体的方法论创新，系统讲解增材制造数字主线（Digital Thread）构建策略，包括多源异构数据采集（涵盖工艺参数、传感器数据、显微图像等）、特征工程处理方法、物理信息神经网络（PINN）构建技巧，以及基于云-边协同的实时决策系统部署方案。针对增材制造特有的挑战，如各向异性控制、残余应力消除、支撑结构优化等问题，课程专题研究AI解决方案的工程化路径，例如开发融合热力学仿真的混合增强智能系统，实现加工参数与零件性能的闭环优化；构建面向金属增材制造的缺陷知识图谱，通过因果推理提升工艺稳定性。在智能制造维度，重点解析AI驱动的智能工厂生态系统，涵盖自感知智能装备、自适应路径规划算法、自主决策MES系统等核心模块，并探讨区块链技术在产品溯源中的创新应用。课程还前瞻性探索AI与增材制造融合引发的范式变革，包括大规模个性化定制商业模式创新、分布式制造网络构建、太空原位制造等新兴场景，通过剖析NASA太空3D打印机器人、GE燃油喷嘴一体化制造等标杆项目，揭示技术融合如何突破传统生产可能性边界。为培养复合型创新能力，课程采用"理论讲授-虚拟仿真-实验操作"三维教学模式，配套开发基于Python的增材制造智能算法工具箱、Unity3D工艺可视化平台和ROS机器人控制实验模块，学员将通过实战项目掌握从数据采集、模型训练到系统集成的完整技能链，典型任务包括开发面向FDM工艺的智能切片参数推荐系统、构建基于深度强化学习的支撑结构生成模型、设计面向金属增材制造的多物理场耦合优化数字孪生体等。课程最终着眼于培育具有系统思维的智能制造领军者，不仅要求学员理解技术原理，更强调培养其在真实工业场景中识别技术痛点、设计AI解决方案并评估技术经济可行性的能力，为此设置制造企业实地调研、行业专家工作坊、技术路线图沙盘推演等实践环节，助力学员把握从技术研发到产业落地的关键成功要素。通过本课程的系统学习，参与者将建立起AI赋能增材制造的完整认知框架，掌握智能设计工具链与智能制造系统的开发能力，并能够前瞻性研判技术融合趋势，为引领制造业数字化转型奠定坚实基础。
default.en: It systematically explores the theoretical framework, core technologies, and industrial implementation pathways for the deep integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and additive manufacturing (AM, commonly known as 3D printing). Structured around the "design-process-production-service" lifecycle, the course establishes a comprehensive knowledge system spanning intelligent material design, process parameter optimization, production control, and AI-driven quality inspection. It emphasizes how machine learning, deep learning, digital twins, and generative design technologies break through traditional manufacturing constraints to propel additive manufacturing toward intelligent paradigms characterized by enhanced precision, efficiency, and reliability. The curriculum addresses both fundamental theories and industrial applications: Theoretically, it provides in-depth analysis of AI-empowered AM principles, including neural network-based materials genomics for accelerated material discovery, multi-objective process optimization via reinforcement learning, melt pool dynamics monitoring through computer vision, and virtual manufacturing workflows enabled by digital twins. Practically, cross-industry case studies – such as lightweight aerospace component design, personalized medical device fabrication, and automotive part topology optimization – demonstrate AI's transformative role in redefining manufacturing processes. Examples include generative adversarial networks (GANs) automatically creating structures that meet mechanical and lightweight requirements, time-series prediction models anticipating thermal stress deformation in selective laser melting (SLM), and transfer learning-enabled defect recognition with limited training data. The course highlights the innovative "data-algorithm-physics" trinity methodology, systematically explaining digital thread construction strategies for AM – covering multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition (process parameters, sensor data, microstructural images), feature engineering techniques, physics-informed neural network (PINN) development, and cloud-edge collaborative decision systems. For AM-specific challenges like anisotropy control, residual stress mitigation, and support structure optimization, dedicated modules investigate engineering solutions: hybrid intelligence systems integrating thermodynamic simulations for closed-loop parameter optimization, defect knowledge graphs employing causal reasoning to enhance process stability, and more.
