In smart manufacturing contexts, the course analyzes AI-driven smart factory ecosystems comprising self-aware equipment, adaptive path-planning algorithms, and autonomous MES decision systems, while exploring blockchain applications in product traceability. Forward-looking discussions address paradigm shifts emerging from AI-AM convergence, including mass customization business models, distributed manufacturing networks, and in-space fabrication – illustrated through NASA's orbital 3D printing robots and GE's integrated fuel nozzle production. To cultivate interdisciplinary innovation capabilities, the course adopts a "theory-simulation-experiment" tripartite pedagogy, supplemented with Python-based AM algorithm toolkits, Unity3D process visualization platforms, and ROS robotic control modules. Hands-on projects enable mastery of complete skill chains from data acquisition to system integration, including developing intelligent slicing parameter systems for FDM, deep reinforcement learning-based support generation models, and multi-physics coupled digital twins for metal AM. Ultimately, the course aims to develop systems-thinking leaders capable of identifying industrial pain points, designing AI solutions, and evaluating techno-economic viability – reinforced through factory visits, expert workshops, and technology roadmap simulations.

default.zh: 本课程秉承“师法自然”的理念，以微纳仿生系统技术为核心，系统梳理该领域的发展脉络、基础理论、关键工艺与典型应用。通过对微纳仿生表／界面能场效应的深入分析，重点讲解增阻、减阻等设计手段，以及液滴操控、雾水收集、减阻材料等前沿案例，帮助学生把握学科前沿动态和应用场景。在教学中，既注重基础理论的夯实，也强调案例驱动的研究性学习，鼓励学生运用超快激光制造、精密3D打印等先进技术，开展跨学科探究与创新设计。课程完成后，学生不仅能够描绘微纳仿生系统科技全貌，熟练掌握核心技术和典型应用，还将具备自主检索文献、撰写学术报告的能力，为今后深入科研和工程实践奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course embraces the principle of “learning from nature,” centering on micro- and nanoscale bionic system technologies. It systematically reviews the field’s evolution, foundational theories, key processes, and representative applications. By delving into micro-/nanoscale bionic surface and interface energy–field effects, the curriculum highlights design strategies such as drag-enhancement and drag-reduction, as well as cutting-edge cases like droplet manipulation, fog-water harvesting, and low-drag materials, equipping students to grasp both frontier developments and practical contexts. Instruction balances rigorous theory with case-driven, inquiry-based learning, encouraging students to employ advanced fabrication methods—ultrafast laser processing and precision 3D printing—to pursue interdisciplinary exploration and innovative designs. Upon completion, students will not only comprehend the full landscape of micro-/nanoscale bionic systems, master core techniques and applications, but also acquire skills in independent literature research and academic report writing, laying a solid foundation for future research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 仿生医工技术是生物医学与工程学科交叉的前沿领域，通过模拟生物系统的结构与功能，推动医疗技术的革新与突破，为解决临床诊疗、精准康复及个性化医疗等难题提供创新方案。本课程以“医疗导向、工程转化”为核心，聚焦液滴微流控、器官芯片、数字微流控、生物打印等关键技术，系统构建从生物原型分析到医疗技术落地的全链条知识体系，培养兼具工程思维与医学洞察力的复合型人才。课程围绕“临床需求—器件设计—技术应用”的逻辑闭环，深度解析生物学、力学、材料学及智能控制等跨学科原理。学生将通过SolidWorks、AutoCAD、COMSOL等工具完成仿生医疗装置的建模与优化，并在实验平台中实践器官芯片构建、仿生材料打印等前沿技术，强化科研素养与工程转化能力。课程注重伦理与创新的平衡，通过案例研讨分析仿生技术的可及性、安全性及社会接受度，例如人工器官的生物相容性设计、基因编辑技术的伦理边界等议题。适合机械、生物、计算机等多学科背景学生选修，助力其成为推动医工交叉领域发展的创新实践者，为精准医疗与健康产业注入前沿技术动力。 课程主要内容包括： 1. 仿生医工技术基础概论 2. 液滴微流控技术 3. 器官芯片 4. 数字微流控技术 5. 生物打印技术 6. 实验设计
default.en: Bionic medical engineering is a cutting-edge interdisciplinary field integrating biomedicine and engineering, which drives innovation in healthcare by mimicking the structures and functions of biological systems. It provides novel solutions to clinical challenges in diagnosis, precision rehabilitation, and personalized medicine. Centered on the principles of “clinical orientation and engineering translation,” this course focuses on key technologies such as droplet microfluidics, organ-on-a-chip, digital microfluidics, and bioprinting. It systematically builds an end-to-end knowledge framework—from analyzing biological prototypes to implementing medical technologies—aiming to cultivate interdisciplinary talents with both engineering acumen and medical insight. The course revolves around the logical cycle of “clinical demand → device design → technological application,” delving into cross-disciplinary principles spanning biology, mechanics, materials science, and intelligent control. Students will employ tools like SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and COMSOL to conduct modeling and optimization of bioinspired medical devices. Hands-on experiments on platforms such as organ-on-a-chip fabrication and bioinspired material bioprinting will enhance their research capabilities and practical engineering skills. Emphasizing the balance between ethics and innovation, the course incorporates case studies to analyze the accessibility, safety, and societal acceptance of bionic technologies. Topics include biocompatibility design of artificial organs and ethical boundaries of gene-editing technologies. Designed for students with backgrounds in mechanical engineering, biology, computer science, and related disciplines, this course empowers future innovators to advance the convergence of medicine and engineering, injecting cutting-edge technological momentum into precision healthcare and the wellness industry. Course Content Includes: 1. Fundamentals of Bionic Medical Engineering Technology 2. Droplet Microfluidics 3. Organ-on-a-Chip 4. Digital Microfluidics 5. Bioprinting Technology 6. Experimental Design

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授人机工程学的基本概念、基本原理和基本应用实例。人机工程学是一门新兴的边缘学科。研究人机工程学的目的就是提高作业的工作效率；提高设备、器具、作业环境的工作舒适性，安全性问题。融会贯通人机工程学的基本原理和准则对于设计师设计出符合人的生理特点、心理特点、科学规律的产品至关重要。 本课程主要有十章内容组成，分别介绍人机工程学的基本概念，起源与发展；人因学部分介绍人的构造尺寸与功能尺寸的测量与特点，人的心理特性与特点；典型常规作业环境的分析与设计原则；人的疲劳的分类，疲劳的测量与预防；安全的基本概念，安全分析的基本原理与方法，安全的预防与产品的安全设计；典型人机装置的设计包括显示控制装置设计，工作岗位与工作场所设计，工具的把手设计等；人机工程学的总体设计方法与设计应用实例；人机工程学的先进研究与技术介绍等。本课程通过课堂教学、实验和产品改良设计几个环节力求学生对人机工程学这门课程能有更深的理解。
default.en: The course mainly the teaches knowledge about the basic concept、principle and application of human-machine engineering. The human-machine engineering is a new-rising boundary discipline. The aim for studying human-machine engineering is to improve the work efficiency, to enhance the comfort and safety of equipment, apparatus and working environment. The grasping of the principle and guide line of human-machine engineering is key for designer to design good products to meet the human’s psychological, physiological need and science rule. The course consists of 10 chapters which introduce the basic concept, origin and development of human-machine engineering; the body and function measurement, the psychological traits in human factor part; the analysis and design for ordinary operating environment; the classification 、measurement prevention of human fatigue; the basic concept of safety, the basic principle and method of safety analysis, the safety prevention and safety design for product; the design for typical human-machine apparatus which include display-control design, work post and work place design, the handle design of tool; the total system design and example of human-machine system; the introduction to the advanced research and technology of human-machine engineering. By class teaching, experiment and product-improvement design, we manage the students have a deep understanding for the human-machine engineering course.

default.zh: 机器人是高端智能产业发展的核心装备，是先进制造与新一代信息技术融合的前沿方向，是全球科技竞争与产业升级的重要领域。驱动器是机器人的核心单元之一，决定了机器人的基本特性、功能及应用领域。机器人采用传统的电机、气压、液压驱动技术受结构、原理和特性等因素的制约已无法很好地满足各种新兴领域的发展需求。基于此，各类新型驱动及控制技术得到了广泛的研究和应用。《仿生驱动技术》是仿生科学与工程专业学生的一门专业课程。本课程主要包括压电驱动及控制技术、音圈电机及控制技术、形状记忆合金驱动及控制技术、介电弹性体驱动及控制技术、磁致伸缩驱动及控制技术、静电驱动及控制技术、电热驱动及控制技术、光热驱动及控制技术及部分新兴驱动技术的基础理论、分类、驱动特性、运动控制技术和应用实例。课程重点在于建立学生对仿生驱动技术的认识，掌握仿生机器人驱动单元的基本设计思想、应用领域和发展方向，开拓学生的学术视野和创新思维，培养学生对仿生机器人驱动技术前沿领域的思辨能力及跨学科领域思考问题和解决问题的能力。本课程能激发学生在该领域的研究兴趣，培养书目检索和学术报告撰写的基本技能。
default.en: Robots are the core equipment for the development of high-end intelligent industries, the forefront direction of the integration of advanced manufacturing and new generation information technology, and an important field for global technological competition and industrial upgrading. The actuator is one of the core units of a robot, determining its basic characteristics, functions, and application areas. Traditional actuator, pneumatic, and hydraulic actuating technologies for robots are limited by factors such as structure, principles, and characteristics, and are no longer able to meet the development needs of various emerging fields. Based on this, various new actuating and control technologies have been widely researched and applied. The course Biomimetic Actuation Technology is a professional course for students majoring in Bionic Science and Engineering. This course mainly includes the basic theories, classifications, actuating characteristics, motion control techniques, and application examples of piezoelectric actuating and control technology, voice coil motor and control technology, shape memory alloy actuating and control technology, dielectric elastomer actuating and control technology, magnetostrictive actuating and control technology, electrostatic actuating and control technology, electric heating actuating and control technology, photothermal actuating and control technology, and some emerging actuating technologies. The focus of the course is to establish students' understanding of biomimetic actuating technology, master the basic design ideas, application fields, and development directions of biomimetic robot actuating units, broaden students' academic horizons and innovative thinking, cultivate students' ability to think critically in the forefront of biomimetic robot actuating technology, and develop their ability to think and solve problems across disciplines. This course can stimulate students' research interest in the field and cultivate basic skills in bibliographic retrieval and academic report writing.

default.zh: 《空间智能仿生机构》是一门涉及空间环境工程学、仿生学、机构学、机器人学等多学科知识的课程，主要讲授空间仿生机构理论与设计、空间仿生机构感知与控制两方面内容，是仿生科学与工程专业选修的专业课之一，旨在培养学生对仿生机构在深空探测、在轨操控等领域中的研究兴趣和应用能力，是掌握空间技术发展前沿、从事空间技术方面科研工作不可缺少的专业课程。 空间仿生机构理论与设计部分主要讲授空间仿生机构学相关理论基础和设计方法，包括仿生学简介、典型仿生机构、空间环境效应、空间仿生机构设计、空间仿生机构仿真等内容。通过本部分内容的学习，使学生能够具备机构学和仿生学等方面的理论基础，了解空间环境对仿生机构的效应和影响，掌握空间仿生机构设计工具，具备开展典型空间仿生机构设计的能力。 空间仿生机构感知与控制部分主要讲授面向空间仿生机构的感知和控制技术，包括面向空间仿生机构的摩擦电感知、电容式感知、摩擦电传感器设计、机器学习理论、智能识别模型等感知识别技术，以及面向空间仿生机构的PID控制、神经网络控制、MPC控制等控制技术。通过本部分内容的学习，使学生能够了解空间仿生机构传感器的技术特点，了解空间仿生机构控制方法的技术特点，掌握建立空间仿生机构感知器和控制器的能力。 最终通过本课程的系统学习，使学生能够深入地了解和掌握空间环境的分类、效应、模拟方法，以及空间仿生机构的设计、仿真、感知、控制等技术，为将来从事空间仿生机器人的设计、控制、试验、科研开发等工作奠定理论与技术基础。
default.en: Space Intelligent Bionic Mechanism is a course involving multi-disciplinary knowledge such as space environmental engineering, bionics, mechanics, and robotics. It mainly teaches the theory and design of space bionic mechanism, and the perception and control of space bionic mechanism. It is one of the professional elective courses of bionic science and engineering, aiming to cultivate students' research interest and application ability of bionic mechanisms in the fields of deep space detection, on orbit manipulation, etc, It is an indispensable professional course for mastering the forefront of space technology development and engaging in scientific research in space technology. The theory and design part of spatial bionic mechanism mainly teaches the relevant theoretical basis and design methods of spatial bionic mechanism, including the introduction of bionics, typical bionic mechanisms, spatial environmental effects, spatial bionic mechanism design, spatial bionic mechanism simulation, etc. Through the study of this part, students can have theoretical basis in mechanism and bionics, understand the effect and influence of space environment on bionic mechanisms, master the design tools of space bionic mechanisms, and have the ability to design typical space bionic mechanisms. The perception and control section of spatial biomimetic mechanisms mainly teaches perception and control technologies for spatial biomimetic mechanisms, including frictional electric perception, capacitive sensing, frictional electric sensor design, machine learning theory, intelligent recognition models, and other sensory knowledge technologies for spatial biomimetic mechanisms, as well as control technologies such as PID control, neural network control, and MPC control for spatial biomimetic mechanisms. Through the learning of this section, students will be able to understand the technical characteristics of sensors in space biomimetic mechanisms, understand the technical characteristics of control methods in space biomimetic mechanisms, and master the ability to establish sensors and controllers in space biomimetic mechanisms. Finally, through the systematic learning of this course, students can deeply understand and master the classification, effects, simulation methods of space environment, as well as the design, simulation, perception, control and other technologies of space bionic mechanisms, which will lay a theoretical and technical foundation for future work in the design, control, experiment, scientific research and development of space bionic robots.

default.zh: 《空间机构仿真》是仿生科学与工程的专业基础课程，授课对象面方向本科生，其教学目的是使学生掌握空间机构的运动学与动力学数学建模、仿真模型构建、机构性能分析的综合能力，并结合科学技术、工艺、材料等相关技术的发展趋势，培养学生空间机构建模、仿真与分析的初步能力，树立起系统观念和优良的设计思想，为解决工程实际问题与科学研究奠定基础。
default.en: Simulation Techniques for Space Mechanisms is a professional basic course in biomimetic science and engineering, targeting undergraduate students in related fields. Its teaching objective is to enable students to master the comprehensive abilities of mathematical modeling, simulation model construction, and mechanism performance analysis for spatial mechanisms. By combining the development trends of science and technology, processes, materials, and other related technologies, it cultivates students' preliminary abilities in spatial mechanism modeling, simulation, and analysis, establishes a systematic concept and excellent design thinking, and lays the foundation for solving practical engineering problems and scientific research.

default.zh: 本课程以学生自主设计、加工、装配、调试协作机器人为目标，是考察学生对机械工程制图、机械原理、机械设计、机械制造技术基础，机械系统设计，机电一体化系统设计等先修课程学习掌握情况的验证性课程，也是学生后续学习机器人专业课程如机器人技术基础、机器人智能控制基础、机器人交互技术、机器人运动控制技术等课程的基础，可以使学生在掌握机械产品设计与制造的同时，充分了解协作机器人的基础知识和结构设计方法，培养学生利用所学知识在机械设计及制造、机器人技术领域从事科研和开发工作的能力。 本课程主要讲授无框力矩电机、谐波减速器、磁编码器、力矩传感器、抱闸、驱动器、控制器等协作机器人核心零部件的工作原理、选型以及集成策略，分析典型模块化关节和协作机器人的设计案例，指导学生设计、加工、装配协作机器人，使学生深入了解协作机器人的组成、结构设计以及应用方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实践环节，着重培养学生进行机电一体化产品的设计以及工程实践能力，为将来从事机械设计及制造、机器人领域的研发工作打下基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: This course aims at students' independent design, processing, assembly and debugging of cobots. It is a confirmatory course to investigate students' mastery of mechanical engineering drawing, mechanical principle, mechanical design, mechanical manufacturing technology foundation, mechanical system design, mechatronics system design and other advanced courses. It is also the basis of students' follow-up learning robot professional courses such as robot technology foundation, robot intelligent control foundation, robot interaction technology, robot motion control technology and other courses. Students can fully understand the basic knowledge and structural design methods of cobots while mastering the design and manufacture of mechanical products. Cultivate students' ability to use the knowledge they have learned to engage in scientific research and development in the fields of mechanical design and manufacturing and robotics. This course mainly teaches the working principle, selection and integration strategy of the core components of cobots such as frameless torque motor, harmonic reducer, magnetic encoder, torque sensor, brake, driver and controller. It analyzes the design cases of typical modular joints and cobots, guides students to design, process and assemble cobots, and enables students to deeply understand the composition, structural design and application methods of cobots. Through the classroom teaching and follow-up practice of this course, it focuses on cultivating students' ability to design mechatronic products and engineering practice, laying a foundation for future research and development in the field of mechanical design and manufacturing and robotics, and supporting the achievement of corresponding index points in professional learning results.

default.zh: 机械设计制造及其自动化专业要求毕业生具有较高的实践性能力，毕业论文（设计）是本专业学生的最后一个教学环节，也是学生走向社会独立解决工程问题的一次演习。毕业论文（设计）课程按照基于项目的学习方法组织和管理，学分为8学分，需在16周内完成教学任务。其主要目的是通过分散式教学方式，在固定专业教师的指导下，结合实践完成某个命题项目的论文或设计，培养学生综合运用所学的基础理论知识和专业知识，具有分析和解决机械工程技术领域的工程技术问题的能力，为走向社会奠定坚实的工作基础。
default.en: The mechanical design, manufacturing, and automation majors require graduates to have high practical ability. Graduation thesis (design) is the last teaching link for students of this major, and it is also a drill for students to solve engineering problems independently in society. The graduation thesis (Design) course is organized and managed according to the project-based learning method. It is divided into eight credits, and the teaching task needs to be completed within 16 weeks. Its primary purposes are: (1) to complete the thesis or design of a particular proposition project with practice under the guidance of fixed professional teachers through distributed teaching methods (2) to train students to comprehensively apply the basic theoretical knowledge and professional knowledge they have learned. (3) to have the ability to analyze and solve engineering and technical problems in the field of mechanical engineering technology and lay a solid foundation for society's work.

default.zh: “综合实践与生产实习(仿生机器人综合实践)”是飞行器制造工程专业一门重要的实践课程。学生需要综合运用先修课程中所学相关知识与技能，从整机出发，强调总体设计的思想，进行仿生扑翼飞行器的总体设计，完成设计参数的计算，并对传动机构、扑翼机构等进行结构设计、建模仿真、加工制造及飞行测试。考核环节包括设计过程、答辩表现、图纸及样机三个部分。样机的研制需能够满足设计要求。本实践课程综合培养学生的总体设计、机械结构计算、飞行控制及软件编写能力，着重培养学生正确的设计思想、创新思维，培养学生的创新能力及综合运用知识的能力。
default.en: Comprehensive Practice and Production Internship (Comprehensive Practice in Aircraft Manufacturing) is an important practical course in the field of biomimetic science and engineering. Students need to comprehensively apply the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses, starting from the entire machine, emphasizing the concept of overall design, to carry out the overall design of biomimetic flapping wing aircraft, complete the calculation of design parameters, and carry out mechanical design, modeling and simulation, production and manufacturing, and flight testing, etc. The assessment process includes three parts: design process, presentation, drawings and prototype development. The development of the prototype needs to meet the design requirements. This practical course comprehensively cultivates students' abilities in overall design, mechanical structure calculation, flight control, and software development, with a focus on cultivating students' correct design thinking and innovative thinking, as well as their innovative ability and ability to comprehensively apply knowledge.

default.zh: 让学生提前进入实验室参与教师的科研项目，将学生课堂所学习的设计与制造(1)、设计与制造（2）、设计与制造（3）等核心课理论知识与工程实际连接起来形成一个有机的整体，通过飞行器先进设计、制造和控制领域的专业实践环节培养学生们运用理论知识研究解飞行器制造工程领域设计、制造、控制等方面复杂工程问题的能力，并同时增强学生的动手能力。
default.en: Encourage students to enter the laboratory in advance to participate in the teacher's research projects, connecting the theoretical knowledge of core courses such as Design and Manufacturing (1), Design and Manufacturing (2), and Design and Manufacturing (3) learned in the classroom with engineering practice to form an organic whole. Cultivate the ability of students to apply theoretical knowledge to research and solve complex engineering problems in the field of aircraft manufacturing engineering, such as design, manufacturing, and control, while enhancing their hands-on ability.

default.zh: 让学生提前进入实验室参与教师的科研项目，将学生课堂所学习的设计与制造(1)、设计与制造（2）、设计与制造（3）等核心课理论知识与工程实际连接起来形成一个有机的整体，通过飞行器先进设计、制造和控制领域的专业实践环节培养学生们运用理论知识研究解飞行器制造工程领域设计、制造、控制等方面复杂工程问题的能力，并同时增强学生的动手能力。

Cultivate the ability of students to apply theoretical knowledge to research and solve complex engineering problems in the field of aircraft manufacturing engineering, such as design, manufacturing, and control, while enhancing their hands-on ability.

Cultivate the ability of students to apply theoretical knowledge to research and solve complex engineering problems in the field of aircraft manufacturing engineering, such as design, manufacturing, and control, while enhancing their hands-on ability.

default.zh: 飞行器制造工程专业要求毕业生具有较高的实践性能力，毕业论文（设计）是本专业学生的最后一个教学环节，也是学生走向社会独立解决工程问题的一次演习。主要目的是通过分散式教学方式，在固定专业教师的指导下，结合实践完成某个命题项目的论文或设计，培养学生综合运用所学的基础理论知识和专业知识分析和解决机械工程技术领域的工程技术问题的能力，为走向社会奠定坚实的工作基础。本专业毕业设计按照基于项目的学习方法组织和管理。通过基于项目的毕业设计，进一步深化和拓宽学生的知识面，提高学生的自学能力和独立工作的能力；培养学生的团队精神、创新精神；使学生受到工程师的基本训练，培养其开展生产实践或科学研究工作的初步能力。

生产实习是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生了解和掌握基本生产知识，验证、巩固和丰富已学过的专业课程内容。本课程以实习单位的乘用车总装制造作为典型制造系统示例，讲授冲压、涂装、装配生产线的组成、规划、设计和实施过程，由校内导师和企业导师共同指导学生参与企业系统优化课题，以达到稳定整车总装质量、提高总装效率和降低成本的目标。通过本课程的学习和实践，培养学生理论联系实际的能力，提高其在生产实际中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，能够运用本专业所需的相关数学和工业工程相关基本理论和基础知识，结合工业互联网技术解决企业亟需的生产优化问题，学生在这个过程中树立精益求精的科学探究精神、整体最优的系统观，养成持续改进的工业工程师思维，形成规格严格的工程实践能力；培养学生对系统优化问题进行系统表达、建立模型、分析求解、论证优化和过程管理的能力， 能够制定系统优化方案、实施工程实验，正确处理和分析实验数据，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Production internship is a very important practical teaching link in undergraduate teaching plans, with the aim of enabling students to understand and master basic production knowledge, verify, consolidate, and enrich the professional course content they have learned. This course takes the passenger car assembly manufacturing of the internship unit as a typical manufacturing system example, teaching the composition, planning, design, and implementation process of stamping, painting, and assembly production lines. Students are jointly guided by campus and enterprise mentors to participate in enterprise system optimization projects, in order to achieve the goal of stabilizing the overall vehicle assembly quality, improving assembly efficiency, and reducing costs. Through the learning and practice of this course, students will be able to integrate theory with practice, improve their ability and methods to investigate, observe, analyze and solve problems in production practice, and be able to use relevant mathematics and basic theories and knowledge related to industrial engineering required by this major to solve production optimization problems urgently needed by enterprises in combination with industrial Internet technology, During this process, students establish a spirit of scientific exploration that strives for excellence, a holistic and optimal system view, cultivate a mindset of continuous improvement as an industrial engineer, and develop rigorous engineering practice abilities; Cultivate the ability of students to systematically express, establish models, analyze and solve system optimization problems, demonstrate optimization and process management, develop system optimization plans, implement engineering experiments, correctly process and analyze experimental data, and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 综合已经学过的工业工程核心课程，融会贯通，灵活运用，通过本课程创新性地解决复杂工程问题。通过项目式教学管理方式，本课程将有针对性的给学生提供个性化的创新实践题目，工作量适当、难度适中且具有一定挑战性。学生在完成相关题目后，除了完成课程本身必要的考核之外，鼓励根据自身兴趣，继续完善提高项目产出，积极参加省级以上相关学科的学生赛事。本课程能够扩大学生视野、提升专业知识应用水平、增强融合创新能力，为将来从事相关工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: The core courses of industrial engineering that have been learned are integrated and flexibly applied to solve complex engineering problems innovatively through this course. Through project-based teaching management, this course will provide students with personalized innovative practical topics with appropriate workload, moderate difficulty, and certain challenges. After completing the relevant topics, students are encouraged to continue to improve the project output according to their own interests, in addition to completing the necessary assessment of the course itself, and actively participate in the student competitions of related disciplines at provincial level or above. This course can broaden students' vision, improve the application level of professional knowledge, enhance the ability of integration and innovation, and lay a solid foundation for future work in related fields.

default.zh: 工业工程综合课程设计是工业工程专业的实践性教学环节，是本科生必修的课程，旨在培养学生综合设计能力，进一步强化学生对所学基础工业工程、生产计划与控制、设施规划与物流管理、质量管理学、人力资源管理、财务管理学等专业基础课和专业课知识的理解，对工厂的设施布置、物料搬运系统、仓储系统、生产系统、组织运作管理、人员及设备配置、质量管理、成本管理等进行全面的设计，并形成完整的解决方案。
default.en: The course of Comprehensive Curriculum Design of Industrial Engineering is a practical foundation courses of industrial engineering. In addition, this course will be useful and essential for further study about Fundamental Industrial Engineering, Production Planning and Control, Facilities Planning and Logistic Management, Quality Management, Human Resource Management, Financial Management. And by working in this course student will build the whole solution by designing in industrial facilities planning, logistic distribution analysis, systematic planning of industrial Facilities, quality management and cost management.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是工业工业工程专业重要的实践性教学环节，是本科生必修的课程，旨在培养学生知识的综合运用能力，进一步强化学生对所学工业工程导论、生产计划与控制、设施规划与物流管理、工效学、工程经济学、质量管理学、人力资源管理等专业基础课和专业课知识的理解。要求学生能够针对工业工程中的某一具体问题进行综合分析、资料收集、设计方案、仿真运行、结果分析，并形成完整的解决方案。
default.en: The course of Graduation Thesis (Design) is an important practical foundation course of industrial engineering with the purpose of training the integrated operating ability of the learned knowledge. In addition, this course will be useful and essential for further study about Fundamental Industrial Engineering, Production Planning and Control, Facilities Planning and Logistic Management, Ergonomics, Economics in Engineering, Quality Management, and Human Resource Management. By studying in this course student will build the whole solution to a problem of IE by analyzing, collecting information, designing, simulating, and result analyzing.

default.zh: 本课程以设计、加工、装配、调试、测试、控制、应用协作机器人为目标，是考察学生对工程制图基础，机械原理，机械设计，机电一体化系统设计，机器人机构学等，机器人学基础，机器人仿真与编程技术，机器人控制技术基础，机器人交互技术等先修课程学习掌握情况的综合性、验证性实践课程，可以使学生在充分了解协作机器人前沿技术的同时，掌握协作机器人的基础知识、结构设计，以及调试、测试、控制、应用方法，培养学生利用所学知识在机器人技术领域从事科研和开发工作的能力。 本课程主要介绍协作机器人核心零部件的工作原理、选型以及集成策略，讲授协作机器人控制系统的软硬件架构、位姿分析、坐标变换、连杆坐标系和DH参数、机器人正逆运动学、雅可比矩阵、奇异性分析、关节空间运动规划、笛卡尔空间运动规划等基础知识，分析典型模块化关节和协作机器人的设计案例以及协作机器人的经典控制案例，指导学生开展协作机器人的设计、加工、装配，以及控制仿真、控制程序编写、控制参数调试等实验，使学生深入了解协作机器人的组成以及结构设计方法，并且完成协作机器人的调试、测试、控制以及应用。通过本课程的实验教学和实践环节，着重培养学生解决机器人领域复杂工程问题的能力，为将来从事机器人领域的研发工作打下基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: This course aims to design, process, assemble, debug, test, control and apply cobots. It is a comprehensive and confirmatory practical course to investigate students' mastery of engineering drawing foundation, mechanical principle, mechanical design, mechatronic system design, robotics, robotics foundation, robot simulation and programming technology, robot control technology foundation, robot interaction technology and other advanced courses. It can enable students to fully understand the cutting-edge technology of cobots while mastering the basic knowledge and structural design of cobots, as well as debugging, testing, control and application methods. Cultivate students' ability to use the knowledge they have learned to engage in scientific research and development in the field of robotics. This course mainly introduces the working principle, selection and integration strategy of the core components of cobots. The basic knowledge of hardware and software architecture, pose analysis, coordinate transformation, link coordinate system and DH parameters, robot forward and inverse kinematics, Jacobian matrix, singularity analysis, joint space motion planning, Cartesian space motion planning and so on are taught. The design cases of typical modular joints and cobots and the classical control cases of cobots are analyzed. The students are guided to carry out the design, processing and assembly of cobots, as well as control simulation, control program writing, control parameter debugging and other experiments. Enable students to understand the composition and structural design methods of cobots, and complete the debugging, testing, control and application of cobots. Through the experimental teaching and practice of this course, it focuses on cultivating students' ability to solve complex engineering problems in the field of robotics, laying a foundation for future research and development in the field of robotics, and supporting the achievement of corresponding index points in professional learning results.

default.zh: 毕业设计是机械电子工程人才培养的重要组成部分，是学生完成基础课、专业课学习和其它实践性环节训练之后，进行全面素质训练的综合性教学环节。通过毕业设计，使学生进一步巩固所学的基本理论和专业知识，提高专业技能和实际动手能力，培养严谨的科学作风以及独立从事科学研究的初步能力，以全面达到本专业培养目标的要求，为社会输送德才兼备的合格毕业生。 通过毕业设计，学生可在导师指导下学会综合运用多学科的基本理论，知识与技能，分析和解决工程问题。通过毕业设计期间的设计、调研与实践，深化理论知识，拓宽知识领域。为将来解决科学和工程问题奠定基础。 通过毕业设计，可以巩固所学的专业理论知识，结合文献研究，具有描述和提炼机械电子工程领域的工程技术问题的能力。 通过毕业设计，可培养学生运用所学的专业知识，提出多种解决方案，并对方案进行分析、论证、确定合理的解决方案，具有独立分析和解决问题的能力和创新意识； 通过毕业设计，学生可以了解本专业领域国际前沿、国内外发展动态和行业需求，能够就机械电子工程领域的科学和工程问题发表自己的见解。 还可以培养学生撰写报告和设计文稿、陈述发言、清晰表达、提炼和展示的能力。
default.en: Graduation design is an important component of talent cultivation in mechanical and electronic engineering. It is a comprehensive teaching process in which students complete basic courses, professional courses, and other practical training before undergoing comprehensive quality training. Through the graduation project, students will further consolidate their basic theories and professional knowledge, improve their professional skills and practical abilities, cultivate a rigorous scientific style and preliminary ability to independently engage in scientific research, in order to comprehensively meet the requirements of their professional training goals and provide qualified graduates with both moral integrity and talent to the society. Through the graduation project, students can learn to comprehensively apply the basic theories, knowledge, and skills of multiple disciplines, analyze and solve engineering problems under the guidance of their supervisors. Deepen theoretical knowledge and broaden knowledge areas through design, research, and practice during the graduation project period. To lay the foundation for solving scientific and engineering problems in the future. Through graduation design, one can consolidate their professional theoretical knowledge, combine it with literature research, and have the ability to describe and extract engineering and technical problems in the field of mechanical and electronic engineering. Through graduation design, students can be trained to apply their professional knowledge, propose various solutions, analyze, demonstrate, and determine reasonable solutions, and have the ability to independently analyze and solve problems and innovative consciousness. Through graduation design, students can understand the international forefront, domestic and international development trends, and industry demands in their field of expertise, and be able to express their own opinions on scientific and engineering issues in the field of mechanical and electronic engineering. It can also cultivate students' ability to write reports, design drafts, make statements, express themselves clearly, refine and present.
