default.zh: 机器人设计实践Ⅰ是机械电子工程、机器人工程专业本科生必需掌握的一门专业实践课，是学生们后续专业课程的基础之一。课程主要讲授协作机器人的基本概念，协作机器人核心零部件的工作原理、选型以及集成策略，典型模块化关节和协作机器人的设计案例，协作机器人设计、加工、装配、调试流程及方法。本课程可以使学生掌握协作机器人的基础知识和设计方法，着重培养学生进行机电一体化产品的设计以及工程实践能力，为将来从事机器人领域的研发工作打下基础。
default.en: Robot design practice I is a professional practice course that must be mastered by undergraduates majoring in mechatronics engineering、robotics engineering. It is one of the foundations of students' follow-up professional courses. The course mainly teaches the basic concepts of cobots, the working principle, selection and integration strategy of the core components of cobots, the design cases of typical modular joints and cobots, and the design, processing, assembly and debugging processes and methods of cobots. This course can enable students to master the basic knowledge and design methods of cobots, and focus on cultivating students' ability to design mechatronic products and engineering practice, laying a foundation for future research and development in the field of robotics.

default.zh: 本课程以调试、测试、控制、应用协作机器人为目标，是考察学生对机器人学基础，机器人仿真与编程技术，机器人控制技术基础，机器人交互技术等先修课程学习掌握情况的验证性课程，可以使学生在充分了解协作机器人前沿技术的同时，充分掌握协作机器人的调试、测试、控制、应用方法，并培养学生利用所学知识在机器人技术领域从事科研和开发工作的能力。 本课程主要介绍协作机器人控制系统的软、硬件架构，讲授位姿分析、坐标变换、连杆坐标系和DH参数、机器人正逆运动学、雅可比矩阵、奇异性分析、关节空间运动规划、笛卡尔空间运动规划等机器人基础知识，分析协作机器人的经典控制案例，指导学生开展机器人控制仿真、控制程序编写、控制参数调试等实验，使学生深入了解协作机器人的调试、测试、控制以及应用方法。通过本课程的实验教学和实践环节，着重培养学生解决机器人领域复杂工程问题的能力，为将来从事机器人领域的研发工作打下基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: This course aims to debug, test, control, and apply cobots. It is a verification course that examines students ' mastery of advanced courses such as robotics foundation, robot simulation and programming technology, robot control technology foundation, and robot interaction technology. Students can fully understand the cutting-edge technology of cobots while fully mastering the debugging, testing, control, and application methods of cobots, and cultivate students ' ability to use the knowledge they have learned to engage in scientific research and development in the field of robotics. This course mainly introduces the software and hardware architecture of the cooperative robot control system, and teaches the basic knowledge of robot such as pose analysis, coordinate transformation, link coordinate system and DH parameters, robot forward and inverse kinematics, Jacobian matrix, singularity analysis, joint space motion planning, Cartesian space motion planning, etc. The classic control cases of cooperative robots are analyzed, and students are guided to carry out experiments such as robot control simulation, control program writing, control parameter debugging, etc., so that students can deeply understand the debugging, testing, control and application methods of cooperative robots. Through the experimental teaching and practice of this course, it focuses on cultivating students ' ability to solve complex engineering problems in the field of robotics, laying a foundation for future research and development in the field of robotics, and supporting professional learning results.

default.zh: 本课程设计主要内容是SCARA工业机器人结构与控制系统设计。在本体的整体机械结构设计方面，通过对机器人的运动机构总体设计、机器人关键关节设计等结构设计环节，关节力学分析、电机选型分析等力学电学分析环节，使学生掌握工业机器人的机械设计方法，建立起比较完善的工业机器人设计的知识结构与设计理念，培养学生对于具有较高精度和自动化要求的机器人系统或装置的综合设计能力。在SCARA工业机器人控制系统的体系结构设计方面，主要包括上位机、下位机、执行系统、检测系统、控制系统、相应接口的硬件、软件方案。通过对机器人控制系统的总体设计、控制模型与算法、信息传递和信号的作用等设计环节，使学生掌握工业机器人的控制系统的设计方法，建立起比较完善的工业机器人设计的知识结构与设计理念，培养学生对于具有较高精度和自动化要求的机器人系统或装置的综合设计能力。
default.en: The main content of this course design is the overall mechanical structure and control system designs of the SCARA industrial robot. Through the overall design of the movement mechanism of the robot, the key joint design of the robot, mechanical Analysis of the robot joints, selection analysis of drive motor and so on design analysis course. This allows students to master the mechanical design methods of industrial robots and to establish a more complete knowledge structure and the design concept of industrial robot. At the same time, it can train students' comprehensive design capabilities for robotic systems or devices with higher precision and automation requirements. The design of the control system of the SCARA industrial robot mainly includes the upper computer, lower computer, execution system, detection system, control system, solutions of the corresponding interfaces of the hardware and software. Through the overall design of the robot control system, control models and algorithms, information transfer and the role of signals and other design aspects, so that students master the design methods of the control system of industrial robots and to establish a more complete knowledge structure and the design concept of industrial robot. At the same time, it can train students' comprehensive design capabilities for robotic systems or devices with higher precision and automation requirements.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本专业学生的最后一个学习环节，采用基于项目学习的方式，目的是使学生充分利用所学专业知识，熟悉本专业工作内容，通过查阅专业资料，综合运用所学专业知识，确定处理方案，选择适宜方法，进行创新和实践，综合解决本专业实际工程技术问题。毕业设计是学生走向社会独立解决工程问题的一次演习，通过毕业设计使学生初步掌握解决工程实际问题的能力。让学生在毕业设计中获得宝贵的实践经验和本领，从而为建设制造强国奠定坚实的技术基础。
default.en: The graduation thesis (design) is the last stage of learning for students in this major, adopting a project-based learning approach. The purpose is to enable students to fully utilize their professional knowledge, familiarize themselves with the work content of this major, consult professional materials, comprehensively apply their professional knowledge, determine processing plans, choose appropriate methods, innovate and practice, and comprehensively solve practical engineering and technical problems in this major. The graduation project is an exercise for students to independently solve engineering problems in society. Through the graduation project, students can initially master the ability to solve practical engineering problems. Enable students to gain valuable practical experience and skills in their graduation projects, thereby laying a solid technical foundation for building a strong manufacturing country.

default.zh: 本课程是机电工程学院学生须掌握的一门重要技术实践课，是考察学生对工程制图基础，机械原理，机械设计，制造技术基础综合课程设计、机电一体化系统设计，机电系统控制基础，机器人学等先修课程学习掌握情况的验证性课程，也是学生后续学习智能制造工程专业课程如智能装备与系统、数字化设计与制造、智能制造装备创新设计、智能制造系统建模与仿真等课程的基础，可以使学生充分了解智能制造系统的现状及发展趋势，并掌握智能制造系统的基础知识和结构设计方法，培养学生利用所学知识在智能制造技术领域从事科研和开发工作的能力。
default.en: This course is an important technical practice course for students of the School of Mechatronic engineering, manufacturing Technology foundation-integrated curriculum design, Mechatronics Engineering System Design, Electromechanical System Control Foundation, Robotics, etc. , it is also the basis for students to follow the courses of intelligent manufacturing engineering, such as intelligent equipment and systems, digital design and manufacturing, innovative design of intelligent manufacturing equipment, modeling and simulation of intelligent manufacturing system, etc. , students can fully understand the current situation and development trend of the intelligent manufacturing system, and grasp the basic knowledge and structure design methods of the intelligent manufacturing system, to develop students' ability to engage in scientific research and development in the field of intelligent manufacturing technology.

default.zh: 智能制造工程专业要求毕业生具有较高的实践性能力，毕业论文（设计）是本专业学生的最后一个教学环节，也是学生走向社会独立解决工程问题的一次演习。主要目的是通过分散式教学方式，在固定专业教师的指导下，结合实践完成某个命题项目的论文或设计，培养学生综合运用所学的基础理论知识和专业知识分析和解决机械工程技术领域的工程技术问题的能力，为走向社会奠定坚实的工作基础。本专业毕业设计按照基于项目的学习方法组织和管理。通过基于项目的毕业设计，进一步深化和拓宽学生的知识面，提高学生的自学能力和独立工作的能力；培养学生的团队精神、创新精神；使学生受到工程师的基本训练，培养其开展生产实践或科学研究工作的初步能力。
default.en: The Intelligent Manufacturing Engineering major requires graduates to have high practical abilities. The graduation thesis (design) is the last teaching stage for students in this major, and it is also an exercise for students to independently solve engineering problems in society. The main purpose is to cultivate the ability of students to comprehensively apply their basic theoretical and professional knowledge to analyze and solve engineering technical problems in the field of mechanical engineering technology through a decentralized teaching method, under the guidance of fixed professional teachers, combined with practice to complete a thesis or design of a certain proposition project, and to lay a solid work foundation for entering society. The graduation project of this major is organized and managed according to project-based learning methods. Through project-based graduation design, further deepen and broaden students' knowledge, improve their self-learning ability and independent work ability; Cultivate students' team spirit and innovative spirit; Provide students with basic training as engineers and cultivate their initial abilities to carry out production practice or scientific research work.

default.zh: 该课程面向我校未来技术学院智能机器人特色班开设，课程内容涵盖机械设计与制造、机电一体化、工业机器人专业、计算机辅助设计与制造、电气自动化技术、数控技术、计算机控制技术、机电一体化技术、精密机械技术等相关专业内容，主动打破传统专业学科壁垒，推动专业学科交叉融合，促进理工结合、工工交叉，助力未来技术学院扎实推进新工科建设再深化、再拓展、再突破、再出发，推行多学科交叉融合的课程体系建设。 课程以工程训练实训课程优势资源为基础，通过课赛融合，以赛促学的方式促进学生多学科交叉融合的实践与创新能力提升。本课程在学习机械设计基础、公差与配合、机械制造基础、应用电子技术等课程的基础上，进一步培养学生综合运用机械设计、公差与配合、机械制造、机电一体化和应用电子技术等专业基础理论和综合应用的能力。通过使用Solid works、NX等三维数字化设计软件，掌握机器人的结构设计基本方法，并将其应用于实际项目当中。同时通过课程配套的机器人设备及工具实验室，供学生进行机器人的实体构建与调试实验，实操各类机械加工设备、电子调试设备以及编程与控制单元，并将学科竞赛和校级自主品牌竞赛、学生活动社团作为课程的“出口”，以此提升学生的知识理解和综合实践能力。
default.en: This course is designed for the intelligent robot specialty class of our school's Future Technology Institute. The course content covers related professional fields such as mechanical design and manufacturing, mechatronics, industrial robotics, computer-aided design and manufacturing, electrical automation technology, numerical control technology, computer control technology, mechatronics technology, precision machinery technology, etc. It actively breaks through the traditional barriers of professional disciplines, promotes the integration and intersection of professional disciplines, facilitates the combination of science and engineering, the intersection of various engineering fields, and helps the Future Technology Institute to solidly promote the deepening, expansion, breakthrough, and re-launch of the construction of new engineering disciplines, and implement a curriculum system that promotes multi-disciplinary integration. Based on the advantageous resources of engineering training and practical courses, this course promotes students' practical and innovative abilities in multi-disciplinary integration through the integration of competitions and learning. On the basis of learning basic mechanical design, tolerance and fit, basic manufacturing technology, applied electronics technology, etc., this course further cultivates students' ability to comprehensively apply professional basic theories such as mechanical design, tolerance and fit, manufacturing, mechatronics, and applied electronics technology. By using Solid works, NX and other three-dimensional digital design software, students can master the basic methods of structural design for robots and apply them to actual projects. At the same time, through the robot equipment and tool laboratory provided by the course, students can conduct physical construction and debugging experiments of robots, operate various types of mechanical processing equipment, electronic debugging equipment, programming and control units, and take subject competitions and school-level independent brand competitions, student activities and associations as the "exit" of the course. In this way, it enhances students' knowledge understanding and comprehensive practical ability.

default.zh: “综合实践与生产实习(仿生机器人综合实践)”是仿生科学与工程专业一门重要的实践课程。学生需要综合运用先修课程中所学相关知识与技能，从整机出发，强调总体设计的思想，进行仿生扑翼飞行器的总体设计，完成设计参数的计算，并对传动机构、扑翼机构等进行结构设计、建模仿真、加工制造及飞行测试。考核环节包括设计过程、答辩表现、图纸及样机三个部分。样机的研制需能够满足设计要求。本实践课程综合培养学生的总体设计、机械结构计算、飞行控制及软件编写能力，着重培养学生正确的设计思想、创新思维，培养学生的创新能力及综合运用知识的能力。
default.en: Comprehensive Practice and Production Internship (Comprehensive Practice in Biomimetic Robots) is an important practical course in the field of biomimetic science and engineering. Students need to comprehensively apply the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses, starting from the entire machine, emphasizing the concept of overall design, to carry out the overall design of biomimetic flapping wing aircraft, complete the calculation of design parameters, and carry out mechanical design, modeling and simulation, production and manufacturing, and flight testing, etc. The assessment process includes three parts: design process, presentation, drawings and prototype development. The development of the prototype needs to meet the design requirements. This practical course comprehensively cultivates students' abilities in overall design, mechanical structure calculation, flight control, and software development, with a focus on cultivating students' correct design thinking and innovative thinking, as well as their innovative ability and ability to comprehensively apply knowledge.

default.zh: 航空宇航制造工程专业要求毕业生具有较高的实践性能力，毕业论文（设计）是本专业学生的最后一个教学环节，也是学生走向社会独立解决工程问题的一次演习。毕业论文（设计）课程按照基于项目的学习方法组织和管理，学分为8学分，需在16周内完成教学任务。其主要目的是通过分散式教学方式，在固定专业教师的指导下，结合实践完成某个命题项目的论文或设计，培养学生综合运用所学的基础理论知识和专业知识，具有分析和解决多学科工程技术领域的工程技术问题的能力，为走向社会奠定坚实的工作基础。
default.en: The Aerospace Manufacturing Engineering majors require graduates to have high practical ability. Graduation thesis (design) is the last teaching link for students of this major, and it is also a drill for students to solve engineering problems independently in society. The graduation thesis (Design) course is organized and managed according to the project-based learning method. It is divided into eight credits, and the teaching task needs to be completed within 16 weeks. Its primary purposes are: (1) to complete the thesis or design of a particular proposition project with practice under the guidance of fixed professional teachers through distributed teaching methods (2) to train students to comprehensively apply the basic theoretical knowledge and professional knowledge they have learned. (3) to have the ability to analyze and solve engineering and technical problems in the field of multidisciplinary engineering technology and lay a solid foundation for society's work.

default.zh: 本课程是面向全校各年级各专业本科生开放的选修课。 学生围绕“励志摆件的精雕细刻”主题，完成“图形绘制”、“数控编程”、“数控雕刻”和“手工雕刻”四个实验项目。 通过本课程的实践锻炼，使学生在参加劳动实践的过程中，出力流汗，磨练意志，树立正确的劳动观，感悟劳动精神，培养规范意识、安全意识、质量意识和专注的品质。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduate students of all grades and majors in HIT. Students will complete four experimental projects, namely, "graphic drawing", "CNC programming", "CNC carving", and "manual carving", around the theme of "exquisite carving of inspirational ornaments" The practical training of this course will temper students’ willpowers. It is also benifit to establish correct values on labor and feel the spirit of labor. During the process of participating in labor practice, standardization awareness, safety awareness, quality awareness will also be trained.

default.zh: 机械产品创新设计及仿真是进行产品创新、技术创新的重要手段，是智能制造的关键基础。要适应制造业数字化、智能化的发展趋势，就必须最大化发挥机械产品三维设计技术对制造业人才提升的效能。课程目的在于促进学生的实践能力和创新精神，引导大学生对数字样机技术与应用能力，培养其创新设计能力、综合设计能力和团队协作能力。加强学生设计能力培养和工程实践训练，提高学生针对实际需求，通过创新思维进行机械设计的能力。同时吸引、鼓励学生踊跃参加课外科技活动，为优秀人才脱颖而出提供条件。运用三维工具来实现模型的虚拟创建，修改，完善，分析等一系列的数字化操作。学生在学习过程中主动地去寻找答案、解决难题，既得到满意的机械设计作品又学到足够的知识。
default.en: Innovative Design and Simulation of Mechanical Products is an important means of product innovation and technology innovation, and is the key basis of intelligent manufacturing. In order to adapt to the development trend of digital and intelligent manufacturing industry, we must maximize the effect of three-dimensional design technology of mechanical products on the promotion of manufacturing talents. The purpose of this course is to promote students' practical ability and innovative spirit, guide college students' ability of digital prototype technology and application, and cultivate their innovative design ability, comprehensive design ability and team cooperation ability. Strengthen the cultivation of students' design ability and engineering practice training, and improve the students' ability of mechanical design through innovative thinking according to the actual needs. At the same time, attract and encourage students to actively participate in extracurricular science and technology activities, so as to provide conditions for outstanding talents to stand out. A series of digital operations such as virtual creation, modification, improvement and analysis of the model are realized by using 3D tools. In the process of learning, students take the initiative to find answers and solve problems, so as to obtain satisfactory mechanical design works and learn enough knowledge.

default.zh: 本课程采用课赛融合的新教学模式，课程以设计并制作机器人为主，竞赛为辅，机器人设计包括机器人机械结构设计及制作、电路板设计及制作、arduino程序编写（图形化编程、代码编程），通过团队协作完成机器人联合调试，最终进行竞技比赛。 本课程特点：1、理论实践相结合，通过学习机器人相关理论知识，运用到机器人实践课程中。2、内容从入门到精通，适用于初学者。3、本课程的实践课程，注重赛课融合的教学模式，以竞赛作为出口，学习机器人相关内容，最终，利用竞技机器人并完成竞赛。4、以学生为中心，通过任务及竞赛作为驱动，充分调动学生的能动性及创造性。
default.en: This course adopts a new teaching mode integrating competition with class. The course focuses on robot design and production, supplemented by competition. Robot design includes robot mechanical structure design and production, circuit board design and production, arduino programming (graphic programming, code programming). Through team cooperation to complete the robot joint debugging, and finally competitive competition. Features of this course: 1. Combining theory and practice, we can learn the theoretical knowledge related to robots and apply it to the practical course of robots. 2, content from entry to mastery, suitable for beginners. 3. The practical course of this course focuses on the teaching mode of integration of competition and lessons, takes competition as the export to learn related contents of robots, and finally uses competitive robots to complete the competition. 4. Student-centered, driven by tasks and competitions, fully mobilize students' initiative and creativity.

default.zh: 创新设计的内容为仿生机械，学生利用一个学期的业余时间完成创新设计内容。具体分为创新设计动员、方案设计、方案评审、中期检查、答辩和评定成绩五个阶段。在教师的启发和指导下，学生以组为单位根据兴趣以及收集的相关资料确定一种或几种仿生机械作为研究对象，提出较为完整的机构实现方案和控制方案，并自主地进行相关内容科技文献检索、方案设计、虚拟仿真、绘制加工图纸、撰写设计说明书并进行答辩。对方案设计合理、结构设计正确的优秀作品，按所绘制加工图纸进行制造、装配、调试，达到设计性能要求，并在第五学期评奖。通过机构综合实现生物的动作行为，通过控制达到动作的协调运动。培养学生对机械系统及控制系统综合设计能力和创新能力，增强学生科研开发和工程实践能力，培养学生的团队协作精神。
default.en: The content of the innovative design is bionic; the students take advantage of the spare time of a semester to complete the innovative design. Specific divided into five stages of the mobilization of innovative design, program design, program evaluation, mid-term examination, the respondent and assessment scores. Under the inspiration and guidance of teachers, student group as a unit identify one or several bionic as an object of study based on the interest and the collection of information, put forward a more complete organization and control programs, and independent retrieval related scientific literature, program design, virtual simulation, drawing machining drawing, writing design specifications and the respondent. For the program design is reasonable, correct structure design outstanding works, manufacturing, assembly, commissioning in accordance with the machining drawing drawn, to achieve the design performance requirements, and in the fifth semester awards. Achieve biological action behavior by institutions, and to achieve co-ordination action by controlling. Train Students’ mechanical system and control system design and innovative ability, Enhance students' research and development and engineering practice, and students’ teamwork Spirit.

default.zh: 二十一世纪，医学正在发生革命性变化，信息技术正在创造医疗新途径，工程科技在加速医疗装备创新。生物信息、人工智能、大数据、物联网、纳米科学与新材料、机器人与新装备广泛而深入地与医学、健康科学交叉融合，精准医学、转化医学、智能医学等新医学科学与技术应运而生。本课程将全面系统介绍新医学科学领域的最技术内涵及最新发展。
default.en: In the 21st century, medicine is undergoing revolutionary changes, information technology is creating new approaches to medical treatment, and engineering technology is accelerating the innovation of medical equipment. Bioinformatics, artificial intelligence, big data, Internet of Things, nano science and new materials, robotics and new equipment are extensively and deeply integrated with medicine and health science, and new medical science and technology such as precision medicine, translational medicine, and intelligent medicine emerge as the times require. This course will comprehensively and systematically introduce the latest technical connotation and development in the field of new medical science.

default.zh: 生物安全与医学伦理是一门新兴的交叉学科。其中生物安全学是一门研究生物性传染媒介对生态环境和人类健康产生威胁或潜在影响的学科，与农林、食品、环境、医学等领域都密不可分。生物安全不仅是科学问题，更是关系到生态、食品等诸多领域，影响到国家经济发展和社会和谐与稳定的问题。伴随这社会和科学的发展，人类逐渐解决了粮食、医药、环保等问题。但同时也面对着新的挑战，各种生物入侵、各类传染性疾病、转基因生物及食品安全性、基因生物技术等，引起了人们对这些实际问题和潜在风险的关注。医学伦理学是人文学科与自然科学联系最紧密、影响最深刻和最直接的交叉学科，是生命科学技术与卫生事业发展的政策、策略与立法的基础，具有实践性、跨文化性和全球性。本课程旨在研究各个时代的医德关系和医德现象，揭示医德的起源、本质、作用和发展规律，研究医德评价的标准和方法，力图结合我国社会主义医疗体制改革过程中出现的新的现实问题，尝试对现代医疗生活中出现的种种令人费解的道德难题加以探讨，并进行多方面的实践归纳和深层次的理论分析，回答现代医疗实践和医学发展中提出的伦理难题。
default.en: Biosafety and medical ethics are a new interdisciplinary subject. Among them, biosafety is a subject that studies the threat or potential impact of biological infectious agents on the ecological environment and human health, which is inseparable from agriculture and forestry, food, environment, medicine and other fields. Biosafety is not only a scientific problem, but also related to ecology, food and many other fields, affecting national economic development and social harmony and stability. With the development of society and science, human beings have gradually solved the problems of food, medicine, environmental protection and so on. But at the same time, it is also facing new challenges, such as various biological invasions, various infectious diseases, genetically modified organisms and food safety, which have attracted people's attention to these practical problems and potential risks. Medical ethics is an interdisciplinary subject with the closest connection between Humanities and natural science, the most profound and direct influence. It is the basis of policies, strategies and legislation for the development of life science and technology and health undertakings. It is practical, cross-cultural and global. This course aims to study the relationship and phenomenon of medical ethics in various times, reveal the origin, essence, function and development law of medical ethics, study the standards and methods of medical ethics evaluation, try to combine the new practical problems in the process of China's socialist medical system reform, try to explore various puzzling moral problems in modern medical life, and conduct various practical induction and deep-seated theoretical analysis, answer the ethical problems raised in modern medical practice and medical development.

default.zh: 《生物化学与分子生物学》是一门在分子水平上阐述生命现象化学本质的科学，是研究生物分子（包括蛋白质、核酸、酶、糖类、脂质）的结构与功能，生物分子在生物体内的物质代谢的科学，是在分子水平上阐释遗传信息传递等精细分子机制的核心知识和前沿理论。 《生物化学与分子生物学》作为当今生命科学领域内最为活跃与其他学科广泛交叉渗透的前沿课程，其理论和技术快速发展。在生物信息学、智能医学工程、生物医学科学专业的课程教学体系中具有举足轻重的作用，为基因组学、功能基因组学、合成生物学、细胞生物学、医学遗传学、医学微生物学与免疫学、基因工程等课程提供支撑。本课程旨在使学生掌握生物化学与分子生物学基础理论和基本实验技能，了解当前生命科学领域的最新发展以及与多学科交叉融合现状，进而培养学生科学创新的思维方式，提高学生利用生物化学与分子生物学相关知识发现科学问题、解决生命科学问题的综合能力。
default.en: Biochemistry and Molecular Biology that elaborates on the chemical essence of life phenomena at the molecular level, and studies the structure and function of biological molecules (including proteins, nucleic acids, enzymes, sugars, and lipids), the metabolism of biological molecules in organisms, as well as fine molecular mechanisms of genetic information transmission at the molecular level. Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, as the most active and widely interdisciplinary cutting-edge course in the field of life sciences, has rapidly developed its theory and technology. It plays a crucial role in the curriculum teaching system of bioinformatics, intelligent medical engineering, and biomedical science, providing support for courses such as Genomics, Functional genomics, Synthetic biology, Cell biology, Medical genetics, Medical microbiology and immunology, and Genetic engineering. This course aims to enable students to master the basic theories and experimental skills of biochemistry and molecular biology, understand the latest developments in the field of life sciences and the current situation of interdisciplinary integration, and cultivate students' scientific and innovative thinking methods. It also enhances students' comprehensive abilities to discover scientific problems and solve life science problems by utilizing knowledge related to biochemistry and molecular biology.

default.zh: 一、 课程导言：什么是生物物理学？ 生命是什么？这个古老的问题在21世纪正通过一门充满活力的交叉学科——生物物理学——得到前所未有的深刻解答。我们不再仅仅满足于描述生命现象（如细胞分裂、神经冲动、肌肉收缩），而是渴望从物理学的基本原理出发， 定量地、可预测地 理解生命过程的底层逻辑。 本课程将以诺贝尔奖得主薛定谔的经典著作《生命是什么？》为思想起点，以菲利普·纳尔逊教授的经典教材《生物物理学：能量、信息、生命》为蓝本，带领大家开启一场探索生命奥秘的定量之旅。我们将学习生命系统如何巧妙地利用物理定律，在分子尺度上处理能量与信息，最终涌现出不可思议的生命活动。 二、 核心教材与课程理念 菲利普·纳尔逊的这本书被誉为生物物理学领域的“圣经”之一，其成功之处在于它完美地平衡了物理的严谨与生物的趣味。本书及本课程的核心理念是： 1. 物理第一性原理： 我们坚信，生命现象尽管复杂，但依然遵循基本的物理定律（热力学、统计力学、量子力学）。课程将从这些最基本的原理出发，推导出理解生命所需的工具和概念。 2. 定量化与建模：我们将摒弃“大概是”、“可能是”的定性描述，转而追求“是多少”、“为什么是这个数值”的定量回答。你将学会如何为生物过程构建简单的物理模型，并进行估算。 3. “自下而上”的探索：课程重点聚焦在分子和细胞尺度，从构成生命的分子机器（如蛋白质、DNA）的工作原理入手，逐步构建对细胞乃至更复杂系统的理解。 三、 课程核心内容模块 本课程将围绕教材的核心脉络“能量、信息、生命”三大主题展开，主要涵盖以下模块： 模块一：生命的热力学基础——能量的游戏 生命是开放的非平衡系统，其核心在于能量转换。本模块将探讨： 生命与热力学第二定律：生命如何通过消耗能量来创造局部的有序，以对抗宇宙中无处不在的熵增？ 自由能：生命的货币：深入理解吉布斯自由能的概念。它是驱动所有生化反应（从ATP水解到DNA合成）的真正推手。 化学势与驱动力：学习如何计算粒子从高浓度流向低浓度、或者被电势差驱动时所蕴含的能量。 模块二：分子机器与随机性——生命在纳米世界的舞蹈 在细胞这个拥挤而嘈杂的纳米世界里，随机热运动占主导地位。本模块将揭示生命如何利用而非对抗这种随机性： 扩散：生命的交通方式：学习分子如何通过随机行走（布朗运动）在细胞内找到它的目标。这解释了为什么小分子扩散迅速，而大分子却步履蹒跚。 分子马达与定向运动：探索驱动蛋白、肌球蛋白等“微型机器人”如何将化学能（ATP）转化为机械能，实现物质的定向运输和肌肉收缩。我们将用简单的随机模型（“棘轮模型”）来理解其工作原理。 速率与能垒：利用阿伦尼乌斯方程和过渡态理论，理解温度、活化能如何决定一个生化反应的快慢。 模块三：信息与生命——从序列到功能 生命不仅是物质的、能量的，更是信息的。 信息论基础： 从香农熵的角度理解DNA序列、蛋白质序列所承载的信息量。 基因调控与“决策”：构建物理模型来解释基因开关（如λ噬菌体开关）如何像电路一样工作，基于输入信号（蛋白质浓度）做出“开”或“关”的决策。这将引入协同结合、希尔方程等关键概念。 自组装：信息如何构建结构：学习病毒衣壳、细胞膜等复杂结构如何通过分子间弱相互作用的精确指令（编码在分子自身的信息中）自发地组装起来。 模块四：神经生物物理学——电脉冲与信息处理 静息膜电位：从能斯特方程和唐南平衡出发，定量推导出细胞膜内外电势差的来源。 动作电位：深入霍奇金-赫胥黎模型，理解电压门控离子通道如何协同工作，产生和传导全或无的电信号脉冲，这是神经系统信息编码的基础。 四、 课程特色与学习方法 跨学科思维：本课程是物理、化学、生物学和工程学思想的熔炉。你将学会用物理学的工具解决生物学问题。 重视数量级估算： 课程强调“信封背面计算”（back-of-the-envelope calculation），培养你凭借基本常数和简单推理，对生物物理问题（如一个细胞有多少个ATP分子？一个马达蛋白的力有多大？）进行快速估算的能力，这是科研中极其重要的技能。 适度的数学工具：课程将使用到微积分、概率论和基础微分方程。但请放心，重点是概念的理解而非复杂的数学推导。教材会循序渐进地介绍所需数学知识。 五、 结语 《生物物理学：能量、信息、生命》及其所代表的课程，为我们提供了一副全新的“眼镜”。戴上它，你看待生命世界的视角将彻底改变：一个细胞的运作不再神秘，它是一台精妙绝伦的、由物理定律驱动的分子机器；一段DNA不仅是蓝图的载体，更是一个信息存储的设备；一个神经脉冲不仅是电信号，更是一个可控的物理波。 欢迎加入我们，共同解密生命在能量与信息维度上的物理诗篇。
default.en: I. Course Introduction: What is Biophysics? What is life? Biophysics addresses this ancient question by applying physics' fundamental principles to understand life processes quantitatively and predictably , moving beyond mere description of phenomena like cell division or nerve impulses. Using Schr？dinger's “What is Life?” as a starting point and Nelson's Biological Physics: Energy, Information, Life as a guide, this course explores how living systems utilize physical laws at the molecular scale to process energy and information. II. Core Textbook and Course Philosophy Nelson's textbook, a field "bible," balances physical rigor with biological fascination. The course philosophy is: 1. Physical First Principles: Life obeys fundamental physical laws (thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, quantum mechanics). We derive understanding from these principles. 2. Quantification and Modeling: We pursue quantitative answers ("how much?", "why this value?") by building simple physical models and performing estimations. 3. "Bottom-Up" Exploration: Focus is on the molecular and cellular scales, starting from molecular machines (proteins, DNA) to build an understanding of complex systems. III. Course Core Content Modules The course revolves around the themes "Energy, Information, Life." Module 1: Thermodynamic Foundations of Life – The Energy Game Life is an open, non-equilibrium system based on energy conversion. Life and the Second Law: How life creates local order by consuming energy to counter entropy. Free Energy: The Currency of Life: Gibbs free energy as the driver of biochemical reactions. Chemical Potential and Driving Forces: Calculating energy from particle concentration gradients or electrical potentials. Module 2: Molecular Machines and Randomness – Life's Dance in the Nano-World This module explores harnessing random thermal motion. Diffusion: Life's Transportation System: Molecular targeting via random walks (Brownian motion). Molecular Motors and Directed Motion: How kinesin/myosin convert ATP to mechanical energy for transport/contraction, explained via stochastic models. Rates and Energy Barriers: How temperature/activation energy determine reaction rates (Arrhenius equation, transition state theory). Module 3: Information and Life – From Sequence to Function Life is matter, energy, and information. Information Theory Basics: Shannon entropy and information in DNA/protein sequences. Gene Regulation and "Decision Making": Physical models of genetic switches (e.g., lambda phage) making on/off decisions, introducing cooperative binding/Hill equation. Self-Assembly: How information in molecules guides spontaneous assembly of structures (viral capsids, membranes) via weak interactions. Module 4: Neurobiophysics – Electrical Pulses and Information Processing Resting Membrane Potential: Deriving the membrane potential origin (Nernst equation, Donnan equilibrium). Action Potential: How voltage-gated ion channels generate/propagate signals (Hodgkin-Huxley model), the basis of neural encoding. IV. Course Features and Learning Approach Interdisciplinary Thinking: A melting pot of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering. Order-of-Magnitude Estimation: Cultivating "back-of-the-envelope calculation" skills for rapid estimation using fundamental constants. Moderate Mathematical Tools: Using calculus, probability, and basic differential equations with a focus on conceptual understanding. V. Conclusion Biological Physics: Energy, Information, Life offers a new lens: a cell becomes a physical molecular machine; DNA, an information storage device; a nerve impulse, a controllable wave. Join us to decipher the physical poetry of life across energy and information.

default.zh: “新医科”是国家为应对新科技革命和产业变革提出的“四新”之一，是为了适应新一轮科技革命和产业变革的要求，提出的从治疗为主到兼具预防治疗、康养的生命健康全周期医学的新理念。其具体内容包括精准医学、转化医学、新型医疗设备、新生物检测方法、新生物医药材料等。本课程是新医学科学与技术综合实验的第一部分，旨在向学生介绍新医学的基本概念和研究内容。本课程的主要内容包括人类、动植物遗传物质的提取、分析，以及生物电信号的检测。通过实验课的方式让学生体会新医学给医学发展带来的革命性变化，激励学生将来投身新医学产业和科研工作。
default.en: “New Medical Science” is included in the “4 news” that is proposed to respond to the new technological revolution and industrial update. It is a new concept that contains not only the diagnosis and treatment of diseases but also disease prevention and rehabilitation. A wide range od research fields including precision medicine, translational medicine, new medical equipment, new methods of biosensing, and new medical materials can be included in new medical science and technology. This course is the first part of the “Comprehensive Experiments of New Medical Science and Technology”. It aims at introducing basic concepts and content of new medical science to the students. The main content of the course includes the extraction and analysis of the hereditary substance, and detection of bio signals. It will let the students realize the revolutionary changes brought by new medicine to the development of medicine and encourage students to engage in the industry and research of new medical science.

default.zh: 本课程面向医学与健康学院一年级学生开设，培养学生的科学与工程思维，促进学生的计算思维与生物、医学等思维交叉融合形成复合型思维，为学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算系统求解生物医学学科问题奠定思维基础。
default.en: This course is aimed at first-year students in the School of Medicine and Health, cultivating their scientific and engineering thinking, promoting the integration of computational thinking with biology, medicine, and other thinking to form compound thinking. It lays a thinking foundation for students to design, construct, and apply various computational systems to solve biomedical problems in the future.

default.zh: 生物医学统计是数理统计学的一个重要分支，具有很强的应用性，它在自然科学、社会科学和经济管理等各领域中得到了越来越广泛的应用，是一种非常有用的数据处理方法。 课程中将重点介绍生物医学统计的最具有实用性的内容：基本统计分析、相关分析、回归分析、聚类分析、判别分析、生存分析、Meta分析及诊断试验临床效能评价等。 本门课程授课对象为工科试验班（医学类1），学生已先修微积分B、概率论与数理统计C、代数与几何C等专业基础课程。 针对学生认为深奥难懂的统计学相关知识点，在授课过程中，将尽量结合身边的实例，以实例和问题为引导，增强学生的兴趣，并尽量用简洁易懂的语言来解释和讲解这些统计学专有名词和概念，加深学生的学习理解，将课堂知识真正转化为自己的知识，做到学以致用。 本课程为大类基础课，通过统计学理论与R语言工具相结合，为学生后续能够更深入的学习人工智能、智能诊断学、数据挖掘等课程提供良好的基础。
default.en: Biomedical statistics is an important branch of mathematical statistics, which has strong applicability. It has been increasingly widely used in various fields such as natural science, social science, economic management, etc., and is a very useful data processing method. In this course, we will focus on the most practical contents of biomedical statistics: basic statistical analysis, correlation analysis, regression analysis, cluster analysis, discriminant analysis, survival analysis, Meta-analysis, and clinical efficacy evaluation of diagnostic tests. The teaching object of this course is the Engineering Experimental Class (Medical Category 1), and students have already taken such major basic courses as Calculus B, Probability Theory and Mathematical Statistics C, Algebra and Geometry C, etc. In order to make the difficult statistical knowledge points easier for students to understand, we will combine real-life examples with problems to enhance students' interest during the teaching process. We will try to use simple and understandable language to explain and interpret these statistical terminologies and concepts, deepen students' understanding of the course content, and turn classroom knowledge into their own knowledge, so that they can apply what they have learned. This course is a general basic course, which combines statistical theory with R language tools, providing a good foundation for students to further study courses such as artificial intelligence, intelligent diagnostics and data mining.

default.zh: 《生物信号处理》是智能医学工程、医学信息学、生物医学工程、电子信息工程、信息工程等电子与电气信息类专业最为重要的专业基础课之一。它从理论上建立了完整的对生物信号和离散系统的分析方法和系统模型，从时域和变换域等多个角度为信号与系统的分析与求解提供了系统而有效的解决方案，同时给出了多种滤波器的设计和计算方法。生物信号处理是理论性和工程性都很强的学科，该课程注重“生物信号处理”的理论与工程应用的紧密结合 , 使学生深入理解信号处理的内涵和实质。
default.en: Biomedical Signal Processing is one of the most important professional basic courses for electronic and electrical information majors such as intelligent medical engineering, medical informatics, biomedical engineering, electronic information engineering, and information engineering. It establishes a complete analysis method and system model for biological signals and discrete systems in theory, and provides a systematic and effective solution for the analysis and solution of signals and systems from multiple perspectives such as time domain and transformation domain. At the same time, it also gives a variety of filter design and calculation methods. Biological signal processing is a subject of strong theory and engineering. This course focuses on the close combination of the theory and engineering application of "biological signal processing", so that students can deeply understand the connotation and essence of signal processing.

default.zh: 《医学基础导论》是为了适应21世纪多学科交叉研究，在教育过程中加强文、理、医互相渗透和多学科交叉融合，探索文、理、医相结合的培养模式和课程体系。《医学基础导论》把医学基础知识作为一个统一的整体，从正常人体的组织形态到生理功能、从病理状态的形态学改变到功能学改变的基本原理，融合《人体解剖学》、《组织学与胚胎学》、《人体生理学》、《病理生理学》、《病理学》、《药理学》等多学科知识，着重于基础医学的本质、特征和发展规律，阐明医学的科学性质、科学领域、分支结构及研究范畴。使学生对基础医学知识有一全面的认识和了解。首先使学生纵向地认识正常人体的构成和基本形态，然后根据组成人体的各系统，进行从形态到功能、从正常到异常、从疾病到药物治疗的横向学习。将基础医学知识纵横、有机地结合起来，有利于学生更全面的掌握基础医学知识，同时为其后期学习相关知识打好坚实的基础。
default.en: 《Introduction of Preclinical Medicine》 is designed to adapt to interdisciplinary research in the 21st century, emphasizing the mutual permeation and interdisciplinary integration of liberal arts, science, and medicine in the educational process. It explores the cultivation mode and curriculum system that integrate liberal arts, science, and medicine. Treating medical foundational knowledge as a unified whole, the course covers the basic principles from the morphological structure of the normal human body to physiological functions and from morphological changes in pathological states to functional alterations. It integrates multidisciplinary knowledge from subjects such as 《Human Anatomy》， 《Histology and Embryology》,《Human Physiology》,《Pathophysiology》,《Pathology》and 《Pharmacology》. The course focuses on the essence, characteristics, and development laws of basic medicine, elucidating the scientific nature, scientific fields, branch structures, and research scopes of medicine. It aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of basic medical knowledge. Initially, students are guided to vertically understand the composition and basic morphology of the normal human body. Subsequently, based on the various systems comprising the human body, students engage in horizontal learning that spans from morphology to functionality, from normal to abnormal, and from disease to drug treatment. The integration of foundational medical knowledge in both vertical and horizontal dimensions facilitates students in gaining a more comprehensive grasp of basic medical knowledge, laying a solid foundation for their later studies in related fields.

default.zh: 《生物化学》是医学类I的大类平台课程，是生物信息学、智能医学工程、生物医学科学专业的专业基础课程，是一门在分子水平上阐述生命现象化学本质的科学。 本课程主要介绍生物分子（包括核酸、蛋白质、酶、糖类、脂类）的结构与功能，以及生物分子在生物体内的新陈代谢过程等内容。旨在使学生掌握生物化学基础理论，了解当前生命科学领域的最新发展以及与多学科交叉融合现状，进而培养学生科学创新的思维方式，提高学生利用生物化学相关知识发现科学问题、解决生命科学问题的综合能力。
default.en: Biochemistry is a major platform course for Medical Class I, and a fundamental course for majors in Bioinformatics, Intelligent Medical Engineering, and Biomedical Science. It is a science that elaborates on the chemical essence of life phenomena at the molecular level. This course mainly introduces the structure and function of biomolecules (including nucleic acids, proteins, enzymes, sugars，lipid), as well as the metabolic processes of biomolecules within the organism. The aim of this course is to enable students to master the basic theories of biochemistry, understand the latest developments in the field of life sciences, and the current situation of interdisciplinary integration, thereby cultivating students' scientific and innovative thinking methods, and improving their comprehensive ability to use knowledge related to biochemistry to discover and solve life science problems.

default.zh: 《分子生物学》是生物信息学、智能医学工程、生物医学科学专业的专业基础课程，是一门在分子水平上阐述生命现象化学本质的科学，是在分子水平上阐释遗传信息传递等精细分子机制的核心知识和前沿理论。 《分子生物学》作为当今生命科学领域内最为活跃与其他学科广泛交叉渗透的前沿课程，其理论和技术快速发展。在生物信息学、智能医学工程、生物医学科学专业的课程教学体系中具有举足轻重的作用，为功能基因组学、合成生物学、系统生物学、细胞生物学、医学遗传学、医学微生物学与免疫学等课程提供支撑，是从分子水平上研究生命现象，揭秘生命本质的基础科学。本课程旨在使学生掌握分子生物学基础理论和基本实验技能，了解当前生命科学领域的最新发展以及与多学科交叉融合现状，进而培养学生科学创新的思维方式，提高学生利用分子生物学相关知识发现科学问题、解决生命科学问题的综合能力。
default.en: Molecular Biology is a fundamental course in the fields of bioinformatics, intelligent medical engineering, and biomedical science. It is a science that elucidates the chemical essence of life phenomena at the molecular level, and provides core knowledge and cutting-edge theories for elucidating fine molecular mechanisms such as genetic information transmission at the molecular level. Molecular Biology, as the most active and widely interdisciplinary course in the field of life sciences today, has rapidly developed its theories and technologies. It plays a crucial role in the curriculum and teaching system of bioinformatics, intelligent medical engineering, and biomedical science majors, providing support for courses such as functional genomics, synthetic biology, systems biology, cell biology, medical genetics, medical microbiology, and immunology. It is a fundamental science that studies life phenomena at the molecular level and reveals the essence of life. The purpose of this course is to enable students to master the basic theories and experimental skills of molecular biology, understand the latest developments in the field of life sciences and the current situation of interdisciplinary integration, and cultivate students' scientific and innovative thinking, thereby improving their comprehensive ability to use molecular biology related knowledge to discover scientific problems and solve life science problems.

default.zh: 《分子生物学综合实验》是医学类I的大类平台课程，是生物信息学、智能医学工程、生物医学科学专业的基础实践课程，开设本课程的目的是使学生掌握分子生物学的基本理论和常规实验技术，具备应用现代分子生物学技术手段，研究生物大分子的初步能力；并培养学生发现问题、分析问题和解决问题的基本技能，培养学生端正的科研态度和独立思考解决问题的能力，为今后从事生命科学、分子生物学等相关领域的科学研究奠定基础。
default.en: Molecular Biology Comprehensive Experiment is a major platform course for medical category I, which is a basic practical course for bioinformatics, intelligent medical engineering, and biomedical science majors. The purpose of offering this course is to enable students to master the basic theories and conventional experimental techniques of molecular biology, and to have the preliminary ability to apply modern molecular biology techniques to study biomolecules; And cultivate students' basic skills of discovering, analyzing and solving problems, cultivate their correct scientific research attitude and independent thinking and problem-solving ability, laying a foundation for future scientific research in fields such as life sciences and molecular biology.

default.zh: 《脑机接口原理》是由医学与健康学院面向生物医学工程、智能医学工程等相关专业学生开设的一门专业选修课程。本课程立足于神经科学、信息科学和临床医学的交叉前沿，系统介绍脑机接口（Brain-Computer Interface, BCI）的基本原理、关键技术及其在多个领域中的创新应用，旨在培养学生跨学科的系统思维与工程实践能力，为其将来在神经工程、康复医学和智能医疗设备等方向的深入研究或工程开发奠定基础。 课程内容涵盖神经生理基础、生物信号采集与处理、解码算法与应用系统设计等方面。学生将首先学习大脑结构与神经信号产生的基本机制，包括脑电（EEG）、皮质脑电（ECoG）等多模态神经信号的特性与采集方法。在此基础上，课程重点介绍信号预处理、特征提取与模式识别等关键处理技术，尤其是基于机器学习的神经信号解码方法，帮助学生掌握从原始信号到控制指令的完整处理流程。 在掌握基本原理与技术方法之后，课程将进一步深入脑机接口的系统架构与典型应用场景。学生将了解非侵入式、侵入式等多种BCI系统的构成与性能特点，并通过真实案例学习BCI在卒中康复、运动功能替代、意识障碍沟通、虚拟现实交互和认知增强等领域的实际应用。课程强调“理论-技术-应用”三位一体的知识整合，帮助学生形成对BCI系统从底层机制到顶层设计的全面认识。 为强化学生的综合创新与实践能力，本课程采用理论讲授与上机实践相结合的教学模式。学生将在MATLAB或Python平台中完成信号处理与解码算法的实现任务，并尝试设计简单的BCI功能原型。通过实验操作和项目实践，学生可切实提升多模态神经信号处理、解码模型构建和系统集成方面的工程能力，初步具备设计与开发脑机接口解决方案的能力。 除了技术与方法的训练，本课程高度重视科技伦理与社会责任的培养。课程设置专门模块，引导学生探讨脑机接口技术带来的隐私安全、人格身份、社会公平、伦理边界等深刻议题，帮助学生树立符合技术规范与社会价值观的责任意识，理解创新与约束之间的平衡关系。 修读本课程的学生应具备一定的生物医学信号处理或程序设计基础。完成课程后，学生不仅能够掌握脑机接口的核心原理和关键技术，还将具备跨学科合作与创新的初步能力，可在医疗康复设备、智能人机交互、神经工程等领域从事研究、开发或应用工作，为未来成长为新一代生物医学工程师和健康科技创新人才奠定扎实基础。
default.en: Principles of Brain-Computer Interfaces is an elective course offered by the School of Medicine and Health, designed for students majoring in Biomedical Engineering, Intelligent Medical Engineering, and related disciplines. This course situates itself at the intersection of neuroscience, information science, and clinical medicine, providing a systematic introduction to the fundamental principles, key technologies, and innovative applications of brain-computer interfaces (BCI). It aims to cultivate students' interdisciplinary systems thinking and engineering practice capabilities, laying a solid foundation for future research or engineering development in neural engineering, rehabilitation medicine, intelligent medical devices, and other related fields. The curriculum covers neurophysiological fundamentals, biosignal acquisition and processing, decoding algorithms, and the design of application systems. Students will first learn the basic mechanisms of brain structure and neural signal generation, including the characteristics and acquisition methods of multimodal neural signals such as electroencephalography (EEG) and electrocorticography (ECoG). Building on this foundation, the course emphasizes key processing techniques such as signal preprocessing, feature extraction, and pattern recognition—particularly machine learning-based neural signal decoding methods—enabling students to master the complete pipeline from raw signal processing to control command generation. After establishing a firm grasp of the core principles and technical methodologies, the course further delves into the system architecture of BCI and its typical application scenarios. Students will examine the composition and performance characteristics of various BCI systems, including non-invasive and invasive approaches, and study real-world use cases in areas such as stroke rehabilitation, motor function substitution, communication for patients with disorders of consciousness, virtual reality interaction, and cognitive enhancement. The course emphasizes the integration of theory, technology, and application, fostering a comprehensive understanding of BCI systems from underlying mechanisms to top-level design. To strengthen students’ comprehensive innovation and practical abilities, the course adopts a teaching model that combines theoretical instruction with hands-on computer practice. Students will implement signal processing and decoding algorithms using platforms such as MATLAB or Python, and attempt to design functional prototypes of simple BCI systems. Through experimental exercises and project-based learning, students will enhance their engineering capabilities in multimodal neural signal processing, decoding model construction, and system integration, gradually developing preliminary competence in designing and developing BCI solutions. In addition to technical training, the course attaches great importance to ethical awareness and social responsibility. A dedicated module guides students in discussing profound issues brought about by BCI technology, including privacy security, personal identity, social equity, and ethical boundaries. This module aims to help students establish a sense of responsibility that aligns with technical standards and social values, and to understand the balance between innovation and regulation.

default.zh: 《模式识别与机器学习》是医学与健康学院面向医学类本科生开设的一门跨学科大类基础课程。本课程融合计算机科学、统计学与医学应用三大领域，旨在为学生构建扎实的数据分析与智能算法基础，适用于生物医学工程、智能医学工程、人工智能、计算机科学与技术等多个相关专业的学生修读。 课程内容系统全面，涵盖机器学习的基本理论与主流方法，重点围绕监督学习、无监督学习、特征工程和模型评估等核心模块展开教学。在监督学习部分，将介绍分类与回归的经典算法，如支持向量机、决策树与神经网络等；在无监督学习中，聚焦聚类、降维及异常检测等关键方法；特征工程部分着重讲解数据预处理、特征提取与选择策略；模型评估则涉及交叉验证、性能指标及模型优化等实用技术。 区别于普通机器学习课程，本课程特别注重医学领域的应用实践。通过系统讲解机器学习在医学图像识别、生理信号分析和健康大数据处理等方面的典型案例，帮助学生理解算法在实际医学场景中的运用逻辑与实现路径。课程采用理论教学与实例分析相结合的方式，引导学生掌握从数据清洗、特征构建到模型训练与评估的全流程能力，培养其跨学科的系统思维和解决实际医学问题的创新能力。 本课程作为一门基础性桥梁课程，不仅为学生奠定必要的数理与编程基础，更致力于推动其形成计算机技术与医学健康相融合的学科视野。课程结束后，学生将能够理解常用机器学习模型的原理与适用场景，具备初步的医学数据建模与分析能力，为后续深入学习智能医学工程、高级机器学习、医学人工智能等专业课程提供坚实的理论支撑与方法准备。 在健康医疗迈向智能化的时代背景下，掌握模式识别与机器学习技术已成为医学与工程复合型人才不可或缺的核心能力。本课程希望通过系统的训练，培养更多具有创新能力和实践素养的跨学科人才，为推动医学领域的智能化发展贡献力量。
default.en: Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning is an interdisciplinary foundational course designed for undergraduate students in medical and health-related fields. Integrating computer science, statistics, and medical applications, this course focuses on key topics such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, feature engineering, and model evaluation. It is tailored for students majoring in Biomedical Engineering, Intelligent Medical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science and Technology, and related disciplines. The course aims to establish a solid foundation in data analysis and intelligent algorithms. It covers fundamental theories of machine learning, widely-used models, and their applications in areas such as medical image recognition, physiological signal analysis, and health big data processing. Through theoretical instruction and practical case studies, students will learn to apply machine learning techniques to medical data interpretation and intelligent system development. The course seeks to cultivate interdisciplinary thinking and innovation capabilities, providing essential theoretical and methodological support for advanced studies in intelligent medical engineering, pattern recognition, machine learning, and other specialized subjects. This course serves as a critical bridge between computational methods and medical practice, preparing students to contribute to the growing field of AI in health and medicine.

default.zh: 智能诊断原理及技术是一个交叉性的概念，融合了医学、计算机、数理分析相关领域于一体，为医疗事业发展发挥智能化作用。智能诊断学字面意思就是在原有的诊断学基础上，融入人工智能等先进科学技术，使得原有的人为诊断变得更智能化、流程化、个性化。 智能诊断，和精准医学类似，其实质就是基于各种多源数据采用智能算法的诊断。本课程特色：传统的诊断学仅局限于问诊或者看片的过程中，而智能诊断学贯穿于整个医疗服务的始终，无论是诊前筛查、诊中诊断、诊后康复等都涉及到决策过程，其不仅在诊中提供智能而精准的决策方案，同时也在诊前达到了智能预警的功能，达到了治未病的效果，更可以在愈后实现更好的康复及智能居家健康管理，实现全民自主健康管理。因此，本书将在诊断学的医学理论基础之上，融合先进的数字技术，为每位居民提供全流程、全周期、全方位的智能诊断决策，力争为居民健康的“1”保驾护航，为实现国家全民健康助力。 本课程主要围绕当下中国新医学、新医科重大战略部署，从“理论”、“技术”、“应用”三大方面，通过理论与案例相搭配、线上与线下相结合的方式，为本课程的使用者提供很多元化的学习模式。本课程分为三篇，第一篇为“智能诊断学理论”，介绍智能诊断学的基本内容；第二篇为“智能诊断学技术”，介绍典型人工智能、大数据、物联网等新兴的核心数字技术；第三篇为“智能诊断学应用”，介绍智能诊断学在脑科学、影像学、疾病监测等不同领域的应用。通过讲述智能技术下的新的诊断模式新的诊断思路，打造领域前沿的、高水平的智能诊断学教材，推进新医学与新医科领域高水平复合人才队伍培育，助力制造强国、网络强国建设。
default.en: Intelligent diagnostics is an interdisciplinary concept that integrates medicine, computer science, and mathematical and statistical analysis to play an intelligent role in the development of medical services. Literally, intelligent diagnostics refers to the integration of advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence into the original diagnostic methods, making the original human-based diagnosis more intelligent, standardized, and personalized. Similar to precision medicine, the essence of intelligent diagnostics lies in the use of intelligent algorithms based on various types of multi-source data. The unique feature of this course is that, unlike traditional diagnostics limited to consultation or imaging interpretation, intelligent diagnostics the entire process of medical services, involving decision-making in pre-diagnosis screening, diagnosis, and post-diagnosis recovery. It not only provides intelligent and precise decision-making solutions during the diagnosis but also achieves intelligent early warning before the diagnosis, achieving the effect of preventing diseases. It can also achieve better recovery and intelligent home health management after recovery, enabling the whole population to take charge of their health management. Therefore, this course builds upon the medical theoretical foundation of diagnostics, integrating advanced digital technologies to provide intelligent diagnostic decision-making for each resident throughout the entire process, life cycle, and all aspects, aiming to safeguard residents' health and contribute to the national effort in promoting health. Focused on the major strategic deployment of new medicine and medical education in China, this course offers a diversified learning model through a combination of theory and case studies, as well as online and offline methods. It is divided into three sections. The first section, "Theory of Intelligent Diagnostics," introduces the fundamental concepts of intelligent diagnostics. The second section, "Technologies of Intelligent Diagnostics," covers typical emerging core digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data, and the Internet of Things. The third section, "Applications of Intelligent Diagnostics," explores the applications of intelligent diagnostics in different fields like neuroscience, imaging, and disease monitoring. By presenting new diagnostic models and approaches under the guidance of intelligent technologies, this course aims to create a cutting-edge and high-level textbook on intelligent diagnostics, promoting the cultivation of a high-level interdisciplinary talent pool in new medicine and medical education, and supporting the construction of a strong manufacturing and technological nation.

default.zh: “医学数据分析与可视化”课程是面向医学与健康学院大二学生的计算机类必修课程。本课程立足医工交叉融合趋势，以Python为核心工具，衔接医学科研实际需求与大数据技术应用，帮助学生打破“医学 + 计算机”知识壁垒，构建“医学问题驱动 - 数据技术支撑”的思维体系。采用理论讲授与上机实操深度融合的教学模式，引导学生在知识探索与实践应用的交互过程中，掌握Python编程核心知识，理解编程语言及应用方式，深化对医学数据特性、临床科研逻辑的理解，为后续智能医学工程、生物信息学等专业课程学习，以及未来参与智能诊断、精准医疗等领域研究奠定基础。
《生物组学数据编程基础》是一门面向本科生的交叉学科基础课程，融合了生物学、医学与计算机科学的知识体系。课程以 C 语言编程 为主要工具，重点训练学生运用程序分析和解决组学数据问题的思维方法及基本编程技能。通过学习，学生能够建立从 生物数据存储与表示 → 问题抽象与建模 → 算法设计 → 程序实现 的认知框架，掌握以计算方式处理和分析生物医学数据的基本能力，为后续课程学习和科研训练奠定坚实基础。
default.en: "Fundamentals of Biomomics Data Programming" is an interdisciplinary basic course for undergraduate students, integrating the knowledge systems of biology, medicine and computer science. The course takes C language programming as the main tool, focusing on training students' thinking methods and basic programming skills to analyze and solve omics data problems through programming. Through learning, students can establish a cognitive framework from biological data storage and representation → problem abstraction and modeling → algorithm design → program implementation, master the basic ability to process and analyze biomedical data in a computational way, and lay a solid foundation for subsequent course study and scientific research training.

default.zh: 医学概论（1）是医学的融合课程。本课程包括基础医学中的人体解剖学、组织学与胚胎学、生理学及病理学。人体解剖学在宏观上介绍人体的构造，包括人体骨骼、肌肉、神经及血管的分布等；组织学与胚胎学则在微观上介绍人体组织结构、胚胎的发育过程及常见的先天畸形；生理学着重介绍人体各器官及系统的正常功能活动规律；病理学从宏观到微观介绍疾病导致组织和器官的病理变化。学习过程应先了解人体正常结构和功能，再掌握疾病导致人体组织和器官的病理变化。通过课前布置的作业引导学生自主学习、培养学生信息和文献检索能力。案例引导式教学在授课前先引入生活中常见疾病，启发学生学习前先思考，带着问题学习，通过所学寻找问题答案并做到学以致用。授课环节注重学生能力培养，介绍工科相关技术在医学中的应用，逐步培养学生通过工科技术解决医学瓶颈问题的科研思维。课程中融入思政教育和人文教育，启发学生理解人体是有机整体，全身各器官和系统协同作用维持机体稳态、认识疾病发展的客观规律；启发学生认识病理学是诊断疾病的“金标准”。课后作业注重培养学生自主学习的能力，通过课后作业拓展医学健康前沿和科研进展。教育和引导学生敬畏生命、尊重生命、刻苦钻研及甘于奉献的工匠精神。
default.en: Introduction to Medicine (1) is an integrated course in medicine. This course includes the study of human anatomy, histology and embryology, physiology, and pathology in basic medicine. Human anatomy provides a macroscopic introduction to the structure of the human body, including the distribution of skeletal, muscular, nervous, and vascular systems. Histology and embryology focus on the microscopic study of human tissue structure, embryonic development, and common congenital malformations. Physiology emphasizes the normal functional activities of various organs and systems in the human body. Pathology introduces the macroscopic and microscopic pathological changes in tissues and organs caused by diseases. The learning process involves understanding the normal structure and function of the human body before grasping the pathological changes in tissues and organs caused by diseases. Assignments given before class guide students to learn independently and develop their skills in information retrieval and literature review. Case-based teaching introduces common diseases in daily life before lecturing, inspiring students to think before learning, guiding them to learn with questions, and enabling them to apply what they have learned in practice. During the teaching process, attention is paid to the cultivation of students’ abilities, introducing engineering-related technologies applied in medicine, gradually developing students’ research thinking to solve medical bottlenecks through engineering technology. The course incorporates ideological and humanistic education, inspiring students to understand the human body as an organic whole, the coordinated functions of various organs and systems in the body to maintain homeostasis, and the objective laws of disease development. It also helps students recognize pathology as the “gold standard” for diagnosing diseases. Post-class assignments focus on cultivating students’ ability for independent learning, expanding their knowledge of cutting-edge medicine and research progress. The education aims to instill in students a sense of awe for life, respect for life, a spirit of diligent study, and a willingness to dedicate themselves like craftsmen.

default.zh: 生物信息学利用数学、信息学、统计学和计算及科学的方法研究生物学问题，是当今生命科学和自然科学的重大前沿领域之一。以研究从分子生物数据中挖掘和提取信息的理论和方法为主，实现计算方法的应用和开发、资源的充分共享。本课程在普及生物信息学基本知识点（包括基础理论和基本方法）的基础上，围绕生命科学研究的热点问题，注重介绍数据分析的基本技术、方法和工具的理解和掌握，把握生物信息学引领生物大数据分析的前沿方向。本课程包括两大部分内容，第一部分涵盖常见的分子层面的数据获取、分析的方法和技术，包括基因组测序、单细胞测序、蛋白质组测序、表观基因组测序，使学生们学习和掌握生物信息学的先进基础理论知识和技能，通过上机实践掌握常用的数据库和数据分析工具；第二部分结合生物医学实践，讲授生物信息学的应用，以实例介绍生物信息学在癌症生物学、免疫学、药物设计等方面的研究进展。本课程注重培养学生解决科学问题的能力。通过本课程的学习，掌握从基因组、转录组、表观基因组到蛋白质组等组学数据分析的常用方法、数据资源，以及各类组学数据在疾病、免疫、药物设计等领域的应用。
default.en: Bioinformatics applies mathematics, informatics, statistics and computational and scientific methods to study biological problems and is one of the major frontier fields of life sciences and natural sciences today. Focusing on the study of theories and methods of mining and extracting information from molecular biological data, the application and development of computational methods and the full sharing of resources are realized. On the basis of popularizing the basic knowledge for bioinformatics (including basic theories and methods), this course focuses on introducing the basic technologies, methods and tools of data analysis, and grasping the knowledge of bioinformatics to lead the forefront of biological big data analysis around the hot issues of life science research. This course consists of two parts. The first part covers common molecular-level data acquisition, analysis methods and techniques, including genome sequencing, single-cell sequencing, proteome sequencing, and epigenome sequencing, which enables students to learn the advanced basic theoretical knowledge and skills of bioinformatics and master the commonly used database and data analysis tools through computer practice; The second part combines biomedical practice to teach the application of bioinformatics, and introduces the research progress of bioinformatics in cancer biology, immunology, drug design, etc. with examples. This course focuses on developing students' ability to solve scientific problems. Through this course, students can master the common methods and data resources of omics data analysis ranging from genome, transcriptome, epigenome to proteome, as well as the application of multi-omics data in the fields of disease, immunity, drug design and so on.

default.zh: 当前，随着生命组学测序等高通量生物实验技术的快速发展和广泛应用，生物大数据持续爆发式增长，已成为规模最大的数据集合之一，并使生命科学和生物医药领域转向数据驱动发展模式，进入新的快速发展时期。在此背景下，对生物大数据的开发和利用成为生命科学与生物医药的新发展引擎，其核心在于创造可以有效处理、分析、挖掘、应用生物大数据的算法，以实现对PB-ZB级生物大数据的分析挑战。 本课程是生物信息学专业的核心专业基础课程，主要目标是使学生认识和理解生命科学计算问题，生物数据的表示与组织，生物数据管理、分析、挖掘、应用的基本算法，并了解生物信息算法系统的基本原理、组成与运行方式，为学生今后设计、构造和应用生物信息学算法与系统，解决生命科学与生物医药领域的计算问题，特别是大数据分析与应用问题，奠定坚实的理论和技术基础。本课程的主要内容涉及基因组、转录组、蛋白质组等组学数据的表示、组织、索引的数据结构，大规模生物序列比对、搜索、拼接、变异检测、基因表达分析等基础核心算法，及生物数据质量评估的基本方法。重点通过课程讲解配合较为系统的算法实验，培养学生的生物信息学算法设计与实践能力，达成课程目标。
default.en: Currently, with the rapid development and widespread application of high-throughput biological experimental technologies such as life genomics sequencing, biological big data continues to experience explosive growth, becoming one of the largest datasets. This trend has led the fields of life science and biomedicine to shift towards a data-driven development model, entering a new era of rapid growth. In this context, the development and utilization of biological big data have become a new driving force for the development of life science and biomedicine. The core lies in the creation of algorithms that can effectively process, analyze, mine, and apply biological big data, aiming to address the analytical challenges of PB-ZB scale biological big data. This course is a core foundational course for the bioinformatics major. Its primary objectives are to enable students to understand and comprehend computational issues in life sciences, the representation and organization of biological data, basic algorithms for biological data management, analysis, mining, and application. Additionally, students will gain insight into the fundamental principles, components, and operation of bioinformatics algorithm systems. The course aims to prepare students for designing, constructing, and applying bioinformatics algorithms and systems to solve computational problems in the fields of life science and biomedicine, particularly in the realm of big data analysis and applications. The main content of the course covers data structures for representing, organizing, and indexing genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data, fundamental core algorithms for large-scale biological sequence alignment, searching, splicing, variant detection, gene expression analysis, as well as basic methods for assessing the quality of biological data. Emphasis is placed on hands-on algorithm experiments to cultivate students' abilities in the design and practical application of bioinformatics algorithms, laying a solid theoretical and technical foundation to achieve the course objectives.

default.zh: 医学遗传学是将遗传学理论应用于临床医学实践，研究人类疾病与遗传关系的一门新兴学科，已成为现代生物医学的重要组成部分。本课程是一门理论联系实际的科学，本课程通过教师的课堂讲授、结合学生的实验操作，使学生理解和掌握遗传学基本的原理和规律，着重培养学生对临床上常见遗传病的诊断、检验、预防、治疗及遗传咨询的实际应用能力。通过从医学遗传学的基础知识出发，适当结合医学实际，通过学习基因的结构、功能与突变，正常人类染色体基础知识，临床常见的单基因病与多基因病，线粒体疾病，染色体疾病等，为学生了解临床常见遗传病的表现和机理，进一步学习医学知识打下较好的基础。
default.en: Medical genetics is a new subject which applies genetics theory to clinical medicine practice and studies the relationship between human disease and heredity. It has become an important part of modern biomedicine. This course is a science combining theory with practice. Through teachers' classroom teaching and students' experimental operation, this course enables students to understand and master the basic principles and laws of genetics, and focuses on cultivating students' practical application ability in diagnosis, testing, prevention, treatment and genetic counseling of common genetic diseases in clinical practice. Starting from the basic knowledge of medical genetics, appropriately combined with medical practice, by learning the structure, function and mutation of genes, basic knowledge of normal human chromosomes, common clinical monogenic diseases and polygenic diseases, mitochondrial diseases, chromosome diseases, etc., students can understand the manifestation and mechanism of common clinical genetic diseases and lay a good foundation for further study of medical knowledge.
