It has become an important part of modern biomedicine. This course is a science combining theory with practice. Through teachers' classroom teaching and students' experimental operation, this course enables students to understand and master the basic principles and laws of genetics, and focuses on cultivating students' practical application ability in diagnosis, testing, prevention, treatment and genetic counseling of common genetic diseases in clinical practice. Starting from the basic knowledge of medical genetics, appropriately combined with medical practice, by learning the structure, function and mutation of genes, basic knowledge of normal human chromosomes, common clinical monogenic diseases and polygenic diseases, mitochondrial diseases, chromosome diseases, etc., students can understand the manifestation and mechanism of common clinical genetic diseases and lay a good foundation for further study of medical knowledge.

default.zh: 《功能基因组学》课程全面涵盖了基因组测序计划、生命树、基因组计划分析方法和技术等多个方面。学生将深入了解基因在生物体内的功能和相互关系，包括从转录到蛋白质水平再到蛋白质相互作用的全貌。重点介绍功能基因组的核心概念和动物模型在研究中的应用，使学生初步了解功能基因组的研究方式。此外，课程还涵盖了人类基因组计划、疾病发病机理、基因工程技术在医学、生物、农业领域的应用等内容。学生将通过实践操作熟练掌握基因工程原理，了解蛋白质组学的概念，并运用数据库进行癌症基因组和基因表达数据分析，培养实际操作和数据解释的能力。这门课程旨在为学生提供全面而实用的功能基因组学知识，加深对生命科学的理解和应用。
default.en: The Functional Genomics course provides comprehensive coverage of many aspects of the genome sequencing program, the tree of life, and methods and techniques for genome program analysis. Students will gain an in-depth understanding of the functions and interrelationships of genes within an organism, including the full spectrum from transcription to the protein level to protein interactions. The core concepts of functional genomics and the use of animal models in research are emphasized to provide students with an initial understanding of how functional genomes are studied. In addition, the course covers the Human Genome Project, disease pathogenesis, and the application of genetic engineering technologies in medicine, biology, and agriculture. Students should become proficient in the principles of genetic engineering through hands-on practice, understand the concepts of proteomics, and utilize databases for cancer genome and gene expression data analysis to develop hands-on and data interpretation skills. This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive and practical knowledge of functional genomics and deepen their understanding and application of life sciences.

default.zh: 计算生物学是利用计算的方法研究生物学问题的一门学科, 计算生物学是综合了生物、计算机、物理和数学等学科在内的交叉学科。本课程主要通过计算的方法使学生能够在系统层次上理解生物的现象、功能和机制。通过本课学习，使学生掌握利用计算手段系统研究生物学的对象，掌握常见分子生物网络的构建及复杂网络分析方法，能够建立复杂生物系统的数学计算模型，并能够对所建立的模型进行计算模拟及分析；培养学生能够运用计算的手段, 分析分子网络及相关的高通量生物数据，提取生物分子及其之间的关系。使学生具备生物网络系统的建模及分析能力，开拓学生的研究视野。课程具体目标如下： 1.知识目标： 了解计算生物学研究的内容,方法和现状, 理解生物分子之间互作和调控的原理,熟悉构建生物网络和调控模型的过程和知识,掌握构建生物模型的基本工具的工作原理。 2.能力目标: 能够利用现有的计算生物工具和生物信息学软件,构建生物分子互作和调控模型, 能从系统层次和分子层次上分析和理解生命活动的现象、规律和机制, 并能从生物的角度根据模型计算的结果挖掘出有意义的分子成分,能够对实验的结果进行可视化。 3.素质目标: 理解计算生物学模型的工作原理,搭建方法，掌握知识之间的相互关联,能从系统的角度理解和解释一般的生物现象。跟踪计算生物学的前沿发展及先进的分析工具， 提高学生的科学素养以及勤于探索和实践的精神。
default.en: Computational biology is a discipline that uses computational methods to study biological problems. Computational biology is an interdisciplinary field that integrates biology, computer science, physics, and mathematics and so on. This course mainly focuses on computational methods to enable students to understand biological phenomena, functions, and mechanisms at a systematic level. Through this course, students will master the use of computational methods to systematically study biological objects, master the construction of common molecular biological networks and complex network analysis methods, be able to establish mathematical calculation models for complex biological systems, and be able to perform computational simulation and analysis on the established models; Train students to use computational methods to analyze molecular networks and related high-throughput biological data, extract biomolecules and their relationships. Enable students to have the ability to model and analyze biological network systems, and broaden their research perspectives. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: 1. Knowledge Objectives Understand the core content, methodological frameworks, and current research landscape of computational biology；Comprehend the fundamental principles governing the interaction and regulatory mechanisms between biomolecules；Familiarize oneself with the standard processes and key knowledge points involved in constructing biological networks and regulatory models；Master the operating principles of basic tools used for building biological models. 2. Ability Objectives Be able to utilize established computational biology tools and bioinformatics software to construct models of biomolecular interaction and regulation；Develop the ability to analyze and interpret the phenomena, inherent laws, and underlying mechanisms of life activities at both the systemic and molecular levels；Learn to mine biologically meaningful molecular components from model calculation results, grounded in biological principles；Be proficient in visualizing experimental and computational results to present findings clearly. 3. Quality Objectives Gain a deep understanding of the working principles and construction methodologies of computational biology models, and master the interconnections between key knowledge areas in the field；Develop the capability to understand and explain common biological phenomena from a systems-level perspective；Cultivate the habit of tracking cutting-edge advancements and advanced analytical tools in computational biology, thereby enhancing students’ scientific literacy, exploratory thinking, and practical spirit.

default.zh: 《基因组信息学》是生物信息学专业的核心专业基础课程，目的是使学生掌握基因组基本结构与信息，基因组信息分析的基本原理和方法, 海量基因组数据表示与分析模型，在对众多处理基因组问题的信息学解决方法有清晰的认识后，具备严谨的科学态度与分析问题、解决问题的能力，为以后的科学研究打下基础。课程具体内容如下： 课程内容1：能够设计并实现面向高通量基因组数据分析的计算系统，可以集成DNA、RNA、表观、元基因组等多层面高通量数据构建计算系统来解决具体生物问题。 课程内容2：掌握解决基因组数据分析计算系统相关的关键技术、方法与工具。掌握基因组的基本结构与信息表示模型，基因组分析方法，具备从生物数据中构建基因组并挖掘功能元件的能力。 课程内容3：具备在多学科背景下将数学、计算机算法与具体基因组问题相结合，对高通量基因组数据分析计算系统进行分析与评价的能力。 课程内容4：能够撰写高通量基因组数据分析计算系统相关的报告并进行交流与沟通。
default.en: "Genome Bioinformatics" is the core professional basic course of bioinformatics, which aims to enable students to master the basic structure and information of the genome, the basic principles and methods of genomic information analysis, the representation and analysis model of massive genomic data, and have a rigorous scientific attitude and the ability to analyze and solve problems after having a clear understanding of many informatics solutions to deal with genomic problems, laying a foundation for future scientific research. The specific content of the course is as follows: Course content 1: Be able to design and implement a computing system for high-throughput genomic data analysis, and integrate DNA, RNA, epigenetic, metagenomic and other high-throughput data to build a computing system to solve specific biological problems. Course content 2: Master the key technologies, methods and tools related to solving the computational system of genomic data analysis. Master the basic structure and information representation model of the genome, genome analysis methods, and have the ability to construct genomes from biological data and mine functional elements. Course content 3: Have the ability to combine mathematics, computer algorithms and specific genomic problems in a multidisciplinary context, and analyze and evaluate high-throughput genomic data analysis and computing systems. Course content 4: Be able to write reports related to high-throughput genomic data analysis computing systems and communicate and communicate.

default.zh: 当前，随着生命组学测序等高通量生物实验技术的快速发展和广泛应用，生物大数据持续爆发式增长，已成为规模最大的数据集合之一，并使生命科学和生物医药领域转向数据驱动发展模式，进入新的快速发展时期。在此背景下，对生物大数据的开发和利用成为生命科学与生物医药的新发展引擎，其核心在于创造可以有效处理、分析、挖掘、应用生物大数据的算法，以实现对PB-ZB级生物大数据的分析挑战。 本课程是生物信息学专业的核心专业基础课程，主要目标是使学生认识和理解生命科学计算问题，生物数据的表示与组织，生物数据管理、分析、挖掘、应用的基本算法，并了解生物信息算法系统的基本原理、组成与运行方式，为学生今后设计、构造和应用生物信息学算法与系统，解决生命科学与生物医药领域的计算问题，特别是大数据分析与应用问题，奠定坚实的理论和技术基础。本课程的主要内容涉及基因组、转录组、蛋白质组等组学数据的表示、组织、索引的数据结构，大规模生物序列比对、搜索、拼接、变异检测、基因表达分析等基础核心算法，及生物数据质量评估的基本方法。重点通过课程讲解配合较为系统的算法实验，培养学生的生物信息学算法设计与实践能力，达成课程目标。
default.en: Currently, with the rapid development and widespread application of high-throughput biological experimental technologies such as life genomics sequencing, biological big data continues to experience explosive growth, becoming one of the largest datasets. This trend has led the fields of life science and biomedicine to shift towards a data-driven development model, entering a new era of rapid growth. In this context, the development and utilization of biological big data have become a new driving force for the development of life science and biomedicine. The core lies in the creation of algorithms that can effectively process, analyze, mine, and apply biological big data, aiming to address the analytical challenges of PB-ZB scale biological big data. This course is a core foundational course for the bioinformatics major. Its primary objectives are to enable students to understand and comprehend computational issues in life sciences, the representation and organization of biological data, basic algorithms for biological data management, analysis, mining, and application. Additionally, students will gain insight into the fundamental principles, components, and operation of bioinformatics algorithm systems. The course aims to prepare students for designing, constructing, and applying bioinformatics algorithms and systems to solve computational problems in the fields of life science and biomedicine, particularly in the realm of big data analysis and applications. The main content of the course covers data structures for representing, organizing, and indexing genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data, fundamental core algorithms for large-scale biological sequence alignment, searching, splicing, variant detection, gene expression analysis, as well as basic methods for assessing the quality of biological data. Emphasis is placed on hands-on algorithm experiments to cultivate students' abilities in the design and practical application of bioinformatics algorithms, laying a solid theoretical and technical foundation to achieve the course objectives.

default.zh: 生物信息学综合实验是一门面向本科生的交叉学科综合实验课程，融合了分子生物学、细胞生物学与计算生物学的知识体系。课程以单细胞转录组测序、空间转录组测序及数据分析为核心，强调实验操作与计算分析结合，重点训练学生运用实验设计、数据处理与生物信息学分析解决复杂生物学问题的能力。通过学习，学生能够建立实验设计、数据获取、数据预处理与质量控制、数据分析与可视化、结果解释的认知框架，掌握单细胞与空间组学综合实验与分析的基本能力，为后续科研训练和创新研究奠定坚实基础。
default.en: It is an interdisciplinary comprehensive experimental course for undergraduate students, integrating the knowledge systems of molecular biology, cell biology and computational biology. The course focuses on single-cell transcriptome sequencing, spatial transcriptome sequencing and data analysis, emphasizing the combination of experimental operation and computational analysis. It aims to train students' ability to solve complex biological problems by applying experimental design, data processing, bioinformatics analysis, data visualization and result interpretation. Through learning, students can establish a cognitive framework for experimental design, data acquisition, data preprocessing and quality control, data analysis and visualization, and result interpretation. They will master the basic capabilities of comprehensive experiments and analyses in single-cell and spatial omics, laying a solid foundation for subsequent scientific research training and innovative research.

default.zh: 医学影像学是应用X射线、核磁共振、超声等现代医学成像技术对人体疾病进行诊断和在医学成像技术辅助下指导介入器械应用于人体微创诊疗的医学学科。是临床医学的重要组成部分。医学影像学利用现代科学技术对不同成像原理所获得的信号进行整合处理，获得客观的图像信息，从而显示人体内部组织器官的形态和生理功能，实现正常组织结构与病变部位的区分。凭借对客观准确的图像进行判断，观察人体内部形态和功能的变化，为人类进一步认识、预防和治疗疾病提供了巨大的帮助。 本课程主要讲授临床中常用的X线、CT、超声、MRI和PET等检查方法的基本原理和诊断应用范围，着重介绍上述影像设备的基本成像原理及其在常见疾病中的应用，旨在帮助学生构建完整的医学影像知识结构体系，了解医学影像学在临床实际应用中的重要意义。此外，简要介绍人工智能技术在医学影像学特别是图像处理方面的应用，培养和激发学生在实际应用中发现和解决问题的能力，为实现医工交叉合作，帮助临床解决实际应用中的重要问题奠定重要的理论基础。通过构建系统的知识网络，鼓励学生运用多学科的知识背景和研究方法，探索医学前沿领域的发展，启发和培养学生的科学素养和科研思维，锻炼学生综合分析和解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Medical imaging is a medical discipline that applies modern medical imaging technologies, such as X-rays, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), ultrasound, and others, to diagnose diseases in the human body. It also involves guiding minimally invasive interventions in medical diagnosis and treatment using imaging techniques. It is a crucial component of clinical medicine. Medical imaging integrates and processes signals obtained from different imaging principles using advanced scientific technologies. This integration results in objective image information, allowing the visualization of the morphology and physiological functions of organs and tissues within the human body. It enables the differentiation between normal tissue structures and pathological changes. The objective and accurate judgment based on these images facilitates the observation of variations in internal human anatomy and function, significantly aiding human understanding, prevention, and treatment of diseases. This course primarily focuses on the fundamental principles and diagnostic applications of commonly used clinical imaging methods such as X-ray, CT (computed tomography), ultrasound, MRI, and PET (positron emission tomography). It emphasizes the basic imaging principles of these devices and their applications in common diseases. The goal is to assist students in constructing a comprehensive knowledge structure of medical imaging, understanding the significant role of medical imaging in clinical practice. Additionally, the course provides a brief introduction to the application of artificial intelligence technology in medical imaging, particularly in image processing. It aims to cultivate and stimulate students' abilities to identify and solve problems in practical applications, laying a crucial theoretical foundation for interdisciplinary collaboration between medicine and engineering. By building a systematic knowledge network, the course encourages students to apply knowledge from various disciplines and research methods, explore developments in the forefront of medical science, inspire and cultivate scientific literacy and research thinking, and train students in comprehensive analysis and problem-solving skills.

default.zh: 《医学数据分析与处理》是一门面向高年级本科生和研究生的交叉学科核心课程，融合了医学、生物信息学、统计学与计算机科学的知识体系。课程以多组学与医学影像数据为对象，系统讲解从数据预处理、特征提取、统计分析到可视化展示的完整流程，重点训练学生将基因组、转录组、单细胞、空间组学、蛋白质组学及影像组学等复杂数据转化为科学结论的能力。通过学习，学生能够建立从 医学数据获取与质控 → 问题建模与算法选择 → 统计推断与可视化 → 生物学解释与验证 的分析框架，掌握多组学整合分析和医学数据挖掘的基本方法，为后续科研工作和临床转化应用奠定坚实基础。
default.en: "Medical Data Analysis and Processing" is an interdisciplinary core course for senior undergraduates and postgraduates, integrating the knowledge systems of medicine, bioinformatics, statistics and computer science. The course takes multi-omics and medical imaging data as the objects, systematically explaining the complete process from data preprocessing, feature extraction, statistical analysis to visualization display, with a focus on training students' ability to transform complex data such as genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell, spatial omics, proteomics and radiomics into scientific conclusions. Through learning, students can establish an analytical framework that covers medical data acquisition and quality control, problem modeling and algorithm selection, statistical inference and visualization, as well as biological interpretation and verification. They can master the basic methods of multi-omics integrated analysis and medical data mining, laying a solid foundation for subsequent scientific research and clinical application transformation.

default.zh: 智能诊断学是一个交叉性的概念，融合了医学、计算机、数理分析相关领域于一体，为医疗事业发展发挥智能化作用。智能诊断学字面意思就是在原有的诊断学基础上，融入人工智能等先进科学技术，使得原有的人为诊断变得更智能化、流程化、个性化。 智能诊断，和精准医学类似，其实质就是基于各种多源数据采用智能算法的诊断。本课程特色：传统的诊断学仅局限于问诊或者看片的过程中，而智能诊断学贯穿于整个医疗服务的始终，无论是诊前筛查、诊中诊断、诊后康复等都涉及到决策过程，其不仅在诊中提供智能而精准的决策方案，同时也在诊前达到了智能预警的功能，达到了治未病的效果，更可以在愈后实现更好的康复及智能居家健康管理，实现全民自主健康管理。因此，本书将在诊断学的医学理论基础之上，融合先进的数字技术，为每位居民提供全流程、全周期、全方位的智能诊断决策，力争为居民健康的“1”保驾护航，为实现国家全民健康助力。 本课程主要围绕当下中国新医学、新医科重大战略部署，从“理论”、“技术”、“应用”三大方面，通过理论与案例相搭配、线上与线下相结合的方式，为本课程的使用者提供很多元化的学习模式。本课程分为三篇，第一篇为“智能诊断学理论”，介绍智能诊断学的基本内容；第二篇为“智能诊断学技术”，介绍典型人工智能、大数据、物联网等新兴的核心数字技术；第三篇为“智能诊断学应用”，介绍智能诊断学在脑科学、影像学、疾病监测等不同领域的应用。通过讲述智能技术下的新的诊断模式新的诊断思路，打造领域前沿的、高水平的智能诊断学教材，推进新医学与新医科领域高水平复合人才队伍培育，助力制造强国、网络强国建设。
default.en: Intelligent diagnostics is an interdisciplinary concept that integrates medicine, computer science, and mathematical and statistical analysis to play an intelligent role in the development of medical services. Literally, intelligent diagnostics refers to the integration of advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence into the original diagnostic methods, making the original human-based diagnosis more intelligent, standardized, and personalized. Similar to precision medicine, the essence of intelligent diagnostics lies in the use of intelligent algorithms based on various types of multi-source data. The unique feature of this course is that, unlike traditional diagnostics limited to consultation or imaging interpretation, intelligent diagnostics the entire process of medical services, involving decision-making in pre-diagnosis screening, diagnosis, and post-diagnosis recovery. It not only provides intelligent and precise decision-making solutions during the diagnosis but also achieves intelligent early warning before the diagnosis, achieving the effect of preventing diseases. It can also achieve better recovery and intelligent home health management after recovery, enabling the whole population to take charge of their health management. Therefore, this course builds upon the medical theoretical foundation of diagnostics, integrating advanced digital technologies to provide intelligent diagnostic decision-making for each resident throughout the entire process, life cycle, and all aspects, aiming to safeguard residents' health and contribute to the national effort in promoting health. Focused on the major strategic deployment of new medicine and medical education in China, this course offers a diversified learning model through a combination of theory and case studies, as well as online and offline methods. It is divided into three sections. The first section, "Theory of Intelligent Diagnostics," introduces the fundamental concepts of intelligent diagnostics. The second section, "Technologies of Intelligent Diagnostics," covers typical emerging core digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data, and the Internet of Things. The third section, "Applications of Intelligent Diagnostics," explores the applications of intelligent diagnostics in different fields like neuroscience, imaging, and disease monitoring. By presenting new diagnostic models and approaches under the guidance of intelligent technologies, this course aims to create a cutting-edge and high-level textbook on intelligent diagnostics, promoting the cultivation of a high-level interdisciplinary talent pool in new medicine and medical education, and supporting the construction of a strong manufacturing and technological nation.

default.zh: 智能医疗仪器设计是智能医学工程专业的必修课程，其目的是使本专业学生了解智能医疗仪器的总体分类和基本结构；深入了解生物医学测量的各种方法、生物医学信号产生的机理和特点；掌握智能医疗仪器的基本工作原理、主要技术、设计方法；了解智能医疗仪器的微处理器功能；掌握智能医疗仪器的数据采集技术、数据处理技术、人机对话外设处理技术、通信接口技术和抗干扰技术。通过课堂教学、实践教学等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和工程科学知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Intelligent medical device design is a compulsory course for intelligent medical engineering majors. Its purpose is to make students understand the overall classification and basic structure of intelligent medical instruments; understand various methods of biomedical measurement, the mechanism and characteristics of biomedical signal generation; master the basic working principle, main technology and design method of intelligent medical instruments; understand the microprocessor function of intelligent medical instruments; master the data acquisition technology, data processing technology, man-machine dialogue peripheral processing technology, communication interface technology and anti-interference technology of intelligent medical instruments. Through classroom teaching, practical teaching and other links, cultivate students' innovative consciousness and ability and the application ability of engineering scientific knowledge, and support the achievement of corresponding index points in professional learning achievements.

default.zh: 《智能医学图像处理》是智能医学工程专业的专业选修课，也是目前医学影像智能化的核心内容之一。本课程将针对医学领域的数字图像产生的基本原理、成像的模态以及相关的处理算法进行介绍，尤其是基于机器学习和深度学习来进行医学图像的增强、重构、分割、分类等。让同学们掌握基本的医学影像知识，并能够应用机器学习和深度学习来进行医学图像处理，掌握最新的医学影像分析的基本算法和技能。
default.en: "Intelligent Medical Image Processing" is a specialized elective course for the field of intelligent medical engineering, and it is also one of the core contents of medical image intelligence at present. This course will introduce the basic principles of digital image generation in the medical field, the modalities of imaging, and related processing algorithms. Especially, it will use machine learning and deep learning to enhance, reconstruct, segment, and classify medical images. It aims to enable students to master basic medical imaging knowledge and be able to apply machine learning and deep learning for medical image processing, as well as to acquire the basic algorithms and skills for the latest medical image analysis.

default.zh: 先进生物治疗致力于为学生提供一个全面且深入的平台，以探索和理解生物治疗领域的前沿技术和理论知识。课程目标是让学生系统地掌握生物治疗的基本原理、关键技术和临床应用，涵盖细胞治疗、基因治疗、免疫治疗、生物制药等多个子领域，并且深入探讨这些技术的最新发展动态和未来趋势。通过一系列精心设计的理论讲授，学生将能够理解生物治疗技术在疾病诊断、治疗和预防中的重要作用，以及它们如何推动现代医学的进步。课程还将培养学生的批判性思维和分析能力，使他们能够独立评估生物治疗方案的有效性、安全性和可行性，为未来从事相关领域的研究或临床工作打下坚实的基础。此外，课程中还会涉及生物治疗领域的伦理、法律和社会问题，帮助学生形成全面的职业素养，确保他们在未来的职业生涯中能够负责任地应用这些先进的生物治疗技术。
default.en: Advanced Biological Therapy is committed to providing students with a comprehensive and in-depth platform to explore and understand cutting-edge technologies and theoretical knowledge in the field of biotherapy. The course aims to enable students to systematically grasp the basic principles, key technologies, and clinical applications of biotherapy, covering multiple subfields such as cell therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy, and biopharmaceuticals, as well as to delve into the latest developments and future trends of these technologies. Through a series of carefully designed lectures, students will be able to understand the significant role of biotherapy technologies in disease diagnosis, treatment, and prevention, and how they drive the progress of modern medicine. The course will also cultivate students' critical thinking and analytical skills, enabling them to independently evaluate the effectiveness, safety, and feasibility of biotherapy programs, and lay a solid foundation for future research or clinical work in related fields. In addition, the course will address ethical, legal, and social issues in the field of biotherapy, helping students develop comprehensive professional literacy and ensuring that they can responsibly apply these advanced biotherapy technologies in their future careers.

default.zh: 智能医疗仪器设计是智能医学工程专业的必修课程，其目的是使本专业学生了解智能医疗仪器的总体分类和基本结构；深入了解生物医学测量的各种方法、生物医学信号产生的机理和特点；掌握智能医疗仪器的基本工作原理、主要技术、设计方法；了解智能医疗仪器的微处理器功能；掌握智能医疗仪器的数据采集技术、数据处理技术、人机对话外设处理技术、通信接口技术和抗干扰技术。通过课堂教学、实践教学等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和工程科学知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Intelligent medical device design is a compulsory course for intelligent medical engineering majors. Its purpose is to make students understand the overall classification and basic structure of intelligent medical instruments; understand various methods of biomedical measurement, the mechanism and characteristics of biomedical signal generation; master the basic working principle, main technology and design method of intelligent medical instruments; understand the microprocessor function of intelligent medical instruments; master the data acquisition technology, data processing technology, man-machine dialogue peripheral processing technology, communication interface technology and anti-interference technology of intelligent medical instruments. Through classroom teaching, practical teaching and other links, cultivate students' innovative consciousness and ability and the application ability of engineering scientific knowledge, and support the achievement of corresponding index points in professional learning achievements.

default.zh: 《互联网医疗与医疗物联网》是面向智能医学工程专业大三本科生开设的课程，旨在立足医工交叉领域，系统构建学生关于互联网医疗与医疗物联网的理论认知与实践应用能力。课程以“政策 - 技术 - 场景 - 数据 - 安全”为主线，通过模块化、循序渐进的内容设计，全面讲授互联网医疗与医疗物联网的基本概念、体系架构、关键技术及数据处理方法，助力学生形成“从技术原理到实际应用”的完整知识链条。 课程内容紧密结合智能医学工程专业培养目标，总学时 32 学时，以系统化授课为主要教学方式，精准对接三大课程目标：首先，通过“互联网医疗基础”“智慧医疗体系与医疗大数据”“医疗物联网概念和特征”三部分内容（共8学时），奠定学生对行业发展背景、政策环境及基础理论的认知，使其理解互联网医疗对传统医疗模式的变革意义，熟悉 HIS、LIS、EMR等信息化平台组成，掌握医疗大数据的类型与基本处理方法；其次，聚焦“医疗物联网架构与关键技术”“医疗传感器与可穿戴设备”“远程医疗与智慧医院”“移动健康管理”“物联网数据处理技术”五部分内容（共20学时），深入解析IoMT感知层、网络层、应用层的三层架构，蓝牙、ZigBee等无线通信协议的应用，心电、血压等医疗传感器的数据采集原理，以及智慧医院、远程会诊、慢病移动管理等典型场景的实践逻辑，帮助学生掌握从技术落地到场景应用的全流程能力；最后，通过“人工智能赋能医疗物联网”“物联网信息安全”两部分内容（共4学时），打通“技术 - 智能 - 安全”的闭环，引导学生理解AI与IoMT融合的优势、伦理隐私挑战，以及物联网安全体系与防护技术，形成兼具前沿视野与风险意识的综合素养。 在教学实施中，课程以真实医疗场景为牵引，以“数据与系统”为核心载体，将理论讲授与场景化分析深度结合：通过拆解智慧医院建设案例、远程医疗实操流程、可穿戴设备数据采集项目等，让抽象的技术原理与临床实际需求紧密衔接；同时，引导学生围绕“医疗数据从感知（传感器）到处理（大数据技术）再到智能应用（AI诊断）”的全链路展开思考，逐步建立“从感知到应用、从数据到智能”的系统化认知。 通过本课程的学习，学生不仅能系统掌握互联网医疗与医疗物联网的核心知识与关键技术，更能提升在医工交叉领域的综合分析、场景落地与问题解决能力，为未来投身智慧医疗系统研发、医疗物联网设备开发、健康大数据分析等相关领域的科研与实践工作，打下坚实的理论与实践基础。
default.en: Internet-Based Healthcare and the Medical Internet of Things (IoMT) is a core course for junior undergraduates majoring in Intelligent Medical Engineering. Positioned at the intersection of medicine and engineering, it provides students with systematic theoretical foundations and practical skills in internet-based healthcare and IoMT. The course follows a “policy–technology–scenario–data–security” framework and adopts a modular, progressive design. It introduces fundamental concepts, system architectures, key technologies, and data processing methods, helping students build an integrated knowledge chain that connects technical principles with real-world applications. Aligned with the training objectives of the Intelligent Medical Engineering program, the 32-hour course combines systematic lectures with scenario-based exploration and addresses three core learning objectives: Foundational Knowledge – Through modules on Fundamentals of Internet-Based Healthcare, Smart Healthcare Ecosystems and Medical Big Data, and Concepts and Characteristics of Medical IoMT, students develop an understanding of the industry’s development trajectory, policy environment, and basic theories. They explore how internet-based healthcare reshapes traditional medical models, gain familiarity with healthcare information systems (HIS, LIS, EMR), and acquire skills in medical big data classification and basic processing. Technical Implementation – Focusing on IoMT Architecture and Key Technologies, Medical Sensors and Wearable Devices, Telemedicine and Smart Hospitals, Mobile Health Management, and IoMT Data Processing, students examine IoMT’s three-layer architecture (perception, network, application), wireless communication protocols (Bluetooth, ZigBee, NB-IoT), and data acquisition principles for medical sensors (e.g., ECG, blood pressure, oxygen saturation). They also analyze practical workflows in scenarios such as smart hospitals, remote consultation, and chronic disease management, equipping them with end-to-end implementation capabilities. Intelligence and Security – In modules on AI-Enabled IoMT and IoMT Information Security, students explore the advantages of AI–IoMT integration, ethical and privacy challenges, and IoMT security frameworks and technologies. This builds a comprehensive literacy that balances technological innovation with risk awareness. Throughout the course, real medical scenarios and data-driven case studies are emphasized. Students analyze examples such as smart hospital construction, telemedicine workflows, and wearable data projects. They are guided to examine the full lifecycle of medical data—from sensor-based perception → big data processing → intelligent applications such as AI-assisted diagnosis—to form a systematic understanding of the path from perception to application and from data to intelligence. By the end of the course, students achieve a systematic mastery of core knowledge and technologies in internet-based healthcare and IoMT, while also strengthening their interdisciplinary skills in analysis, scenario-based implementation, and problem-solving. This provides a solid theoretical and practical foundation for future work in smart healthcare R&D, IoMT device development, and health big data analytics.

default.zh: 可穿戴医疗技术为生物医学工程、电子、计算机等交叉学科的专业讨论课。主要介绍可穿戴传感技术基础知识和国内外相关研究方向和产业的最新研究成果。包括有关可穿戴传感器的发展概况、可穿戴传感技术基础以及其在生物医学、健康护理中的应用，展示可穿戴设备在生活、健康、医疗等领域的应用案例。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握可穿戴传感技术的基本思想、基本概念和基本方法，熟悉可穿戴传感技术在医疗与健康领域中的应用，并能运用所学的知识和技能对一般问题进行分析和开发设计，熟练使用实验设备的各种模块，对可穿戴传感分析算法进行综合设计开发。
default.en: Wearable medical technology is an interdisciplinary specialized course covering biomedical engineering, electronics, computer science, and related fields. It primarily introduces fundamental knowledge of wearable sensing technologies and the latest research directions and industrial advancements both domestically and internationally. The course includes an overview of the development of wearable sensors, the fundamentals of wearable sensing technology, and its applications in biomedicine and healthcare, showcasing real-world use cases of wearable devices in daily life, health, and medical fields. Through this course, students will gain a solid understanding of the core principles, concepts, and methodologies of wearable sensing technology, become familiar with its applications in medical and health sectors, and acquire the ability to analyze and develop solutions for general problems using the knowledge and skills learned. They will also become proficient in utilizing various modules of experimental equipment to comprehensively design and develop algorithms for wearable sensing analysis.

default.zh: 《医学微生物学与免疫学》是生物医学科学专业的专业核心课程，在医学类专业课程中占有重要的地位。医学微生物学主要阐述病原微生物的一般生物学特性、生命活动规律、致病性与免疫性、实验室检查方法与防治原则；医学免疫学主要介绍人体免疫系统组织结构、生理功能、免疫应答规律、免疫应答产物、某些疾病的免疫学发病机制以及免疫学诊断和防治。 本课程旨在让学生掌握微生物学与免疫学的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，能够初步应用所学的知识对常见的免疫现象及免疫性疾病、传染病等疾病的发病机制、实验室检查与特异性防治做出解释；加深对病原微生物与人体和环境间相互关系的理解，建立无菌观念，在消毒、隔离、预防医院感染等工作中加以具体运用；为学习其它相关课程奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Medical Microbiology and Immunology is the core course of the biomedical science major and plays an important role in medical courses. Medical microbiology mainly elaborates on the general biological characteristics, life activity patterns, pathogenicity and immunity, laboratory testing methods, and prevention and control principles of pathogenic microorganisms. Medical immunology mainly introduces the organizational structure, physiological functions, immune response patterns, immune response products of the human immune system, as well as the immunological pathogenesis, immunological diagnosis and prevention of certain diseases. This course aims to enable students to master the basic theories, knowledge and skills of microbiology and immunology, to explain common immune phenomena and the pathogenesis, laboratory tests, and specific prevention and treatment of immune diseases and infectious diseases, to deepen the understanding of the interrelationships between pathogenic microorganisms and the human body and environment, to establish a sterile concept and apply it specifically in disinfection, isolation, and prevention of hospital infections, to lay a solid foundation for learning other related courses.

default.zh: 疾病组学是一门综合运用基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学等高通量生物学技术的学科，旨在全面理解和揭示与疾病相关的分子水平的信息。通过对基因、蛋白质、代谢物等分子层面的全面分析，疾病组学致力于揭示疾病的发生、发展和治疗等方面的分子机制。精准医学是一种将个体基因、环境与生活习惯差异考虑在内的疾病预防与治疗的新策略，其实质是“个性化医疗”，目标是更准确、更有效地预测、诊断、治疗和预防疾病。精准医学往往依赖于组学技术，尤其是基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学和微生物组学等。这些组学技术为医学提供了大量的分子层面数据，有助于更全面地理解个体的生物学信息，从而实现更为精准的医疗和治疗手段。例如精准医学通过基因组学技术分析个体基因组的遗传变异，识别潜在的疾病风险和药物反应差异，从而实现个体化的医疗决策；通过分析转录组数据，可以了解基因的表达情况，识别与疾病相关的基因表达模式，并为个性化治疗提供依据；通过代谢组学技术分析个体的代谢产物，可以了解代谢通路的活性，帮助定制适应个体特征的营养和治疗方案。本课程将通过对疾病相关基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、表观遗传组学、微生物组学、单细胞组学、影像学等与精准医学的关系进行详细讲解，并对组学数据的分析以及多组学数据整合在精准医学的应用进行实例分析和讲解。此外，本课程还通过融入课程实践，加深学生对组学和精准医学的理解。通过本门课程的学习，学生将在疾病组学与精准医学领域获得深刻的专业理解，为未来的学术研究和医学实践打下坚实基础。
default.en: Multi-omics for disease (disease omics) is an interdisciplinary field that comprehensively utilizes high-throughput biological technologies such as genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics. Its aim is to comprehensively understand and reveal molecular-level information related to diseases. Through comprehensive analysis of molecules such as genes, proteins, and metabolites, disease omics seeks to elucidate the molecular mechanisms underlying the occurrence, development, and treatment of diseases. Precision medicine is a novel approach to disease prevention and treatment that takes into account individual differences in genetics, environment, and lifestyle. Essentially, it is "personalized medicine," with the goal of predicting, diagnosing, treating, and preventing diseases more accurately and effectively. Precision medicine often relies on omics technologies, especially genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and microbiomics. These omics technologies provide a wealth of molecular-level data in medicine, aiding in a more comprehensive understanding of an individual's biological information and facilitating more precise medical and therapeutic approaches. For example, precision medicine utilizes genomic techniques to analyze genetic variations in an individual's genome, identifying potential disease risks and drug response differences to make personalized medical decisions. Transcriptomic data analysis helps understand gene expression patterns associated with diseases, providing a basis for personalized treatments. Metabolomics technology analyzes an individual's metabolites, revealing the activity of metabolic pathways and assisting in customizing nutrition and treatment plans tailored to individual characteristics. This course will provide a detailed explanation of the relationship between disease-related genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, epigenomics, microbiomics, single-cell omics, imaging omics, and precision medicine. It will also include practical examples and discussions on the analysis of omics data and the integration of multi-omics data in the application of precision medicine. Additionally, this course enhances students' understanding of omics and precision medicine through the integration of practical coursework. Through this course, students will gain a profound professional understanding in the field of disease omics and precision medicine, laying a solid foundation for future academic research and medical practice.

default.zh: 《系统生物学》旨在为生物科学、生物技术和生物工程专业的学生提供深入了解生命科学新研究领域的机会。与传统的“老”系统生物学不同，该课程将焦点放在后基因组时代的系统研究上，将分子生物学作为知识基石，超越传统的“还原论”和分析方法，强调“整体论”和综合方法的应用。课程全面涵盖了系统生物学的演变背景、基本概念和关键技术。将深入介绍生物系统的组成和相互关系，涉及基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学等多组学分析。课程注重实践操作，使学生了解基因组测序、蛋白质质谱等技术，并培养数据分析能力。大规模蛋白质相互作用研究、基因功能富集分析等内容深入剖析生物网络特性。通过实践操作介绍使用Cytoscape软件构建蛋白质互作网络，强调网络可视化和网络药理学的关键技能，课程将在分子生物学基础上，探讨生物体系的整体性和相互作用。
default.en: Systems Biology is designed to provide biological sciences, biotechnology, and bioengineering students with an in-depth understanding of new research areas in life sciences. Unlike traditional systems biology, this course focuses on systems research in the post-genomic era by using molecular biology as the cornerstone of knowledge, moving beyond traditional "reductionist" and analytical approaches, and emphasizing the application of "holistic" and integrative methods. The course provides a comprehensive coverage of the evolutionary background, basic concepts and key techniques of systems biology. The composition and interrelationships of biological systems will be introduced in depth, involving genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and other multi-omics analysis. The course focuses on hands-on practice, enabling students to understand techniques such as genome sequencing and protein mass spectrometry, and to develop the ability to analyze data. The characteristics of biological networks will be analyzed through large-scale protein interaction studies, gene function enrichment analysis and other contents. By introducing the use of Cytoscape software in constructing protein interaction networks through hands-on practice, and emphasizing the key skills of network visualization and network pharmacology, the course will explore the wholeness and interactions of biological systems on the basis of molecular biology.

default.zh: 医学细胞生物学是细胞生物学与医学科学融合形成的交叉学科，是生物医学科学专业的专业核心课程。医学细胞生物学从细胞的角度研究人体的结构、功能以及疾病发生的机制，旨在从细胞和分子水平揭示人体的生命活动规律，并建立其与人类健康及疾病之间的联系。 课程内容主要包括细胞的基本结构、细胞质膜与物质的跨膜运输、细胞质基质与内膜系统、蛋白质分选与膜泡运输、线粒体与叶绿体、细胞骨架、细胞核与染色质、核糖体、细胞信号转导、细胞周期和细胞分裂、细胞增殖调控与癌细胞、细胞分化与干细胞、细胞的衰老与死亡等内容。 采用课堂讲授和实验教学相结合的教学方法，使学生在牢固掌握基础知识和基本概念的同时，得到科学研究、科学思维和科学方法的良好训练，为其他专业课的学习及日后的研究工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Medical Cell Biology is an interdisciplinary subject formed by the integration of cell biology and medicine. It serves as a core professional course for students majoring in Biomedical Science. This discipline studies the structure and function of the human body, as well as the mechanisms of disease pathogenesis, from a cellular perspective. It aims to reveal the laws of human life activities at the cellular and molecular level and to establish the link between these activities and human health and disease. The course content mainly includes the basic structure of cells, cytoplasmic membranes and transmembrane transport of substances, cytoplasmic matrix and endomembrane system, protein sorting and membrane vesicle transport, mitochondria and chloroplasts, cytoskeleton, nucleus and chromatin, ribosomes, cell signal transduction, cell cycle and division, cell proliferation regulation and cancer cells, cell differentiation and stem cells, the aging and death of cells. Through the classroom lectures and experimental teaching , the students can receive good training in scientific research, scientific thinking, and scientific methods while firmly mastering basic knowledge and concepts, that will lay a solid foundation for the study of other professional courses and future research work.

default.zh: 《医学免疫学》是生物医学科学专业的专业核心课程，在整个课程体系中占有重要的地位。医学免疫学是研究人体免疫系统结构及功能，阐明免疫系统识别抗原后发生免疫应答及清除抗原的规律，探讨免疫功能异常所致病理过程和疾病机制的科学。免疫学与多学科相互交叉、渗透，已成为生命科学的前沿学科和现代医学的支撑学科之一。 《医学免疫学》课程通过对免疫应答过程、免疫功能调节及免疫诊断技术应用等内容的讲解，使学生掌握免疫学的基本理论和基本知识，培养学生分析、综合和独立解决问题的能力，为学生在未来从事安全有效的医学影像诊断、介入治疗和医学成像技术等方面医疗工作中合理运用免疫学知识诊疗疾病打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Medical Immunology is a core course in the field of biomedical science and holds an important position in the entire curriculum system. Medical immunology is a scientific that study the structure and function of the human immune system, elucidate the rules of immune response and antigen clearance after the immune system recognizes antigens, and explore the pathological processes and disease mechanisms caused by immune dysfunction. Immunology intersects and permeates with multiple disciplines, it has become a cutting-edge discipline in life sciences and one of the supporting disciplines in modern medicine. The course "Medical Immunology" explains the immune response process, immune function regulation, and application of immune diagnostic techniques, enabling students to master the basic theories and knowledge of immunology, cultivate their ability to analyze, synthesize, and independently solve problems, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for students to apply immunological knowledge to diagnose and treat diseases in safe and effective medical imaging diagnosis, intervention therapy, and medical imaging technology in the future.

default.zh: 《诊断学概要》是研究如何运用诊断疾病的基础理论、基本知识、基本技能和诊断思维对病人提出诊断的一门学科；是一门连接基础医学与临床医学的桥梁课程，也是开展临床医疗工作的重要基础。 本课程的目的是让学生掌握诊断学的基本概念、问诊方法与常见症状的鉴别思路；掌握系统的体格检查手法及正常体征的识别；了解常用实验室检查及心电图的基础知识；培养建立临床逻辑思维与规范书写病历的能力。通过本课程的学习，学生可在掌握基础理论的同时，得到科学研究方法和逻辑思维模式的良好训练，为将来的从事相关研究工作奠坚实的知识基础。
default.en: Outline of Diagnostics is a discipline that studies how to apply fundamental theories, basic knowledge, essential skills, and diagnostic reasoning to diagnose patients. It serves as a bridging course connecting basic and clinical medicine, as well as a crucial foundation for clinical medical practice. The purpose of this course is to enable students to master the fundamental concepts of diagnostics, methods of inquiry, and differential diagnosis for common symptoms; acquire systematic physical examination techniques and the ability to recognize normal signs; understand the basics of common laboratory tests and electrocardiography; and develop clinical logical thinking and standardized medical record writing skills. Through this course, students can gain a solid theoretical foundation while receiving excellent training in scientific research methods and logical thinking models, laying a strong knowledge base for future research in related fields.

default.zh: 慢性病是指不构成传染、具有长期积累形成疾病形态损害的疾病的总称。一旦防治不及，会造成经济、生命等方面的危害。 经过系统学习慢性疾病特点与机理，培育学生采集和整理信息的水平、在已有知识和生活经验的基础上具备获取新知识的水平、推行社会检查的实践水平。了解认识慢性疾病预防举措，树立正确的慢性疾病的预防方法。通过对慢性疾病理论研究，学生初步形成重视、关注社会问题的习惯，培育学生踊跃健康的生活态度。
default.en: Introduction of Chronic Diseases is the core course of the biomedical science major and plays an important role in medical courses.This course aims to explain its risk factors, screening methods, prevention and treatment principles, lifestyle guidance, rehabilitation exercise, monitoring and follow-up requirements, etc.Through theoretical research on chronic diseases, students have initially formed a habit of valuing and paying attention to social issues, and cultivated a positive and healthy attitude towards life.

default.zh: 本课程采用“AI预判 → 实验验证 → 偏差分析”闭环教学模式：AI负责快速筛查、提出假设，实验负责精准验证，学生通过亲手对比AI预判值与实验实测值，发现AI在什么条件下准、什么条件下不准、偏差从哪里来，使“健康医学”从概念落地为可测量的医学指标。
default.en: This course adopts a closed-loop teaching model of "AI prediction → experimental verification → deviation analysis": AI performs rapid screening and hypothesis formulation, while experiments conduct precise verification. By manually comparing AI-predicted values with experimentally measured values, students identify the conditions under which AI is accurate or inaccurate and the sources of deviations, enabling "health medicine" to evolve from a concept into measurable medical indicators.

default.zh: 本课程为面向生物医学科学专业学生开设的选修课，旨在构建“以健康为中心”的医学理念，强化疾病预防与健康促进的全局思维。课程系统介绍预防医学的基本理论、核心内容和实践方法，涵盖环境与健康、营养与食品卫生、职业卫生、流行病学基础、卫生统计学、慢性病防控、公共卫生政策与健康管理等内容。通过本课程学习，学生不仅掌握人群健康影响因素的识别与干预策略，更理解从个体诊疗到群体健康的范式转变。结合生物医学科学的专业特点，课程特别融入大数据驱动的疾病预测模型、人工智能在公共卫生监测中的应用、可穿戴设备与健康数据采集、数字健康管理系统设计等前沿内容，引导学生将工程技术与预防医学深度融合。本课程注重理论与实践结合，通过案例分析、项目设计与跨学科讨论，培养学生运用智能技术解决公共卫生问题的能力，为其未来参与智慧医疗系统开发、健康数据分析、个性化健康管理平台建设等奠定坚实的医学基础，助力“以治病为中心”向“以健康为中心”的战略转型。
default.en: This course is an elective offered to students majoring in Biomedical Sciences, aiming to establish a "health-centered" medical philosophy and strengthen a holistic mindset toward disease prevention and health promotion. The course systematically introduces the fundamental theories, core content, and practical methods of preventive medicine, covering topics such as environment and health, nutrition and food hygiene, occupational health, basic epidemiology, health statistics, chronic disease prevention and control, public health policy, and health management. Through this course, students will not only master the identification of population health determinants and intervention strategies but also understand the paradigm shift from individual clinical care to population health. Aligned with the characteristics of biomedical sciences, the course integrates cutting-edge content such as big data-driven disease prediction models, applications of artificial intelligence in public health surveillance, wearable devices and health data collection, and digital health management system design, guiding students to deeply integrate engineering technologies with preventive medicine. Emphasizing the integration of theory and practice, the course employs case studies, project design, and interdisciplinary discussions to cultivate students’ abilities to apply intelligent technologies in addressing public health challenges. It lays a solid medical foundation for their future involvement in smart healthcare system development, health data analysis, and personalized health management platform construction, supporting the strategic transformation from a "disease-centered" to a "health-centered" approach.

default.zh: 生物大分子是生物体的重要组成成份，不但有生物功能，而且分子量较大，其结构也比较复杂。在生物大分子中除主要的蛋白质与核酸外，另外还有糖、脂类和它们相互结合的产物，如糖蛋白、脂蛋白、核蛋白等。生物大分子的分析与检测主要是利用分子生物学、化学或物理学技术以及现代先进仪器设备来研究机体外源性和内源性生物大分子和大分子体系的存在、结构或表达调控的改变，从而为疾病诊断，病情监测，药物疗效，预后判断和疾病预防等多方面提供信息和理论依据，例如常见的PCR技术、DNA测序技术、免疫检测技术、质谱检测技术等。此外，生物大分子间的相互作用也是生命活动的基础，对生物大分子互作的分析与检测以及实时监测反应的动态过程也是生命研究中常见的主题。本课程理论讲授部分主要通过分章节详细介绍DNA、RNA、蛋白质、糖类、脂类以及其他生物大分子分析及检测技术的主要原理、特点和应用。实验课程部分，通过学生实际动手操作，使学生对课程所学理论知识有更加清晰地认识。通过本课程地学习，学时将掌握不同生物大分子检测方法的基本原理，了解这些检测方法的实际应用，并且能更加深入理解今后专业课程，包括生物化学、分子生物学、细胞生物学以及基因组学所讲授的知识内容。
default.en: Biomacromolecules are important components of living organisms. They not only have biological functions, but also have large molecular weights and complex structures. In addition to the main proteins and nucleic acids in biological macromolecules, there are also sugars, lipids and their combined products, such as glycoproteins, lipoproteins, and nucleoproteins. The analysis and detection of biological macromolecules mainly use molecular biology, chemistry or physics technology and modern advanced instruments and equipment to study the changes in the existence, structure or expression regulation of exogenous and endogenous biological macromolecules and macromolecular systems. , so as to provide information and theoretical basis for disease diagnosis, disease monitoring, drug efficacy, prognosis judgment and disease prevention, such as common PCR technology, DNA sequencing technology, immune detection technology, mass spectrometry detection technology, etc. In addition, the interaction between biological macromolecules is also the basis of life activities. The analysis and detection of the interaction of biological macromolecules and the real-time monitoring of the dynamic process of the reaction are also common topics in life research. In the theoretical part of this course, we will detailly introduce the main principles, characteristics and applications of analysis and detection of DNA, RNA, proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, other biological macromolecules and the interaction of biological macromolecules. In the experimental part of this course, students will have a clearer understanding of the theoretical knowledge learned in the course through practical hands-on operation. After finishing the study of this course, students will master the basic principles of different biological macromolecular detection methods, understand the practical application of these detection methods, and have a deeper understanding of the courses that will to study in the future, including biochemistry, molecular biology, cell biology and genomics.

default.zh: 从自然界中学习经验从而应用到人工系统中是科技发展的重要推动力，如今已经极大地促进了医学、光学、能源、催化等领域的发展。而在过去的几十年中，自然界的种种纳米现象也为先进材料的设计制备提供的了无限的灵感。纳米生物技术是目前国际生物技术领域中最前沿的研发热点。纳米生物材料和纳米生物技术的发展推动了相关生物技术的发展并将对人类的未来生活产生重大影响。课程通过讲授自然界中的纳米现象，纳米生物材料的物理效应、化学效应，以及介绍纳米贵金属、荧光量子点、磁性纳米粒子、无机药物载体等纳米材料在生物分离、检测及其在临床疾病诊断和治疗方面的相关成果知识，使同学们掌握纳米生物材料与技术的基本概念和基本原理，了解国内外相关研究的最新进展。着重掌握纳米材料的物化效应，以及在各种生物检测和治疗中的基本原理，为进行纳米生物技术的研究奠定理论基础。
default.en: Learning experience from nature and applying it to artificial systems is an important driving force for the development of science and technology. Now it has greatly promoted the development of medicine, optics, energy, catalysis and other fields. In the past few decades, various nano phenomena in nature have also provided infinite inspiration for the design and preparation of advanced materials. Nano-biotechnology is currently the most cutting-edge research and development hotspot in the international biotechnology field. The development of nano-biomaterials and nano-biotechnology has promoted the development of related biotechnology and will have a significant impact on human future life. The course aims to enable students to master the basic concepts and principles of nanomaterials and technologies by teaching nanomaterials in nature, physical effects and chemical effects of nanomaterials, as well as introducing the relevant achievements of nanomaterials such as precious metals, fluorescent quantum dots, magnetic nanoparticles and inorganic drug carriers in biological separation, detection and clinical disease diagnosis and treatment, Understand the latest progress of relevant research at home and abroad. Focus on mastering the physical and chemical effects of nanomaterials, as well as the basic principles in various biological detection and treatment, to lay a theoretical foundation for the research of nanotechnology.

default.zh: 微纳机器人技术作为机器人研究领域的重要分支，融合了材料、机械、化学及纳米等多学科交叉知识，被列为国家“十四五”和“健康中国2030”等战略规划的优先发展技。微纳米机器人尺度介于微米和纳米之间，能够将化学能、超声能、磁能、光能等转换为机械能，可深入狭小空间，完成宏观机器人无法实现的任务，在微纳加工、精准医疗、信息检测、能源开采以及环境污染处理等领域具有广阔的应用前景。微纳机器人所带来的先进技术优势与高附加值，已经引起国内外研究的普遍重视，其研究内容涉及数学、物理学、化学、生命科学以及医学等多方面知识，可供各专业学生进行学习。本课程基于微纳操作机器人的特点，提出根据微纳机器人的驱动与控制设计微纳机器人的构型原理，系统研究其设计理论和相关问题，培养学生对微纳机器人技术在生物医学领域的了解并提高学生设计纳米机器进行生物医疗方案的综合能力，应用纳米科学知识解决医学问题的能力，为培养我国微纳机器人等领域的人才奠定基础。
default.en: Swimming micro/nanorobots can be designed to carry out various tasks that macroscopic robots cannot, which renders them more possibility to be applied in various fields, including iatrology, biology, environment science, and nanotechnology. Especially in iatrology, these micro/nanorobots are expected to access hard-to-reach areas of the human body in a minimally invasive manner, such as the circulatory system, gastrointestinal tract, vasculature, brain, and eyes, resulting in the promising potential of micro/nanorobots for various biomedical applications, including targeted drug delivery, cancer treatment, diagnosis and monitoring, minimally invasive surgery, and tissue engineering. In the process of implementing various biomedical tasks, locomotion behavior is of great significance for micro/nanorobots. Unlike macroscale robots, when the size of robots reduces to the micro/nanoscale, their movement in the fluid is dominated by viscous forces rather than inertial forces due to the low Reynolds number environment. As a result, inertia-based propulsion strategies become ineffective in the microworld, in other words, a microscopic scallop can only execute reciprocal motion without net displacement at a low Reynolds number environment, which is concluded by Purcell’s Scallop Theorem. To overcome the limits caused by the Scallop Theorem, micro/nanorobots with flexible structures are developed by the inspiration of microorganisms with flagella or cilia. Additionally, strategies involving designing asymmetric geometric structures, providing interfaces, or utilizing asymmetric actuation sources can also be employed to break the Scallop Theorem. The energy sources used to power the micro/nanorobots are mainly divided into chemical energy sources, and external field energy sources (such as magnetic field, optical field, acoustic wave, and electric field. The Lecture is to introduce the basci fundermental, challenges, and research progress of micro/nanorobots.

default.zh: 分子影像学是指在活体状态下，应用影像学方法与技术手段对人和动物体内的细胞和分子水平生物学过程进行成像、定性和定量研究的学科。与传统的医学影像学相比，分子影像学着眼于生物体病理生理过程中细胞和分子水平的基础变化，通过解剖、功能、代谢或分子信息，为直观呈现基因表达、蛋白质作用、信号转导和细胞代谢等病理生理过程提供了有力的支持。实现了对病理生理过程的定性或者定量分析捕捉，为研究疾病的发生发展及转归奠定了坚实的基础。 本课程在生物化学与分子生物学、大学化学、医学基础导论等先修课程的基础上，系统介绍分子影像探针的设计原理及其在磁共振、CT、核医学、超声和光学成像中的实际应用。作为医工交叉协作的重要成果领域，分子影像学课程从实际应用角度出发，加深了学生对于生物医学工程前沿领域的认识和理解。同时有助于锻炼学生综合运用、整合、归纳生物化学、分子生物学、大学化学、医学影像学等基础学科的知识内容，强化学生利用多学科知识背景综合分析和处理问题的能力。
default.en: Molecular imaging refers to the interdisciplinary field that utilizes imaging methods and technological approaches to visualize, qualify, and quantitatively study cellular and molecular-level biological processes in living organisms, including humans and animals. In comparison to traditional medical imaging, molecular imaging focuses on the fundamental changes at the cellular and molecular levels in the pathophysiological processes of living organisms. Through anatomical, functional, metabolic, or molecular information, it provides robust support for the visual representation of pathological physiological processes such as gene expression, protein interactions, signal transduction, and cellular metabolism. Molecular imaging enables qualitative or quantitative analysis and capturing of pathophysiological processes, establishing a solid foundation for the study of disease occurrence, progression, and outcomes. Building upon prerequisites in biochemistry, molecular biology, general chemistry, and introductory courses in medicine, this course systematically introduces the design principles of molecular imaging probes and their practical applications in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography (CT), nuclear medicine, ultrasound, and optical imaging. As a significant outcome of interdisciplinary collaboration between medicine and engineering, the Molecular Imaging course, from a practical application perspective, enhances students' understanding of and insight into the forefront of biomedical engineering. It also helps students exercise their ability to comprehensively apply, integrate, and synthesize knowledge from foundational disciplines such as biochemistry, molecular biology, general chemistry, and medical imaging. The course aims to strengthen students' capacity to analyze and address problems using a multidisciplinary knowledge background.

default.zh: 《生物医学技术原理》课程是集“生物技术”、“仪器分析”和“医学实验技术的理论与应用”为一体的实验技术原理课程。注重培养学生知识、能力、素质的并重发展，贯穿培养学生创新思维和自学能力这一主导思想，在教学内容上体现了当前生物医学领域的最新技术，在教学手段和教学形式上强调教、学互动，拓展学生的视野和思路，着重培养并激发学生的综合分析能力。课程向学生传授当前医学检验和生物医学实验以及临床疾病实验室诊断中最具代表性的新的前沿技术，主要涵盖了分子生物学、细胞生物学、分子免疫学和分子诊断学等当前医学生物领域最前沿学科的相关技术，包括：免疫组织化学技术、生物芯片技术、下一代测序技术、单细胞基因组测序技术、液态芯片技术、基因组编辑技术等。本课程的开设旨在强化生物医学相关专业学生对传统的和先进的生物医学实验技术理论有较为完整的了解。同时，进一步理解这些技术在临床医疗实践和生物医学相关研究中的应用价值，了解国际、国内生物医学研究领域中的最新动态。
default.en: 《Principles of Biomedical Technology》is an integrated experimental technology course that combines "Biotechnology," "Instrument Analysis," and "Theory and Application of Medical Laboratory Techniques." It emphasizes the simultaneous development of students' knowledge, skills, and qualities, with a overarching focus on cultivating innovative thinking and self-learning abilities. The curriculum reflects the latest technologies in the field of biomedical science, highlighting a pedagogical approach that emphasizes interactive teaching methods and forms to broaden students' perspectives and thinking. The course places a strong emphasis on nurturing and stimulating students' comprehensive analytical abilities. The curriculum imparts to students the most representative cutting-edge technologies in medical diagnostics, biomedical experiments, and clinical disease laboratory diagnosis. It mainly covers technologies in the forefront disciplines of current medical biology, such as molecular biology, cell biology, molecular immunology, and molecular diagnostics. These technologies include immunohistochemical techniques, biochip technology, next-generation sequencing, single-cell sequencing, liquid chip technology, and genome editing technology. The objective of the course is to strengthen students' comprehensive understanding of both traditional and advanced theoretical principles of biomedical experimental techniques. Simultaneously, it aims to further their understanding of the applied value of these technologies in clinical medical practice and biomedical research, providing insights into the latest developments in the international and domestic biomedical research fields.

default.zh: 纳米医学是将纳米科学与技术应用于医学领域，用以开展疾病的预防、诊断、治疗和康复的一门新兴科技。纳米科技是近三十年来快速兴起的一门交叉学科。目前为止，纳米科学和纳米技术的研究成果已经从实验室逐渐走向临床实践，在疾病的治疗和预防过程中得到了广泛的应用。比如在新冠疫情中广泛应用的病毒检验试剂盒，治疗中广泛应用的纳米药物载体，等，都是纳米医学的产品成果。 本课程首先讲授纳米科学的基础理论，纳米科学的研究手段和纳米材料的种类特点，然后从生物医学检测、药物递送释放、卫生防疫、美容美妆、食品安全、农林养殖等方面介绍纳米医学的理论和产品的应用。在此过程中，使学生了解纳米医学目前面临的问题和挑战，以及纳米医学在国民生活和生产中的重要经济价值。本课程将为学生今后从事与生命科学相关的前沿研究、技术研发奠定知识基础，激发学生从事纳米科技创新工作的兴趣以及为我国生物医药事业奋斗的社会责任感。
default.en: Nanomedicine is the application of nanoscience and nanotechnology in medicine, including disease prevention, diagnosis, therapy, and rehabilitation. Nanoscience is interdisciplinary and has been quickly developed for three decades. So far, the achievements of nanoscience and nanotechnology have been extended from the lab to a wide range of applications. The test kits that are used in the COVID-19 pandemic and nanocarriers that are used in drug delivery are the achievements of nanoscience and technology. This course first introduces the basic principles and the methodology of nanoscience, and nanomaterials, then demonstrates the production and theory that can be used in biosensing, drug delivery, hygiene, cosmetics, food safety, agriculture, and forestry. The problems and challenges of the development of nanoscience and nanotechnology will be discussed. The economic value produced by nanotechnology will be introduced. This course will also encourage students to devote themselves to the development of nano bio- or medical technology.

default.zh: 信息物理系统-理论与建模是生物信息学专业、智能医学工程专业和生物医学科学专业的选修课程，其目的是使本专业学生了解信息物理系统的总体分类和基本结构；深入了解信息物理系统的设计、规范、建模和分析原则；掌握信息物理系统的基于模型的设计、并发理论、分布式算法、规范和验证的形式化方法、控制理论、实时系统和混合系统。通过课堂教学、实践教学等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和工程科学知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Cyber-Physical Systems: Theory and Modeling is an elective course for Bioinformatics majors, Intelligent Medical Engineering majors, and Biomedical Science majors. Its purpose is to make students understand the overall classification and basic structure of Cyber-Physical Systems; understand the design, specifications, modeling, and analysis principles of Cyber-Physical Systems; master the model-based design, concurrency theory, distributed algorithms, formal methods for specification and verification, control theory, real-time systems, and hybrid systems. Through classroom teaching, practical teaching and other links, cultivate students' innovative consciousness and ability and the application ability of engineering scientific knowledge, and support the achievement of corresponding index points in professional learning achievements.

default.zh: 《分子诊断》是临床检验诊断学的一个重要分支，是医学检验的前沿，代表着医学检验的发展方向。分子诊断以分子生物学理论为基础，利用分子生物学的技术和方法，在分子水平探讨疾病发生、发展及转归的分子机制，为疾病的预防、诊断、治疗及转归提供重要信息。课程内容主要包括分子诊断理论基础、分子诊断常用技术、感染性疾病的精准分子诊断、遗传性疾病的精准分子诊断、肿瘤的精准分子诊断、分子诊断技术在移植配型和法医物证鉴定中的应用、分子诊断技术在临床精准医疗中的应用、临床分子诊断的质量控制等内容。 本课程构建了科学合理的知识、能力、素质培养体系，包括分子诊断基本理论、分子诊断基本技术、分子诊断的临床应用三个部分。教学内容紧跟学科发展前沿，注重培养学生实际解决问题的能力，实现课程的创新性和挑战度。本课程主要采用课堂讲授和课堂报告的教学形式，通过学习使学生可以掌握常见分子生物学技术及其在临床医学检验中的应用，并得到科学研究和科学思维的良好训练，为将来的从事相关研究工作奠坚实的知识基础。
default.en: Molecular diagnostics is an important branch of clinical laboratory diagnostics, which is at the forefront of medical testing and represents the development direction of medical testing. Molecular diagnostics is based on molecular biology theory and utilize molecular biology techniques to explore the molecular mechanisms of disease occurrence, development, and prognosis at the molecular level, which provides important information for disease prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis. The course content mainly includes the theoretical basis of molecular diagnosis, common techniques of molecular diagnosis, precise molecular diagnosis of infectious diseases, precise molecular diagnosis of genetic diseases, precise molecular diagnosis of tumors, the application of molecular diagnosis technology in transplant matching and forensic material evidence identification, the application of molecular diagnosis technology in clinical precision medicine, and the quality control of clinical molecular diagnosis. This course constructs a scientific and reasonable knowledge, ability, and quality training system, including three parts: basic theory of molecular diagnosis, basic technology of molecular diagnosis, and clinical application of molecular diagnosis. The course content closely follows the forefront of subject development, focuses on cultivating students' practical problem-solving abilities, and realizes the innovation and challenge of the curriculum. Through the classroom lectures and reports, students can master common molecular biology techniques and their applications in clinical medical testing, and receive good training in scientific research and scientific thinking, that will lay a solid knowledge foundation for future related research work.

default.zh: 数据挖掘是近十几年来大数据、人工智能行业飞速发展最重要的驱动技术之一，当前大数据分析几乎都离不开数据挖掘技术，应用广泛，是业界所需。数据挖掘集合了概率统计、机器学习、人工智能、数据可视化、算法等等多门计算机领域核心知识，是信息技术研究的重要领域。掌握数据挖掘的相关知识技能对于学生当下就业和未来深造都有重要意义。 课程中将重点介绍：数据挖掘的最具有实用性的内容，包括认识数据、数据预处理、关联规则挖掘、聚类挖掘、回归分析、Logistic Regression、决策树、朴素贝叶斯、支持向量机、集成学习等。 本门课程授课对象为医学与健康学院工科试验班（医学类1），学生已先修微积分B、概率论与数理统计C、代数与几何C等专业基础课程。 经过这些训练，学生已经掌握了一些基本统计知识与技能。但医学与健康学院属于高度交叉学科，并且在医疗领域的应用中，需要学生掌握各种方法，不局限于医学专业知识，还包括统计学、计算机科学、生物学等专业知识。此外，学生们经过大一年级的学习，只是对医学与健康学院相关的专业与内容有了初步的了解，并没有实际深入到海量医疗数据计算、分析、建模等，对相关原理和知识运用缺乏足够认识，还停留简单概念理解层面，不能很好的以一个系统和有序的体系，去理解医疗大数据分析、作用及意义；不能更有效地结合专业知识与领域问题，全面理解数据建模在医疗健康领域中的重要作用；不具备应用统计学及R语言工具对相关知识进行问题分析、评估、解决实际问题和独立思考的能力。而这些能力的需求是本专业人才培养的核心目的，是学生有必要掌握的重要能力。 本课程为选修课，通过数据挖掘经典算法与R语言工具相结合，为学生后续能够更深入的学习有效开展科学研究、找到合适的工作提供良好的基础。
default.en: Data mining is one of the most important driving technologies for the rapid development of big data and artificial intelligence industries in the past decade. Currently, almost all big data analysis relies on data mining techniques, which are widely used and highly demanded in the industry. Data mining integrates core knowledge from multiple computer science fields such as probability and statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data visualization, algorithms, and more, making it an essential research area in information technology. Mastering relevant knowledge and skills in data mining is crucial for students' current employment and future advanced studies. In this course, we will focus on the most practical aspects of data mining, including data understanding, data preprocessing, association rule mining, clustering mining, regression analysis, Logistic Regression, decision trees, Naive Bayes, support vector machines, ensemble learning, and more. The teaching object of this course is the Engineering Experimental Class (Medical Category 1), and students have already taken such major basic courses as Calculus B, Probability Theory and Mathematical Statistics C, Algebra and Geometry C, etc. After these introductory courses, students have acquired basic statistical knowledge and skills. However, the Medicine and Health Sciences major is a highly interdisciplinary field, and in the medical domain, students need to master various methodologies that extend beyond medical expertise to include statistics, computer science, biology, and other disciplines. Additionally, while students may have had a preliminary introduction to their major's related topics during their freshman year, they lack a deep understanding of areas such as massive medical data computation, analysis, modeling, and the application of relevant principles and knowledge. They often remain at a superficial level of understanding concepts and cannot effectively comprehend the significance and impact of medical big data analysis within a systematic and organized framework. They may also struggle to integrate professional knowledge with domain-specific issues, fully appreciate the importance of data modeling in healthcare, or employ statistical methods and R language tools for problem analysis, evaluation, solution, and independent thinking. These capabilities are core to the professional development of students and are essential skills they need to acquire. This course is an elective that combines classic data mining algorithms with R language tools, providing a solid foundation for students to delve deeper into scientific research and prepare for suitable career paths.

default.zh: 微生物组涵盖了一个特定环境或者生态系统中的全部微生物及其遗传信息，反映了微生物与其环境和宿主的相互作用。微生物组与人类健康密切相关。微生物组学是继基因组学，生命科学与生物技术研究领域的重大突破之一，在医疗健康、农业、生态环境和工业制造方面具有广阔的应用前景。 《微生物组学概论》是生物信息学、智能医学工程、生物医学科学专业的选修课程，本课程从微生物组学的基础知识出发，指导学生学习掌握微生物组的研究方法和策略；以最新研究成果实例，阐述微生物组与代谢性疾病、神经精神疾病、膳食营养的关系；系统阐述益生菌、益生元、益生菌功能性代谢产物对肠道菌群的影响。 本课程旨在使学生掌握微生物组学基础理论和基本实验技能，了解当前微生物组学在生命科学领域的最新发展以及与多学科交叉融合现状，进而培养学生科学创新的思维方式，提高学生利用微生物组学相关知识发现科学问题、解决生命科学问题的综合能力，拓宽学生的科学研究视野。
default.en: The microbiome encompasses all microorganisms and their genetic information in a specific environment or ecosystem, reflecting the interactions between microorganisms and their environment and hosts. The microbiome is closely related to human health. Microbiomics is one of the major breakthroughs in genomics, life sciences, and biotechnology research, with broad application prospects in healthcare, agriculture, ecological environment, and industrial manufacturing. Introduction to Microbiomics is an elective course for majors in Bioinformatics, Intelligent Medical Engineering, and Biomedical Science. Starting from the basic knowledge of Microbiomics, this course guides students to learn and master the research methods and strategies of Microbiomics; Using the latest research results as examples, explain the relationship between microbiome and metabolic diseases, neurological and psychiatric disorders, and dietary nutrition; Systematically explain the effects of probiotics, prebiotics, and functional metabolites of probiotics on gut microbiota. This course aims to enable students to master the basic theories and experimental skills of microbiome, understand the latest developments in the field of life sciences and the current status of interdisciplinary integration of microbiome, cultivate students' scientific and innovative thinking methods, improve their comprehensive ability to discover scientific problems and solve life science problems using microbiome related knowledge, and broaden their scientific research perspectives.

default.zh: 生物药剂学是研究药物及其剂型在体内的吸收、分布、代谢与排泄过程，阐明药物的剂型因素，机体生物因素和药物疗效之间相互关系的学科，是药学专业的重要课程之一。它为正确评价药剂质量，设计合理的剂型、处方及生产工艺奠定基础，并为临床合理用药提供科学依据，使药物发挥最佳的治疗作用，是药学、医学等专业必不可少的课程。
default.en: Biology pharmaceutics is a discipline that studies the absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion processes of drugs and their formulations in the body, elucidates the formulation factors of drugs, and the interrelationships between biological factors and drug efficacy. It is one of the important courses in the field of pharmacy. It lays the foundation for the correct evaluation of drug quality, the design of reasonable dosage forms, prescriptions, and production processes, and provides scientific basis for clinical rational drug use, enabling drugs to exert the best therapeutic effects. It is an essential course for majors such as pharmacy and medicine.

default.zh: 生物医学材料，又称为生物医用材料或生物材料，是用于生物体诊断和治疗、修复、替换人体组织及器官或增进其功能的材料，其研究及应用涉及多个学科内容的交叉融合，如材料学、化学、生物学、生命科学和临床医学等。生物医学材料在治疗人类疾病、改善人类健康状况和提升生活质量方面起到了不可替代的作用，是一个重要的研究和应用领域。生物医用材料学也是生物医学科学和生物医学工程学科中的重要分支学科之一。《生物医学材料学》是面向生物信息学、智能医学工程、生物医学科学等专业本科生的专业选修课，将系统介绍生物医学材料的概念、分类、制备、性能、生物学评价以及应用，涵盖生物医学陶瓷、生物活性玻璃、生物医学金属、生物医学高分子材料、天然生物医学材料、组织工程与再生材料、纳米药物载体、医用游动纳米机器人等诸多类型的生物材料，重点讲解生物医学材料的性能与制备、生物学评价等方面内容，介绍国内外生物材料研究的最新进展以及发展趋势，可为从事新医工学科学研究等相关工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Biomedical materials, also known as biomaterials, are materials used for the diagnosis, therapy, repair, replacement of human tissues and organs, or enhancement of their functions. The research and application of biomaterials involve the chiastopic fusion of multiple disciplines, such as materials science, chemistry, biology, life sciences, and clinical medicine. Biomedical materials play an irreplaceable role in treating human diseases, improving human health, and enhancing quality of life, and are an important research and application field. Biomedical materials is also an important branch of biomedical science and biomedical engineering. Biomedical Materials is a professional elective course for undergraduate students majoring in bioinformatics, intelligent medical engineering, biomedical science, etc. This course systematically introduces the concept, classification, preparation, properties, biological evaluation, and applications of biomedical materials, covering biomedical ceramics, bioactive glass, biomedical metals, biomedical polymer materials, natural biomedical materials, tissue engineering and regenerative materials, nanomedicine carriers and medical swimming nanorobots. It will be introduced with a focus on the performance and preparation, biological evaluation, and other aspects of biomedical materials. The latest progress and development trends in biomaterials research at home and abroad will be introduced. This course can lay a solid foundation for engaging in new medical engineering scientific research and other related work.

default.zh: 生物力学是一门融合力学原理与生物学知识，旨在研究生物体力学行为的交叉学科。本课程聚焦于生物力学的基本概念、原理和方法，涵盖从细胞、组织到器官等多个生物层次的力学问题。通过本课程学习，学生将掌握生物力学的核心知识，具备运用力学方法分析生物系统力学特性的能力，为相关领域研究奠定坚实基础。本课程考核方式为平时上课表现占比20%，期末考查报告占比80%。
default.en: Biomechanics is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates mechanical principles with biological knowledge, aiming to study the mechanical behavior of living organisms. This course focuses on the basic concepts, principles, and methods of biomechanics, covering mechanical problems at multiple biological levels from cells and tissues to organs. Through the study of this course, students will master the core knowledge of biomechanics and possess the ability to analyze the mechanical characteristics of biological systems using mechanical methods, laying a solid foundation for research in related fields. The assessment method of this course is that daily classroom performance accounts for 20%, and the final examination report accounts for 80%.

default.zh: 益生菌与肠道健康是研究益生菌与肠道健康关系的科学，主要研究不同层次下益生菌的概述，益生菌与肠道环境的构建之间，以及益生菌对肠道健康的影响机制等内容。 本课程主要内容包括益生菌和肠道微生态的基础知识和概念；肠道微生态的构建、组成、与益生菌的关系、宿主环境与肠道微生态的关系；微生态的构建与肠道健康之间的关系。益生菌对肠道平衡的调节作用、对肠道炎症的调节作用、对糖脂代谢疾病的调节作用、益生菌代谢产物对肠道健康的影响；益生菌对肠道健康调节的作用机制；益生菌对肠道健康调节作用的前言和热点问题的讨论。使学生运用本课程所学的基础知识，为未来研究调节肠道健康的相关益生菌食品的研发提供思路。采用课堂讲授和讨论教学相结合的教学方法，使学生在牢固掌握基础知识和基本概念的同时，得到科学研究、科学思维和科学方法的良好训练，为其他专业课的学习及日后的研究工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Probiotics and gut health is a science that studies the relationship between probiotics and gut health. It mainly focuses on the overview of probiotics at different levels, the relationship between probiotics and the construction of the gut environment, and the mechanisms by which probiotics affect gut health. The main content of this course includes basic knowledge and concepts of probiotics and gut microbiota; The construction and composition of gut microbiota, its relationship with probiotics, and the relationship between host environment and gut microbiota; The relationship between the construction of microecology and intestinal health. The regulatory effects of probiotics on intestinal balance, intestinal inflammation, glucose and lipid metabolism diseases, and the impact of probiotic metabolites on intestinal health; The mechanism of probiotics in regulating intestinal health; Introduction and hot topic discussion on the regulatory effects of probiotics on intestinal health. Enable students to apply the basic knowledge learned in this course to provide ideas for future research on the development of probiotic foods that regulate intestinal health. Adopting a teaching method that combines classroom lectures and discussion teaching, students can not only firmly grasp basic knowledge and concepts, but also receive good training in scientific research, scientific thinking, and scientific methods, laying a solid foundation for the study of other professional courses and future research work.

default.zh: 本课程将为学生介绍机器学习、模式识别和数据挖掘技术。通过学习该课程将使学生能够掌握两种系统方法：一种能够从试错经验中制定自己的规则以解决问题，另一种能够在没有任何监督的情况下在数据中发现模式。在后一种情况下，数据挖掘技术将使生成新知识成为可能，包括非常庞大的数据集。此课程将涵盖一系列主题，包括：机器学习基础；模式识别基础；人工神经网络；支持向量机；机器学习的应用和假设评估。
default.en: Providing students with an introduction to machine learning, pattern recognition, and data mining techniques, this module will enable students to consider both systems which are able to develop their own rules from trial-and-error experience to solve problems, as well as systems that find patterns in data without any supervision. In the latter case, data mining techniques will make generation of new knowledge possible, including very big data sets. It'll cover a range of topics including: machine learning foundations; pattern recognition foundations; artificial neural networks; support vector machine; applications of machine learning and evaluating hypotheses.

default.zh: 本课程结合医学数字图像的特点,向学生介绍医学数字图像处理和分析基本知识、方法和技术。培养学生掌握医学图像处理的基本概念，熟悉医学图像处理的常用知识， 具备数字图像的数学描述、医学图像处理常用的能力：数学知识、取样定理、离散傅氏变换的基本性质和算法，熟悉正交变换、哈德玛变换算法，了 解离散余弦变换和K-L变换等；掌握图像增强、图像分割、图像压缩及编码、图像复原的基本概念、熟悉常用的图像增强、图像分割处理技术、图像编码技术、基本图像插值方法、图像复原数学模型建立方法等。
default.en: This course combines the characteristics of medical digital images to introduce students to the basic knowledge, methods and techniques of medical digital image processing and analysis. Cultivate students to master the basic concepts of medical image processing, be familiar with common knowledge of medical image processing, and have the mathematical description of digital images and common abilities of medical image processing: mathematical knowledge, sampling theorem, basic properties and algorithms of discrete Fourier transform, and be familiar with normal Alternate transform and Hadmar transform algorithms, understand discrete cosine transform and K-L transform, etc.; master the basic concepts of image enhancement, image segmentation, image compression and coding, and image restoration,, basic image interpolation methods, image restoration mathematical model establishment methods, etc.

default.zh: 发育生物学是研究多细胞动物生长发育的基本过程和机理的科学。在先修生物化学与分子生物学、细胞生物学、医学基础导论、医学遗传学等课程的前提下，本课程重点讲述多细胞动物的胚胎发育、胚后生长及相关的分子机制，侧重人及模式动物为研究对象。 要求学生掌握本教学大纲所规定的基本内容, 理解多细胞动物发育的主要过程、规律与分子机制；从发育的角度来认识动物有机体, 并与其它课程相结合, 以达到对多细胞动物发育的全面认识。通过发育生物学课程的学习，主要了解动物发育的基本规律和机理、当前发育生物学领域的新进展和新发现，为今后从事生物医学科学研究和相关工作打下基础。
default.en: Developmental biology is the science that studies the basic processes and mechanisms of growth and development in multicellular animals. With the prerequisite of biochemistry and molecular biology, cell biology, introduction to medical fundamentals, medical genetics and other courses, this course focuses on the fertilization process, embryonic development, post-embryonic growth of multicellular animals and related molecular mechanisms, and focuses on human and model animals as the object of study. Students are required to master the basic content of the syllabus, understand the main processes, laws and molecular mechanisms of multicellular animal development; recognize the animal organism from the perspective of development, and combine with other courses to achieve a comprehensive understanding of multicellular animal development. Through the study of Developmental Biology, students will learn the basic laws and mechanisms of animal development, and the new progress and discovery in the field of developmental biology, which will lay the foundation for future biomedical scientific research and related work.

default.zh: 本课程致力于运用信息科学的基本理论和方法,与临床医学数据相结合,向学生介绍计算机辅助诊疗基本知识、方法和技术。培养学生掌握计算机辅助诊疗的基本概念，熟悉计算机辅助诊疗的常用知识，具备计算机辅助诊疗的应用领域、发展状况以及基本原理的能力与素质：掌握解决一般计算机辅助诊疗涉及的数学形式化问题（如聚类、分类及特征表示）的形式化方法；掌握具体问题抽象化、复杂问题简单化的基本思想；熟练计算机辅助诊疗应用相关的基本模型、算法；具备计算机辅助诊疗系统及模块构建的基本能力；能够利用统计、机器学习基本方法，根据具体问题设计并实现合理的智能医学数据分析算法及系统。
default.en: This course is dedicated to using the basic theories and methods of information science, combined with clinical medical data, to introduce students to the basic knowledge, methods and technologies of computer-aided diagnosis and treatment. Cultivate students to master the basic concepts of computer-aided diagnosis and treatment, be familiar with common knowledge of computer-aided diagnosis and treatment, and have the ability and quality to apply fields, development status and basic principles of computer-aided diagnosis and treatment: master the mathematical formalization problems involved in general computer-aided diagnosis and treatment (such as Formal methods of clustering, classification and feature representation); master the basic ideas of abstracting specific problems and simplifying complex problems; be proficient in basic models and algorithms related to the application of computer-aided diagnosis and treatment; have the basic ability to build computer-aided diagnosis and treatment systems and modules ; Be able to use basic methods of statistics and machine learning to design and implement reasonable intelligent medical data analysis algorithms and systems based on specific problems.

default.zh: 本课程立足"药食同源"传统智慧，创新性融合人工智能技术，构建中医药健康管理的现代科学实践体系。课程系统讲授药食同源物质性味归经与功效药理、现代医学营养学构效关系、中医体质辨识等基础理论，结合AI图像识别、健康大数据分析、生成式大语言模型等技术手段，培养学生通过药食同源物质功效信息、机体健康状态分析、问卷信息等进行健康状态数据采集与评估，运用算法模型实现个性化健康干预方案设计。重点开展AI辅助精准营养订制、特需食品开发、功能因子智能匹配、药膳配方优化等实践项目。课程旨在培养既深谙传统养生智慧，又能运用现代智能技术解决健康管理问题的新型复合人才，推动中医药传统文化传承与大健康产业智能化升级的深度融合。
default.en: This course is rooted in the traditional wisdom of Food & Medicine Homology and innovatively integrates artificial intelligence (AI) technology to build a modern scientific practice system for traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) health management. It systematically teaches fundamental theories, including the properties, flavors, meridian tropism, and pharmacological effects of Food & Medicine Homology substances, the structure-activity relationships in modern medical nutrition, and TCM constitution identification. By combining technical tools such as AI image recognition, health big data analysis, and generative large language models, the course trains students to collect and evaluate health status data through the efficacy information of Food & Medicine Homology substances, physical health analysis, and questionnaire data. Students will learn to design personalized health intervention plans using algorithm models. Key practical projects include AI-assisted precise nutrition customization, development of special-needs foods, intelligent matching of functional factors, and optimization of medicinal diet formulations. The course aims to cultivate new-type interdisciplinary talents who possess deep knowledge of traditional wellness wisdom and can apply modern intelligent technologies to solve health management challenges, promoting the in-depth integration of TCM cultural inheritance and the intelligent upgrading of the big health industry.

default.zh: 微纳机器人技术作为机器人研究领域的重要分支，融合了材料、机械、化学及纳米等多学科交叉知识，被列为国家“十四五”和“健康中国2030”等战略规划的优先发展技。微纳米机器人尺度介于微米和纳米之间，能够将化学能、超声能、磁能、光能等转换为机械能，可深入狭小空间，完成宏观机器人无法实现的任务，在微纳加工、精准医疗、信息检测、能源开采以及环境污染处理等领域具有广阔的应用前景。微纳机器人所带来的先进技术优势与高附加值，已经引起国内外研究的普遍重视，其研究内容涉及数学、物理学、化学、生命科学以及医学等多方面知识，可供各专业学生进行学习。本课程基于微纳操作机器人的特点，提出根据微纳机器人的驱动与控制设计微纳机器人的构型原理，系统研究其设计理论和相关问题，培养学生对微纳机器人技术在生物医学领域的了解并提高学生设计纳米机器进行生物医疗方案的综合能力，应用纳米科学知识解决医学问题的能力，为培养我国微纳机器人等领域的人才奠定基础。
