Especially in iatrology, these micro/nanorobots are expected to access hard-to-reach areas of the human body in a minimally invasive manner, such as the circulatory system, gastrointestinal tract, vasculature, brain, and eyes, resulting in the promising potential of micro/nanorobots for various biomedical applications, including targeted drug delivery, cancer treatment, diagnosis and monitoring, minimally invasive surgery, and tissue engineering. In the process of implementing various biomedical tasks, locomotion behavior is of great significance for micro/nanorobots. Unlike macroscale robots, when the size of robots reduces to the micro/nanoscale, their movement in the fluid is dominated by viscous forces rather than inertial forces due to the low Reynolds number environment. As a result, inertia-based propulsion strategies become ineffective in the microworld, in other words, a microscopic scallop can only execute reciprocal motion without net displacement at a low Reynolds number environment, which is concluded by Purcell’s Scallop Theorem. To overcome the limits caused by the Scallop Theorem, micro/nanorobots with flexible structures are developed by the inspiration of microorganisms with flagella or cilia. Additionally, strategies involving designing asymmetric geometric structures, providing interfaces, or utilizing asymmetric actuation sources can also be employed to break the Scallop Theorem. The energy sources used to power the micro/nanorobots are mainly divided into chemical energy sources, and external field energy sources (such as magnetic field, optical field, acoustic wave, and electric field. The Lecture is to introduce the basci fundermental, challenges, and research progress of micro/nanorobots.

default.zh: 《慢性病智能监控与干预》是生物医学科学专业的专业核心课程，在医学类专业课程体系中占有重要的地位。慢性病是指不构成传染、具有长期积累形成疾病形态损害的疾病的总称。慢性病的危害主要是造成脑、心、肾等重要脏器的损害，易造成伤残，影响劳动能力和生活质量，且医疗费用极其昂贵，增加了社会和家庭的经济负担。 本课程旨在讲解其危险因素、筛查方法、防治原则、生活方式指导、康复锻炼、监测随访要求等。提升医学生、医务工作者和普通人群对常见慢性病有关知识的掌握和了解，有助于降低慢性病的患病率、致残率和死亡率，提高慢性病的知晓率、治疗率、依从性和控制率，从而提高人们生活质量和延长寿命。通过课程学习，让学生掌握如何利用数字化、智能化技术手段，对慢性疾病患者进行全方位健康数据采集、分析与管理。系统研究慢性疾病理论，学生初步形成重视、关注社会问题的习惯，培育学生踊跃健康的生活态度。
default.en: Introduction of Chronic Diseases is the core course of the biomedical science major and plays an important role in medical courses. Chronic diseases refer to the general term for diseases that do not constitute infection and have long-term accumulation and form of disease damage. The harm of chronic diseases is mainly caused by damage to important organs such as the brain, heart, and kidneys, which can easily cause disability, affect labor ability and quality of life, and medical expenses are extremely expensive, increasing the economic burden on society and families. This course aims to explain its risk factors, screening methods, prevention and treatment principles, lifestyle guidance, rehabilitation exercise, monitoring and follow-up requirements, etc. Improving the knowledge and understanding of common chronic diseases among medical students, medical workers, and the general population can help reduce the incidence, disability, and mortality rates of chronic diseases, improve the awareness, treatment, compliance, and control rates of chronic diseases, thereby improving people's quality of life and extending their lifespan. Through course learning, students will master how to use digital and intelligent technology to collect, analyze, and manage comprehensive health data of chronic disease patients. Through course learning, students will master how to use digital and intelligent technology to collect, analyze, and manage comprehensive health data of chronic disease patients.Through theoretical research on chronic diseases, students have initially formed a habit of valuing and paying attention to social issues, and cultivated a positive and healthy attitude towards life.

default.zh: 《智能仿生医学》是医学与健康学院面向本科生开设的一门跨学科选修课程，融合生物学、医学、材料学、电子与控制科学等多个前沿领域，旨在为学生提供智能仿生医学领域的系统性知识框架和创新能力训练。本课程适用于生物医学工程、智能医学工程、人工智能、计算机科学与技术等相关专业学生修读，致力于衔接基础医学理论与尖端工程应用，推动医学与工程的深度交叉融合。 课程内容涵盖仿生学基础理论与方法、智能材料与结构设计、生物信号感知与交互技术、神经仿生与脑机接口、仿生机器人系统等重要方向。课程从仿生学基本原理出发，系统介绍生物系统的结构与功能机制，重点探讨如何利用智能材料、传感技术和控制方法实现医学应用中的功能模拟与增强。在神经仿生与脑机接口模块，将引导学生理解神经信号编解码、运动控制重建等关键技术；在仿生机器人部分，则聚焦于医疗机器人、康复辅助设备等实际系统的设计与分析。 教学方式注重理论与实践结合，通过典型案例分析——如仿生假肢、智能植入器件、可穿戴健康设备等——帮助学生建立从生物机理到工程实现的系统化思维。课程特别设置有关科技伦理与社会影响的专题讨论，引导学生反思智能仿生技术发展过程中的伦理挑战、安全性问题及社会接受度，培养其负责任创新的意识与能力。 本课程致力于培养学生跨学科整合知识与技术的能力，强调创新设计与系统实现，支持学生在康复工程、智能医疗器械、精准医疗等方向的深入发展与职业规划。课程不仅为学生提供扎实的理论基础和技术方法，更注重激发创新意识和团队协作精神，是培养具备国际视野与社会责任感的创新型医学工程人才的重要环节。
default.en: Intelligent Bionic Medicine is an interdisciplinary elective course offered by the School of Medicine and Health for undergraduate students. Integrating biology, medicine, materials science, electronics, and control science, this course covers fundamental topics such as bionics principles, smart materials and structures, biosignal sensing and interaction, neural bionics and brain-computer interfaces, as well as bionic robotics. It is designed for students majoring in Biomedical Engineering, Intelligent Medical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science and Technology, and related disciplines. The course aims to bridge basic medical knowledge with cutting-edge engineering applications, focusing on the use of bionic principles, smart materials, biosensing, and control technologies in medicine. Through a combination of theoretical instruction and case studies, students will develop a holistic understanding of bionic systems and critically examine ethical challenges and societal impacts associated with intelligent bionic technologies. The course seeks to cultivate interdisciplinary integration and innovative design capabilities. By building a cross-disciplinary knowledge framework, this course supports students' academic and professional development in rehabilitation engineering, intelligent medical devices, precision medicine, and other emerging fields. It serves as a vital component in educating innovative talents in medical engineering, preparing them to contribute to the future of healthcare technology.

default.zh: 《基因与疾病》是智能医学工程专业的专业选修课程。大量研究表明，基因与疾病之间存在着紧密联系。本课程旨在使学生掌握基因与疾病关系的基础理论、基因诊断和基因治疗的基本实验技能，了解当前基因与疾病相关研究的最新发展以及与多学科交叉融合现状，进而培养学生科学创新的思维方式，提高学生利用相关知识发现科学问题、解决生命科学问题的综合能力。
default.en: Genes and Diseases is an elective course for the Intelligent Medical Engineering major. Numerous studies have shown a close relationship between genes and diseases. The purpose of this course is to enable students to master the basic theory of the relationship between genes and diseases, as well as the basic experimental skills of gene diagnosis and gene therapy. They will also learn about the latest developments in gene and disease related research and the current status of interdisciplinary integration. This will cultivate students' scientific and innovative thinking, and enhance their comprehensive ability to use relevant knowledge to discover scientific problems and solve life science problems.

default.zh: 《基因治疗前沿进展》是生物医学科学专业的课程，在整个课程体系中占有重要的地位。基因治疗作为现代医学的革命性技术，正以前所未有的速度重塑疾病治疗格局。其核心在于通过基因编辑、基因替换或基因调控等手段，从分子层面纠正致病基因缺陷或增强靶向功能，以治疗疾病或改善生理状况的一种技术。随着分子生物学和基因工程技术的飞速发展，基因治疗逐渐成为生物医学领域的研究热点。越来越多的疾病被证实与基因突变或常表达密切相关，为基因治疗提供了广阔的应用空间。 本课程主要讲述基因治疗的核心技术、通过临床应用与案例分析让学生了解基因治疗的未来发展趋势，为学习其他相关课程奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: The Frontiers of Gene Therapy "is a course in the field of biomedical science, which occupies an important position in the entire curriculum system. Gene therapy, as a revolutionary technology in modern medicine, is reshaping the pattern of disease treatment at an unprecedented speed. The core of this technology is to correct pathogenic gene defects or enhance targeted functions at the molecular level through gene editing, gene replacement, or gene regulation, in order to treat diseases or improve physiological conditions. With the rapid development of molecular biology and genetic engineering technology, gene therapy has gradually become a research hot spot in the biomedical field. More and more diseases have been confirmed to be closely related to gene mutations or frequent expression, providing broad application space for gene therapy. This course mainly discusses the core technology of gene therapy, and through clinical applications and case analysis, enables students to understand the future development trends of gene therapy, laying a solid foundation for learning other related courses.

default.zh: 《神经调控技术》是医学与健康学院面向智能医学工程专业本科生开设的一门跨学科选修课程，同时也适用于生物医学工程、人工智能、计算机科学与技术等相关专业的学生。本课程聚焦于神经科学、工程技术与人工智能的交叉领域，旨在通过系统化的理论教学与前沿实践案例，帮助学生掌握神经调控技术的核心原理、关键方法及其在医疗健康中的创新应用。 课程内容涵盖神经调控的基本理论与技术体系，包括神经电刺激（如深部脑刺激、脊髓刺激）、磁刺激（如经颅磁刺激）、经颅电刺激、经颅聚焦超声刺激等调控手段，并重点讲解如何通过多模态信号处理、人工智能算法与闭环反馈系统设计实现精准、自适应的神经调控策略。学生将学习到神经环路功能解析、刺激参数优化、神经信号解码与建模等知识，同时深入理解神经调控在帕金森病、抑郁症、癫痫、睡眠障碍等疾病治疗中的临床应用。 本课程注重培养学生跨学科整合与创新实践能力。通过案例研讨、仿真实验与项目实践，学生将尝试设计面向特定场景的神经调控方案，从而提升独立分析问题、开展工程设计与医学应用转化的能力。 随着脑科学与人工智能的快速发展，神经调控技术在脑机接口、智能医疗设备、神经康复工程等领域展现出广泛前景。本课程将为学生在神经工程、智能医疗系统研发、科研创新及产业应用等领域的发展奠定坚实理论基础与实践能力，培养符合未来医疗健康行业需求的复合型人才。
default.en: Neuromodulation Technology is an interdisciplinary elective course offered by the School of Medicine and Health for undergraduate students majoring in Intelligent Medical Engineering. It is also suitable for students from related disciplines such as Biomedical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, and Technology. This course focuses on the intersection of neuroscience, engineering technology, and artificial intelligence, aiming to help students master the core principles, key methodologies, and innovative applications of neuromodulation technology in healthcare through systematic theoretical teaching and cutting-edge practical case studies. The course content covers the fundamental theories and technical systems of neuromodulation, including neural electrical stimulation (e.g., deep brain stimulation, spinal cord stimulation), magnetic stimulation (e.g., transcranial magnetic stimulation), transcranial electrical stimulation, transcranial focused ultrasound stimulation, and other modulation techniques. Emphasis is placed on how to achieve precise and adaptive neuromodulation strategies through multimodal signal processing, artificial intelligence algorithms, and closed-loop feedback system design. Students will learn about neural circuit function analysis, stimulation parameter optimization, neural signal decoding and modeling, while gaining an in-depth understanding of the clinical applications of neuromodulation in treating diseases such as Parkinson's disease, depression, epilepsy, and sleep disorders. This course emphasizes the development of students' interdisciplinary integration and innovative practical abilities. Through case studies, simulation experiments, and project practices, students will attempt to design neuromodulation solutions for specific scenarios, thereby enhancing their ability to independently analyze problems, conduct engineering design, and translate medical applications.

default.zh: 本课程为面向智能医学工程专业学生开设的选修课，旨在构建“以健康为中心”的医学理念，强化疾病预防与健康促进的全局思维。课程系统介绍预防医学的基本理论、核心内容和实践方法，涵盖环境与健康、营养与食品卫生、职业卫生、流行病学基础、卫生统计学、慢性病防控、公共卫生政策与健康管理等内容。通过本课程学习，学生不仅掌握人群健康影响因素的识别与干预策略，更理解从个体诊疗到群体健康的范式转变。结合智能医学工程的专业特点，课程特别融入大数据驱动的疾病预测模型、人工智能在公共卫生监测中的应用、可穿戴设备与健康数据采集、数字健康管理系统设计等前沿内容，引导学生将工程技术与预防医学深度融合。本课程注重理论与实践结合，通过案例分析、项目设计与跨学科讨论，培养学生运用智能技术解决公共卫生问题的能力，为其未来参与智慧医疗系统开发、健康数据分析、个性化健康管理平台建设等奠定坚实的医学基础，助力“以治病为中心”向“以健康为中心”的战略转型。
default.en: This elective course is designed for undergraduate students majoring in Intelligent Medical Engineering, aiming to cultivate a "health-centered" medical philosophy and strengthen a holistic mindset toward disease prevention and health promotion. The course systematically introduces the fundamental theories, core content, and practical methods of preventive medicine, covering topics such as environment and health, nutrition and food hygiene, occupational health, fundamentals of epidemiology and biostatistics, chronic disease prevention and control, public health policy, and health management. Through this course, students not only learn to identify population-level health determinants and design intervention strategies, but also understand the paradigm shift from individual clinical care to population health. Aligned with the characteristics of intelligent medical engineering, the course integrates cutting-edge content such as big data-driven disease prediction models, artificial intelligence applications in public health surveillance, wearable devices for health data collection, and digital health management system design, encouraging deep integration of engineering technologies with preventive medicine. Emphasizing the combination of theory and practice, the course employs case studies, project-based learning, and interdisciplinary discussions to develop students’ abilities to address public health challenges using intelligent technologies. It lays a solid medical foundation for their future involvement in smart healthcare system development, health data analytics, and personalized health management platforms, supporting the strategic transformation from "disease-centered" to "health-centered" care.

default.zh: 公共营养学是研究如何预防疾病和通过改善人群的饮食习惯以提高其营养状况和健康水平的科学，是营养学的重要分支学科。本课程旨在全面培养学生在公共营养领域的专业素养和实践能力，涵盖公共营养的基础理论、不同生命周期群体的营养需求、社区营养干预等内容。通过理论教学与案例分析，学生将能够系统掌握公共营养的核心知识，具备解决实际营养问题的能力，并培养良好的职业素养和社会责任感。
default.en: Public Nutrition is the science of preventing diseases and improving the nutritional status and health level of populations through better dietary habits. As an important branch of nutrition, this course is designed to comprehensively develop students' professional competence and practical skills in the field of public nutrition. It covers the fundamental theories of public nutrition, the nutritional requirements of different life-cycle groups, and community nutrition interventions. Through theoretical teaching and case analysis, students will systematically master the core knowledge of public nutrition, be equipped with the ability to solve practical nutritional problems, and cultivate a strong sense of professional ethics and social responsibility.

default.zh: 本课程全面覆盖特殊人群、特殊环境及特殊职业人群的营养需求与代谢特点，旨在培养学生深入理解不同人群的生理特征、营养需求及健康挑战，掌握科学的营养评估与干预方法，为从事营养学研究、公共卫生实践及临床营养指导提供坚实的理论基础和实践技能。
default.en: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the nutritional needs and metabolic characteristics of special populations, individuals in special environments, and those with unique occupational demands. It aims to equip students with a deep understanding of the physiological features, nutritional requirements, and health challenges faced by different groups of people. By mastering scientific methods of nutritional assessment and intervention, students will be well-prepared for careers in nutrition research, public health practice, and clinical nutrition guidance, with a solid theoretical foundation and practical skills.

default.zh: 本课程系统讲解营养与代谢的基础知识和前沿技术，涵盖细胞结构、代谢通路、遗传物质与蛋白质合成，深入探讨消化吸收机制、营养素代谢过程、激素调控、代谢性疾病与营养干预，以及现代技术在代谢研究中的应用。通过理论教学与案例分析，培养学生运用代谢理论解决实际问题的能力，为从事相关领域的研究和实践提供坚实的理论基础和实践技能。
default.en: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the fundamental knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in nutrition and metabolism. It covers a wide range of topics, including cell structure, metabolic pathways, genetic material and protein synthesis. The course also delves into the mechanisms of digestion and absorption, the metabolic processes of nutrients, hormonal regulation, metabolic diseases and nutritional interventions, as well as the application of modern technologies in metabolic research. Through theoretical teaching and case analysis, students will be equipped with the ability to apply metabolic theories to solve practical problems. This course aims to provide students with a solid theoretical foundation and practical skills, preparing them for careers in research and practice in related fields.

default.zh: 该课程面向智能医学工程专业学生开设，首要目标为使学生对主要疾病的症状表现、诊疗策略、预后以及康复等临床医学各环节有整体的认知。在此基础上，参考医工结合领域的应用实例，使学生掌握结合自身专业背景发现临床医学痛难点的能力，通过自主学习找到切入点并初步提出解决方案。本课程分为基础篇与疾病篇。前者从物理诊断、辅助检查、常见操作、急危重病方面介绍临床医学的逻辑体系与基础知识，并通过医工结合的应用实例，引导与启发学生在后续学习中关注以工学手段解决医学问题的切入点。后者为疾病各论，着重讲授疾病的病理生理和实验室及其它检查与疾病诊治的联系，涉及内、外、妇、儿、传染病等临床各科常见病、多发病，使学生对临床医学应用场景有具象的认识。本课程临床医学理论知识的讲解，将提升学生以工学背景解决临床医学实际问题的敏锐度，有助于引导学生形成正确的人生观并增强社会责任感。
default.en: This course is designed for undergraduates in Intelligent Medical Engineering majors. The primary goal is to enable students to have a holistic understanding of various aspects of clinical medicine, including symptoms, diagnosis and treatment strategies, prognosis, and rehabilitation of major diseases. On this basis, students will develop their ability to identify challenges in clinical medicine based on their engineering background, and to independently find solutions and propose initial plans, through application examples in the field of medical and industrial integration. This course is divided to the basic section and disease section. The former section introduces the logical framework and basic knowledge of clinical medicine, covering physical diagnosis, auxiliary examination, common operations, and critical illness, utilizes case studies of medical-engineering integration to guide and inspire students to focus on entry points for solving medical problems with engineering approaches in their future studies. The latter section focuses on the relationship between disease pathophysiology, laboratory and other examinations, and disease diagnosis and treatment, covering common and frequently-occurring diseases in various clinical departments including internal medicine, surgery, gynecology, pediatrics, and infectious diseases, allowing students to gain a concrete understanding of clinical application scenarios. The current course aims to enhance students' sensitivity to solving practical problems in clinical medicine with an engineering background, and guide students to establish correct values and a strong sense of social responsibility.

default.zh: 生物传感器是一类特殊形式的传感器，由生物分子识别元件与各类物理、化学换能器组成，用于各种生命物质和化学物质的分析和检测，广泛应用于医疗、环境监测、食品检测、发酵工业等领域。本课程的理论教学是使学生了解传感器的静、动特性和主要性能指标，掌握常用传感器的工作原理以及在医疗器械中的地位，学会生物传感器的生物分子敏感元件基础及其固定化方法，电化学、微热学、半导体、声波、光学、表面等离子体共振等各种生物传感器的工作原理和常规制备方法；同时掌握集成技术、生物芯片、纳米技术等在生物传感器中的应用，了解本领域国际研究热点。通过实验培养学生总体上了解和掌握生物传感器的常规制备方法和传感器的设计，要求学生理解实验原理及实验方案，掌握正确操作规程；掌握相关仪器的使用，了解其性能参数、适应范围及注意事项等。通过本课程的学习，培养学生利用生物技术、现代电子技术、传感器技术和计算机技术解决生产实际中信息采集以及处理问题的能力，并为医疗器械系统的设计与开发奠定良好的基础。
default.en: A biosensor is an analytical device which converts a biological response into an electrical signal and is key technique used to quantify biomolecules, for detection of disease, pharmaceutical research, diagnostic testing, monitoring health of living organisms, and others. This course provides a thorough review of fundamental concepts of biosensing systems, principles of common detection methods, and modern applications of biosensors. Students will obtain a detailed understanding of cutting-edge biosensing techniques, the instrumentation used and the application space. Students also will develop skills in using current literature as a source of knowledge and through practical experiments.

default.zh: 在综合实验1和综合实验2的基础上，本次实验旨在让学生回顾肌电信号的特点及常用的数据采集与分析方法，学习描述机械臂位姿的数据工具、机械臂的正逆运动学建模方式以及空间轨迹规划的基本知识。在掌握上述内容后，在老师的指导下开展基于肌电信号手势识别的人机交互实验，完成实验设计与完善、数据采集与处理、模式分类与机械控制等任务，做到融会贯通。对学有余力的学生引导其人机协作领域的未来发展方向，了解前沿研究和应用案例。
default.en: On the basis of Comprehensive Experiment 1 and Comprehensive Experiment 2, this experiment aims to allow students to review the characteristics of EMG signals and commonly used data collection and analysis methods, to learn data tools for describing the pose of robotic arms, the forward and inverse kinematics modeling methods of robotic arms, and the basic knowledge of spatial trajectory planning. After mastering the above content, under the guidance of the teacher, a human-computer interaction experiment based on EMG signal gesture recognition will be carried out, completing tasks such as experimental design and improvement, data acquisition and processing, pattern classification and mechanical control, and achieving integration. Guide students who have spare energy to explore the future development direction of human-machine collaboration, and understand cutting-edge research and application cases.

default.zh: 细胞生物学是研究细胞基础生命活动规律的科学，它在不同层次上研究细胞的结构与功能，是现代生命科学的重要基础学科。课程内容主要包括细胞的基本结构、细胞质膜与物质的跨膜运输、细胞质基质与内膜系统、蛋白质分选与膜泡运输、线粒体与叶绿体、细胞骨架、细胞核与染色质、核糖体、细胞信号转导、细胞周期和细胞分裂、细胞增殖调控与癌细胞、细胞分化与干细胞、细胞的衰老与死亡等内容。 采用课堂讲授和实验教学相结合的教学方法，使学生在牢固掌握基础知识和基本概念的同时，得到科学研究、科学思维和科学方法的良好训练，为其他专业课的学习及日后的研究工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Cell biology is a subject that studies the fundamental life activities of cells. It studies the structure and function of cells at different levels. It is an important basic course of modern life science. The course content mainly includes the basic structure of cells, cytoplasmic membranes and transmembrane transport of substances, cytoplasmic matrix and endomembrane system, protein sorting and membrane vesicle transport, mitochondria and chloroplasts, cytoskeleton, nucleus and chromatin, ribosomes, cell signal transduction, cell cycle and division, cell proliferation regulation and cancer cells, cell differentiation and stem cells, the aging and death of cells. Through the classroom lectures and experimental teaching , the students can receive good training in scientific research, scientific thinking, and scientific methods while firmly mastering basic knowledge and concepts, that will lay a solid foundation for the study of other professional courses and future research work.

default.zh: “大数据”一词最初起源于互联网和IT行业，然而随着“人类基因组计划”的完成，带动了生物行业的一次革命，高通量测序技术得到快速发展，使得生命科学研究获得了强大的数据产出能力，包括基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学等生物学数据，这些组学数据具有数据量大（Volume）、数据多样化（Variety）、有价值（Value）、高速（Velocity）等特点。组学大数据是时下生物信息的前沿领域，而R语言是生物专业学生理解和掌握组学大数据的一把钥匙。本课程的最大特色就是内容新颖。 本课程主要讲授：面向前沿的组学大数据分析中，所需要的基本原理和R语言工具。主要包括：核酸数据库、蛋白质序列数据库、蛋白质结构数据库、多组学测序数据（基因组测序、转录组测序、宏基因组测序）以及基因调控网络数据等高通量生物大数据的分析技术。内容涵盖了目前所有主流的生物数据库和检索工具。此外，还以计算机语言R为媒介，提供学生利用计算机编程语言进行生物大数据分析的能力。 最主要的教学目标就是培养本科学生掌握最前沿科学研究的实践能力，通过对新一代测序技术组学大数据的分析，增强学生分析组学大数据并解决实际生物问题的能力。在这一过程中，培养学生的创新意识，锻炼学生的逻辑思维能力、学习主动性以及自己动手解决问题的能力。同时，通过课程设计等报告的设计，培养学生的团队协作能力。 本课程面向生物信息专业本科学生，针对医学与健康学院学生在计算机编程基础上的薄弱，特意增多了大量的上机动手实践机会，同时，选取计算机高级语言中，最偏向于自然语言的R语言，来进行高通量多组学数据的分析。即使在计算机方面零基础的同学，也能够熟练掌握各种检索与分析工具，并运用R语言编写自己设计的分析问题。
default.en: The term "big data" originally originated in the internet and IT industry. However, with the completion of the "Human Genome Project," it spurred a revolution in the biotechnology industry. High-throughput sequencing technology developed rapidly, endowing life science research with powerful data output capabilities, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and other biological data. These omics data are characterized by large Volume, Variety, Value, and high Velocity. Omics big data is a cutting-edge field in bioinformatics, and the R language is a key for biology students to understand and master omics big data. The most distinctive feature of this course is its novel content. The course mainly teaches the basic principles and R language tools needed for cutting-edge omics big data analysis. It includes the analysis techniques of high-throughput biological big data, such as nucleic acid databases, protein sequence databases, protein structure databases, multi-omics sequencing data (genome sequencing, transcriptome sequencing, metagenome sequencing), and gene regulatory network data. The content covers all the current mainstream biological databases and retrieval tools. In addition, it uses the R programming language as a medium to provide students with the ability to analyze biological big data using computer programming languages. The primary educational goal is to cultivate undergraduate students' practical abilities in cutting-edge scientific research. By analyzing the omics big data of new generation sequencing technologies, it enhances students' abilities to analyze omics big data and solve real biological problems. In this process, it aims to cultivate students' creativity, exercise their logical thinking abilities, initiative in learning, and the ability to solve problems on their own. Meanwhile, through the design of course projects and reports, it fosters students' teamwork skills. This course is aimed at undergraduate students in bioinformatics, specifically targeting students from medical and health schools with weak foundations in computer programming. It significantly increases hands-on practice opportunities and selects the R language, the computer programming language most akin to natural language, for the analysis of high-throughput multi-omics data. Even students with no background in computing can master various retrieval and analysis tools and use the R language to write their analysis problems.

default.zh: 《感觉与系统神经科学》主要学习介绍了感觉与系统神经科学的基本概念和功能，同时探讨感觉系统与神经系统在生理和行为方面的重要性。主要的研究对象主要有三个方面：一、探索感觉系统与神经系统机制的实际运行机制，对于感知觉的形成、认知活动的表现方式、识别和记忆等进行研究；二、探究神经系统活动的功能和规律：包括但不限于神经元回路，突触递质传递过程、神经反射等；三、联系神经系统和躯体运动调节，神经系统如何回路控制躯体运动；四、了解神经系统疾病模型，进一步研究感觉系统与神经系统的实际应用；为后续进一步学习更深内容的课程打造基础。
default.en: Sensory and systemic neuroscience introduces the basic concepts and functions of sensory and systemic neuroscience, and explores the physiological and behavioral importance of the sensory and nervous systems. The main research objects are three aspects: first, to explore the practical operation mechanism of sensory system and neural mechanism, and to study the formation of perception, the expression of cognitive activities, recognition and memory; second， to explore the functions and rules of nervous system activities, including but not limited to neuronal circuits, synaptic transmission processes, nerve reflexes , how the nervous system works to control body movement, understanding neurological disorder models to further explore the practical application of the sensory and nervous systems, and building a foundation for further in-depth courses.

default.zh: CRISPR/Cas9技术是一种革命性的基因编辑工具，受到广泛关注。CRISPR是一种天然存在于细菌和古细菌中的防御机制，而Cas9是一种酶，能够切割DNA。本实验旨在评估ZIF-8/Cas9基因敲除体系对已连接GFP绿色荧光蛋白的细胞系的影响，并通过荧光显微镜观察荧光强度的变化来验证基因编辑效果，进而让同学们理解基因编辑技术作为精准医学与个性化治疗的重要研究工具，如何改变细胞功能，改造生命。
default.en: The CRISPR/Cas9 technology is a revolutionary gene-editing tool that has garnered widespread attention. CRISPR is a natural defense mechanism found in bacteria and archaea, while Cas9 is an enzyme capable of cutting DNA. This experiment aims to assess the impact of the ZIF-8/Cas9 gene knockout system on a cell line expressing the connected GFP green fluorescent protein. The objective is to evaluate the gene-editing effects by observing changes in fluorescence intensity through fluorescent microscopy. This approach allows students to comprehend how gene editing technology, as a crucial research tool in precision medicine and personalized therapy, can alter cellular functions and reshape life.

default.zh: 《生命健康综合创新实践1》是在创新实践教育理念指导下的实践课程，课程指导并组织未来技术学院生命健康领域本科生围绕生命健康相关问题，利用专业知识开展自主选题科学研究工作，强调选题的科技前沿性、学科交叉性和学术创新性，重视对学生创新实践能力的培养。项目由学生根据自己的兴趣和特长提出选题。项目选题要求思路新颖、目标明确，具有创新性和探索性，要充分利用生物大数据组学分析方法，现代生物医学检测技术以及医工交叉的智能医学思维，项目研究方案要合理、可行。
default.en: The "Innovative Practice Course on Life & Healthcare 1" is a practical course guided by the concept of innovative practice education. The course guides and organizes undergraduate students in the field of Life & Healthcare in the Future Technology College to carry out independent scientific research work on topics related to life health using their professional knowledge, emphasizing the frontier of science and technology, interdisciplinarity and academic innovation of the selected topics and attaching importance to the cultivation of students' innovative practice ability. Students will propose topics based on their own interests and strengths. The project topic should be innovative and exploratory with novel ideas and clear objectives, making full use of biological big data analysis methods, modern biomedical detection technology and intelligent medical thinking at the intersection of medicine and industry, and the project research plan should be reasonable and feasible.

default.zh: 《生命健康综合创新实践（2）》是在《生命健康综合创新实践（1）》的基础上继续开展的创新实践课程，课程指导并组织未来技术学院生命健康领域本科生围绕生命健康相关问题，利用专业知识开展科学研究工作，强调项目的科技前沿性、学科交叉性和学术创新性，重视对学生创新实践能力的培养。项目研究内容由学生根据《生命健康综合创新实践（1）》的完成情况，继续在此基础之上提出选题。项目选题要求具有延续性、思路新颖、目标明确，具有创新性和探索性，要充分利用生物大数据组学分析方法，现代生物医学检测技术以及医工交叉的智能医学思维，项目研究方案要合理、可行。
default.en: " Innovative Practice Course on Life & Healthcare 2" is a continuation of the innovative practice course based on " Innovative Practice Course on Life & Healthcare 1." The course provides guidance and organization for undergraduate students in the Future Technology College to conduct innovative practices in the field of life and health. Students are encouraged to explore life and health-related issues, utilize their professional knowledge to engage in scientific research, and emphasize the technological forefront, interdisciplinary nature, and academic innovation of projects. The course places importance on cultivating students' innovative practical abilities. Based on the completion of " Innovative Practice Course on Life & Healthcare 1," students are required to propose topics for their projects. Project topics should be continuous, with novel ideas and clear objectives, demonstrating innovation and exploratory aspects. Students are expected to fully utilize bioinformatics analysis methods, modern biomedical detection technologies, and the intelligent medical thinking at the intersection of medicine and engineering. The research plans for the projects should be reasonable and feasible.

default.zh: 依托哈尔滨医科大学附属第一医院丰富的临床资源、先进的医疗设备与多学科协作平台，组织学生开展临床实习任务。实习期间，学生根据专业在必选与自选科室进行实践，参与临床数据挖掘与辅助诊疗分析；学习先进医疗设备与智能系统的临床应用与维护；聚焦疾病分子机制研究与实验诊断技术应用。整个实习过程中，要求学生每日记录实习内容与心得体会，最终形成一份完整详实的实习报告，全面反映其临床见识、实践收获与专业思考。本实习课程，旨在使学生将所学的医学理论知识与临床实践深度融合。通过系统性的观摩、学习与实操，提高学生的临床思维和实践操作技能，为今后从事相关专业工作奠定坚实的实践基础。
default.en: The Hospital Practice is organized utilizing the extensive clinical resources, advanced medical facilities, and interdisciplinary collaboration platform of the First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University. Throughout the program, students will conduct rotations in both required and elective departments tailored to their academic majors. Key practical activities include participation in clinical data mining and computer-aided diagnostic analysis, training on the operation and maintenance of advanced medical devices and intelligent systems, as well as engagement in molecular mechanism research and applied diagnostic technologies for various diseases. During the entire practice period, students are required to maintain daily logs documenting their activities and reflections. By the end of the practice, a comprehensive and detailed practice report must be submitted, which should reflect their clinical observations, hands-on experience, and professional insights. The practice course is designed to enable students to deeply integrate their theoretical medical knowledge with real-world clinical practice. Through systematic observation, guided learning, and practical operation, it aims to enhance students’ clinical thinking and operational skills, thereby establishing a solid foundation for their future professional careers in related fields.

default.zh: 毕业设计是本科生能力培养的重要一环，旨在培养学生综合运用所学的知识（基础课、技术基础课、专业课等知识），分析和解决生物信息学、生物医学科学、智能医学工程及相关领域的工程技术问题的能力，并提高学生的实践能力、分析能力、沟通能力和科研素养。在毕业设计开展中，培养学生围绕研究内容开展调查研究、文献检索和搜集资料能力；培养学生方案论证、确定方案的能力；培养锻炼学生理论分析、设计和计算的能力；培养掌握现代生物医学领域的研究方法和能力。
default.en: The graduation project is an important part of undergraduate ability development, aiming to cultivate students' ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned (basic courses, technical basic courses, professional courses, etc.), analyze and solve engineering and technical problems in bioinformatics, biomedical science, intelligent medical engineering, and related fields, and improve their practical ability, analytical ability, communication ability, and scientific research literacy. In the implementation of the graduation project, to cultivate students' abilities to conduct survey research, literature search, and data collection around the research content; cultivate students' ability to argue and determine plans; cultivate and exercise students' abilities in theoretical analysis, design, and calculation; cultivate mastery of research methods and abilities in the field of modern biomedical science.

default.zh: 先进材料与智能制造专业导论高等院校材料科学与工程专业的专业方向选修课程，本课程讲授先进材料与智能制造相关的基本概念、基本原理和前沿应用。 本课程主要包括先进材料与智能制造通识、先进材料基本概念、智能制造制备工艺以及材料智能制造前沿应用。通过课程的学习，使学生对先进材料（新能源材料、高性能金属材料以及先进复合材料）的分类及其使役性能具有系统性的认识，掌握先进材料智能制造工艺与应用，为从事先进材料研发、材料智能设计、工艺选择与优化打下较为扎实的理论基础，具备利用相关理论和技术基础进行新材料与产品设计开发的能力。
default.en: Introduction to Advanced Materials and Intelligent Manufacturing is a professional elective course for the major of materials science and engineering. This course teaches the basic concepts, basic principles and advanced applications related to advanced materials and intelligent manufacturing. This course mainly includes general knowledge of advanced materials and intelligent manufacturing, basic concepts of advanced materials, intelligent manufacturing preparation processes, and advanced applications of materials intelligent manufacturing. Through the course, students will have a systematic understanding of the classification and service performance of advanced materials (new energy materials, high-performance metal materials, and advanced composite materials), master the intelligent manufacturing processes and applications of advanced materials, and prepare for Engaged in advanced materials research and development, material intelligent design. It will lay a solid theoretical foundation for students to engage in advanced materials research and development, intelligent material design, process selection and optimization in the future, and to equip them with the ability to apply relevant theoretical and technological foundations to design and develop new materials and products.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础》是高等工科院校材料类专业的一门专业基础课程。本课程阐述材料科学的核心问题，系统、全面地介绍材料科学的基本概念和基础理论知识，包括材料的结合键、材料的晶体结构和晶体结构缺陷的特点和性质、材料中的扩散、相图及凝固理论、塑性变形特点。本课程着眼于材料基本问题、从材料的基本理论出发，使学生能把握材料的共性，熟悉材料的个性。通过理论教学和项目研究，使学生不仅能掌握和理解材料科学与工程方面的基础知识和基本理论，善于分析和解决问题，同时也培养学生创造性思维、综合研究能力和材料科学与工程实践能力。本课程为后续专业课的学习以及将来从事材料的研究与开发打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Foundation of materials science and engineering is one of the required core courses for the students of materials science and engineering in colleges of engineering. This course elaborates the central issues of materials science, systematically and comprehensively introduces the basic concepts and fundamental theories and rules of materials science, including interatomic bonding of materials, crystal structures, and imperfections in solids, diffusion in materials, phase diagrams and solidification theory, and plastic deformation characteristics. This course focuses on the basic problems of materials. The students can grasp the general characteristic of materials and master the specific properties of materials based on the fundamental theories and rules of materials science. The principal goals of this course are to make the students not only understand and master the fundamental theories and rules of material science, analyze and solve the problems of materials research and application, but also have the capability of innovation, comprehensive research and practice of materials science and engineering through theory study and research project. This course lays solid theoretical foundation for the study of following courses and the research and development of materials in the future.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础》是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门专业基础课程。本课程阐述材料科学的核心问题，系统、全面地介绍材料科学的基本概念和基础理论知识，包括材料的结合键、材料的晶体结构和晶体结构缺陷的特点和性质、材料中的扩散、相图及凝固理论、塑性变形特点。本课程着眼于材料基本问题、从材料的基本理论出发，使学生能把握材料的共性，熟悉材料的个性。通过理论教学和项目研究，使学生不仅能掌握和理解材料科学与工程方面的基础知识和基本理论，善于分析和解决问题，同时也培养学生创造性思维、综合研究能力和材料科学与工程实践能力。本课程为后续专业课的学习以及将来从事材料的研究与开发打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Foundation of materials science and engineering is one of the required core courses for the students of materials science and engineering in colleges of engineering. This course elaborates the central issues of materials science, systematically and comprehensively introduces the basic concepts and fundamental theories and rules of materials science, including interatomic bonding of materials, crystal structures, and imperfections in solids, diffusion in materials, phase diagrams and solidification theory, and plastic deformation characteristics. This course focuses on the basic problems of materials. The students can grasp the general characteristic of materials and master the specific properties of materials based on the fundamental theories and rules of materials science. The principal goals of this course are to make the students not only understand and master the fundamental theories and rules of material science, analyze and solve the problems of materials research and application, but also have the capability of innovation, comprehensive research and practice of materials science and engineering through theory study and research project. This course lays solid theoretical foundation for the study of following courses and the research and development of materials in the future.

default.zh: 材料物理基础是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门专业基础课程，主要内容包括量子力学基础、粒子统计分布规律、固体结构与布里渊区、晶格振动、金属自由电子理论、能带理论和半导体理论。通过课程学习，使学生学生能够切实掌握材料物理基础基本概念，具备材料物理方面坚实的理论基础知识，能够利用材料物理基础知识分析和阐述导体、半导体等的物理原理，具备综合利用基本物理原理和知识分析和解决材料工程问题的能力。
default.en: "Fundamentals of Materials Physics" is a fundamental course for materials science and engineering majors in higher engineering colleges. Its main content includes quantum mechanics fundamentals, particle statistical distribution laws, solid structure and Brillouin zone, lattice vibration, metal free electrons theory, energy bands theory, and semiconductor theory.Through this course, students will be able to effectively grasp the basic concepts of material physics and have a solid theoretical foundation in material physics.Students are able to analyze and explain the physical principles of conductors, semiconductors, etc. using basic knowledge of material physics, and have the ability to to analyze and solve material engineering problems based on basic physical principles and knowledge.

default.zh: 材料物理基础是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门专业基础课程，主要内容包括量子力学基础、粒子统计分布规律、固体结构与布里渊区、晶格振动、金属自由电子理论、能带理论和半导体理论。通过课程学习，使学生学生能够切实掌握材料物理基础基本概念，具备材料物理方面坚实的理论基础知识，能够利用材料物理基础知识分析和阐述导体、半导体等的物理原理，具备综合利用基本物理原理和知识分析和解决材料工程问题的能力。

Its main content includes quantum mechanics fundamentals, particle statistical distribution laws, solid structure and Brillouin zone, lattice vibration, metal free electrons theory, energy bands theory, and semiconductor theory.Through this course, students will be able to effectively grasp the basic concepts of material physics and have a solid theoretical foundation in material physics.Students are able to analyze and explain the physical principles of conductors, semiconductors, etc. using basic knowledge of material physics, and have the ability to to analyze and solve material engineering problems based on basic physical principles and knowledge.

default.zh: 材料宏观力学、物理和化学性质是由它的微观形态、晶体结构和微区化学成分所决定。材料分析测试方法是一门培养学生掌握分析材料微观组织结构测试技能的专业必修课，包含了材料X射线衍射分析和材料电子显微分析两大部分。材料x射线分析是使学生在掌握X射线衍射基本理论的基础上，能够熟练应用X射线测试技术研究材料的晶体结构、物相组成、晶粒尺寸、残余应力等；电子显微分析在掌握透射电子显微镜、扫描电子显微镜与电子探针等大型电子显微镜的结构和工作原理基础上，通过课堂教学和实验，使学生初步掌握电子衍射分析、电子衍衬图像解释、扫描电子显微分析技术和能谱分析技术。为今后从事材料科学研究奠定理论基础。
default.en: The macromechanics, physical, and chemical properties of materials are determined by their microscopic morphology, crystal structure, and microchemical composition. “Electronic Micro-Analysis” reveals information about a material's morphology, structure, and micro-area composition through the interaction of electrons with the material. This course introduces the structures and principles of large electron microscopes, including transmission electron microscopes, scanning electron microscopes, and electron probes. Through classroom teaching and experiments, students gain a preliminary understanding of electron diffraction phase analysis, interpretation of electron micrographs, scanning electron microscopic analysis techniques, and spectrum analysis techniques. This course equips students to apply electron microscopic analysis techniques for scientific research, addressing practical engineering problems by examining the micro-mechanisms behind the service conditions and failure phenomena of various components.

default.zh: 固体物理是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门专业基础课程，主要内容包括量子力学基础、粒子统计分布规律、固体结构与布里渊区、晶格振动、金属自由电子理论、能带理论和半导体理论。通过课程学习，使学生学生能够切实掌握固体物理基本概念，具备固体物理方面坚实的理论基础知识，能够利用固体物理基础知识分析和阐述导体、半导体等的物理原理，具备综合利用基本固体原理和知识分析和解决材料工程问题的能力。
default.en: "Solid State Physics" is a fundamental course for materials science and engineering majors in higher engineering colleges. Its main content includes quantum mechanics fundamentals, particle statistical distribution laws, solid structure and Brillouin zone, lattice vibration, metal free electrons theory, energy bands theory, and semiconductor theory.Through this course, students will be able to effectively grasp the basic concepts of Solid State physics and have a solid theoretical foundation in Solid State physics.Students are able to analyze and explain the physical principles of conductors, semiconductors, etc. using basic knowledge of Solid State physics, and have the ability to to analyze and solve material engineering problems based on basic physical principles and knowledge.

default.zh: 本课程是材料科学与工程专业的一门专业基础课，讲授晶体结构与晶体结合、晶格振动及材料热学性能、金属自由电子理论和固体能带理论、材料导电性能、材料介电性能和磁学性能。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解固体材料的宏观和微观特性，掌握微观粒子运动规律和相互作用及对固体性质的影响，熟悉周期性结构固体材料的常规性质和处理方法，为以后专业课程的学习提供基础知识。授课内容包括：晶体特征和结构类型、原子间结合力和结合方式、晶格振动和声子理论、自由电子气经典理论、量子理论及能带理论，材料导电、介电、热学和磁学性能的表征参量、影响因素和表征方法。
default.en: This course is a professional basic course for materials science and engineering. It teaches crystal structure and crystal combination, lattice vibration and thermal properties of materials, metal free electron theory and solid energy band theory, conductive properties, dielectric properties and magnetic properties of materials.Through the study of this course, students will understand the macro and micro characteristics of solid materials, master the motion laws and interactions of micro particles and their impact on solid properties, and be familiar with the conventional properties and treatment methods of periodic structure solid materials. Therefore, this course provides basic knowledge for the study of professional courses in the future.The teaching contents include: Crystal Characteristics and structure types, binding forces and modes between atoms, lattice vibration and phonon theory, classical theory of free electron gas, quantum theory and energy band theory, characterization parameters, influencing factors and characterization methods of electric conductive, dielectric, thermal and magnetic properties of materials.

default.zh: 本课程是材料科学与工程专业学生必修的专业基础课。本课程的教学目的在于使学生熟悉材料在各种应力状态和不同环境因素下的变形断裂行为及其微观机制，掌握各种力学性能指标的物理本质、测试方法与应用，并进一步理解材料力学性能与微观组织结构之间的相互关系，了解正确评价与改善材料力学性能的方法与途径。主要内容包括材料变形行为与变形抗力、断裂行为与断裂韧性、材料的疲劳及高温蠕变等。
default.en: This is a required course for students in materials science and engineering. It aims to build a broad-based understanding of the deformation and fracture behaviors of materials under various stress states and environments as well as the microscopic mechanisms. It provides students an opportunity to apprehend the physical meanings, testing methods and applications of various mechanical properties, and to comprehend the relationship between microstructure and mechanical properties of materials, and learn how to evaluate and further improve mechanical properties. Topics covered include elasticity, viscoelasticity, plasticity, deformation behavior and deformation resistance, fracture, fracture behavior and fracture toughness, fatigue, and creep etc.. Case studies and examples are drawn from structural and functional applications that include a variety of material classes: metals, ceramics, polymers, thin films, and composites.

default.zh: 《机械设计原理与方法》课程囊括了从机械方案设计（原理设计）、参数设计到结构设计的所有内容，它是高等工科院校近机类和非机类各专业必修的一门技术基础课程，主要研究机械中的常用机构和通用零部件的工作原理、结构特点、基本的设计理论和设计计算方法等，该课程将为学生学习后续课程和将来从事工程技术工作打下良好的技术基础，培养学生掌握常用机构分析与设计的基本理论和基本方法；具有对机械系统运动方案创新设计的基本能力；掌握设计或选用通用机械零部件的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，具有设计机械传动装置和一般机械的能力；掌握运用标准、规范，具有查阅技术资料的能力、计算能力、绘图能力；掌握机械设计基础的实验原理和方法，具有进行实验研究的初步能力。对培养学生的设计思维和创新能力有着非常重要的作用。因此，在近机械类专业和非机械类专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和作用，是高等工科院校本科教学计划中的一门主干课程。
default.en: The course 'Principles and Methods of Mechanical Design' covers all aspects of mechanical scheme design (principle design), parameter design, and structural design. It is a compulsory technical foundation course for various majors in near mechanical and non-mechanical fields in higher engineering colleges. It mainly studies the working principles, structural characteristics, basic design theories, and design calculation methods of commonly used mechanisms and components in machinery, This course will lay a solid technical foundation for students to learn subsequent courses and engage in engineering and technical work in the future, and cultivate students to master the basic theories and methods of commonly used mechanism analysis and design; Having the basic ability to innovate the design of mechanical system motion schemes; Master the basic theories, knowledge, and skills of designing or selecting general mechanical components, and have the ability to design mechanical transmission devices and general machinery; Mastering the application of standards and norms, possessing the ability to access technical data, calculation ability, and drawing ability; Master the experimental principles and methods of mechanical design fundamentals, and have the preliminary ability to conduct experimental research. It plays a very important role in cultivating students' design thinking and innovation ability. Therefore, it occupies an important position and role in the teaching plans of near mechanical and non-mechanical majors, and is a backbone course in the undergraduate teaching plans of higher engineering colleges.

default.zh: 材料工程力学基础涉及众多的力学学科分支和广泛的工程技术领域，是一门理论性较强、与工程技术联系极为密切的技术基础课。本课程涵盖了“理论力学”和“材料力学”的主要内容，适用于工科材料类及相关专业。 本课程内容主要包括静力学基础、运动学、应力与应变状态分析、材料的力学性能与应力应变关系、拉压与扭转、弯曲、强度理论与杆件强度刚度计算和压杆稳定等内容。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，要求学生准确掌握静力学基本公理，能够完成物体（或物体系）的受力分析，掌握任意力学简化与平衡问题求解方法；正确理解构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念；能计算杆件的应力与变形以及分析其强度、刚度与稳定性；并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。通过实验教学环节使学生掌握材料的力学性能及材料力学实验的基本知识和操作技能，培养学生的组织能力、实验设计能力及分工协作和创新精神，着力提高学生实际动手的实操能力，使学生能够运用材料力学的基础理论和分析方法，解决复杂的工程实际问题。
default.en: The Fundamentals of Materials Engineering Mechanicsinvolves many branches of mechanics and a wide range of engineering technical fields. It is a technical basic course with strong theoretical property and very close relationship with engineering technology. This course covers the main contents of "theoretical mechanics" and "material mechanics" and is applicable to engineering materials and related majors. This course mainly includes the basic statics, kinematics, stress and strain state analysis, mechanical properties of materials and stress-strain relationship, tension and compression and torsion, bending, strength theory and member bar strength and stiffness calculation and compression bar stability. Through this course, students are required to master the basic theories and methods of classical mechanics, accurately master the basic principles of static mechanics, be able to complete the stress analysis of objects (or material systems), and master the methods for solving any mechanical simplification and balance problems; Correctly understand the basic concepts of strength, rigidity and stability of components; Be able to calculate stress and deformation of member bars and analyze their strength, rigidity and stability; He is good at applying these theories and methods to solve practical engineering problems and lay a foundation for subsequent courses. Through the experimental teaching link, students can master the mechanical properties of materials and the basic knowledge and operation skills of material mechanics experiment, train students' organizational ability, experimental design ability, division of labor, cooperation and innovation spirit, focus on improving students' practical ability, so that students can use the basic theory and analysis methods of material mechanics to solve complex engineering problems.

default.zh: 《材料化学基础B》这门课是材料科学与工程类专业所学的第一门化学基础课，是提高材料科学与工程类学生化学素质的第一步。课程分为材料化学基本原理、物质的性质及应用两大部分。其中，第一部分材料化学基本原理主要包括热化学基础、化学反应的基本原理、物质的结构基础及化学平衡及应用。第二大部分物质的性质及应用以元素周期律为核心，讲述不同周期和不同主族、副族元素的单质、化合物性质的递变规律及应用。通过本课程的学习，需要学生掌握材料化学反应的基本原理、物质结构的基础理论和元素化学的基本知识，培养学生分析和解决材料类化学基础问题的能力，为学生材料制备及性能分析打下坚实的化学基础。
default.en: The curriculum of Fundamentals of Materials Chemistry is the first basic chemistry course for materials science and engineering majors. And it is the first step to improve the chemistry quality of materials science and engineering students. The course is divided into two parts: basic principles of materials chemistry and properties of substances and applications. Among them, the first part of the basic principles of material chemistry mainly includes the thermochemical basis, the basic principles of chemical reactions, the structural basis of substances and chemical equilibrium and application. The second part mainly includes the periodic law of elements and the properties of substances and applications. Through studying this course, students are required to master the basic principles of chemical reaction of materials, the basic theory of substance structure and the basic knowledge of elemental chemistry. Moreover, it can cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve basic problems of material chemistry and lay a solid chemical foundation for the preparation and performance analysis of materials.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础基础实验》是材料科学与工程专业本科生必修的实践课程，旨在让学生掌握材料科学与工程专业的基本实验技能和方法。课程通过对材料的显微分析及力学、电学、磁学等特性的表征，使学生理解材料的成分、制备及处理工艺与材料的组织结构、性能之间的内在关系，培养学生的实验设计、实验操作、数据处理和结果分析能力，以及团队协作和创新思维能力。通过实验课程的学习，学生可以更好地理解材料科学与工程的基础理论知识，提高专业素养，为后续的专业学习和研究打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Fundamental Experiments of Materials Science and Engineering is a compulsory practical course for undergraduate students majoring in Materials Science and Engineering, aiming to enable them to master the basic experimental skills and methods of Materials Science and Engineering. The course aims to help students understand the inherent relationship between the composition, preparation and processing techniques of materials, as well as their organizational structure and properties, through the microscopic analysis of materials and the characterization of mechanical, electrical, magnetic, and other characteristics. It also cultivates students' abilities in experimental design, operation, data processing, and result analysis, as well as teamwork and innovative thinking. Through the study of experimental courses, students can better understand the basic theoretical knowledge of materials science and engineering, improve their professional literacy, and lay a solid foundation for subsequent professional learning and research.

It also cultivates students' abilities in experimental design, operation, data processing, and result analysis, as well as teamwork and innovative thinking. Through the study of experimental courses, students can better understand the basic theoretical knowledge of materials science and engineering, improve their professional literacy, and lay a solid foundation for subsequent professional learning and research.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础综合实验》为材料科学与工程专业学生必修的一门实践课程。课程以试样制备、金相显微分析基本技能以及电子显微分析为基础，分析材料成分、制备与处理方法与材料各种典型组织特征、机械性能、物理性能等之间的内在关联。要求通过本课程的学习，了解和掌握材料样品的制备，掌握材料实验设计和基本性能测试方法以及先进分析测试方法，掌握材料实验数据的记录方法以及对实验数据的深入分析能力，了解材料组织、成分等与性能之间的关联，加深对材料科学与工程基础理论的理解，培养学生实验设计及实施能力，以及分析问题以及解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: The Experiment of Materials Science and Engineering Fundamentals is a compulsory practical course for students majoring in Materials Science and Engineering. The course is based on the basic skills of sample preparation and metallographic analysis, as well as electron microscopy analysis and numerical simulation experiments, to analyze the inherent relationship between material composition, preparation and processing methods, and various typical structural characteristics, mechanical properties, physical properties of materials. Through the study of the course, students will understand and master the preparation of material samples, master material experimental design, basic performance testing methods, and advanced analysis and testing methods, master the recording methods of material experimental data and the ability to deeply analyze experimental data, understand the relationship between material organization, composition, and performance, deepen their understanding of basic theories in materials science and engineering, and cultivate their experimental design and implementation abilities, and the ability to analyze problems and solve practical problems.

default.zh: 《金属力学性能》是材料科学与工程专业课题体系中重要的专业基础课程，课程先导课程为《材料力学》，《材料科学基础》，面向材料科学专业、材料工程专业、焊接科学与工程专业的大三学生开设。课程的基础理论是以位错理论为基础的塑性变形理论和断裂理论，课程的基本知识体系为：金属力学行为的一般规律、物理本质、性能测试及评价，组织结构与性能的关系。课程重点讲授金属的基本力学行为和应用力学行为，其中基本力学行为包括弹性变形、塑性变性和断裂，应用力学行为包括疲劳等。课程重点讲述金属力学行为的物理本质，并在此基础上介绍使用条件下的性能。通过课程学习，学生可以掌握金属力学性能指标的概念、物理本质和测量方法，初步掌握、分析常见金属材料的力学性能问题，提出改善金属力学性能的措施，初步具有设计金属零件的能力。
default.en: "Mechanical Properties of Metals" is an important foundational course in the field of materials science and engineering. The leading courses are "Mechanics of Materials" and "Fundamentals of Materials Science", aimed at third year students majoring in materials science, materials engineering, and welding science and engineering. The basic theory of the course is plastic deformation theory and fracture theory based on dislocation theory. The basic knowledge system of the course is: general laws of metal mechanical behavior, physical essence, performance testing and evaluation, and the relationship between organizational structure and performance. The course focuses on teaching the basic mechanical behavior and applied mechanical behavior of metals, including elastic deformation, plastic deformation, and fracture, and applied mechanical behavior including fatigue, etc. The course focuses on the physical essence of metal mechanical behavior, and on this basis, introduces the performance under usage conditions. Through course learning, students can master the concept, physical essence, and measurement methods of metal mechanical performance indicators, preliminarily grasp and analyze the mechanical performance problems of common metal materials, propose measures to improve metal mechanical properties, and have the ability to design metal parts.

default.zh: 热处理原理是材料科学与工程及其相关专业学生必须掌握的重要专业基础知识。通过课程的学习，使学生掌握材料热处理过程中发生典型相变的原理和规律，掌握如何通过热处理改变金属材料的组织结构和性能特点，以及各种典型相变的特点、热力学、动力学、转变机制、转变过程、转变产物的组织与性能特点。通过课程学习，学生应掌握金属材料中成分、结构、相、组织的概念，固态相变特征、固态相变形核与长大机制，以及固态相变的动力与阻力，新相形状的影响因素等。掌握加热过程中珠光体向奥氏体转变机制、动力学、及其影响因素，以及奥氏体晶粒长大影响因素。掌握冷却过程中珠光体组织形态特点、珠光体转变过程和转变速度、珠光体的机械性能和影响因素、钢中的相间沉淀。掌握快速冷却过程中马氏体与贝氏体的晶体结构、组织形态、转变特点、转变机理、热力学、动力学、强化机理和性能特点，掌握回火定义与目的，淬火钢在回火过程中组织转变过程。掌握合金固溶和时效定义及组织与性能变化规律，掌握铝合金与其他合金的脱溶分解与时效过程，热力学与动力学，组织与性能演变规律等。
default.en: Heat Treatment Principles A is the compulsory course of the materials science and the engineering profession. Through the study of this course, students will grasp the typical principle and law of solid phase transformation during heat treatment of metals, and how to modify the microstructures and properties of metals through heat treatment technologies. The students will also know well about the typical characteristics, thermodynamic and kinetic, mechanism, processes, microstructure and properties of transformed phases. Through the course of learning, students should understand the concept of metal material composition, structure, phase and microstructure, phase transformation characteristics, solid phase nucleation and growth mechanism, and the power and the resistance of solid phase, the new shape of the influence factors. The mechanism, kinetics and influencing factors of pearlite to austenite transformation during heating and the factors influencing austenite grain growth are investigated. The microstructure characteristics, pearlite transformation process and transformation rate, mechanical properties and influencing factors of pearlite and interphase precipitation in cooling process are mastered. Master the rapid cooling process and the martensite crystal structure, morphology, change characteristics, transition mechanism, thermodynamics, dynamics, strengthening mechanism and performance characteristics, understand the definition and purpose of quenching steel, microstructure transformation during quenching process. To master the definition and structure of alloy solid solution and aging, the law of microstructure and property change, to understand the dissolution, dissolution and aging process of aluminum alloy and other alloys, thermodynamics and kinetics, microstructure and property evolution law.

default.zh: 热处理工艺学A是高等工科院校金属材料科学及其相关专业学生的必修课程，是必须掌握的重要专业基础知识。结合先修课程热处理原理的学习，通过具体的热处理工艺学习，使学生掌握材料的退火、正火、淬火、回火四种传统热处理工艺，掌握金属材料的表面淬火、包括渗碳、渗氮、碳氮共渗等在内的化学热处理方法和工艺。了解常用金属材料的成分及热处理对其组织和性能的影响，具备正确选择金属材料及热处理工艺的能力，能够简单设计一般金属零件的热处理工艺，为实际生产应用奠定理论基础和实验能力。
default.en: Heat Treatment Technology A is a compulsory course for students majoring in metal materials science and engineering in higher engineering colleges, and it is an important basic knowledge system which must be mastered. The specific knowing of heat treatment technology, with the prerequisite course of heat treatment principle, enable students to master not only four kinds of traditional heat treatment methods including annealing, quenching, tempering and normalizing, but also the technology of surface hardening and chemical heat treatment method and process including carburizing, nitriding and carbonitriding. The students need know the effect of composition and heat treatment of the common metal materials on their microstructures and properties, and have the ability to select metal materials and design proper heat treatment process for metal parts which could help students to lay a solid theoretical foundation and experimental ability for practical production and application.

default.zh: 本课程是结构陶瓷研究方向的本科专业基础课，讲述陶瓷材料及其制备与力学性能的基本概念、基本原理、基本方法。课程的教学目的是为从事陶瓷材料的设计、制备、结构分析、性能测试及材料应用等生产、科研和管理工作打基础。
default.en: Ceramic Materials is an undergraduate professional basic course in the direction of structural ceramics research. It introduces the design principles, basic properties and fabrication processes of ceramic materials. This course enables the students to understand the basic knowledge involving the design and fabrication, microstructure analysis, properties testing, and application of ceramic materials.

default.zh: 本课程是材料科学与工程专业特种陶瓷研究方向本科生的一门专业基础课程。本课程以材料热力学、材料科学与工程基础为基础，突出特种陶瓷粉体制备与表征、成型和烧结基本原理与新工艺。本课程主要讲授陶瓷成型与烧结工艺相关的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法。主要内容包括陶瓷粉体的制备与表征、胶体化学基础、陶瓷的成型原理与方法、陶瓷烧结基本原理、陶瓷显微组织的形成与演变、陶瓷烧结工艺方法等部分。通过本课程的学习，让学生们更好地了解陶瓷材料与构件的化学成分、烧结工艺、组织结构与性能之间的相互关系，熟练掌握陶瓷材料与构件成型与烧结过程中各环节的物理化学基本原理与技术方法，为从事陶瓷制备工艺的设计、选择与优化打下扎实的理论基础，具备利用相关陶瓷工艺理论和技术基础进行高性能陶瓷与产品设计开发的能力。
default.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students who study advanced ceramics in the major of materials science and engineering. It is based on the prerequisite courses including Thermodynamics of Materials, Fundamentals of Materials Science and Engineering, and focus mainly on the basic concepts, principles and methods of ceramic processing and sintering. The topics covered in this course include mainly fabrication and characterization of ceramic powders, fundamentals of colloid science, shaping and forming, sintering and densification theory, microstructural formation and evolution, sintering and processing methods etc. It provides students a broad-based understanding on the relationship among chemical composition, processing and sintering, microstructure and properties of advanced ceramics and components. This contributes primarily to develop the ability of the students to select proper ceramic materials and to design the forming and sintering processes that yield desired microstructures and controlled properties for high-performance ceramic components of industrial applications.

default.zh: 空间环境物理主要研究空间物理的基本理论及研究方法，从空间物理状态的形成和演化出发，阐述空间环境与物质交互作用的本质。本课程主要任务是使学生了解和掌握空间环境因素的物理本质、主要的环境参数和空间环境模式以及空间环境对航天器材料和器件产生的影响，具备选用掌握的适宜的理论和实验方法来分析与解决毕业设计试验中的实际物理问题，良好的表达能力以及独立解决问题的科研能力。
default.en: Space Environmental Physics primarily focuses on the basic theories and research methods of space physics, starting from the formation and evolution of space physical states, to elucidate the essence of interactions between the space environment and matter. The main task of this course is to enable students to understand and master the physical nature of space environmental factors, the main environmental parameters, and space environment models, as well as the impacts of the space environment on spacecraft materials and devices. Students will be equipped with the ability to master appropriate theoretical and experimental methods to solve practical physical problems in their graduation projects, and possessing good communication skills and the ability to solve problems independently through research.

default.zh: “空间材料学”是建立在数学、化学、空间物理及材料学基础上的新兴学科，是空间材料加工与技术、空间材料学等专业一门重要专业核心课程，是各相关专业课程的平台课程之一。该课程教学目的使学生了解空间环境因素对材料的损伤效应，掌握空间环境与材料交互作用的基本原理，了解国际相关领域的研究动态，为我国航天事业培养合格人才。内容涉及空间环境简介，典型空间材料，空间环境因素对材料的损伤效应、损伤形式和损伤机理等内容。课程主要包括绪论、空间真空热环境、微重力环境、等离子体、原子氧以及高能粒子等对材料的损伤效应等部分，本课程考试采用累加式，要求每位学生进行课堂讨论并提交报告。课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合课堂测验、课后作业和学习报告等。
default.en: “Space Materials Science” is a new discipline established on the basis of mathematics, chemistry, space physics and materials science. It is an important professional core course of space materials processing and technology, space materials science and other majors, and is one of the platform courses of all related professional courses. The course aims to make students understand the damage effect of space environment factors on materials, master the basic principle of interaction between space environment and materials, understand the research trends of international related fields, and train qualified talents for the space industry. The contents include brief introduction of space environment, typical space materials, damage effect, damage form and damage mechanism of space environmental factors on materials, etc. The course mainly includes the introduction, space vacuum thermal environment, microgravity environment, plasma, atomic oxygen, high-energy particles and other damage effects on materials, etc. This course adopts the cumulative examination, and each student is required to conduct a class discussion and submit a report. The final grade of the course is cumulative, which integrates the classroom test, homework and study reports.

default.zh: 高分子物理是在人们长期的生产实践和科学实验的基础上逐步发展起来的一门新兴的学科，是高等工科院校高分子材料工程专业（含复合材料）及有关专业学生必修的专业技术基础课。本课程主要研究高分子物理的基本理论及研究方法，从分子运动的观点出发，阐述高分子的性能与结构间的关系，以及高分子的热性能、机械性能，力学松弛行为以及流变特性。 高分子物理是高等工科院校高分子材料工程专业的一门主干课程，在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行高分子材料工程技术人员的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事高分子材料的加工工作打下基础，因此，在高分子材料工程专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和发挥着重要作用.
default.en: Polymer Physics is new subject which gradually established by combining the practice and research for a long time. It is the core subject of the required course for the students who major in the Polymer Materials Engineering including Composites. The focus of Polymer Physics is the principle theory of Polymer physics and its research method, which start from molecular kinetic theory. Elaborated thermal properties, mechanical properties, mechanical relaxation behavior and rheological properties of polymers. Polymer Physics is a special major course for students major in Polymer Materials Engineering in the university of engineering, which comprehensively applying various relevant knowledge and skills with all kinds of experimental sectors to effectively lay the first stone for the forward studying and processing of polymer materials. Therefore, it plays a very important role in the teaching program of Polymer Materials Engineering.

default.zh: 课程目标1. 通过本门课程教学，使学生掌握材料制备与改性过程中的热量传输、传质传输、动量传输（三传）原理与方程。包括：传输基本概念和基本原理；稳态/非稳态热传导方程及应用；对流换热方程及应用；黑体辐射定律及应用；稳态/非稳态扩散方程及应用；稳态/非稳态动量传输方程及应用；三传相似理论；广义扩散方程/组织结构演变模型与仿真。基于所学知识求解三传过程数学模型、并实现过程的可视化。 课程目标2. 支撑材料科学与工程专业课学习与实践创新，并为将来从事新材料研究应用、突破高端装备制造关键技术，以及相应的理论创新奠定坚实基础。热量传输授课支撑：材料成形等过程中温度场与相变研究应用；质量传输授课支撑：扩散传质对制件/器件的改性、服役性能的研究和应用；动量传输授课支撑：流场调控高性能材料制备及应用。
default.en: Objective 1: Through learning this course, students will master principles and mathematical equations of heat transport, mass transport and momentum transport in the process of materials fabrication and modification. Based on these knowledge, students are expected to be able to formulate and solve the mathematical models of the transport phenomena, and visualize the calculation results. Objective 2: Establish solid background for learning other professional courses of materials science and engineering, practice and innovation for working on new materials, developing key technology of high-end equipment manufacturing, and theoretical innovation. Learning heat transport will support the research of temperature field and phase transformation during the processes, for instance, materials molding, modification and damage of work-piece; and support the study of new materials development (e.g. emitting materials) et. al. Learning mass transport will support the study of modification and longevity of work-piece. For example, diffusion of gaseous molecular in macromolecule materials indicates a damage of materials; diffusion of atoms in solids indicates phase transportation and service longevity; diffusion of charge carriers in semiconductor devices indicates thermoelectric, photoelectric or electrochemical performance. Learning momentum transport will support the study of fluid mechanics in the fabrication and working processes of materials and devices.

default.zh: 材料物理性能A是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门专业基础课程，主要讲授材料物理性能的基本概念、表征参量、物理基础、影响因素以及物理性能分析测试方法和相关的功能材料。料物理性能的教学内容涉及了许多功能材料设计和开发的基本物理原理，也包括了材料学科普遍使用的一些研究手段，在材料学科专业课程中处于十分重要的地位。本课程的主要任务是培养学生掌握材料物理性能的基础理论、材料和环境因素对物理性能的基本规律，掌握材料物理性能分析的基本方法，培养利用物理性能基本知识分析问题、设计解决方案、解决复杂材料工程问题的能力。教学内容涵盖导电、介电、光学、热学、磁学和弹性物理性能。
default.en: “Physical properties of Materials A” is a special basic course for Materials Science and Engineering Speciality, which describe the basic concept, characterization parameters, physical base, influence factors , analysis and testing means, relative functional materials. The teaching content involves many basic physical principles of the design and development of functional materials, and also includes some research methods commonly used in the material discipline. This course is in a very important position in the professional curriculum of the material discipline. The main task of this course is to train students to master the basic theory of material physical properties, the basic laws of material and environmental factors on physical properties, the basic methods of material physical property analysis. It also cultivate students' ability to analyze problems, design solutions and solve complex material engineering problems by using the basic knowledge of physical properties. The teaching content covers the physical properties of electric conduction, dielectric, optics, heat, magnetism and elasticity.

default.zh: 材料热力学是材料科学与工程专业的主要基础课程之一。材料热力学课程介绍热力学基本原理在材料科学研究中的应用。课程的主要内容包括状态函数、过程变量、强度性质等热力学基本概念；热力学第一、第二和第三定律，熵、焓、自由能、内能的概念及计算方法；封闭体系中热力学函数和性质间的关系；单元系的相平衡与相图；溶液热力学；二元系的相平衡和相图；化学平衡；表面和界面等。通过本课程的学习，要求学生掌握热力学的基本原理，理解材料科学中的热力学现象。
default.en: Thermodynamics of materials is one of the main fundamental courses in materials science and engineering. The course introduces the application of the basic principles of thermodynamics to the study of materials science. The main contents of the course include laws of thermodynamics; phase equilibrium and phase equilibrium of unary materials; thermodynamics of solutions; phase equilibrium and phase diagrams of binary materials; chemical equilibrium, surfaces and interfaces and so on. Through the learning of the course, students are required to master the basic principles of thermodynamics and understand thermodynamic phenomena in materials science.

default.zh: 本课程是材料科学与工程专业学生必修的专业基础课。本课程的教学目的在于使学生熟悉材料在各种应力状态和不同环境因素下的变形断裂行为及其微观机制，掌握各种力学性能指标的物理本质、测试方法与应用，并进一步理解材料力学性能与微观组织结构之间的相互关系，了解正确评价与改善材料力学性能的方法与途径。主要内容包括材料变形行为与变形抗力、断裂行为与断裂韧性、材料的疲劳及高温蠕变等。
default.en: This is a required course for students in materials science and engineering. It aims to build a broad-based understanding of the deformation and fracture behaviors of materials under various stress states and environments as well as the microscopic mechanisms. It provides students an opportunity to apprehend the physical meanings, testing methods and applications of various mechanical properties, and to comprehend the relationship between microstructure and mechanical properties of materials, and learn how to evaluate and further improve mechanical properties. Topics covered include elasticity, viscoelasticity, plasticity, deformation behavior and deformation resistance, fracture, fracture behavior and fracture toughness, fatigue, and creep etc.. Case studies and examples are drawn from structural and functional applications that include a variety of material classes: metals, ceramics, polymers, thin films, and composites.

default.zh: 工程材料学是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业（材料学方向）的一门专业课程，根据学生已掌握材料科学基础理论和基础知识，从材料服役和使用出发，分析工程材料成分、工艺、组织结构和性能之间的内在联系，建立整体统一的概念和体系，以帮助学生提高分析问题和解决问题的能力，从而正确选择材料和使用材料，最终达到能够根据需求设计新材料的目的。 课程主要内容包括：合金化原理（钢的合金化，有色金属如铝、钛、镁、铜的合金化）。结构钢（结构钢分类与命名方法，普通碳素结构钢，优质碳素结构钢，低合金高强度结构钢）。机器零件用钢（渗碳钢，调质钢，弹簧钢，滚动轴承钢，耐磨钢）。工具钢（分类及命名方法，刃具钢，模具钢，量具钢）。特殊钢（不锈钢和耐热钢）。有色金属及合金（金属间化合物，铝合金，钛合金，镁合金和铜合金）。陶瓷材料（陶瓷材料概述，常用工程结构陶瓷材料）。高分子材料（高分子材料概述，常用高分子材料）。复合材料（复合材料概述，金属基复合材料，陶瓷基复合材料，高分子基复合材料，碳/碳(C/C)复合材料）。
default.en: Engineering materials Science is a professional course of materials science and engineering major in engineering colleges and universities. The aim and objective of this course is to begin with service performance of materials, clarify the relationship between composition, microstructure and properties of engineering materials, help students to select and use materials properly, design new materials in the end, according to base theory and knowledge obtained by the students. The main contents of the course contain: the foundation of alloying (alloying of steel, nonferrous metals and alloys such as aluminum alloy, magnesium alloy and copper alloy). Structural steels (classifications and naming methods of the structural steel, carbon structural steel, high strength and low alloy steel). Machine parts steels (carburizing steel, hardened and tempered steel, spring steel, bearing steel, wear-resistant steel). Chisel tool steels (classifications and naming methods, cutting tool steel, die steel and gauge steel). Special steels (stainless steel, heat-resistant steel). Nonferrous metals and alloys (intermetallic, aluminum alloy, titanium alloy, magnesium alloy, copper alloy). Ceramic materials (Introduction to ceramic materials, structural ceramics). Polymer materials ((Introduction to polymer materials, several polymer materials). Composites (Introduction to composites, metal matrix composites, ceramic matrix composites, polymer matrix composites and carbon/carbon (C/C) composites).

default.zh: 功能材料学A是材料科学与工程专业的一门课程，它以材料科学为基础，主要讲述功能材料的光电磁的基本概念、类型和应用。本课程的教学目的在于使学生了解材料的功能性能与应用。这门课程包括半导体能材料、导电材料，超导材料、介电材料（铁电和压电材料）、磁性材料、光敏材料、光学材料（激光材料，发光材料，非线性光学材料，）能源转换材料等的制备、结构与性能、及应用等，希望学生能够较为熟练地掌握各种功能材料的基本原理与研究方法。
default.en: Science of functional materials A is a course for the students in materials science and engineering, which is based on materials science. It introduces the basic concepts, types and applications of functional materials. This course enables the students to understand optical, electrical and magnetic properties and their applications. This course mainly includes: semiconductor materials, conducting materials, superconducting materials, dielectric materials (ferroelectric and piezoelectric materials), magnetic materials, photo-sensitive materials, optic materials (laser materials, electroluminescent materials, non-linear optical materials), energy transition materials etc. The basic theory for material design, the methods for characterization, and structure-property of functional materials are necessary for students to grasp.

default.zh: 本课程是材料科学与工程专业学生必修的专业基础课。本课程的教学目的在于使学生熟悉材料在各种应力状态和不同环境因素下的变形断裂行为及其微观机制，掌握各种力学性能指标的物理本质、测试方法与应用，并进一步理解材料力学性能与微观组织结构之间的相互关系，了解正确评价与改善材料力学性能的方法与途径。主要内容包括材料变形行为与变形抗力、断裂行为与断裂韧性、材料的疲劳及高温蠕变等。
default.en: This is a required course for students in materials science and engineering. It aims to build a broad-based understanding of the deformation and fracture behaviors of materials under various stress states and environments as well as the microscopic mechanisms. It provides students an opportunity to apprehend the physical meanings, testing methods and applications of various mechanical properties, and to comprehend the relationship between microstructure and mechanical properties of materials, and learn how to evaluate and further improve mechanical properties. Topics covered include elasticity, viscoelasticity, plasticity, deformation behavior and deformation resistance, fracture, fracture behavior and fracture toughness, fatigue, and creep etc.. Case studies and examples are drawn from structural and functional applications that include a variety of material classes: metals, ceramics, polymers, thin films, and composites.

default.zh: 材料热力学是材料科学与工程专业的主要基础课程之一。本课程的目的是使学生掌握热力学的基本知识，能将热力学的基本原理和方其应用于材料科学的理论和应用研究。课程的主要内容包括状态函数、过程变量、强度性质等热力学基本概念；热力学第一、第二和第三定律，熵、焓、自由能、内能的概念及计算方法；封闭体系中热力学函数和性质间的关系；单元系的相平衡；溶液；二元系的相平衡和相图；化学平衡、表面和界面等。通过本课程的学习，要求学生掌握热力学的基本原理，能够应用热力学基本原理分析相图、相变以及其它材料科学与工程相关现象。
default.en: Thermodynamics of Materials is one of main courses of Materials Science and Engineering. The purpose of the course is to enable students to employ thermodynamics theory to tackle the thermodynamical problems involved in materials design, fabrication and processing. The course includes the following topics: laws of thermodynamics, thermodynamics of unary materials, thermodynamics of solution, compound and mixture, in particular, this course covers the phase equilibrium and phase diagram which are related to materials science. This course also introduces chemistry equilibrium, surface and interface. Learning this course provides the students with thermodynamic understanding of the phenomenon associated with the design, preparation, and services of materials.

default.zh: 材料物理性能C是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门专业基础课程，主要讲授材料物理性能的基本概念、表征参量、物理基础、影响因素以及物理性能分析测试方法和相关的功能材料。料物理性能的教学内容涉及了许多功能材料设计和开发的基本物理原理，也包括了材料学科普遍使用的一些研究手段，在材料学科专业课程中处于十分重要的地位。本课程的主要任务是培养学生掌握材料物理性能的基础理论、材料和环境因素对物理性能的基本规律，掌握材料物理性能分析的基本方法，培养利用物理性能基本知识分析问题、设计解决方案、解决复杂材料工程问题的能力。教学内容涵盖导电、介电、光学、热学、磁学和弹性物理性能。
default.en: “Physical properties of Materials C” is a special basic course for Materials Science and Engineering Speciality, which describe the basic concept, characterization parameters, physical base, influence factors , analysis and testing means, relative functional materials. The teaching content involves many basic physical principles of the design and development of functional materials, and also includes some research methods commonly used in the material discipline. This course is in a very important position in the professional curriculum of the material discipline. The main task of this course is to train students to master the basic theory of material physical properties, the basic laws of material and environmental factors on physical properties, the basic methods of material physical property analysis. It also cultivate students' ability to analyze problems, design solutions and solve complex material engineering problems by using the basic knowledge of physical properties. The teaching content covers the physical properties of electric conduction, dielectric, optics, heat, magnetism and elasticity.

default.zh: 《工程材料学》是材料科学与工程（强基计划）专业课程，是在材料科学基础理论学习基础上进一步深入学习工程材料研制与应用技术的基础课程。课程以组织性能理论为引导和基础，在回顾整理材料学科基础知识的基础上聚焦主干工程材料，系统学习服役要求、合金化设计、合金体系演化、组织性能等知识，并最终落脚于材料的研制、选择及应用技术。课程主要内容包括：钢强韧性原理及其合金化设计；有色金属强韧性原理及其合金化设计；冶金质量及其对合金化效果的影响；典型构件用钢的性能要求、分类、合金体系衍变、组织性能及适用性；典型机器用钢的性能要求、分类、合金体系衍变、组织性能及适用性；典型工具钢的性能要求、分类、合金体系衍变、组织性能及适用性；钢钝化耐蚀机理及相应合金化设计；不锈钢性能要求、分类、合金体系衍变、组织性能及适用性；热强/抗氧化机理及相应合金化设计；耐热钢性能要求、分类、合金体系衍变、组织性能及适用性；有色合金强韧/耐蚀性机理及相关合金化设计，铝合金、钛合金、铜合金、镁合金性能要求、服役条件、合金化设计、合金体系衍变及组织性能特征；陶瓷、高分子材料的设计、性能特点与适用性；复合材料的设计、性能特点与适用性。 课程设立的目标包括：(1) 引导学生系统掌握工程材料相关知识，系统掌握钢铁、有色金属、陶瓷、高分子、复合材料等主干工程材料设计思路、制备/加工、性能特点、体系衍变和适用性，初步形成工程结构材料设计、制造加工及选用的能力；(2) 强化学生对组织演化、力学性能、加工/处理原理与工艺等基础理论、基本概念的理解，培养从使用出发进行材料设计、加工/处理和选择应用逆向思辨能力和工程素养；(3) 完成从材料学共性基础到实际工程材料知识延伸，贯通“基础理论—工程技术—工业应用”链条，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 课程面向材料科学、机械、能源及相关专业本科生，于大学三年级春季学期开课，设置为40学时，2.5学分。先修课程包括材料科学与工程基础，材料力学性能，热处理原理A，热处理工艺A等。
default.en: Engineering Materials Science is a core course for the Materials Science and Engineering (Strong Base Program), focusing on fundamental theories of materials science and applied technologies for engineering materials. The course, guided by microstructure-performance principles, systematically covers service requirements analysis, alloy design and evolution, microstructure-properties of key engineering materials, culminating in material selection and application techniques. The core topics of the course include: ？ The strengthening/toughening of steels and the relevant alloying design； ？ The strengthening/toughening of non-ferrous alloys and the relevant alloying design； ？ Metallurgical quality and its impact on the alloying effect; ？ Performance requirements, alloying design, classification, microstructure and performances, development, and applicability of steel for typical components; ？ Performance requirements, alloying design, classification, microstructure and performances, development, and applicability of typical machine steel; ？ Performance requirements, alloying design, classification, microstructure and performances, development, and applicability of typical tool steels; ？ Passivation and the corrosion resistance of steel and the relevant alloying design； ？ Performance requirements, service conditions, alloying design, and microstructure/properties, development, and applicability of stainless steel; ？ Thermal strength/oxidation resistance of steels and corresponding alloying design; ？ Performance requirements, service conditions, alloying design, microstructure/properties, development, and applicability of heat-resistant steel; ？ The mechanism of strengthening/toughening and corrosion resistance and the related alloying design in non-ferrous alloys; ？ Performance requirements, service conditions, alloying design, alloy system evolution, and microstructure/performance of aluminum alloys, titanium alloys, copper alloys, and magnesium alloys; ？ Design, performance characteristics, and applicability of ceramics and polymer materials; ？ Design, performance characteristics, and applicability of composite materials. Course Profile: ？ Designed for: undergraduates majored in Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Science and Technology, Energy Science and Engineering ？ Term: Spring semester, Grade 3 ？ Credits: 2.5 (40 class hours) ？ Prerequisites: Fundamentals of Materials Science, Mechanical Properties of Materials, Heat Treatment Principles A, Heat Treatment Technology A

default.zh: 量子力学是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门基础理论课程，主要描述微观物质（原子，亚原子粒子）的基本物理性质；它是许多工科大学材料学课程的基础，包括固体物理、材料物理性能、功能材料学、半导体材料及纳米材料等。 本课程的主要任务是培养学生具备量子物理方面的基本理念、基础理论背景，掌握微观物质主要是电子的基本物理规律，具备从量子力学的角度看待诸多物理学和材料学问题的能力，培养从事功能材料研究和器件设计的科研能力，同时为相关后续课程提供理论基础。
default.en: Quantum Mechanics is a basic theoretical course for materials science and engineering. It describes the basic physical properties of microscopic objects (atoms and subatomic particles).
