It is the foundation of many relative courses, including solid state physics, physical properties of materials, functional materials science, semiconductor materials and nano-materials. The main task of this course is to help students understand the basic concept, the background of quantum physics and the basic laws of microscopic objects (i.e. electrons). So one could be capable to regard the problems of physical and materials science from the quantum mechanics point of view. It also cultivate the ability of functional materials research and device design, providing theoretical basis for relevant follow-up courses at the same time. 1. Apply the knowledge of quantum mechanics and combine the knowledge of other courses to explain the properties of materials such as sound, light, heat, electricity and magnetism. Analyze and study the engineering problems encountered in complex practical materials through specific computational models, so as to obtain clear scientific conclusions. 2. Accurately describe and make simple qualitative analysis of physical phenomena based on quantum mechanics. Write research reports on engineering problems related to quantum mechanics in Chinese. 3. Through the study of quantum mechanics, cultivate the ability of abstract thinking. Learn mathematics and modern physics related to quantum mechanics on one's own, and have academic communications with foreign peers, so as to acquire the ability of learning and adaptation to development.

default.zh: 本课程通过材料多尺度计算模拟实际案例的引入及其与先修课程的融会贯通的启发式教学，使学生了解计算材料学的基本概念，克服对材料进行模拟计算的畏难情绪与习惯于“炒菜式”实验方法的惰性思维，着重了解和掌握第一性原理计算与新材料设计、分子力学和蒙特卡洛法与材料微观和介观结构模拟的理论基础、模拟计算方法。基于量子力学、牛顿力学和统计物理引入计算材料学的基本概念与基本方法，重点介绍第一性原理、分子动力学与蒙特卡洛法等计算模拟技术在材料科学与工程领域中的应用，促进学生进一步理解材料科学理论、模拟与实验的相互关系与融会贯通，激发学生采用计算模拟方法进行材料创新研究的兴趣。进一步深化材料学及相关学科的有关基本原理，开拓学生的创新思路和视野。旨在培养学生针对复杂材料工程问题，能够利用材料科学与工程基本原理进行合理分析，建立物理模型与数值计算模型；能够运用计算机软件进行原子和介观尺度材料微观结构模拟与设计，具有利用现代化信息技术与资源解决复杂材料工程问题的能力；能够正确组织语言，用汉语就专业领域的工程问题规范正确地撰写报告，并具有与同行进行学术交流的能力；具有自主学习和终身学习的意识。
default.en: Through the introduction of practical cases of multi-scale computational simulation of materials and its integration with the prerequisite courses, this course will enable students to understand the basic concepts of computational materials science, overcome the fear and inertia of the "frying pan" experimental approach to materials simulation, and focus on the understanding and mastery of the first principles of computation and new materials design, molecular mechanics and Monte Carlo methods and materials micro- and mesoscopic structure simulation. Theoretical foundations and computational methods for the design of new materials, molecular mechanics and Monte Carlo methods, and the simulation of micro- and mesoscopic structures of materials. This course introduces the basic concepts and methods of computational materials science based on quantum mechanics, Newtonian mechanics, and statistical physics, and focuses on the application of first principles, molecular dynamics, and Monte Carlo methods in materials science and engineering. To stimulate students' interest in innovative materials research using computer simulation methods. To further deepen the basic principles related to materials science and related disciplines, and to develop students' innovative ideas and perspectives. The aim is to train students to be able to use basic principles of materials science and engineering to conduct reasonable analysis and establish physical and numerical computational models for complex materials engineering problems; to be able to use computer software to simulate and design the microstructure of materials at atomic and mesoscopic scales, and to have the ability to use modern information technology and resources to solve complex materials engineering problems; to be able to organize language correctly and write reports in Chinese on engineering problems in their specialized fields. They should be able to write reports in Chinese on engineering problems and have the ability to communicate with peers; they should have the awareness of independent learning and lifelong learning.

default.zh: 《材料相变原理》是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门专业核心课程。本课程系统的阐述了固态相变的基本原理和基本规律、固态材料组织结构转变的基本规律和相图的基本理论和基础知识，着重介绍了固态相变的驱动力、热力学和动力学基本知识、合金脱溶和调幅分解特点和基本规律、三元相图的基本概念和理论和相图的特点和应用，介绍工业上常用三元系金属材料相图的分析方法。本课程着眼于材料相变和相图的基本问题、从相变和相图的基本概念和理论出发，使学生能把握固态相变的特点和相图的共性，熟悉不同相变和相图的个性。通过理论教学和项目研究，使学生不仅能掌握和掌握材料相变和相图方面的基础知识和基本理论，善于分析和解决问题，同时也培养学生创造性思维、综合研究能力和材料科学与工程实践能力。本课程为学生将来从事材料的研究与开发打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Phase Transformations Principles of Materials is one of the core specialized courses for the students of materials science and engineering in colleges of engineering. This course systematically elaborates the fundamental principles and laws of solid-state phase transformations, the basic rules of microstructure evolution in solid materials, as well as the fundamental theory and basic knowledge of phase diagram, and emphatically introduces the driving forces of solid-state phase transformations, fundamental thermodynamics and kinetics, the characteristics and underlying principles of alloy precipitation and spinodal decomposition， and the basic conception and theories and rules of ternary phase diagram, including the characteristics and applications of ternary phase diagram, and also introduces the analysis method of the common three-component alloys phase diagram in the industry. This course focuses on the basic problems of material phase transformations and phase diagram. The students can grasp the general characteristic of material phase transformations and phase diagram and master the specific properties of material phase transformations phase diagram based on the fundamental theories and rules. The principle goals of this course is to make the students not only understand and master the fundamental theories and rules of material phase transformations and phase diagram, analyze and solve the problems of materials research and application, but also have the capability of innovation, comprehensive research and practice of materials science and engineering through theory study and research project. This course lays solid theoretical foundation for the research and development of materials in the future.

default.zh: 《热加工过程传输原理A》是为满足材料成形和控制工程教学计划的实施而教学的。在材料工过程中、熔融金属液凝固过程中，往往会存在着三种传输现象(动量传输、热量传输和质量传输)的现象，并且会影响着最后材料的组织和性能，因此如何有效的控制好材料加工过程中的三传过程，是获得高质量构件的关键。课程内容无论在基础原理，还是在结合实际叙述原理的应用方面，都特别注意与金属热态成形过程中可能遇到的现象特点相结合。
default.en: The transmission principle A of hot working process is taught to meet the implementation of the material forming and control engineering teaching plan. In the process of material processing and solidification of molten metal, there are often three types of transmission phenomena (momentum transfer, heat transfer, and mass transfer) that affect the microstructure and properties of the final material. Therefore, how to effectively control the three transmission processes in material processing is the key to obtaining high-quality components. The course content pays special attention to combining the characteristics of phenomena that may be encountered in the process of metal hot forming, both in terms of basic principles and practical application of principles.

default.zh: 该课程讲授金属液态成形技术的理论基础，介绍金属凝固过程的基本概念、理论、组织形成规律及控制原理，以及与铸件成形相关的诸种缺陷的形成机制与控制原则，具体内容包括液态金属的结构与性质、金属熔体充型过程、凝固温度场、晶体形核与生长、单相合金凝固、多相合金凝固、铸件凝固组织的控制、液态金属与气相和渣相的相互作用、凝固过程中的成分偏析、气孔和夹杂的形成与控制、凝固收缩过程中的缺陷形成与控制、固态冷却过程中的缺陷形成与控制。
default.en: This course will teach the theoretical foundation of casting technology including the basic concepts and theories of solidification, the formation discipline and controlling principle of casting microstructures, and the formation mechanism as well as controlling methods of various casting defects. The course will introduce the structure and physical properties of metal melt, the filling process of melt, solidification temperature field, nucleation and growth of crystal, solidification process of single phase as well as multiple phases, the controlling of casting microstructure, interaction between melt and gas/inclusion impurities, the component segregation during solidification, the formation and controlling of gaseous pores and inclusions, the formation and controlling of defects during solidification shrinkage as well as colling process after solidification.

default.zh: 本课程是材料成型及控制工程的一门专业核心课程，通过对典型的液态成形铁基和非铁基合金基本概念、基础知识和理论的学习，培养学生掌握液态成形合金的成分特征、合金化原理、组织性能控制以及液态成形的工艺性能作用机理等基本知识，了解其工程、科研和技术研发的应用和发展趋势，强调研究方法的掌握和运用，增强分析和解决问题的能力和素质，奠定从事材料成型加工和控制工程中选择、运用和设计开发新型合金材料的理论基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程学习要求如下：1）了解和掌握几种典型铸造合金的成分、性质、组织和性能特点，具备分析铸造合金问题的基础知识，了解近平衡和非平衡凝固条件下铸造合金组织性能控制规律；2）了解和掌握几种典型铸造合金的合金化原理及液态成形工艺对组织和性能的作用机理，具有结合工程应用需求和液态成形工艺特点进行铸造合金选用和设计的初步能力；3）了解铸造合金的新理论、新方法以及研究热点和发展趋势，为今后新型铸造合金设计、开发新型液态合金成形工艺和提高铸件性能奠定基础。
default.en: This course is a core professional course of material forming and control engineering. Through the study of basic concepts, basic knowledge and theories of typical liquid forming iron and non-iron based alloys, students will be trained to master the basic knowledge of composition characteristics, alloying principle, structure property control and process property action mechanism of liquid forming alloys. Understand the application and development trend of engineering, scientific research and technology research and development, emphasize the mastery and application of research methods, enhance the ability and quality of analysis and problem solving, lay the theoretical foundation for the selection, application, design and development of new alloy materials in material forming processing and control engineering, and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results. Course requirements are as follows: 1）To understand and master the composition, properties, structure and performance characteristics of several typical casting alloys, have the basic knowledge of analyzing casting alloy problems, control of microstructure and properties of cast alloys under near-equilibrium and non-equilibrium solidification conditions, 2）To understand and master the alloying principle of several typical casting alloys and the action mechanism of liquid forming process on the structure and properties, and have the preliminary ability to select and design casting alloys according to the requirements of engineering applications and the characteristics of liquid forming process, 3) To understand the new theories, new methods and research hotspots and development trends of casting alloys, to lay the foundation for the future design of new casting alloys, the development of new liquid alloy forming processes and the improvement of casting properties.

default.zh: 《材料成形模具数字化设计A》是本专业一门重要的专业基础课，在学习机械制图、机械设计、CAD、液态成形工艺基础等专业基础课程的基础上，综合应用相关基础知识和专业知识，了解模具设计及制造技术的发展趋势，熟悉和掌握材料成型模具设计的基本原理、设计方法，实现铸造成型工艺设计的目标。 内容主要包括成型模具的应用、模具结构特点、模具工作原理、模具设计规则、模具设计方法和设计计算方法、典型模具的结构和设计、模具材料、模具制造技术及模具设计制造CAD等。
default.en: Digital design of material forming dies A is an important professional basic course of this specialty. Students can understand the development trend of die design and manufacturing technology, understand and master the basic principles and design methods for the material forming mold design. On the basis of learning the profession basic courses such as mechanical drawing, mechanical design, CAD, liquid forming process and so on, students can comprehensively apply the basic knowledge and professional knowledge to achieve the goal of casting molding process design. The main contents of the course include mold application, mold structure, mold working principle, mold design rule, mold design method and calculation method, typical mold structure and design, mold material, mold manufacturing technology and mold design and manufacturing CAD.

default.zh: 本课程是为了加强学生的基础理论的应用能力，适应材料加工学科高新技术的发展，拓宽知识面而设立的。本课程主要讲授动量传输-热量传输-质量传输的有限差分法数值模拟理论基础，以及材料成形过程有限元模拟、相场法计算、分子动力学计算、第一性原理计算等原理与应用内容，包括基本理论、基本公式推导、基本求解方法、具体应用案例等。主要目的是培养学生采用多尺度数值模拟计算方法解决材料加工过程实际问题能力，为解决一般材料加工问题提供计算材料学理论基础。
default.en: This course is designed to strengthen students' application ability of basic theory, adapt to the development of high technology of material processing and broaden the scope of knowledge. This course mainly teaches the theoretical basis of numerical simulation of momentum transfer-heat transfer-mass transfer-finite difference method, as well as the principles and application contents of finite element simulation, phase field calculation, molecular dynamics calculation, first-principle calculation of material forming process, including basic theory, basic formula derivation, basic solution method, and specific application cases. The main purpose is to cultivate students' ability to solve practical problems in material processing by using multi-scale numerical simulation and provide theoretical basis of computational materials science for solving general material processing problems.

default.zh: 《材料成形设备与控制A》课程教学目的在于使材料成型及控制工程专业本科学生掌握金属材料凝固成形设备原理及其自动控制方面的基本知识，重点掌握砂型铸造和特种铸造中合金熔炼、造型、浇注及后处理等各个过程的关键设备结构与控制技术，掌握材料成形过程中常用执行机构和检测元件的工作原理、技术参数和工艺范围等，并初步了解铸造设备及其自动控制方面的最新进展和发展方向。 具体课堂授课教学共32学时，内容包括凝固成形设备与自动控制基础、凝固成形过程的执行机构和检测元件、砂型铸造设备与控制等。
default.en: The object of the Material Processing Equipment and Control A course is to give some fundamental theory and characterization of Automatic Control of Foundry Equipment, to the undergraduates of Material Processing and Control Engineering. The basic principles of the Sand casting and special casting equipment, including main characteristics, technical parameters, the process ranges of actuators and detecting elements as well as some future developments for the casting equipment and control are introduced. The total teaching course is 32 hours, i.e., fundamentals of automatic control, actuators and detecting elements of liquid processing equipment and automation of sand.

default.zh: 纵观铸造发展史，铸造工艺的变革和进步往往都是由于造型材料的发展而引起的，与造型材料有关的废品率约占铸件总废品率的60-80%造型材料，造型材料在铸造生产中占有举足轻重的地位。本课程共分8章，包括绪论、原砂、粘结剂、粘土粘结砂、水玻璃砂、水泥自硬砂、树脂粘结砂和铸造涂料。本课程以培养创新型应用人才为目标，大量工程实例及应用，培养学的工程应用能力和分析问题、解决问题的能力，同时给出各种阅读材料，拓宽学生视野。在知识框架组织上显得更加流畅，强调理论知识的工程应用性。
default.en: Throughout the history of casting development, the transformation and progress of casting technology are often caused by the development of molding materials. The scrap rate related to molding materials accounts for about 60-80% of the total scrap rate of castings. Molding materials play a crucial role in casting production. This course is divided into 8 chapters, including introduction, raw sand, binders, clay bonded sand, sodium silicate sand, cement self hardening sand, resin bonded sand, and casting coatings. This course aims to cultivate innovative applied talents, with a large number of engineering examples and applications, to cultivate students' engineering application ability and ability to analyze and solve problems. At the same time, various reading materials are provided to broaden their horizons. In terms of knowledge framework organization, it appears more fluent, emphasizing the engineering applicability of theoretical knowledge.

default.zh: 液态成形工艺基础是材料成型及控制工程专业（液态成形方向）的专业核心课。课程的目的是了解和掌握铸造工艺过程基本原理和要求，具备铸造质量控制及工艺设计的基础知识；了解和掌握液态金属与铸型之间的相互作用机理、铸造缺陷产生机理及其对铸件质量的影响，具备分析和解决工程实践中铸造缺陷的能力；了解和掌握铸造工艺设计的基本原理，具有进行简单铸造工艺设计的能力；了解金属液态成形新理论、新方法和发展趋势。 主要讲述：铸造成形的特点、重要性及应用；金属液态成形工艺过程；液态金属与砂型之间的热作用、机械作用、物理化学作用，与相互作用有关的各种铸造缺陷产生机理、防止措施；粘土砂型制造方法及质量控制、无机粘结剂砂型制造及质量控制、有机粘结剂砂型制造及质量控制，铸造涂料；零件结构的铸造工艺性分析，铸造工艺方案，包括浇注位置与分型面的选择、砂芯设计、铸造工艺参数的优选，铸件浇注系统设计，包括浇注系统分类、液态金属在浇注系统中的流动、浇注系统引入位置的选择、浇注系统的设计计算，铸件冒口及冷铁设计；常用特种铸造方法，包括低差压铸造、消失模铸造、金属型铸造、压力铸造等，以及金属液态成形技术新进展。
default.en: Fundamentals of Liquid Forming Process is the core course of the material forming and control engineering major (liquid forming field). The purpose of the course is to understand and master the basic principles and requirements of the casting process, and possess basic knowledge of casting quality control and process design. Understand and master the interaction mechanism between liquid metal and casting mold, the mechanism of casting defects and their impact on casting quality, and have the ability to analyze and solve casting defects in engineering practice. Understand and master the basic principles of casting process design, and have the ability to design simple casting processes. Understand the new theories, methods, and development trends of metal liquid forming. The main content includes: the characteristics, importance, and application of casting forming, metal liquid forming process, thermal, mechanical and physicochemical interactions between liquid metal and sand molds, as well as the mechanisms and preventive measures for various casting defects related to the interactions, clay sand mold manufacturing methods and quality control, inorganic binder sand mold manufacturing and quality control, organic binder sand mold manufacturing and quality control, casting coatings, analysis of the casting process of the component structure, casting process plan including selection of pouring position and parting surface, sand core design, optimization of casting process parameters, design of casting pouring system, including classification of pouring system, flow of liquid metal in the pouring system, selection of pouring system introduction position, design calculation of pouring system, design of casting riser and cold iron; Commonly used special casting methods, including low differential pressure casting, lost foam casting, metal mold casting, pressure casting, and new developments in metal liquid forming technology.

default.zh: 《材料成形综合实验A》属于凝固成形专业方向核心课程，作为一门独立的实验课程，是本专业重要的实践性环节。课程的内容基本涵盖了砂型铸造整个工艺流程，主要包括：铸造原材料性能测试，铸造工艺设计，液态金属充型及凝固过程仿真，合金的熔炼及处理工艺，液态金属铸造性能测试，浇注系统设计对铸件质量的影响，铸件组织性能检测与分析。通过上述一系列的实验教学，使学生了解和掌握材料液态成形及其性能测试方面主要环节的实验方法和实验技巧。学生通过亲自动手实践加深对所学理论知识的领悟，同时培养其在金属液态成形方面的基本实验技能和运用理论解决实际问题的能力和设计创新能力。
default.en: “Comprehensive Experiment of Material Forming A” is a core course of solidification forming major, and as an independent experimental course, it is an important practical link in this major. The content of the course basically covers the entire process of sand casting， mainly including casting raw materials performance test, casting process design, simulation of liquid metal filling and solidification process, alloy melting and treatment technology, liquid metal casting performance test, the impact of gating system design on casting quality, testing and analysis of casting microstructure and properties. Through the above series of experimental teaching, students will understand and master the experimental methods and techniques of the main aspects of material liquid forming and its performance testing. Students deepen their understanding of theoretical knowledge through hands-on practice, while cultivating their basic experimental skills in metal liquid forming, as well as their ability to apply theory to solve practical problems and design innovation.

default.zh: 通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握工程材料凝固加工及新材料制备过程中有关材料熔化、熔炼基本知识和技术，了解材料熔融状态质量的评估方法及其对凝固过程、材料最终性能的影响，应用熔炼基本知识和理论，针对特定的金属材料熔炼过程的特殊性，全面分析熔体质量控制的复杂性及关键环节，获得实现高质量合金熔体的能力。能够运用专业术语及知识进行沟通交流，并获得自我学习能力。 本课程内容主要包括（1）熔炼技术的发展及社会贡献；（2）熔炼热力学与动力学；（3）不同种类材料熔化特性，熔炼过程的物理化学反应；（4）熔渣与熔剂组成、结构、物理化学性质、与熔体的反应等；（5）熔体中气体、夹杂物种类、来源、作用及控制方法；（6）常用金属材料熔炼特殊性问题，包括黑色金属和有色金属。
default.en: Based on this course study, the students will master the fundamentals of melting that is related to the solidification processing of main engineering material and the preparation of new materials, understand the material molten state quality evaluation method and its influence on the solidification and the final performance, build the analysis ability of melt quality controlling facing to the complex questions and determine the key processing parameter. After this course study, the students will have the exchange ability based on the professional terms and knowledge. This course includes the following issues: (1) smelting technology development and its impact on the social development; (2) melting thermodynamics and dynamics; (3) different kinds material melting characteristics, melting process physical and chemical reaction; (4) slag and flux composition, structure, physical and chemical properties, and the reaction with melt, etc.; (5) the origin, function and control method of gas and inclusion in melt; (6) melting particularity problems related to common metal materials, including ferrous alloys and nonferrous alloy.

default.zh: 本课程为材料成型及控制工程专业本科生基础课，通过向学生讲授动量传输和热量传输的基本原理和实践应用的知识，使学生掌握动量传输中流体的基本性质、力学特征以及热量传输中热传导、热对流、热辐射的基本原理和热量传递计算方法，主要目的是培养学生具有分析热加工中流体流动和热量传递的能力，以及具有运用数学方法描述实际传输现象的能力，并能运用基本原理对简单的工程传输问题进行分析和计算。
default.en: This course is the core curriculum for undergraduate students in the major of material molding and control engineering. The course introduces the basic principle and practical knowledge in the fields of momentum and heat transfer. Students can understand the basic properties and mechanical characteristics of liquid in momentum transfer, and also basic principles and calculation of heat conduction, heat convection and thermal radiation in heat transfer. The aim is to improve students’ ability to analyze the liquid flow and heat transfer problems in thermal processing, and to describe the practical transport phenomena by using the mathematical method. Students can further know how to solve and analyze some problems in practical engineering.

default.zh: 弹塑性力学基础课程是一门用以培养学生运用弹性与塑性力学解决材料成型与控制中问题能力的技术基础课。是为了使学生加强基础并拓宽知识面而设立的。本课程主要讲授物体小变形条件的连续体力学的弹性、塑性问题，包括：应力、应变理论；平衡微分方程与几何方程及协调条件；应力与应变关系；屈服准则；弹性与塑性力学解题方法与应用等，其主要任务是培养学生扎实的力学基础，较宽的知识面和创新的能力。
default.en: Fundamentals of Elastic and Plastic Mechanics A is a major foundation course aiming to training students the ability to solve the problem in materials processing and controlling by using elastic and plastic mechanics, enhancing their foundation and broadening their knowledge. This course mainly teaches the elastic and plastic problems of continuum mechanics for small deformation, including stress and strain theory, equilibrium differential equation, geometric equation and conforming equation, stress-strain relationship, yield criteria, solution algorithm of elastic and plastic mechanics and application, et al. the main task of this course is to bring up students abilities as stable mechanical foundation, widely knowledge and innovation ability.

default.zh: 《塑性成形物理基础》课程的开设，一方面是为学生在掌握材料科学的基础上，掌握金属材料塑性变形过程中内部微观结构、宏观形貌及性能表征等演变过程的基础理论；另一方面提高学生塑性加工过程中分析问题以及解决问题的能力。通过此课程的学习，使学生举一反三，培养和提高学生运用塑性加工理论分析表达塑性加工工艺的专业知识的能力，进而直接运用基础理论知识解决实际问题奠定基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: On the one hand, the course "Physical Foundation of Plastic Processing" is set up for students to master the basic theory of the evolution process of internal microstructure, macroscopic morphology and performance characterization of metal materials in the process of plastic deformation on the basis of mastering material science. On the other hand, improve students' ability to analyze and solve problems in the process of plastic processing. Through the study of this course, students can draw a conclusion from one example to another, cultivate and improve their ability to analyze and express professional knowledge of plastic machining technology with plastic machining theory, and then directly apply basic theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems to lay the foundation and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results.

default.zh: 模具是制造业的重要基础工艺装备，主要用于高效大批量生产工业产品中的有关零部件和制件，是装备制造业的重要组成部分。其产业关联度高，技术、资金密集，是制造业各有关行业产业升级和技术进步的重要保障之一。模具制造水平已经成为衡量一个国家制造业水平高低的重要标志，也是一个国家的工业产品保持国际竞争力的重要保证之一。 本课程是本专业一门重要的专业核心课程，综合运用用前面学习的机械制图、机械设计、材料成形等相关课程的专业基础知识，在培养学生知识应用、综合分析、综合设计能力等方面具有重要地位。 本课程主要讲授材料成型模具的分类和作用、模具结构特点、模具工作原理、模具设计规则、模具设计方法和设计计算方法、典型模具的结构和设计、模具材料、模具制造技术等，着重培养学生在材料成形工艺及装备方面的分析能力和设计能力，以及材料成形工艺知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Mold is an important basic technology equipment in the manufacturing industry, mainly used for efficient and large-scale production of related components and parts in industrial products. It is an important component of the equipment manufacturing industry. It has a high degree of industrial correlation and is technology and capital intensive, which is one of the important guarantees for the upgrading and technological progress of various related industries in the manufacturing industry. The level of mold manufacturing has become an important indicator of a country's manufacturing level, and also an important guarantee for a country's industrial products to maintain international competitiveness. This course is an important core course in the major, which comprehensively utilizes the knowledge of mechanical technology drawing, mechanical design, materials forming and other foundational courses learned earlier. It plays an important role in cultivating students' knowledge application, comprehensive analysis, and comprehensive design abilities. This course mainly teaches the classification and functions of material forming molds, mold structural characteristics, mold working principles, mold design rules, mold design methods and calculation methods, typical mold structures and designs, mold materials, mold manufacturing technology, etc. It focuses on cultivating students' analytical and design abilities in materials forming processes and equipment, as well as their application abilities in materials forming process knowledge, support the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《材料成形设备与控制B》课程的开设，目的在于使材料成形及控制工程专业学生掌握常用材料成形设备基本原理、主要特征、技术参数和工艺范围等知识，重点掌握液压传动系统、计算机控制系统的设计原则和方法，了解典型材料成形设备的应用范围、基本原理及控制方法，并初步了解材料成形设备自动化技术的最新进展，智能塑性成形设备的发展方向，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Basic principle, characteristic and working process of material forming equipment are main topic of this course. The basic theory of hydraulic drive and control, operational principle of general components of hydraulic drive, such as hydraulic pump, valve, cylinder are introduced. The composition and characteristic of the modern hydraulic control system which the core element is proportional valve or servo valve are introduced. Composition and principle of computer control system are also introduced. Two representative plastic forming equipment, mechanical press and hydraulic press are introduced, computer control and hydraulic control technology are introduced combined with specific forming process. The concept and potential application of intelligent control are also introduced in this course.

default.zh: 轧制工艺是目前生产金属板材、带材、管材以及型材的重要工艺方法。而且金属板材、带材、管材和型材又是金属材料塑性加工的主要原材料。所以增强对金属材料轧制工艺的了解非常重要。本课程以金属轧制理论与工艺为主线讲授材料成型及控制工程的基础理论与基本知识，阐述了金属轧制过程中工艺参数与板材、带材、管材及型材的组织性能之间的关系。课程内容包括金属轧制技术的技术内涵，轧制技术的技术特点，轧制技术的基本原理，金属板材、带材、管材以及型材的轧制工艺原理及其工艺控制技术要点。重点介绍金属轧制的基本原理以及轧制产品的工艺控制技术要点，加强学生对金属材料轧制理论与工艺的深入理解，为材料成型及控制工程专业学生对金属板材、带材、管材及型材的主流制备工艺的掌握提供重要支持。通过本课程的讲解达到以下两个课程目标：（1）使学生掌握金属轧制技术的技术内涵、技术特点和轧制技术的基本原理;（2）使学生具备分析金属板带材、管材、型材以及线材的轧制工艺的工艺原理及其工艺控制技术要点的的能力。
default.en: Rolling process is an important process for the production of sheet metal, strip, pipe and profile. Moreover, sheet metal, strip, pipe and profile are the main raw materials for plastic processing of metal materials. Therefore, it is very important to enhance the understanding of metal material rolling process. This course takes metal rolling theory and technology as the main line to teach the basic theory and basic knowledge of material forming and control engineering, and expounds the relationship between the process parameters and the microstructure properties of sheet, strip, pipe and profiles in the metal rolling process. The course content includes the technical connotation of metal rolling technology, the technical characteristics of rolling technology, the basic principle of rolling technology, the rolling process principle of metal sheet, strip, pipe and profile and the key points of process control technology. It focuses on the basic principle of metal rolling and the key points of process control technology of rolled products, strengthens students' in-depth understanding of the theory and process of metal material rolling, and provides important support for students majoring in material forming and control engineering to master the mainstream preparation technology of metal sheet, strip, pipe and profile. Through the explanation of this course to achieve the following two course objectives: (1) enabling students to master the technical connotation of metal rolling technology, technical characteristics and basic principles of rolling technology, (2) equipping students with the ability to analyze the process principle and key technical points of process control of the rolling process of metal plate and strip, pipe, profile and wire.

default.zh: 本课程是一门介绍板材塑性变形原理和成形方法的专业必修课。本课程将重点介绍板材塑性变形的基础理论、典型成形工艺的基本原理、板材成形的变形机理和变形分析方法等，并紧密结合板材成形的新理论和新方法，让学生掌握板材变形分析方法，具备分析和解决板材零件成形工艺、模具设计和缺陷分析的能力。通过对成形工艺知识的学习增加对板料成形技术的理解和掌握，为学习塑性成形方向专业课程奠定基础。
default.en: The course is a necessary course of this major on the plastic deformation theory and forming method of sheet metal. The basic knowledge on sheet forming, foundational theory of typical forming processes, deformation mechanism and analysis method of sheet metal forming are mainly introduced combined with new theories, technologies and methods of plastic forming. The course will make students to grasp the analytical method of sheet metal forming. By learning this course, the students will have the analyzing and resolving ability on the design of forming process and tools as well as defect problems. Students can improve their knowledge on sheet forming technology by studying this course, and make the foundation of on learning other specialized knowledge.

default.zh: 材料成形综合实验B课程是材料成型及控制工程专业学生的专业必修课，该课程力图通过一系列的教学实验，使学生全面了解金属材料塑性成形特点、模具结构、工艺过程控制及其性能测试方面的主要环节的实验方法、实验技术和操作技巧，从而训练学生在金属塑性成形方面的基本实验技能，在帮助学生理解和领会课堂所学的理论知识的同时，培养学生的实践动手能力和创新性。
default.en: Material Forming Comprehensive Experiment B course is a required course for students majoring in material forming and control engineering. Through a series of teaching experiments, this course tries to make students fully understand the experimental methods, experimental techniques and operation skills of the main links of metal material plastic forming characteristics, mold structure, process control and performance testing. In order to train students in the metal plastic forming of the basic experimental skills, to help students understand and grasp the theoretical knowledge learned in the classroom at the same time, to cultivate students' practical ability and innovation.

default.zh: 体积成形原理与方法是材料加工及相关专业学生必须掌握的专业基础课之一，主要介绍塑性体积成形的基础理论知识，并以变形分析为基础、以成形规律为主线、以质量问题为重点，论述自由锻和模锻的典型工序变形特点及控制方法；介绍精密模锻和特种锻造技术的分类及发展趋势。通过本课程的学习，学生能掌握自由锻和模锻主要工序；能从零件出发，制定较为合理的自由锻和模锻工艺路线；了解各类先进锻造技术的工作原理和应用范围，培养学生解决塑性体积成形工艺问题和技术革新的能力。
default.en: Plastic bulk forming is one of the required professional basic courses for materials processing and relative majors, which introduces the fundamental knowledge on plastic bulk forming. The foundation, main line and emphasis of this course are deformation analysis, flow forming laws and forging defects, respectively. On this basis, typical deformation procedures of free forging and die forging are analyzed systematically and controlling methods are proposed correspondingly. In addition, precision die forging and special forging processes are introduced and the developing trend of bulk forming was analyzed. Through studying this course, students can master the main procedures of open forging and die forging. Also, students can make reasonable process routes of open forging and die forging according to specific parts. Through this course, the students can understand the working principles and application range of various advanced forging processes, and build the ability of problem-solving and technical innovation in materials processing field.

default.zh: 材料智能成形是现代先进制造业的主要发展方向之一。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解智能塑性成形技术的发展、内涵、体系结构、基础理论与基本方法，认识塑性成形领域的前沿发展现状和趋势，开阔视野，培养分析、选用和设计智能制造单元的基本能力，巩固所学基础理论，为今后从事塑性成形领域产品设计制造、科技开发、运行管理等工作打下基础。
default.en: Intelligent material forming is one of the primary development directions in modern advanced manufacturing. Through the study of this course, students will gain an understanding of the development, essence, system architecture, fundamental theories, and basic methods of intelligent plastic forming technology. They will become familiar with the cutting-edge advancements and trends in the field of plastic forming, broadening their horizons and fostering their ability to analyze, select, and design intelligent manufacturing units. This course consolidates foundational theoretical knowledge, laying a solid groundwork for future endeavors in product design and manufacturing, technological development, and operational management within the field of plastic forming.

default.zh: 讲述增材制造常用的热源基础知识、原理、特点、系统组成及应用，包括电弧热源、激光热源和电子束热源。电弧热源部分包括电弧热源的产生、热源和力源特性，金属熔化及成形规律；学习非熔化极电弧热源、熔化极电弧和埋弧的概念、特点、系统组成和应用；掌握直流电弧、交流电弧、脉冲电弧及熔滴过渡知识。激光热源部分包括激光物理特性、激光与材料的相互作用、激光增材制造的热源特性等；学习激光器的类型及其应用特点、激光与材料之间的能量传输特性及激光熔化沉积与选区激光熔化过程的热源特点等；掌握激光增材制造的光束特征、材料熔化行为等相关知识。电子束热源部分包括电子束的电子光学基础、系统与原理、与材料的作用及增材应用；学习电子束形成的物理过程、电子枪组成及原理、电子束热源增材制造的方法。掌握电子束增材制造电子枪特征、电子束增材的产热原理与加热特点。
default.en: This course mainly introduce the basic knowledge, concept, features and system about the heating sources in additive manufacturing process including arc heating source, laser heating source and electron-beam heating source. Arc heating source part mainly introduce the generation, heat and force characteristics, metal melting and formation of arc. The concept, features, system and applications of non-consumable arc and consumable arc and submerged arc as well as DC arc, AC arc, pulsed arc and droplet transfer are also introduced. Laser heat source includes laser physical characteristics, laser and material interaction, laser additive manufacturing heat source characteristics, etc. The types and application of different lasers, the energy transfer mechanism between laser and material, the heat source characteristics of laser melting deposition and selective laser melting process are taught. The purpose is to help students mastering beam characteristics, material melting behavior and other related knowledge of laser additive manufacturing. The electron beam heat source part includes the electron optics basis, system and principle of electron beam, the interaction with materials and application in additive manufacturing process. The physical process of electron beam formation, the composition and principle of electron gun, and the additive manufacturing method by electron beam heat source are introduced. Characteristics of the electron gun for additive manufacturing, the heat generation principle and heating characteristics during electron beam additive manufacturing processes are emphasized.

default.zh: 本课程首先总体介绍增材制造过程的完整生产流程，指导学生了解前端设计涉及的主要技术及其在增材制造加工中的作用，增材制造的主要设计准则与考虑因素；具体专业知识分三大部分：第一部分，详细讲解不同类型零件的结构设计与建模方法，包括零件结构的拓扑优化，仿生结构、多孔结构、免组装结构等，以及逆向工程技术及其在零件结构设计中的应用；第二部分，讲解增材制造零件的前端设计相关知识，包括路径规划、切片分层、支撑设计，及不同环节的文件建立方法，并系统讲解复杂形状结构的设计理念及数学方法，通过具体设计案例，掌握设计方法的运用；第三部分：结合激光增材制造工艺特点，讲解模拟仿真技术在激光增材制造质量控制与变形预测方面应用，以及不同仿真方法的分析特点，包括热场、流场、力场的计算与仿真。最后，通过工业界中的典型应用案例，综合讲解上述各知识点的应用情况，以及零件结构设计与仿真技术的新发展。最后，结合三维建模、模型处理及增材制造工艺的实验教学，通过实际操作，加深学生对知识的理解。
default.en: The course firstly introduces the complete production flow of additive manufacturing process, and guides students to understand the main technologies involved in front-end design and its role in additive manufacturing process, as well as the main design criteria and considerations of additive manufacturing. The specific professional knowledge is divided into three parts: The first part explains the structural design and modeling methods of different types of parts in detail, including the topology optimization, bionic structure, porous structure, assembly-free structure, and reverse engineering technology and its application; The second part explains the front-end design knowledge of additive manufacturing parts, including path programming, slice layering, support design, and document establishment methods of different steps. In addition, explain the design concepts and mathematical methods of complex shape structures systematically, and master the application of design methods through specific design cases. The third part, based on the characteristics of laser additive manufacturing process, explains the application of simulation technology in laser additive manufacturing quality control and deformation prediction, and the analysis characteristics of different simulation methods, including the calculation and simulation of thermal field, flow field and stress field. Finally, through the typical application cases in the industry, the application of the above knowledge points, as well as the new development of structural design and simulation technology of parts are comprehensively introduced. Finally, in the assistance of experimental teaching of three-dimensional modeling, model processing and additive manufacturing processes, students would deepen their understanding of the knowledge through practical operations.

default.zh: 增材制造又称3D打印，是当下很前沿的高科技，是融合了计算机辅助设计、自动控制、材料加工与成形技术，以数字模型为基础，通过软件与数控系统将专用的金属材料、非金属材料以及生物材料等，按照挤压、烧结、熔融、光固化、喷射等方式逐层堆积，获得实体物品的制造技术。增材制造逐层堆积的单元体积很小、形状各异，最小时只有几十微米，因此可以制备传统方法无法制备的复杂结构，非常适合个性化设计与制造的需求，因此也是未来制造的一个重要方法。 本课程主要学习金属材料增材制造所涉及的一些基本理论及技术问题，包括不同热源与金属材料作用机理、金属熔池行为、微小熔池凝固过程、凝固组织调控方法、金属构件增材制造工艺、增材制造金属构件表面质量控制等。上述问题将结合电弧熔丝增材制造、激光选区熔化增材制造、激光定向能量沉积增材制造、电子束选区熔化增材制造、电子束熔丝沉积增材制造等增材制造技术与装备，同时了解增材制造原材料及复合增材制造技术的发展趋势。
default.en: Additive manufacturing, also known as 3D printing, is a very cutting-edge high-tech, is the integration of computer-aided design, automatic control, material processing and forming technology, based on digital models, through software and numerical control system will be dedicated metallic materials, non-metallic materials and biological materials, according to extrusion, sintering, melting, light curing, spraying and other ways layer by layer. Acquire manufacturing skills for physical objects. Additive manufacturing layer by layer of the unit volume is small, different shapes, the smallest melt pool is only about tens microns, so it can prepare the traditional method can not prepare complex structures, very suitable for personalized design and manufacturing needs, so it is also an important method for future manufacturing. This course mainly studies some basic theories and technical issues involved in the additive manufacturing of metallic materials, including the interaction mechanism between different heat sources and metallic materials, the behavior of metal melt pool, the solidification process of small melt pool, the control method of solidification structure, the additive manufacturing process of metal components, and the surface quality control of metal components in additive manufacturing. The above questions will be combined with arc fuse additive manufacturing, laser selective melting additive manufacturing, laser direct deposition additive manufacturing, electron beam selective melting additive manufacturing, electron beam fuse deposition additive manufacturing and other additive manufacturing technologies and equipment, and understand the development trend of additive manufacturing raw materials and composite additive manufacturing technology.

default.zh: 《陶瓷材料增材制造》是高等工科院校增材制造工程相关专业的一门基础理论课程，主要描述基于离散-堆积原理不同陶瓷材料的增材制造技术及其陶瓷器件制备的原理方法；本课程涉及材料学、物理、化学、力学等多门基础理论，对增材制造工程相关专业本科生而言，本课程是对大学期间所学习的各门基础课和相关专业基础课程的综合运用。 通过本门课程的学习，进一步深化学生对材料学及相关学科有关基本原理的认识，激发和开拓学生的创新思路和视野，具备从多维度多层次分析诸多陶瓷材料增材制造技术背后的科学原理问题，培养从事陶瓷材料研究和器件制造的科研能力，加强理论联系实际，同时为相关后续课程提供理论基础。
default.en: The Additive Manufacturing of Ceramic Materials is a basic theoretical course for the related majors of additive manufacturing engineering in tertiary engineering institutions, mainly describing the additive manufacturing technology of different ceramics based on the principle of discrete - stacking and the principle of ceramic parts preparation. This course involves several basic theories relating to materials science, physics, chemistry, mechanics, etc. For undergraduate students in the related majors of additive manufacturing engineering, this course is a comprehensive application of many basic courses and professional courses studied during the university. Through the study of this course, we aim to further deepen students' understanding of the basic principles of materials science and related disciplines, to stimulate and develop students' innovative ideas and horizons, to make the students have the ability to analyze the scientific principles behind the additive manufacturing technology for many ceramics from a multi-dimensional and multi-level analysis, to help the students develop scientific capabilities of the ceramics research and ceramics devices fabrication, to strengthen the link between theory and practice, and at the same time to provide the theoretical basis for the relevant follow-up courses.

default.zh: 增材制造固相组织调控是增材制造类相关学生必须掌握的重要专业核心课。通过课程的学习，使学生掌握增材制造金属材料热处理过程中发生典型固态组织变化的工艺方法、原理和规律，掌握如何通过热处理改变增材制造金属材料的组织结构和性能特点，以及各种典型相变的特点、热力学、动力学、转变机制、转变过程、转变产物的组织与性能特点。通过课程学习，学生应掌握金属材料中成分、结构、相、组织的概念，固态相变特征、固态相变形核与长大机制，以及固态相变的动力与阻力，新相形状的影响因素等。掌握热处理加热过程中平衡珠光体和增材制造非平衡组织向奥氏体转变机制、动力学、及其影响因素，以及奥氏体晶粒长大影响因素。掌握冷却过程中珠光体组织形态特点、珠光体转变过程和转变速度、珠光体的机械性能和影响因素。掌握快速冷却过程中马氏体与贝氏体的晶体结构、组织形态、转变特点、转变机理、热力学、动力学、强化机理和性能特点，掌握退火、正火、淬火、回火定义与目的，退火与正火的目的、分类和组织性能特点，淬火钢在回火过程中组织转变过程。掌握增材制造铝合金、钛合金等固溶和时效定义及组织与性能变化规律，掌握增材制造铝合金、钛合金等脱溶分解与时效过程，热力学与动力学，组织与性能演变规律等。
default.en: Solid control for additive manufacturing is the compulsory course of the related additive manufacturing engineering profession. Through the study of this course, students will understand the typical principle and law of solid phase transformation during heat treatment of additively manufactured metals, and how to modify the microstructures and properties of additively manufactured metals through heat treatment technologies. The students will also know well about the typical characteristics, thermodynamic and kinetic, mechanism, processes, microstructure and properties of transformed phases. Through this course, students should understand the concept of metal material composition, structure, phase and microstructure, phase transformation characteristics, solid phase nucleation and growth mechanism, and the power and the resistance of solid phase transformation, the influence factors of phase morphology. In addition, the mechanism, kinetics and influencing factors of austenite transformation during heating, and the factors influencing austenite grain growth are introduced. The microstructure characteristics, pearlite transformation process and transformation rate, mechanical properties and influencing factors of pearlite in cooling process are mastered. The rapid cooling process and the martensite crystal structure, morphology, transition mechanism, thermodynamics, dynamics, strengthening mechanism and performance characteristics. Understanding the definition and purpose of annealing, normalizing, quenching and tempering, the classification, microstructure, and mechanical properties of annealing and normalizing, as well as the microstructure transformation during tempering process. Moreover, to master the definition and structure of alloy solid solution and aging, the law of microstructure and property change, understanding the dissolution, dissolution and aging process of additively manufactured aluminum alloy, titanium alloy and other alloys, thermodynamics and kinetics, microstructure and property evolution law.

default.zh: 增材制造技术作为一种近净成形工艺，具有无需模具、不受构件复杂程度限制、材料利用率高、制造过程节能环保等优点，在航空航天、汽车船舶、微纳制造、生物医学工程等领域具有极高的应用价值。但是，增材制造技术其特殊的逐层打印机制使得构件在制造过程中缺陷倾向大，可能出现尺寸形状差异、表面质量缺陷、致密度差、各向异性、局部变形、内部质量缺陷及应力集中等问题，因此为了确保增材制造构件质量的稳定性，需要合理高效的质量检测技术对其进行缺陷检测和质量检查。 本课程作为增材制造工程专业的专业必修课，通过分析增材制造构件质量检测技术的原理、优点及局限及典型应用等，使学生了解和掌握增材制造成形过程及构件质量检测相关技术、测量方法及具体应用。课程内容主要包括增材制造过程在线检测原理及分类、在线检测方法和测量技术、成形质量智能控制技术、增材制造零件的形状及尺寸检测、表面质量检测、内部质量检测以及使用质量性能检测等方面的检测技术，从本质上认识增材制造过程中各种参量的测试原理和方法，并能有针对性地制定相应测试方案，为本科生后续的学习以及今后从事相关的工作奠定坚实的基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: As a net-shape forming process, additive manufacturing technology has the advantages of without mold, no limitation of component complexity, high material utilization rate, energy saving and environmental protection. Additive manufacturing technology has high application value in the fields of aerospace, automobile and ship, micro nano manufacturing, biomedical engineering and so on. However, the special layer by layer printer system of additive manufacturing technology makes have large tendency of defects in the manufacturing process, and there may be problems such as size and shape difference, surface quality defect, density difference, anisotropy, local deformation, internal quality defect and stress concentration. Therefore, in order to ensure the stability of the quality of additive manufacturing components, reasonable and efficient quality inspection technology is needed for defect detection and quality inspection. As a professional compulsory course for additive manufacturing engineering, the course enables students to understand and master the forming process of additive manufacturing and component quality detection related technologies, measurement methods and specific applications by analyzing the principle, advantages, limitations and typical applications of additive manufacturing component quality detection technology. The course content mainly includes on-line detection principle and classification of additive manufacturing process, on-line detection method and measurement technology, intelligent control technology of forming quality, detection technology of shape and size of additive manufacturing parts, surface quality detection, internal quality detection and use quality performance detection, so as to understand the testing principle and method of various parameters in additive manufacturing process in essence, It can also formulate corresponding test plans, lay a solid foundation for Undergraduates' follow-up study and related work in the future, and support the achievement of corresponding index points in professional learning achievements.

default.zh: 《增材制造综合实验》课程是培养学生利用相关专业知识，分析和表征增材制造材料、了解增材制造工艺和设备，解决复杂零件的数字化、快速化制造实践能力的一门课程。课程内容叙述增材制造的原理、方法与步骤，通过包括三维数字建模、模型数据处理、典型增材制造和材料检测与表征的全过程实验教学，加强学生在增材制造方面的实践能力培育，加深学生对增材制造技术的认识与理解；使学生了解和掌握增材制造成形及其性能测试方面的基本实验方法、实验技术和操作技巧；培养学生的实践动手能力和创新性，具备研发增材制造系统、材料及其工艺的基础和创新实践能力。
default.en: The course "Additive Manufacturing Comprehensive Experiment" aims to cultivate students' practical ability to analyze and characterize additive manufacturing materials, understand additive manufacturing processes and equipment based on their knowledge related to additive manufacturing, and to solve the digital and rapid manufacturing of complex parts. The course content describes the principles, methods, and steps of additive manufacturing. Through full process experimental teaching including 3D digital modeling, model data processing, typical additive manufacturing and testing and characterization, it strengthens students' practical ability cultivation in additive manufacturing and deepens their recognizing and understanding of additive manufacturing technology. Enable students to understand and master the basic experimental methods, techniques, and operational skills in additive manufacturing forming and performance testing. Cultivate students' practical and innovative abilities, possessing the foundation and innovative practical ability to lead or participate in the research and development of additive manufacturing systems, materials, and processes.

default.zh: 增材制造，通常也被称为3D打印，是一种制造技术，它与传统的切削或去除材料的制造方法截然不同。增材制造的核心概念是通过逐层堆叠或添加材料，逐渐构建三维物体，而不是从一个块材料中削减或去除材料以获得所需形状。这一过程的核心思想可以简化为"增加而非去除"。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握增材制造的基本原理，了解该领域的现状和发展方向，使学生掌握增材制造的建模、数据分析和剖分等处理方法，能够独自完成增材制造前期的设计、分析和计算工作，使学生掌握典型增材制造技术应用情况，实现在该领域进行科研工作的知识储备。
default.en: Additive manufacturing, also commonly referred to as 3D printing, is a manufacturing technique that is very different from traditional manufacturing methods of cutting or removing material. The core concept of additive manufacturing is to gradually build three-dimensional objects by stacking or adding material layer by layer, rather than cutting or removing material from a block to obtain a desired shape. The core idea of this process can be simplified as “adding, not removing”. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic principles of additive manufacturing, understand the current situation and development direction of the field, make students master the modeling, data analysis and dissection of additive manufacturing and other processing methods, and be able to complete the pre-design, analysis and calculation of additive manufacturing alone, so that students can master the application of the typical additive manufacturing technology to achieve the knowledge reserve for scientific research in this field.

default.zh: 课程目标1. 通过本门课程教学，使学生掌握材料制备与改性过程中的热量传输、传质传输、动量传输（三传）原理与方程。包括：传输基本概念和基本原理；稳态/非稳态热传导方程及应用；对流换热方程及应用；黑体辐射定律及应用；稳态/非稳态扩散方程及应用；稳态/非稳态动量传输方程及应用；三传相似理论；广义扩散方程/组织结构演变模型与仿真。基于所学知识求解三传过程数学模型、并实现过程的可视化。 课程目标2. 支撑材料科学与工程专业课学习与实践创新，并为将来从事新材料研究应用、突破高端装备制造关键技术，以及相应的理论创新奠定坚实基础。热量传输授课支撑：材料成形等过程中温度场与相变研究应用；质量传输授课支撑：扩散传质对制件/器件的改性、服役性能的研究和应用；动量传输授课支撑：流场调控高性能材料制备及应用。
default.en: Objective 1: Through learning this course, students will master principles and mathematical equations of heat transport, mass transport and momentum transport in the process of materials fabrication and modification. Based on these knowledge, students are expected to be able to formulate and solve the mathematical models of the transport phenomena, and visualize the calculation results. Objective 2: Establish solid background for learning other professional courses of materials science and engineering, practice and innovation for working on new materials, developing key technology of high-end equipment manufacturing, and theoretical innovation. Learning heat transport will support the research of temperature field and phase transformation during the processes, for instance, materials molding of work-piece; Learning mass transport will support the study of modification and longevity of work-piece; Learning momentum transport will support the study of fluid mechanics in the fabrication and working processes of materials and devices.

default.zh: 《焊接方法及设备》是焊接技术与工程专业核心主干课程之一。本课程主要讲授电弧理论和具体焊接方法的原理、特性和特点，使学生明确掌握电弧理论知识以及该领域研究发展的最新成果，达到了解和掌握焊接电弧基础理论、电弧特性、各种焊接方法、实际应用等方面知识的目的。本课程既非常注重基础理论的讲授，又特别关注理论知识和工程实际的联系和运用，既要培养学生的创造性思维，又要培养工程思维和解决实际问题的能力。另外，课程还特别注重跟踪国际先进焊接方法，及时更新教学内容，开拓学生视野。 课程重点阐述电弧的本质、物理过程及物理现象，阐述电弧的热源和力源特性，以及电弧的静特性、动特性、磁场变化及影响因素。学习直流电弧、交流电弧、等离子电弧、脉冲电弧、高频电弧、熔化极电弧、非熔化极电弧的特点与应用。学习钨极氩弧焊、熔化极氩弧焊、CO2电弧焊、混合气体保护电弧焊、等离子弧焊接、埋弧焊几种主要的焊接方法的技术基础。学习钨极电弧特性、焊丝熔化特性和熔滴过渡及其控制，介绍技术和学术上的最新研究进展，学习焊缝的形成规律及焊接缺陷的产生原因和防止措施，讲述高效焊接方法，开拓学生创造性思维。
default.en: "Welding Methods and Equipment" is one of the main courses of Welding Technology and Engineering undergraduate department. The course mainly introduces the principle, characteristics and features of the arc and specific welding methods. The purpose of the course is enable the students to understand and master the basic theory of welding arc, various welding methods and practical application etc. This course pays great attention to the teaching of basic theories, and pays special attention to the connection and application of theoretical knowledge and engineering practice. The course should train students' creative thinking and cultivate the ability of engineering thinking and problem solving. The course also pays special attention to tracking international advanced welding methods, updating teaching contents and developing students' knowledge. This course mainly teaches the knowledge including characteristics, physical process and phenomena of arc plasma, heat source and force source of arc plasma, static and dynamic characteristics, arc magnetic and its effects. The features and applications of DC arc, AC arc, plasma arc, pulsed arc, high frequency arc, melting electrode arc, no-melting electrode arc are highlighted. The technical basis of GTAW, MIG/MAG, PAW, SAW, and other arc welding method is given. The features of tungsten arc, wire melting and metal transfer and control are taught. Developing prospects in technical and academic are introduced. The reasons of forming principle and weld defects as well as high efficiency welding methods are introduced. The creative ideas of students are encouraged.

The course mainly introduces the principle, characteristics and features of the arc and specific welding methods. The purpose of the course is enable the students to understand and master the basic theory of welding arc, various welding methods and practical application etc. This course pays great attention to the teaching of basic theories, and pays special attention to the connection and application of theoretical knowledge and engineering practice. The course should train students' creative thinking and cultivate the ability of engineering thinking and problem solving. The course also pays special attention to tracking international advanced welding methods, updating teaching contents and developing students' knowledge. default.zh: 本课程是焊接技术与工程专业的一门核心专业课程，又是一门多学科交叉课程，是所有焊接技术问题及90%工程结构服役可靠性分析研究的基础，具有普适性。 课程学习的主要内容包括：焊接热过程、焊接应力与变形、焊接接头的力学不均匀性、焊接结构的脆性断裂、焊接结构疲劳强度共6个部分，使学生对焊接应力及变形产生原理、影响与控制方法等方面的基础知识有深刻了解，能够灵活运用所学的知识独立进行典型结构的受力分析和失效情况预测，掌握焊接结构脆性断裂的特征和应对策略，掌握影响焊接结构疲劳性能的主要因素及如何提高其疲劳强度的方法。本课程的特点是理论深入、逻辑严谨，并且与其他学科和工程实际密切联系。通过本课程的学习，为今后从事焊接技术与工程等方面的工作和科学研究奠定较为扎实的基础，培养学生灵活运用知识能力，为解决工程焊接结构受力分析、断裂与强度方面的实际问题提供专业思路。
default.en: This is a core professional course in welding technology and engineering, as well as an interdisciplinary course, which is the basis for all welding technology issues and 90% service reliability analysis about engineering structures, with universal applicability. The main content of the course includes 6 parts: welding thermal process, welding stress and deformation, mechanical inhomogeneity of welded joints, brittle fracture of welded structures, and fatigue strength of welded structures. It enables students to have a deep understanding of the basic knowledge of the generation principle, influence and control method of welding stress and deformation, and be able to flexibly apply the knowledge independently to stress analysis and failure prediction of typical structures, master the characteristics and strategies of brittle fracture of welded structures, as well as the main factors affecting the fatigue performance of welded structures and fatigue strength improving method. This course is characterized by its theoretical depth, rigorous logic, as well as close contact with other disciplines and engineering practice. The study of this course could lay a more solid foundation in welding technology and engineering for future work and scientific research, also can train students to utilize the knowledge to carry out engineering welded structure stress analysis and provide professional ideas to solve practical fracture strength issues.

default.zh: 焊接冶金学是高等学校焊接专业的一门核心主干课程，主要任务是通过课堂教学培养学生创新性思维、综合分析能力、科学研究能力和工程实践能力，支撑毕业要求中相应指标点的达成。课程目标是使学生掌握焊接冶金过程的基本理论和基本知识，具有分析材料焊接性、制定焊接工艺方案以及撰写总结报告的综合能力。教学内容涉及焊接冶金和焊接性两个方面，主要讲授熔焊条件下的冶金理论，分析典型材料的焊接性。具体内容包括焊接术语，焊接材料，焊接化学冶金，接头的组织和性能，焊接缺陷及其控制，焊接性及其试验方法，典型材料的焊接性分析及焊接工艺要点。
default.en: Welding metallurgy is one of the basic and core courses for welding specialty in the institution of higher education. The primary mission is to train students’ abilities of innovative thinking, comprehensive analysis, scientific research and engineering practice by classroom teaching, and so as to meet the requirements for corresponding graduation indexes. The course objective is to make students grasp the basic theory and elementary knowledge of welding metallurgic process, and possess the comprehensive abilities of materials weldability analysis, welding technology design, and consolidated report writing. The teaching contents in this course are involved in the two aspects. One is welding metallurgic theory under the conditions of fusion welding, and the other is weldability analysis of typical materials. The detailed contents include welding nomenclature, welding materials, welding chemical metallurgy, microstructure and properties of joints, formation mechanism and control of welding defects, material weldability and its testing means, and weldability analysis and technological focus on the typical materials.

default.zh: 《焊接基础实验》是以焊接冶金学、焊接结构学等课程为基础的一门焊接专业实验课，重点培养学生的综合分析和解决问题的能力和专业实验技能，是焊接专业本科生毕业从事焊接研究和工程技术工作的实践基础。本课程实验32学时。以焊接性分析、接头组织观察、应力和变形的测量与控制、焊接质量评价的一系列实验过程，完成焊接基础实验综合训练。在此基础上，提供部分先进焊接方法的实践教学。
default.en: Fundamental Welding Experiments is an experimental course of welding, based on courses of Welding Metallurgy, Mechanics of Welding Structure. This course aims to develop the students’ ability of analyzing and solving problems and their experimental skills in their specialty. This is the practical foundation for the graduates to work on welding research or welding engineering. The required experiments in this course are of 32 hours. Weldability analysis, microstructure observation of the joint, measurement and control of welding stress and deformation, and welding quality evaluation will be carried out to fulfill the training. Moreover, some certain advanced welding methods practical training are provide.

default.zh: 电子封装基础实验是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，主干专业课程的配套实验课程，有助于加强教学效果，对专业基础知识的巩固、拓展。主要培养学生工程知识学习能力，问题分析能力，设计/开发解决方案能力以及探索新工艺、新材料、新方法的创新能力。课程内容由LED芯片键合及推力测试；LED内引线键合及拉力测试；LED灯混合电路组装工艺实验；LED灯外引线微电阻焊工艺实验；自动贴片演示实验；激光焊接实验；红外热像焊点缺陷测量实验等专业基础实验组成，要求学生掌握电子封装专业课程的基础知识，实验的目的、原理及方法；能够熟练应用现代工具处理实验数据，采用图表规范表达实验结果，熟练使用作图软件。
default.en: Basic Experiment of Electronic Packaging is an elective course of electronic packaging technology specialty, and the supporting experiment course of main specialized courses will help to strengthen teaching effect and consolidate and expand the basic knowledge of specialty. Mainly train students' engineering knowledge, learning ability, problem analysis ability, design / development solution ability, and explore new process, new materials, new methods of innovation ability. The course content is composed of LED die bonding and thrust test; LED wire bonding and pull test; LED SMT and through-hole assembly; LED pin micro resistance welding experiment; automatic die bonding; laser solding; infrared solder defect measurement; of 6 interconnect technology professional basic experiment, students are required to master the basic knowledge of electronic packaging professional course, purpose, principle and method of experiment; be proficient in application of modern tools to deal with experimental data, using charts and regulate the expression of the experimental results, the skilled use of graphics software.

default.zh: 电子封装可靠性是电子封装技术专业的主干课程，其目的是使本专业学生熟练掌握可靠性特征量的基本概念、寿命试验统计分析和相关统计检验的概念和方法；掌握电子器件及组件的失效率试验、寿命试验、加速试验、可靠性增长试验的原理和方法以及可靠性基础试验；掌握电子封装失效与环境应力之间的关系、失效的物理本质和失效物理模型。
default.en: Reliability of electronic packaging is the main course of electronic packaging technology. Its purpose is to make the students of this major proficient in the basic concept of reliability characteristic quantity, the concept and method of statistical analysis of life test and related statistical test; to master the principle and method of failure rate test, life test, acceleration test, reliability growth test and reliability basic test of electronic devices and components; to master the relationship between electronic packaging failure and environmental stress, the physical nature of failure and physical model of failure.

default.zh: 半导体器件物理是电子封装技术专业的专业基础课程，课程的主要内容包括: 半导体能带、载流子浓度及输运特性等半导体的基本性质；半导体器件的基本构件特征，如p-n结特性、金属-半导体接触以及MIS电容等；双极晶体管、各种MOS场效应晶体管、各种负阻和功率器件、光学器件以及传感器等半导体器件的物理特性、工作原理以及主要应用等。通过对半导体器件物理课程的学习，学生将对各种半导体器件的物理性质相当的了解，能够利用相关的物理、电学基本原理对诸如MIS, BJT, MOSFE等半导体器件进行分析和设计。
default.en: The physics of semiconductor devices is a basic course of electronic packaging technology subject. The main contents of this course include: the basic properties of semiconductor, including semiconductor band, carriers concentration and transport characteristics, etc; the basic structural characteristics of semiconductor devices, such as p-n characteristics, metal-semiconductor contact and MIS capacitance, etc; the physical properties of semiconductor devices, working principle and main application of the semiconductor devices, including the bipolar transistors, MOS field effect transistors, various negative resistance and power devices, optical devices and sensors, etc. After attending the course students should have detailed knowledge of the physical properties of the semiconductor and be able to analyze & design a range of semiconductor devices, including MIS, BJT, MOSFET etc, using relevant physical/electrical engineering principles.

default.zh: 微连接是电子封装的核心技术，电子封装结构的发展依赖于微互连技术的进步。微连接原理与方法是电子封装技术专业的基础课程，课程目标如下：（1）使本专业学生了解电子封装微连接所涉及到材料、结构的特殊性、微互连方法的特殊性和对微互连可靠性的特殊要求；（2）了解与各种微连接方法相关的焊接方法（如固相焊、钎焊、熔化焊）的基本原理，以及与微连接方法的区别；（3）熟练掌握超声引线键合、微软钎焊、熔化微连接、粘接的基本原理和工艺特性；（4）理解电子封装中微连接失效机理、缺陷及检测、可靠性（热疲劳、电迁移等）及质量控制方法；（5）熟悉电子封装和制造中前沿互连技术（晶圆键合、三维封装TSV键合等）的基本原理、工艺方法和应用；（6）掌握不同能量场（光、电、热）作用下纳米连接的特殊性和在器件领域的前沿应用。本课程将通过课堂教学、课堂作业、项目研究等环节培养学生的创新意识、运用电子制造和材料加工方面的知识解决电子封装行业中微互连的实际问题，以及分析和解决电子封装微互连工程实践问题的创新意识和创新设计能力，为学生今后在电子封装领域的工作和深造奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Micro-connection is the core technology of electronic packaging, and the development of electronic packaging structure depends on the progress of micro-interconnection technology. The “Micro/nano-joining Principle and Methods” is the basic courses of electronic packaging technology. In general, seven levels of understanding are desirable for students: 1)The important role of the interconnection technologies that play in the manufacturing of the integrated circuits and electronic packaging devices, and the special demands in materials, structures and reliability for the micro-interconnections in electronic packaging . 2)The principle of the welding methods such as solid state bonding, soldering, and molten welding, and the differences between the interconnection technologies and traditional welding technologies. 3)Basic principle of the microjoining methods such as ultrasonic wire bonding, micro-soldering, micro-welding, adhesive bonding applied in the integrated circuits and electronic packaging devices. 4) Reliability and failure mechanisms of the micro-interconnections such as thermal fatigue and electro-migrigation. 5) The advanced electronic packaging technologies such as wafer bonding, TSV bonding, and their development trends in electronic packaging and manufacturing. 6) Nanonojoining methods under light, thermal and electrical field, and their cutting edge application in nano devices. The objectives of this course are to provide detailed information and theoretical understanding of the important interconnection technologies as applied to manufacturing of the integrated circuits and electronic packaging device, to broaden the knowledge for the students majoring in materials science and engineering, and to build the solid background for the students who will enter in the new field of the manufacturing of integrated circuits and microelectronic assembly.

default.zh: 电子封装结构与设计是电子封装技术专业的核心课程，在培养学生工程知识学习能力，问题分析能力以及科研能力方面占有重要的地位。本课程设置的目的是使本专业学生掌握典型的塑料、陶瓷、金属、薄膜、圆片级，以及三维封装的结构、工艺过程和各关键封装技术，掌握电子封装结构设计原理，了解封装、组装、微组装、多芯片封装以及微系统封装的基本概念。使学生具备典型封装结构及设计解析能力，以及复杂结构封装流程进行分析和设计的能力。课程最后的成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、作业、研究报告和期末考试。
default.en: Structure and Design of Electronic Packaging is a core course of electronic packaging technology major, it plays an important role in training students' engineering knowledge learning ability, problem analysis ability and research ability. its purpose is to make the students grasp the typical packaging structure of electric devices and components, such as plastic packaging, ceramic packaging, metal packaging, thin film packaging, wafer level packaging and 3D packaging, and grasp the packaging process and key packaging technology of the devices and components, and know well the principle of structural design of electronic devices and components, and then understand the basic concept of packaging, assembly, micro-assembly, multi-chip packaging and micro-system packaging. The students will have the ability to analyze and design the typical packaging structure, and have the ability to design and analyze complex packaging structures and processes. Final result of this course is accumulative type, including performance, assignment, research reports and a final exam.

default.zh: 电子封装结构与设计是电子封装技术专业的核心课程，在培养学生工程知识学习能力，问题分析能力以及科研能力方面占有重要的地位。本课程设置的目的是使本专业学生掌握典型的塑料、陶瓷、金属、薄膜、圆片级，以及三维封装的结构、工艺过程和各关键封装技术，掌握电子封装结构设计原理，了解封装、组装、微组装、多芯片封装以及微系统封装的基本概念。使学生具备典型封装结构及设计解析能力，以及复杂结构封装流程进行分析和设计的能力。课程最后的成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、作业、研究报告和期末考试。
default.en: Structure and Design of Electronic Packaging is a core course of electronic packaging technology major, it plays an important role in training students' engineering knowledge learning ability, problem analysis ability and research ability. its purpose is to make the students grasp the typical packaging structure of electric devices and components, such as plastic packaging, ceramic packaging, metal packaging, thin film packaging, wafer level packaging and 3D packaging, and grasp the packaging process and key packaging technology of the devices and components, and know well the principle of structural design of electronic devices and components, and then understand the basic concept of packaging, assembly, micro-assembly, multi-chip packaging and micro-system packaging. The students will have the ability to analyze and design the typical packaging structure, and have the ability to design and analyze complex packaging structures and processes. Final result of this course is accumulative type, including performance, assignment, research reports and a final exam.

default.zh: 微电子制造技术是电子封装技术专业的专业基础课程。主要介绍微电子制造工艺过程引论；硅衬底，氧化与扩散，离子注入与快速热处理，光刻，刻蚀，薄膜工艺，包括物理淀积（蒸发与溅射）、化学气相淀积和气相外延，以及工艺集成等。使本专业学生掌握微电子制造技术的基本原理，熟悉半导体集成电路的基本制造过程、了解微电子制造技术的发展趋势。培养学生工程知识学习能力，问题分析能力以及终身学习能力。
default.en: Microelectronic Manufacturing Technology is a fundamental course in the field of electronic packaging technology. It primarily introduces the introduction to microelectronic manufacturing processes; silicon substrates, oxidation and diffusion, ion implantation and rapid thermal processing, lithography, etching, thin film processes, including physical deposition (evaporation and sputtering), chemical vapor deposition, and vapor phase epitaxy, as well as process integration. This course enables students in the field to grasp the basic principles of microelectronic manufacturing technology, become familiar with the fundamental manufacturing processes of semiconductor integrated circuits, and understand the development trends of microelectronic manufacturing technology. It cultivates students' abilities in engineering knowledge learning, problem analysis, and lifelong learning.

default.zh: 微纳加工涉及材料在微米、纳米等多尺度的加工技术，广泛应用于物理、化学、材料、电子、机械和生物等各种学科，是电子封装技术专业的必修课程。本课程通过课堂教学及项目研究等环节使学生熟练掌握各种典型微纳加工技术的基本原理与方法，培训学生将所学的微纳加工知识应用于先进的电子/机械/生物医疗等制造领域，锻炼学生能利用文献检索获取微纳加工技术发展的趋势和最新动态，培养主动学习的意识。课程主要内容包括：传统光学曝光技术、电子束曝光技术、聚焦离子束曝光技术、扫描探针加工技术、微纳米尺度的复制技术、各种沉积法与刻蚀法图形转移技术、间接纳米加工技术与自组装纳米加工技术。
default.en: Micro and nanofabrication is related to materials processing in multiple micro and nano scales. These fabrication technologies are extensively applied in physics, chemistry, materials, electronics, mechanics, biology, and interdisciplinary fields. This course is a required course in electronic packaging technology specialty. Through the classroom teaching and research projects, students will master the fundamental principles of typical micro-nano fabrication methods and train students to apply micro-nano fabrication knowledge in advanced electronic/mechanical/ biomedical and other manufacturing fields. Also, this course will guide students to obtain the state-of-the-art micro- and nanofabrication technologies and their trends from the latest literature, cultivating the consciousness of active learning. The course mainly includes: conventional optical lithography, electron beam lithography, focused ion beam lithography, fabrication using scanning probe microscopy, micro-nanoimprint lithography, pattern transfer using various deposition and etching methods, indirect nanofabrication, self-assembly nanofabrication technologies.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向材料物理等相关专业学生，以固态相变原理为中心，从材料热力学、动力学的基本概念和原理入手，讲授热平衡条件和非热平衡条件下的材料的相变和组织结构演化、相变的起源、特征与分类、非匀相相变的形核理论、长大和粗化过程的热力学和动力学、典型的形核长大类型相变实例、调幅分解的热力学条件及其解释、马氏体相变的热力学、动力学和晶体学，以及近现代相变理论的发展等方面的内容，使学生掌握材料热力学与相变原理相关的思维方法，深刻认识材料微观组织结构形成的物理本质，理解和掌握相变的基本概念、基本原理及公式的演绎过程和计算方法，了解与本学科相关的相变领域的前沿研究方向，培养材料研究的科学研究方法的训练和逻辑思维能力，并能够结合具体条件应用材料热力学与相变原理解决材料科学和工程中的实际问题，为从事材料科学研究和工程技术工作打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: This course mainly includes materials thermodynamics and phase transformation principles for the undergraduates in the major of Materials Physics and Chemistry. The lecture refers to different aspects of phase transformation but centers on the thermodynamics, kinetics and crystallographic of solid-state phase transformation. The basic contents of the course include phase transformation and microstructure evolution during thermal equilibrium and non- equilibrium conditions, origin, characterization and classification of transformation, nucleation-growth-coarsening-formal theory of kinetics, typical nucleation-growth phase transformation in materials, the theory of Spinodal decomposition, the thermodynamics, kinetics and crystallographic of martensite transformation and the recent development of the transformation theory. The lecture focuses on the interpretation of physical nature and mathematical description of phase transformation, the factors controlling microstructure and connection between microstructure and property. The purpose aims to conduct students to understand microstructural features of materials more in-depth, to train the ability of scientific research methods and logical thinking ability of materials research, and to solve the practical problems in material science and engineering for their future studies.

default.zh: 本课程为材料物理专业的一门基础课，以大学化学和材料化学基础为基础，主要论述有机化合物的结构、性质、表征及制备方法，是材料物理专业核心课程之一，是材料领域中材料合成及高分子材料的基础，在材料物理专业的教学中占有重要的地位。有机化学主要讲授脂肪烃，芳香烃，有机含卤化合物，有机含氧化合物，有机含氮化合物和杂环化合物的构造异构、命名、结构、物理性质和化学性质；红外光谱的基本原理和有机化合物的特征吸收峰，核磁共振的基本原理和有机化合物的化学位移；自由基反应机理，亲电加成反应机理，亲电取代反应机理和亲核取代反应机理。有机化学主要在于培养学生掌握有机化合物的结构、性质和反应机理，了解有机化合物的分离、提纯和鉴定方法，使学生具备从事材料研究开发、生产及检测的基本技能。同时，使学生具有分析并解决复杂材料工程问题的能力，从事有机化合物结构设计、生产工艺设计及材料制备工艺设计的能力，自主学习以适应材料领域快速发展的能力等。
default.en: This course is a basic course for students of materials physics, on the basis of university chemistry and the basic of materials chemistry. As one of main courses, the course mainly introduce the structure, properties, characterization and preparation methods of organic compounds. It takes an important position in the courses of materials physics and helps students to learn the synthesis of materials and polymer. The contents of organic chemistry are the structure, naming, physical properties and chemical properties of fat hydrocarbon, aromatic hydrocarbon, organic halogen compounds, organic oxygen-containing compounds, the organic nitrogen compounds, and heterocyclic compounds. The basic principle of infrared spectrum and the characteristic absorption peak of organic compound, the basic principle of nuclear magnetic resonance and the chemical displacement of organic compounds are included in the course. Free radical reaction mechanism, electrophilic addition reaction mechanism, electrophilic substitution reaction mechanism and nucleophilic substitution mechanism are also introduced. The target of organic chemistry is to cultivate students to master the structure and properties of organic compounds and reaction mechanism, and to understand the separation, purification and identification of organic compounds, so that the students have engaged in research and development, production and testing of materials. At the same time, the students will have the ability to analyze and solve complex problems in materials engineering, structure design of organic compound, production process design and independent learning, which will make them adapt to the rapid development in the field of materials science.

default.zh: 材料物理性能是高等工科院校材料物理专业主干课程之一，它以大学物理、大学物理实验和材料物理基础为前置课程，主要论述材料的基本物理性能的分析方法和测试技术，其教学目的是使同学们掌握以电、光、磁、热以及内耗等为代表的物理性能的本质、影响因素以及测试原理与方法，能够利用材料物理性能，针对工程问题，基于数学、物理化学和工程科学的基本原理进行合理分析，识别和判断工程问题中的关键环节，能够在工程实践中依据不同的工程需要，通过合理选择物理性能参量，为工程结构选择合适的材料体系。同时，使得学生初步具备利用材料物理性能参数研究材料内部组织结构的能力，能够对物理性能变换的物理本质进行初步的分析，能够运用物理参数的变化研究材料内部组织结构的演化规律，使学生具备从事材料物理性能的测试与分析的试验理论基础，同时能够理解材料开发、生产、应用过程中各环节的相互影响，能够初步提出材料选择方案，这两种能力的培养可以为学生未来从事现代结构材料和功能材料的研究与应用奠定理论和实验技术基础。
default.en: Materials Physical Properties is one of the main courses for the students major in Material Physics in engineering colleges. Based on the three courses (the collegial physics, collegial physics experiment and fundamentals of materials physics, it mainly discusses the analysis methods and testing technologies of basic physical properties of materials. The purpose of course is to make the students master the nature, influencing factors and testing principles and methods of physical properties, such as electricity, optical, magnetism, thermal and elastic as well as internal friction, and make reasonable analysis of engineering problems based on the fundamental principles of mathematics, physical chemistry and engineering science by using the physical properties of materials, identify and judge the key links in engineering problems. By studying this course, the students can choose the appropriate material system for engineering structure through reasonable selection of physical property parameters to meet the different engineering practice. At the same time, it enables students to preliminarily acquire the ability to study the internal organizational structure of materials by using the physical property parameters of materials, conduct a preliminary analysis of the physical nature of physical property transformation, and study the microstructure evolution by using the measurement of physical parameters, thus providing students with the experimental theoretical basis for testing and analyzing the physical properties of materials. Moreover, students can understand the internal links in the process of material development, production and application, and can initially propose material selection schemes. The cultivation of these two abilities can lay the theoretical and experimental technical foundation for the students who engage in the research and application of modern structural materials and functional materials.

default.zh: 计算材料学是材料物理本科专业的一门专业基础课，其目的是要求学生在掌握材料物理基本知识的基础上，掌握材料计算、模拟和设计的基本理论与方法。本课程包括基于密度泛函理论的第一性原理计算、分子动力学模拟、蒙特卡洛模拟和有限元模拟。 要求学生掌握从材料基态模拟、过程模拟、组织模拟及宏观模拟的基本思路和方法，掌握多尺度材料设计和模拟的思路与理论方法。
default.en: “Computational Materials” is one of fundamental and technique courses for the undergraduate students majoring in materials physics, it aims to let students well understand the basic theories and methods for materials design on the basis of the learning of fundamental knowledge of materials physics. The course is composed of First Principle calculation, Molecular dynamics simulation, Monte Carlo simulation and finite element simulation. The students should well understand the basic approaches and methods of ground state, process, and microstructure simulations, and multi-scale simulation theories and methods.

default.zh: 功能材料学B是本专业的重要材料类通识课，主要介绍电学功能材料、光学功能材料、磁学功能材料、热学功能材料、力学功能材料以及功能复合材料相关基础知识、工作原理、性能特点和应用实例，培养学生针对工程使用要求和研究背景需求，综合分析和选择特定功能材料的能力。主要目的是使学生了解和掌握各类功能材料特性、应用及最新进展，为学生从事功能材料方面的科学研究和工作打下良好基础。
default.en: Functional Materials Science B is an important general course.The main content of this course include the introduction of the basic knowledge, operating principle, characteristics and application of multiple functional materials, such as electronic functional materials, optical functional materials, magnetic functional material, thermal functional material, mechanical functional materials and functional composite materials, training the ability of comprehensive analysis and selecting a specific functional materials directed at the engineering application and research background requirements. The purpose of this course is to make the undergraduate students understand and master the characteristics and application of functional material, as well as the recent advances, lay the good foundation for the students taking on the research of functional material.

default.zh: 半导体物理是研究半导体原子状态和电子状态以及各种半导体器件内部电子过程的科学，是光电信息材料与器件专业本科生所必须掌握的专业基础知识，也是后续专业课程学习的基础。《半导体物理学》是一门基础理论知识与实际应用紧密关联的课程，《半导体物理学》课程将全面地论述半导体物理的基础知识，授课内容包括半导体的晶格结构、半导体中的电子状态、杂质和缺陷能级、载流子的统计分布，非平衡载流子及载流子的运动规律；讨论了p—n结、异质结、金属半导体接触、表面及MIS结构等半导体表面和界面问题；介绍了半导体的光学性质和光电效应等物理现象。通过课程学习，使学生掌握并深刻理解课程中涉及的半导体物理基本概念、理论和方法，以及增强解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Semiconductor physics is a science that studies the atomic state and electronic state of semiconductors and the internal electronic processes of various semiconductor devices. It is the professional basic knowledge that undergraduates majoring in optoelectronic informational materials and devices must learn, and it is also the basis for subsequent professional courses. " The Physics of Semiconductors " is a course closely related to basic theoretical knowledge and practical application. The course " The Physics of Semiconductors" will comprehensively discuss the basic knowledge of semiconductor physics. The teaching content includes the lattice structure of semiconductors, electronic states in semiconductors, Impurity and defect energy levels, statistical distribution of carriers, non-equilibrium carriers and the law of carrier movement; discuss p-n junctions, heterojunctions, metal-semiconductor contacts, surfaces and MIS structures and other semiconductor surfaces and interfaces; physical phenomena such as the optical properties of semiconductors and the photoelectric effect are introduced. Through course study, it will enable students to master and deeply understand the basic concepts, theories and methods of semiconductor physics involved in the course, and enhance the ability to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 半导体物理是研究半导体原子状态和电子状态以及各种半导体器件内部电子过程的科学，是光电信息材料与器件专业本科生所必须掌握的专业基础知识，也是后续专业课程学习的基础。《半导体物理学》是一门基础理论知识与实际应用紧密关联的课程，《半导体物理学》课程将全面地论述半导体物理的基础知识，授课内容包括半导体的晶格结构、半导体中的电子状态、杂质和缺陷能级、载流子的统计分布，非平衡载流子及载流子的运动规律；讨论了p—n结、异质结、金属半导体接触、表面及MIS结构等半导体表面和界面问题；介绍了半导体的光学性质和光电效应等物理现象。通过课程学习，使学生掌握并深刻理解课程中涉及的半导体物理基本概念、理论和方法，以及增强解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Semiconductor physics is a science that studies the atomic state and electronic state of semiconductors and the internal electronic processes of various semiconductor devices. It is the professional basic knowledge that undergraduates majoring in optoelectronic informational materials and devices must learn, and it is also the basis for subsequent professional courses. " The Physics of Semiconductors " is a course closely related to basic theoretical knowledge and practical application. The course " The Physics of Semiconductors" will comprehensively discuss the basic knowledge of semiconductor physics. The teaching content includes the lattice structure of semiconductors, electronic states in semiconductors, Impurity and defect energy levels, statistical distribution of carriers, non-equilibrium carriers and the law of carrier movement; discuss p-n junctions, heterojunctions, metal-semiconductor contacts, surfaces and MIS structures and other semiconductor surfaces and interfaces; physical phenomena such as the optical properties of semiconductors and the photoelectric effect are introduced.
