Through course study, it will enable students to master and deeply understand the basic concepts, theories and methods of semiconductor physics involved in the course, and enhance the ability to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 光电材料与应用是光电信息材料与器件专业的核心课程之一。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握光电材料的基本知识、光电材料的制备方法及相关应用，培养学生科学思维和分析、解决光电信息领域相关问题的基本能力和素质。 本课程内容主要介绍光电材料的基本性质、制备方法、结构表征、特性测试及相关应用。主要内容包括：半导体基础知识、磁控溅射、物理及化学气相沉积法及多种低维材料制备方法，光催化、光电探测器等相关应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生对光电材料制备技术和应用有更好、更深入的理解，为后续专业课程的学习打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: The Optoelectronic Materials and Applications is a core course for the students of Optoelectronic Information Materials and Devices. By learning this course, the students can acquire much knowledge of optoelectronic materials, including the basic principals, preparation method and the application of optoelectronic materials preparation and fundamental experimental ability. What's more, it can also enhance the students'capacity of logical analyzing and ability to solve practical problems in the field of optoelectronic information functional materials. The course contents introduce basic principles, preparation methods, characterization of optoelectronic materials and applications. It contains: semiconductors physics theory, magnetron sputtering, physical vapor deposition, chemical vapor deposition and various nanomaterial preparation methods, photocatalysis, photodetectors, and so on. Through the study of the course, students would develop a better and in-depth understanding of the preparation methods and applications with photoelectric materials, which serves as a solid foundation for the learning of further relevant specialized courses.

default.zh: 量子力学是近代物理两大支柱之一，是近代光学技术的重要基础，因而本课是光电专业一门重要的专业必修课。本课程将在量子力学基础B的基础上，以专题的形式介绍角动量理论，近似方法，量子散射理论，量子多体理论。通过本课学习，应使学生：进一步加深对非相对论量子力学理论的理解；培养辩证唯物主义的世界观和科学的方法论。
default.en: Quantum mechanics is one of the two main pillars of modern physics and an important foundation for modern optical technology. Therefore, this course is a required core course for the Photonics major. Building on Fundamentals of Quantum Mechanics B, this course will introduce topics such as angular momentum theory, approximation methods, quantum scattering theory, and quantum many-body theory. Through this course, students should: further deepen their understanding of non-relativistic quantum mechanics theory, and cultivate a dialectical materialist worldview and scientific methodology.

default.zh: 半导体器件物理B课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22MS31804B 课程名称： 半导体器件物理B 总学时： 48 理论学时： 48 实验学时： 0 上机学时： 0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时： 0 学分：3 开课单位：材料科学与工程学院光电信息材料与器件系 授课对象：光电信息材料与器件专业 开课学期：3春 先修课程：凝聚态物理学A,凝聚态物理学B，量子力学基础,量子力学B，热力学与统计物理，大学物理D，固体物理，半导体物理学 二、课程简介 本课程是光电信息科学及其相关专业学生必须掌握的专业基础课之一，本课程主要介绍半导体功能器件所涉及的物理问题， 包含半导体器件的材料，结构和工作原理等问题。具体内容包括：半导体物理、P-N结二极管、金属-半导体接触、金属-绝缘体-半导体电容、双极晶体管、MOS场效应晶体管、JFET，MESZFET和MODFET器件、发光二极管和半导体激光器、光电探测器和太阳电池。通过本课程的学习, 掌握半导体器件物理和原理方面的基础知识,具有对半导体器件工作原理进行分析的能力、了解材料和工艺对器件性能的影响；学到有关知识与技能，结合实践教学环节，进行光电信息科学与工程专业工程技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事光电信息科学方面的工作打下基础。 撰写人： 王东博 审核人： 王金忠 日 期：2023年3月5日
default.en: Introduction to Semiconductor Device Physics B 1.General Information Course Code： 22MS31804B Course Title： Physics of Semiconductor Devices B Credit Hours： 48 Lecture： 48 Lab： 0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 3 Offering Department: Photoelectric information materials and devices Department School/Division of： Department of Optoelectronic Information Science, School of Materials Science and Engineering Students: Photoelectric information materials and devices Term: Third Spring Prerequisites: Condensed Matter Physics A, Condensed Matter Physics B, Fundamentals of Quantum Mechanics, Quantum Mechanics B, Thermodynamic and Statistical Physics, University Physics D, Solid State Physics, Semiconductor Physics 2.Course Description This course is one of the basic courses that students of optoelectronic information science and its related majors must master. This course mainly introduces the physical problems involved in semiconductor functional devices, including the material, structure and working principle of semiconductor devices. Specific topics include: semiconductor physics, P-N junction diodes, metal-semiconductor contacts, metal-insulator-semiconductor capacitors, bipolar transistors, MOS field effect transistors, JFET, MESZFET, and MODFET devices, light-emitting diode and semiconductor lasers, photodetectors, and solar cells. Through the study of this course, I will master the basic knowledge of the physics and principles of semiconductor devices, have the ability to analyze the working principles of semiconductor devices, and understand the influence of materials and processes on the performance of devices. Learn the relevant knowledge and skills, combined with practical teaching, to carry out the basic training required for engineering technicians in optoelectronic information science and engineering, to lay the foundation for students to further study the relevant professional courses and engage in optoelectronic information science in the future. Author: wang dongbo Reviewer： wang jinzhong Date：2023/3/5

default.zh: 对本科学生介绍现代光谱技术的基本概念、检测方法及其应用，包括各种光谱产生的物理根源、检测手段和仪器及光谱学在不同学科的应用。要求学生掌握各种光谱技术的原理，对各类检测方法有较全面的了解，在今后的科研工作中能够将光谱学知识应用于自己的研究。本课程主要阐述光谱学的基本概念、原理和应用。
default.en: This course provides an introduction to an overview of basic concept about modern spectroscopy technique, testing and applications, including basic theory of different spectroscopy, testing methods, related equipments and spectroscopy applications in wide fields. The subjects requests students understand the basic theory of spectroscopy techniques and different testing method and applies spectroscopy knowledge to their future research. This course covers the spectroscopy theory, equipments, spectroscopy testing technique and laser spectroscopy technique.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授构成光电探测系统的核心部件（光源、光电信号调制器件及光电探测器件）的构造原理、光电特性及器件结构与功能的关系。课程内容包括光辐射度量学基本规律和物理量，热辐射光源和气体放电光源及发光二极管（LED），受激辐射光源（激光器、半导体LD），光电调制原理与器件（光调制器、电光调制器），光电探测原理与器件（探测器的性能参数、探测器的噪声、热探测器和光子探测器），光电探测方式与探测系统（双元和多元探及列阵测器构造原理、相干探测方法及直接探测系统的组成）。
default.en: This course is mainly composed of the core components of the photoelectric detection system (light source, photoelectric signal modulation device and photoelectric detection device) structure principle, characteristics and the relationship between the photoelectric device structure and function. The contents of the course include optical radiometry basic rules and physical quantity, the thermal radiation light source，gas discharge light source，light emitting diode (LED) and stimulated radiation light source (laser, semiconductor LD), the principle of optical modulation and modulators (light modulator, electro-optic modulator), photoelectric detection principle and devices ( performance parameters, detection noise, pyroelectric detectors and photon detectors), photoelectric detection mode and detection system (the structure principle of dual and multiple detection and Array detection ,the coherent detection method and direct detection system ).

default.zh: 《光纤基础》课在介绍当前光纤研究与应用进展的基础上，系统讲述了光在光纤中传输的基本原理、光纤的分类、主要特性和制备方法、及一些典型特种光纤应用的基础知识，并通过实验设计使学生掌握光纤传输损耗系数的测试技能。该课程是为光电信息材料与器件及相关专业本科生在大三学年开设的一门专业课程。
default.en: On the basis of introducing the current research and application progress of optical fiber, the course of "Fundamentals of Optical Fiber" systematically describes the basic principle of optical fiber transmission in optical fiber, the classification, main characteristics and preparation methods of optical fiber, and the basic knowledge of some typical applications on special optical fibers. Furthermore, it makes students to master the testing skills of optical fiber transmission loss coefficient by the experiments. This is a professional course for undergraduate students majoring in Optoelectronic Information Materials and Devices, and related majors in the junior year.

default.zh: 《光电信息科学与工程综合实验》是一门光电信息材料与器件专业的实验课。本课程主要实验有磁控溅射法、溶液法制备光电材料；光电探测器的制备及性能测试。通过本课程的学习，培养学生的动手能力和实验技能，也为学生继续学习光电信息材料与器件打下了必要的基础。 本课程分几个不同的专题进行，每个专题安排4个学时
default.en: "The integrated experiments of optoelectronic information science and engineering" is an experimental course supporting for the optoelectronic information materials and devices. The contents introduce preparation of optoelectronic materials by the magnetron sputtering technique and solution method, preparation and performance testing of photodetectors, and so on. Through the study of the course, students would develop the manipulative ability and experiment skill. This course also prepares students for their further study of other courses related to optoelectronic information materials and devices. This course is composed of several sections covering the above mentioned topics, each section will need 4 class hours.

default.zh: 量子力学基础A是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门基础理论课程，主要描述微观物质（原子，亚原子粒子）的基本物理性质；它是许多工科大学材料学课程的基础，包括固体物理、材料物理性能、功能材料学、半导体材料及纳米材料等。 本课程的主要任务是培养学生具备量子物理方面的基本理念、基础理论背景，掌握微观物质主要是电子的基本物理规律，具备从量子力学的角度看待诸多物理学和材料学问题的能力，培养从事功能材料研究和器件设计的科研能力，同时为相关后续课程提供理论基础。 1、能够应用量子力学的知识并结合其它课程的知识解释材料中的声、光、热、电、磁等材料性能，并通过具体的计算模型分析和研究复杂的实际材料中遇到的工程问题，获得明确的科学结论。 2、够对基于量子力学的物理现象进行准确描述与简单的定性分析，并能使用中文撰写量子力学相关工程问题的研究报告。 3、通过量子力学的学习，培养抽象思维的能力，自主学习和量子力学有关的数学和现代物理思想，并能够和国内外同行进行相对深入的学术交流，获得不断学习和适应发展的能力。
default.en: Foundation of Quantum Mechanics A is a basic theoretical course for material science and engineering. It describes the basic physical properties of microscopic objects (atoms and subatomic particles). It is the foundation of many relative courses, including solid state physics, physical properties of materials, functional materials science, semiconductor materials and nano-materials. The main task of this course is to help students understand the basic concept, the background of quantum physics and the basic laws of microscopic objects (i.e. electrons). So one could be capable to regard the problems of physical and materials science from the quantum mechanics point of view. It also cultivate the ability of functional materials research and device design, providing theoretical basis for relevant follow-up courses at the same time. 1. Apply the knowledge of quantum mechanics and combine the knowledge of other courses to explain the properties of materials such as sound, light, heat, electricity and magnetism. Analyze and study the engineering problems encountered in complex practical materials through specific computational models, so as to obtain clear scientific conclusions. 2. Accurately describe and make simple qualitative analysis of physical phenomena based on quantum mechanics. Write research reports on engineering problems related to quantum mechanics in Chinese. 3. Through the study of quantum mechanics, cultivate the ability of abstract thinking. Learn mathematics and modern physics related to quantum mechanics on one's own, and have academic communications with foreign peers, so as to acquire the ability of learning and adaptation to development.

default.zh: 本课程通过材料多尺度计算模拟实际案例的引入及其与先修课程的融会贯通的启发式教学，使学生了解计算材料学的基本概念，克服对材料进行模拟计算的畏难情绪与习惯于“炒菜式”实验方法的惰性思维，着重了解和掌握第一性原理计算与新材料设计、分子力学和蒙特卡洛法与材料微观和介观结构模拟的理论基础、模拟计算方法。基于量子力学、牛顿力学和统计物理引入计算材料学的基本概念与基本方法，重点介绍第一性原理、分子动力学与蒙特卡洛法等计算模拟技术在材料科学与工程领域中的应用，促进学生进一步理解材料科学理论、模拟与实验的相互关系与融会贯通，激发学生采用计算模拟方法进行材料创新研究的兴趣。进一步深化材料学及相关学科的有关基本原理，开拓学生的创新思路和视野。旨在培养学生针对复杂材料工程问题，能够利用材料科学与工程基本原理进行合理分析，建立物理模型与数值计算模型；能够运用计算机软件进行原子和介观尺度材料微观结构模拟与设计，具有利用现代化信息技术与资源解决复杂材料工程问题的能力；能够正确组织语言，用汉语就专业领域的工程问题规范正确地撰写报告，并具有与同行进行学术交流的能力；具有自主学习和终身学习的意识。
default.en: Through the introduction of practical cases of multi-scale computational simulation of materials and its integration with the prerequisite courses, this course will enable students to understand the basic concepts of computational materials science, overcome the fear and inertia of the "frying pan" experimental approach to materials simulation, and focus on the understanding and mastery of the first principles of computation and new materials design, molecular mechanics and Monte Carlo methods and materials micro- and mesoscopic structure simulation. Theoretical foundations and computational methods for the design of new materials, molecular mechanics and Monte Carlo methods, and the simulation of micro- and mesoscopic structures of materials. This course introduces the basic concepts and methods of computational materials science based on quantum mechanics, Newtonian mechanics, and statistical physics, and focuses on the application of first principles, molecular dynamics, and Monte Carlo methods in materials science and engineering. To stimulate students' interest in innovative materials research using computer simulation methods. To further deepen the basic principles related to materials science and related disciplines, and to develop students' innovative ideas and perspectives. The aim is to train students to be able to use basic principles of materials science and engineering to conduct reasonable analysis and establish physical and numerical computational models for complex materials engineering problems; to be able to use computer software to simulate and design the microstructure of materials at atomic and mesoscopic scales, and to have the ability to use modern information technology and resources to solve complex materials engineering problems; to be able to organize language correctly and write reports in Chinese on engineering problems in their specialized fields. They should be able to write reports in Chinese on engineering problems and have the ability to communicate with peers; they should have the awareness of independent learning and lifelong learning.

default.zh: 复合材料原理是高等工科院校高分子材料工程专业复合材料研究方向的一门专业课程。本课程主要研究内容是复合材料中的材料设计原理，包括基体、增强体、功能体的结构与性能、界面结构与界面效应、复合后材料的物理及力学性能的一般规律。 复合材料原理是在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行高分子材料工程技术人员的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事高分子材料的加工工作打下基础，因此，在高分子材料工程专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和发挥着重要作用。
default.en: The Principle of Composites is a core subject of the required course for the students who major in the Polymer Materials Engineering in the university of engineering. The focus of The Principle of Composites is the principle theory of materials design, including matrix, reinforcement, structure and property of function bodies, the structure of interface and interfacial effect, the laws of physical and mechanical properties of composites. The Principle of Composites is a special major course for students major in Composites in the university of engineering, which comprehensively applying various relevant knowledge and skills with all kinds of experimental sectors to effectively lay the first stone for the forward studying and processing of polymer materials. Therefore, it plays a very important role in the teaching program of Polymer Materials Engineering.

default.zh: 复合材料力学与结构设计是高等工科院校聚合物基复合材料专业的一门专业课程，主要研究连续纤维增强聚合物基复合材料宏观、细观力学基本理论与结构分析设计基本方法。 本课程的主要任务是培养学生掌握复合材料力学的基本概念，宏观、细观力学的基本理论，复合材料结构分析与设计的基本方法，具备运用基本理论与分析设计方法进行复合材料结构分析与设计的能力。
default.en: The mechanical and structural design of composite materials is a specialized course of polymer matrix composites in higher engineering colleges. It mainly studies the basic methods of macroscopic and mesoscopic basic theory and structural analysis of continuous fiber reinforced polymer matrix composites. The main task of this course is to cultivate students to master the basic concepts of composite mechanics, the basic theory of macroscopic and mesoscopic mechanics, the basic method of structural analysis and design of composite materials, with the use of basic theory and analytical design method for composite structure analysis and design ability.

default.zh: 弹性力学概论是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门专业基础课程，主要内容包括平面问题的基本理论、平面问题的直角坐标解答、极坐标解答、差分法与变分法求解平面弹性力学问题、有限元求解平面弹性力学问题以及空间问题基本理论。通过课程学习，使学生理解弹性力学的基本理论、基本思想、基本假设和原理，掌握弹性力学的基本方法，了解弹性力学在材料中的基本应用，在基础知识学习的基础上培养利用弹性力学基本知识分析问题、设计解决方案、解决复杂材料工程问题以的能力。
default.en: “Introduction to Elastic Mechanics” is a professional basic course for materials science and engineering majors in higher engineering colleges. The main contents include the basic theory of plane problems, rectangular coordinate solutions, polar coordinate solutions, difference and variation methods for solving plane elasticity problems, finite element methods for solving plane elasticity problems and basic theories of space problems.Through the course learning, students can understand the basic theory, basic thought, basic assumption and principle of elasticity, master the basic methods of elasticity, understand the basic application of elasticity in materials, and cultivate the ability to analyze problems, design solutions and solve complex material engineering problems with the basic knowledge of elasticity on the basis of basic knowledge learning.

default.zh: 高分子复合材料工艺学是复合材料专业、高分子材料科学与工程专业的主干课程之一，主要内容是从复合材料原材料性能、复合材料结构性能、复合材料结构特点、复合材料工艺特点、复合材料加工等方面入手，理解和掌握复合材料成型原理、成型工艺设计方法、成型设备设计和选用。注重培养学生： 1．掌握复合材料成型工艺基本理论及其应用、理论联系实际、具有创新精神； 2．掌握复合材料工艺特性及其在成型过程中的作用； 3．掌握复合材料工艺设计、工艺方案设计和选用的基本方法； 4．掌握复合材料力工艺优化设计方法； 5．掌握复合材料模具设计基本原理和方法； 6．了解复合材料新工艺、新方法及发展趋向。 在教学过程中运用先修课中所学的有关知识和机能，结合各个教学环节，完成教学任务。为学生进一步学习有关课程及从事复合材料生产、研究工作打下基础。
default.en: Polymer Composite Materials Technology is one of the main courses in the composite materials major, polymer materials science and engineering major. The main content is to start from the aspects of composite material raw material properties, composite material structural properties, composite material structural characteristics, composite material process characteristics, composite material processing, etc., to understand and master the principles of composite material forming, forming process design methods, forming equipment design and selection. Emphasis on cultivating students: 1. Master the basic theory and application of composite material forming technology, connect theory with practice, and possess innovative spirit; 2. Master the process characteristics of composite materials and their role in the forming process; 3. Master the basic methods of composite material process design, process scheme design, and selection; 4. Master the optimization design method of composite material force process; 5. Master the basic principles and methods of composite material mold design; 6. Understand new processes, methods, and development trends of composite materials. Apply the relevant knowledge and functions learned in the prerequisite courses during the teaching process, combined with various teaching stages, to complete teaching tasks. To lay a foundation for students to further study relevant courses and engage in composite material production and research work.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍应用量子力学基本原理及相关方法来研究化学问题的内容，包括量子力学基础、简单体系的量子力学解、分子轨道理论、密度泛函理论、分子力场及计算方法，以及常用软件介绍等。本课程着眼于材料科学领域微观层次基础科学问题的理论分析和模拟计算，使学生能够运用量子力学等理论来进行基于原子、分子层次的计算和数值模拟等方面的研究，进而实现对材料的结构、性能进行预测的目的。通过本课程的学习，使学生不仅能掌握基本理论，善于分析和解决问题，同时也培养学生的验证理论、探索新知识的能力，对于材料基因组等材料新方向的了解和进一步研究具有重要意义，也可为其他相关课程的学习提供借鉴。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the basic principle of quantum mechanics and related method to solve the chemical problems, including quantum mechanics foundation, quantum mechanics solution of simple systems, molecular orbital theory, density functional theory, molecular force field and calculation methods, and commonly used software. This course focuses on the theoretical analysis and numerical simulation of basic scientific problems on microscopic level on material science field. After learning, the students can apply theory of quantum mechanics calculation and numerical simulation on atomic and molecular level research, then to predict the microstructures and performances of the materials. Through the course study, students can not only master the basic theory and to analysis the problems, but also cultivate students' ability of validation of the theory and explore new knowledge. There have great significance on comprehending material genome and further research, and also can be used for learning other courses.

default.zh: 《热处理设备与控制》教学综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合材料学科培养本科生各种实践性教学环节，对学生所进行热处理设备设计与控制、操作与实践能力进行训练。为学生进一步学习有关专业课程、毕业论文和将来从事材料科学实验和理论研究打下基础，最终达到以下课程目标： 课程目标1：掌握典型热处理设备及控制系统的结构、组成、工作原理及应用，并掌握设备设计原理，使学生了解材料热加工设备发展趋势；掌握典型热加工设备结构、有效加热区、热交换基本方式、换热量计算；了解并掌握电热材料种类、应用及其计算；熟悉材料加热物理过程，学会加热时间计算方法。 课程目标2：掌握电位差计、辐射测温仪、热电偶和热电阻的工作原理、炉温测量方法以及炉温的调节方式和原理、热处理炉温的成套校对方法与精确控制原理；同时了解热处理其它参量检测传感器及应用；学会针对具体热处理对象，提出设备设计与精确控制思想乃至原型制造。
default.en: The course 《HEAT TREATMENT EQUIPMENT AND CONTROL》 integrates the relative knowledge and skills that have been learnt in prerequisite courses, penetrates the various practical teaching events for the materials science and engineering undergraduates, and teaches students the practice ability of design, control and operation of heat treatment equipments, providing solid background for the study of other professional courses, thesis project, and other research relative to materials science, ultimately achieving the following objectives. Objective 1: Students are expected to master the construction and components of typical heat treatment equipments and their controlling systems, the design principle of equipments, the advances in the development of hot processing equipments; the construction, effective heating zone, basic ways of heat exchange, calculation of heat exchange amount; the types of electric heating materials, their applications and design principles; the physical process of materials heating and the calculation methods of heating duration; Objective 2: Students are expected to master the working principle of potentiometers, radiation temperature measurement devices, thermal couples, and thermal resistors; the measurement, adjustment and calibration methods of furnace temperature; the working and control principles of other sensors in heat treatments. Based on specific case studies, students are expected to know how to design and construct a heat treatment equipment, and even rebuilding the heat treatment equipments.

default.zh: 金属材料零件或构件在工程应用或服役过程中典型的失效形式有四种，其中就有三种与表面直接相关，即腐蚀、磨损和疲劳。这三种形式的失效，严重制约了零部件的使用寿命，每年对国民经济都会造成重大损失。表面工程技术是解决上述问题的重要手段，学习和掌握提高材料表面性能的技术，对提高产品性能，降低成本，实现可持续发展具有重要意义，也是材料科学工作者必备的专业知识。 本课程主要介绍材料表面的状态、表面的失效形式、提高材料表面性能的各种表面工程技术的基本理论和技术方法。表面工程技术方面主要包含三大基本部分，第一，表面层的成分不发生变化的表面改性技术，包括形变表面改性、相变表面改性、表面非晶态技术；第二，表面成分渐变的表面合金化技术，包括电火花表面合金化、激光表面合金化技术、离子注入表面合金化技术；第三，表面成分突变的表面覆层技术，包括喷涂技术、电镀技术、微弧氧化技术、化学镀技术和真空气相沉积技术。除此之外，还介绍不同技术并用的复合表面工程技术及各种表面工程技术的应用实例。
default.en: This course deals with surface status and surface failure modes of materials, basic theories and techniques to improve the surface properties of materials. Surface Engineering includes the following three parts: Firstly, the technologies which do not change the composition of surface layers, such as deformation strengthen, surface hardening, surface non-crystallization and so on. Secondly, surface alloying technologies which make the surface composition changed gradually, such as alloyed by electro-spark, laser beams, ion implantation and so on. Thirdly, surface coatings technologies which form a surface layer differ from the substrate, such as spray, electroplating, surface oxidization, electroless plating and vacuum vapor deposition and so on. Besides, the hybrids techniques which combine above technologies together, as well as their industrial applications, will be introduced to the students.

default.zh: 粉末冶金原理与工艺是材料科学与工程专业选修课。本课程以材料科学基础、热处理原理与工艺、物理化学为基础，突出粉末冶金基本原理和新工艺。 本课程的主要任务是使是学生掌握粉体材料的基本制备方法、粉末性能的表征、粉末成形与烧结致密化过程的相关原理和技术。使学生具备利用粉末制造各种粉末冶金材料及其零部件的相关理论和技术基础和新材料的开发设计能力。 1. 运用基本的物理和化学基本原理，能够利用现有设备制备出不同尺寸不同形貌的粉末冶金粉末，并对粉末性能进行表征，满足实际工作中对粉末合成和制备的要求； 2. 掌握粉体的压制基本过程和坯体的性能的评价方法，会采用粉末成型的压制方程（如黄培云粉末压制方程）来分析坯体的性能，从而分析和解决工程实践问题。课程学习过程中培养学生的独立思维、解决实际工程问题的能力。 3. 从热力学和动力学的基本观点出发，掌握粉末烧结的基本原理，从而针对实际的复杂冶金工程实例提出满足特定需求的烧结工艺，并能够在设计环节充分考虑到经济、安全及环境等因素，给出完整的复杂粉末冶金工程的解决方案。
default.en: Principles and Processes of Powder Metallurgy is an elective course for material science and engineering. This course is based on materials science, heat treatment principle and technology as well as physical chemistry, highlighting the basic principle and new technology of powder metallurgy. The main task of this course is to enable students to master the basic preparation methods of powder materials, characterization of powder properties, principles and techniques related to the process of powder forming and sintering densification. Students will be equipped with the theoretical and technical basis of making powder metallurgy materials and their parts by using powder, and the ability of developing and designing new materials. 1. Using the basic physical and chemical mechanisms, it can make use of existing equipment to prepare powder metallurgy powders with different sizes and morphologies, and characterize the properties of powders, so as to meet the requirements of powder synthesis and preparation in practical work. 2. Master the basic process of powder pressing and the evaluation method of the performance of the green body, and use the theoretical equation of powder forming to analyze the performance of the green body, so as to analyze and solve engineering practice problems. The course learning process cultivates students' ability of independent thinking and solving practical engineering problems. 3. Starting from the basic point of view of thermodynamics and dynamics, to master the basic principle of powder sintering, which aimed at the actual complex metallurgical engineering example is given to meet the specific needs of the sintering process is put forward, and be able to in the design process fully consider the factors such as economy, safety and environment, gives a complete complex powder metallurgy engineering solutions.

default.zh: 本课程的目的是使学生掌握材料与环境介质相互作用的普遍规律。掌握在典型环境以及大气、海水、土壤等自然环境下材料发生腐蚀的原因及控制措施。掌握材料发生腐蚀的热力学判据、材料腐蚀动力学参数的测量方法及材料发生不同类型腐蚀的原理。 本课程主要内容包括：腐蚀热力学判据及其电化学参数表征、电化学腐蚀动力学原理、几种重要的腐蚀类型及其形成机制、发生腐蚀的必要条件、极化现象及原因、阴极腐蚀类型以及阳极钝化现象与特征、自然环境腐蚀特征、耐腐蚀材料及其设计原理、材料保护涂层的选择与设计、材料电化学保护的参数制定。 本科程的主要任务是培养学生掌握腐蚀的基本概念及基础理论，掌握材料产生腐蚀的原因以及控制的方法，了解金属发生各种腐蚀的电化学本质，并结合材料的成分与结构特征，从材料学的角度，分析耐腐蚀材料的设计原理。使学生具备选用掌握的适宜的理论和实验方法来分析与解决毕业设计试验中的实际物理问题。
default.en: The aim of the course is to get the interactional rule of materials and surroundings medium, obtain the reason and control measures of materials corrosion under some typical environment along with the natural environment (such as atmosphere, seawater and soil). The aim of the course is to make the students mastering the thermodynamics criterion of material corrosion as well as the testing technique of materials corrosion and principle of differently corrosive types. The contents of this subject include the thermodynamics criterion of material corrosion and its electrochemical parameter along with the kinetic theory of electrochemical corrosion. Some importance corrosion types and accordingly formed mechanism are mentioned. The subject deals with the necessary conditions for corrosion, polarization phenomenon and polarization reason, anodic passivation and character. The subject also deals with the character of materials corrosion at elevated temperature and nature environment. In addition, corrosion control by design and coating are also described. The task of the course is to train students to master the basal conception and theory of corrosion, master the reason of corrosion and control methods. This subject not only has important practicality effect on the students in the future, but also is the important part of basic knowledge for materials science.

default.zh: 钢铁生产技术概论是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业及其相关专业学生的选修课程，是需要掌握的基础知识。通过学习，使学生了解钢铁材料的来源和生产工艺过程，掌握炼铁和炼钢、轧钢的基本原理，了解炼铁、炼钢、轧钢工艺过程，熟悉相应的设备，为实际生产应用奠定理论基础和实验能力。
default.en: Steel and iron production technology is an elective course for students majoring in material science and engineering and its related majors in higher engineering colleges, and it is a basic knowledge that needs to be mastered. Through learning, students can understand the source of iron and steel materials and its production process, master the basic principles of ironmaking, steelmaking and rolling, understand the process of ironmaking, steelmaking and rolling, familiar with the corresponding equipment, and lay the theoretical foundation and experimental ability for practical production and application.

default.zh: 本课程是一门综合性的技术学科，涉及材料科学、力学、摩擦学和机械制造工艺学等各方面的知识。本课程的教学目的是使学生在较为精通材料科学的基础上，综合掌握其它学科的基本知识，学会失效分析的基本思路和方法，掌握失效及失效分析的概念，机械产品失效的分类，失效分析的工作内容，失效分析与其它学科，技术之间的关系；开阔学生的思路，综合运用所学过的知识，解决实际工程中失效问题；掌握失效分析的基本技能，失效形式的判断。 本课程共分为四章，第一章失效分析的概念，第二章失效分析的基础知识，第三章失效分析的思路及方法，第四章实际构件失效分析实例。总学数为32学时，其中讲授32学时，实验0学时。
default.en: This curriculum is a comprehensively technical discipline which involves material science, mechanical behavior, friction and mechanical manufacturing technology. The aim of this curriculum is to make the students grasp the concept of failure and failure analysis, the sort of failure of mechanical product, the content of failure analysis and the relationship of failure analysis with other disciplines and technologies; broaden the students’ mind and solve the failure problems in the practical engineering by using the relative knowledge we have learned; grasp the primary skill to analyze failure and judge the failure modes on the foundation that the students master material science. This curriculum contains Four chapters. The first chapter: the elementary concept of failure and failure analysis; The second chapter: the basics of failure analysis; The third chapter: the ideology and technology of failure analysis; The fourth chapter: the typical examples of failure analysis. The total credit hours are 32 hours, where 32 hours for teaching, 0 hours for experiment.

default.zh: 本课程的主要目的是使学生系统掌握材料发生摩擦磨损的基本原理、规律和测试技术。学生在了解固体表面几何形状特性、表面物理化学性质及其表征方法、固体表面接触时的相互作用和变化的基础上，需掌握基本的摩擦理论及影响摩擦的因素，懂得选择合适的理论模型（如分子-机械理论、粘着理论、能量理论）来分析和解决工程实践问题。针对不同类型磨损形式，特别是常见的磨粒磨损、粘着磨损、疲劳磨损、腐蚀磨损、剥层磨损、微动磨损等，学会选用相应的材料和采取不同的减摩抗磨表面设计，掌握研究不同类型磨损的实验方法和检测技术。本课程培养学生从材料科学的角度，结合磨损表面的摩擦力学和摩擦化学特征，来分析磨损形貌特征、磨损程度与磨损机理之间的内在关系，建立起“根据工件的实际工况条件来选择材料类型、组织及处理工艺”的概念，为今后从事材料摩擦磨损的检测、磨损机理和防护研究奠定基础。本课程除了摩擦与磨损机理、摩擦学测试技术和减摩耐磨材料等传统领域外，还介绍当今空间摩擦学、纳米摩擦学、生物与仿生摩擦学等技术领域的最新进展。
default.en: The objective of this course is to provide the undergraduate students basic knowledge on fundamental principles, characteristics and testing methods of friction and wear, and to develop their ability to analyze and solve the practical problems in friction and wear of materials. The topics covered in this course include surface physical and chemical characteristics on solid surfaces, tribo-stressing contact of solids, basic friction principles such as molecule-mechanical theoretical model, adhesion contact model and energy dissipation theory etc., different wear modes and basic mechanisms of materials such as abrasive wear, adhesion wear, fatigue wear, corrosive wear (include oxidation wear), delamination wear, fretting wear, etc., friction-reducing and wear-resistant materials, different friction and wear testing methods, failure analysis of worn surfaces, and recent research progress on advanced tribology, especially such as space tribology, nanotribology and biomimetic tribology. It also provides the students an opportunity to widen their sights on tribomaterials selection, friction-reducing and anti-wear strategies after obtaining a better understanding on the relationship among tribomaterials selection and wear-resistant surface design, processing, microstructure, wear degree and mechanisms.

default.zh: 电子封装材料B是电子技术与产业中的基础和先导，同时也是材料学院相关专业的选修课程。本课程将学习电子技术中的主要材料类型，包括芯片粘接材料、金属类封装材料、陶瓷基板材料、塑封料等。通过本门课程的学习，使学生掌握电子封装和制造中的材料及其特性和应用；对材料的热物理特性、化学特性、力学特性等基本封装特性有深入的了解。
default.en: Electronic material A is a functional characteristics, structure features, physical and chemical properties of materials widely used in the electronic information technology and industry; it is the foundation and guide of electronic information technology and an elective course of Electronic Packaging Technology. This course covers the main materials of electronic information technology, including the types of Chip bonding materials, metal materials，Ceramic substrate materials， Plastic sealant etc. its purpose is to make the students master the materials in manufacturing electronic packaging and their characteristics and application; To encapsulate in-depth understanding the basic properties such as electromagnetic properties, chemical properties, physical characteristics, mechanical properties, etc.

default.zh: 空间环境模拟与实验方法是为了满足航天技术发展而设立的一门专业课，针对航天器材料和器件空间环境适应性实验，介绍近地轨道空间环境的主要地面模拟方法和实验方法。为了保证空间飞行器的可靠性，必须利用各种地面模拟空间环境实验对空间材料、器件、机构甚至飞行器整体进行评价。本课程介绍了热真空（真空效应）、太阳电磁辐射（热效应和紫外效应）、原子氧（侵蚀效应）、带电粒子辐照（电离效应和位移效应）、空间粉尘与碎片（撞击和侵蚀效应）、空间微重力（微重力效应）以及月球环境模拟的要求、原理、设备及相应实验方法，给出航天器材料和器件的空间环境适应性、空间环境模拟实验的效应等效、等效区间、加速实验、加速因子、空间环境综合模拟等重要概念，列举了常用空间环境模拟实验的适用性和局限性，例举了典型空间环境实验，如太阳电磁辐照、带电粒子辐照、原子氧暴露等的实验流程，以及常用的空间环境模拟实验的原位动态测量技术。课程适用于材料科学大类专业本科生。教学内容和设计的目的是培养学生具备对特定轨道环境下服役的典型航天器材料或器件进行所需空间环境模拟实验项目与实验方法的选择能力，能够进行空间环境因素的剪裁、实验规范制定、以及典型空间环境因素的地面等效实验和加速实验的设计。课程学分为1.5学分，总学时24学时，其中讲课24学时。
default.en: Space environment simulation and experimental methods is a major course, which meets the development of space technology. In this course, focused on the environmental adaptation of materials and devices used in spacecrafts, the main techniques for the ground-simulation of near-earth-orbit space environment and the corresponding experiment methods are introduced. In order to ensure spacecraft reliability, it is essential to evaluate the space materials, components, mechanisms, or even the spacecraft system itself by various ground-based space environment simulation tests. This course describes the requirements, principles, facilities, and corresponding experiment methods for simulating thermal vacuum (vacuum effect), solar electromagnetic irradiation (thermal and ultraviolet effects), atomic oxygen (erosion effect), space charged particle radiation (ionization and displacement effects), space meteoroid and debris （impact and erosion effects）, space microgravity (microgravity effect), and lunar environment. Some important concepts are given, such as environmental adaptation？of materials and devices for spacecrafts, equivalent effect of space environment, equivalent condition region, accelerated test, acceleration factor, comprehensive space environment simulation etc. The applicability and limit of common space environment simulation tests are listed. The processes of the typical space environment simulation tests are illustrated, such as solar electromagnetic irradiation, space charged particle radiation, atomic oxygen exposure etc. Some in-situ dynamical measurement techniques during space environment simulation test are also introduced. The course is assumed to the undergraduates from materials science. The teaching materials are designed for students to train their ability of selecting space environment simulation testing items and methods for some typical spacecraft-used materials or devices served under special orbital environment. The knowledge in this course can also help conduct space environmental tailoring, test procedure, and experiment design of on-ground equivalent test and accelerated test for the typical space environment factors. The course is credit 1.5 and total class hours are 24 consisting of 24 lectures hours

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍功能材料的一个分支-铁磁功能材料的功能特性及其内在机理。课程首先介绍铁磁功能材料主要功能特性及各种功能特性的应用领域与前景。随后从成分、结构、马氏体相变和样品空间维度等因素对铁磁功能材料的功能特性的影响规律方面进行详细介绍。课程主要介绍合金成分对其马氏体结构、物理性能等的影响规律，详细介绍不同成分下合金中存在的马氏体种类及其对应的结构性能特征并简单介绍铁磁功能合金中存在的主要相变类型及其与不同功能特性之间的内在联系。课程主要介绍合金不同空间维度，包括三维多孔泡沫、二维薄膜与带材、一维微米丝与纤维、零维粉末的铁磁功能材料的制备方法，并探讨尺寸和维度对相应功能特性的影响规律。课程结合不同空间维度材料进一步介绍单晶、大块多晶、织构多晶、微纳米小尺寸材料等多种形态对铁磁功能材料功能特性的影响规律，最后再从合金本身的结构和马氏体相变特性出发，介绍不同合金的磁感生应变、磁热、弹热、温控形状记忆效应和超弹性等方面的功能特性。
default.en: In this course, interesting functional properties and their inner mechanisms in ferromagnetic functional materials will be introduced. At the first part of this course, the functional properties and their potential application of ferromagnetic functional materials will be briefly introduced. After that, the effects of chemical composition, microstructure, martensite transformation and the sample size and dimension on the functional properties of the materials will be discussed in detail. In this course, the effects of chemical composition on the martensite structure and physical properties, with emphasis on the microstructure and properties of different martensites in ferromagnetic shape memory alloys will be discussed. Then the inner relationship between different transformation processes and functional properties will be covered. The main body of this course is to introduce the synthesis methods of this material with different dimensions and sizes, including 3-dimensional porous foams, 2-dimensional ribbons/films, 1-dimensional microwires/fibers and 0-dimensional powders. The effects of the size and dimension on the according functional properties will be discussed. Furthermore, combined with the results based on different size and dimension of the materials, different properties in single crystalline, bulk polycrystalline, textured polycrystalline, micro-sized polycrystalline ferromagnetic functional materials will be presented. Finally, functional properties including magnetic-filed-induced strain, magnetocaloric effect, elastocaloric effect, thermal induced shape memory effect and superelasticity of different alloys will be introduced based on the intrinsic microstructure and martensite transformation of them.

default.zh: 本课程是材料科学与工程专业学生必修的专业基础课。本课程的教学目的在于使学生熟悉聚合物基复合材料中基体材料的种类、合成原理、合成工艺方法、性能特点及应用，掌握各类热固性树脂基体常用固化剂的种类、固化机理、性能特点及应用，认识聚合物材料的结构特点以及结构与性能间的关系，领会聚合物基复合材料中聚合物分子结构对性能的影响，促进学生构建较完整的聚合物材料理论及应用的知识体系。本课程为学生在步入社会后，尽快将基础理论知识用于生产、科研工作实践奠定基础，有助于培养“工程型、创新性”人才培养。
default.en: Polymer material is a required specialized elementary course for students major in materials science and engineering. The teaching purpose of this course is to familiarize students with the type, synthetic principle, synthetic process, performance characteristics and application of matrix material in polymer composites. Also master various types of commonly used curing agent, curing mechanism, characteristics and application of thermosetting resin matrix. Understand how the molecular structure of polymer materials impact on the performance of the polymer matrix composites. Promote the students to build a complete knowledge systems of polymer materials and application. This course helps build a foundation for the basic and gives students an opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge in practice and scientific research as soon as possible for the students after entering society. The course helps to foster innovation-type and engineering talents.

default.zh: 金属基复合材料是金属材料与无机非金属相复合的新型材料，在学生的材料学知识体系中占有重要的地位。本课程将参考国际上权威的论著，同时结合哈工大金属基复合材料研究的历史与现状进行教学。使学生系统掌握金属基复合材料的发展历史、复合工艺方法、材料性能与功能设计的原理、创新思维方法，掌握金属基复合材料的基本知识，学会运用金属学、力学、物理学原理进行材料设计。同时了解金属基复合材料国际上发展的前沿学术问题，以及在科学研究过程中发现问题、解决问题的基本思路和方法。
default.en: Metal matrix composite is a kind of new material which combines metal material with inorganic non-metallic phase. It takes an important place in students' knowledge system of material science. This course will reference the authoritative international treatises and combine with the history and status of metal matrix composites’ study in HIT, in order to make students grasp the history of metal matrix composites’ development, composite process methods, material properties, functional design principle and innovative way of thinking and also learn to use metal, mechanics, physics principles for material design. At the same time, the academic problems for the international development of composites and the basic methods of finding and solving problems in the scientific process will also be learned by students.

default.zh: 生物材料是材料科学与工程专业的一门选修课程，它以物理化学和材料科学基础为基础，主要讲述生物材料的基本概念、类型和应用。本课程的教学目的在于使学生了解材料的生物性能和作为生物医用的适应性，掌握生物化学基本原理，天然生物材料基本结构和性能，材料的生物适应性和生物医学材料选用原则，现有生物医学材料的结构、制备原理和应用情况，以及仿生与纳米生物材料学概况，为学生今后从事生物医学材料研究开发奠定必要基础。
default.en: Biomaterial is a selected course for the students major in materials science and engineering, which is based on physical chemistry and materials science. It introduces the basic concepts, types and applications of biomaterials. This course enables the students to understand bio-properties and their applications, also master the following focuses: basic theory of biochemistry, microstructure and properties of inartificial biomaterials, bioadaptability and selecting rules of biomaterials, microstructure, preparation principles and applications of current biomedical materials, and survey for biomimetic materials science, which lay a foundation for students to research and develop biomedical materials in future.

default.zh: 新能源材料是材料科学与工程专业的一门选修课程，它以物理化学和材料科学基础为基础，主要讲述新能源材料的概念、类型及应用，主要包括：太阳能电池材料，燃料电池材料，锂离子电池材料，超级电容器材料，热电转换材料和核能材料等。通过课堂教授使学生掌握各类新能源材料的基本概念，工作运行原理，器件的基本组成及器件对材料的基本技术要求，以及未来的发展趋势等。
default.en: New energy materials is an elective course for the students majored in materials science and engineering, which is based on physical chemistry and materials science. It introduces the basic concepts, types and applications of new energy materials including solar cell, fuel cell, lithium ion battery, supercapacitor, thermoelectric and nuclear materials. This course enables the students to understand the basic acknowledge, basic working and operating theory, devices structure and their materials dependants, applications and future developments.

default.zh: 碳材料已成为二十一世纪最前沿的研究热点和最具应用潜力的新型材料之一，碳材料已成为材料学科发展的一个重要分支。随着新能源、电子和信息产业的兴起，新型碳材料更是显示出其独有的优势。 本课程以掌握新型碳材料的特性、结构与性质为基础，重点学习几种新型碳材料的结构、制备、性能及应用前景，结合彼此间共性和个性的研究，可以使学生获得新型碳材料的基本知识，拓宽学生的视野，增强学生投入材料研发的兴趣与信心。
default.en: Carbon materials have become one of the most cutting-edge research hotspots and potential new materials in the 21st century, and have become an important branch of the development of materials science. With the rise of new energy, electronics, and information industries, new carbon materials have shown their unique advantages. This course is based on mastering the characteristics, structure, and properties of new carbon materials, with a focus on studying the structure, preparation, performance, and application prospects of several new carbon materials. By combining research on their commonalities and individuality, students can acquire basic knowledge of new carbon materials, broaden their horizons, and enhance their interest and confidence in material research and development.

default.zh: 空间摩擦材料学是随着航天器材料和机构润滑等技术发展而产生的新技术领域，是空间环境学、表面科学和材料学的交叉学科。针对空间应用，本课程内容涉及材料的表面与表面接触理论；空间摩擦学概述；空间主要固体润滑材料（软金属、层状固体润滑材料、聚合物及其复合材料、氧化物高温润滑剂等）的润滑原理、空间摩擦学特性、制备、及应用；空间摩擦材料选择原则；空间液体润滑剂；空间固体润滑新材料介绍等内容。课程适用于材料科学大类专业本科生。本课程的教学目的是使学生掌握摩擦部件与材料在空间环境下使用的要求、空间用摩擦润滑材料种类及应用、摩擦学基本概念和原理、摩擦材料的空间环境效应、空间摩擦材料的选择原则、以及空间摩擦学性能环境评价试验方法，了解空间摩擦材料发展趋势和前景。要求能够根据航天器具体服役条件和摩擦学原理，初步设计空间润滑模式、选择空间摩擦材料体系；能够依据表面接触的赫兹分析与估算，选择表面摩擦学涂层的制备方法；培养学生根据空间摩擦学性能的新需求，运用薄膜润滑理论和表面物理理论，设计、选择和评价空间摩擦新材料的研究能力。课程学分为1.0学分，总学时16学时。
default.en: Space friction materials science has been become a new technology field with the development in techniques of space materials and mechanism lubrication. It is a crossed subject of space environment technology, surface science, and materials science. Aiming to space applications, the main contents of the course includes: basic theory for surface and interface of materials; overview of space tribology; lubrication theory, tribological performance, preparation technology, and applications of main space solid lubricant materials (soft metals, laminar solid lubricant materials, polymers and their composites, oxides for high temperature lubrication etc); selection principles of space lubrication materials; space liquid lubricant; new lubrication materials for space tribology. The course is assumed to the undergraduates from materials science. The teaching materials are designed for students to master the following knowledge: requirements for tribological devices and materials used in space; main species and applications of material s for space tribology; basic concepts and principles of space tribology; space environment effects on lubrication materials; selection principles and space environment evaluation experiment methods for space lubrication materials; Development trends and prospects of new space lubrication materials. It also trains the abilities of designing space lubricating mode and materials used in space based on the serving conditions of spacecraft in space environment and tribological principles, selecting preparation process according to the Hertz analysis and estimation on surface contact, designing, selecting, and evaluating new materials for space tribology to meet new requirements of space tribological property by using theories of film lubrication and surface physics. The course is credit 1.0 point and 16 class hours.

default.zh: 大学实验室是人才培养和科学研究的重要基地，在培养学生的动手能力、实验实践能力、协作创新能力的过程中发挥着不可或缺的支撑作用。同时，实验过程中可能涉及具有一定危险因素的实验环境，如高温、高压、超低温、强磁、真空、辐射、高电压和高转速等，还可能使用有毒有害化学品、易燃易爆危险品、生物制剂等。因此，安全开展实验是大学进行人才培养和科学研究的前提和保障。 本课程的主要内容包括：实验室常见安全事故类型及原因分析，化学品安全基础知识，实验室消防安全，实验室电气安全及实验事故应急处理。
default.en: University laboratories are important bases for talent cultivation and scientific research, playing an indispensable supporting role in developing students' hands-on skills, experimental practical abilities, and collaborative innovation capabilities. Meanwhile, experimental processes may involve experimental environments with certain risk factors, such as high temperature, high pressure, ultra-low temperature, strong magnetism, vacuum, radiation, high voltage, and high rotation speed. They may also involve the use of toxic and harmful chemicals, flammable and explosive dangerous goods, biological agents, and more. Therefore, conducting experiments safely is the prerequisite and guarantee for universities to carry out talent cultivation and scientific research. The main contents of this course include: types of common laboratory safety accidents and their cause analysis, basic knowledge of chemical safety, laboratory fire safety, laboratory electrical safety, and emergency handling of experimental accidents.

The Materials Genome Initiative (MGI) aims to establish a new "culture" in the materials field that prioritizes theoretical simulation and prediction over experimental validation, thereby overturning the existing empirical and experimental-based materials R&D concepts. Therefore, the main task of this course is to provide students with an understanding of the main content, technical content, nature of science, the latest trends, and future development trends of the Materials Genome Initiative, so as to improve students' knowledge of materials R&D and cultivate new thinking in materials R&D.

default.zh: 扫描探针显微镜是扫描隧道显微镜及在扫描隧道显微镜的基础上发展起来的各种新型探针显微镜（原子力显微镜、扫描近场光学显微镜、静电力显微镜、磁力显微镜等）的统称。扫描探针显微镜的使用环境宽松但分辨率极高，并且实时的、真实的样品表面的高分辨率图像，还可对材料的各种不同性质进行原位研究，自问世以来，扫描探针显微镜在物理学、化学、生物学、微电子学和材料科学等领域得到广泛的应用。本课程将介绍扫描探针显微镜的原理与结构、工作模式以及主要应用，为本科生从事相关研究提供参考。
default.en: Scanning probe microscope (SPM) is a large branch of probe-based microscopes, including scanning tunneling microscope (STM), atomic force microscope (AFM), scanning near-field optical microscope (SNOM), electrostatic force microscope (EFM), and magnetic force microscope (MFM), all of which originate from the scanning tunneling microscope. SPM can be operated at ambient atmosphere. High-resolution, in-situ image of the sample surface as well as surface properties can be obtained by using SPM technique. SPM has found broad applications in physics, chemistry, biology, microelectrics and materials. The principles, components, working model and applications of SPM will be presented in this course.

default.zh: 《多元系相图》是高等工科院校材料类专业的一门专业选修课程。本课程系统的阐述了多元系相图的基本理论和基础知识，着重介绍了三元相图的基本概念和理论，包括二相平衡、三相平衡及四相平衡相图的特点和应用，介绍工业上常用三元系金属材料相图的分析方法。本课程着眼于多元系相图的基本问题、从相图的基本概念和理论出发，使学生能把握相图的共性，熟悉不同相图的个性。通过理论教学和项目研究，使学生不仅能掌握和掌握多元系相图方面的基础知识和基本理论，善于分析和解决问题，同时也培养学生创造性思维、综合研究能力和材料科学与工程实践能力。本课程为学生将来从事材料的研究与开发打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Multicomponent phase diagram is one of the elective courses for the students of materials science and engineering in colleges of engineering. This course systematically elaborates the fundamental theory and basic knowledge of multicomponent phase diagram, and emphatically introduces the basic conception and theories and rules of ternary phase diagram, including the characteristics and applications of ternary phase diagram of two-phase equilibrium, three-phase equilibrium and four-phase equilibrium phase diagram, and also introduces the analysis method of the common three-component alloys phase diagram in the industry. This course focuses on the basic problems of multicomponent phase diagram. The students can grasp the general characteristic of phase diagram and master the specific properties of phase diagram based on the fundamental theories and rules. The principle goals of this course is to make the students not only understand and master the fundamental theories and rules of multicomponent phase diagram, analyze and solve the problems of materials research and application, but also have the capability of innovation, comprehensive research and practice of materials science and engineering through theory study and research project. This course lays solid theoretical foundation for the research and development of materials in the future.

default.zh: 高分子化学不仅是高等工科院校高分子材料与工程专业必修的专业基础课程，也是化学、化工和材料等理工类专业的重要课程。由于高分子材料产量大、品种多、应用广、经济效益高，早已渗透到了每一个科学技术领域和部门。高分子化学已不再是有机化学、物理化学等某一传统化学学科的分支，而是整个化学学科和物理、工程、生物乃至药物等许多学科的交叉和综合。 高分子化学是研究高分子化合物合成和化学反应的一门科学。主要内容包括：自由基聚合、自由基共聚合和逐步聚合的反应机理，聚合反应动力学、聚合度及其分布、聚合物微观结构及共聚物组成等的影响因素与控制方法，聚合方法以及聚合物的化学反应。 本课程的主要任务是培养学生对高分子材料的认知能力和创新能力，为今后从事相关领域的研究工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Polymer Chemistry is not only a compulsory professional basic course for the major of Polymer Materials and Engineering in higher engineering colleges and universities, but also an important course for science and engineering majors such as Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and Materials Science. Due to the large output, wide variety, extensive applications, and high economic benefits of polymer materials, they have long penetrated every field and department of science and technology. Polymer Chemistry is no longer a branch of a single traditional chemical discipline like Organic Chemistry or Physical Chemistry, but an intersection and integration of the entire chemical discipline with many other disciplines such as Physics, Engineering, Biology, and even Pharmacy. Polymer Chemistry is a science that studies the synthesis and chemical reactions of polymeric compounds. Its main contents include: the reaction mechanisms of free radical polymerization, free radical copolymerization, and step-growth polymerization; the influencing factors and control methods of polymerization kinetics, degree of polymerization and its distribution, polymer microstructure, and copolymer composition; as well as polymerization methods and chemical reactions of polymers. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' cognitive ability and innovative ability in polymer materials, laying a solid foundation for their future research work in related fields.

default.zh: 本课程是材料科学与工程专业本科生的一门专业方向选修课程。本课程主要针对材料科学与工程的实验学科背景，讲授实验设计与数据处理基本准则、实验数据（误差）分析、实验设计优选法、数据可视化基础与原则、数据可视化图类型、常用方法、可视化工具与实战等部分。通过本课程的学习，让学生们更好地了解科学数据分析、可视化元素与科学图表绘的基本原理与流程，为后续从事科学研究、论文撰写打下科学数据分析与可视化基本理论基础和认知，提升学生的科学数据分析能力和科研绘图能力，还可进一步使学生感受科学图表可视化图形设计美学。
default.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students in the major of materials science and engineering. The topics covered in this course include mainly the basic elements and design criteria of experimental design, data analysis and experimental design, basics knowledge of data visualization, data visualization methods, data visualization tools, and visualization chart drawing, etc. It provides students a broad-based understanding on the basic principles and processes of scientific data analysis, visualization elements, and scientific chart drawing. This contributes primarily to develop the students’ ability of understanding the basic principles and processes of scientific data analysis, visualization elements, and scientific chart drawing. This course would provide a basic theoretical foundation and understanding of scientific data analysis and visualization for future scientific research and paper writing, enhance their scientific data analysis and drawing abilities, and also further enable them to experience the aesthetics of scientific chart visualization graphic design.

default.zh: 核材料是高等工科院校核工程与核技术及其相关专业学生的选修课程，是核相关专业学生必须掌握的重要专业基础知识。通过对该门课程的学习，使学生了解材料科学的基本知识，包括材料的晶体结构、缺陷、显微组织、相图、基本性能，掌握核反应堆各个结构的主要材料组成和选取原则，特别是燃料、包壳材料、主要的结构材料和其他核材料等。使学生对材料科学有一个基本的认知，为反应堆设计和应用奠定材料科学基础。
default.en: Nuclear material is an elective course for students of nuclear engineering and nuclear technology and related majors in higher engineering colleges, and it is an important basic professional knowledge that students of nuclear related majors must be mastered. Through the study of this course, students can understand the basic knowledge of material science, including the crystal structure, defects, microstructure, phase diagram and basic properties of materials, and master the main material composition and selection principles of various structures of nuclear reactors, especially fuel, cladding materials, main structural materials and other nuclear materials. To enable students to have a basic understanding of materials science, to lay a material science foundation for reactor design and application.

default.zh: 科技文献阅读与写作是掌握科研问题发展动向、传播科研成果的重要语言工具。本课程应为材料科学与工程专业的高年级本科生选修课。利用24个课时，使学生掌握科技文献检索方法，掌握常用科技论文专业英语词汇，熟记常用英语用式，帮助学生在专业学习和研究中更好的应用英语，达到能用英语较熟练地阅读专业科技文献资料、攥写专业科技论文，满足学生参加国际科技交流活动的需要。
default.en: The importance of Reading and Writing Skills of Academic Articles has encouraged us to give the course to the junior class in Materials Science . By the end of the program (24 class hours), students will master the retrieval methods of scientific and technological documents and familiarize with article structures of typical English publications. Meanwhile, the students master about nomenclatures and expressions that are highly specialized in Materials Science and Engineering. Moreover, the students are expected to use specialized English in their major course study and research, and be able to read the scientific and technical literature and write scientific articles. It will meet the students’requirements for participating into the international scientific and technological activities.

default.zh: 《晶体学》是高等工科院校材料类专业的一门专业选修课程。本课程主要阐述晶体学的基本概念和基础理论知识，包括晶体学基本概念、晶体对称性、晶体投影、点群和空间群、晶体位错理论和晶体强度理论的位错机制。本课程着眼于晶体基本问题、从晶体的基本理论出发，使学生能把握晶体的共性，熟悉晶体结构分析的重要概念和分析思路。同时，掌握晶体位错的几何性质、弹性性质和实际晶体结构中的位错特点，从而运用晶体位错基本原理分析和解决问题。课程能够培养学生的材料科学与工程综合研究能力，为将来从事材料的研究与开发打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Crystallography is one of the selected courses for the students of materials science and engineering in colleges of engineering. This course introduces the basic concepts and fundamental theories of crystals, including the basic concepts, crystal symmetry, crystal projection, point groups and space groups, theory of crystal dislocation and dislocation mechanisms of crystal strength. This course focuses on the basic problems of crystals and starts from the basic theories of crystals, so that students can grasp the commonality of crystals and be familiar with the important concepts and analysis ideas of crystal structure analysis. At the same time, the geometric and elastic properties of crystal dislocations and the characteristics of dislocations in the actual crystal structure are mastered, so as to analyze and solve the actual problems using the basic principles of crystal dislocations. This course can cultivate students' comprehensive research ability in materials science and engineering, and lay solid theoretical foundation for the research and development of materials in the future.

default.zh: 《专业思维训练》是高等工科院校材料科学与工程专业的一门专业选修课程。本课程阐述材料科学的核心问题，介绍材料科学的基本概念和基础理论知识，包括材料的结合键、材料的晶体结构和晶体结构缺陷的特点和性质、材料中的扩散、相图及凝固理论、塑性变形特点。本课程着眼于材料基本问题、从材料的基本理论出发，使学生能把握材料的共性，熟悉材料的个性。通过理论教学和项目研究，使学生不仅能掌握和理解材料科学与工程方面的基础知识和基本理论，善于分析和解决问题，同时也培养学生创造性思维、综合研究能力和材料科学与工程实践能力。
default.en: Professional thinking training is one of the elective courses for the students of materials science and engineering in colleges of engineering. This course elaborates the central issues of materials science and introduces the basic concepts and fundamental theories and rules of materials science, including interatomic bonding of materials, crystal structures, and imperfections in solids, diffusion in materials, phase diagrams and solidification theory, and plastic deformation characteristics. This course focuses on the basic problems of materials. The students can grasp the general characteristic of materials and master the specific properties of materials based on the fundamental theories and rules of materials science. The principal goals of this course are to make the students not only understand and master the fundamental theories and rules of material science, analyze and solve the problems of materials research and application, but also have the capability of innovation, comprehensive research and practice of materials science and engineering through theory study and research project.

default.zh: 本课程聚焦热辐射管理材料的设计与优化，并引入人工智能（AI）方法提升研究与工程应用能力。课程涵盖热辐射的基本理论、材料的热辐射特性及其调控机制，并结合机器学习、深度学习、智能优化算法等AI技术，探索其在热辐射材料设计、实验数据处理、智能优化中的应用。通过案例分析、AI建模实验和智能优化设计训练，学生将掌握热辐射管理材料领域的前沿技术，并具备运用AI解决实际热管理问题的能力。
default.en: This course focuses on the design and optimization of thermal radiation management materials, incorporating artificial intelligence (AI) methods to enhance research and engineering capabilities. It covers the fundamental theories of thermal radiation, the thermal radiative properties of materials and their tailoring mechanisms, and integrates AI technologies such as machine learning, deep learning, and intelligent optimization algorithms to explore their applications in thermal radiation material design, experimental data processing, and intelligent optimization. Through case studies, AI modeling experiments, and intelligent optimization design training, students will acquire cutting-edge techniques in the field of thermal radiation management materials and develop the ability to apply AI to solve practical thermal management problems.

default.zh: 本课程旨在通过系统学习人工智能在新材料研发中的应用方法，使学生掌握数据驱动的材料创新思维与工具，具备解决材料科学复杂问题的能力；掌握机器学习基本算法（监督/无监督学习、生成模型）及群体智能优化原理，了解人工智能在材料科学中的应用框架，理解材料基因工程、高通量计算与AI算法的协同逻辑；能运用Python等工具实现简单材料性质预测模型，掌握材料数据标准化、特征提取、模型训练、性能预测及逆向设计基本流程，具备设计人工智能驱动材料创制研究方案并解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: This course is designed to equip students with data-driven innovative thinking and tools for materials science, enabling them to tackle complex problems in the field through systematic learning of artificial intelligence applications in new materials research and development. Students will master fundamental machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised learning, generative models) and the principles of swarm intelligence optimization, gain an understanding of the application framework of AI in materials science, and comprehend the synergistic logic between materials genome engineering, high-throughput computing, and AI algorithms. They will learn to use tools such as Python to develop simple predictive models for material properties, master essential processes including material data standardization, feature extraction, model training, performance prediction, and inverse design, and develop the ability to design AI-driven research plans for material creation and solve practical problems.

default.zh: 本课程讲授材料智能设计与制备相关的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法。主要内容包括智能设计与制备基本原理与通识、人工智能（机器学习）算法、材料智能设计算法应用、材料智能制备基础、材料智能制备工艺方法五部分。通过课程的学习，使学生掌握材料智能设计与制备过程中各环节的物理化学、晶体学、材料学、计算机人工智能算法基本原理与方法，为从事材料智能设计与制备、算法优化、数据分析、工艺选择与优化打下较为扎实的理论基础和感知经验，具备利用相关理论和技术基础进行新材料与产品设计开发的能力。
default.en: This course focuses on some basic concepts, principles, and methods for the intelligent design and preparation of materials. The main content includes five parts: basic principles and general knowledge of intelligent design and preparation, artificial intelligence (machine learning) algorithms, application of material intelligent design algorithms, foundation of material intelligent preparation, and process methods of material intelligent preparation. Through the study of the course, students could master the basic principles and methods of physical chemistry, crystallography, materials science, and computer artificial intelligence algorithms in various aspects of material intelligent design and preparation processes. This course would lay theoretical foundation and experimental experience base for engaging in material intelligent design and preparation, algorithm optimization, data analysis, process selection and optimization, and enable the students to utilize relevant theoretical and technical foundations for the design and development of new materials and products.

default.zh: 本课程将为学员提供一个实用且易于掌握的 Ansys Granta EduPack 入门培训。作为一款功能强大的材料数据库与选材分析软件，EduPack 可让工程师进行科学、系统且有依据的材料选择。课程包含四小时的理论授课与四小时的动手实践，学员将学习如何使用 EduPack 软件，根据材料的力学、热学及环境性能，并结合制造工艺与成本因素，对不同材料进行评估与比较。课程主要内容包括介绍材料选择图、性能指数及相关决策策略，帮助学员在综合工程需求与实际约束的前提下做出合理判断。通过互动演示与实际操作练习，学习者将深入了解软件辅助选材如何提升设计效率、可持续性与产品性能。
default.en: This short course provides a practical and accessible introduction to Ansys Granta EduPack, a powerful software tool designed to support informed and systematic materials selection. Over eight hours—comprising four hours of guided teaching and four hours of hands？on practical work—participants will learn how to use EduPack software to evaluate and compare materials based on their mechanical, thermal, and environmental properties, alongside manufacturing considerations and cost factors. The module introduces the principles of materials selection charts, performance indices, and decision？making strategies that integrate engineering requirements with real？world constraints. Through interactive demonstrations and practical exercises, learners will explore how software？assisted selection can enhance design efficiency, sustainability, and product performance.

default.zh: 金属材料具有多种不同尺度的微观结构，而金属的性能在很大程度上取决于微观结构——这是金属材料最重要的特性之一。本课程基于相变、析出、再结晶和塑性变形的冶金学原理，系统回顾金属在加工过程（凝固、变形、热处理等）中微观结构的发展演变。随后，结合本人25余年来在剧烈塑性变形及超细晶金属领域的研究成果与经验，探讨金属纳米结构控制的可能性。
default.en: Metallic materials have variety of microstructures in widely different length scales and properties of metals significantly depend on the microstructure, which is one of the most important characteristics of metallic materials. In the present lectures, the development of microstructures in metals during processing (solidification, deformation, heat treatments, etc.) is fundamentally reviewed based on the metallurgical principle for phase transformation, precipitation, recrystallization and plastic deformation. Then, possibilities of nano-structure control in metals are discussed based on the lecturer’s research results and experiences on severe plastic deformation and ultrafine grained metals which have been accumulated for more than 25 years.

default.zh: 高温合金液态成形技术课程统地介绍高温合金的应用基础理论，制备工艺和工程应用。包括高温合金的强化与韧化，合金成分确定与设计；高温合金的液态成形工艺，高温合金的工程应用、包括变形和铸造高温合金，铁基、镍基和钻基高温合金，定向凝固高温合金，粉末高温合金，航天和核工业用高温合金以及民用高温合金等。提高学生在材料方面的专业基础和理论知识，具备在材料设计和制备过程中发现问题、提出问题和改进问题的能力。
default.en: The course of liquid forming technology for high-temperature alloys provides a comprehensive introduction to the basic theories, preparation processes, and engineering applications of high-temperature alloys. Including strengthening and toughening of high-temperature alloys, determination and design of alloy composition; The liquid forming process of high-temperature alloys, engineering applications of high-temperature alloys, including deformation and casting of high-temperature alloys, iron-based, nickel based, and drill based high-temperature alloys, directionally solidified high-temperature alloys, powder high-temperature alloys, high-temperature alloys for aerospace and nuclear industries, and civilian high-temperature alloys. Enhance students' professional foundation and theoretical knowledge in materials, and possess the ability to identify, raise, and improve problems in material design and preparation processes.

default.zh: 熔模精密铸造是一种先进的近净成形工艺，能够生产高质量的精密铸件，不仅用于航空航天、军事领域，几乎应用于电子、石油、化工、能源、交通运输等所有工业部门。本课程主要讲述熔模铸造工艺的全部过程，包括制模材料及制备工艺、型壳材料及制备工艺、熔模精密铸造工艺、压型设计、熔模铸件应用实例与铸件质量分析等内容。通过本课程的讲解，使学生对熔模精密铸造过程有一个全面的了解和认识，加强基础、拓宽知识面。
default.en: Investment casting is a kind of the net-shape forming technology that can produce high quality precision castings. Investment casting is not only used in aerospace, military field, almost applied to all industrial departments, especially in the fields of electronic, petrochemical industry, energy, transportation, medical equipment, pump and valve and other departments. This course mainly introduces the development of the technology of investment casting, classification and application of investment casting techniques, modeling wax materials and manufacturing technology, teaches materials and basic knowledge of mold shell, preparation process of mold shell, design of investment casting process, casting core, defects and prevention of investment casting. Through the interpretation of this course the students will have a comprehensive understanding about the investment casting process, and strengthen students’ foundation, broaden the scope of knowledge.

default.zh: 《数字化成型车间概述》课程简要介绍了材料制造的方法以及发展历史、材料制造发展的趋势、我国在制造领域取得的成就以及面临的问题；介绍了数字化（智能化）制造在国内外的发展与应用状况、数字化（智能化）制造的内涵与特征、数字化车间的体系架构与建设内容。从设计研发、工艺开发、生产制造、制造管理、物流售后等产品全寿命周期实行数字化管理的前提下，具体讲解了典型车间组成及运行、数字化设计及仿真、企业资源规划ERP 、制造执行系统MES 、数字化制造装备等内容。最后通过具体数字化车间案例， 帮助理解数字化制造理念以及数字化车间的构建。
default.en: The course of Overview of Digital Forming Workshop introduces the methods and development history of material manufacturing, the trends of material manufacturing development, the achievements and problems faced by China in the manufacturing field. The course introduces the development and application status of digital (intelligent) manufacturing at home and abroad, the connotation and characteristics of digital (intelligent) manufacturing, and the system architecture and construction content of digital workshops. Under the premise of implementing digital management throughout the entire life cycle of products, including design and development, process development, production manufacturing, manufacturing management, logistics and after-sales service, the typical workshop composition and operation, digital design and simulation, enterprise resource planning ERP, manufacturing execution system MES, digital manufacturing equipment, and other contents were explained in detail. Finally, through specific digital workshop cases, it helps to understand the concept of digital manufacturing and the construction of digital workshops.

default.zh: 钛合金优异的服役性能使其在航空、航天、化工、交通、海洋工程等行业领域具有重要的地位。热成形技术是获得钛合金构件的重要技术途径，涉及材料科学与工程的众多学科方向，本课程的主要任务是基于前期的知识积累，通过本课程的学习，让学生做到以下几点：使学生进一步了解掌钛合金构件的性能优势，在构件设计、材料选择等方面积累更多的知识；使学生掌握钛合金热成形技术的成形原理及工艺特点，能够结合构件应用背景、结构特点和成分特性，选择适合的热成形技术；使学生掌握钛合金热成形技术发展的前沿方向，拓展学生视野、提升学生创新能力和自我学习能力。
default.en: The excellent service performance of titanium alloy makes it have an important position in aviation, aerospace, chemical, transportation, marine engineering and other industries. Hot forming technology is an important technical method to obtain titanium alloy components, which involves many disciplines of materials science and engineering. The main task of this course is to allow students to do the following under the accumulation of previous knowledge and through the study of this course: Enable students to further understand the performance advantages of titanium alloy components, and accumulate more knowledge in component design and material selection. Enable students to master the forming principles and process characteristics of titanium alloy hot forming technology, and be able to combine component application background, structural characteristics, material according to the characteristics, choose suitable hot forming technology. Enable students to master the frontier direction of the development of titanium alloy hot forming technology, expand students' horizons, improve students' innovation ability and self-learning ability.

default.zh: 本课程是材料成型及控制工程的一门专业方向选修课程，系统地讲授新兴的材料电磁加工技术在材料的熔化、铸造加工和成形中的应用，从电磁场与材料的电磁作用基本原理及基本规律出发，使学生掌握电磁感应熔化、电磁搅拌、电磁净化、电磁约束铸造等材料电磁加工技术的相关基础知识，通过掌握材料电磁加工原理，了解材料电磁加工工艺手段、电磁加工设备以及应用方面的最新进展情况，拓宽学生解决实际问题的知识面，为从事科研、生产和技术开发奠定坚实的基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程学习要求如下：1、了解电磁场与材料的电磁作用基本原理及基本规律，具备材料电磁加工技术的相关基础知识；2、掌握电磁感应熔化、电磁搅拌、电磁净化、电磁约束铸造等材料电磁加工的工艺过程，具有结合科研、生产和技术开发实际初步开展材料电磁加工工艺应用的能力；3、了解材料电磁加工技术在材料的熔化、加工和成形中的应用现状和发展趋势，为今后开发新型的材料成型和控制工艺奠定基础。
default.en: This course is an elective course for material forming and control engineering. It systematically teaches the application of emerging electromagnetic processing technology for materials in material melting, casting processing and forming. It starts from the basic principles and laws of electromagnetic interaction between electromagnetic fields and materials.Enable students to master the relevant basic knowledge of electromagnetic processing technology of materials such as electromagnetic induction melting, electromagnetic stirring, electromagnetic purification, and electromagnetic constrained casting. By mastering the principle of electromagnetic processing of materials, they can understand the latest progress in the process of electromagnetic processing of materials, electromagnetic processing equipment and applications, and broaden their scope of knowledge to solve practical problems. And lays a solid foundation for scientific research, production and technology development, and supports the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results. The course requirements are as follows: 1. Understand the basic principles and laws of electromagnetic interaction between electromagnetic fields and materials, and have basic knowledge of electromagnetic processing technology of materials, 2. Master the process of electromagnetic processing of materials such as electromagnetic induction melting, electromagnetic stirring, electromagnetic purification, electromagnetic restraint casting, and have the ability to initially carry out the application of electromagnetic processing technology of materials in combination with scientific research, production and technical development, 3. Understand the application status and development trend of material electromagnetic processing technology in the melting, processing and forming of materials, and lay the foundation for the future development of new material forming and control processes.

default.zh: 本课程是使学生掌握金属凝固成形过程检测技术，拓展学生在金属材料凝固成形技术领域的知识面，为后续的毕业论文课题研究以及从事相关工作奠定技术与理论基础。本课程主要讲授内容包括：金属凝固成形过程中的温度、气体含量、专用热分析技术、铸造性能、铸型材料、铸件内在及外观质量、铸件使用质量、铸造应力等方面的检测技术，从本质上认识金属凝固成形过程中各种参量的测试原理和方法，并能有针对性地制定相应测试方案。
default.en: This course is intended to enable students to master solidification forming detecting and measuring technique and to offer an opportunity letting students to develop their own knowledge in the field of metal solidification forming techniques, which lay a foundation for the sequent subject study of graduation thesis and working. The main contents of the course include: temperature measuring, gas content measuring, special thermal analysis technology, casting properties testing, casting mould materials measuring, casting internal quality and appearance quality detecting, casting stress detecting and so on. After learning this course, students will understand principles and methods of the detecting and measuring of the various parameters during metal solidification forming process essentially, and formulate testing program.

default.zh: 粉末冶金是一种集材料制备与零件成形于一体，节能、节材、高效、近净成形、少污染的先进制造技术，是材料科学与工程的的重要分支，在现代工业技术，粉末冶金在高性能材料和零件制造业中具有不可替代的地位和作用。粉末冶金技术课程主要讲授粉末冶金技术的基本原理和粉体材料的制备、检测、成形、烧结及最终处理等知识，其中重点讲授各种粉末成形理论及工艺、粉末烧结原理、烧结气氛和各种烧结技术、粉末冶金技术新发展等内容。
default.en: Powder metallurgy (PM) technology which combines materials preparation and forming is an advanced manufacturing due to its lower costs, great efficiency, net near shape forming and less pollution. PM is an important field of material science and engineering. PM plays an unparalleled part in the modern manufacturing of high performance materials and products. Courses of PM technology will introduce the basic principles of PM technology, the powder fabrication and test, powders forming, powders sintering and final treatment of PM products. The key knowledge points of this course are principles and technology of powders forming, sintering principles and sintering atmosphere, various sintering techniques and resent developments of powder metallurgy technology.

default.zh: 金属间化合物结构材料以其优良的高温力学性能，低的密度，优异抗氧化性等特点，成为在航空航天等领域具有极高应用潜力的新型材料。本课程旨在使学生掌握先进金属间化合物结构材料基本原理、科学规律和成形技术，要求学生重点掌握金属间化合物的结构与相图、性能特点及其改善方法、先进结构材料的制备与成形技术以及典型高温金属间化合物结构材料的基本特性，深化对金属间化合物结构材料相关理论与技术的理解，为本学科学生拓展知识面、或后续的相关毕业设计及从事相关工作奠定理论与技术基础。
default.en: Intermetallic Compounds（IC） is a novel competitively structural materials system due to their good creep and fatigue resistance, excellent high temperature mechanical properties, low density and oxidation resistance, which show excellent application potential in the field of aerospace. This course is intended to enable students to master fundamental, scientific discipline and forming technology of the advanced structural intermetallic compounds, and to offer an opportunity letting students to develop their own knowledge in the field of the advanced structural intermetallic compounds, which lay a foundation for the sequent subject study of graduation thesis and working.

default.zh: 本课程面向液态金属成形方向本科生，阐述镁合金液态金属成形的特点，旨在通过镁合金液态金属成形方法和原理的学习，使学生掌握镁合金液态金属成形的基本知识，并与生产实际相衔接。本课程以传热、传质及流体力学、物理化学、铸造工艺学、金属学为基础，阐述镁合金熔体处理、成分设计、铸造工艺、组织性能及质量控制的本质、规律和影响因素。
default.en: This course is given to graduate students casting major and the characterization of magnesium alloys is mainly elaborated. Its essential aim is to obtain the fundamentals of casting for magnesium alloys and to relate these fundamentals to practice and provide basic knowledge for magnesium alloys processes for the students in the casting field. This course builds on the fundamentals of heat flow, mass transport, hydromechanics, physical chemistry, casting process and metallography and describes nature, laws and affecting factors for remelting, composition design, casting process, microstructures and mechanical properties as well quality control of magnesium alloys.

default.zh: 与传统的平衡凝固相比，非平衡凝固技术是材料科学领域制备、开发先进合金材料的一种新方法。通过非平衡凝固，可以获得传统铸件或铸锭冷却速度下所不能获得的亚稳态合金新材料。非平衡凝固过程、非平衡凝固原理、非平衡凝固技术，非平衡的世界究竟具有怎样的奥秘？另一方面，新型非平衡凝固技术-增材制造，作为金属材料复杂构件的先进成形制造技术，有哪些特征？增材制造技术具有哪些独门秘技？在本门课程中，同学们可以找到上述问题的答案。希望与各位同学一起分享非平衡凝固科学技术与新材料的内涵及魅力！
default.en: Compared with conventional equilibrium solidification, non-equilibrium solidification technique is a new developed way to fabricate advanced alloy materials. By non-equilibrium cooling process, the obtained novel alloys have unique metastable state, which cannot be achieved by conventional solidification methods. What are the mysteries of the non-equilibrium solidification process, the non-equilibrium solidification principle, and the non-equilibrium solidification technology in the non-equilibrium world? On the other hand, the additive manufacturing, as the novel non-equilibrium solidification and advanced manufacturing technology for complex alloy components, what are its characteristics? What are the unique secrets of additive manufacturing technology? In this course, the attended students can find the answers to the above questions. It is hopeful to share with students the connotation and charm of non-equilibrium solidification science and technology, and novel materials!

default.zh: 先进材料精密液态成形课程旨在使学生掌握先进材料的精密液态成形工艺及其相关理论，了解先进材料及其成形的新理论、新方法和新进展；从而开拓学生知识广度，优化学生知识结构，提高学生在先进材料及成形方面的创新能力。 本课程主要讲授先进钛基合金及精密成形、先进镍基合金及精密成形、金属间化合物及其复合材料、金属基复合材料、多孔金属材料、微纳米结构高熵合金及复合材料等先进材料的制备工艺、成形方法、材料特点及其应用。
default.en: Advanced materials, precision liquid forming course is designed to enable students to master advanced materials, precision liquid forming process and its related theories. Understanding of advanced materials and forming new theories, new methods and new progress. To broaden students' knowledge breadth optimize the structure of students' knowledge. Improve students' ability to innovate in advanced materials and shaping. This course teaches advanced titanium-based alloys and precision forming, advanced nickel-based alloys and precision forming, intermetallic compounds and their composites. Metal Matrix Composites Porous metal material Preparation of micro nanostructured high-entropy alloys and composites and other advanced materials technology. Forming methods, materials, characteristics and applications.

default.zh: 艺术铸件是雕塑创作和科学技术相结合的艺术工程产物。它的生产包括雕塑创作、翻制模具、制作雕塑、合金选择、熔炼浇注、清理、修理、组装、表面处理等工序。 本课程针对艺术铸件的要求和特点，从艺术铸造的鉴赏开始，详细介绍了制作各种艺术铸件的铸造技法，原辅材料、连接、着色、清理、打磨、精修等艺术品后处理方法和技巧。艺术铸造是铸造的一个重要分支，同时也是一门与文化艺术等多门类学科相结合的交叉学科。
default.en: Art casting is the combination of art sculpture invention and casting science and technology. Its processing includes art sculpture inventing, mould preparing, sculpture producing, alloys choosing, melting and pouring, cleaning, repairing, assembling, surface treating and so on. Based on the requirement and characteristic of art castings, from the appreciation of art castings, this course introduces different art casting methods, raw materials, jointing, color up, cleaning, polishing, repairing and post processing and technique. Art casting is an important division of casting, and is a multi disciplinary subject.

default.zh: 非晶合金作为一种奇特的新型亚稳金属材料，又称为金属玻璃和液态金属，由于其独特的长程无序微观结构，表现出比常规晶态材料更为优异的物理、化学和力学性能。作为一种具有优异综合性能的材料，非晶合金具有广阔的应用前景，可应用于航空、航天、汽车、化工、能源、军事等领域。本课程主要讲述新型非晶合金的形成原理、制备工艺、组织结构特征、性能特点及应用前景，为学生正确理解和今后从事与非晶合金新材料研究、制备相关的工作奠定理论基础。
default.en: As a novel class of advanced metastable materials, amorphous alloys exhibit excellent physical, chemical and mechanical properties resulted from the long-range disordered structure. Due to the unique properties, amorphous alloys have widespread application fields such as spaceflight, auto industry, chemical engineering, energy and military affairs etc. In this course, the formation mechanism, processing technique, microstructure, properties and applications of novel amorphous alloys will be introduced, which will help to provide basically theoretical foundation for the students engaged in the study of relatively novel metastable materials in the future.

default.zh: 与传统的铸造工艺相比，喷射成形技术是材料科学领域制备、开发具有优异性能材料和功能梯度材料的一种新方法。通过喷射成形方法制备的材料组织细化、成分均匀，力学性能改善。本课程将讲授喷射成形技术的基本原理及其应用，包括金属雾化过程、金属液滴的热力学与动力学行为、金属液滴的沉积与凝固、喷射成形过程的优化控制、喷射成形材料的组织与性能以及工业化应用现状与分析等。
default.en: Compared with conventional casting method, spray forming technique is a new developed way to fabricate multifunctional composites and novel microstructures materials with excellent properties. By spray forming process, the obtained materials have unique compositions, which cannot be achieved by conventional cooling method and will improve the properties of the materials. Therefore, the materials fabricated by spray forming route exhibit widespread applications. In this course, the basically theoretical principle and application of spray forming, such as atomizing, thermodynamics, dynamics and microstructural evolution, the deposition and solidification, and the typical properties and applications of materials prepared by spray forming method will be introduced.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍Pro/Engineer软件的特点、功能和设计流程，讲授软件的基本使用，绘制零件的一般过程，常用基本命令操作，基准特征与模型分析、特征建立、工程特征，典型零件的三维实体造型过程等。通过本课程的学习和上机操作，使学生了解和掌握Pro/E的基本功能与模块组成，掌握运用Pro/E进行典型零、部件的三维实体设计方法，获得产品设计、开发技能的基本训练，为学生用现代化手段从事工程设计奠定坚实的基础。
