default.en: This course mainly introduces the characteristics, the function of Pro/Engineer software and design process, interpret the basic use of the software, the general process of drawing parts, common typical commands, feature and model analysis, feature construction, engineering characteristics, the 3D solid modeling process of typical parts etc. Through the study and computer operation of this course, students can understand and master the basic function and module of the software Pro/Engineer, master the 3D solids design method of typical parts and components by using Pro/E, obtain the basic training of product design and development skills, and lay a solid foundation for students to engage in engineering design with modern means.

default.zh: 本课程主要是使学生了解显微分析、断口分析、光谱分析、能谱与波普分析、X射线光电子能谱分析、DTA/DSC分析、EBSD分析等分析方法，掌握这些分析方法的样品制备方法和实际使用技巧，加强这些分析方法与其它专业课的联系，提高上述各种分析测试方法在材料科学和材料成形等领域中的实际应用能力，为学生今后从事研究、技术开发、生产等工作奠定分析测试方面的知识基础。
default.en: This course is intended to enable students to understand modern analytical methods, such as microscopic analysis, fracture analysis, spectroscopy analysis, EDX, XPS, DTA/DSC, EBSD and so on, upon the basis that the students have studied the fundamental theory of the methods, and to master sample preparation methods and practical tips of these modern analytical methods. This course will offer an opportunity letting students to develop their practical ability of these modern analytical methods in the field of materials science and materials forming, which lay a foundation for the sequent subject study of graduation thesis and working.

default.zh: 本课程重点在于使学生熟悉材料成型及控制工程（铸造）行业工程师必须熟知的标准内容，培养对象为毕业后有志于在企业、研究所工作，或将来攻读硕士学位后从事工程类课题的学生。课程内容包括铸造标准基本要素、铸造设备标准、铸造材料及工艺标准以及其他领域的专用铸造标准。目的是培养学生了解、运用国家标准、国际标准和行业标准的能力，提高学生对国内外标准进行转化应用的能力，为学生从事金属液态成型工程实际应用奠定基础。
default.en: The emphasis of this course is to provide students the content that must be well known by the engineers in the field of material forming and control engineering (casting). Training objects are the undergraduates aspired to work in the enterprise or research institutes after graduate, or engaged in the engineering project in the future of master degree. The content includes the basic elements of foundry standard，the foundry equipment standards, the standards related to casting material and process and the special casting standard in other fields. The lecture can help student raise the ability of understanding and using national standards, international standards and industry standards, and improve students' ability to translate and apply the domestic and foreign standards, which can build the foundation for the students to be engaged in the engineering application of metal liquid forming.

default.zh: 核材料是未来世界获取核能、掌握核武器资源的物质基础。核材料主要有哪些？获取核能、制造核武器的基本原理与区别是什么？核能作为一种新型能源，在未来的应用会越来越广。核电站作为提供核能的重要设施，其安全性举足轻重。如何安全稳定的获取核能、利用核能？通过本门课程的学习，同学们可以找到上述问题的答案，掌握核反应基本理论、核燃料等典型核材料的特点及应用。希望与同学们一起走进核的世界，聚焦前沿、突破瓶颈！
default.en: Nuclear materials are the substance basis for the future world to obtain nuclear energy and acquire nuclear weapon resources. What are the main nuclear materials? What are the basic principles and differences in the acquisition of nuclear energy and the manufacture of nuclear weapons? The nuclear power, which is known as a novel power, will have widespread applications in the future. Therefore, the safety of nuclear power plants as the supplement of nuclear power is very important. How to obtain and use nuclear energy safely and stably? Through the study of this course, the attended students can find the answers to the above questions and master the basic theory of nuclear reaction, the characteristics and applications of typical nuclear materials such as nuclear fuel. It is hopeful to join the students into the nuclear world, for focusing on the leading edge and breaking through the technique bottlenecks.

default.zh: 雾化粉末成形技术是材料科学领域制备、开发具有优异性能材料的一种新方法。通过雾化方法制备的粉体材料，具有传统铸件或铸锭冷却速度下所不能获得的成分、相结构或显微结构，进而达到改善、提高产品性能的目的。因此，雾化粉末新材料具有广阔的应用前景。本课程将讲授雾化粉体材料制备的基本原理，包括传热特点、热力学与动力学，组织演变规律；雾化粉体材料的制备技术；雾化粉体材料的致密化技术；雾化粉体材料的性能与应用。
default.en: Consolidation technique of atomized powder is a new developed way to fabricate novel materials with excellent properties. By atomization process, the obtained powder materials have unique compositions, phases and microstructures, which cannot be achieved by conventional solidification method and will improve the properties of the materials. Therefore, the materials fabricated by atomization route exhibit widespread applications. In this course, the basically theoretical principle of atomized solidification for the powder materials, such as heat transferring, thermodynamics, dynamics and microstructural evolution, the techniques of the fabrication and densification for the atomized powders, and the typical properties and applications of materials prepared by atomization method will be introduced.

default.zh: 增材制造技术是集成了计算机、数控、高能束和新材料等技术而发展起来的先进制造技术，随着该学科的发展，其研究深度和广度逐渐延伸。增材制造技术采用电子束、激光、离子束在计算机的控制下按零件截面轮廓的信息有选择性地熔化金属粉末，并通过层层堆积，直至整个零件全部熔化完成。最后，去除多余的粉末便得到所需的三维产品。本课程的主要任务是在前期的知识积累下，通过本课程的学习，让学生做到以下几点： 1.掌握增材制造的基本原理； 2.掌握增材制造的建模、数据分析和剖分等处理方法； 3.掌握高能束直接成形金属制件的机理和应用情况； 4.了解增材制造未来的发展方向。
default.en: Additive Manufacturing technology, also known as rapid prototyping, integrated computer, CNC, high-energy beam and new materials technology and advanced manufacturing technology development, with the development of the discipline, its research depth and breadth has a gradual extension. Additive manufacturing technology using electron beam, laser, ion beam under the control of the computer by the cross-sectional contour of parts information selectively melting the metal powder, and through the layer deposited, until the entire part is completely melted. Finally, the whole process is finished after the removal of the excess powder. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the follows: 1 know the basic principles of additive manufacturing . 2 know the growth modeling, data analysis and triangulation methods of additive manufacturing. 3 know the mechanism and application of directly shaping metal parts by high energy beam. 4 understand the future development direction of additive manufacturing.

default.zh: 《液态成形理论基础 B》课程面向塑性成形方向本科生，旨在通过金属液态成形及其凝固过程基本现象和原理的学习，使学生掌握液态成形的基本理论知识。本课程以传热、传质及流体力学、金属学为基础，阐述凝固过程的本质、规律和影响因素，课程系统给出了从溶质分配到凝固界面转变的全套凝固理论体系。课程贯穿了从控制形状、控制组织结构与缺陷到控制性能的全部内容以及合金性质、铸型性质、浇注条件和铸件结构四方面因素。
default.en: This course is given to graduate students for plastic forming major. Its essential aim is to obtain the fundamentals of solidification processing and provide basic knowledge for subsequent casting processes for the students in the plastic forming field. This course builds on the fundamentals of heat flow, mass transport, hydromechanics and metallography and describes nature, laws and affecting factors. It comprehensively analyzes the theories on solute redistribution and interface change, and deals with controlling in shaping, microstructure and defects as well as properties and influencing factors, such as alloy, mould, pouring conditions and cast structure.

default.zh: 本课程是材料成型及控制工程的一门专业方向限选课程，通过对专业性阅读和写作基础理论知识、基本技能和方法实践的学习，培养学生掌握材料成型及控制工程领域科技文献的阅读与写作要素及其构成，系统性地了解期刊论文、学位论文、会议论文和专利文献的检索、查阅、精读与泛读和基本写作技能与要求，强化在材料成型及控制工程专业方向的知识基础以及对专业词汇的吸收和掌握，增强运用专业性思维来分析和解决问题的能力和素质，为课程学习和从事工程技术及科研等实践与创新奠定基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程学习要求如下：1）学习掌握专业性文献的检索、阅读和专业论文的基本写作方法、认识基本规律和培养基本素质，为今后的学习工作奠定基础；2）为继续学习专业理论知识提供良好的机会，熟悉材料成形专业的中、英文专业表达方式和术语词汇，重点掌握材料成型及控制工程科技文献的阅读与写作技能；3）培养和提高运用科技语言来表达专业知识的能力，特别为课程学习和从事工程技术与科研等实践与创新中快速获得最新专业信息、解决实际问题奠定基础。
default.en: This course is a limited-selection course in the field of Material forming and control engineering. Through the study of basic theoretical knowledge, basic skills and method practice of professional reading and writing, students are trained to master the elements and composition of reading and writing scientific and technological literature in the field of material forming and control engineering. Systematically understand the retrieval, review, intensive and extensive reading and basic writing skills and requirements of journal papers, academic dissertations, conference papers and patent documents, strengthen the knowledge base of solidification and forming majors, absorb and master professional vocabulary, and enhance the ability and quality of analyzing and solving problems with professional thinking. It lays a foundation for course study and practice and innovation in engineering technology and scientific research, and supports the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results. The course learning requirements are as follows: 1) To learn and master the basic methods of retrieving and reading professional documents and writing professional papers, to understand the basic laws and to cultivate basic qualities, to lay the foundation for future study and work, 2) To provide a good opportunity for further study of professional theoretical knowledge, familiar with professional expressions and terminology in Chinese and English (material forming and control engineering), and focus on mastering the reading and writing skills of professional (material forming and control engineering) scientific and technical literature, 3) Cultivate and improve the ability to express professional knowledge with scientific and technological language, especially to lay a foundation for quickly obtaining the latest professional information and solving practical problems in course learning and practice and innovation of engineering technology and scientific research.

default.zh: 近年来，人工智能作为新兴技术得到了快速发展和推广，在材料科学中体现为材料基因，成为今后材料科学与工程学科研究模式发展的趋势，有利于加快材料的研发速度，降低成本。为适应这种模式转变，对接国家科技创新战略、顺应材料学科发展潮流，特为本科生专门开设本课程。主要授课内容涉及数据驱动的材料科学概述、数据库与数据标准、高通量计算、实验方法与案例，并将较为系统地讲授机器学习算法及案例等。本课程旨在使学生了解数据驱动材料科学的内涵及趋势；理解和掌握材料加工人工智能技术的基本概念与内涵；具备应用材料加工人工智能技术手段解决材料设计问题能力，是材料专业本科生获得材料加工人工智能技术基础技能、接轨国际研究热点的有效途径。
default.en: In recent years, as emerging disciplines, big data and artificial intelligence have achieved rapid development and promotion. In the field of materials science, they are manifested as the "Materials Genome," becoming a future trend in the research paradigm of materials science and engineering. This trend is conducive to accelerating material R&D and reducing costs. To adapt to this paradigm shift, align with the national strategy for scientific and technological innovation, and follow the developmental trend of materials science, this course is specially designed for undergraduate students. The main teaching content covers an overview of data-driven materials science, databases and data standards, high-throughput computing, experimental methods and case studies, as well as a systematic introduction to machine learning algorithms and their applications. The course aims to enable students to: 1) understand the connotations and trends of data-driven materials science; 2) comprehend and master the basic concepts of artificial intelligence technologies in material processing; and 3) acquire the ability to solve material design problems using artificial intelligence techniques in material processing. It serves as an effective pathway for undergraduate students in materials science to obtain fundamental skills in material processing AI technologies and connect with international research frontiers.

default.zh: 材料成形过程工业机器人感知技术课程以成形加工技术现代化与数字化为背景，主要介绍材料加工过程中的测控主要软硬件的原理及其使用。其主要内容包括：材料成形过程中的基本概念，常用仪器仪表，误差处理方法，非电量测量中常用传感器的基本原理和应用，监控软件简介，成形过程中工业机器人的使用及原理。
default.en: The course of Sensing Technology for Industrial Robots in Material Forming Processes is mainly based on the modernization and digitalization of metal forming technology. The main contents of the course are following: The concept of measurement and controlling; the hardware and software in the deformation process; commonly used instrument and meter; error processing method; sensors used in the process; application and principle of industrial robot in forming process.

default.zh: 塑性成形科技英语课程的学习不仅能够为学生继续学习英语提供良好的机会，而且能够使学生熟练掌握塑性成形英语术语，掌握塑性成形英文科技文献的阅读与写作，培养和提高学生运用英语来表达塑性成形专业知识的能力，从而为学生将来直接运用英语获得本专业的最新信息及解决实际问题奠定基础，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: The Course of Plastic Forming Technology English provides a good opportunity for students to continue learning English. It will enable students to master the English terms of plastic forming, master the reading and writing of scientific and technical literature of plastic forming in English, and cultivate and improve students' ability to express professional knowledge of plastic forming in English. This course will lay a foundation for students to directly use English to obtain the latest information of the major and solve practical problems in the future, and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in the learning results of the major.

default.zh: 先进的分析方法与技术是开展先进材料成形必不可少的手段，是提高材料成型质量的重要保障，数字化测量分析技术是基于这一发展需求而发展的，通过分析材料的变形情况，获得三维方向上的应变分布，建立成形极限图，可用于评价板材和管件的成形性能，揭示材料成形过程中的失效形成机制，为解决成形中的各种缺陷提供理论分析基础。本课程主要讲授数字化测量和应变分析的理论基础和基本方法。拓宽材料成型专业学生的知识结构，拓展学生的工程化应用能力。
default.en: Advanced analysis methods and technology is the key to carry out advanced material forming, and improve the material forming quality. Digital measurement and analysis technology is based on the development needs by the analysis of material deformation, it can acquire three-dimensional direction of strain distribution and the forming limit diagram. The technology can be used to evaluate the forming performance of sheet and tube, reveal material forming process of failure mechanism in order to solve the various forming defects to provide the basis of theoretical analysis. According to the newest research progress on foreign strain analysis theory, the course has combined with plastic forming of sheet metal forming, pipe forming and die forging forming, the digital measurement and strain analysis of the theoretical basis and basic methods will be taught. The course will broaden students' knowledge structure and expand their engineering application ability.

default.zh: 本课程为材料成型及控制工程专业的选修课，通过向学生讲授材料加工领域模具制造过程中的主要加工工艺和基本原理，使学生了解和初步掌握模具的主要加工制造技术和模具表面处理技术、拓宽知识面、提高工程实践能力。本课程主要讲授模具的分类、模具材料的种类及热处理、模具零件的传统机械加工工艺、模具型面的数控加工技术、模具的表面加工技术和表面处理技术。
default.en: This course is the elective course for undergraduate students in the major of material molding and control engineering. The course introduces the main manufacturing technology and basic principle for die and tooling in the fields of material processing. Students can know some main manufacturing technologies and surface treatment technologies. The aim is to broaden students' scope of the knowledge and improve the ability of engineering practice. The main contents of this course include: mould classification, types of mould materials and heat treatment, the traditional machining processing of mould parts, NC machining technology for mould surface, the surface processing and treatment technologies for mould.

default.zh: 纳米材料制备与成形课程主要以最新科学研究前沿为背景，主要介绍纳米材料概念，纳米材料的特殊物理化学性质及其成因，讲授隧道扫描显微镜，原子力显微镜等介观工具的基本原理与加工中的应用，同时介绍不同种类的纳米材料的制备方法，其设计团簇，纳米粉末，纳米纤维，纳米膜，纳米块体材料，纳米复合材料及纳米结构，并使学生在了解知识的基础上，获得获取最新科研信息及独立进行未知领域学习的能力。
default.en: The course of preparation and deforming of nanometer materials is mainly based on the newest development of scientific research. The main contents of the course are following: The concept of Nano-materials; the special properties of nanomaterials and causes; the fundamental theory and application of STM and AFM in characterization and manufacturing; nanotechnology and micro-manufacturing; preparing method for all kind of nanomaterials. The material of the course will include: cluster; nano-powder; nano-fibre; nano-film; bulk nanomaterials, nano-composite and nano structure.

default.zh: 本课程讲授不同尺度下材料行为的数值模拟方法和应用范围，介绍不同层次模拟方法的联系与耦合思想，讲解数值模拟基于商业软件和开源软件的实现，并探讨多尺度模拟中亟待解决的关键技术及其发展方向。通过本课程的学习，加深学生对材料塑性成形过程的认识，培养其材料模拟研究的理念与思维模式，拓展其对开源软件的认识，提高其对科学问题多层次、多角度思考的能力。
default.en: This course teaches numerical simulation methods and application scope of material behavior at different scales, introduces the connection and coupling ideas of simulation methods at different levels, explains the implementation of numerical simulation based on commercial and open source software, and explores key technologies and development directions that need to be addressed in multi-scale simulation. Through the study of this course, students will deepen their understanding of the plastic forming process of materials, cultivate their concepts and thinking patterns in material simulation research, expand their understanding of open source software, and improve their ability to think at multiple levels and perspectives on scientific problems.

default.zh: 板材成形仿真软件及应用课程是一门培养运用数值模拟的手段解决金属板材成形问题的专业选修课，使学生加强数值模拟基础知识的运用能力，掌握1-2种软件的基本功能和使用方法，并能进行板材成形过程数值模拟分析，适应材料加工学科新技术的发展，课程具有较强的专业性和实用性。课程内容如下： 1、 板材成形数值模拟的应用现状、基本方法、软件种类及基本结构； 2、 板材成形数值模拟的前处理基础和后处理基础； 3、 1-2种板材成形数值模拟软件的基本功能和使用方法。
default.en: Sheet forming simulation software and application is a major selective course aiming to training students the ability to solve the problem in sheet metal forming processing by using numerical simulation method. It is set up in order to enhance students the application ability of numerical simulation foundation knowledge and make them to grasp the basic function and method of one or two software for the analysis of sheet metal forming process. The course has a strong professional practicality, so as to keep up with the development of new technique and broaden knowledge of students. The main contents of this course are as follows: 1． The state and art of application, basic method, classify and main structure of numerical simulation for sheet metal forming. 2． Basic knowledge of pre-processing and post-processing of numerical simulation method. 3． Main functions and practical using method of one or two numerical simulation software for sheet metal forming.

default.zh: 超塑性成形是一种快速发展的材料先进成形技术，可在一次工艺中完成整体复杂形状零件的近净成形，具有材料塑性好，成形力小，成形件质量高及近无加工余量等优点，是航空航天领域中进行板材成形的一项新技术。本课程是以掌握各种先进材料的超塑性成形为目标，介绍了超塑性成形实现条件、原理及国内外应用情况，针对不同材料的超塑性成形及应用，进行模具设计、工艺优化及数值模拟等方面的教学。并根据超塑性成形发展的国际前沿，教授目前超塑性成形的最新方法及实现条件。在系统掌握超塑性成形相关知识的前提下，开拓视野，提高其发现问题并解决问题的能力。
default.en: Introduction to the Course of Superplastic Forming Principles and Applications in Chinese and English Course Code：22MS32308 Course Title：Principles and Applications of Superplastic Forming Credit Hours：16 Lecture： 16 Lab： Computer Lab: Practical: Tutoring: Credit(s)：1 Offering Department: Materials Science and Engineering School/Division of Students:Material forming and control engineering Term: Spring Prerequisites: mechanical properties of metals 2.Course Description Superplastic forming is a rapid developing forming technology of advanced materials, the overall complex shape parts near net shape can be performed in a single process. It owns many advantages, including good plasticity of the material, low forming force, high quality of the formed parts and nearly no allowance etc.. it is a new technology of sheet metal forming in the aerospace field. The target of this course is to master the superplastic forming of a variety of advanced materials. Superplastic forming conditions, principles and application situation at home and abroad will be learned. Superplastic forming for different materials and applications, mold design, process optimization, and numerical simulation etc. will be studied. The superplastic forming development and the new techology of the international frontier will also be introduced. On the basis of totally master premise superplastic forming knowledge, broading student’s horizons and improve the ability to identify problems and solve the problem. Author: Shaosong Jiang Reviewer：Kehuan Wang Date：2024.3.5

default.zh: 现代锻造技术是指以等温精密成形技术为代表的新兴锻造技术，等温精密成形技术是指坯料和模具在几乎恒定的温度条件下模锻成形，所成形的制件达到或接近产品零件的形状和尺寸，主要用于航空、航天等行业复杂形状锻件的精密成形，它是在传统塑性加工基础上发展起来的一项新技术。本课程目的是使学生掌握等温精密成形技术原理，了解等温精密成形技术特点，拓宽学生的专业知识面，重点培养学生分析问题和解决问题能力。 主要讲授等温精密塑性成形技术的起源及发展过程，等温精密成形技术原理、特点，装备及工艺设计，典型锻件工艺设计，关键技术如闭塞式锻造成形、分流成形、局部加载和浮动凹模成形等，等温精密成形缺陷控制技术等。教学重点是典型锻件工艺设计，等温精密成形中的各种关键技术及成形缺陷控制技术，教学难点是典型锻件工艺设计，各种关键技术的原理、应用范围及其优缺点。
default.en: Today forging technology refers to the emerging forging technology represented by isothermal precision forming technology. Isothermal precision forming technology refers to the forging of billets and dies under almost constant temperature conditions, and the formed parts reach or approach the shape and size of product parts. It is mainly used for precision forming of complex shaped forgings in industries such as aviation and aerospace. It is a new technology developed on the basis of traditional plastic processing. The purpose of this course is to enable students to master the principles of isothermal precision forming technology, understand the characteristics of isothermal precision forming technology, broaden their professional knowledge, and focus on cultivating students' ability to analyze and solve problems. Mainly teaching the origin and development process of isothermal precision plastic forming technology, the principles, characteristics, equipment and process design of isothermal precision forming technology, typical forging process design, key technologies such as closed forging forming, split flow forming, local loading and floating die forming, and defect control technology of isothermal precision forming. The teaching focus is on typical forging process design, various key technologies in isothermal precision forming, and forming defect control technology. The teaching difficulty is typical forging process design, the principles, application scope, and advantages and disadvantages of various key technologies.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍管材内高压成形、板材液压成形、难变形材料气体介质压力成形及封闭壳体无模液压成形的工艺原理、现状和发展趋势、特点和适用范围，以及关键工艺参数计算、基本工艺规范和工艺控制途径，典型应用实例及其创新思路。通过本课程的学习，使学生系统地掌握现代液压成形技术的基本知识，扩大知识面，提高学生分析、解决相关实际技术问题的能力，适应企业人才需求。培养学生严谨的科学态度，理论联系实际的优良学风和勇于创新的科学精神。
default.en: In this course, the tube internal high pressure forming, sheet hydroforming, hot gas medium forming and shell hydroforming are introduced at the aspects of process principle, characteristics, present state, trend of development and applicability, and key process parameters, basic process standard and process control are involved. Typical applications and original innovations are also introduced. With the course, students can systematically grasp the basic knowledge about modern fluid medium pressure forming technologies, enlarge the knowledge range, and improve the ability of analyzing and solving the practical problems, meeting the demand of enterprises. During the course, scientific attitude, good style of study and creative spirit are educated.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22MS32311 课程名称： 塑性成形件质量分析与控制 课程英文名称：Quality Analysis and Control of Plastic Formed Parts 总学时： 理论学时：16 实验学时：0 上机学时： 0 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1.0 开课单位：材料科学与工程学院 材料工程系 授课对象：材料成型及控制工程专业本科三年级学生 开课学期：1春 先修课程：无 二、课程简介 《塑性成形件质量分析与控制》是材料科学与工程学院本科生的专业选修课。授课对象为材料成型及控制工程专业本科学生。课程包括锻件的主要质量问题类型、工艺不当产生的质量缺陷、主要塑性成形工序的质量问题、大型锻件和冲压成形件的质量问题等内容。本课程授课的指导思想是通过基础知识和实际案例的介绍，增加学生对塑性成形件质量问题分析与控制相关知识的认知，基本掌握相关基础知识，具有初步的辨识、描述、分析和解决工程问题的能力。通过对《塑性成形件质量分析与控制》课程的学习，拓宽学生知识面，使学生能够辨识塑性成形件的质量问题，能够描述产生质量缺陷的原因和控制方法，结合工程实例初步给出解决方法。
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22MS32311 Course Title：Quality Analysis and Control of Plastic Formed Parts Credit Hours： Lecture: 16 Lab: 0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：1.0 Offering Department: Department of Materials Engineering School of Materials Science and Engineering Students: undergraduate students majoring in Materials Forming and Control Engineering Term: Spring Prerequisites: None 2.Course Description " Quality Analysis and Control of Plastic Formed Parts " is an electve course for undergraduate students in the School of Materials Science and Engineering. The course is designed for undergraduate students majoring in Materials Forming and Control Engineering. It covers topics such as the main types of quality in forgings, quality defects caused by improper processes, quality issues in major plastic forming processes, and quality issues in large forgings and stamped parts. The guiding principle of this course is to increase students' awareness of the analysis and control of defects in plastic forming parts through the introduction of fundamental knowledge and practical cases. Students are expected to acquire basic knowledge and develop preliminary abilities to identify, describe, analyze, and solve engineering problems related to defects in plastic forming parts. Through the study of " Quality Analysis and Control of Plastic Formed Parts " students will broaden their knowledge base. They will be able to identify the types of defects in plastic forming parts, describe the causes and control methods of quality, and give preliminary solutions combined with engineering examples.

default.zh: 体积成形模拟软件及应用课程是一门用以培养运用数值模拟的手段解决材料成型与控制中的问题能力的专业选修课，是为了使学生加强基础知识的应用能力，适应材料加工学科高新技术的发展，拓宽知识面而设立的。本课程讲授体积成形数值模拟的基本原理、基本方法、应用软件等，包括体积成形有限元的基本理论、基本求解方法、体积变形、体积成型数值模拟的关键技术、应用软件的介绍和实践、体积成形典型问题的数值模拟的解决方法等。
default.en: The Bulk Forming Simulation Software and Application Course is a professional elective course aimed at cultivating the ability to use numerical simulation methods to solve problems in material forming and control. It is designed to strengthen students' ability to apply basic knowledge, adapt to the development of high-tech materials processing, and broaden their knowledge. This course teaches the basic principles, methods, and application software of numerical simulation of bulk forming, including the basic theory and solution methods of finite element method for bulk forming, bulk deformation, key technologies of numerical simulation of bulk forming, introduction and practice of application software, and solutions to numerical simulation of typical problems in bulk forming.

default.zh: 《弹塑性力学基础B》课程是材料科学与工程类学生重要的专业核心课，着力培养学生综合运用弹性与塑性力学理论和方法解决材料设计、成型与控制问题的能力，是后续专业课如体积成形原理与方法、板材成形原理与方法、材料成形有限元分析基础、材料成形设备与控制、材料成形综合实验等课程的基础。
default.en: Fundamentals of Elastoplastic Mechanics B is an important course for materials science and engineering students. It cultivates students' ability to comprehensively apply elastic and plastic mechanics theories and methods to solve material design, molding and control problems. It is the foundation of subsequent specialized courses such as principle and method of volume forming, principle and method of sheet metal forming, basis of finite element analysis of material forming, material forming equipment and control, and comprehensive experiment of material forming.

default.zh: 本课程旨在系统介绍金属非平衡凝固的基本理论框架，着重了解金属非平衡凝固中的基本理论问题，包括热力学与动力学、溶质再分配、成分过冷、热传导等，阐述微重力、超声、电磁场等特殊物理场条件下的金属非平衡凝固的基础问题，介绍非平衡凝固缺陷形成基本理论及控制方法。通过学习和课堂讨论，学生应了解与掌握金属非平衡凝固的基本理论，尤其是非平衡凝固的热力学与动力学条件及形貌演变基本规律。同时，本课程拓宽学生的专业知识面，提高其在金属非平衡凝固理论与增材制造技术方面的研究与创新能力。
default.en: The basic theories and problems of nonequilibrium solidification of metals will be introduced in details in this course. This course will introduce basic theories of nonequilibrium solidification, including dynamics and thermodynamics, solute distribution, undercooling and heat transfer. Fundamentals of nonequilibrium solidification under particular physical fields including microgravity, ultrasonic field and electromagnetic field will be stated. The theories of defect formation and controlling during nonequilibrium solidification will be also introduced. Through the course learning and discussion, the students will know the fundamentals of nonequilibrium solidification of metals, especially the dynamics and thermodynamics, and the microstructural evolution. The purpose of this course is to broaden the professional knowledge of the students, and to improve their innovation in nonequilibrium solidification theories of metals and additive manufacturing processing,

default.zh: 本课程将系统讲授各类金属粉体制备技术的原理、粉末特征及其应用情况等，重点讲授粉末雾化制备过程的传热及凝固行为，讲授物理和化学法粉末制备技术的热力学和动力学理论；同时拓展讲授粉末的固结过程和应用。本课程为学生正确理解和今后从事与增材制造研究相关的工作奠定知识基础。
default.en: This course will systematically teach the principles, characteristics and applications of various kinds of metal powder preparation techniques, with emphasis on the heat transfer and solidification behavior in the process of powder atomization, to teach the theory of thermodynamics and kinetics of powder preparation by physical and chemical methods, and to develop the consolidation process and application of powder. This course lays the foundation for students' understanding and future work related to additive manufacturing.

default.zh: 这是一门综合性介绍3D打印技术的课程，旨在帮助学生正确了解3D打印技术的发展与应用情况，掌握不同3D打印技术的基本专业知识，并客观认识3D打印技术在制造业中的发展潜力。课程首先总体介绍3D打印技术的概念、起源与发展、技术分类与工艺特点、应用领域、国内外的研究应用状况及发展趋势等概况。进一步，详细介绍3D打印生产链涉及的加工工艺，包括了计算机、机械设计、激光加工等多门跨学科知识的理解与应用。课程将综合性地介绍3D打印技术在建筑、医疗、商业、工业等不同领域的应用与发展情况，并指导学生从市场、发展历史、应用、技术挑战等多方面客观分析3D打印技术的发展。
default.en: This course will present a comprehensive introduction for the 3D printing technology, the purpose is to help students understand the development and application of 3D printing, master the basic professional knowledge of different 3D printing method, and know its development potential. The course begins with a general introduction to the 3D printing technology, including concept, origin and development, technical classification and processing characteristics, application area, current situation and developing trend and so on. Then the laser processing technology of 3D printing production chain is explained in detail, which involves in the compute, mechanical design, laser processing and so on. At the same time, the course will give an overview of application and development for 3D printing technology in construction, medical, commercial, industrial and other different fields, and guide students to better understand the 3D printing technology development from the market, development history, application and technical challenges aspects. To broaden the understanding of 3D printing key technology in industrial products, some typical components in aerospace, medical equipment are chosen as the examples to explain their manufacturing process and major technical challenges in detail.

default.zh: 结构功能一体化增材制造技术是增材制造类相关方向学生需要学习掌握的一门专业选修课程。通过课程的学习，使学生了解结构功能一体化3D打印技术的起源、发展与特点，掌握技术的分类FDM、DIW、光固化、选择性激光烧结等3D打印技术的发展现状及未来应用前景；通过学习结构功能一体化概念、设计理论及应用场景，使学生掌握全新的材料–结构–工艺–性能一体化“并行模式”的设计方法，在复杂整体构件内部同步实现多材料设计与布局、多层级结构创新与打印，以主动实现构件的高性能和多功能；通过学习先进材料3D打印原理、过程及应用，使学生掌握“材料–结构–性能一体化增材制造”的跨尺度调控原理及方法，包括微观尺度的材料组织与界面调控、介观尺度的结构设计及致密化工艺控制、宏观尺度的构件结构与性能协调控制；了解结构功能一体化电磁超材料、力学超材料、光学超材料的制造技术及应用；掌握结构功能一体化材料3D打印制备技术，包括材料制备、3D建模、切片设置、3D打印及后处理工艺等。
default.en: Structural and functional integration of manufacturing technology is an optional course that students need to learn and master. Through the study of the course, students can understand the origin, development and characteristics of 3D printing technology with structural and functional integration, and master the development status and future application prospect of new-style 3D printing technologies (such as FDM, DIW, light curing, selective laser sintering and so on). Through studying the concept of structural-functional integration, design theory and application scenarios, students need to master the new design method of "parallel mode" of material-structure-process-performance integration. synchronously realize multi-material design and layout, multi-level structural innovation and printing within complex integral components, so as to further realize high performance and multi-function of components. Through learning the principle, process and application of 3D printing of advanced materials, students need to master the cross-scale tailoring principle and method of "material-structure-performance integrated increasing material manufacturing", including micro-scale material structure and interface tailoring, mesoscopic-scale structure design and densification process control, macro-scale component structure and performance coordinated control. Furthermore, to understand the manufacturing technology and application of structural and functional integrated electromagnetic metamaterials, mechanical metamaterials and optical metamaterials; To master the 3D printing preparation technology of structural and functional integrated materials, including material preparation, 3D modeling, slice setting, 3D printing and post-processing technology, etc.

default.zh: 4D打印技术自2013年提出以来就引起了学术界和工业界的广泛关注，它属于智能构件的增材制造技术，是在材料、机械、力学、信息等学科高度交叉基础上产生的颠覆性制造技术。本课程主要介绍4D打印技术的概念和内涵、4D打印的技术特点和制约因素以及4D打印材料的不同变形驱动机制，结合4D打印技术在智能构件设计、模拟仿真、数据处理与工艺规划、成形工艺与装备和智能构件的功能测评等方面内容的介绍，详细阐述聚合物及其复合材料、金属及其复合材料、陶瓷及其复合材料等几种不同材料4D打印技术的技术特点，最终介绍4D打印技术的应用前景与展望。本课程的主要任务是使学生具备选用掌握的适宜的理论来分析与解决毕业设计试验中的实际问题，良好的表达能力以及独立解决问题的科研能力。
default.en: 4D printing technology has aroused widespread attention in the academic and industrial communities since its conceptualization in 2013. It is an additive manufacturing technology for fabricating intelligent components and a revolutionary manufacturing technology based on the high degree of cross-integration of the disciplines including materials, mechanical engineering, dynamics, information, etc. This course clarifies the concept and connotation of 4D printing and introduces the technical feature and limitation factors of this technology. Different “driving”effect of external stimuli on the material are presented as well. The state of the art of intelligent component design, simulation, manufacturing processes & equipment, and functional evaluation of intelligent components in 4D printing are also introduced. The technical characteristics of 4D printing technology for polymer and its composite materials, metal and its composite materials, ceramic and its composite materials and other different materials are described in detail. Finally, this course introduces the application prospects of 4D printing in aerospace, automotive, biomedical, software robots, etc. The main task of this course is to make students have the ability to analyze and solve practical problems in graduation project experiments with appropriate theories, and have good expression ability and scientific research ability to solve problems independently.

default.zh: 作为智能制造的重要组成，增材制造备受关注，已成为热点研究领域，但其应用基础仍待突破。增材制造使得制造业有了新的活力，多样化小批量复杂大型多腔零件具备了一次性增材制造成型的可能。然而，当前主流的增材制造技术仍存在着一定的局限性，如制造成本高、成形精度低，缺陷倾向性高等问题。固相增材制造技术因其无熔化过程，可有效避免气孔、疏松等缺陷，且节约能源，具有成形精度高、成形性能优异、制造效率高、生产成本低、绿色环保等特点，可实现火箭箭体连接环、飞机机翼桁架等大型结构件的高效高质量的制造。《固相增材制造技术》是高等学校增材制造工程专业的一门选修课程，围绕固相增材制造技术的基本概念、发展历史、成形特点、组织性能调控、设备与装置类型及其设计等方面，主要任务是通过课堂教学培养学生创新性思维、综合分析能力、科学研究能力和工程实践能力，支撑毕业要求中相应指标点的达成。培养学生掌握固相增材制造技术基本理论和基本知识，并能够将相关知识用于解决复杂工程问题的能力。使学生具有分析材料固相增材制造特性、制定连接方案以及撰写报告的综合能力，并能够通过信息综合获得合理有效的结论，具备初步的科学研究和技术开发能力。
default.en: As a vital component of intelligent manufacturing, additive manufacturing has attracted much attention and has become a hotspot research field, despite that its application foundation still needs to be broken through. Additive manufacturing has brought new vitality to the manufacturing industry, making it possible to one-time additive manufacturing of diversified small batches of complex and large-scale multi-cavity parts. However, the current mainstream additive manufacturing technology still has certain limitations, such as high manufacturing cost, low forming accuracy, and high defect tendency. Solid phase additive manufacturing technology can effectively avoid defects such as porosity because it has no melting process. It has the characteristics of saving energy, high forming precision, excellent forming performance, high manufacturing efficiency, low production cost, and green environmental protection. Efficient and high-quality manufacturing can be achieved in terms of large structural parts such as arrow body connecting rings and aircraft wing trusses. Solid phase additive manufacturing technology is one of the elective courses in the additive manufacturing engineering specialty of Institutions of Higher Education. The base concept, development history, formation mechanism, microstructure and property regulation, device type and design are taught. The main task is to develop the innovative thinking, analysis ability, scientific research ability and engineering practice ability via classroom teaching, which can support the related index point of graduation requirements. The students are required to comprehend the base theory and knowledge, and use the related knowledge into the complex engineering problems. Meanwhile, the students should possess the all-round abilities in the analysis of solid phase additive manufacturing characteristic, the making of plans and the writing of reports. The rational effective conclusion can be obtained via the information integration, possessing the abilities of preliminary scientific research and technological development.

default.zh: 《电弧增材制造技术》课程是对于系统学习金属材料增材制造学生的应选课程。通过课程学习，使学生掌握金属构件电弧增材制造技术的基本概念、特点，以及电弧增材制造方法的大体分类与应用现状。使学生掌握各类基本/先进的电弧增材制造工艺的基本原理、特点、装备以及应用案例，并通过实验学习掌握典型电弧增材制造自动化设备基本操作。使学生能够深入发掘各方法提出的背景需求、理论基础及相关知识，进而能够创新性的进行新型电弧增材制造方法概念设计。使学生掌握各类典型材料适用的电弧增材制造方法的工艺特点以及沉积件的组织与性能特征。同时，学习电弧增材形性调控技术，掌握电弧增材制造工艺参数与成形质量的关联，以及基于明弧、红外、激光视觉监测等技术的电弧增材制造在线检测及控制技术。使学生掌握基于工艺优化、微合金化、微纳米颗粒强化、后热处理等组织性能调控技术。课程在夯实理论基础、拓宽视野、培养创造性思维、提高工程应用实践能力方面具有重要的作用。
default.en: “Wire arc additive manufacturing” is an optional course for students who systematically study additive manufacturing of metal materials. Through the study of this course study, students can grasp the basic concepts and characteristics of WAAM of metal components, as well as the general classification and application status of WAAM methods. Enable students to master the basic principles, characteristics, equipment and application cases of various basic/advanced WAAM processes, and master the basic operation of typical arc additive manufacturing automation equipment through experimental study. So that students can deeply explore the background needs, theoretical basis and relevant knowledge of the various WAAM methods, and then be able to carry out the conceptual design of new WAAM methods innovatively. Enable students to master the process characteristics of WAAM methods applicable to various typical materials, as well as the microstructure and mechanical properties of the deposited components. Meanwhile, make students learn the shape control technology of WAAM, and master the relationship between processing parameters and forming quality and the on-line detection and control technology of WAAM based on video, infrared, laser vision monitoring and other techniques. Enable the students grasp the control of microstructure and mechanical properties based on processing optimization, microalloying, micro/nano particles strengthening, post heat treatment and so on. The course plays an important role in consolidating the theoretical foundation, broadening the vision, cultivating creative idea and improving the practical ability of engineering application.

default.zh: 电子束增材制造技术是一项结合电子束焊接技术和增材制造原理而形成的创新性制造方法，其利用高能电子束作为热源，逐层构建三维零件，具有多材料选择、低废料产生、定制制造和适应复杂结构的优势，尤其在活泼金属和难熔金属制造方面表现出色，被应用于航空航天、医疗、汽车工业和国防领域。本课程通过绪论、电子束粉末床熔融增材制造、电子束熔丝沉积增材制造、典型材料的电子束增材制造、形状与性能控制和电子束增材制造技术的应用几部分的多媒体教学，以及电子束增材再制造实际操作的实验教学，由浅入深地探讨电子束增材制造技术的原理、特点和应用。通过本课程的教学，将使学生理解电子束增材制造的基本原理和工作过程，掌握电子束粉末床熔融增材制造和电子束熔丝沉积增材制造的技术细节，能够解决电子束增材试样制备和工程应用中的常见问题，从而学生为未来的科研或工程工作提供坚实的基础。
default.en: Electron beam additive manufacturing technology is an innovative manufacturing method formed by combining electron beam welding technology and additive manufacturing principle. It uses high-energy electron beam as a heat source to build three-dimensional parts layer by layer. It has the advantages of multi-material selection, low waste generation, custom manufacturing and adaptation to complex structures. It is used in aerospace, medical, automotive and defense industries. This course includes introduction, electron beam powder bed melting additive manufacturing, electron beam fuse deposition additive manufacturing, electron beam additive manufacturing of typical materials, shape and performance control and application of electron beam additive manufacturing technology, as well as experimental teaching of practical operation of electron beam additive remanufacturing. The principle, characteristics and application of electron beam additive manufacturing technology are discussed. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic principle and working process of electron beam additive manufacturing, master the technical details of electron beam powder bed melting additive manufacturing and electron beam fuse deposition additive manufacturing, and solve the common problems in the preparation of electron beam additive samples and engineering applications, so as to provide a solid foundation for future scientific research or engineering work.

default.zh: 激光增材制造技术，又称为激光3D打印技术，是在计算机辅助下，把三维实体模型切片处理为二维层片，二维层片再离散为一维线条，采用激光为能量源进行逐点堆积，最终实现三维实体零件成形的激光制造技术。同传统制造技术相比，该技术具有柔性化、无模具、生产周期短、易于实现智能化、不受零件结构和材料限制、能生产出很高力学性能的零件等特点，该技术已经在航空、国防、交通、能源、冶金、矿采等领域得到了广泛的应用，并展现出诱人前景，被誉为有望成为“第三次工业革命”的代表性技术。 激光增材制造技术按照其成形原理包括最具代表性的为以粉床铺粉为技术特征的激光选区熔化(Selective Laser Melting，SLM)和以同步送粉为技术特征的激光金属直接成形(Laser Metal Direct Forming，LMDF)技术。本课程主要包括激光增材制造技术原理与特点、激光增材制造设备、增材制造技术方法、形性控制技术、以及激光增材制造过程质量监测与智能控制技术等。通过课程的学习，使学生对目前应用比较广泛且具有很好应用前景的激光增材制造技术的零部件打印方法、应用特点、及其应用领域有详细的了解，掌握激光增材制造零部件打印工艺、形性调控策略，并能为解决工程应用中实际问题提供解决方案。
default.en: Laser additive manufacturing technology, also known as laser 3D printing technology, is a laser manufacturing technology that processes three-dimensional solid model slices into two-dimensional slices with computer assistance, and the two-dimensional slices are then discretized into one-dimensional lines, the laser is used as the energy source for point-by-point accumulation, and finally the formation of three-dimensional solid parts is realized. Compared with traditional manufacturing technology, this technology has the characteristics of flexibility, no mold, short production cycle, easy to realize intelligence, not limited by part structure and material, and can produce parts with high mechanical properties. The technology has been widely used in aviation, national defense, transportation, energy, metallurgy, mining and other fields, and has shown attractive prospects. It is expected to become a representative technology of the "third industrial revolution". According to its forming principle, laser additive manufacturing technology includes the most representative laser selective melting technology (Selective Laser Melting，SLM) characterized by powder bed spreading and laser metal direct forming technology (Laser Metal Direct Forming，LMDF) characterized by synchronous powder feeding. This course mainly includes the principles and characteristics of laser additive manufacturing technology, laser additive manufacturing equipment, additive manufacturing technology methods, shape control technology, and laser additive manufacturing process quality monitoring and intelligent control technology. Through the study of the course, students will have a detailed understanding of the parts printing method, application characteristics, and application fields of laser additive manufacturing technology, which is currently widely used and has good application prospects, master the printing process and shape control strategy of laser additive manufacturing parts, and can provide solutions for solving practical problems in engineering applications.

default.zh: 3D打印材料是增材制造技术的核心之一，是增材制造技术发展的重要基础。3D打印专用材料种类较多，主要包括金属、高分子、陶瓷、复合材料几大类，不同增材制造技术所用的材料也不尽相同，有其特定的要求和性质。《3D打印材料》是增材制造工程专业本科生的专业选修课，本课程要求学生能够比较系统地掌握3D打印专用金属材料、高分子材料、陶瓷材料、复合材料的分类、选材要求、特性、制备、成形性、表征与评价，并采用案例教学的方法使学生了解3D打印材料的应用及发展趋势。
default.en: 3D printing material is one of the cores of additive manufacturing technology and an important basis for the development of additive manufacturing technology. There are many kinds of special materials for 3D printing technology, mainly including metals, polymers, ceramics and composites. The materials used in different additive manufacturing technologies are also different, with specific requirements and properties. 3D Printing Materials is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in additive manufacturing engineering. This course requires students to systematically master the classification, material selection requirements, special performances, preparation methods, formability, characterization and evaluation of metal materials, polymer materials, ceramic materials and composite materials for 3D printing technology, and use case teaching methods to make students understand the application and development trend of 3D printing materials.

default.zh: 零件在增材制造成形过程中，为改善控形、控性能力和提高综合力学性能，采用一种或多种辅助工艺与增材制造工艺耦合协同工作，将等材、减材以及特种能场辅助技术与增材制造技术进行复合，这种复合增材制造技术已成为当代增材制造领域的发展前沿之一。《复合增材制造技术》是增材制造工程专业本科生的专业选修课，本课程要求学生能够比较系统的掌握复合增材制造技术的分类、基本原理、工艺过程及应用，并重点介绍机加工复合增材制造技术、激光辅助复合增材制造技术、超声辅助复合增材制造技术、喷丸复合增材制造技术、轧制复合增材制造技术、锻造复合增材制造技术、旋压复合增材制造技术等多种工艺复合的3D打印技术及应用领域，使学生具备利用复合金属增材制造技术设计并制造各种先进材料及其零部件的理论和技术的能力，同时本课程对复合增材制造技术的研究现状和发展趋势有一定的了解。
default.en: In the process of additive manufacturing and forming, in order to improve the shape control, controllability and comprehensive mechanical properties of parts, one or more auxiliary processes are used to couple or cooperate with additive manufacturing processes, and the additive manufacturing technology is combined with equal material manufacturing technology, subtractive material manufacturing technology and special energy field auxiliary technology. This composite additive manufacturing technology has become one of the development fronts in the field of additive manufacturing technology. Composite additive manufacturing technology is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in additive manufacturing engineering. This course requires students to systematically master the classification, basic principle, process and application of the composite additive manufacturing technology, and mainly introduce composite 3D printing technologies, such as composite technology of machining and additive manufacturing, laser assisted composite additive manufacturing technology, ultrasonic assisted composite additive manufacturing technology, composite technology of shot blasting and additive manufacturing, composite technology of rolling and additive manufacturing, composite technology of forging and additive manufacturing, composite technology of spinning and additive manufacturing. Through the study of this course, students will have the ability to design and manufacture various advanced materials and their components using the composite additive manufacturing technology. At the same time, students can understand the current development trend of the composite additive manufacturing technology.

default.zh: 间接金属增材制造技术指的是需要经过脱脂、烧结等辅助工艺的金属3D打印技术。该技术是集材料制备与零件成形于一体，是集节能、节材、高效、低成本的先进金属3D打印技术，是当代增材制造领域的发展前沿之一。《间接金属增材制造技术》是增材制造工程专业本科生的专业选修课，本课程要求学生能够比较系统的掌握间接金属增材制造技术的基本原理、金属粉体材料的制备与要求、各种间接3D打印技术、生胚脱脂、烧结原理及工艺等相关内容，并重点掌握间接金属增材制造技术的基本原理、间接3D打印技术和烧结原理。通过本门课程的学习，使学生具备利用间接金属增材制造技术设计并制造各种先进材料及其零部件的理论和技术的能力，同时本课程对该技术的研究现状和发展趋势有一定的了解。
default.en: Indirect metal additive manufacturing technology is a metal 3D printing technology that requires auxiliary processes such as degreasing and sintering. This technology integrates material preparation and part forming. It is an advanced metal 3D printing technology with energy saving, material saving, high efficiency and low cost. It is one of the development frontiers in the field of additive manufacturing technology. Indirect metal additive manufacturing technology is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in additive manufacturing engineering. This course requires students to systematically master the basic principles of indirect metal additive manufacturing technology, the preparation and requirements of metal powder materials, various indirect 3D printing technologies, green billet degreasing, sintering principles and processes, and focus on the basic principles indirect 3D printing technology and sintering principle. Through the study of this course, students will have the ability to design and manufacture various advanced materials and their components using the indirect metal additive manufacturing technology. At the same time, students can understand the current development trend of the indirect metal additive manufacturing technology.

default.zh: 课程以材料科学、机械工程为基础，整合人工智能、数据科学等模块，通过融合人工智能AI与增材制造工艺构建数字化、智能化的新型教学体系，旨在让学生掌握人工智能以及增材制造技术的基本理论框架；了解人工智能赋能增材制造领域的国际前沿热点和发展趋势；具备分析人工智能赋能增材制造过程所面临的关键基础科学问题的能力，并具有创新意识；建立科学分析思想，对人工智能以及增材制造的复杂工程问题进行建模、模拟和分析，并在计算机辅助下提出和优化解决方案，培养具有跨学科创新能力的高素质人才。
default.en: This course is based on materials science and mechanical engineering, integrating modules such as artificial intelligence and data science. By integrating artificial intelligence AI with additive manufacturing processes, a new digital and intelligent teaching system is constructed, aiming to enable students to master the basic theoretical framework of artificial intelligence and additive manufacturing technology; Understand the international cutting-edge hotspots and development trends in the field of AI enabled additive manufacturing; Ability to analyze the key fundamental scientific issues faced by AI enabled additive manufacturing processes and possess innovative thinking; Establish scientific analytical thinking, model, simulate, and analyze complex engineering problems in artificial intelligence and additive manufacturing, and propose and optimize solutions with computer-aided methods, cultivating high-quality talents with interdisciplinary innovation capabilities.

default.zh: 《等离子体放电原理与焊接》课程主要讲授等离子体放电原理及其在焊接中的应用。这门课是焊接方法与质量控制知识的一个有效补充，拓宽了焊接相关学生的知识范围和思考角度。课程涉及到多学科交叉，包括材料加工、电工学、等离子体物理、磁学等等。使得学生不仅从焊接本身考虑焊接，也能从更多的视角去考虑焊接，进而激发学生的学习兴趣和提高学生实际解决问题的能力。 课程从等离子体的广阔的工程应用案例开始，然后讲到等离子体产生的形式、激发手段以及工作条件。重点讲解了焊接电弧等离子体、激光焊接等离子体、电子束焊接诱导等离子体、等离子体清洗的化学作用和物理作用以及等离子体表面工程在焊接中的应用。通过对焊接相关的等离子体产生和属性的认识和了解，利用电场、磁场以及外部的其他能量场的控制，可以有效提高焊接质量。 学生通过对该课程的学习，有效拓宽知识面，体会到可以从更宽的视角去解决实际中的工程问题，该课程不仅可以增大焊接相关学生的知识量，也提升学生基本理论水平和交叉学习思维，使得学生具有更强的创新意识和解决问题的能力。
default.en: The course“Plasma discharge and Applications in welding” mainly concerns the fundamentals of plasma discharge and application in quality control in welding processes. This course is an effective complement to the knowledge of welding methods and quality control, and widens the knowledge scope and thinking angle of the welding-related students. The course involves interdisciplinary including material processing, electrotechnics, plasma physics, magnetism, etc. Consequently students consider welding technology not only from the welding itself but also from more perspectives. It stimulates students ' interest in learning and improves students ' practical ability to solve problems. The course begins with a wide range of engineering applications of plasmas, and then the formation, excitation and working conditions of plasma. The emphasis is put on the welding arc plasma, laser welding plasma, plasma from electron beam welding and plasma cleaning, and the application of plasma surface engineering in welding. Through the knowledge and understanding of the generation and properties of plasma related to welding, the welding quality can be improved effectively by using the control of electric field, magnetic field and other energy fields outside. From the course the students effectively broaden the knowledge and realize that they may solve the practical engineering problems from a wider perspective. this course makes students not only widen the welding-related knowledge but also improve the basic theoretical level and cross learning thinking, in this way students have a stronger sense of innovation and problem-solving ability.

default.zh: 电子束焊接是材料加工工程领域一种重要的焊接方法。因其独有的高能量密度、大深宽比、小变形及焊缝金属纯净的特点在国防与民用工业领域得到日益重视。本课程围绕电子束的发射形成及其与材料的热作用，主要讲解电子束的形成机制、电子束与材料的作用行为，系统地介绍电子束的发射系统及其工作原理。课程内容包括电子束焊接设备原理与电子束焊接基础两部分内容。电子束焊接设备原理包括电子光学原理、电子枪与电源的结构与功能等方面的内容；电子束焊接基础包括电子与物质作用过程中的能量转换与传递、熔池受力与流动行为，以及对真空电子束焊接工艺的介绍。电子束的发生机制与发射系统工作原理，电子束与材料之间的物理冶金作用关系是本课程的重点知识内容。 要求学生通过本课程的学习，掌握电子束的发射机制、电子枪与电源的结构与功能，了解电子束与材料之间的热-力-冶金作用行为，掌握电子束焊接工艺规范的要求与流程。课程采用传统板书与多媒体相结合的教学方式，共计16学时。
default.en: Electron beam welding is an important welding method in the material processing field. Electron beam welding has received increasing attention in the defense and civilian industry due to its characterization of high energy density, high ratio of depth-to-width, maximum penetration with minimal distortion and inert atmosphere (vacuum). This course mainly focuses on explaining of the formation mechanism of electron beam, the interaction between electron beam and material based on the introducing of the working principle of electron beam emission system. The course includes the explaining of both working principle of electron beam welding equipment and the electron beam welding foundation. The principle of electronic optics, the structure and function of electron gun and power supply are the main content of “working principle of electron beam welding equipment” part. The energy conversion and transmission during the interaction the process between electron and material, the forces and flow behavior of the molten pool, and the vacuum electron beam welding process are explained in the “electron beam welding foundation” part. Electron beam generation mechanism, the working principle of electron beam welding equipment, the relationship between the electron beam and the material between the physical metallurgy are the focus of this course. Students are required to grasp electron beam generation mechanism, know the structure and function of the electron beam gun and power supply, understand the thermo-force-metallurgical behavior between materials and electron beam during electron beam welding process, and gain the knowledge of whole electron beam welding process. The course, in a total of 16 hours, uses a combination of traditional blackboard and multimedia teaching methods.

default.zh: 电阻焊是工件组合后通过电极施加压力，利用电流通过接头的接触面及邻近区域产生的电阻热进行焊接的方法，属压力焊。电阻焊过程的物理本质是利用焊接区本身的电阻热和大量塑性变形能量使两个分离表面的金属原子之间接近到晶格距离形成金属键，在结合面上产生足够量的共同晶粒而得到焊点、焊缝或对接接头。电阻焊是一种焊接质量稳定，生产效率高，易于实现机械化、自动化的连接方法，广泛应用在汽车、航空航天、电子、家用电器等领域。据统计，目前电阻焊方法已占整个焊接工作量的1/4左右，并有继续增加的趋势。 通过本课程的学习，使同学能较好的掌握电阻焊的基础理论，并结合常用金属材料及典型零件焊接特点分析，培养具有制定电阻焊工艺及处理有关实际生产问题的能力。
default.en: Resistance welding is a method of welding the workpiece combination by applying pressure through the electrode and using the resistance heat generated by the current through the contact surface of the joint and the adjacent area, which belongs to pressure welding. The physical nature of resistance welding process is to use the resistance heat of the welding zone itself and a large amount of plastic deformation energy to make the metal atoms on the two separated surfaces close to the lattice distance to form a metal bond, and generate enough common grains on the bonding surface to obtain solder joints, welds or butt joints. Resistance welding is a kind of stable welding quality, high production efficiency, easy to realize mechanization, automation connection method, widely used in automotive, aerospace, electronics, household appliances and other fields. According to statistics, the current resistance welding method has accounted for about 1/4 of the whole welding workload, and there is a trend to continue to increase. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theory of resistance welding well, and cultivate the ability to formulate resistance welding technology and deal with practical production problems by combining with the analysis of welding characteristics of common metal materials and typical parts.

default.zh: 本课程是焊接技术与工程专业本科生的一门选修课，是理论性和实践性较强的专业课。电能转换和利用是目前热门的技术之一，本课程能够使学生掌握各种焊接方法的基本原理，常用弧焊电源的基本理论、基本知识和实验技能，开拓视野；能根据不同弧焊工艺方法正确地选择、使用弧焊电源；课程知识兼顾基础、领域最新发展和工程应用时间，能够为学生接下来进入课题研究和工作奠定良好的知识基础。 课程主要包含如下内容： （1）分析和掌握最新的电源技术和电能转换方法，熟练掌握不同弧焊方法对弧焊电源的要求，分析具体弧焊电源的外特性、调节特性和动特性； （2）掌握晶闸管式整流弧焊电源的设计原理、主电路、控制电路，熟悉弧焊电源的闭环控制，掌握弧焊电源外特性获得原理，能够针对具体弧焊电源的电路进行电路分析。 （3）掌握逆变弧焊电源的基本原理、主电路的工作原理，控制电路的工作原理及实现。 （4）掌握现代弧焊电源的控制方法及实现原理，熟悉数字化弧焊电源的实现方法及硬件原理。
default.en: The course is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in welding technology and engineering. It is a professional course with strong theory and practice. The teaching task is to master the basic theory, basic knowledge and experimental skills of various arc welding power sources. Also the students can correctly select and use arc welding power sources according to different arc welding process methods. The course contains 16 hours of content, and the structure design includes: ① introduction; ② Basic requirements for arc welding power supply; ③ Thyristor arc welding rectifier; ④ inverter arc welding power supply; ⑤ Digitalization of arc welding power supply. The five parts are gradually, organically combined, and closely combined with the latest developments in current scientific research and application fields. So that students can master both basic theoretical knowledge and the latest development trends. In terms of course content, the introduction part concentrates the basic development history of traditional arc welding power supply, including the brief history of development of arc welding power supply, the status quo and development trend of arc welding power supply at home and abroad, and the classification of arc welding power supply. The basic requirement of arc welding power supply is to undertake the welding method, and further describes the means to realize arc welding power supplying. In the third part and the fourth part, two kinds of latest arc welding power technology are introduced respectively, and combined with the inverter arc welding power technology. So that students can master the development status of new energy technology for expansion and application. The fifth part is the continuation of ③ and ④, combined with the development of the latest technology, as well as the developing digital technology, the introduction of new breakthroughs in arc welding power supplies. The course structure is compact, which takes into account the basic and latest development of arc welding power source. The course build a good knowledge foundation for students to enter the topic research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 本课程核心内容为兼顾焊接冶金连接与机械连接双重模式，解决难焊特异性材料的连接问题，满足结构和功能连接件强度和功能性指标设计要求。主要讲授螺纹连接、铆钉连接、过盈连接、胀紧连接、冲压点连接以及粘接技术的原理、特点及工作参数的计算方法以及其发展趋势，强调机械连接与焊接冶金连接的复合作用。并重点讲授机械连接与冶金连接的复合效应，通过机械和冶金复合连接方法解决实际工程问题，提高关键部件的可靠性。通过本课程的学习，学生可以掌握机械连接各种方法的基本原理，熟悉机械连接方法的特点及应用领域。并掌握机械连接与焊接冶金复合连接设计方法，具备通过机械与冶金复合效应解决关键部件连接的问题。
default.en: The key information of this course aims to combine mechanical and metallurgical co-joining methods and theories. The content of the course includes the principle and properties of threaded connection, rivet connection, interference connection, bulging tight connection and cementing connection. In addition, the development of these methods will be discussed. And it focuses on the composite effect of mechanical and metallurgical connections through mechanical and metallurgical composite connection method to solve practical engineering problems, and improves the reliability of key components. The students can obtain the basic concepts of these different methods and understand the ways to choose a proper mechanical joint method. The composite connection design of mechanical and metallurgical should be mastered, and the connection of key parts is solved by mechanical and metallurgical compound effects.

default.zh: 激光焊接被公认为“二十一世纪最有发展前景和应用潜力的焊接技术之一”。目前，激光焊接技术已逐渐成熟，并广泛应用于国防以及国民经济社会的各个领域，有取代一些传统焊接方法的趋势，是焊接领域的一种重要焊接方法。 本课程是焊接专业的一门专业必修课程，又是一门涉及到光学、电学、流体力学、热力学、冶金学、材料科学和自动控制等多学科且学科交叉的课程；主要包括激光焊接方法在工业中的应用特点、激光束的基本物理特征、激光束与材料之间的相互作用及其传热特点、激光器工作原理、不同金属材料的激光焊接特点、以及以激光焊接为基础的各种先进方法等。教授基础知识的同时，注重分析激光束实际焊接过程中存在的主要问题及其解决方法，并对国内外相关的先进技术进行介绍。 通过本课程的学习，使学生对目前应用比较广泛且具有很好应用前景的激光束这一高功率密度焊接热源的应用特点、应用领域有详细的了解，掌握激光的基本特点、激光与金属材料相互作用的物理机制、激光焊接的基本原理及不同种类激光束的加工特点，了解世界先进激光束焊接工艺及其应用，针对具体的材料焊接问题，能够结合材料特点和结构特征选择合适的激光束焊接方法与工艺，具备为解决工程实际问题提供专业思路的能力。
default.en: Laser welding has been recognized as “one of the most promising and potential welding technologies in the twenty-first century”. For now, laser welding technology has gradually matured, and widely used in national defense and every field of the national economy. Also, as an important welding method in welding field, it has a tendency to replace other traditional welding methods. This course is a compulsory course in welding specialty, and also a compositive one involved multidisciplinary knowledge, such as optics, electricity, hydromechanics, thermodynamics, metallurgy, material science, automatic control and so on. This course mainly includes the application characteristics of laser welding method in industry, basic physical characteristics of laser beams, the interaction between laser beam and materials and their heat transfer characteristics, the working principle of laser, laser welding characteristics of different metal materials, and various advanced methods based on laser welding. In the process of teaching basic knowledge, the problems existing in the actual welding process of laser beam and their solutions are mainly emphasized. And the related technologies at home and abroad are introduced in detail. Through the study of this course, the students can have a detailed understand of the application characteristic and application area of laser beam which has a high-energy density and good application prospect, master the basic characteristics of laser, the physical mechanism of the interaction between laser and metal materials, the basic principle of laser welding and the processing characteristics of different kinds of laser beams, and know the advanced laser beam welding process and its application in the world. Furthermore, based on a practice case, the students can choose suitable methods and techniques of laser beam welding to provide solutions for practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 非平衡凝固材料制备技术（熔体旋淬，雾化沉积，水冷铜模吸铸等）在推动新材料研发的同时促进了传统材料的升级换代，是国民经济发展和国防建设所需关键材料的重要制备技术。同时，金属的增材制造（如激光熔覆沉积、电子束熔丝沉积等）也受到越来越多的关注。这些制造技术的一个核心问题就是熔体金属非平衡凝固行为。金属的非平衡凝固过程直接决定了成形过程中的应力应变和变形开裂，材料组织形成与演变规律，最终决定了零件的力学与物理性能。 本课程详尽介绍了包括非晶、准晶、微晶、纳米晶在内的非平衡疑固新型金属材料、非平衡定向凝固与组织超细化、熔体热处理与非平衡凝固的新进展，并结合授课教师自身在上述领域的研究成果和研究体会的介绍，将材料与技术、理论与实验、基础与前沿有机结合，便于学生对当今世界新材料研究前沿领域的了解和对相关知识的理解。
default.en: Non-equilibrium solidification techniques (melt spinning, gas atomization, water-cooled copper die casting, etc.) promote the development of new materials as while as the upgrading of traditional materials. It is an important fabrication approach for key materials required for the development of the national economy and national defense construction. At the same time, metal additive manufacturing (e.g., Laser Metal Deposition, Electron Beam Free Form Fabrication, etc.) is also receiving more and more attention. A central issue in these fabrication techniques is the non-equilibrium solidification behavior of molten metals. The non-equilibrium solidification process of the metal directly determines the stress and cracking during the processes, the formation and evolution of microstructures, and ultimately the mechanical and physical properties of the part. This course provides a detailed introduction to the new materials for non-equilibrium solidification, including amorphous, quasi-crystalline, micro-crystalline and nanocrystalline materials. Based on the lecture’s own research results and experiences in these fields, we will facilitate the students' understanding of the frontier of new materials research in the world.

default.zh: 这门课最大的特点是：学习一门课，就可以了解掌握好几类特种应用领域的焊接方法和技术，是对焊接主体课程的全面补充。 未来就业以后，去航天院所要懂空间焊接，去海洋舰船类单位要懂水下焊接，去核工业单位要懂核辐射环境下焊接。因此，学习本门课程能提升焊接专业知识的全面性。 本课程可拓宽焊接专业视野，了解某一类应用领域的特种环境的特点，焊接存在的特殊问题，并给出解决之道。课程内容宏观掌握即可，避免极强的专业性，结课提交课程报告。
default.en: The most significant feature of this course is that by studying one course, students can understand and master several types of welding methods and techniques for specialized application fields. It is a comprehensive supplement to the main welding curriculum. In future employment, knowledge of space welding is needed for aerospace institutes, underwater welding for marine and shipbuilding units, and welding in nuclear radiation environments for nuclear industry positions. Therefore, studying this course enhances the comprehensiveness of welding professional knowledge. This course can broaden the professional vision, allowing students to understand the characteristics of special environments in certain fields, recognize the unique welding problems, and provide solutions. The course content requires a macro-level understanding, avoiding high specialization, and concludes with the submission of a course report.

default.zh: 近十多年快速发展的芯片、航空航天和先进材料领域对表面技术提出了很高的需求，《先进材料表面改性》是针对该需求而开设的选修课程，使本科生能够对表面技术应用领域需求有较深的了解，掌握先进表面强化的相关知识，拓宽知识面。本课程主要讲述气体分子运动理论、等离子体放电原理、表面改性、薄膜技术、涂层技术、复合技术、强化层性能测试等相关技术领域的知识体系，着重从物理上讲清各种技术原理、材料强化机制、相关设备和优缺点以及应用领域，使学生掌握先进表面改性技术的选用原则，为将来的科研与工作拟解决的问题提供思路，并夯实相关物理基础。除了正常的课程讲授之外，本课程要求学生组成小组，针对当前先进表面强化技术的热点方向，对其材料特征、发展趋势及制备方法开展项目研究，进行研究报告撰写和答辩，从而培养学生的自主学习、团队协作以及表达与沟通能力。本课程最终成绩评定主要由三部分组成，其中，平时作业占20%，项目报告占30%，期末考试占50%。
default.en: The course “Advanced Surface Modification Methods for Materials” mainly focuses on the knowledge of the fast development of surface engineering technologies recently. It will build the bases of the knowledge for surface engineer and expand the scope of the student. The contents of this curriculum include the molecular dynamics, gas discharge, plasma, surface modification, thin film deposition, coating technology, duplex processes for surface enhancement and characterization methods for surface properties. In addition, the principle of different surface modification methods and surface enhancement mechanisms will be discussed. After the curriculum, the students will understand the applications, disadvantages and advantages of different surface modification methods. In addition to lectures, the students will be divided to different groups, and each group will perform a project study on specific materials in advances of surface engineering applications. Each group will write a paper and give a presentation on the properties, development and processing method of this material. Therefore, the capability on self-study, team spirit, expression and communication will be development through this project study. The score of this curriculum is composed of exercise (20%), project study (30%) and final exam (50%).

default.zh: 《智能焊接技术》是工科高等学校焊接技术与工程专业的一门选修课，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和智能化焊接实践能力方面占有重要的地位。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学环节培养学生的创新意识和智能化焊接方面科学知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 主要内容包括：智能焊接的概念、智能焊接的发展历程与趋势、工业4.0（智能制造）与智能焊接；智能焊接的基础知识；物联网下的智能焊接；智能焊接中的传感技术；智能焊接中的路径生成技术；智能焊接中的控制技术；智能焊接实例分析等。 本课程教学以课堂讲授为主。 课程考核以作业和课程报告为主。
default.en: Intelligent welding technology is an elective course for students specialized in welding technology and engineering in engineering colleges and universities, which plays an important role in cultivating students' creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and intelligent welding practice ability. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' innovative consciousness and the application ability of scientific knowledge in intelligent welding through classroom teaching, and to support the corresponding index points in professional learning achievement. The main contents include: the concept of intelligent welding, the development process and trend of intelligent welding, industrial 4.0 (intelligent manufacturing) and intelligent welding; the basic knowledge of intelligent welding; intelligent welding and IOT; sensor technology in intelligent welding; intelligent welding path generation Technology; intelligent welding control technology; intelligent welding example analysis. This course is taught in class. The course assessment is mainly based on homework and the course report.

default.zh: 焊接与社会是焊接技术与工程专业的一门主干技术专业课，培养学生科学素养和人文素质、可持续发展理念和焊接实践能力，以期提高学生的综合素养，掌握焊接的基本内涵，知悉焊接发展史，了解主要焊接在国民经济中的贡献和地位，具备可持续发展理念和国际化视野。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学及项目研究等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和材料加工科学与焊接知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。采用讲授、研讨、网上资料共享、大作业等互动式教学模式，提高学生分析问题，独立解决问题的能力，并具有良好的团队合作意识及组织协调能力与创新精神，做到课堂教学与工程应用相结合。
default.en: The course of Welding and Society is an important professional one for welding subject. The course focused on the cultivation of scientific literacy and humanistic quality, the concept of sustainable development and the welding practice ability. The primary purposes included to improve comprehensive qualities, understand the basic knowledge of welding, be familiar with the history of welding, and be aware of the main contribution to the national economy and the status of welding, and hold the concept of sustainable development and international vision. The main task is to link classroom teaching and research projects, to cultivate innovation consciousness and ability of applying materials processing and welding knowledge, to reach the corresponding index point in support of professional learning. Using lectures, seminars, online information sharing, large operations and interactive teaching model, the course aims to improve the abilities of analyzing, solving problems independently, teamwork spirit, and innovation spirit.

default.zh: 焊接国际标准是焊接专业的一门重要课程。该课程教学定位主要在于开拓学生的专业知识面，培养学生的专业能力，其目的是使学生对焊接标准、焊接质量要求、焊接工艺规程及评定、焊接材料和焊接试验及检验有一定的了解，初步掌握焊接质量要求、焊接通用要求和焊接材料的分类与选择。本课程结合焊接国际标准本身的特点来探讨焊接标准化发展战略、焊接质量保证、焊接评定及认证等。采用讲授、研讨、网上资料共享、大作业等互动式教学模式，提高学生分析问题，独立解决问题的能力，做到课堂教学与工程应用相结合。
default.en: The course of International Standards of Welding is an important professional one for welding subject. The teaching positions are mainly in developing students’ professional knowledge and competence, and its purpose is to enable students to understand welding standards, welding quality requirements, assessment of welding procedures, welding materials and welding test, and preliminary master welding quality requirements, welding general requirements, classification and selection of welding materials. It is combined with the characteristics of International Standard of Welding to explore the development strategies of welding standard, assurances of welding qualities, evaluation and certification of welding. Using lectures, seminars, online information sharing, large operations and other interactive teaching model, the course aims to improve the abilities of analyzing, solving problems independently. The classroom teaching and engineering applications are combined for the course.

default.zh: 随着电子信息科学技术的进步和大规模超大规模集成电路技术的飞速发展，单片机技术也得到了迅速发展。单片机的特点是功能强、体积小、成本低、可靠性高。目前，单片机已在工业测控、智能化仪表、数据采集、机电一体化、家用电器、办公室自动化及航空航天等各个领域得到了广泛应用，极大地提高了这些领域的技术水平和自动化程度。因此，单片机的开发应用已成为工程技术领域的一项非常必要的课题，各大专院校相关专业都将单片机课程作为一门重要课程列入教学计划。 单片机技术的开发和应用水平已成为一个国家工业发展的重要标志之一。目前生产单片机的厂家很多，产品种类繁多，型号不断更新，性能各具特色。在单片机家族的众多成员中,MCS-51系列单片机结构体系完整、内部寄存器规范、指令系统功能完善、技术成熟、性能优越、可靠性和性价比高，因而迅速占领了工业测控和智能化仪表等领域的主要市场。 本课程主要介绍了MCS-51系列单片机的基本概念，基本原理，硬件结构，指令系统，汇编语言程序设计，中断系统，定时器/计数器，串行通信，A/D、D/A接口技术，单片机应用系统设计与调试，单片机应用系统抗干扰设计等内容。
default.en: With the progress of electronic information science and technology and the rapid development of large scale integrated circuit technology, SCM technology has also been a rapid development. SCM is characterized by strong function, small size, low cost, high reliability. At present, the single chip microcomputer has been widely used in industrial measurement and control, intelligent instrument, data acquisition, electromechanical integration, household appliances, office automation and aerospace and other fields, greatly improving the technical level and degree of automation in these fields. Therefore, the development and application of microcontroller has become a very necessary subject in the field of engineering technology, and the relevant majors of colleges and universities will take the microcontroller course as an important course included in the teaching plan. SCM technology development and application level has become one of the important signs of national industrial development. At present, there are many manufacturers producing single chip microcomputer, with a wide variety of products and constantly updated models. Among many members of the single-chip microcomputer family,MCS-51 series single-chip microcomputer has complete structure system, internal register specification, complete instruction system function, mature technology, superior performance, reliability and high cost performance, so it quickly occupied the main market in the field of industrial measurement and control and intelligent instrument. This course mainly introduces the basic concept, basic principle, hardware structure, instruction system, assembly language programming, interrupt system, timer/counter, serial communication, A/D, D/A interface technology, SCM application system design and debugging, SCM application system anti-interference design and so on.

default.zh: 机器人原理与焊接应用是焊接科学与技术专业本科生的一门技术专业课。教学任务是使学生掌握机器人的基本原理、基础知识和实验技能，结合不同的焊接工艺，正确的设计机器人系统、机器人生产线。通过对机器人的分类、特点、前景、应用的讲解，使学生了解机器人的现状和发展趋势。本课程覆盖机器人人工智能的知识，结合焊接工艺应用，使学生掌握感知、导航、路径规划、不确定导航、人机交互等领域的知识，同时使学生了解计算机视觉、图形图像的相关知识，正确的开发用于机器人的传感器。 本课程能够提高学生对机器人、电气、控制、焊接工艺的综合应用能力。本门课重点在于强化学生的对于机器人智能化原理、设计及焊接应用的基本功，也通过学科交叉培养学生的创新思维、开拓视野、提高综合创新能力。本课程对于提高焊接专业本科生对于机器人理论和焊接应用实践的综合水平具有重要的意义。
default.en: The course of robot principle and welding application is a technical course for undergraduates majoring in welding science and technology. The teaching task make students to master the basic principles of robots, basic knowledge and experimental skills, and the correct design of robot welding systems. By explaining the classification, prospect and application of robots, students understand the development trend of robotics. This course covers the knowledge of robot artificial intelligence, which students can master the knowledge in the fields of perception, path planning, uncertain navigation, human-computer interaction, etc. At the same time, students can understand the relevant knowledge of computer vision, graphics and images, and correctly develop sensors for robots. The course can improve comprehensive application ability of robotics, electrical, control and welding technology. The course focuses on strengthening students' basic skills in the principle of robot intelligence, design and welding application, and also cultivates innovative thinking, expands vision and improves comprehensive innovation ability through interdisciplinary training. The course is of significance to improve the comprehensive level of robot theory and welding application practice for welding undergraduates.

default.zh: 热电发电是通过先进的连接技术将热电材料与电极等组装起来，可以直接利用热电材料的Seebeck效应将热能转换为电能。它是一种静态的固体器件，具有热源稳定、结构紧凑、能量密度高、无声音、无振动、性能稳定、寿命长、无需维护等优点，使其在航天、航空、尖端电子和军事等领域有着很大的潜在应用价值。美国登月计划中“阿波罗”17号飞船就是使用了热电转换技术提供的电源从月球表面向地球成功地传送了数据；“好奇号”火星车利用热电发电技术实现了在火星表面的一系列复杂检测工作。近年来，随着环境污染和能源危机的日益加重，热电材料再次成为材料科学研究的热点，利用热电发电器件将低品质热源直接转化为电能的研究在世界范围内受到广泛的重视。本课程主要向学生介绍热电现象的基本理论，热电材料的连接技术，热电材料研究的最新进展，以及热电器件的制造和应用等。
default.en: Thermoelectric generator (TEG) is made of thermoelectric materials and metal electrodes through advanced joining technology. TEG can directly convert heat energy into electrical energy using the Seebeck effect of thermoelectric materials. It is a static solid device with the advantages of stable heat source, compact structure, high energy density, no sound, no vibration, stable performance, long life, no maintenance, etc., which makes it has great potential application value in aerospace, aviation, advanced electronics and military fields. In the U.S. lunar program, the Apollo 17 spacecraft successfully transmitted data from the lunar surface to the Earth using the power provided by TEG; the Mars Curiosity rover realized a series of complex tests on the surface of Mars using thermoelectric power generation technology. In recent years, with the increasing environmental pollution and energy crisis, the use of thermoelectric devices to convert low quality heat directly into electrical energy has received widespread attention around the world. This course introduces students to the basic theories of thermoelectric phenomena, thermoelectric joining techniques, the latest advances in thermoelectric materials research, and the manufacture and application of thermoelectric devices.

default.zh: 试验设计与数据处理是自然科学研究方法论领域中的一个分支学科，它不仅提供如何正确地设计科学试验和收集数据的方法，而且也提供如何正确地整理、分析数据，得出客观、科学的结论的方法。正确设计试验方法并对所获得的实验数据进行科学的统计分析是每个研究工作者必须具备的基本功。本课程主要包括试验结果的统计分析原理与方法，如误差理论与测定结果表达、统计推断和显著性检验、数据的方差分析与回归性分析等；以及常用的试验设计原理及设计方法，如正交试验设计、均匀试验设计、调优试验设计、回归正交试验设计等内容。 通过该门课程的学习，可以使学生详细了解各种试验设计方法与数据处理的基本原理和特点，获得进行试验设计和数据处理分析所必需的基本知识、技能和方法，并能利用试验数据得出科学的结论，为学生毕业论文以及将来从事科研工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: Experiment design and data processing is a branch of natural science research methodology. It provides not only the correct methods of scientific experimental design and data collection, but also the methods about how to disposing and analyzing data and making objective and scientific conclusions. The correct methods for experiment design and the statistical analysis of experimental results are the basic training which every research workers must have. This course mainly includes the statistical analysis principle and method of experimental result, such as error theory and determination results expressions, statistical inference and significance testing and common experiment design principle and method. The experiment design methods mainly include orthogonal experimental design, uniform experimental design, optimized experimental design and regression orthogonal experimental design. Through the study of this course, the students can understand the basic principle and characteristic of experiment design and data processing methods, grasp the knowledge, methodology and technique in experimental design and data processing and use experimental data to make scientific conclusions. All of these would built a sound foundation for students’ theses and their future scientific research.

default.zh: 真空技术在焊接、铸造、材料表征等先进材料科学与工程领域得到了广泛的应用。《真空系统原理及设计》是针对此类应用而开设的选修课程，培养学生理解真空基本原理，掌握真空系统设计的相关知识，拓宽学生的知识面。本课程主要讲述真空物理基础、真空材料、真空密封设计、真空泵组工作原理、真空测量、真空装置的检漏以及真空系统设计。本课程学习能够使学生了解表征真空系统的基本参数，熟悉各种真空泵组的工作原理，掌握真空系统的测量和检漏方法，具有不同真空系统设计的基础理论知识。除了正常的课程讲授之外，本课程要求学生组成小组，针对当前材料与科学工程领域先进真空设备，对其功能、参数及设计方法开展项目研究，进行论文撰写和答辩，从而培养学生的自主学习、团队协作以及表达与沟通能力。本课程最终成绩评定主要由三部分组成，其中，平时作业20%，项目研究30%，期末考试50%。
default.en: The course “Principle and Design of A Vacuum System” mainly focuses on the fast development of vacuum systems in materials science and engineering applications. It will build the bases of a vacuum system design and expand the scope of the student. The contents of this curriculum include basic theories for vacuum, materials used in vacuum, vacuum seal design, working principle of different vacuum pumps, vacuum gauges, leak detection methods of a vacuum chamber and vacuum system design. Through the course, the students can understand basic concepts of a vacuum system, obtain the rules for selecting proper vacuum pumps and master the methods for vacuum characterization and leak detection. Furthermore, the students will understand how to design a vacuum system. In addition to lectures, the students will be divided to different groups, and each group will perform a project study on a specific vacuum system design for materials science and engineering applications. Each group will write a paper and give a presentation on the applications, principle and design of this vacuum system. Therefore, the capability on self-study, team spirit, expression and communication will be development through this project study. The score of this curriculum is composed of exercise (20%), project study (30%) and final exam (50%).

default.zh: 《钎焊》是焊接技术与工程专业的一门核心课程，重点讲授钎焊技术的基本原理、钎焊材料、钎焊工艺方法及设备和钎焊技术的应用，在培养学生焊接工程的设计能力、解决复杂焊接工程问题的能力、焊接工程实践能力和创造性思维方面占有重要的地位。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、研讨及项目研究等环节培养学生焊接学科知识的应用能力和创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Brazing and Soldering is one of the most commonly used joining process, especially in joining of new materials, dissimilar materials, electronic materials and functional materials.
