The course provides more detailed information and fundamental understanding of the important phenomena happened in the soldering and brazing process, including wetting and spreading process, physical process of capillary flow, dissolution and diffusion between the solders and base metals, and the mechanism and methods of oxide film removing. In soldering and brazing, the processes and equipment, selection principles of the filler metals used, the joining processes for the typical materials are also covered. Through the study of the course, students could have ability to solve the engineering problems in the joining of new materials, dissimilar materials, functional materials.

default.zh: 固相连接是高等学校焊接专业的一门必修课程，主要任务是通过课堂教学开阔学生视野，拓宽研究思路，培养学生创新性思维、综合分析能力、科学研究能力和工程实践能力，支撑毕业要求中相应指标点的达成。课程目标是使学生掌握典型的固相连接基本理论和基本知识，具有综合分析材料固相连接性、制定连接工艺方案以及撰写总结报告的能力。教学内容涉及扩散连接和搅拌摩擦焊接两个方面，重点讲授基本原理、工艺特点及接头性能控制方法。主要内容包括扩散连接技术基础，扩散连接方法及工艺，典型材料的扩散连接，搅拌摩擦焊接原理及特征，典型材料的搅拌摩擦焊接，以及搅拌摩擦焊接的新发展。
default.en: Solid phase joining is one of the compulsory courses for welding specialty in the institution of higher education. The primary mission is to open students’ eye shots, broaden their research thoughts, train their abilities of innovative thinking, comprehensive analysis, scientific research and engineering practice by classroom teaching, and so as to meet the requirements for corresponding graduation indexes. The course objective is to make students grasp the basic theory and elementary knowledge of typical solid joining processes, and possess the comprehensive abilities of materials solid phase joinability analysis, joining technology design and consolidated report writing. The teaching contents in this course are involved in the two kinds of solid phase joining processes, namely diffusion bonding and friction stir welding, and the teaching focus is placed on the basic principle, technological features and joint performance control. The detailed contents include the technology basis of diffusion bonding, process and technology of diffusion bonding, diffusion bonding of typical materials, principle and features of friction stir welding, friction stir welding of typical materials, and innovative progress in friction stir welding.

default.zh: 讲授高效化焊接方法的研究现状以及技术基础、特点和应用。主要内容涉及到助焊剂TIG焊技术、窄间隙TIG焊技术、热丝TIG焊技术、摆动电弧(机械和电磁)TIG焊技术、等离子弧焊(PAW)技术的基本原理、设备、特点和应用。双丝焊MIG方法、复合电弧技术、表面张力过渡(STT)、摆动电弧MIG、交流(AC)MIG焊、混合气体MIG焊的原理、特点、设备和应用。双丝以及多丝埋弧焊技术、窄间隙埋弧焊技术的原理、特点和应用。搅拌摩擦焊以及激光电弧复合焊接的原理、特点、设备、应用范围。鼓励学生创新思维以及自主阅读消化吸收技术文献的能力。
default.en: The developing prospect and technical basis of high efficient welding methods is taught. The contents of this course mainly include the feature, equipment, principle and application of high efficient arc welding method, for example, activating flux assisted TIG welding, narrow gap TIG welding, hot wire TIG welding, oscillating arc TIG welding, plasma TIG welding tandem MIG welding, hybrid arc welding, surface tension transfer MIG welding, oscillating arc MIG welding, mixed-gas MIG welding, two wire or more SAW welding, friction stir welding and laser-MIG hybrid welding, etc. the creative idea and reading and digesting technical papers for student is encouraged.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍缺欠与缺陷概念、特点、分类、在工程领域存在的问题以及控制方法的大体分类。以焊接构件的应力集中、三种主要焊接裂纹产生机理、焊接热过程对接头性能的影响本为课程的重点与难点。
default.en: To adapt to the requirements of engineering, the concepts, characteristics, classification and controlling methods of the defaults in the welded structure will be introduced. More attention will be paid to such aspects as stress concentration, the mechanism of three types of cracks and the effects of the welding process on the properties of the weld.

default.zh: 无损表征是实现焊接质量检测及焊接结构健康检测必备的技术方法，其中基于声学的无损表征方法在焊接对象应用的最为广泛。课程介绍焊接缺陷的无损检测方法，包括超声相控阵方法、超声TOFD法、超声导波检测方法、激光超声、电磁超声、声发射及非线性超声技术。通过课程学习，要求学生掌握各种基于声学的检测及监测方法原理及技术特点，能够选择合适的检测方法对不同种类及结构的焊接接头缺陷或损伤状态进行表征，能运用现代检测技术手段，并将其用于制造质量评价方案的设计与分析。不同的无损表征方法具有不同的适用性及局限性，通过本课程学习，要求学生了解不同方法的技术弊端，并能掌握解决技术弊端的方法。要求学生能够运用文献检索工具，通过专业资料、期刊文献数据库等资源,获取相关研究的发展动态与趋势。
default.en: Nondestructive characterization is the necessary technique to realize the inspection of welding quality and the structural health inspection of welding structures, among which acoustic based nondestructive characterization is the most widely used method. This course introduces nondestructive testing methods for welding defects, including It includes ultrasonic phased array method, ultrasonic TOFD method, ultrasonic guided wave detection method, laser ultrasound, electromagnetic ultrasound, acoustic emission and nonlinear ultrasonic technology. Through the course, students are required to master all kinds of detection and monitoring methods based on acoustics, especial for the principle and technical characteristics. The students can choose the appropriate test methods for characterize defects or damage state for welding with different structure. Using of modern detection technology, the students can design and analysis the quality of manufacturing. Nondestructive characterization methods have different applicability and technological limitations. Through this course study, students are required to understand the technical drawbacks of the methods. Moreover, students are required to master certain methods to solve the technical drawbacks. Using literature retrieval tools, students are required to know the current states and progress of nondestructive characterization of weld.

default.zh: 本课程是焊接技术与工程专业本科生的专业选修课,是《焊接结构学》内容的延伸及拓展，涉及到各种金属材料焊接结构应力变形的特殊性及其控制方法两大方面。本课程的特点就是理论性更深入，并且与其它学科和工程实际密切联系。通过本课程的学习，为今后从事焊接技术与工程等方面的工作和科学研究奠定较为扎实的基础，培养学生灵活运用知识能力，为解决工程实际问题提供常规经验和专业思路。主要内容包括： （1）构件焊接性的分析方法与内容、影响因素 （2）焊接结构学的疑难问题解析 （3）焊接残余应力与变形规律在钢、铝合金、铜合金、钛合金等典型材料上的特殊表现 （4）各种焊接应力测量方法 （5）焊接应力与变形的焊前、焊接过程中、焊后的常规控制措施 （6）焊接应力与变形的先进控制工艺原理与实现方法、控制效果、适用场合
default.en: It is an optional course for undergraduates majored in welding technology and engineering, it is an extension of welding mechanics, which is related to the particularity of welding structural stress and deformation and its relevant control methods for a variety of metallic materials. The characteristic of this course lies in its theoretical depth as well as close contact with other disciplines and engineering practice. The study of this course could lay a more solid foundation in welding technology and engineering for future work and scientific research, also can train students to utilize the knowledge and ability to carry out engineering welded structure stress analysis and provide professional ideas to solve practical issues. The contents include: （1）Weldability analysis, contents and influence factors for the weldments； （2）Troubleshooting in welding mechanics; （3）Welding residual stress and deformation law in typical material such as aluminum, copper alloy, titanium alloy and steel; （4）All kinds of welding stress measurement methods; （5）Conventional control measures for stress and deformation that prior to the welding, in company of welding and after welding; （6）The advanced control principles and implementation of methods, the effect and application occasions for welding stress and deformation.

default.zh: 焊接质量检测与评价技术是控制产品质量、保证设备安全运行的重要手段，在质量保证系统中发挥着的重要作用。其中，无损检测技术在质量保证系统中发挥的作用越来越显示它的重要性和必要性，并成为控制产品质量、保证在役设备安全运行的重要手段。焊接质量检测的重要作用有赖于检测方法选择的正确和检测结果是否可靠。在焊接质量检测与评价体系中，不同的检测方法具有不同的适用性及局限性。通过本课程学习，使学生了解不同焊接接头中可能存在的缺陷类型及特点；了解焊接质量的无损检测方法，掌握焊接缺陷五大常规无损检测方法的技术原理、特点、常用设备及应用对象和场合，重点掌握超声及射线两种方法的工艺过程；了解强度及致密性等检测方法；了解破坏性试验的常用方法；要求学生能够选择合适的检测方法对不同种类及结构的焊接接头进行检测及评价，并根据选定方法初步制定无损检测工艺；了解无损检测方法中存在的科学及技术问题，并初步了解针对科技问题目前的研究前沿及现状。
default.en: Welding quality testing and evaluation technology is an important means to control the quality of welding product and ensure the safe operation of the equipment. Non-destructive testing technology is increasingly showing its importance and necessity in the quality assurance system, and it becomes an important means to control the quality of products and ensure the safe operation of in-service equipment. The important role of welding quality testing depends on the selection of the test method and the reliability of the test results. In the welding quality inspection and evaluation system, different detection methods have different applicability and technological limitations. Through this course, the students can understand the characteristics of the welding defects in different welding joints. The students can understand the technical principles of the five conventional welding nondestructive testing methods, as well the technological features, commonly used equipment and application objects. This focused on mastering the craft of the two methods, i.e. ultrasonic and X-ray based NDT methods. Meanwhile, the student will understand the strength and density testing methods, the commonly used destructive testing method. The course requires the students can choose the appropriate detection methods for different types and structure of the welded joints for testing and evaluation, and can develop non-destructive testing craft according to the selected method. Through the course study, the students should understand the scientific and technical problems existing in the non-destructive testing methods, and the research frontiers as well.

default.zh: 《焊接自动化基础》是工科高等学校焊接技术与工程专业的一门核心技术基础课，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和焊接过程控制实践能力方面占有重要的地位。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和焊接过程控制科学知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 主要内容包括：焊接过程中的传感与控制问题概述，典型传感器原理及特性，焊缝跟踪传感，焊缝成形传感，焊接过程计算机控制系统的组成、工作原理和设计方法，焊接过程控制方法，焊接过程传感与控制实例分析等。 本课程教学以课堂讲授为主。 课程考核包括作业、期末考试等部分。
default.en: Automation of Welding Process is a basic technical course for students specialized in welding technology and engineering in engineering colleges and universities, which plays an important role in cultivating students' creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and welding process control practice ability. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' innovative consciousness and the application ability of scientific knowledge in welding process control through classroom teaching, and to support the corresponding index points in professional learning achievement. The main contents include: overview of sensing and control problems in welding process, typical sensor principle and characteristics, weld tracking sensor, weld forming sensor, composition, working principle and design method of welding process computer control system, welding process control method, analysis of welding process sensing and control example. This course is taught in class. Course assessment includes two parts: homework, final exam.

default.zh: 《先进材料的连接》是一门拓宽学生专业知识面、综合应用所学专业基础课内容的技术应用型课程，本课程主要针对近期在各工程应用领域出现的一些特殊结构的新型材料，分析其连接过程中出现的关键问题，介绍典型的连接方法原理及应用，帮助学生掌握基本的分析方法和研究思路。本课程主要内容涉及陶瓷材料和金属间化合物等功能材料，铝基复合材料、树脂基复合材料、碳／碳复合材料、陶瓷基复合材料、超细晶粒钢的连接原理，连接中的物理和化学冶金过程的规律分析。
default.en: Joining of advanced materials is an application-oriented course that aims to widen the specialized knowledge of the students and enables them to utilize what have learned comprehensively. Key problems that occur during joining of the advanced materials with special structure recently used in various engineering fields are analyzed. The principles and applications of some typical joining methods are introduced. Fundamental analysis method and research approach during joining are also concerned with. Joining principles and physical, chemical and metallurgical processes of joining of ceramics, ceramics-based composites, intermetallic compounds, aluminum metal matrix composites, resin based composites, C/C composites, superfine grain steel are emphasized in the course.

default.zh: 课程主要讲授焊接领域常用的造型软件以及三维有限元分析软件，焊接热过程和应力应变的有限元模拟过程，重点使学生掌握和应用MARC有限元软件进行基本的静力学与焊接热过程及应力变形的有限元分析，掌握焊接模拟结果的后处理的方法及过程，通过该课程的学习为学生在后续毕业设计和工作中提供有效的分析方法。
default.en: Course introduces the modelling software and 3D finite element analysis software in the welding field, welding thermal process and the finite element simulation of stress and strain. Course makes the students master and apply finite element software MARC simulate basic statics, welding thermal process/deformation and stress. Students learn the method and process of post-processing welding simulation results. Students master an effective method in the subsequent graduation design and work through the study of the course.

default.zh: 电子束作为一种高效高能量的工业热源正逐步得到工业领域的关注与应用，特别是在航空、航天、核能、舰船、汽车及交通等领域的焊接与加工需求日益迫切。本课程围绕上述工业领域先进材料与异种材料的焊接热点，以及材料切割去除和表面加工方面的需求，重点介绍电子束在先进材料与异种材料焊接方面的技术应用和一些特种加工方法。课程内容包括电子束焊接应用及电子束加工技术两大部分内容。电子束焊接应用主要围绕先进材料及异种材料在工业领域的应用进行方法特点和工艺原理的阐述，以几种典型的先进材料与异种材料为例介绍电子束焊接质量控制技术；电子束加工技术重点介绍电子束切割与钻孔及电子束表面加工技术的技术原理与应用现状。 要求学生通过本课程的学习，了解典型先进材料与异种材料的电子束焊接性，掌握电子束焊接与加工的基本工艺方法，了解电子束技术在热加工领域的应用。课程采用传统板书与多媒体相结合的教学方式，共计16学时。
default.en: Electron beam, as a high efficient and high-energy density heat source, has gained increasingly attention and application in many industrial fields, especially in the aviation, aerospace, nuclear, ship, automotive and transportation areas. This course mainly focuses on explaining the application of advanced materials joints and dissimilar materials joints as the welding of advanced materials and dissimilar materials has always been the research hotpot of the electron beam welding. The electron beam cutting, electron beam surface treatment and other special processing methods of electron beam are also introduced in this course. The course includes two parts: application of electron beam welding and electron beam processing technology. The process principle of electron beam welding and the application of advanced materials joints and dissimilar materials joints in the industrial fields are the main content of “application of electron beam welding” part. The electron beam welding quality control technology will be introduced by the explaining of welding process of several typical advanced materials and dissimilar materials.The technical principle and application status of electron beam cutting, electron beam drilling and electron beam surface treatment are explained in the “electron beam processing technology” part. Students are required to understand the electron beam weldabilities of typical advanced materials and dissimilar materials, grasp the basic methods of electron beam process, know the applications of electron beam process technology in the hot work area. The course, in a total of 16 hours, uses a combination of traditional blackboard and multimedia teaching methods.

default.zh: 激光增材制造技术是一门为材料科学与工程学院开设的专业选修课。该课程主要介绍激光熔化沉积、激光选区熔化两种激光增材制造技术，以及以光为基础的光固化增材制造技术，包括基本概念、原理、设备及其在高端零件与构件快速制造与智能化制造等领域的应用。学生通过这门课程学习能了解金属材料激光增材制造领域中的关键问题；掌握零件激光增材制造的质量及性能控制思路；培养学生对激光增材制造技术相关知识的综合应用能力，拓宽视野，增加创新意识。
default.en: Laser additive manufacturing technology is a major elective course for the students from School of Materials Science and Engineering. This course mainly introduces laser metal deposition, selective laser melting, two kinds of typical laser additive manufacturing technologies, and light-based Stereolithography additive manufacturing technology, including basic concepts, principles, equipment, and its applications in the field of rapid and intelligence manufacturing of high-end parts and components. Through this course leaning, students can understand the key issues in the field of laser additive manufacturing of metal materials. Moreover, students will master the quality and performance control of laser additive manufacturing. Finally, this course can cultivate students' comprehensive ability to use the knowledge related to laser additive manufacturing technology，broaden their horizons as well as increase the awareness of innovation.

default.zh: 《陶瓷与金属连接》是焊接技术与工程专业的一门选修课程，课程主要内容有陶瓷与金属连接基础原理包括陶瓷润湿基本原理、钎料润湿机制与钎料体系设计等方面，其目的是帮助焊接专业学生掌握陶瓷与金属连连接基础理论，并拓展该方法在多种连接体系的应用，为后续焊接专业学生从事陶瓷/金属连接研究及工艺工作奠定理论基础。
default.en: Joining of ceramics and metals is an elective course for the students in the welding technology and engineering major. The main content of the course includes the basic principles of ceramic and metal joining, wetting of the brazing alloy on ceramics, the wetting mechanism of brazing alloy and the design of filler metal system. The aim of this course is to help the students in welding major master the basic theory of ceramic and metal joining, and expand the application of the methods in different situations, It lays a theoretical foundation for students in the welding major to engage in the subsequent research and process of ceramic/metal joining.

default.zh: 异种金属焊接是一门重要的学科技术，它除了要研究焊接的一般规律以外，还要研究许多特殊的规律，如异种金属的物理、化学性能和组织结构变化、金属间化合物的形成机理，冶金扩散过程等等，涉及知识面很广。作为焊接专业的选修课程，开展异种金属焊接课程教学目的是使本专业学生掌握异种金属的主要焊接方法及基础理论；同时让学生对异种钢、钢与有色金属及其合金、异种有色金属及合金、难熔金属与其它金属的焊接工艺及特点有广泛的认知和了解，对完善学生的专业知识、增强学生适应能力和创造能力发挥作用。本课程主要围绕异种金属的焊接原理、异种金属主要焊接方法及基础理论、多类型异种金属的焊接工艺及特点进行讲解。其中，异种金属主要焊接方法及基础理论、多类型异种金属的焊接工艺及特点是本课程的重点；多类型异种金属的可焊性分析及焊接工艺的选取是本课程的难点。
default.en: Joining of dissimilar metals is an important subject technology, which investigates both general rules during joining and many special rules, such as the physical and chemical properties, the changes of the microstructure, the formation mechanism of the intermetallics during welding dissimilar metals. As a kind of elective course, teaching the joining of dissimilar metals can make the students master the main joining methods and the basic joining theories of dissimilar metals. At the same time, the students can know and understand the joining process and characteristics of dissimilar steel, steel and non-ferrous metals and alloys, dissimilar nonferrous metals and alloy, refractory metals and other metals. It is useful for students to enhance their professional knowledge, adaptability and creativity. This course was performed mainly around the welding principle and welding method and basic theory for dissimilar metals, welding process and characteristics of multi-type dissimilar metals. Among them, the welding method and basic theory for dissimilar metals, welding process and characteristics of multi-type dissimilar metals are the focus of this course. The weldability analysis and selection of welding process for multi-type dissimilar metals are the difficulty of this course.

default.zh: 课程主要讲解以激光为工具在工业界中常用的几种激光制造技术相关基础知识与工业应用特点。课程开始，首先介绍激光物理相关的必备知识，如激光的理特性、激光器的工作原理与分类、激光操作安全知识等；以及激光加工中的专业基础知识，包括激光热源特性、激光与材料的相互作用、激光加工过程的传热传质特性、材料的快速凝固行为等。进一步，将分别介绍激光连接、激光表面处理、激光切割、激光烧蚀与钻孔、激光增材制造、超快激光微纳加工等几种激光加工技术的激光特性、工艺特点、物理现象及控制方法等。根据方法的不同，有针对性地分析不同工艺方法特有的专业知识、相关设备及工业应用情况，让学生更全面了解激光制造技术中光源、工艺、材料的重要性及其对加工质量的影响规律，掌握当前激光制造技术在工业领域的最新应用动态。最后，以实例介绍高功率激光在汽车、模具、造船等行业中用到的典型激光制造技术，讲解不同激光制造工艺在结构件生产中的考虑因素，对激光加工技术的工业应用潜力与发展趋势进行综合的分析与讨论。
default.en: The course mainly explains the basic knowledge and industrial application of several laser manufacturing technologies. At the beginning of the course, we will introduce the necessary knowledge of laser physics, such as laser physic characteristics, laser operating principle, laser classification and laser safety, etc. as well as the basic knowledge of laser processing, including laser heat source characteristics, interaction between laser and material, heat and mass transfer of laser processing, rapid solidification of materials, etc. Further, the laser processing characteristics, physical phenomena and control methods of several laser technologies are introduced, including laser joining, laser surface treatment, laser cutting, laser ablation and drilling, laser additive manufacturing, Ultrafast laser micro-nano processing and so on. According to different laser processing method, the relevant professional knowledge, equipment and industrial application situation are targeted analysis, which to help student comprehensive understanding of the importance influence of laser source, processing and materials on the laser manufacturing quality. Finally, the examples of high laser manufacturing in the automotive, mould, shipbuilding industry are introduced comprehensively, the interpretation of the different considerations for the different laser manufacturing technology in the real production. Based on this, the potential industrial applications and the development tendency of laser manufacturing technology are analyzed and discussed.

default.zh: 本课程以提高学生焊接专业实际工程能力为目标，结合典型的焊接生产过程，介绍焊接工艺技术在实际焊接生产环节中的应用及其生产组织方式。课程的主要内容涉及焊接生产过程的备料、装配、焊接及检测整个环节。具体包括：焊接备料、焊件装配，焊接工艺装备及其自动化、焊接工艺制定，装焊夹具的选择及设计、焊接接头的设计及焊后检测。体现焊接过程技术运用及生产管理组织相结合。 通过本课程学习，使学生了解焊接生产的备料、装焊及质量检测的整个生产链条；了解焊接生产组织的机械化和自动化发展趋势及典型应用的相关知识。使学生熟悉焊接工艺评定规则及其程序；熟悉焊接工艺规程编制的相关要求。使学生掌握进行焊接工艺设计及焊接工装夹具设计的必须知识。
default.en: The aim of this course is to improve the welding engineering ability of students. Subjected to typical welding production process, welding technique and management mode which utilized during practical welding production process was introduced. The content of this subject was including material preparation, assembly, welding and test procedure. The specific content was as following: material preparation, assembly of weldment, technological equipment of welding procedure and its automation, development of welding procedure, selection and design of fixture for assembly and welding, design and test of weld joint. The course will integrate the technique application and production management during welding. Through study of this course, students should understand the whole production chain including material preparation for welding production, assembly and welding process and welding joint test; students should understand the knowledge about mechanization and automation during welding production and its typical application; students should be familiar with rules and procedures for welding procedure qualification, be familiar with the requirement for the development of welding process specification; students should master the basic knowledge for welding procedure design, equipment selection and fixture design for welding production.

default.zh: 本课程的前导课程《焊接方法及设备》是焊接系核心专业课，主要讲授电弧物理基础、各种电弧焊接方法的原理、特点、机制等理论知识，由于课时限制，对于电弧焊接的实际工程应用等方面的知识基本不讲或略讲，造成理论和生产实际的脱节。工程应用部分知识，恰恰是学生毕业进入企业后，作为焊接工程师首先和直接要面对的问题，直接体现个人职业素养和能力。本课程的设置就是为了实现学校和企业、理论和实践的紧密衔接，使学生在学校中能够了解具体的电弧焊接生产过程，避免“上手慢”，为日后焊接工程师工作奠定坚实的基础。 课程主要内容包括：焊接结构的特点、焊接工程图识别和审查、焊前焊后处理、焊接工程实例、焊接工艺评定、焊接工艺规程设计、焊接车间设计和焊接生产安全等。重点讲解电弧焊接的应用范围、应用对象及工程应用现状，结合产品构件分析接头形式及可用焊接工艺，焊接过程控制，生产效率控制，产品质量及质量问题应对。焊接评定主要讲解焊接工艺评定的意义、方法、原则、遵循标准，评价过程，技能评定与产品质量的关系。
default.en: The leading course of this course, "welding methods and equipment" is the core specialized course of welding department. It mainly deals with the fundamentals of arc physics, the principles, characteristics and mechanisms of various arc welding methods. Because of the time limit, in the leading courses, the knowledge of the actual application of arc welding, such as the actual engineering application, will not be explained or talked about, which will cause the separation between theory and practice. Engineering application is exactly the first and the direct problem that the welding engineers should face as soon as they graduate to enter the enterprise, which directly reflects their professional accomplishment and ability. The purpose of this course is to make up for the gap between schools and the enterprise, theory and practice, so that students can learn the basic knowledge of the actual application of arc welding, and lay a solid foundation for future work. The main content of the course includes: characteristics of welding structures, identification and review of welding engineering drawings, pre - and post welding treatments, welding engineering examples, welding process evaluation, welding process specification design, welding workshop design, and welding production safety. Focus on explaining the application scope, application objects, and engineering application status of arc welding. Analyze the joint forms and available welding processes based on product components, control the welding process, control production efficiency, and address product quality and quality issues. Welding qualification mainly explains the significance, methods, principles, standards to be followed, evaluation process, and the relationship between skill evaluation and product quality of welding process qualification.

default.zh: 增材制造是当今制造业升级换代独一无二的技术手段，在局部领域可以替代焊接来实现增材连接，在未来材料类科研院所或企业是必须掌握的专业技能。 本课程全面介绍增材制造领域的背景、研究现状及应用实例，讲解电子束、激光、电弧、超声、搅拌摩擦等增材制造技术。在此基础上，讲解电子束增材制造的原理和应用。课程考核方式为结课报告。
default.en: Additive manufacturing is a unique and cutting-edge technology that is revolutionizing the manufacturing industry today. In certain applications, it can replace welding to achieve additive joining. Therefore, it is an essential skill for professionals in material research institutes or enterprises to master in the future. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the background, current research status, and application examples in the field of additive manufacturing. It covers various additive manufacturing technologies, including electron beam, laser, arc, ultrasonic, and friction stir deposition. Building upon this foundation, the course delves into the principles and applications of electron beam additive manufacturing. Assessment is based on course reports.

default.zh: 根据生态环境材料的本质特征，并考虑到其作为一门课程的系统性，以及作为应用型的总体培养目标，确立的课程内容构建指导思想为：以阐述生态环境材料的基本概念、材料环境协调性评价方法及环境协调性设计原则与方法为重点，以金属材料、无机材料、高分子材料制备及天然资源利用为具体事例，使生态环境材料课程内容既具有系统性、科学性、又具有实用性，以切合工科类本科教学的总体目标，并注重与相关课程内容的衔接，为生态环境研究和开发奠定理论基础和技术支持。具体讲授内容包括：环境材料的定义、起源、研究内容、应用及其发展趋势；材料加工和使用对资源和环境的影响；材料的环境影响评估，涉及材料的环境指数；生态循环评估方法（LCA），以及常用的LCA理论模型及数学方法和LCA的指导原则和应用；环境材料的设计，重点为材料流分析方法和工业生态学；生态环境材料实例，包括：仿生物材料、环境治理材料、高分子材料；材料的环境友好加工技术及工业生态学；基于生态足迹的绿色制造系统设计。
default.en: According to the characteristics of the eco materials, and considering it as a system of course, and overall as an application of the training objectives, course content construction established the guiding ideology: the basic concept, elaborated the eco materials environment evaluation method and environment design principles and methods for the key, with metal materials, polymer materials, inorganic materials preparation and utilization of natural resources for a specific example, the course content of eco materials not only has the systematic, scientific, and practical, in order to meet the overall goal of engineering undergraduate teaching, and pay attention to the connection with the relevant curriculum, lay the theoretical foundation and technology support for the research and development of ecological environment. The specific contents of teaching materials include: environment definition, origin, research contents, application and development trend; the processing of materials and influence on resources and environment; environmental impact assessment materials, involving environmental index materials; evaluation method of ecological cycle (LCA), and LCA theoretical model and mathematical methods and commonly used in LCA guidance the principle and application of design; environmental materials, key analysis method and industrial ecology material flow; ecological environment material includes examples: biomimetic materials, environmental treatment materials, polymer materials; Environmentally friendly processing technology and industrial ecology of materials; Design of green manufacturing system based on ecological footprint.

default.zh: 目前材料连接的相关研究多针对结构材料，连接时仅需考虑连接接头的结构可靠性。相比结构材料，功能材料连接时除了需要考虑结构可靠性，还需考虑连接过程及连接接头的引入（尤其对于小型化器件）不能影响材料功能性的发挥，其影响因素更为复杂。然而，目前对功能材料连接的相关研究较少，本校也未开设专门针对功能材料连接的相关课程。因此，深入开展功能材料连接研究，同时开设相关课程以激发学生的研究兴趣，对于推动先进功能材料应用至关重要。本课程以功能材料先进连接技术及应用为背景，紧跟最新的相关研究进展，重点掌握：1、磁性功能材料先进连接技术及应用；2、全固态电池材料先进封装技术及应用；3、透明陶瓷材料先进连接技术及应用；4、热电材料先进连接技术及应用；5、生物材料先进连接技术及应用；6、结构功能复合材料先进连接技术及应用。通过本课程学习，训练学生从工程实际中思考问题的方式、处理问题的方法以及实验动手能力，培养学生的创新精神和实践能力，以此提升学生的综合科研能力。
default.en: At present, most of the research on material bonding is focused on structural materials, and only the structural reliability of the joint is considered in bonding process. Compared with structural materials, the bonding of functional materials should not only consider the structural reliability, but also consider the bonding process and the introduction of the joint (especially for miniaturized devices) can not affect the performance of the material function. So the influencing factors are more complex. However, there are few studies on the bonding of functional material, and there are no courses specifically for functional material bonding in our university. In order to promote the application of advanced functional materials, it is very important to carry out in-depth research on functional materials bonding and open relevant courses to stimulate students' interest in this research. With the background of advanced bonding technology and application of functional materials, this course follows up with the latest research progress and focuses on: 1. Advanced bonding technology and application of magnetic functional materials; 2. 2. Advanced packaging technology and application of all-solid state battery materials; 3. Advanced bonding technology and application of transparent ceramic materials; 4. Advanced bonding technology and application of thermoelectric materials; 5. Advanced bonding technology and application of biological materials; 6. Advanced bonding technology and application of structural and functional composite materials. Through the study of this course, students are trained to think about problems from the engineering practice, to deal with problems and experiment ability, to cultivate their innovative spirit and practical ability, to improve their comprehensive scientific research ability.

default.zh: 增材制造是一种数字化制造技术，具有快速制造、绿色环保、可加工复杂构件等特点，正越来越多应用于先进材料和特种结构的成型。激光增材制造技术是一门为材料科学与工程学院开设的专业选修课。该课程主要介绍基于选区激光熔化增材制造技术的先进材料及特种结构的设计和制造，以及相关专业基础知识。指导学生了解激光增材制造领域中的材料及结构方面的特点和问题，对新材料开发及新结构设计有新的思路；培养学生对激光增材制造技术前沿方向和发展趋势的预判及识别能力。
default.en: Additive manufacturing is a digital manufacturing technology that has the characteristics of rapid manufacturing, green environmental protection, and the ability to fabricate components with complex structure. It is becoming more and more popular to build components with special structures from advanced materials. Laser Additive Manufacturing Technology is a major elective course for the students from School of Materials Science and Engineering. This course mainly introduces the design and manufacture of advanced materials and special structures based on selective laser melting technology, as well as the related knowledge. This course would instruct students to understand the characteristics and problems of materials and structures in the field of laser additive manufacturing. Moreover, this course would motive students to have new ideas for the development of advanced materials and novel structures. More importantly, this course will train students to predict and identify the frontier direction and development trend of laser additive manufacturing technology.

default.zh: 金属3D打印是一种先进制造技术，基于计算机辅助设计模型，将金属材料通过逐层制造的方式生产出形状复杂的产品。该制造方式具有材料利用率高、制造周期短、设计与制造无缝集成、个性化定制、以及易于生产出传统工艺难以甚至无法加工的复杂结构等不可替代的优势，广泛应用在航空航天、国防、汽车、电子、制药和生物医学等领域。然而由于其特定的工艺制造过程，产品仍然存在诸多质量问题，尤其在可重复性以及可靠性方面存在不足，严重制约其大规模工业化生产与应用。因此亟需发展质量控制技术，对增材过程进行实时监测，并通过数值模拟的方法为稳定增材过程提供理论指导，以提高增材制造的质量。本课程的内容主要包括金属3D打印过程概念及原理、监测方法及其工业应用、热流传输基础、缺陷和变形模拟、组织模拟及数字孪生技术。本课程旨在指导学生掌握金属3D打印的基本概念及原理，引导学生掌握金属3D过程的各种监测方法，同时掌握其监测原理和机制，能够针对不同工程应用领域提出合理的监测方法并根据特定的应用需求对监测方法进行改进。进一步地，引导学生通过使用数值模拟的方法实现变形、组织及缺陷的模拟，为实际的工程应用问题提供理论指导。
default.en: Metal 3D printing is an advanced manufacturing technology that uses metal materials to produce complex-shaped products through layer-by-layer manufacturing based on computer-aided design models. It’s an advanced manufacturing technology with significant advantages, including high material utilization, short production cycle, customization and the ability to produce complex structures. It is widely used in aerospace, defense, automotive, electronics, and biomedical fields. However, due to its specific manufacturing process, the product still has many quality problems, especially in terms of repeatability and reliability, which seriously restrict its large-scale industrial production and application. Therefore, it is urgent to develop quality control technology, monitor the additive process in real time, and provide theoretical guidance for stabilizing the additive process through numerical simulation. The content of this course mainly includes the concept and principle of metal 3D printing process, monitoring methods and industrial applications, the basis of heat flow transmission, defect and deformation simulation, tissue simulation and digital twin technology of metal 3D printing process. This course aims to guide students to master the basic concepts and principles of metal 3D printing, various monitoring methods of metal 3D process and its monitoring principles and be able to propose reasonable monitoring methods for different engineering application fields and improve them according to specific application needs. Furthermore, students are guided to accomplish the numerical simulations of deformation, structure and defects, which may provide theoretical guidance for practical engineering application problems.

default.zh: 本课程涵盖微电子器件生产的重要加工手段之一——微电子焊接技术与微纳制造技术的主要内容。本课程包括微电子焊接技术的基本原理、基本方法及基本试验、微连接工艺材料（焊料、焊膏、焊剂、粘接剂、清洗剂）的选择与设计知识、微电子器件检测与返修技术（来料检测，组件工艺过程检测与组件测试技术，微电子组件的返修技术），为从事微电子器件生产与设计打下良好基础。
default.en: This course covers the main content of microelectronic welding technology and micronano manufacturing technology, one of the important processing means of microelectronic device production. This course includes the basic principles, methods and tests of micro-electronic welding technology, the selection and design knowledge of micro-connection process materials (solder, solder paste, flux, adhesive, cleaning agent), the detection and repair technology of micro-electronic devices (incoming material detection, component process detection and component testing technology, and the repair technology of micro-electronic components). It lays a good foundation for the production and design of microelectronic devices.

default.zh: 《基于AI技术的焊接材料设计》是一门面向焊接技术与工程专业高年级本科生的课程，课程旨在借助人工智能技术（AI），为特殊冶金环境下焊接材料的设计及开发提供一种高效、便捷的途径，解决传统设计方法周期长、成本高、主要凭经验等问题。课程内容主要包括：传统焊接材料设计方法及不足；机器学习、深度学习与生成式AI的基本概念及发展趋势；基于AI的焊接材料设计原理与建模方法；典型焊接材料的AI设计及性能预测的项目学习等。
default.en: "Design of Welding Materials Based on AI Technology" is a course for senior undergraduates majoring in welding technology and engineering. The aims to provide an efficient and convenient approach for the design and development of welding materials in special metallurgical environments by using artificial intelligence technology (AI), addressing the issues of long cycle high cost, and reliance on experience in traditional design methods. The course content mainly includes: traditional welding material design methods and their shortcomings; basic concepts and development trends of machine learning deep learning, and generative AI; principles and modeling methods of AI-based welding material design; project-based learning of AI design and performance prediction of typical welding materials, etc.

default.zh: 《先进焊接与增材制造技术前沿》由国际高水平专家共建，聚焦金属焊接及增材制造的先进工艺与前沿技术，通过最新科研成果和工程案例，使学生深入了解国际科研中心文化与前沿动态，拓展创新能力与全球视野。
default.en: Frontiers of Advanced Welding and Additive Manufacturing, co-developed by internationally recognized experts, focuses on advanced metal welding and additive manufacturing processes. Through cutting-edge research and engineering case studies, students gain insight into the culture and frontier developments of leading international centers, fostering innovation and global perspective.

default.zh: 先进印刷电路板材料与制造是电子技术与产业中的基础和先导，同时也是电子封装技术专业的选修课程。本课程将学习印制电路板材料电气特性、印制电路板材料可靠性以及印刷电路板中的导电材料和介电材料及其制作方法等内容。通过本门课程的学习，使学生掌握先进印刷电路板和制造中的材料及其特性和应用；对材料的热物理特性、化学特性、力学特性等基本封装特性有深入的了解。
default.en: Advanced printed circuit board materials and manufacturing is the pilot and foundation of electronic technology and industry; it is also an important electronic packaging technology course. Students will study the electrical characteristics of printed circuit board materials, printed circuit board material reliability, printed circuit board conductive materials, dielectric materials and its production methods. Through taking this course, students should be able to master the advanced printed circuit board and manufacturing materials as well as their characteristics and applications. Students will also get a deep understanding of the thermal physical properties, chemical properties, mechanical properties and other basic packaging characteristics of the above materials.

default.zh: 集成电路热管理技术是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，作为电子封装领域中关键技术之一，其专门研究各种电子设备的高效散热方式、散热结构及所热界面材料。本课程也是工科高校电子类、信息类专业的一门重要的课程，在培养学生综合设计能力和工程实践能力方面占有重要的地位。 在集成电路的集成度快速提升，功率密度越来越高的背景下，本课程将带领学生学习如何从结构与材料的角度出发进行器件热设计，从而快速、高效地处理芯片积热问题。如台式机、笔记本电脑、手机等电子产品中的热管理方法，以及如何通过热设计实现性能释放。授课内容包括集成电路热管理基础知识、集成电路热管理关键技术、集成电路导热界面材料、热界面材料性能测试方法与可靠性。通过本门课程的学习，使学生掌握集成电路热设计的基本思想与实现原理、热界面材料特性与应用领域，并对封装热界面理论预测方法有深入的了解。
default.en: Heat Management Technology in Integrated Circuits is an elective course for the Electronic Packaging Technology. As one of the key technologies in the field of electronic packaging, it specializes in the efficient heat dissipation methods, heat dissipation structures and thermal interface materials of various electronic devices. This course is also an important course for electronics and information majors in engineering universities and plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive design ability and engineering practice ability. In the context of the rapid improvement of integrated circuit integration and the increasing power density, this course will lead students to learn how to perform thermal design from the perspective of structure and materials, to quickly and efficiently deal with the problem of chip heat accumulation. For example, this course will introduce how to achieve performance release through thermal design in electronic products such as desktops, laptops, mobile phones, etc. The lecture includes the basic knowledge of integrated circuit thermal management, the key technologies of integrated circuit thermal management, integrated circuit thermal interface materials, thermal interface material performance measurement methods and reliability. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic ideas and implementation principles of integrated circuit thermal design, thermal interface material characteristics and application fields, and have an in-depth understanding of the theoretical prediction methods of electronic packaging thermal interface.

default.zh: 混合微电路技术是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，其目的是使本专业学生熟练掌握混合微电路的基本概念和应用；熟练掌握厚膜基片、厚膜浆料及厚膜电路制造工艺；熟练掌握薄膜基片、薄膜导体、薄膜电阻、薄膜电容及薄膜电路制造工艺；熟练掌握混合电路无源元件微调工艺；了解与混合电路设计有关的几个概念，即平面波导、损耗、寄生参数、热考虑、布图。
default.en: Hybrid Microcircuit Technology is an elective course of electronic packaging technology subject, its purpose is to make the students master the basic concepts and applications of hybrid microcircuit; to master thick-film substrate, thick film paste, and their manufacturing process; to master thin-film substrate, thin film conductor, thin-film resistor, thin-film capacitor, and their manufacturing process; to master fine tuning process of passive components in hybrid microcircuit; to understand the several concepts about hybrid microcircuit design, that is, planar waveguide, loss, parasitic parameter, heat dissipation, and layout.

default.zh: 混合微电路技术是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，其目的是使本专业学生熟练掌握混合微电路的基本概念和应用；熟练掌握厚膜基片、厚膜浆料及厚膜电路制造工艺；熟练掌握薄膜基片、薄膜导体、薄膜电阻、薄膜电容及薄膜电路制造工艺；熟练掌握混合电路无源元件微调工艺；了解与混合电路设计有关的几个概念，即平面波导、损耗、寄生参数、热考虑、布图。
default.en: Hybrid Microcircuit Technology is an elective course of electronic packaging technology subject, its purpose is to make the students master the basic concepts and applications of hybrid microcircuit; to master thick-film substrate, thick film paste, and their manufacturing process; to master thin-film substrate, thin film conductor, thin-film resistor, thin-film capacitor, and their manufacturing process; to master fine tuning process of passive components in hybrid microcircuit; to understand the several concepts about hybrid microcircuit design, that is, planar waveguide, loss, parasitic parameter, heat dissipation, and layout.

default.zh: 《纳米电化学》是电子封装技术专业的主干课程，主要涉及电化学技术在纳米加工中的应用，系统讲述纳米电化学技术的原理和具体工艺，以具体的应用为例介绍纳米电化学技术在微电子和电子封装领域的应用。主要包括：纳米粒子和超薄膜的电化学生长，镀层微观结构的控制原理，镀层分析方法，镀层显微组织在热处理中的变化，最后介绍目前的纳米电化学研究的前沿热点。使学生能够了解和掌握目前纳米电化学技术的科研和应用情况。
default.en: Electrocrystallization in Nanotechnology is a major course of electronic packaging technology subject which involves the nano-electrochemical technology for different micro- and nano- devices. The principles and processes of nano-electrochemical technology are introduced systematically. The applications of nano-electrochemical technology in micro-electro- mechanical system engineering and electronic packing are stated by specific instances. The main contents of this course include: Electrocrystallization in nano-particle and nano-layer, the principle in layer microstructure control, plated layer analysis method, the layer microstructure change in the thermal treatment, and the front hotspot in the nano-electrochemical technology. The students can understand and hold the research and application status in nano-electrochemical technology.

default.zh: 《纳米电化学》是电子封装技术专业的主干课程，主要涉及电化学技术在纳米加工中的应用，系统讲述纳米电化学技术的原理和具体工艺，以具体的应用为例介绍纳米电化学技术在微电子和电子封装领域的应用。主要包括：纳米粒子和超薄膜的电化学生长，镀层微观结构的控制原理，镀层分析方法，镀层显微组织在热处理中的变化，最后介绍目前的纳米电化学研究的前沿热点。使学生能够了解和掌握目前纳米电化学技术的科研和应用情况。

default.zh: 电子封装模拟与仿真是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，培养学生工程知识学习能力，问题分析能力以及使用现代工具能力方面占有重要的地位。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、现场教学、上机等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和巩固和拓展材料工程科学知识的应用能力以及使用现代工具能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程内容包括：模拟与仿真有限元软件应用背景；Marc有限元软件的基础操作；大功率芯片热仿真分析；激光焊接温度场仿真分析；BGA再流焊工艺仿真分析；通孔插装焊接温度场分析；组装焊点寿命预测。
default.en: Modeling and Simulation for Electronic Packaging is an elective course of electronic packaging technology subject , training students' engineering knowledge learning ability, plays an important role in problem analysis ability and the ability to use modern tools. The main task of this course is through classroom teaching, field teaching, computer and other aspects of the cultivation of students' innovation consciousness and ability and to consolidate and expand the application of knowledge engineering materials and the use of modern tools, a corresponding index point in support of professional learning. The course content includes the background of finite element analysis simulation software applications, fundamental operations of Marc finite element software, thermal simulation analysis of high-power chips, temperature field simulation analysis of laser welding, simulation analysis of BGA reflow soldering processes, temperature field analysis of through-hole soldering, and life prediction of assembly solder joints.

default.zh: 《电子制造装备》是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，其目的是使本专业学生掌握电子制造装备的基本概念、历史渊源、相关技术与经济的关系，以及所依托的理论基础、技术基础及发展趋势；能运用数学、物理、化学知识表达电子制造装备领域的工程问题，建立电子制造装备的数学物理模型，并正确求解；具有基本的电子制造装备分析及电子制造装备设计能力，以及分析和解决电子制造装备工程实践问题的创新意识和创新设计能力。
default.en: Manufacturing Equipment for Electronic Packaging is an optional course of electronic packaging technology subject, its purpose is to make the students master the basic concepts and applications of equipment for electronics packaging; to master inspection system, interconnection or adhesion process, ball bonding, chip mount technology, CMP, flip chip technology, reflow, molding, THT, and their manufacturing equipments; to master fine tuning process of equipments in electronics packaging; to understand the several concepts about the equipment design.

default.zh: 电子封装新兴技术简介是电子封装技术专业的专业选修课程，课程的主要内容包括电子封装技术的历史沿革、电子封装新兴技术在航空航天、汽车工业、生物电子、计算机通信、柔性传感等领域等应用现状、电子封装技术发展趋势等。通过本课程学习，使学生了解目前新兴且较为先进的封装技术、封装形式及技术特点，了解未来电子封装技术的发展趋势，为培养学生的工程能力奠定理论基础。培养学生的创新意识与能力，为后续专业课程的学习提供支撑。
default.en: IIntroduction to emerging technologies of electronic packaging is an elective course for the major of electronic packaging technology. The main contents of the course include the historical evolution of electronic packaging technology, the application status of emerging electronic packaging technology in aerospace, automobile industry, bioelectronics, computer communication, flexible sensing and other fields, and the development trend of electronic packaging technology. Through the study of this course, students can understand the current emerging and more advanced packaging technology, packaging forms and technical characteristics, understand the development trend of electronic packaging technology in the future, and lay a theoretical foundation for cultivating students 'engineering ability. Cultivate students 'innovative consciousness and ability, and provide support for the study of subsequent professional courses.

default.zh: 光与材料之间的相互作用以时空控制的方式激发多物理、瞬态和非平衡光子相互作用的卓越能力而受到可穿戴电子设备的极大关注。它与金属纳米材料、陶瓷、石墨烯、聚合物和钙钛矿等各种材料实现了独特的光热和光化学反应，在不损坏温度敏感基板的情况下实现了软电子器件的性能大幅提升。在众多光源中，闪光灯因其出色的光输出效率、快速处理能力以及与大规模“卷对卷”制造的出色兼容性而被认为是适合商业应用的平台。与传统的高温微细加工工艺相比，这些独特的特性在广泛的可穿戴和柔性电子产品中提供了相当大的优势，例如太阳能电池、薄膜晶体管、光电子产品和聚合物基板上的传感器。闪光灯技术不断进步，为未来的可穿戴电子产品提供具有无限外形尺寸的纳米材料/设备的新颖概念和策略。本课程从材料和器件等方面总结了光与材料相互作用领域的最新前沿理论，以及其在柔性印刷电子器件研究中的最新进展。
default.en: Light-material interaction has received significant attention for wearable electronics because of its exceptional ability to excite multi-physical, transient, and non-equilibrium photon interactions in a spatiotemporally controlled manner. It has realized unique photothermal and photochemical reactions with various types of materials, including metal nanomaterials, ceramics, graphene, polymers, and perovskites, enabling the substantial performance improvement of soft electronics without damaging a temperature-sensitive substrates. Among the numerous optical sources, flash lamps have been considered to be a suitable platform for commercial applications owing to their excellent light-output efficiency, rapid processing capability, and outstanding compatibility with large-scale roll-to-roll manufacturing. These exclusive features offer considerable advantages in a broad range of wearable and flexible electronics such as solar cells, thin-film-transistors, optoelectronics, and sensors on polymer substrates compared to the conventional high-temperature microfabrication processes. The flash lamp technology has consistently advanced to provide novel concepts of nanomaterials/devices with unlimited form factors and strategies for future wearable electronics. Here, the recent progress in the field of flashlight-material interaction for soft electronics is summarized with regard to the process parameters, materials, and devices, together with the latest updates on the flash lamp technology.

default.zh: 电子封装国际标准讲座是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，其目的是使本专业学生了解IPC-610(美国电子工业联接协会 电子组件可接受性标准)，该标准是全球应用最广范的电子组装标准。通过该课程使学生掌握无铅、通孔、SMT及分立布线组件的元器件排列朝向和焊接要求、印制电路板和层压板要求。提高电子封装技术专业毕业生就业能力、工程化能力、国际化视野。
default.en: Certification of International Standards of Electronics Packaging is a elective course of electronic packaging technology major, its purpose is to make the students master IPC-610 (Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies, published by Association Connecting Electronics Industries ). IPC-610 is the most widely recognised and accepted standard ever published by the IPC for the PWB assembly industry world widely. The objective of this programme is to improve accuracy of discrimination between an 'acceptable' or 'defect' electronic assembly, i.e. Demand of soldering, leadfree, throughhole, SMT and distribution and orientation of Electronic Assemblies, demand of printed wiring board circuit and laminated board. Another objective is to to improve the employability of electronics packaging technology’s graduates, engineering capabilities and international horizons. Final result of this course is accumulative type, including performance and a final exam.

default.zh: 电子封装国际标准讲座是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，其目的是使本专业学生了解IPC-610(美国电子工业联接协会 电子组件可接受性标准)，该标准是全球应用最广范的电子组装标准。通过该课程使学生掌握无铅、通孔、SMT及分立布线组件的元器件排列朝向和焊接要求、印制电路板和层压板要求。提高电子封装技术专业毕业生就业能力、工程化能力、国际化视野。
