Another objective is to to improve the employability of electronics packaging technology’s graduates, engineering capabilities and international horizons.

default.zh: 化学微加工是电子封装技术专业的主干课程，主要涉及微纳米器件的化学加工方法，系统讲述不同化学微加工技术的作用原理和具体工艺，以具体的应用为例介绍化学微加工在微电子和电子封装领域的应用。主要包括：化学腐蚀和电化学腐蚀技术的原理和具体应用，化学机械抛光技术的作用原理和具体工艺及应用，电化学阴极还原技术的应用，化学镀的反应原理与技术，导电胶的组成和应用，纳米材料的化学制备方法，最后介绍目前的化学微加工研究的前沿热点。使学生能够了解和掌握目前化学微加工技术的科研和应用情况。
default.en: Chemical Micro-Fabrication Engineering is a major course of electronic packaging technology subject which involves the chemical fabrication technology for different micro- and nano- devices. The principles and processes of different chemical micro-fabrication technology are introduced systematically. The applications of chemical micro-fabrication technology in micro-electro- mechanical system engineering and electronic packing are stated by specific instances. The main contents of this course include: the principle and process of the chemical and electrochemical corrosion technology, the principle and application of the CMP technology, the application of the electrochemical cathode reduction technology, the principle and process of the electroless plating, the composition and application of the ECA, the chemical methods in nano-materials and the front hotspot in chemical micro-fabrication engineering. The students can understand and hold the research and application status in chemical micro-fabrication engineering.

default.zh: 纳米材料与连接是电子封装技术专业的专业选修课，本课程的目的是让本专业学生掌握包括纳米材料及其电子学性质等基本知识，如纳米效应的物理原理，电子能级的不连续性，久保理论，量子尺寸效应，小尺寸效应，表面效应等；了解纳米材料的诞生和发展综述，如纳米科学技术的诞生及其潜在影响，从微电子学到纳米电子学，纳米电子材料等；深入了解纳米光电子材料的物理特征、工作原理以及主要应用等相关知识；熟悉纳米复合钎料的结构特点、制备方法和强化机制；掌握纳米材料的表征技术，如碳纳米管的表征方法等。通过对纳米材料与连接课程的学习，学生将对代表性的纳米材料的基本特性、制备工艺及应用前景有了深入了解，能够利用相关的材料、物理、化学基本原理等对诸如颗粒状、薄膜状、三维网状等纳米复合钎料进行分析和设计。
default.en: Nanomaterials and Joining is a professional elective course of electronic packaging technology subject. The main contents of this course include: basic knowledge of nanomaterials and their electronic properties, such as physical principles of nanoscale effect, discontinuity of electron energy levels, Kubo theory, quantum size effect, small size effect, surface effect, etc.; an overview of the birth and development of nanomaterials, such as the birth of nanoscience and technology and its potential impact, from microelectronics to nanoelectronics, nanoelectronic materials, etc.; the knowledge of physical characteristics, working principles and main applications of nano-optoelectronic materials; structural characteristics, preparation methods and strengthening mechanisms of nanocomposite brazing materials; characterization techniques for nanomaterials, such as characterization methods for carbon nanotubes, etc. After attending the course, students should have in-depth knowledge of the basic properties, preparation process and application prospects of nanomaterials, and be able to analyze and design a range of nanocomposite brazing materials, including granular, thin-film, three-dimensional mesh, etc., using relevant materials, physical and chemical fundamentals.

default.zh: 纳米材料与连接是电子封装技术专业的专业选修课，本课程的目的是让本专业学生掌握包括纳米材料及其电子学性质等基本知识，如纳米效应的物理原理，电子能级的不连续性，久保理论，量子尺寸效应，小尺寸效应，表面效应等；了解纳米材料的诞生和发展综述，如纳米科学技术的诞生及其潜在影响，从微电子学到纳米电子学，纳米电子材料等；深入了解纳米光电子材料的物理特征、工作原理以及主要应用等相关知识；熟悉纳米复合钎料的结构特点、制备方法和强化机制；掌握纳米材料的表征技术，如碳纳米管的表征方法等。通过对纳米材料与连接课程的学习，学生将对代表性的纳米材料的基本特性、制备工艺及应用前景有了深入了解，能够利用相关的材料、物理、化学基本原理等对诸如颗粒状、薄膜状、三维网状等纳米复合钎料进行分析和设计。
default.en: Nanomaterials and Joining is a professional elective course of electronic packaging technology subject. The main contents of this course include: basic knowledge of nanomaterials and their electronic properties, such as physical principles of nanoscale effect, discontinuity of electron energy levels, Kubo theory, quantum size effect, small size effect, surface effect, etc.; an overview of the birth and development of nanomaterials, such as the birth of nanoscience and technology and its potential impact, from microelectronics to nanoelectronics, nanoelectronic materials, etc.; the knowledge of physical characteristics, working principles and main applications of nano-optoelectronic materials; structural characteristics, preparation methods and strengthening mechanisms of nanocomposite brazing materials; characterization techniques for nanomaterials, such as characterization methods for carbon nanotubes, etc. After attending the course, students should have in-depth knowledge of the basic properties, preparation process and application prospects of nanomaterials, and be able to analyze and design a range of nanocomposite brazing materials, including granular, thin-film, three-dimensional mesh, etc., using relevant materials, physical and chemical fundamentals.

default.zh: 电子封装与社会是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，在培养学生科学素养和人文素质、可持续发展理念和电子封装实践能力方面占有重要的地位。本课程的主要介绍电子封装技术对社会、经济以及个人发展的影响，电子封装技术相关的法规与政策，电子封装技术职业规范和职业危害因素识别及防护措施，电子封装过程对环境的影响，新技术在电子封装技术中的应用与影响，本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学及项目研究等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和材料加工科学与电子封装知识的应用能力。
default.en: Electronic Package and the Society is an elective course of electronic packaging technology. The main subject of this course is to bring up the student scientific literacy and humanistic quality, establish the sustainable development concept and practice electronic packaging operation. The main content of this course include: the electronic packaging technology effect on the society, economics and person development, the relevant regulations and policies of electronic packaging technology, the electronic packaging professional criteria, hazard and protection, the electronic packaging influence in the environment and the new technology application in the electronic packaging technology. Through the teaching and project studying, the student innovation and knowledge application ability should be promoted.

default.zh: 电子封装创新设计是电子封装技术专业的专业选修课程，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和电子封装实践能力方面占有重要地位。本课程的主要是培养学生的创新思路，运用数理基础、专业基础和专业知识，解决材料连接、电子封装中的疑难问题，通过引入电子封装创新设计实例，使学生对创新方法有更全面的了解，启发学生的创新思维。通过课程报告和团队项目的训练，学生能采用合适的方法获取知识解决疑难问题，具备自主学习和终身学习的意识。课程主要内容包括：创新思想与方法概论，材料连接方法中的创新案例，电子封装材料设计案例，多领域交叉的创新启示，工业应用引导科技创新。
default.en: Innovation design in electronic packaging is an elective course in electronic packaging technology specialty. This course aims to train students’ creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and practice ability in electronic packing field. Also, it is mainly to cultivate students’ innovative ideas and they can solve difficult problems in material joining and electronic packaging on basis of mathematics and physics, specialty fundamentals and knowledge. After the case study of innovation design in electronic technology, students will have a more comprehensive understanding of innovation and inspire their creative thinking. Through the training of the course report and the team projects, students can acquire knowledge to solve relatively difficult problems with appropriate methods and have the awareness of active learning and lifelong learning. The course mainly includes: the introduction to innovative thinking and methodology, the case study of material joining methods, the case study of packaging materials design, the innovation inspiration of the multidisciplinary crossing fields, and the guidance of scientific and technological innovations for industrial applications.

default.zh: 集成电路器件表面组装技术是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，包括表面组装工艺技术、表面组装元器件、表面组装材料、表面组装设备、表面组装质量与检测等SMT技术基础内容。具体内容包括表面组装元器件的特点、种类以及应用；印制电路板的设计原则；表面组装各个环节（焊膏印刷、贴片、焊接、测试、清洗及返修工艺）的工艺流程、技术特点及方法；表面组装设备的构成、原理以及工作特点以及表面组装缺缺陷的产生原因及检测方法等。通过该课程的学习，为本科生系统掌握表面组装技术工艺及原理打好基础。
default.en: Surface Mount Technology for Integrated Circuit Devicesis a elective course of electronic packaging technology subject，including surface mount process, components, materials, equipments, quality and inspection technology contents of SMT. The details content includes that the characteristics, types of surface mount components and their application, the design principles of printed circuit board, surface mount each link (solder paste printing, patch, welding, testing and cleaning and repair process) process, technical characteristics and methods, the structure, principle of surface mount equipment and working characteristics, and the failure and defects mechanism and their inspection methods. It will lay a firm professional foundation for undergraduates to master systematically the process and principles of SMT.

default.zh: MEMS和微系统封装是电子封装技术专业的必修课程，其目的是使本专业学生掌握MEMS和微系统相关的各种微制造技术、封装技术；深入了解MEMS和微系统工作原理、微系统封装中采用的材料、自动化微组装过程、微系统封装的可靠性及其测试。通过课堂教学、课外科技文献检索研究等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和材料工程科学知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: MEMS and micro system packaging is a compulsory course for the major of electronic packaging technology. Its purpose is to enable the students to master the MEMS and micro fabrication technology, micro system related packaging technology. Understanding of MEMS and the working principle of the system, the encapsulation materials, automated micro assembly process, reliability and reliability tests of the micro-system. Through the teaching, extracurricular scientific research link of literature retrieval to cultivate students' innovation consciousness and ability of engineering and materials science knowledge application ability, to reach the corresponding index point support professional learning achievements.

default.zh: 本课程将从柔性电子器件出现的背景、应用领域、基本结构和核心技术出发，使学生掌握柔性电子技术领域中的技术实现方法和基础理论；了解柔性电子技术在器件设计、功能材料、制造工艺方面与微电子技术的异同；通过介绍相关领域国内外的最新研究进展，了解器件柔性化应用中所遇到的机遇和挑战等；以电子皮肤为牵引探讨柔性电子材料与器件未来的发展趋势，使学生具备追踪学术前沿、发现关键问题的科研能力。柔性电子材料与器件是电子封装专业的选修课程，课程目标如下：（1）使本专业学生了解柔性电子器件所涉及的材料（金属纳米材料，石墨烯，液态金属等）、结构及制备方法、发展趋势、不同之处及相关性，掌握柔性电子器件的基本结构及制备关键技术（线路制备互连技术、性能表征等）；（2）使学生能够运用数学、物理、化学知识表达柔性电子器件中的工程问题，推导微纳连接过程的数学物理模型；（3）使学生具有基本的柔性电子器件制备工艺试验设计能力、分析和解决工程实践问题的创新意识和创新设计能力，以及追踪学术前沿、发现关键问题的科研能力。
default.en: This course will start from the background, application fields, basic structures, and core technologies of flexible electronic devices, enabling students to master the technical implementation methods and basic theories in the field of flexible electronic technology; Understand the similarities and differences between flexible electronic technology and microelectronics technology in device design, functional materials, and manufacturing processes; By introducing the latest research progress in relevant fields both domestically and internationally, we aim to understand the opportunities and challenges encountered in the application of device flexibility; Exploring the future development trends of flexible electronic materials and devices using electronic skins as a guide, enabling students to have the scientific research ability to track academic frontiers and discover key issues. Flexible electronic materials and devices are elective courses in the field of electronic packaging. The course objectives are as follows: (1) To enable students in this major to understand the materials (metal nanomaterials, graphene, liquid metals, etc.), structures, preparation methods, development trends, differences, and correlations involved in flexible electronic devices, and to master the basic structure and key preparation technologies of flexible electronic devices (circuit preparation interconnection technology, performance characterization, etc.); (2) Enable students to apply mathematical, physical, and chemical knowledge to express engineering problems in flexible electronic devices, and derive mathematical and physical models for micro/nano connection processes; (3) Enable students to have basic experimental design capabilities for flexible electronic device preparation processes, innovative awareness and design capabilities for analyzing and solving engineering practical problems, as well as scientific research capabilities for tracking academic frontiers and discovering key issues.

default.zh: 纳米新能源器件是电子封装技术专业的专业选修课，本课程的目的是让本专业学生掌握包括纳米新能源器件及器件的组成等知识，如纳米新能源器件定义，纳米新能源器件构造特点，纳米新能源器件的技术原理，纳米新能源器件的应用，国内外纳米新能源器件的研究现状等；了解纳米新能源器件的现状与发展和纳米新能源器件的主要特征，如纳米新能源器件的诞生和发展，新能源器件电极材料从宏观结构到纳米尺寸，其电荷存储能力和使用寿命的惊人变化等；深入了解锂离子电池、超级电容器以及电解水制氢等新能源器件的物理特征、工作原理以及主要应用等相关知识；掌握纳米新能源器件表征技术和制造技术，如原位透射表征技术、原位电化学表征技术、等离子体增强化学气相沉积设备、焦耳热快速加热设备等。
default.en: Nano New Energy Devices is a professional elective course of electronic packaging technology subject. The main contents of this course include: The knowledge of new nano-energy devices and the components of the devices, such as the definition of new nano-energy devices, the characteristics of new nano-energy device structure, the technical principle of new nano-energy devices, the application of new nano-energy devices, the status of research on new nano-energy devices at home and abroad, etc.; the current status and development of nano new energy devices and the main features of nano new energy devices, such as the birth and development of nano new energy devices, the amazing changes in charge storage capacity and service life of nano new energy devices from macrostructure to nanostructure of electrode materials, etc.; relevant knowledge of the physical characteristics, operating principles and main applications of new energy devices such as lithium-ion batteries, super-capacitors and electrocatalysis for hydrogen production; nano new energy device characterization technology and manufacturing technology, such as in-situ transmission characterization technology, in-situ electrochemical characterization technology, plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition equipment, Joule heat rapid heating equipment, etc.

default.zh: 光电子器件与封装技术是电子封装技术专业的选修课程，培养学生工程知识学习能力，问题分析能力以及使用现代工具能力方面占有重要的地位。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、项目研究等环节培养学生的创新意识与能力和材料工程科学知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程主要介绍光电子技术应用及光电子器件基础；半导体激光器与发光二极管；光接收组件与光电检测器；LED封装技术，包括LED封装结构、LED的封装工艺、荧光粉溶液涂抹技术、封胶胶体设计、LED的散热设计和LED的光学设计；光电子器件封装技术，包括光电子器件封装形式、光电子封装技术、耦合工艺和光电子多芯片组件封装技术。
default.en: Opto-electronic Device and Packaging Technology is an elective course of electronic packaging technology subject , training students' engineering knowledge learning ability, problem analysis ability and the ability to use modern tools. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' innovation consciousness at material engineering application of knowledge through classroom teaching, research projects, achieve the corresponding index results in support of professional learning.The main content of the course include: opto-electronic technology application and opto-electronic devices; semiconductor lasers and light-emitting diodes (LEDs); optical receiver module and the photoelectric detector; LED packaging technology such as LED packaging structure, LED packaging processing, Phosphor powder solution coating technology, design of sealant gel, LED thermal design and optical design; optoelectronic components packaging technology such as optoelectronic components packaging structure, opto-electronic packaging technology, coupling process and photoelectron multi-chip components packaging technology.

default.zh: 电子封装材料A是电子技术与产业中的基础和先导，同时也是电子封装技术专业的选修课程。本课程将学习电子技术中的主要材料类型，包括芯片粘接材料、金属类封装材料、陶瓷基板材料、塑封料等。通过本门课程的学习，使学生掌握电子封装和制造中的材料及其特性和应用；对材料的热物理特性、化学特性、力学特性等基本封装特性有深入的了解。
default.en: Electronic material A is a functional characteristics, structure features, physical and chemical properties of materials widely used in the electronic information technology and industry; it is the foundation and guide of electronic information technology and an elective course of Electronic Packaging Technology. This course covers the main materials of electronic information technology, including the types of Chip bonding materials, metal materials，Ceramic substrate materials， Plastic sealant etc. its purpose is to make the students master the materials in manufacturing electronic packaging and their characteristics and application; To encapsulate in-depth understanding the basic properties such as electromagnetic properties, chemical properties, physical characteristics, mechanical properties, etc.

default.zh: 《先进连接概论》是电子封装技术本科专业的专业基础课程，为拓展本专业学生对微电子制造、精密机械制造等领域的材料先进连接技术的广泛知识的掌握而设置。课程主要讲授几类主要材料连接的原理、方法、工艺、设备以及结构特点，重点使学生了解先进材料连接的基本理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势和前沿应用；熟悉和掌握不同连接方法的主要特点、应用领域，特别是在微细、精密制造领域的应用特点等。
default.en: A Survey of Advanced Joining is one of professional foundation courses to the undergraduate students in Electronics Packaging Technology, and the goal of this course is to develop students’ wide range of knowledge of advanced joining technology in the manufacturing fields of microelectronics, precision mechanics etc. In this course, several major joining technologies are introduced about their basic principle, materials, processes, related equipment and structural features. Students should be able to understand the theoretical foundation, hot research topics, development tendency and application in advanced manufacturing fields, be familiar with the main characteristics and application areas of major advanced joining technologies, especially application in micro and precision manufacturing after the course finished.

default.zh: 功率器件与封装技术是电子封装技术专业的专业基础课程，课程的主要内容包括功率半导体封装的定义和分类，如功率器件所用材料、分立器件和功率模块的封装等；典型功率器件的封装过程，包括从晶圆加工到焊料烧结、再到塑封电镀等全部工艺流程；功率器件的封装设计，包括材料和结构设计、封装工艺设计以及封装的散热设计等；功率器件的可靠性评价，包括功率器件的电特性测试、功率封装的仿真技术等；不同功率器件的应用及特点，如车规级半导体器件封装特点及要求、特种封装/宇航级封装的特点等。通过对功率器件与封装技术课程的学习，学生将对功率器件的制造与封装技术、可靠性评估方法和应用领域具备相当的了解，并能够利用相关的电子封装专业基础知识对诸如汽车功率半导体器件、宇航功率半导体器件等进行分析和设计。
default.en: Power Devices and Its Packaging Technology is a professional basic course for the major of electronic packaging technology. The main contents of the course include the definition and classification of power semiconductor packaging, such as the packaging of materials used for power devices, discrete devices and power modules; The packaging process of typical power devices includes the whole process flow from wafer processing to solder sintering to plastic packaging electroplating; Packaging design of power devices, including material and structure design, packaging process design and packaging heat dissipation design; Reliability evaluation of power devices, including electrical characteristics test of power devices, simulation technology of power packaging, etc; The application and characteristics of different power devices, such as the characteristics and requirements of vehicle specification semiconductor device packaging, and the characteristics of special packaging/aerospace packaging. Through the study of the course of power device and packaging technology, students will have a considerable understanding of the manufacturing and packaging technology, reliability evaluation methods and application fields of power devices, and be able to analyze and design such as automotive power semiconductor devices, aerospace power semiconductor devices, etc. with the relevant basic knowledge of electronic packaging.

default.zh: 先进封装和系统集成技术是电子封装技术专业的专业基础课程，课程的主要内容包括系统级封装技术介绍，如电子系统组成部分、系统技术演变历史、系统技术的比较等；片上系统(SOC)封装介绍，包括SOC架构和SOC设计；堆叠式IC（SIP）和TSV技术，包括SIP的定义、应用、材料及工艺流程、机械电学和热学问题、非TSV和TSV SIP技术的特点及对比；射频系统级封装(RF)，包括电磁设计、材料选择和模块集成技术；光电子系统级封装，包括光学布线设计、芯片光互连技术；此外还有对SOP基板集成技术、MEMS系统级封装、晶圆级封装的介绍。通过对先进封装和系统集成技术课程的学习，学生将对系统级集成封装技术的作用、结构、功能、关键技术和应用领域具备相当的了解，并能够利用相关的电子封装专业基础知识对系统级封装的结构进行分析和设计。
default.en: Advanced Packaging and System Integration Technology is a professional basic course for the major of electronic packaging technology. The main contents of the course include introduction to system level packaging technology, such as electronic system components, system technology evolution history, system technology comparison, etc; Introduction to System on Chip (SOC) packaging, including SOC architecture and SOC design; Stacked IC (SIP) and TSV technologies, including the definition, application, materials and process flow of SIP, mechanical electrical and thermal problems, characteristics and comparison of non TSV and TSV SIP technologies; RF system level packaging (RF), including electromagnetic design, material selection and module integration technology; Optoelectronic system level packaging, including optical wiring design, chip optical interconnection technology; In addition, we also introduce the SOP substrate integration technology, MEMS system level packaging, and wafer level packaging. Through the study of the course of Advanced Packaging and System Integration Technology, students will have a good understanding of the role, structure, function, key technologies and application fields of system level integrated packaging technology, and be able to analyze and design the structure of system level packaging using the relevant basic knowledge of electronic packaging.

default.zh: 柔性传感器件的可拉伸性、柔性、轻质等特性，赋予其可穿戴性，其在个人智能医疗系统、运动监测系统、人机交互等领域均表现出广泛的应用前景。柔性可穿戴传感技术及应用是电子封装专业的选修课程，课程目标如下：（1）使本专业学生了解柔性可穿戴传感技术所涉及到材料（金属纳米材料，石墨烯，导电聚合物等）、结构及制备方法；（2）了解与各种柔性可穿戴传感器件的功能特性，如柔性应变传感器，柔性压力传感器，柔性湿度传感器，柔性温度传感器等；（3）熟练掌握各种柔性可穿戴传感器件的的基本工作原理和制备工艺特性；（4）理解柔性可穿戴传感器件的失效机理、缺陷及检测、可靠性（机械稳定性、电迁移等）及质量控制方法；（5）熟悉先进柔性可穿戴传感技术（压电式、压阻式）的基本原理、工艺方法和应用；（6）掌握柔性可穿戴传感器件领域的前沿应用。本课程将通过课堂教学、课堂作业、项目研究等环节培养学生的创新意识、运用电子制造和材料加工方面的知识解决电子封装行业中微互连的实际问题，以及分析和解决柔性传感器件实践问题的创新意识和创新设计能力，为学生今后在柔性电子领域的工作和深造奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Flexible sensors have the characteristics of stretchability, flexibility and light weight, which make them wearable. They show broad application prospects in personal intelligent medical system, motion monitoring system, human-computer interaction and other fields. Flexible wearable sensing Technology and application is an elective course for electronic packaging major. The course objectives are as follows: (1) To enable students of this major to understand the materials (metal nanomaterials, graphene, conductive polymers, etc.), structures and preparation methods involved in flexible wearable sensing technology; (2) Understand the functional characteristics of various flexible wearable sensors, such as flexible strain sensors, flexible pressure sensors, flexible humidity sensors, flexible temperature sensors, etc.; (3) Master the basic working principle and preparation process characteristics of various flexible wearable sensors; (4) Understand the failure mechanism, defects and detection, reliability (mechanical stability, electromigration, etc.) and quality control methods of flexible wearable sensors; (5) Familiar with the basic principles, process methods and applications of advanced flexible wearable sensing technologies (piezoelectric and piezoresistive); (6) Master the cutting-edge applications in the field of flexible wearable sensors. Through classroom teaching, class work, project research and other links, this course will cultivate students' innovation consciousness, use the knowledge of electronic manufacturing and material processing to solve the practical problems of micro-interconnection in the electronic packaging industry, and analyze and solve the practical problems of flexible sensor devices' innovation consciousness and innovative design ability. It lays a solid foundation for students to work and further study in the field of flexible electronics in the future.

default.zh: 《空天环境复杂器件先进组装及连接技术》课程内容结合空天环境下陶瓷材料及连接技术的不断发展，同时结合教师所在团队的最新研究成果，一方面从整体上讲述陶瓷组装与连接的发展与挑战，另一方面通过研究实例具体论述陶瓷组装与连接新技术及其应用原理。主要讲述陶瓷组装及连接的发展、机遇及共性基础问题；新型玻璃钎焊功能陶瓷和结构陶瓷的设计思路、界面反应及接头强化机制；超高温陶瓷低温连接高温使用的新型扩散连接方法；陶瓷及陶瓷/金属的原位强化连接技术；新型陶瓷基复合材料与金属的连接技术。其目的是使本专业学生了解陶瓷组装及连接的主要难点、方法及其基本特征；掌握陶瓷金属化的基本原理和设计准则；熟练掌握玻璃封接、原位强化、低温连接及空气钎焊等陶瓷组装与连接新技术的原理及设计准则。全面拓展学生知识体系，提高专业素质，增强其专业学习能力以及奠定坚实的职业基础。
default.en: The course content of Integration and Joining Technologies of Complex Devices in Aerospace Environment combines the continuous development of ceramic materials and bonding technology in space and space environment, and the latest research results of the teacher's team. On one hand, the development and challenge of ceramic assembly and bonding are described as a whole. On the other hand, the new technology of ceramic assembly and bonding and its application principle are specifically discussed through research examples. It mainly describes the development, opportunities and common basic problems of ceramic assembly and bonding. Design idea, interface reaction and joint strengthening mechanism of new glass brazing functional ceramics and structural ceramics. A new diffusion bonding method for low temperature joining of ultra-high temperature ceramics. Ceramic and ceramic/metal in situ strengthened bonding technology. Bonding technology of new ceramic matrix composite material and metal. The purpose is to make students understand the main difficulties, methods and basic characteristics of ceramic assembly and bonding. Master the basic principles and design criteria of ceramic metallization. Proficient in the principles and design criteria of new ceramic assembly and bonding technologies such as glass sealing, in-situ strengthening, low-temperature joining and air brazing. Comprehensively expand students' knowledge system, improve their professional quality, enhance their professional learning ability and lay a solid career foundation.

default.zh: 生物材料学课程的主要内容包括：从材料学、生物学和医学等方面探讨生物材料与人体组织间的相互作用规律和机制，介绍生物材料的生物学评价原则和微生物灭活评价原则，并依据不同应用场景介绍相关生物材料与器件原理及应用。要求在深入理解生物相容性基本理论的基础上，掌握外科用生物材料与器件、骨科用生物材料与器件、耳鼻喉科用生物材料与器件、口腔用生物材料与器件、纳米生物材料、生物传感材料与器件和组织工程支架等先进功能生物材料与器件的原理、设计和应用。为材料学科相关专业学生今后从事相关工作奠定基础。
default.en: The main content of the course on biomaterials includes exploring the interaction laws and mechanisms between biomaterials and human tissues from the perspectives of materials science, biology, and medicine, introducing the principles of biological evaluation and microbial inactivation evaluation of biomaterials, and introducing the principles and applications of relevant biomaterials and devices based on different application scenarios. On the basis of a deep understanding of the basic theory of biocompatibility, it is required to master the principles, designs, and applications of advanced functional biomaterials and devices such as surgical biomaterials and devices, orthopedic biomaterials and devices, otolaryngology biomaterials and devices, oral biomaterials and devices, nano biomaterials, biosensing materials and devices, and tissue engineering scaffolds. To lay a foundation for students majoring in materials science to engage in related work in the future.

default.zh: 材料沉积方法与原理课程主要培养学生掌握薄膜基本制造技术的原理、特点及应用，使学生具备从事新型功能薄膜研发和管理工作的能力，并初步掌握表面改性的相关知识。通过本课程的学习，掌握沉积薄膜材料的技术、工艺方法。对所涉及的高真空技术，真空蒸发镀膜、真空溅射镀膜法、离子镀膜法、化学气相沉积法等有一个全面的理解与掌握；对液相沉积技术以及薄膜的形成及特性有一个初步的了解。因此，本课程在材料物理专业教学计划中具有奠定基础的作用。
default.en: The course named《Method and Principle of Material Deposition》is a course that mainly cultivates students to master the basic principle, characteristics and applications of thin film manufacturing technology, So that students have the ability to engage in new functional film development and management capabilities and the initial understanding of the surface modification of the relevant knowledge. Through the study of this course, student can master the deposition technology and methods process of thin film materials. They can get a comprehensive understanding and grasp of the high vacuum technology, vacuum evaporation coating, vacuum sputtering coating, ion plating and chemical vapor deposition. They can have a preliminary understanding of liquid phase deposition techniques，the formation and properties of thin films. Therefore, this course in the material physics professional teaching plan has laid a foundation role.

default.zh: 《材料合成与制备》是材料科学与工程各专业方向的一门重要基础课程。基本内容包括：材料合成与制备的基本原理（包括形核与生长、扩散与界面反应、热力学与动力学基础）；固相反应合成法；液相合成法（如溶胶-凝胶法、共沉淀法、水热/溶剂热法）；气相沉积法（物理气相沉积PVD、化学气相沉积CVD）；晶体生长技术（提拉法、布里奇曼法、区熔法等）；特种制备技术（如自蔓延高温合成等）以及材料制备过程中的结构-工艺-性能关系分析等部分。通过整个教学过程，使学生掌握典型材料合成与制备方法的基本原理、工艺特点、适用范围及调控手段，要求学生深入理解不同制备方法中的物理化学过程，建立清晰的工艺-微结构-性能之间的内在关联，并具有综合运用所学知识设计合理制备路线、分析与解决实际材料制备问题的能力。
default.en: Materials Synthesis and Preparation is an important core course for all specialty directions in Materials Science and Engineering. Its basic content includes: the fundamental principles of materials synthesis and preparation (including nucleation and growth, diffusion and interfacial reactions, and the fundamentals of thermodynamics and kinetics); solid-state reaction synthesis; liquid-phase synthesis methods (such as the sol–gel method, co-precipitation method, and hydrothermal/solvothermal method); vapor deposition methods (physical vapor deposition, PVD, and chemical vapor deposition, CVD); crystal growth techniques (the Czochralski method, Bridgman method, zone melting method, etc.); special preparation techniques (such as self-propagating high-temperature synthesis, microwave synthesis, electrospinning, etc.); and analysis of structure–process–property relationships during materials preparation. Through the entire teaching process, students are expected to master the basic principles, process characteristics, scope of application, and control approaches of typical materials synthesis and preparation methods. Students are required to develop a deep understanding of the physical and chemical processes involved in different preparation methods, establish clear intrinsic correlations among processing, microstructure, and properties, and possess the ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to design reasonable preparation routes and to analyze and solve practical problems in materials preparation.

default.zh: 材料结构缺陷方面的知识是材料科学的基础,材料特殊的物理化学性能都与材料中的各种缺陷密切相关。课程主要介绍结构缺陷理论的产生和研究发展过程、结构缺陷的分类、研究材料结构缺陷的意义;介绍缺陷对材料的屈服现象、加工硬化、强化、断裂、高温强度、疲劳强度等力学性能的影响;介绍缺陷对材料的电学性能、半导体性能、离子电导、磁学性能以及光学性能等方面的影响并举例加以说明。
default.en: The knowledge of material structural defects is the foundation of materials science, and the special physical and chemical properties of materials are closely related to various defects in materials. The course mainly introduces the emergence and research development process of structural defect theory, the classification of structural defects, and the significance of studying material structural defects; The course introduces the influence of defects on the mechanical properties of materials, such as yield phenomenon, work hardening, strengthening, fracture, high-temperature strength, fatigue strength, etc; The course introduces introduces the effects of defects on the electrical, semiconductor, ion conductivity, magnetic, and optical properties of materials, and provide examples for explanation.

default.zh: 材料力学性能是材料物理专业的重要基础必修课，它在材料物理专业整个教学计划中是一门综合利用金属学知识阐述材料力学性能的基础课程。主要目的让学生从金属学的角度掌握材料微观组织结构与性能之间的关系，为机械设计和制造过程中正确选择和合理使用材料提供可靠的力学性能依据；也为充分发挥材料的性能潜力，改进或创新工艺，研制新材料及机器零件或构件的失效分析提供基础。学习本课程的任务是培养具有国际视野，适应社会经济发展，满足航天、国防等尖端领域及国家重点行业需求的高素质人才。
default.en: The course "Materials Mechanical Properties" is a crucial subject in the field of materials physics. Its primary objective is to understand the relationship between the microstructure and properties of materials from the perspective of metallurgy. This course provides a reliable mechanical performance basis for the correct selection and rational use of materials in mechanical design and manufacturing processes. It also serves as a foundation for improving or innovating processes, conducting failure analysis of new materials, and examining machine components. Through this course, students are trained to possess an international perspective, adapt to social and economic development, and meet the demands of cutting-edge fields such as aerospace, national defense, and other key industries.

default.zh: 本课程内容包括：电化学热力学、电化学动力学基础；锂离子电池及其电极材料；超级电容器及其电极材料；金属锂电极；锂硫电池及其电极材料。采用灵活的教学方式，包括：授课、案例分析、任务驱动。考核环节包括：指定文献阅读报告、课程综合报告。 通过本课程的学习，培养学生掌握储能材料基础理论知识、储能材料研究现状与发展趋势，了解目前储能材料与电池领域存在的关键科学问题和工程问题，使学生能够运用理论知识分析和解决工程实际问题，最终达到具有从事能源材料领域的科研、技术管理的能力。
default.en: his course includes following knowledges, electrochemistry thermodynamics, electrochemistry kinetics; lithium-ion battery and its electrode materials; supercapacitor and its electrode materials; Lithium metal anode; Lithium-Sulfur battery and its electrode materials. This course adopts multiple methods, such as teaching, case analysis and literature reports. The examination of this course is divided into three parts. They are literature reviews, comprehensive reports. Through studying this course, students can master basic theory of electrochemistry, status and development of energy storage materials, and know key science and engineering issues in the research of energy storage materials and batteries. More importantly, students can learn how to use the knowledge involved in this course to solve real issues, and this course can offer students abilities to engage in research, technical management jobs related to energy storage materials.

default.zh: 本课程是为材料物理专业本科生开设的专业选修课。纳米材料学是一门交叉性很强的综合学科，研究的内容涉及物理、化学、材料、生物、微电子学等多个领域。本课程的作用是让学生对于纳米材料有所认识和了解，拓宽本专业学生的知识面，为将来有可能从事纳米科学与纳米技术方面生产和研究工作打好基础。本课程首先通过课堂教学、课堂讨论使学生掌握纳米材料粒度、成分、结构、形貌的测试和表征方法。并以碳材料、超分子组装、气敏传感器以及胶体化学等专题分别介绍纳米材料的概念、分类及其特点；纳米材料的物理性能和化学性能；纳米材料在不同领域的应用现状和应用前景。而后选取纳米材料中的三大类：一维纳米材料、二维纳米材料和纳米多孔材料，分别介绍其制备方法与应用。此部分主要对选定的具有代表性纳米材料相关案例，进行有针对性的分析、审理和讨论。而本课程的实验内容则是选取纳米材料相关测试表征的实验方法进行讲解与演示，给学生以直观印象，并通过相应的实验操作提高学生的实验动手能力。总而言之本课程让学生认识纳米材料的概念、性能、制备和研究方法，了解一些常见纳米材料现有的应用或未来潜在应用。
default.en: This course is a professional elective course for undergraduate students of material physics. Nanomaterials is a highly interdisciplinary subject, covering the fields of physics, chemistry, materials, biology, microelectronics, and so on. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand and understand the nano-materials, broaden the knowledge of the students, for the future may be engaged in nanotechnology and nanotechnology in the production and research work to lay the foundation. This course first through the classroom teaching, classroom discussion so that students master the nano-materials particle size, composition, structure, morphology of the test and characterization methods. The characteristics, classification and characteristics of nanomaterials were introduced, including carbon materials, supramolecular assembly, gas sensor and colloid chemistry. The physical properties and chemical properties of nanomaterials were introduced. The application status and application prospect of nanomaterials in different fields were introduced. Then three kinds of nanomaterials were selected: one-dimensional nanomaterials, two-dimensional nanomaterials and nanometer porous materials, and their preparation methods and applications were introduced respectively. This part of the main representative of the selected representative of the case of nano-materials, targeted analysis, trial and discussion. The experimental content of this course is to select the experimental method of nano-materials related to the test method to explain and demonstrate to the students with an intuitive impression, and through the corresponding experimental operation to improve students' practical ability to experiment. In short, this course allows students to understand the concept of nanomaterials, performance, preparation and research methods, to understand some of the common applications of nanomaterials or future potential applications.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍智能材料的定义及内涵，介绍了智能材料仿生构思和实现对外界条件变化做出智能响应的原理与依据，着重介绍了智能金属材料、智能无机非金属材料、智能高分子材料、智能药物释放体系、智能膜材和智能纤维等多种智能材料的构成原理、应用及发展，为相关专业的学生了解和掌握智能材料的研究现状和发展趋势奠定基础。 通过课程的学习，帮助学生掌握智能材料的仿生化组成思路，以及对外界条件变化做出智能相应的原理和依据，能够根据工程实际研究方案，选择实验仪器设备，安全的开展实验，并能综合文献信息等对研究结果进行分析，提出简单的智能材料构造思路，解决工程实际中需要解决的自诊断、自修复、自愈合等工程问题。同时，让学生了解典型智能材料的性能特点、刺激响应信号、工程适应范围，对现代工具的优缺点和适用范围有明确的了解，能够选择与应用适当方法与工具，对智能材料设计、制备、改性等复杂工程问题进行测试、计算和设计。理解材料物理领域工程实践与科学技术不断发展和进步的客观性，明确其对知识和能力要求不断增长的必然趋势，能够通过对已有智能材料与结构的关联性分析，通过自主学习，掌握分析、解决新工程问题的实际能力，具有终身学习的意识。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the definition and connotation of smart materials, including the bionic conception of smart materials and the principle and basis for materials to realize intelligent response to external conditions. The course focuses on the constitute principle, application and development of some typical smart materials such as metal materials, inorganic non-metallic materials, polymer materials, drug release system, membrane materials and fibers as well as other intelligent materials. It lays a foundation for students in related majors to understand and master the research status and development trend of smart materials. By studying of the course, students get the ability to masterthe biochemical composition ideas of smart materials as well as the principles and basis for making intelligent responses to changes in external conditions. They will be able to select experimental instruments according to the actual engineering research scheme, carry out experiments safely, analyze the research results based on literature information, propose simple ideas for the construction of smart materials and solve engineering problems such as self-diagnosis, self-repair and self-healing which need to be solved in engineering practice. At the same time, students can understand the performance characteristics, stimulus response signals and engineering adaptation range of typical smart materials, have a clear understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of modern tools and their application range, and be able to choose and apply appropriate methods and tools to test, calculate and design complex engineering problems such as smart materials design, preparation, and modification. Understand the objectivity of the continuous development and progress of engineering practice and science and technology in the field of materials physics, identify the inevitable trend of increasing requirements on knowledge and ability, master the practical ability to analyze and solve new engineering problems through the correlation analysis of existing smart materials and structures, through independent learning, and have the consciousness of lifelong learning.

default.zh: 本课程是材料物理专业本科生重要的专业课。本课程的主要教学内容是材料光谱学历史、材料光谱基础理论、原子光谱、紫外-可见光谱技术、红外吸收光谱、拉曼光谱技术、核磁共振谱和光谱分析在材料研究中的应用等部分。学生将掌握光谱学的基本原理和重要规律，了解常用材料光谱分析仪器结构，掌握常用分析技术的基本原理，综合运用材料光谱分析技术分析材料的元素组成、含量、构型和价键结构等信息。课程以讲授和多种教学方式结合，开展课堂讨论等活动，并注重理论与科研工作结合。注重培养学生运用所学知识分析材料相关信息的能力，培养学生在团队中沟通能力、自主学习和终身学习的意识。
default.en: This course is an important specialized course for undergraduates majoring in materials physics. The main contents of the course are material spectral analysis history, basic theory of material spectroscopy, atomic spectroscopy, UV visible spectroscopy technology, infrared absorption spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, and spectral analysis and application in materials research. Students will master the basic principles and important laws of spectroscopy, understand the structure of commonly used material spectroscopic analysis instruments, master the basic principles of commonly used analytical techniques, and comprehensively apply material spectroscopic analysis techniques to analyze information such as element composition, content, configuration, and valence bond structure of materials. The course will be taught in combination with a variety of teaching methods, lectures, classroom discussions, and focuses on the combination of theoretical and scientific research work. It will pay attention to train students to use the knowledge, analyze materials information, cultivate students in the team communication ability, independent learning and lifelong learning consciousness.

default.zh: 工程材料课程主要论述钢铁材料、有色金属材料、高分子材料、陶瓷材料以及复合材料的成分构成、组织结构及性能方面的基本知识，该课程是从机械工程的应用角度出发，阐明机械工程材料的基本理论，介绍常用机械工程材料及其应用等基本知识，扩大知识面，使学生具备生产和技术开发的基本技能。具备根据机械零件使用条件和性能要求，对结构零件进行合理选材及制订零件工艺路线的初步能力。学习并掌握及结构材料的基本知识，对于工科院校机械类专业的学生是十分必要的。
default.en: The course named《Engineering Materials》focuses on the basic knowledge of the composition, structure and performance of steel materials, nonferrous metal materials, polymer materials, ceramic materials and composites. The course can elucidate the basic theory of mechanical engineering materials from the perspective of the application of mechanical engineering, introduce the basic knowledge of commonly used mechanical engineering materials and their applications, and expand the knowledge of students, so that students can get the basic skills of production and technology development. They can also have the capability to make a rational materials selection of structural parts and the initial process of parts development according to the service conditions and performance requirements of mechanical parts. So it is very necessary for students of mechanical engineering in engineering colleges to learn and master the basic knowledge of structural materials.

default.zh: 本课程内容包括：电阻型敏感材料、电介质与电容型敏感材料、肖特基节型敏感元件、固体电解质与电化学气体传感器。采用灵活的教学方式，包括：授课、提问、案例分析、任务驱动。考核环节包括：课堂提问、课程综合报告，所占比例分别是20%、80%。 通过本课程的学习，培养学生掌握敏感电子材料基础理论知识、研究现状与发展趋势，了解目前敏感电子材料领域存在的关键科学问题和工程问题，使学生能够运用理论知识分析和解决工程实际问题，具有较强的创新意识，最终达到具有从事敏感电子材料领域的科研、技术管理和国际化竞争的能力。
default.en: This course includes principle and fundamental knowledges of following sensors and sensing materials, chemiresistive sensing materials, dielectric and capacitive sensing materials, Schottky sensor, solid electrolyte and electrochemical gas sensors. This course adopts multiple methods, such as teaching, oral quizzes, case analysis and literature reports. The examination of this course is divided into two parts. They are oral quizzes, comprehensive reports, which contribute 20%, 80% and of final score, respectively. Through studying this course, students can master basic theory of electronic sensing materials, status and development of sensing materials, and know key science and engineering issues in the research of electronic sensing materials and sensors. More importantly, students can learn how to use the knowledge involved in this course to solve real issues, and this course can offer students abilities to engage in research, technical management jobs related to of electronic sensing materials.

default.zh: 《实验安全教育》是材料科学与工程类相关专业的一门综合实践课程，是材料科学与工程类学生从课堂教育走向实验室实践的一门重要的衔接类课程。通过本课程学习，学生在进入实验室前，能够了解实验室的基本安全常识、相关法律法规和行业标准及规范，掌握实验室水电、化学品、生物制剂、特种设备及实验室基础安全设施和个人防护用品的安全使用方法，初步具备应急救援和危险处置相关技能。通过本门课程学习，能够加强学生安全和环保意识，提升学生实验室安全操作规范素养，增强学生社会责任感以及学生在危机处置过程中的团队协作能力。
default.en: Safety Education of Laboratory is a comprehensive practical course for the students of materials science and engineering majors. It is an important bridging course from classroom teaching to laboratory practice. Through this course students can master the basic safety knowledge of the laboratory, relevant laws and regulations before entering the laboratory. In addition, the students can master the safe use of chemicals, biological agents, basic safety facilities and personal protective equipments. At the same time, they can acquire the relevant skills of emergency rescue and hazardous disposal. In a word, through this course the awareness of safety and environmental protection can be strengthened, the safety operation standards can be improved and the sense of social responsibility and teamwork ability in crisis management can be enhanced.

default.zh: 高分子材料学为材料物理专业的一门专业基础课，是一门理论结合实践的课程。本课程首先对高分子材料基本概念进行讲解，使学生掌握高分子的定义、命名、分类等基础知识与理论。在此阶段主要培养学生掌握高分子材料基本知识与概念，使学生具备从事高分子材料研究开发、生产及检测的基本技能。而后联系实际，以塑料、橡胶、纤维、涂料、粘合剂、功能高分子以及医用高分子材料等实用高分子材料为例分别介绍其基本组成与结构、基本制造工艺、性能及应用，加深学生对高分子材料基础知识与理论的理解。此部分主要通过教师的指导，对选定的实用高分子材料，进行有针对性的分析、审理和讨论，引导学生做出自己的判断和评价，以拓宽学生的思维空间，增加学习兴趣，开发学生思维能力，提高学生的判断能力、决策能力和综合素质。而本课程的实验内容则是选取的高分子材料通过其测试表征的实验方法进行讲解与演示，给学生以直观印象，并通过相应的实验操作提高学生的实验动手能力。总的来说，高分子材料学是一门以介绍高分子材料基本知识为内容，全面而深层次提高大学生的科学理念、素养的课程。
default.en: Polymer materials science for the material physics professional a basic course, is a theory combined with the practice of the course. This course begins with the basic concepts of polymer materials to explain, so that students master the definition of polymer, naming, classification and other basic knowledge and theory. At this stage the main training students master the basic knowledge of polymer materials and concepts, so that students have engaged in polymer materials research and development, production and testing of basic skills. And then contact with the actual, to plastic, rubber, fiber, paint, adhesives, functional polymers and medical polymer materials and other practical polymer materials, respectively, as the introduction of its basic composition and structure, the basic manufacturing process, performance and application, Understanding of the basic knowledge and theory of polymer materials. This part mainly through the guidance of teachers, selected practical polymer materials, targeted analysis, trial and discussion, to guide students to make their own judgments and evaluation, in order to broaden the students' thinking space, increase learning interest, development Students thinking ability, improve students' ability to judge, decision-making ability and overall quality. The experimental content of this course is to select the polymer material through its test description of the experimental method to explain and demonstrate to the students with an intuitive impression, and through the corresponding experimental operation to improve students' practical ability to experiment. In general, the polymer materials science is a basic knowledge to introduce the basic content of polymer materials, comprehensive and deep times to improve the scientific concept of college students, literacy courses.

default.zh: 《纳米3D打印技术基础与应用》: 探讨了纳米尺度3D打印技术的基础知识及其在集成电路、可再生能源、人工智能、生物医学和传感器等诸多重要领域中的新兴应用。将系统介绍目前世界顶尖研究人员利用纳米尺度3D打印技术在电子晶体管、软体机器人、能源装换、健康监测传感器以及生物医学等前沿应用中的基本原理。同时，还将深入分析当前纳米尺度3D打印技术在面向高端应用时所面临的挑战及可能的解决方案。
default.en: Nanoscale 3D Printing Technology: Fundamentals and Applications discusses the fundamentals of 3D printing technologies at the nanoscale and their emerging applications in many important fields such as integrated circuits, renewable energy, artificial intelligence, biomedicals, and sensors. We also address current challenges and possible solutions in nanoscale 3D printing technologies for advanced applications.

default.zh: 凝聚态物理A是材料学院本科生的一门选修课，主要介绍凝聚态物理学的基础知识，内容包括晶体结构、晶体的结合、晶格振动与晶体的热学性质、晶体中的缺陷等。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握凝聚态物理学的基础知识，学生可初步了解如何综合运用所学基础知识处理实际问题，为进一步学习和研究凝聚态物理学各种专门问题打下基础。
default.en: Condensed Matter Physics A is a fundamental course for undergraduates of School of Materials Science and Engineering. The basic knowledge of the condensed state physics is mainly introduced in this course, which includes crystal structure, crystal bonding, lattice dynamics, thermal properties, and defects etc. Students are expected to learn the basic knowledge and understand how to use the knowledge to deal with practical problems, which lay the foundation for students to further investigate professional problems in condensed matter physics.

default.zh: 量子力学是研究微观粒子（原子，电子等）运动规律的科学，是一门技术基础理论课。课程主要是讲述量子力学的基本原理，逐步深入地让学生认识表述原理的数学结构，如薛定谔波动力学、海森伯矩阵力学以及抽象表述的希尔伯特空间的代数结构。同时讲述量子力学的应用，比如一维定态问题，氢原子问题等，使同学们在分析清楚各类基本应用问题的物理内容基础上，掌握量子力学对一些基本问题的处理方法。
default.en: Quantum mechanics is a science that studies the laws of motion of microscopic particles (atoms, electrons, etc.), and is a technical basic theoretical course. The course mainly introduces the basic principles of quantum mechanics, and gradually allows students to understand the mathematical structures that express the principles, such as Schrodinger wave dynamics, Heisenberg matrix mechanics, and the algebraic structure of abstract Hilbert space. At the same time, it describes the applications of quantum mechanics, such as one-dimensional stationary state problems, hydrogen atom problems, etc., so that students can master the methods of dealing with some basic problems in quantum mechanics on the basis of analyzing the physical content of various basic application problems.

default.zh: 材料表面物理化学性质对材料的功能性有重要的影响，了解材料表面或界面处发生的物理和化学相互作用，将为解决功能材料关键问题提供基础。该课程围绕功能材料的表面物理化学特性，从基本概念出发，讲述功能材料的表面物理化学特性、表征方法及其在功能器件中的应用。
default.en: The physicochemical properties of material surfaces have an important impact on the functionality of materials, and understanding the physicochemical interactions that occur at the surface or interface of materials will provide a basis for solving key problems of functional materials. This course focuses on the surface physicochemical properties of functional materials, and introduces the surface physicochemical properties, characterization methods and applications of functional materials in functional devices.

default.zh: 本课程将讲授发光现象的基本原理、常见发光材料的类型及实际应用。介绍发光材料的制备方法和性能表征技术。课程内容涵盖光致发光、电致发光和长余辉发光等机制以及稀土荧光粉、金属量子点和碳点等典型材料体系，并结合照明、显示（OLED）、信息储存和防伪等实际应用场景，培养学生对发光材料的科学认知。通过理论讲授与案例分析，帮助学生掌握材料设计思路，了解学科交叉趋势，为后续科研工作或就业奠定基础。
default.en: This course will cover the fundamental principles of luminescence, luminescent material types, and their applications. It will introduce preparation methods and performance characterizations. The course content includes mechanisms such as photoluminescence, electroluminescence, and long-persistent luminescence and their applications in lighting, displays (OLEDs), and information storage/anti-counterfeiting. The course aims to develop students' scientific understanding of luminescent materials. Through theoretical lectures and case studies, students will gain insights into material design strategies and interdisciplinary trends, laying a foundation for future research or career development.

default.zh: 本课程旨在加深学生对可再生能源的理解。课程内容涵盖清洁能源、 化石燃料、核能、热能科学、太阳能、风能、水力发电、地热能、生物质 能、海洋能、氢能和燃料电池等基础能源概念。通过清洁能源课程的学习， 学生不仅能了解各种能源形式的优缺点，还能增强其在实际行业环境中应 用清洁能源的知识。
default.en: This course reinforces the students’ understanding of renewable energy. It involves some basic energy concepts such as clean energy, fossil fuels, nuclear energy, thermal sciences, solar energy, wind energy, wind energy, hydropower, geothermal energy, biomass energy, ocean energy, hydrogen and fuel cells. The study through the clean energy course will not only introduce clean energy to the students in terms of understanding the advantages and disadvantages of each form of energy but also enhance the knowledge towards practical industry settings.

default.zh: 本共建本科课程系统介绍太阳能泵浦激光器设计与表征的关键内容，旨在提升学生在固态激光器及太阳能光学汇聚系统设计方面的能力。课程涵盖太阳能泵浦激光器的发展与应用、太阳能激光介质，以及成像与非成像型多级太阳能汇聚器的基本理论，并进一步探讨太阳能泵浦固态激光器原理及其功率转换效率。同时介绍ZEMAX和LASCAD等数值模拟工具，培养学生的工程设计与创新能力。
default.en: This jointly developed undergraduate course introduces the key aspects of solar-pumped laser design and characterization, aiming to enhance students’ capabilities in solid-state laser systems and solar optical concentrator design. The course covers the development and applications of solar-pumped lasers, solar laser gain media, and the fundamental principles of imaging and non-imaging multi-stage solar concentrators. It further explores the operating principles of solar-pumped solid-state lasers and their solar-to-laser power conversion efficiency. In addition, numerical simulation tools such as ZEMAX and LASCAD are introduced to develop students’ engineering design and innovation skills.

default.zh: 《半导体物理与器件》是微电子、光电子、新能源等专业的核心基础课程。本课程旨在系统介绍半导体材料的物理特性及其器件的工作原理。主要内容包括半导体中的电子状态与能带结构、载流子的统计分布与输运现象、平衡与非平衡载流子行为、PN结与金属-半导体接触特性、以及MOS场效应晶体管等基本器件。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握分析半导体器件性能的基本方法，为后续深入学习集成电路、光电器件等专业课程奠定坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Semiconductor Physics and Devices is a fundamental course for undergraduates majoring in microelectronics, optoelectronics, and new energy technologies. This 16-hour course provides a systematic introduction to the physical properties of semiconductor materials and the operational principles of key devices. Key topics cover the electronic states and energy band structures of semiconductors, statistical distribution and transport phenomena of carriers, behaviors of carriers under equilibrium and non-equilibrium conditions, the characteristics of PN junctions and metal-semiconductor contacts, as well as fundamental devices like MOSFETs. The course aims to equip students with the essential skills to analyze device performance, serving as a crucial foundation for integrated circuits and semiconductor technology.

default.zh: 毕业设计是实现本科培养目标的重要教学环节。在完成基础课、专业基础课和专业课学习的基础上，在指导老师的指导下独立完成一个完整的科学实验。实验研究内容要有探索性、创新性，获得详实的实验数据，得出有价值的结论。该课程包含开题、中期检查和论文答辩三个主要环节。要求学生完成一万五千字以上的学位论文，论文主要内容应包括文献综述、实验材料与研究方法，结果与讨论以及结论等。通过该课程的学习，提高学生的专业素养和实践能力，培养学生的自学能力、实验动手能力、分析和解决科学问题的能力。
default.en: Graduation project is an important part in undergraduate student cultivation objective. The students need to complete the whole scientific experiments under the tutors’ instructions after they finish the basic courses, the subject courses and the specialized ones. The content of the experiment researches should be explosive and innovative, then the detailed and accurate empirical data are gotten and the aluable conclusions are drawn. This course includes three important parts：dissertation proposal, in-process spection, and oral defense. It requires a thesis of over 15,000 words, of which the content should include liateratures review, experimental, results and discussions, and conclusions. This course aim to improve students’ professional qualities and practical abilities, cultivate their self-study abilities and experiment abilities, and enhance their capacities to analyze and solve the scientific issues.

default.zh: 课程设计是实现本科培养目标的重要实践环节。在完成基础课、专业基础课和专业课学习的基础上，在指导老师的指导下，在规定的时间内独立完成课程设计所规定的内容和工作量。实验研究内容要有探索性、创新性，获得详实的实验数据。学生运用所学的基础理论和专业知识，进行课程设计实践工作，巩固所学的专业知识，为毕业设计做好前期准备工作。要求学生完成不少于5页的课程设计报告，报告主要内容包括文献阅读、实验材料与研究方法，结果与讨论等。课程设计培养学生的动手能力以及分析数据的能力。
default.en: Curriculum design is an important part to achieve the goal of undergraduate training. The students need to complete the content and workload of the curriculum design independently within the specified time, under the tutors’ instructions after they finish the basic courses, the subject courses and the specialized ones. The content of the experiment researches should be explosive and innovative, then the detailed and accurate empirical data are gotten. The students need apply the basic theory and professional knowledge they have learned to carry out curriculum design practice, consolidating the professional knowledge which is a good preparation for the graduation project. It requires a report of no less than 5 pages, including literatures reading, experimental, results and discussion. This course aims to improve students’ professional qualities and practical abilities, cultivate their self-study abilities and experiment abilities, and enhance their capacities to analyze and solve the scientific issues.

default.zh: 生产实习是培养学生工程实践能力和创新能力的重要实践环节，在素质教育中占有重要的地位，对创新型工程科技人才培养具有重要意义。“认识—实践—再认识—再实践”是掌握知识的循环过程。通过生产实习的实践，所学的专业知识转化成为专业能力和素质。作为实践类课程，生产实习不仅能够传授知识、验证理论、培养技能，还能通过综合性、设计性、研究性的训练，培养学生科学的思维方式，提高学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，养成良好的科学素养及分析问题和解决问题的能力，养成自主探索知识真理和理论联系实际的方法和能力，为学生步入工作岗位打下坚实的基础。 生产实习是学生在校期间与企业和社会距离最近的学习环节，能够把所学的专业知识与生产实际紧密地结合起来，帮助学生更好地理解所学的专业课知识，促进学生将所学知识融会贯通。生产实习能够锻炼学生的实践动手能力，并为灵活运用专业知识解决生产实际问题打下坚实的基础。生产实习能够加深学生对专业内涵及其在国民经济中的地位和认识，明确将要从事工作的性质，有助于提高学生的社会责任感和学习自觉性。生产实习有助于提高学生的沟通交流能力、团队协作能力。
default.en: Production practice is an important part of training the engineering practice ability and innovative ability for students, and it plays an important role in quality education. It is of great significance to train innovative engineering scientific and technological talents. "Cognition, practice, re-cognition, re-practice" is the cycle of mastering knowledge. Through the production practice, the specialized knowledge could been transformed into professional ability by students. As a practical course, practice can impart knowledge, proof theory, train skills , and design and research through comprehensive training. The practical course can also help the students to cultivate scientific thinking way, improve their ability to analyze and solve problems, develop good science literacy and problem analysis and problem solving ability, develop autonomous exploration method and ability of knowledge and truth of theory and practice, and finally, make our students lay a solid foundation for the future work. The production practice is the nearest segment between high school and enterprise and social society for students, and it can make our students grasp the professional basic knowledge and practical specialty knowledge better. Production practice will training the practical ability for our students, and lay a solid foundation for the flexible use of professional knowledge to solve practical problems in production for them. Production practice can deepen the students' professional connotation and their status and understanding in the national economy, and make it clear that the nature of the work and to help to raise the students' sense of social responsibility and learning consciousness. Production practice is helpful to improve students' communicative competence and team work ability.

default.zh: 毕业设计是实现本科培养目标的重要教学环节。在完成基础课、专业基础课和专业课学习的基础上，在指导老师的指导下独立完成一个完整的科学实验。实验研究内容要有探索性、创新性，获得详实的实验数据，得出有价值的结论。该课程包含开题、中期检查和论文答辩三个主要环节。要求学生完成一万五千字以上的学位论文，论文主要内容应包括文献综述、实验材料与研究方法，结果与讨论以及结论等。通过该课程的学习，提高学生的专业素养和实践能力，培养学生的自学能力、实验动手能力、分析和解决科学问题的能力。
default.en: Graduation project is an important part in undergraduate student cultivation objective. The students need to complete the whole scientific experiments under the tutors’ instructions after they finish the basic courses, the subject courses and the specialized ones. The content of the experiment researches should be explosive and innovative, then the detailed and accurate empirical data are gotten and the aluable conclusions are drawn. This course includes three important parts：dissertation proposal, in-process spection, and oral defense. It requires a thesis of over 15,000 words, of which the content should include liateratures review, experimental, results and discussions, and conclusions. This course aim to improve students’ professional qualities and practical abilities, cultivate their self-study abilities and experiment abilities, and enhance their capacities to analyze and solve the scientific issues.

default.zh: 材料成型及控制工程专业的课程设计旨在培养适应21世纪现代化建设需要，德、智、体等方面全面发展的专业人才。了解现代工具和技术在材料成型及控制工程中的应用，培养学生运用先进技术解决实际问题的能力。培养学生具备终身学习的意识和能力，使他们在职业生涯中不断更新知识、适应技术进步和社会发展。强化工程与社会的关系，使学生认识到工程师的社会责任，培养他们具有良好的职业道德和人文科学素质。通过实践环节，培养学生具备实际操作能力和创新能力，提高他们在材料成型及控制工程领域的竞争力。材料成型及控制工程专业的课程设计旨在培养学生具备全面的工程知识，使他们成为能够运用现代工具和技术解决实际问题，具备终身学习能力和良好职业道德的专业人才。
default.en: The course design of Materials Forming and Control Engineering aims to cultivate professional talents who can meet the needs of modernization construction in the 21st century and have comprehensive development in morality, intelligence, physical fitness, and other aspects. Understand the application of modern tools and technologies in material forming and control engineering, and cultivate students' ability to apply advanced technology to solve practical problems. Cultivate students' awareness and ability for lifelong learning, enabling them to continuously update their knowledge, adapt to technological progress and social development in their career. Strengthen the relationship between engineering and society, make students aware of the social responsibility of engineers, and cultivate their good professional ethics and humanities qualities. Through practical activities, cultivate students' practical and innovative abilities, and enhance their competitiveness in the field of material forming and control engineering. The course design of Materials Forming and Control Engineering aims to cultivate students with comprehensive engineering knowledge, enabling them to become professional talents who can use modern tools and technologies to solve practical problems, possess lifelong learning ability, and have good professional ethics.

default.en: The graduation design course of Material Forming and Control Engineering aims to cultivate students with comprehensive abilities in engineering knowledge, modern tool application, engineering and society, and lifelong learning, so that they can become excellent engineers who can independently solve practical problems in the field of material forming and control engineering. Cultivate students with good professional ethics and a sense of social responsibility, so that they can consider the social impact and environmental responsibility when solving engineering problems. To cultivate students with strong teamwork and communication skills, enabling them to effectively communicate and cooperate with team members, stakeholders, and society when solving engineering problems. Cultivate the ability of students to learn independently and continuously, so that they can continuously update their knowledge and skills in their career, adapt to technological progress and social development. Cultivate students with critical thinking and innovative abilities, enabling them to propose innovative solutions when facing new engineering problems.

default.zh: 本实习课程旨在通过实际生产环境下的实践活动，使学生掌握材料成型及控制工程的基本技能，了解现代制造业的生产流程和质量控制方法，增强学生的实际操作能力和解决实际问题的能力。生产实习旨在让学生将课堂上学到的材料成型及控制工程理论知识与实际生产场景相结合，从而加深对材料成型加工工艺、模具设计、制造技术等理论知识的理解和掌握。通过实习，使学生熟练掌握材料成型设备及工艺的操作方法，提高学生在实际生产过程中的动手能力，培养解决实际工程问题的能力。生产实习要求学生在实际生产环境中学习和应用工程原理，提高学生分析和解决复杂工程问题的能力，培养学生的工程实践能力。
default.en: This internship course aims to enable students to master the basic skills of material forming and control engineering through practical activities in actual production environments, understand the production process and quality control methods of modern manufacturing industry, and enhance their practical operation ability and problem-solving ability. The production internship aims to enable students to combine the theoretical knowledge of material forming and control engineering learned in the classroom with actual production scenarios, thereby deepening their understanding and mastery of theoretical knowledge such as material forming and processing technology, mold design, and manufacturing technology. Through internships, students can proficiently master the operation methods of material forming equipment and processes, improve their hands-on ability in actual production processes, and cultivate the ability to solve practical engineering problems. Production internships require students to learn and apply engineering principles in actual production environments, improve their ability to analyze and solve complex engineering problems, and cultivate their engineering practical abilities.

default.zh: 生产实习是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，本课程的主要目的是使学生了解和掌握基本生产知识，印证、巩固和丰富己学过的专业课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实际中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法．通过生产实习，了解增材制造技术的原理、掌握增材制造技术方面的知识，在培养学生的创新意识、能力和增材制造科学知识的应用能力的同时，还应使学生了解现代化生产方式和先进制造技术，培养热爱专业、致力于祖国社会主义建设的思想，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Production practice is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan. The main purpose of this course is to enable students to understand and master basic production knowledge, confirm, consolidate and enrich the content of the professional courses they have learned, train students to combine theory with practice, and improve their ability and method of investigating, observing, analyzing and solving problems in the production practice. Through production practice, students can understand the principle of additive manufacturing technology and master the knowledge of additive manufacturing technology. While cultivating students' innovative consciousness, ability and application ability of additive manufacturing scientific knowledge, students should also understand modern production mode and advanced manufacturing technology, and cultivate the thoughts of loving their profession and committing to the socialist construction of the motherland. Support the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 增材制造工程专业的课程设计旨在培养适应21世纪现代化建设需要，德、智、体等方面全面发展的专业人才。 课程目标如下： 目标1：掌握扎实的数学、物理、化学等自然科学知识，为解决增材制造工程问题提供理论基础。熟悉力学、电工电子学、计算机学等工程基础知识，使学生能够运用这些知识解决实际工程问题。掌握机械制图、材料科学、增材制造、材料成型、机械设计等专业知识，培养学生分析和解决增材制造工程领域复杂问题的能力。 目标2：了解现代工具和技术在增材制造工程中的应用，培养学生运用先进技术解决实际问题的能力。培养学生具备终身学习的意识和能力，使他们在职业生涯中不断更新知识、适应技术进步和社会发展。强化工程与社会的关系，使学生认识到工程师的社会责任，培养他们具有良好的职业道德和人文科学素质。 目标3：通过实践环节，培养学生具备实际操作能力和创新能力，提高他们在增材制造工程领域的竞争力。增材制造工程专业的课程设计旨在培养学生具备全面的工程知识，使他们成为能够运用现代工具和技术解决实际问题，具备终身学习能力和良好职业道德的专业人才。
default.en: The Course Design of Additive Manufacturing Engineering is designed to cultivate professionals who are able to meet the needs of modernization in the 21st century and develop morally, intellectually and physically in an all-round way. The objectives of the Course Design are as follows: Objective 1: To master solid knowledge of natural science such as mathematics, physics, chemistry, etc., to provide a theoretical basis for solving additive manufacturing engineering problems. Familiarize with the basic knowledge of mechanics, electrical electronics, computer science and other engineering fundamentals, so that students can use this knowledge to solve practical engineering problems. To master the professional knowledge of mechanical drawing, material science, additive manufacturing, material molding, and mechanical design, so as to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve complex problems in the field of additive manufacturing engineering. Objective 2: To understand the application of modern tools and technologies in additive manufacturing engineering, and to cultivate students' ability to utilize advanced technologies to solve practical problems. Cultivate students with the awareness and ability of lifelong learning so that they can update their knowledge and adapt to technological advancement and social development throughout their career. Reinforce the relationship between engineering and society, make students realize the social responsibility of engineers, and cultivate them to have good professional ethics and humanistic science quality. Objective 3: Through practical sessions, students are trained to have practical ability and innovation ability to improve their competitiveness in the field of Additive Manufacturing Engineering. The curriculum of Additive Manufacturing Engineering is designed to cultivate students with comprehensive engineering knowledge so that they can become professionals who can use modern tools and technologies to solve practical problems and have lifelong learning ability and good professional ethics.

default.zh: 增材制造工程专业的毕业设计课程目标旨在培养学生在工程知识、现代工具应用、工程与社会和终身学习等方面具备全面的能力，使他们成为能够独立解决增材制造工程领域实际问题的优秀工程师。 增材制造工程专业的毕业设计课程目标如下： 目标1：培养学生深入理解增材制造工程领域的基本原理和理论知识，能够运用这些知识对实际工程问题进行分析和解决。培养学生掌握增材制造工程领域的先进技术和方法，能够运用现代工具和技术对工程问题进行高效解决。培养学生具备扎实的数学、物理、化学等自然科学知识，能够运用这些知识为基础，深入分析和解决增材制造工程问题。 目标2：培养学生熟悉并能够运用现代工具和技术，如计算机辅助设计（CAD）、计算机辅助制造（CAM）、有限元分析（FEA）等，对增材制造问题进行设计和分析。培养学生掌握数据处理和分析的能力，能够运用现代工具对实验数据进行处理和分析，得出科学的结论。 目标3：培养学生具备良好的职业道德和社会责任感，使他们在解决工程问题时能够考虑到社会的影响和对环境的责任。培养学生具备较强的团队合作和沟通能力，使他们在解决工程问题时能够与团队成员、利益相关者和社会进行有效的沟通和合作。培养学生具备自主学习和持续学习的能力，使他们能够在职业生涯中不断更新知识和技能，适应技术进步和社会发展。培养学生具备批判性思维和创新能力，使他们能够在面对新的工程问题时能够提出创新的解决方案。
default.en: The goal of the capstone design course for the Additive Manufacturing Engineering program is to develop students with comprehensive abilities in engineering knowledge, modern tool applications, engineering and society, and lifelong learning, so that they can become excellent engineers capable of independently solving practical problems in the field of additive manufacturing engineering. The goals of the capstone course in Additive Manufacturing Engineering are as follows: Objective 1: To train students to have an in-depth understanding of the basic principles and theoretical knowledge in the field of additive manufacturing engineering, and to be able to apply this knowledge to analyze and solve practical engineering problems. To train students to master advanced technologies and methods in the field of additive manufacturing engineering, and to be able to utilize modern tools and technologies to solve engineering problems efficiently. To train students to have solid knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry and other natural sciences, and to be able to use this knowledge as a basis for in-depth analysis and solution of additive manufacturing engineering problems. Objective 2: To develop students' familiarity with and ability to apply modern tools and techniques, such as computer-aided design (CAD), computer-aided manufacturing (CAM), and finite element analysis (FEA), to design and analyze additive manufacturing problems. The students will be able to master the ability of data processing and analysis, and be able to use modern tools to process and analyze experimental data to draw scientific conclusions. Objective 3: To develop students with a good sense of professional ethics and social responsibility, so that they can consider the impact of society and their responsibility to the environment when solving engineering problems. To develop students with strong teamwork and communication skills so that they can communicate and collaborate effectively with team members, stakeholders and society when solving engineering problems. To develop students with the ability to learn independently and continuously so that they can update their knowledge and skills throughout their careers and adapt to technological advancement and social development. To develop in students the ability to think critically and creatively, enabling them to come up with innovative solutions when faced with new engineering problems.

To train students to have solid knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry and other natural sciences, and to be able to use this knowledge as a basis for in-depth analysis and solution of additive manufacturing engineering problems. Objective 2: To develop students' familiarity with and ability to apply modern tools and techniques, such as computer-aided design (CAD), computer-aided manufacturing (CAM), and finite element analysis (FEA), to design and analyze additive manufacturing problems. The students will be able to master the ability of data processing and analysis, and be able to use modern tools to process and analyze experimental data to draw scientific conclusions. Objective 3: To develop students with a good sense of professional ethics and social responsibility, so that they can consider the impact of society and their responsibility to the environment when solving engineering problems. To develop students with strong teamwork and communication skills so that they can communicate and collaborate effectively with team members, stakeholders and society when solving engineering problems. To develop students with the ability to learn independently and continuously so that they can update their knowledge and skills throughout their careers and adapt to technological advancement and social development. To develop in students the ability to think critically and creatively, enabling them to come up with innovative solutions when faced with new engineering problems.

default.zh: 焊接课程设计课程要求学生按照设计题目的技术指标及要求，进行焊接工艺、焊接冶金、焊接变形及缺陷检测的技术方案的论证，进行焊接工装夹具方案设计，作必要的结构件的强度计算，绘制焊接工装夹具设计图，写出设计说明书。
default.en: During the welding project course, the student will analysis the welding metallurgy process, design the welding method and parameter, obtain the welding distorting prevention and defect detect methods. In addition, the mechanical equipment for the welding process should be proposed and an engineering drawing should be finished.

default.zh: 本课程的设置是为了提高从事焊接技术与工程专业的学生能够运用课堂上所学习的焊接专业基本知识，去理解和领会焊接的生产实践，加深对焊接工艺及设备、焊接材料、焊接结构应力与变形、焊接质量检验方面的基本知识与理论的实践认识，了解焊接生产用的装备卡具的原理、设计和使用要求，学习焊接结构产品的工艺试验、工艺制定、生产监督与质量检验验收等工序，学习生产中采用的实用技术与工艺的原理及特点。 实习内容包括学习企业生产中的安全知识，熟悉焊接专业领域相关的技术标准、知识产权、产业政策和法律法规，企业管理体系，压力容器的焊接工艺要求，厚板窄间隙焊接工艺方法与设备，管板焊接工艺与设备，一般焊接结构产品的焊接工艺，掌握不同形状压力容器如何选择变位机及操作机，了解电机厂机座下料、 成型、 焊接的全部过程，总结焊接方法的生产应用特点。
default.en: This course is designed to improve the ability of students engaged in welding technology and engineering to understand and appreciate the production practice of welding by applying the basic knowledge of welding specialties learned in the classroom. Deepen students' practical understanding of the basic knowledge and theory of welding process and equipment, welding materials, welding structure stress and deformation, welding quality inspection, understand the principle, design and use of welding production equipment and tools requirements, learn the process of welded structural products such as process testing, process development, production supervision and quality inspection and acceptance process, learn the principles and characteristics of practical techniques and technologies used in production. The internship includes learning the safety knowledge in the production of enterprises, familiarizing with the relevant technical standards, intellectual property rights, industrial policies and laws and regulations in the field of welding, enterprise management system, welding process requirements of pressure vessels, narrow gap welding process methods and equipment for thick plates, welding process and equipment for pipe plates, welding process of general welded structural products, and mastering how to select the shifter and the operator for different shapes of pressure vessels. Understand the entire process of discharging, forming, and welding of the seat of the motor plant, and summarize the characteristics of the production and application of the welding method.

default.zh: 本课程是焊接技术与工程专业的创新实验课，主要培养学生运用所学的物理、化学、材料方面的知识和理论，论证试验方案及设计并进行试验，探索新工艺、新材料、新方法的创新能力。学生需要独立查阅文献、独立思考、科学评价研究现状、提出新方案或改进方案、可以从物理、化学、金属学、传热学、力学等各个角度提出新方案或改进方案，例如：解决异种金属连接问题冶金学、焊接应力或热裂纹的问题。不易实现高质量连接的异种金属焊接组合主要包括：铜与铝焊接、铜和钢焊接、玻璃与铝焊接、钛合金与铝焊接、钛合金与钢焊接、钛合金与铜焊接。
default.en: The Welding Innovation Design is a professional innovative experimental course in welding technology and engineering, the aim is to cultivate the students in demonstrating programs and designing the test, and then exploring new technology, new materials, new methods in welding based on the knowledge and theory of physical, chemical, materials. Students need to literature, thinking, carry out scientific evaluation of research status, independently, and put forwards new proposal or improvement program in perspectives of physical, chemical, physical metallurgy, heat transfer, mechanics and so on, to solve the problems such as, metallurgical problems of dissimilar metal connection, welding stress or hot cracking. Dissimilar metals, which are not easy to achieve high-quality joining, consist of copper and aluminum welding, welding of copper and steel, glass and aluminum welding, welding of titanium and aluminum, titanium and steel welding, titanium and copper welding.

default.zh: 《毕业论文（设计）》是在完成基础课、专业基础课和专业课学习的基础上，在指导老师的指导下独立完成一个完整的科学实验。实验研究内容要有探索性、创新性，获得详实的实验数据，得出有价值的结论。该课程包含开题、中期检查和论文答辩三个主要环节。要求学生完成一万五千字以上的学位论文。课程培养学生综合运用所学基础课、技术基础研究课和专业课，分析和解决工程技术问题的能力，深化和扩大所学基础知识、专业知识及实验技能，提高学生的自学能力和独立工作能力，使学生受到高级技术人员能力的综合训练。
default.en: "Graduation Thesis (Design)" is an independent completion of a complete scientific experiment under the guidance of a supervising teacher, based on the completion of basic courses, professional basic courses, and professional courses. The experimental research content should be exploratory and innovative, obtain detailed experimental data, and draw valuable conclusions. Students are required to complete a thesis of at least 15000 words. The course cultivates students' ability to comprehensively apply the basic courses, technical research courses, and professional courses they have learned, analyze and solve engineering and technical problems, deepen and expand their basic knowledge, professional knowledge, and experimental skills, improve their self-learning ability and independent work ability, and provide them with comprehensive training in advanced technical personnel abilities.
