default.zh: 电子封装技术课程设计是电子封装技术专业的非常重要的实践性教学环节，培养学生实事求是的科学态度和勇于探索的创新精神，在工程实践中理解并遵守工程职业道德和规范并履行责任；通过项目设计实践，训练并提高学生在理论计算、结构设计、工程绘图、查阅设计资料、运用标准与规范和应用计算机等方面的设计/开发解决方案能力及科学研究能力。课程内容包括选题，中期及答辩等环节，按照项目研究的要求，学生分组完成，提交研究报告并答辩。每个项目同组设计者及分工：1）1名负责人，2-3名成员； 2）团队成员共同讨论方案，但是每个人的方案要有差别，组内成员重复率不超过30%；3）团队所有成员均需要上交论文；4）按项目进行答辩。
default.en: Course Design of Electronic Packaging Technology is a core course in welding/electronic packaging technology specialty, cultivating students' scientific attitude and innovative spirit of enterprising, abide by the occupation ethics and engineering responsibility in engineering practice and understanding; through the project design practice, training and improving students in the theoretical calculation, structure design, engineering drawing, design, application design / inspection standards and norms and other aspects of the development and application of computer solution ability and scientific research ability. The content of the course includes topics, opening, medium and defense and other sectors, in accordance with the project requirements, the students completed, submit research reports and reply. Each project with the group of designers and division: 1) the person in charge of 1, 2-3 members; 2) team members to discuss the plan, but the plan to have the difference, the members of the group repetition rate of not more than 30%; 3) team members are all need to submit papers; 4) to debate for the project .

default.zh: 《生产实习》是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，本课程的主要目的是使学生了解和掌握基本生产知识，印证、巩固和丰富己学过的专业课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实际中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法。通过生产实习，懂得电子封装工艺、流程、检测手段等，了解电子封装技术的原理、掌握封装技术方面的知识，在培养学生的创新意识、能力和电子封装材料科学知识的应用能力的同时，还应使学生了解现代化生产方式和先进制造技术，培养热爱专业、致力于祖国社会主义建设的思想，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程结合课堂所学知识，掌握和分析典型电子元器件材料的组成结构，了解典型电子元器件材料的制造工艺及相关设备，掌握和分析电子元器件的制造、集成生产线工作流程及典型器件的封装工艺过程，具备从事电子封装科学研究、技术开发、设计制造和生产管理的能力；学生掌握电子封装产线上的关键设备和工具的使用，包括焊机、点胶机、贴片机等，能够独立完成基本的生产操作，并了解电子封装生产过程中的品质控制和检测方法，掌握相关质量标准和检测工具的使用；学生具有工程实践和社会实践经历，了解现代企业的生产、组织及管理情况，了解先进电子封装制造技术和现代化生产过程，能适应先进材料及加工、电子制造等领域对电子封装专业人才的需求。
default.en: "Production Practice" is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan. The main purpose of this course is to enable students to understand and master basic production knowledge, confirm, consolidate and enrich the content of professional courses they have learned, and train students to combine theory with practice. Improve the ability and method of investigating, observing, analyzing and solving problems in production practice. Through the production practice, understand the electronic packaging technology, process, testing means, etc., understand the principle of electronic packaging technology, master the knowledge of packaging technology, while cultivating students' innovation awareness, ability and application ability of electronic packaging material science knowledge, students should also understand modern production methods and advanced manufacturing technology. Cultivate the thoughts of loving the major and committed to the socialist construction of the motherland, and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in the learning results of the major. The course combines the knowledge learned in class to master and analyze the composition structure of typical electronic components and materials, understand the manufacturing process and related equipment of typical electronic components and materials, master and analyze the manufacturing process of electronic components and integrated production line and the packaging process of typical devices, and have the ability to engage in scientific research, technology development, design and manufacturing and production management of electronic packaging; Students master the use of key equipment and tools in the electronic packaging production line, including welding machines, dispensing machines, placement machines, etc., able to independently complete basic production operations, and understand the quality control and testing methods in the electronic packaging production process, master the use of relevant quality standards and testing tools; Students have experience in engineering practice and social practice, understand the production, organization and management of modern enterprises, understand advanced electronic packaging manufacturing technology and modern production process, and can adapt to the demand for electronic packaging professionals in advanced materials and processing, electronic manufacturing and other fields.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是完成本科阶段全部课程学习之后进行的综合性实践教学环节，是人才培养的重要途经，同时也是衡量教学水平、学生毕业与学位资格认证的重要依据。通过毕业设计，使学生经历从选题、调研和查阅资料、开题、设计论证、撰写毕业设计、答辩这样一个完整学习过程，受到理论联系实际的综合训练。毕业设计教学过程中的学习、研究和实际操作可以使学生受到现代安全工程学科的基本训练，并使其理论认识深化、知识领域扩展、专业技能延伸。培养学生综合运用所学理论知识和基本技能分析解决工程设计及科学研究问题的能力，锻炼和培养学生的创新意识和严格的实际工作作风，进一步培养学生严谨的科学态度、创新能力、实践能力和创业精神，为学生在之后的人生阶段中更好地适应工程设计，科学研究及其它技术工作奠定必要的基础。
default.en: Graduation Thesis (Project) is a comprehensive practical teaching process after the completion of all courses in undergraduate study. It is an important way to train talents, and also an significant basis for teaching level measuring, students' graduation and degree qualification. Through graduation design, students experience a complete learning process including topic selection, research and data consulting, thesis proposal, design and demonstration, graduation design writing and thesis defense, and receive comprehensive training of combining theory with practice. The study, research and practical operation in the course of graduation design teaching can enable students to receive the basic training of modern safety engineering discipline, deepen their theoretical understanding, expand their knowledge fields and extend their professional skills. Students are trained to comprehensively use the theoretical knowledge and basic skills to analyze and solve engineering design and scientific research problems, and the innovative consciousness and strict practical work style of students can be exercised and cultivated. So as to further cultivate students' rigorous scientific attitude, innovative ability, practical ability and entrepreneurial spirit, and lay the necessary foundation for students to better adapt to engineering design, scientific research and other technical work in their later life stage.

default.zh: 掌握几种基础功能和能源材料的基本特性及表征方法，熟悉材料表征与性能测试仪器设备的操作；掌握实验基本设计方法，学会实验数据处理和实验结果分析。培养学生掌握几种典型功能材料制备、材料结构和形貌分析，以及基于该功能材料器件的组装与性能测试的实验方法，主要包括材料沉积方法、材料合成与制备、纳米材料、电解水制氢、热电材料和器件五方面，使学生具备从事新型功能材料的研究、生产、技术开发的实践能力。同时，加深对基础理论的理解，增强感性认识，促进理论知识与实践的有机结合。培养学生科学严谨的实验研究方法，掌握基本实验技能，提高实践动手能力，为在今后生产实践中的创新性研究打下基础。
default.en: Students should master the basic characteristics and characterization methods of several basic functional and energy materials, and be familiar with the operation of material characterization and performance testing instruments and equipment; master the basic design methods of experiments, and learn experimental data processing and experimental result analysis. Train students to master the preparation of several typical functional materials, material structure and morphology analysis, as well as experimental methods for assembly and performance testing of devices based on functional materials, including material deposition methods, material synthesis and preparation, nanomaterials, and hydrogen production by electrolysis of water, thermoelectric materials and devices, to equip students with the practical ability to engage in the research, production, and technology development of new functional materials. At the same time, it deepens the understanding of basic theories, enhances perceptual knowledge, and promotes the organic combination of theoretical knowledge and practice. It aims to cultivate students' scientific and rigorous experimental research methods, master basic experimental skills, improve practical skills, and lay the foundation for innovative research in future production practice.

default.zh: 本课程包含了从先进功能材料的结构与性能、制备或加工到应用或开发等内容，它是材料科学与工程教学中的一门实践课程。通过先进功能材料制备与加工的基本原理和技术方法，让学生掌握材料制备与加工的基本技能；通过分析材料的结构、组成及其对材料性能的影响，让学生掌握材料的基本知识和原理；通过分析各种材料的应用前景、产业趋势、市场需求等相关知识，让学生了解行业前景和职业发展。该课程将为学生学习后续课程和将来从事材料工程技术工作打下良好的技术基础，对培养学生的设计思维和创新能力有着非常重要的作用。因此，本课程是学生在校期间第一次较全面的工程师能力训练，在材料物理专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和作用。
default.en: This course covers the contents from the structure and properties of advanced functional materials, preparation or processing, to application or development. It is a practical course in materials science and engineering education. Through the study of the basic principles and technical methods of advanced functional material preparation and processing, students can master the basic skills of material preparation and processing; By analyzing the structure and composition of materials and their impact on material properties, students can master the basic knowledge and principles of materials; By analyzing the application prospects, industry trends, market demands, and other related knowledge of various materials, students can understand the industry prospects and career development of material engineering. This course will lay a solid technical foundation for students to learn subsequent courses and engage in material engineering technology work in the future. It plays a very important role in cultivating students' design thinking and innovation abilities. Therefore, this course is the first comprehensive engineer training for students during their school years and plays an important role in the teaching plan of materials physics.

default.en: Production practice is an important teaching link in teaching plan of undergraduate course. The main purpose of this course is to enable students to understand and master basic production knowledge, confirm, consolidate, and enrich the professional course content they have learned, cultivate students to connect theory with practice, and improve their abilities and methods of investigating, observing, analyzing, and solving problems in production practice. Through production Practice, students will understand the packaging process and flow of devices by using testing methods, we can understand the principles of material physics and master the knowledge of material physics. This course can cultivate innovative awareness, abilities, and the application ability of material physics and materials science knowledge, enable students to understand modern production methods and advanced manufacturing technologies, cultivate the idea of loving the profession and dedicating themselves to the socialist construction of the motherland, and support the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 本课程是实现本科培养目标的重要教学环节。在完成基础课、专业基础课和专业课学习的基础上，在指导老师的指导下独立完成一个完整的科学实验。实验研究内容要有探索性、创新性，获得详实的实验数据，得出有价值的结论。该课程包含开题、中期检查和论文答辩三个主要环节。要求学生完成一万五千字以上的学位论文，论文主要内容应包括文献综述、实验材料与研究方法，结果与讨论以及结论等。通过该课程的学习，提高学生的专业素养和实践能力，培养学生的自学能力、实验动手能力、分析和解决科学问题的能力。
default.en: This course is an important teaching link for achieving undergraduate training goals. On the basis of completing basic courses, professional basic courses, and professional courses, students independently complete a complete scientific experiment under the guidance of a supervising teacher. The experimental research content should be exploratory and innovative, students obtain detailed experimental data, and draw valuable conclusions. This course includes three main stages: proposal, mid-term review, and thesis defense. Students are required to complete a thesis of at least 15000 words, which should mainly include literature review, experimental materials and research methods, results and discussions, and conclusions. Through the study of this course, students can improve their professional literacy and practical abilities, cultivate their self-learning ability, experimental hands-on ability, and the ability to analyze and solve scientific problems.

default.zh: 光电信息材料与器件课程设计中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程编号：22MS33801 课程名称：光电信息材料与器件课程设计 英文名称：Project of Optoelectronic Information Materials and Devices 课程学时：4周 讲课学时：0 实验学时：4周 上机学时：0 习题学时：0 课程学分：4.0 开课单位：材料科学与工程学院光电信息材料与器件系 授课对象：光电信息材料与器件专业 开课学期：3春 先修课程：半导体物理，半导体器件物理 二、课程简介 掌握几种典型半导体材料（III-V氮化物、压电材料和氧化物半导体材料）的基本特性及表征方法，熟悉材料表征与性能测试仪器设备的操作；掌握实验基本设计方法，学会实验数据处理和实验结果分析。培养学生掌握几种典型功能材料（III-V氮化物、压电材料和氧化物半导体材料）制备、材料结构分析，以及基于该功能材料器件的组装与性能测试的实验方法，使学生具备从事新型功能材料的研究、生产、技术开发的实践能力。同时，加深对基础理论的理解，增强感性认识，促进理论知识与实践的有机结合。培养学生科学严谨的实验研究方法，掌握基本实验技能，提高实践动手能力，为在今后生产实践中的创新性研究打下基础。
default.en: Master the basic characteristics and characterization methods of several typical semiconductor materials (III-V nitride, piezoelectric materials and oxide semiconductor materials), familiar with the operation of material characterization and performance testing instruments and equipment; Master basic experimental design methods, learn experimental data processing and experimental results analysis. Students are trained to master the preparation of several typical functional materials (III-V nitride, piezoelectric materials and oxide semiconductor materials), material structure analysis, and experimental methods based on the assembly and performance testing of the functional materials, so that students have the practical ability to engage in the research, production and technology development of new functional materials. At the same time, deepen the understanding of basic theory, enhance perceptual understanding, and promote the organic combination of theoretical knowledge and practice. To cultivate students' scientific and rigorous experimental research methods, master basic experimental skills, improve practical ability, and lay a foundation for innovative research in future production practice.

default.zh: 生产实习课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程编号：22MS33802 课程名称：生产实习 英文名称：Production Intership 课程学时：3周 讲课学时：0 实验学时：2周 上机学时：0 习题学时：0 课程学分：3.0 开课单位：材料科学与工程学院光电信息材料与器件系 授课对象：光电信息材料与器件专业 开课学期：4秋 先修课程：半导体器件物理B,半导体物理学，管理学和经济学选修课 二、课程简介 生产实习是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生了解和掌握基本生产知识，印证、巩固和丰富已学过的理工专业课程内容和经管知识，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实际中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法．通过生产实习，懂得器件制备、封装工艺、性能检测手段等，了解电子封装技术的原理、掌握材料物理方面的知识，还应使学生了解现代化生产方式和先进制造技术，培养热爱专业、致力于祖国社会主义建设的思想。
default.en: Production practice is a very important practical teaching link in undergraduate teaching plan, its purpose is to make the students understand and master basic knowledge of production; confirm, consolidate and enrich the courses they have learned corresponding to both science and technology and management and economy; integrate theory with practice, improve their abilities for observing, analyzing and solving problem in practice; know the technology, processes, and testing methods of materials; understand principles of materials physics and master the technology. Another purpose of production practice is making them know the modern production methods and advanced manufacturing technology, cultivate their love of major and ambition for construction of country.

default.zh: 毕业设计课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程编号：22MS33803 课程名称：毕业设计 英文名称：Graduation Project 课程学时：16周 讲课学时：0 实验学时：0 上机学时：0 习题学时：0 课程学分：8.0 开课单位：材料科学与工程学院材料科学系 授课对象：材料科学与工程专业 开课学期：04春 先修课程：半导体物理，半导体器件物理 二、课程简介 《毕业设计》是实现本科培养目标的重要教学环节。在完成基础课、专业基础课和专业课学习的基础上，在指导老师的指导下独立完成一个完整的科学实验。实验研究内容要有探索性、创新性，获得详实的实验数据，得出有价值的结论。该课程包含开题、中期检查和论文答辩三个主要环节。要求学生完成一万五千字以上的学位论文，论文主要内容应包括文献综述、实验材料与研究方法，结果与讨论以及结论等。通过该课程的学习，提高学生的专业素养和实践能力，培养学生的自学能力、实验动手能力、分析和解决科学问题的能力。
default.en: Graduation project is an important part in undergraduate student cultivation objective. The students need to complete the whole scientific experiments under the tutors’ instructions after they finish the basic courses, the subject courses and the specialized ones. The content of the experiment researches should be explosive and innovative, then the detailed and accurate empirical data are gotten and the aluable conclusions are drawn. This course includes three important parts：dissertation proposal, in-process spection, and oral defense. It requires a thesis of over 15,000 words, of which the content should include liateratures review, experimental, results and discussions, and conclusions. This course aim to improve students’ professional qualities and practical abilities, cultivate their self-study abilities and experiment abilities, and enhance their capacities to analyze and solve the scientific issues.

default.zh: 先进材料与智能制造创新项目与实践是高等院校材料科学与工程专业的专业方向选修课，本课程讲授材料智能设计与制备相关的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法，主要分为理论与实践两部分内容。理论部分介绍先进材料的基本概念、分类以及智能制造的主要方法等内容，以钛合金的3D打印技术为例，介绍智能制造与先进材料的组织、性能及应用之间的关系。实践部分使学生针对先进材料的制造方案提出设想，在授课教师的指导下开展科学研究和创新实践，完成项目的开题、中期进展和结题各环节。使学生了解材料领域发展最新动态的同时，增加学生对材料学、制造业、科学研究等领域的兴趣，提升学生的科研素养和创新实践能力，培养学生系统化规范化解决问题的方式。
default.en: The Advanced Materials and Intelligent Manufacturing Innovation Project and Practice is an elective course offered in the field of Materials Science and Engineering at higher education institutions. This course covers fundamental concepts, principles, and methods related to intelligent design and fabrication of materials. It is divided into two main parts: theory and practice. The theoretical part introduces basic concepts of advanced materials, their classification, as well as major methods of intelligent manufacturing. Using 3D printing technology of titanium alloys as an example, the course explores the relationship between intelligent manufacturing and the organization, properties, and applications of advanced materials. The practical part allows students to propose manufacturing schemes for advanced materials and engage in scientific research and innovative practices under the guidance of the instructor. Students are required to complete various stages of the project, including project proposal, mid-term progress, and final presentation. This enables students to stay updated with the latest developments in the field of materials and enhances their interest in materials science, manufacturing industry, and scientific research. Moreover, it fosters their research capabilities, innovation skills, and systematic problem-solving approaches. Through this course, students gain insights into the latest advancements in the field of materials and develop a systematic and standardized approach to problem-solving. It also cultivates their research literacy and innovation capabilities, while fostering their interest in materials science, manufacturing industry, and scientific research.

default.zh: 为深入推进习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想进教材进课堂进头脑，根据中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发的《关于深化新时代学校思想政治理论课改革创新的若干意见》和中共黑龙江省委宣传部、中共黑龙江省委教育工委、黑龙江省教育厅相关文件精神，我校在大一阶段为本科生开设“习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想概论”课。本课程对习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想作了较为全面深入的阐述，对新时代坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的奋斗目标、总体布局、战略布局、政治保障、领导力量、能力建设，以及新时代中国特色社会主义大国外交做出全面系统的阐述。有助于引导新时代青年更好地理解把握这一思想的基本精神、基本内容、基本要求，增强“四个意识”、坚定“四个自信”、做到“两个维护”，在思想上政治上行动上同以习近平同志为核心的党中央保持高度一致，在知行合一、学以致用上下功夫，做担当民族复兴大任的时代新人和新时代的奋斗者，为决胜全面建成小康社会、夺取新时代中国特色社会主义伟大胜利、实现中华民族伟大复兴的中国梦贡献力量。
default.en: In order to further advance Xi Jinping's new socialist ideology into the classroom, we should follow the spirit of the document issued by the general office of the CPC Central Committee and the general office of the State Council on deepening the reform and innovation of China's ideological and political theory course in the new era, and the relevant documents of the Propaganda Department of the Heilongjiang provincial Party committee, the Heilongjiang provincial Party committee's Education Commission and the Heilongjiang provincial education department. In the freshman year, the school offers the undergraduate course a "Introduction to Xi Jinping's new era China characteristic socialism thought". This course has made a more comprehensive and in-depth exposition of Xi Jinping's socialist ideology with Chinese characteristics in the new era. He has made a comprehensive and systematic exposition of the goals, overall layout, strategic layout, political guarantee, leadership strength, ability building and China's socialist diplomacy with Chinese characteristics in China in China's new era. It helps to guide young people in the new era to better understand and grasp the basic spirit, basic content and basic requirements of the thought, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses", strengthen "four self-confidence" and achieve "two maintenances". They are highly consistent with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at the core in ideological and political actions, and work hard in the unity of knowing and doing, learning for the purpose of application and acting as national complex. The new people of the times and the strivers of the new era contribute to the decisive victory of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects, winning the great victory of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era, and realizing the Chinese dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

default.zh: “思想道德与法治”课，是高等学校思想政治理论课程体系的重要组成部分，是帮助大学生提高思想道德素质和法律素质的重要课程。本课程以马克思主义为指导，以正确的世界观、人生观、价值观和道德观、法治观教育为主要内容，把社会主义核心价值观贯穿于教学的全过程，通过理论学习和实践体验，帮助大学生形成崇高的理想信念，弘扬伟大的爱国主义精神，确立正确的人生观和价值观，加强思想道德修养，增强学法守法用法的自觉性，全面提高思想道德素质和法律素质。 课程主要任务是培养学生： 1、形成科学的人生观、价值观、道德观和中国特色社会主义的理想信念。 2、具有一定的法律意识和法治精神，提高学生的法律素质。
default.en: The course "Ideology, Morality, and the Rule of Law" is an important component of the ideological and political theory curriculum system in colleges and universities, and is an important course to help college students improve their ideological and moral qualities and legal qualities. This course is guided by Marxism, with the main content of education on correct world outlook, outlook on life, values, ethics, and the rule of law. It applies socialist core values throughout the entire process of teaching. Through theoretical learning and practical experience, it helps college students form lofty ideals and beliefs, promote great patriotism, establish correct outlook on life and values, and strengthen ideological and moral cultivation, Strengthen the consciousness of learning, observing, and using the law, and comprehensively improve ideological, moral, and legal qualities. The main task of the course is to cultivate students: 1. Develop a scientific outlook on life, values, ethics, and the ideals and beliefs of socialism with Chinese characteristics. 2. Have a certain sense of law and the spirit of rule of law, and improve the legal quality of students.

default.zh: “中国近现代史纲要” 是全国高等学校本科生必修的思想政治理论课之一，本课程主要讲授近现代中国社会发展和革命、建设、改革的历史进程及其内在的规律性，使同学们深刻领会历史和人民是怎样选择了马克思主义、选择了中国共产党、选择了社会主义道路，选择了改革开放。 课程主要包括导言、资本-帝国主义的侵略与近代中国的演变、早期对国家出路的探索、辛亥革命、中国共产党的成立、中国革命新道路的探索、抗日战争、人民共和国——中国人民的历史选择、改革开放前后两个30年等专题。 本课程考试采用累加式，包括期末和平时两个部分。
default.en: The Compendium of Chinese Modern and Contemporary History is one of the most ideological and political theory courses to all the undergraduates. In this course, social development in modern china and the historical process of Chinese revolution, construction, reform and their regularity are introduced. By learning this course, students should understand deeply how to choose Marxism, the CPC, socialism road as well as reform and opening up for the history and people. The course mainly includes the introduction, capital-imperialist aggression and evolution of modern china, the early exploration of the country’s way out, Xinhai revolution, the establishment of the CPC, the exploration of new road of Chinese revolution, the anti-Japanese war, the people’s republic of china- the people’s history choice and the two 30 year’s subjects before and after and reform and opening up. This course takes a cumulative examination form, including the usual performance part and the final examination part.

default.zh: 《中国近现代史纲要》课是一门集历史性、理论性、教育性、知识性、政治性、科学性等于一体的公共思想政治理论教育课程，是国家规定的高校本科学生必修课程。本课程教学对象为大学所有专业的全日制本科生。《中国近现代史纲要》主要讲授中国近代以来争取民族独立、人民解放和实现国家富强、人民幸福的历史，帮助学生了解党史、国史、国情，深刻领会历史和人民选择马克思主义、选择中国共产党、选择社会主义道路、选择改革开放的必然性。
default.en: The course "Outline of Modern Chinese History" is a public ideological and political theory course integrating history, theory, education, knowledge, politics and science,which is a compulsory course for undergraduate students in colleges and universities as stipulated by the state. The Outline of Modern Chinese History focuses on the history of China's struggle for national independence,people's liberation,the achievement of national prosperity and people's happiness since modern times, helping students to understand the history of the Party, the history of the country and the national conditions, and to gain a deep understanding of the inevitability of history and the people's choice of Marxism, the Communist Party of China, the road to socialism and reform and opening up.

default.zh: 《毛泽东思想和中国特色社会主义理论体系概论》课程是所有本科学生必修的一门思想政治理论课。课程主要包括“毛泽东思想”、“邓小平理论”、“‘三个代表’重要思想”、“科学发展观”四部分内容。该课程以马克思主义中国化时代化为主线，集中阐述马克思主义中国化时代化理论成果的主要内容、精神实质、历史地位和指导意义，充分反映中国共产党不断推进马克思主义基本原理与中国具体实际相结合、与中华优秀传统文化相结合的历史进程和理论成果。
default.en: The course "Introduction to Mao Zedong Thought and the Theoretical System of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics" is a compulsory ideological and political theory course for all undergraduate students. The course mainly includes four parts: "Mao Zedong Thought", "Deng Xiaoping Theory", "Important Thought of the Three Represents", and "Scientific Outlook on Development". This course focuses on the modernization of Marxism in China, focuses on the main content, spiritual essence, historical status and guiding significance of the theoretical achievements of the modernization of Marxism in China, and fully reflects the historical process and theoretical achievements of the CPC in constantly promoting the integration of the basic principles of Marxism with China's specific reality and with China's excellent traditional culture.

default.zh: 本课程是全国高等学校本科生必修的一门思想政治理论课。学习这门课程的目的是帮助大学生系统掌握中国化马克思主义的形成发展、主要内容和精神实质，不断增强中国特色社会主义道路自信、理论自信、制度自信、制度自信，坚定中国特色社会主义信念。
default.en: The course "Introduction to Mao Zedong Thought and the Theoretical System of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics" is a compulsory ideological and political theory course for all undergraduate students. This course takes the localization and modernization of Marxism in China as the main line, fully reflects the historical process and basic experience of the CPC in constantly promoting the combination of the basic principles of Marxism with China's specific reality and with China's excellent traditional culture, and focuses on the formation process, main contents, spiritual essence, historical status and guiding significance of the theoretical achievements of localization and modernization of Marxism.

default.zh: 《马克思主义基本原理》是高校思想政治理论课程体系的主干课程，其内容包括：马克思主义哲学、政治经济学和科学社会主义三个组成部分。通过本课程的学习，要使学生完整地把握马克思主义基本理论，使学生认识到马克思主义是科学的世界观和方法论，是我们从事社会主义革命和社会主义建设指导思想和理论基础。要求学生要掌握和了解马克思主义哲学、马克思主义政治经济学以及科学社会主义的基本理论，在实践中学会运用马克思主义的基本原理认识和分析各种社会实际问题，正确认识人类社会的本质、社会发展动力和社会发展基本规律，正确认识资本主义和社会主义在其发展过程中出现的各种新情况、新问题，认识社会主义代替资本主义的历史必然性，从而坚定对社会主义和共产主义的信念。
default.en: "An Introduction to the basic principles of Marxism" is a main course in the ideological and political theory curriculum designed for college students, which includes: Marxist philosophy, political economy and scientific socialism. The course has the following targets: Firstly, to give students a complete grasp of basic Marxist theory, enable students to understand that Marxism is a scientific world outlook and methodology, which is a guiding ideology and theoretical basis of our socialist revolution and socialist construction. Secondly, to require students to master and understand the basic theory of Marxist philosophy, Marxist political economy and scientific socialism, learn to understand and analyze the actual social problems by using the basic principles of Marxism in practice.

default.zh: “形势与政策”课是理论武装时效性、释疑解惑针对性、教育引导综合性都很强的一门高校思想政治理论课，是帮助大学生正确认识新时代国内外形势，深刻领会党的十八大以来党和国家事业取得的历史性成就、发生的历史性变革、面临的历史性机遇和挑战的核心课程，是第一时间推动党的理论创新成果进教材进课堂进学生头脑，引导大学生准确理解党的基本理论、基本路线、基本方略的重要渠道。 教学内容依据教育部每学期印发的《高校“形势与政策”课教学要点》安排教学，紧密围绕学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，把坚定“四个自信”贯穿教学全过程，重点讲授党的理论创新最新成果，重点讲授新时代坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的生动实践，引导学生正确认识世界和中国发展大势，正确认识中国特色和国际比较，正确认识时代责任和历史使命，正确认识远大抱负和脚踏实地。主要开设全面从严治党形势与政策的专题，重点讲授党的政治建设、思想建设、组织建设、作风建设、纪律建设以及贯穿其中的制度建设的新举措新成效；主要开设我国经济社会发展形势与政策的专题，重点讲授党中央关于经济建设、政治建设、文化建设、社会建设、生态文明建设的新决策新部署；主要开设港澳台工作形势与政策的专题，重点讲授坚持“一国两制”、推进祖国统一的新进展新局面；主要开设国际形势与政策专题，重点讲授中国坚持和平发展道路、推动构建人类命运共同体的新理念新贡献。此外，根据形势发展要求和学生特点有针对性地设置教学内容，及时回应学生关注的热点问题。
default.en: Situation and Policy is a theory-based course centered up on ideology and politics taught at higher education institutes; it features high-level of theoretical timeliness, high accuracy and effectiveness in terms of doubt clearance, and high comprehensiveness in educational guidance. It is a core course that helps college students correctly understand domestic and overseas situations in the new era, equipping them with deep knowledge on the historical achievements, the historical changes, as well as the historical opportunities and challenges encountered during the pursuit of the Party’s and national causes since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. It is also an important approach to impart the Party’s latest theoretical innovation achievements to students and to guide college students to accurately comprehend the Party’s basic philosophy, basic development path, and basic strategy. The teaching content is arranged in accordance with the Main Points for the Teaching of Situation and Policy at Higher Education Institutes issued by the Ministry of Education each semester, closely revolving the learning and implementation of Xi Jinping’s thoughts on socialism with Chinese characteristics for the new era and in the principle of the “four traits of self-confidence”. The instructions are focused on the latest theoretical innovation achievements of the Party and the dynamic practices of carrying forward and developing socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era, aiming to guide students towards the correct perception on the development situation of China and the world, Chinese characteristics and international comparison, the responsibility of the times and the historical mission, as well as the far-reaching aspirations and the implications of making earnest efforts. Special lectures on the situation and policy of comprehensively strengthening the Party’s discipline are given to explain the Party's political construction, ideological construction, organizational construction, style construction, and disciplinary construction, as well as elaborate the new measures and results of institutional construction running through the above processes.Special lectures on China's economic and social development situation and policy are given to impart the new decisions and new arrangements of the CPC Central Committee on economic construction, political construction, cultural construction, social construction, and ecological civilization construction. Special lectures on the situation and policy of Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan affairs are set up to update the new progress and situations on the compliance to the “one country and two systems” treaty and the advancement of national reunification. Special lectures on international situation and policy are given to elaborate the new concepts and contributions of China in following the path of peaceful development as well as promoting the building of a “community of shared future for mankind”. Furthermore, other targeted teaching contents are also arranged according to situational development requirements and student characteristics to timely analyze the popular issues that caught the most attention of the students.

default.zh: “形势与政策”是1987年国家教委在大学生思想政治教育中设置的一门必修课，至今已有近四十年的历史。实践证明，形势与政策教育是高等学校学生思想政治教育的重要内容。“形势与政策”课是高校思想政治理论课的重要组成部分，是对学生进行形势与政策教育的主渠道、主阵地，是每个大学生的必修课程，在大学生思想政治教育中担负着重要使命，具有不可替代的重要作用。 “形势与政策”课程目标设立的基本依据来自三个方面，即“意识形态教育”、“素质教育”与“通识教育”的要求——“形势与政策”课着重进行党的基本理论、基本路线、基本纲领和基本经验教育；进行我国改革开放和社会主义现代化建设的形势、任务和发展成就教育；进行党和国家重大方针政策、重大活动和重大改革措施教育；进行当前国际形势与国际关系的状况、发展趋势和我国的对外政策，世界重大事件及我国政府的原则立场教育；进行马克思主义形势观、政策观教育。
default.en: “Situation and policy” is a compulsory course set up by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China in 1987 in the ideological and political education of college students. Practice has proved that situation and policy education is an important part of ideological and political education for college students. The course of“Situation and policy” is an important part of the course of ideological and political theory in colleges and universities, in the ideological and political education of college students bear an important mission, has an irreplaceable important role. The basic basis of the establishment of“Situation and policy” curriculum goal comes from three aspects, that is, the requirements of“Ideological education”, “Quality education” and“General education”-the course of“Situation and policy” focuses on the party's basic theory, basic line, basicprogram and basic experience education; To carry out education on the situation, tasks and achievements of our country's reform and opening-up and socialist modernization; To carry out the education of the current international situation and international relations, the development trend and our country's foreign policy, world important events and our government's principle and stand, and to carry out the education of Marxist situation view and policy view.

default.en: Situation and Policy is a theory-based course centered up on ideology and politics taught at higher education institutes; it features high-level of theoretical timeliness, high accuracy and effectiveness in terms of doubt clearance, and high comprehensiveness in educational guidance. It is a core course that helps college students correctly understand domestic and overseas situations in the new era, equipping them with deep knowledge on the historical achievements, the historical changes, as well as the historical opportunities and challenges encountered during the pursuit of the Party’s and national causes since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. It is also an important approach to impart the Party’s latest theoretical innovation achievements to students and to guide college students to accurately comprehend the Party’s basic philosophy, basic development path, and basic strategy. The teaching content is arranged in accordance with the Main Points for the Teaching of Situation and Policy at Higher Education Institutes issued by the Ministry of Education each semester, closely revolving the learning and implementation of Xi Jinping’s thoughts on socialism with Chinese characteristics for the new era and in the principle of the “four traits of self-confidence”. The instructions are focused on the latest theoretical innovation achievements of the Party and the dynamic practices of carrying forward and developing socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era, aiming to guide students towards the correct perception on the development situation of China and the world, Chinese characteristics and international comparison, the responsibility of the times and the historical mission, as well as the far-reaching aspirations and the implications of making earnest efforts. Special lectures on the situation and policy of comprehensively strengthening the Party’s discipline are given to explain the Party's political construction, ideological construction, organizational construction, style construction, and disciplinary construction, as well as elaborate the new measures and results of institutional construction running through the above processes.Special lectures on China's economic and social development situation and policy are given to impart the new decisions and new arrangements of the CPC Central Committee on economic construction, political construction, cultural construction, social construction, and ecological civilization construction. Special lectures on the situation and policy of Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan affairs are set up to update the new progress and situations on the compliance to the “one country and two systems” treaty and the advancement of national reunification. Special lectures on international situation and policy are given to elaborate the new concepts and contributions of China in following the path of peaceful development as well as promoting the building of a “community of shared future for mankind”. Furthermore, other targeted teaching contents are also arranged according to situational development requirements and student characteristics to timely analyze the popular issues that caught the most attention of the students.

default.zh: 为深入推进习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想进教材进课堂进头脑，根据中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发的《关于深化新时代学校思想政治理论课改革创新的若干意见》和中共黑龙江省委宣传部、中共黑龙江省委教育工委、黑龙江省教育厅相关文件精神，我校在大一阶段为本科生开设“习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想概论”课。本课程对习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想作了较为全面深入的阐述，对新时代坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的奋斗目标、总体布局、战略布局、政治保障、领导力量、能力建设，以及新时代中国特色社会主义大国外交做出全面系统的阐述。有助于引导新时代青年更好地理解把握这一思想的基本精神、基本内容、基本要求，增强“四个意识”、坚定“四个自信”、做到“两个维护”，在思想上政治上行动上同以习近平同志为核心的党中央保持高度一致，在知行合一、学以致用上下功夫，做担当民族复兴大任的时代新人和新时代的奋斗者，为决胜全面建成小康社会、夺取新时代中国特色社会主义伟大胜利、实现中华民族伟大复兴的中国梦贡献力量。
default.en: In order to further advance Xi Jinping's new socialist ideology into the classroom, we should follow the spirit of the document issued by the general office of the CPC Central Committee and the general office of the State Council on deepening the reform and innovation of China's ideological and political theory course in the new era, and the relevant documents of the Propaganda Department of the Heilongjiang provincial Party committee, the Heilongjiang provincial Party committee's Education Commission and the Heilongjiang provincial education department. In the freshman year, the school offers the undergraduate course a "Introduction to Xi Jinping's new era China characteristic socialism thought". This course has made a more comprehensive and in-depth exposition of Xi Jinping's socialist ideology with Chinese characteristics in the new era. He has made a comprehensive and systematic exposition of the goals, overall layout, strategic layout, political guarantee, leadership strength, ability building and China's socialist diplomacy with Chinese characteristics in China in China's new era. It helps to guide young people in the new era to better understand and grasp the basic spirit, basic content and basic requirements of the thought, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses", strengthen "four self-confidence" and achieve "two maintenances". They are highly consistent with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at the core in ideological and political actions, and work hard in the unity of knowing and doing, learning for the purpose of application and acting as national complex. The new people of the times and the strivers of the new era contribute to the decisive victory of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects, winning the great victory of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era, and realizing the Chinese dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

default.zh: 《国家安全教育课》以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，贯彻党的教育方针，落实立德树人根本任务，牢固树立和全面践行总体国家安全观，紧密围绕《大中小学国家安全教育指导纲要》的各项要求，充分结合哈尔滨工业大学各优势学科专业的特点及本科生教育教学特色，构建《国家安全教育》独立课程，并将之纳入公共课教学体系。课程围绕总体国家安全观和国家安全各领域，确定综合性或特定领域的主题，成为培育大学生国家安全意识的主渠道和主要阵地。
default.en: Guided by Xi Jinping’s Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, “National Security Education” implements the Party’s education policy, carries out the fundamental task of cultivating people through virtue, firmly establishes and comprehensively practices the overall concept of national security. Furthermore, closely following the requirements of the “Guidelines for National Security Education in Colleges, Schools, and Colleges”, the independent course of “National Security Education” is constructed by fully combining the characteristics of the dominant disciplines and undergraduate education and teaching in Harbin Institute of Technology, and it is incorporated into the teaching system of public courses. This course focuses on the overall concept of national security and various fields of national security, and determines the theme of comprehensive or specific fields, which becomes the main channel and main front for cultivating college students’ awareness of national security.
