default.zh: 国外马克思主义是马克思主义理论的重要内容之一。本课程系统梳理21世纪国外马克思主义批判的重大问题，依据历史与逻辑相统一的方法，深入挖掘每个问题的理论渊源、代表人物、现实语境、发展脉络及其逻辑演变，评述国外马克思主义在这些重大问题研究上的最新进展、理论贡献及其局限性。 本课程的主要任务是：引导学生了解国外马克思主义发展的基本逻辑，帮助学生提高研究、分析和批判的能力，进一步坚定马克思主义的理想信念与道德情操，学会运用马克思主义的立场、观点、方法来分析与判断当代世界的发展变化及其思潮激荡，为新时代中国马克思主义的发展提供借鉴与参考。
default.en: Marxism in Foreign Countries is one of the important contents of Marxist theory. This course systematically combs the major issues of Marxism criticism in foreign countries in the 21st century. Based on the method of integrating history and logic, this course will dig deeply into the theoretical origin, representative figures, realistic context, development context and logical evolution of each issue, and review the latest progress, theoretical contributions and limitations of Marxism in foreign countries on these important issues. The main tasks of this course are: to guide students to understand the basic logic of the development of Marxism in foreign countries, to help students improve the ability of research, analysis and criticism, further strengthen the ideal belief and moral sentiment of Marxism, learn to use Marxist methods to analyze and judge the development and change of the contemporary world and its ideological trend, and to provide reference for the development of Chinese Marxism in the new era.

default.zh: 科学社会主义是马克思恩格斯创立的科学理论体系，是社会主义革命和建设的科学指南。社会主义革命首先在经济文化相对落后国家的胜利，开辟了人类历史的新篇章，但是，社会主义建设在取得了伟大成就的同时，也经历了曲折，如何认识马克思恩格斯社会主义理论的科学性，国际共产主义运动的成就和曲折，特别是苏联东欧社会主义的发展及挫折，本课程将对这些问题进行讲述和探讨。通过本课程的教学，学生还将对中国社会主义建设的历史和现实进行、理论与实践进行全面系统的学习和了解，从而坚定对中国特色社会主义道路自信、理论自信、制度自信、文化自信。 通过本课程，让学生坚定马克思主义理想信念，加强社会主义核心价值观建设；在课程教学中帮助学生掌握马克思主义世界观和方法论，从历史与现实、理论与实践等维度深刻理解习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想。通过本课程，帮助学生既要打好基础知识，又要做好价值观的树立和传递，从重视知识内容的传递转向关注学生的学习效果；教学实施中，一方面注重教师讲课能力的提升，同时注重学生学习能力的培养；学业考评中，平时考评和期末考试相结合。
default.en: Scientific socialism is a scientific theoretical system founded by Marx and Engels, and a scientific guide for socialist revolution and construction. The victory of the socialist revolution in the relatively backward countries has opened up a new chapter in human history. However, while the socialist construction has made great achievements, it has also experienced twists and turns. How to understand the scientific nature of Marx and Engels' socialist theory and the achievements and twists of the International Communist movement? Especially the development and frustration of socialism in the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe. This course will discuss these problems. Through this course, students will learn and understand the history and reality of China's socialist construction, theory and practice comprehensively and systematically, so as to strengthen their confidence in the road, theory, system and culture of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

default.zh: 《马克思恩格斯列宁哲学经典著作导读》是马克思主义理论研究和建设工程重点教材，教材精选了马克思、恩格斯、列宁等具有代表性的哲学著作，这些著作都是马克思主义哲学的代表著作，内涵丰富、思想深邃、逻辑严密。本课程引导学生从文本的角度了解马克思主义经典著作，掌握这些著作的特点及它们之间的内在联系，理解马克思主义理论。本课程使学生在文本解读的基础上更加深刻地把握马克思主义的思维方式、价值理想和基本精神，坚定学生对于马克思主义的信仰，使学生能够运用马克思主义的基本观点和方法分析和解答现实的和思想的问题，提高马克思主义理论专业学生的马克思主义理论素养和专业研究水平。本课程共计48学时，其中理论学时为46学时，实践学时为2学时，分为15个专题。通过教学，使学生比较系统地了解马克思主义经典作家及其继承者的基本思想，全面把握马克思主义理论体系，进一步深化对辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义的理解和把握，培养学生学习马克思主义理论著作的基本方法，掌握学习古今中外思想家著作的技巧，并能站在新时代的高度，理论联系实际，科学地运用马克思主义的立场、观点和方法，分析问题和解决问题，能够有效鉴别与理性汲取中西方的哲学思想，培养和提高学生的理论思维、创新思维和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Introduction to Philosophy Classics of Marx,Engels,and Lenin is a key textbook for Marxist theoretical research and construction projects.The textbook selects representative philosophical works of Marx,Engels,Lenin,etc,all of which are representative works of Marxist philosophy,with rich content,profound thoughts,and rigorous logic.This course guides students to understand Marxist classics from a textual point of view,grasp the characteristics of these works and their internal connections,and understand Marxist theory.This course enables students to have a deeper understanding of the thinking mode,values,ideals,and basic spirit of Marxism on the basis of text interpretation.It strengthens students' faith in Marxism,enables them to apply the basic viewpoints and methods of Marxism to analyze and answer practical and ideological problems,and improves the Marxist theoretical literacy and professional research level of students who are majoring in Marxist theory. This course has a total of 48 hours including 46 theoretical hours and 2 practical hours.It is divided into 15 topics.Through the class,students can systematically understand the basic thoughts of Marxist classic writers and their successors,comprehensively grasp the theoretical system of Marxism,further deepen their understanding and grasp of dialectical materialism and historical materialism,cultivate students to learn the basic methods of Marxist subjective theory works,master the skills of learning the works of thinkers at all times,and be able to stand at the height of the new era,connect theory with practice,scientifically apply the Marxist standpoint,viewpoint,and method to analyze and solve problems, can effectively distinguish and rationally absorb philosophical ideas from both the East and the West,cultivate and improve students' theoretical thinking,innovative thinking,and problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 本课程主要是对学生进行马克思主义政治经济学资本主义部分基本原理的教育，引导和帮助学生运用马克思主义的立场、观点和方法去观察和认识资本主义生产关系和社会主义生产关系的实质，科学认识资本主义和社会主义经济运行的基本问题，把握经济全球化发展的大趋势，认识世界经济发展的新变化与中国经济发展面临的新问题，从而科学认识资本主义和社会主义发展的历史进程，坚定为建设有中国特色的社会主义而奋斗的理想信念。
default.en: This course is mainly designed for students to enable them to learn the basic principles of Marxist Political Economics, help them observe and discover the essence of production relationships in capitalist and socialist world with the principles of Marxism, and get a scientific cognition of the basic problems in economic operations of both capitalist and socialist world. It also helps them grasp the main trend of economic globalization, study the latest changes of the economic development in the world and the newly-emerging problems of China’s economy, thus endowing students with a right awareness of the historical processes of capitalist and socialist development and strengthening determination and conviction of striving hard for constructing the socialism with Chinese characteristics.

default.zh: 政治学是研究和探索政治现象及其发展规律的一门科学。政治学概论是政治学各部门学科的基础理论，它研究整个政治学领域中的共同性和根本性的问题，这些问题对政治学各分支学科都具有指导意义，为研究政治学各分支学科提供基本理论基础。
default.en: Political science is a science that studies and explores political phenomena and their development laws. Introduction to Political Science is the fundamental theory of various branches of political science, which studies the common and fundamental issues in the entire field of political science. These issues have guiding significance for all branches of political science and provide a basic theoretical basis for studying them.

default.zh: 政治学是研究和探索政治现象及其发展规律的一门科学。政治学概论是政治学各部门学科的基础理论，它研究整个政治学领域中的共同性和根本性的问题，这些问题对政治学各分支学科都具有指导意义，为研究政治学各分支学科提供基本理论基础。
default.en: Political science is a science that studies and explores political phenomena and their development laws. Introduction to Political Science is the fundamental theory of various branches of political science, which studies the common and fundamental issues in the entire field of political science. These issues have guiding significance for various branches of political science and provide a basic theoretical basis for studying various branches of political science.

default.zh: 《马克思主义哲学》课程是思想政治教育专业的核心课程之一，是思想政治教育专业的学生必须掌握的一门课程。本课程主要研究马克思主义哲学的伟大变革及其思想贡献，辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义的基本原理及其当代意义。
default.en: The course "Marxist Philosophy" is one of the core courses of ideological and political education majors, and it is a course that students of ideological and political education majors must master. This course mainly studies the great changes and ideological contributions of Marxist philosophy, the basic principles of dialectical materialism and historical materialism, and their contemporary significance.

default.zh: 逻辑学是一门既传统又现代的学科，其主要内容是研究思维的逻辑形式，是实践性和技巧性很强的专业基础课。本门课程从逻辑学的学科性质入手，带学生一起了解逻辑学发展简史，通过学习概念、判断、推理、逻辑基本规律和论证等相关逻辑知识，培养学生严密地表达、论证思想的能力，为学生探求知识提供必要的基本逻辑方法，使学生的思维更具逻辑性、科学性。
default.en: Logic is a traditional and modern subject, its main content is to study the logical form of thinking, is a very practical and skilled professional basic course. Starting with the nature of logic, this course takes students to understand the brief history of the development of logic. By learning concepts, judgments, reasoning, basic laws of logic, demonstration and other relevant logical knowledge, it cultivates students' ability to express and demonstrate ideas rigor, provides necessary basic logical methods for students to explore knowledge, and makes students' thinking more logical and scientific.

default.zh: 本课程介绍中西方政治思想史的研究对象、发展历程、基本线索和研究方法。其研究主题涉及中西方重要思想家关于哲学伦理、政治制度、国家、权力、政体等的认识和思考。对于拓展学生的知识视野，锻炼学生的思维，更好的坚持马克思主义具有重要意义。
default.en: This course introduces the research object, development process, basic clues and research methods of the history of Chinese and Western political thought. The research topic involves the understanding and thinking of important Chinese and Western thinkers on philosophy, ethics, political system, state, power, political system, etc. It is of great significance for expanding students' knowledge horizons, exercising their thinking, and better adhering to Marxism.

default.zh: 本课程介绍中西方政治思想史的研究对象、发展历程、基本线索和研究方法。其研究主题涉及中西方重要思想家关于哲学伦理、政治制度、国家、权力、政体等的认识和思考。对于拓展学生的知识视野，锻炼学生的思维，更好的坚持马克思主义具有重要意义。
default.en: This course introduces the research object, development process, basic clues and research methods of the history of Chinese and Western political thought. The research topic involves the understanding and thinking of important Chinese and Western thinkers on philosophy, ethics, political system, state, power, political system, etc. It is of great significance for expanding students' knowledge horizons, exercising their thinking, and better adhering to Marxism.

default.zh: 政治学是研究和探索政治现象及其发展规律的一门科学。政治学概论是政治学各部门学科的基础理论，它研究整个政治学领域中的共同性和根本性的问题，这些问题对政治学各分支学科都具有指导意义，为研究政治学各分支学科提供基本理论基础。
default.en: Political science is a science that studies and explores political phenomena and their development laws. Introduction to Political Science is the fundamental theory of various branches of political science, which studies the common and fundamental issues in the entire field of political science. These issues have guiding significance for various branches of political science and provide a basic theoretical basis for studying various branches of political science.

default.zh: 《法学概论》是思想政治教育专业学生的专业必修课之一，是一门系统讲授马克思主义法学基本原理、简要介绍国内主要部门法、国际法的基本知识和相关法律规范的法学课。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握法学基础知识、使非法学专业的学生初步形成对法学知识体系的完整建构，提高学生对法律现象的认识和分析能力，提高学生的法律意识，培养学生的法治观念。为培养政治坚定，业务合格的思想政治教育工作者、理论扎实的马克思主义理论研究者及适应新世纪社会主义建设需要的复合型的政治法律人才服务。
default.en: A general introduction to jurisprudence is one of the compulsory courses for students majoring in ideological and political education. It is a legal course that systematically teaches the basic principles of Marxist law, briefly introduces the basic knowledge of domestic and international law, and relevant legal norms. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic knowledge of law, and non-law major students will initially form a complete construction of the legal knowledge system. This will improve their understanding and analytical ability of legal phenomena, enhance their legal awareness, and cultivate their concept of the rule of law. To cultivate politically determined and qualified ideological and political educators, solid Marxist theoretical researchers, and composite political and legal talents who meet the needs of socialist construction in the new century.

default.zh: 马克思主义发展史是一门研究马克思主义产生、发展的历史过程及其规律的科学，是思想政治教育专业本科学生的必修课程。内容主要有：马克思主义的创立、马克思主义政治经济学的形成、马克思主义体系的丰富与发展、列宁主义对马克思主义的新发展、马列主义在苏联的发展及挫折、西方马克思主义理论的形成和发展、马克思主义中国化的历程及其最新发展等。
default.en: Development History of Marxism is a compulsory course designed for Students majoring in ideological and political education, and it is a science that studies the historical process and laws of the emergence and development of Marxism. The contents mainly include: the establishment of Marxism, the formation of Marxist political economy, the enrichment and development of Marxist system, the new development of Marxism by Leninism, the development and frustration of Marxism-Leninism in the Soviet Union, the formation and development of western Marxist theory, the course and latest development of Marxism in China, etc.

default.zh: 中共党史课程是为马克思主义学院本科生开设的必修课程。作为马克思主义相关专业的学生，中国共产党历史是必须熟知且掌握的内容。课程以马克思主义史学理论为指导，重点讲解中国共产党的创立，以及中国共产党如何将马列主义基本原理与中国革命、建设和改革的具体实际相结合，领导中国人民不断奋斗的光辉历程。课程将向学生展现宏大的党史画卷，拓宽学生视野，并将总结中国共产党建设发展中的规律和经验，培养学生分析问题的能力，最重要的是在百年党史中汲取奋进力量，真正达到以学促干。
default.en: The course of the History of the Communist Party of China is a compulsory course for undergraduates of the School of Marxism. As a student majoring in Marxism, the history of the Communist Party of China must be familiar with and mastered. Guided by Marxist historical theories, the course focuses on the founding of the Communist Party of China, and how the Communist Party of China combined the basic principles of Marxism-Leninism with the concrete realities of China's revolution, construction and reform, and led the glorious course of continuous struggle of the Chinese people. The course will show students a grand picture of the history of the Party, broaden their horizons, and will sum up the laws and experiences in the construction and development of the Communist Party of China, train students' ability to analyze problems, and most importantly, draw forging strength in the century-old history of the Party, and truly achieve the realization of learning to promote work.

default.zh: 工程活动是现代社会存在和发展的物质基础,它不但体现着人与自然的关系而且必然深刻涉及人与人的关系、人与社会的关系。工程活动中内在地存在着许多深刻、重要的伦理问题。目前我国正在进行史无前例的工程建设，科学提出、分析与解决不同行业、领域工程活动的伦理问题则成为重中之重。《工程伦理与工程认识》是面向高年级本科生开设的工程教育与工程伦理教育课程，该课程既包括工程内涵、工程全生命周期、工程伦理、工程共同体等理论要素，也包括从具象的案例出发分析所出现的工程伦理问题，通过师生互动探讨，希冀培养学生伦理意识，提升他们伦理素养，强化他们勇担时代的社会责任。
default.en: Engineering activities are the material foundation for the existence and development of modern society. It not only reflects the relationship between human and nature, but also inevitably refers to the relationship between people and people, and between human and society. There are many profound and important ethical issues inherent in engineering activities. Nowadays, China is undergoing unprecedented engineering construction. It is of great importance to propose, analyze and solve the ethical problems of engineering activities in different industries and fields. “Engineering Ethics and Cognition” is designed for senior undergraduates for their engineering and ethics education. The course includes not only theoretical elements such as engineering connotation, engineering life cycle, engineering ethics, engineering community, but also the analysis of engineering ethics problems from concrete practical cases. Through the active discussion between teachers and students, it is hoped that students’ ethical awareness in engineering will be well cultivated, ethical literacy will be further improved and social responsibility will be more strengthened.

default.zh: 本学科的“学术规范”是什么？这是每个从事专业学习与学术研究的学子都应该了解的问题。本课程旨在从马克思主义理论学科的概况（基本建制、基本范畴、基本研究伦理）出发，引导学生掌握马克思主义理论学科学术研究的技术规范（与选题、文献检索、写作和评价等学术活动有关的基本程序、基本技术标准和规则），并在这一过程中进一步了解马克思主义理论学科的独特研究方法（从一般方法到具体方法）。 希望通过本课程的学习，大家能够增进对马克思主义理论学科学术研究的认识和理解，把握学术研究的伦理和原则，熟悉学术研究的流程和方法，养成独立撰写学术论文的能力。
default.en: What are the "academic norms" of this discipline? This is a question that everyone engaged in professional study and academic research should know. This course starts from an overview of the discipline of Marxist theory (basic structure, basic categories, basic research ethics) to guide students in mastering the technical standards for academic research in their major (related to basic procedures, basic technical standards, and rules for academic activities such as topic selection, literature search, writing, and evaluation) and to further understand the unique research methods specific in this field (from general to specific). Through the study of this course, it is hoped that students’ understanding of academic research in the discipline of Marxist theory will be well enhanced, so that they could fully comprehend the ethics, principles, methods and procedures of the academic research in this field, and develop the ability to write course papers and theses independently.

default.zh: 社会统计学是文科学生必须掌握的方法与技术。但统计学庞杂的计算使得计算机的应用成为其重要的技术支撑。SPSS与r是世界最优秀的统计软件，目前在我国的应用范围正在迅速扩大。作为哲学社会科学学者，学会使用SPSS/r已成为精确、快捷地进行研究的必要能力之一。本课程结合了统计学的知识与实践操作，主要内容包括：基于SPSS及r软件的各种窗口的介绍；菜单、对话框、选项、按钮等的操作方法；数据文件的建立与数据的录入；录入误差的消除；数据的排序、排秩、选择、插入、重新编码；数据文件的转置、合并、分割、汇总；描述统计；平均值分析与T检验；相关分析；回归分析；多选变量分析；非参数检验；统计图表的绘制与编辑等。
default.en: Social Statistics and its computer application are the elementary and necessary knowledge and skills for liberal undergraduates. As the SPSS/R is one of the most widespread statistic tools now, proficient SPSS/R operation is the required ability for researchers of philosophy and social sciences. This course introduces the theories of social statistics, and the layout in SPSS and r. It requires students to achieve a solid proficiency in operations of files, data, and charts within the software. Operations of files include establishing, transposing, merging, splitting, and summarizing files. Basic operations of data include ranking, selecting, inserting, re-encoding data, as well as elimination of errors. Data analyzing operations include descriptive statistics, means analysis and T-test, correlation analysis, regression analysis, multi-selection multivariate analysis, and non-parametric test, etc.

default.zh: 本课程是为马克思主义理论或思想政治教育专业学生开设的、旨在提高专业能力的英语课程。课程遴选马克思主义经典作家作品的英文范文进行讲解、分析和研究，从专业知识、词汇、文化背景和理论提点等方面进行专业英语素养培养，提高其使用英语进行专业研究的能力。在完成学习后，学生能较顺利阅读马克思主义经典文献和马克思主义中国化理论成果的英文版，能初步地用英语对专业内容进行听、说、写的交流。
default.en: This course is designed for Marxist Theory or Ideological and Political Education majors to enhance their professional accumulation in understanding Marxist works in English. Through this course, students would learn classical works of significant Marxists, thus cultivating their English language proficiency and improving their ability in conducting research in English. After finishing this course, students can comprehend the classic Marxist works and the readings of localization of Marxism in China, and preliminary communicate with others on Marxism-related topics in English.

default.zh: 本课程是为马克思主义理论或思想政治教育专业学生开设的、旨在提高专业能力的英语课程。课程遴选马克思主义经典作家作品的英文范文进行讲解、分析和研究，从专业知识、词汇、文化背景和理论提点等方面进行专业英语素养培养，提高其使用英语进行专业研究的能力。在完成学习后，学生能较顺利阅读马克思主义经典文献和马克思主义中国化理论成果的英文版，能初步地用英语对专业内容进行听、说、写的交流。
default.en: This course is designed for Marxist Theory or Ideological and Political Education majors to enhance their professional accumulation in understanding Marxist works in English. Through this course, students would learn classical works of significant Marxists, thus cultivating their English language proficiency and improving their ability in conducting research in English. After finishing this course, students can comprehend the classic Marxist works and the readings of localization of Marxism in China, and preliminary communicate with others on Marxism-related topics in English.

default.zh: 课程简介:习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，是新时代中国共产党的思想旗帜，是国家政治生活和社会生活的根本指针，是当代中国马克思主义、21世纪马克思主义，为实现中华民族伟大复兴提供了行动指南，为推动构建人类命运共同体贡献了智慧方案。“习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想概论”是高校思政必修课，是系统阐释习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学体系、严密逻辑和丰富内涵的关键课程。对引导广大青少年树立马克思主义信仰，坚定中国特色社会主义道路自信、理论自信、制度自信、文化自信，立志听党话、跟党走，形成正确的世界观、人生观、价值观，具有重大意义。 课程充分体现“八个明确”“十四个坚持”“十三个方面伟大成就”的核心内容，系统阐述关于新时代坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的总目标、总任务、总体布局、战略布局和发展方向、发展方式、发展动力、战略步骤、外部条件、政治保证等基本观点，全面介绍习近平总书记对经济、政治、法治、科技、文化、教育、民生、民族、宗教、社会、生态文明、国家安全、国防和军队、“一国两制”和祖国统一、统一战线、外交、党的建设等方面作出的理论概括和战略指引。引导学生树立中国特色社会主义共同理想，深刻认识习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想是实现中华民族伟大复兴的行动指南。
default.en: Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for the New Era is the ideological banner of the CPC in the new era, the fundamental indicator of the country's political and social life, contemporary Chinese Marxism and Marxism in the 21st century, providing an action guide for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, and a smart plan for promoting the construction of a community with a shared future for mankind. “Introduction of Xi Jinping's Chinese Characteristic socialist ideology about the New Era” is a required course for ideological and political education in colleges and universities, and a key course for systematically explaining the system of ideological science, rigorous logic, and rich connotations. It is of great significance to guide young people to establish Marxist beliefs, strengthen confidence in the path, theory, system, and culture of socialism with Chinese characteristics, aspire to listen to and follow the Party, and form a correct world outlook, outlook on life, and values. The course fully embodies the core content of "Eight Clarifications," "Fourteen Perseverances," and "Thirteen Aspects of Great Achievements." It systematically elaborates on the general goals, tasks, overall layout, strategic layout, development direction, development methods, development momentum, strategic steps, external conditions, and political guarantees of adhering to and developing socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era,Comprehensively introduce the theoretical summary and strategic guidance on economy, politics, rule of law, science and technology, culture, education, people's livelihood, ethnic groups, religions, society, ecological civilization, national security, national defense and the military, "one country, two systems" and national reunification, united front, diplomacy, and party building.Guide students to establish the common ideal of socialism with Chinese characteristics and deeply understand the thought of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era is an action guide for achieving the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

default.zh: 本课程以中国化的马克思主义为主题，以马克思主义中国化为主线，以中国特色社会主义建设为重点，从理论与实践、历史与逻辑的统一上揭示马克思主义中国化的理论轨迹。课程充分展示了毛泽东思想和中国特色社会主义理论体系在中国革命、建设、改革和实现中华民族伟大复兴中的重要历史地位和作用。帮助学生系统掌握毛泽东思想和中国特色社会主义理论体系的基本原理，正确认识和分析中国特色社会主义建设过程中出现的各种问题，从而培养学生运用马克思主义基本原理分析和解决实际问题的能力，坚定在党的领导下走中国特色社会主义道路的理想信念，增强投身到我国社会主义现代化建设中的自觉性、主动性和创造性。
default.en: This course takes Marxism with Chinese characteristics as the theme and the main thread, with the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics as its focus. It introduces the theoretical development of Marxism with Chinese characteristics from the perspective of the unity of theory, history and logic. The course fully demonstrates the important historical role and the effect of Mao Zedong Thought and the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics in process of the Chinese revolution, construction, reform, and the realization of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, assists students in systematically mastering the basic principles of Mao Zedong Thought and the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, correctly understanding and analyzing various problems that arise in the process of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, thereby cultivating their ability to analyze and solve practical problems using the basic principles of Marxism, firmly adhering to the ideal belief of walking the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics under the leadership of CPC, and enhancing their consciousness, initiative, and creativity in participating in the construction of China’s socialist modernization.

default.zh: 课程聚焦贯通中西的思想认知搭建，精选两地哲学史上具有里程碑意义的经典文本片段，兼顾思想深度与知识广度。内容上以先秦诸子、宋明理学等中国哲学核心流派与古希腊哲学、近代认识论、现代存在主义等西方哲学主流脉络为核心，覆盖天人关系、心性修养、本体论、伦理学等关键议题，既呈现中国哲学聚焦人际与实践的智慧凝练，也彰显西方哲学侧重逻辑与体系的思辨特质。该选读适配哲学入门者夯实基础与非专业学习者拓宽视野的需求，旨在跳出单一文化视角，帮助读者直击中西方哲学的精神内核，明晰思想差异与共通性，培育批判性思维与跨文化认知能力，为人文素养提升与现实生活认知提供智慧借鉴。翻译成英文
default.en: This course aims to construct an integrated vision of Chinese and Western thoughts. It selects representative excerpts from pivotal works across both philosophical histories, striking a balance between ideological depth and intellectual breadth. Its content encompasses core Chinese philosophical schools (pre-Qin philosophers, Song-Ming Neo-Confucianism) and major Western philosophical traditions (ancient Greek philosophy, modern epistemology, modern existentialism), covering key topics including humanity-nature relations, moral self-cultivation, ontology and ethics. It embodies Chinese philosophy’s condensed wisdom rooted in human interactions and practice, while demonstrating Western philosophy’s speculative nature characterized by logic and systematicity. Catering to philosophy beginners and non-specialist learners alike, it helps transcend cultural one-sidedness, grasp the spiritual essence of Chinese and Western philosophy, distinguish their differences and commonalities, cultivate critical thinking and cross-cultural awareness, and provide intellectual guidance for improving humanistic quality and rational life cognition.

default.zh: 本课程专为对中国传统思想有探索热情的同学开设。授课过程中，会从先秦诸子的智慧开篇，带你领略儒家 “仁礼” 体系的构建、道家 “道法自然” 的深邃意境，还有墨家 “兼爱非攻” 的理想追求。顺着历史长河，深入剖析魏晋玄学的思辨魅力、宋明理学的哲理精微，直至近代哲学对传统的革新与突破。
default.en: This course is specially designed for students who have a passion for exploring traditional Chinese thought. During the lectures, we will start with the wisdom of the pre-Qin scholars, taking you to appreciate the construction of Confucianism's "benevolence and ritual" system, the profound artistic conception of Taoism's "following the way of nature", and the ideal pursuit of Mohism's "universal love and opposition to war". Following the long river of history, we will conduct in-depth analysis of the speculative charm of Wei-Jin metaphysics, the philosophical subtlety of Song-Ming Neo-Confucianism, and even the innovation and breakthrough of modern philosophy on tradition.

default.zh: 哲学通常被看作是一门极为深奥、枯燥和抽象的专门学问，看起来与其它学科和我们的日常生活都没什么关系，这是对哲学的误解。哲学家们的不懈努力恰恰是要理解我们是谁，我们是如何看待自己和生活的。哲学讨论的是人类永恒面对的话题：对知识的渴求、对美好生活的追寻、对正义的向往、对生活意义的探索等等，这些问题也是这门《哲学导论》课所要讨论的问题，我们将与历史上伟大的思想家们一道，尝试着通过哲学思考来理解我们自身、我们的时代以及我们在宇宙中的位置。 《哲学导论》是素质教育核心课程，授课内容包括以下几方面：哲学学科的基本性质及与其他知识体系的关系、哲学在人类精神生活中的位置和作用、哲学研究的主要问题和方法等等，注重培养学生的普遍理性、批判精神和独立思想。
default.en: Philosophy is usually regarded as a very profound, boring and abstract special science, and it seems to have nothing to do with other subjects and our daily life. It is a misunderstanding of philosophy. The philosophers' unremitting efforts are precisely to understand who we are and how we view ourselves and our lives. The discussion of philosophy is about the human eternal topic: the desire for knowledge and the pursuit of a better life, for justice, the meaning of life to explore the main problems and so on. These problems will be discussed in "Introduction to Philosophy" course. We will work with the great philosophers to try through philosophical thinking to understand ourselves, our era and our location in the universe. "Introduction to Philosophy" mainly discusses the following problems: the basic nature of philosophy and the relation between philosophy and other knowledge, the position and role of philosophy in human spiritual life, problems and methods and so on. It put emphasis on students’ universal reason, critical spirit and independent thinking.

default.zh: 本课程将向同学们讲授古希腊罗马哲学、中世纪基督教哲学、16-18世纪西欧哲学、18世纪法国哲学、德国古典哲学等重要内容，逐渐培养同学们的哲学思维方式和独立批判精神。使同学们对西方哲学的一些主要范畴、重要哲学家和哲学流派及其内在逻辑联系有初步了解，并能从中把握西方哲学思想发展的基本脉络和趋势，从而以历史与逻辑相统一的方法对西方哲学进行总体性和辩证性的把握，以便从哲学史的视角来真正理解哲学。
default.en: This course will introduce students to ancient Greek and Roman philosophy, medieval Christian philosophy, 16th-18th century Western European philosophy, 18th century French philosophy, German classical philosophy, etc., and gradually cultivate students' philosophical thinking and independent critical spirit. This course enables students to have a preliminary understanding of some major categories, important philosophers and philosophical schools of Western philosophy and their internal logical connections, and to grasp the basic context and trend of the development of Western philosophical thought, so as to grasp Western philosophy in an overall and dialectical way with the unity of history and logic, so as to truly understand philosophy from the perspective of the history of philosophy.

default.zh: 《马克思主义哲学原理》课程是全校辅修专业的核心课程之一。本课程将向同学们讲授主要研究马克思主义哲学的创立、伟大变革及其思想贡献，唯物论、辩证法、认识论和历史观等基本原理及其主要内容，理解马克思主义哲学理论的当代意义与价值。培养同学们的哲学思维能力，确立马克思主义的世界观、人生观和价值观，学会运用马克思主义哲学的世界观和方法论分析问题和解决问题。
default.en: The course "Principles of Marxist Philosophy" is one of the core courses for minors throughout the university. This course will introduce students to the establishment, great transformation and ideological contributions of Marxist philosophy, as well as its fundamental principles and main contents such as materialism, dialectics, epistemology and historical outlook. It aims to help students understand the contemporary significance and value of Marxist philosophy theory, cultivate their philosophical thinking ability, establish a Marxist worldview, outlook on life and values, and learn to apply the worldview and methodology of Marxist philosophy to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 马克思主义发展史是一门研究马克思主义产生、发展的历史过程及其规律的科学，是思想政治教育专业本科学生的必修课程。内容主要有：马克思主义的创立、马克思主义政治经济学的形成、马克思主义体系的丰富与发展、列宁主义对马克思主义的新发展、马列主义在苏联的发展及挫折、西方马克思主义理论的形成和发展、马克思主义中国化的历程及其最新发展等。
default.en: Development History of Marxism is a compulsory course designed for Students majoring in ideological and political education, and it is a science that studies the historical process and laws of the emergence and development of Marxism. The contents mainly include: the establishment of Marxism, the formation of Marxist political economy, the enrichment and development of Marxist system, the new development of Marxism by Leninism, the development and frustration of Marxism-Leninism in the Soviet Union, the formation and development of western Marxist theory, the course and latest development of Marxism in China, etc.

default.zh: 马克思主义发展史是一门研究马克思主义产生、发展的历史过程及其规律的科学，是马克思主义理论专业本科学生的必修课程。内容主要有：马克思主义的创立、马克思主义政治经济学的形成、马克思主义体系的丰富与发展、列宁主义对马克思主义的新发展、马列主义在苏联的发展及挫折、西方马克思主义理论的形成和发展、马克思主义中国化的历程及其最新发展等。
default.en: Development History of Marxism is a compulsory course designed for Students majoring in Marxist Theory, and it is a science that studies the historical process and laws of the emergence and development of Marxism. The contents mainly include: the establishment of Marxism, the formation of Marxist political economy, the enrichment and development of Marxist system, the new development of Marxism by Leninism, the development and frustration of Marxism-Leninism in the Soviet Union, the formation and development of western Marxist theory, the course and latest development of Marxism in China, etc.

default.zh: 《毛泽东思想》为马克思主义理论本科专业的必修课程。通过修习此课程，学生需深入领会毛泽东思想的科学体系，掌握其基本内容与活的灵魂。该课程着重以中国革命与建设的实际问题为核心，注重马克思主义理论的应用，培育学生针对实际问题开展理论思考的能力，并关注新的实践与发展。经由系统学习，学生将为理解新时代党的创新理论筑牢根基，同时更为深刻地认识习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想对中华民族伟大复兴的重要指导价值。课程亦注重培养学生运用马克思主义的立场、观点和方法剖析历史与现实问题的能力，提升理论联系实际的思辨水准，深化对中国共产党指导思想的认知，增强政治认同，树立正确的历史观与价值观。
default.en: Introduction to Mao Zedong Thought is a compulsory course for the undergraduate major in Marxist theory. Through this course, students are required to deeply understand scientific system of Mao Zedong Thought, master its basic content and live soul. The course focuses on the practical problems of Chinese revolution and construction, pays attention to the application Marxist theory, cultivates students' ability to carry out theoretical thinking on practical problems, and pays attention to new practice and development. Through systematic learning, students will lay a foundation for understanding the Party's innovative theory in the new era, and at the same time, they will have a deeper understanding of the important guiding value of Xi Jinping Thought Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. The course also focuses on cultivating students' ability to analyze historical and realistic problems Marxist standpoints, viewpoints and methods, improving the level of theoretical thinking in connection with reality, deepening the understanding of the guiding ideology of the Communist Party of China, enhancing identity, and establishing correct historical views and values.

default.zh: 本课程以中国特色社会主义理论为学习对象，从理论与实践、历史与逻辑的统一上揭示马克思主义中国化的理论轨迹。课程充分展示了中国特色社会主义理论在中国建设、改革和实现中华民族伟大复兴中的重要历史地位和作用。帮助大学生系统掌握中国特色社会主义理论的形成发展、主要内容和精神实质，深刻认识以中国特色社会主义理论体系为指导对实现中华民族复兴的重要性，不断增强道路自信、理论自信、制度自信和文化自信，坚定中国特色社会主义理想信念，能够正确认识和分析中国特色社会主义建设过程中出现的各种问题，从而培养学生运用马克思主义基本原理分析和解决实际问题的能力，坚定在党的领导下走中国特色社会主义道路的理想信念，增强投身到我国社会主义现代化建设中的自觉性、主动性和创造性。
default.en: This course focuses on the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics as its object of study, revealing the theoretical trajectory of the sinicization of Marxism from the unity of theory and practice, as well as history and logic. The course fully demonstrates the important historical position and role of the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the construction, reform, and realization of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. It helps university students systematically grasp the formation and development of the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics, its main contents, and its spiritual essence, profoundly recognizing the importance of guiding the realization of national rejuvenation with the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, continuously enhancing confidence in the path, theory, system, and culture, and firmly establishing the ideal beliefs of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Students will be able to correctly recognize and analyze various issues that arise during the construction of socialism with Chinese characteristics, thereby cultivating their ability to use the basic principles of Marxism to analyze and solve practical problems, and reinforce their ideal beliefs in following the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics under the leadership of the Party, increasing their consciousness, initiative, and creativity in contributing to the modernization of our country.

default.zh: “马克思主义伦理学”，是马克思主义关于道德及其发展规律的学说。它是以辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义为指导，全面、系统地研究人类社会的道德现象和道德关系，揭示道德的本质、发展规律和价值标准的理论科学。是马克思主义理论体系的一个组成部分。通过教学，要使学生系统地掌握马克思主义道德科学的基本理论、基本知识和基本观点，了解道德的起源、本质、作用和历史演变发展的规律，明确社会主义道德的基本原则和规范，树立正确的道德观念和科学的人生观，自觉地加强道德修养，提高思想道德境界。 通过学习马克思主义伦理学，要达到以下课程目标： 1．知识方面：学习和掌握马克思主义关于道德的本质、功能与基本范畴的理论主张，熟悉伦理学的历史演变轨迹，理解各伦理学理论的理论进路、基本观点和理论困境，深刻领会马克思主义伦理思想和社会主义道德原则，为道德教育和道德建设等实践活动的开展奠定扎实的理论基础。 2．能力方面：通过增进学生对伦理学历史和理论的了解，认识道德的本质与结构以及道德在人类社会生活中的地位与作用，掌握道德原则界定的依据和社会主义道德原则的架构，并能够自觉运用伦理学理论分析当前社会道德状况与道德现象，把握道德建设的基本规律。 3．素养方面：能够把所学的伦理学理论知识应用到今后的教育教学工作中，树立正确的道德观，提高自身道德素质，增强从事道德评价和道德教育的能力。同时，提高大学生的道德素质，实现个体道德完善。
default.en: Marxist ethics "is a Marxist theory about morality and its development laws. It is a theoretical science guided by dialectical materialism and historical materialism, comprehensively and systematically studying the moral phenomena and relationships in human society, revealing the essence, development laws, and value standards of morality. It is an integral part of the Marxist theoretical system. Through teaching, students should systematically grasp the basic theories, knowledge, and viewpoints of Marxist moral science, understand the origin, essence, role, and historical evolution and development of morality, clarify the basic principles and norms of socialist morality, establish correct moral concepts and scientific outlook on life, consciously strengthen moral cultivation, and improve ideological and moral realm. By studying Marxist ethics, the following course objectives must be achieved: 1. Knowledge aspect: Learn and master Marxist theoretical propositions on the essence, function, and basic categories of morality, be familiar with the historical evolution trajectory of ethics, understand the theoretical approaches, basic viewpoints, and theoretical difficulties of various ethical theories, deeply understand Marxist ethical thoughts and socialist moral principles, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for the development of practical activities such as moral education and moral construction. 2. In terms of ability: By enhancing students' understanding of the history and theory of ethics, understanding the essence and structure of morality, as well as the status and role of morality in human social life, mastering the basis for defining moral principles and the framework of socialist moral principles, and being able to consciously apply ethical theory to analyze the current social moral situation and phenomena, and grasp the basic laws of moral construction. 3. In terms of literacy: Able to apply the theoretical knowledge of ethics learned to future education and teaching work, establish correct moral values, improve one's own moral quality, and enhance the ability to engage in moral evaluation and moral education. At the same time, improve the moral quality of college students and achieve individual moral improvement.

default.zh: “马克思主义伦理学”，是马克思主义关于道德及其发展规律的学说。它是以辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义为指导，全面、系统地研究人类社会的道德现象和道德关系，揭示道德的本质、发展规律和价值标准的理论科学。是马克思主义理论体系的一个组成部分。通过教学，要使学生系统地掌握马克思主义道德科学的基本理论、基本知识和基本观点，了解道德的起源、本质、作用和历史演变发展的规律，明确社会主义道德的基本原则和规范，树立正确的道德观念和科学的人生观，自觉地加强道德修养，提高思想道德境界。
default.en: "Marxist Ethics" is a doctrine of Marxism concerning morality and the laws governing its development. Guided by dialectical materialism and historical materialism, it is a theoretical science that comprehensively and systematically studies moral phenomena and relationships in human society, revealing the essence, developmental laws, and value standards of morality. It constitutes a component of the Marxist theoretical system. Through teaching, students should systematically grasp the fundamental theories, knowledge, and perspectives of Marxist moral science, understand the origins, essence, functions, and historical evolution of morality, clarify the basic principles and norms of socialist morality, establish correct moral concepts and a scientific outlook on life, consciously enhance moral cultivation, and elevate their ideological and ethical standards.

default.zh: 《思想政治教育学原理》是思想政治教育专业的一门主干课程，是思想政治教育学科的基础理论课，在学科体系中据于中心地位，是思想政治教育专业学生的专业必修课和学位课程。通过本课程教学，使学生系统掌握思想政治教育基本理论，充分认识思想政治教育的地位和作用，全面把握思想政治教育的规律，并初步掌握思想政治教育的方法和技能。为学生从事思想政治教育的研究与实践提供理论依据、分析工具和方法论基础。 本课程在教学上以基本原理为主线，要求学生了解学科特点、发展历史及研究现状，掌握基本概念，能够理论联系实际地对学科深层次问题进行系统的思考，提高政治思想觉悟和专业意识，为进一步开展思想政治教育的学术研究和实践工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: The Principles of Ideological and Political Education is a core course in the field of ideological and political education, and a fundamental theoretical course in the discipline. It holds a central position in the disciplinary system and is a compulsory course and degree course for students majoring in ideological and political education. Through the teaching of this course, students will systematically master the basic theories of ideological and political education, fully understand the status and role of ideological and political education, comprehensively grasp the laws of ideological and political education, and preliminarily master the methods and skills of ideological and political education. Provide theoretical basis, analytical tools, and methodological foundation for students to engage in research and practice of ideological and political education. This course focuses on basic principles in teaching, requiring students to understand the characteristics, development history, and research status of the subject, master basic concepts, and be able to systematically think about deep-seated problems in the subject in a theoretical and practical manner, improve political and professional awareness, and lay a solid foundation for further academic research and practical work in ideological and political education.

default.zh: 《思想政治教育学原理》是思想政治教育专业的一门主干课程，是思想政治教育学科的基础理论课，在学科体系中据于中心地位，是思想政治教育专业学生的专业必修课和学位课程。通过本课程教学，使学生系统掌握思想政治教育基本理论，充分认识思想政治教育的地位和作用，全面把握思想政治教育的规律，并初步掌握思想政治教育的方法和技能。为学生从事思想政治教育的研究与实践提供理论依据、分析工具和方法论基础。

default.zh: 课程中文简介： “比较思想政治教育”按照思想政治教育比较研究的本体论、方法论、理论基础和借鉴、典型国家思想政治教育理论与实践、中外思想政治教育综合比较、中国思想政治教育在比较视野中的创新次第展开。通过比较，既勾勒出思想政治教育这一实践活动的传统与现代、中国与西方、本土与外来的时空图景，为思想政治教育在新时代中国特色社会主义建设进程中的创新发展提供方位和方向，又呈现出中国思想政治教育的理论、制度、文化和价值维度，为世界思想政治教育实践贡献中国智慧和中国方案。
default.en: "Comparative Ideological and Political Education"is carried out in accordance with the ontology, methodology, theoretical basis and reference of comparative research on ideological and political education, the theory and practice of ideological and political education in typical countries, the comprehensive comparison of ideological and political education between China and foreign countries, and the innovation of Chinese ideological and political education in the comparative perspective. Through comparison, it not only outlines the traditional and modern, China and the West, and local and foreign spatiotemporal landscapes of ideological and political education as a practical activity, providing direction for the innovative development of ideological and political education in the process of building socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era, but also presents the theoretical, institutional, cultural, and value dimensions of Chinese ideological and political education, contributing Chinese wisdom and solutions to the practice of global ideological and political education.

default.zh: 课程中文简介： “比较思想政治教育”按照思想政治教育比较研究的本体论、方法论、理论基础和借鉴、典型国家思想政治教育理论与实践、中外思想政治教育综合比较、中国思想政治教育在比较视野中的创新次第展开。通过比较，既勾勒出思想政治教育这一实践活动的传统与现代、中国与西方、本土与外来的时空图景，为思想政治教育在新时代中国特色社会主义建设进程中的创新发展提供方位和方向，又呈现出中国思想政治教育的理论、制度、文化和价值维度，为世界思想政治教育实践贡献中国智慧和中国方案。

default.zh: 思想政治教育方法论是以马克思主义、毛泽东思想、中国特色社会主义理论为指导，以思想政治教育理论为基础，吸收了现代自然自然科学和社会科学方法论的一门思想政治教育基础理论课程。依照世界观与方法论相统一的原则，阐释了思想政治教育方法论的基本概念、研究对象、理论基础、功能特点、历史发展及继承改革；采用系统论方法建构了以思想政治教育的认识方法、工作方法等为主体的方法论体系；探索总结了许多适应新时期需要的新方法；借鉴了中国古代一些行之有效的传统方法和相关学科知识，也借鉴了西方思想政治教育的有益经验。本课程具有科学性与思想性、时代性与民族性、理论性与应用性相统一的特点。
default.en: The methodology of ideological and political education is guided by Marxism, Mao Zedong Thought, and the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics, based on the theory of ideological and political education, and absorbs the methodology of modern natural sciences and social sciences.According to the principle of the unity of world view and methodology, the basic concepts, research objects, theoretical basis, functional characteristics, historical development and inheritance reform of ideological and political education methodology are explained. The system theory method is used to construct a methodological system with the cognitive methods and working methods of ideological and political education as the main body. Explore and summarize many new methods to meet the needs of the new era; It draws on some effective traditional methods and related subject knowledge in ancient China, as well as the beneficial experience of Western ideological and political education.This course has the characteristics of scientific and ideological, contemporary and national, theoretical and applied.

The system theory method is used to construct a methodological system with the cognitive methods and working methods of ideological and political education as the main body. Explore and summarize many new methods to meet the needs of the new era; It draws on some effective traditional methods and related subject knowledge in ancient China, as well as the beneficial experience of Western ideological and political education.This course has the characteristics of scientific and ideological, contemporary and national, theoretical and applied.

default.zh: 思想政治教育是中国共产党的政治优势和优良传统，在我国革命、建设和改革事业中发挥了“生命线”作用，为党的组织建设、作风建设、反腐倡廉建设、制度建设提供了重要支撑。中国共产党思想政治教育史是一门研究党的思想政治教育发生、发展的历史及其规律的学科。学生应从两个角度把握其学科性质：第一，中国共产党思想政治教育史既是中共党史的分支，又是思想政治教育的分支；第二，中国共产党思想政治教育史既属于历史学范畴，又属于马克思主义理论学科。 学习中国共产党思想政治教育史，有助于学生掌握党的思想政治教育的地位作用、目标任务、方针原则、发展变化规律，加深对思想政治教育工作“生命线”地位的理解；使学生掌握思想政治教育的基本概念、范畴、理论体系，掌握该课程的基本理论和精髓，提升理论水平，打牢理论根基，培养学生的专业归属感和专业素养； 有助于学生形成正确的历史观，形成历史地分析问题和解决问题的能力；有助于引导学生掌握中国共产党思想政治教育的历史经验和优良传统，提升运用历史经验，服务现实需要的能力，培养理论联系实际，在实际工作中增长才干的素质。
default.en: Ideological and political education is the political advantage and fine tradition of the CPC. It has played a "lifeline" role in China's revolution, construction and reform, and has provided important support for the Party's organizational construction, style construction, anti-corruption construction, and system construction. The history of ideological and political education of the CPC is a subject that studies the history and laws of the occurrence and development of the party's ideological and political education. Students should grasp the nature of the discipline from two perspectives: first, the history of ideological and political education of the CPC is a branch of both the history of the Communist Party of China and the ideological and political education; Second, the history of ideological and political education of the CPC belongs to both the historical category and the Marxist theoretical discipline. Studying the history of ideological and political education of the CPC will help students master the role, objectives, principles, development and change laws of the party's ideological and political education, and deepen their understanding of the "lifeline" status of ideological and political education; Enable students to master the basic concepts, categories, and theoretical system of ideological and political education, master the basic theories and essence of the course, improve their theoretical level, lay a solid theoretical foundation, and cultivate their sense of professional belonging and professional competence; Helping students form a correct view of history and develop the ability to analyze and solve problems historically; It is helpful to guide students to master the historical experience and fine tradition of the ideological and political education of the CPC, improve the ability to use historical experience to serve the needs of reality, and cultivate the quality of integrating theory with practice and increasing talent in practical work.

default.zh: 本课程以马克思主义唯物史观为指导，主要讲授从春秋战国到明末清初各主要流派思想家的德育思想。主要包括德育思想的形成背景、主要内容和当代价值等方面的知识。以广义“德育”的概念为标尺，对中国古代不同历史时期、不同学派、不同思想家的德育思想，进行深入的发掘、总结，从而系统地阐明了中国古代德育思想发生、发展的历史轨迹。中华民族有着上下五千年的优秀文化传统，其德育思想，源远流长，博大精深，在世界文化史上享有独特的地位。系统阐明中国古代德育思想发生、发展的历史，必将有助于总结我们的祖先在德育领域的智慧之思与理论创造。分别对古代思想家关于德育宗旨和德育目标的构想，关于德育理论和基本内容的设计，关于德育原则、方法、途径的种种思考，作了系统而深刻的理论阐发。这对于全面认识中国古代德育学说，对于有效探索和把握具有中国特色的德育活动规律，对于丰富社会主义德育理论和推进当代的德育实践，都有借鉴意义。
default.en: This course is guided by the Marxist materialist view of history and mainly teaches the moral education thoughts of various major schools of thinkers from the Spring and Autumn period and the Warring States period to the late Ming and early Qing dynasties. This mainly includes knowledge about the background, main content, and contemporary values of the formation of moral education ideas. Using the broad concept of "moral education" as a benchmark, this paper deeply explores and summarizes the moral education ideas of different historical periods, schools, and thinkers in ancient China, and systematically elucidates the historical trajectory of the occurrence and development of ancient Chinese moral education ideas. The Chinese nation has an excellent cultural tradition of five thousand years, and its moral education ideas have a long and profound history, enjoying a unique position in world cultural history. Systematically elucidating the history of the emergence and development of ancient Chinese moral education ideas will undoubtedly help summarize the wisdom and theoretical creations of our ancestors in the field of moral education. A systematic and profound theoretical exposition was made on the ideas of ancient thinkers about the purpose and objectives of moral education, the design of moral education theory and basic content, and various reflections on moral education principles, methods, and approaches. This has reference significance for a comprehensive understanding of ancient Chinese moral education theories, for effectively exploring and grasping the laws of moral education activities with Chinese characteristics, for enriching socialist moral education theories and promoting contemporary moral education practices.

default.zh: 随着信息革命的到来和信息时代的不断发展，网络生态的发展成为影响社会稳定的导火索，网络舆论工作日益成为我们宣传思想工作的重中之重。针对新场域、新问题，高校网络思想政治教育课程，着力围绕网络环境下开展思想政治教育的理论与方法进行 研究。学生能够运用网络思想政治教育的基本原理和方法分析思想政治教育领域的问题与现象，帮助学生掌握网络思想政治教育的学科研究方法和网络思想政治教育的工作方法，提升新时代思想政治工作者的网络应用、网络管理、网络建设和网络治理的意识和能力。
default.en: With the arrival of the information revolution and the continuous development of the information age, the development of network ecology has become the fuse affecting social stability. Network public opinion has increasingly become the top priority of our propaganda and ideological work. Aiming at the new fields and problems, the network ideological and political education curriculum in Colleges and universities focuses on the theory and methods of Ideological and Political Education under the network environment. Students can use the basic principles and methods of network ideological and political education to analyze problems and phenomena in the field of Ideological and political education. Help students master the subject research methods of network ideological and political education and the working methods of network ideological and political education. Enhance the awareness and ability of Ideological and political workers in the new era in network application, network management, network construction and network governance.

default.zh: 企业文化，或称组织文化，是一个组织由其价值观、信念、仪式、符号、处事方式等组成的其特有的文化形象。企业思想政治工作，是指企业管理人员，针对员工在思想上的各种矛盾、疑惑，通过宣传科学、正确的道理，解决员工的思想问题，帮助员工树立正确的世界观、人生观、价值观，使员工以积极的姿态投入工作和生活，促进企业全面发展的一种教育疏导工作。思想政治工作是做好经济工作和其他工作的有力保证，在改革开放和发展社会主义市场经济的新形势下，思想政治工作必须适应新的形势和任务，找准位置，探索有效途径，以适应新形势的发展。思想政治工作是一项博大精深的系统工程，没有一成不变的固定模式，在新形势下，企业的思想政治工作者要根据社会发展的新情况，不断研究探索和创新思想政治工作的观念、内容和方法，推动企业向前发展。 本门课程为学生讲解在企业中思想政治工作是搞好企业治理的有机组成部分，为企业生产经营活动提供精神动力和思想保证。那么做好新时期企业思想政治工作，以增强企业的凝聚力和向心力，促进企业按照市场经济规则健康运作和发展就显得更为重要。
default.en: Corporate culture, or organizational culture, is an organization's unique cultural image composed of its values, beliefs, rituals, symbols, and ways of doing things. Enterprise ideological and political work refers to the management personnel of enterprises, aiming at various contradictions and doubts in employees' thinking, by propagating scientific and correct principles, solving employees' ideological problems, and helping employees establish a correct world outlook, outlook on life, and values, so that It is a kind of education and guidance work that employees devote to work and life with a positive attitude and promote the all-round development of the enterprise. Ideological and political work is a powerful guarantee for doing economic work and other work well. Under the new situation of reform and opening up and the development of the socialist market economy, ideological and political work must adapt to the new situation and tasks, identify the position, and explore effective ways to adapt to the new situation. development of new situations. Ideological and political work is a broad and profound systematic project, and there is no immutable fixed pattern. Under the new situation, the ideological and political workers of enterprises should constantly research, explore and innovate the concepts, contents and methods of ideological and political work according to the new situation of social development. , to drive the enterprise forward. This course explains to students that ideological and political work in an enterprise is an integral part of doing a good job in corporate governance, and provides spiritual motivation and ideological guarantee for the production and operation of enterprises. Then it is more important to do a good job in the ideological and political work of enterprises in the new era to enhance the cohesion and centripetal force of enterprises, and to promote the healthy operation and development of enterprises in accordance with the rules of the market economy.

default.zh: “思想政治教育前沿问题专题”是思想政治教育专业本科生的专业必修课。本课程探讨的内容主要包括：思想政治教育的基础理论的创新发展；思想政治教育研究的最新方法探讨；以及国家和社会发展中所遇到的重大理论和实践问题对思想政治教育的挑战以及思想政治教育的创新实践。 通过本课学习，使学生了解思想政治教育专业领域理论前沿问题，引导学生敏锐地捕捉理论前沿问题和重大的经济社会政治问题，能够运用马克思主义的世界观和方法论研究这些问题，并能合乎理论逻辑地寻找答案。 本课程秉持理论联系实际，高度关注社会现实的以问题为导向的研究态度，运用马克思主义的世界观和方法论来批判性地探讨和分析现实经济、社会发展中出现的重大问题，培养学生的批判性思维和严谨认真唯实的科研精神。 通过本课程的教学，提高学生对思想政治教育学科及其相关前沿问题的认识、理解和全面把握的能力，为下一步确定毕业论文选题和进行论文撰写奠定基础。
default.en: "Subjects on Frontier Issues in Ideological and Political Education" is a compulsory course for undergraduate students majoring in ideological and political education. The content discussed in this course mainly includes: the innovative development of the basic theories of ideological and political education; Exploring the latest methods of ideological and political education research; And the challenges faced by major theoretical and practical issues in the development of the country and society to ideological and political education, as well as the innovative practice of ideological and political education. Through this lesson, students will be able to understand the cutting-edge theoretical issues in the field of ideological and political education, guide them to keenly grasp the cutting-edge theoretical issues and major economic, social, and political issues, apply Marxist worldview and methodology to study these issues, and be able to find answers in accordance with theoretical logic. This course adheres to the principle of integrating theory with practice, with a problem oriented research attitude that highly focuses on social reality. It uses the Marxist worldview and methodology to critically explore and analyze major issues that arise in the development of the real economy and society, cultivating students' critical thinking and rigorous, serious, and realistic scientific research spirit. Through the teaching of this course, students will enhance their understanding, comprehension, and comprehensive grasp of the discipline of ideological and political education and its related cutting-edge issues, laying the foundation for determining the topic of their graduation thesis and writing the thesis in the next step.

default.zh: 《马克思恩格斯列宁哲学经典著作导读》是马克思主义理论研究和建设工程重点教材，教材精选了马克思、恩格斯、列宁等具有代表性的哲学著作，这些著作都是马克思主义哲学的代表著作，内涵丰富、思想深邃、逻辑严密。本课程引导学生从文本的角度了解马克思主义经典著作，掌握这些著作的特点及它们之间的内在联系，理解马克思主义理论。本课程使学生在文本解读的基础上更加深刻地把握马克思主义的思维方式、价值理想和基本精神，坚定学生对于马克思主义的信仰，使学生能够运用马克思主义的基本观点和方法分析和解答现实的和思想的问题，提高马克思主义理论专业学生的马克思主义理论素养和专业研究水平。本课程共计32学时，其中理论学时为32学时，分为14个专题。通过教学，使学生比较系统地了解马克思主义经典作家及其继承者的基本思想，全面把握马克思主义理论体系，进一步深化对辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义的理解和把握，培养学生学习马克思主义理论著作的基本方法，掌握学习古今中外思想家著作的技巧，并能站在新时代的高度，理论联系实际，科学地运用马克思主义的立场、观点和方法，分析问题和解决问题，能够有效鉴别与理性汲取中西方的哲学思想，培养和提高学生的理论思维、创新思维和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Introduction to the Classic Works of Marx and Engels-Lenin Philosophy is a key textbook for Marxist theoretical research and construction engineering. The textbook selects representative philosophical works such as Marx, Engels and Lenin. These works are representative works of Marxist philosophy, with rich connotations, profound ideas and rigorous logic.This course guides students to understand Marxist classics from the perspective of text, grasp the characteristics of these works and the intrinsic connection between them, and understand Marxist theory. This course enables students to grasp the Marxist way of thinking, value ideals and basic spirit on the basis of text interpretation, strengthen students' belief in Marxism, and enable students to use the basic views and methods of Marxism to analyze and answer the problems of reality and ideology, and improve Marxism. Marxist theoretical literacy and professional research level of theoretical students. This course has a total of 32 hours, of which the theoretical hours are 32 hours, which are divided into 14 topics. Through teaching, students can more systematically understand the basic ideas of Marxist classic writers and their successors, comprehensively grasp the Marxist theoretical system, further deepen the understanding and grasp of dialectical materialism and historical materialism, cultivate students' basic methods of learning Marxist theoretical works, and master learning The skills of the works of ancient and modern Chinese and foreign thinkers, and be able to stand at the height of the new era, connect theory with practice, scientifically apply Marxist positions, views and methods, analyze and solve problems, effectively identify and rationally draw on Chinese and Western philosophical ideas, and cultivate and improve students' theoretical thinking, innovative thinking and reconciliation. The ability to solve problems.
