The textbook selects representative philosophical works such as Marx, Engels and Lenin. These works are representative works of Marxist philosophy, with rich connotations, profound ideas and rigorous logic.This course guides students to understand Marxist classics from the perspective of text, grasp the characteristics of these works and the intrinsic connection between them, and understand Marxist theory. This course enables students to grasp the Marxist way of thinking, value ideals and basic spirit on the basis of text interpretation, strengthen students' belief in Marxism, and enable students to use the basic views and methods of Marxism to analyze and answer the problems of reality and ideology, and improve Marxism. Marxist theoretical literacy and professional research level of theoretical students. This course has a total of 32 hours, of which the theoretical hours are 32 hours, which are divided into 14 topics. Through teaching, students can more systematically understand the basic ideas of Marxist classic writers and their successors, comprehensively grasp the Marxist theoretical system, further deepen the understanding and grasp of dialectical materialism and historical materialism, cultivate students' basic methods of learning Marxist theoretical works, and master learning The skills of the works of ancient and modern Chinese and foreign thinkers, and be able to stand at the height of the new era, connect theory with practice, scientifically apply Marxist positions, views and methods, analyze and solve problems, effectively identify and rationally draw on Chinese and Western philosophical ideas, and cultivate and improve students' theoretical thinking, innovative thinking and reconciliation. The ability to solve problems.

default.zh: 本课程旨在介绍马克思主义经典著作的主要思想，既有对马克思恩格斯经典著作的介绍，也有对马克思主义后继者经典著作的阐释，以期以一种更广阔的视角看待马克思主义理论，让学生能够对马克思主义理论体系有一种全方位的认识，对马克思主义的创立、发展有更深入的了解。课程旨在引导学生深入理解马克思主义理论的精髓，并通过系统学习和实践应用，培养学生的批判性思维和社会责任感。
default.en: This course aims to introduce the main ideas of classic works of Marxism, including the introduction of the classic works of Marx and Engels, as well as the interpretation of the classic works of Marxist successors, in order to view Marxist theory from a broader perspective and enable students to have a comprehensive understanding of the Marxist theoretical system, and to have a deeper understanding of the establishment and development of Marxism. The course aims to guide students to deeply understand the essence of Marxist theory and cultivate their critical thinking and sense of social responsibility through systematic learning and practical application.

default.zh: 本课程的讲述涉及中华人民共和国的重大历史事件基本史实、基础理论，使学生较好地掌握新中国成立以来的历史史实，做到理论联系实际，运用所学的知识达到分析历史和现实问题的要求，从而提高学生的基本素质、基本技能。
default.en: This course covers the basic facts and fundamental theories of major historical events in the People's Republic of China, enabling students to have a good grasp of the historical facts since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It aims to connect theory with practice and apply the learned knowledge to analyze historical and current issues, thereby enhancing students' basic qualities and skills.

default.zh: 本课程的讲述涉及中华人民共和国的重大历史事件基本史实、基础理论，使学生较好地掌握新中国成立以来的历史史实，做到理论联系实际，运用所学的知识达到分析历史和现实问题的要求，从而提高学生的基本素质、基本技能。
default.en: This course covers the basic facts and fundamental theories of major historical events in the People's Republic of China, enabling students to have a good grasp of the historical facts since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It aims to connect theory with practice and apply the learned knowledge to analyze historical and current issues, thereby enhancing students' basic qualities and skills.

default.zh: 本课程主要通过精讲和分析毛泽东同志在各个不同时期的代表作及重要文献的写作背景、基本内容、基本精神和现实意义，增进对毛泽东思想及其发展过程的了解，明确马列主义、毛泽东思想和中国特色社会主义理论体系是一脉相承的思想体系，及它们各自在思想上的独创性发展，是指导中国进行革命、建设的重要指导理论。培养学生学会运用马克思主义的立场观点方法分析问题和解决问题，正确认识和把握我国社会发展规律、党的建设规律和人类社会发展规律，树立建设中国特色社会主义的信念和共产主义的远大理想，为自觉贯彻、执行党的路线、方针、政策奠定理论基础。
default.en: This course mainly aims to enhance understanding of Mao Zedong Thought and the developmental process by providing in-depth lectures and analyses of the writing background, basic content, fundamental spirit, and practical significance Mao Zedong's representative works and important documents from various periods. It clarifies that Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics are a coherent body of thought, each having its unique contributions to ideological development, which serve as important guiding theories for China's revolution and construction. The course will cultivate students' ability to apply Marxist positions, viewpoints, and methods to analyze and resolve problems, correctly understand and grasp the laws of social development in our country, the rules of party building, and the laws of human social development, instilling a belief in building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the grand ideal of communism, laying a theoretical foundation for consciously implementing and executing the party's lines, principles, and policies.

default.zh: 本课程主要通过精讲和分析中国化马克思主义基本著作和重要文献，包括邓小平、江泽民、胡锦涛、习近平等同志在各个不同时期的代表作及重要文献的写作背景、基本内容、基本精神和现实意义，梳理中国化马克思主义理论及其发展历史进程, 明确马列主义、毛泽东思想和中国特色社会主义理论体系是一脉相承的思想体系，及它们各自在思想上的独创性发展，是指导中国进行革命、建设和改革开放的重要指导理论。培养学生学会运用马克思主义的立场观点方法分析问题和解决问题，正确认识和把握我国社会发展规律、党的建设规律和人类社会发展规律，树立建设中国特色社会主义的信念和共产主义的远大理想，为自觉贯彻、执行党的路线、方针、政策奠定理论基础。
default.en: This course primarily involves detailed discussions and analyses of the fundamental works and important documents of sinicized Marxism, including representative works and important literature from Deng Xiaoping, Jiang Zemin, Hu Jintao, and Xi Jinping from various periods, focusing on the writing backgrounds, main content, fundamental spirit, and practical significance. It aims to clarify the theoretical framework of sinicized Marxism and its historical development, emphasizing that Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, and the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics are all part of a unified ideological system, highlighting their unique developments in thought, which serve as important guiding theories for China's revolution, construction, and reform and opening up. The course also aims to cultivate students' ability to apply the standpoint, viewpoint, and methodology of Marxism to analyze and solve problems, correctly understanding and grasping the laws of social development in our country, the laws of party building, and the laws of human social development, instilling a belief in building socialism with Chinese characteristics and the lofty ideal of communism, thereby laying a theoretical foundation for consciously implementing and executing the party's guidelines, principles, and policies.

default.zh: 本课程旨在为非哲学专业的学生提供一个深入了解哲学与社会相互关系的平台。通过课程学习，帮助学生掌握哲学的基本思维方法和理论框架，同时引导学生运用哲学视角分析各种社会现象和问题，提升学生的批判性思维能力、理论分析能力以及对社会现实的洞察力，培养具有跨学科视野和综合素养的复合型人才。
default.en: This course aims to provide a platform for non-philosophy students to deeply understand the interrelationship between philosophy and society. Through the study of this course, it helps students master the basic thinking methods and theoretical frameworks of philosophy, while guiding them to use a philosophical perspective to analyze various social phenomena and problems. It aims to enhance students' critical thinking skills, theoretical analysis abilities, and insight into social reality, and cultivate interdisciplinary and comprehensive talents with integrated literacy.

default.zh: 人生哲学课程是一门以哲学视角探究生命本质、意义与价值的核心课程，旨在引导学生通过系统性的理论学习与深刻的自我反思，理解人生的基本问题，探索适合个人的生命道路。？通过本课程的学习，学生不仅能够掌握人生哲学的基础理论知识，培养批判性思维与深度思考的能力，还能在哲学智慧的启发下，重新审视自己的人生目标与价值观，学会以更理性、更豁达的态度面对生活中的挑战，探寻属于自己的生命意义。
default.en: It is a core course that explores the essence, meaning, and value of life from a philosophical perspective. It aims to guide students, through systematic theoretical study and profound self-reflection, to understand fundamental questions about life and explore a life path suitable for themselves. Through the study of this course, students will not only master the basic theoretical knowledge of the philosophy of life and cultivate critical thinking and in-depth thinking abilities, but also, inspired by philosophical wisdom, reexamine their life goals and values, learn to face life's challenges with a more rational and open-minded attitude, and seek the meaning of life that is unique to them.

default.zh: 伦理学课程是哲学领域的核心课程，聚焦道德本质、善恶标准与行为规范的系统性探究。课程涵盖元伦理学对道德概念的逻辑分析、规范伦理学中功利主义、义务论、美德伦理学等经典理论。通过研读哲学文本、分析真实案例，培养学生批判性思考能力，理解不同文化与理论的道德逻辑，掌握在职业选择、社会议题中做出理性道德判断的方法。
default.en: This course is a core course in the field of philosophy, focusing on the systematic exploration of the essence of morality, standards of good and evil, and codes of conduct. The course covers meta-ethics' logical analysis of moral concepts and classic theories in normative ethics such as utilitarianism, deontology, and virtue ethics. Through studying philosophical texts and analyzing real-life cases, it cultivates students' critical thinking ability, helps them understand the moral logic of different cultures and theories, and master methods to make rational moral judgments in career choices and social issues.

default.zh: 本课程介绍西方政治思想史的研究对象、发展历程、基本线索和研究方法。其研究主题涉及西方重要思想家关于政治制度、国家、权力、政体等的认识和思考。对于拓展学生的知识视野，锻炼学生的思维，更好的坚持马克思主义具有重要意义。
default.en: This course introduces the research object, development process, basic clues and research methods of the history of Western political thought. The research topic involves the understanding and thinking of important Western thinkers on political system, state, power, political system, etc. It is of great significance for expanding students' knowledge horizons, exercising their thinking, and better adhering to Marxism.

default.zh: 中华文明是世界上唯一没有中断的文明，中国式现代化深深植根于中华文明。只有全面深入了解中华五千多年文明史，深刻把握中华文明突出的连续性、创新性、统一性、包容性、和平性，才能真正理解中国道路的历史必然性、文化内涵与独特优势，更有效地推动中华优秀传统文化创造性转化、创新性发展，更有力地推进中国特色社会主义文化建设，建设中华民族现代文明。因此，当代大学生特别是马克思主义学院的大学生，必须认真学习中国文化的生成演变发展的过程，包括其中重要的典籍和重要的人物。具体来说，本课程目的包括：第一，通过有针对性地研读中国文化史，带领学生把握中国文化的发展脉络，明确中华优秀传统文化是中华民族的“根”和“魂”，是中华民族的精神动力和突出优势，是我们最深厚的文化软实力，进而增强“四个自信”，自觉做学习者、传承者、实践者、弘扬者；第二，了解中国文化发展过程中的典型代表人物，选学中国文化经典文献作品，深入挖掘、阐释蕴含其中的恒常价值和具有教育意义的优秀美德，引导学生用古人的智慧启发自己的智慧，加强学生的批判思维、独立思考能力，提升其综合素质和心灵境界；第三，总结思考分析归纳古代文化的当代价值和启示，引导学生自觉把中华文化特别是中华优秀传统文化与思政课程、课程思政相关知识点进行融合，将价值引领内容融入学生学习成长的全过程，从而激发他们的现代创新能力，助力他们真正实现人的现代化。
default.en: Chinese civilization is the only uninterrupted civilization in the world, and Chinese modernization is deeply rooted in Chinese civilization. Only by understanding the history of more than 5,000 years of Chinese civilization comprehensively and thoroughly and grasping the outstanding continuity, innovation, unity, inclusiveness and peace of Chinese civilization profoundly, can we truly understand the historical inevitability, cultural connotation and unique advantages of the Chinese path, more effectively promote the creative transformation and innovative development of Chinese excellent traditional culture, more effectively promote the construction of socialist culture with Chinese characteristics, and build the modern civilization of the Chinese nation. Therefore, contemporary college students, especially those of Marxism College, must conscientiously study the process of the formation, evolution and development of Chinese culture, including important books and figures. Specifically, the purpose of this course lies on the following aspects: first, through targeted study of Chinese cultural history, lead students to grasp the context of the development of Chinese culture, and make it clear that Chinese excellent traditional culture is the "root" and "soul" of the Chinese nation, the spiritual driving force and outstanding advantage of the Chinese nation and our deepest cultural soft power, so as to enhance the "four self-confidence" and encourage them to be conscious learners, inheritors, practitioners and promoters. Second, guide students to inspire their wisdom with that of the ancients, strengthen their critical thinking and independent thinking ability, and improve their comprehensive quality and spiritual realm by understanding the typical representative figures in the process of the development of Chinese culture, selecting and studying the classical literature works of Chinese culture, and deeply excavating and explaining the constant value and excellent virtues of educational significance. Third, by summarizing, analyzing and summing up the contemporary value and enlightenment of ancient culture, guide students to consciously integrate Chinese culture, especially excellent Chinese traditional culture with ideological and political courses and relevant knowledge points of curriculum ideological and political education, and integrate the content of value guidance into the whole process of students' learning and growth, so as to stimulate their modern innovation ability and help them realize human modernization.

default.zh: 本课程是马克思主义学院本科生专业限选课，通过课程学习，使学生了解工作党务工作概论，党务工作职能、机构设置和领导方法，了解党的组织、宣传、统战、纪检等工作要领，掌握党务工作基本工作方法，提高学生党性修养、党务工作的素质要求和未来相关履职本领。
default.en: This course is a professional elective course for undergraduates in the School of Marxism. Through this course, students will be familiarized with the basic contents of the party affairs of the CPC, including the theories, functions, institutional setup and leading methods, the essentials of the organization, propaganda, united front, discipline inspection and other work, etc., and master the basic working skills of party affairs, thus to cultivate their party spirit and abilities in working on party affairs in the future.

default.zh: 本课程以就业为导向，围绕新时代辅导员工作的基本理论、方法与实务技能展开，从辅导员职业角色和职业能力分析入手，以党团建设、班级管理、心理教育等为例探讨辅导员职业能力运用，着重介绍辅导员九大方面的职责，并通过案例演示和学生课堂实践强化知识内容。课程运用理论讲解、案例分析和实践操作等多种教学方法，致力于使学生全面了解和掌握辅导员工作所需的专业知识、技能素养和实际操作技巧。
default.en: This course is employment-oriented and focuses on the basic theories, methods and practical skills of counselors' work in the new era. Starting from the analysis of counselors' professional roles and abilities, this course discusses the application of counselors' professional abilities by taking party and league building, class management, psychological education, etc., as examples, focuses on the introduction of counselors' responsibilities in nine major aspects, and strengthens the knowledge content through case study and classroom practice. This course adopts a variety of teaching methods such as theoretical explanation, case analysis and practical operation, and is committed to making students fully understand and master the professional knowledge, technical literacy and practical operation skills required by the counselor's work.

default.zh: 课程以辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义为指导，以《公务员法》为依据，系统阐述了我国公务员制度的概念、特点和基本内容，全面体现了我国公务员制度的发展历程。同时，也通过与国外主要公务员制度比较的方式，帮助学生更加完整、准确地了解和掌握公务员制度的基本理论和知识。 整个课程体系主要包括：中国公务员制度概述；公务员考核制度；公务员奖惩制度；公务员职务与职级制度；公务员回避、交流、培训制度；公务员工资、福利与保险制度；公务员辞职、辞退和退休制度；公务员权利救济制度；公务员制度比较；公务员录用制度；公务员面试实践；公务员面试实践
default.en: The course, guided by dialectical materialism and historical materialism and based on the Civil Service Law, systematically elaborates on the concept, characteristics, and basic content of China's civil service system, comprehensively reflecting the its development process. At the same time, it also helps students obtain a more complete and accurate understanding and mastery of the basic theories and knowledge of the civil service system by comparing it with the ones in other major countries. The entire curriculum system mainly includes: Overview of China's Civil Service System；The assessment system for civil servants；The system of rewards and punishments for civil servants；Civil Service Positions and Rank System；The avoidance, communication, and training system for civil servants；The salary, benefits, and insurance system for civil servants；The system of resignation, dismissal, and retirement for civil servants；The system of remedies for civil servant rights；Comparison of the Civil Service System；The civil servant recruitment system；Civil Service Interview Practice；Civil Service Interview Practice.

default.zh: 本课程秉承社会学研究人与社会关系的主旨，介绍社会学的基本概念（如社会化、文化、社会群体、社会组织、社会制度、社会分层、社会流动等）、基本理论、基本方法，突出社会学本土化研究的特色。通过本课程的学习有助于学生掌握社会学的基本概念、知识和相关的理论，达到比较系统地了解社会知识、增强分析社会的能力、提高科学文化素质和专业技能的目标。
default.en: The course provides an overview of the relationship between human and society. It introduces basic concepts of sociology, such as socialization, culture, social groups, social organizations, social stratification, and social mobility. It mainly focuses on the fundamental theories and methods of sociology and emphasizes the indigenized sociological studies. After finishing this course, students will acquire systematic knowledge of sociology and enhance their ability to analyze social problems.

default.zh: 本门课程为思想政治教育专业本科生的专业方向选修课程。 本课程将向同学们讲授古希腊罗马哲学、中世纪基督教哲学、16-18世纪西欧哲学、18世纪法国哲学、德国古典哲学等重要内容，逐渐培养同学们的哲学思维方式和独立批判精神。通过课程教学，使思想政治教育专业的同学们对西方哲学的一些主要范畴、重要哲学家和哲学流派及其内在逻辑联系有初步了解，并能从中把握西方哲学思想发展的基本脉络和趋势，从而以历史与逻辑相统一的方法对西方哲学进行总体性和辩证性的把握，以便从哲学史的视角来真正理解哲学。 本课程旨在使学生获得基本而系统的西方哲学史知识，激发学生对哲学及西方哲学的兴趣，培养学生运用辩证思维和方法，对西方哲学史知识进行思考的能力，以及研究西方哲学的初步能力，为将来进一步攻读相关学科的硕士和博士研究生学位或从事实际工作奠定必要的理论基础。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in ideological and political education. This course will teach students the ancient Greek and Roman philosophy, medieval Christian philosophy, western European philosophy in 16th-18th century, French philosophy in 18th century, German classical philosophy and other important contents, and gradually cultivate students' philosophical thinking mode and independent critical spirit. Through the study of this course, students majoring in ideological and political education will obtain a preliminary understanding of certain major categories of western philosophy, important philosophers and philosophical schools and their internal logical relations, and can grasp the basic context and the trend of the development of western philosophical thoughts, so as to understand western philosophy in a holistic and dialectical way by integrating history and logic, and comprehend philosophy from the perspective of historical development. This course will enable students to acquire basic and systematic knowledge of the history of western philosophy, stimulate students' interest in philosophy and western philosophy, cultivate students' ability to think about the knowledge of the history of western philosophy by dialectical thinking and study methods, and their preliminary ability to study western philosophy, so that they could lay a necessary theoretical foundation for further study of their master's and doctoral processes in related disciplines or engaging in practical work in the future.

default.zh: 中国传统哲学课程主要讲授中国古代哲学的在不同时期的发展状况，按照基本的历史发展分期来依次讲授不同哲学家的哲学观念，通过基本的哲学框架来梳理古代中国哲学概念的逻辑发展，以期对于中国古代哲学的发展有一个概观性的了解和普遍性的掌握。基本的哲学框架就是哲学所主要包含的宇宙论、本体论、认识论和方法论等，以此为基本内容去整理中国哲学概念的整体发展，并说明其在各个时期的发展状况，及其所展现的逻辑特质。中国古代哲学也形成了自己独特的思维特点和本质内容，此种独特性在中国古代哲学家的思想体系中得到了充分的体现，因而，对于此种独特性的讲授和强调也是本课程所致力达到的主要方面。
default.en: The course of Chinese traditional philosophy briefly instructs Chinese ancient philosophy in different stages of development, according to the historical development stage to successively teaching philosophy of different philosophers, and logical development through basic philosophy frameworks in ancient China, in order to have a general understanding and universal master for the development of Chinese ancient philosophy. The basic frameworks of philosophy are mainly consisted of cosmology, ontology, epistemology and methodology, and as the basic content to sort out the basic concept of Chinese philosophy, and to display the logic quality. Chinese ancient philosophy also formed its own unique characteristics of thinking and the nature of the content, this uniqueness has been fully reflected in the Chinese ancient philosopher's thought systems which this course is going to teach and emphasize on.

default.zh: 共产党是先进生产力的代表，是工人阶级的代表，但是这并不意味着不用开展党的建设工作，党要始终保证自身的先进性，就要顺应时代的发展，与时代发展相适应，要做到这一点就要加强党的建设工作，从历史中吸取经验教训，在实践中不断地丰富与完善马克思主义理论，并把理论研究的成果运用到实践中，指导实践工作。加强思想政治教育专业学生关于党建方面的理论素养教育，有利于提高群体的政治思想素质，对于国家党建工作的开展具有极强的实践意义。
default.en: The Communist Party is the representative of the advanced productive forces and the working class, but this does not mean that there is no need to carry out party building. To always ensure its progressiveness, the party must conform to the development of the times and adapt to the development of the times. To do this, it is necessary to strengthen party building, draw lessons from history, and constantly enrich and improve Marxist theory in practice, And apply the results of theoretical research to practice to guide practical work. Strengthening the theoretical literacy education of college students on Party construction is conducive to improving the political and ideological quality of college students, and has strong practical significance for the development of National Party construction.

default.zh: 该课程主要由两个体系构成，一是当代世界经济与政治发展局势，二是强化学生对国际组织的了解。在当今世界经济政治发展局势授课中，主要对学生进行习近平外交思想的教育，使学生了解关于当今国际问题的重要论述和我国外交政策的教育，使学生能够正确地运用这些理论、观点和方法观察世界，了解和把握当代世界经济、政治与国际关系演变及其发展趋势、特点和面临的主要问题；了解和认识主要国际力量在世界经济、政治中的地位和作用以及它们的对外战略，了解和认识苏联东欧国家兴衰存亡的经验教训；全面认识中国的外交战略、方针、政策与国际地位和作用，树立为国家富强和民族振兴、为人类的共同繁荣与进步而奋斗的信念。 在国际组织的授课中主要涉及四个方面的内容，使学生了解国际组织的基本概念、国际组织在全球政治中的产生和发展、研究国际组织的方法；使学生了解各种政府间国际组织在全球政治屮的功能和解决全球性问题的局限性；使学生了解政府间国际组织与政府互动的历史与现状；培养学生对国际组织的学术兴趣，发展学生研究国际组织的能力。
default.en: There are two parts in this course: one is modern world’s politics and economics, and another is the concept of international organizations. The first part is about the development process and the law of economy and politics of the world since the Second World War; the relationships between major nations in the world and their characteristics, tendency, reason of development and change; Chinese basic principle of foreign policies, development and adjustment of foreign relations, change of international standing; analysis of modern focus. There are four goals of the second part. First , students can understand the basic concepts of international organizations, the emergence and development of international organizations from the perspective of global politics, the ways in which international organizations are studied. Second, students are able to understand the functions of various intergovernmental international organizations and address their limitations when dealing with global problems. Third, students can be familiarized with the history and current interaction situation between intergovernmental organizations and governments. At last, this course is designed to develop students’ academic interest in international organizations and to improve students’ ability to study international organizations.

default.zh: 教育学概论原称“教育基本理论”、“教育学原理”或“教育学基础”，是 教育学中的基础学科，主要研究教育学中的基本理论问题，探求教育的一 般原理和规律，为其他二级学科或相近学科与专业提供理论观点和思想方 法，为研究各级各类教育提供理论基础，为教育理论的发展和教育改革提 供综合性的研究成果。通过该课程的教学，不仅有助于增强学生对于教育学、教育现象、教育过程的认识，深入理解教育的政治、经济、文化功能 以及对个人发展的意义，还有助于培养学生自我教育、自主学习的意识与 能力，让学生学会学习，提高自我认知，对培养学生观察社会、理解社会、 改造社会的责任感，造就全面发展的、有担当、有能力、有方法的思想政 治教育工作者有着特殊作用。
default.en: The principles of Education, formerly known as "the basic theory of education" or "the basis of pedagogy", is a basic discipline in pedagogy. It mainly studies the basic theoretical problems in pedagogy, explores the general principles and laws of education, provides theoretical viewpoints and ideological methods for other secondary disciplines or similar disciplines and specialties, and puts forward suggestions for the study of various types of education at all levels. It provides theoretical basis and comprehensive research results for the development of educational theory and educational reform. The aim of this course not only helps to enhance students' understanding of pedagogy, educational phenomena and educational process, to understand deeply the political, economic and cultural functions of education and its significance for personal development, but also helps to cultivate students' awareness and ability of self-education and self-learning, and to enable them to learn to study, and improve their learning and self-recognition.It plays a special role in cultivating students' sense of responsibility for observing society, understanding society and reforming society, as well as in fostering ideological and political educators of all-round, responsible, competent and methodological.

default.zh: 课程旨在传承中华文脉，致力于把马克思主义普遍原理同中华优秀传统文化相结合，努力培养和造就内有传统根基、外有现代专长、德智体美劳全面发展的社会主义建设者和接班人。《论语》《道德经》《庄子》《孟子》《诗经》……含藏着中国人最初的政治制度、文学风格、礼仪风俗、生活方式的来源。作为当代大学生，立足原文，读懂经典，体味它们对各自时代问题的回答，感受跨越时空的情感共鸣与智慧启示，进而审视现实。“为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平”，就是读第一流的书籍涵养出来的胸襟和智慧。中华文化经典有着最美的汉语，是文化传承的载体。文化是一个国家、一个民族的灵魂。阅读经典至少有三大好处：一是传承文脉，让学生自觉成为中华文明薪火相传文化链条中的一环；二是明德修身，大学之道在明明德在新民在止于至善，说到底文化的积淀，是一个人成长成才的根本；三是知行合一，古者为学，重在行事。用古人的智慧启发自己的智慧，在许党报国、服务人民的过程中，实现人生价值，成为更好的自己。总之，课程通过理论和实践，将价值引领内容融入课程建设全过程，在潜移默化中内化于心，外化于行。
default.en: The course aims to train and bring up socialist builders and successors with traditional roots inside and modern expertise outside, and all-round development of virtue, intelligence, physical conditions, mind status and community service by combining the universal principles of Marxism with the fine traditional Chinese culture to inherit Chinese culture. The excellent classics, such as The Analects of Confucius, Tao Te Ching, Zhuangzi, Mencius and The Book of Songs, are valid displays of the Chinese people’s initial political system, literary style, etiquette and customs and lifestyle.Contemporary college students should base ourselves on the original text of the Chinese cultural classics and understand them to savor their answers to the questions of their time, feel the emotional resonance and wisdom revelation across time and space so as to examine our current reality.To ordain conscience for Heaven and Earth.To secure life and fortune for the people. To continue lost teachings for past sages. To establish peace for all future generations.It is the mind and wisdom cultivated by reading first-class books.Chinese cultural classics contain the most beautiful Chinese language, which is the carrier of cultural inheritance. Culture is the soul of a country and a nation. There are at least three benefits to reading the classics. The first, it can urge the students to inherit the cultural spirit, so that they can consciously become a part of the cultural chain of the torch of Chinese civilization. The second, it can make the students be wise and virtuous. Recondite knowledge lies in making people know the virtue, learn the new knowledge and arrive at supreme goodness. It is the accumulation of culture that is the basis for a person to grow and become talented. Third, knowledge and action should go hand in hand. The purpose of learning traditional Chinese cultural classics lies at promoting our action now. Students should enlighten their own wisdom with the wisdom of the ancients, realize the value of life and become a better self in the process of serving the Party, the country and the people. In short, through theory and practice, the course integrates the value-leading content into the whole process of curriculum construction to promote the students’ mind and guide their practice.

default.zh: 《当代社会思潮》课程，主要讲解20世纪70年代以来人文社会科学领域所普遍接受的基本主张和理论假设，其中“当代”是指20世纪70年代至今，“社会思潮”则主要是国内外学术界、社会生活中流行的基本主张、理论观点和各类学说。具体来看，主要包括新自由主义、女性主义、生态主义、语言哲学、语言社会学、后现代主义、实用主义、分析的马克思主义、新儒家思想等等。
default.en: The course "Contemporary Social Thoughts" mainly explains the basic propositions and theoretical assumptions widely accepted in the field of humanities and social sciences since the 1970s. "Contemporary" refers to the time since the 1970s until now, while "social thoughts" mainly refers to the basic propositions, theoretical viewpoints, and various theories popular in academic studies and social life. Specifically, it mainly includes neoliberalism, feminism, ecology, philosophy of language, sociology of language, postmodernism, pragmatism, analytical Marxism, new Confucianism.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是实现教学、科研与社会实践相结合的重要结合点，是培养学生综合运用本学科的基本理论、专业知识和基本技能进行综合实践的基本训练，注重培养学生的实践能力、创新意识和创新能力，强化学生在毕业设计过程中的系统性和综合性训练。
default.en: The undergraduate thesis project allows students to get involved and gain first-hand experience in some facet of research in their chosen areas by applying basic theories, professional knowledge and practical skills in a systematic and comprehensive manner.The project will focus on developing students’ awareness of creativity and ability in carrying out innovative research projects

default.zh: 毕业实习是在学生完成本专业全部课程学习之后安排的实践性教学环节。目的是既能让学生对所学习的专业理论知识技能进行全面运用，也能适应社会环境，完成就业前的适应性训练，并结合实际，确定毕业论文选题。
default.en: Graduation Practices is a practical teaching component that follows the completion of all major courses by students. The purpose is to facilitate the comprehensive application of professional theoretical knowledge and skills acquired, foster adaptability to the social environment, accomplish preparatory training for future employment, and choose the subject of their graduation thesis based on their practices.

default.zh: 专业实习是在第一学年全部专业课程学习之后安排的实践性教学环节。目的是既能让学生对所学习的专业理论知识技能进行全面运用，也能适应社会环境，完成毕业前的适应性训练。
default.en: Specialty practice is a practical teaching link arranged after all professional courses after first academic year. Its purpose is not only to enable students to comprehensively apply the professional theoretical knowledge and skills they have learned, but also to adapt to the social environment and complete the pre - graduation adaptive training.

default.zh: 劳动教育是发挥劳动的育人功能，对学生进行热爱劳动、热爱劳动人民的教育活动。劳动教育是新时代党对教育的新要求，是中国特色社会主义教育制度的重要内容，是全面发展教育体系的重要组成部分，是大学生必须开展的教育活动。 本课程依据教育部《大中小学劳动教育指导纲要（试行）》要求，结合时代特征与哈尔滨工业大学的办学方向和特色，以普及劳动知识，培养大学生优良劳动品质，提升大学生的劳动能力为落脚点，制定了课程内容。 期待通过课程学习，能帮助大学生正确理解劳动是人类发展和社会进步的根本力量，认识劳动创造人、劳动创造价值、创造财富、创造美好生活的道理，尊重劳动，尊重普通劳动者，牢固树立劳动最光荣、劳动最崇高、劳动最伟大、劳动最美丽的思想观念。在生活中、在学习中、在工作中能够自觉自愿、认真负责、安全规范、坚持不懈地参与劳动，形成诚实守信、吃苦耐劳的品质。珍惜劳动成果，养成良好的消费习惯，杜绝浪费。最终成为具有良好的劳动精神面貌、正确劳动价值取向和高超劳动技能水平的社会主义建设者和接班人。
default.en: Labor education is an educational activity that brings into play the educational function of labor and provides students with love for labor and the working people. Labor education is a new requirement of the Party for education in the new era, an important content of the socialist education system with Chinese characteristics, an important component of the overall development of the education system, and an educational activity that must be carried out by college students. This course is based on the requirements of the "Guidelines for Labor Education in Universities, Middle Schools, and Primary Schools (Trial Implementation)" issued by the Ministry of Education, combined with the characteristics of the times and the direction and characteristics of Harbin Institute of Technology, with the goal of popularizing labor knowledge, cultivating excellent labor quality for college students, and improving their labor ability as the foothold. The course content is formulated. I hope that through the course learning, it can help college students correctly understand that labor is the fundamental force for human development and social progress, understand the truth that labor creates people, creates value, creates wealth, and creates a better life, respect labor, respect ordinary workers, and firmly establish the ideology of labor being the most glorious, labor being the noblest, labor being the greatest, and labor being the most beautiful. In life, in learning, and at work, they can voluntarily, conscientiously, responsibly, safely, and persistently participate in labor, forming a quality of honesty, trustworthiness, and hard work. Cherish the fruits of labor, cultivate good consumption habits, and eliminate waste. Finally, they will become socialist builders and successors with good labor spirit, correct labor value orientation, and high labor skills.

default.zh: （一）体育课程目的 为实现体育课程目的，课程设置首先是以身体练习为基本手段，通过合理的体育教学方式、多元化的体育锻炼途径以及科学的自我监督过程，切实增强学生体质和身心健康水平；其次，通过激发学生参与体育活动的兴趣，增强体育意识、提高体育能力，培养学生终身参与体育锻炼的意识和习惯；更重要的是本课程可为培养更多具有“健康第一”意识，在德、智、体、美、劳等方面全面发展的合格人才服务。 （二）体育课程任务 1．全面发展体能，提高运动能力，并结合自己的兴趣爱好和身体实际制定个人锻炼计划；掌握常见运动伤病的预防和处置方法；掌握体育基本理论知识，具有一定的体育文化素养和体育欣赏能力。 2．向学生传授体育技能和科学锻炼身体的理论与方法，培养学生积极参与各种形式的体育健身活动，并掌握几种有效的运动技能和锻炼方法，提高体育方面的素养，培养独立从事体育活动的能力，养成良好健康的体育锻炼习惯，终身受益。 3．通过体育课程学习，使学生能够提高对身体和健康的认识，学会利用体育活动调节身心，改善心理状态，养成积极乐观的生活态度。 4．加强学生的素质教育，使学生正确认识和处理德、智、体的辩证关系，树立正确的体育道德观，提高自觉性，培养勇于拼搏、团结进取、战胜自我的坚强意志品质。 （三）体育课程的设置 哈尔滨工业大学的体育教学，强调课程结构中的多学科知识内容相融合，充分利用课程体系内部的相互联系，有效提高体育课程的整体功能，结合北方地域及学校实际，最大限度满足不同层次，不同水平的学生兴趣爱好的要求，开设了多种形式的体育课程。具体课程内容包括： 1、体育训练课 校代表队（高水平组及阳光组）：田径、篮球、乒乓球、游泳、速滑、冰壶、羽毛球、足球、排球、武术、健美操等。 2、体育专项课 足球、篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、网球、武术、跆拳道、户外、游泳、自行车、冰壶、陆地冰球等。 3、体育选项课 篮球、篮球裁判、排球（气排球、软排球）、足球（雪地足球）、乒乓球、羽毛球、网球、武术、散打、搏击健身、健美、健美操、芭蕾形体、体育舞蹈、瑜伽、游泳、速度轮滑、自行车、户外运动、陆地冰球、冰壶、冬季户外徒步、滑冰、高山滑雪、雪地球、雪合战等。 4、体育基础课 基础田径、徒步、自行车、游泳、运动减脂等。 5、体育健身课 太极拳、导引养生、八段锦、徒步等。
default.en: (1) Purposes of PE Curriculum There are three main purposes of PE Curriculum. First, based on physical exercises, the curriculum aims at enhancing students’ physical and mental health through effective teaching methods, diversified ways of doing exercises and scientific self-monitoring process. Second, the curriculum helps to form the lifelong habit of participating in physical exercises through inspiring students’ sports interest and enhancing their sports awareness and sports skills. The most important is that the curriculum is helpful to serve the all-round development of moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic and labor qualified talents through training more students with the “health first” consciousness (2) PE Curriculum Tasks 1. To improve students’ physical conditioning and sports skills. Courses helps students to learn how to make personal exercise schedules which both suits their own wills and actual physical conditions. It also helps students to learn how to prevent and how to treat common sports injuries. In addition, acquiring basic and theoretical knowledge of sports can contribute the cultivation of sports culture literacy and sports appreciation ability. 2. To teach students sports skills and scientific exercise theories and methods. The courses aim at encouraging students to participate in various physical activities, and mastering several effective exercise skills and methods. By means of the PE learning, students can improve their sports literacy, engage in sports activities independently, and develop good and healthy exercise habits, all of which will benefit them all their lives. 3. To improve their understanding of body and health through the learning process. PE courses contribute to adjust students’ physical and mental health, and develop a positive and optimistic attitude towards life. 4. To strengthen quality education in PE courses. Quality education is quite crucial in making students realize and how to do with the relation between morality, intelligence, and physical exercises. By means of the quality education in PE courses, students tend to establish a correct sports morality, take initiatives and cultivate assertive personalities including courage, solidarity, enterprise, fearlessness. (3) PE Curriculum Settings Sports Department in Harbin Institute of Technology effectively improves the overall functions of PE curriculum, through the integration of multidisciplinary knowledge and the interrelationship within the curriculum system. Taking climate, environment and campus situation into consideration, Sports department opens a variety of PE courses to satisfy students with different interests and skills to its maximum. Details of the courses open are as follows. 1. Physical Training Courses School team (high level group and sunshine group): Track and Field, Basketball, Table Tennis, Swimming, Speed Skating, Curling, Badminton, Football, Volleyball, Martial Arts, Aerobics and so on. 2. Special Training Courses Football, Basketball, Badminton, Table Tennis, Tennis, Martial Arts, Taekwondo, Outdoor Sports, Swimming, Cycling, Curling, Floorball and so on. 3. Optional Courses Basketball, basketball referee, Volleyball (balloon volleyball, soft volleyball), Football (snow football), Table Tennis, Badminton, Tennis, Martial Arts, Sanda, Fighting Fitness, Bodybuilding, Aerobics, ballet, sports dance, yoga, swimming, Speed roller skating, Cycling, Outdoor Sports, Floorball, Curling, Winter Outdoor Hiking, Ice Skating, Alpine Skiing, Snowfield Hockey, Yukigassen and so on. 4. Basics Training Courses Basic Track and Field, Hiking, Cycling, Swimming, Sports for Fitness and so on. 5. Physical Fitness Courses Tai Chi, Guided Health Preservation, Ba Duan Jin (Ancient Chinese Qigong), Hiking and so on.

default.zh: （一）体育课程目的 为实现体育课程目的，课程设置首先是以身体练习为基本手段，通过合理的体育教学方式、多元化的体育锻炼途径以及科学的自我监督过程，切实增强学生体质和身心健康水平；其次，通过激发学生参与体育活动的兴趣，增强体育意识、提高体育能力，培养学生终身参与体育锻炼的意识和习惯；更重要的是本课程可为培养更多具有“健康第一”意识，在德、智、体、美、劳等方面全面发展的合格人才服务。 （二）体育课程任务 1．全面发展体能，提高运动能力，并结合自己的兴趣爱好和身体实际制定个人锻炼计划；掌握常见运动伤病的预防和处置方法；掌握体育基本理论知识，具有一定的体育文化素养和体育欣赏能力。 2．向学生传授体育技能和科学锻炼身体的理论与方法，培养学生积极参与各种形式的体育健身活动，并掌握几种有效的运动技能和锻炼方法，提高体育方面的素养，培养独立从事体育活动的能力，养成良好健康的体育锻炼习惯，终身受益。 3．通过体育课程学习，使学生能够提高对身体和健康的认识，学会利用体育活动调节身心，改善心理状态，养成积极乐观的生活态度。 4．加强学生的素质教育，使学生正确认识和处理德、智、体的辩证关系，树立正确的体育道德观，提高自觉性，培养勇于拼搏、团结进取、战胜自我的坚强意志品质。 （三）体育课程的设置 哈尔滨工业大学的体育教学，强调课程结构中的多学科知识内容相融合，充分利用课程体系内部的相互联系，有效提高体育课程的整体功能，结合北方地域及学校实际，最大限度满足不同层次，不同水平的学生兴趣爱好的要求，开设了多种形式的体育课程。具体课程内容包括： 1、体育训练课 校代表队（高水平组及阳光组）：田径、篮球、乒乓球、游泳、速滑、冰壶、羽毛球、足球、排球、武术、健美操等。 2、体育专项课 足球、篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、网球、武术、跆拳道、户外、游泳、自行车、冰壶、陆地冰球等。 3、体育选项课 篮球、篮球裁判、排球（气排球、软排球）、足球（雪地足球）、乒乓球、羽毛球、网球、武术、散打、搏击健身、健美、健美操、芭蕾形体、体育舞蹈、瑜伽、游泳、速度轮滑、自行车、户外运动、陆地冰球、冰壶、冬季户外徒步、滑冰、高山滑雪、雪地球、雪合战等。 4、体育基础课 基础田径、徒步、自行车、游泳、运动减脂等。 5、体育健身课 太极拳、导引养生、八段锦、徒步等。
default.en: (1) Purposes of PE Curriculum There are three main purposes of PE Curriculum. First, based on physical exercises, the curriculum aims at enhancing students’ physical and mental health through effective teaching methods, diversified ways of doing exercises and scientific self-monitoring process. Second, the curriculum helps to form the lifelong habit of participating in physical exercises through inspiring students’ sports interest and enhancing their sports awareness and sports skills. The most important is that the curriculum is helpful to serve the all-round development of moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic and labor qualified talents through training more students with the “health first” consciousness (2) PE Curriculum Tasks 1. To improve students’ physical conditioning and sports skills. Courses helps students to learn how to make personal exercise schedules which both suits their own wills and actual physical conditions. It also helps students to learn how to prevent and how to treat common sports injuries. In addition, acquiring basic and theoretical knowledge of sports can contribute the cultivation of sports culture literacy and sports appreciation ability. 2. To teach students sports skills and scientific exercise theories and methods. The courses aim at encouraging students to participate in various physical activities, and mastering several effective exercise skills and methods. By means of the PE learning, students can improve their sports literacy, engage in sports activities independently, and develop good and healthy exercise habits, all of which will benefit them all their lives. 3. To improve their understanding of body and health through the learning process. PE courses contribute to adjust students’ physical and mental health, and develop a positive and optimistic attitude towards life. 4. To strengthen quality education in PE courses. Quality education is quite crucial in making students realize and how to do with the relation between morality, intelligence, and physical exercises. By means of the quality education in PE courses, students tend to establish a correct sports morality, take initiatives and cultivate assertive personalities including courage, solidarity, enterprise, fearlessness. default.en: (1) Purposes of PE Curriculum There are three main purposes of PE Curriculum. First, based on physical exercises, the curriculum aims at enhancing students’ physical and mental health through effective teaching methods, diversified ways of doing exercises and scientific self-monitoring process. Second, the curriculum helps to form the lifelong habit of participating in physical exercises through inspiring students’ sports interest and enhancing their sports awareness and sports skills. The most important is that the curriculum is helpful to serve the all-round development of moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic and labor qualified talents through training more students with the “health first” consciousness (2) PE Curriculum Tasks 1. To improve students’ physical conditioning and sports skills. Courses helps students to learn how to make personal exercise schedules which both suits their own wills and actual physical conditions. It also helps students to learn how to prevent and how to treat common sports injuries. In addition, acquiring basic and theoretical knowledge of sports can contribute the cultivation of sports culture literacy and sports appreciation ability. 2. To teach students sports skills and scientific exercise theories and methods. The courses aim at encouraging students to participate in various physical activities, and mastering several effective exercise skills and methods. By means of the PE learning, students can improve their sports literacy, engage in sports activities independently, and develop good and healthy exercise habits, all of which will benefit them all their lives. 3. To improve their understanding of body and health through the learning process. PE courses contribute to adjust students’ physical and mental health, and develop a positive and optimistic attitude towards life. 4. To strengthen quality education in PE courses. Quality education is quite crucial in making students realize and how to do with the relation between morality, intelligence, and physical exercises. By means of the quality education in PE courses, students tend to establish a correct sports morality, take initiatives and cultivate assertive personalities including courage, solidarity, enterprise, fearlessness. (3) PE Curriculum Settings Sports Department in Harbin Institute of Technology effectively improves the overall functions of PE curriculum, through the integration of multidisciplinary knowledge and the interrelationship within the curriculum system. Taking climate, environment and campus situation into consideration, Sports department opens a variety of PE courses to satisfy students with different interests and skills to its maximum. Details of the courses open are as follows. 1. Physical Training Courses School team (high level group and sunshine group): Track and Field, Basketball, Table Tennis, Swimming, Speed Skating, Curling, Badminton, Football, Volleyball, Martial Arts, Aerobics and so on. 2. Special Training Courses Football, Basketball, Badminton, Table Tennis, Tennis, Martial Arts, Taekwondo, Outdoor Sports, Swimming, Cycling, Curling, Floorball and so on. 3. Optional Courses Basketball, basketball referee, Volleyball (balloon volleyball, soft volleyball), Football (snow football), Table Tennis, Badminton, Tennis, Martial Arts, Sanda, Fighting Fitness, Bodybuilding, Aerobics, ballet, sports dance, yoga, swimming, Speed roller skating, Cycling, Outdoor Sports, Floorball, Curling, Winter Outdoor Hiking, Ice Skating, Alpine Skiing, Snowfield Hockey, Yukigassen and so on. 4. Basics Training Courses Basic Track and Field, Hiking, Cycling, Swimming, Sports for Fitness and so on. 5. Physical Fitness Courses Tai Chi, Guided Health Preservation, Ba Duan Jin (Ancient Chinese Qigong), Hiking and so on.

default.zh: （一）体育课程目的 为实现体育课程目的，课程设置首先是以身体练习为基本手段，通过合理的体育教学方式、多元化的体育锻炼途径以及科学的自我监督过程，切实增强学生体质和身心健康水平；其次，通过激发学生参与体育活动的兴趣，增强体育意识、提高体育能力，培养学生终身参与体育锻炼的意识和习惯；更重要的是本课程可为培养更多具有“健康第一”意识，在德、智、体、美、劳等方面全面发展的合格人才服务。 （二）体育课程任务 1．全面发展体能，提高运动能力，并结合自己的兴趣爱好和身体实际制定个人锻炼计划；掌握常见运动伤病的预防和处置方法；掌握体育基本理论知识，具有一定的体育文化素养和体育欣赏能力。 2．向学生传授体育技能和科学锻炼身体的理论与方法，培养学生积极参与各种形式的体育健身活动，并掌握几种有效的运动技能和锻炼方法，提高体育方面的素养，培养独立从事体育活动的能力，养成良好健康的体育锻炼习惯，终身受益。 3．通过体育课程学习，使学生能够提高对身体和健康的认识，学会利用体育活动调节身心，改善心理状态，养成积极乐观的生活态度。 4．加强学生的素质教育，使学生正确认识和处理德、智、体的辩证关系，树立正确的体育道德观，提高自觉性，培养勇于拼搏、团结进取、战胜自我的坚强意志品质。 （三）体育课程的设置 哈尔滨工业大学的体育教学，强调课程结构中的多学科知识内容相融合，充分利用课程体系内部的相互联系，有效提高体育课程的整体功能，结合北方地域及学校实际，最大限度满足不同层次，不同水平的学生兴趣爱好的要求，开设了多种形式的体育课程。具体课程内容包括： 1、体育训练课 校代表队（高水平组及阳光组）：田径、篮球、乒乓球、游泳、速滑、冰壶、羽毛球、足球、排球、武术、健美操等。 2、体育专项课 足球、篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、网球、武术、跆拳道、户外、游泳、自行车、冰壶、陆地冰球等。 3、体育选项课 篮球、篮球裁判、排球（气排球、软排球）、足球（雪地足球）、乒乓球、羽毛球、网球、武术、散打、搏击健身、健美、健美操、芭蕾形体、体育舞蹈、瑜伽、游泳、速度轮滑、自行车、户外运动、陆地冰球、冰壶、冬季户外徒步、滑冰、高山滑雪、雪地球、雪合战等。 4、体育基础课 基础田径、徒步、自行车、游泳、运动减脂等。 5、体育健身课 太极拳、导引养生、八段锦、徒步等。

default.zh: 物理学是研究物质、能量和它们相互作用的学科。其原理是技术的源泉，是多学科交叉、转移和渗透的支撑点，在促进科技创新和技术进步等方面，物理学发挥着先导作用。针对我校航天自动化集群“立足航天、服务国防，面向国际学术前沿和国家重大需求，培养具备多学科知识体系结构，胜任跨学科、跨行业需求，具有工程实践能力和创新能力，能够引领航天、电气等相关领域未来发展的国家杰出人才”的目标定位，大学物理B以“厚基础，重创新，强能力，见成效”为教学理念，从夯实物理基础、拓展知识结构、培养团队协助精神、培养创新意识，几个方面支撑航天自动化集群的人才培养目标。 通过大学课程的学习，使学生全面了解并掌握力学、电磁学、狭义相对论所涉及的物理原理及其在相关工程技术领域中的应用，培养学生掌握以物理学思维特征为基础的思维能力，利用物理知识解决工程技术问题的意识和能力，提高综合研究素质与自主学习能力。激发学生的科学研究兴趣，培养学生的创新意识。培养学生树立科学的自然观和辩证唯物主义的世界观。使学生充分认识物理学作为现代科学技术的基础在工程技术领域的重要支撑作用。
default.en: Physics is the study of matter, energy and their interactions. Its principle is the source of technology and the supporting point of multidisciplinary intersection, transfer and penetration. Physics plays a leading role in promoting scientific and technological innovation and technological progress. Aerospace automation cluster of our university have put forward the following training objectives: Based on aerospace and national defense service, and facing the international academic frontier and national major needs, we aim to cultivate national outstanding talents with multidisciplinary knowledge system structure, competent for interdisciplinary and cross-industry needs, engineering practice and innovation ability, and able to lead the future development of aerospace, electrical and other related fields. In order to achieve the above objectives, University Physics B takes the teaching concept of "thick foundation, innovation, strong ability and results" as the teaching concept. It supports the talent training goal of aerospace automation cluster from several aspects: consolidating physics foundation, expanding knowledge structure, cultivating teamwork spirit and cultivating innovation consciousness. To enable students to fully understand and master the physical principles involved in mechanics, electromagnetism, and special relativity and their applications in related engineering and technical fields through University Physics B（1）， cultivate their thinking ability based on the characteristics of physical thinking, use physical knowledge to solve engineering and technical problems, and improve their comprehensive research quality and independent learning ability. Stimulate students' interest in scientific research and cultivate their innovative consciousness. default.en: Physics is the study of matter, energy and their interactions. Its principle is the source of technology and the supporting point of multidisciplinary intersection, transfer and penetration. Physics plays a leading role in promoting scientific and technological innovation and technological progress. To serve the aerospace industries and the important strategic demands of the country, and also to face the scientific and technological frontiers, the Intelligent Equipment and Advanced Materials Cluster of our university has put forward the following training objectives: To enable students to have excellent communication and collaboration skills, interprofessional cognitive and integrative abilities, and lifelong learning abilities; have a solid foundation in mathematics and other natural sciences such as physics, chemistry, etc.; be able to apply what they have learned to solve the complex problems in electromechanical engineering, precision instrumentation design and measurements, material development and fabrication, and energy and power engineering; own the awareness of innovation, autonomous learning and acquiring new knowledge. In order to achieve the above objectives, University Physics takes the teaching concept of "solid the foundation, stress the innovation, strengthen the ability, and achieve results" as its teaching philosophy. It supports the talent training objectives of the Intelligent Equipment and Advanced Materials Cluster in terms of strengthening the basis of physics, cultivating abilities and thinking modes to solve complex issues by using physical principles, improving the ability of independent learning and integrating multidisciplinary knowledge. Through the study of University Physics, students can fully understand and master part of the knowledge system of physics, cultivate their thinking ability based on the characteristics of physical thinking, use physical knowledge to solve engineering and technical problems, and improve their comprehensive research quality and independent learning ability. Stimulate students' interest in scientific research and cultivate their innovative consciousness. Cultivate students to establish a scientific outlook on nature and a world outlook of dialectical materialism. To enable students to fully understand the important supporting role of physics as the basis of modern science and technology in the field of engineering technology.

default.en: Physics is a natural science that involves the study of matter and its basic structure, basic motions, interactions and transformation laws. Its principle is the source of technology and the supporting point of multidisciplinary intersection, transfer and penetration. Physics plays a leading role in promoting scientific and technological innovation and technological progresses. The Computer and Electronic Communication Cluster and the Medical Science Cluster of our university have put forward the following training objectives: Based on aerospace, serving national defense, facing the international academic frontier and major national needs; Cultivate the ability of cooperation and cross-cultural communication with interdisciplinary integration; Having multi-dimensional knowledge structure and mastering basic theoretical knowledge such as mathematics and physics; Solving complex engineering problems based on related theoretical knowledge and scientific methods; Having innovative spirit and international vision. In order to achieve the above objectives, College Physics C takes the teaching concept of "Consolidating the foundation, focusing on innovation, strengthen the capabilities, and achieve results" as its teaching philosophy. It supports the talent training objectives of the above mentioned two clusters in terms of consolidating the foundation of physics, building a multi-disciplinary cross integration knowledge system, cultivating students' ability and thinking habits to solve complex problems using physics principles, and improving their independent learning abilities. Through the study of College Physics C, students can fully understand and master the knowledge system of physics. We focus on culturing their thinking ability based on the characteristics of physical thinking, the ability of solving engineering and technical problems based on the knowledge of physics, their comprehensive research quality and independent learning abilities. It is also aimed to stimulate students' interest in scientific research and cultivate their innovative consciousness. Students will be trained to establish a scientific vision on nature and a dialectical materialism world outlook, as well as a fully understand upon the role of physics as the basis of modern science and technology in the field of engineering technology.

default.zh: 本课程是为文科大学生提高科学素养而开设的，所以本课程肩负着科学知识和科学素质教育的双重任务。其主要内容有：经典力学简介、电磁学简介、热学、光的本性研究、相对论简介、物质结构及量子力学基础。通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解物理学在教育、科学、文化领域中的特殊地位以及物理学在现代科学技术和整个人类文明进步中的重要作用，了解自然科学与人文及社会问题的紧密结合。本课程注重培养学生的科学素质和创新能力，培养学生科学的思维方法；扩大学生的知识面、开阔眼界，提升学生的综合素养。
default.en: This course is set up for liberal arts students to improve their scientific literacy, so it shoulders the dual tasks of scientific knowledge and scientific quality education. Its main contents include: a brief introduction to classical mechanics, electromagnetism, thermology, the study of the nature of light, a brief introduction to relativity, the structure of matter and the basis of quantum mechanics. Through learning of this course, students could understand the special status of physics in the fields of education, science and culture, and the important role of physics in modern science and technology and the progress of human civilization, and understand the close combination of natural science and human and social problems. This course focuses on cultivating scientific quality、innovation ability and scientific thinking methods of students, expanding students' knowledge, broadening their horizons and improving their comprehensive quality.

default.zh: 本课程是为文科各专业本科生和国际留学生提高科学素养而开设的，肩负着科学知识和科学素质教育的双重任务。教学上避免使用大量数学公式，主要通过课堂讲授、讨论和演示实验的方式，理解物理概念和物理思维，并将物理概念和物理规律应用到本专业知识的学习中。讲授内容涵盖经典力学、流体力学、振动与波、热力学、电磁学、光学、相对论和量子力学等领域的基本物理概念，共32课堂学时。 通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解物理学在教育、科学、文化领域中的特殊地位以及物理学在现代科学技术和整个人类文明进步中的重要作用，了解自然科学与人文及社会问题的紧密结合。本课程注重培养学生的科学素质和创新能力，培养学生科学的思维方法；扩大学生的知识面、开阔眼界，提升学生的综合素养。
default.en: This course is designed to enhance the scientific literacy of undergraduate international students in humanities/social science majors. It carries the dual tasks of imparting scientific knowledge and fostering scientific competence. Instruction minimizes the use of complex mathematical formulas, focusing instead on lectures, discussions, and demonstration experiments to help students grasp physical concepts and physical thinking. Students are encouraged to apply these physical concepts and laws to their own fields of study. The course content covers fundamental concepts in classical mechanics, fluid mechanics, vibrations and waves, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, optics, relativity, and quantum mechanics, totaling 32 lecture hours. Through this course, students will gain an understanding of the unique role physics plays in education, science, and culture, as well as its crucial importance in modern science and technology and the overall progress of human civilization. They will explore the close connections between the natural sciences and humanities/social issues. This course emphasizes cultivating students' scientific literacy and innovative abilities, developing their scientific thinking methods, broadening their knowledge base, expanding their horizons, and ultimately enhancing their overall comprehensive competence.

default.zh: 物理学是研究物质、能量和它们相互作用的学科。其原理是技术的源泉，是多学科交叉、转移和渗透的支撑点，在促进科技创新和技术进步等方面，物理学发挥着先导作用。 大学物理A（1）是工程力学、核工程与核技术专业学生的一门公共基础核心课，该课程以力学、电磁学、狭义相对论所涉及的物理原理及其在科学技术中应用为主要内容。该课程所教授的知识结构、物理思维模式、科学精神是引领工程力学、核工程与核技术专业未来发展的卓越人才所必备的。 通过大学物理课程的学习，应使学生对物理学的基本概念、基本理论、基本研究方法有比较全面、系统的认识和正确的理解，培养学生树立科学的自然观、宇宙观和辩证唯物主义的世界观，培养学生的创新精神和科学思维能力，同时使学生掌握物理学中独特的科学研究方法。该课程为学生将来从事工程力学、核工程与核技术专业课的学习和相关研究奠定坚实的的物理基础。
default.en: Physics is the science of matter, energy and their interaction. Its principle is the source of technology, is the support of multidisciplinary cross, transfer and penetration. In promoting scientific and technological innovation and progress, physics plays a leading role. College physics A（1） is a common basic core course for students majoring in engineering mechanics, nuclear engineering and nuclear technology. The course focuses on the physical principles involved in mechanics, electromagnetism, and special relativity and their application in science and technology. The knowledge structure, physical thinking mode and scientific spirit taught in this course are necessary for outstanding talents leading the future development of engineering mechanics, nuclear engineering and nuclear technology majors. Learning college physics can make students has comprehensive, systemic and accurate understanding about the basic conception, basic theory, basic idea of physics. Also college physics can train students to gain scientific theory about nature and universe, dialectic and materialistic theory about world, explorative and creative spirits, scientific ideation, which can be the academic base for the next study. This course lays a solid physical foundation for students to engage in engineering mechanics, nuclear engineering and nuclear technology specialized courses and related research in the future.

default.en: Physics is the study of matter, energy and their interactions. Its principle is the source of technology and the supporting point of multidisciplinary intersection, transfer and penetration. Physics plays a leading role in promoting scientific and technological innovation and technological progress. Aiming at the target orientation of our future technical college to cultivate leading scientific and technological innovation (innovation) talents for the future development of science and technology and industry. University Physics X supports the talent training goal of the future technical college from the aspects of consolidating the physical foundation, cultivating innovation awareness, improving independent learning ability and basic scientific literacy with the teaching philosophy of laying a solid foundation, focusing on innovation, strengthening ability, and achieving results. University Physics X is a public basic core course for students of Future Technology College. The course focuses on the physical principles involved in mechanics, special relativity, electromagnetism, vibration and waves, and their application in science and technology. The knowledge structure, physical thinking mode and scientific spirit taught in this course are necessary for leading talents in scientific and technological innovation to lead the future development. The teaching content of the course is the basis for establishing the materialistic world outlook. The scientific research methods and thinking modes involved are the main carriers of students' innovation ability. The knowledge system, cognitive structure and scientific attitude established in the learning process are the necessary knowledge foundation and scientific quality for students to learn independently. default.zh: 《大学物理实验x》课程是面向未来技术学院专门开设的物理实验课程，课程分为上下两学期，即《大学物理实验x(1)》和《大学物理实验x(2)》，其中，《大学物理实验x(1)》课程侧重基础性的经典物理实验，《大学物理实验x(2)》课程侧重综合性的近代物理实验，两学期课程均包含一定数量的设计性实验。课程遴选26个涵盖力、热、声、光、电、磁、近代物理等诸多领域的经典物理实验和特色自主探究式物理实验项目，学生在开设的不同层次的实验项目中选做至少15个实验并提交完整的实验报告，鼓励多选多做。课程注重与理论知识的衔接，在实验项目安排上确保学生掌握相关的物理和数学知识再做实验，保障实验课的教学效果。 本课程为学生建立多学科知识结构奠定实验基础，培养学生跨学科和系统思维；通过实验项目、实验内容和实验过程的层次化设计，满足学生个性化的需求；通过实验方法、实验技能、实验理论和数据分析方法的系统训练，使学生初步掌握科学实验的思想和方法，厚植开展科学实验所需的基础素养；通过具有挑战度的、现代化的实验项目和自主探究式实验教学模式培养学生创新能力、审辩思维和沟通合作等核心素养，以及追求真理、勇攀高峰的科学精神，为今后进行更深入的科研工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: The College Physics Experiment x is a course specially offered for the School of Future Technology. The course is divided into two semesters, College Physics Experiment x(1) and College Physics Experiment x(2). The College Physics Experiment x(1) course focuses on basic classical physics experiments, the College Physics Experiment x(2) course focuses on comprehensive modern physics experiments, and both course include a certain number of design experiments. The course selects 26 classical physics experiments and characteristic independent inquiry physics experiments covering many fields such as force, heat, sound, light, electricity, magnetism and modern physics. Students should choose at least 15 experiments from the experimental projects by their own interests and submit complete experimental reports. Students are encouraged to do more experiments than what's required. The course focuses on the connection with theoretical knowledge. In terms of experimental project arrangement, it ensures that students can master relevant physical and mathematical knowledge before doing experiments, so as to ensure the teaching effect of experimental courses. This course lays an experimental foundation for students to establish a multi-disciplinary knowledge structure, and cultivates students' interdisciplinary and systematic thinking. The hierarchical design of experimental items, experimental content and experimental process can meet students' personalized needs. Through systematic training of experimental methods, experimental skills, experimental theories and data analysis methods, students can initially master the ideas and methods of scientific experiments and cultivate the basic qualities required for scientific experiments. The challenging and modern experimental projects and independent inquiry experimental teaching mode can cultivate students' core qualities such as innovation ability, critical thinking, communication and cooperation, as well as the scientific spirit of pursuing truth and climbing the peak, so as to lay a solid foundation for further scientific research in the future.

default.zh: 物理学本质上是一门实验科学，人类对物理规律的认识和掌握是从实验开始的。物理实验是科学实验的先驱，体现了大多数科学实验的共性，在实验思想、实验方法以及实验手段等方面是各学科科学实验的基础，在培养学生严谨的科学思维和创新能力，培养学生理论联系实际，特别是与科学技术发展相适应的综合能力等方面起着重要的作用。 本课程学时总数为48学时，其中绪论课讲授3学时，主要内容为误差与实验数据处理，以及科学实验的基础理论和基础知识。实验环节采用开放式教学，遴选26个涵盖力、热、声、光、电、磁、近代物理等诸多领域的经典物理实验和特色自主探究式物理实验项目供学生选择，秋季和春季学期各开出13个实验项目。实验为45学时，分两个学期完成15个实验项目。每人秋季学期完成7个实验项目，并提供完整的实验报告；春季学期完成8个实验项目，并提供完整的实验报告。除部分必做实验外，学生可根据个人情况自主选择，鼓励多选、多做实验。
default.en: In essence, physics is an experimental science. The understanding and mastery of the laws of physics begin with experiments. Physical experiment is the pioneer of scientific experiment, which reflects the commonness of most scientific experiments. It is the basis of scientific experiments in various disciplines in terms of experimental ideas, experimental methods and experimental means. It plays an important role in cultivating students' rigorous scientific thinking and innovation ability, cultivating students' ability to connect theory with reality, especially the comprehensive ability to adapt to the development of science and technology. The total class hours of this course is 48, including 3 class hours of introduction course, which mainly covers error and experimental data processing, as well as basic theory and knowledge of scientific experiments. The experimental part adopts open teaching, and 26 classical physics experiments covering mechanics, thermology, acoustics, optics, electrics, magnetics, modern physics and other fields and characteristic independent inquiry physics experiment projects are selected for students to choose. 13 experiment projects are opened in autumn and spring semesters respectively. The experiment lasts 45 class hours, and 15 experimental projects are completed in two semesters. Each student completes 7 experimental projects in the autumn semester and provides complete experimental reports, while in the spring semester, complete 8 experimental projects and provide complete experimental reports. In addition to some required experiments, students can make their own choices according to their personal conditions, and are encouraged to do more experiments.
