default.en: The role of Computational Physics is continuously increasing since very few problems allow explicit analytical solutions. The course of Computational Physics mainly includes basic ideas of numerical methods applied to mathematical problems for ordinary and partial differential equations. Starting with the simplest Euler scheme applied to the initial value problems for ordinary differential equations, the course progressively describes more specific methods which can be applied to stiff problems and problems involving large parameters. The course describes also numerical methods for the integral equations and for the boundary value problems of partial differential equations. The main goal of the course is to provide basic knowledge of the methods which would allow further specialization in particular subjects of computational physics and understanding of modern finite element and boundary element methods and their realizations in quick solvers.

default.zh: 激光原理与技术是一门理论性较强的课程，也是光电信息科学与工程专业核心课程之一，是从事光学和光电子领域科学研究、技术开发必须掌握的基础内容。在过去半个多世纪的现代光学和物理学的重大基础研究成果和革命性技术发明中，激光都起到了关键作用，对人类的生产和生活方式产生了广泛而深刻的影响。 本课程介绍激光的基本特性、基本工作原理、光与物质共振相互作用过程中的物理过程及特性、激光振荡、激光调制、调Q与锁模技术等基础知识，使学生对激光器的物理机理和相关激光技术有较深入的理解，掌握激光的基本理论、分析方法和重要结论，并使学生一定程度了解激光技术新进展和重大应用背景，为学生从事光电信息科学与工程工作打好专业基础。 本课程分为“激光原理”和“激光技术”两部分。“激光原理”部分包括激光基本原理、开放谐振腔、高斯光束及其特性、光与物质共振相互作用及激光器的工作特性四部分；“激光技术”部分包括激光放大技术、激光调制技术、激光调Q技术和激光锁模技术。
default.en: Laser principle and technology is a highly theoretical course and one of the core courses of major in optoelectronic information science and engineering. It is the basic content that must be mastered in scientific research and technology development in the field of optics and optoelectronics. In the important basic research achievements and revolutionary technological inventions of modern optics and physics over the past half century, lasers have played a key role and had a broad and profound impact on human production and lifestyle. This course introduces the basic characteristics, basic working principles, physical processes and characteristics in the process of resonance interaction between light and matter, laser oscillation, laser modulation, Q-switching and mode locking technology, so that students can have a deeper understanding of the physical mechanism of lasers and related laser technologies, master the basic theories, analysis methods and important conclusions related to lasers. In addition, it also enables students to understand the new progress and major application background of laser technology to a certain extent, so as to lay a good professional foundation for students to engage in photoelectric information science and engineering. This course is divided into "Laser Principle" and "Laser Technology". "Laser principle" includes four parts: laser basic principle, open resonator, Gaussian beam and its characteristics, resonance interaction between light and matter and working characteristics of laser; "Laser technology" includes laser amplification technology, laser modulation technology, laser Q-switching technology and laser mode locking technology.

default.zh: “专业物理实验”课程可以让学生在实验室环境中探索物理现象，对描述这些现象的模型和理论得出自己的结论，并在这个过程中加深学生对实验和理论之间关系的理解。本课程所涉及的物理知识内容较深，并具有较强的专业性和技术性。通过从现代物理学各领域中选择的实验，进一步丰富和活跃学生的物理思想，培养他们观察和分析物理现象的能力，把握现象的本质和产生机理；引导他们认识到实验物理在物理新学科的产生、形成和发展过程中所发挥的重要作用；学习专业物理研究中常用的方法、技术、仪器和知识，进一步培养学生正确的和良好的实验习惯以及严谨的科学作风，使学生获得具有一般专业水平的用实验方法和技术研究物理现象和规律的独立工作能力，为学生从事专业、科研、应用和发展新技术打好坚实的物理实验基础。
default.en: "Professional Physics Experiments" course allows students to explore physical phenomena in a laboratory environment, draw their own conclusions about the models and theories that describe these phenomena, and deepen their understanding of the relationship between experiments and theories in this process. The physics knowledge involved in this course is deep and has strong professionalism and technical skills. By selecting experiments from various fields of modern physics, further enriching and activating students' physical thinking, cultivating their ability to observe and analyze physical phenomena, grasping the essence and mechanism of phenomena; Guide them to recognize the important role played by experimental physics in the emergence, formation, and development of new physics disciplines; Learn the commonly used methods, techniques, instruments, and knowledge in professional physics research, further cultivate students' correct and good experimental habits, as well as rigorous scientific work style, so that they can acquire independent work ability to study physical phenomena and laws using experimental methods and techniques at a general professional level, and lay a solid foundation for students to engage in professional, scientific research, application, and development of new technologies in physics experiments.

default.zh: 《现代光学测量原理与技术A》课程注重光学基本理论与应用紧密结合，重点介绍了光学精密测试所涉及的光学测量方法及其特点，对在工业、军事、生物和医学等领域进行光学精密测试具有较高的参考价值。本课程首先讲述现代光学测量的发展现状与趋势、光学测量方法的分类、光学测量系统的典型类别，从光源到探测的匹配应用对典型光学测量系统进行了举例分析。然后分别讲述光干涉测量技术、激光全息测量技术、激光衍射测量技术以及激光测距和测速技术。通过学习本课程使学生掌握现代光学测量技术的基本概念和原理，能够自行分析和设计所需的光学测试系统，切实提高学生独立分析和解决光学测量问题的能力。
default.en: The course 《Principle and Technology of Modern Optical Measurement A》combines theory with technical applications, and focuses on the methods and their characteristics of optical precision measurement. It’s important for applications in industry, military, life science, medicine, and so on. In this course, we firstly introduce the fundamental of modern optical measurement technique, including the categories, system composing and the future trends. Typical optical measuring systems are analyzed with examples, and light sources, detectors and the match for both are highlighted. Then we introduce the laser interference, hologram, diffraction, ranging and speed measurement technologies. The course will give the students a theoretical background for analyze and design an optical measurement system independently, and improve the ability of analyzing and solving problems during optical testing by one’s own.

default.zh: 课程的目的是在最简单的水平上提供对激光行为的广泛而统一的描述，这与正确的物理理解相兼容。它尽可能提供直观的描述，并坚持最简单的数学形式。介绍了激光原理、方案和技术的概述，并列举了许多实际例子。真实的例子非常有助于理解所描述概念的实验室应用，以及具体操作参数，本课程可以推荐给那些希望对现代激光物理和技术有广泛了解的高级学生。
default.en: The aim of lectures is stated as to provide a broad and unified description of laser behavior at the simplest level which is compatible with a correct physical understanding. It tries to provide an intuitive description wherever possible and to stick to the simplest mathematical formalism applicable. An overview of laser principles, schemes and technologies is presented together with numerous real-life examples. The real-life examples are very helpful in understanding laboratory applications of the described concepts, together with realistic numbers for operation parameters. The lectures can be recommended without constraint especially to advanced students who look for a broad overview of modern laser physics and technology.

default.zh: 信息光学是傅立叶光学与电子学中的通信理论相结合的新学科，是现代光学的核心内容之一。它应用电子学中的通信理论和系统理论以及数学上的傅里叶分析（频谱分析）方法来研究光学问题，包括光波的传播、光波的衍射、波前的记录和再现、透镜的傅里叶变换性质、光学成像系统的频率响应特性和相干空间滤波等问题。 本课程的主要内容包括傅立叶光学的数学基础和空间频率的概念，二维光学图像的傅立叶变换及其性质，光波传播的系统理论、标量衍射理论和衍射的角谱理论，薄透镜的相位调制作用以及薄透镜的傅立叶变换性质和成像性质，光学成像系统的频率响应特性，包括衍射受限的相干成像系统的频率响应及相干传递函数，衍射受限的非相干成像系统的频率响应及光学传递函数，光学全息的基本原理及其应用，傅立叶变换全息图的实现和分析，相干光学信息处理系统及空间频率平面的确定，空间滤波的傅立叶分析和应用等。 本课程教学的主要目的是使学生了解光学信息频谱分析的方法和光学信息处理技术及其在科研、生产中的广泛应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生理解和掌握信息光学的基本原理、概念，培养学生解决问题的能力，激发学生对光学专业的浓厚兴趣。
default.en: Information Optics is an important branch of modern optics, and a new subject which combines Fourier optics and communication theory in electronics. Information Optics treats the optical problems with the communication theory and system theory in electronics, Fourier analysis (spectrum analysis) in mathematics, including the propagation of light wave, the diffraction of light wave, the recording and reconstruction of wavefront, the Fourier transformation characteristic of lens, the frequency response characteristic of optical imaging system, the coherent spatial filtering, and so on. The main content of the course includes: the mathematical fundamentals of Fourier optics and the concept of spatial frequency, the Fourier transformation of two dimensional optical images and its properties, the system theory, scalar diffraction theory and the angular spectrum theory of diffraction, the phase modulation function of ideal thin lens and its Fourier transformation and imaging characteristics, the frequency response characteristic of optical imaging system, including the coherent transfer function for the diffraction-limited coherent imaging system and the optical transfer function for the diffraction-limited incoherent imaging system, the basic principles and applications of optical holography, the realization and analysis of Fourier transform hologram, the coherent optical information processing system and the determination of spatial frequency plane, the Fourier analysis of spatial filtering and its application. The main purpose the course teaching is to let students understand the method of optical spectrum analysis, understand the technique of optical information processing and its application in scientific research and daily life, understand and know the basic idea, concept of information optics, cultivate the skill of solving problems, excite the interesting in studying the major of optics.

default.zh: “专业物理实验”将为应用物理专业的学生提供学习实验物理的机会。通过从现代物理学的几个子领域中选择的实验，学生们将获得一些特殊科学研究技术的经验，并在这一过程中学习一些新的物理学。眼前的问题不是重做旧的实验，而是有机会在实验室环境中探索物理现象，进行仔细的测量，并对描述这些现象的模型和理论得出自己的结论，并在这个过程中加深学生对实验和理论之间关系的理解。
default.en: “Professional Physics Experiments” will give the students who major in Applied Physics the opportunity to learn about doing experimental physics. By working through experiments chosen from several sub-fields of modern physics, the students will gain experience in some of the special techniques of scientific research and learn some new physics along the way. The issue at hand is not to redo old experiments but rather to have a chance to explore physical phenomena in a laboratory setting, making careful measurements, and drawing their own conclusions about the models and theories which are supposed to describe these phenomena and, in the process, deepening students’ understanding of the relations between experiment and theory.

default.zh: 实践教学是拔尖人才培养的重要环节。本课程面向物理学院本科生光电类的实验实训需求，围绕光电相关理论教学内容进行设计，为多门专业课程教学提供支撑。 本课程的教学内容涉及激光器的原理与电光、磁光、声光调控，光电器件的基本特性，光学干涉、衍射的测量应用，光场调控、傅里叶变换，数字全息记录和再现，光纤及基本有源、无源器件的制作，光纤通信、传感，以及双目三维成像等多个方面的内容。实验设计既突出基础理论和物理内涵，又涉及光电相关领域的最新技术和应用，可为学生的毕业设计和科学研究奠定基础。 本课程的目的是使学生学习近代科技中典型的实验方法和手段，掌握复杂仪器的操作和使用，培养从复杂实验现象中发现和解决本质问题的能力，培养端正的科学态度，养成严肃认真的科学作风，具备团结合作、共同进取的良好品德。通过本课程的学习，使学生加深对理论知识的理解和掌握，激发学生对光电领域的研究兴趣。
default.en: Practical teaching is important in cultivating top-notch talents. This course is aimed at the experimental and practical training needs of undergraduate students in the field of optoelectronics in the School of Physics. It is designed around the theoretical teaching content of optoelectronics, providing support for the teaching of multiple professional courses. The content of this course involves the principles of lasers and electro-optic, magneto-optical, and acousto-optic regulation, basic characteristics of optoelectronic devices, measurement applications of optical interference and diffraction, optical field regulation, Fourier transform, digital holographic recording and reconstruction, production of optical fibers and basic active and passive devices, fiber communication, sensing, and binocular 3D imaging, among other aspects. The experimental design not only highlights the basic theoretical and physical connotations, but also involves the latest technologies and applications in the field of optoelectronics, which can lay the foundation for students' graduation projects and scientific research. The purpose of this course is to enable students to learn typical experimental methods and methods in modern technology, master the operation and use of complex instruments, cultivate the ability to discover and solve essential problems from complex experimental phenomena, cultivate a correct scientific attitude, cultivate a serious and serious scientific style, and possess good moral character of unity, cooperation, and common progress. Through the study of this course, students will deepen their understanding and mastery of theoretical knowledge, and stimulate their research interest in the field of optoelectronics.

default.zh: 半导体物理一方面是现代科学的重要组成部分，另一方面是大多数现代技术的基本基础。我们的日常生活中生产和使用了数十亿个由半导体制成的设备。本课程致力于半导体的主要物理特性、器件制造中使用的主要工艺以及半导体的基础科学研究。包括半导体的电子性质、电荷载流子统计、电场和磁场中的主要电荷传输过程以及半导体的光学性质。
default.en: Physics of semiconductors is an important part of a modern science in one hand and a fundamental basis for most of modern technologies in another hand. Billions of devices made of semiconductors are produced and used in our everyday life. This course is devoted to the main physical properties of semiconductors and main processes which are employed in device fabrication as well as basic science investigations of semiconductors. Electronic properties of semiconductors, charge carrier statistics and main charge transport processes in electric and magnetic field as well as optical properties of semiconductors are included.

default.zh: 原子核物理是处理微观领域问题的重要工具。原子核物理以原子核为研究对象，包括原子核的结构、核反应和核子间相互作用等，是一门内容异常丰富、理论和应用十分重要的前沿学科。原子核物理是从事核物理实验与理论研究、核工程设计与管理、核技术应用与开发等专业的一门重要的基础课。主要包括以下内容：原子核组成与静态性质、原子核结合能、液滴模型、核力的基本性质、放射性原子核衰变规律，α衰变、β衰变和γ衰变的机理，核反应基本原理，核反应类型、模型、反应截面和中子核反应机制、核裂变、核聚变原理。
default.en: The nuclear physics is an important tool processing questions in the microscopic field. Nuclear physics takes nucleus as the research object, including nuclear structure, nuclear reactions and nuclear interactions, is extraordinarily rich content cutting-edge disciplines. Its theory and application are very important. Nuclear physics is an important fundamental course for engaging in nuclear physics experiments and theoretical research, design and management of nuclear engineering, nuclear technology application and development and other professional courses. The contents include: nuclear composition and static nature, nuclear binding energy, droplet model, the fundamental nature of nuclear forces, the law of decay of radioactive nuclei, α, β, γ and other decay mechanism, the basic principles of nuclear reactions, the nuclear reactions type, model, cross sections and neutron nuclear reaction mechanisms, nuclear fission and principle.

default.zh: 本课程提供了软物质物理学中热点问题领域的基本信息，即聚合物和液晶的物理化学领域。 聚合物在自然界和人类活动中的重要性很难高估。生物聚合物是地球上所有生命的基础。合成聚合物是人类在各个领域使用的主要材料。本课程阐述了高分子化合物的性质和聚合物分子的性质的基本概念，这些概念决定了基于高分子化合物的材料的独特特性。简要介绍了聚合物的结构特征及其合成方法；给出了溶液中大分子的统计和热力学的基本信息。充分详细地描述了溶液中大分子平移和旋转摩擦理论的基本原理，使人们能够获得大分子的基本特性。考虑了与聚合物分子的光学、电光特性有关的问题。 长期以来，液晶一直是创建各种信息显示设备（指示器、显示器等）以及各种传感器、调制器和其他主要是光学设备的基础。本课程介绍了LC的基本分类，概述了它们的主要物理特性，这些特性是创建显示器的基础。简要介绍了创建和改进液晶单元的方法。
default.en: The course provides basic information in the field of topical issues in the soft matter physics, namely, in the field of physical chemistry of polymers and liquid crystals. The importance of polymers in nature and human activity is difficult to overestimate. Biopolymers are the basis of all life on Earth. Synthetic polymers are the main materials used by man in various fields. The course sets out the basic ideas about the nature of high molecular compounds, the properties of polymer molecules, which determine the unique characteristics of the materials created on their basis. Structural features of polymers and methods of their synthesis are briefly described; basic information on the statistics and thermodynamics of macromolecules in solutions is given. The basic principles of theories of translational and rotational friction of macromolecules in solutions are described in sufficient detail, allowing one to obtain the basic characteristics of macromolecules. Issues related to the optical, electro-optical properties of polymer molecules are considered. Liquid crystals have long been the basis for the creation of various information display devices (indicators, displays, etc.), as well as various sensors, modulators, and other, primarily optical, devices. The course gives the basics of the classification of LC, outlines their main physical characteristics that underlie the created displays. Briefly presented are the ways of creating and improving liquid crystal cells.

default.zh: 核电子学是在核辐射探测技术和电子技术基础上发展起来的电子学与核科学间的一门交叉学科。核电子学形成于50年代，本课程的主要目的是使学生理解和掌握核电子学的基本原理、概念和方法，熟悉和运用基本电路单元，学会和掌握核仪器设备的使用，培养学生具有独立地手动能力和解决实际问题的能力。核电子学是今后从事核物理事业的教学人员、研究人员和工程技术人员的必备基础。本着由浅入深的思路，本课程的课程安排如下：辐射探测器的输出信号和前置放大器，线性脉冲放大器，单道脉冲幅度分析器，定标器，线性率表电路，直流放大器，稳压电源，多道脉冲幅度分析器。
default.en: Nuclear Electronics is a cross-discipline of nuclear science and electronics developed on the basis of nuclear radiation detection and electronic technologies. Nuclear Electronics was formed in the 50's. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand and master the fundamental principles of nuclear electronics， concepts and methods and make students familiar with and apply the basic circuit units, study and master the uses of nuclear equipments and train students the ability to manual independently and the ability solving practical problems. Nuclear electronics is the essential basis for the people engaging in the cause of nuclear physics teaching staff, researchers and engineers. In line with the principle of penetrating deeply step by step, the curriculum is as follows: Radiation detectors and pre-amplifier output signal, linear pulse amplifier, single channel pulse height analyzer, scalar, linear rate of the table circuits, DC amplifiers, regulated power supply, multi-channel pulse amplitude analyzer.

default.zh: 物理学的哲学问题是一门重要的本科生基础课。原子物理学也称为量子物理学或现代物理学。本课程简要介绍相对论理论和原子物理学中提出的一些认识论问题。在这门课程中有许多问题需要讨论：从具体的相对论理论开始。相对论宇宙学提出了奇点的问题。原子物理学与确定性描述的哲学问题密切相关。本课程的主要内容包括爱因斯坦相对论理论的哲学问题，以及从哲学角度对量子力学和原子物理公设的解释。
default.en: The philosophical problems of physics is an important basic course for undergraduates. The atomic physics is also referred to as the quantum physics, or the modern physics. This course gives a brief survey of some epistemological problems raised in relativistic theory and in atomic physics. There are many problems to be discussed in this course: started from the beginning of the specific relativistic theory. The relativistic cosmology raised the problem of singularity. The atomic physics is closely connected with the philosophical problem of deterministic description. The main content of this course includes the philosophical problems of Einstein’s relativistic theory and interpretation of the postulates of quantum mechanics and atomic physics from philosophical point of view.

default.zh: 核电子学实验是核物理专业的一门重要专业课。核电子学实验可以使学生掌握专门实验 、增强理论与实验相结合的能力，提高学生综合利用理论知识、实验技术和计算机技术解决问题的能力和动手能力。本课程强调掌握实验原理、目的和实验方法。通过本实验课程教学，学生可以加深对专业知识的理解和掌握，掌握相关仪器设备的工作原理和使用方法，学会相关仪器的配套组合并进行相关的测量，了解和掌握核探测器及相关电子器件的性能和应用，掌握实验的关键技术。
default.en: Nuclear electronics experiment is an important specialized course for nuclear physics majors. It can enable students to master specialized experiments, enhance the ability of combining theory with experiment, and improve students' ability to solve problems and practice by comprehensively using theoretical knowledge, experimental technology and computer technology. This course emphasizes mastering experimental principles, objectives and methods. Through the teaching of this experimental course, students can deepen their understanding and mastery of professional knowledge, master the working principle and usage of relevant instruments and equipment, learn the matching combination of relevant instruments and make relevant measurements, understand and master the performance and application of nuclear detectors and related electronic devices, and master the key technologies of the experiment.

default.zh: 核物理专业实验是核物理专业的一门重要专业实验课。本课程培养了学生使用核物理相关实验仪器的能力，并且使学生了解实验误差产生的基本原因和分析处理的方法。通过这门课程的教学，学生能够提高综合利用理论知识和实验技术解决问题的能力，学会和掌握实验数据的处理和分析。本课程强调掌握实验原理、目的和实验方法。通过本实验课程教学，学生可以加深对专业知识的理解和掌握，掌握相关仪器设备的工作原理和使用方法，学会相关仪器的配套组合并进行相关的测量，了解和掌握核探测器及相关电子器件的性能和应用，掌握实验的关键技术。
default.en: Experiments of Nuclear Physics is important course of specialty experiment. It cultivates the ability of students to use the experimental instruments and make students to know about the basic reason of the experimental errors and know how to tackle these them. Through this course, students could strengthen the ability of using the theoretical and experimental knowledge, to solve problem. This course emphasizes on the experimental principles, purposes and methods. After this course, students should improve the understanding of specified knowledge, know the working principle and usage of related equipment, have the ability of combining several equipment to do related measurement, learn the performance and application of nuclear detectors and related electronic devices and master the experimental key skills.

default.zh: “专业物理实验”课程可以让学生在实验室环境中探索物理现象，对描述这些现象的模型和理论得出自己的结论，并在这个过程中加深学生对实验和理论之间关系的理解。本课程所涉及的物理知识内容较深，并具有较强的专业性和技术性。通过从现代物理学各领域中选择的实验，进一步丰富和活跃学生的物理思想，培养他们观察和分析物理现象的能力，把握现象的本质和产生机理；引导他们认识到实验物理在物理新学科的产生、形成和发展过程中所发挥的重要作用；学习专业物理研究中常用的方法、技术、仪器和知识，进一步培养学生正确的和良好的实验习惯以及严谨的科学作风，使学生获得具有一般专业水平的用实验方法和技术研究物理现象和规律的独立工作能力，为学生从事专业、科研、应用和发展新技术打好坚实的物理实验基础。
default.en: "Professional Physics Experiments" course allows students to explore physical phenomena in a laboratory environment, draw their own conclusions about the models and theories that describe these phenomena, and deepen their understanding of the relationship between experiments and theories in this process. The physics knowledge involved in this course is deep and has strong professionalism and technical skills. By selecting experiments from various fields of modern physics, further enriching and activating students' physical thinking, cultivating their ability to observe and analyze physical phenomena, grasping the essence and mechanism of phenomena; Guide them to recognize the important role played by experimental physics in the emergence, formation, and development of new physics disciplines; Learn the commonly used methods, techniques, instruments, and knowledge in professional physics research, further cultivate students' correct and good experimental habits, as well as rigorous scientific work style, so that they can acquire independent work ability to study physical phenomena and laws using experimental methods and techniques at a general professional level, and lay a solid foundation for students to engage in professional, scientific research, application, and development of new technologies in physics experiments.

default.zh: 《现代光学测量原理与技术B》课程注重光学基本理论与应用紧密结合，重点介绍了光学精密测试所涉及的光学测量方法及其特点，对在工业、军事、生物和医学等领域进行光学精密测试具有较高的参考价值。本课程首先讲述现代光学测量的发展现状与趋势、光学测量方法的分类、光学测量系统的典型类别，从光源到探测的匹配应用对典型光学测量系统进行了举例分析。然后分别讲述光干涉测量技术、激光全息测量技术、激光衍射测量技术以及激光测距和测速技术。通过学习本课程使学生掌握现代光学测量技术的基本概念和原理，能够自行分析和设计所需的光学测试系统，切实提高学生独立分析和解决光学测量问题的能力。
default.en: The course 《Principle and Technology of Modern Optical Measurement B》combines theory with technical applications, and focuses on the methods and their characteristics of optical precision measurement. It’s important for applications in industry, military, life science, medicine, and so on. In this course, we firstly introduce the fundamental of modern optical measurement technique, including the categories, system composing and the future trends. Typical optical measuring systems are analyzed with examples, and light sources, detectors and the match for both are highlighted. Then we introduce the laser interference, hologram, diffraction, ranging and speed measurement technologies. The course will give the students a theoretical background for analyze and design an optical measurement system independently, and improve the ability of analyzing and solving problems during optical testing by one’s own.

default.zh: “专业物理实验”将为应用物理专业的学生提供学习实验物理的机会。通过从现代物理学的几个子领域中选择的实验，学生们将获得一些特殊科学研究技术的经验，并在这一过程中学习一些新的物理学。眼前的问题不是重做旧的实验，而是有机会在实验室环境中探索物理现象，进行仔细的测量，并对描述这些现象的模型和理论得出自己的结论，并在这个过程中加深学生对实验和理论之间关系的理解。
default.en: “Professional Physics Experiments” will give the students who major in Applied Physics the opportunity to learn about doing experimental physics. By working through experiments chosen from several sub-fields of modern physics, the students will gain experience in some of the special techniques of scientific research and learn some new physics along the way. The issue at hand is not to redo old experiments but rather to have a chance to explore physical phenomena in a laboratory setting, making careful measurements, and drawing their own conclusions about the models and theories which are supposed to describe these phenomena and, in the process, deepening students’ understanding of the relations between experiment and theory.

default.zh: 本课程是物理学院中俄联合培养本科生的专业课，具体形式包括讲座、参观、座谈、实践等形式。由学科或方向的负责人介绍学科研究方向、国内外现状和发展趋势；有针对性的定点参观，熟悉实验环境和实验仪器；与有经验的老师进行座谈交流，深入理解专业背景和应用，探讨人生的价值；进入实验室、研究室，了解先进的仪器设备运行原理操作方法，亲手操作仪器设备。通过本课程的学习使学生深入社会实践，了解生产、开发或科研的具体过程，学习实践经验，扩大知识面，深化理论知识，促进理论与实践结合。深入了解专业历史、专业背景，学习老一代科学家科技兴国无私奉献的科学精神，增强学生的民族自豪感和历史责任感。加强了解专业及其应用领域的研究现状和未来发展趋势，使学生自主制定合理的未来发展规划，树立正确的世界观和价值观，增强适应社会的能力。
default.en: This course is a professional course for China-Russia joint training undergraduate students in school of physics, with specific forms including lectures, visits, discussions, and practical exercises. The person in charge of the discipline or direction introduce the research direction, domestic and international status, and development trends of the discipline or direction; By fixed-point visits, the students are familiarized with the experimental environment and instruments; The students are engaged in discussions and exchanges with experienced teachers to gain a deeper understanding of professional backgrounds and applications, and explore the value of life; By entering the laboratory and research room, the students can understand the principles and methods of advanced instruments and equipment, and operate the instruments and equipment by themselves. By the study of this course, the students will involve into social practice, understand the specific processes of production, development, or scientific research, learn practical experience, expand their knowledge, deepen theoretical knowledge, and promote the integration of theory and practice. The students will deeply understand the history and background of the specialty, learn the scientific spirit of selfless dedication of the older generation of scientists in promoting science and technology, and enhance the sense of national pride and historical responsibility. The students will strengthen the understanding of the current research status and future development trends in the specialty and its application fields, enable themselves to independently formulate reasonable future development plans, establish correct world view and values system, and enhance their ability to adapt to society.

default.zh: 研究实践讲座是应用物理学（中外合作）专业学生的一门必修课，包括8个物理学前沿领域的研究现状及关键技术介绍，通过这门课的学习，可以使学生（1）对现代技术的过程和问题进行跨学科分析；（2）在基础知识、材料科学和现代应用的基础上，培养学生在应用物理各个领域的导航能力；（3）了解科学研究在国民经济、人类生活、科学研究、军事等领域的重要作用。
default.en: Research Practice Lecture is a compulsory course for students majoring in Applied Physics (Sino foreign Cooperation), which includes an introduction to the research status and key technologies in 8 cutting-edge fields of physics. Through this course, students can (1) conduct interdisciplinary analysis of the processes and problems of modern technology;？(2) On the basis of basic knowledge, materials science, and modern applications, cultivate students' navigation abilities in various fields of applied physics;？(3) Understand the important role of scientific research in national economy, human life, scientific research, military and other fields.

default.zh: 固态核磁共振光谱学的主要目标是：让学生对固体磁共振研究方法有总体认识；掌握核磁共振、核四极矩共振、穆斯堡尔谱学等多种技术的特性及其在固体研究中的应用；教会学生从实验数据中提取材料结构与电子性质的基本信息，并能在后续专业活动中运用所获技能。
default.en: The main goal of the discipline is to provide students with a general understanding of magnetic resonance methods for studying solids; to show the features of various techniques, including nuclear magnetic resonance, nuclear quadrupole resonance, Mossbauer spectroscopy, and their applications for studying solids; to teach them how to extract basic information about the structure and electronic properties of materials under study from experimental data and use the acquired skills in subsequent professional activities.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生对俄罗斯艺术文化的基本认识。课程和课程目标是让学生熟悉俄罗斯文化中最重要的现象，提供文化和艺术领域的知识，形成分析艺术作品的技能和能力，提供文化术语领域的基本知识。在学习过程中，学生将熟悉与俄罗斯文化相关的主要国家现实，熟悉俄罗斯艺术、文化和文学领域的顶尖大师的杰作及其作品的具体特点。因此，该门课程将发展学生对于艺术史、文学史和文化史的基本能力。
default.en: The course is aimed at forming students' basic ideas about Russian art culture. The course and program objective is to acquaint students with the most important phenomena of Russian culture, to provide knowledge in the field of culture and art, to form skills and abilities to analyze a work of art, to provide basic knowledge in the field of cultural terminology. In the course of study students will familiarize themselves with the main country realities related to the culture of Russia, with the masterpieces of the leading masters of art, culture and literature of Russia and the specific features of their works. Thus, students will develop basic competencies in the history of art, literature and culture.

default.zh: 导波光学主要研究光在部分受限空间或结构中的传播特性，与光在自由空间中的传播行为有很大的不同，是光子芯片应用技术以及微纳光子学基础研究领域的核心课程，也是物理学相关专业不可或缺的知识构成部分。通过对本课程的学习，学生能够深入理解有关光波导的重要概念和理论分析方法，掌握典型波导及波导器件的工作原理、光在波导结构中传播的基本特性，并且能够设计基本的光波导结构与器件。本课程以导波光学的基本原理和典型应用为主要内容，包括平面介质光波导的传输及耦合特性，包括波导色散方程的推导和求解，本征模和有效传播常数的概念，以及基于平面波导的常用光子器件；同时矩形和圆形介质光波导的基本传输特性和模式特点也是重要内容；此外，近年来发展的金属表面等离激元波导、光子晶体光波导、拓扑光波导等，这些新型波导结构的传输特性，波导模式存在的条件，色散方程及本征模特性等内容也有讲解。本课程采用累加式方法计算总成绩，综合考虑平时成绩及期末考试。
default.en: Guided wave optics (GWO) emphasizes on the properties of light propagation in partially confined spaces or structures, which are quite different from those in free spaces. GWO is one of the key core courses for the photonic chip technology and fundamental researches in nanophotonics, and is also an indispensable part in knowledge system for majorities in physics. Through the study of this course, students will deep understand the conceptions and methods in GWO, mastering the operation principles and propagation properties of light in waveguides. Also, the design of waveguides should also be understood by the students. The main contents of this course include the fundamental theories and applications of GWO, including the propagation and coupling of planar waveguides. In this part, the students should derive and solve the dispersion equation of the waveguide, and clearly understand the conception of eigen mode and effective propagation constant, and the functional devices based on the optical waveguides. Further, the properties of rectangular waveguide and circular fiber are also vital in this course. In addition, for the surface plasmonic polariton waveguide, photonic crystal waveguide, topological waveguide proposed recently, the exist conditions of guiding mode, dispersion equations, and the properties of eigenmodes will be covered also. The final score of this course is accumulated by two parts of usual performances and the final examination.

default.zh: 生命安全培训的目标是形成在紧急情况（紧急情况）下具有人、社会和环境综合保护领域高等教育的专家的安全型人格、思想态度、基本知识、技能和能力，该专家具有健康生活方式和保健技术的技能，并熟悉劳动保护的要求。 通过培训，形成了有效的专业活动与确保人的安全、环境以及物质和文化价值不受各种自然威胁的要求不可分割的统一思想，并使毕业生准备使用主要的保护方法，免受自然、人为、生物、社会和军事政治紧急情况的可能后果。
default.en: The goal of life safety training is to form the qualities of a safe type of personality, ideological attitudes, basic knowledge, skills, and abilities of a specialist with higher education in the field of comprehensive protection of man, society, and the environment in emergency situations (emergencies), who has the skills of a healthy lifestyle and health-saving technologies and is familiar with the requirements of labour protection. As a result of the training, the formation of an idea of the inseparable unity of effective professional activity with the requirements of ensuring safety and security of the man, the environment, and material and cultural values from threats of various nature is achieved and the readiness of the graduate to use the main methods of protection from the possible consequences of natural, man-made, biological, social, and military-political emergencies is ensured.

default.zh: 本课程首先介绍有关光电功能材料现状，如电光材料、压电及热电材料、光信息材料等；在光电材料的性质方面介绍材料的介电性质、压电性质、电光性质及材料的一些非线性效应，如电光效应、弹光效应、声光效应等；非线性光学性质包括非线性光学极化、相位匹配等；然后介绍光电功能陶瓷、单晶的制备方法及光电功能材料的性质检测技术。在对有机、无机等光电功能材料深入讲授的基础上，介绍各种力、热、光、电、热等高性能如光开关、调制器、偏转器等。 《光电功能材料与器件》是专业限选课，除了讲授相关的基础知识外，还将介绍学生毕业后走向工作岗位可能需要的相关知识和技术，提高学生的学习兴趣。
default.en: First, the course introduces the current conditions of optical-electric functional materials, such as electro-optic materials, piezoelectric materials and Optical information material，etc. About the properties of the optical-electro functional materials, we focus on the dielectric, piezoelectric, electro-optic properties and other nonlinear effects. For example, electro-optic effects and Elastic light effect, acoustooptic effect. Nonlinear optical properties include nonlinear optical polarization, phase matching and so on. Second, the growth methods and Property detection technology of optical-electro functional ceramics, single crystal are described. Based on the in depth study of organic and inorganic photoelectric functional materials, we introduce the high-performance optical switches, modulators, deflectors, etc The course of Optical-Electric Functional Materials and Device is the Major required course, In addition to teaching the relevant basic knowledge not only the interrelated rudiments should be introduce, we will also introduce relevant knowledge and skills that students may need to move into the workplace after graduation.

default.zh: 本课程旨在系统掌握俄罗斯从古代至现代的历史。通过学习，学生将理解俄罗斯历史的核心议题及其在世界历史进程中的地位，研究俄罗斯国家形态形成与发展的广泛问题，掌握有关该国社会政治、社会经济及文化历史最新学术研究成果。 课程同时涵盖国家疆域形成的独特性、政治经济发展特征及文化传统等专题内容，特别关注俄罗斯历史上形成的多民族国家特性，以及不同族群间相互包容的传统。
default.en: The objective of this course is to provide a systematic understanding of Russian history. Through this course, students will comprehend the core issues of Russian history and its place in the global historical process, examine a wide range of topics related to the formation and development of the Russian state, and master the latest academic research findings concerning the country's socio-political, socio-economic, and cultural history. The curriculum also covers specialized content including the distinct characteristics of national territorial formation, features of political and economic development, and cultural traditions. Particular attention is paid to Russia's historically formed characteristics as a multi-ethnic state and the tradition of mutual tolerance among different ethnic groups.

default.zh: 计算光学成像在光学基础上，融入多维光学信息，如相位、偏振、轨道角动量等物理量，以信息传递为计算主线，结合数学和信息处理技术感知光场信息，解译和获取更高维度的数据信息。这种成像技术是光学、计算机、信息等学科交叉而形成的。计算光学成像技术正朝着更高分辨率、更远作用距离、更广观察视场、更小结构体积、更强环境适应方向发展。《计算光学成像原理与技术》课程在已修过的数学分析、线性代数、光学等课程基础上，介绍计算光学成像原理、技术、应用。学习计算光学成像的数值算法，应用光学衍射、光学元件的数学模型与算法解决不同光学成像系统中的信息处理问题，为光学成像领域创新性人才储备信息理论和计算技术。 本课程具体内容包括计算光学成像理论、技术、应用。理论部分内容包括以快速傅里叶变换、角谱等技术的计算光学成像方法。计算光学成像包括关联成像(鬼成像)、压缩感知成像、CT成像、计算全息成像、非视域成像、编码孔径成像、相位成像、光场相机、自适应光学成像、合成孔径成像、受激发损耗显微成像、偏振成像等为例，讲授计算光学成像原理与技术，使学生具备从基础数学和光学理论到应用研究转化的基础能力、创新意识、科研认知。
default.en: On the basis of optics, computational optical imaging integrates multi-dimensional optical information, such as phase, polarization, orbital angular momentum and other physical quantities, takes information transmission as the main line of calculation, and combines mathematics and information processing technology to perceive light field information. interpret and obtain higher-dimensional data information. This kind of imaging technology is formed by the intersection of optics, computer, information and other disciplines. Computational optical imaging technology is developing in the direction of higher resolution, longer operating distance, wider field of view, smaller structural volume and stronger environmental adaptation. The course “principles and techniques of Computational Optical Imaging” introduces the principle, technology and application of computational optical imaging on the basis of mathematical analysis, linear algebra, optics and other courses. Learn the numerical algorithm of computational optical imaging, apply the mathematical models and algorithms of optical diffraction and optical elements to solve the problems of information processing in different optical imaging systems, and reserve information theory and computing technology for innovative talents in the field of optical imaging. The specific content of this course includes the theory, technology and application of computational optical imaging. The theoretical part includes the computational optical imaging method based on fast Fourier transform, angular spectrum and so on. Computational optical imaging includes correlation imaging (also called as ghost imaging), compressed sensing imaging, CT imaging, computer holographic imaging, non-field imaging, coded aperture imaging, phase imaging, light field camera, adaptive optical imaging, synthetic aperture imaging, excited loss microscopic imaging, polarization imaging, etc., as examples, teach the principles and techniques of computational optical imaging. So that students have the basic ability, innovative consciousness and scientific research cognition to transform from basic mathematics and optical theory to applied research.

default.zh: 该课程的主要目标是让学生熟悉圣彼得堡国立大学的历史，了解在圣彼得堡国立大学工作的著名科学家在不同时期和年份的活动，展示圣彼得堡国立大学对俄罗斯文化发展的贡献。为了实现这一目标，设定了以下任务：讲述大学和科学院的历史思想，讲述彼得大帝在教育和科学领域的改革，讲述大学第一批教授的活动，讲述凯瑟琳大帝时期和俄罗斯历史上其他时期大学的发展；讲述与圣彼得堡国立大学有关的文化、文学和艺术人物的传记，介绍他们的主要作品；以展示圣彼得堡州立大学如今的文化和艺术发展。学生将获得文化研究、艺术和文学领域的新知识，发展文化分析的基本能力。
default.en: The main goal of the course is to familiarize students with the history of St. Petersburg State University, to give information about the activities of famous scientists who worked at St. Petersburg State University in different epochs and years, to show the contribution of St. Petersburg State University to the development of Russian culture. To realize this goal the following tasks are set: to tell about the idea of the history of the university and the Academy of Sciences, about the reforms of Peter the Great in the field of education and science, about the activity of the first professors of the university, about the development of the university during the period of Catherine the Great and other epochs in the history of Russia; to tell about the figures of culture, literature and art, whose biography was connected with St. Petersburg State University, to present their main works; to show how culture and art are developing in St. Petersburg State University nowadays. Students will gain new knowledge in the field of cultural studies, art and literature, develop basic competencies in cultural analysis.

default.zh: 纳米科学技术是现代科学技术的重要前沿领域，也是一个多学科交叉科学领域。纳米科学技术导论课程主要讲授纳米科学技术的基本概念和原理以及涉及的技术方法， 其目的是使学生对纳米科学与技术具有一个比较全面的认识，了解纳米科学与技术的研究背景和前沿进展，掌握纳米科学中涉及的基本物理概念和原理，熟悉纳米技术的相关应用，进而加深学生对于已经学习的物理知识的认识和理解，为学生未来的毕业论文课题研究、学习和工作提供必要的知识积累。课程主要包括纳米科学与技术概述、纳米结构单元、纳米科学的基本理论、纳米材料的制备技术、纳米材料的检测分析技术、和纳米材料的特性与应用。
default.en: Nanoscience and nanotechnology is a cutting edge and interdisciplinary branch of modern science and technology. The course of Introduction to Nanoscience and Nanotechnology is to deliver undergraduates a full knowledge of nanoscience and nanotechnology, to introduce its background and development trends, the basic physical principles of nanoscience, and the application of nanotechnology, thus to improve students’ understanding on physics, and to serve for their research work in the near future. The course includes concepts and background of nanoscience and nanotechnology, nanostructure units, basic physical principles of nanoscience, synthesis techniques of nanomaterials, characterization techniques of nanomaterials, properties and applications of nanomaterials.

default.zh: 通过光与物质相互作用可以诱发新的物理和化学现象，进一步拓展人们认识材料和应用材料的新维度。现代光化学和光与物质相互作用理论是现代物理发展的成果，对电子激发态的研究所建立的新概念、新理论和新方法大大开拓了人们对物质认识的深度和广度,对了解自然界的光合作用和生命过程、对太阳能的利用、环境的保护、开创新的反应途径、寻求新的材料提供了重要基础,在新能源、新材料和信息处理新技术等高技术领域中发挥着越来越重要的作用。本课程是为物理系本科生开设的一门选修课。安排在第四学期，原子物理和光学等基础课程之后，我们结合物理专业的学科特点，对课程的结构进行了合理的优化和设置。主要内容包括化学键理论、分子轨道理论、化学热力学、化学动力学、激发态原理等基本知识，同时结合一些常见的光学材料的结构特点，揭示物质微观结构与性质的内在联系。课程从物质结构入手，层层深入，由基础理论逐渐拓展光电信息材料在相关领域的应用、光电器件结构和工作原理，从物质结构入手，层层深入，由基础理论逐渐拓展光电信息材料在相关领域的应用。
default.en: The interaction between light and matter can induce new physical and chemical phenomena, further expanding people's understanding and application of materials in new dimensions. Modern photochemistry and the theory of the interaction between light and matter are achievements of the development of modern physics. The new concepts, theories, and methods established in the study of electronic excited states have greatly improved understanding of matter. Achievements in the fields of photochemistry and photophysics are playing an increasingly important role in high-tech fields.This course is an interdisciplinary course for undergraduates majoring in Photoelectric Information Engineering and technology in the Department of Physics. It aims at introducing the optical phenomena and chemical reactions caused by the interaction between light and matter from the point of view of physics, especially optics, and expounding the important optical phenomena and the mechanism of photochemical reactions. The relationship between material structure and optical properties of materials is established. According to the characteristics of physics, this course will selectively introduce the basic knowledge of structural chemistry and chemical reaction, and appropriately introduce the preparation methods of materials chemistry which are interesting in the field of physics. The aim is to cultivate students'interest in photochemistry and improve their skills in solving chemical problems.

default.zh: 半导体物理学是近年来迅速发展的半导体技术及其产业的核心基础。本课程作为一门以应用为背景的基础技术课程，以半导体中的电子状态、半导体中杂质和缺陷能级、半导体中载流子的统计分布为基础理论，深入探讨半导体中载流子的漂移运动及对导电特性影响、非平衡载流子注入与复合基本物理过程。随后从半导体PN结的形成和杂质电荷分布、PN结能带图等基本物理机理出发，重点介绍非平衡状态下的理想PN结模型及其电流电压方程，从而分析影响PN结电流电压特性偏离理想方程的各种因素。 本课程的任务是使学生掌握半导体物理学这门课的基本概念、理论和方法，在教学中逐步提高学生对半导体物理问题的理解能力、推理能力、分析能力和计算能力。对于半导体的基本概念和理论要强调简明易懂和深入浅出，对于理论方法和问题分析的教学要着重在理论的清晰性和问题的具体性方面。要求学生基于半导体物理学的基础理论能够对半导体中载流子和PN结有机融合有较为透彻的理解和深刻的掌握。通过典型问题的重点教学，培养学生具备举一反三、触类旁通的深入学习和研究半导体物理的能力。为学生从事光电信息科学与工程方面的科研、教学及新型半导体器件研发奠定理论基础。
default.en: Semiconductor physics is the core foundation of semiconductor technology and semiconductor industry, which has developed rapidly in recent years. As a basic technical course with an application background, this course takes the electronic states in semiconductors, impurity and defect energy levels in semiconductors, and the statistical distribution of carriers in semiconductors as the basic theory, and provides an in-depth discussion of the drifting motion of carriers in semiconductors and its effect on the conductive properties, the basic physical processes of non-equilibrium carrier injection and compounding. The course then focuses on the ideal PN junction model and its current-voltage equations in a non-equilibrium state, starting from the formation of semiconductor PN junctions and the basic physical mechanisms such as impurity charge distribution and the PN junction energy band diagram, so as to analyze the various factors affecting the deviation of the PN junction current-voltage characteristics from the ideal equations. The task of this course is to enable students to master the basic concepts, theories and methods of the subject of semiconductor physics, and to gradually improve their understanding, reasoning, analyzing and computational skills of semiconductor physics problems. The basic concepts and theories of semiconductors are emphasized in terms of simplicity and depth, and the teaching of theoretical methods and problem analysis is focused on the clarity of theory and the specificity of problems. Students are required to have a thorough understanding and profound grasp of the organic fusion of carriers and PN junctions in semiconductors based on the fundamental theory of semiconductor physics. Through the focus on typical problems, students will be able to develop the ability to learn and study semiconductor physics in depth. This will provide students with the theoretical foundation for research and teaching in optoelectronic information science and engineering and for the development of new semiconductor devices.

default.zh: 本课程是光电信息科学与工程专业的专业选修课之一。生物光子学研究光和生物样品之间的相互作用，是融合了光子学和生物学的一个前沿交叉学科，是光子学在生物领域的延伸。光子学可以用于光学诊断和光学疗法；反过来，生物材料为未来的技术应用提供了一个新的光子介质。生物光子学导论课程的任务是系统讲解生物光子这一前沿交叉领域，包括光生物学，传统光学生物成像，扫描荧光共聚焦荧光成像，非线性光学显微成像，光学生物传感，光动力疗法，激光组织工程学，光镊和光剪和生物光子材料。本课程的目的是通过学习使学生理解生物光子学领域的各项技术及其基于的基本原理，了解生物光子学的最新进展，从而为从事生物光子学的研究和应用打下坚实的基础。本课程还将帮助学生了解科学研究的一般过程，激发学生对从事科学研究的兴趣。
default.en: The course of Introduction to Biophotonics is a one of the optional courses for the major of optoelectronic information science and engineering. Biophotonics deals with the interactions between light and biology specimens. It is an interdisciplinary subject combining photonics and biology, which is an extension of photonics into biology. Photonics can be used in optical diagnosis and optical therapy. Meanwhile, biomaterials provide a new optical medium for future technological applications. The course is to systematically teach biophotonics, which includes photobiology, traditional bioimaging, scanning confocal microscopy, nonlinear optical microscopy, optical biosensors, photodynamic therapy, laser tissue engineering, laser tweezers, laser scissors and biomaterials for photonics. The objective is to help students understand the various technology and the basic principles and know the recent progress, which could lay a strong foundation for biophotonics researches and applications. Meanwhile, this course will help students know how to do scientific research, and stimulate their interests in scientific researches.

default.zh: 《物理前沿与科学思想》课程通过系统介绍物理学院各前沿研究领域，助力本科生深度洞悉学院不同学科的特色优势，为其毕业设计选题、研究生阶段学习筑牢基础。
default.en: The course 《The Frontiers of Physics and Scientific Thought》 systematically introduces the cutting-edge research fields of the School of Physics, helping undergraduate students deeply understand the distinctive advantages of different disciplines within the school and laying a solid foundation for their graduation project topics and postgraduate studies.

default.zh: 本课程是面向大二、大三学生开设的小班课程，主要讲授光电传感材料与器件的物理基础与性能评估方法。从基本材料体系出发，探索不同材料、不同工作模式下光电传感方法与器件评估新方法。突出研究性、科学性和前沿科技。 目标1：通过讲授光电传感材料的物理效应，器件物理基础以及光学测试方法前沿知识和发展趋势，培养学生独立思考、解决问题以及科学研究能力。 目标2：结合实际测试方法讲授，培养学生理论联系实际的创新能力，培养发现问题，解决问题的研究能力，并能够准确表达学术成果的科技交流能力。
default.en: This course is a small-class course designed for sophomore and junior students, mainly covering the physical fundamentals and performance evaluation methods of photoelectric sensing materials and devices. Starting from basic material systems, it explores new methods for photoelectric sensing and device evaluation under different materials and working modes. It emphasizes research, scientificity and cutting-edge technology.

default.zh: ““高等光学”课程是物理学院光电信息科学与工程和应用物理专业本科生重要的专业基础课之一。本课程以光的电磁理论为主线，在经典物理学框架之内深层次揭示光的波动本性以及光波在各种线性介质和界面传播行为。课程主要内容包括光波的电磁理论描述；波动方程以及不同种类解的形式所表示的光波场的物理性质；光场偏振特性；光波在各向同性的电介质、金属及界面上的传播、反射和折射特性等。本课程旨在指导学生深入理解光的电磁波动理论的基本概念和基本物理规律，掌握一些典型的处理光学物理问题的数学方法，使学生建立一个完整系统的理论光学的框架，为深入学习现代光学（如非线性光学、量子光学、信息光学等）奠定扎实的理论基础。
default.en: 《Advanced Opticsis》is a fundamental course for the undergraduates majored in Opt-electric information Science and Engineering, and Applied Physics. Based on the electromagnetic theory of light, the course reveals the wave nature of light and the propagation properties in various linear media and on the surfaces. The course includes the electromagnetic descriptions of light, wave equation and its solutions, the characteristics of the different light fields, the propagation, reflection and refraction of light in dielectric media, metals and on the surfaces, polarization of light, and so on. The course motivates to instruct the undergraduates to understand the insights of fundamental concepts and physical laws of the electromagnetic waves, to grasp necessary mathematical methods of solving the problems of the Classical Optical Physics, and to establish an integral theory framework of theoretical optics. Such trainings will benefit the students for the further studies in modern optics such as Nonlinear Optics, Quantum Optics and Information Optics.

default.zh: 光纤光学是与光信息科学与技术的一些领域，包括光网络、光通信及现代光传感技术紧密联系的基础性课程之一，通过该课程的学习，学生将建立起对光纤的分类、传光机制，以及光纤的结构与组成等的清楚的认识；学生将掌握光纤的模式理论；了解光在光纤波导内的传输特性；学生将掌握基本光纤光学器件原理，包括无源器件（连接器、耦合器、光栅、干涉仪、偏振起偏与控制器），有源器件（光放大器、光纤激光器）以及交换器件（调制器，光开关、OADM，OXC）。学生将了解基于光纤的传感原理，把握现代光（纤）网络的构成及发展趋势。相信本课程对学生后续学业的发展和未来事业的方向定位起到一定的帮助作用。
default.en: Fiber Optics is one of the fundamental courses which is tightly related to some fields of science and technology of optical information，including optical network，optical communication and modern optical sensoring techniques. Via the course, the clear understanding for the classification, the mechanism of guiding light, the structure and composition of the fibers will be established. The students will comprehend the mode theory of fiber and master the transmission characteristics of light inner fiber waveguide. The students will make acquaintance of the principles of some basic fiber-optic components, such as passive (negative) components (connector, coupler, grating, interferometer, polarizer and polarization controller), active components (optical amplifier, fiber laser) and exchanging (switching) components (modulator, optical switch, OADM - Optical add-drop multiplexer, OXC – optical cross connector ). Through the course, the students will be familiar with the fiber-based sensor principle and master the construction of modern (optical) network and its development tendency. It is believed that this course will provide a certain assistance in determing the career direction to the students who will be engaged in the further study or to that who will take the position in the enterprises in the future.

default.zh: 现代仪器分析方法是物理系本科生的一门专业选修课，主要介绍科研中常用的各种现代分析测试技术与方法，帮助学生掌握这些分析测试技术的基本原理、测量方法和分析要点，为开展实验物理研究奠定技术基础。课程具体内容包括：（1） X-射线的衍射测试技术与数据分析；（2）电子光学基本原理、扫描电子显微镜、透射电子显微镜以及它们的应用；（3）扫描隧道显微镜、原子力显微镜、电化学显微镜、微区热分析、扫描近场光学显微镜等；（4）固体表面，电子能谱以及表面分析技术的应用；（5）多种使用现代分析仪器进行的成分分析技术。
default.en: Modern instrument analysis method is one of the selective courses for undergraduate students of Department of Physics. This course introduces many modern analysis techniques that are usually used in science research work, in order to help students to master the basic principles, testing method and main points of analysis as well as lay a foundation for the experimental physics research work. The course includes: (1) X-ray diffraction technology and the data analysis, (2) the principle of electron optics, scanning electron microscopy, transmission electron microscopy and their applications, (3) scanning tunnel microscopy, atom force microscopy, electrochemical microscopy, micro thermal analysis, scanning near field optical microscopy etc, (4) the characteristics of solid surface, electron energy spectrum and the applications of surface analysis technologies, (5) composition analysis technologies including aqueous solution analysis and some analysis methods using modern analyzers.

default.zh: 《等离子体物理》是应用物理学、核物理学及物理相关专业的一门专业选修课程。本课程的教学目的是通过学习使学生了解物质第四态—等离子态的基本性质和基本规律、了解等离子体物理发展的新趋势，培养等离子体物理相关人才。本课程讲授等离子体物理基本概念，介绍等离子体物理中的三种描述方法：单粒子方法、流体方法和动理学方法。要求学生掌握如何利用这三种方法来解决等离子物理中的基本问题；了解等离子体微观现象和宏观现象之间、快过程和慢过程之间的不同和联系。
default.en: Plasma physics is a specified optional course for applied physics major, nuclear physics major and other related majors in physics. The teaching purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the basic properties and laws of the fourth state of matter-plasma state, understand the new trend of plasma physics development, and cultivate plasma physics related talents through learning. This course teaches the basic concepts of plasma physics and introduces three description methods in plasma physics: single particle method, fluid method and kinetic method. Students are required to master how to use these three methods to solve basic problems in plasma physics; Understand the differences and connections between micro and macro phenomena of plasma and between fast and slow processes.

default.zh: 流体是相对于固体的普遍物质存在形态，包括液体、气体和等离子体，广泛存在于地表、地下、近地空间、星际空间、以及恒星、黑洞等天体，包含了物理学主要研究的一大类研究对象。流体物理是物理学的重要分支，是流体力学的基础，是物理、天文、化工、热动、航天等众多领域的基础。 本课程面向物理学院高年级本科生，主要讲授认识和描述流体的一般物理认知方法，通过对流体的物理和数学描述（第二章）、时空尺度分析和相似性（第三章）、波与不稳定性（第四章）、以及流体中的非线性过程（第五章）和求解方法（第六章）的学习，使同学们将所学的基本物理规律与奇异多样的物理过程相结合，切实提高同学们用物理规律认识、解释、利用和改造自然世界的能力，加深对物理和数学知识技能的理解，为未来逐渐开展自主科学研究打下基础。
default.en: Fluid is a universal form of matter relative to solid, including liquid, gas and plasma, which widely exists on the surface, underground, near Earth space, interstellar space, stars, black holes and other celestial bodies, including a large category of research objects in physics. Fluid physics is an important branch of physics, the basis of fluid mechanics, and the basis of many fields such as physics, astronomy, chemical engineering, thermal dynamics, aerospace, etc. This course is intended for senior undergraduates of the School of Physics. It mainly teaches general physical cognitive methods for understanding and describing fluids. Through the study of physical and mathematical description of fluids (Chapter 2), space-time scale analysis and similarity (Chapter 3), waves and instability (Chapter 4), and nonlinear processes in fluids (Chapter 5) and solution methods (Chapter 6), It will enable students to combine the basic physical laws they have learned with strange and diverse physical processes, effectively improve students' ability to understand, explain, use and transform the natural world with physical laws, deepen their understanding of physical and mathematical knowledge and skills, and lay a foundation for gradually developing independent scientific research in the future.

default.zh: 广义相对论是一种相对论性的引力理论，由爱因斯坦在1915年提出，目前成为描述引力相互作用的经典性场论。在爱因斯坦广义相对论的框架下，物质间的引力相互相互作用表现为时空的弯曲，能够用黎曼几何很好的描述，时空的曲率直接决定于其周围的物质（包括辐射）的能量与动量。目前，广义相对论已通过诸多实验检验，成为理解引力本质、描述宇宙的重要工具。本课程将从广义相对论的基本原理出发，简要介绍广义相对论的基本数学工具“黎曼几何”，介绍相对论性引力场中物质的运动，爱因斯坦引力场方程，引力波与黑洞物理的初步。
default.en: General relativity is a relativistic theory of gravity, which was proposed by Einstein in 1915 and is now a classical field theory describing gravitational interactions. Under the framework of Einstein's general theory of relativity, the gravitational interaction between matter is shown as the curvature of space-time, which can be well described by Riemann geometry. The curvature of space-time is directly determined by the energy and momentum of the surrounding matter (including radiation). At present, general relativity has passed many experimental tests and becomes an important tool to understand the nature of gravity and describe the universe. Starting from the basic principles of general relativity, this course will briefly introduce the basic mathematical tool of general relativity, "Riemann geometry", the motion of matter in the relativistic gravitational field, Einstein's gravitational field equations, gravitational waves and the preliminary physics of black holes.

default.zh: 《能源材料与物理》是物理学院的专业选修课。课程内容包括：（1）新能源概念与特点，物理学在能源科学中的重要作用；（2）离子导电与氧化物燃料电池物理机制；（3）嵌入化合物与锂离子电池的电极材料及其物理机制；（4）超级电容器概念及其物理原理；（5）半导体光伏效应与太阳电池材料；（6）氢能的概念、特点与应用，储氢材料；（7）核能材料的辐照效应、核燃料与核反应堆。
default.en: Energy materials and physics is one of the selective courses for the School of Physics. This course introduces the functional materials used in the new energy systems and devices, as well as the related basic physical principles, material systems, and some applications. This course includes: (1) the concept and characteristics of new energy, the essential effect of physics on energy science, (2) the physical mechanisms of fast ionic conduction, and solid oxide fuel cell, (3) intercalation compounds, the electrode materials, and the related physical mechanism of Lithium-ion battery, (4) the concept and mechanism of the supercapacitor, (5) photovoltaic effect of semiconductors and solar battery, (6) the concept, characteristics, and applications of hydrogen energy, hydrogen storage materials, (7) radiation effect of nuclear materials, nuclear fuel, and reactor.

default.zh: 加速器物理是物理学院本科生核物理轨道专业选修课。加速器物理以研究带电粒子在电磁场中加速和传输为对象。伴随着加速原理和技术的不断创新，新的加速器不断出现，性能不断提高。借助高性能的加速器，许多相关学科，如粒子物理、核物理、材料科学、生命科学、医药工程、食品科学等都得到了极大地丰富和发展。 本课程主要讲授加速器的基本理论、原理、结构和计算方法与工具。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握粒子加速和传输原理，对加速器理论和技术研究的最新进展有较为充分的了解，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，为利用加速器开展原子核物理、核技术应用方面的研究工作提供基础理论知识。 本课程在保持传统教学严谨、扎实等优点的基础上，使学生在掌握基本概念、原理、理论方法和计算工具的同时，了解相关领域的研究前沿和热点、以及与其它自然科学分支的联系，重点培养科学思维方法、创新意识和解决具体问题的能力，为后继课程的学习与未来的科研奠定坚实基础。
default.en: Accelerator physics is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in nuclear physics in the School of Physics. Accelerator physics focuses on studying the acceleration and transmission of charged particles in electromagnetic fields. With the continuous innovation of acceleration principle and technology, new accelerators continue to emerge and their performance continues to improve. With the help of high-performance accelerators, many related disciplines, such as particle physics, nuclear physics, material science, life science, medical engineering, food science, have been greatly enriched and developed. This course mainly teaches the basic theory, principle, structure and computing tools of the accelerator. This course enables students to master particle acceleration and transmission principles, fully understand the latest progress in accelerator theory and technology research, cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve problems, and provide basic theoretical knowledge for research on nuclear physics and nuclear technology applications using accelerators. On the basis of maintaining the advantages of rigorous and solid traditional teaching, this course enables students to master the basic concepts, principles, theoretical methods and computing tools, understand the research frontiers and hot-spots in related fields, as well as the links with other natural science branches, and focus on cultivating scientific thinking methods, innovation awareness and the ability to solve specific problems, so as to lay a solid foundation for the study of subsequent courses and future scientific research.

default.zh: 等离子体在自然界中普遍存在：事实上，宇宙中的大多数已知物质都处于电离状态，许多自然发生的等离子体，如太阳的表面区域、星际气体云和地球的磁层，都表现出由电和磁力的影响所产生的独特的等离子体动力学现象。等离子体物理学的发展既是为了提供对这些自然发生的等离子体的理解，也是为了推进对受控核聚变的追求。等离子体科学现在已被用于其他一些实际应用，如先进半导体芯片的蚀刻、等离子体除污等。本课程将介绍等离子体物理学的基本原理及其技术和应用。课程适合那些主要兴趣是气体放电、等离子体材料处理、电离层物理学、空间等离子体物理学或天体物理学的学生。理论方面主题包括单粒子运动、动理学理论、磁流体力学，以及碰撞效应。包含多种不同类型的等离子体（例如，弱电离等离子体、尘埃等离子体、非中性等离子体、），主要讨论非相对论的、准中性的、弱耦合的等离子体。通过逐步推导和自成体系的数学方法介绍等离子体的基本理论、等离子体的产生、诊断以及相关应用。
default.en: Plasma occur pervasively in nature: in fact, most of the known matter in the universe is in an ionized state, and many naturally occurring plasmas, such as the surface regions of the Sun, interstellar gas clouds, and the Earth's magnetosphere, exhibit unique plasma dynamics produced by the influence of electric and magnetic forces. Plasma physics was developed both to provide an understanding of these naturally occurring plasmas and to advance the pursuit of controlled nuclear fusion. Plasma science is now used in a number of other practical applications, such as the etching of advanced semiconductor chips and plasma decontamination. This course will introduce the basic principles of plasma physics and its generation and applications. The course is suitable for students whose primary interest is in gas discharges, plasma materials processing, ionospheric physics, space plasma physics, or astrophysics. Theoretical topics include single-particle motion, kinetic theory, magnetohydrodynamics, and collisional effects. Many different types of plasmas are included (e.g., weakly ionized plasmas, dusty plasmas, non-neutral plasmas,) with a focus on non-relativistic, quasi-neutral, weakly coupled plasmas. Introduces the basic theory of plasmas, plasma generation, diagnosis, and related applications through a step-by-step derivation and a self-contained mathematical approach.

default.zh: 计算材料科学是近年来飞速发展的一门新兴交叉学科，它综合了固体物理、材料物理与化学、理论化学、数学、计算机技术等多个相关学科。本学科的内容是利用现代高速计算机模拟材料的各种物理化学性质，深入理解材料从原子到宏观多个尺度的各类现象与特征，并对材料的结构和物性进行理论预言，从而达到设计新材料的目的。 《计算材料科学基础与实践》课程是物理类、材料类、化学类、电子工程类高年级本科生的一门重要课程。本课程将重点介绍基于密度泛函第一性原理的纳观尺度的计算材料科学跨学科理论体系，并涉及微观、介观、宏观不同尺度的理论体系。同时将多种计算方法与具体的建模、实践操作、实际问题相结合，并辅之以研究论文实例，使学生较深入的了解从原子尺度到宏观尺度计算材料科学的思想与方法，体会计算材料科学在不同领域的应用与实践。本课程能够培养学生从凝聚态物理领域、材料科学领域中抽象出本质问题，并加以分析解决的能力，使学生具备根据已有知识储备和具体问题进一步开展自主探索与创新的能力。
default.en: In recent years, computational materials science is a new quickly developing interdisciplinary science. It is a combination of multi-disciplines, including solid state physics, materials physics and chemistry, theoretical chemistry, math, computer technology, etc. The substance of computational materials science is to simulate the physical and chemical properties of different materials by modern high performance computers, to deeply understand different phenomena and characters for the materials in the size ranged from atomic to macroscopic scale, to theoretically predict the material structure and physical properties, and after that to design the new materials. The current course for Fundamentals and practice of computational materials science is very important for the advanced undergraduate students whose majors are physics, material science, chemistry, and electronic engineering. This course will especially introduce the first-principles density function theory, which is an interdisciplinary theory in computational materials science and is exactly adequate for the investigations of materials in the nanoscopic scale. This course will also introduce other interdisciplinary theories applied for the materials in the microscopic, mesoscopic, and macroscopic scale. At the same time, this course will combine the different computational methods with detailed model buildings, practical operations, actual problems, and the examples in the research publications. Such combination will cause the students to be familiar with the design ideas and the computational methods from atomic to macroscopic scale in computational materials science. Then the students will be deeply impressed with the broad applicability of computational materials science in different fields. This course can train the students to correctly extract and reasonably analyze the physical essence in the fields of condensed matter physics and material science. Moreover, this course can help the students to improve their abilities of autonomous exploration and innovation based on their knowledge and the practical issue.

default.zh: 场论是描写自然界基本相互作用的重要工具，这既包括了跟日常生活紧密相关的引力和电磁力，也包括亚原子尺度下的强相互作用和弱相互作用。目前，场论是探究物质深层次结构的重要数学手段，在基本粒子物理、宇宙学、统计物理、凝聚态物理等物理学分支的均有着广泛的应用。本课程着重学习经典场论，忽略量子力学效应。具体说来，在相对论的框架下，从作用量原理的角度阐述常见经典场的基本理论，为后续量子场论的学习打下基础。
default.en: Field theory is an important tool in describing the basic interactions in nature, which include not only the gravitational and electromagnetic forces closely related to daily life, but also the strong and weak interactions at the subatomic scale. At present, field theory is an important mathematical means to explore the deep structure of matter, and it is widely used in the branches of physics such as fundamental particle physics, cosmology, statistical physics, condensed matter physics, etc. This course focuses on classical field theory, ignoring quantum mechanical effects. Specifically, within the framework of special relativity, the basic theory of common classical fields is expounded from the perspective of the principle of action, laying the foundation for the subsequent study of quantum field theory.

default.zh: 粒子物理概论是一门针对物理学院本科生的选修课。该课程的目标在于使学生掌握粒子物理的基本理论框架、研究方法及思维方式；培养学生发现问题、解决问题的能力以及实事求是、勇于创新的科学精神。粒子物理是研究组成物质的基本粒子以及它们之间的相互作用规律的物理学分支。目前已知的所有基本粒子都可以用一个被称为粒子物理标准模型的理论来进行描写。在该理论中，自然界存在的电磁、强、弱三种基本相互作用是通过传递相应的规范玻色子来实现的。 本课程将介绍目前人们已经发现了哪些基本粒子，这些粒子具有怎样的性质。由于粒子物理常用的研究手段为加速器和对撞机，因此，还会讲授粒子运动学相关的内容。粒子之间的相互作用过程可以用费曼图来描述，本课程将会讲授如何画出一些典型物理过程的费曼图。此外，还会重点讲授对称性在粒子物理中的应用，特别是一些重要的守恒量如何在粒子的发现过程中发挥巨大作用，对称性破缺如何导致弱相互作用理论的建立。最后，还会讲授夸克模型、夸克与轻子如何参与弱相互作用以及味道混合等内容。
default.en: Introduction to Particle Physics is an elective course for undergraduate students in the School of Physics. The objective of this course is to enable students to master the basic theoretical framework, research methods and ways of thinking of particle physics. Cultivate students' ability to discover and solve problems, as well as the scientific spirit of seeking truth from facts and being brave in innovation. Particle physics is the branch of physics that studies the fundamental particles that make up matter and the laws of interaction between them. All known elementary particles can be described using a theory known as the Standard Model of particle physics. In this theory, the three basic interactions of electromagnetic, strong, and weak in nature are realized by passing the corresponding gauge bosons. This course will introduce students to the elementary particles that have been discovered so far and what their properties are. Since accelerators and colliders are commonly used in particle physics, particle kinematics will also be taught. The interaction processes between particles can be described by Feynman diagrams, and this course will teach students how to draw Feynman diagrams of some typical physical processes. In addition, the application of symmetry in particle physics will be emphasized, especially how some important conserved quantities play a huge role in the discovery of particles, and how symmetry breaks lead to the establishment of weak interaction theory. Finally, the quark model, how quarks and leptons are involved in weak interactions, and flavor mixing will be taught.

default.zh: 天体物理学是天文学的重要分支之一，是用物理学的基本理论、基本方法研究各种天体的形成、结构和演化的学科。天体物理导论是为物理学院高年级本科生开设的一门专业选修课，本课程主要内容包括：天文学和天体物理学的基本知识，重要的天体物理过程，恒星的性质和结构，恒星的形成过程与机制，恒星的晚期演化和超新星爆发，白矮星、中子星、黑洞等致密天体的形成过程及其特性，银河系和河外星系的特征和分类，本星系群、星系团和超星系团的特点，宇宙学基本原理和宇宙学模型，宇宙原初核合成，宇宙的早期演化、暗物质和暗能量，宇宙的大尺度结构和宇宙微波背景辐射，观测宇宙学的最新进展和重要成果。本课程能够让学生了解和接触天体物理前沿研究领域，培养学生利用所学物理知识研究各种天体的性质和天体物理过程的能力，对有天文学兴趣或有志从事天文学和天体物理研究的本科生有重要的帮助和引导意义。
default.en: Astrophysics is one of the branches of astronomy, which researches on the formation, structure and evolution of various celestial objects by using the theories and methods of physics. The course is a complementary course for senior undergraduates in physics program, which mainly includes: the basic knowledge of astronomy and astrophysics, some astrophysical processes, features and structures of stars, mechanisms of stellar formation, stellar evolution and supernova explosions, formation and features of compact objects such as white dwarfs, neutron stars and black holes, features of the Milky Way and classification of galaxies, composition of the Local Group, galaxy clusters and superclusters, cosmological principle and the standard model of cosmology, the primordial nucleosynthesis, the early evolution of the universe, dark matter and dark energy, the large-scale structure of the universe and the cosmic microwave background radiation, and the latest results of observational cosmology. Students taking the course will understand and touch on the frontier of astrophysical research, and learn how to apply the physics knowledge to study various astrophysical phenomena. The course is of great help and guidance for undergraduate students who are interested in astronomy and astrophysics.

default.zh: 能量转化与存储器件是应用物理专业的专业选修课。主要介绍用于各种新能源转化与存储装置的各类功能材料所涉及的基本物理与化学原理、材料体系、研发进展和部分应用实例。课程内容包括：(1) 燃料电池与电解池的基本概念、主要类型与特点，其材料与器件制备与性能测试方法；(2)太阳能电池的基本原理、结构、制备技术与研究进展；(3)不同类型超级电容器的原理、电极制备技术和应用进展；(4)锂离子电池的概念、原理、分类、特点；电极材料和电解质体系及各类锂离子电池研究进展等；(5)金属空气电池的基本概念、原理与研究进展等。
default.en: Devices of energy conversion and storage is one of the selective courses for applied physics speciality. This course introduces the basic physical and chemical principles of novel devices of energy conversion and storage, material systems, R&D progresses and some applications. Including (1) concepts, types and features of fuel cell and electrolysis cell as well as the key materials, preparation techniques and measuring methods, (2) basic principle, configuration, preparation and investigation progresses of solar cell, (3) principles of different kind of super capacitance and its preparation techniques as well as applications, (4) concept, principle, classify and features, as well as the electrode, electrolyte systems and R&D progresses of lithium ion battery, (5) the basic concept, principle and R&D progresses of metal-air battery.

default.zh: 铌酸锂自70年前首次合成以来，已广泛应用于从光通信到量子光学等光学和微波技术的各种应用。铌酸锂现已被认为是新一代颇具前景的集成光子学材料平台，一系列集成铌酸锂光子学器件，诸如光调制器和非线性波长转换器等，明显优于在体相铌酸锂晶体中实现的传统器件。晶圆级制造的成功、绝缘体上铌酸锂（铌酸锂光学集成）的高质量薄膜，以及纳米制造技术的突破，使高性能集成纳米光子元件成为可能。铌酸锂光学集成器件，提高了铌酸锂在光通信和数据中心、集成微波光子学和量子光学中传统应用的性能，并在计量学中开辟了新的应用领域，包括测距系统和频率梳光谱。本课程向学生讲授集成铌酸锂光子学的理论、制备方法及典型应用。课程将涵盖一系列有趣的主题：基于铌酸锂的光波导、基于铌酸锂的宽带电光调制器、铌酸锂调制器的各种应用、基于铌酸锂量子光子学平台、以及薄膜铌酸锂新技术。除此之外，我们还将讨论集成铌酸锂光子学的科学挑战和潜在的解决方案。
default.en: Lithium niobate (LN), first synthesized 70 years ago, has been widely used in diverse applications in optical and microwave technologies, ranging from communications to quantum optics. LN is a promising material platform for integrated photonics, and some integrated LN optical devices, such as optical modulators and nonlinear wavelength converters, have already outperformed their legacy counterparts implemented in bulk LN crystals. The successes of manufacturing wafer-scale, high-quality thin films of LN-on-insulator (LNOI) and breakthroughs in nanofabrication techniques have made high-performance integrated nanophotonic components possible. LNOI devices boost the performance of LiNbO3-based traditional applications in optical communications and data centers, integrated microwave photonics, and quantum optics and open up novel applications in metrology, including ranging systems and frequency comb spectroscopy. This course introduces the students to integrated lithium niobate photonics. A series of interesting topics will be covered during the course: LN-based Optical waveguides, LN-based Broadband electro-optic modulators, Applications of lithium niobate modulators, LN-based platform of quantum photonics, and Thin-film LN technology. Beyond this outlook, we will discuss the challenges in integrated LN photonics and the potential solutions.

default.zh: 本课程的主要目标是介绍微纳结构光子学的经典理论和前沿科学方法，指导学生解决典型微纳光子系统中的传输/反射问题及散射问题。课程旨在为学生提供掌握传输矩阵法、电磁方程格林函数以及严格多重散射理论的知识，从而能够开展纳米光子学与超构光学领域的研究，设计具有光子带结构与共振特性的超构器件，并进行建模分析。 通过本课程，学生可掌握以下知识：结构光子学的基本概念、光子结构中透射与反射的本征值问题、光子带结构的计算方法、二维与三维情形下的多极展开与米氏散射问题、耦合偶极子方法以及严格多重散射理论。学生将通过计算机实践，完成一维与二维结构光子带结构的计算、二维结构衍射图样的模拟、无限长棒散射的模拟、单粒子及配对球形粒子系统散射的模拟。同时了解纳米结构光子器件与系统的应用领域及发展趋势。课程结束时，学生需独立完成一个课程项目或报告以进行成绩评定。
default.en: The main objective of the course is to introduce advanced concepts about micro/nano-structured photonics and guide students to resolve the transmission/reflection problems and scattering problems in typical nanophotonics systems. The purpose of the course is to provide students with knowledge that will allow them to master the Transfer matrix method, Green’s function for electrodynamics equations and Rigorous multiple scattering theory, then to conduct research in the field of nanophotonics and meta-optics for design and modelling of meta-devices with Photonic band structures and Resonances. Through this course, the students can acquire the following knowledge: some concepts about structured photonics, eigenvalue problems for transmission and reflection in photonic structures, calculation method of photonic band structures, multipole expansion and Mie problem in two- and three dimensional cases, coupled dipoles method, and rigorous multiple scattering theory. The students are able to practice in computers and make calculations of photonic band structures of one- and two-dimensional structures, simulation of diffraction patterns of two-dimensional structures, simulation of scattering on infinite rod, simulation of scattering on single particle and paired spherical particle systems. The main applications and developing trends of nano-structured photonic devices and systems. At the end of the course, the students will be required to submit one course project or report by themself for performance evaluation.

default.zh: 本课程面向物理学院或相关专业已完成普通物理学习的本科生，针对其科学思维训练不足的问题，以电磁学、光学、量子物理学领域典型案例为核心载体，系统培育学生的科学思维素养。通过拆解经典物理问题的分析逻辑，引导学生掌握 “现象观察 - 假设提出 - 模型构建 - 验证推理 - 结论拓展” 的科学思维闭环，帮助学生理解物理学科中抽象概念与实际问题的关联，提升运用物理原理分析复杂问题、设计验证方案的能力，树立严谨务实的科学态度，为后续专业课程学习与物理领域实践研究筑牢思维基础。

机器学习作为人工智能的一个分支，近年来在物理学领域掀起了一场革命。其强大的数据处理和模式识别能力，为物理学家提供了全新的研究工具，推动着物理学各个分支的快速发展。 机器学习在物理学中的应用范围广泛，涵盖了从基础研究到实际应用的方方面面，以下列举几个主要领域： 1.数据分析与处理:（1）处理海量实验数据，例如高能物理实验中的粒子碰撞数据、天文观测数据等；（2）识别数据中的模式和特征，例如从望远镜图像中识别星系、从粒子轨迹中识别新粒子等；（3）数据降噪和重建，例如从噪声数据中提取信号、重建不完整的实验数据等。 2.物理系统建模与模拟:（1）构建复杂的物理系统模型，例如分子动力学模拟、材料性质预测等；（2）加速数值模拟，例如使用神经网络替代传统的数值计算方法，提高计算效率；（3）探索新的物理现象，例如利用机器学习发现新的材料、预测新的物理定律等。

default.zh: 本科毕业论文的过程管理包括开题、中期检查、论文验收和论文答辩四个环节。在完成本科毕业论文的过程中，学生在导师的指导下进行文献调研和总结，确定研究任务目标，明确论文工作内容，制定研究方案。在论文工作期间，学生将在导师指导下认真开展理论、仿真或实验方面的研究，在研究过程中致力于解决实际问题，并积累一定量的研究结果，最终按照论文要求和时间节点完成论文的撰写，并参加毕业论文的答辩。
default.en: Graduation thesis is the last training of undergraduate students, it is an important stage for them to apply the physics theory knowledge and experiment skills that they have learned before, and it is also a key turning point from learning to work. In the process of completing the undergraduate graduation thesis, students need to choose the topic and determine the supervisor, first. Under the guidance of the supervisor, the student will search and read literature, determine the research tasks, goals, and contents of the thesis, write a proposal for the thesis, and complete the opening report of the graduation thesis. During the thesis work, students will conscientiously carry out theoretical, simulation, or experimental research under the guidance of their supervisor, devote themselves to solving practical problems in the research process, accumulate a certain amount of research results, and finally write the thesis according to the requirements and time nodes of the thesis, and participate in the defense of the graduation thesis.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本科生培养的最后一个环节，是对学生此前学习到光电信息科学的基础理论和光电实验技能进行应用的重要阶段，也是实现从学习到工作的关键转折点。在完成本科毕业论文的过程中，学生需要先选择课题并确定导师，在导师的指导下进行文献调研和总结，确定研究任务目标，明确论文工作内容，制定研究方案，完成毕业论文的开题报告。在论文工作期间，学生将在导师指导下认真开展理论、仿真或实验方面的研究，在研究过程中致力于解决实际问题，并积累一定量的研究结果，最终按照论文要求和时间节点完成论文的撰写，并参加毕业论文的答辩。毕业论文应包括中英文摘要、目录、绪论和若干正文章节，最终给出研究结论，列出参考文献。本科毕业论文的过程管理包括开题、中期检查、论文验收和论文答辩四个环节。通过毕业论文阶段的学习和训练，光电信息科学与工程专业的本科毕业生可以接触有关领域的科技前沿，掌握必要的研究方法，具备从事科学研究和工程技术开发应用的实践能力，从中学习并掌握学术伦理和规范，成为具备独立从事科学研究、技术开发和工程应用的能力的合格毕业生。
default.en: Graduation Thesis (Design) is the last training of undergraduate students, it is an important stage for them to apply the basic theory and optoelectronic experimental skills of optoelectronic information science that they have learned before, and it is also a key turning point from learning to work. In the process of completing the undergraduate graduation thesis, students need to choose the topic and determine the supervisor, firstly. Under the guidance of the supervisor, student will search and read literatures, determine the research tasks, goals and contents of the thesis, write proposal of thesis, and complete the opening report of the graduation thesis. During the thesis work, students will conscientiously carry out theoretical, simulation or experimental research under the guidance of their supervisor, devote themselves to solving practical problems in the research process, accumulate a certain amount of research results, and finally write the thesis according to the requirements and time nodes of the thesis, and participate in the defense of the graduation thesis. Graduation thesis should include both Chinese and English abstracts, catalogue, introduction and several text chapters, final conclusion and list the references. The process management of undergraduate graduation thesis includes: opening, mid-term inspection, thesis acceptance and thesis defense. Through the graduation thesis stage of learning and training, the undergraduate students can touch frontier of science and technology, master the necessary research methods, achieve practical ability of scientific research and engineering technology application, learn and master academic ethics and norms, and become a qualified graduate with the ability to independently engage in scientific research, technology development and engineering application.

default.zh: 本课程分为校内、校外实习两部分，形式为讲座、参观、座谈和实践等。目的是学生深入社会实践，了解生产、开发或科研的具体过程，学习实践经验，扩大知识面，深化理论知识，促进理论与实践结合。深入了解专业历史、专业背景，学习老一代科学家科技兴国无私奉献的科学精神，增强学生的民族自豪感和历史责任感、加强了解专业及其应用领域的研究现状和未来发展趋势，使学生自主制定合理的未来发展规划，树立正确的世界观和价值观，增强适应社会的能力。了解本校及国内相关专业的科研方向、应用背景，学习实践经验，巩固理论知识，增强合作精神，掌握综合运用所学知识分析和解决科研、开发实际问题的基本思路和方法。了解国内本专业的科研方向、应用背景，了解专业历史接受专业教育。学习实践经验，巩固理论知识，增强合作精神，掌握综合运用所学知识分析和解决科研、开发实际问题的基本思路和方法。
default.en: The course is divided into two parts: on-campus and off-campus internship, in the form of lectures, visits, symposiums and practice, the goal is to immerse students in social practice, enabling them to understand the specific processes of production, development, or scientific research. This entails acquiring practical experience, broadening their knowledge base, deepening their theoretical understanding, and promoting the integration of theory and practice. Furthermore, it involves gaining in-depth knowledge of the history and background of their field, learning from the selfless dedication of earlier generations of scientists who contributed to the nation's technological advancement. This experience serves to enhance students' national pride and a sense of historical responsibility. Additionally, the study aims to strengthen students' understanding of the current state and future trends in their field and its application areas. This empowers students to autonomously develop rational future plans and cultivate the right worldviews and values. It also enhances their adaptability to society. Understanding the research directions and application contexts of their own institution and related domestic disciplines is vital. This allows students to acquire practical experience, solidify their theoretical knowledge, foster a spirit of collaboration, and master the fundamental approaches and methods for analyzing and addressing real-world issues in research and development. Furthermore, gaining insight into the research directions and application contexts of their specific field at the national level, as well as familiarizing themselves with the history of their discipline and the education it provides, is integral. This equips students with practical experience, reinforces their theoretical foundation, bolsters their cooperative spirit, and imparts comprehensive skills for applying their acquired knowledge to analyze and resolve real-world research and development challenges.

default.zh: 本课程是应用物理专业本科生的专业课，具体形式包括讲座、参观、座谈、实践等形式。由学科或方向的负责人介绍学科研究方向、国内外现状和发展趋势；有针对性的定点参观，熟悉实验环境和实验仪器；与有经验的老师进行座谈交流，深入理解专业背景和应用，探讨人生的价值；进入实验室、研究室，了解先进的仪器设备运行原理操作方法，亲手操作仪器设备。通过本课程的学习使学生深入社会实践，了解生产、开发或科研的具体过程，学习实践经验，扩大知识面，深化理论知识，促进理论与实践结合。深入了解专业历史、专业背景，学习老一代科学家科技兴国无私奉献的科学精神，增强学生的民族自豪感和历史责任感。加强了解专业及其应用领域的研究现状和未来发展趋势，使学生自主制定合理的未来发展规划，树立正确的世界观和价值观，增强适应社会的能力。
default.en: This course is a professional course for undergraduate students in Applied Physics specialty, with specific forms including lectures, visits, discussions, and practical exercises.
