It is mainly to introduce raw materials of ordinary cement concrete and their functions to students, as well as the requirements, theories, influence factors, models and assessment of fresh concrete workability, micro and macro structures, concrete deformation (self-shrinkage, drying shrinkage, carbonized shrinkage and temperature deformation), durability (frost resistance, carbonization，resistance to chemical attack, alkali-aggregate reaction and reinforcement corrosion), and mechanic performance (strength theory, fracture and creep). Mix design theory of ordinary concrete and several special concretes are also introduced in this course. Students could learn the basic knowledge and skills for design and use new materials in roads and bridges field.

default.zh: 《道路复合材料》课程为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（材料方向）本科生课程。本课程结合道路材料、土建材料等工程材料的应用实例介绍了复合材料的基础知识，包括复合材料概述、复合材料基体、复合材料增强体、水泥基复合材料、聚合物基复合材料，并从复合理论、界面理论出发，介绍了以水泥基复合材料和聚合物基复合材料为主的道路复合材料的设计基础。
default.en: The course "Composite Materials for Road" is a course for undergraduates majoring in Road Bridge and river crossing engineering (material direction). This course introduces the basic knowledge of composite materials in combination with application examples of engineering materials such as road materials and civil materials, including overview of composite materials, composite matrix, composite reinforcement, cement-based composite materials and polymer-based composite materials, and starts from composite theory and interface theory. This paper introduces the design basis of road composite materials, which mainly consists of cement-based composite materials and polymer-based composite materials.

default.zh: 本课程为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业道路材料工程方向的一门核心专业课，是材料学专业学生的主干课、必修课，也适合土建类其他专业学生。主要讲述有关混凝土施工技术、制品生产技术、性能检验与评价方面的专业课，主要向学生介绍现代混凝土的施工过程与施工技术、常用制品的生产技术、混凝土工程质量的检验与评价、预应力混凝土技术、活性粉末混凝土、高性能混凝土等。通过该课程的学习，使学生掌握常用混凝土的生产与施工工艺技术等，掌握各种施工对混凝土性能的影响，为学生今后从事该方向的研究、开发和应用奠定基础。课程内容主要包括模板工程、钢筋工程、计量与搅拌、混凝土的密实成型工艺、混凝土的养护与质量检查、预应力混凝土、活性粉末混凝土、超高性能混凝土、高性能混凝土、自密实混凝土、快速修补材料、冬季施工混凝土、磷酸镁水泥等。
default.en: This course is a specialized core course for the students of road and bridge engineering major. It is also suitable for other students of civil engineering major. The main content of this course is an introduction to the concrete technology, including formwork engineering, reinforcement engineering, measuring and mixing engineering, manufacturing technique of ordinary and special type of concrete, testing and evaluation for concrete engineering, prestressed concrete technology, reactive powder concrete, ultra-high performance concrete, high performance concrete, self-compacting concrete, rapid repaired materials, winter- construction concrete, and Magnesium Phosphate cement concrete, etc. Through the course, the students can get a general comprehension to the production and construction technology of concrete, as well as the effect of construction on concrete properties. The students will have the ability to do corresponding researches and work on new type of cement concrete. The learning evaluation includes final exam, course work and test course.

default.zh: 本课程内容包括材料基本性质实验、水泥性能测试、骨料级配测试等验证性实验，和普通混凝土配合比设计、路用混凝土配合比设计、大流动性混凝土配合比设计等综合性设计型试验。通过对原材料各项性质的测试，得到主要性能参数，进而完成配合比的初步计算、试配过程，并测试抗压强度等力学性能。其中，对于大流动性混凝土配合比设计，要求学生自主选择原材料，完成设计和试配过程，以各小组间的竞赛方式进行，从而提高学生学习的主动性和创造性。
default.en: The course of Proportion Design of Cement Concrete mainly gives lab classes about replication experiments, such as basic properties test of materials, test of cement properties and grading test of aggregates, and comprehensive design experiments, including proportions design of ordinary concrete, pavement concrete and flowable concrete. Students could learn test methods and experiment skills, and they could also learn the calculation of proportions, mixture process and obtain data of materials properties. For the flowable concrete, students have opportunity to choose raw materials, finish the proportions and mix it by themselves, which is carried out as a competition between different groups to improve students’ initiative and creative.

default.zh: 《路用基层与透水材料设计试验》课程是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（道路材料工程方向）的一门专业课。主要内容为：无机结合料稳定材料的击实实验、无侧限抗压强度实验、水泥稳定材料中水泥剂量测试实验及透水混凝土配合比设计实验。实验课以坚持以学生为主体的原则、教师仅进行必要的讲解，全部实验项目均由学生自己动手完成。课程设计的实验项目包含验证类实验和综合设计类实验两大类。其中验证类实验可以帮助学生强化理论知识、熟悉仪器设备的操作，培养良好的实验习惯；综合设计类实验可以充分发挥学生的主观能动性，培养学生的创新意识和创新能力。通过实践教学环节为学生提供理论联系实际的机会，加深其对道路基层材料及透水路面材料组成、结构和性能间相互关系的理解和认识，掌握路面基层材料及透水路面材料性能的测试方法及配合比设计方法和原则，熟练掌握有关仪器设备的性能和操作方法。从而培养学生分析解决问题的能力和动手能力，使其掌握专业相关基本实践技能，养成严谨求实的实验精神，为其今后的从事相关工作奠定基础。
default.en: This course is a specialized course for the students of road and bridge engineering major. This course gives laboratory classes about replication experiments including beating experiment, unlimited compressive strength experiment, cement content of cement-stabilized materials and design of pervious concrete. This course adheres to the principle of student-centered approach. The teachers only provides the necessary explanations, and the students complete all the experimental projects by themselves. This course includes both validation experiments and design experiments. Verification experiments can help students strengthen their theoretical knowledge, familiarize themselves with the operation of instruments and equipment, and cultivate good experimental habits; Design experiments can fully tap into students' initiation ability. This course gives a chance for student to use the theory and knowledge they have learnt, and also makes student understand the relationship among compose, structure and properties. Furthermore, this course is to enable students to understand the test method of road base and pervious materials and the operational approach of equipment. The course provides the basement for the study in graduate design phase and work in transportation and roads.

default.zh: 综合运输概论课程是交通工程专业的专业课，设置目的是使学生了解交通运输工程的特点、性质、内容及其分类，熟悉各种运输方式规划、设计、运营管理的方法，为将来深入学习和从事本专业工作打下良好基础。课程主要介绍运输的性质、分类、组成和意义，交通运输的发展阶段，各种运输方式的技术经济特性及评价；运输系统规划的阶段和步骤，土地使用—运输系统模型，活动系统需求和运输系统供应的平衡问题；铁路运输系统、道路运输系统、水路运输系统、航空运输系统、管道运输系统五种运输方式的特点、分类、设备、站场选择以及管理技术；综合运输系统的概念、系统构成，各种运输方式的合理配置与分工协调。课程考核采用平时考核（根据出勤和课堂表现）、课内讲演、期末考试相结合的方式。 课程学习的具体目标包括：（1）培养交通运输系统工程基本素养；（2）掌握综合交通运输系统的特点、性质、内容、分类等基础理论知识，了解综合运输发展现状、前沿发展趋势和行业发展的相关法规、政策措施；（3）熟悉各种运输方式规划、设计、运营、管理的基本方法，为将来各专业课的深入学习打下坚实的基础；（4）通过课堂小组讨论，培养学生的组织管理能力及团队协作能力、较强的表达能力和人际交往能力。
default.en: An Introduction to Transportation’ is a major course of the transportation engineering. Through the course, students can realize the feature, character, composition and classification of transportation, make familiar with planning, design, and operating management methods of various transportation modes, and pave a firm base for future study and work. The course mainly introduces feature, classification, composition and meaning of transportation, developing stage of transportation, and technology and economic features and evaluation of transportation. The stage and process of transportation system planning, land using-transportation system model, the question on the balance between activity system demand and transportation system supply will also be introduced. The feature, classification, equipment, choice of the station, and management technology of five transportation modes, including railway transportation system, road transportation system, waterway transportation system, aviation transportation system and pipeline transportation system, will be introduced in detail. The concept and composition of the integrated transportation system will be introduced at last, and the division and cooperation between different modes will be discussed. The examination of this course includes regular grades which are grading by their attendances and other behaviors in class, presentation in class, and final exam. The specified goals of this course include: (1) the students’ basic literacy of transportation engineering can be cultivated; (2) the students can know basic knowledge on the feature, character, composition, and classification of the integrated transportation system, and the students can also know the state of the art and developing trend of transportation, as well as some relative law, regulation and policy; (3) the students can be familiar with the planning, design, operation, and management methods of various transportation modes, and thus pave a solid base for future study and work; (4) the students’ management ability, collaboration ability, expression ability, and interpersonal skill can be improved during the team work.

default.zh: 本课程系交通工程专业核心课程，以道路交通为研究对象，主要讲解道路交通的信号控制方法，以此达到提高道路交通通行效率、确保交通安全的目的。课程内容涉及：交通信号设置依据及分类、单个交叉口的交通信号控制理论与方法（包括定时信号控制、感应信号控制和环形交叉口信号控制）、公交优先信号控制方法、干线协调交通信号控制理论与方法、区域交通信号协调控制系统和快速干道交通控制方法。本课程的设置目标：通过系统学习使学生掌握道路交通信号控制的基本理论和方法，了解交通信号控制研究领域的现状、前沿发展趋势及现行道路交通信号灯设置规范中的相关规定，而且能够运用高新技术（如通讯技术、控制技术、计算机技术等）和先进装备对动态交通流进行合理调控、应用所学知识解决城市道路及公路交叉口的交通信号设计、改善和评价等实际工程问题，并具备开展道路交通信号控制领域科学研究的基本素质与创新意识。
default.en: Traffic control is a core course of traffic engineering professional. It takes road traffic as the research object, mainly introduces the traffic signal control method to improve road traffic efficiency and ensure traffic safety. The content of the course includes: the setting basis and classification of road traffic signal, the theory and method of traffic signal control at single intersection (including the fixed signal control, actuated？signal？control and roundabout signal control), the traffic signal control method for bus priority, the traffic signal control theory and method for arterial coordinated, the traffic signal control system of regional coordination, and expressway traffic control methods. The curriculum goal: (1) to make students master the basic theory and method of road traffic signal control by systematic learning; (2) understand the current situation and frontier development trend of traffic signal control research, also the relevant regulations of current road traffic signal setting norms; (3) can use high-and-new technology (such as communication technology, control technology, computer technology etc.) and advanced equipment to reasonably regulate the dynamic traffic flow, and apply the knowledge to solve the practical engineering problems such as traffic signal design, improvement and evaluation of urban road and highway intersection, and have the basic quality and innovation consciousness in scientific research of road traffic signal control.

default.zh: 交通规划是交通工程的重要分支，涉及社会、自然、经济、人文、政治、土地利用等许多方面，是一门综合性的学科。交通规划课程是交通工程专业的主干课程之一，也是交通工程专业人员的主要专业技能培养内容之一。随着经济和交通的发展，交通规划已成为城市规划、公路交通、交通管理等部门一项十分重要的工作。 交通规划课程重点讲述了城市和区域各种交通系统的构成与特点，进行交通规划所需采集和调查的各类资料、数据？的内容及方法，现状交通分析评价的指标和方法，交通与土地利用的关系，交通生成预测、交通分布预测、交通方式划分预测等交通需求预测模型及方法，交通网络的处理技术和交通阻抗的分析方法，道路网络交通分配理论的类别及其模型和方法，城市综合交通规划的编制内容与方法，城市交通发展战略规划的基本原理、预测和规划方法，城市中长期交通体系规划的内容和要求，城市近期交通治理的内容、方法及方案设计，城市道路网、城市公共交通、城市静态交通设施、城市自行车交通与步行交通、城市货运交通、城市对外交通等专项规划的原理、内容、模型与方法，城市交通管理规划的内容与方法，公路网规划的原理与方法，以及交通规划的综合评价指标、体系及方法。
default.en: Traffic planning is a comprehensive subject which involves society, nature, economy, humanities, politics, land use and many other aspects as an important branch of transportation engineering. The traffic planning course is one of the main courses of transportation engineering major and it is also the main content of the professional skills training for traffic engineering professionals. With the development of economy and transportation, traffic planning has become a very important work in urban planning, highway transportation, traffic management and other departments. The traffic planning course focuses on the composition and characteristics of various traffic systems in cities and regions .It consists of the contents and methods of data collection and investigation of traffic planning, the evaluation index and methods of current traffic analysis, the relationship between urban transportation and land use, traffic demand forecast model including traffic inducing forecast, traffic distribution forecast, traffic mode-split forecast and other methods, the traffic network processing technology and the method of traffic impedance analysis，the categories of the road network traffic assignment theory and its models and methods, the contents and methods of urban comprehensive transportation planning, the basic principle, forecasting and planning methods of urban traffic development strategy planning, the contents and requirements of the urban medium-and-long-term traffic system planning, the contents, methods and scheme design of the urban traffic treatment, the principles, contents, models and methods of the road network, public transportation, static transportation facilities, bicycle traffic and pedestrian traffic, freight transportation, outbound traffic and other special planning of a city，the contents and methods of urban traffic management planning, the principles and methods of highway network planning and the comprehensive evaluation index, system and methods of traffic planning.

default.zh: 本课程为交通运输工程专业核心课程，是本科教学计划中的必修课。课程注重教学内容的基础性与先进性，注重理论联系实际，融知识传授、能力培养、素质教育于一体。通过介绍国内外交通安全方面的研究成果，使学生了解交通安全与人、车、路和环境之间的关系，掌握减少或预防交通事故的基础理论与方法。课程内容包括：交通参与者、汽车、道路交通条件与道路交通安全的关系、交通事故调查与处理、交通事故分析与再现、事故统计分析、道路交通安全评价与事故预测、交通安全审计及保障技术等内容。 通过理论学习和拓宽视野，使学生进一步掌握道路交通安全基本理论及其方法，培养具备开展道路交通安全领域科学研究的基本素质与创新意识，具有现代生命价值理念和交通安全技能的交通行业人才。
default.en: The course of Traffic Safety of Road is the core course of transport engineering major, which is a required course for undergraduate teaching plan. Courses focus on the basic and advanced features of teaching content, pay attention to the theory connection practice, the integration of knowledge transfer, ability cultivation, and quality education. By introducing the research results in traffic Safety at home and abroad, enable students to understand the relationships between people, vehicles, roads and environmental, master the theories and methods for reducing or preventing the amount of traffic accidents. The course contents include: the relationship between traffic participants and traffic safety, motor vehicles and traffic safety, road traffic conditions and traffic safety, traffic environment and traffic safety; traffic accident investigation and handling, traffic accident analysis and reconstruction, traffic accident statistics and analysis, traffic safety assessment and accident prediction, traffic safety audit, the protection technology for traffic safety. Through theoretical study and broaden academic horizon, can help students further master the basic theories and methods of road traffic safety, and bring up the professional person with modern techniques of traffic safety, also can cultivate the basic quality and innovative consciousness of scientific research in the field of road traffic safety, and the transportation expert with modern life value philosophy and traffic safety skills.

default.zh: 交通系统工程课程是为交通工程专业开设的专业课，是交通系统研究的方法论，它把系统工程的理论和方法推广应用到交通系统，重点探讨了解决实际交通问题的思路和方法。简化系统方法本身介绍，侧重方法应用，选取各种理论方法在交通领域针对性的应用案例，注重处理实际问题的方法，注重理论的完整性和在实际应用中的连续性。通过课程学习可以使学生掌握交通系统的规划、设计、建设、管理与研究的整体过程及应用的各种方法；掌握系统工程的在交通领域的实际应用及解决交通系统实际问题的思路和方法；了解各类方法理论的未来发展方向及研究思路。
default.en: Traffic System Engineering is a specialized course for traffic engineering majors. It is the methodology of traffic system research. It extends the theories and methods of system engineering to traffic systems and focuses on the ideas and methods to solve practical traffic problems. The introduction of the simplified system method itself, focusing on the application of the method, selecting a variety of theoretical methods in the field of transportation targeted application cases, paying attention to the method of dealing with practical problems, paying attention to the integrity of the theory and the continuity in practical application. Through the course study, students can master the overall process of planning, design, construction, management and research of traffic system and various methods of application; Master the practical application of system engineering in the field of transportation and the ideas and methods to solve the practical problems of transportation system; Understand the future development direction and research ideas of various methods and theories.

default.zh: 随着机动车保有量逐年递增，区域间公路网密度不断加密，城市交通拥堵由点向面快速扩展，道路交通带来的环境影响越来越为人们所关注。课程主要立足于道路交通，讲授道路交通环境保护的含义、国内外研究现状，同时系统地讲授道路交通污染的调查方法、预测原理和模型、环境影响评价的基本方法以及减缓道路交通环境影响的工程措施。通过课程讲授，以期传授道路交通环境保护的基本知识和理论，加强学生道路交通环境保护的专业素养，强化其将来从事交通行业的环境保护意识。
default.en: With the increasing of vehicle holdings year by year, increasing of the density of highway network among cities, and rapidly expanding of urban traffic congestion from the point to surface, more and more attention are paid to the environment impact brought by road traffic. The course mainly bases on road traffic. The meaning and research status at home and abroad of road transportation environment protection are taught in the course. Meanwhile, the road traffic pollution survey methods, forecasting principles and models, basic methods of environment impact assessment and engineering measures to mitigate road traffic environment impact are also taught systematically. The objective of the course is to teach basic knowledge and theories, to strengthen the students’ professional accomplishment of road traffic environment protection and to intensity awareness of environment protection when students engaged to traffic engineering sector in future.

default.zh: 交通工程是道路工程的重要组成部分之一，对保障行车安全，提高道路通行能力和运行效率，改善出行的舒适和方便程度具有重要意义。本课程主要以课堂讲授的方式向学生介绍道路交通安全设施（包括安全护栏、防眩设施、隔离封闭设施、视线诱导设施）、道路交通标志与标线、道路照明设施、道路收费设施、停车设施等交通工程设施的设计。课程考核采用平时考核（根据出勤和课堂表现）、课内讲演、期末考试相结合的方式。 通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握主要的交通工程设施的类型、一般构造、设置原则和设计方法等，在道路主体工程设计基础上，能够自主进行交通工程设施设计，培养学生的专业素养。具体目标包括：（1）能够灵活应用数学、力学、工程基础和专业知识，用于解决交通工程设施设计问题；（2）能够分析不同类型交通工程设施设计过程中存在的具体问题，自主开展工程设施设计工作并合理评价设计方案对社会、健康、安全、法律以及文化的影响；（3）通过课堂小组讨论，培养学生的组织管理能力及团队协作能力、较强的表达能力和人际交往能力。
default.en: Traffic engineering is one of the important parts of the road engineering, and it plays an important role in guarantying road safety, increasing road capacity and operation efficiency, and improving the comfortability and convenience of travelling. This course mainly gives lectures in class, to teach students about the design of traffic engineering facilities as traffic safety facilities (including guardrail, anti-dazzle facility, isolation facility, and sight guidance facility), road traffic signs and markings, road lighting facility, road tolling facility, and parking facility. The examination of this course includes regular grades which are grading by their attendances and other behaviors in class, presentation in class, and final exam. Through learning this course, the students should know about the type, structure, setting principle and design method of the traffic engineering facilities. The students should design the traffic engineering facilities on their own when the road main project is given. Moreover, the professionalism should be cultivated during the study. The specified goals of this course include: (1)the students can solve the traffic engineering facility design problems with flexibly using the knowledge of math, mechanics, and other engineering foundation and professional knowledge; (2) the students can analyze the specific problems in the design procedure and can evaluate the effects of their design on society, health, security, law and culture; (3) the students’ management ability, collaboration ability, expression ability, and interpersonal skill should be improved during the team work.

default.zh: 智慧交通系统是集通信、控制、计算机等高科技技术于一身的综合交通运输系统，目前它已成为国内外交通运输界研究的热点学科领域，具有广阔的应用前景。本课程是交通工程专业课，课程内容涉及智慧交通系统基础理论、智能诱导系统、智能交通信号控制系统、不停车收费系统、北斗卫星导航系统与GPS、交通应急管理系统、智慧交通系统规划设计等。 通过本课程的系统学习，使学生了解世界发达国家和地区的智慧交通系统发展状况、建设目标、基本内容及其在交通运输系统现代化进程中的作用，了解智慧交通系统研究领域的基础理论、现状、前沿发展趋势，通过该课程一方面拓展专业知识面，具备开展智慧交通系统领域科学研究的基本素质与创新意识，另一方面可以为研究生课程学习和学术研究提供新技术、新方法。
default.en: Intelligent transportation system is a comprehensive transportation system which integrates communication, control, computer, and other high-tech technologies. At present, it has become a hot research field in the transportation field at home and abroad, and has broad application prospects. This course is a specialized course in traffic engineering, which covers the basic theory of intelligent transportation system, intelligent guidance system, intelligent traffic signal control system, ETC system, Beidou satellite navigation system and GPS, traffic emergency management system, intelligent transportation system planning and design, etc. Through systematic learning of this course, students can understand the development status, construction objectives, basic content, and role of intelligent transportation systems in developed countries and regions in the world, understand the basic theory, current situation, and frontier development trend of intelligent transportation systems in the research field, and expand their professional knowledge through this course on the one hand. It has the basic quality and innovation consciousness to carry out scientific research in the field of intelligent transportation system, on the other hand, it can provide new technologies and new methods for postgraduate course learning and academic research.

default.zh: 本课程系交通设备与控制工程专业课程。该课程以道路交通为研究对象，主要讲解道路交通的管理与组织方法，以此达到提高道路交通效率，确保交通安全的目的。通过该课程，学生应理解城市交通管理的基本目的、原则与方法，学会如何按照既定的交通法规，根据道路的具体情况，运用各种手段、方法和工具，采取各种限制措施，对交通进行科学的组织和指挥；学会运用现代化技术（通讯技术、控制技术、计算机技术等）和装置对动态交通流进行准确的调度，使其通畅运行；了解先进国家的城市交通管理的方法和技术，以及城市交通管理的发展趋势。
default.en: This course is for traffic equipment and control engineering. It regards road traffic as the research object, explains the management of road traffic mainly, to raise road traffic efficiency and ensure traffic safety. Through this course, students should understand the method, principle and the basic purpose of city traffic management. According to the established traffic regulations and the specific condition of road, students should learn how to utilize various means, method and tools, adopting various restriction measures, carry out traffic organization. Students should learn with modern technology (communication technology, control technology and computer technical etc.) and facilities to regulate traffic flow accurately to make it unobstructed run, know the urban traffic management and the method of traffic control and technology of advanced country, as well as the development tendency of urban traffic management.

default.zh: 本课程系交通工程专业核心课程，以道路交通为研究对象，主要讲解道路交通的信号控制方法，以此达到提高道路交通通行效率、确保交通安全的目的。课程内容涉及：交通信号设置依据及分类、单个交叉口的交通信号控制理论与方法（包括定时信号控制、感应信号控制和环形交叉口信号控制）、公交优先信号控制方法、干线协调交通信号控制理论与方法、区域交通信号协调控制系统和快速干道交通控制方法。本课程的设置目标：通过系统学习使学生掌握道路交通信号控制的基本理论和方法，了解交通信号控制研究领域的现状、前沿发展趋势及现行道路交通信号灯设置规范中的相关规定，而且能够运用高新技术（如通讯技术、控制技术、计算机技术等）和先进装备对动态交通流进行合理调控、应用所学知识解决城市道路及公路交叉口的交通信号设计、改善和评价等实际工程问题，并具备开展道路交通信号控制领域科学研究的基本素质与创新意识。 本课程采用授课与互动式教学相结合的教学方法，互动式教学形式包括：提问、讨论、课堂作业。
default.en: Traffic control is a core course of traffic engineering professional. It takes road traffic as the research object, mainly introduces the traffic signal control method to improve road traffic efficiency and ensure traffic safety. The content of the course includes: the setting basis and classification of road traffic signal, the theory and method of traffic signal control at single intersection (including the fixed signal control, actuated？signal？control and roundabout signal control), the traffic signal control method for bus priority, the traffic signal control theory and method for arterial coordinated, the traffic signal control system of regional coordination, and expressway traffic control methods. The curriculum goal: (1) to make students master the basic theory and method of road traffic signal control by systematic learning; (2) understand the current situation and frontier development trend of traffic signal control research, also the relevant regulations of current road traffic signal setting norms; (3) can use high-and-new technology (such as communication technology, control technology, computer technology etc.) and advanced equipment to reasonably regulate the dynamic traffic flow, and apply the knowledge to solve the practical engineering problems such as traffic signal design, improvement and evaluation of urban road and highway intersection, and have the basic quality and innovation consciousness in scientific research of road traffic signal control. The teaching method of this course uses a combination of teaching and interactive teaching. The interactive teaching includes questions, discussions and assignments.

default.zh: 交通地理信息系统（Geographic information systems for transportation, GIS-T）是地理信息系统与交通相结合的产物。它是在传统GIS基础上，充分考虑交通网络特征和交通分析模型而形成的应用型GIS。目前，GIS-T已广泛应用于交通基础设施的设计、规划与管理，公交规划与调度，交通分析及控制，交通安全分析，环境影响评价，危机管理，配置及管理复杂的物流系统等交通管理的各个环节，形成了其独特的技术内涵和体系结构。本课程的第一部分介绍GIS-T基础理论，包括GIS-T的概念、数据采集方法、数据模型、数据组织以及基于GIS的空间分析，第二部分介绍GIS-T在交通运输管理中的应用，重点介绍GIS-T在交通规划、智能运输系统、交通环境评价、危机管理、物流系统中的应用。
default.en: Geographic information systems for transportation (GIS-T) are application-oriented GIS, which are interconnected geographic information systems, transportation network properties and transportation analysis model. By far, GIS-T applications cover much of the broad scope of transportation. Transportation analysts and decision makers are using GIS tools in infrastructure planning, design and management, public transit planning and operations, traffic analysis and control, transportation safety and analysis, environmental impacts assessment, hazards mitigation, and configuring and managing complex logistics systems. GIS-T has owned unique architecture and contents of technology. The contents of this course consist of two parts. In the first part, concepts of GIS-T, methods of data collecting, data models, data organizing, spatial analysis based on GIS are introduced, and in the second part, how GIS-T has been applied in transportation planning, intelligent transportation systems, environmental impacts assessment, hazards management and logistics systems are focused.

default.zh: 《交通智能检测原理及应用》既是一门“入门”课，也是一门“专业”基础课。其主旨在于深入浅出地向学生讲授在交通工程中，应用的各种典型智能传感器的原理，智能控制器的应用实例，以及典型的数据处理方法，为以后的深入学习本专业知识和科学研究打好基础。 通过本课程教学，使学生学习检测技术的理论基础，传感器及智能传感器，交通工程中常用传感器原理，智能检测系统的基本结构，智能检测中常用数据处理方法，分析交通工程中智能检测系统应用实例，使学生初步了解智能检测技术的基本概念、内容与方法；培养观察问题、解决问题、调查分析、初步设计等能力。
default.en: "Principles and Applications of Intelligent Traffic Detection" serves as both an introductory course and a specialized foundational course. Its objective is to provide students with an accessible yet in-depth understanding of the principles behind various typical intelligent sensors used in traffic engineering, practical examples of intelligent controller applications, and standard data processing methods. This course lays a solid foundation for further advanced studies and scientific research in the field. Through this course, students will learn the theoretical foundations of detection technology, study sensors and intelligent sensors, explore the principles of commonly used sensors in traffic engineering, and understand the basic structure of intelligent detection systems. They will also become familiar with frequently used data processing methods in intelligent detection and analyze real-world application cases of intelligent detection systems in traffic engineering. The course aims to help students develop a preliminary understanding of the fundamental concepts, content, and methodologies of intelligent detection technology, while cultivating their abilities to observe and solve problems, conduct investigative analysis, and engage in preliminary design.

default.zh: EDA技术与物联网技术在我们的日常生活中随处可见，其中单片机作为嵌入式系统的典型产品，在诸如智能交通系统、无人驾驶系统、家电、工业自动化、移动电子和电子测控等诸多领域得到了广泛应用。通过对本课程的理论学习，使学生了解EDA技术与物联网技术的相关基础知识并学习掌握单片机的基本结构、内部各种功能部件的工作原理、程序指令系统及常用的硬件设计和软件程序设计方法。通过实验教学，使学生能够比较熟练地使用EDA软件开发工具进行软硬件开发、设计与调试。在课程学习中，主要目标是使学生能够了解掌握单片机的相关基本知识及相关软硬件设计的基本原则与方法；同时重点培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，为其今后学习与工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: EDA technology and Internet of Things based embedded systems are almost applied everywhere in our daily life. Microcontrollers are the key components of embedded systems with applications in all of the major electronics markets, including the automotive industry, intelligent transportation system, automatic driving system, home appliances, industrial automation, mobile electronics，electronic measurement and control. Through the theoretical study of this course, the students can understand the basic concepts and contents of EDA technology and Internet of Things technology. The students also can learn the basic structure of the microcontroller, the working principle of various internal parts, the program command system and the commonly used hardware design and software program method. Through experiential learning, students can skillfully use the related EDA software development tools for hardware and software development, design and debugging. The main goal of course study is to enable the students to understand the basic knowledge and concepts of microcontrollers, the related hardware and software design based on the basic principles and methods, enhance the ability of analyze problems and solve problems, which may lay a solid foundation for their future learning and work.

default.zh: 课程主要讲授各种机器学习模型和算法（包括SVM, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, KNN,Kmeans, Artificial Neuro Network, pca, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Adaboost XGBOOST等）的基本原理，并结合交通流预测、交通状态识别、交通异常检测、交通图像识别等具体实践问题，采用Python（包括Numpy、Pandas、Scikit-Learn、Matplotlib、Seaborn）软件，指导学生动手编程。
default.en: The course mainly teaches the basic principles of various machine learning models and algorithms (including SVM, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, KNN, Kmeans, Artificial Neuro Network, PCA, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Adaboost XGBOOST, etc.), and combines specific practical problems such as traffic flow prediction, traffic state recognition, traffic anomaly detection, and traffic image recognition. Python software (including Numpy, Pandas, Scikit Learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn) is used to guide students in hands-on programming.

default.zh: 《交通系统建模与仿真》系统介绍了交通仿真的基本原理与步骤以及典型交通仿真软件VISSIM的操作流程以及应用方法。本课程介绍了交通仿真技术的概念、原理、进行交通仿真的意义和基本步骤以及道路设施模型、交通生成模型、车辆跟驰模型、换道模型、行人仿真模型。并以常见的微观交通仿真软件VISSIM为例，深入讲解了路网设施建模方法、车辆及驾驶行为建模方法、信号控制方案设置方法、交通流信息采集方法、交通控制方案评价方法。最后通过实际案例的讲解，使学生了解交通仿真在交通控制方案改善、交通状态评价、交通规划方案评价方面的应用流程。该课程以知识讲解为基础，以教授典型交通仿真模型为核心，通过课堂教学与上机实践相结合的方式，加深学生对交通工程、交通规划、交通管理与控制等知识的理解。
default.en: The course of “Transportation System Simulation and Applications” mainly introduces the basic principle and flow of traffic simulation technology, and the operation flows and application methods of one typical traffic simulation tool, which is VISSIM. This course firstly introduces the concept of traffic simulation, the meaning of simulation and basic steps, and road facility model, traffic generation model, vehicle following model, lane changing model and pedestrian simulation model. Then take VISSIM as an example, the road network modeling method, vehicle and driving behavior modeling method, signal control scheme setting method, traffic information collection method, signal control scheme evaluation method are introduced. At last, the application examples of the traffic simulation tool are illustrated, which can help the students understand the flow of applying the tool to traffic control scheme improvement, traffic state evaluation and traffic plan scheme evaluation. Based on the knowledge illustration, the course takes teaching the traffic simulation models as the core. By combining class teaching and computer experiment, the students can have profound understanding of the traffic engineering, traffic plan, traffic management and control knowledge.

default.zh: 围绕智能网联汽车的核心感知系统，系统讲解多模态传感器技术原理与应用。内容涵盖摄像头、毫米波雷达、激光雷达、超声波传感器及惯性导航装置的工作原理、信号处理算法等。通过典型案例分析，探讨多传感器数据融合技术、目标检测跟踪算法及复杂场景下的感知可靠性提升策略。重点培养学生在自动驾驶感知层的关键技术研发能力，结合行业前沿动态，解析车路协同系统中V2X传感技术的创新应用。通过本课程学习，学生将具备智能汽车传感器系统设计、性能评估与工程化落地的综合能力，为从事自动驾驶研发奠定核心技术基础。
default.en: Centering on the core perception system of intelligent connected vehicles, this paper systematically explains the technical principles and applications of multimodal sensors. The content covers the working principles and signal processing algorithms of cameras, millimeter-wave radars, lidars, ultrasonic sensors and inertial navigation devices. Through the analysis of typical cases, this paper explores multi-sensor data fusion technology, target detection and tracking algorithms, and strategies for improving perception reliability in complex scenarios. The focus is on cultivating students' key technological research and development capabilities in the perception layer of autonomous driving. Combined with the latest industry trends, the innovative application of V2X sensing technology in vehicle-road coordination systems is analyzed. Through the study of this course, students will possess comprehensive capabilities in the design, performance evaluation and engineering implementation of intelligent vehicle sensor systems, laying a core technical foundation for their research and development in autonomous driving.

default.zh: 技术正以前所未有的速度和规模重塑全球交通运输格局。未来的智慧交通系统将在人工智能驱动下实现全域感知互联、数据智能决策、动态资源优化配置、清洁能源驱动及全流程自主化运行。本课程聚焦AI赋能的交通基础设施创新实践，重点涵盖四大前沿方向：1）基于深度学习的道路表面病害智能识别技术，实现毫米级裂缝与破损的实时检测；2）探地雷达与人工智能融合的隐蔽病害诊断体系，突破地下结构无损检测技术瓶颈；3）无人机多光谱巡检系统，构建三维立体的基础设施健康监测网络；4）道路大模型开发与应用，通过多模态数据融合提升基础设施全生命周期管理能力。课程深度融合《国家综合立体交通网规划纲要》要求，结合数字孪生、智能养护等国家战略需求，培养具备AI技术与交通工程跨界创新能力的新型人才，助力建设安全可靠、智慧韧性的新一代交通基础设施体系。
default.en: Technology is reshaping global transportation with unprecedented speed and scale. The future intelligent transportation system, powered by artificial intelligence, will achieve omnidirectional perception and connectivity, data-driven decision-making, dynamic resource optimization, clean energy propulsion, and fully autonomous operations. This course focuses on AI-empowered innovation in transportation infrastructure, emphasizing four cutting-edge domains: 1) Deep learning-based intelligent recognition for road surface defects, enabling real-time detection of millimeter-level cracks and damages; 2) Ground-penetrating radar integrated with AI for subsurface defect diagnosis, breaking through non-destructive testing barriers; 3) UAV-based multi-spectral inspection systems constructing 3D infrastructure health monitoring networks; 4) Development and application of transportation large models, enhancing lifecycle management through multimodal data fusion. Aligned with China's National Comprehensive 3D Transportation Network Plan, the course addresses strategic needs including digital twins and smart maintenance, cultivating interdisciplinary talents with AI-transportation integration capabilities to build safer, smarter, and more resilient next-generation transportation infrastructure systems.

default.zh: 《AI+交通行为分析》课程立足国家交通强国建设战略需求，使学生能够熟练地运用行为科学、系统科学、信息科学理论与方法，与交通项目实践紧密联系，研究如何有效地分析交通参与者中的出行者、运营者等行为，科学地认识交通行为对交通资源分配、交通安全的影响，并能够提出切实可行的引导行为的策略建议。 交通行为学是交通运输工程学科的基础科学理论之一，涉及交通科学、行为科学、系统科学、信息科学、实验、计算等科学理论与方法，是多学科综合的基础理论，通过融合人工智能、大数据等前沿技术，能够进一步提升智慧交通领域拔尖创新人才的培养。
default.en: The course "AI + Traffic Behavior Analysis" is based on the strategic needs of the national transportation power construction. It enables students to skillfully apply theories and methods from behavioral science, systems science, and information science, closely integrating with practical traffic projects. It focuses on how to effectively analyze the behaviors of traffic participants such as travelers and operators, scientifically understand the impact of traffic behavior on traffic resource allocation and traffic safety, and be able to propose practical and feasible strategies for guiding behavior. Traffic behavior science is one of the fundamental scientific theories in the discipline of transportation engineering. It involves theories and methods from traffic science, behavioral science, systems science, information science, experiments, and computing, among others. It is a comprehensive basic theory that integrates multiple disciplines. By integrating cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence and big data, it can further enhance the cultivation of top-notch innovative talents in the field of intelligent transportation.

default.zh: 《专业思维训练A》是交通学院各专业本科教学中的一门选修课。在专业教学计划中占有较为重要地位和作用。学习本课程旨在使学生了解和掌握有关公路路基路面构造、一般路基、柔性和刚性路面的构造原理、设计和施工技术等内容基础上，培养学生工程系统思维能力和解决实际工程问题能力，为毕业后从事本专业的监理、施工、设计、管理与科研工作打下基础。
default.en: This course occupies a crucial role in the professional teaching program. Through this course, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of highway subgrade and pavement structures, general subgrade design, as well as the structural principles, design methodologies, and construction techniques for flexible and rigid pavements. Building on this knowledge, the course aims to cultivate students' systematic thinking abilities in engineering and equip them with practical problem-solving skills. This foundation prepares graduates to engage in professional supervision, construction, design, management, and research within the field.

default.zh: 《专业思维训练B》课程旨在打破传统学科壁垒，引导学生从“局部技术思维”转向“系统解决思维”，为未来桥梁工程复杂问题提供前瞻性解决方案。
default.en: The course Professional Thinking Training B aims to dismantle traditional disciplinary boundaries, guiding students to transition from "fragmented technical thinking" to "systemic problem-solving thinking," thereby enabling the development of forward-looking solutions for complex challenges in future bridge engineering.

default.zh: 《轨道工程》是面向道路桥梁与渡河工程专业、交通运输工程专业本科生开设的一门专业选修课。本课程的教学任务是让学生对轨道交通的发展历史、发展前景有所了解；对轨道交通的基本知识有总体的了解和把握；帮助学生了解在轨道交通及高速铁路等领域面临的基本问题和解决问题的思维方式。本课程主要内容包括：铁路运输的发展、地位和作用，轨道类型与发展；钢轨的功用和类型、截面设计及截面形状、钢轨材质及其力学指标、钢轨损伤、钢轨接头；有砟轨道结构形式和组成、扣件、轨枕、道床、其他轨道部件；无砟轨道扣件、无砟轨道过渡段。道岔的种类和构造、几何形位、单开道岔总布置图、过岔速度、提速道岔和高速道岔。轨道几何形位；无缝线路温度力计算及分布、线路稳定性及设计、超长无缝线路、应力放散和应力调整；有砟轨道施工、无砟轨道施工等内容。
default.en: Track engineering is a specialized elective course for undergraduate students of Highway Bridge and River-crossing Engineering and Transportation Engineering. The teaching task of the course is to make the students know about development history and development prospect of rail transit, generally master basic knowledge of rail transit, and to help the students to understand the basic problems and thinking mode of problem solving in rail transit and high speed railway. The main contents include: development, status and effects of railway transportation, types and development of rail, function and type of track, section design and profile of track, materials and mechanical properties of track, damage and joint of track, structure form and consistent of ballast track, track fastener, sleeper, bed and other track parts, track fastener and transition section of ballastless track, structure and kinds of turnout, geometry shape and general arrangement plan of simple turnout, bifurcation speed, acceleration turnout and high speed turnout, geometry shape of rail, distribution and calculation of temperature stress in jointless rail, line stability and design, overlength jointless rail, stress consumption and adjustment, construction of ballast track and ballastless track.

default.zh: 《道路工程项目管理基础》是为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业、交通运输工程专业开设的一门重要专业管理类课程。管理学知识是行业顶尖人才的重要素质要求；管理才能是道路工程技术人员必须掌握，也是企业迫切需要的。 课程基于管理学基本原理，介绍道路工程施工管理的行为主体，主要讲解道路工程施工质量管理、施工进度控制、工程费用管理；讲解道路工程施工安全及环境保护管理，及工程合同及信息管理；介绍道路工程监理和道路工程审计。 课程内容全面涵盖道路工程施工管理范畴。旨在拓宽学生认识视野，掌握工程施工管理内容和基本方法,提高学生工程项目综合管理意识，丰富和完善管理学知识体系；立足全局，提高学生行业的竞争意识和能力。
default.en: Road Engineering Project Management is a basic management course for undergraduate students of Highway Bridge and River-crossing Engineering and Transportation Engineering. Management knowledge is important for top talents which is also urgently needed by enterprises in the industry. According to the theory of management, the course introduces the main body of road construction management, mainly explains road construction quality management, construction schedule control, project cost management, explains road construction safety and environmental protection management, engineering contract and information management, Road engineering supervision and road engineering audit. The course content covers the scope of road engineering construction management. The aim is to broaden students' understanding of engineering, improve the comprehensive management awareness of students' engineering projects, enrich and improve the management knowledge system; and base on the overall situation to improve the competition awareness and ability within the industry.

default.zh: 《道路景观与环境设计》是针对道路桥梁与渡河工程专业、交通运输工程专业本科生开设的一门专业基础课程，通过本门课程的学习，培养学生在道路选线设计时的景观与环境设计意识与基本技能，掌握景观与环境设计的相关知识理论与基本方法，提高学生运用相关基础知识解决实际公路选线设计中景观设计的能力与技巧。通过相关的背景介绍、应用案例的分析及相关图片的讲解，提高学生的学习兴趣，达到预期的教学效果。课程的主要内容包括：道路交通景观美学基础，城市道路景观规划与设计原则，城市道路景观设计，城市道路照明景观设计，城市道路绿化设计，公路景观设计，道路铺装景观设计，道路环境设计，环保型路面材料设计理念与应用等内容。
default.en: Landscape and Environmental Design of Road is a basic course for undergraduate students of Highway Bridge and River-crossing Engineering and Transportation Engineering. Through the course, it is to train the students on landscape and environment awareness and basic skills for road location, to master related theory and basic methods of landscape and environment design, to enhance the ability and skills of using related knowledge to solve landscape design problems in road location in reality. Through introduction of related background, analysis of application cases and interpretation of related pictures, it is to increase learning interest of students, so that to achieve the expected teaching result. The main contents include: base of road traffic landscape aesthetics, principles for landscape planning of urban roads, landscape design of urban roads, lighting landscape design of urban roads, greening design of urban roads, landscape design of highway, pavement landscape design of roads, environment design of roads, design philosophy and application of environmentally friendly pavement materials.

default.zh: 《工程检测与技术管理》是针对道路桥梁与渡河工程专业、交通运输工程专业本科生开设的一门重要专业技术及管理课程。 本课程旨在培养学生全面掌握工程质量管理工作的能力，树立工程项目综合管理的全局意识，建立工程管理完整的知识体系。具体培养目标在于：培养质量策划、质量检查、质量监督和评价的技术能力；掌握工程质量改进方法和技术途径，学习质量事故处治技术和处理程序；学会质量与进度、费用关系；掌握基于综合要素的施工组织方法；培养道路工程项目质量管理全局意识和整体掌控能力。 课程的主要内容包括：工程质量检测的试验原理及应用技术；道路工程质量检查项目；道路工程质量检测技术和实际操作；道路工程质量评定方法与标准；道路工程施工质量保证体系、质量管理程序和质量事故处治技术；道路工程质量改进方法和技术途径；道路工程施工质量与进度、费用的关系；基于质量、费用和进度的道路工程施工组织设计方法。
default.en: Detecting and Management Technology of Road Engineering is a basic management course for undergraduate students of Highway Bridge and River-crossing Engineering and Transportation Engineering. By taking this course, students are trained to have ability of carrying out engineering quality management work and establish a general awareness of the comprehensive management of engineering projects, which builds a complete knowledge system of project management for them. The course intends to cultivate the technical ability of quality planning, inspection, supervision and evaluation, master the engineering quality improvement methods and technical approaches, learn the quality accident treatment techniques and processing procedures, learn comprehensive elements construction organization method, and cultivate the overall awareness and control ability of road project quality management. The course contents includes testing principle and application technology of engineering quality inspection, road engineering quality inspection project, road engineering quality inspection technology and actual operation, road engineering quality assessment method and standard, road engineering construction quality assurance system, quality management procedures and quality accident treatment technology, road engineering quality improvement methods and technical approaches, the relationship between road construction quality and cost, and road construction organization design method based on quality, cost and schedule.

default.zh: 本课程是为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业本科生开设的一门选修课，目的是使学生了解和掌握一些道路工程经济、施工组织和管理方面的基本原理和方法，以适应具有经济观点与工程管理技能是现代工程技术人员必不可少的基本素质的要求。满足桥梁工程、道路工程行业对即懂技术又懂经济与管理人才的需要。 这门课程的内容有经济分析原理与方法、工程建设项目经济与评价、施工组织设计、概预算与工程定额等内容。
default.en: The curriculum introduced is a professional course which is opened for the Road, Bridge and Crossing Engineering specialized undergraduate. Its goal is to make the student understand and grasp some road engineering economy, execute the type organization and the management aspect basic principle and the method, adapting the request of having the perspective of economic and the project management skill is the modern engineers’ and technicians' essential quality, and to meet the urgent need of person with professional skills and economical and managerial talent. The content of this course includes the principles and methods of economic analysis, the economy and evaluation of engineering construction projects, the construction organization design, estimates and budgets.

default.zh: 《建筑材料与可持续》是面向交通与土木专业本科生开设的一门专业课程，属选修课范畴。该课程的设置目的是通过理念讲解、实例演练、课堂报告和综合考评，系统探讨：建筑材料体系构成（传统材料和新材料）、建筑材料表征、应用和维护的方法及设备、不同类型建筑材料与方法的优缺点，同时以LCA评价系统为切入点，探讨可持续发展理念、基础设施可持续发展评价体系、LCA在工程中的应用、可持续建筑材料设计原则以及环境影响等，从而帮助学生初步帮助学生掌握与建筑相关的知识，建立交通基础设施可持续发展理念。
default.en: 《Construction Materials and Sustainability》is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in transportation and civil engineering which objective is to systematically discuss, construction elements including both novel and conventional; materials and methods including aspects of materials characterization, method and equipment for application and maintenance; pros and cons of various construction materials and methods, meanwhile, taking LCA evaluation system as the entry point, sustainable development concept, sustainable development evaluation system of infrastructure, application of LCA in engineering, design principle of sustainable materials and environmental impact by presenting concepts, discussing in groups, and class presentation. Then the final destination is to help students gain knowledge on the topics related to construction, establish the concept of sustainable development of infrastructure.

default.zh: 《交通基础设施可持续发展》是面向交通工程专业本科生开设的一门专业课程，属选修课范畴。该课程的设置目的是通过理念讲解、实例演练、课堂报告和综合考评，以LCA评价系统为切入点，系统探讨：可持续发展理念、交通基础设施可持续发展评价体系、LCA在工程中的应用、交通可持续材料设计原则以及交通问题带来的环境影响等，从而帮助学生初步建立交通基础设施可持续发展理念。 本课程以交通基础设施可持续发展的基本概念和基础理论为主，使学生明确交通基础设施可持续化的评价工具和体系，掌握全生命周期评价(LCA)的方法在具体工程项目中的应用。同时通过本课程的学习,使同学们了解和掌握可持续发展材料的使用和设计原则，明确交通环境面临的巨大挑战。 通过本课程的讲授，学生对交通基础设施的范畴、可持续发展的基本知识、交通与环境的关系与影响以及如何建立可持续发展的交通基础设施方面有所了解；熟悉掌握生命周期评价的定义与内涵，了解功能性单元、系统边界的定义与特征等内容。并在生命周期评价框架下按照三个关键步骤进行生命周期评价的自主演练。通过实践，同学明确了LCA输入和输出概念，掌握了LCA有关影响评价的方法与指标理解了LCA中集团、标准化、交互的概念与策略。同时介绍可持续发展材料的使用以及对环境的影响。最终使学生具备分析和解决工程实践中交通基础设施可持续发展问题的能力。
default.en: 《Transportation Infrastructure and Sustainable Development》is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in transportation engineering which objective is to systematically discuss, taking LCA evaluation system as the entry point, Sustainable development concept, sustainable development evaluation system of transportation infrastructure, application of LCA in engineering, design principle of sustainable materials for transportation and environmental impact of transportation problems by presenting concepts, discussing in groups, class presentation and visiting labs. Then the final destination is to help students establish the concept of sustainable development of transportation infrastructure This course is based on the basic concept and basic theory of the sustainable development of transportation infrastructure, so that students can understand the evaluation tools and system of the sustainable development of transportation infrastructure, and master the application of the whole life cycle assessment (LCA) method in specific engineering projects. At the same time, through the study of this course, students can understand and master the principles of the use and design of sustainable development materials, and identify the great challenges facing the traffic environment. Through this course, students will have an understanding of the scope of transportation infrastructure, basic knowledge of sustainable development, the relationship and impact of transportation and environment, and how to establish a sustainable development of transportation infrastructure. Also, students should be familiar with the definition and connotation of life cycle assessment, and understand the definition and characteristics of functional units and system boundaries. Under the framework of life cycle assessment, the autonomous exercise of life cycle assessment is carried out according to three key steps. Through practice, students have clarified the concepts of LCA input and output, mastered the methods and indicators of LCA impact assessment, and understood the concepts and strategies of group, standardization and interaction in LCA. It also introduces the use of sustainable materials and their impact on the environment. Finally, students have the ability to analyze and solve the sustainable development of transportation infrastructure in engineering practice.

default.zh: 本课程是为交通运输工程专业开设的一门选修课，采用中英文结合的授课方式。主要学习冻土和冻土工程的基本特征、冻土的物理和热学属性、冻土的力学行为等内容。使学生掌握公路工程、铁路工程、岩土工程和桥梁工程中所涉及的冻土物理学和冻土力学与工程的知识和基本理论，使学生能够系统掌握冻土的基本物理力学性质，初步掌握冻土路基、基础的工程设计原则和基本方法。
default.en: Introduction of Frozen Ground Engineering》 is an elective course for transportation and civil engineering majors, which is taught in both Chinese and English. This course focuses on the basic characteristics of frozen soil and frozen soil engineering, the physical and thermal properties of frozen soil, and the mechanical behavior of frozen soil. To enable students to master the knowledge and basic theories of frozen soil physics and frozen soil mechanics and engineering involved in highway engineering, railway engineering, geotechnical engineering and bridge engineering, so that students can systematically grasp the basic physical and mechanical properties of frozen soil, and initially grasp the engineering design principles and basic methods of frozen soil subgrade and foundation.

default.zh: 本课程将讲述美国沥青及沥青混合料规范的发展以及规范本身、理论背景和今后的发展趋势。
default.en: This course will discuss the evolution of asphalt binder and asphalt mixture specifications in the United States. We will explore the historical context that lead to the development of existing specifications; the theory behind these developmental efforts; the specifications themselves; and current and emerging trends that are shaping the next generation techniques.

default.zh: 《气候变化与交通基础设施：GIS方法》是一门面向道路桥梁与渡河工程、交通工程、交通设备与控制工程等专业本科生和研究生开设的专业选修课程。课程以气候变化背景下交通基础设施面临的新风险为切入点，以地理信息系统方法为核心工具，以QGIS为主要教学平台，系统讲授气候数据处理、空间表达、交通基础设施风险识别、脆弱性评价与韧性决策支持等内容，旨在培养学生运用空间数据和GIS技术分析气候变化影响、服务交通工程规划设计与运行维护的综合能力。 随着全球变暖和极端气候事件频发，交通基础设施正面临更加复杂的不确定性挑战。温度升高会改变路面服役环境，影响沥青路面材料选择、PG等级分布、结构性能退化和养护成本；极端降雨会增加城市道路积水、交通中断和排水系统失效风险；气候条件的非平稳变化也使传统工程设计中基于历史统计规律的“定常性假设”受到挑战。交通系统具有网络性、区域性和公共服务属性，其气候适应能力不仅关系到道路结构安全，也关系到城市运行效率、应急保障能力和社会经济韧性。因此，面向未来交通基础设施建设和更新，工程人才需要掌握气候风险空间识别、基础设施脆弱性评价和适应性决策支持方法。本课程正是围绕这一前沿需求，构建气候科学、道路工程、城市水文、空间信息技术和基础设施韧性相融合的教学内容。 课程内容分为八个部分。第一部分介绍气候变化与交通基础设施的背景问题，重点讲解气候变化的基本特征与不确定性，分析温度升高、极端降雨对交通系统的影响，以及路面性能劣化、城市洪涝和基础设施失效风险的形成机制。第二部分讲授GIS与QGIS基础，包括GIS基本概念、空间数据类型、栅格数据与矢量数据差异、坐标系统与投影方法，以及Shapefile、GeoTIFF、NetCDF等常用空间数据格式，使学生具备开展后续空间分析的基础操作能力。第三部分围绕气候数据的GIS表达与处理，讲解气温、降雨和极端气候指标的空间表达方法，训练学生处理气候站点数据、多年气候时间序列数据，并理解未来气候情景RCP/SSP与空间数据构建之间的关系。 第四部分聚焦路面温度变化与沥青性能的GIS分析，讲授沥青PG等级与路面温度之间的关系，训练学生计算七日最大路面温度和最低路面温度，绘制不同气候情景下PG等级空间变化图，并开展路面性能退化风险区划和基础设施经济影响空间表达。第五部分关注极端降雨与城市道路洪涝GIS分析，内容包括城市下垫面、汇水区和排水系统的GIS建模，SWMM与GIS的洪涝模拟数据接口，道路淹没深度、流量和风险等级空间分布，以及道路功能等级与洪涝脆弱性的叠加分析。第六部分讲授交通基础设施脆弱性与韧性GIS评价，围绕脆弱性和韧性指标体系、多因子空间叠加评价模型、气候风险等级空间分区，以及Fail-safe和Safe-to-fail两类决策理念，引导学生理解不同风险条件下基础设施适应性治理思路。第七部分通过综合案例分析，将路面温度变化、城市道路洪涝风险和多方案GIS决策对比结合起来，训练学生从数据、模型、图件和工程解释之间建立联系。第八部分进行课程总结与前沿展望，介绍GIS与气候交通工程交叉研究、高分辨率气候数据、智能分析方法以及中国交通基础设施气候适应性发展方向。 本课程突出“问题导向、方法训练和工程应用”相结合的特点。一方面，课程不把GIS仅作为制图工具，而是将其作为连接气候数据、交通基础设施属性、空间风险分布和工程决策的分析平台；另一方面，课程强调真实科研案例和上机实践，围绕路面温度变化、城市道路洪涝、基础设施韧性评价等典型任务，引导学生完成从数据获取、格式转换、空间叠加、风险制图到结果解释的完整流程。课程还吸收国际前沿研究成果，参考气候变化对路面基础设施成本影响、气候不确定性下基础设施可靠性、道路气候影响综述以及人类世基础设施韧性等高水平论文，使学生了解该领域的学术发展和工程需求。 通过本课程学习，学生应能够掌握QGIS基本操作和常用空间数据处理方法，理解气候变化对路面结构、城市道路和排水系统的主要影响机理，具备基于GIS开展路面温度变化分析、城市洪涝风险识别、交通基础设施脆弱性与韧性评价的初步能力，并能够在不确定气候条件下提出面向工程规划、设计、养护和应急管理的空间决策支持方案。课程考核由平时表现、课程作业和期末考试构成，既关注学生对基本概念和理论方法的掌握，也重视其在GIS实践任务中的数据分析、图件表达和工程解释能力。课程的开设将有助于拓展学生的国际化视野和跨学科能力，为培养适应气候变化挑战、掌握空间信息技术、服务交通基础设施韧性发展的复合型工程人才提供支撑。
default.en: “Climate Change and Transportation Infrastructure: A GIS Approach” is a professional elective course for undergraduate and graduate students in Road, Bridge and River-Crossing Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Traffic Equipment and Control Engineering, and related fields. Using QGIS as the main teaching platform, the course introduces GIS methods for climate data processing, spatial analysis, transportation infrastructure risk identification, vulnerability assessment, and resilience-oriented decision support. Under global warming and more frequent extreme weather events, transportation infrastructure faces increasing uncertainty. Rising temperatures may affect pavement service conditions, asphalt material selection, PG grade distribution, structural performance, and maintenance costs, while extreme precipitation may cause urban road flooding, traffic disruption, and drainage system failure. The course helps students understand how climate change challenges traditional engineering assumptions and why spatial risk analysis is essential for future infrastructure planning, design, maintenance, and management. The course consists of eight parts. It first introduces the relationship between climate change and transportation infrastructure, including climate uncertainty, temperature rise, extreme rainfall, pavement deterioration, flooding, and infrastructure failure risks. It then covers GIS and QGIS fundamentals, including spatial data types, raster and vector data, coordinate systems, projections, and common formats such as Shapefile, GeoTIFF, and NetCDF. The course also explains GIS representation and processing of climate data, including temperature, precipitation, extreme climate indicators, climate station data, time series data, and future climate scenarios such as RCP and SSP. Key application modules include GIS analysis of pavement temperature change and asphalt performance, spatial mapping of PG grade changes, pavement degradation risk zoning, GIS-based urban flooding analysis under extreme precipitation, SWMM-GIS data interfaces, road inundation and risk mapping, and overlay analysis of road function and flooding vulnerability. The course further introduces vulnerability and resilience assessment methods, multi-factor spatial overlay models, climate risk zoning, and the concepts of Fail-safe and Safe-to-fail. Comprehensive case studies are used to connect data, models, maps, and engineering interpretation. After completing the course, students should be able to use QGIS for basic spatial data processing, understand the impacts of climate change on pavements, urban roads, and drainage systems, conduct preliminary GIS-based risk and resilience analysis, and propose spatial decision-support schemes for transportation infrastructure under climate uncertainty. The course assessment includes class performance, assignments, and a final examination.

default.zh: 本课程面向全校本科生开设，旨在展示现代工程与前沿数据科学交叉融合的核心理念与应用前景。课程从工程可靠度与不确定性分析入手，通过计算思维、机器学习、深度学习和现代概率方法的讲解，引导学生理解智能化工程体系背后的理论基础与技术框架。 课程内容涵盖从传统可靠度理论到基于采样的先进失效概率方法，并拓展到工程领域中常用的代理模型构建、深度学习方法、少样本学习、贝叶斯推断以及智能优化技术。通过这一系列内容，学生将系统了解如何利用数据科学工具对复杂工程系统进行快速模拟、智能设计与风险决策。课程的最后部分将围绕老化基础设施的全生命周期管理展开，引导学生思考数字孪生、智能监测、AI+智慧土木等未来方向，为工程学科的数字化与智能化发展奠定扎实基础。
default.en: This course is open to all undergraduate students across the university and aims to illustrate the fundamental concepts and application potential of the interdisciplinary integration between modern engineering and cutting-edge data science. Starting with engineering reliability and uncertainty analysis, the course guides students through computational thinking, machine learning, deep learning, and modern probabilistic methods to develop a comprehensive understanding of the theoretical foundations and technical frameworks underpinning intelligent engineering systems. The course content ranges from traditional reliability theory to advanced sampling-based methods for failure probability assessment, and extends to widely used engineering techniques such as surrogate modeling, deep learning, few-shot learning, Bayesian inference, and intelligent optimization. Through this comprehensive curriculum, students will systematically acquire the ability to apply data science tools to enable rapid simulation, intelligent design, and risk-informed decision-making in complex engineering systems. The final module focuses on full lifecycle management of aging infrastructure, guiding students in exploring emerging frontiers such as digital twins, intelligent monitoring, and AI-driven smart civil engineering. This foundation will support the advancement of engineering disciplines toward greater digitalization and intelligence.

default.zh: 《桥梁结构智慧管养》课是为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（桥梁工程方向）本科生开设的专业方向选修课。本课程主要讲授桥梁健康监测与巡检检测、桥梁养护维修与加固的基础理论和相关分析方法。具体内容包括：桥梁病害分析；桥梁结构材料性能检测；桥梁荷载试验与评定；准静力影响线快速检测；桥梁结构运营安全监测系统；桥梁养护维修；桥梁加固。 通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握桥梁检测与评定技术、桥梁健康监测技术、桥梁养护维修与加固技术的基本理论和基本分析方法，为学生将来从事桥梁运营管理与养护维修等相关工作奠定坚实的理论基础。
default.en: The course "Intelligent Management and Maintenance of Bridge" is a professional elective course for Road, Bridge, and River-Crossing Engineering (Bridge Engineering direction) major students. The course focuses on basic theories and analysis methods of bridge structural health monitoring and inspection, bridge maintenance and reinforcement, and its contents include: Bridge faults analysis; Bridge material performance inspection; Bridge load test and evaluation; Rapid detection using quasi-static influence lines; Bridge structural health monitoring system; Bridge maintenance; Bridge reinforcement. The purpose of this course is for students to obtain the basic theories and analysis methods in Bridge inspection and evaluation, Bridge structural health monitoring, Bridge maintenance and reinforcement technology field, and build a strong foundation on pursuing the bridge management and maintenance engineering work.

default.zh: 桥梁美学是美学的重要分支之一，是美学基础知识在桥梁工程方面的应用。该课程内容包括美学的基本理论，美的本质和基本特征，形成桥梁审美的初步概念，掌握桥梁建筑造型、桥梁结构设计、桥梁附属结构美学设计、立体交叉美学造型和景观设计及桥梁色彩何照明等桥梁美学的理论和处理方法。通过课程的学习，一方面可以提高学生的审美意识，了解桥梁美的特点，另一方面，可以掌握桥梁设计中美的造型法则，为实际工程所应用。
default.en: Bridge Architectural Aesthetics is one of the most important branches of Aesthetics. It is the application of basic knowledge of aesthetics in bridge engineering. The main contents of the course are as follows: the basic theory of Aesthetics, load and stress, the essence and basic characteristics of Aesthetics, the basic concepts of Bridge Aesthetics, the culture and history of bridge architectures, the sculpt of bridge architectures, design of bridge structures, aesthetic design of bridge adjunctive constructions, aesthetic sculpt of cloverleaf junction, sight design of bridge, color and illumination of bridge and etc. Through the study of the course, on the one hand, students can improve their aesthetic consciousness and understand the characteristics of the beauty of Bridges; on the other hand, they can master the aesthetic modeling rules in bridge design and apply them to practical projects.

default.zh: 桥梁结构试验包括：桥梁结构的外观检测、等级评定；桥梁静、动载试验中的关键技术、理论分析和试验方法；混凝土结构无损检测技术；试验数据处理和分析。 通过对桥梁现场的外观无损检测和桥梁结构的静动力的数据分析，为桥梁综合评价和确定桥梁现有承载力及桥梁结构剩余寿命预测提供科学依据,也可以正确评定现有桥梁结构技术状况和工作性能。
default.en: The bridge structure experiment includes visual inspection of the bridge structure and grading assessment, the key technical, theoretical analysis and test methods of bridge static and dynamic load test, the nondestructive inspection technology of concrete structures and test data processing and analysis. Through data analysis to the bridge static and dynamic tests ,non-destructive experiment and visual inspection，the results can accurately evaluate the technical condition and the operating performance of the existing bridge structures and provides the scientific basis for the bridge quality comprehensive evaluation and the determination bridge existing supporting capacity and the bridge structure remaining life forecast.

default.zh: 本课程为桥梁与隧道工程专业本科生的专业选修课，它由课堂讲授和课后自学组成。本课程涉及结理论力学、构动力学、土力学、结构设计、计算机技术等多个学科领域，内容广泛，综合性强。通过该门课程的学习，使学生能够了解桥梁结构抗震抗风设计的基础理论，能够较熟练的运用公路桥梁抗风抗震设计规范，为今后学生解决桥梁工程抗震抗风设计方面的问题奠定基础。
default.en: An elective course for undergraduate students at Bridge and Tunnel Engineering department, which consists of classroom teaching and after school self-study. The course is wide ranging and comprehensive, covering theoretical mechanics, structural dynamics, soil mechanics, structural design and computer technology etc. The course leaning enables students to understand the basic theory of wind-resistant and seismic-resistant design of bridges, through which the students could also use the wind and seismic specifications skillfully. The course could lay solid foundation for solving the wind-resistant and seismic-resistant problem in the future.

default.zh: BIM（Building Information Modeling）技术是建筑学、工程学及土木工程的新工具，通过对建筑数据化、信息化模型整合，在项目策划、运行维护的全生命周期过程中进行共享和传递，使工程技术人员对各种建筑信息做出正确有效应对，已经在全球范围内得到业界的广泛认可。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够初步掌握建筑信息模型获取、处理和应用的基本知识。通过实践教学环节，掌握利用BIM平台软件构建三维建筑信息模型的基本操作技能，使学生养成自主分析问题和解决问题的能力，培养和提高学生的创新实践能力。
default.en: BIM (Building Information Modeling) technology is a new tool for architecture, engineering and civil engineering. Through the integration of building data and information model, it can be shared and transmitted in the whole life cycle process of project planning, operation and maintenance, so that engineering and technical personnel can make correct and effective responses to various building information. It has been widely recognized by the industry in the world. Through the study of this course, students can preliminarily master the basic knowledge of building information model acquisition, processing and application. Through the practice teaching link, students can master the basic operation skills of building three-dimensional building information model using BIM platform software, so that students can develop the ability to analyze and solve problems independently, and cultivate and improve their innovative and practical ability.

default.zh: 课程立足国家“智能建造”战略需求，面向土木工程与智能技术交叉领域，以桥梁工程全生命周期为主线，融合人工智能、大数据、物联网等前沿技术，构建“智能设计-智能建造-智能检测-智能评估”全链条技术体系。课程依托周绪红、丁烈云、朱宏平、李惠等多位院士团队的科研成果，结合行业最新实践案例，旨在培养具备智能工具应用能力与工程创新思维的复合型人才，为未来桥梁工程智能化转型提供理论支撑与技术路径。

AI赋能的结构设计原理课程简介 《AI赋能的结构设计原理》是为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业本科生量身打造的一门专业选修课程，旨在通过人工智能技术与传统结构设计的深度融合，培养学生在复杂工程实践中运用人工智能技术解决实际问题的综合能力。课程以钢筋混凝土结构设计为核心基础，系统整合AI技术，突破传统设计模式中依赖经验试错、高重复性劳动的局限性，推动学生从理论认知到实践创新的全方位提升。课程总学时为32学时，内容涵盖结构设计的基本原理与AI技术的应用逻辑，注重理论与实践的结合，通过智慧教学系统、互动式课堂及虚拟仿真实验，构建“学习-反馈-实践”的闭环教学模式，为学生适应未来智能建造与数字化工程领域的需求奠定坚实基础。 课程内容分为基础理论学习与AI技术应用两大核心部分。基础理论学习聚焦于钢筋混凝土结构设计的核心知识体系，包括极限状态设计方法、结构可靠度分析、承载能力与正常使用极限状态，以及混凝土与钢筋的力学性能研究。通过深入讲解受弯构件的正截面与斜截面承载能力计算、受压与受扭构件的复合受力分析，以及深梁设计中拉-压杆模型的建模原理等知识，使学生能够系统掌握结构设计的基本逻辑与规范要求。在此基础上引入人工智能，探讨AI在结构设计中的底层逻辑与实现路径，包括AI辅助编程工具的开发、自动化设计流程的构建、复杂受力场景的模拟与优化，以及虚拟仿真实验在结构破坏形态分析中的应用。通过将AI技术嵌入设计全流程，引导学生探索智能算法在荷载组合优化、参数敏感性分析及工程问题诊断中的潜力，培养其技术开发与工程实践的双重能力。 课程采用“AI讲伴+学伴”的智慧教学模式，实现教学全链条的智能化与个性化。课前，教师通过AI系统推送预习任务，学生需回顾数学与力学基础知识，AI学伴实时检测预习内容中的错误并提供修正建议，确保学生进入课堂前具备必要的知识储备。课中，嵌入式AI讲伴与教师协同授课，AI通过语音识别自动标注重难点内容，同步展示相关工程案例、行业规范及前沿技术动态，帮助学生快速理解抽象概念。课堂互动采用匿名问答机制，学生通过AI学伴自由提问，问题汇总后由教师集中解答，既缓解传统课堂中“不敢问、答不上”的困境，又提升师生互动效率。课后，教师根据线上及线下的反馈数据，通过国产大模型生成分层题库，检验学生的阶段性学习成果。学生答题后由系统自动批改并通过AI学伴反馈学生薄弱点，建立各个学生的薄弱知识库及知识图谱，使学生更有针对性地学习。另外，针对混凝土结构试验成本高、周期长的特点，课程引入虚拟仿真实验替代实体试验，通过高精度模拟呈现结构在不同荷载下的力学响应与破坏过程，增强学生对理论知识的直观理解。此外，教师还可引导学生探索AI工具开发，编写代码优化设计算法或构建特定工程场景的解决方案，进一步强化AI技术应用能力。 本课程考核体系兼顾理论学习与实践创新，共有课堂互动与课后练习（5次）、虚拟仿真实验（2次）、AI应用、AI工具开发及期末考试（线上+线下）五个考核环节，分数占比分别为10%、10%、20%、10%、50%。通过多元化的评价机制，不仅能检验学生对结构设计原理的掌握程度，更能培养其利用AI技术解决复杂工程问题的创新能力。课程以《结构设计原理（第3版）》为核心教材，辅以《钢筋混凝土基本构件》《Design of Concrete Structures》等国内外经典著作，确保理论深度与工程实践的平衡。拓展资源包括AI开发工具包、行业前沿数据库及虚拟仿真平台，可为学生提供丰富的学习素材与实践环境。 通过该课程的学习，学生不仅能够掌握钢筋混凝土结构设计的基本原理、熟练使用AI进行简单结构设计计算，还能够利用AI对复杂工程问题进行研究，包括规划、设计、实验、分析与解释数据等，并初步具备应用技术开发能力，形成“工程师+开发者”的复合思维模式，为学生未来参与智能桥梁设计、数字化施工管理及智慧城市建设等领域提供技术储备与创新视野，助力其成为推动工程领域智能化转型的核心力量。
default.en: "AI-Enabled Structural Design Principles" is a specialized elective course tailored for undergraduate students majoring in Road, Bridge and River Engineering. It aims to cultivate students' comprehensive ability to solve practical problems in complex engineering practices by deeply integrating artificial intelligence technology with traditional structural design. The course takes the design of reinforced concrete structures as its core foundation and systematically integrates AI technology, breaking through the limitations of traditional design models that rely on experience-based trial and error and repetitive labor. It promotes an all-round improvement of students from theoretical cognition to practical innovation. The course lasts for a total of 32 class hours, covering the basic principles of structural design and the application logic of AI technology. It emphasizes the combination of theory and practice and builds a closed-loop teaching model of "learning - feedback - practice" through a smart teaching system, interactive classrooms, and virtual simulation experiments, laying a solid foundation for students to adapt to the demands of future intelligent construction and digital engineering fields. The course content is divided into two core parts: basic theoretical learning and AI technology application. Basic theoretical learning focuses on the core knowledge system of reinforced concrete structure design, including limit state design methods, structural reliability analysis, bearing capacity and normal service limit state, as well as the mechanical properties of concrete and steel. Through in-depth explanations of the calculation of the bearing capacity of flexural members' normal and inclined sections, the composite force analysis of compression and torsion members, and the modeling principle of the tension-compression bar model in deep beam design, students can systematically master the basic logic and normative requirements of structural design. On this basis, AI is introduced to explore the underlying logic and implementation paths of AI in structural design, including the development of AI-assisted programming tools, the construction of automated design processes, the simulation and optimization of complex force scenarios, and the application of virtual simulation experiments in the analysis of structural failure modes. By embedding AI technology into the entire design process, students are guided to explore the potential of intelligent algorithms in load combination optimization, parameter sensitivity analysis, and engineering problem diagnosis, cultivating their dual capabilities in technology development and engineering practice.

default.zh: 作为交通基础设施资产的托管人，各国地方道路管理部门都在努力制定高效的资产管理计划和投资计划。这种计划是建立在风险评估基础上的。原则上，是将始终有限的投资与当地道路管理部门他的风险承受能力进行权衡。 好的资产管理和投资计划是建立在全生命周期资产管理视野的基础上的。 它是对服务水平、风险评估、投资策略、社会资源和能力的整体思考， 还是建立在对不断增长的交通需求的良好预测的基础上。 本课程将涉及上述各个方面基础知识，并讨论如何运用这些知识来影响基础设施管理的决策制定。
default.en: The bridge structure experiment includes visual inspection of the bridge structure and grading assessment, the key technical, theoretical analysis and test methods of bridge static and dynamic load test, the nondestructive inspection technology of concrete structures and test data processing and analysis. Through data analysis to the bridge static and dynamic tests ,non-destructive experiment and visual inspection，the results can accurately evaluate the technical condition and the operating performance of the existing bridge structures and provides the scientific basis for the bridge quality comprehensive evaluation and the determination bridge existing supporting capacity and the bridge structure remaining life forecast.

default.zh: 针对交通基础设施长期服役安全评估以及韧性恢复与评价难题，结合俄罗斯交通基础设施运维和管养的实际与案例，讲解交通设施事故分析、仿生方法在交通设施设计中的应用、聚合物复合材料在交通建设中的应用、交通设施运营管理、预应力钢筋混凝土桥梁结构、钢筋受到腐蚀开裂的计算模型和计算方法已及恶劣运营环境评估其耐久性的数学模型方法等知识，使不同年级的学生有不同的收获，为交通基础设施的安全运维提供基础知识积累。
default.en: For the long-term service safety assessment of transport infrastructure and toughness recovery and evaluation of difficult problems, combined with the Russian transport infrastructure operation and maintenance of the actual and case studies, explaining the analysis of transport facilities accidents, bionic methods in the design of transport facilities, polymer composites in transport construction, transport facilities operation and management, prestressed reinforced concrete bridge structures, the corrosion and cracking of steel reinforcement by the calculation model and calculation method has been and the harsh operating environment to assess the durability of the mathematical model method and so on, so that different levels of students have different gains to provide the basic knowledge accumulation. This course is designed to provide students of different grades with different gains, and to build up basic knowledge for the safe operation and maintenance of transport infrastructure.

default.zh: 本课程为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业的核心专业课，是材料学专业学生的主干课、必修课，也适合土建类其他专业学生。主要讲述国内外结构混凝土劣化与修补现状、钢筋混凝土的劣化机理与种类、结构混凝土的修补原理与修复材料，修复技术及修复后的性能评价等内容的专业课，主要向学生介绍结构混凝土的劣化机理及修复材料、修补技术等。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握常用结构混凝土的劣化机理及种类、传统和新型修补材料的性能特征及修补技术、性能评价等，为学生今后从事该方向的研究、开发和工程应用奠定基础。课程内容主要包括国内外钢筋混凝土结构劣化与修补现状、钢筋混凝土的劣化机理与种类、结构混凝土的修补原理与设计、混凝土修补材料、混凝土的修补技术、混凝土修补体系的性能评价等。
default.en: This course is a specialized core course for the students of road and bridge engineering major. It is also suitable for other students of civil engineering major. The main content of this course is an introduction to the degradation and repair technology of structural concrete and reinforced concrete, including degradation and repair research status of reinforced concrete, degradation mechanism and types, repairing mechanism and repairing materials, repairing technology and performance evaluation. Through the course, the students can get a general comprehension to degradation mechanism, destroyed types, performance and repairing technology of all kinds of repairing materials and performance evaluation system of repaired concrete structure. The students will have the ability to do corresponding researches and work on repair technology of structural concrete.

default.zh: 本课程为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业道路材料工程方向的一门专业选修课。主要讲授在道路工程中具有潜在应用的常用功能材料（碳材料、发光材料、压电材料、净化材料、热敏与湿敏材料、防水材料、吸声与降噪材料、绝热材料与防火材料，热反射材料与相变控温材料）研究及应用与发展动态，及其在道路工程材料中的作用与应用；通过学习使学生了解常用各类功能材料的基本知识、原理及应用，了解和理解各种功能材料在道路工程中的应用背景和功能材料及其复合材料、器件在解决道路工程问题中的作用。
default.en: This course is a professional elective in the Road Materials Engineering specialization under the discipline of Road, Bridge & River-Crossing Engineering. It focuses on the research progress, application trends, and developmental dynamics of common functional materials with potential applications in road engineering, including carbon-based materials, luminescent materials, piezoelectric materials, decontamination materials, thermal-sensitive materials, moisture-sensitive materials, waterproof material，Sound Absorption and Noise Reduction Materials，Thermal insulation materials and fire-resistant materials， Heat reflective materials and phase change temperature control materials. The curriculum emphasizes their functional roles and practical implementations in road engineering materials. Through systematic study, students will acquire fundamental knowledge of these functional materials, including their principles and applications, while gaining insights into their application contexts in road engineering. The course further explores how functional materials, their composites, and related devices contribute to addressing road engineering challenges, fostering an understanding of material innovation in infrastructure solutions.

default.zh: 材料是交通基础设施的物质基础，是支撑交通基础设施服役韧性的关键核心，是推动“交通强国”、“一带一路”国家战略的内在动力”，在我国交通运输事业发展中起到重大基础性、保障性作用。然而，以沥青/水泥基材料为核心的交通基础设施材料研发长期依赖于经验性试错方法，效率低、效果差、成本高，成为制约交通基础设施韧性提升的国际难题。近年来，与材料科学相关的计算机技术一直在稳步地从“技术开发与纯计算研究”转向“以计算结果、机器学习和数据挖掘与计算之间的紧密协作为指导的新材料的发现和设计”。目前在新能源、合金材料等材料研发过程中已采用了材料数字化设计方法，而对于传统交通基础设施材料，相关研究较少，需加强研究推动交通基础设施材料产业数字化转型。因此，开设交通基础设施材料数字化设计专业课，为学生提供系统的理论知识和实践技能培养，是适应新时代交通材料研发需求的必然举措。学生通过本课程的学习，掌握交通基础设施材料数字化设计方法，突破传统试错模式的能力，为提升我国交通基础设施材料的自主创新能力储备跨学科人才。 本课程任务在于通过教学使学生掌握交通基础设施材料数字化设计理论及基本知识，同时具有运用高通量计算、机器学习建模、大数据分析等数字化工具在沥青/水泥基材料研发中的应用。
default.en: Materials are the material foundation of transportation infrastructure, the key core to support the service resilience of transportation infrastructure, the internal driving force to promote the national strategy of "transportation power" and "the Belt and Road", and play a major fundamental and supportive role in the development of China's transportation industry. However, the development of transportation infrastructure materials with asphalt/cement-based materials as the core has long relied on empirical trial and error methods, which are inefficient, ineffective, and costly, becoming an international challenge that restricts the improvement of transportation infrastructure resilience. In recent years, computer technology related to materials science has been steadily shifting from "technology development and pure computational research" to "discovery and design of new materials guided by close collaboration between computational results, machine learning, and data mining and computation". At present, digital design methods for materials such as new energy and alloy materials have been adopted in the research and development process. However, there is relatively little research on traditional transportation infrastructure materials, and it is necessary to strengthen research to promote the digital transformation of the transportation infrastructure materials industry. Therefore, offering a specialized course on digital design of transportation infrastructure materials to provide students with systematic theoretical knowledge and practical skills training is an inevitable measure to meet the research and development needs of transportation materials in the new era. Through the study of this course, students will master the digital design methods of transportation infrastructure materials, break through the traditional trial and error mode, and reserve interdisciplinary talents to enhance the independent innovation ability of transportation infrastructure materials in China. The task of this course is to enable students to master the theory and basic knowledge of digital design of transportation infrastructure materials through teaching, and to apply digital tools such as high-throughput computing, machine learning modeling, and big data analysis in the research and development of asphalt/cement-based materials.

default.zh: 本课程内容涉及公路路段（高速公路基本路段、一级公路基本路段、双车道公路路段）、匝道及匝道与主线连接点、交织区、收费站、城市道路路段、无信号交叉口、信号交叉口、环形交叉口、立体交叉口的通行能力计算与服务水平评价。 通过系统学习本课程使学生掌握各类道路交通设施通行能力计算与服务水平评价的基本理论与分析方法，明确其能解决的实际工程问题；能够应用所学知识解决道路交通规划、可行性研究、设计、运营管理中涉及的公路等级与车道数确定、交通运行评价及改善等实际问题；熟悉道路通行能力研究领域的现状、前沿发展趋势及现行公路与城市道路设计规范中对道路通行能力与服务水平的相关规定，具备开展道路通行能力领域科学研究的基本素质与创新意识。
default.en: This course content involves the highway road (Freeway basic section, basic section of grade I highway, a two-lane highway sections), ramp and ramp with the main line connection point, weaving area, toll station, urban road section, no signal intersection, signal intersection, roundabout intersection, interchanges capacity calculation and service level evaluation. Through systematic study of this course, students can master the basic theory and analysis method of capacity calculation and service level evaluation of various road traffic facilities, and the practical engineering problems that can be solved. Be able to apply the knowledge to solve the practical problems in road traffic planning, feasibility study, design, highway classification and lane number determination, traffic operation evaluation and improvement, etc. Familiar with the current situation of the research field of road capacity, the frontier development trend and the relevant provisions on the road capacity and service level in the current highway and urban road design specifications, and have the basic quality and innovative consciousness to carry out scientific research on road capacity.

default.zh: 城市公共交通是城市交通不可缺少的部分，公交优先一直是我国交通发展的主要政策。本课程跨越了城市公共交通系统的规划、设计与运营管理三个层次，对常规地面公共交通、轨道交通、快速公交系统、城市出租车等多种公共交通方式介绍系统特征、需求预测过程、规划与评价方法、管理手段等，同时对公交各方式之间的协调及换乘枢纽和公交系统发展战略进行了研究。通过课程学习使学生了解城市公共交通的规划、设计、管理的各种方法、手段以及发展方向。
default.en: Urban public transport is an indispensable part of urban traffic; and public transport priority has always been the major part of our transport policy. This course includes three levels: the city's public transportation system planning, design and operations. And it also introduces the system characteristics, demand forecasting process, planning, evaluation methods and management tools of ground public transportation, rail transportation, BRT, urban taxis. This course has a research on the various means of coordination between public transport hubs and public transportation systems and the development strategies. After learning this course, students can understand a variety of methods and direction of development of the urban public transport planning, design and management.

default.zh: 本课程是交通工程专业的专业课，通过学习高速公路交通量预测技术、几何线形设计的高标准要求、高速公路上的关键节点及设施设计技术、高速公路建设与养护技术、高速公路管理及其智能化等，使学生系统掌握高速公路设计、建设、管理、智能化等方面的基本概念、理论和方法，具备从事高速公路建管及智慧化建设的工作能力。 课程目标1：掌握高速公路交通需求预测的基本知识，即通过土地利用与社会经济模型的建模研究，掌握高速公路的交通需求来源，进而确定高速公路上的未来交通量。针对高速公路交通量预测的工程实践问题能够进行独立思考、设计并开发相关解决方案。 课程目标2：具备高速公路几何线形设计、互通式立体交叉设计、沿线设施设计、智能交通设计等工程设计能力和素质。 课程目标3：具备使用交通需求分析软件等现代工具的能力及研究、解决高速公路规划与管理工程实际问题的能力。 课程目标4：培养学生自主学习和终身学习的意识。
default.en: hrough the study of highway traffic volume prediction technology, high standard requirements of geometricdesign, key nodes and facilities design technology on the expressway, expressway construction and maintenance technology, expressway management and intelligence, etc., students can systematically master the basic concepts, theories and methods of expressway design, construction, management, intelligence, etc., and have the ability to engage in expressway construction, management and intelligent construction.

default.zh: 本课程为交通信息与控制工程专业本科生的专业课,系统地介绍公共交通规划与运营的基本概念、基础理论及模型算法，主要内容包括公交服务规划介绍、乘客需求与客流数据采集、发车频率与发车间隔确定、先进的时刻表与行车计划编制、行车计划中的车辆类型和大小、人员排班、乘客需求、路径选择与客流分配、公交服务与线网设计、公交服务可靠性控制以及公交未来发展的前景展望等。
default.en: This course is the compulsory course of Traffic Information and Control Engineering. The main contents of the course comprise Introduction to Transit Service Planning, Data Requirements and Collection, Frequency and Headway Determination, Timetable Development, Advanced Timetables and Vehicle Scheduling, Vehicle-type and Size Considerations in Vehicle Scheduling, Scheduling, Passenger Demand, Route Choice and Assignment, Service Design and Connectivity, Network (Routes) Design, Designing Short-turn trips, Service Reliability and control, Future Developments in Transit Operations.

default.zh: 本课程在先修课程基础上，为全面提高学生动手能力而开展的一门专业实验课程。通过课程学习，学生能够掌握交通控制、交通管理、车路协同、自动驾驶方面的仿真实验技能和操作技巧，并能够开展相关理论验证工作。
default.en: The course is a professional experimental course aimed at comprehensively improving students' hands-on abilities, based on the prerequisite courses. Through course learning, students will be able to master simulation experimental skills and operational skills in traffic control, traffic management, vehicle road collaboration, and autonomous driving, and be able to carry out relevant theoretical verification work.

default.zh: 《自动驾驶控制理论基础及应用》是一门专注于自动驾驶技术中控制理论的本科生课程。本课程深入探讨自动驾驶系统中的核心技术，特别强调滑膜控制和神经网络控制在自动驾驶车辆中的应用。滑膜控制以其强大的鲁棒性和适应性，在处理系统不确定性和外部干扰方面表现出色。而神经网络控制则利用其学习能力，对复杂非线性系统进行建模和控制。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够理解这些先进控制策略的原理，掌握其在自动驾驶车辆中的实际应用，并为未来在智能交通系统及自动驾驶领域的研究和工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: 《 The Fundamentals and Applications of Autonomous Driving Control Theory》is an undergraduate course focused on control theory in autonomous driving technology.
