This course deeply discusses the core technology of auto drive system, with special emphasis on the application of synovial control and neural network control in automatic driving vehicles. Synovial control performs well in dealing with system uncertainties and external disturbances due to its strong robustness and adaptability. Neural network control utilizes its learning ability to model and control complex nonlinear systems. Through the study of this course, students will be able to understand the principles of these advanced control strategies, master their practical applications in autonomous vehicles, and lay a solid foundation for future research and work in the fields of intelligent transportation systems and autonomous driving.

default.zh: 本课程综合了车辆动力学、控制理论、传感器技术、计算机仿真等多个学科领域的知识，旨在通过理论讲授、实验操作和项目实践，使学生掌握智能驾驶车辆的动力学建模、仿真分析和控制策略设计。课程内容从智能驾驶系统的基本概念出发，深入探讨车辆运动学和动力学的基础知识，介绍各种传感器和感知系统的工作原理，以及如何将这些技术应用于智能驾驶车辆的控制和决策。学生将学习如何构建智能驾驶车辆的动力学模型，并利用专业仿真软件进行模拟和分析，以验证和优化控制算法。
default.en: It focuses on the core principles and practical applications of intelligent driving technology. This course integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as vehicle dynamics, control theory, sensor technology, and computer simulation. The aim is to enable students to master the dynamic modeling, simulation analysis, and control strategy design of intelligent driving vehicles through theoretical lectures, experimental operations, and project practice. The course content starts from the basic concepts of intelligent driving systems, delves into the fundamental knowledge of vehicle kinematics and dynamics, introduces the working principles of various sensors and perception systems, and how to apply these technologies to the control and decision-making of intelligent driving vehicles. Students will learn how to construct dynamic models of intelligent driving vehicles and use professional simulation software for simulation and analysis to validate and optimize control algorithms.

default.zh: 道路与桥梁工程综合设计是一门以项目学习为基本理念，将原有道路桥梁与渡河工程专业的核心课程相关课程设计，包括结构设计原理课程设计，道路勘测设计课程设计，路基路面工程课程设计，桥梁工程课程设计、桥梁基础工程课程设计等，依托实际道路与桥梁工程项目，以一条包含桥梁结构的公路设计项目为对象，将这几门课程设计有机的结合在一起，按照实际工程设计顺序，训练学生在已有基础资料的条件下，完成设计出一条包含桥梁结构的公路（包含路线选线、平纵断面设计、路基路面结构设计、桥梁上下部结构设计、构件配筋设计及验算等工作）工程项目。通过综合课程设计训练，一方面使学生对所学各课程之间的关系形成整体认知，另一方面达到理论与实践相结合，锻炼学生工程设计的实践能力，培养现代工程思维和素养，培育团队协作意识和沟通能力。
default.en: The Road and Bridge Design is a project-based learning course that integrates core course designs from the original Road, Bridge, and River-Crossing Engineering program. These include Course Design of Structural Design Principles, Course Design of Road Survey and Design, Course Design of Subgrade and Pavement Engineering, Course Design of Bridge Engineering, and Course Design of Bridge Foundation Engineering. Centered around practical road and bridge engineering projects, this course uses a highway design project incorporating bridge structures as the framework to organically combine these course designs. Following real-world engineering design procedures, it trains students to complete a highway engineering project containing bridge structures (including tasks such as route selection, horizontal/vertical alignment design, subgrade and pavement structural design, superstructure/substructure design of bridges, reinforcement design and verification of components) based on existing foundational data. Through this comprehensive course design training, the program aims to: Help students develop a holistic understanding of the relationships between various courses; Combine theoretical knowledge with practical application to enhance students' engineering design capabilities; Cultivate modern engineering thinking and professional competencies; Foster teamwork awareness and communication skills.

default.zh: 通过实习的参观、走访和专业人士的介绍，进一步了解的道路桥梁工程有关规划、设计、施工、管理和研究等方面的工作性质，使学生更加热爱他即将从事的事业，在未来的工作中找到一个合适的定位和确定明确的奋斗目标。毕业实习的另一个目的就是为毕业设计（论文）做前期的准备工作，收集毕业设计相关的资料，深入理解毕业设计（论文）的意义。
default.en: Through the internship visit, visit and the introduction of professionals, Students can further understand the nature of the planning, design, construction, management and research of road and bridge engineering, so that students can love the career they will be engaged in more, find a suitable positioning and determine a clear goal in the future work. Another purpose of the graduation internship is to do the preparatory work for the graduation design (thesis), collect the information related to the graduation design, and deeply understand the significance of the graduation project (thesis).

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是一门必修课。本科教学最后一个重要的综合训练教学环节，是对本科整个教学过程的总结，是培养学生综合运用所学的基本理论、基础知识和基本技能进行科学研究能力的初步训练，是培养和提高学生分析问题、解决道路桥梁与渡河工程复杂工程问题能力的重要环节，也是学生毕业与学位资格认定的重要依据。毕业论文（设计）既是对本科各教学环节的延续，又是对之前各教学环节的深化和检验，具有独立性、综合性、实践性的突出特点。通过毕业论文（设计），使学生对所学过的基础理论和专业知识进行一次全面、系统地回顾和总结，通过对具体题目的分析和设计，使理论与实践相结合，巩固和发展所学理论知识，掌握正确的思维方法和基本技能，使学生具备解决本专业复杂工程问题的能力。
default.en: The graduation thesis (design) is a compulsory course. The last important comprehensive training and teaching link of undergraduate teaching is the summary of the entire teaching process of undergraduate, the preliminary training of cultivating students' ability to comprehensively use the basic theories, basic knowledge and basic skills they have learned to conduct scientific research, the important link of cultivating and improving students' ability to analyze problems and solve complex engineering problems of roads, bridges and river crossing projects, and the important basis for students' graduation and degree qualification. The graduation thesis (design) is not only a continuation of the teaching links of the undergraduate, but also a deepening and test of the previous teaching links, which has the outstanding characteristics of independence, comprehensiveness and practicality. Through the graduation thesis (design), students will have a comprehensive and systematic review and summary of the basic theories and professional knowledge they have learned, and through the analysis and design of specific topics, the theory and practice will be combined, the theoretical knowledge will be consolidated and developed, and the correct thinking methods and basic skills will be mastered, so that students will have the ability to solve complex engineering problems in their majors.

default.zh: 《混凝土材料科学课程设计》是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业(先进材料工程方向) 的一门专业课程，要求从多个混凝土性能要求侧重点不同的典型工程案例中任选一个作为设计目标，完成混凝土材料设计，并撰写设计书。旨在帮助学生理解和消化混凝土材料科学相关理论知识，掌握常用特种混凝土配合比设计理论与方法，合理选用原材料，正确确定和计算混凝土中各材料用量，掌握原材料与混凝土性能及使用条件之间的关系，制定研究方案、技术路线，引导学生在实践中运用理论知识解决复杂工程问题，培养学生综合分析问题的能力及创新精神。
default.en: "Curriculum Design of Concrete Materials Science" is a specialized core course for the students of road and bridge engineering major (advanced materials engineering direction). According to a number of typical engineering cases with different emphasis on concrete performance requirements and design goals, students can choose one of them to accomplish concrete material design and corresponding design books. It can help students understand and digest the relevant theoretical knowledge of concrete material science, master the mix design theory and design methods of commonly used and special concrete. It contains that reasonably select raw materials, correctly determine and calculate the amount of each material in concrete, master the relationship between raw materials and the performance and use conditions of concrete and formulate the research plans and technical routes. It aims to guide students to apply theoretical knowledge to solving complex engineering problems in practice, and cultivate students' ability to comprehensively analyze problems and innovation mind.

default.zh: 《道路复合材料课程设计》课程为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（材料方向）本科生必修课，是《道路复合材料》的课程设计部分。本课程拟利用《道路复合材料》课程的理论知识，从材料的角度，解决实际道路工程领域中出现的问题，并撰写项目策划书1份。本课程主要是进一步促进学生能够灵活运用《道路复合材料》的理论知识解决道路工程领域中的复合材料问题，培养学生学科交叉方面的学术创新能力，推动智能交通的发展，最终培养交通强国的建设者和接班人。
default.en: Curriculum Design of Composite Materials for Road is a required course for undergraduates majoring in Road Bridge and river Crossing Engineering (Material direction). It is the curriculum design part of Composite Materials for Road. This course intends to use the theoretical knowledge of "Composite Materials for Road" course to solve the problems in the field of practical road engineering from the perspective of materials, and write a project plan. The main purpose of this course is to further promote students' ability to flexibly apply the theoretical knowledge of Composite Materials for Road to solve the problem of composite materials in the field of road engineering, cultivate students' academic innovation ability in interdisciplinary aspects, promote the development of intelligent transportation, and finally train builders and successors of powerful transportation countries.

default.zh: 通过交通控制课程设计，目的是使学生掌握用数解法和图解法进行干线交通信号协调控制方案设计的原理、步骤、注意事项和计算方法，提高其分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Through the course design of traffic control, the purpose is to make students grasp the principle, procedures, precautions and calculation methods of arterial traffic signal coordination control scheme design by numerical method and graphical method, and to improve their ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 交通规划是交通工程的重要分支，涉及社会、自然、经济、人文、政治、土地利用等许多方面，是一门综合性的学科。随着交通的发展，交通规划已成为城市规划部门、公路交通部门等一项十分重要的工作。 交通本课程重点讲述了城市和区域各种交通系统的构成及特点，进行道路交通规划所需采集资料的内容及采集方法，现状交通分析评价的方法、指标及近期交通治理的内容与方法，交通需求预测的模型及方法，交通网络的处理技术、交通分配模型及方法，城市道路交通系统中各组成部分的规划原则与方法，公路网规划的原则与方法，城市交通发展战略规划的原理、分析预测技术及规划对策、道路交通系统的综合评价指标及方法。
default.en: Transportation planning is a critical branch of traffic engineering, encompassing social, natural, economic, cultural, political, and land-use dimensions, making it a highly interdisciplinary field. With the advancement of transportation systems, it has become an essential task for urban planning departments and highway transportation authorities. This course focuses on the composition and characteristics of various urban and regional transportation systems, the content and methodologies for data collection required for road traffic planning, techniques and indicators for analyzing and evaluating current traffic conditions, as well as strategies and methods for near-term traffic management. It also covers models and methodologies for traffic demand forecasting, processing techniques for transportation networks, and traffic assignment models and methods. Additionally, the course addresses planning principles and approaches for components of urban road transportation systems, principles and methods for highway network planning, the theoretical foundations of urban transportation strategic planning, analytical forecasting techniques, planning strategies, and comprehensive evaluation indicators and methods for road transportation systems.

default.zh: 系统地学习《交通系统工程》课程，了解一般的系统工程分析思维方法之后，通过编程实践进一步掌握并体验系统分析方法的特点及优点，提高分析及解决实际问题的能力。课程设计要求掌握最短路距离及最短路线的求解方法，为以后的相关交通专业课程学习奠定基础。
default.en: After systematically learning the course "Traffic System Engineering" and understanding the general system engineering analytical thinking method, students will further master and experience the characteristics and advantages of system analysis method through programming practice, and improve my ability to analyze and solve practical problems. The course design requires a master of the shortest distance and the shortest route solving method, which lays a foundation for the future study of related transportation courses.

default.zh: 根据《交通工程设计》课程所学理论知识，依据相关规范的规定，按照任务书要求独立开展设计任务，完成指定的设计内容，并按要求提交设计成果和资料。设计内容包括：（1）分析道路、交通条件对交通安全设施设置的影响；（2）确定应当设置的交通安全设施的类别并说明依据；（3）安全护栏设计；（4）防眩设施设计；（5）隔离设施设计；（6）视线诱导设施设计；（7）标志与标线设计；（8）编写设计说明。课程考核包括平时成绩、设计成果和答辩三部分。 通过本次设计，要求学生在实践环节中进一步巩固课堂基础知识，掌握高速公路交通工程设施的设计方法和要点，初步熟悉工程设计的基本方法和流程，加强学生读图、绘图、编制说明书的基本技能。
default.en: Through the study of “Design of Traffic Engineering ” and based on relative regulations, the students should conduct the traffic facilities design on themselves as the assignment required. The final design files should be submitted on time. The detailed design tasks include: (1) analyzing the influence of road and traffic conditions on the setting of traffic safety facilities; (2) determining the types of the traffic safety facilities needed to be set and explaining the reason; (3) designing safety guardrail; (4) designing anti-dazzle facility; (5) designing isolation facility; (6) designing sight guidance facility; (7) designing signs and markings; (8) writing the design specification. The examination of the course design includes regular grades, design results, and final defense. Through the course design, it is required that the students can further consolidate the basic knowledge learned in the course of “Design of Traffic Engineering Facilities”, grasp the traffic facilities design of freeways, make familiar with the basic methods and procedures of engineering design, and improve the graph reading and drawing abilities as well as the writing specification ability.

default.zh: 模拟驾驶实习是交通工程专业本科教学计划中非常重要的教学环节，其目的是使学生除了解汽车构造外还需学会汽车驾驶，为以后道路设计、交通管理打下一个良好实践基础，使学生更加热爱自己所学的专业。 实习内容主要包括：1．简单了解汽车构造，各部分主要功能及操作方法；2．掌握起步、停车、换档、转弯、调头的操作方法，使之在操作过程中平稳起步、平稳停车、换档时机及操作的连续性、协调性、初步掌握汽车驾驶机能；3．通过汽车驾驶实习，使学生了解交通安全法规，各种交通标志、标线的识别，达到正确运用和理解；4．通过汽车驾驶实习，使学生了解人、车、路三者之间的关系及在行驶过程中各种情况的处理。
default.en: Simulated driving practice is a very important teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan of traffic engineering major. Its purpose is to make students learn how to drive by cars in addition to understanding the automobile structure, so as to lay a good practice foundation for road design and traffic management in the future, and make students love their major more. The contents of the internship mainly include: 1. Simple understanding of the automobile structure, the main functions and operation methods of each part; 2. Master the operation methods of starting, parking, shifting, turning, turning, continuity and coordination of the operation; 3. Through the car driving practice, make the students understand the traffic safety laws and regulations, various traffic signs and lines; 4. Through the car driving practice, make the students understand the relationship among people, cars and roads, and the handling of various situations in the driving process.

default.zh: 毕业实习是交通工程专业教学计划的重要组成部分，是贯彻理论联系实际、培养高素质人才的重要实践环节，是交通工程专业学生了解交通工程的概念、培养实践应用能力的实践性教学环节。课程内容涉及：了解现代化的交通调查手段及方法、掌握城市道路的分类、规划指标及原则、了解交通规划理论在典型城市的实施过程、道路交通行车管理和道路交通安全管理的具体实施、了解交通指挥中心的作用、工作流程和能够实现的主要功能。本课程的设置目标为：针对交通工程专业特点，掌握实际交通问题分析方法；根据交通调查的基本知识和调查方法，通过文献研究和实地调查，获得有效结论；基于交通规划基本理论，进行典型城市的实例分析，了解交通规划理论的实施过程；学习交通管理的目的和分类，掌握道路交通行车管理和道路交通安全管理的具体实施；了解交通工程学所涉及的多门学科，培养与相关学科人员及团队合作、学科交叉创新的能力；为未来的工作和深造奠定基础，引导学生自主学习、终身学习，不断提高适应发展能力。 本课程以学生为中心，通过实地交通调查、典型交通问题的讨论、到校友单位参观、听取专业人员讲座、道路交通实况的考察与讲解等方法开展教学。
default.en: Graduation practice is an important part of the teaching plan of traffic engineering. It is an important practice section of combining theory and practice and cultivating high-quality talents. It is the practical teaching link of traffic engineering students to understand the concept of traffic engineering and cultivate practical application ability. The contents of the course cover the following areas: understanding the methods of traffic survey, master the classification of urban roads, planning indicators and principles, to understand the traffic planning theory in the implementation of a typical city, road traffic management and road traffic safety management of the specific implementation of traffic, understand the role of traffic command centers, work processes and the main functions that can be achieved. The goal of this course is according to the basic knowledge and survey method, through the literature research and field investigation, obtains the effective conclusion. Based on the basic theory of traffic planning, understand the traffic planning in the typical city, and the traffic planning is carried out according to the basic knowledge of transportation survey. The implementation process of the theory; study the purpose and classification of traffic management, master road traffic management and road traffic safety management of the specific implementation; understanding of traffic engineering involved in a number of disciplines, training and related disciplines and teamwork, The ability to lay the foundation for the future work and further study to guide students to self-study, lifelong learning, and constantly improve the ability to adapt to development. This course is student-centered, through the field traffic survey, the discussion of typical traffic problems, to the alumni unit to visit, listen to professional lectures, road traffic investigation and explain the way to carry out teaching.

default.zh: 毕业设计是教学过程的最后阶段采用的一种总结性的实践教学环节，主要培养学生综合运用所学知识，分析、解决交通工程领域规划、设计及施工问题的能力；提高自学和独立进行研究、设计工作的能力；使学生受到工程师的基本训练，培养其调查研究、文献检索、搜集资料的能力，方案论证、确定方案的能力，理论分析、设计和计算的能力，计算机绘图及编程能力，或开展科学研究工作的初步能力，撰写科技论文及设计说明书的能力等。
default.en: The graduation project is a comprehensive practice teaching sector at the later stage of teaching progress. The objectives of this course are training students who can comprehensive use the learned knowledge from the different courses and can have the abilities to analyze and solve the transportation engineering related planning, design and construction problems, improving the abilities on research and design work by self-study and independently, and basic training students like an engineer, in order to bring up the students to have the abilities on investigation research, bibliographic search and data collection, project approach and confirmation, theoretical analysis, design and computation, and computer drawing and code, or be the basic abilities on conducting scientific researches, writing scientific papers and design instructions.

default.zh: 通过交通控制课程设计，目的是使学生掌握用数解法和图解法进行干线交通信号协调控制方案设计的原理、步骤、注意事项和计算方法，提高其分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Through the course design of traffic control, the purpose is to make students grasp the principle, procedures, precautions and calculation methods of arterial traffic signal coordination control scheme design by numerical method and graphical method, and to improve their ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 实习拟走访深圳、广州、上海、青岛等地的交通管理部门以及从事智能交通系统开发的企事业单位，由指导教师联系有关单位的技术人员介绍所在城市的特点及有关课题的情况，对所在城市的先进交通设施进行实地参观考察。在实习结束时，学生应提交书面的实习报告。通过本次实习，使学生在掌握交通设备与控制工程专业基础理论知识的前提下，学习和掌握综合运用所学知识分析和解决工程、科研实际问题的基本思路和方法，并根据毕业设计（论文）内容和研究方向开展相应调研工作。
default.en: Through visiting the traffic management departments and enterprises and institutions engaged in the development of intelligent transportation system of Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Shanghai, Qingdao and other places. instruction teacher contact related institute and engineers introduce the characteristic of city and their projects. Students visit advanced transportation facilities of the cities. At the ending of practice, students should submit their practice reports. Through this internship, students learn and master the integrated use of knowledge in analyzing and solving engineering practical problems, the scientific research of the basic ideas and methods, and according to the content of graduation design (paper) to carry out the relevant research work and research direction.

default.zh: 交通设备与控制工程专业毕业设计是交通设备与控制工程专业学生的必修课程之一，是实现专业培养目标的重要教学环节。毕业设计内容主要涉及到交通设备的设计与研究、公交系统调度优化、浮动车数据挖掘、交通信息采集、交通信号优化设计、智能交通系统设计、交通仿真和智能辅助驾驶系统研究等设计研究方向。期望通过毕业设计培养学生获取知识、融合知识和运用知识的基本技能，提高学生的科研动手能力，巩固理论知识，增强创新意识和合作精神。毕业论文（设计）成绩是学生毕业和学位资格认定的重要依据之一。
default.en: The graduation design of？transportation equipment？and control engineering？is one of the compulsory courses for？students？of professional？transportation equipment？and control engineering. It is an important teaching？link to realize the？training goal. The graduation design content mainly？involves transportation？equipment design & research,？dispatching？optimization,？floating car？data mining,？traffic information collection,？traffic signal optimization？design,？the design of intelligent transportation system,？traffic simulation？and intelligent？driving assistant？system research？and so on.？ It is expectation that students？can bring up the basic skills to acquire knowledge and use of knowledge. It can improve students’ practical ability and consolidate the？theoretical knowledge,？enhance the consciousness of innovation？and the spirit of cooperation.？The graduation project (design)？is one of the important？factors for the？achievement of graduation and？degree？qualifications.

default.zh: 《路基路面工程A》是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业的专业核心课程，以路基工程和路面工程的设计原则、方法及理论为主体，通过较系统的理论学习，旨在培养本科生具备从事路基工程和路面工程设计的理论基础、专业知识、专业技能、创新思维和综合素养。 课程以路基工程和路面工程的设计理论与方法为主体，通过较系统的理论学习，使学生掌握路基路面工程的基本原理与方法，建立相应的知识体系。包括：掌握路基路面工程的基本特点和性能要求，能够分析路基路面工程破坏的主要机理，理解自然环境和交通荷载对路基路面的影响规律，掌握一般路基设计、路基边坡稳定性设计、路基防护与加固、挡土墙设计、路基排水设计、沥青路面结构设计、水泥混凝土路面结构设计与桥面铺装设计的基本原则、方法和主要内容，了解路基路面施工概况。引导学生认识路基路面工程的地域性、系统性、不确定性等特征，具有因地制宜选择路基路面工程技术的初步能力，具有理论联系实际及综合分析一般工程实际问题的能力；具有运用行业标准、规范、相关技术资料和专用软件进行路基路面结构设计的能力。立足翻转课堂和师生互动，培育现代路基路面工程思维，培育现代技术人员应具有的写作表达、综合集成、科研创新、团队协作等素养。 课程采用累加式考核方法，包括平时测试、项目学习、翻转课堂和期末笔试。
default.en: " Road Subgrade and Pavement Engineering A" is a Road engineering and Bridge Engineering professional core courses, the design principle and method of subgrade and pavement engineering and theory as the main body, through systematic theoretical study, aims at cultivating the undergraduates have engaged in road base engineering and pavement engineering design theory, professional knowledge professional skills, creative thinking and comprehensive qualities. The course takes the design theory and method of subgrade engineering and pavement engineering as the main body, through the systematic theory study, enable students to master the basic principles and methods of subgrade and pavement engineering, and establish the corresponding knowledge system. Including: master the basic features and performance requirements of subgrade and pavement engineering, to analyze the main failure mechanism of subgrade and pavement engineering, understand the influence of natural environment and traffic load on the subgrade pavement, master general roadbed design, subgrade slope stability design, subgrade protection and reinforcement, retaining wall design, subgrade drainage design, structural design of asphalt pavement, the structure design of cement concrete pavement and bridge deck pavement design principle, method and main content, understand the situation of roadbed construction. To guide students to understand the roadbed project regional, systematic, uncertainties and other characteristics, has the ability to select the initial pavement subgrade engineering technology, has the ability to integrate theory with practice and comprehensive analysis of the general engineering actual problem; ability to have the subgrade pavement structure design using industry standards, regulations and relevant technical data and special software. Based on the flipped classroom and the interaction between teachers and students, the thinking of modern subgrade and pavement engineering is cultivated, and the writing, expression, integration, scientific research innovation and team cooperation of modern technical personnel should be cultivated. The course adopts the cumulative assessment method, including the usual test, project learning, flipped classroom and final written examination.

default.zh: 智慧交通系统是集通信、控制、计算机等高科技技术于一身的综合交通运输系统，目前它已成为国内外交通运输界研究的热点学科领域，具有广阔的应用前景。本课程是交通设备与控制工程专业课，课程内容涉及智慧交通系统基础理论、智能诱导系统、智能交通信号控制系统、不停车收费系统、北斗卫星导航系统与GPS、交通应急管理系统、智慧交通系统规划设计等。 通过本课程的系统学习，使学生了解世界发达国家和地区的智慧交通系统发展状况、建设目标、基本内容及其在交通运输系统现代化进程中的作用，了解智慧交通系统研究领域的基础理论、现状、前沿发展趋势，通过该课程一方面拓展专业知识面，具备开展智慧交通系统领域科学研究的基本素质与创新意识，另一方面可以为研究生课程学习和学术研究提供新技术、新方法。
default.en: Intelligent transportation system is a comprehensive transportation system which integrates communication, control, computer, and other high-tech technologies. At present, it has become a hot research field in the transportation field at home and abroad, and has broad application prospects. This course is a specialized course in Traffic equipment and control engineering, which covers the basic theory of intelligent transportation system, intelligent guidance system, intelligent traffic signal control system, ETC system, Beidou satellite navigation system and GPS, traffic emergency management system, intelligent transportation system planning and design, etc. Through systematic learning of this course, students can understand the development status, construction objectives, basic content, and role of intelligent transportation systems in developed countries and regions in the world, understand the basic theory, current situation, and frontier development trend of intelligent transportation systems in the research field, and expand their professional knowledge through this course on the one hand. It has the basic quality and innovation consciousness to carry out scientific research in the field of intelligent transportation system, on the other hand, it can provide new technologies and new methods for postgraduate course learning and academic research.

default.zh: 思想政治理论实践课程是思想政治理论课堂教学的延伸，通过“线上理论方法学习，线下投身社会实践”的实践教学环节，引导学生深入剖析近现代中国政治兴替背后的原因、引导学生深刻认识到中国人民怎样选择了马克思主义和中国共产党，实现树立正确历史观、学懂弄通做实习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想、牢固树立中国特色社会主义的道路自信、理论自信、制度自信和文化自信的教学目标，帮助大学生形成崇高的理想信念，弘扬伟大的爱国主义精神，确立正确的世界观、人生观和价值观，引导学生学以致用，提高他们分析问题和解决问题的能力，自觉投身于中国特色社会主义建设事业。
default.en: Practicum on Ideological and Political Theories is an extension of the classroom teaching of Ideological and political theory. Through the practical teaching link of "online theoretical method learning, offline social practice", students are guided to deeply analyze the reasons behind the rise and fall of modern China's politics, to deeply understand how the Chinese people chose Marxism and the Communist Party of China, and to realize the establishment of a correct historical view Xi Jinping, a student of the new socialist China, and firmly establishing the teaching goal of China's own socialist road, self-confidence, theoretical self-confidence, institutional self-confidence and cultural self-confidence.It further aims to establish a correct world view, outlook on life and value systems, to guide students to apply what they have learned to improve their abilities to analyze and solve problems, and consciously to devote themselves to the cause of building socialism with Chinese characteristics.

default.zh: 围绕本科生课程教学与项目式学习为中心，以培养学生信息素质和科学素养为宗旨，融入学科特点和创新创业理念，运用“课堂讲授-网络教学-课题实习-专利翻课”四位一体教学模式，综合提高学生获取新知识、解决问题和科学研究的能力。
default.en: Focusing on undergraduate course teaching and project-based study, aiming at cultivating students' information quality and scientific literacy, integrating discipline characteristics and innovation and entrepreneurship concept, the four in one teaching mode of "classroom teaching-network teaching-project practice-patent flipping" is applied to comprehensively improve students' ability to absorb new knowledge, solve problems and conduct scientific research.

default.zh: 军事课是普通高等学校学生的必修课程。军事课以习近平强军思想和习近平总书记关于教育的重要论述为遵循，全面贯彻党的教育方针、新时代军事战略方针和总体国家安全观，围绕立德树人根本任务和强军目标根本要求，着眼培育和践行社会主义核心价值观,以提升学生国防意识和军事素养为重点，为实施军民融合发展战略和建设国防后备力量服务。普通高等学校通过军事课教学，让学生了解掌握军事基础知识和基本军事技能，增强国防观念、国家安全意识和忧患危机意识，弘扬爱国主义精神、传承红色基因、提高学生综合国防素质。军事课纳入普通高等学校人才培养体系，列入学校人才培养方案和教学计划，实行学分制管理，课程考核成绩记入学籍档案。军事课由《军事理论》《军事技能》两部分组成。《军事理论》教学时数36学时，记2学分。
default.en: Military course is a compulsory course for students in Colleges and universities. The military lesson should be guided by Xi Jinping's idea of strengthening the army and general secretary Xi Jinping's important exposition on education, fully implementing the party's educational policy, the new military strategy and the overall national security concept, focusing on the fundamental requirements of the basic mission and the goal of strengthening the army, focusing on cultivating and practicing the socialist core values and focusing on improving the national defense consciousness and military accomplishment of the students. We will implement the strategy of integrating military and civilian development and build a reserve force for national defense. Through the teaching of military courses, ordinary colleges and universities let students understand and master the basic military knowledge and skills, enhance the national defense concept, national security awareness and crisis awareness, carry forward the spirit of patriotism, inherit the red gene, and improve the comprehensive national defense quality of students. Military courses are included in the talent training system of ordinary colleges and universities, in the talent training program and teaching plan of colleges and universities, and credit system management is implemented. The course assessment results are recorded in the student status file. The military course consists of two parts: military theory and military skills. 36 teaching hours and 2 credits for military theory.

default.zh: 根据《中华人民共和国国防法》、《中华人民共和国兵役法》、《中华人民共和国教育法》，为适应立德树人根本任务和强军目标根本要求，我校于 1987年正式开设军事课课程，含军事技能教学内容。根据教育部、中央军委国防动员部关于印发《普通高等学校军事课教学大纲》通知要求，为更好的增强学生国防观念、提高学生军事技能和综合国防素质。将原军事课中军事技能部分单列，于2020年开设“军事技能”课程。本课程包括共同条令教育与实施、射击与战术训练、防卫技能与战时防护训练、战备基础与应用训练四部分。课程教学以国防教育为主线，通过军事教学，使学生掌握基本的军事技能，弘扬爱国主义精神、传承红色基因，为实施军民融合发展战略和建设国防后备力量服务。 本课程考核施行四级制评定：优秀（90分）、良好（80分）、及格（60分）和不及格（低于60分）。
default.en: Military courses, including military skills, have been offered in Harbin Institute of Technology since 1987，according to the National Defense Law of the People's Republic of China, the Law of the People's Republic of China on Military Service and the Education Law of the People's Republic of China, aiming to adapt to the basic requirements of fostering virtue and increasing the power of its armed forces. Following the order of The Syllabus of Military Courses in Ordinary Institutions of Higher Learning from the Ministry of Education and the National Defense Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission, the part of the military skills is singled out as an independent course in 2020 in order to strengthen students’ awareness of the importance of national defense and improve their military skills and overall national defense quality. The course of Military Skills includes four parts: Education and Implementation of Common Regulations, Shooting and Tactical Training, Defense skill and Wartime Protection Training, Basic Combat Readiness and Application Training. This course focuses on national defense education, serving the goal of implementing the national military-civilian integration strategy and strengthening our national defense reserve forces through the education of basic military skills enabling students to acquire basic military abilities, deepen patriotism and carry on the great cause of communism. The assessment of this course will be in four levels: great (90), good (80), pass (60) or fail (below 60).

default.zh: 通过本课程的设计训练，使学生深入理解城市可持续更新理念以及城市环境对居住建筑的制约关系，利用欧洲在城市更新方面的经验，了解城市住宅更新趋势及模式，从更加全面地视域集成促进城市可持续发展的住区设计体系。
default.en: Through the design training of this course, students can have an in-depth understanding of the restriction relationship between urban environment and residential buildings, understand various spatial combinations of residential buildings, get familiar with the architectural design codes of residential buildings, and design residential forms that meet different living requirements of different living objects.

default.zh: 20世纪快速的城市化为人类带来了很多好处，例如高效的工业生产，技术进步和公共卫生的改善，中国是最杰出的实践者和见证者之一。然而，由于城市的集聚和人类生物学遗产之间的矛盾，城市无限的增长和有限生态系统的萎缩，快速的城镇化进程不可避免地需要寻求新的模式。因此，21世纪需要寻找新的能与自然共存的城市形态和建筑类型，将资源消耗与交通和信息的高度联通相结合，借助大数据、数据链、人工智能等技术，创造能够满足多样性生活需求的后工业生活方式。课程要求学生通过学术研讨、概念设计、方案设计提出哈尔滨未来发展模式，创造未来美好世界。
default.en: XX century rapid urbanization has brought many benefits like high productivity of industry, technology advances and improvement of public health. China is one of the most remarkable evidences. However urbanization process comes to a moment now when it inevitably collapses due to inherit contradictions between urban densities and human biology, unlimited growth of cities and shrinking of limited ecosystems supporting urbanized world. Thus XXI century needs to invent new urban spaces and buildings’ types that will coexist with the nature, combine autonomy in resource consumption and high connectivity in transport and information flows, and provide diversity of post-industrial lifestyles where all functions can be in one place. The course calls students to discuss, conceptualize and design solutions for Harbin future matching this new better world.

default.zh: 概述健康建筑理念从起源至今的发展历程；我国健康建筑的发展背景与需求分析；健康建筑的定义与内涵；健康建筑的国内外发展现状；健康要素对人体的作用机理；健康建筑标准解读；健康建筑项目实践案例展示。
default.en: The development of healthy building concept from its origin to the present. The background and demand analysis of healthy building in China. The definition and connotation of healthy building. The development status of healthy building in the world. The mechanism of health elements on human body. The interpretation of healthy building standards. The healthy building project practice case presentation.

default.zh: 概述智慧城市能源计量的背景和意义；智慧城市中的能源供应构成及相关参量的计量脉络；节能减排评价体系中碳排放、碳足迹及碳中和的定义及内涵；水、热、油、气、电等能源使用过程的工程计量实践案例展示。
default.en: Summarize the background and significance of energy metering in smart city; The composition of energy supply in smart city and the measurement of relevant parameters; The definition and connotation of carbon emission, carbon footprint and carbon neutralization in the evaluation system of energy conservation and emission reduction; project practice of energy metering for water, heat, oil, gas, electricity and other energy use processes.

default.zh: 理论力学是研究物体机械运动一般规律的科学，是工科大学生重要的技术基础课。理论力学内容包括：静力学（研究物体平衡问题）、运动学（研究物体运动的几何性质）、动力学（研究物体机械运动状态的变化与作用力之间的关系），这些属于矢量力学范畴。还讲述虚位移原理、达朗贝尔原理等专题内容。 通过本课程的学习学生应掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: Theoretical Mechanics B is a course studying the general rules of object’s mechanical motions. It’s a technical and basal curriculum and it’s important for engineering students. The contents of Theoretical Mechanics C involve: Statics (to study the balance of object), Kinematics (to study the geometry characteristic of object motion), Dynamics (to study the relation of object’s mechanical motion and forces on object), which belong to the vector mechanics category. It also involves some special contents such as principle of virtual displacement, d’Alembert’s principles, etc. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of classical mechanics and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 《工程力学实验》围绕理论力学、材料力学两门理论教学的主要内容，并结合诸如结构动力学、实验力学等相关的课程，对传统的力学实验加以完善和补充而构成的一门独立课程。全部实验项目采用开放式教学，实行网上预约。实验内容分三个层次（基本实验、综合性实验、研究型和设计型），综合性、研究型实验项目占总实验项目比例约占60%。这些实验强调学生实验的自主性，增强实验的启发性和研究性，注重学生实验素养和创新能力的培养。学生根据这些实验项目的性质，综合运用所学知识，自已设计实验方案，自主独立完成实验。 《工程力学实验》是学生由基础课程转为技术基础课程学习的重要教学环节，既承担基础力学实验教学功能，以加深理解力学基本理论，又旨在工科学生基本力学科学实验素质和创新能力的培养。通过《工程力学实验》课程的学习使学生利用实验手段观察力学实验现象，探索力学实验规律，训练力学实验基本技能，培养力学科学实验素养，为解决工程实际力学问题奠定良好的力学实验基础。
default.en: EXPERIMENTS IN ENGINEERING MECHANICS is an independent course which includes the mechanical experiments covering the theoretical courses such as Mechanics of Materials, Theoretical Mechanics, Experimental Mechanics, as well as Structural Dynamics. All experiments are opening experiments which can be pre-booked in advanced through internet. The experiments can be divided into three groups, basic experiments, comprehensive experiments and designing experiments. The total number of comprehensive experiments and designing experiments is nearly 60% of all items. These experiments are illuminating and focus on training the students’ independence and research abilities. By considering the experimental requirements and using the related theoretical knowledge, the students should design the experimental program and complete it independently EXPERIMENTS IN ENGINEERING MECHANICS can not only fulfill the teaching of basic mechanical experiments but also help the students to make a thorough understanding about the basic theories in mechanics. In addition, through this course, both the basic scientific qualities and the creative thinking abilities of the students will be initiated and enlarged. Through this course, the students will not only be capable of observing the mechanical phenomenon, but also will be trained with advanced experimental techniques. This will help them to be qualified in solving problems coming from the practical engineering.

default.zh: 本课程介绍初级可变形体力学的经典内容及其在工程结构中的典型应用。通过本课程学习，学生将掌握固体变形和强度分析的基本概念、基本理论和基本分析方法；深刻理解平衡、几何、物理三类方程以及叠加原理、能量原理等基本力学原理在求解力学问题时的重要作用。课程强化学生杆件与杆系三类问题的分析和求解能力：1.工程应力与变形，2.强度、刚度与稳定性，复杂工程问题的力学建模。
default.en: Mechanics of Materials introduces classical knowledge and its applications of engineering structures based on elementary mechanics of deformable bodies. Students will grasp basic concepts, theories and methods of deformations and strength analysis, understand the importance of balance, geometric and physical equations, as well as principles of superposition and energy in mechanics problem solving. It aims to strengthen abilities of analysis and problem solving of engineering rods and complex bar systems in three aspects: 1. engineering stress and strain, 2. strength, stiffness and stability, 3. mechanics modeling of complex engineering problems.

default.zh: 这是一门培养科学兴趣和提升科学能力素养的课程。通过力学各方向科研教师介绍目前承担的航天领域相关科研工作，使学生们了解航天专业技术发展过程中遇到的问题以及解决方案；促进学生的科研思考能力和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This is a course that cultivates scientific interest and enhances scientific literacy. By introducing the current research work in the aerospace field undertaken by teachers in various fields of mechanics, students can understand the problems encountered in the development of aerospace technology and their solutions; Promote students' scientific research thinking and problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 大学化学C简明地反映了化学学科的基本原理以及与工程实际和日常生活的联系，是高等工业院校不可缺少的一门基础课，是工科院校学生科学文化素质教育的重要环节，是培养全面发展的工程技术人才知识结构和能力的重要组成部分，在化学与工程之间起到桥梁作用。 大学化学C共32学时，其中讲课24学时，实验8学时。主要介绍化学反应热、化学反应的方向和限度、化学反应速率、稀溶液定律和溶液中的离子平衡、氧化还原反应与电化学、原子结构与同期系、分子结构与晶体结构等知识；并介绍化学知识在材料、能源、环境领域中的应用。 通过本课程的学习，使学生在中学化学的基础上，对化学反应的基本规律、能量关系以及物质组成、结构与性能的关系等有比较全面的认识和一定程度的掌握；对当前化学学科发展的特点及与其他学科的联系、交叉和渗透有所了解。 通过本课程的学习，使学生能够在工程实践及日常生活中能够运用化学的观点和所学化学知识分析和解决问题。 课程包括8学时化学实验，对化学实验基本技术、方法和手段作进一步训练，为学习后继课、新理论、新工艺、新技术和进行其他实验与研究打下必要的化学基础。
default.en: General Chemistry (C) concisely reflects the basic principles of chemistry, seeks to reflect the actual contact with the engineering, and is an indispensable basic course for advanced engineering colleges. These contents are important to engineers, and are a bridge connecting engineering with chemistry. The course includes the classroom teaching of 24 class hours and the experimental course of 8 class hours. In this class, the topics will be discussed as below: Chemical reaction heat，Velocity of chemical reaction，Law of diluted solution，Single-phase and multiphase ion-balance in solution，Oxidation- reduction reaction and electrochemistry，Atom structure and periodic law of elements，Molecular structure and crystal structure，The application of chemistry in material, energy and environment, etc. Learning this course can make students have a more comprehensive understanding on the basic law of chemical reaction, the relationship between energy, the relationship between composition, structure of matter and performance. Learning this course can make students have a proper understanding of the current development of the chemical subject and links and cross-penetration with other subjects. Learning this course can make students use chemical opinion and knowledge to analyze and solve problems. The course includes the experimental course of 8 class hours. It is further trained on the basic techniques of chemical experiments, methods and means which can construct an extensive chemical base for the further study of the follow-on courses, new theories, new technologies, new techniques and other experiments and research.

default.zh: 本课程涉及目前国际上从事表面科学研究的学者所感兴趣的各种表面及界面上结构以及超快过程的表征，并通过表征来揭示界面微观结构及其动力学与宏观物理化学性质的关系。在本课程中，我将介绍在基础研究和应用表面分析中都非常有效的最前沿的主要分析技术的理论和实践。
default.en: This course deals with the characterisation and understanding of the surface of substrates, how they function and react which are all of interest to surface scientists. Within this course, I will introduce the theory and practice of the principal techniques that have shown themselves to be effective in both basic research and in applied surface analysis.

default.zh: 有机材料广泛应用于电化学电源，如电池、超级电容器和燃料电池。在本课程中，学生了解先进有机材料的主要功能，了解电化学反应的现象和基本规律以及相关的物理过程。通过本课程的学习，提高学生对氧化还原活性材料、固体聚合物电解质、导电聚合物和功能粘合剂的基本知识的理解能力。
default.en: Organic materials are widely used in electrochemical power sources, such as batteries, supercapacitors and fuel cells. In the course, the students learn the main functions of advanced organic materials, understand phenomena and underlying laws of electrochemical reactions and relevant physical processes involved. Through this course, the students can build up the abilities of understand the basics of redox-active materials, solid polymer electrolytes, conducting polymers and functional binders.

default.zh: 土木工程与人工智能的结合迎来了难得的战略机遇期。《土木工程机器学习导论》是契合国家智慧土木工程战略需求，响应教育部关于开展新工科建设的号召而开设的新课程。本课程旨在重点培养学生运用机器学习方法分析土木工程（大）数据的能力，并为相关课程的学习及科学研究奠定数据分析理论和方法基础。主要内容包括最优化与概率基础理论、线性回归分析、多变量分析、核方法、决策树和随机森林、神经网络、贝叶斯与高斯过程模型等适用于土木工程（大）数据分析的基本理论与计算方法。
default.en: The combination of civil engineering and artificial intelligence usher in a period of rare strategic opportunities. The new course of “Introduction to Machine Learning in Civil Engineering” is set up to meet the national strategic need of intelligent civil engineering and in response to the call of Ministry of Education for “Emerging Engineering Education”. Through the course, we focus on cultivating the students' ability to use machine learning methods to analyze civil engineering (big) data, and lay the foundation for data analysis theories and methods for related course study and scientific research. The main contents of the course are the basic theories and calculation methods suitable for civil engineering (big) data analysis, which includes: optimization and probability theories, linear regressions, multivariate analysis, kernel methods, decision tree and random forest, neural networks, and Bayesian inference and Gaussian process.

default.zh: 本课程用于提高学生开展实验研究的能力，包括设计搭建实验平台，实验实施，和实验数据处理与分析。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握信号处理，数据采集，数据简化，数据精度，仪器响应，数据统计以及撰写实验报告。本课程会介绍多种应用于机械工程的实验方法和设备工具。理论讲解结合课后作业和撰写实验报告，加深学生对课堂理论教学内容的深入理解，扩展学生的专业知识，培养学习学科交叉思维能力，为学生进一步深造打好基础。
default.en: This course is used to improve the ability of students to carry out experimental research, including the design and construction of experimental platform, experimental implementation, and experimental data processing and analysis. Through the study of this course, students can master signal processing, data acquisition, data simplification, data accuracy, instrument response, data statistics and write experimental report. This course will introduce a variety of experimental methods, equipment and tools used in mechanical engineering. Theoretical explanation combined with homework after class and writing experiment report can deepen in-depth understanding of classroom theoretical teaching content, expand the professional knowledge, cultivate interdisciplinary thinking ability, and lay a good foundation for further study of students.

default.zh: 课程讲述非饱和土的基本原理、研究的基本方法以及非饱和土力学的研究进展和应用。包括：非饱和土的简介、状态变量及其度量、水土特征曲线、非饱和土渗流、非饱和土的强度、非饱和土的变形等。
default.en: This course introduces the basic principles and research methods of unsaturated soils. In addition, some recent developments and applications are also introduced. The content of this course are as follows: Introduction to Unsaturated Soil Mechanics; State Variables and their Measurement; The Soil-Water Characteristic Curve; Seepage through Unsaturated Soils; Shear Strength of Unsaturated Soils; Volume Change & Deformation of Unsaturated Soils.

default.zh: 本课程面向大学一年级学生开设，培养学生的科学与工程思维--计算思维，促进学生的计算思维与各专业思维交叉融合形成复合型思维，为各专业学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算系统求解学科问题奠定思维基础，帮助学习者提高解读真实世界系统并解决全球范围复杂问题的能力。 本课程以“机器自动计算==>机器难于计算==>计算与社会/自然的融合”为脉络，引导学生建立“计算机世界观”，理解社会/自然问题利用计算手段进行求解的基本思维模式；理解高级语言/机器语言程序是如何被执行的,了解复杂系统化复杂为简单的基本思维；理解由问题、到算法、再到程序的问题求解思维模式，了解问题、算法与计算系统(资源和环境)之间的关系，了解难解性问题求解的基本思路。
default.en: This course is an introductory technical one for all freshmen of university. Students will learn computational thinking which can lay a foundation for the further study to design, to construct and to apply computer systems or software systems or computer-based sysyems,and also which can help students to understand complicated systems in real worlds,such as social/natural network system based on Internet. This version of the course is suitable for the majors which are weakly related to computer techniques. The main contents of this course are as following: (1) Understand basic computational thinking and know how to build a simple computing system based on computational thinking; (2) Understand how program is compiled level by level and finally executed on hardware, and how complex system is built on simple component; (3)Understand problem solving procedure,i.e.problem anlysis, algorithm design,and programming, relations among problem, algorithm and computing system, and know how to solve (hard) problem by constructing algorithm and executing algorithm.

default.zh: 《集合论与图论》是计算机与电子通信大类专业的一门专业基础课程。本课程为后继的专业基础课及专业课提供必要的数学工具，为描述离散模型提供数学语言。该课程的设置主要是为了培养学生的抽象思维和逻辑推理能力，提高学生提出问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，提高学生的数学修养及计算机科学素质。 要想用计算机解决问题就要为它建立数学模型，即描述研究对象及对象与对象之间的联系，并通过事物之间的联系找出事物的运动规律。集合论与图论为此提供了强有力的描述工具与推理理论。 本课程的目标是通过理论学习，使学生正确地理解概念，正确地使用概念进行推理，养成一个好的思维习惯，理解理论与实践的关系。引导学生观察生活、社会和大自然，分析事物间的联系，建立系统的模型，提出和解决其中的复杂工程问题。 本课程主要包含二部分内容：集合论与图论。集合论是整个数学的基础，也是计算机科学的基础，计算机科学领域中的大多数基本概念和理论，几乎均采用集合论的有关术语来描述和论证，而图论的基本知识则将始终陪伴着每一个计算机工作者的职业生涯。 计算学科以抽象、理论、设计为其学科形态，以数学方法和系统方法为其学科方法，本课程的核心目标就是在抽象和理论的基础上提供数学方法，因此，本课程是整个专业的基础课程，是计算机专业最重要的课程之一。
default.en: "Set Theory and Graph Theory" is a basic course of computer and electronic communication specialty. This course provides the necessary mathematical tools for subsequent professional basic courses and specialized courses, and provides mathematical language for describing discrete models. The curriculum is set to cultivate students' abstract thinking and logical reasoning ability, improve students' ability to propose problems, analyze problems and solve problems, and improve students' mathematical accomplishment and computer science quality. In order to solve the problem with computer, it is necessary to establish a mathematical model for it, that is, to describe the objects studied and the relationships among them, and to find out the law of motion through the connections among them. Set theory and graph theory provide powerful descriptive tools and reasoning theory for this purpose. The aim of this course is to make students understand the concept correctly, use the concept to reasoning correctly, develop a good habit of thinking, and understand the relationship between theory and practice through theoretical study. Guide students to observe life, society and nature, analyze the relationship between things, establish a model of the system, and propose and solve complex engineering problems. This course consists of two parts: set theory and graph theory. Set theory is the foundation of mathematics, but also the basis of computer science. Terms of set theory can describe most all of the basic concepts and theories in the field of computer science. The basic knowledge of graph theory will always accompany every computer worker’ occupation career. The form of computational discipline contains abstraction, theory and design, while the discipline methods consists of mathematical method and system method, the core goal of this course is to provide mathematical method, based on the abstraction and theory and therefore, this course is a basic course of the specialty, is one of the most important courses in computer science.

default.zh: 高级语言程序设计是高等工科院校中非计算机专业的一门计算机公共基础课。设置本课程的主要目的是培养学生的程序设计、实现及调试能力。通过本课程的学习，使学生学会用计算机处理问题的思维方法，增强解决问题的编程实践能力，为将来从事软件开发及后继课程的学习和解决工程问题、科学技术问题奠定基础。
default.en: High-level Language Programming is a basic computer course for non-computer majors in higher engineering colleges. The main purpose of the course is to cultivate students' programming, implementation, and debugging abilities. The course enables students to handle problems using computers, enhance their programming practical ability to solve problems, and lay the foundation for future learning and solving engineering and scientific problems in software development and subsequent courses.

default.zh: 本课程是非计算机专业的计算机技术基础课程，围绕计算机基本组成结构展开，介绍电子计算机的发展历程，信息在计算机中的表示与运算方法，中央处理器CPU和主存储器的内部组成和工作原理，中断技术等基本概念。课程内容紧跟计算机技术发展的新潮流，着重阐述基本概念、基本原理，强调培养学生建立计算机整机概念，了解计算机系统及其子系统的结构与逻辑实现。本课程不强调特定产品的具体细节，重点讨论常见的计算机体现出的共性概念与原理。本课程具有较强的工程性、技术性和实用性。
default.en: This is a basic course of computer technology for most majors in science and engineering. The course is carried out with a center of computer primary organization, to introduce the progress of computer, the presentation and arithmetic methods of information in computer, the internal organization and principle of central processing unit(CPU) and main memory,pay more attention on basic concept. The content of this course emphasizes the basic concepts and principle, keeps up with the development of computer technology, aim at establishing a big picture of a complete computer, make students understand the logic structure and implementation. This course focuses on the common concepts and principle of the general computer, do not fall into the details of specific products. This course have the features of engineering, technicality and practicality.

default.zh: 数据结构与算法课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程编号：CS32132 课程名称：数据结构与算法 英文名称：Data Structures and Algorithms 课程学时：48 讲课学时：40 实验学时：8 上机学时：0 习题学时：0 课程学分：3 开课单位：计算机科学与技术学院计算机科学与技术系 授课对象：计算机大类 开课学期：2秋 先修课程：集合论与图论、高级语言程序设计 二、课程简介 数据是客观世界的抽象描述，是信息和知识的载体。算法使计算机能够有效地从给定输入生成输出，帮助我们获取数据中的信息和知识。本课程介绍数据的表示、存储、访问方式，以及针对不同数据类型的各种算法的实现、评价和设计策略。数据结构与算法是计算机大类的专业基础课程，本课程旨在通过讲授基本的数据结构以及典型的应用算法，培养学生数据结构和算法的设计能力，使学生能够从数据对象的特性和问题的特征入手，选择适当数据结构并设计相应算法，提高学生的算法和数据结构修养，能够通过实际问题，设计和使用基本数据结构（线性结构、树形结构、图型结构）,能够对基本数据结构上的基本操作算法进行时间和空间复杂性的分析,能够根据算法的实际操作需求，选择、设计适合的数据结构，并能实现相关算法，能够分析计算复杂工程问题，抽象出逻辑结构和问题求解算法，并能设计或选择合理的存储结构，实现问题求解算法。
default.en: To solve real-world problems, usually we need start from data, to build mathematical models and design correct and efficient algorithms, to perform experiments and analyze the result. We try to let students understand it and know well about the basic data structures, widely-used algorithms and design ideas of algorithm types. Data structure and algorithm is a basic course for computer majors. This course aims to help students to acquire the ability to design data structures and algorithms by learning basic data structures and typical application algorithms, so that students can pick appropriate data structures and design corresponding algorithms based on the characteristics of data objects and problems, thus improving their skills on developing algorithms and data structures. Let students know how to develop algorithms by using basic data structures (linear structures, tree structures, graph structures) through practical problems, analyze the time and space complexity of basic operational algorithms on basic data structures, pick and design suitable data structures according to the requirements of algorithms. Finally, by learning this course, students can analyze complex engineering problems, find proper models and data structures, and implement relevant algorithms. Figure out the logical structure of the objects in problems, and can design a suitable storage structure to implement the algorithm to solve the problems.

default.zh: 目前，大数据在各种应用中广泛存在，为了有效应用大数据，需要对其进行有效计算。然而，大数据的规模大、速度快、多样性的特点为其快速有效的计算带来了挑战。为了有效应对这些挑战，大数据计算需要独特的理论和方法。因此，从事数据科学与大数据技术领域的人才需要专门学习大数据计算相关的知识。 大数据计算基础是计算机大类/软件工程大类的一门学科方向性课程，目的是使学生初步认识和了解大数据方向的基础知识，为学生今后深入研究大数据方向求解大规模数据问题奠定思维基础，认识和了解目前大数据科学的研究方法及技术应用体系, 初步了解大数据学科的问题求解思路及能力培养思路，进而理解大数据学科未来工作中的专业要求及能力要求，提高学生对大数据方向求职的核心竞争力。 大数据计算基础课程的内容如包括大数据基础知识、大数据算法、面向大数据的数据结构、大数据计算系统、大数据管理系统以及大数据的应用。其重点在于强调大数据计算和传统计算在算法、系统、数据管理以及应用的不同之处，为进一步学习大数据计算相关知识奠定基础。
default.en: Big data currently play important roles in many applications. For effective application of big data, effective computation for big data is in great demand. However, the features of big data, i.e. volume, velocity and variety, bring new challenges for effective and efficient computation. Big data computation requires special theory and techniques facing these challenges. Therefore, the talents in data science and big data technology require to get specialized knowledge of big data computation. The basis of big data computation is a professional course for the direction of data science and big data technology. The goal of this course is to provide preliminary knowledge for big data computation. This course builds a solid basis for students to solve scalable data-centric problems. Students could learn state-of-art research approaches and applications of data science and big data technology from this course and know the approaches for solving data-centric problems. They could furthermore understand the ability requirement for data science and big data technology. Thus, the competitiveness of students in this area is increased. The contents of this course include basic knowledge of big data, big data algorithm, data structure for big data, computational architecture for big data, big data management system as well as the application of big data. Its emphasis is the difference between big data computation and traditional computation on algorithms, systems, data management and applications to provide solid basis for further study of big data computation.

default.zh: 目前，多媒体等非结构化数据占互联网流量的80%左右。同时，超过70%-80%的潜在可用信息以非结构化的形式存在，如音频/视频信息、社交网络关系、用户购买习惯、环境数据等。本课程将讨论和探索多媒体应用中的机器学习技术，目标如下：（1）理解AI的概念。（2）了解多媒体大数据应用需求。（3）获得实现AI模型的实践经验。（4）积累AI模型调试经验。（5）了解最先进的人工智能算法。 教学内容主要包括（1）机器学习介绍，（2）深度学习（BP，CNN，RNN），（3）非结构化数据索引，（4）大数据应用（如多媒体大数据应用），（5）机器学习/深度学习中的可信计算，（6）加密图像的隐私问题和分类。采用讲授法、演示法和实验法组合的教学方式。 这是一门本科水平的课程，专为对大数据处理和机器学习应用感兴趣的学生设计。要求学生积极参与课堂讨论、实验操作。本课程的最终成绩以课程设计为基础，学生可以单独或两人一组进行课程设计。
default.en: Nowadays, unstructured data such as multimedia data account for around 80% of Internet traffic. Meanwhile, more than 70%–80% potentially usable information exists in unstructured formats, e.g., audio/video information, social network relations, users’ purchasing habits, environmental data, etc. This course will discuss and explore machine learning techniques for multimedia applications with the following objectives: (1) Understanding the concept of AI. (2) Understanding the requirements of multimedia big data applications. (3) Obtaining hand-on experience on implementing AI models. (4) Gaining experience on debugging AI model. (5) Knowing the state-of-the-art AI algorithms. The teaching content mainly includes (1) Introduction to machine learning. (2) Deep learning (BP, CNN and RNN). (3) Indexing for unstructured data. (4) Big Data Applications (e.g., multimedia big data applications). (5) Trustworthy computing in machine learning/deep learning. (6) Privacy concerns and classification over encryption images. This is an undergraduate level course designed for students who are interested in big data processing and machine learning applications. Students are required to actively participate in the class discussions, lab operations. The final grade of this course is based on the course projects, and the students may conduct the course projects individually or in a group of two students.

default.zh: 软件测试是保障软件质量的重要手段，在软件开发中占有重要的地位。本课程对软件测试理论与技术进行深入的讲解。课程内容涵盖了软件质量工程、软件测试概念、原则和演化过程的介绍、以及软件测试基础理论与技术，如测试数据生成、测试预言设计、测试驱动设计，以及测试输出分析等技术与方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生能掌握软件测试的基础理论和方法，为未来从事软件工程以及与应用相关领域的研究奠定理论基础。
default.en: Software testing is an important means of ensuring software quality and holds an important position in software development. This course provides an in-depth explanation of software testing theory and technology. The course content covers an introduction to software quality engineering, software testing concepts, principles, and evolutionary processes, as well as basic theories and techniques of software testing, such as test data generation, test prediction design, test driven design, and test output analysis. Through the study of this course, students will be able to master the basic theories and methods of software testing, laying a theoretical foundation for future research in software engineering and related fields.

default.zh: 《服务计算前沿技术》重点介绍服务计算的基本概念，包括Web服务的关键标准、Web服务架构SOA等，学生将重点学习在Web服务的服务发现、服务推荐、服务组合等相关技术。课程基于当前大数据，物联网，云服务和智慧城市等的应用背景，介绍服务计算在IoT和云计算两个重点领域中的新发展和新技术，特别是在这两个领域中服务模型的新形式，以及在不同领域中目前存在的挑战，培养学生对于新技术的自我学习能力，进一步提高学生的自学能力和解决实际问题的能力，培养学生的综合素质。 课程具体目标如下： 课程目标1：理解服务计算的基本概念、原理、关键标准，能够对服务计算领域的基本问题进行分析。 课程目标2：掌握服务计算中服务发现、服务选择、服务流程组合等相关技术，能够实现在大量的服务中发现、或者通过流程组合，实现满足符合功能需求的服务。 课程目标3：了解IoT和云计算两个领域中，前沿的服务计算发展方向和技术，通过文献检索，能够分析服务计算的新应用、新技术的发展趋势和可能存在的问题。
default.en: Advanced Web Service Technologies will provide students an opportunity to understand the basic concepts behind service computing, and new service computing development and research directions, particularly giving the consideration of recent exciting application areas such as big data, the Internet of Things, cloud computing and smart cities, especially in these two fields, the new forms of service models and the current challenges in different fields aim to cultivate students' self-learning ability towards new technologies, further improve their self-learning ability and problem-solving ability, and cultivate their comprehensive qualities. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Course objective 1: Understand the basic concepts, principles, and key standards of service computing, and be able to analyze basic problems in the field of service computing. Course objective 2: Master relevant technologies such as service discovery, service selection, and service process composition in service computing, and be able to discover a large number of services or achieve services that meet functional requirements through process composition. Course objective 3: Understand the cutting-edge development directions and technologies of service computing in the fields of IoT and cloud computing. Through literature search, be able to analyze the new applications, development trends, and potential problems of service computing.

default.zh: 电子技术B课程是为全校非电类专业开设的一门技术基础课。其目的是使学生通过本课程的学习，获得电子技术必要的基本理论，基本知识和基本技能，了解电子技术的应用和发展概况，为从事与本专业有关的工程技术等工作打下一定的基础。 本课程主要内容包括：模拟电子技术和数字电子技术。模拟电子技术包括：半导体器件、基本放大电路、集成运算放大电路、直流稳压电路。数字电子技术包括：门电路及组合逻辑电路、触发器及时序逻辑电路。 电子技术是一门实践性较强的技术基础课，通过本课程的学习，着重培养学生分析问题、解决问题及综合用电技术的能力，增加创新意识。
default.en: Electronics B is a fundamental curriculum for undergraduates not majoring in Electrical Engineering or related disciplines. This course is presented with the goal of understanding the behavior of electronic devices, circuits, and systems before the nitty-gritty details of calculating the behavior, having a general idea of the applications and advancements of electronic technology, and build a strong foundation on pursuing the relative engineering work. The main contents include: The basic working principle and characteristics of semiconductor devices; Transistor amplifiers; Operational amplifiers; Active working principles of rectifier circuits, filter circuits and DC regulators; Logic gates; Analysis and design of digital logic circuits. Electronics B is a course with strong practicality and comprehensiveness. Through the analysis of some practical cases, this course will cultivate students' abilities to apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 电路与电子技术基础是非电类专业的一门技术基础课，本课程主要讲授电路基础、模拟电路和数字电路的基础理论和相关分析方法。具体内容包括：直流电路的基本概念、基本定律和基本分析方法；电路瞬态过程产生的原因和条件，一阶电路瞬态过程中电压电流的变化规律和分析方法；交流电的基本概念，正弦量的相量表示法与计算；三相电源和负载的连接方式，三相电路中的电压、电流和功率计算；常用半导体器件；由分立元件构成的基本放大电路的电路结构、工作原理以及分析方法；集成运算放大器的特性及典型应用电路；数字逻辑基础知识以及组合逻辑电路的分析与设计；双稳态触发器的类型与逻辑功能，典型时序逻辑电路的分析方法与应用。 通过本课程的学习，使学生获得电路与电子技术的基本理论、基本分析方法和基本技能，了解电路、电子技术的应用情况和发展趋势。通过本课程的理论教学以及后续实验操作等环节，培养学生对电工以及电子系统的综合分析、综合设计能力，强化学生工程伦理教育，在日后工程实践及日常生活中能够运用所学的电学知识分析和解决实际问题。
default.en: Fundamentals of Circuit and Electronic Technology, is a curriculum for undergraduates not majoring in Electrical Engineering or related disciplines. The course focuses on basic theories and analysis methods of circuits and electronics, and its contents include: Basic concepts, laws and analysis methods of DC circuits; Transient state analysis of First-order linear circuits; Analysis and calculation of sinusoidal AC circuits; Analysis and calculation of three phase AC circuits; Working principle of commonly used semiconductor devices; Transistor amplifiers; Operational amplifiers and their applications; Logic gates; Analysis and design of digital logic circuits, etc. The purpose of this course is for students to obtain basic theory, knowledge and technical skill in circuit and electronic technology field, have a general idea of the applications and advancements of circuit and electronic technology, build a strong foundation on pursuing the relative engineering work, and possess a strong sense of responsibility, good work manner and work ethic. Through the analysis of some practical cases, this course will cultivate students' abilities to apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 电工学实验是培养本科非电类专业学生理论联系实际的实践性环节，为学生提供了一个培养动手能力、综合设计能力和创新能力的实践平台。本课程主要讲授常见电工仪器仪表的使用方法、直流、交流、单管等基础原理的验证、电动机的继电接触器控制、数字逻辑及时序逻辑电路的设计、OrCAD仿真高新技术的应用，既包括基础性验证实验，又包括综合性、设计性创新实验。 通过本课程的基于网络数字化资源的预习、后续的实验操作和计算机仿真等环节，使学生掌握常用电工仪器的使用方法和常用电路的调试测量方法，加深理解基础电路的工作原理，提高学生的分析设计能力，了解高新技术，培养学生的综合素质及工程能力。
default.en: The main purpose of the electrician technique experiment is to foster the undergraduate of non–electrical specialties to apply in practice the knowledge they had acquired in theory class, and construct a platform for students that can develop their practical ability, comprehensive design ability and innovation ability. This course teaches students the usage of instruments and meters, the validation of basic principles, such as DC, AC and single tube etc, the control of relay contactor of the electromotor, the design of digital logic and sequential logic circuit, and the application of OrCAD simulation technology. This course includes the design of the confirmatory experiments, comprehensive experiments, and also includes creative experiments. Through the preview which is based on network digital resources, experimental operation, and computer simulation, students could easily master the usage of the instruments and meters, and the debugging and measuring methods of common circuits, and deeply understand circuit operational principles, and improve their abilities to analyze issues, understand new and high technology, and develop students' comprehensive quality and engineering ability.

default.zh: 互换性与测量技术基础课程目的使学生掌握互换性、标准化的概念及机械零部件精度设计的基本原理和方法；了解典型零件极限与配合标准的组成和应用以及各种典型零件制造精度的确定方法。进一步加强学生基本理论、基本知识和基本技能的学习和训练。不仅进一步培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，还要培养学生独立工作能力及动手能力。 课程主要内容包括互换性和标准化的基本概念，尺寸精度设计，几何精度设计，表面粗糙度精度设计，典型零部件精度设计（滚动轴承、平键、花键、螺纹等）、尺寸链的计算等。
default.en: The purpose of the subject “Fundamentals of interchangeability and measurement technology” is to help students have a good mastery of the concepts of interchangeability and standardization, basic principles and design methods of machine parts; and know the composition and application of limiting and matching standards of typical parts, and the method for deciding manufacturing accuracy of typical parts; and to help students further study and train basic theory, knowledge and skill; and cultivate the ability of analyzing and solving problems and the ability of independently working and operating. Its main content includes: the design principle of geometric accuracy of mechanical parts——interchangeability and standardizationsize, dimensional accuracy design basis, geometric accuracy design basis, surface roughness, precision design of typical components accuracy(rolling bearing, flat key, rectangle spline,screw thread)，precision design of gear drive, calculation of dimension chain .

default.zh: 电磁兼容是研究电子系统或器件之间的干扰机理、干扰测量、如何设计干扰和受扰设备以减轻干扰水平或增强敏感设备的抗扰度的一门课程。 通过这一课程将学习到电磁兼容现象及其出现的原因，学会如何在电子设计过程中实现电磁兼容。本课程将以电子系统以及信号完整性为背景，重新学习基本的电路概念，使同学们对这些概念以及基本电路参数之间的相互作用有更深的理解。
default.en: Electromagnetic Compatibility is the study of how one electronic system or device interferes with another, how this can be measured and how both the victim and the threat can be better designed to minimise both the level of interference and the response of the victim. This module studies EMC phenomena, their causes, electronic design mitigation. It does this by setting EMC firmly into the concepts of electronics and signal integrity: revisiting basic circuit concepts but interpreting them in a way that develops a deeper understanding of those concepts and the interaction of basic circuit parameters.

default.zh: 本课程概述了电化学能量转换和存储装置(如电池、超级电容器、燃料电池和电解槽)工作的基本原理，旨在使学生了解化学能和电能相互转换的热力学原理、能量转化存储装置的工作原理以及它们的工程应用。该课程总结了上述技术在性能、寿命、安全性和成本方面所面临的挑战，突出了它们在实现能源清洁化方面的重要作用。
default.en: This course provides an overview of the fundamental principles underpinning the operation of electrochemical energy conversion and storage devices, such as batteries, supercapacitors, fuel cells and electrolysers. It is designed to give the students an understanding of the thermodynamic principles underpinning the interconversion of chemical and electrical energy, the basic theory of operation of the devices and how they are used in a range of engineering applications. The course summarizes the challenges of increasing the performance, lifetime and safety of these technologies, while continuing to drive down their cost, and highlights their role in enabling decarbonisation of the energy sector.

default.zh: 本课程将介绍电力电子技术在可再生能源系统并网场景下的基础知识、先进概念和控制方法，包括电力电子变换器的拓扑结构、调制策略和控制方法、光伏系统并网技术，以及系统仿真方法。
default.en: This course will introduce the basics, advanced concepts and control methods for using power electronics as the enabling technology for the grid integration of renewable energy systems, including the topologies, modulation strategies, control methods of the power converters, the grid integration of PV systems, and the simulation techniques.

default.zh: 经贸英文报刊文章选读课旨在培养具备国际视野和商业沟通能力的人才。本课程将扩展学生经贸及商务英语词汇量、提升英文经贸文章的阅读理解能力，掌握长难句子的分析方法，提高阅读速度，从而直接获取第一手的国际市场资讯，快速全面了解国际商贸的最新行情和动态，有的放矢的做出决策。课程内容选自《时代周刊》《福布斯》《VOA》《BBC》等多种英文报刊。要求学生具备良好的英语基础，至少具备大学英语四级水平。
default.en: Selected Readings on International Business & Economics from Western Journals is one of the major optional courses for students in Economics and Trade and all the other majors in the School of Management, Harbin Institute of Technology. Through reading and analyzing relative articles in the field of business and economics on English newspaper, magazines, web and academic journals, this course will help the students understand the characteristics of economic articles, improve reading skill, vocabulary, as well as analysis ability. Meanwhile, enable the students to collect the latest international business information, trace the developments of prevailing world economy with broader vision, exercise their logic thinking and enlarge their international business background knowledge.

default.zh: 热机，是能够将热源提供的一部分热量转化成为对外输出的机械能的机器。由于向热机提供热能的热源实际上可以由任何种类的能量提供，因此热机涵盖了广泛的应用，在人类生活中发挥着重要的作用。从现代交通工具中使用的内燃机，到火力发电厂中的蒸汽机，热机的应用和发展推动了社会的快速发展。 本课程从热力学基础理论出发，详尽地介绍了气体循环和蒸汽循环两类热机的理论和应用，重点介绍了一类特殊的朗肯循环——有机朗肯循环的发展和应用价值，并在课程的最后介绍了热机在核能中的应用。 通过本课程的学习，让学生了解各类热机的发展历程、工作原理、应用背景和研究前沿，为学生今后在相关领域的科研实践打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Heat engine is a machine that can convert part of the heat provided by a heat source into mechanical energy for external output. Since the heat source that supplies thermal energy to the engine can thus be powered by virtually any kind of energy, the heat engine covers a wide range of applications and plays an important role in human life. From internal combustion engines used in modern vehicles to steam engines in thermal power plants, the application and development of heat engines have promoted the rapid development of society. Starting from the basic theory of thermodynamics, this course introduces in detail the theories and applications of two types of heat engines, gas cycle and steam cycle, and focuses on the development and application value of a special type of Rankine cycle—Organic Rankine Cycle. Finally, the application of heat engine in nuclear energy is introduced. Through the study of this course, students will be able to understand the development process, working principle, application background and research frontiers of various heat engines, and lay a solid foundation for their future scientific research in related fields.

default.zh: 许多科学设备和实验都需要超高真空，普通的真空泵可能无法在高抽速下实现超真空。在这种情况下，需要使用低温泵。本课程将讲授真空技术的基本概念，介绍适用于每个真空级别的泵类型，例如油/干式粗/前级泵，扩散泵，涡轮分子泵，离子泵和低温泵等。对于低温泵，我们将介绍工作液，安全预防措施，以及相关工作原理。以高能物理同步加速器辐射电子加速器领域为例，介绍每个泵在实际应用中的工作原理与技术。
default.en: many scientific equipment and experiment require ultra-high vacuum , normal vacuum pumps may not be able achieve the ultra-vacuum at the high pumping speed. When this is the case, cryo pump is required. We will build the basic concept of vacuum technology, the pumps type for each vacuum level such as oil/dry rough/fore pumps, diffusion pumps, turbo molecular pumps, ion pumps and cryogenic pumps. For the cryo pump, we induce the working fluid, the safety precaution, working principle. In between we will add some practical application examples for each pumps in the field of high energy physics, synchrotron radiation electron accelerator.

default.zh: 《综合英语》是面向英才学院一年级学生开设的一门英语必修课程。本课程旨在全方位夯实学生语言基础知识，主要通过阅读、词汇、写作等方面的训练，培养和提高学生的综合英语能力，扩大词汇量。在培养学生的自主学习良好习惯的同时，提高学生的综合英语能力，包括词汇知识、词汇记忆和词汇应用能力，以及阅读句子、段落、短文的阅读技巧，和写作句子、段落、短文的能力，以形成合理的语言学习策略，使其英语综合能力达到《大学英语课程教学要求》的较高要求。本课程的考核方式为累加式。
default.en: Integrated English Skills is a course for first-year students in the Honors School of Harbin Institute of Technology. It aims at developing basic English knowledge and skills. Its objective is to develop students’ overall language skills, especially vocabulary learning, sentence and paragraph reading and critical reading. It increases students’ analytic thinking and study skills by raising their English competence through a teaching focus on word formation, word recognition and memorization, word use, sentence analysis, identification of the main ideas in reading, understanding of restatements and inferences, and writing sentences, paragraphs, and short articles. This course is assessed in a cumulative manner.

default.zh: 《学术英语阅读》是面向英才学院一年级学生开设的一门英语必修课程。本课程旨在用一个学期的时间，全面提高学生的英语综合能力，尤其是批判性阅读能力和模仿写作能力。通过分析文章体裁和讲解语言难度较高的句子，使学生能够分析和归纳文章主要内容，找到或概括出文章主题，并回答相关问题和进行讨论，欣赏和批评阅读文章。利用篇章结构和文章体裁训练和培养写作能力。训练学生写出内容完整，条理清晰，文理顺畅的短文。通过英语课程中的读写译训练扩充词汇量。提高学生的英语理解能力和书面表达能力，形成合理的自主语言学习策略。
default.en: Advanced English is a course for first-year students in the Honors School of Harbin Institute of Technology. It aims at enhancing their English knowledge and skills. Its objective is to develop students’ overall language skills, especially their critical reading and essay writing skills. By analyzing the organization and style of reading materials, students will learn to read for gist and to read between the lines, to summarize and discuss the reading materials, and to appreciate and criticize them. Students will also learn to write short essays through reading and imitation. They will also enlarge their vocabulary through reading and writing classic materials. Upon completion of this course, the students’ English reading comprehension and writing skills will be improved, and strategies they can use in future learning developed.

default.zh: 本课程旨在提高学生英语综合能力及英语应用技能，并为进一步参与各领域国际交流打下坚实的基础。本课程以雅思听、说、读、写技能要求为标准，精选听、说、读、写训练素材。听力材料精选自不同生活场景素材；口语训练涉及各种话题；阅读训练紧扣题型并精选材料；写作涵盖各类图表作文和论述文写作技能训练。本课程同时侧重扩大学生的词汇量，熟悉复杂语法结构，扩展背景知识。最终学生在听力方面能够基本无障碍听懂日常对话、学术讨论、讲座以及各种媒体信息；在口语方面能够迅速整理思路，清晰准确地表达观点，从容参与日常交流、学术讨论及各种场合的口语互动；在阅读方面能够快速准确地接纳学术期刊和论著的文字信息和各种媒体文字信息；在写作方面能够准确地描述科学数据和各种图表，有条理地分析多种社会领域问题并提出解决方案，清晰流畅地表达较复杂的学术观点。
default.en: This course aims to develop students’ comprehensive abilities of the English language (listening, speaking, reading and writing) so that solid foundation will be laid for the students to communicate and interact internationally in various fields and on different occasions. This course covers four parts (listening, speaking, reading and writing) and teaching materials are carefully collected strictly according to the requirements of IELTS tests. Listening materials are chosen from different situations in real life; speaking materials include all kinds of related topics; reading materials closely model IELTS tests; writing materials cover seven possible variations for task 1 and three possible variations for task 2. This course also helps students to develop lexical and syntactic skills specifically focusing on the building of vocabulary and the understanding of complex sentence structures as well as the broadening of their English background knowledge. At the end of this course, students’ comprehensive abilities are good enough to understand daily conversations, academic lectures and seminars, etc. in English; speak English fluently and clearly; read English journal articles and books with accurate comprehension; write English essays cohesively and coherently and describe information given in charts and graphs logically and clearly.

default.zh: 《学术英语演讲比赛训练营》(Workshop for Academic English Presentation Contest) 是面向一年级非英语专业本科生发展级开设的一门英语创新创业课。旨在提高理工科学生的学术技能， 提高我校学生参加学术会议等学术活动的能力。课程教学围绕全国大学生五分钟学术英语演讲比赛展开，具体包括阅读学术文献、撰写论文、宣读论文、参加学术讨论等。该课程采用“以结果为导向”的学术英语教学法，结合正式期刊或会议论文，训练学生学术英语演讲技能，培养学术素养。
default.en: 《学术英语演讲比赛训练营》(Workshop for Academic English Presentation Contest) 是面向一年级非英语专业本科生发展级开设的一门英语创新创业课。旨在提高理工科学生的学术技能， 提高我校学生参加学术会议等学术活动的能力。课程教学围绕全国大学生五分钟学术英语演讲比赛展开，具体包括阅读学术文献、撰写论文、宣读论文、参加学术讨论等。该课程采用“以结果为导向”的学术英语教学法，结合正式期刊或会议论文，训练学生学术英语演讲技能，培养学术素养。

default.zh: 俄罗斯是横跨欧亚大陆、领土面积世界第一的国家。独特的社会、历史、人文和地理因素造就了俄罗斯艺术独具一格的特征。《俄罗斯文化艺术》阐释相关的美学理论和文化艺术赏析知识，系统讲解俄罗斯文化艺术的发展，赏析俄罗斯具有代表性的文化艺术作品。本课程通过对美学知识的传授和俄罗斯文化艺术的欣赏，使学生不仅能够了解俄罗斯文化艺术的发展脉络和，掌握俄罗斯当今俄罗斯的文化艺术，而且具备一定的欣赏能力，从而丰富学生的人文文化素养。
default.en: Russia is the world's largest country across the Eurasian continent and the largest territory in the world. Unique social, historical, humanistic and geographical factors have created unique characteristics of Russian art. "Russian Culture and Art" explains related aesthetic theories and cultural and artistic appreciation knowledge, systematically explains the development of Russian culture and art, and appreciates representative Russian cultural and artistic works. Through the teaching of aesthetics and the appreciation of Russian culture and art, this course enables students to not only understand the development context of Russian culture and art, and master the current Russian culture and art in Russia, but also have a certain appreciation ability, thereby enriching students' humanistic and cultural literacy .

default.zh: 本课程适合以汉语为目的语的零起点的学习者。在该阶段，培养听、说能力比读、写能力更重要。因此，本课程用一学年的时间，完成汉语发音、基本语法以及日常生活必需的交流方式的教学，同时，在课堂上介绍相关的中国文化知识及中国现状。通过一年的学习，学生应当掌握汉语拼音和基本的汉语语法知识，具有初步的听说读写能力，能够满足日常生活、学习以及一般场合的交际需要。
default.en: This course is suitable for beginners of Chinese as the target language learners.At this stage,Listening, speaking ability is more important than reading and writing ability.Therefore,this course with the school year to complete the Chinese pronunciation, basic grammar, and the teaching of the daily necessities of life exchanges.At the same time，introduce the relevant knowledge of Chinese culture and present situation of China.By one year of study，students should master the Pinyin and basic knowledge of Chinese grammar，have preliminary ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing,and be able to meet the communication needs of daily life, learning, and general occasions.

default.zh: 本课程适合以汉语为目的语的零起点的学习者。在该阶段，培养听、说能力比读、写能力更重要。因此，本课程用一学年的时间，完成汉语发音、基本语法以及日常生活必需的交流方式的教学，同时，在课堂上介绍相关的中国文化知识及中国现状。通过一年的学习，学生应当掌握汉语拼音和基本的汉语语法知识，具有初步的听说读写能力，能够满足日常生活、学习以及一般场合的交际需要。
default.en: This course is suitable for beginners of Chinese as the target language learners.At this stage,Listening, speaking ability is more important than reading and writing ability.Therefore,this course with the school year to complete the Chinese pronunciation, basic grammar, and the teaching of the daily necessities of life exchanges.At the same time，introduce the relevant knowledge of Chinese culture and present situation of China.By one year of study，students should master the Pinyin and basic knowledge of Chinese grammar，have preliminary ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing,and be able to meet the communication needs of daily life, learning, and general occasions.

default.zh: 中级汉语课程是土木学院、化工学院留学生的综合课、必修课。它以语言技能训练为主，并辅之必要的语言知识、文化背景知识教学的讲授。整个教学过程要进行听、说、读、写的综合训练。本课程采用对外汉语系列教材：《汉语教程》，每课由课文、生词、词语搭配与扩展、语法例释、练习等部分组成。内容详尽、难度适宜。通过学习可以进一步扩大学生的词汇量，巩固、补充、扩展、深化基本语法项目，逐步提高阅读能力。
default.en: Intermediate Chinese course is a comprehensive and compulsory course for international students in the School of Civil Engineering and the School of Chemical Engineering. It mainly focuses on language skills training, supplemented by the teaching of necessary language knowledge and cultural background knowledge. The entire teaching process requires comprehensive training in listening, speaking, reading, and writing. This course adopts the series of textbooks for teaching Chinese as a foreign language: "Chinese Tutorial". Each lesson consists of text, new words, word combinations and extensions, grammar examples, exercises, and other parts. The content is detailed and the difficulty is appropriate. Through learning, students can further expand their vocabulary, consolidate, supplement, expand, and deepen basic grammar items, and gradually improve their reading ability.

default.zh: 中级汉语课程是土木学院、化工学院留学生的综合课、必修课。它以语言技能训练为主，并辅之必要的语言知识、文化背景知识教学的讲授。整个教学过程要进行听、说、读、写的综合训练。本课程采用对外汉语系列教材：《成功之路*起步篇》，每课由正课文、生词、词语搭配与扩展、语法例释、副课文、练习等部分组成。内容详尽、难度适宜。通过学习可以进一步扩大学生的词汇量，巩固、补充、扩展、深化基本语法项目，逐步提高阅读能力。
default.en: Intermediate Chinese language is a comprehensive and obligatory course. It's main aim is language skills training.At the same time the teacher introduce the necessary knowledge of the language and cultural background. The entire teaching process includes comprehensive training of listening, speaking, reading and writing.This course uses the textbook: the "bridge - Practical Chinese Intermediate tutorials".Each lesson consists of six parts:positive text, new words,words expansion, grammar, vice text and exercises.The content is detailed and the difficulty is very suitable.Through the study,students can expand vocabulary,consolidate, supplement, extend, and deepen the basic grammar items, and gradually increase the reading ability.

default.zh: 课程涵盖了弹性介质中超声波和声波传播的基础科学，以及该科学在无损检测中的应用。介绍了控制超声波传播的数学方程式，并将其作为开发在实际情况下用于建模超声波传播的技术的基础。
default.en: The material in this course covers the underlying science of ultrasonic and acoustic wave propagation in elastic media, and the application of this science to NDT. The mathematical equations that govern the propagation of ultrasonic waves are introduced and used as a foundation to develop the techniques used in modelling ultrasonic wave propagation in practical situations.

default.zh: 随着社会发展，生命科学与人类健康、环境保障、工业与技术产业发展的关系日益紧密。科学技术的发展和融合呼唤高水平的复合型人才，不仅要有良好的数、理、化和专业基础知识，还要有生命科学和信息科学的相关知识。为此，21世纪的高等教育知识体系中，需要具备生命科学的知识及其理念。本课程是面向全校学生开出的核心课程，旨在扩大学生的知识面，培养学生生命科学的思维方式，将生命科学的思想、方法运用到他们所从事的工作领域。通过学习生命科学的基础知识和基本理论，使学生了解生命科学的最新成就和发展趋势。
default.en: With the development of society, the relationship between life science and human health, environmental protection, the development of industry and technology industry is becoming increasingly close.
