The development and integration of science and technology calls for high level of compound talents, not only a good math, science, chemistry and professional basic knowledge, but also related knowledge of life science and information science. Therefore, in the twenty-first Century higher education knowledge system, the knowledge and concept of life science were needed. This course is a core course for all students. It aims at expanding students' knowledge, cultivating students' thinking mode of life science, and applying the ideas and methods of life science to their work field. By learning the basics of life science and basic theory, it will help students to understand the latest achievements of life science and development trends.

default.zh: 概率论与数理统计是研究随机现象统计规律的一门数学学科。 概率论是以数学模型为基础来研究随机现象，并用数学语言描述随机现象，进而研究其基本规律，找出其内在规律，在随机现象和其他数学分支之间架起一座桥梁，利用数学工具和方法来研究随机现象。 数理统计是以概率论为基础，运用概率论和数学方法，研究如何收集具有随机影响的信息和数据，建立适当的数学模型(随机统计模型)，通过统计模型对数据和信息进行统计分析，对问题进行统计推断和决策研究。数理统计是应用数学中最重要和最活跃的学科之一，它已经在自然科学和社会科学中得到了越来越广泛的应用，在国民经济和科学技术中发挥着越来越重要的作用。 随着大数据时代的到来，作为工科本科生，应该具备概率论和数理统计的基础知识，掌握它们的思想和方法以及数据分析能力。本课程突出概率论与数理统计的特点，注重概率论与数理统计思想方法的介绍，重视概率论与数理统计的应用，培养学生随机数学思维的能力。本课程讲授概率论与数理统计的基本概念、随机事件的概率、随机变量及其分布、随机变量的数字特征与极限理论、数据分析、估计问题等内容。
default.en: Probability theory and mathematical statistics is a mathematical discipline to study the statistical laws of random phenomenon. Probability theory is based on mathematical models to random phenomenon, and describes random phenomenon by mathematical language, then to study the basic law, to find out the inherent law, building a bridge random phenomenon and other mathematics branches, using mathematical tools and methods to research random phenomena. Mathematical statistics is based on probability theory, it applies probability theory and mathematical method, researches how to collect information and data with random effects, establishes appropriate mathematical models (random statistical model), statistical analysis of the data and information by the statistical model, to make statistical inference and decision of study on the problem. Mathematical statistics is one of applied Mathematics as the most important and active subject, it has been applied in natural science and Social Science in the more extensive, in the national economy and science and technology in a more and more important role. With the advent of the era of big data, as an engineering undergraduate, we should have the basic knowledge of probability and mathematical statistics, master their ideas and methods and data analysis capabilities. This course highlights the characteristics of probability theory and mathematical statistics, pays attention to the introduction of probability and statistics thought method, attaches importance to the application of probability and statistics, and trains students' ability of random mathematical thinking. This course teaches the basic concepts of probability theory and mathematical statistics, the probability of random events, random variable and its distribution, the number of characteristics of random variables and limit theory, data analysis, estimation and so on.

default.zh: 《复变函数与积分变换》 是电类及与电有关的理工科专业本科生的必修工程数学课。本课程是理工科院校电类专业本科生的一门基础课，是继微积分、线性代数与空间解析几何课程之后的又一门数学基础课，主要研究复变函数以及积分变换的基本理论和有关方法。它的理论和方法不仅在数学的许多分支中，而且在其它自然科学和各种工程技术领域中均有着广泛的应用。 本课程分两部分： 第一部分主要研究复变函数中的基本理论以及有关的工程技术中的常用数学方法， 重点讲授解析函数的微积分理论、 泰勒级数及洛朗级数展开、留数的计算及应用，通过初等函数的映射特点，给出保形映射的应用等。 第二部分是积分变换理论内容，主要介绍傅立叶积分变换、拉普拉斯变换及其有关方法， 着重讲授相关性质和变换在工程中的应用。通过本课程的学习，学生不仅能学到复变函数与积分变换中的基本理论及工程技术中的常用数学方法，同时还可以巩固和复习微积分等基础知识，为学习有关的后续课程和进一步扩大数学知识面奠定必要的数学基础。 通过本课程的学习，也使学生提高了抽象思维能力、逻辑推理能力、空间想象能力以及科学创新能力。
default.en: The course, Complex Function and Integral Transformation, is a compulsory course of Engineering Mathematics for undergraduate students majoring in Electrical and other Science and Engineering related with Electrical. As a basic course for undergraduate students majoring in Electrical Science and Engineering College, it is a basic Mathematics class after Calculus, Linear Algebra and Space Analytic Geometry, which mainly studies the complex function and integral transform basic theory and related methods. Its theory and method are widely used not only in many branches of Mathematics, but also in other natural science and various of Engineering Technology. The main content of this course is divided into two parts. The first part mainly studies the basic theory of complex variable function and common mathematical methods used in Engineering Technology, which focus on the calculus theory of analytic function, the expansion of Taylor series and Laurent series, the calculation and application of the residue, the properties of elementary complex variable function and the application of Conformal Mapping. The second part is about the theory of Integral Transformation. It mainly introduces the Fourier Integral Transform, Laplace Transform and related methods, which focuses on related properties and applications of transformation in engineering. By studying this course, students can not only learn the basic theory of Complex Function and Integral Transformation and the common mathematical methods in Engineering Technology, but also consolidate and review basic knowledge of Calculus. Then, it help students to lay the necessary mathematical foundation for the following study of relevant courses and the mathematical knowledge. Meanwhile, it also improves the students' ability of abstract thinking, logical reasoning, spatial imagination and scientific creativity.

default.zh: 课程包含极限、一元微分学、一元积分学、微分方程几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.函数：函数及其性质，复合函数，初等函数。 2.极限与连续：极限定义，极限的性质与运算法则，无穷小与无穷大，函数的连续性。 3.导数与微分：导数的基本公式与四则运算法则，反函数与复合函数求导法则，隐函数与参数式函数求导法则，高阶导数，微分。 4.微分中值定理：微分中值定理，洛必达法则，泰勒公式。 5.不定积分：原函数与不定积分，换元积分法，分部积分法。 6定积分：定积分的定义与性质，微积分基本定理，定积分的换元积分法和分部积分法，反常积分。 7.导数与积分应用：函数的极值与最大（小）值，函数的分析作图法，曲线的弧长与弧微分，曲率，定积分的应用。 8.微分方程：一阶微分方程，几种可积的高阶微分方程。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including limit, unitary differential calculus, unitary integral calculus, differential equation： 1. Functions: Functions and their properties, composite functions, elementary functions. 2. Limits and continuity: Definition of limit, limit properties and laws, infinities and infinitesimals, continuity. 3. Derivatives and differentials: Differentiation formulas and rules, chain rule, implicit differentiation, higher derivatives, differentials. 4. Mean value theorem: Mean value theorem of differentials, L`hospital rule, Taylor formula. 5. Infinite integrals: Antiderivatives and infinite integrals, substitution rule, integration by parts. 6. Definite integrals: Definition and properties of definite integral, fundamental theorem of calculus, substitution rule, integration by parts, improper integrals. 7. Applications of differentiation and integration: Maximum and minimum values, curve sketching, arc length and differential of arc length, curvature, applications of integration. 8. Differential equations: First-order differential equations, some integrable higher-order differential equations.

default.zh: 课程包含多元微分学、多元积分学、微分方程及无穷级数几部分内容，具体内容如下： 1.线性微分方程。 2.多元函数微分学：偏导数与高阶偏导数，全微分，复合函数求导法，隐函数求导法，偏导数的几何应用，多元函数的泰勒公式与极值，方向导数与梯度。 3.多元函数积分学：黎曼积分定义，二重积分，三重积分，第一型曲线积分，第一型曲面积分，黎曼积分的应用。 4.第二型曲线积分与第二型曲面积分：向量场，第二型曲线积分，格林公式，第二型曲面积分，高斯公式，通量与散度，斯托克斯公式，环量与旋度。 5.无穷级数：无穷级数及其性质，正项级数，任意项级数，函数项级数，幂级数，傅里叶级数。
default.en: The course of calculus includes several parts, including multivariate differential calculus, multivariate integral calculus, differential equation and infinite series： 1. linear differential equations. 2. Multivariable differential calculus: Partial derivatives and higher partial derivatives, total differentials, chain rule, implicit differentiation, applications of partial derivatives to geometry, Taylor formula and extreme values, directional derivatives and gradients. 3. Multivariable integral calculus: Definition of Riemann integrals, double integrals, triple integrals, line integrals, surface integrals, applications of Riemann integrals. 4.Infinite series: Infinite series and its properties, positive series, arbitrary series, function series, power series, Fourier series.

default.zh: 本课程系统介绍线性代数与空间解析几何的基本理论和方法，把线性代数与空间解析几何有机地结合起来。内容包括行列式的定义，计算及其性质；矩阵的代数运算，分块矩阵，矩阵求秩；向量代数，引入向量坐标，并在其下讨论几何问题，讨论平面与直线的方程及其相互位置关系；n维向量，向量组间的线性相关性与线性无关性的讨论；介绍线性方程组解的结构理论；特征值与特征向量，相似变换，矩阵可对角化的条件和方法，利用特征值和特征向量化简矩阵的计算方法；介绍线性空间与线性变换，线性变换的矩阵；介绍二次型的理论，讨论二次型的化简，简介二次曲面及其分类。 考察方式为累加式，作业及课堂表现占20%，期中考试占 20%，期末考试占 60%。
default.en: This course is intended to introduce fundamental methods and concepts in linear algebra and analytic geometry. It is an organic combination of linear algebra and analytic geometry. Topics are usually selected from: the definition of determinant, its calculation and properties; operations of matrices, partitioned matrices and the rank of a matrix; vector algebra, vector coordinates and geometric questions which based on coordinates, the equations of a plane and a line and the relations between plans and lines; n-dimensional vectors, linear independence among vector set; the structure of solution sets of linear system; eigenvalues, eigenvectors, similar transformations, the conditions and methods of diagonalizations of matrices, methods of diagonalizations of matrices using eigenvalues and eigenvectors; linear spaces and linear transformations, the matrix of a linear transformation; the theory of quadratic forms, simplification of quadratic forms; the quadratic surface and its classification. The grade policy is as following: homework and performance in class 20%, midterm exam 20%, and final exam 60%.

default.zh: 近年来，应用于生物学的数学建模已成为在某些生物现象的理解和决策方面相当活跃和有前途的研究领域。这些现象包括例如特定人群中流行病的出现、细菌的增殖动态或简单的疾病（如阿尔茨海默氏症等）的演变等等。在本课程的框架内，我们将研究对生物现象的不同建模方法，包括：常微分方程方法和考虑空间的偏微分方程的研究方法。
default.en: Mathematical modeling applied to biology has become in recent years a fairly active and promising field of research in the understanding and decision support of certain biological phenomena. Among these phenomena we can cite for example the appearance of an epidemic in a given population, the proliferation dynamics of a bacterium or simply the evolution of a disease such as Alzheimer's etc. Within the framework of this course, we will be interested in the different approaches of modeling biological phenomena: a compartmental approach which often leads to ordinary differential equations and a non-compartmental approach which often leads to partial differential equations that takes into account space.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍两部分内容，第一部分介绍多元统计分析的理论基础，包括多元正态分布及其抽样分布、参数估计、假设检验、多元回归分析；第二部分介绍一些实用的多元统计分析方法的理论及其应用，包括判别分析、聚类分析、主成分分析、因子分析、典型相关分析及多元线性模型；通过对多变量统计问题的分析，了解各变量间的关系、建立合理的模型。同时应用SAS软件，通过实例介绍如何处理数据分析中的各种实际问题。
default.en: Two main sections are introduced in this course. First, the theoretical base of Multivariate Statistical Analysis is introduced, including Multivariate Normal Distribution and its Sampling Distribution, Estimation of Parameters, Hypothesis Testing, Multivariate Regression Analysis. Second, some theories and applications of Multivariate Statistical Analysis method are introduced, including Discriminant Analysis, Cluster Analysis, Principle Analysis, Factor Analysis, Canonical correlatinal analysis and Multivariate Linear Model. Based on the analysis of multivariate statistical problem, students will learn to establish reasonable models. How to deal with actual problem in data analysis is illustrated in detail with SAS software.

default.zh: 机械原理课程是高等院校中机械类专业一门主干课程。机械原理课程对培养学生的机械系统的分析、设计能力，解决复杂机械工程问题的能力方面具有重要地位。 机械原理程主要讲授以下内容：机构的组成原理；机械运动简图的绘制；机构运动分析的原理与方法；机构力分析的原理与方法；连杆机构的功能及设计原理、设计方法；凸轮机构的功能与设计方法；齿轮机构的传动原理与设计方法；齿轮传动系统的分析与设计；间歇机构的工作原理与设计方法；机械系统动力学分析方法；刚性转子静平衡、动平衡的原理与试验方法；机械系统运动方案设计方法。 通过机械原理课程的课堂教学、机械基础实验、大作业、课程设计及课外习题辅导等环节，培养学生利用机械设计基础理论和机械设计方法来解决复杂机械工程问题的能力、增强创新意识，培养学生的钻研精神、科学素养和社会责任感。
default.en: Machinery theory course is a main course in mechanical major in higher college. The course plays an important role in the cultivating of students' ability to analyze and design mechanical system, and the ability to solve complex mechanical engineering problems. The machinery theory A course mainly teaches the following contents: the composition principle of the mechanism; drawing the mechanical motion diagram; the principle and method of mechanism kinematic analysis; the principle and method of mechanism force analysis; the function, design principle and design method of linkage mechanism; the function and design method of cam mechanism; the drive principle and design method of gear mechanism; the analysis and design of the gear transmission system; the working principle and design method of intermittent mechanism; the dynamics analysis method of mechanical system; the static balance and dynamic balance principle and test method of rigid rotor; the kinetic scheme design of mechanical system. The machinery theory A course focuses on cultivating the students’ innovation sense and ability of using mechanical design theories and methods to solve complex mechanical enginnering problems through classroom teaching, experiments, curriculum design and other aspects.

default.zh: 机械原理实验教学是《机械原理》课程教学中重要的实践环节。包括机构运动简图测绘与分析实验、齿轮范成原理与齿轮参数测定实验、典型机械拆装与分析实验和刚性转子动平衡设计与实验。在实验教学中通过设立部分验证性实验，使学生进一步加深理解课堂教学的内容；通过设立一些综合性、设计性实验，培养学生的理论联系实际的能力、机械系统运动方案设计能力及机构设计的创新意识和能力；通过强调学生参与实验的全过程，培养学生的动手操作能力；通过设立较多的选修实验，满足学生的求知欲，促进学生的个性发展。
default.en: Theory of Machines and Mechanisms experiment course is an important practice part in this course. There are experiments as follows: Mechanical kinematic sketch of surveying and mapping and analysis experiment, Gear enveloping principle and Gear tooth parameter measurement experiment, Typical mechanical dismounting and analysis experiment, Rigid rotor dynamic balance design and experiment. In order to make students further understand what taught in classroom teaching, in the experiment teaching set up a part of the verification experiments. Some comprehensive designing experiments cultivate students' ability to integrate theory with practice and innovation consciousness and innovation ability of the mechanical structure design. Students' practical operation ability can be obtained through the whole process of the experiment. By setting up more experiments chosen, meet the students' thirst for knowledge, and promote students' personality development.

default.zh: 机械设计课程是高等工科院校中机械大类专业的主干课程，主要讲授在一般工作条件和常用参数范围内的通用机械零部件的工作原理、结构特点、基本设计理论和设计计算方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、实验和后续的机械设计课程设计等环节，着重培养学生利用机械设计基础理论和机械设计方法来解决复杂机械工程问题的能力，增强创新意识。课程主要内容包括： 机械零件设计概述；螺纹联接的类型、标准件、预紧和防松，单个螺栓联接的强度计算，螺栓组设计，螺旋传动；键联接、花键联接；带传动的应用基础，普通V带传动设计；齿轮传动类型、失效形式、材料、计算载荷，齿轮结构、润滑，圆柱直齿轮传动强度计算，圆柱斜齿轮强度计算，参数选择及许用应力；蜗杆传动类型，普通圆柱蜗杆传动设计；轴的结构设计、强度及刚度计算；滚动轴承的构造、代号及其类型选择，滚动轴承的寿命计算，轴系部件结构、润滑与密封；滑动轴承的结构和轴瓦材料，非液体摩擦轴承设计计算，液体动压滑动轴承的计算；联轴器、离合器及制动器的类型、应用及选择；弹簧材料及许用应力，圆柱螺旋弹簧设计；机械传动系统的功能、特点、分类与设计。
default.en: It is main one of courses of the major of mechanical engineering for institution of higher education, which mainly covers working principles ,characteristics of mechanical structures,basic theories and calculation methods of mechanical design under general working conditions and common parameters’ range of general mechanical elements.The course covers missions which is needed compulsorily including the parts of classroom instruction and teaching ,classical mechanical experiments and subsequent curriculum design of mechanical design,which aims to cultivate the abilities to solve complicated problems of mechanical engineering using basic theories and methods of mechanical design and improve the consciousness of innovation.the content of the course mainly includes are as follows: Summary of design of mechanical elements;types of threaded connection;standard components;pretightening force and locking;strength calculation of single bolted joints, design of group bolted joints;screw-drive;key connection and spline connection;basis of application of belt drive;design of general V-belt drive;gear drive which consists of failure modes, materials, calculation of specified load, structures,and lubrication;strength calculation and the methods to choose the parameters and permissible stress of cylindrical spur gear drive and cylindrical helical gear drive, types of worm gear;design of general cylindrical wormgearing;Structure design, strength calculation and rigidity calculation of the shaft; the configuration, code and selection of type of the rolling bearing,life calculation of the rolling bearing;structure,lubrication and sealing of the shaft components;structure and pad materials of sliding bearings,design and calculation of sliding bearings with non-liquid lubrication,calculation of sliding bearings with hydrodynamic lubrication; main types ,applications and selections of couplings ,clutches and brakes; materials and permissible stress of springs ; design of cylindrical helical compression and extension springs; functions, characteristics,types and design of the system of mechanical transmission.

default.zh: 机械设计实验教学是《机械设计》课程教学中重要的实践环节。包括机械组成及典型机械零部件认识与分析实验、带传动实验、轴系部件设计与分析实验、摩擦学基础实验、滑动轴承实验和机械系统运动方案及结构分析实验。在实验教学中通过设立部分验证性实验，使学生进一步加深理解课堂教学的内容。了解机械零件、部件的结构与其工作能力之间的关系；初步掌握机械传动方案及其结构、机械零件、部件机构设计的思路与基本方法。通过设立一些综合性、设计性实验，培养学生的理论联系实际的能力、机械结构设计能力及创新意识。
default.en: Theory of Machines and Mechanisms experiment course is an important practice part in this course. There are experiments as follows: Mechanical components and mechanical parts understanding and analysis of typical experiment，Belt transmission and Euler's formula experiment，Bearing parts design and analysis experiment，Sliding bearing experiment，Tribology experiment，Motion scheme of mechanical system and structure analysis experiment. In order to make students further understand what taught in classroom teaching, in the experiment teaching set up a part of the verification experiments. Understand the relationship between the structure and working ability of machine parts; Preliminary master the mechanical transmission scheme and basic methods and thoughts of mechanical parts, components and structure design. Some comprehensive designing experiments cultivate students' ability to integrate theory with practice and innovation consciousness and innovation ability of the mechanical structure design.

default.zh: 本门课程是为机械类专业和近机械类学生开设的一门技术基础课，主要研究用投影法绘制工程图样和解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，主要内容如下：机械制图的基本知识，介绍有关《机械制图》的国家标准及有关绘图的一些基础技能；投影的基础理论，点、直线和平面的投影，直线与平面的相对位置，平面与平面的相对位置，平面立体和曲面立体的投影，截交线和相贯线的画法，轴测图的画法；组合体的画法及组合体的尺寸标注，通过这部分内容的学习，使学生能够将各种空间几何形体，正确地用三视图表达出来；学习机件的表达方法，标准件和常用件,使学生了解有关机械图的有关知识,能够画出和读懂简单的工程图样。同时学习计算机CAD绘图知识。
default.en: This course is a technical basic course for mechanical and near-mechanical students. It mainly studies the theory and method of drawing engineering drawings and solving spatial geometric problems by projection method. The main contents are as follows: basic knowledge of mechanical drawing, introduction National Standards for Mechanical Drawing and some basic skills related to mapping; basic theory of projection, projection of points, lines and planes, relative position of lines and planes, relative position of planes and planes, projection of plane solids and curved surfaces, The drawing method of the intersecting line, the drawing method of the isometric drawing; the drawing of the combined body and the dimensioning of the combined body, through the study of this part, the students can use various spatial geometric shapes correctly. Learning of machine expression, standard parts and common parts of machine enable the students to understand the relevant knowledge about the mechanical drawings, and to draw and read simple engineering drawings. At the same time learn computer CAD drawing knowledge.

default.zh: 工程图样是人们用来表达和交流设计思想的重要工具，是工程技术部门一项重要技术文件，是工程界的共同“语言”，是工程技术人员必须掌握的知识，是从事技术工作的基础。机械工程制图是研究绘制和阅读工程图样的一门技术基础课，它既有系统的理论又有较强的实践性和技术性。本课程主要研究用投影理论绘制零件图和装配图的方法。为培养学生的绘图、读图和建立空间想象能力打下必要的基础，同时，又是学生学习后续课程和完成课程设计和毕业设计不可缺少的基础。
default.en: Engineering drawings are important tools used by people to express and exchange design ideas. They are an important technical document of the engineering and technical department. They are the common "language" of the engineering community, the knowledge that engineering and technical personnel must master, and the basis for engaging in technical work. Mechanical engineering drawing is a technical basic course for studying drawing and reading engineering drawings. It has both systematic theory and strong practicality and technicality. This course focuses on the method of drawing part and assembly drawings using projection theory. It lays the necessary foundation for cultivating students' drawing, reading and establishing spatial imagination. At the same time, it is also an indispensable foundation for students to learn follow-up courses and complete curriculum design and graduation design.

default.zh: 通过7次专家讲座和1次调研座谈交流，进一步了解机器人技术与系统国家重点实验室的科研成果和发展方向，开阔学生专业视野，增长专业见识，明确专业学习目标，为进一步探索和深入学习专业知识做好准备。
default.en: Through 7 expert lectures and 1 survey and discussion, further understand the scientific research achievements and development direction of the National Key Laboratory of Robotics Technology and system, broaden students' professional vision, increase professional insight, clarify professional learning objectives, and prepare for further exploration and in-depth study of professional knowledge.

default.zh: 通过8次高端人才讲座，了解机器人的总体发展现状，最新的科研成果和发展方向，使学生了解机器人方向要学习哪些内容，开阔学生专业视野，增长专业见识，明确专业学习目标，为进一步探索和深入学习专业知识做好准备。
default.en: Through 8 lectures for high-end talents, students will understand the overall development status of robots, the latest scientific research achievements and development direction, so that students can understand what content to learn in the direction of robots, broaden their professional vision, increase their professional insight, clarify their professional learning goals, and prepare for further exploration and in-depth learning of professional knowledge.

default.zh: 机械工程材料及成形技术基础课程是重要的机械类基础课程之一，是在“工程训练”的实践基础上，使学生获得常用工程材料及毛坯或零件的成形工艺知识，培养成形工艺分析的初步能力及创新意识，支撑专业学习要求中相应指标点的达成，并为学习其他有关课程及今后从事机械设计和制造工作奠定必要的基础。课程主要内容包括：金属材料学基础、非金属材料学基础、工程材料的力学性能、材料热处理、材料表面工程技术、材料选择、金属液态成形、金属塑性成形、连接成形、粉末冶金成形、高分子材料成形、陶瓷及复合材料成形。
default.en: Fundamentals of Mechanical Engineering Materials and Manufacturing Technology B is one of the important mechanical basic courses. It is based on the practice of engineering training, causes the student to obtain knowledge of common engineering materials and blank or parts forming technology, cultivates the preliminary analysis ability of the forming process and innovation consciousness, supports the achievement of corresponding indicator points in the professional learning requirements, and lays the necessary foundation for the study of other related courses and future mechanical design and manufacturing work. The contents include: basis of metal material science, basis of non-metallic materials, mechanical properties of engineering materials, material heat treatment, surface engineering technology, material selection, casting, welding, powder metallurgy shaping, polymer materials forming, ceramics and composite materials forming .

default.zh: “机械制造技术基础C”面向机械电子工程专业本科生开课，是机械工程类专业平台课中最重要的课程之一。通过本课程的学习，培养学生主动思考和深入探究的学习态度，扎实掌握未来从事机械专业所必备的基础知识，有效提升学生的综合工程素质，以及解决工程实际问题的能力，为后续课程的学习和今后可能从事的工作奠定坚实基础。 本课程根据专业的发展主要讲授必备的专业基础知识点，包括机械制造过程的基础知识、金属切削与磨削原理、机械加工质量的影响因素分析及其控制、机器的装配工艺等。本课程包括课堂授课、讨论、实验等环节，最终成绩采用累加式，包括2个实验和期末考试，总成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: The “Fundamentals of Machinery Manufacturing Technology C” is one of the most important courses of the mechanical engineering class platform for the undergraduate students majoring in mechatronic engineering. It can cultivate the students’ initiative thinking sense and the in-depth learning attitude, equip students with the professional knowledge necessary for the mechanical career they may pursue in the future, effectively improve the comprehensive engineering quality of students and their ability to solve the practical problems, and lay the foundation for the follow-up courses the students will learn as well as their potential future work. The “Fundamentals of Machinery Manufacturing Technology C” course addresses the necessary professional knowledge on the basis of the development of the manufacturing technology, involving the fundamentals of machining processes, the principle of metal-cutting and grinding technology, the analysis of factors influencing the machining quality and the control approaches, the assembly technology of machine, etc. This course includes classroom lectures and discussions, experiment, and so on. The final academic record will be accumulated by all the involved links, including two experiments and the final examination, and the total score in percent out of 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授控制理论的基本原理与基本知识及其在机械工程中的应用，以典型机电系统位置伺服系统为例，贯彻控制系统建模、分析及设计的始终，主要介绍机电系统的数学模型的建立方法、传递函数及结构图；典型一阶、二阶及高阶系统的时域分析；典型环节的频率特性极坐标图、对数坐标图及频率特性的性能指标分析；控制系统的稳定性判据及相对稳定性分析、稳态误差的计算；机电系统的校正方法和装置设计；计算机控制系统的组成、PID离散化方法及改进
default.en: The course is mainly taught the basic principles characteristics and basic knowledge of control theory and its application especially in mechanical engineering. The methods of modeling, analysis and design are introduced combined with a typical electromechanical control system, for example, an position servo system. The mathematical modeling method, transfer function and block diagram of electromechanical systems are provided. The time-domain analysis of a typical first-order, a second-order and a higher order systems are presented; the polar diagram, logarithmic plot and the analysis of performance indicators of frequency characteristics for a typical control system are presented; the control system stability criterion and the relative stability of the composition of the computer control system analysis, the calculation of the steady-state error are introduced; the correction method and device design of electromechanical systems are also provided. In addition, the PID discretization method and improvement are introduced.

default.zh: 本门课程是智能装备与系统专业的主干专业课之一。智能控制是自动控制发展的最高阶段，是人工智能、控制论、系统论、信息论、仿生学、神经生理学、进化计算和计算机等多种学科的高度集合的边缘交叉学科。本课程主要讲授模糊控制、神经网络控制和遗传算法控制等。通过本课程的学习，使学生熟悉智能控制的主要理论分支、数学基础、应用场合及发展趋势，进而掌握智能控制的基础理论及其在机器人系统中的应用方法。
default.en: This course is one of specialized courses of undergraduate students majored in the intelligent equipment and systems. The theory framework of the intelligent control was constituted by Artificial Intelligence, Cybernetics, System Theory, Information Theory, Bionics, Neurophysiology, Genetic Algorithm, Computer Science, and etc. Therefore, the intelligent control is an edge interdiscipline highly integrated by the multidisciplinary knowledge, and represents the highest stage of development of the automatic control. The Fuzzy-logic based control, Neural-network based control, genetic algorithm, and etc are introduced in this course. The aim of opening this course is to familiarize the students with the theoretical branch, mathematical foundations, applications, and trend of the intelligent control, and then to make students master the basic theory of the intelligent control and its associated usages in the robotic systems.

default.zh: 本门课程是机器人工程专业的专业核心课程之一，也是学生们学习后续其他专业课的基础。传感器是机器人系统的重要组成部分，机器人检测技术是机器人系统可靠、良好运行的重要技术基础。课程阐述各种典型传感器的工作原理、结构形式、一些工程设计方法和选用的基本知识，也对各种传感器检测技术进行叙述，以及学习各种传感器的应用。通过本门课程的学习，使学生了解机器人系统所应用的传感器基本原理及检测方法，使学生具备一定的机器人传感系统设计与分析能力。
default.en: This course is one of the core courses of robot engineering, which is a knowledge foundation of the latter specialty lessons. Sensor is a very important part of the robot system. Measurement technology is also an important technical basis for reliable and good operation of robot system. This course explains the working principle, structural form, some engineering design methods and the selection of the basic knowledge. Measurement techniques are also described, and the application of various sensors is studied. After learning this course, students can understand the basic principle and structural composition of the robot system. Students also have the basic ability to design a sensor system and measuring system in robot systems.

default.zh: 本课程为理论教学课程，学时数为16学时。对于实验室参观环节可以在师生见面会后进行，课堂理论教学环节介绍纳米加工方式及加工原理、详细阐述模拟计算、Lammps介绍、Lmmps在windows的安装、Lammp的案例介绍、Lammps的具体输入文件讲解、可视化软件OVITO实操、最后介绍分子动力学在化学、物理、生物材料等领域的应用。
default.en: This course is a theory teaching course with 16 credit hours. For the laboratory visit session can be carried out after the teacher-student meeting, the classroom theory teaching session introduces the nanofabrication methods and processing principles, elaborates the simulation calculations, introduces Lammps, the installation of Lmmps in windows, the introduction of the case of Lammps, the explanation of the specific input files of Lammps, the hands-on practice of the visualisation software OVITO, and finally introduces the application of molecular dynamics in the fields of chemistry, physics, biomaterials and so on. The last part of the course introduces the application of molecular dynamics in chemistry, physics, biomaterials and other fields.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授各种典型智能材料的基本特性、智能结构的设计与控制方法，结合智能结构的应用特点，阐述智能材料及智能结构系统在精密机械、微机电、航空航天、生物医学等工程领域的应用实例。本课程通过介绍智能材料（例如压电材料、挠曲电材料、形状记忆材料、电/磁/光致变材料、电/磁流变材料、聚电解质材料、热释电材料、磁光材料、超导体等）与智能结构的基本特性、设计原理、控制机制及发展方向，使学生建立智能结构系统的总体概念，帮助学生了解智能材料与智能结构在精密机械、微机电系统、航空航天、生物医学等领域中的应用和潜在发展方向，使学生能够综合应用所学知识，掌握利用智能结构控制技术从事相关研究的先进手段和方法。在本课程中，学生将学习最先进的智能结构和结构电子技术的设计和应用案例，利用智能材料、结构及其控制手段，以团队合作的形式进行独立研究和开发，通过课程设计等环节提升创新实践和团队协作的能力。
default.en: This course primarily focuses on the fundamental characteristics of various typical smart materials and the design and control methods of smart structures. Combining the application characteristics of smart structures, it elaborates on the application examples of smart materials and smart structure systems in engineering fields such as precision machinery, microelectronics, aerospace, and biomedical engineering. By introducing smart materials (such as piezoelectric materials, flexoelectric materials, shape memory materials, electro/magneto/photo-responsive materials, electro/magneto-rheological materials, polyelectrolyte materials, pyroelectric materials, magneto-optical materials, superconductors, etc.) and their basic characteristics, design principles, control mechanisms, and development trends, this course enables students to establish a comprehensive concept of smart structure systems. It helps students understand the application and potential development directions of smart materials and smart structures in fields such as precision machinery, microelectronics, aerospace, and biomedical engineering. Students will be able to integrate their knowledge and master advanced methods and techniques for utilizing smart structure control technology in related research. In this course, students will learn the design and application examples of cutting-edge smart structures and structural electronics technology. They will engage in independent research and development using smart materials, structures, and their control methods in a collaborative team format. Through course design and other activities, students will enhance their abilities in innovation and teamwork.

default.zh: 《导弹发射装备与技术》以典型国防装备为对象，面向机械大类本科生讲授导弹发射技术的发展现状、基本原理、系统构成、关键技术和开发过程等。结合我国导弹技术的发展历程，介绍几代航天人艰苦奋斗所取得的卓越成就；介绍机电领域的新理论、新技术和新设计方法在导弹系统上的发展应用；重点讲授机械结构、力学分析、液压、电控以及车辆技术等专业知识在导弹发射车的主要分系统设计中的应用；结合典型工程案例，讲授航天系统工程概念，以及航天产品总体设计的内容、程序、设计方法。
default.en: Missile Launch Equipment and Technology focuses on typical national defense equipment, teaching the development status, basic principles, system composition, key technologies, and development process of missile launch technology. Based on the development history of missile technology in China, introduce the outstanding achievements made by generations of astronauts through hard work and struggle; Introduce the development and application of new theories, technologies, and design methods in the field of electromechanical technology in missile systems; Emphasis will be placed on teaching the application of professional knowledge such as mechanical structure, mechanical analysis, hydraulic, electrical control, and vehicle technology in the design of the main subsystems of missile launch vehicles; Combining typical engineering cases, teach the concepts of aerospace system engineering, as well as the content, procedures, and design methods of overall design of aerospace products.

default.zh: 本课程将邀请航天工程部门高水平专家担任任课教师，讲课专家来自火箭、卫星、空间站、深空探测、通信与导航等各个领域，他们多年从事航天型号任务或分系统的研制工作，担任型号总师、总指挥、所级领导、专业科室主任等职务，具有丰富的工程经验和研发水平。讲座内容覆盖航天系统主要技术体系，在学科方向上包含了航天器设计、制造、控制、探测等，符合机电学院学生培养的目标与定位。内容包括航天器技术的系统组成、基本原理、发展现状、未来展望等内容，有利于学生将所学理论知识与工程实际相结合，明确学习目标，拓展学生的学术视野和知识面，激发学生对航天科技的兴趣，引导优秀学生投身航天事业，培养学生的爱国情怀和民族自信心，帮助学生做好生涯职业规划。 课程初步安排为16学时，由8次学术讲座构成，拟邀请航天一院专家讲授火箭总体与推进系统，五院总体部专家讲授卫星平台技术和可靠性技术，529厂专家讲授卫星制造技术，五院通信事业部专家讲授通信与导航技术，五院载人事业部专家讲授空间站技术，五院东方红卫星公司专家讲授深空探测技术，五院西安分院专家讲授大天线技术，八院805专家讲授空间机构技术，七院专家讲授导弹技术。每个讲座安排两位教师，一个为主讲教师，一个为备份教师，以保障在主讲教师因故不能出席时既定教学任务的正常进行。
default.en: This course will invite high-level experts from the aerospace engineering department as teachers, lecturers from rockets, satellites, space stations, deep space exploration, communication and navigation and other fields, they have been engaged in the development of aerospace missions or subsystems for many years, and have rich engineering experience and research and development level. The content of the lecture covers the main technical systems of the aerospace system, including spacecraft design, manufacturing, control, and detection in the discipline direction, which is in line with the goals and positioning of the students of the School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering. The content includes the system composition, basic principles, development status and future prospects of spacecraft technology, which is conducive to students to combine the theoretical knowledge they have learned with engineering practice, clarify the learning objectives, expand students' academic vision and knowledge, stimulate students' interest in aerospace science and technology, guide outstanding students to devote themselves to the aerospace industry, cultivate students' patriotic feelings and national self-confidence, and help students do a good job in career planning. The course is initially arranged for 16 class hours, consisting of 8 academic lectures, and it is planned to invite experts from the First Academy of Aerospace Science and Technology to teach on rocket general and propulsion system, experts from the General Department of the Fifth Academy to teach satellite platform technology and reliability technology, experts from the 529 Factory to teach satellite manufacturing technology, experts from the Communication Division of the Fifth Academy to teach communication and navigation technology, experts from the Manned Division of the Fifth Academy to teach space station technology, experts from Dongfanghong Satellite Company of the Fifth Academy to teach deep space exploration technology, and experts from the Xi'an Branch of the Fifth Academy to teach large antenna technology. 805 experts from the Eighth Academy of Sciences gave lectures on space agency technology, and experts from the Seventh Academy gave lectures on missile technology. Two teachers will be assigned for each lecture, one as the main teacher and one as the backup teacher, so as to ensure the normal progress of the established teaching tasks when the main teacher is unable to attend for some reason.

default.zh: 机器人交互技术课程面向机械电子工程专业机器人方向本科生开课，是一门重要的专业课。本课程是一门涉及人与计算机交互、人工智能、机器人、自然语言理解等的交叉学科，研究人与机器人之间通过输入输出设备进行有效交互的原理与方法。课程主要讲授常见的机器人交互设备和交互方法，通过机器人交互实例，重点使学生了解机器人交互的理论基础、研究热点及发展趋势，熟悉和掌握常见的机器人交互设计和实现方法，培养设计过程中运用人机交互知识的能力。 课程主要包括概论、感知和认知基础、常用的交互设备与交互技术、三维图形交互仿真、人机物理交互安全、手柄、手套、语音、手势、体感、表情等机器人交互应用技术。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末考试、平时测评和作业三部分。 课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时和实验等。
default.en: Human–robot interaction (HRI) is an important course to the students with major field of robot in Mechatronic Engineering. It is a multidisciplinary field with contributions from human–computer interaction, artificial intelligence, robotics, natural language understanding and etc. This course discusses the principle and implementation of interactions between humans and robots through input and output devices. In this course, several commonly used devices and methods for human-robot interaction are introduced. Through examples of robot interaction, after finish the lesson the students should know the theoretical foundation, research focus and tendency, be familiar to the development method of commonly used HRI, master the ability of using HRI knowledge in practical projects. The contents of this course includes the development history of HRI, perceptual and cognitive foundations of HRI, commonly used HRI devices, interaction techniques, robot graphical simulation, human robot physical interaction, HRI based on joystick, glove, speech, gesture, kinect, emotion and etc. The examination results are cumulative, including the final exam, the regular grade and homework. The final results of the course are cumulative, taking into account the examination results, regular and experimental scores.

default.zh: 《机器人学基础》课程是机械电子工程专业的一门基础课程，主要讲授机器人学相关的技术内容。从机器人的产生及发展入手，系统的介绍机器人的概念、特点、组成和分类，精要讲述机器人运动的数学描述与计算方法、机器人运动学、静力学、动力学的数学建模方法，机器人运动轨迹规划的基本理论和方法。结合上机环节，让学生将所学的数学建模方法在计算机软件中得以实现，在加深学生对数学建模方法理解的同时，了解机器人设计与分析中的计算机辅助建模方法。最终，让学生掌握对机器人建模与分析的相关理论体系及建模方法，奠定今后机器人研究的相关理论基础。
default.en: "Fundamentals of Robotics" is one of the foundation course for Mechanical Engineering, which is mainly concerned with robotics-related technical contents. Starting from the development of robots, this course will systematically introduce the kinematics, statics, dynamics, trajectory planning theory and methods for robot analysis and modeling. The students can also utilize the learned methods by computing software, which will deepen the students’ understanding of robot design and analysis by computer-aided modeling method. Finally, the students should master theoretical system for robot analysis and modeling, and establish the theoretical foundation for robot research in future.

default.zh: 本门课是智能装备与系统专业本科生的核心主干课程，是学生学习后续专业课如并联机器人技术、医疗机器人技术以及课程设计的基础，在培养学生机器人综合设计能力、分析、仿真和运用复杂机构能力以及工程实践能力等方面占有重要的地位。 机器人机构决定了机器人的作用机理，是机器人实现预期功能和性能的前提。本门课主要讲授机器人机构的三个大类，即串联机器人、并联机器人和移动机器人，所运用的理论工具是螺旋理论。通过本课程的课堂教学以及后续的虚拟样机仿真等环节，使学生熟悉机器人机构学的基本原理；掌握机器人机构的拓扑理论，并能够运用拓扑结构综合方法，优选设计方案，开发特定功能和性能的机器人机构；培养学生在机器人机构学方面原始创新和集成创新的能力，促进本课程相应目标点的达成。
default.en: This course is the core backbone course for undergraduates majoring in intelligent equipment and systems. It is the basis for students to learn follow-up professional courses such as parallel robot technology, medical robot technology and curriculum design. It plays an important role in training students' comprehensive design ability, analysis, simulation and application ability of complex mechanism and engineering practice ability. Robot mechanism determines the mechanism of the robot, and is the premise of the expected function and performance of the robot. This course mainly teaches three major categories of robotic mechanisms, namely series robots, parallel robots and mobile robots. The theoretical tools used in this course are screw theory. Through classroom teaching and follow-up virtual prototype simulation of this course, students will be familiar with the basic principles of robotic mechanism; master the topological theory of robotic mechanism, and be able to use the method of topological structure synthesis to optimize design schemes and develop robotic mechanisms with specific functions and performances; and train students' original and integrated innovative capabilities in robotic mechanism. Strength, promote the corresponding objectives of this course.

default.zh: 机器人运动控制技术是机械电子工程专业的主干专业课之一，机器人的应用越来越普及，它不仅广泛应用于工业生产和制造部门，在航天、海洋探测、危险及恶劣等特殊环境中也获得了大量的应用。所以运动控制技术在机器人应用中起着重要作用，是学生后续从事科学研究的基础知识，在培养学生机器人运动系统综合分析能力、设计能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要以机器人为研究对象，阐述机器人相关运动控制原理及应用技术。通过本门课程的学习, 使学生正确地理解和运用机器人运动控制基本原理及方法，具备机器人总体设计和运动控制设计能力。
default.en: Robot motion control technology is one of the main professional courses in mechanical and electrical engineering. The application of robots is becoming more and more popular. It is not only widely used in industrial production and manufacturing departments, but also has been widely used in special environments such as aerospace, marine detection, danger and harshness. Therefore, robot motion control technology plays an important role in robot application and is the basic knowledge of students' subsequent scientific research. It plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability and design ability of robotic motion system. This course mainly focuses on robots and describes the principles and application techniques of robot-related motion control. Through the study of this course, students can correctly understand and apply the basic principles and methods of robot motion control, and have the capabilities of overall design and motion control design.

default.zh: 本课程讲授嵌入式计算机系统的基本概念和原理，着重于嵌入式系统在机器人系统的应用。课程的第一部分将涵盖嵌入式计算机体系结构、嵌入式计算机指令系统以及嵌入式系统外设等内容。通过比较新兴的RISCV架构和成熟的ARM架构，本课程将着重介绍嵌入式系统的共性特征。本课程的第二部分是嵌入式操作系统和嵌入式软件开发相关内容。其中包括嵌入式Linux的系统管理、项目管理、软件开发及调试等内容。另外，本部分还将介绍在机器人控制器中广泛应用的实时操作系统和实时以太网等技术。
default.en: This course provides an introduction to embedded computer system with an emphasis on its application to robotics. The first part will cover embedded computer architecture, embedded computer instructions and essential peripherals of embedded system. By comparing two computer architectures, namely the new emerging RISCV architecture and the more mature ARM Cortex-M architecture, common features of embedded systems are provided. The second part of this course is about embedded operating system and embedded software development, which will focus on system administration, project management, programming & debugging on embedded Linux. Moreover real-time operating system and real-time Ethernet, which are essential for robotic controllers based on embedded systems, are introduced.

default.zh: 工业机器人设计与应用是智能装备与系统专业学生重要的专业核心课，是基于机械设计、机器人学基础及机器人机构学等基础课的机电系统专业综合课程，在培养学生工业机器人综合分析、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授工业机器人的基本概念、分类、结构特点、机械系统、控制技术、编程技术及应用维护技术。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验操作等环节，着重培养学生们工业机器人的综合分析与设计能力，以及机电系统科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Industrial robot design and application is an important core course for students majoring in intelligent equipment and system. It is a comprehensive course for mechanical and electrical systems based on basic courses such as mechanical design, robotics and robot mechanism, and plays an important role in training students' comprehensive analysis and design ability of industrial robots. This course mainly teaches the basic concept, classification, structural characteristics, mechanical system, control technology, programming technology and application maintenance technology of industrial robots. Through classroom teaching and subsequent experimental operation, this course focuses on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design ability of industrial robots, as well as their application ability of mechanical and electrical system scientific knowledge, increasing their awareness of innovation, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results. Industrial robot design and application is an important core course for students majoring in intelligent equipment and system. It is a comprehensive course for mechanical and electrical systems based on basic courses such as mechanical design, robotics and robot mechanism, and plays an important role in training students' comprehensive analysis and design ability of industrial robots. This course mainly teaches the basic concept, classification, structural characteristics, mechanical system, control technology, programming technology and application maintenance technology of industrial robots. Through classroom teaching and subsequent experimental operation, this course focuses on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design ability of industrial robots, as well as their application ability of mechanical and electrical system scientific knowledge, increasing their awareness of innovation, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results.

default.zh: 机械原理课程设计是服务于机械原理课程的一门主干课程，培养学生机械系统运动方案设计能力的重要环节。机械原理课程设计是进行机械系统运动方案设计的一次实践。通过机械原理课程设计培养学生综合应用各类机构的能力、各类机构的设计能力、复杂机械系统运动方案的设计能力以及解决复杂机械工程问题的能力。
default.en: The Curriculum Design of Machinery Theory is a main course serving the course of Machinery Theory, and it is an important link to train students' ability of motion scheme design of mechanical system. This course is also a practice of designing the motion scheme of mechanical system. Through the course design of mechanical principle, students are trained to apply all kinds of mechanisms synthetically, to design all kinds of mechanisms, to design motion schemes of complex mechanical systems, and to solve complex mechanical engineering problems.

default.zh: “机械设计课程设计B ”是与“机械设计”理论课相配套的重要实践环节，在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，进行机械工程技术人员所需的基本训练，在培养学生机械系统综合设计能力、提高解决复杂机械工程问题的能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程作为培养学生机械设计能力的重要实践环节，从整机出发，强调系统的思想，以减速器（或其他机器为例），进行机械系统方案的设计与选择，完成设计计算及结构设计。综合培养学生的计算、设计、绘图和查图表的能力，着重培养学生的正确的设计思想及综合运用知识的能力。
default.en: Course design of mechanical design (B) which is matching with the Mechanical Design theory course is the important internship and practical training. It is the integrated use of theory course content. In the teaching process, need the integrated use of prerequisite course related knowledge and skills to make fundamental training to meet the need of mechanical engineering and technical personnel. For students to further learn about professional courses and in the future work in the mechanical design, lay the foundation. Mechanical system in training students' comprehensive design ability, improve the ability to solve the problem of complex mechanical engineering occupies an important position. This course as an important practice cultivates students’ ability to mechanical design, starting from the whole, emphasizes the thought of system, to speed reducer (or other machines, for example), include the following content: the design of mechanical system scheme and selection, complete the design calculation and structure design. Cultivate students' calculation, design, drawing (2 d and 3 d figure, optional) and the ability to check the chart. Focus on cultivating the students’ correct design ideas, innovative thinking, cultivates the students' innovation ability and comprehensive ability to use knowledge.

default.zh: 该课程面向我校未来技术学院智能机器人特色班开设，课程内容涵盖机械设计与制造、机电一体化、工业机器人专业、计算机辅助设计与制造、电气自动化技术、数控技术、计算机控制技术、机电一体化技术、精密机械技术等相关专业内容，主动打破传统专业学科壁垒，推动专业学科交叉融合，促进理工结合、工工交叉，助力未来技术学院扎实推进新工科建设再深化、再拓展、再突破、再出发，推行多学科交叉融合的课程体系建设。 课程以工程训练实训课程优势资源为基础，通过课赛融合，以赛促学的方式促进学生多学科交叉融合的实践与创新能力提升。本课程在学习机械设计基础、公差与配合、机械制造基础、应用电子技术等课程的基础上，进一步培养学生综合运用机械设计、公差与配合、机械制造、机电一体化和应用电子技术等专业基础理论和综合应用的能力。通过使用Solid works、NX等三维数字化设计软件，掌握机器人的结构设计基本方法，并将其应用于实际项目当中。同时通过课程配套的机器人设备及工具实验室，供学生进行机器人的实体构建与调试实验，实操各类机械加工设备、电子调试设备以及编程与控制单元，并将学科竞赛和校级自主品牌竞赛、学生活动社团作为课程的“出口”，以此提升学生的知识理解和综合实践能力。
default.en: This course is designed for the intelligent robot specialty class of our school's Future Technology Institute. The course content covers related professional fields such as mechanical design and manufacturing, mechatronics, industrial robotics, computer-aided design and manufacturing, electrical automation technology, numerical control technology, computer control technology, mechatronics technology, precision machinery technology, etc. It actively breaks through the traditional barriers of professional disciplines, promotes the integration and intersection of professional disciplines, facilitates the combination of science and engineering, the intersection of various engineering fields, and helps the Future Technology Institute to solidly promote the deepening, expansion, breakthrough, and re-launch of the construction of new engineering disciplines, and implement a curriculum system that promotes multi-disciplinary integration. Based on the advantageous resources of engineering training and practical courses, this course promotes students' practical and innovative abilities in multi-disciplinary integration through the integration of competitions and learning. On the basis of learning basic mechanical design, tolerance and fit, basic manufacturing technology, applied electronics technology, etc., this course further cultivates students' ability to comprehensively apply professional basic theories such as mechanical design, tolerance and fit, manufacturing, mechatronics, and applied electronics technology. By using Solid works, NX and other three-dimensional digital design software, students can master the basic methods of structural design for robots and apply them to actual projects. At the same time, through the robot equipment and tool laboratory provided by the course, students can conduct physical construction and debugging experiments of robots, operate various types of mechanical processing equipment, electronic debugging equipment, programming and control units, and take subject competitions and school-level independent brand competitions, student activities and associations as the "exit" of the course. In this way, it enhances students' knowledge understanding and comprehensive practical ability.

default.zh: 机械产品创新设计及仿真的内容为完成一项学院统一命题下的研发与制作项目，依托全国“欧特克杯大学生机械产品数字化设计大赛”为平台，学生利用一个学年的业余时间完成创新设计及仿真内容。具体分为立项培训、方案设计、方案评审、中期检查、结题检查五个阶段。学生每3人组合成小组，在教师的启发和指导下，各小组根据感兴趣的及收集的相关资料确定研究对象，提出较为完整的机构设计方案和创新点，并自主地进行相关内容科技文献检索、方案设计、虚拟仿真、制作动画、撰写设计说明书并进行答辩。学生以项目组的形式自主开展的为期一年的研发与制作项目，在学院的统一命题下完成一项任务，使其体验项目学习与管理过程，激发学生对科学研究的兴趣，提高大学生的创新能力，提高学生自主学习、问题求解、团队协作、项目管理、综合创新等方面的能力和素质。
default.en: The content of Innovative design and simulation of mechanical products is the completion of a project's development and production under the college unified proposition, relying on the national "Autodesk Cup Undergraduate Mechanical Products Digital Design Competition" as a platform, students will use their spare time for one academic year to complete innovative design and simulation content. Specifically divided into project training, program design, program evaluation, mid-term examination, concluding, totally five stages of inspection. Each of three students grouped into a group, each group has an instructor to give inspiration and guidance, the team collected relevant information and identify subjects based on interest, made more complete institutional design and innovation, and autonomous scientific literature search for related content, design, virtual simulation, animation, writing and design specifications for reply. Students to carry out a one-year independent research and development and production projects in the form of project team, to complete a task under the college’s unified proposition, make the experience project learning and management processes, stimulate students' interest in science, improve students’ ability to innovate, improve student learning, problem solving, teamwork, project management, and other aspects of integrated innovation capacity and quality.

default.zh: 创新设计的内容为仿生机械，学生利用一个学期的业余时间完成创新设计内容。具体分为创新设计动员、方案设计、方案评审、中期检查、答辩和评定成绩五个阶段。在教师的启发和指导下，学生以组为单位根据兴趣以及收集的相关资料确定一种或几种仿生机械作为研究对象，提出较为完整的机构实现方案和控制方案，并自主地进行相关内容科技文献检索、方案设计、虚拟仿真、绘制加工图纸、撰写设计说明书并进行答辩。对方案设计合理、结构设计正确的优秀作品，按所绘制加工图纸进行制造、装配、调试，达到设计性能要求，并在第五学期评奖。通过机构综合实现生物的动作行为，通过控制达到动作的协调运动。培养学生对机械系统及控制系统综合设计能力和创新能力，增强学生科研开发和工程实践能力，培养学生的团队协作精神。
default.en: The content of the innovative design is bionic; the students take advantage of the spare time of a semester to complete the innovative design. Specific divided into five stages of the mobilization of innovative design, program design, program evaluation, mid-term examination, the respondent and assessment scores. Under the inspiration and guidance of teachers, student group as a unit identify one or several bionic as an object of study based on the interest and the collection of information, put forward a more complete organization and control programs, and independent retrieval related scientific literature, program design, virtual simulation, drawing machining drawing, writing design specifications and the respondent. For the program design is reasonable, correct structure design outstanding works, manufacturing, assembly, commissioning in accordance with the machining drawing drawn, to achieve the design performance requirements, and in the fifth semester awards. Achieve biological action behavior by institutions, and to achieve co-ordination action by controlling. Train Students’ mechanical system and control system design and innovative ability, Enhance students' research and development and engineering practice, and students’ teamwork Spirit.

default.zh: 本课程采用课赛融合的新教学模式，课程以设计并制作机器人为主，竞赛为辅，机器人设计包括机器人机械结构设计及制作、电路板设计及制作、arduino程序编写（图形化编程、代码编程），通过团队协作完成机器人联合调试，最终进行竞技比赛。 本课程特点：1、理论实践相结合，通过学习机器人相关理论知识，运用到机器人实践课程中。2、内容从入门到精通，适用于初学者。3、本课程的实践课程，注重赛课融合的教学模式，以竞赛作为出口，学习机器人相关内容，最终，利用竞技机器人并完成竞赛。4、以学生为中心，通过任务及竞赛作为驱动，充分调动学生的能动性及创造性。
default.en: This course adopts a new teaching mode integrating competition with class. The course focuses on robot design and production, supplemented by competition. Robot design includes robot mechanical structure design and production, circuit board design and production, arduino programming (graphic programming, code programming). Through team cooperation to complete the robot joint debugging, and finally competitive competition. Features of this course: 1. Combining theory and practice, we can learn the theoretical knowledge related to robots and apply it to the practical course of robots. 2, content from entry to mastery, suitable for beginners. 3. The practical course of this course focuses on the teaching mode of integration of competition and lessons, takes competition as the export to learn related contents of robots, and finally uses competitive robots to complete the competition. 4. Student-centered, driven by tasks and competitions, fully mobilize students' initiative and creativity.

default.zh: 随着高性能半导体器件需求的日益旺盛，新型半导体材料制备工艺已进入高速发展阶段。本课程以离子束为核心手段，从对半导体材料的掺杂、缺陷改性与半导体材料加工三个方面入手，详细介绍离子束对现代半导体材料与器件领域的贡献。通过本课程的学习，使得学生了解离子束与半导体材料作用的机理，半导体材料同质异质掺杂的物理现象，离子束加工的应用背景。为学生从事半导体材料与离子束相关研究工作积累知识。
default.en: Due to intensive demand of high performance of semiconductor device, novel process of semiconductor has been developing quickly. Based on the ion beams, our lessons will focus on the doping, defect engineering as well as etching in semiconductors, detailly describing the contribution of ion beams to semiconductor and related device. Through the study of this lessons, students will learn deeply the mechanism of interaction between ion beams and matrix atoms, physical phenomenon of hyper-doping in semiconductors as well as background of ion beam etching, accumulating more acknowledge for application of ion beams in semiconductors.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生理论与实践结合开展技术创新的能力，首先使学生了解最广泛使用的工程材料；然后了解不同部件的金属加工技术；掌握典型卫星主要结构及其金属构件加工要求；面向工业4.0的要求，学习和了解用于金属零部件设计和工艺优化的工具，包括CAD和CAE软件；使学生能够了解采用软件开展卫星主体结构的设计和制造工艺设计的基本方法。 本课程由帝国理工学院王礼良教授授课。王礼良教授的团队在金属成形领域做出世界一流的研究成果，在金属结构数字化制造和数据科学、云计算、高效成形技术等方面取得重要成果，曾获得英国帝国理工学院杰出团队金奖。通过本课程，将帮助学生感受国外教学模式、接触专业前沿、激发科技创新潜能。 王礼良教授领导帝国理工学院金属成形与建模团队，在建模和开发先进金属成形工艺方面享有世界一流的声誉，被认为是世界领先的金属成形组之一，2022年获得帝国理工学院颁发的杰出团队长金奖。王教授的主要研究领域包括先进金属成形技术和制造系统的研发，在材料表征、工程材料界面热力及化学行为建模方面做出了重要贡献。对以下领域产生了直接影响： (1)金属成形领域的数字化制造和数据科学； (2)高强度钢、铝合金、钛合金快速热冲压技术，在国际期刊、学会等多次获奖； (3)金属成形工艺设计与优化的云有限元分析技术；(4)金属成形中的摩擦学；(5)热/冷传热系数的高级材料表征。
default.en: In the course, most widely used engineering materials will be introduced. Then, metal forming technologies (MFT) for different components are discussed. To obtain deeper understanding on MFT, the satellite main structures are introduced and regarded as forming objects. As main tools in industry 4.0, the tools for components design and process optimization are introduced and trained, including CAD and CAE softwares. Projects about design & manufacture a satellite’s main structure will be completed by the students through using the softwares. This course is taught by Professor Liang Wang from Imperial College London. Professor Wang's team has achieved world-class research in metal forming, particularly in digital manufacturing of metal structures, data science, cloud computing, and efficient forming technologies. They have been awarded the Gold Medal for Outstanding Team at Imperial College London. Through this course, students will gain insights into foreign teaching models, engage with cutting-edge professional knowledge, and be inspired to innovate technologically. Metal Forming and Modelling group (MFG) at Imperial College London, led by Prof. Wang, has world-class reputation on modelling and developing advanced metal forming processes, regarded as one of the world's top leading metal forming groups, as witnessed by the Imperial 2022 President’s Gold Medal for Outstanding Research Team. Prof. Wang’s major research interests include the design and development of advanced metal forming technologies and manufacturing system. His work has made fundamental contributions to the characterization and modelling of materials and interfacial thermo-mechanical and mechanochemical behaviours of engineering materials. Particularly, Prof. Wang’s research has direct impacts on： (1) Digital manufacturing and Data Sciences in metal forming; (2) Innovative warm/hot stamping technologies (FAST) for high strength steels, aluminium and titanium alloys. The innovative FAST technology led to awards by international journals and society. (3) Cloud-FEA technologies for metal forming process design and optimization. (4) Tribology in metal forming. (5) Advanced material characterization of heat transfer coefficients for hot/warm stamping.

default.zh: “思想道德修养与法律基础”课，是高等学校思想政治理论课课程体系的重要组成部分，是帮助大学生提高思想道德素质和法律素质的重要课程。本课程以马克思主义为指导，以正确的世界观、人生观、价值观和道德观、法制观教育为主要内容，把社会主义核心价值观贯穿于教学的全过程，通过理论学习和实践体验，帮助大学生形成崇高的理想信念，弘扬伟大的爱国主义精神，确立正确的人生观和价值观，加强思想道德修养，增强学法守法用法的自觉性，全面提高思想道德素质和法律素质。 课程主要任务是培养学生： 1、形成科学的人生观、价值观、道德观和中国特色社会主义的理想信念。 2、具有一定的法律意识和法治精神，提高学生的法律素质。
default.en: The course of Ideological and Moral Cultivation and Legal Basis is an important part of the curriculum system of ideological and political theory courses in colleges and universities. It is an important course to help college students improve their ideological and moral quality and legal quality. This course is guided by the Marxism, and it contains the main contents of the correct world outlook, outlook on life, values, morality and legal education. The socialist core values is throughout the whole process of teaching. Through the theoretical study and practical experience, it helps students establish lofty ideals and beliefs, carry forward the great spirit of patriotism, establish a correct outlook on life and values, strengthen the ideological and moral cultivation, enhance the consciousness of studying, obeying and using the law, and comprehensively improve the ideological moral quality and legal quality. The main task of the course is to train students: 1, to form a scientific outlook on life, values, morality and ideals and beliefs of socialism with Chinese characteristics. 2, with a certain sense of law and the spirit of the rule of law, to improve the legal quality of students.

default.zh: “中国近现代史纲要” 是全国高等学校本科生必修的思想政治理论课之一，本课程主要讲授近现代中国社会发展和革命、建设、改革的历史进程及其内在的规律性，使同学们深刻领会历史和人民是怎样选择了马克思主义、选择了中国共产党、选择了社会主义道路，选择了改革开放。 课程主要包括导言、资本-帝国主义的侵略与近代中国的演变、早期对国家出路的探索、辛亥革命、中国共产党的成立、中国革命新道路的探索、抗日战争、人民共和国——中国人民的历史选择、改革开放前后两个30年等专题。 本课程考试采用累加式，包括期末和平时两个部分。
default.en: The Compendium of Chinese Modern and Contemporary History is one of the most ideological and political theory courses to all the undergraduates. In this course, social development in modern china and the historical process of Chinese revolution, construction, reform and their regularity are introduced. By learning this course, students should understand deeply how to choose Marxism, the CPC, socialism road as well as reform and opening up for the history and people. The course mainly includes the introduction, capital-imperialist aggression and evolution of modern china, the early exploration of the country’s way out, Xinhai revolution, the establishment of the CPC, the exploration of new road of Chinese revolution, the anti-Japanese war, the people’s republic of china- the people’s history choice and the two 30 year’s subjects before and after and reform and opening up. This course takes a cumulative examination form, including the usual performance part and the final examination part.

default.zh: 《毛泽东思想和中国特色社会主义理论体系概论》课程是所有本科学生必修的一门思想政治理论课。该课程以马克思主义中国化为主线，集中阐述马克思主义中国化理论成果的主要内容、精神实质、历史地位和指导意义，充分反映中国共产党不断推进马克思主义基本原理与中国具体实际相结合的历史进程和基本经验；以马克思主义中国化最新成果为重点，系统阐释习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的主要内容和历史地位，充分反映建设社会主义现代化强国的战略部署。
default.en: Introduction to Mao Zedong Thought and theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics is a required ideological and political theory course for all undergraduate students. This course focuses on the main content, spiritual essence, historical status and guiding significance of the theoretical achievements of Marxism in China, fully reflects the historical process and basic experience of the Communist Party of China to continuously promote the combination of the basic principles of Marxism and China's specific reality, and systematically expounds the latest achievements of Marxism in China The main contents and historical status of Xi Jinping's socialist ideology with Chinese characteristics in the new era will fully reflect the strategic plan for building a modern socialist China. The course mainly consists of three parts: "Mao Zedong thought", "Deng Xiaoping theory," Three Represents "," Scientific Outlook on Development ", and Xi Jinping's socialist ideology with China characteristics. The test of this course is cumulative, including two parts: normal and final.

default.zh: “形势与政策”课是理论武装时效性、释疑解惑针对性、教育引导综合性都很强的一门高校思想政治理论课，是帮助大学生正确认识新时代国内外形势，深刻领会党的十八大以来党和国家事业取得的历史性成就、发生的历史性变革、面临的历史性机遇和挑战的核心课程，是第一时间推动党的理论创新成果进教材进课堂进学生头脑，引导大学生准确理解党的基本理论、基本路线、基本方略的重要渠道。 教学内容依据教育部每学期印发的《高校“形势与政策”课教学要点》安排教学，紧密围绕学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，把坚定“四个自信”贯穿教学全过程，重点讲授党的理论创新最新成果，重点讲授新时代坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的生动实践，引导学生正确认识世界和中国发展大势，正确认识中国特色和国际比较，正确认识时代责任和历史使命，正确认识远大抱负和脚踏实地。主要开设：《战役中的家国情怀与中国制度优势》——让学生对百年不遇的新冠疫情及中国军团的阻击战、人民战、总体战有一个感性的认知，通过深层分析中国抗疫高分答卷背后的制度优势，让学生能对中国国家制度有一个更加直观和客观的领悟，并在此基础上增强“四个自信”，强化“四个意识”；《十八大后的中国反腐实践》——让学生了解十八大后以习近平为总书记的党中央审时度势提出了关于全面从严治党及反腐倡廉的一系列新要求、反腐败工作取得的最新成果及其特点；《百年中俄》——让学生了解中俄关系的历史渊源、发展脉络、面临的考验等，培养学生科学、客观、理性、历史的解读大国关系的战略思维；《弘扬龙江精神 助力振兴发展》——让学生了解黑龙江的人文、地理、历史概况及其在历史演进中生成的四大优秀精神。充分了解四大精神的起源、生成、内涵、发展及在新时代贡献与价值。 此外，根据形势发展要求和学生特点有针对性地设置教学内容，及时回应学生关注的热点问题。
default.en: Situation and Policy is a theory-based course centered up on ideology and politics taught at higher education institutes; it features high-level of theoretical timeliness, high accuracy and effectiveness in terms of doubt clearance, and high comprehensiveness in educational guidance. It is a core course that helps college students correctly understand domestic and overseas situations in the new era, equipping them with deep knowledge on the historical achievements, the historical changes, as well as the historical opportunities and challenges encountered during the pursuit of the Party’s and national causes since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. It is also an important approach to impart the Party’s latest theoretical innovation achievements to students and to guide college students to accurately comprehend the Party’s basic philosophy, basic development path, and basic strategy. The teaching content is arranged in accordance with the Main Points for the Teaching of Situation and Policy at Higher Education Institutes issued by the Ministry of Education each semester, closely revolving the learning and implementation of Xi Jinping’s thoughts on socialism with Chinese characteristics for the new era and in the principle of the “four traits of self-confidence”. The instructions are focused on the latest theoretical innovation achievements of the Party and the dynamic practices of carrying forward and developing socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era, aiming to guide students towards the correct perception on the development situation of China and the world, Chinese characteristics and international comparison, the responsibility of the times and the historical mission, as well as the far-reaching aspirations and the implications of making earnest efforts. It is mainly set up: "the feelings of home and country in the campaign and the advantages of China's system" -- let students have a perceptual understanding of the new crown epidemic and the resistance war, the people's war and the overall war of China's legion. Through in-depth analysis of the system advantages behind China's high score anti epidemic response, let students have a more intuitive and objective understanding of China's national system, and on this basis Strengthen the "four confidence", strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses", and "the eighteen anti-corruption practice in China" - let students understand that the Party Central Committee, headed by Xi Jinping as the general secretary, has made a series of new demands on the overall administration of the party and combating corruption and building a clean government after the eighteen big party, and the latest achievements and characteristics of anti-corruption work. To cultivate students' strategic thinking of scientific, objective, rational and historical interpretation of the relationship between major countries; to promote the spirit of Longjiang to promote the revitalization of development -- to let students understand the humanities, geography, history of Heilongjiang and the four outstanding spirits generated in the historical evolution. Fully understand the origin, generation, connotation, development, contribution and value of the four spirits in the new era. Furthermore, other targeted teaching contents are also arranged according to situational development requirements and student characteristics to timely analyze the popular issues that caught the most attention of the students.

default.zh: 为深入推进习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想进教材进课堂进头脑，根据中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发的《关于深化新时代学校思想政治理论课改革创新的若干意见》和中共黑龙江省委宣传部、中共黑龙江省委教育工委、黑龙江省教育厅相关文件精神，我校在大一阶段为本科生开设“习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想概论”课。本课程对习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想作了较为全面深入的阐述，对新时代坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的奋斗目标、总体布局、战略布局、政治保障、领导力量、能力建设，以及新时代中国特色社会主义大国外交做出全面系统的阐述。有助于引导新时代青年更好地理解把握这一思想的基本精神、基本内容、基本要求，增强“四个意识”、坚定“四个自信”、做到“两个维护”，在思想上政治上行动上同以习近平同志为核心的党中央保持高度一致，在知行合一、学以致用上下功夫，做担当民族复兴大任的时代新人和新时代的奋斗者，为决胜全面建成小康社会、夺取新时代中国特色社会主义伟大胜利、实现中华民族伟大复兴的中国梦贡献力量。
default.en: In order to further advance Xi Jinping's new socialist ideology into the classroom, we should follow the spirit of the document issued by the general office of the CPC Central Committee and the general office of the State Council on deepening the reform and innovation of China's ideological and political theory course in the new era, and the relevant documents of the Propaganda Department of the Heilongjiang provincial Party committee, the Heilongjiang provincial Party committee's Education Commission and the Heilongjiang provincial education department. In the freshman year, the school offers the undergraduate course a "Introduction to Xi Jinping's new era China characteristic socialism thought". This course has made a more comprehensive and in-depth exposition of Xi Jinping's socialist ideology with Chinese characteristics in the new era. He has made a comprehensive and systematic exposition of the goals, overall layout, strategic layout, political guarantee, leadership strength, ability building and China's socialist diplomacy with Chinese characteristics in China in China's new era. It helps to guide young people in the new era to better understand and grasp the basic spirit, basic content and basic requirements of the thought, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses", strengthen "four self-confidence" and achieve "two maintenances". They are highly consistent with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at the core in ideological and political actions, and work hard in the unity of knowing and doing, learning for the purpose of application and acting as national complex. The new people of the times and the strivers of the new era contribute to the decisive victory of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects, winning the great victory of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era, and realizing the Chinese dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.
