default.zh: “形势与政策”是1987年国家教委在大学生思想政治教育中设置的一门必修课，至今已有近三十年的历史。实践证明，形势与政策教育是高等学校学生思想政治教育的重要内容。“形势与政策”课是高校思想政治理论课的重要组成部分，是对学生进行形势与政策教育的主渠道、主阵地，是每个大学生的必修课程，在大学生思想政治教育中担负着重要使命，具有不可替代的重要作用。 “形势与政策”课程目标设立的基本依据来自三个方面，即“意识形态教育”、“素质教育”与“通识教育”的要求——“形势与政策”课着重进行党的基本理论、基本路线、基本纲领和基本经验教育；进行我国改革开放和社会主义现代化建设的形势、任务和发展成就教育；进行党和国家重大方针政策、重大活动和重大改革措施教育；进行当前国际形势与国际关系的状况、发展趋势和我国的对外政策，世界重大事件及我国政府的原则立场教育.
default.en: "Situation and Policy" is a compulsory course established by the National Education Commission in 1987 for ideological and political education of college students, with a history of nearly 30 years. Practice has proven that situation and policy education is an important part of ideological and political education for students in higher education institutions. The course "Situation and Policy" is an important component of ideological and political theory courses in universities. It is the main channel and battlefield for educating students on the situation and policy, and is a compulsory course for every college student. It bears an important mission and plays an irreplaceable role in ideological and political education for college students. The basic basis for setting the goals of the "Situation and Policy" course comes from three aspects, namely the requirements of "ideological education", "quality education", and "general education" - the "Situation and Policy" course focuses on educating the Party's basic theory, basic line, basic program, and basic experience; Education on the situation, tasks, and development achievements of China's reform, opening up, and socialist modernization construction; Provide education on major policies, activities, and reform measures of the Party and the state; Conduct education on the current international situation and international relations, development trends, China's foreign policy, major world events, and the principles and stance of the Chinese government

default.zh: “形势与政策”课是理论武装时效性、释疑解惑针对性、教育引导综合性都很强的一门高校思想政治理论课，是帮助大学生正确认识新时代国内外形势，深刻领会党的十八大以来党和国家事业取得的历史性成就、发生的历史性变革、面临的历史性机遇和挑战的核心课程，是第一时间推动党的理论创新成果进教材进课堂进学生头脑，引导大学生准确理解党的基本理论、基本路线、基本方略的重要渠道。 教学内容依据教育部每学期印发的《高校“形势与政策”课教学要点》安排教学，紧密围绕学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，把坚定“四个自信”贯穿教学全过程，重点讲授党的理论创新最新成果，重点讲授新时代坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的生动实践，引导学生正确认识世界和中国发展大势，正确认识中国特色和国际比较，正确认识时代责任和历史使命，正确认识远大抱负和脚踏实地。主要开设全面从严治党形势与政策的专题，重点讲授党的政治建设、思想建设、组织建设、作风建设、纪律建设以及贯穿其中的制度建设的新举措新成效；主要开设我国经济社会发展形势与政策的专题，重点讲授党中央关于经济建设、政治建设、文化建设、社会建设、生态文明建设的新决策新部署；主要开设港澳台工作形势与政策的专题，重点讲授坚持“一国两制”、推进祖国统一的新进展新局面；主要开设国际形势与政策专题，重点讲授中国坚持和平发展道路、推动构建人类命运共同体的新理念新贡献。此外，根据形势发展要求和学生特点有针对性地设置教学内容，及时回应学生关注的热点问题。
default.en: Situation and Policy is a theory-based course centered up on ideology and politics taught at higher education institutes; it features high-level of theoretical timeliness, high accuracy and effectiveness in terms of doubt clearance, and high comprehensiveness in educational guidance. It is a core course that helps college students correctly understand domestic and overseas situations in the new era, equipping them with deep knowledge on the historical achievements, the historical changes, as well as the historical opportunities and challenges encountered during the pursuit of the Party’s and national causes since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. It is also an important approach to impart the Party’s latest theoretical innovation achievements to students and to guide college students to accurately comprehend the Party’s basic philosophy, basic development path, and basic strategy. The teaching content is arranged in accordance with the Main Points for the Teaching of Situation and Policy at Higher Education Institutes issued by the Ministry of Education each semester, closely revolving the learning and implementation of Xi Jinping’s thoughts on socialism with Chinese characteristics for the new era and in the principle of the “four traits of self-confidence”. The instructions are focused on the latest theoretical innovation achievements of the Party and the dynamic practices of carrying forward and developing socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era, aiming to guide students towards the correct perception on the development situation of China and the world, Chinese characteristics and international comparison, the responsibility of the times and the historical mission, as well as the far-reaching aspirations and the implications of making earnest efforts. Special lectures on the situation and policy of comprehensively strengthening the Party’s discipline are given to explain the Party's political construction, ideological construction, organizational construction, style construction, and disciplinary construction, as well as elaborate the new measures and results of institutional construction running through the above processes.Special lectures on China's economic and social development situation and policy are given to impart the new decisions and new arrangements of the CPC Central Committee on economic construction, political construction, cultural construction, social construction, and ecological civilization construction. Special lectures on the situation and policy of Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan affairs are set up to update the new progress and situations on the compliance to the “one country and two systems” treaty and the advancement of national reunification. Special lectures on international situation and policy are given to elaborate the new concepts and contributions of China in following the path of peaceful development as well as promoting the building of a “community of shared future for mankind”. Furthermore, other targeted teaching contents are also arranged according to situational development requirements and student characteristics to timely analyze the popular issues that caught the most attention of the students.

default.zh: 《马克思主义基本原理》是高校思想政治理论课程体系的主干课程，其内容包括：马克思主义哲学、政治经济学和科学社会主义三个组成部分。通过本课程的学习，要使学生完整地把握马克思主义基本理论，使学生认识到马克思主义是科学的世界观和方法论，是我们从事社会主义革命和社会主义建设指导思想和理论基础。要求学生要掌握和了解马克思主义哲学、马克思主义政治经济学以及科学社会主义的基本理论，在实践中学会运用马克思主义的基本原理认识和分析各种社会实际问题，正确认识人类社会的本质、社会发展动力和社会发展基本规律，正确认识资本主义和社会主义在其发展过程中出现的各种新情况、新问题，认识社会主义代替资本主义的历史必然性，从而坚定对社会主义和共产主义的信念。
default.en: "An Introduction to the basic principles of Marxism" is a main course in the ideological and political theory curriculum designed for college students, which includes: Marxist philosophy, political economy and scientific socialism. The course has the following targets: Firstly, to give students a complete grasp of basic Marxist theory, enable students to understand that Marxism is a scientific world outlook and methodology, which is a guiding ideology and theoretical basis of our socialist revolution and socialist construction. Secondly, to require students to master and understand the basic theory of Marxist philosophy, Marxist political economy and scientific socialism, learn to understand and analyze the actual social problems by using the basic principles of Marxism in practice.

default.zh: （一）体育课程目的 为实现体育课程目的，课程设置首先是以身体练习为基本手段，通过合理的体育教学方式、多元化的体育锻炼途径以及科学的自我监督过程，切实增强学生体质和身心健康水平；其次，通过激发学生参与体育活动的兴趣，增强体育意识、提高体育能力，培养学生终身参与体育锻炼的意识和习惯；更重要的是本课程可为培养更多具有“健康第一”意识，在德、智、体、美、劳等方面全面发展的合格人才服务。 （二）体育课程任务 1．全面发展体能，提高运动能力，并结合自己的兴趣爱好和身体实际制定个人锻炼计划；掌握常见运动伤病的预防和处置方法；掌握体育基本理论知识，具有一定的体育文化素养和体育欣赏能力。 2．向学生传授体育技能和科学锻炼身体的理论与方法，培养学生积极参与各种形式的体育健身活动，并掌握几种有效的运动技能和锻炼方法，提高体育方面的素养，培养独立从事体育活动的能力，养成良好健康的体育锻炼习惯，终身受益。 3．通过体育课程学习，使学生能够提高对身体和健康的认识，学会利用体育活动调节身心，改善心理状态，养成积极乐观的生活态度。 4．加强学生的素质教育，使学生正确认识和处理德、智、体的辩证关系，树立正确的体育道德观，提高自觉性，培养勇于拼搏、团结进取、战胜自我的坚强意志品质。 （三）体育课程的设置 哈尔滨工业大学的体育教学，强调课程结构中的多学科知识内容相融合，充分利用课程体系内部的相互联系，有效提高体育课程的整体功能，结合北方地域及学校实际，最大限度满足不同层次，不同水平的学生兴趣爱好的要求，开设了多种形式的体育课程。具体课程内容包括： 1、体育训练课 校代表队（高水平组及阳光组）：田径、篮球、乒乓球、游泳、速滑、冰壶、羽毛球、足球、排球、武术、健美操等。 2、体育专项课 足球、篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、网球、武术、跆拳道、户外、游泳、自行车、冰壶、陆地冰球等。 3、体育选项课 篮球、篮球裁判、排球（气排球、软排球）、足球（雪地足球）、乒乓球、羽毛球、网球、武术、散打、搏击健身、健美、健美操、芭蕾形体、体育舞蹈、瑜伽、游泳、速度轮滑、自行车、户外运动、陆地冰球、冰壶、冬季户外徒步、滑冰、高山滑雪、雪地球、雪合战等。 4、体育基础课 基础田径、徒步、自行车、游泳、运动减脂等。 5、体育健身课 太极拳、导引养生、八段锦、徒步等。
default.en: (1) Purposes of PE Curriculum There are three main purposes of PE Curriculum. First, based on physical exercises, the curriculum aims at enhancing students’ physical and mental health through effective teaching methods, diversified ways of doing exercises and scientific self-monitoring process. Second, the curriculum helps to form the lifelong habit of participating in physical exercises through inspiring students’ sports interest and enhancing their sports awareness and sports skills. The most important is that the curriculum is helpful to serve the all-round development of moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic and labor qualified talents through training more students with the “health first” consciousness (2) PE Curriculum Tasks 1. To improve students’ physical conditioning and sports skills. Courses helps students to learn how to make personal exercise schedules which both suits their own wills and actual physical conditions. It also helps students to learn how to prevent and how to treat common sports injuries. In addition, acquiring basic and theoretical knowledge of sports can contribute the cultivation of sports culture literacy and sports appreciation ability. 2. To teach students sports skills and scientific exercise theories and methods. The courses aim at encouraging students to participate in various physical activities, and mastering several effective exercise skills and methods. By means of the PE learning, students can improve their sports literacy, engage in sports activities independently, and develop good and healthy exercise habits, all of which will benefit them all their lives. 3. To improve their understanding of body and health through the learning process. PE courses contribute to adjust students’ physical and mental health, and develop a positive and optimistic attitude towards life. 4. To strengthen quality education in PE courses. Quality education is quite crucial in making students realize and how to do with the relation between morality, intelligence, and physical exercises. By means of the quality education in PE courses, students tend to establish a correct sports morality, take initiatives and cultivate assertive personalities including courage, solidarity, enterprise, fearlessness. (3) PE Curriculum Settings Sports Department in Harbin Institute of Technology effectively improves the overall functions of PE curriculum, through the integration of multidisciplinary knowledge and the interrelationship within the curriculum system. Taking climate, environment and campus situation into consideration, Sports department opens a variety of PE courses to satisfy students with different interests and skills to its maximum. Details of the courses open are as follows. 1. Physical Training Courses School team (high level group and sunshine group): Track and Field, Basketball, Table Tennis, Swimming, Speed Skating, Curling, Badminton, Football, Volleyball, Martial Arts, Aerobics and so on. 2. Special Training Courses Football, Basketball, Badminton, Table Tennis, Tennis, Martial Arts, Taekwondo, Outdoor Sports, Swimming, Cycling, Curling, Floorball and so on. 3. Optional Courses Basketball, basketball referee, Volleyball (balloon volleyball, soft volleyball), Football (snow football), Table Tennis, Badminton, Tennis, Martial Arts, Sanda, Fighting Fitness, Bodybuilding, Aerobics, ballet, sports dance, yoga, swimming, Speed roller skating, Cycling, Outdoor Sports, Floorball, Curling, Winter Outdoor Hiking, Ice Skating, Alpine Skiing, Snowfield Hockey, Yukigassen and so on. 4. default.en: (1) Purposes of PE Curriculum There are three main purposes of PE Curriculum. First, based on physical exercises, the curriculum aims at enhancing students’ physical and mental health through effective teaching methods, diversified ways of doing exercises and scientific self-monitoring process. Second, the curriculum helps to form the lifelong habit of participating in physical exercises through inspiring students’ sports interest and enhancing their sports awareness and sports skills. The most important is that the curriculum is helpful to serve the all-round development of moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic and labor qualified talents through training more students with the “health first” consciousness (2) PE Curriculum Tasks 1. To improve students’ physical conditioning and sports skills. Courses helps students to learn how to make personal exercise schedules which both suits their own wills and actual physical conditions. It also helps students to learn how to prevent and how to treat common sports injuries. In addition, acquiring basic and theoretical knowledge of sports can contribute the cultivation of sports culture literacy and sports appreciation ability. 2. To teach students sports skills and scientific exercise theories and methods. The courses aim at encouraging students to participate in various physical activities, and mastering several effective exercise skills and methods. By means of the PE learning, students can improve their sports literacy, engage in sports activities independently, and develop good and healthy exercise habits, all of which will benefit them all their lives. 3. To improve their understanding of body and health through the learning process. PE courses contribute to adjust students’ physical and mental health, and develop a positive and optimistic attitude towards life. 4. To strengthen quality education in PE courses. Quality education is quite crucial in making students realize and how to do with the relation between morality, intelligence, and physical exercises. By means of the quality education in PE courses, students tend to establish a correct sports morality, take initiatives and cultivate assertive personalities including courage, solidarity, enterprise, fearlessness. (3) PE Curriculum Settings Sports Department in Harbin Institute of Technology effectively improves the overall functions of PE curriculum, through the integration of multidisciplinary knowledge and the interrelationship within the curriculum system. Taking climate, environment and campus situation into consideration, Sports department opens a variety of PE courses to satisfy students with different interests and skills to its maximum. Details of the courses open are as follows. 1. Physical Training Courses School team (high level group and sunshine group): Track and Field, Basketball, Table Tennis, Swimming, Speed Skating, Curling, Badminton, Football, Volleyball, Martial Arts, Aerobics and so on. 2. Special Training Courses Football, Basketball, Badminton, Table Tennis, Tennis, Martial Arts, Taekwondo, Outdoor Sports, Swimming, Cycling, Curling, Floorball and so on. 3. Optional Courses Basketball, basketball referee, Volleyball (balloon volleyball, soft volleyball), Football (snow football), Table Tennis, Badminton, Tennis, Martial Arts, Sanda, Fighting Fitness, Bodybuilding, Aerobics, ballet, sports dance, yoga, swimming, Speed roller skating, Cycling, Outdoor Sports, Floorball, Curling, Winter Outdoor Hiking, Ice Skating, Alpine Skiing, Snowfield Hockey, Yukigassen and so on. 4. Basics Training Courses Basic Track and Field, Hiking, Cycling, Swimming, Sports for Fitness and so on. 5. Physical Fitness Courses Tai Chi, Guided Health Preservation, Ba Duan Jin (Ancient Chinese Qigong), Hiking and so on.

default.zh: 本课程是面向英才学院、数学学院等对物理要求较高专业的本科生开设，旨在为培养非物理类专业研究型人才打好物理基础。基于研究型大学的教学理念，本课程采用研究型教学模式。通过本课程的学习，使学生全面的认识和正确的理解物理学的基本概念、基本理论和基本方法。本课程把培养学生分析问题和解决问题能力、掌握以物理学思维特征为基础的思维能力、以及科学素质和创新精神放在第一位。教学内容以教育部高等学校非物理类专业物理基础课程教学指导委员会“非物理类理工学科大学物理课程教学基本要求”为基础。精讲经典，巩固基础，着重加强近代物理，充分反映前沿。
default.en: This course aims to lay a good foundation of physics for non-physics professional research talents, opened to undergraduate in Honor School、Mathematics and other majors with high requirements on physics. This course adopts a research-based teaching model based on the teaching philosophy of a research-based university. The students should comprehensive and correct understand the basic concept、theories and method through the course learning. This course puts the cultivation of students' ability to analyze and solve problems, the cultivation of students' thinking ability based on physical thinking characteristics, and the cultivation of students' scientific quality and innovative spirit in the first place. The teaching content is based on the basic teaching requirement of the non-physical science and engineering college physics course, which developed by non-physical major physical basic course Teaching Guidance Committee of Tertiary Institutions of the Ministry of the Education. Concentrate on the classics, consolidate the foundation, emphasize the strengthening of modern physics, and fully reflect the frontier.

default.zh: 物理实验课程是一门学习物理实验基本知识、基本方法，培养学生科学实验基本能力，激发学生探索精神、创新精神的一门重要的基础实验课程。课程内容涵盖力、热、声、电、光、近代物理等诸多领域的实验技术。 本课程学时总数为33学时，是大学物理实验系列课程的第一阶段。其中大课讲授3学时，主要内容为误差与实验数据处理，该部分内容涉及科学实验的基础理论和基础知识，因此十分重要。实验为30学时，每人必须完成10个实验项目，并提供完整的实验报告。实验采用开放式教学，实验室选择开出17个实验项目。除部分必做实验外，学生可根据个人情况选择完成，鼓励学生多选、多做实验。
default.en: The course of College physics experiment is a fundamental course covering Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Acoustics, Electricity, Optics and Modern Physics. The aim of this course is to acquaint students with the elements of physical measurement techniques, data analysis, preliminary preparation for data collection and error estimation. This course helps to inspire the students' creative and exploring spirit. The course is designed for 33 lab hours. It is the first part of the College physics experiment course. One 3-hour lecture period is to help students to understand the error estimation and data analysis theory at the beginning. Ten 3-hour lab periods are for students to do experiment. All the 10 experiments must be finished during the third semester. Each experiment lasts 3 lab hours and 10 experiments should be completed in each semester, during which 17 experiments are arranged in an open style. Except for those compulsory experiments, students can choose other experiments to their own interests and are encouraged to do more experiments than what's required.

default.zh: 物理实验课程是一门学习物理实验基本知识、基本方法，培养学生科学实验基本能力，激发学生探索精神、创新精神的一门重要的基础实验课程。课程内容涵盖力、热、声、电、光、近代物理等诸多领域的实验技术。 本课程学时总数为27学时，全部为实验学时。本课程是大学物理实验系列课程的第二阶段，目标是使学生在掌握基础实验技能的基础上进一步提升解决实际问题的能力。课程要求每人必须完成9个实验项目，并提供完整的实验报告。实验采用开放式教学，实验室开出17个实验项目，不设必做实验，学生可根据个人情况选择完成，鼓励学生多选、多做实验。
default.en: The course of College physics experiment is a fundamental course covering Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Acoustics, Electricity, Optics and Modern Physics. The aim of this course is to acquaint students with the elements of physical measurement techniques, data analysis, preliminary preparation for data collection and error estimation. This course helps to inspire the students' creative and exploring spirit. The course is designed for 27 lab hours. It is the second part of the College physics experiment course, and is designed to help students to assist the students to grasp the fundamental experimental skill and operating technique, to raise their ability to analyze and solve problems. Nine 3-hour lab periods are for students to do experiment. All the 9 experiments must be finished during the fourth semester. Each experiment lasts 3 lab hours and 9 experiments should be completed, during which 17 experiments are arranged in an open style. Students can choose other experiments to their own interests and are encouraged to do more experiments than what's required.

default.zh: 随着数字化、多媒体、互联网等科技的高速发展，为满足国家创意产业与制造业发展的需求，培养技术与艺术结合的交叉性创新设计人才，当下数字媒体的设计与开发迎来了新的机遇与挑战。基于目前最先进、功能最强大、最流行的三维场景、人物交互设计引擎Unity3D，本课程将提供学生一个绝佳的机会对数字媒体的设计与开发有一个基本、全面的了解和掌握。 Unity3D支持当今几乎所有的数字媒体平台，包括Windows10， Mac，安卓（Android），苹果（IOS）和WWW等。用Unity3D可以在很大程度上降低设计和开发的入门难度，充分激发学生的兴趣。本课程将主要覆盖设计的基本理论，以及开发中最基本但又最重要的环节，包括C#编程，场景的设计，物体的控制，声效，动画，纹理，光照等。借鉴和采用西方发达国家的教学模式，老师将主要用英语授课（包括课堂讲座，实验，答疑等）。 不过对于游戏理论和开发的难点、要点， 会根据情况用中文讲解或补充。
default.en: This course will provide an excellent opportunity for students to design and develop interactive media, based on Unity3D which is the most popular and powerful 3D engine. Students will learn and master the fundamental and yet important aspect of design and development of digital media (such as animation, graphics, games, virtual reality, etc.), including scene design, control of objects, user interaction, sound, animation, texture, lighting and so on.
